instructions: Heat a little oil in a non stick fry pan. Fry the beef in the pan on each side in a few batches. Reserve about half of the beef. Place the ziti into a colander and press out as much water as possible. Place into a medium bowl. Put 1 cup of the beef, capicum and orange peel in the ziti and mix together. Divide the ziti between individual serving bowls. Pour over the cheese and beef sauce over the top.

title: Hot Sandwich - Starbucks
ingredients: 1 ripe pear, peeled, cored, and diced small | 8 -12 leaves iceberg lettuce, torn into small shreds | 1 jar sliced pimientos | 1/4 cup coffee | cracked iceberg lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: Place the pear pieces and lettuce in a large bowl. Mix in the pimiento slices and pour the coffee over everything.

title: Chipotle Roasted Duck
ingredients: 5 lbs duck, fresh | 3 1/2 cups kale, raw | 4 cans tomato juice | 2 cans chipotle chiles, diced | 1 can red snapper, diced | 1 large red ripe tomatoes, diced | 12 ounces sake ( rice wine works best ) | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Score and wash duck under cold running water until any large blood seeps out. Dry well on a rack set over a roasting pan. Bour bones with fat from duck. Rinse duck inside and out, pat dry with paper towels. Place duck in 2 - 11 by 7 inch baking pans spaced slightly apart. Roast in preheated 350f oven about 45 minutes for medium done duck or until the skin browns. Transfer to a jelly roll pan and keep warm. Combine all ingredients except saki in large bowl, cover and let stand overnight. Uncover turkey and bake 45 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 325f, carefully remove roasting pan from oven. With back of spoon, spread saki over bottom and sides of duck. Return to oven and bake about 1 hour longer, basting regularly with juices. Remove duck and let stand 5 minutes. If desired, slice turkey.

title: Cherry Tomatoes in Sour Sauce (Spain-Yukon De Vinho)
ingredients: 6 green onions, finely chopped ( scallions ) | 1 1/2 lbs small cherry tomatoes
instructions: Boil tomatoes in water 15 minutes or until tender, drain and reserve. Stir scallions into tomatoes. Stir in tomato juice. Simmer 1 minute. Serve warm or at room temperature. Do not overcook.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,spinach leaf,bread flour,edible flower,rice flour,courgette,baby bella mushroom,pomegranate
title: Spinach Salad With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 medium courgette, washed, peeled and cut into half inch rounds | 8 baby bella mushrooms, washed and sliced | 10 fresh spinach leaves, washed and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon mint, chopped | 1 tablespoon pomegranate, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, dissolved | 1 tablespoon bread flour
instructions: Heat the oil in an earthenware casserole or flat top pan. Add the courgette, mushrooms, beetlla and spinach leaves. In a separate container, mix together the rice flour, mint, pomegranate juice, vanilla bean and bread flour. Dissolve into a thick glaze. Pour over the mixed vegetables. Cover and simmer gently until tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Ww 3 Points - Cheese Baked in Baking Onions
ingredients: 1 cup grated pecorino cheese | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 250f degrees and place baking sheets in oven. Brush onions lightly with olive oil spray, about 30 seconds per side. Place on a baking sheet and bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. When cool, crumble and stir into onion/cheese mixture. Sprinkle ww 3 points over cheese mixture and serve. Goes well with a twisty french bread or fresh veggies. Note 1, if grated cheese mixture is too dry, add a little water. If mixture is too thin add a little more water and cheese.

title: Grilled Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons espresso powder | 3 lbs grated gruyere cheese or 3 lbs cheddar cheese | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped sage or 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/2 cup finely chopped dried apricot | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill or 2 teaspoons dried dill | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 12 inch round pan with cooking spray. Combine espresso powder with the gruyere in a large ziploc. Seal bag and shake to coat the cheeses completely. Spread cheese in the pan. Stir sage or rosemary, apricots, and dill into cheese. Arrange lettuce around and over cheese and pour espresso mixture over, smoothing top with a spatula or a fork. Turn the rack in middle position, and place baking sheet on baking sheet. Bake until the espresso starts to brown on top, about 25 minutes. Slice and serve.

title: Tuna Patties
ingredients: 1 can tuna in olive oil | 1/2 cup italian seasoned bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons ground coriander
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Mix tuna, bread crumbs, and ground coriander together in a bowl. Lightly form mixture into patties. Heat 2 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown on the bottom.

title: Moroccan Fish
ingredients: 1 white fish fillet, 1 1/2 inch diameter cut into 2 - 3 pieces | 1/2 cup green olives, pitted and halved
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange the fish on a broiler pan or in a shallow baking dish. If there are any gaps between pieces, use your fingers to moisten them with a little water. Broil about 4 inches from the heat for 3 minutes, to the color of the fish, turning over once. Transfer the fish to a work surface. Make several slits, about 1 inch deep on both sides of the fish. Top with olives. Broil about 1 minute. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: fish,egg yolk,sherry wine,bermuda onion,cauliflower floret,red onion,dijon mustard,hot green chili pepper
title: Fish Cakes With Cauliflower and Onions (Aruba)
ingredients: 4 ounces sliced fish | 2 tablespoons chopped red onions | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled hot green chili peppers | 1/3 cup chopped cauliflower floret | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon red onion, minced
instructions: Put fish on a plate. Mix together the remaing ingredients and season with a pinch of salt. Stir the sauce, adding a tbsp at a time until it is right to use. Pour over the fish and toss lightly. Cover and marinate for 30 minutes. Drain off any excess marinade and stir fry the onions. Serve fish cakes along with the onions and sauce.

title: Fried Applesauce II
ingredients: 2 cups chunky salsa | 3/4 cup white sugar or 3/4 cup brown sugar | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 medium yellow onion, finely chopped | 3 lbs ground veal | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Mix together salsa, sugar, oil, and onion. Set aside 15 minutes to allow flavors to blend. In a large skillet, lightly brown ground veal. Mix in the sauce mixture. Simmer 5 minutes over low heat. Serve on rice.

title: Guacamole Bread & Raspberry Snack
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1/4 cup fresh oregano, chopped | 100 g guacamole | 4 tablespoons marsala wine | 4 tablespoons raspberry, diced | 2 slices french bread, toasted
instructions: Place the flour in a large bowl, add the oregano and mix well to combine. Stir in the guacamole, marsala and raspberries. Use your hands to rub the mix into the toasted bread pieces. Allow bread pieces to absorb the flavours of the mix prior to transferring onto an ovenproof dish. Broil at c for 5 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Easy Creamy Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream mushroom soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced cloves
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Let chill overnight on the counter. Serve with bread or rolls.

title: Kormom's Mulled Wine
ingredients: 2 fluid ounces burgundy wine | 1 jar curry paste | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Pour the Burgundy into a large, shallow, glass baking dish. Stir in curry paste, and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 6 hours, shaking the dish occasionally. Stir in the vanilla essence. Turn out onto a large, chilled serving dish, and serve with fresh bread slices or chunks of french bread.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,pie apple,dark sesame oil,mustard powder,coriander powder
title: Apple Sesame Oil Pies
ingredients: 1 medium pie apple, grated or 1 medium onion, finely chopped finely | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda, a baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Peel, core and shred the apple. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, mixing well. Divide the mixture into 12 equal portions and roll each into a 10cm/1in/8in thick patty. Arrange the patties on a lightly greased & floured oven tray, allowing room for rolling. Cook for 12 - 15 minutes, or until crisp & browned on the underside.

title: Smells Pita Bread Pizzas
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup ( campbell's select harvest ) | 4 pita breads ( i used the pita bread ones )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread one can of cream of mushroom soup on the bottom of a 9x13 baking pan. Spread the pita bread out on the soup spoon. Spread the second can of mushroom soup over the pita bread, using the pita bread. Place under the broiler on the top shelf of the oven and just watch it so it does not burn. Watch it like this. You can also place a baking sheet under it to catch any spillover or drippings. Cut into 4 pieces and serve. If you want to be more labor intensive, use a small, sharp knife to slice them out of the oven before putting in the oven.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom black chinese,pearl onion,thyme sprig
title: Homemade Mushrooms Stock
ingredients: 1 cup whole dried shiitake mushroom ( or chinese dried black chinese mushroom caps ) | 1 dried thyme sprig | 2 pints ready to use stock
instructions: Place dried mushroom caps, 1 mushroom at a time, in cold water to cover. Allow to soak until all liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes, or, if desired, 30 minutes. Rinse mushroom caps with cold water and remove stems, gills, and loose skins. Place mushrooms in a large pot, add the thyme and bring to a boil. Add the stock and bring to a full boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until mushrooms are tender, about 30 minutes. Remove pot from the heat and set aside for 30 minutes. Using an immersion blender, return mushrooms to the stock and heat just to boiling. Serve in soup cups or hot, sterilized tins.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,phyllo pastry,blueberry,splenda sugar substitute,yukon gold potato
title: Potato Phyllo Bundles
ingredients: 6 small yukon gold potatoes, peeled, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups blueberries, fresh, fresh or frozen | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 2 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute | 1/4 cup fat free fat free egg free lemon-flavored liquid calorie | 12 sheets phyllo pastry ( frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a 13x9 pan with cooking spray and set aside. Layer the phyllo in the bottom of the pan, brushing each with some liquid, then brushing with additional liquid every 4 sheets. Layer the potatoes on top of the sheets, sprinkling them inches. Sprinkle with caraway seeds. Sprinkle with splenda. Layer the blueberries evenly on top of the potatoes. Make a lengthwise slit in each phyllo sheet 1/2 inch deep and brush each side generously with egg and then with fat free liquid. Bake at 375°f for 25 - 30 minutes until browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,beef bouillon cube,allspice,beef tenderloin fillet,lime wedge,sun tomato oil,fennel seed
title: Broiled Italian Beef With Noodles
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin fillets | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon ground fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 8 cups broccoli florets | 8 slices sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 8 lime wedges
instructions: In 8 qt saucepan, place beef over medium heat and brown on both sides, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Remove meat to plate.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,beef sirloin steak,pasta,swiss cheese,tarragon,tamari
title: Budget Tender Steak With Swiss Cheese & Tarragon Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 australian rare beef sirloin steak, about 12 ounces each | 1/2 cup dried tri-colored pasta ( such as orecchiette, gemelli, or rigatoni ) | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 3 tablespoons red currant jelly | 2 slices swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons tamari ( dark sesame paste can be substituted )
instructions: Soak dried tri colored pasta in boiling water for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cut sirloin into 2 x 1/2. Remove sirloin from water.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,garlic powder,kiwi fruit,prosciutto,stewing beef,button mushroom,white pepper,cottage cheese
title: Fantastic French Slizzle Loose-Wrap Beef Rollups
ingredients: 5 ounces lean stewing beef, cut 3/4-inch thick | 2 tablespoons cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons kraft garlic and herb spreadable cheese | 2 teaspoons dried hawthorne's red wine vinegar or 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon dried garlic powder | 1 small green bell pepper, cut into strips | 1 large kiwi fruit, peeled, cut into sticks
instructions: In 3 1/2 x 3 1/2 inch rectangle on wax paper, spread cottage cheese with garlic spreadable cheese spread, making small rectangle spread with each cheese spread. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon each salt, white pepper and wine vinegar to taste. Starting at short end of long side of long, roll up jellyroll style. Place seam side down on wax paper. Repeat procedure to remove wax paper. Slice crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Transfer roll to wax paper lined trays, making 8 equal sections. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours. Combine 1/8 teaspoon red pepper powder and garlic powder. Brush both ends of roll with mixture and sprinkle with more powder mixture. Sprinkle with green bell pepper rings and cut kiwifruit over. Serve with crackers or assorted fruit.

Random Ingredients: masa harina,pecorino romano cheese,emmenthaler cheese,veal,star anise,hot pepper sauce
title: Italian Gravy
ingredients: 2 lbs veal | 1/2 cup masa harina | 1 ounce pecorino romano cheese | 1 ounce manjar ground espresso or 1 ounce parmesan cheese | chile hot pepper sauce | 1 star anise ( optional )
instructions: Cut veal into 1/2 inch strips, each about 1/2 inch long and 1/2 inch wide. Mix all ingredients in a bowl. The sauce should be quite thin, although it should not be liquid. You cook it right away, but it can also be kept overnight. Dry the gravy in a paper towel to remove as much excess moisture as possible.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,sunflower oil,pineapple preserve,salsa,green cardamom pod
title: Crispy Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 4 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1/3 cup unsweetened pineapple preserves | 1 cup salsa | 3/4 cup icing sugar
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a heavy medium skillet over medium heat. Fry the cardamom pods for one minutes, then remove from pan, but leave for about five seconds. Remove and discard the pods, reserving oil. Heat half the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the preserves and pineapple concentrate, stir and cook for a few minutes until almost dry. Remove from heat. Add about 2/3 of the salsa and the pista.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,cardamom powder,anise extract,radish,yeast,maraschino cherry,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Cauliflower Cheese and Smoked Pepper Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 1 tablespoon anise extract | 1 1/2 cups lowfat monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend shredded | 5 cups cauliflower florets | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom powder | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon anise extract ( or to taste ) | 1 medium radish, sliced super thin ( optional ) | 1 jar maraschino cherries ( optional ) or ( 5 ounce ) jar cherry tomatoes, halved ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over 1 cup warm water. Let sit until dissolved and foamy. Add 3 cups cheese, mix well. Set aside. Stir yeast mixture, anise extract, 7 cups cauliflower florets, cardamon, and 1/2 cup arise flavored extract into flour mixture. Add more spices if desired. Cut 12 - 12 slices from mozart's cheddar cheese. Dunk chedderia into filling, coating each with mozart's cheese. Cover and let rise until doubled. Punch down, add remaining cheese. Cover and let rise. Punch down, top each piece with mozart's chedderia slices and enjoy you are done.

title: Yucatan Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 medium head iceberg lettuce | 1 medium yellow bell pepper | 1 medium sweet red chilies | 4 medium tomatoes | 12 small thin radishes | 3 tablespoons diced noodle ( to serve )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, combine all lettuce, pepper and chilies. Finely dice the tomatoes and radishes into thin slices. Dice the noodle into 1 cubes. Mix well with the lettuce mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Broccoli Rabe and Shell Pasta
ingredients: 8 cups uncooked shell pasta | 1 pound broccoli rabe, trimmed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the shell pasta in the pot, and cook 2 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,green bell pepper,prune,adobo sauce,apple
title: Grilled Apple or Pepper Stripline (Or Bamboo Shoots)
ingredients: 4 large green bell peppers | 4 large apple, cored and sliced | 1/4 cup seasoned rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce | 1/4 cup chopped pitted prune
instructions: Cut peppers into thin strips. Toss with vinegar and adobo. Add prunes.

title: Chinese Steak Ball
ingredients: 1 lb top round steak, cut into 1 by 1 inch pieces | 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1/2 medium onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup ketchup
instructions: Heat oil in skillet or wok until very hot. Carefully add in the steaks and stir fry, or let brown on both sides. Remove from skillet and set aside. In same skillet, mix the onion and ketchup.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,dark rum,self rising flour,pumpkin,white pepper,black bean,peach,ham hock
title: Creamy Ham and Bean Scones
ingredients: 1 can black beans ( drained and rinsed well. ) | 1 cup canned pumpkin ( drained & rinsed well, or regular pumpkin ) | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries ( chopped ) | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 lb ham hock | 8 1/2 ounces self-rising flour ( or wholemeal flour ) | 2 ounces white breadcrumbs ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, and using your hands, rub the mix with your fingers until ingredients hold together well. Divide the mixture between two lightly greased 8 inch square baking sheets. Place into oven, turn heat down to 350f and cook for 25 - 30 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve with toast or cream.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,irish cream,chicken bouillon cube,mexicorn,mexican oregano,fruit,yogurt
title: Soupe Momma's Vegetable Soup (Homemade or Not)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 4 cups cubed mixed vegetables | 2 chicken bouillon cubes ( i used beef broth cubes or equivalent ) | 2 cups mexicorn ( fresh or thawed ) | 4 tablespoons thickened yogurt | 4 tablespoons orange-flavored frozen fruit, frozen
instructions: Pour brown syrup into a sauce pan and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,pecorino romano cheese,soymilk,vanilla,stewing beef,extra virgin olive oil,corn kernel,chive
title: Tibetan Beef Milkshake
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon dried chives | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon fresh minced chives | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, finely grated | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh chives | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder or 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: In a small bowl, combine marinade ingredients. Add the beef and allow it to marinate for 10 minutes. Remove the beef from the marinade. Heat a wok over medium high heat. Add the olive oil, swirl to coat the wok and add the beef, marinade and chives and saute for about 5 minutes. Add in the soy milk and mix well. Cover and simmer for five minutes, while stirring occasionally. Add in the vanilla, salt, chives and mix well. Serve with jasmine rice and fresh parsley.

title: Carnival Surimi
ingredients: 1/2 pound chopped imitation crabmeat | 1/2 pound rhubarb, chopped | 2/3 cup dry white wine | 12 taco shells
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Drain crabmeat.

title: Italian Sausage and Marinara Sauce (Marinara)
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 28 fluid ounces tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices and cook in a heavy skillet or dutch oven over medium heat, stirring to crumble, until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Add tomato paste and oregano leaves. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until sauce is slightly reduced and flavors have blended, at least 2 hours but up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,horseradish,yellow pepper,butternut squash,peanut canola oil,vanilla bean,pearl barley
title: Barley, Squash and Orzo Salad Morocco
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 2 cups butternut squash or 2 cups hubbard squash, cut into thin, thin wedges | 1 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 orange, juice from | 1/2 vanilla bean | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 1/4 cup chopped salted peanut canola oil | 1/2 yellow pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: Combine barley, squash and orange juice in a large bowl. In a frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon peanut oil over medium heat. Add the bean sprouts and orange juice with the vanilla bean and horseradish. Cook, stirring until the beansare bright in color and the squash is tender crisp, about 5 minutes. In a salad bowl toss the barley, squash, orange juice, and peanut canola oil. Garnish with chopped peppers.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,black tea,peanut oil vegetable,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Arabic Spiced Tea Mix - for Bread, Toast or Toast
ingredients: 4 tablespoons black tea | 1 teaspoon raspberry ground in spice mix | 1 tablespoon rails ( el hanout spice mix ) or 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1 tablespoon icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar )
instructions: Measure 4 cups of fresh tea and add it to a cup of water. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, then pour the tea into a large bowl. Allow the tea to cool and then stir in the remaining ingredients.. Store the tea in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,tarragon,apple,tamarind paste,sage,corn kernel,lemon juice zest,sauce
title: Tamarind Tatin
ingredients: 2 cans sliced corn kernels | 1/2 apple, peeled and grated | 1/4 cup lemon juice, zest of | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 3/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1/2 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine corn and remaining ingredients in a mixing bowl. Divide mixture between two pizza crusts. Bake for 7 - 10 minutes or until crust is golden and bubbly. Remove from oven, and allow to cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: The Best Tamari Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamari, tamarind paste | 2/3 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Combine tamari and whipped topping in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake bottle until completely mixed, adding more sugar if desired. Serve over greens in large salad bowls.

title: Sweet N' Savory Pasta & Coconut
ingredients: 300 g sweet noodles ( spaghetti, cellophane pasta or other sweet pasta ) | 4 tablespoons arrowroot | 1/4 teaspoon old bay seasoning, combined with | 1 fresh thyme sprig | 200 g shredded coconut | 2 bamboo skewers, soaked in cold water
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Dissolve arrowroot in the boiling water. Add Old Bay and thyme and return to a boil. Add sweet pasta and noodles and simmer until al dente. Remove sweet pasta and noodle from water and run under cold water in a sieve catching any remaining ‘bits’. Drain noodles and noodle on absorbent paper. Serve immediately.

title: Fluffy Baked Baked Eggplant (Aubergine) and Bacon Rolls
ingredients: 4 medium eggplants ( or zucchini ) | 2 slices bacon, diced finely | 2 slices brown rice ( uncooked ) | 2 sheets puff pastry ( i use fat free prepared ) | 4 teaspoons xanthan gum
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180c. Cut slashes widthways down one side of each eggplant and slice thickly. Boil for 7 - 10 minutes, then place in a colander, drain. Cut out the core with a sharp knife and place on a baking tray lined with baking paper and prick all over with a fork. Place the eggplant slices in the oven and bake for about an hour. The eggplant should be tender and soft. This should take around 20 - 30 minutes. Check every so often so it doesn't burn. Drain the eggplant, return them to the pan with the bacon and brown rice and bake for a further 15 minutes. If all the rolls are browning too quickly, check the timing with the bacon, the bacon should be fairly crispy, and gooey. Allow to cool slightly and then cut the rolls in half. Place 2 tbsp filling in the centre of each roll and fold the roll around the filling taking care to seal the edges. Place onto a baking paper lined tray and bake for 25 - 30 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: allspice,gingerroot,taco seasoning mix,onion salt,salt pepper,beef stew meat,mirin,pita bread
title: Japanese-Style Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup mirin | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion with | allspice | 1/2 tablespoon salt | 1 teaspoon crushed gingerroot | 7 pita bread, rolls sliced in half crosswise
instructions: Place meat in slow cooker. Add remaining ingredients except bread. Cover.

title: Baja Beef With Cod (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut in 1 inch cubes | 1 whole chicken bouillon cubes or 1 large chicken bouillon bouillon | 1 1/2 lbs cod, or 1 1/2 lbs halibut
instructions: In a large casserole dish add the beef, bouillon and enough water to barely cover the meat. Bake covered over a low hear for 2 hours, till meat is tender. Remove meat, and cover to keep warm, if desired. Skim off fat from beef pan juices. Remove cover, and boil rapidly till some of the juices run clear. Turn meat often, cover and simmer over very low heat 3 to 4 hours. Check often to make sure liquid doesn't boil away, or you may have too much liquid. About 30 minutes before serving, remove lid and boil rapidly until meat is tender, taste for seasoning. Remove from heat, and let meat cool completely.

title: Tajine Pork Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 hamburger | 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1/4 tablespoon ground turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger or 1/4 teaspoon garlic | 1/4 teaspoon mace or 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large, nonstick skillet. Heat over medium high heat and cook, stirring occasionally, for 6 to 8 minutes or until mixture is very hot. Cool 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: aceto balsamico,spring onion,green pea,flat leaf parsley,guacamole
title: Guatro Ranch Fresh Green Pea Salad
ingredients: 6 1/2 cups fresh green peas ( or frozen ) | 1 large spring onion, minced | 1 1/2 cups bottled bottled anaheim chilies in balsamico, minced ( about 3 large peppers ) or 1 1/2 cups bottled green chili peppers, minced ( about 3 large peppers ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons pure aceto balsamico ( or other achiote-flavored liqueur ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons other balsamic vinegar | chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, garnish, and
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.

title: Apricot Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix | 10 -12 brussels sprouts | 5 dried apricot halves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Chill thoroughly covered. Will keep in refrigerator up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,red bell pepper,chipotle pepper,kidney bean,jasmine rice,baking potato,pork loin chop
title: Sweet Chili Pork and Beans Bake
ingredients: 1 sweet potato, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 red bell pepper, cut into chunks | 1 chipotle pepper, chopped, or more to taste | 1 boneless pork loin chops, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 3 chipotle peppers, chopped | 2 cups cooked jasmine rice | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stir sweet potato, red bell pepper, and chipotle peppers together in a bowl. Toss pork, kidney beans, chipotle pepper, and rice together in a separate bowl. Spread bean mixture into the bottom of a baking dish. Spoon pork and rice mixture over bean mixture. Spread chocolate over pork and rice.

title: Hot Cocoa
ingredients: 16 ounces raw cocoa powder | 2 lemons, juice and zest of
instructions: First, put the raw cocoa in a large bowl and stir it to mix. Add the lemon juice and zest and mix. Store in a dry glass container, or a deep bowl, for 1 or 2 days before using. Shake well before using, because drinking chocolate is very hot. You can burn the cocoa if left unattended too long.

Random Ingredients: cheese tortellini,black sesame seed,spring onion,black pepper,oil
title: Tortellini Salad
ingredients: 250 g cheese tortellini | oil ( for frying ) | 1 bunch spring onion | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds | black pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Cook tortellini in a saucepan with a little water until soft, drain well and rinse under cold water. Mix spring onion with sesame seeds and black pepper, mix together with heated tortellini and chill for 2 hours in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,whipping cream,ginger,bell pepper,red wine vinegar,allspice
title: Kerry's Sweet Peppered Paprika Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 large yellow onions | 1/3 cup bell pepper, coarsley chopped | 1/2 cup sweet red wine vinegar | 3 -4 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 2 teaspoons ground allspice
instructions: Peel and slice the onions. I cut one in half and then slice it cross-wise into 1/8 slices. Whisk the vinegar, cream, ginger and allspice until well blended. Coat each slice of onions with the vinaigrette to taste. Cook, covered, on a preheated, griddle over medium heat until tender and dark brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Italian Tortilla Cake
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pure vanilla beans | 1 pinch italian seasoning or 1 pinch mrs. dash seasoning blend | 1 small white kidney beans, cooked & drained | 12 soft tortillas | 1/2 cup grated italian cheese blend ( optional ) or 1/2 cup shredded reduced fat sharp cheddar cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven if using casserole dish. In large mixing bowl stir together the beans, spice mixture, onion and half of the cheese. Spoon bean mixture in ungreased and floured 9 inch pie plate. Cut tortillas into 12 wedges and arrange on top. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake for 15 minutes, or until puffy.

title: Black Bean-Chill Salad
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup enoki mushrooms, sliced | 1 package frozen cut peaches with stems
instructions: Mix black beans, enoki mushrooms, and frozen sliced peaches together in a bowl. Just before serving, stir in more black bean juice if desired.

title: Indonesian Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup bean sprouts | 1/3 cup shallot, finely chopped | 1/3 cup scallion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pickled gherkin, finely chopped ( filipino cucumber ) | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Soak bean sprouts in water 15 minutes, then drain. In a bowl, mix bean sprouts, shallot, scallion, and gherkin until mixed well. Heat a large non stick skillet over high heat. When hot, wet your hand with water and quickly form the mixture into 1 inch diameter meatballs. Remove meatballs from pan, but reserve pan drippings. Place the meatballs in the hot skillet and cook until they are cooked through, about 3 minutes. Remove the meatballs from skillet. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: lemon,splenda sugar substitute,banana,dijon mustard,egg yolk,taco seasoning,lavender flower
title: Banana Taters
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe bananas, mashed | 1 tablespoon dried lavender flowers | 2 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 3/4 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 3/4 teaspoon lemon rind, julienned | 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine mashed bananas, lavender flowers, mustard, splenda and lemon rind. In a small bowl, combine egg yolk and taco seasoning. Stir egg yolk mixture into mashed banana mixture. Mix well. Spoon mixture in well greased muffin tins. Bake 15 to 18 minutes or until nicely browned.

title: Mixed Green Olives
ingredients: 1/4 cup coriander | 1/4 cup green olives ( such as nicoise ) | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 2 -3 teaspoons gingerroot, grated
instructions: Stir all of the ingredients together and store in refrigerator up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,salsa,coconut milk,picante sauce,banana,thai red curry paste
title: Sweet and Savory Curry Bananas
ingredients: 4 bananas, sliced | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 3 tablespoons coconut milk | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup crushed sweetened coconut flakes, or to taste
instructions: Place the curry paste into a skillet over medium heat, and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Pour in the coconut milk, and cook, stirring frequently, until the coconut cream is thickened and beginning to brown, about 3 minutes. Taste and add more coconut if desired.

title: Lamb Chops in Fettuccine, Bacon Wrapped in Mayonnaise.
ingredients: 8 lamb chops | 1/2 teaspoon dried fettuccine | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard | 1 shallot, minced
instructions: Season lamb with onion salt, pepper, cinnamon and mustard. Marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour. Heat a grill pan or griddle over medium high heat. Grill lamb for about 4 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Raspberry and Coriander
ingredients: 2 1/2 kg beef tenderloin | 2 -3 teaspoons coriander seeds | 100 g raspberries, frozen thawed | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 slices baguette, halved lengthways
instructions: Preheat oven 200c/180c fan forced. Cut small round slits in the top of the beef and sprinkle with one third of the coriander seeds, reserving them for garnish. Place the beef on a board and stud with the remaining coriander seeds. Cut 2 slits in the top of each slice. Place meat, fat side up, on a lightly oiled oven tray. Roast for 25 minutes. Set oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Cook for further 15 minutes or until cooked as required. Slice meat and serve with the raspberries and syrup. Garnish with the reserved coriander seeds.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,tamari,broccoli floret,baby spinach,tart apple,rice flour,rump steak,ketchup
title: Tibetan-Style Steak With Apples and Greens
ingredients: 1/3 cup ketchup | 2 teaspoons tamari ( or 2 teaspoons soy sauce ) | 1 lb rump steak, trimmed ( or other firm, fast fryable beef, cut into bite-sized cubes ) | 3 tablespoons rice flour, preferably brown rice flour | 8 ounces fresh baby spinach, cleaned, stemmed and washed | 4 small tart apples, such as fuji, golden delicious or ( 5 1/2 ounce ) anjou pear, stemmed, cored, seeded, sliced ( 1 1/2-2 cups ) | 8 broccoli florets, steamed and trimmed | 1/4 cup fresh parsley sprigs
instructions: Combine ketchup and tamari in a small bowl. Coat steak with rice flour. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a heavy nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add half the beef and cook until it starts to brown, 6 to 8 minutes. Transfer to a platter and repeat with remaining beef. Add 2 tablespoons oil. When it is at least 1/2 inch at the bottom of the skillet, add half the spinach. Sprinkle evenly with remaining spinach. Place all pieces atop spinach. When all of the spinach is in the skillet and it has wilted, spoon on the sauce and spinach. Scatter with apple slices. Continue with remaining steak and spinach. Serve with steamed greens and parsley sprigs.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,garam masala,collard green,cabbage,tomato sauce,pam cooking spray
title: Easy Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 lbs green cabbage, shredded ( i use a small head, but i'm not a huge fan of large ) | 1 lb collard greens or 1 lb beet, chopped | 3 tablespoons tomato sauce | pam cooking spray | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Spray large pan with pam. Heat oil in pan on high until it's smoking. Place cabbage, collard greens, tomatoes & seasonings & salt and pepper over oil. Steam mixture for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,tuna water,gorgonzola,turkish bread,kalamata olive,cinnamon,kernel corn
title: Green Chile Tuna Toast
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 0.5 can diced green chilies | 1 can tuna in water, drained ( or a small can of other white fish ) | 1 greek cheese ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 - 3/4 cup kalamata olive, to taste | 6 -12 slices turkish bread
instructions: Combine the corn, green chilies, tuna, gorgonzola and cinnamon. Wrap up the sliced bread in aluminium foil and warm in a 325 degree oven until hot through and warm through. Spoon the corn mixture onto one slice of bread and top with remaining slice. Serve warm.

title: Herbal Dessert Pastries (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 3/4 bunch fresh basil leaf, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together the flour and basil leaves until just combined. Cover with a towel to prevent drying out. Gather small pieces of the dough and roll into small balls by roughly rolling each out piece. Roll out with a rolling pin, about 1/4 inch thick, until about 1/8 or 1/4 inch thick. Arrange on a baking sheet. Bake the pastries for about 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until puffed and lightly browned. Cool slightly before serving.

title: Olive and Olive Bread (Aka Italian Beans Mix)
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen italian style breadcrumbs | 16 ounces fresh mixed beans | 1/4 cup black olives, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon sage leaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Mix all ingredients together except the breadcrumbs, and press mixture evenly on a baking sheet. Bake until browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,self raising flour,pork loin roast,andouille sausage,vegetable oil cooking spray,cream,corn
title: Crispy Pork Loin Fry
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin roast | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 3 tablespoons self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 cups fresh corn, cut from cob ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup sour cream | 1 sausage, peeled and sliced thinly ( optional )
instructions: Remove the fat from the pork and cut into small cubes. Put all of the sauce ingredients into a small bowl and mix well. Coat the pork with cornstarch and shake off any excess. Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Cook all of the pork cubes in small batches, turning gently until brown and cooked, 2–3 minutes each side. Drain all of the pork juices. Reheat the pan and add half the pork. Stir in the sauce, scraping up any bits of food. Lower the heat and simmer until the pork is cooked through, and there is no more pink inside.

title: Indian Raisin Ice Cream for a Rainy Day
ingredients: 180 g golden raisins | 180 g double cream or 180 g sour cream | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Put raisins in a mixing bowl and stir in cream until fluffy. Add garam masala. Beat until soft peaks appear on a sharp knife. Place in the refrigerator to cool. Add more cream to the mixture or ice cream maker and beat until stiff peaks turn colour, approx 5 minutes. Ice cream should not be able to reach the corners of the bowl. Remove from machine and place the mixture in a freezer for a few hours, stirring regularly. Transfer to a bowl and return to freezer until hard. Break up with a fork, using a fork and stir in raisins. Pour into plastic or plastic wrap and refrigerate until cold. Drain off any fat or liquid that has formed on top.

Random Ingredients: ciabatta,ladyfinger,lemon thyme,white mushroom,dill,white sugar,beef brisket,peanut oil
title: Beef Brisket Gyros
ingredients: 8 white mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill | 1 can white mushrooms, sliced | 2 teaspoons chopped lemon thyme | 3 tablespoons peanut oil, divided, or as needed | 2 tablespoons white sugar, divided | 1 pound beef brisket, cut into about 3 1/2-inch pieces | 1 loaf ciabatta, cut into 10 slices | 16 ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Layer about 1/4 of the sliced white mushrooms into the bottom of a large roasting pan. Layer half dill sprigs white mushrooms on top of the mushrooms. Sprinkle beef with 2 teaspoons of lemon thyme, and drizzle 1 tablespoon peanut oil over beef mixture. Top with another layer of mushrooms, and sprinkle lemon thyme over the top. Drizzle remaining 1 tablespoon peanut oil over the top, and top with remaining sliced white mushrooms. Place ciabatta slices, cut side down, in the center of the pan. Bake in the preheated oven until the beef is easily pierced with a fork and beginning to show no resistence when prodded for a few minutes, about 1 hour. Remove the beef from the pan, and allow to cool somewhat, about five minutes. Pour juices into a bowl to cool a little, and season with remaining 1 tablespoon lemon thyme, and set aside. Place a roasting pan over medium heat, and sear brisket until well browned, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat, and allow to rest for 15 minutes. To serve, plate gyros, and top with a meat mixture of sliced mushrooms, and dill sprigs.

title: Spicy Lentils in Chipotle Sauce
ingredients: 1 - lb lentils, washed thoroughly | 1 -2 teaspoon ground chipotle chile
instructions: Put the lentils in a mixing bowl and pour boiling water over them. Allow lentils to absorb the water then drain and put back in the pot. Add the ground chili then mix. Bring to the boil then reduce to medium heat on the stove top. After 30 minutes, remove from heat and let cool a little. Once they are cool, transfer the mixture into a bowl and mix well.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,mozzarella cheese,tuna,extra virgin olive oil
title: Tuna Italiano
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta | 2 cans tuna, drained | 1/2 - 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 4 -6 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese ( to taste )
instructions: Cook the rotini in boiling salted water until just al dente, drain. Rinse, drain and flake with fork. Mix the tuna, rotini, and olive oil in a medium sized bowl. Add the shredded mozzarella cheese. Place pasta noodles in a greased 9x13 inch casserole dish or 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with cheddar cheese mixture. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes. You might need to top with more mozzarella cheese, to taste. Enjoy.

title: Simple Italian Roast
ingredients: 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 3 lbs beef roast | 1 teaspoon cold water
instructions: Rub the italian seasoning all over the beef. Place meat in a roaster. Add water to cover. Pour the 1 teaspoons of cold water over the meat. Cover and bake in slow oven 325°f for 4 hours. Remove roast.

title: Antipasto
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe olives ( i love the type of olives ) | 1 hard-boiled egg, cut into slices | 6 tablespoons sour cream or 6 tablespoons low-fat sour cream | 5 tablespoons minced garlic ( or garlic powder, to taste ) | 2 tablespoons minced fresh tarragon ( or 1 teaspoon dried tarragon ) | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 -2 teaspoon of minced fresh tarragon ( or 1 teaspoon dried tarragon ) | 1 -2 teaspoon of minced garlic ( or garlic powder, to taste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Preparation, place olives in a plastic bag, cover with hot tap water and allow to soak for 20 - 30 minutes. Drain and place in a bowl of a food processor along with all other ingredients, except for egg. Pulse to create a smooth paste. Note, i often make this in the food processor with a batch of the egg and a batch of garlic, but it's not necessary. Taste paste to see if it is to your liking. Remove olives from bag and add to the food processor. Puree to a smooth paste, using a large bowl, but do not overprocess. I don't have to use an immersion blender, my immersion blender is too watery and for us a smoother texture that takes a few minutes. I taste paste now and again, as paste is better the longer it sits in the frig, to allow the flavors to incorporate, it is usually about the consistency of a paste. Pour paste into a bowl and refrigerate until well chilled, about 6 hours. Dish out onto serving plates. This is a hearty appetizer, but i prefer it the way they are eaten.

title: Macaroni in Nuts - Nuts Mit Nuts (From Nut Tree Nuts)
ingredients: 240 g macaroni | 4 dried bermere, cut into strips | 4 tablespoons honey | chopped of fresh mint | 1 teaspoon almond meal ( optional )
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions on the pack. Cool to room temperature. When cold, drain. Place macaroni in a microwave proof bowl and cover with microwave proof water. Microwave on high until macaroni becomes soft and creamy, stirring half way through. Meanwhile, mix honey and nectar, if using, in a small pan with a medium heat. Add nuts and cook until warmed through. Stir in mint leaves. Add more nectar if desired. Drizzle honey syrup over macaroni and serve.

title: Pork Fritters With Peach-Pistachio Sauce
ingredients: 2 links sausage, sliced thinly ( mild or hot, see note at end ) | 1/2 cup light peach flavored liqueur | 1/2 cup light peaches in light liquor or 1/2 cup peach-infused amaretto, divided | 1/4 cup smooth blue cheese ( recommended a great blue ) | 2 teaspoons tomato paste
instructions: Note, if substituting smoked sausage substitute, omit the sausage for pork. Remove casings from sausage. Place sausage, liqueur, and 3/4 cup of the amaretto in a large skillet and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat.

title: Lime Glazed Chicken With Vegetables & Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken thigh, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons shredded lime rind | 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon minced fresh lime rind | 2 tablespoons honey | 8 ounces sliced mushrooms | 8 cups hot cooked rice, prepared | 1/2 cup whole milk
instructions: Combine chicken, lime rind, ricotta, lime rind and honey in a large bowl. Add mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,whipping cream,red capsicum,pesto sauce,baby carrot,buttermilk biscuit,horseradish,ginger ale
title: Spiced Oyster Pasta With Carrots
ingredients: 350 g buttermilk biscuits | 1 package baby carrots ( finely grated ) | 1 red capsicum ( finely sliced ) | 1 teaspoon ginger ale ( grated ) | 3 tablespoons horseradish ( grated fresh ) | 200 ml whipping cream | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 4 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon light buttermilk biscuit, crumbs
instructions: Place dough on lightly flour surface, with kneading board or rolling pin and lightly roll out to about 2cm thickness. Using a 4cm cutter of biscuit or plain non stick biscuit cut out 2 circles of dough. Place the carrots, capsicum, and ginger ale in a large non stick fry pan over medium heat. Cook for 3 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender. Set aside. In a medium bowl combine cream, horseradish, pesto, and buttermilk biscuits, then spoon the vegetables, vegetables, horseradish cream and caramelised horseradish into pastry cases. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake in oven on 200c for 10 minutes or until golden.

title: Cha Cha Cha (Chocolate and Saffron Stir Fry)
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped dried apricot jam | 1 teaspoon saffron ( or turmeric powder ) | 12 baby bok choy, cleaned and cut in half lengthwise | 2 cups shredded napa's choc-style semi-sweet chocolate ( may use less ) | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh tarragon | 1/2 cup sliced daikon radish | 3 cups prepared low-fat salsa
instructions: Combine jam, and saffron in a small bowl.

title: Okra and Cheese Dip in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup rotel diced tomatoes ( about 2 tomatoes, seeded and finely chopped ) | 1 1/2 cups sliced okra | 2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine yogurt, horseradish and rotel in a bowl. Add okra and tomato. Mix well. Serve warm or cold. Makes 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,beef stock cube,grand marnier,leek,red enchilada sauce,honey
title: Lazy Onion Leek Soup
ingredients: 1 medium leek | 1 medium onion | 1 liter vegetable stock or 1 liter beef stock | 1 tablespoon honey | 8 -10 ounces red enchilada sauce | 1/2 liter grand marnier
instructions: Wash the leek, removing the top layers of the root. Clean off any root tips and root ends and scrape off any green or black spots. Cut the leek into 5 6cm pieces. Cut the onion in half and cut into half again. Clean the onion and cut around the base and top portion into half again. Cut off and discard the hard, central stem of the leek. The smaller portions will take longer to cook. If using a stockpot, make sure they are covered and add water in the order given. Bring to the boil and add the stock, honey, enchilada sauce and Grand marnier in a slow, stream to dissolve the alcohol in the stock. You may add a little extra stock if desired but be careful not to add too much as the soup is quite oily. The soup is done when the mixture is very frothy. Serve with tortilla chips or soft, wholemeal bread pieces and chopped scallions. The soup can be eaten immediately or eaten the next day after refrigeration.

title: Steamed Tuna Bites
ingredients: 4 slices fresh ginger juice | 1 tablespoon sake or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 tablespoon beetroot pickle juice | 4 tuna fish, about 1 kilogram in weight | beef gravy
instructions: Put the ginger juice, sake, beetroot pickle juice, and 1/2 tsp of salt in a wok. Bring to the boil and leave to simmer for 3 to 5 minutes until reduced by half. Add the fish and serve. Serve with extra beef gravy drizzled over.

title: Roasted Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, skin on | 2 tablespoons risotto rice | 2 tablespoons demerara sugar | 2 teaspoons roasted hot peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/160c fan forced. Place salmon on a rack in a shallow roasting dish, skin side down. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with sugar. Roast for 20 minutes until cooked. Turn over. Roast for a further 20 mins until firm and flakey. Serve hot, with roasted pepper to garnish.

title: Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 pound shaved beef | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1/3 cup grated romano cheese | 1/3 cup mango chutney | 1 can yellow diced tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl, mix beef, bread crumbs, cheese, mango chutney and diced tomatoes, blending until just combined.

title: Wild Mushrooms and Oyster Beignets
ingredients: 1 cup brown onion ( i used a medium ) or 1 cup shallot ( i used a medium ) | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 5 fresh oyster mushrooms | 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: Mince/crush onion. Add oil to large skillet over medium high heat. Add onion and saute until translucent ~ about 3 minutes. Add mushrooms, being careful to saute them in oil as this will help the flavor mellow. Mix in garlic powder. Cover and cook until mushrooms are done ~ ~1 3/4 2 hr, stirring occasionally. After mushrooms are soft, remove lid and stir in nuts. Enjoy.

title: Guacamole and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 cup fresh snow pea | 1 teaspoon ground sage | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 loaf french bread | 1/2 cup guacamole or 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place the snow peas in a pot of salted boiling water, and cook for 2 minutes. Drain, and set aside. When cool enough to handle, remove strings from the snow peas by crushing with your hands, and chopping in a food processor. Add sage, white pepper, and reserved snow peas, and process together. Slice the bread into cubes. Brush a baking sheet with cooking spray, and spread the guacamole or sour cream over the slices. Place the bread on top, and top with the guacamole mixture. Bake in oven for about 15 minutes, or until heated through and the cheese is golden.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,thai red chili pepper,limeade concentrate,raspberry jam,onion soup mix,red bean
title: Jungle Dog
ingredients: 46 ounces red beans, drained and washed | 16 ounces sauerkraut, drained | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 7 ounces frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 1/2 cups thawed raspberry jam | 1 thai red chili pepper
instructions: Blend all ingredients and put into crock pot. Cook on high for 2 hours take out chili. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: egg white,new potato,plain flour,white cabbage,skewer,pimento olive
title: Potato Wedges
ingredients: 250 g new potatoes ( or equivalent amount of potato in a package ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup plain flour | 125 g white cabbage ( or regular cabbage ) | skewer, as required | 1 - 1 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive ( or similar amount of stuffed olives ) | slightly beaten egg white, for glazing
instructions: Slice potatoes into about 2 inch or 2 inch/1/2 inch thick pieces. Place flour and salt in a baking, oven or griddle. Add potato and fry in a non stick pan for about 8 - 10 minutes until light golden and crisp. Place cabbage and olives in a bowl and add the flour and mixed mixture. Toss to coat all the ingredients well. Place on a tray and glaze with a little beaten egg white. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Ground Meat With Tomatillo Chips and Smoked Veal
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 1 dozen corn tortilla chips | 1 can tomatillos, with salsa fresca
instructions: Brown meats with can of tomatillos and sauteed tomatillos in a skillet until cooked through. Drain meat and tomatillos and heat them on medium with about a tablespoon of canola oil, or to desired texture. Add a generous amount of salt to taste. Spread some of the sauce on the bottom of a 9 pie pan. Add some shredded cheese, if desired, then cover meat with more sauce and pour cheese on top. Add some more cheese, if desired, and enjoy. This is awesome on a bun, on a sandwich or as a side dish. Try a little on green veggies and make mexican food with a spoonful of sour cream. Some family members even like some cheddar on top of the meat.

title: Risotto Pilaf
ingredients: 1 turnip | 10 ounces risotto rice | garlic powder
instructions: Bring water to boil.

title: Black Olive Sauce
ingredients: 12 black olives | 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Wash and soak olives. In a heavy saucepan, put olives, saffron, cover pot and gently simmer over low heat 2 hours, skimming off the scum that rises to the top. When most of the liquid has been absorbed, add the balance of the water and cook 5 minutes longer. It should be creamy and serve as main dish served over rice. Note, depending on the size of your olives, you may need to use more water and saffron in the cooking process.

Random Ingredients: coconut,cumin seed,ginger garlic paste,extra virgin olive oil,ghee,whipping cream,almond extract,red bean
title: Red Beans With Coconut (Aloo Raita)
ingredients: 1 lb red beans, rinsed ( or fresh if available ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream or 1 1/2 cups yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon ghee or 1 tablespoon canola oil ( or canola butter ) | 1/2 cup coconut, unsweetened, shredded ( optional )
instructions: Combine coconut, if using, with cream, almond extract, and 1/4 cup water. Heat over medium high heat until mixture bubbles and is thickened, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in coconut. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 3 days. Store any leftover coconut liquid in a small cauldron covered with plastic wrap in the refrigerator. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Heat or microwave ghee in a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes or until hot but not smoking. Reduce heat if oil can smoke, cover, and heat to low, about 5 minutes. Add coconut mixture and stir until heated through and coconut is smooth.

title: Quinoa, Zucchini, and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 3/4 lb zucchini, cut thinly on diagonal | 2/3 lb yellow pepper, julienned | 1 pinch salt | 2 1/2 tablespoons white vinegar | linguine
instructions: Place quinoa in a large bowl and cover with very hot tap water. Let stand for 30 minutes and drain. Bring 6 cups water to a boil. Add quinoa and zucchini.

title: Solo's Baked Mozzarella
ingredients: 5 -6 tablespoons unsweetened dried shredded coconut | 1 jar chopped pimiento, drained | coarse salt
instructions: Put the dried shredded coconut in a shallow bowl and sprinkle liberally with coarse salt to cover. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside at room temperature 30 minutes. When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 375°f. In a small bowl, stir together the pimentos and coarse salt. Remove the coconut from the bowl, using a slotted spoon, taking care not to break the surface, and set aside. Rinse the drained mozzarella and pat dry with paper towels. Place the mozzarella in an oven proof dish, about 2 by 2 inches in size. Insert the paring knife blade into the center of the mozzarella. Bake 5 to 7 minutes, until golden brown. Using a spatula, slice the mozzarella diagonally into 1/4 inch thick slices. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,crouton,flat leaf parsley,pork roast,garlic salt,rosemary,lemon zest
title: Porc upma or Swiss Roast Pork
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs pork roast | 1 -2 tablespoon rosemary ( dried, crumbled ) | 3/4 - 1 cup good flat leaf parsley ( chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 grated lemon, zest of | 1/2 cup crouton
instructions: Wash and dry the pork. With a large dinner plate cut the lengthwise slits, about ½ inch. Pound the top and bottom sides of the roast to an even ¼ depth and stuff with herbs. Add the salt and pepper. Roll the roast up fast. Seal the inside of the roast with the lemon zest. Place in a roasting pan. Cover and roast in a pre heated oven at 325°f for 2 hours. Uncover and let braise 2 hours more. Remove from oven and let sit for 15 minutes.

title: Dill Rice and Roquefort Noodles With Cardamom and Dill
ingredients: 1 package dry flat rice noodles | 3/4 3/4 cup buttermilk ( plus some liquid to make the dish a little thicker ) or 3/4 cup milk ( plus some liquid to make the dish a little thicker ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 3 -4 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, plus additional for serving ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons chopped dill
instructions: Bring a medium pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, make the dill sauce while the noodles are soaking. In a small bowl, whisk together the buttermilk or milk, cardamom and cardamom, adding more buttermilk or milk as needed, to thin sauce. Taste and add more buttermilk, if necessary. In a large frying pan, heat 1 1/2 tablespoons of the olive oil over medium heat until it shimmers. When the oil shimmers, add noodles and cook, stirring with a fork, until golden in color and almost cooked through, 4 - 5 minutes. When the noodles are fully cooked, add one ladle of sauce to the noodles and stir. Add the dill, increase heat and cook, stirring occasionally until noodles are warmed through, 3 - 4 minutes. Taste and add more of the buttermilk, if needed. Note, if a little bit thick, cook until it thickens before adding any more. If the noodles are too dry, add a couple of tablespoons of water. If the noodles are too soft, add more noodles, if desired. Taste and adjust the seasoning, adding additional buttermilk as needed. A few dashes of black pepper might be added.

Random Ingredients: sugar syrup,rosemary leaf,guinness stout,coriander seed,bamboo shoot,self raising flour
title: Guinness Battered Rosemary Fritters
ingredients: 500 g self-raising flour, sifted | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1 tablespoon sugar syrup | 150 ml guinness stout | 60 g bamboo shoots, halved crossways
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/fan 180c/gas sieve the flour into a large bowl. Add the coriander, rosemary, sugar syrup, guinness, and bamboo shoots and mix together gently until combined. Tip the batter into a piping bag or an oven tray lined with non stick baking paper and transfer into the oven. Bake at 190c/fan 160c/gas 5 for about 20 minutes, until risen and golden and batter is puffed up. Serve immediately.

title: Fava Bean Ravioli With Cardamom Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange liqueur | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 3 -4 drops orange-flavored liqueur, such as cointreau | 3 gala apples, peeled, cut in wedges | 12 ounces dried fava beans, rinsed, drained then boiled to tender crisp | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 1/2 unbaked pastry shells
instructions: On a platter, combine the first five ingredients and set aside. Cut the apples into thin wedges and toss with a splash of orange-flavored liqueur. On another platter, place the fava beans, raisins and drained pastry shell. Spoon on approximately 1 tbl or guar gumgala or orange liqueur and gently fold. Dust with additional cinnamon and drizzle with orange flavouring.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,serrano pepper,kaiser,cracker,blueberry,pork steak,cream mushroom soup
title: Beef, Blueberry, and Spinach Burgers
ingredients: 8 ounces lean boneless pork steaks or 8 ounces pork tenderloin, thinly sliced | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 package frozen mixed baby spinach, thawed and well drained | 1 cup fresh blueberries ( or fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup crumbled cracker ( or toasted ) | pickled serrano pepper ( optional ) | cooked kaiser ( optional )
instructions: Put pork in a 10 inch nonstick skillet.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,canola oil,chicken stock,barley,pineapple chunk,dark chocolate,grainy mustard,sirloin steak
title: Beef, Barley and Chocolate Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/4 cup reduced-sodium chicken stock | 1/3 cup barley | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/2 cup pineapple chunk, drained and sliced | 1/4 lb boneless sirloin steak, trimmed of fat and cut into strips | 1/4 cup grainy mustard | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Place barley, chocolate, canola, and 1/2 cup water in a microwave safe bowl and microwave for about 4 minutes, stirring twice, until chocolate is melted and smooth. Heat the remaining 1/2 cup of water over medium high heat and add barley, stirring with a fork, until coated. Add chestnut, swiss or other steak, mustard and the brown sugar and stir to combine well. Add the meat mixture to the rice mixture and stir to combine. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,graham cracker crumb,yoghurt,maraschino cherry,crabmeat,pearl barley,strawberry
title: Rob's Famous Barley Crab Soda
ingredients: 1 box frozen pearl barley or ( 8 ounce ) box barley, your favorite combination | 1 can crabmeat | 1 cup yoghurt | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry ( you can use canned ) | 1/3 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 container frozen strawberries
instructions: Place the shell ingredients into a large freezer bag. Shake to combine and place in the freezer. Boil for 15 min with the lid off on a high heat on your stove. Take out of the freezer and leave it to finish off in the fridge. When it has defrosted in a little, take chunks of crab and toss them into a bowl. Place in the freezer again if not ready for the next step. Place in fridge until ready to be served. Just before serving add the strawberries to the yoghurt. Place the crushed graham crackers in a bowl, and mix in the frozen chunks of crab. Place that onto your plates, with the crumbed strawberries on the side to create a pretty effect. Serve with a salad of greens or with crackers on the side.

title: Maple Ginger Snap Soup
ingredients: 1 quart vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 piece fresh ginger snaps, peeled | 1 -2 teaspoon maple syrup | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Heat oil to 375 f. Place the ginger snaps in a microwave safe plate or other flat container and microwave on high, uncovered, until they are toasty and fragrant but not brown, about 3 minutes, stirring once or twice. Remove the ginger snaps from the microwave.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,chunky salsa,plain nonfat yogurt,fenugreek seed
title: Salsa Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh fenugreek seeds
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
