title: Thai Chicken Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce and cornstarch. Set aside. Heat oil in a nonstick saute pan, medium heat. When it is hot, add the cornstarch mixture. Stir often, to prevent burning, until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Turn down heat. Cook, stir often, for a few minutes, until it is thick enough to coat a spoon. Set aside until ready to use, and then add fish sauce. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Serve over your favorite noodles.

title: Beef Tenderloin Steak Sandwich Style
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed
instructions: Score fat and place on grill. Cook 5 - 10 minutes on each side or until meat thermometer reads 130 degrees. Slice. If desired sprinkle with lemon juice. Note, make certain it is hot enough that it will show a grill marks at one side of the steak.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,sesame oil,red onion,pignolis,vegetable oil cooking spray,ice cube,salad oil,focaccia bread
title: Pan-Fried Salpicon
ingredients: 8 ounces salpicon bread | 4 large ice cubes | 1/4 lb fresh fideos ( about 4 slices ovals ) | 2 ounces sesame oil | 2 teaspoons oil, neutral preferably ( such as vegetable or canola ) | 1/4 cup salad oil | salt and country-style fried onions, as accompaniment ( see illustration below ) | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Trim ends and cut fideos in quarters, and boil in water, covered on medium high heat, until al dente, which should take less than 7 minutes. Drain and set aside. Using a fork or slotted spoon, remove fideos, and cut into strips about 5 inches long, then cut diagonally into thin strips 1/3 inch wide. Bring 2 quarts of water to the boil in a large pot. Add salt and fideos and return to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, about 12 minutes. Remove from the heat and drain fideos well. To prepare fideos, slice 1 inch wide strips about 1/2 inch long and reserve. To prepare oil, heat 1/4 cup salad oil in a wok or large skillet until it just shimmers, swirling pan to coat and stirring often. Add salt to taste and stir fry onions until soft and dark green, about 10 to 15 minutes. If mixture begins to darken too much for your taste add 1 minute of cold water as you continue cooking it, until oil is absorbed and mixture looks dry. Stir in fried fideos and stir fry until heated through but still moist, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and allow fideos to cool slightly and absorb oil. Place the warmed fideos in a bowl and serve at room temperature. To serve, divide fideos among 4 shallow dishes. Sprinkle sesame oil over fideos, and drizzle with 1 teaspoon of oil. To serve, arrange fideos in overlapping rings on plate, and mound about 1/4 cup of the grilled fideos over fideos. Place fries on top of fideos, then drizzle with additional 1 1/4 teaspoons of oil.

title: Baked Escargots
ingredients: 2 pounds escargots, trimmed | 1 1/2 cups uncooked long-grain rice | soya sauce, for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 2 1/2 or 3 quart baking dish with foil. Line the baking dish with parchment paper. Arrange the escargots in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover and steam until barely tender, about 5 minutes. Reserve water. In a deep bowl, rinse rice with water until water runs clear. Pat dry. Place rice in the greased baking dish. Drizzle evenly with soya sauce. Transfer to the oven and cook until hot, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ham,green bean,chili powder,dark chocolate,garam masala powder
title: Halloween Dogs
ingredients: 1 large ham | 2 packages frozen green beans | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder | 3 ounces dark chocolate, melted
instructions: If ham is not already roasted, roast it, or preheat oven to 300°f. Remove excess fat from ham by rubbing it off with your hands and slice ham into thin strips. Use about a tablespoon of the ham for each dog. Place ham in a bowl, and mash in chili powder with the rest of the chili powder. Add the green beans. Sprinkle the garam masala powder over the mixture and stir well. Remove the lid from the bowl and stir well using your fingers. When the mixture is smooth, drizzle melted chocolate over the mixture. Return to the oven, and bake at 300°f until the chocolate melts. Cool, then chill for at least 15+ hours before eating.

Random Ingredients: half,dark beer,soy margarine,pastry,plain flour,orange juice,milk ricotta cheese,bread dough
title: Olive Beer Stuffed Rolls
ingredients: 1 pastry for a double-crust double-crust double crust pie | 1/2 cup dark beer or 1 other beer | 8 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 2/3 cup plain flour | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1/2 cup half-and-half ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon soy margarine ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon half-and-half ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine or 1 1/2 tablespoons butter, softened | 3/4 cup loosely-packed fresh bread dough ( may need a bit more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f prepare a double crust pan as follows, or use either puff pastry, recipe #230316, or a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper and lightly floured. Dust a work surface with flour or corn meal and roll the pastry out to 1/8 inch thickness and cut out 4 circles about 3/4 inch deep by cutting circles from 1/2 inch dough. Place 3 circles on a parchment lined baking sheet, making sure to leave a 1/2 inch space between each. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the ricotta cheese into the centre of each circle and press the filling into the centre of each circle, making sure that the filling is completely covered with filling. If using a cookie sheet the filled rolls can be left to stand for a bit and then placed on the greased tray. Brush the tops with remaining margarine, and then top the rolls with the remaining 2 tablespoons of ricotta cheese. Bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown, and remove tray from oven. Let rolls rest for 3 to 5 minutes on the baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce heart,yogurt,san marzano tomato,vanilla essence,yoghurt,vegetable
title: Veggies in Yogurt (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 5)
ingredients: 8 fresh yoghurt, bowls with live cultures ( or 5 1/2 pints homemade yogurt ) | 300 g vegetables, peeled, cut into thick slices ( callaloo ) | 600 g low fat greek yogurt | 1 medium sized romaine lettuce hearts or 1 medium romaine lettuce, torn | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 4 cups low-fat yoghurt ( low fat or low-fat can be used ) or 4 cups strained yogurt ( low fat or low-fat can be used )
instructions: Preparation. Divide yoghurt among 4 bowls, dividing it evenly among them. Arrange vegetables, yoghurt and 1/4 cup water around yoghurt. Place on 2 baking trays or flat baking paper lined with greaseproof paper and drizzle with about 6 teaspoon of vanilla essence. Place under a grill, turning and basting with juices every 3 - 5 minutes until vegetables are golden brown and cooked through. Note, alternatively, you can use any yogurt you like. The flavour is best if allowed to cool before adding to yoghurt. Serve yoghurt topped with yoghurt and vanilla, and sprinkle with a small amount of cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,brandy,parmesan cheese,cremini mushroom,pimento olive,mace,vanilla essence
title: Mushroom, Pepper & Olive Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 lb mushroom | 2 3/4 ounces pimento stuffed olives | 2 3/4 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | 1/4 teaspoon allspice berry | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 tablespoon brandy | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Remove the hard stalks from the mushrooms & cut into 5 slices. Chop the pepper olives into 3 squares. Wash the cremini mushrooms & slice into thin slices. Heat the oil in a deep pan. When hot, add the mushrooms & cook till soft. Add the spice buerry, nutmeg & brandy. Stir & cook till alcohol burns off. When ready, add the pepper mushrooms & cook till heated through. Garnish with parmesan cheese & pour into serving dishes. Note, if you slice your mushrooms then you should chop them first, then proceed as above.

Random Ingredients: port wine,salt black pepper,dark chocolate,orzo pasta,double cream,banana lengthwise,roast beef
title: Gambas Al Ajillo
ingredients: 250 g orzo pasta | 2 tablespoons port wine | 450 ml double cream | 150 150 g steak/beef or 150 g ham, chopped | 400 g dark chocolate | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Boil the orzo until al dente about 10 minutes drain and rinse under cold water, place back in pan and toss in the port. Heat the cream in a medium saucepan and stir continuously until it thickens a little. Add the meat, or lamb, and stir through until the meat is coated in the cream mixture. Remove from the heat, and stir in the chocolate until melted. Check the seasoning, it should have a strong enough consistency to suit. Pour over the orzo and toss to coat. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: tuna water,dark brown sugar,wakame,chicken bouillon cube,sherry vinegar,lemon peel,vegetable oil
title: Wakame and Tuna Skewers With Sweet & Sour Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb wakame, washed and dry | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon lemon peel, freshly grated | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 7 ounces tuna in water, drained | 1/4 teaspoon salt or 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: To make the sauce, combine the vinegar, sugar & lemon peel in a small bowl & set aside. To make your satiny tuna skewers, thread the wakame with long, narrow ends that hang over both sides of the skewer forming a grid. Toss the wakame in a bowl with the fish boullion, sherry & brown sugar to coat well. Heat 1 tsp vegetable oil over high heat & sear the soaked wakame sticks in batches, approximately 2 - 5 mins per side or until crispy & browned. Repeat with remaining wakame & reheat the oil, adding more oil if necessary. Divide among serving plates and serve with sweet sour sauce.

title: Lazy Savoy Cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium savoy cabbage | 1/2 cup nonfat yogurt | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Wash the savoy cabbage and cut it into 2 inch long pieces. Coat the cabbage with spray cooking spray. Place the pieces of cabbage in a lightly greased 9x13 baking dish, breaking as needed to fit if they overlap. Brush with a little water. Bake in the oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until tender and brown. Serve with a side dish of cucumber salad or pita bread and yogurt on the side.

title: Creamy Coriander Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut flakes | 3 tablespoons coriander seeds, lightly crushed | 32 ounces cod, fillet cut into 2-inch pieces | 4 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1/2 lemon wedge
instructions: Combine coconut flakes, coriander seed, and fish in a resealable plastic bag. Close bag and press air out.

Random Ingredients: bread,cottage cheese,scotch bonnet pepper,phyllo pastry,baby spinach leaf,almond extract
title: Spinach & Hot Pepper Strudels
ingredients: 1 bag fresh baby spinach leaves, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped toasted almond, or to taste ( optional ) | 12 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 12 scotch bonnet peppers | 1/4 cup cottage cheese, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line 2 12x7 inch sheets of aluminum foil with parchment paper. Spray 2 sheets of aluminum foil with nonstick cooking spray, then spray again with a nonstick cooking spray. In a medium bowl, mix the spinach, almonds, and a couple of pinches of almond extract. Spread 1 - 2 tablespoons of the spinach/almond mixture on one end of each rectangle of phyllo pastry, leaving a 1 1/2 inch strip along the long side. Fold the sides into the center to slightly enclose the spinach mixture. Place the pastries on the prepared sheets in the preheated oven. Spray the tops of the strudels with nonstick cooking spray, and continue layering, spraying each strudel with nonstick cooking spray, until the top of the pastry is barely covered. Bake strudels for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the tops have become lightly marked and crisped. Sprinkle reserved 2 tablespoons almonds and black pepper all over the saucers, then bake again until the topping is slightly golden, about 5 minutes. Remove strudels from the oven. Sprinkle the remaining 1 cup of cottage cheese over the top, then bake to melt the cheese. Cut into serving sized pieces after removing from oven. Enjoy note, to freeze, place strudels in their plastic freezer bags.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,kalamata olive,rice vinegar,salad oil,salt pepper,english cucumber,lemon
title: Greek Salad With Sweet and Sour Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 english cucumber, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup red pickling salt ( red wine vinegar tastes good, too ) | 1/2 cup salad oil | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon fresh lemon rind, grated ( or 1/2 tsp. dried lemon peel ) | 2 cups fresh blueberries | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, pitted and sliced ( about 3/4 cup )
instructions: Cook cucumber in boiling water, uncovered, about 2 minutes, until just softened, but still a little chunky. Drain, discarding any remaining liquid. Transfer cucumber to plate.

title: Tuna & Broth
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained | 2 cups stock or 2 cups broth
instructions: Drain tuna well. Bring broth to boil in medium saucepan.

title: Baked Fettuccine With Italian Turkey Sausage  (Baked)
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian turkey sausage, casings removed | 1 package frozen peas, defrosted | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 cup frozen cornmeal, thawed and kept warm | 1 lb dry fettuccine, cooked
instructions: Cook sausage over medium heat in large skillet just until browned. Transfer sausage and any accumulated juices into a bowl, leaving any drippings in skillet. If using the peas you don't have to drain them. Add peas, paprika, cornmeal, and a pinch of salt and pepper to the sausage drippings and heat, stirring often, 5 to 6 minutes, or until mixture becomes light in color. Drain fettuccine under cold water until it's cold. Drain fettuccine and serve with sausage and peas.

title: Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 2 pieces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 teaspoons pineapple juice | 1/2 teaspoon mixed herbs ( optional )
instructions: Dry the sun dried tomatoes on paper towels. In a small bowl add the pineapple juice. Mix all together and add the herbs last. Serve.

Random Ingredients: roast,celery seed,chicken breast tender,mango nectar,vanilla essence,coffee granule
title: Mango Ginger Chicken
ingredients: 3 chicken breast tenders | 3 cups mango nectar | 1 cup brewed coffee granules | 2 tablespoons instant chicken-flavored coffee granules | 2 tablespoons celery seeds | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the mango nectar, coffee granules and celery seeds. Bring the mixture to boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Transfer all the sauce to a large bowl, and add the chicken pieces. Add the remaining dry ingredients. Mix well. Cover and let stand overnight, stirring occasionally. Let stand for another 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,apple,cocoa powder,turnip,topping,plain nonfat yogurt,coconut milk,picante sauce
title: Santa Fe Turnips
ingredients: 6 cups turnips, cut into 1/2 - 3/4 inch cubes | 1 pint picante sauce | 0.5 can coconut milk | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 3/4 teaspoon dried shredded coconut ( optional ) | 4 ounces fat-free whipped topping, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick vegetable spray. Place all ingredients except yogurt in a large bowl. Mix well and set aside. Brush the tops of the turnips with 1 tbs. Of the milk & bake 50 - 60 minutes or until tender and glazed. Top with yogurt & serve.

title: Grilled Spaghetti and Wings
ingredients: 20 ounces chicken wings | 3 eggsplants, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 3 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 8 ounces spaghetti, cooked, drained and kept warm in the microwave
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Remove wing tips in bundles or other large pieces if using. Brush wings with oil and thread onto skewers. Sprinkle cajun seasoning onto both sides of wings with oil. Grill until cooked through or to desired doneness, turning frequently. Brush with maple syrup and serve with cooked spaghetti.

title: Lamb Stew
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs rabbit, cut into one inch cubes | 1/3 lb beef | 1/3 lb ground beef or 1/3 lb ground lamb | 2 tablespoons ground coriander | 6 -7 tablespoons olive oil | 4 tablespoons rosemary, dried | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon almond essence
instructions: Brown the meat pieces in 2 tsp. Of olive oil. Remove meat and brown in hot olive oil. Add the spices to the meat and brown well. Add 4 cups water. Sprinkle with dried coriander and almond essence. Cover and leave at medium temperature covered for 3 hours. Turn meat on the stove and boil until meat is tender and all the liquid is off. Serve in rice or with a salad.

Random Ingredients: green coriander,rose water,chicken stock,napa cabbage,hard egg
title: Persian Noodle Soup - Avgolemeno
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock | 1 piece napa cabbage ( daikon ) | 1 tablespoon green coriander | 3 -4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons rose water
instructions: Wash the cabbage and cut it into 6 - 8 large squares. Wedge the egg and coriander into each leaf, and place 1 heaping tablepoon of the broth along the centre. Place a cabbage square in the centre and surround with the rest of the broth. Bring the outer edges just up to the centre and tie with kitchen string. Bring to boil, then simmer for 25 - 30 minutes. Lift out the coriander and eggs, sprinkle on a little water and serve hot.

title: Blackberry and Salmon Terrine
ingredients: 12 ounces salmon fillets, cut into 1-inch slices | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 teaspoons horseradish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/8 teaspoon blackberry ( optional ) | 12 ounces sweet matzo ( white ) | 2/3 cup sliced blackberries ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange salmon and 1 tablespoon cornstarch on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with horseradish sauce, sugar and blackberries if using. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until just cooked through. Meanwhile, over medium heat, melt remaining 2 tablespoons cornstarch with sugar. Cook until mixture begins to caramelize. Set aside. Meanwhile, soak matzo in cold water 10 minutes or until barely firm. Drain on paper towels. Cut into 2 inch lengths. Remove sauce from heat. Drain and set aside. Transfer remaining 1 tablespoon butter and half of cornstarch to a 9x9 inch pan. Top with matzo and berries. Bake, uncovered, for 15 to 20 minutes or until matzo is slightly browned. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,salsa,bamboo shoot,ricotta cheese,green cardamom pod
title: Pesto Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 3 fresh bamboo shoots | 15 ounces ricotta cheese | 3 green cardamom pods | 1/3 cup pesto sauce | 1 jar salsa ( preferably homemade )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f line a baking dish with foil. Slice the tops off of the bamboo shoots and discard the green tops. Cut a slit in each bamboo shoot and remove the fibers by gently rolling the cut bottom out and rolling to the point where it is a little wider. In a medium bowl, combine the ricotta, 3 green cardamom pods, and 1/3 cup pesto. Stir in 1/3 jar salsa and divide into equal portions. Transfer each meatball to baking dish and top each with remaining pesto. Bake just until warm, about 15 minutes. Serve over freshly baked or streamed vegetables.

title: Melba & Eggplant Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 eggplant, fresh | 1 container cool whip
instructions: Remove the stem from the eggplant using a vegetable peeler i. E. Slice the stem lengthwise into 1/2 inch wide slices using a vegetable peeler or zester. Place slices in a colander or sieve and sprinkle lightly with salt and set aside. Rinse eggplant under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Spray an 8 x 12 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place the eggplant slices in the dish, turn once, and set aside. Using the same vegetable peeler, make 3 diagonal cuts on top of the eggplant. This will help to make the eggplant less likely to break after baking. Brush eggplant with the eggplant flavored oil and place on the rack of a broiler pan. Broil eggplant for about 10 minutes or until lightly toasted and eggplant is tender. Turn slices and broil until crisp on the outside and tender in the middle. Remove eggplant from heat and spread the cooled whipped topping evenly over the eggplant. Serve.

title: Quick and Easy Sausage and Kidney Bean Soup
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 1 package hot italian sausage, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 can kidney beans | 6 ounces canned turnips, drained and rinsed well | 4 1/2 cups sugar substitute, splenda is good ( or equivalent ) | 8 slices limes ( optional )
instructions: Brown sausage until cooked through and crumbled, then drain grease from pan. Brown both sides of sausage in same pan with the fat. Remove sausage from pan and add to the meat. Drain the kidney beans and turnip, and rinse with hot water in separate pan with the sugar, or splenda. Add to the meat and sausage. Place the can of kidney beans with juice and water in the slow cooker. Add the juice from the second can of beans and turnip juice into the slow cooker. Cook on low setting for 6 - 8 hours, or until liquid thickens a little bit and beans and turnip are tender. Serve in soup bowls with limes if desired.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,red lentil,rice,chicken breast half,almond,white peppercorn
title: Tortilla Di Maialo
ingredients: 2 bone-in chicken breast halves | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon white peppercorns, cracked | 2 teaspoons rice, or as needed | 1/4 cup red lentils, or as needed | 1 tablespoon slivered almonds
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken breast halves in a baking dish skin side down. Sprinkle salt, lemon juice, white pepper, and cracked black peppercorns evenly over chicken. Roast in the preheated oven until the chicken juices run clear, 1 to 1 1/2 hours. An internal temperature of 165 degrees f should be taken after 30 minutes and the chicken should be cooked through. Remove chicken to a platter, and set aside. Rinse black pepper and lentils in a bowl of water. Let sit 25 minutes to soften. Place rice and lentils in a separate dish and pour enough hot tap water into the dish to cover. Remove chicken and place on top of the rice and lentils. Sprinkle almonds on top. Shake dish and refrigerate. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Chocolate Chocolate Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 package chocolate cake mix | 8 ounces cream cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spray the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish with non stick cooking spray. In a bowl, sprinkle the cake mix evenly over the bottom of the pan. Cut the cream cheese into four thin sticks, one each lengthwise, then then into four strands. Insert the cheese sticks into each cake piece, being careful not to break the cake into the cheese. Place in oven and bake for 40 - 45 minutes. Check occasionally, the cheesecake will be puffed up, golden brown and slightly firm to the touch. Remove from oven, let cool for a few minutes, then set on wire rack to cool completely. Store the cheesecake in the refrigerator. When the cake is cold, cut into squares.

title: Minty Scallion Toss
ingredients: 1 tablespoon walnut oil | 8 scallions, trimmed but thinly sliced ( i remove the center stem end, discard outer white portion ) | 1/3 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | 8 teaspoons low fat sour cream or 8 teaspoons low fat yogurt | mint leaf
instructions: Mix the oil, scallions and mozzarella together and spread in a thin layer on your baking sheet. Sprinkle top with sour cream or yogurt and bake in a 400 degree oven about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the oven and let it sit for 3 minutes until it's warm and bubbly. Sprinkle with chopped mint leaves. Serve immediately.

title: Caldo De Dexter
ingredients: 1 rutabaga, peeled and chopped | 1 pound pearl barley | 1 teaspoon chopped toasted epazote leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 cup shredded mexican cheese blend | 1/2 cup chinese noodles, broken into rings
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Roast rutabaga and barley in a baking dish in the preheated oven until tender, about 30 minutes. Remove rutabaga and barley from oven and set aside to cool to room temperature. When the rutabaga is cool enough to handle, remove and discard the outer skin from the rutabaga, then chop. Return chopped rutabaga to a large bowl and sprinkle with epazote, nutmeg, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Toss with cheese and noodles.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,avocado,pepperoni,lettuce leaf,whipping cream,yellow bell pepper,chili garlic sauce,pearl barley
title: Beef Barley Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin, trimmed, cut into thin bite-size pieces | 3/4 cup pearl barley ( about 1 3/4 cups ) | 1/2 small yellow bell pepper, cut into thin rings | 4 lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat whipping cream | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 2 slices pepperoni, halved | 1/4 cup diagonally-sliced avocado
instructions: Coat nonstick skillet with oil, then heat over high heat. Add beef.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce green,jasmine rice,japanese eggplant,tabasco sauce
title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Risotto - Diabetic Friendly
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplants, cut lengthwise on the bias | tabasco sauce | 20 ounces enchilada sauce, can use green | 2 cups cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Toast the jasmine rice. Boil the enchilada sauce in sauce pan. While it is warming, wash eggplant. Cut in half lengthwise and de seed. Dice eggplant and saute until light brown. When rice is done, add to sauce. You may strain the rice before adding to the sauce depending on the amount of rice and eggplant. Stir fry until eggplant is tender. This is not necessary as the rice will cook the eggplant and it will have absorbed more of the sauce and become softer as it absorbs the rice.

title: Roasted Leg of Lamb and Mango
ingredients: 4 lbs leg of lamb ( or other lean lamb ) | 2 cups fresh mangoes, peeled and chopped | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Remove rack from lamb. Score the surface of the meat on each side and place on a rack in a roasting pan or roasting pan about 8 inches deep. Insert skewer 2 inches deep and 1 inch deep in the bone. In a food processor, process the mangoes with a little water. When chopped, add the pumpkin seeds and process until smooth. Spread half the mango stuffing over the lamb and rub the remaining mixture underneath. Spread the rest of the stuffing over the lamb and spread out the pumpkinseed on top of stuffing. Roast lamb for about 1 hour, basting regularly and turning over twice, until the stuffing is brown and dry.

Random Ingredients: mirin,sweetcorn,white mushroom,bread flour,turmeric,black cardamom pod,hot pepper,pepper flake
title: Spicy Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 8 small white mushrooms, chopped ( fresh if possible ) | 1/2 ounce dried sweetcorn ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 ounces bread flour | 5 dried hot peppers ( dried or jalapeã os ) | 4 dried hot pepper flakes | 4 black cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepper | 1 tablespoon mirin or 1 tablespoon chinese rice wine
instructions: Soak mushrooms and sweetcorn in water for at least 1 hour. Drain, cut into 3 pieces and put into a mortar. Grind 2 pods of hot peppers, 2 dry peppers, one black pepper, and one cardamom pods into fine crumbs. Add to mortar and blend well. Fry mushrooms in skillet over medium heat until soft and nicely browned. Add sweetcorn and continue to cook and stir about 2 minutes. In a small bowl, mix together 1/4 c rice wine or mirin. Add to mushroom mixture, stir and simmer until thickened, about 3 minutes. Serve over pasta.

title: Simple Beef "french fries"
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds cubed beef stew meat | 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Heat oil in a deep fryer or large, deep skillet to 375 degrees f. Cut stew beef into cubes, 1 inch square, or smaller. Place cubes in hot oil. Fry in batches, stirring to avoid burning the oil. Drain on paper towels as soon as the last batch is golden, about 3 minutes per batch. An instant read thermometer inserted into the mixture should read at least 160 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: sauce,margarine,curd cottage cheese,apricot jam,basil sprig,orange extract,italian cheese
title: Cheese Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup small curd cottage cheese | 1 cup shredded italian cheese blend | 1 teaspoon orange extract | 3 tablespoons margarine | 3 -5 dashes hot sauce ( tabasco ) | 1 tablespoon dried sweet basil leaves | basil sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Microwave until cheese is melted. Serve over your favourite pasta.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,vegetable stock,grain rice,bacon bit,greek yogurt
title: Greek Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 3 cups cooked whole grain rice | 3/4 cup reduced-fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon bacon bits | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Place rice, yogurt, bacon bits, and romaine lettuce in large bowl.

title: Tamarind Shrimp  (Shrimp Kabobs)
ingredients: 12 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Place shrimp in a zip lock bag and add tamarind paste. Using your hands, mix well, coating shrimp in the mixture. Refrigerate for 4 hours, stirring occasionally. Place shrimp in a metal cooking bag, seal and remove air pockets. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until shrimp are soft. Preheat grill on high. Thread shrimp onto skewers. Cook, brushing occasionally with reserved marinade, for about 8 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Shrimp
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs medium shrimp, peeled | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Remove tails from shrimp and devein. Combine shrimp with onion powder, mint and cheese. Place in a greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Bake at 400f for 20 minutes or until shrimp are pink.

title: Greek Goddess Restaurant Style Bread
ingredients: 2 cups greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 -2 cup hot chicken stock
instructions: Beat together yogurt and bicarb soda until light and creamy. Pour hot chicken stock into the yogurt mixture, stirring until dissolved. Let stand for about 10 - 15 minutes until cool. Serve warm.

title: Pesto Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 cup couscous, preferably whole grain | 1 cup loosely packed fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place the potatoes in a pot, cover with water by 1 inch, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the potatoes are fully cooked, drain and reserve the cooking water, then set aside to cool until manageable. Meanwhile, cook the couscous according to package directions, adding 1/4 cup water and the cilantro about 5 minutes before the end of the cooking process. When the potatoes are cool enough to handle, cut each quarter in half, then cut each half lengthwise into thin slices. Heat the reserved 1/4 cup water in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the oil and swirl to coat the bottom and sides of the pan. When the oil seems to shimmer and just barely shimmer up the edges of the pan, add the potatoes and stir fry until lightly browned and the edges begin to crisp a little, about 2 minutes. Add the couscous and toss to coat. Add the cilantro and stir for a minute or two, until the couscous has absorbed the water. Transfer to a serving platter, and let cool slightly, then serve, or refrigerate until served.

title: Lemon Pepper Raspberry Preserves
ingredients: 9 ounces red sweet bell peppers, halved and seeded | 1/2 cup fresh lemon pepper, chopped | 1 cup raspberries preserves ( about 2 cups ) | 1/4 cup unsweetened flaked coconut, toasted
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position.

title: Amaretto Butter
ingredients: 6 ounces amaretto | fresh ground black pepper | lemon peel, for garnish
instructions: Combine the amaretto and a couple of grinds of black pepper in a small bowl set aside. Add remaining pepper and lemon peel to a small heatproof mug or small pan and melt in the microwave. Pour the cooled amaretto and pepper mixture into the mug, and place onto a table. Chill for an hour in the refrigerator. Garnish with a lemon peel.

title: Chinese Cabbage and Chia Seeds
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 head cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup chia seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Heat vegetable oil over medium high heat. Stir chia seeds, and pour into the hot oil. Bring to a boil, then stir in shredded cabbage. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Turn in the chia seeds just before serving.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,pork tenderloin,pinot noir wine,chili oil,orange peel,nonfat milk,cream mushroom soup,provolone cheese
title: Pork Tenderloin Sandwich
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 8 ounces sliced fully cooked pork tenderloin ( or other tender cut of pork ) | 8 slices provolone cheese | 4 slices reduced-fat provolone cheese | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon thinly sliced orange peel | 1/4 cup nonfat milk | 4 teaspoons patisserie-style minced mushrooms ( optional ) | toasted pinot noir wine ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Toast rolls if desired. Spread cream of mushroom sauce over each of the rolls. Place pork on top of sauce. Place the provolone slices between the pork and the sauce. Sprinkle on the black pepper. Place in oven and bake, turning once or twice until pork is no longer pink inside, 5 - 10 minutes or so. To serve, spread 1/4 cup of the provolone on the inside of each roll. Slice thinly and sprinkle with orange peel.

Random Ingredients: green onion,polenta,white sugar,anise seed,red kidney bean,gingerroot
title: Mexican Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup polenta | 1/2 cup red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 4 green onions | 1/2 cup gingerroot, chopped | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon anise seeds
instructions: In large bowl, combine polenta, kidney beans, green onions, ginger, sugar and anise seed. Mix with hands until well blended.

title: Kiwi Fruit and Salt Substitute
ingredients: 5 kiwi fruits | 3/4 teaspoon lemon zest ( or to taste ) | 1/3 cup splenda granular ( granular is a better choice than splenda but it will be a little less ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried basil, to taste ( i use fresh but dried is too strong for my taste, so i use fresh more )
instructions: Cut kiwi fruit into small pieces and stir in zest. Add splenda and dried basil, to taste. I like to add 1/2 cup extra to thin it out a bit. This recipe tastes even better if it gets a bit dry before serving. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,heavy whipping cream,salmon steak,chuck,basil,spaghetti
title: Chile-Spiked Salmon
ingredients: 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 pound salmon steaks, rinsed and patted dry | 1 pound ground chuck | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh red chile peppers | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 1 package spaghetti, broken into 2-inch pieces
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cream and 1/4 cup water, and set aside. Place salmon in a separate nonporous glass dish. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate. To marinate, in a medium bowl, mix together ground chuck, ground chile pepper, and basil. Drain meat on paper towels, and combine with the cream cream sauce. Set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,vanilla essence,lime zest,pea,chinese barbecue sauce
title: French Canadian White Pizza!
ingredients: 1 pizza type frozen peas, defrosted | 1 1/2 tablespoons chinese barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon mexican blend cheese | 1/2 teaspoon grated lime zest | 1 dash vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat the oven to 230 deg c. Place pizza base sheet on your pizza peel, then place frozen peas on top. Place a dollop of la choy sauce on top of the peas and peas, then sprinkle the cheese, using the lime zest, over. Poke holes in the top with a fork, so the base and peas can breath. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes then check and stir the veggies from the base. If they feel crispy on the outside, pop them back in for 5 minutes or so. Allow to cool slightly before cutting into 12 slices. Serve with cafe creme classic chili sauce.

title: Baked Ziti With Grated Gruyere Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces ziti pasta, such as prego or 12 ounces penne | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 7 large whole serrano chilies | grated gruyere cheese | chopped scallion
instructions: Directions. Preheat the oven to 350°f in a large nonstick skillet, heat the oil. Saute the chiles for 3 minutes. Drain the chiles on paper towels. Set aside. Season the pasta with salt and pepper then place in a medium bowl. Add all the remaining ingredients, except the cheese, to the skillet and toss over medium heat, breaking it up with a wooden spoon. Transfer the pasta to a well oiled baking dish. Top with the grated gruyere and chopped scallions. Bake until the cheese and scallions have melted.

title: Roasted Tzatziki Gyros
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless chuck roast | 2 zucchini, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup lemon juice, or as needed | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed | 3 pita bread rounds, cut in half | 1 large pocketless round, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place chuck roast in a roasting pan and fill with enough water to cover. Cover the roast and cook in the preheated oven until tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Shred meat on the diagonal and return it to the pan. Squeeze the zucchini between your fingers or fork to release juices and to break down into long, ribbons. Stir zucchini into the roast and cook over low heat until zucchini is tender and juices run clear, about 15 minutes. Stir lemon juice into the shredded meat and season with salt and black pepper. Place the pita bread halves around the outside of a large platter. Spoon the meat mixture onto the pita bread and spread to edges with a spatula or spoon. Top with the whipped topping and sliced pita. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,snow pea,peanut butter,rice flour,marinara sauce,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese 5-Spice Noodles With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1 package fresh snow pea, trimmed | 1 1/2 lbs prepared rice flour | 2 tablespoons peanut butter ( light is ok ) | 1 tablespoon chinese five-spice powder | 2 cups prepared marinara sauce | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Start by preparing your rice. Slice one package of fresh snow peas crosswise into 1 inch half inch pieces. Stack them in the center of the counter. With a sharp knife slice snow peas at an angle across and diagonally, then slice perpendicular again across and diagonally. Repeat slices until you reach all the snow peas and slice the next package. Lay out your snow pea slices in front of you and trim excess ends. Spray a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Turn the rice out onto a clean, dry surface. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of peanut butter over the peas. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of five spice with 1 tablespoon of chinese five spice. Dredge the snow peas in prepared rice, followed by 1 tablespoon of rice flour. Repeat. Set the baking dish in a cool place. Pour in 1 cup of prepared marinara sauce. Cover. Let marinate in refrigerator for 20 - 30 minutes. Prepare your snow pea mixture. Place rice noodles onto a large platter or tray. Arrange 1/2 cup of prepared marinara sauce onto each of the snow peas. Using a slotted spoon, place 1/2 cup of prepared marinara sauce into a blender and blend until smooth.

title: Nettie's Summer Clam Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked baby clams | 1/4 cup lime juice, freshly squeezed | 12 radishes, trimmed | 2 tablespoons chives, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons peanut oil, for frying
instructions: Combine the clams, lime juice, radishes, chives, and 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large bowl. Stir gently to combine. Chill. Serve.

title: Baked Mexican Mushroom & Apricot Skewers
ingredients: 1 ounce habanero pepper ( or hot sauce, i have used a hot pepper but i like staying inches ) | 2 ounces toblerone cheese or 2 ounces montrachet grated cheese | 1 tablespoon minced shallots | 1/2 ounce oyster mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 ounce tequila | 2 -3 drops caribbean jerk seasoning
instructions: Pre heat oven to 500°f brush the grill with oil. Soak the mushroom skewers in salt water for 10 - 15 minutes. Slice cheese into small cubes, mix with steak and skewer. Place skewers on hot grill and cook until cheese is melted and starts to bubble. Drizzle with good marinade or a splash of tequila to your preference.

title: Red Chili Paste
ingredients: 10 red chili peppers, diced | 50 g wheat flour ( approximately )
instructions: Roast the chilies by placing them on a baking tray lined with baking paper and roasting them in the oven with the chilies on top for about 15 - 30 minutes until black. This should only take the darker the skin. Remove all of the flesh from the chillies with a spoon and discard the seeds as follows,.. 1. 1. 2. Strain the liquid off of the chilies. You should have approximately 4tblsp worth of liquid. Blend in your favourite dry herb or seasoning. Stir in the flour until the paste can be easily rolled into balls. Place in refrigerator until needed. 3. 4. Place the paste on a non stick vegetable griddle that has been lightly sprinkled with flour. Cook the paste over a medium heat, stirring, until it is golden brown, approximately 10 - 20 minutes.

title: Macaroni Beef and Rice
ingredients: 1 lb cubed beef stew meat | 1 1/2 cups uncooked macaroni | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup rice
instructions: Prepare rice, according to package directions. Cover and cook on stovetop, or large pot for 2 - 3 minutes. Add all of the ingredients, except the macaroni, into crockpot and stir well. Cover and cook on high 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,dark sesame oil,green cardamom pod,clam,cucumber,sherry
title: Quick Seafood Salad
ingredients: 24 large green cardamom pods | 32 small clams | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 6 tablespoons dry sherry | thinly wedges cucumber, for garnish
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium bowl. Dry each clam with paper towels. Scrub clams and discard any that do not close when tapped on the bottom. Divide seafood evenly among 8 serving bowls. Sprinkle with the sesame oil. Spoon salsa atop the shrimp. Sprinkle with cucumber.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,tomato sauce,cranberry,extra virgin olive oil,rice wine,water,yoghurt,taco seasoning
title: Rice & Bean Taco Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup rice wine ( or any red cooking wine ) | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup fresh cranberries | 1 - 1 1/2 cup warm water | 1 tablespoon low-fat greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning ( or other seasoning )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the yogurt and taco seasoning in a small pot. Bring to boil.

title: Chinese Roasted Pepper and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 yellow bell peppers - halved, seeded, and cut into 2 inch strips | 8 ounces soba noodles | 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange 3 yellow bell peppers into a 1 to 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the peppers are tender, about 25 minutes. Remove and cool. Remove and discard the stem and seeds from the remaining peppers. Place peppers in a large bowl. Toss with soba noodles until evenly coated. Spread the peanuts over the pepper mixture. Using a slotted spoon, stir the sweet peppers into the soba noodles and peanuts. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar and dried tarragon. Refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: mace,cream chicken soup,russet potato,italian plum tomato,meat,honey,chinese five spice powder,green cabbage
title: Italian Plum Soup
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, peeled ( approx 1 1/2 lbs. ) | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 head green cabbage, finely chopped | italian plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 teaspoon mace | 1 teaspoon italian five spice powder | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Peel potatoes & slice in half from top to bottom.

title: Cinnamon Sugar (Shrikhand)
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons cinnamon sugar | 1 -2 green cardamoms | cinnamon sugar ( to taste )
instructions: Place 2 - 3 tbls. Dollops of cinammon powder in palm of hand. Place a cinnamon stick in center of palm and put the cinnamon on top, shaking the palm of hand to move the cinnamon and coat the surface of the palm evenly. Place the cinnamon stick on a tea towel to dry out. Repeat with the rest of the dollops. Add cinnamon sugar to your palm and shake the palm of hand to dry out cinnamon sugar and set aside to cool. Store in an airtight tin for up to 1 week.

title: Crispy Sunflower Oil
ingredients: 2 cups sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat in a large pot. When the oil just begins to smoke, add chili oil and quickly fry the sunflower oil until golden brown on all sides. Pour oil into a tea towel/pouring container and set the towel over the oil. It needs to be really tight, so if you make the oil too cold, your oil may splattered before popping, you can do a lot sooner.

title: Quick Chutney Pasta Sauce - Low Fat
ingredients: 8 ounces low fat small curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1 tablespoon fresh corn ( optional )
instructions: Mix the cottage cheese with the mango chutney and corn and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,ice cube,asiago cheese,red chilies,canola oil
title: Spicy Chili Oil
ingredients: 2 red chilies, chopped | 1 cup of grated asiago cheese | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup chili paste | 1/2 cup ice cube
instructions: Place the chillies, asiago cheese, canola oil and chili paste in a food processor together and process until smooth. Place in a glass bottle, seal, and refrigerate or freeze. Use with all or part of your favourite dishes. Garnish with some grated asiago on top, if desired. Can make ahead.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,center pork chop,berry,lemon extract,chinese cabbage,rice wine
title: Chinese Pork Chops and Mixed Berry Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups chinese cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup fresh mixed berry, frozen | 2 teaspoons lemons extract | 2 center-cut pork chops | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Mix all ingredients together except meat in a large baking dish. Cover and bake for 45 minute remove meat from oven and add to vegetables. Bake an additional 30 minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: seasoning mix,icing sugar,confectioner sugar,cucumber,green cardamom pod
title: Mosaic's Turkish Delight
ingredients: 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1 green cardamom pod | 2 1/2 teaspoons seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon ground cucumber, or as desired | 2 1/2 teaspoons confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together 1/4 cup confectioners' sugar and 1/4 cup icing sugar until thoroughly combined. Stir in the cardamom, seasoning mix, and ground cucumber. Cover bowl, and refrigerate 2 to 4 hours. Dust hands with 2 1/2 teaspoons confectioners' sugar before starting to form patties. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat 1 tablespoon confectioners' sugar in the microwave on medium high power until dissolved. Mixture will bubble up. Remove from microwave, and spread onto a plate using a spatula to flatten out. Refrigerate patties until firm. Using another tablespoon, spread remaining confectioners' sugar onto a plate, and spread evenly with a spatula. Roll patties in the confectioners' sugar, and arrange on the plate with a sprinkling of ground pepper. Serve with a dollop of plain yogurt, if desired.

title: The Easiest and Simple Tasting Coffe Beans
ingredients: 2 cups dried currants | 1 tablespoon mccormick currant seasoning
instructions: Wash the dried currants with a swivel brush to remove any sand. Place in a small non aluminum pan with water to cover. Stir and cover. Let sit at room temperature for at least an hour or up to 1 day. Drain and transfer the soaked currants to a heavy 2 cup re sealable plastic bag. Add the dry masala seasoning to the currants and shake bag so the masala adheres. Pack the beans into the re sealable bag. Snip as much air as possible off of the bag. Heat on your gas stove or in the microwave for about 1 minute stirring every now and then. Store the bag in the dark, cool pantry. The best way to use this is to dip the bag in warm water, dip back into the masala, then shake gently with your hands until the masala is wet and all the air is gone. This should make a large bag.

Random Ingredients: cheese,picante sauce,oil vegetable,lime juice,half cream,knorr vegetable soup mix
title: Mexican Dip With Cheese!
ingredients: 1/3 cup oil ( your choice of vegetable ) | 1 package knorr vegetable soup mix | 8 ounces half-and-half cream | 1 jar picante sauce | 8 ounces shredded cheese | 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Pour oil into a medium or large frying pan. Heat oil to medium high and add soup mix. Blend in half and half until well blended and the soup mixes into the oil a little bit. Add the chopped olives and stir to mix. Put heat on medium high until it starts to boil.

title: Tex-Mex Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu, drained | 6 hot dogs ( i use the mini size-sized one ) | 2 cans chili-flavored salsa | 1/3 lb veal, cooked and cut into pieces | 8 fluid ounces skim milk
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Cut the sausages into 1/4 thick slices. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray. Place the tofu and heated sausages on the baking sheet. Bake the sausages for 12 minutes, turning them over halfway during toasting. Remove the baked sausages and tofu from the oven and set aside in an airtight container to cool off. Heat the chili bean salsa in a large skillet over medium heat. To serve, place a warmed sausagemeat on a dinner plate with a hot dog slice on the hot dog.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,napa cabbage,flat leaf parsley,rosemary sprig,chicken stock,lemon grass
title: Gramma's Kielbasa and Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds kielbasa, cut into 1-inch pieces | 3 tablespoons fresh rosemary sprigs | 3 cups chicken stock | 3 large leaves napa cabbage, chopped | 1 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 lemons, cut into wedges
instructions: Place the kielbasa pieces into a large dutch oven, and heat over medium heat. Cook, stirring often, until evenly browned, about 8 minutes. Remove the kielbasa from the pan, place into a bowl, and set aside. Add the rosemary sprigs to the broth, and bring to a boil over high heat. Add the cabbage, and return to a simmer over medium heat. Cover and continue to cook until the cabbage is very tender, 5 to 10 minutes longer. Remove the rosemary sprigs and reduce the broth to about half its original volume, about 10 minutes. Stir in the parsley, remove from the heat, and let cool slightly. Transfer one portion of the kielbasa mixture into a blender, and puree until smooth, or beat the kielbasa mixture in the blender with the broth until smooth.

title: Aubergine Mushrooms With Avocado Appetizer
ingredients: 5 medium shiitake mushrooms | 1 hass avocado | 1 tablespoon custard powder
instructions: Using an avocado, poke hole in the mushroom top with an avocado slice. Add 1 to 2 teaspoons of custard powder in a sauce pan placed over medium heat. Place the mushrooms on a plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,fish,green onion,monterey jack pepper cheese,pie shell,halibut fillet,feta
title: Greek Fish Pie
ingredients: 1 pie shell, unbaked | 1/2 cup self rising flour | 1/2 lb halibut fillet, diced ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 lb boneless skinless fish fillet, diced | 4 ounces feta, crumbled | 1/4 cup chopped green onion | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese ( or your favourite cheese )
instructions: Mix flour with pepperjack cheese. Place filling in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400f degrees for 8 - 10 minutes or till fish is cooked. Slice fish, mix with feta, onions, and cheese. Top with the cheese & fish mixture. Bake additional 5 minutes while warm.

title: Frozen Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stew meat | 5 tablespoons white flour | 2 cups fish stock | 1/2 cup grated cheese | 1/4 cup alfredo sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place stewing beef in a roasting pan and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Insert a wooden skewer into the meat, or use a toothpick. Place meat on middle rack of oven and bake until meat is brown about ½ hour.. Add flour and stir to thicken. Cook over med heat til thickened. Add fish stock. Stir to blend and cook until thick. Remove from heat. Stir in grated cheese and alfredo sauce. Cover pot and let stand over very low heat about 10 minutes. Serve over hot pasta or rice.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,chili sauce,almond paste,chili flake,milk ricotta cheese
title: Chilli-Infused Baked Ricotta and Chili
ingredients: 600 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon thai red chili flakes ( to taste ) | 1/2 tablespoon chili sauce, thai style ( to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon almond paste ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chili flakes, thai red chili sauce | 1 tablespoon chilli flakes, sweet red chili sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together well and place in an oven dish and bake at 190c for 30 minutes. Serve immediately with plain yogurt, papadums, curries, celery and chutney.

title: Grecian Bamya (Baked Okra W-Stained Curd)
ingredients: 1 lb okra, ends trimmed | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 7 ounces feta cheese | 1 can pimientos, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped celery ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Lightly coat a large oven safe frying pan with cooking spray. Wash okra. Cut into 1 inch pieces. Toss with 2 tbsp chopped cilantro and 2 tbsp crumbled feta cheese. If using okra, combine with remaining cilantro and feta cheese. Spread mixture in pan. Bake on a foil lined baking sheet for 30 minutes stirring occasionally, until center is firm and topping is golden. Or, wrap entire pan in foil and bake on baking sheet uncovered for 40 minutes stirring periodically, until hot and bubbly. Serve right away with a dollop of crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,flour tortilla,chestnut,ice water,wheat flour,orange zest,grape,turmeric
title: Chestnut and Orange Wheaten Burritos
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup unbleached flour | 1/4 cup orange zest, grated ( approx 1/4 tsp ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | lemon juice ( approx 2 tbsp. ) | 2 cups ice water | 1 cup chestnuts, shelled | 1 cup sweet whole wheat flour | 1 cup cracked wheat flour ( extra, to help you work with ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric ( extra ) | ice water | 1 orange, juice and zest of ( approx 1/4 tsp. )
instructions: Make sure your food processor is in fine crumbs or place in your food processor with the dry ingredients. Pour in the ice water until it reaches a smooth dough. Using a rolling pin, roll out the dough until it reaches a rectangle about 1/8 thick. Cut into squares 3 inches wide and 4 inches long. Keep all your items from the fridge. Heat up a frying pan, preferably nonstick. Brush the outside of the squares with some olive oil or some butter, fry the squares in batches over medium heat until lightly golden. Take out and cool on a wire rack. Mix all the filling ingredients together in a baking or couscous casserole, except for the grapes. When you are ready, mix together the grapes with the filling mixture. Put in the oven and bake for 5 to 7 minutes, or until the filling is firm and golden. Serve warm or refrigerate and reheat before serving. To reheat, place a small piece of parchment under the surface of the filling and spoon 1/4 cup of boiling water over it. Wrap in another piece of parchment and pop back into the oven for 3 to 5 minutes, to dry out the moisture. Note, these can be frozen or put in ice water in order to get them to freeze.

title: Bourbon and Cardamom Ice Cream (No Egg Noodle)
ingredients: 1 cup berry milk or 1 cup milk | 15 cardamom seeds ( see note in notes ) | 1 cup ice cream, softened | 2 tablespoons bourbon or 2 tablespoons rum
instructions: Heat milk and cardamom seeds in microwave for 2 minutes. Whip softened ice cream to fluffy consistency, cool. Fold milk mixture into chilled ice cream. Pour into a glass and top with bourbon or rum, if using. Enjoy note, the flavour is more enhanced after chilling.

Random Ingredients: coconut,mustard seed,chili sauce,green bell pepper,roast pork,chickpea,parsley leaf
title: Curried Chippy Roast Pork
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs roast fat | 1 head chicke, peeled | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/2 small green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Poke holes all over roast with fork. If necessary, add extra roast fat to pan. Place fat in a large dutch oven or heavy skillet. Add mustard seeds. Heat to a light haze. Add chickeas with enough water to cover. Cook for about 10 minutes, turning occasionally. When chickeas are tender, drain excess liquid, place in a mixing bowl. Add bell pepper, parsley, hot sauce and ground mustard. Mix well.

title: Mexican Cheese and Black Pepper Oat Bars
ingredients: 1 package shredded american cheese | 1/3 cup catsup | 3 1/2 teaspoons quick-cooking oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spread the shredded cheese on a baking sheet. In a bowl, mix the catsup and quickcooking oats. Spread over the cheese. Spread the remaining cheese on top of the cheese. Sprinkle with the oats. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is lightly brown and crumbly, about 15 minutes.

title: Frugal Gourmet's Chicken Risotto (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 250 g chicken thigh, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1/3 cup beer | fruit ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Start rice cooker. Put all ingredients in rice cooker and pulse until rice is cooked. You may also add dried fruits if you wish. This is important. The secret to good risotto is in the beer. If your rice cooker is a bowl, don’t forget the beer. If your rice cooker is a cup, don't forget the beer.

title: Mexican Barbecue Beans
ingredients: 6 cups kale, chopped | 1 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 cans kidney beans, drained ( navy beans may be substituted if preferred ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter
instructions: In a medium nonstick skillet, combine all ingredients except peanut butter.

Random Ingredients: boston lettuce,marinara sauce,italian salad dressing mix,vegetable,lamb,anchovy fillet,chili pepper flake,parmesan cheese
title: Gourmet Magazine Spiedeline
ingredients: 1 head boston lettuce, outer leaves discarded, outer leaves torn into large pieces | 1/4 cup vegetable, cut into small pieces | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing mix | 4 anchovy fillets, chopped | 2 -3 chili peppers flakes, crushed | 12 ounces ground lamb | 8 ounces mixed vegetables, chopped fine | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place the lettuce leaves in a large bowl with the mixed salad dressing mix, anchovies, chilli and pepper flakes. Add the lamb and mix thoroughly. Divide into 6 portions, form a ball and thread onto the toothpicks, securing with toothpicks. Place the meatballs on a cookie sheet lined with foil with two outer rimmed baking sheets below and one in each of two shallow shallow bowls. Preheat the broiler. Arrange the meatballs over the greased foil lined baking sheets, cut side up. Top with the remaining onion rings. Top each piece with a small handful of grated parmesan. Broil in the oven approximately 12 minutes or until cheese bubbles and begins to brown.

title: Mexican Monkey Appetizer
ingredients: 2 1/4 ounces low-fat mexican cheese | 2 slices low-fat brie cheese, halved
instructions: Heat a nonstick griddle or large frying pan. Sprinkle one side of each slice of cheese with a tablespoon of the mexican cheese. Place half a cheese slice on the griddle for about 30 seconds or until cheese begins to melt. The cheese should be slightly softened. Repeat with the second cheese slice and cheese until they are completely melted. Spread half of the melted cheese on the untoasted cheese side of each burger to represent an appetizer, then sprinkle the remaining mexican cheese and mexican cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,grape,tamarind paste,green olive,sauce,italian salad dressing,active yeast
title: Moroccan Green Olive Bread
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup warm italian salad dressing | 2/3 cup hot sauce | 9 ounces pitted green olives, chopped | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1 1/2 - 2 cups crushed grape | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Dissolve yeast and the italian salad dressing over low heat in a large bowl. Stir until dissolved. Let stand 10 to 20 minutes. Stir in hot sauce, olives, tamarind paste, grape and turmeric. Put into two well greased 9x5x3 inch loaf pans. Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour and 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,tomato juice,heavy whipping cream,italian sausage,white wine vinegar
title: Italian Sausage Skewers
ingredients: 8 links mild italian sausage | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 bunch fresh italian scallions or chopped fresh italian scallions, chopped | 8 bamboo skewers, soaked and soaked
instructions: Heat grill or broiler. Lightly oil grill or broiler pan. Remove sausage casings and discard casing. Cook sausage until lightly browned on the outside and cooked through, about 10 minutes per side. Cut sausage into 1 inch pieces. In a medium bowl, mix cream, vinegar, and scallions. Place sausage on a plate. Pour some of the cream mixture into the skillet, and coat evenly. Stir in sausage, and cook for about 10 minutes, until lightly browned.

title: Smoked Turkey Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey breast | 2 -3 green cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons sultanas ( golden raisins ) | 20 black peppercorns | 1 orange, zest of | 2 tablespoons raspberries ( red berries can be substituted ) | 1 1/2 cups mixed berries
instructions: The day before cooking, combine ground turkey, chopped orange zest and ground sultanas. Mix well. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate at least an hour, preferably overnight. To cook, remove meat from marinade and pat dry with paper towels. Remove orange zest, cardamom pods and peppercorns. Remove orange rinds and add raspberries and mixed berries. Mix well. Thread 2 to 3 pieces of turkey at a 45 degree angle onto each skewer. Grill on medium hot grill about 5 minutes per side, until cooked through. Be careful not to overcook. Serve with plain boiled rice/roti.

title: Italian Patty Melt Recipe
ingredients: 4 slices prosciutto di parma | 4 hamburger rolls | 4 romaine lettuce leaves, washed and patted dry
instructions: Using a paper thin bladed knife, split the tops of the rolls. Place the rolls on a cutting board and place one slice of prosciutto on top.

title: Curry Powder
ingredients: 4 teaspoons curry powder ( i add a teaspoon at a time ) | 4 teaspoons sweet sherry wine
instructions: Mix in a small bowl.

title: Crock Pot Easy Chicken Veronique
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast fillet, cut into 1-inch cubes ( or skinless breasts ) | 1/4 cup vegetable broth
instructions: Place chicken breast pieces in crock pot. Cover with broth. Cook on high for 6 hours or low for 4 - 5 hours. Remove chicken breasts to serving platters or serving bowls. If your crock pot allows it, leave lid on during cooking. This will allow the moisture from the chicken to get in the crock to thicken up a little.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,spring onion,red curry paste,kosher salt black pepper,wonton skin
title: Simple Thai Wontons (Samaki)
ingredients: 3 red bell peppers, halved and seeded | 3 spring onions, finely chopped | 1/4 cup red curry paste | 1 pinch kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 package wonton skins
instructions: Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Place the bell peppers in a bowl, and pour enough boiling water into the bowl to cover. Let peppers steam until softened, about 5 minutes. Remove peppers from water, and cool completely. Remove peppers from water and coarsely chop the flesh. Place the cooked peppers in a bowl, and stir in the red curry paste, salt, and pepper. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or refrigerate for up to 24 hours to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,arugula,chili pepper flake,oyster sauce,red chilies
title: Marinated Arugula and Chilli
ingredients: 1 cup arugula, loosely packed | 1 cup vegetable oil flavored cooking spray | 2 dried red chilies | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Remove the stems from the chilis and finely chop the flesh. Cut the chillies into thin slices and cut each into 3 strips. Arrange the arugula on a flat surface and place the chilis and chili in the centre of the arugula.

title: Easiest Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 -2 lb lean beef brisket | 1/2 cup finely chopped hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup green olives, coarsely chopped | hot coffee ( optional )
instructions: Cut brisket in half. Place beef in crockpot with eggs, olives and coffee. Cover and cook 10 - 12 hours on low. Serve with mashed potato or boiled egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin fillet,red chili pepper,broccoli floret,white pepper
title: Stir-Fried Beef With Broccoli
ingredients: 5 tablespoons white pepper | 1/2 lb beef tenderloin fillet | 4 cups broccoli florets | 6 medium dried red chili peppers
instructions: In a heatproof bowl or other heavy large skillet over moderate heat, grind the pepper into a coarse grain. Add the beef and turn once to coat. Slightly cook the beef for 3 minutes on each side. Transfer the beef to a platter. Add the broccoli, chilies and some salt and pepper. Heat the oil in the pan and fry the bruschetta until hot and piping hot, about 1 minute. Transfer the beef and veggies to a plate. Drain the pan from the beef and spoon off most of the drippings. Add it to the pan, scraping up the browned bits and cooking the beef until the sauce is almost dry, 1 1/2 to 2 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: black bean,meat,egg substitute,dill weed,creole seasoning,red potato
title: Ole! Meat-less French Fries
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes, cut into 3/4 to 1-1/3 slices each | 1 can black beans, drained | 2 cups frozen southern fried meat, of choice | 2 1/2 cups egg substitute or 2 1/2 cups yolks | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning ( optional, i use tony chachere's creole seasoning ) | 2 teaspoons black dill weed ( optional, i prefer fresh dill weed ) ( optional, i prefer fresh dill weed ) ( optional, i prefer tony chachere's creole seasoning ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 °f. In a large bowl, mix together the potato slices and black beans. Using hands, mix everything well and divide mixture into 4 even portions and set each portion aside on a parchment lined baking sheet. In another bowl, pour in enough egg substitute or yolks to cover all portions of potato mixture. With a wooden spoon, stir egg substitute into potato mixture with a rubber spatula until a smooth, white sauce is formed. Add creole seasoning and dill weed if desired. Place half of each portion of potato mixture on prepared baking sheet and bake french fries until crisp, turning once.

title: Passover Steak
ingredients: 1 whole steak | 1 cup orange juice | matzo meal
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Rub the outside of the steak with matzo meal. Place the steaks in a roasting pan, and cover with hot olive oil. Bake in the preheated oven for 2 hours, or until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 140 degrees f. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 145 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,black greek olive,italian parsley,plum tomato,cream tartar,peppercorn
title: Mellow Tomato-White Gazpacho
ingredients: 4 -6 plum tomatoes, fresh, vine-ripened, seeded and roughly chopped | 1 cup heavy cream | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 6 black greek olives, roughly chopped ( stoned ) | 1 small bunch fresh italian parsley, finely chopped | 6 peppercorns
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large jug and blend. Cover and freeze until required. Transfer to a large, chilled bowl and stir in parsley, peppercorns and the salt. Season again with salt if desired.

title: Savoury Bread With Anchovies
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 2 leeks, finely sliced | 4 anchovies, peeled and grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees celsius. Place the flour into a large bowl and rub in the leeks. Make a well in the mixture and pour in 2 cups of boiling water. Use your hands to gather all the loose pieces of flour into a dough. Knead dough for 5 minutes, dust in a little more flour if the dough is too sticky. Turn dough onto a floured board and knead again for 5 minutes more. Place dough on a greased, preferably non stick baking sheet. Roll out to about 2mm thick. Cut into slices with the cutter. Arrange on a baking tray. Bake for about 15 minutes, until pale golden. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Lemon-Ricotta Ricotta Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/2 cup bottled lemonade | freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Stir the ricotta, picante sauce, lemonade, and pepper together in a large bowl until smooth.

title: Deli Slice
ingredients: 1/2 pound slice deli roast beef, chopped | 1/2 pound celeriac, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Place roast beef and celeriac in a 2 cup glass pie dish. Mix in crumbs. Bake in the preheated oven until top is browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken soup base,heavy whipping cream,ladyfinger,wheat flour
title: Easy Tiramisu
ingredients: 12 ladyfingers | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 4 tablespoons chicken soup base ( or your favourite flavor ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Heat the chicken soup base in a small heavy saucepan over low heat or in the microwave until slightly bubbling. Pour about 1/4 cup of the hot soup base into your bowl of a large sieve over a clean, dry towel to drain fat. Place 1 ladyfinger into the sieve, moisten with water, and press it gently into the moistened surface. Arrange 2 more ladyfingers in a large glass baking dish that can be molded so that they fit snugly onto the dish. Pour 1/2 cup of the hot soup base evenly over the ladyfingers in the dish. Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake, uncovered, at 350 °for 20 minutes or until golden brown. When cooled, spread the cream over the top and refrigerate for up to 2 hours. Remove from the refrigerator and let sit at room temperature for 8 hours or until completely chilled to serve.

title: Sausage and Kielbasa
ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 1 small mustard pickling onion, left whole | 1/4 cup diced sweet pickling onions | 1/4 cup pickling onions, diced | 3 kielbasa | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 lb rotelle pasta ( dry ) | 1 jar green olives | 1/4 cup pickling onions, sliced | 1 teaspoon dried cumin powder | 1 -2 drop hot sauce
instructions: Bake sausage until lightly browned. Set aside and allow flavors to mingle. In large skillet, saute bacon until crisp. Remove to paper towels to drain and reserve. In same skillet, add sauteed bacon, remaining contents of pickling onions and cumin powder. Cover and saute for 20 minutes. Add diced sweet pickling onions and hot sauce to taste and simmer until water is absorbed. Add the pasta and olives and heat until heated through. Add the drained sausage and allow to sit on top of the pasta for 15 minutes to absorb moisture. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,chocolate square,egg substitute,spaghetti sauce,vanilla,kaffir lime leaf,orange zest
title: Orange Mousse With Chocolate Squares
ingredients: 2 tablespoons low sodium yellow salt | 2 squares unsweetened chocolate squares, roughly chopped ( not butter or margarine ) | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 cup orange zest | 12 ounces uncooked spaghetti sauce | 3 kaffir lime leaves, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line and flour a 4 to 6 cup serving bowl with plastic wrap extending over sides of bowl. In shallow pan, melt chocolate and mix well, set aside. In large bowl, whisk egg substitute, vinegar, zest, and half the orange sauce with a whisk. Add chocolate mixture and beat with whisk until smooth. Stir in remaining sauce. Gently mix in remaining orange zest. Spoon mixture into prepared bowl. Use tooth pick or sharp knife to insert zest carefully and evenly over surface of filling, in strips or diamonds or other shapes. Arrange the chocolate mousse in an attractive pattern. Decorate with orange zest and lime leaves. Serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Dijon Prosciutto Wrapped in Phyllo
ingredients: 1 teaspoon finely chopped prosciutto, fresh ( italian cured ham ) | 2 -8 slices dijon-style mustard ( thin slices )
instructions: Preheat a heavy skillet over medium heat. Line the work surface with parchment. Place a piece of prosciutto near the base of the skillet, and roll around the prosciutto so prosciutto is captured on the sides. Arrange one slice of dijon style dijon mustard on top of prosciutto, then wrap up the prosciutto into a log about 2 long and 1/2 thick. Wearing kitchen gloves, transfer log to an ungreased baking sheet. Repeat with a second piece of prosciutto wrapped in phyllo. Brush tops of log with dijon style mustard before baking. Slide log out of the skillet and arrange in an even single layer on a baking sheet with rim. Bake in a 400 degree f oven until it becomes a nice golden color, about 20 to 30 minutes, depending on the thickness of the prosciutto. Cool log on a cutting board for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,red pepper,italian parsley,meringue nest,beef brisket,nutmeg,chipotle chile,kaiser
title: Spicy Chipotle Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons italian parsley | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef brisket | 3 dried meringues nest, leaves ( see note below ) | 3 tablespoons fresh ground red pepper | 2 chipotle chiles, in adobo | 2/3 cup fresh italian parsley | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 4 kaiser rolls, split
instructions: Place brown sugar in a small pot set over medium heat, stirring often, until melted. Keep stirring until mixture is light golden brown, and has a syrupy taste, about 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from heat, and pour onto a sheet of wax paper. Set aside. Wipe brisket with a damp cloth, and trim off the excess fat. Slice across the grain in 1/4 inch thick slices. Place in a bowl, pour on the brown sugar syrup, and stir until mixed well. Add the remaining ingredients, and mix well to incorporate. Place brisket in a glass dish, cover, and refrigerate overnight, turning several times. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f and place brisket fat side up on a foil lined baking sheet or roasting pan with a 1/2 inch raised edge. Bake brisket in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until it reaches 155 degrees f on an instant reading thermometer. Slice when done, and serve with warm slices of bahn toasted with a dollop of dijon mustard.

title: Duck Breasts with Coconut Milk and Coconut Adobo
ingredients: 1 duck breast, whole | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon coconut milk powder
instructions: Put the duck breast in a pan, pour enough water in to cover, and cover with a lid. Boil about 15 minutes depending on how tender you are, how tender you want your duck to be. Remove the duck breast, drain and reserve. Slice into thin strips. You should use half of the breast. Combine the coconut milk powder and fish sauce in a small bowl, and set aside. Dip the duck breast pieces into the coconut milk. Reserve any leftover coconut milk. Grill the duck. If necessary, cook in the oven and turn every 10 minutes until it is browned. Serve with your favorite curry.

title: Lemony Peaches
ingredients: 2/3 cup peach juice | 1/3 cup tamari | 1 tablespoon clams in sauce or 1 tablespoon cherry juice
instructions: Simmer peach juice, tamari and clams in saucepan. Heat through.

title: Mock Daisy Stock

instructions: Stir chicken stock, marshmallows, ground anise seed, fresh dill weed, and brandy together in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until hot, and simmer for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,ginger juice
title: Zababees
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger juice | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spices mix
instructions: Grind up ginger and mix with zabies and put in an air tight tin.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Gyros

instructions: Combine hot red pepper flakes and crushed red pepper flakes in small bowl, mix well. Pour half of mixture into small baking dish. Cover dish with foil, and bake 15 minutes at 375 degrees, or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear, and sauce is very thick. Serve with sauce or guacamole.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,noodle,turmeric powder,tomato juice,ghee,shortcut bacon,caraway seed,tortilla chip
title: Noodles With Caraway Spread
ingredients: 2 cups skim milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 6 slices shortcut bacon, cooked until crisp, drained and crumbled | 1 cup noodle, toasted ( such as vermicelli, thin spaghetti or whole wheat ) | 2 teaspoons grated carrots, powder | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds, toasted | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons ghee or 1 1/2 tablespoons butter

Stir in the cheese and cook until cheese has melted. To serve, spread the toasted noodles evenly over the top of the cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,cheese,red grape,brandy,rotel tomato,canadian bacon,lime zest
title: Mexican Kiwi and Bacon Salad
ingredients: 1 lb sliced kiwi fruit | 10 ounces shredded cheese | 3 ounces cubed canadian bacon | 1/4 cup brandy ( or syrup ) | 1/2 lime, zest of, grated | 1 jar red seedless grapes | 3 1/2 tablespoons grated cheese
instructions: Place kiwi fruit in a salad bowl. Dice cheese and place in bowl. Add brandy to sauce if using, simmer for a minute or two to soften a little. Add lime rind and grated cheese to the cheese. Pour over kiwi and toss to combine. Top with cheese slices.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,chile,cilantro,thai red curry paste,tomato,chicken broth,pecan,chinese mushroom
title: Thai Red Curry and Roasted Pecans

instructions: Preheat oven to mix crushed tomatoes with chicken broth, sugar, spices, and pecans in a large bowl and mix well. Put in a 9x13 dish and bake 30 minutes. Mix pecans and mushrooms into the curry and sprinkle on top of stew.
