title: Cheese Crisp With Lemons
ingredients: 1/2 lb american cheese, cut up | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemon peel | 4 corn tortillas, cut in 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a 10 inch nonstick skillet, layer 1/3 cheese.

title: Ginger Beer Sweet Potato & Snow Pea Mash
ingredients: 750 g sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 5cm chunks | 1 teaspoon grated gingerroot | 1/4 cup dark beer | 2 tablespoons grenadine | 250 g channa dal, soaked overnight drained | 2 cups snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Place potatoes, ginger, beer and grenadine in a pan and bring to the boil. Cook until potatoes are tender, stir through chana dal and cook for 1 minute. Add peas and cook for 2 more minutes.

title: Sunchies
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs self-raising flour ( measure after measuring ) | 1 ounce unsalted butter | 1 can pizza dough | vegetables | 1 red chilies, deseeded and chopped or 1 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon mirin ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon copha
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Grease baking sheet, and line with parchment paper. Measure flour into a large bowl. Melt the butter in a saucepan with a splash or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, over a low heat. When butter is melted stir in dry ingredients, and a few drops of milk if the mixture is too dry add a couple of tablespoons of water, until it forms a soft dough. Turn onto a lightly floured surface. Knead the dough gently on a lightly floured surface until no longer sticky, and the dough is smooth. Turn dough onto a well floured board, and knead again, until smooth, elastic and fairly firm. Grease a large round 20cm fluted tin with oil, and put onto the greased baking sheet. Using your hands, press the dough down and gently lift the edge of the tin to free form it. Make three impressions in the dough with your fingertips. Press the edges firmly into each impression. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until light brown. Allow to cool for a few minutes, then break into large squares. Serve with dipping sauces or fillings.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,bamboo shoot,buttermilk,lime zest,potato starch,vegetable broth,palm sugar
title: Sweet Potato and Pistachio Covered in Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons potato starch | 400 g sweet potatoes, peeled and quartered | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon grated lime zest ( or lemon rind ) | 100 g bamboo shoots, sliced thinly | 50 g shelled pistachio nuts | 1 tablespoon palm sugar, lightly packed
instructions: Place potato starch in a bowl and stir in enough cold water to make a paste. Add sweet potato, vegetable broth, lime zest and half the bamboo shoots and mix well until the sweet potato slices are completely covered. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes at room temperature.

instructions: Put chicken thighs in a roasting pan. In a bowl, stir together barbecue sauce, sesame oil, vinegar, and mace.

title: Gluten Free (Guilt Free) Sponge Cake Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 4 cups cake flour | 2 cups rice wine vinegar
instructions: Make sure the cake flour doesn’t make a very stiff dough. Use a plastic rolling pin, cut the dough into 2cm pieces. Add a little flour at a time until the dough is manageable. Place in a non stick cake tin or pan and allow to rise for around 15 - 20 minutes, or until cooked. Allow to cool, then lightly flour the tortillas leaving the rest to dip in the vinegar. Once your cake has risen, cut into desired shapes using a sharp knife or a scalloped biscuit cutter. Spray them with oil or butter and allow to set as low as possible before placing on a cooling rack to allow the tortillas to set up. When the tortillas have set, slice or stack them using a cake cutter to cut out the excess dough. Place them on paper plates and leave the to set up for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: white wine,ham,tahini,garlic granule,baking powder,worcestershire sauce,butternut squash
title: Butternut Squash Ham Cake With Tahini and Garlic
ingredients: 2 cups butternut squash, cooked whole ( or diced in 3/4's ) | 2 teaspoons garlic granules, crushed | 1/2 cup ham, cooked and chopped | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons tahini, light | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease and sugar 4 bundt cake pans. Toss squash in a bowl with the garlic granules. Place ham in a 1 1/2 quart casserole and top with squash. title: Chocolate, Radish and Foil Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 16 ounces button mushrooms | 8 -10 cherry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon chocolate | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes
instructions: Boil up water in a pot. Clean the mushrooms by placing the stalks into hot water for the first time then removing the stalks and remove the stalks. When done, drain. Reserve. De stem mushrooms. Heat up the olive oil in a pan, add dried onion, cherry tomatoes and chopped onion. Cook them for a minute then add the mushrooms. When the mushrooms become tender and the mixture changes color and moisture from the mushrooms, add the coriander powder and chocolate powder and mix together. Cook for 5 minutes. Garnish with dried onions and enjoy.

instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Spray or brush a 9x13 inch pan with cooking spray. Prepare onion soup mix according to package directions. Place the tofu slices in a large serving platter or baking dish and top with the soup mixture. Bake uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes, or until soup thickens and cheese is melted.

title: No Peeky Poppy Seed Chili & Beans-Slow Cooker
ingredients: 16 ounces pinto beans, drained | 1 package lipton reduced-fat sour onion soup mix | 14 ounces of mild diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can of chopped chipotle chiles | 1 teaspoon pure dried chipotle chile | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar or 1/4 cup sugar | splash splenda brown sugar or 1 light brown sugar substitute | toasted poppy seed
instructions: Place all ingredients in the slow cooker in the order listed. Do not brown the beans. Do not drain. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours, stirring once or twice during cooking to see if liquid is absorbed. Serve warm with a garnish of fresh parmiggies.

title: Cottage Cheese and Shrimp
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 container cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 lb raw jumbo shrimp | 1 carrot, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine rotel tomatoes and cottage cheese, lime juice, and jumbo shrimp in blender.

instructions: Soak the dried red chillies in warm water 20 minutes so they soften. Combine all ingredients in a small heavy based saucepan over medium low heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until thick.

title: Quick and Easy Kimchee Pork Chop Suey
ingredients: 2 lbs pork fillets, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 lb fresh white mushroom, sliced | 1 lb fresh fresh egg noodles, made according to package, cooked and drained | 2 packages frozen whole egg noodles, cooked and drained | 3 -4 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 3 -4 tablespoons black peppercorns, cracked ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large skillet. Bring to a boil, lower heat, cover and simmer 5 to 10 minutes or until pork is cooked through. Taste the pork for desired tenderness. Serve with warm korean dipping sauce. Sauce, mix together all ingredients and stir until well mixed.

title: Soupa Keftet (Beef Brisket)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed of excess fat | 1 large yellow onion, cut into 4 thick slices | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dry sherry or 1/2-3/4 cup water | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | chopped coriander or parsley ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to high heat. Trim excess fat from brisket and trim excess fat. Place brisket under indirect heat. Grill brisket, turning if necessary, until well browned, about 25 minutes. If brisket starts to burn, cover it loosely. Turn brisket over and grill until meat thermometer reaches 130f on the thickest part of the brisket, about 45 minutes longer. Turn meat over again and grill until thermometer reaches 135f for medium rare, 15 - 20 minutes more. Let rest for at least 10 minutes before carving. Slice thin and serve with the onions, chickpeas and sherry.

title: Bread of Beetroot (Burgundy)
ingredients: 10 raw beets, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch wedges | 1 -2 tablespoon mixed italian herbs | 2 tablespoons chutney
instructions: Place the beets in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, until tender. Drain, and place in a bowl of cold water. When cool enough to handle, peel, and slice into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place in a bowl with mixed herbs and chutney. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour before serving. Garnish with whole or whole roasted corns to taste and sliced strawberries.

title: Baked Yoghurt With Olives and Kalamata
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups yoghurt | 1/2 cup kalamata olive
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place yoghurt in a baking dish. Mix with a fork. Pour into oven dish and bake for 20 minutes or until lightly browned around the edges. Serve warm, hot, chilled or over night.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,baby octopus,rice vinegar,pine nut
title: Roasted Baby Octopus With Pine Nuts and Chilli Jam
ingredients: 1 kg baby octopus | 6 tablespoons pine nuts or 6 tablespoons finely chopped walnuts | 1 small red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Bring 5 cups cold water to the boil and carefully skim off the surface. Rinse the octopus well under cold water and pat dry with a paper towel. Remove the tubes and heads from the octopus. Use a skewer or your hands to remove the excess gills and any remaining muscle tabs. Place the octopus in the boiling water and cook for 20 minutes. Drain. Remove the octopus from the boiling water and set aside. Heat the oven to 200c/fan 160c/gas in a clean ovenproof bowl, scatter the nuts over the base of the octopus and pour in boiling water. This will cause the water to cook out and rise above the octopus. Bake the octopus for 15 - 20 minutes and set aside. While the octopus is cooking, combine the chilli & vinegar in a small bowl. Boil until reduced by half. Drain the water and leave to cool quickly. Scrape the reduced sauce into a saucepan and cook until reduced and thickened. Return the octopus to the pan and stir well, ensuring that the flavours are evenly distributed. Pour over the octopus and serve either warm or at room temperature.

title: Butternut Squash Stove Top Casserole
ingredients: 2 butternut squash | 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin | 12 ounces tomato paste | 3 tablespoons margarine or 3 tablespoons butter | 1 1/2 lbs half-and-half | 1/2 teaspoon table salt
instructions: To deseed and cut squash in half about 1/2 inch thick. If you have the 2 inch diameter at home cut the squash into 3/4 inch thick long thin slices. Cut half of the squash in half lengthwise, if the cut is large, remove that half. Cut the 2 halves in to the same size cubes as the squash. Remove the zest of the squash and discard. Discard the zest. Cut meat off the tip of the tail and discard it. Cut in 1 tablespoon pieces, if it is too lean, if it is too lean add a little more meat. Add tomato paste and butter to a large skillet with a bit of water. Cook over medium high heat until bubbly. Add meat, squash, salt and half and half and cook, stir occasionally for at least 45 minutes or until meat is cooked thoroughly. Let rest until squash is done and sauce is thickened.

title: Angel Hair Pasta and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta | 1 can button mushrooms, drained
instructions: Cook the angel hair pasta in just enough lightly salted water to cover for 5 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Italian Pot Roast

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Liberally grease a roasting pan with cooking spray. Pour red pepper flakes into a resealable plastic bag. Add beef.

instructions: Chop prunes roughly, but not liquefied. Cook prunes whole in hot madeira, and drain. Place prunes in bowl with yoghurt, sesame oil, and honey, mix well. In shallow tray, layer ingredients with prune compote, pressing gently onto tray. Refrigerate until cold.

title: Italian Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 hoagie roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place wings in a pot of lightly salted water and bring to a boil. When the water is boiling, uncover and place the pot over high heat. Arrange each one on a separate baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, or until a meat thermometer reads 170 degrees f. Turn off the oven, transfer the wings to a plate and sprinkle with salt. Serve hot or warm.

title: Lamb or Pork Sausage Rollups

instructions: Mix together the meat, tvp, and marillade. Divide the filling among two 4 x 1/2 inch patty tins. Top with a lettuce leaves and crumb the marinated meat. Place one crumbly roll on top. Cut sausage rolls into slices of 1/2 inch thickness and serve.

title: Cuban-Mexican Potatoes

instructions: Heat a few tablespoons of nonstick cooking spray in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add one fourth cup of the potato slices and stir to coat with the coating spray. Turn off the burner and stir the potatoes to mix with the other ingredients. Mixture should still be slightly wet, but not watery. Transfer the mash to a serving dish and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of potato slices. Garnish with remaining 1/4 cup chopped sweet onion.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,dark sesame oil,worcestershire sauce,cornstarch,mushroom,cream tartar
title: Stove Top Easy Beef Tips

instructions: Thoroughly dry roast meat in a non stick skillet without crowding, and place in the slow cooker. Combine all remaining ingredients and pour over the meat. title: Apple and Swiss Chard Pasta Salad

instructions: In a 4 to 6 qt saucepan of boiling water, blanch chard and parsley for 2 minutes. Transfer to strainer, reserving liquid in pan. Rinse chard and parsley, then dry well and roughly chop. instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f, 400 degrees f. Mix together thyme, courgette, cardamom, olives, sausage, and kaiser rolls until evenly mixed. title: Chinese 5 Spice Lamb Steaks

instructions: Combine chicken with next 7 ingredients in a large resealable plastic zipper bag.

ingredients: 2 large chicken breast halves, boneless and skinless | 100 g cauliflower, broken into florets | 400 ml soymilk | 1 chicken leg, thighs and thigh bone, cut into 8 pieces

instructions: Sprinkle both sides of the steak with a pinch of baking soda and allow the brined beef to dry on a sheet pan lined with parchment paper for 45 minutes to an hour, or up to 8 hours. Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Brush the inside of a roasting pan with the oil. Place the meat slices on a rack in the pan and bake for about 20 minutes, then add the apricots and bake for another 20 minutes. Transfer the sausages to a platter.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,water liquid,white rice,yellow onion,lemon juice,arborio rice
title: Yellow Rice and Coriander

instructions: In large saucepan cook rice and onion in boiling water, covered, until tender, about 45 - 50 minutes. Stir. Return all to saucepan, add 3 1/2 c water and lemon juice. title: Kohara (Baked Ocean Salmon)

instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Thread alternate pieces of fish over skewers and brush both sides of kohara with butter. Sprinkle both sides with ghee and salt and pop them into the hot oven. Watch as it starts to pop and sizzle when the kohara's are light golden and springy about 15 - 20 minutes. Check by carefully removing the fish from the oven and placing one piece on the skewer with kohara flesh on the top if all pieces have been removed put on a plate and set aside. Repeat and check again if all pieces are cooked. The pumpkin should easily flake away and it should still be pink on the surface, if not, just pop it back in the oven. Remove the kohara and serve, sprinkled with celery salt if desired.

title: Tropical Key Lime Jam
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds pineapple rings | 1 1/4 pounds key lime juice, divided
instructions: Pour 1½ pounds of crushed pineapple rings into a large saucepan over medium heat. Cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until the pulp has evaporated and the mixture becomes brittle, about 10 minutes. Stir in 1 pound of key lime juice. Remove from heat, and remove the rind and pulp. Pack into clean, sterilized jars, leaving about 2/3 inch of headspace. Fill with remaining key lime juice, leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Seal, and process in a hot water bath for 20 minutes, or until the temperature is released right away. Refrigerate jam immediately, after opening.

title: Green Beans With Mint
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans ( preferably young ones ) | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint | 1/4 cup pure vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons good quality turmeric ( i use pimentos brand )
instructions: Boil beans until al dente. Drain, rinse with cold water, and remove tips of beans. Cut in 1/3 inch pieces. Set aside. Place remaining ingredients in a blender or food processor, and blend until smooth. Place beans in a serving dish, pour in the mint and blend briefly. Serve warm, or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,peach,garlic pepper seasoning,grain white rice,curry leaf
title: Curried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice ( can use minute rice ) | 3/4 3/4 cup peaches or 3/4 cup raisins | 1 teaspoon garlic pepper seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 cloves garlic peppers, cut in half lengthwise and sliced thin
instructions: Wash your rice with water. Put rice in a bowl and cover with clean water and leave in refrigerator to wilt. Wash out your pot and set on medium heat. When your water comes to a boil, add half the sliced garlic, and all pepper, cooking 2 - 3 minutes until fragrant. Add your peaches. When peaches are soft, add your rice and spices, stir, turn down heat, cover and do not boil. Allow to cook 30 - 45 minutes, until all liquid is absorbed. Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Tasty Roasted Pepper Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 head red peppers, roasted | 1 lb bulb fennel, roasted | 16 ounces plain yogurt | 1 lime, zest of | mustard
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Cut peppers in half and scrape out the seeds. Place in a roasting tin and toss with the fennel. Cover and roast for 1 hour. Cool completely and remove cores. With a peeler, peel away the skin and seeds from the pepper and the fennel and cut into quarters. Place all the spices into a food processor and add the yogurt, lime zest and mustard and process to combine. Remove the spices from the oven and stir well. Spoon the pepper mixture into sterilized jars, leaving 1/2 inch space on the top. Seal with a small, wet twist or metal spool if desired. If refrigerated, this will keep for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: cream,egg noodle,lamb,tomato puree,green cabbage,wheat flour,maple syrup
title: Creamy Lamb and Noodle Croquettes
ingredients: 1 lb lean lamb, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons sour cream | 3 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 cups green cabbage, finely shredded | 2 cups egg noodles, preferably multi-colored variety
instructions: Place the lamb in a large frypan, cook over medium high heat for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon and set aside. Reduce heat to low and add the sour cream and tomato puree. Cook for 3 minutes longer. Remove with slotted spoon. Meanwhile, cook the noodles according to package directions. Drain and return to the pan. In a large bowl combine the lamb and any juices from the lamb.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,iceberg lettuce,white chocolate,green salsa,tahini,green bell pepper
title: Salsa Cruda With Tahini and White Chocolate
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1/2 cup green salsa | 1/2 cup green salsa | 2 tablespoons white chocolate, grated | 1 teaspoon dry rubbed sage leaves | 1/2 cup iceberg lettuce
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl and mash to a fine paste. Spoon onto lettuce leaves and roll up. Serve with white chocolate drizzled on top.

title: Cumberland Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/4 small cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 tablespoon grated orange rind
instructions: In a large pan, boil the cauliflower for about 10 minutes, until just tender. Drain in a colander and toss with the orange rind.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,chipotle chile adobo,orange juice,english toffee bit,tortilla chip
title: Chipotle Caesar Salad (Tortilla Chips)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dry english toffee bits | 2 cups toasted tortilla chips | 1/4 cup orange juice, to taste | 1/3 cup chipotle chile in adobo | 1 head romaine lettuce or 1 head red leaf lettuce | 4 -8 cups romaine lettuce or 4 -8 cups iceberg lettuce
instructions: Combine toasted tortilla chips and orange juice in a bowl. Stir in chipotle chile and adobo. Serve at once or chill, tightly covered, in fridge for up to one hour, stirring a few times during the marination process. Toss and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,ginger paste,grand marnier,swiss cheese
title: Swiss Cheese With Plums and Ginger
ingredients: 1 cup swiss cheese, cubed ( about 4 cups ) | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, preferably san marzano, drained | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 3 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large, microwave safe casserole dish. Microwave, covered, on high power for 3 minutes. Stir, uncover, and cook in microwave on high until cheese is melted, about 3 minutes. Serve warm. Makes 2 servings.

title: Spam and Scamorza Appetizers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 cup finely chopped iceberg lettuce | 1 scallza cheese, rind removed and cut into matchsticks
instructions: In a small bowl, melt the sugar until it turns pale golden in colour. In a large bowl, pour the icing sugar evenly over the scallza and finely shred the cheese. Roll the mixture into 1 balls with your hands if you wish. Refrigerate the balls for at least one hour so that everything is really soft. Dip the balls in the icing sugar to lightly coat and sprinkle over the scallza to serve.

title: Linguine With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb veal, thinly sliced | 2 shallots, minced | 2 cups breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons saffron | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons minced fresh breadcrumbs
instructions: Place one cup bread crumbs in a bowl. Add half the saffron, the tabasco and the shallots. In a large baking dish, place the veal slices and top with the bread crumbs. Arrange the slices on top of bread crumbs. Dip in the remaining saffron, using your fingers and spoon over the bread crumbs. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Turn the bag over and refrigerate the next day. Turn the oven on to 400°f remove the remaning slices of veal and arrange them on uncoleasted foil lined baking sheets. Bake for 20 minutes or until browned.

title: Sausage Patties (Avocado Balls)
ingredients: 1/4 lb smoked sausage, ground or 1/4 lb kielbasa ( or substitute beef sausage ) | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1/2 cup cabbage, finely shredded | 1/2 cup coriander, finely chopped | 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, grated | 24 biscuits, split in half | 1 avocado, peeled, halved, pitted, and cut into large chunks
instructions: Place a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the smoked sausage, parsley, cabbage, coriander, and cheese. Mix gently, and form the mixture into 25 small patties. If you are making patties with ground beef or kielbasa, you may place all ingredients inside the first patties, and form into 12 - 15 small patties. Place onto a plate, and refrigerate for 30 minutes, flipping once. Remove meat and patties from the fridge 30 minutes before cooking, and let cool 10 minutes prior to glazing the patties. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Take one pattie at a time, and lightly flatten into a large crescent shape, using fingers, if necessary. Place onto a baking sheet. Top with another small dallion shaped round of bread or pattie, pressing lightly on the bread until it is covered with patties. If you have a pizza peel or a pizza cutter, you can also use a bread knife to cut the patties in smaller squares. Glaze the dough with a little tomato sauce and brush with melted butter, if desired. Bake 20 - 25 minutes, depending on the thickness of your patties.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,clam juice,colby,vegetable shortening,veal steak,purpose flour,sausage,tahini
title: Tahini Veal
ingredients: 4 veal steaks, boned or large pounded thin | 36 fluid ounces low sodium chicken broth | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 3 cups clam juice | 4 slices cooked pork sausage | 1 cup colby or 1 cup swiss cheese, grated
instructions: Place in shallow glass baking dish. Combine veal with chicken stock and seasonings. Cover with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator to marinate at least 1. To make sauce, whisk together tahini, flour, clam juice and sausage. Stir in cheese until melted.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,coriander powder,pepperoni,rom tomato,hoisin sauce,louisiana sauce,chive
title: Aioli
ingredients: 2 roma tomatoes, quartered | 1/4 cup chopped chives | 2 tablespoons sliced coriander powder | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 12 ounces sliced pepperoni, chopped | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons louisiana-style hot sauce | 1 teaspoon orange zest, finely grated
instructions: In a small bowl combine the tomatoes, chives, coriander powder, chives and pepperoni. Spoon 1 - 2 tablespoons of hoisin sauce into a small serving bowl. Using a pastry brush, brush the tops of the 4 roma tomatoes with the hoisin sauce. Place the pepperoni and tomatoes on a baking paper lined tray. Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top. Bake at 220 degrees celcius for 8 mins until the pepperoni is warm and topping is golden.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,marsala wine,apple pie filling,parsley,guacamole,lime juice zest,raisin,plain yogurt
title: Guinness Mince
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 1/2 lbs lean mincemeat | 1/8 cup plain yogurt, greek style ( see directions ) | 3 tablespoons raisins | 1/2 cup apple pie filling, plain ( see directions ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice, lemon, zest of | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon marsala wine | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Heat the oven to 375f degrees. Put the sugar in a heavy frying pan add the mince and cook over a moderate heat until beginning to brown. Add the yogurt, raisins, apple pie filling, lime juice and lemon zest, then stir. Bake for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, then pour off any excess fat. Serve with steaming water biscuits. To make dressing, mix the mustard, sugar and lemon zest in a jar, shake well until sugar dissolves. Add the wine and stir well. Dress all salad ingredients and add dressing.

title: Homemade Peppercorn Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 ounce natural yoghurt | 1 piece peppercorn
instructions: Pour the yoghurt into a shallow bowl. Rub the peppercorns into the peppercorns. Cover, and refrigerate at least 5 hours before serving. Serve with pitta bread.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,quinoa,coriander seed,ghee,italian bread,yellow squash,peppercorn,chicken breast
title: Tingon's Spicy Chicken and Pumpkin Pilaf(Shalgam Masala)
ingredients: 6 whole chicken breast | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 1/2 cup water | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup quinoa | 1 slice italian bread | 1/2 cup yellow squash, chunks cut lengthwise | 1 tablespoon ghee
instructions: Combine the chicken and spices in a non stick skillet. Pour in the water, reduce the heat to low, cover and cook for 45 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand for 10 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a bowl. When cool enough to handle, shred or shred. Reserve the cooking water for the sauce and set aside. Grind quinoa to a fine powder in a mortar and pestle or small food processor. Measure out 3 cups into a large bowl, pour in the reserved cooking water, 1/2 cup pineapple juice, and the remaining 1/2 cup pineapple juice. Stir thoroughly and reserve. Fry the bread in a pan over high heat until lightly crumbly. Place the quinoa in another bowl and spread it to the edges using a spatula. Divide the quinoa evenly among the two bowls, placing the sliced squash on top. Spoon chicken and sauce over quinoa. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,phyllo pastry,herbes de provence,provolone cheese,cheddar cheese soup,marsala,white bread,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Cheese Triangles
ingredients: 4 cups shredded old cheddar cheese soup | 4 cups shredded mozzarella cheese in cheese, divided | 4 cups shredded provolone cheese, divided | 1 can cheddar cheese soup | 8 tablespoons marsala, divided | 2 tablespoons herbes de provence | 8 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. For the soup, combine the all ingredients in a large bowl.

title: Lighter Decadent Raspberry Bombs
ingredients: 1/2 cup raspberry jam, softened | 1/4 cup brewed coffee | 1 tablespoon bourbon | 1/2 teaspoon red chile powder | 1 ounce chocolate chips ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl with a fork, combine raspberry jam, coffee, bourbon, and chile powder. Pour into a 1 quart glass, and top with chocolate chips if desired.

title: Microwave Marshmallow & Sun Dried Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato | 1 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: Combine sun dried tomatoes, sweet morsels, sun dried tomatoes in microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for about 2 minutes, stir, microwave about another minute to soften, stir again and microwave again. Serve warm or set aside.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,vanilla sugar,snow pea,fish sauce,garlic clove,white flour,tomato,oyster
title: Tomato and Black Bean Cakes (Kee-ee)
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes | 2 tablespoons oyster | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons triple sec | 3 garlic cloves, crushed | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 12 snow peas | sweet chili-garlic sauce or sweet chili paste
instructions: Drain the tomatoes in a strainer to remove excess tomato juice. Add water just until the tomatoes are tender. Place drained tomatoes in a bowl and mash with a fork. Add oyster, flour, triple sec, garlic, fish sauce, and vanilla sugar. Add the snow peas and serve on top of steamed white rice.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,turmeric powder,bell pepper strip,mace,rice noodle
title: Paella - Spicy and Flavourful Rice Noodle and Pepper Strips for Snack or Meal
ingredients: 20 -25 rice noodles ( i prefer maggi brand ) | 1/2 large bell pepper strip | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 small mace | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder
instructions: Place a pan on the stove on low heat and lightly spray with non stick spray. Add bell pepper strips and raisins, saute until softened. Add turmeric powder. Add saute for 1 minute, add rice noodles and mix. Add water as needed. Cover and cook on low heat for 10 minutes or until noodles are soft and liquid absorbed and water absorbed. This is an very fragrant rice noodle dish so if you feel creative just try this and if not, add your favorite sweet basil and chili powder, etc. Note this is also good with chinese fried meat or fish.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,cream tartar,tuna water,red chile pepper,red enchilada sauce,guajillo chilies,salmon fillet,celery seed
title: Spicy Salmon With Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 3 -6 ounces salmon fillets, skinless | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 can tuna in water, drained | 1 red chile pepper, halved and seeded | 1 red chile pepper, halved and seeded | 2 guajillo chilies, halved and seeded | 1 dash cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Place salmon fillets in a baking dish, skin side down. In small bowl, combine enchilada sauce, tuna, chile pepper and chile pepper. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 1 to 5 hours. Preheat broiler. Remove fish from dish. Broil salmon for 6 to 8 minutes, depending on thickness of fish. During last 5 minutes, spread a small amount of enchilada sauce in broiler safe dish. Place fish on top of sauce. Top each piece of fish with another slice of lemon, if desired. Spoon the remaining 2 ounces enchilada sauce over top of fish. Sprinkle with celery seed and crushed red pepper flakes.

title: Grilled Salmon Wraps With Fruit Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs salmon fillets, skin, boned and boned | 2 star anise, bruised | 2 tablespoons fruit, chopped ( optional ) | 8 flour tortillas, warmed | 4 slices salami, halved ( optional )
instructions: Place oven rack 1 from the heat and heat the broiler. Toast the salmon fillet, skin side down, on the rack until cooked. Leave 5 - 6 minutes before carving across the grain. Let rest 3 minutes and remove the salmon skin. Rinse under running water and drain. Pat dry and set aside. Finely grind star anise in a pestle and mortar or with a knife blade. Stir in the fruit if using. Divide fish and fruit mixture among tortillas and roll up. Place in an oiled 10 inch ovenproof skillet. Serve with salsa if desired.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,pimento pepper,cream mushroom soup,garam masala,buckwheat flour,tamari
title: Baked Tater Tot Gourd
ingredients: 1/2 cup buckwheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon tamari or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 jar pimento pepper, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine dry ingredients then add cream of mushroom soup and blend until mixture resembles a thick paste. Pour mixture into ungreased casserole dish. Bake until crusty, browned and bubbly, approximately 1hour.

title: Ham and Cucumber Scrolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked ham, finely chopped | 1 cup cooked spinach or 1 cup rocket, finely chopped | 1/2 cup diced cucumber | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 cup red capsicum, chopped finely | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup fresh basil or 1/2 cup green salad leaves
instructions: Drain the ham, then chop it finely. Mix all the ingredients together in a large mixing bowl. Shape the mixture into 12 rounds and brush 1 side with water. Flatten each round with the palm of a large knife. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside. Preheat the oven to 220°c or gas mark 10 to 220°c if using a fan forced oven. Using a sharp knife, cut a cross on the top of each patty. Place about 2cm apart on a tray. Bake for 15 minutes until lightly browned, but not browned. Set aside to rest for 5 minutes. Serve with extra salad leaves on the side. The Scrolls may also be stored in an airtight container for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: plantain,italian seasoning,horseradish,caster sugar,chicken,pasta sauce,dijon mustard,green plantain
title: Horseradish Chicken & Plantain Fries
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 6 tablespoons creamy horseradish | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 3 cups sliced green plantains ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 3 tablespoons light italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons instant minced horseradish | 4 lbs chicken ( i use chicken breasts or thighs ) | 6 cups pasta sauce | 3 -4 plantains
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a plastic bag. Add chicken.

title: Chocolate Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 6 -9 medium potatoes | 1 cup mixed candied chervil | 1 square unsweetened chocolate square | chocolate powder, for sprinkling or decorating
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut a small slit in the top of each potato several inches deep, with a sharp knife. Wash potatoes well. Cut each potato in half lengthwise. Insert one cherry into each half and insert the other into each potato, making two or three roasts in the potatoes depending on the size of the potato. Place potatoes in a cookie sheet and bake till tender, around 20 - 30 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Meanwhile, melt the butter together with chervil and chocolate. Sprinkle over the potatoes, and serve with a sprinkling of chocolate powder or sprinkles.

Random Ingredients: thai basil,curry powder,dark brown sugar,vegetable,topping,ham hock,brown sugar
title: Crazy Good Thai Curried Vegetables
ingredients: 20 frozen mixed fresh vegetables, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 10 ounces ham hocks | 2 teaspoons vegetable curry powder | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar, packed | 1 cup thai basil, chopped | 1 cup canned light cream or 1 cup whipped topping
instructions: Place thawed vegetables in slow cooker. Sprinkle brown sugar and 2 t curry powder over vegetables. Add ham hocks. Mix cream and remaining 2 t curry powder in bowl. Pour over veggies. Cover. Cook on low heat setting 7 to 9 hours or on high heat setting 4 to 5 hours or until vegetables are tender and cooked through. Stir in 1 cup dark brown sugar. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Can be served with coconut sauce or sweet rice. Tip, to freeze, freeze half the vegetables instead of sprinkling them with granulated sugar then place them in a freezer bag with the other half of the vegetables, plus the other half of the sugar for the topping. If frozen mixed veggies, thaw the vegetables in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: chocolate baking square,tomato,beef tenderloin steak,amber beer,black bean,edible flower,malt vinegar
title: Beef Tenderloin Steaks in Barolo
ingredients: 12 ounces amber beer | 14 ounces lean beef tenderloin steaks | 8 ounces sliced ripe tomatoes, in a single layer, about 3/4 of an inch in weight | 1/3 cup malt vinegar | 1 can black beans, drained | 2 ripe tomatoes, cut into a coarse dice | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh edible flower
instructions: Rinse out the pan. Reserve the fat from the beer and add the beer to the pan. Over medium heat, add the beef, stirring quickly to coat all of the meat. When almost cooked through, add the sliced tomatoes and vinegar. Stir and simmer just until the mixture thickens slightly, about 3 minutes. Add the black beans and stir just enough to coat with the juice, about 30 seconds, but do not let the liquid boil. Remove from heat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. The longer it marinates, the easier it will be to cut.. Slice the tenderloin into 3/4 inch thick slices on the diagonal. Put the slices on a platter and arrange tomato slices across the meat, spooning tomato mixture around them. Garnish with the fresh edible flowers. Serve.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,adobo sauce,curd cottage cheese,chili paste,white bread,lobster tail,pork butt
title: Prawn & Lobster Stuffed Baked Mojo
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs small cooked prawns or 1 1/2 lbs lobster tail | 1 1/2 lbs cooked lean pork butt ( about 3 ) | 2 ounces white bread | 1/2 lb small curd cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons minced adobo sauce | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( hot )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a small food processor, chop the prawns into large pieces. Set aside. Finely chop the pork and lobster meat, discarding shells and or heads. Cut the white bread into cubes and put a cube into a mixing bowl. Slice the white meat into chunks and put those into the bowl. Chop the curd into large pieces and put that into a bowl. Heat the oil in a frying pan, when hot, add the shrimp and pork and cook 5 - 7 minutes, stirring frequently, until just pink. Remove from heat and stir in the cheese, then add the adobo sauce and chili paste and season with salt and pepper to taste. Fill the prepared mojo shells with the prawns and cheese mixture. Bake for 15 minutes, or until bubbling and a bit browned around the edges.

title: Penne With Shanks and Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dry penne or 1 cup other long-grain pasta | 3 lamb shanks | 1 cup tomato paste | 1 1/2 cups low sodium chicken or 1 1/2 cups beef broth, mixed with | 1/2 cup water | 1 cup canned tomato puree ( san marzano tomato puree is best but if you want to use 1.5 bottle, add 1/2 cup of water ) | 1 tablespoon wine or 1 tablespoon beer | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained ( you can use black beans can also be used )
instructions: Combine 2 tablespoons of tomato concentrate with 1 cup of water.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,hot paprika,onion flake,cauliflower,bean sprout,serrano chilies
title: Mexican Baked Beans and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 2 cups small bean sprouts | 1/4 medium onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dried hot paprika | 1 teaspoon ground serrano chilies
instructions: Remove tough core from cauliflower and cut into florets. Separate the florets. Trim the top and bottom ends of the florets to about 3 inches in diameter. Cut the florets into florets at the florets core level. Line a casserole dish with a single layer of aluminum foil, and spray the foil with cooking spray. Place the large florets on the bottom third of the prepared casserole dish, or put a square of aluminum foil on the center and fold all around the florets. If your pan is large enough, you could bake it in a 375 degree f oven for about 30 minutes, until slightly crispy and golden. While the casserole dish is baking, mix the dried minced onion with the dried and hot onion flakes in a small mixing bowl, then add in the paprika and serrano chilies. Dip a small spoonful of the mixed spices into the cauliflower florets, coating all sides. Place the cauliflower, bean sprouts and 1/2 cup water in the prepared casserole dish. Cover with foil, and bake at 375 degrees f for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,sesame seed,corn tortilla chip,lime wedge,butter,feta cheese,fire tomato
title: Grilled Mini Corn Chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 6 corn tortilla chips | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fire-roasted tomatoes | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds | lime wedge
instructions: Heat an oven to 400 degrees. Butter a baking sheet with 1 tablespoon butter. Place the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet and place over medium heat. When the butter foams, add the mustard seeds. Cook and stir until the mustard seeds begin to pop, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and spread mustard in the hot pan. Place half the corn chips in the skillet. Scatter feta cheese evenly over the chips. Top with tomatoes and sesame seeds. Grill until the cheese melts, about 3–4 minutes, rotating the oven to allow even cooking. Repeat with remaining corn chips. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,onion soup mix,angel hair pasta,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Angel Hair Pasta With Oranges and Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 3 1/4 lbs angel hair pasta or 3 1/4 lbs ziti pasta | 1 medium onion soup mix | 2 cups flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. In a separate pan, melt butter, onions and carrots and saute until onions are just soft and carrots are slightly crisp and caramelized. Remove pan from heat. Drain pasta when just shy of al dente and add to pan with caramelized onion mixture. While pasta is cooking, combine remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour over pasta mixture. Adjust seasonings to taste and serve hot.

title: Wild Rice Peach Tomato and Vanilla Bean St. James Hotfry
ingredients: 4 tablespoons active dry yeast | 1 can ripe tomatoes with juice, drained | 1 can wild rice, drained | 10 ounces frozen unsweetened peaches, thawed and sliced | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl or measuring cup, dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup of the tomato juice. Set aside. Put the remaining tomato juice and wild rice, undrained, in the top of a double boiler over simmering water. Remove from heat. Stir in the yeast and allow to cool 5 minutes, or until mixture begins to bubble. Stir in the apples and vanilla sugar. Serve, or allow to cool and use within 2 days.

title: Spicy Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch chopped white & vegetarian oyster sauce | 5 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons ground cumin powder
instructions: Whisk the ingredients together in a small bowl. Serve & enjoy.

title: Shredded Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red beets, washed and coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup hot water, or as needed | 5 teaspoons harissa, divided | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | tortilla ( optional )
instructions: Place beets in a large saucepan with enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, about 30 minutes. Drain, and allow to cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, mix together 2 teaspoons harissa with the remaining harissa paste and sesame oil in a small bowl. Pour over the beets with their liquid, and toss to mix. Cover, and refrigerate while preparing the salad. Serve warm, or refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve, place the chilled beets into a serving bowl, and pour the hot water on them. Toss well, and serve with tortillas and additional harissa or sesame oil.

title: Avocado Toaststicks
ingredients: 6 1/2 ounces assorted prepared stuffing | 2 teaspoons clear honey | 2 teaspoons liquid honey | 2 medium hass avocadoes, halved lengthways
instructions: Heat the grill until very hot, add the stuffing and cook, stirring, for 1 minute toss the avocados through the stuffing, season with pepper and drizzle over the honey.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,yellow cornmeal,wheat bread,puff pastry,ziti pasta,lamb,red bell pepper
title: Pistachio and Lamb Strudel
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 8 ounces lean ground lamb | 1 red bell pepper, halved, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup shelled whole-milk pistachio nuts | 1/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon cold water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring it to a rolling boil over high heat. Once it starts to come to a boil, stir in the ziti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Lay out the puff pastry and place it on a baking sheet. Spread the nut filling over the pastry and top with the lamb, red pepper, and pistachio nuts to create a 5 inch stack. Brush with water and top with the remaining pastry sheet. Cut several slits lengthwise and press the dough together to seal. Bake until the top is golden brown and the filling is hot, 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,ketchup,white wine vinegar,cotija cheese,kosher salt,maraschino cherry
title: Cherry Vinaigrette
ingredients: 6 cups ketchup, at room temperature | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 3 cups maraschino cherries | 1/2 cup crumbled cotija cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the ketchup, salt, vinegar, and tarragon. Stir in the cherries.

title: Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1 1/2 to 2 inch cubes | 1 lb canadian bacon, coarsely chopped | 12 ounces sliced pimientos | 6 whole cloves | 1/2 cup drained capers | 1/2 cup coriander | 1/4 cup canadian flavored cream
instructions: In a large skillet over high heat brown the pork evenly. Put the pork aside in a 9x13 baking pan. Preheat the oven to 325f degrees. Mix the pimentos, cloves, capers, coriander and cream in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer. Pour the mixture over the pork.

Random Ingredients: pasta,brown sugar,red pepper flake,italian salad dressing,beef bouillon granule
title: Italian Beef Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions. Brown ground beef in dutch oven over medium heat. Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Roasted Sausage With Cilantro Limes
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 2 sprigs fresh cilantro leaves, washed and dried | 2 teaspoons dried whole cumin | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lime juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Remove casings from sausage and cut into 1 inch pieces. In a bowl, stir together cilantro and cumin. Add sausage and toss with cilantro mixture. Transfer to a medium sized shallow roasting pan. Insert toothpicks into top of sausages to secure. Toss sausage and casings with remaining lime juice. Roast 25 to 30 minutes, or until sausage is cooked to your liking, brushing occasionally with juices.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,chili paste,jiffy cornbread mix,cream cheese,margarine,swiss cheese,lime zest,balsamic vinegar
title: P. F. Chang's Cornbread Swirl
ingredients: 1 box jiffy cornbread mix | 1/2 cup boiling water | 1/8 cup balsamic vinegar | 12 ounces cream cheese, diced | 1/4 cup margarine, softened | 2 medium sweet peppers or 1 medium red bell pepper, chopped and seeded | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons fresh lime zest, grated
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Grease a 9x9 inch loaf pan or a deep 8 inch square cake pan. In a small bowl, combine cornbread mix and boiling water. Stir in vinegar. Spread cornbread batter in prepared pan or pan and bake 20 minutes or until tester comes out clean. In a separate pan, combine cream cheese, margarine, peppers, and lime zest.

title: Chinese Pork Sausages
ingredients: toothpicks | 1 pound country-style pork ribs
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Cover a baking sheet with foil. Lay the sausages on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, about 45 minutes. Remove the sausages from the oven, and carefully roll them in the excess foil. Allow the sausage to cool until easily handled, about 15 minutes. Cut the rolls in half, and roll each half inside a large paper sack. Wipe any excess juice from the outside of the sack with paper towels. Place the pork sausages on a wire rack to drain off any excess grease. Arrange the sausages on the prepared baking sheet, and season with salt. Bake in the preheated oven until the sausages are dark brown and crispy, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,thyme leaf,raisin,tomato paste,ginger garlic paste,leek,arborio rice,prawn
title: Prawn Risotto
ingredients: 400 g ground prawns | 1 stalk leek, finely sliced | 1 cup arborio rice with rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon raisins ( optional ) | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Cook prawns in boiling water for 3 minutes. Shell and devein and set aside. Place leek in a saucepan with a little water and season with salt. Bring to the boil and then let sit for about 8 - 10 minutes until tender. Drain well. Place rice in a large heated pan with a little water. Stir and bring to the boil. Remove from heat and cook covered stirring occasionally for 5 - 7 minutes or until water has been absorbed. Return all stock to the pan and bring to the boil. Add tomato paste, ginger and thyme and cover. Simmer for 10 minutes then remove lid. Add prawns, raisins and pepper and cook, stirring, for 10 more minutes or until prawns are pink. Stir occasionally. Serve immediately either over mash or steamed greens and pass a salad.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,thai basil,apricot jam,quinoa,sourdough bread,cannellini bean
title: Quinoa Crumble
ingredients: 250 g sourdough bread, cut into cubes | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 400 g quinoa, rinsed well and drained | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 teaspoon thai basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Line 2, 7x11cm loaf tins with baking paper. Mix together the bread and beans in a large bowl. Add the quinoa, vinegar, jam and basil and toss to combine, then divide the quinoa topping between the tart tins. Bake 15 - 20 minutes, until golden and crumbly. Serve warm, warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: pearl onion,serrano pepper,yellow food coloring,duck,purpose flour,peppercorn,red bean paste,salt
title: Puchero Moderno
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs duck | 2 tablespoons red bean paste | 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 3/4 teaspoon peppercorn | 2 drops yellow food coloring | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper, minced ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon jalapeno, minced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pearl onions or 1/2 cup onion, sliced with skin on
instructions: Rinse and dry duck, and tie legs neatly. Marinate for 4 days at room temperature, or overnight in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 325°f. Place duck in a shallow roasting pan and roast uncovered until very tender, 40 - 55 minutes. Let rest for 10 to 15 minutes, loosely tent with foil, and slice into serving sized pieces.

Random Ingredients: tamari,pine nut,pickling spice,red pepper flake,jalapeno pepper
title: Spicy Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 package dried pineapple nuts | 4 -6 jalapeno peppers, minced | 3 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons pickling spices
instructions: Soak the pine nuts in water at least 1/2 hour, or over night. Cook the pineapple nuts in a frying pan with the jalapeños for about 5 minutes, until they are crisp and browned. Add the remaining ingredients and simmer until hot. Remove from the heat and let the nuts cool to room temperature. Store in an airtight container.

title: Chinese Ginger Infused Red Wine
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup rice wine
instructions: In small saucepan, combine ginger garlic paste and 2 - ½ cups of water. Bring to boiling, stir. Boil for 1 minute or until sauce is reduced by half. Stir in wine.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,rosemary leaf,pickling spice,buckwheat flour,peanut butter,herb,french bread,chocolate frosting
title: Buckwheat French Bread ( Paula Deen )
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread or 1 loaf challah ( 8x8-2x2 ) | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/4 cup buckwheat flour | 1 teaspoon pickling spices | 1 teaspoon dried basil | rosemary leaf, to garnish ( optional ) | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate frosting
instructions: Slice the top off the loaf of french bread. Hollow out bread using a grape/knead or similar sized tool. This prevents the bread from curling during baking. Cut the loaf into 1 1/2 slices, creating pocket that will close when removing from the loaf. Cut the bread into 1 wide and 2 long diagonal slices. Mix the soup, peanut butter, sour cream and bulgur until well combined. Sprinkle pickling spices over bread and stir lightly. Spoon the soup mixture back into the loaf. Sprinkle the basil leaves over the top and top of the french toast with the chocolate frosting. Place in the refrigerator to chill overnight. Slice to serve.

title: Ranch Beef Burgers
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat | 1 teaspoon italian herb seasoning
instructions: Prepare an iron skillet or grill to medium high heat. Rub the seasoned hamburger mix liberally on both sides of the ground beef. Place the prepared hamburger on the preheated grill. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes on each side, or until golden brown. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 150 degrees f.

title: Bread Rolls (Lapsack)
ingredients: 6 slices crusty bread ( about 6 x 4-oz. each cut into thirds ) | 1/2 cup unsalted butter, room temperature
instructions: Place 4 bread slices on cutting board. Place butter into a small bowl. Spread 1 slice of bread with butter. Roll in bread, enclosing it. Slice or twist each slice into a log. Arrange on a plate. Repeat with remaining bread slices, butter, and log ends up. Arrange on a parchment lined baking sheet and allow to rest at room temperature for 10 minutes. Using a fork and a sharp knife, break apart and transfer to a baking platter or tray. Brush rolls with remaining butter. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes. With a sharp knife, cut roll into rounds. Serve at once, with butter, jam or ice cream.

title: Quick Homemade Taco Filling
ingredients: 3 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 cans stewed tomatoes with chilies, undrained | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Combine the cumin and tomato juice in a large bowl. Add the cubed meat the water tends to add more water if necessary. Let sit in refrigerator 1 hour to absorb the flavors. Enjoy,.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,italian breadcrumb,splenda brown sugar,poultry seasoning
title: Curry Flavored French Bread Cookies
ingredients: 1 lb italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup splenda brown sugar blend | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to mix all ingredients and press into miniature muffin tins. Bake for approximately 12 minutes.

title: Eggplant With Swiss Cheese and Taco Seasonings
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 1 package taco seasoning | 3/4 cup brewed espresso powder | 6 -8 slices swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Slice each eggplant lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Heat skillet over medium high heat. Remove eggplant slices and place on greased cookie sheet, 1 inch apart. Spray skillet with cooking spray. Spray skillet with cooking spray and add taco seasoning. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes. Place slices of eggplant on tortilla with 3 tablespoons of cheese on each. Fold tortilla over and place on baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

title: Easy Finnish Pear Beer
ingredients: 1 gallon beef broth or 1 gallon vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | baking soda, to taste
instructions: Bring broth to boil and add baking soda.

Random Ingredients: arugula leaf,strawberry,onion soup mix,taco sauce,turnip,cardamom pod,eggplant
title: Quick and Easy Pavlova
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, chopped | 1 medium onion, diced | 1 small turnip, peeled and diced | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/3 cup taco sauce | 1 package frozen strawberries, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Place the eggplant, onion, and turnip into a large bowl. In a small bowl, whisk together the dry onion soup mix, taco sauce and yogurt. Pour over the vegetables and stir until well coated. Chill the mixture for 2 hours. Place the frozen strawberries into a food processor.

title: Chinese Vegetable and Ricotta Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 300 g fresh chinese vegetables, cut into sticks ( see note ) | 300 g ricotta cheese | 300 ml double cream | 100 g dry pasta
instructions: Put the mushrooms and vegetables into a saucepan with just enough water to cover them and bring to the boil. Meanwhile, boil the pasta until it is barely cooked and drain. When the pasta is cooked but still warm, stir in the ricotta cheese, stir until well combined and serve topped with the cream.

title: Nigella's African Leek & Olive Oil Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb nigella seeds or 1/2 lb black olives, soaked in plenty of water for at least 30 mins | 1 lb leek, cleaned and trimmed | 1/3 lb caster sugar | 3/4 cup olive, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon peanut oil | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a food processor and puree until just smooth. Heat a cast iron skillet or crepe pan over low medium heat. Add the olive oil and the cayenne and coat the pan. When the oil bubbles, swirl in the nut oil and allow to brown. Add the leeks and stir them around until the leeks are beginning to soften. When they have absorbed most of the oil, stir in the nut oil. When the mixture looks almost dry, stir in the baking soda. Cook about 5 mins, then turn off the heat. Let the dip cool slightly then stir in a little milk until it is smooth and creamy. This is better eaten immediately. The olive oil helps bind the flavours together. It will keep in the fridge for a week. To serve, you'll need to scrape the nuts, garlic, ginger and seasoning mix back into the pan and heat through, stirring constantly, until the mixture is creamy and smooth. It's wonderful on crusty bread, or fresh vegetables, etc. The nigella is a deliciously layered dip, you can use it on toast, etc.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,chick pea,vanilla,fig,arugula,anise seed,bay leaf,beef mince
title: Huey's Spiced Pork
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 500 g pork tenderloin | 1 can chick-peas, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 2 1/2 teaspoons anise seeds | 2 bay leaves | 200 g arugula, chopped
instructions: Place beef mince in a large frying pan and fry on both sides until well browned. Remove from pan and drain most of the fat. Cut mince into 2cm pieces and return to pan. Turn the heat up to medium or high and add chickpeas, pork, vanilla, anise and bay leaves. Cook and stir for 5 minutes or until aromatic. Add the chopped arugula and warm through. Serve with crusty bread and salad.

title: Japanese Zucchini Ribbons
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken | 1 small cabbage, cored | 1 medium onion soup mix | 2 zucchini, sliced | 1 tablespoon lemon peel | 1 tablespoon dried sage leaves | powdered onion soup mix
instructions: Place chicken, cabbage, onion soup mix, zucchini, lemon peel, sage and soup mix into two 13x9 baking dishes. Cover and marinate in refrigerator overnight. Preheat broiler or grill. Drain chicken, cabbage, zucchini and vegetables.

title: Crab Toast With Spicy Shrimp Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup canned baby clams | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 3 slices bread, toasted
instructions: Crush the clams and combine with the hoisin sauce and cornstarch in a small dish. Spread on toasted bread slices.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,green,buttermilk biscuit,papaya,chicken thigh fillet,sherry wine vinegar
title: Chicken Papaya Salad
ingredients: 1 lb papayas, peeled and seeded | 6 chicken thigh fillets, skin removed | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar ( i used red wine vinegar ) | 300 ml buttermilk biscuits ( approximately 8 biscuits ) | 150 ml mixed greens
instructions: Cut papaya in half lengthwise, scoop out the seeds and discard. Cut 1cm/1cm dice. Remove papaya flesh from skin and cut into 2 cm/1cm dice. Place papaya, chicken and papaya in a bowl. Add sherry vinegar and toss to coat. Coat grill rack with cooking oil, line it with foil and heat it on high. Cook the chicken on one side for 4 minutes until just cooked through or place on a plate and keep warm. Brush with a little oil. Place biscuits on a baking tray and cook for 10 minutes, depending on the type of biscuit. Flip them over and cook for a further 3 - 5 minutes or until golden, then cool on a wire rack. Place a small spoonful of the papaya salad, along with a sprinkling of mixed greens on each biscuit, in a bowl. Add a tablespoon of the sherry vinegar and gently toss to combine. Transfer to a serving platter. Repeat with another spoonful of sherry vinegar, sherry vinegar and sherry vinegar and toss.

title: Chili Seeds
ingredients: 1 can or bottle black sesame seeds | 4 -6 tablespoons chopped green chilies
instructions: Open sesame seeds in a cheese cloth and place several layers of damp kitchen towels onto ground sesame seed stack. Turn the stack over. Tear off a strip of about 2 inches wide and stick it into a tiny bun or deep, flat object no more than 1 1/2 inches wide and 2 inches long. Sprinkle chili flakes or whole black sesame seeds onto sesame pods, then roll up and tie with kitchen twine. Store in a cool dry place for up to one year.

title: Curry Borscht
ingredients: 3 quarts red cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup chicken base | 1 tablespoon curry | 3 tablespoons dry white wine
instructions: Place the red cabbage in a large kettle with water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a small bowl, mix the chicken base, curry and wine. Bring chicken mixture to a boil and stir until the liquid is reduced by half. Serve the curry hot.

title: Cranberry Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped cranberries | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Place cranberries in a heat resistant bowl. Top with sesame oil. Let sit overnight with plastic wrap on top.

Random Ingredients: lime,salt black pepper,tomato sauce,extra virgin olive oil,beef stew meat,russet potato
title: Portuguese Stewed Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled & cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup tomato sauce | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Season the beef generously to taste. In a dutch oven, brown the meat in hot olive oil. Season lightly to your taste. Pour off and reserve the drippings. Return the reserved drippings to the pan and add the potatoes and tomato sauce. Cover & simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender about 1 1/2 hours. Turn off the heat & stir in the olive oil. Dice the limes into wedges and sprinkle over the stew. Cover & cook for 10 minutes, before serving.

Random Ingredients: havarti cheese,dark red kidney bean,lasagna noodle,pimento olive,dark corn syrup,lemon juice
title: Carcassie's Favorite Lasagna
ingredients: 1 jar pimento stuffed olives | 3 cans dark corn syrup ( regular corn syrup also works ) | 6 sheets lasagna noodles | 2 1/2 cups havarti cheese, shredded | 12 pimento stuffed olives | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Mix the corn syrup, 1/2 cup of the oil, and the drained and black beans in a sauce pan, warm gently but not boil. Place the whole jar of olives in a 9x13 baking dish and spread them in an even layer. Top with one third of the cheese and two tablespoons of the olives. Repeat with two pimento, one third of the two olives, and the remaining two olives, then top with the second layer of cheese. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and top with lemon juice. Remove from the oven and let stand for a few minutes to allow excess moisture to run out. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Low Fat "yummy" Pierogies for Pierogies - Low Calorie for Diabetics!
ingredients: 150 g fat cottage cheese ( or other type of cheese ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon ( optional )
instructions: Add the chicken bouillon to the cottage cheese and mix till there are no lumps. Add the chicken bouillon and the instant chicken bouillon, if using. Mix it. Use the back of a spoon for a damp hand. Take a ball and take a small amount and roll it into a ball. Do not take the ball of dough out of the hand. Use the back of a spoon to remove excess air on the ball and make more flattened. Make more flattened little balls and then roll them in either a cheese cloth or some coloured plastic. This will help keep the balls from sticking together while in the refrigerator. When you are ready to cook the pierogies, put a pan on top and warm it. If using a non stick pan, you can make this dough for 1/2 cups of dry noodles or eat one to get the right taste. When this is done, put all the pierogies in a plate and pour the sauce/spice mixture over them. Serve with plain boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,cold water,hot paprika,clam,olive oil,red chili pepper
title: Kirsty's Oatmeal (With Clams)
ingredients: 2 cups cold water | 3/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup olive oil, divided | 6 whole red chili peppers, halved | 1 tablespoon hot paprika | 1 1/2 lbs clams
instructions: Wash and dry the clams, if desired. Place in a large pot with 4 cups cold water. Slowly cook, partially covered and using a slotted spoon, until the clams begin to open, approx 5 to 10 minutes.. Drain the water from the clams through a sieve into a small bowl. Combine oatmeal, 1/2 cup oil, and chile peppers in the bowl. Add the clams, one at a time, tossing constantly with a spoon until each clams are well coated with the mixture. Add salt and paprika, if desired. Cook, covered, for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,cream mushroom soup,red curry paste,island dressing
title: Curried Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 cremini mushrooms | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 tablespoons red curry paste | shredded rea light island dressing
instructions: Punch holes in mushrooms with fork, removing beak easily. Sprinkle with remaing dressing. Bake 350f for 30 minutes.

title: Chile Ziti
ingredients: 2 lbs ziti pasta | 1 cup rice wine ( dry ) | 1 -2 hot red chili pepper
instructions: Heat a large pot of water to boiling. In large bowl, add ziti and enough water to barely cover ziti. After about a half hour, add rice wine to pot. Cook until ziti is just cooked, according to package directions. Drain, reserving pasta water. Stir fry a large pinch of chili in water until fragrant. Add cooked ziti into chili and mix thoroughly. Remove from heat and serve with a generous amount of chopped fresh cilantro or parsley. Great cold too.

title: White Gravy for Pasta
ingredients: 375 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 175 g white flour ( approximately )
instructions: Sift flour into mixing bowl, and then mix in the ricotta cheese and mix well. Make a well in the centre, add the milk all at once and mix with a fork to form a smooth paste. Turn the heat on. While it is warming up, pour the mixture down the funnel in the gravy boat. Once it forms bubbles and forms a solid mass, turn it onto a warm plate so it can drain off excess fat. Serve drizzled with extra virgin olive oil and with freshly chopped black cherries.

title: Crock Pot Kielbasa and Rice Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1 package kielbasa sausage, sliced into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can condensed chicken and rice soup | 8 ounces corn tortillas, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1 package penne, cooked
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add kielbasa and brown, breaking it up. Drain well. Pour soup over kielbasa and rice soup in crock. Mix well. Cover and cook on low 6 - 8 hours, stirring every three hours. Warm tortillas in microwave for 20 - 30 seconds to soften. Remove to plate and spoon soup into bowl, coating tortillas evenly.

Random Ingredients: caesar salad dressing,taco seasoning,vegetarian bean,baby spinach,canola oil,raspberry,artificial sweetener
title: Lavash® Harvest Vegan Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed artfully baked vegetarian refried beans | 1 package frozen raspberries | 1 package caesar salad dressing | 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 packets artificial sweetener, or to taste | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 package baby spinach
instructions: Place the frozen mixed artfully baked vegetarian refried beans in the bottom of a 9x13 inch pan.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,apricot jam pineapple,parsley leaf,turnip,ajwain,splenda sugar substitute,flavor fruit jam,rice
title: Gluten Free Rice and Vegetable Bake
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal, plus extra for dusting | 1 cup rice, plus extra for dusting | 1 cup ajwain, spice blend ( see note ) | 6 -8 cups mixed flavoring fruit preserves ( i use pineapple or mango jams ) | 2 cups turnips ( or red onion, grated ) | 1/2 cup apricot jam ( or mango flavored jam ) or 1/2 cup pineapple jelly ( or mango flavored jam ) | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1 tablespoon dried parsley leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f using a 2 cup capacity ceramic oven dish, line the bottom of the dish with cornmeal. Place the rice, fruit, and 2 cups water in another large dish, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat with a wooden spoon to medium low and simmer, covered, for about 30 minutes. Using a slotted spoon remove the rice and fruit, cool, and then transfer the fruit mix to a food processor or blender. Process the soup to the consistency of a thick porridge. Return the soup to the bowl. Stir in the remaining 3 cups water and the jawawain, spices, and jam. Cover and place the soup mixture in the refrigerator. Stir the soup before bringing it to room temperature. Cover and bring to room temperature. Bake for 5 minutes, take off the oven and allow the dish to cool for 10 minutes, then remove parchment from the oven. Spread the soup and fruit mixture evenly over the cooled cake. Cover and bake for 50 minutes, then uncover and bake 20 minutes, until the top is golden and creamy.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,white pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,rye bread,gingerroot,fish sauce,kielbasa sausage
title: Ginger-Sausage and Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 2 slices bread, crusts removed ( use your favourite bread ) | 1 kielbasa sausage or 1 other hot german sausage | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 4 tablespoons salad oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh gingerroot | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Arrange bread slices on grill rack coated with cooking spray. Cook, turning, until lightly toasted, about 5 minutes on each side. Cut into 1 inch cubes or 1 inch chunks. Cut sausage into 1 inch cubes. When ready to serve, spray a large salad bowl with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange kielbasa cubes on salad bowl. Sprinkle with fish sauce, oil, ginger and white pepper. Toss lightly with kielbasa. Serve warm.

title: Guacamole Watercress
ingredients: 1 bunch watercress | 1 red pepper, roasted and peeled | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | ground white pepper | parmesan cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Wash and dry the blackened watercress over a bowl. Cut off stems and cut into 4 or 5 pieces. Heat a grill, grill pan or comal until very hot. Remove any bits of green surrounding watercress, and throw away the stem. Chop the rest of the watercress. Put the pepper and parmesan in a jar with a tight lid and shake to mix. Sprinkle with pepper and salt, to taste. Stir with the cheese. Place the mixture on a platter and garnish with the pepper bits and watercress.

title: Tater Tot Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 2 medium onions, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons shallots, minced or 2 tablespoons minced fresh onions | additional onion powder, to desired consistency
instructions: Using a spoon or large measuring spoon, measure approximately ¼ cup of onion power into a medium bowl. Add minced onion to bowl and coat the onion with onion powder. Mix until the onion is evenly coated with onion power. Use a food processor for a fine texture and pulse onion power until onion and spice mixture are finely chopped or finely shredded. Store in refrigerator for 1 - 2 months.

title: Pomodori Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 1 fryer chicken, cut into 8 pieces | 1/2 cabbage, sliced into thin wedges | 3 medium plum tomatoes, cut into 8 pieces | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place chicken pieces in a sauce pan. Add cabbage, plum tomatoes and sweet chili sauce. Combine baking powder and salt together. Sprinkle over chicken mixture. Cover and simmer 30 minutes, or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken from saucepan. Place on serving plate and serve with warm rolls.

title: Grilled Chile Peppers
ingredients: 4 medium green chilies ( hot or mild ) | 12 mild yellow peppers | 2 tablespoons cream | 3 tablespoons sour cream ( optional ) | 1/2 cup toasted pecans or 1/2 cup walnuts
instructions: Lightly oil grill and grill peppers about 20 mins, turning until charred all over. Place in a plastic bag cool, then remove the membrane and seeds then slit the peppers lengthways. Remove the stem ends if desired. Place the sour cream and nuts in a small bowl and stir in the chilis. Spoon mixture onto peppers and grill until heated through.

title: Vegetarian Melt in Your Mouth Open-faced Submarine
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 cup chopped spring onion ( spring onion finely chopped finely ) | 3 teaspoons hoagie rolls, split with a small amount grated, divided | 1/2 red cabbage, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped almonds meal | 1/8 teaspoon msg ( i like lots of it's flavour because i have always had my mum's recipe'wrong ) | 1 teaspoon salad oil | 2 tablespoons toasted slivered almonds ( crushed ) or 2 tablespoons toasted almond meal ( crushed ) | 2 -4 crackers, split open or 2 -4 slices toasted plain non-toasted bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Melt the margarine in a skillet or a nonstick skillet and add the spring onion. Saute for 1 minute and then add the remaining 1 teaspoon of the grated cheese. Cook 2 minutes. Add the chopped cabbage and cook until the cabbage is softened a little then add the almond meal, msg and oil and cook until well blended. Turn off heat. Spread half the sandwich with half the cheese sauce mix and sprinkle with ground almonds or crushed almonds. Top with remaining cheese sauce mix and place on a sheet pan. Slice the sandwich in half and pop back in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until hot. Remove the rolls and serve with the remaining cheese sauce mix or topping. If desired, top with a few crushed almond flakes or sliced almonds. Note, for some, i added some fresh parsley if i'm not terribly into spice foods. If you don't care for that, you can also add more of the crushed almonds if you like.

title: Stir Fried Tempeh and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 package tempeh, broken into 3 equal pieces | 2 cups snow peas, strings removed | 1 green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt ( to taste ) | 1/2 tortillas or 1/2 - 1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-2 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/4-1 1/2-1 1/4-1 1/1-4 1/4-1 1/2-1 1/4-1 1/4-2 1/4-1 sichuan peanut or ground nuts | 2 tablespoons canned whole green chili peppers, finely chopped ( to taste )
instructions: Pulse tempeh in hot grinder or food processor about 15 times, or until well ground. Transfer to bowl. Scatter snow peas, green chile and kosher salt over tempeh. Mix well, using fingers or fork. Divide among 2 plates. Divide snow peas between 2 plates. Top with tempeh and chile. Dollop with chile rice sauce. Serve with sesame seeds or rice crackers. Sichuan chiles may be found in asian stores, or you can make a few at a time. Makes about two servings.

title: Quinoa and Chestnuts With Bacon Flavored Quinoa
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw quinoa | 1 teaspoon bacon drippings | 1/2 cup chestnuts | 1/2 cup dried cranberries or 1/2 cup craisins ( fresh would be best )
instructions: Rinse quinoa well in a fine sieve and drain. Place in a nonstick nonstick skillet with enough bacon fat to just slightly coat the pan. When the fat is heated, add the quinoa and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until the quinoa has absorbed all the water and is tender but still firm, about 25 to 30 minutes. Stir in the chestnuts and cranberries or craisons. Serve immediately, or allow to cool and serve at room temperature.

title: Rajma's "Truffle"
ingredients: 2 tablespoons onion paste, to taste | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 pint light vegetable stock | 3/4 cup salsa | 1 package rapini | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Place onion paste in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until golden brown. Saute cauliflower for 1 to 2 minutes in soup pot of vegetable stock. Add to skillet. Stir in salsa. Simmer for 2 minutes. Place rapini and cream of tartar in a small piece of cheesecloth and press the ends with the back of a spoon to extract liquid. Cut the cheesecloth into pieces that are 5 inches long, about 3 inches wide. Pour vegetable and salsa mixture over rapini. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cauliflower is tender.

Random Ingredients: feta,mustard powder,french bread,snow pea,olive oil,shrimp,black peppercorn,dill
