title: Hawks over Bleu St. John's Gateaux
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen peeled shrimp, thawed | 1/3 cup fresh dill, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh dill, chopped | 8 ounces frozen long-grain french bread | 3/4 teaspoon olive oil | 1/4 cup feta, crumbled | 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns, slightly crushed | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/3 cup fresh snow pea, trimmed
instructions: Preheat broiler. In food processor, combine shrimp with dill, bread, olive oil, feta, peppercorns and mustard powder. Process until well mixed. Place on greased or floured baking sheet. Broil 4 - 5 inches from heat for 2 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,red kidney bean,poblano chile,vanilla pudding mix
title: Mexican-Style Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1/2 poblano chile - stemmed, seeded, and chopped | 2 cups grape tomatoes, halved | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine kidney beans and poblano chile. Stir in tomatoes and pudding mix. Spoon into a 9x9 inch baking dish. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour. Remove foil, stir, and bake for 30 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,italian herb,sucanat,sunflower oil,herb,cube steak,tomato paste,cashew
title: Noodles and Cashew Nests (Garlic-Steamed Beef Risotto)
ingredients: 450 g rice noodles | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 ounce cashews | 1 ounce chinese herb | 1 teaspoon mixed italian herbs | 2 2/3 ounces tomato paste ( eg heinz ) | 2 cube steamed steak | chopped fresh herb, for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil, and add the rice noodles. Put 1 tbsp of sunflower oil in a frying pan, then cook the cashews for 2 - 3 minutes or until lightly browned and softened. Add the herbs and stir. Keep warm. Drain any excess water, then add the tomato paste to the hot water and stir, breaking the tomato up with a fork. Add the noodles to the boiling water and cook for 5 - 7 minutes or until al dente. Transfer to a bowl and set aside. Cut the steamed beef into thin strips. Place half the noodles into a large, non stick steamed basket and set aside to cool slightly. Using a small knife, roughly chop the basil and scatter over the noodles. Remove and discard the meat from the cashew cashewnuts. Drain the noodles, reserving the water and noodles in the pan, and rinse well. Place a large wok over a high heat, add the remaining 1 tbsp oil, then add the cashew nuts. Stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes. Add the steak strips, nuts and basil to the wok and stir fry for 4 - 5 minutes or until the steak and nuts are cooked. Stir in the paste from the pasta. Pour in 2 - 3 tbsp of reserved water from the pan to deglaze. Divide the noodles between 2 bowls, and arrange the meat, noodles and vegetables evenly among the bowls. Serve immediately. Garnish with chopped fresh herbs.

title: Guacamole Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1/2 cup guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix peanut butter and guacamole together in a bowl.

title: Easy Beef and Onions
ingredients: 800 g beef sirloin steaks, cut into 1 x 1/4 strips | 4 medium vidalia onions | 2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Coat beef strips with cornflour and marinate in the refrigerator overnight. Grill or broil until beef is cooked to desired doneness. Allow to cool.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,silken tofu,lime juice,pasta noodle,cashew,mustard powder,grain rice,tarragon
title: Cashew & Lime Rice Prawns
ingredients: 180 g pasta noodles | 1/2 cup silken tofu, drained | 1/3 cup cashews, chopped | 4 tablespoons lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon ground tarragon | 2 teaspoons coarse grain rice | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Boil pasta according to packet instructions and drain. Meanwhile microwave tofu for 1 minute or until heated. Add cashews, lime juice, mustard and tarragon until well combined. Mix cornflour with cold water to form a paste, stir into tofu until blended. Drain pasta and reserve. Add tofu mix to cooked pasta and stir until heated through.

title: Spiced Turnips (Chana Ghaab)
ingredients: 4 turnips | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Wash the turnips well. Cut off the stem and make into 1 inch pieces. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder, cover and allow to stand for about 1 - ½ hours in a covered pot. Bring to boil once every 2 hours. Remove from heat and drain well. Keep aside to cool and serve.

title: Cheesy Italian Dip
ingredients: 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat stewed tomatoes with pimentos in a saucepan in the preheated oven until hot, and simmering for 5 minutes, or until liquid reduces slightly. Remove from heat, stir in mozzarella cheese, pepper, and heat for another 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,tahini,sugar snap pea,pork shoulder,italian seasoning
title: Jasmine Rice With Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 1 3/4 - 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 1 can jasmine rice | 1 package frozen cut sugar snap peas | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/3 cup light tahini | 2 tablespoons fresh sweet basil, chopped
instructions: Cook rice per package directions. Meanwhile, trim all visible fat from pork. Place pork and peas in a large, deep skillet. Sprinkle with italian seasoning. Cook over medium high heat until browned and crisp, stirring often, about 6 to 8 minutes. Stir in rice and tahini. Cover and let stand until liquid is absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes. Spoon rice into bowls or large resealable plastic baguette containers coated with cooking spray. Garnish with basil.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,white wine,arborio rice,serrano chili,salad oil,double cream,caster sugar
title: Sweet Corn Risotto
ingredients: 150 ml double cream | 100 g baby arborio rice | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 small whole serrano chili, seeded and finely chopped ( optional ) | 60 ml dry white wine | 1 can kernel corn, drained
instructions: Heat the cream over medium heat in a large deep glass or non metal pan, then add the rice. Season with salt and pepper and stir in the oil. Cook, stirring until the water has been absorbed, about 10 minutes. Add the sugar and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Stir in the chili and the corn, then stir until heated through. Divide the risotto between 4 warmed bowls and serve immediately. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,peel,pepperoni,red kidney bean,coffee liqueur,rump roast,jumbo shrimp,vinegar
title: Hot Pepperoni - Grilled Shrimp Prawns
ingredients: 14 -24 prawns, raw | 1 jar pickled peppersoni, roughly chopped | 10 -12 large shelled jumbo shrimp | 2 tablespoons coffee liqueur | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1/2 cup freshly chopped parsley sprig | 1 can red kidney beans | coffee-flavored liqueur ( optional ) or strong coffee beans flavoring ( optional )
instructions: Slice the prawns and set aside. Pick the prawns from the shell and set aside. Place all ingredients into a large saucepan except for the beans and liquor and cook over high heat for 1 hour. Add the prawns, cover and cook until the shrimp are cooked by the time you finish finishing the main dish. Serve immediately, accompanied by freshly cooked coffee beans or strong coffee flavoring.

title: Thai Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/4 head napa cabbage, thinly sliced
instructions: In a 10x15 inch baking dish, melt margarine with curry paste. Stir in cabbage. Pour dressing over cabbage mixture. Refrigerate, covered, until very thinly chilled, 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,iceberg lettuce,cardamom pod,white bread,celery rib,hot water,pearl barley
title: Lettuce and Barley Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp | 2 sprigs celery ribs | 3 cardamom pods | 4 cups hot water | 1 iceberg lettuce, separated into leaves and stalks | crusty white bread or rye bread, toasted in a dry sautee pan
instructions: Place the barley into a large pan with water and bring to a boil over medium heat. Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat, transfer the barley to a bowl. Discard the celery, cardamom, and barley. Pour about 1 cup hot water into the blender and liquify until smooth. To serve, spoon the pureed barley into bowls and top with some chopped lettuce leaves and some slices of rye or toasted bread.

title: Sage and Pinto Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 2 sage leaves | 1/2 cup shaved butter | 4 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional ) | crushed ice, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Place pinto beans, sage and shaved butter in food processor. Process until smooth. Add grand marnier and process just until combined. Serve with crushed ice.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,salsa,russian salad dressing,white cabbage,biscuit,fennel seed,garlic powder
title: Cheese and Crispy Asiago Chips With Russian Dressing
ingredients: 1 packet refrigerated biscuits | italian dressing | 4 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 head white cabbage, shredded | 1 jar salsa ( recommended classico ) | 1/4 cup asiago cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to lightly spray 2 cookie sheets with non stick cooking spray. Separate biscuits into 2 biscuits. Place biscuits on cookie sheets and spray tops slightly with non stick cooking spray, then bake for approximately 8 to 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from oven and let cool for about 10 minutes. Place desired amount of asiago chips on a slice or two of cabbage. Place the biscuit on the cheese and roll up.

title: Chinese Sesame Oil (Neeh Asada)
ingredients: 1/2 lb shortening | 2 cups hot oil
instructions: Cut shortening into 1/2 inch pieces using a pastry blender, laddle down a strainer or colander until it resembles cornmeal add hot oil, stirring until all lumps dissolve. Dip your fingers in the oil then quickly stir in until completely dissolved and then remove to a piping bag. Variation, add 2 tablespoons confectioners sugar to the shortening and drop into hot oil, a little at a time, stirring until melted.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,syrup,green chili powder,wooden toothpick,jalapeno pepper,ginger root
title: Indian Jalapeno Bread
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked minute rice wine | 1 can chopped green chili powder | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger root | 16 wooden toothpicks, crushed | 1 jalapeno pepper, minced | 1/4 cup bottled syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the rice wine, green chile powder, ginger, and crushed toothpicks. Roll dough into 2 inch balls. Place balls on an unprepared cookie sheet, and lightly press dough into miniature muffin cups, or equivalent. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned. Allow to cool slightly before removing from the muffin tin. For jalapenos, remove stem, seeds, and membrane from jalapenos. Stit the peppers in boiling water for a few seconds to blanch them, then remove and plunge into ice water to stop the cooking process. Drain. Place the chilis and jalapenos in a bowl. Add the syrup, and stir until well combined. Drizzle onto warm bread, and serve.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,canadian bacon,pesto sauce,rice noodle,pork loin,nutritional yeast,brown sugar
title: Pesto Stuffed Pork Loin With Noodle Medley
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin | 4 tablespoons pesto sauce, divided | 4 teaspoons brown sugar | salt and pepper | 2 ounces canadian bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 10 ounces rice noodles, cooked
instructions: Thinly slice loin crosswise across the grain into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place 1 teaspoon of pesto sauce, brown sugar, salt, and pepper on the cutting board with the pork slices. Starting with one side, push pesto mixture to the other, making a well in the center. Reserve 1 tablespoon per slice, for sandwich filling. Sprinkle each slice lightly with salt and pepper. Place 1 slice of cheese, bacon, and the top slice of mozzarella cheese into each well. Fold in the middle sides. Place one or two sandwiches on parchment paper lined, 12 inch square sheets, and cover with another piece of parchment. Heat 3 tablespoons of the remaining pesto over moderate flame of a gas burner or medium flame. Grasp each sandwich lightly and grill, turning once, until a nice golden colour, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Transfer sandwiches to a platter and put in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Rosemary Beef Roll-Up
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs beef roast | 1/4 cup cornmeal | 4 tablespoons chopped mint | 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro leaf | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped rosemary | 1/3 cup rice wine | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | topping ( optional )
instructions:
Coat meat generously with cornmeal, then sprinkle generously with mint, cilantro and rosemary. Dry tomato and cherry halves in a clean towel and add to meat. Roll up and secure openings with toothpicks. Brown meat in a 325° oven 30 minutes per pound. If necessary, remove toothpicks to check 
    - tomato juice could be stirred up and returned to skillet to warm the meat. Add the rice wine to drippings and boil 5 minutes, stirring to dislodge browned tomatoes. Stir in cherry tomato halves and serve over bread.

title: Almond-Amaretto Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup amaretto | 1/2 cup chili
instructions: Combine all ingredients and heat over low heat. This sauce takes only a 30 sec per 1/2 cup of amaretto.

title: Brioche
ingredients: 1 package pie crusts | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 1 cup cornflour | 2 cups cornflower
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place pastry on a floured surface and roll between two sheets of baking paper until 1cm thick and 12 cm long. Repeat until all pastry has been used. Cook rice according to recipe of packet. Dissolve cornflower in 1/4 cup hot water. Add remaining ingredients, except pastry and pastry, to rice. Bring to the boil over medium high heat, then cover and transfer to the oven to bake for 25 - 30 minutes. Remove from oven and place pastry on a large oven tray and bake for a further 8 minutes. Remove pastry from tray, and transfer to a clean tea towel. Allow to cool. Cut out 2cm circles or squares, place rice on tray, and drizzle with the prepared filling. Set aside to cool further. When it has cooled, cut a small hole in the centre of each pastry using a sharp knife. Brush the edges with beaten egg and sprinkle with a little plain flour to stop them from burning. Place 2cm of filling in the centre of each pastry round and press the edges slightly together. Cut a slit in the top of each pastry and brush with more beaten egg. Bake for 15 minutes or until pastry is golden, and filling is bubbling.

title: Swiss Fried Celery
ingredients: 4 large celery ribs, trimmed
instructions: Slice celery stalks into 3 or 4 slices. Wash thoroughly and place on a baking sheet with sides. Sprinkle with dry mustard oil.. Broil in a preheated 350 degrees f oven until just cooked, about 4 minutes per side.

title: Tamari Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup tamari | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Combine tamari, oil, and water in a blender or food processor. Cover and blend until thick.

Random Ingredients: black olive,tomato green chilies,cocoa powder,cinnamon sugar,leek
title: Chocloate
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded green swiss leek | 1/2 cup finely diced tomato with green chilies | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons dried aniseed, divided | 1 tablespoon cinnamon sugar
instructions: Place in a medium bowl and let chill for 20 minutes. Garnish with grated cheese and cinnamon before serving.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,vodka,sambal oelek,mini chocolate chip,red currant jelly
title: Vodka Mayo
ingredients: 1/4 cup vodka, sweet-water | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | sambal oelek ( a good one ) | 1/2 teaspoon red currant jelly ( optional ) | mini chocolate chip ( optional )
instructions: Using either a shot glass as a base, carefully add vodka to a small cup or small bowl with ice cubes. Microwave the vodka on high just until it begins to warm up, then pour into the pan. Add mayonnaise, red currant jelly, and sambal to the vodka. The vodka will infuse the vodka with flavor into your tongue. Once the vodka gets heated up again, add more, taste, and add more sambal if needed. If desired, garnish with mini chocolate chips, and serve.

title: Alton Brown's Fattigmans Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch slices | 1 cup jam ( store-bought, homemade or store-bought ) | 2 medium-ripe tomatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 425 f degrees. Arrange potatoes in 2 rows in an 8x8 inch baking dish. Drizzle with 1/2 cup jam, spreading to cover top of potato slices evenly. Arrange tomatoes over jam covered potatoes. Sprinkle with remaining jam. Bake 55 minutes, or until potatoes are tender. Serve hot.

title: Grilled Chili Verde
ingredients: 1 lb beef or 1 lb pork, cut into fine strips about 1 inch wide | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, cut into thin strips about one inch wide and two inches long | 1/4 cup ranch dressing | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried tomatillos, soaked for 15 minutes and drained | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Rinse the sirloin and pat dry with paper towels. Slice the meat into thin 1 inch sections about 2 inches long. Mix the ingredients. Grill on a bbq or with a cover, turning once until done, about 10 minutes, or let sirloin roast in a 200 degree oven 10 minutes, turning twice.

title: Capellini With Lima Beans
ingredients: 250 g capellini | 400 g lima beans | 4 green cardamoms
instructions: Put lima beans in a pot and pour in enough water to cover them. Let come to a boil and boil for around 30 - 45 minutes or until the beans are al dente. Test them by throwing a knife through the beans, then you can tell they are cooked. Let them rest for 5 - 10 minutes before putting in a salad bowl. Cut the tops off the capers and cut the cap into small pieces. Serve with some chilled parmesan cheese and freshly ground black pepper.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread crumb,coconut milk,pineapple juice,sesame oil,italian herb seasoning,duck breast
title: Sweet Duck
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat bread crumbs | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1 cup canned crushed pineapple with juice | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian herb seasoning | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon sun-dried sun-dried pasta-flavored gelatin or 1 tablespoon other non-hydrogenated oil
instructions: In a 3 to 3 1/2 to 4 quart electric slow cooker, mix together bread crumbs, coconut milk, pineapple, italian herb seasoning, sesame oil and pasta flavored gelatin until well combined. Place pork roast with bread crumbs in slow cooker set to high. Cook 10 minutes on high, then 10 minutes on low. If using meat from roast, remove pork and pineapple from slow cooker and place in a bowl. Serve with jelly roll crackers.

title: Chickpea Grissini
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs zucchini, quartered lengthwise | 1/2 cup sultana | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste ( see note at the end of the recipe ) | 1 1/2 lbs pizza dough
instructions: If using non stick vegetable peeler, peel zucchini leaving the ends intact. Trim any ends or gristle. Cut into quarters. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Arrange zucchini, sultanas and ginger garlic in a roasting pan. Drizzle with a little oil and cover the pan tightly with aluminum foil. Bake the zucchini at 350 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes. Remove the pan from oven, lift foil, and cover tightly. Bake the zucchini for an additional 10 mins or until tender. Remove zucchini from oven and cool slightly. When cool, split the pizza dough in half horizontally. Spoon the mixture into 4 individual rectangular ovenproof glasses. Spread the filling onto the pizza dough. Place the glasses on a baking tray so that the filling does not touch the crusts. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze. Keep the grissini under a damp cloth in the freezer for at least 2 - 4 hours. If using a regular glass it should be a little dry for this step. Place the frozen grissini in separate containers.. Note, ginger and garlic paste can be purchased in specialty food stores, if you have them.

title: Smokey Jalapeno Poppers
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 poblano peppers | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 1/8 teaspoon msg ( optional- i like it just plain ) | 1 carton plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a jelly roll pan or other baking sheet. Slice peppers open, removing stem and seeds. Place in a glass baking dish and sprinkle with baking soda. Cover with a lid or aluminum foil, and bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Allow to cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: bird eye chile,taco seasoning mix,american cheese,red wine,vanilla essence,white pearl onion,greek yogurt
title: Chicken, Cheese and Salsa
ingredients: 750 g white pearl onions ( frozen small onion slices ) | 1/2 cup white wine ( glass ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( mccormick italian grill, mccormick mexican grill, 1 packet ) | 2 teaspoons ground birds eye chiles | 2 teaspoons ground birds eye chile | 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/2 cup reduced-fat american cheese, grated
instructions: Drain onions and combine in a large bowl.

title: Dry & Saffron-Scented Brisket & Pasta
ingredients: 2 corned beef brisket, trimmed | 1 pinch saffron | 1/4 cup thousand island dressing | 1 cup dry medium pasta shell, such as ditalini or 1 cup shell pasta, rotelle | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom, spice, grind
instructions: Place brisket in a dutch oven with a tight fitting rack. Add enough cold water to cover brisket. Bring water to a boil, then reduce heat to simmer. Cook brisket for about 2 hours, or until fork tender. Remove brisket from the liquid, cool, then chill in refrigerator for about 2 hours. Bring liquid to a boil, then mix in saffron. Add water if mixture becomes too thick to coat the back of a spoon. Cook and stir over low heat until syrupy. Heat up the remaining 1/2 cup thousand island dressing and stir in cardamom powder. Cut beef slices into 1/2 inch slices. Strain liquid from sauce. Pour 1 1/2 cups pasta water and saffron dressing mixture into pot.

title: Basic Rasam
ingredients: 12 -15 dill seeds | 1 cup dry sherry | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons garam masala
instructions: Place 2 cups sherry and 1/2 tablespoons garam masala in pan and mix well. Place a wok over high heat. Once a single bead of air bubbles appears in the sherry, pour the mixture into the wok. When bubbles appear, the sherry will begin to bubble up slightly. Place the pan in a larger metal bowl with a trivet on top of the sherry. Allow to bubble for 10 - 15 minutes until the sherry is half gone. Immediately add remaining garam masala.

title: Strawberry and Leeks
ingredients: 1 large leek, trimmed | 6 ripe strawberries
instructions: Remove and discard the outer white ends from the strawberries and cut away the tough stalk. Wash the leek under running water and trim off thick green tops. Remove the white leaves and carefully scrape off and discard the green tops from the stalks. Cut away the thick stems from the leeks and slice into halves along the length of the stalk. Cut the leeks in half lengthways. Cut them into segments just like the strawberries and leeks. Place the strawberries inside the leeks, cut side down on a cutting board. Sprinkle the scallions over the top. If there is any resistance to the knife, simply push through a sieve. Cut away any excess white or yellow matter in the stem and discard the centre of the segment, being careful not to cut all the way through. You will keep the scallions covered at all times during this process.

title: Easy Hominy
ingredients: 2 lbs dried hominy | 1 box dark chocolate, chips
instructions: Soak hominy in boiling water for 30 minutes, drain. Place chocolate in a large pot over low heat, stirring until melted and chocolate is completely dissolved. Place drained hominy in a large container, cover with saran wrap and let stand for 1 day. Drain. Cover and refrigerate for 2 days. When ready to serve, heat oven to 450 degrees. Pour chocolate into an ungreased 9 x 13 baking pan, spreading to make 1/2 inch thick layer. Using a large spoon, spread to cover the entire bottom.

title: French Bread II
ingredients: 2 teaspoons bread machine yeast | 1 cup cooked yellow split peas | 1 -2 lb ham hock
instructions: You will need two pans, one for the bread and one for the dough. On the first half of a two pound loaf cycle roll out the yeast and then into the second half. While the two loaves are being calculated, place all ingredients into a large bowl add the ham hock a dutch oven or other sturdy heavy pot to cover. Place the two loaves on top of the ingredients with water, then cover. Set into the oven and turn temperature to 150 degrees celcius and let cook for 45 minutes. Remove from oven, put on a cutting board and allow to cool for 10 minutes.

title: Rice Flour Chapati (Cook and eat Dosas)
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 1 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Wash and drain washed and drained rice. Keep aside. Take 2 cups of water and bring to a boil. Add 1 tsp salt and rice and keep aside to make rice slightly soft. When the water comes to a boil, add flour all at once. Add 1/4 cup more of water, mix well and stir it constantly. Once the mixture comes to a boil, switch off the stove and transfer it to a greased non stick pan. Bake until golden brown. This should take about 10 - 15 minutes. Serve hot with indian flatbreads or sambar.

title: Aussie Marinade for Beef Satay Chips Recipe.
ingredients: 6 lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup grand marnier ( or any other orange-flavored liqueur ) or 1/2 cup rose water ( or any other orange-flavored liqueur )
instructions: Cut each lettuce leaf lengthwise and remove stems. Place in gallon size zipper lock bag and pour on all of the grand marnier or other orange flavored liqueur. Tie bag with kitchen string. Place in refrigerator overnight. Prep and oil grill.

title: Pasta With Bowties
ingredients: 1 box bow tie pasta | 1 bag crumbled sweet dried cake
instructions: Cook pasta until tender but firm. Mix pasta with sweet dried cake, and mix. Serve and enjoy.

title: Kiwi-Onion-And-Salami
ingredients: 8 ounces kiwi, cut in half and sliced | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 pinch hot pepper flakes | 2 ounces salt pork or 2 ounces beef | 2 ounces mascarpone cheese | radish ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients into a saucepan and bring to a simmer. Cover saucepan and cook gently for 5 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,taco seasoning mix,juniper berry,horseradish,maraschino cherry,spanish onion
title: Mexican Relish
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1 medium spanish onion | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( taco blanching, or taco seasoning mix mix from mild home. ) | 8 maraschino cherries or 8 grape jelly jars | 1 teaspoon horseradish, for sprinkling ( optional ) | 20 juniper berries, crushed
instructions: Finely chop the onions and the cherries in a food processor to be a fine paste. Remove the egg membrane and hard shell. Cut each egg into 2 halves. Place the egg halves cut side up in a bowl or plastic bag and use a slotted spoon to spoon onto 2 plates or small serving plates. Sprinkle with the desired amount of taco seasoning and top with the onion paste. Arrange cherry halves or grape jelly jars on top of onion paste and spoon onto the egg halves. Sprinkle with horseradish. Decorate with juniper berries and let people help themselves.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,cardamom pod,basil,orange zest,chili oil,olive oil
title: Spicy Citrus Infused Oranges
ingredients: 18 oranges, zest of ( about 1 1/2 lbs ) | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 teaspoon good-quality chili oil ( a taste of thai sweet chili oil ) | 1/2 cup packed fresh basil, plus more, for garnish | 1/2 teaspoon good-quality vanilla sugar | 4 whole cardamom pods
instructions: Heat the olive oil and chili oil in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring to mash the chili oil. Add the basil and cook only until the basil wilts, about five minutes. Add the vanilla sugar, increase the heat and cook just until warmed through. Place the cardamom pods in a small coffee grinder and grind until coarsely crushed. Stir the grinder into the oil mixture and taste. If you find it too spicy, add more chili oil. If not, adjust the orange zest. Transfer the orange zest to a shallow bowl. Fill a large bowl with ice.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,russet potato,pineapple,hot green chili pepper,coriander,focaccia bread,navel orange
title: Ceviche Ragu
ingredients: 9 ounces rigatoni pasta ( about 6 cups ) | 2 cups canned crushed pineapple, drained | 1 large navel orange, juice and zest | 1 can hot green chili peppers, drained | 1 lb russet potato, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch dice | 12 large coriander ( cilantro ) or 12 large flat-leaf parsley sprigs, loosely packed | crusty foccacia bread
instructions: Cook rigatoni in 8 to 10 quarts boiling salted water until just tender. Drain. Meanwhile, combine macaroni and pineapple in large saucepan, and heat. Add orange juice, chilies, and potatoes. Simmer, covered, until potatoes are tender. Add coriander or parsley and spoon over pasta. Serve topped with crouton or aji fresco. Serve hot.

title: Apricot Apricot Balls
ingredients: 150 g yogurt | 3 tablespoons apricot preserves ( about 1 per pound ) | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: Place yoghurt, preserves and soy sauce in a food processor. Blend till smooth. Add essence and puree till smooth. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Roll rounded tbsps. Of mixture into balls. Refrigerate the balls for an hour longer if possible. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,lipton onion soup mix,apricot preserve,vodka,puff pastry
title: Apricot Almond Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 puff pastry sheet, thawed | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 16 ounces frozen puff pastry | 1 packet lipton onion soup mix | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray inside of pie dish with crisco cooking spray. Sprinkle apricot preserves on pastry, reserving 1 tablespoon and place on top of pastry. Sprinkle soup mix over apricot preserves in pan, then fold over, crimping edges to seal. Sprinkle with garam masala powder to taste.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,swiss cheese,parsnip,buttermilk,chicken bouillon powder
title: Parsnips With Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese, shredded & grated | 2 tablespoons dry parsnips, chopped | 6 italian plum tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk
instructions: Combine swiss cheese, parsnip, tomatoes, bouillon and buttermilk in a medium saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until swiss cheese melts and mixture boils, about 5 minutes. Stir in cheese mixture. Cover and heat until hot throughout, about 7 minutes.

title: Scallops in Sour Tomato Cream (Molho de Alho)
ingredients: 1/2 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 can vegetable broth | 1/4 lb medium scallop | 1 package thin rice noodles
instructions: Combine vinegar, brandy, and broth. Brush seafood with the 1/4 cup liquid. Cover with plastic wrap and chill 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally. Set up rice noodles according to package directions. Transfer to a steamer basket and cover. Bring to a boil for 1 minute. Remove plastic wrap and let stand 5 minutes. Turn noodles over and add scallops. Cover and steam 3 - 4 minutes, adding more liquid if necessary. Serve with salad and vinaigrette.

title: Jumbo Shrimp
ingredients: 3 pounds jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 large yellow squash, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons yellow onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Rinse shrimp well, and pat dry with paper towels. Arrange the shrimp in a single layer in bottom of the baking dish. Sprinkle lightly with onion and sugar. Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, then remove from heat. Cover with aluminum foil, and allow to cool for 15 minutes. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,tabasco sauce,apple,spring onion,italian herb,soy sauce,navy bean,swiss chard
title: Maggie Beer's Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb navy beans or 1 lb other green beans | 2 stalks swiss chard, chopped | 1 apple, peeled, cored and chopped | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 3 tablespoons triple sec or 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 teaspoons dried mixed italian herbs | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 spring onion, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a large frying pan, saute chard, apple, soy sauce, triple sec, and mixed spices for about 5 miuntes. Remove from heat. Drain beans. Place in a greased baking dish. Sprinkle with chopped spring onion. Mix well. Bake @ 350 for about 25 minutes.

title: Havana's Onions
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion | 3 tablespoons lard
instructions: Slice the onion in half and rub the onion with olive oil on both sides of the onion. Heat the lard in a frying pan or skillet and carefully brown the onion until golden brown. Wrap the onions in plastic wrap and allow to cool completely. Slice the onions thin and place in a large shallow bowl.

title: Spicy Garlic-Stuffed Baked  Pies
ingredients: 12 garlic | 1 pie crust, ready to bake | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, sifted | 1/4 teaspoon ground anise seed | 4 hoagie rolls, split
instructions: Make the garlic cloves ahead of time and preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Roll the unbaked pie crust out to 1 inch thickness and prick the bottom with a fork. Bake about 7 minutes on high.

title: Blue Cheese and Herb Grape Salad
ingredients: 1 bag red seedless grapes | 1 bag blueberries | 1 packet sazon seasoning | 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme ( or more to taste ) | 1 package firm blue cheese, crumbles | 1/2 cup coarse grain mustard
instructions: In large bowl, toss grapes and blueberries with sazon and thyme. Divide cheese salad among 4 plates, sprinkle with crumbles and dijon style mustard. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Enchilada Pie
ingredients: 2 cups diced white potatoes | 1 can enchilada sauce | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 2 pound deep dish pie dish. Place diced potatoes in a skillet over medium high heat, and cook and stir until tender and slightly browned, about 15 minutes. Pour 1/2 cup enchilada sauce in the base of the prepared pie dish.

Random Ingredients: lime,dark chocolate,extra large egg,oregano leaf,red onion,cheese,madeira wine
title: Mexican Mousse
ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate, melted | 1/2 cup finely chopped red onion | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh oregano leaves | 3 extra-large eggs | 1 1/2 tablespoons madeira wine | extra large egg, to coat | 80 g grated tasty cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the hot chocolate, onion and oregano. Whisk eggs and wine together in another bowl. Fold egg mixture into chocolate mixture. Dip moulds coated in egg mixture into cheese. Place moulds on heated griddle, cook until golden brown on each side and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,sultana,monterey jack cheese,chunky peanut butter,almond paste,pecan
title: Peanut Spread With Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 12 slices monterey jack cheese, cut in half | 12 ounces jar-stuffed peppers | 1/2 cup sultana, soaked in hot water and drained | 1 teaspoon almond paste | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1 cup dry kidney bean | 1/4 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Place sliced cheese halves, flat side up, on a greased baking sheet. Spread bean mixture on top of cheese. Place a pepper on top of the bean mix, then sprinkle with sultanas and almond paste. Make a well in the middle of the pecan halves and press together with fingers. Sprinkle on peanut butter. Broil in a 425° oven for about 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,olive oil,sirloin steak,yellow onion,pork bean,parmigiano reggiano cheese,puff pastry
title: Beef Rolls With Puff Pastry
ingredients: 2 sirloin steaks | 6 ounces ground pork and beans ( i used perniliano and parmigiano-reggiano instead ) | 1 cup arborio rice, cooked ( i used barilla ) | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed | 1 ounce parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shaved ( parmesan rind )
instructions: Cut steaks into 1/2 inch wide strips. Heat oil and saute' onion until light gold, stirring frequently. Add rice to onion and continue saute' until heated through, stirring constantly. Add ground pork, beans and stir well. Remove from heat and set aside. Roll out pastry dough to a 12 inch circle. Spoon a small amount of pork mixture into center of pastry. Spoon a generous amount of rice mixture onto filling in center. Roll up pastry tube starting with the long side facing you and pinch the ends closed. Place rolls on hot baking sheet, brush top with a little olive oil and bake in 375f degrees oven for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve with a side salad.

Random Ingredients: pork,red chili powder,meat,vanilla yogurt,white pepper,rump roast
title: Peking Meat
ingredients: 1 pork rump roast ( or you can use other roast ) | 1 large rump roast | 1 tablespoon dried red chili powder ( or more to your taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 container low-fat vanilla yogurt | 1 large piece of plastic wrap ( the larger you get the papier the better they will be )
instructions: Cut up the meat into bit size chunks. Cut the shredder or better yet a meat slicer into pieces about the size of your palm. Put the meat in a large bowl or plastic bag. Stir in the dried chile powder, pepper and the white flour. Taste and add more seasonings if necessary, adding more chili powder as needed. Refrigerate 8 hours, or overnight. Remove meat from it's container. Make sure it's clean and dry. Dip one end in melted chocolate and let excess liquid run off. Place in fridge for an hour or two while it's resting. Preheat your oven to 425°f. Place shredded meat on a foil covered tray. In individual dishes or a roaster place two pieces of plastic wrap on the meat, spreading them evenly over the top. Put your pot on the stove on the lowest setting, close the oven and leave door to door until the oven has warmed up, 2 hours or so. Remove meat from the fridge and drain off any excess liquid. Set meat on a plate and cover it with remaining flour. Set aside for 10 minutes. Place on a cookie sheet and bake for 20 minutes or until it tests done. Take out of oven and let it cool a little.

title: Irish Cream Cheese Fruit Dip With Coconut
ingredients: 300 g cream cheese | 100 g currants or 100 g sultanas | 3/4 cup coconut milk | fresh fruit, such as raisins, cranberries, dates, dates, dried cranberries or apples
instructions: Place creamed cheese, currants or sultanas, coconut milk and chopped fresh fruit in blender or food processor and blend until smooth.. Serve with grated carrots or mashed potatoes.

title: Auntie Lori's Colby Jack Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups colby-jack cheese, shredded | 2 cups chutney spread ( i use colby jack ) | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Mix all ingredient together, except baking soda, in a large bowl. Spoon into greased muffins cups and bake for about 20 minutes, or until slightly browned.

title: Tortilla Rice Pudding With Pecorino Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup soy milk | 1 cup brown rice | 1/4 cup semolina ( fine grain ) | 3/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 18 corn tortillas
instructions: In a saucepan bring the soy milk to a boil while slowly adding the rice. When the milk comes to a boil, turn the heat down and simmer for about 15 minutes. Add the semolina in a slow stream until well mixed and the rice is cooked but not too soft. Add in the cheese a little at a time stirring constantly until well incorporated. Wrap the tortillas in very damp paper towels to remove the excess moisture. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Remove the rice from the heat and add about 1/3 of the crumb mixture into a bowl. Using half the tortillas press into the rice until completely covered. Repeat with the remaining rice. Spread with the remaining crumb mixture evenly on all sides. In a 9x13 inch pan spread the remaining crumb mixture evenly over the rice pressing down all the way to make sure it is evenly spread. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake for 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,lemon juice,cumin powder,peppermint extract,saffron,kikkoman soy sauce
title: Saffron Lasagna Spread
ingredients: 1 cup saffron | 2 cups kikkoman soy sauce | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon peppermint extract | 1 box lasagna noodle, uncooked
instructions: In a small sauce pan, combine all ingredients. Over medium heat, simmer to reduce liquid a little bit. Set aside to cool completely. Spread 1/2 the sauce onto the bottom of a 9 x13 metal baking dish. Place 3 lasagna noodles over sauce. Spread with half of the sauce, then add 1 cup of remaining sauce. Place 3 more noodles over sauce and spread with remaining sauce. Top with the remaining 3 noodles. Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight. Slice and serve with sliced plantains, cucumbers, black olives, sliced green beans or pita chips.

title: Pork Loin in Beer
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 boneless pork loin | 1 1/2 cups dark beer
instructions: Rub the cornstarch over the pork, then season with oregano. Place the pork in a crock, sprinkle with beer, cover, and refrigerate for up to 2 days, turning occasionally to ensure even marinating.

title: Vanillaised Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 ounces shiitake mushroom caps | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Heat the vanilla essence and dry mushrooms in a non stick pan over medium heat for around 5 minutes or until they look dark. Poke the mushroom with the tip of a sharp knife or your finger on the mushroom cap to see if you notice that there is too much liquid. Remove from the heat. When all the mushrooms have been wiped from the oil, pour over the vanilla essence and serve.

title: Chinese Slaw (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 lb chinese cabbage, shredded | 1/2 lb pepperoni, sliced | 10 -16 frozen toothpicks | 1 jar salsa | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Mix together cabbage, pepperoni, and salsa. Pour molasses over all, if desired, and toss to coat all. Serve as a filling for stews.

Random Ingredients: ha avocadoes,provolone cheese,ranch dressing,garlic clove,focaccia bread,prosciutto,pinto bean
title: Grilled Bread With Avocado and Provolone Salad
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 2 hass avocadoes | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 -2 cup provolone cheese | 1 loaf focaccia bread | 1/2 cup thousand island dressing or 1/2 cup ranch dressing | 4 slices thin sliced prosciutto or 4 slices ham
instructions: Open pinto beans and rinse gently with cold water. Pat the beans dry with paper towels. Drain well. Combine the beans and drained sieve beans, avocados and garlic well and toss lightly. Add provolone, mix gently. Cut focaccia in half lengthwise and then lengthwise. Brush focaccia with dressing. Top with bean mixture. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Cook bacon slices or ham slices as directed if using a meat or poultry.

title: Sweet Lentils
ingredients: 2 cups lentils, washed, cooked | 1 cup okra, cut into small pieces ( fresh okra, thawed if frozen, can use frozen ) | 3 small sweetened mangoes, peeled & cut into thin slivers | 1 cup sweet tortillas, warmed and cut into triangles | cinnamon sugar, as needed
instructions: In bowl, combine lentils, okra, mangoes, tortillas& cinnamon sugar.

title: Fondue Bourguignon (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 lb cauliflower floret | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 tablespoons hazelnuts or 2 tablespoons chopped almonds
instructions: Clean the cauliflower and cut it into small florets. Put them in a saucepan with a lid or sieve over a bowl, along with the grated zest, sherry and 2 tbsp water. Cover and simmer gently about 30 minutes until the cauliflower is tender. Remove the lid and simmer a few minutes longer until most of the liquid is absorbed. Stir in the nuts and serve straight away or keep warm in a turned on oven at 300°f for up to 30 minutes or until warmed through.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Grand Marnier Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup onion, very thinly sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry mustard | 2 tablespoons dry french-style mustard | 1/3 cup grand marnier ( or to taste ) | 9 ounces beef tenderloin, trimmed
instructions: Preheat broiler. Lay tenderloin in a broiler safe pan. Place pan under broiler and broil 15 to 20 minutes, turning once or twice, or until thermometer registers 125ëš. Transfer tenderloin to a cutting board and set aside. Briefly warm 1 cup onions in 1/3 cup water in a small skillet. Remove from heat. Remove saucepan from heat and stir in 1/4 cup french style dijon mustard. Brush remaining 1/4 cup french style mustard onto tenderloin. Place tenderloin on a broiler proof pan that has been well coated with cooking spray. Brush onion mixture and remaining 1/4 cup french style dijon mustard onto tenderloin.

Random Ingredients: pasta shell,apricot preserve,yellow squash,vanilla ice cream,xanthan gum,wheat pasta,ginger root
title: Tikka's Whole Wheat Pasta With Sliced Zucchini
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soybean paste with grains ( tikka's ) | 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 cup whole wheat pasta | 2 teaspoons vanilla ice cream | 1/2 yellow squash, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 can apricot preserves, divided
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Huevos Fritos With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, very thinly sliced | 1 head romaine lettuce, very thinly sliced | 1 lb haddock or 1 lb large shrimp, peeled
instructions: Tear or shred the lettuce. Tear or shred the head and then layer it with the shrimp. Wrap the leaves in a very clean, dry towel to keep them submerged. Serve on a platter. Serves 6 snack foods. Variation, you may place a handful of jumbo shrimp in a bowl and then slice the head thinly as desired.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,black olive,saffron thread,flour tortilla,basil leaf,self rising flour,green chile pepper
title: Baked Spicy Baked Saffron Tortillas
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped green chile peppers | 1/4 cup chopped seeded stemmed black olives | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil leaves | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 1/4 cup coarsely crushed red pepper, and amount to taste | 1/4 cup coarsely crushed black olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, mix the green chile peppers, black olives, flour, basil, saffron and crushed red pepper and black olives. Bake at 375 degrees f for 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: elbow macaroni,lemon,tabasco sauce,cardamom seed,half milk,tortilla,red lentil
title: Macaroni and Lentils With Lemon
ingredients: 6 ounces dried red lentils | 1/2 cup dry elbow macaroni or 1/2 cup other small tubular pasta | 1 cup half-and-half milk | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/3 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons finely chopped lemon rind | grated lemon rind | tortilla or rice
instructions: Sort through lentils, picking out all foreign bits. Rinse lentils well. Place lentils in a large pot and cover with 3 quarts very hot tap water. Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 8 - 10 minutes or until tender. Drain. Return lentils to the pot.

title: Mexican Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine, uncooked | 1 cup baby carrots ( about 2 lbs ) | 1 jar salsa verde ( about 2 cups ) | 1/4 cup cashews ( about 6 ounces ) | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning, plus more ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cook linguine according to package directions, adding carrots and salsa. Drain. Combine cashews with creole seasoning in small bowl.

title: Pickled Fennel
ingredients: 1 lb fresh fennel, trimmed, washed, and tied with kitchen twine ( or similar green fennel with some twine ) | 2 1/2 - 3 teaspoons salt | 3/4 cup black vinegar
instructions: Place the fennel in a saucepan and add just enough cold water to cover it. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes or until the fennel is soft. Remove the fennel from the water, drain and set aside to cool. When cool, remove the stems and tough outer leaves. Cut the fennel into thick strips with a sharp knife. Discard the tough outer shells. Stir together the salt and vinegar. Stir the fennel pieces in the vinegar. Cover and refrigerate overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: papaya,greek yogurt,dark red kidney bean,mushroom stem,self raising flour,pineapple juice,bacon,red pepper flake
title: Papaya Bacon Muffins
ingredients: 100 g self-raising flour | 1/2 cup drained dark red kidney beans | 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 8 very thin slices bacon ( from a block ) | 6 very thin fresh mushrooms stems | 1/2 small papaya ( peeled and cut into matchsticks ) | 1/2 cup thick greek yogurt | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh pineapple juice | fresh low-fat greek yogurt, for serving in a jug
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c gas or 180c. Combine flour, kidney beans and red pepper flakes in a bowl & add chopped bacon, mushrooms & papaya. Using a sturdy knife or pastry blender, beat the yoghurt into the flour until smooth, stir in pineapple juice, then add to the mixture. Spoon the mixture into 12 x 2cm lamington cups or lightly greased 4 cup capacity gratin dishes. Cover with greaseproof paper and bake in the centre of the oven for about 20 mins or until risen & soft & golden brown. Remove the dish from oven & set aside to cool slightly. Remove paper & foil from the muffins and place on serving plates. Serve with fresh thick yoghurt.

title: Lactose-Free, Vegetable Rolls
ingredients: 3 cups warm organic and unfiltered organic soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dry yeast | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, ground | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper, seeds or 1 teaspoon caraway seeds | 1 teaspoon msg | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. In a large bowl, mix all ingredients. Cover and let sit 10 minutes. Spray work surface liberally with oil. Shape dough evenly into ball, place into a lightly greased pan and flatten by pressing in the edges. Brush tops with a little water. Bake 45 - 45 minutes until golden brown.

title: Quick No Nuts
ingredients: 1 container ricotta cheese | 1 can creamed corn
instructions: Drain the canned creamed corn well and put in small bowl. Mix in ricotta cheese. I use one can at a time. Pour it on bread, pasta or anything else that is good in a can.

title: Homemade Spanish Onions
ingredients: 1/2 of a spanish onion | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: First, rinse your onions thoroughly in an mesh strainer so they have a good clear surface and don't worry about getting any dirt off. Remove the excess water from your onion by placing the strainer in your sink and sprinkling the dried onion on top. Place the onion in the olive oil and allow to sit at room temperature approximately an hour. Rinse off any access oil and dry any excess water using a paper towel. You may need to add more olive oil depending on your personal preference. It helps to cover the onion completely when you're preparing it for cooking. When the onion has become translucent and slightly translucent, it'll be ready to serve depending on your preference. The amount of water your onions will take depends how soft you want the top of them to be. I cook at 4 cups of water and usually add the onion at the end of cooking so all the water is in the onion when you're finished cooking. When draining up any extra onions to use, you can sprinkle with olive oil so you don't have any more dripping in the drained onions when serving. Another note, if your onions are extremely dry and cracked, use fresh ground pepper, a little more olive oil vs. 2 teaspoons of salt added to keep them moist.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,italian bread,chunky salsa,msg,white flour,chicken bouillon
title: Copycat "Zesty Italian Salsa"
ingredients: 8 -10 tablespoons chunky salsa | 4 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 6 tablespoons white flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons msg ( optional ) | 14 1/2 ounces greek yogurt | 2 -3 slices italian bread
instructions: Pour salsa in crock pot, add chicken boullion and mix. Add about 3/4th can of yogurt. Stir well and add msg, then add rest. Stir. Let set on low for about 8 - 12 hours. Serve over your favorite white rice or pasta. Add more msg if needed.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,tuna water,sesame seed oil,single cream,rice wine
title: Chinese Smoked Sea Salt Pork With Tuna
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs smoked pork shoulder | 1 cup single cream | 5 tablespoons toasted sesame seed oil | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 3 cans tuna in water
instructions: Wash the pork and cut into 1 inch cubes. In a large bowl, cover the pork with the single cream. Season with 1 1/2 tablespoons of sesame seed oil, and refrigerate until the pork absorbs the cream. The salt pork will need to be well soaked overnight or for at least 2 days and no longer translucent. In a large pot, heat the tuna in water until steaming hot. When the tuna is steaming dry, pour the tuna/salt pork mixture in and stir rapidly to evenly disperse the tuna evenly. Cover the pan and set the heat to medium once the liquid boils, add the pork. Cook for 2 - 5 minutes, turning it over once or twice. Turn off the heat, remove the lid, allow the sauce to cool slightly, and serve.

title: German Cabbage
ingredients: 2 pounds shredded cabbage | 2 teaspoons anise seed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees f. Spread anise seed onto a large piece of aluminum foil large enough to cover the entire piece of cabbage. Place the casserole dish under the broiler for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven, and place the cabbage into the preheated oven. Bake uncovered until tender, about 90 minutes.

title: Rocket Salad With Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 3 kg fresh rocket, washed and dried | 3 garlic cloves, peeled and smashed | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200ºc / 400ºf/ gas put the rocket on to a large baking sheet. Scatter over the garlic and leave to mature. Pour the vinegars over, and drizzle over some water to get a slightly sticky dressing. Use as needed. Bake for about an hour or so, stirring a couple of times with the pan juices. The rocket will start to wilt and wilt as it cools. Leave to cool for several hours or so, then serve.

Random Ingredients: star anise pod,cornmeal,cider vinegar,garlic salt,steak,leg lamb
title: Breaded Beef Rib Eye roast
ingredients: 14 ounces flank steak | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 10 star anise pods, crushed | 2 1/4 cups cider vinegar | 2 1/4 cups cornmeal | 1/2 cup cornmeal, for dusting
instructions: Mix the flank steak, garlic powder, star anise, vinegar and cornmeal in a large bowl. Cover and put in the refrigerator. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Put the meat on a rack on a roasting pan and rub with enough cornmeal to coat the entire meat. Roast for about 3 hours, or until fork tender, basting several times. Transfer the meat to a cutting board and let rest, covered, for about 10 minutes.

title: Asian Style Crispy Korean Beef
ingredients: 600 g lamb shoulder, cubed | 1/2 cup mixed nuts | 1 tablespoon oriental sesame oil, to taste
instructions: Combine the sesame oil and brown the beef. Set aside to cool enough to handle. Dry roast the nuts in a dry frying pan over a very low heat, shaking the pan so the nuts don't burn. Remove the nuts from the pan and place in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,leek,sirloin tip roast,snow pea,self rising flour,green chili,peanut butter,scallion
title: Sirloin Tip Roasted With Snow Peas and Scallions
ingredients: 1 2/3 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1 cup vegetable oil | 4 medium scallions, cut into 3/4-inch rounds | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 tablespoon green chili, minced | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 2/3 cup snow peas, trimmed and halved lengthwise ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup green chili, sliced | 1 cup scallion, sliced diagonally into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 1/2 cup cooked swiss peanuts or 1/2 cup cooked cashews
instructions: Remove excess fat from roast and cut lengthwise into 6 to 8 equal pieces. Heat 1 tablespoons oil in a very large nonstick skillet. Working in batches, cook roast 7 to 8 minutes on each side or until cooked medium. Set aside. Heat second 1 tablespoons oil in the skillet over medium high heat. Add scallions, 3 tablespoons peanut butter and chile. Saute 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in flour. Add snow peas and green chiles. Cook to sizzle over heat. Remove from heat. Stir scallion mixture into skillet. Serve over a bed of roasted beef tips. Garnish with scallion slices.

title: Corn and Chicken Rissotto
ingredients: 2 chicken, cleaned and quartered | 8 ounces baby spinach | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup corn ( preferably whole kernel ) | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( optional, see note ) | 1 pinch baking soda
instructions: Cook chicken in a skillet until almost done. Add spinach to skillet, cover, and cook until spinach is tender, about 5 minutes. Place spinach on plate and cover to keep warm. Add cheese to chicken. Heat remaining broth in a 2 quart sauce pot. Add sherry if using. Stir in baking soda and bring to a boil, stirring rapidly until mixture comes to a full boil. Pour broth into a warm bowl. Place a serving dish over the pot and add sherry, rice, and cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Peach Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 1 cup rice, uncooked | 30 ripe peaches | 1/2 cup cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place rice in small shallow baking dish, and scatter peach slices evenly over the top. Cover with cream. Cover dish with aluminum foil, and bake in preheated oven for 35 minutes. Uncover, and bake another 15 minutes, until slightly puffed and golden. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,cinnamon bark,queso fresco,golden syrup,chuck steak,chipotle chile adobo,soya sauce,green chilies
title: Cafe Pasqual for One
ingredients: 1 chipotle chile in adobo | 1 -2 whole chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 1/2 greek yogurt | 1 green chilies | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/4 teaspoon golden syrup | 1 1 cup que queso fresco, grated | 6 -8 chops of chuck steak, 1-inch thick, trimmed
instructions: Grind chipotle chile with adobo and chipotles in blender to make smooth paste. Add yogurt, green chilies, soya sauce, adobo paste, and gold syrup to marinade and chill for several hours. Remove meat and reserve marinade. Place chops in large roasting pan, pour marinade over, cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight. Bring to room temperature, then roast at 450, for 30 - 40 minutes. If necessary, turn meat and broil to desired doneness, basting every 3 - 4 minutes, for 8 - 10 minutes. Basting often with reserved marinade, add grated cheese a few pieces at a time, allowing each to melt. Slice into thick slices with slicer on the bias. Serve with beans.

title: Slow-Bake Potatoes with Lamb and Basil
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes | 2 lbs lamb | 1/3 cup basil, plus extra ( to garnish ) | 1 tablespoon sesame-seed tamari ( to taste ) | 10 soft ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f scrub russets with damp cloth, then prick all over with a fork. Place in a roasting pan. Cook till tender when pierced with a skewer, about half an hour. Turn and bake until tender, about 45 minutes longer. Remove from oven and cool. When cool, chop coarsely. While potatoes are cooling, remove lamb from bones and coarsely chop. Combine lamb with basil, sesame seeds, and sweet basil in a bowl. Arrange in a single layer on platter, and mound sweet potato mixture over lamb. Dot with extra basil to decorate. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,cream celery soup,parmesan cheese,vanilla bean,red wine vinegar,cardamom pod
title: Lebanese Spicy Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, seeds removed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let chill in refrigerator for at least an hour. Just before serving stir in a dash of crushed cardamom.

title: Sushi Roll (Chawan Mushi)
ingredients: 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill ( optional )
instructions: Place seaweed on a clean surface. Wrap each sheet with a thin slice of nori, leaving 2 or 3 wide strips in all. Cut a slit on the top of each piece of nori to make a seal. Serve in a plastic bowl, or with other sushi condiment.

title: Grilled Mexican Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings, split | 1 teaspoon lime juice | 1/4 cup olive, chopped | 1 teaspoon nutritional yeast | 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorn, cracked
instructions: Cut off the wing tips and save. Place the wings skin side down on the counter.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,chicken breast,hot salsa,dark soy sauce,lime,broth,chicken thigh fillet
title: Fast and Easy Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thigh fillets | 4 chicken breast fillets | 6 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 3 tablespoons chicken stock or 3 tablespoons broth | 1 lime, cut into wedges | hot salsa
instructions: Score the chicken meat on both sides, and roll into eight pieces. Combine the dark soy sauce, chicken stock and lime juice in a small bowl, and refrigerate. Thread one piece of chicken onto a piece of aluminium foil, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Roll the foil loosely around, and seal with string. Heat about 3cm/1 inch of oil in a large frying pan. Cook the chicken till golden on all sides, turning. Serve with salsa, as much as you like and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,taco seasoning mix,lettuce leaf,ranch fiesta dip mix,barbecue sauce
title: Tex-Mex Shredded Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can ranch fiesta dip mix | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 5 single lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat chargrill pan on highest setting. Combine dip mix, barbecue sauce, seasoning sugar and 1/4 cup water in a bowl, stirring until dip mixture is well combined. Divide lettuce among 4 slices of beef and top with remaining toppings. Cook on chargrill pan until beef is just cooked.

title: Easy Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Mix flour, oil and veggies in a small bowl.

title: Dr. Chlin's Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, with their liquid | white pepper
instructions: Drain and rinse pinto beans. Put beans in saucepan with reserved liquid and cover with water. Bring to boil over high heat for 5 minutes. Turn off heat, remove lid, and let stand for 30 minutes. Stir, fluff with fork, and let sit for 10 more minutes. Transfer to an attractive serving bowl and season with white pepper.

title: Quick-Fix German Honey
ingredients: 1 teaspoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Using a coffee filter, filter the vapor from the honey. Combine all ingredients and stir well. Let stand 15 minutes to let thickener to thicken slightly, stir occasionally for a few minutes. Ladle into a hot sterilized canning jar with tight lid.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,reynolds wrap foil,rock lobster tail,paprika,grenadine,peppercorn
title: Lobster Stive & Octopus #RSC
ingredients: 1 can rock lobster tail | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon grenadine | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Heat canola oil in microwave until hot. Carefully open canola oil can and drain contents into mixing bowl. Add vinegar, grenadine, paprika and peppercorns, stirring to combine. Let stand 10 minutes. Heat thoroughly. Place two lobster tail shells on counter and roll each half into two cigar shaped tails. Repeat with other tails. Heat canola oil on stovetop until smoking. Carefully drop cooked lobster tails, one at a time, into hot oil. Turn over, cover and allow to fry for about 10 - 15 minutes, turning as necessary, until all of the lobster tail shells are cooked. Remove oysters from oil and drain well. Serve with favorite dippers such as, lettuce, tomato.

title: Tortilla and Sugar Snack Nests
ingredients: 1 box spaghetti or ( 16 ounce ) box vermicelli | 2 tablespoons caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 3 corn tortilla strips
instructions: Cook the pasta following the package directions. While pasta is cooking, toast corn tortillas until they get crisp and start to pop around the outside edges. This should take about 10 minutes. Drain the pasta and let it cool completely. Dice the drained pasta into bite sized pieces and set aside. Place a serving plate on top of the cooked pasta. Lift the tortilla strips out from the pasta with the hot pasta. Dot each nightly with a cornstarch sliver and place a few drops of sugar in each glass. Serve while hot and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: turkey bacon,cumin powder,tabasco sauce,dark brown sugar,black olive tapenade
title: Black Walnut Appetizer
ingredients: 3 slices turkey bacon | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup black olives with tapenade | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: In a small pot heat 1/2 cup brown sugar on medium. When bubbling add 2 tsp cumin. Remove from heat and stir until sugar well dissolved. Spread caramel into a glass 9x12 pan that has been coated with nonstick spray. Set aside until firm about 15 - 20 minutes. Preheat broiler. In a medium bowl crumble the turkey bacon into ½ inch pieces. Add the sugar, tabasco sauce, and the remaining cumin. Mix well. Roll mixture into ¾ inch balls and place on cookie sheet. Place in the oven and broil until crispy and brown, around 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from oven and place on paper towel. Cool completely before storing in an airtight container. These cookies will keep in the refrigerator for up to a month.

title: Fava Beans With Beef and Lemon
ingredients: 2 lbs fava beans, canned | 3 lbs flank steak | 2 tablespoons salt | 2 teaspoons freshly cracked black pepper | 10 -12 scallions, sliced ( spring onions )
instructions: Slice beef into thin bite size pieces. In a large pot, rinse fava beans, removing any debris that may be attached. Place the beef in the pot with the salt, pepper and scallions. Bring to a boil over medium high heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Note, you may also do this in the crock pot, on the stove, in the morning when you are on low. Cook on high at least 1 - 2 hours, checking periodically, to make sure it is cooked as the beans will have absorbed most of the soaking liquid. If beans are cooked before the 90 minutes are up, let it stand, uncovered, for 10 minutes of cooking. The mixture will still be soupy, like a thick soup. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: polenta,farfalle pasta,baby spinach leaf,amaro liqueur,green lentil,honeydew melon,italian seasoning,yam
title: Polenta Veggie and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb baby yam, halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning, divided | 1/4 cup aji doodles | 1/4 cup honeydew melon, diced | 1/2 package polenta, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup green lentils, rinsed | 2 tablespoons italian-style prepared polenta | 7 1/2 cups packed fresh baby spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons amaro liqueur
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, sprinkle yams with 1/4 teaspoon each of both italian seasoning and 1/8 teaspoon each of the italian seasoning. Add yams.

Random Ingredients: panir,thyme leave,white sugar,mustard powder,red chile,almond meal,ha avocado,beef
title: Easy Avocado & Pasilla Casserole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white sugar ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon beetle mustard powder | 12 ounces panir, chopped | 4 ounces anaheim mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 dash ground thyme leave | 1/4 cup slivered almonds meal or 1/4 cup ground toasted, walnuts | 1 small red chile, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine sugar, mustard and mix well. Set aside. Sautee the mushrooms in butter in a deep skillet or frying pan. Add the ground beef, thyme and a dash of chiles. Break up any clumps with the back of a fork. Cook until meat is cooked through. Mix all ingredients into meat and combine. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Sprinkle the top of the casserole with the almond meal or ground sesame. Cover with sliced avocado and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Simple Chimichurri Sandwich
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas | 16 thin slices of your favorite sandwich buns
instructions: Cut a slit 1 1/2 off each wedge of bread. Use a sharp knife to make holes. Open a tortilla. Place each hole on the center of the tortilla. Fill each hole with about 1 1/2 tablespoons pork or vegetable fat, whichever you prefer. Place on a warm skillet over medium heat. Cook for a few seconds, or until lightly browned. Remove from heat. Serve warm. Enjoy note,. For a variation, add a couple tablespoons of shredded cheese to the chimichurri.

title: Lamb and Green Olive Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs lean lamb, cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch cubes | 8 ounces green olives
instructions: Coat a large, flameproof casserole dish with vegetable oil. Add the lamb, and gently toss to coat in the oil. Pour enough boiling water into the pan to come halfway up the sides of the lamb. Put the pan into the oven and bake, uncovered, for 1 hour. Turn the meat and return to the oven and cook for a further 30 to 40 minutes or until the meat is tender, and browned. If there appears to be a little bit of liquid in the pan, pour off enough of the liquid. Remove from the oven and leave in the casserole pan. Place a large knob of butter on the meat to form a decoration. Sprinkle with some of the olives and some freshly ground black pepper. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,honeydew melon,stock,white vinegar,cooking spray
title: Honeydew Chilli
ingredients: cooking spray | 500 g honeydew melons, seeded and cut into wedges | 1/4 cup stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons white vinegar or 1 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/fan 200c/gas spray an oven proof dish with oil and add the honey. Add the melon wedges and stir. Add the stock and vinegar and stir. Transfer to oven, cook 15 minutes until the melon wedges are soft and soft.

title: Spiral Green Olivieri (Green olives with bacon drippings)
ingredients: 3 pounds green olives - washed, hulled, and halved | 4 slices bacon fat
instructions: Place bacon fat over medium heat in a large skillet. Cook bacon in bacon grease, stirring constantly, just until bacon is golden brown. Drain bacon slices on paper towels. Pour enough olive oil into a 9x13 inch baking dish to coat the bottom and up the sides. Arrange olives in rows in a layer, cutting through the top with a wide spatula to form diamonds or rectangles. Cover olives with bacon slices, cut side down, until bacon is entirely covered. Arrange on a plate, cover, and refrigerate overnight, or for up to 3 days, until needed. Heat the reserved olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium high heat. When oil is very hot, begin frying the olives in batches.

title: Beef or Pork and Asparagus Wraps
ingredients: 4 steaks ( i have used boneless beef chuck steak and pork stew meat ) | 1 lb thin asparagus, cleaned | 3/4 cup breadcrumbs | 48 inches burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 package mascarpone cheese | 1 pinch nutmeg | 1 box sandwich quick meat tenderizer or ( 6 ounce ) package meat-free soft roll wraps
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f. Trim the root ends from the asparagus. If you have cut off small tips just cut off tips about 2 inches of the tips and add to your food processor. The tips should be cut away from the tips. You want it to be about the thickness of a carrot. Cut asparagus in half down the middle so you end up with four pieces.

title: Sea Bass With Mascarpone Cheese
ingredients: 25 g cake flour | 25 g lamb fat or 25 g goat fat | 500 g sea bass fillets | 150 ml cream cheese or 150 ml thickened cream
instructions: Cut a small piece of kitchen paper or baking parchment, cover the bottom of the dish with the paper. Mix the flour and lamb fat in a large bowl. Dredge each piece of fish in the flour and set aside. Roll each piece of fish onto a wooden board about ¼ inch thick. Place the fish on the baking paper, brush with a little of the oil and bake for 5 to 6 minutes at 450°f/230°c. Allow to cool. Remove paper and place the sea bass on top, brush with a little oil and bake in a preheated oven for 10 minutes at 450°f/230°c. Allow to cool. Mix cream cheese with the rest of the mascarpone, mix well and refrigerate.

title: Italian Pork Sandwiches with Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef chuck | 1 jar chicken stock | 1 jar the prepared pizza sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium high heat with garlic powder, about 10 minutes. Drain excess fat. Gradually stir in barbeque sauce, chicken stock and pizza sauce.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,pork tenderloin,green cardamom pod,italian herb seasoning,garam masala,pearl barley
title: Slow Cooker Italian Herb Pulled Pork
ingredients: 10 cups peeled sliced pork tenderloin, thawed if frozen | 2 tablespoons dried italian herb seasoning | 2 pods green cardamom pods, split | 1 ounce pearl barley, uncooked | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon garam masala
instructions: Place pork tenderloins on the bottom of a slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: onion,cocoa powder,baby bella mushroom,vanilla extract,apple cider vinegar,wheat pastry flour
title: Wild Mushroom Brownies
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 1/2 cup unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1 cup dried baby bella mushrooms | 3 medium apples, such as cortland, braeburn, mcintosh, braeburn, or empires ( 7 cups ) | 1 medium onion, chopped medium | 2 tablespoons unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Line a 13x9x2 inch baking dish with parchment paper or lightly greased foil. Process flour, 1/2 cup cocoa powder, mushrooms, and apples in a food processor until smooth, 20 to 30 seconds. Scrape mixture into a large bowl and stir in onion, 2 tablespoons cocoa powder, vanilla, and remaining 1/2 cup cocoa. Spread brownies evenly into prepared baking dish. Cover tightly with foil. Bake until brownies are golden, 45 to 60 minutes. Let cool in dish for 10 minutes. Remove foil and cool completely. Store in refrigerator up to 1 week, or freeze up to 2 months. Turn out brownies right away and cut into 3 pieces.

title: French Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, cut into 1/2-inch thick strips | 4 tablespoons italian salad dressing | 4 teaspoons butter
instructions: Drain fat. Combine italian salad dressing and butter in a small bowl. Brush one side of strips with this mixture. Grill strips 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until browned.

title: Cheese-Stuffed Plantains
ingredients: 20 plantains, cleaned and peeled | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Fill a skillet with oil, enough to cover the Plantains, and heat until very hot. Fry each plantain whole until golden brown, about 1 minute per plantain. Drain on paper towels. Place on a plate, and sprinkle with cheese. Serve warm.

title: Fajitas Dates
ingredients: 1 can pitted dates | 1 cup creole seasoning | 1 dash oregano | 1 dash marjoram | 1/4 - 1/2 cup water
instructions: Dump can of dates into a bowl. Place creole seasoning over a can, dump the can of dates in, add a little water, then toss until it coats the dates. Toss in a dash of oregano and marjoram last because it will add a little depth to the mixture. Dump the creole seasoning onto the dates. Toss with your hands until covered well. Place your hands under water for a few seconds. When you feel able to touch your fingers the creole seasoning will start to get stronger. The more you can touch it with your hands the better, don't worry about having your hands do however. You can even use a plastic bag to form the creole mixture into fajita sized balls. You can form them into small balls or you can use an ice cream scoop to form the mixture. Serve with chips for dipping.

title: Antillean Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared mustard | 1 cup bok choy | 1 can tuna in water, drained | 1 1/4 ounces pepperoni, thinly sliced | 3 cups raspberry-flavored frozen raspberries ( i like to use the juice fresh from a can of italian frozen berries )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mustard, bok choy, tuna, pepperoni and 2/3 of the raspberries.

title: French Breakfast Mousse
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Beat egg white with thyme. Fold egg white into egg yolks. Pour mixture into six 1/2 cup ramekins. Chill until firm. Before serving, turn into sherbet dishes. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Homemade Brisket of Beef
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark raisins or 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1/4 - 1/2 gallon corned beef brisket, well trimmed | 6 lbs boneless chicken, cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Place the raisins and fennel seeds in an airtight container with enough air space to allow the spices to air dry. Reserve a few raisins and fennel seeds for the glaze, the other reserved for the sauce and other uses. Place the corned beef in a large, heavy bottomed crock, or plastic container. Add the dried spices, seal tightly, and add enough water to cover. Allow to marinate for 12 hours or overnight, refrigerated. Remove the brisket from the refrigerator two hours prior to cooking, and bring the meat to room temperature for the glaze.. Cook the brisket, in a large deep fryer or heavy bottomed sauce pan, over medium high heat to cover the bottom with about 7 inches of water. The water should be about 2 inches above the brisket. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to a simmer. Skim off any foam as it rises to the surface. After cooking for about 2 1/2 hours, stir occasionally to keep the brisket from sticking to the bottom by scraping the edges with a wooden spoon, then remove it from the heat. Place the brisket in a roasting pan lined with a double layer of aluminum foil and cover with the foil. Allow to cool to room temperature for about 5 hours before serving. Remove the brisket, then slice across the grain into 1/2 inch thick strips. Return the slices to the pan and drizzle with the glaze to glaze them. Sprinkle with additional fennel seeds if desired.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine)  Substitute and Variation
ingredients: 2 -3 eggplants | 1/4 cup fresh parsley flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Use a knife to slice off any large pieces of eggplant you can see. Trim stem ends and peel off skin. Cut lengthwise into 1/8 slices. Place on prepared sheet. Place on oven rack and bake 20 - 25 minutes or until tender when pricked.

title: Raspberry and Green Bean Saute
ingredients: 1 ounce light soy fyaki | 1/2 teaspoon ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon rice flour | 2 tablespoons light sofrito | 400 g green beans, cut in half ( or other variation ) | 150 g raspberries
