instructions: Combine soy faki with ketchup and rice flour, stir well. Add beans, raspberries and toss to mix.

title: Fennel Sorbet
ingredients: 2 fennel bulbs | 2 ounces triple sec | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Wash fennel bulbs, peel and cut tips and cores away from tips. Using a vegetable peeler, remove tough leaves as much of the outer skin as possible. Trim off the dark yellow core as well. Cut the fennel bulb in half lengthwise with a knife. Roughly chop the fennel and place it in a roasting pan and add triple sec, anise and a little extra water. Roast in the preheated oven for about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,white flour,monterey jack pepper cheese,ice water,yellow pea
title: Beef in Peas - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless lamb shank | 4 cups ice water | 1 package frozen yellow peas or ( 3 ounce ) package peas | 3/4 cup unbleached white flour | 3/4 cup grated monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Prepare salt according to your instructions for your pressure cooker, except for one of the beef shanks. Remove the lamb shank from the fridge about half an hour before beginning to cook. Place the ice water in the pressure cooker pot and stir well so as to leave some chunks in the bottom of the pot. Place your frozen peas into the pot and add the meat on top of the peas in chunks. Place the lid on the pot and bring up to high pressure. This will take about 20 minutes per pound of meat. You will know it is at the correct pressure when the button beeps. When the rock comes to a boil, remove from heat and immediately put the lid on and open lid for about 1 minute. Let steam escape and you will know your pressure cooker is finished. Remove the lid and let the pressure come down under water and then cool down. Remove the meat and reserve the meat and peas in the ice water. Strain the ice water into another pot, and add one spoonful of the unbleached white flour. Slowly add enough of the ice water to make a porridge like consistancy.. Mix together the rest of the cheese and pepper and pour over the meat and peas.

title: Egg Salad With Sizzling Lemon Dressing
ingredients: 2 medium parsnips, peeled and chopped | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 celery leaves, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 container plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 3 teaspoons fennel seed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup mixed salad green
instructions: In a large bowl crumble 1/4 cup of the parsnips and egg into chunks and set aside. In a small saucepan over medium high heat, stir together 2 tablespoons of the dressing ingredients, 1 tablespoon of the dressing will dissolve, and then add 1/4 cup of cold water.

Random Ingredients: tequila,kelp,taco seasoning mix,cumin seed,white wine vinegar
title: Beer Canning III
ingredients: 12 cups beer canning salt | 1 cup dry white wine vinegar | 2 cups taco seasoning mix | 1 cup finely chopped kelp ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds ( optional )
instructions: Fill 12 cups of beer canner with water and start heating. Bring 6 cups of water to a boil. Boil the salt. Mix the salt and water together in a large, non aluminum bowl. Mix taco seasoning with kulep in a separate bowl. Lift the beer canner from the hot water with a slotted spoon and rinse with the salt water. Repeat with the cumin and lime. Place the spices into the bowl of dry ingredients and dissolve. Pour ale canner into canner and stir. Pour the beer canner into the canner, seal, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, cover, and let stand 1 to 2 days, adjusting the water a little as needed. The canner will continue to suck in the beer. Store the canner in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: tortellini,creole seasoning,corn oil,double cream,coffee powder,clementine,vegetable oil,seasoning
title: Creamy Tortellini in Roasted Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 400 g tortellini | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 200 g creamed corn | 1 tablespoon instant coffee powder | 1 tablespoon double cream | 1/4 teaspoon steak seasoning | 1 teaspoon instant coffee powder | 1 cup double cream
instructions: Heat oven to 180oc/160oc. Spray a large baking tray with non stick cooking spray. Place tortellini on the tray, spray, then sprinkle with creole seasoning. Roast for 20 mins, stirring, until golden. Set aside. Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a medium saucepan. When hot, add creamed cream, coffee, cook for 1 minute. Stire in the steak seasoning and instant coffee. Bring to boil, reduce stirring. Add tortellini, toss to combine. Remove from heat, add creamed corn and re season if needed. Stir until the cream comes to bubble, pour into ovenproof dish, then bake in the oven for 15 - 20 mins until the base is golden.

Random Ingredients: margarine,red curry paste,sherry,palm sugar,broccoli,cauliflower floret,hard egg
title: Spiced Vegetables
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 tablespoon red curry paste, or more to taste | 3 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1/2 cup chopped broccoli | 3 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1 cup cauliflower florets
instructions: Combine sherry, red curry paste, sherry, palm sugar and margarine in a small saucepan. Stir over low heat until sugar is dissolved. Bring to a boil and simmer, stirring frequently, until mixture is reduced by half. Remove from heat. Stir in broccoli, eggs and cauliflower. Serve at once.

title: Steak Rolls
ingredients: 600 g beef tenderloin | 4 tablespoons mussels | 2 slices beef medallions | 300 ml vegetable broth | 6 dried sage leaves | 4 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 180. Place the beef on a baking tray, flatten slightly with a meat pounder, insert beef slices into beef rolls and place on a tray containing mussels. Insert a sage leaf into the roll. Combine the broth and tabasco.

title: Puy Lentile
ingredients: 1 lb lentils | 2 ounces sultanas
instructions: Place lentils in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil then cook until soft. Remove from the heat and allow to cool. Place lentils and sultanas in cold water.

title: Brown Rice Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice, uncooked | 2 cups cooked brown rice and 1/4 cup rice flavored non-stick cooking spray | cooking spray ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place brown rice and rice flavored cooking spray in large bowl. Spoon brown rice mixture evenly into four 1 1/4 cup ramekin dishes coated with cooking spray. Bake mixture for 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Baked Clams in Chili Pepper Gravy
ingredients: 3 lbs clams, well scrubbed | 7 chili peppers
instructions: In an ovenproof saucepan, layer the clams, chili peppers and hot sauce. Leave the clams all around for 5 minutes or until bubbling. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Roasted Asparagus With Fresh Toasted Feta and Mint
ingredients: freshly ground sprig | sea salt | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped of fresh mint | 6 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh sage | 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed of stems and blanched
instructions: Season asparagus with salt. Let stand for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in small bowl, combine butter, mint and sage. Strain herb mixture to remove most of the excess as much liquid as possible. Stir in butter mixture and asparagus. Season to taste. Preheat oven to 400°. Spread mint mixture evenly on two large cookie sheets lined with foil. Bake until top is very lightly browned, 6 to 8 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Pear Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can sweet pears | 12 fresh lasagna noodles | 1/8 teaspoon mixed spice | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Peel, core and slice pears into 1/4- inch thick slices. Rinse, then drain the pears with a strainer. Add the pears to a large skillet with a drizzle of olive oil, a few pears at a time for about 5 minutes to make them browned. Sprinkle the parsley over the pears and set aside. Sprinkle both sides of the lasagna with the mixed spice. Sprinkle one sheet of phyllo with a little of the papery papery salt. Cut another sheet of phyllo so it hangs over the edge of the lasagna, but hangs a little higher along the edges of the lasagna. Spread about 5 tbs of the pears to cover the bottom of the lasagna. Layer 6 more sheets of phyllo, brushing each with a little olive oil. Spread the last layer of phyllo with the remaining filling and repeat until you reach the desired amount of noodles. Take the remaining phyllo sheets and lay them on top of each other on top of the pears. Cut slits in the top layer for air to escape and brush with oil. Bake at 375 degrees f for about 25 - 35 minutes, until browned and bubbly.

title: Egyptia's Testosa - Tomato and Almond Salad
ingredients: 10 small tomatoes, sliced thin | 2/3 cup blanched almond
instructions: In an 8 x 8 pan, layer the sliced tomatoes in rows, then the sliced almonds. Sprinkle chopped almonds over the tomatoes in rows. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin,saffron strand,tomato green chile pepper,elbow macaroni,peanut oil
title: Pumpkin Noodle Goulash
ingredients: 1 large pumpkin - peeled, seeded and diced | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 3 -4 saffron strands | 3/4 teaspoon peanut oil | 2 cups uncooked elbow macaroni
instructions: Place diced pumpkin in a microwave safe bowl, add diced tomatoes with chilies and saffron and microwave on high for 4 to 5 minutes, or until the pumpkin is tender. While pumpkin is cooking, bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add macaroni and cook until al dente, drain thoroughly. Serve hot.

title: Grilled Corn Fish Horseradish and Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb red snapper fillet, halved lengthwise, then sliced crosswise 1/4-inch thick | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 8 ounces dry noodles
instructions: Oil grill. Arrange fish skin side down. Sprinkle fish with cornstarch, cumin and horseradish. Arrange fish on hot grill. Cook 3 to 5 minutes, then turn. Brush fish with half and half. Sprinkle with red peppers. Transfer to a platter. Serve with rice pilaf or toasted baguettes.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,beef stew meat,sesame oil,swiss cheese,cake,grain white rice
title: Beef and Cheese With Rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package frozen chesses, cut into 1/4 by 3-inch strips | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, uncooked | 1 package of sliced long grain white rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 package of grated swiss cheese for topping
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook beef and rice for 6 minutes or until beef is browned. Stir in the artichokes and heat through. Pour into a greased 8 x 8 inch baking dish, cover and set aside to keep warm. In a separate pot, bring a large 3 cups water to a boil. Add the chesses and rice.

title: Grilled Chili-Date Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs boneless beef chuck ( cut into 3 to 6 to 8 pieces ) | 1 1/2 ounces tequila ( not recommended, but i use sam adams blackstrap ) | 1 -2 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 teaspoon dried dates ( optional ) | 1 -2 bay leaf | 1/2 cup sweet vermouth ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients, chill for 6 - 8 hours. Grill over hot coals for 30 - 45 minutes or until desired doneness. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: sultana,dill weed,chili pepper flake,meat,tortilla chip,egg,chipotle chile
title: Nando's Chocolate Chip Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground meat | 2 large eggs | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chiles | 3/4 cup sultana, raisins or 3/4 cup other dark raisin | tortilla chips
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly, adding salt and pepper to taste. If necessary, cover and chill for up to an hour. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Mix all ingredients well, making sure that they are well mixed. Transfer to an oven safe pan. Pour the meat mixture on top of the meat. If the mixture is getting too crumbly, cover loosely with foil. Bake 1 hour, or until the top is a dark golden brown. Let stand for 10 minutes. Serve on a plate, sprinkling top of meat with cheese.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,green tomato,gravy,cannellini bean,fenugreek seed,red grape
title: Quick and Easy Chicken & Gravy.
ingredients: 400 g chicken meat ( bone-in or skinless, can be bought at health food stores ) | 2 tablespoons crushed dried fenugreek seeds | 420 g cannellini beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 cup red seedless grapes ( to garnish ) | green tomato ( to garnish ) | mild gravy ( to serve )
instructions: Combine the meat, fenugreek, beans and red grapes in a large roasting tin and drizzle with enough olive oil to just cover the chicken. Spoon over any remaining fat and mix together. Cover the chicken with tin foil and bake for 3 hours at 220 c or until the meat is cooked through. Serve and garnish with tomato.

title: Zucchini in a Baking White
ingredients: 2 zucchini, trimmed | 3 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons active dry yeast | pepper
instructions: Place zucchini on a baking pan. Warm the chicken broth in a small saucepan on top of the zucchini. Dissolve the yeast in the warm broth, and pour into the pan with the zucchini. Cover, and let stand in a warm place for 90 minutes to rise. To use, grease the baking sheet, and preheat for 25 minutes in a microwave oven. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the baking sheet with the zucchini in the oven, and bake at 100% power for 45 minutes or until tender. Cool for 1 minute, and transfer to a food processor. Process for 1 to 2 minutes, or until smooth, adding more broth if necessary. Season with black pepper.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,white bread flour,extra virgin olive oil
title: Ajeen Beckford's Bread Machine Crust (Abm)
ingredients: 8 ounces white bread flour | 2 whole black cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil ( or sunflower oil )
instructions: If you’re looking for bread flour that is just slightly softer than regular whole wheat flour add it now. If not, add more bread flour and/or a teaspoon of water. Follow your manufacturer’s operating instructions on your manual or french bread settings. When the bread machine enters the oven, place the cardamom pods in their pods and lightly grind with a pestle. You do not have to crush the pods with your spoon, but do want to flatten them more and get them higher into the bread. Set the blade to medium and gradually add the olive oil in a steady stream while beating the mixture. When the bread is sufficiently processed but not soupy, transfer the bread to a plastic bag and allow it to cool completely on the counter. If you’re using a wooden paddle attachment, divide the dough into 2 equal portions. Shape each portion into a ball, place it onto a baking sheet, cover with plastic wrap, and allow it to rest at room temperature for 20 minutes. Preheat the griddle to 300°f. If you want to bake this on the stove top, lightly oil your griddle. To test whether the dough has risen, lift the dough out of the bowl onto the hot griddle and place it flat on the parchment covered griddle. When the crust is just set, brush the edge of the crust with a teaspoon of water and sprinkle lightly with flour. If it is a little soft but not sticky, brush it with a teaspoon of olive oil. If it is still sticking, gently press it down with the fork or a metal spatula. If it’s not crisp, you can use a spatula to release the edges. Cook on the griddle/griddle as before, until the crust is golden, about 1 - 2 minutes. Transfer the browned bread onto a tray lined with a clean silicone paper towel or a clean, dry cloth. Allow it to cool completely before lifting it carefully from the mould. Cut into pieces. Serve with honey or jelly and other fresh accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,graham cracker crumb,caster sugar,cooking oat,tabasco sauce
title: Oat Cakes - Cookies (Scottish)
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3 ounces caster sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce, such as lalahiki | 2 ounces cooking rolled oats | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche or 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Mix the graham cracker crumbs, caster sugar and tabasco sauce with the oats in a bowl. Using your hands, roll 2 teaspoons of the mixture into balls or ovals and then press lightly into the graham cracker crumbs to coat. Place onto a baking sheet, and bake for 8 minutes. Remove, allow to cool and refrigerate any remaining treats until firm. Once the oat cakes are cold, roll a little more and cut into squares or smaller shapes. Arrange on a serving plate and drizzle a little creme fraiche or sour cream on top. Makes about 5 oatcakes.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,vanilla extract,pea,orange,cream mushroom soup
title: Easy Pea Pudding II
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 3 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 orange, sliced into thin rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange peas evenly in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place cream of mushroom soup, vanilla extract, and cardamom pods in separate serving dishes. Spoon soup mixture over peas. Sprinkle top with sliced orange slices. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven until bubbly and heated through, about 45 minutes.

title: Nuts Cookies (Cookies)
ingredients: 1 lb unsalted butter ( or margarine, softened ) | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to cream butter, golden syrup and vanilla together. Add sugar and mix well. Roll dough into balls and place on cookie sheets. Bake for about 10 minutes. Cool and enjoy.

title: Chicken and Barley Lasagne
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts ( cut into thin strips ) | 4 carrots, peeled & sliced into sticks ( cut in half ) | 1 -2 parsnip, peeled & cut into sticks | barley | 1 box lasagna noodles
instructions: Start by making the barley barley noodles as per instructions on the barley box. Drain the barley noodles, and set in large mixing bowl with cold water. Dump the barley noodles onto your cold sink & get cold. When cold, put the barley noodles in the cold water with the barley noodles & peel, cut into sticks. Put these all into the large mixing bowl, along with the chicken strips. Chop the carrots, parsnips, & ginger in to small pieces. Put this mixture in the large, lidded tub of a stand mixer with 1/2 of the salt & pepper on your mixer. Once everything is mixed in, turn the mixer and start to mix with the whisk. Keep mixing until the noodles and chicken are well mixed. If you need more salt & pepper, use the teaspoon. The more salt & pepper, the better. Let the pasta and chicken marinate in the fridge before assembling your lasagne. Take the noodles from the refrigerator & set aside in a large bowl,. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Once the oven is ready, put the lasagne noodles on a baking sheet. Pour about 1/4 of the barley barley barley barley barley into each lasagne noodle and spread out to form a flat layer in the pan. Top with approximately 3 lasagne noodles per row, then the carrots, parsnip & ginger with another layer of lasagne noodles and an additional slice of garlic on top. Cook in oven for approximately 30 minutes, until noodles are cooked, bubbly & crisp and garlic is starting to brown, then turn off the oven. Let rest for 15 minutes or to desired crispiness before serving.

title: Applesauce-Ribbon Chicken Soup
ingredients: 3/4 cup applesauce ( preferably heinz applesauce ) | 4 1/2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1/4 cup molasses | 3/4 cup uad dal, split | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 1/4 cup grated orange peel | 1 small radish, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel | 1 -2 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: In a large saucepan combine all the ingredients plus 2 cups water. Bring to a boil and remove from the heat. Let stand 15 minutes. Strain the soup through a sieve or sieve lined with a cheesecloth and discard the solids. Heat broth to boiling and reduce it to about 1 1/2 cups. In a medium bowl combine the sauerkraut and the hot soup.

Random Ingredients: cool whip topping,maraschino cherry,ginger garlic paste,pecan,balsamic vinegar
title: Szechuan Pecan Dip
ingredients: 3 cups cool whip topping | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup pecans, chopped | 1 jar maraschino cherries
instructions: Place all ingredients in large bowl. Mix until smooth. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Serve with crackers, french fries, etc.

title: Sauce With Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb cottage cheese | 3 teaspoons cajun seasoning, blend ( mccormick ) | 1 bouquet garni
instructions: Prepare cajun seasoning mix, blend with cottage cheese. Serve cold.

title: Danish Onion Soup - Kosher Home Brew Version
ingredients: 4 medium spanish onions, peeled and finely chopped ( about 3/4-3/4 large, vidalia ) | 1 cup milk ( or cream, or water ) | 1 teaspoon dry dill weed
instructions: Using a sharp knife, make small slits randomly on the onions to let the juices run back into the bowl.

Random Ingredients: celery,yellow bell pepper,ham hock,garlic,chicken breast,pork loin,liquid smoke
title: Texas-Style Grilled Chicken with Red Pepper BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless chicken breasts, 1 inch thick | 1/4 cup liquid smoke | 1 large yellow bell pepper, quartered | 1/4 cup chicken breast, cut into strips | 1 large chicken breast, cut into strips | 1/3 lb pork loin, cut into strips | 3 teaspoons garlic, crushed
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in large resealable plastic bag. Remove chicken breasts from bag and discard. Place chicken in shallow baking dish and cover with 1/2 cup sauce. Turn to coat thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Prepare grill with moderate coals or use indirect method. Remove chicken from marinade and discard juice. Place chicken, bell pepper, bread, chicken and pork on grill. Brush with remaining sauce. Grill chicken 4 to 5 inches from heat, turning frequently until chicken is cooked through, about 25 minutes.

title: Asafetida Fruit and Yogurt (Dolmades)
ingredients: 2 bunches mixed fresh fruit, washed, peeled and cut into cubes, 1 inch | 1 cup yoghurt, sour | oil ( for deep frying ) | asafoetida powder
instructions: Take out all the fruits. Keep aside. Heat oil in a pan. Drain the fruit. Now, remove any kurdles from the kurdles. Now, dip a handful of kurdles into the yoghurt. Dunk 1 more handful of kurdles into the yoghurt and repeat this procedure till all kurdles are done. Once done, garnish with asafoetida. Serve hot with your favourite curry or satay.

title: Spinach with Dates
ingredients: 2 ounces frozen baby spinach leaves, thawed | 2 ounces dates, halved
instructions: Place spinach and dates in a microwavable bowl. Cover with boiling water and micro heat on high for 3 minutes or until spinach wilts. Drain. Serve immediately.

title: Panir Fry
ingredients: 125 g panir, cubed | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use to marinade sandwiches. Bake in oven at 190c for 5 - 10 minutes. Allow to cool. Can be stored in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: mexican seasoning,bell pepper,onion,pine nut,crostini,bean,pork roast,salt black pepper
title: Pork and Refried Bean Filling for Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb pork roast | 3 tablespoons mexican seasoning | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1/2 cups canned refried beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup crushed pecan nuts or 1 cup chopped walnuts | 1 medium onion, diced into 1 inch cubes | 1 bell peppers or 1 small yellow bell pepper, diced into 1 inch cubes | 1 package crostini or ( 8 ounce ) package any soft bread dough, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place the pork in a large skillet and sprinkle with the seasoning.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,iceberg lettuce,ancho chile,gherkin,black bean,flour tortilla
title: Beef and Garlic Wraps
ingredients: 4 -5 garlic tongs | 1/2 cup finely chopped gherkin | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cups shredded beef stew meat | 1 can of cut and drained gherkins | 1 can ancho chiles or ( 3 ounce ) can pasilla chiles ( 5 ounce ) | 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Wash and pick the garlic.

title: Apple Cider
ingredients: 2 quarts apple cider | 2 teaspoons sourdough starter | 3 cups orange marmalade
instructions: Combine the apple cider and sourdough starter in a large mixing bowl and whisk lightly to make a smooth, thick paste. Add the marmalade and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight for best flavor.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,cocoa powder,vanilla essence,seasoning salt,green apple
title: Apple Salad With Balsamic Vinaigrette-Crujoles (Dip)
ingredients: 4 lbs green apples, peeled and thinly sliced crosswise | 1 1/2 cups balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the cocoa powder in a large bowl. Mix well. Toss apple mixture with cocoa powder until coated. Serve at once or refrigerate up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: veal,tomato green chile,beef bouillon cube,orange marmalade,cumin
title: Veal Tacos
ingredients: 3 boneless veal, cut into strips | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: Heat oil in skillet over medium high heat. Add veal and fry until browned.

title: Radish Phyllo Pastry
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed radishes
instructions: Preheat broiler. Spread phyllo sheets with melted butter. Sprinkle with crushed radishes. Place pastries on a large baking sheet.

title: Minty Cider
ingredients: 2 cups fresh mint leaves | 1 cup hot chicken broth | 1 package apple cider
instructions: In a blender, combine mint leaves and 1 cup hot broth, blend until smooth. Mix in cider. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Turkish Beef Spread
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef chuck | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 ounce dried dill | 1/2 teaspoon chile paste | 1/4 cup toasted walnuts, chopped | 4 tablespoons hummus
instructions: Place chuck in crockpot, cover with water and cook for 6 hours on low. Shred meat with two forks and place back in pot. Add other ingredients and stir to blend. Cover and cook for 15 min. Remove lid and cook for up to 1 hr longer. Serve with toasted pita and warm pita bread. To re heat, heat in microwave for one minute more.

title: Chinese Five-Spice Asparagus
ingredients: 100 g asparagus | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder
instructions: Cut the asparagus into 5 lengths. Grill over hot coals for about 5 minutes, or until crisp tender.

title: Fettuccine
ingredients: 12 ounces fettuccine | oil | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Pour oil in a medium pan. Cook fettuccine in 3 batches until tender and crisp. Drain. Serve with cheese and red pepper sauce.

title: Grilled Chorizo and Date Breakfast
ingredients: 250 g chorizo sausage | 125 g chopped dates | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint
instructions: To make the ground dried dates,. Wash, dry and dry the chorizo. Heat a small frying pan over medium high heat. Add the chorizo and cook for 4 minutes, stirring, or until it starts to brown slightly. Push it to the outside edge of a greased pan. Stir chorizo and dates into the chorizo. Place pan in the middle of the barbeque and brush with milk. Cook to toast the dates and begin to flip, pressing down on them with the back of a spoon, to moisten the bread. Turn to brown the other side. Serve with fresh salsa, fresh bread and mint.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,vinegar,black pepper,picante sauce,lemon twist,black bean,greek yogurt
title: Fantastic Black Bean Salad with Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup reduced fat greek yogurt | 1/4 cup picante sauce ( i use mild-flavoured salsa ) | 1 -2 teaspoon vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 lemon twists, fresh
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients. Pour into a serving bowl. Sprinkle with lemon twists.

title: The Daggoo
ingredients: 1 teaspoon bacon fat ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon olive oil ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon rum ( optional ) | 1 cup oatmeal ( instant or old-fashioned ) or 1 cup quick-cooking oatmeal ( instant or old-fashioned ) | 1 cup watermelon, cut into cubes | cheddar cheese, as garnish
instructions: Place the bacon fat, if using, in a large skillet and warm over medium heat. Add the oats and watermelon and toss to combine. Bring to boil, then simmer over medium heat, stirring frequently, until the water is absorbed. Garnish with cheese before serving.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,french fry,bacon dripping,pita bread,taco seasoning,jalapeno,parmesan cheese,malt vinegar
title: Crispy Baked Fries
ingredients: 1 package frozen french fries, thawed | 2 tablespoons minced canadian bacon | 2 tablespoons canadian bacon drippings, reserved ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon jalapeno, minced | 2 tablespoons low-sodium taco seasoning | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | pita bread, sliced
instructions: Place french fries on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven for 10 minutes, or until crisp. Remove from the oven and set aside. Heat canadian bacon drippings in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in jalapeno. Add taco seasoning and cook 1 minute, then stir in the vinegar and parmesan cheese. Combine hot fries and bacon drippings in a large bowl. Arrange in the oven, sprinkle with parmesan cheese, and bake about 10 minutes, until fries are tender and crisp.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,spanish onion,coconut extract,cinnamon,pot double cream,hamburger
title: Easy Baked Sweet Pot
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 1 package beef-and-hamburger-flavor hamburger roll ( or more if desired ) | sweet potato double cream, to cover ( not too thick ) | coconut extract | cinnamon, to taste
instructions: Saute onion and meat until brown. Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly until meat is warmed through and potatoes are just tender. Serve with crusty or toasted buns.

title: Blueberry Daiquiri
ingredients: 1 package masa harina | 1 glass blueberry wine | 1/3 cup crouton
instructions: Mix the masa harina, curle and croutons in a mixing bowl. Add 2/3 of the blueberries, combine thoroughly. Add rest of the blueberries to taste. Stir vigorously. Refrigerate in the refrigerator overnight to allow the flavors to infuse. Strain before serving.

title: Linguine With Onions & Sour Cream
ingredients: 1/2 lb linguine, broken in half and uncooked | 4 ounces onions, peeled, cut in half, then sliced 1/2-inch thick | 3 ounces white vinegar | 1 1/2 cups dry italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 7 tablespoons low sodium white vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta and cook as directed on package until 'al dente', about 8 minutes. While pasta is cooking, prepare remaining ingredients. Drain pasta and return to pot. Add all ingredients. Drain pasta water. Gently toss. Add drained pasta and mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer mixture into a large baking pan coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle top lightly with salt and pepper.

title: Stoofvlees
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 6 ounces gorgonzola, crumbled | 1 leaf celery, trimmed
instructions: Dice the meat and place in crock, sprinkling with cheese and a bit of celery. Cook on low 6 - 8 hours, till meat is tender adding a bit more cream or water if necessary.

title: Stir Fry Eggs (Eggs)
ingredients: 12 uncooked linguine | 1 1/2 lbs hard-boiled eggs | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat the wok and add some oil and a pinch of salt. Add the egg, and let scramble. Cook until it turns white and begins to scramble. Remove the egg to drain on paper towels and set aside. Add a small amount of oil and cook the egg until it turns slightly translucent. Add the oyster sauce and stir to blend.

title: Filipino Beef and Cabbage (Filipino Beef and Pineapple)
ingredients: 4 medium cabbage, cored | 250 g pork roast or 250 g steak | 125 g mushrooms | 100 g sweet potatoes or 100 g sweet potatoes | 100 g tomatoes puree | 100 g dry coconut, shredded | 30 g marshmallows
instructions: Cut the pork into thin slices and slice thinly. Put pork pieces into a bowl and cover with a lid to keep it moist for 30 to 40 minutes. Do not rinse the pork. After 15 minutes turn it and press it with a spatula to break up the pieces of pork. Do not rinse the mushrooms, unless any. Remove the soft heart from the sweet potatoes and cut into small chunks. Wash cabbage thoroughly under water and drain. Slice into small pieces. Slice the mushrooms into small pieces, and put into a bowl with a lid to keep it moist. Cut the steaks into pieces. In a pot, heat 1 tablespoon of oil for a while then, add the mushrooms and stir fry for about a minute or two. Then add the pork, sweet potatoes, cabbage, coconut and tomato pureée.

title: Hot Cherry Jelly Spread
ingredients: 10 -12 kirsch red peppers or 10 -12 jelly | 1 package dried cherries
instructions: Dry the kirsch and place in a small dish. Put on your frozen cherry puddings or pintos from frozen ones in. Chill for 4 hours. The longer this sets the better. When ready to serve, remove puddings from the freezer and scoop out some of the cherries and place in a bowl, and add cold cherry juice or jelly to cover. Mix, but do not over mix, and then add cold cherry juice or jelly one tablespoon at a time until the mixture has the consistency of mashed potatoes, creamy smooth ice cream, or a sweetened condensed milk based smoothie mix. The consistency of the creamy smoothie mix will change dramatically and will not hold together when the spoon is lifted off.

Random Ingredients: arbol chile,graham cracker crumb,vegetable oil rice,corn,coriander powder
title: Spicy Corn Risotto
ingredients: 1 bunch ear of corn | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon rice oil | 1 teaspoon garlic or 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 2 cups arbol chiles ( dried chilli flakes )
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to a boil. Turn off heat, and add 1 bunch of corn, and let sit and cool for about 10 minutes. Break into smaller pieces and boil them for about 5 more minutes. Keep cooking until corn is cooked through, about 3 more minutes. Heat oil in a pot or skillet over medium low, and add 1/2 teaspoon garlic and 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder. When garlic splutters, add arbol chiles. Cook, stirring regularly, for about 3 minutes. Add rice, a cup at a time, stirring continuously so that it doesn't stick. After a minute, add 4 more cups of water. Bring to a simmer, then turn to low. Cover and cook for 15 more minutes. If it looks creamy, just add a little of the remaining water. Taste for seasoning, add garlic or coriander powder, if desired. If too sour for your taste, leave the lid off for an hour or so more.

title: Chipotle Bacon Wrapped Radishes
ingredients: 6 medium radishes, trimmed | 6 slices crisp bacon, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f. Stack radishes, cut side down, on cookie sheet. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoons salt and 1/2 teaspoon chipotle powder. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes until crisp. Remove and cool. Heat remaining 1/2 tsp salt in medium nonstick skillet over med. Heat, stirring often, 2 minute. Stir in bacon and cook until bacon is crisp and bacon and radishes are crisp tender. Spoon a small amount into paper towel lined small baking dish, patting with spoon or paper towel. Repeat with remaining radishes. Cool slightly. Cut each radish in half lengthwise, cutting thin strips. Wrap each radish tightly with a strip of crisp bacon. Secure with toothpicks and any remaining bacon. Serve warm.

title: Kittencal's Greek Dip
ingredients: 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 2 lemons, juice and zest of
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well using a wooden spoon. Serve with kasseri bread or your favorite breadsticks.

Random Ingredients: topping,fennel bulb,cardamom powder,spinach leaf,grape tomato,liquid smoke
title: Palak Paneer
ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen, chopped spinach leaves | 5 -5 grape tomatoes, washed, de-seeded and sliced | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried fennel bulb, crushed with fork | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | topping ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried cardamom powder
instructions: Place frozen spinach and tomatoes in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cardamom powder and fennel. Add liquid smoke. Mix well. Let the ingredients sit to soften the spinach and tomato. Spoon the mixture onto a serving platter. Top with additional toppings and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,black peppercorn,squash,vanilla,mushroom,chicken breast half,asafoetida powder,italian parsley
title: Soupe Au Pistou
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground whole black peppercorns | 1 tablespoon powdered asafoetida powder | 2 large plum tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla | 3 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into strips | 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms | 1 sprig italian parsley | 1 square piece of store-bought plastic wrap
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the cracked peppercorns and asafoetida powder into a mortar and grind until the spices are evenly soaked in the mixture. Spread the tomatoes over the bottom half of a baking dish and place in the oven. Cook until the tomatoes have softened slightly, about 20 minutes. Turn off the oven. In a medium serving bowl, mix together the mushrooms, parsley, vanilla and chicken strips. Remove the black peppercorns. Stir in the peppercorns and mushrooms. Gently stir in the canned tomatoes. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Unwrap the plastic wrap and wrap the serving plate with a square piece of plastic wrap. Spread sliced plastic wrap with a layer of tomato mixture on top of the plastic wrap. Serve over whole wheat spaghetti with your favorite grain.

title: Sausage With Sauerkraut
ingredients: 12 ounces beef sausages | 2 cups sauerkraut, washed and drained | 1/2 vanilla bean
instructions: Slice sausages diagonally across the width 1/8 of the sausage, removing the casings and fat. Place sausages in a pot and cover with cold water. Heat over low heat and cover to keep warm. Strain sauerkraut and add to pot. Cover and simmer until sausages are cooked and sausages are cooked through, about 30 minutes. Remove bean scrapings from the vanilla and cut vanilla into chunks or shreds with the back of a spoon. Serve on toasted bread, with a good french or italian sandwich.

title: Haitian-Style Chickpeas
ingredients: 3 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup drained bottled sweetened roasted pine nuts | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | chopped of fresh mint ( to garnish ) | 1/4 cup low-fat farina
instructions: Place the chickpeas in a medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,allspice,prosciutto,italian parsley,red chili pepper flake,coffee,ginger,thyme sprig
title: Spiced Roast Feta
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsalted feta cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup minced italian parsley | 2 teaspoons ground ginger | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/4 cup cold coffee | 12 slices prosciutto
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. In a small bowl, combine the feta, parsley, ginger, chili flakes, allspice, thyme, and coffee. Spoon 3 tablespoons of the crumb mixture onto each of six of the slices of prosciutto. Roll up each slice of prosciutto jelly roll style and secure with two toothpicks. Place the rolls on a sheet pan lined with parchment paper. Bake the rolls for 45 minutes, until crispy. Let cool for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,tomato green chilies,oregano,flat leaf parsley,breadcrumb
title: Chile Cheese Fritters
ingredients: 500 g fresh tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup potato starch | 2/3 cup moist breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and mix well. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes. For the fritters, press the mixture into balls the size of a little lemon with your palms. Roll in breadcrumbs and fry in hot oil, approximately 4 - 5 fritters at a time. Drain on absorbent paper and serve.

title: Noble House Sizzlin
ingredients: 12 ounces guinness stout | 2 scallions, chopped | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 2 teaspoons dry sesame oil
instructions: Mix the sesame oil and olive oil together in a large measuring cup. Shake it in a jar with about ¾ cup water and pour it into a small bowl. Add guinness. Shake. Mix thoroughly. Spoon it into a clean bowl. Serve in small cups.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,ginger garlic paste,vanilla ice cream,alfredo sauce,pace picante sauce
title: Olive Garden Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 cans refrigerated spaghetti sauce | 1 jar pace picante sauce | 2 bags vanilla ice cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, stir together the ginger garlic paste and spaghetti sauce. Place half of the spaghetti sauce in a blender and blend until smooth. Pour half of the mixture into the prepared baking dish. Repeat with the remaining half of spaghetti sauce. Spread half of the picante sauce over the top of the alfredo. Cover dish with foil and bake in the oven for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, spread 1/2 the remaining alfredo sauce in the baking dish. Cover dish with foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes. Remove foil and cook for an additional 15 minutes. Cut into squares and serve.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,garlic butter,pork loin,lettuce leaf,leek
title: Italian Grilled Pork
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin | 15 ounces garlic butter, cut into pieces, room temperature | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 8 -10 lettuce leaves, washed ( i like boston soft, but romaine and french ) | 3 leeks, cleaned, sliced, rinsed, and sliced very thin
instructions: First we want to get the grill going for 5 - 10 minutes. First, brush the grill with olive oil. Place the pork on the grill. When the grill is ready, remove the pork from the grill and let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes. Next, prepare the garlic butter by putting a pot of water on the gas stove or charcoal and making sure it has come to a boil. Add the 1/4 1/2 cup of chopped pecorino and let boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Let cool. Slice the pork into 1/4 inch wide slices. Brush olive oil over the pork slices. Sprinkle the 2 pieces of rind on top of the pork. On each sliced piece of pork, spread 2 tablespoons of garlic butter and some freshly crushed pecorino romano. Place one lettuce leaf on each piece of pork and put a slice of leeks on the top of it. Cover with the remaining lettuce leaves.

title: Olive Oil for Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 -10 large fresh rosemary leaves, stems peeled, wiped dry | 8 -10 fresh thyme leaves, stems trimmed, stem trimmed, chopped ( to taste )
instructions: In an electric blender combine the rosemary and thyme leaves. Cover and blend well until the mixture is finely chopped. Use as a rub for sun dried tomatoes.

title: Rooster Catsup

instructions: Place red, green and orange peppers and cream of chicken soup, vinegar, seasoning and cornflour in a large bowl, mix well. title: Almond Coated Waffles
ingredients: 1 can almond paste | 1 tablespoon finely minced lemons, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon yellow cornmeal | 1 cup tomato juice
instructions: Drain and reserve 100 ml of almond paste. In a small bowl mix sugar into the almond paste until the sugar is dissolved. Stir in the lemon juice, zest, cornmeal and tomato juice. title: Quinoa with Dates
ingredients: 12 -15 dried dates | 3 cups water | 2 cups uncooked quinoa | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce ( like tabasco )
instructions: Rinse the dates and pick out the stones. Soak the dates overnight in water. Drain the dates and add to a pressure cooker, along with the quinoa and 1 teaspoon hot sauce. Remove from heat and allow to sit covered for another 10 minutes before releasing the pressure and setting of a timer. Check after 20 minutes. Remove lid, fluff with a fork, and serve hot.

title: Mexican Red Vinegar Dressing

instructions: Place all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Seal with a tight fitting lid. Shake well to combine. Keep refrigerated until use.

title: Beef Birds

Cook and stir the ground sirloin and pearl onions in the hot fat until the meat is brown and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes, breaking it apart with a spoon as it cooks. Reduce heat to medium and cover the skillet. Cook and stir until the meat is no longer pink, 10 to 20 more minutes. Season with salt, place about 1 cup of beef mixture on top of each fried egg and serve immediately.

title: Spice Mix Cookies..for Diabetics
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups plain sweet graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/4 cups tahini | 1 1/4 cups tamarind pulp ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons thai sweet chili paste | 2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Process all ingredients together until smooth, adding more sweetener if desired.

ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 5 tablespoons spicy grill seasoning ( like mccormick beef flavour ) | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 1 1/4 lbs filet of beef | 1 1/4 teaspoons sea salt | 1/2 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon chimichurri chili paste ( aji no choto hari mirch ) | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro

title: Sarasota's Ultimate Brazilian Breakfast Dish

instructions: In a large frying pan fry the bacon pieces in a little bit of oil until done. Drain. Add the chicken stock and eggs to the frying pan and cook until it thickens. Add the chopped dill and the salsa and cook for 2 minutes. Pour into bowls and enjoy.

title: Italian Herb Salad Dressing
ingredients: 8 ounces italian salad dressing mix | 1 ounce dried italian herb ( mixed dried herbs or rosemary, crushed )
instructions: In a large bowl combine salad dressing mix and herbs. Pour dressing over salad and stir to coat. Chill until ready to serve.

Beat with a hand whisk or electric beater for 5 minutes until mixture is well combined. Spoon a heaped tsp of the mix onto greased and floured tray and press into 1 2cm thick. If using oven trays, pop muffins in and bake for about 40 for 25 mins until well risen and lightly golden on top about.

title: Kathy O'Callaghan's Mint Patty Melt
ingredients: 4 slices white bread, about 1/2 inch thick | 1 1/2 cups prepared liquid smoke, such as spicy marinade ( such as mccormick's ) | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 2 tablespoons minced fresh mint | 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 graham cracker crust ( recipe id # 24375 )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lightly oil a 1 1/4 quart baking dish. Cut the bread into 3/4 inch squares and set aside. In a small bowl, mix the liquid smoke, garlic, mint, and soy sauce until combined. Add the bread to the liquid smoke mixture and toss to coat. Spread bread onto the lightly oiled crust in the prepared baking dish. Smooth top of crust with a spatula and bake until bread is golden, about 20 minutes. Remove pan from the oven and allow bread to cool for about 5 minutes. Place baking dish on a serving plate and top bread with mint mixture.

title: Lime and Pecorino Pecorino Grated
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh lemon juice, to taste | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Mix half of the pecorino cheese with the lemon juice, if using it. Add more lemon juice to taste if not using. Pour about a 1/2 teaspoon at a time of the olive oil on a clean, dry dish towel. Pat the pecorino cheese dry with paper towels. Tightly roll the cheese with the palms of your hands or the towel tightly. Tightly wrap the cheese again with the towel and set aside. Place the remaining 1/2 cup pecorino cheese on your dinner plate and wrap the ball of pecorino cheese around it to make a packet. If you prefer, pinch the cheese into individual pieces using your thumb and forefinger. This can be done at any time in advance the cheese can be kept in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks after preparation and up to 2 months later. You can also wrap the cheese packet with waxed paper and use in salad or as a grill item when you grill. Serve with a lime wedge.

ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 3 3 cm cubes | 3 sheets bamboo skewers | 2 teaspoons of grated fresh romano cheese ( may use parmesan or asiago ) | 2 cups self raising flour | 1 cup plain flour | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/2 cup firm tofu ( optional ) | 2 cups shredded cabbage
instructions: To make the filling. Place the pork in a large bowl with all the other ingredients. Mix well to combine, season to taste and refrigerate for 1 hour or until thoroughly chilled. Add the cheeses to the frying pan you have set aside. Add a little more oil to the frying pan if needed, then cook the mushrooms and shitake mushrooms, stirring, until they release their liquid. title: Scallops on the Half Shell With Smoked White Wine

instructions: Pour the wine into a large pan, add the sugar and simmer until reduced by half. Remove the scallops from the shells and gently push the shell into the liquid. Wipe out the sauce and discard. Season to taste the smoked scallops are placed in a single layer in a pan and pour over the reduced liquid. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the fish is cooked. Scrape away the scallops from the pan and set aside. Add the rice to the liquid in the pan, stir well and cook over a high heat for a couple of minutes until well coated. Add the chicken stock, bring to the boil, cover and simmer for around 20 minutes, or until the stock has been absorbed. Place the scallops on to a platter and arrange over the rice. Cover with foil and cook in a preheated 350f oven for 20 minutes, or until the scallops are thoroughly cooked and the rice is tender.

title: Healthy Beef Bake

instructions: Remove fat from lamb and cut into small chunks or strips. Mix flour, sour cream and salad dressing/salad dressing and place lamb in a plastic bag. title: Karaage-Japanese Sweet Ramen

instructions: Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Add dashi and cook until water turns milky white. While the dashi is cooking, preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the cherry halves into a small bowl. Pour the hot water into a baking dish to cool. When the dashi has become milky, pour the liquid into the bowl with the almonds and cherries and stir. Pour almonds and cherry onto a small plate and serve.

title: Roasted Green Cabbage With Escarole and Cauliflower

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Place cauliflower in large casserole dish with enough boiling water to cover. Simmer for 20 minutes, then drain. Cut the heads into small pieces. instructions: Stir stock and coconut in a heavy 4 - 5 qt. Saucepan over medium low heat. Increase heat to medium and simmer gently. title: Chickpea Burgers
ingredients: 3 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 celery ribs, diced | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon baileys irish cream
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the chickpeas, oregano and celery. Toss with the barbecue sauce and set aside to macerate for about an hour. Drain the chickpeas well and coarsely mash with a potato masher or wooden spoon. Stir in the yogurt, cilantro, chipotle powder and baileys. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Roasted Yellow Pepper and Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 large yellow sweet peppers ( capsicum ) | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon fresh garlic, minced | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat broiler. Remove and discard papery outer skin and top 3/4 cup of onions. Pierce the skin with a very sharp knife. Place them on a baking paper lined baking sheet. Roast under the oven's broiler, turning every 5 minutes by rotating the peppers. Turn often so the skins can darken. When the skins begin to darken on all sides, remove from the oven. Set them aside and let cool off in a dry place. Roast in a medium hot oven, stirring occasionally until they have roasted an even color, about 20 - 25 minutes. While the onions are still warm, rub the skins off the peppers with your hands. Do not let them touch the skin while they are roasting. Place in a medium size mixing bowl. Add the onion soup mix and garlic. Mix well. Sprinkle the pepper skin onto the mixture. Sprinkle about 1/2 teaspoon of kosher salt over the pepper. Wash hands thoroughly. Set aside. To roast, heat the oven's broiler. Put the top 3/4 cup of onions in a large roasting pan, skin side up. Sprinkle the top with 1/2 teaspoon of kosher salt. Place the pan, skin side down, under the preheated oven's broiler. Broil the onions, skin side up, until the skins are charred and beginning to blacken, 12 - 15 minutes. Immediately place the pan under the broiler for 5 - 10 minutes. Turn the pan over. Roast for 10 - 15 minutes more or until the skins are charred and the onions are browned on top. Remove from the oven and let cool off. Use a sharp knife and knife to slit them open and remove the seeds. Use a fork to scrape the onion from the skins, removing the skin and all of the green inside. Gently open the skins and squeeze out the excess juice.

title: Red Bell Pepper Stuffed Bell Peppers

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f remove tops and bell peppers from peppers. Scoop out the pulp and seeds from the peppers with a spoon. Combine the pulp with the enchilada sauce and lemon extract and fill the peppers with the sauce. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until tender. Garnish with prunes.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,nutmeg,poblano chile,white wine,anchovy oil,chili powder,oyster sauce,cayenne pepper
title: Spicy African Peppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 pinch ground cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon white wine | 2 poblano chiles ( or a red pepper ), thinly sliced | 1 -2 teaspoon anchovies packed in oil
instructions: Combine oyster sauce, peanut butter, chili powder, nutmeg, cayenne pepper, wine, poblano chilies and anchovies in a medium frying pan over medium heat. Heat until hot, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Sauce for Zucchini and Shredded Swiss Steak
ingredients: 3 zucchini | 3 cups tomato sauce, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Cut zucchini diagonally into 1/4 inch slices, and arrange them on the hot grate. Sprinkle shredded zucchini with salt, and continue to grill zucchini until the zucchini are tender and lightly browned on the bottom, and the cheese is golden brown, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,white wine vinegar,red wine,thai chili sauce
title: Thai Chili Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons thai chili sauce | 2 teaspoons minced fresh cilantro, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix red wine vinegar, white wine vinegar, hot pepper sauce, chile sauce, and cilantro together in the top bowl of a blender.

title: Rice Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 lb spareribs, cut into 4 pieces each | 1 cup rice noodles | spareribs, cut in 4 pieces each | 3 cardamom seeds
instructions: Wash the spare ribs well. Rinse them and put them in a bowl, pour in 1 pint of hot water and leave them overnight. Pour in 2 tablespoons of sparerib water and cover them. Refrigerate for about 4 hours. In a heavy based pan, bring the 6 quarts of water to a boil. Meanwhile, rinse the noodles very well under cold water, put them into a colander and drain them thoroughly. Drop the spareribs into the boiling water, stir, add the noodles, and cook them for about 4 minutes. The noodles should just be beginning to soften but still have a little bite to them. Do not stir them into much of the soup. If they are, continue to stir for a few minutes, then turn them back into the boiling water. Stir well. Bring the stock back to a boil. Add the ribs and bring to the boil. Cover and cook for about 5 minutes. Add the cardamom seeds, then remove cover and cook, stirring, for a further 5 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,lite peach,white sugar,shell pasta,lime juice,tilapia fillet,crabmeat
title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 packages frozen shell pasta ( or any small pasta shape ) | 3/4 cup fresh lime juice | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon fish sauce ( optional ) | 1 pound tilapia fillets, chopped | 1 can lite peach slices
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook shell pasta in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,picante sauce,sage leaf,baby corn,clear honey,masala
title: Tex Mex Corn and Salsa
ingredients: 6 baby corn, on the cob, husked | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/3 cup salsa | 1/4 cup dried texmati masala | 1 teaspoon sage leaves | 1 teaspoon clear honey
instructions: Combine tomato and chili powders in small bowl. Let stand for 5 minutes. In a skillet, cook corn, tomatoe and their liquid, and chilis on high heat 15 minutes or until corn is tender. Drain. Stir into tomato mixture. Add rice and gently stir to coat. Add the sage. Sprinkle with honey. Stir to mix. Cook 5 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes. Note, add water as needed to ensure mixture doesn't dry out.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,rom tomato,creole seasoning,simple syrup,white bread flour,gingerroot,vermouth,beef broth
title: The Classic American Onion Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs thinly sliced white bread flour | 3 tablespoons finely grated fresh gingerroot | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 4 cups beef broth | 1 tablespoon dry vermouth | 4 roma tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1 medium orange, coarsely chopped | 1 can diced roma tomatoes, packed in water, drained
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the flour, ginger, creole seasoning and bread until they are well incorporated. Add the broth, vermouth and tomatoes and stir. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, preheat the broiler. Ladle soup into oven proof soup bowls, place the tomatoes in a single layer in a large baking pan, and top with the orange and roma tomatoes. Cover the tomatoes with clean boiling water to cover the tomatoes, then place under the broiler and broil until the soup is bubbling, about 10 minutes. Remove from the broiler and ladle the soup into warm bowls. Serve hot. Note, the soup can be made several hours ahead the soup and chilled, tightly covered. You can serve right before serving, just cover and refrigerate. The soup can last for 3 days to 4 days.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,malibu rum,dark chocolate,key lime juice
title: Frog Eye
ingredients: 1 kg dark chocolate | 1 can chopped sundried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 fresh key limes, juice of | 1/2 cup malibu rum ( optional )
instructions: Finely chop the semi dried tomatoes. Heat the dark chocolate in a bowl over gently boiling water, add the sundried tomatoes and half the lime juice. Mix well. Remove from heat, allow to cool to room temperature and then chill until set, then break up the cooled chocolate chunks and add to the chocolate mixture. Stir well to combine, remove the remaining lime juice and pour into a mould which has been lined with greaseproof paper. Refrigerate the mixture for several hours or overnight to set. When ready to serve, remove from the mould and remove the paper. Garnish with extra whipped cream and cherry to serve.

title: Tre's Easy Creamy Indian Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 piece fresh gingerroot, sliced | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Stir cream soup and ginger together in a large soup bowl. Return soup mixture to pan, and season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: coriander,pork butt,fennel seed,beef rib,canadian bacon,oat,chili pepper flake
title: Homemade Molasses Smoked Oats With Canadian Bacon and Chiles
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon, diced | 12 ounces pork butt, diced, 1-inch | 1 lb beef rib, diced ( i use rib meat and pork ribs ) | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | salt & fresh chili pepper flakes, to taste | 3 tablespoons canadian bacon drippings or 3 tablespoons smokey bacon drippings, for smoke and flavor | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional )
instructions: In a large non stick skillet, add 1/2 pound cooked pork butt, 1/2 lb pork ribs, 1/2 cup Canadian bacon and 1/2 cup beef rib. Toss to combine. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon salt and chili flakes on top. Cook over medium temperature until heated through, stirring occasionaly until salt is caramelized on the ribs. Remove from heat and place in a clean skillet. Add the remaining 1/2 pound of cooked pork butt to the skillet, coating evenly with the caramelized liquid from the skillet. Cook, stirring, over medium heat until liquid is absorbed. Place into a clean nonstick skillet. Combine 1/2 cup Canadian bacon drippings or smokey drippings, the fennel seed and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a small bowl. Sprinkle over the mixture. Close skillet and cook over very low heat until mixture begins to bubble, stirring occasionally. Cook until mixture is well incorporated. Spread this mixture on toasted bread. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,baking soda,lettuce leaf,watermelon,dark brown sugar,dark sesame oil,pancetta
title: The Greatest Salad Dressing Ever
ingredients: 3/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup pancetta, finely diced | 1 tablespoon watermelon, finely diced | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, diced ( or sesame seed ) | 1/3 cup dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 4 large lettuce leaves, mixed and shredded
instructions: Put sugar, pancetta, watermelon, sun dried tomatoes and sesame oil in a blender or food processor. Blend on high until well mixed. Pour in the baking soda and process again for one more minute. Store in the fridge until ready to use, about a week. Pour over greens right before serving, toss lightly and sprinkle with sesame seeds to get a wonderful glaze.

title: Tomats in Agave (Guatemalan Mushroom Candy)
ingredients: 1 lb mushroom ( button, crimini ) | 3 ounces golden tequila | 2 large plum tomatoes | 1/2 vanilla bean
instructions: Boil the mushrooms for 5 minutes. Drain well and mash the mushrooms with the crushed vanilla bean and tequila. Pour into a well buttered 9 inch round baking tin and leave a one inch to form a crust. Sprinkle the surface with icing sugar and bake at 300 degrees f. For about forty minutes, until light brown. Cool, cut into squares and leave to set. Can be sprinkled with extra agave.

title: Pork and Broccoli Fried With Coconut
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 10 ounces frozen broccoli | 3/4 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the pork and broccoli in a large saucepan with water to cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, until the meat and veggies are tender, about 45 minutes. Drain any remaining water. Transfer the meat to a bowl and mash it. Return the broth to a boil and cook, stirring, until thickened, 2 to 3 minutes longer. Transfer the pork and broccoli to a large colander and press down hard on it between your hands to remove any stray pieces of meat. Discard the broccoli. Dip each piece of meat in the flour, then coat well with the peanuts. Set aside to marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours, or overnight. Heat an 8 to 12 inch nonstick skillet on high heat until a cube of bread dropped into it sizzles, browns quickly and immediately. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the cooked pork and broccoli to the skillet and fry, turning once or twice, until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from the skillet.

Random Ingredients: head iceberg lettuce,cilantro,ketchup,lime zest,lemon juice zest,monterey jack cheese,picante sauce
title: Quick and Easy Mexican Restaurant Style Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds fresh curly-leaf lettuce, outer leaves removed | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 ounces ketchup | 2 ounces lemon juice, or as needed | 1 lime, zest of | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 ounce fresh cilantro, chopped ( optional ) | 2 ounces monterey jack cheese, chopped into bite-sized cubes
instructions: Tear the curly end off the lettuce.

title: Plant Fritters
ingredients: 3 plums ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup canola oil | 4 taco shells | 1 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Bake plums in 350 degree oven for 5 minutes to soften plums and then remove pit. Scoop out plums and put them in ice water to stop thawing the skin. Remove plums from bowl and place on plate. Bring canola oil to high in large skillet and heat on stove top until a cube forms. Drop patties into the hot oil a few at a time for two to three minutes before turning over. Drain. Sprinkle patties with almond extract if using. Serve immediately as fritters and/or taco shells.

Random Ingredients: spice,chili pepper flake,green curry paste,cider vinegar,chicken stock,oatmeal,yellow mustard
title: Green Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon green curry paste ( or hot, to your taste ) | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon hot chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon chicken stock | 1/2 cup oatmeal | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized pan. Stir to coat evenly.

Random Ingredients: turkey broth,cooking sherry,phyllo pastry,chicken breast half,asparagus,raisin
title: Chicken Phyllo with Asparagus, Raisins, and Turkey
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 pound fresh asparagus | 1/2 cup raisins | 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 cup quick-cooking sherry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken breasts in a large skillet, and pour in enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer until the chicken is no longer pink, about 15 minutes. Add asparagus and raisins, and continue cooking until the asparagus is tender, about 4 minutes more. Remove from heat, and set aside. Cut the phyllo pastry into 3 long squares. Arrange one square on a work surface, and brush with cooking sherry. Fold pastry over the filling, and crimp edges with a fork. Cut a slit in the top of each square to create an open pocket. Spoon about 1/2 spoonful of stuffing into each pocket. Close the dough pocket over and pinch closed. Transfer the stuffed pastry triangles onto a baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

title: Spicy Green Chili Dogs
ingredients: 500 g green chili peppers | breadcrumbs | oil or cooking spray
instructions: Place the green chili peppers in a plastic bag with a cup or plain yogurt and crush with a rolling pin. Place in a deep microwave safe dish and add a bit of water to cover. Cook on high for 2 - 3 minutes and then drain off any extra water. Turn off the microwave, leave it in, leave the oven on for 2 - 3 minutes until soft, drain, return to the dish and dry out slightly. Roll the chili dogs in breadcrumbs, coating fully. Spray a frypan with oil or spray with a little oil and fry the green chili dogs until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Serve with salad or french fries.

Random Ingredients: broiler fryer chicken,corn,chicken sausage,hot chili pepper,snow pea,guava
title: Chicken and Sausage With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, quartered | 1 lb fresh mushrooms | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can corn | 1 lb fresh guava, sliced thinly | 1 small hot chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f place chicken and mushrooms in an ovenproof casserole dish that is large enough to hold both the chicken and mushrooms. In a bowl combine cream of mushroom soup, corn, guava, chili and chicken. Pour over chicken mixture. Coat the chicken pieces with cooking spray. Cover and bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Remove chicken and mushrooms to a serving platter and loosely cover with foil until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: turkey,red apple,orange juice zest,parsnip,lettuce,baking powder,roast beef,cream chicken soup
title: Roast Beef & Parsnip Bundt Cake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orange juice ( or juice from zest of 1 orange ) | 3 tablespoons sour cream ( reduced fat ) | 1 tablespoon low-fat cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 200 g roast beef, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup parsnip, thinly sliced | 1 red apple, thinly sliced | lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 140c. Grease a 25cm bundt cake or a deep round one, with oil or cooking spray. Combine all ingredients except the last 2 tablespoons of sour cream, cream of chicken soup, and baking powder in a medium bowl. Add the beef and parsnip and mix well to combine. Scatter the apple slices over the base of the baking tin, and then add the beef/parsnip mixture. Top with the reserved 2 tablespoons of sour cream and bake for 50 - 60 minutes, or until the top is golden and the cake is cooked. Remove from oven and set aside. When completely cooled, drizzle a little olive oil over the warm cake and serve on a platter.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,hot italian sausage,lemon zest
title: Sausage in Lemon Cream
ingredients: 1/2 small red hot italian sausage or 1/2 small other spicy flavoured sausage | 1/4 medium lemon, zest of, freshly grated | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh red chili pepper or 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh chile ( i use dried red chile )
instructions: Place the sausage in a frying pan with a lid placed on medium heat or a griddle, turning the heat to high. When the sausage has begun to color, sprinkle with the freshly grated zest and hot pepper. The chile is quite hot, so don't let it burn. When the sausage begins to char, about 3 - 5 minutes, stir, cover and turn the heat down to very low. Stir in the lemon zest and chile, and leave for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring periodically. Leave the cover off for the final 5 mintues or longer if needed,. Serve immediately, or refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: paprika,italian salad dressing mix,horseradish,artichoke heart,caper,tilapia fillet
title: Grill-Grilled Tilapia With Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts | 4 ounces horseradish | 8 ounces italian salad dressing mix | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 lb tilapia fillet
instructions: Preheat grill on medium high heat with rack in middle. Combine first 4 ingredients and set aside. Brush grill with oil and grill tilapia 8 to 10 minutes. Remove and discard brush. Brush with more oil, sprinkle paprika on and then drizzle with remaining horseradish sauce.

Random Ingredients: shallot,cooking oil,lemon juice,knorr vegetable soup mix
title: Lemon Thyme-Mustard Sauce for Pastrami
ingredients: 1 package knorr vegetable soup mix ( knorr is good ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/4 cup chopped shallot | 1/4 cup lemon juice
instructions: Prepare soup mix according to package. Cook, oil and shallots until shallots are just crisp tender and starting to brown, drain off the oil. Add soup mix and lemon juice to skillet. Heat through. Serve over pastrami slices.

title: Apple Stuffing
ingredients: 4 medium granny smith apples | celery rib, to garnish
instructions: Peel, core & mince the apples. Combine them with granny smith in a bowl. Pour the apples mixture on to a shallow tray lined with foil. Bake at 200c for 30 minutes.

title: Angel Hair Pasta
ingredients: 500 g angel hair pasta | 400 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling water to al dente. While you are waiting, lightly fry the sun dried tomatoes in a separate pan with a dash of olive oil over a low heat. Drain and combine with the fried sun dried tomatoes. Serve with some parmesan cheese on top.

title: Nacho Cheese Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken meat, cubed | 2 ounces queso fresco | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Place the chicken in a large bowl with the cheese, pepper and fennel seed. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Drain the meat. Thread meat onto wooden skewers. Place on skewers that have been sprayed with oil. If desired, grill for 10 - 15 minutes per side or until the outside is brown. Serve with salsa fresca or pico de gallo or sour cream.

title: Pesto-Filled Potato Squares
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable oil for frying | 1 pound potatoes, peeled and shredded | 1/4 cup dry-roasted cashews | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 3 tablespoons potato starch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place potato shreds in a large bowl of cold water until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain the potato shreds using a cheese grater, or the side of a ricer. Transfer potato shreds to another large bowl, and set aside. Stir cashews, cheese, and parmesan cheese together in a skillet over medium heat until the cheese melts, and the cashews are crisp. Transfer the potato shreds to the potato bowl, and toss to coat. Drain off excess water. Stir in the potato starch until smooth, and transfer to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,chive,green chilies,dark sesame oil,jalapeno pepper,corn oil
title: Roasted Sesame Oil Condiment
ingredients: 1/4 cup corn oil | 3 tablespoons dry sherry or 3 tablespoons rice wine | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 4 -6 tablespoons minced fresh chives | 8 -10 small thin green chilies
instructions: First roast chilies, then heat the oil so it will spread evenly, put in the chilies, sesame oil and stir fry. Put back in pan, and simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the chives, green chilies and dry sherry. Note, if you have to use extra sesame oil, you can use regular sesame oil, which will increase the taste of the condiment.

title: Champagne and Chilli Jam
ingredients: 100 ml sweet chili sauce | 100 ml honey mustard or 100 ml grain mustard | 75 ml mirin
instructions: Pour into sterilised jars and seal. Keep in a cool, dark place. To make the jam, combine all jam ingredients in a small saucepan. Stir over a low heat until the sugar dissolves and the jam thickens. Keep warm over a low heat while you prepare the jelly. Pour boiling water over some clean hot water, and run a knife around the rim of the jar to release steam. Leave in the heat for 10 minutes, then remove the lid, and leave for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, remove the lid, and stir well. Put a serving plate on top, and invert the jam onto the plate. Leave for 5 minutes to cool. Store the jam in an airtight glass jar in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,splenda granular,garlic powder,pineapple juice,asparagus spear,okra
title: Spicy Pineapple & Okra Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh pineapple juice | 1 3/4 cups frozen okra, thawed and halved | 1 can sliced poblano chiles, drained | 5 -6 asparagus spears, halved lengthwise and cut into 2-inch lengths | 2 tablespoons splenda granular, sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, toss to coat. Cover and chill until serving.

title: Cashew and Chilli Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch shiitake bok choy | 7 -8 fresh chilies, sliced diagonally | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted finely
instructions: Cut the sprouts into thin strips. Grind the cashews with a mortar and pestle or in a food processor till they are the texture of rice grains. Arrange over a bed of greens, scatter over the chillies and scatter over the cashews.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,half,lemon pepper seasoning,sea salt,bok choy,anaheim chile pepper
title: Pinto Beans and Green Chilies
ingredients: 1 pound dry pinto beans | 2 large lemons, juiced | 1 pound fresh bok choy, chopped | 1 pound anaheim chile peppers, seeded and diced | 2 tablespoons sea salt | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper seasoning
instructions: Sort through the pinto beans and remove any stones. Rinse. Place in a large slow cooker, and add enough water just to cover. If water has boiled to cover, stir in the lemon juice. Cover, and cook on high until beans are tender, about 4 hours. Add more water as needed while cooking if necessary. Drain the beans, and set aside. Place bok choy, anaheim chilies, sea salt, and lemon pepper seasoning in a large serving bowl. Stir to blend, and leave just before serving.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,fennel,mozzarella cheese,green onion,grain white rice,lamb backstraps
title: Quick Lamb Stuffed Rice
ingredients: 12 lamb backstraps ( or similar type of meaty backstraps ) | 2 cups long grain white rice | 3 green onions, finely chopped | 50 g of shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/3 cup oatmeal ( regular or gluten free ) | 1/4 teaspoon fennel | roasted fennel ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a grill pan on medium high heat. Place the lambstraps in a foil lined shallow roasting tin, or equivalent. To make the rice, place the rice with water, and cover completely with a microwave proof plate and cook on high for 8 minutes. Turn the heat down to medium and cook, covered, for an extra 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place the green onions and mozzarella cheese in a small salad bowl. Drain any excess liquid from the rice and place it in the bowl. Preheat a grill pan on high heat and spray with olive oil cooking spray. Cook the lamb, lamb and onions for 5 - 5 minutes each side, depending on the thickness of the meat, until the meat is cooked through. Add the oatmeal and fennel and gently stir to combine. Stir in the rice and top with roasted fennel and additional mozzarella cheese. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: oil,pear,white creme de cacao,cognac,manicotti,coffee,corn syrup,rice flour
title: Manicotti With Cappuccino
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour | 1 cup corn syrup | 2 tablespoons cognac | 4 tablespoons blended steamed coffee | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 cup manicotti | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/4 cup white creme de cacao or 1/4 cup orange liqueur | 1 cup pear, diced
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the rice flour, corn syrup, cognac, steamed coffee, 2 tblsp. Of oil and the blended steamed manicotti. Set oven to 325°f. Wrap the remaining dough around each manicotti. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake for 40 mins, turning every 15 minutes. Keep an eye on the bread to be sure it doesn't burn turn off and keep warm. In a medium saucepan, heat the remainder of the oil until just starting to shimmer on the edges. Add the creme de cacao and drippings and simmer for 3 - 4 mins, until the sauce darkens slightly. Add the pear and stir to combine. Pour over warm noodles and serve.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1/2 lb sun-dried tomato, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon anise seed, crushed or 1 tablespoon anise liqueur, like | 1 lb frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a small bowl, combine all ingredients, except for phyllo. Lay a sheet of phyllo on a lightly floured board. Lightly flour the top sheet, lightly dust with remaining flour, and gently but quickly roll into a long rectangle.
