instructions: Combine berries and soymilk and chill for about an hour. Sift flour and rice together. Mixture should resemble coarse crumbs. Place rattle and amaretto in a small pot on low, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon to avoid any clumps. When mixture becomes dry and becomes slightly thick, add berries, if using.

title: Crunchy Pouches on the Barbie
ingredients: 20 -25 lettuce | 12 -15 cherry tomatoes | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup greek salad dressing | 1 tablespoon honey | 0.5 packet plain doritos | 3 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Wash, pat dry, cut top off each cherry then arrange on top of a lettuce leaf. Wash the jar from the shrimp/doritos and place on top of the lettuce. Stir the honey all over the salad making sure everything gets coated. Next, sprinkle the catsup over the cherries. Put small amount of the crushed doritos in, shake around the bottom of the jar. Pour catsup over the cherry tomatoes. You could also use honey and catsup instead if you don't have the desired results. If using honey instead of catsup, just put it in a small, shallow bowl or bowl. Sprinkle with the sugar. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,pinto bean,sage leaf,apple cider,chili oil,plum tomato
title: Auberge Baked Beans
ingredients: 4 cups pinto beans, washed and picked over | 1 apple cider | 6 plum tomatoes, peeled, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup peanut butter ( full fat preferred ) | 1 tablespoon of fresh sage leaves, finely chopped ( or 2 tsp crumbled dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil ( or other vegetable oil )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f/150c/gas put the beans in a large bowl, pour over enough cold water to come halfway up the beans and allow to soak overnight. If you have a large roasting tin, put a couple of ovenproof ramekins or cake tins on your tray and add the beans. Pour the cider into the tin and add a little water to come half way up the sides of the ramekins. Turn the heat on to medium and stir in the tomatoes, peanut butter, sage and chili and oil. If you need to, put the beans into an ovenproof dish and fill with plenty of boiling water. When the water starts to boil, stir the beans to dislodge any bits of food that may have stuck to the sides. The liquid will gradually bubble up. Bake, covered, for 25 mins until beans are tender and the liquid has reduced and absorbed.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,marinara sauce,chili garlic sauce,ice water,colby monterey jack cheese,pecorino romano cheese,baking soda
title: Caesar-Style Grilled Cheese on a Stick
ingredients: 12 -14 wooden sticks ( like tennis picks ) | 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese ( about 1/2 lb. ) | 1 cup dry-roasted pecorino romano cheese or 1 cup asiago cheese, and or 1 cup asiago, grated ( about 1/4 lb. ) | 1 1/4 cups bottled chili-garlic sauce, such as < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/garlic-chili-garlic-sauce-39217 '' > garlic sauce < /a > | 3/4 cup golden raisin | 1 cup bottled marinara sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda or 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | ice water, as needed
instructions: Cut the sticks in half lengthwise. Soak the sticks in water in a bowl, cover and refrigerate for about 20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed. Meanwhile, preheat the grill for high heat. If you have an outdoor grill, make sure to wear nonstick aluminum foil in place of the wood sticks when grilling. Combine cheeses, raisins, and sauce in a large bowl. Dip sticks, one at a time, into the cheese mixture, coating both sides of each. Lightly oil grate. Place kebobs on hot grill, close lid, and grill for 3 minutes on each side. Serve hot with warm marinara, garlic or chili garlic sauce.

Random Ingredients: miso,pineapple,yellow squash,zucchini,kaffir lime leaf,pecorino romano cheese,plain flour,thyme sprig
title: Pasta Primavera (Zucchini Chips, Pasta Primavera)
ingredients: 4 zucchini, halved lengthways and cut crossways into 2. 5 cm thick slices | 1 yellow squash, halved lengthways and cut crossways into 2. 5 cm thick slices | 4 kaffir lime leaves, torn | 4 fresh thyme sprigs | plain flour | 2 teaspoons miso | 1/3 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 600 g dried prawns or 600 g red snapper fillets, roughly chopped
instructions: Set the oven to 200c/180c fan/gas for the chips, put the zucchini, yellow squash, kaffir lime leaves, thyme sprigs and cheese in a baking dish. To make the primavera,. Sprinkle flour, miso and some seasoning over the zucchini mixture. Toss the mixture to coat. Add the prawns and mix. Pour the mixture over the chips and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the primavera has thickened slightly and the prawns are opaque throughout.

title: Pesto (Aioli with Ham)
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes crumbs | 1 cup ham, cooked cubed ( cold ) | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic, fresh crushed
instructions: Dump ham and garlic into food processor and pulse until combined. Roll pesto into balls and roll in crumbs to coat. Freeze on cookie sheet and bake in a 450 degree oven about 20 minutes, depending on thickness of ham.

title: Frijoles Borrachitos (Pinto Beans)
ingredients: 8 cups cooked pinto beans, undrained | freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Mix the pinto beans, black pepper, and salt in a blender. Process until smooth, about 30 seconds. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: prawn,tilapia fillet,tomato sauce herb,turmeric powder,red wine vinegar,heirloom tomato,marjoram,red wine
title: Indian Beef and Tomatoes With Spicy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces tilapia fillets | 14 ounces can of heirloom tomatoes | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons red wine | 14 ounces can tomato sauce with herbs | 2 red heirloom tomatoes | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Drain the tomatoes, and dice the flesh into small chunks. Dice the tomatoes into small pieces, add, stir in the red wine, tomato sauce, and marjoram. Heat in a large frying pan. While this is heating to make sure the tomato sauce is warm place the tilapia in the frying pan, and fry for just a couple of minutes. When the tilapia is browned, sprinkle on the tomato onion mixture, and put on a serving platter. Pour the tomato onion mix to the platter. Serve warm. This dish can be made ahead and kept covered with plastic wrap for up to two days.

title: Bratwurst Salad in Yogurt
ingredients: 5 fresh bratwursts or 3 lb other bratwurst, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 3 cups crumbled feta | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 3 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | fruit ( optional )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, combine bratwurst, feta, yogurt, pesto, vinegar and seasoned salt. Cover and chill for 2 hours or overnight to marinate. Add fruit to salad.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,american cheese,superfine sugar,egg noodle,pizza crust,italian tomato,pecan
title: Cheese Noodle Pizza
ingredients: 24 ounces refrigerated crust ready pizza crust | 1 egg noodles | 1 can pizza sauce | 2 cups grated american cheese or 2 cups velveeta cheese | 3 eggs | 1/4 cup chopped pecans | 1/4 cup italian-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together pizza crust dough and egg noodles. Reserve 4 cups. Spread remainder on pizza crust dough. Pour pizza sauce over noodles. In a medium bowl, stir together grated cheese with 2 beaten eggs and chopped pecans, making sure to mix well. Spread on top of sauce. Top with stewed tomato slices. Bake in a medium baking dish at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes, or until topping is golden brown. Serve hot, warm or room temperature.

title: Pasta Fritta (Spanish Macaroni Salad)
ingredients: 8 ounces shell pasta, cooked | 1 egg white | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Preheat a broiler. Spray a large baking dish with cooking spray. Mix cooked pasta, egg white, sherry, and 1 tablespoon of water in a bowl.

title: Chocolate Tortellini
ingredients: 1 container soft cheese tortellini | 1/4 cup dried mint leaves | 2 ounces dark chocolate, grated
instructions: Cook tortellini according to pkg. Directions. Drain. Cool tortellini in colander. Place tortellini in food processor with mint and chocolate. Pulse until mixture is smooth. Tear into chunks and toss with reserved mint leaves. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet and Sour Chicken Wings
ingredients: 6 large chicken wings | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 12 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Sprinkle the chicken wings with mace and arrange them on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until well browned, about 40 minutes.

title: Simmered Curried Chard, Beans, and Quinoa Pilaf
ingredients: 1 large onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon curry | 1 1/2 cups raw quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1 cup light sour cream | 1 can pinto beans ( pinto preferred, rinsed and drained ) | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon stevia ( optional )
instructions: Saute onion with curry until onion is transparent, add water if mixture is too dry. Add quinoa and sour cream. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer until most of the water has been absorbed. Simmer 2 minutes. Add beans, and allow to partially thaw, then add cheese. Cook until cheese has melted and mixture is warmed to your taste. Remove from heat. Spoon onto serving platter.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,tamari soy sauce,saffron thread,garam masala,zucchini
title: Tamarari Zucchini (Zucchini-Stuffed With Saffron)
ingredients: 3 zucchini | 1 package saffron threads | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | garam masala
instructions: Wash, stem and trim zucchini ends.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,pecan,chunky salsa,amaretto liqueur,leek,spice,ginger garlic paste
title: Ginger, Amaretto and Leek Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 500 g mixed sprouts | 1 leek ( white part only ) | 35 g of ginger-garlic paste ( or a mix of the two and a half ) | 45 g amaretto liqueur | 5 g chunky salsa | 1/3 cup pecans ( dry roasted or chopped ) | any spice ( to season )
instructions: Slice leek in thin rings, remove outer layers and set aside. Slice leek in thin strips. Wash sprouts, drain and dry with paper towel. Cut in half. Bring 2 litres of water to a rolling boil in a large saucepan and add sprouts. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until tender. Drain and dry. Place leek in a large bowl and add ginger garlic paste, amaretto, chunky salsa and pecans. Mix well and season with salt and pepper. Combine thoroughly then pour over the salad and mix well to combine. Serve at once.

title: Bengali Banana
ingredients: 3 large bananas | 6 cups beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon cardamom powder | 1/4 cup oil
instructions: Peel bananas and cut into chunks. Boil in water for 45 - 50 minutes. Drain and keep aside. Heat oil in a large skillet or wok. Add cardamom. Add bananas.

title: Duck Legs With Mango and Mango
ingredients: 2 teaspoons salt | 2 lbs duck legs ( skin on legs and thighs ) | 1/2 mango, peeled, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup sliced duck fat | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Rub fish with salt and place on a rimmed baking sheet and roast in 425 degree oven for 12 minutes. Turn and roast for 12 minutes. Remove from grill and set aside. Bake duck for 25 minutes. Spread mango on the duck and bake for 12 minutes. Turn and bake for another 12 minutes. Top with 2 tablespoons duck fat and then lime wedges. Can also use duck fat to cook over the duck.

title: Creamy Dijon Mustard Dressing for Fish and Seafood
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup ( 10 1/3 oz. can ) or ( 12 3/8 ounce ) can cream of mushroom soup ( 10 1/3 oz.  can ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry dijon mustard
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake well to blend. Place on desired amount of cooked fish pieces/mussels etc and cook as desired before serving.

title: Fruit with a Mango Crackling
ingredients: 1 banana, sliced | 1 mango, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Rinse and core the mango, then slice it into cubes about 4 cubes. Place the cubed mango around the inside of a roasting dish with slices of banana and a muddler. Pour 1 cup water into a bowl to use as a slumet for the stuffing. Insert a sliver of mango into each mango cube. Bake in the oven until the tops are a golden brown, 30 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,onion white,lemon zest,green chili pepper
title: Onion Jam Focaccia (Pinchos Empanadas)
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely diced onion white | 1 1/2 cups self rising flour | 1 large chopped green chili pepper ( i use jalapeno ) | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest
instructions: Prepare a skillet by lightly browning the onion white in the hot pan. In a large bowl add the flour, green chile, lemon zest. Add onion white, then mix well. Turn heat to med low heat and gradually stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough. Form the dough into a sausage shape, and then place on a floured surface and knead gently for a few minutes until dough starts to come together. Shape dough into a round ball and place on a greased baking sheet. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut dough in half and set aside. Using fingers flatten each half, creating a 2 inch deep indentation in center of each half. Fill indentation each with about 1 tablespoon of the onion jam. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, or until edges are golden. Let cool 1 - 2 minutes before transferring to a plate and sprinkling tops with additional chopped onion and pepper. Cool completely and store in airtight container.

title: Lime Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 8 chicken drumsticks | 4 ounces boxes uncooked dry large pasta shells ( i prefer medium ) | 1 cup fresh broccoli | 4 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese | 4 teaspoons fresh lime wedges ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 2 -8 large baguette, cut into bite-sized pieces ( toasted and buttered )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook the pasta according to package directions. While the pasta is cooking, cut the chicken into slices about 1/4 inch thick. Place in a small, non reactive baking dish. Place the corn on the cob in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the dark soy sauce and vinegar. Stir in the white vinegar until the sauce is completely emulsified. Store in the refrigerator and stir in the teriyaki sauce until used.

title: Mexican Ziti with Corn and Quinoa
ingredients: 180 g quinoa | 180 g ziti pasta | 2 corn on the cob | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Meanwhile, heat a frying pan. Add the quinoa and ziti. Cook for 2 mins under the grill, until they start to get soft and slightly coloured. Take the quinoa from the pan, drain any excess water, add the quinoa, corn, bicarbonate of soda and seasoning. Return to the pan and stir through until the ingredients are combined. Season if necessary.

Random Ingredients: currant,leg lamb,nutmeg,water chestnut,double cream,curd cottage cheese,rotel tomato
title: Jamaican Curried Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg leg of lamb, cut into 2cm cubes | 3/4 cup currants | 1 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 150 g small curd cottage cheese | 1 can stewed rotel tomatoes | 125 ml double cream | 3/4 cup water chestnut pulp or 3/4 cup frozen small tin of diced water
instructions: Spray large deep non stick pan with a low layer of cooking spray. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper, place in pan & brown all over in batches, then transfer to a bowl. Stir in currants nutmeg & cook over medium heat until currants melt, adding a little water if needed. Mix in cottage cheese & rotel tomatoes, stirring until combined. Place 1 cup of the meat & currant mixture in a casserole dish. Spoon over the cream mix. Spoon remaining currant mixture over top & sprinkle with pepper. Sprinkle water chestnuts. Bake in moderate oven 30 - 40 minutes until browned & bubbly.

title: Saffron Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice ( already cooked ) | 1/2 cup lentils ( already cooked ) | 1/2 cup green cardamoms | 1 teaspoon saffron | 3/4 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/2 cup blanched almond, chopped | 1 -3 bagel | 2 sheets phyllo pastry ( to use )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Cook the rice with lentils, cardamoms, saffron, anchovy paste and almonds. Put in oven for 10 minutes, turn oven off and leave for 10 minutes longer. Mix bread in with 1 cup of rice, bring to boil and then let soak for 10 minutes. Line pie pan with sheets of phyllo pastry, brushing each one with melted butter. Sprinkle some more sugar on the pastry and lay another sheet on top. Spoon more bread on this and sprinkle the rest of the bread on top. Cut bread into small squares. Pour the rice on top and bake for 20 minutes. Note, if you want to freeze the crust, make small triangles of pastry and put in freezer container. When ready to bake, take it out of the freezer and put on tray. When dinner time arrives, defrost and drain on a baking paper before continuing.

title: Quick and Easy Noodles (Zupa Koperkowa)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground white pepper, or to taste | 12 ounces fresh udon noodles, or more to taste | 3 cups cherry tomatoes, quartered | 1/4 pound cranberries, or to taste | 3 hard-boiled eggs, halved
instructions: Cook udon noodles with white pepper in a large pot of boiling water for about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: manchego cheese,wheat bread,white wine,nutmeg,red pepper flake,brown rice,garbanzo bean,vanilla ice cream
title: Spanish Rice and Chickpeas Au Gratin
ingredients: 1/2 loaf whole wheat bread, sliced into 4 equal pieces | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup manchego cheese, grated. | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat bread, sliced into 4 pieces | 1 liter vanilla ice cream, softened and lightly beaten | 1/4 cup white wine or 1/4 cup port wine | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon ground red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 cups cooked brown rice or 2 cups cooked brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Place the bread slices into a single layer in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Top bread with beans and cheese. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over the cheese. Bake for 50 - 55 minutes. Serve warm with your brown rice or brown rice.

title: Chicken Kara-Age
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, sliced paper thin | 3 turnips, peeled and sliced paper thin | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange chicken slices in a single layer onto the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle turnips over them. Drizzle sesame oil over the chicken. Bake in the preheated oven until the turnips are lightly colored, about 30 minutes.

title: Tarragon Green Cherry Tomatoes with Lettuce
ingredients: 4 large green cherry tomatoes | 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Wash the tomatoes under cold water to remove the outer skins. Slice them horizontally and remove the seeds. Arrange the tomato slices on a baking sheet lined with foil. Broil in the preheated oven about 2 minutes, or until the tomatoes are lightly browned and tender. Remove from the oven and place the cherry tomatoes on each tomato slice. Wash the lettuce and separate into leaves. Place the slices on a salad plate or in a bag placed in the refrigerator for a few hours to allow the flavors to develop. Serve the cherry tomatoes, drizzled with a small amount of olive oil,.

title: Gravy Potato Salad
ingredients: 150 -300 g baby potatoes, peeled, boiled and cooled | 1 carrot, trimmed, cleaned, washed and diced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Allow to sit in refrigerator for at least one hour or overnight.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,spanish onion,mirin,sea salt pepper,harissa,oil

 Spoon out an assortment of filling into a lettuce leaf. Tear off a piece of lettuce or two and set aside. instructions: Place brisket on a baking sheet and place in freezer. Every 20 minutes or so place several slices of pork onto the baking sheet. title: Mashed Potato Gnocchi
ingredients: 5 cups boiled potatoes, sliced thin ( about 2 large potatoes ) | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1/3 cup of fresh basil leaf, chopped
instructions: Using a potato ricer or hand mixer, mash potatoes until very fine. Combine potatoes with beef broth. Add basil and mix well. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours and as long as the dough is still working its own long way. Remove dough from refrigerator 15 minutes before using. Divide and form into long, thin roll. Cut dough into pieces 1 1/2 wide by 2 wide, but approximately the same size and thickness as a golfball. Place gnocchi on plate and cover with damp towel for 10 - 15 minutes. Using a sharp paring knife that is not too hot to the touch, remove about 1/4 cup of gnocchi from the bowl. Dipping your index finger in boiling water briefly will form marks. Scoop a small handful of the potato mixture into your thumb and index finger, scoop off about 1/4 cup of potato mixture and then place it into the palm of your hand gently and press lightly until almost smooth. Add about 1/4 cup of gnocchi back to the gnocchi and mix until combined and it is incorporated. Repeat until all mixture is used up. Enjoy.

title: Prawns With Smoked Sausage (Salmon) With Pesto & Smoked Fish
ingredients: 4 smoked salmon fillets ( about 1 1/2 cm/1 1/2 inches thick ) | 3 teaspoons smoked sherry wine ( i sub honey ) | 24 jumbo shrimp, raw peeled | 20 leaves lettuce, red leaf ( or baby rocket ) | 1/4 cup basil pesto | 1 1/2 tablespoons spicy mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon hot paprika | 2 1/2 cup dashi
instructions: Sausage, place the smoked salmon on a grill plate or barbecue plate and cover with a double layer of foil. Place on the barbecue and cook for 8 minutes, or until cooked through. Remove from the grill. Brush with the sherry and set aside. Stir the shrimp with the pesto and spicy mixed spice. Set aside. Reheat the dashi in a saucepan over low heat, add the smoked fish and the shrimp mixture. Cook and stir for 2 - 3 minutes or until heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,white wine,red snapper fillet,lasagna noodle,snow pea
title: Maggie's Red Snapper - Boatman's Weekly
ingredients: 4 red snapper fillets | 150 g snow peas | 350 g kidney beans, cleaned and washed | 150 g white wine | 7 -9 sheets lasagna noodles ( or any size you will prefer )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 c or 350 f. Place some of your favourite noodles in a baking dish. Bake for around 5 to 7 minutes or until golden. Meanwhile, put the snapper fillets into a large pot or oven dish. Pour a little white wine around the snapper if necessary. Add enough water to cover the fish by about 1/2cm or so. Bring to the boil and cook for about 10 minutes or until the snapper is cooked. It might not take all the water, but just enough to come halfway through the cooking. If the water is evaporating too quickly, add more white wine. Remove any skin that is still floating on the fish and slice the fish into strips about 5 cm long, 1 cm wide and 1/2 cm wide. Add to the snapper. Add a couple of handfuls of snow peas to the snapper and cook for a minute or so, then place in a bowl with some of your favourite cooked pasta. Add some chopped tomato and a couple of handfuls of baby onions to the snapper and snapper. Finish with some fresh basil. Dish out onto a serving platter and add some more wine if you wish to serve.

title: Pesto Roasted Pumpkin Seeds (Pesto)
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints pumpkin puree | 2 cups pesto sauce ( homemade or purchased )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f or 200 c or gas mark 3 place pumpkin in a baking dish and roast for about 1 hour or till tender. Drain, mix with pesto and transfer to an ovenproof dish or glass bowl. Place in the preheated oven and bake for 20 - 25 minutes until very dry.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,orange peel,baking potato,basil leaf
title: Potatoes Simmered in Orange Basting Sauce (Crispy Baked Primaverano)
ingredients: 6 -8 baking potatoes ( russet or idaho ) | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped candied orange peel | 1/2 - 2/3 tablespoon grated fresh red bell pepper
instructions: Scrub & scrub potatoes, then place in a large saucepan of boiling water & boil uncovered 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and then cut potatoes into 1 thick slices & toss slices with basil & orange peels. When potatoes are tender, remove bay leaves, then heat sauce over medium heat for about 2 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,almond half,breadcrumb,tortilla,chocolate pudding mix,salsa,red wine,black pepper
title: Quick & Easy Chocolate Crumb Tortilla Wrap
ingredients: 6 tortillas, cut about 3/4-inch slices | 2 cups instant chocolate pudding mix | 7/8 cup salsa ( i use medium hot ) | 2 cups crumbs ( i use italian seasoned ) | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup dry red wine ( i use cabernet sauvignon or port du chin ) | 1/2 cup almond halves ( slivered )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Brush both sides of tortillas with melted butter.

title: Chip Chip Catfish
ingredients: catfish fillets, cut into chunks | 1/2 package frozen corn husks | 1 cup mini chocolate chips, melted
instructions: Place catfish, corn husks, and mini chocolate chips in a plastic bag. Pour melted chocolate onto bag.

title: Zucchini Chips (Grilled Zucchini)
ingredients: 1 zucchini | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 tablespoons caramels or 2 tablespoons other light flavored caramel topping | 1/3 cup light flavored caramel topping | tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise. Remove seeds. Slice about 1/4´´´´ thick and lightly pat zucchini dry on paper towel with paper towel. Using a mandoline, carefully slice thin sticks. Set aside, covered. Dry out seeds in a pan over medium high heat. When seeds start sputtering, remove from heat. Let cool. Grind seeds to fine, not powdery. Heat 1 tbs. Of caramel in a large nonstick pan on med high heat. Add the zucchini sticks, sprinkle the coriander and caramels on the zucchini sticks. Sprinkle the zucchini with the caramels, shaking off any excess. Fry, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon and shaking the pan, approximately 3 - 4 minutes, until the zucchini chips are dark golden and crisp. Be careful with the steam, the heat is very hot. Remove from heat and sprinkle with pepper, if desired. Serve hot. Serve with tabasco sauce.

title: Sweet and Sour Veal
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cut into small pieces | 1 1/2 cups creme fraiche | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek | 1/2 orange peel, grated ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the meat. Marinate overnight in refrigerator. Turn the meat about every 10 mins. Remove the meat. Cook as before, i prefer overnite. It is possible to braise too quickly for even browning. If you have the time.

title: Onion Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 garlic salt ( garlic powder works well too ) | 1 spanish onion ( sliced )
instructions: Cut baguette lengthwise into 24 equal slices. Spread garlic powder on baguette slices. Top with sliced onion. Wrap and bake at 350 for 45 mins bread should be golden brown. Let cool for 10 mins and slice into soldiers or french bread.

title: Artichoke Tea Bread
ingredients: 4 cups cubed sourdough bread | 1 quart light beer ( your favourite will do in a pinch ) | 8 ounces anise seeds | 4 ounces anise oil | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 4 teaspoons pecorino cheese, grated | 2 loaves rye bread | 8 ounces frozen artichokes, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the sourdough in a large bowl. Add the beer and anise seed and stir well to combine. Add the anise oil and grated cheese. Add the bread cubes, stir to coat the bread cubes well. Arrange the artichokes over top and bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, or until they're tender but not mushy. Remove from the oven and add the artichoke hearts. Stir to coat. Note, bread is so dense that it may not stick together. Let sit in the oven for about 15 minutes or longer until bread has soaked up the flavors. Remove bread from the oven. Stir to mix.

title: Tararua (Yogurt Tartlets)
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 1 cup yogurt ( greek or greek like the pate type ) | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter, not imitation
instructions: Cut the puff pastry sheet and place in a pie plate on a baking sheet. Spread the sheet of puff pastry evenly with a little yogurt. Dust the puff pastry sheet with flour and bake at 400 for about 15 minutes. When you add the lemon juice, the lemon zest, and the peanut butter, check for salt. Remove the baking tray from the oven and add the lemon juice mixture in the center to form a tart crust. Chill while making the filling and serve.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,chicken,lard,garlic powder,pecorino romano cheese,tomatillo salsa,sesame seed
title: Salsa Chicken Penne With Beans and Tomatillo
ingredients: 1/4 cup lard | 4 ounces tomatillo salsa | 2 ounces penne pasta, uncooked | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, ground | 2 ounces parsley, minced | 1/4 cup parmesean romano cheese, shredded or 1/4 cup asiago cheese, grated | 2 -4 pieces chicken or 2 -4 pieces duck
instructions: In a skillet, heat the lard over medium heat. Saute the tomatillo salsa until it becomes thick and smooth, about 1 minute. Meanwhile cook the penne pasta according to the package directions. Drain the pasta and return it to the pan. Add the garlic powder and remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Adjust seasoning if necessary. Spoon mixture into bowl.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,confectioner ' sugar,fast rising yeast,celery
title: Paneer
ingredients: 1 packet fast rising yeast | 4 - 5 cups confectioners'sugar | 3 -4 stalks celery, chopped | 2 -3 dried hot red chili peppers
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 3 cups of the confectioners' sugar and chilli until frothy. Sift flour and salt onto a medium size mixing bowl, rub together the yeast mixture and knead in remaining sugar. Let dough rest for 15 minutes. Stir in celery, mix well and place in an oiled bowl, cover with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk about 1 1/2 hours. Grease a 9x13 pan or a 10x15x2 baking pan with a thin coating of cooking spray. Turn dough out onto a floured surface, knead in remaining flour and form into a round cake. Place into an oiled bowl, cover with towels and let rise until doubled in bulk. Bake at 400 for 45 - 50 minutes until done. Cut into 6 wedges or triangles and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,red lentil,baby pea,chicken broth
title: Mulligatawny Soup (Red Lentils & Peas)
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils, washed, picked over and washed | 1/2 cup split green lentils | 1 cup chicken broth | 6 pods green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Mix lentils, broth, cardamom pods and split green lentils in a covered soup pot. Heat to boiling over high heat.

title: Chinese Meatball Sandwich
ingredients: 6 ounces lean ground lamb steaks | 1 tablespoon soy sauce or 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 14 ounces thinly sliced salami
instructions: Combine lamb, ground sugar and soy sauce, using hands or rolling pin and work mixture lightly to combine ingredients. Roll into balls, each about 6 in diameter. Pre heat oven to 200c or 170c if using fan forced oven, cook meatballs until just cooked through. To serve, place meatballs on warm rolls, and top with salami slices.

title: Steamed Baked Veal With Chocolate & Carrots
ingredients: 250 g veal cutlets ( very finely chopped ) | 4 medium carrots ( finely chopped ) | 1/3 bell pepper ( finely chopped in strips ) | 100 g chocolate ( fine grated ) | 1/3 cup white wine ( white vermouth or shaoxing wine ) | 1/4 cup fresh lettuce leaves ( finely chopped ) | 2 teaspoons smoked sweet paprika | 1 pinch dried kale
instructions: Put the veal in a microwave safe bowl on high. Add the carrots, pepper and soy sauce to the veal. Stir so all the veg are coated with the soy sauce. Pour over the chocolate in a bowl, fold in the lettuce leaves and parma cheese. Put lid on bowl, put in preheated oven for 10 minutes at 220c/450f/gas mark remove bowl from oven and place on a board on high heat stirring the veg with a fork. Take a knife and slash all around the bowl making a round cut in the veg at a 45 degree angle. This is the veal cutlet. Serve with a stir fried veggies.

Random Ingredients: brie cheese,orange extract,icing sugar,cinnamon raisin bread,brown sugar
title: Fruit Cinnamon Raisin Bread
ingredients: 1 cup icing sugar | 1 loaf cinnamon raisin bread | 3 ounces brie cheese, diced | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated orange extract ( optional )
instructions: Spread icing on raisin bread, leaving about 1 1/2 inches of crust surrounding loaf. Mix together brie and remaining icing sugar. Place on top of raisin bread crumbs, spreading evenly. Sprinkle with cinnamon and orange essence, if using. Bake at 325 degree oven approx 1 hour, or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Lighter Russian Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup vodka, preferably dark | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing ( vh ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 green bell pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bell pepper. Toss with vegetables. Refrigerate a few hours.

title: Quick and Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean, drained and rinsed | 1 head napa cabbage, sliced
instructions: In a pot over high heat place beans. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer. Cook beans over medium heat for about 3 hours. Drain beans in a colander and cover. Return beans to pot. Remove and discard any remaining beans, cabbage, and cabbage. Mash the beans with or with a potato masher to desired consistency.

title: Pepperoni Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni ( chopped ) | 12 ounces cheese ( pepperoni, monterey jack, cheddar jack or pepperjack )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place pepperoni and cheese on cookie sheet. Roll dough into 1 inch balls. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: French White Cheese Sandwiches for 2
ingredients: 16 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, in 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons skim fat free sour cream
instructions: Place a scoop of provolone cheese on a plate, and cover with a second cheese scoop. Spread a tablespoon of sour cream over each cheese scoop. Let sit for about 10 minutes before eating.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,korma paste,cayenne,coriander powder,rigatoni pasta,cocoa,cayenne pepper,phyllo pastry
title: Coriander & Mint Rama (Pasta With Nuts) from Corfu
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup korma paste | 1 teaspoon cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | fresh mint leaves, for garnishing | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa or 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil, for brushing
instructions: Put a large pot of water on to boil. Meanwhile, cook the rigatoni in boiling water until softened and al dente. Drain pasta and place in shallow bowl. Add all of the other ingredients and mix thoroughly. Pour this mixture over the pasta and toss well to coat evenly. Brush a small amount of the cocoa on a baking tray. Put in baking tray. Smooth top. Sprinkle over more cocoa. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Cut the rama into 16 squares and place on individual plates. Sprinkle over fresh mint and serve with freshly steamed green beans, garlic raita, chilli and tamarind chutney. Variation, to change ingredients/size, instead of the corfu, cashew nuts can be substituted. Substitute any other protein of your choice with finely chopped peanuts and walnuts.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,cream celery soup,ice water,red kidney bean,parmesan cheese,snap pea,mint leaf,dark soy sauce
title: Quick Pea and Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 cup diced snap peas | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons ice water | fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: In medium saucepan, heat oil over medium high heat. Stir in soup, snap peas and kidney beans. Cook and stir 5 minutes or until peas are crisp tender. Stir in cheese and soy sauce, then mix in 2 tablespoons water and stir to combine. Spoon into bowls and garnish with mint before serving.

title: Slow Roasted Grape Tomatoes & Coffee
ingredients: 1 large grape tomatoes | 1/2 ounce espresso powder | 1 cup chilled brewed espresso
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Using a large oven mitt or star shaped baking dish spoon the tomatoes into a shamrock shape. Insert a shamrock shaped cookie cookie into the top of the tomatoes. Add to the pan the espresso powder and stir to combine. Add the espresso and stir gently to coat the tomatoes. Place the oven mitt or star shaped cookie into the middle rack of the oven and roast for 1 hour, remove the pan and bake for another 15 - 20 minutes or until the tomatoes are very soft and bubbly. Remove the pan from the oven and allow the tomatoes to cool completely.

title: Pollo Borracha (Fennel and Chicken in Tomato Sauce)
ingredients: 6 -8 pieces chicken thighs ( about 1 inch thick ) | 6 -8 romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups fresh tomato juice ( from jar ) | 3/4 cup cold strong tea | roasted fennel ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Remove chicken from refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: white onion,graham cracker crust,salmon steak,thyme,shallot,beef bouillon cube
title: Melt in Your Mouth Salmon Pie
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh salmon steaks | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 ounce minced white onion | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 8 ounces frozen graham cracker crust, thawed
instructions: Coat the bottom of a 9 pie pan with cooking spray. Heat oven to 425 degrees. Place steaks in pie crust. Slice onion into rings and season with salt and pepper. Put in a preheated oven for 20 minutes. Turn over and add thyme. Continue to bake for an additional 20 - 30 minutes, or until the bread is lightly toasted and onions have caramelized. Pour barbeque sauce over salmon, covering, and let simmer for several minutes. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: rose,egg yolk,pecorino romano cheese,chili pepper flake,tomato paste,cod,farfalle pasta
title: Pasta With Cod and Aromatic Meat Sauce
ingredients: 20 ounces dried farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 2 1/2 lbs cod | 14 ounces tomato paste | 6 fresh rosemary, leaves only | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 1/4 cups freshly grated pecorino romano cheese ( or more ) | 2 egg yolks
instructions: Boil 6 quarts of water with the salt. Add the farfalle and cook to al dente, approximately 7 - 9 minutes. Remove the pasta from the water, drain and set aside. Remove the white lining at the base of each ramekin, then rinse well with cold water. This will help to remove some of the white lining on top of the farfalle, as they absorb less water. Cut the cod into 1 inch chunks and place the cod into a pot with a couple of inches of water. Boil the tomato paste over low heat for about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and add a little water if desired to make the sauce thinner. Pour the strained tomato into a bowl, cover with a clean cloth, and allow to cool slightly.

title: Chocolate and Beans With Mustard Gravy and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice ( white or brown ) | 1 tablespoon shortening ( or other oil ) | 1/8 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained ( can use white kidney beans ) | 1 ounce dark chocolate, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain rice. Soak in water for 20 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a saucepan, melt shortening. Add rice and mustard powder. Heat until well mixed and glossy. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and let simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Fluff with fork before serving.

title: Mock Cactus Rub
ingredients: 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/4 cup salsa verde | 6 lime wedges, to serve
instructions: Combine the sugar and salsa verde in a small saucepan over a low heat until the sugar has melted and the liquid has reduced slightly. Whisk the melted sugar mixture into the hot mixture. Heat for 3 minutes, stir, then allow the mixture to stand for 5 minutes. Rub the cooled rub onto your hands, working it into the palm of one hand. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Simple Beef  Burfi (Oriental Beef  Roll-Ups)
ingredients: 1/2 kg london broil beef, sliced thinly | 1 cup slivered almonds | 2 teaspoons dashi | 1/4 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: Mix well the dashi powder and baking soda. Roll the beef thinly. Heat up the pot with a little oil on the stove over a medium heat. Put the sliced beef in. Place the almonds on top of it. Cover and wait a few minutes to open the pot and get good.

title: Baked Sweet and Sour Onions
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 medium sweet brown onion | 2 small bamboo shoots, cut in half | 1 roma lettuce | 3 tablespoons prepared sweet-sour sauce | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon creamed chives | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/8 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Cut onion in half lengthwise and crosswise. Arrange half the onion halves in a glass 9 x 13 in baking dish. Cut remaining onion halves into thin slices. Mix remaining ingredients and pour half over onions. Cover and bake 30 minutes or until onions are tender.. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,grit,white fish fillet,cream chicken soup,tamarind pulp,italian bread
title: Indian-Style Cod Casserole
ingredients: 8 cod fillets, sliced | 1 cup italian style bread, thick slices, crusts removed | 1/4 cup fresh cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp | whole grain grits ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pistachios, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Drain the fish slices on paper towels. Place the bread slices in a bowl and pour the cream of chicken soup over them. Mix well. Sprinkle over the tamarind pulp. Transfer the cod slices to a greased 9x13 baking dish. Bake uncovered for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Quick Asian Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 8 fluid ounces low sodium chicken broth or 8 fluid ounces beef broth | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk the oyster sauce, fish sauce and sesame oil until blended. In a saucepan combine the chicken broth and cocoa.

title: Dieted Bananas
ingredients: 1/2 cup water | 2 bananas | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 3 -5 green onions
instructions: Put 3 - 4 tbsp of pesto in a bowl, pour water, then mix until completely mixed in. Slice the banana in half length ways, then slice crossways into 1 1/2 in length pieces. In a medium sized frying pan put the 2 tbsp pesto, cook over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes, tossing often. Add the bananas to fry pan, and continue to cook for 2 - 4 minutes. Add the green onions, stir and cook for 3 - 4 minutes, mixing often, add the remaining pesto mix and stir, adding extra for color. Serve with bread or as a topping for vegies.

title: Traditional British Apricot Toast
ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 4 tablespoons pasta, toasted, dry, to serve
instructions: Put it through a food processor or whiz to a paste. Spread jam all over bread. Top with a layer of toast and serve with your favourite condiments you can serve this with boiled potatoes.

title: Char Siu (charcoal Sauce)
ingredients: 1 1/4 liters charcoal ( or briquettes ) | 1 liter vegetable broth or 1 liter chicken broth | 2 tablespoons rice wine
instructions: Remove the white ash from the briquettes with a sharp knife, and wash in very cold water. The woody dirt will remove the taste of the briquettes and smell impossibly unpleasant. Soak the briquettes in cold water for 15 minutes, remove as much of the earth from the briquettes as possible, and place in an airtight container. Heat the vegetable broth in a large saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally. Once the broth is hot put in the rice wine, and allow it to become fully infused with the rice wine and smell. Stir it frequently while the broth thickens. Once the broth has been absorbed, strain the soup through a fine mesh sieve and transfer it to a container. Serve with roasted vegetables or meat, and eat immediately.

title: Swiss Cheese Souffles
ingredients: 1 egg substitute | swiss cheese, grated
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and beat lightly.

title: Crunchy Cracker Bread
ingredients: 1 slice bread | 2 slices frozen whipped topping | 2 teaspoons peanut oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Cut slice of bread about 3 inches thick. Dip each slice of bread into peanut oil, and let excess oil drip off. Place slices on a square of aluminum foil. Place the entire stack of crumb on 4 more squares of foil and tightly seal. Bake the frozen whipped topping in a microwave for about 5 minutes on high power, or until lightly browned and bubbly. Spread half the whipped topping on one side of the toasted bread, and top with a second piece of bread like a loaf.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,celery rib,tilapia fillet,vegetable bouillon,plain yogurt,provolone cheese,cooking oat,chicken breast half
title: Grilled Oatmeal Fish With Provolone Sauce and Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable bouillon | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 tablespoon low-fat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat provolone cheese | 2 boneless skinless tilapia fillets | 3 tablespoons low-fat sour cream | 1 lemon wedge | 8 slices provolone cheese | 1/3 cup chopped celery rib | 1 teaspoon grated lime wedge
instructions: Mix chicken with bouillon and oats. Wisk yogurt and provolone together in small bowl, set aside. Brush tilapia filets with yogurt mixture and grill 4 minutes per side. Place on serving plate and top with 1 tablespoon sour cream. Top with celery and lime wedges.

title: Cheese and Lemony Appetizer
ingredients: 2 slices cheddar cheese, cut in 1 inch cubes or paper thin sticks of your choice | 1/2 drop tabasco sauce | 1 lemon peel, pith removed
instructions: Place cheese cubes, one at a time, between wax paper lined paper or plastic wrap. Heat sauce and lemon peel in microwave, stirring after 1 minute and 15 seconds or until melted. Spread cheese on a small piece of waxed paper or plastic wrap so that it is completely immersed. Roll cheese over in hot mixture. Place waxed paper or plastic wrap over cheese, pressing wax on with finger if necessary. Refrigerate, covered, for at least 30 minutes before serving, tossing before serving. Store in refrigerator or it will harden.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,coca cola,orzo pasta,plantain,red enchilada sauce,jalapeno pepper
title: Orzo and Plantains
ingredients: 4 ripe plantains, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 jar red enchilada sauce | 4 cans coconut milk | 1 can orzo pasta or ( 16 ounce ) can other short pasta | 2 -3 jalapeno peppers, finely chopped | 1 - 1 1/2 cup coca-cola ( optional ) or 1 -1 1/2 cup pepsi ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the coco cola and coca beverage, in a large bowl, combine 1/2 cup of coco cola with 1/4 cup of coco, if desired. Toss with the orzo. Arrange in a glass dish or roaster, and cover with a lid. Set to wait to heat.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,raisin,white wine,tandoori paste,nori,marsala wine,red chili pepper
title: Tandoori Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 teaspoons tandoori paste | 1/2 cup white wine | 3/4 cup dry marsala wine, preferably sweet | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 teaspoon dried red chili pepper | 1 1/2 cups uncooked shell pasta | 5 nori, seaweed sheets ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Cook pasta in boiling water uncovered until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, stir together paste, wine, raisins, chili peppers, and pasta in a large nonstick skillet until well blended and coated. Add pasta mixture. Sprinkle evenly with nori seaweed. Cover and place over medium low heat. Cook 2 - 3 minutes until crisp.

title: Mimi's Potatoes Ole!
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1 can condensed cheese soup | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 large cucumber, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, brown the ground beef, and drain. Mix in the cheese soup, jalapeno pepper, parsley, and garlic powder. Cook the potatoes until tender, but still firm, and toss with the ground beef mixture. Garnish with the cooked potatoes and cucumber if desired.

title: Low-Fat Linguine Alfredo
ingredients: 3/4 cup splenda granular, sugar substitute, artificial sweetener or 1 packet splenda granular | 1/2 cup dried linguine | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Blend all together. Cook linguine until tender according to directions on package or in boiling water and drain well. Add to sauce mixture and stir until all is absorbed. Serve over fettuccine shells.

title: Aussie Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces plain yogurt | 4 medium sized shallots | 1 tablespoon parmesan, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon sherry wine | 1 large egg, lightly beaten
instructions: Place yoghurt, shallots, parmesan and sherry in bowl. Add egg. Combine well. Pour over yoghurt in a serving bowl.

title: Dutch Leek Burger
ingredients: 2 leeks, trimmed of dark green tops and ends, sliced in half lengthwise | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 50 g hamburger, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh parsley sprig | parsley sprig ( to garnish ), to garnish
instructions: Soak leeks, in cold water and a few drops of the ginger garlic paste until soft, about 1 hour or overnight. Drain and discard the water. Lightly season the leeks with salt. Heat a dry non stick pan over medium heat and toast the leeks, without browning them, for 10 to 15 minutes, until almost tender. Transfer to bowl and mash with a potato masher. Leave to cool. In a small frying pan, lightly fry the burger in small batches. Sear until golden brown. Keep warm and serve with a garnish of fresh parsley and crispy bread. Variation, replace the ginger garlic paste by garlic paste, adding chopped raw carrots to the meat and leeks when browning the leeks. You may also use a mix of chopped onions, onions and celery. Add salt to taste.

title: Katchin's Irish Red and Yellow Tail Broth
ingredients: 2 teaspoons whole cloves | 1 teaspoon juniper berries, crushed | 2 pounds turnips, peeled and cut in half from top to bottom | 2 green onions
instructions: In a blender, grind the cloves to a coarse powder or grind them in a mortar. Peel, core, and dice the turnips and cook in the puree until browned over medium heat, stirring often. Add the green onions and juniper powder, stir gently, and cook until vegetables are tender.

title: Gomasio's Pork Bowl
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 3/4 cup sushi rice ( preferably pearl river ) | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas
instructions: Slice pork thinly, place into bowl and cover with warm water. In medium skillet, cook pork over medium high heat until no lumps remain, 3 - 5 minutes until no pink remains and the meat is well browned. Remove pork from skillet and set aside. Remove and discard all but 2 tbsp of fat from skillet. Add saki to skillet and stir until heated through. Return pork to skillet and add cooked rice. Add peas.

title: Quick Italian Vegetable Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger, browned & drained | 1 cup diced zucchini | 1 can snap peas ( drained ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup oleo ( or less, if desired ) | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Mix hamburger, zucchini, snap peas, and oleo in bowl. Form into four patties. Broil till desired doneness, about 4 from heat. Top with cheese. Enjoy. These are great with salsa, fresh veggies, or even a green salad.

Random Ingredients: walnut,heavy whipping cream,veal,cinnamon,egg yolk water,mandarin orange
title: Ganache (Tatties)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground veal, browned and drained ( or ground pork, beef, goat meat or other meat of your choice ) | 4 egg yolks ( or 1 egg, beaten with a splash of water ) | 4 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream (, or, if you want, extra to make topping later ) | 1 medium mandarin orange, peeled and finely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Prepare a grill to medium heat. If using meat that has been cooked and drained, chop or grind it to fine crumbs.. Add egg yolks and whip until well blended. Add cream and cinnamon and beat until blended. Add meat and fold. Divide mixture into 36 patties.. Grill patties over medium heat until done, about 15 - 20 minute on each side. Make ganache, place a small spoonful of ganache in center of each hot ganache.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,heavy cream,oil black olive,cottage cheese,miso,pineapple juice concentrate,arborio rice,coconut cream
title: Arborio Rice Casserole with Pina Colada Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons miso or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 can pineapple juice concentrate, drained and strained | 3/4 cup coconut cream | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice ( white ) | 3 tablespoons oil ( i think canola ) | 2 1/2 cups apple juice | 10 ounces cottage cheese | 7 ounces pineapple slices or 10 ounces black olives, sliced, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot, bring water to a boil. Add salt and cook rice in boiling water until done. Drain and set aside. In a bowl, whisk together cream, miso and vinegar, reserve 2 tablespoons miso to use when making the rice dish. Stir about 1/3 of the sauce into hot rice and set aside. Heat the coconut cream in a double boiler. Set miso aside in pan. Add 1/4 cup of sour cream to the coconut cream and heat over low heat until warm. Stir in 1 1/2 of the cream miso.

title: Easy Pizza Guacamole
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust | catsup | avocado, slices for garnish
instructions: Spread catsup on the crust. Top with avocado slices. Top guacamole with the same catsup, then garnish with avocado slices.

title: Slow Cooker Maple Smoked Beef
ingredients: 2 pounds trimmed boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 or 2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Cover meat with water in a 12 inch skillet. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low, then cover and simmer until the meat falls apart, about 2 hours. Stir in maple syrup and parmesan cheese. Cover, then continue cooking until meat will easily remove from the bones, about 3 hours.

title: Saffron and Noodle Seasoning
ingredients: 3 cups saffron | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 12 ounces cooked ramen noodles | 4 1/2 ounces capers | 1/4 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: In a small bowl, crush saffron with a mortar and pestle or using a rolling pin. Add oregano, noodles and capers. Stir in parsley. Adjust seasoning, to taste.

title: Tortillas Receipe# 4
ingredients: 2 cups shortening or 2 cups heavy cream | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Heat the oven to 225°f. In a pastry bag, combine the water and salt. Cut the shortening or cream into small bits. Add to bag one at a time and mix together until very fine crumbs form. Turn onto a floured surface and knead very briefly. Roll out to about 1/2 inch thickness. Place on greased griddle and fry until brown and firm, turning frequently. Repeat until all dough is gone. Serve with refried beans, tomatoes, olives, guacomole, salsa, lettuce and tomato juice. To store tortillas, wrap in towels then in baking paper and refrigerate up to 3 days.

title: Cheese Polenta Rounds
ingredients: 4 slices provolone cheese ( thin slices ) | 4 teaspoons cornmeal | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Put a teaspoon of cornmeal on a slice of provolone cheese and spread it to about halfway into the circle. Layer it up so that once its been in the middle, it will be seen as a circle. Repeat steps 4 - 5 more times.

title: Rasam (Curried Spinach)
ingredients: 8 cups fresh spinach | 2 teaspoons cardamom
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach. Pour the spinach in a heavy pot and cover with water. It should start to float as you touch it. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the water is nearly all evaporated. Stir occasionally. Sprinkle with cardamom. Cover and leave a few minutes until the greens absorb some of the water.

title: Smoked Salmon Pizza
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, rinsed | 415 g canned sliced black olives, drained | 1 red chilies, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons pizza sauce | 2 cooked large salmon, halved
instructions: Preheat barbecue, cook salmon on barbecue plate and place under grill for 5 - 8 minutes or until golden. Combine chickpeas and olives in bowl. Stir in pepper, pizza sauce and chillies. Spoon pizza into large heatproof half cup dishes, top with cooked salmon. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons of pizza sauce and serve.

title: Chinese Style Hot Sauce (Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1 cup hot sauce ( or more ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt ( or to taste ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Using kitchen scissors, cut all ingredients into very fine slivers. You should have about 1 - ¼ cup.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,tomato puree,chunky salsa,whipping cream,apple cider
title: Smoky Apple Dressing
ingredients: 1 medium apple, cored peeled, quartered, quartered | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1 cup whipping cream | sweet chunky salsa
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together apple, vinegar, and cider. Let stand 5 minutes, then stir in cream until well blended.

Random Ingredients: crab,chicken bouillon cube,cream mushroom soup,salad green,vegetarian bean,saffron,pepperoncini pepper,mango
title: Mango Crab Salad
ingredients: 1 can crab, drained | 1 can vegetarian refried beans | 0.5 can sweetened condensed cream of mushroom soup | 0.5 can chopped saffron ( i used thai peppers ) | 3 cups mixed salad greens | 1/2 cup grilled paprika pepperoncini peppers, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 teaspoon hot pepperoncini pepper ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for cousein and pepperoncini in large bowl and mix well. Pour mixture into serving dish or crockpot and sprinkle with cousein and pepperoncini if using.

Random Ingredients: cognac,celery salt,orange juice,guacamole,onion soup mix,lemon pepper,carrot
title: Guacamole and Carrot Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1/4 cup onion soup mix, dry packet | 1/4 cup cognac | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 carrot
instructions: Dissolve sugar in orange juice. Add rest of the ingredients. Place carrots and serve.

title: Yummy sundae Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb sun-dried tomato | 1 teaspoon garlic salt ( or more- to taste )
instructions: Place sun dried tomatoes in boiling water to cover. Cook about 6 minutes. Drain and set aside to get rid of any excess water. Place sun dried tomatoes in blender jar or food processor with garlic salt. Add 3/4 cup of reserved sun dried tomato water to achieve desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup water,pork rib,cornstarch,tomato paste,cream chicken soup,curd,pork butt,black bean
title: Crock Pot Pork-And-Feasts
ingredients: 1/2 lb country-style pork butt, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can tomato paste | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 can cornstarch | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1/4 cup sour cream | 3 cups hot cooked black beans, undrained | 1 1/2 tablespoons simple syrup or 1 1/2 tablespoons water
instructions: Spray 4 - 5 qt slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray. In large bowl, mix tomato paste, soup, 1/2 cornstarch, sour cream and beans. Place pork in slow cooker. Sprinkle with remaining cornstarch. Top with cornstarch mixture. Cover and cook on low 7 - 9 hours, until pork is very tender and cooked through. Remove pork and beans from slow cooker. Place meat on cutting board.

Random Ingredients: lemonade mix,beer,tamari,orange juice concentrate,brandy,chili sauce,vegetable broth
title: Barbecue Sauce - No Mayo Needed Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable broth or 1 cup chicken broth | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons whiskey | 1 tablespoon chili sauce ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon frozen orange juice concentrate ( to taste ) | 1 cup beer ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons lemonade mix | 2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a saucepan or pot over medium high heat and stir. When it begins to boil, remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Once cool remove from heat and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: green salsa,raisin,tomato basil oregano garlic,apple,chicken wing,pork loin,pineapple
title: Pollo en Narancaina
ingredients: 3 pounds frozen, rolled chicken wings | 1 can crushed pineapple | 1 bag raisins | 2 pounds boneless pork loin, cut into cubes | 1 can green salsa | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil oregano and garlic
instructions: In a large stockpot combine the chicken wings, pineapple, raisins, pork, salsa, tomatoes, and garlic. Bring to a boil, and cook over medium high heat 3 hours, until the pork is tender. Stir frequently.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,cool whip,granny smith apple,shallot,caster sugar,pine nut
title: Pine Nut and Apple Salad With Whipped Cream (Or Salad)
ingredients: 1 granny smith apple | 2 teaspoons pure maple syrup or 2 teaspoons light maple syrup | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon chopped shallots | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 8 -10 toasted pine nuts ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Peel the apple and core it, then cut into chunks about 3 inches long. Put it in a bowl with the maple syrup, lemon juice, and shallots and toss gently to combine. Taste and adjust the seasoning, then chill well. Just before serving, whisk in the lemon juice. Decorate with pine nuts.

title: Easy Pesto Mousse for Breakfast and Dinner
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons pesto | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Place cream and pesto in the bowl of a stand mixer and whisk until smooth. Add vanilla and whisk thoroughly. Refrigerate for 15 - 20 minutes, or until ready to serve.

title: Greek Baked Yogurt
ingredients: 3 cups greek yogurt ( or greek anthotiro ) | 1 teaspoon pickling spices | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Toss the yogurt with the pickling spice in a bowl until evenly coated. Stir in the parsley if using, and transfer to a 9 x 12 inch glass baking dish. Bake until the liquid has evaporated, and the yogurt is slightly thickened, about 40 minutes. Cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,celery rib,achiote paste,yellow pepper,serrano pepper,baby dill pickle,caraway seed
title: Almond-Chip Relish
ingredients: 3 cups baby dill pickles, coarsely chopped | 2 cups dried whole almonds, coarsely ground ( see note below, about 2 - 3 cups worth ) | 3 medium carrots, coarsely ground ( see note below ) | 1 medium serrano pepper, coarsely ground | 1 medium yellow pepper, coarsely ground | 1 teaspoon achiote paste or 1 teaspoon other chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground caraway seeds ( optional, not recommended )
instructions: Drain any excess water from the pickles throughly, discarding any trimmings. Place the pickles, almonds, and carrots in a food processor. Pulse the vegetables until finely ground. Transfer the mixture to a medium bowl and stir in the saki paste or chilli paste, ground caraway seeds, and achiote. Cover and chill the mixture in the refrigerator at least 1 hour or up to 3 days to develop the flavors. Taste and adjust the seasoning.

Random Ingredients: courgette,soymilk,rice wine vinegar,red curry paste,mushroom cap,green chili pepper,sage,vanilla flavoring
title: Red Curry Vegetarian Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1/4 liter soymilk | 250 g mushrooms caps | 1 bunch fresh spinach | 1 fresh green chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla flavoring | 1/8 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Combine the soymilk, mushrooms, basil, chilli and curry paste in a blender and blend until smooth. Add the remaining ingredients, blend for a few seconds and pour into ramekin trays. Preheat the oven to 160°c. Bake for 5 minutes or place on a chopping board and cut into 5cm squares. Serve with a salad.

title: Yummy Coriander Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken wings, tips discarded | 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup olive oil, melted ( one stick ) | 1 jar deli-style whole kernel corn, drained | 2 tablespoons natural yoghurt | 1 cup finely chopped escarole ( optional ) | 1/4 cup walnut halves ( optional )
instructions: Arrange chicken wings in baking dish. In small bowl combine melted margarine, corn, yoghurt and escarole. Pour over chicken wings. Place in fridge to marinate approximately 30 minutes or longer. Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Bake for 30 minutes or until crisp and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,heavy cream,grand marnier,hard egg,beef sirloin,red pepper flake,margarine
title: Beef Au Juivre
ingredients: 2 pounds beef top sirloin, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes, or to taste | 1 pinch saffron threads, crushed ( optional ) | 2 dashes grand marnier ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons margarine, melted, or as needed
instructions: Tenderize beef strips with a meat hammer, a food processor, or mandolin with a slicing blade. Arrange beef strips in a wide, flat dish. Pour cream into a wide, thin layer. Sprinkle with parmigiano reggiano cheese, red pepper flakes, and saffron. Mix together grand marnier and margarine until mixture is smooth. Pour mixture over beef. Cover, and let marinate at room temperature 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pour melted margarine over the beef, and place in a baking dish. Roast in the preheated oven 15 minutes, or until meat is browned outside but not caramelized in the center.

Random Ingredients: cheese spread,rice wine,hot chili pepper,pork tenderloin,lemon peel,baking potato,basil leaf
title: Chile Pork Tenderloin With Basil and Lemon
ingredients: 5 large baking potatoes | 1 lb sweet fat pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 lemon peel, chopped finely | 1 cup basil leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 cup shredded mild cheese spread | 1/4 cup rice wine | 2 -3 tablespoons pickled hot chili peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Wrap each potato individually with a double thickness of aluminum foil that has been patted dry. Arrange the wrapped potatoes in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 1 to 1 1/4 hours. After the first ½ hour. Remove potatoes from oven and turn oven temperature up to 425 degrees f, then place potatoes on a piece of aluminum foil that has been patted dry. Cover potatoes with foil and return to oven for 30 minutes. Remove foil and potato from oven. Using a spatula, gently remove potatoes from foil, leaving a 1/2 inch border on each. Turn heat off and place potatoes in a bowl. Allow to cool in the microwave for 20 minutes. Peel potatoes and cut into 1/2 inch wide strips. Place a large dutch oven over high heat. Add 1 tablespoon vegetable oil to dutch oven and cook pork, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 10 minutes. Remove pork from the pot and set aside to keep warm. Stir together lemon peel, basil and cheese in a bowl. Spread both sides of each potato with the cheese mixture and sprinkle each with the chopped peeled chiles. Return potatoes to baking sheet and transfer to the oven. Bake until heated through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Immediately spoon reserved bacon fat evenly over both slices of pork. Heat a large nonstick skillet over low heat. Carefully place the bacon on the pan and cook until lightly browned, stirring occasionally. Remove bacon to a platter, leaving fat in skillet. Increase oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Place covered dutch oven into oven. Transfer to the preheated oven and bake for 12 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer to a warmed serving plate. Cover with foil and allow to cool 15 minutes before serving.

title: Yogurt Cheese Balls With Pistachios and Shallot
ingredients: 400 g plain yogurt | 80 g shallots, chopped | 80 g pistachios, chopped
instructions: Sieve the yogurt into a bowl. Add the shallots, and mix well. Add pistachios and mix well. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: pretzel,parsley leaf,yellow bell pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,lotus root
title: Pesche Potzaria
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 lbs mixed assorted fresh garden fresh lotus roots ( or winter squash including green peas ) | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, cut into thin wedges | 3/4 lb fresh pimento-stuffed pretzel ( about 3/4 cup size, see directions below ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil or 1/4 cup parsley leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Spray 13x9 inch metal baking dish with cooking spray. Remove the outer green leaves then cover the root ends tightly with aluminum foil. Bake until tender, about 12 hours. Peel off aluminum and discard the hard skin lining from the lotus roots and discard. Wash the root ends thoroughly under cold running water then shake off any sand or hard outer green skins. Cut the roots lengthwise into halves and then cut back into bite sized lengths, leaving the root 2 inches wide at each end. Place in the largest mixing bowl at room temperature for 15 minutes then stir well to break up any clumps. Meanwhile, rinse and peel all vegetables. Cut up the lotus roots into halves and then cut them into about 1/2 inch pieces. Place them in a large mixing bowl, stir in the carrot, green pepper and fresh basil, tossing to coat. Prepare a 10x6 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Toss the vegetables with the carrot mixture, distributing evenly in the baking dish. Sprinkle with the pretzel pieces. Cover dish tightly with foil and bake until hot, about 25 minutes. Uncover dish and stir well. Sprinkle with parsley leaves before serving.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,cannellini bean,meat,beef,cranberry bean,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Crock Pot Italian Goulash
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground meat | 1 lb lean ground beef, extra lean | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can cranberry beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cups red cabbage, shredded | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Brown meat in a skillet over medium heat and drain fat. Add all ingredients except cheese. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high 2 to 3 hours. Stir until thickened slightly. Remove lid, increase heat to high and boil until thickened slightly, about 20 minutes. Stir in cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Apple Casserole
ingredients: 10 apple rolls, cut to fit a large casserole dish | 3 kaffir lime leaves | 1/4 cup shredded colby cheese | nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange apple rolls on a baking sheet. Crush rolls lightly with the heel of your hand, and sprinkle evenly with bread crumbs. Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is golden brown and the apples are tender, about 40 minutes. Top with shredded cheese and sprinkle with nutmeg. Return to oven until cheese is melted, about 10 more minutes.

title: Italian Sausage
ingredients: 2 pounds italian sausage | 1 package seasoning
instructions: Slice the sausages about 1/4 inch thick. In a large skillet with a lid, fry the sausage until browned and cooked through. Drain, and place back in the skillet. Stir the seasoning into the sausage. Heat until the flavors have blended and the sausage links have turned brown. Allow to cool. Place the sausage mixture into a freezer safe plastic bag, and freeze it for at least 1 hour.

title: Roasted Peppers
ingredients: 4 large yellow bell peppers | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line a large cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Place the bell peppers on the prepared cookie sheet. In a small bowl, mix together the bouillon, and water, stirring until the liquid has been completely mixed inches. Pour mixture onto peppers and cook in the preheated oven for 1 hour.

title: Tasty Popcorn
ingredients: 1/4 cup fish sauce | 5 tablespoons corn oil | 3/4 cup cheese spread
instructions: Beat the corn oil and fish sauce with a whisk. Combine with other ingredients in a skillet. Toast popcorn on high just until bubbles begin to form and popcorn starts to crackle. Note, do not burn the popcorn. Instead, turn onto an oiled plate and flatten it a bit. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,cream mushroom soup,filling,poblano chile,garlic powder,dark brown sugar,tamari,chestnut
title: Mexican Chilies
ingredients: 2 cups cream of mushroom soup | 1 can cream of celery soup | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 6 cups diced poblano chiles | 1/2 cup tamari | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 cup chestnuts, with skin | 1/2 cup cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine all ingredients in a large crockpot, and mix thoroughly. Cover, and cook for 3 hours on low. Serve warm.

title: Orange and Lemon Peel Salad Recipe. (Healthy Version)
ingredients: 1 orange bell pepper | 2 tablespoons lemons or 2 tablespoons lime peel, finely grated | 1 tablespoon sake ( optional. add more for a less sweetened taste. )
instructions: Cut the bell pepper in half & remove the membrane. Peel the skin off the orange or lemon peel & cut the peppers into 1 or 2 inch pieces. Set aside. Juice the lemon or lime peel w/a small spoon but do not mash the pepper. Set aside. You'll want to have some oranges left over. If you don't have a juice pitcher, you can use an empty ice cream freezer bag. Put the pepper pieces, zest, sugar, & sake in a blender & process until smooth. Store in the fridge or freeze in the freezer.

title: Tamarind Treats (Veggies)
ingredients: 150 g firm tofu, drained | 200 g firm tofu, drained | 3 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons sliced of fresh mint ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cut the tofu into 2 or 4 pieces each and put it in a food processor and whizz until you have a mixture that resembles mashed potato. Add tamarind pulp and pulse until it reaches the desired consistency. Add 3/4 cup of water and mix well. Add the chopped mint and stir until the mixture is thoroughly mixed in, then add the tofu bits and pulse briefly so they are mixed with the dough. Keep in mind that the texture will vary based on how smooth and fluffy you want your treats to be. Roll out into a rectangle shape about 15x12in or so. Spread the tofu/tamarind mixture over the rectangle, then sprinkle with the sliced of fresh mint. Bake in a preheated oven, 200°c/400°f for about 20 - 25 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. Note, you can cut your treats into squares of similar sizes just place them on a pan or tray to cool them down. Serve these little treats warm or room temperature, as a snack or appetiser.

title: Kidney Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 6 teaspoons coriander powder | 3 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Place olive in a medium bowl. Add coriander, fenugreek and fenugreek seeds. Stir well. Add dry kidney beans and stir. Cook for 2 minutes serve rightaway.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,pork loin,asparagus spear,rice noodle,cheese,lasagna noodle,marshmallow
title: Asparagus, Pork, and Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces lasagna noodles | 1/2 lb pork loin, cut into bite sized pieces | 24 asparagus spears | 24 large marshmallows | 1 jar red currant jelly | 1 cup cooked rice noodles | 1 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Cook and drain lasagna noodles as directed on package. Rinse and drain noodles. While noodles are still hot, in a large bowl, toss with pork. Pour noodles over pork, and toss with asparagus and marshmallows until well coated. Set noodles aside. Arrange noodles over a bed of rice noodles. Spread one cup of jelly over noodles. Sprinkle evenly with cheese. Cover with another layer of noodles. Continue layering, ending with a layer of noodles. Cover, and refrigerate 3 hours. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top of each bowl before serving.

title: Lamb Fritters
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs of precooked lamb or 2 -3 lbs chops | 2 -3 slices country bread, day old, cut into chunks | 1 can crushed yellow cornmeal | 1/2 - 3/4 cup finely ground red pepper ( optional ) | 1 fresh serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno chiles, diced | 3 teaspoons salt ( as per taste ) or 3 teaspoons kosher salt | 3/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Dice the meat, if using, into small chunks. Remove the crusts from the bread, crumbs, salt and chiles. Combine 2 tbsp crushed cornmeal and 1/4 cup red pepper. Toss the meat in mixture until evenly coated. Heat a frying pan, add 3 tsp of oil, then sear meat on medium high heat until browned, turning only once. Set aside and drain any excess oil on the hot frying pan. Remove lamb meat from fry pan and place on a large plate. Drain excess fat from fry pan, if using. Add cornstarch mixture to fry pan and stir well, add the rest of the red pepper. Stir until sauce turns translucent. Add the diced chilis or chilies to fry pan and continue to stir until thickened and fragrant. Add the bread. Turn heat down to low, and cook 1 - 2 minutes more, stirring intermittently.

title: Roast Pork Cauliflower-Papadillas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cabbage, rinsed and patted dry | 1 lb cauliflower, rinsed and thickly chopped | 1 lb pork roast, sliced very thinly ( or smoked ) | 1 pork fat ( optional ) | 3 medium poblano chiles ( optional ) | 1/2 lb mixed dried fruit ( optional ) | salt | vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Line an 8 inch square baking pan with aluminum foil. Tear off enough of the outer leaves of the cabbage to make them fit into the pan. Place about an inch of water on the bottom of the pan to put the heat on if the pan starts to water. Remove the lid and place the cabbage and cauliflower on top of the water that has risen about an inch. Cut the pork fat into thin slices and reserve. Lightly salt the pork and set aside. Spread the slices of pork fat over top of the cabbage and cauliflower and using your fingers, roll each slice of pork evenly around the stuffing, pushing to cover the slices completely. Sprinkle some salt over the rolled pork and place seam side down in the prepared pan. Add the poblano chiles to the pan if using and place in the oven. After 5 to 7 minutes, lower the heat to 350 degrees and continue cooking for 50 to 60 minutes, until the internal temperature of the bacon reaches at least 145 degrees f.. Continue checking the pork as it cooks to make sure that the juices are no more visible when pierced with a knife.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,sea salt,red pepper,pita bread,shiitake mushroom,chili paste
title: Spicy Shiitake Mushrooms With Pita Chips
ingredients: 1/4 lb shiitake mushroom | 1 pinch chili paste ( optional ) | 1 pinch sea salt | 1 pinch red pepper | pitted flat leaf parsley ( to garnish ) | 4 pita bread
instructions: Clean shitake mushrooms if you have them. If not, cut them into quarters and remove stems. Finely chop the mushrooms and place in a bowl. Use a mortar and pestle or a blender for a coarse chop. Add 1/4 tsp chili paste if desired. Then add 1 tsp sea salt or 2 tsp red pepper. Mix everything throughly.
