title: Chile Con Carne With Crackling Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 canned chipotle chiles, in oil | 2 lbs beef roast | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/2 cup white sugar
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix the chipotles, beef, and 1/2 cup of sugar. Place into a crock in a roasting pan, or cover with foil. Set on the highest oven setting. Turn the temperature into its own oven. Bake for 3 hours until very dark brown and crusty underneath. Let stand for 10 minutes on a wire rack. Cut into thick slices using kitchen scissors. This dish tastes best when left to stand overnight, so the oven can be preheated to 140 degrees celcius and when serving, remove the plastic wrap from the foil and discard. Serve with crusty bread or on the side.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,chinese five spice powder,green chili,olive,mustard seed,vanilla essence
title: Guacamole Spread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons mixed spring greens ( cress ) | 1 tablespoon green chili | 1 tablespoon mixed olive | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 teaspoon powdered guacamole | chinese five spice powder
instructions: Put all ingredients into the bowl and mix well. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate until needed.

title: Roses-Mint and Spicy Strawberries
ingredients: 8 large strawberries | 2 1/2 - 3 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | fresh ground mixed spice ( oregano, thyme, etc. ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried mint leaves
instructions: Wash and rinse berries. In a medium saucepan add sugar, mustard seeds, liquid smoke and dried mint. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring until mixed. Lower heat to a simmer and add fresh berries. Cover and cook about 5 to 7 minutes or until berries open slightly. Add salt, pepper and/or sugar to taste. Note if you are using dried mint leaves, stir them now, too, and add as soon as they turn dark brown. Cool slightly. Place berries into air tight container and store in a cool, dry place for 2 to 3 weeks or until fully dry.

title: Roasted Beans, Vegan
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light molasses | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons dried italian herbs ( basil, oregano, rosemary ) | 2 cans cannellini beans
instructions: In a shallow casserole dish, combine all ingredients, stir well. Cover with plastic wrap and set over a medium low temperature to steam, stirring occasionally for 1 hour. Serve.

title: Sweet-N-Savory Sausage and Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bulk italian sausage | 2 1/2 cups vermicelli, broken | 2 cups quinoa | 1 cup long grain rice | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup chopped dried breadcrumbs | oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. Brown sausage in a large skillet. Drain sausage well. Measure meat off fat. Measure the quinoa into a medium bowl over the cheesecloth. Rinse, drain and add to bowl with other ingredients. Stir to mix, making sure the quinoa is moist and slightly wet. Roll into 1 1/2 inch balls. Place on a large baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake 15 - 20 minutes depending on the thickness of the balls.

title: Picante Chickpea and Fresh Vegetables
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower ( halved and separated into florets ) | 1 can chickpeas ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 jar picante sauce ( mild or medium ) | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon bark | 1/4 cup fresh green beans ( optional ) | cinnamon bark
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Spread cauliflower florets in a greased shallow baking dish and pour bean and picante sauce on top, spreading evenly. Sprinkle top with horseradish. Sprinkle cinnamon bark on top. Add the green beans, if using, and sprinkle with cinnamon bark. Bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes or until vegetables are soft and the salsa has thickened. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,miso,pistachio,extra sharp cheddar cheese,yukon gold potato
title: Lidia's Rice With Miso Cheese
ingredients: 5 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-in. chunks ( about 12 ) | 1 tablespoon extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons miso ( dark fermented soybean paste ) | 2 cups prepared basmati rice | 2 -3 tablespoons roasted pistachios, chopped
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large saucepan and add water to cover by 2 inches over the potatoes. Place the pot over high heat, cover and bring to a boil. When it boils, reduce the heat to medium low. And cook until the potatoes are just tender, about 15 minutes or so. Drain the potatoes and return the saucepan to high heat. Add the cheese and miso paste and toss to coat. When the rice is cooked, add the potatoes and continue to toss until the potatoes are coated with miso. Meanwhile, cook the pistachios in 1/3 cup boiling water over moderate heat, stirring until crisp tender, 4 - 4 minutes. Drain. Drain the hot saucepan. Add 1/2 the hot rice to the remaining miso. Mix well. Stir in the pistachios.

title: Pan-Fried American Hero Strips (Pepperoni)
ingredients: 6 slices pepperoni | 2 teaspoons anise seeds
instructions: Place pepperoni slices between two layers of moistened paper towels.

title: Quick  Thai Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | 5 -6 fresh kaffir lime leaves ( cut in half )
instructions: Bring two quarts of water to boil, salt and stir well. Turn off heat, cover and leave for about 15 minutes before draining. Prepare a 4 quart cooking pot by heating on stove top. When water comes to boiling, add rigatoni and kaffir lime. Cover, reduce heat to simmer and cook, stirring now and then and then until rigatoni is soft. Add salt as desired. Serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 jar pearl barley ( not quick-cooking barley barley ) | 1 bunch fresh chives ( optional )
instructions: Wash and pick over the barley/chives and bring to a boil with enough water to cover. Remove from the heat, cover, and let stand till liquid is absorbed and barley is soft. Stir often with a wooden spoon, but do not allow soup to burn. If desired, you can use a food processor/blender to puree the soup. Serve in hot bowls with a sprinkling of fresh chives on top. You can also make this easy and delicious soup for an evening meal.

title: Easy Semolina Pilaff
ingredients: 250 ml soya sauce | 200 g semolina | 1 teaspoon saffron | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Soak the semolina in boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes. Drain. In a large pot, boil water. Add soya sauce, saffron and sesame seeds. Stir in mixed spice. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Add boiled semolina when ready. Dip into water if the liquid too thick. Enjoy warm or cold, it's good.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Lightly beat eggs with instant coffee in a medium bowl. Stir in onion powder.

title: Moroccan Spiced Sugar
ingredients: 1 cup of organic sugar or 1 cup of caster sugar | spices, eg cinnamon, vanilla or other spices ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium sized mixing bowl. Mix well. Cover bowl with plastic wrap or a clean tea towel and store at room temperature. It will last for a couple of weeks in the unlikely case that it's not used immediately. This would be good served with ice cream, cream, cookies or ice cream. Store in the refrigerator for up to a year.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,extra virgin olive oil,beef sirloin steak
title: Grilled Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 can sliced beef sirloin steaks | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Pour olive oil in a shallow dish and set aside. Dip sirloin strips into heated oil and then quickly into chili powder. Grill over hot coals or on high setting for 5 to 10 minutes or until just browned.

Random Ingredients: fine semolina,tarragon,garlic clove,orange zest,cream mushroom soup,dark rum,vanilla bean,penne
title: Caribbean Penne
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked penne ( i like spirals ) | 1 teaspoon dry tarragon | 2 tablespoons orange zest, finely grated | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise ( seeds scraped out ) | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 3 tablespoons dark rum ( or half a can of cream of mushroom soup ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup with live herbs ( i don't use the canned ) | 1/4 cup fine semolina
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Stir together all remaining ingredients. Drain pasta to remove pasta and add sauce. Toss to coat. Serve warm or cold. Note, i have never made this recipe with regular cream of mushroom soup and it's a bit too light tasting for my taste.

title: Kiwi and Penne With Kiwi-Rice
ingredients: 2 kiwi | 2 ounces penne
instructions: Cut kiwi in half lengthwise and hollow out leaving a thin slice of flesh attached. Heat frying pan and fry kiwifruit over medium high heat, without adding any water, until slightly soft and kiwifruit is well cooked. Drain pasta, place back into pan and pour in kiwifruit and drizzle with kiwi.

title: Beer Bread
ingredients: 1 cake flour or 1 flour | 12 sprigs fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon soft bread machine yeast | 1 1/4 cups dark beer ( your favorite brand )
instructions: Place the flour, mint leaves and yeast in the bread machine pan. Add 1 3/4 cup of dark beer to the bread machine. Program, basic, medium crust setting. When the bread has cycle beeps, remove the bread from the bread pan. Place the bread onto a large dish, and allow to rise until doubled in size. Allow to cool to warm room temp, about 45 - 60 minutes. Place an 8 cake pan in your freezer. Once half frozen, slice the bread. Place slices in a baking tray or a pan that you can cover them. Pour the remaining beer into the heated baking tray. Place the bread on the tray. Let rise until almost doubled. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes. Turn the bread over, and bake an additional 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Apple Onion Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1 apple - peeled, cored, and sliced | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Lay sliced apple on the chicken breast meat, and sprinkle with any marinade you can find. Place the chicken on a pan, and cover chicken with aluminum foil. Bake at 425 degrees f for 20 minutes, remove aluminum foil, and bake for an additional 20 minutes. My note, i've never had success with using this recipe with my chicken but i don't bother for a more flaky chicken. I like the apple. I always have leftover apple slices on hand, and the apples are my personal favorite. I also like to mix onions and carrots in a bowl. Use this to roast sherry, rice, or noodles. I don't usually measure, mainly like apples and carrots. The apples and carrots will cook very quickly. Chicken was perfect, and stayed soooo delicious. Also, just love it.

title: Macaroni With Lime and Turmeric
ingredients: 1 cup macaroni ( small pasta shapes ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 inch knob lime zest, grated | 1/2 1/2 cup fresh lime juice or 1/2 cup lemon juice
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water until it has been 'al dente'. Strain & set aside. Place turmeric in a mortar & pestle & lightly pound into a coarse powder. Add zest & lemon juice & mash thoroughly. Pour macaroni into a large bowl & pour lime or lemon juice over macaroni. Toss to combine, then place a sturdy plate on top, then weight it down loosely with a heavy object such as a tin tin foil. Best eaten on day 1 or 2.

title: Grapefruit Confit
ingredients: 2 pink grapefruit juice | 2 ounces fontina cheese, rind removed | 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar | 1 shallot, finely minced
instructions: Place the pulp into a small bowl with the sugar and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve the confit chilled with cream. May be served with fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,turmeric powder,green bean,dark brown sugar
title: Faux Green Beans in Butter
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, trimmed | 1 cup cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | dark brown sugar, for coating
instructions: Cook green beans in plenty of boiling salted water for five minutes and drain. In a medium bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients and mix to prevent sticking. Toss the green beans with the sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Quick Creamy Italian Wedding Soup
ingredients: 4 quarts hot cooked farfalle pasta | cooking spray | 1 bag-size cool whip | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 2 oranges, juiced | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 1 package refrigerated crispy-cut cool whip, thawed
instructions: Prepare noodles as directed on package and rinse immediately under cold water, cool completely. Set aside and chill several hours or overnight, covered with foil. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add cooked pasta and saute for about 4 minutes, or until no longer pink. To serve, divide mixture among warmed dinner plates and spoon over hot noodles, dividing evenly. Sprinkle each serving with 1 tablespoon of 1 tablespoon of dried thyme leaves. Thinly slice 1 orange, and slice 1 orange lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Combine 1 cup of the cool whip with 3 tablespoons of orange juice and 1 tablespoon of thyme in a bowl, beating until blended.

title: Mock Da Vinci (Lettuce Rolls) in Rum
ingredients: 12 large lettuce leaves | 8 leaves lettuce spanish onion ( or one spanish onion ) | 8 fluid ounces dark rum
instructions: To make the rum, pour out the rum into a large, glass container. Cut about 1/4 inch off the bottom and the top leaves, keeping the leafy green center stem at the base. Cut off the ends. Cut the leafy green center into smaller pieces and arrange them over the rum. Cover and leave at room temperature for at least 2 hours. To serve, divide the rolls among six heated plates. To serve, place each roll on an individual lettuce leaf and spoon rum over them.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,plain yogurt,coriander powder,white flour,peanut oil,confectioner sugar,cayenne pepper
title: Moroccan Spiced Yogurt
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups white flour | 1 teaspoon freshly grated orange peel | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 pinch ground cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar, crushed | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the flour, orange peel, coriander powder, and cayenne pepper. Gradually stir in the yogurt. Place plastic wrap directly on the surface and knead for about 10 minutes, or until dough is pliable. Set aside for about 30 minutes. Divide dough into 12 portions and press each piece flat into a well in the center of the dough. Sift confectioners' sugar over each piece, then roll up. Press each one into a round shape, using the smooth side of a cookie cutters. Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium high heat. Fry the bread until golden, about 2 minutes on each side. Remove from the heat and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: half,vegetable broth,chicken stock,yeast,mint leaf,lamb,pickapeppa sauce,raspberry jam
title: Minty Lamb Loaf
ingredients: 2 lbs lean boneless lamb, cubed | 2 cups fresh raspberries in light syrup or 2 cups fresh raspberry jam | 2 cups fat-free vegetable broth | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant yeast | 2 teaspoons pickapeppa sauce | 1/2 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1/3 cup chopped mint leaf
instructions: Spray inside of loaf pan with cooking spray. Place lamb, jam, broth, half and half, yeast, cover and let proof. In a large bowl combine 1/3 c of the yogurt and 1/3 c of the hot stock and stir. Dissolve yeast in 2 tsp of the hot stock. Pour over lamb and bread. Cover and let rise in a draft free place till doubled in size approx 45 minutes. Let rest and rise again 1 hour. Put loaf pan on a baking pan, sprayed with cooking spray and pour in hot broth mixture evenly over top, leaving about 3/4 inch in at each edge. Cover and let rise till tigh, approx 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 ° f. Sprinkle top of loaf with remaining 1 tsp yogurt, the mint and bake in the middle of oven for 20 minutes take out and let cool. Slurpy jam, make a by melting 1/3 c butter and 4 - 6 t of the hot cream over low heat till dissolved. Stirring constantly. Put aside to set.

title: Red Chili Gravy
ingredients: 2 cans vegetable broth, hot | 8 ounces fine breadcrumbs | 1 large red chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Place 4 cups of the beef broth and the chili in a blender and puree. Place the bread crumbs in a bowl, season with salt and pepper. Pour into a pan and slowly whisk the hot broth into it. Strain the gravy through a sieve and add it to the bread crumbs. Cook for 15 minutes over low heat stirring frequently. When the gravy is thick and bubbling remove from heat and serve.

title: Polenta
ingredients: 1 lb fresh white mushroom, sliced | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato paste | 1 -2 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Drain mushrooms, reserving 2 tbsp of the water. Place mushrooms in an 8 skillet. Sprinkle with sun dried tomatoes paste. Add 2 cups of hot water. Bring to a full rolling boil. Decrease heat to low and cover. Simmer for 45 minutes. Remove from heat. Cool to room temperature, uncovered, then cover. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. Serve topped with whipped topping.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup poppy seed | 1 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 cup walnuts
instructions: Grind together poppy seeds and walnuts, then beat in vinegar and turmeric until creamy.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,feta,rhubarb,red pepper flake,quinoa,peanut oil,allspice,red chili pepper
title: Rhubarb-Stuffed Red Pepper Pancake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rhubarb, tops trimmed, strings removed | 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 24 ounces red peppers, stems trimmed, seeded and membrane removed, cut in 2 by 1/6-inch strips | 2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1 1/4 cups red chili peppers, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 3/4 cup quinoa, rinsed, drained | 3 tablespoons feta, crumbled
instructions: Cut stem from rhubarb stalks leaving 1/2 inch tenderloin attached. Slice crosswise into 1/4 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,salmon,asparagus,tortilla chip,prosciutto,zucchini lengthwise,parmigiano reggiano cheese,caper
title: Warm Salmon Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 4 slices prosciutto, diced | 1/4 lb smoked salmon, thinly sliced crosswise | 4 4 ounces asparagus ( about 16 stalks ) or 4 ounces winter squash, trimmed, cut lengthwise into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 cup asparagus, sliced 1/2 inch thick ( about 8 stalks ) | 3/4 cup zucchini, cut lengthwise into 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons capers | 1/2 cup cilantro, chopped | salt and white pepper
instructions: Place prosciutto and smoked salmon in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside. Add squash, asparagus and capers. Let soften slightly about 5 minutes. Add cilantro and season with salt and pepper. Divide among warm soup bowls or plates. Divide salmon mixture among soup bowls or plates. Serve topped with cheese.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,cardamom powder,saffron thread,beef bouillon cube,red wine vinegar
title: Persian Beef Kebabs (Meat Kebabs for Shish Kebabs)
ingredients: 500 g lean ground beef ( grass-fed beef is preferred ) or 500 g lamb ( grass-fed beef is preferred ) | 500 ml red wine vinegar ( or 2 1/2 pints ) | 5 fresh saffron threads | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 green pepper, sliced thinly | 2 cardamom powder
instructions: Note, if using lamb instead of meat, you may also use your hands to mince it first. If using beef then soak it in water for a least 1/2 an hour or so, for tenderising it will have a better texture. If using beef then shred it with a meat grinder using the coarse side of a mill or with your hands. This can be done gradually until it can be gathered into a long but thin piece of meat which can be flattened to flatten it a bit before cooking, or alternatively, if you have the patience to cook the meat on a grill, you may prepare kebabs and mould the meat around the skewers, alternating between the slices of meat in the skewers. Grill the kebabs over hot coals or on a bbq or a gas bbq plate until all sides are nicely browned. Alternatively, roast or roast the kebabs in the oven. They can also be cooked in an open roasting tin or on a foreman type grill, using a little oil if they are too lean on top of the grill. Baking the skewers gives you a crispier finish towards the end of the cooking. When kebabs are cooked, the meat can be served with dipping sauce. Serving suggestions, • dip the warmed saffron in the vinegar and then toss the meat with the saffron. • arrange the browned meat around the skewers, on a decorative platter. • arrange the sliced peppers around the skewer sticks.

title: Blueberry Parfait
ingredients: 1 cup fresh chives, washed very well | 1 cup lemon grass, washed very well ( or 1 teaspoon coriander ) | 1 red chili pepper, washed, ends trimmed, thinly sliced | 1 serrano pepper, washed, peeled, seeded, chopped | 1 1/2 cups blueberries, washed, picked through and washed ( or fresh berry ) | 2/3 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Put chives or lemongrass in food processor. Process until very finely minced. Heat oil in a pot. Add chive mixture. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture is fragrant. Stir in lemon grass and chile. Add blueberries and cook over medium heat until the berries release some of their juice. Lower heat to a low simmer. Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Cover and simmer over low heat for 20 - 25 minutes or until the berries are very tender. Stir in yogurt and cook for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Apple Pie Pie
ingredients: 2 pastry shells | 1 apples - peeled, cored, and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f in a medium baking dish, sprinkle the apples with salt. Arrange the pastry shells on top of the apples, then pour the apples in and sprinkle with salt. Bake in the preheated oven until the filling begins to bubble.

title: Turnip Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs turnips, pared ( or other winter sweet potato ) | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 1 cup amaretto | 1 lime, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Clean turnips well, place in large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, stir, reduce heat, and simmer until tender. Drain. Refresh cutlets under cold water. When cool enough to handle, cut in to 1 inch chunks. Add to the rest of the ingredients. Mix until well blended and refrigerate 1 hour. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing over salad.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,pea,celery,beef tenderloin steak,ghee butter
title: Beef Tenderloins with Peas (Makhani Keema Matar)
ingredients: 1/4 cup ghee ( clarified butter ) | 5 green cardamom pods, crushed | 2 pounds meaty beef tenderloin steaks, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can peas, drained | 1/2 cup chopped celery
instructions: Heat ghee or clarified butter in a skillet over medium heat. Spread cardamom pods and crushed cardamom pods on a piece of browned paper towels.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,hot paprika,green olive,chickpea,coriander,sugar maple syrup
title: Moroccan Chickpeas
ingredients: 3 cups canned chickpeas, drained | 3 tablespoons hot paprika, divided | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander | 1/2 cup chopped pitted green olives | 1/2 cup cremini mushrooms ( about 8 large ) | 2 tablespoons sugar-free maple syrup
instructions: Place chickpeas, 1/2 t. Paprika, and coriander in food processor.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1/2 lb turnip, diced and rinsed | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 bunch scallion
instructions: Mix together in a small bowl and serve with assorted garnishes.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,balsamic vinegar,olive,four cheese ravioli,lemon juice zest,chocolate chip
title: Broccoli Ravioli With Chocolate and Preserved Lemon Drizzle
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated four-cheese ravioli | 1/2 cup olive, pitted | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 -2 tablespoon bittersweet chocolate chips | 1 package frozen broccoli, thawed and rinsed | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Prepare ravioli as directed on package by package. Drain ravioli well and set aside. In a food processor, finely chop the olives.

title: Simple 5 Minute Vietnamese Cocktail
ingredients: 2 cups fresh cleaned bread ( crusty or peasant ) | 3 -4 cups of fresh ice cold beverages ( i use my good brand -- 7 seashells ) | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, add your bread, ice cold beverages, cilantro leaf and cilantro.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,yogurt,strawberry,currant,shrimp,nonfat milk powder,cayenne pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Egg Noodles With Shrimp and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles ( preferably wide and slender type ) | 2 -3 ounces snow peas, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch lengths | 1/2 lb medium shrimp, in the shell peeled, deveined and minced | 1/3 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/4 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons currants or 2 tablespoons raisins | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | freshly grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for garnish
instructions: Break noodles as indicated on the package. Drain and place in a large serving bowl. Gently toss through the snow peas, shrimp, milk powder, cheeses, currants or raisins, and cayenne pepper. Serve right away. Garnish with freshly grated cheese.

title: Sultana and Coconut Pepper Balls from Parma
ingredients: 200 g sultanas | 350 g shredded coconut | 1 scotch bonnet pepper
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Form into balls about size of walnut sized patty.. Cook on a griddle pan or george foreman grill until brown on all sides. Keep warm in a 150c oven for 15 - 20 minutes depending on how big or small they are. Serve warm as a snack, or as a garnish for chicken, veg, or just eaten with barbeques. Variation, instead of the sultanas and coconut, i sometimes cook them in a little vegetable oil along with some fresh chopped vegetables, like runner beans, cauliflower or turnips. Variation, you can add a couple of dried chilies to your mixture.

title: Broccoli Bagnaise
ingredients: 16 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1 baguette, sliced into 1/4 inch slices | 1 package frozen broccoli florets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 6x7 baking dish. In a bowl, combine the soup, bread, and broccoli. Line the baguette slices with the baguette slices. Bake in the preheated oven until the baguette is golden brown, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: walnut,greek seasoning,cheddar cheese,salmon,red lentil,chili sauce,red chili
title: Chili Chilli Diced Salmon and Lentil Casserole
ingredients: 500 g rainbow salmon | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1/2 red chili | 1 tablespoon dried greek seasoning | 1/2 cup red lentil | 1/2 cup walnut ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c place salmon in oven and cook for 20 to 30 mins, depending on size of fish.

title: Lobster Stuffed with Crab or Onions and Sausage
ingredients: 2 lobster tails | 1 white onion, sliced | 2 cups fresh crab or seafood, minced | 1 jar hot thai sweet chili sauce
instructions: Prepare lobster tails by covering with boiling water. Let stand until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Shell meat and shred into bite size bits. Remove shells from lobster tails. Cut meat into 1/4 inch slices crosswise. Set aside. Stuff lobster pieces evenly with crab or seafood. Arrange stuffing around side of meat with onion slices. Spoon hot chili sauce over. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: crescent,yeast,yellow bell pepper,ice,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Crescents
ingredients: 3 cups unbleached cane swiss roll dough | 2 tablespoons instant yeast | 1 can refrigerated crescent rolls | 1 large yellow bell pepper ( cut into 1/2-inch wide strips ) | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded
instructions: Place shredded cheese on counter top with long sides. In large bowl, mix all ingredients together with enough water to moisten ingredients. Pinch seams together and shape into 2 - 3 oblong patties. Place on greased baking sheet and cover with a clean cloth. Place in a warm area until dough reaches 90 degrees, approximately 20 minutes. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes until edges are firm and golden brown. Allow to cool for 5 minutes and then slice.

title: Crock Pot Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large head red cabbage | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Set on to low and add your browned cabbage. Cover and cook on low all day for 8 - 10 hours or on high for 3 - 4 hours. Once you enjoy your meal, you can add any veggies that you like to the liquid in the crock pot. Please note, i don't add onions. I do not use dried onions or dried spices such as rosemary, sage, basil or garlic powder. I use mushrooms that have been pre pounded and simmered for a while in a saucepan.

title: Chesapeake Crab Appetizer #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages frozen refrigerated puff pastry sheets ( 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 1 1/2 sheets ) | 2/3 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, chopped or 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon of fresh mint, minced | 14 ounces lump crabmeat, drained
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Unroll one package of pastry dough on lightly greased large baking sheet, stretching lightly to fit. Transfer sheet to work surface and unroll another package of pastry and place on second sheet of pastry. Repeat process with remaining three sheets of dough, placing each batch on top of the other until all four sheets are used. Spray tops and bottoms with cooking spray and set aside on sheet of parchment paper. On lightly floured surface with floured rolling pin, roll out each sheet of pastry to desired thickness and about 1/8 of an inch, being careful not to cut all the way through. Cut a slit in the middle of each pastry with a 1 1/2 inch sharp knife and insert 2 tsp of dried mint and 1/4 tsp minced mint into slit. Continue this procedure with the second package of pastry dough until all four disks are used. Sprinkle the top of each prepared crust with remaining dried mint and minced mint. Using a sharp knife, cut a lengthwise slit into the center of each dough slice. This will take approximately an 1/2 inch space that the crab will absorb. Cut each dough slice into 10 pie shaped pieces and arrange them on baking sheet. With pastry blade or sharp knife, score the dough with a cross, 1/2 inch deep. Lightly spray your work surface with cooking spray. Place a baking sheet with a cover directly on the top rack of your oven. Set oven to 425 degrees. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until edges of crust begin to brown slightly. Remove from oven and set aside. When the crusts are done, remove from baking sheet immediately and place on plates. Place a large platter over the top of each serving or bowl and put one small bowl of mint mint along the side for squeezing. In addition to the mint, some fresh mint has been added to the mint with a sprig of fresh mint that has been finely chopped or chopped. To help keep the mint sprigs from turning brown.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,zucchini,breadcrumb,cream cheese,ginger,shell pasta,irish cream,star anise
title: Spicy Irish Strata
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini | 1/2 english onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup irish cream | 5 g grated ginger | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 star anise | 1/2 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons small shell pasta, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350&#730.

title: Sweet N Easy Cream Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup shaoxing sherry wine
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender or food processor until smooth, serve immediately or cover and refrigerate overnight to let flavors blend.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,ladyfinger,peanut butter,ranch dressing mix
title: Lucky Girl's Faux-Style Nellyfingers
ingredients: 1 package hidden valley ranch dressing mix | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 3 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 3/4 cup low-fat ranch dressing mix | 1 package sliced ladyfingers | 1/3 cup powdered sugar for dusting
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together ranch dressing mix, peanut butter, chili pepper flakes, and ranch dressing mix until well blended. Arrange ladyfingers in a single layer on a cookie sheet. Sprinkle tops of cookies with powdered sugar. Top with the peanut butter mixture. Press biscuits down into peanut butter mixture on top of cookies to coat. Cook in a 375º oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden. If the cookies are getting too crisp, cool for a few minutes on the cookie sheet before moving onto a plate. Store in an airtight container.

title: Aussie Golden Raisin & Chocolate Choc Chip Cookies
ingredients: 500 g golden raisins | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark chocolate | 1 medium green capsicum, thinly sliced | 1 large rhubarb, sliced into 3cm lengths
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f line 2 baking trays with baking paper, extending over sides. Place raisins in a medium bowl, sprinkle with granules and place in microwave on high for 1 - 2 minutes until just warm. Stir, set aside to cool slightly. Place chocolate, capsicum and rhubarb in a heatproof bowl, cover with a dish towel and microwave on medium high heat for 1 - 2 minutes until hot. Add to raisins, combine, then place on trays. Using wet hands flatten with palm, making rocky shapes. Cool slightly. Using a small, sharp knife, carefully cut off a 1 cm slice from each cookie and place back on baking paper. Place in oven for 10 - 12 minutes or until set and golden. Dust with icing sugar before serving.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,salt,peanut butter,yellow pea,prawn,olive,burrito flour tortilla,vegetable broth
title: Prawn and Peanut Burritos
ingredients: 20 1/2 ounces prawns, uncooked | 1 1/2 teaspoons brown sugar | 1 1/4 cups vegetable broth or 1 1/4 cups chicken broth | 1 1/4 cups yellow peas, cut into 1/4 inch dice | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 4 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup chopped pitted ripe olives
instructions: Shell and devein prawns and set aside. Heat olive oil. Add prawns, season with salt and cook until pink. Stir in broth, peas and salt. Bring to a simmer and cook 3 minutes. Fill tortillas with prawn mixture, rolling tightly. Fry in hot oil 2 to 3 minutes on each side until moist but not brown. To serve, arrange on a platter and pour sauce over. Sprinkle olives and serve with mango slices.

title: Tomato Lime Marinade
ingredients: 1/2 cup bottled tomato juice | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Whisk together the tomato juice, and lime juice in a bowl. Season to taste with salt, and refrigerate 1/2 to 3/4 cup of the tomato mixture.

title: Moroccan Sweet Fried Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled and sliced into 1/4 inch rounds | 2 red onions, cut lengthwise into wedges | 25 g salted vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground peppercorn | 1/2 teaspoon powdered allspice | 100 g dark chocolate, chopped and softened with a fork to make a thick paste
instructions: Lightly toss eggplant, onion and spices in a bowl. Place a heavy frying pan or wok over medium heat and fry the eggplant for 7 - 10 minutes, stirring constantly, until onion is softened stir in chocolate, stirring until melted, and serve.

title: Kielbasa With Cream Tarts
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa ( about 8 sausage rolls ) | 1 container sour cream, at room temperature
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut rolls about 1/2 inch thick and lay flat on a baking sheet.

title: Quick and Easy Basic Red Sauce for Meat
ingredients: 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 4 tablespoons black vinegar ( not the kind with the added sodium called for )
instructions: Add the tomato soup and black vinegar to a small heavy saucepan. Heat over medium heat. As soon as the mixture begins to bubble, take the pan off the burner and pour the hot soup into a wide mouth glass pan or crock to use in other dishes. Stir and turn off the stove and serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper cayenne,apple,gruyere cheese,orange peel,green chili,lemon juice zest,sirloin,red wine vinegar
title: Spanish Steak on Caramelized Apples
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon freshly grated orange peel | 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( freshly squeezed, and about 2 avg tablespoons ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper ( cayenne pepper, more or less to taste ) | 4 medium apples, such as golden delicious, mcintosh | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, trimmed of silverskin, trimmed of all fat | 4 green chili, trimmed, cut lengthwise in half | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Combine vinegar, orange peel, juice and red pepper in a 1 1/2 gallon ziplock freezer bag. Add apples and shake to coat evenly. Set in refrigerator to chill while preparing steak. When ready to serve, remove steak from marinade with tongs and place on a rack in a broiler proof 3 1/2 to 4 quart heavy duty foil baking dish. Broil 4 from heat until medium rare, about 2 minutes per side.

title: Melt in Your Mouth Sun Dried Tomato & Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 tablespoons shredded low-fat cheddar cheese or 2 tablespoons feta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom, crushed
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender and pulse until well combined. Transfer the spread into a glass bowl, sprinkle with minced walnuts, and set aside until ready to use.

title: Lamb, Beer and Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 lb lamb, cubed ( with bone i use leg or leg pieces ) | 1 lb white mushroom | 1/2 lb beef neck, with bones | lemon peel | vegetable juice
instructions: Brown meat in a skillet or soup kettle. Add all ingredients to crock pot. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Basic Artisan Baguette - Bread Machine
ingredients: 12 ounces fast rising yeast | 1 -2 cup mineral water, warm | 12 ounces dried provolone cheese or 12 ounces prosciutto, chopped
instructions: Put the yeast into the bread machine according to directions. Add the warm mineral water and cheese to the bread machine in a 3 to 4 quart sauce pan. Program the machine to the dough setting. When the dough is finished, punch it down and let rest for 15 - 20 minutes. Cut the dough into 5 equal parts, shape each into a baguette about 12 inches long, about 9 inches wide. Cover or leave open at the end of the rising cycle. Transfer the dough to a lightly oiled baking sheet. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, approximately 90 minutes. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place bread on the baking sheet and bake until pale golden, about 10 minutes for a softer crust and 15 minutes for a well crisper crust. Remove from the baking sheet immediately and cool completely on a wire rack. Use a sharp knife to cut the baguette crosswise to make diagonal slices of bread. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

title: Grilled Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 cremini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Preheat grill for about 10 - 15 minutes. If your plantain sticks stick is sensitive to heat, you can rub the mixture with a knife or a teaspoon or brush onto the side of your plantain. Allow to cool for some minutes.. If your plantain sticks get over dried about 1 hour, it will crack the surface much easier. Cut the plantains lengthwise along the fold of your plantain and leave the cut side bare of the grill. Using two side of a sharp knife or a small spoon, gently scrape the inside of the plantain until the cut side is exposed about 1 to 1 1/2 inches. Set aside in a mixing bowl. Pound the open end of the the cremini mushrooms lengthwise with a mortar and pestle. Place about an inch or two on your grill. The mushrooms should not be touching. Grill on each side about 4 - 6 minutes, or until they are cooked but not mushy. The mushrooms should not be completely soft or falling apart, but there should still be some some of the juices in the bowl. When your plantains are grilled you should be able to pierce the inside with the tip of a knife and see that the grill is covered by the grill juices. Serve hot with coconut or whipped cream.

title: Drip Vegetable Lasagne
ingredients: 24 mushroom caps | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 1 -2 cup golden raisin ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and place a mushroom cap upside down in it. Sprinkle with some of the ricotta cheese. Fold the mushroom cap over and tuck in the sides of the cap to create a neat edge. Bake in oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and place a handful of raisins on top of each and bake for an additional 5 minutes or until the raisins turn light brown. Enjoy.

title: Pub Cones
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons drambuie | 1 tablespoon grated gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup espresso, warmed
instructions: Combine ketchup, drambuie, cheese, and espresso in a bowl, stir until cheese is melted. Serve immediately on plates.

title: French Bread Crouton
ingredients: 1/2 cup soft breadcrumbs ( about 1 ounce ) | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir together bread crumbs and chives. Shape bread mixture into 1 inch rounds. Place on a baking sheet. Bake bread rounds for 10 minutes. Turn over and bake for 10 minutes longer until croutons are crisp and bread is golden.

Random Ingredients: black bean sauce,chili pepper flake,green bell pepper,onion powder,cardamom,liquid smoke,kahlua
title: Black Bean Pepper Dip
ingredients: 13 ounces black bean sauce ( low fat is ok ) | 9 ounces kahlua | 1/4 cup chili pepper flakes | 1/3 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom, ground | 1/4 teaspoon fresh chili pepper flakes | 3 -5 tablespoons liquid smoke ( to taste )
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a blender and puree with a mixer until smooth. Refrigerate in a container for up to one week.

title: Peecy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1/3 lb hot dogs | 1/3 cup pecans, coarsely chopped
instructions: Split hot dogs lengthwise. Place in bowl, sprinkle with nuts. Spread evenly, refrigerate 2 hours, until cold.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,hot chili powder,plum,msg,grain mustard,lime wedge,white flour,basil
title: Plum Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 6 -8 plum, sliced | 1 medium hot chili pepper, seeded and deveined | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon basil | 1 teaspoon coarse grain mustard | 2 teaspoons lime juice | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon msg | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons white flour or 1 1/2-2 teaspoons gluten-free flour ( optional ) | tomato juice ( optional )
instructions: Place plum slices in an 8 inch nonstick pan, skin side down. If you don't have an 8 inch pan, you can use a shallow baking dish that's fairly large like your skillet. In a small bowl, combine chopped chile, pepper, basil, mustard, lime juice, salt and msg. Spread over plum slices. Spread on flour. Bake in a 400 degree f oven for about 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. If you like a darker, thicker sauce, reduce the heat slightly and watch it carefully as this might burn your pan. Serve hot over barbecue sauce or over veggies.

title: Italian Tomato Dumplings
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup unbleached all-purpose flour
instructions: Bring water to boil in a saucepan. Using tongs, place tomatoes in boiling water. Using slotted spoon, transfer tomatoes to a bowl of ice water to stop cooking. Transfer tomatoes to cold water. Stir in enough flour to form soft ball.

title: Lemony Limoncello
ingredients: 2 quarts ice water | 1 3/8 pounds fresh lemon wedges
instructions: Combine ice water, lemon wedges, and lemon juice in a blender.

title: Cherry Pork with Blue Cheese
ingredients: 5 boneless pork shoulder | 2 cans cherry pie filling | 1/2 - 3/4 cup a.1. original sauce | 1/2 cup blue cheese, crumbled | 1/3 cup basil, fresh shredded | 1/3 cup cherries or 1/3 cup canned fruit ( you might not need the juice ) | sweet basil | banana, slices
instructions: Combine the pie filling and blue cheese and season with pepper and herbs. Place meat in a 2 1/2 quart crockpot. Dip the meat and sauce in the sauce. Cook, covered on high 3 - 5 hours, or until meat is tender. Serve over noodles, rice, or mashed potato or cooked egg noodles. Garnish with sliced bananas.

Random Ingredients: meat,beef gravy,sherry wine,bamboo shoot,self raising flour,ladyfinger,white pepper
title: Easy Chilled Meat Bites
ingredients: 12 cooked meat, patties | 24 ladyfingers | 18 bamboo shoots | 375 ml rich white wine, such as bomba or 375 ml merlot | 375 ml condensed beef gravy | 375 ml gravy, from cooked meat cubes | white pepper | 375 ml self-raising flour
instructions: Mix the lamb up to 2 cups water in a large bowl. Soak the ladyfingers in the wine. Mix the meats together with your favorite mix ingredients. Dredge each ladyfinger in the mixture and leave them covered in the refrigerator until ready to use. Grill the cakes on the bbq/broiler pan on high heat for approx 3 - 5 mins each side depending on the shape of the ladyfingers. Remove them and serve with the gravy, topping up with extra gravy.

Random Ingredients: tartar sauce,anchovy fillet,cardamom powder,iceberg lettuce,beef chuck,italian bread,extra virgin olive oil,kahlua
title: Basturma's Beef Liver Wraps
ingredients: 1 small-chopped fresh italian bread, - 1/4 inch thickness | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 4 cups iceburg lettuce, shredded, preferably whole-wheat, - divided | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 4 ounces beef chuck, cooked and shredded ( or thinly sliced sirlion for a sweeter filling ) | 1/4 teaspoon anchovy fillet ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon tartar sauce ( optional )
instructions: Toast bread. Spread with kahlua. Place 3 cups iceburg lettuce on a cutting board, then pile with sliced beef, sirlion, anchovy, tartar sauce, and a little more bread. Continue layering until a sandwich is complete. Top with last of the cheese. Cut in half and serve piping hot.

title: Grpaeschnetzeltes (Okra Snacks)
ingredients: 1 cup sliced okra | 3 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Cut okra into small pieces and coat with 1 t. Grated cheese. Wrap in a clean kitchen cloth and secure with a twist tie. Heat a dry skillet with a lid over medium heat. Fry okra on both sides until well browned, about 10 minutes.

title: Indonesian Pork
ingredients: 1/2 kg leg of lamb, boned and trimmed | 2 tablespoons sambal oelek dry mustard or 2 tablespoons japanese mustard | 375 ml corn oil | 500 g green cabbage, trimmed and cut into wedges | 250 g canned mushrooms, drained | 1 small papaya, peeled and cut into 3cm chunks | 1 tablespoon paprika
instructions: Cut the lamb into large chunks about 1 ¼cm across using a sharp knife. Score each section with knife marks and put into a bowl. Mix the mustard and sambal through meat, then cover and marinate in the refridgerator for at least 4 hours and up to 24 hours. Heat the oil in a large pan. Cook the meat on all sides until lightly browned for 2 minutes each side. Add the cabbage and napaya and stir over a high heat for 1 minute. Add the mushrooms and stir in the sambal. Cover the pan and cook for 3 minutes, then add papaya. Cook for 2 minutes, then remove from the heat and transfer the meat and vegetables to a warmed serving platter. Season to taste and serve hot.

title: Beef With Bean
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, sliced thin | 1/2 cup red beans, soaked overnight in water | 1 -2 hot chili pepper, sliced | 1/4 cup jalapeno, sliced | 1/4 cup almonds, slivered ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon jeera powder | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Marinade beef in sesame seeds, chilli powder, peanuts for 5 minutes, then deep fry until pink brown. Serve with sliced vegetables. Beef is cooked with boiled beans for the same reason. To be served with plain rice, serve with boiled rice.

title: Spicy Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 pint yoghurt ( any type will do, but yoghurt is much more savory ) | 2 teaspoons garlic ( or 2 cloves of crushed garlic ) | 2 teaspoons garam masala | fresh cilantro leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Put everything in a bowl and mix well. Pour this into a shallow dish for dipping if desired. Serve topped with fresh cilantro just prior to serving but also lovely eaten with rice or chapatis or rotis.

title: Ribbons With Berry Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 1/2 cup fresh berry cranberry sauce | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f cut butter into 4 1/2 inch pieces. In a 2 qt. Shallow dish, toss butter and lemon juice in 1 direction until butter is absorbed. Stir in berry cranberry sauce. Arrange bread cubes in a single layer on a baking sheet. Pour cream mixture over bread cubes in baking dish. Sprinkle with thyme. Bake uncovered for 25 - 30 minutes or until cranberries are tender and cream topping bubbles. Serve hot. Makes 8 servings.

title: Easy Veal Feta Cheese Soup
ingredients: 6 cups veal or chicken stock | 1/2 lb chorizo sausage | 1/2 lb lean veal | 1/2 cup dried feta
instructions: Prep lamb. Sear pork chops and add to stock. Slice chorizo sausage into 3inch pieces, add to stock. Add dried feta to mixture and cook on simmer to thicken. Serve hot.

title: Buffalo Beef Strips W-Blueberry Sauce and Nutty Crudites!
ingredients: 2 lbs very thinly sliced flank steaks | 1 lb bacon drippings or 1 lb butter | 4 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup coffee liqueur | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 1 cup fresh blueberries
instructions: Heat dripping or butter in skillet over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Sauté steak until meat is almost cooked through, but still moist. Do not add salt. Remove from skillet and allow to rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Mix teriyaki sauce and coffee liqueur in small saucepan over medium heat until boiling. Simmer for 5 - 6 minutes, until sauce is slightly thickened. Add walnuts and blueberries and mix well. Pour over steak, or serve with hot cooked egg noodles, garnished with crumbled bacon.

title: Tabbouleh Rice Ball With Meatballs (Baked in Parchment)
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 jar meatballs | 1 tablespoon tahini | fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped | 0.5 package dry rice noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Prepare rice as directed on package. Cool completely. Dice meatballs. Place meatball, tahini, and cilantro at the center of a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake until heated through, about 15 minutes. While mixture bakes, soak rice noodles until soft, about 20 minutes. Drain and rinse rice noodles. Place noodles and meatballs into a large bowl. Toss with rice noodles and serve with meatballs and cilantro on the side.

title: Raspberry Yogurt Dip - Great Gift!
ingredients: 1 pint plain yogurt | 3 -4 tablespoons margarine ( optional ) | fresh raspberry
instructions: Melt the margarine in a small bowl in the microwave. Put in yogurt slowly. When it reaches a creamy consistency take one tablespoon on low and stir into yogurt. Add raspberries and enjoy. You can garnish with fresh berries just before serving.

Random Ingredients: mussel,veal,red leaf lettuce,ginger,madras curry powder,poblano chile
title: Madras Curry with Mussels
ingredients: 1/2 lb mussels, scrubbed and debearded | 2 red leaf lettuce, finely shredded | 1/2 lb lean ground veal | 1/2 cup fresh ginger, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon red-leaf lettuce, chopped | 2 tablespoons madras curry powder
instructions: Place mussels and 1/4 cup water in a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Allow 30 minutes for mussels to open. Remove mussels from shells, rinse well with cold water and drain. Discard any mussels that have not opened, discarding shells and shells. Trim meat of dark, tough shell fragments if present. In a large oven proof skillet, cook meat over medium high heat, stirring to break up clumps, until browned. Transfer meat to a medium bowl and set aside. Heat skillet over medium heat and add 1/2 teaspoon of madras curry powder and ginger, stirring to make a paste. Add the curry to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until fragrant. Add remaining 1/4 cup water and mussels and simmer, stirring often, for 3 minutes or until liquid evaporates. Add lettuce to broth, toss to mix. Serve over the mussels, with red leaf lettuce, toasted slivered almonds or whole cashews.

title: Famous Restaurant Rotel Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs diced bell peppers | 20 1/2 ounces rotel tomatoes ( can use any brand )
instructions: Combine all ingredients into crock pot, and cook on high until hot then reduce and cook on low 4 - 6 hours, or you can transfer tomatoes to a serving dish and serve over hot cooked rice. Note, if desired, use 3/4 of a cup of rotel instead of rotel tomatoes for a hotter dish.

title: Italian Hero Fish on the Grill
ingredients: 4 salmon | 3 -4 slices pepperoni | 1/2 grape
instructions: Grill one side of salmon as directed on package. Turn over salmon and broil for three minutes until done. Top with pepperoni. Enjoy with remaining grape.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,rye flour,apricot jam,milk ricotta cheese,chocolate chip,lemon,onion powder
title: Easy Baked Irish Apricot Fudge Rollups
ingredients: 3/4 cup fat-free evaporated milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried lemon, rind of | 14 1/2 ounces apricot jam ( or other jam ) | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar, packed | 2 1/2 tablespoons low-fat milk chocolate chips | 1 1/4 cups rye flour | 1 tablespoon unbleached all-purpose flour
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper or parchment sugar. In a large bowl, mix the ricotta, onion powder, lemon rind and jam until smooth. Stir the brown sugar, milk chocolate bits and flour until just combined. Set aside. Stir in the rye flour. Scrape into a 2 cup glass measure and smooth the top. Roll the mixture slightly and lightly into a log approximately 9 inches in diameter. Cut crosswise into 1 inch slices. Place on the baking sheet. Bake until the bottoms are dry and the tops are light brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Remove to a rack and let cool completely.

title: Apple Nut Bread
ingredients: 1 package yeast cakes, 1 packet | 1/2 cup brown rice, rinsed | 3/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 large apple, peeled, cored, and chopped | 1 large red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup pecans, coarsely chopped
instructions: Spray a large loaf pan with cooking spray. Spray the inside of the pan with cooking spray, or preheat over medium heat. Set aside. In a large bowl, dissolve the yeast in the brown rice and let stand 5 minutes. Stir in 2/3 c oil, and pour into the pan with the remaining ingredients. Mix well and cover with a tea towel. Allow to rise about 1 hour, or until dough rises and forms a ball. Turn out on a floured surface. Divide the dough into 20 portions. Shape each piece into a ball, put into a greased 10 x 15 inch loaf pan, and cover with a tea towel. Allow to rise until doubled in bulk. Brush with remaining oil. This will take 1 1/2 hours or more, depending on oven heat and temperature. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bake bread for 50 to 55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: purple onion,nutritional yeast,garam masala,currant,chickpea flour,head broccoli,green bean,tea
title: Indian Chickpea Flour Burgers
ingredients: 2 cups chickpea flour | 1 cup purple onion, minced | 1 bunch green beans, trimmed and cut in 1/4-inch slices | 1 head broccoli, cut into florets, tips chopped | 1/4 cup low-sodium tea or 1/4 cup evaporated milk | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 teaspoon dried minced onion | 1/4 teaspoon dried minced garlic | freshly grated nutritional yeast
instructions: Whisk chickpea flour, onion, green beans, broccoli, and tabasco sauce in medium bowl to blend. Add remaining ingredients, stir until just combined. Divide mixture into 8 equal portions, form each into a 6 by 12 inch long patty. Place onto baking sheets. Sprinkle tops with a pinch of nutmeg. Preheat the grill to medium. Remove burgers from grill and place on grill, close lid and grill, turning once, until golden, 3 to 8 minutes per side. To serve, place burger on platter. Drizzle with remaining sauce.

title: Arugula Salad With Turkey
ingredients: 1 lb deli turkey | 1 tablespoon golden raisin | 1 bunch arugula | 1/4 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Cut the deli turkey into 1/2 inch cubes. Place into bowl. Add raisins, salad greens, and yogurt. Toss lightly and serve.

title: Chicken Sausage & Pork Casserole
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 100 g lean ground chuck | 1 can applesauce | 150 -300 ml soymilk | 2 sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven 200°c. Cut chicken into large chunks and place in casserole dish with beef and onions.. Mix applesauce and soy milk together and pour over. Add sage. Bake in oven for 2 hours. Remove sage and slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,meal flour,coconut milk,coriander,pecorino romano cheese
title: Perfect Tamale (Fritters)
ingredients: 1 cup corn syrup | 1 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 cup grated fresh coriander, leaves ( or cilantro ) | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs ( or coarsely grated fresh coriander leaves ) | 2 1/2 cups coconut milk
instructions: Pour the corn syrup into a large, heavy saucepan and whisk in the cheese, cheese, coriander, breadcrumbs and coconut milk, until well mixed and smooth. Heat for about a minute, stirring, to blend everything together. Drop the mixture into hot little tamales and fry for three minutes, turning once, until golden brown and cooked through. Serve immediately.

title: Spinach & Chestnuts
ingredients: 1 cup instant spaghetti sauce ( for pasta ) | 1 cup spaghetti water chestnut ( sliced ) | 1 cup frozen chopped spinach leaves ( thawed, drained ) | 1 tablespoon ghee ( vegan margarine ) | 1/4 teaspoon pumpkin spice ( hsiwan crushed or your own recipe to make pumpkin spice ) | 2 tablespoons low-sodium pizza sauce | 2 -6 cups cooked pizza dough or 2 -6 cups prepared pizza dough | 1/4 cup dried cherries
instructions: Preparation,. Prepare instant spaghetti according to package directions. Sauté spinach in ghee on medium high heat with pumpkin spice and pizza sauce until spinach is slightly wilted. Set aside to cool. Punch down dough or roll and cut into two equal pieces. Set aside to cool further on a rack. Sauté cherry in ghee. Set aside to cool slightly on rack. Preparing the pizza crust,. Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface until 1cm larger than your pizza dough. Spread the pizza sauce over the pizza dough until 1/2” thick. Lay spinach and chestnuts flat on the pizza dough. Spread the spinach/chestnuts mixture and fold dough over and pinch together to form a flat round. Brush with ghee. Cut two cross section slits in the top of the pizza crust with a sharp knife. Bake in 350 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes until crust is light golden brown. Serve with your favourite dipping sauce or your favourite topping.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,red pepper,hoisin sauce,red potato,fontina cheese,hard egg,maraschino cherry,oregano
title: Cheesy Beef Potatoes, Peppers, and Egg Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 pound red pepper, cored, halved lengthwise and cut into 2 x 2-1/2 inch strips | 12 hard-boiled eggs, coarsely chopped | 1 pound salt pork, chopped | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh oregano | 20 maraschino cherries, for garnish | 1/2 cup crumbled fontina cheese
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Mango Chutney With Roasted Red Pepper
ingredients: 2 cups mango chutney, chopped | 3 tablespoons red pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh tarragon leaves, chopped | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the chutney, red pepper, tarragon, and buttermilk and mix well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,white flour,vegetable oil,harissa,tomato juice,yellow food coloring,asparagus
title: Spicy Asparagus Jam
ingredients: 5 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 tablespoons white flour | 6 cups tomato juice | 1 tablespoon yellow food coloring, optional ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons harissa ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs asparagus, trimmed | 1/4 cup jalapeno chile, seeded and chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in saucepan over moderate heat until hot but not smoking. Do not let smoke. Add flour and cook, stirring, until the mixture turns light brown. Remove from heat. Add tomato juice and 1 cup of the water. Place harissa and food coloring in small bowl. Pour paste over asparagus and cover. Bring to a full boil. Reduce to a full simmer. Cook until the asparagus is crisp tender. Remove from heat. Stir in chilies. Transfer asparagus to a serving bowl. Serve warm.

title: Taco Bell Mexican Quinoa
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 cups quinoa | 1/8 cup taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon, zest of
instructions: Prepare quinoa according to package directions. Meanwhile combine the taco seasoning and chili oil in a small saucepan. Bring to just over a boil and then continue to cook until the quinoa is tender. Remove from heat, add lemon zest, and toss it in serve.

title: Braised Spareribs
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs spareribs | 1 can sweet peas or ( 16 ounce ) can peas of your choice | 2 -3 tablespoons dried ancho chili
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees or 300 degrees f. Spray a 13x9 baking dish with cooking spray. Combine the ribs and peas and sprinkle with spices. Cover loosely with foil and bake 1 hour. Uncover and bake 30 minutes more or until ribs are done. Allow the ribs to sit on the foil for 5 - 10 minutes. Remove ribs and reheat if needed.

title: Green Peppers & Cheese Squares
ingredients: 1 cup grated cheddar cheese | 2 cups grated tasty cheddar cheese | 1 cup grated tasty green bell pepper | 1/4 cup finely crushed aniseed | 1/2 cup biscquick | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Heat oven to 180 c. Line a 22cmx21cm ovenproof dish with baking paper. Using electric mixer, combine first three ingredients. Stir well, then add remaining ingredients. Spread on prepared baking paper. Bake for 40 mins, or until golden brown and filling has set.

title: Quick and Easy Noodles With Shrimp and Spinach
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 cups cooked medium shrimp, thawed | 8 ounces egg noodles, cooked
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain well. Coat nonstick skillet with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,kosher salt,skirt steak,white flour,red pepper sauce,vegetable oil,flour tortilla
title: Steak Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 lb skirt steak, cut into thin strips | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 cup unbleached white flour | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 teaspoon red pepper sauce or 1 teaspoon mild red chili sauce | 7 flour tortillas
instructions: Sprinkle the steak with 1/2 teaspoon of salt. In a heavy skillet over medium high heat, heat the oil. Sprinkle the steak with 1/2 teaspoons of salt and cook for about 1 minute, stirring to ensure the meat cooks evenly and evenly. Remove from the skillet and place in a mixing bowl. Add the flour to the skillet. Slowly whisk in the cream cheese, until creamy and smooth. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of salt and red pepper. Stir well. Spread 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture on one side of a tortilla and place in the hot skillet. Do not crowd the tortillas. Allow 2 to 5 minutes of flipping once, just to set the cheese. Top with the remaining tortilla and allow to set, about 10 seconds. Serve with salsa and sour cream and additional salsa on the side.

title: Tomatillo Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 -2 lb sweet potato | 1 leek or 1/2 cup onion | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 -3 fresh tomatillos salsa | 1/4 cup good quality malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water until potatoes are cooked, and then drain. While potatoes are cooking, bring the salsa to the boil in a small bowl in the microwave. When potatoes are done, drain, mash with a potato masher. Chop onion a bit and throw in with the potatoes. Add salt and mix well. Let cool for an hour while you're waiting for the potatoes to cool. When potatoes are cool, mix salsa and rice vineger and put into a food processor. Blend for at least 30 seconds, or pulse until desired consistency.. If desired, after cooking the potatoes a bit, mix in any extra ingredients. Serve warm.

title: Easy Mashed Corn Fritters #RSC
ingredients: 24 6-inch cornmeal or 6-inch cereal | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix
instructions: Heat 1 1/4 cups water to boiling in a medium size saucepan.

title: Santa Fe Blackberry and Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 9 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 cup small broccoli, coarsely chopped | 1 cup whole kernel corn | 2 cups long-grain rice ( not instant ) | 1 cup frozen blackberries
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot and simmer on low setting for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Greek Lentil Casserole
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves cut into bite sized chunks | 4 cups cooked brown lentils | 1/3 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine the chicken, lentils and feta cheese. Pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 45 minutes, until chicken juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: white onion,wheat flour,beef ribeye steak,cream chicken soup,mayonnaise
title: Quick & Easy Italian Country Style Beef
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup ( undiluted ) | 1 1/2 lbs beef ribeye steak | 2 tablespoons reduced fat mayonnaise | 1 small white onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: In a bowl, combine the soup and beef. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. When ready to cook, spray a large skillet with cooking spray. Heat to medium heat. Remove beef from the soup mixture, and slice across to the desired serving size. Add mayonnaise and onion to beef. Stir well to combine, and continue cooking until heated through. Serve over egg noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,turmeric,beef brisket,pork belly,salt black pepper,tomato green chilies,cream cheese,french haricot vert
title: Haitian Beef and Pork Belly Stew
ingredients: 1 beef brisket ( about 5 pounds ) | 1 pork belly, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 can french haricots vert ( stringy green beans ), drained | 3 tablespoons reduced-fat cream cheese | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/2 scotch bonnet pepper, minced | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the brisket, pork belly, and tomatoes in a large baking dish. Pour in the green chilies. Cover, and bake the meat until very tender, about 2 hours. Add the french haricots verts, cream cheese, turmeric, and scotch bonnet pepper.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,raclette cheese,green olive,vegetable broth,pimento olive,fig,green chilies,vegetable shortening
title: Rannalitos de Palomilla
ingredients: 3 ounces vegetable shortening | 2 cups chunky salsa ( i prefer mild or medium ) | 4 ounces ricotta salata or 4 ounces rotel | 4 ounces diced green chilies ( canned, diced in food processor ) | 1/3 cup pimento stuffed olive | 1 1/2 cups cubed raclette cheese ( or cheddar ) | 3 cups frozen mixed vegetables, such as corn, peas, lima beans, and carrots ( optional but good to use ) | 1/3 cup green olives or 1/3 cup black olives | 3 cans vegetable broth
instructions: For fritos de palomilla, melt the shortening in a large, heavy skillet over medium heat. Add the salsa and simmer until it has reduced a little, stirring a few times, then stir in the ricotta salata or rotel. When the romano is well melted, stir in all of the green chiles. Remove from the heat and stir in the olives. For best results, let cool completely. For the filling, pre heat the broiler. For the cheese sauce, in a large bowl, stir the olives and cheese together with the vegetable broth. The broth can be mixed in with the cheese. To assemble, ladle about a half cup of the cheese mixture in a ring mold. Place a cheese mold on top of the cheese, then spoon most of the filling mixture in evenly over the cheese mold. Dollop some of the cheese mixture on top of the cheese and return the mold to the broiler. Broil until the bottom is bubbly and the top is bubbly, about 30 seconds. Watch carefully. Garnish with chopped green olives or black olives.

title: Ham and Walnut Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vinegar ( preferably white ) | 2 slices flat leaf parsley ( very thinly sliced ) | 12 slices black forest ham ( about 2 ounces )
instructions: Mix the vinegar with salt and pepper to taste. Brush a small serving dish with the vinegar mixture. Arrange half of the walnuts in the dish. Place remaining walnuts in a layer over the walnuts. Cover with remaining walnuts. Serve hot. Variation, use balsamic vinegar for a touch of sweetness. If using whole black walnuts, omit the salt, and instead of pepper, drizzle with a little of the reserved vinegar mixture. Top with a layer sliced, unstuffed black forest ham.

Random Ingredients: currant,chicken breast,green cardamom pod,black olive,thai fish sauce
title: Chicken and Olive Tare
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried currants | 1 teaspoon black olives, halved ( optional ) | 2 green cardamom pods | 2 chicken breasts, cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Place currants in a small container with a close fitting lid. Tie the cardamom pods in a piece of cheesecloth or double thickness of cheesecloth. Add the chicken pieces, and place them into the container. Sprinkle on the fish sauce. Cover and shake until chicken is coated. Let sit for about 20 minutes to marinate. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place chicken in the pot, and cook, uncovered, over medium heat for 10 minutes or until no longer pink inside.

title: The French of Gruyere Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 lb gruyere cheese, shredded on a microplane | crushed iceberg lettuce ( to accompany the party )
instructions: Cut each head of lettuce in half. Tear off the lettuce leaves. Wrap each half with 2 to 6 pieces of gruyere cheese. Place a microplane on the counter top. Place a handful of shredded lettuce on top of the cheese, and then cover the whole wheel of shredded gruyere with crushed ice. Slip the microplane back and forth with a large spoon to ensure cheese is dispersed evenly around the microplane. Using a wooden spoon, press ice pieces into the cheese and rock a microplane on top of the cheese, using the back of the spoon to press the salt off. Repeat with more cheese and ice until cheese is fully melted.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,ancho chile powder,corn oil,habanero pepper,basil leaf,fennel bulb,polenta,egg noodle
title: Egg Noodle and Corn-Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 egg noodles | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/4 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 2 dried ancho chiles, broken into 1-inch pieces | 2 pounds chicken tenders | 1/3 cup prepared polenta | 3 dried ancho chile peppers, broken into pieces | 3 dried ancho chile powder, broken into pieces | 3 sprigs fresh basil leaves | 1 fennel bulb, trimmed | 1 large fennel bulb, trimmed
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the egg noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 6 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Heat the corn oil in a skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,red capsicum,cinnamon,tabasco sauce,chipotle chile,lamb,ricotta cheese
title: Low Fat Spicy Meatball & Chipsotle Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 kg lamb | 1 red capsicum, diced ( bell pepper ) | 2 chipotle chiles, seeded, finely chopped | 1 chipotle chille, finely chopped | 200 g low fat ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons flour tortillas | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | tabasco sauce
instructions: Trim fat from meat and finely dice meat. Place in pan with capsicum and chipoltes. Stir over heat for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and cool slightly. In a small bowl mix chilli, ricotta cheese, cinnamon until well blended. On a plate, place 1 tortilla, spread with half the meat, with a few drops of tabasco sauce. Place in microwave for 1 - 2 minutes on high until just pliable. Place on a plate, spoon 2 tbs of spice mixture on top and serve piping hot.

title: The Bestest and Best Steak Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 pound top round steaks, cut into serving sized pieces | 3 tablespoons walnut oil ( or other neutral oil )
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the steak in a single layer.

title: Homemade French Bread
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat your kitchen broiler on medium high setting. Place baguette on oven rack. Cut through baguette once or twice to open a pocket, remove to a cutting board. Sprinkle mustard seeds on top of the inside of bread. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 small red onion, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons vegetarian worcestershire sauce | 20 ounces refrigerated reduced-fat sourdough topping spread, such as kraft
instructions: Heat oil in skillet over medium heat till hot. Add onion and saute till tender and starting to brown, about 5 minst to 1 1/2 min, stirring occassionally. Toss in worcestershire sauce and spread onto sourdough mixture. Let cool 10 minute sprinkle with parmesan cheese just before serving.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,tabasco sauce,coconut,white wine vinegar,lasagna,snow pea,whipping cream
title: Lemon and Coconut Cannelloni
ingredients: 8 fresh lasagna sheets, cooked ( barrilla brand or similar brand ) | 175 ml white wine vinegar | 2 cups whipping cream | 1 cup desiccated unsweetened coconut | 1/2 cup shredded coconut ( preferably fresh ) | 1 -2 teaspoon tabasco sauce, depending on your taste | 1 1/2 lbs fresh snow peas, trimmed, peeled and cut lengthwise into 1-inch lengths | 1 cup fresh raspberry, halved ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f spray a 12x12 inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Lay 3 lasagne sheets in prepared dish. In small bowl, mix vinegar with 1/4 cup cream.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,white wine,prosciutto,white wine vinegar,watercress,chicken broth,lettuce leaf,white chocolate chip
title: White Chocolate Chicken Wrapped in Lettuce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped watercress | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 5 slices prosciutto, chopped | 1 package white chocolate chips | 4 lettuce leaves | 1 bunch shredded lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, wisk together 1/2 cup watercress and 1 teaspoon soy sauce. Set aside. Heat 1/4 cup chicken broth over medium heat in a large skillet. Remove from heat and keep hot, but keep the remaining broth at a boil. In a small bowl, whisk together 2 teaspoons of soy sauce, 2 teaspoons of white wine vinegar, and 1 teaspoon of soy sauce. Add white wine and vinegar mixture to chicken broth, and whisk until the liquid has almost disappeared. Remove from heat, and mix in prosciutto. Place 2 slices of prosciutto in each lettuce leaf, then top with 1/4 cup of white chocolate, 1 to 2 tablespoons of white chocolate sauce, 1/4 teaspoon of soy sauce, and 1/4 teaspoon of watercress. Roll each wrap in chopped lettuce leaves. Wrap individually in foil, and place onto a baking sheet, seam side down. Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until the chocolate is melted and the lettuce is soft. Let stand 10 minutes before serving, and cut into slices.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,kielbasa sausage,zucchini,apple juice,kosher salt black pepper,self raising flour
title: Zucchini Kielbasa & Kielbasa (Sausage, Zucchini, Apple Zucchini
ingredients: 1 large zucchini | 1 package kielbasa sausage | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 3/4 cup apple juice | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c or 160°c, gas mark 2. Trim the zucchini, cut it lengthways into 3/4 inch chunks and place into a pan with water to just cover on the zucchini and cook, turning to lightly coat in the oil. Tip everything into a large, ovenproof bowl or roasting tin, add the kielbasa and mix. Bake for 1 hour or until the kielbasa is golden, turning once during cooking. Remove from the oven and leave for 10 minutes or until all the zucchini has turned a pale golden brown colour. Toss into the roasting tin and leave for another 10 minutes. Serve with ketchup or barbecue sauce.

title: Pear and Pickum Sushi (Sushi)
ingredients: 12 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 2 cups white flour | 1 tablespoon ground celery seed | 1 pear, sliced | 6 drops barbeque sauce
instructions: Remove seaweed from seaweed by scoring a cut in the middle. Remove the top shell and place on cold water. Let them stand for 2 to 3 minutes and drain water. Wash and dry flour sift the ground celery seeds into a large bowl. Add apple and pear slices and rub in the celery seed paste. Add barbeque sauce and knead until well combined. Place mixture on cold and dry seaweed, pat into a ball, then shape into a large round using a rolling pin. Sushi with wet hands, stretch slightly in the center to keep from sticking and also to keep the roll from sticking. Cut into 2 inch lengths and fill with sushi, roll up, cut on the diagonal, with the tips of the palms of your hands to keep them from sticking. Eat with rice, fillings, and pickups with dipping sauces.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,green enchilada sauce,gruyere cheese,brown sugar
title: Chinese Snow Pea and Gruyere Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 bunch fresh snow pea, trimmed and cut into thirds | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/3 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the enchilada sauce with the snow peas into the green sauce. Sprinkle with sugar and add the cheese. Stir to coat. Transfer to oven and bake until snow peas are tender and cheese is melted, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,basmati rice,parsley,worcestershire sauce,coconut milk,dark soy sauce,fruit
title: Indian Rice Salad (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, cooked | 1 can coconut milk | 1 cup sliced mixed fruit | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 2 teaspoons dried fruit ( dried cranberries, red cherries, apricots, dried cherries, etc. ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine coconut milk, diced fruit & dark soy sauce in a microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,chicken breast half,red chili pepper,shrimp
title: Nigerian Shrimp and Chicken
ingredients: 2 large chicken breast halves or 2 large chicken thighs, chopped into large chunks | 4 shrimp, cleaned and shelled | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 4 tablespoons peanut oil or 4 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: In a hot wok or deep skillet heat the oil or vegetable oil, just until smoking. Add the chicken and stir fry over low heat for 3 - 4 minutes. Add the shrimp and chile, stirring fry 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in just enough of the peanut or vegetable oil to coat the bottom of the pan, and continue cooking for a few moments. Transfer to a serving platter and serve. This serves 7 as part of an appetizer or as a side dish with a salad, rice or pasta.
