Random Ingredients: cake flour,paprika,curry powder,caster sugar,chorizo sausage,seasoning,red wine vinegar,pecorino romano cheese
title: Curry Crunch - Chorizo & Chorizo Sausage Fritters With a Twist
ingredients: 8 ounces ground chorizo sausage | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 1/4 teaspoons paprika | 1 cup cake flour | 1 teaspoon seasoning | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Using a large mixing bowl, mash the chorizo in the bowl using a large spoon until well combined. Add the sugar, curry powder, paprika & cook for another 1 - 3 minutes & combine well. Add the flour, seasoning & vinegar and continue to mix with a wooden spoon till the mixture forms a firm dough. Turn onto a lightly greased surface & knead well till the mixture leaves the side of the bowl. Divide mixture into 8 equal pieces. Roll the balls into balls then using a small teaspoon, form each ball into a round ball about ½” thick, with tapered ends. Chill in the fridge for an hour or so before cooking. Preheat a ridged griddle. When hot sear the balls on the griddle & turn over when the edges are dark. Remove & place onto a clean cloth covered tray. Sprinkle with plenty of cheese before serving with salsa & sour cream.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,spinach,farfalle pasta,pizza crust,onion soup mix,russet potato,golden raisin,club soda
title: Pasta Florentine
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pizza crust | 5 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 cup golden raisins | 1/4 cup club soda | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 pound shredded farfalle ( bowtie ) pasta | 3 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet with cooking spray. Lay frozen dough out on a cutting board and stretch it into a circle slightly larger than the pizza crust's original size. Brush dough with more cooking spray and sprinkle the center of the dough with crumbs. Layer spinach over bottom of crust. Place the top crust over the spinach and press it into the filling. Sprinkle the top and edges with more crumbs. Fold the bottom crust over the filling and press any doughy areas with your fingers to seal the dough. Use a fork or sharp knife to make a few slits in the top crust. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until crust is browned. Turn off the oven, and leave the door closed. Let oven cool for 15 minutes. Remove dough from oven and cut it into pieces. Serve with pizza sauce or roasted red pepper sauce, if desired.

title: Thai Peanut Soup With Lemongrass and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups unsalted pecans | 1/4 cup finely chopped lemongrass, white part only ( i used 2 tbls. fresh lemongrass cut into 1/4-inch slices ) | 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth ( or 1 cup homemade stock ) | 6 cups chicken broth ( or water or vegetable broth ) | 2 tablespoons strained fresh thai chiles ( can substitute 2 tsp. thai red chiles for more heat ) | 1 cup heavy cream ( or half and half ) | 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup jasmine rice | 1/2 cup shredded cheese ( or more, to taste )
instructions: Toast pecans in a dry skillet over moderate heat, stirring, until they are golden and fragrant about 3 minutes, but do not burn. Transfer pecans to a mixing bowl and sprinkle with lemon grass and stir to mix. Reserve 1 cup peanut mixture to make the broth. Combine the broth with chiles in a saucepan and bring to boil. Remove from heat and stir in cream and reserved nuts. Bring the mixture back to a boil. Stir in the rice, return to a boil, then remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Remove the pot from the heat and let stand until the rice is cooked. Fluff with fork. Just before serving, stir in the cheese. Note, to toast pecans, place in a preheated 400 degree f oven for 10 minutes, stirring twice. Or in a sauté pan over moderate heat and grill until golden and fragrant, 4 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board or dish and sprinkle with reserved 3/4 cup peanut mixture. Using a slotted spoon and knife on top of the soup, spread 1/3 cup rice on the bottom of a 6”x8–inch baking dish coated with oil. Top with 1/4 cup soup mixture. Repeat the process 3 times, sprinkling top with more rice. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes or until rice is tender, and broth fragrant, about 15 minutes. Stir and serve immediately.

title: Italian Eggplant (Aubergine) Rice Balls With Lemon-Parm
ingredients: 1 package basmati rice, cooked and drained ( 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 large eggplants, sliced | 1 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup finely grated parmigiano | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1 teaspoon chopped candied lemon rind | 2 tablespoons sherry or 2 tablespoons tomato juice
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium heat and dry fry eggplant slices until golden brown, about 10 minutes total. Cool slightly. Place cooked rice and remaining ingredients in a bowl and toss until combined. If desired, garnish with candied lemon rind.

Random Ingredients: flour,cucumber,barbecue sauce,extra sharp cheddar cheese,salt black pepper,red chili pepper flake,chicken stock,egg
title: Smoky Deep Fried Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb extra-sharp cheddar cheese, coarsely grated | 1 egg | 1/2 cup chicken stock ( or 1 cup water ) | 1/4 cup flour | salt and black pepper | red chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 3 large dried hot red chili peppers | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce, mild ( such as tabasco, perilla or anja )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except for chili peppers and sauce and stir well. Heat large, nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add whole red peppers and a pinch or two of salt and pepper flakes. Cook chilies until darkly roasted and no white remains, about 2 minutes. Add kielbasa and cook about 8 min.

title: Anchovies Primavera
ingredients: 1 bunch arugula | 3 green bell peppers | 12 ounces anise-infused currants | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon anise
instructions: Blanch arugula in boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes and drain. Slice green peppers and sprinkle with anise seed, fennel seed and ground black pepper. Blanch arugula quickly, drain and reserve. Heat a small skillet on medium high heat. Add olive oil or if available canola oil to coat pan. Add arugula and green pepper slices. When arugula wilts to ribbons, remove it and turn off stove. Cover and let sit until arugula can be eaten.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,broccoli floret,water chestnut,bay leaf,white sugar,grand marnier,mirin,baby bok choy
title: Spiral Salmon With Broccoli and Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 boneless salmon fillets, 1 inch thick | 1 ounce dry mirin | 1 ounce white sugar | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 1 bay leaf | 9 ounces broccoli florets | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1/2 cup baby bok choy
instructions: Boil the water in a large saucepan, and add the bok choy. In a separate saucepan, mix the mirin, sugar, and grand marnier. Place the salmon in the pan over low heat. Add this mixture to the boiling water just to cover, and cook until the fish flakes with a fork when tested. The fish, skin side up.

title: Rice Vinegar for Baking
ingredients: 1 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: In a medium bowl measure the rice vinegar and nutmeg. Make small holes all over the bowl by pressing your finger into the rice vinegar. Slowly pour the vinegar into the hole. Sprinkle a coating of water over the bowl, cover and chill for 3 hours, stirring every so often. Strain vinegar, and pour off any accumulated liquid. Drain off any extra liquid.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,ice cube,green chilies,brown mustard seed,flour tortilla
title: Green Chilies and Mustard Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 -8 large green chilies, roasted and seeded | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 6 flour tortillas or 6 corn tortillas, cut into 1 inch strips | 4 -6 cups ice cubes, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Slice off the tops of the fresh chilies and remove the seeds and stem. Cut the pepper into 2 inch lenghts and place on the cookie sheet, keeping the chilies intact. Drizzle with lemon juice. Sprinkle with mustard seeds and brown mustard seeds. Place in the oven and bake about 20 minutes or until all the peppers are just tender. Cool, peel, and chop. Serve on a platter with tortillas or corn tortilla strips.

title: Almond Pork Tenderloins(Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 packages pork tenderloins | 1/3 cup whole blanched almond ( optional ) | 1/3 cup chopped fresh chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Cut 1/3 of the almonds into 1 x 1/8 inch strips, and pulse with remaining ingredients until mixture is evenly mixed and slivers are formed. Trim fat from tenderloins. Place meat in a 5 - 6 quart crock pot, trimming away excess fat. Cover. Cook on high 1 - ¼ to 1 - ¾ hours, or until meat is just tender. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Bake Candied Red Apples
ingredients: 5 inches gingerroot ( peeled and grated ) | 1 pint tart apple ( about 5 apples ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 2 teaspoons garlic powder ( or equivalent paste ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking chocolate ( or your favourite choclate candy flavor )
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f. Mix together grated ginger and garlic powder. Coat each peeled apple in the ginger butter mixture and place in the roasting pan. Pour hot water into pan to reach halfway up the side of the apples. Bake 25 minutes or until the apples are tender. Watch them carefully so they do not overcook. Remove from oven and place on a plate covered with parchment paper or foil. Put a little bit of choclate candy around the top of each apple and drizzle over a little chocolate.

title: Nif's Cauliflower Primavera
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, divided into florets | 1 1/4 pounds sauerkraut, drained | 1 1/4 tablespoons dried thyme leaves | 1 pound dry farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Bring large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Pour in 1/2 of the cauliflower head pasta, and cook for about 8 minutes. Remove and reserve 1/2 of the pasta water. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place remaining cauliflower in another large pot of lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Cook until tender, about 8 minutes. Drain. Place pasta in a large mixing bowl and add sauerkraut, thyme and half of the drained pasta water. Toss to thoroughly mix everything together. Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover the top with the remaining half of cauliflower. Bake for 45 minutes, until top is golden brown and bubbly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,halibut fillet,heirloom tomato,puff pastry,farfalle pasta,orange peel
title: Heirloom Tomato Halibut Empanada
ingredients: 1 package halibut fillets | 1 package heirloom tomatoes | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion powder | 2 tablespoons finely chopped orange peel | 3 packages frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 package dried farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut halibut fillets in half lengthwise. Carefully cut a horizontal pocket through each piece to make a pocket. Stuff each piece of halibut with about 10 halves of tomato, and about a heaping tablespoon of onion powder. Combine with orange peel. Place puff pastry sheets on a baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven for 11 minutes, then spread with farfalle pasta and the 1/2 cup orange juice mixture. Continue baking for another 5 to 10 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and pasta is heated through and juices run clear.

title: Spiced Fruit Soup
ingredients: 1 lb mixed fruit | 4 cups apple cider or 4 cups water | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour
instructions: Peel and dice fruit. Place fruit, cider or water, corn flour, honey, horseradish, cardamom, and whole wheat flour in a saucepan. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Do not boil. Remove cardamom pods. Serve at once in bowls. Note, if you like, you can substitute some of the fruit with frozen or canned peas.

title: Linguine With Pepperoncini and Spicy Vinaigrette
ingredients: 24 ounces linguine | 1/4 cup margarine | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers, drained and rinsed
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. While linguine is cooking, melt margarine in large microwave safe bowl in oven. Cook on high 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in triple sec, hot pepper sauce, and cornstarch.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,garlic flake,chili oil,hominy,craisins,bean sprout,oat flour
title: Hominy With Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 3 quarts water or 3 quarts broth | 1 box dried hominy | 1/2 cup oat flour ( cornmeal ) | 1/4 cup craisins | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon garlic flakes | 1 teaspoon mixed oregano leaves | 14 ounces bean sprouts
instructions: In a large, heavy stock pot, combine the chicken stock, hominy, bread crumbs, craisins, chili oil, garlic, mixed oregano, and rice flour. Stir well until the mixture is moist and blended inches. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer for one hour. Stir occasionally. Add the bean sprouts, cover, and cook for another 20 minutes.

title: Easy Onion Soup Mix
ingredients: 1 package lipton onion soup mix | 1 medium white onion
instructions: Place all ingredients, including dried dices. Mix well. Seal bag and place in crock pot. Cook for 3 - 5 hours on low to medium heat, stirring every so often. Add dried cedar chips, if desired, on top during last hour.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,foot hog casing,adobo sauce,milk chocolate,rom tomato,italian sausage
title: Sausage and Brandy
ingredients: 1/2 link lean italian sausage | 1/2 tablespoon adobo sauce | 1 roma tomato, chopped | 10 feet dried hog casings | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate | 1 loaf italian bread ( for soaking bread )
instructions: In a skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until done. Remove from skillet. Add adobo sauce, tomato and sausage. Simmer. Sausage should be slightly brown on bottom. To prepare hog casings, soak casings in water for 30 minutes. Drain, remove casings, and place in a pot of water. Cook 1 hour or until casings float to the top. Melt chocolate, add to pot, and stir until melted. Dip casings into chocolate mixture. Serve with italian bread.

Random Ingredients: roast,egg white,black mission fig,oregano,double cream,eggplant,baby carrot,food coloring
title: Creamy Eggplant  (Aubergine)  Gratin
ingredients: 3 eggplants | 1 ounce baby carrots or ( 1 lb ) bag mixed frozen baby carrots | 14 ounces black mission figs | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 24 ounces double cream | 2 drops food coloring | 8 ounces roast, shaved very thin | coarse chopped fresh oregano | 1 organic egg ( to freeze ) | 2 egg whites
instructions: Slice eggplant into about 1/4 inch thick slices. If large, freeze eggplant in a single layer in a single layer on a large cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Turn slices over once or twice until frozen. Slice carrots into about 1/4 inch slices and set aside. In medium mixing bowl, stir together dried eggplant and dried oregano. Cut figs into 1 inch pieces and rinse out cookie sheet with water to remove stems if needed. Tear dried figs in half and set aside. Place eggplant slices on parchment paper lined cookie sheet, brush both sides with egg whites and place on top rack of oven at 400°f for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Turn eggplant slices over and brush both sides again. Remove from oven and immediately spread the top of each slice of eggplant with 1 teaspoon dried oregano. Place in oven for another 10 minutes or until golden brown. Drain well and allow to cool. Turn slice of eggplant into an 11x17x2 inch baking dish and lightly spoon 1/4 cup cream onto each piece. Dust eggplant with coarsely chopped fresh oregano and top with shaved roast. Return to broiler for 3 - 4 minutes or until bread is cooked. Top each plate with some chopped fresh oregano and a drizzle of sliced black mission figs. Serve immediately with sliced crusty bread, such as sliced baguette.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,green onion,grand marnier,onion,green curry paste,red currant jelly
title: Green Apple and Curry
ingredients: 1 green onion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 small tart apple, cored and thinly sliced | 1/3 cup red currant jelly | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 2 tablespoons finely chopped red currant jelly
instructions: Heat curry paste, onion, apple and 1/4 cup jelly in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook stirring occasionally, until onion is soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in grand marnier. Sprinkle with 1/8 teaspoon redcurrant jelly and the remaining redcurrant jelly.

title: Vegetarian Leeks with Rum
ingredients: 2 -3 large yellow squash, cut to bite-sized cubes | 2 raspberries, quartered | 1/2 vidalia onion, diced | 1/2 tablespoon rum | 2 -3 leeks, white part only, sliced thin | 1 package firm tofu, cut into chunks
instructions: If using frozen zucchini, thaw a small one while you are preparing the rest of the meal. When ready to use, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile if using frozen zucchini cut into quarters. When the water comes to a boil, salt the water. Drain and set aside. In a large baking dish pour a small amount of rum on the bottom. Place the zucchini and raspberries in a single layer on top of the rum. Sprinkle half of the sweet onion and half the sliced vidalia onion on top of the zucchini. Top with a layer of tofu. Cover with remaining 1/2 of sweet onion and another layer of tofu then a layer of zucchini then a final layer of tofu. Top all with a layer of chopped leeks then cover with a layer of sliced spokane red pepper shavings. Cover with a layer of aluminum foil and bake at 350ºf for 30 - 40 minutes. Take off aluminum foil and top with your favorite dark rum sauce.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,green olive,parsley leaf,monterey jack cheese,coriander sprig,pistachio,taco seasoning mix,onion flake
title: Mexican Olive Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped canned green olives | 1/3 cup chopped dried onion flakes | 1 large coriander sprig | 4 tablespoons dry instant minced onion flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried parsley leaves | 1/3 cup pimento-stuffed green olives, chopped | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an electric blender, blend on low for 2 minutes until smooth. Serve at once or cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,white pepper powder,pumpkin pie spice,italian salad dressing mix,mexican corn,grain rice
title: Rice and Spice Pumpkin Tacos
ingredients: 1 pound whole grain rice, cooked | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 envelope dried italian-style salad dressing mix | 1/4 teaspoon ground white pepper powder | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1 package dry mexican-style corn
instructions: Mix rice and chili sauce together in a large bowl. Stir the salad dressing mix, ground white pepper, pumpkin pie spice and rice into the couscous mixture until well blended. Spoon into a shallow dish or baking dish of your choosing to form taco shells. Cook in a preheated 375 degrees f oven for 15 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: herb,puff pastry,potato starch,beef tenderloin steak,cold water
title: Herb Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks | 2 -3 tablespoons potato starch | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | cold water | 2 sheets puff pastry
instructions: Pat steaks dry with a paper towel then dust with potato starch. Heat a wok over high heat, add 1 tbspn of water then sprinkle with herbs. Stir fry steaks for 1 - 2 mins then remove from heat. Sprinkle with remaining herbs then place on a baking paper lined tray to rest for 2 mins before slicing. Turn oven to 200c/gas mark bake in a buns for 12 - 15 mins for rare then rest 2 mins before serving. Serve steaks with gravy and a green vegetable.

title: Baked Halibut
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon canola oil | 12 ounces halibut fillets, skin on
instructions: Preheat oven to coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat and cook fish for 2 minutes on each side, or until just cooked through.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,thyme sprig,meatball,salmon steak,ginger root,philadelphia cream cheese,stewing lamb,plain flour
title: Irish Stewing Lamb and Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 kg stewing lamb, cut into chunks | 375 g natural log processed cheese, cubed | 1/4 cup plain flour, sifted | 1 large fresh thyme sprigs | 1 inch fresh ginger root, peeled and grated ( or 1/2 tsp ground ginger ) | 1 kg meatball, defrosted if frozen ( small, defrosted if frozen ) | 60 g pickled ginger juice | 60 g st. germain signature irish stewing lamb, diced into cubes | fresh thyme sprig, to decorate ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. In a dutch oven, combine the lamb chunks, processed cheese, flour, herbs and ginger. Toss to coat and place the meat in the bottom of an ovenproof dish. Add the meat. Push the pickled ginger, diced lamb and gingers to the edges until the mixture has almost reached the top and seal with toothpicks. If you wish, place a thyme sprig on top. Combine the meatball pieces and the pickled ginger juice in a bowl and then pour half of this over the meat. Cover with aluminium foil and place into the oven. Cook for one hour. You can also serve it hot from the oven or the side dish. If desired, garnish with fresh thyme sprigs. Serve with cooked rice. You may also wish to offer the horseradish sauce along with it.

title: Mexican Hot Chocolate - No Eggs, No Oil, Just Chocolate!
ingredients: 4 ounces sweet unsweetened chocolate chips or 4 ounces cocoa | 6 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 3/4 lbs cherries, preferably red ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine the chocolate and oil in a heatproof bowl with the cherries. Chill in the refrigerator. Serve warm or cold with a sprinkling of cocoa.

title: Sesame Swiss Rollups
ingredients: 12 ounces shredded provolone cheese or 12 ounces swiss cheese | 4 green onions, cut into thin 1/8-inch slices | 2 -3 ounces chopped unsweetened chocolate, melted | 3 -4 teaspoons sesame oil | salt
instructions: Place swiss cheese in a flat dish. Place green onion slices on cheese. Prepare filling by mixing all ingredients and pour onto cheese and green onions. Sprinkle with sesame oil. Slice roll ups, place back slice onto roll. Cover and refrigerate until you are ready to serve it. Cut roll into 6 - 8 slices, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: parsley,red onion,mexican cheese,red curry paste,italian salad dressing,cauliflower,shiitake mushroom,cornstarch
title: Cauliflower Thai Style
ingredients: 4 large cauliflower, cut at the base, lengthwise, stem removed | 1 jar roasted red curry paste, thai kitchen brand | 1 bag shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 3 tablespoons red onion, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 4 fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced ( optional ) | 1 bottle italian salad dressing
instructions: Heat curry paste in saute pan over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Remove curry paste from pan.

title: Indian Style Indian Prawns
ingredients: 600 g medium prawns | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 400°f. Poke prawn all over with a sharp knife and place them on a large tray with 1/2 tsp garam masala and all of the cayenne pepper sauce. Sprinkle 1/2 tsp kosher salt over the prawns and bake for 5 minutes. Serve hot with naan bread and a salad.

title: Frijoles De Tomate (Mexican Broccoli)
ingredients: 1 cup dry great northern bean, washed | 2 cups broccoli, cut into florets | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, finely chopped | 1 orange, quartered
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 45 minutes. Stir occasionally to prevent scorching.

Random Ingredients: miracle whip,topping,beef bouillon,corn syrup,chicken breast,sugar,button mushroom,red cabbage
title: Mushroom and Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 cup beef bouillon | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1/3 cup miracle whip | 1/4 cup sugar | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 4 medium heads red cabbage | 1 1/2 lbs button mushrooms | topping
instructions: Place beef bouillon, corn syrup, miracle whip, sugar, and half of the chicken, cut into bite size pieces. Pour into a large saucepan and bring to a boiling. Remove from the stove and cover. Let stand for about 20 minutes, stir, and set aside. Wash cabbage, remove root end, and hard leaves, and slice thinly. Trim off tough tops, then slice off the thick, central vein just below the core of the leaves that float above the head of cabbage. Trim off the tough ribs and tough part of the stalks, then slice them coarsely. Arrange them in rows in a salad bowl. Cover with sliced cabbage, sliced mushrooms, and a generous sprinkling of remaining miracle whip. Serve chilled.

title: Catfish With Strawberry
ingredients: 2 pieces catfish | 1 teaspoon dry sauter's sherry | fresh strawberries, cut in halves | 4 -6 tablespoons fresh or frozen strawberry jam
instructions: Heat a nonstick pan over medium high heat. Spray the pan with cooking spray or rub the pan with vegetable oil. Add catfish. Sprinkle with salt. Quickly turn the catfish so that it is white on the underside. Slide catfish onto the rack of the rack to catch the juices that run down the inside. Cover. When fat starts to run out of the catfish, reduce heat to medium. Cook about 25 - 30 minutes until thickened. Turn catfish occasionally so that it cooks evenly. Spoon half of the strawberry jam over the catfish. Top with remaining jam. Serve immediately.

title: Japanese Five Spice Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup allspice | 1/2 cup dry white sugar | 1/2 cup sake | 1/3 cup japanese-style dressing
instructions: To prepare dressing, combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: green bean,raspberry,hot sauce,farfalle pasta,french green bean,sherry wine
title: Fast and Easy French Bean Pasta Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 3 1/2 ounces french style green beans, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberries or 1 1/2 cups frozen raspberries, thawed | 3 tablespoons sherry wine ( or red wine vinegar ) | 1 -2 tablespoon sriracha hot sauce ( or to taste ) | 3/4 cup thawed green beans rinsed from microwave frozen green beans, drained
instructions: Cook and drain farfalle as directed on package.

title: Baked Butternut Squash
ingredients: 1 butternut squash - peeled, seeded and cubed | 1 tablespoon chopped celery seed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh capers | 4 flour tortillas, cut in half
instructions: Place the butternut squash in a microwave safe dish with 1/2 teaspoon of celery seed and water. Cover and microwave on high for 3 - 3 minutes, or until tender. Spread about 1 tablespoon of the celery seed mixture evenly over 1 tortilla half.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,biscuit,milk ricotta cheese,tomato green chile pepper,sesame seed oil,ketchup
title: Mexican Style Baked Ricotta Spread
ingredients: 1/2 can evaporated milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 2 teaspoons sesame seed oil | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 can refrigerated biscuits, keebler brand suggested
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Put biscuits in the bottom of a 9 inch square baking dish and press a bit of into each biscuit. Sprinkle a bit of cocoa over the biscuits and bake for 10 minutes or just until golden brown.

title: Kansas City Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 large ripe tomatoes | 2 tablespoons brown gravy mix | 2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut tops off tomatoes and discard. In a small bowl, combine brown gravy mix and molasses. Brush the tomatoes with the molasses mixture. Place tomatoes in a square of aluminum foil and pour remaining sauce over tomatoes. Bake 15 minutes, or until tomatoes are bubbling and the juices have thickened.

title: Homemade Wood Furniture Polish
ingredients: 1 envelope kitchen bouquet | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice
instructions: To remove excess sand from a wooden popsicle stick, place a candy thermometer on a baking sheet and warm it over a gas burner until it registers 280 degrees f. Pour in 2 teaspoons of kitchen bouquet into a heatproof glass jar, or about 1/2 cup. Sprinkle the remaining 1/2 teaspoon bouquet into a clean jar with a lid. Add the lime juice to the jar and swirl the mixture with your finger tips until the bouquet is incorporated, then add about 1 teaspoon of kitchen bouquet to the jar. Close the lid using a long metal spatula and shake the jar to coat any residue from the bouquet and stir it around. Store up to 2 weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Yummy Tzatziki Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup grated monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 teaspoon scallion | 1 cup plain greek style yogurt
instructions: To make it all the way, make sure the cheese is grated or chopped very finely. Grate the pepper cheese. Place it in a strainer.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,lemon juice,red chili sauce,spinach leaf
title: Ravioli With Spinach
ingredients: 2/3 cup ricotta cheese or 2/3 cup fresh spinach leaves | 1/3 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, finely grated | 1/3 cup red chili sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Line a baking sheet with nonstick foil and spray with cooking spray. In a food processor, combine ricotta, parmigiano reggiano, red chile sauce and lemon juice and process until well combined, stopping the motor as needed to scrape down the sides. Place spinach in a medium bowl and stir in the cheese mixture. Toss to combine. Spread onto prepared baking sheet and chill 2 hours, shaking about 10 minutes to dry spinach.

title: Salmon Cabbage and Cabbage Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs green cabbage, cored and shredded | 7 ounces smoked salmon fillets | 6 loaf french bread
instructions: Place the cabbage and smoked salmon in a mixing bowl. Sprinkle with salt to taste. Using a slotted spoon, put the cabbage mixture under the griller or the broiler until browned. Place the sandwich in the french or italian bread. Place the slices of smoked salmon on top of the sandwich and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,rice noodle,splenda brown sugar,cucumber,italian seasoning
title: Easy Italian Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 cucumber | 1/2 cup splenda brown sugar blend | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 cup dry rice noodles, no-cooked | 1/3 cup dry sherry wine | 1/4 cup splenda brown sugar blend, for drizzling on finished salad before serving - 2 tablespoons per serving
instructions: Peel cucumber, cut in half lengthwise, then in thin slices using a mandolin or knife. Remove seeds and membrane from cucumber. Place cucumber in a strainer and rinse with cold water. Pat with paper towels to remove as much moisture as possible. Using the same large bowl as cucumbers to rinse, place 1/2 cup splenda brown sugar blend, water, rice noodles, and sherry in a microwave safe bowl, cover and cook on high for 3 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds until noodles are tender. Now, i've started making this again, but instead of splenda, i double the brown sugar mix, and after tasting, i add 2 tablespoons of sherry and a bit of italian seasoning. I also took the advice of a reviewer over making a batch of this instead of the 2 tablespoons. I substituted 1/2 cup of rice noodles for 1/2 of the suggested sherry, which works well, for a wonderful tasting sauce. Also, i didn't need any substitutions, because i couldn't find the splenda brown sugar mix. It would've been too bland.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,corn oil,beef rib,kielbasa,peanut oil vegetable,cake flour,red bell pepper,pineapple chunk
title: Kielbasa with Pineapple-Stuffed Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 3 red bell peppers, cored and seeded ( about 12 oz. ) | 3 tablespoons peanut oil or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons cake flour | 1/3 cup milk chocolate | 1 cup pineapple chunks | 1 kielbasa, cut crosswise into 1/4 inch-thick slices | 1 3/4 cups cake flour | 2 teaspoons corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Arrange bell peppers on foil lined jelly roll pan.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,cayenne pepper,double cream,egg wrap,vanilla bean
title: Chocolate and Pepper Omelette (Tarte Au Chocolat)
ingredients: 4 eggs, with yolks | 4 chocolate chips | 1 split vanilla bean, split | cayenne pepper | 30 double cream
instructions: Take each ounce of the vanilla bean from a pod, peel off the bottom and discard. Place the seeds and pods in the center of four 6 oz custard cups, and place four whole broken chunks of vanilla in each. Fill the cup with cream. Pour cream onto the vanilla bean pods and let sit until the cream is almost set, to give a lovely vanilla flavour. Cut the remaining vanilla bean in half lengthways and scrape out the pod of pod. Chop the pod and return the bean to the pan if you wish. Let sit for a couple of minutes, then whisk in the egg yolks and the scraped pods from the vanilla pod. Whisk mixture until it thickens enough to coat the back of the spoon, but if you want a creamier sauce then whisk the egg whites until they form stiff peaks. Spoon egg mixture into a piping bag with a 3mm at tip. Pipe a line into each pastry cup, to create a 'heart shape'. Put another piping bag on top to make 8 equal circle shaped omettes. Heat a frying pan on the stove for a few minutes, before turning out the omlette onto a plate. Slide a frying pan under the omelette to set the omelette. Then put the serving plate in the microwave for 5 mins., or until it sets if cooked on the underside. It's very important not to overcook the egg to make sure it's cooked through, otherwise it could become 'too' tough. To serve, lift the omelette from the plate and cut into four fingers. Divide the fingers between the serving plates and spoon on some of the warm cream.

title: Kiwifruit Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup glutinous rice | 2 1/2 cups cold oil | 4 kiwifruit, cut into sticks | 10 slices korean-style fried rice, to serve | chili oil, to serve
instructions: Boil the glutinous rice in 2 1/2 cups of water for 10 - 15 minutes until the rice is soft. Drain the rice and set aside to cool. Cut 2 - ½ inch kiwifruit sticks into 2 - ½ inch long sticks and slice 3/4 inch thick. Heat a small amount of oil in a large frying pan or wok over high heat. Once it is hot enough, add the kiwifruit sticks. Stir fry until lightly golden. Remove from heat. Place the fried rice on a plate. Sprinkle a few drops of chili oil over the fried rice. Scatter 2 kiwifruit sticks and slices of fried rice over the kiwifruit sticks. Serve immediately.

title: Rigatoni With Pork and Beet (Grilled)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 bag rigatoni pasta
instructions: In plastic bag, combine pork and oregano. Seal bag and turn to coat pork thoroughly. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat grill to medium and line with grate. Grill pork until just cooked through, about 8 minutes per side. Meanwhile, cook rigatoni as per package directions and drain. Reserving 1/2 cup, combine the reserved 1/2 cup liquid and the pork and beet mixture and divide among serving bowls. Serve with reserved pasta.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,beer,sicilian olive,chicken breast fillet,garlic salt
title: Baked Sicilian Olives
ingredients: 12 ounces extra-virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt ( can add more if desired... more garlic salt will give a flavor ) | 1 quart organic beer | 1 1/2 cups uncooked arborio rice | 6 boneless skinless chicken breast fillets
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375 f. In a glass bowl pour in half a bottle of your bottled garlic salt and olive oil. Mix well then add in the beer. In a large pot add in the arborio rice, mixing well so as to coat evenly. Add the chicken breasts, and coat well with the beer. Place the chicken breasts onto a large rimmed cookie sheet with sides. Slice the chicken into strips and arrange on the top of the rice on top of the chicken. Pour one cup of the olive oil mixture over the chicken. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes.

title: Dynamite (Drunken Cocktail)
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas | 1 cup coke | 1/2 lb of cubed smoked salmon
instructions: Rinse, drain, and rinse the cans of chickpeas. Drain the chickpeas from the cans. Mix the can of Coke and 1/2 of the cubed salmon into the cans. Pour the can of Coke into the can of chickpeas and stir. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Chile Basmati Rice from the Microwave
ingredients: 300 g chile, deseeded and chopped ( fresh or frozen ) | 400 g basmati rice, medium grain | 300 g basmati rice, long grain
instructions: Place all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl and stir to combine. Cook on high for 10 minutes, stir, then cook on high for 30 seconds longer or until all of the liquid has been absorbed. Use a fork to fluff rice and serve.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,yellow squash,italian herb seasoning,spinach leaf,orange zest,pesto sauce,maple syrup
title: Italian Seasoned Squash with Green, Yellow, and Orange Peel
ingredients: 2 cups yellow squash, cut in 1/4-inch slices | 1 cup frozen spinach leaves, thawed and squeezed dry | 2/3 cup pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 2 tablespoons dried italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 5 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Position a rack in the center of an oven. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium glass or metal bowl, toss the squash with the pesto, orange zest, italian seasoning, and orange zest. Spread squash mixture in a layer on a rack in a shallow baking dish just large enough to hold all of the squash. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 30 minutes. Remove the squash and bake until firm and a deep brown, about 15 minutes. Remove the zest from the bowl with the squash, and allow it to cool completely on a rack. Transfer the squash to a serving plate and allow it to cool at room temperature. Transfer the squash to a serving bowl, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Stir the maple syrup into the pesto.

title: Aloo Ras El-Holq (Potatoes in Ras El Hanout)
ingredients: 12 small red potatoes, washed in cold water, peeled and cut into 4 squares | 4 tablespoons coriander powder | 3 green peppers, cut into large squares ( seeded, de-seeded and cut into cubes ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Place potatoes and coriander in a pan and add cold water to cover all by 1. Bake for 40 minutes at 425f stirring occasionally. Add peppers and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in remaining spices. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,italian salad dressing,chunky salsa,golden syrup
title: Golden Skillet Fresco
ingredients: 3 cups crispy italian salad dressing | 1/4 cup bottled italian salad dressing | 1/4 cup chunk chunky salsa | 1/4 cup grated pecorino-romano cheese
instructions: Heat 2 cups salad dressing, salsa, cheese, and 3 tablespoons salad dressing and stir til combined.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,spring onion,cumin,extra virgin olive oil
title: Mexican Spring Onion Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lettuce leaf ( like bibb lettuce ) | 1 shallot ( preferably very finely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin ( to taste )
instructions: Rinse lettuce and pat dry with paper towel. Place on salad plate or serving plate. Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with cumin and scatter chopped shallots over lettuce. Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil and salt to taste.

title: Tamarind Marinade for Chicken or Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tamarind paste | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized dish. Note, if using pork, heat over low heat until well blended, and cover. It will take at least 40 minutes at temperature.

title: Italian Spiced Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Rinse and dry tomato. Heat oil in a skillet or wok over medium high heat. When oil shimmers, stir in sun dried tomatoes. Reduce heat to low, and let simmer about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper.

title: Japanese Shichimi - Yaki Seaweed Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wakame seaweed, soaked for 30 to 45 minutes | 1 1/2 cups endive, leaves
instructions: Prepare the seaweed from soaking the wakame by placing the seaweed in a pot with cold water.

title: Goulash (India Lentils With Lemons)
ingredients: 1 cup dried brown lentils | 3/4 cup mango or 3/4 cup apricot, diced | 2 plum tomatoes, diced | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 - 1 cup lemonade | 1/2 tablespoon ground paprika
instructions: Cook lentils in water with bouillon cubes until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain. Add mango and tomatoes. Drain any excess water. Add lentils and lemonade. Season with paprika.

Random Ingredients: mustard,hot italian sausage,pecorino romano cheese,nutritional yeast,mint
title: Italian Herb Sausage Spread(Raw)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 2 tablespoons hot mustard ( or 1/2 teaspoon of your favourite hot paste ) | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese ( grated ) | 3/4 lb lean ground hot italian sausage | 1 small bunch fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large food processor and blend until well mixed and creamy. You may need to add more milk or broth if too grainy. Let sit at room temperature for an hour or two before using store bought pesto. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,head cabbage,french bread,chicken wing,prawn,anchovy paste,white sesame seed
title: Chinese Style Breaded Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow squash, cut into thick bite sized pieces | 2 large heads of cabbage, cut into 3 large chunks | 1 can ready-to-eat prawns | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 1 loaf french bread, halved lengthways | 4 pieces white sesame seeds | 8 pieces anchovy paste | 16 chicken wings | 6 tablespoons white sesame seeds
instructions: Place the squash, cabbage, prawn eggs, and 2 tbsp anchovy paste in a sauce pan and bring to simmering. Lower the heat and simmer until cooked though. Cut the bread into thick slices. Slice 3 - 5 pieces from the inside of the bread and leave them to side. Whip the remaining anchovy paste until it is a thick paste. Using a sharp knife cut the pieces into strips about 1 1/2 long. Remove all of the bread but 1 tbsp anchovy paste from the saucepan. Drain the mixture of tomatoes and peppers into a bowl and stir in the strained anchovy paste. Scoop out half of the bread from the loaf and discard the remainder. Cut and discard most of the middle portion of the loaf, leaving a 5 cm thick shell. Take the bread from the loaf and lay it into your food processor. Crush the bread crumbs into crumbs. Using two forks quickly mix in the remaining anchovy paste. Mix the bread crumbs and anchovy paste into the chicken. Cover and let it marinate for at least 2 hours. To make the sauce, toast the sesame corn on a dry, cast iron griddle pan or under a preheated grill over a medium heat. Toast until golden brown. Using tongs, transfer to a warmed plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Wipe out the pan. Place a couple of pieces of marinated chicken onto a plate and cover with the sesame seed slices. Place the second piece of bread on top of the bread and press the bread lightly together. Heat a large nonstick wok or skillet over high head of mustard and cook the toast, turning once, until golden brown. Remove from heat and set aside. To serve, divide the bread onto 4 warmed serving plates and top with the cooked chicken. To eat, cut the bread into slices and place a piece of chicken on top and serve with a dipping sauce of your choice.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,brown mustard seed,rice vermicelli,cumin,golden mushroom soup,chicken thigh,white rum,cream mushroom soup
title: Easy Chicken Roulades
ingredients: 3 -4 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 teaspoon salt, to taste | 1/8 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/8 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 8 slices cinnamon roll paper ( optional ) or 8 slices other long sheets of vermicelli ( optional ) | 12 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 10 1/2 ounces condensed golden mushroom soup | 2/3 cup dark sweet white rum
instructions: Combine the soup and rum in a medium bowl and whisk thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate overnight, stirring occasionally. Cut away the end flap of each roll and trim off any fat. Remove rolls from refrigerator, leaving a 5 inch strip at the top and 1 inch of meat on the outside of each roll. Place 2 chicken thighs in each roll, tucking the tips into the meat to help seal. Season both sides with salt and cumin. Roll each roll in the spice mixture and place seam side down in a lightly greased 9x13 baking dish. Pour any leftover spice mixture over the rolls and top evenly with the cinnamon rolls. Cover and refrigerate overnight, stirring occasionally. Preheat oven to 350°f. Bake for one hour, uncover and bake for an additional 45 minutes or until a crust has begun to brown. Remove from oven and allow to sit for at least 10 minutes before cutting into slices.

Random Ingredients: pasta,basil leaf,mexican oregano,ricotta cheese,stewing beef,lamb,broccoli floret,dijon mustard

instructions: Cook beef and broccoli, drain. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine mustard, oregano and 1/4 cup of the ricotta cheese.

Random Ingredients: white wine,turmeric powder,bell pepper,rosemary sprig,chocolate,cocoa,romaine lettuce
title: Vegan Chocolate Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 4 bell peppers ( red or yellow ) | 4 leaves romaine lettuce | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa | 6 tablespoons unsalted chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 10 fresh rosemary sprigs | 8 tablespoons dry white wine
instructions: Combine the cocoa, turmeric, rosemary, and 1/2 cup of the wine in a clean glass jar with tight fitting lid. Stir gently to combine. Peel and remove the stem from each bell pepper, and slice into 6 equal lengths, then place them in the jar with the cocoa mixture. Pour the remaining wine into a small, nonstick skillet, and bring to a boil over high heat. While holding the peppers by the jar, transfer the contents of the jar back to the pan, cover and warm it over moderate heat for a minute. Remove the peppers, arrange them on a warm plate and place them in a serving bowl. Remove the stems from the lettuce, and slice into 6 equal pieces each. Add the chocolate and remaining 1/2 cup of wine to the skillet and cook over moderate heat, stirring constantly, until the chocolate melts. Stir the chocolate mixture into the skillet and cook over moderate heat until glossy, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in the remaining 1/2 cup of wine. Arrange the lettuce leaves on a platter and drizzle them with the chocolate sauce. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cool whip,brioche bread,lemon pepper,grand marnier,chipotle chile pepper,shrimp,water,corn tortilla chip

instructions: Mix together the lemon pepper, chipotle chile pepper, and shrimp in a small bowl. Sprinkle shrimp mixture over shrimp mixture. Press mixture into the brioche bread slices to form a 6x8 inch rectangle. Chill bread slices at least 1 hour. Spread grand marnier on each slice.

Random Ingredients: chocolate coffee bean,cilantro,cilantro leaf,radish,spanish onion,green chili,anchovy oil,english muffin
title: Hot Chocolate Sandwich
ingredients: 8 sprigs cilantro ( small bunch ) | 1/2 spanish onion, thinly sliced | 6 thin slices smoked english muffins | 1/2 ounce dried chocolates or 1/2 ounce bittersweet chocolate, melted and set aside | 1 tablespoon anchovy oil | 8 sprigs cilantro leaf ( flat-leaf ) | 1/2 fresh green chili, thinly sliced | 1/2 small radish, thinly sliced
instructions: Place a grill pan over medium high heat or preheat broiler. Tear 5 sprigs cilantro leaves and slice finely. title: Water Chestnuts in Curried Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seeds | 2 small water chestnuts, peeled and sliced | 1/3 cup superfine sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a small skillet over high heat until very hot. Stir in the caraway seeds. Cook 1 minute or until fragrant. Stir in onion and water chestnuts. title: Quinoa Pilaf - Vegan
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( i prefer basmati ) | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons green cardamom pods, crushed | 1/2 - 3/4 fresh peach, peacock or 1/2-3/4 peach, pitted | 1/4 teaspoon ground turkish quinoa ( for colour )
instructions: Cook quinoa as directed on package. Rinse with warm water and soak for 15 - 20 minutes. Rinse under warm water and drain well. Place ingredients in blender and pulse to a coarse, mushy consistency. Serve warm with warm yogurt for a smooth pass.

instructions: Place beans, sherry, tomatoes, chicken strips and water in a 3 litre slow cooker. Cover and cook on high setting for 15 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and add it to the slow cooker. Cover and cook for an additional 30 minutes. Remove chicken from slow cooker and transfer it to a clean plate and discard any juices. Spoon the chicken back into the slow cooker and stir in the tomato chutney.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,rosemary,rice vinegar,spanish onion
title: Savory Spanish Onions
ingredients: 4 large spanish onions, thinly sliced ( vidalia, purple or sweet onions ) | 6 tablespoons rice vinegar or 6 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 5 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped
instructions: Arrange onions in a serving dish and top with remaining ingredients. Let stand for 30 minutes to develop flavors before serving.

title: Minty, Fresh and Easy Chicken With Thyme
ingredients: 2 whole chickens | 1 sprig fresh thyme sprig | 1 dried mint leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f and put the chicken in a large roasting pan. Lay the thyme leaves in a large handful and roll or press them into the chicken. Bake them for 1 hour. Carefully remove the thyme leaves. Slip them out onto a serving platter. Put in the mint leaves. If you like, you can serve this dish hot with grilled lamb for an evening meal. Enjoy on its own, too..

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,cucumber,soy sauce,serrano chili,red capsicum,dark corn syrup,grand marnier,salmon steak
title: Grilled Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cucumber, thinly sliced | 1/2 red capsicum, sliced | 1/2 cup of sliced pepperoni | 100 g dark corn syrup | 1 1/4 cups soy sauce | 3 tablespoons grand marnier or 3 tablespoons cream sherry | 1 red serrano chili, sliced | 2 seared salmon steaks
instructions: Soak the salmon steaks for at least 20 minutes in cold water prior to cooking. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a bowl. Combine dipping sauce ingredients in a pan, and heat, stirring constantly, over a low heat until combined. Set aside. Place salmon steaks onto a tray and sprinkle with the dipping sauce, and grill for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,garlic salt,ro tel tomato,heavy whipping cream,tabasco sauce,vanilla bean,jasmine rice,cheddar monterey cheese
title: Cheesy Mexican Rice

instructions: Cook rice until just under done. Drain. Put rice into a large bowl, add the mozarella, half the cheddar, the pepper sauce, the spices, and half the cheese. Stir til cheese is melted. Put rice and cheese mixture into large casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350' f until top is golden brown, about one hour and fifteen minutes.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,tomato ketchup,water,chili paste,baking powder,mexican cheese,mustard seed
title: Mexican Style Salmon
ingredients: 2 boneless salmon fillets, skin on | 1/3 cup tomato ketchup | 1/4 cup water | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( see recipe id # 479884 ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon mexican blend cheese, shredded
instructions: Place salmon in a large shallow baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl.

title: Traditional British Baked Gnocchi
ingredients: 4 romano cheese, grated | 1 1/2 pounds bacon, diced | 2 cans chopped gnocchi, drained | 1 cup sultanas, split | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground cardamom | 1 1/2 tablespoons poultry seasoning, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a medium sized baking dish. Mix romano cheese, bacon, gnocchi, sultanas, cardamom, and poultry seasoning together in a bowl until well combined, then transfer into the prepared baking dish. Cover dish with a lid and bake in preheated oven until gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened, about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,yoghurt,fish sauce,extra virgin olive oil
title: Baked Fish With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 cans fish sauce | extra virgin olive oil | 1 cup corn flakes | 2 cups yoghurt, to dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Put the fish in the oven and bake for 25 minutes or until opaque, turning and rearranging pieces halfway through. Serve immediately with dipping sauce. Dipping sauce, put all the ingredients, in a large bowl, and beat together until well combined and well mixed. If the sauce is a bit thick, add a few tablespoons of water. Serve with fish, and dip the fish once or twice.

title: Le Mouton
ingredients: 12 ounces double cream | 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped | lemon zest ( to taste, i leave this out, but add a few grated zest of candied lemon if you wish to grate a little bit on top. )
instructions: Whip double cream to soft peaks, fold into cream. Serve over lettuce as desired.

Random Ingredients: banana liqueur,pumpkin,spaghetti,salt black pepper,beef stock,hominy,vegetable broth
title: Pumpkin and Tortilla Soup With Hominy
ingredients: 2 lbs pumpkin, peeled, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 3 lbshominy, canned beans, drained | 1/2 cup banana liqueur, such as contadina ( or another anise-flavored liqueur ) | 4 cups beef stock | 6 ounces small spaghetti, broken into 1-inch pieces | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth
instructions: Place pumpkin in a soup pot, cover with water, and place over medium heat. Bring to a boil and cook until golden in color, about 3 minutes. Remove and set aside. Using a stick blender, purée pumpkin in bowl of food processor or with immersion blender until smooth. Measure pumpkin puree while puree is hot, then place pumpkin puree and all remaining ingredients except spaghetti in a stock pot and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours, or until pumpkin is very soft. Meanwhile, bring a medium pot of water to boil. Add spaghetti pieces and stir in. Cook 3 to 5 minutes, or until just tender. Drain and place spaghetti onto a serving platter, spoon soup over and sprinkle with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,chickpea,taco sauce,white vinegar,rye flour,mushroom,garlic powder,canola oil
title: Beef and Chickpea Flatbread
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 1/4 cups minced sauteed mushrooms | 5 cups cubed velveeta cheese | 1 can chickpeas, drained, rinsed ( reserve juice ) | 2 cups chopped cooked corned beef ( reserved juice ) | 3 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 tablespoon white vinegar
instructions: In a frying pan, heat 1/2 cup canola oil.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,golden raisin,pomegranate juice,red food coloring,spinach leaf
title: Pomegranate Chicken
ingredients: 1 boneless pork shoulder ( about 1-1/2 pounds ) | 1/2 cup golden raisin ( shelled ) | 2 bags fresh spinach leaves ( packed ) | 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice | 4 drops red food coloring
instructions: Using vegetable peeler, remove and discard any large white or yellow membrane from the pork. Cut into ¾ inch slices. Place in medium bowl, add raisins and enough water to cover by 3 inches. Let soak 30 minutes, then drain. Place in crockpot and set aside. Cut remaining spinach into thirds, then coarsely chop using food processor or large slicing disk of hand held slicer. Transfer remaining spinach to a small bowl, cover with 1 tablespoon water and microwave on high, 1 to 2 minutes, or until wilted. Drain, squeezing out excess water. Place spinach in a large plastic storage bag and add 1/2 teaspoon of pomegranate juice. Seal and shake to combine. Serve meat mixture with the spinach for a main course, or with other accompaniments, such as noodles or rice. Note, if you prefer, use vegetable peeler or the vegetable peeler to remove fibers from pork.

title: Lamb Chops with Toasted Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 3 lamb chops, 1-inch thick | 2 tablespoons cracked pepper | 2 cups warm bread
instructions: Using a mallet, pound the chops well, using a mallet to pound to flatten slightly. Place the bread crumbs on a nonstick baking sheet. Sprinkle the lamb with the cracked pepper and set aside for 1 minute. Dip in the crumbs and let the excess dry off. Heat a nonstick skillet over moderately high heat. Place the lamb in the skillet cook for 4 minutes on each side or until the lamb is well browned. Serve immediately.

title: Pasta With Tomatoes, Penne and Penne
ingredients: 2 cans tomato sauce | 3/4 lb penne, uncooked
instructions: Cook penne and drain. Combine tomato sauce and penne in large saucepan until well blended. Cover over low heat and simmer 10 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Bread, Spice, and Apple Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 cup bulgur wheat | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground anise seed | 3 cups all-purpose flour, divided | 2 large yellow onions, diced | 1 green apple - peeled, cored, and diced | 1 loaf fusilli | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, divided
instructions: Place bulgur wheat and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt into a bowl. Let stand 5 minutes to absorb water. Combine 2 cups flour, diced onion, and diced apple in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 25 minutes. Place bulgur wheat mixture into a large bowl, and stir in flour until well mixed. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cook filling in a pot over medium heat. Cook until the mixture has melted, and the topping is dark brown. Stir in remaining 2 tablespoons flour. Set aside cooking mixture. Serve pasta in a large soup bowl with enough filling to coat, but not overflowing. Garnish with reserved 1 tablespoon of flour.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,chinese five spice powder
title: Homemade Four-Spice Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese ( or other mild cheese ) | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 celsius. Mix cheese and five spice. Press mixture evenly on a greased tray, then bake or 1 hour at 200c until golden brown.

title: Stir Fry Rice Noodles
ingredients: 3/4 cup sodium-reduced sodium splenda granular | 1 package rice noodles
instructions: Put rice noodles in a pot of boiling water and cook according to package instructions. Drain and rinse under cold tap water. Drain well with cold water. Repeat steps 1 and 2 using a fork, add sugar for each noodle. Cover and let sit 5 minutes. Meanwhile, put noodles in a large microwave safe bowl and microwave on high 1 minute more, stirring after every minute or so. Serve and enjoy.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Puree
ingredients: 3/4 cup of raw cauliflower | 1/4 cup of pure frozen purple onions | 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 cup stock ( beef or vegetable ) | 1/4 cup lemon juice
instructions: Finely chop cauliflower. In bowl place onion, chipotle powder, lemon juice and stock. Whisk together well. Pour mixture into your food processor and pulse until the consistency of soup. Pour into large, microwave safe bowl and cover with cling wrap. Microvave on high for 6 minutes, then micro on medium for 1 more minutes. Pour into serving bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Quinoa Salad

instructions: Rinse quinoa well and place in pan with water to the depth of 1/2 inch and add 1 tablespoon salt. Bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat. Taste and adjust seasoning. Enjoy.

title: Sushi Crusted Beef Hash (Sushi)
ingredients: 3 cups dry instant rice | 1 1/2 lbs rump steak | 1/2 cup rice flour | 2 eggs | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 6 tablespoons miso | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 12 cups sushi rice | 1 cup of shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Combine 2 cups of dry instant rice and 2 tablespoons of cold water in a sauce pan with a lid and bring to the boil. Remove from heat and cover for about 15 - 20 minutes. Drain and place on a paper towel lined plate to dry and cool completely. Cut the meat into medium sized cubes and stir in the 1/2 cup of rice flour in a large heavy bottomed pot. Beat in the eggs, followed by the cream and miso. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly, then simmer on medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is smooth and thick, 5 - 9 to 10 minutes. While the eggs are coming to a boil, bring about 2 1/2 cups of sushi rice to a boil in lightly salted water. Reduce heat and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and cook 15 minutes, or until cooked through. Rinse rice well under cold water until no longer cloudy. Dip a 1/2 cup measuring cup into boiling water and then drain the rice of excess water. This will drain some of the excess water into the rice and keep it moist. Fill each of the prepared steamed sushi shells by pushing down with your thumb and stretching slightly over the sides of the pan to make them dry enough to mold easily. You could also use a rice mat to keep the sushi from sticking to itself. Pour about 1 1/2 cups of rice in a bamboo sushi mold and place into a steamer over medium heat. This will also help the rice mold keep its shape while you cook it. The bamboo sushi mat has to be big enough to fully wrap around your hands if it is submerged in water. It will not have to be big enough to reach all of the rice, but it should tightly cover the rice. When the water at the bottom of the steamer stops coming to a boil, place a clean, damp towel on top of the mold and press on the sides to push some of the rice into it to make a flat shape. This is not very handy you can simply pat the rice off the rice and onto the towel or mat in your hands, which are left in the pot on top of the rice to keep the steam from seeping through. Remove the plastic wrap and gently turn the sushi over. Hold the rice with both hands and pull the rice over the mold so the top of the rice resembles a cone. Steam a couple of minutes until the rice turns a deep amber color and has been cooked through. Do not overcook the rice. When it turns into a cone, the rice should be cooked through. To unmold the rice, put a piece of rice on a flat surface and top with about 1/4 cup of the mexican cheese. Then lay about 1 - 2 tablespoons of the cheesy mexican cheese on top of the cheese and then put another mexican cheese piece over the cheese. Continue to carefully unroll the steamed rice and place onto a platter. Repeat with the remaining mexican cheese pieces and mexican cheese, placing each onto a plate. The mexican cheese is the traditional garnish used in sushi making sure to provide additional mexican cheese in your last moments.

title: French Toast With Coffee-mate
ingredients: 2 slices sourdough bread | cocoa powder or cinnamon flavored coffee-mate
instructions: Toast each slice of bread. Spray a non stick pan with cooking spray. Add one slice of bread to the pan. Sprinkle desired amount of cinnamon and coked coffee over the top of the bread. Add the other slice of bread to the pan and turn toast over with a spatula so that the bread is nicely toasted on the bottom.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 3 cans lobsters meat
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the worcestershire sauce and worcestershire sauce together in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Distribute lobster meat in baking dish into single layer. Pour worcestershire sauce over the meat.

Random Ingredients: sherry,mushroom,chicken wing,purpose flour,kosher salt black pepper,iceberg lettuce,cannellini bean
title: Grilled Chicken Wingettes W-White Beans
ingredients: 1 cup canned cannellini beans, with liquid | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 2 1/2 lbs chicken wings, tips removed | 1 -2 head iceberg lettuce, separated into leaves | 1 1/2 cups sliced fresh mushrooms
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°f. In a 4 to 5 quart dutch oven over medium high heat, cook and stir beans in liquid until liquid evaporates. Add flour and cook, whisking, just until lightly browned. Increase heat to high. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Add chicken wings to pan and cook until golden brown and chicken is just cooked through, about 8 minutes, turning once. Remove chicken and reserve. Discard any remaining oil in pan. In a nonstick skillet large enough to accommodate all chicken wings and wings, cook the sherry over high heat, swirling pan occasionally, until browned and syrupy, about 3 minutes. Add chicken wings, lettuce and mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,guacamole,nutmeg,pear,graham cracker crumb,calrose rice
title: Pear 'n' Beef on a Crust
ingredients: 4 cups uncooked calrose rice ( jasmine rice ) | 4 pounds beef chuck roast | 1 pound pear slices | 1 cup guacamole | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 1/4 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place uncooked calrose rice in a large bowl, and add enough water to cover. Stir in beef, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Remove meat from the refrigerator, and cut into 1 inch chunks. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray, and spread the rice out onto it. Sprinkle cracker crumbs onto the rice. Place meat chunks in a single layer on the cracker crumbs. Top the meat with guacamole, then sprinkling nutmeg over it. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Focaccia Bread
ingredients: 2 naan bread | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Grease a baking sheet. Spread the bread with olive oil. Sprinkle the brown sugar into the hot bread and place on a baking sheet. Broil for 5 minutes until the bread is toasted. Serve hot.

title: Korean Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/4 cup soy sauce ( i was told this was 1 tbsp ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried chili ( i used jalapeno's )
instructions: Mix seasonings. Form into patties. Grill or fry until browned.

title: Faux Cashew Nut Dessert Salad
ingredients: 1 package vanilla pudding mix | 1/2 cup cashew nuts | 1 teaspoon grated orange rind | fresh basil leaf
instructions: Prepare the vanilla pudding according to pkg directions, adding remaining ingredients into a large bowl and beating well. Turn onto serving platter and garnish with fresh basil leaves.

title: Mexican Green Chile
ingredients: 1 -2 small poblano pepper | 1 inch piece fresh gingerroot, peeled | 2 cups golden rum ( mexican rum is good to use too )
instructions: Slice all the peppers and place them, cut side down in a large dish. Sprinkle on the ginger, top with the rum, pour on enough boiling water to cover. Let stand for one hour or until the peppers are pliable. Garnish with paprika.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,salsa,oka cheese,cherry tomato,raspberry,sesame seed,celery root
title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 -2 ounce ko cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 4 -5 ounces risotto vegetables or 4 -5 ounces raspberries | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 3 stalks celery root, finely chopped | 1 jar salsa, your favourite
instructions: Place the cheese, bicarbonate of soda and tomatoes in a bowl. Place the vegetables/raisins/salsa in the bowl and gently stir to blend. Then, add the cheese mixture and stir to combine. Chill in the fridge for a few hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: sultana,streaky bacon,porridge oat,spring onion,pasta,beef rib,burgundy wine
title: Beef Broth and Rice Balls
ingredients: 600 g beef short ribs | 1/2 lb streaky bacon | 1 pint burgundy wine | 100 g sultanas | 300 g pastas | 100 g mixed spring onions | 3 sprigs fresh porridge oats
instructions: Cut the meat into 1 inch cubes, cut the bacon rind into slices and cook slowly in the pan over a low heat so the fat does not burn or crisp. Do not brown as this could cause severe burns. Leave to cool until easy to handle and then cut into thin strips. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a pan and fry the strips of bacon. Remove from the heat and cool. Soak the sultanas in the wine for 1 - 2 hours, drain and then cut into thin wedges and fry in the remaining olive oil until golden. Place the meat, sultanas, pastas and spring onions in a pan and cover with water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes, then add the oats, then boil for a further 5 minutes. Lift out the meat with a slotted spoon and place onto a plate. Remove the pan from the heat but leave the stock until it has been reduced by half. Add a little salt if desired and strain through a tea towel. Cut the meat into small cubes and stir through the sauce just before serving.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,red bean,celery rib,head cauliflower,white vinegar,milk cream,maraschino cherry
title: Red Bean, Cauliflower & Tomatoes Salad-Casserole
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1/2 cup chopped celery rib | 1 can red beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 container whole milk & cream | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and finely chopped | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 400ºf. Toss first 7 ingredients in heavy large skillet. Transfer to oven.

title: Japanese Five-Spice Tea
ingredients: 4 cups strong hot tea, room temperature | 1 1/2 cups plus 1 teaspoon sansho | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder
instructions: Combine hot and cold water in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Pour into a tea infuser and place over high heat. Cover with a double thickness of cloth secured with wooden picks, place a tea towel on top of the cloth and suspend the tea bag over the tea. Let steep 5 minutes. Remove tea bag and add 3 teaspoons to the tea.

title: Chili and Sausage With Bok Choy
ingredients: 4 links sweet italian sausage | 20 leaves bok choy, cut into 4cm lengths | 1 tablespoon dried chili powder | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lavender flowers
instructions: Wash and dry the sausages. Cut lengthways into four 5cm lengths. Mix together chili powder and dried lavender flowers. Sprinkle over sausages, coating all sides well. Sprinkle with a little extra chili powder mixture and marinate 30 minutes or overnight in fridge. Brush with a little oil and grill for 4 - 5 mins each side or until cooked through and golden. Serve with plain boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,strawberry,tuna water,tart apple,duck breast,raspberry,peanut butter,tomatillo
title: Spicy Duck and Apple Salad
ingredients: 300 g duck breasts, slices | 2 large tart tatillos, roasted, skins left on ( optional ) | 300 g strawberries, hulled | 150 g mixed mushrooms, cleaned clean | 6 pieces tomatoes ( small tomatoes should be used ) | 100 g peanut butter, smooth | 250 ml duck water | 600 g raspberries
instructions: Slice onions and caps very thinly. Wash and dry mushroom slice. Cut the duck breast into thin strips, place in a small sauce pan with duck fat and water. Cover and allow to cook over a moderate heat for 10 - 15 minutes, turning occasionally. The duck fat will burn easily and make this extremely tasty dish.

title: Rhubarb and Squash with Squash
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds rhubarb, cut into 1-inch pieces | 6 ears corn kernels, cut from the cob | 3 small red thai chiles, cut into halves | 1 pound squash, halved
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, blanch the rhubarb until the stems are tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, discarding the stems, and cut into 1 inch pieces. Transfer to a large mixing bowl, add the corn kernels and chiles and toss to combine. Set the bowl aside. Fill the pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once it comes to a rolling boil, stir in the squash and return to a boil. Cook the squash until tender, 4 to 5 minutes. Drain and add to the squash with lime wedges and salt to taste. Serve warm.

title: Russian Mushroom and Noodles With Lavender (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 lb dried wild mushroom | 3 1/2 cups cooked cabbage or 3 1/2 cups savoy cabbage, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon saffron ( or 1 teaspoon turmeric ) | 1 -3 teaspoon dried lavender
instructions: Place all ingredients except saffron or turmeric in large mixing bowl and combine well. Sprinkle saffron or turmeric over top. Toss well to cover ingredients and let stand for 15 minutes. Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid. Place mushrooms and liquid in saucepan on low heat and bring to a boil. Serve over brown sticky noodles of your choice or rice.

title: Dynamite Beef in the Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shortening ( i use butter ) | 1/2 lb coriander powder ( or ground coriander ) | 2 packages refrigerated beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 8 ounces half-and-half | 10 ounces frozen corn or 10 ounces frozen cut corn, thawed | 1/4 cup scallion, chopped
instructions: In a large skillet, melt shortening over medium heat. Add coriander powder and beef.

Random Ingredients: midori melon liqueur,sage,cream tartar,rigatoni pasta,white rice
title: Creamy Sweet Scented Garlic & Sticky Rice Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice | 3 tablespoons midori melon liqueur | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 3 cups cooked rigatoni pasta
instructions: Rinse and drain rice well. Combine all ingredients and mix well.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,cabbage,fish sauce,lamb,icing sugar,vegetable stock,corn tortilla
title: Lamb Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb ( i used venison ) | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 1/2 cups cabbage or 1 1/2 cups kale, finely shredded | 8 crispy soft corn tortillas ( i use the corn tortillas ) | your favourite pizza sauce
instructions: Prepare meat by combining the fish sauce, sugar, stock, cabbage, and meat in a large bowl, and mix with your hands until the meat is mixed. Warm a large non stick frying pan over medium high. Put the tortillas into the hot frying pan and cook for about 10 seconds on each side or until golden and pliable. Lay out a few spoonfuls of meat mixture onto them, top with a spoonful or two of your choice of pizza sauce and wrap tightly. Cut in half and eat warm or cold.

title: Curried White and Black Vegetable Posole
ingredients: 1 can condensed consomme | 2 cans white hominy, drained | 1 can curd cottage cheese | 1 dash curry powder
instructions: Place the drained white hominy, curd cottage cheese, and curry powder into the crock pot. Mix well. Place lid on crock pot and place on high for 6 to 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: catsup,fig,black pepper,marjoram,kaffir lime leaf,self raising flour
title: Toad in the Hole (Figs in the Hole - Figs in the Hole)
ingredients: 1 lb self raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 5 kaffir lime leaves, torn into 8 -10 pieces | 5 large fresh figs, halved and stoned | catsup | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Place the flour in a bowl and make a well in the centre. Add one of the lime leaves, the marjoram and kaffir lime leaves. Pour in the chopped figs and the catsup. Stir together with a fork, then stir in little black pepper, a little at a time.

title: Sazon Goya (Sazon Goya)
ingredients: 1 packet sazon goya | 1/4 cup sherry wine
instructions: Dry fry sazon goya in pan with 1/4 cup sherry for about 2 minutes. Set aside. Serve with white rice.

title: Homemade Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef ( lean ) | 1 lb ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon hing
instructions: Dice the beef very small and then set aside. In a mixing bowl combine the beef, ricotta and hing. Mix well and form into little balls. Refrigerate for 1/2 hour before cooking. Cook 1 inch diameter slices of cheese in water to cover until they are brown in color.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,vanilla sugar,green olive,taco seasoning,kosher salt
title: Faux "drunken" Baked Olives
ingredients: 6 green olives ( such as nicoise, lisbon, obregon ) | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange the olives in a single layer in a baking dish. Place the remaining ingredients on top of the olives. Bake, covered, until the olives are tender, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Uncover, and cool for 10 minutes.

title: Creamy Orzo
ingredients: 8 ounces orzo pasta | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 1/4 cup prepared mustard, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add orzo and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Tahini Mutton
ingredients: 1 piece mutton | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon tahini
instructions: Wash the mutton well, remove all traces of blood and skin. Put the mutton into a bowl. Sprinkle icing sugar over it. Mix well and keep aside for 1 hour at room temperature or overnight in fridge. Stir the tahini well, then add the tahini mixture to the meat. Sprinkle icing sugar. Keep in mind that the meat will absorb the tahini. Cover with cling wrap. Keep in fridge for a few hours for the flavours to blend. Break off pieces of lettuce leaves, or mix lettuce into the meat and serve on a plate.

title: Stuffed Fingers
ingredients: 1/2 cup cashews | 3/4 cup dried mint | 2 pinches grated nutmeg | cambozola cheese, for stuffing
instructions: Combine cashews with mint, nutmeg and a little bit of cheese. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. With a pastry brush, lightly grease a small baking dish. Using a pastry brush, lightly sprinkle each finger with 1 teaspoon of the remaining cheese. Bake in a preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until golden.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,radish,peanut butter,scallop,date,white flour,dark soy sauce
title: Thai Salt Crusted Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup white flour | 2 large scallops | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1/4 cup diced date | 1 bunch fresh radish, scored and sliced thin
instructions: Whisk together the dark soy sauce and the peanut butter. Stir in the flour with a pinch of salt and whisk until smooth. Set aside. Heat a medium saute pan and add the scallops. Shake the pan to coat it evenly with the oil. Cook just until the scallops are just cooked through, 1 or 2 seconds per side. Remove the scallops from the pan. Set aside. Sprinkle the dates and radishes over the scallops and top with the peanut sauce. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: tahini,catsup,pimiento,almond extract,scotch whisky,taco seasoning,dijon mustard,white vinegar
title: Scotch Mustard Spread
ingredients: 1 cup catsup | 1/2 cup scotch whisky | 1 pinch ground tahini | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 tablespoons finely chopped sun-dried tomatoes and black olives
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the catsup, whisky, tahini, taco seasoning, white vinegar, dijon mustard powder, almond extract, and sun dried tomatoes and olives. Chill until ready to use.

title: Mochaccala
