ingredients: 1 package wild rice | 8 ounces melted cantaloupes | 1 can wasabi-flavored mayonnaise, optional
instructions: Steam wild rice until tender. Meanwhile, spread wasabi mayonaise on a warm platter. Place melted cantaloupe on top of wasabi mayonaise. Top with cooled wild rice. Serve.

title: Raspberry Chutney
ingredients: 5 cups raspberries, fresh or frozen | 2 1/2 cups fresh raspberry | 3/4 cup whole wheat bread crumbs | 2 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper ( optional )
instructions: If using canned raspberries, pour them into a large mixing bowl and add the raspberries and rye crackers. Mix the bread crumbs, mustard and chilli together in a small bowl. Add the rye cracker crumbs mix and mix well. Add more bread crumbs mix if it's too wet. Turn out onto a paper lined chopping board and cut into bite size chunks. Chop or pulse raspberries and divide into smaller pieces. Add the berries, including the seeds if using. Blend well. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: dill,sharp cheddar cheese,tarragon leaf,thyme sprig,chicken wing,maraschino cherry,sauerkraut,white fish
title: Sue's Spicy Chicken Reuben Baked Wings
ingredients: 1 package frozen cooked white fish | 1 container sauerkraut, drained ( no-sauerkraut can be substituted ) | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried maraschino cherries, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 8 tablespoons sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 lbs chicken wings, tips removed
instructions: Thaw fish and fish at room temperature for up to 1 day. Mix remaining ingredients in an 8 qt crockpot. Cover and cook on medium 7 - 8 hours until fish is cooked through. Place the chicken wings in a large casserole dish or pie pan. Spoon hot mixture over chicken. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cheese. Bake at 350 for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.

title: Basic Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 5 teaspoons unflavored gelatin | 5 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 5 cups tomato sauce
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over 3/4 cup water in a 2 quart saucepan.

title: Alaskan Poached Salmon
ingredients: 1 cup crumbled gorgonzola | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 pound fresh salmon fillets
instructions: In a small bowl, mix gorgonzola and cocoa with 1/2 cup water. Brush 1 of the salmon fillets with gorgonzola glaze, and top with the other fillet to coat in the glaze. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the salmon fillets on baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes, then turn the fillets. Bake until the salmon is easily removed from the baking sheets, and is easily flaked with a fork, about 5 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: elbow macaroni,cake flour,dark chocolate,arborio rice,kaffir lime leaf,artichoke heart,chili pepper
title: Tunisian Macaroni With Artichokes & Chocolate
ingredients: 6 cups elbow macaroni ( about 3 cups ) | 2 1/2 cups chinese wombok-style dark chocolate | 1/2 cup cake flour | 3 3 1/2 cups arborio rice | 24 3-inch fresh chili peppers ( such as jalapeno or serrano ) | 24 small fried dried chile peppers ( optional ) | 2 kaffir lime leaves, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Bring 2 cups water to boil in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,vegetable stock,bacon dripping,chuck roast,meat,egg yolk,ha avocadoes
title: Egg Rolls
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast, sliced thinly | 2 cups vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1 lb cooked beef, sliced thinly or 1 lb sausage, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces feta cheese, crumbled ( reserve the crumbled feta cheese ) | 4 large egg yolks | 1 ripe hass avocado | mitted feta cheese, for garnish
instructions: Place the beef slices into a mixing bowl. With your fingers, stir in the stock and bacon drippings until well combined. Pour mixture into a crockpot. Add the meat slices, turn to coat evenly and cook on high for 1 hour, or until the meat is tender. While meat is cooking, make the avocado dip by placing the egg yolks into a bowl along with 1/4 cup of the feta cheese and mix well. Spoon the avocados into a colander and run under warm water. Dip the avocado slices into the egg mixture and set aside until serving. Garnish the roll with the feta cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: passion fruit,wheat elbow macaroni,golden brown sugar
title: Quick Fruit Maccheroni (Maccheroni)
ingredients: 1/3 cup golden brown sugar | 1 package whole wheat elbow macaroni | 1/3 cup passion fruit pulp ( juice of )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, salt heavily and stir in the sugar. Add pasta and cook for 6 - 8 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,egg substitute,pumpkin seed,mint,cottage cheese,bean sprout,mustard
title: Pumpkin Seed and Dill Veggie Quiche
ingredients: 1 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 cup chopped yellow bell pepper | 1 cup pumpkin seeds, coarsely crushed | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint | 1/4 cup raw unsalted shelled pumpkin seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Butter a 9 inch springform pan. Whisk together the cottage cheese, egg substitute and mustard in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,pecorino romano cheese,red chili pepper,taco seasoning
title: Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ricotta cheese | 1 1/4 teaspoons taco seasoning | 2 -3 teaspoons dried italian herb seasoning | 4 -5 whole dried red chili peppers
instructions: Mix well and put into a small bowl. Drain your dried dried chilies and rinse them. Mix in dried chilies with oil and grated cheese. Chill, covered.

title: Lebanese Kibbeh
ingredients: 1 lb lamb, cut into 2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 1/3 cup pitted prunes, drained and patted dry with a paper towel | 3/4 cup dried snow peas | 2 tablespoons allspice | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for oil and mix thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate in a cool place 2 hours, or overnight. Prepare lamb by frying meat by adding some of oil to pan and brown on all sides. Set aside. Serve with kebbeh. This can also be served warm.

title: Cajun Chicken
ingredients: 1 package wild rice | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 2 large boneless chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Boil the wild rice according to package directions, adding turmeric powder, cajun seasoning, and chicken thighs in the last 5 minutes. Transfer the chicken and rice to a baking dish, and bake uncovered for 35 to 45 minutes, or until chicken is done.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,orange juice,raisin,taco bell seasoning mix
title: Sizzlin' Spicy Taco Bell®
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces taco bell taco seasoning mix | 1/3 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, or more to taste | 1/2 teaspoon dried sweet red pepper flakes, or more to taste
instructions: Mix taco seasoning mix, raisins, orange juice, red pepper flakes, and sweet red pepper flakes in microwave safe serving dish. Microwave on high for 1 minute.

title: Grilled Lemongrass Salmon
ingredients: 3 lbs salmon fillets | 3 medium carrots, peeled cut into 2 inch lengths | 1 lb thawed frozen green beans | 1/4 cup sriracha hot sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed dried carrot
instructions: Lightly coat grill pan with cooking spray. Place salmon, cut side down, on grill rack. Grill for 7 minutes. Turn and spray with cooking spray. Grill carrots for 3 minutes, turning once. Meanwhile, combine green beans, sriracha and carrots in a 12 inch nonstick skillet, cook over med heat until tender crisp about 2 minutes. Stir and cook an additional minute. Top each salmon fillet with 1/2 teaspoon of bean mixture. Grill salmon for 2 minutes on side or until fish flakes easily with fork. Serve salmon with carrot sauce.

title: Spicy Roasted Lemongrass
ingredients: 1 stalk lemongrass, trimmed | 1/2 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Using a vegetable peeler remove peel from lemongrass and wrap the peel in bacon. Place onto a baking sheet along with 2 or 3 tablespoons of the oil. Roast in the preheated oven until the bacon is brown, 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool. Cut lemongrass into 1 inch pieces. Toss vegetables with the remaining 1 tablespoon oil.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,black bean,shell pasta,sprinkle,basmati rice,chicken wing,coffee,vanilla
title: Robust Cinnamon-Cafe Arroz Con Gandules
ingredients: 2 lbs whole chicken wings, split, tips discarded | 1/4 cup brewed coffee | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee | 14 1/2 ounces black beans, rinsed, drained, 2 cans drained | 1/2 lb shell pasta, cooked, drained and drained | 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Cook the chicken in 1/4 cup of brewed coffee and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla for 5 minutes in a 3 1/2 quart enamel or stainless steel saucepan. Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 15 minutes. Cool completely. Remove the fat from the chicken. Discard the meat. Cut each piece of chicken across the bones into 1/4 inch wide strips. Put 1/4 cup of bean bean mixture in a small saucepan. Add 1/2 cup water. Simmer over medium low heat, stirring occasionally until mixture just begins to bubble. Remove from heat. Serve the arroz con gandules over rice, arranging pieces separately.

title: Creamy Chipotle-Lebanese Bread
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 teaspoon canned chipotle chile | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 tablespoon lard
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together milk, chile, basil and lard. Pour milk mixture into a bread maker. Process until bread is thoroughly moistened and a thermometer inserted into the bread shows 110 degrees f, 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove bread from maker and spread onto a baking sheet. Let bread stand until cool enough to handle, about 15 minutes. Cut into thick slices and serve immediately.

title: Salmon and Tomato
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato paste | 1 tablespoon chopped sun-dried tomato concentrate
instructions: In a small bowl combine the sun dried tomato paste and sun dried tomato concentrate and mix well. Place salmon fillets in a glass casserole dish and pour over the tomato mixture. Cook in a preheated oven 190°c for 10 - 15 minutes or until just cooked through and the tomatoes soften and the salmon are turning pink.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,vanilla pudding,rum,cream mushroom soup,italian seasoning
title: Lighter Rum Dessert Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 container plain italian-style pudding | 1/4 cup light brown sugar, packed | 1/4 cup rum | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: In a 9x13 inch pan spread cream of mushroom soup and pudding.

title: Fig and Red Cabbage
ingredients: 4 cups shredded red cabbage | 4 dried figs, chopped
instructions: Place cabbage and figs in a skillet with water to cover. Simmer over high heat until figs are tender and figs are cooked. Drain, reserving liquid. Serve cabbage with syrup.

Random Ingredients: cherry,cheddar cheese soup,salsa,spaghetti sauce,black tea,self raising flour
title: Carry-Bean Rascals
ingredients: 350 g self-raising flour | 2 cups spaghetti sauce | 500 g cheddar cheese soup ( your favourite ) | 400 ml hot cherry tomatoes | 2 cups salsa | 2 -3 tablespoons black tea
instructions: Heat oven to 190°c. Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix with your hands until thoroughly combined. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead on a lightly floured surface. Roll into a roll about 20x8cm, then cut into 2cm pieces. Put on a baking tray and brush with oil. Bake 35 - 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hamburger N' Veggie Melt
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb ground ham | 1 cup mushroom liquid | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Brown meat for a few minutes, add spices, saute' for 3 minute. Add mushrooms if you like.

Random Ingredients: lovage,hoisin sauce,hash brown potato,rice vinegar,red chili powder,broccoli floret
title: Spicy Broccoli & Sweet Potato Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped sweet potatoes | 8 medium broccoli florets | 2 cups cooked hash brown potatoes | 1 medium red chili powder | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Cook broccoli & potatoes according to package directions, then drain. Add chili powder, hoisin & rice vinegar. Stir fry over medium heat till vegetables are crisp tender & all ingredients are hot. Serve in bowls with a side of your choice of veggies.

title: Chicken Cheese Stuffed Chicken
ingredients: 500 g ground chicken ( any quantity ) | 2 tablespoons shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 teaspoon mace ( ground )
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and stuff into a chicken. Put on a plate and bake at 180c for 20 - 25 mins until golden. Serve on top of a traditional vegetable sandwich.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,fromage frais,olive oil,sauce,heavy cream,rye bread
title: Reiss-Fried Rye Bread Casserole
ingredients: 18 slices rye bread | 3 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup a.1. original sauce | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir together the cream of mushroom soup, a 1 sauce, cream and olive oil. Place one slice of bread into the frying pan over medium heat, and toast the slices until golden brown, and crispy. Top with the mushroom soup mixture, and top with the remaining slice of bread.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,heavy cream,lemon peel,thyme sprig,strawberry,gruyere cheese,beef bouillon cube,garlic
title: Frozen Strawberry Souffle
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe strawberries | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon cube or 1 teaspoon beef base | 1/4 teaspoon chopped garlic | 1/4 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme sprigs or 1/4 teaspoon dried herms | 1/4 teaspoon grated lemons or 1/4 teaspoon lemon rind | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Divide strawberries evenly among eight 12 cup souffle dishes. In top of each cup, place 1/8 teaspoon each of beef base, garlic, thyme, lemons. Top with gruyere cheese. Pour boiling water around the souffle to halfway cover. Bake 35 - 50 minutes or until puffed and golden.

title: Chilean Yellow Hominy
ingredients: 1 can yellow hominy | 1 tablespoon peanut oil ( or other neutral oil ) | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 ounce dark chocolate
instructions: Rinse the can of yellow hominy and drain it. In a medium size sauce pot, heat the peanut oil. Add the chopped hominy.

title: Tuna Fritters
ingredients: 240 g tuna steaks, fat removed | 400 g kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 150 g pitted prunes, drained and chopped | 1/3 cup cornflour | 1 1/2 cups canned chopped clams, drained
instructions: Chop tuna roughly into strips.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,chinese rice wine,pineapple chunk,no salt tomato sauce
title: No-Salt Dipping Pineapple and Fontina (Pineapple) Salsa
ingredients: 1 can no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1/2 package fresh pineapple chunks ( reserve 1/4 cup juice ) | 2/3 cup chinese rice wine ( or other dry white wine ) | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese or 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, plus more for sprinkling on top
instructions: In a bowl, combine the tomato sauce and reserved pineapple juice. Stir in the rice wine until thoroughly mixed. Place the pineapple chunks on a serving platter, and drizzle the tomato mixture over the whole thing. Sprinkle the cheese over the pineapple. Serve and let people top their own pieces of pineapple, and some slices of pineapple for added flavor. Serve with chips or a spoon.

title: Orange Sponge Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1 large orange ( the size and shape of a whole orange ) | 1 1/4 cups boiling water
instructions: Using a rolling pin, roll out your orange. Using a knife, slice the orange on a slight diagonal onto the unoiled side, being careful not to cut all the way through. The more the better. Once all the oranges are slices, sprinkle the flour into the water and use your rolling pin to gently mix through the flour and water. Pour the mixture into a greased & lined shallow nonstick tin. Bake at 180c for 15 - 20 mins, stirring the mixture often, until the top is golden. Remove from tin and leave to cool slightly before cutting into bars to serve or serve from a cupcake tin. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: littleneck clam,orange juice,vegetable stock chicken,mango powder
title: Clam Soup
ingredients: 400 g littleneck clams | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 liter vegetable stock, hot heated | 1 tablespoon mango powder ( optional )
instructions: Scrub the clams in plenty of cold water and dry them thoroughly on paper towels. Place the clams in a large soup pot and cover with cold water. Add the clam juice and bring to a boil. Lower the heat, add the mango powder if using it, and add the stock. Return to a simmer and cook very slowly for about 2 hours or until the clam shells open and the shucked clams. Serve hot.

title: Quick Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 8 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Trim the tenderloin if desired. Place tenderloin in plastic bag with ricotta cheese and place in refrigerator for two to four hours. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Remove plastic bag cover beef tenderloin with cream and bake until desired doneness is reached. Turn off oven and allow beef tenderloin to sit for at least 10 minutes before serving.

title: Black Olives
ingredients: 1 large orange bell pepper, diced | 1 can chopped black olives, drained
instructions: Combine in a large bowl 1/4 cup of diced, diced pepper and olives.

title: Lebanese Broad Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried black beans | lemon wedge
instructions: Soak beans over night or preferably over night at the most. The beans should be just about submerged in liquid.. Cover beans with water and boil for 90 to 90 minutes. You want them a nice thin sauce. The beans and water should be about 4 to 5 inches above the beans at the most end of the cooking. Check it often when the beans are fully cooked and there is no more liquid.. The beans will have a sort of dent from their cooking. To test whether they are done, put the lemon wedge over them. A sharp knife or a sharp small fork should come out clean. If they float, they are done. Note, if you have never cooked beans yourself they may be eaten hot or chilled.

title: Chicken Nacho Bowl
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 4 cups prepared grilled ground chicken | 1 cup frozen corn | 1/2 cup lime wedge
instructions: Place 1/4 meat mixture in medium bowl. Roll meat mixture in remaining mixture. Place on plate and freeze 30 minutes. Grill on high 12 to 15 minutes until fully cooked and thoroughly cooked all over. Meanwhile, place corn in microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high 4 to 6 minutes or until heated. Drain meat and corn and add with lime wedges. Toss till well coated. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,porcini mushroom,carrot,tamari soy sauce,egg white,onion soup mix,chili paste,splenda pack
title: Vegetarian Tamari Omelet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/4 onion, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons instant minced onion soup mix | 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 1/3 cup tamari soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste ( optional ) | 200 g fresh mushrooms, sliced | 2 large egg whites
instructions: Heat the oil in a large, non stick frypan on high. Add the onion and cook over a moderate heat for 4 minutes, or until soft. Add the soup mix, then fold in the yoghurt, tamari, chilli paste and mushrooms. Using a metal spoon gently fold the mixture into the omelet. Cook the mixture over a medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes, or until it begins to colour slightly. Beat the eggwhite until soft peaks form. Gently fold into the meat mixture. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes on high, or until the omlette is cooked. Spread half of the omlette with the soy sauce mixture. Scatter with half the reserved mushrooms, and continue to cook for a further 1 - 2 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender. Top with the remaining omlette, pressing lightly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,bay leaf,cooking sherry,enchilada sauce
title: Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs red chili peppers | 1/2 cup chile cooking sherry | 1 1/2 cups enchilada sauce | 3 bay leaves
instructions: Cut the chilies into 1 inch pieces. Arrange them in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish, skin side up.. Drizzle with the chile cooking sherry. In a small cup combine the enchilada sauce and bay leaves.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,italian parsley,ham,anise seed,garam masala powder,veal
title: Veal Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons garam masala powder | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 lb lean boneless veal, cut into � inch strips | 4 -6 lettuce leaves, washed and dried, as needed | 4 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 4 slices crisp boiled ham
instructions: Grind the garam masala powder and aniseed in a processor to a fine powder. Spread the mixture evenly over the meat and marinate at least 30 minutes. Prepare a bbq or oven, set on grill and cook meat over high heat till cooked to your liking. Meanwhile, wrap lettuce leaves around the meat and wrap them in foil. Place on bbq or oven and bake for about 15 minutes, turning halfway through. Add parsley to meat.

Random Ingredients: capsicum,plain yogurt,thyme,saffron thread,chicken bouillon granule,chili sauce,thyme sprig
title: Kofta Paste, Zucchini Rissoles
ingredients: 375 g plain low-fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/4 teaspoon thyme | 1 medium red capsicum, grated | 1 sprig thyme
instructions: Place yoghurt, hot sauce, granules, saffron and thyme in a large mixing bowl. Add grated capsicum and mix thoroughly. Using your hands, roll mixture into small sausage shapes. Place on paper lined tray and chill for at least 30 minutes. Turn onto greased baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes at 200°c. Turn heat down to a slow simmer. Spoon paste onto warm kofta pieces and sprinkle tops with dried herbs. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: grape,garlic salt,olive oil,jalapeno chile,white red snapper,wine vinegar
title: Rabo De Cebícas
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced garlic salt | 2 tablespoons chopped jalapeno chiles | 1 lb white red snapper, cleaned and scaled | 1 cup grapes or 1 cup green grape | 1 1/2 teaspoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Make sure the fish is at room temperature. Heat the olive oil over medium low heat, add the garlic salt and jalapenos and cook about 3 minutes. Add the fish and simmer gently for 3 - 4 minutes. Deglaze the pan with the wine vinegar and pour over fish. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 15 - 20 minutes until hot and flaky.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,maple syrup,lime wedge,green chilies,spice,mint
title: Vegan Chile (Tex Mex)
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons maple syrup | green chili, chopped | 4 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon or 4 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 lime wedge | 1 teaspoon of fresh mint or 1 teaspoon dried mint | 2 -3 drops mixed spice
instructions: To make the syrup. Put all the ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Let chill for 10 - 15 minutes to allow flavors to blend and the spices to blend. If desired, you can put a few drops of mixed spices in with the syrup, then serve over your plate.

Random Ingredients: string bean,muscovado sugar,russet potato,sesame seed,asparagus,brown onion,vanilla,thyme
title: Potato and Asparagus Stew
ingredients: 6 medium russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2 to 3/4-inch lengths | 5 medium fresh asparagus, tough ends discarded and tough tips cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 medium brown onion, finely chopped | 6 links string bean, cut in half crosswise | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 2 tablespoons light muscovado sugar | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f line a 2 1/2 quart baking dish with a piece of foil, letting the foil extend over the sides of the dish. Scatter half the potato pieces over the foil. Sprinkle the asparagus pieces and asparagus pieces evenly over the potatoes and top with the remaining potatoes. Sprinkle over the sesame seeds, onion and dried thyme. Mix together the sugar, vanilla and remaining 1/2 teaspoon of salt, pour onto the top of the potatoes, and evenly distribute the remainder of the vegetable ingredients on top. Scatter over the remaining thyme and top the dish with the foil. Cook for 40 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Note, the cooking times could vary depending on the size of the potato chunks, adding up to 1/2 inch to an hour. Serve hot or cold.

title: Awesome Basic Ricotta Cheese - No Dairy!!!
ingredients: 2 lbs cheese container ricotta cheese | 2 garlic cloves | 1 pinch nutmeg
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate for one week. In the mean time chop riccinni and bake on a cookie sheet with a medium temperature. You can also do on cookie sheet on the grill as well. I prefer to do it on the bbq. You can even bake it at 350 or in a pan on the pan or on the pan rack under the broiler.

Random Ingredients: french bread,coconut rum,fruit,o'brien potato,red bliss potato,chicken
title: Coconut Chicken & Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb of diced chicken ( leftover roast cooked from the original recipe ) | 1 can of diced mixed fruit | 2 loaves french bread ( cut in thick slices ) | 3 red bliss potatoes ( cut in thick slices ) | 2 cans coconut rum | 1 lb o'brien frozen potato sticks | 3 -4 cups of your favorite coconut rum ( to top )
instructions: In a large skillet on medium high heat, add chicken, fruit, coconut rum and potatoes. Cover with aluminum foil. Simmer until potatoes are tender and chicken is cooked. Drain off any oil/baking soda in the pan. Place the frozen potato sticks in a separate pan of water to defrost and thaw for about 15 - 20 minutes until they are easy to cut with a knife. Add them to the mixture of rice and coconut rum and mix together well. Place the french bread in a glass bowl, cover with plastic wrap and warm. Preheat oven to 350°. When ready to serve, place several spoonfuls of the mixture onto each toasted bread slice and place in toaster dish. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,sea salt,marinara sauce,kosher salt,corn tortilla,vanilla,serrano pepper
title: Spicy Spanish Tortilla
ingredients: 1/2 cup marinara sauce ( homemade is best ) | 1/2 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder ( to taste ) or 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric ( to taste ) | 6 -8 corn tortillas | 1 tablespoon roasted ground serrano peppers or 1 tablespoon roasted onion, sliced
instructions: To make the espresso sauce, combine the prepared marinara sauce, coffee powder, salt, and vanilla. To warm the tortillas, wrap each warm tortilla in foil to keep warm. Heat the oven to 200 degrees f. Dip a tortilla into the espresso sauce until soft, about 1 minute per side. Transfer onto a plate, and sprinkle with the ground serrano. Arrange the heated tortillas on a baking sheet, and bake 2 to 3 minutes in the oven, until the tortillas are crisp and heated through. Serve warm. Variation, serve the spanish tortillas with fresh cream.

Random Ingredients: green bean,sherry vinegar,pork fillet,ghee butter,vegetable oil cooking spray,white wine,italian salad dressing,beef marrow
title: Dutch Oven Pork With Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup sherry vinegar | 2 lbs boneless pork fillets, about 1 1/2 inches thick, cut into 4 pieces | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons ghee, divided | 2 cups fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 beef marrow, thinly sliced | 1 cup italian salad dressing | chopped roasted garlic and red bell peppers ( to garnish )
instructions: Pour wine, vinegar, and 1/2 cup water into a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat, swirling pan occasionally, until liquid is reduced and syrupy, about 5 minutes. Transfer wine syrup to a bowl. Add pork, turning to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate, turning once, about 8 hours. Heat 1 tbsp oil in an ovenproof skillet set over medium heat. When hot, add pork. Cook, turning, until browned, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a plate and cover. Add remaining oil to skillet. Add beans. Cook, stirring, until heated through, 3 - 4 minutes. Add marrow.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,lavender bud,tomato green chilies,picante sauce
title: Texas Caviar
ingredients: 3 cans ro-tel tomatoes and green chilies, well drained ( velveeta ) | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 2 teaspoons black cardamom pods | 3 tablespoons dried lavender buds
instructions: In a blender, puree ro tel tomatoes, picante sauce, black cardamom pods, and dried lavender buds until smooth. Transfer mixture to a serving bowl, chill, and serve.

title: Homemade Peppercorn Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti ( or your favorite ) | 1 cup peppppercorn
instructions: Prepare the spaghetti as directed. Drain the spaghetti well. Place in a large bowl. Cover with boiling water. Cover and let stand 8 to 10 minutes, or until tender.

title: Saskatchewan Meatball Supper With Creamy Fettuccine
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked uncooked dry wheat noodles or 3/4 cup fettuccine | 2 cups beef broth ( i use swanson brand ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup uncooked bulgur ( or sub with 1 box of whole-wheat ) | 2 large egg yolks | skewer
instructions: In a medium saucepan, cook noodles as label directs on package, but do not overcook. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine broth, soup, bulgur and egg yolks. Add noodles and mix gently with a rubber spatula or wooden spoon. Form mixture into 20 meatballs. Place on a paper towel lined baking sheet. Broil 3 inches from heat 5 minutes. Add keffir.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,beef tenderloin steak,red chile pepper,peanut,white fish fillet,superfine sugar,crabmeat
title: Fish With Red Chile Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry roasted salted peanuts, chopped | 1/3 cup superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 4 1/2 pounds beef tenderloin steaks | 4 red chile peppers, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1 cup chopped red cabbage | 1 can crabmeat, drained
instructions: In a food processor, combine peanuts, sugar, peanut butter and 3 cups water. Blend until smooth, stopping once or twice to scrape down the sides. Stir in steaks, chile peppers, cabbage and crabmeat. Cover and chill in the refrigerator 1 hour or overnight. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place remaining 1/4 cup water in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread mixture over steaks. Cover and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove cover, return to oven and bake for 15 minutes more.

title: Chef John's Panzanella
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 6 ounces gruyere, shredded | 2 tablespoons unbleached all-purpose vinegar | 2 can reduced-sodium low-fat chicken broth
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Spray four 1 1/2 inch depth disposable foil roasting pans with cooking spray. Whisk hoisin sauce, picante sauce, gruyere cheese, vinegar, and chicken broth together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: clove,thai red curry paste,egg white,cooking oil,green capsicum,lamb,sherry,yellow pea
title: Lamb Meat Kebabs
ingredients: 400 g lamb, cut into 1 1/2 cm pieces ( or use leg of lamb ) | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon dried yellow split peas | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 medium egg white, lightly whisked | 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry | cooking oil, for shallow-frying | 1 medium green capsicum, de-seeded and cut into 1/2 cm dice | salt and dried yellow peppers or red capsicum flowers
instructions: Using a sharp knife, score 2 long x 1 - 2 deep slits or squares about 3/4 inch deep in lamb meat or other part of meat. Dissolve chay paste in sherry in a small saucepan over medium heat, until fragrant, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat, add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly with a spoon. Taste and adjust seasoning. Thread meat onto metal skewers. Grill 3 - 4 minutes, turning occasionally, until desired doneness. Serve with a sprinkling of chopped mixed chilies and vegetables,.

title: Spicy Salt
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons bicarbonate soda | 3 -4 fresh cilantro stems | kosher salt
instructions: Crush leaves of cilantro stalks finely with rolling pin or clean hammer and place on rimmed baking sheet. Sprinkle generously with kosher salt. Place all the leaves under running water and dry them off a bit. You should end up with a single layer of large, even pieces of fresh, not dark colored but dark green leaves. Store in airtight jars in the refrigerator. Keeps for 5 days. Note, if using kosher salt, it helps to make a dent in the salt. Note, you can also use a combination of bicarb, cilantro and freshly ground black pepper for your basting sauce. Note, if using a mortar and pestle, a good way to crush dried corns is to pound in the mortar and pestle. If using a food processor, grind them with the cilantro and mortar and pestle. Note, if you have a mortar and pestle, mix all the dry spices together and use as a rub for any bread you make.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,green bean,almond meal,bok choy,radicchio,jumbo pasta shell
title: Jumbo Shells With Choy, Beans and Radicchio
ingredients: 1 package jumbo pasta shells | 12 ounces green beans | 12 ounces bok choy | 1 package onion soup mix | 1/2 cup slivered almonds meal
instructions: Break and cook the shells as directed on package. Steam the green beans until tender crisp. Remove the shells from the pot, cut into pieces and then dice the beans. Thinly slice the bok choy and radicchio. When the shells are done, drain the shells and cut them into thin strips. Dredge the green beans in the onions soup mix. Top with the sprinats and almonds meal.

title: Southern Style Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken leg, cut into pieces | 1 cup white vinegar ( for brushing )
instructions: Place chicken pieces in a roasting pan coated with non stick cooking spray. Pour vinegar over the top. Add more vinegar if needed. Bake at 425 degrees for 15 minutes. Turn chicken over and bake for an additional 15 - 20 minutes at 425 degrees. Remove from oven and allow to sit on a serving platter covered with foil for about 20 minutes. Remove chicken from the pan and drizzle the remaining vinegar and baste all the pieces of chicken. Serve with salad or grilled veggies.

title: Apple Salsa and Broccoli Burritos
ingredients: 1 large broccoli, cut into small florets | 3/4 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons heavy cream ( whipping ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 fresh jalapeno, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 frozen 9-inch uncooked spiral flour tortillas, thawed and warmed
instructions: Cook broccoli in a large pot of boiling salted water until almost tender, about 3 minutes. Drain. Combine apple juice, cream, salt and jalapeno in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,gruyere cheese,pico de gallo,ketchup,butterscotch chip,icing sugar
title: Easy Cheesecake Cocktail
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crushed pico de gallo | 4 ounces ketchup | 3 tablespoons icing sugar, sifted ( confectioners ) | 2 ounces kraft butterscotch chips | 1 ounce ketchup | 2 ounces gruyere cheese, coarsely grated ( optional )
instructions: Beat the ketchup and icing sugar until smooth and creamy. Fold the pico de gallo and chips through the ketchup mixture. Serve, or refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: cooking brown rice,garlic,pam cooking spray,curry paste,pizza crust
title: Oriental Beef Roll-up
ingredients: cooking brown rice | cooking spray | 10 -20 slices crusty bread or 10 -20 slices crusty bread, each cut into 10 x 3 inch slices | 10 -20 slices thinly sliced cooked lean sirloin steak ( about 1 cup ) | 1 teaspoon curry paste, such as < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/kormi-mutton-curry-paste-218735 '' > kormi curry paste ( i used curry paste ) < /a > | pam cooking spray
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, while waiting for cool cooker so it can be handled.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,italian parsley,brown sugar,walnut,sharp cheddar cheese,basmati rice,new potato
title: Italian Cheddar Baked Rice and Potatoes
ingredients: 6 cups hot steamed basmati rice or 6 cups brown basmati rice | 2 jars of good italian herb flavored pate ( optional ) | 6 small red new potatoes, washed and sliced ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped walnuts ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 4 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese ( about 6-8 ounces ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Drain the rice thoroughly, and place in a large covered pan and set aside. Pour the pate into a large microwavable bowl, and heat on high until the pate has melted, 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in the remaining ingredients until the cheese is melted, then set aside to set. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees, grease a casserole dish. Stir the rice and pate into the melted cheese, and spread it in the prepared casserole dish. Cover tightly with aluminum foil, and bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil, and bake an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden brown. Serve immediately. If serving cold, cover and refrigerate about 1 hour, if not serving hot.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,vodka,beef consomme,chinese noodle,season salt,olive oil,taco seasoning mix
title: Chinese Noodle Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 package frozen chinese noodles, thawed | 1 1/2 lbs ground beef ( i use a leaner pack, not the leaner variety ) or 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey ( i use a leaner pack, not the leaner variety ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons vodka | 1 teaspoon course salt | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: In a crock pot, combine the uncooked noodles and beef, or turkey. In a small bowl, combine the dry seasonings, and combine, then add the wet ingredients to the meat mixture, and toss. Pour into the crock pot, and cook on low for 4 - 5 hours, until the meat is no longer pink. Serve over noodles. This recipe doubles very well.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,ice water,arugula leaf,semolina,almond extract,jalapeno juice,yellow pepper,spice
title: Jalapeño Poached Salad (Aurora)
ingredients: 1 cup shelled arugula leaf | 3/4 cup semolina or 3/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup diced yellow pepper | 3 tablespoons jalapenos, minced fresh ( or canned jalapeño peppers-very-hot ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 teaspoon ice water | 1/2 teaspoon instant magic joag water | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice ( to taste )
instructions: Soak arugula in cold water. Soak semolina or bread crumbs in water for 5 minutes. Drain well and mix together with other ingredients. Cover and chill until you are ready to serve.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Garlic and Black Pepper
ingredients: 2 lbs brussels sprouts | kosher salt | white bread, thick | handful coriander and cilantro
instructions: Drop one pint of water in a pot and add the brussels sprouts and salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a simmer for 20 minutes or longer until sprouts are tender. Transfer sprouts to a bowl and squeeze water out of the cabbage. Cut the brussels sprouts into slices that are about 1/2 thick. Arrange the sliced brussels sprouts on a platter. Lift out the slices of bread and top with the sliced brussels sprouts and coriander and cilantro.

Random Ingredients: double cream,beef bouillon cube,hot chili pepper,rotel,dressing
title: Lazytime Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 cup rotel, cubed | 1/2 cup double cream | hot chili pepper ( optional ) | dressing
instructions: In a pot add olive oil, salt and garlic powder. Once garlic is to taste, add the beef bouillon cube. When the cube is dissolved, add the rest of the ingredients. Bring the contents up to a boil and then simmer until beef is tender. This is very versatile, and for a change i make my bouillon cube and add a dash of crushed red pepper flakes.

title: Cardamom Roasted Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken breasts | 2 tablespoons cardamom seeds ( crushed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees fahrenheit. In a large mixing bowl, rub the cardamom seeds into the chicken breasts. Sprinkle the chicken with salt. Arrange the chicken in a lightly oiled 8x8 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, pour the chicken broth over the chicken. Roast, uncovered, until the chicken feels firm when pricked with a fork, about 1 1/2 hours. Transfer the chicken to a platter or carving board and tent with foil.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,salt pepper,peanut,anise seed,wine vinegar,japanese eggplant,kalamata olive,white pearl onion
title: Mixed Pearl and Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 1 lb white pearl onion, in thin strips with stems | 1/2 cup white pearl onion, in thin strips with stems | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and chopped | 4 kalamata olives, quartered | 1 japanese eggplant, cut into 1-inch-thick rounds | 1/4 cup salad oil or 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon toasted anise seed | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,extra virgin olive oil,jalapeno chile pepper
title: Queso Blanco
ingredients: 3 pounds monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 package jalapeno chile peppers, sliced | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In the bowl of a stand mixer with a paddle attachment, combine the grated cheese and jalapeno chilies. Add half of the olive oil and mix well. The batter should be the texture of wet sand. Transfer to a casserole dish or baking dish and bake at 350 degrees f for about 1 hour, or until bubbling and set. Serve hot.

title: The World's Easiest Hot Fennel
ingredients: 2 large fennel bulbs | 2 fresh hot green chili peppers, or to taste
instructions: Fill a skillet with water, and place fennel bulbs into it. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook for 10 minutes. Remove cover, and simmer for 10 more minutes. Allow fennel to steam as desired for the desired doneness, and drain, if necessary. Toss fennel with cooked hot green chili peppers.

title: Rice With Herbs and Tortillas
ingredients: 12 -14 tortillas | 4 cups arborio rice | italian herbs, to your taste ( optional )
instructions: Pour a little olive oil in a skillet, and heat, then add the spanish herbs. Add the arborio rice, making sure that the spanish herbs don't burn. Wrap tightly in the wrap, and let the cheese melt. When the rice has melted, remove the wrap, and cut into slices.

title: Caldo Verde I Think It's Not
ingredients: 1 head about 3 lbs cod ( about 3 pounds ) | 1 bunch kale, about 12 bunches | 1/4 cup mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to wash kale clean, cut in small pieces and place under a double broiler for about 10 minutes until just brown. Take off heat and rub all over with a little bit of the mustard. Break up the fish and place in a casserole or baking dish. Spread the mustard over the fish. Place kale around the fish, pour some boiling water over and cover. Bake uncovered for about 30 minutes or or until fish flakes easily. Note, cooking time depends on type of fish and the amount of kale you are using.

title: Spiced Tea
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried currants | 2/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 teaspoon aniseed ( optional )
instructions: Place currants in a bowl and pour boiling water over. Let soak for 15 minutes. Transfer to a blender, add sugar, and add anise if desired. Blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,chocolate chip,saffron,riesling wine,nut,apricot preserve,frisee,chili sauce
title: Choc Chaat - Chilled Raspberry and Apricot Smoker
ingredients: 1 cup chopped dried apricot preserves | 1/4 cup chopped apricot preserves, reserve 1/2 cup to use for garnish | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup dry riesling wine | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili sauce ( see note below ) | 2 tablespoons chocolate chips ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried minced onion flakes ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried minced onion flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried minced onion flakes ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried apricot preserves ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup blanched almond, lightly toasted, coarsely chopped and divided | saffron | chopped nuts
instructions: Combine preserves with 1/4 cup apricot preserves, 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce, 1/4 cup riesling wine, saffron and optional ingredients in a 2 cup serving bowl. Mix well. Cover and chill at least 2 hours. Sprinkle with reserved 1/2 cup diced apricot preserves. Serve chilled. Note, you can use a combination of apricot preserves and sweet chili sauce, which is usually not necessary. You may also choose a mild green chili sauce, such as jalapeno or serrano or ancho chili sauce for a milder chili. Toast almonds on a grill or in the oven for a few minutes each side just until golden. Serve warm with the toasted almond slices.

title: Mexican Style Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 bunches kale | 1 jar pimientos | 1 cup spanish onion, chopped | 1/3 cup cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon bacon fat or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/4 cup shredded mexican style cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f wash kale well and slice thick. Chop spanish onion and set aside aside. Finely chop pimientos set aside. Place bacon fat or canola oil in saute pan with onions and garlic. Cook until onion is clear and garlic starts to sizzle. This will take about 5 - 10 minutes over medium heat, or until onions are tender and bacon is slightly browned. Add pimentos, chopped kale, cocoa, and mexican style cheese. Stir well together and place on a cookie sheet or baking sheet, and cook in preheated oven until cheese melts completely. It should serve as a condiment for the finished product.

title: Fajita Pasta
ingredients: 6 ounces dry pasta | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions while pasta is still hot. Drain pasta and return to pot. Stir in fajita seasoning mix and mix well. Serve.

title: Traditional Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1 pie shell | 18 ladyfingers ( the size `` if necessary '' ) | white cabbage, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to unfold the pastry on a work surface. Cover the bottom of the pie shell with one dozen ladyfingers, then spread the cabbage over the ladyfingers. Place the second pie shell on top of the first pie shell and brush with a little vegetable oil. Repeat for the rest of the filling. Cut a slit crosswise down the length of each roll. Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out a few napkins or towels, place them in the freezer for later use. Unwrap the rolls and serve with cold, sour cream, and fruit.

title: Homemade Honey Glazes
ingredients: 4 teaspoons honey
instructions: Make sure your honey is not too runny.

title: Cashew Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cashews | 3/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place cashews in a bowl with a lid, and pour boiling water into the bowl. Stir in the baking soda, and shake to mix. Pour mix into a greased 9x5 inch loaf pan, and bake 1 hour in the preheated oven, stirring every 10 minutes. The loaf is done when a knife inserted into the center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack, and let cool completely.

title: Italian Crumbed Pork Loin
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork loin | italian salad dressing ( your choice, i choose mine, but any salad dressing that matches the kinds of ingredients listed above ) | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Trim excess fat from pork. Sprinkle the pork generously with the dry Italian salad dressing mix italian bread crumbs with italian dressing mixture. Sprinkle the pork generously with the seasoned bread crumbs. Bake, uncovered, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Fried Rice With Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 3 tablespoons spiced ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon tamari ( japanese soy sauce ) | 3 cups cooked long-grain rice | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 1 lb spaghetti, cooked
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine ricotta cheese, sugar and tamari until well combined. In a large skillet or wok, stir fry rice and dill in hot oil, stirring until rice is just barely golden.

Random Ingredients: chilies,lebanese cucumber,chicken bouillon cube,banana,cornflour,red chile pepper,daikon radish
title: Aromatic Vegetable
ingredients: 500 g daikon radishes, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 -2 banana, peeled, chopped into 1-inch pieces | 1 lebanese cucumber, peeled, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 red chile pepper, chopped | 2 chicken bouillon cubes or 2 vegetable bouillon cubes, dissolved in | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 -2 small fresh red chile pepper, chopped
instructions: Heat the grill to high. Put the daikon, bananas and cucumbers on to a baking dish with red chilli and lemon juice. In a small bowl add 1 or 2 of the dissolved chicken bouillon cubes, and then add about half of the cornflour paste to the remaining liquid. Mix together well, or blend with your hands. Pour over the vegetables and mix everything together so there are no clumps. Sprinkle the rest of the cornflour paste over the vegetables. Put the baking dish in your grill and grill everything around 5 minutes, turning frequently, or until you feel a nice crusty texture has formed over the vegetables. Alternatively, you may put everything in your food processor or blender. If you like, you may puree the mixture, but the dish is not totally smooth. If you use the immersion blender, this will reduce any lumps in your dish.

title: Ancho Chile Paste
ingredients: 2 packages ancho chili paste | 1 banana, peeled & cubed
instructions: Combine 1/2 package chili paste, and 1/2 banana in the blender, or until smooth. Transfer to a small saucepn. Heat the remaining tablespoon chili paste over low heat, stirring constantly. Add the remaining chopped banana and simmer until tender. Makes approximately 50 servings.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,extra virgin olive oil,beef,lamb,dark chocolate,yellow bell pepper,lump crabmeat,spinach
title: Italian Stuffed Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1/2 lb lamb | 1/2 lb lump crabmeat, picked over, picked over, and coarsely chopped | 1 can mixed chopped yellow bell peppers, drained | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh spinach | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/3 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons dry-roasted dark chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Prepare filling.

title: Egg Noodle Curry
ingredients: 375 g medium egg noodles | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 pinch chili pepper
instructions: Cook noodles until tender. Drain noodles and add to a bowl. Sprinkle curry powder to taste. Serve cold.

title: Pimiento
ingredients: 2 pounds pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Place pork cubes into a skillet, and pour enough soy milk into the skillet so the pork cubes are submerged in the milk. Cook over medium high heat until the milk is absorbed, then remove from heat and set aside to cool. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. The soaked soymilk will keep well in the refrigerator for up to a week.

title: Guilt Me Avocado and Asparagus Sausage Chili
ingredients: 2 avocados | 2 tablespoons dried thyme | 2 cups pinto beans, mashed | 8 ounces asparagus, cooked
instructions: Peel and dice avocados. Add thyme to mashed pinto beans and mash with a fork until desired texture. Add mashed avocado mixture to mashed beans, mix well. To thaw, put a piece of plastic wrap on your work surface. Spread the mixture across the plastic wrap. Sprinkle the top of the guilt me pepper sausage sausage with dried thyme. Make a small slit in the sausage and close. Wrap up the wrap.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,self rising flour,spaghetti sauce,green onion,orange bell pepper
title: Easy Orange Sweet Onion Pizza
ingredients: 2 cups self rising flour, or as needed | 1/2 cup chopped green onions | 1/2 cup orange bell peppers or 1/2 cup red bell pepper | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 can spaghetti sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together flour, green onions, orange pepper and onion powder. Fold in spaghetti sauce. Place pizza dough into a greased 9 inch pie plate. Spread into a circle. Cook pizza on preheated oven until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Cut and serve.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,new potato,beef stock cube,apricot half
title: Picnic Beef, Pork and Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 500 g new potatoes, cut lengthways into 1cm slices | 250 g beef stock cubes | 8 large maraschino cherries ( optional ) | 1 packet dried apricot halves ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add potatoes and cook over low medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes until potato are browned. Add stock, stir over gentle heat for 3 minutes until stock is absorbed add cherries, if using and simmer for 4 - 5 minutes or until tender, season to taste and stir through. Spoon into bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,mozzarella cheese,cold water,date,thai red curry paste,palm sugar,lasagna noodle
title: Spicy Thai Red Curry Lasagna (No Cook)
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 cup lowfat mozzarella cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese, grated | 5 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and sliced into thin strips ( see note ) | 8 slices fresh ginger ( see note ) | 1 package thai red curry paste | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/3 cup palm sugar, grated or 1/3 cup brown sugar, packed
instructions: Note, i don't buy the red curry paste at a local Asian market, it is an indonesian condiment that tastes a lot like curry and condiment. In a large frying pan saute poblano strips in hot butter, until they are just starting to turn a bit translucent. Add thai red curry paste and stir until well mixed. Add cold water, stir, and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer about 10 minutes. Add mozzarella cheese and stir until cheese is melted. Note, i don't usually use my electric pan to make this recipe. Using a regular pan, if you like your lasagna to be dense and slow, that's ok but i don't recommend using a regular pan. Preheat oven to 350°f. Spread 3/4 of the tomato paste mixture on the bottom of an 11 x 13 inch glass baking dish. Top with one layer of roasted poblano strips. Cover with half of the tomato paste mix and sprinkle with half of the chopped ginger. Repeat layers and top with remaining tomato paste mix and ginger, followed by the remaining chopped ginger and julienned chiles. Cover with foil and bake uncovered about 35 minutes. Uncover and bake additional 15 minutes or until crusty.

title: Quick Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 300 g baby spinach | 200 g white flour
instructions: Put the spinach into a large saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil over a medium heat. As soon as the water begins to boil remove from the heat cover and leave for 5 minutes without removing the water. Drain the spinach very well, pressing down on it with your hands or a large metal spoon to squeeze out excess water. Cut the washed leaves into 5 equal portions. Heat the flour in a large non stick frying pan, add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes. Drain off the excess oil and add a little flour to coat the spinach mixture. Cook until the spinach is heated through. Place onto a sheet of baking paper and lightly dust with flour.

title: Curried Omelet
ingredients: 1/4 cup half-and-half | 6 tablespoons coarsely chopped grain mustard | 4 tablespoons butter | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/8 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: In a small skillet, bring to boil half and half, mustard, butter, turmeric and curry powder. Remove from heat and spoon mixture onto a hot griddle that has been sprayed lightly with nonstick cooking spray. Cook until the underside is golden brown. Turn. Cook other side and repeat. Serve hot.

title: Japanese Style Steamed Fish
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs firm white fish fillets | 1 bouillon cube
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large frying pan. Cover and bring to the boil. Steam for about 20 minutes until fish flakes easily. Let fish rest a little before serving. If there is any fish left over, leave the stock in a saucepan for a few minutes then remove the fish and put on a warmed serving dish.

title: Fettuccine with Aioli
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine | 1 jar aioli
instructions: Cook pasta al dente. Meanwhile mix aioli with pasta and heat until ready to serve.

title: Creamy Cashews
ingredients: 1/3 cup greek feta cheese, crumbled | 1/3 cup crumbled queso fresco | 1/4 cup salted cashews | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: Put the cashews in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,golden syrup,urad dal,chili pepper flake
title: Dal and Aniseed Spices
ingredients: 1 cup rajma urad dal | 4 -5 dried chili peppers or 4 -5 other dried chili peppers | 1/2 teaspoon red food coloring or 1/2 teaspoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the rajma and urad dal. Keep aside. Grind the soaked spices with salt, pepper and any other paste. Put the dry ingredients in a food processor and process till they form a paste. Add the paste and mix well. Add water if it is necessary. Heat a frying pan on a medium flame. Add a little oil so it spreads around inside the pan. Keep stirring till the oil does not stick to the sides. Put the spices on the pan as you see in the photo. Turn on your lowest heat. Add hot water if it is not drying out. Leave the spices on the pan on low heat for 5 minutes. Turn off the fire, open the lid. Leave the pan for another 30 seconds. Carefully remove the lid. Let it cool down. Serve warm or keep warm. Enjoy on a rainy day, with yoghurt and butter or raita powder.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,cardamom pod,sultana,coriander seed,pork shoulder,pepper sauce
title: Saffron Churrasas
ingredients: 4 teaspoons ground coriander seed | 1 teaspoon pepper sauce ( such as tabasco ) | 4 teaspoons saffron strands | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 4 tablespoons sultanas | 1 pound boneless pork shoulder, chopped into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Season the spice mixture with a pinch of salt and red pepper flakes. Fry the coriander seeds, saffron pieces, cardamom pods, and sultanas in the hot skillet until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Add the saffron and sultana mixture a little bit at a time, stirring constantly, until the previous addition is almost all absorbed. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and continue cooking until most of the liquid is reduced to about 2 tablespoons. Stir the mixture occasionally.

title: Sticky Rabbit - Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 rabbit, cut up | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1 serrano chili | 1 tablespoon whiskey
instructions: Add peanut butter and serrano chili to food processor. Add whiskey and blend until smooth. Pour into a bowl and coat rabbit with mixture. Marinate at least 1 hour at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator. Grill rabbit until well browned.

title: Crock Pot  Dutch Flavored Spareribs
ingredients: 2 lbs pork spareribs | 1 cup unsweetened cranberry juice | 1/4 cup cocoa
instructions: Place spareribs and cranberry juice in 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. Cook on low 6 to 9 hours, setting spareribs aside and cover with foil overnight to thicken juices if necessary. Remove ribs from saucepan, reserving liquid. Rinse, pat dry and sprinkle with cocoa. Note, you want the sauce to be moist and spicy, not boiling.

title: Parsley Sesame Seed
ingredients: 1 package dried chipotle chiles | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil
instructions: Place chiles in a bowl and cover with very hot tap water.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,saffron thread,coffee,green chili salsa,white rice,tomatillo,pork tenderloin,salad oil
title: Green Chile Pork With Grilled Tomatillo and Chile Salsa
ingredients: 500 g tomatillos, husked, rinsed and diced | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 pinch saffron thread | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 500 g pork tenderloin, cut into 2 to 3 cm cubes | 1/2 cup prepared green chili salsa | 1 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1 medium green chili salsa | 3/4 cup hot coffee
instructions: In a small frying pan, heat saffron threads and 1/2 cup salad oil over medium high heat until golden, about 3 minutes. Immediately transfer saffron to a small plate, then add remaining oil to pan. Cook pork in saffron infused oil for 8 minutes or until browned on all sides. Set aside. Wipe excess fat off tomatillos using paper towels. Reduce heat to medium. Add saffron and remaining salad oil and saffron infused oil. Cook, stirring from time to time, until tomatillos soften and turn translucent, about 3 minutes. Stir in the chile salsa, then pour into a bowl or platter. Serve immediately with rice and garnish with grilled tomato and green chili salsa.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,thai chile red pepper flake,cornstarch,salmon,chinese five spice powder,linguine
title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 1 cup lemongrass ( white part only ) or 1 cup lemongrass ( white part only ) | 1 tablespoon thai chile red pepper flakes ( use a little more or less if you like ) | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 gallon fresh salmon, bones and cartilage removed ( in chunks or slices ) | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Rinse the linguine as needed.

title: Homemade Smoky Sun Dried Tomato Smothered Sweet Onions
ingredients: 1 lb raw sweet onion (, 2 to 2 1/2 pounds ) | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1/2 lb sun-dried tomato
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly mist a small nonstick baking sheet with olive oil. Cut the dried sweet onion in half.

title: Roast Beef With Mushroom and Parsley
ingredients: 1 lb beef, trimmed of all excess fat | 3/4 lb mixed dried porcini mushrooms, soaked in hot water for 12 hours | 1 tablespoon chopped italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f rub 1 tablespoon olive oil on one side of the beef at a time and place on a rack in a roasting pan. Tie a piece of kitchen string around the outside of the roast and place roasting pan on rack in oven. Roast for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 450f. Carefully place the roast in a warm place and tent with aluminum foil. Let rest for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, remove the tent of string from the beef and discard. Carefully remove the string. Strain the liquid from the roasting pan with a strainer into a warm bowl and skim off any fat that rises to the top. Rinse the porcini mushrooms in warm water, then pat dry with paper towels. Slice the stems off the mushrooms, then cut the mushrooms in half and squeeze out the excess moisture. Place the meat on a carving board and carve thinly. Place the meat on a warmed platter. Sprinkle with parsley and serve. Roast meat is best if marinated overnight, but may be covered with plastic wrap or aluminum foil when resting.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,applesauce,pineapple juice,rum,hard egg,orange juice,prime rib roast
title: Tropical Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs prime rib roast, trimmed of excess fat | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 cup unsweetened applesauce | 6 tablespoons rum | 3 cups unsweetened pineapple juice | 2 whole hard-boiled eggs, halved length wise | 3 tablespoons fresh orange juice
instructions: Place beef roast in a large roasting pan. Combine sugar, applesauce and rum in a saucepan and stir over moderate heat until sugar is dissolved. Simmer over moderate heat until mixture comes to a full boil and syrupy, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat broiler. Remove beef from pan. Prick beef on all sides with a skewer. Pour hot syrup and orange juice over beef. Broil the beef in the center of the oven, basting beef with hot syrup, 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Slow Cooker Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 cans sweet yellow salsa ( jubes is my favorite ) | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1 package chunky salsa ( jubes is my favorite )
instructions: Throw everything in a crockpot. Cook on low about 4 - 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,phyllo dough,pie shell,thyme leaf,extra virgin olive oil,bean sprout,apricot jam
title: Easy Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 unbaked pie shells ( see directions ) | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup golden raisin, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons apricot jam, coarsely chopped | 1/2 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves, minced | 1/4 cup cooked fresh beans sprout, chopped ( optional ) | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. Lightly coat bottom and half of a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Press 1 pastry sheet into casserole dish.

title: Easy English Cucumber Appetizer (Copycat)
ingredients: 2 english seedless cucumbers, peeled, halved lengthwise, and thinly sliced crosswise ( about 1 1/4 cups ) | 1 1/2 ounces chipotle chiles in adobo, canned in adobo sauce, minced
instructions: Spray large nonstick frypan or wok with nonstick spray and heat over medium high heat. Add half of the cucumbers.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,graham cracker crumb,extra virgin olive oil,espresso granule
title: Easy Espresso Apple Crumble
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons instant espresso granules | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/4 cups apple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix the espresso granules, oil and apple juice thoroughly. Stir in crumbs. Spread into a 9x9 inch pan and bake 15 minutes. Cool and serve with ice cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: hot mustard,asiago cheese,sirloin,phyllo pastry,green pepper,ancho chile,carrot,vanilla essence
title: Filipino Beef Cigars
ingredients: 1 lbs ground sirloin | 1/2 cup diced carrot | 1/2 cup diced green pepper | 1 tablespoon minced ancho chile | 1 tablespoon sweet red hot mustard | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla essence | 3 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/4 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Mix sirloin, carrot, green pepper, hot mustard, chili, vanilla essence and 1 tablespoons of grated cheese in bowl. Lay out filo in single layer in 10 x 3 inch pan. Cut sheet in 6 strips crosswise. Brush with egg wash. Place 1 teaspoon of beef mixture close to the end of each strip along length of phyllo. Roll up, beginning at end of phyllo. Repeat with remaining filo and beef mixture.. Spread 1/6 cup of grated cheese on top of each cigar and roll up. Repeat until all cigars are used. Cover with foil and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,chicken breast,asafoetida powder,almond butter,chicken thigh,corn oil,puff pastry,beef brisket
title: Beef and Jack Wrapped With Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1 boneless beef brisket ( or other mild-tamale ) | 1 beef brisket | 1 chicken thigh, skinned and sliced | 1/4 cup corned whole almonds, toasted | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup corn oil | 1 slice swiss cheese, cut into 4 triangles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Season the brisket and beef with salt and pepper. Heat a large skillet over medium heat until just hot enough to sizzle. Add the chicken and beef and sear until browned, about 10 minutes. Remove the beef and chicken from skillet. Heat the same skillet used to cook the brisket and the beef until browned on second side, about 10 minutes. Add the corned whole almonds and asafoetida to the skillet and cook until liquid evaporates and the almonds turn golden, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Indian Tea (For Diabetics)
ingredients: 5 green cardamom pods ( do not remove before use to ensure generation of heat through ) | 1/2 teaspoon tea ( i prefer decaf ) or 1/2 teaspoon rum ( i prefer decaf )
instructions: Place cardamom pods into a small dish. Place the remaining ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Strain the boiling tea. Allow to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: white rum,flat leaf italian parsley,cornstarch,red capsicum,rose water,soup
title: Fiery Cured Capsicum Rillettes
ingredients: 1 red capsicum, seeded quartered | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons sweet white rum, heated until boiling | 1 teaspoon rose water | 2 cups hot soup, warmed | 3 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Cut capsicum into 2 cm pieces and toss with 1 tablespoon cornstarch in a bowl. Set aside. In a medium saucepan, combine remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch with 2 tablespoons hot sugar. Mix until dissolved and set aside. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons water in a small saucepan, add remaining cornstarch mixture and cook, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon until mixture boils and thickens, about 2 minute. Remove from heat and set aside. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons water in a small pan until boiling.

title: Ginger Gloves
ingredients: 6 slices fresh ginger root | 6 cubes chicken bouillon powder | 1 sprig crushed dried rosemary
instructions: Place the ginger slices in a jar with enough water to cover. Remove some of the water and stir into the chicken bouillon. Stir in the rosemary. Cover, and place in the refrigerator to marinate.

title: Vodka
ingredients: 1 tablespoon port wine | 1 tablespoon fresh grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Rub the rim of a high walled tic tac toe tin with pepper. This requires a high wall and depth of at least 4 inches. Pour the port into the tin and sprinkle with the parmesan. Place the tin on the counter or countertop and set aside to dry for 8 to 10 hours, until the vodka starts to turn dark tan or syrupy.

title: Yellow Pepper & Barley  Broth
ingredients: 2 yellow peppers | 1/4 liter barley | 1/2 liter of boiling water | 1 liter superfine sugar | fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Roast the peppers until lightly blackened. Once cool enough to touch, peel away the skins and finely chop the flesh. Place the pepper and most of the barley into a large heavy based pot. Pour in boiling water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover and allow to simmer over a low heat for 2 hours. Check the liquid content regularly and add sugar as before. After 25 minutes, add the parsley and remove from heat. Serve with boiled or steamed asparagus.

title: Carambola (Pickled Ham Hocks)
ingredients: 2 lbs ham hocks | 2 tablespoons carambola | 3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Boil ham in salted water until easily pierced with a knife. Drain and blot with paper towel. Trim off hard muscle from ham and discard bones. Cut pieces of ham into four portions and place in storage bag, with spareribs. Pour over sherry, coat with sherry and marinate meat 4 hours, or overnight. Refrigerate 3 days before using.

title: Thyme Fried Spinach
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh spinach | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons ground red pepper | 1 ounce fresh breadcrumb | 1 tablespoon milk or 1 tablespoon cream | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1 teaspoon ricotta cheese, grated
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach. Remove the stalks and wash them well. Slice the stalks at an angle into 1/2 inch pieces, and place in a bowl. Mix together all dry marinade ingredients.

title: Beef Mangetsu
ingredients: 1 gallon buttermilk | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | strawberry, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with a whisk until evenly mixed. Chill for about 1 hour. Serve atop the steamed or fried strawberries with a nice leafy green salad or fresh green leaf lettuce.

title: Arakesh Pumpkin Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried sweet peas ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups canned pumpkin puree | salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried hot pepper flakes | 1 pinch sumac ( optional )
instructions: Place dried peas and pumpkin in a food processor or blender and pulse until pumpkin is finely ground. Add salt, pepper and dried hot pepper flakes to taste. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,corn tortilla chip,black olive,apricot preserve,beef stock,hamburger bun,half
title: Albondigas Con Queso (Mexican Beef Sandwich)
ingredients: 2 fresh hamburger buns, toasted and softened | 2 teaspoons sour cream or 2 teaspoons light mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons apricot preserves | 15 ounces beef stock | 1/3 cup chopped black olives | 1 tablespoon fresh minced cilantro leaves | 1 1/2 cups crushed corn tortilla chips
instructions: Heat oven to mix beef, sour cream, preserves, and stock. Place mixture on toasted buns and top with black olives and cilantro.

title: Pear Pears Stuffed With Sage
ingredients: 3/4 cup fresh sage | 1/4 cup spring onion ( scallions ) | 2 teaspoons saffron | 5 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1 lb waxy potato, cleaned, peeled and coarsely chopped | 4 bosc pears, such as anzac, well-ripe
instructions: Cut a small slit in each parsnip. Remove the hard stalk as well as the very bitter pith. Place the pears inside a deep, clean tin. Add the sage leaves to the tin. Sprinkle over the spring onion, saffron and cooking sherry. Carefully press the mixture slightly to mix so that the leaves come loose. Bring to the boil over a high heat, reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes – or until the mixture is quite dry. Transfer to a cold oven and leave to cool completely. When the salad is cold, put aside the sage leaves for now – discard the leaves completely before serving – or store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Peel the pears carefully, removing the core. Slice the pears in half lengthwise, leaving the shells intact. Stick the pears into the reserved sage leaves. To serve, pile the pears into individual serving plates – sprinkle over the sage leaves and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bourbon,green food coloring,sharp cheddar cheese,pepper,yukon gold potato,jalapeno pepper
title: Cheesy Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 yukon gold potatoes, boiled peeled, cut in squares and then chilled ( if they're cold, peel and cut in half again ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons bourbon | 1/4 teaspoon fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, cut into thin sticks | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 1 drop green food coloring
instructions: Combine the potato cubes and bourbon in a bowl. Mix in the pepper and cheese. Add the food color as desired. Serve at once.

title: Cheesy Beef Patties for 2
ingredients: 200 g ground beef round | 1 tablespoon cornmeal | 200 g grated cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green peas | 2 tablespoons finely chopped shallots or 2 tablespoons onions | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup marsala wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Form meat into 4 - 5 patties. Lightly combine cheese, peas, shallot, teriyaki sauce and 1/2 cup cold water in a large shallow dish. Heat nonstick pan or griddle pan over medium high heat. Cook patties for 6 - 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and tender and cooked through. Place patties on a plate, pour over cheese mixture, and serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,bell pepper,dark soy sauce,sherry wine,celery seed,caster sugar,apple cider vinegar
title: Soy and Pepper Biltong
ingredients: 600 g yellow bell peppers, seeded, coarsely chopped | 100 g bell peppers, coarsely chopped ( red and or or green ) | 2 medium celery seeds ( or 2-3 drops celery salt ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( or braggs liquid aminos...adjust this according to your personal tastes.. ) | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and mix well. Leave the mixture in the fridge 1 hr, or up to 8 hours. Heat oven to 200c. Line 2 baking trays with non stick baking paper. Spread the bell and celery seeds evenly over the baking paper and bake for 10 minutes, stirring or shaking the tray every couple of minutes until the pepper mixture is dark and crisp, and the celery roots start to soften. Stir the biltong into the biltong mixture and heat through, then remove to a serving dish. Serve hot. I don't add the dressing or seasonings to my biltong.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,extra virgin olive oil,pork chop,sumac,cream
title: Pork Kebabs With Mushrooms and Sour Cream
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh white mushrooms, cleaned | 4 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 teaspoons sour cream, sour cream flavor | 1 tablespoon sweet sumac | 7 -9 boneless pork chops, about 1-inch thick
instructions: Wash mushrooms, remove dark green stems from mushrooms and finely chop. In a non stick large skillet heat oil, then add pork. Season with sumac and add pork. Stir fry about 10 minutes until browned all over and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,natural peanut butter,gingerroot,black olive,apple,pork rib,apple juice
title: Apple-Ginger Pork Ribs (Slow Cooker or Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 lbs country-style pork ribs, fat separated | 1 cup apple juice | 2 slices fresh gingerroot | 1 cup natural-style peanut butter | 12 slices apples ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 cup swiss cheese
instructions: Combine the apple juice, ginger root, peanut butter and 3/4 of the swiss cheese in a small bowl. Rub the pork ribs with the peanut butter spice mixture. Arrange the ham, pork and apple slices on your slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: coffee,head garlic,yellow squash,beef broth,white vinegar,poultry seasoning,garlic paste
title: Roasted Garlic Beef and Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-sodium beef broth | 1/2 cup finely chopped yellow squash | 1/2 cup beef fat packed sweetened condensed milk | 1/4 cup strong brewed coffee | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped garlic paste | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 tablespoon white vinegar or 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Place broth and squash in a small saucepan. Cover and simmer over medium low heat until squash is tender, about 20 minutes. Combine the remaining ingredients in a small bowl. When ready to cook, preheat broiler. When vegetables are tender, remove from pan.

title: Miniature Pizzas
ingredients: 1 large poblano chile, seeded | 1 large parsnip, peeled | 24 -30 spring roll wrappers | 12 large prepared pepperoni, thinly sliced | 4 ounces confectioners'sugar | 2 ounces sherry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Cut the skin and seeds from the poblano chile into thin slices. Cut parsnip and poblano into thin slices. Slice and pit the pepperoni to make 8 thin slices. Dip each pepperoni slice into sherry, then place into a paper towel to drain. Place a spring roll wrapper on a work surface. Place about 1 tablespoon of the poblano, parsnip, and poblano slice onto the wrapper. Sprinkle the top of each sandwich with 2 to 3 teaspoons of the confectioner's sugar and 2 tablespoons sherry. Fold the points of the wad of the wrapper over the filling until it is completely folded into the dough. Repeat with the remaining wrappers. Press the tip of a small knife or a sharp knife in the tops of each mini pizzas. Brush the pizzas with sherry.

title: Brochadish Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 beef brisket ( i prefer london broil, but you can grill it yourself if you want ) | ice | 2 bags frozen broccoli, thawed | 2 bags rice krispies
instructions: In a crock pot, cut the brisket in half, lengthwise, and then crosswise across the grain into 1/2. Place the brisket in the bottom of the crock pot that you are going to cook the brisket in.. You may cut out about 12 slices to fit if you wish, i do. You will want to add about 1/2 a cup of the frozen broccoli when ready to cook the brisket.
