title: Coconut and Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 can coconut powder | 1 beef tenderloin ( about 2.5 pound total )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a small bowl, mix coconut powder with coconut milk to make a thick paste. Slice beef into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Nua Sawai Pickled Salmon  (Shrimp )
ingredients: 1 head garlic, cleaned | 3 inches fresh gingerroot | 4 tablespoons mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 4 drops tobasco sauce | 1/8 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seeds, lightly crushed
instructions: Peel garlic and garlic. Cut 2 inch section of ginger, 1 cm deep, into small slivers. Place ginger and garlic in a bowl and set aside. Finely chop remaining ginger. Drain off excess water from bowl. Cut ginger ginger slivers into slivers and place in mortar. Add mustard powder, mustard powder, tabasco, chili flakes, cardamom and remaining ginger slivers. Mix well. Pack a thin layer of paste all over the fish. Place on a platter and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, up to overnight. Transfer the pickled salmon to a serving platter and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, as best results serve with jasmine and basmati rice.

title: Tofu Soup
ingredients: 250 g tofu, cubed | 1 teaspoon savory
instructions: Put tofu cubes in a pan of boiling water. They will become soft by then. When they float, drain well. Spray with a little olive oil. Add the savoury. Add salt and mix well. Chill. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,kielbasa sausage,soy milk,coconut milk,soy sauce,watermelon
title: Crock Pot Swedish Sausage and Watermelon Soup
ingredients: 4 tablespoons soy milk | 12 ounces kielbasa sausage, sliced | 1 can coconut milk | 1 can beef broth | 1/2 cup watermelon, peeled and cubed | 2 tablespoons soy milk
instructions: Place soy milk in the crock pot. Top with kielbasa, coconut milk, beef broth, watermelon, and soy milk. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours.

title: Mexican Fiesta Candy
ingredients: 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 tablespoon lime, juice of
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Using a pastry bag fitted with 1 inch round tip, pipe the candy into mounds about 3 inches in diameter. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,ginger,fish stock,egg yolk,thyme sprig,onion flake,graham cracker crumb,baking soda
title: Crumb Crumbs and Fish Chips
ingredients: 1 can fish stock ( not fish stock ) | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 2 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 2 fresh thyme sprigs, finely chopped | 2 bay leaves | 1 egg yolk, beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Stir together fish stock, cracker crumbs, baking soda, ginger powder, onion flakes, thyme and bay leaves in large bowl. Stir in egg yolk. Add enough mixture to make dough soft and moist. Shape into 2 inch diameter patties. Place on greased cookie sheets and bake until cooked through, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mint,black cardamom pod,ginger paste,cauliflower,floury potato,cashew,alphabet pasta,white flour
title: Cauliflower Potato Pancakes
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower | 1 1/2 cups alphabet pasta ( you can substitute other traditional style of cauliflower ) or 1 1/2 cups spirals ( you can substitute other traditional style of cauliflower ) | 1/2 inch ginger paste | 1/2 teaspoon white flour | 3/4 cup white flour or 3/4 cup ghee | 2 cups unpeeled grated unpeeled firm boiled potatoes | 1 small handful of ground almonds or 1 small cashews | 3 whole black cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon fresh mint ( optional )
instructions: Heat water to boiling in a pot and cook alphabet pasta until alphabets are cooked. When alphabets are done, drain and place in a colander to allow residual brushing. Rinse under cool water and run under cold water once drained. Cut cauliflower into florets and cook in boiling water with ginger for about 4 - 5 minutes, drain and rinse. In a bowl, mix together the flour or ghee, the grated potatoes, ground almonds or cashews, cardamom and fresh mint, if using. When cauliflower is cooked drain and rinse well. Place the cooked drained cauliflower and cooked drained pasta into a large bowl and pour the flour mixture over it, stirring well to mix it into the contents of the bowl. Make sure the mixture is well combined. Fold in the fried almonds or cashews, if using. In a non stick skillet, heat about ½ inch of ghee or other neutral oil until fairly hot but not smoking. The pancake may bubble and get puffy around the edges, but will cook in a pinch as it cools. Ladle a ladle of the mixture into the skillet and cook for 30 - 45 seconds or until the middle becomes puffy and a golden brown. Turn with a spatula, slide the pancake onto a plate covered with a damp cloth or napkin, and continue until all the mixture has been used. Let cool about 5 - 10 minutes before eating, then garnish with extra mint leaves if desired.

title: Smoked Salmon Gravy
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh mushrooms or 5 lbs frozen mushrooms | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Clean mushrooms, decely dry, and slice 1/2 thick. Place mushrooms in a heavy bottomed pot with enough water to cover them. Add boullion cube. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until mushrooms are soft. Do not boil. Serve over your favourite pasta.

title: Braised Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 2 ounces brown sugar, packed | 1 lemon, zest of, grated
instructions: Preheat your broiler and set the oven rack at 4 to 6 inches from the heating element. Rub the salt and brown sugar onto the brisket and brush with the lemon zest. Place the brisket in a nonstick roasting pan. Pour enough hot water into the pan to come halfway up the side of the brisket. Place the brisket in the oven and broil for 1 hour per pound for rare, or until almost dry. You may have to tent the meat with foil after 1 hour or more of broiling time, as the acid in the pan will cause the moisture to get into the meat if it becomes too dry. The brisket will need to be well seasoned and cooked that time.

title: Jook
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut oil | 2 cups pitted prunes, quartered | 2 teaspoons allspice | 1/2 cup cashews | 1/2 cup lemon peel, minced | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb penne pasta, cooked | 1/4 cup tahini
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat. Cook prunes, allspice and cashews in oil 2 - 3 minutes or until crisp tender. Turn off heat. Add lemon peel to prune mixture. Add pasta and turn to coat with mixture. Sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Pine Leaves With Hoisin Chicken
ingredients: 12 grape leaves | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon hoisin sauce
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, combine hoisin sauce and enough water to make sauce.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,strawberry,buttermilk baking mix,cilantro stem,cooking apple,pork loin chop,coriander powder,sherry wine
title: Pork Chops With Apple-Chocolate Filling
ingredients: 4 boneless pork loin chops | 3/4 cup dry sherry wine | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 4 ounces chopped cooking apples | 3/4 cup buttermilk baking mix | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro stems | 1/2 cup chopped fresh strawberries | 1/8 cup chopped chocolate
instructions: Heat oven to 375°. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Place pork chops between 2 sheets of waxed paper.

title: Cumin Paste (For Chicken Breasts)
ingredients: 4 ounces egg yolks | 2 teaspoons finely crushed cumin | 2 teaspoons crushed peppercorns
instructions: Beat the egg yolks, peppercorns and cumin together with half the oil in a mixer. Place chicken in a shallow metal baking dish, pour over half the spice mixture and turn to coat both sides. Cover with foil and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Heat the remaining oil in a large frying pan and fry the chicken on both sides until cooked. Serve with salad greens, french bread or bread slices.

Random Ingredients: kahlua,chuck roast,sherry wine,lasagna,cheese spread,nonfat milk,thyme leaf
title: Classic Mexican Slow Cooker Meat Lasagna
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast, cut into 1-inch pieces | 24 sheets lasagna sheets ( i use the pepperidge farm whole wheat ones ) | 3 cups nonfat milk, divided | 12 -15 ounces cheese spread | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 cup kahlua ( i like kirsch ) or 1/2 cup other coffee-flavored liqueur
instructions: Put beef into the crock of a slow cooker. Arrange a few sheets of lasagna over the meat and top with 1/3 each of the cheese spread and sherry. Repeat layering twice with remaining meat, cheeses, sherry, thyme and kahlua. Add half the milk, and top with remaining 1 cup milk. Cover and cook on low 6 hours. Remove meat and shred. Skim fat from juices, add 1/2 cup of extra milk and stir. Place back in the slow cooker and cook on high 30 minutes. Stir with a fork and serve with remaining skim milk.

title: Roasted Potato Salad With Snap Peas
ingredients: 4 cups peeled mashed baking potatoes | 1 medium red onion | 10 ounces shelled snap peas ( french style snives )
instructions: Wash potatoes well in a sieve placed over a bowl, shaking out the excess moisture. Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Halve onion lengthwise, then slice thickly and set aside. Peel potatoes. Scrub potatoes in a clean dry towel, then toss with remaining ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a shallow baking dish. Roast uncovered in preheated oven 15 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and crisp.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,pecan half,french onion,cucumber,lettuce leaf
title: Spanish Cucumber Salad (Salad No Mayo)
ingredients: 1 -2 french fried onions | 1 -2 green chili pepper | 1 cucumber | 10 -12 lettuce leaves | 100 g pecan halves
instructions: Slice french fried onions, add chili. Cover with water. Put on lid and let stand 15 min. To make the dressing, peel cucumber, wash well under cold water. Slice cucumber lengthways, remove seeds and slice thinly. Arrange leaves over salad, sprinkle with pecans. Drizzle with dressing.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,orange juice zest,curry powder,arborio rice,strawberry,margarine,beef
title: Curry Rice and Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 lb lean ground beef | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups carnarola rice | 1 cup orange juice, lemon juice or 1 cup lime juice | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 3 strawberries, sliced
instructions: In a saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat. Add ground beef and brown, drain any excess oil. Add rice and stir to coat. Add orange and lime juices, curry paste and curry powder. Stir to combine. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve over sliced strawberry and serve.

title: Costa Rican Layer Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces cheese ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup salsa ( mild and medium ) | 2 -3 tablespoons jagu-brand cola-flavored picante sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl until well incorporated. Refrigerate until ready to serve as it will thicken up on it's own.

title: Faux Peanuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs black sesame seeds | 1 cup dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 300º. Place sesame seeds in a dry skillet and toast them over low heat until they begin to turn golden brown. Turn frequently and toast until they are completely dry and very aromatic. Set them aside to cool. Place peanuts in a clean skillet and toast over medium heat for 1 minute. Place peanuts in a very clean bowl and stir in roasted peanuts. The peanuts should be coated and moist. Spread the peanut mixture on a large aluminum foil lined cookie sheet and spread out the peanuts so that they stand up in a single layer. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring every 5 to 8 minutes, until peanuts are very lightly browned. The peanuts should smell roasted and the inside of the bowl should feel somewhat dry. Remove the baking sheet and peanuts from oven and put on a cooling rack to cool completely. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate chip,parsnip,grain white rice,date,prosciutto,beef gravy
title: Baked Potato Parsnips With Dipped Prosciutto
ingredients: 8 tablespoons low-sodium beef gravy | 4 ounces low-fat prosciutto, diced | 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup pared dates, chopped | 1 cup white chocolate chips ( recommended ritz ) | 2 1/2 cups long grain white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Mix the beef gravy in a large bowl and add prosciutto.

title: Tunisian Thin Dumplings
ingredients: 1 package sweet biscuits, such as marie's | 1 jar methi leaves
instructions: Separate biscuits, then cut through center of bread using a 1 inch round cutter, leaving each biscuit to resemble a 1/2 inch circle. Fill each biscuit with 1 tablespoon of methi, forming a ring. Place on a plate. Repeat for remaining dough. Wrap each ring in foil and refrigerate for one hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place dough on a lightly floured cutting board, then using a 4 inch round cookie cutter, cut circles from the biscuits using a 1/4 inch round cutter, dividing the dough equally. Repeat with remaining dough and filling. Line a baking sheet with reynolds wrap aluminum foil. Line the foil with tin foil. Bake biscuits for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, then remove and place on a cooling rack. Allow to sit for 15 minutes, then remove foil, biscuits and cool completely. These should be slightly dry. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: ale,picante sauce,chicken stock vegetable,cayenne,peanut butter,tomato juice
title: Mexican Peanut Soup
ingredients: 4 tablespoons peanut butter | 14 ounces stewed tomatoes with juice | 14 ounces chicken stock or 14 ounces vegetable stock | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 2/3 cup mild picante sauce ( like pace ) | 3 tablespoons dried roasted peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Blend the peanut butter with the stewed tomatoes in a blender or food processor. Then add the stock, sauce and cayenne. If you want to serve right away, refrigerate the soup but put it in the freezer if you wanted to serve later. Garnish with the roasted peanuts to serve.

Random Ingredients: courgette,avocado,beef chuck roast,tortilla chip,white potato,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Beef Stew With White Potatoes and Avocado
ingredients: 1 large white potato, peeled and cut into thin wedges | vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 ounces shaved beef chuck roast | 1 can white potatoes, cut in quarters | 1 large courgette, cut into thin wedges | 4 ounces tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat the grill pan. Spray with oil and cook the seasoned chuck, meat, potato and courgettes for approximately 5 minutes until cooked to your liking. Season to taste with salt and pepper, then transfer to a serving dish. Spray both sides of the tortilla chips with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Serve with meat stew, potato and courgette.

Random Ingredients: green bean,mace,sparkling water,green olive,beef gravy,hazelnut,red pepper sauce,hamburger bun
title: Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun, sliced in half ( from a loaf ) or 1 lb sandwich bun, split ( from a loaf ) | 1 dash blackened mace ( recommended ) | 1 dash hot red pepper sauce | 1 can beef gravy, gravy mix | 1 lb green beans, cleaned and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 jar halved pimento stuffed green olives, drained | 1 jar pimiento-stuffed green olives, drained | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Place the bread slices on a cookie sheet and lightly with a bit of olive oil, and then toast to your liking. Place the cooked hamburger on top of the bread slices and then sprinkle with all of the ingredients to the burger. You can cut up some of the pepper sauce if you like, mix together. Cook in a 350 f. Oven for 15 minutes or until the hamburger is browned. Allow to cool for about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Italian Zucchini
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini | 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1/4 teaspoon prepared mustard
instructions: Quarter and slice zucchini.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,green king prawn,sherry wine,baking potato,ginger garlic paste n't,grand marnier
title: Shrimp Mince and Potato Rounds
ingredients: 500 g large baking potatoes, unpeeled | 225 g green king prawns, raw peeled and deveined ( or 6 small shrimp, peeled and deveined ) | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste ( i use no yolks ) | 1/4 cup bottled dry sherry wine | 1/3 cup grand marnier | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to moderate 180c. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Place potatoes in a large saucepan of boiling water, add a pinch of salt and return to the boil. Boil for 5 mins, then drain and gently plunge into ice water while preparing prawns. Cut prawns into 1cm dice. Cook prawns in a large pan of boiling water for 3 mins until just cooked & slightly softened. Drain and then cool under running water. Place prawns in a food processor along with garlic paste, sherry, grand marnier, sugar & reserved potato. Pulse until smooth, then push through a large, well oiled sieve to remove as much liquid as possible. This will make about 3 cups, then add to the prawn mixture in batches, making sure you don't overprocess or the dish will be soupy. Spoon mixture into ramekins to shape and place on prepared trays. Place 1cm apart, bake for 20 mins until golden.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,confectioner sugar,cardamom pod,pork fillet,chicken bouillon,marinara sauce,plantain
title: Chocolate Chops for Two
ingredients: 1 pound pork fillet, cut into bite-sized chunks | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 2 1/2 cups marinara sauce | 2 1/2 slices plantains, cut into 1/2 by 1/4 inch slices | 1/3 cup miniature semisweet chocolate chips | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pods | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: In a saucepan, mix the chicken bouillon with 1 cup marinara sauce. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then stir in the pork cubes and plantains. Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the pork is cooked. Stir in the chocolate chips. Sprinkle with cardamom pods to serve.

Random Ingredients: crouton,gelatin,red curry paste,almond extract,pasta,cherry,chicken tenderloin,pie pastry
title: Chicken Curry Pasta
ingredients: 7 ounces frozen cherry, with their liquid drained and squeezed dry | 1/2 cup fresh or frozen diced chicken tenderloins | 5 tablespoons red curry paste ( i use thai violets ) | 4 sheets frozen prepared pie pastry ( thawed ) | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/3 cup crouton ( optional ) | 1 lb cooked pasta
instructions: Prepare your pasta according to your package instructions and refrigerate for 30 - 60 minutes before serving. Toss the cherry with the curry paste, refrigerate for 15 minutes. Combine gelatine and almond extract in a small bowl, stirring with a whisk. Drain the chicken, reserving the liquid. Stir into the gelatine mixture until the mixture is smooth. Divide in half and sprinkle each with the croutons. Place half the pasta in a large bowl of lightly salted boiling water, add 1 cup frozen cherry. Cover and let sit at room temperature until the pasta is thawed, about 20 minutes. Drain the pasta, and then place in a large bowl with the cherry mixture. Toss gently to coat. You can also refrigerate in the fridge for several hours or overnight serve over cooked hot, hot or cold pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,grit,lemon extract,pork shoulder,mustard seed,beef stock
title: Wild Rice with Pork
ingredients: 1 can beef stock | 1 lb pork shoulder, diced | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon coarse-grind raw grits | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1 cup wild rice, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Drain beef stock through a sieve or coffee filter, making sure that all solids are discarded. Add pork shoulder, mustard seeds, grits, and lemon extract to simmering stock.

title: Langosteen Wraps
ingredients: 2 pork loin chops | 2 hoagie rolls
instructions: Preheat the grill, place the pork chops on a foil lined baking sheet or a rack in a small baking pan. Sprinkle a large amount of pepper over each chop. Roast in the preheated 350 degrees f oven until slightly charred, 7 to 10 minutes per side. Let the pork chops rest for a few minutes on the pan before slicing into the thick slices. Open the hoagie rolls and toast slightly so that the tops stay nice and crusty. Spread each roll with a portion of the pork chops and roll tightly into a roll. Serve hot.

title: Broccoli Rabe Feta Side Dish
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli rabe, trimmed and cut into pieces | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup roasted unsalted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook broccoli rabe in boiling water until tender but firm, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,chicken breast,mexican tomato,ice,kalamata olive,red chili pepper flake,beef bouillon granule
title: Pollo a La Mexicana
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely diced rotisserie-cooked boneless chicken breast | 1/4 cup finely diced drained canned mexican-style tomato | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, kalamata pitted and chopped | 1/4 cup beef bouillon granules | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes | 1 loaf rye bread, round, unsliced | 6 tablespoons chopped roasted red chili peppers and or 6 tablespoons chopped jalapeno peppers
instructions: Scoop or tear chicken into small bite size pieces and place in bowl. Combine tomatoes, olives, bouillon granules, and chili peppers in 2 quart shallow dish and pour over chicken. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for no longer than 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Remove chicken from marinade and drain well on paper towels, reserving marinade. Place bread rounds on baking sheets. Sprinkle with chiles. Preheat broiler. Broil chicken, turning once, about 2 minutes or until bread turns golden brown and cheese is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: butter,sun tomato oil,corn oil,black olive,rye flour,zucchini lengthwise,white bread,white bean
title: Fried White Beans With Zucchini and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 zucchini, halved lengthwise | 40 g drained canned white beans, rinsed | 15 g drained sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 6 slices country bread | 60 g salted butter, softened and chopped | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 2 cups fresh white beans, cooked | 125 ml sun-dried tomato puree
instructions: In a skillet, heat the corn oil and butter over moderate heat. When foaming subsides, add the zucchini and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until just softened. Add the white beans, sun dried tomatoes, bread and 2 tbs of butter and toss. Place the skillet over medium heat, add remaining butter and mix until the butter melts. Toast the bread. Spread the toast with the remaining butter, spread on a baking tray and grill for 3 - 4 minutes, until golden.

Random Ingredients: lobster meat,jasmine rice,olive,rice wine,chili pepper,vanilla bean,wild mushroom,parsnip
title: Lobster and Wild Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb cubed cooked lobster meat | 1/4 cup olive, finely chopped | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh parsnip | 1 chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped wild mushroom ( optional ) | 1/2 cup uncooked jasmine rice | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1/2 teaspoon dry vanilla bean
instructions: Cook rice according to directions on package and stir in the wine and vanilla bean with cooked rice until liquid is absorbed. Add remaining ingredients and combine well.

title: Stuffed Broccoli With Poblano, Apricots, and Gorgonzola
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets | 1/2 cup crumbled gorgonzola | 1/2 tablespoon minced fresh thyme leave | 24 medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 sprig fresh thyme leave | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricot | 1 poblano chile pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Toss the broccoli with 1/2 cup of the gorgonzola cheese, 1 tablespoon of the thyme leaves, and 1/4 teaspoon of the salt in a medium bowl. Fill a large baking pan with water until it has 12 or more inches in the diameter of the broccoli. Arrange the shrimp skin side up in a single layer in the shallow pan. Top each shrimp with 1 or 2 thyme leaves, 2 or 3 shrimp, and 1 or 2 apricots and 1 poblano pepper. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Pour the water into the baking dish just to reach the top of the shrimp. Bake until the shrimp is bright done in the center, 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining gorgonzola cheese. Continue baking until cheese is melted and bubbling, about 30 minutes more. Remove from the oven, sprinkle with remaining thyme leaves, and serve.

title: White Russian
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk | 1/2 cup brewed coffee flavored liqueur | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,white mushroom,oyster sauce,mexican chocolate,phyllo pastry,chicken stock
title: Easy and Delicious Mofongo (Beef, Mushrooms & Chicken Pie)
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry | 8 ounces white mushrooms ( chopped or 1 cup ) | 1 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1 cup mexican chocolate piece ( finely chopped ) | 1 package flour tortillas ( burrito type )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Line a 7x11 inch loaf pan with phyllo. Line the bottom with parchment paper. Cut the pastry as thinly as possible. Lay phyllo cut side down on the lined pan. Repeat this step until all phyllo or pastry has been used. Chop the mushrooms then layer them in bottom of pan. Drain the stock from the mushrooms then place them into a pan. Bring the stock to a boil, over high heat, while stirring. Lower the heat slightly and simmer until the stock just reduces. Add the oyster sauce, chocolate pieces then set aside. After the cream has reduced, pour over the prepared phyllo. The pie is now ready to bake. If you run out of time, let it cool for ten minutes or so, then take a large sharp knife and cut the pie into squares. You can do this over the course of two to five minutes or so so, you don't want to make it too crispy. To get them to golden brown, line the square of bread with foil or butter, then put the pieces side by side in and cook for 3 or 4 minutes until golden on both sides. Sooo good,.

Random Ingredients: pasta shell,cherry tomato,bouillon cube,palm sugar,olive green,lemon juice,oyster sauce,white bean
title: Pasta Shell Toss
ingredients: 3 cups dry pasta shells | 1 large bouillon cube | 1 can small white beans, drained | 1 can chopped olives with green, drained | 20 cherry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon palm sugar, finely grated
instructions: Place the pasta shells in boiling water for five minutes, or until they are cooked. Drain and put into a large bowl. Add the bouillon cube and stir until dissolved. Stir in the white beans and olives. Mix the tomatoes through the mixture. Stir in the lemon juice, oyster sauce and sugar. Pour over the pasta to coat. Toss until mixture is well coated.

title: Kielbasa Focaccia
ingredients: 10 potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced ( about 3 pounds ) | 1 package kielbasa, sliced into 6 pieces | 1/2 cup prepared basil garlic basil pesto | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 bunch basil leaves, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the potatoes in a dutch oven coated with cooking spray. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium low and cook the potatoes until tender, turning occasionally, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the kielbasa in a skillet over medium high heat until browned on all sides, about 15 minutes. Drain. Spread the sliced kielbasa over the potatoes. Place the potatoes in a bowl, add enough basil pesto to the remaining pesto in the pan and mix well. Spoon over the kielbasa and sprinkle with more basil.

title: English Cucumber Salad, English Style
ingredients: 12 english cucumbers ( about 2 inches in diameter ) | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1/2 cup english cucumber, peeled, seeded and finely diced
instructions: Using vegetable peeler, peel cucumbers in very long strips and julienne. Place in bowl of a food processor and pulse to get large and coarsely chopped. Add remaining ingredients and pulse for about 5 seconds or until evenly combined. Serve at room temperature. Enjoy.

title: Low-Fat Cauliflower Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower florets | 2 baking potatoes, washed | 1 cup self rising flour | cornmeal, for dusting
instructions: Wash and boil the cauliflower for 2 mins drain and keep aside. Cut the potatoes into slices and soak well in water. Dry out the potatoes and keep aside. Mix the self rising flour and the cornmeal together. Toss everything together with a fork in a bowl. Make sure to coat the potatoes well with the batter. Dip the florets into the batter. Lightly dust the florets with flour and fry them on all sides till the florets are golden brown.

title: Grilled Zucchini Skewers
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, large | 1/2 cup pecan halves, toasted and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1/4 cup mirin ( dry cooking sherry ) | kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Thread about 2 slices onto a skewer, repeating with other slices. Toss lightly with pecan halves & set aside. For the marinade, combine molasses, vanilla, & 1/4 cup of the mirin in large shallow pan. Whisk in remaining mirin & season to taste with salt. Add zucchini & marinate for 10 minutes at room temperature or refrigerate up to 2 hours. Thread zucchini alternately with skewers. Place a sheet of foil large enough to enclose each skewer in a shallow dish. Press 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla essence over zucchini, then wrap tightly & place on foil covered dish. Refrigerate for 1 hour or up to 1 day. Place dish on an open grill & cook for 12 minutes, turning zucchini occasionally, until light brown ~ about 5 - 7 minutes. Place an 8' x 5' baking dish on the center rack of a grill & arrange skewers on the pan. Grill zucchini, turning, until charred and tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from grill & cool slightly. Place about one zucchini skewer on each serving plate & top with some of the warm marinade.

title: Mongo Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked white rice | 1 teaspoon pickle, finely chopped ( optional ) | 4 ounces halloumi cheese, finely sliced ( or a mix of the two ) | 1/2 cup mung beans ( optional ) | 1 cup mint leaf, fresh, coarsley chopped
instructions: Toss all the ingredients together and chill until required. This salad can be prepared the night before to give the flavors a chance to develop.

title: Cafe Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 6 cups marmalade | 2 cups cocoa powder wine or 2 cups balsamic vinegar | 500 g moroccan chocolate, melted | 1 tablespoon garlic | 1 tablespoon marmalade | 1 -2 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to instructions. Drain. Place 2 tbsp cocoa, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tbsp marmalade, sugar and 1 tbsp marmalade into a bowl with 1 cup boiling water. When warm, add sauce to noodles. Place 2 more noodles over sauce and coat with sauce. Bake in oven at 220°c for 10 minutes remove from oven and place top side down in baking tin. Top with last batch of sauce and bake for a further 10 minutes. This recipe is fairly dry depending on the amount of noodles used, but the amounts of wine and cocoa will have plenty. Leave to cool, and when cool, cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: beer,bacon dripping,vanilla sugar,lime zest,lukewarm water,oat,grain rice
title: Rice With Beer (Porir)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bacon drippings | 1 cup long grain rice, such as arborio | 1/2 cup lukewarm water | 1/2 cup low-sodium beer ( such as jack daniels ) or 1/2 cup guinness stout beer, like budweiser | 1/2 cup organic vanilla sugar or 1/2 cup raw sugar | 2 tablespoons rolled oats, slightly toasted | 1/2 lime, zest of, finely grated
instructions: Heat bacon drippings in a skillet over medium to medium heat. Add rice and saute 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until light golden. Add 2/3 cup water and beer and simmer until water is absorbed, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and sugar. Let mixture rest 5 minutes and set aside to cool. Fluff rice with a fork and transfer to a large bowl. Stir in vanilla and sugar mixture until well combined. Place remaining cup of water in a shallow bowl, preferably glass, and cover with a piece of cheesecloth. Tie a piece of cheesecloth at the knot in the center to hold liquid. Put the cheese cloth inside, and let it sit while the rice absorbs the liquid in the bowl. In a small cup, lightly stir the oats and lime zest until well mixed. Put rice aside until mixture is cold. Put rice in a bowl and pour liquid over.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,veggie crumbles,hard egg,pasta,swiss cheese,rice noodle,curd,cheddar cheese
title: Dee's Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 jar large pasta, uncooked | 12 slices swiss cheese | 12 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 3 cups vegetable crumbles ( cooked ) | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1 box dry pasta, such as ditalini
instructions: Cook and drain the large noodles as package directs, reserving 4 cups of the liquid. Drain the noodles completely in a colander set in the sink to retain the grease. Toss the noodles with swiss cheese slices, eggs, parsley, vegetable crumbles and 1 cup of the swiss cheese. Place the remaining 1 cup of swiss cheese in the center of the noodles. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the noodles until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Place the cooked pasta in individual shallow bowls and top with the cheesy mixture.

title: Spicy Banana Fritters
ingredients: 4 ripe bananas, thinly sliced lengthways | 1 large mango, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 pinch cayenne | 3 pieces white bread ( loaves )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/375f/gas cut each of the banana slices in quarters, place on baking paper, and bake for 6 - 6 minutes, until the skin browns. Remove from pan and leave to cool. Once the banana is cool, carefully peel off the skin. Halve or tear the bananas into very small pieces. Place them in a pan with the vanilla, cayenne, and half the bread and cover with water. Add half the coconut and bring to the boil. Simmer over a low heat for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Divide the mixture into 8 portions and mould into small balls the size of an orange or lemon. Repeat until all the banana pieces have been used. Place half the coconut over two pieces of baking paper. Dip the bananas into the warm syrup, then place in the paper cases. Place in the preheated oven and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, turning twice.

title: Chocolate Baskets
ingredients: 6 good quality bakestones cookies, such as keebler | 12 bakaro beets, trimmed | 1 red capsicum, trimmed and cored | 20 ladyfingers | 2 -3 tablespoons chocolate curls, or as desired
instructions: Cut each beets crosswise into 1/4 strips about 4 by 5 inches long and then into 1/4 strips about 1/3 by 5 inches wide. Stack the beet slices and cut into quarters about 1/2 thick. Set aside. Heat oven to 400°f. Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper. Arrange bakaro slices in baking sheets and lightly brush with a little water. Sprinkle strips of capsicum over slices and transfer to oven on top rack. Bake for 10 minutes, then flip and bake for an additional ten minutes. When beets are completely cool, transfer to a cutting board and slice diagonally into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet coated with cooking oil. Arrange strips of red capsicum over bread slices and top with slice of beet. Sprinkle liberally with chocolate curls. Bake for five minutes, or until chocolate is slightly darkened, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rump steak,veal,cocoa powder,semolina flour,chive,chicken breast,sirloin,italian tomato
title: Rump-Kangaroo
ingredients: 2 sirloin | 1/2 lb chuck steak | 1 tablespoon sesame molasses flour | 1/2 lb sirloin | 1 can italian tomatoes | 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup sifted semolina flour | 3/4 cup chopped chives | 2 tablespoons dried chives
instructions: Rinse meat and pat dry. Cut into 3/4 inch chunks. Cut into strips. Sprinkle lightly with salt and place in a medium bowl. Stir together sesame molasses and flour. Add tomatoes with liquid, cocoa powder and chopped chives. Stir together thoroughly and let marinate at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Preheat grill. Grill meat with onion and pepper on medium high heat, 8 - 10 minutes on each side. Serve over hot spaghetti. Variation, substitute beef and pork for sirloin. Cooking time will vary.

Random Ingredients: apple,lamb,lasagna noodle,corn tortilla strip,chicken broth,hoagie,self raising flour
title: Lamb and Apple Lasagne
ingredients: 400 g ground lamb | 2 tablespoons wholemeal self-raising flour | 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth | 400 g chopped apples | 1 bag lasagna noodles | 60 g corn tortillas or 60 g thickly sliced bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. In a large frying pan, cook ground lamb in a little olive oil until browned. Stir in the flour to coat and cook until well combined. Drain any excess fat from the pan with a slotted spoon. Add broth and bring to the boil, stirring continuously until slightly reduced. Remove from heat and stir in cooked lamb, apple and tortilla. Line a large roasting pan with a couple of layers of foil, approximately 4 and add enough hot water to the roasting pan, to come halfway up the base of the pan. Arrange 1/2 the lasagne pieces in a single layer over the water, then top with 1/2 the lamb mixture and then half the bread pieces. Repeat until all ingredients are used up. Place roasting pan in preheated oven and bake for 40 - 45 minutes. Check for doneness after about 10 minutes, adding more hot water if necessary. Remove from oven and drizzle with some of the pan liquid and sprinkle with more bread or serve with sour cream if you like.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,garlic infused olive oil
title: Yummy Garlic Oil Biscuits
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 bunch garlic infused olive oil
instructions: Take your baking paper and place it on the kitchen counter. Using a cup or small glass bowl, sieve the flour into the bowl. Add your garlic oil, mix together until the oil is dissolved. Then start adding your flour in a thin stream. Once you have a thin but sticky dough, add your flour again and mix all the way to it. If the dough is too sticky, add a little more flour. If too wet, add a little more flour. Take your hands and make sure they are holding together, and then flatten out onto the baking paper. Allow to sit for 10 - 15 minutes. Make sure all the air has been removed from the dough so that it can rest in the bowl on the counter if you have any dough left. If it has extra air, roll it out or shape your dough into ropes on the floured surface. Place on the baking tray with your fingers. Using a floured fork or a rolling pin, press the dough out until you get a circular shape approximately 5 in diameter. Take your garlic olive oil, brush it on your dough and roll each time to 1/4 thick. You can freeze them for later use. Bake in a preheated oven at 375f for 30 - 40 minutes. Remove from oven, and let cool and harden, then cut into fingers.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Best Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 cup distilled black vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | ground cinnamon, to taste
instructions: Place the vinegar and black pepper in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir, and cook, stirring frequently, until the vinegar is reduced to a nice syrup consistency, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove the saucepan from the heat, and set aside. Light the grill. Place the hot dogs on the grill. Grill, turning once, until the hot dogs are medium hot, 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cinnamon to serve.

Random Ingredients: tandoori paste,white bean,cocoa,phyllo dough,meat,kidney bean,filling,yellow bell pepper
title: Tandoori Filling for Veggies in Phyllo
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat, mixed ( any leftover meat will do ) | 2 cups cooked white beans | 2 yellow bell peppers ( chopped fine ) | 1 tablespoon tandoori paste | 1/4 cup canned kidney beans ( mashed ) | 1 package phyllo dough ( frozen or thawed ) | filling ( optional ) | unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Cook the meat and drain. Add the beans and pepper and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes. Add the tando to the meat with the kidney and simmer until you’re halfway done cooking. If using thawed phyllo sheets bring a large pot of water to the boil. Trim the edges of the sheets to make them like a jelly roll. Use a cookie cutter to cut out 10 - 12 squares. In a bowl place about ½ cup of the meat and bean mixture and a sprinkle of flour mixed with corn or black pepper. Spray a 9x13 inch pan with cooking spray and spoon a small amount of meat mixture in the middle of the phyllo square. Top with a few more squares and cover that with a sheet of pastry, trimming the pastry so you don’t end up with a pastry square. Cut these sheets in two, layering the two squares and filling in the center, and roll them tightly. When you run out of filling the sheets should be stretched about 1 inch wide. I like to put a fork through the pastry and it stops the pastry sliding off. Using a fork in the middle of the pastry for the second step and pull the pastry into the pan. Repeat with the last 3 sheets of phyllo and filling. Put in the fridge until all your phyllo is gone, you’ll want to bake it at 375 for about 25 minutes or so, until the top is golden.

title: Mint & Lemon-Hint Pesto
ingredients: 2 quarts mint, coarsely chopped | 3 lemons, juice and zest of, grated or 1/2 cup zest
instructions: Using a food processor, process the remaining ingredients until smooth. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,blueberry,five spice powder,fig,wonton wrapper,graham cracker crumb
title: Five-Spice Figs With Graham Crumbs
ingredients: 1 lb dried figs | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 4 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 24 wonton wrappers ( or you may use plain wonton wrappers ) | 1 cup blueberries
instructions: Wash the figs and place them in a microwave safe bowl. Pour boiling water over them and cook on high for 20 minutes, or until they are soft, stirring occasionally. In a large bowl, mix together the sugar, cracker crumbs, and five spice powder. Use a pastry brush to grease a baking sheet. On the prepared baking sheet, lay out 1 won ton wrapper and add about 30 figs, about 1 heaping tablespoon of the sugar mixture, and 1 tablespoon of chewy graham cracker crumbs. With an index finger, press each fig to create a crescent shape from the filling. Use the back of the fork to firmly press the edges to seal. Repeat with the remaining wrappers. Lay the triangles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush the tops with the egg wash. Bake at 375°f for 15 to 25 minutes or until they are crisp, browned, and cooked through. If you want to make the fortune baggies, fill about 5 or 6 blueberries with the cooled figs, and freeze the cookies to use later. You can also use a cookie/sugar cookie to make the fortune baggies, simply cut the circle of cookies into half or quarters and bake in the oven as directed.

title: Irish Black Olive Salad
ingredients: 2 leaves iceberg lettuce, washed | 4 tablespoons irish cream | 2 tablespoons black olives, finely cut | 1/3 cup chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Gently put the lettuce leaves together with the irish cream, then scatter over the black olives and the thyme. Serve immediately.

title: Arancini (Italian Risotto)
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 1/2 pounds round steak, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Place the arborio rice, jasmine rice, and beef into the slow cooker. Pour enough water into the cooker to cover the rice. Cover.

title: Orange Glazed Banana Peppers
ingredients: 3 medium sized banana, cut in half lengthwise | 3 medium sized sweet potatoes, cut into 1/4-inch chunks | 1 tablespoon finely grated orange zest | 1/2 cup green olives, chopped | 3/4 teaspoon ground galangal
instructions: Cook potatoes in a large pot of boiling water until tender, about 9 minutes. Drain and then let cool slightly. Remove 1 cup peels of the bananas while warm. Using the back of a fork, mash half of the bananas and potato pulp thoroughly. Stir the mashed mixture into the cooled mashed potatoes with orange zest, olives and chopped galangal, and season to taste.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper seasoning,panko breadcrumb,chicken stock,anaheim chilies,taco seasoning
title: Easy Chiles
ingredients: 3 -4 fresh anaheim chilies, roasted, seeded, and sliced thin | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the chiles on a foil lined baking sheet. Drizzle with a little olive oil and sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, paprika, sugar, cayenne pepper, or your favorite spices. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top and bake 15 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,maraschino cherry,tomato green chile pepper,green curry paste,molasses,baking potato,olive
title: Malaysian Chilli Muffins
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, mashed | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chile peppers | 1/4 cup ripe sliced ripe olives | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons reduced-sodium tomato curry paste | 1 teaspoon molasses | 2 tablespoons finely chopped red chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Line a 12 cup muffin tin with paper liners. In a large bowl, mix together the mashed potatoes, diced tomatoes, green chile peppers, olives, cherries, tomato curry paste, molasses and red chilies. Spoon the mixture into the prepared muffin tin. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, until the center of the muffin starts to jiggle. Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then gently remove from the tin. Cool completely on a wire rack before storing in an airtight container.

title: Fried Jalapeno Pasta or Rotini W- Beans & Caramelized Garlic
ingredients: 1 package tri-colored rotini pasta, cooked al dente | 1 small jalapeno pepper ( optional ) | 1 package caram masala powder ( i used light )
instructions: Using an 8 inch frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat. When hot, carefully add 1/2 cup of hot water. Stir in uncooked rotini and jalapeno. Add 1/2 cup of warm water, if necessary. Toss to coat well, heat 1 minute. Stir in 1/2 teaspoon garam masala. Note, don't let it stick.

Random Ingredients: caper,chicken broth,black bean,cilantro leaf,icing sugar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,lasagna noodle
title: Black Beans & Pasta With Caper Chiffonade
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, about 2 handfuls | 4 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth | 2 lbs black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup icing sugar ( superfine ) | 8 sheets lasagna noodles | 1/4 cup capers, drained of any liquid | shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese, for serving
instructions: Combine cilantro and 2 cups of the broth in a blender and blend to a consistency similar to your desired texture. Bring broth to a boil with black beans. Add another 1/4 cup broth to aid in blending and cook black beans until al dente. Season with sea salt. Preheat oven to spread a thin layer of icing sugar on the bottom of a 13x9x2 baking dish. Bring a large pot of water to boil and add noodles. Cook for 10 minutes, just until soft but not mushy. Drain and rinse. Spread about 2/3 of the bean mixture evenly over the noodles in the baking dish. Spread about an even amount of the bean mixture over this. Add another layer, a third of noodles and a fourth of the remaining bean mixture. Repeat layers 3 to 4 times, ending with final layer of noodles. Sprinkle the top with more icing sugar and sprinkle with capers. Bake until top is golden, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,pineapple tidbit,chicken wing,pineapple juice
title: Sun Dried Tomato Chicken
ingredients: 16 chicken wings | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1/2 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Coat a large skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. Add chicken and cook, about 5 minutes per side. Add the pineapple chunks and simmer 2 minutes. Add the sun dried tomatoes and cook for 2 more minutes. Remove the chicken to a plate and set aside. Add the orange juice to the skillet and bring to a boil, scraping up the browned bits from the skillet. Return the cooked chicken and the pineapple to the skillet. Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer, about 20 minutes. Serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,beef bouillon cube,anchovy,cream chicken soup,red bliss potato,rosemary,lemon juice
title: Creamy Beef Potato Romanoff
ingredients: 3 large red bliss potatoes ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed orange juice | 1 beef bouillon cube, with 3 tbsp of meat juices | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 1 anchovy ( optional )
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut each potato in half crosswise. Place cut sides down in casserole dish, fat side up. Sprinkle with salt. Scatter with half can of soup, rosemary, orange juice and meat juice. Dissolve bouillon cube with 3 tablespoon of broth and stir into potato mixture. Cover pan with lid and bake 1/2 hour at 350 degrees. Cover pan with foil and continue baking for 25 minutes. Remove foil and serve.

title: Lebanese White Beans (Frittsur Ramen)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh white beans, cleaned and rinsed | 4 lbs pork loin, cut into about 1-inch sticks | 3 cups freshly chopped lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons saffron threads | 1/4 cup chopped nuts, for garnishing ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon saffron thread | powdered confectioners'sugar ( optional )
instructions: Cook beans in water to cover and cook for about 4 - 5 minutes. Drain, let cool and reserve the liquid. Place in a heavy skillet and add pork slices. Brown lightly over medium heat, not crowding the pan. Remove pork and set aside. To the skillet add 3 cups reserved bean liquid, reserved bean liquid and saffron and cook, stirring constantly, over medium high heat for about 10 minutes. Add lettuce leaves, 3/4 cup saffron infused bean liquid. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer at least 30 minutes or until the pork is tender. To serve, cut pork into about 1 inch cubes. Add to bean mixture and toss well. Serve in soup bowls sprinkling with nuts if serving as an appetizer.

title: Sage and Garlic Sorbet
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh sage leaves | 2 garlic cloves, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup sour cream, or more to taste | 12 tablespoons ice, or more as needed
instructions: Place a sage leaf in a mortar with the garlic, sour cream, and ice until the pieces are thoroughly mixed.

Random Ingredients: bulk chorizo sausage,cumin,spice,sharp cheddar cheese,farfalle pasta,romano cheese
title: Spicy Chorizo and Grits
ingredients: 8 ounces bulk chorizo sausage | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 1/2 cups romano cheese | 1/4 cup mixed spice | 1 box farfalle pasta, cooked ( bowtie ) | 1 1/2 lbs romano cheese, shredded
instructions: In frypan, cook chorizo in 1 teaspoon cumin over med. Heat until done. Turn off heat. Mix chorizo mixture with bowl of cooked bowtie pasta except for romano cheese. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Pour mixture into greased 9x13 pan. Combine other 1/2 cup of cheddar, 3/4 cup of romano and mixed spice. Spoon into pasta mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Salsa and Pimiento Skewers
ingredients: 4 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 6 tablespoons sour cream or 6 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 small jar medium salsa ( i use muir glen ) | 1 tablespoon minced gingar root ( about 3 inches, or you can use 2 jalapeno peppers )
instructions: Soak 8 bamboo skewers in cold water until slightly softened. Combine all ingredients, except for the salsa and skewers, in a large bowl and mix. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Preheat grill. Thread 2 skewers on each skewer and cook over high heat 10 minutes, or until desired doneness basting with the salsa as needed.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,mint leaf,corn kernel,lemon,cardamom seed
title: Indian Corn With Lemons, Chilli and Cardamom Seeds
ingredients: 1 large lemon | 2 3/4 cups corn kernels or 2 3/4 cups fresh corn kernels, cleaned, drained & cooked | 3/4 cup dried red chili pepper | 2 -3 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1/4 cup freshly fresh mint leaves, washed
instructions: Using a sharp knife with the peel on, cut away the skin from the lemon and cut away the pith from the white pith. Halve the lemon down the centre, then cut it into halves. Squeeze the juice of half the lemon. Place peel in a small heavy based pan and cook gently over medium heat, stirring frequently, until pulpy. Remove pan from heat & stir in the corn kernels through the lemon peel. Spread the mixture evenly on a cookie sheet, sprinkle with chili flakes. Let stand while making the minty sauce. To make the minty sauce, combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until the mixture almost boils. Stir often, to ensure that it does not burn. Reduce heat to low & simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for about an hour to infuse the flavors. If sauce becomes too thick, stir in more corn liquid until the consistency is the desired consistency. Or, heat the mixture over slow heat, stirring constantly, for about 15 minutes, or until the mixture becomes fragrant. Remove from heat. Stir in the mint leaves.

title: Easy Delicious Baked Vegetarian Lasagna
ingredients: 12 white dinner sized dinner sized dinner sized dinner sized fresh lasagna noodles | 3 packets kitchen kraft 2 % fat cottage cheese | 3 tablespoons a.1. original sauce or 3 tablespoons other your favorite hot sauce | 1 cup peas, frozen or cooked | 1 cup bisquick baking mix, blend
instructions: Bake lasagna noodles according to package directions. After lasagna noodles have cooked, spray with olive oil cooking spray, and spread with cottage cheese. After noodles have baked for about 20 - 30 minutes, stir every 5 minutes to break noodles up, and stir in 1/2 the hot sauce per packet directions, and then dump on your frozen peas. After 20 - 30 minutes, stir every 5 - 8 minutes and spoon on the rest of your prepared hot sauce. Stir every 5 - 8 minutes so all is evenly spread. Place in oven and bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes, stirring every 5 - 8 minutes. Take from oven, and let sit for 5 minutes. If you enjoy your hot sauce on the side, just drain some and place back on the stove to get hot. Serve.

title: Simple, Quick and Easy Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 can italian plum tomatoes, drained | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 tablespoon taco, taco seasoning ( for a milder sauce, we use zatarains') | 1 pear ( optional )
instructions: Combine the tomatoes and next 3 ingredients in a bowl and mix well. To make the patties, preheat oven to 425°f. Spread about ½ cup of the tomato mixture on the inside of a large saute pan. Cut pear into thin wedges, place on top. Add patties to sauce, and bake until bubbly, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,cardamom,sauerkraut,russet potato,confectioner ' sugar,blackstrap molasses,rice noodle,mandarin orange
title: Indian Sauerkraut Risser
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes | 1 can sauerkraut, drained, but juices reserved | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 cup fresh blackstrap molasses | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | cooked rice noodles
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender. Cool completely. Peel and cut in wedges. Rinse sauerkraut under cold water until water runs clear. Pat dry. In a large frying pan, combine sauerkraut, 2 tablespoon soaking liquid, sugar, molasses, sugar, cardamom and cardamom. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, 3 to 4 minutes. Add graham cracker crumbs and cool to room temperature. In a large bowl, combine potato mixture and sauerkraut. Sprinkle top of mixture with remaining crumbs, if using. Cover and chill 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Uncover and bake in preheated oven 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned.

title: Tamarind Fish Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless and skinless tamarind fillets, cubed | 2 cans unsweetened coconut milk | 2 tablespoons hot pepper, crushed | tamarind paste
instructions: Heat coconut milk and jalepeno in saucepan over medium heat.

title: Pasta with Spicy Cheese and Chili
ingredients: 2 habaneros | 16 ounces soymilk | 4 ounces cotija cheese, cubed | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh cilantro stems | 6 ounces farfalle ( bowtie ) pasta ( bow tie )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place the habansi peppers on a broiler pan. Place them under the broiler, and roast for 10 - 12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the skins blister and blacken. Turn off the heat, and transfer the peppers to a bowl of cold water to cool. When cool enough to handle, remove the skin and seeds, and cut them into thin strips. Bring the soy milk in a large skillet to a simmer, and stir in the chives. Sprinkle in the chives, and remove from the heat. Place the cilantro, drained peppers, farfalle and pasta in a large serving bowl. Pour soy milk over the pasta, mixing to combine. Season with salt and pepper. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Crunchy Rice Krispies
ingredients: 1 cup rice krispies ( i use nut roll breakfast krispies ) | 1 cup flour ( i use all purpose )
instructions: Stir together 1 cup of the rice krispies with the flour. Pat into buttered 9 x 13 inch pan. Top with the rest of the rice krispies. Bake in 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,coconut,penne pasta,turmeric powder,red potato,sage,peanut oil
title: Coconut-Smoked Turkey Pot Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 4 red potatoes, chopped into chunks | 8 -12 red potatoes, chopped into chunks | 2/3 cup unsweetened flaked coconut, roughly chopped | 1/3 - 1/3 cup light unsweetened chocolate syrup ( or to taste ) | 1/3 teaspoon turmeric powder ( or to taste ) | 3 -4 teaspoons rubbed sage, and extra (, to taste ) | 12 ounces penne pasta, cooked al dente. such as barilla's
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the potatoes and toss well until they are lightly colored, about 8 - 10 minutes. Add the coconut and stir well. Add the chocolate syrup and turmeric, mixing well until the chocolate has melted and is well combined with the potatoes. Add the sage and mix well. Add the pasta and mix well. Add the dressing just prior to serving and mix well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,dark red kidney bean,mozzarella cheese
title: Italian Kidney Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 3 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the kidney beans, mozzarella cheese, and orange juice concentrate. Transfer to a serving bowl and refrigerate until chilled, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,chocolate baking square,horseradish,active yeast,canola oil,italian breadcrumb,rice vinegar
title: Easy Pineapple Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil | 4 tablespoons fresh pineapple juice | 2 2 lbs italian breadcrumbs or 2 lbs breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons horseradish | 1 packet active dry yeast or 1 packet fast-rising dry yeast | 1/4 cup rice vinegar or 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup canola oil or 1/2 cup dark corn syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Oil a loaf pan. In a medium bowl, combine all crust ingredients. Combine all breadcrumbs and horseradish. Dip the breadcrumb mixture into the warm pineapple juice. Layer the breadcrumb mixture in the loaf pan. Cover with oil. Place in oven. Check after 35 minutes and add a little more cooking liquid. Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Currant and Chocolate Stuffed Wild Rice
ingredients: 4 cups wild rice, cooked and cooled | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons currants | 1/4 cup dried currant | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 1/2 cups unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1 1/2 teaspoons allspice
instructions: Heat oil in saucepot over medium heat for 1 minute. Add currants and cook until plump, about 5 minutes. Stir in rice and season with black pepper. Remove from heat. While rice is cooking, combine cocoa, peanuts, and allspice in a small bowl, and grind to a paste with a mortar and pestle or spice grinder. Stir into rice in saucepot. Pour rice mixture into a casserole dish and refrigerate until cool, about 1 hour. Serve with a sprinkling of cocoa crumbles on top.

title: Mexican Bread (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 cake yeast | 1 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 cup cilantro, coarsely chopped | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Dump all ingredients into baking pan and select white bread setting, press start. When bread is almost done, preheat oven to 350°f. Turn bread out onto lightly floured board and knead until smooth and elastic. Place dough in a greased bowl, cover and let rest in a warm place until doubled in size. Punch down dough. Form into a 15 inch round. Brush top with vegetable oil and sprinkle top with chopped nuts. Place in oven and bake for 35 - 40 minutes. Serve warm. Note, the nuts make a delicious topping, as a nutty or cuminseed mixture.

title: Kittencal's Yukon Gold (Gluten Free) Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes | 1 lb yerrikye's light yellow potato ( unpeeled, quartered )
instructions: Slice potatoes in half and place in water to cover. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce to low and simmer 15 minutes until almost tender. Drain, and mash with a potato masher until creamy. Cover and refrigerate until cold, at least 8 hours or overnight, to allow flavors to blend. The longer you let the potatoes sit at room temperature, the starchier they will be. Add a little bit of broth or water if they stick..

title: Artichoke-Fontina Toast
ingredients: 2 slices thick-cut french bread ( i prefer baguette ) | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 artichoke hearts, thinly sliced | 1/4 lb thin-sliced fontina cheese | 12 slices thinly-sliced prosciutto, from a jar, cut crosswise into sixths
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Spread the mustard seeds on both sides of the bread slices. Place the artichokes on 2 slices of the bread. Cover evenly with fontina cheese. Place a slice of prosciutto over the cheese and prosciutto. Broil until the cheese melts, 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,french baguette,cumin powder,spaghetti sauce,poppy seed,spice,pickle relish
title: Low Fat Spiced French Bread
ingredients: 8 -12 slices french baguettes | spaghetti sauce or other sweet pickle relish, to mix | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar or 2 tablespoons honey, brown sugar packed | 1 tablespoon pickle relish | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | spices
instructions: Place bread slices on cookie sheet and brush with a little soy sauce/soy sauce. Bake at 350 degrees for 5 - 10 minutes until golden brown. Meanwhile, melt poppyseeds in a dry skillet. Mix in brown sugar with the syrup ingredients. Dip sliced bread in the syrup mixture and serve.

title: Straw Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white sesame seeds | 4 ounces maraschino cherries, drained and juice reserved | 12 large straw mushrooms
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small saucepan, toast the sesame seeds over medium low heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until light golden. Remove from heat, and set aside until cool enough to handle. Place the drained cherries in a small bowl. Sprinkle with the sesame seeds, and rub gently into the mushrooms. The mushrooms may be placed under a hot grill to sizzle, if desired, and removed when soft, about 3 minutes per side. Remove mushrooms from the grill, and set aside until cool enough to handle, about 2 minutes. Peel the dried off stems, and coarsely chop. Stir the cherries and their juice into the sesame seed mixture, and season to taste with salt. Let sit until cool. Use as a garnish for rice, soup, or other dishes.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,red pepper flake,kosher salt,flour tortilla
title: Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin steaks, cut into 1 inch strips | 1 cup sweet red pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons all purpose flour | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | kosher salt, for sprinkling
instructions: Put the steak strips into a mixing bowl with a cup of water, the red pepper flakes, flour, and the sugar. Stir, cover, and refrigerate at least one hour. Preheat your grill to medium. Remove the strips from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels. Coat the steak with a thin layer of oil. Cook the steak on the preheated grill for about 5 minutes, brushing with more oil as necessary to sear. Turn and cook an additional 5 minutes on the second side. Remove from the grill, and sprinkle with salt. Add more oil as needed to keep the steak moist while cooking.

title: Capellini Alla Campagnola
ingredients: 500 g ricotta cheese | 300 g pancetta
instructions: Slice the pancetta into thin slices. Pour a little oil into the bottom of your fry pan or fry pan. Fry pancetta until crisp and then set aside. In a large bowl mix ricotta cheese and pancetta, saving some in the bottom when finished. Add the bacon to ricotta mix and fry until crispy and the fat has cooked into a bit of grease. Pour into a warm serving bowl and serve with sliced french bread.

Random Ingredients: red onion,chinese cabbage,cream tartar,kaffir lime leaf,plum jam
title: Vietnamese Red Onion Cabbage
ingredients: 4 plums ( or 1/2 lb if desired-cut in half ) | 3 -4 cabbage ( about 1 cup each ) | 3 red onions, chopped | 1 bunch thai cabbage | 2 -4 kaffir lime leaves, cut in 2-inch lengths
instructions: Dice the cabbage into about 1 inch squares. I can cut the leaves into 1 inch squares.

title: Rice With Spiced Basmati Rice
ingredients: 2 ounces fresh buttermilk | 1 ounce basmati rice | 3 ounces mixed spice, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/spice-mix-with-white-rice-and-spice-mix-with-white-rice-and-spice-from-pancake-or-531739 '' > white rice & spice with white wine and spice from st. james < /a >. < /a > | 2 ounces white rice, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/spice-mix/white-rice-and-spice-mix-with-white-rice-and-spice-from-scratch-531739 ( optional )
instructions: Pour the buttermilk into a shallow pan and bring to a boil. Add the dry rice and return to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, until all liquid has been absorbed. Add the mixed spice mix from step # and stir until the rice is cooked and sticky. Serve warm.

title: Spicy Cashew Guacamole With Blueberry and Peaches
ingredients: 2 -4 large fresh sage leaves | 1 cup fresh peach, diced into 1/2 inch dice ( or frozen, cut in half ) | 1 cup fresh blueberries or 1 cup frozen blueberries | 1 cup guacamole, to your liking ( we prefer hass avocado ) | 2 -3 tablespoons picante sauce ( to your liking ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1/2 cup cashews, toasted until just slightly browned
instructions: Toss all the ingredients together in a bowl, except for the cashews sprinkle them on top. Mix everything together. Serve immediately or refrigerate for better flavor.

title: Soup Base (From Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 cup dried grated coconut | 4 beef bouillon cubes | 1 can condensed sweetened condensed milk, undiluted
instructions: Place the coconut in the blender and process until the coconut is finely ground. Transfer to a large bowl and set aside. Dissolve the beef bouillon into the condensed milk in the blender until well mixed. Stir the mixture into the coconut in the blender, cover and blend well until smooth. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Pour the contents of the blender into the pot and gently boil until thickened for about 20 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir the contents of the blender into the soup base.

title: Greek Feta Chicken Breast
ingredients: 500 g feta cheese, small cubes ( roughly 1.5oz, or more, depending how feta you like ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 500 g pork, skinned and diced
instructions: You need 1 pint of chicken stock cubes made from 5/6 cups of water in a saucepan or large bowl with lid slightly ajar to combine. Pour the stock cubes into the bowl, add the pork and cubed feta, and leave to soak in for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Then, place the feta cubes inside and just stir them in to combine. Continue to leave for about another 30 minutes. Note, the longer it stays in there, the more the feta becomes crispy the crumbly chicken breast will taste delicious.

title: Mexican Fried Green Beans
ingredients: 6 cups fresh green beans, washed thoroughly | 6 tablespoons butter flavored shortening | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning, divided
instructions: Remove and discard strings and tips from beans. Cut off tough ends with a sharp knife. Cut beans by cutting in half lengthwise. Dice 2 tablespoons of butter shortening. Spread mixture on each shell of the beans, leaving about 1/2 inch between each shell.

title: Chinese Five-Spice Powder for Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar. Seal tightly and shake well to combine. Shake well again to mix contents. Will keep in fridge for up to 2 weeks.

title: Mexican Green Grape and Tomatillo Salsa Fresca
ingredients: 1 jar tomatillo salsa ( i prefer mild but you want to use the medium and not the hot ) | 1 bag red grapes
instructions: Rinse and drain grape. Combine with other ingredients and serve. I like it the way i like it.

title: Wild Rice With Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cremini mushroom ( wild or other mild green ) | 1 tablespoon rose water | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons ranch dressing ( or other brand )
instructions: In a 2 1/2 3 quart microwave safe casserole dish, layer mushrooms, rose water, chicken bouillon, and ranch dressing. Cover and microwave on high 5 minutes, stirring halfway through cooking time. Stir.

Random Ingredients: curly leaf parsley,banana,chile powder,kielbasa,tomatillo,zucchini,elbow macaroni,parsley leaf
title: Mexican Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 large tomatillos, husked | 1 zucchini, diced | 1 lb kale, cooked and chopped | 1 can sliced jalapenos or ( 1 ounce ) can chile peppers, drained and chopped | 1 cup curly leaf parsley leaves, loosely packed | 2 bananas, sliced | 1 teaspoon chili powder | parsley leaves
instructions: Cut stems off tomatillos. Wash and drain the zucchini and kale. Core and dice the tomatoes. Slice the chilies. Layer in a salad bowl the tomatillos, zucchini, kale, chilies, parsley leaves and bananas. Sprinkle with chili powder. Sprinkle with parsley. Cover and chill in the refridgerator at least 6 hours, overnight is best.

title: Prawns With Mushrooms and Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 200 g large shrimp, shelled and deveined | 200 g button mushrooms, caps trimmed, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon veal, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat a very large nonstick frying pan over high heat. Add shrimps and mushrooms to pan and cook, turning occasionally, for 5 minutes or until pink, stirring often. Add sun dried tomatoes and chopped veal and stir for a further minute. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,lettuce,self raising flour,cod,anise seed,bread,plum,creole seasoning
title: Italian Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 -2 teaspoon anise seed | 300 -400 ml corn syrup | 3 tablespoons golden brown light corn syrup | crisoles or bread, etc. | cod or chicken, etc. etc. | lettuce, etc.
instructions: Mix together dry ingredients in a bowl with creole and light corn syrup. Mix well. Add corn syrup gradually until your dough is able to handle. Knead lightly on lightly floured board. Roll dough between your palms to about a 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into 3 inch squares or rounds with cookie cutter or biscuit cutter. Spread each with a tsp or so of corn syrup. Place an x on top of each. Gently press together. Bake on ungreased baking sheet in preheated 400 degrees f oven for about 20 minutes.

title: Bengali Sweet-Sour Moroccan Fish
ingredients: 200 g black cardamom pods, cracked | 10 dried ladyfingers, chopped | 180 g salmon fillets, cut into 6 or 8 pieces | 100 g coriander leaves, washed
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c and mix the black pepper and the ladyfingers together in one bowl. Lay the salmon pieces on the pepper soaked ladyfingers and gently sprinkle the coriander leaves over. Scatter over the chopped herbs in the other bowl. Put oven on. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes until crispy and well cooked.

title: Yogurt Cheese
ingredients: 3 cups yogurt ( thick or greek ) | 12 maraschino cherries | sesame seeds ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees fahrenheit. Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Mix the curds, cherries and sesame seeds together. Transfer to the baking dish. Sprinkle on toasted sesame seeds or top with other desired garnishes.

title: French Fried Celery
ingredients: 2 celery ribs ( including some leaves ) | 3 teaspoons fine salt | 1 head lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: Make sure the celery leaves are separated, keeping any leaves connected with strings on them. In a dry non stick frying pan, heat the oil until a deep, dark haze forms over the surface by adding about 10 to 15 drops of oil.. This will produce 2 or 3 drops when you take the frying pan out of the pan. When the oil is hot, carefully place the celery leaves into the hot oil. Turn them over and cook until they turn bright green and have begun to soften, about 3 to 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the celery to a plate lined with paper towel. With a slotted spoon, remove both the celery leaves to paper towels and sprinkle them lightly with salt. Allow the celery to drain in the oil a minute or so, tossing them as they are done. Pour the celery immediately into the skillet, shaking it to get all the celery inside its leaves. Cook the celery over medium heat, shaking the pan several times, until a dark crust of even golden brown flecks appear on it and the celery has softened and turned bright green and creamy. Transfer the celery to a serving platter and serve at once.

title: Cheesy Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup chopped mango chutney | 1 tablespoon pesto-pernod | 1/8 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: In a small bowl combine the orange juice and pesto pernod. Stir in mango chutney, cheese, and coconut extract until well mixed. Pour into a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle top with mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350 for about 25 minutes or until top is golden brown.

title: Indian Spiced Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole cumin seeds | 1/4 cup cumin seeds | 1/2 cup fresh ginger root, peeled and grated | 1 pound cauliflower florets
instructions: Grind cumin and cumin seeds in grinder. Combine cumin and cumin seeds in a skillet over medium heat.

title: Spritsaracha (Indian Cheese Ball)
ingredients: 2 heads iceberg lettuce, washed and trimmed | sea salt
instructions: Clean, trim and wash lettuce thoroughly. Dredge lettuce in salt. Place lettuce on a board sprinkled over with sea salt. Flatten a little bit of the mix with your hands so that there are no air bubbles and the cheese sticks completely on top of the lettuce. Pick up handfuls or roll and toss them back and forth a few seconds after they have been rolled. Slice into desired number of desired size and enjoy.

title: Perfect Spanish Rice (Crock Pot or Not)
ingredients: 14 ounces white onions, minced | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 1 ounce basmati rice, soaked in water, drained | 3 ounces chicken bouillon
instructions: Use your crock pot rice to cook all the ingredients together. Stir them until the rice is cooked and they are all mixed thoroughly. Serve.

title: Tabbouleh I
ingredients: 1/2 lb brown lentils | 1 teaspoon of chopped chili oil ( hulgah ) | 1 green onion
instructions: Wash lentils. Drain and rinse well. Place in a colander over a bowl, cover and let drain for 1 hour. Place the chili oil and green onions on to the lentils. Gently toss the contents of the bowl and let drain off liquid. Pour over the mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato chilies,chili pepper,green curry paste,orange zest,avocado,soba noodle,cachaca,pecan
title: Kikko's Noodles With Soba Nests
ingredients: 1 package cappellini or ( 16 ounce ) package spaghetti noodles | 8 ounces cholula brand sazon goya with goya ( one brand with green chilies ) | 3 -4 tablespoons green curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon orange zest, minced | 1 can diced tomatoes with chilies, undrained | 1 avocado, sliced | 1/2 cup toasted chopped pecans | 1 tablespoon sweet chili pepper, chopped ( or to taste )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain.
