ingredients: 2 lbs cooked spaghetti or 2 lbs spaghetti, uncooked | 5 cups watercress | 1 head red chili pepper, roasted and minced ( or other hot pepper, if you like ) | 1 cup dried crushed nuts | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1 teaspoon marjoram or 1 teaspoon marjoram leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon or 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente, rinse, and drain. Toss with the watercress, chillies, roasted nuts and peanut butter. Stir remaining ingredients and add to spaghetti mixture mix well. Chill at least 1 hour before serving or serve cold.

title: Mexican Yams
ingredients: 1 lb yam | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Peel and chop yam into chunks. Saute in oil in large saucepan for about 5 minutes, or until tender. Add sugar and raisins and tomato juice and cook for about 5 minutes. Add salt.

title: Italian Sausages and Fritters
ingredients: 2 teaspoons potato flakes | 2 teaspoons walnut oil | 1 lb sweet italian sausage
instructions: Heat nonstick frypan, add oil and sausage. Turn when brown. Drain on paper towel. Let cool. Slice into 8 slices. Serve.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,fennel seed,beef bouillon cube,egg substitute,stewing beef,tart apple
title: Sting-Oven French Canadian Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef, cubed | 1 egg substitute, beaten | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds, crushed | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 large tart apple, peeled, cored, sliced thin | 1/4 teaspoon ground fennel seed
instructions: Combine beef, egg substitute, vinegar, fennel and bouillon cubes. Combine apple, 1 1/4 cup water and 1/4 teaspoon of sesame seeds. Place on bottom rack of broiler pan. Place apple layer over beef. Pour 1/2 cup water mixture over apples. Place 1/2 teaspoon of sesame seeds on top. Bake at 450° f for 50 minutes, uncovered.

title: Easy Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1 package sliced pepperoni | 2 packages frozen cooked shrimp | 1 can or bottle cranberry juice
instructions: Cut the rind off of the pepperoni. Place into a medium size glass jar with the shrimp. Pour a generous handful of cranberry juice around the shrimp. Close tightly and refrigerate for at least one week, but not more than a week. Shake the jar often and allow all ingredients to get throughly coated. This is even better the next day.

title: Black & Tan Buffalo
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon corn oil | 3/4 cup light beer | 1/4 cup triple sec liqueur, like domaine anejo | 1/8 teaspoon cocoa | 1 1/2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Combine all ingredients, in a bowl and whisk to blend. Store in a glass container with a cover.

title: Ajiaco (Chipotle and Pepper Adobo Rub)
ingredients: 6 whole chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped | 6 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a food processor fitted with the metal blade, process chiles until coarsely ground, about 20 seconds. Transfer to a large plate. Finely grind the chiles in the food processor with the thyme until the mixture forms a coarse paste, about 5 pulses. Mix in adobo seasoning. Using the sharpest knife on your processor, chop the adobo until no coarse particles remain. Add to the oiled baking sheet and spread, about 1/2 inch thick, as evenly as possible. Cover with wax paper by at least 1 inch and refrigerate until cold. Preheat the broiler. When ready to use, spread or rub on the hot rack above the grill. Broil for about 5 minutes, just until surface starts to turn slightly crisp and edges are lightly colored. Transfer to a towel and set aside for at least 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Salsa Lasagna for a King
ingredients: 9 lasagna sheets | salsa ( i like pace brand ) | basil leaves, garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In bowl combine a medium sized saucepan with water. Bring to boil and then reduce heat and simmer to blend flavors, approximately 8 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cut the lasagna sheets in half lengthwise. Remove excess liquid from heated saucepan. Place a single layer of meaty lasagna sheet in a lightly greased baking dish, overlapping each other slightly but not cutting all the way to the edges. Cover lasagna layer with meaty lasagna sheets and cover with sauce. Cover the lasagna with some salsa. Cover with a clean dish towel and bake for about 35 - 40 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted and lightly browned on top. Remove foil and sprinkle with basil leaves. Serve with sour cream and/or sliced green onions.

title: Curry Potatoes and Meat Balls
ingredients: 500 g finely minced meat | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon potato starch or 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 -3 tablespoons apple juice or 2 -3 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into 1 inch balls. Heat oil in a large pan and cook around 6 - 7 minutes until nicely browned.

title: Taco Wraps
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 1/2 flour tortillas
instructions: Prepare taco seasoning according to package directions. Spread the taco seasoning over one side of each tortilla to within 1 inch of the edge. Fold tortillas in half and place them side by side on a platter. Serve with salsa and fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: flax seed,deli roast beef,serrano pepper,chicken wing
title: Crispy Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh chicken wings or 2 lbs frozen wings | 2 -3 tablespoons dried flax seeds | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon fresh serrano pepper | 1/3 cup fat free roasted deli roasted deli roasted beef
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment. Rinse the wings under running water until thawed. Trim off excess fat. Place wings in a large bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the wings and dry seeds and saute until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Add the remaining 1/3 cup oil and cook until liquid evaporates, about 10 minutes. Stir in the chile peppers and remove from heat. Spread the mixture evenly amongst the wings, covering completely. Bake until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees or 79 to 80 degrees, turning them halfway through. Immediately place the wings on paper towels to dry. Place the roasted deli meat between 2 sheets of waxed paper. Using a slotted spoon, remove the paper. Serve, keeping the hot deli food warm and hot. Variation, substitute chili sauce for the chili pepper powder.

title: Mushroom Cannoli
ingredients: 1 package mascarpone | 12 maraschino cherries | 12 cremini mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prick the mushrooms with a skewer to open up the cherry. Slice off and discard the stems and set aside. In a medium bowl, whip the mascarpone until smooth and creamy. Stir in 1 to 2 tablespoons of the mushroom soaking liquid and the cherries. Stuff mushroom caps with half of the cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,mint jelly,heirloom tomato,chicken bouillon granule,provolone cheese
title: A Madeira Smoked Chicken Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 3 pounds smoked provolone cheese, sliced thin | 4 heirloom tomatoes, sliced or torn into bite-size pieces | 6 squares madeira wine or other dry white wine | 1 packet chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup mint jelly, or to taste
instructions: Combine sliced provolone in a bowl. Layer each tomato, cut side down, in the cheese. Layer with the madeira. Pour hot, smoke flavored port or other white wine over the layered ingredients and mix well. Spoon into small paper freezer bags to store up to 3 months.

title: Easy Salsa #2, #2FIX
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, cooked | 1/2 cup guacamole
instructions: Put bacon in a deep skillet and cook over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon from skillet using a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Cut bacon into 1/4 inch pieces and place in a bowl. Add guacamole to bacon and mix well. Enjoy.

title: Fish With Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs halibut fillets, cut 3/4 inch thick | 1 tablespoon za'atar spice mix | 2 teaspoons fresh baby carrots, sliced thin
instructions: Place meat in bag with za'atar. Marinate in refrigerator at least 2 hours. Preheat oven to 400°f brush top and sides of bag with oil. Place meat in center of rack. Insert carrots into meat and arrange vegetables around fish. Bake for 35 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork.

Random Ingredients: white flour,biscuit,green bean,lime juice zest,monterey jack cheese,anchovy paste,ketchup
title: Ketchup Bites
ingredients: 3 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 bunch white flour | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 2 cans small green beans, drained | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 can refrigerated biscuits or ( 15 ounce ) can biscuit, biscuits
instructions: Mix the cheese, flour, ketchup, the lime zest and lemon juice together in a wide microwaveable bowl.

Random Ingredients: honey,tea,pizza sauce,sun tomato oil,soy flour,mexican cheese,habanero pepper
title: Spicy Roast Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon low sodium soy flour | 1 - 1 1/2 lb steak ( i get my butt cut crosswise into 8 slices, 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick, and 3 in all ) | 1 -2 tablespoon hoisin sauce ( or a combination of ho and t ) | 1 can pizza sauce ( i use my del monte brand ) | 6 ounces mild shaved reduced-fat mexican cheese blend ( i sometimes use colby-jack ) | 1 -2 large fresh habanero pepper ( pepper optional ) | 12 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped, packed | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Coat an oven proof nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray with cooking spray.

title: French Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine, uncooked | 2 teaspoons lard | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 4 -5 lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup creme de banane
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. In 2 t. Butter and 1/2 c water fry the onion in 2 t. Lard over medium high heat for 5 - 10 minutes or until tender. Remove the lidded skillet from the heat. Add the linguine and linguine to the skillet. Turn off the heat. Add the creme de banane and toss until heated through. Turn the linguine into a serving bowl. Garnish with the onion and sprinkle with remaining cheese.

title: Italian Sausage and Walnut Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 teaspoon dried italian sausage | 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted | 1/2 cup wild rice, prepared according to package
instructions: Cut chicken in half. Sear in a 10 x 15 inch jelly roll pan on the first side until lightly pink. Turn over, brown the other side. Remove from pan. Cut up sausage into small pieces. Place all three halves back in pan, and sprinkle with italian sausage. Add walnuts and saute for a few minutes longer. Meanwhile prepare rice according to package instructions. While warm, sprinkle wafers with remaining nuts. Cover and set aside to keep warm.

title: Grape Salad
ingredients: 1 grape, peeled | 1 bunch okra, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 4 tablespoons kirsch
instructions: Cut grapes into 1/2 inch pieces. Drop grapes into boiling water and boil. Soak okra, cut side up, in kirsch until tender and bright green, about 1 minute. Drain okra and remove and let water run clear. Combine okra and grapes. Sprinkle with oregano and serve.

title: Polish Sausage (Crock pot)
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh meatballs or 3 lbs pork butt ( 3-1/2 lbs - 3.5-1 lb ) | 1 lb ground lean pork or 1 lb ground lamb | 1 lb cooked polish sausage ( bulk or bulk recommended, sliced, or a mild italian sausage ) | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/2 cup old fashioned cocoa | 2 1/2 cups salsa ( hot ) | 2 1/2 cups shredded italian cheese blend
instructions: Cook or brown meatballs in lard or olive oil, drain. Drain if meatballs are long. Remove meat meatballs to a bowl. Brown sausage in same skillet. Drain meatballs in same skillet. Remove sausage and drippings from skillet. Combine rest ingredients, except cheese, and mix. Add meatballs and cheese to bowl with remaining ingredients. Pour cheese mixture over meatballs and cheese. Stir until combined. Cover and chill 6 - 8 hours. Serve or remove casings. Sprinkle with paprika if desired. This is a very versatile recipe with no substitutions and is available on zaar. The flavor comes from spanish sausage. The sausage is often sauted as part of our country style meals.

title: Fiery Cabbage and Sultanas
ingredients: 4 medium fingerling potatoes, peeled | 2 medium heads of cabbage, sliced | 7 -8 small dried chilies | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 6 ounces sultanas ( optional ) | 2 ounces sultanas, extra to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place the potatoes over a medium to large pan of boiling water, then cover with a lid and leave to simmer gently for 15 minutes or until just tender. Leave for a few minutes more, then drain. Place the cabbage, chillies, and baking powder into a large casserole dish, then add the sultanas if using. Stir well to cover the cabbage with sultanas. Cover then cook on high for 10 minutes until warmed through and golden, stirring every now and then.

title: Prawn and Bacon Melt
ingredients: 8 prawns ( in shell ) | 1 package brownie mix | 1/2 cup dry wine | 1 egg ( beaten ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon brown sugar ( optional ) | 5 hamburger buns
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Shell prawns and boil on high for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain and set aside. Boil brownie package in enough water with a lid on, then drain and plunge in cold water, drain and set aside. Meanwhile mix prawn and onion and season with salt. Heat remaining ingredients in a small microwavable bowl on high for 1 - 2 minutes, stirring occasionally, but not until the mixture boils. Spread mixture onto hamburger buns and top with prawns and onion mixture. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon sugar,hash brown potato,chicken soup base
title: Easy Chicken Dinner
ingredients: 1 container instant chicken soup base | 2 tablespoons cinnamon sugar | 1 pound frozen hash brown potatoes
instructions: In a saucepan, combine chicken soup base and cinnamon sugar. Add frozen potatoes, and heat through.

Random Ingredients: sage,lemon juice,beet,parmesan cheese,limeade concentrate,chicken breast,black mustard seed
title: Grilled Chicken Picnic Sandwich
ingredients: 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1 jar frozen limeade concentrate | 2 lemons, juice and zest of, finely grated | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cooked shredded | 1 1/2 cups grated parmesan cheese or 1 1/2 cups asiago cheese
instructions: Combine the mustard seeds, sage and limeade concentrate in a resealable plastic bag. Shake well to dissolve the flavors. Add the lemon juice and zest. Add one fourth cup of the parmesan and stir to combine. Add the chicken and shake to distribute. Add the remaining parmesan and mix. Add the remaining 1 1/2 cups of cheese and mix well. Sprinkle the mixture over the top of the chicken and grill or broil in a toaster oven, to the desired doneness, or with a sharp bread knife. Serve.

title: Margaritas on the Rocks
ingredients: 2 cups margarita sugar crystals ( see footnote for recipe link ) | 1 cup grated fontina | 7 fluid ounces tequila
instructions: Note, 1 cup of sugar crystals is just about the amount of sugar crystals needed to make one cup of margarita drink. The amounts of sugar crystals in this recipe are adjustable for the brand you purchased your margaritas in, so if you want more, use 5 fl oz. Of sugar crystals. Mix in margarita and sprinkle with grated fontina.

title: Chipotle-Smoked Tilapia With Chipotle Glaze
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile in adobo | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1/4 stalk celery, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. Brush grill with olive oil. Place all 4 fillets on the grill and cook for approximately 5 minutes or until fully cooked, turning once. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the chipotle and adobo peppers. Spread the guacamole on the tilapia fillets and top with chipotle pepper mixture. Turn and cook for approximately another 2 - 3 minutes or until completely cooked and the sauce has thickened. Serve with the celery.

title: Tortellini Nests
ingredients: 1 lb cheese tortellini ( fresh, frozen or canned ) | 1 small sweet yellow onion, finely chopped | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions. When done, drain the pasta and return to the pot. Stir the contents of the pot into the drained pasta. Add the chopped sweet onion and the chili pepper flakes. Toss on low heat until well blended. Serve.

title: Spiced Tempeh Tacos
ingredients: 1 package tempeh, cut into chunks | 1 container canned pumpkin puree | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt or 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves, crushed | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 12 taco shells
instructions: Drain the tempeh and set aside. Puree the pumpkin, vegetable broth, worcestershire sauce, kosher salt and marjoram or oregano in a blender or food processor and whirl until smooth. Transfer the puree to a medium saucepan, stir in the tempeh and bring to boiling over high heat. Reduce the heat to simmer and cook for about 35 minutes, until the tempeh is tender crisp and the flavors blended. Place the taco shells on a baking sheet and warm under a broiler to golden, about 2 to 3 minutes. Serve the taco shells with the tempeh filling. Note, tempeh is very similar to a cashew spreadable tuna. You can also make it in a cashew mold or a baguette, refrigerate in a plastic ziploc bag, and serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,icing sugar,kaffir lime leaf,live lobster,taco seasoning mix
title: Lobster Taco Mousse
ingredients: 1 package live lobsters ( cooked ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix, made according to directions | 1 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons icing sugar
instructions: Drain cooked lobster or shrimp. Rinse or dry lobster/shrimp and place in serving bowl. Add taco seasoning mix and raisins if using. Drizzle with lime.

title: Spaghetti Con Salsa Picante (Mexican Spaghetti With Ground Beef)
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef ( or use turkey or veggie protein ) | 1 medium head green cabbage, finely chopped ( the long ones ) | 1/2 cup cornstarch ( i use cornflour ) | 1/2 cup cold chopped coriander ( cilantro ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped culantro ( `` rella '' ( or other herb seasoning )
instructions: In a large frying pan, brown beef. Sprinkle cabbage with sugar. Cook over medium heat about 10 minutes, add cornstarch and coriander, stir, and cook until cornstarch is done to your preference. Pour sauce over cabbage, let cook about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,beef bouillon cube,shiitake mushroom,okra,tex mex cheese
title: Microwave Shiitake-Okra and Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon cube | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium light corn syrup | 1/3 lb fresh shiitake mushroom | 3 medium fresh okra, sliced | 1/4 cup shredded tex-mex cheese
instructions: Lightly grease a 10 cup microwave safe casserole dish with cooking spray. Add the cube of bouillon to a microwave safe bowl. Add the corn syrup. Cover and microwave on high power until the corn syrup is hot and the bouillon dissolves, about 1 minute. Add the shiitakes and okra.

title: Aioli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut butter | kahlua, to taste | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar | 1 dash cayenne ( optional ) | 1 1/3 cups vegetable oil
instructions: Mix ingredients with a whisk. Let sit for 30 minutes to overnight. Use immediately or refrigerate for up to 1 week.

title: Greek Lima Bean and Olives Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lima beans | 1 large orange, peel of, cut into thin wedges | 1 cup fresh kalamata olive, pitted ( about 2 halves ) | 1/2 cup red wine ( more or less )
instructions: Heat a medium saute pan over medium high heat. Add the lima beans and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and remove the pan from the heat. Add the orange wedges and olives. Let cool for about 5 minutes then toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,red onion,blackberry,banana,beer,snow pea,tomatillo,szechuan peppercorn
title: Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 2 cups blackberries | 1 cup fresh tomatillo | 1 medium red onion | 1 medium green chili pepper | 1/4 cup dry sichuan peppercorns | 3 cups mashed bananas | 16 ounces beer ( i prefer guinness & sam adams ) | 2 cups fresh snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Chop tomatillos, onion and green pepper, if using. Drain tomatoes and place in medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: anchovy oil,ouzo,mango chutney,noodle,coconut cream,red chilies,french baguette,parsley
title: Chutney Bruschetta
ingredients: 100 g of prepared ouzo | 1 teaspoon anchovy oil | 250 g french baguettes ( toasted or breaded ) | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 tablespoon ouzo | 2 -3 red chilies | parsley | 200 ml coconut cream | 50 g of prepared'stuffed chutney | 1 tablespoon of madeira 'noodle
instructions: Cut baguette in half lengthways. Spread 1 tbs. Ouzo on the toasted side of each piece. Slice on 1/4 to 1/2 sides. Mix the chutney, ouzo and anchovy paste together. Spread generously over toasted side of the baguette. Top the bread with some mango chutney and the toasted side. Place the second bread on top. Heat a panini grill. Brush with 2 teaspoons olive oil and sear the bruschetta until golden brown. Remove and garnish with the toasted side chopped chutney, parsley and the remainder of the madeira'snoodle. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,bacardi pina colada concentrate,masa harina
title: Baca (Filipino Shredded Cheese)
ingredients: 1 package bacardi pina colada concentrate | 10 cups masa harina | 42 ounces graham cracker crumbs
instructions: To shred the cheese, stir with a fork or rubber spatula until the cheese is thoroughly melted and resembles fine bread crumbs. Combine 10 cups of the masa harina with 5 cups of cold water. Dry the cheese using a coffee filter to remove all excess moisture. Place one cup of the cheese mixture into a large freezer bag. Remove the cheese mixture from the freezer and stir well. Repeat until all of the dry cheese mixture has been used then repeat with the remaining cheese mixture. Transfer cheese mixture into one 9 x 13 inch pan that has been coated with cooking spray. To make the pina colada con un una discos, place a piece of plastic wrap directly on top of each con una discos. Carefully place the una discos on top of plastic wrap so that they don't break when heated up. Place the pan on a flat counter top and cover the pan with a double thickness of foil. Place the top of the una discos on the plastic, then place a towel onto the counter top to remove excess moisture. Place 1 con una discos on the plastic, pressing plastic directly on top of the con una shell. Place another trivet on top of the con una and place a piece of plastic wrap directly on top of it and press all of the cheese mixture through the potato masa harina water. Repeat process using the remaining una discos. Scoop the stuffing into the una shell and fill with the una discos to form 2 layers of pina colada con una. Serve with fruit or salsa and/or plain rice and a side salad.

Random Ingredients: fast rising yeast,catsup,cucumber,five spice powder,red chili,dark soy sauce,chicken base
title: Chinese-Style Five Spice Calzone
ingredients: 2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 7 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 4 fluid ounces catsup, chinese style ( i buy this at the oriental market's lower-fat ) | 2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce ( can be 1/4 cup regular if you're too generous ) | 1/4 cup catsup ( can be 1/4 cup regular if you're too generous ) | 1 tablespoon instant double-quick yeast | 1/3 cup minced seeded red chili ( we like jalapenos ) | 1/4 lb cucumber, about 24-ounce, peeled and cut lengthwise into 4-inch sticks
instructions: Dissolve five spice powder and five spice powder in 1/3 cup water, and set aside. Combine catsup, 5 spice, 5 spice power, 5 spice, and 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce in a bowl and set aside. Combine catsup mixture, yeast and chiles in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake. Measure soy sauce/catsup mixture into empty bottle. Add dry ingredients with 5 spice/spice to the wet mixture and stir until well combined. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight or for up to 1 day. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Transfer dough to the baking sheet. Transfer to oven and bake on the middle rack at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 10 minutes.

title: Simple Vinaigrette Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons white vinegar or 1 1/2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon chili sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let sit 30 min before using for best results.

title: Homemade Phyllo Balls (Peanut Butter)
ingredients: 3 lbs raw peanuts | 2/3 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Remove the skin from the peanuts by soaking them in boiling water for 30 minutes drain and set aside. Wash the peanuts very well in a sieve. Dry off the peanuts with towels. Combine the olive oil and 1/3 cup water in a saucepan over medium heat and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Add the peanuts and mix together well. Cover and place in the refrigerator to harden the mixture, at least 2 hours, overnight is best. Place the mixture in a bowl and, pressing it down to remove additional moisture, add 2 - 4 tablespoons of the oil each time until you have a roll of dough. If doing this, the oil mixture may curdle. Roll the dough out into 5x12 inch rectangle and cut into 3 squares or pieces by hand. Work with one piece at a time and keep the next one covered with plastic wrap, at least a few hours. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and boil the phyllo dough for 5 - 6 minutes, or until thick, but still firm. Drain the phyllo dough, placing it on a clean dry towel to dry in a warm oven. Once cooled, divide it into two equal portions. Oil a baking sheet or use a bowl and put one portion of the phyllo dough in the middle. Brush the top with oil and sprinkle with the peanuts. Repeat process until all of the dough has been used. The dough may be covered and refrigerated for up to a week or two before cooking. After making this dough in advance, store it for up to a week.

title: Pork With Barley
ingredients: 1/4 cup pearl barley | 3 1/2 - 4 lb pork back ribs, cut in half | 1 teaspoon dried oregano, divided | fresh sage leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Combine barley, 3 1/2 to 4 pound cutlets, 1/2 teaspoon each of oregano and sage well in medium bowl. Place pork in large roasting pan. Rub half the marinade into cutlets.

title: Pork Loin Chops
ingredients: 2 pork loin chops, 1/2 inch thick | 12 large leaves lemongrass ( about 3 inches long ) | 1 tablespoon freshly chopped tarragon
instructions: Pound pork chops between 2 pieces of wax paper to 1/4 inch thick. Cut lemongrass into 2 slivers with a knife or mortar and pestle. Place 2 lemongrass pieces at a time under the pork, working with a handful at a time, pounding out any air bubbles as you go.

title: Aji
ingredients: 2 pounds beef sirloin, sliced | 1 jar roasted pistachios | 1 jar pimientos | 1/2 cup finely chopped sun-dried tomatoes | 3 ounces dried penne
instructions: Place the sirloin in a large skillet and brown over high heat for about 10 minutes. Remove the meat and pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat. Slip the sirloin into the skillet, spreading it out so that the pieces are as flat as possible. Pour the jar of pistachios into the skillet and toss until the pistachios are golden and a little crispy. Drain the sirloin slices on paper towels. Return the skillet to medium heat, pour in enough water to cover the beef, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 20 minutes, or until the beef is done. Remove from heat and stir in the sun dried tomatoes. Cook the pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain well and toss with the sirloin and pistachios. Serve with parmesan cheese for topping.

instructions: Wash and drain the gemelli noodles.

instructions: Place the white and green hominy in a large pot. Cover with water.

title: Totally Stuffed Cucumbers (From Kraft Dinner Rolls)
ingredients: 4 fresh cucumbers | 3 cups frozen hash browns | 1/2 cup black olives, chopped | 1/4 cup oat bran ( corn starch or baking powder )
instructions: Unwrap and cut 1 large cucumber in half lengthwise and scoop out the inside. Cut out the inside of the cucumber from the top, and cut a very thin slice from top to bottom. Combine the shredded potatoes with 3 cups of olives and 1/4 cup of bran. Tear off a 1 inch strip of plastic wrap about the size as your bag allows. Then you'll end up with a piece of plastic wrap. Place each piece on a clean, dry surface. Place the scoop of potato in the center of each piece, leaving the potato on the outside, then stuff those shells with the potato. Random Ingredients: cooking sherry,lemon juice,ear corn,pecorino romano cheese,corn oil,italian salad dressing mix,pepper
title: Italian Roasted Corn Salad
ingredients: 2 ears corn, shucked | 2 -3 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese or 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | fresh cracked pepper, to taste | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 - 3/4 cup corn oil ( corn syrup is a good choice ) or 1/2-3/4 cup olive oil ( corn syrup is a good choice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Wash corn thoroughly. Using a knife remove kernels from cob and remove skin and all visible fat. Chop kernels into approximately 1 inch pieces. Place corn in a large bowl. Combine sherry, salad dressing mix, cheese, pepper and lemon juice in a small bowl. Add the corn, mixing thoroughly. Pour corn mixture into a greased shallow pan or shallow roasting pan. Place in oven and roast for 45 - 50 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to cool to room temperature. Drizzle a little olive oil while still slightly warm. Place on a serving plate and allow to infuse.

Random Ingredients: beer,seasoning salt,fish,baking potato,baby bok choy,golden syrup,cabbage
title: Grandma's Beer and Fish Casserole
ingredients: 1 gallon beer | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 3 lbs fish, cut up | 1 head cabbage | 4 lbs baby bok choy | seasoning salt | 8 medium baking potatoes, scrubbed
instructions: In large saucepan, stir together beer and golden syrup. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 7 to 10 minutes. Transfer fish, cabbage and bok choy to a dutch oven and sprinkle generously with seasoned salt. Place over moderately high heat and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook for 30 to 35 minutes, stirring twice. Add potato and cook until potatoes are tender and fish is opaque, about another 20 minutes. Season with seasoned salt, to taste. Cover and continue cooking for 10 - 15 minutes, until potato is cooked. Serve immediately.

title: Brazilian Fish Balls
ingredients: 500 g cod | 3 tablespoons white flour | 35 g green olives, pitted and halved
instructions: Drain the fish, remove any bones and skin, and cut off any bones with tweezers. Combine in a mixing bowl with flour. If the mixture is very dry, add 1 tablespoon more flour, but the fish should still be quite moist. Shape into walnut sized balls and roll them around in the flour to coat. Heat non stick frying pan over low heat. Place each one on the pan and cook for 5 to 6 minutes on each side or until they are brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot.

title: Stuffed Mango Brie
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice | 1 1/4 pounds firm | 3 ounces sweet cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup capers, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 1 carrot, peeled, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare rice using package directions. Combine cooked rice, cheddar cheese, maple syrup, capers and xanthan gum in a bowl. Mix cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water in a separate bowl.

title: Spicy Poppers for Sosaties
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 white onion ( finely diced ) | 1 small chili pepper ( finely diced ) | 3 -4 dried hot chili peppers ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat a cast iron pam cooking. In a small mixing bowl combine all of these ingredients, and stir with a knife until combined properly. Take a small ball of mixture and roll it out slightly with your hands so that its flattened. Cook in the heated pan until both side are nice and brown around the edges then flip over and cook the other side.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,chipotle pepper,sesame seed oil,red pepper flake,beet
title: Yummy Chipotle Beet Chips With Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 lb tiny beet | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup cilantro | 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 1 chipotle pepper
instructions: Scrub, peel and grate the beets and place them in a bowl. Stir in the red pepper flakes and mix. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside to marinate for 12 hours or overnight. Drain the beets and chop into small dice. Combine the cilantro and sesame seed oil and set aside. Bring 4 cups of water to a boil and add the beet chips. Reduce heat, cover, and cook 45 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and allow to sit for 10 minutes. Drain and then stir in the chipotle pepper.

title: Chili Cheese Mousse for Two
ingredients: 1 package mango chutney | 1 cup prepared salsa-flavored chutney | 1/4 cup olive, chopped, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix mango chutney and salsa flavored chutney together in a bowl. Mix olive into bowl with mango chutney mixture until completely blended. Serve with crackers or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,white fish fillet,shallot,cream cheese,fennel seed
title: Fish Fillets With Fennel and Cream Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1/2 cup shallots or 1/2 cup green onion, chopped | 2 ounces cream cheese | 2 lbs white fish fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Heat a small ovenproof skillet and toast the fennel and almond extract for 2 to 3 minutes, or until aromatic. Grind this in a pestle and mortar to a fine powder. Set aside. In a small bowl, mix together the grated shallots and the cream cheese. Spray the baking pan with nonstick spray and place fish fillets in the pan. Sprinkle nutique and almond mixture under fish. Roast fish for 10 minutes. Turn heat down and broil for 5 to 7 minutes, or until fish is cooked through and the topping is lightly browned.

title: Mexican Confetti Appetizer
ingredients: 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground garlic powder | 1 1/2 cups shredded cotija cheese
instructions: Clean shiitake mushrooms and cut off ends. Set aside to soften slightly. Mash the mushroom with the garlic powder and shredded cheese into a paste using your hands or with a pastry blender. The mixture will still be wet. Refrigerate until needed. Use a small cookie scoop to drop a teaspoon of paste onto a parchment lined cookie sheet and spread as desired. Repeat with the remaining paste. The recoating and spreading process will make a thinner paste and crispier confection. Keep cool in the refrigerator.

title: Italian Rolled Salami
ingredients: 10 slices genoa salami | 2 cups chopped cabbage | 10 tablespoons italian-style bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons dried cilantro leaves | 10 tablespoons prepared broth | 4 tablespoons grated or flaked sharp provolone cheese | 4 toothpicks
instructions: Cut a slit lengthwise down the center of each slice of salami. Open and remove meat from the end. Combine cabbage, bread crumbs, cilantro, broth, cheese and salami slices. Roll out a piece of salami to a 1/4 inch thickness and cut in half diagonally. Roll up and secure with toothpicks. Place on baking sheet and cover with aluminum foil. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange tortillas on a baking sheet. Bake for 7 to 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Microwaved Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup marshmallow cream | 1/2 cup oriental sesame oil | 1 tablespoon minced fresh italian parsley
instructions: Place marshmallow cream, sesame oil and italian parsley into a 1 quart microwavable bowl. Microwave on high power for one minute or microwave for 5 minutes. Drain marshmallow cream in a mesh colander over a large bowl. Carefully remove marshmallow cream and parsley from bowl, using a slotted spoon. Place onto a cutting board and cut along the side of the bowl to separate the strands of marshmallow cream. Using a sharp knife, slice each piece into 8 squares or thirds and arrange on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Let cool to room temperature then store in an airtight container.

title: Red Pepper & Almond Milk
ingredients: 3 ounces blanched almonds, soaked in cold water for 30 minutes | 3 ounces finely roasted red bell peppers | 10 ounces almond milk
instructions: Put the peanuts, roasted bell peppers and almond milk into a blender or food processor, process until smooth.

title: French Bread Pockets
ingredients: 4 whole wheat pita bread, cut into squares | 2 -3 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Divide pita squares evenly among 4 warmed serving dishes. Sprinkle each with a teaspoon of vinegar then cover with a second tray. Warm the remaining pita breads on either side of the bowls in a steamer or in a pot on the stove until golden.

title: Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 4 pounds pork spareribs | 1 cup bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place spareribs in a large bowl of very hot water. Turn often until all sides are lightly browned. Drain. Place bread crumbs in another shallow bowl. Arrange soaked ribs on foil in a layer. Dust ribs with bread crumbs to cover. Heat a large, cast iron skillet over medium heat. Fry ribs in the hot skillet until golden brown on both sides, about 10 minutes per side.

title: Mexican Beef
ingredients: 8 medium white mushrooms | 4 small beets | 50 g bread, crusts removed | 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1/4 cup cornflour | 2 tomatoes and green chilies, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Melt oil over medium heat in a large frying pan with a lid. Dice mushrooms and beetroot into bite sized cubes. Add the chopped mushroom and beetroot, corn flour and fry for 1 minute. Add the chillies and tomatoes and a little water, mix and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Kefalonitsih - Finnish Beef Soup
ingredients: 4 lbs stewing beef, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup curry powder ( mild, medium and hot ) | 2 cups beef stock
instructions: The secret is to add a bit of the beef stock at a time so it is not too runny. Add curry powder and mix well. After adding beef, stir often to keep the bouquet garni from burning. When this does not happen, just cover and cook until meat is tender. Remove. Discard the bouquet garni. Cool and serve with patties.

title: Chili Gorgonzola Beef
ingredients: 8 ounces gorgonzola, crumbled | 2 lbs beef stew meat
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Dredge ground beef in cheese mixture. Lay in shallow roasting pan. Bake 2 hours or until meat is tender. If the cheese mixture hardens before beef is fully cooked, drain juice out of pan. Serve with hot cooked noodles.

Random Ingredients: sea salt black pepper,saffron,italian seasoning,cherry pie filling,coconut milk
title: Easy Coconut Pastries
ingredients: 4 ounces sweetened coconut milk | 2 tablespoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1 pinch saffron | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | dried cherries or fresh fruit, cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat coconut milk in a small saucepan over medium heat until just simmering, 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in greek seasoning and saffron. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon the pastries into dessert dishes. Scatter cherries over the pastries and serve.

title: Lola's Killer Fillets of Tacos
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 2 bananas, chopped fine | 1 white onion, chopped | 5 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | 1/2 tablespoon dried marjoram | 1/4 cup sliced ripe banana | 15 ladyfingers
instructions: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well. Heat large skillet over medium heat. Lay tilapia fillets in pan. Cook, 3 to 4 minutes per side, or until fish just flakes easily. To serve, arrange in lettuce lined bowl onto plates.

Random Ingredients: water,papaya,ancho chile,chicken broth,pecorino romano cheese,salt pepper,garbanzo bean
title: Guisado De Pintos En Salsa De Ancho
ingredients: 3 cups dried garbanzo beans | 1 1/4 cups water | salt and fresh ground pepper to taste | 12 ounces papayas, diced, or other papaya | 4 stalks celery, chopped, or to taste | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Place the garbanzo beans and 1 cup of water in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Simmer over medium heat until the beans soften slightly, about 30 minutes. Drain, and let cool until easily handled, about 15 minutes. Rinse the rice, and place in a medium bowl with enough cold water to cover. Let rest 10 minutes. Drain the rice through a strainer, discarding any fibers. In a saucepan, bring the remaining 1 cup of water to a boil. Add salt, pepper, and diced papaya. Reduce heat to low, and simmer until soft, about 10 minutes. Stir in the celery, and remove from heat. Stir in the rice and cheese. Transfer to a serving dish, and serve hot.

title: Lobster and Radish Rice
ingredients: 1/2 pound lobster tail, cut in half lengthwise and butterflied | 18 ounces long-grain rice | 1/2 pound fresh red radishes, cut into half lengthwise and sliced
instructions: Cook the lobster in a pot with water to cover over high heat until the shells open and the meat no longer has a tail on the bottom, about 3 minutes. Remove lobster meat from the pot, cool, and cut into 1/4 inch strips. Place rice, lobster meat, radishes, and red pepper pieces into a 2 quart resealable plastic bag. Shake bag to mix.

title: Vegetable Salad

instructions: Heat oil in a deep skillet over moderate heat until just beginning to smoke. Add almonds, cook and stir until golden, about 30 seconds. Drain off oil. Stir in chilies and radicchio.

instructions: Lay 2 slices of pepperoni on work surface and top with 3 or 4 c cabbage wedges. Roll up jellyroll style and secure with a tooth pick. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,poblano chile,carrot,gingerroot,coriander,yukon gold potato,chicken breast

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place chicken breast on a large, rimmed baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes. Cool, remove skin and cut into 2 inch pieces. instructions: In a large, heavy skillet, heat oil over medium high heat until smoking. Stir in ginger and garlic paste.

title: Cheese Penne

Place the pan or wok over a high heat and add the cheese and cook, stirring constantly, until the cheese is melted. Serve straight away with a few good pita wedges.

instructions: Slice the bread in half. You can make the sandwich as you like, starting by topping it with the peas. title: Zucchini and Cheese Rounds

instructions: Heat oven to 350&deg.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,cold water,kielbasa,vanilla sugar,palm sugar,grain rice,radish,filling
title: Kielbasa With Rice

instructions: Note, original recipe offered radishes with fresh shaved radishes for added flavor. Soak rice in hot stock and let sit for 30 minutes. Rinse, and drain rice. Place remaining cinnamon with palm sugar in a small, shallow bowl. Toss sausages with cinnamon mixture, water, and 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar. Repeat layers ending with cinnamon and sugar, top with cinnamon and sugar. Place a radish strip on top. Bake in a preheated 400f oven for about 20 minutes, or until the radish strips are tender and golden. Sprinkle with cinnamon before serving.

title: Liptauer
ingredients: 2 cups dried beef consomme | 2 tablespoons dehydrated basil or 2 tablespoons dried italian spices | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley flakes | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Place dried beef with spices and parsley flakes in crockpot. Pour consomme over top. The consomme will be very hot. Allow to cook for about 2 hours on high. If your crockpot does not have a low setting, check for 5 hours. If your crockpot does not have a low setting, check for 30 minutes.

title: Gingered Oranges
ingredients: 25 g dark chocolate | 1 navel orange, peeled | 1 tablespoon garlic paste
instructions: Put the dark chocolate, orange and garlic paste in your blender and blitz until smooth. Chill in a small paper bag overnight.

Random Ingredients: cold water,kalamata olive,marjoram,tilapia fillet,grain white rice,creme fraiche
title: Lidia's Mediterranean Tilapia With Olives
ingredients: 1/2 lb tilapia fillet | 3/4 cup short-grain white rice ( whole grain or jasmine ) | 1 1/4 cups cold water | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram or 2 teaspoons oregano | 4 -6 kalamata olives, pitted and thinly sliced | creme fraiche
instructions: In a shallow dish, combine rice, water and marjoram. Place tilapia fillets on top of the rice, cover and refrigerate for 10 - 12 minutes. Drain the tilapia and place on a greased baking sheet. Gently flip over and spray with the cooking spray. Grill tilapia for about 12 - 3 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness. Meanwhile, in another shallow dish, toss olives with 2 tablespoons olive oil. Serve on top of the fish with the olives. Serve with a dollop of creme fraiche.

title: Ziti With Mango-raisin Crumb Topping and Bread Crumbs

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Grilled Chicken Fajita Bread
ingredients: 2 cups dry farfalle pasta, cooked | 2 cups dried texas toast | sugar substitute, of choice | 1 can chicken thighs, drained | 2 teaspoons catsup | chunky salsa | 3 cups fresh portabella mushrooms, sliced thin ( or fresh, if you like. i use mushrooms ) | 1 package crumbled reduced fat cheddar cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat grill to high or preheat broiler. Toast farfalle according to directions on package. While farfalle is toasting, to make chicken sauce, in a 2 to 3 quart saucepan combine chicken, catsup and salsa. Remove from heat and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Drain farfalle, return to pan and toss with sauce. Add remaining ingredients and toasted farfalle. Cook 4 to 5 minutes or until hot.

title: Cassava Rice With Zest
ingredients: 6 cassava, peeled, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon paprika, sweet | 2 lemons, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup vinegar
instructions: In a small skillet, heat the zest, lemon juice, paprika and garam masala on medium heat until the zest is fragrant and beginning to brown. Put 1 cup of rice and some of the vinegar in a 2 quart pan. Stir until the rice is coated with the liquid. Bring to a boil, then turn down the heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Toss with 1/4 cup of rice. Fluff up with a fork.

title: Cornmeal Steak With Greek Slices
ingredients: 2 beef sirloin steaks | 1 cup feser's cornmeal | 1 packet feta cheese
instructions: Brush the sirloin steaks with oil and season with salt and pepper to taste. Place in the fridge to marinate for 15 minutes. Meanwhile pour the cornmeal into a large bowl. Add the feta cheese and mix together with your hands until the cheese has completely dissolved, then press into a lined baking dish. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place the steaks on top of the cornmeal, then bake for 35 minutes, or until fully cooked and the topping is golden.

title: Italian Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 head iceberg lettuce | 4 slices prosciutto or 4 slices silladella | 2 slices green bell peppers | 2 -4 teaspoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Slice the iceberg lettuce thinly. Place the slices of cheese in a sandwich and grill on both sides until the cheese melts, usually about 2 - 3 minutes. Top each sandwich with a slice of prosciutto. Top with a few green pepper slices and drizzle with a few tablespoons of olive oil and a little sprinkling of freshly grated parmesan. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,dark soy sauce,lemonade,italian bread,french bread,lamb,oat,french green bean
title: French Bread Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup lemonade | 1/3 cup low sodium soy sauce | 12 ounces day-old french style green beans, cut in half | 12 ounces lamb ( very lean in any combination ) or 12 ounces turkey ( very lean in any combination ) | 12 ounces loin bread, cut in half lengthwise, cut to fit loaf pan | 1/2 lb fresh button mushroom | 1 loaf crusty italian bread, quartered
instructions: To make the sauce, combine 1/2 cup dark soy sauce, 1/3 cup lemonade, and 1/3 cup low sodium soy sauce in saucepan.

title: Quick Persian Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed of all extraneous fat, cut into 12, 1 inch cubes | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1 1/2 inch wide strips | 3/4 teaspoon ground cardamom ( to taste )
instructions: Thread the pork, bell pepper strips, and cardamom on metal skewers. Fire up the grill, basting the kebabs with a little oil. Cook the kebabs over medium heat, turn once or twice, until the meat is lightly charred all over, about 7 to 10 minutes. Serve immediately with any kind of dipping sauce. For best results, keep covered in the refrigerator.

title: Churros
ingredients: 3 ounces vermicelli | 200 -250 g butter, unsalted | 1 lemon | 1 dash hot sauce | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1 1/2 tablespoons flour | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 -2 tablespoon sweet paprika
instructions: Put vermicelli in boiling water to soak. Drain and then fry in butter til golden brown. Cut the lemon in wheels and set aside in a bowl. Cut lemon into wheels and set aside. Blend all other ingrediants in food processor till smooth. Add 1 - 2 tbls of cream and mix till combined. Drain vermicelli and mix through the marinade and stir fry til coated. Remove from pot once it's cooked and put it on paper towels to drain any excess oil. Serve in single plates with vermicelli on top serve warm.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki marinade,green bell pepper,saffron,parsley flake,taco seasoning,italian turkey sausage
title: Cheater's Spanish Sausage
ingredients: 1 can italian-style turkey sausage | 1/4 green bell pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon butteryaki marinade | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, i 'll use equal parts cajun seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl. Cut sausages lengthwise in half and brown in the microwave for 3 to 5 minutes, per your preference. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,vegetable bouillon cube,msg,bean,farina,flour tortilla,bay scallop
title: Scallops in Bean Sauce
ingredients: 5 ounces dried beans ( or fresh ) | 2 -3 vegetable bouillon cubes, dissolved in | 3 -4 cups water or 3 -4 cups milk | salt and pepper | 2 cups farina, a type of hard bread ( not the hard wheat type ) | 2 dozen fresh small bay scallops | 1 -2 dash msg ( optional )
instructions: Soak the beans in water for a few hours or overnight, drain. Bring the milk to a boil. Add the smashed bouillon until dissolved. Add the beans and enough water to cover the beans by at least two inches. Bring to a boil again and then turn down to a simmer, until the beans are tender. Dice the scallops up into pieces a couple of inches long if using fresh cut them into small cubes. When they are done put them in a pan with plenty of salt, pepper and a little monosodium glutamate. If using whole wheat farina, add it during the last minute of cooking. Put a small piece of the farina or a small piece of plastic wrap on the hot surface, let it soften for a few seconds. Add a few drops of water or milk until mixture is evenly spread. Add the smashed bouillon until blended. Put the chopped or chopped scallops in the sauce. Taste and add more salt, pepper, or seasoning. Serve immediately.

title: Pear and Pepper Popcorn Balls
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 1/4 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns | 1 pound assorted pears - peeled, cored, chopped, and squeezed | 1 pint wooden popsicle sticks, with wrappers
instructions: Mix yolk and cracked black pepper in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,white flour,soy sauce,broccoli floret,hard egg,pinot noir wine,cider vinegar,black salt
title: Broccoli Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret | 1 hard-boiled egg, shelled | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/4 cup pinot noir wine | 1 pinch black salt | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 tablespoon sifted icing sugar | 1 tbsp cider vinegar
instructions: Drop the broccoli into boiling water, then plunge into cold water and immediately plunge into ice water to stop the cooking. The broccoli has to be bright green and slightly tender. Dissolve the soy sauce with a pinch of salt in a small dish. Beat into the egg with 1/4 cup of the sugar and a little more of the vinegar. The mixture should not be too stiff, but it is just as creamy. Heat a non stick frying pan or griddle until very hot. Using a tablespoon of the mixture, drop small slabs of the broccoli and egg onto the hot oil, taking care not to drop the mixture too often and making sure it does not break. Cook until they are golden underneath, about 3 - 4 minutes, turning every now and then. The fritters should be slightly crisp but not black in the center. Carefully lay with a slotted spoon on absorbent paper to drain. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: My Favourite Sausage With Fresh Peas
ingredients: 1 whole wheat pita bread ( or homemade bread ) | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar ( or palm sugar ) | 1/2 onion, chopped ( or brown sultanas ) | 1/4 cup frozen peas ( or chopped chickpeas )
instructions: Pound and shape sausage into 8 large patties. Brush with dark brown sugar and bake in a hot griddle/casserole dish at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes, turn and bake for another 20 minutes. Serve with fresh peas or fresh fruit. Variations, use sliced sausage for flavouring, or sausages that can subsequently be cooked. If the pork is not browned enough, leave out the sugar. Cooked sausage is also nice and tasty with roasted potatoes and cauliflower. Instead of the brown sugar, sultanas are wonderful in this southern comfort breakfast and have been suggested as an accompaniment as well as a healthier option for something to do with your food. A great addition to this dish is a slice of bread such as sourdough bread, toasted pine nuts and finely chopped spring onion, toasted carrots and/or finely minced scallions.

title: Tortelli E Piselli
ingredients: 20 large shrimp, unpeeled | 150 g pancetta, in thin slices ( i use salgollette ) | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed ( use fat free, fat-free, low-fat ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1 sheet frozen ready-rolled frozen pancakes ( or use cornflake )
instructions: Peel and devein the shrimp. Slice the shrimp lenghtwise into ½ to½ inch wide strips. Slice the pancetta into ½ to ¾ inch lengths and fry in 1 tbls. Of the 2 tbs. Of oil. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Drain the shrimp and set aside. Remove all of the excess oil from the pan. Add the shrimp and pancetta and fry on high for 3 minutes. Pour in the whipped topping and fry on high for 2 to 3 minutes. Turn the shrimp mixture out onto a plate. Heat a second tbls. Of oil in the empty pan and fry the tortelli for 2 to 3 minute drain on towels. Serve immediately with additional whipped topping. Note, you can also roll the tortelli as you need them for this.

title: Sweet Potato Puree
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick on the diagonal | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | warm maple syrup, to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile, in a deep nonreactive frying pan or skillet cook the sweet potato slices in the boiling water until they're just tender but still firm to the bite. Using a slotted spoon, transfer them to a bowl of room temperature water to cool. Drain the potatoes and slice them as thinly as possible. Set them aside and let them drain on paper towels. Stir the puree with salt, pepper and warmed maple syrup and transfer to a bowl. Toss the cooked sweet potatoes with the puree to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour. Serve warm, or at room temperature.

title: Tomato and Bread Crumb Topping -- Basic Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs tomatoes, medium sized, ripe, peeled, seeded, sliced | 1 cup chopped bread | butter, to taste | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Arrange an oven proof dish, such as baking dish or crockpot, in a single layer. Dice the tomatoes, stir into the bread and pour 1/2 cup of water into the dish or crockpot. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover the dish or crockpot, and cook the topping on low for 7 - 10 hours, or until it has become really thick. Do not add water while cooking, because the bread will expand as it cools.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,feta cheese,pico de gallo,cardamom pod,angel hair pasta,greek yogurt
title: Feta  and Blue Cheese Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package uncooked angel hair pasta | 2 cups crumbled feta cheese | 1 quart plain greek yogurt | 2 containers crumbled blue cheese | 5 cardamom pods, crushed | 1 jar pico de gallo | 2 tablespoons crushed dried pico de gallo
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta in boiling water for 13 to 15 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Chocolate and Onion Noodle and Veggie Casserole
ingredients: 500 g egg noodles | 1 white onion ( small diced ) | 250 g courgettes ( small diced ) | 50 -60 ml orange juice ( i used bottled ) | 1 pinch unsweetened cocoa powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Place all ingredients into a large oven dish and toss gently until combined but not mushy. Cover with a lid and cook on oven for 45 - 60 minutes or until cooked.

title: Jamaican Citrus Tea
ingredients: 300 g orange marmalade | 4 kiwi | 4 tablespoons orange marmalade
instructions: Put the kiwifruit in a tall tea bowl. Pour the orange marmalade on top, then top with 100g of the orange marmalade. Cover and leave in the fridge for 24 hours. Remove the kiwifruit using a spoon. Put the fresh fruit in a blender and puree until smooth. Pour into a tea bag and pipe into 4 small tea teas. Serve immediately.

title: Sushi Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sushi rice | 4 mussels, cleaned and debearded
instructions: Clean and debeard the mussels. Bring a small amount of water to a boil over high heat in a skillet. When the water boils, add rice. Turn down the heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender. Steam the mussels until they are bright green and cooked. Arrange rice on a platter, and sprinkle with mussels. Serve.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,cheddar cheese,lemon juice zest,burdock root
title: Hogkit Kebab
ingredients: 1 quart burdock root | 1 cup grated cheddar cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of | tabasco sauce ( for those unable to find these )
instructions: Remove the sprinards from the burdock root and slice the root into 1/2 inch thick slices lengthwise. Arrange the slices in layers in a shallow glass baking dish or roasting pan in a single layer. Sprinkle the grated cheese over the ginger and lemon zest, then drizzle the sauce over the top generously. Turn the dish around several times, so that the cheese is melted throughout. Cover with foil, and bake at 350f for about 20 minutes. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,cumin,olive oil cooking spray,green enchilada sauce,red leaf lettuce,spinach leaf
title: Spinach Enchilada Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil-flavored cooking spray | 3 1/2 cups fresh spinach leaves, washed and coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 small red leaf lettuce, washed and chopped | 2 cans green enchilada sauce
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet with a lid, heat the olive oil. Add spinach and cook, stirring, over high heat for 2 minutes. Immediately, stir in cumin and coriander.

Random Ingredients: adobo sauce,tea,fatty bacon,rice wine,worcestershire sauce,egg noodle
title: Bacon Ramen   (EASY)
ingredients: 12 ounces egg noodles | 8 slices smoked fatty bacon | 2 -3 tablespoons low-sodium worcestershire sauce | 1/2 - 3/4 cup good strong tea ( a.1. only! ) | 3 -4 drops of your favourite sweet and sour sauce ( i prefer kool-aid ) | adobo sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,italian salad dressing,anaheim chilies
title: Santa Fe Fish
ingredients: 1 white fish fillet | 1/3 cup italian-style salad dressing | 2 anaheim chilies, seeded and sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking tray with aluminum foil. Trim any excess skin from the fish. Rub all over with salad dressing. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until fish flakes easily with fork.

Random Ingredients: white onion,red onion,egg noodle,green chili pepper,lime juice,black eyed pea,graham cracker crumb,granny smith apple
title: EZ New Zealand Kiwi Fondue
ingredients: 1 lb fresh goya black-eyed peas or 1 lb frozen black-eyed peas, thawed | 1 small white onion, finely chopped | 1 small red onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup white onion, minced | 1/2 cup green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 medium granny smith apple, peeled and grated | 6 -8 ounces egg noodles, cooked | 1 tablespoon lime juice | graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Drain and rinse goya beans well. Place in large skillet. Fill with water and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Drain and discard 1/2 cup of the water and put back into pan. Sauté onions, green chile and granny smith apple in the 1/2 the left over water or bacon drippings, stirring often, until vegetables are tender. Add the cooked noodles. In small bowl combine the rest of the ingredients and stir well. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Season to taste and serve with crème fraiche to dip in. Great in winter and next day.

Random Ingredients: white,nonstick cooking spray,lamb shank,grain white rice,stewing beef
title: Lamb Shanks With Rice and Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided | 2 1/4 lbs stewing beef, halved | 6 cups cold medium grain white rice | 1 1/4 lbs lamb shanks, with skin | 1 1/4 cups water
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in heavy large pot over medium high heat. Working in batches, add lamb to pot and brown all sides, transferring lamb to plate. Return all oil to same pot except 2 tablespoons. Working in batches, add lamb and brown over high heat, stirring until browned, about 3 minutes per batch. Return lamb to pot. Reduce heat to low. Working in batches, add rice and 2 cups water to pot and bring to boil. Cover and simmer until water is absorbed and rice is tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Working in batches, transfer lamb and any accumulated juices to large warm platter. Using slotted spoon, transfer rice to large bowl. Discard liquid remaining in pot. Reserve. Skim fat from pot. Stir 1 1/4 cups reserved liquid, remaining tablespoon oil, 2 pounds chump meat, and remaining 2 tablespoons oil each into the rice. Bring to boil. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,sage,chinese five spice powder,coconut,english muffin,marjoram
title: Sausage & Five-Spice English Muffins
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dry shredded coconut | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/8 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 2 large whole english muffins, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line an 8 inch square glass baking dish with foil. Cut the sausage into 1 pieces. In a large skillet over medium high heat, brown the sausage slices until no longer pink, but not fully cooked. Remove the sausage slices from the pan. Drain any excess grease and return all the sausage drippings to the pan. Stir in the coconut, sage, marjoram, crème five spice and cook for 10 minutes. Place a piece of foil on the bottom of the baking dish to keep the muffins open. Sprinkle the muffins with some of the sausage drippings and top with a slice of sausage. Bake in the upper third of the oven for 20 minutes or until the muffins are hot, puffed, and crusty.

title: Mama Zuquinis' Magnifico
ingredients: 2 lbs tomatoes, fresh ripe, peeled and very ripe | 2 cups parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated ( from the reggiano cheese deli ) | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 -2 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( optional ) or 1 -2 teaspoon vegetable bouillon granules ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon parsley ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon sage ( optional )
instructions: Place tomatoes in a heavy kettle. Pour boiling water over them about 1/2 inch or a little bit so they can stand upright. Bring water to a rolling boil, then carefully ladle the water into the tomatoes and mash the tomatoes. Drain the liquid and place in a bowl. Add the grated cheese, stir, and set aside. Remove tomatoes from the boiling water and pat dry with a towel. Place the tomatoes under a towel, and squeeze the liquid that is clinging to the towel between your fingers, to get all the water out and into the tomatoes. Turn out onto a platter, and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese before serving. Garnish with chopped tomato, parsley or sage.

title: Kale & Rice Stuffing
ingredients: 4 cups cooked basmati rice or 4 cups basmati rice | 2 cups fresh mixed vegetables | 1 cup fresh kale ( chopped or chipped or shredded ) | 1/3 cup brandy | 1/4 cup fresh white bread, crumbly ( optional ) | 20 g fresh mesclun ( optional )
instructions: Place rice, mixed vegetables and kale in a large saucepan and add plenty of cold water to cover and bring to the boil over high heat. Reduce heat.

title: Italian Chicken and Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 skinless, boneless chicken breasts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil that has been covered with the foil. Open a can of beans and spread them on the foil. Sprinkle the chicken with garlic salt. Layer the chicken with 1/2 the beans. Close the aluminum foil and wrap tightly using the ends of the foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Unwrap the foil and bake 30 minutes longer.

title: Chinese Green Cardamom Tea
ingredients: 6 fresh green cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 5 teaspoons dry chinese wine ( or up to 5 tsp. extra if you choose ), to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place cardamom pods in a large tea ball with sugar and water. Brew tea for five minutes. Pour into a tea strainer or a tea strainer lined with tea towel and leave for five minutes before releasing tea. Transfer to a tea strainer with a tea spoon and serve. Note, i have also seen recipe 'coffee' flavored tea that you can substitute with 1 cup instant coffee.

Random Ingredients: caribbean jerk seasoning,chicken bouillon,cream cheese,peanut,nonfat milk powder,tamarind pulp,rosemary,ginger
title: Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/2 cup tamarind pulp | 1 tablespoon caribbean jerk seasoning | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon minced fresh rosemary | 1 cup chopped peanuts | 2 tablespoons fat free cream cheese
instructions: In medium bowl combine all ingredients except cream cheese.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,kernel corn,chuck roast,brown rice,lemon peel,baking potato,ancho chile powder,buttermilk
title: Spicy Buttermilk Beef-And-Corn Pie
ingredients: 1/2 lb hamburger chuck roast | 3 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 can whole kernel corn | 2 teaspoons baking potatoes, broken into pieces | 1 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel | 1/3 cup buttermilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Brown beef in skillet over low heat. Remove beef to a plate. In a bowl, combine peanuts, corn, potato and seasoning except buttermilk. Press peanut butter mixture into the bottom of a 9 inch pie plate sprayed with non stick cooking spray. Carefully put beef into the pie pan and sprinkle the brown rice on top. Scatter the corn mixture over the beef. Bake at 350f for 35 minutes. If necessary, cover with foil. Continue baking for 15 - 20 minutes longer or until rice is tender. Remove from oven and put on a plate. Mix buttermilk and the buttermilk together and pour over the beef/corn mixture and bake for 5 - 10 minutes longer or until meat is done. You may also make gravy with this sauce, but if you bake on the stove instead of the oven, the meat and corn mixture can be served. I like to cook this to my family, i like to serve it on the side with a hot sauce from a can of corn and green beans.

title: Beefy Chocolate Pouch Pot  Breakfast Mix
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef ( or lamb ) | 1/3 cup ground tea ( strong, hot & plenty to taste ) | 2 tablespoons sultanas ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon honey | 2 squares dark chocolate
instructions: Combine ground beef, tea, sultanas, & honey. Make sure it is thoroughly mixed inches. Roll into 1 balls.

title: Ww 5 Points - Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 small red onion, finely chopped | 3 cups unpleached cider vinegar
instructions: Place the chopped red onion in a bowl. Add the cider vinegar and toss to combine. Serve with your favourite greens.

title: Cambodian Spaghetti
ingredients: 3 lbs ground turkey breast | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried turmeric | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 container fat-free thawed frozen whipped topping, thawed | 14 ounces drained crabmeat
instructions: In large bowl, mix together turkey, garlic salt, basil, turmeric, soy sauce and thawed whipped topping mix well until well blended. Pour mixture over meat in bowl. Toss well, making sure meat is coated with mixture well. Cover and refrigerate overnight in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In shallow dish, lay out a cookie sheet with about 1 1/2 inch sides. Arrange crabmeat on cookie sheet, and arrange meat on top, breaking apart with fingers to help hold crabmeat in place. Bake in preheated oven 30 minutes, or until heated through, and meat is cooked through. Serve over spaghetti, and serve warm.

title: Cherry Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice ( jasmine or other long grain rice ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1 jar maraschino cherries ( drained )
instructions: Soak the rice on the counter for about 1 hour. Add the herbs, mix thoroughly and set aside for about an hour. If using whole cherries add them now. Note, cherry tomatoes can be added, about an hour. The flavor is more intense as cherries cook. It is a delicious and tasty lunch.

Random Ingredients: yellow cherry tomato,shell pasta,cheese curd,white wine vinegar
title: Cherry Tomato Pasta Salad
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces cheese curds | 1 lb small shell pasta ( i like whole wheat penne or spiral ditalini ) | 3 -4 yellow cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Cut cheese curds into 1/4 inch cubes. Place in a large salad bowl. Toss with pasta. Toss with cherry tomatoes. In a small bowl, combine vinegar and remaining 1/2 cup cheese until well blended. Pour over salad. Chill several hours.

title: Barbecue Spareribs With Calamari and Black Beans

instructions: Heat medium nonstick skillet over medium high heat until very hot, about 2 minutes. Add olive oil, orange peel, barbecue sauce, hoisin and pepper. Stir to combine. Add ribs, cook 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until browned. Drain cooked beans and stir in. Serve hot.

title: Baked Fritters With Broccoli, Corn and Baby Carrots
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, scrubbed | 2 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1 1/4 cups low-fat mayonnaise | 1/2 cup packed baby corn, steamed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut the potatoes into 1/4 inch thick fries.

ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, with liquid | 8 boneless chicken leg quarters | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon salt | 1/2 cup limoncello | 1 tablespoon star anise | 4 crusty french baguettes
instructions: Drain kidney beans of their liquid into a large, wide pot. Combine the chicken legs, onion, red bell pepper, salt, limoncello, and star anise in a large crock of water.

title: Tasty & Easy Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 stewing beef, cut into bite size chunks | 1 cup sweet bell pepper, diced and seeded | 1 cup sweet marsala wine | 1 cup shredded coconut
instructions: In crockpot place meat, peppers, wine and coconut. Cook 6 - 8 hours on low or 4 - 5 hours on high. Thicken gravy with cornstarch to thicken if you want a thicker consitency.

title: Minted Olives
ingredients: 2 cups shelled green olives | 1 cup fresh mint sprigs
instructions: Wash the olives. Remove the stem and then discard the hard outer green leaves. Cut each olive crosswise into 4 large slices. Put the olives in a saucepan and add 3/4 cup of cold water. Cover and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and simmer until no more liquid is left in the olives, which will swell during cooking. Remove and discard leaves. Allow to cool. Place olives in sterile jars and fill with mint mint leaves. Seal and store in the cool dark place.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,fettuccine,baby spinach leaf,golden raisin,nonfat milk,lettuce,sharp cheddar cheese,beef stew meat
title: Hearty Beef Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups rotini pasta, uncooked | 1 bag baby spinach | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 2 cans fat-free refried beans | shredded four-cheese blend, for garnish | shredded iceberg lettuce, for garnish | shredded reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese, for garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add the stew meat, cook, stirring, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Add rotini, spinach and golden raisins. Cook, stirring, about 2 minutes. Stir in refried beans and heat through. Serve over noodles and garnish with shredded cheese.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,turmeric powder,sea salt,green chili pepper,chipotle chile adobo,greek yogurt,pecorino romano cheese
title: Rajas Con Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra virgin greek yogurt | 1/4 ground green chili pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon grated pecorino romano cheese or 1/4 teaspoon parmesan cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a mixer and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve on lettuce leaves, tortilla chips or crackers and your favourite fresh vegetable. Enjoy.

title: Pasta with Grape Juice
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 can grape juice
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the bow tie pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Stir grape juice into the hot cooked pasta, and return the pasta to the pot. Cover, and cook on low heat about 5 minutes, until the grape juice has been absorbed.

title: Salsa con Limoncello (Spanish Onion Bread)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet spanish onions, coarsely chopped ( about 3 cups ) | 1 loaf crusty italian bread, cut into 3/4 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line baking sheet with foil, then lay the onions flat in a single layer. Top each with a few teaspoons of sherry to make a crusty crust. Bake until onions are golden, about 25 to 30 minutes and the tops are brown and crisp, 10 to 15 minutes, switching position of the pans halfway through baking. Remove from oven, and let stand 5 minutes. Place bread cubes on a cutting board, and transfer to cutting board. Top and side with the onions. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,chili pepper flake,colby monterey jack cheese,baking potato,oyster sauce
title: Lemon Pepper Jack French Fries (Stir Fry)
ingredients: 1 medium baking potato ( about 3 medium ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped lemon peel, for each fries | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Microwave potato on high for 5 minutes then microvave on high for 2 more minutes. While potato is microwaving, prepare oyster sauce by combining 1/2 a tbsp of the oyster sauce, 1/2 tsp of chili flakes and 1/4 tsp of lemon peel in a small bowl. In a small bowl combine the rest of the oyster sauce, 1/4 tsp of the chili flakes and 1/4 tsp lemon peel. Peel potato until you desire a matchy taste. I like to use a mandolin to cut the potato into fries. If you prefer fries the same size add a small amount of water to the frying pan. Place fries on a plate or tray. Add a layer of the marinade mix to the fries. Place fries into microwave and microwave on high for approximately 3 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes. Do not over stir as potatoes may become tough. Top with shredded cheese and cook for approx 3 minutes or till melted. title: Mexican Pumpkin (Pumpkin or Squash) Barley Soup

instructions: Place the buttermilk, half the nutella, half the ground biscuits, and ice water into a large mixing bowl and mix with an electric knife until well combined, gradually adding the pesto and vanilla. Place the quiches on the baking tray, cut side up, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden. Serve warm, with extra pesto and a green springy vinaigrette if desired.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,onion soup mix,snow pea,olive,mango chutney,chili oil,currant,hash brown potato
title: Spicy Mango Chutney Potato Potatoes

instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain, and spread potatoes out in the bottom of a 2 quart casserole dish. Stir mushrooms and onion soup mix into the potatoes.

instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions or alternatively, cook macaroni in a large saucepot of boiling, salted water. Drain pasta and keep warm. Divide cheese mixture among plates and top with remaining stilton cheese cubes. Serve hot.

title: Tomato-Pesto Sauce

title: Corn Oil Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup corn oil | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/4 cup kalamata olives, pitted and diced
instructions: Heat corn oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: cold water,baby spinach leaf,dark raisin,taco seasoning mix
title: Pine-crusted Greens
ingredients: 1 cup coarsely chopped red kale leaves or 1 cup kale | 1 1/2 packets taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 cups cold water | 2/3 cup dark raisin, chopped
instructions: Combine everything except the raisins in a bowl and set aside.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,milk chocolate,peanut oil
title: Chocolate Fudge or Nut Oil
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons other vegetable oil | 7 ounces milk chocolate, chopped | 5 ounces milk chocolate, chopped
instructions: Heat the oven to 300°f. In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine the oil, chocolate and the milk chocolate and mix until fully combined.
