Random Ingredients: white pepper powder,flour,romaine lettuce,grain white rice,active yeast,barbeque sauce
title: Texas Pizza Bread With Seasonings, Mayo, and BBQ
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 2 cups cooked barbeque sauce ( recommended barbeque sauce ) | 2 3/4 cups unbleached flour ( more or less, depending on your taste preference. the amount depends on your taste. i like it with a kick ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/4 teaspoons white pepper powder | 2 1/2 teaspoons salt | 3 cups all purpose flour, bread flour is my authentic | olive oil ( optional )
instructions: Sauce, combine the rice and 5 cups of water in a medium saucepan. Over medium heat, bring the liquid to a boil and simmer. Stir in the barbeque sauce, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Meanwhile. In a large bowl, stir together the flour, yeast, white pepper, and salt. Stir in the hot liquid and mix until a soft dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth, about 8 minutes. Put the dough into an oiled bowl, cover with clean, dry cloth, and let rise for about 1 to 1 1/2 an hour, or until the dough is puffy, and doubled in volume. Punch down the dough, and knead lightly for about 2 minutes. Divide it into three pieces and roll each into a 10 x 5 inch round or 2 inch oval, each 3 - ½ inches thick. With a sharp, clean razor blade, make a series of 6 inch wide x 1 - ½ inch deep holes at the top of each bread round or oval. Brush the bread rounds with olive oil. Sprinkle with more white pepper, if desired. Transfer the bread rounds to a lightly greased baking sheet. Cover with clean, dry cloth and let rise for 25 - 30 minutes, or until puffy and golden. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bake the bread rounds for 10 to 15 minutes, or until puffed and browned. Cool and store in an airtight container. This will keep for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,yellow onion,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chicken breast,pinto bean
title: Puerto Rican Pico Con Pintes (Filling for Chicken Breasts)

title: Pork and Bean Stuffed With Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb pork, chopped | 8 ounces cream cheese | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 cans pork and beans | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 8 ounces canola oil
instructions: Mix the pork and cream cheese and add 2 tblsp of peanut oil. Whip with a mixer until smooth. Heat canola oil in a skillet. Pour cream cheese mixture into skillet. Mix and pour onto pork and bean mixture. Mix canola oil and pour over mixture. Serve and enjoy.

title: Beans and Pecans
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 2 cups finely chopped parsley | 1 cup finely chopped gherkin | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon garlic granules ( or equivalent artificial-type ) | 1 teaspoon molasses | crackers or bread, to eat
instructions: Wash barley. Soak in water overnight to rehydrate. Drain, reserving 1/3 cup of the soaking liquid. Mix all ingredients in a large saucepan. Pour half of the remaining soaking liquid into the pan and bring to boil. Turn heat to low. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Remove from heat. Remove and cool. Strain liquid, discard solids. title: Quick and Easy Lamb-Pasto and Rice Casserole

Heat oven to 200c/fan 160c/gas put meat and rice mixture into casserole. Cover and bake for 1 1/2 hours or until rice is tender. Meanwhile prepare sauce. Combine cream and diced tomatoes in a pan and boil, stir constantly until thickened. When casserole is cooked remove from oven and leave covered for 45mts to warm through. To serve, invert onto serving plate. Garnish with extra parsley.

title: Apple Greek Style Burger
ingredients: 4 large apples | 4 tablespoons greek yogurt | butter | sauce | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/8 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Slice each apple lengthwise, removing the core. Remove the crusts from each apple, and using a grater or a vegetable grater, slice into very thin rounds. Sprinkle with the greek seasoning and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white wine,extra virgin olive oil,pepper flake,peach,hard alcoholic cider,lasagna,icing sugar,pak choi
title: Pulao (French Pearly Baked Parsley Salad)
ingredients: 250 g fresh pak choi, rinsed and patted dry ( or a mix of the two ) | 1 small peaches or 1 small red pineapple, in thin wedges ( or one 14-ounce tin ) | 100 g icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar, can be substituted if confectioner's sugar is not availabel ) | 200 ml hard alcoholic cider ( or drinking apple cider ) | 10 sheets fresh lasagna sheets ( approx 4 ounces each ) | 1 teaspoon dried hot pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 150 ml unsalted icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar, can be substituted if confectioner's sugar is not availabel )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325°f slice fresh pearls or slice canned pineapple into thin wedges. Tear the pak choi into large pieces and add, minus all the peaches or red pineapple, to a pan of boiling water. Cook for one to two minutes, or until just tender. Drain in a sieve or colander. Place a large sheet of plastic wrap over the top and, using your fingers, gently but quickly remove the wrap, until the dish is completely dry and the plastic can be squeezed over. Place a small piece of plastic wrap over 1/4 of the lasagna sheets to weigh it down and spread each sheet with a thin coating of the olive oil. Place one sheet on the board and place the peach mixture on it and roll it into a log, about 20 x6 inches square. Repeat with remaining sheet of plastic and filling. Place the rolled log onto the board and tightly press down to compact it and slightly flatten it. Place a large sheet of plastic wrap directly on top of the rolled log and carefully press it down to compact it. Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets, packing them down with fingers or hands if needed. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar, cover with a kitchen towel and refrigerate for at least two hours. Using a sharp knife or a sharp knife, remove the string on the top and bottom of the log. Slice the log into 1/4 inch thick slices. Arrange them, cut side down, on a serving plate and drizzle them with a few teaspoons of olive oil and sprinkle with the dried pepper flakes. Serve immediately with a salad of arugula.

title: Linguine with Chocolate and Chocolates

instructions: Cook linguine in lots and drain. Cook chocolate in saucepan for 5 minutes add the wine to hot. Drain pasta and add chocolate mix. Serve hot.

instructions: Put all ingredients into small bowl or blender. Blend well. Use immediately for meat and vegetable stir fry dishes.

title: Raspberry-Stuffed Fajitas

instructions: Place berries in a microwave safe bowl. Pour taco sauce over berries and stir. Microwave on high power 1 minute. Stir. instructions: Cook your uncooked pasta per instructions. When done, rinse and let cool slightly. Mix italian dressing and all, except pine nuts. Pour over cooked ravioli. Mix in mushrooms, peas and cheese. Mix in enchilada sauce. Sprinkle with pine nuts just prior to serving.

title: Scottish Raspberry and Jam Focaccia

instructions: Place the raspberries and jam in a pan along with the flour and vinegar. Mash roughly with a fork, stirring continuously, then season. title: Spinach and Potato Pie

instructions: Combine pork strips and red pepper paste in a large heavy duty zip top plastic bag.

title: Navy Beans and Pork with Nutritional Grubs
ingredients: 1/2 cup skim milk | 4 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder ( about 4 pork shoulder fat pieces ) | 1 can navy beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 3 ounces roasted red peppers, thinly sliced ( about 3-4 ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped white sugar or 1/2 cup brown sugar cubes
instructions: Prepare the nutritional yeast as indicated on the package and set aside. Combine the milk and yeast in a large nonstick dutch oven, and bring just to boil over medium heat. Stir the pork into the milk mixture until coated. Reduce heat to medium, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until all of the pork is browned. Return the pork to the skillet, and stir in the beans and red peppers. Simmer, stirring once, for about 10 minutes, or until the beans are warmed, stirring often. Transfer to a large serving dish and sprinkle sugar over the top.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,date,nonstick cooking spray,pasta,chunk tuna,vodka,lasagna noodle,lard
title: Lombo Di Tonno Con Finocchio (Lombo Noodle and Tuna Lasagna)
ingredients: 12 ounces lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 package light chunk tuna, drained | 1 tablespoon lard | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 3/4 cup date, pitted and chopped ( or raisins ) | 3/4 cup pasta wine ( chianti, chablis ) | nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 cup gina padano, shaved or 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions and place in a large bowl. While noodles are cooking, place lard in a medium saucepan for 2 minutes over medium heat. Add rice flour and cook, stirring, 2 more minutes. Add tuna and cook, breaking up any pieces with a meat mallet, 2 to 3 minutes more. Add 1/2 cup of the dates.

Random Ingredients: cool whip,poblano chile,lime zest,vanilla extract,pork medallion
title: Pork Medallions and Chiles
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 4 ounces pork medallions | 1/4 cup smooth vanilla yogurt or 1/4 cup sour cream, stirred | 1 teaspoon lime zest ( orange peel or other citrus zest ) | 1/4 cup light cool whip or 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Roast poblano chiles on foil or parchment paper in a 400 degree f oven until blackened on all sides, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven and place on an oiled baking sheet. Allow chiles to cool. Peel. Cut into slices about 1/4-inch thick. Seed and devein chile pieces. Combine cooled chiles with yogurt or sour cream, lime peel and zest and refrigerate until serving time. When ready to serve, place cooled pork medallions each breast up on a slice of chile. Spoon yogurt mixture over each piece and top with whipping cream.

title: Roasted Parsnips and Parsnips With Oat Stuffing
ingredients: 1 kg parsnip, chopped | 1 kg asparagus, chopped | 175 g flour | 25 g oatmeal, powder with | parsley, to sprinkle
instructions: Add all the above to a deep roasting tray with a good sprinkling of olive oil, roast a further hour, turning it on and adding more oil if necessary to make a crisp, fairly dark crust. Cook to packet instructions and then cool slightly, then toss in any left over stuffing from the roasting tray, such as the stilton flakes, and serve with crackers. Note there may be to much stuffing left in the roasting tray and we suggest checking the size of the tray before adding it to the food.

Random Ingredients: brown rice flour,white cheddar cheese,asafoetida powder,cauliflower,active yeast,cream chicken soup,beef tenderloin
title: Slow Cooker Pepper and Cauliflower Crusted Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 envelope active dry yeast | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup brown rice flour | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped white cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 1 pound beef tenderloin, trimmed | 2 stalks cauliflower, finely chopped
instructions: Place the yeast into a large bowl or slow cooker with the cream of chicken soup and 2 cups water. Let stand for 5 minutes and then stir into the yeast mixture with the remaining 3 cups water. Stir in the beef, cheddar cheese, and asafoetida. Cover and set temperature to 300 degrees f. Cook 4 to 5 hours or until the tenderloin is tender and very well done. Place the beef and cauliflower into a slow cooker on the stove top. Cover and cook for 30 to 45 minutes or until well heated. Turn the crockpot to high and heat the meat and cauliflower mixture for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove the beef and cauliflower mixture to a serving dish and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Kalamata
ingredients: 4 veal shanks, in one piece | seasoning salt for cooking | 1 carton plain yogurt
instructions: Season veal shanks on all sides with seasoning salt. Cook in skillet for 20 minutes. Place 1 cup yogurt on each piece of veal shank. Serve with salad.

title: Cashew Lime-Lime Burritos
ingredients: 2 cans limeade concentrate | 1 package frozen unshelled cashews, coarsely chopped | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 10 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix the limeade concentrate, cashews, and cherries. Spread equal amounts of the mixture among the tortillas. Roll up, and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and the tops are golden brown, 20 to 30 minutes. Allow to cool before removing from the pan.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,white sugar,italian salad dressing,chicken tender,fine herbes,bean,rocket,spaghetti
title: Crunchy Crunchy Bolognaise Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups mixed fresh beans ( such as pinto beans ) | 1/2 cup orange juice concentrate | 1/2 cup chopped rocket | 1/4 cup white sugar, or to taste | 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenders ( cut into small pieces ) | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon fine herbes | 14 ounces spaghetti
instructions: Cook and stir the mixed beans, orange juice concentrate, rocket, sugar, and chicken in a skillet over medium heat until the chicken pieces are no longer pink and beginning to cook, 7 to 10 minutes. Stir the italian dressing into the salad dressing. Bring the sauce to a boil, and cook until the dressing is reduced by half, 1 to 2 minutes. Toss the cooked pasta with the prepared sauce in a large bowl.

title: Cranberry and Cherry Tomatoes With a Sized Cherries
ingredients: 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 3 tablespoons dried cranberries or 3 tablespoons other dried fruit
instructions: Divide tomatoes and cherries evenly and cut in half. Place in a 1 quart glass jar with lid. Top with the snipped dried fruit. Let sit at room temperature for 1 hour to develop flavors. Serve while still warm.

title: Vanilla Bean Hoagies
ingredients: 1/4 cup bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 sprig fresh thyme | 4 hoagie rolls | 1 teaspoon instant powdered bacon-flavored bouillon, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Combine bouillon cubes, vanilla bean, and thyme in a saucer.

title: Mexican Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 rump roast | 1 cup red enchilada sauce | 4 -5 lbs of canned red enchilada sauce | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Marain roast in enchilada sauce while in crock pot. Slice vanilla bean in half lengthwise.

title: Beer Battered Buns
ingredients: 12 ounces beer | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon of your favourite beer
instructions: Pour beer into a heat proof bowl, then dissolve the baking soda in the beer, using a spoon. Pour into the heated beer. Cover with a clean cloth and leave to sit in a cool place overnight. The next day, remove the cloth and stir well. Re heat and serve with new meat or vegetables. These buns freeze well.

title: Simple Niter kebbeh
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 teaspoons ketchup | 500 g spaghetti, spaghetti shaped ( or other 'noodle'shapes may be used, i find that those look too short ) | 1 small apple, chopped | 1 small green pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup dates, pitted and chopped
instructions: Boil water for pasta, add salt and cook until al dente and drain.. Wash your hands, and use to make sure they are dry to avoid burning them, otherwise you will have noodles with clumps, and it will take a bit of napkin to remove those. If the noodles are salted, they should still be firm to the touch, but slightly chewable. Meanwhile heat the ghee in a large frying pan on low. Add in spaghetti and mix well until the spaghetti is coated in ghee and it starts to soften a bit on the edges. Mix in the apple, green pepper, and dates.

title: Pistachio Dessert  1999
ingredients: 8 tablespoons shelled pistachio nuts | 32 fluid ounces sweetened condensed milk | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine the pistachios and condensed milk in a small saucepan over a low heat. Stir, and bring to the boil. When it comes to a boil, you can add the maraschino cherries. Stir, reduce heat to low, just to maintain a low boil. After about 2 minutes, you can stop stirring and put in a well buttered glass bowl for a few moments. The taste will deepen with time and you don't want the mixture to stick. Stir again and cool to room temperature. Refrigerate if your not using right away. Use within about 4 weeks. Note, you can also store this in the freezer in a jar until just before serving. Note, you can get away with a mixture of these pistachio powders called almond spice, ground almonds, or even just mixed by themselves, and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,oatmeal,garam masala,pizza crust,xanthan gum,salsa,lime juice,almond extract
title: Salsa Sticky Onion Baked Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 2 tablespoons oatmeal | 1 prepared pizza crust ( see note )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f and position rack in centre of oven.

title: Mile High Gooseberry and Pear Salad
ingredients: 1 medium goatberry | 8 -10 cherry tomatoes | 8 -10 mozzarella cheese, cut into strips | 1 bell pepper, deseeded and cut into strips | 1 large mixed bean, cut into wedges | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon mustard ( optional )
instructions: Wash the goatberries & peep off any dirt. Wash and pat dry thoroughly. Cut the goatberries into halves or quarters. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile, heat the chopped up vinegret to simmering. When the water reaches a boil, drop in the tomato halves, then the guavas. After about 10 minutes, when the guavas are floating, take them out and place the tomatoes into a sink. Pour off all the water. When the tomatoes are cooked through and still warm, place them on paper towels to drain. Remove the goatberries from the water and cut them into half or quarters. Scoop out the insides of the guavas while you're waiting for them to cool. Once the vinegret is cool enough to handle, remove any damaged or wilted bits of the goat's skin and cut it into medium sized cubes. Add all the ingredients into a large serving bowl the ingredients should be at hand but not too deep and too cold to eat. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let stand in the fridge to let the flavours mingle. To serve, line four salad bowls with the goat's skin. Place the mixed berries in the bowls. Sprinkle with the caster sugar and mustard if using. Place two or three strips of mozzarella cheese on top of each mound. Place in a preheated oven for 5 - 10 minutes till the cheese has melted and begins to brown slightly. Serve in small plates with extra mozzarella cheese sprinkled on top or with extra mustard to taste.

title: Hot Spicy Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces sweet red peppers, diced | 12 fluid ounces chili sauce | 1/2 ounce chili powder | 1/2 ounce butter | 1 ounce flour | 1 ounce half & half
instructions: Mix all ingrediants together. Simmer to thicken. Store in freezer up to 2 months.

title: Cherry Corned Beef
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon margarine, melted | 1 corned beef brisket | 2 tablespoons chopped dried tart cherry
instructions: Prepare charcoal or gas grill with high sides or preheat gas grill with high sides. Brush corned beef with melted margarine, place on prepared rack and grill for 15 minutes, turning once, until tender. Turn corned beef. Place dried cherries, 1 tbsp salt, and 1 tbsp pepper in small bowl. Arrange corned beef on cherry. Wrap tightly and refrigerate leftover corned beef while making next steps. Remove beef from refrigerator about 15 minutes before barbecue is done. Place beef on heated grill and continue grilling until beef begins to brown and cherry flavors meld, about 15 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,pepper sauce,chili sauce,quark cheese,extra beef,artichoke heart
title: Baked Artichoke
ingredients: 2 packages frozen artichoke hearts, thawed ( or a mix of artichoke hearts and peas ) | 10 1/2 ounces extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup quark cheese | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( depending on desired heat level ) | 1 1/2 cups vegetable shortening or 1 1/2 cups cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place thawed artichokes in a greased 9x13 baking pan. Set the artichokes aside. In a mixing bowl, combine beef, cheese, chili sauce, and pepper sauce.

title: Deep-Dish Frittata With Charred Chilis
ingredients: 1 dinner roll, thawed overnight in the refrigerator | 3/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, finely grated | 2 -3 garlic red chilies, deseeded and finely chopped | 10 green onions, roughly chopped | 40 g ground walnuts
instructions: Slice off roll about 1/4 inch thick, from one end of roll. Remove the roll from roll and place on paper towels. Pat the roll lightly to remove excess moisture. Preheat oven to 180°c. Combine cheese, chilies, green onions and walnuts in a bowl.

title: Kool-Aid
ingredients: 1 cup fresh bean sprouts | 1 -2 lime, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup gin or 1/2 cup white rum
instructions: Wash sprouts and trim any root or tough ends. Dry thoroughly on paper towels. Put the lime juice, white pepper and or rum into the bottom of a small clear glass serving bowl or a pretty dish or jar. Pour the gin/rum over the sprouts and let sit for 45 - 60 minutes.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,sauce,bean sauce,chocolate syrup,half,beef sirloin steak
title: Chocolate Beef With Poblano Chile Strips and Beans
ingredients: olive oil or butter | 4 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and seeded | 1 can baked beans with sauce | 12 fluid ounces half-and-half | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/8 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place the chilies on a foil lined jelly roll pan.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,ancho chili,curd cottage cheese,chili powder,beer,chicken breast fillet,peach,veal
title: Ancho Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chili | 2 chicken breast fillets, sliced | 2 tablespoons dry curd cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon beer | 2 slices canned peaches, sliced and seeded | 2 slices veal, sliced
instructions: Heat the peanut butter in a skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the chili powder and ancho flakes.

Random Ingredients: egg substitute,yellow mustard,almond extract,tomato puree,cherry tomato
title: Amanda's Cherry Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 4 ripe cherry tomatoes ( or 1 1/2 pounds cherry tomatoes ) | 1 1/2 cups light egg substitute | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard ( or 1 small regular-dry mustard ) | 3/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Carefully unpeeled, halved tomatoes crosswise. Chop. Place in processor and blend until well mixed all ingredients. Pour into a resealable container and freeze at least 2 hours. Note, the dressing can be kept in the freezer 8 hours or overnight.

title: Teddy's Easy Rice Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked fusilli or 2 cups uncooked rice | 1 egg white | 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and chopped | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, lightly beat egg white and egg yolk in medium bowl. Stir in brown sugar, turmeric, and rice wine. Add egg mixture to boiling water in a 2 quart saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick, 5 - 6 minutes. Cool slightly.

title: Spinach with Onions (Kong Neeo)
ingredients: 2 medium spanish onions, cut into half inch thick slices | 1 box frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well squeezed ( use fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 4 cups fish sauce | 1 package pectin
instructions: Place onions in a 9x13 glass baking dish. In a saucepan, pour enough water to reach halfway up the sides of the onions. Heat to boiling over high heat. Place spinach in a sieve over a medium bowl and squeeze as much moisture as possible from spinach. Place liquid in a small bowl and set aside. Place fish sauce in a medium bowl and mix in the spinach. Cut pectin into 1/4 cup portions and set aside. Place onions in a large skillet and stir fry over high heat about 3 minutes or until the onions are beginning to color. Stir onions and remaining fish sauce into spinach mixture and heat, stirring frequently, about 3 minutes or until mixture coats a spoon. Pour mixture onto plates and sprinkle with onion mixture. Enjoyed, for a heartier meal just be sure to serve it as a first course, then garnish with shredded coconut, chopped cilantro, chopped chives or julienned onions.

title: Pineapple-Saffron Potatoes and Berry Jardinas
ingredients: 2 cans pineapple chunks | 1/2 medium red potato, cut in 1/4-inch cubes | 1 jar raspberries in jam or ( 10 ounce ) jar raspberry preserves | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | saffron | sliced pimiento, for garnish | 1 bottle medium-vinaigrette beer ( recommended ( bells ) | 2 -3 cups frozen peas
instructions: Drain first 5 ingredients in a colander. Add saffron and grand marnier to fruit mixture. Set aside. In a shallow dish, mix preserves and grapefruit juice to make 1 1/2 cups. Marinate 4 - 4 hours in refrigerator or overnight. Turn 1/4 cup marinated marinade with a wooden spoon or spoon and add to fruit mixture. Set aside to cool and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,lime zest,cider vinegar,red pepper flake,pork shoulder
title: Tangy Caribbean Pork Chops
ingredients: 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup long grainy mustard | 4 teaspoons lime zest | 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes | 3 lbs pork shoulder, trimmed of excess fat
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, combine vinegar, mustard, lime peel and red pepper flakes. Add pork and stir to coat. Cover and cook 7 - 8 minutes, or until pork is no longer pink but tender.

title: Greek Pasta With Oranges and Feta and Grand Marnier
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine pasta or 1 lb similar dried pasta | 1 pint orange soda, such as grand marnier ( about 1/2 a bottle ) | 1 quart grand marnier, chilled, well chilled so it doesn't burn ( about 2 quarts, about 5 quarts total ) | 3 oranges, cut in half crosswise and then slices crosswise into 1/4 inch-thick quarters ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 cup reduced-fat feta cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted, water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook until tender but firm to the bite, stirring often, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, measure 1 cup the orange soda into the cup of grand marnier and set aside. When the pasta is done, drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the liquid and then set aside. Cut the orange slices into thin slices and return to the pasta pot. Pour half the orange soda into the pasta pot with the orange soda and the grand marnier. Add the orange slices and feta and toss to combine. Drain the pasta and return it to the hot pot. Toss well to coat the pasta with the orange soda mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: walnut,tuna olive oil,new potato,garlic,milk ricotta cheese,meatball
title: Caccia di Marmellata
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh potato sticks | 1/4 lb fresh meatballs, sliced | 8 ounces fresh tuna in olive oil, drained and broken into pieces | 2 ounces walnut pieces | 15 ounces fresh whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh chopped garlic
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender. In a separate bowl, mix ricotta, walnuts and garlic. Set aside. Drain potatoes and mash. Add tuna and meat mixture and mix gently to combine and distribute seasonings. Pour into greased glass baking dish and put back into a cold oven. Cook until heated through and top with garlic croutons and fresh parsley. Yum.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,egg,red onion,white bread,chicken bouillon,golden syrup
title: Easy Onion Croquettes
ingredients: 4 large red onions, sliced | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 2 eggs | 3 slices white bread, tore into crumbs | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place onions in microwave safe bowl and sprinkle with bouillon. Heat in microwave until broth is clear. Beat eggs and whisk in bread crumbs. Pour over the onions in a bowl and stir until onions are coated. Spread a cookie sheet with oil spray. Drop the onions on the cookie sheet. Bake 45 minutes in oven, until nicely browned and a knife inserted into the crumbly centers comes out clean. Place crumbs on a plate and top with gravy to drippings.

title: Couscous for ZWT-9
ingredients: 200 g pink beans, soaked overnight ( or cannellini beans ) | 1 cucumber, peeled
instructions: Soak the beans in cold water 1 hour and drain completely. Remove the peels and peel the cucumber, leaving only around 2cm of unpeeled flesh at the root end. Cut the flesh into long narrow strips. Place in an earthenware or ceramic bowl or bowl and cover with hot tap water. Cover and let stand for 1 & 1/2 hours, until softened. Drain the beans and rinse well in cold water. Line a baking tin with baking paper. Cut off the beetroot, leave the top of the beetroot intact. Using a very sharp knife, lift the beetroot in one piece and cut into wedges or chunks. Place the beans in the bowl with the cucumber. Use a knife to toss the beans around in the cucumber. If mixture is too loose and tacky, add water to produce smooth consistency. Spoon the couscous into a serving bowl and spoon over the bean and cucumber mixture. Serve piping hot with a selection of dressing of your choice.

title: Curried Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb cremini mushrooms or 1 lb baby portabella mushrooms, sliced | 2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Set aside about 1 tablespoon of the mushroom stems for garnish for garnish if desired. Slice caps into 1/4 inch slices. Heat small amount of oil over medium heat until hot. Place mushrooms in bowl of ice water to soften for about 10 minutes. Drain and set aside. Heat oil in same skillet over medium high heat until hot. Add mushrooms. Brown on all sides. Place reserved mushroom stems in small cup of coffee or soup to heat for 10 minute pour mushroom broth of mushroom stems into skillet. Boil mixture about 5 minute remove from heat and stir in curry. Serve hot mushrooms as garnishes on platter or in individual bowls.

title: Pastry Dough With Beef or Turkey
ingredients: 1 recipe pastry for a 9 - 10-inch double crust pie | 1 egg yolk | 1/2 bay leaf
instructions: Line a baking sheet with non stick baking paper. In a small bowl beat egg yolk and add bay leaf. Beat again for at least 1 minute or until yolk is very thick. Carefully remove bay leaf and start with the meat or turkey cut into small pieces and place in a medium sized bowl. With your hands mix thoroughly but don't overwork. Place in pastry case. Top with a spoonful of egg mix. Cover with a pastry sheet and a cloth so it doesn't dry out. Dab pastry generously with glaze. Cover top and edges of pastry with cloth and bake at 400 for 30 to 45 minutes until top is golden brown but not crusty like.

Random Ingredients: shortening,chinese white rice wine,vegetable stock,italian seasoning,baby spinach,broad bean,peach,allspice
title: Aunt Gunley's Peach Sichuan
ingredients: 1 package frozen broad beans | 3 cans sliced peaches in syrup ( drained ) | 1/4 cup chinese white rice wine | 3 tablespoons shortening | 1 teaspoon dry italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 bag baby spinach, rinsed and patted dry
instructions: Heat a 12 inch sauté pan over medium heat for 1 minute. Add the peas, rice wine, shortening, oregano and allspice. Cover and reduce to low heat. Cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in the vegetable stock and spinach. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, or until a gravy has formed.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,penne,beef sirloin steak,chicken broth,vegetable broth,celery,thyme leaf,green bell pepper
title: Beef Goulash With Penne
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef sirloin steaks | 4 medium celery, chopped | 1 1/2 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 1 1/2 cups reduced sodium chicken broth | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 lb penne
instructions: Cut steak crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Combine beef, celery, 1 1/2 cups broth and remaining ingredients in a heavy large skillet over medium high heat. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium. Cover and let simmer, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon until beef and celery are near tender, about 7 minutes. Meanwhile, cook penne in a large pot of boiling water until tender but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Add remaining 3/4 cup broth, noodles and meat mixture to skillet and heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,pine nut,chicken,red bell pepper,anise seed,ketchup
title: Korean Chicken Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground chicken | 4 slices firm white bread ( can use any bread of your choice ) | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 cup ketchup | 1 cup finely diced red bell pepper
instructions: In bowl, mix thoroughly ground chicken, bread, and anise seed. Form into four patties. Place patties in oiled fry pan and cook over medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes or until outside is crusty and lightly golden, turning over once so that each side cooks evenly. Remove to cookie sheet or plate with meat. Serve warm with salsa, chili sauce, and other ingredients, topping with a sprinkling of sesame oil as desired.

title: Saurage-Tahini Lamb With Sauerkraut
ingredients: 4 tablespoons light dijon mustard, divided | 1/4 cup light brown sugar, packed | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1/4 cup mirin | 1 lb boneless lamb shoulder or 1 lb lamb rib, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 cup sauerkraut, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 2 medium cucumbers, unpeeled, seeded, cut crosswise into 4 wedges
instructions: Combine 1 tablespoon mustard with the brown sugar and the tahini and mix well. Spread over lamb and marinate at least 2 hours or up to 6 hours, stirring occasionally. Prepare corned beef or lamb if using lamb skewers. Mix sauerkraut, remaining 1 tablespoon mustard with 1/4 cup water in a shallow baking pan. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f. Oven for 30 minutes or until just slightly browned. Add cucumbers and 3 tablespoons mustard to sauerkraut, toss well and serve with the remaining salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: mexican tomato,panko breadcrumb,thyme sprig,chicken thigh,wheat tortilla
title: Slow Cooker Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 1 can mexican-style diced tomatoes | 12 bone-in skinless chicken thighs | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon panko breadcrumbs | 4 whole wheat tortillas, warmed
instructions: Add tomatoes with juice, thighs, thyme, panko, and tortillas to slow cooker. Insert the skewers through the center of the chicken, leaving a small pocket in each piece. Cover, and cook on high for 1 hour.

title: Faux Heirloom Heirloom Heirloom Pepper Salad
ingredients: 4 heirloom tomatoes or 1 regular tomato | plenty of assorted assorted assorted assorted assorted fresh vegetables
instructions: Cut the heirloom tomatoes in half. Put them on small plates with assorted assorted assorted assorted vegetables around. Drizzle the heirloom tomatoes with olive oil.

Random Ingredients: pea,thyme sprig,hard egg,cremini mushroom,bulb garlic,beef bouillon cube,pumpkin pie spice
title: Pot Sticker
ingredients: 6 whole dried cremini mushrooms | 1 bulb of garlic, unpeeled | 4 ounces cremini mushrooms | 2 beef bouillon cubes, crushed | peas | 2 tablespoons pumpkin pie spice | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprigs or 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: In a large roasting pan or pot add the dried mushrooms, cracked garlic and cremini mushrooms. Dissolve the crushed bouillon in enough boiling water to cover the vegetables. Let stand for 30 minutes. Drain the ingredients well and add the peas. Stir well. Add the pumpkin pie spice and rosemary to the vegetables. Taste, correct seasonings etc. Pour into a jar and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,cremini mushroom,chicken broth,extra virgin olive oil,jalapeno,cranberry sauce
title: Gourmet Mushroom Stuffing
ingredients: 1 jalapeno or 3 jalapeno pepper, diced | 10 cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried cranberry sauce | 3 teaspoons fresh minced jalapeno peppers ( optional ) or 3 teaspoons pickled jalapeno peppers ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, put chicken broth, cremini mushrooms and canned jalapeno's in. Cook a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are softened. Remove and set aside. Heat olive oil in skillet on medium high heat. Stir in mushrooms. Sprinkle with dried cranberry sauce or jalepeno peppers.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,horseradish,mandarin orange,taco seasoning,red chili pepper,apricot preserve
title: Italian Salsa
ingredients: 4 cans mandarin oranges, drained to 1.5 cups liquid | 1 can mandarin orange segments, drained completely liquid | 1 package taco seasoning | 4 ounces dry parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 jar russian-style hot pickled red chili peppers, drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a large mixing bowl.

title: Beer and Pigeon Peas With Szechuan Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 cup beer | 1/4 cup cornmeal | 1/4 cup chopped green olives | 1/8 cup sliced sauerkraut with pimenton peppercorns, well drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon ground szechuan peppercorns | 1/2 cup sweet red onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons hot sauce
instructions: Combine beer, cornmeal, olives, sauerkraut with pimenton peppercorns, szechuan peppercorns, sweet red onion, and hot sauce in a large nonstick skillet. Reduce to a simmer over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until reduced slightly, about 10 minutes. Cover and chill, covered, for up to 2 hours. Serve.

title: Italian Pear Cakes
ingredients: 1 quart pears, peeled in their natural juice, and diced ( about 4.5 cups ) | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning
instructions: Spray griddle with cooking spray. Preheat griddle to 325°f and line 8x8 inch baking dish with parchment paper, extending about 2 inches from the surface of the grill. Mix pears and italian seasoning in a medium bowl and set aside. With your fingers, mix pears and seasoned italian oil in a bowl to create a thick coating. Spoon about 1 teaspoon of batter onto prepared baking dish. Bake until brown and pears are crisp, about 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Remove to a rack.

title: French Salad With Italian Sausage
ingredients: 150 g shrimp | 1/2 cup italian sausage links | 1 tablespoon raw sugar | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing ( see note ) | 1 tablespoon egg substitute | 1 cup finely shredded lettuce | 1/2 cup finely shredded jicama
instructions: Shell and devein prawns, set aside. Cook sausage to your favourite taste add sugar, salad dressing, egg substitute, and cooked sausage to the shrimp and mix well. Add chopped lettuce and jicama and mix well. Arrange prawns on serving dish and pour over the salad. Note, it is believed that toasting means cooking time is added to ingredients, but i don't think cooking time is given in recipe. Cooking time is for shrimp and prawns time is to cook the shrimp and prawns so they are cooked in less time and still very brightly colored.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,ketchup,pine nut,pineapple peach salsa,milk chocolate,chinese five spice powder,nori,kikkoman soy sauce
title: Chinese Spicy Pepper Cookies
ingredients: 1 container of sliced canned peaches in syrup | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup unsweetened pineapple-pecan salsa | 1 tablespoon kikkoman soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 sheet nori | 2 tablespoons pine nuts
instructions: Remove the hard shell from the nori and cut the nori into long strips about 1/4 inch wide and 12 long. Place the nori slices in a small bowl of cold water and soak for 10 minutes. Place the nori, pine nuts and ketchup in a small saucepan and heat. Stir in the peach syrup. When the mixture is warm, remove from heat and let cool. Stir in the soy sauce, baking powder and five spice. In a small bowl, combine the kikkoman spicy mixture with the peaches. Stir into the sauce. Using 2 teaspoons of mixture, form the dough into small balls and roll into the nori to coat. Place in a medium size frypan of hot water. Keep the pan covered with a paper towel until needed so that the water does not dry up. Fill the frypan with about 1/2 of the pineapple mixture and place over medium high heat. Cook the cookies, turning them over constantly with tongs, until the outsides are browned evenly. Take the cookie out of the pan onto plates and place them in a single layer on top of the hot pepper peppers. Sprinkle them with the pine nuts. Serve with mango flavored ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Grated Asparagus
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh asparagus | 1 1/2 cups cold water
instructions: Trim the ends off the asparagus, cut off any tough tips and remove the woody stalk part of the asparagus. Cut the tips away from the tough ends and cut off the tough ends if any part, if using the woody stem part. Bring the water to the boil, add the asparagus and let it boil gently and gently for about 5 minutes. Take the pan off the burner, remove the asparagus and place in a colander in the sink, drain the asparagus well, pressing hard to remove the water clinging to the tough stems. Return the water to the boil, add the cold water and boil for 3 to 5 minutes or until asparagus is fork tender. Drain the vegetables reserving the cooking water and serve hot, with a few slices of toasted bread on the side, such as the rye bread. The dish is great accompaniment to any meal with an herb salad.

title: Beef and Cheese Stuffed Poblano Peppers (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 1/4 lb lean hamburger | 1/4 cup chopped roasted poblano pepper | 7 -9 small fingerling potatoes, peeled ( about 3-inch diameter ) | 1 package baby spinach ( about 8 ounces ) | 8 cooked jumbo shrimp
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat, heat the hamburger. When the hamburger is brown, drain off any excess grease. Place poblano peppers in the bottom of an 8x8x2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle the inside of the pan with the peppers, leaving the stems on. Place a potato between the stems, cut side down, in a 2 inch wide strip. Carefully lift the strips of skin away from the poblano peppers using a vegetable peeler.

Random Ingredients: white onion,vegetable stock,golden raisin,bulgur,cilantro,white sugar,ham,red chili pepper
title: Mujadarra (Middle Eastern Bulgar Balls and Meatballs)
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked bulgur | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 small white onion, chopped | 1/4 cup black and wild red chili pepper | 1/2 cup smoked ham, chopped | 3 tablespoons golden raisins | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Place bulgur in a large bowl, and mix with vegetable stock and sugar, until the bulgur has soaked up all the flavors. Let mixture stand for 10 minutes, then stir in onion, chopped chile, ham, raisins, and cilantro. Using your hands, shape mixture into 1 inch balls. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add meatballs, and cook until browned and cooked through, about 1 hour. Transfer meatballs and crumbled bulgur balls to a large serving bowl, and stir until heated through.

title: Baked Apple Salad With Brown Rice and Apples
ingredients: 3 tart apples ( i like ruby red delicious ) | 1/2 cup brown rice, cooked ( cold ) | salad greens
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large round casserole dish and mix well. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Stir to break up all browned bits. Note, i do not like red. Variation, stir 1/2 apple into the rice and salad before baking.

title: Cheese Pate (France)
ingredients: 1 lb white onion, minced | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Note, this is not a smooth and finely ground mixture. Measure out 1 lb of the minced onion and set aside for topping the finished dish.

title: Chinese Sticky Baked Jicama
ingredients: 5 cups jicama, peeled and diced small ( about 2 medium ) | 3/4 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup sweet mango chutney | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line 3 large baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine jicama and mango chutney in bowl of blender and process until smooth. Spoon mixture into bowl and sprinkle with cardamom. Toss to coat. Spoon jicama mixture onto prepared baking sheet. Bake until golden, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,raisin,turmeric powder,chili powder,italian sausage,pumpkin puree
title: Pumpkin Raisin-Sausage Mix
ingredients: 2 lbs bulk italian sausage | 4 large dried fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 1/2 cups pumpkin puree | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional )
instructions: Grind the fenugreek seeds to a fine powder or grind them to crumbs. Heat skillet and add sausage and fry until no longer pink. Drain grease and stir in spices along with the pumpkin. Cook, stirring constantly, for an additional 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Chilean Nuts
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup good tasting tamari | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon cube ( or 2 chicken portions ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 lb natural farmer cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, combine tamari & boullion. Cover and refrigerate approximately 20 minutes. Drain the cheese and pat dry with paper towels. Slice or crumble the cheese into pieces & coat with the tamari mixture. Heat canola oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Add cheese and cook until it begins to turn brown. If it starts to turn dark, drain off excess oil. Serve with pita bread.

title: White Beans and Chick Peas
ingredients: 5 cups cooked cannellini beans | 3 cans chick-peas, drained and rinsed
instructions: In 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker combine the beans and chick peas. Cover and cook on high setting 3 to 4 hours or low setting 6 to 8 hours, until hot.

title: Lamb Cutlets and Pesto (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 13)
ingredients: 2 lamb cutlets | 3 teaspoons basil pesto sauce | 3 teaspoons pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Place chicken cutlets in shallow baking dish. Combine pesto and pesto in bowl. Spoon 1 tablespoon pesto over chicken.

title: Tequila Parsnips & Beet Baked
ingredients: 8 ounces cooked beet ( peeled and sliced 1/4-inch thick ) | 4 ounces parsnips, peeled and sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1/3 cup orange juice or 1/3 cup apple juice | 3/4 cup white tequila | 2 tablespoons chopped shallots | 1/3 cup ice water | 7 lasagna noodles, no-boil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f & butter a 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish. Mix together the beets, parsnips, oranges, tequila, & shallots, then pour in the water. Cover & bake for 30 minutes. Add noodles just to the top of the beet mixture & return to oven for another 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red chili,ginger,hummus,bacon grease,yellow squash,fruit juice,meatball,thyme sprig
title: Spicy Bacon Salad With Sweet Lamb Meatballs
ingredients: 12 -24 cooked meatballs, frozen | 1 small yellow squash or 1 small zucchini, sliced | 3/4 tablespoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 -2 tablespoon of fresh grated ginger | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons bacon grease | 1/2 teaspoon dried red chili, deseeded | hummus | fresh thyme sprig, to garnish
instructions: Remove any excess fat from the frozen meatballs. Dry the meatballs by placing them on a paper towel lined baking tray and freezing them overnight in the fridge. When they are ready, transfer the meatballs to a bowl. Combine the honey and the ground red chilli. Add the meatballs and leave for at least 20 minutes. For a soft consistency, leave until just before serving. Garnish with honey and thyme.

title: Black Cherry Walnut Crumble
ingredients: 1 lb fresh black cherries | 1/2 cup dried graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place cherries in a single layer on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle cheese over the cherries, and sprinkle with dried crumbs. Bake 10 minutes, or until crumbs are lightly golden. Sprinkle with walnuts, and continue baking 5 minutes, or until walnuts are toasted. Sprinkle with dried rosemary. Serve warm or cool.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,dish pie shell,rosemary leaf,plum tomato,date,anise seed
title: Moroccan Red Curry Pastry Recipe
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chunky red curry paste | 1 plum tomatoes, seeded & diced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, finely crushed | 1 tablespoon chopped dates | 1 deep dish pie shell, such as tasty tart shell, thawed if previously pressed | finely chopped rosemary leaves, for garnish
instructions: Place curry paste in a microwave safe serving bowl. Add tomatoes, rosemary, aniseed & date pieces, mix well and microwave on high 4 - 5 minutes or until curry paste is fragrant and tomatoes soften slightly. Pour contents into crust and garnish with rosemary leaves. Serve with your favourite savoury dishes.

title: Mushroom, Horseradish and Chocolate-Pancake Recipe
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried porcini mushrooms ( optional ) | 300 300 g grated chocolate or 300 g good drinking chocolate | horseradish ( or your favourite flavour )
instructions: If using dried mushrooms, soak in plenty of water until soft. Strain. Put the drained mushrooms, sugar, grated chocolate and a little horseradish into a bowl and mix gently. If using dried mushrooms, add a little water to thin if necessary. The mixture will thicken rapidly. Serve warm with fresh cream.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,garlic clove,pork,potato,cilantro,chicken bouillon granule,cheddar cheese
title: Potato Ole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground lean pork | 1 cup cooked & cubed potatoes | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/3 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 1/2 tablespoons tomato sauce or 2 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: In a large frypan, cook potatoes and garlic in oil in microwave. Stir in chicken bouillon. Cook until potatoes are tender, but not brown. Stir in tomato sauce and cilantro. Heat through.

title: Quick and Easy Pasta Pronto
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked elbow macaroni | 1/1 green bell pepper, chopped | 7 tablespoons salad-seasoning, divided | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boiling. Add elbow macaroni and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,tarragon,white pepper,beef tenderloin,corn muffin mix,hot chili sauce
title: Beef Tenderloin Medallions With Chimichurri Sauce
ingredients: 1 package dry corn muffin mix | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon or 2 teaspoons fresh tarragon, minced | 3/4 cup hot chili sauce | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 lb beef tenderloin
instructions: Preheat broiler. Prepare muffin mix according to package instructions. Spread 2 teaspoons tarragon over the bottom of a 13 x9 inch baking dish. Arrange beef on top of the tarragon and sprinkle with 1/8 cup hot sauce. Using tongs, place under preheated broiler and broil 3 - 6 minutes or until desired doneness, turning once. Remove beef from pan, let stand 5 minutes. Slice beef as thinly as possible, slice across the grain into thin half moon slices. Place sliced beef and sauce over the beef. Sprinkle with the cheese, pepper and remaining 1 teaspoon tarragon. Broil beef 3 - 6 inches from heat 3 - 4 minutes until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,chili pepper,sun tomato oil,paprika,coriander seed,grain brown rice,spring onion,rump steak
title: A Unique Steak Bowl
ingredients: 12 ounces rump steak, cut into long thin strips | 2 spring onions, chopped | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds, crushed | 2 tablespoons spanish paprika | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1 cup long grain brown rice
instructions: Soak rice noodles for approx 2 hrs and rinse & dry well. In large skillet place the beef & sprinkle over the coriander seeds cover with water, bring to boil then reduce the heat, cover & simmer for 15 minutes. Takes around 30 mins to an hour & depend on your steak, i usually make it as quick & easy as 40 mins. This recipe works best w/a little water, but as long as it is left in the pan to absorb excess moisture & dry out a little bit. To prepare beef bowls, pour hot water over a large wok or large bowl lined w/o a damp paper towel. When water is boiling, pour water into bowl & soak for 30 seconds. Place drained noodles on wok. Toss in meat & add 1 1/2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp curry powder, chili pepper, sundried tomatoes, rice & mix well. To serve, pile on noodles then top w/ more meat & curry if desired. Garnish w/ a drizzle of sundried tomatoes, 2 tsp spred pesto & 1 tbsp green salad. Enjoy.

title: Spinach Tortellini Florentine
ingredients: 250 g spinach or 250 g arugula pasta | 500 g self-raising flour | 60 g strawberries, chopped
instructions: Boil, steam or microwave the spinach or arugula in covered steamer, for 6 minutes or until just wilted and steamy. Sift the flour into a bowl, stir in the spinach or arugula, then stir in the strawberries. Turn onto floured surface and knead until smooth. Roll into circle in olive oil about 12cm x 18in. Prick with a fork several times to allow air to escape and dry out if not covered. Heat a griddle or skillet until very hot. Cook tortellini on one side until golden, then turn and cook on other side for a further 5 minutes. Place under a preheated grill for 5 minutes or until crisp and golden and cooked through.

title: Quick and Easy Grilled Fish & Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs fish fillets | 1/4 cup unflavored gelatin | 2 cans great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 3 -4 1 - 1-2 lbs boneless beef ribs
instructions: Slice fish into 1 pieces and sprinkle with gelatin. Drain beans and combine with beans in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours. In a separate pan heat the juices of your fish fillet, if using. Cook for 5 minutes. Turn and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until fish is cooked through and flakes easily. Serve over basmati rice, with steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,guinness stout,confectioner sugar,tomato green chilies,poppy seed,bamboo shoot
title: Texas Canning
ingredients: 12 cups guiness baked guiness tomatoes and green chilies | 4 cups confectioners'sugar | 4 cups diced bamboo shoots | 1 cup poppy seeds | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Bring guiness to a boil in a large pot. Lower heat and continue to simmer over low heat until guiness is reduced by half. Cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Transfer to a large saucepan. Beat confectioners' sugar, bamboo shoots, poppy seeds, and baking soda in a bowl until well combined. Pour guiness, including the vinegar, into the sugar mixture. Bring to a boil.

title: Easy English Toffee
ingredients: 8 ounces white chocolate chips | 8 ounces buttermilk | 1/2 bell pepper, deseeded and diced | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: Put in a bowl the white chocolate and buttermilk together in a microwave. Heat on high for 2 - 3 minutes or until chocolate melts. Stir. Stir in the peppers and sweet chili sauce. Use this mixture to stuff any unopened cashew nuts.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,cremini mushroom,pie crust,vanilla sugar,paneer cheese,green chile,gin,lard
title: Paneer Mushroom Pate
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lard | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar, divided ( for the vanilla sugar version use 1/4 tsp vanilla extract, adjust to taste ) | 3/4 pint sauerkraut | 3/4 cup pancaneer cheese | 1 jar diced green chiles | 1 can sliced cremini mushrooms | 2 packages pie crusts ( ready-made and refrigerated, or store-bought )
instructions: In a medium size bowl mash lard and the vanilla sugar until lump free. Rinse sauerkraut under cold running water to remove any sand. Chop cheese in fine pieces and add to the bowl with the cheese and the chiles. Set aside and allow to reach room temperature for about 10 minutes. In a food processor, puree half of the sauerkraut into a nice creamy paste. Preheat oven to 375°f. Spread the batter into 1 pie shell then spread sauerkraut over that and spread a layer of sauerkraut. Spread pancetta and green chilies over pancetta, then spread the remaining sauerkraut and cheese over the cheese. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 375°f until crust is light golden brown. The pate is done when it puffs up and is firm to the touch but still chewy in the middle.. Note, a tip, if using frozen pie crusts, allow to thaw completely before using. If possible, return pate to the refrigerator for up to 1 to 2 hours prior to baking to increase its firmness.

title: Quinoa and Spring Onions Saute
ingredients: 3 cups cooked quinoa | 2 handful baby carrots | 1 large spring onion, cut crosswise into 4 pieces
instructions: Warm the quinoa in a pot for about 5 minutes or until it begins to swell a bit. When the quinoa begins to swell and plump, reduce heat to medium. Add carrots and onions. Saute for about 2 - 3 minutes or until onions begin to soften. Remove the quinoa mixture from the heat. Transfer the quinoa in a bowl to serve. Serve warm with any vegetables from the saute and garlic.

title: Warm Mushroom Soup (Gf)
ingredients: 6 white button mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 can tomato paste | 1 1/2 cups soy milk
instructions: Clean the mushrooms and slice them in half. Place the sliced mushrooms and tomato paste in a pot and simmer for 10 minutes. Pour in soy milk. Cover and refrigerate until chilled. Serve.

title: Beer Rice and Humus
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1/2 cup hummus | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon beer
instructions: Combine all ingredients except hummus, rice and beer, in a skillet and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes, stirring often, until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.

title: Garlic, Herb,  Garlic,  Wine Oatmeal  Mix
ingredients: 1 lb baking mix or 1 lb quick-cooking oatmeal | 1 cup white wine ( i use bbq ) | 1 cup olive ( i use stuffed olives ) | 1/2 cup dried garlic chives | 3 tablespoons sesame ( you 'll need approx 1/2 cup ) | 1/4 cup fresh chives ( can use green onions ) | bouillon
instructions: Drain the olives and rinse them in cold water. Drain them well, remove only the pits. Warm the wine, stir in the olives, garlic, sesame seeds, and chives and bring to boil. Add the dry mix to the boiling liquid and boil rapidly. Boil rapidly and only after a minute or two, the mix will sink to the bottom of the pot.. You may need to add just enough boulion to keep mixture at the right consistency. You may need to cook a couple of minutes longer or until the mixture has a gooey consistency. There should be no liquid at all in the mix. Turn on the broiler, pour oatmeal into two 8 x 4 inch baking dishes. Put two whole cloves on top of each dish, broil until browned.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,avocado,red chili pepper,jalapeno jack cheese,mayonnaise,chicken wing,pork loin,white cabbage
title: Spicy Mexican Pork Rolls and Chiles
ingredients: 3 lbs pork loin, cut into 1-inch chunks or 2 1/2-3 lbs pork loin, cut into 1-inch chunks | 2 cups mayonnaise ( i use hellman's ) | 4 large jalapenos ( red anaheim ), seeded and sliced in 1/4-inch wide rings ( i use the green and orange bell peppers, but leave the peppers out if they ) | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 large head white cabbage, cut crosswise into 2-inch wedges ( i use napa ) | 2 large avocados | 1 large head white cabbage, cut crosswise into 2-inch-wide wedges ( i use napa ) | 2 heads firm white cabbage, cut crosswise into 2-inch-wide wedges ( i use napa ) | 2 1/2 cups crispy mexican jalapeno jack cheese, coarsely shredded
instructions: If using pork, heat oil in heavy 5 or 6 qt dutch oven until shimmering. Add pork and cook until brown, stirring frequently, about 10 minutes. Remove and set aside. In a bowl, whisk mayonnaise and next 5 ingredients until blended, about 2 minutes. Stir in pork, chiles, and 1/2°c. Shred cabbage and stir until mixed. Cover, put lid on pot, and simmer until cabbage is well shredded, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly oil a 13 x 9 x 2 inch glass baking dish. Line the inside of the dish with a piece of reynolds wrap aluminum foil, shiny side up. Place the pork mixture in the foil. Fill the dish with the cabbage mixture. Bake, uncovered, until hot and bubbly, about 35 minutes. Meanwhile, make the avocado salad dressing by peeling the avocados and cutting into 1/2 inch wide ribbons. Combine avocado pieces and jalapenos in large bowl. Cut remaining cabbage into 6 wedges. Arrange among 4 serving plates, top with fried crumb mixture and sprinkle with cheese. Serve pork rolls and chiles over avocado salad, or alongside cabbage salad, or use pork and chicken wings over rice.

title: Easy No Salt Pinto Beans
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs no-salt-added canned pinto beans | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons dry mustard
instructions: In a large dutch oven combine undrained rinsed well drained and washed pinto beans with mustard seeds or a combination of other seasonings. Cook over medium heat 4 - 6 hours, adding liquid gradually as it evaporates. Drain thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: large mushroom,rhubarb,spice,rice noodle,quinoa,grain rice,philadelphia cream cheese,broccoli
title: Super Easy Microwave Rice Noodle Bake
ingredients: 16 ounces philadelphia cream cheese ( softened ) | 1 cup rice noodles ( i used whole wheat ) or 1 cup basmati rice ( i used whole wheat ) | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese ( softened ) | 3/4 cup quinoa ( i used white ) | 4 large mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1 lb large mushroom ( sliced ) | 1 bunch broccoli ( sliced, or 1 package frozen ) | 2 cups rhubarb ( fresh )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an electric mixer and mix well until smooth. Spoon half the mixture into a 9x13 inch casserole and layer as follows. 1/2 of the noodles, 1/2 of the cream cheese, 2/3 of the quinoa and 1/2 of the philly cheese mixed together. Repeat the layers until there are no more noodles and cheese/non cheese mixture. Cover and microwave on high power for 5 minutes. Turn off the microwave and let it sit for 25 more minutes. Cut the rhubarb into small pieces, add to the remaining mixture and mix well. Serve with crusty italian bread and fresh parsley to taste.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,rice vinegar,yellow squash,apricot preserve,white miso,lemon,poblano chile,shrimp
title: Shrimp With Pumpkin Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb large uncooked shrimp ( raw shrimp ) | 2 tablespoons minced poblano chiles | 1 tablespoon minced orange peel | 1 tablespoon minced lemon peel | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon white miso | 1/2 cup orange juice | 3 tablespoons hot cooked rice ( optional )
instructions: In a large non stick skillet, simmer shrimp and poblano chiles in boiling water about 3 minutes. Peel shrimp and set aside. In a small saucepan, add orange peel, lemon peel, rice vinegar, preserves, miso, and orange juice.

title: Spicy Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup cremini mushroom | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 teaspoon spices | 1/8 teaspoon pepper ( optional ) | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Remove stems and finely slice mushrooms. Combine in a medium bowl with salt, vinegar, pepper and cayenne. Let sit in fridge for 20 minutes prior to grilling. Lightly sear or grill to desired doneness.

title: Microwave Macaroni and Beef
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 jar enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cook macaroni according to packet directions. Heat sauce in microwave on high until hot. Stir in noodles and coat with sauce.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,lemon wedge,red chile,plum tomato,gingerroot,coriander seed
title: Berbere (Spiced Tomatoes)
ingredients: 4 ripe plum tomatoes, cored and cut into wedges | 2 teaspoons crushed lemongrass, pulp | 2 teaspoons crushed coriander seeds | 2 slices fresh gingerroot, peeled and finely grated | 1 small red chile, deseeded and finely chopped ( remove seeds if you want less heat ) | 3/4 cup canola oil
instructions: Blend all of the ingredients together until smooth or with a pinch of black pepper. Stir in the oil and serve at room temperature along with steamed rice.

title: Spicy Bacon Wrapped  Veggies
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, sliced | 3 large radishes, thinly sliced | 1/8 - 1/4 cup mixed vegetables | 2 tablespoons cinnamon sugar | 1 lemon, juice of ( or a mixture of the two ) | 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup bacon fat
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp, remove to a paper towel with slotted spoon, drain, set aside. Sauté lettuce and vegetables in bacon fat for 5 minutes or until crisp tender, remove and keep warm. Place bacon on a cutting board and use a knife to slice diagonally about 3 - 4 long and ¼ inch slices. Place each slice of bacon between 2 pieces of wax paper. Wrap around a tablespoon of veggies to create a cross on the edge of each piece. Sauté for 10 minutes or until crisp and brown and crispy, remove to paper towel and keep warm. Repeat the process until all the veggies are made. Add the spices and lemon juice, heat over low until hot and sugar dissolved. Serve warm.

title: Oaxacan Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked spaghetti | 1 orange bell pepper, chopped | 4 sprigs fresh rosemary sprigs | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: In a saucepan of boiling salted water, cook spaghetti until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain and reserve 1/4 cup of cooking water. Return pasta to the saucepan. Stir in orange bell pepper, rosemary sprigs and thyme.

title: Foil for Chips, Fritters and Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup sofrito sauce | 3 cups cooked and cold sesame-colored rice or 3 cups cooked and cold rice | 4 large fresh mint leaves, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Combine sofrito and rice in a bowl and stir to thicken. Sprinkle each serving with salt and pepper and garnish with a sprinkling of sliced mint.

title: Crock Pot Chicken Parmesan
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb chicken piece | 1 cup shredded italian cheese blend | 1 cup finely chopped sweetened coconut ( optional )
instructions: Spray crock pot with non stick cooking spray. Layer chicken on crock pot. Sprinkle top with cheese & coconut. Cook on low 2 to 4 hours. Serve with warm bread, pasta, potatoes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding,worcestershire sauce,brazil nut,sherry wine,cayenne,italian seasoning
title: Italian Baked Pudding
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup aged brazil nuts, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a glass mixing bowl, combine the sherry, worcestershire sauce, sherry, italian seasoning and cayenne. Add nuts and stir until evenly coated. Pour into a buttered shallow baking dish and bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour or until top is golden brown and pudding is bubbly and firm to the touch. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Filipino Beef Satay With Coconut Milk and Vegetables (Samadar Belay)
ingredients: 1 lb round steak | 1 can coconut milk | 1/4 cup light soya sauce | 1 large romaine lettuce ( washed and chopped ) | 1 can bamboo shoots
instructions: Slice steak into narrow strips. Put both the meat and the coconut milk into a food processor and blend til a smooth paste forms. In each bowl, place a few pieces of the meat and a few pieces of the lettuce. Add some soy sauce. Stir fry over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. You can also add more and hotter soya sauce depending on your taste. Remove from heat and stir in the vegetables. Serve with rice or cooked noodles.

title: Chicken Legs in Macaroni-Pasta-Carmesan-Pasta
ingredients: 2 chicken legs, separated at the knee and thigh joints, with bone in | 1 package dry pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the chicken legs and skin side down in a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, mix the cornmeal with about 1/2 teaspoon each salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Pour the cornmeal on top of the chicken. Sprinkle chicken pieces with about 1/2 teaspoon of the garlic powder. In a separate small bowl, mix the pasta with a tablespoon or so of the remaining salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Pour pasta over the chicken and the garlic powder. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until pasta is tender and chicken is cooked through, about 35 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,irish whiskey,yellow tomato,cabbage,potato,baby green,porcini mushroom,italian sausage
title: Irish Breakfast Lazy Day Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 2/3 cup irish whiskey | 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 1 package mixed baby greens | 1 package rice noodles | 5 small baby potatoes | 1 can diced yellow tomatoes, drained | 1 package sliced cabbage | 1/2 cup sliced dried porcini mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease bottom and sides of a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Place whiskey, sausage, mixed greens, rice noodles, potatoes, tomatoes, cabbage, mushrooms, and porcini mushrooms in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,parsley,salt pepper,graham cracker,purpose flour,chocolate cookie crumb,peanut butter
title: Southern Butter Cookie
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup peanuts | 24 ounces boneless pork loin, trimmed | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | salt and pepper to taste | 1 cup peanut butter | 1 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray cookie sheets with cooking spray. In a small bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs and peanuts. Press pork evenly into crumb mixture. Dredge pork in flour, and shake off excess. In a small skillet, melt peanut butter, then pour peanut butter liquid into skillet. Cook and stir until sauce is smooth. Set sauce aside. Spread peanut butter mixture evenly over cookie sheets. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Pear Dip With Jalapenos
ingredients: 5 medium fresh pears ( about 1 pound ) | 1/2 cup jalapeno pepper, chopped
instructions: Make sure the pears are completely unpeeled. Peel and core the fruit, and slice into 1/4 to 1/8 pieces. Chop the jalapeno peppers. Pour the jalapeno into a medium bowl, and toss with the pears to coat. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,chicken breast,granny smith apple,baking powder,cod fish fillet,beef steak,adobo sauce
title: Chipotle Chicken with Chipotle
ingredients: 4 lbs of bone-in chicken breasts or 4 lbs skirt steaks | 1 cup ground black peppercorns | 2 granny smith apples, peeled, cored, chopped ( about 5 cups ) | 1 1/2 cups of fresno chipotle chile adobo sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground black peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup of fresthe fish fillet, diced ( i just use my macaroni grill bouquet garnish ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons whole balsamic vinegar or 2 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar
instructions: For the chipotle, combine the black peppercorns and the chipotle sauce, in a blender or mortar and pestle. Mince the chipotle into bits, removing each clove. Put all of the ingredients except the diced fish in a large glass baking dish. Toss chicken in the chipotle puree and marinate for at least one hour, or overnight. Cook the chicken uncovered over medium heat until done. Serve over boiled or steamed cod fish. Garnish, balsamic reduction is optional and adds flavor to the dish. You can also garnish as desired. You can also make a bed of vegetables for the meal with this, or if preferred, add some chopped red onion to it. You can also garnish the dish with diced tomatoes, salsa, or anything else you wish.

title: Gramma's Pickled Beets
ingredients: 1 large beet, with greens | 2 tablespoons table salt | 1/2 red bell pepper | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Peel beet and trim away any leaves, or scrub them well. Scrub and quarter them. Place in a bowl, cover with water and soak for 30 minutes. Drain. Place beet in large saucepan of salted boiling water, add allspice and salt to taste and cook, turning beet over occasionally, until tender, about 15 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: mochiko,colby monterey jack cheese,arborio rice,cashew nut,double cream,corn,kalamata olive
title: Arancini (Arborio Rice) Bake
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups uncooked arborio rice | 3 cups double cream ( or milk and 2 or 3 tbsp white wine ) | 1/4 cup corn | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, sliced | 2/3 cup cashew nuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons mochiko | 2 cups shredded colby-merey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook rice according to package instructions, but be careful not to over cook it. In a small saucepan over medium heat, heat the remaining cream and cook til it just begins to boil, then remove from heat. Mix the rice into the cream mixture, stirring to coat it in cream. Spread a small shallow baking dish about 13x9 inches with cooking spray. Spread the arborio rice evenly over the dish, and top with the remaining cream, olives and cashews. Sprinkle with mochiko. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes, or until cheese has melted.

title: Apple and Black Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 4 medium tart apples, washed, peel, and very finely diced | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds
instructions: Place the apples in a very small, heavy saucepan. Sprinkle with half the sesame seeds. Cover with clean, barely soaked, cold water, bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally for 30 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the pot from heat and set aside for 10 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer apples to an ovenproof serving dish. Discard any liquid accumulated over the dish. Sprinkle with remaining sesame seeds. Serve warm.

title: Cherry-Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 1/3 cup apricot jam | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Stir apricot jam with chili powder in small pan on high heat until jam comes to a boil. Remove from heat and set aside. When glaze is cold stir in warm apricot mixture. Remove from heat and brush over your favorite savoury biscuits or biscuits. Serve immediately with fresh fruit or vegetables. I prefer fresh fruit such as strawberries. These glazes last 2 days in the fridge in a sealed container in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,cumin,coconut oil,lemon zest,beef sirloin steak,lebanese cucumber,peanut oil
title: Beef Satay With Peanut and Cumin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 600 g beef sirloin steak, finely sliced | 1 lebanese cucumber, trimmed and cut into 4cm slices | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 orange, zest of, minced | 1 lemon, zest of, minced | 2 teaspoons roasted ground cumin | 1 tablespoon desiccated coconut oil
instructions: Wash the steak under running water, dry well and set aside. For the satay, heat a large, heavy based frying pan over high heat. Add the oil, peanut oil and beef to pan, reduce heat to medium and cook until beef is cooked through, about 12 min, keeping temperature as close to medium as possible.. While the beef is cooking, make the dressing, in a mortar, pound the cumin and lemon zests into a paste. Combine these paste with a few tbsp of water in a small bowl, season with salt & pepper and transfer to a warm dish. Add the coconut oil to pan when beef is ready to be used. Return the beef to pan and coat well with the dressing, remove from pan if there is any leftover dressing and set aside. To serve, place beef on serving plate, top with satay and drizzle with dressing.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,hamburger,chunky salsa,cashew,cocoa,cannellini bean,lipton onion soup mix
title: Nacho Beef Burgers
ingredients: 3/4 lb hamburger | 1 package lipton onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons spaghetti, cooked | 1/2 cup chunky salsa, hot | 2 tablespoons cashews, salted | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Mix together sloppy joe and other ingridients until blended. Chill for an hour or more. Form into patties, or hamburgers, and grill over medium hot coals or charcoal for about 3 minutes per side. Serve on fresh salsa or pico de gallo with sour cream and grated cheese.

title: Apple Cinnamon Maconara
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant pastry dough, dough | 2 cups hard apple cider ( or you can use apple juice but the flavors will not be the same -- the apple will be quite sweet ) | 4 ounces mascarpone, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Press your dough dough through a pastry bag or you can use a biscuit cutter. Place it on a plate. Using your fingers, break off a small ball. Roll it out to roughly 1/3 inch thick and place on 1 parchment lined sheet. Roll our the dough over the rolling pin until it forms a circle approximately 5 inches in diameter, and cut circles or hearts out of them. Do this with the apples to prevent discoloration. Place the biscuits on a greased cookie sheet and poke a few holes into the dough with a fork. Bake for 20 minutes, remove and let cool for a few minutes. Remove the crust from the oven if it is a bit too hot to the touch, sprinkle with cinnamon to taste. Place one cup of the apple filling in a medium size bowl and spread in a thin layer. Spoon the rest of the apple filling in, along the edges, on top of the cinnamon chocolate. Enjoy.

title: Cashew Crumb Toasted Sandwich
ingredients: 1 baguette | 2/3 cup hot water | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup roasted salted cashews, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup freshly shredded pecorino cheese
instructions: Slice baguette in half lengthwise and toasted. Spread with dijon and spread with hot water. Sprinkle with crumbs. Arrange cashews on top of bread. Sprinkle with cheese and drizzle with cheese. Cut into 4 pieces and serve immediately.

title: Broccoli, Beef and Potato Soup
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, halved, sliced | 2 small carrots or 300 g carrots, chopped | 200 g broccoli or 200 g frozen broccoli | 500 ml beef stock | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes or 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 soup can of condensed yellow onion
instructions: Put beef stew into pot, add stock and bring to boil. Reduce. In separate pan fry carrot or broccoli till just tender. Put beef into soup pot, add onions with peppers and heat through stir in soup can. Pour over broccoli and onion in soup pot.

title: Faggots
ingredients: 1 pound ground pork shoulder | 12 white peppercorns, crushed | 1 can partridges, drained, rinsed | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed and cooled | 1 tea bag
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the pork shoulder, peppercorns, and partridges in a large bowl. Fold phyllo pastry sheets in half. Place filling on one piece of phyllo, and arrange a tablespoon of filling along the short end. Fold over the unfilled half. Repeat with the remaining filo sheets. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,romano cheese,bacon,cayenne,maple syrup,bean sprout
title: Easy Bacon, Bean Sprout Salad
