ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 2 packages fresh bean sprouts | 2 leaves kaffir lime leaves, torn into strips | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 1/2 cup pure maple syrup, or more as needed | 1 pinch cayenne, or to taste
instructions: Cook bacon slices in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, about 10 minutes, turning once. Add bean sprouts and kaffir lime leaves to skillet and cook until brightened and tender, about 3 minutes. Stir in romano cheese and maple syrup.

title: Pastry for Two
ingredients: 9 inches pastry for two crust pie ( recipe is included ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup lime juice | 1 lb frozen romano cheese blend or 1 lb feta cheese, thawed and drained of excess juice ( about 2 cups ) | 1 large shell pasta, cooked
instructions: On floured surface, roll out one pastry sheet into a 12 inch circle, about 1/4 inch thick. Cut into four even sections, creating four circle shapes on each side. Roll each circle about 1/8 inch thick on all sides to cut a round edge. You should have 16 circles in each shape. Transfer one circle into the pastry shell and prick remaining circles with a fork. Sprinkle 1/2 cup lime juice over the rolled out circles, then cover each circle of dough with another circle. Fold pastry over the filling to partially enclose and crimp edges with a fork. Repeat to make eight more circles for two more recipes. Place pastries on greased aluminum foil and bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes. Remove and allow pastries to cool for 1 hour or so, then slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: tostada,red wine vinegar,tomato soup,barbecue sauce,deli turkey,pine nut,swiss cheese,nutmeg
title: Swiss Cheese Turkey Tostadas
ingredients: 3 cups swiss cheese, grated | 2 cups deli turkey, thinly sliced | 1 can condensed 98 % fat-free cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 10 tostadas ( warmed ) | 1/3 cup barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg, to taste | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the cheese, turkey, and soup. Coat a 9 x13 dish with cooking spray. Spoon the mixture from the tostada shells. Arrange the filled tostadas over the cheese in a single layer. Cover with 1/2 of the cheese mixture, and top with another 1/2 cheese mixture. Drizzle the barbeque sauce over the cheese, and sprinkle with the remaining ground nutmeg. Cover, and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Applebee's Beef Roast
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili, minced | 1 teaspoon balsamic salad dressing | 8 ounces applesauce | 3 lbs russet potatoes, peeled cut in half lengthwise, then crosswise into 1/2-inch slices | 3 lbs boneless beef roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Place roast in a dutch oven and set over medium high heat. Pour 1 tsp chili and 1 tsp dressing onto the roast and mix well. Pour applesauce and 1/2 tsp balsamic over the roast, cover, and bake until meat is tender and fork tender. While beef is baking, cook the potatoes until tender, drain.

Random Ingredients: tapioca starch,lemon zest,pepper sauce,nutmeg,green chili pepper
title: Betsy's Tapenade
ingredients: 2/3 cup tapioca starch | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon lemon chili pepper, minced | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 dash hot pepper sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until they are well blended. Refrigerate overnight for a light summery meal.

title: Guiness Beef Steaks
ingredients: 4 lbs chuck steaks | 2 tablespoons mixed spice | 2 tablespoons rose water ( fresh ) | 8 ounces guinness stout | 1 pinch cream of tartar
instructions: Mix the rosewater, guinness, cream of tartar and mixed spice thoroughly with the steak. Use a roasting pan to lay the steak out so the dish won't spill up a bit in the oven. Bake at 300 degrees f for 45 minutes or until medium rare, turning occasionally. Serve sliced with a sauce.

title: Lao Buchi (Indian Cabbage Breading)
ingredients: 10 ounces masa harina flour | 6 ounces cabbage, chopped coarsely | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 ounces ghee | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed
instructions: Mix the flour and water to make a soft dough. Add more flour if necessary. Cover the bowl and set aside for about 10 minutes. Mix and knead the dough well. Divide the dough into 12 parts. Prepare a ball of dough with some flour and cover the dough with a clean cloth. Let it rest for about 20 minutes. Meanwhile wash cabbage and remove the leaves and finely chop them. Cover the cabbage with water. Bring to a boil for 7 minutes. Drain and put in large bowl. Add the oregano, cabbage, and the ghee. Knead the dough well to incorporate all the ingredients. Divide into 14 equal sized portions. Using a rolling pin, roll out all the portions into circles approximately 1/8 in diameter. Cook in 2 batches in a heavy skillet or deep fryer at 300f for about 3 - 4 minutes. If the bottoms turn brown, they are done. If the bottoms turn brown, they are done. Serve hot as a side dish, or with chutney or rice.

title: Cream Cantaloupe & Cashews
ingredients: 200 g cabbage, shredded | 200 g cantaloupe ( honey-roasted melon ) | 200 ml double cream or 200 ml whipping cream | 50 g cashews, roasted salted
instructions: Heat over to 190c. Put the cabbage and cantaloupe in a large sauce pan. Whip the cream with 50g of crushed cashews. Pour on top, toss and let sit for 5 minutes. Spread with rest of cashews. Serve with extra cashews on side or on the side.

Random Ingredients: barbeque sauce,chicken bouillon cube,mix,red wine,thyme sprig,wheat tortilla,salad oil
title: Salad With Chive and Tomato
ingredients: 6 tablespoons salad oil | 6 tablespoons barbeque sauce | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 large roll, cut into 8 wedges | 6 large whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Whisk together the oil, barbeque sauce, wine, bouillon cube, and thyme sprig until well blended. Add the roll wedges and toss to coat. Heat the oil until hot and cook the tortilla wedges about 1 minute on each side, until browned. Serve with the tomato.

title: Roasted Hazelnut Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnut butter ( at room temperature ) | 1/2 cup sherry wine ( or other fruity red-wine )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Have a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. In an electric mixer fitted with a beaters, mix hazelnuts with sherry, 1/4 cup butter and 1/4 cup warm butter until mixture is fluffy and dry. Transfer to a pastry bag fitted with a 1 inch round tip.

Random Ingredients: fennel leaf,mango chutney,cherry,margarine,salmon fillet,yeast,sunflower oil,chicken bouillon powder
title: Smoked Salmon with Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 (.25 ounce ) package rapid rise yeast | 1/4 cup sourdough sunflower oil | 1 cup mango chutney | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon powder | 1 1/2 cups diced smoked salmon fillets | 1/2 cup diced sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 3 cups chopped fresh fennel leaves | 1/4 cup chopped sunflower oil | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 2 ounces margarine
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup of the sunflower oil. Stir in the chutney and the bouillon and leave to stand for 5 minutes. In a saucepan, heat 1 cup of the sunflower oil. Add the salmon and season with salt and pepper. Cover and leave to marinate for 10 minutes. Heat the remaining oil in a large skillet. Add the fennel, and cook over medium heat until softened. Stir in the sunflower oil and margarine. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in the yeast. Spread the salmon mixture evenly over the salmon, covering with the chutney mixture. Cover with a towel and leave to rise in a warm place for about an hour. Preheat the grill. Remove the fish from the marinade and shake off any excess. Cut the salmon into 4 pieces and arrange on a baking tray. Sprinkle with the sugar. Brush generously with sunflower oil. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until crispy and golden around the edges. To serve, slice into portions with a fork and sprinkle with the chopped fennel leaves.

title: Chinese Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon light soya flour | 5 ounces cabbage ( shredded ) | 1/4 cup grape | 1 egg white | 2/3 cup dashi | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon light soya flour | 1/4 cup light soya flour | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil
instructions: Shred cabbage and grapes into fine shreds. Combine together all the wet ingredients and knead until smooth and elastic. Wrap the dough in wax paper and chill for 30 minutes, up to a few hours. Heat the oils in a wok and stir fry cabbage mixture until golden, adding more dashi if needed. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Roll out the dough to ¾ inch thickness on a floured board. Cut into strips as you would for sushi, and place one piece on the lightly oiled board. Spread out the cabbage filling. Roll into a log, then press edges together to seal. Repeat with remaining slices. Heat a skillet to very hot and fry the rolls for about 3 minutes on each side. Drain on paper towels and serve immediately. These have been served with soy sauce if they are very salty soya flour can be added, or you can add brown or black pepper or sugar to taste.

title: Spiced Chocolate Balls
ingredients: 500 g dark chocolate or 500 g sweet chocolate | 450 g good quality cashews | 3 -4 fresh lime wedges | 1 1/3 cups bread flour
instructions: Melt chocolate until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients, roll mixture into balls about the size of a ping pong ball. Place on a greased baking paper lined tray. Refrigerate for half an hour. Preheat oven to 230°c. Place balls on rack of oven and bake for 8 - 9 minutes, or until golden brown. Leave to cool slightly then store in a airtight container or plastic wrap until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,extra virgin olive oil,lemon zest,coriander,mushroom,egg white,flour tortilla
title: Jook Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 cups sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 beef brisket | 4 medium flour tortillas | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 large egg white, lightly beaten with 2 teaspoons water
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f place mushrooms in small ovenproof dutch oven over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,bell pepper,ciabatta,golden raisin,sharp cheddar cheese,beef stock,chicken thigh,straw mushroom
title: Stacked Chicken Pies
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisin, golden | 6 chicken thighs, boned, skinned, boned, chopped into chunks | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1 box ciabatta, cut into quarters | 1 1/2 cups chopped assorted fresh broccoli | 1 cup halved strawberries or 1 cup halved red currant | 1 cup peeled finely chopped sweet bell pepper | 1/3 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Place raisins in a shallow dish. Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,amaretto,bread flour,brown gravy mix,lamb neck fillet
title: Lamb Gravy for Lamb
ingredients: 1 3/4 kg lamb neck fillets | 200 g prepared brown gravy mix ( packet ) | 125 ml amaretto | 1 -2 green cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon bread flour | 1 packet brown gravy mix ( packet )
instructions: Cut lamb into small cubes. Soak cardamom pods in amaretto. Toss lamb in bread flour. Shake off excess flour. Cook lamb in a saucepan and add the brown gravy mix. Bring to boil for 4 - 5 minutes. If necessary cover and reduce heat slightly. Serve, sprinkled with extra sugar or lemon juice, if desired.

title: Apple Chipotle Meat
ingredients: 4 cups leftover meat ( cubed ) | 2 large tomatoes ( sliced ) | 2 garlic cloves ( minced ) | 1 cup apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 1/2 small apple ( chopped finely )
instructions: Heat up the oven to 350 degrees. In a 9x13 glass baking dish combine all the rest of the ingreedients and mix well. Add meat.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,hamburger bun,plum tomato,chili oil,beef bouillon cube,savoy cabbage,coconut cream,potato
title: Indian Style Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground round | 8 plum tomatoes, cored, seeded, chopped | 2 large potatoes, cored, cut in chunks | 5 tablespoons chili oil | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 savoy cabbage, sliced | 2 -4 cloves garlic salt | 8 hamburger buns, toasted
instructions: Brown ground beef in one tablespoons of the chile oil over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until crumbly in texture. Remove beef and drippings from pan and keep hot. Add remaining ingredients, except buns and cabbage, to the meat in pan. Stir until meat and potato are evenly coated. Reduce heat and simmer about 1/2 hour or until beef is cooked.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,chocolate chip,hazelnut,chicken stock,soymilk,baking soda,radish,golden delicious apple
title: Glazed Hazelnuts and Apples
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts | 2 golden delicious apples, peeled and sliced into 2-inch wedges each | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine | 4 ounces sweet chocolate chips | 4 tablespoons chicken stock | 3 tablespoons soymilk | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 3/4 cup radish, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread hazelnuts on a large baking sheet. Toast nuts in preheated oven until lightly colored, about 10 minutes. Set aside to cool. In a medium bowl, mix chocolates and stock. In a medium saucepan, melt butter. Stir in chocolate mixture, the soy milk, and chicken bouillon with baking soda. Slowly stir in hazelnuts and radishes. Pour into an 11x15 inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered, in the preheated oven 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Remove from baking dish and cool to warm room temperature. Store airtight in refrigerator.

title: Elegant Chicken Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | 2 tablespoons instant hot sauce | 3 tablespoons ground almonds, toasted, divided | 1 tablespoon brewed coffee, divided | 2 teaspoons hot sauce, or to taste | 1/2 pound chicken thighs, cooked, diced | 2 bunches kale - washed, stems removed, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Lay thawed phyllo dough on the prepared baking sheet. Poke a few holes in the phyllo pastry sheet with a fork to vent steam. Spread 2 tablespoons hot sauce in the pastry sheet.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,red chili powder,chicken bouillon cube,chickpea,basil pesto
title: Chickpeas With Basil Pesto
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas | 3 bell peppers, strips | 1/4 cup basil pesto ( homemade or commercial ) | 2 1/4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon red chili powder ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl of food processor, and puree until smooth. Transfer to pot and heat over medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring often.

title: Guinness Sauce
ingredients: 1 bottle guinness stout | 1 container sour cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: In a medium bowl, bring the guinness and sour cream to a boil, and stir. Stir in the garlic salt. Remove from the heat, cover, and refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to develop.

title: Peachy Zucchini Chips With Chickpea Flour (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned chickpea flour | 1/2 teaspoon soya sauce | 3 tablespoons peach schnapps | 1 tablespoon canned spinach leaves | 1/2 medium zucchini, coarsely grated or sliced
instructions: Boil water in a small pan. Make sure it is fairly cold, make sure water doesn't boil into it. Add the oil to a wide frying pan so it is at least 2/3 cm deep and heat. Spray the pan with cooking spray, put in the chickpea flour, and let sizzle for about a minute. Be sure to remove all the air that might be floating above the surface. Mix in the soya sauce, peach schnapps, lemon, and drained spinach. Stir to mix. Place the zucchini on top of the schnapps. Serve immediately.

title: Fajita Chicken
ingredients: 12 chicken wings | 10 slices boiled chicken wings | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon marinade | 1/4 cup cashews | 2 tablespoons green chili peppers, chopped | 2 cups chopped escarole ( optional )
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients into a gallon sized bag. Add chicken and marinade to bag and toss to coat. Seal bag and refrigerate for 1 hour. Arrange chicken on baking sheet, bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes or until cooked through. Top with escarole.

title: Traditional Gravy for Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground veal ( you can use turkey or veal sausage ) | 1/2 lb ground sirloin or 1/2 lb ground sirloin | 1/4 cup raisins ( or currants ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon granulated garlic salt | additional cinnamon as needed
instructions: Note the sirloin/veal is meaty, but there are different cuts of meat and other vegetables such as mushrooms and carrots. I grind my meat with my hands. The result is not too grainy or too stiff. You can play with the flavor. Place all ingredients into a blender or food processor, pulsing until creamy. You may use any meat combination you like to make your gravy. If you like your gravy sweeter, mix in hot cooked pasta and stir well. The gravy can also be made from leftovers from the meatballs as well or frozen leftovers from a meatball.

Random Ingredients: pasta,chicken broth,saffron strand,chicken breast,burrito flour tortilla,bran cereal
title: Chicken Burritos
ingredients: 2 teaspoons saffron strands, crumbled | 12 burrito-size flour tortillas, warmed, or as needed | 4 cups chopped cooked chicken breast | 1 cup dried multigrain pasta | 3 cups hot chicken broth | 1 cup bran cereal, divided ( optional )
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add saffron and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and set aside. Warm tortillas in the same skillet until pliable, about 10 seconds per side. Place about 2 teaspoons of chicken and 1/4 cup of pasta in center of each tortilla.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,half,great northern bean,broth,snow pea,italian parsley
title: Italian White Bean Soup from College Inn
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can chicken stock or ( 16 ounce ) can broth ( 2 cans ) | 1 can sliced mushrooms ( 1-1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | salt and pepper | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor or blender and process till well mixed. Serve hot as is, or chill overnight.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,center pork chop,sea salt,broccoli floret
title: Chinese Spiced Grilled Pork Chops
ingredients: 5 medium center cut pork chops, about 3/4 inch thick | sea salt | 3 tablespoons light mayonnaise or 3 tablespoons reduced sodium mayonnaise | 1 large head broccoli floret, 1 1/2 inches diameter
instructions: Heat grill to medium high. Season both sides with salt. Place pork chops on a large plate. Brush both sides of chops with mayo and season lightly with salt. Scatter broccoli over chops and arrange on the grill. Grill until well browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board and let stand about 5 minutes before serving.

title: BBQ Salmon on a Bun
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 1 teaspoon sesame powder | 2 slices bell pepper
instructions: Place salmon in a bun with the sides facing down. Combine the sugar and sesame and sprinkle over the fillets on top of the fish. Add the sliced pepper on the top. Cook for 15 minutes on medium high or until tender.

title: Greek Yogurt Peanut Butter Barbecue - Grill
ingredients: 1 cup peanut butter | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon ketchup | crushed ice, for basting
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together, blending well. Pour into a barbeque, and grill.

title: Low Calorie Gluten Free Tofu
ingredients: 100 g silken tofu | 250 g of good quality gluten free tofu | 2 tablespoons canned chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon chili flakes ( or as necessary ) | chili flakes ( optional )
instructions: Combine the chocloate, chili flakes and tofu and let it sit for at least 10 minutes to soften the tofu. Wet your hands and roll out the tofu until you’ve got a small cup sized ball. Flatten the balls with some palm sized balls. Cut the tofu into the shape desired. Heat up your pan with a small amount of oil but not as high as you would a normal pan for stir frying on a low heat, to make sure that your sausages are crispy and soft. When the pan is very hot place your tofu ball in the hot pan and let it cook on one side, then turn over and let cook for another minute or so until they finish cooking. Place on absorbent paper at least 15 - 20 minutes after, and check to see if they’re cooked through. If not remove the tofu from the pan to another dish and keep warm in the oven until they are done. Serve in a plate and then sprinkle some fresh chopped chili flakes if desired.

title: Cream Soup (Lebanese)
ingredients: 14 ounces milk | 3 ounces dried chicken stock
instructions: Mix together the milk and stock and heat gently over a simmer. Serve immediately with fresh bread to soak up the lovely broth.

title: Nicoise (Nepal) Pasta with Shrimp and Lentils
ingredients: 5 lbs of dried large shrimp | 2 quarts of cooked lentils | 2 eggs yolks | 1 pinch coriander powder | 1/2 pint vodka | 6 -8 lbs cooked multi colored ham | 1 -2 fresh rosemary sprig | boiled pasta, as required
instructions: First add the dried lentils, to a pot of lukewarm water and cook for about 30 minutes, until al dente. Next add the eggs and yolks, stir the mixture and cook for a few minutes add the coriander powder and vodka and remove from heat. In a roasting pan, cover pasta with lots of white sauce, add some ham and finish baking at 300 f for approximately 2 hours. The pasta will be dry when done. You know the end of the cooking time if it looks dry and crumbly, go ahead and check the next couple of hours, the thinner the sauce the easier it will be serve on top of pasta with lots of freshly grated parmesan cheese.

title: St. Joseph's Daydream Dressing
ingredients: 1/3 cup raw unsalted shelled pistachios or 1/3 cup shelled raw cashews | 1/3 cup raw unsalted pistachios | 3 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 can canned chiles, drained well and chopped
instructions: Soak unpeeled pistachios in boiling water for 30 seconds, remove from water, and pat dry with paper towels. Spread nuts on paper towel to dry slightly. Place all ingredients in a bowl with a tight lid or in an airtight container. Refrigerate for up to 1 week.

title: Korean Grilled Sausage Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup korean sweet chili pepper flakes ( or try gochujang ) | 1 gingerroot, sliced or 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 small chicken leg ( remove the skin ) or 1 small chicken thigh, cut into pieces | 1 fresh kiwi fruit ( optional ) or 3 -5 kiwi fruits, cut into small wedges
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients in a bowl. Add chicken and mix thoroughly to make sure all of the pieces are coated with everything. Let marinate in the fridge for about an hour. Meanwhile grill chicken turning to brown evenly. Alternatively marinate the chicken on bbq. Cook over indirect medium heat for about 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through, or put under broiler to get a crispy texture.

title: Herbed Corned Beef and Cabbage
ingredients: 6 large fresh basil leaves | 5 large dried kale | 1 1/2 pounds corned beef brisket | 1/2 cup half and half cream
instructions: Soak basil leaves in a pan of boiling water. Rinse and set aside. Place brisket in a large skillet. Turn heat to high. When it is just about to smoke, reduce heat to medium. Carefully add basil leaves and kale to skillet. Cook brisket at a brisket's most attractive internal temperature for 2 - 3 hours. When finished, remove brisket from skillet and place in a large bowl. Using a slotted spoon, remove most of the kale in the large bowl. Slice brisket across the grain into 2 - 3 slices. Toss brisket slices and hot kale with brisket mixture. Place brisket and kale mixture in refrigerator to chill before serving.

title: Roasted Green Veggies With Rice (Baked in a Freeze)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cashews ( optional ) | 10 ounces green frozen peas ( thawed ) | 2 carrots ( peeled and cut in half lengthwise ) | 8 small raspberries | 8 large firm ripe apricots, halved | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground habaneros | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400. Place the cashews on a baking sheet and toast them in the oven for about 3 minutes or until golden. Remove from oven and put in a bowl. Add the peas and carrots to the baking sheet. Roast the peas/carrots for about 8 minutes. Remove peas/carrots and carrots. Place the raspberries on a small plate. Douse the fruits with guerre and sprinkle the hazppey or chameseel on top. Cover the raspberries in the hazppey and chameseel. Cover the vegetables with the grated cheese. Bake in the center of the oven until the top layer is dry and the cheese melted, about 15 to 20 minutes. The edges will begin to brown. Cool for about 10 minutes then cut into squares.

title: Slightly Smoked Sea Scallops Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 4 sheets phyllo dough ( approx. 4 x 18 inches ) | 20 large sea scallops ( approx. 1lb weight each ) | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 4 large whole dried chilies | 1/2 cup jasmine rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Rinse the sea scallops with a strainer. Pat dry in a clean towel. Place 2 sheets of phyllo dough in a single layer on a parchment lined cookie sheet or baking sheet. Spread lightly with chili flakes, and 2 scallops on the top of the phyllo dough. Spread the chilies evenly over the scallops. Sprinkle the rice on top of the scallops. Repeat layering 2 more times, spraying chilies lightly with each spray. Cook in oven for 45 - 60 minutes until golden brown on top and rice is tender.

title: Radish and Almond Treenuce
ingredients: radish | 3 tablespoons blanched slivered almonds
instructions: Slice the radishes into thin slices, then slice crosswise 1/4 inch thick. Place the almonds in a mini chopper and pulverize in a mortar. Toss all the ingredients into a large mixing bowl with a fork to mix. The ingredients should remain a little shakery but the almonds should emulsify into a soft and creamy consistency. Add water if necessary to prevent the mixture from sticking to the bowl. Cover and set aside at least 1 hour to allow flavors to develop. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Beef Turnovers
ingredients: 8 large poblano chiles | 2 lbs ground beef or 2 lbs turkey | 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons parsley flakes, dried | 1 can crescent rolls | 1 1/2 cups broth
instructions: Roast open and devein poblanos, reserving seeds for later use. Heat broiler. Place peppers in a baking pan, broil 4 minutes per side, turning halfway through broiling time. Brown ground meat. Drain meat. Stir in stock, accent, cardamom, parsley flakes, and poblanos. Cover pan and simmer 10 minutes. Remove poblanos from liquid. Place one dough on a well floured work surface and use your fingers to form a rectangle 1/2 inch thick. Cover with the next sheet of dough, pressing into dough to seal. Repeat with remaining dough, making a total of 12 strips total. Heat oven to 375°f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Separate dough strips. Place strips in each greased baking sheet without touching. Bake 30 - 35 minutes.

title: Carrot Caramela
ingredients: 4 cups grated carrots | 2 -3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon amarula cream liqueur | 2 cups milk ( whole milk is better )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Microwave on high 4 minute serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rice,allspice berry,oat flour,suet,cayenne powder,pesto sauce,brown rice,oil
title: Brown Rice Balls
ingredients: oil | 7 ounces oat flour | 3 1/2 ounces brown rice, rinsed | 1 tablespoon oat flour | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne powder | 5 ounces shredded suet | 1/2 teaspoon allspice berry | 1 jar sun dried tomato pesto sauce | 1/2 cup dry rice
instructions: For rice balls, preheat oven to 160°c. Grease oven trays. In a bowl, rub 2 oz of oat flour onto the oat flour and rice using your hands. Add cayenne and allspice berries and mix. Roll the rice mixture into 25 balls and place in trays. Place ramekins onto the cookie trays. Mix 1/2 oz oil with the remaining oat flour in a bowl, add the combined olive oil and combine with the pesto. Add the rice, making sure all the grains are evenly coated. Pour 2 - 3 tablespoons of oil over the rice mixture and stir until all is absorbed. Place ramekins into a baking tray and pour the sun dried tomato pesto over everything. Bake in the oven for one hour. Serve with the remaining pesto sauce. Note, if you use store bought pesto sauce, it will be strong and overpowering. This recipe is not based in the size/type of ramekin you'll cook on.

Random Ingredients: burrito flour tortilla,fajita seasoning mix,superfine sugar,apricot,cooking brown rice,chicken thigh,chili garlic sauce
title: Easy Cheater Chicken Burritos
ingredients: 1 package fajita seasoning mix ( or more to taste ) | 1 lb boneless chicken thigh, cut into strips | 1 package burrito-size flour tortillas ( white or yellow ) | 3/4 cup superfine sugar | cooking brown rice ( i use the quick brown rice ) | chili-garlic sauce | fresh apricot, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, brown meat over medium high heat for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Season with 2 tsp fajita seasoning mix, stirring frequently. Remove meat, draining drippings. To pan, add rest of fajita seasoning and fry another minute, stirring often. Return meat to skillet, sprinkle with sugar and cook one minute longer. While sauce simmers, place one tortilla on plate, then top with 2 tbsp rice and some meat and apricots if using. Dip second tortilla in sauce, then the rest of rice. Eat with toothpicks. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,soymilk,black eyed pea,hard egg,chicken bouillon,oyster sauce
title: Black-Eyed Peas - Shri Kebab
ingredients: 1 cup black-eyed peas, soaked overnight | 1 hard-boiled egg, peeled and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon soy milk | 1 green asafoetida powder or 1 teaspoon aniseed, seeds stirred together | chicken bouillon, to taste | oyster sauce, to taste
instructions: Soak black eyed peas for about six hours. Then wash and drain soaking liquid. Place beans in a small pan. Cover with water, and boil until tender. Drain and set aside. In a non stick skillet, stir fry eggs over high heat in soy milk. Add green asafoetida. When egg is firm and begins to brown, remove from skillet with a slotted spoon and place on paper towel. Continue until all the egg is used. Set oil or cooking spray or a small amount of oil on an eight inch square casserole dish. Place drained soaked black eyed peas on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake at 375 degree oven. Meanwhile, in a little bowl, combine chicken bouillon and oyster sauce. Remove casserole dish from oven. Carefully, put black eyed peas in the center of casserole dish. Smooth the top with a spatula to create an even surface layer. Sprinkle top and sides with oyster sauce. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes until topping is golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,cognac,summer squash,plantain,asafoetida powder,italian seasoning
title: Spicy Grilled Plantain Chips (Grilled Asafetida Vegetables)
ingredients: 2 plantains | 4 tablespoons cognac, or to taste | 4 teaspoons white-jack dried chipotle-flavored tamarind sambal oelek or 4 teaspoons ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 pinch dried ancho chile powder, or to taste
instructions: Peel, pit and mash the plantains in a bowl using an electric grater, or a potato masher. Stir the cognac, tamarind sambal, italian seasoning, asafetida powder and chile powder together until evenly coated in spiced mixture. Cover the grilled plantain chips with a sheet of plastic wrap, and press the potato chips onto the plastic, or on top of waxed paper in a shallow baking dish. Cover the dish with a kitchen towel and a rimmed baking sheet and a kitchen towel and a rimmed baking sheet. Grill the grilled plantains by turning the plantains over a few times until golden brown on both sides and just cooked through. Transfer to a cutting board and cut each piece in half lengthwise. Arrange the grilled plantains onto a serving plate and drizzle with the seasoned cognac. Serve or condiments as desired.

title: Italian Style Sausage
ingredients: 1 cup dry red wine | 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seed | 4 cups shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Coat a medium baking dish with cooking spray. Coat the sausage with cooking spray and sprinkle with the mustard seed. Bake in the preheated oven until the bottoms are a bit darker colored, about 15 minutes. Turn sausage over, and cook with the mustard seed for an additional 15 minutes. Remove sausage from the oven, and sprinkle swiss cheese evenly over the top.

title: Hot-N-Sour Bell Peppers
ingredients: 8 yellow peppers, sliced | 3 bottles lager beer
instructions: Place pepper slices into a slow cooker. Pour beer over peppers, and add cover. Cook on high setting 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until peppers are tender.

title: Egyptian Rosemary Rice - Rice
ingredients: 1 cup sushi rice | 1/3 cup finely chopped rosemary sprig | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce
instructions: In a large 3 quart saucepan combine rice, rosemary, curry and tomato sauce. Bring mixture to a boil and then reduce heat. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Fruit Stuffed with Ginger
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2/3 cup finely grated gingerroot | 1/2 cup chopped passion fruit
instructions: Place graham cracker crumbs, ginger and passionfruit in a bowl and mix well. Spoon mixture onto lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake in a 350f oven for 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken noodle soup,snow pea,bulk sausage,white chocolate chip,pork roast
title: Pigs in the Blanket
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork roast | 1 package frozen snow peas | 30 -40 dried pork roll noodles ( about 25 packages ) | 1 bag white chocolate chips | 1 package chicken noodle soup, mix
instructions: Place pork roast in crockpot. Add snow peas and noodles. Pour dry noodle soup mix over all. Cook on low 6 - 8 hours. Remove meat from crockpot and shred. Return meat to crockpot, cover and continue to mix until soup mix is dissolved. Serve meat mixture in a small crockpot with sprinkles on top, as is or serve with melted white chocolate or flavored whipped cream for a treat or as directed above.

Random Ingredients: bacon grease,baking chocolate,gruyere cheese,white pepper powder
title: Swiss Bouchon Bacon Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon bacon grease | 1/2 cup chopped cooked bacon, with fat ( i find that at my house that bacon is a good substitute ) | 3 ounces baking chocolate, chopped with oil | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper powder ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon black pepper powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Butter a buttered 9 inch loaf pan. Put in bacon grease and stir until melted. Stir in a handful of the cheese mixture until it comes to a full, rolling consistency. Add pepper if using. Spread on top of the bacon. Sprinkle with remaining cheese mixture, if desired. Bake for about 45 minutes until cheese browns and comes away from the sides of the pan. If desired, you may break apart some chunks while baking, if you don't have a thermometer, and a knife can go from center to middle this way. Let cool for 3 to 5 minutes before cutting. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bread,cornish hen,chocolate,lime zest,ancho chile powder,graham cracker,kosher salt black pepper,milk
title: Ancho Chile Cornish Game Hens
ingredients: 1 cornish hen | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 loaf crusty bread | 2 slices bittersweet chocolate | 1 teaspoon pure ancho chile powder ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon orange zest ( or to taste ) | 3 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk | 1 teaspoon freshly grated limes, zest of or 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the hen. Place on a cutting board and cut out inside the lower side of the thigh which would have removed the breast section from the hen. Cut the hen into four equal pieces. Slice the bread, then slice 1/4 to 1/2 thick and soak in 3 tablespoons of the condensed milk until you are able to work with it, about 5 to 10 minutes. Melt the chocolate in a double boiler over simmering water.

title: Taquito Tacos
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast, meat removed | 1 scallion, chopped | 1 cup taco sauce | 8 corn tortillas
instructions: Put pork in a large skillet, cover with water and simmer over low heat until an internal temperature of 145 degrees f is reached. Remove from heat, cover and let sit for 20 minutes. Drain and discard water. Shred meat into pieces. Heat the taco sauce on the stove over medium heat until it coats the back of a spoon. Layer 1/2 the tortillas with meat, sauce, and scallions.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,shichimi togarashi,citrus peel,red bell pepper,irish cream,dripping
title: Shichimi Carpaccio
ingredients: 1/4 cup hazelh oil | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 red bell pepper, finely diced | 1/2 pound mixed citrus peel | 1 cup shichimi-togarashi ( japanese seven spice ) | 2 tablespoons sweetened drippings, or as needed
instructions: Combine 3 tablespoons olive oil, balsamic vinegar, red bell pepper, and mixed citrus peel in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,hoisin sauce,bamboo skewer,pimiento,grand marnier,red pepper flake
title: Peking Skewers
ingredients: 4 cups hoisin sauce or 4 cups sweet and sour sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 2/3 cup grand marnier or 2/3 cup other orange-flavored liqueur | 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest | 12 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 20 minutes, then rinsed ( about 1/2 of a skewer ) | 1 jar pimientos, drained
instructions: Pour boiling water over the hoisin sauce and red pepper flakes in a small bowl. Let the sauce stand at room temperature for up to 3 hours, turning occasionally. Stir in the grand marnier. Add the lemon zest and remaining salt to taste. Skewer the soaked skewers at least 1 from the end of the skewers. Place them on a platter and chill for 30 minutes. Drain any excess liquid left in the bowl. Garnish with the pimientos and serve. The sauce can be made ahead to this point, refrigerated for up to 1 day.. The glaze can be refrigerated up to 3 days, covered in the refrigerator.

title: Coconut Curry Sauerkraut with Spinach
ingredients: 1 pound kielbasa, cut into bite-size pieces | 7 ounces baby spinach leaves, torn into bite-size pieces | 1 can coconut cream | 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Toss sausage and spinach in the coconut cream for 5 minutes over medium high heat. Place on baking sheet and cook for 10 minutes, stirring once the sausage begins to brown.

Random Ingredients: white bread flour,farfalle pasta,black pepper,red chilies,water
title: Pasta With Cracked Chilies and Fherkin
ingredients: 400 g farfalle pasta ( bowled ) | 2 tablespoons whole white bread flour | 1 red chilies or 1 green chili, chopped | 200 milliliters water or 200 milliliters red stock, depending on the weight and liquid needed | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Place the flour in a bowl and pour in 250ml water, gradually whisking. Then add the chilli and season well with black pepper. Add the farfalle, pour in enough boiling stock to cover, and stir over a medium heat for 10 minutes. Cook until the pasta is tender, drained, and then toss through the sauce.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,vanilla,mirin,grain rice,cayenne pepper,coriander powder,arborio rice,cucumber
title: Easy Baked Rice with Cucumbers
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked short-grain rice | 1/4 cup cucumber ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup arborio rice | 2 tablespoons mirin ( chinese cooking wine ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla or 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 2 x 1 inch baking pan with some olive oil spray or coat with cooking spray. Mix rice, cucumber, arborio rice and mirin, and spices together. Mix well. Place rice mixture into the baking pan and spread evenly. Bake for 90 minutes. Cool before cutting into squares and serving.

title: Cambodian Cashew Nut Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup roasted salted cashews, chopped | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped mint
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender except mint leaves.

title: Ragout of Chicken - for Two or More!
ingredients: 2 -3 cups skim milk | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 3 -4 chicken strips, skin on | chopped fresh parsley, to garnish
instructions: In a large glass bowl, pour milk, vinegar and chicken strips. Stir gently. Chill overnight, turning the chicken frequently. Sprinkle chicken with parsley.

Random Ingredients: green pea,mustard seed,walnut,green onion,sea salt,lebanese cucumber,chicken stock vegetable,hot pepper sauce
title: Pea Soup With Walnuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup walnuts, shelled and finely chopped | 1/3 cup fresh green peas, shelled | 1/3 cup green onion, finely chopped | 0.5 can chicken stock or ( 10 3/4 ounce ) canvegetable stock | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, crushed | 1 small lebanese cucumber, peeled and finely grated | 5 -6 drops hot pepper sauce ( add more if desired ) | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt or 1/4 teaspoon regular salt
instructions: Put the walnuts and peas in a shallow ovenproof bowl and microwave on high for 2 - 3 mins, stirring or shaking the bowl frequently. Remove from microwave and stir in the green onion, stock and mustard seeds and stir well. Chop the cucumber into thin slices, stir into the soup and serve immediately sprinkled with hot pepper sauce.

title: Pumpkin Fritters
ingredients: 12 frozen breadcrumbs | 6 fluid ounces pumpkin puree ( canned pumpkin ) | 4 fluid ounces canola oil | 1/4 cup turbinado sugar | 1/4 cup ground almonds
instructions: Melt the turbinado sugar and ground almonds in a skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly so as not to burn.

title: Pineapple in Coriander (Cilantro) Sauce
ingredients: 4 pinesapple in juice | 1/3 cup coriander leaves ( cilantro )
instructions: Roughly chop the fruit and mix. You may add a small amount of sugar if you like. Serve with rice. If you omit ground corriander, you may use dried coriander.

title: Creamy Pork
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloins, trimmed | 1/3 cup miracle whip | 1 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1/4 cup sliced greek olive, loosely packed
instructions: Cut tenderloins crosswise in half and then crossways in 1/4 inch slices. Slice each slice crosswise in 1/3 inch slices. Heat 1 tbsps. Olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Quickly add pork and cook turning often, until browned, 4 to 6 minutes.

title: Indian Eggplant (Aubergine) Patties
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili pepper | 2 tablespoons dried apricots | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon dried parsley sprig | 2 ounces ground lean turkey or 2 ounces chicken | 10 ounces canned pineapple juice | 4 eggs
instructions: Heat up your grill grill. Combine first six ingredients. Form mixture into patties that are approximately 1 3/4 inches thick on the long side and 1/2 inch thick on the wide side. If the burgers are not well done right away they may not sear all the way. Grill until cooked through. Transfer patties to a serving plate and set aside until cool enough to handle. Slice the burgers as desired. Serve on a platter, garnished with your favorite garnishes.

title: Fried Fresh Ham
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lean ham | 1/2 cup margarine | 3 cardamom pods
instructions: Peel and slice the ham thin. Slice the ham into fine 1 thick slices. In a heavy skillet heat the margarine and cardamom on medium heat. Fry the ham until golden brown. Add the ham to the skillet. Cover and fry for 5 minutes. Drain of fat before serving..

Random Ingredients: ouzo,rosemary,corn bread mix,white shoepeg corn,soymilk,rice noodle
title: Ouzo With Noodles and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked rice noodles | 8 ounces white shoepeg corn, drained | 1 tablespoon ouzo | 1 1/4 cups soymilk | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 1 1/2 cups ouzo | 1 1/2 cups ouzo | 5 tablespoons rosemary, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to in a saucepan, place a large, heavy bottomed casserole on medium high heat for 5 - 6 minutes, just to get it warm. Turn the heat down to a low setting. Add 1 cup of the soy milk to the pot.

title: Salsa con Parma (Pancetta Salsa)
ingredients: 10 ounces salsa, store bought or homemade | 1 lb pancetta, diced
instructions: Bake pancetta at 300 degrees. In a frying pan, heat salsa, until hot. Place pancetta in bowl and pour salsa on top and mix well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: szechuan bean sauce,channa dal,baking soda,rice,italian seasoning,vanilla pudding mix,egg yolk,fillet salmon
title: Chinese Crusted Salmon on Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice | 4 fillets salmon | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 envelope vanilla instant pudding mix | 2 cups channa dal | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon szechuan hot bean sauce | 1 egg yolk, beaten
instructions: Bake rice with baking soda 5 to 6 minutes until fragrant. Cool and dice salmon into 2 inch squares, about 1½ inch wide, so salmon is about four squares thick. Dissolve italian seasoning in hot bean sauce. Place channa dal in a medium bowl. Pour soybean sauce mixture on top. Remove rice from oven. Dip salmon pieces into egg wash and coat both sides well with the italian seasonings. Dredge salmon in rice mixture and saute in a hot skillet for about 2 minutes each side until browned, turning occasionally. Put rice on a plate. Place the salmon fillets on the rice. Spoon channa dal over the salmon and serve.

title: Easy Chicken and Ham Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 box deli ham, chopped | 2 cans chickpeas, drained | 1 head fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut beef into cubes. Place the ham into a large casserole dish. Sprinkle with parsley. Top with soup. Pour chickpeas over salad. Bake at 350 degrees 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Let stand for 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,italian flat leaf parsley,meat,flat leaf italian parsley,cotija cheese,oregano leaf,tea,tortilla chip
title: Crispy Beef Tacos with Sweet Italian Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar hot italian-style flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 bottle italian flat-leaf parsley | 12 ounces beef brisket, rinsed and trimmed | 1/2 cup cotija cheese | 2 1/2 cups brewed tea | 2 cans italian style mixed-pepper tortilla chips | 1/2 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/4 cup dried oregano leaves
instructions: Combine the italian style italian style flat leaf parsley, italian style flat leaf parsley, brisket, cheese, and tea. Add oregano. Place in a dutch oven.

title: Scallops of Galilei
ingredients: 12 scallops | cooking oil
instructions: Rinse scallops and pat dry. Coat with oil. Heat a griddle to a medium heat, and quickly brown scallops on both sides. Serve at once with a nice green salad and a hot glass of white wine. Note,.

Random Ingredients: rosemary sprig,poppy seed,chicken thigh,peach schnapps,crab,ha avocado
title: Chicken and Avocado Skewers With Poppy Seed Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 honey avocados, peeled, pitted and sliced | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1/2 cup crushed canned peaches in schnapps | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rosemary sprig | 3 lbs skinless boneless chicken thighs | 10 -12 wooden skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes, soaked in water, for 30 minutes
instructions: Skewer 2 avocados lengthwise and 2 of the poppy seeds onto soaked soaked wooden skewers. Dip chicken thighs in peppercorn mixture, and then roll in remaining poppy seeds to coat. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients, and add to the dip. Serve warm, with toothpicks.

title: Chiles Poached in Vodka With Pickled Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles, roasted | 4 roma tomatoes | 4 cubes chicken bouillon | 3 poblano chiles | 1 bottle white aleppo pepper, with cayenne power added | 2 1/2 2 1/2 quarts strong beer or 2 1/2 quarts ale
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Peel and core poblano chiles and remove seeds and ribs. Cut tomatoes into very thin slices. Cut roma tomatoes into thin rounds, about 1/2 inch thick. Dice one poblano chille and quarter remaining poblano chile and quarter remaining poblano poblano chile. Bring aleppo pepper with cayenne power to boil in heavy 1 quart dutch oven. Place both chiles into hot aleppo pepper and cook for 8 minutes stir. Remove from heat and set aside until cool enough to handle. Place 2 poblano chiles and 2 roma tomatoes into blender container and add 3 1/2 quarts beer or ale. Blend until smooth and return to dutch oven. Add one poblano chile and one tomato. Repeat with remaining poblano and tomato. Simmer for 8 minutes. Remove from heat and leave for 2 hours. Remove poblano and tomato before ladling into jars.

title: Olive Fritters With Chicken Wings
ingredients: 20 large chicken wings | 1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon rose water | 1/2 cup green olives, chopped | 4 tablespoons dried dill leaves | 16 tortillas or 16 flat bread
instructions: Break wings into halves or thirds and set aside. Mix bread crumbs with rose water until evenly blended.

title: Roast Pecorino (Beef & Pecorino-Romano Burgers)
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig, lightly crushed | 2 tablespoons raw unsweetened dried coconut, finely chopped ( or to taste ) | 2 lbs ground beef ( or use 1 lb of lamb ) | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Position a rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 450°f. Combine the pecorino romano, thyme, coconut, and beef and season well with salt and pepper. Form into 4 patties. Place on a rack and roast to desired doneness, about 12 - 15 minutes for rare and 20 - 25 minutes for medium rare. Allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve on top of warm pappardelle or your favorite type of toast.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,lime,skirt steak,center pork chop,golden raisin
title: Italian Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 center-cut pork chops | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 1/2 lime | 12 ounces skirt steak, trimmed and cut into 6 strips
instructions: Put raisins in freezer for 1 to 2 minutes to draw out their water. Coat chops with a mixture of the raisins and tomatoes. Slice crosswise into 4 sections and place on a rack over a baking pan or wire basket. Cover tightly and freeze for two hours. Unwrap chops, reserving marinade. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Coat grill rack with cooking spray and preheat for direct heat. In a medium bowl, toss the pork chops with raisins and tomatoes, then squeeze lime juice over chops. Grill for 15 to 15 minutes or until desired doneness. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin pie spice,flour tortilla,purpose flour,hamburger,coffee,orange zest
title: Orange Beef Wraps
ingredients: 2 large flour tortillas | 3 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 1/8 teaspoon instant coffee | 1/8 cup finely chopped hamburger
instructions: Using 2 forks, shred roast beef evenly over tortillas. In small dish, combine flour, spice, orange zest and coffee. Stir in beef. Wrap tortillas in paper towels, microwave 5 seconds on high. Lay on plate. Microwave 2 to 3 seconds more. Spread with mixture to within 1 inch of ends. Microwave until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spring wrapper,lime juice,white fish fillet,rotel tomato,hot paprika,rice vinegar,lime wedge
title: Fish Cakes With Soft Spices
ingredients: 1/2 cup lime juice | 1 teaspoon lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon hot smoked paprika | 4 medium spring roll wrappers | 1/8 teaspoon crushed hot smoked paprika | 2 medium tilapia fish fillets, skinned, boned or 2 medium other white fish fillets ( 1/2 '' x 1/2 '' x 1/2 '' ) | 6 tablespoons sweet-spice-free rice vinegar | lime wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Pour lime juice, 1/2 teaspoons lime juice & hot smoked paprika into bowl. Add fish & let sit for 2 minutes. Stir to coat, then set aside. Place rice vinegar & remaining 1/2 teaspoons lime juice. In large nonstick skillet, spread sweet spice mixture. Place 1 spring roll wrapper on work surface. Coat bottom of each wrapper with sweet spice. Starting at one end, roll up the spring roll wrapper around the fish. Lay in a shallow bowl & refrigerate for another 15 - 20 minutes to firm it a bit. Slice fish, lay on top of roll, then drizzle lime juice over fish & sweet spice. Serve warm. Note, fish cakes can be made up to 3 days ahead & stored, covered with a slightly damp paper towel & refrigerated. Reheat just before serving. Note, if serving as a main course, heat remaining lime juice, sweet spice & paprika on stove over low heat until hot & syrupy, then drizzle over fish cakes.

title: Pine Parsnip and Scallops over Stilton Crumble
ingredients: 1 large parsnip | 1 cup peach ( fresh pitted or canned ) | 100 g stilton cheese ( crumbled ) | cooking spray | sea scallops | simple syrup
instructions: Trim the parsnip of all the pith and remove the root end. Trim the parsnip all the way around the pith to avoid removing any blemishes on the parsnip. Wash and dry the parsnip. Peel and roughly chop the peaches. Place on a clean flat surface. Place the peaches, cheese, sprout end of parsnip over the parsnip. Spoon 1/2 tablespoons of the olive oil over the mixture and coat. Seal the top of the crumble with cooking spray. Place in to an oven on 200c for 30 minutes or until golden brown and the tops are beginning to crisp on the outside. Turn the crumble out into a bowl and serve with simple maple syrup.

Random Ingredients: peach preserve,basil leaf,cilantro leaf,butter,lime juice zest,mace,veal,irish whiskey
title: Holiday Pate Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro leaf | 1/4 teaspoon of freshly grated nutmeg or 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon of freshly ground mace | 15 fresh basil leaves | 2 tablespoons peach preserves | 1/4 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill for at least 1 hour. Serve with hot veal, poultry or meats.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,fettuccine pasta,mace,vegetarian bean,arborio rice,beef stew meat,salt black pepper,crust
title: Feta-Rice Beef and Beans
ingredients: 1 jar vegetarian baked beans, undrained | 2 tablespoons dry onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 pound cubed beef stew meat | 1/4 cup uncooked arborio rice | 5 cups cooked, drained pasta | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 slices crusty french-fried onions
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the beans into the the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish, and sprinkle with onion soup mix, mace, and beef. Top with arborio rice, then sprinkle with pasta. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the beef and pasta are hot and the dish is beginning to brown, about 1 hour. Serve right away, garnished with onions.

title: Easiest Pitas Ever
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat bread ( plain or wholemeal ) | pita bread | 1/2 cup red pasta sauce | pepper
instructions: Bread the pita bread into two or three pieces. I like to grill it till it has an ever 3 color. I use my kangola grill pans. Remove the pitas from the pitas and place the on a plate covered with foil. Spray with non stick spray and line them with tin foil. Heat up grill pan. Turning them regularly. Add olive oil to the pan. Add the pita bread. Sear both sides. Spread pasta sauce on all sides and let it simmer for a few minutes. Sprinkle the chopped parsley on top of all.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,ham,malt vinegar,applesauce,quince,wheat pastry flour,idaho potato
title: Shallot Potatoes and Ham Tarts
ingredients: 2 large idaho potatoes | 4 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour | 2 poblano peppers, chopped | 4 tablespoons ham, finely minced | 1 tablespoon dried quinces, diced | 0.5 jar sauerkraut with pepper sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons malt vinegar
instructions: Prepare dough, using 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour, mix in poblano peppers and ham. Roll out onto well floured board. Cover with other dough recipe # add 1/2 cup of flour to dough and mix in quince and seasonings and add 2 cups water. Once dough is rolled, cut in 4 rounds. Place tart on well floured board and cover with damp cloth and allow to rest in a warm place for at least an hour. Bake for approximately 20 minutes in pre heated 400 degree oven and let cool slightly. Filling, while oven is heating up, place dough rounds on a floured board and stretch gently into circles. Place 1 teaspoon of filling in center a circle of dough and pin closed, using fingers or a fork. Repeat until all dough and filling are used, placing filling in the center and pinching the edges closed with your hand. Place in a 400 degree oven and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Let cool slightly before removing from pan. Serve.

title: Banana Sausages and Pork
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 6 bananas | 1 kg pork sausage, cut into large chunks | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade / 400°f. Rub 2 tablespoons Tabasco sauce into each banana. Arrange the sausage pieces in a single layer on an oven tray. Wet your fingers with warm water and dip the bread into them to help break it up. Spread 2 tablespoons tabasco over each banana. Bake in oven for around 30 minutes, turning regularly. Sausages should be tender and starting to brown. Serve with your favourite condiments.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,graham cracker crumb,club soda,cheese,basmati rice
title: Rice Balls (Rice Balls)
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked basmati rice, rinsed in cold water with a little salt and drained | 12 ounces cheese ( grated or shredded, i used cheddar & quot ; ) | 2 cups club soda | 2 cups club soda or 2 cups milk | 1/2 cup basil leaves, finely chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the rice, cheese and 1/2 cup club soda/marsala milk and mix well. Make about 12 balls, then roll in the basil. Chill in the fridge. Bake in a 325f oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned. If you want a fancier dessert, serve in a small bowl with the rest of the club soda/marsala and club soda and topped with cherry tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: coconut extract,butternut squash,olive,chickpea flour,irish cream,cotija cheese
title: Curried Squash Pies (Pumpkin or Apple)
ingredients: 4 large butternut squash, peeled, seeded, and cut into bite-sized chunks | 1 can chickpea flour, unbleached, such as bob's red mill | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 12 ounces cotija cheese, grated ( italian cheddar cheese ) | 1/2 cup creamed coconut extract | irish cream, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Place squash onto a baking sheet and drizzle with 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil. Roast until just tender and starting to brown, 25 to 25 minutes. Allow to cool.

title: Golden Spiced Naan Bread
ingredients: 500 g sweet potatoes or 500 g yams, peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes | 2 envelopes onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons golden syrup or 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 200 g fresh coriander, chopped | 2 cups oatmeal
instructions: Place the sweet potato in a saucepan with 1 cup of water and add enough water to cover. Bring to the boil, cover, and cook over a low heat until the potato is soft. Drain and allow to cool. Mash the onion soup mix and golden syrup together in a large bowl with 2 1/2 cups water. Stir in the sweet potato, coriander and oatmeal. Place all the ingredients in a microwave safe bowl and, using the flat of a large knife, smash and mix until all ingredients are evenly blended. Spread mixture over the prepared bread slices and cover with cling wrap. Microwave on high for 2 1/2 3 minutes, until golden brown on top.

title: Mango Chutney Dip
ingredients: 12 ounces mango chutney | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, and refrigerate 1 hour prior to serving. Serving, can be served on tortilla chips, topped with lettuce, tomatoes, chopped green onions, cucumbers, chopped bananas, etc.

Random Ingredients: red potato,chocolate syrup,almond,tahini,chicken breast half,black vinegar,eggplant
title: Mousaka
ingredients: 1 eggplant, sliced | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into bite size pieces | 4 red potatoes | 1/2 cup finely sesame-seeded almonds | 3/4 cup soy-free tahini | 3 tablespoons brown-and-spoon chocolate syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken flavored instant malay sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the eggplant in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender, about 8 minutes. Drain. Cook and stir the chicken in the boiling water until no longer pink in the center, about 6 minutes. Set aside the chicken. Pour the chocolate sauce into a small bowl. Heat the maple syrup and almond syrup in a skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly. Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the chicken. Stir in the mashed potatoes, and mix until evenly coated. Spoon the potato mixture into a medium serving bowl, and top with the chicken and eggplant.

title: Almond Milk (Corn Fritters)
ingredients: 1 quart almond milk | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 quart frozen corn | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/3 cup gherkin, chopped
instructions: Blend the milk, bouillon and corn in a blender or food processor until thick but smooth. Pour half of the almond mixture into a large nonstick frying pan with a tight fitting lid. Heat over medium heat. Add the syrup, nutmeg and ghekin and cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce is thick and fragrant, about 20 minutes.

title: Garlicky Dill Pasta and Oil
ingredients: 1 lb penne | 10 ounces fresh dill weed, chopped | 2 lemons, juice of
instructions: Pour oil into a large skillet with the zest of 2 lemons. Drain the pasta and add it to the heated oil. Drain the water from the dill weed and add it to the skillet. Bring the pasta to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and cook for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let it sit for 5 minutes. Uncover the pasta pan and stir the dill weed into the pasta. Serve warm.

title: Vegetable Sambol
ingredients: 1 lb medium green beans, tipped and cut into 2-inch pieces | 1/4 lb raw mexican-style tri-colored masa harina | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 garlic clove | 2 ounces maizena pasta | 20 -24 wonton wrappers
instructions: Boil the beans until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water. Mash beans with masa harina. Combine rice bran, garlic, and mixed spice. Spread 1 - 2 teaspoons of filling in the center of the won ton wrapper. Fold envelope over filling and pinch to seal. If desired, lightly brush the outside of the won ton with warm water. Place won ton wrappers on a baking sheet. Bake in a preheated oven for 25 - 30 minutes, until crispy and golden. Allow to cool before serving.

title: Cheddar Crusted Steak
ingredients: 2 sirloin, trimmed | 1 can sliced mushrooms | 1/4 cup reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 teaspoon fennel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Using your choice of blade, cut steak in half lengthwise, across 1/4 inch. Combine mushrooms, cheese and fennel together. Sprinkle evenly over both sides of the steak. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes or until desired doneness. Cut steak into 4 serving pieces.

title: Mika's Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces macaroni | 1 small green pepper, cut in rings | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Cook macaroni, and let cool for 1/2 hour. Drain. Meanwhile, mix all the ingredients together. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,nutmeg,chocolate syrup,rigatoni pasta,tap water,plain yogurt,green chilies
title: Sweet Yummy Beef Skillet #RSC
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain low-fat yogurt | 1 1/4 cups tap water | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/3 cup chocolate syrup | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 -2 green chilies | 4 ounces mild green chilies
instructions: Heat a large non stick skillet over medium high heat.. Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl, whisking to blend well. Add rigatoni.

title: Homemade Adobo
ingredients: 8 cups nonfat dry milk | 5 cups distilled white wine vinegar
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the vinegar. Bring the milk to a boil over medium heat. Pour the vinegar into the milk, whisking constantly. Reduce heat to low. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Pour the hot milk into a sealable container and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before using. Remove from the refrigerator 1 hour before using. Use hot, nonfat dipping sauce, such as sambal oelek, for sandwiches, or in place of salsa.

title: Glazed Turnips II
ingredients: 6 turnips, pared and sliced | 1 tablespoon canadian bacon ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon minced fresh sage | 1 teaspoon rice wine | 2 tablespoons dry bread crumbs, divided
instructions: Lightly saute' turnip, bacon and rice wine together over medium heat until turnips are tender and lightly crisp. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon bread crumbs over turnip and sprinkle with sage. Serve with fresh cream if desired.

title: Anchovy Stuffed Indian Bread
ingredients: 4 slices fine semolina ( farfalle ) | 1 tablespoon fine semolina | 2 tablespoons very finely chopped onions | 3 tablespoons finely chopped anchovies | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or foil. In a medium bowl, stir together the semolina & fine semolina. Stir in the cilantro. Gently mix in the onions & anchovies. Spoon mixture into the prepared pan, 1 cup from the edge of the pan. Broil for 8 minutes, or until edges are lightly browned and top is firm. Serve hot. Variation #1, remove the anchovies before spooning the m&ms over the bread.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,sesame oil,canola oil,tarragon,vegetable oil,tomato soup,yukon gold potato,pasta
title: Swiss Potatoes Ole'
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, washed and cut into chunks | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 0.667 can condensed tomato soup | 0.667 can tomato soup | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 cups dry pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: In a large pan, place the potatoes, oil, and undiluted sauces on high to heat. Stir in tarragon. In a separate bowl, measure soup, and add a little olive oil to make a slightly runny gravy. Once potatoes are heated through, add to soup, stirring well. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Pour cooked pasta into oven safe casserole dish. Spoon stewed pasta over the top of the noodles. Pour remaining soup over the top. Sprinkle on cheese. Cover and bake for 30 minutes at 400 degrees. Remove cover, bake for an additional five minutes. Note, i never bake the dish after the five minutes, so it can stand back a little in the oven for a few minutes, and then re cover.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,coconut cream,red chili pepper,baby spinach,hamburger,cardamom
title: Coconut Barley Burgers
ingredients: 225 g baby spinach | 150 g smoked hamburger | 100 g pearl barley | 200 g coconut cream | 2 tablespoons dried red chili peppers | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Wash the spinach and boil it in a microwaveable bowl for 30 seconds, then squeeze out any excess moisture. Set the cooked spinach aside for a moment to cool. Mix the rice into the cooled spinach, then work in the burger, breaking it into small chunks. Heat a large, non stick frying pan over a medium heat, then add the barley. Stir over a low heat for 5 minutes, until everything is just starting to wilt, then stir in the coconut cream, dried red chilis and cardamon. Bring to the boil, then cover, and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring once or twice. Allow to stand for a few minutes so that the coconut cream thickens, then cut into slices.

Random Ingredients: chili,balsamic vinegar,clear honey,white pepper,onion soup mix
title: Chili Oil Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 250 ml clear honey | 150 g dried onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dry chili
instructions: To make sauce, mix all ingredients together in saucepan on low heat.

title: Easy Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 can tomato puree | 3 teaspoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons lemon zest
instructions: Chop chicken. If using lean beef, shred it coarsely with a sharp knife. Mix tomato puree, garam masala and zest. Place chicken in 2 large buttered baking dishes. Sprinkle the spice mix onto chicken. Cover with foil and bake in 375 degree oven for 40 - 45 minutes or till golden in colour. Serve with rice/chop salad.

title: Chickpea & Watercress Rillettes
ingredients: 6 teaspoons chili pepper ( minced or crushed ) | 1 cup chickpeas ( rinsed, patted dry, soaked in cold water until no longer soft ) | 1 tablespoon watercress ( optional ) | 4 bay seasoning tm ( optional-increase if desired ) | 4 cups fresh water ( or about 1 1/4 - 2.5 cups mixed greens ) | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme ( or a little less than 1/2 tsp chopped fresh thyme ) | crushed ice | 4 -6 teaspoons grated romano cheese, for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: Heat your broiler and position a rack 6 inches from the heat. Heat your chile until the tiny dark spots are starting to rise to the surface.. Remove from the heat when the chile is slightly charred and aromatic, about 5 - 10 minutes. If you are using the chile, keep it in a jar in the fridge for up to a couple of days before using. Pour about 3 tablespoons of the chile into a bowl, then stir in the chickpeas. If using the watercress, drain the water in between pressing it down and then stir it inches. Pour the remaining liquid into the same bowl and stir in your watercress. Stir your greens and thyme into the liquid, breaking them into small bits as you go. Place the rillettes on a baking sheet or a tray and sprinkle lightly with crushed flakes. Broil in your oven, using a panni press or a circular motion, moving the rillettes in the residual heat for 3 - 5 minutes, until the water has evaporated and the rillettes show glochy resistance. Serve piping hot, with cheese sprinkled over the rillettes for sprinkling.

title: Crock Pot Rice With Apples (Arroz Con Sal)
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless fish steaks | 1 can rosado mixed apple cider ( or apple juice ) | 6 cups cooked rice | 16 ounces sour cream | 1 package frozen ravioli | 2 -3 cups prepared shredded topping ( optional )
instructions: Mix apple cider and sour cream. Spray crock pot with cooking spray. Add fish to crock pot. Pour apple cider mixture evenly over fish. Cook on low for 3 - 5 hours or on high for 4 - 5 hours. Serve on top of rice with ravioli and shredded cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,goat cheese,sirloin,heavy whipping cream,extra virgin olive oil,wheat spaghetti,cheddar cheese,baking cocoa
title: Beef and Goat Cheese Arepas With Spicy Polenta
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup whole wheat spaghetti | 3/4 lb ground sirloin | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 7 ounces goat cheese | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons baking cocoa | 1/4 cup cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Put cornmeal in a food processor and pulse until fine. Sift cornmeal onto a pastry board and put into a mixing bowl. Cook spaghetti in boiling water with 2 teaspoons olive oil until just soft tender and drain. Transfer to a bowl of ice and water. Mash with a fork. Set aside. Mix together ground beef, extra virgin olive oil and goat cheese. Drain spaghetti and mix in well. Add the cornmeal mixture and pulse a few times. Shape half of the pasta mixture into sausages, about 6” in diameter and 2 ½” thick. Pound with a meat mallet until thin and place onto baking sheet. Bake the arepas for about 10 mins each side until golden brown. To serve, place a sausage on top and cheese slice on top. Serve and enjoy.

title: Baked Fennel Hummus
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazel hummus | 1/3 cup white rum ( do not use kool-aid type ) | 3 tablespoons miso ( white or brown ) | 2 teaspoons white rum ( do not use kool-aid type ) | 1 large fennel, bulb only, with fronds | cooking spray
instructions: In large bowl mash hazel hummus with a fork or pestle. Make a space around the bowl for the honey to dissolve. Add white wine rum and miso and whisk. Add seeds from fronds and add about 2 tbsp to honey. Spoon into a 9 x13 inch pan and bake uncovered 1 hour at 375°f. Serve warm. If using white rum and or sherry leave as is. Serve with your choice of fruit.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,vegetable stock,jalapeno chile pepper,chili paste garlic,chicken bouillon,green cardamom pod
title: Ethiopian Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 pound cubed, skinless chicken breast meat | 1 jalapeno chile pepper, seeded and minced | 2 stalks celery salt | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | 1 can vegetable stock | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Place chicken into a medium pot and cover with water.

title: Zucchini Fried With Cheese-Gravy
ingredients: 4 -5 medium zucchini | 2 large eggs | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup half-and-half | salt | 1 green pepper, finely chopped | 3 -5 thin slices queso fresco
instructions: Peel zucchini and remove the ends so they can also be cut into 2 inch pieces. Steam the zucchini until soft. Drain liquid but reserve liquid. Beat the eggs lightly. Mix with the ginger garlic paste and half and half. Add salt to taste, grated cheese, sliced green pepper, and desired amount of the reserved zucchini liquid. Stir until all ingredients are mixed. Put mixture in large frying pan at medium high heat until bubbly and browned. Flip zucchini. Use tongs to stir mixture.

title: Chilled Dhal(Bangladesh)
ingredients: 4 cups fresh cooked chickpeas ( not canned ) | 3 cups canned chicken ( your choice of meat ) | 3 teaspoons tobiko nori ( flying fish sauce ) | 1 large fresh cherries ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon mirin
instructions: Puree half of all ingredients in your food processor. Heat the dhal over medium heat in a frying pan and add the puree to the pan. Cook the dhal over medium heat for 5 minutes and then remove from heat, and allow to cool in a refrigerator for 20 minutes. Remove the chilled dhal from the refrigerator and serve with a slice of cherries on top.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,rom tomato,grapefruit,sunflower oil,coriander powder,green olive,olive oil,rice wine
title: Moroccan Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 kg grapefruit | 16 green olives | 3 roma tomatoes ( seeded & diced ) | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 tablespoon rice wine | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1/3 cup olive oil
instructions: Wash & trim the ends from the grapes & break off the stalks. Discard any discoloured ones. Cut into a rough 2cm x 1cm dice. Place all ingredients into a large glass bowl. Toss well to amalgamate, then cover and leave in the fridge overnight. Remove the bowl mixture from the fridge & leave to come to room temp, about 180 degrees celcius. Remove skins from grapefruit & use a teaspoon or teaspoon to pierce the pulp all over. Slice off the bottom of the grapefruit stalks, remove as much membrane & white pith as possible & set aside. Slice grapesfruit crossways into 1/8 thick slices, then diagonally into 1/4 thick slices. Heat the sundried tomato oil & sundried tomato pbq on a ridged griddle pan until smoking. Brush/spray the tomatoes with oil & cook until just softened & well charred, about 3 minutes on each side. Remove from heat & serve immediately & let cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,chili pepper flake,salmon,panko breadcrumb,pork tenderloin,cranberry,buttermilk,chicken wing
title: Chicken and Pork Taterloin
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/2 cup shredded cooked chicken or 1/2 cup pork tenderloin | 1/4 - 1/3 cup dried cranberries ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried parsley or 1 tablespoon fresh parsley | 1/2 lb cooked cooked salmon | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken wings
instructions: In a shallow bowl, mix panko, chili pepper flakes, taco seasoning and chicken or pork tenderloins to evenly coat. Drain cranberries and place on a paper towel to dry slightly. Using your hands or a spatula, coat cranberries with bread crumbs. Roll salmon in dried cranberries and then into crumbs. Place fish head down on plate with large head down. Tear off two 12 inch lengths of heavy duty aluminum foil, making sure there are no pockets of air at bottom or top. Place 2 pieces of cooked chicken on top of each piece of fish head, then drizzle with taco seasoning and parsley. Wrap foil around chicken and sprinkle with more corn meal, pressing into any openings. Place fish directly on foil with chicken on top. Bake at 425 degrees for 45 minutes or til fish flakes easily with fork.

title: Cauliflower in a Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 lb button mushroom
instructions: Prepare the cauliflower and cut it into 4 to 5 inch florets. If the cauliflower is very small, it is easier to cut out the core and then cut all the pieces into smaller pieces. Steam the cauliflower until fork tender. Cut the mushrooms up into chunks. Bring water to a boil and bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the cauliflower and cook until no longer tough. Drain and rinse in cold water and remove the tough outer leaves. Place the cauliflower on a large serving platter and set it aside. In a small fry pan, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over a medium high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until they begin to release their liquid. If you are cooking in a crockpot place the cauliflower on top of the mushrooms. Pour the mushrooms over the cauliflower and serve. This is a hearty dish and tastes even better after chilling for several hours.

title: French Bread and Cheese Toasts With Sage Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup swiss gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh sage, chopped | 2 tablespoons a.1. original sauce | 1 loaf french bread, cut in thick slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. In a small bowl, stir the first five ingredients together until smooth. Arrange the bread slices on a baking sheet. Top each slice with 1 tablespoon of the sage butter and then with 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons grated gruyere. Bake for 5 to 10 minutes or until golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: mint,apple,coffee extract,chipotle chile,pork loin,sage,red pepper flake
title: Tinga (Apple Meat and Chipotle)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried minced sage | 1 can chipotle chiles or ( 10 ounce ) can green chilies, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs pork loin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( i like the small cut-up version which is cut in half ) | 2 tablespoons coffee-flavored extract ( optional ) | 1/4 cup of fresh mint ( dried for garnish ) or 1/4 cup basil ( dried for garnish )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the sage, red pepper flakes, and sage powder. Lightly brown the pork cubes in a skillet.

title: New Potato Sticks With Avocado and Cornmeal Crackers (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 1 )
