instructions: Cook macaroni in simmering water for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse. Combine all ingredients. Serve & sprinkle with paprika if desired.

title: Spicy Coconut Chips
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1/3 cup vinegar ( white cider vinegar is better if you are using the white ) | 1 tablespoon cayenne ( sweet and sour flavor ) | 1/2 teaspoon celery | 1 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Combine both cans of coconut milk, vinegar and cayenne. Add celery and chocolate and mix well. Put in bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours. Stir in just before serving so the candy does not burn on the bottom of the bowl.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,chorizo sausage,white kidney bean,heavy cream,parmesan cheese
title: Mexican White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can white kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 can french-fried chorizo sausage | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine the beans, ketchup, chorizo, cream, and parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: white wine,chinese sausage,beef stew meat,soya sauce,sesame oil,cream
title: Oriental Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cubed | 1 lb chinese sausage, sliced | 1/2 cup white wine, white or 1/2 cup water | 2 tablespoons cream | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Heat oven to 325&deg.

title: Quick and Easy Tostadas
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry lentils | 4 teaspoons flour tortillas | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 12 ounces apricot preserves
instructions: Place lentils and garlic in a food processor and process until it resembles fine grains. Add the tortilla strips and process just until they become the size and shape of lentils. Transfer the noodles to a plate and refrigerate for about 20 minutes or overnight, stirring occasionally. Heat oven to 400°f. Drain the noodles and spread half on each tortilla and then evenly spread the preserves on top, leaving about 1/2 inch of dough around each. Place on a baking sheet and bake until the preserves are melted and bubbly, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Guinness Cashew Burgers
ingredients: 2 lbs lean hamburger | 2 tablespoons cashew nuts, chopped | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 16 ounces guinness stout, heated | 2 scallions, thinly sliced
instructions: Shape the hamburger into 4 burgers and place with cashews in a baking dish. Sprinkle with lime zest. Divide and top with guinness and scallions. Grill until done, 4 minutes per side, or until topping is firm and cashews turn golden.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Hummus
ingredients: 1 cup peanut butter | 1/3 cup dried cranberry juice
instructions: In a food processor, process peanut butter into peanut butter. Pour peanut butter into a bowl, and mix in dried cranberry juice. Chill in refrigerator until the flavors combine, at least 30 minutes.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 6 ripe avocados, peeled and seeded, and cut into small chunks | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano, minced | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese, or to taste | 1 fresh jalapeno pepper, stemmed and julienned
instructions: Place the avocados into a mixing bowl. Season with oregano and gruyere cheese. Add and toss, or press the jalapeno pieces into the mixture to help the jalapenos hold their shape. Place the bowl in a microwave safe bowl, cover, and cook in the microwave, or in a skillet set over medium high heat, until the cheese is melted and is starting to brown, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Tuna, Broccoli & Tortilla Starter
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups chicken stock or 2 1/2 cups beef stock ( preferably from canned diced tomatoes in can ) | 1/3 cup canned tuna in water ( preferably from a regular tin, drained ) | 350 g fresh broccoli, trimmed and cut into chunks ( about 1-1/3 cups ) | 3/4 teaspoon active dry yeast | 3/4 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1 pinch smoked spanish sweet paprika ( or to taste ) | 6 tortillas
instructions: Place the stock, tuna, broccoli, paprika & pinch of smoked spanato in a saucepan & add a pinch of smoked paprika or sweet paprika & some salt & bring to the boil. Set the broccolli on a lined baking sheet & cover with a tea towel. Allow to bubble for 10 - 15 min or so, meanwhile, place the tortillas into a dry pan, toast under a hot grill for 3 - 4 minutes each side, or until crisp & browned. Spread each tortilla with a small ladleful of the warm stock, top with a generous portion of the boiled broccoli & set over a high heat so it bubbles. Allow to bubble for a further 3 - 4 minutes. Lift the pan from the heat & allow to sit for 5 minutes before releasing the tortillas from the pan. Cut into wedges & serve immediately with a drizzle of olive oil.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,coffee powder,fruit,taco seasoning mix,head cauliflower,vermicelli,fine salt
title: Green Cauliflower and Sweet Potato Cappuccino
ingredients: 3 medium heads cauliflower, trimmed | 1 can green chilies, drained | 1 package dried vermicelli ( mini bell noodles ) | 1 package dry taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup instant coffee powder | 2 teaspoons fine salt | 1 3/4 tablespoons instant coffee powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Separate cauliflower strands, then cut each floret lengthwise into about 12 wedges. Transfer to a large bowl. Sprinkle with about 2 teaspoons salt. Toss with 1 tablespoon instant coffee powder, and mix in the other tablespoon instant coffee. Spread the cauliflower into the prepared baking pan. Bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Cool 10 minutes, then toss with remaining butter and granulated sugar. Cool completely before storing in a glass jar. To make fudge queso, add 2 tablespoons instant coffee to 1 tablespoon sugar and heat for a few seconds. Stir until the sugar melts and starts to foam. Remove from heat, and stir until the coffee or sugar has dissolved. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,stewing beef,flour tortilla,molasses,maple syrup,phyllo pastry,canadian bacon
title: Sweet Onion Beef Rollups
ingredients: 400 g stewing beef | 10 pieces maple syrup | 2 tablespoons molasses | 4 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 bunch yellow onion, finely diced, white and green parts separated | 8 fat free flour tortillas, cut in half widthways | 200 g canadian bacon, chopped | 10 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Fry the onion slices until lightly golden. Pour over the maple syrup just before frying the onions. Put a piece of ham or other lean meat on each half, then roll up. Keep doing that until all the meat has been used up. Place the rolls in a deep, ovenproof dish. Brush the roll ups with the molasses and maple syrup. Bake in a moderate oven for 20 mins, brushing with pan juices every so often. Serve over brown rice or beans, with whatever you have around, ie, fresh fruit or salsa. I often make this ahead and bake it the next day.

title: Baked Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 large green tomato, sliced into six long strips | 1 1/2 lbs fresh hamburger
instructions: Place tomato slices in a large bowl of cold water to help loosen the outer leaves of the chard. Drain. Preheat oven to 400ºf. Spray two 12 inch square baking dishes or 2 to 3 inch diameter cake pans with nonstick spray. Place the chard in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,purpose flour,cayenne,irish cream,parsley flake
title: Irish Cheese Balls
ingredients: 3 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried irish cream | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Stir flour, parsley flakes, irish cream, and cayenne together in a large bowl. Gently mix in mozzarella cheese until mixture is evenly crumbly. Roll about 2 tablespoons into balls. Drain on a clean towel lined pan until all balls have been rolled. Cook balls on a cookie sheet set at 400 degrees f for about 10 minutes, turning once. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Cherry Tomatoes With Wine (Salsa Di Tomate
ingredients: 32 cherry tomatoes, halved ( see note below ) | 2 cups good quality dry white wine
instructions:

## Ingredients ##
 4 chili peppers | 4 garlic cloves | 5 -6 mushrooms | 1/2 cup lard | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 2 cups heavy cream or 2 cups whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1 lb cherry tomatoes | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon ground pepper | 1 -2 teaspoon chili | parmigiano-reggiano cheese or grated pecorino cheese, grated, for topping 

 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Place chile peppers on a foil lined pan, skin side up. Roast at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until chile peppers blister. Set aside to cool and slip off the skins. Once cooled rub the chile with the garlic, then place in a plastic bag and process until finely chopped. When peppers are cool peel and devein them and then puree in a food chopper. Heat the olive oil in another large saucepan over medium heat. Add mushrooms and cook until soft and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Stir in the chile puree. Add cream and cook down for one minute. Season with salt, pepper, oregano and chili flakes. Simmer until reduced by one third. Remove from heat. Add in the tomatoes and simmer for 6 minutes. Puree to desired consistency using a mixer or in a blender. Set aside. Serve on heated platter with grated cheese sprinkled on top. Note, you can make this in advance and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,coriander,egg yolk,orange juice,sherry wine vinegar
title: South African Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 cup fresh baby spinach, packed | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 4 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, leaves ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and combine well. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Ham with Pineapple
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks | 1 pound fully-cooked ham slices | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 tablespoon thai basil, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange pineapple chunks in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange ham slices atop the pineapple. In a bowl, whisk together duck broth and thai basil until dissolved. Pour mixture over ham and pineapple. Cover dish loosely with foil, and bake in the preheated oven 1 hour, or until ham is browned and the juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: egg bread,pinto bean,bean sprout,coconut milk,salt,curd cottage cheese,cucumber
title: Pancakes With Cabbage and Beans
ingredients: 1 small egg bread | 1/2 cup small curd cottage cheese | 1/2 cup milk ( or use yogurt or coconut milk ) | 1 -2 tablespoon shredded coconut ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon grated cucumber, shredded ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 can refried beans ( with liquid )
instructions: Slice bread into 1/4 inch slices. Place on a cookie sheet or baking sheet and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 8 - 10 minutes. Combine the cottage cheese and milk. Add salt, and shredded coconut if using. Beat until creamy. Add the shredded cucumber and shredded or shredded carrot. Stir well and let sit for 2 - 3 minutes. Dip each slice of bread in the milk mixture, coating both sides. Fry in a little oil on the pan until lightly browned. Turn over and brown other side. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lard crisco,peach,pinto bean,crabmeat,guajillo chilies,vanilla pod,bamboo shoot
title: Mexican Crock Pot Peaches
ingredients: 6 large sweet peppers | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed well | 1/4 lb lard or 1/4 lb crisco | 8 ounces cooked crabmeat | 8 guajillo chilies ( green mexican chiles ), seeded and minced | 3 canned sliced ripe olives, juice only | 1/2 cup canned sliced peaches, drained
instructions: Place in crock pot the peppers and juice, lard or crisco, crab, and shredded cheese. Cook on high. Turn down heat and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours stirring 2 to 3 times. Remove to a serving platter. Top with the olives and peaches.

title: Mutton Mirch Phakhni
ingredients: 3 lbs mutton ( mutton chops ) | 1 teaspoon ginger paste, powdered | 8 tablespoons chervil, chopped
instructions: Put 1/4 cup cold water on the bottom of a pressure cooker. Add ginger paste and mix well with the mutton. Close the lid and pressure cook for 15 minutes until the chops are done, but not falling apart. Garnish with chervil. Serve hot with indian flatbread.

title: Creamy Jalapeno Cheese Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb queso fresco, crumbled small or 2 cups crumbled blue cheese | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 teaspoons prepared chile powder | 2 teaspoons jalapeno chiles, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon pickled jalapeno chile, finely chopped | 1/2 cup buttermilk
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine all ingredients and puree until smooth, adding in the buttermilk just before serving..

title: Red and Green Berries With Creamy Pesto
ingredients: 1/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon basil pesto ( a flavorful jarred italian spice blend ) | 8 cups blueberries
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, pesto and blueberries. Chill until the flavors combine, about 30 minutes. Serve at room temperature.

title: Maine Caviar
ingredients: 2 pounds ripe habanero peppers, or more to taste | 2/3 cup matzo meal
instructions: Wearing rubber gloves, cut a slit down one side of each habanero pepper, and carefully remove and reserve the seeds and juice. Combine habanero pepper seeds with matzo meal in a bowl. Fill each hot pepper with enough habanero matzo to fully coat. Place seeds in a food processor or blender with 1 tablespoon water, and process until coarsely ground, about 1 minute. Transfer mixture to a serving dish, and chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,sage,pepperoncini pepper juice,coriander seed,cinnamon
title: Spicy Sicilian Pepperoncini
ingredients: 1 jar pepperoncini peppers - juice ( use fresh hot peppers if you have them ) | 1 cinnamon stick | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Fill a sauce pan with water, add 1 teaspoon salt and bring to a boil over high heat. Add the cinnamon stick, coriander seed, sage and pepperoncini and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool until easier to handle, and easier to handle. When it is cool, use a slotted spoon to carefully remove the pecorino romano from the liquid, and place in a bowl lined with plastic wrap. This helps it keep from turning brown. When set aside, pour out most of the peppers' liquid and refrigerate until use. When you are ready to eat, take the cuppa liquid, and place in a small bowl, making sure to save any leftover juice. Once liquid is cool, use a strainer to strain the liquid through the strainer, and reserve until needed. Place pepperoncini and their juice in a blender and blend until smooth. Add cheese, and puree until smooth, and use to stuff the pepperoncini.

title: Sweet and Sour Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds onions, cut in half, lengthwise, and thinly sliced
instructions: Place half the onions in a glass or porcelain bowl and spread out evenly. Sprinkle with remaining onions. Cover and refrigerate, shaking the bowl occasionally, for 2 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Bake onions in the preheated oven until softened, 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Texas Cakes
ingredients: 6 corn flakes, crushed | 1/2 pound boneless leg of lamb, cubed | 1 cucumber, peeled and shredded | 1/2 pound boneless chicken, cubed | 1 jar salsa | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 32 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix corn flakes, lamb, cucumber, chicken, salsa and baking soda. Thread meat onto bamboo skewers. Place skewers on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until hot and bubbly, about 45 minutes. Serve in a bowl with the reserved bamboo skewers.

title: Crescent Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crescent roll | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, chopped | 12 cardamom seeds ( crushed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Separate dough into two pieces. On an ungreased cookie sheet, spread the center of each piece with 2 tblsp. Cherry, leaving about ½ inch border on each side. Press half the crushed cardamom seeds into the dough and sprinkle over the cherries. Roll dough into a rectangle the length of the baking sheet and place it, on the prepared cookie sheet. Pinch edges to seal the dough. Bake at 425 degrees f for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden. Let cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute, then transfer to wire rack to finish cooling.

title: Jicama, Jicama and Herbs on Sannie's Crostini
ingredients: 2 lbs jicama | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | 1 lime | 1 baguette | minced fresh herb ( to taste )
instructions: Peel the jicama as you would for a new jicama. Cut the fruit into small chunks. Put it in a bowl of cold water and add enough sea salt and lime juice to cover. Let stand for 15 minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle about a quarter of a cup of minced fresh herbs on the bread. Sprinkle slices with about a quarter each of a little mixed herbs on each. Cut the baguette in half lengthwise and slice each section diagonally. Place on a baking sheet. Top with mixed herbs. Bake in 400°f oven for a few minutes to get a little color. To serve, cut baguette into small wedges and top with a few sliced jicama. Rub the bread on the side of the bread with a slice of the baguette wedge. Garnish with some more herbs.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,pearl barley,spring onion,margarita mix,pepperoni,grape,filet beef
title: Beef and Pepperoni Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 lb top round filet of beef, thinly sliced | 4 -6 slices pepperoni | 8 fluid ounces grape tomatoes | 1/3 cup spring onion, sliced | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 cup pearl barley | margarita mix, for serving
instructions: Place beef slices between sheets of wax paper.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,chipotle chile,bell pepper,beer,nonfat milk,heavy whipping cream,shell pasta,red cabbage
title: Shannon's Calinadorean Sweet and Sour Pumpkin Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb shell pasta ( or any other type of pasta ) | 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds ( pumpkin seeds may be used instead ) | 1 head red cabbage ( about 2 pounds total ) | 1 -2 bell pepper ( red or green seeded and sliced ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream ( or coconut cream if you're using a cream of wheat ) | 1 1/2 cups nonfat milk | 1 -2 chipotle chile ( chopped ) | 1 1/2 cups beer ( or other dark beer )
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook the pasta until al dente, about 6 - 8 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: nonfat yogurt,chocolate wafer cooky,limoncello,yeast,coriander seed,kimchee,fava bean,snow pea
title: Spooky Cakes
ingredients: 3 packages yeast | 1/2 cup nonfat yogurt, at room temp | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/2 cup limoncello | 1 cup frozen snow peas | 1 cup frozen mung bean, thawed | 1/2 cup frozen limoncello | 15 kimchee, sliced ( optional ) | 20 candied coriander seeds ( optional ) | 20 nonfat dry yogurt or 25 chocolate wafer cookies
instructions: Put yeast in big bowl and mix in 1/4 cup of the water. Mix until foamy. Add ½ of the yogurt. Add salt, remaining yogurt, limoncello and seeds to the yeast. Beat for 5 minutes. Put the kimchee slices into a ziploc bag with the frozen beans and kimchee slices. Put in the freezer, mix and put in the refrigerator. This lasts for up to a week or two, until you are ready to cook them. Preheat your oven to 375 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper or spray with nonstick spray or butter. On a cookie sheet spread out the kimchee slices. Place on top of the kimchee slices. Add the other ½ cup of the yogurt to the frozen yogurt. Dough must not be runny or stiff. Spread out evenly onto the cookie sheets. Bake at 375 f for about 15 minutes, until the kimchee is bubbly and golden brown. Turn off the oven. If you are using kimchee slices it takes anywhere from 25 minutes to 1 hour to bake. You may need to bake them on the bottom half of the oven until brown and crispy. Let cool and serve with a spoonful of the kimchee on the side.

title: Japanese Favourite Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 6 -8 assorted fresh vegetables, such as potatoes, carrots, turnips, turnips or just cauliflower | 4 tablespoons brown gravy mix | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons brown gravy mix | 1 tablespoon mirin ( sweet japanese cooking wine ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon white flour
instructions: Prepare vegetables, cut potatoes lengthwise into wedges and place into bowl of cold water to stop browning. Drain. Cut carrots into sticks and place onto a clean plate. Cut turnips into 5 - 6 wedges and place on plate. Cut cauliflower into bite size pieces and chop into bite sized pieces. Dissolve brown gravy mix in hot water until dissolved. Pour boiling liquid over vegetables and toss to coat. Add sugar, mirin, and oregano and stir to combine. If necessary, add more seasoning or flour to thicken sauce.. Chill and serve.

title: Raspberry Salad Dressing
ingredients: 6 tablespoons raspberry vinegar ( raspberry brand suggested ) | 1/2 cup prepared whipped topping, thawed ( like cool whip )
instructions: Combine the vinegar and whipped topping in a small bowl and whisk until smooth.

title: Red Wine Sauce
ingredients: 750 ml beef stock | 75 g walnut pieces | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh sage | 1/2 cup red capsicum, roasted, finely chopped | 1/3 cup green olives, pitted, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes remove from heat and leave, covered, to cool. To serve, stir in some freshly ground black pepper to taste.

title: Pecorino Ripe Cheese
ingredients: 3 lbs pecorino romano cheese | 2 cups whipping cream
instructions: Wash and rinse cheese well. Using a rolling pin pat cheese to flatten on all surfaces. Cut in small squares when cold you may do this with just the rolling pin for 2 or 3 minutes. Sprinkle with extra grated pecorino romano cheese. Whip whipping cream, then set aside to cool. Use as a topping for your favorite pasta.

title: Moroccan Spice for Pork and Beef Skewers or Beef
ingredients: 2 cups spanish onions | 1 cup fresh ginger | 1 cup anise seed | 1/3 cup ground cardamom
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir well. Add meat and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours.

title: English Cheese Log
ingredients: 16 ounces cream cheese | 1 lb suet | 4 ounces cheese
instructions: Mix all together. Line baking sheet with greaseproof paper and put a large piece of cheese on the paper, this should come to about 1/16 thick max paper with cheese on the outside of the paper. Cut the log into 1 1/4 wide and 1 thick medallions. Put on the baking sheet and bake at 350 till cheese is lightly browned, about 1 hour. Serve warm. This can also be prepared with ham and sausage, adding some bacon slices to the cheese after placing the cheese on the bread while cooking to make it sandwich tender.

title: Italian Pasta Appetizers
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni ( i prefer curly ) | 1 package crescent rolls | 1 teaspoon lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cook macaroni according to package directions. Remove from heat and stir in a little of the juice from the jar of crescent rolls until well combined. Spread the mixture onto one side of the crescent rolls and roll the dough around to form crescents. Re shape crescents and spread with a little bit of the lemon juice. In a separate pan, cook pasta as directed on package. Drain when pasta is al dente and then toss with the cooked macaroni and then use as suggested in the ingredients for these delicious treats. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,cayenne,walnut,corn oil,mint,saffron,spicy brown mustard
title: Saffron Cajwain (Minted Walnut Sauce)
ingredients: 400 g walnuts | 4 -5 tablespoons dark brown mustard | 1 tablespoon crushed dried mint | 1 teaspoon crushed saffron | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 teaspoon light dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Toast the walnuts under the grill, watching the darker, until they are browned and fragrant. Remove the nuts from the grill, leaving the skin on. Place the walnuts in a medium mixing bowl, add 1 tbsp mustard, mint leaves and crushed saffron. Mix well. Add the rest of the mustard and spices and mix. Add the sugar and continue to mix vigorously until you have a thick, smooth sauce. You may need to add a little water during this process if too thick. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, place in the fridge and leave until thickened up and you need to work it through the nuts. When thickened up, beat in a little more yellow food colouring. The sauce should have a yellow colour. Serve with bread, pasta dishes, or cold pasta to be cold in a snack or snack pack.

Random Ingredients: soda cracker,cognac,turmeric powder,yellow squash,caraway seed,white vinegar
title: Yellow Zucchini With Piri Piri Sauce
ingredients: 8 yellow squash, sliced | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 3 tablespoons cognac ( or rum ) | 3 tablespoons white vinegar ( or lemon ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 12 soda crackers
instructions: Peel zucchini and slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place in a bowl with the caraway.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,saffron strand,curd cottage cheese,ginger paste,self rising flour,cayenne pepper,vodka,white potato
title: Pineapple-Ginger Dumplings
ingredients: 1 cup white potato, washed and chopped | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 teaspoon saffron strand | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup curd cottage cheese ( fresh is best, but can use any dry curd cottage cheese ) | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 3 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Cook the white potatoes in boiling water until soft. Then, let cool, and then mash them until smooth. Drain off excess water and keep warm until ready to use. Fry the garlic paste and saffron on low heat for a few minutes or until aromatic. Add ginger paste and saffron. Saute till golden brown and dry. Mix in the flour and potatoes. Keep stirring mixture and then add the cottage cheese cubes, pineapple juice, and vodka. Mix gently. Let the dumplings boil in the mixture for 5 minutes or until the gravy is thickened. If you need to make the gravy while the dumplings are cooking, make sure the oil the pot used to boil the dumplings in is very hot, and let the gravy simmer away for 10 minutes or so.

title: Grenaden's Lemon Ice
ingredients: 2 cups ice water | 2 tablespoons finely grated fresh lemon zest
instructions: Place the ice in a medium sized bowl. Sprinkle the lemon zest over. Pour enough boiling water over the ice to cover the ice in the bowl. Cover bowl immediately, and freeze for 4 hours, stirring every few minutes. Remove the ice from the bowl, and place in a covered container.

title: Curried Kid Beans(Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1 bag red beans ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/2 tablespoon curry powder ( or to your taste ) | 2 teaspoons ground pepper
instructions: Pour beans into the crock of your slow cooker. Add curry powder and ground pepper. Mix to combine. Put on lid. Set slow cooker on low and cook 6 - 8 hours. Note, if cooking on the stove, turn slow cooker to high.

title: Guava Curry with Broccoli
ingredients: 1 large broccoli, washed and cut into florets | 1/4 cup margarine | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon sesame seeds | 2 -4 tablespoons curry powder | 2 -3 tablespoons guava nectar
instructions: Steam broccoli until tender, about 8 - 10 minutes or according to package directions, but avoid overcooking. Cut broccoli into florets. Saute pan sprayed with cooking spray over medium high heat until margarine melts, about 3 - 5 minutes. Stir in celery salt, sesame seeds, and curry powder. Cook for 1 minute. Add guava nectar and curry powder. Stir until curry is just a little thin, about 1 minute.

title: Lebanese Apricot & Blueberry Pizza
ingredients: 15 g coriander seeds | 400 g sliced leeks | 200 g fresh apricots | 200 g honey | 400 g pizza crust, ready-made | 1 bunch coriander leaves | 250 g frozen blueberries ( defrosted if frozen )
instructions: Toast coriander seeds in a dry non stick frying pan over medium heat for about 3 minutes or until fragrant. Transfer to a bowl and cool. Finely chop coriander seeds. Trim leeks and cut into 5 cm lengths. Mix chopped coriander seeds with chopped leeks. Arrange leeks, apricots and honey over pizza base then sprinkle with coriander, leaving 2cm border on each side. Place pizza on tray, then top with coriander and blueberries. Bake in a medium oven about 20 minutes or until crust is puffed and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,sirloin,wonton wrapper,cumin powder,cooking oil,egg,red kidney bean,bouillon cube
title: Beef and Bean Pot Stickers With Wontons
ingredients: 1 cup red kidney beans, rinsed and drained well | 1/2 lb ground sirloin | 1/4 cup low-fat extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 large egg, lightly beaten | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 12 wonton wrappers ( these have pictures on the boxed ) | cooking oil ( for frying )
instructions: Place beans in a food processor and process until they disappear. In a bowl, combine the ground sirloin, cheese, egg, worcestershire sauce, and cumin. Stir in the beans until well blended. Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Place some of the bean mixture in the center of a won ton wrapper. Fold the dough in half on the left side and the other side and press the edges firmly together. If the wrapper becomes too flakey, moisten the edge with water and fold the rest of the wrapper over. Pinch the edges firmly together to seal them in. Heat the oil in a skillet, and fry the wontons in batches for a couple minutes each, until golden brown on all sides. Place the fried wontons in batches in a paper towel lined plate and serve immediately.

title: Applesauce on Rice
ingredients: 1 cup apple juice | 4 -6 lettuce leaves
instructions: Heat apple juice in a frying pan. Put lettuce leaves on your rice. Stir a few times so the lettuce leaves and the rice don't stick together, or when the juice is still floating over them, they don't move much. Serve warm.

title: Jollof Tortellini With Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon crushed tri-colored pepper ( i use red pepper ) | 2 tablespoons butter | 4 ounces canned cannellini beans | 1 tablespoon double sec
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, fry chicken thighs in melted butter until lightly browned. Remove it from the skillet, and place onto cutting board to rest in oven for 10 minutes. In the skillet, add beans and triple sec, stir, and cook for about 2 minutes until heated through. Preheat the broiler to high. Arrange the tortellini in oven for 6 minutes until lightly browned. Serve immediately, with a light salad.

Random Ingredients: pasta,fruit,almond,shrimp,almond extract,graham cracker crumb,red bell pepper,lettuce leaf
title: Shrimp Filled Pasta Salad

ingredients: 1 jar roasted garlic ( or less, see note ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh horseradish, grated

instructions: Place barley in large bowl. Rinse with cold water and drain. In a large skillet heat oil over medium high heat. title: Apple Beans and Corn
ingredients: 2 lbs baby corn, trimmed | 1 lb small green beans, trimmed | 1 apple, peeled, cored, cut into wedges | 2 garlic cloves, crushed
instructions: Simmer beans, corn and garlic in water with remaining ingredients until tender, about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: filling,blue curacao,pepperoni,chinese wine,seashell pasta,chutney,belgian endive,gruyere cheese
title: Korean Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen seashell pasta | 4 cups crumbled gruyere cheese, divided | 4 ounces thinly sliced pepperoni, cut in half | 7 ounces sliced fresh belgian endive, tops left whole | 1 ounce belgian blue curacao, halved | 1 tablespoon chutney | 1 fluid ounce sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup prepared sweet chutney
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Toss with 1/2 of the gruyere cheese, the pepperoni, endive and blue curacao. Combine the chutney and chutney in a small bowl. To serve, pour the filling into a serving bowl and top with remaining 2 tablespoons of the gruyere cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Glorious Nachos
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 1/2 cups crushed corn tortilla chips
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls into rapidly boiling, salted water. When noodles rise to the surface, they're done. Drain well and place on a plate or platter.

title: Greek Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 package small ladyfingers | 1 package shredded feta cheese | 2 cups milk | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line the bottom of a baking sheet with parchment paper. Lightly coat with cooking spray. Arrange the ladyfingers on the baking sheet, then sprinkle with cheese. Combine the milk and cinnamon in a small bowl, then pour evenly over the cheese. Bake in the preheated oven 12 minutes, until cheese is bubbly and browned. Remove from oven, and top with additional cheese.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,coconut milk,beef stock,vegetable oil cooking spray,aubergine,szechuan peppercorn,currant,celery rib
title: Beef and Pork Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs lean sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups beef stock, divided | 1 teaspoon dried sichuan peppercorns | 2 celery ribs, sliced | 1 aubergine, cubed ( eggplant ), peeled and cut into thin strips | 1 1/2 ounces currants | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Spray a nonstick wok or 2 - 4 tablespoons oil with cooking spray and set over high heat. Add beef and stir fry for 2 minutes or until meat is no longer pink. Stir fry celery, 1/2 cup stock and peppercorns for 1 minute. Add aubergine and stir fry for 3 minutes, or until tender. Add remaining 1/2 cup stock and coconut milk and stir fry for 3 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Stir in currants, heat through.

title: Peas With Walnuts
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen peas, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons walnut halves or 2 tablespoons cashew nuts
instructions: Combine the peas and nuts in a medium skillet and saute for about 3 to 4 minutes. Add the walnuts and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Swiss Hazelnut Cake
ingredients: 2 cups honey roasted hazelnuts | cornmeal, to dust
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Spread nuts evenly on a flat baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 15 to 40 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes, or until lightly colored and fragrant. Watch carefully, as they burn easily, watch carefully, as they burn easily. Remove nuts carefully, and watch carefully they burn quickly. Remove from oven. Cool. Sprinkle with more nutmeg. When completely cool, dust with cornmeal. Store in an airtight container.

title: Pigs in a Blanket
ingredients: 14 ounces pork, very lean | 14 ounces white mushrooms, wiped clean | 2 ounces walnut halves | 8 ounces pepperoni, sliced | white pepper | 2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Preheat grill. If using all lean pork, cut into 1 inch pieces and remove any membrane or undesirable parts. Using a large roasting pan, place pork on a rack that is slightly larger than the walnut halves. Drizzle with the molasses and season with salt and white pepper. Wrap the walnut halves around the pork so that they will fit snugly. Use foil, or brown garbage bags with a heavy cloth over the ham hock. Allow to dry for 2 days, before using. When ready to cook, use a sharp knife to cut the ham hock into 1 inch wide strips. Wash the mushrooms. Rinse the walnuts well and chop the basil. Remove as many large pieces of ham hock that will fit into your grill and reserve for another use. Scoop out the ham hock into a saute pan, and place in a single layer on the foil. Add the mushrooms and pepperoni slices and continue to saute, stirring as needed, for 10 – 15 minutes until the mushrooms are tender. Remove from heat, and place a strip of ham hock in the center all around and around the ham hock. Fold the ham hock over the ham, and allow to dry for 30 or 45 minutes. Remove the ham hock and place on a heavy plate. Using a kitchen towel, lightly wipe the ham hock. Use a sharp knife to remove the ham hock as many as possible from the foil sheet, and set aside the remaining ham hock for next use. Wash and chop the basil. Place all ingredients in the pan of a blender or food processor and blend on high speed until the walnuts are chopped and well ground. Pour into a bowl, stir, and cover with another piece of foil and chill for at least 30 minutes before serving. Serve with mashed potatoes or spaghetti, if you like.

title: Lebanese Cardamom Hot Cream or Soup
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Combine the hot cream/hot soup or soup stock in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in cardamom. To serve, pour into hot ramekins and serve immediately.

title: Apricot Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 14 ounces macaroni, cooked | 1/2 cup reduced-fat soymilk | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon apricot, chopped | 2 tablespoons lettuce leaves, finely shredded
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water until just tender. Drain.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,kaffir lime leaf,veal,mint,red enchilada sauce,shoulder lamb chop
title: Minty Veal With Grape Tomato Salad in Tomato-Chile Sauce
ingredients: 8 shoulder lamb chops, trimmed of fat | 2 -3 lbs grape tomatoes, washed, stems removed | 4 -5 kaffir lime leaves, bruised to release flavor | 1 teaspoon dried mint, crushed or 2 tablespoons fresh mint, chopped small | 2 -3 tablespoons vietnamese red enchilada sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 cup green mint or 1/2 cup basil, chopped
instructions: Place lamb on broiler pan. Season with salt and pepper. Broil on high for 3 minutes per side or until done to your taste. Remove from oven and let rest 10 minutes. Cut the tomatoes into quarters or chunks. Put on a platter, spoon 1 tsp mint and 1 tsp lime juice over them. Put the chops back in and spoon on the remaining mint and lime juice. Spoon the tomato sauce over them. Sprinkle with the crumbled mint and lime leaves. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: spinach,salsa,cream chicken soup,red chili paste,rice wine,mint,breadcrumb
title: Nigerian Spinach With Hot Rice
ingredients: 1 bag frozen chopped spinach | 1 cup of fresh diced breadcrumbs | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup sweet salsa | 1 teaspoon red chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mint | 2 1/2 cups hot cooked rice, preferably basmati or 2 1/2 cups jasmine rice, cooked, chilled and drained well
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Combine chopped spinach, bread crumbs, soup, salsa, chili paste, and mint in a large bowl. Stir in cooked rice. Using a fork, stir to blend. Spoon into a large cookie sheet. Place in freezer. To serve, break apart and serve.

Random Ingredients: biscuit dough,black eyed pea,bell pepper,stew meat,penne,pumpkin,fennel seed,sugar cube
title: Pasta with Stewed Pumpkin, Peppers and Garlic
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough, pillsbury recipe ready made dough | 2 lbs stew meat, stewed | 1 bell pepper ( any color ) | 1 can pumpkin | 1 can black-eyed peas | 1 sugar cube | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 3 -4 bell peppers ( any color ) | powdered sugar cube, for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Mix stew meat, bell pepper, pumpkin, chickpeas, fennel seed and sugar. Roll out 1 package of biscuit dough to fit a 9x9 inch baking dish. Place 1/2 mixture in a dish, roll up, place in baking dish, cover with greased plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. The next day, bake covered for about 50 - 60 mins, remove wrap and brush top with a little water, bake for 5 mins more, then sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving.

title: Baked Doughnuts (Nøderskål)
ingredients: 24 thin springy spring roll tops ( not sure size... ) or 24 small sponge cakes | 24 pieces small dinner rolls ( not sure size... ) or 24 dinner roll sheets ( not sure size... )
instructions: You have two ways to make a very basic danish sponge cake. Place an inverted 18 x 8 cake pan in the freezer until frozen and ready to proceed with recipe. If using doughnuts, roll each one into a log about 8 in long. Cut into four even lengthwise slices, then cut in half crosswise on bias. Repeat with second log. Place all of the slices and doughtnuts on a floured board and use your hands to stretch and stretch them until they are about 1/4 inch thick. Cut each slice into 6 equal pieces and place on a preheated baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes. Meanwhile cook your rolls in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain well and cool on a rack. Slice each cake in half crosswise and arrange cut sides down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Cover with waxed paper and set aside in a warm place. Heat your oven to 375 degrees f and lightly grease a large baking sheet. Remove the risen rolls from the baking sheet and gently stretch and stretch them until they are about 1/4 in thick. Place the rounds on the baking sheet leaving space between any of the cut sides. Brush with warm egg white so they will stick to the doughnuts. Bake until golden, about 25 minutes, and carefully remove from baking sheet on a rack. Let cool for 5 minutes before moving the rounds onto a plate for serving. Variation, while the dutchnuts make small indentations in the doughnuts, place a small piece of waxed paper between each. If the bread becomes really crispy you can brush that on while still on the baking sheet.

title: Kielbasa, Cheese and Corn Stuffed Potatoes

instructions: Place sausage in skillet.

instructions: Combine syrup, rice, 1/4 cup cheese, turmeric, and anise seed in an airtight container. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes prior to serving. instructions: Dissolve 1/2 cup sugar in the boiling water, add mustard oil, whisk together and set aside. Place remaining sugar/mustard, garlic, oil and 1 teaspoon of the horseradish in an ovenproof frying pan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for a few minutes. Add water and bring to boil. Simmer, stirring, for 2 - 3 minutes or until sauce thickens. Remove from heat and add remaining horseradish, stirring until combined, serve with fish or chips. Goes well with chicken as well as carrot sticks.

ingredients: 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 250 g red capsicums, roughly sliced | 225 g fresh papears, roughly chopped | 1 large pear, roughly pared, cored and roughly chopped
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl, then stir well. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight. When ready to cook, remove the stir fry from the refrigerator 10 minutes before serving. Serve with steamed rice.

ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice noodles, soaked in warm water until softened | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard | 1 medium red chile pepper | 3 large yellow squash - halved and seeded, as desired | 3 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, combine rice noodles, maple syrup, mustard, chili, squash, mirin, and mint. Cover and set in the refrigerator to allow flavors to develop, about 15 minutes.

title: Sweet and Smoky Sweetened Scented Tea
ingredients: 32 ladyfingers | 1 bunch broccoli, washed and chopped | 1/2 cup sugar | 6 cups strong black tea
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blitz the broccoli, sugar, and 4 cups water for 10 to 15 seconds. Stir in the tea and refrigerate.

title: Wild Rice
ingredients: 3 cups wild rice, washed and well rinsed | 4 -5 red chilies | 1 bunch radish, washed and cut into long thin slices | 1 1/2 cups yogurt | vegetable shortening ( for frying )
instructions: Wash and rinse wild rice well. Spread the wild rice between two layers of damp cloth, and soak until dry for a couple of hours. Place the chilies, the radishes and the salt in a saucepan and cover tightly with water. Bring to the boil, then lower the heat. Simmer on low heat for 30 minutes. Drain all of the water and stir wild rice into simmering chilies and radishes with fresh cream or yogurt. Serve hot, garnished with the shortening.

title: Black Eyed Pea and Raspberry Riesling (Rajas Con Cebola)
ingredients: 16 ounces black-eyed peas | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 lb fresh raspberry
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. In a 2 quart casserole dish, combine the black eyed peas, red wine, and raspberries. Mix well and bake for 45 minutes, or until tender and the berries are glazed.

title: Homemade Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 jars of mango chutney | 2 cups white sugar
instructions: Combine mango chutney and sugar in a bowl and mix well. Store covered in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,pepper sauce,extra virgin olive oil,basil
title: Capellini Pepper Oil
ingredients: 8 large peppers | 5 tablespoons hot chili sauce ( try ancho or chipotle ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped basil | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Trim the stem ends off each pepper, and slice off the stem. Slice the pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Heat the remaining olive oil in a skillet, and cook the pepper strips in it over medium heat until they start to change color, 3 to 4 minutes, turning them over to cook all sides. Sprinkle the pepper with basil, and shake the skillet to remove most of the basil. Continue to cook peppers until all of the oil cooks out. Remove from heat, and toss in pepper sauce. Stir in additional basil, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chuck steak,head cauliflower,tamari,irish cream,poblano chile,ancho chile powder,oat,self raising flour
title: Tear and Eat Beef and Cauliflower Croquettes
ingredients: 250 g self-raising flour | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder ( optional ) | 300 g chuck steaks | 1 tablespoon tamari, sauce | 12 poblano chiles, trimmed, cut into small pieces | 2 heads cauliflower, cut into small florets | 1 tablespoon extra oats | 250 ml irish cream
instructions: Put your flour in a mixing bowl. Add 2 tablespoons of tamari and stir to combine. Dip your chuck in the flour, shake off excess. Tear off a piece of tinned foil and put in your tin. Place your beef in your tin and coat with the flour to completely cover. Heat your oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Put the poblanos on a baking tray and bake for 25 - 30 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the stalk is charred. Cool for 5 minutes, remove from the oven, cut the meat into small pices and put in a warm oven. While the meat is sitting, put the cauliflower florets in a pan of boiling water and cook for 10 minutes. Drain and put aside. Now put your oven on. Turn your oven down to 150 degrees centigrade and preheat the oven to 220 degrees centigrade. When you feel the oven's hottest remove it from the oven and, with a slotted spoon, put the beef in a large ovenproof dish. Toss it with the roasted poblanos and return it to the oven for 20 minutes until the beef is brown and everything is cooked. Toss it once more, and check that it is cooked through. If it is, put it back into the oven for a few minutes to warm through. Make sure it is warm enough to serve by sitting it on a chopping board with some arugula in it, which should just soak up the flavour. To serve, spread the pocces on a dinner plate and top with the chopped cauliflower, followed by the beef, roasted poblanos, and the cauliflower floret. Top with cream and drizzle with a little extra tamari. Serve with a fresh loaf of bread.

title: Gourmet White Wine Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half cream ( or substitute heavy cream ) | 1/8 cup white vinegar
instructions: Place all ingredients in saucepan. Serve with vegetables, meats or rice.

title: Brussels Sprouts in Pomegranate and Pomegranate Juice
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout, trimmed | 2 -3 pomegranate juice or 2 -3 ounces orange juice | 1 tablespoon low-sodium worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon greek seasoning | 1/8 cup light olive ( kalamansi ) | 2 celery ribs | 1/4 cup pecans or 1/4 cup walnut pieces | 1/8 teaspoontabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Bring the brussels sprouts to a boil in 3/4 cup of water. Cover and continue to boil to the very top of the water, approximately 5 to 6 minutes. Drain the brussels sprouts, and rinse well with cold water. Shake the brussels sprouts off the bottom of the pan to remove any excess water. Transfer to a bowl and mix with the remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Blueberry Cherry Soup
ingredients: 250 g blueberries | 100 g dried cherries
instructions: In a small saucepan bring half the water to the boil, add berries and reduce heat. Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Add the cherries and season to taste. Serve.

Random Ingredients: raspberry vinegar,cream sherry,bean sprout,frangelico,onion soup mix,tabasco sauce,shallot,pork sparerib
title: Baked Pork Sills and Blossoms
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs pork spareribs | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 cups cream sherry | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 4 shallots, chopped | 1 bunch fresh bean sprouts ( or frozen, chopped green onions, or red shallots ) | raspberry vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Lay out the spareribs and place them on lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake in a moderate oven for approximately 1 hour. Turn them over, and again bake for another hour. After that, remove from oven, cool down any remaining fat. Slice the ribs, and set aside. Prepare the sauce by combining the onions, salt, pepper, hot pepper sauce, and dijon mustard in medium saucepan. Cook until onions are translucent. Add the cream sherry, tabasco sauce, and the rest of the dry onion soup mix to the sauce mixture. Heat through, remove from heat, then cool. When the sills are cool enough to handle, slice them crosswise in half, and spread out each half with the back of the spoon. Place the sliced pork over each half, and spread bean sprouts on top of them. The rusks should cover them. Pour the sauce over all of the meat. Sprinkle with fresh chopped greens of onion or scallions. You can use the vinegar to add flavor or sprinkle with salt, but it tastes quite salty and is hard to ruin the flavor of the rusks. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes, stirring half way through. Serve warm or room temperature with toast.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,linguine pasta,heavy cream,dripping,coconut milk,ricotta cheese,greek yogurt,gruyere cheese
title: Creamy Linguine With Cheese and Coconut Nests
ingredients: 1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 1/3 cup coconut milk | 3 ounces linguine pasta | 2/3 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/3 cup ricotta cheese | 3/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/4 cup crumbled feta-stuffed greek yogurt | chopped olive oil, for drizzling
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add coconut milk, linguine pasta and simmer, stirring often, until pasta is tender but still lightly chewy, about 16 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Whisk together cream, greek yogurt, ricotta cheese and greeere cheese in large bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in cumin seeds. Pour sauce into small flameproof casserole and sprinkle with olive oil. Top with bread crumbs. Serve.

title: Lunchbox Salad (Vietnamese)

instructions: Wash lettuce. Separate the leaves of lettuce, as any large leaves will be tough. When you're done assembling the pile, place a small slice of cream or vanilla cream in the center of a lettuce leaf. Roll up like a cigar. Repeat till you're done packing in the cream. Enjoy.

instructions: In a small container, combine the sauce ingredients. Set aside. Bring a medium pot of water to a boil.

title: Grilled Thanksgiving Turkey Ham

instructions: Grill turkey until no longer pink inside. Spread turkey with maple syrup and sprinkle with cinnamon. Grill onions until limp.

instructions: Mix together all ingredients except soured cream and parsley. Heat over medium high to high heat on griddle. Patties should be brown on the outside, but not burned. To serve, divide meat between buns. Spoon on top of meat. Garnish with a bit of sour cream and cilantro if desired.

instructions: Trim and discard ends of zucchini.

title: Blue Ribbon and Radishes With Fresh Blueberries

instructions: In a 2 1/2 or larger jar, reserve 2 cups of the fresh blueberries. Rinse & drain the remaining 1 1/2 c berry juice. Discard the stems & the rind. Place the berry juice in the bowl of a blender & mix until the liquors are completely dissolved. Strain into a clean container, cover, & freeze overnight. Uncover the container & freeze overnight. The next day, before serving add 5/6 c more of the reserved blueberries. Cover tightly & let it rest for 30 minutes before serving with toast or crackers.

title: Apple Cider BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup french dressing | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Baste on meat during cooking.

title: Mexican Corn Rice
ingredients: 1 bag brown rice, frozen | 24 ounces cream-style corn | hot salsa ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.

title: Aromatic Tomato Sauce

instructions: In a small bowl stir together the tomato juice, garlic, and oregano. Stir in the soy sauce. This sauce can keep for up to 3 days or can be frozen for up to 5 months.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,mustard seed,sesame oil,salmon fillet,soy sauce,vanilla bean
title: Italian-Style Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 4 teaspoons dry mustard seeds | 1 vanilla bean | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed & drained
instructions: Dry the salmon well on paper towels, pat dry. Place in a non reactive container & pour the marinade over. Marinate 20 minutes. instructions: Put the chopped onions in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer until the onions are transparent. Remove from heat and let cool. Drain well and place in a large bowl with the sliced leeks and celery. Put the prunes in a microwave bowl or a bowl with a lid. Microwave on high power for about 3 minutes, or until the prunes are just softened. Drain the prunes and pour into the bowl with the onions and celery. Stir well. Add the icing sugar, onion soup mix, taco seasoning and parsley. Toss to combine. Cover and leave to stand for 2 hours at room temperature before serving.

title: Chili Beef Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 1 loaf beef fresh sandwich crust ( such as texas toast ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Cut beef top and all the way to the bottom of sandwich. Rub chili powder on edge of bread for a crispy crust. Fill inside bread with seasoned beef and onion. Cut french loaf lengthwise into 8 squares, and serve.

title: Macaroni Apple Crumble
ingredients: 150 g dried macaroni | 1 chicken stock cube | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce or 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 3 tablespoons dry pepitas, flakes | 1 tablespoon light apple cider | 1 tablespoon mashed dried active yeast | 2 tablespoons hot chili sauce or 2 tablespoons cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place the macaroni in a large bowl with the stock cube, tomato puree, hot pepper, pepitas flakes, cider and yeast. Stir to combine. Place in a large baking dish or pan and cover with a clean cloth to double wrap. Refrigerate overnight or for up to 3 days before using.
