The recipe is fairly flexible so be guided by your macaroni cookbook.

title: Crusty Baked  Bamboo Shoot
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 f or a convection oven.

title: Apple Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 medium beets | 1 tart apple, peeled and diced | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Dice the beet and apple.. Heat cornflour in a frying pan then add the apple, beet and apple. Add a little water and stir well. When it is hot pour into an oven proof pan. Sprinkle with crushed cardamom seeds. Bake at 150c for about 20 - 30 minutes or until the apple is a little mushy. Variation if you want a thicker consistency, add an egg, or add a few drops of cream to the beet soup before adding the egg.

title: Lebanese Shortbread
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 1 cup cream | 1 cup salad oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Work dough. Cut with a cookie cutter to size you prefer. Let dough rest while preparing ingredients. Place mixture on a paper lined baking sheet. Bake at 375°f until just golden brown 15 to 20 minutes for light brown.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,chicken meat,egg yolk,beef brisket,beef stew meat,feta cheese,catsup
title: Crock Pot Beef Pastitsio With Feta Cheese, and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 package feta cheese, crumbled | 1 cup catsup | 1/2 cup beef stew meat or 1/2 cup turkey stew meat, chopped | 1 egg yolk | 2 lbs beef brisket, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 -2 lb farfalle pasta
instructions: In crockpot, add the feta cheese, catsup and beef. Add the egg yolk, and then the beef and turkey. Cook on high 4 - 6 hours. Meanwhile, cook the farfalle pasta or other large tubular pasta of your choice. Drain the pasta and toss with some of the cooking liquid. Serve with some of the cooking liquid drizzled over the top.

title: Venison and Chorizo Stuffed Wraps
ingredients: 3 -6 tablespoons spanish chorizo, fat removed | 1 1/2 kg venison, ground | 2 cups nonfat dry milk | 3 1/2 cups nonfat dried milk | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon crushed turmeric powder | 1/2 cup walnut pieces | 2 tablespoons halved dried currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°c. Place the chili fat in a small pan, fry the spanish chorizo and ground venison over a medium heat until the fat starts sizzling, add the nonfat dry milk and simmer, stirring occasionally and bring to the boil to reduce the liquid by half pour the liquid through a fine mesh sieve into a large bowl, stir in the dried mixed pulses, salt and turmeric, mix well. Add the walnuts, currants and the dried fruit juices and mix well. Roll the prepared wrap into 20 small long rolls which are 6 in length and about 3/4 thick. Wrap the unfilled wraps in parchment and tie each one with cotton string. Place the wraps in a large baking tin and roast for 1 1/2 hours, turn every so often.

title: Lamb Kebab
ingredients: 1/2 lb lamb shoulder, trimmed and cubed | 1/2 lb red potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1/2 lb baking potato, peeled and cubed | 1/2 lb smoked turkey breast, with bones, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 bunch cilantro leaf, stemmed and loosely packed
instructions: Prepare grill using medium hot grill. Make the spice mixture, combine lamb, potatoes, cilantro and turkey bones. Place meat on skewers. Close grill. Grill until meat is cooked well. If using barbecue mate, turn meat on the grill.

title: Danish Filled Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 2 cups fresh danish cherries or 2 cups frozen cherries | 1/2 cup fresh dill, chopped or 1/4 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: In small bowl, mash cherry or whole cherries with fork. Mix in remaining ingredients. Set aside for 15 minutes for flavors to blend into cherry mixture.

title: Chickpea Salad Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 2 cans chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 cup golden raisin | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Place noodles in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients except for almond extract. Toss until well combined. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,apple cider vinegar,mexican oregano,red pepper flake,pine nut,chipotle chile adobo,mirin
title: Pine Nut Feta Salad
ingredients: 2 cans chipotle chiles in adobo | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 2 1/2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1 tablespoon mexican oregano | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, or to taste | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the chipotle chilies, pine nuts, vinegar, mirin, oregano and red pepper flakes. Blend in the cheese just until it is combined.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,nutmeg,egg beater substitute,cottage cheese,celery seed,club soda,celery salt,marshmallow
title: Low Fat No-Yeast Low Fat Stovetop Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sourdough starter yeast | 8 cups fat-free cottage cheese | 1/4 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon nutmeg | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 12 cups powdered egg whites ( not egg or milk ) | 16 cups club soda
instructions: In large mixer bowl mix together yeast, cottage cheese, egg beaters, and seasonings. Add wet ingredients, blend till combined. Turn onto lightly floured board and knead till elastic, about 10 minutes. Place in buttered bowl, cover and let rise til bubbly, about 40 minutes. Punch dough down and turn onto a lightly floured board. Knead till smooth and elastic. Place on lightly floured board, cover and let rise till light. In medium mixer bowl beat egg whites till stiff. Add club soda, and beat till stiff peaks form. Transfer egg whites to greased 8x8x2 inch loaf pan. Cover. Set aside in a warm place til foamy. Bake at 350°f for 45 - 55 minutes till edges are slightly crispy.

Random Ingredients: mace,broccoli floret,baby carrot,corn tortilla,water,picante sauce,sage leaf
title: Microwave Spicy Vegetable Enchiladas from Campbell's Kitchen
ingredients: 1 box frozen broccoli florets, thawed and drained | 10 ounces baby carrots or 10 ounces green carrots, cut into thin shreds | 1 can fire-roasted corn tortillas, warm | 1 jar picante sauce, medium | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup water ( optional ) | mace ( optional )
instructions: Mix first 4 ingridients in a microwave safe bowl, cover and cook on high 10 minutes. Pour into 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with mace. Microwave on high 3 to 4 minutes. Sprinkle with desired amount of mace. Microwave on high 2 to 3 minutes, until heated through and vegetables are soft.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,allspice,cashew,parmesan cheese,active yeast,creme fraiche,cumin seed,pork tenderloin
title: Cheeseburger Cashew Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon sour cream or 1 tablespoon cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds, lightly crushed | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried active dry yeast | 1 lb pork tenderloin, trimmed of surface fat, pounded to ¼ inch thick ( about 2 ) | 1 tablespoon cashews, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped roasted salted cashews
instructions: Combine creme fraiche, sour cream, parmesan cheese, cumin, allspice, and dried yeast in small bowl and let stand until bubbly, about 5 minutes. Cut pork into ¼ inch wide strips. In large bowl, combine pork with 3 tablespoons cashews, remaining 1 tablespoon cashews, and remaining teaspoon cumin, and 1 teaspoons of allspice.

Random Ingredients: steak,yukon gold potato,farfalle pasta,hot red chili pepper,vegetable stock,broccoli
title: Thai Slow Cooker Beef & Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 500 g whole low-fat flank steak | 1/2 cup uncooked farfalle pasta | 2 large yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 2cm cubes | 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 hot red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 3/4 cup broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Trim the steak of any fat or gristle and cut into thin slices. Place the farfalle in a large mixing bowl, add the potatoes followed by the chicken/broccoli and pour over the stock. Toss well. Cover and stand for 12 hours at room temperature, or in the fridge for up to 8 hours.. Drain the farfalle and return it to the base of the slow cooker. Increase the cooking time for the beef and potatoes, if they haven't already cooked enough, after 12 hours, remove it and keep it warm. Increase the slow cooker to high and cook for 30 minutes. Stir the soup, season to taste and serve.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,chicken broth,lettuce leaf,extra virgin olive oil,red chili pepper
title: Spicy Cauliflower
ingredients: 400 g cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 red chili pepper, deseeded and finely sliced | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons chicken broth | 5 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Place the cauliflower in a large pan of boiling, salted water. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat to medium, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Drain and cool for 5 min, then drain well. Heat oil in a pan, add chili and cook for 1 min stir in cauliflower, stir for 1 minute. Stir in broth, cook for 2 mins, then remove from the heat and cool. Divide between lettuce bowls, pour remaining sauce over and scatter with red chilli.

title: Blueberry Guacamole
ingredients: 4 avocados, mashed | 1/2 cup blueberries, frozen ( reserve 1/4 cup liquid ) | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 fruit, diced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well mixed. Add reserved liquid and stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: turkey,lemon peel,green apple,pasta shell,cannellini bean,triple sec,white mushroom,italian plum tomato
title: Pasta Shells and Beans
ingredients: 10 ounces tri-colored cheesecloth, with ties | 1 can white mushrooms | 1/4 lb turkey | 2 cans cannellini beans | 1/3 cup triple sec | 10 ounces italian plum tomatoes | 3 slices lemon peel | 8 ounces pasta shells
instructions: Rinse turkey and brown. Drain. Trim green mushrooms, cut into 2 chunks, dice. Drain cannellini beans, rinse. Dice turkey, shred with cheesecloth in large skillet, drain juices. Pour turkey, beans, tomatoes, lemon peel and juice into slow cooker. Heat until hot, pour over pasta, stir, cover and cook on high until pasta is tender 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Easy Beef and Noodles for Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 4 cellophane noodles ( or 1 package linguine ) | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Spray a 4 quart slow cooker with veggie cooking spray. Put stew meat in crock pot. Cover with cellophane noodles or linguine. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover. Cook on low for about 7 hours or high for 3 - 4 hours and then turn to high for 5 hour.

title: Baked Tomatoes, Mushrooms & Rice
ingredients: 500 g tomatoes with juice | 400 g stew meat | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 1/2 cup mushroom, finely chopped | 3 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150oc/gas cut stew meat into 1cm chunks. Place in a casserole dish with the tomatoes, thyme and mushrooms. Season to taste and cover the dish with foil. Cook in the oven for 2 1/2 hours until the tomatoes are cooked and the juices have reduced and concentrated. Remove the foil, remove the tomatoes, thyme and mushrooms from the casserole and serve from the baking dish.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,bulk italian sausage,arborio rice,cardamom,chicken,wasabi powder
title: Egg Rolls With Sausage & Wasabi - wasabi Rice, Rice & Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 8 ounces bulk italian sausage | 1 medium chicken, cooked and finely shredded | 12 ounces arborio rice | 1 tablespoon wasabi powder | 1 1/2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips | cardamom | chocolate chips
instructions: Heat oven to in large nonstick skillet, heat sausage until just slightly browned. Drain. In 2 1/2 to 3 quart cassrole, combine sausage, chicken, rice, wasabi and 1/2 cup chocolate chips and mix well, breaking it into pieces. Shape into 12 oblong cylinders. Arrange about 2 inches apart on parchment lined or greased baking sheets. Brush rolls with remaining melted, buttered chocolate and sprinkle with cardamom. Bake in preheated 400 degree oven until tops are golden brown, about 10 - 15 minutes. Cool until almost completely warm, about 10 minutes.. Slice diagonally across. Serve with a dip sauce such as wasabi dipping sauce or wasabi rice dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,sirloin,kaffir lime leaf,topping,red bell pepper
title: Spicy Thai Beef Salad
ingredients: 14 -16 ounces sirloin, skirt steak or 14 -16 ounces other very lean cut steak | 3 kaffir lime leaves, thinly sliced | 1 red bell pepper, julienned | fresh cilantro stem ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Trim any visible fat from steak. Remove any fat from steak. In a large ziploc baggie, squeeze out the lime leaves and add the sliced meat. Squeeze out as much air as possible and add the lime leaves. Add the bell peppers. Stir in the chopped cilantro leaves and refrigerate for one hour. Serve on a platter with hot thai chunky style dressing and warm spiced bread.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,rum extract,confectioner ' sugar,chinese noodle,cake flour,clove,lemongrass,chipotle chile
title: Devilled Lentils, Chipotles or Long Beans
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils or 1 cup french green lentils, well rinsed and drained | 1/2 an ounce chinese noodles, soaked 5 minutes in hot water until tender ( can sub short pasta of this ) | 4 stalks lemongrass, chopped | 1/2 inch piece clove | 1 tablespoon chopped garlic | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried chipotle chile ( paste from canned chipotles ) | 2 tablespoons rum extract | confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine the lentils, noodles or long beans and lemongrass with water to cover. Bring to boil over moderate heat, reduce heat to lightly simmer, and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, about 30 minutes. Stir in the garlic, cloves, chile, rum extract, and 2 tablespoons water. Cover and simmer until noodles are cooked, about 15 minutes, or to desired tenderness. Serve hot.

title: Farfalle With Shrimp and Radishes
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 4 bunches fresh radishes, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4-inch-thick rounds | 2 cups peeled cooked shrimp | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup packed coarsely chopped plum tomato | 1/4 cup icing, for dusting ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling water until just tender, 8 to 10 minutes. Meanwhile, toss the radish rounds in the remaining 3 tablespoons of icing. Drop the radish rounds, a few at a time, into boiling water just long enough for the radishes to be blanched. Drain the radish rounds, place in a bowl, and toss with enough pasta to coat, about 2 1/2 tablespoons. Add the shrimp and tomato and toss to coat. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Place a few radishes on each plate, spoon 1/2 cup pasta mixture over, and serve immediately.

title: Pork and Mango Sticks
ingredients: 2 -3 large mangoes, peeled, pitted, cut in 1/16 inch slices | 2 -3 green onions, cut lengthwise in half and then into 1/16 inch slices | 3 lbs pork belly, cut about 3 thick slices | 1/4 cup tamarind juice ( i use the juice of 3 medium mangos, peeled and finely grated ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Toss mangoes, green onions, ginger, vinegar, savory and garlic salt together in a bowl. Let sit at least 1/2 hour at room temperature and up to 2 hours in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 400°f. Wash, remove thick rib and skewer meat onto each mango by sewing it with cotton or a piece of string. Place on a baking sheet and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Transfer to a serving plate when ready to serve.

title: Brazilian Broccoli (Broccoli)
ingredients: 1/4 cup sliced black olives | 1 can chicken bouillon | 1 bunch broccoli, trimmed and cut into florets
instructions: Place the sliced olives into a saucepan over medium heat, and cook and toss the olives with the chicken bouillon until the chicken bouillon dissolves. Bring the mixture to a simmer, pour in the broccoli, and continue cooking until the broccoli is tender and the sauce has thickened.

title: Chicken Wings (Chicken or Vegetarian)
ingredients: 12 chicken wings | banana ( optional )
instructions: Bake about 12 minutes until crisp and the color turns light brown. Place on baking sheet sprayed with pam.

title: Veal and Rice Lasagna
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles, cooked al dente | 1 lb ground veal | 2 green onions, sliced | 3 cups prepared prepared white basmati rice
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions. Remove from heat and drain well. Brown the ground veal in a large skillet for 5 minutes, remove from skillet. Add the green onions to the pan the browned veal is in, and mix well. Add the cooked noodles to the meat mixture, and stir to combine. Place in an 8x8 inch baking pan. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or until set. Remove from refrigerator and bake for 30 minutes. Serve with cooked, drained noodles.

title: Tortillas With Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 medium brussels sprouts | 2 tablespoons flour tortillas | 1/2 cup shredded cooked brussels sprout
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut stem from brussels sprouts. Place sprouts in a small roasting pan or baking dish. Drizzle vegetables with extra virgin olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake vegetables in the center of the oven 3 to 4 minutes, or until brussels sprouts are to desired tenderness, stirring occasionally. While vegetables are cooking, place tortillas on oven rack and bake 3 to 4 minutes or until just heated through. Top each warmed tortilla with sprouts and shredded brussels sprouts and serve warm.

title: Crock Pot Lamb Chops
ingredients: 12 shoulder lamb chops | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast
instructions: If using dried yeast in liquid measure out 2 tablespoons to act as dry yeast. Rinse lamb and dry with paper towels. Rub the scallions on the lamb. Place the lamb in the crock pot. Combine 1 teaspoon yeast and 1 teaspoon butter or margarine and pour into the pot. Cover. Set on low heat and cook until lamb is very tender. This makes about 6 to 8 hours. Take off heat and let stand 10 - 15 minutes before slicing. Note, this recipe can be frozen, and it works just fine if you leave in the bag and cook on cold, warm cycle.

title: Spicy Italian Crock Pot Caramelized Ham Hocks
ingredients: 1 ham hock | 500 g canned italian tomatoes | 1/2 cup coffee | 2 -4 cm ginger | 1/2 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 4 eggs | 1/3 cup chopped crystallized ginger
instructions: Place rack in lower third of oven and preheat to 200°c. Slice ham hock into 2 3cm lengths using tweezers or kitchen shears, and set aside. Finely chop canned tomatoes place in medium bowl with remaining ingredients and mix well. Place ham in bottom of an 8 inch square casserole dish and cover with the tomato mixture. Pour boiling water in the bottom of the casserole dish and place in preheated oven, about 180°c, for 25 minute, or until golden brown, stirring occasionally. Remove ham and slice into slices. To serve, remove ham from hot casserole dish, and keep warm in oven. Degrease pan and return pan juices to the heat and boil for a few minutes, stirring constantly. Return ham slices to pan, remove from heat and serve.

title: Feta Chapli with Garlic and Basil (Kaffir Lime)
ingredients: 1 bunch basil leaves | 1/4 cup fresh kaffir lime leaves or 1/4 cup fresh tarragon leaves | 8 ounces feta | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh italian or ( 1 g ) teaspoon creole pepper basil leaves
instructions: Briefly warm 1/2 cup basil in 1 inch of water. Add 1/8 cup of kaffir lime leaves and let sit until water becomes very cold, about 10 minutes. Drain leaves very well in strainer and toss with basil, feta and italian pepper basil leaves. Variation, kaffir lime is available at asian specialty food stores, asparagas, or asian sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,curry powder,green enchilada sauce,red capsicum,snow pea,ice water
title: Green Rice Salad
ingredients: 400 g green enchilada sauce | 2 cups rice wine ( or equivalent of rice wine ) | 500 g snow peas ( trimmed ) | 1 medium red capsicum ( deseeded and finely sliced ) | 1/2 bunch red curry powder, divided | 10 -15 ice water | 250 g chilled green rice ( or equivalent rice white vermicelli )
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large saucepan. Heat gently, covered, over low heat for 10 - 20 minutes or until wine boils. Add snow peas to hot rice. Set aside to cool slightly. Add capsicum and curry powder to rice wine mixture. Stir well. Remove from heat, then stir in 3 ice cubes. Cover and leave in fridge for 20 minutes or until cold. Remove lid from mixture and stir in rice. Serve immediately.

title: Quinoa-Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup couscous | 1/2 cup wild rice, cooked | 1/2 cup quinoa ( not instant ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 16 slices french bread, cut in half ( each about 3 inches long )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Prepare couscous according to package directions. Add wild rice and quinoa and mix well. Cut 2 slices of the french bread and spread 2 tablespoons of couscous mixture over half of each bread slice, then top with a second slice of bread. Heat a griddle or large frying pan over medium heat. Cook 2 bread halves 2 - 3 minutes on each side, or until lightly toasted. Serve.

title: Tea Eggs
ingredients: 1 ounce black tea ( we used colavita, but i like decaf ) or 1 ounce lemon tea ( we used colavita, but i like decaf ) | 1 hard-boiled egg
instructions: Fill the microwaveable mugs or small coffee cups with hot water. Fill with tea and a slice of egg. Cover and microwave on high 15 - 20 minutes till tea is set or the whites of the eggs have turned golden.

Random Ingredients: sugar icing,veal,whiskey,tamari,apple cider,green chili pepper,allspice,milk powder
title: The Ultimate Tamari Fudge
ingredients: 250 g tamari | 125 ml sugar icing | 600 ml low fat evaporated milk powder | 500 ml sugar icing | 2 teaspoons green chili peppers ( roasted, peeled and finely chopped ) | 500 ml whiskey | 1 teaspoon lemon juice or 1 teaspoon lime juice | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Mix the tamari and sugar in a bowl then add the evaporated milk powder and mix well. Add the green chilies, whisky and lemon juice. Pour filling into a greased rectangular slice pan and bake in a moderate oven until the middle is dry and the top is a light golden brown colour. Allow to set and cut into fingers before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,cardamom pod,cayenne,ranch bean,red wine vinegar,rye flour
title: Swedish Rye Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pods, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne, or to taste | 2 1/2 tablespoons rajah-no-serve plain powdered ranch-bean blend | 1 tablespoon rye flour, or to taste
instructions: Pour red wine vinegar into a small, nonstick skillet, then add chicken broth cube. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then stir in cardamom, cayenne, rajah mix and rye flour.

title: Stuffed Sauerkrauters
ingredients: 600 g sauerkraut, prepared | 1/4 kg minced sirloin
instructions: Slice off about 1 cm from the edge. Fill with the saurergrat and pinch. Repeat the same procedure with remaining saurkraut, with minced sirloin in between. Roll from one long end, then twist to seal. Secure with skewers through the kraut if desired. Bake in oven for 30 to 45 minutes. The amount of filling depends on how large your saurkraut is. They should be soft.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,coffee,orange flower water,barbecue sauce,anise seed
title: Puff Paste for Roast Beef
ingredients: 10 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon orange flower water | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1/8 teaspoon instant coffee
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a bowl and rub in between your hands. Rub into the meat until the mixture is well incorporated and the meat is coated with flavor. Preheat your oven to 500 degrees f. Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, depending on how well done you like your meat. If you prefer a medium rare meat, roast for about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,apple juice,green bell pepper,baby spinach leaf,active yeast,dark rum,ricotta cheese
title: Spinach Calzones
ingredients: 8 ounces baby spinach, washed and trimmed | 2 3/4 cups bread crumbs | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons shredded part skim ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup plain dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup white rum | 1 can dark rum | 1 package active dry yeast
instructions: Place spinach in a large bowl, and sprinkle with 1 3/4 cups bread crumbs and ½ cup green pepper. Toss to coat. Cover, and place in the refrigerator. Let rise in a warm place until doubled. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease 2 heavy baking sheets. When the dough has risen, punch down, and let sit for 1 minute. Divide into 4 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a 6 inch circle. Place on baking sheets. In a small bowl, mix ricotta cheese and 1/4 cup bread crumbs, in a small bowl. In a small saucepan, combine rum, rum, and the remaining 1 cup of bread crumbs. Place the rum mixture into a small pot, and heat to boiling, then remove the heat. Place half of the calzones in the preheated oven with the tops set up. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, then remove from the oven. Split the remaining calzones in half. Top with half of the ricotta cheese mixture, and return to the oven. Bake an additional 10 minutes, or until golden.

title: Danish Beef and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/4 cup warm water | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 3 cups flour | 2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 1 cup tart apple, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 6 medium carrots, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast over the water. Let stand 5 minutes, then stir to dissolve the yeast. Stir in 1 cup of the flour and the salt. Stir in the remaining flour 1 cup at a time, alternating with the yeast mixture. Beat with an electric mixer until the dough loses its stickiness and forms a smooth yet firm ball. Cover and let rise in a warm place 20 minutes. Mix the carrots, remaining flour, and the remaining yeast. When the dough has doubled in volume, punch it down. Grease two 15x20 inch jelly roll pans, or line with parchment paper. Stir together the vegetable mixture and spread evenly over the paper. Roll the dough out onto the vegetables as thinly as possible. Bake at 350° for 10 - 15 minutes, or until very light brown.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,rigatoni pasta,cream tartar,brown lentil,dark brown sugar,potato,ketchup
title: Lentil & Sweet Potato Pasta With Brown Sugar
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and cut into chunks | 5 ounces light brown lentils, rinsed and drained | 4 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons plain low-fat sour cream or 2 tablespoons soy sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh flat leaf parsley
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f place the pasta in a large roasting pan, add 2/3 cup water and stir to combine. Cover and cook for 10 minutes, then drain and tip the sweet potato into the pan. Cook, covered, for 30 minutes. Cook the lentils and sweet potato in a large pan of boiling water, uncovered, for 5 minutes or until tender. Drain, then return to the pan along with the lentils, ketchup, sour cream, and cream of tartar. Toss, then transfer to a large ovenproof dish, cover, and bake for 15 minutes. Top with parsley and serve.

title: Scrubbed German Chocolate
ingredients: 100 g german sweet chocolate | lemon wedge, for rubbing
instructions: Place your german sweet chocolate in a heat resistant bowl, bring to a steady simmer and stir frequently for 10 minutes, or until a smooth and creamy consistency is formed. Remove from heat and stir in a few drops of lemon juice and a few drops of lime juice to the melted german chocolate. Use and rub on your favorite sponge or sponge finger, and let it drip down your fingers, then dip the surface of the candy with a thin film of lemon juice for a rich, shiney shiney finish. Refrigerate until firm.

Random Ingredients: pineapple,demerara sugar,corn syrup,pistachio,beef brisket,suet,watercress leaf,corn oil
title: Tropical Brisket
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs beef brisket | 1 pineapple, peeled, cored, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 -3 tablespoons demerara sugar | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 3 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 24 -50 large watercress leaves | wooden skewer, soaked in water
instructions: Combine 1 cup sugar with 3 tablespoons of light corn syrup in small bowl and set aside. Using meat mallet, pound brisket between two sheets of wax paper to a thickness of about 1/8 1/4 inch. Drain off any water that has seeped onto the meat from step score it using diagonal lines. Remove string where needed and arrange meat on a rack in a roasting pan or large shallow baking pan in a single layer. Add pineapple, mandarin, pine nuts and a little corn syrup mixture to the slits of the meat. Set aside. Pour remaining 1 cup sugar syrup into a small saucepan and stir over medium heat until sugar has dissolved. Raise heat to medium and cook until syrup comes to boil and becomes slightly transparent, 2 or 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 cup water. Drain meat and reserve syrup. Rub remaining 1/2 cup syrup on outside of brisket, inside and out. Tent with foil. Place meat in hot fat side up on rack in roasting pan and cook for 2 hours basting every 15 minutes with glazing mixture.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,italian tomato,cilantro leaf,great northern bean,cake flour,savoiardi cooky,black peppercorn
title: Citrus and Italian Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb great northern bean ( italian-mexican ) | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 8 ounces savoiardi cookies | 1 jar roasted italian tomatoes, in tomato sauce or ( 28 ounce ) jar tomato sauce | 1/4 cup cake flour, sifted | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Scrub and rinse beans. Place in a 3 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with peppercorns and salt. Cook uncovered for 25 minutes until beans are heated and slightly brown. Remove from oven and set aside in oven. In a medium bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Add beans and gently stir until well blended. Spoon over warm bread and bake uncovered for 15 minutes until bread is golden brown.

title: Beetroot W-Vegetarian Sazon
ingredients: 300 g farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 250 g red beets ( peeled, finely chopped ) | 250 g couscous | 3 tablespoons french mustard | 1 tablespoon soybeans ( dried beans or pearl onions in natural juice ) | 1 tablespoon dried parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 tablespoon dried parsley, crushed
instructions: Cook the pasta till just tender, according to the directions on the package. Cook the tofu according to package directions. Drain the pasta and set aside. Rinse the beets and chop finely, then steam them for 4 minutes. Set them aside and let sit for 5 minutes. Remove the beets from the water, place them through a sieve and reserve the liquid. Boil the wok, with the cooking oil, for 2 minutes. Add the couscous to wok and stir in the mustard, soybeans, drained beetroot, dried parsley and finally a splash of the reserved beet liquid. Stir well till the couscous is creamy and hot and the tomatoes are distributed evenly and heated through. Take out the wok contents and sprinkle dry ingredients over the top. Sprinkle dried parsley.

title: Paleo Crock Pot Beef and Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb chuck | 1 lb stew meat | 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup sour cream | 3 lbs lean ground round | 2 lbs lean ground meat | 5 eggs | 3 cups cooked chicken meat
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a crock pot and let sit overnight in the fridge and come to work the next day. When ready to cook, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix in eggs and meat and flour until dough is formed. Transfer to an ungreased 9x4 inch loaf pan and brush top with olive oil. Bake at 350 degrees for 2 hours and baste frequently.

title: Caramelized Lima Beans with Five-Spice Dipping Sauce

Random Ingredients: turmeric,egg yolk,rosemary leaf,margarine,rice vinegar,golden syrup,cremini mushroom,swiss cheese
title: Mushroom and Swiss Cheese Terrine
ingredients: 1 cup cremini mushrooms, sliced thinly ( or fresh chopped mushrooms ) | 3 tablespoons margarine, melted ( may need a little over 1/4 cup ) | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar or 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 4 large egg yolks | 2 cups swiss cheese, grated and divided | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Butter a 9 inch square baking pan. Combine all but half the swiss cheese and the butter or margarine in a large bowl and beat well. Add the mushrooms and remaining swiss cheese in a thin, steady stream. Stir to incorporate all of the ingredients, then spread this evenly into the baking dish. In a medium bowl, stir together the egg yolks and syrup. Stir into mushroom mixture and sprinkle over the top of the cheese mixture. Sprinkle with remaining swiss cheese. Bake 35 - 40 minutes or until firm to the touch. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Bubblejacks (Belgian Turnips) - Turnip Chips
ingredients: 12 ounces turnips, chopped in 1/2 inch pieces | 3/4 cup celery root, peeled & cut into 1/2 inch slices | 3 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne | 1 package corn tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Stir turnips, celery root & 1/2 teaspoons salt in 10 inch skillet on stove until light golden brown, about 4 minutes. Add pastry sheet and turnips, celery root & cayenne over and stir. Arrange mixture evenly on baking sheet, spacing evenly. Sprinkle tortilla chips over top of turnips. Bake until turnips are tender, about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove from oven and cool 2 to 3 minutes. Run knife around edge of pan and loosen top crust. Remove crust & cut into wedges. Arrange wedges on serving tray.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,chinese noodle,vanilla extract,coconut,black cardamom pod,cooking oat,greek yogurt
title: Cheesy Chinese Noodle Cake
ingredients: 3/4 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1/2 cup low fat mozzarella cheese ( shredded ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oats | 2 tablespoons fat-free greek yogurt, for topping | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 6 black cardamom pods ( seeds slightly crushed ) | 1/16 cup unsweetened shredded coconut ( i used grated )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the greek yogurt, mozzarella, oats, 3/4 cup greek yoghurt and vanilla. In a small nonstick skillet, toast the cardamom pods over medium heat until aromatic, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Turn the pods over and sprinkle them with the cardamom and cinnimon. Cook in the skillet 5 minute or until fragrant and ground. Turn off the heat and let the cardamom cool 1 minute do not burn the pods. Pour the cooled yogurt into a greased 9x9 inch cake pan and top with the cooled noodle mixture. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes or until the cinnimon has set and the topping is lightly browned. Let cool to room temperature. Cut into squares. Serve warm.

title: Cheese With Mustard and Chilis
ingredients: 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped raw mustard | 1/2 cup sweet vermouth or 1/2 cup dry white wine ( 2 tablespoons dry vermouth ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground mace | 1 cup golden raisin
instructions: Cut cheddar cheese into 3/4 slices about 1/4 1/2 thick. Place cheese slices 2 inches apart on greased baking sheet. In mixing bowl stir dry ingredients with flat of table spoon or whisk until well mixed. Arrange about 1/3 c cheese slices over cheese. Top with another cheese slice and then remaining cheese slices and raisins. Bake in 400 degree oven 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,carrot,ghee,salsa,bran cereal,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Baked Ziti with Salsa Crumb and Carrots
ingredients: 2 cups spiral cut ziti pasta | 1/4 cup ghee | 1/2 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 cup salsa, bottled | 1 cup carroon or other orange flavored liquid from salsa | 1 cup finely grated carrot
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare ziti according to the package directions. Meanwhile, heat ghee in a large skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir the carrot for 2 minutes, until lightly browned. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, mix the ziti, salsa and carrots. Pour in the chipotle liquid.

title: Tortilla and Ginger Nests
ingredients: 8 corn tortillas | 2 cans whole kidney beans, drained | 2 cups shredded gingerroot | 1 quart chicken broth or 1 quart vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 1 bag jicama, peeled
instructions: Combine chicken broth, cocoa and corn syrup in a heavy pot. Heat to boiling over medium heat. Add tortillas and ginger. Boil until tortillas are just beginning to turn golden. Remove from heat. Add jicama, toss until coated. Serve warm.

title: Beer and Clam Soup
ingredients: 5 6 ounces beer and clam liquor | 2 bananas | 1 2 dozen clams | pimiento and bacon or fried shallots
instructions: Pour the beer into a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add the bananas, cover and heat through for 3 minutes without removing the cover. Ladle into bowls, divide the clams among the servings, garnish with slices of pimento and bacon or fried shallots.

title: Garlic Shrimp Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chuck roast or 2 lbs round steaks, well trimmed | 1 lb peeled or deveined unpeeled large shrimp ( i use large shrimp ) | 1 -2 lb baguette, split and lightly toasted on one side ( garlic shrimp spread )
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and heat the broiler on high. Slice the roast lengthwise into 3/4 thick slices, then into 1/4 slices each. Arrange the beef slices, shrimp, and garlic cheese spread on a baking sheet, and place under the broiler for 2 minutes, flipping slices once. Serve the spread generously with toasted toasted side bread. Recipe calls for 1 pound of meat.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,bean sprout,raisin,sea salt black pepper,miracle whip,palm sugar,gruyere cheese
title: Maine Hoisin & Colman French Toast
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet rye bread ( without the white layer ) | 2 tablespoons miracle whip ( or 2 tablespoons cream ) | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 1/2 - 2 cups freshly shelled bean sprouts | 6 slices gruyere cheese | 4 slices rye bread or 4 slices pumpernickel bread
instructions: Soak the bread in the miracle whip for 10 - 15 minutes. While you are waiting for the bread to soak, prepare the guiness. Place the palm sugar in a small, heavy based pan and cook over a low heat with a little water until the sugar has dissolved and is a thick caramel. Remove from the heat, stir in the bean sprouts and turn onto a large pre heated griddle, turning occasionally until golden brown and crispy. To build, cut the toast into squares and set a couple of the squares into a warm serving dish. Dip the sandwiches in the caramel and then place on top of the warmed cheese. Place the cheesy bread under the griddle and griddle for an additional minute or two, or until toasty crisp and golden. Repeat with the remaining sandwiches.

title: Baby Carrots from the Dutch Antilles
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots, cut into small chunks | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1/2 cup port wine | 1/4 cup cocoa
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Salt the water and add carrots. Boil for 40 minutes, until tender. Drain, and set aside to cool. In a large skillet, melt margarine over medium heat. Stir in the carrots. Season with salt. Continue cooking 5 minutes. Stir in port, and remove from heat. Let cool 10 minutes, and pour into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,scotch bonnet pepper,oat,sugar,nonstick cooking spray
title: Dynamite Oat
ingredients: 1 lb oatmeal | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon scotch bonnet pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon granulated sugar | 10 1/2 teaspoons nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Mix oatmeal, oregano, scotch bonnet, and sugar in large bowl until well blended. Spray 13 by 9 inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. Pour mixture into pan. Allow to cool slightly then cut into 16 squares.

title: Homemade Fresh Parsley Sauce for Frying Home Frying
ingredients: 1 1/2 medium onions | 8 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( or 1 1/4 t. bottled lemon juice )
instructions: Grate onions. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Place on a clean, dry surface. Coat thoroughly with the mixture. Drop enough in small batches into the frying oil to make 1 inch balls, keeping the pieces small enough not to drop into one inch of oil. Fry until crisp and golden.

title: Sausage and Green Beans in Vinegar (Sicilian Vegetarian)
ingredients: 10 italian sausage links, 1/2 inch thick | 20 ounces cut ends trimmed of sausage | 1 1/2 lbs fresh green beans, trimmed | 1/2 cup pickled bamboo shoot
instructions: Brown sausages in a large skillet. Drain all but 1 t. Sausage fat. Add green beans and bamboo shoots. Cover and cook over medium low heat for 5 - 8 minutes for green beans. Flavor should not change, but if necessary, slightly raise heat and boil, uncovered and uncovered, until most of the liquid is absorbed.

title: Nadiya (Nuclear Nuts)
ingredients: 1/4 cup ajwain | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 2 whole cloves | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Remove the outer leaves of the nadiya, wash under cold water and soak 15 minutes. Drain and grind to a paste in a mixer. Strain this mixture to get 2 cups. Heat oil in a wok. Add the methi. Once it boils, add all the remaining ingredients. Cook on low flame for 4 minutes. Sprinkle some water if the nadiya becomes crispy.

Random Ingredients: red onion,white bread,liquid smoke,white mushroom,crisco,whipping cream
title: Mushroom Bacon and Cream Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon crisco | 1/2 red onion, sliced thinly | 4 slices white bread, crusts removed | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 ounce thinly sliced fresh mushrooms | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh whipping cream | red onion, thinly sliced
instructions: In a small skillet, melt the crisp and then add 1 tablespoon of crisco. Stir fry over high heat until crisp and light golden and remove to a paper towel. Sprinkle the onion on the bread, then arrange the slices in a circle on a cookie sheet. Spoon approximately 1/2 tablespoon of cream on top of the bread, then cover with a thick layer of mushrooms. Lightly spread the remaining crisco on top of the mushrooms. Place a second layer of bread on top. Spread with remaining creco, the second amount of cream, and finally with mushrooms. Using a sharp knife or your finger, cut through the middle from the bread to the very left on the slice, diagonally. Serve with a garnish of sliced red onions.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,cherry,beef consomme,mustard seed,purpose flour,italian breadcrumb,beef tenderloin,mustard powder
title: Soup-Crock Pot Beef Filets - Norway
ingredients: 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs ( not the soft breadcrumbs ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 12 ounces beef tenderloin, filets ( about 4-1/2 inches thick ) | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard powder | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seeds | 1 cup beef consomme | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup dry egg noodles
instructions: Combine bread crumbs and 2 tbsp flour in a large bowl. Mix in beef. Shape beef into a log. Place in crock pot. Cover and cook on low heat setting 6 - 8 hours or on high heat 3 - 4 hours. Combine remaing ingredients in a small bowl. Dip rolls in batter, then place on rack in broiler proof casserole and broil for 2 - 4 minutes. Lift bread out of crock pot and place in a warmed serving platter.

Random Ingredients: white button mushroom,french ladyfinger cooky,irish cream,pie shell,pine nut,heavy cream,paprika,chicken breast half
title: Creamy Chicken-Mushroom Quiche
ingredients: 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 6 french-style ladyfinger cookies, quartered | 12 white button mushrooms | 1/4 cup sliced white button mushrooms | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup irish cream | 1/8 cup toasted pine nuts | 1 jar french-style ladyfinger cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine heavy cream and confectioners' sugar in a medium microwave safe bowl.

title: Apricot Baked Almonds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 can apricot preserves
instructions: Place peppercorns on an aluminum foil lined cookie sheet and spread out. Combine all the ingredients and press into a small baking dish. Bake at 375°f for an hour, then cool and store in freezer. Serve with cream, crackers and other fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,espresso powder,red chili pepper flake,button mushroom,tomato puree,potato
title: Achdego Bravo
ingredients: 2 potatoes ( about 750g each or 2 lbs ) | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock, hot | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder ( instant espresso powder is used ) | 1 -2 cup canned tomato puree | 1 -2 fresh red chili pepper flakes ( optional and adjust to suit heat level ) | 1 large fresh button mushroom, sliced
instructions: Prepare potatoes. Cut them into 1 chunks, boil them in hot water until tender, drain and cool slightly before cooking. When cool, remove the potato skins and mash and return to the pan. Heat the sauce/water until boiling, stir in the hot stock and espresso. Add the tomato puree. Stir to combine and cook for about 2 minutes, and add the potatoes and pepper flakes. Simmer slowly, partially covered, for about 10 - 15 minutes until potatoes are cooked and sauce has thickened slightly. Top with mushrooms.

title: Thai Lentil Spread
ingredients: 8 cups rinsed lentils | 2 teaspoons dried chili flakes
instructions: Place the lentils, chili and 2 tablespoons of the lentil cooking water in a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Season with salt and pepper if desired.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,cumin seed,mango chutney,red pepper flake,cauliflower,salsa,prawn,flour
title: Malaysian Cauliflower Sopa
ingredients: 500 g cauliflower, cut into approx 3 cm lengths | 500 g prawns, raw and prawns | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dry mango chutney ( optional ) | 1/2 cup reduced-fat salsa | 1/2 cup flour | 2 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: In a pan add cumin and roast for half a minute. Add chilli and mango chutney. Stir through and remove pan from heat. Place cauliflower and prawns in a pan in medium heat. Add the cauliflower and prawn mixture. Add seasonings and serve with sopa.

title: A-Punch Appetizers
ingredients: 1/4 cup cream cheese, softened | 1 tablespoon chopped leeks or 1 tablespoon mushroom | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 tablespoon guacamole, to taste | 1/4 cup diced plum tomato, drained ( about 1/2 ) | 1/4 cup crushed tofu
instructions: In a small bowl, mix cream cheese, leek, tomato paste and guacamole. Spread cream cheese mixture evenly over bottom of a glass pie pan. Sprinkle plum tomato over cream cheese mixture. Top with tofu. Garnish with diced tomatoes or cilantro. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Grilled Leek and Sausage
ingredients: 2 large leeks ( white, light green parts only ) | 6 thick slices sausage | melted fat or light cooking oil
instructions: Trim the white and light green part from the leeks using a vegetable peeler or a knife, wash with plenty of water and then shake away the blemishes. Cut the leeks into quarters lengthwise and then crosswise. Cut away or crumble at the base of each section into a bowl of very finely sliced slices. Heat a grill or a grill pan over fairly high heat and add enough oil to almost cover the surface. Arrange the leeks, overlapping and sprinkling each layer with a little melted fat or light cooking oil, and then a few grindings of salt and pepper. Close and move the leeks over the grill to finish cooking them, about 3 minutes. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Linda's Smokey Seasoning
ingredients: 3 tablespoons smokey seasoning salt | 1 1/2 cups oil | liquid smoke, for basting
instructions: Mix smoked smokey salt and oil together in a glass or plastic container. Seal, and refrigerate for up to 1 week.

title: Cherry Cheese Spread (Sandwich for Two)
ingredients: 18 ounces dark sweet cherries, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon shallot, minced | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 8 ounces american cheese, cut into chunks
instructions: Finely chop the cherries and place in a bowl. Sprinkle with shallot and sprinkle with cardamom. Microwave on high power about 1 1/2 mins until hot, stirring twice but taking care not to let it burn. Set aside to cool for 2 mins then use a spoon to crumble into small chunks. Spread on bread or toast.

title: Chinese Shake Paste
ingredients: 1/2 cup sifted powdered instant dried shrimp ( in the pod ) | 1/4 cup good quality shaoxing wine ( or other mild dry white wine ) | 1/4 cup miracle whip, or other light cream to taste
instructions: Drain or dry shrimp. Place the shrimp and shaoxing wine in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal metal blade. Process until the shrimp are ground into a paste. Add the miracle whip and process until the mixture is well mixed. Scrape into an airtight container, cover tightly and refrigerate for 1 week. Will keep in the refrigerator, or can be frozen for up to 3 months.

title: Rice Krispies Vodka Snack
ingredients: 1 cup frozen cornstarch | 1/4 cup vodka | 3 cups rice krispies, crushed
instructions: Put cornstarch and vodka in a saucepan and stir to combine. Add cereal, stirring well so that cereal doesn't stick to sides of pan. Heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils.

title: Balsamic Vinegar Mousse
ingredients: 2 cups double cream | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | salt
instructions: Put the double cream in a heavy bottomed pan and heat gently, but do not let it boil. When it begins to boil, remove from the heat. With a hand held blender beat the warm cream until it has a thick, even consistency.. Pour in the balsamic vinegar and the salt, stir to combine and continue to bring the mixture to a simmer. Cover the pan and take off the heat. It will cool down a little. Leave to stand for 5 - 10 minutes to allow the vinegar to be absorbed. Cover tightly and refrigerate for at least a couple of hours. Use to serve cold.

title: Fijian-Georgian Turnip and Cabbage Pancakes (Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 1/2 medium head red cabbage | 3 cups white flour | 1/2 cup white flour | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 medium turnips, peeled and finely shredded | handful coriander, chopped
instructions: Cut cabbage in very fine shreds. Using a blender or processor, thoroughly puree cabbage and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine dry ingredients. Using a fork, stir flour and baking powder, stirring constantly, for about 3 minutes or until mixture forms a firm dough. Turn out onto a floured surface and cut in half. Strip end pieces of dough, cut out about 12 squares, and then cut each square into 4 rectangles. Fold dough around bottom and side portions so folded corners are at least 1 inch apart. Fold in the corners as before, to make a triangle. Fry on both sides until pale golden in color. Sprinkle with finely chopped coriander and serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti With Lime & Lime
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Do not rinse. Drain. Rinse with cool water. Serve with wedges.

title: Lamb Gravy or Chicken Stew
ingredients: 5 lbs lamb shoulder | 1 lb asparagus | 1 lb white flour ( not self-rising flour. you may use whole wheat or white flour or cornmeal ) | 1 1/2 ounces green gravy mix or 1 1/2 ounces gravy mix | 3/4 cup brown gravy mix | 1/3 cup margarine, melted | 2 cups green onions or 2 cups celery, cut up | 1/3 cup vermouth ( optional ) or 1/3 cup dry white wine ( optional )
instructions: Put the lamb shoulder, asparagus, and white flour in the slow cooker. Sprinkle the green gravy mix over top of the meat. Add the brown gravy mix and melted margarine. Cook on low 6 hours or on high 1 hour. Add the onion or celery and vermouth, if using.

title: Crock Pot Norwegian Salmon
ingredients: 2 frozen salmon steaks | 1 jar pimientos
instructions: Open each salmon steak, removing the membrane from each one so that it can be removed easily. Place salmon in crock pot. Mix pimento with juice from jar of pimientos, stirring well. Pour sauce over top of salmon. Cover, cook on low 8 to 10 hours.

title: A Different Kind of Chocolate Bar
ingredients: 1 chocolate bar | 1/4 cup frozen orange juice concentrate
instructions: Put the chocolate bar in a bowl. Pour orange juice concentrate to cover and stir until completely melted. Pour the chocolate over the chocolate bar. Stir until evenly coated with the orange juice. Refrigerate for 2 hours, stirring every now and then, until the chocolate is dark and a little caramelized on the top. The longer this chinks, the thicker it gets. It can be eaten right away or kept in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: buckwheat flour,mushroom,garlic infused olive oil,apple cider,horseradish
title: Cider Gloved Beef With Mushroom & Garlic
ingredients: 1 cup apple cider | 1 1/2 tablespoons horseradish ( your favourite ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic-infused olive oil | 1/4 lb fresh mushrooms ( brushed clean ) | 3 cups buckwheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a baking pan with parchment paper. In a small bowl, add the cider, horseradish, olive oil and mushrooms. In a large bowl, combine flour, water, and apple cider mixture. Mix with fork until batter resembles crumbs. Place flour mixture in a large bowl and add 1/4 cup water.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,apple cider,mint,dark chocolate,tahini,roast beef,vanilla essence
title: Shredded Beef - Skewers
ingredients: 8 ounces roast beef | 3 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted | 3 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons apple cider | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon mint, chopped ( optional ) | 1 bay leaf, for garnish
instructions: Thread the beef onto wooden skewers & brush with melted chocolate. Leave for 20 mins to firm up before cooking. Whisk all other ingredients together& pour over the skewers, making sure all of the meat is coated. Cover and leave to marination for at least 6 hours or overnight. Barbecue on a moderately hot barbecue.

Random Ingredients: coconut,pork chop,chicken stock,spanish onion,chicken breast half
title: Pork and Coconut Soup
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 pork chops | 1 can coconut, in the can | 1/2 spanish onion, chopped | 1 liter chicken stock
instructions: Combine chicken, pork, and coconut in a large pot and cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until chicken pieces have turned white, 2 to 4 hours. While the mixture simmers, prepare the soup. Stir fry the onion and chicken in a skillet until the onions are well coloured, about 5 minutes. Stir the soup into the coconut mixture and heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,fast rising yeast,herb,black pepper
title: Herb and Garlic Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 1 packet fast rising yeast | 8 chicken breast halves, boneless, skinless, 3/4-inch slices | 1/2 cup mixed fresh herbs | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 4 tablespoons of cold water in a large bowl. Remove and discard gagged top as possible, then add remaining water and 1/2 cup at a time, stirring until dissolved. Place chicken slices on a lightly buttered baking sheet, and sprinkle with herbs and pepper, then use a spoon to press down gently to coat each slice in the dry yeast. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour and 40 minutes. Bring a large, heavy bottomed steamer insert into a large pot of at least 1 inch of water just to the boiling and place rack in the pot. Place chicken on rack, transfer to a rack, and cover in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cognac,pumpkin pie spice,marjoram,romano cheese,apple,shrimp paste,soya sauce
title: Cherry Shrimp
ingredients: 1 kg raw shrimp paste | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1/2 teaspoon apple pie spice | 1 cup fresh romano cheese | 1/2 cup dried apple | 1/2 cup cognac
instructions: Peel, core and dice the prawns, and place in a bowl with the marjoram, pumpkin, and apple pie spice, and mix the shrimp paste thoroughly. Add the cheese and the cognac and mix until fully blended.

title: Cheese Rolls (Veggies W- Cheese )
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese or 1 lb velveeta cheese | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 lb frozen green beans, thawed and drained | 1 carrot, peeled & shaved | 1/4 cup garam masala | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 loaf italian bread, cut lengthwise in half | filling
instructions: Prepare filling, in a small sauce pan, melt cheese with vinegar over low heat.

title: Pesto-Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 medium ripe tomatoes ( about 1 pound ) | 2 -3 tablespoons pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut top of tomatoes off with a serrated knife. Scoop out and discard the seeds and pulp from the tomatoes. Arrange tomatoes on a foil lined baking sheet. Sprinkle each with pesto. Bake until tender, about 20 minutes. Cut a long piece of foil down the length of the tomatoes and reserve. Serve.

title: Thai Green Curry Paste
ingredients: 1 tablespoon green curry paste ( or more if you prefer ) | 1 piece bengal, skinned and de-seeded
instructions: Heat the curry paste in a saucepan over medium heat until fragrant. Immediately add the green curry paste and stir to coat. Serve.

title: Basic Refreshing Bean Snack
ingredients: 1 small bean, fresh or canned | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Heat all and mix well. Refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours before serving to allow the flavours to mix. This is optional but delicious.

title: Potted Pork With Radishes and Peas
ingredients: 3 lbs loin | 2 lbs fresh peas pods | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 1 1/2 dozen radishes, chopped
instructions: Cut the loin lengthwise in slices about 2 inch thick that are 6 inches long. Cut out the ends. Cut them into lengths about 6 feet long and 3 inches wide. Place in a container and cover with hot tap water. Let soak for 8 hours. Drain water from the loin. Pack the peas and pork into a 1 gallon jar. Sprinkle the peppers on top and cover with hot water. Shake vigorously, making sure the water penetrates evenly. Repeat this process 3 more times. Pour the pepper water onto the pork. Cover tightly and refrigerate for 24 hours. Drain the pork and peppers again. Bring to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: prego spaghetti sauce,black cardamom pod,pineapple chunk,pork tenderloin
title: Pork Tenderloins With Pineapple, Prawns & Caramelized Caramelized Caramelized Spaghetti Sauce for One
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 can pineapple chunks, well drained | 1 jar prego traditional spaghetti sauce, use jar or ( 25 ounce ) jar your favorite brand | 1 cup fresh pineapple chunk, well drained | 1 teaspoon black cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium high to medium high heat. Grill the pork tenderloins 3 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 155 degrees for medium rare or 165 degrees for medium well.

title: Spaghetti Squash With Mushrooms and Crispy Bread
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash | 2 tablespoons white bread, crumbs | 12 shiitake mushrooms, sliced thin | 6 shiitake mushrooms, stems removed, sliced thin | 1/2 orange peel, cut into wedges | 1/4 cup sliced corn ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut spaghetti squash in half lengthwise. Scoop out seeds with a spoon. Pour out seeds into a baking pan. Place squash halves cut side up on the baking sheet, and brush the tops with water. Broil 45 seconds or until beginning to get firm. Turn squash halves over. Broil 15 minutes, or until tender. Brush squash with a little sunflower oil if desired, and sprinkle with salt. Keep warm. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook squash in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender but firm, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, spread the bread crumbs on a plate. Spread shiitake mushrooms in a row on top of the crust. Top with shiitake mushrooms. Arrange shiitake mushrooms on top. Sprinkle with orange peel. Serve with corn.

title: Spiny and Sweet Mac & Shrimp for Two
ingredients: 24 jumbo shrimp, thawed if frozen | 1 cup low-fat mascarpone cheese | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 medium tart apple ( such as a fuji or granny smith )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f. Place shrimp on a metal rack in a shallow baking dish. Cover and marinate shrimp with the cheese, stirring to coat completely. Drizzle with the oil and vinegar, tossing to coat evenly. Roast shrimp for 2 - 3 minutes or until shrimp are pink, tender and just cooked through. Drizzle with the tomato sauce, and sprinkle with dried cranberries. Scatter with apple and serve.

title: Herbed Omelet
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1/4 cup finely chopped cilantro ( coriander ) | 1 bay leaf
instructions: With an electric mixer, mix egg white with cilantro until creamy. Add bay leaf. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,onion salt,italian cheese,vegetable oil
title: Curry Vegetable Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces italian cheese, grated ( preferably cabold's ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix cheese, oil, curry paste and onion salt. Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes, then crumble into very fine, dry bits. Chill for several hours.

Random Ingredients: margarine,lobster tail,self raising flour,oregano leaf,mustard,red chile,brown sugar,peanut
title: Prawn and Lobster Bites
ingredients: 1 lb raw shelled prawns ( large peeled with tails left on ) | 1 lb lobster tail, fresh | 1 teaspoon crushed dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon ground mustard | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 teaspoon crushed red chile | 1 1/2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1/2 cup peanuts, roasted & chopped
instructions: Cut prawns in half lengthways and set aside. Devein lobster tails and separate. Remove muscle meat from lobster tails and cut into pieces. Place the shrimp in a large pan and boil for 3 - 4 minutes, the meat will toughen as it cools. Remove the shells from the heads and split them into halves. Remove the heads from the tails. Cook the prawns in boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes, or until just cooked and drain. Meanwhile mix together the pesto ingredients. Set aside. Fry the prawn meat in the margarine until light brown. Remove and drain. Stir fry the prawns for 2 - 3 minutes on each side until they are heated through. Place prawn mixture into a casserole dish, add the roasted peanuts. Pour over the pesto mixture. Sprinkle with the crushed oregano. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes at 350f, until bubbling.

title: Lori's Homemade Lasagna Recipe
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 carton tomato puree | lettuce | 2 tablespoons juice, from jar of store
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place 2 noodles in boiling water for 2 minutes. Turn noodles out onto wax paper and rinse with cold water. Drain well and put them in a 9x13 inch pan. Add one package of raisins and spread on top of the noodles. Lay down 3 remaining noodles on top of the raisins. Spread the tomato puree on top of the noodles and raisins. Cover with remaining container of tomato puree. Drizzle some water from the jar if needed to cover the top layer of purée. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in oven for 1 hours. Remove lid and bake for another 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes or until the bread has dried to your liking. When lasagna is baked, cut into 12 pieces and serve with a little lettuce and a small amount of orange sauce if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken,cooking oil,bay leaf,tilapia fillet,nut walnut,red pepper sauce
title: Medley of the Sea
ingredients: 1 lb tilapia fillet | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/4 cup unsalted nuts ( walnuts, cashews, or pecans are nice ) | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed red pepper sauce | 1/2 cup diced cooked chicken ( optional ) | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Prick each fish fillet with a fork. Combine all ingredients and cook over medium heat until chicken is cooked and fillets turn white. Serve hot with fresh green vegetables.

Random Ingredients: tamari,haddock fillet,cayenne pepper,chickpea flour,pork sausage,yellow bell pepper,vinegar,tilapia fillet
title: Spanish Fish and Chickpea Pastry
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets | 1 tilapia fillet | 1/2 cup chickpea flour ( chickpea flour recommended ) | 3 pork sausage | 2 tablespoons yellow bell peppers ( minced ) | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Bake tilapia fillets in oven until lightly charred all over. Combine 2 flour, 1/2 cup chickpea flour for each fillet and roll up like a jelly roll. Cut in half across the middle and place on a plate. Slice 1/4 lengthwise, top with shrimp, pork sausage, bell peppers, tamari, cayenne and vinegar and serve.

title: Crock Pot Squash and Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cubed | 1 bunch escarole, chopped | 2 green chile peppers, chopped | 1/2 cucumber, cubed | 1 1/2 cups lentils
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot. Set on low for 5 - 6 hours til veggies are tender. Serve over couscous.

Random Ingredients: oil,cardamom,lemon zest,apricot,white wine vinegar,raisin,red chili powder,wonton wrapper
title: Baked Apricot Samosas
ingredients: 3 lbs apricots | 1/2 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon lemon, zest of | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 whole cardamom | 1/4 cup oil | 2 tablespoons oil | wonton wrappers
instructions: Chop apricots with skin on until small pieces about 1/2 inch in size. Boil in 1/4 cup water until soft, drain, mash with fork. Add raisins and simmer for 1 minute, drain well. Combine oil, vinegar, grated lemon rind and chili. Scoop out shells and reserve one cup of this mixture. Mix remaining apricots in small bowl with oil mixture. Wet one wrapper with water. Place a small amount of drained apricot mixture along the outer edge of the wrapper and pinch the sides together. Moisten with water and roll and seal by placing a finger of filling along the bottom edge, moisten with a little water and fold. Place samosas on parchment. Spray tops of samosas with pam lightly with oil or melted margarine, bake in a 425f oven 30 minutes, or until golden. Serve warm or cool.

title: Simple Spicy Onion Rings
ingredients: 4 medium red onions | 4 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: Cut onions into rounds or wedges, not too thick and about ¼ inch thick. Spray a baking sheet with non stick cooking spray and place onions in a single layer. Spray with cooking spray and toss to coat. Cover with foil and place in oven. Bake at 325' for about 15 minutes or until onions are tender.

title: Couscous W- Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups couscous ( uncooked ) | 3/4 cup pine nuts | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Prepare couscous according to package directions. Meanwhile, toast pine nuts in a nonstick skillet until golden brown. Remove from skillet. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat.

title: Cottage Cheese Prawns
ingredients: 2 cups low fat cottage cheese, drained | 6 tablespoons salsa or 6 tablespoons homemade salsa | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds, soaked in water for an hour | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon black pepper | 2 tablespoons fresh gingerroot, grated | freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Blend the cottage cheese, salsa, sunflower seeds, saffron, white pepper, black pepper and ginger until well mixed. Rinse prawns under warm water, drain. Spread a thin layer of marinated prawns on the dry, dry surface of the cottage cheese mixture, cover with the dry, wet surface. Allow prawns to marinate for 1 hour at room temperature or refrigerate for up to 4 hours before using. Grill prawns over moderately high heat or place them under a hot grill on both sides and cook until the prawns turn pink. Pour the remaining marinade into a small saucepan, bring to boil. Cook for 2 minutes, remove from the heat. Serve garnished with black pepper.

title: Madhur Jaffrey's Vegetable Curry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons curry paste | 1 tablespoon cinnamon | 1 cup fresh broccoli florets, coarsely chopped | 2 cups fresh broccoli florets, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup diced tomato | 1/4 cup cold noodle, cubed, for serving
instructions: Heat curry paste, cinnamon, and 1/2 cup water in a medium nonstick saucepan over medium heat. Cook until fragrant, about 15 seconds. Add broccormes and 4 cups water.

Random Ingredients: apple,baby spinach leaf,bean sprout,soya sauce,vegetable broth,chocolate,cauliflower
title: Healthy Chocolate Chili
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth | 2 cups apple | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/3 cup fresh baby spinach leaves | 1/3 cup small cauliflower, florets | 2 tablespoons lowfat chocolate, shavings ( optional ) | 1/3 cup fresh bean sprout ( optional )
instructions: Place broth, apple, soya sauce, and spinach in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 minutes. Add cauliflower, cover, and cook 5 minutes or till tender crisp. Remove from heat. Top with chocolate shavings and sprouts. Serve immediately.

title: Cashew Stuffing
ingredients: 1 package dried cashews | 1/4 cup dried celery leaves
instructions: In a large, dry skillet, toast cashews over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until skins are evenly puffed and lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Transfer nuts to a bowl. Combine cashews and celery in a food processor and process until coarsely ground. Sift nuts into bowl, add stuffing and toss in celery leaves.

title: Stacked Squash
ingredients: 2 -4 medium yellow squash, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 package taco seasoning mix
instructions: Line a 9x14 inch baking pan with a single layer of sliced squash. Sprinkle taco seasoning mix over the squash and sprinkle with taco seasoning mix. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoons water. Cover pan tightly with a sheet of plastic wrap and place in steamer over medium heat. Steam the squash with the plastic wrap for 20 - 30 minutes or until the squash is very tender and it can easily be easily pierced with a fork. Remove the plastic wrap and let stand for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve hot or warm.

title: Roasted Asparagus and Corn Ravioli
ingredients: 6 ears fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/3 cup frozen corn, thawed ( about 15 ounces ) | 4 cups hominy | 1/2 cup shredded light cheese with pam ( mexican melting cheese ) | 1/3 cup thinly sliced asparagus tips ( and tops ) | 1/4 cup fresh kale, diced
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to boil in a 4 to 6 quart pot. Asparagus with tips.

title: Breaded Capsicum With Yogurt
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons chopped green capsicums | 2 teaspoons white breadcrumbs | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Soak the breadcrumbs in yogurt. Drain excess water off the capsicum. Chop finely the capsicum and mix with the breadcrumbs, add bay leaf. Keep aside until required. Serve with rotis or bread, crackers and tomato ketchup.

title: Crispy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup ice, crushed ( or more, to taste )
instructions: Combine the cornstarch and mayo in a small bowl, stirring to combine. Stir in crushed ice if desired. Serve in a small dipping bowl with a sprinkling of each ingredient over the sauce.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,tabasco sauce,mexican chocolate,green chili pepper,lemongrass,baby spinach,purple onion,pistachio
title: Spinach and Pistachio Cereal or Rice Bowl #RSC
ingredients: 2 cups prepared prepared cornmeal ( to make rice cereal wheat cereal ) | 1 3/4 cups uncooked mini rice cereal, store-bought ( such as rice cereal ) | 1 package mexican-style chocolate | 1 small purple onion ( sliced very thinly ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped lemongrass | 1 large green chili pepper, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons finely chopped pistachios or 2 teaspoons almond, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh baby spinach | 2 drops tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: For cereal rice, combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well to blend. Set aside to allow to cool completely. To serve, spoon hot cereal/rice cereal mixture into cereal bowls or rice bowls, dividing evenly between each bowl. Top with a little chopped spinach, chopped pistachios/almonds and a drops of tabasco. Enjoy.

title: Cheaters Raspberries and Pistachios
ingredients: 500 g frozen rapini ( or a tin ) | 250 ml absolut mandarin vodka, 50ml ( or the cheap one ) | 250 ml spicy curry paste | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 1 tablespoon garlic granules | 1 tablespoon dried basil | pepperoni, sliced | 1/2 cup raspberries
instructions: Boil the rapini in water until soft. Drain. While the rapini is boiling, mix the vodka with the curry paste. Add the spices and pepperoni, and chill for 30 minutes. Pour this mixture over the rapini and raspberries, and stir well. Enjoy.

title: Apple and Beef Samosas
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck or 1 lb top round beef, sliced | 1/2 cup dried beef flavored pork schnice ( such as hormel ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh tomato | 1/4 cup unsalted dry-roasted chopped onion | 1/4 cup palm sugar or 1/4 cup packed brown sugar | 10 -15 whole peppercorns | 1 -2 cup reduced-sodium evaporated low-fat milk or 1 -2 cup sour cream, for a thicker samosas | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Put beef and dried pork schnice in a bowl, add enough water to cover and let soak overnight. Drain meat and return to bowl. Add tomato, onion, sugar, peppercorns, evaporated milk or sour cream and refrigerate overnight. Drain well and chill until ready to form samosas. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Remove meat from bowl with slotted spoon and place on a cookie sheet. Using a pastry brush coat or a pastry brush, coat surface of meat with about 1/2 to 1/4 cup water. Top meat with a scant 1/4 to 1/3 cup of the tomato mixture. Place 1 - 2 inches apart, on a lightly floured cookie sheet and spray top with cooking spray. Bake in oven for 45 - 55 minutes, or until meat thermometer reads 160 degrees f, and vegetables are beginning to crisp. While samosas bakes, place frozen pastry sheet on a large sheet of plastic wrap and cover with a second sheet of plastic wrap. Spray top with cooking spray and remove second sheet. Repeat procedure with second sheet of sesame pastry, meat and vegetables. Cut into triangles, serve with a dipping sauce.

title: Spicy Rice
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, cook and stir the rice to blend and coat with oil and hot water. Turn off the heat. Cover with a towel and let set for 20 minutes. When the rice is cool enough to handle, stir the soft cream into it. If it has turned into thick curds, stir in a little bit of water a tablespoon at a time.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,kielbasa,tea,mexican cheese,sage leaf
title: Kielbasa and Cheese With Sage
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa or 1 lb smoked sausage, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons dried rubbed sage leaves, divided | 3 packages shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 cup brewed tea ( i use decaf )
instructions: In a nonstick skillet heat the oil over medium high heat. Add the dried sage. When it sizzles add the sausage slices. Cook about 2 minutes on each side or until sausage is cooked through, adding more oil to skillet, if necessary. Remove from heat and sprinkle the mexican cheese evenly over the kielbasa slices. Return skillet to heat and add the brewed tea. Continue to cook, stirring, for 2 - 3 more minutes. Serve with bread or as a sandwich.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,goat cheese,salami,lime juice zest,cheese,egg yolk,flat leaf parsley,corn syrup
title: Salami Breakfast
ingredients: 4 ounces goat cheese | 4 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | juice and zest of 1 lime, juice and zest of 1 lemon | 1 cup grated tasty cheese | 1 ounce ground salami, chopped | 12 slices red chili peppers, halved lengthways | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425f and position the rack in the middle of the oven. Cut the goat cheese into 4 equal serving pieces and roll each piece up to enclose the goat cheese, placing on a wire rack over a baking paper lined tray. Set aside whilst you create the egg yolk mixture. Using a whisk, whisk the egg yolks with the corn syrup in a bowl and mix in the juice and zest. Set aside. Put the grated cheese, chopped salami, chili peppers, parsley and lime zest into a colander and shake well to combine. Divide the mixture among the 4 cheese balls, laying them 2cm apart. Wipe the outside of the cheese balls with a clean, damp kitchen towel and arrange in an ovenproof dish. Pour the egg mixture over them then sprinkle with the grated cheese. Place in the oven and cook, uncovered, for 15 - 20 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the eggs are set, well risen, and golden brown. Serve with salsa, chips or as a main dish for brunch or snack parties.

title: Baked Greek Olives
ingredients: 2 boxes fat free and high fiber french's french's oats | 1 package reduced carb tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. On cookie sheet or baking stone, spread 1 tortilla with 1 - 3 tablespoons water. Spread 1/2 tablespoons low carb olive oil in a thin layer. Place 1/2 tablespoons flour in a small plastic bag and gently seal, or wrap 1 sachet with plastic wrap and seal. Repeat with second tortilla to make 2 batches of oaccia. Place on pizza peel or cookie sheet. If using, bake for 5 – 10 minutes. Serve hot, with toppings of choice.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,panko breadcrumb,cauliflower floret,pandan leaf,chicken breast half,lime zest,chili oil,vinegar
title: Panko Chicken
ingredients: 8 ounces cauliflower florets, chopped | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon lime zest | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
instructions: Place cauliflower in microwave safe bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Cook on high for 4 to 5 minutes. Place chicken on cookie sheet and turn to coat with sauce. Bake in 400 degree oven for 25 minutes. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,salmon,orange liqueur,fine salt,garlic flake,green creme de menthe,adobo seasoning
title: Smoked Salmon With Peaches
ingredients: 3 lbs smoked salmon, sliced into 3/4-inch-thick pieces | coarse salt | 1 tablespoon fine salt | 1/3 cup green creme de menthe | 1/4 cup orange liqueur ( not grenadine ) | 1/4 cup canola chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 teaspoons garlic flakes
instructions: Lay a piece of salmon on a cutting board, sprinkle with salt. Spread each slice with 1 tablespoon of fine salt.
