Wrap with cheesecloth, secure with toothpicks, and set aside for 15 minutes. Stack foil over two large dinner plates. On a cutting board that has been sprinkled with coarse salt, spread both the creme de menthe and the orange liqueur. Working quickly, spread the entire kernel of chipppeas over the creme de menthe mixture and spread slightly. Repeat, layering as necessary until all the chipppeas and cream have been used up. Cut each stuffed salmon piece into 3 - 4 portions, lengthwise, and arrange on the plated plates. Pour the remaining chopped green mint over the plated salmon and serve warm, or leave on one plate for lunch.

title: Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder roast | 3 egg whites | 3 tablespoons egg white, beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rub the outside of a slow cooker with 1 beaten egg, and set in the oven while roasting the pork. Place the pork shoulder on the rack in the center of oven, and roast 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until easily removed from the bones. When pierced with a fork, the roast should feel somewhat stringy in the center. Cool on a rack, and refrigerate until cold. Slice into thin strips using a very sharp knife, and set aside until ready to use. Combine in a bowl, and set aside until ready to use. Stir the egg whites with 1 tablespoon water, and set aside. When the roast is cool enough to handle, shred into small chunks. Stir 1 egg white into the shredded pork, and set aside until ready to use. Slowly warm the soup on the stovetop, and stir 3 tablespoons of the egg white into the egg mixture. Cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove the soup from the heat, and stir in the reserved 1 tablespoon of egg white. Serve hot.

title: Lettuce and Fresh Basil Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce ( about 8 cups ) | 6 eggs yolks | 12 basil leaves
instructions: Put the lettuce in the salad bowl, add eggs and yolks, and mix well. Let it sit for at least an hour at room temperature before serving. Just before serving, toss with basil leaves before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,grain rice,thyme,baby carrot,beef broth
title: Easy Crock Pot Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breast fillets ( fat trimmed ) | 4 -6 baby carrots | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 1/2 cups long grain rice ( not basmati rice ) | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth or 1 1/2 cups beef broth
instructions: Place carrots and thyme in crock pot. Place chicken in crock pot. Place rice on top of chicken. Pour broth over chicken. Cook on high for 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,beef brisket,balsamic vinegar,walnut,brown basmati rice,rice,oyster sauce
title: Sweet & Crispy Beef Broth
ingredients: 2/3 cup brown basmati rice | 1 1/2 lbs corned beef brisket, trimmed cut into pieces ( i use round roast ) | 3 cups low sodium chicken broth | 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 6 ounces walnuts, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/3 cup brown basmati rice
instructions: Place the rice, corned beef and 2 cups of broth in a large microwave safe casserole dish. Cover and cook on high for about 7 minutes. Remove from the microwave, uncover and let stand for about 10 minutes or until fully cooked. Stir to combine. In a wok over high heat, reheat about 2/3 cup broth until hot, about 5 minutes, about 2 minutes. Set aside and keep warm. Heat remaining broth to boiling.

title: Feta Salad (Low Fat Version)
ingredients: 1 medium broccoli floret, finely chopped | 3 celery ribs, finely chopped | 15 ounces feta, crumbled | 12 mint leaves, fresh, chopped | 1 1/2 ounces cactus | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | fresh herb ( to garnish, mint basil, basil powder )
instructions: Place all ingredients except mints in a non reactive bowl and stir to combine. Toss salad with dressing to coat well and garnish with mints to serve. Note, i do not use my vegetable dressing pan to toss with my salad because it adds some moisture to the dressing.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,bouquet garni,oregano leaf
title: Homemade Chili Roux
ingredients: 2 jars ortega stewed tomatoes with green chile peppers and tomatos with liquid | 4 cubes bouquet garni ( italian herbs ) | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Place tomatoes and bouquet garni in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer, uncovered, for one hour. Strain the solids through a coffee filter lined sieve, pressing frequently, and return to the pot. Add oregano and stir to blend. Bring to a boil, then simmer, covered for 20 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Pasta Con Pernod (Beef Casserole, Potatoes, Beans and Dressing)
ingredients: 8 red potatoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 can great northern beans ( drained ) | 1 jar pimientos | 1 jar pernod | 1 1/2 cups margarine | 1 cup cornflour ( or plain flour ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried pernod ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven at 200&deg.

Random Ingredients: green lentil,kaffir lime leaf,grain white rice,cranberry juice cocktail
title: Kaffir Lime and Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 cups green lentils | 1 cup long-grain white rice, rinsed | 4 1/2 ounces cranberry juice cocktail | 1 kaffir lime leaf, torn
instructions: Place the lentils into a large saucepan, cover with cold water, bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer to just cooked, about 20 mins until tender. Drain well and set aside. Dissolve the cocktail in a small bowl. Cut the kaffir lime in half and squeeze the flesh into the warm lentils and discard the central seeds. In a bowl, combine the cooked lentils and rice, then add the cranberry juice cocktail, lime leaves and kaffir lime juice. Add salt and pepper to taste, then toss to combine. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Wonton Taco's
ingredients: 1 package cheese, queshed | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 dash cracked black pepper ( to taste ) | 2 -3 peppercorns ( optional ) | 1 package wonton wrappers | 16 ounces black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat vegetable stock in microwave to boiling. Add shredded cheese, dry mustard, cracked black pepper, chopped peppercorns and optional ingredients, if desired. Wrap wonton wrappers in cheese and fry in boiling vegetable stock in nonstick pan till soft. Serve with refried beans.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,spring onion,beef bouillon cube,roquefort cheese,snow pea,anise,tomato paste,malibu rum
title: Malibu Smoked Beef Dip
ingredients: 1 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes or 1 cup chopped tomato | 3 tablespoons julienned spring onions | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 4 teaspoons malibu rum | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/3 cup frozen snow pea, trimmed | 4 fresh shucked oysters ( optional )
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,curry leaf,goat cheese,topping,tofu,chili powder,bok choy
title: Curried Tofu Salad With Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, cut into 1/3-inch cubes 3/4-inch diameter | 1 cup firm tofu, cut into 1/3-inch cubes | 3 bunches bok choy, trimmed, cut crosswise into 1/3-inch sections | 1/2 cup prepared goat cheese | 4 fresh curry leaves | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 3 celery ribs, chopped
instructions: Place 2 cups water in a medium saucepan. Add tofu cubes, and bring to a boil.

title: Grilled Trout With Coconut Rum
ingredients: 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 2 teaspoons coconut rum | 1 tablespoon red apple, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs trout, thawed ( about 2 heads )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine fish sauce, rum and apple pieces. Stir in trout and coat trout evenly. Cover and marinate on the counter 1 hour or refrigerate overnight. Heat coals or barbeque. Grill fish until just cooked through, about 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,bitter melon,red curry paste,lemon pepper,almond extract,mint,pineapple chunk,kosher salt
title: Egg Basket Salad
ingredients: 1 bitter melon, halved and seeded | 4 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 1/2 cup toasted pineapples, chopped | 2 tablespoons dried mint | 2 tablespoons minced roasted red curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon minced lemon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt ( optional )
instructions: Combine bitter melon halves and eggs in the bowl of a food processor or blender. Pulse until well combined. Combine diced melon halves, pineapples, mint, roasted red curry paste, lemon pepper, almond extract, and salt.

title: Eggless Mushroom Tamales
ingredients: 12 cornhusks, husks and silk removed | 3 cans canned apple pie filling | 3 cans sliced mushrooms
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil.

title: Homemade Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 cup cold water | 1 lb hamburger
instructions: Pour boiling, cold water over hamburg.

title: Italian Sausage Wraps
ingredients: 1 pound bulk sweet italian sausage | 1/4 cup chopped pimiento | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 20 flour tortillas | 1 1/2 cups crumbled bread, divided
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir sausage in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Spinach and Feta Salad.. Not Crudites!
ingredients: 3 cans chopped mushrooms | 4 ounces feta cheese | 2 bags baby spinach | 2 jars sliced dried apricots ( halved ) | 2 bags baby lima beans | 2 jars sliced peanut, with pimento ( not the kind with honey ) | 1 jar guacamole
instructions: Empty the mushrooms into a large bowl and cover with the cheese. Add the spinach and cook over low heat while preparing the rest of the salad. Drain the can of dried fruit and reserve both cans of fruit for another meal. When the vegetables are just tender, drain the juices into a small pot, then reduce heat to low. Add the figs and lima beans and heat through. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the hot peanut mixture. Serve topped with the remaining fruit and guacamole.

title: Aussie Salami Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup genoa salami, finely diced | 1/2 cup chocolate ice cream | parsley, to top | turmeric, to sprinkle
instructions: Combine salami, ice cream, parsley, and turmeric. Divide mixture into 4 - 4 sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,french onion ring,leek,rice,masa harina,phyllo pastry
title: Tunisian Beef Samosas
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 medium leek, sliced lengthwise | 2 cans french onion rings ( in beef broth, or use beef and onion gravy recipe below, see note ) | 2 boxes instant rice | 3 packages packages frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 1/4 cups masa harina
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.

title: Roasted Italian Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, scrubbed | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup olive oil | 3/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 pinch ground cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the potatoes into a large casserole dish. Combine tomato soup, olive oil, bread crumbs and ground cloves in a large bowl.

title: Oyster Sauce Seasoning
ingredients: 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1/2 cup tamari | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 garlic clove
instructions: Stir together oyster sauce, tamari, garlic salt and garlic. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,gouda cheese,quinoa,coffee liqueur,chicken breast,cardamom pod,canadian bacon,extra virgin olive oil
title: Quinoa & Bacon Bake
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, soaked & cooled | 4 ounces canadian bacon, diced | 4 ounces canadian bacon, chopped | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 cup shredded gouda cheese | chilled roasted, crispy chicken breast | tortilla chips ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°f. Prepare the quinoa to your liking and cook it according to the package directions. Set aside to cool. In a sauté pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced quinoa. Stir and add the grated smoked gouda until the cheese is mostly melted. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the cardamom. The quinoa should be lightly browned but not burned. Place the quinoa in a bowl. Sprinkle each serving with some of the caramelized cheese. Serve with the chicken.

title: Easy Italian Dressing (For Dip or Steak)
ingredients: 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 1 jar barbecue sauce ( i use kraft country style barbecue sauce )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in tightly covered container. Makes about 1 3/4 cups of prepared dressing for dipping.

title: Pork-Stuffed Mushrooms(Sali Kebab)
ingredients: 1 lb pork chop | 2 ounces almond paste | 8 button mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | chocolate chips, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: To make the stuffing, chop the pork chops into chunks and place them on a plate. Add almond paste, mushrooms, cardamom, and chocolate chips and combine. Garnish with chocolate chips/towels if desired.

title: Crispy Jalapeno and Shrimp Loaf (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 lb self rising flour | 1/2 lb tiger shrimp, uncooked | 12 jalapenos, stemmed and seeded
instructions: Wash shrimp. If tails are large, cut along edges of tail and gently pull tail openings away from shrimp. Cut shrimp lengthwise into halves. Cut jalapenos crosswise into halves. Place flour into bowl. Dip shrimp in flour. Arrange shrimp and jalapenos onto lightly greased baking sheet. Push down to ensure even coating. Cover and let stand in fridge for 8 hours. Bake at 500f for 13 minutes.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,tomato paste,kosher salt,sirloin,double cream,dark soy sauce,gruyere cheese
title: Baked Beef Schnitzel With Gruyere
ingredients: 8 ounces sirloin ( lean beefsteak, about 3/4-inch thick ) | kosher salt | 16 ounces gruyere cheese, grated ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup plum tomato, diced ( about 4 ) | 1 tablespoon double cream ( or milk ) | 2 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce, such as dark sesame oil, for brushing
instructions: Position a rack in the lower third of the oven and preheat to 450°f. Spray a small baking pan with nonstick spray. Place sirloin on the pan and poke with a fork about 1/2 inch deep into a small hole. Sprinkle with salt. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of the gruyere on each meat slice. Drizzle with about half the tomato juice, spreading evenly. Bake meat until meat is browned, about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese, and top with the remaining tomato juice and gruyere. Bake until the cheese is lightly browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green olive,prosciutto,coriander seed,anise seed,salt black pepper,cumin,venison
title: Venison With Salt, Pepper and Olives
ingredients: 4 teaspoons coriander seeds | 4 teaspoons cumin | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 lb dried venison, cut into 1-inch pieces ( or other firm white meat, such as venison ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 cup green olives, drained and halved | 4 slices prosciutto, thick slices
instructions: Place the coriander, cumin, and anise on a dry, hot sauté pan and toast over moderate heat, shaking the pan to mix all the browned spices and toasting the spices, until the toasted spices are fragrant and warm. Remove from the heat and cool, then grind into a rough powder. Rub the venison with the spice infused oil and season lightly, to taste, with salt and pepper. Gril the venison over moderate heat, turning once, until nicely browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Scatter with olives and prosciutto and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,stew meat,pastry flour,red wine,cannellini bean
title: Beef and Beans Pie
ingredients: 1/2 lb stew meat, cut into cubes | pastry flour, for rolling out the pastry according to instructions on the package | 1 tablespoon tarragon vinegar | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup red wine, divided
instructions: Spray a large casserole dish with cooking spray, and line half of it with pastry. Lightly roll the meat from any excess flour and place in the casserole dish. Add the vinegar and beans to the meat, toss to coat. Pour over half the red wine. Cover the casserole dish with the rest of the pastry and trim any pastry that has been stuck and cut into squares. Bake in a preheated 375 degree oven for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: tahini,chicken tender,rice vinegar,thai fish sauce,beer,chili bean
title: Beer Chili Chicken
ingredients: 3 -4 chicken tenders | 1 cup dry rice vinegar | 3/4 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons chili bean sauce ( thai hot bean paste ) | 1/2 cup beer | chili bean paste
instructions: In ziploc bag add all ingredients and marinade overnight. Drain chicken add to sauce and bake uncovered at 350°f until chicken is cooked and sauce thickens, about 3 - 4 minutes.

title: Hominy Lasagna
ingredients: 1 jar canned hominy, rinsed and drained ( white kidney beans ) | 1 jar mild applesauce, such as a.1 | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 12 lasagna noodles, preferably whole wheat
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 3 to 5 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low setting 3 to 5 hours at low heat setting. Remove lid.

title: Cheesy Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 pound smoked sausage, finely diced | 1 can mango chutney
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, stir in the sausage, and cook for about 5 minutes to heat it all together. Remove the sausage mixture from the skillet, and pour the mango chutney into a bowl. Serve with slices of fresh toasted french bread, crackers, or tostados.

title: Curry Flavoured Cheese -- Rabdi Kaate
ingredients: 1 -2 lb grated romano cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon curry powder, to taste
instructions: Combine everything together.

title: Fried Herbed Parsley
ingredients: 1 lb thickly sliced fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/3 cup cooking oil
instructions: Wash the parsley. Place parsley in a large bowl. Pour oil and 1 tsp lemon juice over the parsley. Cover and leave at room temp, for 8 to 10 hours. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

title: Sesame Seed Cookies (Martha Stewart)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sesame oil | 1 1/2 cups soy flour
instructions: In a bowl, using a wire whisk, combine sesame oil and soy flour. Stir until the mixture forms fine crumbs. Roll the mixture into small balls about the size of a ping pong ball. Refrigerate balls while making the rest of the balls. Preheat an outdoor or indoor electric griller over medium heat. Cook balls on the grilling surface for 3 minutes on each side. Let cool for 2 minutes on cookie sheets. Store in an airtight, cool, and temperature.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,beer,romano cheese,great northern bean,buttermilk baking mix,beef chuck
title: Beef and Cauliflower Cauliflower Skillet Meal
ingredients: 1 bag refrigerated buttermilk baking mix | 1/2 cup romano cheese | 1 cup canned great northern beans | 1 lb lean ground beef chuck | 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 can beer
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f coat 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Place baking mix in a large bowl and combine with romano, beans, beef and cauliflower. Spoon mixture into prepared dish and sprinkle with remaining romano and/or parmesan cheese. Cover and bake 1 hour or until bubbly. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ruby port,spaghetti sauce,tomato sauce,virgin olive oil,currant,limeade concentrate
title: Port Madeira
ingredients: 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1/2 cup ruby port | 3 tablespoons fresh limeade concentrate, thawed, undiluted | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons spaghetti sauce | 1 teaspoon dried currants
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix tomato sauce, port, limeade concentrate, oil, spaghetti sauce and currants.

Random Ingredients: fruit,channa dal,double cream,granny smith apple,rib eye
title: Sour Cream, Fruit & Apple Salad with Channa Dal
ingredients: 4 ounces channa dal | 3 ounces rib eye steaks, chopped into bite size pieces | 2 granny smith apples, chopped | 1 pint double cream | 4 ounces mixed dried fruits, thawed and finely chopped
instructions: Soak channa dal in 1/2 pint of water. Put in a saucepan, cover and cook over gentle heat for 10 - 15 mins until soft, translucent & cooked. Place steaks in a large ovenproof dish. Mix apples with cream in a bowl, pour over channa & stir gently. Cover with plastic wrap & in the oven, cook in a preheated oven for 10 - 15 mins until the apples and nuts are starting to wilt and the channa brown. Remove from the oven & stir gently, until the salad is thoroughly heated through. Scatter with the warm channadal and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,ricotta cheese,savoy cabbage,red chili pepper,fish
title: Prawn and Cheese Soup
ingredients: 500 g firm small prawns | 400 ml vegetable stock | 125 gsavoy cabbage, shredded | 1 -2 red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Poach the prawn in the vegetable stock for 5 minutes until they change colour. Cool them and shell. Scoop out the flesh and set aside. Combine the cabbage, chilli, salt and garlic. Add the prawn meat, ricotta and vegetables. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for around 20 minutes until vegetables are tender and prawns are cooked through. Serve hot.

title: Rumpleparmesan Shrimp
ingredients: 600 g large shrimp, shelled, deveined and butterflied | 225 g cheese, grated ( parmesan or emmenthal ) | 1 cup plain flour | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Heat oven to 180c or 350°f. Grease, 5cm deep, ovenproof dish with butter. Place the shrimp on one side of the dish to cover. Grate half the cheese into shallow dish. Add the oregano to the cheese, then toss through. Turn shrimp over, then scatter over the cheese and oregano to coat. Make the crust, in a medium bowl, sift the flour and cocoa and the salt and pepper to taste. Stir in the remaining cheese. Dip the shrimp in the mixture. Roll each shrimp from one end until coated on both sides, then arrange in the prepared dish. Sprinkle with remaining oregano. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes until golden and prawn are cooked and pink. Serve hot, garnished with sprigs of parsley.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,soymilk,sun tomato,kashmiri chili powder
title: Homemade Soymilk Dosas (Raita)
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk ( silk sweetened is best ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2/3 teaspoon kashmiri chili powder | 1/2 sun-dried tomato, chopped
instructions: Blend soymilk, chili powder, sun dried tomatoes and kashmiri powder in a blender until smooth. Fold through a bowl to cool the mixture further. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,vanilla extract,kosher salt,chicken tender,pizza crust,pistachio,taco seasoning mix,tamarind paste
title: Tasty Chicken Pizza With Wild Rice and Pistachios
ingredients: 2 prepared pizza crusts ( i use the low fat variety ) | 1 1/2 lbs chicken tenders, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup prepared masaman taco seasoning mix ( i use goya brand ) | 1/8 cup apricot-dolop nectar or 1/8 cup nectarines-dollop nectar | 2 teaspoons kosher salt ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon unsalted dry-roasted unsalted pistachios | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix ( goya brand or regular taco seasoning mix )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place the pizza crust on a pizza pan or large cookie sheet. Spread the arugula or pesto on the pizza crust. Arrange the chicken evenly over the pesto on 1 pizza crust & sprinkle with the taco seasoning. Drizzle the pesto over chicken. Top with the apricot nectar or nectarines. Sprinkle with salt & pistachios, then bake 20 - 25 minutes, or the thickness of the crust depends on how crispy you like your crust. Remove from oven & let cool about 10 - 15 minutes before releasing the crust onto a cutting board. Let cool completely & enjoy.

title: Raita
ingredients: 4 -5 small turnips, peeled and sliced in about 1/4-inch slices | 3/4 lb fresh spinach leaves, washed, stems trimmed | 1 tablespoon fresh dill, chopped | 1 teaspoon garam masala | chili sauce ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons soft lard or 1 1/2 tablespoons other oil | 1 1/2 cups fruit, chopped, such as applesauce, cashew pieces and mango chutney ( chutney, yoghurt or chutney )
instructions: Place the turnips in a large bowl. In a blender container, purée the spinach with the dill, garam masala and hot water until the spinach is chopped and well pureed. Heat the lard or other oil in a skillet over medium high heat. When hot, add the puréed turnip mixture, turnip and spinach, and stir to coat. Lower the heat to medium and cook, stirring for about 15 minutes or just until the turnip is golden brown and tender.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,sherry,soymilk,beef tenderloin,filet mignon,shallot,corn flour,baby onion
title: Beef Tenderloin With Coconut Milk
ingredients: 20 slices beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 16 ounces unsweetened coconut milk | 12 ounces mayonnaise or 12 ounces sour cream | 1 medium shallot, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sherry or 1 tablespoon beef broth | 1 lb baby onions, thinly sliced | 8 ounces raw shallots, sliced ( about 6 ounces total )
instructions: Place a small skillet over medium high heat until hot. Sprinkle the beef with 1 tablespoon of the cornflour and sear until browned, about 4 minutes per side. Spread a small thin layer of the coconut milk in the bottom of a shallow baking dish. Spread the beef on the coconut milk in a thin layer. Let it sit for 10 minutes, flipping once. Spread the mayonnaise and the shallots over the beef. Spoon the remaining coconut milk over the shallots and spread the coconut milk over the shallots and serve.

title: Zesty Dip with Black Olives
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 cup chopped black olives
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the cream cheese and limeade concentrate. Sprinkle on lemon zest. Stir in olives.

title: Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 2 3/4 tablespoons pumpkin seeds, finely ground | 1 packet ladyfingers | glace green decorator sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to gas 7/380f pour the ground pumpkin seeds into a dry frying pan and toast for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the sponge fingers, working quickly to avoid sticking or moulding the sponges. Put into an oven proof dish and sprinkle with glace green decorator sugar. Bake for about 30 minutes or until golden.

title: Indian Spiced Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 cups half-and-half | 1/2 piece fresh ginger root, minced | 7 pounds whole corned beef brisket, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Place mustard seeds, half and half, and ginger in a large saucepan. Place the corned beef brisket, fat side up, in a shallow roasting pan. Pour half of the half and half mixture into the roasting pan, and place on top of the mustard seed mixture. Cover pan with foil, and bake in preheated oven until liquid is reduced completely, about 4 hours.

title: Scallops in Canadian Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 green apples, peeled, cored and chopped | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons fennel powder | 4 scallops | 4 salmon steaks, about 200 grams ( or tuna fillets in the usa, 1 inch thick )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Combine the apples, oil, fennel and pepper in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 10 seconds, uncovered, until heated through and slightly softened. Arrange the scallops in a shallow casserole dish. Sprinkle over the apples, followed by the salmon steaks or tuna.

title: Spicy Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 16 salad shrimp, cleaned | 8 ounces sliced honey-roasted sun-dried tomatoes | 1/2 lb mixed salad shrimp, defrosted if frozen
instructions: Cook the shrimp, in a large saucepan as they are being cooked, just enough to lightly brown them all over so they are bright red and just cooked through. Just a minute or two on each side should do it in 2 batches. Transfer to plates and top with a portion of the chopped sun dried tomatoes. Sprinkle the honey roasted shrimp on top. Serve with fresh crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: coconut,squash,beet,cannellini bean,ra el hanout spice mix,banana
title: Beet, Banana & Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 large beet, diced | 1 squash, diced | 2 bananas, diced | 2 1/2 ounces cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 ounce ras el hanout spice mix | 1/2 cup coconut, shredded
instructions: Mix together all salad ingredients. Refrigerate for 1 hour prior to serving.

title: Spicy Strip Beef
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | 1 teaspoon allspice | 2 teaspoons rum extract | 4 cups crispy rice | 1 package shadybrook pasta ( or any long tubular pasta ) | 1 package tahini | salad greens
instructions: Slice beef into 1/2 inch strips, sprinkle with allspice. Dip in rum extract. Place in steaks' ramekin, or large plastic ziploc® bag. Cover tightly. Refrigerate overnight. Bring to room temperature for easy handling. Boil ramekins and pasta according to package directions for al dente.

title: Yogurt Cheese With Mushrooms, Spring Onions and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 pound fresh button mushrooms | 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 6 ounces snow peas, trimmed and halved
instructions: Soak mushrooms for about 15 minutes in enough warm water to cover. Drain, and set aside. Dissolve whole or 1/2 pound package of the yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Set aside. Wash the fresh mushrooms and trim of as much of the stems as you can. Slice them into 1 inch pieces. Set aside. Melt yogurt and oil in a large bowl. Add the mushrooms, and stir to coat with the yogurt. Drain the mushrooms thoroughly, but do not chop. Stir in the 1/2 package of the yeast mixture, stir to combine, then divide the mushroom mixture among 4 large, heavy baking dishes that are just big enough to hold them. Cover the dishes with plastic wrap and let rise at room temp until doubled.

title: Dried Corn Pudding II
ingredients: 5 tablespoons dried dill | 1 1/2 cups cream-style corn | 2 tablespoons ground fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Soak dried dill in a bowl of water, at least 1 hour before using, for 15 minutes. Bring dill water to boil in a skillet on the stove. Combine cream style corn, fennel seed, cinnamon, and salt. Pour into boiling dill water, add more if necessary, to cover. Bring to boil, then remove from heat and allow to stand 30 minutes.

title: Apple Red Curry Sauce for Pork
ingredients: 1/2 cup red curry paste, more as needed | 1/2 - 2/3 cup apple juice | 1/2 - 2/3 cup shredded coconut | 1 jar chopped pimiento ( drained ) | 2 -3 tablespoons chinese red curry paste | 1 tablespoon cocoa | coconut
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in airtight container up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: brazil nut,white pepper,mango chutney,maraschino cherry,parsnip,green chilies
title: Grilled Mango Chutney Parsnips With Parsnips and Chutney
ingredients: 2 medium parsnips, peeled and cut into pieces | 1 1/2 cups mango chutney, chopped | 1/4 cup mango chutney, smooth | 1/4 cup chopped green chilies | 1/3 cup chopped maraschino cherry | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup grated brazil nut, toasted ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine 3/4 cup mango chutney, 1/4 cup mango chutney, chopped green chilies, maraschino and white pepper. Spoon mixture onto pith side of parsnips and chill under grill for 3 minutes, turning and basting with any remaining chutney mixture on the grill. Place on sheet of aluminum foil in centre of grill and grill until crisp tender, about 6 minutes in all. Serve with melba toast and garnish with a sprig or two of parsley.

title: Cheesy Veggies
ingredients: vegetables | 1/2 cup chopped onion
instructions: Saute onion in butter or oil. Add all ingredients and cook until they are limp.

title: Hot Champagne Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup champagne vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Mix the vinegar with the crushed red pepper flakes. Serve with fresh green salad leaves, fresh fruit, or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pam cooking spray,cherry heering,white flour,maple extract,gingerroot,orange flower water
title: Sizzlin' Maple Filled Sourdough Cherry Crostini (Or Heering)
ingredients: 150 g unbleached white flour | 150 g fresh gingerroot ( finely grated ) | 4 tablespoons maple flavored cooking spray | 2 tablespoons orange flower water | 2 tablespoons cherries heering | 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot | pam cooking spray
instructions: If using dry gluten free flour, combine flour, gingers, baking powder and orange flower water in a bowl then mix well until you have a smooth dough. Preheat the oven to 220c/475f/gas mark dust a work surface with a little more of the flour then press the dough onto it with your fingertips. With lightly floured hands roll out the dough to about a 9in circle and cut into quarters. Using a floured knife, cut out 4 even circles then place the triangles on the baking parchment. Coat the biscuits with cooking oil then bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Leave on the oven to cool for 5 minutes then transfer the heering to a wire rack. Cool for a further 5 - 10 minutes before adding the cherries. Serve immediately with ice cream, cream or yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,beef stew meat,ketchup,thai basil,hard egg,egg yolk,cake flour
title: Beef Patties
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat or 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, sliced very thin | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thai basil or 1/2 cup basil leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon fresh vanilla | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Mix all ingredients except yolk in a bowl. If too dry, add up to 1 tbsp water or vinegar.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,lasagna noodle,cherry,ice cream,white vinegar,cannellini bean,chili pepper flake
title: Cannellini Bean Cannellini Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup white vinegar or 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 12 -14 ounces cannellini beans ( about 3 cups ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla | 1 cup canned cannellini beans or 1 cup other white beans | 16 -20 large sweet sour cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped unpeeled fresh strawberries ( about 2 cups ) or 1 1/2 cups red currant tomatoes ( about 2 cups )
instructions: Place vinegar and 1 3/4 cups water in a wide, heavy pot. Bring to a boil. Add remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: pimento olive,allspice,white cheddar cheese,maple syrup,poppy seed,spring onion,picante sauce,raisin
title: Poppy Seed and Raisin Pimento Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces poppy seeds | 3 1/2 ounces white cheddar cheese | 6 ounces raisins, plump plump plump | 1 ounce pimento stuffed olive, chopped | 1 small bunch spring onion, chopped | 6 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 ounces picante sauce or 2 ounces hot picante sauce, more to taste | 1/4 teaspoon allspice ( optional )
instructions: Put poppy seeds in an airtight container and set aside. Chop cheese in a food processor, then add raisins and olives. Process into fine crumbs, set aside. In a small saucepan, stir remaining ingredients and warm over low heat until hot. Pour mixture into dry ingredients and stir until dry ingredients are incorporated. Put mixture in an ungreased 3 quart rectangular baking dish. Sprinkle with poppy seeds on top. Bake for one hour or until golden brown and very lightly crisp on top.

Random Ingredients: ice,pasta shell,palm sugar,mustard seed,chicken breast half,farfalle pasta
title: Quick Macaroni Grill Chicken
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons chopped palm sugar | 1 pint ice cold water | 1 jar pasta shells, with liquid
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Kielbasa With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut pumpkin ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | ice water | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 lb mushroom, cleaned and quartered | sea salt | 1/2 cup mint leaf, fresh ( or parsley, chopped )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large pot. Toss in the mint leaves.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,gingerroot,vanilla ice cream,pecorino romano cheese,ancho chile,dijon mustard
title: Ancho Chile Roasted Chile Salt
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried ancho chiles ( or 1/3 cup pure ancho powder and 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder ) | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon pure ground gingerroot | 4 scoops vanilla ice cream
instructions: Put chiles in a small bowl.

title: Guacamole Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 bag cauliflower | 1/2 hass avocado | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Cut cauliflower into florets, or slice into small florets as directed above. Chop avocado into small pieces. Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Add 1/2 bag of cauliflower and cook for 8 minutes. Drain. Remove cauliflower from water, drain, and set aside. Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Place cauliflower in a bowl and mash with a fork. Stir in avocado, then spread onto a large baking sheet. Sprinkle the top of the cauliflower with the cheese. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, or until cauliflower is tender.

Random Ingredients: red grape,irish whiskey,lemon juice,green cabbage,garlic,cider vinegar,orange zest
title: Greens with Irish Whiskey and Garlic
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon juice | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons orange zest | 14 ounces red seedless grapes | 3/4 cup green cabbage, shredded | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1/4 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for 2 to 3 hours. Serve chilled on toothpicks.

title: Danish Tandoori (Algerian Beef Noodle-Roast Stew)
ingredients: 1/4 lb deli roast beef or 1/4 lb thin sliced deli ham, cut into small pieces | 2 tablespoons quinoa, soaked in water for an hour or 2 cups fresh stock | 8 dried turmeric sticks, crushed fine | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder ( can use 2 tablespoons dried oregano ) | freshly grated turmeric | cooked rhubarb
instructions: Cook the quinoa in the water according to package directions. Add the roast beef and the turmeric to the simmering broth, stir to mix and cook for about 15 minutes. Add the oregano and simmer for 2 minutes. Serve with crème fraîche.

title: Yummy, Chef's Easy, Chef John's  Phytich Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice | 1 1/2 cups chickpea flour | 5 cups iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced | 1 1/3 cups mascarpone cheese ( use the fat free variety in a small packet ) | 1 tablespoon chopped dill | 2 tablespoons toasted pecans, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place the cooked rice in a large soup pot. Add enough water to just cover the rice.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,fontina cheese,wonton skin,raspberry,cream cheese,black eyed pea,green pea,white flour
title: Corn, New England Style
ingredients: 10 small wonton skins | 5 packages cream cheese, room temp ( neufchatel ) | 1 1/4 cups white flour | 4 cups baby raspberries ( about 1 pound ) | 3 cups shredded fontina cheese | 1 cup sliced black-eyed peas | 1 cup shredded savoy cabbage | 3/4 cup frozen green pea, thawed | 8 tablespoons shredded fontina cheese
instructions: Boil, steam, or microwave the first 3 ingredients until the water boils off. This will take about 5 - 10 min. Drain, rinse with cold water, and set aside. Beat at room temp cream cheese until smooth. Add flour gradually. Mix well to form a paste. Wrap each wonton skin around a cream cheese cube and place in microwave, seam side down. Microwave for 6 minutes to heat. Remove a wonton skin from the microwave and place in a bowl with a layer of raspberries on the bottom. Spread a thin layer of fontina cheese on the raspberries. Spread black eyed peas evenly across the fontina cheese. Add a layer of shredded cabbage. A third layer of raspberries. Repeat process, ending with a layer of raspberries.

title: Tres Bienens
ingredients: 2 lbs plum tomatoes | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons catsup | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Cut ends off tomatoes and then cut crosswise about 1 inch thick. Cut each thin slice in half. Rub the skins on tomatoes and place in non stick skillet. Brown tomatoes and drain. Remove and discard skin. Cut meat into 1 1/2 inch cubes discarding fat. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Place a layer of meat on top of the tomato mixture. Continue alternating tomato chunks and meat making sure each layer consists of one tomato and one meat layer. Finish removing the tomato mixture. Wrap heavy duty aluminum foil around each bundle and seal. Let sit in refrigerator overnight. The next day remove the foil and wrap packet. Bake at 325f for 1 & the 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,dark beer,olive oil,escarole,maple syrup
title: Ale, Escarole & Maple Leaf Saute
ingredients: 5 lbs escarole, trimmed and chopped | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/3 cup light beer, such as stout beer | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 4 kaffir lime leaves, torn
instructions: Preheat broiler to high and line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Combine the greens in a medium bowl with the maple syrup, beer, and olive oil in a medium size skillet, over medium heat. Cook about 8 to 10 minutes, or until the greens are tender and the maple syrup is bubbling. Remove the kaffir lime leaves, sprinkle with more paprika and transfer to a serving plate. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock broth,lemon juice,lemon,cornflour,snow pea pod,apple juice
title: Apple Snow Pea Pods
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 200 ml stock ( chicken broth or water ) | 1 teaspoon lemon rind, finely grated | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 2 cans sliced apples in juice | 80 g snow pea pods, halved
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together except wine vinegar and pea pods and set aside. Place apples in saucepan with 2/3 cup stock. Heat, covered, stirring occasionally, until apples are soft. Place in blender and puree until smooth. Pour sauce into 4 - 6 glasses. Add snow pea pods and remaining stock. Cover and chill for several hours or overnight. Makes about 2 1/2 cups.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,ice cream cone,turmeric,chicken breast half,horseradish,apricot jam,monterey jack cheese
title: Grilled Chicken Breasts With Honey-Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot jam | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter | 8 skinless chicken breast halves | 4 sheets ice cream cone | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, preferably mexican | 2 tablespoons grated provolone cheese or 2 tablespoons monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup shredded reduced-fat monterey jack cheese
instructions: Place jam and 1 t butter in small heavy skillet over medium heat until melted and smooth. Remove from heat. Brush 8 slices chicken with glaze. Layer in 1/2 of ice cream cone.

title: Spanish Peppers and Carrots
ingredients: 1 jar pimiento slices | 1/2 cup strong tea ( not diet )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat. Turn down heat and simmer about 10 minutes, or until vegetables are softened.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,chicken wing,eggplant,white breadcrumb,egg yolk,blue cheese,mirin
title: Korean Crusted Chicken Legs
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled seeded and mashed | 1 1/2 cups fresh white breadcrumbs | 3 ounces blue cheese | 1 large egg yolk | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed | 4 cups chicken wings, cooked, split | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f degrees. Spread eggplant on a baking sheet, and bake for about 40 minutes, until eggplant is golden brown. Toss the bread crumbs with the cheese. In a small bowl, beat egg yolk with the caraway seeds, and lightly oil the wings. Dip the eggplant into the egg, and coat lightly on both sides. Remove the chicken pieces from the baking sheets, and bake the wings on top of the cheese, and bake for about 20 minutes. Serve hot, topped with the sauce. Note, if using the sauce in a barbeque, use tongs to pick up the chicken.

title: Date-Grilled Arepas
ingredients: 2 scallions, trimmed, white and light green parts only, cut 1/4-inch thick on the bias | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1/4-inch rounds | 1 teaspoon peppercorn, cracked whole | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemon zest | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pitted dates
instructions: Arrange scallions and bell pepper rounds on skewers and grill until just cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to an ovenproof serving platter. Place peppercorns in a small bowl. Heat a saute pan over medium high heat. Sprinkle each arepa with some of the ground peppercorns. Transfer the arepas to the saute pan and toast, shaking the pan occasionally until the arepas begin to give off a toasted aroma. Turn the arepas and cook on the other side until crisp and golden and blackened in spots, 3 - 5 minutes. Transfer the arepas to plates and sprinkle with lemon zest and chopped dates and remaining toasted peppercorns.

title: Frozen Spanakopita
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup | 1 dash oregano | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a microwave safe bowl, stir together the spinach, half and half, chocolate syrup, and oregano. Spread the spinach mixture evenly over the the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange frozen phyllo pastry over the spinach mixture, covering the entire bottom. Cover with aluminum wrap, and microwave on high for 8 minutes. Remove the plastic wrap, and sprinkle cheese on top. Recover dish with foil, and cook for 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Green Bean Italian Bread and Butter Appetizer With Focaccia
ingredients: 4 ounces italian bread ( or 1 italian bread or pepper tart for a less bready sandwich ) | 3 -4 ounces mixed greens beans ( italian-style ) | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, halved | 1/4 cup herbed focaccia bread, lightly toasted ( optional )
instructions: Slice sandwich in half diagonally and then crosswise 1/3 to 1/4 inch thick and 3 inches long. Arrange bread on two plates and place half of the greens on bread. Top with rest of cheese. Place second bread slice on top. Cut crosswise into four diagonal slices. Arrange slices in decorative pattern on top. Sprinkle with cherries, then drizzle with herbed focaccia cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Chunky Chile Con Carne I
ingredients: 12 1/2 ounces tomato paste | 14 7/8 ounces stewed tomatoes and green chilies | 11 1/2 ounces cake flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake at 325f for 1 - ½ hours until the top is golden brown. Use chunky chunky cheese and cut into chunks.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil peanut,sage,hard egg,greek yogurt,orange juice
title: Persian Spiced Eggs With Sage - Zahanarrah
ingredients: 5 tablespoons vegetable oil or 5 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 large hard-boiled eggs, divided | 6 teaspoons crumbled dried sage | 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt, whole-milk preferred | 1/2 orange, juice of
instructions: In a large, heavy skillet, heat the oil over moderate heat until hot but not smoking. Add 1/2 egg and cook, turning once, until just set, about 2 minutes. Transfer the eggs to a plate and set aside, keeping the pan hot. Heat the remaining oil in the pan over moderate heat until hot but not smoking. Add the sage and remaining egg and cook, stirring occasionally, until eggs are just set, about 2 minutes. Transfer the eggs to a warm serving plate. Pour the yogurt through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl, shaking the excess liquid. Pour over the eggs and stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,taco seasoning mix,lime juice zest,corn tortilla,pistachio
title: Pista N' Sweet Potato and Lime Grilled Tacos
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs sweet potatoes ( yellow or white ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3 cups mango chutney | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios ( optional )
instructions: Slice or cut up the sweet potatoes so they are about 1 inch or less thick and place them cut side down in a greased baking dish with 1 inch of water. Bake in a moderate oven for 1 - 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until tender. While still hot, add the taco seasoning and mix well. When cooked, remove from burner and spread the cooled sweet potatoes on a serving plate and top with a mixture of sweet potato and chutney as desired. Garnish with lime zest and pistachios and serve.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 8 cups spinach leaves, frozen | 4 cups grape tomatoes, quartered | 1 1/2 cups cherry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon anise seeds | 1/4 teaspoon oregano | 1/4 teaspoon bay leaf
instructions: Combine spinach, tomatoes, cherry tomatoes and anise seed in large bowl. Sprinkle with oregano and bay leaf. Toss gently. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,tomato juice,anchovy paste,cheddar cheese soup
title: Crock Pot Tomato and Anchovy Dip
ingredients: 3 cans condensed cheddar cheese soup | 3 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1 medium tomatoes, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot and stir well. Cover and cook on high for 2 to 4 hours.

title: Carnitas
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 can rotel | 1 tablespoon dried coriander powder | 2 dashes dried thyme
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crockpot. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours.

title: Spicy Red Pepper Bark
ingredients: 4 small red peppers, coarsely chopped | 2 star anise | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed dry breadcrumbs or 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed roasted salted butter
instructions: Combine pepper and star anise in small bowl to flavorning jar. Stir in 2 tbsp of water to coat.

title: Baked Escarole, Cracked Oranges and Oats
ingredients: 2 cups chopped escarole | 1 cup quick-grained oatmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place escarole in a medium bowl. Drizzle with oatmeal. Toss. Bake in preheated oven 20 to 25 minutes, until the edges are lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,maple sugar,cajun seasoning,snow pea,green peppercorn,white cheddar cheese,self raising flour,garam masala
title: Azerbaijani (Spice Griddle Bread)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon maple sugar | 1 tablespoon maple sugar | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 lb fresh snow peas | 1 teaspoon green peppercorn
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together. Add all wet ingredients into dry ingredients except the snow peas and peppercorns. Use as little or no oil as possible. Cut snow peas and peppercorns in halves. Heat a griddle pan/skillet. Knead dough until smooth. Divide mixture into 12 equal portions. Flatten each portion of dough and cover each with wax paper. Let stand for 10 - 15 minutes. Heat an additional brush and fry bread on each side until golden brown. Use a small amount of oil on the surface while cooking. Remove from griddle and brush with oil. Store bread in an airtight container for up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,red chili pepper flake,extra virgin olive oil,pickle,eggplant,tequila,peanut
title: Chile Rabe
ingredients: 3 large eggplants | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 tablespoon pickles, minced | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes ( or you can leave in half if you want ) ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons soy milk ( or soy yogurt ) | 2 tablespoons tequila
instructions: Brush eggplants with olive oil and grill until skin is charred and flesh is soft about 3 - 5 minutes, turning often. Cut into 1/2 inch slices. Heat a heavy medium skillet and melt peanut oil over medium heat. Add eggplant and pickles, sprinkle with chile flakes, and saute for about 4 minutes. Add soy milk and continue to stir. Let the flavors meld and the soy evaporate. When cool enough to handle, scoop flesh from skin. Add eggplant to sauce and toss. Transfer to a dish and serve with a piece of toasted bread.

title: Crock Pot Roasted Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 ham steaks, 1 inch thick ( or 1-inch thick ) | 3 -4 lbs beef chuck roast
instructions: Put chuck roast in crock pot. Place steaks on top of roast. Pour remaining liquid onto roast. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,hamburger,herb stuffing mix,dill pickle,nonfat milk,broccoli floret,basmati rice,thyme sprig
title: Grilled Ham and Broccoli Hamburger
ingredients: 5 slices lean hamburger | 1 cup dry herb stuffing mix, such as miracle whip | 1 teaspoon minced fresh thyme sprig, or other fresh herb seasoning | 1 large frozen broccoli floret, thawed | 1 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 cooked and shredded, cooked rice | 1/4 cup sliced dill pickle, such as removing fennel from the bread ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a grill to high. Place the hamburger in a medium bowl, and mix in stuffing mix, thyme, broccoli, remaining stuffing mix, oregano and thyme. Add milk, if desired. Divide mixture between 2 skewers. Lightly oil the grill grate. Grill, turning once, until cooked to desired doneness, 12 to 14 minutes per side.

title: Clams in Spicy Anchovies (Fakhitha Batata)
ingredients: 6 ancho chili ( or 1 large chilli ) | ice, as needed | 1 1/2 inches gingerroot | 3 pieces clams | 3 cardamom pods, bruised
instructions: In a large frypan, arrange a single layer of unopened anchovies. Fill each opening with 1/8 teaspoon of the ginger and 1/8 teaspoon of the cloves. Scatter over the cardamom pods to cover the fish. Put the fish on top and stir well. Add 2 more cardamom pods and 1/8 teaspoons of salt. The moment the mixture starts to stick to the sides of the pan, move the pan and continue to cook for 2 or 3 minutes, or until the mixture is reduced and starts to darken. Carefully turn a few fillets over, season with more salt. Serve at once. Goes well with plain boiled rice.

title: Scotch Whiskey Breakfast (Czechoslovakian)
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces strong light beer | 1/2 ounce irish whiskey | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1/2 teaspoon instant tea bags, powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Potato Chow Fun
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles, i like to use 3 pkgs of regular egg noodles | 1 1/4 cups red potatoes, peeled and cut into thirds | 3 tablespoons snow peas
instructions: To make the noodles, you need a large pot. Start with 1 1/4 cups of water and bring to a boil on medium heat. When the water is boiling, add the noodles and boil for 2 - 3 minutes or until tender. When the noodles are tender drain the water, return the noodles to the pot and toss with the snow peas and the sauce. This really is a very simple recipe and will last about 24 hours in the fridge, but you want to refrigerate it in a dark bowl, for a day or two prior to making this as i don`t want a heat and to let the flavors mingle.

Random Ingredients: white cabbage,confectioner ' sugar,grain white rice,lemon juice,dijon mustard
title: Lebanese Coleslaw
ingredients: 12 ounces whole grain white rice | 12 ounces sliced white cabbage | 6 1/3 teaspoons dijon mustard | 4 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place the rice in a large, microwave safe bowl, add 5 cups cold water, cover, and microwave on high for 18 to 20 minutes, or until just tender. Place the cabbage in the bowl with the rice. In a small bowl, mix 5 1/3 teaspoon mustard, the lemon juice, and 1 tablespoon confectioners' sugar. Drizzle over the cabbage. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Style Bread
ingredients: 4 teaspoons jalapeno chiles, minced | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°. Use a fork or pastry brush to spread chile. Cut the bread in half lengthwise. Spoon chile onto cut side of bread. Wrap bread with foil. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until toasted and bubbly.

title: Cafe De Sal - Brisket Boeur
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef flank steak | 1 bunch fresh italian parsley, firmly packed | 4 cups hot water
instructions: Trim as much fat off the flank steak as you can, then cut the meat across into 1 inch pieces. Discard any fat. Cut the parsley into 1 inch pieces and set aside in a large bowl. Reserve about half of the parsley tops. Place 1 cup of the parsley leaves into a blender and grind until very finely chopped, but still with a little bit of texture. Pour the hot water into the blender and slowly pour in the chopped parsley until the mixture is almost a liquid. The mixture should have the consistency of sauce. Set aside. Score the top of the flank steak, with the sharp knife, with a small, sharp knife all over. Reserve the rest. Drain all the meat from the marinade in the bowl onto a cutting board. Tear off a piece of meat that holds its shape, and place the meat along one side of the chopping board, then flatten slightly with your hand. Repeat until the meat has been used up. Place the flank steak into the hot grease and place over low heat. Turn the burner on medium and cook for 20 to 30 minutes. Add 1/4 cup of the reserved parsley water to the pan juices and cook, stirring often, until liquid is reduced. Cook for about 3 minutes, then taste and add more salt if necessary. Serve over noodles.

title: Olive Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup vegetable bouillon cubes ( i use knorr-brand ) | 1/4 cup pimento stuffed olive, chopped | 1 tablespoon coconut oil ( from pimentos )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Black Olive and Dill Salad
ingredients: 5 -6 black olives | 12 fresh dill or 2 teaspoons dried dill
instructions: Cut the olives in halves or quarters. Place in a bowl and toss lightly with dill. Variation, if olives make a solid substitute, substitute the 2 tsps red wine vinegar for the olive oil. Variation, to keep this salad moist, toss and let sit 1 - 2 hours for the flavors to develop.

title: Fanny's Simple Alfredo!
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles ( dried or fresh if available ) | 3 tablespoons brandy ( or sherry ) | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard ( or sweet rice vinegar ) | 1 pinch saffron | 1 pinch fennel powder ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons carob powder
instructions: Boil water and add a pinch of salt or sugar if using salted noodles or noodles which have been dry. Mix all together with a fork to give it a subtle garlic like sauce. Set aside. Cook the lasagna noodles for about 10 minutes or so, until golden and tender, not a creamy mess. Add the brandy and stir until melted. The brandy will be sweet so adjust the sweetness accordingly. Add the mustard and saffron and stir, or mix in with your noodles now, if using dry noodles, mix in by now. Drain the noodles and mix with your sauce. Taste and be sure you'd like your salad a little bit more lemony. Serve and enjoy.

title: Balsamic Jelly Jelly
ingredients: 3 ounces silken tofu, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, plus more for brushing | 1 -2 ounce whole milk ( use just enough so that the jelly doesn ` t stick to the bottom ) | 2 -3 juniper berries
instructions: Put the tofu into a sauce pan over a low heat, and cook for 8 - 10 minutes, stirring the tofu frequently and adding more water as necessary to prevent sticking. Then remove the pan from the heat. Meanwhile, bring the milk to a boil with a pinch of salt, the vinegar, and the juniper berries. Stir well and add the jelly to the pan. Cover and simmer over a medium low heat, stirring frequently and checking as its liquid reduces and becomes syrupy, for about 25 minutes, until the jelly becomes thick, creamy and reduced quite small strands of jelly, which develop at the end. Remove the jelly with a slotted spoon to a bowl and reserve the juice. This will be served hot, sweet, and syrupy jelly. This jelly can also be refrigerated and used to make stews or sauces.

title: Ww 3 Points - Healthy Option: Low Fat-Calorie Milk With Coconut Flavouring
ingredients: 1/2 cup fat-free low-fat soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | fresh coriander, for garnishing ( cilantro )
instructions: Heat a medium sized saucepan over a medium heat and add the milk. Allow the milk to double, almost immediately, but not completely. As soon as the milk is almost full of a bubble, pour the soymilk over it. Stir and let the milk bubble till the mixture coats the back of a spoon. Do not over boil. Add the vanilla essence and stir. Do not let it come to room temperature and add fresh coriander leaves before serving. You may want to add some freshly ground black pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: shallot,coconut,wheat flour,fish sauce,tortilla,cavenders greek seasoning,basil leaf
title: Coconut Tacos - Thai
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups flakey flakey flakey flours | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce ( i like kikkoman ) | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves, crushed | 1 1/2 tablespoons cavenders all purpose greek seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped shallots ( i like a mix of dark and brown ) | 1 cup shredded unsweetened coconut | warm tortillas or corn
instructions: Combine first ten ingredients and mix until mixed. Place tortillas or corn tortillas on a baking sheet. Spoon mixture onto each and sprinkle coconut over mixture. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes, or until browned and crispy. Serve on warmed tortillas and add a sprinkle of cilantro and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,herbes de provence,brown rice flour
title: Herbes De Provence and White Chocolate Glaze, Baked Risotto
ingredients: 200 g white chocolate, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 2 cups of bomba brown rice flour ( not glutinous rice flour ) or 2 cups rice flour ( not glutinous rice flour )
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c. Place a baking tray in the oven and heat it up. Once oven is warm add the unsweetened chopped chocolate to a medium sized bowl along with the herbes and rice flour. Stir to get a smooth paste about the consistency of glue. Place mixture in your favourite greased saucepan and place a small piece of baking paper on top. Bake in oven for approx 40 minutes or till you can smell an aroma or soft bubbling. Allow to cool & enjoy.

title: Tuna Salad With Baked Ham and Ziti
ingredients: 3/4 lb hamburger | 1/4 cup vinegar or 1/4 cup apple cider | 1/2 cup pesto sauce or 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1 package ziti pasta or ( 10 ounce ) package rotini pasta | 1 cup grated cucumber | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | grated pineapple nuts, for garnish
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Crumble hamburger into pan, and cook over medium heat. Drain fat, if desired.

title: Sweet Corn Soup
ingredients: 8 cups cold water | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 4 bay leaves | 1 cup thawed frozen corn or 1 cup canned corn kernels | 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Combine cold water, chili paste, cardamom and bay leaves in a 4 to 6 quart slow cooker. Cook on low for 5 hours. Stir in frozen corn or corn kernels and cook on high for about 30 minutes, or until heated through. Ladle into soup bowls and garnish with shredded lettuce.

title: Mushroom Tapas
ingredients: 1/4 lb pancetta, finely diced | 12 large mushroom caps, cleaned and quartered | 2 tablespoons chopped orange bell peppers | 2 tablespoons reduced-sodium marinade | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat grill and lightly oil grate. In a bowl, combine pancetta, mushrooms, orange peppers and 1 tbsp marinade.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,season salt,superfine sugar,arrowroot,fontina cheese,yellow bell pepper,whipping cream,poblano chile
title: Chipotle Egg Noodles
ingredients: 14 ounces egg noodles | 1 poblano chile | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut in strips | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon arrowroot | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 3/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/4 cup grated fontina cheese
instructions: Place noodles in a large pot with cold water and bring to a boil. When water returns to boil, drain and run under cold water until cool. Drain well and put in a bowl of ice water. Repeat with poblano, yellow bell pepper and chicken. In a medium bowl, whisk cream with arrowroot and season with salt and sugar until smooth. Stir in fontina until well blended. In a deep skillet, heat cream over medium high heat, just until bubbles form around edge. Don't let it boil remove from heat and let stand until noodles soften, about 5 - 10 minutes. Mix noodles with cream sauce and garnish with additional grated cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Jeera (Aloo Ki Naan Bread )
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chile powder ( haldi ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons green cardamom pods | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla, or to taste | 2 tablespoons shortening
instructions: Stir chile powder and cardamom pods to release their aroma, about one minute. Combine chile powder, cardamom pods, vanilla, and shortening in a small bowl. Heat a cast iron skillet over medium high heat until just sizzling, about 1 minute. Pour enough batter into the skillet to lightly coat the bottom.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,lime marmalade,tamarind paste,coffee,tomatillo salsa,salt,burrito flour tortilla,thyme leaf
title: Mushroom Lime Tacos
ingredients: 6 ounces cremini mushrooms, trimmed | 1 jar tomatillo salsa ( or salsa verde ) | 1/4 cup brewed coffee | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves, crushed | 1 package burrito-size flour tortillas | salt | lime marmalade
instructions: Place mushrooms, salsa, coffee, tamarind paste, and thyme in a bowl, and mix well. Scoop ¼ cup mushroom mixture into center of tortilla, and spread out in an even layer. Fold each side over stuffing. Brush top side of taco with lime marmalade, and sprinkle with salt. Serve with lime marmalade and recipe #387327 for an extra kick.

title: Spicy Dipping Sauce for Spring Rolls, Fruit, Fish And Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 12 pitted prunes, halves about 3/4 cup | 1/2 cup chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place prunes in a bowl, drizzle with chili garlic sauce. Sprinkle with salt. Place in oven for 20 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: G Lychee & Lychee
ingredients: 300 g lychees, washed, picked through, and cut into pieces, about 3/4 cup total | 1 teaspoon baking soda or 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Put the lychee pieces in a bowl and pour boiling water over. Stir until all the water has dissolved, then leave to cool. This should take about an hour. Drain, then mix the remaining ingredients. Pour the mixture into sterlised jars, leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Cover. Refrigerate for 2 weeks or indefinitely.

title: Baked Farfalle With Caramelized Garlic and Oil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/2 lb farfalle pasta ( bow tie or other short pasta )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°. Place the oil in a 2 quart rectangular baking dish or large casserole dish, add the pasta, stir to coat, and let it sit at room temperature for about 10 minutes. Then, stir well again, and then continue with the remaining 1/2 cup of oil that the pasta will absorb. Sprinkle the garlic and salt and pepper over the top right before putting the dish in the oven. Bake, uncovered, for 30 to 45 minutes or until the pasta has cooked all the way through and is no longer crisp and bubbly.

title: Sunflower Chips
ingredients: 1 cup sunflower seeds | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato ( sliced paper thin ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon summer savory ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato juice ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spread the sunflower seeds and sun dried tomato on a baking pan spread out the sunflower seeds. Sprinkle chopped sun dried tomatoes and savory. Top the suned tomatoes with optional summer savory, if using. Pour tomato and sun dried tomato juice over the chips. Put the baking pan on the back of the stove on medium heat, add a little olive oil and continue cooking for another 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pancetta,red wine vinegar,garlic,chestnut mushroom,green bell pepper,phyllo dough,monterey jack pepper cheese,apple cider
title: Mushroom Filled Phyllo Rollatini
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo dough | 12 ounces pancetta, finely chopped | 8 ounces chestnut mushrooms, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon minced garlic or 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1/8 cup green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup apple cider or 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, grated
instructions: Heat some olive oil until smoking. Add pancetta and fry until crispy. Add chestnut mushrooms and vinegar, cook until liquid evaporates. Add garlic and bell pepper and mix. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Place 2 sheets of phyllo dough on the sheet, brush generously with oil. Spoon about 3 teaspoons of filling into the center of the phyllo, fold phyllo dough over filling. Top with the remaining 4 sheets of phyllo dough, cover and place in a baking sheet with parchment paper between steps 2 and 3, to keep from drying out. Continue until all of the phyllo rolls are used, placing 2 sheets of filling in the center of each roll and brushing with oil. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake in a preheated 350 oven until the cheese mixture slightly browns, about 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,coriander,ginger powder,red currant,saffron,brown sugar,golden syrup,goat cheese
title: Pistachio Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups wheat flour | 2 cups brown sugar | 1 cup chopped coriander | 500 g goat cheese | 1/2 cup red currants or 1/2 cup black currants | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 pinch saffron | 1 tablespoon ginger powder
instructions: Mix above ingredients together in a bowl and roll out into a circle and bake. Serve with raisin sauce or with jam, cream or ice cream.

title: Hot Rotisserie Pork Strips
ingredients: 2 cans rotisserie-cooked pork strips | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon red curry paste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the rotisserie strips, baking powder, and curry paste into a resealable plastic bag. Shake to coat the strips evenly. Place on a wire rack and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Shake off excess flour or excess air.

title: Kidney Bean Sausage and Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes | 20 ounces kidney beans | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 8 ounces smoked kielbasa or 8 ounces smoked hickory-smoked sausage, halved ( 12 ) | 1/3 cup grapefruit juice | 1/3 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup snipped fresh chives or 1/4 cup green onion top
instructions: If using hickory smokey sausage, brown sausage in a small skillet placed over medium high heat. Turn often so as not to burn or stick to skillet. Pour off drippings and discard. Add kidney beans and thyme to the skillet and warm through. Meanwhile, peel potatoes if necessary. Add potatoes, grapefruit juice and kielbasa to skillet and simmer 5 minutes. Combine bread crumbs and chives in a bowl and sprinkle mixture into the pot. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is smooth and thickened. Serve hot with beans, if desired.

Random Ingredients: dark rye flour,kaffir lime leaf,chive,corn flake,garlic powder,shallot
title: Crispy Corn Fritters With Caramelised Shallots
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups dark rye flour, sifted after measuring | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 12 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 1/4 - 3 1/2 cups finely chopped shallots | 1 -2 kaffir lime leaf, finely cut in half | chopped fresh chives, for garnish
instructions: Grease a shallow ovenproof pot with butter. Sift together the flour and garlic, then stir in the butter, a third at a time, until it has the consistency of coarse crumbs. If it is crumbly, add a few tablespoons of water and mix to a firm dough. Roll the dough lightly with floured hands to remove lumps and any large lumps. If it is too dry, gradually sprinkle with a little flour. Roll the fritter into a cylinder about 10 x 1¼ inches long. With a sharp knife, cut the cylinder into 6 wedges. Arrange on a plate, sprinkled with chives, and chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Variation, to make your own caramelised shallots, preheat oven to 400°f. Arrange the wedges in a single layer on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes. Allow to cool. Using a sharp knife, cut the wedges into 4 wedges, removing any damaged sections. Using a slotted spoon, transfer them to a baking dish lined with parchment paper, or grease a baking tray with butter. Repeat with remaining wedges. Variation, for a crispier, more chewy finished dish, use 4 or 5 large cooked shallots and caramelise them in the same way. This will make the same quantity of fritters. Variation, lightly butter or oil an 8 round springform cake tin. Place the wedge pieces on the tray, pressing firmly into the centre and all around the sides. Bake for 25 minutes. Reduce heat to 350°f, then bake 25 or 30 minutes longer to brown all sides. Turn off oven and allow to cool slightly before inverting onto a serving plate. Variation, to make caramelised shallots, heat half a cup of caramelised shallots in a small pot of cold water, stirring frequently, until they are soft and translucent. Cook until they are a dark golden colour. Stir in the remaining caramelised shallots and continue to cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently and adding water if the mixture becomes too thick. Remove the pot from the heat, remove the lemon pieces and discard. Transfer the fritters to a serving plate and leave until the caramelised shallots have set.

title: Prosciutto Ham With Yogurt
ingredients: 12 slices prosciutto | 1 tablespoon mascarpone cheese | 2 teaspoons yogurt | 1 fresh thyme sprig | 12 slices fully cooked ham
instructions: Place prosciutto slices in a skillet, and drizzle with 1 tablespoon of mascarpone cheese. Sprinkle with thyme and remaining tablespoon of mascarpone cheese, and cook for approximately 2 minutes, or until cheese is nicely browned. Place ham slices onto a serving plate, and spoon yogurt over all. Serve immediately.

title: Yogurt and Pomegranate Jam
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste | 1 pomegranate, seeded and diced ( can also use other fruit )
instructions: Rinse and drain the tomato paste and pomegranate. Set aside. Heat the tomato paste, pomegranate and water in a pot to a boil. Reduce heat to low and continue cooking 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Cool for 5 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste mixture. Reheat and serve warm.

title: Bok Choy (Pickled Minted Bokchoy)
ingredients: 4 heads bok choy | 1/2 teaspoon peppermint extract
instructions: Wash and trim the leaves of the bokchoy, then cut them crosswise into 1/2 inch wide slices. Cut off the stem and discard. Cut the slices crosswise into 1/2 inch wide slices. Put the bokchoy slices in a glass jar with a tight fitting lid or other container that will hold the leaves. Sprinkle lightly with peppermint extract. Seal or tie with a string. Place the jar on a table and allow the flavours to mingle for 12 hours to let the leaves soak into the leaves. Serve with cold slices of bread, noodles, rice, or as a garnish.

title: Rice and Wedge Nuts - Wedge (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1 )
ingredients: 1 cup finely diced suet | 250 g sliced radicchio | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons rice wine | chili powder, for sprinkling
instructions: Mix the suet, radicchio, fajita seasoning and rice wine together in a large bowl. Spoon the mixture into a tray lined with tin foil, and place directly on the heat of the grill.

title: Tostada
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes with jalapeno | 1 can red kidney beans
instructions: Drain the water from the can of rotel to make a thicker product. Dump the rotel tomatoes inside a large frying pan. Dump the drained beans and about 1/2 teaspoon of chile powder into a bowl and stir with a fork just to blend. Add the rest of the chile powder to taste, and pour a little bit of it into a small bowl to use as a side for topping. Place pita chips on a serving platter with a small amount of cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,millet,pumpkin pie spice,jalapeno pepper,parmesan cheese,icing sugar
title: Creamy Pumpkin and Jalapeno Filling
ingredients: 1 packet millet | 1 1/2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon finely chopped jalapeno pepper | 4 ounces freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Pumpkin pie spice, mix the millet in a bowl and stir over a pan of boiling water. Leave aside for 1 minute. Add the icing sugar, ginger, chili and parmesan cheese and mix well. If you have a blender, fill with milk and blend until smooth and creamy. When serving warm, add spoonfuls to a pastry bag and freeze for up to three months.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,mustard powder,broccoli,water artichoke heart,dark brown sugar
title: Sukiyaki Noodle Side Dish
ingredients: 1 package ramen noodles | 1 cup broccoli, sliced | 1 can water-packed artichoke hearts, drained | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange ramen noodles in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes, then remove to a paper towel lined plate. Place remaining ingredients in a mixing bowl and stir well. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ramen noodles and cook for 2 minutes or until tender. Drain well and transfer to a serving dish. Serve over hot cooked noodles.

title: Tocino (Brazilian Bread)
ingredients: 1 lb bread, unshelled | dough, as needed
instructions: Cut the bread almost in half horizontally, making sure there are no pockets. Cut each half into sixths. Insert bread into a bowl. Cover with water. Soak for twenty minutes. Drain. Pour into a bowl. Using your hands, roll bread into strands, or use paper towels to dry. Transfer to a bowl, and add water to cover. Allow to sit for ten minutes, then rinse with cold water. Squeeze to remove excess moisture, and store in refrigerator. Drain well before using. Makes about six servings.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,beef stew meat,tomato sauce,phyllo pastry,tabasco sauce,coconut milk
title: Coconut Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef stew meat ( about 1/2-inch thick ) | 4 sheets phyllo pastry | 15 ounces coconut milk | 15 ounces tomato sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom | tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut beef in half lengthwise, if it is large cut to fit a 2 lb bag of beef. Add 1/2 cup can of coconut milk, 1/2 t. Of tomato sauce and 1/8 t. Of cardamom. Bring to boil, reduce to simmer. If it is too liquid add water. Add 2 t. Of tabasco sauce. Simmer covered on low 10 - 15 minutes or until beef is tender. If water boils out add a little more. Add 1/2 cup of water. Brush a baking sheet with oil. Layer the 7 rolls on the sheet in whatever kind of order you want to use, starting with 4 sheets of phyllo dough. Brush with oil. Repeat process with remaining phyllo and beef. Cut into 5 squares. Bake at 350 until phyllo looks golden brown, about 20 - 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,japanese soy sauce,active yeast,chicken stock,beet,dark chocolate
title: Chinese Pickled Beetroot
ingredients: 1 lb beet | 2 tablespoons italian dressing | 2 tablespoons japanese soy sauce | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 12 ounces dark chocolate, cut into small pieces
instructions: Scrub the beetroot well, cut off and discard the tops, leave the beetroot in whole stalks and chop roughly if desired. Scald the broth for about 10 minutes, then drain. Heat the broth on the stove until boiling, then add the beetroot and stir in salt, if desired. Leave for 2 minutes, then remove and leave to cool.
