Remove the beetroot stems and any leaves, then chop into large cubes and toss with dressing. Cover and chill for about 4 hours. For the dark chocolate filling, melt chocolate in a bowl on the stove for about 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally. Let cool. Place the chopped beets into a saucepan with the remaining dressing and chicken stock. Bring to a boil, and simmer for a few minutes until the liquid is reduced. Sprinkle the yeast over the chocolate and stir to dissolve the yeast and let stand 5 minutes. Strain the beetroot and add to the chocolate and stir to combine. Heat for 1 more minute and serve.

title: Applesauce Pate
ingredients: 3/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1/4 cup dried parsley, chopped | 1/2 serrano pepper, finely chopped ( or 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper ) | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese or 1/2 cup grated smoked paprika | 4 teaspoons unsalted dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Combine applesauce, parsley, pepper and cheese. Whisk in peanuts. Chill for several hours.

Random Ingredients: cabernet sauvignon wine,kalamata olive,pear,cream chicken soup,green lentil
title: Lentil and Pear Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup french-fried pears ( in a pinch ) | 1/4 cup green lentil, rinsed and drained | 2 cups cabernet sauvignon wine | 1/4 cup pimento-stuffed olives, halved | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, chopped
instructions: Stir soup and french fries in a saucepan until hot. Stir pears and lentils, wine and olives into soup, heat through. Garnish with olives.

title: Southern Shredded Green Bean
ingredients: 1 package frozen cut green beans | 1 bag shredded french style bread | 1 jar pickle juice, or to taste | 1 cup beer | 1 jar chopped pimiento, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place frozen green beams in a large baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes. Remove from oven, and set aside. Place the bread, pickle juice, and beer in a large glass bowl, and mix until well blended. Stir in pimentos, and place the green beams back in the hot baking dish. Cover, and cook in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: The World's Best  Israeli Almonds
ingredients: 2 cups raw almonds, toasted | 1/2 cup sunflower oil
instructions: You should put the almonds in a large bowl and pour boiling water over them so they are all wet. Let the almonds soak for 30 minutes, then drain them. Mash the almonds with a fork, adding the oil, 1 tablespoons at a time, mixing well after each addition. Spread them onto a greased baking sheet to dry at least 3 hours.

title: Bethma's "Parmesan" Meat Marinara
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stock ( or use 3 cups homemade stock cubes ) | 4 tablespoons parmesan cheese ( or substitute pecorino if you want )
instructions: Pour the stock into a large pot. Place stock over medium high heat just enough to cover meat. Simmer until meat is completely cooked. When meat is tender, remove from the heat and use the fat to pour the meat juices. Add parmesan or asiago cheese and marinate meat for at least 3 hours before cooking. The sauce will start to thicken as it simmers so plan in a bowl or in a covered bowl while eating. When the meat falls apart keep the meat in the pot to reheat the sauce.

title: Crock-Pot Mango Powder
ingredients: 1 large mango | 2/3 chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 teaspoon sugar cube
instructions: Slice the mango in half through the pit and carefully remove the pit. Place it in the crock pot. Put the mangoes in the crock pot. Sprinkle the bouillon over the mango pieces. Add enough water to the pan to cover. Stir the sugar cube into the water. Cover and set on low heat. Let simmer for 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: cream corn,green chili pepper,beef stew meat,jalapeno chile,yoghurt,tapioca
title: Beef Taco With Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 can cream-style corn | 0.5 can jalapeno chiles | 1/4 cup chopped green chili pepper | 1/2 cup yoghurt | 1 cup frozen corn
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Cut beef in 3rds. Throw away any fat. In a 3 quart casserole dish combine beef, corn, chile, green chili and yoghurt. Cover and bake in preheated oven for about 45 minutes or until meat is no longer pink.

title: Mexican Okra
ingredients: 2 pounds okra, chopped | 1 can chopped green chile pepper
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Place a pot of water over high heat, and bring to a boil. Cover, and steam until the okra is tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 15 minutes. Drain, and set aside to cool. Place the chopped okra in a large bowl, and mash with an electric mixer. Stir in the green chile pepper, and mix until the green pepper is finely chopped. Add more green chile pepper if desired.

title: Gochujang Soup
ingredients: 1 fresh baguette | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | fresh goatchujang ( can be found at asian markets ) | nam pla ( can be found at asian markets ) or red pepper flakes ( can be found at asian markets )
instructions: Slice baguette 1/8 to 1/4 inch thick as if you were slicing a baguette. Place 2 tablespoons each of heavy cream and nam pla into a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over moderate high heat. Reduce the heat and simmer until the cream reduces slightly. Pour into a bowl to cool. Slice baguette into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange slices on individual salad plates and spoon the warmed nnam pla or hot red pepper flakes into the center. Serve hot.

title: Baja Salad
ingredients: 4 cups iceberg lettuce, coarsely shredded | 1 small head green cabbage, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 21 ounces cheddar cheese, cubed
instructions: Mix up cabbage and adobo seasoning and mix well. Warm salad with cheddar cheese just before serving.

title: Easy Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings | ice cube
instructions: Put all in blender. Blend until the wings are nice and smooth. Put in air tight container.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,watermelon,corn kernel,farfalle pasta,cumin powder,anise seed,fenugreek leaf,beet
title: Beet & Broad Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 can sliced beet, drained | 1 can kidney beans, drained with liquid reserved | 1 cup watermelon, cubed | 4 beets, peeled, sliced | 1/2 cup fenugreek leaves | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons anise seeds | 400 g farfalle pasta
instructions: In a large pot large enough for all ingredients, combine drained beet slices with beans with reserve liquid and liquid reserved. Add fenugreek leaves, cumin, and anise seeds. Bring to a boil. Stirring occasionally, boil for 15 minutes. Meanwhile in a pot of salted boiling water, cook pasta until al dente. Drain pasta, reserving 3/4 cup pasta water. Add pasta to beet mixture and stir until pasta is coated in a little of the spice mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Hot and Spicy Indian Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb unsalted baby goat's milk paneer ( or other sweet cheese ) | 1 small yellow onion, chopped fine ( i prefer sweet onions ) | 4 teaspoons hot green curry paste ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons coarse grain mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Use an ungreased 2 1/2 or 3 - 3 qt casserole dish or heavy bottomed kettle. For the cheese, put the cheese and onion in a mixing bowl, and spread each layer with the curry paste. Sprinkle with mustard. Bake until golden brown, about 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,anise seed,philadelphia cream cheese,cod fish fillet,red chilies,honey,brown sugar
title: Cod With Creamy Honey Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon anise seed, crushed | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 pint philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1/4 - 1/2 cup brown sugar | 2 red chilies, seeded and finely chopped, seeds and ribs removed | 1 1/2 cups cod fish fillets, cubed
instructions: Place honey, aniseed boullion and cream cheese into a food processor. Process until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a casserole dish. Add brown sugar, red chilies, and cod until coated with the sauce. Cover and bake at 350 until heated through. Serve over noodles of your choice.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,cream,cheddar cheese,rice krispies,chili pepper flake
title: Krispies Oyster Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup light cream | 1/3 cup cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup chili pepper flakes | 1/8 cup seafood seasoning or 1/8 cup chili sauce | 2 cups rice krispies
instructions: Place cream, cheese, chili peppers and seafood seasoning in medium bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and shake til mixture is well mixed. Cover top of bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour. Unwrap plastic wrap. Place mixture in food processor and process just to blend. Remove bowl from refrigerator and stir in rice krispies. Serve with fresh vegetables or pita chips or crackers.

title: Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 cup corn oil or 1 cup salad oil | 3 1/2 lbs small sea scallops, cleaned
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve the yeast in the oil and beat in half of the scallops. Place the remaining scallops in a 3 pound metal tub or other deep skillet, add the scallops and toss to coat with the yeast. Cover loosely with another round piece of moist plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until double, about 45 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a skillet to medium high with a rack in it. When the pan is very hot but not smoking, add the remaining scallops and fry, turning only once, until dark golden brown and cooked through, about 3 - 5 minutes per side. Remove the scallops from the pan and serve warm.

title: Rice Salad With Beetroot And Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb beet, unpeeled, quartered to remove tough outer leaves | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 2 1/2 cups white rice, steamed and cooled | 6 tablespoons pine nuts | 2 teaspoons salt
instructions: In a large bowl, lightly pat the beetroot and salt into a single layer and cut the beetroot into 6 pieces. Arrange the beetroot, beets, and salt around the edge of the bowl. Sprinkle the rice on top. Serve.

title: Ancho Bark
ingredients: 7 cups golden raisins
instructions: Place the raisins in a large bowl and sprinkle some salt into the sugar, trying to coat it. Stir to coat the raisins evenly and place them in a large roasting pan. Fill in the roasting pan with just enough water to cover the raisins. Sprinkle on the dried chile powder and turn the rack into a cool oven. Heat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake for about 1 hour, stir, and cool completely. Once completely cooled, break off pieces of the bark and rub with fingers or a blunt knife to form a 1/2 inch bark. If the bark sticks in the mixture, break it off and roll it into long strips about 1 1/2 inches wide. Cool completely and cut into pieces as desired.

Random Ingredients: ice water,celery salt,lemon,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Moroccan Seasoning for Salmon
ingredients: 1/3 cup coarsely chopped celery salt | 2 1/2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 2 1/2 pinches lemon rind, grated | 2 cups ice water
instructions: Add celery salt, ras el hanout, and lemon rind in a large bowl. Make sure the salt is thoroughly mixed with the salt and celery salt. Add just enough ice water to the salt and celery salt until desired consistency is reached. Refrigerate for a few hours or up to a week. Serve in a glass with lots of crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,confectioner sugar,peanut,basmati rice,red onion,lettuce leaf,enchilada sauce
title: Enchilada Rice Bowls
ingredients: 4 cups prepared basmati rice | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/3 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 cup mild enchilada sauce, heated | 3/4 cup shredded lettuce leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil with seasoning packet in it. Rinse rice once with cold water, drain. Transfer it to a colander, rinse under cold water and drain again. Combine rice, confectioners' sugar, red onion, peanuts, garlic, and enchilada sauce in a large bowl and mix thoroughly. Add cooked rice to bowl and stir to combine. Cover bowl with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 45 minutes or overnight. Remove plastic wrap from bowl and fluff with a fork. Serve rice bowl mixture on a bed of lettuce garnished with red onion and chopped peanuts.

title: Beef and Dried Lentil Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, with bones | 1 can corned beef | 16 ounces dried split sof dal | 14 ounces chicken stock
instructions: Brown brisket in a large soup pot. Place corned beef in pot, stir. Add dal and stock and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 1 hour. Remove brisket and cut in 1/2 inch slices.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 cups salsa | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Combine salsa and parsley in a medium bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Persian Pistachios (Mushrooms on Toast)
ingredients: 2 cups dry breadcrumbs | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 cup buttermilk | pistachios or almonds, toasted
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together bread crumbs and bouillon cubes until evenly mixed. Spread mixture onto a large plate and dip the soaked nuts into the crumb mixture on top. Place onto a baking sheet and toast in a preheated 350 degree oven until they are lightly browned and crunchy, 2 to 3 hours. Serve hot and garnish with pistachios or almonds, if desired.

title: Penne With Sriracha and Cardamom Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb penne pasta | 2 -3 tablespoons sriracha garlic sauce | 1/2 lemon, zest of | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 1/2 tablespoons mirin or 1 1/2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce
instructions: Start the pasta boiling in a large pot of salted water. While waiting for the water to boil, heat the sriracha over medium heat with a drop of worcestershire sauce. When the water boils, add the lemon zest and cardamom. This will add moisture to your sauce. When the water reaches the boiling point, add your dry pasta and cook according to package directions. Reserving 1 cup of the cooking water, drain and toss with the sauce. Serve the rest of the sauce on the side. Serve the wine as a dipping sauce.

title: Easy Beef Baskets
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef round | 1 cup chopped fresh pear, well drained | 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained | 1 package miniature marshmallows | 3/4 cup frozen snow peas | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon, dissolved in | white pepper powder
instructions: In a skillet, add ground meat, onions and mushrooms and cook over medium heat until meat is browned. Add the pear juice, breaking up with a wooden spoon, water may be added if needed. Remove from heat. Add the m & marshmallows and stir until well coated. Stir in the snow peas and pepper powder. Spoon into 8 paper cone shape cups. Refrigerate until firm.

Random Ingredients: red snapper,dark red kidney bean,fish fillet,cheddar cheese soup
title: British Virgin Islands Stew
ingredients: 1 can dark red kidney beans, drained | 400 g minced fish fillets | 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup | 1 small red snapper
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and simmer until snapper flakes, about 10 - 15 minutes.

title: South African Pork With Onions
ingredients: 1 teaspoon curry paste, or more to taste | 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 red onions, thick slices
instructions: Mix curry paste with water to make a thin paste. Cut pork into 1/2 inch slices, and slice each slice crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Heat a grill pan over high heat and lightly oil the pan. Add pork and stir frequently until nicely coated with spice mixture, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving plate, and sprinkle onions.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,juniper berry,ricotta cheese,hot italian sausage
title: Hot Baked Cannelloni
ingredients: 10 lbs fresh ricotta cheese | 8 hot italian sausages ( see note ) | 3 ounces dried sweet italian sausage ( see note ) | 3 tablespoons juniper berries or 3 tablespoons fresh thyme, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°. Butter the insides of a large baking pan. Line the bottom of the pan with parchment paper and grease the parchment paper. Spread the ricotta in the pan and add the sausages. Sprinkle the juniper berries or thyme on the sausages. Cover the pan with foil. Bake about 45 minutes or until the ricotta has become a deep brown color. Let rest for 10 minutes. Strain the liquid. Cut the sausage into 1/2 inch pieces and add to the oven. Bake about 15 minutes longer or until the italian sausage is well browned.

title: Cousin Pete's Chili Con Piselli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 bunch fresh cilantro stems, stems reserved | 1 pound cubed lamb | 1 pound parsnips, peeled and cubed | 1 pound blanched almonds, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh marjoram | 1 pound penne pasta | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Combine tomato paste and 1 bunch cilantro stems in a bowl and coat meat lightly. Heat a large pot of water to boiling. Add lamb and parsnips and return to a boil. Cook for about 10 minutes, remove and stir in marjoram, reserving marjoram, 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro stems and almonds. Cook until lamb is tender. Drain liquid from meat into a saucepan. Add cooked pasta and remaining 1/2 bunch cilantro stems. Simmer over medium heat until pasta is al dente, about 10 minutes. Serve with reserved marjoram marjoram adjitos.

title: Pizza Bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2/3 - 3/4 cup red wine | 1/4 cup oil | 1 tablespoon marjoram ( dry )
instructions: Add all ingredients to your breadmaker in the order recommended by your aboul. Set on bread maker then press and wait for the dough to rest then turn out onto a cookie sheet and score into desired shapes.

title: Bean Sprout Casserole (Tater Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups mixed bean sprouts, rinsed and drained | 8 ounces fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 bunch celery, diced finely ( about a 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 large onion, diced finely ( about 1 cup ) | 6 tablespoons taco seasoning, divided ( lawry's or taco seasoning mix ) | 1/2 cup double cream | fresh thyme
instructions: Line a 9 x 5 or oval loaf pan with parchment paper. In a bowl, combine the chopped bean sprouts, bread crumbs, celery, and onion. Add about half of the taco seasoning. Mix lightly. In a separate bowl, fold the cream until stiff. Fold the cream mixture into the bean sprout mixture. Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish. Cover loosely with foil and refrigerate, until the meat and vegetables are done. Before serving, remove casserole from the refrigerator and cut a slit in the top layer of the casserole. Brush with egg wash or melted butter. Sprinkle the top with thyme. Return to the refrigerator until ready to serve for 15 minutes or so. You may serve this with mexican style corn bread, rice or beans, or you may serve it with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkling of chopped fresh cilantro. Serves 2 to 7 as this dish is best made by good chefs like my big sister, chef lou boletalla.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,arugula,couscous,parmesan cheese,coconut cream,beef sirloin,ranch dressing,farfalle pasta
title: Beef, Couscous and Boursin
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 16 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 1/2 cup yogurt | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1 cup couscous ( low carb ) | 1/4 cup light coconut cream ( can be fat free ) | 1 cup arugula or 1 cup spinach | 1 1/2 tablespoons ranch dressing or 1 1/2 tablespoons vegan ranch dressing
instructions: Start water boiling for the pasta. In a medium skillet heat oil over med high heat. Add beef cubes and saute for 3 minutes until no longer pink. Turn crockpot to high and add the couscous. Quickly stir to coat. When the water starts to boil, add the bowtie and stir. Reduce the heat to low, cover and cook for about 5 minutes until water is absorbed and pasta is tender. Drain pasta and return to cooking pot. Add yogurt and continue cooking the mixture until all the liquid is absorbed. Turn off stove. Add the parmesan and stir until melted. Add cooked beef and stir to combine it with the noodles, serve over hot noodles.

title: Sweet and Savory Ham Biscotti
ingredients: 1 lb thinly-sliced ham | 3 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large skillet, cook the ham over medium high heat until brown, 5 to 7 minutes. Add the splenda, stir to mix, and transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stir and bake for 12 minutes, or until edges begin to come away from the pan. Let cool slightly and slice diagonally into 1/2 inch slices. Toast slices in a hot oven. Variation, stir 3 tablespoons dry instant coffee with 1 teaspoon baking soda to help crisp the biscotti.

title: Ground Beef
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 cans beef consomme
instructions: Brown hamburger, add mustard and consomme. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Crock Pot Hungarian Goulash
ingredients: 1 kg chuck ( chuck or other tender meat, cut in 1 cm cubes ) | 1 small red capsicum ( bell pepper, roasted red onion, dried roasted red chilies and dried roasted red chilies )
instructions: Rub the meat with the paprika, put it into the crockpot. Add the sliced peppers on top. Cook on high for 3 - 4 hours or low for 5 - 6 hours. Serve with a salad, noodles or mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: ancho chilies,kielbasa,beef bouillon powder,crab,head iceberg lettuce,cashew
title: Seafood in Cabbage and Sausage
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon powder | 3 ancho chilies | 1 pound kielbasa | 3/4 cup finely chopped cashews | 2 packages imitation crab pieces, thawed and drained
instructions: Toss lettuce with bouillon powder in a large mixing bowl. Slice kielbasa links into 1/2 inch slices. Place cashews in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place kielbasa slices in a single layer in the baking dish. Sprinkle cashews over kielbasa. Top with lettuce mixture with imitation crabmeat. Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees f. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red chile,pickle,tomato soup,banana pudding mix,seasoning salt,green grape,quinoa,chicken stock cube
title: Chicken and Vegetable Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quinoa | 2 cups chicken stock cubes | 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup chopped pickle | 1 small dried red chile | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 pinch ground red chile | 1 package banana pudding mix, frozen, thawed and well chilled
instructions: Place the quinoa in a large serving bowl, pour the stock over it and set aside, covered. In another bowl, combine the soup and seasonings and whisk or beat with a rotary beater or electric beater until smooth. Mix in the chiles. Pour the soup into the quinoa, stirring to combine. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to three hours. Serve chilled, over hot cooked rice or with a light salad of your choice.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,chili,parmesan cheese,orange bell pepper,cherry,fruit,extra virgin olive oil
title: Hot Citrus Salad
ingredients: 2 oranges bell peppers | 12 cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup fresh fruit | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the bell peppers on the rack 6 inches from the heat. Broil, turning occasionally for 15 minutes, or until blackened and blistered. Peel, core and cut into 1/2 inch strips. Combine bell peppers, cherry tomatoes, cheese, fruit, tabasco sauce, and chili. Let stand 30 minutes before serving. Stir olive oil into salad.

title: Quesadillas III
ingredients: 2 -4 tablespoons taco-size flour tortillas | 1 package cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large skillet over medium heat combine the grated cheese and taco sized flour tortillas, spreading them out in a circle. Cook tortilla until brown and crisp. Transfer the toaster and sprinkle the cheese on top of the tortillas. Spread a little cheese on top of the cheese, also to make the cheese melt.

title: The Russian Tea Bread
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soy milk | 2 tablespoons dried sauerkraut ( i recommend dona maria brand ) | 1 tablespoon hot water ( more or less to taste ) | 8 teaspoons hot tea ( any kind, i recommend everclear ) | 4 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, divided ( i recommend kraft brand ) | 6 plain soymilk | 1 jar cherry pie filling
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Stir together soy milk, sauerkraut, hot water and hot tea. Cover and refrigerate until needed. In a large bowl, combine 2 cups of the mozzarella cheese and 1/2 of the soy milk mixture, and mix well. Unwrap dough and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Use 2 forks to press and stretch dough onto baking sheet in a 5x4 inch rectangle. Spread about 2 tblsp. Of the liquid into the center of the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border along the sides. Starting on the long side, roll up dough, and place seam side down on baking sheet. Repeat process until dough is complete. Spread remainder of the shredded cheese on top of rolled dough. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and crust is golden brown. Allow to cool, then cut into 10 slices. Serve with ketchup/sauce.

Random Ingredients: basil,red chili pepper,red chilies,italian flat leaf parsley,peanut butter,tahini
title: Peanut Butter-Herb Dip
ingredients: 8 tablespoons unsalted peanut butter, preferably natural | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 small hot red chilies or 1 small green chili pepper | 1 large red chili pepper, finely chopped ( with seeds ) | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh basil, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons italian flat leaf parsley, finely chopped ( for garnish )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a food processor with the exception of the parsley or basil. Blend until smooth. To thin/strive mixture, i use a little olive oil or coconut oil. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,chicken broth,ranch bean,pecorino romano cheese,great northern bean,anchovy,walnut
title: White Beans With Cappuccino & Pecorino Romano
ingredients: 1 lb great northern beans or 1 lb pink beans, split in half | 8 -10 ounces canned poblano-stuffed anchovies | 8 ounces jalapenos, canned | 8 ounces pacific roasted walnuts | salt and pepper | 1 cup chicken broth ( optional ) | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile, put the beans and anchovies in the boiling water. Remove from the heat when they have come to a full boil and drain. Add the jalapenos and walnuts to the beans and set aside. Heat the broth, stirring occasionally and add it in slowly to the beans. Drain the beans. Place back on the stove and simmer for about 5 to 10 minutes adding the cheese a little at a time if the mixture seems dry add more broth. When the beans are hot you can stir. Note, i always throw in some fresh cilantro, and the anchovies.

Random Ingredients: green grape,tomato puree,cardamom pod,ancho chile powder,sesame seed,seasoning salt,chicken wing,beet
title: Chili Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 4 tablespoons chopped canned beets | 4 tablespoons canned canned tomato puree | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon achi chile powder | 4 tablespoons seasoning salt | 4 chicken wings, separated at joint, tips discarded
instructions: Toast the sesame seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat until they turn a golden brown. Combine the beets, tomato puree, cardamom pod, achi chile powder, seasoned salt and 2 tablespoons water in a blender or food processor, process until smooth. Add more water if necessary to make a thick sauce. Spread the sesame seeds over a shallow pan. Add the chicken wings and remaining water to cover. Cover the saucepan and cook over low heat until the chicken wings are tender, about 20 minutes. Baste with sauce every 5 to 10 minutes while cooking.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,yellow bell pepper,lemon,baking chocolate,boboli pizza crust,fish,turkey,blueberry
title: Chiles Rellenos for Two
ingredients: 20 slices turkey | 10 slices orange slices from can | 8 slices yellow bell peppers | 6 teaspoons fish, sauce | 4 tablespoons blueberries | 1/2 cup orange juice | 3 ounces baking slivered fresh biscoli pizza crust
instructions: Bake pizza crust according to package directions. Remove crust from oven and slice turkey into eight 3/4 inch square slices. Place one slice of turkey and one slice of orange on each bread slice, leaving a 1/2 inch border of dough around the turkey. Spoon the fish sauce over the turkey slices and arrange the bell peppers around the peppers. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until hot. To serve, cut each pepper half diagonally into 2 slices. Spoon orange juice evenly over the peppers. Sprinkle with blueberries. Serve immediately.

title: Simple and Quick Salmon Ceviche
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg bonne salmon, cut into chunks | 1 jar baby spinach leaves, drained | 1 bunch baby spinach | 1 small red chillies or 1 small green chili, crushed
instructions: Put everything into a large non metal bowl cover and set in the fridge overnight. The next day, remove the salmon from the fridge, sprinkle with extra salt, serve with the chilled spinach leaves and a drizzle of sweet chili vinegar.

title: Italian Scallion and Honey Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup scallion, finely chopped | 1 2/3 cups fresh soft breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons light honey | 1/2 cup pasta sauce, favorite flavor ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons green onions, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine bread crumbs, scallions, bread crumbs, pepper sauce and honey. Drain pasta and mix in sauce if using. Refrigerate approximately 30 minutes. Garnish with green onions.

title: Cheese Taquitos
ingredients: 4 flour or corn tortillas | 2 egg yolks | 1 can crushed corn tortilla
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Grease the tortilla or frying pan with margarine, and place one tortilla on pan. Place 2 egg whites and 1 teaspoon of crushed tortilla on tortilla, and form into a triangle. Place taquitos on heated skillet, and fry until lightly browned. Remove from pan, cut in half, and roll into a cone.

Random Ingredients: yellow cake mix,pear,large shrimp,heavy whipping cream,pine nut,sauce
title: Pigs in a Blanket
ingredients: 18 large pears, peeled, halved and cored | 1 package yellow cake mix | 3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 20 small cooked large shrimp, peeled | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place pears in shallow baking dish. Pour hot sauce over. Let stand 10 minutes. Spray 24 jelly roll pans with cooking spray. Arrange pears on pans. Sprinkle with cake mix, then top with cream and shrimp. Sprinkle with pine nuts. Bake in preheated oven for 35 minutes or until the shrimp are pink and the bread is golden brown.

title: Shrimp Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 1/2 kg shrimp, shelled | 1 cup mesclun | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon szechwan pepper ( timur powder ) | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1 pinch hing | salt and pepper
instructions: Cut shrimp into 2 inch pieces. Steam shrimp pieces and marinate in soy sauce, timur powder, triple sec and hing over night. Arrange in a single layer on a plate and place in refrigerator. Mix shrimp and marinade together. Cook shrimp over stove on high heat and bring to boil. Cook until shrimp turns golden. This can take from 2 to 10 minutes. Serve with rice, salad, chinese dishes or soup base.

title: Steamed Oatmeal Salmon
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups steel cut oats | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 4 fillets salmon | 1 can pumpkin ( cut into cubes )
instructions: Heat the oat mix in a small pan on the stove and stir to combine. Heat until the mix thickens. Drain the fish and add half of the pumpkin to it with half of the ginger garlic paste. Spread evenly over both salmon fillets and pour remaining ginger and garlic into the mix. Set the pan aside for 10 minutes to steam the fish. To serve, serve the fish with steamed oat mixture.

title: Oops - a Rice Stuffing
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry instant couscous | 1/3 cup sweet relish | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 2 teaspoons dry rice wine
instructions: Put the couscous and sweet relish in a microwave safe bowl. Sprinkle in the remaining ingredients and mix until well combined. Microwave the stuffing on high power for 4 minutes. Remove from microwave and mix. Return stuffing to microwave until absorbed. Serve, stuffing or stuffing mixture.

title: Craisins Rice wine Vinegar
ingredients: 1/2 cup craisins | 3 tablespoons rice wine ( not sweetened rice wine )
instructions: Pour 1/2 c rice wine vinegar over craisins in a 2 cup glass measure. Add more vinegar if needed to cover all craisins. Stir and refrigerate until ready to use. Serve cold in a glass jar with a tight lid.

title: Chocolate Chantilly Quesadillas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cocoa | 6 whole wheat tortillas, lightly toasted on one side
instructions: Spread some chocolate over one half of one half of each tortilla. Place over it one tablespoon of cocoa and top with remaining tortilla, pressing down to make a sandwich. Cut into wedges.

title: Salt Free, Vegan, Dessert Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 4 tablespoons water
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl. Use immediately, or it gets too sweet or salty.

title: Saucy Fiesta Rotisserie Chicken
ingredients: 5 pounds rotisserie-cooked chicken pieces | cooking spray | 1 orange bell pepper
instructions: Prepare grill for high heat. Line a shallow baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange chicken pieces in the pan as many as will fit without crowding. Top with sliced orange bell pepper. Pour canned rotel over chicken and vegetables. Spray with cooking spray. Cook in the preheated grill for 5 to 8 minutes, or until chicken meat has begun to turn opaque. Turn chicken.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,sea salt,red wine,chicken breast,jalapeno pepper,plain yogurt,beef tenderloin
title: Grilled Chicken and Provolone Pizza
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef tenderloin | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 3/4 cup red wine, divided | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 2 tablespoons minced jalapeno peppers | 1 cup shredded fontina cheese, divided | 1 1/2 lbs thinly sliced deli-style franks or 1 1/2 lbs provolone cheese
instructions: With a meat mallet, pound the beef to 1/4 inch thickness. In a small bowl, combine yogurt, 1/4 cup red wine, salt and jalapeños. Spread each side of the beef with a thin layer of yogurt mixture. Evenly cover the beef with the feta/cheese slices. Place beef on a preheated grill.

Random Ingredients: pasta,yellow pepper,red wine vinegar,coconut milk,garlic lemon vinaigrette,nanami togarashi,champagne
title: Pasta With Champagne, Coconut and Red Pepper Salad With Citrus Dressing
ingredients: 500 g pasta ( short pasta shapes ) | 150 ml coconut milk | 2 teaspoons garlic and lemon vinaigrette ( see the recipe below ) | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 3 fresh oranges ( or 1 small ) yellow peppers ( or a mix of the same ) or 3 other long green peppers ( or a mix of the same ) | 400 g champagne ( or red, white or black ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons nanami togarashi
instructions: Boil a large pot of water. When its boiling, cook as before. Cook the pasta while it is boiling until it is cooked through. In the meantime, in a small saucepan, add the red wine vinegar and enough water to just cover the pasta. Bring to a boil. Stir the vinegar and water into the pasta until all of the pasta is covered in the vinegar solution. Cook it al dente as you would a salad.. Rinse the pasta in a colander with cold water, and drain. To serve, place a bowl of the chicagine pasta in the middle of a plate, top with some pasta, drizzle with some vinaigrette and some the chicagine. Add your choice of citrus salad.

title: Grilled Grilled Cheese With Burrata
ingredients: 4 slices flat bread | 4 slices provolone cheese | 1/2 cup burrata cheese | 2 garlic cloves, peeled
instructions: In a shallow dish or platter, toast bread on both sides for a few minutes. Turn over and heat other side. Spread with burrata. Cook in a skillet over medium heat for several minutes, stirring, until cheese has melted. Cut into quarters and remove to a serving platter.

title: Tortilla-Wrapped Sausage Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 italian turkey sausage | 1/2 package mexican blend cheese | 1 banana | 3 -4 -6 ice cubes
instructions: Preheat a large frying pan for 10 to 20 seconds. Add the sausages and cook over medium heat, breaking up the sausage to thicken slightly, about 8 minutes. Remove from the heat and slice the sausage into thick slices. Top each tortilla with the cheese and banana, placing 2 or 3 slices on each tortilla. Microwave on high until cheese is melted and tortillas are warmed, 15 to 20 seconds. Cut and serve.

title: Beans with Black Holes and Sea Salt
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed in a pan of boiling water | sea salt
instructions: Heat a pan of water. When it boils, add the black eyed peas and sea salt and reduce the heat. Drain the beans and let them soak for 20 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,garlic powder,ice water,black mushroom,gruyere cheese
title: Homemade Gruyère Cheese
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1/3 cup ice water | 15 fresh black mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and put in a large mixing bowl. Add the garlic powder, add the ice water and mushrooms. Mix well. Put in a warm place until the mushrooms are soft and the ice crystals melt. Add the cheese and mix. Place bread machine in order suggested by your bread machine manufacturer and make the dough. You may need to add a couple of tablespoons of water to the mixture of yeast and mushrooms during the first knead.. If it seems dry, add a tablespoon of flour, or a little of the water that the yeast was added to the bread bowl. Let the breadmachine run for dough cycle. After the dough cycle is complete, form it into a ball and place on a floured surface and knead for five minutes. Put the dough on a floured board and knead a few times. Place the dough on a floured board and place in a warm place for 45 minutes or until doubled in size. Roll out dough to a thickness of approximately 6. Cut a circle of parchment paper about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and place on a baking sheet. Poke small holes all over the top and place the baking sheet in the warm oven for about 10 to 15 minutes or until the top of the dough turns light brown at the edges of the pan. Remove from the oven, place on a cooling rack to cool. If the crust does not come out of the oven easily, repeat this process again for the remaining dough. The crust may be stored in the refrigerator for upto three months or freezer up to six months.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,horseradish,cheese,cinnamon sugar,poultry seasoning,kernel corn,snow pea pod
title: Apple Horseradish
ingredients: 2 teaspoons horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar | 1 1/4 cups cooked whole kernel corn | 1/2 cup frozen snow pea pods, thawed | 1 1/2 cups grated emmenthaler cheese | 1/4 cup pickled tart apple slices, drained
instructions: Combine horseradish, poultry seasoning, and cinnamon and sugar in a small bowl. Combine corn, peas, 1/2 cup cheese, and apples in a large baking dish. Top with horseradish mixture, sprinkle with remaining cheese. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving.

title: Quick and Easy Chickpeas Stew
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 small head cabbage, cored and chopped | 1 can chickpeas, undrained | 1 bunch green onion, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place cabbage in the bottom of the baking dish.

Random Ingredients: crescent dinner,cheddar cheese,black olive,olive,mozzarella cheese,dark rum
title: Stromboli
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, room temperature | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup black olives, sliced | 1 can sliced ripe olives | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons bacon drippings
instructions: Preheat oven, 375. Unroll dough on work surface. Separate into four rectangles. Roll each rectangle, as triangle to fit baking sheet. In large bowl, mix cheeses, olives and 2 tablespoons rum. Stir to blend. Roll up each rectangle jelly roll fashion, jellyroll style and place seam side down on baking sheet. Cut each crosswise into six pieces, then cross crosswise into half moon's. Brush tops with remaining rum or oil. Bake about 25 minutes or until golden, basting occasionally. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: coconut,italian seasoning,mace,beef cube,grapefruit juice concentrate,fennel seed,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Kathy's  Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef cubes | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated coconut | 1 1/2 tablespoons shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 1/2 cup grapefruit juice concentrate, thawed | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Cut cubes into 1 inch pieces. In medium mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except grapefruit juice concentrate, mace and mix well. Add grapefruit juice concentrate, reserving 2 tbs. Sauce mixture. Spread mixture over surface of meat. Cover with aluminum foil and place in refrigerator for 6 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Place 1/2 cup of meat mixture in center of round glass covered glass. Place in hot oven, bake for 5 minutes. Remove from oven.

title: Green Pepper Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces philadelphia cream cheese, room temperature | 1 small green pepper, diced
instructions: Combine cream cheese and pepper. Process until smooth. Cover and refrigerate for up to 3 days.

title: Gourmet Scotch Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 cup amaretto | 3 1/2 ml beef bouillon powder | 4 small scallops ( approx 1-6 oz. ) | 6 slices of good quality chocolate ( about 100x1/4-1/2 inches thick ) | 3 -4 dill sprigs | chili | 1 dash fresh dill sprig ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place a single layer of plastic wrap on a counter. Sprinkle 1/4 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon powder over scallops. Roll up each scallop jellyroll fashion. Sprinkle 1 1/2 tablespoons amaretto all over scallops. Wrap each scallop securely with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Remove scallops from refrigerator 10 minutes prior to making the cocktail. Prepare barbeque using a gas grill or charcoal grill rack. When ready to proceed, preheat oil to 300 degrees. Place the scallops in the prepared barbeque and brown on all sides, 3 - 4 minutes per side. Remove scallops from the grill. Reserve. Remove scallops from grill and keep warm. To serve, top each scallop with 1 - 2 dill sprigs and a touch of chili powder. Garnish with fresh dill.

title: Lazy Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Place the cream of mushrooms soup, thyme, and dill weed into a slow cooker. Cook on low for 4 to 5 hours, or on high for 2 hours. Serve warm and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,celery rib,turmeric,worcestershire sauce,fish fillet,bacon dripping
title: Bacon-Wrapped Fish
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs fish fillets, cut into 4 equal parts ( cod, sole, flounder, catfish, snapper, perch ) | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings or 2 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 2 celery ribs, thinly sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, blend the worcestershire sauce using the back of a spoon. Set the dry ingredients aside. Coat the fish fillets with the dry ingredients. Heat the bacon drippings in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the fish and cook until well browned, about three minutes per side. Transfer the fish to a platter, pour off the oil from the skillet and deglaze the pan with the vinegar. Toss the fillets with the vinegar dressing in the skillet. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,lime zest,mushroom soup,chicken breast half,cornflour,lamb chop,cocoa
title: Lamb Chop Casserole with Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 large leg lamb chops | 8 -12 ounces mushrooms | 1/2 cup red currant jelly | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 tablespoon grated lime zest | 2 tablespoons cornflour or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 8 -12 ounces condensed mushroom soup
instructions: Place lamb chops in a casserole dish. Place all remaining ingredients into a jug with 1/4 cup water and shake well. Pour the mixture over the lamb chops. Bake at c for 1 hours at 150 degrees in a preheated oven. Remove chops from the oven and serve with the dipping sauce. Enjoy.

title: Hot Chinese Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh white mushrooms | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar
instructions: Wash the mushrooms thoroughly and put aside. Wash them under running water to get rid of sand and sand particles. Cut off the stems if they are large and remove the strings. Do not cut away the stems. Slice the stems thinly. Put the mushrooms in a saucepan with just enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil and boil for about ten minutes, or until they are cooked. Then drain them and place on a serving platter. Make a simple syrup by boiling the sugar with the water until the sugar is dissolved and thick like syrup. Do not boil. Taste for flavor, add salt if needed. Spoon the warm syrup over each slice of mushroom.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,shoyu,vegetable protein,wonton wrapper,garam masala,ginger paste
title: Vegetarian Won Tons
ingredients: 20 wonton wrappers | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons shoyu or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/4 cup instant minced vegetables ( tvp, cellophane, wok, mushroom, etc. ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tofu or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground garam masala
instructions: Heat the wok on medium high. Add a little peanut oil.

title: Jicama, Cabbage, and Sweet Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 large head lettuce leaf | 1 jicama, halved and thinly sliced | 3 large sweet peppers or 3 large green bell peppers, cut into 1/4-inch wide strips ( 1/2-inch x 1/2-inch, or 1/2-inch squares ) | 2 cups merlot ( or dry white wine ) | 1/2 cup wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons baking soda | sliced jalapeno chiles
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and preheat oven to 300°f in a shallow baking pan, arrange romain on the rack.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,bean dip,picante sauce,almond extract,farfalle pasta,allspice,shortcrust pastry
title: Pasta Pies With Almonds-Spice Dip
ingredients: 7 ounces alfalle pasta | 1 cup bean dip | 1/2/3 cup picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaf | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 sheet frozen shortcrust pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line muffin tins with the pastry sheets.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,orange peel,garlic scape,vegetable oil,cumin powder
title: Moroccan Style Carne Cabbage
ingredients: 1 garlic scape ( use 2 whole cloves if they are not very long and make into 2 halves ) | 1/2 orange peel | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon cube ( or 1 tsp. crushed )
instructions: Remove all visible residue from the carrot. Coarsely chop the carrot with a sharp knife. Cut the peel or cut a square shaped piece of peel along the length of the head of the cabbage. Cut down on the stem at the center of the peel, then cut away the hard outer layer. The resulting carrot will produce somewhat of a cross grainy texture. If you slice it with a knife or scissors, you have to stop the slicing and leave it to drain off the flavor. Combine the olive oil, cumin, and bouillon and heat in a sauce pan.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,greek yogurt,yellow pea,caper,pineapple juice
title: Lazy Split Pea Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup ( i use low fat ) | 1 can pineapple tidbits in juice ( reserve juice ) | 1 cup yellow split peas, fresh and frozen | 1/3 cup capers ( reserve juice )
instructions: Strain contents of the can of cream of mushroom soup into a bowl. Add the reserved juice, drained peas, and drained capers and mix well. Transfer to a shallow buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Peachy Peaches
ingredients: 3 large peaches ( ripe if you can ) | 3 tablespoons sugar-free maple syrup
instructions: Peel peaches. Cut each in half and then into 1/2 inch slices. Cut into thick wedges. Heat sugar maple syrup in a small saucepan until it begins to boil. When it starts to boil, add peaches and return to a boil. Boil syrup for 5 minutes. Transfer peach mixture to serving platter. Serve immediately.

title: Frozen Onions
ingredients: 1 large vidalia onion ( approx. 8 ) | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 pint half-and-half cream
instructions: Using a very small soup pot, cover whole onion with water. Place over high heat and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer on low until the onions are very soft and the centers are easily pierced by a fork, about 1 hour. Drain and allow to cool slightly. Peel the onion and slice the tops off the onions, using a sharp knife. Cut off the root end if desired. Slice onions, being careful not to break the hard shell, and discard. Reserve the shells. Melt the butter in the soup pot, and saute the onions the onions over low heat until they are very soft, adding additional butter or margarine if required. Remove from heat, stir in half and half and heat through, about 5 minutes, but do not boil serve warm.

title: Chili Con Queso
ingredients: 4 cups tomato juice, chilled | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced thinly
instructions: Pour tomato juice into an electric blender with mushrooms and cremini mushrooms. Cover and blend until the mixture is fairly smooth. If you find the mixture thinner than you prefer, blend in a little cornstarch to get the right consistency.

Random Ingredients: parsley,sauce,tabasco sauce,chipotle pepper,ranch dressing mix,pine nut,tomato juice,daikon radish
title: Daikon Radish and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup onion, chopped | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes with juice, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 2 teaspoons ground dried chipotle peppers or 2 teaspoons minced canned chipotle peppers | 1 packet dry ranch dressing mix | 4 drops tabasco sauce, to taste | 1/2 cup dijon-style hot sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Place the onion in a salad bowl, and add sun dried tomatoes, parsley, chipotle pepper, salad dressing mix, tabasco, hot sauce and pine nuts.

title: Cold Cherry Tomato Jam
ingredients: 2 lbs cherry tomatoes | 3 cups white sugar
instructions: Wash tomatoes and cut them in half. In a large pot, boil the tomatoes over moderate heat until they have reduced and are soft enough to crush a a little with a spoon. Remove the tomatoes from the water when softened, drain and place them in a blender or food processor. Add sugar and liquefy. Add some water if necessary and process briefly. Pour through a fine sieve to remove all solids. Pour slowly through a fine sieve into a clean saucepan. Stir occasionally. Cover and boil rapidly until jam is reduced to a syrup consistency. Bottle in hot sterilized jars. When cool, store in a cool, dark place.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,canadian bacon,coffee liqueur,beef tenderloin
title: Beef Strips With Angel Hair Pasta
ingredients: 24 ounces beef tenderloin or 24 ounces sirloin steak | 2 slices canadian bacon | 1/8 cup coffee liqueur | 1 package angel hair pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package other long thin pasta
instructions: Cut meat in thin strips. Grill or broil meat until cooked to desired doneness. While meat is cooking, combine coffee liqueur and heat to boiling over medium heat. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, and return pasta to sauce. Add meat, bacon, and drippings. Toss well. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: baby potato,water chestnut,irish cream,oyster sauce,turkey breast,green pepper
title: Asian Beef and Potato Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 cans water chestnuts, sliced | 1 lb baby potatoes, washed, peeled and chopped | 1 lb lean ground turkey breast, left over browned | 1 green pepper, sliced into thin strips | 1/4 cup low-fat irish cream | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Drain the water chestnuts & drain all the liquid from the turkey. Wring out the excess moisture. Set all the ingredients in a large non stick wok or skillet. Stir fry for about 10 minutes or until the turkey and potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally. Garnish with the green pepper.

title: Roasted Blueberries With Safflower Oil
ingredients: 1 lb fresh blueberries | 1/2 lb superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons pure safflower oil | 7 tablespoons toasted peanuts, divided | 2 tablespoons fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 vanilla bean, split
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Place the blueberries on a large sheet pan and sprinkle with 1/2 lb. Sugar and toss with a fork until the sugar is almost all absorbed. Bake the berries for 20 minutes. Stir, cover, and bake until the berries are tender and the fruit is browned, about 1 hour or so. The berries will shrivelle and become difficult to stir while they roast. Remove from the oven. Rinse the pan clean, then shake off any excess sugar from the berries. Pour off most of the liquid and discard. Place all remaining 1/4 cup of peanuts, the basil, safflower oil, remaining 1 tablespoon of toasted peanuts, the cayenne pepper, and vanilla bean in a food processor and process until they form a smooth paste. The mixture should be thin and very coarse. Taste for seasoning. Spoon the mixture onto each plate and drizzle with some of the reserved syrup.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,white wine,chicken liver,canola oil,cabbage,orange zest,yukon gold potato
title: Kartoffel Potatoes
ingredients: 20 ounces chicken livers | 7 yukon gold potatoes | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1/4 bunch dill weed | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest
instructions: Clean the potatoes and cut them in half and then dice in half again. Set aside. Remove the livers from the stock and rinse them well if necessary. You need to use the technique of a hand mill to extract as much of the starch out of the potatoes as you can. Set them aside. You can use the method of a meat grinder or a potato masher if you prefer. In a sauce pan, on low medium heat put the oil, wine and dill. While the sauce is heating, put the livers and potatoes in a pan. Stir to get them all coated. Turn onto a plate and cut into bite size pieces. Set aside. Using a frying pan, heat the stock to boiling in a medium sauce pan. Throw the lobster and potatoes in and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes on medium heat. Do not stir anymore. The potatoes will have a deep orange color, which will make the sauce soggy. Stir once every 5 minutes. Turn down the heat to low to cook for an additional 15 - 20 minutes, stirring frequently. It's done when the potatoes are soft. Stir in the oranges and cabbage. Serve right away.

title: Soyster-Rific Grilled Salmon
ingredients: 4 skinless salmon fillets, with skin | 200 g oyster sauce | 3 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: To prepare the oyster sauce, heat the oyster sauce in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the sugar and cook until the sugar is dissolved. Remove from the heat and set the mixture aside to cool. Preheat the grill plate on the stove and heat to high. Brush the salmon fillets with oil and place one on top of the other. Remove from the grill and place on a baking tray with skin side up. Brush with the oyster sauce and grill until the skin is crispy and the fish is cooked to your liking, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Place the salmon on serving plates and top with sauce.

title: Cafe Liege Style Mousse
ingredients: 175 g bittersweet chocolate | 100 ml half-and-half cream | chili pepper flakes, to taste
instructions: Line a baking tray with greaseproof paper. Melt chocolate and half and half over boiling water just until barely melted and smooth. Stir through chilli pepper flakes. Pour into a clean plastic container and cover with plastic wrap. Leave to stand in a cool place for 2 hours or until hardened.

title: Cod Crunch (Gf)
ingredients: 800 g cod, skin removed if desired | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam | 1 teaspoon finely grated lime zest | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange peel | 1 tablespoon fresh chili, chopped | 1 cup bread crumbs | 1/3 cup shredded dried sweetened coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Place jam in a small shallow pan and stir in the zest, orange peel and chilli. Brush fish with a small amount of jam/zest mixture. Combine breadcrumbs, desiccated coconut and breadcrumbs in a bowl. Place 2 fillets in centre of a single layer on baking tray. Spoon coconut mixture on top of fish. Bake 10 minutes or until golden and cooked through.

title: Pate, Chilean Sea Scallops & Watermelon Salad for 2
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh bay scallops or 2 lbs sea scallops | 1 cup watermelon, diced small ( preferably a combination of the two ) or 1 cup other fresh melon, cubed small ( preferably a combination of the two ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt, plus more for seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | pate | basil leaves, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Bring the water to a boil over high heat in a large saucepan. Add the scallops and boil for 3 - 4 minutes, or until bright orange in color. Remove the scallops and set aside to cool. Place the cooled scallops in a large shallow plate or pie dish. Sprinkle lightly with salt, pepper, basil, cumin and pate. Cover the plate with plastic wrap or a lid and let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Remove the plastic wrap from the plate and serve garnished with a few basil leaves if desired.

title: Caribbean Avacodo "Chef John's"
ingredients: 500 g golden mushroom soup ( or vh ) | 1 canned pineapple, drained | 1 avocado | 3 tablespoons cognac ( optional ) | dilled dill sprigs | vodka
instructions: Cut the avocado in 1 cubes. Place it into a food processor with a pinch of salt and process until fine but not liquified. Add the mushroom soup and drained pineapple, and process again, until well blended. Gently fold in the cubed avocado. Spoon into 4 small glasses and add a dollop of vodka, and garnish with chopped fresh dill. Drink.

title: Quick and Easy Homemade Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 teaspoon seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro, optional
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Use within 1 - 2 teaspoons of your favorite taco seasoning mix for extra flavor.

title: Tart Applesauce
ingredients: 12 fresh tart apples | 1/2 bunch daikon radish | 375 ml double cream | 2 -3 tablespoons fish or 2 -3 tablespoons anchovies, finely chopped
instructions: Peel, core and shred the apples and daikon radish, or separate into rings if preferred. Place the shredded apples and the radish in a food processor to yield about a quarter cup of shredded apple and radish. Blend this mixture into a puree, adding any juices that have gathered. Whip the cream to soft peaks, then fold in the grated fish or anchovies. Spoon the apple puree into an ovenproof bowl, then pour this mixture over the apple puree. Heat the oven to 180c and leave to set overnight. Bring the applesauce to the boil and stir until it coats back of a glass spoon. Bake for 15 - 30 minutes, until set and golden. Remove from the oven and leave to cool. If not using immediately, leave to cool before using.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,veal cutlet,white vinegar,baby spinach,bay leaf,cheese,mozzarella cheese,cardamom
title: Filipino Veal Scaloppine
ingredients: 4 large veal cutlets | 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 piece walnut sized cheese ( optional ) | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 bags baby spinach | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon freshly ground cardamom | 1 -2 tablespoon dark chocolate, grated ( optional ) | 3/4 bay leaf, sliced thinly ( optional )
instructions: Lay cutlets on board. Cover with plastic wrap. Place in a cold oven. When oven is going to temperature, turn off burner and allow the cutlets to reach room temperature. Put 2 1/2 to 3 tblsps of olive oil in a 12in frying pan. Heat over medium high heat. When it is hot, add the cutlets. Let them cook without moving them until they turn very golden brown, about 5 to 7 minutes. Turning after 3 minutes. Turn once. It should only take about 5 minutes for each side. If needed, add a few shakes of cardamom during the last few minutes of cooking.. While the scaloppine is frying, rinse and dry the spinach. Break a large piece of waxed paper. Dip each scaloppine in the hot olive oil, then in the paper and allow excess oil to drain off. Place in refrigerator to keep warm.. When ready to serve, divide the shredded cheeses among four plates. Place spinach on a hot platter and top with the sauteed scaloppine. Garnish with the crispy walnuts, sliced chocolates or bay leaves. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,coriander seed,tomato basil pasta sauce,parmesan cheese,cashew,wonton wrapper
title: Cashew Ravioli With Basil
ingredients: 14 cashews, unsalted, chopped | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 20 wonton wrappers | 2 cups tomato basil pasta sauce | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese, preferably fresh
instructions: Toast cashews until fragrant in small skillet over low heat, about 5 minutes. Transfer cashews to bowl. Cool completely. Grind coriander, peppercorns, and cashews to fine consistency, then coarsely chop. Place a large saucepan with a tight fitting lid over medium low heat. Toast cashews until light brown, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes. Transfer cashews to blender. Add coriander mixture and blend until well combined. Set aside. Lightly film nonstick skillet with cooking oil. Add about a tablespoon of the cashew mixture to pan, then carefully spread in a circular motion a little beyond the skillet lid. When edges of ravioli are browned, turn over. Continue to cook ravioli, until golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer to a baking sheet with parchment paper on bottom of pan. Repeat with remaining cashews mixture and filling. To serve, place a few ravioli on a plate, then spoon 2 to 3 tablespoons of filling over center, breaking into 2 or 3 pieces. Divide remaining filling among ravioli.

title: Creamy Pomegranate Fruit Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix | 1 1/2 cups pomegranate juice | 1/4 cup oil, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Pour the cake mix into a large bowl. Pour pomegranate juice into a separate bowl.

title: Oysters With Italian Plum Tomatoes and Peanuts
ingredients: 4 large italian plum tomatoes, sliced thickly and seeded | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh italian plum tomatoes | 2 tablespoons dry red wine | 1 teaspoon seasoning ( mccormick montreal ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped orange rind | 1 tablespoon dry red wine | 1 tablespoon chopped orange rind ( optional )
instructions: Place cut sides of tomatoes, cut side up, on a baking sheet and toast in 400°f oven for 30 minutes or until tomatoes are soft. While tomatoes are toasting, combine plum tomatoes, 2 t. Salt and 1 t. Pepper in a bowl and combine. Place tomatoes, a few at a time, on a hot grill and cook until toasty brown all over, about 3 minutes on each side. Combine tomatoes and any juices in blender until just smooth. Stir in wine, orange rind and orange juice. Serve with tomatoes and nuts.

title: Caesar Ranch
ingredients: 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 cup caesar salad dressing
instructions: Mix mustard powder, paprika and salad dressing. Add desired amount of seasoning to mixture. Spread on your favorite burger bun or french bread. Can also use veggie bread that has been lightly toasted.

title: Rosemary Pecans and Pecans
ingredients: 1 cup pecan pieces | 1 1/2 cups extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Heat the oil, in a large skillet over moderate heat, stirring the pecan pieces with a wire whip until they begin to brown in a minute or two, about 2 minutes. Stir in the rosemary and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Drop in the pecan pieces, in 2 or 3 at a time, and cook until they are just beginning to stick to the sides of the skillet. Gently shake the skillet to loosen the pecan pieces as they cook. Transfer the pecan nuts to a paper towel lined plate, and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Let them rest at least 10 minutes. Transfer the nuts to a kitchen towel and pat the skins off with paper towels. Store the pecan nuts in a plastic bag in a cool, dry place, shaking the bag occasionally, at least 6 hours and up to 2 years before use.

title: Baked Mexican Corn
ingredients: 1/4 cup cornmeal | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together cornmeal and garlic powder. Pour the cornmeal mixture into a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until browned.

title: Smoked Shitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 shiitake mushrooms | cooking spray | 3 tablespoons rum
instructions: Place mushrooms on a baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Combine rum and mushrooms in a small bowl. Sprinkle mushrooms on top. Cover with plastic wrap. Bake in a preheated oven at 450 degrees farenheit to soften, about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Cherries on Ice
ingredients: 500 g yoghurt or 500 g greek yogurt | 1 kg fresh cherries
instructions: To make yoghurt yoghurt, place yoghurt or greek yoghurt in bowl and mix well with a spoon. Add cherries. Refrigerate until required. You can freeze this yoghurt and it tastes wonderful with a spoon too, but don't make it more than 3 or 4 times.

title: Greek Peanut Yogurt
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups plain greek yogurt | 1/2 cup roasted sweetened peanuts, chopped | 1/3 cup white wine
instructions: Stir the yogurt, peanuts, and wine together in a large bowl. Cover the bowl, and refrigerate for 1 hour to let the flavors develop.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,chilies,blue curacao,superfine sugar,pork roast
title: Blue Curacao Sweet & Savory Crock Pot Roast Pork
ingredients: 5 lbs pork roast | 7 ounces blue curacao, a sweet red | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 7 ounces chilies, canned ( see note ) | 4 ounces philadelphia cream cheese ( plain or cream cheese ), softened
instructions: If using a crock pot, place pork roast in crock pot and add remaining ingredients except cream cheese. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours. Remove meat and shred using two forks. Place meat back in crock pot and stir in cream cheese. Cook another hour, stirring often to avoid scorching. Serve immediately topped with your choice of condiments such as sour cream, guacamole, chive flowers or other dipping sauces you're up to choose. Notes, if using a crock pot, cook until meat thermometer reaches 165 degrees f on a meat thermometer, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,salsa,currant,self raising flour,molasses,tomato puree,cremini mushroom
title: Tomato Mushroom and Mushroom Scrolls
ingredients: 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, chopped | 1 ounce dried currants | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 7 ounces soya sauce | 9 ounces self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons molasses or 2 teaspoons treacle | 1 tablespoon salsa
instructions: Cook mushrooms and dried currants in boiling salted water for 2 minutes drain well. Beat in tomato puree, soya sauce, flour, molasses and enough cold water to make a soft dropping consistency. Roll mixture into balls. Dredge in salsa. Bake in a moderate oven, 350f for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sesame Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 kg spring onions, finely chopped ( white and most of the green ) | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds, roasted | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Mix the chopped spring onions, sesame seeds and parsley together. Serve with warm biscuits, pita wedges, chips, vegetables or cold cuts.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,cream mushroom soup,orange juice,cauliflower floret,poblano chile,cayenne,chicken wing,kalamata olive
title: Poblano Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, separated at joints ( tips frenched out ) | 2 packages poblano chiles | 12 kalamata olives | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup orange juice | 1 large head cauliflower floret | 1 dash baking soda | 1 dash cayenne
instructions: Slice peppers lengthwise into strips, leaving stem intact. Coarsely chop olives. Drain soup, removing seeds & membrane. In a large oven safe bowl, combine all ingredients except wing tips, except wings, and mix well. Drop wings, one at a time, into boiling soup. Cover bowl & cook at a very slow boil for 25 minutes. Remove from hot soup. Cover & allow to cool. Remove tips of wings, leaving the tips intact, and discard. Cut wings into serving portions. Arrange on a platter & top with remaining sauce. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: white corn tortilla,chili garlic sauce,red kidney bean,pecorino romano cheese,yogurt,ketchup,taco seasoning mix,heavy whipping cream
title: Mexican Layered Pizza
ingredients: 12 white corn tortillas | 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1 cup plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 cup light ketchup | 1 jar chili-garlic sauce | 1 cup grated pecorino-romano cheese | 1 can red kidney beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread one side of each corn tortilla with 1/2 cup cream.

title: Lentils With Dried Fruit
ingredients: dried fruit | 1 cup lentils | 1 cup dried mixed fruit | 3 green cardamom pods | 1 inch gingerroot, peeled and sliced | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 3 1/4 teaspoons filling ( optional )
instructions: Wash the lentils and fruit until water runs clear. Place lentils and fruit in separate saucepans. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer uncovered with lid on for 15 minutes. Remove with a strainer and transfer to strainer. Cover in cold water for about 20 minutes. Drain the water out, place in colander and set aside. Remove all the seeds except the hard part, the crushed hard part of the hard part of the skewer, the white part of the cardamom pod, and the outer part of the radish. Slice the hard part of the cardamom, peel the radish and cut it lengthwise into thin slices, discard the white part. In a dry skillet over medium heat add the ginger and fry them, stirring gently for about 1 minute. Add the cumin and fry for 1 minute. Remove with strainer and set aside. Add 1/2 cup of water to the skillet and stir fry the lentil mixture until the lentils turn light brown. Add the spice mixture all at once. Mix well. Add 3 1/2 cups of water and let simmer for 10 minutes then remove from heat. Mix the filling if using and divide between serving or serving bowl. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: four cheese mexican,grapefruit juice,beef tenderloin,mustard powder,flat rice noodle
title: Easy Beef Tenderloin and Rice Nests
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin or 2 lbs round steaks, pounded to 1/3 inch thickness | 4 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon flat rice noodles, soaked in cold water and drained | 2 teaspoons garlic pickled grapefruit juice | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Place 1/4 cup mayo in a small bowl. Spread on each surface the rice noodles. Place 1 meat side of each noodle on a rice noodle. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon mayo, 1 teaspoon garlic pickled grapefruit juice and 1/4 teaspoon mustard. Roll up each noodle and secure with kitchen twine or toothpicks. Place in a large nonstick skillet and press down on top of the rolls with the palm of your hand. Cook over medium high heat for 5 minutes without moving. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,chili pepper flake,vodka,red lentil,baby spinach leaf,pasta,frying chicken
title: Red Lentil & Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 frying chicken | 1/2 cup red lentil, rinsed and drained | 1/4 dried chipotle chile | 1 can chopped mild chili peppers in adobo | 2 heads baby spinach, washed | 1/2 cup vodka | 500 ml riced pasta
instructions: Trim excess fat from chicken. Cut chicken into ½ inch cubes, then cut across the grain into ¾ inch strips. Place chicken in a saucepan with lentils and chipoltes. Pour in chicken water, cover and bring to boil over medium high heat. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, then remove cover and simmer 5 minutes longer. Stir in torn baby spinach and continue cooking 8 minutes longer, until spinach is wilted. Stir in vodka and reheat. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,parmesan cheese,gingerroot,coconut milk,parmigiano reggiano cheese,flour,butternut squash
title: Butternut Squash and Yellow Squash Ravioli
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 1 yellow squash | 150 ml coconut milk | 1 tablespoon grated gingerroot | 1 teaspoon fresh grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | flour | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preparation,. If butternut squash is unpeeled remove it and cut it in half lengthwise. Cut squash in half again lengthwise and remove the seeds. Cut squash lengthwise into 1/8 in thick slices and cut each half into thick slices. Cut each slice into thin long strips. If you can find it, it should serve as a side dish, but in a separate bowl stir water to create a thick marinade. Combine the ginger root with a teaspoon of olive oil and stir thoroughly. You can put all the ginger in a jar with a lid for this, you just want the salt to be added. In a small saucepan on low heat, stir together the coconut milk and enough water to make a smooth paste and stir this into the water in the pan. Don't worry about having it bubbling or sticking. Add the ginger root paste. Simmer until it is slightly thick and bubbling. Add the squash and some salt. Simmer for 5 minutes or until squash is just tender. Remove and reserve in a large bowl. Make the ravioli,. Pour the coconut milk sauce from the bowl into a medium sautee pan for the ravioli. Heat over medium high heat until sauce thickens and starts to bubble. Add the parmigiano reggiano and mix with the rava. Drain the ravioli and place in a serving bowl large enough to hold them. Pour the rava and parmigiano reggiano over the ravioli and mix so all components are coated evenly with the rava sauce. Transfer the ravioli to a baking tray or serving dish and sprinkle evenly with the freshly grated parmigiano reggiano. Cook's tips,. If you wish to be really decadent you can drizzle some olive oil around the ravioli and bake them in a 350 degree oven for 25 minutes or until browned. You are aiming for golden brown brown taste when done. This won't look very pretty when the ravioli are done because the outside of them will be charred. Enjoy tips for a bit of creativity, instead of putting out the grated cheese right away go ahead and layer the ravioli on a cookie sheet or pizza pan for a minute or two before baking and placing them in the oven. Bake the ravioli for 7 - 9 minutes or until the ravioli start getting brown on the edges. If the ravioli become a little crispy and the cheese starts to melt watch as it doesn't burn or it will be just not as creamy as the ravioli.

title: Orange Peel Shishitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 large dried shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 oranges or 1 lemon | 3 tablespoons freshly grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Wipe the mushrooms clean with damp hands.

title: Chilled Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( and a little more, if needed ) | 1 cucumber | 2 -3 stalks escarole, chopped
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler remove the hard center portion of your long stalk and cut away the tough outer leaves. Using the knife or vegetable peeler, cut the peel into long strips. Place all ingredients in a clean glass bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Toss well before serving.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,spinach,stewing beef,flat leaf parsley
title: Stovies (South Africa)
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes and rinsed | 1/4 cup green cardamom pods | 1/3 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 3 cups fresh spinach, roughly chopped ( about 10 ounces )
instructions: In medium soup pot, heat first 5 ingredients over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until meat is lightly browned. Remove from heat and set aside, in the same soup pot, combine the reserved meat, chopped spinach and the reserved cooking liquid. Bring to a boil, return lid to soup pot and cook, covered, on medium heat until meat and spinach are tender and flavors have blended, about 10 minutes. Remove lid and let stand for 5 minutes, before serving.

Random Ingredients: fruit,vanilla bean,red bell pepper,sharp cheddar cheese,heavy cream,anjou pear,sun tomato oil,broth
title: Baked Pears and Cheese (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 1/2 lb sharp cheddar cheese | 8 ounces domestic deli halved anjou pears, cut into wedges | 1 cup canned reduced-sodium unsalted sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained, patted dry, and cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 red bell pepper, thinly sliced crosswise | 1 3/4 cups dry vegetable stock or 1 3/4 cups light-strength broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 vanilla bean
instructions: Preheat the oven to the lowest temp in an ovenproof pot. Sprinkle the cheese with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Add the pears and sun dried tomatoes, toss, and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Scatter the red bell pepper slices over the cheese. In an oven proof, heavy saucepan, combine the stock and 1/2 inch water. Bring to a bubble over high heat, scraping the pan. Decrease the heat to medium and add the cream and vanilla bean. Cook the mixture, stirring often, until the liquid is reduced by half, about 3/4 cup. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and let cool slightly. Stir in the cream and serve warm. Repeat the procedure with the remaining cheese and pears, adding the cheese back to the cream sauce for each serving as it is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,garlic powder,bell pepper,italian salad dressing,white pepper
title: Roasted Bell Peppers With Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1 bell pepper ( red or green ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder or 1 teaspoon garlic salt, to taste | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing ( i use dreamfields ) | 2 teaspoons white pepper, to taste | 1 -2 cardamom pod, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Heat grill to medium high and line a plate with foil. Pierce pepper all over with a fork. Place on grill and cook for 6 - 8 minutes until they turn black, or peppers are softened. Remove peppers from pan. Peel skins off and deseed. Cut pepper in half so they're striped at the stem level. Immediate remove seeds and membrane, then cut up the peppers in a salad bowl. Whisk the dressing ingredients together. Spoon some of the dressing onto a pepper half, top with the other half of the pepper. Place peppers on foil and let stand for 20 minutes while grill heats up. Turn the pepper halves around until all sides are done. Cook about 3 - 4 minutes for green peppers and a little over 12 minutes for red ones, or 10 or 15 minutes for yellow. Remove peppers from grill and place on serving plate.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,pork chop,artichoke heart,portabella mushroom,black eyed pea
