title: BBQ Pork Chops and Mushrooms With Artichokes & Black Eyed Peas
ingredients: 4 pork chops or 1 1/2 lbs pork sausages | 1/2 tablespoon baking soda | 4 -5 portabella mushrooms | 10 -12 artichoke hearts, canned, drained and chopped | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Slice pork chops or sausages into 1/4 inch slices or a bit smaller. Spray/spray pan with vegetable oil spray. Cook pork chops or sausages until just opaque, just lightly browned. Remove from pan. When pork chops/sausage is browned, drain all but about 2 tbsp of the pan drippings. Turn heat up to medium. Drain and rinse black eyed peas and add to fat in pan. Drain the rest of the bean liquid and add to pan. Add mushrooms and continue cooking, stirring occasionally until the mushrooms start to wilt and the liquid evaporates. Add the drained and chopped artichoke hearts and continue cooking for a few more minutes. Return pork chops/sausages and mushrooms on high until desired texture is achieved, about 2 to 4 minutes more. Serve with a side of hot, crusty bread or rolls and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,grain rice,salt black pepper,beef steak,ranch dressing mix,buttermilk
title: Copycat Mcallister's Ranch Shredded Beef Skillet Meal
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef round steak, 1/2 inch thick | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1 cup buttermilk | salt and black pepper | 3 cups quick-cooking medium grain rice ( preferably jasmine )
instructions: Cook beef over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until browned. Drain meat in a bowl. Add the ranch dressing, buttermilk and black pepper. Cook over medium high heat, cooking until sauce thickens slightly, about 5 minutes. Serve over hot rice.

title: Guinness Roast Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 12 hoagie rolls
instructions: First, make the meat, so that it has time to warm up, and then shred it very fine with your hands. Combine with the beef and roll it up like a burrito. The meat will be pretty easy to stuff into the hoagie rolls with as it rolls absorb any extra goodness. You can also use a meat thermometer to weigh it down for your own doneness and make your sandwich like we do with a meat thermometer from the hoagies, 1/4 inch at a time. I don't know about your favorite kind of dijon mustard, bacon drippings or lard are good, and you can even toast them, or put them under the broiler or toaster until crispy or tan.

Random Ingredients: beer,nonfat cream,balsamic vinegar,mirin,grain mustard,oregano leaf,vegetarian bean
title: Vegan Pan-Toasted Mustard Burger
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon vegetarian baked beans ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon mirin | 2 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 2 teaspoons grain mustard | 4 whole grain mustard
instructions: Using a teaspoon add the oregano in a small, thin stream. Blend in the remaining ingredients in a small glass measuring cup. Add a few drops of water to make a thinner consistency. Divide the bun among four dinner plates. Divide the bean mixture among the four plates.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,taco seasoning mix,neufchatel cheese,baby spinach
title: Baby Spinach on Mexican Layer Dip
ingredients: 2 packages neufchatel cheese | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( no msg ) | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1 bag fresh baby spinach
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a sauce pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 10 minutes. Stir, remove from heat immediately, and let sit for at least 15 minutes or more to cool before serving. It gets pretty thick so you may need to stir at some point too.

title: Bread Tart
ingredients: 2 medium ripe tomatoes, sliced ( about 3/4 pound ) | 2 tablespoons minced shallots | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1/8 teaspoon heavy whipping cream | 1 refrigerated french baguette | filling
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, saute tomatoes in shallot oil with cream. Toss bread with filling until coated evenly. Spray a 13 by 9 inch glass baking dish with nonstick spray. Arrange bread in a lightly buttered baking dish. Bake in a 350 degree f oven 20 minutes, or until golden and crisp and warmed through. Serve with tomato sauce.

title: Spinach and Barbecue Salad
ingredients: 4 bunches baby spinach, washed and stems removed | 1/3 cup barbecue sauce | 1/3 cup walnut halves ( optional )
instructions: Whisk together barbecue sauce and nuts. Set aside. Place baby spinach leaves on a serving platter and spoon greens on top. Serve with barbeque sauce.

title: Peach Sushi
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 2 -8 canned peaches, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced
instructions: Soak the jasmine rice in plenty of water at least 1 hour or overnight so that it can be drained easily.. Prepare the peach slices and set aside. Put the peaches in a bowl and rinse with water. Drain the rice and press once or twice to remove as much water as you can. Place on a rice paddle and cut around the peach slices until all the slices are approximately 1/4/1/2 inch thick, being careful not to tear the rice grains or the rice grains will come off. Arrange the peach slices in one layer on the jasmine sheets. Using an oiled sushi mat, roll each slice up jellyroll style, making sure to keep the rolled slices intact so that the rice does not stick to the bamboo rolling mat. Repeat until the sushi mat is full to the end. Place the mat on the bamboo rolling mat and carefully pull the sushi mat from the sides to get used up the shape. The sushi mat should be turned several times to make rolling easier if the bamboo mat is not long enough for you. Place the uncooked rice on the bamboo mat in the center of the sushi mat, top with the bean slices, and carefully roll the bamboo mat around the peach slices. Wet the edge of the sushi mat with water by using your finger tips. Press the edge of the mat all the way to the bottom, creating a pleated edge and bulging at the center. This will help to seal the peach slices on the bamboo sushi mat. Turn and repeat until the rolled sushi mat is completely filled and all the way to the top. Remove the sushi mat and place the bamboo mat back on the bamboo mat so that it is completely covered with the bean slices and bean slices. Roll your hands into a firm roll and carefully transfer it to a cutting board. Slice the sushi into 1/2 inch slices, then cut those slices diagonally to form slices that measure 1 inch across by 2 inches long. Sushi mat can be kept warm in a 250 degree oven for up to 1 - 2 hours.

title: Miso Glaze
ingredients: 12 serrano chilies, stemmed and seeded | 1 bottle good quality white miso
instructions: Combine the chilies and miso in a saucepan and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to a low, place the pan over medium heat, and simmer, stirring frequently, until the chili has softened and turned bright red, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,meat,pearl barley,rice vinegar,heavy whipping cream,milk ricotta cheese,brown sugar,kernel corn
title: Italian Rice and Barley Salad from Leftovers
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked pearl barley | 1 cup cooked meat, sliced | 1 cup whole kernel corn, drained | 2 ounces italian cheese blend ( cheddar or provolone, cubed ) | 1/2 cup light whole milk ricotta cheese ( regular or reduced-fat ) | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place barley in a large baking dish and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook for 8 minutes. In a medium bowl combine the meat, corn, cheese, vinegar, and sugar and mix well. Pour this over the barley mixture and stir. In a small bowl beat the cream and stir it into the barley/corn mixture until blended. Pour the mixture over the cheese mixture and stir to coat. Pour in the cream mixture and scatter with more of the brown sugar. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 40 minutes. Uncover, remove foil and bake until the topping is golden, about 10 minutes. Let sit for 5 minutes and serve warm.

title: Cherie's Fried Chicken
ingredients: 2 whole chicken cutlets | 2 lbs red apples | 2 1/2 lbs sweet red apples | 1/2 lb citron, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 cup dry wine
instructions: Cut chicken in half. Peal and slice apples 1/4 inch thick. Wash apples and cut in strips 2 inches long. Put apple slices in a colander or sieve, add salt, pepper and citron and drain apples well. In a deep fryer add chicken, apples, spices and wine and heat to boiling, simmering, turning once until chicken is cooked. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: curacao,pastry single crust pie,cream chicken soup,red chilies,cremini mushroom
title: Quick Chilled Mushroom Pastry
ingredients: 1 pastry for single-crust pie, refrigerated crust | 425 g cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon cremini mushrooms | 1 red chilies, deseeded and finely chopped | 1/2 tablespoon curacao
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Press pastry into a lightly greased 28cm x 14cm swiss roll tin, allowing a 1cm overhang. Press pastry into base of pastry case with a rolling pin. Line with baking paper and weigh down with a roasting appliance. Remove pastry case from oven and carefully trim excess overhang with knife. Combine soup, mushroom, chilies and curacao in a small bowl. Spoon into pastry lined tin. Cut slits in pastry with a sharp knife, and carefully pour over soup mixture. Sprinkle top with a little extra curacao. Bake for about 50 mins, until pastry is nicely browned and top is golden around the edges.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,five spice powder,vodka,tomato ketchup,cumin seed,green bell pepper
title: Spicy Baked Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 tablespoons five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 green bell pepper, thinly sliced | 2 1/2 lbs beef brisket, sliced into 8 pieces | 1 cup tomato ketchup | 2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine five spice powder and cumin seeds in a small, dry skillet. Add bell pepper and saute over medium low heat, stirring frequently, until just crisp. Spread vegetables in a roasting pan. Place brisket in the pan. Add vegetable mix and tomato ketchup. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in center of oven for at least 3 hours. Stir and bake a few minutes longer.

title: Chinese Meat Paste Seasoning
ingredients: 500 g pork, fat ( shoulder and leg ) | 100 g prunes, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup palm sugar
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a food processor to form a well. Pulse the paste to the desired consistency. Store in a tightly lidded container.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,tortellini,dill weed,brown mustard seed,muscovado sugar,lotus leaf,cherry tomato,paprika
title: Muxi Barolo
ingredients: 10 whole lotus leaves | 1/2 cup sour pitted cherry tomatoes | 3 tart apples, such as granny smith, finely chopped | 12 ounces grilled muscovado sugar ( demerara or brown sugar twin ) | 1/3 cup brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 lb fresh lotus leaves | 2 tablespoons tulsi brown mustard seeds
instructions: Tear the lotus leaves into smaller pieces and place them in a large bowl. Add all other ingredients except the big leaves and pile into large pot with water to about 2 - 2 1/2 inches above lotus leaves. Place lid on pot and cook over high heat for 10 to 15 minutes, or until mixture is reduced and liquid evaporates into a thick, sticky paste. Remove from heat and stir in some tulsi or brown mustard seeds until well blended. Place lotus on a warm serving platter and pour remaining tulsi on top.

title: The Real Mix - Home Made Better!
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 2 teaspoons rosemary sprigs, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons serrano chilies, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon of aji peppercorn, coarsely chopped ( not ground )
instructions: Dissolve the xanthan gum in a little cold water. Add the rosemary, chiles and the blended spices into the bowl, and mix well. Then pour over a hot tea, and leave to set for 2 - 2 1/4 hours, until thick. If you have leftovers, store in the fridge, and give each grain as gifts.

Random Ingredients: tea,tomato paste,sea salt,pumpkin seed,tamarind pulp,pistachio,french bread
title: Pumpkin Seed Toast
ingredients: 1 stale french bread, sliced | 400 g pumpkin seeds | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/2 cup teabags pumpkin seeds, coarsely crushed | 1/2 cup unsalted pistachios | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp, soaked in | 2 -3 tablespoons warm tepid water
instructions: Place one slice of bread on a baking tray, and spread 1 heaped teaspoon of pumpkin seeds into an indentation. Brush the hollow with some tomato paste and place in the oven for approximately 5 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from the oven and set aside. Sprinkle the remaining pumpkin seeds over the toast in a griller or large frying pan, and brush with more tomato paste. Grill for a couple of minutes until golden and crisp. Meanwhile, place the pistacios in a pan of boiling water and cook for 5 minutes or until softened. Drain and refresh in the warm water. Set the pistacios aside. Toast the remaining slices of bread on the tray for approx 2 minutes on top side, or until golden brown. Spread the toast with tepid water, and drizzle with teabags place the toast under a hot grill until golden brown. To serve, spread the warm pistacios over the toast.

title: Sour Cream for Passover
ingredients: 2 cups prepared salsa | 3/4 cup triple sec | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 -2 chipotle chile, deseeded and finely chopped ( i leave the husks on, and remove the seeds, if desired )
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Cover immediately in plastic wrap and refrigerate 1 hour or longer to allow flavours to develop. Serve chilled. It's usually served with tostado cookies, pita chips, etc. Enjoy.

title: Gramma's Quinoa
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked quinoa | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly. Bring to a boil with enough water to cover. Add the dill and cook at a boil, covered, for 15 minutes. You may need to uncover the pan while cooking. Do not remove the lid.

title: Chinese Cucumber Ramen
ingredients: 1 piece doritos ( dry seaweed ) | 12 fresh ramen noodles ( egg noodles ) | 1/4 cucumber, thinly sliced | scallion | 1/4 cup canola oil, divided | 1/4 cup chopped jam | 4 slices scallions, for garnish
instructions: Soak the ramen noodles in at least 3 inches of hot water. Leave them to soak until softened, about 30 minutes. Drain the noodles, and cut them in half crosswise. Tear the noodles into bite sized pieces, and place them in a mixing bowl. Heat enough canola oil into a wok to coat the edges. Stir fry the noodles for about 1 minute. Add the ramen noodles, and stir over heat for another 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Add the cucumber, scallions, and jam, stir, and cover. Heat the remaining canola oil in the wok. Remove the wok from the heat, and pour one ladle full of hot water into the wok. Drain the noodles, and return them to the wok. Top with the noodle mixture, and serve.

title: Sweet Fish Crunch
ingredients: 1 haddock fillet | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained, with juice | 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped, plus additional walnut halves ( or pecans if not available ) | 1/2 cup frozen corn | 1/4 cup canned pineapple chunks, drained | 1 teaspoon orange rind, grated | 1/3 cup rolled oats | 3/4 cup packed brown sugar | 1 ounce parmesan cheese, grated, plus extra for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Dry the haddock on paper towels then set aside. Combine the remaining ingredients in a bowl. Arrange haddock in the bottom of a shallow baking dish. Spoon the mixture evenly over the fish. Sprinkle with parmesan. Bake for 40 minutes, or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Ravage
ingredients: 3 1/4 cups vegetable stock | 1 1/2 inches fresh turkish turnips, peeled and sliced | 5 ounces french-fried onions, sliced into rounds | 1 package frozen spinach | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp | seasoning
instructions: Bring the vegetable stock to a boil over high heat in a large pot. Add the turnips, and return to a boil. Cook until the turnips are tender, about 15 - 18 minutes. Transfer the turnips and their liquid to a food processor.

title: Ancho-Mushrooms Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large mushrooms, stemmed and sliced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped ancho chiles | wooden bamboo skewers
instructions: Place mushrooms, ancho, and a few tablespoons of the marinade in a plastic bag. Toss to coat evenly. Taste and adjust seasoning. Cover and chill for 30 minutes. Thread mushroom skewers. Preheat grill or broiler. Transfer skewers onto heat. Grill for 6 - 7 minutes, turning once, until browned and cooked through, turning once or twice. Serve immediately.

title: White Beans, Kidney Beans and Tarragon (Zwt II)
ingredients: 4 cups dried white beans, rinsed and drained ( navy beans ) | 4 1/2 cups canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon, chopped or 2 teaspoons dried tarragon
instructions: Cook beans in enough water to cover for 1 minute. Place kidney beans and tarragon in a food processor. Process until no chunky pieces remain. Add the beans and process until all is well mixed together. If needed add more water so mixture is relatively thick but not too watery adjust seasoning.

title: Pesto Crusted Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 cup pesto sauce | 1 1/2 lbs ground extra lean beef, at least 80 % lean | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Line 15x10 inch glass baking pan with aluminum foil and generously brush with olive oil. Spray foil with nonstick cooking spray. Stir pesto into ground beef. With your hands, mix together beef, adding any leftover pesto and ground cheese mixture. Using your hands, mix thoroughly, then shape stuffing into an oblong about 1/2 inch thick. Place bread in baking pan, then pour in desired amount of pesto. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until loaves reach desired tenderness.

title: Asparagus and Beet-Pear Pies
ingredients: 16 sheets phyllo pastry | 6 large beets | 6 large pear slices | 16 asparagus spears
instructions: Toast your english muffin or toast your rolls if you are so inclined. Cut asparagus pieces in halves or thirds across the length into approximately 1/2 pieces, then slice each piece length wise. Lay out one sheet of pastry. Sprinkle top with approximately 1/8 each of the beet slices, pear slices, and asparagus spears and carefully place another sheet of pastry on top. With a very sharp knife, trim any excess pastry on top of pies, keeping pieces together to form 'burgundy'<NEXT_INSTR> Cut 4 large sheets of pastry into 2 equal squares. Lay out top 4 sheets of pastry. Put 2 pieces of pastry on top of 1/2 cup beet slices at a time, laying approximately a half cup pear and a half on each piece of pastry. Bring corners to center of pie to create a 'cup' shape top rolled out piece of pastry. Put one folded piece of pastry on top of another folded piece, then continue with this until you have used up the pastry. This could be done on top boxes or in a ziplock freezer bag and put on top box. Set in oven on lowest setting for about 45 - 60 minutes until golden brown and crispy.

title: Fiery Chipsotle Chili Paste
ingredients: 1/4 cup chipotle powder | 1 head roasted coconut oil
instructions: In a clean dry frying pan, heat 1/4 cup of coconut oil over low heat. Stir frequently so the coconut does not burn. When oil is warm enough, stir in the chipotle powder. Spread the mixture into a paper cone shape to cool completely. Spread into small dry hot jars. Cover with a piece of plastic wrap, seal tightly, and leave in a sunny place for 3 days before using to develop the flavors.

Random Ingredients: vermouth,caribbean jerk seasoning,green pepper,kiwi fruit,raspberry,coriander seed,sunflower oil,beef tenderloin
title: Spiced Beef Tenderloin With Kiwi and Raisins
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 2 kiwi fruits | 1 green pepper | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons caribbean jerk seasoning | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 3 tablespoons sunflower oil | fresh raspberry, to garnish
instructions: Make the marinade by grinding together the coriander seeds with the jerk seasoning and vermouth – you can make up to 2 days ahead and put into the fridge. Heat the oil in a frying pan and add the coriander mixture. Cut the meat into 8 equal pieces and put on a plate and brush with the marinade. Cover and refridgerate for 20 - 30 minutes. Remove from the marinade and pat dry. Thread the beef onto 8 skewers, each about 5 1/2 inches long, and cook over hot coals for about 3 minutes each side until medium rare. Place on platter, cover & keep warm. Bring the marinade to the boil then reduce it by half. Lift the meat out and place on serving plate. Top with the raisins and serve with bubble fried green vegetables.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,curry powder,chicken leg,mirin,poppy seed,oatmeal,maple syrup,date
title: Sweet and Savory Chicken
ingredients: 10 ounces rolled oats | 12 ounces chicken legs ( about 5-3 lbs. ) | 4 tablespoons quick bacon fat ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dates, pitted and chopped ( i like to use sweetened dried cherries ) | 3 tablespoons golden raisins ( optional ) | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 1 tablespoon poppy seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f. Combine the rolled oats, chicken legs, bacon fat, date and golden raisins in a bowl. Dribble maple syrup over all. Combine curry powder and poppy seeds. Sprinkle curry mixture over top. Spread evenly. Roast the chicken in the oven for up to 1 hour, stirring twice, or until done. Remove chicken from oven and let cool in the refrigerator before serving.

Random Ingredients: pork belly,egg substitute,cannellini bean,malt vinegar,canola oil
title: Bacon and Egg Salad
ingredients: 6 slices country lean pork belly | 1 can cannellini beans | 8 large eggs plus 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Cut pork belly into 1 inch pieces. Place in a colander, sprinkle with salt and toss to drain off excess water. Place in a salad bowl with fresh cold water to cover and let sit for 2 hours to draw out excess salt. Rinse beans and drain. In a nonstick frying pan, fry pork in hot oil for 5 - 6 minutes on each side or until crisp and browned. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels, then set aside. Add bean and vinegar to the pan and cook, stirring, for 2 - 3 minutes or until just beginning to darken. Beat together the eggs, egg white and mustard and pour over the salad. Toss to coat well. Serve immediately.

title: Gran's Prunes with Prunes
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 pound prunes, pitted
instructions: Heat golden syrup with prunes in a small saucepan over medium low heat until warm, about 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,cider vinegar,taco sauce,mustard,chipotle chile adobo,worcestershire sauce,egg
title: Mexican-Style Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 6 eggs | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced canned chipotle chiles in adobo ( minced ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Remove yolks from shells and chop the whites into small pieces. Place in a small bowl and sprinkle with worcestershire sauce, mustard, vinegar, chilies, taco sauce and turmeric. Cover and refrigerate until hard, about 30 minutes. Melt yolk mixture over high heat in a large, heavy pot for 1 minute. Uncover and sprinkle with white sugar.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,tomato green chile pepper,milk,stout beer,tomato juice,turnip,cardamom
title: Easy Baked Irish Turnip Dip
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 1/4 cups diced peeled turnips | 1 can condensed tomato juice | 1/2 cup milk | 1/2 bottle medium-dark stout beer | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 bag no-salt-added taco sauce, heated
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a shallow baking dish with aluminum foil, leaving enough room to fold over the top to make room for the dip. Pour the diced tomatoes and their juice into a large bowl. Stir in the turnip, tomato juice, milk, stout beer, cardamom and taco sauce. Stir thoroughly. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. Spread the mixture into the prepared baking dish, and bake in preheated oven until tender and brown, about 45 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,cream tartar,pepper sauce,fennel seed
title: Beef Satay or Kebabs
ingredients: 250 g red curry paste | 600 ml low-fat sour cream or 600 ml light sour cream | 1 tablespoon ground fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper sauce
instructions: Combine the sour cream and the fennel seeds in a medium bowl. Mix well until smooth and place in the refrigerator. Stir in the red curry paste and pepper sauce. Chill the beef satay mixture overnight. Thread the meat onto the skewers. Brush with oil or melted margarine. Cook, uncovered over medium high heat for 2 minutes on each side or until medium well cooked. Remove from skewers and serve warm.

title: Easy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 300 g small curd cottage cheese | 3 -4 spring onions, chopped | freshly ground black pepper ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Microwave on high for 20 - 30 seconds or until well heated through. You can add more seasoning if required before serving.

title: Red Bliss
ingredients: 1 package red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 package tart cherry ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups light beer
instructions: Boil potatoes until just tender, drain. Cut into 1 inch pieces. Drain off excess moisture, but leave potatoes in the potatoes. Place cherry onto a foil covered pan, spread evenly.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,sriracha sauce,coleslaw,rice flour,mint leaf,thai chili sauce,penne pasta
title: Thai Pasta Salad With Crushed Rice Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta, cooked al dente | 2 bunches fresh mint leaves | 1 1/2 - 2 cups coleslaw | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 1/3 cup thai sweet chili sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons rice flour ( to thicken ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sriracha hot sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Bring large pot of salted water to boil over high heat. Add pasta and cook until al dente, drain and rinse with cold water. While pasta is cooking combine next four ingredients, mix well. Combine rice flour and sriracha. Combine with other ingredients in large bowl and toss using a fork until combined. Transfer half of pasta mixture to pasta mixture and toss to combine. Gently stir in remaining pasta mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,snow pea,bread,ginger garlic paste,mix,baking chocolate
title: Chop-Up-A-Monger Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, unsliced, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/4 cups dry mix | 1 1/4 cups ginger-garlic paste | 1/3 cup lime juice | snow peas, sliced on the diagonal ( optional ) | 3 cups crunchy baking chocolate
instructions: If your bread are very large, you can easily cut it down by slicing it as thinly as you can vertically so you have 5 slices. Combine the dry mix, ginger garlic paste, and lime juice in a mixing bowl. Add as much of the mix as you can. Toss until the mix is fairly smooth. Place about 1 1/4 of the cubes onto a cutting board. Using the side of your chef's knife, spread the chocolate all over the cubes. Top with another 1 1/4 cubes and press to press. You can freeze these even if you don't have any left over on hand. Cut each frozen sandwich in half diagonally and toast in the oven at 300°f just until slightly golden, and they're easy to handle. Serve with additional chocolate chips if desired.

title: Auerkraut and Coconut on Sides in a Bun
ingredients: 1 jar sauerkraut | 1/4 cup shredded coconut ( not packed ) | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan-reggiano cheese or 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 -4 celery leaves
instructions: Pour sauerkraut into a large bowl. Add coconut, cheese and celery leaves. Toss until well mixed. Cut a slit in each bun and serve.

title: Mashed Parsnips & Corn Tostadas
ingredients: parsnips, peeled and chopped into small pieces | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 20 corn tortillas
instructions: Prepare onion soup mix according to package directions using 2 cups of water. Set aside until cool. Mash parsnips thoroughly. Add 2 teaspoons of soup mix and mix. Spray a deep skillet or 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking oil. Line the bottom of the dish with a corn tortilla. Spoon some parsnip mixture into the middle, and roll up. Seal with a little more soup mix, or just a little drizzle of oil. Repeat for the rest of the tortillas and parsnips. Garnish with parsley. Serve warm, warm, or cold. Optional, top with crumbled parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,pork,tea,beef chuck roast,cooking oil,chicken bouillon,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Chinese Take-Out Russian Pork Sandwiches
ingredients: 5 pounds boneless beef chuck roast | 6 pounds lean pork | cooking oil for frying | 1 bottle dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
instructions: Cut chuck roast across the grain into 1 inch thick slices. Place sliced meat between 2 sheets of wax paper and pound until about 4 times the thickness of your steaming board. Combine dark soy sauce and chicken bouillon in a small bowl, and mix well. Set aside. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Pour 1 bottle of dark soy sauce and chicken bouillon over beef and pork, and season with salt. When oil is hot, add pork and chicken, and cook until browned. Place pork and chicken in paper between two sheets of wax paper. Spread other bottle of dark soy sauce and chicken bouillon over pork and chicken. Allow meat to absorb marinade, at least 2 hours, refrigerated. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Slice both ends from one side of the other, and set aside. Coat one side of each bread slice with cooking oil. Place two sliced meats on top of each slice of bread. Place an empty microwave safe bowl on top, and cover with a clean paper towel to prevent steam from escaping. Put sandwiches on a baking sheet, and bake for 2 hours in the preheated oven. Remove and discard paper towels, and spread mixed vegetables on top to serve.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,red chilies,apple juice,lamb,lasagna noodle,wheat tortilla
title: Lamb and Apple Lasagna
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups apple juice, divided | 1 teaspoon chilies, minced | 15 whole wheat tortillas ( or use 6-inch tortillas, torn into bite-size pieces or use 2 8-inch pizza crust dough ) | 1 lb lasagna noodle, broken into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup of the apple juice, mix, and set aside. Spray a pan with cooking spray and place the lamb in the pan. Place over medium high heat and brown well, about three minutes, flipping and rearranging with a wooden spoon to brown evenly. Drain the fat, then transfer lamb to a plate with a slotted spoon. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread half the tortillas with half the lamb mixture and arrange half the tortillas on top. Sprinkle the exposed tortillas with more lamb and layer with half the sliced apples. Top with half the remaining tortillas, and spread with remaining sauce. Top with remaining slices of lamb, then the remaining tortillas, apples and any remaining sauce. Sprinkle with minced chilies. Bake for about 30 minutes. Allow to cool slightly and serve. Variations,. Because the lamb is so short on time, it also tastes great on roasted veggies, such as tomatoes and onions. Alfredo sauce can be made by substituting chicken broth, water, or vegetable broth for the water. It can also be made with chicken meat, if desired. Note, if you would like to make your own lasagna using the leftover marinara sauce, you can do so following the directions on the package. It seems difficult to get enough tomato, so often i just put the amount into a blender with a bit of water and blend on high to blend the liquid. It's up to you. You can even add a bit of sugar and milk to the recipe just before you pour the sauce inches i usually only just put it aside and stir. If you don't have whole wheat tortillas on hand, you may use 1 large can of whole wheat tortillas that have been torn into chunks. As is, i usually make up 3 large cans, and freeze what i need to store for future use.

title: Saffron Lime Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 limes | 4 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 pinch saffron threads ( optional ) or 1 pinch saffron paste ( optional )
instructions: Squeeze the juice from 4 limes over the surface and discard. Stir the lime juice into the horseradish. Stir. Stir in the saffron or saffron paste or, if using, a pinch of saffron. Let stand 15 - 20 minutes, then stir again. Serve.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,pita pocket bread,nutmeg,hamburger,vegetable oil olive
title: Nettle Baked Pita Chips
ingredients: 1 pita pocket bread, cut into triangles and toasted | 1/2 lb hamburger | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/4 cup vegetable oil ( olive, corn or sunflower )
instructions: Place pita triangles on foil lined baking trays. Combine hamburger and cream, mix until meat crumbles and is light and fluffy. Mixture will be very dry. Sprinkle meat mixture with nutmeg. Spread mixture lightly on pita chips. Bake in 300f oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool and break into pieces. Serve as is or with yogurt and pickles.

title: Seared Pear & Pancetta Frites
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cornflour | 2 -4 teaspoons cornflour | 2 cups warm pancetta, cubed, to your liking | 3 -4 tablespoons sherry wine, to your liking | 1 large pear, cut into rings | 3 -4 mint leaves, coarsely chopped | 2 -4 tablespoons dry sherry wine | freshly chopped mint leaf
instructions: Mix the cornflour and 3 tbsps of the warm pancetta together. Place in the centre of two large, straight sided sheets of foil, make a large well in the centre and pour in the pancetta mixture and the sherry. With a spout or a skewer, stir the filling ingredients together. Wrap the foil around completely, enclosing them. Tightly seal the edges and leave to rest for around 10 - 15 minutes. Put a sheet of oiled baking paper on your work surface and, using a round bladed knife, slice the pear into rings and remove the core leaving a little of the flesh attached to the pears by chopping. Heat up the oiled barbecue plate, place the pears in and oiled paper and cook over a high, medium heat, turning regularly for a couple of minutes to crisp and char on all sides. Sear the pancetta for another minute or two on each side and remove from the barbecue. Keep warm until ready to serve. Keep the cooked pears warm while you make the garlic bread. Combine the remaining ingredients and mix into a smooth paste by combining a small amount of water with 2 tbsps flour or cornstarch and a little water if necessary. Drizzle the sauce over the pears and serve straight away with the garlic bread or a simple pita for squeezing over.

title: Anchovy-Marinated Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 2 1/2 pounds frying chickens, washed and patted dry | 12 pitted green olives, coarsely chopped
instructions: Spread the anchovy paste into the cavity of each chicken. Cover with a small spoonful of olives. Cover with a large tray of plastic wrap extending slightly over the bird. Refrigerate for 1 to 3 days. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Unwrap the chicken and place on a rack in a roasting pan. Spray the chicken with cooking spray. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 1 1/2 hours. Remove the foil and bake for 45 minutes, or until the internal temperature of the chicken registers 165 degrees f.

title: Sombrero Grande
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple | 1 can tomato puree | 10 taco shells | 8 cups crushed ice
instructions: In a blender pour crushed pineapple, then add tomato puree and crushed ice. Blend until smooth, or make your own ice cream and ice cream.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,beef stew meat,cinnamon,broccoli floret,kosher salt,dark sesame oil
title: Moroccan Beef and Broccoli Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat, trimmed of fat and cut into 3-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups orange juice ( orange-flavored liqueur is my choice, but you could also use lemon or lime juice ) | 4 cups broccoli florets | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil ( or light sesame oil ) | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( or to taste, i used a lot ) | kosher salt
instructions: Add beef to large covered nonstick pan, along with orange juice and broccoli. Pour liquid over the meat and vegetables and stir in sesame oil and cinnamon. Cover tightly and bring to a simmer over low heat, about 8 minute remove cover and let sit 3 to 5 more minutes then check for liquid in pan. If it starts to evaporate, cover and let sit just a few minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve, if there is any left in the pan, skim off any fat that may form on top.

title: Sicilian Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens | 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 head napa cabbage, chopped ( or use other leafy green ) | 1/2 lb of canned small peas | 4 ounces white bread | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/2 cup of good quality cocoa
instructions: Rinse the chicken and place in a large pan. Pour enough water to cover the chicken and place over high heat and bring the water to the boil. When a drop of water jumps on the surface and it falls apart remove the chicken, and set aside. Leave the water there. Cut off the wing tips from the chicken, discard, and pull off the fat from the meat. Cut the meat into pieces, about 3/4 inch cubes. Put it aside. Pick the leaves off of the napa cabbage and tear it into shreds. Rinse the napa cabbage in advance, and place it in a large pan with the peas. Remove the leaves from the napa cabbage and put the leaves in a large bowl. Discard all of the leaves from the napa cabbage. Cut up the bread into bite sized cubes. Place the bread cubes in the bowl with other salad ingredients. Mix in the mustard and sugar. Add the oil. The mix well. Pour the mixture and the chicken over the salad and mix well. Serve chilled.

title: Pickled Beets
ingredients: 2 large beets | 2 jalapeno peppers | cooking oil ( for frying ) | 1/4 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Wipe clean beets and slice thin. Scoop out the center using a teaspoon. Cut into 3/8 slices. Heat enough cooking oil to cover the beets, in a deep fryer, to 375 degrees. Lay the beets out on a paper toweling, drizzle with about 3 tablespoons of oil and place on the middle rack of the heat. Fry until well browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove beets to paper towels to drain, keep warm. To serve, arrange beets on a large platter with peppers decoratively over the beets and sprinkle with asiago.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,vanilla bean,hot red chili pepper,pepper,heavy whipping cream,bell pepper,rhubarb,baby spinach
title: Spanish Inspired Rhubarb & Spinach Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs rhubarb ( stemmed & chopped ) | 1/2 spanish onion ( chopped ) | 1 medium chopped bell pepper | 1/4 - 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 large fresh hot red chili peppers ( minced ) | 1 cup baby spinach ( chopped ) | 3 tablespoons of pure vanilla beans | 1 1/2 teaspoons pepper
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Cut rhubarb crosswise into 1/4 inch slices and add to boiling water. Reduce heat and simmer until rhubarb starts to soften about 8 to 10 minutes. Drainrhubarb & reserve. Chop rhubarb, onion, bell pepper & saute in pan with 1/4 to 1/2 tblsp. Of cream until onion is translucent. Set aside. Slice cooked rhubarb& add back into pan. Cook about 5 to 10 minutes at simmer. Drain liquid from pan, except 1/4 cup of cream. Add remainder of cream to pan and stir until it just begins to thicken and cook down for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in chili.

title: Tunisian Tuna, Melba or Noodle With Candlenut Saffron and Toasted Herbs
ingredients: 1/4 lb fresh salted anchovies | 5 1/2 ounces canned tuna, drained | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 small onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1 2/3 ounces egg noodles | 1 tablespoon packed brown sugar
instructions: For the toasted nuts and saffron, toast anchovies in a skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until aromatic and blackened, about 3 minutes. Remove from pan and grind in a blender until very fine and oily, about a cup. Cool completely. For the nanjing, mix anchovies with tuna, adding saffron, onion, mixed herbs and eggs, stirring until well blended. Cook noodles in a pot of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to the bite, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain. Spread on a rimmed baking sheet and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 400 degrees oven until nuts are golden and sticky, about 15 minutes. Let cool.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,wonton wrapper,red food coloring,sun tomato oil,chuck
title: Steamed Shrimp Dumplings (Jougeres)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef brisket, preferably whole | 4 ounces wonton wrappers | 2 packages dried red food coloring | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 cups pickled beurre manie au jus
instructions: Cut beef brisket into 3/4 inch cubes. Arrange on a trivet or colander in a saucepan. Sprinkle with water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cover. Reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,halibut,sugar snap pea,chicken cutlet,cherry tomato,half,cashew
title: Lail's Chinese Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup cashews | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 1 - 1 1/2 lb halibut | 1 lb chicken cutlet | 14 cherry tomatoes | 14 -20 sugar snap peas ( optional )
instructions: Toast cashews in a hot wok or oven until golden brown, stirring often. Spread onto paper towel covered plate. Heat hoisin sauce and half and half over medium high heat in a large nonstick skillet. Heat to simmering and cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, rub halibut with olive oil. Grill halibut over medium high heat 4 to 5 minutes per side. Set aside and cover. Heat a broiler. Drain halibut and halibut pasta. Cut halibut into 4 - 6 pieces. Spoon pasta onto a platter. Add halibut and top with cherry tomatoes and peas. Drizzle with extra hoisin sauce. Serve with rice.

title: Indian Spiced Cabbage and Strawberries
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 2 cups light cream or 2 cups greek yogurt | 1 cucumber ( grated ) | 1 teaspoon black vinegar or 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 cup fresh strawberries ( halved if large ) | 2 cups cabbage, shredded
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the cream in a large bowl, then stir in cucumber, vinegar and red curry. Let stand for 5 minutes. Pour 1/2 cup of the liquid into a large non stick skillet then place a steamer insert into the center of the pan to fit. Put cabbage into the skillet and steam over medium heat for 18 minutes, or until wilted. Place yogurt in a large bowl and stir till smooth. Fold in half of the cucumber, spinach and cabbage. Cover and let sit 5 or 10 minutes to allow the flavors to combine. Spoon into a warm serving dish, or let chill 5 - 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Linguine Wrapped in Sourraspberry Syrup for One
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1 jar raspberries | 3 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Place the raspberries in a small bowl. Drizzle enough of the liquid smoke into a small saucepan to just cover them. Bring the liquid to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to low, and simmer the raspberries until tender, about 4 minutes. Strain the raspberries out of the liquid. When the linguine is ready, pour the cooked raspberries into a serving bowl or serving dish. Stir the lemon juice and warm liquid smoke into the raspberries and gently drizzle over the linguine.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,english muffin,self raising flour,chili pepper
title: Quick and Easy British Muffins
ingredients: 10 slices english muffins ( you 'll need 16 slices. about the size of your bun. ) | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 tablespoon finely minced chili pepper | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour
instructions: Put the english muffins in the oven for 5 - 6 minutes, or until they are golden brown. Add the pudding mix, chilli and flour, stir well. The mixture should be a bit dry, but not entirely runny. Leave out the seeds for a few minutes or so after removing from the oven. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip steak,okra,spanish onion,tzatziki,lemonade,baby beet,single cream,basmati rice
title: Beef Teriyaki
ingredients: 1 packet zesty teriyaki sauce | 500 g sirloin tip steaks, thinly sliced | 1 large spanish onion, finely chopped | 300 g okra, trimmed, halved lengthways, rinsed well and sliced thin | 300 g baby beets, sliced | 150 ml single cream | 200 g basmati rice, cooked | lemonade, for serving
instructions: Combine teriyaki and 1 packet zesty teriyaki sauce to taste. Place beef and onion in non metallic, shallow, non stick shallow, pan. Add okra and cook over high heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Add cook for 3 - 4 minutes longer until vegetables are tender. Remove beef. Stir fry vegetables with remaining teriyaki marinade until tender. Serve on plate with beef and teriyaki mixture.

title: Salsa Ninety Nine Hot Peppers
ingredients: 1 jar jalapeno peppers | 1 yellow pepper
instructions: Slice pepper into 1/4 inch pieces and put into a jar. The stem is left on the pepper. It should sit on the edge of jar, but then be careful, because the oil from the peppers is dangerously hot. The fumes from the peppers can leave you licking your fingers for a few seconds, but you don't want them to burn. The pepper strips can also be put into a spice mill bag and ground right into the jar of peppers.

title: Easy, No-Cook Moroccan Chicken Stew
ingredients: 3 -6 chicken | 1 can sweet chickpeas, drained | 3 tablespoons roasted garlic and herbs seasoning blend ( i use mccormick's ) | 2 tablespoons dried fennel seeds | 2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Cut the chicken up into serving size pieces. Sprinkle the chicken and any juices over the chickpeas. Sprinkle remaining ingredients over chicken. Let stand and allow flavors to blend for 2 hours or more. Cook over coals or on the stove top until chicken is cooked through. Cooking times will vary, depending on size of pieces used, so watch for flare ups. Serve over couscous or with bread and salad.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,snow pea pod,fish sauce,cayenne pepper
title: Tunisian Snow Pea Pods (Green Pea Pets)
ingredients: 1 pound snow pea pods, trimmed | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 3 tablespoons fish sauce |  cayenne pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add snow peas and cook uncovered until tender, about 3 minutes. Drain, squeezing out excess moisture. Transfer snow peas to a bowl. Add serrano pepper and fish sauce. Toss to coat. Sprinkle cayenne pepper on top. Serve with noodles.

title: Pea Fish With Coriander
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh green beans ( cut in half ) | 1 small chopped peach | 1/4 lb fresh salmon ( sliced ) | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: In a small pan, saute all ingredients over a medium heat until the peas are well cooked, but not mushy. Put the coriander on the plate. Put the cooked peas on top of the corriander and serve.

title: Ouzo for Two
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ouzo | 1 teaspoon mixed italian herbs | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 ounce dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the ouzo and mixed italian herbs.

Random Ingredients: tostada shell,asiago cheese,chocolate,red bean,cilantro,cucumber,red pepper flake
title: Sarasota's Grilled Tuna and Beans
ingredients: 14 ounces can canned red beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can red-bean tuna packed in water, undrained | 2 tablespoons asiago cheese, shaved | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon fresh cilantro, chopped | 1/2 cup diced peeled cucumber | 14 tostada shells, warmed
instructions: Place drained beans and tuna in a small bowl. In a separate bowl, combine cheese, pepper flakes, cilantro and cucumbers. Divide tuna mixture among warmed tostada shells and sprinkle with cheese mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Fricassee
ingredients: 2 pounds pork tenderloin, thinly sliced | 36 sprigs fresh mint
instructions: Place pork slices onto a plate, and top with a sprig of mint. Serve immediately.

title: Glazed Whole Spicy Pecans
ingredients: 12 cups whole pecans, shelled ( about 12 large ) | 2 cups light-colored rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 cup clear honey, such as sunflower | 1 large pinch ground cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: In a large baking pan, or walnut pan, spread pecan halves evenly with a mixture of whole green pecan halves, rice wine vinegar, 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon, and 1/4 cup of honey.

title: Green Chili Pepper and Chile Pepper Bread
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups self-rising flour, divided | 2 cans chopped green chile peppers | 1 can chopped green chile peppers, drained
instructions: In a large bowl, mix 1 cup of the flour, julienned 3/4 cup green chilies and green chile peppers. Stir in remaining flour 1 cup at a time, until all ingredients are moistened.

title: Italian Turkey and Artichoke Sausages
ingredients: 4 -5 links of fully cooked fully cooked turkey breast ( approximately 1 pound ) | 4 -5 canned artichoke hearts, drained and chopped, or | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 12 dried figs, cut into thin wedges
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. In a large baking dish, lay out the turkey sausages. Lay out a layer of sliced artichoke heart on top of them. Continue to layer the sausage on top of the artichoke hearts. After all the sausages have been rolled, pour the jar of chopped artichoke hearts over the meat on top of the sausages. Cover and bake for 45 minutes, until done.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,pork,part mozzarella cheese,black bean garlic sauce,strawberry jam,chicken breast fillet,chili paste,artichoke heart
title: Paleo Chicken
ingredients: 800 g pork | 15 -20 g artichoke hearts | 1 tablespoon tomato paste or 1 tablespoon marmite sauce | 1 tablespoon canned black bean and garlic sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 100 g part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 english cucumber | 1 tablespoon strawberry jam
instructions: Heat the grill pan and spray with oil. Grill the pork until well cooked. Cut into bite sized pieces, removing any excess fat if desired. Remove any traces of blood from the pork. Place the chopped roast into a separate dish. Pour the black bean and garlic sauce over it and set aside. Heat the sweet chilli paste in the microwave until warm and hot and stir in well. Cut the cucumber into thin slices, cut the ends off & put the slices in a large serving bowl. Cut the mozzarella into strips. Drain the pork and place it into the bowl with the marinade. Grate the cheese. Add the shredded mozzarella, cucumber, and black bean sauces. Stir until all the cheese is incorporated. Serve on top of warm pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: mustard,coconut extract,greek yogurt,hash brown potato,soya sauce,asparagus,white breadcrumb,beef bouillon powder
title: Paleo Mashed Potatoes With Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, chopped and steamed | 3 medium waxy potato sticks ( about 3/4 cup each, boiled and cut into 1/2 inch pieces ) | 1 cup shredded plain sweet potato | 1/2/3 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon coconut extract ( i prefer kikkoman ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons soya sauce ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon powder
instructions: Cook mashed asparagus in water until tender crisp. Drain. In large bowl, wisk together remaining ingredients. Stir in hot mashed asparagus. Place potatoes in large casserole dish, spoon over potatoes. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes, or until bubbly.

title: Irish Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup bailey's irish cream
instructions: Put all ingredients into a bowl. Serve or refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,ginger,almond extract,red bean,lettuce leaf,focaccia bread
title: Spiedies on Focaccia
ingredients: 1/4 cup thinly sliced orange peel | 1/4 cup finely chopped crystallized ginger | 1/2 cup dried red beans, soaked overnight and then drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 1 loaf focaccia bread, cut into 4 x 1 1/2 inch slices | 6 lettuce leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. In small bowl, combine orange peel, ginger, beans, and almond extract. Brush bread slices with infused oil, place atop toasted bread slices, and place on a baking sheet. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly toasted. Meanwhile, pile lettuce on top of sliced bread. Spread with orange mixture, and serve warm.

title: Almonds and Thyme Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken breast | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs | 7 ounces blanched almonds
instructions: Trim fat, skin and any excess fat from the chicken breast. Cut into 3 inch dice. Place the chicken breast in a large frying pan with the thyme sprigs, and a few blanched almonds. Brush the flesh side with olive oil. Reduce the heat to very low and cook, covered, for about 2 hours, turning occasionally. When cooked, transfer the chicken to a plate, and skim any fat off the surface. Increase the heat under the pan. Increase the heat to very high, place the chicken pieces in and cook for 5 minutes or until browned. Turn them over, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper, and cook for a further 15 minutes. Drain the chicken on kitchen paper, and serve.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,baking powder,water chestnut,chipotle chile,tomato sauce,lemon
title: Spicy Italian Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups crushed tomatoes with chipotle chiles | 1/2 cup water chestnut, chopped | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/8 teaspoon lemons or 1/8 teaspoon black pepper | 3 -4 canned chipotle chiles, pureed ( optional )
instructions: In a small glass or ceramic bowl, puree tomatoes with chilies, water chestnuts and cheese. Stir in baking seasonings. Pour into a jar with a tight fitting lid. Cover and store in refrigerator up to 3 days.

title: Sauce for Roasted Veggies
ingredients: cooking spray | 20 ounces white wine ( choose a flavorful one such as cabernet sauvignon or chardonnay )
instructions: Line a 15 x 10 x 1 inch jelly roll pan with a single layer of aluminum foil. Wrap a heavy duty rubber tub towel up around the tub and set over the foil. Spray the foil with cooking spray. Spread about 2/3 cup dry white wine into the foil and sprinkle with dried fruit. Bring vegetables to the center of the pan. Drizzle with remaining wine. Wrap tight or fold back the foil. Wrap up the entire pan, folding the ends of the foil inward over the veggies. Tightly tie with kitchen twine. Bake at 450 degrees f for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,spice,pear,lamb fillet,active yeast,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Bread of Lamb & Melted Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup chopped pared fresh pear | 1 1/2 cups melted butter or 1 1/2 cups margarine | 2 packages active dry yeast | 3 1/2 - 4 cups bread flour | 1/4 cup mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Using 1/2 cup of the fetta cheese, coat a medium sized baking sheet. Place the rest of the fetta cheese, pears, and melted butter in large bowl. Stir in the yeast and 1 1/2 cups of the flour. Mix well to combine. Add the remaining flour 1/4 cup at a time, stirring well after each addition. Mix in the remaining cheese, using a wooden spoon. The dough will be a little stiff. When the dough becomes rather firm, knead on a floured surface for about 5 minutes, or until dough is smooth and shiny. Cover and let rest for 30 minutes. Divide the dough into golf ball size pieces. Roll flat in the palms of your hands until the dough is flat and about 1/4 inch thick. Sprinkle a little fetta cheese to lightly grease the top. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add about 2 tablespoons of seasoning to the water. Add the balls and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, then remove from heat and set cooked ones aside, keeping warm with the pot covered. When all the bread has cooked, fill the bowls with the bread mixture. Top each bowl with a fried slice of meat, and drizzle with more fetta.

title: Baked Kuihan
ingredients: 2 tablespoons palm sugar or 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1/2 lb beef, ground | 3 ounces sirloin or 3 ounces lamb shoulder, minced | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup potato starch mixed with 1/2 cup water | 1/2 cup broccoli, blanched and cut into pieces
instructions: Prepare the kuihan ingredients by heating the palm sugar, mirin, and beef through the pan of boiling water. Set aside for 5 minutes. Then stir in the sirloin, then add the egg and potato starch mixture. Pour hot kuihan mixture over the meat and vegetables, sprinkle with sugar, then serve.

title: Lasagna Rollups for 2
ingredients: 1 package whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 pounds ground sirloin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread a small spoonful of ricotta cheese across each sirloin shoepeg or other flat surface. Place the ground sirloin in a bowl and set aside. Roll up the ricotta cheese mixture, starting with the wider end, rolling up as necessary, to make a long log. Arrange the rolled up sirloin in a single layer on a baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or as long as overnight. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake rolls in preheated oven until beginning to brown, about 12 minutes. Remove rolls from oven and slice diagonally into 3/4 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,season salt,coconut milk,adobo sauce,blue cheese,monterey jack cheese,vegetable stock
title: Aussie Blue Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1/4 lb blue cheese, grated | 1/4 lb monterey jack cheese, grated | 12 ounces beef stock | 12 ounces vegetable stock | 3 -4 tablespoons adobo sauce | 1 cup coconut milk ( optional ) | 3 -4 tablespoons salt ( to taste )
instructions: Heat the beef stock, vegetable stock, and adobo sauce over medium high heat. Turn down heat. Dump in the coconut milk and salt. Simmer until it is melted and the soup has thickened. Remove the casserole from the heat. Put the blue cheese, monterey jack cheese, and soup in a food processor or blender, and puree until smooth. The soup will be chunky. Serve..

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,barbeque sauce,tomato green chilies,purple onion,basil leaf,chicken broth,oatmeal,elbow macaroni
title: Easy Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups elbow macaroni | 3/4 lb deli-roasted chicken breast | 1 can whole tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 3/4 cup chopped purple onion | 2 ounces oatmeal | 1 tablespoon barbeque sauce | 3 -4 fresh basil leaves
instructions: In 2 quart rectangular baking dish, stir together macaroni, chicken, tomatoes, broth, onion, oatmeal, barbeque sauce and basil leaves. Cover and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes. Uncover and continue baking for another 25 minutes or until pasta is al dente.

title: Oatmeal and Apple Salad
ingredients: 225 g porridge oats, washed | 2 golden delicious apples, peeled, cored, and roughly chopped | 1/4 cup finely chopped spring onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place porridge oats, apples and spring onions in a bowl and gently toss to mix. Transfer to a baking tray and bake for 10 minutes and serve warm.

title: Roasted Pork
ingredients: 4 lbs large boneless pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Trim excess fat. Tear off excess fat and discard. On a large cutting board, using a meat tenderizer, gently pound the pork shoulder with the flat of a cleaver to flatten it slightly. Spread out evenly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread out the pork evenly with your hands. Remove plastic wrap and rub some of the pork with your hands onto pork. Sprinkle rice vinegar evenly over the pork, pressing against the surface. Place pork in a shallow roasting pan on top of a sheet of aluminum foil. Roast uncovered until pork is slightly charred at edges and beginning to render some fat on top. This may take up to 2 hours. Allow to rest about 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Apple Cider Vinegar - Salsa
ingredients: 6 cups apple cider vinegar | 1 pound asparagus, trimmed
instructions: Place the vinegar and asparagus in a large pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,hamburger,glace ginger,red chili pepper,liquid smoke,jicama,dijon mustard,island dressing
title: Island Ham & Jicama Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 lb hamburger ( or ground sausage ) | 1 jicama, peeled & cut into smallish chunks | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon ginger, grated | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper, seeds in | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves, crushed | 1 teaspoon bottled jamaican jerk spice | 2 ounces thousand island dressing
instructions: Mix the mustards with liquid smoke, ginger, galic, jama, chili and oregano. Dip the hamburger in the mixture and allow to rest for 10 - 15 minutes covered in marinade. Spread the mustard mixture all over the hamburger. Wrap in plastic wrap and put in the fridge for at least one hour. Slice the jicama into 1/2 slices and arrange on a platter with a few slivers of jerk spice on each slice of jicama. When ready to serve, take the napa napa napa and slice it into 1 lengths if necessary.

title: Green Beans Fajitas
ingredients: 1 cup frozen cut green beans | 1 lb ground beef, browned & drained | 4 large flour tortillas, warmed | 1/2 cup steak seasoning | 1/2 lemon peel, grated
instructions: Cook beans as directed on package. Meanwhile, heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat 1 minute. Place beef, green beans and half the seasoning in skillet. Cook until well browned. Stir into beans.

title: Queso Mexicano Queso
ingredients: 1 cup queso fresco | 1 package frozen mixed olives
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Place 1 cup of queso fresco in a square of aluminum foil. Spread it out so the top faces up. Take one piece of the block of queso fresco and wrap around the queso fresco. Fold one side of the queso fresco right over the queso fresco, and roll it up. Repeat with the remaining queso fresco and olives. Place the queso fresco on a jelly roll pan lined with aluminum foil. Let stand in the oven, and let stand for 20 minutes. Remove aluminum foil and pour olive oil into pan. Drizzle olive oil over queso fresco and olives. Return to the oven until queso is puffed and browned. Cut into squares, and serve with warm corn tortillas.

title: Roast Pork & Caramelised Veal Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour | 2 -3 lbs pork roast or 2 -3 lbs sirloin roast | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 -3 lbs veal, sliced
instructions: Place the flour in a shallow dish and make a well in the centre. Dredge the roast in the flour using half of the sugar. Heat half the butter in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Put the roast in to the pan and cook, turning, until browning on all sides. Sprinkle the remaining sugar over the meat and give it a good stir. Place the meat onto a piece of foil or two large oven proof dinner sized dinner rolls. Place a slice of veal on top of each piece of meat and pour over enough boiling water to cover. Bring to the boil and reduce the heat to low. Cook for 40 - 50 minutes, until the meat is tender. Transfer the meat to a carving board and cut into thin slices before carving the meat.

title: Quick and Easy Crusted Haddock
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 pound haddock, rinsed and well drained | 1/2 cup melted butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a bowl, melt 1/2 cup of butter. Add cream, haddock and 1/2 cup melted butter. Mix lightly, then spread mixture on a flat surface. Rinse and pat dry, then sprinkle generously with remaining 1/2 cup melted butter. Place haddock in a baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for about 15 minutes.

title: Almond Paste
ingredients: 16 ounces poppy seeds ( hulled ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry mustard | 1/2 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional ) | 1/2 cup almond paste, of your choice
instructions: Take a baking tray and spread the poppy seeds on it, spreading it out evenly. Mix the mustard, cayenne and almond paste together and spread on the poppy seeds. Bake on 400 degrees for about 10 minutes. This would be best if allowed to cool and it will thicken up a bit. Cool and serve.

title: Mexican Chicken on the Grill #RSC
ingredients: 6 -8 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 lime | 1 cup tarragon | 1 jar pizza sauce | 1 package italian cheese blend, shredded | 8 dried shiitake mushrooms, sliced thin
instructions: Remove the peel from your lime. Using a zester, extract the juice from 1 lime into a large bowl. Squeeze the lime pulp as much as possible from the flesh. Add the juice. Slice the chicken thighs in half lengthwise, then tear the chicken thighs apart. Mix chicken pieces with remaining ingredients. Serve onto a large platter or plates.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,brown rice,lime juice,canola oil,graham cracker crumb,cayenne pepper,egg substitute,grain white rice
title: Lime Rice Pie
ingredients: 8 ounces long grain white rice, uncooked | 1 cup egg substitute or 2 -3 eggs | 1/4 cup canola oil or 1/4 cup olive oil | 2 cups lime juice | 1/2 cup brown rice | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs or 2 cups grated nut crusts | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Place rice in a large bowl, add water to cover. Set aside for 15 - 20 minutes until tender and fluffy. Preheat oven to 450°f. Prepare a 9 inch tart pan by spraying the bottom and sides with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, beat eggs in another bowl with fork. Pour oil evenly over lemon rice, then add egg mixture, beating until combined. Add lime juice and stir well. Add half of the brown rice, then spread mixture evenly into baking dish and top with remaining rice. Stir together graham cracker crumbs, cayenne pepper, and cardamom using a fork. Sprinkle evenly over top of pie. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until lightly browned. Let cool slightly before cutting into wedges and serving.

title: Cheese and Bacon Kebab
ingredients: 2 packages cottage cheese, shredded or 2 cartons cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon kosher salt
instructions: Using hands or a food processor, mix the contents of the packet of cottage cheese into the contents of the mixing bowl, including the salt, making sure well incorporated. If your kitchen is very dry, you may have to press the contents slightly. If they are wet and dry, dry them now. The cheese should be slightly limp. Make sure the cheese is well drained and crumbly and no longer crumbly.. Line a baking sheet with tin foil. Place a handful of the cheese mixture onto the center of the foil and roll out to fit the baking sheet. Press the cheese mixture in the baking pan to coat evenly. Repeat with the remaining cheese mixture and paneer until all the cheese is used up. Bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven until golden brown, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Tara's White Bean Cakes
ingredients: 4 cans cannellini beans | 500 g golden caster sugar ( super fine ) | 500 g low-fat plain yogurt | 200 g parsnips, grated
instructions: Drain the beans well. Combine the sugar and yogurt together in a small pot on a low medium heat. Cook until the mixture becomes pale orange. Add the cooked beans and parsnips, mix thoroughly. Add more yogurt if you need to.

title: Pickling Water
ingredients: 20 ml pickling salt | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Make sure the salt is clean. Pour the salt into a clean glass jar. Add 1 pinch of asafoetida powder. Seal and leave in a cool dark place for 24 hours to ferment in a dark, cool, dry place. It's ready when the salt turns a rich, dark reddish yellowish color.

Random Ingredients: dashi,canola oil,pimiento,icing sugar,cooking oil,sea salt,vidalia onion,tomato puree
title: Japanese Onion Dipping Sauce (Niku-Yaki)
ingredients: 1/3 cup canola oil ( use light tasting ) | 1 large vidalia onion ( about 1/2 large ) | 1 teaspoon sea salt or 1 teaspoon table salt | 1 can tomato puree ( i use hunts ) | 1 tablespoon pimentos or 1 tablespoon other oil ( optional ) | 1 cup dashi ( optional-i like to have dashi granules in the packet, make certain to have dashi granules in the box ) or 2 -3 tablespoons water ( optional-i like to have dashi granules in the packet, make certain to have dashi granules in the box ) | icing sugar ( to dust or top )
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the onion then sauté in the canola oil until golden brown then add the salt and tomato puree. Add the can of dashi / fish soup / beef stock powder and bring to a boil then lower. Add a few dashi granules to taste. It will be very slightly thick and it will thicken as it cools. I usually add 1 - 2 tblsp to each serving. Sprinkle with icing sugar. This is nice served on toasted nori or nori kabab. If you don't have toasted nori kabab, chop it up very fine or use something a bit shorter than the recipe suggested — just use 1 - 2 teaspoons of chopped up dried breadcrumbs or crumbs.

title: Potatoes & Wild Mushrooms Skewers With Grated Cotija
ingredients: 250 g red potatoes, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons arrowroot ( as required ) or 2 tablespoons cornflour ( as required ) | 200 g mixed wild mushrooms ( such as chanterelles waxy chanterelles, soaked for 40 minutes in hot water then drained ) or 200 g cremini mushrooms, soaked for 40 minutes in hot water ( such as chanterelles waxy chanterelles, soaked in hot water then drained ) | 1 -2 cup cotija cheese, crumbled ( as required, see note below ) | fresh dill sprigs
instructions: Pour about 2 tablespoons of arrowroot to a bowl or sieve. Dry and line a baking tray with foil. Cut the potatoes into 1 inch cubes. Place the cubes in the mixture and mix well with a fork. Pour 1 or 2 tablespoons of arrowroot on a plate and roll the potatoes to coat the potato cubes with the arrowroot. Chop the mushrooms roughly. Place the potatoes in a bowl and cover with cold water. Put aside for 15 minutes, or until completely cold to touch. Drain the potatoes very well and arrange them on the prepared baking tray. Sprinkle with the crumbled cheese. Set aside in a cool place. Preheat the barbecue. Pour 1 to 2 tablespoons of water over the potatoes and mushrooms. Using a sturdy wooden skewer, poke a series of holes in the potatoes. Pour more water over the potatoes as required, and allow to baste from time to time with the grill. Grill on both sides until they are tender and nicely browned, about 20 minutes. Serve immediately, garnished with chopped dill.

title: Chile Risotto
ingredients: 5 cups lukewarm water ( divided into small amounts ) | 8 ounces arborio rice | 12 fresh whole green chilies ( optional ) | 1 egg white
instructions: Place 1/4 cup of the water in a 3 quart bowl and start cooking the rice, chiles and a pinch of sugar in the water until it is soft and beginning to change color. When the water is almost fully absorbed turn the heat down again. Mix in the remaining cup of water and the egg white until thoroughly blended. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes so the rice can absorb the liquid. Risotto can be served hot or cold.

title: Pickled Tarragon
ingredients: 1/2 cup tarragon, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chile, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Sift all ingredients into bowl. Cover and leave several hours or overnight. Keep refrigerated. To serve, sprinkle with ground chilies and/or tricolor. Goes well with steak.

title: Tamale Casserole
ingredients: 7 ounces beef tamales | 1/2 cup picante sauce, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wrap 1/2 cup picante sauce in each tamale.

title: Artichoke Hearts and Artichokes
ingredients: 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and chopped | 1 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Mix all the ingredients except the artichoke hearts in a large bowl. Drop by spoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Vietnamese Bananas (Vietnamese-Style)
ingredients: 2 bananas | 2 ounces pancetta ( cut crosswise into slices ) | 1/2 red chili pepper ( cut into thin slices ) | 2 fresh red chili peppers ( cut into thin slices ) | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/4 cup cognac ( or brandy ) | 1 lb thin diagonally sliced baguette ( french or italian type baguette )
instructions: Slice each banana crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Arrange on a serving platter, cut side down. Slice the pancetta sticks into thin short, strips and place in a small bowl. Slice the peppers into thick strips and place them in a small bowl. Heat the wok over high heat and when it is hot, add the pancetta slices and red chili rings. Toss until the pancetta melts and the slices are hot. Place the slices in the wok and stir until they start to brown. Place the bananas on top of the bacon. Heat the sauce over medium heat and slowly stir in the cognac until the flames start to run. Pour the sauce over the bananas and serve immediately.

title: Thai Wasabi Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk, divided | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon wasabi
instructions: Whisk together 1/4 cup buttermilk and artichoke hearts in a bowl. Stir catsup, fish sauce and wasabi into the vinegar mixture until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Indian Spiced Cookies With Herbs
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons cilantro leaves ( packed ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Mix the cilantro and baking power in a small bowl. Take a small teaspoon of the spice mixture and roll it in the palms of your hands so that it is completely coated. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or lightly oiled. Chill for at least 3 hours if you plan on using these. Preheat the oven to 375°f. Cookies should be firm and slightly crispy in the last 5 - 10 minutes of rolling and should be completely crisp around the edge. Allow to cool. If not using right away cut on a diagonal into 1/2 inch pieces or smaller pieces. These cookies will keep several days refrigerated.

title: Tuna on Toast
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 6 slices bread dough | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Place the tuna in the middle of each bread slice and brush with brandy. Roll up and serve with mustard.

title: Caramelized Green Chillies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts | 1 fresh thyme sprig, or two teaspoons thyme | 1 -2 -2 -3 medium green chili, depending on how hot and how hot you like them
instructions: Use a small skillet over the medium low heat. Drizzle with the roasted peanuts, and sprinkle with the thyme or thyme stalks. Alternatively you can sprinkle these with red pepper flakes. Add the chillies and stir for a minute or two until the chillies are a lovely shade of golden brown. Take the pan out of the heat and let cool slightly. Store in an airtight container. Note chillies will keep up to a week or two in the refrigerator. Enjoy.

title: Tender & Delicious Barley Lentil and Brown Rice Salad
ingredients: 250 g brown lentils | 1 cup stone-ground rice | 1 iceberg lettuce | 200 g gruyere cheese ( or your favourite variety ) | 1/2 cup soy sauce
instructions: Combine the lentils, rice and 3 cups boiling water in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered 2 hours. Cover and remove from heat. Allow to cool while you prepare the garnishes. Scoop out the lettuce into a salad bowl and toss with half the cheese. Place the rice, lentils & cheese into a serving bowl, and sprinkle rest of cheese over the top. Top with the dressing. Serve with a crisp seasonal green salad, such as baby greens or mixed salad greens.

title: Crispy Queso - Cheese Omelet
ingredients: 1 tortillas | 2 tablespoons shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 spring onion, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Use a griddle or frying pan to cook the tortilla. It should take about 10 - 15 seconds on each side depending on your griddle. Spread evenly the griddle/frying pan with half the cheese. Sprinkle over the spring onion if using. When the bottom of the queso has turned black and starts to sizzle, turn it over. When underside is just starting to get marked turn other side. Remove from grill, allow to sit for 2 minutes. Spread remaining half of cheese over the tortilla, then sprinkle over remaining spring onion. If you wish, cut into wedges to serve.

title: Indonesian Crispy Shallots
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 3 large shallots, peeled and sliced into long thin strips
instructions: Heat oil in wok or deep pan over medium heat. When oil is almost smoking, add shallots and stir fry 2 minutes or until they are golden, taking care not to overcook them. Drain and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: jumbo shrimp,grape leaf,cornstarch,seasoning salt,ginger garlic paste,cream,green chili pepper,arugula
title: Chile-Garlic Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 10 medium grape leaves | 1 packet baby arugula | ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 -2 green chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Arrange shrimp on a single layer on a baking sheet, and pour boiling water over the shrimp. Turn shrimp once while they're still in the water. Let sit, and then pat dry with paper towel. In a bowl, mix cornstarch, sour cream, and seasoning salt. Add chili peppers and fresh chopped ginger garlic, and mix well to blend. Reserve 1/4 of the chopped, drained shrimp for garnish. If you still feel like a little bit of zing, rinse shrimp thoroughly with cold water. Place shrimp in a bowl with the cornstarch mixture. Toss with shrimp and remaining salad greens.

title: Mac 'n Cheese Squash
ingredients: 1 small butternut squash, about 3 pounds | 2 bay leaves | 1 pinch savory, or to taste | 1/2 cup shredded chihuahua cheese, or to taste
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Pierce the squash with a fork in a spiral to cut into chunks. Place the squash chunks in a shallow baking dish. Cover each piece with the bay leaves, and season with savory. Cover the dish with a lid or aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the squash is starting to soften and the squash is tender and beginning to brown, 1 1/2 hours. Uncover, and increase the temperature to 400 degrees f. Stir in the queso cheese to taste.

title: Curried Almond Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups of chopped almonds | 2 cans bamboo shoots | 1/4 - 1/2 cup good curry powder
instructions: Cook and stir almonds in 2 - 3 tablespoons of olive oil until golden brown. Remove from heat and place in strainer to drain a bit of the oil. When cool crumble and set aside. Repeat until all nuts have been crumbled. Spray a skillet with spray. Saute nuts until golden all over. You want to make them a little crunchy but not too mushy, so they won't burn. You can also add a splash of white wine. I have had them on the grill. Serve warm with butter and green mango chutney.

title: Beef With Cilantro Guacamole Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 jalapeno chile, minced | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 cup hot stock | 1 cup bottled guacamole | 2 tablespoons fresh marjoram, finely chopped | 3/4 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
