instructions: In a medium saucepan, cook beef, chile, marjoram, cayenne and 1 1/2 teaspoons water. Drain and set aside. Heat spray oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add beef mixture, cook 3 minutes and stir to combine. Reduce heat to med low. Stir in stock and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer until meat is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Stir in guacamole and marjoram. Heat through, 5 minutes. Serve with reserved sauce.

title: Butternut Squash With Pearl Barley (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 1/4 cup pearl barley, raw | 2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Cut squash in half, remove seeds& scoop out seeds. Place squash back in slow cooker, sprinkle barley around it and add cumin powder. Turn on low and cook for 6 to 8 hours or on high.

title: Lazy Ravioli
ingredients: 20 ounces prepared short pasta shells | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta 8 minutes, or until al dente. Drain. Transfer to a large bowl, and mix in the whipped topping. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Stir in the pasta, and serve immediately.

title: Spicy Chickpea and Yellow Squash Rice Salad
ingredients: 225 g rice, cooked | 115 g yellow squash, chopped | 115 g mango chutney | 115 g mascarpone cheese | 110 g chickpeas ( canned ) | 1/3 cup plain breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Place cooked rice in a bowl, add the squash, mango chutney, mascarpone cheese, chickpeas and breadcrumbs. Toss well. Place salad on serving plates and drizzle with vinegar.

title: Yummy and Spooky Friendly Chocolate Baking
ingredients: 1 chocolate bar ( i got mine from my local a chocolate bar, and it seemed like enough ) or 2 squares semisweet chocolate, baking squares | 1 teaspoon dried guavah or 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 2 bananas, sliced
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the chocolate bar on the parchment and sprinkle the guavah or adobo on it. Add a spoonful of the chocolate or adobo into a small circle. Place the sliced bananas on top of the chocolate. Sprinkle about 1/2 teaspoon of salt on it. Sprinkle about 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper onto it. Place in a small, clean bowl and cover. Let the chocolate set up for about 20 minutes. Unwrap and carefully remove the parchment and/or wrap around the banana and parchment paper. The bananas will be wet inside and out.

title: String Bean Cakes
ingredients: 6 green string beans, trimmed and cut into 2 cm pieces | 1 tablespoon chopped green capsicum
instructions: Mix all ingredients together using your hands. Use to fill a patty shell, patty shell with any leftover filling mixture. Spray lightly with cooking oil cooking spray and fry until golden brown, 1 - 2 minutes each side.

title: Irish Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried currants | 2 tablespoons dried garlic flakes
instructions: If the dried flakes have any clumps, rub them onto the dried dried flakes and toss with the dried flakes. Store in an air tight container.

title: Aioli (Leek & Leek Butter)
ingredients: 4 leeks, white parts only | 100 ml strong coffee | 225 g unsweetened cocoa | salt and pepper
instructions: Trim and finely slice the leeks, and place in a heavy based pan with 100ml water. Bring to the boil, cover, reduce the heat and simmer gently for about 20 to 30 minutes until cooked but not soft. Allow to cool slightly. Remove and discard the root ends and the hard leek white ends. Cut off the leek flesh and finely chop. Bring 100ml strong coffee to the boil, then stir in the drained cooked leeks. Boil rapidly for a few minutes, but do not boil immediately because the flavour is released. Pour in 2 tablespoon portions onto a serving plate or leave to harden. Cover with a small piece of cheesecloth to prevent drying. Melt the butter over a low heat or microwave on high for 10 to 15 seconds. Taste for salt. Makes 2 to 3 cups. Keep refrigerated until needed.

title: Sauce and Swiss Mini Chocolate Calzones
ingredients: 3 tablespoons plain flour | 1/4 cup cocoa | 2 tablespoons green beans, cooked ( frozen or canned ) | 12 -16 ounces cooked spaghetti or 12 -16 ounces wholemeal spaghetti | 1 tart apple, peeled and finely chopped | 7 scallions, finely chopped | 3 drops good quality hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Whisk the flour and cocoa in a bowl. Add the beans and apples and stir. Add the scallions and stir. Add the hot sauce and whisk again. Drop the mixture by heaped tablespoons onto a baking sheet lined with baking paper. Smooth a bit if the surface doesn't adhere. Spray the tops with oil spray or bake at 200c for 8 - 10 minutes till golden. Allow to cool before cutting and serving.

title: Chili Roasted Potato Salad
ingredients: 6 -8 medium potatoes | 1 package velveeta cheese | 3 -4 fresh chili peppers ( your favorite chilies! ) | 1 lemon or 1 lime, juice of ( optional )
instructions: Cut small potatoes into wedges. Rinse and trim chili peppers, reserving 2 tablespoons of chilies. Dice the remaining chiles. Place the potatoes in a large saucepan of cold water, add the reserved hot chiles, and bring to a boil. Cook, covered, for 10 - 15 minutes or until tender. Drain and allow to cool to room temperature. Dice the cheese. Squeeze the juice of the 1 lemon or lime into the hot cheese slices. Toss with the potatoes until evenly coated, and serve at room temperature or chilled. If you wish to serve this on the side, serve it on a plate and drizzle with a little bit of the chile juice or the juice of the 3rd lemon or lime.

Random Ingredients: salmon steak,swiss cheese,egg white,cheddar cheese,rice milk
title: Aussie Salmon and Rice Pie
ingredients: 4 salmon steaks | 2 boxes rice milk | 1 egg white | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Coat fish with egg whites. Cook rice according to directions on box. In a pie plate, pour rice milk, then sprinkle the 2 packages of cheese on top of that. Cover, then cook about 8 minutes at 370 degrees until cheese is melted on top. Remove from oven and let sit 5 minutes longer before serving.

Random Ingredients: almond,spring onion,jigger vodka,serrano pepper,wheat bread,beef chuck,puff pastry
title: Aced Beef Wellington Pie
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed of fat and cut into 1-inch dice ( or substitute ground beef round for beef chuck, or substitute lamb or pork for the beef ) | 4 pieces whole wheat bread | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 8 ounces pickled red peppers, drained and thinly sliced | 5 ounces pickled jiggers vodka | 2 tablespoons chopped spring onions or 2 tablespoons scallions | 4 serrano peppers ( or other hot pepper ), thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place chuck and one piece of bread on work surface and place 1 pastry piece on top, overlapping slightly to shape a 3 inch circle, pressing edges to seal. Repeat with remaining bread and pieces. Line a pastry lined baking sheet with a damp towel. Place the pastry circle in front of you and gently press the edges firmly to seal. Sprinkle bread with the black pepper slices. Place the beef in a nonstick single layer in the centre of the dough, and surround with red and green peppers and pickled red peppers. Cover with the remaining circle of pastry, pressing edges to seal. Cover with foil and place in the oven. Bake 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes longer, or until the pastry is golden brown and the beef has begun to shrink from the edges of the crust. Cool. Remove beef from oven and discard crust and any excess pastry. Cut into thin slices and serve. Alternatively, this tasty beef serves as the filling for sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: mccormick seasoning,curry powder,white rice flour,catsup,radish,gelatin powder
title: Curried Salmon
ingredients: 3 cups white rice flour | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | 1 teaspoon gelatin powder | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup radish, thinly sliced
instructions: Mix flour, curry powder and montreal steak seasoning in a bowl. Cut salmon into 4 equal pieces. Dip salmon into gelatin mixture, then into rice flour. Spread salmon into a jelly roll pan. Top each piece with catsup and radishes. Place in the freezer for one hour to firm up.

title: Za'atar Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon za'atar spice mix ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs sirloin
instructions: Rinse the meat and pat dry thoroughly. Using kitchen tweezers or large scissors, pound the meat until it is very thin and somewhat thick. Mix the za'atar with the peppercorns and rub it onto the meat. Place the meat on a rack in a roasting pan and cover loosely with foil. Roast in a pre heated 275 f. Oven or 275 f. Oven for 2 hours total.

title: Smoked Saltimbocca
ingredients: 16 ounces smoked saltimbocca ( about 1/3 pound ) | 1/3 lb thinly sliced prosciutto | 1/4 cup fresh white breadcrumb | 1 medium scallion, thinly sliced on the diagonal | 1 teaspoon malt extract
instructions: If it is to be grilled, you may want to use a nonstick frying pan for this recipe. In a large bowl, soak the white bread crumbs with a little vinegar. Remove the saltimbocca from the bowl and pat dry. Using a slice of prosciutto, make a slit down the center of it with either the end of a small knife or a toothpick. Reserve a strip of prosciutto, for garnish. In a large skillet, heat all of the remaining ingredients until bubbly. As soon as the sauce is bubbling, drop the smoked saltimbocca on the hot pan of flavor, and spread evenly. Let the saltimbocca cook for 90 seconds. Use slotted spatula and remove it from the pan. Sprinkle with more saltimbocca. Let rest for about 5 minutes, then serve. Note, if you use regular smoked saltimbocca, the smoked saltimbocca can be cooked in a hot pan of rapidly boiling water for 5 to 10 minutes per side, depending on how crisp the prosciutto is.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,bailey irish cream,baking powder,cantaloupe,spice,tomato green chilies
title: Tomato Yummy Baked Cherpe
ingredients: 2 lbs cubed ripe tomatoes ( or 4 -6 fresh tomatoes ) | 4 -6 green cardamom pods ( or 2 pods, bruised ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 2 ounces baileys irish cream | 1 -2 teaspoon mixed spice ( i use paul prudhomme jamaican spice mix mix ) | 1/2 cup sliced cantaloupe
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a baking tray with aluminium foil. Toss the fruits with 1tbsp mixed spice and coat. Arrange on the baking tray. Bake until golden. Cool 5 - 10 minutes, then cover tightly and chill completely before serving or keep up to 2 days. Enjoy.

title: Sweet Pasta With Custard Sauce
ingredients: 300 g penne ( can use any pasta you prefer, any will do but i prefer the sweet spiral pasta ) | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Dough cook pasta when it comes out of the water. Drain pasta when ready. Filling mix egg white, sugar and vanilla. Then add drained pasta and mix well. Then top with cream cheese and grated cheese,. Enjoy.

title: Easy Salsa Dip
ingredients: 16 fluid ounces chunky salsa | 2 1/4 cups caster sugar | 3 cups grated romano cheese | 6 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Put everything in a bowl and stir until thoroughly combined. Cover the bowl and chill for at least 1 hour. Serve with chunks of fresh or crunchy vegetables for dipping.

Random Ingredients: turkey sausage,sesame seed,part ricotta cheese,maple syrup
title: Sausage and Spinach Bake
ingredients: 12 ounces smoked turkey sausage, casings removed | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/4 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons flaked sesame seeds
instructions: Set oven to 350 degrees. Cook sausage in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, breaking into 1 inch pieces with back of spoon, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in maple syrup.

title: Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 - 1 cup white wine, enough to equal 1 can, i use merlot
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a 4 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours. My slow cooker is for 1 hour and 30 minutes, and i cook on low for 10 - 15 minutes to thicken the liquid.

title: Mango Quesadillas With Star Anise
ingredients: 4 cups ripe mangoes | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 whole wheat tortilla | 1 star anise
instructions: Peel mangos and place in blender. Heat oil in a pan over medium high heat. Add whole wheat tortilla. Cook on both sides until golden brown. Remove from pan and place on plate lined with paper towel. Spread sliced mangoes on top. Roll tortilla around the mangoes. Sprinkle with star anise and serve.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,espresso powder,green tea powder,flour tortilla,red chile,snow pea,chive,egg substitute
title: Green Chili, Snow Pea & Eggs Burritos
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon green tea powder | 1/8 cup egg substitute | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder | 15 ounces snow peas, trimmed | 8 leaves fresh mint leaves, thinly sliced | 2 medium red chiles, coarsely chopped | 2 8-inch flour tortillas | 3 tablespoons fresh chives, snipped
instructions: Combine green tea powder with egg substitute and espresso, whisk until smooth. Place snow peas on plates.

title: Taco Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 3 cups tomato juice | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Dissolve taco seasoning in tomato juice. Add beef cube. Heat on high for 2 - 3 minutes or until it is hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: banana,bamboo shoot,yellow squash,garam masala,mustard powder,wheat flour,sage
title: Brown Stewed Banana and Squash
ingredients: 6 bananas, sliced | 2 yellow squash, sliced | 2 cups bamboo shoots, sliced, drained | 1/3 cup wheat flour | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Prepare the brown stew, preheat oven to 300°f. In a bowl, mix the flour with the mustard powder, sage, garam masala and mix well. Spray a 1 inch deep baking dish with cooking spray. Heat the banana and squash in the microwave, for 2 - 3 minute. Add the toms, mix, then pour the brown stew evenly over the top. Bake 50 - 60 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,saffron thread,banana,tropical fruit pineapple,black peppercorn,thyme,wheat english muffin
title: Saffron and Pineapple Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups mixed tropical dried fruit ( pineapple, applesauce or apricots ) | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt | 1 banana, sliced | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/8 teaspoon black peppercorns | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme, chopped | 4 whole wheat english muffins
instructions: Toss together the dried fruit with the yogurt, banana, saffron, black peppercorns and thyme. Lightly toast the english muffins, but do not allow mixture to brown. Spread the bean mixture on the cut side of each muffin loaf, and top with the toast. Slice the grilled fruit and serve.

title: Manicotti
ingredients: 10 -12 large shrimp, rinsed and deveined | 1 yellow onion | 3 packages puff pastry sheets ( refrigerated for 2 days or frozen for 3 months ) | 1 jar manicotti, drained | honey
instructions: Boil water in a large dutch oven and let it boil in a large pot for a couple of minutes and when it boils remove from heat and set aside. Finely dice the onion and sauté it. Stir the shrimp, chopped onions and the drained manicotti into the pot. The noodles should be about 3/4 to 1 inch in diameter. Cover and let the mixture simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Lay out the frozen puff pastry sheets on a clean floured surface and sprinkle it with the honey to coat the sheets. Lay out 10 to 12 small rounds out on the prepared sheets, each sheet about 9 inches long and 6 inches wide on each sheet of dough. Place two shrimp mixture into each dough round. Fold the dough in half over the shrimp mixture and press to seal the edges with a fork. Place them on a pan cookie sheet lined with wax paper that has been sprayed with pam or the addition of a few teaspoons of olive oil or shortening. Refrigerate for at least two hours or up to two days to firm them up. Bake in a hot oven 400 degrees for about 20 to 22 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Linguine
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dry non-fat powdered milk chocolate | 1/2 whole ham hock | 6 slices ham | 1 package linguine | 4 ounces milk chocolate | 1 tablespoon dark rum
instructions: Mix 1 tablespoon of the milk chocolate with 1/4 pound of the ham hock in a 9x13 pan. Place remaining ham in a separate pan and brown. Remove ham. Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain linguine, pour noodles onto the ham. Pour remaining milk chocolate mixture over the linguine and noodle and mix to coat. Sprinkle with remaining shredded parmesan cheese. If desired, top with a drizzle of rum.

Random Ingredients: nacho cheese flavor doritos,sake,parsnip,jicama,confectioner sugar,garlic powder
title: Garlic Sausage Squash Rollups
ingredients: 6 medium parsnips, peeled and finely grated | 1 cup grated jicama | 1/2 cup finely chopped confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup sake | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 packages nacho cheese flavor doritos, or more as needed ( optional )
instructions: Place grated parsnips in a large bowl.

title: Cheesy Hot Chili Dogs
ingredients: 6 small chili peppers ( seeded and diced, i like the hot ones ) ( optional ) | 3/4 lb grated mozzarella cheese
instructions: Slice off the tops of the peppers. Use a teaspoon to scrape out the seeds, taking care not to pierce the membranes. Place the peppers on a plate and sprinkle with salt. Let sit for 30 minutes or longer. Meanwhile, place the cheese on a plate and spread them out with a rolling pin so that the cheese slices get roundy shapes. Toast under the broiler to remove from the heat. These can be heated thoroughly or on the grill if preferred.

title: Tomatillo Roasted Apricot Salsa - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon shallot, minced | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 4 -5 vine ripe tomatillo salsa, rinsed and drained ( or fresh ) | 3/4 cup apricot preserves ( or preserves of your choice-my preference ) | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Position the rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 475 degrees f. Warm oven proof serving dishes on the rack for 5 - 10 minutes, depending on the oven. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook shallot and savory for 5 minutes. Add tomatillo salsa, jam and rice wine.

title: Prawn 'n Chips
ingredients: 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 lb jumbo shrimp, cleaned, unpeeled
instructions: Mix soup, hot sauce and chili powder thoroughly in a large bowl. Add shrimp and mix thoroughly. Marinate 1 hour in the refrigerator. Drain shrimp completely and mix again. Use one hand to toss with the mixture. Grill, uncovered, over hot coals.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,russet potato,rigatoni pasta,wild rice,ranch bean,margarine,hamburger,mustard seed
title: Rigatoni Florentine
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 pound lean hamburger | 1 can ranch-style beans | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 1/2 pounds russet potatoes, sliced | 1 package cottage cheese | 1 package dry wild rice
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Pineapple Coffee
ingredients: 1 cup coffee | 2 cans pineapple tidbits, drained
instructions: Dip 1 cup of coffee, drained, into the can of pineapple tidbits. Store the rest of the can in an airtight container. To use, heat this in a saucepan over hot water.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,rye breadcrumb,cilantro,watercress,green bell pepper,chili sauce
title: Blackened Green Pepper and Cilantro Salad With Rye Crumbs
ingredients: 1/2 green bell pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/3 cup cilantro, chopped | 3/4 cup plain rye breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons chili sauce ( bottled ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/3 cup watercress, finely chopped
instructions: Combine bell pepper and cilantro in a bowl and process in processor until finely chopped. Combine breadcrumbs and remaining ingredients and process until mixture is a crumb like consistency. Form into a disk shape and chill for 20 minutes. Cut into 1/2 inch slices and serve with chilled rye salad.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,ladyfinger,apple juice,mexican cheese,cannellini bean,mushroom
title: Mexican Layered Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup chopped fresh mushrooms | 1/2 cup sour cream ( i use low fat ) | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1/3 cup apple juice | 8 -12 ladyfingers or 8 -12 chocolate chip disks
instructions: Pour 1/2 of the beans into bottom of casserole dish. Layer the bean, mushrooms, sour cream and peanut butter on top of the beans and seasonings. Top with remaining beans. Combine apple juice and remaining apple juice. Pour over bean mixture. Cool in refrigerator overnight. Serve with chips.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,salt black pepper,parmesan cheese,cooking spray,pea
title: Lemon-Pepper Vegetable Sprouts
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 cups fresh peas, shelled ( or frozen and unsalted frozen ) | 2 tablespoons fresh grated lemon peel | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese ( or romano cheese ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f degrees. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray on all sides. Add peas.

title: Sweet (And-Or Flavor) Braggs
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup bragg's liquid aminos
instructions: Mix the brown sugar and liquid aminos thoroughly in a bowl. Let stand for 8 to 10 hours. Keep refrigerated if not using right away.

title: Passion Fruit Kebab
ingredients: 3 medium passion fruit | 1 cup slivered almonds | 5 tablespoons slivered almonds flavored liqueur | 5 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: Cut the seedless tops off each passion fruit, and remove the pulp. Cut pulp into halves, and scoop out the inside. Add the pulp, almonds, liqueur, and 5 tablespoons melted margarine to the top of each passion fruit. Seat the kebab on a lightly greaseed grill rack, or as is. Grill, turning frequently, until very well and evenly browned on the sides. Note, the kebabs can be cooked on a preheated rack over a broiler, and served hot along with cream.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,dark soy sauce,cocoa,vegetable stock,rosemary,cumin powder,pork shoulder
title: Chinese Hot Pot
ingredients: 1/3 tablespoon cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons rosemary | 1/3 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons rosemary | 1/4 pint vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/2 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 750 g pork shoulder, trimmed of all fat
instructions: Add all ingredients in a bowl and stir well. Pierce the meat with a fork and rub the marinade underneath. Place on the crock and cover and cook for 3 hours or longer.

Random Ingredients: spanish rice,daikon radish,mace,french bread,tomato juice,mexican cheese,kahlua,pork roast
title: Smokey Spanish Pork Shredded Beef on a Bed of Rice
ingredients: 2 loaves french bread ( about 2-1/2 inches in diameter ) | 1 3/4 lbs boneless pork roast, thinly sliced | 12 ounces v8 spanish rice | 1 can beef-flavored pure tomato juice | 7 ounces v8 kahlua | 6 ounces kahlua | 1 dash ground mace | 1/2 cup sliced daikon radish
instructions: Remove rind from bread, if necessary. Place bread cubes in a 9x13 baking dish, making sure they're not touching each other inside the dish it's easier to remove the crust when they're removed. Cut a 1 inch deep slit off the top of each loaf. Pull out the tender fiber from the bread under running water and place bread on baking sheet lined with tin foil. Bake at 325°f for 25 minutes, or until bread is beginning to turn golden brown and crust is crisp. Watch closely so it doesn't get really brown.

title: Thai Basil Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup warm slightly salted water | 3 - 3 1/2 cups lukewarm pancetta, minced or 1 -2 cup fresh smoked bacon, minced | 3 3/4 teaspoons active dry yeast or 3 -4 teaspoons bread machine yeast | 2 -3 ounces thai basil or 2 -3 ounces fresh chiffonade | chopped dried small almonds or toasted grated coconut
instructions: For quick start, follow directions for your bread machine. For the finished rolls, preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. In a large mixing bowl combine the warm water, pancetta, yeast, and 1 cup of the basil/chiffonade. While mixing it, begin to add the remaining basil/chiffonade to the hot mixture in the bowl. When the yeast has formed a layer on the bottom of the bowl, add in the remaining ingredients. Mix the ingredients until the ingredients are well blended. Place the dough on a floured board or lightly floured table and knead for about 10 minutes on a lightly floured board or table until nice and elastic. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with clean, damp cloth and leave in a warm place until doubled in size, about 2 - ½ hours. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees fahrenheit. Remove the dough from the bowl and divide into 24 equal portions. Roll one portion into a rectangle about 4 inches wide and 1½ inches thick. Lay the rolled dough on a clean, dry towel or a cutting board and with a sharp knife make diagonal cuts with a sharp knife in the rectangle until roughly the length of the rectangle is ½ inch / 5 inches wide. Repeat with the remaining dough, adding more water or bread flour if necessary. Place the filled rolls on a baking sheet and place in the bottom oven. Let the rolls rest in the oven for 3 hours, covered, before cutting. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,cauliflower floret,rice noodle,hot paprika,ranch dressing mix,russet potato,olive
title: Pot Potatoes and Beef
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, peeled, cut into bite-size pieces | 8 ounces pork tenderloin, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup ranch dressing mix | 1 tablespoon hot paprika | 2 cups cauliflower florets, steamed | 1/2 cup sliced pitted ripe olives | 2 cups cooked rice noodles, hot
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with fresh water.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,pineapple chunk juice,sea bass fillet,beef stock bouillon,squash
title: Gulf Coast Sea Bass With Pineapple Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs sea bass fillets, cut into 8 serving pieces | 2 large celery ribs, thinly sliced, with leaves cut into 2 pieces | 2 tablespoons beef stock or 2 beef bouillon cubes | 3 cups pineapple chunks with juice, drained | 1 -2 squash, cut lengthwise into 2 wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Arrange the fish in a roasting pan. In a small bowl combine the celery, bouillon, and 2 cups of the pineapple juice. Spread over the fish. Bake for 25 minutes, basting occasionally with remaining broth. Remove from the oven and serve warm with the squash and a crisp green salad.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,brown sugar,creamy peanut butter,extra beef,malt,iceberg lettuce,baking powder,pesto sauce
title: Honey Glazed Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon white balsamic vinegar or 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil | 1 tablespoon brown sugar, packed | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 2 ounces firm halibut fillets, cut in half lengthwise and then cut crosswise into thin strips | 2 tablespoons shaved fresh cheddar cheese or 2 tablespoons monterey jack cheese | 2 -6 leaves iceberg lettuce
instructions: Combine the sour cream, pesto sauce, vinegar, sugar, or brown sugar.

Random Ingredients: feta,chicken breast,broccoli floret,green chilies,cumin,pickling spice,szechuan peppercorn
title: Hot and Spicy Thai Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breasts, boneless, skinless | 1 1/2 cups fresh broccoli florets, cut into bite size pieces | 10 ounces canned green chilies | 4 ounces bottled diced jalapeno peppers or 4 ounces canned hot and spicy chilies ( 2 1/2 ounces ) | 4 ounces feta, crumbles | 1 teaspoon pickling spices | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground szechuan peppercorns
instructions: Rinse chicken.

title: Veal Noodles in Cilantro
ingredients: 1 package cellophane noodles | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 veal, legs minced | 3 tablespoons cilantro, chopped | 1/2 fennel, minced | 4 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into bite size pieces
instructions: Boil the cellophane noodles until just softened and about half of the liquid comes off. Set aside. Heat the oil in a large sauce pan over medium high heat. Add the minced veal and cook until just golden. Add the cilantro and fennel. Cook about 1 minute. Stir in the potatoes and drained cooked cellophane noodles. Cook until potatoes are tender and cooked through.

title: Cheese Teriyaki Marinade
ingredients: 1/2 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine vinegar ) | 1 package sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Combine the cheddar cheese and mirin in a bowl, and set aside. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat. Pour the margarine into a pan, and heat, swirling the pan until the margarine is entirely melted. Coat the rim of a teriyaki dish with the margarine. Slice the cheese into small squares, and place in the teriyaki. Pour 1/3 of the cheese into the teriyaki, and repeat with the remaining cheese slices. Lightly salt and pepper to taste to prevent a sauce from burning, and allow to marinate for 10 minutes. Serve the marinated cheese in the pan with the remaining marinade, sprinkling each piece with the additional cheese.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,orange peel,french bread,spaghetti sauce,summer squash,rhubarb,cumin seed
title: Orange Pistou Chops
ingredients: 2 quarts spaghetti sauce | 1 lb summer squash, sliced ( about 3 medium ) | 10 rhubarb, sliced ( about 3 cups cooked baby greens ) | 1 teaspoon oregano or 1 teaspoon mint, minced | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds or 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel, minced | cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl and serve with crackers, if desired.

title: Real Chicago-Style Queso Fundido
ingredients: 1 pound ground chuck | 1/3 pound genoa salami, cut into chunks | 1/3 pound queso fresco, cut into cubes | 1/3 cup lime juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Place chuck, salami, queso fresco, lime juice and vanilla extract into the work bowl of a food processor. Process until all ingredients are mixed well, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer the mixture to a large pot and heat over medium high heat.

title: Low Fat Salmon Cakes (Low Fat)
ingredients: 3/4 1/4 lb salmon or 3/4 lb salmon fillet | 1 1/4 cups plain nonfat yogurt or 1 1/4 cups low fat sour cream | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat broiler or grill. Put salmon in a medium bowl and mix with yogurt. Add baking soda and mix well. Pour mixture into a 8 x 8 oven safe pan or small bowls. Put in the oven or on your gas grill.. Cook approximately 6 to 7 minutes. Turns over, or leave to finish cooking until it flakes easily with a fork. Serve in a warm pita, with salad and french bread for dipping.

title: Tasty Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces sirloin, sliced | 1 can butter beans, drained and rinsed | 11 ounces sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 4 slices bacon, cooked, chopped | 2 tablespoons shredded unsweetened coconut | 8 ounces whole wheat bran | 1/3 cup peanuts, chopped toasted
instructions: Brown meat in a nonstick skillet and drain. Combine the beans, sauerkraut, tomatoes and bacon. Stir together the bran, peanuts and coconut in a bowl. Pour over meat and vegetables. Cover and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of onion soup | 1/4 cup chives, chopped | 1 teaspoon finely crushed black mustard seeds
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a food processor or blender until smooth and creamy.

title: Halloumi, Endive, and Egg in Sherry
ingredients: 6 ounces halloumi cheese or 6 ounces cheddar cheese, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 4 small belgian endive, peeled and cut in half lengthwise | 2 large eggs | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine ( optional ) or 1/4 cup dry vermouth ( optional )
instructions: Arrange the cheese in a single layer on a well oiled baking sheet and broil in a preheated 400 degree oven until lightly browned and well puffed, about 5 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside. Halve the endive halves and hollow out on a baking sheet. In a bowl, stir together the cheese, endives, eggs, and sherry. Spoon the cheese mixture into the endive halves and spread them out evenly. Arrange the ham in a decorative pattern over the ham and serve immediately.

title: Swiss Cheese Hot Dogs
ingredients: 6 -8 slices swiss cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons white pepper
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place 2 slices swiss cheese on each piece of swiss cheese. Combine pepper and liquid smoke and brush over each piece of cheese. Place on baking sheet with edges overlapping slightly. Broil for 2 - 3 minutes until cheese is browned and bubbly.

title: Scotch Scotch Bonnet Grilled Hamburger
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 4 cups chicken stock | 4 teaspoons scotch bonnet peppers | 1/4 cup gingerroot, fresh grated or 1 teaspoon fresh grated gingerroot | 3 1/2 teaspoons rose water or 3 1/2 teaspoons rose water
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Cook meat until no pink remains in the meat and most of the fat is rendered from the meat. Remove meat from grill and let cool. Remove meat from the grill and put on two or more sheets of aluminum foil that have been sprayed with cooking spray. Spray tops of the foil all over with cooking spray. Place the meats on the foil. Pour out most of the fat from the meat and save for another use. Top each piece of meat with 1 tablespoon of the ginger root or 1 tablespoon of grated gingerroot. Wrap up the meat tightly in the foil, put on the cooler part of the grill and cook for 30 minutes. Carefully remove the meat and let rest for 20 minutes before serving. Serve with warmed biscuits or as a garnish to cooked potatoes or rice.

title: Grilled Snow Pea in Balsamic Vinegar and Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds fresh snow peas, washed, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 loaf fresh bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Arrange the snow peas on the prepared grill, cover with aluminum foil, and lightly spray with cooking spray. Cook for about 15 minutes, turning once, or until tender. Combine the bread cubes and balsamic vinegar, tossing to coat. Place the snow peas on grill, close lid, and continue cooking for an additional 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: basil,cheddar cheese soup,cumin powder,italian breadcrumb,sandwich bun,graham cracker crumb,cake,kidney bean
title: My Great-Grandma's Great Chili
ingredients: 4 cans condensed cheddar cheese soup ( or other flavor ) | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons dried italian spices ( i like to use mrs dash's tuscan chili powder ) | 12 -14 sandwiches buns, split ( i buy the whole wheat split bread ) | 1 crusty sandwich bun | 1/4 cup dried italian ( preferred flavor ) or 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs ( i prefer to use real creole creole seasoning mix ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder or 1 teaspoon garam masala | fresh basil
instructions: Combine first 10 ingredients and mix until thoroughly blended. To serve, preheat oven to 350°f. Place 1 or 2 bread slices on a cutting board, overlapping the slices slightly on the board edges. Spread about 1/2 the soup evenly on each slice. Using a slotted spoon, top the soup with the soup onto each flattened sandwich bun. Sprinkle on top and spread the remaining soup evenly on the bun tops. Sprinkle the cumin and garam masala over the top. Garnish with fresh basil and serve.

title: Shiitake Mushroom Salad With Apricots
ingredients: 14 ounces shiitake mushrooms, drained | 12 dried apricots, chopped | 5 garlic cloves, crushed | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons dried basil seasoning | 1/4 cup fresh basil, finely chopped | 10 ounces low-fat plain low-fat yogurt
instructions: Place dried apricots in a microwave safe bowl and cover with microwaveable cling wrap. Microwave on high for 4 minutes or until softened. Stir and set aside. Using your hands or a blender, combine the remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Set aside. Using a fork, remove skin from mushrooms and mince or process. Add diced mushrooms and garlic to the bowl with the crumbled mushrooms. Stir until combine. Spoon into a shallow salad bowl, cover and chill for 24 hours. To serve, mound salad onto a serving tray. Sprinkle top with basil.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 3 ripe mint leaves | 1 jar salsa
instructions: Wash and dry mint leaves. Put into a food processor with one jar of salsa verde and puree. The salsa will keep, refrigerated, for several weeks.

title: Aussie Lamb Salad
ingredients: 2 kg lamb | 2 bunches spring onions
instructions: Grill or broil the lamb to the liking. Take off the heat and cut into 2 portions. Arrange on a platter, leaving enough to toss and eat as a snack. Garnish with spring onions.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,heavy cream,walnut,cream,curry powder,green bell pepper,english cucumber,chipotle chile
title: Gramma's Creamy Chipotle Walnut Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups heavy cream | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup finely diced english cucumber ( or other mild onion ) | 1 green bell pepper, seeded, diced | 1 teaspoon of minced chipotle chile ( the canned kind in adobo sauce should also be used, but i used canned ) | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon sweet rice wine ( or sherry ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts, toasted
instructions: In a big bowl, combine all ingredients. Pour dressing over and mix well.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,green onion,sesame seed,bean,tabasco sauce,cooking oil
title: Nif's Yummy "saucing"
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 2 teaspoons cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup sliced green onion | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Heat bean over med high heat, stirring often until warm. Remove from heat. Mix in remaining ingredients, blending well. Spread over your favorite hot spread & refried beans.

title: Truffler Pepperoni and Choclo Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs mexican cheese, divided | 1/2 lb broccoli floret | 2 tablespoons dried rambuie | 24 ounces crushed pepperoni ( a mild deli type ) | 12 ounces chocolate pieces ( not unsweetened, but good quality for melting ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 dash pepper ( or use regular, but not necessary )
instructions: Start heating your broiler to 450 degrees. Microwave 1/2 lb of the cheese in the microwave and stir in 1/2 the crushed pepperoni. Put in the crockpot, and put on low for 8 - 10 hours. After about 15 minutes, mix everything together, taste and adjust flavour. Pour in a container with hot lips and serve. Note, you can add other cheeses if you wish, like cheddar, mozzarella, provolone, etc.

title: Cheese and Vegetable Raita
ingredients: 225 g cheddar cheese, grated | 450 g pickling cucumbers | nutmeg, grated ( optional ) | 1 green capsicum, roasted, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Place cheese and cucumber chunks in a large bowl. Sprinkle with grated nutmeg and chopped green capsicum.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,vanilla wafer,pepper,romaine lettuce,extra tofu
title: Tofu Delights
ingredients: 1/2 lb extra firm tofu | 8 ounces deluxe jello mixed spraties ( such as jello deluxe ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup strong arm sweet pepper | 1 ounce biley's irish cream, plus extra ( to taste ) | 8 -10 pepper wafers
instructions: Freeze bag of tofu according to package directions. While that's being prepared, place remaining ingredients in food processor and blend until smooth and creamy, stopping to scrape sides as needed. When tofu is frozen, heat over low heat until hot and bubbly. Serve tofu with extra whipped cream, sliced pepper wafer cookies and additional irish pepper if desired. Makes 8 servings. Delicious.

title: Corn Oil Fried Rice
ingredients: 6 cups cold water | 1 -2 tablespoon jicama, diced | 1 -2 teaspoon jalapeno seasoning ( i use pickapeppa ( mexican seasoning - 2 tablespoons plus 1 -2 tbs. salt ) | 2 -3 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Place jicama and jalapeno seasoning into a medium bowl, and mix well. Add rice, and stir. Cover bowl with plastic wrap, and let sit at room temperature to refrigerate for at least 5 hours or overnight to blend flavors. Bring to room temperature before frying. Heat oil in a fryer to 375 degrees. Test with a small cube of bread to see if it sizzles then add the rice to the oil for 1 - 2 minutes, depending on the size of the piece of rice. If the rice is browned quickly, the oil is ready. If it sizzles, flip the rice so that it is browned on both sides, or else it gets a little crispy. This will take several minutes, depending on the size of the rice, but i prefer medium for this. After a few seconds, shake the rice around to mix and release any bits of rice stuck to the bottom of the pan. If desired, you can sprinkle a little flour over the top. Serve immediately or cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Margaritas on the Rocks
ingredients: 1/2 lb silver tequila | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/2 cup cooking sherry ( try sweet sherry )
instructions: In a large martini shaker about 9 inches in diameter, pour the vodka, soy sauce, and cooking sherry, and shake well. Strain into 2 martini glasses. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,beef brisket,red cabbage,italian seasoning,white chocolate chip,canola oil
title: Sweet Russian
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 lb beef brisket | 1 head red cabbage | 1 package white chocolate chips | 1 cup canola oil | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Brown hamburger, drain. Slice cabbage. Combine beef, sugar, and salt and pepper, and shred cabbage. Heat oil in frying pan. Add cabbage, melt chips and add to frying pan. Combine well. Cover and fry on medium heat for 30 minutes or until cabbage has wilted. Serve hot with french baguette.

title: Apple Salad with Pickled Shallots
ingredients: 2 large cooking apples, peeled, cored and chopped | 4 spring onions, finely chopped | 1 stick fresh mustard seed
instructions: Place the apples, spring onions and mustard seed in a bowl. Pour over water to just cover and leave to soak for 20 minutes. Toss with the dressing and serve.

title: Salmon, White Beans, Pasta and Pesto Glaze on Gluten Free
ingredients: 6 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 cup italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup dried white bean, soaked overnight and drained | 3 tablespoons miso-free canned pesto sauce | 3 tablespoons fresh orange juice ( or more ) | 1/2 - 3/4 of a 3/4 lb wild pacific salmon or 1/2-3/4 lb cod, with skin | 24 ladyfingers | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Note, cook time is marinating time. Combine first 3 ingredients in a heavy non reactive saucepan, bring to boil, then reduce heat. Simmer about 15 minutes. Drain beans and puree in a food processor. Place in a large bowl, add pesto sauce, orange juice and salmon. Toss to coat. Spread out half the jam on a 10 x 15 jelly roll or jelly roll pan as a thin layer. Lay 1 ladyfinger in pan. Spread 2 tablespoons of the pesto over the ladyfingers and spread evenly. Spread 1/2 cup of the ham evenly over the jam. Repeat ladyfingers and ham with remaining jam and pesto. Spread 1/4 cup of the pesto on top and use as much pesto as you have. Use as many as you can, it is very important to spread evenly. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f and place a roasting pan on the middle rack. Carefully start heating the rack with a lit candle or a large baking sheet with the heating element at the lowest level. Turn off and leave oven in there until the timer shuts off. Slice and arrange in a single layer on a large plate and top with the ham/white bean mixture. Serve at room temperature or keep warm in a 200 degree f oven for up to 1 hour. Brush the glaze glaze over your pasta if you wish.

title: Italian Dressing
ingredients: 3/4 cup light italian dressing | 1/4 cup dijon mustard
instructions: Add mustard to italian dressing mix. Chill and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white onion,vital wheat gluten,beef shank,mozzarella cheese,rye flour
title: Zippy Shanks with Rye
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef shanks or 2 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 2 1/4 cups low-fat shredded mozzarella cheese or 2 1/4 cups old cheddar cheese | 2 2/3 cups vital wheat gluten or 2 2/3 cups whole wheat gluten | 2 white onions or 4 shallots, chopped | 1/2 cup rye flour
instructions: Soak shanks or pork in water to cover overnight. Drain and place in large roasting pan. Cook over high heat, uncovered, turning occasionally, until shanks or pork are tender, about 1 hr 15 minutes. Remove from pan.

Random Ingredients: neufchatel cheese,pearl barley,peppercorn,beef chuck,red enchilada sauce
title: Beef N' Barley Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean beef chuck | 1 package neufchatel cheese | 32 fluid ounces red enchilada sauce or 32 fluid ounces enchilada sauce | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 cup peppercorn, crushed
instructions: Chop meat up into bite sized pieces. In a large stock pot, combine the meat, cheese, enchilada sauce, and barley. Bring to a slow boil and reduce flame. Cover. Simmer for 45 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Chickpeas With Sherry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 400 g canned chickpeas, rinsed & drained | 1/4 cup shaoxhiya sherry wine | basil sprig, to serve
instructions: Heat oil & add chickpeas. Cook over a medium heat, shaking the pan occasionally, mashing & adding the sherry to the pan with the chickpeas. Cover & cook until chickpeas are heated through. Serve hot garnished with basil.

Random Ingredients: black tea,fennel bulb,baby bok choy,butter,black sesame seed,self raising flour,spanish onion,spice
title: Spice Tea Sables
ingredients: 2 ounces self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon black sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons black tea | 8 ounces white mushrooms, sliced | 8 ounces small baby bok choy | 1 spanish onion, roughly chopped | 1 ounce butter
instructions: Combine flour, spice and sesame seeds in a bowl and stir in tea. Add mushrooms, bok choy. Add butter and mix together. Preheat pan on high heat until sables are ready. Add sables and cook for one minute. Remove onto tray and serve.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,tamari soy sauce,mango chutney,methi seed,great northern bean,blue cheese,pumpkin seed,ginger garlic paste
title: Spiced Fenugreek Beans
ingredients: 1 lb great northern bean ( hulled ) | 10 ounces blue cheese ( cubed fine ) | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon dried methi seeds | 1 teaspoon dried mango chutney | 1/2 tablespoon tamari soy sauce or 1/2 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 garlic paste | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: In a food processor blend beans until fine. Set aside. Puree blue cheese. Put through a sieve under cold running water into a measuring sieve, then into a bowl with dried fenugreek, methi, mango chutney, tamari, garlic paste and ginger garlic paste. If you don't have tamari you can use 1 teaspoon ginger and 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder. You can adjust ingredients based on what you have. The amounts above can either be adjusted for yourself or add more to your taste. Set aside about half of the cheese mixture for topping. Add another half to the bean mixture and fold. Spoon bean mixture into baking dish and sprinkle remainder of cheese on top. Bake at 375 to 375 for 30 to 40 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbling.

title: Tunisian Tomato Spread
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe fresh tomatoes ( or canned tomatoes ) | 1 1/2 cups soft fresh apricot jam | 2 bunches scallions, chopped | 1 cup pine nuts, toasted, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a food processor. Serve with bread, crackers, or pita bread.

title: Chicago Style Baked Romaine Wraps
ingredients: 1 package genoa salami | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat the oven on the middle rack in the oven. The salami will only be on the top of the wrap about 10 minutes, so you may have to do this in 2 batches. Slice the salami very thinly and put on a plate covered with paper towels to drain. Place on a baking sheet. With paper towels, generously pat the salami into a rectangle about 10 x 15 inches and about 3/8 inch thick. Use a paper towel to pat and pat the lettuce down so it looks like the picture. Place the lettuce onto a large cutting board and with a large sharp knife, carefully and evenly cut along the side of the lettuce. Turn the lettuce over and cut down each slice on the same long side. Slice the salami as thinly as possible and place on the lettuce. Using the back of a spoon, spread a teaspoon to the salami over the top. Roll up and set on the baking sheet. Repeat until the wraps are all used up and placed on a baking sheet. The salami wraps may be made up to this point up to 2 days ahead of baking the sandwiches and kept frozen at room temperature for up to 4 days.

title: Guacamole Beef Crockpot
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef | 1 jar salsa verde | 2 pints meat, cooked ( from roast, turkey or elk ) | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot except guacamole. Cover and cook on low 5 - 6 hours. Remove lid and stir, sprinkle with guacamole.

title: Kerry's Pecans and Turnips
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried pepitas ( pumpkin seeds ) | 1 pound turnips, peeled and diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Stir the pepitas into a medium bowl. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the turnips, cover, and remove from heat. Let stand for 10 minutes. Drain well. Spread the turnips out onto a baking sheet, and sprinkle with the pecan mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until the turnips are tender, about 5 minutes.

title: Velveeta Meatloaf
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 30 ounces meatballs | 1/4 cup dry vermouth | 10 ounces diced velveeta cheese | 1 lb linguine, cooked and drained | 1 lb provolone cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large crock pot. Set crock pot on low for 8 hours. Serve over cooked hot linguine.

title: Dha likes chita in her bag
ingredients: 6 -8 medium baking potatoes, peeled and cut | 1 cup dried chick peas ( chickpeas in natural juice ) | 1/4 cup whole cumin seed | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Place potato and peas in a pot with water. When they come to a boil, add sugar and chick peas. Let cook for about 20 minutes, drain and let sit a few minutes. Serve warm in the bag or wrapped in aluminium foil and let cool a bit before eating to have the air chill off.

title: Sesame Butter Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil, dark, if you have it
instructions: Put the sesame oil in a saucepan with a cover ready. Skin the chicken pieces if you do not wish to use them, then rub them with a little dark sesame paste. Let it warm up for 10 - 15 minutes. Bake it, covered, in a medium oven for about 15 minutes. Turn and rub the other side with dark sesame oil. It is done when the skin is brown and the juices run clear.

title: Minty Onion-Mustard Sauce With Fresh Mint
ingredients: 5 -6 medium mint leaves | 1/4 cup of fresh mint leaves, chopped ( fresh mint stems should be used ) | 1 -2 tablespoon stock | 1 -2 teaspoon mustard seeds, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1 pinch salt and pepper
instructions: In a small pan, scald the mint and fresh mint stems. Do not overheat the mint leaves. Place mint and dried mint into a blender, add the onion seeds and add the broth, mustard seed and salt and pepper. Process until almost smooth, about 1 minute. Store in the fridge for up to a week.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup sweetened almond extract | 4 cups cooked chicken breasts, shredded | 2/3 cup frozen guacamole | 2 tablespoons dried cranberry juice | 1 tablespoon ice water | 1/8 teaspoon ground sumac
instructions: Mix almond extract, chicken, guacamole, cranberry juice, water, and sumac together in a bowl until blended. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Macadamia Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons macadamia nuts, ground almonds | 2 teaspoons rosemary, dried or 2 teaspoons sage, dried
instructions: Combake, and store in the fridge or refrigerator up to 6 months. Use half teaspoons with each ounce.

title: Potato Croutons
ingredients: 5 lbs large russet potatoes ( about 2 large ) | 8 1/2 fluid ounces vodka | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into 1/4 thick x 3/8 wide x 6 1/2 thick strips about 2 inches long. Heat 1 inch oil in heavy large skillet over high heat until just beginning to smoke, 3 to 4 minutes. Working in batches, cook potatoes in batches until very tender when pierced with tip of knife, 5 to 7 minutes total.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,cremini mushroom,lamb,beef rib,american cheese,ginger beer,linguine,limeade concentrate
title: American Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 package lamb, cut up | 1 package american cheese, shredded | 1 bag cremini mushrooms, chopped | 4 slices fresh ginger beer | 1 1/2 teaspoons vinegar | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 8 ounces linguine | 8 ounces linguine, cooked and drained
instructions: Cook linguine in boiling water for 10 minutes, drain, rinse with cold water and set aside. Place lamb in a skillet and brown. Remove. Add the rest of the ingredients and reheat. Serve over linguine.

title: Rich Brown Lentils with Cacik
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils, washed and drained | 1/2 cup plain yogurt, smooth | 2 ounces baking chocolate | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | watercress, to garnish
instructions: Place the lentils into a large bowl and cover with cold water. Soak 8 hours, until tender. Place in the fridge. When cool enough to handle, drain. Rinse the lentils a little then put in a blender and process to a smooth puree. Add the yogurt, chocolate, cocoa powder and enough water to form the thick paste. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Toss the chopped watercress with the lentils. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pork baby back rib,ricotta cheese,brown rice,sugar snap pea,catsup,pineapple tidbit,rosemary
title: Baked Sweet and Spicy Stretching Ribs
ingredients: 4 lbs pork baby back ribs | 2 cups sugar snap peas | 1 jar roasted pineapple tidbits, packed in juice | 16 ounces low-fat ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons catsup | 3 tablespoons dried rosemary, crushed | hot cooked brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Rinse the ribs, place in a large bowl and coat with the sugar snaps and pineapple juice. Place the remaining ingredients in a large slow cooker. Cover and cook on high 5 hours or low 8 hours. Check on the ribs.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,lemon peel,red bell pepper,fish sauce
title: Lemon Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 lemon peel, grated | 1 pinch white sugar ( optional ) | 1/2 cup fish sauce, for serving
instructions: Place the bell pepper, lemon peel, fish sauce, and white sugar in a jelly roll pan. Stir to mix. Place a lid on the pan, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling reduce heat, and simmer for 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: white onion,basil,fast rising yeast,taco sauce,maple syrup,serrano chili,steak
title: Slow-Cooker Fajita Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white onion, chopped | 1 serrano chili, seeds removed | 12 inches day old sandwich steaks | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1 tablespoon fast rising yeast
instructions: Place onion, chili, and steak in a 6 quart slow cooker or dutch oven. Pour maple syrup and taco sauce over the meat and sprinkle with basil and yeast. Cover and cook on low heat setting 4 to 5 hours.

title: Indian Onion Dip - Microwave
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Add seasoning mix. For a richer dish, increase salt. For cracker, omit the salt and spread on crackers.

title: Roasted Parsnips in Thyme
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, peeled and cut on the diagonal into 1 1/2 inch slices | 4 sprigs thyme leave
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c/ 400°f place the parsnips in a lightly oiled oven proof dish. Sprinkle all over with thyme. Roast for 1 1/4 hours, tossing every 15 minutes until tender and crisp.

title: Gone Buche De Noel
ingredients: 1 large ripe mango, peeled and cut into chunks | 4 -5 serrano chilies, stemmed and minced | 1/4 cup papaya, peeled, seeded, cut into chunks | 2 teaspoons rice wine | 1 dash cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place the mango and chiles in a bowl and sprinkle with the papaya. Pour over the rice wine and cayenne, adjusting the cayenne if necessary. In a small ovenproof skillet, place the skillet over medium low heat and broil until the mango and chiles are lightly browned and bubbling, about 15 minutes. Serve drizzled with the mango and chiles.

title: Lebanese Swiss Chard Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs swiss chard | 12 -14 sunflower oil, for frying | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory | 1/2 teaspoon sambal oelek
instructions: Cut the chard into thin slices and place them in a saucepan with 10 - 15 fluid oz of water. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and cook for 5 - 6 minutes until tender. Rinse the chard and dry under cold water. Remove the chard from the water under running water, drain, pat dry with clean paper towels. Roughly chop the chard, then mix with the oil, savory and sambal oelek. Serve at room temperature.

title: Peperoni Chicken Packets
ingredients: 24 pieces american cheese, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 1 jar sliced pepperoni | 1 chicken bouillon, powder
instructions: Combine the cheese, pepperoni, bouillon powder, and chicken bouillon in a bowl.

title: Beef and Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 bags egg noodles | 3/4 cup frozen peas and carrots | 1 cup bean sprouts | 3 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan add all ingredients except the bean sprouts and rosemary. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until noodles are tender. Ladle into soup bowls and garnish with fresh rosemary and serve immediately.

title: Tomato-Cranberry Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crushed tomatoes | 4 cups shredded fresh cranberries | 1 (.25 ounce ) package active dry yeast
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the tomatoes, cranberries, and yeast. Let sit 5 minutes. Add to the mixture in stages, adding the remaining ingredients as necessary to total the amount of dough. Dough will be slightly soft and stretchy after the first rise. Place in a greased 1 1/2 quart round cake pan. Cover tightly and let rise in a warm area until doubled, approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes. Bread should be golden brown and the edges of the dough should appear cracked when the pizza is inserted into the hot oven, about 45 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Bake in a preheated 400 degrees f oven for 15 minutes. Bread should be lightly browned and crisp when done.

Random Ingredients: green bean,green chile,jalapeno pepper,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Green Chili Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb of fresh green bean, cleaned and trimmed | 2 bunches green chiles ( or 1 pkg canned jalapeno peppers ) | 2 cups of shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 1 jalapeno peppers, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut green beans in half lengthwise and dehusk under running water for a few seconds place beans in a bowl and cover with warm water until just tender, about 2 minutes meanwhile, cut chilis crosswise into 1/4 inch pieces place in microwave safe casserole dish in single layer. Cover and microwave on high for 1 minute. Drain green beans well and then spoon into an oven safe dish. Cover the dish with the cheese. Stir chilis and then return to the oven. Cook for about 10 minutes or until thoroughly heated and cheese is melted, stirring a few times.

Random Ingredients: penne,dark sesame oil,kiwi fruit,oriental sesame oil,provolone cheese
title: Kiwi and Provolone Pasta With Sesame-Soy Dipping Sauce, Prosciutto, and Kiwi
ingredients: 3/4 cup thinly sliced kiwi fruit, such as fuji, peeled ( about 2 kiwis ) | 1/2 julio unpeeled provolone cheese, coarsely grated | 1 1/2 cups cooked penne | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon oriental sesame oil | 2 slices provolone cheese ( about 1 cup )
instructions: Stir kiwis, provolone, cooked pasta, dark sesame oil, and oriental sesame oil together at the end of 15 minutes.

title: Chinese Sweet & Sour Onions
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried red onions | 3 tablespoons shaoxing wine | 3 tablespoons light soya sauce
instructions: Place dried red onion in shallow dish and cover with shaoxing wine. Let stand for 1 - 2 hours to dry. Shake off excess vinegar and then dry onion using a brush. Heat wok or frying pan until hot. Add a little oil to wok and when hot saute dried red onion until tender. Add regular soya sauce and mix well. Serve immediately on warm plate.

title: Cherry Toast
ingredients: 12 slices white bread, crust trimmed | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro stems | 1/4 cup sliced mushrooms | garlic powder | 1 jar sweet cherry flavored jars
instructions: Place the bread on a cookie sheet and toast under the broiler about 1 - 2 minutes on each side. Remove to a large plate. Sprinkle on the cilantro and mushrooms. Sprinkle with garlic powder. Place the jar of sweet cherry flavored jars in the bottom of the pan and pour hot water into the jar to get dipping temperature of the jars. Dip the bread back into the dipping liquid and place into the plastic bag. Seal bag and let sit for at least 1 hour. Use a sharp knife to cut the bread into 1 squares. Serve.

title: Causage and Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh italian sausage | 1 head cauliflower | 2 cups black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 ounce unsweetened chocolate | 1/4 cup brandy | 1/4 head green coriander, finely chopped | 1/4 cup crushed garlic
instructions: Cook sausage on stovetop until lightly browned and cooked through. Remove from pan and slice into 1/4 pieces. Cut cauliflower into bite size florets, discard ends and break apart if necessary. Pour beans into food processor and process to a chunky fine puree. Add brandy, chili powder and remaining ingredients and process until well combined, adding more brandy if necessary. Pour into pretty bowl, cover and place in fridge to chill while preparing the rest of the salad, about 2 hours. When ready to serve, serve on warm pita crisps, garnished with a green leafy sprinkle.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,sugar snap pea,almond essence,sugar orange marmalade,italian sausage
title: Sausage & Sugar Snap Pea Salad With an Italian Spiced Sizzle!
ingredients: 8 links italian sausage | 2 sugar snap pea | 1 ounce blanched almond, toasted | 2 tablespoons almond essence | 1/4 cup sugar-free orange marmalade
instructions: Slice the sausage, leaving the fat in the pan.

title: Herring Kebabs
ingredients: 1 bunch celery rib, trimmed | 2 large boneless herring fillets, about 8 per fillet ( about 1 pound ) | 1/2 cup coarse-ground dried oregano | 2 -4 baguette, slices cut on the diagonal
instructions: Process celery, herring fillets, and oregano in a food processor until smooth. Using a tablespoon, drizzle a few drops of water over fillets. Serve with baguette slices. Note, herring is better if used pre ground. Soak baguette slices in cold water for 15 minutes. Arrange 1 - 2 baguette slices on a baking sheet. Brush with oil, then sprinkle with 2 - 3 tablespoons of the olive or canola oil.

title: Spanish Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 1 cup good quality tea, cold | 6 tablespoons spanish sherry wine vinegar ( spanish )
instructions: In an earthenware jar with a tight fitting lid, combine all of the ingredients except for the vinegar. Close lid and shake well to combine. Place lid on jar and brew in a cool, dark, dry place for 2 - 3 weeks, shaking the jar every half and hour. Allow to cool completely before using in recipes.

title: Grilled Xinjiang Pork Salad (Mango Chutney)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless pork | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 tablespoons dried basil | 1 tablespoon dried orange blossom honey | 1/4 cup orange blossom honey | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 tablespoon chopped celery | 4 sheets aluminum foil, cut into 1 1/2-inch squares
instructions: Cut pork into strips. Mix remaining ingredients together and refridgerate until ready to grill, about an hour. Heat grill and place pork on grill rack, close lid and cook until internal temperature reaches 175 degrees f, 1 to 1 1/4 hours. Allow to rest 10 minutes before slicing. Wrap each piece of pork in aluminum foil tightly and refrigerate until ready to use. Cook pork on grill rack until nicely browned and crispy, 5 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle with a few drops of orange blossom honey to prevent burning. Serve on a bed of lettuce leaves with garnishes.

title: Chinese Vegetable Burger
ingredients: 1 package dried shrimp | 4 tablespoons snow peas | 1 cup dried lean ham of choice or 1 cup other cooked meat | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: Soak the dried shrimp in luke warm water for 1 hour. Drain and rinse shrimp and set aside. Prepare your favorite burger maker according to the manufacturer's instructions. Rinse the dried shrimp and set aside. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add the snow peas to the pan and cook for 3 minutes or until beginning to soften. Remove the snow peas from the pan with a slotted spoon and set aside. Using the same skillet that you cooked the mushrooms in add the meat and cook for about 5 minutes. Stir in the cayenne pepper. Dump the shrimp out of the shrimp and place on top of the pepper mixture. If it's too dry, add as much water as needed. Cook and stir until the mixture is hot. Serve with the romaine lettuce and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,part mozzarella cheese,lemon juice zest,adobo seasoning,cabbage,pearl barley,mexican cheese
title: Party Calzones (Diabetic)
ingredients: 6 cups shredded cabbage ( i use shredded mexican cabbage ) | 2 chicken wings, cut at joints ( i use frozen wings that are sliced ) or 3 pieces chicken tenders ( i use frozen wings that are sliced ) | 1/2 cup pearl barley ( optional ) | 1/4 cup grated mexican cheese | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | adobo seasoning | 4 cubes mexican cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Mix the cabbage and chicken together in a bowl with the rice, spices, and mexican cheese. Add in the lemon zest and juice to give it a little sweetness and season to taste. Roll them up and put them on a cookie sheet sprayed with cooking spray. If you have leftovers, sprinkle generously, but not too heavily, then bake for about 20 minutes, or until they're crisp and a little browned all over. Serve with tortillas and beans, or whatever else floats your boat. If you have any leftover calzones, you can use these suggestions for those suggestions to serve over fajitas, rice, or taco, along with pico de gallo, and others.

title: Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn kernels, shucked | 1/3 cup orange zest | 2 eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place corn onto foil. Lightly coat the corn with cooking spray and spread it out evenly in a 10 inch straight sided. Gently push the corn down into the corn so each ear lies flat on the foil. Bake corn until a knife inserted into the center of the corn comes out clean, 20 to 25 minutes. Transfer corn to a cutting board. Cut kernels off the corn and discard. Rinse with boiling water. Drain well. Cut corn into 12 wedges using a knife or grater and place onto the serving plates. Whisk eggs and orange zest together in a small bowl. Lightly beat in corn. Sprinkle corn mixture over warm corn. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: black bean,red pepper flake,cannellini bean,rhubarb,orange zest,snow pea
title: Rhubarb Bean Bean and Snow Pea Stew
ingredients: 3/4 lb rhubarb, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 orange, zest of, grated | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons orange zest, grated
instructions: Heat a large wok over medium high heat. Add rhubarb and stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and cook until rhubarb is tender, about 3 - 4 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Zucchini With Zucchini
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs zucchini, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon white pepper powder, blend
instructions: Place zucchini in 2 layers of paper towels. Sprinkle with saffron or other ground spices. Place paper towels between each layer to press out excess moisture. Place in shallow pan, cover tightly and marinate at room temperature for about 3 - 4 hours or in refrigerator overnight. Drain excess liquid. Grill zucchini over hot coals or under preheated broiler until browned.

title: Sesame Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup sesame oil | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a bowl, stir the sesame oil and cream until they are well combined. Refrigerate the sesame cream sauce for an hour to become more creamy. If it's too thick, add more cream.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,barley,nutella,cream tartar,tahini,romano cheese,zucchini,taco seasoning mix
title: Tex Mex Zucchini Barley Salad
ingredients: 8 cups cold shredded iceberg lettuce | 8 large zucchini, quartered and sliced 1/4 inch | 16 ounces store-bought prepared pound cake mix | 1/3 cup light cream of tartar | 1/3 cup tahini | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 3/4 cup barley
instructions: Place the lettuce, zucchini, cake mix, cream of tartar, and tahini, respectively, in a large salad bowl. Toss everything together well. Stir in the taco seasoning.

Random Ingredients: vegetable juice,bay leaf,greek yogurt,almond paste,red cabbage
title: Red Cabbage Soup With Yogurt
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage, shredded | 2 cans vegetable juice | 1 tablespoon almond paste | 2 bay leaves | 1 cup plain greek yogurt | freshly ground roasted salted almond paste
instructions: Place the colander over a sink, add some water to bring the water close to the top and allow the colander to catch any juice from the colander. In a medium size pot, add the colander and bring it to the boil over high heat. When the colander becomes very hot, immediately remove it from the heat, take out the colander, and allow it to drain for about 15 minutes. After 15 minutes, remove the colander and place it in a bowl. Squeeze out excess water out of the shredded cabbage and add it to the colander. Place remaining ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a bowl and allow to chill for 20 to 30 minutes before serving.

title: Orange Soyed Nuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups orange juice | 3 shallots ( about 4 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons corn niblets | 3 tablespoons roasted unsalted peanuts ( chopped ) | fresh thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan, stir together the orange juice, shallots, corn niblets, and 1 teaspoon of salt. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer, covered 10 minutes. Set aside. In a small skillet over moderately high heat, combine the remaining 2 tablespoons of salt and the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt. Add the peanuts and cook, stirring frequently, until the peanuts are hot and starting to brown, about 10 seconds. Transfer to a plate and let cool before sprinkling with thyme. When ready to serve, remove the thyme sprig and orange zest and reserve.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,dark rum,yellow squash,fine breadcrumb,basmati rice,fenugreek leaf,rye flour,guacamole
title: Thick, Fresh Grapefruit and Nigella Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 large yellow squash | 1 1/4 ounces dry-aged sweet plain breadcrumbs | 1 1/4 ounces dry-aged fari-style rice | 2 tablespoons minced fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons minced fresh basil leaves | 1/2 tablespoon dried coriander leaves | 1/2 - 1 cup chilled unsalted dry-made dark rum | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Halve and pit the yellow squash. Thin slices should be 2/3 to 3/4 inch thick. Slice off the top 1/2 inch of squash with a sharp knife or kitchen knife. Slice the squash in half.

title: Maggie Beer's Chinese Flavored Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked rice | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 8 cups hot salsa
instructions: Prepare rice according to package instructions. Meanwhile, combine the hoisin sauce, mace, and garlic salt in a small bowl and stir to blend. Set aside about 1/3 cup rice from jar. Rinse out rice pot and re measure the jar. Set it over medium heat. When the water boils, add rice and stir. Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 15 minutes. Remove cover and continue cooking and stirring another 5 minutes to fluff rice. When rice is fluffy, remove from heat and stir in jar salsa.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,noodle,oatmeal,enchilada sauce,chicken stock,beef tenderloin steak,dark chocolate,fish
title: Beef and Noodle Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 cup low sodium chicken stock | 1 lb beef tenderloin steak, trimmed of fat | 1 -2 tablespoon enchilada sauce | 2 green cardamom pods, bruised and split ( or 1/2 tbs. ground cardamom ) | 1/2 ounce dark chocolate ( finely chopped ) | 1 1/2 ounces dried noodles | 2 ounces dark chocolate, melted | 1/2 cup oatmeal
instructions: Place the chicken stock in a small saucepan and set over a medium high heat,. Cook the beef for 6 minutes then drain and, reducing the heat to low, add one of the pods. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until just softened. Transfer to a plate. Cut the flank steak into 1/2 inch cubes. Set aside. Heat the enchilada sauce in a small pot with a tight fitting lid,. The moment it reaches this point, remove from the heat, add the cardamom pods and place in a blender with the chocolate and noodles to cover. Blend until smooth, stopping the blender once or twice to scrape down the side of the blender bowl,. Set aside. Meanwhile, to assemble the kebabs,. Place the noodles and noodles on 2 sheets of wax paper and cover with a damp towel.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,graham cracker crumb,zucchini,orange peel,corn,grapefruit juice,maple syrup,spinach leaf
title: Spinach, Rice and Zucchini Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 1/4 cups grapefruit juice | 1 1/4 cups long-grain rice, rinsed | 1 1/4 cups shredded zucchini | 1 1/4 cups torn fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup corn, frozen or canned, thawed | 1/4 cup finely snipped orange peel | 1 jar graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees farenheit. In a medium mixing bowl, combine all ingredients. Place dough on a floured work surface. Press 1 teaspoon of the filling into the center of each roll. With floured hands, roll up the roll jelly roll fashion, jelly roll style, enclosing the filling. Place the rolls seam side down in a greased 9x9 inch baking dish. In a medium mixing bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs and 1/4 cup water until crumb topping is moist and evenly moist. Sprinkle crumbs over the rolls, pressing in to coat evenly.

title: Creamy Green Chile French Bread
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread | 1 green chili, deseeded, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green chilies ( or more to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 120c/170c fan forced. Line a large ovenproof dish with baking paper. Cut the bread slices into 4cm/1½ inch pieces. Arrange the bread slices in a single layer on the baking paper, leaving space between each slice. Sprinkle over the chilies and a little black pepper. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until the bread is cooked through and tender.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,coleslaw mix,jalapeno pepper,mozzarella cheese,kernel corn
title: Wattie Muesli
ingredients: 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 1/4 cups frozen whole kernel corn | 1 jalapeno pepper, halved, seeded and diced | 1 dash black mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons prepared coleslaw mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Grease with nonstick cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine mozzarella cheese, corn, jalapeno and mustard seeds. Top with cheese mixture.

title: Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kaffir lime leaves, finely crushed, or as desired
instructions: Combine the kaffir lime leaves and ground, red pepper, or shrimp paste. Mix well.

title: Brie Fondue
ingredients: 1 pound brie cheese, diced | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup vegetable oil for frying
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Cover the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish with about 1/4 cup of vegetable oil. Place the cubed brie cheese into a large, flat container. Mash the brie with a masher. Stir in the bread cubes until thoroughly coated with the brie mixture. Spread bread cubes on the top of the bread cubes. Drizzle with more oil, and dot with more bread cubes. Cover with aluminum foil, and bake in the preheated oven until the fondue is bubbling, about 45 minutes.

title: Anaheim Pizza Using Oatmeal
ingredients: 1/3 cup oatmeal | 1 can diced fire-roasted tomatoes, drained | 1/2 cup low-fat ricotta cheese, drained | 2 1/2 tablespoons asiago cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. In a shallow baking dish, combine oatmeal, sliced tomatoes, and ricotta cheese. Sprinkle with asiago cheese. Bake for 10 minutes.

title: Tuna Meat Rolls
ingredients: 1 egg roll wrap | 200 g tuna steaks, cut into 3 cm strips
instructions: Place spoonful of tuna steaks along edge of the roll skin. Roll up the meat, folding like a roll. Slightly moisten the edge of the roll with water, press the ends together with a toothpick. Steam for 35 - 45 minutes in a steamer or a saucepan covered with foil, or bake on a grill over a medium hot coals. Alternatively cook on a grill pan for around 10 minutes, or until the outside is browned and the inside is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,red wine vinegar,grain white rice,rosemary leaf,russet potato
title: Pommes à L'orilly et Potage (Rice and Rosemary Potatoes With Rice)
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled, cut in half lengthwise | 1 cup whole grain white rice, rinsed ( preferably arborio ) | 2/3 cup red wine vinegar | 6 whole cardamom pods, split | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary leaves ( or 1/2 tsp. dry minced ) | 1/4 cup fresh coarsely ground black ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Place potatoes on a cookie sheet and bake in a 375f oven for 40 minutes or until tender.

title: Auntie Anita's English Muffins
ingredients: 3 english muffins | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 1/2 ounces beef sirloin, cut into 1 in. chunks
instructions: Place english muffins on a baking sheet. Spray with oil. Toast both sides of the english muffins in a hot skillet for a few minutes. Place sirloin in a small bowl, and toss with 1 teaspoon fennel seeds. Spread one side of each english muffin with 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed oil, and place on top of the muffins. Put under a preheated broiler for a few minutes, turning once. Serve on plates with your favourite greek salad.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,white rice,apple,ajwain,hot italian sausage link,greek oregano,topping,soy sauce
title: Grilled Sausages With Apple Rice
