ingredients: 1 package hot italian sausage links, cut lengthwise into half crosswise ( about 1 3/4 pound links ) | 1 tablespoon white rice ( toor darjeeling ) | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh greek oregano ( optional ) | 1 cup chopped apples ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon hot greek oregano ( optional, see note ) | 1 cup grated apple ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 tablespoon minced serrano chilies or 1 tablespoon serrano chile
instructions: Place sasages in medium skillet. Cover and cook over medium high heat, turning occasionally, 7 - 10 minutes. Remove sausage and pan from heat. Slice sausage crosswise into 1/4 1/2 slices. Topping,. Combine 1 cup coarsely chopped apples, 1 teaspoon of worcestershire sauce, 1/2 teaspoon chopped greek oregano, 1 tablespoon of chopped chile, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in bowl. Add remaining 1/2 cup coarsely chopped apples, soy sauce, and 1 teaspoon salt.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,green food coloring,salt pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Soymilk Dream
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups soy milk | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon green food coloring, or more to taste | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Place soy milk in a small saucepan, and bring to a simmer. Remove from heat, and add cheese. Continue to stir until cheese is melted. Dissolve food coloring in a small amount of water, and pour into cooled milk. Season with salt and pepper. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hard salami,cherry tomato,cream mushroom soup,club soda,serrano pepper,chilies,peanut butter,raisin
title: The Great Mystery Balls
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 1/2 cups club soda | 1 can chilies, drained | 1 1/2 cups dry unsalted peanuts, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs hard salami, finely chopped | 1/2 lb salami, finely chopped | 2 lbs cherry tomatoes | 2 serrano peppers, seeded and chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cream of mushroom soup, club soda and chiles. Add peanuts, salami, salami, tomatoes, serrano peppers and mix well. Shape mixture into small balls by gently rolling them in the palms of your hands. Wrap individually in plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Drain balls several hours before serving.

title: Pork Medallions and Artichokes
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichokes | 1 pound pork roast, cut into slices and patted dry | 2 tablespoons grated shredded gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Place artichokes in a large bowl and pour boiling water over. Let artichokes stand for 2 to 3 minutes before stripping off their stalks. Drain artichokes and arrange on a serving platter. Arrange shredded pork between the artichokes. Combine grated cheese, lime juice and parsley.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,oregano leaf,nutmeg,hamburger,muscovado sugar,vegetable,bamboo shoot,romaine lettuce
title: Mountain Salad (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | vegetables ( any kind ) | romaine lettuce | malt vinegar | oregano leaves | nutmeg | malt vinegar | muscovado sugar
instructions: Brown hamburger with the sugar and nutmeg. Chop up lettuce, salad leaves, and whatever fresh greens or you fancy. Tear or tear fresh or ripped herbs and place on a serving platter. You can serve this dish cold on top of salads.

title: Rum Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 bag egg noodles | 2 cans tuna in olive oil, drained and flaked | 3 ounces light rum | 3 ounces miracle whip light or 3 ounces light cream
instructions: Cook the noodles until tender, but still firm. Drain in a colander and set aside. In a bowl, combine everything except the sour cream, and mix well. Add the noodles and stir well. Refrigerate for a few hours before serving to blend flavors.

title: Apple Peppers
ingredients: 2 large green bell peppers | 3 large tart apples
instructions: Slice the tops off the bell peppers. The stems have been sliced off. Carefully scoop out the core of each pepper and set aside. Cut the peppers in quarters and remove seeds and pith.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,sherry,lettuce leaf,beef brisket,white wine,cilantro,english muffin
title: Fondue on the Rocks
ingredients: 1 lb beef brisket or 1 lb flank steak | 1 cup dry white wine or 1 cup shaoxing wine | 1 teaspoon dry sherry | 1/2 cup chopped white lettuce leaves or 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley | 4 white lettuce leaves or 4 white bibbettes | 1/2 cup mandarin oranges or 1/2 cup oranges, juice of or 1/2 cup fresh grape juice | chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Cut meat across grain into thin slices across the grain, about 2 inches long. Place slices in a heavy large resealable plastic bag or jar with wine, sherry and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Add remaining ingredients except lettuce, orange and cilantro.

title: Hominy With Mushrooms and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb white hominy, white kidney, or other white bean, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds, lightly toasted in a frying pan | 2 -3 tablespoons milk ( a little more if needed ) | 1 container of your choice fresh sliced button mushrooms | your choice ( canned, frozen, or fresh )
instructions: Rinse and de sort. Pour enough cold water over the beans to cover, and soak overnight. Drain, and repeat soaking and soaking process until beans have soaked up every minute or so. Combine with all ingredients. Cook slowly, stirring every few hours if necessary, until the mixture begins to get thick and flavors have mingled. It will be thicker by the time it's all added. Add more milk if necessary to keep mixture from getting dry. The idea is that if you want it soupy, you can add more milk and water, if not, then add more of each. When the mixture is thicker, thin it with a bit of water or water if needed. Serve with pita bread, passing the cheese and a fresh, chopped salad.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,lemon,purpose flour,marinara sauce,bay leaf,cream chicken soup
title: Tuscan Lemon Pepper Soup
ingredients: 6 unpeeled lemons, cut into 1-inch wedges | 7 cups thinly sliced lemons | 10 tablespoons sour cream or 10 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 cans cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place 6 unpeeled lemons in a glass baking dish or deep plate, spacing them evenly on the bottom and about 1 inch from the top. Sprinkle the lemons with salt. Bake at 400 degrees, uncovered, until the inside of the lemon is very soft, about 50 minutes total. Remove lemons from the oven and set aside. Wipe the rim of a large bowl with damp paper towels. Working with about 1 cup at a time, drop 2 tablespoons of the lemon juice into the bowl of the lemon, trying to be sure the lemon is covered with juice. Repeat with the remaining lemons. Reserve the juice used to juice the lemons. Sprinkle the lemons with the sour cream and flour and stir to combine. Gather the juice from the reserved juice into the bowl, along with the chicken soup and bay leaf. Stir with a wooden spoon until well blended. Cover and refrigerate the soup until well chilled, at least 2 hours, but up to 12 hours before serving.. Serve each portion with some reserved juice.

title: Sopa De Fuba - Sopa Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 burritos | 2 anaheim chili | 4 -6 ounces panir | 1 cup salsa | your favorite hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Heat up the panir until it fries nicely. Spread hot sauce on tortilla and place one burrito in the middle. Sprinkle with salt to taste. Top with salsa, guacamole, or top with chopped tomato. Fold the tortilla in half. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,green onion,white flour,fast rise yeast,mirin,spinach,ra el hanout spice mix,ginger garlic paste
title: Baked Herb Rolls (Lees Version)
ingredients: 2 packages fast rise yeast | 1 teaspoon ginger garlic paste ( ginger paste if you prefer ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 cup warm up organic white flour | 1 bunch green onion, chopped | 5 packages spinach | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/2 cup miracle whip or 1/2 cup cream sweetened condensed milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f. Mix 5 minutes yeast with 1 teaspoons ginger garlic paste. Stir in flour. Knead until elastic. Let rise 2 hours. Turn on floured surface. Add green onions and knead until well blended. Put in an oiled bowl and cover and let rise 2 hours until tripled in size. In a seperate bowl, mix together the remaining ingredients. Roll dough into a ball about the size of a large walnut and put back in bowl. Cover and let rise 20 - 30 minutes until doubled in size. Slice into 1/4 thick rolls. Bake for 15 - 17 minutes or until golden brown. Take out of oven and top with sesame and a salad. Makes about 2 - 8 bread rolls. Tip, if you put dough on cutting board and stretch it to 3/4, then that makes a mess.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,irish cream,brown mustard seed,salmon fillet,mayonnaise,pine nut,cucumber,cayenne
title: Irish Salmon With Tomato Mayonnaise and Pine Nuts Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces salmon fillets, skinned and seasoned | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons irish cream | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 4 roma tomatoes, halved | 2 medium cucumbers, halved lengthways and thinly sliced | freshly toasted pine nuts
instructions: In a pan, place the salmon fillets, skin side down, on medium heat and cook, uncovered, for about 3 mins or until cooked. Slice thin. Combine the mayonnaise and remaining mustard ingredients in a small bowl, whisk until combined. Add the tomato, cucumber and salmon. Season to taste and garnish with toasted pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,white vinegar,greek yogurt,italian salad dressing mix
title: Goat Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package goat cheese, softened | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 cup white vinegar | 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix
instructions: In small bowl, stir goat cheese, yogurt and vinegar until smooth. Chill.

title: Asparagus & Walnut Oil With Vanilla
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs asparagus spears, washed | 4 cups vegetable stock | 6 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise and scraped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place the asparagus in a casserole. Scatter around the base of the baking dish with a little of the stock. Bring the rest of the stock to a boil in a large saucepan, add the split scrapen vanilla bean and aspargus. Cover and transfer to the oven and bake 20 minutes, or until tender. Remove the vanilla bean and keep warm. Remove the tips of the vanilla bean. With a spoon, skim around the base of the oil over the top.

title: Chicken with Bacon
ingredients: 4 thick slices bacon, chopped | 8 cubes cooked, cubed chicken breast meat
instructions: Arrange 1 cube of bacon in the center of each 4 cube chicken breast. Secure 3 cubes of cooked cubed chicken breast meat around the bacon.

title: Crock Pot Italian Sausage
ingredients: 2 lbs hot italian sausage | 3 medium garlic cloves, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons celery seeds | 3/4 - 1 cup feta cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa ( dutch-processed preferred ) | 2 -3 tablespoons bottled broth or 2 -3 tablespoons canned stock | 3 fresh sage leaves ( optional )
instructions: In skillet, cook sausage, garlic and celery seeds over medium high heat until sausage is browned and cooked through, stirring to keep from sticking. Drain off fat. Add cheese, cocoa, and stock. Stir well.

title: Carrot, Banana, & Roasted Red Pepper Soup
ingredients: 3 carrots, peeled and julienned | 2 medium red peppers, roasted | 1 -2 banana, peeled and sliced | 2 cups all-purpose flour ( about 1 cup ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes, undrained ( about 20-22 ounces )
instructions: Spray a large 6 - 8 quart pot with cooking spray, add carrots, peppers, banana, flour, and rotel tomatoes and stir to combine. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,puff pastry,iceberg lettuce,guava paste,mustard seed,gruyere,red onion
title: Guava and Bacon Tartlets
ingredients: 500 g guava paste, sliced | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons dry oregano | 1 red onion, sliced thickly | 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 bunch iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup gruyere or 1/2 cup swiss cheese, grated
instructions: In bowl, combine guava paste, mustard seed, oregano, and onions. Taste and season with pepper. On a lightly floured surface roll out the puff pastry thinly. Using a 3mm round cutter cut out 12 rounds and place on baking trays. Spoon guava mixture onto the pastry and brush the edges with water. Bake in the centre of a preheated oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and stand 5 minutes before slicing. Cut into 8 wedges and place each tartlet on a serving platter. Pour over dressing and sprinkle with grated swiss cheese.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,caper,chipotle chile,thyme leave,breadcrumb,lamb chop,poultry seasoning
title: Quick Grilled Lamb Chops
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 teaspoons minced chipotle chiles | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 1/8 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme leave | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup finely chopped drained bottled capers | 4 lamb chops
instructions: Pour all but rum and capers in a small dish and sprinkle with thyme, poultry seasoning and bread crumbs. Toss in the chops. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove chops from the refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking. Prepare grill. Grill chops 6 - 8 minutes on one side or until internal temperature is 160 degree c. Turn chops and brush with rum. Grill 3 - 5 minutes on the other side or until cooked to your desired doneness. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,spaghetti,wine vinegar,brown rice,pecan,carrot,beef bouillon cube,vegetable broth
title: Chinese 5-Spice Spaghetti (Oriental)
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked spaghetti | 1 cup beef bouillon cube, finely crushed | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 3/4 cup vegetable broth or 3/4 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1/4 cup carrot, sliced into thin 1/8-inch diagonally slices | 1/4 cup toasted pecans, chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup wine vinegar
instructions: Cut spaghetti into 1/2 inch pieces. Place pasta and broth in a saucepot and bring to boiling.

title: Italian Pasta With Broccoli and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into bite size pieces | 2 small russet potatoes, peeled and cut into bite size pieces | 1 lb rotini pasta
instructions: Cook pasta by directions on package until tender.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,peach,corn oil,white sugar,italian parsley,olive,hungarian paprika,pork shoulder
title: Portuguese Pork-Pork Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 1/2- & quot, chunks | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 10 ounces sliced ripe olives, drained | 4 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika | 2 cans chicken stock | 6 tablespoons white sugar | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley, plus more fresh sprigs for garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium heat. Brown pork thoroughly on all sides. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat. Scatter olives, paprika, chicken stock and sugar into hot dutch oven. Cover and bake at 325°f for 2 hours. Remove pork and pour off accumulated fat. Pour pork broth into dutch oven. Simmer over medium low heat for 45 minutes. Stir in chopped parsley. Note, you may use fresh chopped Italian parsley, which should be packed well. Serves. Cooks note, this may be made in advance and refrigerated for up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: bitter,red pepper,mung bean,chunky salsa,beef bouillon cube,brown sugar
title: Bitter Beans
ingredients: 1 red pepper, roughly chopped | 1 bag mung beans | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 2 jars chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons bitters
instructions: Heat olive oil in pan over medium heat. Throw in all the ingredients except the bitter. Stir. Let simmer over low heat for about 45 minutes. After an hour, stir everything around, and simmer for another hour or less. This would be considered good leftovers. If any of the ingredients are still liquid they may be reheated in the microwave.

title: Easy Lemon Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 bottle lemonade ( chilled, the flavored is already chilled. ) | 4 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Pour lemonade into a glass and pour on cheese. Mix with a spoon. Serve with assorted tortilla chips and hot dogs.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,oil,pineapple juice,baking soda,chicken breast half,spring onion,lettuce leaf,raspberry
title: Grilled Pineapple Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, skin removed and chopped | 3/4 cup fresh pineapple juice | 3 spring onions, chopped | 4 cups baby carrots | 1 cup thawed frozen raspberries | 1 cup diced pineapple with juice | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 12 lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup oil
instructions: Mix chicken, pineapple juice, onions and carrots in large bowl. Add the raspberries, pineapple and baking soda and pour over chicken mixture. Toss gently until well coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour or up to 24 hours. Place a serving plate on counter and spread the lettuce leaves around the outside. Heat grill or broiler and position rack to the top of the grill. Cook chicken for approximately 6 minutes per side, or until no longer pink in the center. Let stand 5 minutes. Cut into strips. Serve with pineapple salad.

Random Ingredients: deli hard salami,rye bread,vanilla bean,orange zest
title: Quick Salami Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread | 4 slices deli hard salami | 1/2 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, split
instructions: Slice each sandwich in half. Spread each slice of bread with orange zest and vanilla bean.

title: Blueberry Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 1 1 cup chopped fresh blueberries | 1/3 cup shredded lettuce | 1/3 cup raisins, or more to taste | 1 pinch creole-style seasoning blend
instructions: Mix blueberries, lettuce, raisins, and creole style seasoning together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,vegetable shortening,pork,dark beer,green chili pepper,nutritional yeast,saffron thread,meat
title: Green Chile Pork & Strawberries Stew
ingredients: 1/4 cup veggie shortening | 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted | 1 lb ground lean pork | 1 cup shredded fresh strawberries | 4 -6 saffron threads | 1 can strawberries, drained | 1/2 cup dark beer, or 1/2 cup water | 1 -2 green chili pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Combine the shortening and butter. Melt slowly over low heat. Add the pork and stir until it is cooked through but not brown. Stir in the strawberries, saffron, and half of the water. Stir in the rest of the water and chiles. Put in a greased 4 quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Stir and bake 15 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,veal,orange juice concentrate,cornbread,cannellini bean,black pepper
title: Fantastic Cannellini Bean CASSEROLE #A1
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained & rinsed ( not drained! ) | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed and well drained ( i use orange pure concentrate ) | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 4 tablespoons cornbread ( plain cornmeal will do ) | 2 teaspoons black pepper | 1 lb ground veal, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f degrees. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Transfer to a 2 qt casserole dish or baking dish. Cover and bake 25 to 30 minutes, stirring every 15 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,garlic,parsley,penne pasta,almond extract,marsala wine,egg white,mexican cheese
title: Mexican Mac 'n' Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked penne pasta | 1 bag shredded reduced fat mexican cheese blend ( cheddar, jack, pepperjack ) | 7 ounces shredded fat free mozzarella cheese, divided | 3/4 cup sliced almonds ( optional ) | 2 large egg whites | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup marsala wine ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, reserving 1 cup cooking liquid. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray an 8 inch square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Combine the prepared pasta, 1 cup of the cheese blend, mozzarella cheese, almonds, egg whites, and almond extract in a large bowl. Blend until smooth. Spoon the mixture into the prepared baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees for about 40 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup shredded cheese. Bake for 5 minutes, or until top is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: white rice,hazelnut,chicken thigh,heavy whipping cream,green capsicum,honey
title: Quick and Easy Chicken Cacciatore in Rice Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 green capsicum, chopped ( red bell pepper can be substituted ) | 3 1/4 ounces sweet white rice | 3 1/4 ounces hazelnuts, toasted and chopped | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | honey
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the heavy cream, honey and sherry very well and set the mixture aside until needed. Rinse and pat dry the chicken thighs. If they are less than 1 1/2 inches thick, cut them into strips. Thread the strips onto wooden skewer alternating with strips of capsicum and chicken. Preheat broiler to high. Place the chicken in a nonmetal baking dish or broiler pan. Place under high heat and cook for 6 - 8 minutes, turning and basting the chicken at least twice, until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin pie spice,nori,chicken leg,anaheim chili,cooking oil,beer
title: Pumpkin Beer Legs
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 14 chicken legs with thigh | 2 anaheim chili, chopped | 1/2 ounce pumpkin pie spice | 3 ounces beer, of your choice ( optional ) | 4 sheets nori
instructions: Boil a pot of water for the marinade and the skin. Wash and dry the chicken legs and cut them into pieces of similar size to chicken. Heat half the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the chicken pieces till coloured. Remove chicken from the pan and set aside. Add the remaining oil to the pan, adding the chilies and pumpkin. Cook for a minute then add the beer if using. Pour in the beer with the chicken and bring it to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until chicken is tender and cooked. Set all the ingredients aside and simmer for 25 minutes. Heat another half of the oil in a frying pan and fry the nori until golden. Toss each piece of nori with the cooked marinade, then transfer to a plate and set aside. Cover the nori with plastic wrap to keep warm for a few minutes. Add to the pot the chicken legs and simmer for 5 minutes and squeeze with fingers until warm. Return the chicken legs back to the pot and stir. Serve the chicken legs hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken liver,rose water,cognac,coconut milk,white mushroom,dill weed,tomato ketchup
title: Dried Tomatoes, Chicken Liver & Cognac
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | 6 tablespoons cognac or 2 tablespoons white wine | 3 tablespoons chicken livers, sliced thin | 1 can coconut milk | 1 tablespoon rose water | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 4 white mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Combine everything except mushrooms in a large sauce pan and simmer until the liquid has reduced the consistency of tomato sauce. Strain the liquid into a measuring cup and pour it into the liquid in the pan. Keep warm over low heat, covered until ready to serve. Garnish with mushrooms and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Hungarian Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs egg noodles, uncooked | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine onion, soup and canola oil in a 3 quart pot. Stir well. When noodles are done, drain them, rinse with cold water and toss with noodle mixture. Serve.

title: Creme Sticks-Rolled Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 fresh sage leaves | 500 g fresh mushrooms, washed, brushed well with oil | 120 ml thickened cream or 120 ml creme fraiche | 6 cardamom pods, crushed | 10 round puff pastry sheets or 10 small savory round tart pans | 10 small dried sage leaves | 100 g dry roasted sweet potato flakes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200ºc. Prepare the stuffing by placing all ingredients into a large oven dish, except for dried sage leaves, and heating them in the oven until the cream begins to thicken. Transfer the stuffing to a pastry bag fitted with a plain tip, add the sage and roll into 8 balls. Roll each piece of pastry to 15 x 12 and then cut out the required 8 squares. Place in the oven for about 10 minutes or until pastry is golden. Drain on kitchen paper and serve with warm creme fraiche if desired. Note, if using savory leaves, place them in a small pan with 1/2 cup water and bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes, then drain and dry on kitchen paper and brush on with cream. Dry roast the pastry in the oven for about 12 to 15 minutes or until it is brown and crispy. When cooked, remove it from the oven and immediately place one tart piece into the hollow of the dish or puff pastry case with a sage leaf. Repeat until all of the pastry is used up. Place the mushrooms on top of the filled tart.

title: Veal Tacos (Veal and Mozzarella)
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 heads of garlic ( depending on size ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 head of lettuce | 1/4 cup cocoa powder | 2/3 cup shredded mun mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cube the veal, and rinse with water. Place the cubed meat into a large bowl. Add the garlic and salt, and leave covered while cutting the head into smaller pieces. After draining the water, add the asafoetida, cover with cheese, and set aside. Take your two largest spoons and put them first into your bowl, and place your two clean spoons into the bowl, and put the santa leaf or bowl in the center, place a scoop of meat mixture into the bowl, and scoop more meat mixture. Place back into the bowl, and repeat these steps, using two forks to pull the meat into smaller pieces. The more meat mixture you scoop, the firmer the meat will be. You will end up with two or three slightly tough tacos. The key is to keep pushing the meat from the sides of the bowl, and not your nose, but the pressure produced inside of your bowl should escape. The goal is to push the meat to the edges of your bowl. The key is the meat to not break, because it will be too runny. When this happens, cover the bowl with foil and set aside on the side to let the meat dry out for 2 hours, or overnight. To prepare your taco filling, put your mozzarella cheese into a bowl. Place your meat mixture into a paper sack, cover, and set aside. Put two spoonsfuls of meat mixture into the cheese, and make a second layer of meat mixture on top. You will need 4 - 5 strips of mozzarella. Put on a cookie sheet, and set in the freezer to set, about 20 - 30 minutes. Once the meat mixture sets, remove the plastic wrap and allow it to cool. This will help the mozzarella flavor melt into the meat. Cut in half, pull out the seeds and fibers, and use them to flavor tacos for burritos. You can also use whatever method you prefer, such as corn, red onion, or pepperoni.

title: Danish Almond Cream
ingredients: 5 cups almonds, blanched and skinned ( i prefer roasted, skinned blanched almonds ) | 1 small red onion, finely diced | 1 tablespoon orange peel, grated | 8 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Heat a heavy based pan over medium heat and gently cook the almond skins until golden and soft, 5 - 10 minutes, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, peel and dice the onion. Place the orange peel in a sieve over a bowl. Using a fine mesh sieve set over a bowl, place a heatproof plate on top. Dampen your finger tips or sharp knife with cold water and dip both the almonds and onion in the liquid. Allow the skin to drip off, then gently press through the sieve to expose all the flesh. Chop the flesh roughly and stir into the sieve. Return the mixture to the pan over low heat, stir in the cream and simmer over a medium low heat, stirring regularly, 15 - 20 minutes. The cream should have thickened slightly and started to bubble and smell strongly of the almonds.. Transfer to a large serving bowl and cool to room temperature. Refrigerate until well chilled, at least 4 hours and up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: korean rice,fast rising yeast,fruit,creole seasoning,mexican tomato sauce,kalamata olive,ghee butter
title: Korean Tomato Sticks
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups kalamata olives, pitted | 1 can mexican-style tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 4 1/2 - 5 cups cooked korean-style prepared slow-rising yeast
instructions: Combine olives and tomato sauce in a food processor.

title: Black Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small saucepan, bring mustard seeds just to a boil, then remove from heat and cover to let cool down. When cool, remove the skins. In a small dry skillet or spice grinder, grind the hot mustard seeds until they are a fine powder. Add the paprika, adjust the seasonings and serve. Store in an airtight jar at room temperature for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: pepperoncini pepper,steak,pork tenderloin,ketchup,splenda sugar substitute,beef sirloin
title: Beef Fondue
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef sirloin | 1 lb steak | 2 pork tenderloins | 14 ounces pepperoncini peppers | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/3 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1/3 cup splenda sugar substitute, for rolling
instructions: Slice beef steak into bite sized chunks. Slice pork loin into bite sized pieces. Slice beef into bite sized chunks. Combine all remaining ingredients in crockpot. Cook on high 4 - 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,bean sprout,meat tenderizer,chicken bouillon cube,coconut
title: Spicy Coconut Meat (For the Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato sauce | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 cups fresh coconut | 1 lb fresh cooked meat tenderizer ( i used venison or pork sausage ) | 1 can beans sprouts
instructions: Sprinkle tenderizer over meat. Pour tomato sauce over pork. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Add coconut during last half hour of cooking.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,pasta,pine nut,cashew,tomato green chilies,corn tortilla,lime juice,white wine
title: Beef Enchilada Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb beef roast | 1/2 cup white wine | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 16 ounces drained canned diced tomatoes with mild green chilies, undrained | 8 ounces canned cashews, chopped | 8 ounces canned corn tortillas, drained | 1/3 cup cashews | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Place roast in crockpot. Cover.

title: Grilled Japanese Chicken With Crispy Crisp Bread for Shaking
ingredients: 1 chicken leg, cut into 6 leg in. 1 1/2 inch thick slices of white bread | 3 -4 slices of dried shichimi togarashi or 3 -4 slices dry fishy fish | 3 slices of fresh carrot | 1 teaspoon coriander | sake, sauce | steak, thinly sliced, for serving
instructions: Place a piece of paper on countertop or a plate and place the bread on top. Sprinkle the rice/rice or shichimi togarashi over rice/rice/rice. Layer carrot and coriander over rice/rice. Sprinkle the togarashi on the top. If desired, top with sliced steak. If steamed, place steamed piece of chicken on top. Use two skewers for each piece of chicken. Lightly oil the grill grates. When hot, put about a teaspoon of meat on the oiled grill grate. Using one skewer, push meat off the skewers. The meat should not stick, and not fall out of the skewers. Grill for 2 - 3 minutes, turning often or to the desired doneness. Serve the grilled chicken hot with sake sauce. It should also be toasted and served with wasabi or ginger slices.

title: Rigatoni With Turnips and Jasaggery(Charishma)
ingredients: 6 medium turnips ( peeled, cubed 1 1/2 cm. ) | 2 bunches coriander ( chopped leaves and stalks to yield 2 bunches ) | 1/3 cup lemon wedge ( divided ) | 1 teaspoon cashews or 1 teaspoon pepitas | 4 large egg whites | 1/4 cup jaggery ( grated ) | 1 1/2 ounces dried rigatoni pasta ( not supermarket brand ) or 1 1/2 ounces other small shaped pasta ( not supermarket brand ) | 1 teaspoon jaggery ( ground ) | 2 teaspoons brandy
instructions: Mix the turnip, coriander, lemons and cashew in a bowl. Whip the egg whites with a pinch of salt and 1/4 cup of the jaggery until you can hold peaks. Add the remaining jaggery, whisking until thick and glossy. Add the turnip mixture to the bowl and fold in the egg whites. Season and mix well. Cook in a large pot of boiling, salted water for 7 minutes, and drain. Cut the pasta and turnip into quarters. Cook in the remaining jaggery, stirring, for 2 minutes. Add the brandy and continue to cook until it thickens. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Put the pasta in plates and arrange the turnip mixture on top. Serve with remaining lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: chicken,white chocolate,cayenne powder,beetroot,pickling onion,extra virgin olive oil,strawberry
title: Spicy Strawberry Chicken
ingredients: 2 kg small waxy chicken, pieces ( we have used breasts too ) | 1 large beetroot, peeled and cubed | 1 sweet pickling onion, peeled, diced | 125 g white chocolate, roughly chopped ( or dark chocolate ) | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder ( to taste ) | 500 g fresh strawberries
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°c or 240°c if using regular oven chicken, heat oil and cook chicken for 5 mins on each side or until cooked through. Cool, then slice into bite sized pieces. To make the sauce, combine all of the ingredients and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Place chicken in a pan, pour sauce over and cover with lid or foil. Cook in the oven, for 1 hour. Serve the chicken warm or warm. Garnish with pickling onions if desired.

title: Tasted Red Pepper Ice Cream
ingredients: 3 cups strawberries | 2 cups heavy cream | 1/4 cup red pepper | 3 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1 lb arugula, trimmed
instructions: To make the marinade, combine the strawberries with the cream in a food processor, and process until smooth. Stir in red pepper, and puree until smooth. Scrape into a bowl, and fold in vanilla sugar until melted. Place the arugula in the center of a sheet of waxed paper, and spread evenly over the paper. Press the arugula into the paper, then roll the arugula into a cylinder shape. Freeze 30 minutes, or until firm. Transfer the chilled jar onto a dessert plate, and carefully roll in the chilled orange marinade until coated. Refrigerate, covered, for 6 hours or overnight. Slice into thin pieces, or cut into slices and serve.

title: Nuoc Cham (Vietnamese Noodles)
ingredients: 1 lb sweet butter | 1 lb salted butter | 3 cups of real fish sauce
instructions: Make fish sauce by melting your butter at a low heat. In a pan add your nuoc cham, 1 pound of salted butter and 2 cups of fish sauce. Mix well, bring to a boil, reduce heat and leave to simmer for 20 minutes. Add more lemon/fish sauce or sugar to taste. I like ours very sweet.

title: Corn Fritters With Cilantro
ingredients: 6 -8 cups fresh cilantro leaves, packed | 1 white onion, halved | cornflour, to dust | white onion, strips to garnish
instructions: If the cilantro leaves are coarsely chopped, then use a blender or food processor to grind them finely. Set aside. Place the chopped cilantro leaves in a clean tea towel to dry for 5 - 10 minutes. Remove the paper towel and set aside until the leaves are dry. Trim off any large roots or stems, then chop in a food chopper or blender. Place the chopped white onion in a clean glass bowl add the chopped cilantro sprigs and mix to combine. Coat the entire mixture of herbs with the cornflour, then dip each fritter in the cornflour so that all of the breadcrumbs are covered. Then place in a non stick pan placed over a medium heat. Sauté the fritters for 2 - 3 minutes, turning once or twice, making sure the fritters are golden on both sides and tender inside. Serve immediately. Serves.

title: Tasty Lamb Chard Chard (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg kale leaves, weighed after removing some of the stems and coarsely chopped | 1 lamb shoulder, trimmed of all fat and cut into 2 cm chunks | 1 large leek, trimmed, washed and sliced | 2 cups apple juice | 2 xanthan gum
instructions: Place the kale leaves in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil over a high heat and cook until just tender, about 8 minutes. Drain well and allow to cool, then cut into 1cm cubes. Put all the chopped veg in a bowl and add the lemon juice. Stir to combine. Add 3/4 of the chopped celery, the lamb, the ground celery and the apple juice and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours. Stir into the veg mixture until the greens are thoroughly coated with the flavour. Sprinkle the rest of the celery over the top. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours before serving.

title: Grilled Vanilla Chicken Breast with Vanilla
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts
instructions: Prepare grill place chicken breasts on grill plate and sprinkle with salt. Grill 15 minutes until the chicken is very white. Remove chicken from grill with slotted spoon and turn each breast over and spray the other side. Grill the breasts until done the rest of the way.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,jalapeno pepper,chicken breast half,red chilies,margarine,garlic
title: Spicy Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 2 tablespoons minced fresh jalapeno peppers, or to taste | 2 fresh red chilies, seeded and minced
instructions: Rinse and pat dry chicken breasts. Cut crosswise into strips. Whisk sesame oil, margarine, garlic, jalapeno peppers, and red chilies together in a bowl. Place shrimp in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,miracle whip,puff pastry,cardamom seed,oregano leaf
title: Puff Pastry and Mustard Spread
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 1/4 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 pinch oregano leaves | 1/4 cup miracle whip
instructions: Roll out all the ingredients. Cut a hole in the middle and put a teaspoon of mustard paste inside. Dump the stuffing in half and bake on a lightly greased tray for 20 - 30 mins at 180°c.

Random Ingredients: yeast,thyme,rosemary sprig,chorizo sausage,cabbage,extra virgin olive oil
title: Chorizo and Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1 cup shredded chorizo sausage | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary sprigs | 3 1/2 cups fresh shredded cabbage | 1 1/4 cups extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary sprigs | 1 tablespoon dried yeast
instructions: Place whole cabbage in baking dish and cover with water. Cover and let rise for 30 minutes. Rinse cabbage and remove excess water, then shred using 2 forks. Combine cabbage, chorizo, thyme, rosemary, 1 cup shredded cabbage, extra virgin olive oil, rosemary, and 1 tablespoon rosemary in a large bowl. Let dough rise and punch down to release all air pockets. Divide dough into 12 equal pieces. Put about a tablespoon of each herb mixture on each dough piece. Place dough on a lightly oiled surface, cover with wet cloth, and let rise for 1 to 2 hours, or until the dough has expanded. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Slice dough 3/4 inch thick. Brush each piece of dough with olive oil and sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon rosemary. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the filling is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: potato traditional,tater tot,chili pepper flake,maple syrup,corn tortilla,ancho chile,baking soda
title: Cheater's Enchiladas
ingredients: 20 corn tortillas | 10 ounces tater tot, chopped | 1 can chili peppers with beans | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 large dried ancho chiles | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup sweet potato traditional | corn tortillas, for topping
instructions: Chop your sweet potato into small bits with a potato masher, or peel them. Heat pan with 1/4 cup olive oil and a can of water over medium high. Add diced potato, and a pinch of chili pepper flakes. Bring to boil. While potatoes are cooking, spray cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray. Set aside. When potatoes are tender, pour off most of the water. Then add your taco seasoning package. Add your chopped taco spices. You can do this with your own personal preference if you want a hotter dish. Once potatoes are tender, put aside until cool enough to handle. Use a spoon to scoop a quarter of the mixture and roll up, about 1/8” thick. Next, lightly coat the tortillas with a little cooking spray. Then, place them in a baking dish in a single layer. Add taco mixture to baking dish. Cover the enchiladas with taco mixture. Sprinkle corn tortillas over the top. Spray your tops with a little cooking spray. Bake at 350 for about 30 minutes until golden. Take from oven and serve with sour cream, guacamole, salsa, etc. Enjoy.

title: Finnish Beets
ingredients: 2 large beet, peeled, washed, and cut diagonally into 1/2-inch slices | 4 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Place beets in a steamer basket, cover, and steam over high heat until tender, 6 to 8 minutes. Drain. Place beets in a bowl. Heat flour in a bowl over medium heat until lightly browned. Stir beet mixture into flour.

title: Antoine Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 4 -5 slices crusty french bread | 4 -5 small red beans, cut in half | 3 tablespoons pimiento ( optional ) | 1 can red beans, drain and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Lay out a few slices of french bread on counter, lay one piece of red beans on top of the other.. Lay pimento on the bread. Cut off some of the crusty tops from the bread. Spread the red beans over the pimento. Sprinkle cardamom over the beans. Starting from side center of the bread slice, layer the slices over the cardamom to form a rectangle. The diagonal cuts will help to make a nice pattern. Cover with plastic wrap and place in fridge over night to allow flavors to meld. When ready to serve, slice into squares and serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: polish sausage,green chilies,stew meat,pork shoulder,kaffir lime leaf,russet potato,food coloring,black olive
title: Poleko (Polish Stew)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch squares | 10 -12 large black olives, pitted and sliced | 1 can green chilies, sliced ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs fresh kaffir lime leaves, rolled and chopped ( optional ) | 1 lb polish sausage | food coloring ( optional ) | 1 package russet potatoes
instructions: Puncture lime leaves with a small, sharp knife or skewer and lightly grease the bottom of large pot to prevent sticking to bottom. Heat olive oil in pot on medium low heat. Add the meat and sauté until golden brown, approximately 8 - 10 minutes. Add the garlic, chillies, olives, salt. Cook an additional 2 - 3 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: yeast,sherry wine,plain flour,flat leaf parsley,asparagus,apple juice,green chilies
title: Apple Asparagus & Chilies Loaf
ingredients: 1 kg plain flour | 1 cup extra dry sherry wine | 1/4 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/2 cup apple juice | 100 g asparagus, tough ends trimmed | 2 green chilies | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Place the flour in a bowl and make a well in the centre. Mix in the sherry, 3 tblsps water, the chopped parsley & the apple juice. Stir in the asparagus & chilies and then cover and leave the mixture in a warm place for 45 minutes or until the dough has doubled in size. Meanwhile place a baking paper in a baking tray & grease lightly. Turn the dough out onto a floured work surface & knead until smooth. Preheat oven to 220c/450f/gas 2. Place the dough in a lightly oiled 18x28cm loaf pan, pressing down with your fingers to make a smooth base. Place the loaf pan in the oven and bake for 50 mins, basting every 7 minutes with sherry and cooking juices. Remove from the oven and leave the loaf in the oven for 10 minutes. Brush the loaf with 2 tblsps of water and return to the oven for a further 10 mins or until crisp on top and golden brown on top. Remove the loaf from the oven, leave to cool slightly & turn out onto a wire rack & leave to cool completely. Meanwhile, to make the dressing ~ in a bowl, combine all the dressing ingredients and season to taste with salt and pepper. Brush the loaf with the dressing and place on serving plates. Cut the asparagus into four thick slices. Scatter over the fresh parsley & serve at once.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,taco flour tortilla,egg noodle,sirloin,honey,half cream,grain brown rice,broccoli
title: Quick Beef and Noodle Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup light greek yogurt | 1 can fat-free half-and-half cream | 5 eggs | 1 lb ground sirloin | 3/4 cup uncooked regular long grain brown rice, rinsed | 1 box egg noodles, cooked fresh | 1/3 cup honey | 32 inches fat free tortillas or 32 inches fat free flour tortillas
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine yogurt and cream.

title: Curried Spinach Couscous
ingredients: 1 ounce dried ancho chiles | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1/4 lb fresh spinach, washed | 4 cups hot cooked couscous
instructions: Combine chiles and oregano in a small bowl. Add the wine, turn mixture over and let cool to room temperature. In a large saucepan cook spinach over moderate heat, covered, stirring occasionally, until just wilted, about 5 minutes. Stir in spinach mixture and remaining ingredients except couscous. Bring to a boil. Pour couscous over spinach mixture. Cover and cook over moderately low heat, stirring occasionally, until hot, about 3 minutes.

title: Chinese Peach & Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 2 bottles ginger ale, chilled | 200 g button mushrooms, sliced | 200 g chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 slices fresh melon ( about 300g ) | 1/3 teaspoon saffron | 2 teaspoons sliced blanched almonds, toasted
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts in a large bowl. Cover and chill until serving time. Sprinkle with toasted almonds.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 1 cup orange juice ( freshly squeezed ) | 1 1/2 pounds lobster meat, cubed | 2 teaspoons dry mustard powder | 1 jalapeno, seeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Stir the orange juice, lobster meat, dry mustard powder, jalapeno, and sage in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove the lobster meat from the bowl, and slice it to desired serving size.

title: Kettle Mashed Corned Beef
ingredients: 4 medium russet potatoes, peeled cut into chunks and boiled until fork tender | 4 -5 thin slices of the center cut of the kettle potato | 2 tablespoons ground coriander | 1 can tomato juice | 2 -3 dashes ale
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the ground coriander in a large pot and stir to combine. Drain potatoes and pat dry. Add to other ingredients except the ground coriander. Simmer for 5 minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon powder,bean sprout,chicken thigh,sago,sauce,tahini,green chilies
title: Baked Sago Dump
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 2 cups mixed sprouts, such as spinach, or green beans | 1 can diced mild green chilies ( or green pepper ) | 2/3 cup saag sauce | 1/4 cup tahini ( sesame seed ) | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon powder | 1 cup hot cooked sago, such as sesame seed
instructions: Spray a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Rinse chicken and pat dry. Combine with other ingredients except sago. Place in prepared pan and bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes. Remove from oven, turn over and top with sago crumbs.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,chunky salsa,tempeh,dark rum,sultana,almond,corn syrup
title: Warm and Tangy Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice, cooled | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon sultanas or 1 tablespoon golden raisin | 4 tablespoons slivered almonds | 1/4 cup tempeh, finely chopped
instructions: Place cooled rice, salsa, rum, syrup, sultanas or raisins, almonds, and tempeh in a bowl.

title: Spinach Salad With Ham and Rum Ham
ingredients: 4 cups spinach, washed and spun dry, stems removed | 8 ounces ham, diced | 8 ounces mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon orange flower water
instructions: Put the spinach in a salad bowl. Add the ham and roll it into a cylinder shaped shape with the roll beginning to leak out a little of the water. Tear off a piece of string and tie with kitchen paper to keep it together. In a bowl combine the mayonnaise with the orange flower water and mix together well. Add the ham to the salad and mix well. Serve at room temperature.

title: Beef & Pimiento Patties
ingredients: 400 g beef mince | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/3 cup julienne sliced pimiento | 2 tablespoons cilantro salsa | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, roughly chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh dill, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup kelp, sliced very thick
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. In large bowl, mix mince, 1 tbsp canola oil, pimento and 1 tbsp cilantro. Shape into 4 burgers roughly 3cm in diameter. Place on hot grill. Cook 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. To make fresh dill salsa, combine 1 tbsp chopped fresh dill, 1 tbsp chopped fresh dill, 1/2 cup lime juice, 1/4 cup water. Cook over medium heat, stirring until mixture boils and is thickened slightly. Add 1/4 cup finely chopped cilantro leaves. Serve with salsa.

title: Nuoc Cham (Mung Bean Sprouts)
ingredients: 2 cups mung bean sprouts | 2 cups mixed sprouts
instructions: Wash sprouts quickly, dry thoroughly. Place in a bowl with salt and pepper and mix well. Place a spoonful of sprouts about 1 cm apart on a lightly oiled cookie sheet. Cover tightly with foil, place in a preheated oven for about 20 minutes, checking for a few minutes to ensure they are crisp but not black. Allow sprouts to cool slightly before sprinkling with additional sprouts.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,plain yogurt,spaghetti squash,oyster sauce,vanilla essence
title: Pasta Squash With Yogurt
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti squash, cut into 3cm lengths | 1 tablespoon plain low fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon light vanilla essence
instructions: Boil the spaghetti squash in salted water for 10 minutes or until cooked. Drain and return to pan to keep hot. Toss the spaghetti squash in the yogurt, oyster sauce, chili powder and vanilla essence to combine. Serve hot.

title: Mustard Sauce for Shake Me
ingredients: 1 cup finely crushed ice | 1 can frozen raspberries | 1 cup corn syrup | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 cup prepared mustard powder
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the crushed ice, re frozen raspberries, corn syrup, and mustard powder. When ready to serve, stir in prepared mustard powder.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,beet,almond,vegetarian bean,cake flour,self raising flour,cod,caper
title: Fishcakes
ingredients: 500 g cooked haddock or 500 g cod | 500 g cooked beets | 225 g cake flour | 35 g self-raising flour | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1/4 cup mixed pickled beets | 1/2 cup roasted salted almond, chopped | 3 teaspoons capers, drained
instructions: Grease muffin tins. Slice fish and mix in beets and mix with cake flour, curry powder and capers. Spoon mixture into muffin tins and bake at 190c for 15 - 20 minutes. To remove from oven brush tops with melted butter, sprinkle with sugar. Return to oven for a further 10 - 15 minutes until cooked.

title: Easy Dumplings
ingredients: 4 cups wonton wrappers | 12 fresh curry leaves | dried coriander powder
instructions: Combine the wonton wrappers by lying them on a floured board. Place about 2 tablespoons of the mixture along the centre of the dough, brush off stray mixture and moisten edges with water. Fold in the corners of the dough and pinch with your fingers until the wrappers are completely covered. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Working in batches, drop the filled dumplings into the boiling water, then reduce heat to a simmer. Cook 10 minutes, then remove from water and let stand. Boil the dumplings in the pot for about 5 minutes. Dry the remaining dumplings on paper towels and serve. If desired, sprinkle with coriander powder before serving.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,fava bean,broth,hot chili pepper,cheddar cheese,bean,cream tartar,peppercorn
title: Cheddar & Bean Baked in Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup hot chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup tartare | 1/4 cup beans, cooked and drained | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | 1 1/2 cups canned fava beans or 1 1/2 cups frozen fava beans, cooked and drained | 7 cups broth
instructions: Heat soup, chili, cheese, sour cream, beans and peppercorns and cook on low heat until cheese melts. Add bean and simmer an additional 10 mins. Or until hot, stirring frequently. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and grease a 9x13 baking dish. Pour bean mixture into buttered baking dish and bake in centre rack of oven 15 - 20 mins. Or until heated through.

title: Melting Oat Patties
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 cup old fashioned oats | cornflour | white cheddar cheese, grated or your favourite cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/180c or gas mark wipe the cut surface of the eggplant and cut it into 4 5cm cubes, then place in a roasting tin and sprinkle over the oats. Cut the corners off the cheddar cheese as well as the seasoning packet and press the pieces into a roughly circular shape. Brush the surface of the eggplant with oil, then toss the cubes around the eggplant to thoroughly coat well. Bake for 1hrs until the oats are a pale golden brown colour and the cubes are softened. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,white grape juice,white sugar,lemon zest
title: Grape Prawns With Chilli and Chilli
ingredients: 8 large red chilies | 2 1/2 tablespoons red fresno red chilies | 40 ounces white grape juice | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 2 teaspoons lemon zest
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c, 300f, gas mk lightly grease baking tray with vegetable or olive oil. Cut off and discard ends of each chilli and pull off ribs and seeds. Blanch chillies in boiling water for 15 seconds and set aside. Heat up grape juice and sugar in pan until sugar dissolves and mixture comes to the boil. Mix lemon rind into the chilli mixture. Add chillies and chillies and gently toss. Spoon mixture into baking tray, level the top with a knife and score into diamond shapes. Bake for about 35 minutes.

title: Chicken or Mangoes With Noodle Rolls
ingredients: 2 containers chicken wings or ( 10 ounce ) cans chicken legs-flavored vegetable florets | 8 ounces uncooked lasagna noodles | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place noodles in a medium sized baking dish.

title: Italian Slaw
ingredients: 1 red cabbage ( chopped coarse ) | 1 envelope zesty italian salad dressing mix ( or try marzetti brand )
instructions: Mix together very well. Chill.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,heavy cream,no salt corn
title: Nachos - Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 32 ounces cream of chicken soup | 2/3 cup heavy cream | 20 ounces no-salt-added corn
instructions: In bowl combine cream of chicken soup and heavy cream until blended. Refrigerate until ready to use. Pour desired amount of soup mixture into greased 9x13 pan. Evenly mix corn and spread into pan. Pour remaining mixture over corn and chill at least 2 hours. Can also be prepared ahead and made in advance. Bring to room temperature before serving. Spray pan with pan or lightly sprinkle with corn meal. Spoon 1/4 cup soup mixture at a time onto pan. Roll the dough up. Seal seams well and place seam side down in casserole dish. Repeat until all the chicken mixture is used. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 - 35 minutes or until center of dish is set. Sprinkle the top with paprika if desired before serving.

Random Ingredients: chestnut,basil leaf,brown rice,french bread,chicken stock,green olive,parsley
title: Chestnut Rice Gratin
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups french bread | 2 tablespoons brown rice | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1/3 cup fresh parsley | 1 cup chestnuts, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup green olives, roughly chopped | fresh basil leaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Slice the frond the bread into very thin strips. Arrange the bread on a baking tray. Bake until lightly golden brown and crunchy, about 10 minutes, remove from the oven and stir to remove any crusty crust. Place the rice in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to the boil and then turn up the heat to a low simmer and cook, covered, for 10 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and cover, and leave for 5 minutes, until the water is absorbed. Toast the chicken and chopped chestnuts separately in a heavy frying pan, in batches if necessary. Preheat the broiler. Grease a 9x5 cup ovenproof baking dish with the olive oil. Place the rice, stock, parsley leaves, chestnuts, and olives in a blender and process until smooth. Pour this mixture into a large oven proof dish and top with the bread slices to cover the top. Broil the bruschetta on the top shelf of the oven until bubbling and brown, about 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Garlicky Garlic Tea
ingredients: 6 garlic cloves, crushed | 2 -3 teaspoons loose loose tea ( or 2 tbsp. strong hot water )
instructions: Crush all the garlic very well. Combine all the ingredients in a small pan and simmer slowly for 1 1/2 hrs, or until the flavors have blended.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,sparkling water,cumin,chocolate,tea,orange juice,white pearl onion,baking powder
title: A New Yorker's Gift:  Spicy  Sweet    Onions  Poached  Crock-Pot
ingredients: 14 white pearl onions, cleaned, peeled, and quartered | 1 jar of grated chocolate ( not unsweetened ) | 1 package strong tea | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 -2 orange, juice of, to taste | 2 tablespoons finely chopped onion powder | 1 teaspoon ground cumin ( or more to taste ) | 8 ounces sparkling water ( preferably white ) or 8 ounces vegetable juice ( preferably white )
instructions: Slice onions in half lengthwise and place in a large crock pot. Add chocolate, and stir well. Add 2 cans of soda water or apple juice and stir well. Add orange, and then 1 - 2 tblsp of onion powder and cumin. Stir well. Place onions over chocolate, and turn on low setting for at least 8 hours.

title: Polish Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large red cabbage | 1/2 beef bouillon cube | 2 cups brandy or 2 cups milk
instructions: Cut up the head of cabbage.

title: Sweet Baked Bananas II
ingredients: 1 cup white sugar | 3 tablespoons cumin powder | 3 ripe bananas, peeled | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup white sugar, or more as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a bowl, stir 2 cups sugar with the cumin and mix well. Cut the bananas lengthwise into quarters. Place the bananas cut side down in the mixture. Use hands to shape each piece into a roll. Spread a little bit of the sugar over the top of the bananas. Cover the rolls with aluminum foil, and bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven. Meanwhile, stir 1/2 cup sugar with 1/2 cup of sugar until the sugars are completely dissolved, and set aside. Remove the rolls from the oven, and set them over the foil lined baking sheet. Return to the oven, and bake 20 minutes or until evenly brown. Remove the pans, and turn them over. Sprinkle the tops with 1/2 cup sugar, and return the rolls to oven for 10 more minutes, or until the sugar has melted and turned to a caramel color.

title: Mexican Vegetable Fried Tofu
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu ( tofu ) | 1 large cauliflower floret, sliced | 1 poblano pepper, sliced | olive oil or vegetable oil
instructions: Drain tofu and cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Slice green and red pepper into thin strips. Saute vegetables in a medium sized frying pan with olive oil or vegetable oil, just until crisp tender.

Random Ingredients: cream,kale,superfine sugar,white chocolate,strawberry jam,white rice,baby carrot
title: Kale and Rice Cannelloni
ingredients: 2 cups cubed cooked white rice | 4 cups baby carrots, sliced | 6 strawberries, sliced | 1 cup sour cream | 1 cup shredded white chocolate | 1/2 cup strawberry jam | 1/4 cup superfine sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 13x9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Mix rice, carrots, and strawberries in a large bowl. In another bowl, whisk sour cream, chocolate, and sugar together.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,filet beef,cardamom pod,white onion,cottage cheese,sardine oil
title: Beef Kefta Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb sardines packed in oil | 2/3 cup cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 small white onion, minced finely | 4 whole cardamom pods, cracked ( or 6 pods black )
instructions: Cut slits all over fish using a small knife. Combine remaining ingredients, except fish, in a medium bowl and beat well. Add fish to bowl and cover and let stand 15 minutes. Remove fish from slits reserving marinade. Thread on skewers. Grill keftas 5 inches from medium hot coals 10 minutes, turning often, until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve keftas hot.

Random Ingredients: beef rump roast,cinnamon oil,red chile pepper
title: Salsa Roasted Pork for Carnitas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cinnamon oil | 1 can whole red chile peppers | 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Brush olive oil on bottom of shallow baking dish. Place roast in dish and toss with cinnamon oil. Bake at 300 degrees f for 1 hour. Arrange browned roast on top of roast, then add red chilies and continue baking until meat is tender and pulls apart easily, 2 to 4 hours. Transfer roast to cutting board. Scoop meat mixture into serving bowl, then cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,egg,tomato green chile pepper,pork sausage,dark brown sugar,pita bread,tomato paste,zucchini
title: Sausage Stuffed Zucchini
ingredients: 1 zucchini, halved lengthwise and hollowed out | 1 teaspoon chopped sun dried tomato paste | 2 ounces ground pork sausage | 1 egg, beaten | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 8x8 inch pan and line the zucchini halves with a round of waxed paper. Sprinkle the outside of the prepared zucchini with chopped sun dried tomatoes. Bake zucchini in the preheated oven until tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and turn halves over, and continue to cook until cooled slightly, about 15 minutes more. Remove the zucchini shells and top with the crumbs. In a large skillet, cook the sausage over medium heat until browned and crumbly, breaking the meat up as it cooks, 6 to 8 minutes. Drain. Lightly beat together the egg, cracker crumbs, brown sugar, and tomato paste in a large bowl. Stir in the tomatoes. Spoon half the sausage mixture into the zucchini shells, and sprinkle with half the crumb mixture and tomato paste mixture, spreading it evenly over the sausage.

title: Fig-Potato - French Figs
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 4 cups small dried figs, cut in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f line a deep roasting pan with foil or parchment paper. Dissolve onion soup mix in just enough water to barely cover the figs. Arrange figs around the sides of the baking dish. Pour the soup over the figs to cover. Put roasting pan in the oven, bake for 2 hours, tossing every 30 minutes. Note, the figs can also be placed on top of the figs at this point. Remove figs with a slotted spoon and place in a baking dish to keep hot.

Random Ingredients: maple extract,pepper flake,mint leaf,self raising flour,thai chili sauce,semolina,sherry wine
title: Simple, Delicious & Easy Sweet Peppercorn Scones
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups self-raising flour | 1/4 cup semolina | 1 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1 teaspoon dried hot pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 3 teaspoons thai sweet chili sauce ( nam pla ) | 2 teaspoons maple extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Place flour, semolina, dried mint and pepper flakes in a mixing bowl if using, and mix until well mixed. Dissolve sherry in sherry and add to flour mixture along with dried mint and fresh mint. Use your hands to mix it all together, then add remaining ingredients mixing to combine. Place the dough onto a well floured surface and roll out to about 2mm thick, about 15cm in diameter. Cut out round or square shapes with cookie cutter and place on a lightly greased, non stick baking tray. Brush tops with a little olive oil, sprinkle generously with sugar and bake on the middle shelf of the oven for 10 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Cafe Mexicano
ingredients: 1 -6 ounce sweetened cocoa ( `` manchego '' brand `` brand ) | 1 -4 ounce black coffee, cold | white vinegar ( `` caldo de sabor de puerco '' brand `` caffe borgiana ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped pimiento
instructions: Put cocoa mix with the hot coffee in the fondue pot, add the pimentos and keep on warm while you make the coffee.

title: Spicy Chocolate Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar curry paste | 1 lb small green chili, seeded | 6 tablespoons whipping cream | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 teaspoon dried sage | jelly, to top
instructions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly. Chill at least one hour before serving. Spoon over salads or as filling.

title: Chicken in Pasta Shells
ingredients: 300 ml soda water | 200 g mozzarella cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons chicken base | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Boil the water and cook the mozzarella for 1 minute. Add the cream, stir and then set aside. Mix egg yolk with the grated cheese when it's cool enough to handle. Pour in the baking dish. Put in pre heated oven for 20 minutes. If possible, serve this with spaghetti sauce. The egg yolk will cling to the pasta better.

title: Sesame Seed Chapati
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds, ground | 1 tablespoon pepperoncini pepper, finely chopped, for garnish
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, sesame seeds, ground pepperoncini, and the whole wheat mixture. Shape into a firm round, cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before rolling. Preheat a grill or skillet over medium high heat. Lightly oil the grates, and press the hot chapati onto the grate. Cook until golden brown, flipping once, about 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,grainy mustard,tortilla,brussels sprout,pillsbury crescent dinner,basil leaf,tomato,island dressing
title: Jen's Fantastically Yummiest Lunch
ingredients: 12 tortillas | 2 pillsbury refrigerated crescent rolls | 2 tomatoes, diced | 1 bottle thousand island dressing | 1 pinch basil leaves | 1 tablespoon grainy mustard | 8 brussels sprouts, sliced | 1/4 cup cottage cheese
instructions: Heat pizza stone in oven. Mix 1 package of crescent rolls with thousand island dressing in a large bowl. Stir in tomatoes, basil leaves, grainy mustard, and brussels sprouts. Spread 1/4 cup of cottage cheese on the bottom of a pizza stone and top with the second bag of crescent rolls, pressing to seal. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes in the oven. Slice into 3 - 4 long wedges. Serve each wedge with a brussels sprout wedge.

title: Indian Season's Bread
ingredients: 3 cups self rising flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder ( to taste )
instructions: Combine the flour and the cumin powder. Use a knife to mix well until the mixture is smooth. Turn onto a floured surface and knead lightly for 10 minutes. Remove from the mixing bowl, place on a lightly floured kitchen towel, and roll out to 1/4 inch thick. Cut into desired shape. Place on a greased pizza pan or griddle. Preheat the oven to 450 degree f. Bake for 12 minutes or until browned lightly. Cut into wedges. Allow to cool, then serve warm or cool on a wire rack and enjoy.

title: Smoky Chipotle Grilled Ham Hocks
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ham hocks | 1/2 cup chipotle chile | 1 large green pepper | 4 slices white bread | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Rinse all but the top 1/2 inch of the head of the ham. Cut the heads off the ham hocks. Remove the neck and giblets and discard. Cut off the top quarter of the ham hocks and discard. Pat the top with a paper towel and set the whole head in the bottom of a large pot with about 2 t of water on the top. The water should just cover the ham. Chop the pepper, then cut the green pepper into strips about 1 x 1 1/4. Cover the ham hocks and the water with 3/4 c chipotle, cover and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium low, cover and simmer until the meat is tender and easily shreds, 2 1/2 3 hours or more. Remove the ham hocks from the pot and reserve the liquid for another use. Cool the ham for at least 15 minutes before serving. Remove some of the fat from the liquid and discard. Cool the ham and shred it into a small bowl using two forks. Tear the bread into bite size pieces and set aside. Remove the core from the pepper, remove seeds and veins. Add the bread, pepper pieces, cardamom and some of the reserved chipotle liquid to the bowl. Stir to combine and taste. Let set 1 hour before serving.

title: Beef Tenderloin Steaks With a Fresh Taco Recipe
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 cup low-sodium taco sauce | 6 slices bacon, cooked to taste and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( any mild or hot ) | 1 dash chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to high, or prepare a stove and grill to high. Place meat on prepared rack and drizzle with taco sauce. Cook, turning and rearranging to help brown evenly, until instant read thermometer reads 160 degrees, 5 to 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook bacon in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp, about 5 minutes, then transfer to paper towels and drain on paper towels. Add peas to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender crisp, about 2 minutes. Serve the beef on plate with beans.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,mango powder,egg substitute,rib celery,grain white rice,beef bouillon cube
title: Fritos De Olla
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice, such as arborio | 1/2 cup egg substitute ( like egg beaters ) | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup egg substitute ( like egg beaters ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle chile | 1/2 teaspoon dried mango powder | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Taste, and adjust seasonings with more salt until needed. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Sear meat and cook until browned. Stir in rice and cook about 1 minute. Add egg and cook until eggs are done to your liking. Spoon rice into a 1 cup capacity muffin tin. Fill with meat and serve with taco toppings and sour cream.

title: Sausage-Braised Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs polish sausage, sliced | 1 package chicken wings, cleaned and cut into thirds | 2 1/2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1 package beef roast | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Brown the sausage in a deep fry pan, adding allspice in the fry pan when you add the sausage you should have about 4 inches of sausage fat in the pan. Remove the sausage and add the chicken wings and allspice on top. Add the bouillon and enough water to cover the wings. Cover and simmer until the chicken falls of the bone. Then boil the sausage and chicken wing pieces until cooked, usually 6 - 8 hrs to overnight. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,scallion,wine vinegar,yellow cornmeal,vidalia onion,button mushroom
title: Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 cup chopped yellow cornmeal | 3 cups sliced button mushrooms | 1 small vidalia onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1/4 cup chopped minced scallion
instructions: In 3 quart saucepan, combine chicken stock, cornmeal, mushrooms and onion. Heat to boiling. Meanwhile, in small bowl, combine wine vinegar and scallions. Stir into soup. Serve with crusty french bread.

Random Ingredients: white onion,fire tomato,fish sauce,monterey jack cheese,cocoa
title: Tomatillo Queso
ingredients: 1 medium white onion, minced with the last two in it | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 can whole fire-roasted tomatoes | 6 tablespoons ground cocoa | 1 1/2 - 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a blender add the onions and cook it over high setting, stirring continuously. Add the fish sauce and process for about 30 seconds or so to blend and to mix in the tomatoes. Add the cheese and process a few seconds longer. Serve warm.

title: Tiepix
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons spice
instructions: Add all ingredients to blender and blend until mixed, pour into small pieces on toast and enjoy it.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,ladyfinger,pineapple tidbit,mango,no boil lasagna noodle,ketjap manis,pork loin
title: Grilled Pork Loin and Mango Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin | 2 tablespoons ketjap manis | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 package no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained and chopped | 1 mango, peeled and sliced | 1/2 cup sliced ladyfinger ( optional )
instructions: Place pork in a shallow nonreactive baking dish. In shallow pan, mix marinade ingredients and pour over pork. Turn and coat with marinade. Cover and place on a large shallow grill over medium high heat. Grill for 15 minutes, turning once, until desired doneness is achieved.

Random Ingredients: leek,green cardamom pod,swiss cheese,sage leaf,beer,mozzarella cheese,walnut
title: Stuffed Sage Leaves
ingredients: 8 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 2 ounces smoked mozzarella cheese | 4 leaves fresh sage leaves, finely chopped | 1/2 large leek, washed, trimmed, sliced thinly | 6 large green cardamom pods, cracked | 2 teaspoons ground walnuts | 1 1/2 ounces beer or 1 1/2 ounces apple cider
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the swiss and mozzarella cheeses. Mix in sage, leeks, cardom pods, and walnuts. Form a 1 inch or two deep indentations in the mixture with a spoon. Fill each indentation with beer or apple cider. Bake, uncovered over medium heat for 45 - 55 minutes, or until the cheese has melted and begun to brown lightly. Serve hot.

title: Prawns and Chips
ingredients: 250 g raw prawns, shelled and deveined | 1 -2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Place the prawns in a bowl. Season to taste with pepper. Mix until all the prawns are coated. Heat an iron skillet over medium heat. Add the prawns, cook, stirring, for 1 - 2 minutes or until they are pink on the outside and the prawns are heated through. Remove from the skillet and serve hot.

title: Cumin Soup for Holidays, More for Holidays if You Can
ingredients: 400 g shell pasta | 3 tablespoons butter or 3 tablespoons oil | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Cook pasta in a salty water. Drain the pasta and put in a deep microwave safe bowl. Add the oil, butter and cumin. Mix well and microwave until heated through.

Random Ingredients: egg white,coriander seed,tomato paste,beef,beef sirloin,vanilla soymilk,apple cider vinegar,baby shrimp
title: Easy Baked Greek Meatballs (Mamaw's Recipe)
ingredients: 3 lbs ground beef | 2 lbs beef sirloin or 2 lbs flank steaks | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons vanilla soymilk ( vanilla is also good ) | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 cup baby shrimp | 1/2 cup coriander seed, cracked | 1 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Preaheat the oven to 350 degrees. In a large mixing bowl, with your hands make your mashed potato meat, combining the egg white, vanilla soymilk, vinegar, and coriander seeds. Knead it thoroughly, adding more milk if required. Using well floured hands, form small balls and place on a well oiled baking sheet. Use two toothpicks to hold the toothpicks together. Bake for at least an hour to 1 hour 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,extra virgin olive oil,marjoram,seasoning salt,fast rising yeast
title: Tiroka
ingredients: 4 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Scald cream and let cool until nearly to lukewarm. You can also use an electric mixer to do this. Mix 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast and 1 cup cream together. Slowly add more cream, beating after each addition. Add salt and marjoram and 2 teaspoons of olive oil. Beat until well mixed. Gradually add rest of cream. Turn into a greased bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume. Turn out onto a lightly floured board and form into a ball. Place in a deep buttered bowl, cover with a cloth, and turn dough out onto cutting board. Cut in half, about 10 to 12 sections. Shape each section into a mound and cover tightly with a cloth. Let rise until doubled in size, about 15 to 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Brush lightly with olive oil. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: baking cocoa,black cardamom pod,beef stock,chicken tenderloin
title: Lebanese-Style Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken tenderloins | 1 cup beef stock, made with 2 tablespoons bovril | 1 tablespoon baking cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon black cardamom pod
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Wrap tenderloins in foil.

title: Chinese Peanut Chaat
ingredients: 7 tablespoons peanut butter | 6 tablespoons simple syrup ( or more, to taste )
instructions: Mix the peanut butter with the simple syrup. You don't need to mix it thoroughly because each taste has a varying amount of sweetness when tested with a finger.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 6 ounces beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 cup fine breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup fresh sweet breadcrumb | 1 large yellow bell pepper
instructions: Cut slit on top of bell pepper. Reserve pepper intact. Sauté steak until no longer pink and beginning to brown, about 3 minutes on each side. Remove from heat cover steak with a small plate and let sit 5 minutes. Remove steak and cover with a clean plate. Place platter in a warm oven. Drain off any excess fat or moisture. Combine 1/2 cup of bread crumbs and bread crumbs in a shallow dish. Dredge steak in bread crumbs, coating completely. Place steak on rack in roasting pan and baste with some of the pan juices. Roast at 325 degrees until desired doneness, about 1 hour for medium rare, longer for lower to medium. Remove meat from oven and sprinkle with salt/pepper. Let stand 5 minutes and slice meat on the diagonal. Serve with vegetables.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,chicken thigh,ice,oregano,flour,citrus infused vodka,muenster cheese,spaghetti
title: Grilled Chicken in Italian Creamy Martini
ingredients: 2 chicken thighs | 2 cans tomato-infused vodka | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup shredded muenster cheese | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 cup shredded ice | 1/4 cup citrus-infused vodka
