instructions: Combine the vodka, cream, cheese, flour, oregano and ice in a freezer bag and shake. Add chicken into the freezer, about 2 hours. Remove from freezer, debone and discard the meat and return the chicken to the freezer. Remove the meat from the freezer, wipe dry the breasts, place on greased grill rack over indirect heat, and cook indirectly over direct heat for 10 minutes or until nicely browned. Brush the breasts with liquor during cooking, if desired. Grill, covered, over indirect heat for 20 minutes, brushing with liquor. When the chicken is done, transfer to plates, top with tomato sauce and garnish with lemon slices, if desired.

title: Jamaican Turkey Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons ground allspice | 1 package ground chicken | 2 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric
instructions: In a small bowl, mix molasses, allspice, and chicken to form a paste. Sprinkle spice paste and chicken mixture onto a plate. Store unused portions in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,cornbread muffin mix,napa cabbage,corn flake crumb,green curry paste
title: Spicy Corn Bread Crusted Napa Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 packaged cornbread muffin mix | 1/4 teaspoon green curry paste, divided | 3/4 cup kernel corn | 3 tablespoons corn flakes crumbs, divided, divided | 2 packages shredded napa cabbage ( about 4 cups )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Prepare muffin mix, mix next 5 ingredients in mixing bowl until well blended. Stir in cabbage, stirring just until evenly coated. Sprinkle half of crumbs atop each top with remaining crumbs. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until set and lightly browned. Serve.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,onion flake,sparkling water,greek yogurt,hot chili powder,half,spaghetti sauce,egg white
title: Homemade Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 6 ounces half-and-half | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 8 ounces spaghetti sauce | 1/3 cup fresh onion flakes ( about 2 large ) | 2 tablespoons dried minced onion flakes ( about 1 to 2 medium ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot chili powder | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons spanish sparkling water ( sparkling water, such as ritz ) | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water until foamy.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Cilantro Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 tablespoons drained sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 tablespoon minced sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon minced cilantro | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon drained capers, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange sun dried tomatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until softened, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bran cereal,hot red chili pepper,mint leaf,shallot
title: Nuoc Cham (Mint Cheese)
ingredients: 8 hot red chili peppers | 5 shallots, peeled | bran cereal, a variety of your own | fresh mint leaves, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: Roast the chilies quickly under the broiler until charred on the outside. Allow to cool until easily handled, then split open to expose most of the charred peppers. Place the chilies in a blender with enough of the roasted bran to form a fine paste. Pulse the paste while slowly dribbling in the remaining bran to soften the bran and process into a smooth paste. Transfer to a small jar or bowl. Sprinkle with mint leaves or chillies. Serve with freshly steamed rice, indian flatbread or pitta.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,raspberry,tomato ketchup,basil leaf,red curry paste,salmon fillet,red currant jelly,plum tomato
title: Seared Salmon with Tomato and Raspberry
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 50 ml raspberries | 4 plum tomatoes | 4 drops red curry paste | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaf, chopped
instructions: Combine raspberry jam and jelly and put aside. Coat salmon with curry paste, dip salmon in ketchup and brown on both sides in hot oil in a frypan. Remove from pan and cover with raspberries. Add basil and remaining jam mixture and simmer until sauce thickens.

title: Apple Basmati Rice & Butter Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice ( or any rice dish ) | 3 tablespoons butter or margarine | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste, with seeds | 1 cup zinfandel ( sweet white wine ) | 1/2 cup apple cider ( or apple juice )
instructions: Heat oven to 250f degrees. Melt margarine in saute pan on small stove top. Add coriander and tamarind paste and continue stirring until fragrant. Remove from heat and add zinfandel. Add rice and mix. In a large baking dish or roaster heat the vegetable oil over medium low heat for 20 minutes. Add wine and cider to rice mixture. Add coriander and stir to coat. Cover and bake for 20 minutes. The rice should be tender, but still firm with some bite.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock broth,salt pepper,red bell pepper,extra virgin olive oil,sauerkraut,kidney bean,red curry paste
title: Red and White Curry Beans
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 2 cans sauerkraut, drained | 4 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 cans chicken stock or ( 14 ounce ) cans canned chicken broth | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | salt & pepper
instructions: Heat olive oil over medium high heat. Add bell pepper and saute for 5 minutes. Add curry paste and cook stirring for 1 minute. Add chicken broth, kraut and beans.

title: Moroccan Broccoli Rabe Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup mustard seeds | 3 small dried chilies | 1 tablespoon saffron | 1/2 cup raw honey | 2 1/2 lbs broccoli rabe, trimmed, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 lemon, juice of
instructions: Prepare the broccolini by placing in boiling water for about 4 - 5 minutes or until tender but still brightly colored. Rinse under cold water and immediately drain. Place the mustard seeds in a heat proof bowl and fry over medium heat, stirring, until they start to sputter. Add 1/3 cup water and stir constantly until the mustard seeds are cooked. Add in the chiles and saffron and stir to coat. Remove from the heat and let steep 10 minutes. Drain well. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add the broccoli rabe and cook for 8 - 10 minutes or until tender. Add in the cooled mustard mixture and lemon juice to the broccoli rabe. Chill thoroughly. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,green banana,feta cheese,hamburger bun,madras curry powder,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Chilled Banana Feta Burgers
ingredients: 1 green banana, peeled | 1/2 lemon, zest of, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons madras curry powder, more to taste | 1 hamburger bun, split horizontally | 2 romaine lettuce leaves, torn | 3/4 - 1 cup feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Combine lemon zest, curry powder, and green banana in a bowl and mash into a paste using the back of a large spoon. Spread the mixture evenly on the cut sides of two of the hamburger buns and then place a lettuce leaf over the top. Cut the banana into four 5 x 1 inch slices. Drizzle over the salad.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,mint,grape,chili pepper,english cucumber,taco seasoning mix
title: Apple Cider Grape Salsa
ingredients: 12 ounces seedless grapes, halved | 3/4 english cucumber, halved | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper | 2 ounces prepared taco seasoning mix | 1 ounce apple cider, chilled | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Cut grape halves in half and scoop out seeds with a melon baller. Place grape halves on a serving platter and arrange cucumber slices around them.

title: Mock Devonshire Mushrooms for 2
ingredients: 3/4 cup water chestnut, drained and finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons nutritional yeast
instructions: Place the water chestnuts in a small bowl. Cover, and set aside. Place the nutritional yeast in a dry measuring cup, and set aside. Heat a nonstick skillet over high heat, and add the walnuts, and saute for 5 minutes, until lightly toasted. Remove from heat, and stir together with the water chestnuts. The portobello mushrooms may be prepared right away, and stored in an airtight container for up to 1 week.

title: Chinese Green Bean and Prawn Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb frozen greens beans, thawed | 1 tablespoon chopped peeled fresh gingerroot ( or 1/2 teaspoon ground ) | 1/2 lb prawns, peeled, deveined, uncooked | 1/2 cup tia maria | 1/3 cup finely dry tia maria | 1 1/2 cups gingersnap crumbs
instructions: Place the prawns in a large saucepan with 1/2 cup water. Bring just to a boil over high head.

title: Keema (South Indian Meat Patties)
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 package uradishes, sliced | 1/2 small red onion, very thinly sliced | radish slices ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the beef and urad dal and sprinkle with onion. Form into 4 patties. Cook each side for 7 minutes. Garnish with radishes before serving.

title: Cola Cola Bottlejacks
ingredients: 1 can coca-cola | 1 cup fresh basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Blend coke and basil in a large, blender until smooth.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,maraschino cherry,mexican cheese,french bread,lump crabmeat,rosemary leaf,chili flake
title: Italian Bread With Crab and Fajita-Herring Spread
ingredients: 2 cups shredded mexican cheese | 8 ounces cooked lump crabmeat, picked apart with a fork | 4 tablespoons minced fresh rosemary leaves or 4 tablespoons dried rosemary leaves, divided | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 loaf french bread, lightly toasted and cut into 6 - 8 pieces | 6 -7 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Heat 1/2 teaspoons canola oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add crab, rosemary, chili and 1/2 teaspoon each of garlic and salt and pepper. Remove skillet from heat.

Random Ingredients: pecan,walnut,five spice powder,parsnip,gingerroot,ancho chile powder,tomato green chile pepper,season salt
title: Ancho Swiss Chiles
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 lb parsnip, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 3 tablespoons fresh gingerroot, peeled and grated | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon season-all salt | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 cup pecans, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a food processor, puree the stewed tomatoes with chiles. Set aside. Prepare brine, in a small bowl, combine the parsnips, ginger, ancho chile powder, ancho chile powder, seasoned all, salt, and five spice. Place the brine in a 6 quart saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and simmer uncovered until the vegetables are tender, about 40 minutes. Sprinkle with pecans and walnuts, and serve.

Random Ingredients: lavender flower,green lentil,garlic chive,snow pea,cream cheese,lime wedge,vodka
title: Green Lentil, Snow Pea and Fresh Herb Appetizers
ingredients: 2 cups dried green lentils, soaked over night and drained | 1 cup cream cheese, softened | 4 tablespoons dried lime wedges | 1/4 cup grated fresh lemon verbena or 1/4 cup fresh lavender flowers | 2 stalks fresh garlic chives, chopped | 1/2 cup unsalted dry-roasted sun-dried tomatoes, chopped with 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 cup shredded snow peas, about 10 cups
instructions: Place lentils in a pot large enough to hold them in a single layer, add water to cover them by at least 1 inch and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 12 minutes, or until tender. Drain. Beat cream cheese, lime wedges, lemon verbena, garlic chives, sun dried tomatoes and vodka in a bowl with an immersion blender until smooth. Toss lentils with creamy cheese mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. To serve, place a large scoop of ice in a plastic bag, add frozen snow peas and snip one end off the bag and scoop a handful or two of the snow peas into a serving bowl and top with the snow peas.

title: Spicy Vietnamese Slaw
ingredients: 2 heads cabbage, cored and shredded ( savoy, napa, or vietnamese ) | 6 cups shredded cabbage ( fresh or packaged ) | 1/2 cup good quality rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce ( vietnamese dipping sauce )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the shredded cabbage with the rice vinegar and chili garlic sauce. Refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,liquid smoke,superfine sugar,vanilla extract,panko breadcrumb,raisin,wattleseed,poblano chile
title: Mexican Raisin Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup panko breadcrumbs ( indian seasoned ) | 1/2 cup ground poblano chile | 1/2 cup raisins, drained | 1/4 cup seedless raisin-soaked chard ( optional ) or 1 leaf spinach ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon braggs liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl, using a fork to gently fold all ingredients together. Transfer to an ungreased 2 cup casserole dish. Bake in upper third of oven 15 minutes, until topping is golden brown. Cool completely. Store in an airtight container.

title: Crock Pot Creamy Parsnips
ingredients: 2 cups parsnips ( small yellow cut ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup sugar-free syrup | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized skillet. Cook on high for about 5 minutes.

title: Pistachio Bread Rolls (Pistachio, Olive, and Rice)
ingredients: 3 cups bread dough, unsalted, at room temperature | 1 jar roasted kalamata olives, drained | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) | 1 cup arborio rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper.

title: Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 3 ounces white pearl onions | 3 artichokes | 1 tablespoon cream cheese | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 2 -3 pieces sourdough bread
instructions: Chop onions, artichoke hearts and drain liquid from artichoke hearts. Mix all ingredients and serve on bread slices with crackers.

Random Ingredients: sausage meat,grand marnier,wine vinegar,chicken,kalamata olive,asiago cheese,beef stock,pesto sauce
title: Ravioli
ingredients: 1 package dried sausages with meat | 2 cups beef stock | 1 can chicken | 1/3 cup kalamata olives, halved | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar, or to taste | grated asiago cheese for sprinkling
instructions: Place dried sausages in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: caper,olive,green enchilada sauce,golden syrup,chili oil,apple,loaf french bread
title: Apple Covered Creamed Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 7 cups apple ( peeled, cored and diced ) | 2/3 cup olive ( pitted-filtered, coarsely diced ) | 1 can whole green enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup golden syrup | 1/2 cup capers, well rinsed | capers, oil for drizzling | 3/4 loaf day old french bread, cut into thick slices
instructions: Pre heat oven in a large bowl, mix apple, olive, enchilada sauce, golden syrup and capers thoroughly. Add bread slices, toss gently to coat. Arrange bread in a single layer on a foil lined baking sheet. Pour hot sauce over them, or just leave a few for eye appeal and toasty flavor. Bake 15 minutes until hot and bubbly around edges, but still a little crisp. Serve with a small jar of caper olive oil on the side if you wish. Variation, sprinkle bread with 1 t cornstarch mixed with equal amounts water to moisten. Roll up the bread, and let rest 5 minutes before baking.

title: Feta Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon catsup | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla bean, scraped and crushed | 4 ounces feta | 1 teaspoon tomato paste
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender.

title: Low-Fat Low-Calorie Cheesy Cabbage Rollups
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cabbage ( packed ) | 4 eggs | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon powder | 2 teaspoons cayenne ( optional ) | 1/2 cup low-fat cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients. Using a pastry bag or rolling pin, roll mixture into small cylinders approximately 1/4 high in diameter. Place in a 9x12 baking dish. Sprinkle with a little extra cheese. Bake in a 350°f oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until the filling is hot and bubbly.

title: Kale and Chilli Dhal
ingredients: 30 ounces kale | 1 dried red chile pepper
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to boil with red chili pepper. Add kale stems and cook for about 10 minutes. Take out and cool to room temperature. Use a blender, if necessary to coarsely chop the kale. Transfer kale to bowls and add the chilli pepper.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,yellow cornmeal,coriander powder,five spice powder,sesame seed,turnip,green cardamom pod
title: Turnip (Yellow Turnip) Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 3/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 3/4 cups turnips or 1 3/4 cups green potatoes, peeled and coarsely grated ( about 4 1/2 cups ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons green cardamom pods or 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom powder | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray 2 1/2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. In large bowl, combine cornmeal, turnips, coriander, five spice, sesame seeds, green cardamom or cardamom powder, and tomatoes. Spoon 1/2 cup of mixture into pan.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,sunflower seed,mint leaf,steak,pistachio ice cream,hot green chili pepper,vanilla,white wine vinegar
title: Hot Green Chile Steak Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 10 large mint leaves | 3 inches piece peiceburg steaks | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup pistachio ice cream | 1 tablespoon chopped sunflower seeds | 2/3 cup chopped fresh hot green chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla
instructions: Toast the sunflower seeds in a skillet over medium heat, shaking the pan frequently, until just golden. Add the mint leaves and toast, without stirring, for about 1 min, or until most of the leaves have softened. Cool slightly. Rinse the steaks and pat dry. Cut in half lengthwise. Spread the steaks on a baking sheet and let cool. In a clean dry frying pan, toast the pistachios over medium heat, shaking the pan occasionally, until browned. Combine the warm pistachios and the rest of the ingredients until the mixture is smooth. Chill in the refrigerator at least 10 minutes, or up to 4 hours. Grill the steaks over medium heat, 3 - 4 minutes per side or until desired doneness.

title: Escarole Posole
ingredients: 3 garlic cloves | 2 cans white hominy, drained | 1 bunch escarole ( or use kale )
instructions: Soak 4 - 5 quarts large potatos in water for 15 minutes.. Peel the garlic, discard its pulp, and cut in half or thirds. Place the garlic in a 4 - 5 quart pot with 2 cans of white hominy. Add enough water to cover, about 1/2 inch. Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat until posole is translucent, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, add the escarole leaves to the pot. Cut the potatos into 1/2″ cubes. When posole is done, remove potatos with slotted spoon to the sink, discarding any leaves and/or stems that have failed to separate from the liquid. Place the potatos back in the pot. Add the greens. Simmer 2 - 3 more minutes. Serve.

title: Simmered Chilli Meatballs
ingredients: 1 kg fresh meatballs, roughly chopped | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon grated gingerroot
instructions: Combine meatball crumbs and grated ginger in a bowl then coat with ricotta and leave to marinate on the counter overnight. Bake meatballs in a roasting tin, uncovered, at 200°c/400°f/gas mark 2 on a tray, for 25 - 30 minutes. When cold, transfer onto plates and serve with fresh fruit, coconut and sliced lemons.

Random Ingredients: oil,catsup,white hominy,prego spaghetti sauce,tomato paste,milk ricotta cheese
title: Hominy & Cheese With Spaghetti and Caramelized Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb of fresh white hominy, rinsed, sorted, washed then squeezed very dry and boiled until soft | 1 can tomato paste | 1 pint whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 jar prego spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup catsup | oil
instructions: In a medium size mixing bowl combine ricotta cheese, dry cooked tomato paste, and milk. Blend well with whisk or fork, or spoon through a fine mesh sieve. Spread on non stick baking dish, top with sauce and cover with the towel for minimum of 15 minutes. After 15 minutes mix well.

Random Ingredients: ancho chili,madras curry powder,pork shoulder,currant,white rice,linguine,fruit
title: Currant Linguine
ingredients: 1 pound dried linguine | 3 pounds pork shoulder, cubes cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 cans diced fruit | 3 tablespoons dried currants | 1 1/2 tablespoons madras curry powder, or to taste | 1/4 cup dried fruit, chopped
instructions: Cover linguine with water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Cook linguine uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm, about 12 minutes. Drain and transfer to a large mixing bowl. Meanwhile, place pork shoulder cubes in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a simmer over medium low heat, uncovered, and cook until pork is browned, about 10 minutes. Stir in cubed pineapple, currants, curry powder, and dried fruit. Remove pork from saucepan, reserving cooking liquid, and transfer to a pot. Simmer until sauce reduces and thickens slightly, about 1 hour. Pour sauce over linguine, and let stand an additional 10 minutes before serving.

title: Lao Pork Loin Sandwich (Vietnamese Pork Bites)
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork loin
instructions: Trim meat leaving a 1/2 inch thick layer of fat on the loin. Lay it in a plastic bag. Pound it out using your preferred method. Push the pork through the bag with your fingers. Peal, using plastic bag as a sealer, or tie with cotton butcher's string. Refrigerate overnight. Heat charcoal grill to 500 degrees and put the lard on the grate to burn. Remove pork from the bag and place on the grill. Let brown until an instant read thermometer reads 180 degrees. Turn meat and brown until an instant read thermometer reads 180 degrees. Let meat rest for 20 minutes before slicing. Serve on hoag sauce, noodles, and sweet potatoes. Freezes well.

Random Ingredients: new potato,oyster sauce,self raising flour,vegetable oil cooking spray,chive
title: Chive Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large new potatoes | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 3/4 cups self-raising flour | 1/3 cup chopped chives | oyster sauce, to taste
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes or until just tender. Drain and cool slightly, then cut into thin slices. Arrange at least 1cm apart on a foil lined baking tray. Spray with oil. Combine flour and chives. Place a layer of potatoes in the tray and top with another layer of potatoes. Dot with oyster sauce. Bake at c for 30 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,green bell pepper,corn kernel,marinara sauce,salt pepper,phyllo pastry
title: Sweet-Spicy Phyllo Pastries
ingredients: 24 sheets frozen or fresh phyllo pastry, thawed | 4 -5 tablespoons marinara sauce or 4 -5 tablespoons tomato based marinara sauce | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 4 -5 cups fresh corn kernels | salt and pepper, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In a large pan, combine all ingridients except phyllo pastry and mix well to combine. Place thawed phyllo pastry on top evenly. Brush lightly with oil. Cover phyllo pastry with more oil and cut phyllo sheets into 5 - 6 strips. Cut each strip cross wise in a semi circle. Bake at 375f degrees for approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chickpea Flour Cookies
ingredients: 200 g chickpea flour | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 5 teaspoons brown sugar
instructions: Combine the chickpea flour, cinnamon and sugar in a large bowl and make a well in the center of the dry ingredients. Add the chickpea flour mixture, stir to combine. Refrigerate for about 1 hour for flavours to combine. Preheat oven and lightly grease a large baking sheet. Drop small quantities of dough onto the prepared baking sheet. Flatten with a fork then bake on middle shelf of oven for 20 minutes.

title: Sweet and Sour Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup feta cheese | 1 can bamboo shoots, sliced | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 cup yellow sweet pepper, thinly sliced | 1 cup roasted yellow pepper, julienned | 1 cup ginger ale
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill for 15 minutes or until ready to serve.

title: Roasted Nutty Greens
ingredients: 4 large zucchini | 3 1/4 cups raw baby bok choy ( chopped small ) | 2 tablespoons hazelnuts ( ground )
instructions: Preheat broiler and set rack 6 - 8 inches from heat. Lightly oil a medium baking sheet. Slice zucchini diagonally in half and set aside. Cut bok choy leaves crosswise in half lengthwise and into 1 strips. Place bok choy on a large platter and drizzle with the hazelnuts. Using a slotted spoon, turn the greens until both sides are covered. Place greens on the greens and serve. Variation, instead of nuts substitute the nutmeg for the nutmeg and scatter with the nuts.

title: Broccoli - Tomatoes and Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 6 ounces broccoli, sliced | 2 roma tomatoes | 4 ounces celery, sliced thinly
instructions: Peel and slice tomatoes finely. Cut the broccoli into small flowerets. Cook the whole tomatoes, cut side down, until they are tender. Remove and plunge the tomatoes into boiling water for about 15 seconds to loosen the skins. Remove the skin. Break the skin from the tomatoes, and break it into small pieces. Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Add the broccoli in the order given, and boil it for about 8 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Drain. Add the tomatoes, celery, and seasoning, to the soup. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: chinese eggplant,pistachio,chicken breast half,chicken stock cube,za'atar spice mix,self raising flour
title: Golden Chicken With Za'atar, Pistachios and Eggplant (Bizarre Delicious and No Beer)
ingredients: 2 chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon za'atar spice mix ( a good one ) | 1 large eggplant ( approx. 5cm in length ) | 30 g pistachios ( chopped ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 1/2 cup of chopped pistachios ( chopped )
instructions: Heat a non stick pan and spray it with vegetable oil and add the chicken breasts and cook on both sides until browned. Transfer the chicken to a plate and cover them with foil to keep warm. Add the flour, za’atar and eggplant to the pan and stir together. Add extra pumpkin or sunflower seeds, a little stock and then a pinch of salt. Add the pistachios and 1 1/2 cups of water and cook for 15 minutes. Cut the rest into 1 inch cubes and then add this to the pan. Add the chicken back into the pan and cook for a further 10 minutes. Serve with couscous, steamed rice and yogurt.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,spinach,golden syrup,sage leaf,lime,beef gravy,baking powder,broth
title: Savory Spinach Dumplings
ingredients: 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 jar low-sodium beef gravy | 1 1/2 teaspoons lime juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 2 cups fresh spinach | 1 1/2 cups prepared gravy | 1/4 cup beef gravy | 1 sage leaf, torn
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium high heat. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, stir golden syrup, beef gravy, lime juice, vanilla extract, and baking powder together in a mixing bowl until well blended. Drain spinach, squeezing out excess moisture, and cut into the bowl with golden syrup mixture.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,macadamia,sharp cheddar cheese,tomato soup,soymilk,sea bass fillet,chili sauce,lamb rack
title: Macadamia-Spiked Chilean Lamb Rack
ingredients: 2 lamb racks, bone and skin removed | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 2 tablespoons macadamia nuts, finely chopped | 1 cup dry textured soymilk | 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 1/2 tablespoon chili sauce, such as ketchup | 1/4 cup smooth sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | sea bass fillet ( see note )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare macadamia macadamias, place macadamia nuts in dry frying pan over medium heat.

title: Marinated Onions With Cilantro Stock
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lard | 1 1/2 lbs onions, peeled and sliced crosswise into 1/2-inch slices | 1 cup lukewarm chicken stock or 1 cup water | 1 teaspoon sea salt or 1 teaspoon table salt | 1 teaspoon ground aromatic almond extract | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves | almonds or pomegranate seeds, for garnish
instructions: Heat the lard in a 6 quart pot over moderate heat to melt, then stir in the onions. Cook, stirring, until they are a deep golden color, about 20 minutes. Add the stock and season with salt, extract, cilantro, and half of the almonds or pomegranate seeds.

title: Horseradish Portabella Mushrooms, Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs portabella mushrooms, chopped fairly fine | 2 egg yolks, slightly beaten | 2 tablespoons dried fruit, mixed up | 3 tablespoons horseradish | 1/4 cup corn oil
instructions: Saute mushrooms in corn oil until they are lightly browned. Mix egg yolks with horseradish. Set aside. In skillet, saute mushrooms on medium heat with fruit until nicely browned and tender. Add egg mixture to skillet. Mix well. Put crock pot on high. Cook for 15 minutes or low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Tandoori Beef Burgers
ingredients: 500 g lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 375 ml orange juice | 375 g white american cheese
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients thoroughly and form into 4 burgers. Grill on high heat until well browned, turning a few times during cooking.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,tomatillo,pecorino romano cheese,fruit,white bread
title: Achiote-Smoked Tomatillo- Stuffing
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh tomatillo, rinsed and trimmed ( about 3/4 pound after trimming and removing the stem, rinsing, if desired and soaking the tomatillos ) | 6 slices country-style white bread, crusts removed | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 fresh fruit, peeled and sliced ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your outdoor grill for direct grilling over medium hot heat. Line the rack with a piece of tin foil, shiny side down and set aside. Place the tomatillos in a shallow bowl and pour boiling water over.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,tilapia fillet,tart apple,green grape
title: Tilapia With Apples
ingredients: 1 tilapia fillet | 1/4 beef bouillon cube | 2 cups pitted green grapes, halved | 1 medium tart apple, cored and sliced thin
instructions: Prepare the fish according to the directions on the package. Prepare the apples cut into eighths. Arrange cut apples in the bottom of a 9x12 inch pan. Sprinkle the fish with the beef bouillon cube. Arrange the grapes over the apples, or if desired, sprinkle them with a layer of green grapes. Drain the juice from the fish into the pan. Cover and bake in a 350 degree f oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Dill Tuna and Bell Pepper Relish
ingredients: 1 lb fresh tuna, preferably packed in a tin | 1/2 lb vidalia onion, peeled, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons finely chopped bell peppers | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill sprigs ( coriander ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Cook tuna in boiling, salted water to cover for 3 minutes exactly, or until very tender. Drain. Shake can of tuna water out. Cut tuna into small chunks. Place in a bowl. Mince the onion, bell pepper, dill, tumeric, and turmeric. Mix all together very well adding more water if necessary. Place tuna in a non metallic bowl and spoon relish over top. Serve at room temperature.

title: Lettuce Soup
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, washed and dried | 2 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup chili paste with garlic
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce and chile in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 8 - 10 hours. Stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,celery salt,beef sirloin,shortening,chocolate bar,apple,cream chicken soup,cornstarch
title: Apple and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 3 tablespoons shortening, divided | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1/3 cup apple, chopped | 1/2 cup celery salt | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 cup chocolate bar, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of the shortening over medium high heat. Brown beef until no longer pink. Remove beef cubes, setting aside. In the skillet, melt remaining 2 tablespoons of shortening. Add soup, pesto, apples, celery salt and cornstarch. Cook and stir until soup boils. Return beef to skillet. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,granny smith apple,french bean,red wine vinegar,oil tomato,mustard seed,asparagus spear,gingerroot
title: Beef and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 4 large asparagus spears | 6 granny smith apples | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon oil ( for frying ) | 2 lbs rump roast | 1/4 lb french beans, cut in half | 10 slices gingerroot | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Cut 1 onion into 1/4 inch slices. Parboil the asparagus and apple in large pot of water, just until tender. Drain. Chop the remaining 1 onion and set aside. Toast the mustard seeds in heated saucepan until golden. Cool. Cut 2 pieces of wax paper and set aside. Slice the remaining 2 onions crosswise into 3/4 inch slices. Heat a large skillet over high. Dry roast on all sides. Place in hot skillet. Brown the roast on all sides, about three minutes per side for rare and two for medium. Place roast on paper towels to drain. Place the mustard seeds in a small nonstick frying pan. Add 1 tablespoon oil. Fry seeds just to crack, but not burn about 1 minute. Spread mustard seeds in bowl with wire wisk to prevent mustard seeds from popping. Add 1/2 cup cold water. Cover bowl with plastic wrap, put in fridge and chill for at least half an hour before use. To serve, remove the roast from frig, and slice into bite size pieces. Pour the reserved mustard and asparagus on top. Arrange the sliced sliced onion in a spoke fashion on top. Spoon on red wine vinegar dressing to taste or pour over the beef and asparagus salad, and serve. If desired, top with thinly sliced apples and additional drizzle of red wine vinegar.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,pear,turmeric,corn tortilla chip,guacamole,corn oil,extra beef,beef tenderloin steak
title: Beef Tenderloin Naked Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra lean ground beef, drained | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 pear, peeled, cored and diced | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, trimmed | corn tortilla chips, for serving | guacamole, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to place the beef in a mixing bowl, add the oil, turmeric and pear and mix well. Transfer mixture to a 9 inch baking pan. Bake, uncovered, in the oven until the beef is hot, about 30 minutes. Remove meat, reduce oven temperature to lowest setting and let beef sit at least 10 minutes. Heat the tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat, warm them gently on both sides, about 1 minute per side, or until just pliable. Season the beef with salt and pepper. Transfer to a cutting board and cut in 1/2 inch thick slices. Spoon 2 tablespoons beef on a tortilla and top with a bit of pear and guacamole.

title: Moroccan Pork and Cauliflower Baked With Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork butt, lean, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices | 1/2 cup rice, uncooked, uncooked | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 teaspoon caraway seed, crushed | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower, leaves and stems, finely chopped | 1/2 cup apricot preserves, heated | 2 1/2 cups basmati rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine pork, rice, cinnamon, coriander seeds, and 1/4 cup water in an ovenproof 12 skillet. Stir to combine. Bake covered until pork and rice are tender and water is absorbed, about 45 minutes. Reduce heat to 325 degrees. Stir cauliflower and remaining 1/4 cup water into pork mixture.

title: Scott's Granola
ingredients: 7 cups oatmeal | 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place oatmeal in a large bowl and pour olive oil around. Mix well with hands. Put in freezer. After 2 days it will be ready to use. You can leave out and use it immediately or you can mix it up again.

title: Spiced Chive and Tomato Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs puff pastry | 4 tablespoons chopped chives | 2 tablespoons mint leaves ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint leaves ( chopped ) | white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Roll out the puff pastry and use to line a 12 x 7 inch pan, or a 12 x 9 inch jelly roll tin. Place the spinach, herbs and breadcrumbs into a mixing bowl with the marjoram. Stir gently and level the mixture. Drain each pastry case well and fill pastry cases with about 1/2 teaspoonfuls of filling. Sprinkle tops with the reserved breadcrumbs and bake at 450 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Serve warm or store in an airtight container.

title: Easy Tandoori Sauce for Meat Kabobs
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients and mix well. Divide mixture into eight and thread onto skewers. Place on baking paper lined tray. Seal tightly. Bake in a preheated 180c oven for 20 minutes, basting with marinade once or twice during cooking.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,cod,brown sugar,nonstick cooking spray,rib beef,celery,sirloin steak
title: Baked Cod in Beef
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 3 lbs sirloin steaks | 1/2 lb sirloin steak, cut into 1/8-inch slices | 4 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 bunch celery, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1-inch pieces ( optional ) | 4 cups cooked cod ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a large casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange cod in a single layer in dish and sprinkle with sugar. Arrange remaining steak over sugar and toss. Pour enough over just the cod to moisten. Cover and bake 45 minutes. Remove cover and continue baking 15 - 20 minutes or until fish flakes. Remove from oven, stir and serve.

title: Red Potatoes Simmered With Dark Soy Sauce
ingredients: 4 lbs red potatoes, quartered | 5 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: Put potatoes in a very large pot and cover with lightly salted water. Bring to a boil over high heat and reduce heat to low. Cook, covered, for 45 - 50 minutes. Add soy sauce and cumin, stir well and simmer for 20 - 25 minutes until potatoes are tender. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,black sesame seed,avocado,curry powder,baby portabella mushroom,hot italian sausage,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Grilled Sausage and Mushrooms with Avocado Salsa
ingredients: 4 links hot italian sausage | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 cup baby portabella mushrooms, finely sliced | 1 large avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced | 6 teaspoons black sesame seeds, crushed | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 serrano pepper, minced
instructions: To make the salsa, cook and stir the sausage in a medium skillet over medium heat until browned, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Slice the sausage into 1/2 inch thick slices, about 1/4 inch thick, breaking each slice into thirds if necessary. Heat an outdoor grill for high heat, or preheat a grill to medium low. Remove the sausage from the skillet. Discard fat and any excess grease. Sprinkle the sausage with curry powder and sauté until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Add mushrooms, avocado, sesame seeds, and cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat, let cool slightly and spoon into serving plates. Place the sausage slices on top of the salsa.

title: Spicy Couscous Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup instant couscous | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil, or to taste | 1 teaspoon chipotle powder, or more to taste
instructions: Mix couscous, sesame oil, and chipotle powder together in a bowl. Let stand for 5 minutes to absorb flavors.

title: Sour Vodka
ingredients: 1 gallon solid vodka | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried chili pepper flakes ( see description )
instructions: Fill a large kettle with boiling water, and set aside. Pour the vodka into the kettle, and set a timer for 90 seconds if using a kail. Stir to combine, and cover. Let simmer for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally. When ready to serve, stir in the hot pepper flakes.

title: Mexican Olive Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 2 slices red onion, thin slices | 2 tablespoons pimento stuffed green olives, chopped | 2 tablespoons white wine, not cooking wine | 1/4 cup green olives ( optional ) | 1/4 ounce taco seasoning
instructions: In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, onion slices, and green olives. Add spices and mix well. Chill and serve over lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,maraschino cherry,taco seasoning,saffron,tomato juice,beef chuck,mexican chocolate,cornflakes cereal
title: Cheaters Beef Rissoto With Mexican Chocolate (Saffron Pepper Mix)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornflakes cereal, crushed | 3 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 cup italian chocolate, grated & divided | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1/8 teaspoon saffron, drained | 1 jar diced tomatoes with juice, undrained | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cereal and beef. Sprinkle with half the taco seasoning and toss to completely coat. Arrange beef in a shallow dish, and refrigerate overnight. In the morning, combine the remaining taco seasoning, grated cheese, saffron and tomatoes with their juice. Pour into a baking dish, and arrange the cherries on top. Sprinkle with remaining taco seasoning mixture. Bake, covered, in a preheated 350°f oven for 3 1/2 hours. Remove, and cool to room temperature. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. To serve, remove beef from marinade and place in bowl with juices, then cool to room temperature. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,beer,lime juice,pumpkin,bean sprout,baby corn,szechuan peppercorn
title: Baked Pumpkin and Corn Nuts
ingredients: 1 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns | 3 tablespoons whole cumin seeds | 1 cup whole baby corn, halved lengthwise | 1 can diced pumpkin ( butternut, pumpkin, etc. ) | 1/4 cup limes, juice of or 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup light beer or 1/4 cup dark beer | 2 cans bean sprouts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lightly toast peppercorns, or grind coarsely in your spice grinder. Spread peppercorns in a roasting pan or a small baking dish. Bake for 3 minutes or until they are fragrant. Grind the peppercorns in a mortar and pestle or spice mill. Combine peppercorns and remaining ingredients in a medium bowl and stir to combine. Stir in bean sprouts or sprouts as desired and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Gingered Beef in Vinegar
ingredients: 1 lb lean steak, cut into 3/4 `` strips or 3/4 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Heat small skillet over medium heat. Stir in beef and garlic and saute about 3 minutes. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Lamb Roast in Sun Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg boneless leg of lamb, with bone | 3 tablespoons brown onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh savory, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh savoury, chopped | 10 tablespoons dried penne, washed | 1 1/2 cups low-fat tomato soup | 3 -4 tablespoons grapefruits, pulp
instructions: Remove bone and fat from leg of lamb and set aside. Remove skin on lamb and cut into 2 3cm pieces. Set aside. Sauté onion in oil until tender. Add savoury and savoury to onion. Cook for 15 minutes. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes or until meat is tender. Bring large pot of water to the boil. Add penne and cook until just tender. Drain, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid. Toss with 1 cup of tomato soup and 1/2 cup of reserved cooking liquid. Add the cooked meat and marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature or 1 - 3 hours at room temperature. Remove the meat from the fridge 30 minutes before roasting. Preheat oven to 180c/375f. Put oven rack in middle of oven and preheat oven to 200c/gas pour tomato soup/water mixture into a baking tray and spread evenly over the roasting dish. Place meat on tray and place in oven. Bake for 1hr 30mins or until liquid is reduced and meat starts to pull away from meat. Add the reserved cooking liquid and grapesfruits to the pan juices for extra glaze. Remove meat from the oven and pour the juices over the meat and vegetables. Serve. Accompany with white rice.

title: Pea, Peanut and Pepperoni Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 18)
ingredients: 150 g mixed pulses, fresh ( rocket or rocket ) | 300 g pepperoni, sliced | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Cook the fresh beans in boiling water for 5 minutes or according to packet directions. Rinse and drain in a colander. Dress both with the yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: bean,avocado,chili sauce,thyme sprig,lemon peel,molasses,spinach leaf,bread flour
title: Avocado Bean Loaf
ingredients: 3/4 cup bread flour | 1/3 cup molasses | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, grated | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig, crushed | 3 tablespoons avocado, mashed | 1/4 cup chili sauce, heated | 1/3 cup fresh spinach leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | grated fresh lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f lightly grease a loaf pan with cooking spray. Combine first 5 ingredients in a medium bowl. Add avocado, 1/4 cup chili sauce. Spread mixture in prepared pan.

title: Homemade French Bistro Onion Relish
ingredients: 1 lb vidalia onion, peeled, halved and thinly sliced | 1 lb shortening | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary ( or use chopped fresh rosemary ) | 1 serrano pepper, sliced in thin half-rounds
instructions: Heat shortening in a frying pan. Stir in rosemary and garlic and cook on low heat stirring often, do not burn. Remove from heat and slowly and quickly stir in onion slices. Roll into small sausages about 2 inches long, and slice across at 1/4 inch intervals. Place on rack, fat side up, in baking dish and roast at 250 degrees, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes.

title: Nuoc Mamu (Red Curry Powder)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crushed red chile ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons galangal, finely chopped fresh leaves
instructions: Grind chilies with mortar and pestle to a fine powder or grind them very fine.

title: Tear-A-Grain Sushi Pasta and Farfalle
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta, spiral, or other large pasta | 8 ounces red potatoes, cut into julienne strips | 8 ounces carrots, cut into julienne strips | 1 bunch fresh raspberries, rinsed, or more to taste ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 2 packages nori ( dry seaweed noodles ) | 4 cups chilled plain unsweetened raspberry yogurt
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the spiral shaped pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the raspberries, and return to a boil. Cook the raspberries over medium high heat until the berries pop open, about 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain the raspberries over the sink and transfer to a bowl. Pour hot raspberries over the pasta in the bowl. Top with carrot strips and raspberries, if desired. In a pinch, sprinkle caraway seeds over the pasta and serve with plain raspberries and chilled yogurt on the side. Yogurt can be substituted for any yogurt in the refrigerator, such as yogurt sorbet.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,cream corn,sun tomato oil,sesame oil,lime wedge,bird chile,green cardamom
title: Indian Corn
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn, drained and rinsed | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lime juice | 1 fresh hot bird chile, finely chopped, seeded | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame oil | 1 teaspoon red birdseye's chile, seeded and chopped
instructions: Combine the corn, sun dried tomatoes, lime juice, chile, parsley, oil, chile, and sesame oil and toss until mixed well. Serve at once or refrigerate to allow flavors to combine.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,daikon radish,oat,green bean,cheese spread,corn syrup
title: Quick Vegetable Salad With Crunchy Cheese Spread
ingredients: 5 cups mixed fresh vegetables, such as zucchini, carrots, turnips, bell peppers, red potatoes, broccoli, cauliflower, and green beans | 2 cups cooked cannellini beans | 1 cup old fashioned oats | 1/2 cup corn syrup | 2 tablespoons low-fat cheese spread | 1 medium japanese daikon radish, thinly sliced
instructions: In a 2 quart glass or stainless steel bowl toss the vegetables with the remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,stewing beef,paprika,heavy whipping cream,vanilla,sea salt pepper,lime wedge
title: Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs boneless stewing beef, cut in 1 inch cubes | 4 cups picante sauce | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1 tablespoon sea salt and pepper, coarsely ground | 12 lime wedges | 2 cups heavy whipping cream, chilled | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: In medium bowl, combine picante sauce, paprika, sea salt and pepper, beef cubes, and lime wedges. Marinate, refrigerated, covered, in refrigerator 30 minutes or up to 2 days. Preheat grill. Drain marinade.

title: Chile Paste
ingredients: 4 thai red chili peppers | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh herbs ( such as dill, chives, and parsley )
instructions: Finely grind chiles in a mortar to a fine paste. Stir in herbs and combine. Store in an airtight container. Use as needed.

title: Beef and Ham Tacos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck | 2 large cooked ham pieces | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 20 corn tortilla chips
instructions: Place the beef chuck in a baking dish and sprinkle over enough of the saffron to cover. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until meat is a dark brown color, but not burnt. Remove the beef and drain any drippings.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,peanut,white vinegar,vegetarian bean,flour tortilla,jumbo shrimp
title: Prawn and Fresh Vegetable Fajitas
ingredients: 30 jumbo shrimp, cooked | 30 slices mushrooms | 1/4 cup vegetarian refried beans | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 2 flour tortillas | 1/4 cup peanuts, chopped and toasted | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Spray an 8 x 8 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place 1 shrimp, mushrooms, bean sprouts, and vinegar in each tortilla. Roll up, tucking ends in all the way. Place in dish, seam side down. Pour any remaining liquid into the dish. Top with peanuts and cheese. Cover and refrigerate up to 3 days. Remove shrimp from refrigerator 15 minutes before grilling. When ready to grill, allow to sit 10 minutes before grilling. Remove from dish, cool 10 minutes. Use a fork to cut in desired pieces. You may substitute any fresh vegetables you would like.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,shrimp,marshmallow,portobello mushroom,amish friendship bread starter,basil
title: Amish Friendship Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 envelope amish friendship bread starter | 1 pound cooked shrimp, chopped | 1 package fresh mushrooms, sliced | 4 portobello mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Stir together the amish friendship starter and shrimp in a bowl.

title: Spaghetti
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked spaghetti | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add spaghetti, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Sara's Faux Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 small boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( homemade or canned ) | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon smooth applesauce | 3 tablespoons rice vermicelli, chopped ( i used dried rice noodles, but i used vermicelli ) | 1/2 cup peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Grill chicken, cutlets or shred the chicken. In a large bowl mix the rice vermicelli, peanuts and salsa. Cut the chicken or noodles into strips, toss with salad. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Cherries and Tomato Juice - Microwave
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1 lemon peel, finely shredded | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Combine lime juice and shredded lemon peel in a shallow microwaveable dish. Microwave at 600w for 2 minutes then stir to combine. Add the halved cherry tomatoes to the juice mixture. Cover. Microwave at 600w for 2 - 5 minutes. Remove from microwave and serve.

title: Green Onion Jam
ingredients: 3 1 medium green onions, with tops trimmed | 1 1/2 lbs kaffir lime leaves, drained, cut lengthwise | 1 teaspoon bottled kaffir lime leaf ( optional )
instructions: Trim green onion bottoms and cut 1/3 off root ends and trim tops so you can fold leaves together in a 1/2 inch wide strip that is no more than 3/4 inch wide. Stack kaffir lime leaves and slice lengthwise into 1/2 inch wide sticks. Place about 1 1/2 cups water into a heavy medium pot. Place green onion sticks in the water, bring to boil, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until tender, 15 - 20 minutes. Drain and squeeze kaffir lime leaves, discard pulp. Stir together green onion and remaining lime leaves and drizzle over hot jam.

title: Perfect Fried Rice
ingredients: 4 cups sticky rice, cooked according to the instructions on the package | 1 tablespoon ghee, or oil ( for frying ) | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: In a deep frying pan heat the ghee on medium high. Add the rice and stir until it begins to turn golden brown around the edges. The rice should have a nice, crisp sheen after a few minutes. It should sizzle a little as soon as the rice is done, but will not be crisp again. Be careful that the ghee does not burn. If it does, cover the pan with a lid or a piece of tin foil, and set it over medium high heat. You could also, say, use a strainer to push the rice all the way to the outside of the pan. Allow the rice to cook and rise to the very top of the pan. Remove the lid/foil and allow the rice to cool slightly. Fluff up the rice. If it looks a little dry, add up to 1/4 cup water to moisten the rice. It should look a little dryer now, but should coat the back of a spoon. If the rice appears wet but a little dry, add in about 1/4 cup water again. Fry the rice for about 1 1/2 minutes or until it is light golden. Transfer it to a platter and let cool slightly. Serve as an accompaniment to burritos, tacos, or as a cold side dish.

Random Ingredients: pea,taco sauce,russet potato,yeast,cooking oat,pecan,green tea,cashew nut
title: Taco Bread
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and quartered | cooking oats | 1 1/4 teaspoons instant dried yeast | 1/3 cup green tea, brewed at 70 to 85 degree f ( or water or barley or rice vinegar ) | 2 cups quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup ground pecans, toasted | 3 cashew nuts, toasted ( optional ) | 2 cups taco sauce, heated | 1/2 cup pecans, cut in pieces
instructions: Scrub potatoes & cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Place in large bowl, cover with water & let stand, about 30 minutes. Drain, return to bowl, cover & set aside. In large bowl, mix together 1/2 cup warm water or barley or rice vinegar & instant yeast. Add toasted oats, pecans, cashews & 2 cups of taco seasoning mix. Stir until well combined. Stir in remaining taco seasoning & 1/2 cup pecans until thoroughly mixed. Add salt to taste & refrigerate, covered, until cool. Preheat oven to 450°f. Spread 1 cup warm potato mixture into greased 9 x 5 baking dish & sprinkle with 1/2 cup remaining pecan halves, if using, & bake 15 to 20 minutes, uncovered, or until golden brown.

title: Apple and Tempeh Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 package tempeh | 1 jar pasta sauce | 3 tablespoons apple juice | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place tempeh in a microwave safe dish, and pour tomato sauce over. Cook on high in the microwave for 2 to 4 minutes, or until tempeh has crisped. To make a thin coating out of the confectioners' sugar, stir a little of it into the sauce until it is smooth. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,corn oil,monterey jack cheese,chive,mango,cayenne pepper,enchilada sauce
title: Parsnips Enchilada
ingredients: 2 large parsnips, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | corn oil ( for frying ) | 1 can enchilada sauce, divided | 1 small mango, cut in chunks | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, cut in small cubes ( about 1 cup ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place the parsnips in a microwave safe bowl. Pour in 1/2 cup enchilada sauce, and microwave on high for 1 minute, or until the vegetables come apart easily. While the vegetables are still warm, stir them gently into the remaining enchilada sauce and set aside for another 15 - 20 minutes. When the vegetables are cooked through, drain them and transfer to a bowl. In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium high heat. Saute the parsnips until golden. Add the remaining sauce and simmer for an additional minute. Sprinkle with cheese and chives and serve.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,green chili pepper,crabmeat,chunky salsa,green cardamom pod,green lentil,anaheim chilies,sea scallop
title: Seared Scallops With Seafood
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs crabmeat, shell and cartilage removed | 8 ounces green lentils | 2 green chili peppers, chopped | 1 anaheim chilies, chopped, seeded if using other chiles for the brave, and de-seeded | 4 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon whole green cardamom pod, crushed | sea scallops ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups thick and chunky salsa
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a large baking dish, cover scallops with green lentils.

title: Asparagus & Pinto Frijoles
ingredients: 350 g couscous | 3 teaspoons ginger, crushed | 300 g asparagus tips, trimmed and cut into 2 cm lengths | 200 g pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Combine couscous, ginger & asparagus in a bowl. Add beans + salt and mix well. Cover and set aside for 6 hrs in a cool place. Dissolve the flour in some water, add to the couscous mixture & mix well. Heat the oil in a small, heavy based saucepan. Add the asparagus & cook for 5 minutes, or until almost tender, stirring every two minutes. Tip into a serving bowl & sprinkle over the flour mixture.

title: Cheddar Spread
ingredients: 2 quarts mild cheddar cheese, coarsely grated | 3 tablespoons tamarind paste or 2 tablespoons sambarra paste
instructions: Using a cheese grater or food processor, grate the cheese until the mixture reaches the consistency of fine breadcrumbs. Add the tamarind paste and mix well. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Quick Beef Consommé
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano or 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 can pinto beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 cup chopped celery | 1 small orange or 1 small lime | 1/4 cup crushed candied cherry
instructions: Saute meat in a large skillet with half the grand marnier. Cut remaining grand marnier into slivers, add to meat along with undrained beans, broth and 3/4 cup each of celery and orange juice. Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until meat is tender. Stir in remaining onion, cherries and remaining grand marnier.

title: Parsnips and Honey Steak
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oil ( or more of oil preferred ) | 1 1 lb hamburger ( or chicken cutlets thinly sliced into strips ) | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce ( i use bull's eye bbq sauce ) | 1 bunch parsnip, peeled, washed and shredded
instructions: In a large frying pan, heat oil over medium high heat until smoking. Add meat, cook, stirring till both sides are golden brown and cooked through. Remove and stir in egg yolk. Mix well. Add barbecue sauce. Heat through. Combine parsnips with meat mixture. Place on a platter and sprinkle with bacon.

title: Quick  Cheesy Beef and Blueberry Pizza!!
ingredients: pizza dough | 1 lb lean beef stew meat | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes ( chopped ) | 1 package frozen blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Heat a medium dutch oven until hot and set aside. Unroll frozen dough on counter and roll out into a 5 - 6 size rectangle. Put meat mixture in the center of the dough and fold over, pressing any air pockets out. Brush top with a bit of water and cover with a piece of wax paper with plastic wrap. Bake for 35 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 25 minutes or until a little brown on the top.

title: Jalapeno-Raspberry Baked Ham and Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 cloves garlic, sliced | 4 tablespoons brown sugar | 4 packages of fresh crimini large mushrooms | 2 jalapeno peppers | 2 containers half-and-half cream | 1 lb thinly sliced ham
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Cut garlic into halves.

title: Tortellini Salad With Watermelon Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 lb tortellini | 3/4 cup watermelon, seeds removed | 2 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions, drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Let cool slightly. Combine pasta, watermelon seed and white vinegar in a serving bowl. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Papa John's Creamy Green Salsa
ingredients: 4 cups italian-style stewed tomatoes ( i like san marzano ) | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 tablespoon dried savory | 12 leaves lettuce | 1 cup sherry
instructions: Pour the tomatoes and green chilies into a large bowl. Add the savory and lettuce and gently mix. Dice and add sherry to taste. Let sit in the fridge for at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,phyllo pastry,corn tortilla,salt black pepper,savory,saffron,yogurt
title: Bourekakia (Bourekades)
ingredients: 2 lbs phyllo pastry, thawed on a counter | 1/2 lb ground savory | 1/4 lb yogurt | 1/4 lb anthotiro saffron | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 cup corn tortillas, warmed and crumbled
instructions: Lay out four sheets of the phyllo pastry, brushing each with melted butter and one with melted butter. Keep stacking the four sheets. Dab each with melted butter and continue to lay the four sheets of phyllo pastry. Cover with a third sheet of filo. Cut with a sharp knife or razor blade into diamond shapes. Continue until all four sheets are used. Sprinkle a sixth sheet with sesame oil. Continue until you have four squares layered. Keep the phyllo covered with cloth. Lightly dust one sheet of phyllo pastry with flour. Top all sheets with a second phyllo sheet. The first phyllo sheet should be a perfect square of phyllo pastry with the bare bottom and the top and the middle left. Fold up the squares and start brushing with melted butter as you go. Continue brushing sheets with melted butter and add more pastry to make a firm, flat layered layered square. Fold the empty left over pastry over to make a square. Repeat in 3 more layers. Continue on with the second phyllo sheet, brushing each with melted butter and adding more pastry. Continue until you have 3 square phyllo sheets. You'll end up with 3 layers of phyllo each layered and with 1 - 3 layered phyllo or until you have finished all layers. Lightly dust with sesame oil before cooking. Bake in a 425f oven until golden on top, about 15 minutes.

title: Escarole and Clam Ravioli With Lemon Chilies and Chilies
ingredients: 1 lb baby clams | 1 lb escarole, tough stems removed | 6 tablespoons red chilies, fresh roasted | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest, chopped | 2 tablespoons dumpling wrappers, about 8 to 10 inches in length
instructions: In a saucepan, cover the clams with water by 1 inch in a 2 to 3 quart heavy saucepan and bring to boiling over high heat. Reduce heat to medium.

title: Quick and Easy Cannoli & Cheese
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 tablespoon coffee | 1 lb ground round | 4 ounces manicotti ( cooked in 2 cups hot water ) | 1 jar apricot jam
instructions: Cook the noodles the way you like them, set aside. In a large skillet brown the ground round drain and set aside. Add the cauliflower and coffee to the skillet and cook until the cauliflower is tender. Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to the package instructions. Drain the pasta, cool slightly and put in blender. When the noodles have been drained mix the pasta with the filling and sauce. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,ranch dressing mix,egg,sirloin tip roast,lasagna noodle
title: Quick and Easy Beef Lasagna
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 egg, beaten | 4 lasagna noodles
instructions: Cut meat into 1/4 inch slices.

title: Easy Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 2 green chilies, seeded and chopped ( canned, this amount will change depending on the size ) | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce ( i use thai kitchen brand ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Place black eyed peas in a medium size mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Let stand 10 minutes. Pour into small serving dishes and cool completely.

title: Cheesy Chicken Chips (Sbd P2)
ingredients: 4 chicken leg quarters | 3/4 cup rice | 1/2 cup crumbled goat cheese | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons toasted tortilla chips
instructions: Pat chicken dry and place on a foil lined baking sheet. Whisk cheese into cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Spread tortilla chips on a plate and sprinkle evenly with cheese. Bake at 350°f for 15 minutes, or until cheese has melted.

title: Caribbean Beef and Noodle Supreme
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated pizza crust | 1 pound lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 3 cups diced cooked ham | 2 cups diced cooked spaghetti | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 cup irish cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.

title: Spicy Turkey or Chicken Nannies (Pillsbury)
ingredients: 2 cans pillsbury refrigerated biscuits | 1 can ro-tel tomatoes ( if you can't find ro tel ) | 5 slices fully cooked bacon | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon clove
instructions: Unroll biscuits. Spread tops with 1 can ro tel, 1 slice bacon, 1/2 slice of tomato, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoons pepper. Roll up biscuit style.

title: Cucumber & Cream (Low Fat)
ingredients: 3 medium cucumbers | 2 tablespoons half-and-half
instructions: Chop cucumbers very fine, remove seeds, pat dry. Put half and half in a bowl, stir well. Chop finely a cucumber in the bowl. Stir in cream and mix.

Random Ingredients: chinese rice wine,baby portabella mushroom,pecorino romano cheese,gelatin,monterey jack cheese,onion soup mix
title: Cheese Terrine for Two
ingredients: 4 ounces unflavored gelatin | 3 tablespoons chinese rice wine | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 4 ounces monterey jack cheese | 4 ounces baby portabella mushrooms, drained and chopped | 4 ounces pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Soak gelatin in 1/2 cup of chinese rice wine for at least 1 hour or until it begins to soften. Set oven rack to lowest setting. Drain gelatin through cheesecloth. Place cheesecloth over another large container with just the water in it. You may not need to remove the gelatin completely, it just makes the water easier to remove. In the meantime, heat remaining chinese rice wine, soup mix, and mushrooms in a saucepan over medium heat until hot, but not boiling. Pour about 1/3 of the mushroom mixture into the gelatin & mix to incorporate. Repeat with remaining water, soup mix, and gelatin until total mixture is three cups of gelatin and mixture is three cups. It will appear a little jiggly at first but when it rises up the sides of the bowl, it's okay. Spread mixture on a sheet of greased waxed paper or jellyroll pan. Spread sliced cheeses on top of the gelatin, pressing to adhere. Bake for 25 - 60 minutes or until firm. Cut into squares or diamonds as desired and serve.

Random Ingredients: serrano chile pepper,tortilla,tart apple,yellow bell pepper,pineapple tidbit,breadcrumb,worcestershire sauce,nut
title: Apple Salad With Pineapple
ingredients: 14 ounces pineapple tidbits, drained but reserve 2/3 cup juice | 4 slices country breadcrumbs | 4 slices yellow bell peppers | 4 thick slices firm tart apples ( i prefer white ) | 1 serrano chile pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/3 cup pineapple tidbits | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint | tzatziki ( optional ) or sour cream ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the pineapple juice with the bread crumbs and chile. Line a serving dish with a thin layer of bread crumb mixture, 1/2 of the bread crumb mixture, a layer of apple slices, a layer of bell peppers, a layer of pineapple, a layer of fried plantains, and more bread crumbs finishing with bread crumbs. Pour the reserved juice over everything and let macerate for 15 minutes, or overnight. To serve, garnish with chopped of fresh mint.

title: Fresh and Easy Ramen Noodle Salad

instructions: Place noodles in a bowl. Sprinkle with cilantro and toss. Serve.

title: Oven-Roasted Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Score the surface of the tenderloin with a sharp knife about 1/4 from the edge. Insert a sharp knife into center of the beef and cut 1/2 to 1/2 inch deep slits in the meat with a serrated knife.. In a non aluminum bowl pour about 1/2 cup water and the oil which has been seeping over medium surface. Place meat in bowl with oil. Cover and refrigerate, turning and basting with brine and marinade every 30 minutes or so, until meat is completely tender when pierced with a fork. If the meat starts to develop a crust in the brine it is time to remove dish from refrigerator. Transfer the meat to a rack set over a rimmed baking sheet and let stand for at least 10 minutes before carving.

title: Quick and Spicy Escarole and Kiwi Hash

title: Halibut Mexican Grill
ingredients: 4 halibut fillets | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 2 teaspoons bottled dry crabmeat | 4 slices egg bread, toasted | 3 slices colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded radicchio | 1 jar hot picante sauce
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat. Brush both sides of fish fillets with picante sauce, and place on the grill. Cook until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Place 2 slice bread onto the underside of each fillet and top with colby jack cheese, crabmeat, 1/2 cup picante sauce and 1/2 cup shredded radicchio. Top the sandwiches with remaining 2 slices bread.

title: Orange Marmalade Salad

instructions: Pour the orange marmalade, 3 tbls. Of the orange blossom water, the 1 tbl's sake and the 3 tbl's sherry into a bowl or pitcher. Stir vigorously until the sugar is dissolved. Add 3 tbls. Cover with plastic wrap and refridgerate overnight. Remove the rest of the orange blossom water before serving. This can be served cold.

title: Mandarin Oranges
ingredients: 3 lbs mandarin oranges | 2 cans stewed tomatoes | 4 inches gingerroot, chopped
instructions: Cut oranges in half, remove the peel. Cut a horizontal slit down the center of each orange and remove segments. Using a sharp knife cut the segments into 1/2 inch slices. Remove the pulp. In a large pot layer the oranges, tomatoes, ginger and mandarin oranges in this order into a large pot, adding some water. Cover and simmer over medium heat for 5 hours, depending on the size of your oranges. When cool, place the orange mixture in a jar and cover tightly.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,turnip,fine egg noodle,filling,farfalle pasta,adobo seasoning
title: Pasta Con Filling
ingredients: filling : | 4 cloves garlic powder | 3 tablespoons fine egg noodles | 2 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 2 cups chopped turnips | 1 package dry wide egg noodles
instructions: Combine garlic powder and egg noodles in a medium saucepan over medium low heat. Cook until tender, stirring often. Stir in the turnips.

title: Chef Joe's Super-Easy Italian Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | italian seasoning | 6 tablespoons fresh baby spinach
instructions: Brown ground beef. If cooking the ground beef in 2 1/2 3 cup portions, follow directions on package making sure to drain the grease. Drain any grease left in the bowl with the beef. Add in italian seasoning blend with the spinach. Turn into a 9x13 inch pan and cover with foil. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f and bake for 25 - 30 minutes. Note, when i use fresh spinach, i add in about 2 tb of fresh parmesan cheese, and about 3tb of freshly chopped italian spices. This serves as a base for your favorite meat and is great if served over your favorite pasta.

ingredients: 3 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 cup golden raisin, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium size mixing bowl. Toss evenly. Cover and chill for 1 hour or until chilled. Transfer to a baking tray lined with parchment paper and bake in a 400f degrees oven for 30 - 40 minutes till golden and crispy. Let cool and serve warm.

title: Chicken Tarte (Chicken Tatin)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 gallon apple juice | 1 gallon ice water
instructions: Mix apple juice and water and pour into large resealable plastic bag. Add chicken and turn to coast and refrigerate overnight. The next day drain chicken.

title: Tikka Naan
ingredients: 3 cups plain yogurt | 1/2 cup grated manchego cheese | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram, divided | 1 pinch dried marjoram, divided
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash the yogurt with a fork. Mix in 1/2 teaspoon each of marjoram and 2 teaspoons dry marjoram. Gently mix in the cheese and remaining marjoram, breaking up any lumps. Divide mixture into two 9 inch patties. Cover, and refrigerate at least 6 hours before cooking. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil it. Grill patties 6 minutes per side.

title: Tommy's Famous Steak
ingredients: 2 pounds flank steak | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: In a slow cooker combine steak, tomato sauce, and green chilies.

title: Swiss Steak Flambe
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg ham steaks | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 packets vanilla flavoured quick cooking oil | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 small onion ( finely chopped-for topping ) | 1 stalk celery ( finely chopped-for topping ) | 2 teaspoons onion powder ( i use seasoned salt ) | 120 g snow peas ( trimmed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Score a small cross in top of each steak with a sharp knife so the steaks will absorb as much oil as possible. For the sauce, in a small bowl whisk the maple syrup, cream and half and half until sauce is smooth and has thickened slightly. Set aside. To serve, place the onion, celery and onion powder in a large bowl. Toss them together and season with onion powder, salt and snow peas. Stir the cream sauce into the vegetables, and serve.
