title: EASY Orzo, Pepperoni & Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 box orzo pasta ( or other small pasta ) | 1 package orzo ( or other small pasta ) | 4 cups cabbage leaves | 1 packet sazon goya | 7 ounces jarred hot pepperoni, sliced in thin strips | 1 package presliced cremini mushrooms | 1 chicken bouillon | herbs, of choice ( optional )
instructions: Sauté the mushrooms, oroni in a large soup pan with just a splash of oil. Add the canadian sazon and cook for 2 minutes more. Boil orzo, using 2 cups water if needed to keep the strands thin. Drain the canadian sazon, reserving the broth, and stir into the broth. Add the orzo and cabbage leaves to the soup, simmer on low until the orzo is just tender and the cabbage and mushrooms are tender.

title: Australian Baked Fish
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, cut into 6 wedges | 2 whole allspice | 2 cloves garlic, peeled | 1/2 lime | salt and pepper to taste | 2 pounds fish fillets | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: Place butternut squash wedges and allspice in a saucepan with water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for a few minutes. Place fish fillets in a baking dish, sprinkle them with lime juice, and season with sugar and salt. Cover, and marinate for 30 minutes in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the fish fillets on top of the butternut squash in a single layer in the baking dish. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, and vanilla. Roast in the preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 40 minutes. Turn and brown the other side, about 15 minutes. Garnish with chives. Serve with spiced rice or spiced vegetable sticks with a dab of cream on top. Recipe by marie leeko.

title: Chinese Noodle Bowl #Rachael Ray's Chinese Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 2 cups fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon sriracha sauce | 1 1/2 cups cheese | 1 1/2 cups urad dal
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large pot, boil pasta, until tender, but still firm. Drain spaghetti. In a large bowl, combine spaghetti, mushrooms and spices. Mix well. Stir in the cheese and urad dal. Serve immediately.

title: Asian  Beer Fried Spinach
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh spinach | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 5 drops chinese rice wine | 1/2 cup beer | 1/4 cup tahini
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach and remove any blemishes from the stalks as well with a spoon. Slice or chop the stalks into bite sized chunks. Drain the spinach using some kitchen paper towels, squeeze water out of the spinach then chop roughly. Heat the oil on medium high in your skillet. When the oil is hot enough and starting to smoke, put in the chopped spinach in a single layer. Stir for 2 to 3 minutes then flip and cook another 2 to 3 minutes. Keep watching for the spinach to make sure it doesn't burn and shaking the pan often. Keep shuffling the spinach so it doesn't burn and turning it over as needed. When just barely beginning to wilt, mix in the wine. Let the wine evaporate and reduce for a few minutes. Add the beer a little at a time, scraping the pan to get up the browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Try to keep from splashing in all the beer. Stir and let it reduce a little. Stir in the tahini and transfer the spinach to a serving platter. Serve immediately. This dish is very tasty when served with chicken. Note, for a vegetarian meal, omit the beer and increase the soy sauce and tofu. Instead of soy sauce or tofu, you can use soy seasoning and sauteed chicken. This is also good with other protein and veggies such as squash and peas.

title: Easy Low-Fat Tacos (No Nuts)
ingredients: 18 medium taco shells, warmed | 10 ounces white flour ( i use light ) | chili pepper flakes
instructions: Place warmed taco shells in a non sticking single layer on a microwave safe dish. Spread enough flour over the shells to coat them completely then sprinkle chili flakes over the top. Microwave on high for 1 minute then allow to stand for 1 minute. Carefully unseal then sprinkle with any desired toppings. Serve straight from the dish with corn chips or salsa.

title: Grilled Pork Loin
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons sweet vermouth
instructions: Heat grill. Split split vanilla bean lengthwise. Place pork on grill. Cook until done. Cut pork into 1/2 inch slices. Sprinkle with curry paste. Serve with sweet vermouth.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,cinnamon red hot candy,soba noodle,liquid smoke flavoring,feta cheese,wild rice
title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package soba noodles | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 package cinnamon-flavored red hot candies | 1 package crumbled feta cheese | 1 cup cooked wild rice, chilled
instructions: Cook soba noodles in a pot of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain and cool under cold water. Dry on paper towels. Mix in the liquid smoke and vinegar until well blended and refrigerate at least 3 hours, or overnight. Place the candies in a heatproof bowl, cover, and microwave on high for 2 to 3 minutes or until fragrant. To serve, place the chilled noodles on a chilled platter and sprinkle with the blackened candies. Drizzle the noodles with the syrup, and top with the red cheese.

title: Curried Beet Pizza
ingredients: 1/4 cup yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 4 medium beets, washed and peeled | 2/3 cup pizza dough
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Make a deep slurry in the center of each beet and rub off as much salt as you can and make holes evenly. Bring each beet to the surface and poke holes all over with a fork or fork. Place on a baking sheet. Bake for about 45 minutes or until tender and most of the beet juices have been absorbed. Cool for 5 minutes and then stir in the yogurt and cayenne. Let sit for a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: oat,spring onion,beef base,spinach leaf,italian bread,heavy whipping cream
title: Italian Wedding Soup

instructions: Whip cream lightly with beef base. Place rolled oats in a bowl and add cream. Mix. Place bread in a bowl with onions and pour cream over and gently soak. Place soup bowls on table and add toppings.

title: Quick and Easy Tomato Sauce

instructions: Put tomato cut side down on lightly oiled grill tray. Bake about 15 minutes or until tomatoes pop/dark brown. Turn over. Bake another 10 minutes or until they begin to break and release their juices. Sprinkle with oregano, if using. Serve with roasted vegetables and/or fresh breads.

title: Pastel De Cherry Tomate (Catalan Cherry Tomato Ice Cream)
ingredients: 2 cups halved cherry tomatoes ( can be found in the canning aisle near the cherry tomatoes ) | 6 large egg yolks | 1/4 cup cold milk | 1 -2 tablespoon slivered almonds ( optional ) or 1 -2 tablespoon slivered almonds, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Process the tomatoes in a food processor until it becomes a coarse puree. Scrape the puree into a large bowl along with the sugar, egg yolks and milk. Stir in the almonds. Put the mixture in a metal cake pan and place in the freezer for 2 hours. Remove from freezer. When cold, divide mixture between 4 small bowls. Serve immediately, or refrigerate until serving time.

title: Garlicky Spinach
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried chopped spinach | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill weed | 1/4 cup chopped coconut | 2 large eggs | 2 tablespoons egg wash | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon capers
instructions: In bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Add to salad. Mix well.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,soba noodle buckwheat,garlic powder,red chilies,green pea,green food coloring,dill pickle,olive oil
title: Yummy Chilled Vegetables
ingredients: 4 cups of peeled and sliced pumpkin or 4 cups winter squash ( about 2 1/2 pounds ) | 1 teaspoon dill pickle, finely minced | 2 tablespoons red chilies, finely chopped ( fresh preferred ) | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon green food coloring | 1/2 cup soba noodles ( buckwheat noodles ) | 4 teaspoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon pumpkin puree
instructions: Slice pumpkin/squash into 1 inch cubes. Place squash, pickles, chilies, garlic powder, food coloring and soba in a large saucepan and stir constantly over medium heat for about 10 minutes or until mixture is mixed together. Add ½ cup water and cook 2 minutes more. Drain noodles and place in a serving dish. Top with mixture of pumpkin mixture and drizzle with remaining oil. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,beef stew meat,dessert wine,white vinegar
title: Beef With Sun-Dried Tomato and Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef stew meat ( cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, well drained | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 3/4 cup dessert wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Arrange beef in roasting pan and cover with a single layer of well washed tomatoes. Sprinkle with vinegar and pour wine around the beef. Bake uncovered until beef is almost tender, about 2 hours. Remove beef and tomatoes from pan, reserving liquid in pan. Stir beef juices into pan juices to loosen. Serve.

title: Stuffed Ancho Chiles
ingredients: 6 medium ancho chiles, whole, wiped clean | salt | 1 lb lean ground beef, lean | 1 package mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons orange juice ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt
instructions: If canned chiles are large, cut off stems and discard. Fill each chile with about 2 tablespoons meat and 1 teaspoon of salt.

title: Sunshine Fried Rice
ingredients: 600 g brown rice or 600 g brown rice | 2 teaspoons rock salt | 2 teaspoons gingerroot, grated, fresh | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds | 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a wok and microwave covered for 1 - 2 minutes, or until the rice is ready. Serve.

title: Cardamom Mushrooms (Stuffed Mushrooms)
ingredients: 8 white mushrooms | 2 cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Remove and discard stems from mushrooms. Place the mushroom stem side up in a baking dish. Sprinkle the lightly crushed cardamom pods over the top. Lightly sprinkle with a little more cardamom. Cover and bake at 200°c for 25 minutes. Drain the mushrooms and serve with fresh bread and a cold glass of stout.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,spinach leaf,pepper sauce,dijon mustard,bamboo shoot,italian salad dressing,onion,potato flour
title: Sweet Potato Dipping Sauces for Pierogi or Sandwich
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons potato flour | 2 cups vegetable oil for frying | 1 jar sliced bamboo shoots ( undrained ) | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves ( thawed ) | 1 jar hot pepper sauce | dijon mustard | 1/3 cup reduced-fat italian salad dressing
instructions: Spray 12 nonstick skillet with cooking spray.

title: Spiced Hot Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 2 tablespoons dried chives | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground hazelnuts
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve over cold french baguettes.

title: Cauliflower Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret | 3 ounces spaghetti ( your choice ) or 3 ounces linguine ( your choice ) | 1 large green pepper, diced | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1 lemon, zest of, diced | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Heat 2 oz of pasta water to boil and cook cauliflower until tender, drain and cool. Cut into bite sized pieces. Cook spaghetti or linguine and drain. Mix cauliflower, pasta, pepper, mayonnaise, lemon zest, coriander and seasoning.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,rice wine vinegar,sirloin steak,red chilies,iceberg lettuce,chocolate
title: Beef and Chocolate Satay
ingredients: 200 g sirloin steaks | 1 -2 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 -3 red chilies, minced | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | iceberg lettuce | 4 tablespoons choclate chocolate, melted
instructions: Place the beef in a bowl and add the salt, pepper, red chillies, turmeric, and vinegar. Mix well and leave to marinate for 15 minutes. Cut the sirloin into thin strips. Line the bamboo skewers with lettuce. Thread onto the skewers and secure with toothpicks. Grill over a direct medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes until cooked to your liking. Drizzle with chocolate, serve straight away.

title: Penne With asparagus (Italian Style)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons asparagus, chopped | 1 package dry penne | 1 pint beef stock | 1/4 cup ice water | 1 package frozen small egg noodles
instructions: Bring a few cups of water to a hard boil. Dice the asparagus into bit sized pieces and place them in the boiling water. When the asparagus are just about cooked, drain them and transfer the asparagus to a large pot. Add beef broth and bring to a boil, then add the dry penne. Simmer over medium heat about 10 minutes or until pasta is cooked but still firm. While the pasta is simmering, drain any excess water from the asparagus and put it aside, but leave some as it is. While the pasta is cooking, place a large pot of salted water on the stove over medium high heat. Add the frozen pasta and cook until it is heated through, but does not stick right away. Stir the asparagus with the noodles into the pasta with the beef broth and cook until the noodles soften a bit, about 3 minutes. If it looks like it's getting too thick, add some of the beef broth and water, stir a little then remove the pan from the heat. The pasta can be made up to 2 hours ahead and kept, tightly covered, in the refrigerator until you are ready to serve.

title: Apple Rice
ingredients: 2 cups chopped cabbage | 1/2 cup chopped apple | 1/2 cup shredded cotija cheese or 1/2 cup feta cheese ( about 1/2 ounce ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon savory | 1 1/2 cups medium grain rice ( preferably brown ) | 1 cup coarsely chopped cabbage or 1 cup other leafy greens
instructions: Coat a small skillet with cooking spray. Saute cabbage, apple, cotija cheese and sour cream over medium heat until cheese is melted. Add savory and rice. Cook over low heat, stirring frequently, until rice is tender, apprx 18 minutes. Serve immediately, rice will be slightly crisp.

title: Garlicky Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | 1/2 cup diced celery | 1/3 cup beef stock or 1/3 cup canned beef broth | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Using a sharp knife trim all fat on the brisket. With all beef fat remaining cut the meat in to a 1 1/2 in size strips. Combine all other ingredients. Place the brisket in a large, heavy roasting pan, cover and roast in the 325 degree oven for 3 hours. Remove meat from pan and cover tightly with aluminum foil to maintain the juices. After about 45 minutes remove meat to remove pan juices and arrange in serving dish, cutting meat as desired. Remove all any fat from the pan juices and use to drippings, drippings and or broth to cook off leftover liquid. Serve over basmati rice.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,white wine vinegar,cream,honey,peanut butter,chicken wing
title: Creamy Peanut Butter Barbecue Wings
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup honey | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 7 pounds chicken wings | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, whisk together the peanut butter, white wine vinegar, honey, vegetable oil, and chicken wings. Bring to a boil, and boil for 20 minutes.

title: Lighter Mock Danish
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk or 1 cup low fat milk | 1/4 cup sweet red pepper, strips ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig ( optional ) | 10 -12 meatballs, cooked ( pre-cooked are better )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the soy milk, sweet pepper strips, thyme, and half of the meatballs. Set aside. In a 12 inch nonstick skillet, melt half of the fat. Add the meatballs, 1/4 cup at a time. Cook until meatballs are browned on all sides. Remove the meatballs to a platter and sprinkle rest of the fat on them.

title: Mexican Pulled Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs beef shank ( the meaty ends trimmed off ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Trim excess fat from beef shanks. Rinse under cold running water to remove any sand or impurities. Place beef shanks in a heavy large roasting pan or dutch oven. Add a little water, if necessary, to just cover the meat. Set a pan over high heat and bring to a boil. Add cilantro. Cover tightly and steam at a slow boil for about 2 hours, or until the meat is tender. You may remove the cover for the last 30 minutes, if you wish.

title: Baked Cod
ingredients: 4 cod, fresh cut into 4 pieces | 4 egg yolks | 1/8 teaspoon black olives | coriander powder ( heaping tsp. powdered )
instructions: Preheat the oven 350f degrees. Combine all ingredients for fish in small bowl and add to mixture. Lightly coat a baking dish with ghee. Spread fish mixture into baking dish, skin side down. Cook for 30 mins, or until top becomes crisp and brown. Serve with rice. Note, if you like a more savory fish, use 1 tablespoon coriander powder for one tablespoon.

title: Apple Vinaigrette
ingredients: 4 -6 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 2 lbs trimmed boneless sirloin
instructions: In a bowl whisk together vinegar and salt until salt dissolves. Add meat and allow to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. Preheat broiler. Grill or broil meat until desired doneness, turning once. Serve with french bread, noodles, vegetables, or as a topping for french bread. Garnish with sliced onions and celery before serving.

title: Mashed Plantains (Tapas) With Strawberries and Chipotle Pepper
ingredients: 4 tablespoons kalamata olives, freshly chopped | 2 tablespoons strawberries, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle pepper, more to taste ( chipotle can be very salty. chipotle peppers soften and turn bitter ) | 2 medium ripe plantains, ripe ( cut 1-inch thick, then into 1/4-inch slices ) | 2 whole sweet plantains, ripe ( cut 1-inch thick, then in 1/4-inch slices )
instructions: Combine together, olives, strawberries, and chipotle. Arrange plantain slices on a serving platter. Pour vinaigrette over plantains and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: shallot,sage,green bean,vegetable bouillon cube,cream mushroom soup,taco seasoning
title: Green Beans, Shallots, and Sage
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 vegetarian vegetable bouillon cube | 1 bunch green beans, trimmed | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, or hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 small shallot, minced ( optional )
instructions: Place beans and bouillon cube in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer until beans are tender, 15 to 30 minutes. Drain. Return beans to the saucepan, and add mushroom soup, seasonings, and any optional ingredients. Cover and simmer about 5 minutes.

title: Seared Mini Indian Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 kg rigatoni pasta | 2 cups asafoetida powder | 2 chilies, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, powder ( more or less to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups sultanas or 1 1/2 cups raisins | 400 g pepperoni, halved lengthways | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander powder | 1 1/2 cups croutons
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water per directions. Drain and set aside. Combine asafetida and chillies in a small nonstick frying pan and fry for 1 - 2 minutes on medium heat. Add cayenne pepper powder and fry for 30 seconds or until fragrant. Add sultanas or raisins. Stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes. Add pasta and seasoning. Mix well. Heat through. Add pepperoni and toss to coat all the pasta with the spice mixture. Place on a baking tray and sprinkle with the coriander. Heat through in oven on a medium heat for 6 - 8 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,lime,flour tortilla,white sesame seed,herb
title: Simple Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 1 pint white sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons fresh herbs, chopped | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 fresh lime, juice of | 20 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine seeds with herbs and chili sauce. Mix together cheese and lime juice. Place about 2 tablespoons filling on each tortilla and roll up. Place each rolled up tortilla on paper towel and pat dry with paper towels. Place in ungreased baking dish in single layers. Repeat until all tortillas are used. Top with melted butter. Bake for 45 - 55 minutes. Serve with any main course accompaniments. Yield, 8 servings.

title: Jiffy Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 bag frozen raspberries | 4 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Boil raspberries for 15 minutes, drain and let cool slightly. Put corn oil in a shallow pan over medium high heat. When a drop of water placed on the top bead of the oil immediately evaporates immediately, quickly dip corn chips in the oil and turn over. Let bread crisp. The chips are best when they are hot and firm. These are great cold too.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,mustard powder,chili bean paste,serrano chili
title: Lumpia
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 tablespoon chili bean paste | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 serrano chili
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients together. Pour into a dehydrator and dehydrate for 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,coriander seed,saffron,salt pork,linguica sausage,anise seed,red currant jelly
title: Linguica Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb linguica sausage | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 2 tablespoons salt ( coarse salt is available at specialty food stores ) | 3 tablespoons anise seed | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly
instructions: Grind together the turmeric with the saffron and salt until smooth. Cut into 2 pieces and rub the spice mixture into the meat. Cut the sausage into 1/2 inch slices. Fry over medium heat until they are brown and tender. Drain on paper towels. In a small skillet, toast the anise seeds over medium heat until fragrant and a shade or two darker. Remove seeds from heat and grind in a mortar and pestle. Set the spice mixture aside while making the sauce. In a small frying pan, heat the jelly for 15 minutes until it is slightly warm to the touch. Remove from heat. Drench the sausage slices on paper towels. Put the slices in the sauce and toss well, coating them well. Serve hot. These freeze well and can be reheated in the oven until ready for future use. Just warm them first and then let the sausages warm in the sauce.

title: Salsa with Garlicky Avocado
ingredients: 2 ripe hass avocados, peeled | 1 cup greek salad dressing or 1 cup olive oil | 2 tablespoons dark sweet cherries, drained | 1 tablespoon minced fresh mint leaves
instructions: Cut avocados in half with a sharp knife. Carefully scoop out their stone and place flesh in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until smooth. Add greek dressing and cherry nuts. Blend until a smooth consistancy is reached. Serve immediately.

title: String Beans and Soy Milk Fritters (No Meat)
ingredients: 200 g string beans, in lengths | 1 tablespoon oil | cooking spray | 3 tablespoons soymilk | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil, and add the string beans. Cook for 1 minute, then drain. Preheat the oven to 190c / 375f / gas mark 5, 200c / gas mark 4, 5 or 190c, 190°c. Coat your hands, wetting them first with oil if you want the fritters to stick. Place the beans in a bowl, add the soy milk and baking powder and mix well. Place about 1 teaspoons of the mixture at a time onto the greased, baking paper lined baking tray. Spray all over with cooking spray and bake for about 10 minutes, shaking the tray a few times. If the fritters start to colour or become crisp, take them out and let them cool. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: tomato basil oregano garlic,wheat bran,apricot jam,shell pasta,egg,jalapeno
title: Jalapeno Whole Wheat and Apricot Pasta Nests
ingredients: 1 box whole wheat bran | 3 large eggs | 1 can crushed tomatoes with basil oregano and garlic | 1 can apricot jam | fresh jalapeno, seeded | 1 package uncooked shell pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine bran and eggs, mix well. Drain excess bran. Pour into a large casserole dish. Add next 4 ingredients, stir to combine. Spread tomatoes over bran mixture, cover and bake 25 minutes. Remove cover and bake an additional 25 minutes or until egg mixture is set. While oven is heating, cook pasta according to package directions. Drain well. Place 1 cup pasta in a large bowl. Cover with remaining bran mixture.

title: Homemade Nye Bread (No Beer)
ingredients: 1 kg plain flour, preferably non-sifted | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place the flour on a flat surface and use your fingertips to rub the flour into the flour. Use your hands to work the flour into the dough with your fingertips. Knead the dough into a ball before continuing. Wash the lettuce leaves and carefully separate them from their heads and tear them into two or three similar pieces. Add the lettuce to the balls, cover with kitchen paper and leave to rise a few hours or overnight. You can use an electric kneader or a bench scraper to knead the dough into desired shape. Roll out the dough into a circle about 1cm thick. Using a 2cm round cutter, cut the dough into rounds about 5cm thick. Bake the nye on a baking tray in a preheated oven at 150 c for 8 - 10 minutes. Allow to cool. Store in an airtight container and use within 4 weeks.

title: Spicy Sweet Pepper Bread
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, roasted, peeled, seeds removed, finely diced and seeded | 1 -2 teaspoon yeast | 1 tablespoon sugar ( or to taste )
instructions: Place the red pepper, roasted garlic and yeast into the bowl of a standing mixer fitted with the mixing bowl and add the sugar or butter or margarine. Mix all together to combine. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 7 - 10 minutes until the dough is firm and shiny and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl, cover and place in a warm place until double in size 10 - 12 hours. Knock dough out of bowl by hand onto a greased or oiled tabletop and using the palms or hands knead in additional flour if necessary. The dough will be very soft and sticky, so be patient. Divide dough into 14 pieces. Form into balls and place on a lightly floured baking sheet. Brush with water and sprinkle the tops with a bit of brown sugar. Cover and allow to rise until doubled again, at least 60 - 90 minutes. Bake in a preheated 375f oven for 12 - 15 minutes or until golden, turning and basting with melted butter or oil before baking with melted butter or oil.

title: Fava Beans and Potatoes - Easy and Simple
ingredients: 1 lb dried fava beans | 1 1/2 lbs baking potatoes | 4 hot water | 2 cups hot water, divided | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum
instructions: Prepare your favas and potatoes, and wash them well. Soak them for a few hours while you prepare the others. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees. Drain your favas and potatoes and add 4 cups of hot water, 1 tablespoon of xanthan gum, mix with a wire wisk in a heavy bottomed baking pan. Bake for one hour or until tender and well flavoured. Serve hot with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: cheese,locatelli cheese,red curry paste,broccoli floret,shiitake mushroom,bamboo shoot,chocolate,phyllo pastry
title: Vegetable Parcels With Chocolate and Coconut Crust
ingredients: 100 g chocoholiches or 80 g ricottis | 1 cup fresh shiitake mushroom, sliced | 1/4 cup bamboo shoot, julienned thinly | 1/2 red curry paste | 1/4 cup locatelli cheese, shredded | 1 sheet phyllo pastry, thawed | 25 g low-fat provolone cheese or 25 g grana padano | 3 tablespoons grated cheese | 100 g abalone cheese or 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 deg celsius. Place chocoholiches or ricottis on a baking sheet. Place in oven and bake until toasted and softened. Cool. Blend chilloches with 1/4 cup water and curry paste. Place mushrooms and bamboo shoots along with capsicum and 3 tbsp of cheese in a bowl. Cut the pastry in half crossways and place on a tray. Spread a little sauce over each slice of pastry. Place 2 tbsp of filling on top. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and drizzle with glaze. Bake at 200 deg celsius for 10 - 15 minutes or until the filling is hot.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,yellow cornmeal,porcini mushroom,tempeh,white sesame seed,pork tenderloin
title: Indian Style Pies
ingredients: 1 cup prepared yellow cornmeal | 4 slices tempeh, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 1/2 pounds pork tenderloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 1/2 tablespoons white sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons pine nuts or roasted yellow corn seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl combine the cornmeal, tempeh, paprika and garam masala.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,bay leaf,black pepper,picante sauce,buttermilk baking mix
title: Chocolate Chip Biscuits
ingredients: 1 box buttermilk baking mix | 1 cup unsweetened chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground bay leaf | 1/2 cup picante sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. In a bowl, combine the baking mix, chocolate chips, black pepper, bay leaf and picante sauce. Add enough buttermilk to mix to the consistency of thin buttermilk. Using a spoon, stir until all ingredients are incorporated. Pour mixture onto prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven 15 minutes, or until edges of biscuit are firm to the touch and top is light brown. Remove and cool on wire racks for 10 minutes. Serve warm, or cool completely.

Random Ingredients: lentil,cod fish fillet,yeast cake,pimiento,almond extract,beef stock,ice,vanilla essence
title: Chilean Fish Cake - Yummy!
ingredients: 2 cans chopped canned tomatoes including juice | 1/2 lb cod fish fillet | 6 ounces lentils, drained | 1 ounce pimiento | 2 cups beef stock | 2/3 ounce yeast cakes | 1 ounce raw almonds, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon yeast extract | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | ice
instructions: Put a pan of water on to boil on low heat and put the yeast proof cake in it add the remaining ingredients into the pan and stir to combine. Boil for 8 - 10 minutes until it is just starting to turn frothy. Turn up the heat a little and boil until it has thickened.

title: Pasta With Celery and Salt
ingredients: 1/2 lb rotini pasta or 1/2 lb other type spiral shaped pasta | 1 tablespoon celery salt
instructions: Place pasta in plenty of salted water to boil, cooking until just al dente. In a large frying pan, cook the celery salt in 1 tbsp butter while stirring with a wire whip or fork, until golden brown and starting to crisp up. Set aside. Drain the pasta. If it has rendered a lot of excess water and the water is hot, drain well and return to pan. Add the celery salt and toss until mixed. If not, add a little water, but as the dish sits, the celery salt will thicken.

title: Apple Sauté With French Toast
ingredients: 3 slices french baguette, thickly sliced | 3 tablespoons mango chutney, sweetened ( i use my peach sauté chutney ) | 1 tablespoon apple cider or 1 tablespoon apple juice, to spread
instructions: Spread french bread slices with chutney over the bread. Top the bread with apple cider or juice. Cut in half diagonally before serving.

title: Bacalao - Cod and Baileys Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb dried cod | 6 -8 ladyfingers | 10 tablespoons corn oil ( approximately ) | 1/2 cup corn oil | 3 teaspoons garlic, minced | 1/2 cup light aged baileys irish cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons light sumac | 1 1/2 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Soak daddies in warm water until tender enough to pierce with a fork. Drain well and break into pieces with your fingers. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan. Add the garlic and cook over medium heat for two minutes. Drain any excess oil if garlic burns, and discard. Drain cod and rinse thoroughly. Discard any pieces which have not turned gray. Drain any remaining oil. Pour all oil off of soaked daddies and discard. Set aside. In a large mixing bowl, blend the baileys and 1 1/2 tablespoons water. Make sure to mix well. Combine all ingredients together and knead lightly with hands until mixture is uniform. Add the fish and turn to coat. Cover and chill for 30 minutes to 2 hours. Place your fritter on your work surface and carefully shape into a circle 3 or 4 inches in diameter. Repeat with the remainder. Spread any remaining oil on the surface. Heat your favorite brand of corn oil in frying pan, approximately 1 tablespoon. Pour a few tablespoons into your frying pan. When the oil reaches temperature, use tongs or a spatula. Cook each side for approximately 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, or until golden brown. Turn fritters over to warm side up in the oil for the second time. Once cooked, serve with remaining sauce for dipping the fritters.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,onion flake powder,chunky salsa,dark cooking chocolate,beef broth,baking potato,oyster sauce
title: Beef and Potato Tacos with Chocolate-Yourlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb beef top round steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups chunky salsa ( mexican-style hot ) | 1/4 cup low sodium beef broth | 1 small baking potato, peeled and grated ( from yukon gold ) | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium teriyaki sauce | 2 teaspoons dark cooking chocolate ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dried onion flakes powder
instructions: Cut steak into 1 inch cubes.

title: Cucumber & Chutney (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1 )
ingredients: 1 cucumber, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat or 1 1/2 tablespoons barley flakes
instructions: Peel the skin from the cucumber and grate using a cheese grater. Combine the drained cucumber with the chopped cucumber in a bowl. Add the wheat or barley flakes and mix well. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: fryer chicken,sherry wine,cherry,green pepper,rice noodle,basil leaf
title: Chicken With Paprika Rice Noodles and Fresh Herbs
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs fryer chickens, cut-up | 2 cups dry sherry wine | 1 package fresh basil leaves | 1 package rice noodles | 1 cup chopped mixed green and red peppers | 1 1/2 cups cherry tomatoes or can chopped tomatoes with juice
instructions: Place chicken, wine, basil and noodles in 9x13 baking dish. Broil, covered, for 45 minutes. Stir and sprinkle with pepper.

title: Cashew Dessert
ingredients: 1 cup cashews | 2/3 cup double cream | 2 packets hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; light dressing and seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 teaspoon bottled chili paste, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Put cashews in a large bowl with enough cold water to cover. Soak for 1 hour. Drain and dry on paper towels. Pour cream into a small saucepan and slowly bring to a boil. Cook for 1 minute over low heat. Remove from heat and stir in the ranch and seasoning mix and cumin. Allow to cool, then cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Once the cashews have soaked, spread some cream onto a serving plate. Top with cashews, if desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: hing,nacho flavor tortilla chip,ketchup,chili flake,chicken bouillon cube,rye bread,red pepper paste
title: Mexican Chicken Toast
ingredients: 2 cups ketchup | 2 tablespoons red pepper paste | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 tablespoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh horseradish or 1 tablespoon minced pickled horseradish | 12 slices whole grain rye bread | 1 package nacho flavor tortilla chips
instructions: Mix ketchup, red pepper paste, chicken bouillon cube, chili flakes, and horseradish in a large bowl. Add bread and toss to absorb the dressing. Arrange the bread in a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. Spread mixture over the bread. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight.

title: Panch Phoron
ingredients: 2 cups masoor dal, soaked overnight in | 1 cup water | 4 pieces smoked sausage
instructions: Drain. Soak masoor dal for a few hours in a little warm water. Soak sausages in a little warm water for about an hour, or until cooked through and firm. Break into small pieces. Place meat and sausages in a large covered saucepan. Add salt and pepper. Add 1 1/2 cup water. Simmer for 5 minutes. Gently stir, and serve.

title: Green Salsa-Poached Apple-Pork Fajitas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coarse mustard powder | 1 tablespoon oil | 500 g apples | 1 jar red green salsa ( mild, medium or hot will work ) | fresh lemon wedge | 1 dozen corn tortilla
instructions: Peel the apples and cut into slices.

title: Chard and Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 8 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 10 star fruit, cut into wedges | 1 1/2 lbs swiss chard, cut into 2 inch pieces | 8 cups cooked polenta, cut into 3/4 inch chunks | cream | sour cream, if desired | champagne, if desired
instructions: Preheat over to 400 degrees. Place mushrooms, star fruit, chard and polenta in a 13x9x2 pan with a lip of water. Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes. Remove foil and bake 10 more minutes until vegetables and polenta are tender. Pour over fruit and stir to coat. Serve immediately, if desired. Enjoy.

title: Easy Pesto Dip
ingredients: 4 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/8 teaspoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix. Pour into a crock or serving dish. Serve with pita chips.

title: Beef and White Bean Stew
ingredients: 3 tablespoons raspberry jam | 1 1/2 lbs steak, cut in 1-2inch cubes ( lean ) | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Spread jam on top of meat, sprinkle with salt. Bake on broil 2 minutes. Put beef in crock of slow cooker.

title: Beer Soup (Sushi)
ingredients: 1 can beer | 1 1/2 cups sushi rice ( i used japanese sushi rice which was already prepared but was not available in the japanese market. sushi rice is not gluten-free ) | 1 can beef broth ( i used campbell's healthy request beef or vegetable broth for a complete recipe. )
instructions: Bring two cups of water to a boil in a large pot. Add salt to taste. Add rice and stir to prevent sticking. When rice begins to become soft, lower heat and add broth. Simmer rice for 10 minutes. To see if rice is done, run a knife in hot water and gently flatten rice with the rice paddle.. Remove to a bowl. Continue simmering broth for about three more minutes or until most of the broth has been absorbed. Serve hot with a bowl of sushi.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,pimiento,red potato,asiago cheese,tomatillo,kaffir lime leaf,rice vinegar
title: Tomatillo, Cucumber and Provolone Salad
ingredients: 1 english cucumber | 4 small red potatoes, halved lengthwise | 1 jar whole pimientos, packed in juice | 5 asiago cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 3 sun-dried tomatoes, packed in oil with capers, drained | 1 package loxa asiago-style peeled potatoes, cut crosswise into 1/8-inch-thick rounds | 4 kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | pimiento, leaves drained ( optional )
instructions: Cut off ends of cucumber. Using a vegetable peeler, peel cucumber and potatoes. Slice cucumber in half lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,chicken broth,basmati rice,sherry wine vinegar,olive oil,peanut oil,baking soda,cumin seed
title: Picante Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 2 teaspoons baking soda, or more to taste | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth, or more as needed | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seeds | 1 tablespoon roasted unsalted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Soak basmati rice in a bowl of water at least twice the volume of rice until the water is absorbed, about 30 minutes. Place rice, baking soda, and 1 1/2 cups chicken broth in a blender.

title: Taco Beans and Corn
ingredients: 1 cup pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can baby corn, undrained | 1 tablespoon dried celery or 1 tablespoon finely chopped celery leaves | 4 pita bread, cut in half
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pita bread, in a large microwave safe bowl and microwave on high, about 3 minutes, stirring constantly, until heated through, about 1 minute. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the bean mixture per pita half into each pita half.

title: Nacho Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun, cut into 5 wedges | 1 bell pepper, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 cups canned stewed tomatoes | 1 cup canned broth | 1 1/2 - 2 cups grated texas cheese
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Add cheese to taste or sandwich sour cream if using. Put bread in toaster. Spread burger mixture. Bake on cookie sheets at 450° for 5 minutes.

title: French Fries With Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, loafs cut french style | 1/2 cup catsup | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 lb fennel, sliced into thin wedges | 1 tablespoon breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Cut bread loaf lengthwise into 4 slices. Lay bread slices in a single layer on counter. Brush top of bread with catsup, worcestershire sauce and fennel. Top with second slice of bread and spread top with crumbs and raisins. Grill french fries until crisp, serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rose water,buttermilk,chicken breast fillet,lemon juice,marjoram,coconut milk,grain rice
title: Sweet Chilli Garlic Chicken (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 10)
ingredients: 300 g chicken breast fillets ( skinless ) | 600 ml buttermilk ( low-fat ) | 1 1/2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1/2 cup light coconut milk ( low-fat ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | rose water, for brushing
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c. Put the chicken fillet into a shallow ovenproof dish to which you have added the buttermilk and cook in the oven for 20 minutes until cooked through and turning golden brown. Pour off any excess fat and set aside for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, combine rice, coconut milk and lemon zest in a medium saucepan. Bring to boil, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove the chicken from the oven and stand for 5 minutes. Remove, discard bones and skin, then shred. Stir the rice mixture, chicken, marjoram and lime juice into the chicken. Spoon into a baking dish. Brush the chicken with some of the pan juices, then bake for 50 minutes or until chicken is tender and crispy. Serve with spring onion greens.

title: Lobcracker Steamed Rice Paper
ingredients: 1/4 lb stewing beef | 8 slices cheese ( colby jack if you have it ) | 8 whole round rice paper | 1 can green chiles, chopped | 1/4 cup salsa | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 teaspoons mixed fresh herbs | 1/4 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Cut steak crosswise into 6 slices. Put a slice of cheese in center of each steak slice and roll up the steak. Wrap each roll with a slice of cheese and place onto a steamed rice paper. Arrange a few chilis around the roll, in the order given. Sprinkle with salsa and peanut butter. Garnish with herbs and cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Auntie Lori's Spicy Gravy
ingredients: 1 can tomato soup | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon mace
instructions: Empty tomato soup into a large skillet. Sprinkle creole seasoning and mace over tomato soup. Cover and simmer for 30 or so minutes, until thick and bubbly. Serve over your favorite veggies.

title: Mutton Raita
ingredients: 500 g mutton | 1 cup pearl barley | 1/2 pickle | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 3 slices white bread
instructions: Place rice in a pan that can be opened and covered with water. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook, uncovered, for 2 - 5 hours until it is cooked. Strain water and discard. Place drained rice in a large bowl. Cover with clean cloth and keep warm. Wash mutton well. Place it in the same water as the rice for 2 - 5 hours. Remove from heat and drain completely. Place in the bowl with the rice and add pickle, cardamom seeds, and shredded cheese. Mix thoroughly. Serve with fresh bread. Keep in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: coffee,saltine cracker,green pepper,salmon,irish cream,coconut milk,ginger paste
title: Smoked Salmon and Green Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut milk ( not evaporated ) | 4 fluid ounces irish cream | 2 fluid ounces coffee | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 pinch saltine crackers | 2 ounces smoked salmon | 1 green pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. Place in an ovenproof bowl and bake for 30 minutes, or until top is golden and crusty. Serve hot with crusty bread, crackers or vegetables.

title: Chinese Spicy Asparagus
ingredients: 1 whole cucumber | 2 quarts fresh asparagus, trimmed
instructions: Cut the ends off the asparagus, and cut the ends into 1 inch pieces. Slice the cucumber into 1 inch pieces. Steam the asparagus approximately 3 minutes, or until tender. You can also leave the asparagus whole. Serve immediately.

title: Ethiopian Beef Kabobs-Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 lb top round beef gravy | 1 medium yellow pepper, sliced | 2 tablespoons pistachios or 2 tablespoons almonds | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker. Cook on high for 2 hours or low for 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,ranch dressing mix,hamburger bun,vegetable stock,red bean
title: Bean & Ham Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 300 g red beans ( canned ) | 3 ounces hamburger buns ( wholemeal or gluten-free bread style ) | 1 packet hidden valley original ranch salad mix | 200 ml vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar ( or other vinegar )
instructions: Put the beans in a saucepan, add 1 1/2 pint of veg stock and bring to the boil over a high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes. Turn the heat off, cover and set aside. Meanwhile, make the dressing by combining the following in a screw top jar, 1tbsp rice vinegar and 1tsp soy sauce. Shake vigorously and set aside. Slice up the buns into rounds, place on serving plate, drizzle the dressing over and place under a preheated grill.

title: Frosty Semolina Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza dough, thawed | 1 bag cheese whiz | 2 tablespoons fine semolina | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | of fresh mint, chopped ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 550 degrees f. Lightly grease a cookie sheet. Roll pizza dough in the granulated sugar and place on the greased cookie sheet to form a crust. Bake for 5 minutes. Cut cheese whiz into thin slices and place on top of the crust, brushing with extra milk if you prefer crusty cheese. Bake for 15 minutes, or until cheese has melted, browned slightly, and is bubbling. Spread evenly with remaining cheese to serve.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,sun tomato oil,kaiser,maraschino cherry,oat,cremini mushroom
title: Wild Mushroom Burger Parfait
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped finely | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom, chopped finely | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped finely | 4 leaves fresh thyme leaves ( or 1 tbl dried ) | 3 kaiser rolls, split | 8 tablespoons rolled oats
instructions: In small bowl, combine all ingredients and form into four patties. Grill or grill burgers 3 minutes on each side or till browned and cooked through place one pattie on a plate, top with remaining pattie and then your favourite toppings. Serve with your favourite green salad or vegetable.

title: Hot Green Chili Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 -3 small hot green chili peppers | 4 -5 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Cut a thin slice off the base of the chile peppers lengthwise and then crosswise to free the stem, then split and scrape out the seeds. Discard the stem. Put the hot green chili in a small non reactive skillet and cover with a lid. Cook over medium low heat gently, stirring, for about 15 - 20 minutes or until chiles are soft and beginning to give off their fat. Stir in the tomatoes and cook for 10 - 15 minutes or until tomatoes have reduced by half. Remove from heat and serve hot with some plain yogurt or sour cream, if desired.

title: Chili Verde
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies, mild | 10 fresh chili peppers | 1 green bell pepper, cut to 1 inch squares | 9 ounces spaghetti
instructions: Cook and cool spaghetti for 4 – 5 minutes, drain well. Add all ingredients except spaghetti to a blender and liquify in 1 minute. Pour mixture into saucepan, bring to boil, simmer 5 – 10 minutes or until desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,prosciutto di parma,chuck steak,sriracha sauce,salmon fillet,chow mein noodle
title: Chinese Barbecue (Or Bistro Burger)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sriracha sauce | 2 lbs chuck steaks, 1/4-inch thick ( i used skirt steak ) | 1/2 lb boneless goat meat or 1/2 lb rib eye steak, cut 1/4-inch thick ( i used goat meat ) | 12 ounces cooked garbanzo beans, rinsed well and drained | 4 ounces prosciutto di parma, thinly sliced | 6 ounces chow mein noodles ( may substitute french bread )
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Brush grill with canola oil spray on work surface. Set aside. Rub salt and pepper onto both sides of each steak. Brush grill with canola oil spray. Place steaks directly over hot coals for 1 minute on each side for medium rare. Turn steak grill to medium. Turn off barbecue. Transfer steak to cutting board. Cover each steak with plastic wrap and let stand for 5 minutes. Slice diagonally against grain into 2 long slices. Cut each steak across the grain into 4 equal slices. Arrange meat in one layer on grill. Grill for 3 minutes per side for medium rare, turning once. While still hot, place 2 slices of goat cheese on each steak and top with 3 slices of arugula. Place chow mein noodles on grill and grill for 1 minute, brushing with 1 1/2 tablespoons oil. Serve hot. Accompany with noodles, if desired.

Random Ingredients: pearl onion,anchovy fillet,taco sauce,cooking oil,red pepper
title: Quick and Easy Tasty BBQ Pearl Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 pound pearl onions, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 pound roasted red peppers, chopped | 1 can anchovy fillets | 2 cups taco sauce, divided | cooking oil for frying
instructions: Place the onions, roasted red peppers, anchovies, and 1/2 cup taco sauce in a shallow dish or bowl. Cover tightly, and refrigerate for 1 hour to marinate. Heat about 1/3 cup taco sauce in a skillet over medium low heat. Remove from heat, cover, and allow to sit for 5 to 7 minutes. Heat oil in a deep fryer to 350 degrees f. Drain onions and red peppers, reserving liquid, and toss with reserved taco sauce in a bowl. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,cauliflower,stewing beef,clam juice,italian salad dressing mix,tequila,cocoa,baby bok choy
title: Hot and Spicy Beef Tips and Cauliflower
ingredients: 12 baby bok choy | 1 lb stewing beef | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 46 ounces bottled clam juice | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 16 ounces canned baby bella mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a crockpot. Cover with water. Cook on low about 6 to 8 hours. Serve over cooked white rice.

title: Tropical Green Bean Dip (Canned)
ingredients: 1 can green beans | 4 ounces fresh goat cheese | 1 teaspoon celery leaves
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine goat cheese and celery leaves. Drain green beans from juice. Rinse beans with cold water, and drain again. Pat cheese and celery leaves dry with a paper towels. Stir cheese and celery leaves into beans until cheese is blended. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Chipotle Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 2 tablespoons apple pie filling | 1/2 tablespoon chili powder | 1 pinch chipotle powder
instructions: Open beans and rinse. Soak them overnight, but not quite enough. Add 1/2 tablespoon of chili powder to beans. Dump in apple pie filling and chipotle powder and stir to mix. If you want a milder bean flavor, just add a small amount of apple pie filling. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,mandarin segment,ladyfinger,great northern bean,brown rice,brown sugar
title: Bean and Rice Ring (Pink Spring Roll)
ingredients: 1 box brown rice | 1 can great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 4 ounces brown sugar | 2 cans mandarin segments, drained | 14 ladyfingers ( savoiardi ) | 1/3 cup grand marnier or 1/3 cup orange liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a pan with an oven proof handle, stir together the rice, beans, brown sugar and mandarin segments. Place lady fingers in bottom of ring mold, and fill with bean mixture. Roll up with toothpicks, and place on a baking pan. In a saucepan over low heat, stir together grand marnier and orange liqueur until liquisome. Pour over the ring. Cover pan with foil, and bake for 1 hour. Remove from oven, and allow to cool completely. Cover tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least one hour.

title: Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1 box vegetable oil cooking spray | garlic salt | garlic, to taste
instructions: Spray non stick griddle pan or skillet generously with crisco. Heat over low med heat. Brown sausage on one side. If more grease is needed, add a bit of oil.. Add cooked sausage to pan or skillet, sprinkle with garlic salt and serve hot.

title: Mushroom Pork Lo Mein
ingredients: 1 package lo mein noodles | 1 lb pork | 1 cup fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup apple flavored cooking wine | cooking oil
instructions: Cook the noodles as directed on the package. Drain. Meanwhile, slice the pork into strips, or shred it into bite size pieces. Brown in vegetable oil. Add all ingredients including cooking wine, except the noodles, and cook until mushrooms and apples are tender. Serve over noodles.

title: Farfalle with Chocolate and Garlic
ingredients: 1 pound farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 cup milk | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon vodka ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the bow tie pasta and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is cooked through but the pasta is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well and return pasta to the pot. Stir together the milk, soy sauce and garlic. Spoon this evenly over the pasta and serve with the vodka. Serve immediately.

title: Frijoles a La Yucatecana
ingredients: 1 cup canola oil | 1 pound pinto beans, soaked in warm water for 8 hours
instructions: Drain the beans and place in a large saucepan. Add enough water just to cover them. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until tender, 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Drain and cool in cheesecloth lined colander, pressing with a rubber spatula and extracting as much liquid as possible. Stir cooked beans through a sieve set over a bowl to remove lumps. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat until oil shimmers, then cook the pinto bean mixture until soft and starting to darken, about 20 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Quick Ginger Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups rice, japanese white | 1 cup ginger juice or 1 cup juice of 1 medium fresh ginger | 1 1/2 cups orange juice | 1 bunch basil
instructions: Slice ginger and brown in a frying pan. Add rice to pan and fry for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown. While rice is browning, combine the juice and orange juice and pour over rice. Let sit and absorb the ginger flavor for about 5 minutes. Slice basil and combine with fried rice. Garnish with a sprig or mint.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,cajun seasoning,liver,aluminum foil,garlic clove,flat leaf parsley
title: Liver Pouches on the Saran Wrap
ingredients: 4 lbs liver | 1/4 ounce cajun seasoning | 1/4 ounce horseradish | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 bunch flat leaf parsley, chopped | 3 pinches cajun seasoning | aluminum foil
instructions: Chop liver from head to head and separate head from tail. Remove gills and discard. Chop tail from tail and cut into 2 equal pieces. Mix cajun seasoning, horseradish, garlic, and parsley with liver pieces and heads, using fingers or hands to bind well. Preheat oven to 400 degree fahrenheit. Lay out a piece of aluminum foil large enough to wrap around a liver. Place pouches in and wrap tightly, pressing aluminum foil over the top of the pouches. Place on cookie sheets and cook for 1 hour. Turn pouches at 1/2 hour and bake for 15 minutes longer or until well cooked. Wrap with foil and allow to cool, removing excess foil if desired. Serve open face, or with a side of bread on a plate, or with lemon wedges or cocktail sticks on the side.

title: Auberge Fritters
ingredients: 4 cups corn oil | 6 tablespoons cherry blossoms ( optional )
instructions: Heat one cup of corn oil in a heavy pot over a low flame to 175°f in a deep fryer or deep saucepan, pour about 7 tablespoons into a bowl, swirling the oil in a thin film, then place the bowl over the saucepan of hot water to cool and stir. Heat a 10 inch frypan over moderate heat until it is just beginning to smoke. Drop several tablespoons of the fritters into the hot oil one at a time, turning them over once or twice, then fry only 3 of them, adding more oil each time, frying only the fritters until they are puffed and colored on the outside and tender inside, 2 to 3 minutes total cooking time. Transfer the fritters to a plate when they are cool enough to handle, but leave the drippings in the pan. Makes about 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: banana leaf market,skirt steak,chicken thigh,wild rice,heavy whipping cream,lemongrass,flour tortilla
title: Chicken, Wild Rice and Banana Leaf Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice | 2 tablespoons thawed frozen boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons chopped lemongrass | 20 frozen banana leaves, thawed ( from market or bouillie ) | 12 quick cook complete hog's grillers | 2 whole lean boneless turkey thighs | 1 ounce cooked rolled up warm cooked wild rice
instructions: To prepare rice according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,flat leaf parsley,almond paste,coconut milk,thyme sprig,wooden skewer,green bean
title: Pasta With Indian Flavours
ingredients: 600 g ziti pasta or 600 g penne pasta | 5 wooden skewers or 5 metal skewers | 60 g almond paste | 250 ml coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 150 g frozen green beans, thawed | 1 teaspoon flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the ziti and cook for 8 - 10 mins until just tender. Meanwhile, heat the grill to high. Remove the pasta from the water, and leave slightly underdone. Drain and place in a large bowl. Add the almond paste. Mix well. Place the coconut milk, thyme and half the beans in a saucepan. Bring to gentle heat and simmer, stirring often, for 10 mins until the sauce thickens slightly. Cool slightly. Stir the herbs into the sauce. Place the remaining beans and half the parsley in a large bowl, toss and season. Remove the meat from the skewers and thread onto the stringy beans, alternately with the rest of the beans. Brush a little oil onto the griller pan – place the skewers over the griller and cook, turning, for 5 - 10 mins until crisp brown. Serve warm topped with the sauce.

title: Ginger Baked Rice
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 6 crushed juniper berries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f or 190°c. Mix the rice, juniper berries, and 4 cups hot water in a baking dish.

title: Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup bacon drippings | 1/2 cup water chestnut, sliced | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce or 2 tablespoons fresh basil
instructions: In a saucepan, stir together the oil and water chestnut, heat for 15 seconds. Remove from heat and stir in the pesto. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: red chile,worcestershire sauce,enchilada sauce,mint,beer,red wine,potato flake
title: Sweet Potato Chip-Shredded Hash Browns
ingredients: 4 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2 -inch cubes | 2 tablespoons red chile, chopped | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons dried mashed potato flakes | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup red wine | 1 tablespoon dried mint
instructions: Melt potatoes in microwave or oven. Add chilies, worcestershire sauce and potato flakes and stir fry for a minute or two. Add enchilada sauces and wine. Stir. Cook until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes. Add mint.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,granny smith apple,lentil,beef sirloin steak,fennel
title: Grilled Apple Lentil Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 4 teaspoons ground fennel | 6 mint leaves | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 tablespoons dried lentils
instructions: In a bowl, mix beef with fennel. Thread 1 mint leaf, apple, and 1 tablespoon of lentils onto skewers. Arrange on a plate or tray and allow guests to add skewered meat to bowls for an additional fun touch.

Random Ingredients: white bread,balsamic vinegar,salt pepper,key lime,vanilla soymilk,flour,romano cheese,oatmeal
title: Baked French Toast With Key Lime Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole meal ( i use soymilk ) | 1 tablespoon butter ( one cut in half and one halved or quartered ) | 2 tablespoons flour ( i used gluten free flour ) | 4 slices day-old white bread, cut into 1/8 inch slices ( use 3 slices each for 3 people, i used gluten-free bread ) | 1 cup whole-egg soymilk ( i used soy milk ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon vanilla-flavored soymilk ( i used milk ) | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese or 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix the meal with the butter and flour in a wide mouth bowl. Cut the slices of bread in half, then in half again, to create a 2 inch width spread. Dip each slice of bread, in the flour mixture, into the bread, being careful not to soak off excess mixture. Arrange the slices in a single layer, in a single layer not overlapping. Place in a well sprayed 13x9 baking pan and bake for 15 minutes, remove and sprinkle with grated romano or parmesan cheese and the juice from the 1/4 cup soymilk. Return to the oven and bake for another 15 minutes, remove and check to see if it is done by making a toothpick or knife poke in the middle of the french toast to make a slight dent.

title: K-Jon's Australian Beef Roulades
ingredients: 3 lbs round steaks, with fat and sinew | 1 can condensed beef consomme | 1/2 cup currants | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup frozen lemonade ( not the concentrated kind ) | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 cups cooked quinoa
instructions: Combine the soups ingredients and mix well. Cut the meat into strips about 1 inch thick. Place on a rack in a roasting pan. Bake at 425°f for about 30 minutes, or until meat is browned on the outside. Turn strips often while roasting, so beef is done at one time.

title: Witlof Spinach
ingredients: 10 lbs baby spinach | 1/4 - 1/3 cup bacon drippings ( good quality, you can add more if needed ) | 3 teaspoons sage
instructions: Wash the spinach well, remove thick stems just slightly. In a dutch oven or large pot, on medium low heat, melt bacon drippings. You can add a little water, just to cover the bottom a little. Put in a handfuls of spinach, squeeze a handful to release excess water and add. When the greens are wilted, remove, drain any excess liquid with your hands, then add to the bacon drippings, stirring often. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, or until the spinach seems to just be starting to wilt but not brown. Add the sage. Cook until the spinach becomes limp, stirring occasionally.

title: Chutney and Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup chutney | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 1/2 cup bomba beans | 1 cup arborio rice | 1/2 teaspoon tomato paste
instructions: Put all ingredients in one container in the order listed. You can also use an instant read thermometer to measure and adjust the amount of liquid as desired.

title: Halloween Apricot Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cooked chicken meat | 1 can crab, drained | 1 can apricot preserves | 1 jar dates, drained | 4 tablespoons strong coffee
instructions: In a large bowl put the chicken, crab, apricot preserves mix well, and add one can of water. Stir and leave for at least an hour at room temperature. The more you eat the lettuce the softer it will be. Serve in a small dish or casserole dish, topped with the crushed dates.

title: Simmered Fish
ingredients: 1 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1 cup molasses | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon ground mixed spice ( cumin, paprika, sage, bay ) | 1 pound catfish, cut into chunks
instructions: Mix ranch dressing mix, molasses, cardamom, nutmeg, mixed spice, and catfish.

title: Kofte
ingredients: 2 cups matzo meal | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon coriander powder | pepper sauce | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs ( i like cornbread ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Mix dry ingredients.

title: Garnish and Chips (Churichuelos De Alentejas)
ingredients: 1/2 lb plantain, peeled ( about 4 medium-sized plantains, about 4 cups ) | 6 tablespoons green chilies | 2 tablespoons minced fresh dill leaves | 1/2 lb carrot ( about 3 cups ) | 1/2 cup good quality chili oil
instructions: Cut the plantains into chips about 2 inches in square, cutting them into 1/2 inch dice. Place chips in a bowl with cold water to cover. Place a plate over the bowl, then put the bowl in the refrigerator to chill while preparing and shaping chips. Chop the chilies in a grinder along with the dill and carrot. Place the chili oil in a deep skillet, set over medium heat. When hot but not smoking, add the chips in a single layer, stirring constantly until they crackle and change color about 1 minute per side. Drain the fried chips in a colander set over a rimmed plate. Pour excess oil off of the chilies. Fry the chips in small batches, stirring constantly, until golden brown and crispy on the outside but still soft enough to break when tested with a wooden spoon, about 2 minutes per side. Drain the fried chips on a linen towel lined plate or paper towels, then season with salt. Serve with hot spicy chunky salsa and a light squeeze of lime or lemon juice.

title: Baked Beans With Sweet Rice (Opor Ayam)
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 3 3 tablespoons olive or 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 packet chipotle powder adobo seasoning or 1 packet minced adobo seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/4 cup chopped fresh blueberries, thawed if frozen
instructions: Saute rice until translucent and opaque. Stir in oil and spices. Spread on a large baking pan, cover and bake at 300°f for 25 minutes. Stir halfway through. Spread frozen blueberries over the rice and bake covered until crisp, about 10 minutes, stirring once.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,graham cracker,bailey irish cream,vanilla extract,asparagus spear,extra tofu,soy sauce
title: Asparagus and Cashew Cracker Bark
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 2 asparagus spears, trimmed | 1 container extra-firm tofu, drained | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup baileys irish cream | 6 graham crackers ( or other baking crackers ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat the grill pan or a fryer. In a small bowl, toss the asparagus spears with the sesame oil. Set aside while you finish the grilling. Brush the asparagus with the sesame oil and grill until crisp tender, about 2 minutes per side. Drain well on paper towels. Cut the asparagus into bite size pieces. Spread the tofu on a large plate. Place the asparagus in a large bowl. Make sure it is cut into bite sized pieces. Stir the soy sauce, baileys and vanilla in a small bowl. Stir in the asparagus and tofu. Pour over the tofu and serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: brandy,thyme leave,raspberry,clove,turnip,stew meat,quaker oatmeal square cereal,linguine
title: St. Patrick's Day Oatmeal Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1/2 cup brandy | 1 package frozen raspberries | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 2 tablespoons old quaker oatmeal squares cereal | 12 ounces linguine ( uncooked )
instructions: Cut stew meat into 1 inch cubes.

title: Bourishes
ingredients: 2 large beetroots ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/2 lb good quality pepperoni | 3 tablespoons sea salt | 3 tablespoons sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed ( lightly roasted and ground very fine ) | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 3 cups flour | 3/4 lb fresh black olives, pitted | 2 large pinches coarsely ground raw peanuts
instructions: Peel beetroots, leaving root ends intact. Cut root end in half and, in a single layer, cut about 3 or 4 1/4 inches away from bottom. Cut tops of beetroots lengthwise into 2 or 3 sections at a 45 degree angle. Cut peels crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips, removing hard core and stems or any tough sections from around the beets. Cut slices in half crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips. Place strips on dull, not black, baking pans and drizzle with 2 tablespoons of the salt. Place in the oven for 30 - 45 minutes until tops of beetroots begin to turn dark brown. Cool for 15 - 20 minutes. Cool, then peel and slice them thinly into 1/4 inch thick rounds. Put flour in a mound on a clean work surface. Create a well in the center of the flour, add 1 teaspoon salt or the lowest salt you can find. Form a well in the center and crack the anise seeds all around the well. Add the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt or the lowest salt you can find. Gradually work in the flour with a spatula or a wooden spoon. Put the pieces of peels in a cold bowl, add the pepperoni and toss to coat each slice. Spread the pepperoni thinly over the beets. Spread the pepperoni with your fingers, taking care to keep the strips at least ½ inch wide. Put the beetroot slices in a non stick skillet over medium heat until the slices have darkened in spots, about 10 - 15 minutes. Turn them over and brown them on the other side. They will turn a rich golden brown in color. Remove beets from skillet. Drain on a paper towel. Sprinkle with parsley and serve warm.

title: Mexican Cilantro Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained | 5 tablespoons fresh cilantro, divided | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons sunflower oil
instructions: Combine quinoa, 1 tablespoon of cilantro, vinegar, chili powder, and 1 tablespoon of the remaining cilantro into a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer over medium. Simmer until liquid is absorbed and quinoa is tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Using a slotted spoon, transfer quinoa to a large bowl. Add remaining 1 tablespoon cilantro and remaining 2 tablespoons cilantro plus water to pan. Shake pan to loosen quinoa. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff quinoa with a fork.

title: Roasted Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, cut at 4-6 inch intervals | 1 whole pimento
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lay flank steak on its side on the rack, fat side down. Drizzle pimentos evenly on the meat, leaving ¼ inch at the top of the flank steak and ½ inch at the bottom of the dish. Roast ½ hour or until tender, basting from time to time with juices. Let stand 10 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,coleslaw mix,beef broth,tomato,pineapple tidbit,yeast,cream
title: Crock Pot Beef Pizza With Adobo Sauce
ingredients: 2 packages dry yeast, divided | 1 can pineapple tidbits, undrained | 1 cup reduced-sodium beef broth | 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo, minced ( i use one chipotle chili and two adobo chilies ) | 1 1/2 lbs coleslaw mix | 1 tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Combine 1 package of yeast, the can of pineapple, beef broth and chipotle chile in the crock pot.

title: Easy French Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 package sugar snap peas | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Cut snap peas diagonally, then snap into bite size pieces. Place peas in a large salad bowl. In bowl, stir together mayonnaise, garlic powder and dill weed, and pour over the peas. Toss in croutons or vegetables. Chill for 30 minutes to 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,green grape,white onion,walnut,red chili powder,flat leaf parsley,tomato juice,pasilla chile
title: Parsley and Sun-Dried Tomato Enchiladas - Enchiladas Verdes
ingredients: 2 pasilla chiles, stemmed and seeded | 2 medium ripe tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 white onion, finely chopped | 1/3 cup walnuts, finely chopped | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, finely chopped | 1/3 cup green seedless grapes, halved | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons red chili powder | 8 tablespoons tomato juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Using a kitchen tongs, remove the seeds from the chiles and place in a blender. Add the remaining ingredients and blend until you have the desired consistency. Using a spoon, transfer the mixture to a bowl to marinate for at least 20 minutes and up to 1 day.

title: Homemade Tomato Marinade
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon hot paprika
instructions: In a small bowl, stir tomato puree and paprika together. Using a meat mallet, pound tomato puree to a thickness of 1/8 then add to tomato marinade.

title: Roasted Eggplant With Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 2 teaspoons dry basil, crushed | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/3 cup prepared hot sauce | 1 cup drained wild rice, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Place eggplant on a piece of foil or heavy duty aluminum foil. Spread mustard on eggplant, sprinkle with chives, basil, chile sauce and hot sauce, and top with rice. Place on center rack of oven, roast 15 minutes.

title: Kadai Aloo (Coconut Spice Paste)
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut oil | 1 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: Toast cumin and cayenne pepper on high for 1 - 2 minutes on medium heat. Cool the coconut oil slowly for a while. This will keep it from getting very hard. Grind the cumin with a mortar and pestle until it is a coarse paste. This does not have to be too dry, and can also be stored for upto 3 months in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,chipotle chile adobo,cardamom,green bell pepper,bay leaf,nutritional yeast,plain yogurt
title: Chili Raita
ingredients: 1/2 green bell pepper, seeded and sliced | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 bay leaf | 4 cardamoms | 1/3 cup nutritional yeast | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: Puree the peppers in a food processor or blender and set aside. Heat a skillet over medium heat until hot. Add the chipotles adobo and bay leaf and cook 30 seconds or so. Let them cook for 1 minute. Whisk in the soy yogurt and nutritional yeast.

title: Green Tea (Chai)
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped green onions | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 4 teaspoons orange blossom oil or 4 teaspoons orange juice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and process until combined. Cover and chill for a few hours or overnight.

title: Elderberry Cream Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 cups elderberry flowers, fresh with stalks | 4 ounces cream cheese spread, softened | 2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 5 medium oranges ( the peel only ) or 5 medium lemons ( the peel only )
instructions: Blend all the ingredients together until they resemble a smooth consistency, texture of your choice. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a week.

title: Broccoli in Cardamom Juice(Bhoon Sabzi)
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 inch piece ginger | 8 ounces brown sugar | 6 tablespoons grated fresh ginger
instructions: Wash the broccoli under running water. Cut the stem into 1/2 inch lengths. Place in a pot with the cardamom pods with half of the ginger. Add just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and simmer until the broth is reduced to 2 cups. Remove the cardamom pods before serving in small bowls. Add 1 tablespoon of the brown sugar to the broth before stirring. Heat in a small saucepan. Stir in the remaining ginger until fragrant. Pour the mixture over the hot broccoli and serve.

title: Gruyere and Grape Soup
ingredients: 2 bunches grapes, washed and stems left on | 4 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 cup white sugar | 5 ounces gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Place the grapes in a large saucepan over medium high heat. Pour in the stock and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the grapes are tender and beginning to split, 25 to 30 minutes. Place sugar in a small bowl, and stir 2 tablespoons of hot soup into it to dissolve it. Sprinkle half of the gruyere's over the cheese, and stir in the bowl of cheese. Simmer for 30 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: margarine,angel hair pasta,thyme,vegetable stock,coconut extract,chicken wing,comte cheese
title: Creamy Coconut Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 5 tablespoons margarine | 15 chicken wings, cleaned and trimmed | 1/3 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup grated comte cheese | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 3/4 cup angel hair pasta
instructions: Melt margarine in a heavy saucepan over medium heat. Add chicken and fry until well browned, 5 minutes per side. Transfer chicken to a bowl and set aside. Add broth, cheese, thyme and coconut extract to the pan drippings in the pan. Bring to a boil. While sauce simmers, cook pasta in a large pot of rapidly boiling water until al dente. Drain thoroughly. Return to the pot. Add the sauce to the pot and heat over medium heat until it's hot. Serve hot.

title: Candy Powder Baking
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons instant bouillon cubes or 1 teaspoon instant bouillon cubes | 3 dashes allspice
instructions: Combine in a small bowl and mix well. Store in an airtight container.

title: Chef John's Sausage, Corn and Kielbasa Baked in the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 2 cans sweet white corn, drained | 2 packages frozen white corn, thawed | 2 cans black coffee, chilled and coarsely ground | 15 large mint sprigs | 1 1/2 cups milk | 8 mint sprigs for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the slow cooker on a sturdy cutting board set to low. Lay the kielbasa slices on cutting board, and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Place the sweet white corn in the bottom of the slow cooker. Pile the yellow corn over the corn. In a bowl, mix the crème brulee, ground black coffee, and half of the mint sprigs. Spoon half of the coffee mixture over the corn. Sprinkle the kielbasa slices on top of the corn. Repeat with the white corn, black coffee mixture, and mint sprigs. Pour the milk over the sausage. Cover the slow cooker, and set the cooker to low. Cook until the kielbasa is thoroughly cooked and the corn mixture has warmed through, about 3 1/2 hours. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: coffee granule,chuck steak,chicken bouillon,celery leaf,vegetable broth,sun tomato oil
title: Braised Beef & Onions
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules | 1 tablespoon dried celery leaves | 4 tablespoons hot chicken broth | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil, garlic & oregano, undrained | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 4 chuck steaks, trimmed
instructions: In dutch oven or other large deep skillet, mix all ingredients except steaks. Cover.

title: Homemade Chipotle Chowder(Puerto Rico)
ingredients: 1 potato, peeled | 2 tablespoons ground chipotle powder
