instructions: Using a sharp knife, peel potato and cut in medium dice. Heat a large, non stick skillet over medium heat. Add potato cubes and season with ground chipotle powder. Stir to combine. When potatoes are soft, add water and simmer, about 10 minutes. Serve hot, or keep warm until ready to serve.

title: Lazy Cabbage and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 8 ounces dried sauerkraut | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 bunch thai basil, finely chopped | 2 dates, pitted and chopped
instructions: Cook the sauerkraut according to package directions. Drain, reserving some of the liquid. Press the sauerkraut through a strainer, discarding 1/3c of the liquid it has collected. Add the tomatoes with liquid and 1 1/2c water. Cook, stirring, over medium heat for 20 minutes. Add the basil.

title: Hot Hot Coffee
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces colavita-infused coffee ( such as horlicks or ibarra ) | 2 -3 habanero peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 ounces vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon finely chopped cornichon | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 4 sprigs thyme
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a coffee mug or plunger, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: olive,baby corn,salt black pepper,pineapple chunk,red pepper,phyllo pastry,green cabbage,wheat wrap
title: Sweet Corn Salad Wraps
ingredients: 1 can whole baby corn, drained and finely chopped | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained and juice reserved | 1/2 cup chopped green cabbage | 1/2 cup chopped red peppers | 3/4 cup chopped fresh olives | 1/4 cup chopped fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 cup chopped phyllo pastry sheets | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Mix together baby corn, pineapple chunks, cabbage, red peppers, olives, spinach, and phyllo pastry in a large bowl. Toss with reserved pineapple juice to coat the salad.

title: Soy Batter Fried Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1 1/2 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 300 g fresh button mushrooms, sliced | 3/4 cup black olives | 2 tablespoons chopped beet ( optional )
instructions: Mix the sugar, rice flour and olives and mix well. Put the beets on to fry pan and fry in medium heat over medium high heat. When beets are starting to turn golden, pour in the soy mixture. The beets will absorb this mix well. When they are cooked about 5 minutes, stir beets so beets are coated evenly with the soy. Enjoy.

title: Portuguese Anticuchos (Spicey Potato Candy)
ingredients: 5 lbs potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 1 large sweet potato, peeled and diced or 1 small sweet potato, peeled and diced | 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 bottle dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large bowl toss potatoes with the peppers and tomatoes. Drain excess water and pour into a roasting pan. Add rum to the tomatoes. Sprinkle evenly over the potatoes. Cover and bake potatoes for 1 hour. Remove cover and bake another 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool approximately 4 hours before serving.

title: Spicy Corn
ingredients: 1 dried poblano chile | watercress | 10 stalks lemongrass, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 3 1/2 cups dry pinto beans, cooked and drained | 1 jar picante sauce, divided
instructions: Cut chile in half and remove seeds and veins. Remove seeds and veins and chop. Combine chile with other ingredients in medium saucepan. Bring to boil on medium high heat stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes, covered. Stir in remaining ingredients, reserving 1/2 cup picante sauce if desired. Simmer uncovered until flavors blend and beans are tender.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,wheat flour,bread flour,deli ham,raspberry,cumin powder
title: Roast Ham & Raspberry Bites
ingredients: 10 slices deli ham | 10 raspberries | 1 teaspoon bread flour | 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 dash ground red chili pepper
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Spread out half the ham on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Spread each slice with a thin layer of the flaked bread flour. Then scatter the raspberries over the ham. Combine the bread flour, cumin and red chili powder. Gently spread this mixture over this layer of ham. Sprinkle the remaining ham with the remaining flakes of bread flour. Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until cooked, and dry. Allow to cool completely. Slice into 16 rounds using a sharp knife.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,allspice,peanut butter,pumpkin puree
title: Chilli Peanut Butter Dipping Sauce for Seafood
ingredients: 2 ounces light peanut butter | 1 1/2 tablespoons red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon red allspice | 1 teaspoon allspice, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and process until smooth. Serve with vegetables for fish, chicken or pork.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,napa cabbage,part ricotta cheese,sirloin,hot water,sultana
title: Easy Philly-Style Sirloin Lasagna - Ww
ingredients: 1/2 package crumbled feta cheese | 2 lbs sirloin, trimmed of fat, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 cups hot water or 2 cups beef broth | 1 container part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 cup shredded napa cabbage | 1/2 cup sultana, seeds and tender stems removed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. In a large mixing bowl, stir together the feta cheese and the next five ingredients with a fork till well mixed. Spread 1/3 of the cheese mixture on the bottom of a large baking sheet lined with parchment. Layer 1/3 of the sirloin pieces, followed by 1/3 of the cabbage, then 1/3 of the sultanas, then final cheese mixture, and cover with 1/3 more cheese mixture. Cover and top with parchment. Bake for 45 minutes or till bubbly and golden on top. Let sit for 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Honey Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cilantro | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, chopped, about 20 c. ( or 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, or 1 tablespoon of fresh basil )
instructions: Combine all ingredients well and shake well. Refrigerate well covered until serving time. This dressing makes about 2 servings.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,gouda cheese,rosemary,yeast,eggplant,russet potato,chocolate cake,sirloin steak
title: Beef and Vegetables With Chocolate-Yipped Bread
ingredients: 3 cups medium-grind chocolate cake | 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( sambal oelek ) | 1/2 lb julienned fresh ginger root into thin strips | 2 lbs peeled russet potatoes | 2 cups peeled medium eggplants | 1 cup thinly sliced and toasted ghurtic gluten free crumb ( such as bob's red mill ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degree. Spray an 8 x 4 inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray. In bowl, combine chocolate and yeast. Let stand till lukewarm. Toss beef with chili paste. Arrange beef, potatoes, eggplant, and chile paste on oiled pan. Arrange crumbs over top of beef. Cover. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or till golden and cooked through. Top with gouda cheese slices.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,white flour,ancho chile powder,taco seasoning
title: Patamidis
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes | 1/4 ounce taco seasoning | 1/4 ounce ancho chile powder | 3 1/2 - 4 cups unbleached white flour
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Rinse with cold water and let drain for 20 minutes. Place potatoes in a large pot with water to cover. Bring to a boil. Cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender but not mushy. Drain. Add taco seasoning and ancho powder to the potato mixture. Turn off heat. When finished, mash potatoes well by hand until thoroughly mixed and smooth. Stir in 1/4 to 1/2 cup flour. Add water if necessary. Turn dough onto a floured board and let rest for 5 minutes. Divide dough into 8 portions. For each portion, divide dough into 8 even pieces about 12 inches long, and about 2 inches wide. Form each of the 8 portions into a flattened ball. Place half of the balls on greased paper lined baking sheet. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes. Bake each patty in a preheated 400f oven until light brown, about 30 minutes. Cut dough into 2 parts. Roll each piece into a long cylinder and then press both pieces of dough together in a rolling pin until well mixed. Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake in preheated 400f oven for 15 to 20 minutes until crispy and golden brown. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,asian sesame oil,basmati rice,banana pepper,red potato,cornflour
title: Banana and Rice Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 2 large red potatoes, cut into 3cm dice | 2 medium banana peppers, deseeded and cut into 3cm dice | 1 jar sweet pimientos, drained and cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon light sesame oil
instructions: Place rice and 1 cup water in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, or until liquid has been absorbed. Set aside. Meanwhile, place potatoes and peppers in a large steamer over just boiling water. Cover and cook for 15 minutes, or until tender. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup cooking liquid. Toss potato and pepper in 1 tablespoon of cornflour, then set aside. Heat sesame oil in a large nonstick frypan over high heat, add the sweet prawns and cook for 2 minutes or until just cooked and golden. Add sweet pepper, reserved potato cooking liquid, rice and peppers, stir to combine. Serve with plain yoghurt for a complete main dish.

title: Auld Alliance: French Flank Steak With Mustard Beer and Herbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs flank steaks, fat cap on | 4 teaspoons tarragon leaves, chopped | 4 teaspoons havarti cheese, finely grated | 8 fluid ounces beer ( such as smithwick sauerkraut )
instructions: Sprinkle the steak w/the tarragon leaves and grated cheese on both sides. Brown the steak well on both sides in a frying pan, then set aside in a warm place to rest. Return the pan to the heat, adding water to nearly cover the meat. Return to the stove to reduce the beer, but do not allow to come to as full of any liquid. Cover and simmer gently for 1 hr or until the meat is tender. Add the herbs and serve at once. Goes good with noodles or mashed potatoes, on rye or potato wedges or as a side dish.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,squash,sausage meat,navel orange,half,orange,potato starch,russet potato
title: Sweet and Sour Pumpkin Sausages
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked sausage meat | 5 medium russet potatoes, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick | 2 oranges | 2 small navel oranges | 1 tablespoon cream mixed with | 1 tablespoon rum or 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 1 tablespoon potato starch or 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: In a large skillet, grill the sausage over medium heat until it is a bit black on the outside. Remove the sausage from the skillet and cut in 1/2 inch slices. Sprinkle the sausage with salt.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,curry leaf,pepperoni,grain white rice,chicken bouillon cube,white onion,creamy peanut butter
title: Peanut Butter Rice Ball (Peanut Stew)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice, uncooked | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 white onion ( sliced ) | 1 curry leaf | 10 ounces creamy peanut butter | fresh ground pepperoni | dark rum
instructions: Dissolve bouillon cube in rice and add onion, curry leaf, peanut butter and rum. Mix well and serve with toothpicks or roll into small balls of desired size.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,porcini mushroom,wheat flour,fenugreek leaf,salt black pepper,hard egg
title: Persian Pharanja
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups raw porcini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek leaves ( can be bought at any indian grocery store ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt and black pepper, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 hard-boiled egg
instructions: Place the mushrooms in a colander or sieve set over a bowl, then pour boiling water over the mushrooms to cover. Set aside for 20 minutes. Drain well, then discard the liquid. Rinse and dry, then finely chop. Sprinkle mushrooms with fenugreek leaves. Stir the flour, salt, pepper, and turmeric into the mushroom liquid until no lumps of flour remain. Gradually stir in the soaked mushrooms until the mixture is just right. Transfer the mixture to a piping bag fitted with a large star tip. Cut the egg into 6 wedges. Stuff the turmeric coated slices with the egg wedges and seal tightly. Tie the Pharanja with string in a piece of kitchen twine. Refrigerate for 3 days before using, then serve in a soup bowl.

title: Fish Filets in Pizzas
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes | 1/3 cup semolina flour | 1/4 cup sifted molasses flour | 4 fish fillets | oil ( for shallow frying )
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into 1/4 inch diagonal slices. Using a large skillet, brown potatoes in hot oil.

title: Carrots and Glaze
ingredients: 2 large carrots, peeled & sliced | 1 tablespoon orange-flavored liqueur
instructions: Slice carrots in half diagonally. Bring a kettle of water to a boil over high heat, add carrots & boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat when carrots are just tender but still fork tender drain them & return them to the pan. Add orange liqueur & stir well. Pour carrots into a lightly buttered shallow baking dish. Turn several times while still warm, drizzle with glaze & bake at 375 f for 10 - 15 minutes or until glaze is bubbly & crisp.

title: Mama’s Amazing Caesar-Horseradish Lamb Pizzas
ingredients: 1 package ground lamb or ( 1 g ) package ground beef | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup natural bran | 1/2 cup light sour cream ( sour cream is the best ) | 1/4 cup tequila ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 4 tablespoons italian spices | 1 teaspoon coarsely crushed italian spices | 1 can chickpeas, well drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place rack in middle of oven. Brush panko evenly over bottom and sides of 13 x9 x2 pan. Place meat in a shallow bowl. Mix pitos and bran in a second shallow bowl. Drain chickpeas. In a 3 gallon glass measure, add all ingredients, shake to combine. Evenly distribute the meat among the panko pitos and smooth the top. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until crumbs are a few shades darker and beginning to crisp and brown.

title: Mango Gravy for Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb mango, peeled and chopped | 2 cups beef stock | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Combine the mango and beef stock in saucepan and bring to a boil. Stir in the italian seasoning and reduce heat. Simmer covered for 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Cover sauce pan and allow to stand for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,red chile pepper,fennel,kaffir lime leaf,canadian bacon,spinach leaf,chayotes
title: Spinach Salad With Chayote and Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 1 can chayotes, sliced into 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 cup chopped fennel | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 kaffir lime leaves | 1/4 large red chile pepper, sliced | 2 slices canadian bacon, chopped | 10 fresh spinach leaves
instructions: In a bowl, combine chayote, fennel, taco seasoning, and lime leaves, and mix well. Layer half of the chayote mixture over the spinach in the serving dish, and top with the remaining chayote mixture. Sprinkle with red chile and dot with canadian bacon. Serve warm.

title: Horseradish Barley and Barley Risotto
ingredients: 3 cups pearl barley, such as pearl barley, about 2 1/4 pounds ( can sub 1/4 pound barley for a variation ) | 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped fresh horseradish ( see note below for instructions ) | 1 fresh lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Rinse and dry the barley. Place barley in a medium saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat and simmer, uncovered, until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Drain well and repeat 3 more times. Meanwhile, in a small heatproof bowl combine horseradish, lemon juice and zest. Place rice in bowls and pour over horseradish mixture. Using a slotted spoon, divide evenly among bowls. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,albacore tuna,rye bread,lime juice,bamboo shoot,fish sauce,vegetable broth
title: Grilled Tuna Crock Pot With Albacore and Lime Relish
ingredients: 2 cans albacore tuna | 1 package frozen peas and carrots | 2 cans vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 loaf rye bread ( sliced in half ) or 1 loaf white crusty bread ( sliced in half )
instructions: Place tuna in bottom of slow cooker. Thaw peas and carrots at room temperature. Combine broth, lime juice, fish sauce and tartar in a medium bowl and stir well. Pour over tuna, being careful not to dislodge the bread from the meat. Cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours or on high for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Serve tuna and veggies in a shallow bowl with warmed rye crock pot slices for dipping.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,red burgundy wine,chipotle chile adobo,mustard seed
title: Burgundy Bites
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry mustard seeds | 12 whole chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 cup dry red burgundy wine | 10 sheets frozen puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Stir mustard seeds and chiles in a small skillet over medium heat until dry and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Remove chili mixture from heat and set aside to cool. Pour wine into a baking dish. Arrange pastry sheets over wine, then brush with mustard seed mixture. Bake until cheese is melted, about 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,white pepper,butter,lime juice zest,mustard seed,cranberry juice cocktail,red chili pepper,caraway
title: Cha Cha Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup dry cranberry juice cocktail | 1 tablespoon lime juice, fresh | 1 1/2 tablespoons caraway | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds, lightly crushed | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper ( seeded & chopped ) | 3/4 cup butter | 1 cup cilantro leaf, fresh & coarsely chopped | white pepper
instructions: In a small bowl combine cranberry juice cocktail, lime juice, caraway, mustard seeds & chili pepper.

title: Dixie Dust Bread
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1 cup bread flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 5 -10 slices bread, buttered and floured
instructions: Sift together 2 cups flour and creole seasoning. Add remaining 2 cups of flour and blend well before adding remaining dry ingredients. Turn out onto lightly floured surface and knead 8 - 10 times. Pat out mixture until almost 1/8 inch thick. Fold the butter and dough to about 1/8 inch thick. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Press edges to seal. Spread evenly with butter mixture evenly. Sprinkle with remaining 1 1/2 tbsp sugar. Bake in 375f degree oven until golden, about 40 minutes. Remove from baking sheet and allow to cool for 5 - 10 minutes. If necessary, cut into bars to serve.

title: Lentils for a Crowd
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, diced | 1 1/2 cups lentils, dried
instructions: Boil and dice potatoes. Cook the lentils, drain. Add potatoes to the lentils. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer about 40 minutes until potatoes are soft.

title: Homemade Diced Fennel Scented Vegetables
ingredients: 1 kg chopped mixed dried vegetables | 2 tablespoons onions seeds
instructions: Place mixed vegetables and onions in a large bowl. Stir in the grinder/coffee and knead. Place on absorbent paper lined trays. Refrigerate until required.

title: Tomato and Mace Meat Sauce
ingredients: 500 g fresh lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 liters stock | 400 -500 g tomato ketchup | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: Soak the lasagna noodles in very hot water for 20 minutes. Drain the water and cook the noodles in boiling, salted water for 20 - 25 minutes until just starting to become tender and drain again. Combine all remaining ingredients in a small saucepan over a low heat and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,monterey jack cheese,spanish rice mix,cream sherry,green cabbage,garlic paste,dark brown sugar,steak
title: Crock Pot Spanish Steak (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, tips removed | 2 bags coleslaw mix | 1 head green cabbage, coarsely shredded | 1 jar dark brown sugar, packed, drained ( i like golden ) | 1/2 cup cream sherry or 1/2 cup cooking sherry | 3 tablespoons garlic paste ( i like minced garlic ) | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese ( i like marble )
instructions: Poke holes all over the steak with a fork. Place steak in the crock pot. In a bowl, combine coleslaw mix, cabbage, brown sugar, sherry, garlic paste, and almond extract. Pour over steak and cover.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,bean,vodka,beef shank,white pepper,red tomato,rice wine vinegar,ancho chile powder
title: Portuguese Beef Stock
ingredients: 3 ounces ground ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn | 1 beef shank | 6 cups beef stock or 6 cups beef bouillon | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup un-roasted rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1/4 cup cooked beans
instructions: The beef shank can be removed as is or shaved for a richer flavor. Remove any excess fat or undesirable bone or skin from a meat that has been sliced thinly. Brown on all sides under the broiler. Once the beef shank is browned remove it temporarily, or let it cool for a few minutes so that it can sweat out any extra oil. Place the meat and accumulated juices into a large stockpot. Add the ancho, black pepper, white pepper, peppercorns, beef stock or bouillon, rice wine vinegar, and rum. Heat until it begins to boil then reduce to medium low while you simmer. Simmer the stock for around 2 hours, until the beef is cooked. Check the liquid.

title: Charcoal Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups flour | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce ( can use dark sesame paste if a sweeter flavour is desired )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c and line 2 flat baking trays with baking paper. Sift the flour, bicarbonate of soda and sunflower oil into a bowl. Add the soy sauce and mix well, then hand mix into the dry ingredients with a large metal spoon. If the dough seems dry, add more flour and a little more water. You can also work the dough with your hands and knead the bits of dry ingredients together. Form into smooth, round shapes, about 12cm in diameter. Place on the prepared trays, cut side down with a floured knife. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes, or until the top has a firm, even surface and has browned a bit. Allow to cool on the baking trays. Cool slightly before removing to cool completely. Store in an airtight glass container.

title: Italian Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat milk, low fat ok to use less sodium ( or more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons nonfat dry milk | 1/4 cup half-and-half ( half and half is ok too ) | fresh italian parsley ( for garnish ) ( optional ) | sea salt or kosher salt, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place nonfat milk and half and half in a small pot. Bring to a boil using the whisk attachment to the pot, and heat on the stove until warmed, but not boiling. Add 1/4 cup or more of the warmed milk for a more milky texture. Pour into a serving bowl. Top with fresh chopped parsley. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,balsamic vinegar,paprika,mango chutney,coriander sprig,cooking oil,palm sugar
title: Malaysian Fried Onions
ingredients: 4 large onions, sliced fairly thin ( about 3 1/2 ounces ) | 1/2 teaspoon paprika ( sweet hungarian ) | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander sprig ( cilantro ) | 1/8 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 cup palm sugar or 1 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup cooking oil
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup sugar in saucepan and brown onions 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove and set aside. Add remaining sugar to remaining 1/4 cup sugar. Heat the oil in the pan & add onions, cinnamon, coriander & paprika sprigs. Saute, covered, over moderately high heat for about 10 minutes until onions are caramelized and syrupy. Stir frequently & transfer contents of pan into a shallow dish & keep warm. Sprinkle onions with remaining spice & set aside. Heat oil in frying pan and fry onions 10 minutes, or until golden brown & crisp. Keep warm. Serve on warm plates.

title: Gramma's Cauliflower Pasta Dish
ingredients: 1 cauliflower floret | 200 g goat cheese | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 150 g feta cheese | 1/2 lemon, juiced | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 teaspoons dry felafel tablets or 2 teaspoons dried coriander powder
instructions: Steam the cauliflower with a little butter on low heat in a covered pan for 15 minutes, or until soft and tender. While the cauliflower cooks, cut the goat cheese into medium sized chunks and grate the cheese until smooth. When the cauliflower is done steaming and cool, peel the head and cut it into slices/moosed bite size pieces. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Bake cauliflower in a uncovered oven dish or to your liking. While cauliflower is cooling, combine the goat cheese with the buttermilk. Stir until the cheese has melted. Add the drained cauliflower, feta, lemon juice, coriander powder and felafel tablets/coriander powder. Stir and place in the oven for 15 minutes before serving. This dish may also be served with a salad.

title: Fruity Curried Onions
ingredients: 4 large onions | 2 teaspoons curry leaves | pistachios ( optional )
instructions: Slightly trim and slice onions, approximately 1 1/2 inches slices. Fry in a wok on medium heat until brown and soft. Set aside on paper towel. Once onions are dry, add curry leaves stirring until fragrant and fragrant. Add onions, toss to coat and coat well. Serve at once, garnished with finely chopped pistachios if desired.

title: Simple Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked brown lentils, rinsed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 cup crispy rice noodles | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Place the cooked lentils, parsley and rice noodles, mustard and sour cream in a salad bowl, and toss to evenly mix. Stir together the chicken bouillon and the 1 tsp. Mustard, and pour over the salad. Just before serving, stir gently, and sprinkle the top with the crumbled cheese of choice.

title: Black Beans in Syrup
ingredients: 1 can black beans | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup green onion | 1/2 teaspoon thyme ( optional )
instructions: Drain and rinse the beans and put in a large pot. Put in the ginger garlic paste and green onions. Turn heat low and let simmer for 2 hours. Add the thyme. Allow to simmer another 1 1/2 hours. You can serve over steamed rice.

title: Beets and Leeks for a Tasty Vegetable!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweet plum sauce | 1 can baked beans | 1 small beet, cut into wedges | 1 large leek, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/fan 160c/gas tip the plum sauce into a roasting tin and scatter over the baked beans. Arrange the beet wedges over the beans and pile the leeks over. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes until softened. Serve with a green salad and a crusty bread to mop up the juice.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 6 ounces cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Mix everything except oil and vinegar. Add more vinegar until you have a nice creamy dressing consistency or consistency you like.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,curry paste,hoagie,lemon extract,ice cube,green chile pepper
title: Green Chile Shredded Four-Leaf
ingredients: 8 lemons, zest of | 1/2 cup fresh green chile peppers | 16 hoagie rolls | 8 cups ice cubes | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: In a blender, combine the lemon zest, green chilies, and 4 cups of the ice with the curry paste. Blend until the mixture begins to thicken. Divide the mixture between the 4 rolls, topping with remaining ice. Wrap each sandwich and freeze. To serve, remove the wrap and place on a plate, top with a chunk of cheese and green chile peppers.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,asparagus spear,mussel,curry powder,cake flour,broccoli floret,cumin,yellow mustard
title: Curry Mussels
ingredients: 1 kg mussels | 1/2 kg cauliflower ( i prefer the type with yellow bulbs but you can use regular asparagus if you prefer ) | 1/2 kg broccoli floret | 4 large yellow mustard rolls | 1/2 cup curry powder ( i prefer sharwood's curry powder which are made by keens, but you can try any curry powder you like ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 2 teaspoons yellow mustard | 1 kg cake flour
instructions: First put the mussels in the pot, put the lid on and turn on the gas. When it dies, remove and throw away the clove of beak, discard if they are already closed. After all the mussels and the cauliflower are cooked remove the top shell of the mussels and then remove the shells, discard any that haven't closed. If you left the mussel on top of it, remove it now, then. If you left it on top of everything, take some time before the mussels. If using cabbage, cut up the small cabbage pieces into 2cm wide pieces. Add the mustard to the broth, boil until it starts to boil. Remove from heat and add to the soup the curry powder, the turmeric, cumin, mustard and mix into the soup. Now add the cauliflower and broccoli. Now you need to make a batter out of the cake flour. I mix it together, then then i add in little quantities of the soup, then i put a bit of the potato flour on top of that and mix together. It should look like a rough paste, similar to breadcrumbs in consistency. Put into a deep casserole type serving dish.. Now cook in 180c or 400f oven for 30 - 40 minutes until it is golden brown.

title: Green Olives
ingredients: 8 ounces small green olives ( i use jarred ) | 1 tablespoon dried currants
instructions: Rinse your olives under running water and place them in a bowl with currants. Stir until they are completely covered. Allow to sit at room temperature covered with an inverted dish towel until they darken in color. This should take between 10 - 20 mintues.

title: Tommy's Tequila
ingredients: 1/2 cup tequila | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Take a shaker and fill with ice. Place in freezer for one hour. Take out and set aside. Remove from freezer. Shake the bottle at least 2 times so the mixture will freeze. Mix the tomato puree and tequila with 2 cups cold water until the consistency of heavy cream. Strain into a freezer proof container. Freeze for another 2 hours. Serve over crushed ice.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,corn kernel,cucumber,ro tel tomato,heavy whipping cream,cauliflower floret,chicken stock cube,tarragon vinegar
title: Cauliflower Tarragon
ingredients: 1 bunch cauliflower floret | 1/2 cucumber, peeled | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh tarragon vinegar | 1 tablespoon corn kernels | 100 g thinly sliced provolone cheese | 1 small tomatoes
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil, then plunge in the cauliflower and turn off heat as soon as the water boils. Remove the inner core from the cauliflower and chop into small pieces. Peel the cucumber and cut into small pieces. Heat the cream in a small pan until a little bit of cream dropped in turns color. Dissolve the chicken stock cube in half the cream to make a smooth liquid. Drain some of the water from the cauliflower. Combine the drained cauliflower and all the other ingredients except the provolone cheese, tomato and the remaining cream. Stir over a medium heat until heated thoroughly. Grate the provolone cheese onto top, and serve it immediately.

title: Moroccan Green Olive Lentil Soup
ingredients: 10 ounces green olives, pitted | 9 cups water or 9 cups stock | 1/8 teaspoon gluten ( optional )
instructions: Remove the outer layer of the green olives from the olives. Place the olives in a saucepan or pot, add enough water to cover. Bring ingredients to boil. Reduce heat to med low. Simmer for at least 30 minutes. Strain the lentils. Put the lentils back into the pot and repeat simmering so the stock is absorbed. Continue cooking over medium low heat for another 30 minutes or until the lentils are tender but firm. Add the gluten if using, stirring well. Variation, sometimes i add finely chopped cilantro and sliced pimento pepper.

title: Curried Lentils
ingredients: 2 cups canned lentils | 2 lbs beef chuck | 24 ounces marinated artichoke hearts, drained and diced | 2 large eggs | 1 cup curry
instructions: Place lentils in a food processor, and process into a thick paste with the chuck. Cut meat into small cubes. Drain artichokes and set aside. Mix meat, lentils and artichokes with eggs in a large bowl. Pour mixture into a crockpot and cook on high for 5 hours. Season with curry before serving.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,feta cheese,double cream,aluminum foil,horseradish,italian cheese,beef chuck roast,breadcrumb
title: Beef & Artichoke Horseradish Stuffed Roast
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast ( about 1lb ) | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 tablespoons double cream | 2 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 3 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese | 1 teaspoon italian cheese blend
instructions: Brush roast with horseradish. Place in a lightly greased 15x10x1 inch pan. In a small bowl, combine cream, bread crumbs, horseradish, and artichokes. Spread over roast. Sprinkle feta and italian cheese over top. Bake at 350 degrees f until heated through and tender.

title: Salmon on the Hole #RSC
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh ground smoked salmon | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon tahini | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a small container mix the worcestershire sauce and tahini until well blended. Dip skin of fish in sauce, and carefully close with reynolds wrap. Place each fish on a foil lined nonstick cookie sheet and broil for 12 minutes until skin is browned and crisp and fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Kittencal's Sweet Potato and Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 6 sweet potatoes or 6 yam, halved and peeled | 5 tablespoons ground flax seeds | 4 cups cubed cooked chicken | 1/3 cup dried cranberries | 1/3 cup minced scallion | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place a layer of plastic wrap directly on top of the potatoes in a medium sized pot. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and then sprinkle with salt, pepper, and a bit of garlic. Layer the sliced sweet potatoes in this order, and then add the other 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Spread cranberries and chopped chicken on top with the skin side down, and then sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with additional plastic wrap and then add in the rest of the sweet potato and the scallions. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes, or until tender. In the meantime, combine saffron with poultry seasoning. This goes well with rice, barley, or potatoes.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,vegetable broth,port wine,manicotti,corn kernel,ladyfinger,hot dog,vegetable shortening
title: Manicotti Filling
ingredients: 18 dry manicotti | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 5 cups vegetable broth | 2 packages taco seasoning | 1 cup port wine | 1/2 cup sweet corn kernels | 6 hot dogs | 12 ladyfingers ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot, melt shortening and saute fennel for approximately 10 minutes. Brown fennel. Add broth.

title: Strawberry and Hominy Soup--Ww7
ingredients: 8 ounces strawberries | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 4 cups shredded green cabbage | 14 ounces hominy or 14 ounces pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon minced italian parsley
instructions: Core and cut berries in half.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,chili pepper,creole seasoning,ginger paste,shiitake mushroom,golden syrup,o'brien potato,maraschino cherry
title: Mushroom, Ginger & Shiitake Curry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 tablespoon creole-style seasoning | 2 teaspoons shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup golden syrup | 1 can coconut milk | 8 ounces o'brien frozen potatoes | 2/3 cup maraschino cherry ( optional ) | 1 canned chili pepper
instructions: In a small bowl, blend the ginger paste and creole seasoning. In a large saucepan, whisk the golden syrup& coconut milk. Add the blended coconut mixture. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Add the potatoes and maraschino& chilies.

title: White Bean & Dates
ingredients: 200 g fresh white beans | 150 g pitted dates, cut in half | 1 liter malibu flavored rum
instructions: Cook white beans in a large saucepan as per instructions on the package. If you are planning to serve this in a non metallic dish, bring a little boiling water to the pan to reduce the liquid further. Add dates, stir and allow flavours to amalgamate. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dashi,beef bouillon,golden syrup,tomato paste,link sausage,mango chutney,green taco sauce
title: Sweet Sausage Taco Meat With Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb sausage ( i use jimmy dean breakfast links ) | 1 can tomato paste | 1/2 cup dashi | 1/2 cup mango chutney or 1/2 cup chutney, of choice | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning or 2 tablespoons beef bouillon | 1 1/2 tablespoons maple syrup or 1 1/2 tablespoons light version sugar syrup | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon green taco sauce ( mild, medium or hot..etc. )
instructions: Brown the sausages for 5 minutes on med high, or until no longer pink, turning as needed. Drain the fat then crumble into a pot. Add tomato paste, soup/catsup, taco seasoning, mango chutney and rice syrup. Heat through for about 10 - 15 minutes, until chutney begins to bubble. Pour into bowls and serve with warm tortillas for dipping.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,green chile,arborio rice,prosciutto,flour tortilla,italian salad dressing,coriander powder,buttermilk
title: Fried Rice Wrapped Wraps With Prosciutto, Chiles and Italian Dressing
ingredients: vegetable oil or other neutral flavored shortening, divided | 8 ounces prosciutto | 4 flour tortillas, 10-inch | 1 cup freshly cooked arborio rice | 1 can diced green chiles, drained | 2 tablespoons fish sauce ( or vietnamese chili paste ) | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 cup buttermilk
instructions: Wrap pastry around each tortilla in small pieces of foil, and place on baking sheet with sides. Spray foil with cooking spray, place on top rack of grill over medium heat. Heat 4 inches of oil until shimmering. Remove tortillas from grill, and place on paper towel for 10 minutes. Rinse and drain pan, and return to hot pan. Add 1/4 cup water, chiles and fish sauce.

title: Stilton Linguine
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 1 jar pickled jalapeno chiles, sliced ( or 1 1/2 cups diced jalapenos ) | 1/2 cup sultana | 1 1/2 cups cracker crumbs | 3 ounces stilton cheese, grated
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain. Sauté sausage in 10 inch skillet, over medium high heat, about 3 minutes. Drain. Sauté chiles and sultanas in sausage drippings for 3 minutes. Remove from skillet, place in a bowl, cover, set aside. Mash chili mixture with a fork, but do not press. Add to linguine, mix well. Transfer to a greased 9 x 13 baking pan. Sprinkle with crackers and cheese. Bake in preheated oven 425°f for 15 to 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly and top is browned slightly.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,chicken,black eyed pea,coffee,ghee,worcestershire sauce,rose petal
title: Black-Eyed Peas With Chili Oil and Chicken
ingredients: 150 g chinese chinese black-eyed peas | 1 whole chickens | 1/2 teaspoon oil or 1/2 teaspoon ghee | 1 teaspoon chili oil or 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon coffee | 1 rose petal, sliced diagonally | 1 tablespoon ground coffee
instructions: Boil the black eyed peas with a teaspoon of salt added until the skin blisters and turns black on back up. Turn the peas over until they are cool enough to handle, remove any remaining skin. This step is crucial to reduce the bitterness of black eyed peas as it stainsively adheres to the skin. Once the peas are cool enough to handle, remove the hard shell from the head and split over the open end and discard the root section. Rinse well with cold water then drain and pat dry with paper towels. Trim and break the skin from chicken meat into bite sized pieces and place on the back of the piece of skin. Heat the oil or ghee in a wok or large frying pan and fry the chicken pieces over high heat, turning only once or twice, until it is well browned. Pour the coffee into the pan and stir until the chicken is half covered. Add the chili oil and worcestershire sauce. Simmer, stirring occasionally, for a few minutes until the sauce thickens somewhat and the colour of the coffee changes to dark green. Add the rose petal and stir to combine. Pour into a shallow oven proof dish. Place the black eyed peas in a slow cooker or microwave dish that has been covered with a lid. Top with the sauce. If it doesn’t cover the black eyed peas add a little water. Cover the slow cooker and cook on high for 5 hours. The peas should get tender and have no liquid to them. Serve with rice or noodles or just by itself. Enjoy.

title: Red Kidney Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1/4 lb red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 8 ounces arborio rice | 3 tablespoons dry rice wine | 4 small beets, peeled and cut into matchsticks ( approx 3-4 inches in length )
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan 3/4 of water to a boil, then set aside. Cook dry rice in the 1/4 cup of rice wine until just tender, stir in beets, cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring once or twice. Add rest of the ingredients and cook, covered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally with a fork to keep the rice from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,italian cheese,cool whip,milk ricotta cheese
title: Torta Di Melanzane E Basilico (Bok Choy & Ricotta Dip)
ingredients: 4 leaves baby bok choy | 1 container soft italian cheese blend | 1 cup shredded italian cheese blend | 1 can evaporated skim milk ricotta cheese
instructions: Separate bok choy leaves horizontally as they are tough and brittle. Drain excess water and coarsely chop stem greens. Cut 1/2 inch square piece of cheesecloth into 2 inch lengths. Place bok choy leaves through vegetable grinder with ricotta cheese. With machine running, add shredded cheese, but keep stirring till combined well, about 1 minute. Pour mixture into serving bowl and let drain for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Slow Cooker Chocolate-Caramelized Lamb
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 cup bourbon | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 package dry-roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 pound lamb shoulder ( cut into large chunks )
instructions: Place the brown cake mix, bourbon, and cocoa in a slow cooker. Stir well. Add peanuts. Mix well. Place lamb into slow cooker. Cover.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,coriander seed,shallot,lemon juice zest,italian seasoning,plain yogurt
title: Coriander-Scented Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped shallot | 1/4 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 1 teaspoon freshly ground coriander seed | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2/3 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Whisk all the ingredients together except the salt in a large bowl. Add salt and chill mixture before serving.

title: Raspberry Bavarian Style Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar raspberries | 1 tablespoon finely crushed lind of a lind of fresh raspberries
instructions: Place raspberries on a plate and crush slightly with a rolling pin. Transfer to a small bowl, add crushed lind. Refrigerate for 2 - 3 hours to meld flavors.

Random Ingredients: lentil,pecan,oat,romaine lettuce,plain yogurt,palm sugar,rum,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Fruit Salad With Rum & Yogurt
ingredients: 4 cups sliced romaine lettuce | 4 cups sliced romaine lettuce leaves | 4 cups pecans, chopped | 1 cup dried lentils | 4 cups unsweetened plain yogurt | 1/2 cup palm sugar | 3/4 cup rum | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons mild-flavored liqueur ( i prefer the rum ) | 1/2 cup rolled oats
instructions: To make the fruit salad, place a large salad plate on top of your plates. Divide the romaine lettuce leaves among the plates. Place the pecans in a dry skillet & toast, stirring, over medium heat until golden, about 3 - 5 minutes. Let cool to room temperature. Add the lentils to a large saucepan & cover with water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat To low & simmer, covered, for 30 - 45 minutes or until tender. Drain. Cool slightly & reserve. Whisk together your yogurt, sugar, & liqueur. To serve, divide the cooked lentils among 4 large salad bowls. Top with yogurt mixture and sprinkle with toasted pecans. Garnish with additional toasted pecans.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,pea carrot,beef bouillon granule,extra tofu,clear honey,chocolate,rotel tomato
title: Mama Zuquinis Rosalia's Mexican Stuffed Whole Wheat Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 can evaporated skim milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 lb extra firm tofu, drained and patted dry, crumbled | 2 lbs whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 4 tablespoons unsweetened chocolate, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs frozen mixed pulses carrots | 16 ounces frozen white whole wheat french-fried onions, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f and generously butter the bottom & sides of an 11 by 7 in. Round baking dish. In a blender or work bowl, blend the ricotta, tofu and bouillon granules until smooth. Gently stir in honey. With a rubber spatula, stir in the chopped chocolate. Add the milk ricotta mixture and the carrots. Mix thoroughly. Bake in the center of the oven for 50 - 60 minutes or until the top is browned. Remove and set aside. Pour the french fried onions into the baked loaf. Return the cheesecake to the oven and continue cooking until the cheese is melted and beginning to turn golden about 20 minutes. Transfer to a cake cooling rack and cool for several hours, uncovered.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,beef tenderloin,rosemary,granny smith apple,sherry wine,egg yolk,half,italian dressing
title: Roasted Beef Tenderloin for Two
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh rosemary | 2 packages rigatoni pasta | 2 egg yolks | 1 cup fat-free half-and-half | 1 cup fat-free italian dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat a small saucepan until very hot. Spray a 9x9 inch roasting pan with nonstick cooking spray. Place the beef tenderloin on the pan. Roast beef for 20 - 25 minutes, turning every 5 minutes. Set aside for at least 10 minutes. Brush the roast with sherry. Roast roast meat for 15 to 20 minutes, until thermometer registers 125°f. Remove roast from the oven, remove toothpicks and allow to rest. Tent with foil and let rest for at least 20 minutes. Slice beef as indicated on package. Place the roasting pan on the stove and add the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes or until pasta is tender. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Beer, Feta, and Anchovy Salad
ingredients: 1 bottle pale beer | 2 anchovy fillets | 1 cucumber, quartered lengthwise, seeded, and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 jar thinly sliced pimiento | 8 ounces crumbled feta | table salt | freshly cooked sparkling water ( optional )
instructions: Pour beer into a medium glass bowl. Add anchovies. Gently press anchovies into beer with plastic wrap and transfer to a plate. Refrigerate until ready to use. Line a rimmed 4 inch deep platter with plastic wrap. Arrange cucumber, pimento, and crumbled feta atop platter. Sprinkle on salt and set aside while preparing salad. Ladle hot beer into platter and serve immediately with sparkling water if using.

title: Roquefort and Leek Gratin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs leeks, trimmed & cut diagonally into 3/4 inch pieces | 3 1/2 ounces roquefort cheese, at room temperature | 2 oranges, zest of | 1 cup whole milk | salt & pepper
instructions: Bring 2 qts. Of water to a boil. Add the leeks& cook until just tender, 7 - 10 minutes. Drain leeks, reserving cooking liquid. In a small pan melt the roquefort, add the juice to the reserved liquid and bring to a boil. Gradually whisk in the cooled orange zest. When the leeks are just tender, drain them. Pour orange zest mixture into the sauce and reheat. Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease a 7 x11 inch loaf pan. Stir together the milk & zest. Pour the mixture into the bottom of the pan, smooth the surface, do not stir. Bake for 1 hour or until a knife inserted in one of the long sides comes out clean. Remove from the oven and let cool on a wire rack. Turn out the loaf onto a work surface & let cool 10 minutes. Cut into 6 to 8 slices.

title: Simple Pickle Soup
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini, washed and cubed | 1 1/2 cups pickle juice | 1/4 cup brown mustard seeds
instructions: Put all ingredients into a large saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer on medium low until vegetables are tender. Grate the zucchini and toss into soup.

title: Homemade Ricotta Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb fresh ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup sweet wine, your favorite variety | 6 whole cloves | chili oil
instructions: In a bowl, mix the ricotta with the sweet wine in a small bowl until smooth. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour to allow the flavors to develop. In a covered bowl, mash the cloves of garlic with the chili oil. Bring some room temperature water to boil and stir in the clove garlic mixture. Bring back to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and simmer until the sauce is thickened, about 1 1/2 hours, stirring or whisking as necessary to avoid the garlic sticking to the bottom of the bowl.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,cumin powder,soymilk,white vinegar,salt,fennel bulb,double cream
title: Indian-Spiced Creme Fraiche(Milanese)
ingredients: 2 lbs firm white-fennel bulbs, trimmed ( a mixture of bulbs of your choice but not necessary ) | 2 tablespoons salt | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 fresh serrano chili, seeded and chopped ( or more, if you like ) | 6 tablespoons plain soymilk | 2 tablespoons white vinegar ( or more, if you like ) | 1 cup double cream
instructions: Using a sharp knife, coarsely cut away the stem end of each fennel bulb and discard any discolored outer leaf. Cut the bulbs into thin slices/strips if necessary. Cut the reserved fennel bulb sections into 1/4 slices, discarding the base of the head. Cut slices in half if necessary. You should have around 4 or 5 slices. In a mortar and pestle, combine the fennel pieces with the salt, cumin, chile, soy milk, and vinegar or 1 cup cream. Add more soy milk if mixture is too dry. Beat well and refrigerate for 20 - 25 hours. Just before serving, heat the cream in a skillet and pour off the sour cream from the pan. Add the liquid to the cream and bring to a boil. Remove pan from heat and allow to stand, for 15 minutes. Gently stir in the cream and serve.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes, halved | 1/4 cup dry white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cover a roasting pan with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray, or use parchment paper. Peel and cut potatoes, then place in a large saucepan with water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium. Simmer until potatoes are tender but firm, about 15 minutes. Drain potatoes and return to pan, adding dry white wine. Cook until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Potato-Cheese Pastries
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 3/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons potato starch
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the potato starch, cheese and sesame oil. Stir to combine. Add in the potato starch mixture and knead the dough well around the bowl to combine. Use 1 - 2 tablespoon of dough for each pastry and press it in a 9x13 pan. Sprinkle with more of the cheese if desired. Preheat the oven to 375f degrees.

title: Spicy Yoghurt Cakes or Hot Chili Dogs
ingredients: 500 g yoghurt | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded | 1 serrano chili, deseeded | 1/2 cup bread crumbs
instructions: Place yoghurt in a bowl, mix in the chili, serrano and breadcrumbs and mix. Cover and leave in the fridge for at least 30 minutes or longer depending on quality of yoghurt. Shape mixture into balls. Barbecue on a hot griddle pan or griddle until cooked, browned. Serve with salad and chips.

title: Radish and Niblet Bread Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons spanish olives, pimento stuffed or 4 tablespoons green olives | 4 tablespoons of mixed greens such as radishes, spinach, arugula, etc | 4 pieces whole wheat bread
instructions: Preheat the grill or oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Open the olives and spread them out onto each piece of bread. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Arrange the vegetables around the bread, and set aside. Grill or broil bread to your liking.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,balsamic vinegar,burrito flour tortilla,rice,green chilies
title: Quick and Easy Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb burrito-size flour tortillas | vegetable shortening or crisco | hot cooked rice | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: On a cutting board or platter, cut each tortilla into 8 wedges. Coat the wedges evenly in shortening. Dip each wedge in hot dry rice. Place in a single layer on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes or until hot and lightly browned. Meanwhile, in a double boiler, heat green chilies and vinegar. Dip half of the burritos into heated vinegar mixture. Repeat dipping and turning once or twice until tortillas are lightly browned on underside. To serve, place about 1/4 of the cooked meat and chilies on each plate with green chili salsa and toppings of choice.

title: Cheesy Salmon Poached in Cheese
ingredients: 2 cans salmon, drained well | 1 package monterey jack cheese, shredded ( about 32 cubes )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Place salmon in 1 layer in a bowl. Spoon remaining cheese on top of salmon and top with the cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 15 minutes.

title: Spicy Paneer Panir Pizzas
ingredients: 15 g panir, fat finely chopped | 1 can green enchilada sauce, 1 tablespoon | 60 g tomatoes, chopped | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 teaspoon tangerine, pith and all, flesh chopped finely | 1 teaspoon sage | 4 slices cheese, grated
instructions: Pizza dough, preheat 1/2 of hot pizza stone on tray or a jelly roll pan. Pound the panir until it resembles breadcrumbs. Spread the bean curd onto the panir and add 1 tbsp water or 1 tbsp flour mixed with some oil, spread to a 5mm thickness. Spread the green enchilada sauce on the breadcrumbs to prevent sticking to the breadcrumbs. Sprinkle a handful of grated cheese over the enchilada sauce. Cover the cheese with chopped ginger, chopped herbs and tomatoes and place another handful of grated cheese over the cheese. Spread the remaining green enchilada sauce on the breadcrumb. Place pizza dough on the pizza stone or jelly roll pan and smooth it evenly over the top. Use a pizza press if you have one. Brush the pizza with the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil. Cook pizza in preheated oven 15 mins, turn onto the upper shelf. The pizzas will be crisp and the cheese crispy. You can use more or less oil if you wish. Allow to set for a further 15 mins if the crust has a chance to brown. Remove and slice each pizza into four and enjoy.

title: Totally Simple Garlic Beef Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 can sliced black olives
instructions: Start by making the rice noodles as directed on the package. When noodles have been cooked and drained, rinse with cold water to cool, drain and set aside. When finished, drain oil from olives and pat dry with a paper towel. Cut the noodles into 6 wedges, or more depending on desired thickness. Put them together onto a salad plate and top with beef.

Random Ingredients: mace,chocolate,salt pork,mango chutney,almond flour,yellow mung bean,sesame oil
title: Eggless Mango Chutney Sandwich With Sesame Seeds.
ingredients: 80 g sesame oil ( or any oil available ) | 150 g almond flour | 500 g yellow mung beans or 500 g red kidney beans | 125 g salt pork or 125 g bacon | 2 tablespoons mango chutney or 2 tablespoons chopped mango | 2 tablespoons honey or 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 pinch ground mace ( optional )
instructions: Toast sesame seeds according to the pack instructions. Drain well. Boil beans until al dente. Drain and split while still hot. Mix together all ingredients well. Spread on toasted sesame seeds. Serve warm as sandwich filling or cold as an accompaniment to salads.

Random Ingredients: herb,green bell pepper,green cardamom pod,dill weed,gruyere cheese
title: Gruyere and Herb Fondue for Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup minced green bell pepper, seeds removed | 1 cup minced green bell pepper, seeds removed | 1/4 cup minced fresh dill weed | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1/2 teaspoon fresh fine ground mixed herbs, such as chives, or - 1/4 teaspoon dried dill | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill weed | 2 green cardamom pods, finely sliced for garnish
instructions: Sauce, combine the green bell pepper, green bell pepper, dill weed, gruyere cheese, mixed herbs, and green cardamom. Place in a small heavy saucepan over low heat and stir constantly to melt the cheese and stir well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,pine nut,milk,coriander,italian salad dressing mix,taco seasoning mix
title: Tasty Spinach Dip
ingredients: 600 g baby spinach ( rinsed and chopped ) | 50 g pine nuts | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 cups skim milk | 1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c, 200c / 400f.

title: Cucumber Mustard
ingredients: 2 medium cucumbers, halved lengthways | 1 serrano pepper, halved, deseeded | 1 large shallot, roughly chopped | 3 tablespoons plain flour, plus extra for dusting | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons ketchup ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Line a baking tray with baking paper. Place halved cucumber cut side down on baking tray.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,ricotta cheese,cocoa,pineapple,chinese cabbage,onion powder,kalamata olive
title: Lunch Box Ricotta
ingredients: 250 g ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup kalamata olives | 1 1/2 tablespoons chinese cabbage, shredded | 1 1/2 tablespoons pineapple, chopped | 2 teaspoons dried thyme sprig, leaves | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon cocoa, to sprinkle
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Stir well until creamy. Pack into a serving bowl and sprinkle with more dried thyme.

Random Ingredients: bean,harissa,granny smith apple,tomato juice,chunky salsa,phyllo pastry
title: Bistec De La Olla (Phyllo Pastries)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed | 1 granny smith apple, cut into small wedges | 3 cups chunky salsa, divided | 11 ounces refried beans | 1/4 teaspoon harissa, or to taste | 1 package phyllo pastry dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly butter a baking sheet and line with parchment paper. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Cook and stir shredded apple into hot oil until heated through, about 5 minutes. Combine 1/2 cup salsa and 1/4 teaspoon harissa in a bowl.

title: Sausage & Gruyere Grilled Sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika, sweet | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted | 1 teaspoon ginger, minced | 1/4 cup pizza sauce | 2 cans italian sausage ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 2 cups lettuce leaves | 1/3 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 12 warm pizza rolls
instructions: In a medium bowl, sprinkle the yeast mixture over 1/4 cup of boiling water, then stir until dissolved. Let stand 5 minutes, or until frothy. Whisk in the paprika, melted butter, ginger and 1/4 cup of pizza sauce. Heat the grill. Brush the insides of the sausages with the remaining 1/4 cup sauce. Grill the sausages 6 minutes, or until done. Split the rolls lengthwise and open the pockets. Spoon on the sausage mixture, top with the cheese and a drizzle of remaining pizza sauce, then the lettuce, croutons and bruschetta.

title: Apple Strata
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried apple juice | 1 cup low-fat oat | 1/4 cup low-fat pesto sauce | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon or 1 tablespoon mint | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice, strained | 1 teaspoon capers ( optional ) | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Combine apples and oat in container of an electric blender.

Random Ingredients: broccoli stem,farfalle pasta,self rising flour,ginger root,poultry seasoning,italian breadcrumb,orange juice,half cream
title: Quick and Easy Chicken and Broccoli Pasta
ingredients: 1 package broccoli stems, peeled and halved | 1 cup half and half cream | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 pinch poultry seasoning | 4 ounces dry farfalle pasta | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add broccoli and cook uncovered until tender, about 4 minutes. Drain and spread cut sides of broccoli pieces out onto a baking sheet. Combine half and half cream with ginger, poultry seasoning, and pasta in a bowl. Pour 1/2 of mixture over pasta and veggies. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and orange juice a few drops at a time. Bake in preheated oven until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbling, about 10 minutes.

title: Lemongrass Lasagna
ingredients: 1/2 cup lemongrass, thinly sliced | 2 -8 ounces lasagna noodles, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a large baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Place lemongrass in a food processor with a little of the lemon juice to extract liquid. Spread the lemongrass mixture in rows onto the baking dish and top with lasagna noodles. Cover tightly and bake at 350 degrees f for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,cheddar cheese,pineapple juice,cooking brown rice,turnip,sea bass
title: Bahama Mama Fried Swirls
ingredients: 2 cups instant cooking brown rice | 1 medium turnip, peeled and sliced | sea bass, diced ( optional ) | 1 can pineapple tidbits with juice, drained | 3/4 cup yoghurt, divided | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Prepare rice according to pkg directions. While rice is cooking chop turnip and sea bass, if using. In separate bowl, mix pineapple slices with juice, half of the yoghurt and the cheese. Fold into rice then gently fold in turnip and sea bass. Gently stir in remaining yoghurt. Divide between 4 serving plates and top with remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: yellow cake mix,lemon juice,cayenne pepper,pork tenderloin,white chocolate
title: Spicy Baked Tenderloin With Baked Chocolate
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup white chocolate, melted | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray 13x9 inch metal baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In medium bowl, thoroughly combine cake mix, pork, chocolate, lemon juice and cayenne pepper. Reserve 1/2 cup mixture. Place pork in baking dish. Drizzle with remaining 1/2 cup reserved cake mix. Bake until top is lightly browned and tenderloins are cooked through, 45 - 60 minutes.

title: Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 8 slices white bread | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/3 cup sherry wine
instructions: Soak bread slices in water. Grate butter into bread. Sprinkle with icing sugar. Place in oiled 12 round cake pan. Cut an x on top, but not through, and press into holes evenly. Bake at 325 degrees 1 hour or until golden brown. Remove from oven, and leave on a wire rack while making the icing. Combine sherry and icing, and drizzle over hot crumbs.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,peach,chicken breast,broth,broiler fryer chicken,artichoke heart,jumbo shrimp
title: Shrimp & Peach Chicken Jumbo
ingredients: 3 medium broiler-fryer chickens, about 4 lbs | 12 ounces raw jumbo shrimp | 10 1/2 ounces reduced-sodium chicken stock | 4 ounces artichoke hearts | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 cup chicken breast, cut into strips | 3 cups chicken stock | 1 bunch broth, for thickening gravy
instructions: Rinse the shrimp under cold water. Drain off any remaining salt. Cut the chicken into 1/2 inch cubes. Add the shrimp, shrimp, chicken stock, artichokes and peas to the crockpot. Use all 3 cups of soup stock, chicken broth and 1 cup of beef broth to cover the shrimp completely. Cook on low 4 - 6 hours. To serve, cut chicken strips across the grain into strips. Remove the shrimp from the broth or let stand for about 20 minutes, then tear or dice or shred the meat finely. Add a cup or more of stock to moisten. Garnish with strips of fresh herbs and serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,pesto sauce,corn oil,maraschino cherry,eggplant,cilantro leaf
title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Chips
ingredients: 4 large eggplants | 1 tablespoon corn oil ( or oil, or cooking spray ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( or parsley ) | 1 tablespoon chopped maraschino cherry, halved ( canned okay ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup pesto sauce ( can use more )
instructions: Halve and score eggplants lengthwise, then score the eggplants lengthwise. With a sharp knife, cut each half into 1/4 inch thick chips. In small bowl, stir together corn oil, cilantro, maraschino and baking powder. Place the chips on paper towels and pat dry. Brush eggplant lightly with oil. Arrange on baking sheet and bake 10 minutes at 400°f until golden brown, crisp, cooked through. While chips are baking, heat pesto sauce in saucepan over medium heat. Drain chips and place in bowl to use as a garnish. Garnish warm chips with pesto and a cherry half.

title: Vegetarian Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower ( can use as you prefer ) | 1 can kidney beans | 3 slices pepperoni | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoni ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon parsley ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon anise seed ( optional )
instructions: Boil and saute the onion and pepperoni until softened.

title: Rockefeller Dorado
ingredients: 1 lb ready-made roll ( i prefer oval ) | 1 vanilla bean ( i make my own from scratch ) | 1 cup double cream | whipped cream
instructions: Place roll inside a large bowl large enough to hold roll in one layer. Trim top surface with a sharp knife, remove peel from vanilla and discard. Scrape the vanilla bean from the inside of the vanilla bean and place inside bowl with the roll. Dice the vanilla bean. Over medium heat, bring cream to a simmer in a small pot and add vanilla, vanilla bean and cream. Cook until hot. Cover and turn off heat but leave cover on pot for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and serve with whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,roast,maple syrup,mini chocolate chip,rotel tomato,onion soup mix
title: Santa Fe Roast (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 1 roast | 2 cans rotel tomatoes | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons instant minced onion ( i use frozen ) | 4 ounces mini chocolate chips
instructions: Place the roast in a slow cooker. In a large bowl, combine the tomatoes, soup mix, maple syrup, chicken boullion cube, chopped onion and chocolate chips. Cover and cook on low 7 - 8 hours. Serve over cooked rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: cherry,beef broth,almond,italian parsley,cream tartar,extra virgin olive oil
title: Cherry Rellenos in Garlic and Oil
ingredients: 4 medium ripe cherry or 2 1/2 lbs rabelina olives ( about 8 to 10 cups ) | 1 tablespoon sour cream and tartar | 1 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley ( flat-leaf italian parsley ) | 2 tablespoons minced fresh cherry
instructions: Slice rind off of each cherry leaving about 1/4 inch on each end. Using vegetable peeler, pare away 1 1/2 wide strips of rind and discard remainder. Slice rind and discard pith into 1/3 inch wide strips. Place in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,beet,bicarbonate soda,lettuce,rigatoni pasta,brown onion,chili flake,hot water
title: Bourd Dressing
ingredients: 1 medium brown onion | 6 medium sized beets | 130 g rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/4 teaspoon hot water | 1/4 teaspoon red chili flakes | lettuce | tzatziki ( optional ) or relish ( optional )
instructions: Cut up the onion and beetroot, removing the root end, peel, and cut slices into chunks. Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onion and beetroot over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring from time to time. When the beet root is tender, add the salt and pepper and continue to stir, then cook for 10 minutes or until the liquid is reduced by half. Allow to cool. Boil the rigatoni in plenty of salted boiling water for about 12 minutes, until slightly al dente. Meanwhile, put the flour, bicarbonate of soda and chilli flakes in a big bowl. Add all the liquid from the beetroot and onion and mix well. Add the pepper flakes and mix well. Drain the pasta and mix the pasta into the beetroot and onion mixture. Toss with the dressing. Serve at room temperature, garnished with tzatziki or relish.

title: Ancho Chile and Noodles
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1 package dried ancho chiles
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to rolling boil. Cook linguine in boiling water until cooked through but firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 12 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,cashew,cornflake crumb,cayenne pepper,baby spinach
title: Cashew Spinach and Green Pepper Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup dried cornflake crumbs | 1/2 cup cashews, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 package baby spinach | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spread the cornflake crumbs in the bottom of a 9x9 inch baking dish. Mix the cashews, green pepper, and spinach together in a bowl. Sprinkle in the cayenne pepper, then drizzle over the casserole. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, then remove from the oven and cool for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Stuffed Cauliflower Cheese With Mango & Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 50 ml cauliflower | 1 egg white | 1/2 - 3/4 cup pumpkin seeds | 200 g mozzarella cheese | 1 -2 mango ( optional )
instructions: First wash and steam the cauliflower and microwave until the cauliflower is soft. You will need to steam with a little steam as this can be sticky. Drain. In a dry pan toast the pumpkin seeds. Stir once and add to your cauliflower. Mix until they are golden brown. Cut mozzarella or mango into small cubes. Place on top of the cauliflower and mix well.

title: Teriyaki Marinade for Beef, Chicken, Pork or Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 cup teriyaki marinade | 1 -2 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: In bowl, combine the teriyaki marinade, thyme and pork or lamb slices. Using a sharp knife, press marinade into meat, poultry, etc. Let sit for 2 hours or more.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,rotini pasta,pomegranate seed,half,simple syrup,grain rice,baby corn,active yeast
title: Pomegranate-Corn Stuffed Rye Bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 cups basmati rice ( or other grain rice ) | 2 1/2 cups half-and-half ( or whole, 2 % or fat free ) | 3/4 cup warm pomegranate seeds | 2 packages baby corn | 1 1/2 cups pomegranate seeds | 5 1/2 ounces rotini pasta, plain ( or other short pasta or fruit-homemade sauce ) | 1 1/2 cups whole grain rice, cooked
instructions: Place yeast in a 3 1/2 to 4 cup warm water. Scald, then reduce heat to low and add 1 cup rice. Cover and set aside 30 minutes. Remove from water and cool to lukewarm. In large bowl, combine half and half and pomegranate seeds. Set aside remaining 1 cup of rice. Combine pomegranate seeds and remaining rice in small bowl. Set aside. Add corn and eggs to yeast mixture and beat well. Add half and half to rice and beat until well combine. Place 1 cup rice in a greased 9 x 5x3 loaf pan, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and place in warm spot to rise until doubled. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and cool 10 minutes more, uncover. Increase oven temperature to 400 degrees. Spread 1/4 cup rice onto a cutting board with plastic wrap and make a cross on top. Place an 8 x8 x2 glass baking tin on top, overlapping so that it fits inside the bread. Cut a cross in the top of the loaf to make a vent pipe. Spread 1/4 of the rice mixture onto the bottom of the loaf pan and top it with 1 1/4 c corn mixture and 1 1/4 cup of pomegranate seeds. Continue until pomegranate layer is used up, using remaining rice, corn, pomegranate seeds and pomegranate seed mixture to fill in the gaps in the loaf. Bake at 400 degrees for 40 - 50 minutes or until wooden pick inserted into center comes out dry. Remove from oven, turn off oven, and let bread rest at least 15 - 20 minutes for best flavor absorption. Let cool to room temperature, and store at room temperature for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: ha avocadoes,tomato sauce,pomegranate,bacon,self raising flour,basil leaf
title: Pomegranate Biscuits
ingredients: 200 g self-raising flour | 150 g pomegranate | 4 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1 bunch basil leaves ( chopped fine ) | 125 g cooked bacon | 1 hass avocado ( sliced very thin )
instructions: Dissolve flour in a little bit of water and add tomato sauce. Pour half the batter into a lightly greased ramekin or baking dish. Top with basil/sliced bacon and tomato slices. Repeat layers, sprinkle with remaining flour. Bake in moderate oven for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Tasty Beef and Mango Chutney for Dogs!
ingredients: 2/3 lb lean pork or 2/3 lb beef chuck, sliced very thinly | 1/3 lb veal, sliced very thinly | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon stevia | mango chutney ( to taste ) or jam, of choice ( to taste )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Keep refrigerated for at least 2 hours, longer if needed, otherwise overnight or up to 3 days.

title: Italian Lentil Stew
ingredients: 1 cup dried red lentils | 8 ounces ground pork | 2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 2 ounces amaretto | 1 whole boneless pork shoulder, trimmed of fat, cut into chunks
instructions: For stew, in large bowl cover lentils with water and soak 30 minutes to 1 hour and then drain. Place the peeled pork chunks in a saucepan with the chicken broth and amaretto. Bring to a boil and allow to simmer on low until meat is tender, about 40 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. If using the fat free broth, skim off fat of the top just before serving.

title: Zucchini With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 cup canned chickpeas ( drained ) | 1 small zucchini ( chopped ) | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 2 red chilies ( crushed ) | 1/2 teaspoon harissa or 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 cup coriander ( chopped ) or 1/4 cup cilantro ( chopped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 fahrenheit. Mix cornstarch with 2 tbsp water. Put chickpeas in a bowl, mash with fork. Add zucchini and toss until coated.

Random Ingredients: steak,red chilies,wheat flour,chicken bouillon cube,applesauce,triple sec
title: Caribbean Fried Beef
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs flank steaks, trimmed | 4 ounces diced red chilies, roasted | 3/4 cup applesauce | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 4 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Pleace flank steak in freezer for 30 minutes to firm. Cut steak diagonally across grain into thin slices. Heat skillet on medium high and add chicken, chilies, applesauce and triple sec to skillet. Cook and stir until hot and bubbly. Transfer steak and sauce to oven safe serving dish. Cover and bake at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: broth,gravy,onion soup mix,cocoa,maraschino cherry,cream mushroom soup,brown sugar,vegetable oil
title: Poor Man's Sour Cream Mushroom Swiss Steak
ingredients: 3/4 cup onion soup mix | 1/2 cup beef gravy | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can vegetable oil | 1/3 cup cocoa | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 6 maraschino cherries | 2 lbs round steaks
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Mix together the onion soup and gravy mix together in a large bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Slice the beef into 1/2 inch strips. Place in a 9x13 baking dish and pour the sour cream sauce over. Bake for 1 hour. If the sour cream sauce is too thick, add water and stir in a few tablespoons of soured cream to thin it out more. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Vietnamese Chili Paste (Hsi-Quo)
ingredients: 16 dried limes, rinsed well | chili paste, hiet ( vietnamese basil, coriander roots, thyme, or culantro leaves )
instructions: Grind together limes and thyme in mortar and pestle until coarsely ground. Transfer ground lime mixture to medium bowl. Gradually add chili paste. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Lasts indefinitely.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,flour,white flour,hot paprika,citrus infused vodka,coriander powder,lasagna noodle,part ricotta cheese
title: Delicious Low Fat Low Fat Pizza Cannelloni
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles, cooked, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons white flour | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 tablespoon ground coriander powder | 1 tablespoon citrus-infused vodka ( optional ) | cooking spray | 1/4 cup fat-free part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/8 cup low fat granulated garlic
instructions: Cook noodles as directed. While noodles are still hot, coat a 9x13 casserole dish or a glass bowl with cooking spray and set aside. In a medium bowl, stir together white flour and ground coriander. Whisk in the vodka gradually and set aside. Coat a clean, dry frying pan with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Add ricotta and cook until cheese begins to bubble, then whisk in the flour and 1 tablespoon of the coriander mixture, followed by remaining coriander. Stir a few times so mixture doesn't lump. Cook another few minutes. Quickly transfer contents of frying pan to baking dish or bowl and let cool. Spray a medium skillet with shortening and set over medium heat. Add noodles and sautee until slightly crispy, about 6 - 10 minutes, flipping once, or about 2 minutes total. Add sauce and cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, over low heat. Spoon mixture onto plate and top with a spoonful of low fat granulated garlic or your favourite spice mixture, such as basil or cilantro.

title: Baked Beans (Guisados De Pinto)
ingredients: 5 cups pinto beans, soaked overnight ( i use dry pinto beans that are soaked through a food mill ) | 1 cup bread flour
instructions: Put the beans into an oiled bowl, turn the heat down a bit, and soak overnight. The next day, drain the beans and place them in the food mill, pour in the bread flour, and process until thoroughly mixed. Scrape the texture into an oven dish. Bake, uncovered, at 375 f for 1 hour or until the beans turn pale yellow. If the texture is a bit dry, add water a little at a time, until it is moist but not watery.

title: Pepperoni Grilled Patties (Kebabs)
ingredients: 50 g breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup sweet pepperoni, finely chopped | 150 g sliced pepperoni, diagonally | 1 large sweet bell pepper, sliced | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons clarified butter
instructions: Mix all the ingredients, except the ghee/butter, together in a bowl until well blended. Patties should be well coated on all sides.
