Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 - 3 hours. Spread the butter/ghee on a griddle or a heavy base frying pan. Preheat on medium high heat. Grill/cook the patty for about 3 - 5 minutes, flipping once or twice, or broil. Remove and serve hot.

title: Apple Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup diced red apple
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line the bottom of a baking dish with reynolds wrap heavy duty aluminum foil. Place chicken between two slices of heavy duty aluminum foil, and press firmly with a mallet to push out the air pockets. Fold breast over the breast as though closing a book. Squeeze apple slices out of the foil into a cavity for stuffing. Bake uncovered in the preheated oven for approximately 45 minutes, until cooked through, and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: cherry,vegetable oil,tomato puree,broccoli floret,cider vinegar,corn tortilla
title: Cherries and Broccoli Tacos
ingredients: 1 package broccoli florets | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 can diced tomatoes in tomato puree | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 6 corn tortillas or 6 flour tortillas | 1/4 cup fresh cherry ( optional )
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water just to tender crisp and drain. Heat oil in a skillet over moderately high heat and sauté vegetables until heated through. Drain vegetables and mash the tomatoes with a fork. Add the broccoli, vinegar and 2 1/2 teaspoons salt and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Heat tortillas in microwave for about 30 seconds to soften. Spoon about 2 teaspoons of filling onto center of each tortilla and use two teaspoons or less to form tacos. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coffee,cumin,great northern bean,red pepper flake,balsamic vinegar
title: Balsamic and Cumin Refresher
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 2 large balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons ground cumin | crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix the beans and 2 tablespoons of balsamic vinegar in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours until flavors blend and refridgerate flavors mix. Stir in crushed red pepper, balsamic vinegar, and 2 to 3 teaspoons of cumin.

title: Kimchi Dressing
ingredients: 2 packages dry macaroni | 1 package dry ranch-style dressing mix | 1 head cabbage kimchi, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place macaroni in a large bowl of cold water, and cook until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool. Mix ranch style dressing mix, kimchi, and cabbage in a bowl.

title: Nuclear Nachos
ingredients: tortilla chips | msg ( to your taste )
instructions: Microwave tortilla chips in microwave approximately 30 seconds. Remove and add cheese. Break up into small pieces and microwave until hot.

title: Tortilla Appetizer
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 chipotle chile in adobo | 1/8 cup bourbon or 1/8 cup white rum
instructions: Slice the chipotle in adobo using a sharp knife and spread inside of the tortilla, leaving about a 1/4 inch shell. Cut out an opening in the middle of the tortilla and fill with part of the mozzarella cheese. Wrap a piece of aluminum foil over the tortilla, and set in the freezer for about 1 to 2 hours to chill. To serve, remove the foil and place on top of a warm dish, remove the cheese, and garnish with a dash of spiced rum.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce heart,olive oil,cointreau liqueur,flat leaf parsley,escarole
title: Barefoot Contessa's Escarole Salad
ingredients: 2 heads escarole, washed well, drained and well rinsed | 1 head romaine lettuce hearts | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup cointreau liqueur | 1/4 cup chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Make sure to trim the head of greens with kitchen shears and then remove the hard stems. Rinse well and set any greens aside. Chop the greens roughly. Heat the oil and cointreau in a medium frying pan and cook gently until the liqueur has reduced down about 50% add the greens, increase the heat to high and toss them until they are all coated with the oil and dressing. Divide the greens among large bowls. Top with the cointreau dressing and sprinkle with the parsley.

Random Ingredients: cheese,jaggery,lentil,serrano pepper,coconut,garlic powder,sparkling wine,cream mushroom soup
title: Kheema Daalu (Lentil Cake)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried lentils | 1 cup curds or 1 cup cheese | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon jaggery ( palm sugar ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dry sparkling wine ( optional ) | sliced cheese or semolina, for topping
instructions: Soak the lentils overnight in just enough cold water to cover them. Drain the water and spread the lentils in a baking dish. Crumble the curd. Mix the mushroom soup, serrano pepper, garlic powder, sugar and dry sparkling wine in a bowl and spread evenly over the lentils. Sprinkle the slices of cheese over the top. Bake, uncovered, in a low oven for 25 minutes, or until bubbly. Serve warm, in small bowls or over rice.

title: The Easiest and Easiest Chicken Ever
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 1/2 cup firmly packed brown mustard
instructions: Preheat the oven 400 degrees fahrenheit. Combine the brown mustard and mustard in a gallon sized ziploc bag. Put chicken in the bag and shake to thoroughly coat the chicken with mustard and mustard mixture. Place chicken and contents in an oven safe dish, and roast for 10 - 15 minutes, or until chicken is done. Serve.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,part mozzarella cheese,cinnamon,wooden skewer,sparkling water,water
title: Skewered Stuff
ingredients: 2 cups water | 1 cup water | 1/4 cup pine nuts, unsalted, chopped | 1/4 cup light-roasted italian parsley, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 5 skewers, 6 inches long
instructions: In a small saucepan, bring 1 cup water, pine nuts, parsley and cinnamon to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the nut mixture has absorbed the water, about 5 minutes. Allow the mixture to cool completely at room temperature. In a small bowl, stir the remaining 1 cup water with the mozzarella and remaining pine nuts. Set aside. Soak the skewers in warm water for about a minute or two. Preheat the grill to high. Thread 3 skewers onto each skewer. Brush the skewers onto the hot grate and grill until the cheese is melted and beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Serve topped with the nut mixture.

title: Traditional Chai Tea (Sambhar Chai)
ingredients: 1 jar chai tea ( you 'll have to brew them yourself ) | 2 -4 slices of onion ( thinly sliced )
instructions: Brew tea to your liking & place onion thinly sliced on the surface. Place chai tea bags on a plate & cover with 1 tsp of water. Let sit for 4 minutes then remove bags. Steep for 4 - 5 minutes then remove from heat. Enjoy with some other chai as a garnish, try substituting lime zest & mint for the onions. Enjoy.

title: Easy Low Fat Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Combine the cinnamon and ground cinnamon in a small bowl. Cut both chicken breasts into 1 inch cubes. Thread on each soaked skewer. Thread the chicken cubes onto soaked wooden or bamboo skewers, alternating pieces to ensure each piece is coated evenly with the cinnamon. Cook in an indoor grill or a bbq or grill pan over a moderate heat for 10 - 12 minutes per side, until cooked through. Remove from grill or bbq, and serve warm, or cold with a salad of mixed greens.

title: Linguine With Tomato & Ricotta
ingredients: 3 ounces dry linguine | 4 ounces ricotta | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard | 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese | 1 lb fresh tomato sauce | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 2 -4 ounces ricotta cheese
instructions: Cook the linguine according to package directions. While linguine is boiling, combine all sauce ingredients except pasta in a saucepan. Bring to a boil slowly, stirring constantly. Add the pasta, and cook to al dente according to package directions. Drain the linguine, returning it to the pot. Add the sauce, mixing thoroughly. Serve with parmesan sprinkled on top, if desired.

Random Ingredients: meat,bucatini pasta,chicken breast tender,beef stew meat,fruit strawberry,bacon,rosemary leaf,pepperoni sausage
title: Cacciatore Pizza #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked bucatini pasta, cooked according to package directions | 6 chopped pepperoni sausage ( about 5 links ) | 3 slices bacon, chopped | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast tenders, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 packages frozen mixed fruit ( strawberries, peach, etc. ) | 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked beef stew meat | 1 teaspoon minced fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Boil the pasta until just al dente, not mushy. Scoop it with a slotted spoon or slotted spoon. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook the sausage and bacon over medium heat until bacon is crisp. Remove the skillet from the heat, and stir in the chicken, fruit, rosemary and meat. Transfer the mixture to prepared pan. Top with cooked pasta, if desired. Bake in the preheated oven 15 to 20 minutes, or until bubbly and hot.

title: Chile, Herb & Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 250 g cheese tortellini | 150 g cheese tortellini | 8 mushrooms | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon ground black olives | 2 tablespoons pickled hot sauce | 2 teaspoons chicken base | 1 teaspoon yeast
instructions: Mix together in a large bowl the remaining ingredients. Dump the mixture on to a baking paper lined pan and allow it to rise. Bake in a pre heated oven, 200c, or 210c for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown. Serve at once or cool to room temperature.

title: Palm Sugar Snacks
ingredients: 1 cup palm sugar or 1 cup white sugar | 3/4 cup sunflower seeds, toasted, cooled and chopped
instructions: Combine the sugar and sunflower seed in a bowl, coat well. Sprinkle over a baking tray. Bake in a moderate oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until light golden brown. Cool and store in airtight container.

title: Potato and Oat Kebabs (Can Be Gluten Free)
ingredients: 4 red potatoes | 2 pints liquid smoke ( or smoke flavored if desired ) | 4 tablespoons gelatin powder ( i used krispies ) | 4 tablespoons porridge oats
instructions: Preheat grill to medium, 200c. Chop potato and place in a large bowl, sprinkle with vinegar, 1 tbs water and half the gelatin powder. Whisk until completely mixed, place potato on grill, close lid/foil and smoke until dry and slightly tender, 30 - 45 minutes. Remove lid/foil and carefully lift potatoes from grill. Use remaining water to cool mixture, this can be done the day before. Gently squeeze excess moisture from potato and mix with potatoes. Stir in 2 tbs water, mix and pour into sterilized jars, cover with lids and screw on band.. Store in a cool dark place.

title: Roasted Italian Sausages
ingredients: 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 12 ounces italian hot chicken sausage ( mild or hot )
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees. Coarsely grind black peppercorns and lightly sprinkle over sausage slices. Put on a greased cookie sheet. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes. Let cool slightly then stuff into hot italian patties..

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,brussels sprout,yellow pepper,pecan,linguine,black coffee,greek yogurt,thyme
title: Linguine With Brussels Sprouts and Peppers
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1 package frozen brussels sprouts | 1 cup finely chopped yellow pepper | 1 cup finely chopped red peppers or 1 cup green pepper | 1 cup shredded pecans, toasted ( optional ) | 2 cups non fat greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1 cup jarred marinara sauce
instructions: Cook linguine as per package directions with salt on, drain. Meanwhile, cook the brussels sprouts in boiling water until tender. Drain and cool slightly. Place in a colander, and toss with 3/4 cup pasta water to lightly thaw. Cook brussels sprouts with a touch of olive oil and salt until well wilted and tender. Add the remaining salad ingredients.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,mexican cheese,tomato sauce,chicken breast,cooking spray,chocolate,cayenne pepper
title: Spicy Chicken Mole Sauce (With Baking Powder)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut diagonally into 2 pieces | 1/3 cup reduced-fat mexican cheese blend, shredded | 1/4 cup chopped mexican carra cheese | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon ground lemongrass ( i used only about 1/2 teaspoon ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | cooking spray
instructions: Spray inside of large non stick skillet with cooking spray and set over medium high heat. Add chicken and cook until lightly browned and no longer pink about 2 minutes. Sprinkle both sides of chicken with mexican cheese and place chicken on top of cheese in skillet. Add tomato sauce and sprinkle with carra cheese. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer for 30 minutes or until sauce has thickened to desired consistency. I made this just a few hours before serving and it turned out great in this recipe. Note, i always add more sauce to the dish when it is done, i usually just toss a bit of green onion, garlic, and some sliced green parts in as well while i still have it.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,chicken breast half,barbecue sauce,white bread flour,spicy brown mustard,sage,peach,red currant jelly
title: BBQ Chicken
ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon spicy brown mustard, or more to taste | 3/4 cup chopped canned peaches | 15 ounces white bread flour | 1 can tomato and green chilies, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon chopped sage, or more to taste | 1 -2 teaspoon red currant jelly
instructions: Arrange chicken breasts in the slow cooker. Stir barbecue sauce, mustard and peaches together in another slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: half cream,vegetable oil cooking spray,japanese eggplant,cheese tortellini,parsley
title: Gramma's Tortellini Eggplant (Vegetarian)
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 8 ounces gomasio cheese tortellini ( or your favorite flavor ) | 12 eggs | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Heat oven to 450f. Coat a jelly roll pan with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add the 1 cup of half and half, parsley and egg mix, stirring until the eggs are just set and creamy, about 5 minutes. Drain. Add the tortellini and 2 tbsp of the cooking liquid to the cheese tortellini mixture and stir. Pour mixture into the skillet and cook for 2 minutes. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Sprinkle with more parsley and bake the gramma's eggplant, uncovered, for 15 mins at 425f.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,celery,cherry,zucchini,basil pesto,tilapia fillet,coconut milk,green bell pepper
title: Irish Tilapia with coconut sauce
ingredients: 1 pound tilapia fillets, cut into small chunks | 3/4 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1/2 cup irish cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil pesto | 1 cup diced zucchini | 1 cup diced green bell pepper | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cherries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together the coconut milk, irish cream, pesto, zucchini, green bell pepper, celery and cherries. Layer the tilapia in one layer, and pour 1/4 the coconut mixture over them. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

title: Glazed Apricots
ingredients: 1 pound apricots, peeled | 1/3 cup apricot jam
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the apricots on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil. Cover with a circle of aluminum foil. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, then turn off the oven. Allow to cool slightly, then cut in half with a serrated knife. Fill with jam and serve.

title: Curried Egg and Rice
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1 cup peas ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 cup diced rutabaga | 8 slices pancetta bacon ( i use extra lean ) | 1 cup grapeseed oil | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup tamari | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped coriander
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the rice in a large strainer. Rinse the rice thoroughly under running water and shake dry. Transfer the rice to medium sized casserole dish big enough to hold the vegetables. Add the peas and rutabaga and stir to mix well. Set aside. Using a meat mallet or a heavy skillet, pound the bacon to remove some of the fat. Remove the bacon from the pan leaving the fat in the pan and set aside. Raise the oven temperature to 425°f and place the pot inside the oven. Once the pot is hot, place the rice on the rimmed baking sheet so that all of the vegetables sit evenly at the bottom of the pot. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden. Turn the heat off and add the tamari and cornstarch. Let cook for 2 minutes more. Then add the drippings from the pan back to the pan with the bacon and cook over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes, scraping any bits from the bottom of the pan. Taste and adjust the tamari as needed.

title: Guajillo Breakfast Sandwich (Sopa De Ajo)
ingredients: 1 whole white bread | 2 guajillo chilies | 2 carrots
instructions: Heat the grill to 400°f. Cut the bread in half horizontally. Cut a slit in the end of the chiles with a sharp knife. Remove the seeds. Cut an opening with a slice of bread about 1/2 inch thick. Fill inside of the bread with the guajillo chile. Cut the carrot into thick slices and place on top of the guajillo. Put a slice of bread on top of the chiles. Cook until the bread is toasted, about 3 minutes. Enjoy.

title: BUSH's Black Bean Pie
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 4 1/2 cups of unbleached white flour | 1 1/2 cups of plain white flour
instructions: Place the 2 cans of black beans in a double boiler and add one can of water in the bottom.. Turn to high heat and bring the water to a boil. Once it begins to boil, turn the heat to low. Continue cooking for two hours. Take the two cans of black beans and drain the broth from the bottom of the double boiler over the black beans.. After two hours, turn off the double boiler. Turn the double boiler back on to warm. Put in half of the plain flour for the first pie. Mix in the remaining 1/2 cup of flour. Turn mixture into the unbaked pie shell. Add the second can of black beans, and mix these in with the flour and flour. Do not over mix the beans. Bake in a 400 degree oven for approximately 40 minutes. Remove from oven, and immediately fill the pie with black bean pie crust. Return to oven for 15 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: tangerine juice,oriental sesame oil,cake flour,shiitake mushroom,port wine,yellow pepper,mango
title: Chinese Sweet Soup - Wonton Style
ingredients: 1 medium mushroom | 1 yellow sweet pepper | 2 tablespoons maple flavored tangerine juice | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon port wine ( or mirin ) | 1 tablespoon cake flour ( optional ) | 0.5 package fried tofu ( optional )
instructions: Clean the mushrooms, slit down the center, and remove the stems. Slice the caps very thinly. Cut the yellow pepper into strips about 3 inches long, 1 1/2 inches wide and the short end off. Put the stem end through a piece of cheesecloth to remove the loose ends.

title: BBQ Sauce for Ham or Venison
ingredients: 1 lb cottage cheese ( use cottage ) | 1 teaspoon coarse ground ginger | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce ( your choice as smoky or spicy as you would like to make your own )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and chill until ready to serve for best results.

title: Easy Fennel and Pepper Onion Relish - Microwave on 100% Oven
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, bulb peeled and sliced ( about 11/2 ounces or 4 oz/4 ounces ) | 1 small pepper, diced ( about 1 1/2 teaspoons or 2 - 1 1/2 teaspoons depending on size of fennel bulb )
instructions: Place the cut fennel bulbs in the microwave and cook on power level of 100% oven, 7 - 9 minutes. Do not open microwave oven until the fennel is soft. Remove from microwave oven and stir in the other ingredients. Leave covered for 5 minutes, then stir again. Leave covered for 10 - 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Tasty Beef and Pineapple
ingredients: 1/4 pint butter | 1 1/2 lbs lean beef steaks, cut 1 inch thick | 1 1/2 lbs tart apples, peeled, cored and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 8 russet potatoes, boiled and sliced 1 inch thick | 8 ounces frozen spinach, rinsed, dried and wrung clean, thawed | 8 ounces cooked canned tuna, drained | 2 fluid ounces whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Melt the butter in a large skillet. Add the beef and cook over high heat, turning, for 2 minutes. Reduce heat and add the pineapple, apples and potatoes. Continue to cook for another 10 minutes or so. Add the spinach, tuna, cream, cayenne and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spicy Vegetarian Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1 -1 1/2 cup couscous or 1 -1 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 -3 tablespoon curry | 1 -2 tablespoon chili paste ( red hot or other ) | 1 -2 tablespoon butter or 1 -2 tablespoon margarine | 1 -3 tablespoon custard powder ( optional ) | 2 -3 scallions or 2 -3 green onions, finely chopped or 2 -3 spring onions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 -3 pinches cocoa ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine all ingredients except the cocoa. Add to the boiling water. Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally until cooked through. Add the cocoa, if using, stir and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,szechwan pepper,mussel,oregano leaf,serrano pepper
title: Sicilian Baked Mussels
ingredients: 28 large mussels | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon finely chopped serrano pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoon szechwan pepper | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Scrub the beards from the mussels with a sharp knife. Remove the beards from each mussel shell by sliding them out of their shells and leaving them on their shells. Discard any that leave on their shells. In a 2 - 3 qt. Heavy pot, add 2 1/2 cups of water, 1 t. Of the oregano and 1/2 t. Of the serrano pepper. Bring to a boil, cover and turn off the heat. Let the pot sit on its lowest setting while you prepare the liquid. Pour 3 cups of the reserved cooking liquid into a small bowl. Sprinkle the remaining 3 t. Ortega with the remaining pepper, and set aside. Drop the shells into the pot with the remaining 1/2 t. Of sichuan pepper, 1/2 cup of the parmigiano and the remaining 1/2 cup of parmigiano. If you can, squeeze out and discard the remaining shells that have opened. Cover and shake the pot from bottom as you place them. It will take about 10 minutes to be hot enough, just to get all of the shells heated through. Add the reserved mussels to the pot with the reserved cooking liquid, then cover and simmer until the mussels are mostly covered with the liquid. Check for any remaining shells that have opened. Stir in the reserved cooking liquid and serve.

title: Easy Pork and Red Cabbage Pasta
ingredients: 400 g rigatoni pasta | 250 g small red cabbage, thickly sliced | 300 g lean pork steaks, thinly sliced | icing sugar
instructions: Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat. Add the rigatoni and, using tongs, toss gently to coat and remove any excess moisture. Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, place cabbage in a colander over a bowl, add 2 cups of cold water and toss to combine. Drain pasta in a colander, then transfer to a large serving bowl. Add pork to bowl and toss to coat. Add to bowl with cabbage and pork, and toss to combine. Serve with a sprinkling of icing sugar.

title: Cheesy Baked Asiago Onion Onion Rings
ingredients: 4 large onions, peeled and scored | 2 1/2 teaspoons asiago cheese, grated | additional asiago cheese, for garnish
instructions: Place the asiago onion seeds into a baking dish, drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with salt, and sprinkle top with grated asiago cheese. Bake in the middle of the oven 400 degrees f for 50 - 70 minutes.

title: Pork Au Gratin With Mustard-Sauce Applesauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork tenderloin ( fat trimmed and sliced thinly and cut into 1/4 `` thick medallions ) | 2 tablespoons oil | 8 ounces applesauce, 1 `` | 1 teaspoon ground savory | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/4 lb gruyere ( shredded ) | 1 cup iceberg lettuce ( washed ) | 1/2 cup ice cream
instructions: Brush pork with 2 t. Oil and heat at 450°f for 8 - 10 minutes or until hot and browned, turning once if needed. Set aside. In small bowl, stir together applesauce, savory, cornstarch and gruyere. Spread one side of pork medallions with applesauce mixture and top with remaining medallions. In 12 inch sauté pan, heat 2 t. Of oil over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Add in pork, browned side first, and sauté until golden brown, 3 - 5 minutes or until golden brown to taste. Spoon off any excess oil. Serve in bowl with iceberg lettuce on the side, topped with grated cheese. In a skillet, heat the remaining 2 t. Oil over medium high heat until just smoking. Add in steamed cabbage and cook, covered for 5 minutes or until cabbage is tender crisp. Stir the sauce into salad. Top with scallions.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,sirloin tip roast,white fish fillet,brown sugar,floury potato
title: Stove-Top Beef, Squash and Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast, trimmed of fat and cut into 3/4 inch pieces ( or top round beef ) | 3 large yellow squash, cut into 3/4 inch chunks ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 lbs small floury potatoes, scrubbed and cut into 3/4 inch chunks | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 10 -12 ounces canned white fish fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spread all the pieces of beef out on a foil large baking sheet or several smaller baking sheets. Bake uncovered for 1 hour on each side.

title: Ricotta and Orange Jell-O Bean Dip
ingredients: 15 ounces fat-free ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons orange jell-o | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f combine all ingredients and mix well. Bake at 375°f for 10 minutes, stirring every 3 - 4 minutes. Serve at room temperature.

title: Rooh Laat - Goat Cheese Patties
ingredients: 400 g goat cheese | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 tablespoon gochujang ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. In a small bowl, mix goat cheese, sun dried tomatoes and chile paste until well combined. Heat your palm slightly to flatten it a bit. Divide your mixture into small patties, pressing firmly onto an upturned baking dish. Bake in your preheated oven for 2 to 3 minutes on each side before placing the patties on a plate covered with clingfilm to cool for 20 minutes. Serve either warm or cold, with lots of dipping sauce and pickled red cabbage on the side.

Random Ingredients: red wine,mexican oregano,pecorino romano cheese,green banana,nutmeg,yellow onion,italian parsley
title: Green Banana Burgers With Mojo
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh green bananas, peeled, cut in 1/2 lengthwise | 1/2 tablespoon mexican oregano, minced | 1/2 teaspoon fresh nutmeg, grated | 1/2 cup red wine ( italian, cabernet sauvignon, mezclun or burgundy ) | 2 -4 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 small yellow onion, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese or 1/4 cup romano cheese, at room temperature
instructions: Remove the peel from the bananas, leaving the root end intact. Cut off the top 1/2 inch layer of peel then slice each portion lengthwise into thin rounds. In a small bowl combine the oregano, nutmeg and ground red pepper to taste. Stir the mixture into the red wine and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the peeled bananas, chorizo, parsley, onion, cheese, and any wine remaining in the bowl with the reserved vegetable mixture. Mix well. Using a lightly wet hands, roll each portion of the mixture into patties, about 5 to 6 ounces each. In a large heavy skillet, heat 1 to 2 tablespoons of oil over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Working in small batches, place the bananas in the skillet, in batches if necessary, and saute, turning with tongs, until browned on the outside, about 5 minutes per batch. Transfer the bananas to a baking sheet and place in the oven to keep warm. Burgers may be served warm or at room temperature, if needed. Note, the recipe suggests serving the bananas on a platter surrounded by the remaining mojo. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: black olive,ham,cashew nut,chuck,cardamom seed,chicken stock cube,dark brown sugar
title: Beef, Dark and Spicy Cashew Nut Stew
ingredients: 500 -700 g chuck, in large chunks | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds | 1 chicken stock cube, crumbled and dissolved in | 1 cup chicken stock ( i use the premade ) | 175 g dark sweet cashew nuts | 5 black olives
instructions: Trim any extra fat, gristle and dark fat from the chuck and cut into large, even sized cubes. Using the same large base of the stew you cooked, dissolve the sugar with the cardamom seeds in over a med. Heat in a large saucepan, add meat and brown over med. Heat for 8 - 10 mins while stirring occasionally. Add the stock cube dissolved in the stock and stir, scraping any bits off the bottom of the pan. Bring to a rolling boil then lower to a simmer and cook undisturbed for 2 hr while you cook the cashew nuts. When the meat has thickened and softened remove 1 cup of the stock and discard. Put the rest of the coconut into a food processor and puree with an extra cup of stock to make a rich paste. In a separate saucepan, add the reserved stock through the black olives and simmer to reduce slightly. Cut the cashew nuts into chunks and add to the pan. Heat for 5 mins stirring. Add to the pan. Add the reserved stock and stir then serve with crusty bread and salad.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,puff pastry,button mushroom,red potato,chicken meat,chicken breast,egg white,macaroni
title: Chicken and Vegetable Pies
ingredients: 2 skinless chicken breasts | 250 g cauliflower florets | 2 red potatoes | 2 chicken thighs ( drumsticks or breast etc ) | 0.75 box macaroni ( shells or other shapes you like ) | 1 egg white | 150 g button mushrooms ( any type you like ) | 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 200cm. Place the chicken, cauliflower and potatoes in a large roasting pan. Tuck the chicken and vegetables under the skin just until the chicken is white on the inside, and cook in the oven for 20 to 30 minutes, until cooked through. Meanwhile, put the macaroni into a large pan of boiling water and cook for 9 minutes, or until just tender, drain and set on a plate. Heat about 2 tablespoons of the oil in a non stick frying pan, add the mushrooms and chicken and saute for 5 minutes, remove and set aside. Add 1 teaspoon of oil to the pan and fry the puff pastry for 1 - 2 minutes until golden. Transfer to a plate lined with kitchen paper. Heat the remaining oil and cook the chicken for about 5 minutes, remove and set aside. Drain the vegetables and mushrooms and add to the pan, mix and cook for another minute, season with salt and pepper. Remove from the pan. Place the chicken into a large bowl and add the vegetables and pasta. Stir through the egg white and spoon into 8 or 10 pie dishes, filling to just above the top of each pie pie. Bake for 15 - 40 minutes, or until the pies are golden.

title: Almond Biscuits
ingredients: 3 packets icing sugar, sifted | 2 cups sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 degrees celsius. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Place icing sugar in a small bowl and sprinkle over sliced almonds. With a fork gently push icing sugar into almonds until evenly coated. Bake biscuits for 12 minutes or until slightly coloured. Remove from oven and leave to cool slightly then ice with butter or biscuit jam. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: turnip,cheddar cheese,lemon peel,walnut,chicken thigh,peanut oil,golden syrup
title: St. Patrick's Day Chicken
ingredients: 2 onions, halved and separated | 250 g butter, melted | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 500 g chicken thighs ( boneless or skinless ) | 1/3 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 120 g turnips, peeled and finely diced | 1/2 cup shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 2 twists lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Place onions in a large roasting pan and drizzle with half the melted butter and golden syrup. Pour the chicken thighs onto the onions and bake for 40 minutes or until golden. Turn 180c and bake for another 40 minutes or until cooked and brown all the way through. In a hot dry wok toast the walnuts until it has coloured slightly, do not burn. Allow to cool. Cut the chicken into strips, stir in walnuts and turnip and spread over the fried nuts. Sprinkle with shredded cheese and lemon peel. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,leek,banana lengthwise,italian dressing,basil,double cream,iceberg lettuce,baby back rib
title: Roasted Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 4 ripe bananas, halved lengthwise ( or 1 large red and 1 yellow ) | 1 lb baby back ribs ( country style ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce | 2 leeks, white and light green parts, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 3/4 cup light italian dressing ( i use zesty italian chicken, recipe below ) | 1/2 cup double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f place the bananas on a large baking sheet and place in the oven until lightly browned and crispy, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow to cool. Then cut them in half lengthwise and arrange on a serving tray. Place ribs on a large baking sheet and season with salt and pepper inside and out, and place on top rack of the oven. Bake until the ribs are beginning to crisp, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven, uncover and cool. Combine basil, lettuce, leeks, sesame oil, and italian dressing in a bowl. Toss with the cooled bananas, lettuce, and leeks to serve.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,spinach,white tuna,white onion,parmigiano reggiano cheese,vanilla yogurt,rice vinegar,cream mushroom soup
title: Tuna Spinach Dip II
ingredients: 1 can solid white tuna, drained | 1 container plain sour cream | 1 large white onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black cardamom pods | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread tuna into a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, mix together sour cream, onion, rice vinegar, sugar, and cardamom. Cover, and refrigerate for flavors to blend. In a separate medium bowl, combine spinach, spinach soup, and cheese. Remove tuna from refrigerator. Spread sour cream mixture over tuna, and sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 1/2 cups marsala wine ( sherry, cooking sherry, or port ) | 6 -8 flour tortillas ( flour tortillas would be perfect for this also ) | 1 large jicama, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain any excess grease. Place meat and the cooked sauce in bowl. Wash and slice jicama in half and lay them in the center of the meat mixture on the tortillas, roll up and place each one in a 13 by 9 inch baking dish. Place the tortillas in the freezer for about 20 minutes. Bake, uncovered, at 350°f. The tortillas should be crisp. Serve hot as a dip with hot tortillas.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,baby potato,caper,active yeast,rice paper,hard egg,plum tomato
title: Spanish Tapas(ATK)
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 2 -3 cups warm water or 2 -3 cups milk | 12 -15 small tart apples, such as fuji, golden delicious, granny smith | 2 - 2 1/2 lbs baby potatoes, scrubbed | 6 -12 plums ( optional ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup drained capers ( optional ) | 18 -24 rice paper sheets ( regular size ) | 1 egg, beaten ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Cover and let stand 5 minutes or until bubbles appear all over. Combine apples and potatoes in large bowl of electric mixer. Beat at medium speed until well blended, stopping occasionally and scraping down bowl. Add yeast mixture and capers, if using, beating until blended. Beat in egg. Stir in enough remaining dough to form long loaf. Split in half. Place cut sides of 1 loaf on lightly greased cookie sheet. Dip in hot water. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Brush top with egg, if using. Preheat oven to 425f degrees. Cut top off loaf. Gently transfer top half of loaf, left side up, to parchment or lightly oiled cookie sheet. Score top of loaf in desired pattern with serrated knife. Cover loosely with clean tea towel and let stand 10 minutes. Slash lengthwise from top to bottom. Insert skewer or toothpick through center of loaf. Place on cookie sheet. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden.

title: Cuban Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut in strips | 12 ounces lean hamburger | 1/2 small jalapeno, chopped fine | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/3 cup dried citron ( optional ) | 1/3 cup amaretti
instructions: Put everything in a bowl and marinate for at least an hour or longer.

title: Salmon Fettuccine
ingredients: 4 ounces fettuccine pasta | 4 ounces salmon fillets, skinned and halved
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine salmon and fettuccine in a medium bowl. Drain pasta, reserving 2 cups pasta water. Place salmon on pasta, add water, and toss until salmon is evenly coated. Toss with cooked pasta just until heated through.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,coriander,peanut oil vegetable,coffee powder,walnut oil,beef bouillon cube,sun tomato oil
title: Chinese Tea Leaf Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 kg dried weight ground beef bouillon cube | 1/2 cup ground coriander | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon instant coffee powder | 1 teaspoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/4 cup walnut oil or 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well using hands. Cover and place in refrigerator for 6 hours or overnight. Take out at least 10 minutes before using. Cut with two biscuit/flour knives into small squares and place on a plate. Refrigerate in a covered container for up to 2 weeks or use for flavouring.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper lengthwise,rhubarb,paprika,masa harina,honey,mango chutney,ginger juice
title: Honey Green Chiles with Strawberry Masa
ingredients: 2 cups fresh rhubarb, chopped | 1 cup fresh mango chutney | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1 1/2 tablespoons paprika | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely shredded ginger in juice | 1 green chile pepper, halved lengthwise | 1/4 cup masa harina
instructions: Place rhubarb, mango chutney, paprika, ginger, chile pepper, and masa harina in food processor.

title: Italian Red Lentils & Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 lb red lentil | 4 garlic cloves, crushed or 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 loaf french bread, sliced | 2 tablespoons orange rind, grated | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Prepare the red lentils following instructions on the package. Cook french bread until golden and set aside. Remove french bread from oven and spread lentils evenly on the french bread. Remove french bread and spread garlic cloves evenly on lentils and sprinkle with grated orange rind. Replace french bread and let stand for 5 minutes. Cut french bread into 8 pieces and serve warm with maple syrup or honey.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,extra virgin olive oil,breadcrumb,dark raisin,provolone cheese,mustard powder,mozzarella ball
title: Phyllo Pizza Roll Ups
ingredients: 3 ounces shredded mozzarella balls ( fresh or frozen, thawed ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons light extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon prepared mustard powder | 2 ounces shredded provolone cheese ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup dark raisin ( or golden raisin, sultanas or dried cranberries ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs ( plain or flavored ) | 3 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine all filling ingredients except bread crumbs. Stir well. Mix until smooth. Mix in bread crumbs. Remove one sheet of phyllo dough from freezer and unroll on clean/dry surface. Spread with about 1 2/3 cup of filling mixture, and then with the remainder, working with 1 sheet at a time, keeping phyllo covered with a damp cloth to prevent drying out. Cut into 4 equal parts. Roll each piece into a ball. Place between lightly greased plastic wrap, or a nonstick cooking sheet. Cover with a damp cloth to prevent drying out. Repeat with all 4 pieces. Transfer to a lightly greased or nonstick baking sheet. Repeat once more until you have 8 rolled in phyllo sheets. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until browned. Allow to cool slightly before cutting. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Perfect Beef Sandwiches (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs chuck roast | 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses
instructions: Cut 3 - 4 deep pockets out of beef. Insert a thermometer into each pocket. Combine pomegranate molasses and pomegranate molasses to a small bowl then pour into pomegranate molasses/pomegranate mixture. Cover. Set crock pot to high and set up for 4 - 6 hours. Turn meat 4 times during the last hour. Place meat in a bowl and loosely cover with foil. Let sit for 5 - 6 hours. Slice and serve with greek style bread and a fresh crisp lettuce. Garnish as desired.

title: Sunflower Seed & Raisin Phyllo Parcels
ingredients: 600 g reduced sodium ketchup | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds, roughly chopped | 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 1/4 cups extra sunflower seeds, toasted
instructions: Place the ketchup, raisins and sunflower seeds in a saucepan on a medium heat and bring to a boil. Cover and set aside to cool for 10 minutes or until slightly warm. Remove the sheets of filo from plastic and cover with more sheets. Brush each strip with sunflower seeds. Place on a lightly greased baking tray and bake in a preheated oven at 220 deg c for about 10 minutes, or until golden and crisp. Cool on a wire rack. Store in an airtight container in a cool dry place.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,nori,green grape,pomegranate molasses,soy sauce,venison,chuck,vegetable oil
title: Venison Gyros
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground venison | 1 package plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons pomegranate molasses | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 green grape | 2 sheets nori ( seaweed ) | soy sauce, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine yogurt and molasses. Set aside. Heat the vegetable oil in a frying pan. Add the venison and fry until it produces a few puffs. Add the garlic and marinate, turning once, at least 3 hours, refrigerated, covered. When ready to serve, preheat grill. When ready to serve, break meat into bite sized pieces. Serve with marinated marinated grapes. Warm nori seaweed sheets, cut into 6 - 6 sections. Top each piece with 2 to 4 tablespoons of the yogurt mixture and serve with a sprinkling of sweet soy sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,cake,button mushroom,cherry juice,mozzarella cheese,tomato puree,tamari
title: Mushroom Salad with Cherry Vinaigrette
ingredients: 8 cups button mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup dry crushed tomatoes in puree | 1/4 cup chilled margarine | 1/2 cup cherry juice | 1/4 cup chimari ( japanese fish sauce ) | 1 cup firmly packed fresh mint leaves | 1 pound fresh mozzarella cheese, cubed
instructions: Place mushrooms and tomatoes in a 2 quart casserole dish. Pour enough tomato puree to coat mushrooms, then dot with margarine. Drizzle a little more than half a cup of cherry juice on top, then sprinkle with enough chimari to cover each mushroom. Cover loosely and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight. In the meantime, heat remaining tomato puree and cherry juice over medium high heat. Cook until bubbles rise to the surface, then stir in mint. When ready to serve, remove casserole dish from refrigerator and layer cheese cubes over casserole. Return to refrigerator and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly. If desired, garnish with basil.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,tarragon leaf,bun,gouda cheese,coriander,portobello mushroom cap,vanilla essence,herb
title: Wild Mushroom and Taleggio Bruschetta
ingredients: 2 large portobello mushroom caps, trimmed, sliced | 4 ounces smoked gouda cheese | 4 tablespoons finely fresh herbs, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh tarragon leaves | 6 slices smoked gouda cheese or 6 slices swiss cheese | 2 teaspoons mixed chopped herbs | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 2 teaspoons sweetened vanilla essence | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 8 buns, toasted and toasted
instructions: Remove from fridge and lightly grease a baking tray with non stick cooking spray. Tear mushrooms with the sharp side of a knife into half and set aside. In a small bowl, combine the gouda, 3 tablespoons of finely chopped herbs, 3 tablespoons of lemon juice, sweet vanilla, coriander, remaining 2 tablespoons of lemon juice and essence. Mix well. Tear a piece of cheese into pieces and add to the mixture. Spread mix over the buns. Place the mushrooms around the cheese in the middle and using the edge of a wooden spoon, gently press the sides of the cheese inwards. Brush the mushroom slices with the gouda mixture and place on the baking tray. Bake in a pre heated oven at 190 degrees for 15 - 18 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve with roasted vegetables for a lovely presentation.

title: Chimichurri Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch small green onion, chopped | 1/4 cup sweet pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir well.

title: Smoked Garlicky Gyros
ingredients: 4 thick slices canadian bacon ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads | 1 pinch turmeric | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 pinch of freshly grated smoked garlicky fresh spices ( such as sage, thyme, marjoram, and rosemary ) | salt or sea salt | 2 packets mix ( recommended - tres leches smoky saffron mix ) | 1 romaine lettuce ( preferably large leaves )
instructions: Prep a medium hot fire. Lay the bacon on a piece of aluminum foil, lightly salt it and set aside. Place the saffron in a small bowl, add turmeric, cayenne, smoked garlicky spices, salt, and mix gently until the spices are evenly distributed. Spread on one side of one side of two gyros. Wrap up the bacon and wrap the Gyro with one of the remaining two packets. Wrap the two packets tightly, and leave them in a warm place for 30 minutes or so, until crispy, and hot. Once the first side has crisped up a bit, remove the wraps.

Random Ingredients: coffee liqueur,fillet salmon,cheddar cheese,double cream,grape tomato,salad green
title: Smoked Salmon Roll-Up
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, about 1 3/4 lbs each | 16 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved | 4 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | 12 ounces seedless grapes ( can or jar ) | 1/4 cup coffee-flavored liqueur | 1/3 cup double cream ( can )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the cherry tomatoes, cheese, and berries with the coffee liqueur. Season to taste with salt. Place the salmon in an ungreased rectangular baking dish. Spoon the tomato mixture on top of the salmon. Pour the cream over the salmon. Bake in 400 degree oven for 30 minutes, or until the salmon is easily flaked from the skin. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: clove,chili garlic sauce,green olive,goat cheese,butternut squash,vanilla bean,romaine lettuce
title: Grilled Butternut Squash With Goat Cheese, Green Olives and Chiles
ingredients: 1 lb butternut squash ( peeled, seeds removed and cut into 1/2-inch dice ) | 1/4 cup prepared chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 cup green olives, pitted and chopped | 1/4 cup goat cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla beans, peeled and split | 1 pinch ground cloves | 1 head romaine lettuce, leaves separated | 2 teaspoons fresh chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Place squash in a saucepan, add water to cover and simmer until just tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and cool. Dice squash into 1/2 inch dice. Stir together 1/4 cup chili garlic sauce and remaining chili garlic sauce. Arrange squash, butternut, olives, goat cheese, vanilla bean, and garlic cloves on a serving platter. Sprinkle tops with chiles.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,rose lime juice,walnut oil,tabasco sauce,serrano pepper,coriander,caster sugar
title: Mexican BBQ Fudge (Quesadilla)
ingredients: 225 -250 g walnut oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons rose lime juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons apple cider | 1/2 tablespoon tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | 1/2 tablespoon caster sugar | 25 g ground coriander | 5 teaspoons ground serrano peppers
instructions: First day, mix all ingredients and leave overnight. Wrap mixture into pieces and store in air tight container at cool room temperature for 5 days. Cook time, 30 minutes. Bake 300 - 250 grams until golden brown and remove from oven. Sprinkle with caster sugar. When cool, pour onto clean tea towel. Using towel, blot excess water from towel with paper towels. When sugar is completely absorbed, store at room temperature for 1 week or until soft.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,snow pea,four cheese mexican,egg yolk,wooden skewer,chive,mace,lamb
title: Lamb and Snow Pea Kebabs
ingredients: 6 ounces snow peas, trimmed | 12 ounces boneless lamb, trimmed | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 3/4 cup shredded four-cheese mexican blend cheese | 2 large egg yolks | 2 1/2 ounces finely crunched fresh chives, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | wooden skewer, soaked in water
instructions: Using vegetable peeler, remove strings from snow peas.

title: A-Plus English Rice for One!
ingredients: 1/2 cup arborio rice | maple syrup, warmed
instructions: Combine the rice and warmed maple syrup in a small bowl and serve immediately.

title: Raisin and Dijon Dressing
ingredients: 2 large celery ribs, cut into 1-1/4-inch pieces | 1/3 - 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar, good quality | 2 tablespoons louisiana hot sauce | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Chop the celery and raisins, and place in the container of a food processor fitted with a steel blade. Add the hot sauce, and pulse till the mixture resembles finely chopped cereal. Chill for several minutes before serving. Note, i find it difficult to blend the flavors, because the hot sauce is mostly absorbed in the dressing.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,mango chutney,basil pesto,ginger root,tomato green chilies
title: Smokin', Hot Chipotle-Mango Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 3/4 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 2 teaspoons chipotle powder | 1 tablespoon fresh basil pesto
instructions: Place the tomatoes, mango chutney, ginger, chipotle powder, pesto, and basil into the crock of a electric slow cooker. Cover, and cook until warm and flavors have blended, 3 to 4 hours on high.

title: Broccoli Quesadillas
ingredients: 6 ounces frozen sliced broccoli, thawed and drained | 4 ounces sliced fresh gorgonzola | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 3 tablespoons broth, or as needed | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheet, thawed and kept chilled
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread frozen broccoli evenly over the paper and top with a layer of sliced cheese. Roll out the puff pastry sheets and cut into 8 rectangles. Brush rectangles with picante sauce and top with a second layer of cheese. Top the cheese with a second layer of broccoli and a second layer of cheese. Cut the filled squares into four triangles. Transfer squares one at a time onto the baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 12 to 15 minutes. Cut into wedges and serve warm.

title: Chocolate Aluminium Wrapped Cabbage (Chokladbollar)
ingredients: 1 large head of cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 sheet aluminum foil, separated into 3 equal portions
instructions: Place cabbage in a large nonreactive bowl. Combine cocoa and remaining 3 tbsp water in a small bowl, and drizzle over cabbage, tossing to coat evenly. Place a piece of aluminum foil on a flat surface, and pinch off 3 pieces of foil to fit the ends and corners. Lay several cabbage leaves on top of the foil. Sprinkle with a little bit of the cocoa and/or water mixture, fold the sides in and scrunch up, then tuck the slices of foil around the cabbage into the cabbage. Wrap tightly in the foil, and weigh down with a plate. Place on a parchment lined or floured surface and cover with another piece of foil or other heavy object, placing on top of the parchment. The cabbage can be frozen, or refrigerated for a few days. When you are ready to cook, remove from the foil, and set aside to cool somewhat. Remove it now.

title: Dried and Crown Fruit Tapas - Tapas
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets, 1 1/2 to 2 pounds each | 1/2 cup chopped dates, pitted, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons port wine | 6 chipotle peppers, canned and crushed ( from a 6-ounce can ) | 1 3/4 tablespoons honey | 1/2 cup apricot jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spread olives and dates on a rimmed baking sheet, and roast in the oven for 10 minutes or so, until just softened and beginning to char. Remove from the oven, and set aside. Place nuts in a saute pan and toast over medium heat until fragrant, 1 minute or so. Remove from the heat, and set aside. Stir together the port, 2 chipotle peppers, honey, apricot jam, and 1/2 walnuts in a saucepan, and bring to a simmer. Add the roasted fish to the pan, and saute on all sides for about 5 minutes, or until nicely browned. Place all into a 9x13 inch baking dish, and pour the heated jam overtop. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until fish is cooked through and the topping is dry.

title: Indian Grilled Swordfish
ingredients: 500 g swordfish steaks | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 500 g eggplants | 200 g raw boneless pork, sliced | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon ground coriander leaves | 1 tablespoon orange peel, julienned | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste )
instructions: Mix curry powder with 1 tablespoon of water. Cut eggplants into 2cm thick rings, place on kitchen paper and brush with curry mixture.

title: Blackberry Zucchini Spoon Sweet - Zucchini Spoon Sweet
ingredients: 500 -600 g zucchini | 200 g blackberries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Slice zucchini about 1/8 thick and cook in a little butter, covered with foil, till just softened but not colored, about 10 - 15 minutes. Add blackberries and cook over medium heat, stirring to release their liquid, until almost all of their liquid absorbed. Cool slightly. Wash and peel the zucchini and cut into 1/2 inch thick slices. Place the zucchini in a bowl, and using a fork, toss them well. Mix the blackberry and zucchini through the zucchini in the bowl. Serve at room temperature, or warm, as an accompaniment to grilled meats.

title: Creamy Sweet Potato Dippers
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 1 small fingerling potato, peeled | 1 can fat free sweet potatoes, drained | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 chili, seeded and finely chopped | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Cook bacon in large non stick frypan over medium heat until crisp. Using slotted spoon, remove bacon to paper towel lined plate. Drain bacon fat from pan.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,romaine lettuce,jalapeno pepper,pasta,rigatoni pasta,sirloin steak,beef sirloin steak
title: Sizzling Beef in Pasta
ingredients: 1 medium boneless sirloin steak, 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick | 1 1/3 cups pizza sauce, your favorite | 1 large romaine lettuce | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 cup rotisserie chicken cooked pasta, drained | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked according to package directions ( orzo, or spaghetti )
instructions: Spray skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Set over medium high heat and add beef.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,green bean,grain white rice,green cardamom pod
title: Cauliflower Pilaf With Green Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb green beans, ends cut off | 2 cups long-grain white rice | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 cup cauliflower floret, about 3 to 3 inches in diameter | 1/4 lb thick cut grain white rice
instructions: Steam beans about 30 minutes or until crisp tender. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan of boiling salted water, cook rice until just tender, about 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, steam green beans about 3 minutes, or until tender. Stir in 1 cup of the green beans along with the uncooked rice, the cardamom pods, and cauliflower. Cook until rice is toasted and vegetables are heated through, about 1 minute more.

title: Caribbean Lamb Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs lean lamb shoulder | 1 can pinto beans | 1/2 lb meat | 1 jar cilantro salsa | 1 loaf french bread, cut in half ( or similar )
instructions: Place lamb shoulder in dutch oven. Add 1/2 can of pinto beans plus 1/2 jar of cilantro salsa. Cover and cook slowly for 5 hours. Slice lamb into 1/2 pieces and serve on toasted french bread.

title: Quick, Easy and Easy Egg Noodles
ingredients: 6 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, diced
instructions: In a large bowl, mix eggs and green pepper. In a microwave safe bowl, cook noodles in boiling water until cooked through but firm. Drain. Serve noodles over cooked egg mixture.

title: Salsa and Noodles With Baked Papas and Jicama
ingredients: 3 ounces dried rice noodles | 3/4 white onion, cut into thin wedges | 3 tablespoons baking cocoa | 4 ounces medium salsa | 1/2 lb jicama, thinly sliced ( about 1/3 pound )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add the noodles and stir. When tender, about 5 minutes for the noodles and 16 minutes for the papas. Transfer the noodles and soaking liquid to a bowl and let cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, in a small nonstick skillet, toast the onion over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes. Stir the cocoa into the onion and cook, stirring, until dark and bubbly, about 30 seconds. Stir in the salsa and cook, stirring often, until it evaporates, about 2 minutes. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the cilantro salsa onto a plate and, using a fork, stir in the jicama. Spread the papas and jicama into a 7 x 11 x 1 inch baking dish or deep casserole and top with the remaining cilantro salsa. Bake, uncovered and at 375°, stirring occasionally, until hot, about 30 minutes.

title: Simple White Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb great northern beans, washed and drained | 2 medium scallions, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: In a large souppot, combine beans, scallions, and a generous amount of water. Cover and simmer over low heat 1 hour. Stir occasionally and cook for another 30 minutes to an hour. Remove scallion and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,corn oil,cayenne pepper,pepperoni,pimiento,basil pesto,sugar syrup,taco seasoning mix
title: Quick Taco Salad
ingredients: taco seasoning mix | 1 can refrigerated mixed vegetables, drained, but not well-shredded | 1 jar pimiento, drained in olive oil and patted dry | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon basil pesto | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon sugar-free syrup or 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 package pepperoni, sliced in half
instructions: Prepare taco seasoning mix according to package directions. Toss vegetables, pimientos, oil, pesto, sugar free syrup or brown sugar, and sliced pepperoni in taco seasoning mix. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper seasoning,lamb shank,bean soup mix,canola oil,ricotta cheese,baking powder
title: Lamb and Bacon Shanks
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb shank, chopped ( country style or shoulder tip ) | 2 teaspoons lechpepper seasoning | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper seasoning ( or to taste ) | 1 can fat-free fat-free condensed bean soup mix ( soup can ) | 1 cup fat-free ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Combine lamb, lemon pepper seasoning, and lemon pepper seasoning in ziploc bag. Chill for 2 hours or overnight. Shake bag occasionally. Remove lamb from marinade, reserving marinade. Reserve marinade. Place lamb and marinade in a dutch oven. Cook, covered, over medium high heat for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Remove meat from marinade. Place the dutch oven over medium heat. Stir together the soup mix and ricotta cheese. Spread over lamb and bake, covered, for 30 minutes at 325 degrees f to blend flavors. Add baking powder just before serving.

title: Peanut Butter-Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 1 package reduced fat roquefort cheese | 8 ounces creamy peanut butter | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 1/3 cup finely chopped shallots
instructions: Crush cheese into 1/2 inch pieces over the bowl until all the pieces are in the size they were cooked inches set aside on a plate. Stir remaining ingredients in a blender until smooth and well blended. Stir in cheese and stir until the salad has completely mixed together. Serve with your favorite vegetable.

title: Smoky Caper Tomatillo Soup
ingredients: 1 lb tomatillo, stemmed and cut into half | 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil or 6 tablespoons canola oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla | 6 cups canned low sodium chicken broth | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Heat oil in large saucepan to medium high. Add tomatillos and saute for about 5 minutes, or until skins loosen and blacken. Remove tomatillos with slotted spoon and transfer to a medium bowl. Discard oil remaining in pan. Add onion to pan and saute until soft. Add tomatillos, chicken broth, and saffron. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until tomatillos and broth are reduced by half. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red potato,pineapple juice,rigatoni pasta,red chili pepper flake
title: Spicy Pineapple Spicy Macaroni & Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup red chili pepper flakes | 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 pound red potatoes, cut into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: In a large pot, combine the pineapple juice and chile flakes. Stir in the rigatoni and potatoes. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the potatoes are tender and the rigatoni and potatoes are cooked through, about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Vietnamese Bamboo Shoot Shoot Sauce
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots ( sliced or crushed ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon salt ( optional ) | 1 pinch vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Take your bamboo shoots or crushed ones and mash them into a fine powder. Add to a bowl and mix in the rest of your ingredients. The longer it rests the stronger the flavour is. Enjoy.

title: Cafe Vienna Bread with Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 pizza dough ( store bought is recommended, but can use your favorite dough ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning, to taste | 1 tablespoon coffee, to taste ( optional ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, to taste | 1 -2 tablespoon pizza dough, if desired
instructions: Note, i usually cut the garlic in half and use an apple corer for the juice. Preheat oven to 425 f. Roll out your dough on a floured board, and cut it into 12 squares or circles. Spread the greek seasoning on each circle of dough. Add a bit of the coffee if desired. You may also sprinkle a bit more greek seasoning on each. Bake for about 10 minutes. When done, remove from oven and brush the hot bread with juice. You may also add a bit more greek seasoning if desired. Cut into 6 - 6 pieces. Serve warm. This dough tastes better the longer it sits. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: asadero cheese,couscous,mayonnaise,garlic pepper seasoning,date,tomato soup,plum tomato,mussel
title: Broiled Tomatoes and Mussels
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes, cored | 1/4 teaspoon garlic pepper seasoning, or to taste | 1 pound live mussels - cleaned and debearded | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1 pinch dried asadero cheese | 3 cups cooked couscous | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil. Place plums on aluminum foil.

title: Chinese Chard
ingredients: 1/2 lb swiss chard | 1 -2 tablespoon red chili paste
instructions: Chop the chard coarsely. Combine the chard with remaining ingredients in bowl. Cover and set aside in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Stir before serving.

title: Homemade Fondue
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups fondue ( preferably home made ) | 2 cans pitted black olives | 3 1/3 cups fontina cheese ( grated ) | 3/4 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Put fondue cubes and olives in a fondue pot or large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in cheese, cumin, and remaining 1/2 cup fondue. Transfer to a fondue plate, heat to warm through, and serve with warm tortillas. Serves.

title: Basic Whole Wheat Creole Recipe
ingredients: 11 ounces onion soup mix | 8 ounces whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon sweet paprika
instructions: Prepare onion soup mix according to box directions or envelope directions. In a shallow dish/bowl, mix flour and paprika. Add 1/2 to 3/4 cup soup mix to flour mixture. Add more soup mix if needed. Add more soup mix if desired to form a thick paste. If desired, coat top with paprika. Cook on low heat, stirring once during cooking to prevent burning. If desired, add more water or broth to make a thick creole.

title: Quick, Healthy Delicious Almost Baked Apples
ingredients: 2 bunches mixed vegetables ( eg pumpkin, zucchini, green pepper, green onion, onion and some mix ) | 1 container low fat ricotta cheese | 2 bags pre-made hummus ( plain or flavored ) | 4 medium braeburn apples, peeled, cored, and halved ( or similar seasonal vegetable )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 425 degrees. Toss mixed veggies with ricotta cheese in a 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Spread hummus on top, covering veggies evenly. Arrange remaining vegetables on top, overlapping slightly. Sprinkle top with desired amounts of your favourite spices and serve rightaway.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,capicola,liquid smoke,extra virgin olive oil,mushroom,chive,extra beef
title: Cajun Beef and Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces extra lean ground beef | 6 mushrooms | 1/2 lb capicola | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 3 tablespoons dried chives | 3 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Finely chop the mushrooms. Dice the meat, mushrooms and capicola. Heat the olive oil with the spices. Saute the meat for 5 minutes. Add the mushrooms and the mushroom caps. Cook for an additional 5 - 7 minutes or until tender. Serve in large soup bowls. Garnish with cheese. Serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: banana liqueur,littleneck clam,pistachio,bean,adobo sauce,creme de cacao,thyme leave
title: Mexican Clam Cocktail
ingredients: 2 lbs littleneck clams | 1/4 cup basil & pistachios, coarsely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh thyme leave | 2 fluid ounces banana liqueur ( such as contadina or midazol ) | 2 -4 teaspoons adobo sauce or 2 -4 teaspoons sriracha hot sauce | 1 cup refried beans | 2 tablespoons crumbed and toasted pistachios
instructions: Scrub the clams, removing any beards. Place the clams into a pot of boiling, salted water. Turn off the heat and let clams open up side by side. Do not remove the clam shells, just remove the shells with the clams.. Scrub the insides with a very sharp knife and chop clams or chop coarsely. Stir basil, pistachios and thyme into the chopped clams. Dip in banana liqueur and place into a small saucepan. Pour enough hot water into the pan to cover the clams by 1 inch. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and cook until the clams open, about 5 minutes. Discard any clams that do not open up. Add adobo and mix well. Serve hot with crumbed and toasted pistachios.

title: Beef Strips and Blankets
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs sirloin steaks | 3 ounces condensed milk | 1/2 cup 2 % low-fat milk | 2 teaspoons premade puff pastry, thawed | 3 tablespoons chopped escarole
instructions: Preheat broiler and position rack 6 to 6 inches from heat. Cut beef into 1/2 inch wide strips. Combine 1 1/4 cups milk, 2 teaspoons skimmed milk and 1/2 teaspoon reduced sodium sodium salt in a medium bowl. Add beef strips and toss to coat well. Place pastry sheet on work surface. Spread beef over pastry sheet. Arrange on top of beef. Roll up tightly.

title: Warm Goat Cheese and Snowy Horseradish Dip
ingredients: 2 ounces goat cheese, room temperature | 1 tablespoon soy milk | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 1 1/4 teaspoons curry paste ( i used red curry ) or 1 1/4 teaspoons hot pepper sauce ( i used red curry ) | 1 teaspoon dried strawberry | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Cut goat cheese into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place in small bowl. Spoon horseradish paste into another small bowl. Dip 1 slice of cheese into horseradish paste, letting excess drip off. Toss into goat cheese slices. In food processor or blender, combine remaining ingredients and puree until smooth. Serve chilled.

title: Chilly Creamy Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock ( or stock cubes ) | 1 1/4 cups buttermilk | 1 package tasty oat cereal | 1/4 cup dry instant buttermilk
instructions: In a large heatproof bowl, combine the stock and buttermilk. Stir over medium heat until the soup comes to a boil. Stir in the oaty oatmeal, stir until the mixture is smooth. Reduce the heat to a gentle simmer, cover and return to the stove. Simmer until the cream is reduced by half over about 20 minutes. Pour into heatproof bowls, cover and keep warm until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,black bean,italian seasoning,italian cheese,honey mustard
title: Cuban Spam Sandwich
ingredients: 2 italian cheese | 18 lettuce leaves | 1 can black beans | 1 teaspoon honey mustard | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Place your lettuce into a baking dish. Lay out 1 slice of italian cheese on top of that. Spread a scoop of black beans over the cheese. Sprinkle the top with honey mustard and italian seasoning. Place in the oven for 15 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,heavy whipping cream,cheese,cheddar cheese,pork roast,lime juice,sesame seed,rice wine
title: Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 tablespoon heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 ounces chicken stock or 1 1/2 ounces vegetable stock | 2 ounces shredded mild cheddar cheese | 1 ounce shredded mild mild cheddar cheese | 2 ounces shredded tasty cheese | 4 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds | 1 small boneless pork roast, cut into large cubes
instructions: To make the chile con queso, combine the lime juice, rice wine and heavy cream in a jug. Stir to combine. Set aside for 1 hour or longer.

title: Mexican Tomato Juice, Which Goes Naked
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups pure tomato juice or 3 1/2 cups tomato puree ( 2 cans ) | 4 teaspoons chili oil | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1 pinch salt and pepper | 1 -2 good apple, cut into chunks ( if they are really large, cut into very small chunks, they will fall apart in the cooking process )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan and simmer uncovered on low heat for about an hour or until thickened.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,triple sec,garlic,lamb rack,thyme sprig,shell pasta,beef bouillon granule
title: Lamb Shish Kebab
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb racks, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme sprig | 1 package shell pasta | 1/2 cup triple sec
instructions: Place lamb cubes between two sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap and pound cubes with a meat pounder or rolling pin until the meat is about 1/4 inch thick and 2 to 3/4 of the cubes are large. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over lamb. Let stand 10 minutes. Prepare pasta according to package directions. Thread 2 lamb cubes onto each skewer and thread 3 more lamb cubes onto each skewer. Grill over hot coals or under lightly greased coals 7 to 10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until browned, about 8 minutes per side. Serve with a salad.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,amaretto,shortening,demerara sugar,curry leaf,kale,white rice,baby carrot
title: Lumpia
ingredients: 500 g baby carrots | 100 g white rice ( use kikkoman ) | 100 g green kale | 50 g baby carrots | 20 g amaretto ( almond-flavoured liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 20 g demerara sugar | 10 curry leaves
instructions: Wash the baby carrots well and soak for 30 minutes in water. Boil for 20 minutes. Drain. Wash and trim the kale. Chop into smaller pieces approximately two cm in length. Slice the kale into very small pieces approximately two centimeter wide. Cut the sunflower oil in half and heat it over low heat. Add the sunflower oil mixture. When it is hot, add the carrots and baby carrots. Cook for about 20 minutes. Add the rice and the amaretto. Bring to a boil. Cover and cook for 25 minutes or until the rice is nearly cooked. Drain off the water. Add the demarara sugar and curry leaves and mix well. Remove the lid and stir to mix. Simmer briefly but thoroughly. Serve over basmati rice.

title: Mrs. Olin's Infamous Raisin Cookies
ingredients: 1 lb golden raisin, thawed | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Scoop out 12 x 7 x 1 1/2 inch pieces of raisin using a 2 - 3 inch diameter glass or cookie scoop. Set aside. Preheat oven to 300°f. Spray cookie sheets lightly with cooking spray or grease lightly. Place the raisins, vanilla, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a small bowl and set aside to dry. Place about 1/2 cup raisins into the center of an 8 inch nonstick baking pan that has been lightly coated lightly with cooking spray. Top with 1/8 teaspoon of the dry ingredients. Repeat with remaining cookies to make 12 cookies. Bake 5 minutes, or until edges are lightly browned. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes before removing from pan. Use a spatula to remove the cookies from pan. The cookies should slide right out of the pan onto clean paper towels.

title: Broccoli & Smoked Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch florets | 2 cups thinly sliced smoked fish ( sea bass or other firm-fleshed fish ) | 3/4 cup grainy mustard ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Steam broccoli 10 minutes or until crisp tender. Place broccoli in a large bowl.

title: Easy Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ketchup | 1 cup italian dressing | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Whisk ketchup, italian dressing, red pepper flakes, and olive oil together in a bowl until thoroughly blended. Refrigerate mixture and use remaining dressing for up to 1 week.

title: Crunchy Cheddar Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cheddar cheese ( shredded ) | 4 1/2 cups skim milk chocolate candy bars ( finely chopped ) | 1/3 cup frangelico | 3 tablespoons parsley flakes | 7/8 cup catsup | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix cheeses well in a larger bowl. Add milk chocolate candy bars and french herbs. Mix well until chocolate melts and is all well incorporated. Combine catsup, greek yogurt, 1/2 cup catsup, kosher salt and pepper. Pour into casserole dish and bake until set, about 25 - 30 minutes. Remove from oven and cool completely, about 10 minutes. Run a knife around the edges to loosen and remove cheesecake from pan. Turn over onto a platter and enjoy.

ingredients: 3 lbs top round ground beef | 1 cup chicken soup base | chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | 2 tablespoons garlic flakes | corn tortilla chips | corn tortilla chips ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet, brown the ground beef. Once cooked, break it up as much as you can. Strain the meat into a bowl and mix in the soup base, chipotle peppers and garlic. Bring to a boil and let simmer for about 7 minutes. Spread tortilla chips on a plate and place a large spoonful of the beef mixture on the chips. Roll up and serve when chips are soft and crispy. Guten appetit.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,bacon dripping,beef sirloin steak,lemon juice zest,chicken wing,fruit,salt pepper,caster sugar
title: Chicken Wings in Sour Cream
ingredients: 4 chicken wings | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon vegetable fat or 1 tablespoon bacon drippings | 600 -750 g beef sirloin steaks, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 cup granulated caster sugar | mixed citrus ( optional )
instructions: Poke holes all over chicken wings to allow a secure handle. Place in microwave safe dish, pour in 2 cups warm water and lemon zest and turn to cover in a 600w microwave safe dish. Add vegetable fat or dripping with salt& pepper and cover dish and microwave on high for 7 minutes. Remove chicken pieces to platter. Stir sugar into juices, pour over chicken. Marinate in fridge for 10 minutes, then turn meat over and serve with fresh fruit, if desired.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,chicken stock cube,corn,italian salad dressing mix,white chocolate chip,white creme de cacao,self rising flour
title: Australian Crock Pot Corn and Beef Bake

instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. In casserole dish, combine flour, chocolate chips, creme de cacao, dressing mix, stock, corn and beef.

title: African Barley and Chicken Tagine
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups brown rice ( uncle ben's or other aromatic rice will also do ) | 12 chicken legs ( boneless thighs, drumsticks and wings can be used also ) | 2 teaspoons lemongrass ( fresh and finely crushed ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil oregano and garlic | 1 cup cauliflower ( small florets, chopped into small florets if small ) | 1/2 1/2 cup pearl barley or 1/2 cup barley
instructions: Rinse chicken well and pat dry. Sprinkle lemongrass over chicken and marinate in fridge for 1 hour. Set aside. In a pot bring 6 cups water and pearl barley to a boil, add chicken and simmer for 30 minutes covered.. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 325ºf and prepare another pot by boiling water and barley for 20 minutes or until barley is tender but firm. Rinse chicken again and pat dry. In a heavy 4 quart pot, heat chicken legs until golden on all sides. Remove chicken from pot, cut off pieces and set aside. Add tomatoes, cauliflower florets, and 2/3 cup cooked barley. When rice is cooked, cover and put into preheated oven. Cook covered for 15 minutes. Add chicken to the pot and stir well until chicken is hot throughout. Turn off oven and remove cover. Place the lid back on and place in oven for another 10 minutes. Remove lid and serve.

title: Finnish Broth With Sugar
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups thinly sliced canned bella mushrooms, such as shiitake or shiitake | 2 3/4 cups hot broth | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar for dusting ( optional )
instructions: Stir the bella mushrooms and hot broth together in a small bowl. Spoon mushrooms onto a serving plate, sprinkle with confectioners' sugar and serve with a straw.

Random Ingredients: white potato,orange peel,allspice,rosemary sprig,flour tortilla,bread crumb
title: Roasted Sweet Potato Bread
