instructions: In a bowl, combine the potatoes, bread crumbs, allspice and orange peel. Sprinkle with rosemary and toss to coat evenly. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or foil. Place sweet potato mixture on the baking sheet, and turn to coat evenly. Roast in the preheated oven, 45 to 60 minutes, until tender. Cool, then refrigerate until well chilled. Spoon warm sweet potato mixture onto warmed tortillas. Garnish with additional rosemary sprigs, if desired.

title: Garlicky Steak
ingredients: 1 pound beef top sirloin | 2 tablespoons green curry paste
instructions: Slice the beef into strips 1 inch long x 1/2 inch wide. In a large skillet, fry the steak in hot oil, turning to brown on the all sides. Add the curry paste and cook over high heat, stirring constantly to scrape up the oil. Reduce heat to medium. Add the beef and cook for 5 minutes, or until the beef is heated through.

title: Tahini Cheese (Tahini) for Chicken, Veggies and Noodles

instructions: Prepare sazon and tahini in a pot on a low medium heat stirring constantly. Once it starts to boil remove from heat and transfer the mixture to a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients, mix well. Enjoy.

title: Basic White Bean Dip

instructions: Blend white beans, nutritional yeast, and olive oil together in a blender until smooth.

title: Easy Enchiladas

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 8x8 inch baking dish. Bring a saucepan of lightly salted water to boil. Add corn and cook for 10 minutes or until tender, drain. Combine drained cooked corn and taco seasoning in a bowl. Cut a slit in one side of a cooked manicotti tube and stuff with corn mixture.

title: Grilled Chestnut Lime Curd
ingredients: 1 cup seasoned bread crumbs | 5 fresh limes, juice and zest of, grated | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 2 tablespoons raspberry flavored gelatin
instructions: Place all ingredients except the raspberries in a heavy saucepan and simmer over medium low heat, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, about 25 minutes. Set aside to cool to room temperature. Pour cooled dressing into a freezer bag and pour into a medium bowl. Press plastic wrap onto the chestnut slices to remove excess air. Place sliced mushrooms around the chestnuts and cover with dressing. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Serve cold.

instructions: Toss all ingredients together in a large salad bowl, top with a few mustard greens.

title: Thai Pumpkin Appetizer
ingredients: 2 lbs pumpkin, peeled and cut into chunks | 1/2 cup caesar salad dressing | 3/4 cup alfredo sauce | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon finely chopped lemon grass | canola oil or vegetable oil, for deep-frying
instructions: Place the pumpkin in to a steamer over boiling water. Cover and steam until tender, about 40 minutes. Remove the pumpkin from the steamer, drain, and set aside to cool slightly. title: Cheddar Crunch Apples

title: Beef Tenderloin & Cashew Risotto

instructions: Set a steamer basket in a pot over high heat. Toast the aniseed in a dry medium fry pan. title: Ham and Sheep Pies
ingredients: 2 slices ham, coarsely chopped | cooking spray | 1 cup split peas | 1 1/2 cups rye flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Spray a frypan with cooking spray. Place it over high heat, then stir in the ham, split peas, rye flour, and sage. When the mixture begins to bubble, cover the pan and allow for the bread to pry up on the top. Break the bread into bite sized pieces and serve.

title: "the Saddest Sysnes of the Saddest" - " Bread Stuffing.
ingredients: 2 cups diced white onions | 1/2 cup fresh parsley flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried white wine | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Mix together. Add more or less if desired. To make 1 1/2 cup. Remove stuffing from pan and stuff with stuffing. If desired, cover with a little olive oil, then add melted butter to the drippings. Also add a couple tsp garlic powder to the drippings. I like garlic too. Bake in 425 degree oven for 20 - 30 minutes at 400 degrees.

title: Onion Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons finely chopped onions | 1 cup cilantro leaf, finely minced ( or more, to taste ) | fresh thyme sprig ( or 1 large pinch dried thyme ) | 1 iceberg lettuce, cored and separated into leaves
instructions: Place the onion and cilantro in a strainer over a small bowl and sprinkle with the thyme or pinch of dried thyme. Cover and let drain for 20 minutes. Remove the thyme bundle and rinse out any excess liquid. Place the lettuce leaves in a serving bowl. Ladle the onion/cilantro mixture over them and toss well to coat them. Serve immediately.

title: Healthy Carrot and Apple Smoothie
ingredients: 1 medium carrot | 1 small cooking apple | 4 tablespoons fat-free soymilk or 4 tablespoons skim milk | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Peel and slice carrot with slicer into very thin slices. Peel and cut apple into thin slices. Squeeze out all liquid from apples into blender. Add the soy milk and oregano and pulse until mostly pureed. Spoon into ice cube tray lined with parchment paper. Freeze until solid. Discard frozen liquid. Serve with fresh fruit and/or spices of your choice.

title: Mixed Bean Salad

instructions: Toss salad with garlic, beans and spices. Garnish with grated cheese of your choice just before serving.

title: Spinach Cauliflower and Strawberry Frittata
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, separated into flowerets | 8 ounces mixed baby spinach | 1/4 lb strawberries, cut in half | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 fresh habanero pepper, sliced | 5 egg yolks | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 package store-bought strawberry pesto sauce ( or homemade )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.

title: Homemade Flour Coated Sausages
ingredients: 3 lbs salt pork ( or use dark-colored ) | 1 cup flour | 3 teaspoons salt, divided | 4 - 5 1/2 gallons of good black treacle or 4 -5 1/2 gallons of clean red treacle
instructions: Soak the salt pork overnight, or over night for best results. The next day, put the salt in a colander and place a cloth over it. Put the colander over the salt. When it starts to look clear, put it into the refrigerator. This keeps overnight or for at least three days in the colderest possible conditions. Soak the dough in water for about an hour and a half. When you have a clearer dough, turn it out onto a floured board and knead well, drawing in all the flour from the inside. This will take about 10 to 15 minutes. Divide the dough into thirds. Roll out each part into the sausage form, making sure to leave the fat behind. Spread the fat onto the sausage as before and roll out the second piece of dough until it is long and thin. This will be a very thick sausage form. Put all of the sausage on the greased sheet. Press the fat underneath. Put the second sheet of dough underneath and press lightly in the fat. Repeat for all of the remaining sausage ingredients. Place the sheets in the refrigerator for at least four hours. The fat that will float to the surface at the end of the process, will be very hot. Keep the dough under a cloth or towel. Put each sausages between sheets of greaseproof paper in a well buttered, deep skillet, and press down slightly to remove air bubbles. Fry the sausages in small batches only until they are nicely browned, but not crisp. The temperature of the sosages should be about 300 300f as soon as they are finished frying. They may not be fully cooked all the way through. Remove and drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with salt before serving.

title: Steamed Spinach Leaves
ingredients: 1 kg fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh galangal, or | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rosemary, or | 1/4 teaspoon finely chopped fresh thyme | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt

instructions: Peel and mince chillies.

instructions: Mix everything together, except cashews, and spread a little into each tortilla, as shown in photo. Sprinkle cashews on top of each taco and enjoy.

title: Blackened Beef

instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set a rack 7 inches from the heat source. Sprinkle both sides of the steak generously with coarse black pepper. title: Spicy Cheese Applesauce
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh brandy | 2 bunches fresh coriander, leaves only | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger ( cut into chunks ) | 2 teaspoons dried red peppers | 2 teaspoons onion salt | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 5 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 teaspoons chipotle hot pepper sauce
instructions: Dice the coriander leaves and ginger into rough chunks. Place in a bowl and add the red pepper, onion salt, garlic, tomato paste chipotle hot sauce and ginger chunks. title: Sun Dried Tomato and Beef Pone (Kofta) Patties
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated biscuits ( kofta dough ) | 2 1/2 cups thinly sliced dried beef ( or your favorite instant meat mixture ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1 jar salad oil | 1/2 cup vinegar

instructions: Place all ingredients into a large bowl & mix well using your hands. Shape into 6 patties of approx 1 cm thick. Cook in a non stick frypan of your choice on medium heat for 8 - 10 minutes or until browned on each side.

title: Fish Stew
ingredients: 1 kg red snapper | 1 liter beef stock | 1 cup salami, roughly sliced | 1 cup of grated horseradish | 1 - 1 1/2 cup of grated gin | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish
instructions: Mix the meat, mustard horseradish and water in a large pot. Bring until it boils. Simmer for approximately 3 hours. Add salt to taste. Add the rest of the horseradish.

Random Ingredients: flour,white sugar,green cardamom pod,flat leaf parsley
title: Easy Parsley Parsley Fritters
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh flat leaf parsley | 1 green cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/2 cup flour
instructions: Wash the fresh parsley well, removing as many leaves as possible. You will need to do this in two batches. Do not trim off the root end of the cardamom pods. Wash and dry the parsley well. Place in a large salad bowl and add the sugar. Mix well to blend. Place the flour on a cutting board and add the parsley to it. With a sharp knife slice off 4 1/2 lengths of the parsley. Add to bowl and knead lightly until the mixture leaves the sides of the bowl. Do not over knead. Add a little more flour as needed to keep the mixture from sticking to your hands. Heat frying pan to medium heat, add a tablespoonful of oil and when it's very hot, drop the mixture into the pan, frying until it's fritter sized. Flip them over and fry another 2 or 4 minutes. You want them golden brown on both sides. You can test using one hand, if they sizzle, it is cooked through. The fritters will cook more quickly if the oil is gone before they are done.

title: Yummy & Easy Burritos
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1 can artichoke | 1 can baby peas, and, carrots | 1 bag uncle ben's ready rice | 1 bag red cabbage, sliced | 1 1/2 cups broth | mango - or other toppings ( optional ) | breading ( optional ) | breading ( optional )
instructions: If using broth and rice, combine rice and broth in a large microwave safe casserole dish and microwave, uncovered, on high, 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, stirring halfway through the cooking. Stir beans, artichokes, peas and carrots into rice mixture. Bring to boil, then cover and cook on high 5 minutes. Add cabbage and cook an additional 5 minutes. Meanwhile, remove foil from dish by carefully placing it around edge of dish, then removing excess. Carefully remove dish from microwave and add mango or other toppings. Microwave another 4 minutes to heat through. Serve warm.

title: Chef John's Endive and Onion Wraps
ingredients: 2 small endive, each stalk cut crosswise into 12 slices | 1 green chili pepper blend, red, and cut into strips | 3 tablespoons tapioca, or a few cubes | 2 tablespoons mild montasio chpdarina chopped sun-dried tomatoes with olive oil | 8 drops hot sauce, or more to taste | 1/2 cup shredded low-fat cheddar cheese
instructions: Prepare a small steamer basket with a lid by rinsing them in a colander set in the sink. Place the endives and green chile pepper slices in the steamer basket, and place lid over the steamer basket. Pour enough water over the vegetables to cover the vegetables. Steam until the endives are tender and beginning to fall apart, 12 to 15 minutes. Rinse with cold water, and drain on paper towels. Meanwhile, make tapioca. Break or chop sun dried tomatoes, and set aside. Stir tapioca into vegetable and sun dried tomatoes. Season to taste with hot sauce. Place cheese in a small, ungreased skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,egg wrapper,thyme leaf,limeade concentrate,liquid smoke,cabbage,spicy brown mustard,mozzarella cheese
title: Vegetable Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1 can sliced mushrooms | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1/2 lb shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 egg roll wrap | 1 tablespoon spicy brown mustard | 2 cups shredded cabbage
instructions: Place mushrooms, limeade concentrate, mozzarella cheese, thyme, and liquid smoke in a bowl. Wrap one egg roll wrapper in plastic wrap. Lay wrapper in a shallow pan. Pour water in the pan to reach half up the wrapper. Bring water to a boil. Brush wrapper with mustard and dip in water, coating wrapper with the mixture. Lay wrapper wrapper in pan, and cook for 3 - 5 minutes on each side, until very lightly browned.

title: Roasted Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 4 large poblano peppers ( about 2. 5oz each ) | 2 tablespoons tahini or 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place poblano peppers on a foil lined baking sheet. Broil 2 to 3 inches from the heat until the skin appears charred and blistered. Turn the peppers, close the foil and broil for 10 minutes longer.. When cool enough to handle, cut off the stem and carefully remove the seeds, then peel off the skin. Cut the peppers into 1/3 inch slices. Place the poblano slices on a baking sheet. Brush with oil and broil the poblano peppers for 3 - 4 minutes, just until they begin to turn brown color. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rice,brussels sprout,pizza crust,anchovy,red curry paste,cherry jell o,hot chili sauce
title: Red Curry Rice Pizza with Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1/2 cup brussels sprout ( shredded or chopped ) | 1/2 cup cherry jell-o | 1/2 hot chili sauce ( as per your taste. ) | 1/4 - 1/3 tablespoon red curry paste ( depending on your taste ) | 1 tablespoon pizza crust ( i used boboli ) | 1 tablespoon fresh anchovy ( snipped & chopped ) | 1 -2 tablespoon cooked rice ( i used jasmine ) ( optional )
instructions: Set oven to broil. Put all ingredients in a baking dish & add toppings and mix well. Put baking dish in oven and turn burner to broil. When the tops are starting to darken, remove from oven & place on a plate. I then flip the tomatoes over & peel the skins off of the brussels sprouts. I then scoop the sprouts with a spoon to get all the juice out. If you want to be labor intensive, you can put the brussels sprouts in a bowl, then put them in the skillet with the dressing and let them simmer until they are tender, about 1½ to 2 hours. Enjoy.

title: Pepperoni Japanese Grill Pepperoni Appetizer
ingredients: 1 slice pepperoni | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon japanese sake
instructions: Place pepperoni slice in the center of a slice of cheesecloth. Roll pepperoni slice around pepperoni until tightly wrapped. Roll pepperoni up fast. Seal the ends of the cheesecloth with a little bit of water, and tie tightly with string. Secure with a piece of tomato sauce or skewers if using it. Cook on a grill until cheese has melted some to turn.

title: Rulli
ingredients: 1 kg mutton | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1 tablespoon chunky salsa ( vietnamese sweet food, aji amarillo is a good choice ) | sriracha sauce ( vietnamese sweet food, aji amarillo is a good choice )
instructions: Trim and discard any excess fat and sinew from the mutton. Using a sharp knife, cut into 3 4cm chunks and transfer into a bowl. Add the brandy to the bowl and mix it in, using a little brandy or sambol chili paste to aid the blending. Marinade in the fridge for 30 - 45 minutes. Boil water in the pressure cooker, to seal up the meat. Add the mutton and water to cover and bring to the boil. Add the salsa, stir, ensuring each piece of meat is submerged in the marinade and cook for 10 minutes. Remove the lid and reduce the heat so the meat is just covered. Cook for 5 minutes. Dissolve the honey in the remaining marinade and serve while still hot.

title: Mole Coloradito
ingredients: 2 ounces garlic-infused poblano chiles | 2 serrano peppers or 2 jalapeno peppers
instructions: Roast the chilies over a gas flame, under the broiler, or under the broiler as you would for charcoals or an outdoor grill and turn them occasionally. When all the chilies are roasted, brush them with a half teaspoon of olive oil and place, close together, in a small paper bag and seal. Let the chilies cool to room temperature. When they are cool, slit them down one long side. Do not remove the seeds. Rinse them carefully under cool running water and dry with paper towels. Use immediately or store in the refrigerator or refrigerate for up to two days. Place the minced chilies in a food processor and blend or pulse until coarsely chopped. Remove the chilies from the bag and finely chop them or place them in a bowl and add minced green chilies. Serve on lettuce leaves for a lunch or as a dip.

title: Yaya's Easy Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 cans stewed tomatoes with juice | 8 tablespoons margarine | 1 medium onion, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in pot. Cook for 30 - 45 minutes, or until very thick, stirring often.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,water chestnut,cottage cheese,egg white,pineapple chunk juice,cooking oil
title: Chinese Stuffed Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 can pineapple chunks in juice, drained | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1/2 cup cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix egg white and water. Cut off top 1/4 head of cabbage, and scoop out all of the soft green, white center. Core the head, and scrape out the seeds. Cut a slit down the length of the core. Fill with egg mixture. Then pinch the top of the head closed so it will lie flat in a glass baking dish. Coat outside of the hollowed cabbage with cooking oil. Place lid on dish, and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until water is absorbed and cabbage is soft.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,orange peel,hot red chili pepper
title: Orange Peel Beef
ingredients: 1 bottle hot red chili peppers | 12 slices orange peel ( about 2 x 1/4-inch ) | 3 -6 lbs beef brisket ( or other large steak and cut up )
instructions: Remove the tough outer pith at sides of the chili peppers.

title: Baked Lentils
ingredients: 1 lb dried lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. In a 2 qt baking dish spread ¾ cup of the lentils and ½ - 3 tbs of the sour cream. Repeat the process and add the lentils, another ½ tbs of sour cream and the remaining ½ cup of sour cream. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes, checking after 30 minutes of baking. Reduce the oven temperature to 400 degrees f and bake for an additional 15 minutes.

title: Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 cup dry red wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Tear off a 10x15 inch jelly roll pan. Place pork tenderloin in pan and spread evenly with red wine. Roast in the preheated oven, about 35 minutes.

title: Almond Croutes
ingredients: 250 g unblanched almonds ( in very very very hot water, shelled ) | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon almond essence, powder ( optional )
instructions: Spread the blanched almonds on a cookie tray and bake in a moderate oven, stirring occasionally for 8 - 10 minutes until golden brown. Drain and shake them out of their skins. Put the almonds to one side and put the sugar, almond essence, almond extract and some freshly ground black pepper on the almonds. Using a little almond essence, pour it over the almonds and let the almonds dry out. Cut into squares or finger shaped biscuits and serve with melted ice.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,chicken breast,wheat flour,cucumber,red wine,pesto sauce,butter,nori
title: Chicken Bites
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain pesto sauce ( pesto will do or any other brand will do, can use basil too ) | 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts, cut into 2. 5 by 1. 5 inch squares | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 2 ounces butter ( at room temperature ) | 6 sheets nori, torn into pieces | 2 small cucumbers, thinly sliced julienne
instructions: Stir together tomato pesto sauce and set aside. Place 1 chicken squares in a bowl and stir with a pinch of baking soda. Add 1 tablespoon of flour and mix. Use fingers to rub in the batter of butter to make a crumbly, all purpose flour mixture. Turn over and coat with crumbs. Heat 1 minute butter in nonstick skillet, then cook chicken 4 - 5 minutes or until golden brown on both sides, remove, allow to rest 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,cumin seed,straw mushroom,peanut oil vegetable
title: Spicy Fried Nuts (Beef Chopsticks)
ingredients: 4 large fresh whole unpeeled raw peanuts, toasted | 2 cups peanut oil or 2 cups vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon whole cumin seed | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck
instructions: Slice the chuck, across the grain, into 1/8 inch thick slices. Arrange the slices on a platter, leaving space between them so they are easier to hold together. In a small skillet over medium heat, toast the peanuts, shaking the skillet frequently, until golden and fragrant, 3 to 4 minutes. Cool peanuts on waxed paper. Wipe out the skillet with paper towels and place a large wok over high heat until very hot. Add 2 tablespoons oil. When it is very hot, add cumin seeds, shaking the skillet frequently, until a richly colored bead of roasted cumin seeds is released, about 30 seconds. Add beef and fry until brown on all sides, then transfer to a platter and set aside. Continue in this manner, adding oil 1/2 cup at a time and stirring constantly until the oil is very thin and beginning to shimmer, 5 to 10 minutes. Towards the end of cooking time, use a slotted spoon to lift the meat and brown the pieces in 2 or 3 batches, using a slotted spoon, or drain the meat in a colander as before. To serve, top the platter with the peanuts and serve.

title: Chef Jack Quesadilla
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked chicken tender cubes | 1/2 pound roast beef, thinly sliced | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pit chicken tenderloins with a butcher's knife into paper thin strips.

title: Broccoli Parcel
ingredients: 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie | 1 package frozen broccoli florets | 1 container plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 3 tablespoons light olive oil
instructions: Place broccoli in microwave safe bowl.

title: Quick Meatball Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 750 g frozen meatballs
instructions: Stir fry onion flakes and meatballs in a little oil until golden. Then serve over rice or cooked noodles.

title: Low-Fat, Sticky Terrine
ingredients: 5 ounces oat, roughly chopped | 5 ounces small courgettes, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/4 3 ounces dried mixed fruit or 1/4 cup chopped fresh fruit
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/425°f. Combine the oat and courgette in a bowl with sesame oil, vinegar and fruit. Place in an ovenproof dish and bake for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned. Remove from the oven and slice into quarters. Serve with fat free yoghurt.

title: Guacamole Asparagus
ingredients: 8 ounces asparagus | 3 tablespoons potato starch ( not potato starch ) | 1 -2 teaspoon guacamole | 1/2 - 1 serrano pepper, de-seeded
instructions: Remove tips from asparagus, discard tough ends then slice 1/2 inch thick. In a bowl put simply 1 tbsp potato starch, guacamole and serrano pepper, stirring to combine well then put tips of asparagus into food processor or chopper bowl. Pulse until mixture forms a ball. Put mixture into a bowl with the tips of asparagus, stir well.

title: Italian Dressing for Flatbread or Cannellini Bean Sips
ingredients: 1 jar pizza sauce | 1 dash red wine vinegar
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, mix the pizza sauce, vinegar and red wine vinegar until creamy. To serve, place a thin slice of the cannellini bean on a flatbread or tortilla and spread desired amount of cheese on top. Use a generous amount on each other.

title: Mexican Oyster Dip
ingredients: 4 oysters, shucked and left on the shell | 1/2 bunch cilantro, leaves | 1 bunch cilantro, leaves
instructions: To remove the dirt from the oysters, remove the beard from a good sized scallop or sashine cap. Carefully remove the cap, which will cause the juices to float to the bottom. Rinse the cap with fresh water to clean the coral and sand. This will help to loosen the oyster coral a bit. Dry the cap on a dry towel and place in the bowl of a food processor. When the cap is done, measure the juices and discard them. Combine all of the ingredients in a medium saucepan large enough to hold all of the oysters in one layer and heat gently, breaking up the bits of shell with a wooden spoon.

title: Irish Chocolate Candy
ingredients: 24 ounces semisweet chocolate squares | 1/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup peanut oil, chocolate, and 1/4 cup peanut oil in a heavy heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring frequently, until chocolate is melted and smooth.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,lemon peel,kaffir lime leaf,taco seasoning
title: Lemony Fresh Taco Filling Substitute
ingredients: 2 cans cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf, shredded | 3 teaspoons taco seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the cream of tartar and grated lemon peel. Stir in taco seasoning, pour into resealable plastic bag. Add cream of tartar mixture to bag, and shake to remove any air bubbles. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Refrigerate for up to 1 week. Bring desired amount of filling to room temperature before adding to filling.

Random Ingredients: white flour,gin,rice wine,grenadine,green chile,iceberg lettuce,beef bouillon,palm sugar
title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef round | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 can evaporated giardiner's green chilies ( i buy them canned ) | 1 bunch greens | 2 cups cold water | 1 cup low cal white flour or 1 cup rice flour | 1 teaspoon freshly grated palm sugar | 1/4 ounce grenadine | 3 tablespoons chilled gin | iceberg lettuce, shredded ( to garnish )
instructions: Cut greens in 4 wedges and place on separate plates. Cut chiles into small squares. Place round steak into a large frying pan and brown well on each side. Drain off fat. Sprinkle green chilies over meat. Add beef and coat with 1/2 of the white flour. Add 2 cups cold water, vinegar, palm sugar, grenadine and gin. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Pour over greens and sprinkle with reserved sugar. Serve hot with rice. Garnish with extra iceberg lettuce.

title: Bibb and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 leaf green pepper | 2 leaves bibb lettuce
instructions: Place both pieces of lettuce into a non stick frying pan. When half done, remove to serving plate. When cool to the touch, slice the pepper in thin rings. Place the pepper rings on top of the lettuce and serve at room temperature.

title: Simply Potatoesatoes Skillet
ingredients: 2 cups shredded hash browns | 1 avocado | 1/3 teaspoon horseradish | 1 green pepper, seeded & diced | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Combine hash browns & mashed avacados. Stir in horseradish, green pepper, & cheese. Heat till cheese melts.

title: Tex-Mex Tacos
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/4 cup light coconut cream
instructions: Combine everything in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high power for 6 minutes, stirring after 2 minutes. Turn off microwave. Stir in coconut cream.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,dark rum,great northern bean,celeriac,golden mushroom soup
title: Spanish Cannellini Beans (White Beans)
ingredients: 1 pound dried great northern beans | 1 pound celeriac | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1 jar jalapeno chiles, sliced and with juice | 2 dashes dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Rinse beans, and place in a large pot. Fill the pan with warm water to cover the beans. Bring beans to a rolling boil, skim off any foam that rises to the surface. Turn heat down to medium low, and simmer until beans are tender, about 1 hr 30 minutes. Drain them well. When cool enough to handle, place them in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer gently until tender, about 1 hour. Drain the beans and celeriac and place in a large pot. Cover, and set aside. In a separate large pot, heat mushroom soup, jalapenos and rum. Pour over the beans, celeriac and vegetables.

title: Crispy Vegetarian Enchilada Rice Paper Wraps (Vegan)
ingredients: 10 sheets prepared rice paper | 1 cup red enchilada sauce, divided | 1/8 cup cereal, sweetened to taste | cornmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lay one rice paper sheet in a stack on 2 plate and top with 5 sheets, overlapping to fit.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,turmeric,spanish onion,chicken breast,white rice,cardamom,yellow food coloring
title: Spicy Chicken on Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs skinless chicken breasts, cubed | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | 1 white rice, washed and drained | 3 tablespoons yellow food coloring | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 2 tablespoons spanish onions, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dry yellow food coloring
instructions: In a large bowl, place the cubed chicken, onions, yellow food coloring, turmeric and cardamom. Mix well with your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 4 hours. After 4 hours, remove chicken and keep aside. Stir fry with 2 tblsps. Of water until just cooked. Set aside. Heat the remaining 1 tblsps. Of water and add rice. Mix well. Cover. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Uncover. Add the marinara sauce and cook for a further 10 minutes. Add 2 tblspsps. Of water and mix well. Cover. Cook over low heat until rice is completely cooked. Uncover. Mix well. Serve warm. Tip, it is important to not overcook the chicken as it will be cooked in the dish. Instead, cut the meat in cubes. This will result in the resulting chicken in a dish and more flavor. Instead of the meat, heat it in the microwave and mix well with the sauce.

title: Chochate Molto
ingredients: 6 leaves fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1 package dried espresso or ( 2 ounce ) package strong brewed tea, brewed lightly | 2 whole cloves | 1/4 cup instant espresso powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender jar, cover tightly and process until fine cornmeal consistency. Let stand at room temperature until completely cooled, about 4 hours. Transfer mixture to air tight container for storage.

Random Ingredients: cheese food,dark chocolate,red bell pepper,italian salad dressing mix,cream,american cheese,tuna
title: Italian Tuna Covered Spicy Spread
ingredients: 1 can tuna ( drained, oil reserved ) | 1 container italian salad dressing mix | 1 red bell pepper ( finely chopped ) | 1 -2 tablespoon shredded cheese food ( i used kraft deli cheese and it was so good ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup shredded american cheese ( i used mozzarella ) | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate ( not unsweetened )
instructions: Drain tuna and pat dry with a paper towel. Place tuna, italian dressing mix, red pepper, cheese food crumbs and sour cream in a bowl and mash together. Spread the mixture into a 9x13 inch pan. Bake at 350°f for 30 - 45 minutes or until heated through and the topping is browned. Sprinkle with american cheese and dark chocolate.

title: Crock Pot Cashew-Stuffed Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon quick-cooking oats | 1 package refrigerated pizza dough ( i use gold medal ) | 1/2 cup cubed velveeta cheese | 1/4 cup chopped dry roasted cashews | 2 tablespoons cognac or 3 tablespoons brandy ( optional )
instructions: Add oats and cheese to crock pot. Add cashews. Add cognac, if using. Add dough according to directions. Stir to blend. Cover and cook on low for 4 - 5 hours. Use two forks to pull dough apart. Stick a fork into the middle of each piece to help distribute the liquid during cooking. Remove from crock pot and serve topped with a dab of sour cream if desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: catsup,sunflower seed,green chili,dark rum,baby carrot lengthwise
title: Tropical Carrots
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark rum ( or bacardi light rum ) | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds | 1 small green chili | 1 baby carrots, halved lengthwise
instructions: Place the rum or bacardi light rum in a shallow, non metallic dish, cover and marinate overnight. Heat oven to 350°f place the carrots in a roasting pan and arrange in a single layer. Sprinkle with the sunflower seeds and chillies. Drizzle with the rum mixture, bake in the oven for 30 mins or until the carrots are tender. Drizzle with a little extra rum if liked and serve in shallow soup bowls.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,double cream,orange juice,rigatoni pasta,butter,thyme sprig,golden syrup,egg
title: Parsley & Garlic Pasta With Orange Syrup
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta or 12 ounces fettuccine | 2 ounces butter | 3 hard-boiled eggs | 3/4 cup orange juice ( freshly squeezed ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup ( maple syrup ) | 1 tablespoon thyme sprigs | 2 ounces fresh orange juice | 1/2 cup double cream
instructions: Cook pasta as directed for the packet. Drain well and set aside. Meanwhile, melt butter in a saucepan. Chop hard boiled eggs, add to pan and cook gently for 2 - 3 minutes or until the eggs are just set. Whisk in the orange juice, syrup and thyme. Reduce heat and continue to simmer until sauce thickens slightly. Taste and adjust seasoning. Whisk in cream until incorporated. Set aside. Cook pasta for 4 - 5 minutes or until al dente. Drain and return to pan. Pour sauce over pasta. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Beef and Mango Burgers
ingredients: 1 kg beef chuck, cut in 5 cm cubes | 1 egg yolk | 50 g fresh tarragon or 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 ripe mango ( peeled, seeded, and cut into chunks ) | 2 buns or 2 whole wheat english muffins, split
instructions: Beat the yolk with a fork and add the tarragon and mix. Add the beef cubes and mix well, coating all the meat. Cover the wok or frying pan and heat the oil. Add a large pinch of salt and the meat and break into chunks. Do not over crowd the pieces, leave them seared if desired as the meat will probably burn during cooking. Fry until browned and tender. Meanwhile, combine the mango chunks and buns and toast under the grill until golden. Serve with the meat and mango topping.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,pork,dill weed,turmeric powder,chili pepper,orange marmalade,large shrimp,eggplant
title: Fried Spicy Pineapple (Eggplant) With Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs medium eggplants | 3 cans of sliced italian canned mushrooms ( drained ) | 3/4 cup orange marmalade | 1/2 lb sliced pork ( sliced into strips ) | 1 dash chili pepper ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 pinch dill weed
instructions: Slice eggplant very thin.

title: Baked Beans With Baja Chips
ingredients: 2 cans fat-free refried beans | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: Heat over to boiling. Add taco seasoning, stir. Pour beans into a pan sprayed with pam. Bake until beans are browned and crispy. Serve on buns with salsa and guacamole.

title: Pineapple Broccoli Beans
ingredients: 1 box frozen broccoli florets | 2 cans baked beans, undrained | 1/4 cup butter | 1 can pineapple, drained
instructions: Place broccoli in microwaveable bowl.

title: Dale’s Superb Barley Bean & Barley Bean Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons dark red kidney beans | 1 cup pearl barley, rinsed & drained
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring liquid to a boil, then reduce heat & simmer, covered, for 45 - 55 mins, until barley is tender.

title: Creamy Sweet and Sour Tiramisu
ingredients: 30 large ladyfingers | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Prepare ladyfingers according to package directions using pepper and salt to taste. When ready, dip each ladyfinger in sauce, ensuring both sides are coated. Place 1 to 2 tablespoons of sauce into a 12 x 9 inch glass dish, spreading it out evenly. Arrange half of the ladyfingers over sauce.

title: Grilled Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coconut flour | 2 teaspoons basil | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons lime | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil | 4 pounds chicken wings | 2 pounds kielbasa, cut into 2-inch slices
instructions: Combine the coconut flour, basil, garlic powder, hot pepper sauce and lime juice in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,yogurt,sourdough bread,curly leaf parsley,tamari,vanilla soymilk
title: Mock Tofu (Tofu) Rolls. (Vegetarian.)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vanilla-flavored tamari | 1/3 cup creamy yogurt, plain | 1/4 teaspoon tamari | 1 cup plain sourdough bread, cut into 1 cubes ( about 5 ounces ) | 1/3 cup curly-leaf parsley, fresh, minced | 1/4 lb puff pastry
instructions: For the crust, in a medium bowl, whisk together the flour and tamari until well blended. Add the yogurt and tamari and whisk until well blended and smooth. Transfer the mixture to a bowl. Stir in the bread. Knead the dough on a floured work surface lightly for 5 minutes. Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let rest for 20 minutes. Divide the dough into 8 even pieces. On a lightly floured surface, roll each piece out to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut into 2 inch squares about 1 1/2 inches wide. Transfer them to a lightly greased baking sheet. Brush the tops of the squares with warm water and sprinkle with the parsley. Bake the squares, 2 at a time, for 10 to 12 minutes or until well browned. Serve warm. Note, if using the soy milk, use tamari instead of water.

title: Fennel Roast Mushrooms (Cook's Illustrated)
ingredients: 10 -12 large dried fennel ( about 1.5 lbs. ) | 1 tablespoon instant potato flakes or 1 tablespoon instant aubergine flakes | 2 portabella mushrooms, trimmed
instructions: Prepare roasting pan with nonstick cooking spray, or cover and place in a hot oven. Roast mushrooms, uncovered, in a shallow dutch oven or heavy pot over high heat, stirring frequently and painting with cooking spray, until golden, about 12 minutes and up to 25 minutes. Let cool slightly, then slice mushrooms into 1/2 inch rings and serve.

title: Mochokado (Filipino Chicken)
ingredients: 3 chicken breast fillets or 1 turkey breast | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/3 cup water chestnut, chopped | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 tablespoon pepper | shredded lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: Rinse the chicken fillets well and pat clean. Place the chicken in a pan with a tight lid and fill with tomato soup, water chestnut, pepper and cocoa. Let simmer on low and cook for about an hour, stirring every 15 minutes to keep the sauce simmering and the chicken cooked through.. Garnish with shredded lettuce.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,pineapple juice,kiwi fruit,red chile pepper,pot roast,cabbage,butter
title: Sweet Potato, Fruit, Kiwi Pot Roast
ingredients: 4 kiwi fruits ( i use frozen ones ) | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 large head cabbage, finely shredded | 4 small red chile peppers, minced | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 can unsweetened pineapple juice | 3 pounds boneless pot roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove the root end from kiwifruit pieces by smashing the flesh to form long strips or cut off the tops of the kiwifruit slices. Place kiwifruit pieces in a baking dish, and dot the surface with butter. Bake kiwifruit, kiwifruit pieces, and sliced chile peppers in the preheated oven, or until kiwifruit is tender, about 30 minutes. Remove kiwifruit pieces from oven, and mix in cream of mushroom soup, pineapple juice, and hot pepper sauce.

title: A New Corn on the Cob - Canning Recipe

Coat baking sheet with cooking spray. Layer spinach, egg, and hot sauce in the prepared pastry sheets. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Cook on the prepared sheet until lightly browned, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,self raising flour,italian herb seasoning,cheddar cheese,bread crumb,fontina cheese,fennel bulb
title: The Best Cheddar and Fontina Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, halved, cored and sliced | 7 ounces shredded cheddar cheese | 7 ounces shredded fontina cheese | 3 tablespoons bread crumbs | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup soft bread crumbs | 1/4 cup italian herbs seasoning | italian herb seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Place the fennel bulbs into a roasting tin and roast for 30 - 40 minutes, or until tender. Allow to cool, then slice into 1/2 slices. Place 3/4 cup of the shredded cheeses in a bowl, and stir in the bread crumbs, vinegar, bread crumbs and italian herbs. Remove the fennel from the oven and roll slices into the bread crumb mixture to coat well. Place rolls onto a tray and sprinkle with italian herb. Return to the oven for 15 - 20 mins, until lightly browned and hot. Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side.

title: Banana Apricot Bread Salad
ingredients: 4 slices sourdough bread | 1/3 cup apricot ( minced fresh apricots ) | 2 green bananas | 1/2 teaspoon fresh gingerroot ( minced ) | 1 green onion ( sliced thinly ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Cut the bread diagonally into 1/4 inch slices. Place in a bowl. Slice the banana in half, lengthwise, then cut almost through and then crosswise into 1/8 inch wide slices. Remove and discard the pit and then slice into long thin strips. Add the remaining ingredients and toss to coat. Serve at room temperature or chilled. Note, this can be served warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,pepper sauce,star anise,fish fillet,maraschino cherry,topping,prosciutto,panko breadcrumb
title: Philly Mail Carrier Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 pounds beef short ribs, rolled and tied | dried maraschino cherries | 8 slices prosciutto | topping : | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh maraschino cherry | 1 tablespoon fish fillet-flavored maraschino cherry | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce | 1 star anise
instructions: Place beef short ribs in a shallow baking dish. Pour maraschino cherries over and around the short ribs. Wrap prosciutto around the short ribs and secure with a twist of kitchen twine. Cover dish with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pour 1 cup panko bread crumbs into a shallow bowl. Spread about 100% of the chopped arisette cherry over the crumbs.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,kosher salt,pear,zucchini,canola oil,chipotle chile,mandarin orange,chicken patty
title: Spicy Chipotle Stir Fry
ingredients: 9 ounces chicken patties ( about 1/2 lb. ) | 1 small zucchini, cut into thin rounds | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained ( juice reserved ) | 1 jar pickled pear slices, drained | 2 teaspoons minced canned chipotle chiles, from a jar | 1/3 cup canola oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced chipotle chiles, from a jar | 12 hamburger rolls, split
instructions: Cut each patti in half horizontally to make 2 large patties. If you need to thin them out, add another 1 tablespoon oil. If you need less, use 2 - 2 teaspoons of chipotle powder. Place patties in a shallow dish and season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate while preparing patties. In a large skillet or wok of choice, heat 1 tablespoon of canola oil over medium high heat. Add 1/3 of the patties and cook, turning patties occasionally, until browned well, about 3 - 4 minutes. Transfer to paper towel lined plate. Repeat with 2 additional patties. Return skillet or wok to medium high heat and add 1 teaspoon chipotle powder and 1 tablespoon of chipotle juice. Add canola oil, remaining chipotle chili spice and a few spoonfuls of mandarin oranges. Cook, stirring, until the sauce has reduced and has thickened slightly, about 1 - 2 minutes. Spoon over patties. Sprinkle with remaining chopped chipotle. Serve over a bed of hot cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,margarine,jeera powder,yellow onion,garbanzo bean,sunflower oil,chicken breast fillet
title: Chicken and Chickpeas in Roasted Chutney
ingredients: 1 small yellow onion, peeled and chopped | 1 teaspoon jeera powder | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 4 chicken breast fillets, skin removed | 1/2 cup chopped mango chutney | 1/3 cup garbanzo beans | 1 tablespoon margarine
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place onions in a roasting tin, sprinkle with the jeera, and cover with baking paper. Roast for 25 minutes, stirring to ensure no bits of brown or caramelised onions are left. Cool completely. Heat oil in a frying pan, and fry chicken for 4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown. Remove from pan, stir in chaat masala, and cool. Place the chickpeas, mango chutney, and a pinch of salt in a blender and puree until smooth. Place the chicken on serving plates, and spoon chutney on top.

Random Ingredients: black bean,bean,white bean,masala,pistachio,tamarind paste,sharp cheddar cheese,avocado
title: Chili Bean Dip
ingredients: 15 ounces white beans ( drained & rinsed ) | 15 ounces beans ( undrained ) | 15 ounces black beans ( drained & rinsed ) | 15 ounces refried beans ( use a mix of red & black beans ) | 15 ounces masala ( use good quality ) | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 3 avocados, peeled & diced | 9 tablespoons unsalted pistachios, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients, except pistachios, into a food processor and process until smooth. Spoon into greased bowl. Bake at least 1 hour or until bubbly. Top with chopped pistachios and serve hot with crackers.

title: Cashew Beer (Or Beef or Pork Fondue)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cashew nuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup bread flour | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 3 leaves fresh spinach, thick stems removed and chopped | 1/4 cup beer, dark ( can use apple juice if you wish ) or 1/4 cup chicken broth ( can use apple juice if you wish ) | 4 teaspoons basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine nuts and flour in a food processor and process until well mixed. Slowly add remaining ingredients and process until well mixed. Transfer to a small serving dish and refrigerate until slightly hardened. Drain any excess liquid from the pan and serve.

title: Hoggin Mayonnaise for Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons scotch bonnet peppers | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Mix the mayo, mustard, chile powder and bouillon in a bowl. Serve with salmon.

title: Roasted Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Wash red bell pepper under running water, and cut off stems, and scrape out seeds. Place whole pepper on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes, turn over, and bake for an additional 10 minutes. Remove peppers, and cover with foil to keep warm. Place 1/4 cup brown sugar in a small cup or bowl. Dip peppers into sugar. Place on baking sheet, and bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until sauce is reduced and syrupy about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,ramen noodle,shiitake mushroom,pumpkin,pear,seasoning salt,chicken breast
title: Gingered Ramen Chicken and Pumpkin
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 4 ounces pumpkin or 4 ounces winter squash, cut in bite size pieces | 2 tablespoons finely sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1 green bell pepper, finely julienned | 2 tablespoons finely chopped canned pears ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 package ramen noodles ( exclude seasoning packet )
instructions: Rinse and pat dry chicken. Slice or chop chicken into 1 inch pieces. Cut pumpkin or winter squash into 1 inch pieces/cups. Cut bell pepper in half and place in a saucepan with a splash of water. Add seasoning salt and pears, if using. Bring to a boil. Add chicken and cook 5 minutes or until cooked through. Drain, cool and marinate chicken and vegetables in ramen sauce in a zipper lock bag for approximately 2 hours. After marinating the chicken and vegetables, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the ramen noodles and stir for approximately 2 minutes, or until noodles are al dente. Toss chicken and vegetables with the ramen noodle and serve.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,onion soup mix,phyllo dough,grapeseed oil
title: Grandma's Phyllo Dough
ingredients: 1 jar onion soup mix | 3 packages frozen phyllo dough | 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 2 tablespoons palm sugar or 2 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Prepare onion soup mix according to package directions. Cut phyllo dough into 12 squares and line baking sheets with parchment paper, allowing sheets to go all the way around the pan. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Using a fork, dissolve the gum in the onion soup mix. Brush the pastry with oil and place a row of pastry diagonally across the bottom of a small baking dish. Spoon the soup mixture into the phyllo pastry in a circular motion. Sprinkle in the palm sugar. Repeat with the rest of the pastry and layers. Place in oven and bake until pastry is golden and crisp or a toothpick inserted in the center of the phyllo dough comes out clean. Cool in the refrigerator until cool, about 30 minutes. Use a brush brush or small pastry brush to spread the extra greek goodness onto the cooked phyllo dough and let it sit until all the phyllo dough is frozen.

title: Campania's French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cheddar cheese soup | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 225f degrees f. Place soup cans in a 3 quart casserole dish. Mix well. Sprinkle with chives. Bake in preheated oven for 6 to 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pickling spice,four bean mix,white wine vinegar
title: Two Beans(Pickling and Refreshing)
ingredients: 1 package dry yellow split bean mix | 1 bunch five-spice pickling spice | 2 cups dry white wine vinegar | 2 1/2 cups dry white wine vinegar
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the yellow split bean mix and pickling spice. Seal. Over medium heat, bring one cup of the vinegar to a boil, stirring frequently. Reduce the heat to low.

title: Sear the Fish
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs fresh fish fillet | 1 large red potatoes or 1 medium yellow potato, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Bake fish on a foil lined pan in a 450°f oven for 45 minutes to brown. Cook potato in boiling water to cover for 12 minutes.

title: Strawberry and Strawberry Hoagie
ingredients: 1/2 cup hoagie | 1 cup shredded fresh strawberries | 2 1/2 teaspoons soy milk
instructions: Spread hoagie with soy milk. Top with strawberries and then top with remaining hoagie, swiss cheese, etc.

title: Brown Rice With Nuts and Beans (Fiorina Con Gandules)
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice ( long grain, not short grain ) | 250 g frozen peas | 3 tablespoons dried porcini mushrooms | 10 g dried cannellini beans, or 200 g canned cannellini beans | 1 tablespoon chopped shallots | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/8 teaspoon dried ajwain ( caribe ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped unsalted dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Rinse and drain the rice and let it stand for 10 minutes. Bring 2 1/2 liters of hot water to the boil to cook the rice in a microwave oven on high power for 1 minute. Add peas, mushrooms and bean peas and cook for 2 minutes. Add shallots and season to taste with salt. Recuce the heat to low, cover and cook for 18 - 20 minutes, or until the rice has absorbed the water. Stir once, then remove from the heat and allow to stand, covered, for 15 minutes. Place the peanuts, or grated cheese, in a bowl and crush with a fork or fork. Keep the bowls covered.

title: Cheddar and Canadian Bacon Sausage Loaf
ingredients: 12 ounces shredded canadian bacon | 1/2 lb grated sharp cheddar cheese | 2 1/4 teaspoons instant yeast or 1/2 teaspoons soft fresh yeast | 2 lbs ground chicken or 2 lbs ground turkey
instructions: Crumble the Canadian bacon into a bowl and crumble in the cheese. Dissolve the yeast in 1/4 cup warm water and let sit to proof. When the yeast has proofed, add the yeast mixture, chicken and the rest of the ingredients and mix together. Put the mixture into small 2x4 inch loaf pans or cookie sheets and let rise until doubled in bulk, approximately 20 minutes in a warm place. Bake at 375 degrees for 50 - 55 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Mexican Sausage and Grape Appetizers
ingredients: 5 italian sausages | 1 bag red seedless grapes
instructions: If you are using texas sausages, remove the casings. Wash the sausage and pull apart into 1/2 inch sized pieces using your hands. If you are not using texas sausages, remove the casings. Grill the sausages until done. Do not remove any pieces of sausages from the pan while grilling. The skins will turn a darker shade of brown, and there will be burnt sections of meat. Cut each grape in half, remove the seed sections, and reserve. Slice the grape halves into quarters, and put one piece in each of the 6 wine glasses in a bowl. Pour in the sausage and grapes. You may not use all of this stuff, depending on your tastes, but it should be plenty flavorful, if possible, for flavors to combine at the party.

title: Cheese Stuffing for Flavoring Veggies
ingredients: 1 box garlic and herb seasoned croutons | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1/2 cup asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons dried shrimp and chard stuffing mix ( i use nutrizo herb mix seasoning mix for vegetables, use only if necessary ) | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder, use only if necessary | 1/4 cup canola oil or 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Preheat the grill so that it's moderately hot. Drain the garlic herb flavored croutons. If you have a food processor, put the croutons in the baggie and pulse until you see bits of cheese or crumbs. Add half and half, cheese, shrimp, chard stuffing mix and chipotle powder and process until it forms a paste, adding more olive oil if necessary. Shape the garlic herb stuffing mixture into 1 1/2 to 2 inch diameter balls. Add half and half to the oil. Coat the outside of each meatball with the oil. Lightly brown the meatballs on the grill. It should be rare, so be careful when moving the grill. Allow the meatballs to cool. When ready to use, you can store the unused stuffing in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a month.

title: Greek Phyllo Wraps (Aka Arlo-Yogurt)
ingredients: 1 lb phyllo pastry | 1 lb fresh dill weed | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Clean the greek dill weed very well and use a kitchen shears if available. To remove grit, just scrape off any yellow and then grind the fresh leaves until fine. The leaves must be cleaned first. Put a sheet of dampened butter in a bowl and use it to stack up with half the dill leaves, half the butter, and half the greek dill on the sheet. Cover with a layer of dampened butter. Repeat two more times, finishing with a sheet of sheets of dill weed on top. Using a sharp knife cut the butter into four square pieces. Cut the square stack in half lengthwise using 1 piece of cheese from the jar and then into four square pieces, using small cubes of the same from the jar. Sprinkle with lemon juice and bake @ 425 for about 10 minutes or until golden.

instructions: In large pot with boiling salted water, cook penne until al dente. Drain well and return to large pot. In bowl, stir together yogurt and cream cheese cubes with a mixer until smooth and creamy. Mix in prunes, brandy and chilies.

ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 large eggplant, very thinly sliced | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 4 medium fresh rosemary, sprigs roughly chopped | 1 box penne, cooked | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1 small orange section
instructions: In a skillet, heat walnut oil over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,sauerkraut,hot red chili pepper,red onion
title: Sauerkraut With Red Onions and Chilies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sauerkraut, rinsed | 6 hot red chili peppers, stemmed, seeded, minced | 2 medium red onions, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Toast the sauerkraut in a dry 10 inch skillet until dark golden brown and dry on edges. Remove the sauerkraut to a large bowl. Add one cup of water, chilies and onions to the skillet and bring to a boil. Cover and cook over moderate heat, stirring often, until the sauerkraut is creamy, about 5 minutes. Transfer the sauerkraut to a platter and reserve. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon butter in a 12 inch skillet. Add the red onions to the skillet and sauté, stirring, until tender, about 5 minutes. Add the sauerkraut and the warm red onion mixture and toss well. Serve and enjoy.

title: Channa Dal (Chana Indian Chicken Balls)
ingredients: 1 lb chicken meat, ground to 1 1/3 in squares | 1/2 cup coconut, shredded | 3 cups dark chocolate, grated | 1/4 cup brown onion, chopped ( or 1/4 t onion flakes ) | 3/4 cup white pearl onion | 1/2 cup channa dal ( chana masala ) | 1/4 teaspoon sugar substitute | 1/4 cup light corn flakes or 1/4 cup crushed red chile, coarsely crushed
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except corn flakes or crushed red chilies, and place in 9 x 13 x 2 1/2 oven proof dish coated with cooking oil. Cover and bake at 350f for 1 hour. Remove cover, stir, return to oven, and continue baking until sauce is thick and all liquid has been absorbed, about 30 minutes. Sprinkle cornflakes over cooked dal, if desired.

title: Rice Noodles with Mushrooms and Rice Milk
ingredients: 6 ounces thin rice noodles, prepared as directed on package ( about 1/3 cup uncooked per package directions ) | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 3/4 lb boneless top round steak fillet, cut into 5 thin strips | 3/4 lb button mushroom, sliced | 8 sheets rice noodles, cooked ( about 8 inches wide )
instructions: Rinse the rice noodles in a colander until the water runs clear.

title: Tamarind Oil (Sweet Chilli Filling for Fish Fries)
ingredients: 225 g tamarind paste | 4 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Wash tamarind in cold water, drain and cut into 3 inch lengths. Blend tamarind and a spoonful of tamarind paste until combined, adding enough water to give the mixture a firm consistency. The mixture is now ready. In a frying pan, pour 1 tablespoon of wata or sunflower oil and heat it. Deep fry the tamarind paste for 1 - 2 minutes or until it begins to bubble and darkens slightly. Remove from frying pan to a paper towel lined plate and drain off the oil. Heat half a tablespoon of wata or sunflower oil in a separate frying pan. Add the tamarind paste and fry, stirring gently and continuously until the oil has been reduced to a thick paste. Pour in the remainder of the oil and warm it again. Remove from pan and roll the frites in the warm oil. Keep warm in a 200c degree oven until ready to serve.

title: Sauerkraut with Pear and Rhubarb
ingredients: 1 lb sauerkraut | 1/2 lb rhubarb, cut in half | 3 tablespoons ruby port or 3 tablespoons port wine | 1/2 tablespoon oregano leaves | 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese, grated | pear, wedges for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Combine sauerkraut and rhubarb in an oven proof dutch oven or deep skillet and add enough water to cover. Bake until rhubarb is tender and sauerkraut just begins to brown. Add port and oregano and heat through. Spoon into a serving platter.

title: Italian Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can baked beans, drained | 1 can condensed onion soup mix | 1/2 cup salsa | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate overnight for optimum flavor.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,phyllo pastry,red food coloring,nutmeg,raspberry vinegar,blue curacao
title: Blue Lagoon Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 cup blue curacao, at room temperature | 3 tablespoons raspberry vinegar | 3 tablespoons lime juice, from 2 limes | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 drop red food coloring
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Using a sharp knife, cut the stack of phyllo sheets lengthwise. Lay out on an aluminum foil lined baking sheet and cut 2 triangles out of each sheet. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. In a small bowl, mix the blue curacao, raspberry vinegar, lime juice and nutmeg. Place a heaping teaspoon of blue curacao mixture at the fold of each triangle. Fold through each triangle to make a triangle. Repeat with the remaining phyllo sheets and blue curacao mixture and blue curacao mixture until all triangles have been used. Place on a large baking sheet, sprayed with nonstick cooking spray and bake for 30 minutes. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Stuffed Asparagus
ingredients: 6 medium asparagus, tough ends snapped off and discarded | 1/2 cup marinated dates | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh marjoram
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Fill a baking dish with about 1/4 inch water and cover with aluminum foil. Place asparagus in the oven and bring water just to a boil. Lower heat to medium low, cover, and cook until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Set the asparagus aside. Place the dates and 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid in a bowl. Stir in marjoram and mix well. Slice the tips off the asparagus stalks and separate the green and firm parts of the stalks. Remove stalks from the tips and discard. Fill the reserved asparagus cooking liquid with the date mixture and set aside. Pour the reserved date liquid into a 2 quart baking dish. Place the asparagus in the baking dish with the date mixture and cover. Bake the asparagus until tender when pierced with a fork, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile powder,cayenne pepper,barley flour,lemon zest,sage,chili pepper,margarine,ladyfinger
title: Smokey Barley Chili-Glazed Ladyfingers
ingredients: 5 tablespoons margarine, or as needed | 2 1/2 tablespoons chili pepper, or to taste | 2 teaspoons dried sage, or to taste | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 cup barley flour | 1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste | 1 tablespoon dried minced chili pepper, or to taste | 1 teaspoon dried minced dried chili pepper, or to taste | 1 teaspoon paprika, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon grated chili chile powder, or to taste
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Stir margarine, chili peppers, sage, lemon zest, garbanzo bean seasoning, hot pepper sauce, graham cracker crumbs, cayenne pepper, dried chile powder, dried chile powder, smoked paprika, and optional paprika into chickpea flour until well combined.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,beer,rice vinegar,romaine lettuce,oil,canadian bacon,italian tomato
title: Beer and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups finely chopped romaine lettuce | 1 large ripe italian tomato | 1 1/4 cups diced canadian bacon | 1/2 cup coarsely torn cooked rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons oil | 1 cup beer | 3 tablespoons dry corn kernels
instructions: Combine the lettuce, tomato, bacon and rice vinegar in a large bowl. Combine the oil and beer in a small sauce pan and heat until almost smoking. Pour over the salad. Gently stir until it is thoroughly mixed, but not hot. Cover and chill until needed.

title: Prawn and Spinach With Cured Mushrooms & Rice
ingredients: 350 g basmati rice | 400 g scallops | 1 teaspoon vanilla vodka | 220 g spinach, washed and trimmed | 1 tablespoon chopped toasted pecorino cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh culantro | 1 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Wash the rice and cook in 4 cups of rapidly boiling water, uncovered, over moderate heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to make sure the grains are not sticking to the bottom. After 20 minutes, drain well and add to a large, rectangular serving dish. Add the scallops to the water and cook for 1 minute or so, until they are pink and cooked. Set the scallops aside and keep warm. Cook the spinach in rapidly boiling water for 1 minute or until just wilted. Drain and pat dry. When all is cooked, return the spinach to the pan and stir in the pecorino, mint and sherry. Place the spinach on top of the rice and drizzle with the vodka. Serve immediately with a salad of mixed mushrooms, if liked.

Random Ingredients: shaoxing wine,kiwi fruit,pumpkin pie spice,wine,heavy cream
title: Spiced Fruit Whip
ingredients: 1 lb fresh pumpkin pie spice | 1/4 cup shaoxing wine | 1/2 cup wine, for drizzling | 7 kiwi fruits, sliced | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Combine pumpkin pie spice, wine and kiwifruit in a small bowl, stir well. Whip cream until stiff peaks form. Fold into pumpkin mixture. Scoop into serving bowls over fruit.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,flour,chipotle chile,meat,cream cheese,spanish paprika,liquid smoke,bread dough
title: Baja-Mex Style Chipotle Meat Bread
ingredients: 1 frozen bread dough | 1 lb ground meat | 8 ounces cream cheese, softened | 10 chipotle chiles | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon sweet spanish paprika | 1 cup corn oil | 2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Pound all seasonings and chipotle chiles to paste. Make a hole in the center of the tortilla with your thumb. Fill it with meat, followed by cream cheese and a couple drops of the chipotle chile paste. Roll it around, burrito style, or you can press your hand over top, burrito style. It will make nice pinched rows of rollers, with no air pockets and it should slide into baking dish. Let it cool down, then remove excess dough. Place bread dough onto a cookie sheet, and cover with parchment paper so bread doesn't stick. Make sure the paper is on the bottom of the pan. Pour the oil into the pan, and heat on medium hi until it starts to smoke about a minute or two.. Sprinkle with flour and fry bread pieces a few at a time for 5 - 7 minutes or until deep golden in colour. If they stick, turn over and repeat this until all are done. Let them cool on the pan for a couple of minutes before removing from pan on the plate with a spatula.

title: Fettuccine With Sauteed Beef & Beans
ingredients: 1 lb boneless rump roast | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons mirin ( sweet rice wine, if avail ) | 12 ounces capellini or 12 ounces fettuccine | 4 ounces smoked fontina cheese | 3/4 lb thinly shaved smoked provolone cheese | 1/2 cup thinly sliced pickled beet leaves from jarred roasted jim chi or 1/2 cup drained canned cannellini sherry
instructions: Combine the beans and 3 tablespoons of mirin in a heavy saucepan. Cover and cook over high heat until well reduced. Simmer for 20 minutes. Place the brisket into a shallow roasting pan or crockpot. Cover with plastic wrap and pour the heated bean mixture over the brisket. Let stand at room temperature for about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Pour the remaining 3/4 cup mirin slowly into the pan, stirring to dislodge any browned bits on the bottom of the pan and to thicken it while simmering. Transfer the brisket to a rimmed baking sheet and roast until richly brown, about 2 hours for medium rare. Cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Layer the meat and remaining ingredients, starting with the fontina cheese and finishing with the roast. Place the roasting pan in the oven and bake until bubbling and just beginning to get heated through, about 25 minutes. Serve immediately. Note, for a charcoal grill, line the separable foil liners with 3 inch strips of heavy duty aluminum foil, letting them hang over the sides. Place the foil over open burners and preheat to 250°f using tongs, fold the ends of the aluminum foil over the top of the grill and carefully remove the foil strip. Place the meat on the foil lining and bake until heated through, 5 to 7 minutes. Check that the cheese is melted but not browned. Allow to stand 5 minutes before opening the foil. Place the meat on a platter and serve.

title: Mushroom and Cheese Chipotle Stir-fry
ingredients: 4 chipotle chiles, minced, stemmed, seeded and minced in a mortar | 2 canned chipotle chile chiles in adobo, minced, seeded and minced in a mortar | 2 tablespoons minced red peppers | 1/2 lb baby swiss cheese or 1/2 lb fresh button mushroom | 1/2 medium green bell pepper, seeded, cored, and sliced as thin as possible | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese, if desired
instructions: Drain the chilies. Rinse out the peppers.

instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºf. Remove casings from casings if desired.

title: Butter and Chili Beans

instructions: Heat oil and butter in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in beans and tomato sauce. Simmer about 15 minutes. Stir in serrano chiles. Simmer another 15 minutes until heated through and sauce is slightly thickened.
