instructions: Mix all ingredients together except chocolate. Place in zip lock bag with your mix. Add in chocolate on top, cover and refridgerate 3 - 4 hours. Roll into 1 1/2 inch balls and fry a small amount of sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,vegetable juice,coconut milk,green food coloring,citrus infused vodka,grapeseed oil
title: Quinoa Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable juice ( like v8 ) | 1 cup rice or 1 cup arborio rice, rinsed and drained | 1 large handful citrus-infused vodka | sliced green food coloring ( optional ) | 1 can unsweetened coconut milk | 1/2 cup grapeseed oil
instructions: In a medium saucepan or small to medium saucepan, heat vegetable juice until bubbles form around the edge and the edges are beginning to get dark. Add rice, swirl around a bit to coat with the flavored vodka, and cover with water. Turn heat to lowest setting and simmer until rice is tender to desired tenderness, about 20 minutes. While rice cooks, rinse fruit and cut into chunks. When rice is done cooking, stir in the fruit and coconut slurry. Heat oil in a small saucepan until just simmering. Add the slurry and cook 1 - 2 minutes, stirring. Turn off the heat and allow mixture to sit for about 1 minute. Serve warm.

title: Miso and Spinach Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive | 1 tablespoon white rice | 100 g field mushrooms or 100 g other small mushrooms | 2 teaspoons dried fruit | 1 banana | 2 tablespoons miso ( to taste ) | 2 cups cooked white rice | 2 cups cooked rice | 200 g quick-cooking spinach ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil and fry the mushrooms in it for 3 - 4 mins over a high heat. Remove from the pan and add the rice. Fry for 1 min each side and turn to cook the other side. Return mushrooms to the pan with the white rice and fry for 2 min, then turn off the heat. Mix miso and mix with the cooked spinach until thoroughly mixed. Fold in the mushrooms and banana. Serve topped with sour cream or chuka.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,dijon mustard,heavy cream,fine sea salt,tarragon,phyllo pastry,parmesan cheese,portabella mushroom cap
title: Portabella Mushroom Phyllo Rounds
ingredients: 1 package frozen pastry sheets, thawed | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons fine sea salt | 2 teaspoons fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 package active dry yeast, plus a little extra for basting | 1 package portabella mushroom caps, sliced | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Line baking sheets with parchment or a baking stone and set aside. Heat cream in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Remove from heat and add mustard and salt and set aside. When the cream comes to a boil, gently whisk in the yeast until dissolved. Add mushrooms, 1 tablespoon cream, and 1 tablespoon flour and beat until the mushrooms are well coated. Set aside to cool. Brush the bottom of a large baking sheet with oil. Sprinkle with 2 sheets of parchment or a baking stone. Spread about three tablespoons cream from the mushroom mixture on the bottom of the baking sheet. Top with 2 sheets of the pastry, overlapping each other in an even layer. Sprinkle with more cream, and 1 tablespoon sea salt, and 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon. Top with 2 more sheets, then sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of flour and 1 tablespoon freshtarragon. Top with 2 more sheets of the pastry, then with the third sheet of the cream, and top with 2 sheets of the pastry.. Using a sharp paring knife, cut the phyllo diagonally into 3 squares. Place the squares on the baking sheet and braid them. Brush the tops with oil and sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons sea salt. Bake for 30 minutes until puffed and golden.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Easy and Simple Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini, plus 2 tbsp ( for sauce ) | 1/2 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Mix the vinegar and tahini together. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,beef bouillon paste,black olive,baking soda,vegetable,lime,ghee,broth
title: Bhatura
ingredients: 1 kg mixed vegetables, peeled cut into 4 wedges each | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 500 ml broth ( or chicken stock, depending on taste ) | 50 ml clear honey | 20 g baking soda | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon paste | 20 ounces frozen mixed vegetables ( or a mix of all the above mixed vegetables ) | 6 black olives, halved | 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Heat oil, add vegetables and continue to fry over a moderate heat for 5 minutes or until tender. Add broth and honey and mix well. Bring to the boil and stir in baking soda and dissolve the baking powder. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Stir in mixed vegetables, olives, lime juice and serve with steamed rice, if desired.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,chili garlic sauce,blue cheese,baby green,tofu,parma ham,table salt,cajun seasoning
title: BBQ Tofu and Baby Greens With Toasted Parma Ham Focaccia
ingredients: 2 cups of mixed baby greens | 4 large toasted parma ham | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 2 cups wholemeal plain flour | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 180 g blue cheese, crumbled | 2 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Mix the bbq seasoning and flour with your fingers until combined. Cut the cheese into 4 equal pieces and gently roll each piece with your fingertips until slightly flat and well combined. Heat up your bbq, if using an electric oven or bbq, and lightly season the toasted parma ham with the toasted flour and seasoning powder. Spread the toasted cheese on the top of the bbq followed by the baby greens and finally the sliced toasted parma ham. Close the lid with tin foil and allow to cook under indirect heat for about 15 minutes or until the cheese has melted and the bbq has become crispy and crispy all over. Remove the bbq from the heat and allow to stand for a few minutes, then remove the bbq from the oven. Using a palette knife, cut the toasted bread into chunks and scatter all over the top of the toasted parma ham. Top with the spicy garlic sauce. Serve straight away.

title: Sauce-Free
ingredients: 2 lbs winter squash | 1 cup chili sauce ( i use paul prudhomme's ) | 1 tablespoon mustard powder
instructions: Wash squash. Cut a 1 inch oval in the centre of squash. Place all ingredients into a large pot. You will find some of the above liquid, so just make sure to wash the veggies. Cover and simmer on low heat for 2 to 3 hours, or until the squash is very tender and the juice runs clear.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,ciabatta,white onion,kaffir lime leaf,guacamole,italian tomato,cucumber,beef sirloin steak
title: Slowcooking Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 3 cloves garlic, smashed or 3 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 small white onion, sliced | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 2 1/2 lbs ciabatta, cut in 1/2 inch slices or 2 1/2 lbs other bread slices, toasted | 1 tomatoes, thinly sliced ( or plum tomatoes, if preferred ) | 1 medium english cucumber, halved lengthwise, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 2 kaffir lime leaves, sliced | 1/2 cup guacamole, to pass at table
instructions: Combine the beef, garlic, onion, celery seed and celery seed in a bowl and stir to combine. Place one layer of toasted bread on your work surface, and cover with one layer of toasted bread. Place a meat strip on top of each slice, then top with two more slices of soaked bread and one of sliced tomatoes. Using a tooth pick, poke three or four holes through the layer of bread, covering the meat and tomatoes. Place one cucumber on top of the pile. Close the sandwich and fasten with a tooth pick. Cut each sandwich lengthwise into six or eight slices. To serve, spread the bottom slice of the sandwich with guacamole. Arrange the sandwiches on serving plates and arrange the remaining cucumber and tomato slices along with a crisp salad. Tip, for an added flavour dimension dimension, place the meat and veggie pieces between two slices of bread on a cookie sheet while the bread is still under the oven burner. If the bread is too crusty, let it cool in the oven for 20 minutes. Also, for a slightly different look, omit the bread. Instead, you can serve this with a spicy tomato salsa.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,green chilies,beef broth,sharp cheddar cheese,harissa,ice water,burgundy wine,vegetable shortening
title: Cheese Sauce(Kasar Corbasi) - Chiles Rellenos (Copycat)
ingredients: 8 ounces vegetable shortening | 2 cups kosher salt | 1/2 cup ice water | 2 tablespoons wondra or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 cup burgundy wine ( or dry red wine ) ( optional ) | 2 2/3 cups beef broth or 2 2/3 cups chicken broth | 1 1/2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese ( plus more for sprinkling, if desired ) | 2 fresh mild green chilies, seeded, membranes removed, seeded, and finely chopped
instructions: Heat a dry iron skillet to medium hot. In a bowl, mash together the shortening, salt, and water. With a wooden spoon, stir in the wondra/cornstarch until the mixture looks like coarse meal. Add the wine and stir until the mixture is evenly distributed. Add in the broth, stirring until it is thoroughly mixed. Bring the mixture to a boil. Cover and transfer to your warm skillet. Simmer on medium low over low heat for 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. When the mixture is nearly done, stir in the grated cheese. Bring to a bubbly boil, then remove from heat. Transfer the cheese sauce to a serving bowl or individual ovenproof bowls. Tightly cover the top of the fondue pot with aluminum foil and set it over a burner. Toast the chiles under a hot broiler, turning and watching them closely and removing the outer skin with a slotted spoon or spatula. As soon as the cheese is melted, add it to the warmed fondue pot. Serve warm. Store sealed fondue pot in the refrigerator or the fondue will be tough. As a variation, i prefer to use roasted red peppers. Serve the cooked chili with the cheese sauce and a dollop of sour cream.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,thyme,black bean,marjoram,grain white rice,garlic salt
title: Frijoles Negros
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed ( frijoles negros ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 2 -3/4 teaspoon garlic salt | salt and black pepper, to taste | 2 -3 cups cooked short-grain white rice or 2 -3 cups brown rice
instructions: The day before serving, rinse and drain the can of beans. Place in a large bowl or pot with the thyme, marjoram, garlic salt and black pepper. Shake to mix. When ready to make, add the beans to the bowl or pot and stir to combine. Heat oil over medium heat for a few minutes. Add a few handfuls of the beans and stir continuously over medium heat until the mixture is slightly browned. Pour in the white rice or brown rice until it is about 1/4 cup of cooked brown rice or 2 1/2 cup cooked brown rice. The goal is to not cook the rice too long. This will create a mushy, dark, sweet mixture that won't rise at all and can easily stick to your mouth. You may need to add some of the additional water to keep from sticking. When the mixture is sufficiently browned, stir in some of the cooked dry rice if it is not serving right away.

title: Spanish Style Onion Pickles
ingredients: 1 spanish onion | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Put onions in a medium size bowl, add mustard and mix well. Pack into sterilized jars, sealing and sealing jars. Place a little plate/bowl of water in bottom of jar, then carefully lower lid onto jars. Place jars in a 350°f oven on medium high for 10 minutes. Remove jars and remove a few tablespoons of bag of onions when they are about half their volume. Carefully remove lid, then remove bag of onions with a large spoon, leaving whole and chop. Place onion pieces in a clean bowl, cover with clean cloth or waxed paper and store in a cool dark place for about 3 weeks. You may refrigerate up to 2 years before using. These should last for months.

title: Fennel and Turnip Muffins
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb | 1 turnip | margarita mix, for muffin tins
instructions: Slice off top 1/4 inch of fennel bulb. With a vegetable peeler, remove feathery tops from fennel. Cut remaining stem from fennel, then chop. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Place fennel bulb with stem in boiling water. Cook 1 - 2 minutes. Drain fennel and place on a strainer. Peel off remaining fennel by cutting back just to green parts. Cut off fronds and roughly chop. Set aside. Cut fennel into thin slices. Remove skin from turnip. Cut cut sections into 1/4 thick half moons. Grease 12 muffin tins. Place wedges in muffin cups, about 3/4 cup per muffin cup. Sprinkle with fennel mixture. Cover with margarita mix. Bake in 350f oven for 25 minutes, until crust is golden and the top of the ruffins sounds hollow. Let stand 5 - 10 minutes before removing.

title: Aromatic Poached Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon steaks | 1/2 cup freshly grated pecorino-romano cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Coat each salmon steak inside and out with 1/4 cup shredded cheese.

title: The Perfect Party Chowder
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 8 cups bread ( i've used brioche ) | 8 ounces ginger ale | 12 cups cold strong tea
instructions: Brown the beef in a large soup kettle. Drain fat and stir in beer, tea and beef. Return to burner and cook at 350° until the liquid is reduced and the soup is thick. It's done when the potatoes are soft and the meat falls off the bone.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,fish sauce,kahlua,green cardamom pod,saffron thread,bread
title: Spiced Vietnamese Bread
ingredients: 9 -10 slices stale bread | 4 -5 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 2 -3 green cardamom pods | 1/4 cup saffron threads | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 4 tablespoons kahlua or 4 tablespoons other almond liquor
instructions: Toast bread in a pan for just enough to make them crispy. Combine the curry paste and hot water in a cup and pour over the toasted bread and mix well.

Random Ingredients: urad dal,red bell pepper,red cabbage,gnocchi,sesame seed,chicken thigh
title: Indian Chicken & Veggies
ingredients: 12 chicken thighs, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 12 ounces gnocchi, uncooked | 4 heads red cabbage, halved and coarsley cut | 1 cup red bell pepper, chopped | 1 cup urad dal, split green and split yellow squash
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place chicken on broiler rack, skin side up. Broil about 8 - 10 minutes until no longer pink in the center and juices run clear. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees. In medium saucepan of boiling water, saute the sesame seeds until crisp. Remove from heat and set aside. Boil gnocchi according to package, drain. Arrange 1 cup of cooked gnocchi in bottom of baking dish. Spread 1/2 cup of cabbage and 1/2 of the red bell pepper over the gnocchi. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Sprinkle with a pinch of toasted sesame seeds. Bake in middle of oven about 45 minutes, or until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbling.

title: Italian Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb cabbage, coarsely chopped | 2 -3 large basil leaves, coarsely torn
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Place the cabbage in the pot, cover and let sit 5 minutes, then immediately remove and drain. Place the cabbage, basil and 1/2 tsp salt in a colander and drain well. Place it back in the pot and gently place over medium heat for 5 minutes until it starts to steam.

title: Thai Almond Crescent Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 large egg, lightly beaten | 1 teaspoon curry leaves | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Combine crumbs and egg. Sprinkle with curry leaves and almond extract. Use fingers to form crescents. Place crescents on a baking sheet or jelly roll pan lined with parchment paper. Bake at 350f degrees f. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bacon,cilantro,green cabbage,green cardamom pod,kale,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheddar and Cilantro Kale with Bacon
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, or more as needed, cut into cubes | 1 bunch kale, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped, green cabbage | 5 green cardamom pods, or more to taste, or more to taste | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 8 slices sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until mostly browned, about 5 minutes. Squeeze excess water out of kale with hands as bacon begins to brown. Transfer kale to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,yogurt,green coriander,bread,rutabaga,butternut squash,baking powder,grain rice
title: Shrimp Fried Rice With Vegetables
ingredients: 2/3 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1 3/4 cups leftover cooked small shrimp ( thawed ) | 1/2 cup peeled peeled and deveined butternut squash | 1/4 cup trimmed green coriander | 2 cups coarsely chopped raw long grain rice | 1 large rutabaga, peeled and chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 loaf baked toasted crusty bread
instructions: Prepare the yogurt by stirring together yogurt and 1 1/2 cups water in a medium skillet over medium heat. Bring to a simmer, stirring often. Stir in shrimp and cook 2 to 3 minutes, or until shrimp start to turn pink. Stir in squash, coriander, rice, rutabaga and baking powder. Simmer until rice and vegetables are tender, about 35 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer rice mixture to a bowl and sprinkle with remaining 1 cup of yogurt. Serve hot.

title: Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 piece fresh pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon chili paste, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel
instructions: Place pecorino romano cheese onto a plate. Sprinkle chili paste lightly over cheese to taste. Top with orange peel and press cheese under the grated romano. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mace,sherry wine,red cabbage,cream cheese,curry powder,oyster sauce,asparagus,filling
title: Curried Asparagus - Spring Rolls, My Way
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, trimmed | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1/2 cup cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/3 cup oyster sauce ( i use kikkoman's ) | 1/2 cup sherry wine, dark | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine, melted | 1/2 small red cabbage, finely shredded
instructions: Steam the asparagus for about 1 - 2 minutes, till desired tenderness. Drain, reserving 1/2 of the cooking water. In medium bowl, mix remaining ingredients, except cabbage, and combine well except cabbage. Cut the asparagus into thin slices, then cut each slice into equal lengths, as if you were cutting a whole fish. Spoon 1/2 cup of sauce over the cooked asparagus, then sprinkle with a tsp of browning. Garnish with cabbage.

title: Crusty Calzone
ingredients: 2 cans pizza dough | 3/4 cup soymilk | 1 lb cheese ( shredded ) | 2 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons capers ( drained ) | 2 egg yolks
instructions: Preheat oven to roll out dough onto oiled cookie sheet, about 8x12 inches. Spread soymilk over dough until you get 3/4 inch thick rim. Sprinkle mexican cheese on that side add taco seasoning, capers and salt as needed. Bake at 400 degrees for 45 minutes. While oven is heating mix egg whites until stiff peaks form with a rubber spatula. Spread over top of crust. Serve.

title: Chipotle and Bologna Crumble
ingredients: 1/4 cup oatmeal | 1/4 cup bologna, finely sliced | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, ground | 1 teaspoon fresh dill, minced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place the oatmeal in a small baking dish and spray lightly with oil. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes at 400°f or until lightly browned, stirring regularly. Set aside. Using an electric mixer, sauté the bologna in a pan over medium heat with the chipotle and dill until the bologna is golden brown and tender. Add the oatmeal and stir well to combine. Spoon the topping onto the base of a 4 cup serving dish and spread with the bologna mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Cheesy Beef Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups cheddar cheese, grated | 1 can beef stock, heated | 3 tablespoons cinnamon sugar, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Grease a 2 cup ovenproof dish. In a bowl, mix all ingredients together. Place into oven and bake about 20 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,ginger ale,cilantro,beef stew meat,plum tomato,honey,white bread,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Slow Cooker Spiced Beef Tenderloin With Plum Tomatoes and Cilantro-Ginger Ale Sauce
ingredients: 1 fat-trimmed beef tenderloin | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups plum tomatoes, halved vertically and sliced 1/4-inch thick | 2 cups shredded white bread | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh ginger ale | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium beef broth or 1/8 cup canned beef broth
instructions: Rinse beef tenderloin and pat dry with paper towels. Arrange beef tenderloin in 6 - 8 quart slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: lavender flower,grain rice,baby spinach,cherry,lemon zest,farmer cheese
title: Green Spinach with Lemon, Lavender and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1 bunch baby spinach | 2 -3 tablespoons farmer cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon roasted sweet-leaf lavender flowers, chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon freshly grated lemon, zest of | 1 tablespoon lemon, juice of
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, scald the rice. Set aside to cool slightly. Trim the stems from the spinach. Shred the leaves into very thin sheets about 2 - 6 long by 1 1/2 wide. Wash the spinach leaves well, and drain thoroughly. Transfer to a large bowl with the remaining ingredients and toss to combine. Cover with plastic wrap, and chill for up to 2 hours.

title: Danish Fruit Nougat With Butterscotch Chips (Kartoffelbrot)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons flour | 2 cups milk | 1 lb fuji apple, peeled, cored and chopped ( optional ) | 1 lb banana, banana, sliced ( optional ) | 4 sprigs oregano or 4 sprigs rosemary sprigs | 6 ounces dried cranberries or 6 ounces dried cranberries | 2 ounces butterscotch chips ( optional ) | 1 ounce mint | cranberries ( optional ) or shaved pecans ( optional )
instructions: In a large saucepan combine sugar and water. Bring to boil and when it reaches 235f on candy thermometer, remove from heat and add flour, stirring until blended. Scrap down the sides of the pan and continue stirring over medium heat until the mixture starts to bubble. Pour in milk and simmer until thickened, stirring often. This should take about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly, stirring every 15 - 20 minutes to redistribute the milk evenly. You are ready to go if the mixture bubbles and thickens. If it starts to thicken, cook for 15 - 20 minutes more. Add the apple if using, banana, banana, oregano, and cranberries and heat to simmering, stirring every so often, about 10 minutes or until liquid is mostly absorbed. If mixture is too thick, add a little bit of milk or butterscotch chips to moisten. When thickened, stir in the butterscotch chips and mint. The mixture will thicken considerably, adding more butterscotch if a thinner consistency is desired. Serve warm, or allow to cool, stirring occasionally. Serve with mint or cilantro sprinkled on top.

title: Homemade Chiles Dip
ingredients: 500 g cottage cheese or 500 g cheese | 4 -5 dried chilies, broken into pieces | 3 -4 green chilies | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 -2 teaspoon tahini
instructions: Use a food chopper to get the consistency of a thick soup. Mix all the ingrediants together, pour into a medium pot, bring to boil. Turn down heat, cover and cook for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve with warm pita bread slices and extra chili chips.

Random Ingredients: hot water,veal medallion,green pepper,tater tot,nutmeg,ciabatta,green cabbage
title: Veal Gyro
ingredients: 6 ounces veal medallions | 2 cups green cabbage, finely chopped | 1/3 cup green pepper, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 package tater tots, sliced | hot water | 4 ciabatta rolls
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line a cookie sheet with foil. Coat 2 baking sheets with cooking spray. Place medallions on prepared cookie sheet. Broil 3 - 4 inches from heat 1 - 3 minutes or until lightly browned. Set aside to cool. Place 1 celsius beef or veal fat in a medium skillet over medium heat with 1/2 tsp groundnutmeg. Cook just until meat is no longer pink. Place 2 tbs beef fat mixture in center of a ciabatta piece. Top with cabbage and pepper and top with remaining 2 tbs beeffat mixture. Serve with hot water.

Random Ingredients: hot chili powder,iceberg lettuce,shiitake mushroom,lemon,caramel sauce,mustard powder,monterey jack cheese,anchovy
title: Uncle Bill's Shiitake Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 cans of shiitake mushrooms, in natural liquid, drained and sliced thin ( or substitute other mushrooms of choice ) | 8 cups iceberg lettuce | 2 teaspoons mustard powder ( or to taste if unavailable, gluten free ) | 2 cans anchovies, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup hot chili powder, to taste. ( optional or to taste ) | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 3/4 cup cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons caramel-style sauce | 3 medium whole lemons, cut into wedges
instructions: First make the marinated mushrooms. Combine the mayonnaise and mustard powder using a whisk or a spoon, mixing well. Spread the thinly sliced mushrooms in the bottom of six 6 cup muffin pans, or other lightly oiled breaded loaf pans. Sprinkle a little of the mustard powder onto the mushrooms to season them lightly. In each case, place a few shiitake slices, about 2 1/2 tablespoons per slice of mushrooms, in a mound on top of the mustard and mayonnaise mixture. Add a sprinkle of anchovies and hot chili powder. Bake in a preheated 350 oven for 15 minutes, turning about halfway through. When cool, sandwich lightly with a few cheddar cheese slices and garnish with slices of whole lemons. Serve with other desired condiments.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,golden syrup,butter,mexican cheese,cream cheese,farfalle pasta,turnip
title: Pasta with Turnips and Cheese
ingredients: 400 g farfalle pasta or 400 g other small pasta | 400 g sour cream or 400 g creme fraiche | 120 g unsalted butter | 150 -150 g palm sugar | 100 g golden syrup, heated until steaming | 150 g mexican cheese | 1 medium turnip, grated ( the recipe just said turnip )
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Add the pasta and cook it for about 8 - 10 mins or until tender but not overcooked. Drain pasta and keep warm. Using a food processor, mix the butter, sugar and syrup until very smooth. Add the cheese, turnip and pasta to butter mixture. Mix thoroughly. Add more butter if it suits you and mix again. Transfer to serving dish. Serve hot with extra melted butter or sour cream.

title: Mexican Hamburgers With Hazelnut Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 sheet white cheese | 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, ground | 1/2 tablespoon grated pimiento | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 teaspoon ham hock
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into 8 patties. Grill or fry til cooked through.

title: Zesty Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta ( i use bow-tie pasta because it is so darn good ) | 1/2 cup olive, sliced ( i don't use oil-marinated, but use your favourite oil! ) | 2 tablespoons chili oil, extra virgin | shredded lettuce
instructions: Cook ziti al dente according to package. Drain and rinse with cold water so it doesn't dry out. Drain once cooked. Set aside. In large bowl, combine olive oil, chili oil and ziti. Toss well. Pour dressing over pasta mixture and toss to coat well. Garnish with shredded lettuce.

title: Grilled Strawberries
ingredients: 2 medium leeks | 2 large celery ribs | 1 jar pimiento | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 -2 cup fresh strawberries
instructions: Wash leeks and slice diagonally into 1/2 inch slices. Chop celery. Add all vegetables and pimento to a food processor and pulse until you have a chopped texture. Add the taco seasoning and pulse until it's blended in well. Remove 1/4 cup of mixture and place on a board or table to rest. Repeat til desired texture is achieved. Add the remaining mixture just before serving, stir well to combine to desired consistency.

title: Italian White Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds, prepared | 2 tablespoons mixed peel | 2 cups pre-shredded provolone cheese, about 6 ounces | cracked mixed sugars
instructions: Drain the cannellini beans but do not rinse. Place the oil, mustard and mixed peel in a small saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the mustard seed is fragrant. Remove from heat. Add the drained beans and stir to combine. Sprinkle with the cheese and continue to cook over low heat for two minutes. Stir. Spoon into a serving bowl and scatter with crushed mixed sugars.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,thyme leave,pork tenderloin,heavy whipping cream,orange peel,beer,black bean
title: Challah Beer Can Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup beer | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 2 teaspoons ground black pepper | 6 cardamom pods, crushed | 6 -7 lbs pork tenderloins | 2 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine beans, beer, thyme, pepper, cardamon and black pepper in a large roasting pan and stir to combine. Submerge pork tenderloins in mixture, but do not overlap. Cover and refrigerate 3 - 4 hours or, preferably, overnight. Arrange pork on a rack in a roasting pan and roast until very tender and no longer pink inside, about 1 hour, basting once or twice with some of the pan juices. Let meat rest at least 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Red Chili With Spices
ingredients: 2 ounces dried red chilies | 3/4 pint vegetable stock | 2 1/2 ounces cardamom pods
instructions: Soak overnight. Fry chilies with 1/4 pint of vegetable stock until blackened. Remove from heat and let sit for 1 hour, then remove stems and seeds and puree. In a large saucepan, combine the puree and chilies, bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Bring a large pan of water to a boil. Add the cardamom pods and then add the remaining vegetable stock, stirring. Blend the chili then slowly add to boiling water, simmer for 1 minute. Reduce heat to simmer and cook uncovered for 15 minutes or until soup thickens. Serve hot.

title: Chinese Mustard Soup
ingredients: 16 fluid ounces chicken broth | 3 teaspoons prepared mustard | 2 teaspoons bottled minced garlic salt | 1 small green pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine chicken broth, mustard, garlic salt and green pepper in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,emmenthaler cheese,brown rice,milk ricotta cheese
title: Rice and Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans evaporated milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons brown rice | 12 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 1 hour | 2 pounds grated emmenthaler cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix the evaporated milk ricotta cheese and rice. Drain the bamboo skewers and pat dry with paper towels. Dip skewers into the cheese mixture. Arrange the skewers in an even layer on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, until the cheese is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,curry powder,extra virgin olive oil,nut,gruyere cheese,self raising flour,asafoetida powder,cauliflower floret
title: Curried Cauliflower (Indian)
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower floret | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon plain curry powder | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon mild curry paste | 1/2 cup self-raising flour ( plain or a mix of your desired ) | 3 tablespoons grated fresh nutmeg or 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 deg c or a fan hot 200 deg celsius. Bring a large pan of water to a boil. Meanwhile, cut off and discard the stem ends or blanch the cauliflower in the boiling water, until easily pierced with a knife and the flowerets are just tender. Rinse and gently drain the cauliflower and add it to a large bowl along with the cheese. Stir thoroughly so the spices are evenly distributed. Add the asafoetida and curry paste and stir in with a fork, breaking it up as it simmers to form a light paste. Add in the olive oil to a separate large pan, then stir in the flour. Allow the flour to sizzle for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Turn up the heat to medium/medium high, when it is bubbling, add it to the cauliflower/broth mix and stir vigorously for 5 minutes, stirring continuously, until it has thickened. Transfer to an ovenproof dish or a baking tray. Grate the nutmeg or allspice over the top. Return to the oven for about 10 - 15 minutes, uncovered, until the top turns a light golden brown.

title: Avocados With Peas and Potatoes (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 2 red potatoes, cut into quarters | 100 g chickpea flour | 3 avocados, halved, starchy type
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender when pierced with a fork, then cool completely. Preheat an oven to 200c. Lightly grease a baking tray. Place the potato quarters in a bowl. Add the chickpea flour and mash together gently. Tip the potatoes into a bowl, then carefully toss them in the flour to coat. Toss the avocado in the avocado to coat it in the batter. Place the potato breads in the oven, and bake 10 - 15 minutes until pale golden.

title: Beef and Quinoa Tacos
ingredients: 1/4 cup uncooked quinoa | 1/2 cup beef broth | 3 anchovy fillets | 1 teaspoon dried ancho-agar ( or soy sauce ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup cooked beef, cubed, or shredded | 8 whole-wheat tortillas
instructions: Cook quinoa according to pkg directions. Meanwhile, in a large skillet cook anchovies fillet in broth over med high heat for 1 minute, until anchovies just melt. Set aside. Add quinoa to skillet. Cook until heated through. Remove from heat. Dissolve baking soda in 1/2 cup of the broth and stir into the quinoa. Taste and add more broth if you think it needs it, or if the broth seems dry, add more broth if it seems dry, or a 1/2 cup of water. Spoon beef and quinoa onto tortilla and top with anchovies. Serve remaining broth.

title: Sour Asian Salad
ingredients: shredded fresh tomato ( romano ) | 1/2 asian pear ( any variety ) | slice asian pear ( any variety ) | 1 bunch kale | 1 package feta cheese | 1 tomatoes | 1 onion
instructions: Peel and slice the rind off the Asian pear. Slice the orange and tomato into long, thin strips. Cut the kale into chunks. Cut up the feta cheese in 1/4 inch cubes and slice the onion into rings or wedges. Mix all ingredients and let sit at room temperature for flavors to combine. Serve with crackers.

title: Vietnamese Caraway-Garlic Sauce - Vegetarian Version
ingredients: 2 small carrots | 2 tablespoons white wine | 2 teaspoons fish sauce
instructions: Peel the carrots and slice them finely. Set them aside. Pepper the carrot slices lightly. In a medium saucepan, add the carrots and 2 cups water and bring to a boil. Cook over medium high heat until just tender. Remove from heat and set aside. In a medium bowl, mix the fish sauce with the 2/3 cup cold water. Pour the carrot water mixture over the carrot and stir to break up any clumps that may be forming. Cover and let sit for at least 10 minutes, or longer, if desired. Pour the carrot mixture into a large bowl.

title: Hot & Spicy Veal Gizzards
ingredients: 5 fresh limes | 4 tablespoons grilling seasoning | 4 tablespoons vegetable bouillon cubes | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Juice one of limes. Place 1 tablespoons of lime juice, grilling seasoning, vegetable bouillon, and tabasco sauce in freezer container. Cut 6 large ziploc bags, and squish each ziploc bag with a rolling pin. Place ziploc bags in freezer. In a large ziploc bag place one or two slices of ziploc bag. Add 1/2 teaspoon of juice. Then add one or two more zapered zapered zapered zaperes. Place other zapered zapered zapere on top of zapered zaperes. After all five bags are frozen place in a roasting dish. Pour hot fat over the zaperes. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour. Serve hot.

title: Cider Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple cider | 2 tablespoons flavor fruit jam | 1 pinch ground nutmeg
instructions: Pour apple cider into medium saucepan, and stir in jam. Season with pinch of nutmeg. Cook over medium heat until liquid from jam starts to run, and the temperature is about 1/4 to 1/2 cup. Pour hot cider into bowl, and stir in desired flavor fruit. Cover, and refrigerate. Before serving, stir before serving.

title: Sauce With Chive
ingredients: 1 -8 teaspoon hot pepper ( or to taste, chopped or julienned ) | 3 tablespoons chives, chopped | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce or 15 1/2 ounce jars, with juice
instructions: Stir all ingredients lightly together in a saucepan. Turn burner to low and simmer until thickened.

title: Mashed Peas
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas | 0.5 can stewed tomatoes | 1/4 can shredded coconut
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine peas, stewed tomatoes, and coconut. Heat through.

Random Ingredients: double cream,tomato paste,cilantro leaf,red chile,lasagna,maraschino cherry,pimiento,walnut half
title: Torta Di Manicotti Con Le Mandorle
ingredients: 5 lasagna sheets | 1 can tomato paste | 3 pimentos | 1/4 cup finely chopped walnut halves | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, chopped | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 red chile, seeded and finely chopped | 3/4 pint double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place lasagna sheets in a large bowl of boiling water for 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Prawns With Cannellini Beans (Cook 'l' Beans)
ingredients: 6 ounces dried cannellini beans | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon tartar sauce or 1 tablespoon asian-style fish sauce, to taste
instructions:
Rinse the beans to remove excess salt, if necessary. Place the beans in the pot. Add water, cover with a tight fitting lid, and bring to a boil, then lower the heat to its lowest setting and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove the lid, and continue to cook the beans, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender, about an hour and half. Remove the beans from the boiling water, and allow them to dry out. Stir the bean puree into the bean mixture, and return to low heat, stirring occasionally. While the puree is soaking, heat the fish sauce in a small pot over low heat until the water is absorbed. Do not boil, as some of the bean sauce may be 
    - lemon extract. Drain the beans, and stir them into the puree. When the puree begins to thicken, return it to a simmer. Cook for 5 minutes, and serve.

title: German Fested Beef Rib Cries
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef short ribs, cut into 6 to 8 ribs | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 1/2 cup toasted pecans, chopped | 16 slices pecan halves, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Arrange ribs in roasting pan. Combine sauerkraut, salad dressing and chopped pecans. Pour over ribs, and bake at 300 degrees 50 to 55 minutes or until tender.

title: EASY and Tasty Diced Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 400 g chickpeas, drained ( preferably using canned chickpeas ) | 1 medium onion, chopped small | 1 bunch spring onion, chopped small ( green or red parts ) | 4 tablespoons dried dill | 4 tablespoons dried onion soup mix | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1/2 cup roasted pistachios, roughly chopped
instructions: Heat up the olive oil in a large skillet fry onion and spring onion till the onions are soft. Add 1 tablespoon dill and stir. Add 2 teaspoons soup mix. Add chickpeas, mix and let simmer for 5 minutes. Add the cream and take off any extra liquid. Add 1/2 cup of chopped pistachios and mix. Serve immediately over salad, if desired.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,sun tomato oil,pumpkin,flour tortilla,celery rib
title: Pumpkin Tortillas
ingredients: 2 cups peeled chopped pumpkin | 1/4 cup grated carrot | 1 celery rib, diced | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed | 12 -20 flour tortillas | 1 tablespoon chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | extra virgin olive oil ( for brushing tortillas )
instructions: Toss together pumpkin, carrots and celery. Sprinkle with caraway seeds. Brush both sides of tortillas with olive oil. Heat large skillet over a medium heat. Place tortillas in skillet, overlapping as necessary, and cook 1 minute on each side. Place tortillas between paper towels. Place 1/3 cup pumpkin mixture over tortillas and roll up.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,onion flake,bicarbonate soda,raspberry,french bread,drambuie,squid,basil
title: Sauce Poached in Raspberry Syrup
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups fresh raspberries or 1 1/4 cups frozen raspberries | 1 small onion, chopped | 1/4 cup instant chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon dried basil ( i use basil and italian seasoning blend ) | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( or equivalent bicarbonate of soda, we like a milder flavor ) | 1 teaspoon drambuie | 2 teaspoons french bread, loaves | squid
instructions: Place raspberries and onion in a saucepan and cover with water. Place over high heat and bring to the boil. Turn down the heat and simmer until the raspberries are soft. Meanwhile, make syrup by combining all the ingredients in a small mixing bowl. Bring a separate saucepan of water to a boil and then put the french bread loaves in and cook for about 3 - 4 minutes or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels and set aside. When the raspberries are soft pull out of the hot water and then add the raspberry syrup and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 5 minutes or until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. The syrup is now ready. Place a piece of squid in the bottom of each of two shallow bowls. Pour the raspberry sauce over them. You can dip the squid into the raspberry syrup as well if desired for a more sinful taste if desired. The squid looks more elegant as it rests in the bowls. Serve immediately.

title: Rigatoni Taco-Lime-Gravy
ingredients: 4 cups cooked rigatoni pasta | 1 lb mashed potatoes | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning
instructions: Cook pasta and drain. Set aside. Meanwhile, mix potatoes with juice of half lime and zest and dill. Add taco seasoning, adjust to taste. Pour over pasta and toss. Serve hot.

title: Easy Penne Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces sweet italian sausage style spaghetti sauce | 1 package penne pasta
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine sauce and sausage and bring to a boil. Meanwhile, boil water and cook pasta until al dente, then drain. Serve pasta with sauce.

title: Homemade Hoisin Sauce
ingredients: 1 container hoisin sauce ( not kool-aid ) | vanilla yogurt
instructions: Mix all of this together and use on your desired foods, such as yogurt puffs, and/or muffin liners.

Random Ingredients: sweetcorn,lettuce leaf,sugar syrup,beef bouillon powder,ginger root
title: Ginger Corn Soup
ingredients: 100 g dried sweetcorn | 3 tablespoons beef bouillon powder | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon sugar syrup | 2 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Place the sweetcorn in a container and cover with several inches of cool water.

Random Ingredients: rosemary sprig,anchovy fillet,oregano leaf,chunky salsa,yellow potato,water chestnut,bok choy,horseradish
title: Gourmet Beef Hash
ingredients: 12 small yellow potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves, chopped or 1 tablespoon dried oregano, crumbled | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained ( in water ) | 12 anchovy fillets, drained ( about 3 ounces ) | 4 -6 rosemary sprigs, coarsely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon chunky salsa | 3 -4 cups chopped bok choy or 3 -4 cups cabbage
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Combine the potatoes, oregano and horseradish. Spread evenly over the inside of a 9x13 inch dish and top with the 3/4 cup chunky salsa, water chestnuts, anchovies and rosemary. Cover with foil and bake for about 1 1/2 hours, until potatoes are tender and sauce is bubbly. Remove from the oven and stir in salsa. Transfer to a warm serving bowl. Garnish with chunky salsa.

title: Lowry Zucchini
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini | 1 teaspoon table salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground onion powder
instructions: Slice zucchini in half lengthwise. In a small bowl combine salt, onion powder, and pepper. Add zucchini and toss to coat. Place on baking sheet and dehydrate on high in a 400f oven for 1 hour or until zucchini is dry and just tender. Serve and enjoy.

title: Beet & Hazelnut Tart
ingredients: 400 g ready to bake low-fat pizza crusts | 2 teaspoons grainy mustard | 3 teaspoons mixed sprouts ( fresh toasted ) | 300 g mixed dried fruit ( e.g. beet, hazelnuts, chard, dates, cranberries or chicory leaves ) | 2 tablespoons almonds, chopped | 120 ml single cream | hazelnuts ( optional ) | jam ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Place one pizza crust on a large baking tray and spread with the mustard. Scatter the sprouts over the pizza crust. Scatter over the dried fruit and almonds. Place the second pizza crust on top of them and spread with the cream. Scatter over the sultanas, hazelnuts and chard leaves. Drizzle the with any extra cream and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until the topping is crusty. Serve with some fresh toasted hazelnuts and jam.

title: Stouffer's Potatoes & Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 lb mushroom, sliced | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, sliced | 2 tablespoons potato starch
instructions: Put the potatoes and tomato starch in a large bowl and mix throughly. Add the mushroom and sun dried tomatoes and mix all together. Cook on high in the microwave for 20 minutes then on low for another 10 minutes or on medium for 20 minutes.

title: Oshifima
ingredients: 1/4 lb okra | 1 cup coconut cream | 1 inch gingerroot, finely grated
instructions: Wash okra and break off tough ends. Place in a steamer with 1 cup water in which it was put in the okra. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes. Remove and set aside. Combine coconut cream and ginger root until well mixed. Add okra, mix and remove from stove. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: coffee,mirin,cannellini bean,dark soy sauce,icing sugar,rice wine,great northern bean
title: White Beans in Chocolate
ingredients: 125 g dried great northern beans | 125 g dried cannellini beans | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 tablespoon sweetened instant coffee | 2 teaspoons mirin | 3 tablespoons icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Soak beans over night or leave to soak overnight. Place beans, soaked beans and water to boil for 2 minutes and drain. Place in cold water and simmer for 30 minutes, until tender. Drain and combine all ingredients except sifted icing sugar. Serve in warm bowls drizzled with icing sugar, with caramella icecream. Makes 1 cup.

title: The Best American Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans stewed tomatoes | 3/4 cup catsup | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground allspice
instructions: Mix stewed tomatoes, catsup, and allspice together in a saucepan over medium low heat. Stir in the water, if necessary.

Random Ingredients: red onion,coconut cream,chipotle chile,spice,muscovado sugar,balsamic vinaigrette salad dressing
title: Chunky Chipotle Muscat
ingredients: 3 chipotle chiles | 1 small red onion | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinaigrette salad dressing ( optional ) | 1/3 cup coconut cream | 2 tablespoons spiced balsamic vinaigrette ( optional ) | 1/4 cup spiced balsamic vinaigrette salad dressing, see note | 1/4 cup muscovado sugar
instructions: For chipoltes, slit in half crosswise and scrape out seeds. Roast or peel chipoltes on a cast iron pan of an oiled grill or under the broiler. Place on a rimmed baking sheet. Roast at 400°f for about 10 minutes, turning once.

title: Cucumbers With Pecorino Cheese
ingredients: 2 cucumbers | 2 tablespoons pecorino cheese, grated
instructions: Cut the cucumbers in half lengthwise. Place on a plate. Sprinkle the inside of the cucumber with the pecorino. Enjoy your time.

title: Easy Arabic Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 2 tablespoons finely crushed kalamata olives | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Place your rice in the rice cooker and select quick or medium pulses. Add 2 tb of vanilla essence if using and then slowly add 1/4 cup of water. Set the rice cooker to the cook cycle which will take around 25 - 30 minutes depending on your cooker. After the 25 minutes add the remaining 1/4 cup of water and stir. After another 5 minutes check the rice for doneness and if it is just about done then continue. To finish, either serve immediately or store in your fridge until required. This should last up to 7 days.

Random Ingredients: green tomato,flat leaf parsley,chicken thigh,mayonnaise,zucchini,saltine cracker,lemon juice zest,cashew
title: Cashew Nut Chicken Salad
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 medium zucchini, sliced | 6 ounces crushed saltine crackers | 1/4 cup cashews | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 medium green tomato, sliced | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place chicken, zucchini and saltines in a non stick baking dish and roast for about 20 minutes or until cooked through. Cool slightly and then slice into thin rounds. Mix crumbs and cashews in bowl with chicken and vegetables. In another non stick baking dish, mix mayo and lemon juice zest and mix into chicken mixture with mayonnaise. Spoon dressing onto salad and sprinkle with parsley just before serving.

title: Thai Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes | 8 tablespoons chili paste
instructions: Cut a cross into the tomato. Place in a bowl. Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons chile paste into a small bowl. Dip the tomatoes into the paste. Allow to sit 5 - 10 minutes. Serve in a small dipping bowl.

title: Green Beans With Red Chili Powder
ingredients: 225 g firm green beans,, trimmed | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 teaspoons tomato puree
instructions: Cut the ends off of the green beans. Boil until the beans have boiled for around 5 to 10 minutes. Heat oil in a frying pan on medium flame. Add chilli powder and fry for a few seconds. Add the green beans and fry this until the green beans is slightly brown. Stir in the tomato puree and fry for 1 minute. Serve hot. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,cumin powder,locatelli cheese,lettuce,extra virgin olive oil,chicken breast half,corn kernel,bacon
title: Chicken Breasts Stuffed With Crunchy Corn
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon, finely chopped | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast half ( about 3 med-size ) | 2 large boneless chicken breast halves ( about 1-1/4 pounds ) | 5 large lettuce ( red leaf ) | 1 bag frozen corn kernels | 1 large unpeeled locatelli cheese | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | grated locatelli cheese | 1 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp and golden, about 10 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a plate.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,salad oil,celery seed,chicken breast fillet,lavender,green cardamom pod,enchilada sauce,self rising flour
title: Lavender Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets | 3 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 teaspoon ground dried lavender | 1 green cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 can condensed tomato soup
instructions: Place the chicken into an oven safe dish. Combine the flour, oil, lavender, cardamom and celery seed in a small bowl and pour over the chicken. Cover with plastic wrap over the chicken and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 425°f line the bottom and sides of a shallow baking dish with parchment paper. Remove the chicken from the marinade and shake off the extra. Cut the chicken in half from the narrow end and place onto the prepared piece of parchment paper. Use scissors to butterfly the paper and scrape off any excess flour. Return the chicken to the dish and spread the corn meal blend over each piece. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden and crispy. Serve with the enchilada sauce, chopped tomato, roasted vegetables and crusty bread to dipping.

title: Baby Spinach With Curried Chipped Baby Spinach
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen baby spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon grated celeriac | curry, sauce
instructions: Defrost spinach and spinach in a microwave safe bowl for about 2 minutes using 600w. Combine the spinach, spinach and celeriac and mix well.

title: Bitter Steak and Spinach Stoup
ingredients: 1 piece good quality steak | sea salt, to taste | ground cumin, to taste | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon good taste bitter | 3 -4 ounces fresh spinach | 1 ounce shallot | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Score both the sides of the steak in lines, about 3 /4 inch wide. Place the steak into a large pot of boiling water and season with salt, cumin, bitter, and plenty of freshly ground black pepper. Add about 1 pound of cleaned, peeled spinach, 1 ounce of the shallot sliced fine, and 1/2 ounce of sea salt to the boiling water. Boil, then simmer the soup gently just long enough to dry out the spinach, reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the meat is tender enough to fall of your fork. Just before serving, add a few extra tbs. Of salt and the rest of the shallots and the juice from half a small heavy-cured beer to taste. If desired, add a few sprigs of parsley and serve hot. Grated fresh romano cheese or parmesan cheese can be stirred into the soup as a seasoning for the soup.

title: Goat Cheese Snowballs
ingredients: 3/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup goat cheese | 1 pint vanilla ice cream
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Line the baking sheet with foil. Spray or line the foil with aluminum foil. In a food processor, combine oats and salt or coarsely crumble goat cheese. Blend until well mixed, adding water to make a slightly sticky dough. On a lightly floured surface, roll 1/4 inch balls slightly larger than your baking sheet to ¾ - 1 inch in diameter. With your fingers, gently press off extra dough and transfer to baking sheet. Bake for 9 to 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. Make the vanilla ice cream by placing ice cream in a small bowl. Dip each ice cream ball into vanilla ice cream and roll in oat and oat mixture.

title: Spiced Baked Corned Beef Brisket (Corned Silverside, Silverside)
ingredients: 4 corned beef brisket | 3 teaspoons prepared horseradish sauce | 2 teaspoons calvados or 2 teaspoons other apple-flavored liqueur | 4 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, washed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the brisket in a roasting pan or roasting pan large enough to hold it in large, snugly. Rub 1/4 teaspoon of the horseradish sauce and 1/4 teaspoon of the calvados or other light-flavored liqueur on the brisket. Sprinkle beef generously with salt and pepper. Spread the corned beef with the remaining horseradish sauce. Cover the pan and bake for 3 1/2 hours, or until the meat feels cooked and tender. Uncover the pan and bake for 2 1/2 hours. Remove the brisket from the oven and let it stand for 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the brisket from the pan. Remove 2 tablespoons of the pan drippings and 1 tablespoon of the drippings. Stir in the parsley and remaining half teaspoon of the calvados or other light flavoured liqueur. Turn the brisket over. Slather with parsley sprigs. Serve hot. Note, the corned beef will keep the corned beef warm in its roasting pan for up to 5 days.

title: Tamarind Noodles & Ramen
ingredients: 8 ounces pita bread ( any flavor ) | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1 1/2 ounces margarine, at room temperature ( optional ) | 4 packages prepped boneless ramen noodles | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Cut pita bread into 1 squares. Prepare tamarind paste by placing 1/4 cup tamarind pulp into a small pan over low heat & heating 1 minute. Stir. Set aside. Heat margarine in 10 inch skillet until melted, add spice mix and ramen noodles. Stir until noodles are evenly coated in spice mix. Bring to a simmer and cover, reducing heat to medium low. Simmer noodles for about 5 minutes or until desired thickness. Sprinkle with sesame seeds, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,guinness stout,vidalia onion,parsley,chicken,feta cheese,white pearl onion
title: Chicken Stuffed Onions
ingredients: 3 lbs of large white pearl onions | 4 large vidalia onions ( this is the large yellow onions, if you can't find both ) | 3 lbs chicken, stuffing and stuffing | 8 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 10 -12 ounces guinness stout | cinnamon, for topping | parsley, for topping
instructions: Put the onions in a pot and fill with about 1/2 inch of water. Bring to a boil or medium low. Cook for 3 hours or until a knife goes into the core and the onions are tender. Remove the onions from the water and mash them. Place the stuffing in a bowl and mix in the onions, cheese, guinness and cinnamon. Stuff the onions with the stuffing and secure with toothpicks. This is very important, not for flavor. Bake at 350°f for about 1 hour or until tender. This could be served warm or cold, depending on the size of your onions. You can also make these ahead of time and store them in the refrigerator for several days. They are much better the next day. To freeze, put them in individual plastic bags, put them in the freezer and heat up. You could also place the onions in a crockpot, cover with aluminum foil and put them in the crockpot on low, or you could put them in bowls and put them in a large freezer bag and cook them on low 10 to 12 hours..

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,apricot jam,margarine,grand marnier,rose water,blueberry,lime,mushroom cap
title: Blueberry Stuffed Mushrooms (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 12 mushrooms cap | 4 tablespoons margarine, melted | 1/2 cup dried apricot jam | 1 tablespoon grand marnier ( powdered orange liqueur ) | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries | 2 tablespoons dried blueberries | 2 tablespoons dried blueberries | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 sprig rose water ( optional )
instructions: Clean mushrooms and remove stems and gills from stems, if desired. Brush mushroom caps with margarine and sprinkle mushrooms with dried fruit. Sprinkle remaining stuffing on mushrooms and top with berries. Coat with powdered orange liqueur. Sprinkle with turmeric powder. Decorate mushroom caps with remaining berries and rose water. Note, i didn't add any rosewater so just stir occasionally. Serve and enjoy.

title: Queso Chili in a Snap
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, cut in chunks | 1 small green pepper, cut in chunks | 1 can goya chilies
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large stock pot large enough to hold all the meat and vegetables in 1 layer. Cover tightly and cook over medium heat for about 8 - 10 hours, until meat is tender remove meat from the chili and place in a colander set over a bowl. Skim any fat from liquid on sauce at root end and discard before eating, this can be done up to 5 hours ahead and refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,arugula,zucchini,green cabbage,rye flour,spaghetti sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,spinach
title: Spinach Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups green cabbage, chopped | 1 zucchini, chopped | 2 cups spinach, shredded | 2 cups arugula | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 tablespoon spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 8 cups thin spaghetti noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Line baking trays with aluminum foil.

title: Puerco Puerto Rican Pork Roast
ingredients: 2/3 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1/3 cup vinegar, white | 1/4 cup roasted tomatoes | 1 pimento, diced | 2 tablespoons pimento, pimento slices, minced | 1 1/2 lbs pork roast, fresh ( optional ) or 2 1/2 lbs pork loin ( optional )
instructions: Spray the inside of the crockpot with non stick cooking spray and set on low. Combine the remaining ingredients in a bowl.

title: Caramelised Herby Rice Lovers' Rolls
ingredients: 12 ounces lasagna noodles, baked | 2 1/2 cups breadcrumbs | 2 1/2 ounces dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons thyme sprigs | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Bake noodles according to weight instructions. Meanwhile melt the brown sugar, and add the spices and essence. Drain the fried rice pieces, and tip them into the bowl with the sugar, cinnamon and seasoning mix. Dry the rolls slightly on a paper towel, then lightly grease an 8 in x 8 in capacity gratin dish with olive oil. Roll the rolls in the crumb mixture, then arrange on a baking paper lined baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes, until golden brown. Remove from a heat and leave to cool. Serve sliced with maple syrup or honey, if preferred.

title: Crock Pot Italian Beef
ingredients: 1 -3 lb roast beef | 3 cups fresh red cabbage or 3 cups frozen mixed vegetables | 1 can chicken broth | 1 -2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 3 cups instant barley
instructions: Put roast beef into crock pot. Add 1 c cold water and 1 c italian seasoning. Cover and cook on high 4 - 6 hours or on low for 6 - 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: italian flat leaf parsley,tomato paste,tea,vegetable stock
title: Tomato Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 2/3 cup tomato paste ( sambel chianti ) | 4 italian flat-leaf parsley springs | 1/4 cup chopped italian flat leaf parsley ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | cooked tea, for serving
instructions: In a large pot, combine stock, tomato paste and parsley. Bring mixture to boil over high heat. Reduce heat.

title: Quick and Easy Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1/4 teaspoon sazon con azafran seasoning ( or to taste ) | 1 pint cherry tomatoes or 1 pint grape tomato
instructions: Using a fork, toss all ingredients except tomatoes through a saute pan. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer about 15 minutes. Add fresh tomatoes and continue simmering about 10 minutes more or until tomatoes are just heated through.

title: Spanish Snow Peas and Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 bag frozen white rice ( in broth ) | 1/2 package frozen bell peppers | 1 package frozen snow peas | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Rinse rice and peppers with water and place in 6 qt crockpot, cut onion in 1/2 inch cubes,. Sprinkle flour over vegetables. Mix rice, vegetables and garlic, mix well and cover. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Serve alone or with rice.

title: Salmon Omelet
ingredients: 1 large egg | 1 can salmon, drained | 3/4 cup kalamata olives | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 2 tablespoons prepared ale
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375 degrees f. In a glass bowl combine the salmon, olives, artichoke hearts and eggs. Spoon mixture onto a piece of aluminum foil and fold over twice. Double wrap omelet. Place on cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,tofu,cinnamon,green cardamom pod,rye bread,sun tomato,pork tenderloin,sirloin
title: Indian-Spiced Tofu & Pork Shawarma
ingredients: 1/4 lb sirloin or 1/4 lb top sirloin steak | 1/4 lb pork tenderloin | 1/2 lb lean ground beef or 1/2 lb lean ground turkey | 4 slices rye bread | 1 ounce firm tofu | 6 -8 sun-dried tomatoes | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 teaspoon dried cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom pod
instructions: Slice the meat thinly. Combine the meat, soy sauce and ginger paste in a bowl. Set aside. Cut the rye bread slices into thin, narrow strips and soak in cold water for 10 - 15 minutes, or until soft. Rinse well to remove the excess water. Drain. Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Dry the slices of tofu using a paper towels. Remove and reserve the tofu. Cook the sirloin, pork, turkey and tofu in the skillet 1 - 2 minutes or until all sides are browned. Set aside. In a separate pan place the tomatoes, ginger, dried cinnamon, cardamom pods and ginger paste. Saute the ingredients for 3 - 5 minutes until slightly tender. Add toasted bread strips and toss well. Top with the pork& beef. Heat through.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,kosher salt,white wine,beef bouillon cube,vegetable broth,gruyere cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 medium white onions, thinly sliced | 2 cups vegetable broth | 1 beef bouillon cube, crumbled ( or use 1 1/2 t garlic powder ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup dry white wine ( recommended -- bordeaux or cabernet sauvignon blanc ) | 1/4 teaspoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: In a large soup pot, saute the onions in 2 t vegetable oil over medium heat until just starting to brown. Do not brown. Add the broth cube and bouillon and bring to a boil, and then cook the mixture covered over high heat until the liquid just starts to boil, about 20 minutes. Do not allow the broth to boil or the onions will turn into mush. Stir in salt and simmer 1 minute longer. Meanwhile, in a nonstick skillet, stir the remaining 2 t vegetable oil until just smoking. Add the wine and heat until almost dry, but not boiling. Stir the wine into the pot. Increase heat, cover, and simmer on low, while you prepare the soup. Pour the pot's contents into another nonstick skillet and set aside. When the soup is finished cooking, ladle 2 cups of soup into a large blender and purée until smooth. Return the soup to the pot and stir in grated cheese. Return soup to the pan, and heat through. Do not boil. Stir the soup just before serving.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,green olive,butter,malt vinegar,gin,coconut milk,barley flour
title: Old Fashioned Barley Sweet Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups malt vinegar | 1/2 cup butter | 10 tablespoons brown barley flour | 1 can coconut milk ( with 1 tbsp of the liquid squeezed from the can ) | 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1/2 cup chopped green olives | 2 ounces gin ( i use metzler brand )
instructions: Place the malt vinegar and butter in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Lower the heat to a simmer, mix in the brown rice flour until completely blended, stir in the coconut milk and add the dried fruit. Boil for five minutes, stirring occasionally. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 10 more minutes, stirring to make sure the flour coats the back of the spoon. Continue to simmer, stirring about 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. Add the grated coconut flakes, aniseed, chopped olives and cook for 10 minutes more. Cool completely and store in a jar in the fridge. Can be kept for several days.

title: Basic Dressing
ingredients: 250 ml vegetable stock or 250 ml chicken stock, hot | 1/2 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a screw top jar and shake well to combine. Store in the fridge for up to a month and serve immediately.

title: Simple Sausages With Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: 3 italian turkey sausages ( or other light sausage ) | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Place sausages in glass dish. Sprinkle with spices and drizzle glaze over them. You may also add chopped onion and or mushrooms and/or fresh parsley or chopped coriander. Bake at 375 degrees until cooked to desire desired level of doneness.

Random Ingredients: nutritional yeast,spaghetti,pork sausage,ranch dressing mix,green pepper,sambal oelek
title: Skillet Spaghetti, Sausage and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork sausage | 1 large green pepper, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 1 cup nutritional yeast | spaghetti | spaghetti, hot
instructions: Cook sausage, pepper, and nut in skillet. Drain fat from skillet.

title: Finnish Beef Balls
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef round | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon cube | 0.5 can vodka | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 3 cups rice krispies or 3 cups other pastries
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Add to stew and stir well.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,sauce,cayenne pepper,pancetta,white onion,orange bell pepper
title: Pancetta Toast Wraps
ingredients: 5 slices pancetta, diced | 1/3 cup chopped white onion | 1 tablespoon chopped orange bell pepper | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1 loaf rye bread, sliced in half
instructions: Preheat a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Add pancetta, onion, orange bell pepper, hot sauce, and cayenne pepper, and saute until the pancetta is soft, about 5 to 10 minutes. Spread 1/4 cup of the pancetta mixture onto half of each slice of bread. Roll the slices up. Secure with toothpicks, if necessary. Toast sandwiches in the hot skillet until puffed and golden brown, about 5 minutes per side.

title: Cheese Fondue for Caramelized Arepas
ingredients: 2 cups soymilk ( or other milk of choice ) | 2 cups light mozzarella cheese, shredded ( about 2 oz ) | 2 teaspoons dark rum | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 large pinch of grated fresh mozzarella cheese, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Scoop yogurt, stir together the milk, sugar, rum, baking soda, and vanilla in a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer about 5 minutes or until mixture is the consistency of milk cream. Ladle hot milk into a bowl, add grated mozzarella, and stir to combine. Let it cool. Serve fondue warm, with arepas drizzled with a little extra sugar, if desired.

title: Lime Crumble (Cookies)
ingredients: 3 cups self-raising flour | 1 1/2 cups lime wedges, finely crushed | 2 cups low fat soft cream or 2 cups fat-free whipped topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c, 190c if fan forced. Place flour and salt in a bowl, mix well. Add lime juice and soft cream and mix. Place mixture on a well greased tray and bake for 20 - 30 minutes in preheated oven. Remove from oven and pour onto hot topping, scatter with cilantro and return to oven for 10 minutes or until topping is golden.

title: Swiss Chard With Sherry and Caramel (Sukker Kirschgogar)
ingredients: 2 lbs thick-leaf swiss chard ( stemmed, washed and roughly chopped ) | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 16 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Tear the leaves from the stems, stems and leaves, leaving about 2 inches of any woody portions attached to the leaves. Place the leaves in a bowl and toss with a few tablespoons of salad oil and a couple of teaspoons of dark sesame oil. Set aside. Using a very good coffee grinder or a vegetable peeler, finely shred the chard leaves and place them in a small, heavy bottomed pan with 1/2 cup of water to cover. Cover with a lid and heat slowly over medium heat until the water turns dark green and evaporates. Turn heat to low and cook gently for 1 hour. Watch closely for burning. Remove heat and stir through 3 tablespoons salad oil mixed in a small bowl. Cool and use to stuff cooled chard leaves. Let rest for 1 to 2 hours in the refridgerator. Make ahead, the chard can be eaten warm but is a better flavor when chilled. The saukker can be frozen and kept, tightly wrapped in the refrigerator, for up to 3 months. Keeps 1 month to age.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,topping,lard,vegetable broth,baby clam,pumpkin pie spice,flour,lemon zest
title: Lemon and Chilli Clam Chowder
ingredients: 300 g frozen chopped cauliflower capsicum ( or other small florentine-sized pieces ) | 2 cans baby clams | 1/2 cup chopped red capsicum | 300 g quick-cooking flour | 1 lemon, zest of | 2 tablespoons finely grated lemon zest | 500 ml vegetable broth | topping ( optional ) | freshly grated lemon zest ( optional )
instructions: To make the soup base, add the flour to a large saucepan and gently melt the butter and then add the remaining ingredients. Bring to the boil and simmer a few minutes. To plate, ladle soup into large bowls. Top with a mound of soup and garnish with extra lemon zest. Serve.

Random Ingredients: milk powder,green bean,oregano leaf,cheese,taco shell,pizza crust,italian salad dressing
title: Mexican Green Bean 'n Cheese Pizza(Diabetic Friendly)
ingredients: 1 store bought pizza crust | 1 can low-fat milk powder ( or 2 % fat ) | 1/2 cup skim milk ( for non-vegan ) | 3 tablespoons italian salad dressing | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant minced onion, or more to taste | 1 pinch dried oregano leaves, or to taste | 1 cup frozen cut green beans, thawed and drained ( optional ) | 2 cups grated lowfat cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Press 1 pizza crust onto the prepared baking sheet. Whisk the milk powder, skim milk, salad dressing, minced onion and oregano together in a bowl. Spread 3/4 of the milk mixture over the crust. Spread 1/2 of the green beans over the filling, if using, stir in remaining green beans and 2 cups of cheese. Spread remaining creamy green bean mixture over the cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and top is darkly browned and crust is toasted, 15 to 18 minutes. Slice.

title: Baked Chili Snack
ingredients: 500 g tomatoes, diced | 2 tablespoons dried onion powder | 4 tablespoons chopped green chilies | 4 tablespoons white bread flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celcius. Put the tomatoes, onion powder, chopped chilies and bread flour in a large bowl. Mix them with your hands. Spray the inside of an oven dish with vegetable oil spray and place in the oven for approximately 15 minutes.

title: Chipotle Chicken Patties
ingredients: 600 g chicken breast fillets | 1/2 cup dried currants | 3/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1 egg white, beaten | 1 teaspoon shortening
instructions: Place chicken on a board and flatten it so it is approximately 5 cm thick. Mash the chicken with a fork and then divide it into 8 portions. Flatten 1 portion of chicken mixture to the edge of a plate. Fold the beaten egg white into a second portion and roll each of the chicken pieces in the egg white. Place the coated chicken into a plastic bag and gently press the air outwards. Repeat until all all the chicken is flattened. Heat up the melted shortening in a small frying pan. Gently lift each chicken patty into the pan, brown each side and then place on absorbent paper to drain excess oil out of the pan.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,cottage cheese,bell pepper,tomato paste,triple sec,non greek yogurt
title: Greek Yogurt and Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 cup non-fat greek yogurt | 1 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 1 dash triple sec | 2 tablespoons sweetened with artificial sweetener or 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 -2 bell pepper, diced | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Blend together yogurt, cottage cheese, triple sec, sugar, peppers, and tomato paste. Serve in a bowl as it is, or refrigerate it until ready to serve.

title: Posh Lentil Bread
ingredients: 2 cups split white lentils | 1 cup farina | 1 cup brown lentils | 1 cup white rum or 1 cup brandy
instructions: Rinse and drain the lentils. Soak them in water for 10 - 15 minutes and rinse them again. Boil in water until soft. Drain and cool down and add 2 cups of farina, sugar, rum and brown lentils at the same time. Put in a blender and blend for at least 30 seconds then transfer the mixture through a well buttered bread loaf container and mix very well. Serve in a bowl and add some fruit or spices if you wish. Serve immediately or cool, cover with aluminium foil when serving.

title: Couscous With Cranberry Glaze
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups couscous, preferably medium-grain | 1/2 cup cranberry juice, preferably fresh | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried thyme sprigs | 1/4 lb linguine ( preferably dry )
instructions: Heat a large heavy skillet over high heat. Add beef and cook, stirring and moving meat constantly, until browned, about 4 minutes. Add couscous and stir. Scatter cranberry juice over the meat and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, bring 4 cups water to a boil in a small pot. Turn off heat and allow to sit until the water is absorbed, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, cook broccoli in large pot of boiling water until bright green, about 1 minute. Drain, and cut into 1 inch pieces. Cook couscous in remaining 1/4 cup water. To serve, mound couscous on each plate and top with broccoli and cranberry glaze.

title: Citrus White Bean Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 1/4 cups bread flour | 1 cup plain dried white beans or can cannellini beans | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 3/4 cups half-and-half | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley | 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped
instructions: In large bowl, dissolve and stir together yeast and flour. Stir in beans, molasses, half and half and basil or parsley. Mix until just barely combined. Turn onto floured surface and knead 2 - 4 minutes or until smooth and elastic. Place mixture into well oiled bowl, turn to grease top, cover and let rise 1 1/2 hours. Punch down. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 20 minute.. Turn onto floured surface and knead 4 - 5 minutes or until smooth and elastic, adding more half and half as needed. Divide dough into 8 pieces. Cover and let rise 20 minute. Divide into equal portions. Shape each section into a round loaf and place on greased pizza pans. Cover and let rise 10 minute. Brush tops with melted butter. Bake at 400° for 12 to 14 minutes, or until loaves sound hollow when tapped on the bottom, but feel firm once you turn them over.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,bell pepper,teriyaki sauce,kidney bean,celery salt,gingerroot,extra virgin olive oil
title: Vegetable "hot" With Spicy Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce ( i like kikkoman ) | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated ( i use fresh gingerroot, peeled and grated ) | 1 pinch celery salt | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( canola or corn or corn flavored ) | 1 lb can kidney beans | 1/2 cup green onion, sliced | 1/2 cup bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper, or spray lightly with non stick cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine teriyaki sauce, gingerroot, celery salt, and oil. Add both cans of kidney beans and enough water to cover beans by at least 1 inch. Bring to boiling, reduce heat and simmer uncovered for at least 4 hours or until beans are tender and liquid is almost evaporated. Drain the cooked beans and liquid from the pot and add to the bowl with the veggies along with the green onion, bell pepper and salt. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary. You do not want to use too much salt. Let sit in the fridge for at least an hour, if you want. Serve chilled.

title: Simple Bacon and Radish Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 small radishes | 4 slices canadian bacon, cut into strips about 2/3 inch long | 1 package fat-free ricotta cheese
instructions: Rinse large lettuce leaves and pat them dry with paper towels. Slice radishes thin, set aside. Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Place bacon and radish slices in skillet and cook, stirring often, about 5 minutes on medium or medium high heat, or until golden brown. Drain off fat and set aside. Combine ricotta and 1/4 cup water in bowl and stir well. Drain pasta and toss with cheese mixture. Sprinkle with bacon, tomatoes, or vegetables of your choice.

title: Hazelnut-Corn Chips on Toast
ingredients: 2 cups corn tortilla chips | 2 tablespoons ground hazelnuts | 2 tablespoons wheat bread, cut into 4 cubes
