instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Using 2 forks, pull and fluff up the tortilla chips with the blunt side of your meat mallet or a rolling pin. Add the ground hazelnuts and mix thoroughly. Arrange the bread on a large baking sheet and spread the hazelnut chips over each. Bake, flipping once, for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,cream tartar,spinach,bean thread noodle,cotija cheese,head garlic,rice
title: Noodle Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 package bean thread noodles | 1 bunch fresh spinach ( stemmed and torn in half ) | 8 ounces rice stick noodles | 1 can refried beans with noodles | 2 ounces cotija cheese, crumbled | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 1 head garlic, cloves sliced thin
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water. Let sit for 2 minutes then rinse with cold water. Set aside. In a large bowl, combine spinach, rice noodles, beans with noodles 1 1/2 c water and cheese. Stir till thoroughly mixed. Add cream of tartar. Toss with noodles and garlic. Serve and enjoy.

title: Faux Risotto I
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice, such as carnaroli rice | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon sage leaves
instructions: Mix the rice and celery salt in a medium size bowl. Add the sage in and slowly mix in the hot water. Keep adding water 1/4 cup at a time until the rice is tender and liquid absorbs it. Continue adding water 1/2 cup at a time.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,beef tenderloin,green curry paste,white vinegar,picante sauce,lettuce leaf
title: Quick and Easy Beef Tenderloin in Green Curry Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced green curry paste | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed | 24 lettuce leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 300 f. In 12 to 16 cup baking dish, mix picante sauce with vinegar, curry paste and oregano. Arrange tenderloin on top.

title: American Stewed Noodles - My Way
ingredients: 1 lb fresh udon noodles | 2 1/2 lbs cooked chicken breasts or 2 1/2 lbs cooked lean pork fat | 1/2 cup pickled jicama or 1/2 cup zucchini, sliced | 3 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon
instructions: Brown onion and add 1 cup water. Simmer while noodles cook. Place bag of noodles and all ingredients except the jicama on a dutch oven or other pan. Stir with a wooden spoon or fork to break up the noodles and keep from sticking. When noodles are soft, add the jicama or zucchini. Cook for an hour, stirring every so often.

Random Ingredients: serrano chile pepper,hard egg,parsnip,plain flour,alfredo sauce,mustard powder
title: Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 2 teaspoons minced serrano chile peppers | 2 tablespoons plain flour or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 4 medium parsnips, halved lengthwise and cut into 3cm slices | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 2 teaspoons mustard powder, mixed with | 2 teaspoons hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c or 170°c if using fan forced ovens or 200°c if using a fan forced ovens. In small bowl add the grated serrano and flour and mix to form a firm dough. Roll tablespoons of dough into 8cm rounds. Put a spoonful of parsnip rounds on a lightly greased baking tray. Push a cherry pepper half down the centre of each round. Repeat with remaining rounds. Sprinkle eggs and mustard powder mixture over the top of the dough. Bake for 15 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve at room temperature.

title: Baharat Aka Gloc De Sabra (Baharat Aka Mild Rum )
ingredients: 1 cup dark rum | 2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Combine rum, garam masala and chill well. Store in a sealed glass jar. Shake well. Makes 1 cup. Pour into hot, dark glasses and serve.

title: Grilled Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck steaks, cut 1-inch thick | 1/3 cup italian parsley, minced | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Combine beef and parsley. Brush half of tortillas with oil. Place on grid on coals or grill over medium heat. Grill undisturbed for 3 - 4 minutes or until charred. Turn. Top with other tortilla. Cook for another 3 - 4 minutes or until tortillas are dry. Cut into strips.

title: Grilled Italian Bread With Roasted Beef
ingredients: 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 4 slices italian bread or 4 slices french bread, 3/4 inch thick | 1/2 lb lean ground beef
instructions: Make sauce, combine vinegar and the sherry in a small saucepan and bring to boil. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 10 minutes. Drain liquid, reserve 1 cup of the liquid. Combine remaining liquid and the bread in a medium bowl. Stir beef into bread mixture and coat thoroughly. Lightly oil grill. Grill bread until nicely browned, about 2 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,corn oil,mustard powder,eggplant,chili oil,coriander seed
title: Spicy Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, sliced in half lengthwise | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, coarsely crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 3 teaspoons chili oil | freshly ground coriander seeds
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, crush the coriander seeds and mustard powder into a paste. Heat the oils in a large flat frying pan over a medium heat. Add the spice paste, and stir well for 1 minute. Add the sliced eggplant and fry for 8 - 10 minutes, stirring well and shaking the pan occasionally. The mixture will be quite dry at this stage. If you need to, add a small amount water. Season lightly and cook for another minute or two until eggplant is crisp tender and most of the liquid has evaporated before it is cooked further. Sprinkle the chopped coriander over your favourite meat or serve with grilled veggies.

title: Dill-Cumin Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard, dill | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons dill weed
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve on greens.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,yellow pepper,lite olive oil,bacon,cornstarch,cumin seed,vermicelli,beef stew meat
title: Syrian Beef and Noodles With Bacon and Vermicelli (Deejma Me Roka Salamoatika)
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon ( or 1/2 lb more of your choice ) | 2 lbs beef stew meat ( i prefer top round ) | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds ( optional or adjust to suit taste ) | 1 1/2 lbs yellow peppers ( preferably a mixture of red, green, orange & yellow peppers ) | 5 tablespoons lite olive oil | 8 ounces vermicelli | 2 tablespoons cornstarch ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan on high heat. Add the bacon and brown on all sides. Add beef and stir. Add soy sauce, cumin and adjust seasonings if desired. Add peppers and stir. Reduce heat and cover tightly for 30 minutes. You may uncover this early in the cooking process if you peek, it will burn because the bacon drips out a little bit while cooking if you do. When meat is tender, uncover & stir. Drain off some of the liquid and remove bacon and veggies. Cook the vermicelli according to package directions, drain and set aside.. While heating up your cooking oil, dry fry vermicelli until golden on both sides. Drain on paper towels with tongs and set aside. Once vermicelli is dry, stir it in with the rest of your cooking oil. Turn heat back up to medium and stir fry 1 - 2 minutes. Add beef and veggies and cook another 2 - 3 minutes. Sprinkle with cornstarch if desired.

title: Shrimp in Green Onion Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces medium shrimp, peeled & deveined | 3 green onions, tops trimmed, thinly sliced
instructions: Saute shrimp in large skillet in hot oil until just pink, about 1 minute. Using slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to serving platter.

title: Coconut Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry | 2 cups coconut milk | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Thaw puff pastry sheets according to package directions. Spread coconut milk across the entire pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Saffron Flavored Roast Pork
ingredients: 1 kg boneless beef chuck roast | 3 saffron strands | 2 tablespoons ground walnut oil
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°c. Place all of the marinade ingredients into a plastic bag. Add the roast pieces, turning to coat and shaking off excess air. Place the roast in the roasting tin, fat side down. Pour the remaining marinade over and cover with a lid. Put the roasting tin into the preheated oven for two and a half hours. Leave the beef to rest for about 15 minutes before slicing and serving. Great with rice.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,gingerroot,french bread,whipping cream,farfalle pasta
title: Pasta With Chicken, Ginger Cream & Gravlax
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 6 slices fresh gingerroot | 1 tablespoon whipping cream | 1/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water as directed on the package. Drain and set aside. Preheat oven to 350°f. Place chicken broth cubes in a blender and blend to combine. Place farfalle, gingerroot, whipping cream and chicken and broth in a 3 qt. Baking dish and bake for 45 - 50 minutes, or until pasta is tender.

Random Ingredients: french cheddar onion,tomato sauce,roasting chicken,yellow squash,phyllo pastry,pomegranate molasses
title: Tagine for the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can yellow squash, drained | 1/2 pomegranate molasses | 5 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup french cheddar cheese with dried sweet onion
instructions: Place the chicken in the slow cooker and rub salt on the outside of the chicken. Place the chicken into the slow cooker, cover and set to high. Cook for 20 hours. Remove the chicken and cool completely. Remove the chicken meat from the bones, discard the skin and cut chicken meat into chunks. Return the chicken to the slow cooker and add the tomato sauce. In a medium saucepan on medium heat, stir together the yellow squash, pomegranate molasses and french cheddar. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Place the phyllo pastry sheets on a large baking sheet, brush with olive oil and use your fingers to brush the cut sides with olive oil. Top with some of the onion slices and about 1/2 cup of the warm liquid from the slow cooker. Place some of the chicken pieces on top of the pastry. Season with salt and pepper. Top with more onion slices. Top the chicken with slices of the bread and brush with olive oil. Repeat with another layer of phyllo pastry, then rest of the tomato juice and chicken. Bake for 30 minutes in a preheated oven at 325 degrees f. Remove from oven.

title: Chinese Chicken and Fennel Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 8 cups flour | 1 1/4 lbs chicken backs | 6 eggs, mixed with | 1 teaspoon fennel | 2 green chilies, cut in half lengthwise | 8 ladyfingers | 1 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 2 cups warm water. Place a large dutch oven or roasting pan into the oven. Place chicken into the pan along with the rest of the ingredients. Place in the refrigerator to rise. Turn the heat on to 375 degrees and bake until toothpick inserted into the end comes out dry, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove the ham from the oven and cut it into 1/2 inch slices. Place on a paper towel lined plate and let them rest 15 minutes. While the ham is hot, break down the wings from the back of the back bone and remove the ribs and tendon. Rinse the chicken and pat dry. Using two forks, pull the meat apart. In a separate bowl, whisk together the yeast mixture and 1/2 cup water. Add the flour and egg mixture, stirring to make a soft dough. Pour onto a floured surface and knead for one minute. Turn the kneaded dough out on the board and knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 more minutes. Shape the dough into two loaves. Place them one in the refrigerator and cover with a cloth. Allow to rise for 30 minutes. Cut the ends off of the spring roll and cut the rolls into 1 inch slices using scissors. Place them on a greased baking sheet. Beat the eggs with the fennel seed in a small bowl, and stir in 1/2 cup water. Brush half of the egg mixture into each slice of bread, covering the bottom and sides. Dip the bread slices into the beaten egg wash and let them soak for 7 minutes. Top with the pecans. Bake the bread until golden brown in color, and the internal temperature of the yia is 190°.

Random Ingredients: miracle whip,vegetable stock,beef chuck,oyster sauce,dark rum,paprika,cumin seed,pecorino romano cheese
title: Beef Shank With Pecorino-Pecorino Caramelized Rum, Dipping Ingredients and Gravy
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed of fat and cut into 2 1/2-inch chunks | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons mirin-flavored soy sauce ( pecorino-pecorino ) | 8 ounces pecorino romano cheese, chopped | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 8 teaspoons miracle whip
instructions: Toast the cumin seeds in the nonstick skillet over medium high heat, shaking the pan frequently, until lightly browned and fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and let cool until slightly warm before grinding. Transfer the toasted cumin seeds to a small heavy bottomed skillet. Season with salt and simmer over medium heat, stirring the meat, 1 teaspoon of the paprika, and 1/2 teaspoon of the cumin seeds, stirring to scrape the bottom of the pan, until the liquid has evaporated and the meat is browned on all sides, about 30 minutes. Stir in the stock and mirin and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the liquid in the skillet is reduced and thickened slightly, about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside. To make the rum dipping sauce, toast the remaining 1 teaspoon of paprika, 1 teaspoon of the cumin seeds, the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons of paprika, and the rum in a small heavy skillet over medium low heat, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add the cheese and stir until it melts, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the rum and the miracle whip until combined, then gradually add the remaining 1 teaspoon of paprika and the remaining 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds until combined. Season to taste with salt. Transfer the beef to a shallow serving bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until warm to the touch, about 1/2 hour. To serve, cut or break it into bite sized chunks and serve on top of the pecorino pecorino mixture.

title: Fried Shallots
ingredients: 6 ounces shallots | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili paste
instructions: Heat the oil in a non stick frying pan. When it is hot, add the shallots, stir fry for 5 - 10 minutes remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly. Stir the chili paste into the fried shallots and serve.

title: Creamy Salmon and Apple Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups salmon, flakes | 1 cup strawberries | 1 granny smith apple, cut in half ( optional ) | 1 1/4 lbs skinless chicken thighs | 2 cups lemon vinegar
instructions: In a bowl, mix the salmon and strawberries with the apple, if using, and lemon vinegar. Coat the chicken pieces with a mixture. Thread onto skewers, and cook them over hot coals about 5 minutes per side, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Beef Tenderloin(Oven or Oven)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin fillets, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Place the fillets between two sheets of wax paper or plastic wrap. Press down to flatten. Place in 1 layer on a large baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes, turning once, until golden brown. Turn fillets over and bake for another 10 minutes, or until just cooked through. Remove from oven and let cool for five minutes before cutting into slices. This recipe can be made for a crowd and served all at once.

title: Lime Fizz
ingredients: 1 can black beans | 1/3 cup liqueur
instructions: Put all ingredients into a small mixing bowl. Mix until thoroughly combined. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,baby spinach,baking potato,irish whiskey,kosher salt
title: Irish Sausage With Baby Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large baking potatoes | 2 lbs baby spinach | coarse kosher salt | 3 tablespoons irish whiskey | 3/4 cup soft white breadcrumb
instructions: Prepare a baking dish using a non stick spray. Wash the baby spinach and drain well. Place the spinach on the baking dish. Using a slotted spoon remove the dry spinach from the bowl of hot water on the cutting board and repeat for 5 minutes and repeat for the other side. Place the sausages on top of the spinach and sprinkle coarse kosher salt over all. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or for up to three hours. Remove the sausages from the refrigerator and cut the sausages diagonally into 3/4 inch slices. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. In a food processor add the irish whiskey and pulse a couple of times until you have a good chunky puree. Sprinkle the puree over the sausage and spread evenly. Place the baking dish in on the broiler tray and roast for 12 minutes. Remove from the oven and let sit for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small frying pan toast the breadcrumbs for several minutes on medium heat. Place the toast crumbs in a small bowl. Dip the sausages in the breadcrumbs and place on baking sheet and brown for another 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon sugar,brown sugar,manicotti,serrano chili,cream chicken soup,ice
title: Mexican Manicotti
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 serrano chili, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar | 1 package manicotti, cooked and drained | 3 cups crushed ice
instructions: Combine soup, brown sugar, chili, and cinnamon sugar in a saucepan.

title: Spinach and Cauliflower Fritters
ingredients: 4 ounces broccoli, broken into florets | 1 ounce cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 jar sliced peaches | 1 teaspoon red food coloring
instructions: Put all ingredients in a pot and just enough water to barely cover, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer until the vegetables are tender, stirring regularly, about 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the colouring. Serve immediately.

title: Morel Dip
ingredients: 1 pound morels | 2 jars morels, drained | 2 packages minced onion | 1/2 cup minced fresh ginger paste | 1 jar honeydew melon slices, drained
instructions: Place the morels in a large pot and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,romano cheese,lemon juice,beef broth,dark sesame oil,walnut,virgin olive oil
title: Persian Raisin Beef Rissoles With Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup walnuts | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 2 lbs rissoles or 2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into large dice | 2 cups beef broth | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Soak, rinse and pat dry the nuts. Place in a dry skillet over medium high heat. Toast and stir frequently until most of the nuts are toasted and a light brown in color, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove nuts from skillet and set aside. In a dry skillet, heat 1/2 cup olive oil and brown the raisins over medium heat, stirring regularly, until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl. In the skillet, heat 1 1/2 cups beef broth over medium high heat. Add the sugar and stir until dissolved. Add nuts. Increase heat to high and simmer, stirring occasionally, until warm, about 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove mixture from heat. Stir in the lemon juice and sesame oil. Remove the beef from the bones with a slotted spoon and place in a large bowl. Pour the raisin sauce over the beef and stir well. Sprinkle with grated parmesan to serve.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,greek yogurt,salt water,mustard seed,sprout,cocoa,green bell pepper,spring onion
title: Barefoot Contessa's Swiss Favourite:  a Vegan Green Quesadilla Recipe
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon dried fennel | 3 green bell peppers, washed, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 4 spring onions, washed, trimmed and finely chopped ( green parts, green parts sliced thin ) | 8 -10 fresh sprouts ( optional, i used the green part only and cut it back on the greens for that extra flavor ) ( optional ) | 4 cups low-fat greek yogurt, whisked | 2 -3 tablespoons sesame seeds, for garnish ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f spread the mustard seeds evenly on a baking sheet and place in the preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes, until roasted. Allow to cool completely. Add the fennel seeds in a mortar or coffee ai a while you are waiting for the seeds to become infused with the mustard. When mustard seeds have become a little fragrant, take the pan off the heat and transfer to a bowl. Sprinkle the fennel seeds on the mustard seed and toss lightly. Allow to cool completely. Grind the peeled green bell peppers into a coarse paste then combine with the spring onions in a large bowl. Add more seeds, and mix well. Add yogurt and mix thoroughly. Transfer to the container of a food processor and blend until smooth. Add half as much reserved mustard seed mixture as necessary and pulse lightly until the peppers are coarsely ground. Add more mustard seed, until the desired consistency is reached. If you like the yogurt thinner, add small quantities of yogurt and a little bit more. Place in the fridge to chill.. Spread the quesadilla evenly on a greased baking sheet. Smooth top, sprinkle with sesame seeds and bake for about 15 - 20 minutes or until breads are golden brown. Cut into fingers or cubes and serve warm with other condiments such as lettuce leaves, tomato wedges, honey mustard greens, etc.

title: Dessert Parfait
ingredients: 500 g heavy cream | 2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Beat the cream with butter, add ghee. When it starts to come to a simmer, add sugar syrup and stir all the time. Take off heat and allow it to stand for 15 - 20 minutes. The parfait should be shiny and thick. Serve with crackers, sambar or chillies or as a side dish with a cucumber salad.

title: Terrific Mexican Grill Style Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 can beer | 1 can rotel ( mild red and green mexican blend )
instructions: Brown beer around edge of canning jars in non stick skillet for 5 to 6 minutes until bubbles on top. Drain beer can and pour into hot beer can. Top with rotel. Dip will keep in a cool dark or dry place for 24 hours.

title: Sago Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons steak sauce, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon sago | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 4 thin sliced rump steak
instructions: To make sauce, combine steak sauce, sago, margarine, ginger, and sago mixture. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Dip steak in butter. Place on top of the sago mixture. Cook, turning until steak is no longer pink in the center, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,snow pea,hot italian sausage,chicken bouillon
title: Sausage and Snow Peas Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, thawed | 1 lb snow peas | 3/4 cup sherry wine | 1 chicken bouillon, crumbled
instructions: Cut the sausage into 1/8 slices. Cut the snow peas lengthwise into 1 1/2 lengths.. Heat a large wok or skillet over medium high heat until a bead of water sizzles. Add the sausage and stir fry for 1 minute allowing it to lightly brown. Add the snow peas and toss well to lightly brown. Remove the sausage in the wok or skillet and add the sherry. Cook until it begins to evaporate and the sauce begins to thicken. When it does, add the bouillon and toss to combine and let the liquid come to a boil. Toss in the crumbled sausage slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,ice cube,asiago cheese,baking potato,yellow pepper,white onion,squash,half cream
title: Calabaza Con Calabaza
ingredients: 3 lbs baking potatoes ( unpeeled ) | 2 large yellow peppers | 2 large white onions | 1 can squash | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 1/2 cups asiago cheese | 2 -3 tablespoons cinnamon | 4 ice cubes, crushed
instructions: The night before, place unpeeled potatoes in a steamer, or pot with water to cover. Place over boiling water, bring to boil, then cover and simmer for about 1½ - 2 hours, or until tender. When tender, drain and mash well. Slice the white onions, and peel the peppers. Cut the squash lengthwise into wedges. Cut the squash into wedges in equal sized squares. Place squash cubes, onions, peppers, and garlic in bottom of a greased baking pan. Mash squash with a potato masher or the back of a large spoon to break up clumps. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the cream evenly over the veggies mixture, breaking up clumps as needed. Make small holes in the top with a spoon. In a separate bowl, mix remaining 1 cup of cream, cinnamon, and 1 teaspoon of salt. Drizzle over the dish. Bake in 350 degree oven for 30 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Remove from oven and pour in the remaining cream. Dot with the croutons and serve.

title: Rye Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs beef, lean and ground | 1 lb sausage, sweet or hot, hot, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 3 cups cake flour | 2 heads romaine lettuce
instructions: Mix the meats together and shape them into 6 or 8 - 8 bread rolls. Wrap each in wax paper and place in cold water or freezer for 24 hours, to make slicing easier. Remove the meat individually and slice thick.

title: Homemade Daikon Noodle Shchi
ingredients: 5 ounces daikon radishes, peeled, very grated and very finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | cheesecloth, disardable and lightly wrung | 1 tablespoon grated cheesecloth, disardable and lightly wrung
instructions: Soak a tea towel in a bowl of warm water for ten minutes. Combine the shredded daikon and white pepper and mix into the grated daikon by hand. Divide into four pieces, cover the bowl with a kitchen towel and hang over the sink for fifteen minutes. Rinse it under cold water and squeeze out excess liquid. Drain well. Transfer 1 tablespoon of the liquid to a bowl and add the remaining 1 tablespoon liquid, and the 1 tablespoon cheesecloth. Using a rolling pin, roll the mixture into a ball about 1/8 inch thick. Place the ball on the towel and pinch and shape it with knuckles to reshape it into a ball. Place into a refrigerator and chill for at least two hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: cod,rose water,coconut cupcake,tomato sauce,beef chuck,cranberry,garlic paste
title: Crock Pot Beef Massaman
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef chuck | 1 teaspoon garlic paste ( add more if you like... i used garlic ) | 1 can tomato sauce | 3/4 cup crushed coconut ( or coconut flakes if you can't find this ) | 1 1/2 cups dried cranberries ( or chopped fresh cranberries ) | 2 tablespoons rose water | 2 1/2 tablespoons coconut and cupcake decorations ( optional )
instructions: Slice meat into thin strips.. Sprinkle with garlic. Combine tomatoes, pineapple and 1/2c sugar. Pour over meat. Cover and set to low. Cook overnight. Turn meat over. When ready to cook, add rosewater and cover again. Cook until meat is tender and meat is fork tender. Stir 1c flour into a thin paste, stir into meat. If the paste is still lumpy, stir in small amounts of flour until desired consistency is achieved. Serve over rice. I like this with plain boiled potatoes, which is how they are served by the massaman.

title: Sizzler Steak and Spareribs
ingredients: 1 spareribs, trimmed | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Preheat an oven to 200 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the spareribs on the baking sheet, and season with salt. Bake to desired doneness, about 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or to desired doneness, turning once. Cool to room temperature.

title: Homestyle Beef - or Pork
ingredients: 12 ounces catsup | 18 ounces mustard, any type
instructions: Mix catsup and mustard and heat up to simmering point. Slice meat and pour over sauce. Cover and simmer until meat falls apart when prodded gently, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,rice vinegar,green cardamom pod,merlot wine,white onion,italian salad dressing
title: Spicy Merlot Marinade for Pork and Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup merlot wine | 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 large white onion, chopped | 1 green cardamom pod, whole ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon italian salad dressing
instructions: In a nonmetal bowl, whisk together the wine, vinegar, garlic salt, onion, cardamom, and italian dressing. Place meat in the marinade, cover, and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 15 minutes. Bring to a boil and cook 5 to 8 minutes until the meat is done, and vegetables are tender.

title: Scallops- Scallops With Mango Chutney - Low Fat
ingredients: 6 scallops ( about 450g total ) | vegetable oil ( for frying ) | 400 g chopped mixed mango chutney ( or jam or apple brandy ) | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 1 pinch mango chutney ( optional ) or 1 pinch apricot jam ( optional )
instructions: Cut the scallops lengthways to about 3 4cm. Thick slices. Heat a little veg. Oil in a frying pan and fry scallops for 2 - 3 mins or until just cooked. Drain and set aside. Place the chopped mango chutney or jam in a small, shallow pan. Heat until warm but not boiling. Add tomato puree, mango chutney and tomato purée. Add the steamed scallops and stir fry until warm. Serve with the scallops scallops.

title: Canned Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 cup distilled white vinegar
instructions: Prepare a large skillet with 2 inches oil. Pour in the vinegar and taco seasoning. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cook approximately 2 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until hot. Serve with lettuce, corn, tomatoes, cheese, salsa, or other favorite dish.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,pineapple chunk,thyme sprig,hazelnut oil,pistachio,coffee,tomato green chilies,liquid smoke flavoring
title: Pineapple-Pistachio Crumble
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnut oil | 1 cup soft breadcrumbs | 1 1/4 cups dried breadcrumbs ( i use multigrain ) | 1 can pineapple chunks, in their juice, drained | 3/4 cup packed salted pistachios | 2 tablespoons dried oregano or 1 tablespoon fresh oregano, minced | 2 cans stewed tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | fresh thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Heat 1/2 the hazelnut oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat until just beginning to smoke. Add 1 cup soft bread crumbs, stirring and scraping with a rubber spatula, until mixture resembles coarse meal, about 1 minute. Transfer crumbs to a bowl. Add the remaining 1/2 cup soft bread crumbs and stir. Add the pineapple, peanuts, 1 tablespoon oregano and stewed tomatoes to the bowl. Drizzle with remaining hazelnut oil. Stir gently to combine. Stir in remaining 1 tablespoon oregano. Spoon into a shallow 8 inch baking dish. Bake at 400° for 12 minutes and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup bread crumbs. Bake until light golden and bubbly, about 40 minutes. Serve hot, warm, or at room temperature and garnish with thyme, if desired.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,yellow onion,beef tenderloin,egg noodle,black vinegar,salmon
title: Japanese Beef and Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced yellow onion | 1 tablespoon distilled black vinegar | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon ground dried beef tenderloin | 1 1/2 cups egg noodles, broken into pieces | 1/4 pound sliced fresh salmon, cut into chunks
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the onions, vinegar, oyster sauce, and ground beef. Set aside 1 tablespoon onion mixture for garnish. Place the egg noodle in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water. Cook for 5 to 8 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and keep hot. Toss the reserved onion mixture and salmon in a small amount of cornstarch, then set aside. Serve the beef and noodles on a bed of noodles.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,ginger,coffee,chipotle chile,oregano,bread dough,hearty white bread,cashew nut
title: Beef or Turkey Samosas With Cashew Nut-Chipotle Stuffing
ingredients: 1 large bread dough ( frozen is ok ) | 2 quarts strong hot coffee | 2 chipotle chiles | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 tablespoon ground ginger | 1/4 cup cashew nuts | 1/2 cup hearty white bread, crusts removed | 3 tablespoons sherry wine ( optional ) or 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Dough, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Prepare the bread dough. Using the thawed dough on a lightly floured surface, cut out a circle from the thawed dough. Using 2 tablespoons of dough, lightly stretch the dough about a 4 inches in diameter. Using a cookie cutter, make a cone shape about 1/2 inch wide on the bottom of the dough. Repeat until the diameter of the dough is 6 inches in diameter. Gently place the circle on a piece of parchment paper and lightly flour it. Repeat until the dough is used up. Prick the circle all over with the bottom of a round glass and set aside. Place the chilies in a small saucepan and just cover them with lightly salted boiling water. Boil for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and grind with a mortar or spice mill until ground into a fine powder. Set aside. To make stuffing, place the ground chilies, oregano and ginger in a food processor or blender. Process until very finely minced. Add cashew nuts and pulse until ground into a fine powder. Place the bread, crust sides up, on a clean work surface and cut away any crusts. Remove the dough from the freezer and thaw about 10 minutes. Roll it out to about 1/4 inch thickness. Place on an ungreased baking sheet and bake for about 8 minutes. Reduce the oven heat to 350°f. Bake about 25 to 30 minutes, until golden. Remove from the oven and transfer the samosas to a serving platter. Spoon some of the chilies over the side. To make the cashew nut spread, place the cashew nut paste in a medium bowl. Add sherry and/or rice wine or vinegar. Mix gently to blend. Spread the cashew nut paste over as a top layer of the samosas. Serve warm, garnished with cashew nuts.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,green cardamom,balsamic vinegar,sunflower oil,orange juice,watermelon,jalapeno pepper
title: Watermelon & Orange Salad With Salty Balsamic Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons orange juice, freshly squeezed | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | kosher salt, to taste | 10 -11 ounces watermelon, rind removed, cut into thin bite-sized chunks ( or combination of both ) | 1 fresh jalapeno pepper, coarsely chopped | 2 green cardamoms, thinly sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, orange juice balsamic vinegar and a pinch of salt.

title: Sauerkraut (Sweet Bread)
ingredients: 4 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup rolled oats bran | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon yeast | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamoms, crushed
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the flour, oats bran, ketchup, yeast and green cardamom. Mix well. Use a floured hands or a large spoon. Knead the dough until smooth and elastic. Allow to rest in covered bowl in a warm place for up to 1 hour. Grease baking sheets and set aside. Form loaves onto prepared baking sheets or on floured parchment paper. Brush tops with vegetable oil. Allow to rise about 40 minutes or until puffy. Allow to rest for another 10 minutes. Slash tops with sharp knife, as desired.

title: Irish Cuts
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 4 slices canadian bacon
instructions: Brown beef. Set beef in crock pot on high. Drain and place bacon on top of meat. You may need to add water to crock pot to keep lid of pot dry. I cook mine for 7 - 10 hours. Do not drain after done.

Random Ingredients: sugar substitute,orange zest,pimento olive,prosciutto,bay leaf,ginger juice,onion powder,cabbage
title: Orange Ginger Cabbage Wraps
ingredients: 6 slices ginger ( from a 1/2-ounce bag, left intact at root end ) | 2 teaspoons dried ground sweet onions or 2 teaspoons dry minced onion flakes | 2 bay leaves | 1/2 teaspoon sugar substitute ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon orange zest, crushed | 1 1/2 cups finely shredded cabbage ( we like a mix of shredded cabbage with shredded carrots ) | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, coarsely chopped | 2 slices prosciutto, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium to high heat. Sprinkle crushed ginger with onion flakes, bay leaves, and sugar and if using. Toss ginger mixture until evenly coated, about 2 minutes. Raise the heat to high and add orange zest, cabbage, olives, and prosciutto. Stir fry for about 2 minutes or until cabbage is just tender, but not mushy. Remove pan from heat and let cool slightly to room temperature. Slice into 1/4 inch pieces and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,coriander seed,lime wedge,kidney bean,vegetable broth
title: Slow Cooker Indian Style Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable broth | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander seeds | 1/2 onion powder | 1 lime wedge
instructions: In a slow cooker, combine the vegetable broth, kidney beans, coriander seeds and onion powder. Add the lime wedge, stir to combine and cover, cooking on high for 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,tapioca,peanut oil,rye bread,glace cherry,garam masala,spice
title: Fried Bread (Spiced) from India
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 tablespoon ground mixed spice | 3 tablespoons tapioca | 1/2 tablespoon garam masala | 7 small rye bread, halved lengthwise | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/4 cup halved glace cherries | 1/2 cup chopped mint leaf | 1 teaspoon olive oil
instructions: Combine 2 tablespoons olive oil and the 1 tablespoon mixed spice in a small bowl and set aside. Place the bread halves on a baking sheet and toast under the broiler. Brush the toast with 1 teaspoon olive oil and toast until golden, about 3 minutes. Rub the remaining olive oil all over the toast. Combine the garam masala with 1/4 cup water and brush it onto the toast. Sprinkle with mixed spice. Place the warm bread pieces on a serving platter and drizzle with olive oil. Top with cherries and mint leaves. Serve cold.

title: Cherry Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 pint half-and-half cream | 3 ounces cherries, pitted and halved | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped slivered almonds
instructions: Use an electric mixer to blend all the ingredients in a large bowl until smooth. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate. It will keep in the refrigerator for at least 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,caster sugar,glutinous rice flour,cottage cheese,littleneck clam,red lentil,cherry tomato
title: Linguica - Seafood Pasties from the Pasties
ingredients: 40 fluid ounces water | 40 fluid ounces uncooked glutinous-rice flour or 40 fluid ounces rice flour | 1 tablespoon gluten free caster sugar | 4 large littleneck clams | 4 cherry tomatoes, sliced | 2 pints italian plum tomatoes or 2 pints italian plum tomatoes, halved | 1 3/4 cups low fat cottage cheese or 1 3/4 cups plain yogurt
instructions: Add water to a large bowl of a blender or food processor and mix with dry ingredients to form a fine dough. Transfer dough to a piping bag. Pipe mixture into 1/2 inch or 3/4 inch wide and 2 inch diameter discs, about 2 inches by 5 inches. Place on a plate covered with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour or up to 3 days, turning the disc around on the plate. Place the remaining dough discs on a board covered with plastic and cut in half into 2 inch disks. Using two large pasta forks, press each disk on its sides, gently pressing to seal in the dough. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Cooking,. If using gluten free flour, preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place shrimp in a large saucepan of boiling water. Cook or steam until golden, 1 to 2 minutes. Drain, then refresh under cold water. Drain and set aside. When cool, shelled the shrimp out of their shells and set aside. In a large saucepan, add the clams, tomatoes, and cottage cheese or yogurt. Bring to the boil, stirring to combine. Ladle off any excess tomato juices and pour into the tomato mixture. Simmer for 2 - 3 minutes or until just heated through. Drain shrimp and return them to the tomato mixture for 1 minute. Spoon mixture into hot, cooked pasta and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: spice,garlic clove,brandy,rigatoni pasta,ginger garlic paste,chicken bouillon cube,black sesame seed
title: Pasta Al Sesame
ingredients: 300 g rigatoni pasta or 300 g rotelle pasta, uncooked | 300 g black sesame seeds | 1 piece ginger-garlic paste ( see my note ) | 1 onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste ( see my note ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 garlic cloves, sliced | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Pre a large pot of boiling water on high until heavily salted. Meanwhile cook the rigatoni according to package instructions, then drain. In a food processor combine the black sesame seeds, ginger garlic paste, and onions and process until they are finely minced. Add the contents of the food processor, the chicken, and the brandy and process until smooth. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large nonstick frying pan on medium and brown the onion paste in it for 5 minutes. Add the rigatoni and mix well, then sprinkle salt and pepper. Serve immediately, making sure they don't get stuck to the pan.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,cream cheese,bacon,green cardamom pod,catsup,flour,red wine vinegar,white sugar
title: Swedish Asparagus Appetizers
ingredients: 8 ounces bacon | 2 lbs fresh asparagus spears | 6 ounces cream cheese | 1/4 cup flour | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 pinch white sugar | 1 pinch black pepper
instructions: In a large skillet, cook bacon until crisp.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,navy bean,grapeseed oil,black pepper
title: White Bean Fritters(Fazul)
ingredients: 1 lb dried navy beans | 7 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 teaspoon cracked black pepper | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Soak beans overnight and rinse overnight. Drain the beans thoroughly. Place the beans in a soup pot and cover with cold water. Add 2 tbsp of grapeseed oil, the pepper and the red pepper flakes if using. Bring to a boil and add the salt and 1 tsp of cracked black pepper. Boil for 2 - 3 minutes or until the beans are tender and cooked through.

title: Quick & Easy Calzone Casserole
ingredients: 4 teaspoons cornmeal | 8 ounces turkey meat, diced | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 2 cans baked beans, drained ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Mix cornmeal and turkey in a large bowl until well moistened. Stir in artichokes and cooked beans.

title: Italian Bread Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked glutinous-rice, rinsed under running water | 1/2 cup amaretto | 4 slices sandwich-style bread, toasted and cut diagonally 1-inch thick | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh basil pesto
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f grease a baking sheet. In a medium bowl, mix the saute' rice, amaretto and half the bread slices. Stir in the remaining bread slices. Spread the filling ingredients on the toasted bread slices and sprinkle with the remaining bread. Bake for 5 to 8 minutes or until heated through. Serve hot.

title: Passata Vongole
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon passata | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon spicy chili sauce ( or to taste )
instructions: Pour passata into a small bowl. Add chilli sauce to taste. Serve.

title: Kellaba (Beef and Black Bean Dip)
ingredients: 1/4 ounce active dry yeast | 1/2 cup soymilk, lukewarm | 2 1/4 cups roast beef gravy, undiluted | 1/2 cup banana, drained and chopped | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve the yeast in the soymilk and let stand 5 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover and put in a warm place to rise for about 90 minutes, or until it has doubled in bulk. Stored, the dough can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Simple Penne All'Amatriciana
ingredients: 300 450 g penne pasta | 3 tablespoons bacon grease or 3 tablespoons lard | 1/4 cup caster sugar
instructions: Add the bacon grease to a large frying pan or casserole dish and add the drained pasta. Stir well and pour the sugar into the hot oil. Cook till the pasta becomes creamy then add the caster sugar and stir well for 2 or 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: carrot,chicken broth,garlic salt,stew meat,spaghetti,green cardamom pod,chili garlic sauce,thyme sprig
title: Spaghetti Primavera
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs stew meat | 14 1/2 ounces stew chicken broth | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon thyme sprig | 1/2 cup carrot, julienned | 14 1/2 ounces spaghetti, twists, uncooked or 14 1/2 ounces whole wheat pasta | 1/2 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Brown stew meat in oil in 4 quart pot.

title: Japanese Fruit Salad!
ingredients: 1 kg large soft cheese | 125 ml low-sodium soya sauce or 125 ml tamari soy sauce | 3 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for half an hour.

title: Lemongrass Catfish With Pistachios
ingredients: 5 ounces thickly sliced chinese canadian bacon, chopped ( or use danish bacon or serrano ham ) | 5 ounces thinly sliced catfish fillets | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground lemongrass or 1 1/2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh lemongrass | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint or 3 teaspoons dried mint | 1/2 cup light chocolate syrup | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread
instructions: In a large skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp. Set aside to drain on paper towel lined plate. Add catfish fillets to skillet and cook 1 minute per side. Stir in lemongrass. Spoon 1/4 cup of hot fat from skillet along with mint and chocolate syrup into skillet and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with saffron.

title: Basil and Swiss Cheese Spread
ingredients: 4 cups cheese, shredded | 2 cups basil leaves, finely chopped | 1/2 cup icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Line baking sheet with aluminum foil. Combine cheese, basil and icing sugar in large bowl. Mix in basil. Spread 1/4 of the cheese mixture on foil, leaving a 1/2 inch covering around outside. Spread remaining cheese mixture on top, leaving a ¼ inch cover. Bake in 350°f oven for 15 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,onion soup mix,chili garlic sauce,chili sauce
title: Quick and Easy No-Bake Ricotta Dip
ingredients: 1 container ricotta cheese | 1/2 onion, finely chopped | 1 jar chili sauce | 1 package chili-garlic flavored onion soup mix
instructions: Mash ricotta with a fork over medium heat. Stir in onion, then chili sauce, and mix thoroughly. Spread onto the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with a layer of chili garlic noodles, and cover with remaining chili garlic noodles. Cover dish with aluminum foil, and bake in a preheated oven on center rack of an oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Kirschwasser Onions for Frying
ingredients: 10 medium spring onions, cleaned and sliced into 1/2 to 3/4-inch lengths | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 6 kirschwasser ( cherry brandy ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Heat heavy, cast iron pan over low heat. While the pan is heating, pound onions by hand with flat mallet. When onions are tender, rub the turmeric powder onto onions, sprinkle the kirschwasser over them and allow to become fragrant. Fry the onions in batches over low heat, stirring regularly, until they are nicely browned on all sides. This does not take long for them. Remove and place on paper towel lined plate as you fry them.

title: Dolma (Greek Meatballs)
ingredients: 12 saffron threads | 1/4 cup ground nutmeg | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lemon grass | 5 pounds extra lean ground beef
instructions: In a large bowl, combine saffron and ground nutmeg. Stir in lemon grass. Roll the beef into 1 inch balls on the palms of your hands. Place in a skillet, and add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer until meat is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove meat balls to a large pot, and set aside. Skim fat from pan, and return skillet to medium heat. Stir in meatballs, 2 or 3 at a time, until evenly coated. Continue cooking about 15 minutes, or until meatballs are browned.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola cheese,cauliflower,pecorino romano cheese,curry powder,dark chocolate
title: Curried Cauliflower and Chocolate Pies
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, chopped fine | 12 ounces dark chocolate | 1 cup gorgonzola cheese | 3 ounces feta cheese | 3 tablespoons curry powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Spray cookie sheet with peanut oil and set aside. Place cauliflower and dark chocolate in a small pot melt the chocolate and stir until smooth. Drain the cauliflower, then mix them with the melted chocolate. Take a handful of cauliflower and make sure it doesn’t tear. Roll into small patty shapes and place onto cookie sheet. Repeat until the rest of the cauliflower is gone. Spray pam in a skillet and cook a few at a time. Don’t over cook them, it’s tasty they’ll be crunchy. Enjoy,.

Random Ingredients: beef tip steak,deli ham,juniper berry,chickpea,banana,chicken thigh
title: Baked Beef & Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tip steaks ( about 4 oz each, top sirloin, log eye steak ( about 3/8 inch thickness ) | 2 banana, sliced thick | 6 whole baby portabella mushrooms or 6 baby arugula leaves | 2 teaspoons juniper berries | 9 cups cooked chickpeas | 6 chicken thighs or 6 chicken drumsticks, cut in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Trim any excess fat from steaks under cold running water.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,basil leaf,clove,fennel,celery salt,white breadcrumb,scallop,heavy whipping cream
title: Scotch Mustard
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs scallops | 4 slices white breadcrumbs | 6 whole cloves | 6 leaves fennel | chopped fresh basil leaf | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream or 1/2 cup water | 1 tablespoon light celery salt
instructions: Place scallops in the bottom of a dutch oven or other large pot. Sprinkle the tops with bread crumbs and the cloves. Add water, salt, and pepper. Place garlic and bay leaf in the pot. Cook over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes. Do not stir. Add a little of the cream or water if it starts to boil. Add basil and cook for 15 minutes. Pour over scallops. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes.

title: Korean Hard Boiled Eggs (Golbapjodsalitang)
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs | 1 piece beef liver | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Cut the liver into small thin slices. In a bowl, mash the hard boiled eggs with a fork. Add the liver slices, vanilla essence and mix. Chill for about 2 hours so it can absorb flavors. Break into bite sized pieces.

title: Tex-Mex Rice Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 4 pieces white breadcrumbs
instructions: Stir fry rice and taco seasoning mix in microwave for about 3 minutes. Stir in bread crumbs. Pour into loaf pan and cover. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees for 25 minutes. Stir until golden brown.

title: Beer and Vodka Dijon Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups pasta, dry weight | 2 1/2 cups marinara sauce | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water for 10 - 12 minutes or according to package directions. Drain and set aside in a serving bowl.

title: Spicy Prosciutto Triangles
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons butterscotch schnapps | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 package prosciutto, diced
instructions: To make the dressing, in a small bowl whisk together the mayonnaise, rosemary, curry powder, schnapps, and cayenne until well blended. Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot. Brush 1 sheet of phyllo lightly with oil. Place 1 sheet of phyllo in the pan, brush with oil and sprinkle with 1/4 of the prosciutto. Layer 8 sheets of phyllo on top of the prosciutto. Layer 5 more sheets of phyllo over the last 5 sheets. Brush all remaining phyllo sheets with oil. Top stacked phyllo sheets with prosciutto. Sift half of the dressing over the top of the layered phyllo. Top with remaining dressing and remaining prosciutto. Cut 4 diagonal slices from the top of each layered phyllo stack to form triangles.

Random Ingredients: amarula cream liqueur,vegetable oil,celery salt,savory,sesame seed
title: The Real Recipe for Savory French Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 6 tablespoons amarula cream liqueur | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory
instructions: Using an electric mixer, mix oil, seeds, liqueur, savory and savory. Refrigerate or add to the whipped cream or plain yogurt before serving.

Random Ingredients: turnip,passion fruit juice,rice wine,jalapeno chile,parmesan cheese
title: Passion Fruit and Chilli Risotto
ingredients: 600 ml passion fruit juice, warm | 2 teaspoons rice wine | 1 -2 jalapeno chile, chopped ( seeds and ribs removed ) | 1 cup cooked turnip ( diced ) | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Place the passion fruit juices and rice wine in a jug and add the jalapenos and turnip. Cover and stand for 20 minutes. Stir gently. Turn out into a bowl and sprinkle with parmesan.

title: Pimento Strips
ingredients: 1 jar pimento peppers, drained | 3 cups corn flakes
instructions: Combine the pimentos, corn flakes, and pepper in a mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,golden raisin,watercress,vanilla pudding mix,green pepper,italian parsley,red wine vinegar
title: Italian Herb and Raisin Pudding With Wine Marmalade, Green Peppers and Herbs
ingredients: 4 cups watercress | 2 green peppers | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, roughly chopped | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 package instant red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | powdered confectioners'sugar, for dusting, for serving
instructions: To make the marmalade, combine the watercress, 1/2 the green peppers and the golden raisins. Bring to a boil over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,lamb,tempeh,pecan,kidney bean,coconut extract,cooking oil
title: Hawaiian Lamb Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups long-grain white rice ( korean rice is preferred ) | 3 -4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 lb ground lamb | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 2 cups cooked tempeh
instructions: In large skillet, brown meat in cooking oil. Add kidney beans, coconut extract, rice and pecans.

title: Veggies on Toast
ingredients: 5 -6 frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 4 -6 slices bread ( rye, pumpernickel, etc. )
instructions: Heat pan with a very little vegetable oil on medium. Arrange frozen mixed vegetables on toast. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Cook for about ten minutes or until vegetables are browned on top and toast is puffed up a bit. Cut into quarters.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,dill pickle,white rice,pepperoncini pepper,hard egg,sponge cake,cheese tortellini,pea
title: Easy Rice Cakes
ingredients: 1 lb cheese tortellini, cooked ( or linguine ) | 4 medium hard-boiled eggs | 1 cup peas | 1/3 cup dill pickle, chopped | 1/2 cup guacamole ( i used a little bit of sriracha ) | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper | 4 toothpicks ( optional ) | 4 slices cheese tortellini, cut in wedges ( optional ) | 2 slices peppered pea
instructions: To make fried eggs, cut egg whites in half and set them aside to weep off excess white in a large bowl. Cut yolks in a small bowl, and set aside in a small bowl. Cut cooled tortellini in half lengthwise, and cut through a fine mesh sieve to remove shells. Toss tortellini yolks into yolks and mash thoroughly. Set aside. Mix 1 cup peas with 1/3 cup chopped dill pickles, Guacamole, and pepperoncini and mix all together, until the mixture is a light yellow paste. Spread half of the potato pancake mix into the bottom of a 8x8x2 glass baking dish. Fill a large pan half full with warm water and put 1 tortilla piece into the water. The water should come to a boil, but not too hot, just barely simmering. Set the water covered, on top of a sheet of parchment paper, or other heavy baking pan, and gently press the tortilla into the hot water, one at a time, to soften. The tortillas must still be pliable, not crunchy. When the pot is filled, scoop the scooped out tortilla out onto the hot water and place on a kitchen towel. You can repeat this, but they will take longer to cook. When the tortilla is soft, remove from the water and place on a cutting board. Using two forks, break it up as you go, adding more of each piece and cutting it into strips. When all four strips have been cut, spread guacamole mixture on top, then layer on dill pickle mixture. Cover with another piece of parchment paper or some heavy baking pan, then place a piece of tin foil on top. Place another piece of parchment or heavy baking pan on top of the tortilla, and press the tortilla into the filling, pressing the tortilla into the filling. You may cook the whole lot on one side, but be sure not to overcook. When all four strips have been cut, spread half of the cut tortilla on top of the guacamole mixture, then spread on remaining guacamole.

Random Ingredients: oregano,black,garlic powder,brown gravy mix,cucumber,chinese wine,self rising flour
title: Chinese Dumplings
ingredients: 1 cup chopped cooked cucumbers | 1 cup brown gravy mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup chinese wine | 1/4 cup grated brown gravy mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 teaspoon ground black | 1/4 cup grated cucumber | 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 1/4 teaspoon oregano | 1 cup brown gravy mix | 2 tablespoons chinese wine | 1/4 cup grated brown gravy mix
instructions: To prepare cucumber gravy,. Combine brown gravy mix with oregano, garlic powder, and 1/2 cup of wine.

title: Yummy Banana Taco's
ingredients: 1 lb ripe mango | 1/2 shallot | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Cut mango into bite sized chunks for each person. I use a mandolin slicer, to cut the fruit into bite sized wedges. Once all are used, place in a freezer bag. Combine all ingredients to make the marinade. Use as many bananas as desired to have on your plate. Serve on a toothpick. Enjoy.

title: Rice - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef roast ( lean ) | 10 ounces basmati rice or 10 ounces pearl river rice | 4 -5 tablespoons cornflour | 2 -3 serrano chili peppers ( optional ) or 2 -3 jalapenos ( optional ) | 200 -250 g gruyere cheese or 200 -250 g swiss cheese
instructions: Cut beef into 2 inch chunks and place into a large casserole dish. If using the chile peppers add now, if using chilli, otherwise add now as well. Pour cornflour over the top, to create a gravy. Cover and cook in the slow cooker on high for 7 hours or low for 10 hours. Rice should be tender and beef should break apart. Add your rice and cheese into your dish, stir through quickly. If too much liquid has boiled up, cover to reduce liquid a bit. If too much liquid has boiled up, cover and keep on low. Leave on the low heat for 10 minutes, then remove the lid and stir for a few minutes. Serve with salsa, sour cream, or a green salad or a crusty bread for dipping in the gravy.

title: The Easiest Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens | 1 can mandarin oranges | 1 large onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Place the chickens into a roasting pan. Pour the can of mandarin oranges into the cavity of the chicken, and add enough water to come about half way up chicken. Cover the pan with foil, and bake for about 1hr& 45min to 2 hours or until the juices run clear. Put chicken on a serving platter to rest, and slice into 1/2& 1/4 thick pieces while still warm. Slice onions into 1&1/4&1/2&ts about the same size as the chicken. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cashew,rice flour,chinese five spice powder,onion powder,cold water,rice paper
title: Cashew Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice flour | 1 1/4 cups cold water | 1/2 cup raw unsalted cashews | 1 1/2 teaspoons onions powder | 1/2 teaspoon rice flour | 1 pinch chinese five spice powder | 1 sheet rice paper, soaked for 3 minutes
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together 1 1/4 cups rice flour, 1 1/4 cups cold water, cashews, onion powder, and rice flour. Form the mixture into a log the size of a large walnut. Wrap a piece of wax paper around the log and press it into 1/4 inch slices. Repeat for the remaining slices. Cut the rolls into wedges and place them on a parchment lined baking sheet. Let stand for 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 375 f. Sprinkle the tops of the rolls with a pinch of chinese five spice powder. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Be sure to turn off the heat before removing the rolls from the baking sheet. The spring rolls will harden after a few minutes, so don't walk away while you wait for the oven to cool. Use scissors or kitchen scissors to cut the rolls diagonally.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,yellow cake mix,margarine,taco seasoning mix,sauerkraut,garlic
title: Slow-Cooker Irish Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 pounds boneless chuck roast, cubed | 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 teaspoon instant minced garlic | 1 package taco seasoning mix | sauerkraut | 1/2 cup margarine for cooking
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, mix together the chuck roast, cake mix, garlic, taco seasoning, and sauerkraut. Marinate in the refrigerator for 12 to 24 hours. Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Uncover the pan of the roast, and cook for 20 minutes per pound. If the stew looks dry, uncover, and cook for 5 more minutes. Place roast on a baking sheet. Brush with margarine, and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,lime,alfredo sauce,green bell pepper,pancetta
title: Mexican Rollups
ingredients: 1 package pancetta or other lean bacon | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix, i use pampered chef taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons taco sauce, i use taco bell's or knorr's | 1/2 cup alfredo sauce, i use la victoria ( or other good brand ) | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, shredded, i use strips of fresh green bell pepper
instructions: Preparation, crumble pancetta into very small pieces. Heat olive oil in skillet, cook bacon until crisp.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,green,cardamom,shortening,white bean,olive oil,bulk italian sausage,pine nut
title: Swedish Yellow Bean Stew
ingredients: 3 tablespoons shortening | 3/4 lb bulk italian sausage | 1/2 cup finely chopped pitted ripe olives plus 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs small white beans | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 3 quarts green or red lentils with chard, green and red parts separated | 16 ounces greek yogurt | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Heat shortening in a 5 quart pot over medium heat until it shimmers, but not brown, about 2 minutes. Add sausage and cook, breaking up with a wooden spoon, about 5 minutes. Add olives, beans, cardamom, and 1 cup of the green or red parts of the green beans. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, 5 minutes. Add 3 quarts of fresh water. Stir again, then simmer, covered, 5 minutes. Add yogurt and stir once. Cook, stirring, 5 more minutes. Sprinkle the top with pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: mustard,rice krispies,egg beater substitute,rigatoni pasta,green curry paste,panir,burgundy wine
title: Panir & Ritz
ingredients: 3/4 lb panir, cubed | 1 package frozen egg beater eggs | 1 cup frozen chopped broccoli stem mix ( or 1 1/2 cups egg substitute with equal egg whites ) | 3 tablespoons green curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup reduced fat rice krispies | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon dry mustard ( such as dijon mustard ) | 1/4 cup burgundy wine
instructions: Toss all of the ingredients together in a large bowl, except kasseri and mustard. Cover and set aside to marinate in a warm place for 15 minutes up to 5 hours. Heat up your kasseri, if using the dry mustard on a baking sheet on 350 degrees f. Stir until the mustard is completely incorporated. Sprinkle over the kasseri. Serve immediately.

title: The Tuna and Squash Sushi
ingredients: 1 green tea powder | 1 ounce cooked tuna in water, drained | 2 small butternut squash, peeled and cut into 24 chunks
instructions: Preheat an oven to 450 degrees f. Stir the green chile powder into the tuna in a large bowl. Lightly toss in the squash chunks, and remove 1 tablespoon of the mixture. Dab any excess liquid, and stir in the tuna, if using. Place the mixture onto a bamboo sushi mat or work surface. Roll each piece of sushi into a ball with the ends touching, and secure with a bamboo skewer. Spread the cooked tuna on top, and use the reserved sushi water to moisten the tuna completely.

title: African Apricot Chicken
ingredients: 1 large apricot | 1 cup of canned coconut milk | 2 tablespoons minced chicken meat, add salt and more if needed
instructions: Pare skin from chicken and cut into 8 pieces. Place in saucepan with remaining ingredients, salt to taste and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Celtic Pear and Walnut Tart
ingredients: 300 g puff pastry | 100 g fresh rocket | 200 g sliced green olives | 50 g fresh dill | 100 g chile | 200 g sliced dry pears | 1/3 cup strong cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Place a large roasting tin in the oven to heat up. Place the puff pastry on a board and use a swivel knife to cut along the edge on both sides. This will create ridges that make you able to remove the puff pastry on to the tin. Brush the base of the roasting tin with oil or cooking spray and place the puff pastry on top of it so there is an excess overlap to allow the air to escape. Leave some dough hanging over the edge of the tin. Chop the rest of the fresh herbs into thin strips and place them in a bowl along with the chile. Mix together the vinegar and flour and stir to make a paste. Combine the olives with chopped herbs and add them to the bowl with the dressing. Place the pear slices on top of the puff pastry, cut around the edge of the tart using a sharp knife to form a lid into a jug or other capacity container. Gently press the lid outwards to seal it well. Carefully remove the lid to allow the steam to escape. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, remove and set aside to cool completely. Carefully spoon the tart onto a greased and floured serving plate. Garnish with fresh dill. Serve the tart warm or cold and with warm toast.

title: Roasted Grape
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs grapes | 1 -2 bay leaf
instructions: Place grapes on a flat board or platter. Sprinkle with bay leaves and roll up. Place upright on platter or baking tray. Cook about 1 hour at 375 degrees. The grape should be golden and the skin should come off easily with a good long handled handle.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,taco sauce,chicken thigh,beef sirloin steak,pepperoni sausage,beef bouillon cube
title: Southwestern Chicken "pillsbury"
ingredients: 1 pound beef round steak ( cut into strips ) | 1/2 pound boneless beef sirloin steak ( cut into strips ) | 12 ounces pepperoni sausage, sliced | 3 ounces hot taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon instant beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons light vanilla extract
instructions: Season meat with 1/4 teaspoons salt according to your taste. In a dutch oven brown meat over medium heat for 2 minutes. Remove meat. Add another 1/4 teaspoons salt. Add pepperoni and hot taco sauce. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Add vanilla. Remove from stove. Stir and return meat to pot. Spray 2 - 9 x 13 pans with cooking spray. Spoon meat mixture evenly into pans. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate, turning over once or twice a day for 2 days. To serve, remove plastic wrap from meat. Serve with cornbread or as a side dish for sandwiches.

title: Baraage Me Lahme
ingredients: 400 g dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight | 200 g dried blueberries | 50 g plain flour | 1 teaspoon finely chopped prunes or 1 teaspoon dried apricot
instructions: Drain excess water from the soaked garbanzos and arrange them in alternate layers on a large oven proof plate. Put the grapeseed or walnuts on top and sprinkle with the flour. Put under a hot grill and grill for 5 minutes. Turn, sprinkle with crumbled dried fruit and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: milk powder,bamboo shoot,yellow onion,lemon zest,nut,tarragon,fish sauce
title: Vegetarian Hot and Sour Spicy Bamboo Shoot Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces bamboo shoots | 2 cans evaporated milk powder | 1 small yellow onion, diced | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 pinch nutmeg, or more to taste
instructions: Blend bamboo shoots, evaporated milk powder, yellow onion, fish sauce, zest, tarragon, and nutmeg in a blender until smooth.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,fennel seed,safflower oil,chicken bouillon cube,meat,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Safflower Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs meat, cut small, 1 1/2 inch cubes ( use the thighs, legs or breasts ) | 3 garlic cloves | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 vegetable oil cooking spray | 6 tablespoons safflower oil | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 chicken bouillon cube, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into plastic bag with meat and marinate overnight, turning frequently. Drain meat and reserve marinade. Heat safflower oil in large frypan over medium heat. Cook meat, until browned on all sides.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,rose water,crescent,lemon juice zest,egg beater substitute,almond essence
title: Rosa's Almond Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 3 large eggs | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons ground almonds ( or almonds with all their sheen ) | 1/2 cup almond essence, such as almond flavour | 1 package refrigerated crescent rolls
instructions: Place one pound of chicken meat in a large bowl. Add the 1 egg, lemon rind and juice and 1 tbsp ground almonds. Process the mixture together and set aside. Place the second pound of chicken in a freezer bag and add the almond essence and ground almonds. Using both hands to evenly coat the chicken, remove the chicken chunks the size of pearl pearl peas so they stay in place. Place the chicken and the 1/2 cup almond essence in a large bowl and mix well. Open the refrigerated crescent rolls and place on a baking sheet covered with wax or parchment paper or a silicone paper lined tin foil. Spoon in enough meat mixture to cover half the crescents and marinate for 3 hours. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Remove from the fridge 30 minutes before you want to bake the chicken. Remove chicken from the marinade and bake for 30 minutes, or until cooked through and lightly browned. To serve, remove the crescents from the oven and place on another sheet of parchment paper covered tin foil. Place a pan of hot tap water on the baking sheet and set aside. Add another pan of tortillas onto the hot pan. Dip each piece of chicken into tortillas a bit of the hot tap water and then place in a warmed bowl to keep warm. To serve, place 4 pieces of chicken in the center of each warmed tortilla. Dip in remaining hot tap water and sprinkle with extra almonds, almond essence, or a light dusting of lemon zest. Garnish with sour cream and/or fresh chopped fresh green onions.

Random Ingredients: pearl onion,vanilla essence,vegetable bouillon cube,chile pepper
title: Mildly Poached Eggs
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces boiling water | 1 1/2 vegetable bouillon cubes or 1 1/2 vegetarian bouillon cubes | 1 chile pepper, deseeded and finely diced | 1 tablespoon finely diced pearl onion
instructions: Boil the water and dissolve the bouillon. Cool and place the bouillon through a sieve then mix this with the chile and onion. Place over high heat until boiling. Stir the eggs and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with lots of butter and/or vanilla ice cream.

Random Ingredients: rice,brown sugar,lite olive oil,maple extract,salmon steak,blueberry
title: Blueberry Salmon Packets #RSC
ingredients: 16 ounces salmon steaks, fat removed, cut into strips | 1 cup blueberries, fresh | 1/4 cup maple flavored extract | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons lite olive oil | cooked rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place salmon strips on a parchment lined sheet and bake for 7 to 10 minutes or until cooked through. Remove from oven and cut into strips. Return to the original baking temperature of 400 degrees. Bake for 2 to 3 minutes, add blueberries and stir. Drizzle over remaining maple flavored extract. Topping with brown sugar. Topping with maple oil. Remove from oven and sprinkle with sugar. Serve topped with crispy or fresh brown rice.

Random Ingredients: currant,egg wrap,berry,vegetable broth,monterey jack cheese,lime juice,baking potato,yukon gold potato
title: Fruity Mashed Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 package frozen mixed berries | 2 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cubed | 2 tablespoons dried currants | 1 egg roll wrap | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup lime juice | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 375f degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil. Place the potatoes in a large dutch oven sprayed with cooking spray. Place over high heat cook until they begin to sweat and turn light brown drain potatoes and place in a large bowl. Stir in frozen mixed berries, potatoes, currants and lime juice and stir until all ingredients are coated. Lay out the roll and place on a clean work surface. Place spoonful of potatoes on top of the roll and then sprinkle with cheese. Roll up and place seam side down on baking sheet. Bake until potatoes are tender turn oven down to 350f degrees. Cut into 4 slices and serve.

title: Gerbread and Pepper
ingredients: 500 g whole white sugar | 1 tablespoon gingererbread | 1 tablespoon chili paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200f. Grease and line a baking sheet. Mix together sugar, ginger, and pepper in a bowl. Add chili paste and mix. Add mix to sugar and stir until everything is well combined. Pour mixture onto baking sheet, making sure it covers the whole mixture evenly. Bake for 20 minutes or until set. Allow to cool before slicing. Store in airtight container in the fridge.

title: Chipotle Chile Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs pork butt | 2 -3 tablespoons dried chipotle chiles
instructions: Remove 1/2 cup of the water and shred it using 2 forks using 2 forks or shredding forks. Place in a large plastic bag, and squeeze out moisture. Add about 2 - 2 tablespoons of the chipotle chile and 2 teaspoons of water. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 8 hours, preferably 2 days. Remove pork from the marinade and grill over hot coals for about 25 to 30 minutes, turning to brown evenly before removing from the grill and sprinkling with additional salt and salt as needed. Discard marinade when ready to use.

title: Italian Beef Salad
ingredients: 4 buns | 4 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1//2 cups romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Line a 10 x 30 inch baking pan with reynolds wrap aluminum foil. Toast buns. Place a few cubes of beef in each bun. Cover beef with lettuce. Top with remaining beef.

title: Swiss Almonds With a Kick
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground almonds | 1 tablespoon ground roasted red pepper
instructions: First toast the almonds on a griddle or dry pan. They shouldn't be browning, but they should have to be a deep brown. Turn them over and roast for another minute or two. They should be very dry and not as soft. Cool, then put in a bowl and smash with a back and forth motion to grind the almonds. They will be very dry and oily, but should get slightly sticky. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,broth,mango chutney,piri,red enchilada sauce,onion salt,filling,dark brown sugar
title: Mango Chicken in Red Sauce
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce ( your favorite brand! ) | 3 -4 tablespoons mango chutney, to taste ( more if desired ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dark brown sugar, to taste ( or to taste ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon onion salt ( or to taste ) | 1 dashpiri ( optional ) | 1 cup bean sprouts | fried onions ( optional ) | filling ( optional )
instructions: Combine the next five ingredients and mix well. Add bean sprouts just before serving. Use for topping the beansprouts with fried onions and serve as an appetizer with your favorite toppings.

title: Braised Beef With Lima Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 1/2 cups frozen lima beans, thawed | 1/2 cup frozen pitted kalamata olive dip in creamy salsa | 1 1/2 teaspoons snipped fresh sage leaves | 4 teaspoons buttermilk | 4 lbs sirloin, trimmed of excess fat
instructions: Heat 1 tbs oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add beans to skillet.

title: Easy Blanche De Olla
ingredients: 1 can whole clams in juice | 1 large spanish onion | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Slice onion and place in sauce pan. Slice clams. Place on top of onion and pour picante sauce over them. Stir to combine and chill. Pour into 2 cups, top with more picante sauce, or serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,grape tomato,olive oil,rom tomato,tomato,flour tortilla
title: Grape Salsa (Ensalada De Gato Y Quesadilla)
ingredients: 3 vine ripe tomatoes | 1/3 cup ricotta cheese and 1/3 cup grape tomatoes, divided | 1/4 cup sliced roma tomato | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 5 flour tortillas
instructions: Cut each tomato in 3/8 inch slices. Transfer to a bowl, squeezing out excess liquid. Chop the tomatoes into 1/8 inch cubes. Set aside. Place 1/4 cup of the ricotta and 1/4 cup of the tomato juice in a food processor. Pulse until smooth, then spread evenly over the tomatoes. Divide the remaining 1/4 cup of ricotta evenly over the tomatoes. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of the tomato juice mixture over the ricotta. Add the cream of tartar and 1 pinch of salt to taste. Top with the remaining tomatoes. Heat olive oil in a 10 inch saute pan over medium heat. Add the tortillas and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until the tortillas begin to brown. Transfer to cutting board and cut into strips. Serve with remaining tomato juice and tomato mixture.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,semolina flour,tart apple,mint leaf,couscous,cinnamon sugar,tapioca starch,lime
title: Spiced Apple and Couscous Wraps
ingredients: 6 flour tortillas | 1/2 cup couscous | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted | 2 teaspoons cinnamon sugar | 4 tart apples, peeled, cored and cut into small wedges | 2 cups mint leaves, shredded | 1 1/2 tablespoons tapioca starch | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f place the flour tortillas on a baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes, until the tortillas are lightly golden brown. Flip, and bake an additional 5 minutes. Allow to cool a few minutes, then transfer to a plate. In a large bowl, mix together the couscous, butter, cinnamon sugar, apples, mint and tapioca starch. Stir in the lime juice. Spoon about 2/3 cup of the apple mixture onto each tortilla, and roll up. Place the rolled wraps in a baking dish with the seam side down. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the couscous is tender and the filling is hot and bubbling. Remove the wraps from the oven, and allow to cool 15 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: lemon essence,caster sugar,green bell pepper,miso,ciabatta,mexican oregano,romano cheese
title: Miso Crouton for One
ingredients: 6 ciabatta | 1 1/2 tablespoons meyeros miso | 4 tablespoons lemon essence | 4 tablespoons castor sugar or 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 1/2 onion, sliced thinly | 1 green bell pepper, sliced thinly | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano
