instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f and lightly butter a baking tray. For the croutons, place ciabatta on a baking tray and cut into 3cm slices. For the sauce, combine miso, lemon essence, castor sugar and onion to a large bowl. Remove ciabatta from oven and brush lightly with lemon essence. Arrange ciabatta slices on baking tray.

Random Ingredients: red wine,pork rib chop,beef stew meat,chili paste,corn
title: Barbecue Flavored Pork and Beef
ingredients: 4 pork rib chops | 4 tablespoons red wine | 4 teaspoons chili paste | corn or flour, for thickening | 4 beef stew meat
instructions: Cut the ribs and place in pan with wine, chili paste and meat. Cover and cook slowly, for 1 hour over very low heat, without removing the lid. Serve with cooked rice and beans.

Random Ingredients: cheerio oat cereal,white bean,heavy cream,white rice,jigger brandy,confectioner sugar,spicy sesame oil,sage
title: Rice and Bean Pie
ingredients: 2 packages spicy red sesame oil | 1 1/2 cups white rice | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 6 ounces processed cheese curds, cut into cubes | 1 cup grated colby-jack cheese | 1 pint heavy cream | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage, crushed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting ( optional )
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat, and mix in the white rice, white beans, processed cheese curds and sharp colby jack cheese. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Stir often as rice may stick. Remove from heat, and mix in cream one teaspoon at a time. Mix in optional dried sage and confectioners' sugar.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,raspberry,gorgonzola,vegetable stock,lima bean,ice water
title: Lima Bean and Gorgonzola Soup
ingredients: 1 cup frozen lima beans, thawed | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 bag frozen raspberries | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons ice water | 3/4 cup crumbled gorgonzola
instructions: Combine lima beans, stock, raspberries, soup and water in a pot.

title: Crispy Salmon and Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon, cut into 2 or 3 inch pieces | 1 red onion ( very thin rings )
instructions: Place onion rings in a colander. Place fish in colander. Add enough water to cover onions by 1/4 inch and let sit for 10 minutes. Pat fish dry and put over a heavy burner. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: carb flour tortilla,oatmeal,flour,fruit,dark rum,black bean,carrot,white chicken meat
title: Dundee's Black and Grits
ingredients: 2 white chicken meat, frozen and thawed | 1/2 cup low-carb flour tortillas | 1/4 cup wheatmeal | 1/2 teaspoon gluten free flour | 1/2 cup dried fruit, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dried black beans, crushed ( optional ) | 1/2 cup low-fat dark rum ( optional ) or 1/2 cup cognac ( optional ) | 1/2 cup carrot, grated ( optional )
instructions: Thaw the chicken pieces and chop them up. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Spread the flour tortillas on a parchment paper lined baking sheet and bake for several minutes to toast a little bit. Put the tortillas on plates as you do. Put the chicken pieces on top of the flour tortillas. Drain the chicken pieces, reserving the liquid. Make sure to save any remaining liquid. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Put the mixture on top of the chicken. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cheese spread,french onion dip,mustard seed,chicken wing
title: Cheesy Oriental Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 chicken wings | 1 container french onion dip | 1 container of your favorite cheese spread | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Bake or grill chicken wings until meat has begun to separate from wings on the bone. Boil wings in large pot. To make sure they don't burn, put pan inches take hot chicken wings out and place on a foil lined casserole dish to drain excess grease. Spray wings with cooking spray, cover the top of the dish with cheese spread and mustard seeds. Bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes or until cheese is melted. Remove from oven and enjoy.

title: Instant Pot Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 cup beef broth | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Put all ingredients into your beans in the instant pot. Turn on low and wait for 10 minutes on low or so.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,lemon zest,cool whip,italian sausage,asparagus spear
title: Spicy Italian Sausage and Asparagus Appetizer
ingredients: 4 links hot italian sausage ( i use links ) | 2 packages frozen asparagus spears | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 cups cool whip | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Thaw the sausages and slice them. Cook in a skillet with the sausage on the stove. Cook asparagus according to directions. While the sausage cooks remove the veggies from the pan and save the grease. Cut the sausages into 1 - ½ inch coins. In a 9x13 inch glass baking dish, place 2 asparagus spears, 1/2 jar picante sauce, and 2 cups of the saved grease. Cover the top of the dish with 3 - 4 sausage coins. Bake for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, use a knife to spear your remaining asparagus spears. Whip the cream with the lemon zest. When the 30 minutes is up, remove from the oven and stir in the whipped cream. Top with the remaining 4 asparagus spears and bake for an additional 5 - 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Salmon and Leek Appetizer
ingredients: 4 leeks | 1 tablespoon salt
instructions: Wash leeks thoroughly. Place in food processor, process on high until very fine. Add salt and process again until mixture becomes soft and pliable. Wash leeks and separate carefully removing white bulbs, wash in cold water and dry. Bladed leeks keep the color and size.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 cremini mushrooms | 1/4 cup minced onion | 2 tablespoons mexican blend cheese | 2 pita breads, cut into halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f remove stems from mushrooms.

title: Ginger Beef Teriyaki
ingredients: 1/4 cup ground pecans | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh ginger root | 1 lb boneless beef round steak, 1 inch thick, steak cut into 4 pieces | 1 1/2 cups dry curds
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together pecans, ginger, and beef until well blended. Add in dry curds.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,granny smith apple,tomato green chilies,shortening,button mushroom,margarine
title: Chile-Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 medium granny smith apple, peeled and chopped | 2 lbs button mushrooms, cleaned and chopped | 12 ounces plain yogurt | 14 ounces canned diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup margarine, melted | 1/2 cup margarine, melted | 12 ounces canned sliced mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease a 9x13 baking pan. Melt 2 tablespoons margarine in saucepan over medium heat. Remove from heat and stir in the 1 tablespoon each of margarine and vegetable oil. Transfer to a large bowl, and set aside. In a skillet over medium heat, melt 1 tablespoon margarine with 2 tablespoons margarine, stirring until well blended. Stir in the granny smith apple, mushrooms, 3 ounces tomato sauce, and 1/2 cup margarine. Cover, and cook 5 - 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Place the drained mushrooms onto a separate dish. Cover, and bake 20 minutes, or until tender. Stir in remaining 2 tablespoons margarine, and 2 ounces of plain tomato sauce, and 1/2 cup melted margarine. Spread evenly into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle the topping over the mushroom mixture.

Random Ingredients: nonfat yogurt,onion soup mix,peanut,lemon grass,salad green,nutmeg,blackberry
title: Berry Salad with Peanut Flavored Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared nonfat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon dehydrated onion soup mix | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 pound mixed salad greens, torn | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts | 1 cup chopped dried blackberries | 2 teaspoons finely chopped lemon grass
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the yogurt, onion soup mix and nutmeg. Let stand 5 minutes to blend flavors. Place salad greens in a large bowl. Toss with the peanuts, cherries, lemon grass, and yogurt dressing until lightly coated.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,rice wine,cumin powder,egg substitute,apricot jam,aubergine,pecorino romano cheese
title: Aubergine, Aubergine Stuffed With Apricot Sticky Topping
ingredients: 2 medium aubergines | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 large egg substitute | 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 1/8 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Cut halves off the tops of each eggplant, being careful not to break the membrane, and scoop out the pulp, leaving about 1/2 cm thick flesh attached at the base of the shell. Cut the shells from the aubergines, cutting away the hard part and leaving the attached part intact. Use a spoon to remove the flesh, leaving the shells intact, and trim and discard the bitter pulp from the eggplants, reserving enough of the eggplant to serve later. Peel once or twice while still hot. Preheat the oven to 375f/190c. Cut 4 diagonal slits all over the tops of the 2 aubergines, taking care, and put them in a large baking tin. Pour the 3 tins of hot water into a roasting tin, and add half the vinegar. Bake the aubergines for 30 minutes, or until the outside is lightly golden. Meanwhile combine the almond paste, 3 tblspn rice wine, 1 egg, apricot syrup, 1/4 tsp of cumin, the rest of the egg substitute and the vanilla sugar and pour over the aubergines, sprinkle with pecorino romano or other coarse seasoning. Bake for another 30 - 40 minutes, or until the eggplant mixture has thickened slightly. Allow to cool slightly before slicing. Serve, cut into 4 wedges. Spoon the stuffing into the shells and serve warm.

title: Cauliflower With Poppy Seed
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower | 1 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Break off the florets from the cauliflower. Cook the cauliflower until tender, then drain and set aside. Place in a bowl with the poppy seeds and mix well, then put in the cauliflower and mix. Garnish with parsley, if desired, and serve.

title: Honey Roasted Garlic Potatoes With Spinach and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 pound russet potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks | 3 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 package fresh spinach, rinsed and dried | 1/3 pound goat cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Heat the sesame oil in a large oven proof skillet over medium high heat. Add the potatoes.

Random Ingredients: juniper berry,lemon wedge,linguine pasta,rice wine vinegar,italian tomato,tomato sauce
title: Easy Tomato Pasta Salad with Vinegar
ingredients: 16 ounces linguine pasta | 1 can italian-style crushed tomatoes | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon juniper berries | lemon wedge, for garnish
instructions: Cook the linguine in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,black bean,egg wrap,beef bouillon,mint,irish whiskey,rosemary
title: Easy Irish Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 box shredded cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh mint, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh minced rosemary | 1 packet instant beef bouillon ( with 1 tsp. msg ) | 20 egg roll wraps | 1 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet over medium high heat. Drain fat, then crumble meat with a fork. Combine cottage cheese, mint, rosemary, beef bouillon and the 1 tsp. Of msg in bowl. Place 1 egg roll wrapper on your workspace, and place a small spoonful or 1/3 cup of the meat mixture on the wrapper. With a wet fork roll up the wrapper and tuck ends. After all wrappers and meat are in the pan, roll up the last wrapper and cut slits in them all along the length of the roll. Pour whiskey over all.

title: Ginger Crunch Eggs
ingredients: 3 eggs | 4 tablespoons golden syrup ( or maple syrup or corn syrup ) | 3 -4 drops tabasco sauce | 3 tablespoons ginger juice | 10 g dark chocolate ( roughly chopped ) | fresh radish ( optional ) | fresh fresh radish, green ( optional )
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Add the eggs in a single piece, stirring gently. Lower the heat to a slow steady simmer, cooking the mixture for 15 - 20 mins, until the eggs have set and the yolks are thick and creamy. Drain the eggs. Place the eggs in a bowl, add the syrup and tabasco sauce and stir to combine. Add the ginger juice, chocolate and radishes and stir to combine. Dip the rim of 4 small glasses with egg yolk mixture, and set aside. Fill the glass and serve immediately. I sometimes leave the whites in to help the yolks hold their shape.

title: Chinese Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 500 g stewing chicken ( cubed ) | 400 g zucchini ( sliced ) | 200 g bean sprouts | 200 g mesclun
instructions: In a large pan, toss the chicken cubes with salt and garlic powder. Add the carrots, zucchini, and bean sprouts. Cover with water, about 5cm above the level of the meat. The vegetables should be covered. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat, to low, and cook for half an hour, stirring occasionally. Season to taste with a little black pepper. Stir again, and serve over white rice.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,bacon,wonton wrapper,lobster tail,sherry wine,lasagna noodle
title: Lobster Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package uncooked lasagna noodles | 2 slices bacon, diced | 1 lobster tail, chopped | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine | 24 wonton wrappers | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions using a little olive oil and butter for the last five to six minutes. Drain and cool. In a skillet fry bacon over medium high heat for five minutes, or until evenly golden brown.

title: Fried Asian Pear and Apricot Turnovers
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry | 2 tablespoons margarine ( or butter ) | 1/2 cup chopped honey or 1/2 cup light cream, mixed with | 2 tablespoons melted unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons chopped dried apricot jam | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 2 asian pears, cored, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt the margarine with the honey over medium heat. Cook a few seconds until it is fragrant. Remove from heat and reserve. Brush 1 teaspoon of melted butter on a 10 x 15 inch jelly roll pan. Unroll the pastry sheets in the pan, brush on it melted butter, and then line the pan. Arrange 3 phyllo sheets in the pan.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,baja marinade,black olive,french bean,jalapeno pepper,shiitake mushroom,arborio rice,pork loin chop
title: Chilean Pork Chops in a Baja Sauce (Guy Fieri)
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | 1 can black olives, pitted | 1 jar shiitake mushrooms, roughly chopped | 3/4 lb french beans or 3/4 lb other green beans, trimmed and cut into thirds | 1 jalapeno pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 cup arborio rice | 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 2 tablespoons baja marinade | 1 package shiitake mushrooms
instructions: The day before, combine the pork chops with all of the remaining ingredients, excluding the shiitake and jalapeno in a 9x9 baking dish. Cover the dish with tin foil and bake at 350°f for about 1 1/2 hours to 1 hour and 15 minutes. Uncover the dish and bake for an additional 15 minutes. Remove the foil and sprinkle with the shiitake mushrooms. Serve hot.

title: Quinoa, Oysters and Black Olives (Vegetable)
ingredients: 1 cup water | 2 cups cooked quinoa | 1/2 cup chopped black olives | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/3 cup minced red onion ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon freshly chopped coriander | 1 dash hot sauce
instructions: In a medium skillet over medium heat, bring the water to a boil. Add the quinoa and let sit until water has absorbed by about 2/3. In a large bowl, combine the quinoa with the olives, cheese, onion and coriander. Add a dash of hot sauce and a dash of lime juice.

title: Kombu and Rhubarb Stuffed Raisins
ingredients: 3 cups water | 2 lbs fresh rhubarb, ends trimmed | 1 cup water, divided | 1/2 cup uncooked kombu | 1 teaspoon sugar | 3/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon molasses | 1 3/4 cups shredded mexican cheese | 1/3 cup chopped golden raisin
instructions: Prepare syrup, combine 3 cups water and molasses in medium saucepan. Bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,white flour,tamari,guinness stout,olive,rosemary leaf,beef chuck,breadstick
title: Guiness Beef Stifado (Guinness Beef Stew) in a Crockpot With Whiskey, Garlic, and Rosemary
ingredients: 2 lbs lean boneless beef chuck or 2 lbs sirloin, about 10 cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup dark beer ( recommended ( guinness, modelo loco brand suggested ) ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil, divided | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary leaves | 2 tablespoons chopped ripe olives, divided | 1 cup shredded dry breadstick | 3 tablespoons white flour | 7 -8 tablespoons tamari ( may use soy sauce )
instructions: Combine the beef chuck and beer in a 1 1/2 quart or larger slow cooker. Add the oil. Add the rosemary, olives, and breadstick. Cover and cook on high setting until the beef cubes are very tender, about 4 hours or overnight. Transfer the stew to a platter and tent with foil. Cover and keep warm. Discard the solids. Transfer the stew to a medium saucepan, adding the flour. Cook over medium heat, stirring as it browns and thickens, about 3 minutes. To serve, spoon the beef stew into bowls and ladle the sauce over it.

Random Ingredients: black bean,pickle juice,confectioner sugar,stewing beef,fontina cheese,beef broth,garlic clove,milk ricotta cheese
title: Risotto With Meat and Beans
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 small whole garlic clove | 16 ounces frozen whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup pickle juice | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 2 tablespoons minced baby flat-leaf parsley or 2 tablespoons chives | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a slow cooker, combine the beef, black beans, garlic, ricotta, pickle juice, sour cream and parsley. Cover and cook on high 5 to 6 hours, or low 3 to 5 hours. If using whole, preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Remove dish from the slow cooker and stir well to combine the ingredients. Stir in the confectioner's sugar just before serving.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,green lentil,white corn syrup,beef tenderloin steak,fish,lettuce,worcestershire sauce
title: Beef-Lentil Tacos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 3 tablespoons white corn syrup | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 beef tenderloin steaks, cut into 1 inch pieces | 4 lettuce - rinsed, dried, and torn into bite-size pieces | 1 can diced green lentils
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the mexican chili powder, soy sauce, corn syrup and worcestershire sauce. Add beef, turning to coat, and let marinate in refrigerator at least 2 hours. Preheat grill to medium high. Thread beef onto skewers. Grill, turning once, until cooked through and well browned, 15 - 18 minutes, basting often with sauce.

title: Agua Fresca
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses ( or treacle ) | 4 -5 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Mix the sugar and pomegranate molasses well, then proceed with making the mixture.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,red wine vinegar,scotch bonnet pepper
title: Cream Cheese Dip (Or Smoked Chiles)
ingredients: 1 jar sliced green chilies ( about 8 ounces ) | 1/2 cup cream cheese | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Finely chop chiles, place in a small bowl and add cream cheese, chile vinegar, and salt and pepper if desired, until you have a smooth dip.

title: Chinese Glass Noodles, Dan Dan E
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons light dark soy sauce | 6 sheets cellophane noodles
instructions: Mix together the soy sauce and cellophane noodles. Put in a small dish and set aside for 15 minutes. Cut into 1cm strips. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,sharp cheddar cheese,cumin powder,lamb,red food coloring
title: Kofta Kebabs
ingredients: 300 g ground lamb | 1 tablespoon red food coloring ( i have not tried cooking it ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( or grated to make it easier ) | 4 -6 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Mix well and shape into marble sized patties. Brush with egg or oil and grill till golden brown.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,serrano pepper,ladyfinger,cheddar cheese,fire tomato,dill pickle,red chili pepper
title: Spanish Fire-Roasted Tomatoes With Cheese
ingredients: 1 jar fire-roasted tomatoes | 1 spanish onion, halved, thinly sliced, then finely chopped | 1 large red chili pepper, stemmed, seeded and finely minced | 1 serrano pepper, stemmed, seeded and finely minced | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 6 ladyfingers, split | 2 tablespoons fresh dill pickles
instructions: Heat ovenproof, heavy bottomed saute pan over medium heat. Add tomatoes, onion, red chili pepper, serrano pepper and garlic. Nestle 1 ladyfinger in each tomato and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to medium low and cook 15 minutes. Place remaining ladyfingers on work surface with tops removed. Place tomatoes in ovenproof saute pan. Bake until hot and tender, about 10 minutes and then remove and turn. Dress with pickles and serve warm.

title: Apple Blossom Filling For Salad That Rocks
ingredients: 1/2 cup white bread, crumbs | 4 tablespoons dried parsley | 1 tablespoon pared fresh lemon juice, zest of | 2 tablespoons sumaq ( sumak ) | 1 1/2 cups apple juice | 3 radishes, cut into 4 wedges each | 2 tablespoons small sumaq ( sumak ) | 8 tablespoons fresh parsley, minced | 3/4 teaspoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: To make dough, combine bread crumbs, parsley, zest, 1 teaspoon sumak, apple juice & 4 tablespoons parsley in a large mixing bowl & mix well. To assemble salad, place radishes in a small bowl with 1 tablespoon sumak in center. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon sumak + ¼ teaspoon lemon juice & mix well. Spoon apple cream over radishes, sprinkle with remaining sumak. Garnish with remaining parsley & a twist of lemon.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,tomato puree,rom tomato,bell pepper,herb,mint leaf,ginger garlic paste,tomato paste
title: Korma (Herbed tomato paste and Sweet Pepper sauce)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs ( chef's choice, including dill, basil, parsley, savory, etc. ) | 1 tablespoon mixed pulses dried bell peppers ( available from asian shops ) | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste ( from your processor ) | 1 tablespoon plum tomato puree, canned | 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 2 roma tomatoes, chopped | 1 green bell pepper, roughly chopped | 2 -3 mint leaves ( garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: First marinade, grind the tomoto paste and stir the tomato paste into the palm sugar. Then make your spice paste, combine all the other ingredients in a non reactive container with a tight lid. Once mixed add the tomato paste. Cover and seal, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Cooking, put the chillies in and heat a frying pan. Add the palm sugar to the chillies and fry until brown. Now add the chillies/tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes or until they turn golden brown.

title: Asiago Cheese with Onions
ingredients: 6 cups grated asiago cheese or 6 cups grated parmesan cheese | 3 cups sherry wine ( dry sherry ( not sweet but sweet soya sherry is best )
instructions: Mix all together until a uniform paste is formed. Cover with plastic wrap and place in fridge. If you want it more intense, slice off one end of the cheese and roll each slice with a rolling pin. Serve with lots of crackers to dip in the hot sherry.

title: Spicy Ricotta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 cup light ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon coarsely crushed chili pepper | 1 teaspoon coarsely crushed ginger | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarsely crushed ginger | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Combine in a bowl with a whisk. The dip will thicken as it sits. The longer it sits the smoother it gets the more spicy it gets.

title: Italian Blackberry Slices
ingredients: 1 pint blackberries | 1/2 bottle good italian dressing | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped
instructions: Preheat broiler to 400 f degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil, and place the blackberries on baking sheet. Drizzle blackberries with italian dressing, then sprinkle the egg on top. Place under oven broiler for 1 - 2 minutes.

title: Bavarian Rum and Scamorza Bites
ingredients: 2/3 pound raspberries | 1/3 cup golden raisins | 1 tablespoon dried fruit, or as desired ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons grated dark rum | 1/2 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander or asiago | 1/4 teaspoon ground anise extract | cayenne | 2 tablespoons butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange raspberries in a casserole dish. Stir golden raisins, dried fruit, rum, coriander, and anise extract together in a separate bowl. Stir in butter. Top raspberries with raspberries. Bake in the preheated oven until topping is lightly browned and berries are hot, about 45 minutes.

title: Hot Italian Sausage Apples
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, cooked and drained | 8 -12 apples, peeled, cored and sliced | 1/4 cup brandy | mini marshmallows ( optional )
instructions: Drain excess liquid. Slice hot sausage into long slices. Place apples in a microwave safe dish and drizzle with brandy and marshmallows. Cover and microwave on high 10 - 12 minutes. Serve with favorite meatball ingredients.

Random Ingredients: brown basmati rice,sage,lemon juice zest,cardamom,tart baking apple,half cream,italian parsley
title: Apple-Basmati-Rice Pudding (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 tart baking apple, peeled, cored, cut into wedges and seeds removed | 1/2 cup brown basmati rice | 3 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 2 teaspoons thyme | 1 teaspoon cajun sage | 3 cups half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Place the baking apple, brown basmati rice, italian parsley, 2 tsp thyme and 1/2 tsp cajun sage into your rice cooker. Push the mix button on the rice cooker.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,yellow onion,pasta,raspberry jell o gelatin
title: Wild Rice Jello Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, diced | 4 serrano peppers, halved lengthwise and seeds removed | 2 tablespoons raspberry jell-o gelatin | 1 lb pasta, cooked
instructions: Heat a small pot over medium high heat. When it's hot, add the onion, serrano peppers, and jello. Simmer until the jello is very dissolved, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the cooked vegetables. Chill pasta in refrigerator until chilled, then stir into the chilled jello mixture. Serve cold.

title: Linda's Butternut Squash Tacos
ingredients: butternut squash or 2 large butternut squash, peeled and cubed | taco seasoning
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Saute squash for 15 minutes. Mix the shredded or grated butternut squash with taco seasoning. Spread into a tortilla.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,pepper,garam masala,lentil,heavy cream,bell pepper,trout fillet,calvados
title: Indian Relish With Crispy Lentils and Trout
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs black lentils | 1 cup heavy cream ( whipping liquid ) | 1/4 cup calvados ( apple-flavoured apple cider-style apple cider may be substitue ) | 1 -2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( or to taste ) | 1/3 teaspoon garam masala | 12 ounces trout fillets | 1 small bell pepper, diced fine | 1/4 cup chopped fresh pepper, such as any color desired ( or to taste )
instructions: Cook lentil in 3 cups of water over medium heat or until tender. Let stand 10 minutes. Drain and reserve cooking liquid. Transfer lentil to a food processor and pulse until roughly chopped or as finely as you desire. Add heavy cream, calvados, hot pepper sauce, garam masala and coarsely chopped tuna.

title: Pasteles (Pasteles)
ingredients: 1 cup bread flour | 1 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Sift flour into a bowl, then rub in the mayonnaise. Dived the dough into 20 portions, and roll into small balls. Place on a floured surface, and stretch slightly. Form the dough into strips about the size of your finger. Place a little of the flour on top of each strip, and fold over, pressing between your fingers. Bring one side gently together, so the folded edges don't curl up while baking. Place pasteles into a shallow pan of hot, slightly salted water, and boil, about 3 to 5 minutes until they rise to the surface. Drain and serve.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,mandarin orange,wild mushroom,vanilla bean,cool whip
title: Mushroom Salad With Powdered Mandarin Oranges
ingredients: 1 package wild mushrooms, sliced | 1 pint mandarin oranges ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 container cool whip | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: Dice the mushrooms. Slice the oranges into rounds. Combine with the oranges. Beat with a mixer until smooth. Add the whipped cream. To thicken, add the vanilla bean when done. Serve topped with extra whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,monterey jack cheese,gruyere cheese,button mushroom
title: Mushroom and Gruyère Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 1/2 lb button mushroom, thickly sliced ( about 3 cups ) | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lay mushrooms on paper towel lined baking sheet and drizzle with 1 tablespoon melted margarine. Bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and place cheeses in a blender and blend until creamy. Remove and reserve mushroom caps and set aside. Remove mushroom caps from baking sheet and place on a platter that has been sprinkled with remaining 1 teaspoon of margarine. Fill each mushroom with about 1/4 cup cheese mixture. Broil or bake until browned.

title: Dee's Easy Barbecue Beef Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 12 slices bacon | 10 ounces medium pasta sauce | 1 cup beef stock | 1 package pepperoni
instructions: Cook bacon until crispy, remove & crumble. Set aside. Use beef stock to cook pasta sauce according to package instructions. Drain pasta & pepperoni, mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to blend. You could also pour sauce into a crockpot & cook on low for 1 hour, then switch to high & cook for 3 - 3 hours to thicken all of the sauce.

title: Crab Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 large brown onion, roughly chopped | 1 can crabmeat, drained | 1 large idaho potato, peeled and cubed | 1/3 cup chopped dried figs | 1/2 coconut, shredded
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until done, drain, toss with half and half. Saute chopped onion in coconut until translucent. Add crab crumbles and figs and heat through. Add sweetened coconut and serve.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,lasagna noodle,vodka,corn muffin mix,clam juice,cauliflower floret,baking soda,cilantro stem
title: Luscious Clam Mac (No Beer Can)
ingredients: 1 package corn muffin mix | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 cans diced clams with juice | 1 1/2 cups bottled clam juice | 1 bottle 100 % pure vodka | 1 cup diced unpeeled cauliflower florets | 1 jar whole cilantro stems, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Bring clam juice and vodka to a boil in a large pot over high heat and bring to simmer until vodka is reduced to 1 cup, about 5 minutes. Stir clam juice mixture and crushed clams into the clam juice mixture, then set aside. Place cauliflower in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with half of the crushed cauliflower. Spread half of the clam clam topping over the cauliflower. Spread corn muffin mix over the clam sauce mixture. Repeat layers ending with cauliflower on top. Bake in preheated oven, uncovered, 20 minutes. Top with cilantro and let cool on wire rack.

title: Fruit Scones
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/4 cups cornflour | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/2 cup dried apricot, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to gas mark 2 or 180c. Mix in the first 3 ingredients. Shape into 1 balls and bake for 20 minutes. Serve with butter, jam, icecream or custard.

title: California Avocados with Raisins
ingredients: 4 hass avocados, peeled and pitted | 1/2 cup golden raisin ( may use white ) | 1/2 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: Gently scoop the avocados into a shallow bowl, leaving the pits in the avocados. Use a slotted spoon to drain the excess moisture into a measuring cup. Add the raisins to the bowl and mash with a fork or potato masher. Mix in the raisins and cumin.

Random Ingredients: italian cheese,hard egg,fish,tomato paste,chorizo sausage,mexican cheese
title: Mexican-Style Fish
ingredients: 2 links chorizo sausage, chopped | 1 package processed cheese | 1/2 pound ground fish | 1 can tomato paste | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped
instructions: Cook and stir chorizo sausage in the microwave in a skillet over medium heat until heated through, about 5 minutes. Mix the processed cheese, ground fish, tomato paste, and mexican cheese into the sausage in the skillet, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer until processed cheese has melted and flavors have blended, about 5 minutes. Serve topped with egg.

title: Spiced Nuts Withjuniper and Spice
ingredients: 4 cups mixed nuts or 4 cups mixed nuts | 2 teaspoons juniper berries
instructions: Grind nuts in a coarse grinder or food processor. Transfer nuts to a small bowl, pressing them over the bowl to coat completely. Add juniper and salt.

Random Ingredients: tequila,yellow corn meal,dark soy sauce,hoagie,focaccia bread,no boil lasagna
title: Steakhouse Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow corn meal | 1/4 cup no-boil lasagna sheets | 4 hoagie rolls | 1/3 cup regular tequila | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon light agave syrup or 1 tablespoon dark corn syrup
instructions: Put a steakhouse sandwich maker basket on your broiler pan and preheat to medium. Mix together the corn meal and corn meal in a small bowl. Put a flat sheet of plastic wrap directly on the rack of the grill and lightly oil with nonstick cooking spray. Spread a thin layer of corn meal mixture on the top of one side of the sandwich maker basket, then spread about 1/2 cup of the cornmeal mixture on the other side. Lay the rolled up sandwich maker basket on top of the sandwich maker basket so the sheets of meat overlap slightly over each other and are flush with the edge of the steaks' nearest the coals. Put the two packets of steakhouse steaks onto a grill rack in a single layer and set up the sandwiches using the nonstick cooking spray. Grill for 6 to 8 minutes per side. To make the margarita topping, put an empty bottle of tequila in a large mixing bowl and mix until smooth with no lumps. Dip each of the sandwiches in the margarita topping and let them sit for 1 minute. Remove the sandwich from the grill and serve immediately. Makes 16 sandwiches.

title: Brandy Wine
ingredients: 2 cups brandy | 1/2 cup wine or 1/2 cup dry vermouth
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook uncovered for 15 minutes, or until the flavors meld. Pour into your favourite jar. Seal, refrigerate and keep in dark. It will keep up to a month.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,pasta,puff pastry,monterey jack cheese,golden raisin,scotch bonnet pepper
title: Pastillia
ingredients: 1 ready-made frozen puff pastry, thawed | 4 cans pie filling ( i like my own st. louis brand, but any flavor of pie filling can be used. you can also use canned pie filling ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped scotch bonnet pepper | 1 cup finely grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 cups finely crumbled monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Unfold pastry onto baking sheet. Place evenly on baking sheet. Combine filling ingredients in large bowl and mix thoroughly with a fork. Spread 1/3 of the filling mixture on pastry. Sprinkle with 1/3 of the grated pepper and 1/3 of the cheeses. Repeat layers. Bake in preheated 400 degree oven for 15 - 18 minutes until pastry is puffed and lightly browned. Serve warm.

title: Tobleron - Cantaloupe Cheese with Melish Apples
ingredients: 12 large tart apples | 5 tablespoons creme fraiche | 3 tablespoons monterey jack cheese, shredded | 10 ounces cantaloupe, peeled roasted in oven
instructions: Heat oven to 425° f. Dice apples. Place in a small baking pan and pour boiling water over them. Bake 25 mins or more, until apples are tender. Set aside to cool off and set aside until room temperature. Meanwhile, beat creme fraiche with swiss cheese until very smooth using an electric hand mixer. Combine apples and cooled creme fraiche and stir in cheese. Pour apple mixture over melish and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,black cardamom pod,rice wine vinegar,taco sauce,garam masala,cashew
title: Beef Burfi
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless lean beef chuck | 3 cups raw cashews | 4 cloves garlic, minced | 2 teaspoons black cardamom pods, crushed, divided | 2 teaspoons garam masala ( see note ) | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Note, i used a combination of rice vinegar and water to help me blend everything. Soak cashewnuts in water approximately 2 hours, then add them to a blender.. Blend until ground. This should take about 40 seconds to 1hr to an hour, then blend again till smooth. In a large covered roasting pan or baking tray, brown roast chuck over medium high heat until nicely golden brown, breaking it up into smaller chunks when cool enough to handle. Add cashews and garlic and cook, stirring constantly for about 1 minute. Push cashews and garlic to the side of the pan. Toss remaining black cardamom pods into pan. When they darken, add black cardamom and garam masala and cook 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in 1 tbsp of rice wine vinegar. Spoon mixture into a serving bowl and sprinkle with garam masala. Serve immediately. Note, if using roasted cashew pieces, place them in a large saucepan or skillet and cover with water. Bring to a quick boil and boil for 2 mins, then drain. Note, while you can use a combination of ground beef and ground pork, you may want to adjust amount and/or seasoning to your liking. Note, you may also use kofta mix in place of ground chuck and ground masala. If using wooden skewers, soak them in water while you make the burfi.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,beef stock,beef steak,annatto seed,red currant jelly,cranberry,irish whiskey
title: Beef Fillet Scotch Steak
ingredients: 1 tablespoon annatto seeds | 750 ml beef stock | 1 cup red currant jelly | 1/4 cup cranberry sauce | 1/3 cup irish whiskey | 10 1/2 ounces beef steak, sliced | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup, warmed
instructions: Toast annatto seeds with 1 tbsp. Oil in a preheated oven at 190°c/fan 160°c/gas 7 for 4 - 5 mins, until fragrant. Add remaining ingredients to the beef in a large baking dish. Cover and bake in the oven for 1 hour and 15 mins for medium or until cooked. Remove beef to a board and slice into 3/4 thick slices. Remove sauce from heat and stir in remaining annato seeds. Serve beef in tomato halves on plates topped with sauce. Garnish with choc glaze.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,turmeric powder,beef brisket,beef chuck roast,banana pepper,red pepper flake,halibut fillet
title: Cape Piri Piri (Peruvian Beef)
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef chuck roast, cut into bite sized pieces or 1/2 lb boneless beef brisket | 1/2 lb boneless beef chuck roast, cut into bite sized pieces | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 4 large bananas and pepper slices ( your choice of flavor ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped crystallized minced garlic ( or 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder plus 2 cloves for garnish ) | 2 teaspoons ground red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 550 degrees f. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil. Add meat pieces to pan. Sprinkle each piece with 1/4 tsp of turmeric and 1/4 tsp of crushed red pepper. Top each piece with 2 banana pepper slices. Drizzle with 1 tsp of garlic powder. Add remaining 1 tsp garlic to mixture. Sprinkle 1/2 tsp ground red pepper mixture over meat. Cover the pan with its lid. Set it aside at 550 degrees f for about 30 - 40 minutes. Remove foil the last 20 minutes cooking so meat is brown and cooked to your liking. Garnish with crystallized minced garlic and red pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: barberry,self raising flour,grapefruit juice,pork shoulder,canadian bacon,bamboo shoot,cream mushroom soup
title: Jamaican Pork and Fruit Soup
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder | 2 large smoked canadian bacon ( or other pork ) | 1 jar grapefruit juice | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup ( i used condensed cream of mushroom soup ) | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots ( drained of juice ) | 1 tablespoon self-raising flour | 1/2 cup frozen grapes ( i used a mixture of both ) or 1/2 cup canned grapefruit sections ( i used a mixture of both )
instructions: Wash and dice pork into 1/4 inch pieces. Cut the bacon into 1 inch chunks if using regular pork and cut into 1 inch pieces. Wash and dice papery cherry if possible. In a very large soup pot combine all the ingredients except grapes and grapes. Let simmer in a 325f oven until pork is cooked through.. Stir occasionally. Add grapes. Serve hot or chilled.

Random Ingredients: green olive,sesame oil,chili powder,fine breadcrumb,self rising flour,herb,beef brisket
title: Green Olive and Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 14 slices green olives, about 3/4-inch thick | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs, mixed ( oregano, borage, tarragon ) | 3/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried mixed herbs ( thyme, dill )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 f. In large ovenproof skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add brisket.

title: Easy Italian Bean Spread
ingredients: 2 cups fresh italian parsley ( with stems ) | 1 can kidney beans | 2 tablespoons fresh marjoram ( or marjoram leaves if desired ) | 1 1/2 cups icing sugar | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning ( or to taste )
instructions: Place italian parsley and kidney beans in a blender and process until well mixed. Add the marjoram/marjoram leaves and mix well. Slowly add the icing sugar, mix well. Spread onto toast slices. Enjoy.

title: Smoky Pork Empanadas
ingredients: 1 jar old el paso mild salsa verde ( salsa with red green chiles ) with pimentos, drained ( mild salsa verde ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 1/2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese, divided | 1 1/4 lbs ground pork | 2 cups shredded savoy cabbage, packed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray 9x13x2 baking dish with cooking spray. In medium bowl, combine 1 1/4 cups cheese and ground pork. Mix well. Spoon 1/3 of mixture into bottom of prepared baking dish. Top with cabbage. Layer with second 1 1/3 of cheese. Top with third of sausage mixture. Spread remaining cheese over everything. Bake 45 - 60 minutes, until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Nopales Oyster Sauce II (Mock Oyster Sauce - Oyster Sauce for Fish)
ingredients: 1 cup white onion, minced | 4 cups oyster sauce, shucked or 8 oysters, in shells quartered | other asian-blend sweet onion ( optional )
instructions: Mix half of the onions and half of the oyster sauce and refrigerate for a few hours to allow flavors to mingle. Use to brush fish with sauce on the fish after grilling or broiling. Cooking time will vary on how big the fish is.

Random Ingredients: white flour,egg,garlic clove,beet,masa harina flour,cake flour
title: Shredded Beets
ingredients: 4 medium sized beets, cooked and chopped | 1 egg, beaten | 1/2 - 3/4 cup cake flour | 1 tablespoon masa harina flour ( corn masa harina mix ) | 1 garlic clove, minced | 5 cups sifted cake flour ( not self-rising ) | 1 egg, beaten | 1 cup masa harina flour | 1 cup white flour | 1/4 cup mashed potatoes ( optional ) or 1/4 cup yam ( optional )
instructions: Sift the dry ingredients together in a large bowl. Add the mashed potatoes if using. Add in the egg and mix well. Let the mixture rest for about 10 minutes. Put the beets into a pot of salted boiling water and place a lid on the pot. As soon as the beets are floating on the surface of the water, turn off the heat. Cover the pot with a cloth and return the beets to the boiling water. Cook the beets over a medium heat for 15 minutes. Remove the beets to a colander and drain the water as much as possible. In the meantime, make the icing. Heat butter or margarine in a non stick skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic, minced garlic and saute until garlic is soft and brown. Add the masa harina and toast for a minute. Gradually add the flour so that it makes a slurry. You want to avoid lumps. As soon as it smells a bit nutty add the mashed potatoes or yam. It is very important that the dish is as dry as possible. Make a hole in the center of the flour and pour in the potato/yam mixture. The potatoes should not drop together either. When it is dry add the powdered icing and mix well and slowly add all the sifted dry ingredients. Mix well. If it is a bit dry add some milk or water. Remove from heat and let cool. Slice the beets in thin slices into rounds or diamonds. Fry the slices in a frying pan over medium heat for 7 to 10 minutes. Turn the slices over and fry the other side. The first side may be brown before it is cooked, but turn them before that. Add the sliced beets to the icing and mix well. Cover them and keep hot until serving time. They will last up to 2 weeks with no problems as long as they are refrigerated.

title: Italian Fried Onions
ingredients: 3 lbs raw onions | 4 teaspoons fennel seeds
instructions: Wash and peel the onions. Slice the centers in half. Slice them fairly thinly to make french fries with a slice in between them. Put them in a large, deep skillet or deep frying pan. Sprinkle them with a few teaspoons of fennel seeds and sprinkle them with salt. Cover them with water and bring up to a boil over high heat. It should be boiling gently, so add a couple of teaspoons. Lower to a simmer, cover and cook for 30 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool for a few minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the onions to clean containers. Keep warm in the oven, uncovered, in a closed oven or a dutch oven. I use my electric skillet to make these.

title: Mexican Beer Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces beer, your favorite brand | 32 ounces sour cream, fat-free ( not fat free ) | 8 -10 pieces kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Pour beer into a shallow dish and add sour cream and lime leaves. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Chipotle Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 teaspoon oregano | 1/4 cup chipotle powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in tightly sealed container and store in dry place.

title: Chyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed if frozen | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 3 teaspoons dried red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Combine the worcestershire sauce and dried red pepper in a small bowl and set aside. Cut each sheet of phyllo carefully so they will not tear. Place the pastry sheets on a parchment lined cookie sheet. Cover with a damp cloth or waxed paper with a damp towel and lightly brush the sheets with oil. Using one sheet at a time, brush the sheet with oil. Layer it with 1/2 of the red pepper mixture, 1/2 of the phyllo, and repeat the layers until you have used up all the phyllo and pepper mixture. Wrap the sheets in waxed paper and refridgerate for at least 30 minutes. Place the phyllo sheets on a clean, dry surface. Cut a 1 inch slit down the center of each stack, lengthwise. Carefully lift one end of the phyllo sheet and fold it over to make a triangle. Repeat this one more time until all the sheets are filled and folded. Bake for about 12 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,green grape,tamarind pulp,tomato paste,celery seed,honey
title: Chilean Chilli (Sour Jeera)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 3 tablespoons tamarind pulp, fresh | 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 3 green seedless grapes | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon dark chocolate
instructions: Mix the tamarind with the rest of the ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to boil. Lower heat and stir often. Simmer for 5 minutes or until the chillies are soft and pulpy. Melt chocolate and stir into chilli mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Spiced Mozzarella and Cumin Salad
ingredients: 500 g mozzarella cheese | 2 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 2 teaspoons caster sugar, for sprinkling
instructions: Slice the mozzarella into thin slices about 3/4 inch wide. Combine cumin and sugar in a small frying pan and toast for 1 minute stirring constantly, until they start to pop from the side of the pan. Remove the from the heat and toss the cheese with the cumin and sugar until coated well. Scatter over some of the remaining coriander leaves over the top.

title: Veal with Madeira
ingredients: 1/2 lb boned veal | 2 tablespoons madeira wine | 1 rosemary sprig | 1/4 cup chopped walnut, toasted
instructions: Trim excess fat from the veal. Coat all sides of the veal with the madeira, then place on a rack in a roasting pan. Roast, uncovered in a 350 degree f oven 2 hours, basting occasionally until a meat thermometer registers 140 degrees f for rare. Remove from oven, let stand, covered with foil, 5 minutes. Skim off accumulated fat. Slice with a sharp knife into rounds. Arrange on a platter and sprinkle with walnuts. Serve immidiately.

title: Chinese Oyster Sauce (Artichokes) on Crostini
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 10 ounces water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill weed | 1/2 cup chopped dry roasted peanuts | 1/2 - 3/4 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place baguette, artichokes, sherry, dill weed, and peanuts on an aluminum baking pan or platter. Drizzle with oil and brush with oyster sauce. Broil 5 to 10 minutes, or until toasted.

title: Arroz Verde (Mexican Rice and Masa harina)
ingredients: 7 1/2 cups masa harina | 1 1/2 cups long grain rice
instructions: Boil the rice with the 1 1/2 cups of water in a stock pot along with 1 1/2 tablespoons of corn oil to make a slurry. Add as much masa harina as you can, one cup at a time. Mix well, until the rice is all wet and loose. Cover and let simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. While waiting for the rice to cook, cook the rice in the 1 1/2 cups of hot water on low heat if necessary, till it is tender. It should take 15 to 20 minutes for the rice to be completely soft and creamy.

title: Super Easy Microwave Chutney
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons chili paste ( thai bird chili paste, i find in ethnic food store ) | 1 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Put chutney on a microwavable dish, and microwave on high 50% power for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, stir the chutney after 5 minutes. Then let cook for 20 minutes on high. If you would like a smooth paste, let cool.

title: Cider Pear Ketchup
ingredients: 1 large ripe pear | 1/2 cup margarita mix | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon zest | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar
instructions: Core the pears and cut into very thin slices.. Pour margarita mix in small bowl. Add all remaining ingredients and mix.

Random Ingredients: fruit,tabasco sauce,italian tomato,turmeric,green curry paste,apricot preserve
title: Quick and Easy Indian Fruit Curry
ingredients: 1/3 cup apricot preserves ( made by imagine brand ) or 1/3 cup strawberry preserves | 1 can italian stewed tomatoes ( chopped ) | 1 -2 drop tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon green curry paste ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1 dash turmeric | 1 dash dried fruit or 1 dash citric acid
instructions: Combine preserves and tomatoes in a microwave safe bowl. Season with tabasco and curry. Microwave on high for about 3 - 5 minutes. Stir again, add optional liquid drops. Microwave for another 3 - 5 minutes or until desired consistency or the preserves are well incorporated. Remove from microwave. Serve over rice. Enjoy.

title: Pesto Butter
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium sauce pan. Cook over medium heat for 5 - 10 minutes or until mixture is well blended. Stir constantly. Serve.

title: Quinoa-Braised Pork With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1/4 cup ground dried chickpea flour | 1 pound boneless pork loin, trimmed and cut into 2 inch cubes | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh sage leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 3 cups coarsely quinoa, soaked in a large bowl of cold water 30 minutes | 1 can chickpea flour | 1 cup uncooked quinoa
instructions: Spray a large dutch oven with nonstick spray. Place the pork into the heated dutch oven and add the sage. Cook over high heat until browned, stirring frequently. Reduce heat to med low and add the browned pork, browned turkey, quinoa, and chickpea flour. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the pork is cooked through, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the quinoa according to the package directions, adding the quinoa and chickpea flour along with water, using a wooden spoon to get the water up to medium consistency, about 8 minutes. If the pan does not have a lid, loosen the lid, increase the heat to medium and cook until bubbly, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,tahini paste,yellow bell pepper,kalamata olive,lamb stock,taco seasoning,thyme sprig,grand marnier
title: Lamb Merguez (Kosher Lamb Kebabs)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3/4 cup tahini paste | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 2 medium yellow bell peppers, cut into 1 1/2-inch strips | 1 cup kalamata olive, pitted and halved | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Combine the lamb, tahini, grand marnier, boullion, and taco seasoning in a large resealable plastic bag. Refrigerate at least 1 hour, or up to 1 day. Thread the lamb cubes onto soaked wooden skewers, alternating with peppers and olives, starting at the tip of the skewer and working your way into the kebab. If you have a skewer attachment, remove the kebabs, close the marinade, and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Cook the kebabs on a ridged grill over a medium hot coals for 10 to 12 minutes, basting on each side with the marinade as it cooks.

title: Olive Oil & Sun-Dried Tomato
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground arabic spices | 12 -14 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 4 1/2 fluid ounces milk
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill for 30 minutes. Serve cold on your favourite salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: coffee,tomato sauce,salt pork,onion salt,chili powder,fish sauce
title: Simple Vietnamese Fish Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs firm and fresh fish, cut into chunks | 1 small onion ( diced medium ) | 1 lb salt pork, cut into cubes or 1 lb bacon | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup canned crushed tomatoes with their juice | 1/3 cup water
instructions: Fry up onion and salt pork cubes, then set aside to drain. Add to pan a pinch of chili powder and the rest of the ingredients and simmer very slowly for about 15 - 20 minutes or until the sauce has thickened. Put the fish stew pot on the stove top with a very small amount of water and simmer for about 20 minutes. Or just put everything in a bowl. Add to the sauce and simmer for another 15 or 20 minutes. Serve on hoagies, crackers or as a side dish with any kind of bread.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,dark soy sauce,hot chicken broth,baby bok choy,cayenne,mexican chili powder,beet,chunky peanut butter
title: Peanut Butter Chicken Chili
ingredients: 1 lb chicken meat | 1 cup chunky peanut butter, toasted | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon mexican chili powder ( to taste ) | 1/3 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup baby bok choy, trimmed, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Season all sides of chicken with cayenne. Roast in a 350°f oven for 35 minutes. When chicken is done, remove from oven and let cool slightly, then slice into bite size pieces. While chicken is roasting, toast peanut butter.

title: Baked Haddock
ingredients: 8 ounces skinned haddock | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons orange bell peppers, finely chopped | 1 packet frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place all ingredients in medium saucepan and cook until heated through. Place on oven tray. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes until fish is cooked and browned.

title: Saffron Brie Snack (France)
ingredients: 1/4 cup saffron, coarsely crushed | 1/2 lb brie cheese, in cubes, preferably with rind | 1 medium yellow onion, peeled, halved lengthwise, thinly sliced | 6 tablespoons biscuit cutouts
instructions: Combine rind and saffron in small bowl and set aside. Place cheese, onion slices, in cheesecloth.

Random Ingredients: chilies sauce,cucumber,beef chuck roast,red chile pepper,fruit,egg yolk,ice,pork shoulder
title: Spicy Cucumber-Shredded Pork Roast
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground beef chuck roast | 1/2 pound pork shoulder, thinly sliced | 4 large egg yolks | 4 cups ice, or as needed | 6 red chile peppers, chopped | 2 whole dried chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup fruit sauce | 1 can sliced cucumbers, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix together ground beef chuck roast, pork shoulder, egg yolks, salt, and chiles. Place on a piece of aluminum foil large enough to wrap around the roast. Wrap tightly with the aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the roast reaches 130 degrees f, and the temperature has reached 145 degrees f, about 3 hours. Allow meat to rest while chopping, about 15 minutes. Spread one third of the tomato sauce canola oil in the bottom of a roasting pan, and arrange chilies, chilies, and fruit sauce. Place the meat on top of the tomatoes in the roasting pan, and wrap tightly with the aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the sauce has become fragrant and the meat is very tender, about 3 more hours. Remove meat from pan, and slice very thinly. Scoop out most of the juices, but leave enough to serve in a gravy boat for dipping.

title: German-Style French Beans
ingredients: 1 can french beans, drained and rinsed | 1 bottle ale ( any ale i choose ) | 1 jar green seedless grapes
instructions: Mix all ingredients in 6 qt casserole. Cover and heat in 375 degree oven for 1 hour. Uncover. If using regular oven, bake at 325 degree oven for 45 - 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,escarole,taco seasoning mix,bicarbonate soda,vanilla essence,mushroom
title: Quick Mushroom & Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mixed mushrooms | 1/2 cup chopped escarole | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning mix
instructions: Mix all vegetables together in a salad bowl, add taco seasoning & flavourings. Add remaining dressing ingredients and mix well. Chill thoroughly for an hour. Serve.

title: Chinese Roast Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 12 green chiles, sliced with seeds | 4 pieces white mushrooms, sliced and sliced across the grain | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon vinegar | light syrup
instructions: Grind 2 tablespoons of szechuan peppercorns over a bowl. Place a layer of chiles on a plate. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of peppercorn mixture evenly over chiles.

title: Spiced Corn for Beef
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 3 1/2 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Mix cornstarch and stock together and add to hot saucepan. Heat mixture on low stirring continuously until thickened.

title: Papaya Salad

instructions: Peel grape & cut in half. Slice red bell pepper and cut in thin strips. Bring milk and soy sauce to a boil in a skillet. Turn down heat, add grapes & pepper and cook covered 15 - 20 minutes until done.

title: Sausage-Turnip Porcini
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 4 thai chiles, seeded and minced | 2 small turnips, peeled and diced | 2 stalks lemongrass, peeled and minced | 5 ounces sweet italian sausage | 1 1/4 cups vodka, or more to taste

Cool slightly, then cut each pita in half and serve warm, or refrigerate for up to 1 hour.

ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine, dry-roasted | 2 tablespoons sliced rosemary leaves | 4 bone-in chicken cutlets | 2 tart cooking apples, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 lb small dried beans, washed | 1/2 cup frozen quartered artesian deli ham or 1/2 cup other leftover ham, cut into thin slices | crushed ice
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a medium bowl combine wine, rosemary, and 1/4 cup of water. Spread over both sides of chicken cutlets. Top with apple slices. Top with beans. title: Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 4 egg yolks | 1/4 cup tahini
instructions: Whisk together the egg yolks, tahini, and hot pepper sauce. When ready to serve, pour over toasted bread, or on top of pita chips.

title: Pasta With Nuts and Arugula (Chao De Arugula)
ingredients: 250 g fresh fettuccine pasta | 1 1/2 cups arugula leaves | 125 g roasted vanilla achar ( from a jar ) | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander, leaves
instructions: Boil 1 quart of water then add 1 cup of the pasta water. Add fettuccine, arugula, and achar. Cook until pasta is tender and al dente. Rinse with cold water, drain well then toss with red chili powder and coriander leaves. Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Perfect Easy Beef Brisket
ingredients: 5 lbs lean beef brisket, fat trimmed | 1 teaspoon spice | 2 1/2 cups macaroni or 2 1/2 cups penne pasta | 1 1/2 tablespoons maggi seasoning salt or 1 1/2 tablespoons mrs. dash seasoning mix
instructions: Sprinkle brisket with seasoning salt. Spread thin layer of fat on the brisket, and put back on the fat. Put one cup of cooked pasta on the brisket, turn, and place on a rack in the bottom of a roasting pan. Pour 1/2 cup of boiling water into the pan. Cover the pan and bake at 400 degrees farenheit for 3 - 5 hours, or until very tender when pierced when pierced with a fork. Remove brisket from roasting pan to a carving board or carving board and let rest 20 minutes. If necessary, re cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days. The longer the brisket rests in the liquid, the more flavorful it will be. Remove brisket from liquid and keep meat warm in a 150 degree f oven until ready to eat. Cut brisket into serving sizes.

title: Frozen Key Lime Pops
ingredients: 2 packages dried yeast | 1 pint warm water | 4 ounces key lime juice | 24 dates, cut into small pieces | 14 ounces sliced water chestnuts
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the yeast with the warm water. Let stand until the yeast is bubbly, about 10 minutes. Add key lime juice and dates, cover and let stand for 20 minutes. Stir the mixture once or twice so that the yeast is fully dissolved. Refrigerate overnight, or until the next day. Bring 2 3/4 cups water to a boil in a 2 - 3 qt saucepan. Pour mixture into a gallon sized ziplock bag. Punch down and form into patties. Seal bag, and let rise a second time. To defrost, preheat oven to 400°f. Place the patties in a baking pan and bake uncovered for 20 - 25 minutes. While patties are baking, stir one more time with the water chestnuts. Serve warm and enjoy.

ingredients: 4 chicken breast, halved | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin filet | 1 package instant vanilla pudding | 1/4 cup dark molasses
instructions: Place chicken, breast halves and steamed vegetables in an oblong saucepan. Cover and steam the mixture together for 45 minutes, until meat is tender and juices run clear.

title: Baileys Irish Cream Mousse
ingredients: 5 large egg whites | 3 tablespoons cumin seeds | 3 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Line a 9 1/2 to 6 1/2 in. Square baking tin loosely with foil. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f and position a rack in the center. In a small bowl, place egg whites, cumin seeds, and irish cream and beat to stiff peaks with mixer. Whisk 1/3 of the mousse mixture into egg whites. Fold in the remaining mixture. Pour into prepared pan. Turn out pan on oven racks. Bake mousse for 30 - 40 minutes until top is firm and lightly browned. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate.

instructions: Combine the tomotoe ingredients in a large bowl. Toss to combine, then add the shrimp and sugar to the mixture and stir to combine. Place a large, lightly oiled nonstick skillet over medium high heat to bring out the tamale batter. Add the 1/2 cup of mixture to the pan.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Arrange the sausage in a single layer in an 11x7 inch baking pan. Sprinkle with cheese, mustard seed, and crushed red pepper flakes. Bake uncovered, for 35 minutes, or until sausage is cooked through. Remove from the oven.

title: Raspberry Vegetable Rollups(Yissel Kaffe)
ingredients: 7 large frozen raspberries | 2 lbs vegetarian ground chicken ( or extra firm ) | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 -3 ounces snow peas, trimmed well
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. On a cutting board, lay out 6 raspberries and divide each half into three halves. Using a vegetable peeler, peel away the rind and membrane from each half. Place one half of each raspberberberin rind in a wide, shallow bowl. Sprinkle the ground chicken and 1 tablespoon of the confectioners' sugar over the raspberries, rubbing the mixture into the meat with your fingers and lifting the raspberins as you're going. Sprinkle on 1½ teaspoons of kosher salt and 1½ teaspoons of sugar. Roll each piece of raspberin over the seasoned chicken and transfer to a rimmed baking sheet. With a pastry brush, paint remaining 1½ tablespoons of confectioners’ sugar over and around the roll, making sure it covers all sides of the meat. Sprinkle with 1½ teaspoons salt and 1½ teaspoons sugar. Using the back of a fork to help draw down the raspberries, lightly press the fruit back into the juice. Repeat with remaining slices and raspberins. Sprinkle the remaining ½ tablespoons confectioners’ sugar and 1½ teaspoons salt over roll and place in the preheated oven until the rolls are lightly browned, about 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly. Remove the raspberries from the bowl. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a serving platter with a slotted spoon. Sprinkle with remaining 1½ teaspoons salt and 1½ teaspoons sugar, drizzle with remaining juice, and serve immediately.

title: Chile Pepper Mascarpone Cheese for Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped fresh chile pepper | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1 tablespoon crushed dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon crushed dried thyme
instructions: Place a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add half of the chile peppers, all of the marjoram, the thyme, the instant coffee, and the 1 tablespoon of crushed, dried marjoram. Stir gently until the cheese comes to the surface. Lift the skillet out of the heat. Transfer the cheese to a clean metal bowl, and cover with plastic wrap until cool. instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. While the water is heating, place the linguine in the boiling water, and return to a boil. instructions: Preparation, to prepare the spinach, remove 1 cup of water, squeeze out excess liquid, and chop into about 1/2 inch chunks. ingredients: 3 tablespoons honey | 3 tablespoons soup ( your choice ) | 2 teaspoons grand marnier ( optional ) | jalapeno, strips ( optional )
instructions: Place honey, soup, and grand marnier in a pot over low heat and stir until bubbly, about 4 minutes. Add jalapeno strips and serve.

title: Nuoc Cham Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons gin | 4 teaspoons asian ( toasted ) sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon fresh sliced mushrooms
instructions: Mix in a blender. Serve over rice.

title: Cajun Champagne Salad
ingredients: 1 pint champagne | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 2 leaves romaine lettuce, torn into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Fill a pitcher with chilled champagne and the cream of chicken soup.

title: Italian Breadsticks

instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 2/3 cup of warm water, and set aside. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and add 5 cups of bread crumbs. Stir until the crumbs are toasted. Let cool completely before coating with a thin coating of vegetable oil. Variation, instead of bread crumbs use breadcrumbs and finely chopped pecans instead.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine pasta,vinegar,dill pickle,crescent dinner,chili pepper flake,ranch dressing
title: Mom's Noodle Ring

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.
