title: Easy and Deliciously Easy Fonduta
ingredients: 1/4 pint water | 1/4 bunch green onion, finely chopped | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded ( not grated )
instructions: Dissolve the bouillon at least half way if you use fondue pot for this recipe. In a medium saucepan combine the water and spring onion and simmer over medium heat for about 5 minutes until the liquid has been mostly absorbed, but a little sauce is still clinging. Stir in the frituta and set aside to cool for about 10 minutes. Serve garnished with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,orange zest,chili con carne,halibut fillet,salsa,kidney bean
title: Brazilian Halibut With Chilis and Olives
ingredients: 1 lb halibut fillet | 3/4 cup salsa | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1 teaspoon chili con carne ( or other spicey spanish chile ) | 1/2 cup canned kidney beans | 1 -2 tablespoon lemongrass, chopped | 1 teaspoon orange zest, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place fish on foil covered rack in a baking dish. Brush evenly with salsa. Sprinkle with the lime zest and chili con carne. Bake 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. To serve, place salmon on a heated serving plate. Scatter beans on top of the fish.

Random Ingredients: havarti cheese,chili sauce,ricotta cheese,rock salt,brown mustard seed,chicken,half cream
title: Hot & Creamy Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, quartered if using breasts | 1 - 1 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon rock salt | 1 teaspoon instant brown mustard seeds | 1/2 cup brown mustard seeds | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream or 1/2 cup cream | chili sauce ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: To prepare chicken, rinse and remove giblets, and cut chicken in chunks leaving the other parts unwhiled. Toss chicken pieces with ricotta cheese, salt, and mustard seeds evenly in a large bowl. Set aside. To prepare salad, stir together brown mustard seeds with brown mustard seed in a small bowl. In a small skillet, warm the chili sauce over meduim heat. Add half and half or cream, and chili sauce to coat the spoon. Heat through and pour over chicken pieces. Decorate with chili sauce, if desired, and serve immediately.

title: Spanish Burgers
ingredients: 4 ounces lean ground sirloin | 2 ounces thinly sliced hamburger | 2 tablespoons chopped green onions | 1/2 cup sliced stuffed green olives | 2 tablespoons grated mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine meat, green onion, and cheese. Shape into 4 - 6 patties. Cook 5 minutes per side or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,salmon,currant,cashew,black tea,brown button mushroom,green chilies
title: Wild Forest Smoked Salmon Tea Party Platter
ingredients: 300 g smoked salmon | 200 g wild mushrooms ( sliced ) | 2 tablespoons green chilies ( chopped ) | 2 tart apples ( peeled and chopped ) | 125 g roasted unsalted cashews ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup dried currant | 200 ml black tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour over cooked dried fruit and mix well. Refrigerate for at least six hours to draw out the flavours. Turn into serving bowl and add tea.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,green bell pepper,butternut pumpkin,fennel bulb,hard egg
title: Pumpkin & Egg Salad
ingredients: 500 g butternut pumpkin, peeled, chopped and baked | 1 green bell pepper, chopped ( bell pepper works too ) | 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 fennel bulb, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Mix pumpkin, pepper, hard boiled eggs, fennel and vanilla essence together and let sit 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Yummiliciously Meat Mix!
ingredients: 500 g fresh minced meat | 1 tablespoon chile, dried ( see notes ) | 1 tablespoon rosemary, dried | 250 g pine nuts ( can be purchased as a natural can't be found ) | 1 pinch sea salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Use a wooden spoon to mix well. Add salt if necessary, but add enough to form a smooth mixture. Refrigerate for 2 - 3 days, but make sure it's completely free of lumps. Afterwards, transfer to the refrigerator, and let sit at room temperature for 1 hour. Use in sandwiches, on its own or on top of cooked pasta. This is a great snack with anything to dip the raw veggies in.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,paprika,serrano pepper,head cabbage,broccoli floret,thai fish sauce
title: Thai Fish Soup
ingredients: 3 medium heads of cabbage, core removed, thinly sliced | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 small serrano pepper, deseeded and diced | 1 medium head of broccoli floret | 3 teaspoons sweet paprika
instructions: Place cabbage in a medium size saucepan with enough water to cover, add fish sauce and serrano pepper. Bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until cabbage is soft. Remove with slotted spoon and place on a plate covered with plastic wrap to drain any excess liquid.

title: Ricotta
ingredients: 1 lb whole milk ricotta cheese or 1 lb cottage cheese | 1 can creamed corn
instructions: Mix well. In a pan melt 1 stick of butter with an oven proof pan filled with approximately 1/3 of boiling water. Pour a small amount of sauce into the pan. Mix together the corn and milk and pour over ricotta mixture in pan. Spread the rest of the sauce over all. Bake at 350 f for about 30 mins or until golden brown.

title: Tuna Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package uncooked lasagna noodles | 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 1 pound ground sirloin | 1 can tuna | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 pound italian sausage, casings removed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Rinse and drain the lasagna noodles. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the lasagna noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Rinse under cold water, and drain. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook the italian sausage until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Cut the sausage into 1 inch pieces, and set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the lasagna noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Set aside 1 cup of the cooked noodles, and set aside. Place a large pot of lightly salted water on the stovetop, and bring to a boil. Cook the sweet italian sausage until no longer pink in the center, about 20 minutes. Drain any excess grease, and set aside. Cook and stir the ground sirloin and ground sausage in a skillet over medium heat, breaking the meat into crumbles as it cooks. Mix in the tuna, and season with baking soda.

title: Kolachi Beef and Peas
ingredients: 1 lb stew beef chunks | 8 ounces frozen peas | 2 tablespoons chocolate, grated | 8 ounces kohlrabi ( kohlrabi is good ) | 8 ounces feta cheese ( or you can use more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Brown stew beef chunks and peas in skillet. Add the grated chocolate. Put into a casserole dish. Bake 1 hour or until tender. Serve with bread, egg slices, or a green vegetable.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,haricot bean,spring onion,pimiento,tomato green chile pepper
title: Haricot Habanero
ingredients: 8 cups dried haricot beans | 8 large leaves fresh mint leaves, torn | 2 tablespoons pickled japeno pepper, or to taste | 1/4 cup chopped green onions | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento
instructions: Place haricots into a large container. Season with salt.

title: Raspberry Avocados
ingredients: 6 ripe avocados | 1 cup frozen raspberries | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained well
instructions: Using a sharp knife, carefully cut each avocado lengthwise. Remove the peel with a brush. Cut each avocado crosswise into halves, and remove a pit. Fill the shells with the remaining ingredients, reserving one rind for garnish. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,black pepper,garam masala,chicken breast,new potato,miracle whip,bragg liquid amino
title: Slow Cooker Indian Chicken, Potatoes and Braggs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken breasts, cubed | 10 medium new potatoes, quartered | 2 tablespoons braggs liquid aminos | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon miracle whip ( optional )
instructions: In a slowcooker, toss the chicken, potatoes, braggs, garam masala, pepper, worcestershire sauce, and tabasco together. Pour the aminos over the chicken and potatoes. Cover and cook for 12 to 15 hours on low.

title: Munavian Shortening
ingredients: 1 cup currants | 4 cups shortening for frying
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Combine currants and butter in a medium bowl.

title: Radish Coins
ingredients: 5 -6 radishes, finely sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon white vinegar | 6 leaves milk chocolate, broken into several pieces
instructions: Place a piece of the chocolate piece into a small bowl. When melted, pour in a small portion into the bowl of chocolate to make it cool the chocolate too much. Remove the skin from the radish and cut the radishes into fine rounds or wedges. Place all the radishes on a microwave safe plate and microwave on high for 3 minutes, turning every 2 minutes until the radishes are dry and crisp. Remove from the microwave and add the radish slices on top of the chocolate. Spread chocolate over the radish coins and let cool for 15 minutes. You will need to let them stand for at least 15 minutes before eating.

title: Sweet Sour Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1/2 cup finely crushed tortilla chips | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Heat cast iron skillet on medium heat. In small bowl mix flour & tortilla chips/chilli flakes. Add to skillet. Stir frequently & turn over when bottom is golden. Poke a few holes in the crust with a fork. Add sugar & cook until it has turned a dark golden color. Turn off heat & pour hot liquid into small bowl. Place back in skillet and mix with your favorite chips.

title: Crock Pot Chicken With Corn
ingredients: 1 cup fresh corn kernels | 2 lbs chicken stock ( or chicken broth or water ) | 2 teaspoons rice wine ( optional )
instructions: In a large pan, combine corn and stock and bring to a boil. Simmer for 30 minutes, or until tender. Strain off liquid and cool for 5 minutes. Transfer corn to a food processor or blender and puree until smooth. Return to soup stock and stir in rice wine and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Cheese Ale Dip (Tasty Beer Dip)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low-sodium beer, such as corona or 1 1/2 cups light beer | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground dry mustard powder | 3 cups shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 3 olives, sliced and pitted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spread the beer and dry mustard powder in the bottom of a 2 quart glass baking dish.

Random Ingredients: splenda brown sugar,kaffir lime leaf,bread crumb,butter,sugar,chili paste,lasagna
title: Chilli Lime Butter Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna sheet | 1/2 lb butter | 6 ounces splenda brown sugar blend | 8 ounces dry bread crumbs | 3 large kaffir lime leaves | 1 -2 teaspoon chili paste ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Place oven rack in lower third of oven. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Butter 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook lasagna sheets in boiling water, 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red wine,heavy whipping cream,sage,asparagus spear,mandarin orange,raspberry
title: Spicy Cream for Asparagus
ingredients: 1 quart heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons red wine | 12 thinly sliced asparagus spears | 6 small fresh sage leaves | 1 pint fresh red grapes or 1 pint green grape | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced mandarin oranges, drained
instructions: Place whipping cream on chilled cutting board. Using sharp knife, cut asparagus through vegetable peeler just until the tips are separate and just beginning to curl at the edges. Sprinkle with a little of the sage leaves, then top with the asparagus slices and oranges. Garnish with additional sprigs of lemon or orange zest and sprigs of lemon or orange. Variation, add 2 tbsp of lemon or orange juice to the cream, and add a little more of the heavy cream. If you desire a sweeter cream, add 2 tbsp to the heavy whipping cream.

title: Andouille Sausage and Bocconcini Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh andouille sausages, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 8 ounces andouille sausages, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 1 package frozen, chopped bocconcini, divided
instructions: Prepare and preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together the sausage, andouille sausages and vegetable broth. Stir in dried parsley flakes. Place 2 pieces of bocconcini on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 15 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the bottoms are lightly browned. When baked, pour 1 1/2 teaspoons olive oil into the pan, or stir in 1 teaspoon of the olive oil into the soup. Top with fresh parsley flakes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: collard green,puff pastry,bacardi rum,double cream,green bell pepper,vanilla extract,wheat flour,rock sugar
title: Crayfish Rolls

instructions: Preheat the oven to 210c/fan 180c/gas brush the pastry sheets with the rum and scatter over the sugar. Spoon the greens, pepper and rum into a large bowl and mix until well coated.

Random Ingredients: southern comfort,olive,garam masala,italian salad dressing,ice water,fenugreek seed,cardamom seed
title: Indian Spiced Olives
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely ground olives | 3/4 cup italian salad dressing | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds or 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 cups ice water | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients in an electric blender and process until smooth. Gradually stir in the ice water until the mixture is smooth, about 10 - 15 pulses. Taste and adjust the salt. Drizzle the olive oil over the top and serve.

Random Ingredients: bacon,green onion,cremini mushroom,italian,goat cheese,flat leaf parsley
title: Grilled Mushroom Pizza With Goat Cheese and Bacon
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, chopped | 1/2 bunch green onion, chopped | 4 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup goat cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup sweet italian spices ( your favorite )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. In medium bowl, combine goat cheese, parsley, and sweet italian spices. Stir in bacon. Spread 1/2 the goat cheese mixture on the prepared grill. Cook until underside lightly browns and cheese filling is bubbly. Cut through top crust. Slice through. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,double cream,red lentil,purpose flour,fenugreek seed,dark chocolate,green apple,lime
title: Bhel Puri (Red Lentil and Apple Cake)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spray a 9x13 inch pan with cooking oil. Heat the oil in a big frying pan over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and sauté till transparent. Combine the chocolate and cream in a small bowl and stir through to form a paste. Add the fenugreek seeds and stir to combine. Pour mixture into the pan and bake for 40 - 45 mins till the top is light gold and brown about 50 - 60 mins in the middle. Couscous will still be soft and crisp. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Grilled Pork with Pineapple and Sweet Pepper Salad
ingredients: 500 g pork, boned | 8 ounces pineapple chunks, drained | 8 green olives, trimmed | 1 bell pepper, halved deseeded and seeded | 4 bay leaves | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1/2 - 3/4 cup palm sugar, tightly packed ( or raw sugar, if you prefer ) | 1 -2 tablespoon plain flour, to thicken
instructions: Put the pineapples in a bowl of ice water to soften for 5 minutes. Roughly chop and put in a colander. Drain off any juice over the pork and put in a large bowl. Put in the pineapple, green olives, bell pepper, bay leaves and red curry paste and toss to combine. Taste to see if the sauce needs more salt. You can also use a mortar and pestle if you want a milder sauce. Pre heat a barbeque or bbq grill to medium. Brush a little fat over the grates if using, or put in a small, shallow tin. Brush with a little oil and cook for a couple of minutes on each side, till lightly coloured. Remove from the barbecue and serve the warm pork with sweet pepper salad. If using raw sugar, sprinkle over the pork just before serving.

title: Braised Parsnips
ingredients: 10 parsnips, peeled and cut into 3/4 inch slices | 3 pounds ground lamb | fresh basil, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spread the parsnips into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix the ground lamb and basil together thoroughly, and spread evenly over the parsnips. Cover the dish with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven for about 5 hours, or until tender.

title: Fennel Chutney
ingredients: 3 cups fennel seeds, crushed | 1 teaspoon freshly grated ginger root | 1 teaspoon fennel seeds, pounded to a powder
instructions: Toss together fennel seeds and ginger root in a bowl. Heat the crushed fennel seeds in a skillet over medium high heat. Remove from heat and grind to a fine powder. Mix ground fennel powder with fennel powder. Transfer mixture to a clean bowl and keep aside for 2 hours.

title: Frieten  ( French Beans )
ingredients: 500 g dried french beans | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Boil. When water starts boiling, add the vegetables, and when beans are soft and all of them are cooked, add the vinegar. Serve chilled.

title: Linguine With Orange Blossom Water and Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1 tablespoon red sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon orange flower water | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 3 tablespoons potato traditional, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add linguine pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: harissa,kosher salt black pepper,serrano chile pepper,heirloom tomato
title: Moroccan Heirloom Tomato Jam with Preserved Heirloom Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 pounds heirloom tomatoes with their stalks attached | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 serrano chile pepper, seeded and minced | 2 tablespoons harissa, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Slice the tomatoes in half through the core. Remove the seeds and pulp. Transfer to a large bowl, sprinkle with salt, and set aside. Scrape half of the pulp and seeds out of each tomato half. Stir in the serrano pepper with 2 tablespoons harissa, and spread out to cover the tomatoes. Arrange the tomato halves around the outside edge of the pan. Fill the bowl with 1/4 inch water, and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven until browned and tender, about 1 hour 10 minutes. Let cool, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Prepare toasting sauce, combine tomatoes, remaining harissa, and 1/4 cup water in a small saucepan over medium heat.

title: Ancho Pugliese
ingredients: 1 pound fresh shiitake mushrooms, washed and stems removed | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 40 whole anchovy fillets | 1 pound salad greens
instructions: Place shiitake mushrooms in a bowl, drizzle with about 1/2 teaspoon of salt, cover, and let stand 30 minutes. Rinse and dry shiitake mushrooms very thoroughly under running cold water, rubbing out the sand and exuded liquid. Rinse mushrooms under running water, and pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with cardamom and allow to stand 15 minutes. Set aside. Heat an iron skillet or large skillet over high heat until a bead of water sizzles in it. Cook mushrooms, stirring often, until softened and lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Serve hot, at room temperature or chilled.

title: Betsy's Fudge
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup | cooking spray | 3 maraschino cherries, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chocolate syrup or 1/2 teaspoon chocolate syrup
instructions: Put half the cherries in a microwave safe bowl. Melt 1 tablespoon of chocolate syrup in the microwave until smooth. Spray a 2 cup dish with cooking oil. Quickly pour syrup in dish. Swish cherry pieces around the pan so they don't unroll when added to the dish. Melt chocolate sauce in microwave for 20 seconds to 1 minute more. Stir cherry pieces gently into hot chocolate mixture. Pour into prepared dish. Put dish in the fridge to cool completely, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: crawfish tail,green bean,english cucumber,onion salt,vegetable oil cooking spray,cucumber
title: Veggies with Crawfish on the Barbie or Cactus Barbie
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, ends trimmed and cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 small english cucumber, sliced | 1 small cucumber, cut into thin slices | 1/2 lb crawfish tail, fresh | 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/4 cup cooking spray | 1 onion salt | about 1/2 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Cook beans and cucumber in a large pot of boiling water until just tender crisp, about 2 minutes. Drain beans and vegetables and place in a large glass baking dish or bowl. Cut crawfish into 1 inch pieces and arrange in a small circle on top of cucumbers and beans. Spray crawfish with cooking spray and sprinkle with onion salt.

title: Scotch Eggs
ingredients: sausage, scotch eggs or brains | ice cube | whiskey | 1/2 pint whiskey
instructions: Fill a saucer with water. Dip the sausages into the water, and drop them into the bowl of icy cold water. Repeat until the water is gone. Leave the eggs to harden.

title: French Quarter Style White Pearls Onions With Mushrooms and Beans
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white pearl onions | 1 package portabella mushrooms, sliced, in 1/2 inch pieces | 6 -7 slices deli-style hot pickled hamburgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients except hamburgers. Line a baking sheet with foil and place the hamburgers in a single layer, one each on top of each other. Bake at 425 degrees about 20 minutes, or until heated through. Serve with crusty bread and assorted vegetables.

title: Creamy Jalapeno Fried Chicken
ingredients: 16 ounces roasting chickens, cut into pieces | 1/2 cup ketchup, or to taste | 1/4 cup picante sauce or 1/4 cup picante sauce, divided | 1 large jalapeno, chopped, or more to taste | 1 box rigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup ice
instructions: Place the chicken pieces on a plate and stir together the ketchup, picante sauce and jalapeno. Place the rigatoni into a colander and set over the sink. Fill a large frying pan with enough water to come 3/4 of the way up the side of the pan. Place the chicken pieces into the water and bring the water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,lard,purpose flour,canola oil,beef,chicken stock,vanilla essence,quinoa
title: Lebanese-Style Mini Quinoa Gruntes
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 lb ground beef | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup quinoa | 4 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon lard | 1/2 tablespoon vanilla essence
instructions: To make the filling, in a big pan, melt the oil with the lard and vanilla. Once the lard is sizzling, gradually stir in the flour to make a roux. Add the stock and bring to a boil. Add salt if necessary. Add the quinoa and then lower the heat and simmer. This will take roughly 20 minutes. While the quinoa is cooking, make the patties. Divide the quinoa and beef into 2 or 4 portions and form 2 smaller round balls. Place the dough balls onto a tray and gently roll them around the balls. Using a fork, prick several holes in the top. Once they have begun to look firm, remove from the oven and set aside to cool. When the quinoa is cool enough to handle, transfer it to a bowl and add the cooled quinoa, stirring in thoroughly. Place in an ovenproof dish and pour the patties in the batter. Bake at 180c for 2 and a half minutes on each side, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,cardamom seed,sun tomato oil,cider vinegar,marjoram,green cabbage,red pepper flake,sirloin
title: Sliced Cabbage with Spinach, and Smoked Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1 lb sirloin, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh marjoram or 1 tablespoon oregano | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed, crushed | 1 head green cabbage, sliced | 1 cup shredded baby spinach, mixed the first 6 ingredients
instructions: Heat a wok over high heat, add oil and swirl to coat the sides. Remove and discard all but 2 tablespoons of the oil. Toss in the beef and marjoram. Stir fry until beef is just cooked through, turning halfway through. Add vinegar and stir fry 1 minute until it almost evaporates. Remove to a bowl. Stir in the red pepper, cardamom, cabbage and spinach. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,apple,extra virgin olive oil,mint leaf,rose water,tomatillo salsa,lime juice,ice water
title: Roasted Green Bell Peppers With Tomatillo Salsa
ingredients: 3 lbs tomatoes ( plum, about 3 medium ) | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves | 2 tablespoons minced fresh rose water | 1 tablespoon fresh-squeezed lime juice | 1 tablespoon canola extra virgin olive oil | 1 green bell pepper ( a large 1/2-1/2-inch, orange ) | 1/4 cup prepared tomatillo salsa | 2 tablespoons water | 2 tablespoons minced fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. For the tomatillo salsa, if using fresh tomatoes, cut off and discard the stem ends. Cut crosswise into 1/4-inch thick slices. Place the tomatoes in a large bowl. Break off the tip of a small piece of tomato and place in the bowl. Halve the bell pepper into 1 inch wide rings and put into a bowl. Break down the tomato seeds with your fingers on the underside of the bell pepper rings to remove the pit and the hard shell. If using fresh tomato, cut it into large chunks. Stir in the mint leaves and set aside until ready to serve. Place the bell pepper rings in a roasting pan or on a sheet of aluminum foil and pour in enough boiling water to cover them by 3 inches. Bake the tomatoes for about 45 minutes. Immediately remove the pan from the oven and drain all the water out. Spray a broiler pan with some cooking spray and preheat the broiler. Add the tomato slices and sprinkle with the dried mint leaves. Place the tomatillo salsa in a small bowl. To serve, place a serving plate over the tomatillo salsa. Sprinkle with the optional amount of chopped fresh mint if desired and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,rigatoni pasta,greek yogurt,fajita seasoning mix,leek,new mexico chile powder,chunky salsa,dill
title: Chunky Salsa Rigatoni
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 3 large leeks, coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon greek yogurt, extra | 1 can new mexico chile powder | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | dill, to sprinkle, to serve
instructions: Place the rigatoni in a large pan of boiling water. Boil for 10 - 12 minutes, or according to packet instructions. Meanwhile, place the leeks in a microwave safe bowl with 1 tablespoon of water. Cover and cook on high for 2 - 3 minutes, or until tender. Drain well and set aside. Place the yogurt, fajita seasoning and extra fajita seasoning in a large bowl. Mix well. Mix in the leeks. Add hot prepared rigatoni pasta to the bowl and stir to combine. Divide the pasta among 4 serving bowls, topping up each serving with half a spoonful of salsa. Top with dill.

title: Flatbread(British Columbian)
ingredients: 2 cups unbleached whole wheat flour | 2 3/4 cups pizza dough or 2 3/4 cups pizza dough
instructions: Mix flour and dough ingredients in a medium bowl. Knead dough on a floured surface until the mixture becomes a smooth ball. Transfer dough to a lightly floured surface and roll out to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes and place on a tray. Bake at 375 degrees for about 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cognac,olive,anchovy fillet,red beet,chow mein noodle,turmeric powder,jalapeno,pita bread
title: Beet With Pita(Barsi)
ingredients: 4 -5 small red beets, boiled for about 1/2 an hour, and then peeled ( about 1 5 oz or 10oz ) | 10 pitted pita bread | 1/4 - 1/2 cup olive, to taste | 1/4 cup cognac ( optional ) | 3/4 onion, chopped finely into 1/8 inch pieces | 3 -4 anchovy fillets ( optional ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 jalapeno, chopped finely | 1 can chow mein noodles
instructions: Grill whole red beets, and slice them in slices about 1/4 inch thick. Put them on the grill and allow to sweat and soften at least 15 minutes. The harder, tastier they will be. Let them cool for about 15 min, then peel and chop the beets into 1/8 inch pieces. Mix all ingredients except noodles, in a small pan. Put on low heat. Keep on low heat, stirring occasionally to avoid sticking to bottom of pan. Cook until beets are done, and can be stirred. Serve with pita for dipping. Note, if beets are very thick, add a bit water. You can either add a bit more, or add a pinch of salt while you are cooking the beets, then the liquid will drain back into the beets for a little bit.

title: Simple Spanish Onions for Dip
ingredients: 4 cups spanish onions | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 450°f. Peel and finely chop onions. Place the chopped onions and fenugreek seeds in an oven proof pan in the oven. Place pan on a baking tray and bake for 50 - 60 minutes, stirring at least once or twice.

title: Indian Style Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 2 cups yoghurt
instructions: Rinse the head of lettuce. Dice the lettuce. Mix yoghurt, lettuce, and onion and eat.

title: Avocado and Pesto Hummus
ingredients: 1/2 ripe hass avocado | 1 ounce parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 -2 large fresh hot pepper ( jalapeno, serrano pepper..your choice ) | 1 tablespoon margarine ( or a combination of these ) or 1 tablespoon oil ( or a combination of these )
instructions: Peel the ripe avocado by using a fork or peeling it. Cut into chunks, place in a food processor and with the pesto, put a fork through them and whir until mixed. Mash up the avocados to desired consistency with the pesto and drizzle in the olive oil. Stir in the grated cheese, or use the margarine or oil for the pesto. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,taco seasoning,corn syrup,salmon,peanut,peach,green chili pepper
title: Smoked Salmon Tacos
ingredients: 1/8 cup light corn syrup | 1/8 cup light corn syrup | 1 green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/2 cup chopped peach | 1/3 cup feta cheese | 3 tablespoons chopped roasted peeled peanuts
instructions: Heat corn and 1/8 cup light corn syrup in a small saucepan until hot. Spread 1/8 cup light corn syrup mixture on waxed paper lined cookie sheet. Microwave on high power 1 minute, stirring every 30 seconds. Stir chili with taco seasoning.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,farmer cheese,ranch dressing,limeade concentrate,meatball,cherry brandy,spaghetti squash,tomato paste
title: Picnic Kabobs in Sweet Tomato Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 large spaghetti squash, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can tomato-flavored plum tomatoes with jalapeno sauce | 1 container apricot preserves | 1 jar cherry brandy | 1 package farmers cheese | 1 can frozen cooked meatballs, thawed | 1 package frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add spaghetti squash.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,french bread,white wine,sourdough bread,broiler fryer chicken,nutmeg,basmati rice,chinese five spice powder
title: Crock Pot French Chicken Slices With Risotto and Five Spice
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, halved, backbone removed | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 loaf french bread ( i use one loaf ) | 1 can condensed chinese five spice powder ( i use mccormick brand ) | 1 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup raisins ( i've also used sultanas ) | 1/2 cup coarsely grated fresh italian parsley or 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Make a slit in the back of the bread lengthwise. Open out the bread by scoring it with a knife at 1 1/2 intervals. Do not allow bread to absorb moisture. Place loaves in crock pot. Season chicken with 1 tsp nutmeg, 1/2 tsp chinese five spice powder and 1/4 tsp chinese five spice powder. Add remaining ingredients in order listed to crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for three to five hours. Serve over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,guinness stout,cooking sherry,farfalle pasta,swiss cheese,vegetable oil,curry powder,chocolate pudding mix
title: Curried Guinness & Swiss Cheese Side Dish
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta or 12 ounces penne pasta, cooked | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 1/3 cups guinness stout ( approximately ) or 1 1/3 cups other stout beer ( approximately ) | 1/2 cup cooking sherry or 1/2 cup sweet sherry wine vinegar | 1/4 cup sweet sherry or 1/4 cup sweet sherry wine | 4 tablespoons quick-cooking sherry wine or 4 tablespoons sweet sherry wine vinegar | 2 cups swiss cheese, shredded ( approx. ) | 3 tablespoons curry powder
instructions: Drain pasta well.

title: Elegant Rice & Cucumbers
ingredients: 3/4 cup leftover cooked rice | 1 medium cucumber, chopped | 2 tablespoons grated emmenthaler cheese
instructions: Mix up cooked rice and remaining ingredients.

title: Pecan Crackers
ingredients: 3/4 cup quick cooking oats, dry flakes | 1 -2 large serrano pepper, diced in 4 pieces | 1/2 small lime
instructions: Set oven to 375 degrees. Grease a baking sheet and line it with parchment paper. In a medium bowl combine 3/4 cup of the dry flakes with the diced chilies, lime juice and remaining dry flakes and toss to evenly coat the dried flakes. Press the mixture onto the parchment paper and sprinkle with additional flakes. Bake until light golden brown and crispy, about 10 - 12 minutes.

title: Roasted Beef and Goat's Cheese Wrap
ingredients: 1 whole flank steak | 2 tablespoons goat's cheese | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pistachio nuts | 2 tablespoons grated fresh goat's cheese | 2 tablespoons crumbled aged brie cheese | 2 2 tablespoons crumbled aged brie cheese, divided | 1 tablespoon clear aged brandy or 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475 degrees f. Using your fingers, poke holes in the flank steak several times and insert a whole shard from goat's cheese until well hidden between thumb and forefinger. Insert your finger into the hole. Place the shard in the oven and roast for 15 minutes. Let sit for 5 minutes while your oven is heating to redistribute the cheese throughout the meat. Take the ham off the grill, top with the goat’s cheese and allow excess liquid to drip off. Place on a piece of waxed paper and use the waxed paper as a helpful tool to remove the cheese from the steak. Roll the steak up into a roast shape, then slice into 1/4 inch wide slices and wrap into the goat’s cheese. Place in a piece of parchment paper that has been dipped in the brandy and refrigerate for a couple of hours or overnight. After 30 minutes, lightly coat with some of the brie cheese. Bake until heated through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to sit for 15 minutes, then drizzle with some of the brandy. For a twist, drizzle on some of the aged brie, then drizzle over some sliced brie, and top with some of the chopped pistachios.

title: Roasted Pecans and Rigatoni
ingredients: 3 cups rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1/2 cup dried pecan pieces ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f degrees. Bring water to a boil, and add the rigatoni. Cook and immediately drain, then dry on paper towels. Mix the dried pecan pieces with the dry pasta in a roasting pan. Place in the oven and cook until toasted and browned, about 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Breaded Escarole and Sausage
ingredients: 2 cups chopped, cooked sausage | 3 tablespoons butter, divided | 8 eggs, beaten | 2 cups dry bread crumbs | 1 1/4 pounds escarole, rinsed and chopped | 1 can stewed tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon melted butter, divided | 1/4 cup ghee ( clarified butter for frying )
instructions: Stir sausages in 1/4 cup water into bread crumbs, and place in a large skillet. Place over medium low heat, and cook, stirring frequently, until sausage is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat, and cook eggs, stirring frequently, until set, about 5 minutes. Remove from skillet, and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon butter in an electric skillet to the very very top, and cook and stir escarole, stewed tomatoes, and 1 tablespoon of clarified butter until the escarole is wilted and butter is beginning to melt, about 10 minutes. Pour the escarole mixture into the bowl with the cooked egg eggs, and stir gently. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place a 9x9 inch baking dish in the oven, and melt 2 tablespoons of melted butter in the bottom of the baking dish. Pour sausage mixture into dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs to cover filling, and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until sausage mixture browns, and bread crumbs are golden brown, about 30 minutes for a total baking product. Let cool about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Baked Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 teaspoon harissa | 2 teaspoons prepared harissa or 2 teaspoons anise-flavored hot sauce | 6 ounces shredded feta | 3 tablespoons water | 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 jar spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Sprinkle feta on top and mix. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve over hot, hot cooked spaghetti.

title: Cafe Formaggioso - Italian Spiced Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces hazelnuts, toasted, skins on, husked, and shredded | 4 ounces blue cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup espresso or 1/4 cup strong coffee, hot | 1 teaspoon coconut oil | 1 -2 chili pepper, dried, chopped
instructions: Mash hazelnuts with a mortar and pestle. Stir in cheese and coffee. Chill until serving.

title: Salsa con Cielo (Eggs and Eggs)
ingredients: 5 eggs, beaten | 1/2 cup salsa | 8 sage leaves, fresh
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a heavy medium ovenproof skillet over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the sage and cook, stirring until the sage just starts to color. Add the eggs and salsa, stirring until the yolks form, about 2 minutes. Cover the skillet, and bake the eggs 10 minutes, until the eggs are set and the yolks no longer runny. Stir the eggs again, and cook 2 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,rice vinegar,bread,italian parsley,garlic salt,pork shoulder
title: Crazy Garlic Pork Gyros
ingredients: 1/4 cup italian parsley | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup rice vinegar ( i used regular white salt ) | 1 -2 poblano chile, seeded and chopped | 1 - 1 1/4 lb lean boneless pork shoulder | 4 slices bread, toasted
instructions: Heat grill to high. Mix garlic salt, parsley and vinegar in ziploc bag. Add pork and shake to coat well. Marinate, in refrigerator for 2 - 4 hours. Heat grill to high. Drain pork, discard marinade. Grill pork 30 minutes. Add chilies to the cooked pork, turning once. Grill pork 2 minutes. Serve on toasted bread with salsa and cheese. Serve on the side. It's hot.

title: Swiss Hazelnut and Pumpkin Gratin
ingredients: 8 ounces pumpkin pie spice | 7 ounces double cream or 7 ounces cream | 1/2 ounce hazelnuts, toasted and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly grease a 2 1/2in x 3in loose bottomed loaf tin and line with baking paper. Combine pumpkin spice and cream and stir through nut pieces. Spoon one sixth of mixture into prepared tin and smooth over. Bake in centre of oven 40 - 45 minutes or until golden and firm. Serve warm.

title: Chipotle Tequila Salt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried sage | 4 teaspoons ground chipotle powder | 1 1/2 cups tequila, or as needed
instructions: Mix sage and chipotle powder together in a jar with a lid. Slowly pour tequila over the spice mix. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: lime,rice noodle,aluminum foil,bok choy,beef,red pepper,cooking wine
title: Aloha Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef ( depends on your personal tastes ) or 2 -3 lbs pork chops ( depends on your personal tastes ) | 6 -8 cups bok choy ( about 1/2 bag per person ) | 10 -15 dried rice noodles | 5 tablespoons cooking wine ( can find at any asian store ) | 6 -16 limes, cut into julienne ( can also substitute 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar to 1/2 lime, if your galangal is exceptionally fresh ) | red pepper, to taste | garlic foil
instructions: Slice beef or pork into thin strips, or you could just leave it as much as 1/4 or 1/2 inch wide. Pour cooking wine in a large straight sided pan or wok, and place over high heat. When your pan begins to smoke, add your shrimp, or any other meat you fancy. Stir fry the meat quickly and stir till the shrimp or the meat is cooked through. When they are cooked through, add the beef/garlic to the pan, and stir. Place 2 - 3 tbls. Chopped garlic into the pan. Add 1/3 cup bok choy, and stir with a large wooden spoon, mixing everything together lightly with the meat. Turn up the heat, stir to coat the bottom and sides of the pan with the bok choy, and cook till the ingredients seem to dry out, about 15 - 20 minutes, stirring every couple of minutes to keep everything from sticking or burning. Stir the meat and bok choy into the pan, and season with the red pepper. Stir to coat, and remove from heat. Serve at once or allow to cool slightly before serving. You can store any leftover pan juices in an air tight container at room temperature for up to 3 days. Enjoy.

title: Salsa Paste (From Vegetarian Times)
ingredients: 1 jar green chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons almond paste | 1 stalk celery root, peeled and finely diced | 3/4 cup loosely packed fresh basil leaves
instructions: Drain the chunky salsa of chunky salsa and blend with the almond paste. Add celery root and basil leaves and blend well. Store in a spice jar.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,yellow onion,mint leaf,balsamic vinegar,caster sugar,beef base,coconut cream
title: Minted Raspberry Beef Salad
ingredients: 500 g raspberries | 150 ml coconut cream | 180 g caster sugar | 1 teaspoon beef base | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 small yellow onion, finely diced | 1/4 cup of fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: Peal and hull raspberries.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,egg wrap,tamarind paste,macadamia nut
title: Macadamia Nut Rollups
ingredients: 1 can macadamia nuts | 1 - 1 1/2 cup italian salad dressing, to taste | 1 package egg roll wraps ( egg roll ) | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste ( or to taste )
instructions: Place macadamia nuts in blender with italian dressing. Process until mixture is mixed well. Place about 1/2 cup macadamia mixture on the very top edge of one egg roll wrapper, covering the entire top of wrapper. Place egg roll wrappers on a greased baking sheet, making sure they are not touching and place them on the baking sheets. Spread some of the remaining macadamia mixture over wrappers in a circle about 1/2 to 1/2 inch thick. Bake in a preheated 375 degree f oven for about 10 minutes or till golden. Roll up and serve right away.

title: BBQ Swiss Burgers
ingredients: 1 ripe peach, peeled and sliced | 1 swiss cheese, cut into 8 slices | 1/2 lb ground veal | 12 ounces prepared hummus
instructions: Remove peach and swiss cheese slice from plastic container, leaving one slice in container. Sprinkle veal slices with peach slice, then top with remaining swiss cheese slices. Place on medium high heat. Lightly brown cheese, then place on preheated grill or skillet. Close lid and allow to cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until cheese is melted. Place on buns or slice of baguette with lettuce and tomato, then top with hummus.

title: Lentils (Lebanese) - Non-Alkya
ingredients: 1 lb green lentil, picked over | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 medium green chile, chopped
instructions: Wash lentils. Put lentils into a large saucepan and add enough water to cover the lentils by about 2 inches. Place on stove, bring to low boil, and then cover, bring to a slow boil for 2 minutes. The lentils should be mushy, but still crisp. Drain in a colander. Remove excess water from saucepan, then place chili oil in skillet. Cook over medium heat 3 - 5 minutes, until oil is light and bubbly. Stir in the chile and cook 1 minute more, until it starts to brown. Stir in drained.

Random Ingredients: bread,monterey jack cheese,red wine vinegar,tuna,milk,mung bean sprout,barbecue sauce,orange extract
title: Cheesy Tuna Spread with Mung Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained | 1 cup mung bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried, crushed orange extract | 1 1/2 cups milk | 1/4 cup sliced mild bread, such as toasted or crumbled french bread, toasted | 6 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup sweet red wine vinegar | 1 dash milk | 1 dash red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the tuna with the mung bean sprouts, red wine vinegar, oregano and orange extract. Pour into an 11x3 inch baking dish, and bake for about 40 minutes, stirring every 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together the milk, bread and half of the cheese. Cut each slice of the toasted french bread into 4 thin slices. Arrange on serving plates, and top with the tuna mixture and remaining cheese slices. Whisk together the sauce ingredients, pour over the top, and serve.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,lemon juice,vanilla ice cream,chuck roast,catsup,guacamole,apple,fine breadcrumb
title: Apple & Roasted Jerk Salmon
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chuck roast | 1 - 1 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup unsalted dry breadcrumb ( i use progresso ) | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon apple powder ( try applejack for a delicious apple crust ) | 2 -3 teaspoons catsup ( try a-1 for a hotter flavor ) | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla ice cream
instructions: The night before, cut roast in half across the middle and pull out most of the bone. Cut a couple of slits all around the center of the roast, and place into slow cooker. Add enough water to cover the roast completely, cover and cook for 8 hours on low, or 3 hours on high. I usually leave the roast in the pot until the meat is nearly fork tender, then use two forks or slotted spoon to remove the meat from the slow cooker.

title: Copycat Mc Donald's Recipe for Tacos
ingredients: 4 cups shredded lettuce | 1 can catsup | 1/2 cup white flour | 1 dash cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine catsup, flour, and cayenne pepper. Put the lettuce and the mix in a large bowl. Add the catsup/flour mix to the lettuce and stir. Chill for 30 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Coffee Crabe
ingredients: 2 pounds cubed pork shoulder | 1 pound crabmeat | 1 head cauliflower, cored and cut into florets | 2 tablespoons ground coriander seed | 2 tablespoons coffee liqueur
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the pork in the boiling water, stirring to make sure the pork is crumbly. Season with salt and pepper. Add crab meat, cauliflower florets, coriander seed, and coffee liqueur, and cook until the cauliflower is tender, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,garden salad lettuce tomato onion bell pepper olive,parsley leaf
title: Greek Herbed Country-Style Whole Wheat Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour ( or whole wheat if available ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley leaves ( `` italian-style '' ) | 2 cups garden salad tomatoes, halved ( about 4 medium-ripe tomatoes, such as romaine or large red plum tomatoes ) ( optional ) | chopped fresh parsley leaves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Mix flour and parsley in large bowl. Add tomato halves and toss to distribute. Transfer half the bread to pizza pan or pizza stone and sprinkle with remaining bread. Bake until crust is brown and edges are crispy, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley just before serving.

title: French Consommé
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic, minced | 2 cans stewed fruit, drained | 1 envelope unflavored gelatin | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 1/2 pounds ground turkey breast
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large pot over medium heat, combine the garlic, stewed fruit, gelatin, and catsup. Cook until gelatine is dissolved, stirring constantly. Heat the turkey in a large skillet over medium high heat until evenly browned. Drain off excess grease and add to the simmering sauce. Bring to a simmer, and reduce heat to low. Simmer, covered, until the juice of the turkey cooks off and forms thick gravy, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,tarragon,ladyfinger,serrano pepper,saffron,baking powder
title: Sweet Chili Kisses
ingredients: 12 fresh ladyfingers | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon saffron, soaked in 2 tbsp. warm water for 15 minutes | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 serrano pepper, roasted
instructions: Brush fingers with oil and place on paper towels to dry. Toss with all remaining ingredients and place on rack in a broiler pan. Broil 12 minutes to brown slightly.

title: Spiced Espresso Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 tablespoons bacon grease, divided | 8 white mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 1/4 cup brewed espresso
instructions: In a large skillet, melt 3 tablespoons bacon grease over medium heat. Add mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: chive,mandarin orange,ginger root,rosemary,hawaiian bread,soy sauce,scallion,wheat spaghetti
title: Ww Core Chinese Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat spaghetti | 3/4 cup reduced sodium soy sauce | 1/4 cup chopped canned mandarin oranges or other orange-flavored liqueur | 1 tablespoon minced peeled fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon fresh minced chives | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh ginger root ( optional ) | 1 small scallion, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions, but do not overcook, stirring occasionally. Cool slightly, then transfer to a bowl. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, mix the soy sauce, mandarin oranges, ginger, chives, rosemary and ginger. Toss with cooked spaghetti until well coated. Garnish with chopped scallions.

Random Ingredients: rum extract,ginger garlic paste,plain flour,lamb shoulder,red chili pepper,white sugar,bite mozzarella cheese ball
title: Spiced Baked Lamb Lollies
ingredients: 16 ounces bite sized mozzarella cheese balls, sliced | 10 ounces plain flour | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 ounce red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 ounce rum extract | 2 ounces white sugar | 1/2 ounce preserved ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Mix the garlic and chilli with about 1 tsp water to make a paste. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Brush the outside of the ball of mozzarella with this paste and place on an oven proof dish. Put the flour, chili paste, sugar, and ginger garlic paste in a food processor and whiz until very fine. Tip all the contents of the food processor into the prepared dish and mix well. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until golden and crusty. Serve with fresh crusty bread. Store leftovers in the fridge.

title: Feta Cheese (Tulsi)  (Indian Cheese Feta) Spread
ingredients: 250 g feta | 500 ml cornstarch | 35 cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Blend the feta with the cornstarch until you have a smooth paste. Add the crushed cardamom pods and mix until the mixture is smooth. Serve with pita bread, toast, pitta bread, raita chips, veggies etc.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,cabbage leaf,chili sauce
title: Chinese Five-Spice Cabbage Rolls (Bo Bao)
ingredients: 1 medium cabbage leaf | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce
instructions: Fill a large pot with water. Wash cabbage leaves and cut off the stem end. Slice leaves into thin slices. Place cabbage rolls in the water and bring to slow rolling boil. When it reaches boiling, reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 45 minutes. Drain cabbage rolls and discard water inside cabbage rolls. Combine the five spice powder and sweet chili sauce in a small bowl. Place cabbage rolls into a serving bowl and pour on the spicy chili sauce.

title: Lori's Pork Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 3 lbs pork or 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 3/4 cup white onion, chopped | 2 medium zucchini, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup dried currants or 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup toasted peanuts, chopped | 1 cup mayonnaise or 1 cup miracle whip, well stirred | tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Shred meat from strips and arrange in layers over noodles, seasoning evenly. Combine chopped onion, zucchini, currants and nuts. Top salad with dressing and sprinkle with toasted peanuts.

Random Ingredients: spicy brown mustard,puff pastry,baby carrot,icing sugar,red enchilada sauce,broccoli floret
title: Enchilada Rolls
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup spicy brown mustard | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped broccoli floret, fresh | 1 tablespoon sliced baby carrots, baby-sized | 2 teaspoons icing sugar, for topping
instructions: Thaw puff pastry according to package directions. Preheat oven to 200°c line baking trays with parchment paper. In small bowl, stir enchilada sauce with brown mustard. Remove plastic wrap from pastry and roll dough out on a lightly floured surface to about 1/4 inch thick. Cut into rounds. Place rounds on prepared trays. Divide enchilada sauce among pastry rounds, then sprinkle with sugar. Sprinkle broccoli, baby carrots and icing sugar evenly over top. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until pastry is goldenbrown.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,superfine sugar,pepper,green peppercorn,topping,thyme sprig,chili oil,red pepper flake
title: Nana's Fresh "Salsa Verde (Mexican Sauce)
ingredients: 12 ounces tomatoes and green chilies, canned drained, chopped | 1/4 cup green peppercorn, freshly snipped | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon thyme sprig | 6 drops chili oil | 1/8 cup superfine sugar | 1/4 cup fresh hot pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, minced
instructions: In a blender or food processor, whirl all of the ingredients. Transfer to a small heavy skillet and heat over moderate heat, stirring until sugar is dissolved. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,pearl barley,hamburger bun sesame seed,tandoori paste,onion,red cabbage
title: Tandoori Barley Slaw
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1 large onion, coarsely chopped | 1 bunch red cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon roasted tandoori paste | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 tablespoons chopped onion, or as desired | 8 hamburger buns with sesame seeds
instructions: Place pearl barley in a large container, cover, and refrigerate overnight. The next day, rinse barley throughly with cold water.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,asparagus,dark sesame oil,hamburger bun,vegetarian bean,prawn
title: Sizzling Party Bites
ingredients: 3 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 100 g vegetarian refried beans | 1/2 cup cooked cooked prawns, cut into strips | 4 hamburger buns, split | 1/2 cup lettuce leaf, torn | 4 slices ham or 4 slices bacon, cooked until brown
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c, 356°f. Coat two of the burger buns with the sesame oil. Line each with the lettuce leaves then transfer them to a baking tray and spread both halves with the sesame oil. Place the prawns, prawns and bacon between the two slices of the buns. Top each with a spoonful of the refried beans and place the other top half of the bun over the top. Bake for 3 - 4 minutes or until golden and crisp.

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 can fat-free ricotta cheese | 1 cup catsup | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Mix ricotta, catsup and chili flakes. Spread on a 10 inch pizza pan or pizza stone in a single layer. Bake until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,italian tomato,lime juice,chunky salsa,salsa,godiva chocolate liqueur,crabmeat
title: Easy Chewy Momma's Crab and Chip Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lime juice | 3 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 can italian stewed tomatoes, drained | 1 jar large chunks chipotle peppers in adobo sauce with a good pinch of cumin | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro or 1/2 cup fresh parsley | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 lbs peeled crawfish- shells or 2 lbs cooked crabmeat
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the lime juice and chile salsa, stir in tomatoes and cooked chipsotle peppers. Stir in the cumin and cardamom and turn into an ovenproof dish that will fit into your crockpot. Cover and cook on low 10 - 12 hours. Add crawfish to dip, cover and continue cooking over low heat. You can serve the entire dish hot, warm or at room temperature. It tastes best the day after leaving the seafood inches. Serve with crackers or tortilla chips on the side.

Random Ingredients: onion,rye flour,lemon peel,quinoa,sole fillet,cheese,beef bouillon,marsala wine
title: Seafood Parcels
ingredients: 1 cup rice, uncooked | 1 cup sourdough rye flour | 400 g sole fillets, chopped | 1/2 cup onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons grated instant cheese | 4 teaspoons beef bouillon | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 1/2 cup grated raw cheese | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Combine cooked rice with flours in bowl. Combine fish, onion, 1tb bouillon marinade, and 1/4c water in a bowl. Stir into rice mixture. Roll mixture into 1 balls. Flatten each ball. Repeat with remaining fish mixture. Dredge each ball in cheese, 1tb juice, and 1/4c water. Heat a non stick frying pan and dry fry cheese balls on all sides. Keep warm.

Random Ingredients: green bean,vanilla bean,vegetable stock,anise seed,purpose flour,zucchini
title: Green Bean Soup With Zucchini
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup green beans, trimmed | 1/2 cup zucchini, cut in 1/3-inch dice | 1 small anise seed | 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon vanilla bean, scraped
instructions: Combine stock, beans, zucchini, and anise seeds in pot. Bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer until beans are tender, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 20 minutes.. Place flour in large bowl. Blend in enough hot stock to form soft paste. Stir paste into soup. Return mixture to pot. Stir in vanilla bean.

title: Shrimp and Beet Salad with Coconut Rum
ingredients: 3 large cooked shrimp ( peeled, cooked, drained ) | 24 shrimp ( about 24 large ) | 16 ounces beet, greens ( rinsed and sliced in 1/2-inch-thick half-wheat slices and about 1 1/2 cups ) or 16 ounces beet greens ( rinsed and sliced in 1/2-thick half-wheat slices and about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 lb raw peanuts ( rough chopped ) | 1 -2 tablespoon lemonade | 2 tablespoons coconut rum ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 24 sprigs watercress leaves
instructions: In small bowl, combine 3/4 cup of the coconut rum and 2 tablespoons watercress leaves. Mix well and pour over shrimp, beets and greens, tossing gently to coat. Add peanuts and lemonade, stirring gently to coat. If desired, add almond extract and remaining 1/4 cup coconut rum and blend until smooth. Cover and refridgerate until serving time. For topping, divide salad among four salad bowls.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,mint sauce,pecorino romano cheese,monterey jack cheese
title: The Perfect English Pepinad Pepiniera--Pepper Jack Cheese and Mint Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups shaved monterey jack cheese ( about 6 oz ) | 4 ounces grated pecorino romano cheese ( about 2 1/2 oz. each ) | 2 tablespoons crushed dried mint sauce | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar ( to taste )
instructions: To prepare the cheese, combine the cheese with the crushed mint sauce and sugar in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: cream cottage cheese,tomato green chilies,pimento,pepper jack cheese,tomato paste,vegemite,apple
title: Tomato Pimento Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream-style cottage cheese | 1 chopped peeled apple | 1 can condensed tomato paste | 1 pimento, chopped, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | pepperjack cheese, shredded | vegemite
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stir together the cottage cheese, chopped apple, tomato paste, pimento, tomatoes with green chilies, pepperjack cheese, and vegemite in a bowl until thoroughly combined.

title: Turmeric Dill Cream
ingredients: 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 4 tablespoons sesame seeds, roasted | 2 lemongrass, stalks, outer layers sliced ( white part only ) | cake flour
instructions: Place the sesame seeds in a small frying pan and toast on a medium low heat stirring frequently for 10 minutes until golden. Place the cooled sesame seeds in a blender, add the turmeric powder and puree until smooth, add the yogurt and blend on a medium speed or with a pinch of salt until it becomes a soft, smooth sauce texture. Divide the mixture between four small ramekins, sprinkle it with the sesame seeds and lemon grass, place them in a baking dish and put in a moderate oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until they begin to colour. Allow to cool and store in a cool, dry place.

title: Portuguese Sausage, Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs spiced portuguese sausages, skin on | 1 1/2 lbs meat, cut into chunks
instructions: Poke holes all over the sausages with a fork. Place into crockpot. Cook on low 5 - 6 hours. Sausages should be moist and tender.

title: Corn Tortilla (Corn) With Citrus Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina flour, made with 1 cup masa harina or 1 regular masa harina | 1 cup fresh orange rind | 3 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1 cup grated coconut, toasted | 4 scallions, sliced thin | 12 ears fresh sweet corn, husked and cut into 6-10 wedges | 1 lb linguine or 1 lb linguine
instructions: For the salsa,. Heat a large nonstick skillet. In the bowl of a food processor, puree 1 1/2 cups of the salsa with the rind, orange zest, coconut and scallions. Set aside. Using a mandoline, cut corn off of the cob and remove as much husk and juices as possible. Grill corn, over medium heat, for about 6 minutes each side, until blackened in spots.

title: Risotto Caramelized Caramelized Caramelized White Nuts with Palm Sugar
ingredients: 1/3 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup palm sugar, sifted | 2 packages saffron rice, well rinsed
instructions: In a double boiler, over low heat, mix the cream and palm sugar, and heat gently to just below boiling. Remove from heat. Pour 1/4 cup of caramelized sugar into a 9 x 13 baking dish. Place in refrigerator, and set aside until the caramel has hardened. Pour the remaining caramelized sugar into a large, heavy saucepan, and place over medium heat. Remove from heat and pour in the rice. Stir to coat the noodles evenly with caramel. Spread the noodles in the pan. Cover and refrigerate for about 2 hours. Remove the noodles from the refrigerator, and set aside until cool enough to handle. Cut into squares, and set aside until any remaining liquid has hardened and turned caramlized. Dip into the caramel, and set on candy rack until hardened.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,beef,mustard,chard leaf,cilantro leaf,red wine,onion powder
title: Mustard Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb steak, cut into bite size pieces | 1 bunch celtic greens or 1 bunch swiss chard leaf, chopped | 2 cups red wine | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 6 chicken tenders, cut in half
instructions: In a food processer, toss the ingredients with the greens or chard in a bowl.

title: Easy Easy Microwave Beef
ingredients: 1 lb steak, cubed | fresh ginger, peeled and cut into matchstick strips
instructions: Sprinkle the meat with ginger on all sides. Place in a microwavable dish and cook on high power for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,frying oil,lard,pizza crust,yellow cornmeal,fast rising yeast
title: Fried Pepperoni Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal ( not instant ) | 3 tablespoons lard, melted | 1 1/3 cups fast rising yeast | 1 tablespoon fast rising yeast | 1/4 cup lard, melted | 1 pizza crust sheet ( i prefer king arthur ) | 12 ounces pizza pepperoni ( sliced thin ) | 1/2 cup fritter oil ( extra virgin olive oil )
instructions: Heat a skillet to 375 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together the cornmeal, 2 tbs. Lard, 3 minutes active dry yeast, 1/4 cup lard, 1 pizza crust sheets, and 2 cups of the cooked flour from the skillet. Knead with the mixer until well blended and elastic. Dough will be smooth and will have about 3/4 of the sticky dough. Cut in 1/4 pieces and transfer to a oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside. Roll out dough on a floured surface. Spread the dough with 3/4 of the pepperoni slices. Roll the dough up to enclose the pepperoni, and arrange in a 9 - 12 inch pizza pan. Brush the top with 1/4 of the melted lard. Dough should be slightly moist. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled, about 55 - 60 minutes. Place pizza pan over a burner or in a 450 f. Oven. Reduce heat to 425 f. Continue to work the dough, adding the remaining flour as needed, to develop a sticky dough, about 15 minutes. The dough should have the consistency of a firm play dough. If necessary, spread more melted lard on top of the dough. Spread the tomato sauce over the pizza. Brush the top with lard, and continue brushing with the remaining 1/4 cup melted lard. Bake 25 minutes and let cool to warm in the oven, or until slightly puffy. Cut into 4 squares or 6 wedges. My note, i think this would be great with tomatoes, garlic and onion in it. It was a great meal for my husband along with that recipe, but you could easily make a pizza with it or use a sauce, pizza toppings etc and let them simmer in a saucepan, and just bake at 350 degrees until they're all fully cooked. They came out great. I loved the warm pepperoni slices this is a keeper for a weekend lunch with my new family and friends along with a little bit of garlic, onion, sour cream and fresh grated parmesan. I did not play with the yeast. I think the yeast is in the skillet with the flour, and the butter better than the other spices.

title: Green Chilies
ingredients: 2 cans chopped green chilies | 2 cups ice water
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender/blender and puree. Add more ice water to desired consistency.

title: Oatmeal
ingredients: 200 g finely crushed oats | 1/4 cup finely ground almonds or 1/4 cup finely chopped almonds | 2/3 cup icing sugar | 3/4 cup golden syrup or 3/4 cup maple syrup | 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce or 1 1/2 cups tomato puree | 2 tablespoons crushed kalamata olives or 2 tablespoons sliced black olives | 200 g finely chopped kalamata olives
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients with oats. Press mixture in a greased and floured 19 cm square or oblong tin. Mix tomato sauce with kalamata oil and pour evenly over the oatmeal. Put in fridge and leave overnight. In the morning, cut into squares with a sharp knife and spread on a pan of hot water and bake in slow oven for about 40 minutes turning frequently until golden brown. Dried tomato sauce, mix everything together and simmer on the lowest heat for about 20 minutes.

title: Easy Basic Basic Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 cans garbanzo beans ( or chick peas ) | 2 cans refried beans
instructions: Drain the beans, and rinse the peas, or the chick peas until fully dry. Place the beans and peas in a large 2 - 3 quart casserole dish. Heat the beans and peas to serving temperature by pouring about 1/2 cup hot water in the bottom of the dish. When the beans are hot and bubbling pour the beans into the refried beans. Turn on the heat setting and put the pan in a 225 degree oven, stirring every 5 - 8 minutes to mix the hot beans into the beans. When the beans are soft and most of the liquid has been absorbed take a large spatula and use to scoop up and mash the beans as the liquid in the dish dries out. The idea is to not mash too much too much. The bean mixture is more flavorful after it has been mashed. Let it cool for about 20 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Minted Seafood Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon brandy | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 teaspoon chopped of fresh mint | 1 lb fresh lobster meat ( or seafood mixed seafood ) | 3 ounces fish, fillet chopped
instructions: To make dressing, mix all the ingredients together in a jar and then shake well until well blended. Toss with seafood and top with freshly cut up vegetables. Serve with toasted bread of your choice.

title: Chile and Turnip Gratin
ingredients: 3 medium turnips, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch wedges | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon red curry paste, or more to taste | 3 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease and flour a 9x13 inch baking dish. Whisk turnip wedges, cocoa powder, and curry paste in a bowl to coat. Arrange turnip wedges in the prepared baking dish, overlapping slightly. Sprinkle with cheese and half the cilantro. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly brown, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp  Satay
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shrimp | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil ( or other neutral ) | 1 large vidalia onion, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, sliced | 2 tablespoons light cinnamon sugar
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp, if any, then leave the shells intact. Place the shrimp in a bowl, cover with a towel, and refrigerate for 5 to 10 minutes. Meanwhile, place a wok over high heat until a bead of water sizzles. Add 1 teaspoon of sunflower oil or other neutral oil. When it shimmers, add the onion slices and stir briefly, then spread them out in one layer on the oil. When they sizzle, add half of the shrimp along with any residual oil from the shrimp. Stir, cover, and continue to cook and stir for 3 - 5 minutes or until shrimp are pink and cooked. Remove shrimp from the wok, drain on a paper towel, then sprinkle with lemon grass. Serve immediately or cover for 30 minutes, or refrigerate overnight. Enjoy.

title: Fried Cauliflower with Almonds
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower | 6 tablespoons oil | chopped almonds
instructions: First of all, trim the cauliflower well. Place the cauliflower inside a large frying pan. Cover the pan with cold, and boiling water, and put it under a preheated grill to cook. Check on it after 10 minutes. You want the cauliflower to be a little softer, but still very firm. If it is still uncooperative, remove it from the heat, drain off any excess water, and cut it into small wedges. Once the cauliflower is nicely cooked, mix in the chopped almonds. Serve immediately.

title: Cider Broccoli, Apples, and Broccoli.
ingredients: 1 head broccoli | 2 apples ( i have never tried other kinds of apple )
instructions: Prepare, wash and trim broccoli, peeling it off the stem. Cut off the woody part of the stem, leaving 1/2 head and the rest of the stalk with the leaves. Steam the broccoli in the steaming basket above a pot of boiling water for 5 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and plunge into a bowl of ice water, drain and toss. Cool, then peel and chop the apple. I have tried other varieties, but these are the ones i have always found in the spice section of my local foods store. When serving, arrange on a platter and place a few slices of broccoli on top. Use the apple slices as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,red kidney bean,quinoa,pineapple,olive,baking potato,almond extract

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Combine all ingredients except the crushed fennel in a 2 quart baking dish. Press the fennel seed into the beans. Bake for 30 minutes, or until crisp and brown.

instructions: Rinse rice under running water.

instructions: Place bacon in deep pan.

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Spicy Ranch Cheese
ingredients: 1 package dry curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup spicy brown mustard | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds
instructions: In a bowl, mix all ingredients with a wire whisk until mixture is completely smooth and creamy.

ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs thinly sliced deli roast beef | 4 large baking potatoes, halved, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 1/2 lbs cubed peeled baking potatoes | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon dried cranberries | 1/2 cup guacamole | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Layer roast beef and potatoes in the bottom of a 12 x 8 inch baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over top of roast beef and potatoes. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Turn on oven to 425°f bake covered for 1 hour. Uncover and bake about 1 1/2 hours, stirring after 45 minutes, or until roast is browned and potatoes are crispy.

title: Quick Vegan Beans With Broccolini and Lime
ingredients: 1/2 bunch broccoli, cut into 3 inch florets | 1 can vegetarian refried beans, well stirred | 1 lime | 4 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Heat canola oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Stir fry broccoli for about 1 minute. Add refried beans. Squeeze lime into beans and cook until mixture is hot. Stir in fresh lime. Serve warm.

title: Port Wine and Rosemary Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rosemary, chopped | 1 1/2 cups port wine, or | 1 teaspoon rum | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Combine rosemary, port, rum, and cornflour in a saucepan. Stir until butter is distributed throughout.

ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can canned tomato paste | 4 tart apples, peeled, cored and sliced | 1 can frozen apple juice concentrate, thawed

instructions: Rinse inside and out and pat dry. Place on a rack on a hot grill, cut side down, and grill until just cooked through. Remove from the grill and allow to cool. Drizzle with orange juice and sprinkle with sugar and serve on individual salads.

title: Spicy Asparagus
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus, trimmed and cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces | 4 tablespoons dark asian sesame paste ( shao hsing ) | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice, about
instructions: Place asparagus in a large pot of boiling water. Cook 10 minutes, or till crisp tender, but firm to the bite. Drain and transfer to a bowl of ice water. Drain. Toss asparagus with the sesame paste, grand marnier, and lime juice. Cover and refrigerate about 3 hours or until the flavors develop.

title: Spaghetti With Lamb and Spiced Roasted Spaghetti Topping

Serve over hot buttered noodles.

title: Spinach With Oyster-Stir-Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 8 cups fresh spinach, cleaned | 1/2 cup vodka | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Wash the spinach well, and squeeze out excess water, then set aside. Cut into 2 inch lengths and set aside. In a wide wok, add the vodka, oyster sauce and sherry and bring to a boil. Add the spinach and cook for 5 minutes. Add the cooked spinach to the wok and toss everything through. Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl. Serve hot.

title: Cheesy Refried Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage | 2 small red chilies, seeded | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into cubes
instructions: Core cabbage. Discard the tough outer leaves. Cut cabbage into large bite size pieces. Place cheese cubes in a bowl and mash with a fork. Place the cabbage into a skillet over medium heat. Cover, stir occasionally, and steam until cabbage is limp and golden brown, about 15 minutes. Break up cheese pieces by pushing them between two paper towels. Spread some cheese on a large serving dish and layer cabbage on top.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Drain canned cannellini beans and sweet potato and place in a large bowl. Coarsely chop the remaining ingredients. title: Sweet and Savory Mango Chutney - Stove Top Filler
ingredients: 4 corn on the cob, husked | 4 mango chutney ( can omit, if required ) | 4 slices breadcrumbs ( or a thick slice ) | 2 tablespoons tea | 2 tablespoons fresh green beans, trimmed and halved lengthways
instructions: Place the corn kernels between two pieces of greaseproof paper on a baking sheet and cover with a plate, so that it doesn't dry out while cooking. Place a griddle pan on a medium heat, or on the barbecue.

instructions: Halve avocados and remove the pit. Place the halves in a large bowl. Using a sharp knife, roughly mash the avacados together. Stir the raisins into the avocado mixture, then pour dressing over the mixture. Sprinkle lightly with black pepper and serve.

title: Creamy Norwegian Honeyed Walnut Yogurt

instructions: Place walnuts, yogurt, ground cloves, and ground cinnamon in a blender. Blend until smooth. Serve chilled with pita chips.

instructions: Heat oven to 400°f spray 8x8 casserole dish with cooking spray. Place sausage in skillet and sear over medium heat, turning, until browned, about 5 minutes. Bake until just tender, about 8 minutes. Spread potatoes over sausage. Sprinkle potatoes with marjoram.

instructions: Preheat oven to 450°.

title: Thai Bok Choy Salad With Hominy

instructions: Using the flat of a large spoon, coarsely tear the leaves from the bok choy.

title: Shrimp Toast
ingredients: 20 -24 shrimp ( fresh, raw, shelled ) | 5 slices italian bread | 15 -36 fluid ounces dark rum
instructions: Heat rum in a frying pan over medium high heat.

title: Italian Shrimp on Shell

instructions: Cook shells according to directions. When shells are done, rinse in cold water, drain. Meanwhile combine catsup and quinoa in a small dutch oven and heat through, stirring. Add shrimp to sauce and simmer 5 - 10 minutes or until shrimp are pink and sauce has thickened a bit. Serve with a sprinkling of parmesan cheese.
