ingredients: 2 cups dried chickpeas, washed and drained | salt, to taste | 4 beef tenderloin steaks | 4 -8 portabella mushroom caps, with stems removed | 4 medium apples, cored and cut into chunks ( depending on size ) | 4 ounces blue cheese | 1 bunch green onion, trimmed
instructions: Soak the chickpeas in ample warm water for 30 to 45 minutes, then drain. In a large sauté pan or sauté pan set to high, warm 2 tablespoons butter over high heat, then add the beef tenderloin steaks and cook, turning once, until golden brown on all sides, about 10 minutes total, depending on thickness of meat. Remove from heat, then tent in foil. Keep warm. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter over high heat. Sauté the mushrooms and apples in the other 1 - 2 tablespoons butter until browned, 2 - 3 minutes. Add blue cheese and stir until melted. Slice the tenderloin steaks crosswise twice, about ½ inch thick. Place half of the tenderloin steaks in a baking dish large enough to hold them in one layer. Spoon the chickpeas over the steaks, then top with the mushrooms and apples. Top with the remaining steaks, tucking them underneath for a rustic look. Cover and bake in a 375 f oven for 40 minutes or longer if desired. Uncover and bake until tender, about 10 minutes longer. Meanwhile, warm the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat. Serve the tenderloin with the chunky blue cheese sauce.

title: Quickly Sausages (Using Soft Shell Method)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw sausages ( about 4 to 5 links per pound ) | 1/3 cup minced onion | 1/3 cup table salt
instructions: Prepare a gas or charcoal grill on your hot coals, with or without the burners. When the ash comes up close to all parts of the grill surface, put the sausages on the grill rack. Do not spray the cooking grate or you will have a little smoke from the sausage and nothing to cook with. Light your gas grill, making sure the fire is completely dry before turning the sausages. Turn the sausages often to ensure no splatters. When they reach desired doneness, remove from the grill and cut them in half lengthwise. Scoop out most of the meat and place them on a plate using a slotted spoon. Reserve the drippings if you would like to use for a soup or other sauce. While the sausages are cooking, place the onions and salt in a small frying pan over medium heat. Sauté for a couple of minutes. Stir in the onions and salt. Simmer gently for about 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,ketchup,pepper,pork sausage,mozzarella,pam cooking spray,pork belly,semolina
title: Pam's Easy, Yummy, Sweet, Yummy, Savory-Smoked Pork & Sausage With Semolina Crust
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork belly ( i used frozen pork, skin removed, left on ) | 1 ounce ketchup ( i used a bit of ketchup in mine, it really helped the consistency ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup whipping cream ( i use 1/3, i would use 1/2 if using skimmed milk, use half ) | 1 dash pepper | 4 slices mozzarella ( i used regular or part-skim mozzarella, i think any cheese would work ) or 4 slices provolone cheese ( i used regular or part-skim mozzarella, i used regular or part-skim mozzarella ) | pam cooking spray | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dry semolina, i used whole wheat | 1/2 - 3/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degress f. Slice the pork belly into bite size chunks. Spray pam with pam.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,date,beef stew meat,green chili pepper,polenta,chicken bouillon cube,kielbasa,applesauce
title: Indian Beef Bake
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, trimmed of fat | 1 medium green chili pepper, chopped | 1 chicken bouillon cube, with 1/2 cup water ( or equivalent water ) | 1 tablespoon applesauce | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried dates ( optional ) | 3/4 cup precooked polenta ( can use one tube, if desired ) | 1/2 cup kielbasa, chopped ( or other hot italian sausage )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Remove all except the kielbasa from the broth and reserve. Place in 9x13 baking dish. Cut kielbasa in half lengthwise, then cut crosswise for 1/2 large piece. Place the sliced kielbasa pieces on top of the kielbasa. Pour broth and enough water to cover meat by about 1. Place chicken in broth and add rest of ingredients. Put in oven. Stirring occasionally for about 1 hour or until meat is tender and the gravy thickend. Place the chopped kielbasa back on top of meat to absorb it. Sprinkle the drained dates on top and cook for an additional 15 to 20 minutes until the dates are browned.

title: Beer and Wine Dip
ingredients: 3/4 cup wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons beer
instructions: Stir together vinegar and beer. Refrigerate until flavors meld, at least 30 minutes.

title: Horseradish Rounds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shortening | 1 pound beef tenderloin, cut into slices | 1/3 cup salted pistachios, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish
instructions: Microwave shortening on high in a skillet until very very light brown. Remove to paper towel to absorb excess fat. Crumble beef into skillet.

title: Chocolate-Tofu Beef
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip steak | 2 -4 ounces kahlua | 8 -10 tiny red chilies
instructions: Cut steak into serving portions approximately 1 wide. Spread kahlua on each steak, roll up, and secure with skewers. Broil on high heat. Place skewers in oven and broil for about 12 - 15 minutes or until instant read thermometer reads 160°. Transfer steak to plate and brush with remaining kahlua and allow to rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Serve on plates and drizzle with chilies.

Random Ingredients: red bean,golden delicious apple,active yeast,baby carrot
title: Baby Carrots and Red Beans (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 1)
ingredients: 2 lbs small baby carrots, halved | 1 lb small red beans, trimmed | 2 golden delicious apples, peeled, cored and cut into slices and then cut into pieces
instructions: Put the carrots in a large stockpot with the beans, apple slices and enough cold water from the water to cover and bring to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat to medium and cook for 20 - 25 minutes until carrots start to soften but are still tender. Remove from the heat, cover and set the vegetables aside for 10 minutes, to allow flavours to meld. Then gently spoon into warm bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: sugar chocolate pudding mix,bay leaf,ginger paste,radish,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese 5 Spice Chocolate Mix
ingredients: 3 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 package sugar-free instant chocolate pudding mix | 1/4 cup radishes, peeled diced | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place ingredients except radishes, bay leaf and bay leaf in a mixing bowl. Mix until blended but still lumpy.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,wonton wrapper,chicken bouillon granule,serrano ham
title: Hungarian-Style Won Tons
ingredients: 12 won ton wrappers | 2 cups shredded chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup dry mustard powder | 1/2 cup finely chopped serrano ham
instructions: Moisten 1 piece of plastic wrap with water. Place approximately 2 tablespoons of the shredded chicken bouillon in the center of each won ton wrapper. Brush edges with water. Dredge 1 ham stick into the bouillon and pinch the ends closed. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Repeat with remaining wrappers and chicken bouillon. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pickling onion,pesto sauce,lettuce leaf,bean sprout,beef sirloin,sage leaf,cardamom seed
title: Beef Sirloin Saute
ingredients: 16 ounces top center-cut beef sirloin, trimmed and thinly sliced | 8 thin fresh sage leaves ( or 1/2 tsp. dried rubbed sage ) | 1 tablespoon chopped pickling onions | 1 package refrigerated roasted mixed beans sprouts | 1 ounce fresh pesto sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1 large lettuce leaf ( optional )
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add half the sliced beef, cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until browned and thinly sliced. Transfer beef to a cutting board and let stand 5 minutes, then slice thinly. Repeat with remaining 1/2 lb. Of beef. Remove sage and discard. Tear leaves from stems and coarsely chop. Mix bean sprouts, pesto, and cardamom seeds together. Heat a nonstick skillet with a lid over high heat. Add remaining sliced beef and cook, stirring frequently, for 2 to 3 minutes. Add bean sprouts mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, 3 to 4 minutes longer. Serve beef strips and sauce on the side. Note, if you're serving as a sandwich by itself, don't add the hot sauce, as the flavor and flavor will separate.

title: Portabella Mushrooms With Espresso
ingredients: 2 portabella mushrooms | 1 1/2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons hot brewed coffee
instructions: Wash and lightly dry the mushrooms. Cut off stems if desired. Cut the caps into slices 1/4 inch thick, and spread them out on a flat plate to dry. Sprinkle with the sugar, and put in a dry frying pan over the hot coffee to melt the sugar. Stir once, and cook the mushrooms until they begin to brown. Remove in a warm serving bowl, and sprinkle with more sugar.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,pepper ring,corn syrup,chili pepper flake,yellow pepper,bouillon cube,salsa
title: Mexican Pears With Vinegar
ingredients: 6 medium parsnips, peeled | 1 bouillon cube, such as knorr | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper rings, such as jake & amos | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/8 cup light corn syrup | 1/3 cup salsa | 2 teaspoons light corn syrup | 1/4 cup chopped yellow pepper
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut the parsley stalks into 1 1/2 inch chunks. Using a 2 to 4 quart heavy pot, combine the parsnips, bouillon, hot pepper rings, chili flakes, corn syrup, salsa, light light corn syrup and yellow pepper and toss to combine. Bring to a boil, turn the heat to low.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,cheddar cheese,adobo sauce,italian parsley,kaffir lime leaf,jumbo pasta shell,mint leaf,rump roast
title: Shredded Beef and Cheese Stuffed Pasta Shells
ingredients: 1 lb rump roast, cooked ( or any beef that has been shredded ) | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint leaves | 10 fresh kaffir lime leaves | 4 ounces italian cheddar cheese, shredded | adobo sauce, to taste | 1 lb jumbo pasta shells | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Toss beef with parsley, mint, and lime leaves. Place in large bowl. Add shredded cheese. Drizzle with adobo sauce. Spray 12 inch baking dish with a nonstick cooking spray. Spoon a few spoonfuls of beef mixture into shell cavities. Cover with foil. Bake 15 minutes. Remove foil, bake 5 minutes over medium heat. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: bread machine yeast,cardamom seed,parmigiano reggiano cheese,shaoxing rice wine,kalamata olive,vermicelli,strawberry,gorgonzola cheese
title: Pearl's Salad
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups bread machine yeast | 1/4 cup arugula extra virgin olive oil | 7 1/2 ounces gorgonzola cheese, broken into pieces | 7 1/2 ounces sliced kalamata olives | 1/4 cup shaoxing rice wine | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/4 cup unsalted kalamata olive, pitted and chopped | 3 -4 fresh strawberries, stemmed and sliced | 1/3 lb vermicelli
instructions: Place all ingredients into the bread machine in the order according to package instructions. When the bread is picked through, place into a large serving bowl, and stir to mix. If a bread machine did not make enough bread, use the bread machine's basic bread dough cycle.

title: Quick Hawaijito Bread
ingredients: 1 package cake flour | 1 tablespoon instant coffee powder | 1 tablespoon honey | 4 plum tomatoes, cut into thin wedges | 1 red serrano peppers or 1 yellow serrano pepper, cut into thin squares
instructions: Turn on oven to 425 degrees. Mix the flour, coffee powder and honey together in small bowl. Place tomato wedges on plate. Dip the sliced tomatoes in the flour mixture. Place the bread into baking dish, then cover with tomato wedges and serrano pepper squares.

title: Black Beans and Cheese
ingredients: 1 package muenster cheese | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed
instructions: In a large pot over medium high heat, combine the pepper jack cheese, black eyed peas and pepper jack cheese mixture. Mix well and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes, stirring regularly. Remove from heat, allow to sit for 10 to 15 minutes, and serve.

title: Salad with Olive, Prawn and Corn
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil | 4 medium ripe olives | 8 ounces salad greens | 1 small orange | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/3 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f or 200°c. Heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in a small pan. Remove from heat, add olives and gently fry for 1 minute. Place greens in a roasting tin, add remaining 1/2 teaspoon of oil and cover with a lid or a large piece of foil. Bake for 25 minutes or until tender. Carefully unwrap olives and peel off all the black skin and cut into thick wedges. Place on a platter and cut the orange into thin wedges. To serve, sprinkle orange strips over salad then drizzle with a little corn oil. Scatter wedges of olive over.

title: Peachy Apples
ingredients: 2 teaspoons apricot preserves or 2 teaspoons apricot preserves | 36 whole canned peaches, well rinsed
instructions: Using a fork, poke holes all over the peeled and sliced peaches. Insert equal amounts of preserves into each hole. Wrap in waxed paper and chill 24 hours. Serve with fresh fruit if desired.

title: Mango Chutney Couscous Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces israeli couscous | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons radishes, chopped
instructions: Cook couscous according to package directions and set aside. Warm a small skillet over medium heat. Fold in mango chutney, vinegar, and radishes. Serve warm.

title: Herbed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pint shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon dried shrimp or 1/2 teaspoon dried bay leaves | 2/3 teaspoon dried thyme | salt and pepper
instructions: Clean and thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a dish with other ingredients. Toss to coat evenly.

title: Spicy Roasted Red Pepper
ingredients: 1 cup sun dried tomatoes or 1 cup other dried diced tomato | 1 1/2 cups roasted red peppers and herb mix | 2 -3 teaspoons mixed italian herbs
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a glass baking dish. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Cool and serve.

title: Easy Mushroom Trio

instructions: Saute mushrooms and spices until done. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until heated.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine all ingredients and set aside 1 cup of mashed potato. Roll out remaining drained potato onto a floured board to less than 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into rounds using a 4 inch round cookie cutter. Place about 3 tablespoons of potato mixture onto each round. Fold the sides in towards the center then fold the dough over, making sure both sides are sealed. Place pierogis onto parchment lined baking sheet and spread each out evenly. Bake for approximately 10 - 15 minutes until golden brown. Watch carefully to avoid burning. Turn out onto wire rack to cool.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,bell pepper,kosher salt black pepper,egg yolk,graham cracker crumb,lima bean,quinoa
title: Baked Lima Bean and Quinoa Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 3 cups fresh lima beans, rinsed and drained | 2 large egg yolks, beaten until frothy | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs, or as needed | 1 bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups grated parmesan cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place quinoa in a large strainer and rinse with water.

Random Ingredients: coffee granule,sparerib,cannellini bean,simple syrup,garlic clove,orange bell pepper,feta cheese
title: Cannellini Beans and Grilled Country Ribs
ingredients: 1 cup dry cannellini beans, rinsed | 4 tablespoons coffee granules | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | 2 garlic cloves | 1 orange bell pepper, seeded and cut into 3/4-inch thick slices | 5 -6 lbs country-style spareribs, halved crosswise
instructions: Drain and rinse beans. Place beans in crockpot. Add beans, 1 tbsp of the brewed coffee and the syrup, garlic, pepper slices and the remaining cup of coffee.

title: Southern Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled and cubed | 2 slices white bread, cut to make 1/4 inch thick slices | 1/4 cup hot sauce, or to taste
instructions: Place potato in a large bowl with enough water to cover. Soak, covered, in the refrigerator for 24 hours, or until tender. Drain. Place sliced bread into a large skillet with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until lightly toasted. Stir in sliced hot sauce.

title: Beer with Green Beans
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs fresh green beans, topped and tailed | 1/2 cup dark beer
instructions: Place beans in a large pot of boiling water. Reduce heat and boil for 1 minute. Drain water from pot, reserving 1 1/2 cups of beans. Immediately rinse out pot. Overlap fresh beans on a serving platter. Pour beer from the kettle over them. Serve hot. The flavor is enhanced if it is served separately.

title: BBQ Veggie Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons barbeque sauce ( ketjap manis ) | 6 ounces rice, uncooked | 2 medium courgettes, halved lengthways and cut into 3cm lengths | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat barbeque sauce in a non stick pan over medium until hot. Add rice and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, or until all the water has been absorbed. Add courgettes and beans and cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes, or until rice is cooked.

title: Creamy Ricotta Skewers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 4 tablespoons whole milk ricotta cheese | 36 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: In a small bowl, blend dijon and milk cheese. Thread 1 bamboo skewer onto each skewer. Grill skewers 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium rare.

title: Chili and Chocolate Stuffed Chillies
ingredients: 3 red chili | 100 g chocolate, drinking chocolate | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon dried red chili | breadcrumbs, for coating
instructions: Cut chillies in half lengthways and roughly chop, then place in a saucepan of boiling water and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes then drain. Cool. Melt chocolates, mixed spice and red chillies in a bowl, stirring until melted.

title: Sopa De Ajo (Baked Shrimp in Jelly)
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 1/2 lbs baby shrimp | 2 ounces mexican-style tomatoes, canned, drained | 1 ounce advocaat ( advocaat ) | 1 tablespoon red food coloring
instructions: Slice baguette in half lengthwise and open to expose the pocket. Sprinkle shrimp with food coloring. Wrap baguette in foil to preserve moisture. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 15 minutes. Cut baguette diagonally into 1/4 inch slices. Place on serving platter and top with tomatoes, advocaat and red food coloring. Serve with crusty french bread and enjoy.

title: Microwave Warm Beef and Rice for Two
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 lb roast or 1 lb prime rib roast, trimmed fat | 2 cups uncooked long grain white rice
instructions: In a large, shallow 2 3/4 cup measuring cup, mix oil, vinegar and meat. Dip roast in vinegar mixture, allow excess to drain on paper towels. Add rice to bowl and microwave on high power until just beginning to bubble, about 3 minutes.

title: Zippy Prune Burgers
ingredients: 2 lbs prawns, shelled and cleaned | 2 tablespoons finely crumbed cheese | 1/2 cup dried prune | 1/2 teaspoon thyme
instructions: Chop prunes roughly, discarding pits. Dip prawns in cheese and then prunes. Grill until just cooked through and cheese has melted.

title: Green Curry Beef With Tarragon and Mascarpone
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef short ribs | 6 tablespoons green curry paste | 2 teaspoons peppercorns | 1/2 cup warm yoghurt | 2 packages mascarpone cheese | 2 tablespoons tarragon, chopped fresh
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Combine curry paste, peppercorns and warm yoghurt in a 1 or 4 quart baking dish large enough to enclose beef. Arrange beef in dish to marinate. Place dish in oven and bake for about 11 - 15 minutes, or until beef is just cooked through and dry. Place cheese and tarragon in a food processor and process until smooth. Using a slotted spoon, remove beef from dish and arrange in a decorative manner. Pour curry paste over beef. Bake for 25 minutes, or until sauce is just bubbling.

title: Pimiento Gravy for Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 can jar diced pimientos, drained ( pepitas ) | 2 teaspoons dried dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Combine flour and pimientos in a jar and shake to mix. Put in a bowl and stir in dill. Stir until well blended.

title: Tian (Chinese Sweet Spiced Apricot Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1 cup dried apricots | 1 tablespoon ground gingerroot | 1 tablespoon ground dried chili pepper flakes | 1 green onion, finely chopped
instructions: Place apricots in a small bowl, and cover with about 6 t water. Set aside for 2 - 3 hours. Drain, and rinse the apricots, reserving the liquid. Place the drained apricots back into the bowl, add the gingerroot, chili and green onion, mix well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,kosher salt,clove,corn syrup,portobello mushroom cap,green prawn,active yeast,vodka
title: Mushroom & Prawn Pies
ingredients: 1 cup light corn syrup, divided | 1 cup dry active yeast | 2 cups warm, divided | 8 ounces portobello mushroom caps, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 teaspoon whole cloves | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 cup green prawns, peeled, cooked, deveined, or 1 cup pink prawns, cleaned
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine 2 tablespoons corn syrup, yeast, and 1 1/2 cups warm water. Let sit for about 10 minutes or until frothy. Add remaining 1/3 cup of warm water. Stir until dissolved.

title: Cucumber Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 english seedless cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, thinly sliced | 1 bunch swiss chard, stemmed and torn in half, leaves washed | 2 -4 fresh serrano chilies, minced | 1 packet taco seasoning mix
instructions: Place cucumber slices in a bowl of ice water.

title: Smoked Salmon Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb fresh salmon, picked over | 1 lb hamburger | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro stems, and stems
instructions: Place salmon in a shallow baking dish. Using 2 dinner knives, split the salmon into 2 equal portions, discarding the bone and coarse ends. Place the salmon on the salmon and using 2 forks, mash and stir to break it into several chunks. The salmon should be easily incorporated with the meat juices. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate 1 to 2 hours in the refrigerator. Preheat the broiler. Lightly coat 1 small nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Heat the skillet over medium high heat and, when quite hot, add the salmon in 3 turns, being careful to keep the fillets inches. Cook for about 5 minutes over medium high heat, or until lightly browned all over. Cover and remove from the heat.

title: Chicken Dijon II
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cup bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Wash chicken breasts thoroughly and pat dry. Spray a baking dish with cooking spray. Place chicken into a large bowl. Mix bread crumbs into crumbs in a separate bowl. Dip chicken in bread crumbs until coated. Arrange on the prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear, 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | sea salt
instructions: Mix them together and enjoy they are a bit salty.

title: Arugula Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch arugula leaves | 2 tablespoons salsa | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest, grated
instructions: In a large salad bowl, toss together the arugula leaves and salsa. Cover.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,orange juice zest,chili flake,blueberry,cool whip topping,dijon mustard
title: Blueberry Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh blueberries | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons orange juice ( orange juice is a great option ) | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 pinch chili flakes | 1 container cool whip topping, thawed, room temperature | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Mix together first 6 ingredients. Add cool whip topping, spread out mixture evenly on a salad plate, sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Chill in refrigerator for at least two hours or until firm.

title: Quick & Easy Chicken and Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon ( or equivalent ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig | 2 sprigs fresh mint | 1 teaspoon rice | 2 spring onions, sliced
instructions: Warm the oven to 200c/fan 160c/gas put the chicken in a shallow baking dish with the thyme sprigs, spring onions and enough hot water to cover. Season to taste. Cover and bake for 35 minutes or until cooked through and tender.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,sun tomato oil,cider,wheat pastry flour,cream mushroom soup,tomato puree,san marzano tomato
title: Skinny Baked Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can tomato puree | 1 package sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 1 can tomato puree ( not heinz ) | 2 cans san marzano tomatoes, drained | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon, plus more for sprinkling | 4 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 2 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour, for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl mix the mushroom soup, tomato puree, sun dried tomatoes and tomato puree, 1 can of tomato puree, the sundried tomatoes and the cinnamon. Gradually whisk in the 2 1/2 cups of whole wheat pastry flour. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 1 hour. Meanwhile, transfer 1 cup of reserved paste mixture to a medium size saucepan and bring to a rolling boil. Gradually whisk the blended mixture into the saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Cool. Place saucepan with sauce into the freezer for another 15 minutes. Place a baking sheet of parchment paper on the back of a clean work surface and set aside. Divide 1 1/2 cups of the sauce in two smaller bowls. Drain the enchilada sauce in a colander, pressing on the softened pieces of excess liquid to extract all the liquid. Melt the extra virgin olive oil over a medium heat, then stir in your reserved paste mixture and cook over medium heat for two minutes, stir in the sauce, add the rest of the tomato puree and the chopped sun dried tomatoes and simmer for one minute. Sieve into a medium size bowl, season to taste with cinnamon, cover and refrigerate for a minimum of 1 hour to let flavors meld. After one hour, taste for seasoning and adjust. Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish and sprinkle with about 1/2 cup of shredded cheese and a drizzle of olive oil. Bake for 20 minutes, then turn the oven off. Let sit in for fifteen minutes, before serving. You will need to turn it back up to 400 degrees f and place a sheet of foil over it to help keep the steam inside. Let the enchilada sauce rest at room temperature while you make the rest of the enchilada.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,mayonnaise,chicken breast,monterey jack cheese,yogurt,basil
title: Grilled Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/4 lbs boneless chicken breasts, pounded thin | 1/4 cup reduced-fat sour cream | 1/4 cup low fat mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 8 slices monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat large non stick grill pan on medium high heat. Spray cooking spray over chicken and set aside. Combine sour cream, mayonnaise and basil in a small bowl.

title: Italian Steak Sandwich for Two
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin or 1 lb other round steak | 1 can refrigerated light original recipe garlic basil pesto | 4 teaspoons dried basil or 4 teaspoons oregano | 1 teaspoon dried basil or 1 teaspoon oregano | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil or 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 4 sheets of well-chilled softed white and white sandwich wrap, thawed if frozen
instructions: Trim any excess fat from steak. Cut steak across grain into thin slices. Combine pesto, basil, oregano and almond extract. Place steak on wax paper or foil lined cookie sheet, cover with pesto mixture and allow to marinate 5 minutes. Uncover meat and spread evenly with pesto mixture. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Preheat grill to low. Place wrapped steak on grill and grill for 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until desired doneness is reached. Serve with white sandwich roll.

title: Tibetan Fried Steak
ingredients: 500 g flank steak ( sirloin, rib eye, or any type of steak ) | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 2 teaspoons cooking wine | 4 green cardamoms, crushed | 1 cup frozen peas, defrosted
instructions: Place beef in a ziploc freezer bag, add xanthan gum, stir to coat. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Grill or fry meat 2 min per side. Remove from pan and keep warm. Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Stir fry cardamom for 30 seconds, add peas and stir fry 2 minute. Place drained beef on top, bring to boil. Cover and cook 3 min or until meat is tender.

title: Potato Chicken Legs in Lobster Sauce
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken drumsticks, washed | 4 potatoes | 3 chicken stock cubes | 2 tablespoons fat
instructions: Boil potatoes in water until tender then peel. Cut into 4 5cm cubes. In a large pan melt oil and fry chicken until golden brown. Add potatoes, chicken, stock cubes and stir well. Cook on medium heat until potatoes are soft.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,marinara sauce,blackberry,hot sauce,red grape,mango chutney,crabmeat,nutmeg
title: Spicy Crab Chutney with Mango Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups chicken broth | 1 cup chopped fresh mango chutney | 2 teaspoons ground nutmeg | hot sauce | 1 package imitation crabmeat, chopped into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup diced fresh tomato with jalapeno peppers, drained | 2 cups mixed red grapes, halved | 3 cups hot pickled blackberries | mango chutney ( optional )
instructions: Pour chicken broth into a medium saucepan.

title: Pesto Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato pesto | 2 lemons, zest of | 4 tablespoons sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Rub the chicken with lemon zest and pierce the cavity with a toothpick. Roast the chicken on a rack in the middle of the preheated oven for 45 minutes or until juices run clear when pricked with a fork. Cool before carving. When chicken is cool, remove all bones, and skin. You can prepare your own sun dried tomato pesto by warming some fresh basil or parsley, and using it to sprinkle over chicken when ready.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,cilantro leaf,farfalle pasta,white flour,chunky peanut butter,grenadine
title: Garrafria - Spanish Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon white flour | 1 pinch cayenne | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 dash grenadine | 1 small bunch cilantro leaf | 1 3/4 cups fresh farfalle pasta, cooked
instructions: Combine all ingredients with pasta and mix well.

Random Ingredients: black bean,heavy cream,vanilla pudding mix,onion flake,cider vinegar,salmon fillet,poblano chile
title: Salmon Pone and Bean Creme Brulee
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, grilled, peeled, seeded and diced | 4 ounces frozen smoked salmon fillets, thawed & cut into 1/4-inch thick slices | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup onion flakes | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Cook poblano peppers over medium heat in a skillet sprayed with cooking spray, about 3 minutes. Drain peppers and set aside. Preheat broiler. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine pudding mix, cream, onion flakes and vinegar in a small mixing bowl and set aside. Cut poblano peppers into 1/4 inch strips. Arrange peppers, 1/4 cup each black beans and onion flakes along the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with salmon, then drizzle with pudding mixture. Top with remaining pepper strips. Cover and place under broiler until beginning to turn brown, about 3 - 5 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Parsley
ingredients: 3/4 lb parsley ( leaves and stems ) | 5 -7 teaspoons black peppercorns
instructions: Rinse the parsley under cold water. If using dried parsley, cut off the parsley stems and place in a large bowl. Add 5 - 7 teaspoons of black peppercorns. Cover with clean water and let stand for 2 or 3 hours. To serve, rinse well with cool water. The remaining liquid must drain well. Place in a gravy boat or bowl with the remaining black peppercorns. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Frozen Peaches
ingredients: 10 frozen peaches, thawed | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to in a small non stick skillet, combine all ingredients.

title: Punchy Yellow Squash (India)
ingredients: 1 yellow squash ( yellow pumpkin ) | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, grated | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Cut off tops from the squash and remove the peel, seeds and membrane. Cut the squash in half again. Squash should not be too thin or they will burst open while baking. Place cut side down on aluminum foil on medium heat with about 1/4 inch of water and sprinkle with ginger. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until slightly mushy and tender. Cool for 5 minutes, and then spoon out and discard any seeds, and set aside. Place in a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Return to the pan and add remaining ingredients, mix, and remove from heat. Put aside 1 cup to make sandwiches while baking. Dribble a bit of sesame seed oil over the squash when you serve it.

title: Zucchini Blossom Macaroni
ingredients: 4 cups cooked macaroni ( uncooked ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 container frozen zucchini blossoms, defrosted ( or regular zucchini cut up ) | 8 -10 dates, finely chopped
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain well and add soup, zucchini and dates to macaroni. Mix well and turn noodles into 2 rows on the pan. Cover and turn every now and then. Bake at 350 degree oven about 25 - 30 minutes until bubbly on top and tender.

title: Quick Mustard Green Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch mustard greens | 1/2 cup mustard greens, chilled
instructions: Prepare a bowl type salad dressing by heating the mustard greens in a microwave, or you may use a salad dressing jar. It should have the texture of a slightly runny dressing. Remove the mustard greens from refrigerator, unwrap the leaves and cut off the hard center of the stems until the green leaves are free of any hard fiber tissue. Cut the leaves lengthwise. Place the mustard greens in a bowl and pour the prepared mustard green dressing in. Scatter the mustard greens over the salad just before serving.

Random Ingredients: pizza dough,lamb,extra beef,corn muffin mix,mango,dijon mustard,beef broth
title: Lamb and Mango Cobbler
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground lamb | 1/2 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 cup beef broth | 2 ounces instant pizza dough | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 ounce mangoes or 1 ounce other tropical fruit, halved and sliced | 4 ounces corn muffin mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 10 inch saute pan with cooking spray. In a skillet, brown lamb and beef, breaking the meat up as it cooks. Drain excess fat. Combine beef broth and rice wine mixture in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Let boil for 1 minute. Using a large spoon, remove and discard any rice wine mixture that has accumulated on the bottom of the pan. To the liquid in the pan, add onion, and saute until soft. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, spray a 9x9 loaf pan with cooking spray. Combine remaining ingredients in a medium bowl until well incorporated. Spoon about 1/4 cup meat mixture on top of the pizza dough in the loaf pan. Top with remaining meat mixture. Cover with foil. Bake for 40 - 45 minutes, until top is golden brown and crust is beginning to pull away from the sides. Let cool for 5 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Beef Frikadeller (Frikadeller) With Bananas - Diwali Eka Kulova(Mild Beef Stew)
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef, cut in cubes | 1 banana ( peeled and sliced ) | 1 lemon wedge | 3 paprika chili flakes, crushed | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 4 potatoes
instructions: Fry the peeled and sliced banana in the oil. Add chili powder and salt, and fry for another 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from fire and set aside. When ready to serve, arrange the meat on a plate and layer with the fried banana and lemon wedge. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,dark sesame oil,baking potato,cake,cream cheese,white vinegar,bagel
title: Cannoli Tortilla Cake
ingredients: 1 lb cake, 1/2-inch dice | 2 cups cake, 1/2-inch dice | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/8 cup vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon baking potato, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Pour oil into 9x13 pan that has been coated with baking spray. Line with a large sheet of foil and place on top rack of oven. Spray foil with cooking spray. Bake at 450°f for 18 - 22 minutes. Cool to room temperature. While cakes have cooled, mix sesame oil and cream cheese together. Combine cake with sesame oil and cream cheese mixture in a bowl. In another bowl combine vinegar with vanilla sugar, grated potato and baking soda. Toss the potato with the vinegar mixture. Spread a large mound on a work surface. Place in oven to bake for 20 - 25 minutes until lightly brown and crusty and toothpick comes out clean. Let cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Lemon Fish Thermidor
ingredients: 3 sheets frozen lemonade | 75 g sliced leeks | 2 sprigs leeks, trimmed | 2 tablespoons double cream | 2 -4 tablespoons double cream or 2 -4 tablespoons cream, to serve | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 large bell pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Cut 4 sheets of reynolds wrap heavy duty aluminium foil about 15cm in diameter. Use 2 sheets if you have extra space on your hands. Divide spinach and lemonade equally between 2 sheets of reynolds wrap. Divide sliced leeks between sheets. Divide cream between 2 sheets of reynolds wrap, to create 4 equal measures. Lay strips across leeks in a lattice pattern, allowing enough space between strips to allow for spreading of cream. Place a small spoonful of lemon juice along edges of leeks to seal, making a 'boat.'<NEXT_INSTR> Make the whipped topping, in a bowl, using an electric mixer, beat all the ingredients together until blended. Pour the creme fraiche mixture into a greased shallow, shallow dish. Sprinkle the chopped bell pepper over the top.. Chill for up to 1 hour. Slide foil over top of pan and cook in a hot oven until base is golden brown and crisp.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,rice wine vinegar,salt black pepper,kaffir lime leaf,pearl barley,glace cherry,cannellini bean
title: Barley Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 cup plain flour | 300 g pearl barley | 400 g cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 7 kaffir lime leaves | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 handful glace cherries | salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place your flour in the bottom of your soup pot and whisk until mixed inches then gradually add the stock, adding water until you have a nice consistency. Add your barley and rest of indrirections and rice wine vinegar as well as juice from kaffir lime leaves. Simmer over hot fire for approx 10 to 20 minutes until soup has thickened slightly and barley is tender. Taste and adjust seasoning to your liking. Remove from fire and garnish with cherries and sliced kaffir lime leaves. Enjoy.

title: Italian Lettuce - Giada De Laurentiis
ingredients: 3 lbs romaine lettuce, separated | 6 fluid ounces hot espresso coffee, room temperature | 1/4 cup real amaretto ( almond liqueur ) | 3 cups commercial espresso coffee | 1/2 cup bacon drippings or 1/2 cup olive oil, as needed | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Rinse together the romaine lettuce and drain. Cut the lettuce in half crosswise. Remove the hard center vein and discard or save for future use. Place the lettuce leaves in a single layer on a cutting board. Cut a cross on top of the lettuce. Spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the espresso into the outermost portion of a salad bowl. Dip the lettuce in the espresso and arrange in layers. Repeat with another couple of lettuce leaves. In the middle of the salad bowl, place the remaining espresso and amaretto. Top with the remaining lettuce and pour equal portions of the espresso amaretto and amaretto over. Garnish with bacon drippings.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,buttermilk,balsamic vinegar,part ricotta cheese,chicken breast tender
title: Weight Watchers Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 3 tablespoons low-fat buttermilk | 3 tablespoons fresh grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/3 cup shredded part skim-skim mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon low-fat buttermilk | 1/2 lb cooked chicken breast tenders, thawed if frozen
instructions: Combine 3 tbsp buttermilk, 1/3 cup cheese, balsamic vinegar, and the remaining 3 tbsp of cheese in shallow dish. Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,yellow cherry tomato,butternut squash,cilantro,part ricotta cheese,shallot,white onion,salt black pepper
title: Warm Butternut Squash, Cherry Tomatoes and Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash, halved, seeded, peeled, and cut into cubes ( about 8 cups ) | 1 white onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro | 1 teaspoon salt and freshly ground black pepper, or to taste | 1 can reduced-sodium chicken breast halves, rinsed and patted dry, sliced into 1/4-inch-thick slices | 5 yellow cherry tomatoes, quartered | 1 container part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 shallot, chopped
instructions: Place butternut squash cubes and onion in a 3 quart saucepan.

title: Hot and Creamy Italian Slaw
ingredients: 3/4 cup sour cream ( can use low fat, fat free, cream of mushroom ) | 1 can cream of herb soup | 1 1/2 cups shredded red cabbage
instructions: Mix sour cream, soup, and cabbage together until well mixed and coated. Spoon into a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Cover with plastic wrap, and chill for at least one hour or up to overnight until serving.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,pepper sauce,cinnamon sugar,beer,white wine vinegar,cashew
title: Potted Cashew Beer
ingredients: 8 ounces guiness ale or 8 ounces porterhouse-style beer | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon salt | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup cinnamon sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup cashews, chopped to bits
instructions: Pour guiness into medium bowl. Stir vinegar, salt, pepper sauce, and cinnamon sugar, until sugar dissolves. Add the beer. Add nuts, stirring lightly. Cover and refrigerate until chilled. Store in fridge for up to 2 days.

title: Okra
ingredients: 1 ounce frozen okra, thawed | 2 1/2 cups flour, approximately
instructions: Drain the okra, if frozen, and cut off any excess. Lightly flour each piece of okra and put aside. In a medium sized bowl, combine the flour and 3 tablespoons vegetable oil, mix to form a paste. Add okra and mix. Do not add any oil. Divide into 8 equal portions and gently place between damp cloths or wax paper. Wrap with plastic wrap and put into the refrigerator for at least 10 minutes to chill completely. Heat oven to 400°f. Place the flour and okra pieces in a single layer on a parchment lined 15x10x1 inch baking sheet. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: chili paste garlic,brown rice,cumin seed,sea salt,bread
title: Simple & tasty Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, washed | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1 fresh chili paste with garlic ( use a garlic press if you can have it ) | 3 teaspoons sea salt | 8 slices bread ( toasted is best )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c/350f/gas add all of the ingredients to your rice in a baking tray and toss to combine and season to your liking. Place into the oven on top shelf and cook until tender. About 15 minutes depending on your oven, remove from oven and break bread into chunks. Serve warm and enjoy.

title: Crock Pot French Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 large onions, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons golden syrup or 4 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 cans beef broth | 1 can vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat crock pot on low. Sprinkle sliced onions on top of the onions. Add the golden syrup or maple syrup. Pour broth on top. Cook for 6 - 8 hours or high 3 hours. Just before serving, stir in vegetable broth.

title: Easy Veggies with Onion Confit and Radish
ingredients: 2 bunches radishes, trimmed | 1 purple onion, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Tear roots off of radishes, and toss them into a bowl with onion. Toss lightly until onion is limp. Serve warm.

title: Italian Fish Stew
ingredients: 1 cup canned vegetable juice | 1 package bacon, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 8 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, cut into wedges | 1 can or bottle white wine
instructions: Heat vegetable juice in a dutch oven or large pot over medium high heat until hot, 1 to 2 minutes. Add bacon.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,swiss cheese,mini chocolate chip,lamb,herb,beet,teriyaki marinade sauce
title: Lamb Burgers With Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs ground lamb | 1 cup cucumber, chopped | 1/4 cup mixed fresh herbs, chopped ( like flat-leaf parsley, chives ) | 4 slices swiss cheese | 1 cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, seeded | herb marinade and teriyaki sauce ( i like keens bar aide or zesty beef teriyaki marinade and tomato sauce ) | mini chocolate chip, for dipping
instructions: Combine lamb and cucumber in a mixing bowl. In a separate bowl, combine herbs and cheese. Divide mixture into 4 patties. Preheat grill to medium high heat. Brush both sides with marinade and grill for 4 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking. Serve on lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,vegetable oil,sherry wine vinegar,half cream,corn oil,broth,whipping cream
title: Quick, Easy, and Delicious French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 12 corn tortillas, cut in half | 2 bunches broth | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine vinegar | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Heat oil in a sauté pan over low heat. Place tortilla halves face down on a pan. Cook until just limp and beginning to turn golden, stirring constantly. Transfer tortillas to a platter with tongs. Cover with foil. Heat broiler on high. Place tortillas on broiler pan, and cook about 5 minutes, until beginning to brown. Remove tortillas when limp, and drain on paper towels. Sauté onions in oil 2 or 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Turn heat down slightly, and add sherry and half and half. Heat slowly, stirring constantly, until the soup just begins to bubble. Add cream, stir, and remove from heat. Spoon soup into bowls, and garnish with tortilla strips.

title: Sicilian Carne Asada
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/2 cup coconut, shredded | 1/2 cup frozen tea | 1 orange, juice of | 2 - 2 1/2 lbs roast, from freezer ( from can )
instructions: In a small skillet toast cumin seeds over low heat until they begin to smell. Watch them carefully, and do not burn. If they start to brown, place cumin in small bowl or dish towel to drain off excess oil. When cool, break apart until no large pieces remaining. Crush the cumin seeds with your fingers and stir into the coconut, set aside to cool. For the roast, line the bottom with parchment paper. When the tortillas are long enough, use a sharp knife to cut across the thickest part of the bone and remove bone. Pull the strings, then slice crosswise into 1 or 2 slices. Repeat with second piece of roast to trim further. Use scissors to cut into slices. Pour the orange juice into a large dish with a tight fitting lid. Put the roast in the dish, cover, and let marinate in the refrigerator about 8 hours, or until you're ready to cook. You can keep the marinated meat overnight, or you can keep it in your fridge for 1 week. The meat can be frozen also. Just be sure that it's covered by the marinade. Place the frozen pieces into a paper bag, seal, and let them sit on the counter. After the meat has rested long enough, preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place roast in a roasting pan in an oven with the marinade, and add the lid, cook, turning often, for about 2 hours or until very tender and meat is nicely browned.

title: Apple Cheese (Giant and Delicious)
ingredients: 2 apples, cored and thinly sliced | 150 g blue cheese, crumbled | 2 teaspoons coriander powder
instructions: Heat the oil, cook apples slowly until almost all the moisture has evaporated, stir in the cheese and coriander. Mix thoroughly. Cook uncovered over low heat.

title: Spicy Cereal Candy
ingredients: 1 package stevia powder | 1/2 cup cereal ( any flavor ) | 1/2 teaspoon star anise
instructions: In a small pot boil your 3 milers until it reaches 180 degrees celsius. Take off heat and stir in the rest of the ingredients. Cool to luke & pour into greased and covered pan. Let cool overnight. Slice into fingers or a crescent roll.

title: Confetti Seasoning (Italian Peppers)
ingredients: 1/3 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup red bell pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Combine sugar and bell pepper in a small bowl. Place in a medium size, dark plastic bag. Shake to combine. Place bag in refrigerator for 15 to 30 minutes. Remove pepper mixture from bag. Scoop out the seeds and membrane. Discard any remaining. Place pepper mixture in a plastic bag and set aside. Close bag and shake to coat. Grill on medium high heat until caramelized, approximately 8 to 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mirin,red chilies,white sugar,cream celery soup,cornstarch,ketchup,cucumber,coconut milk
title: Panda Express' Version of Chuka's Yakisoba Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup | 1 can coconut milk | 1/4 cup ketchup | 4 -5 chopped fresh red chilies ( such as california or new mexico ) | 2 tablespoons white sugar, to your taste | 1 tablespoon mirin, or ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 cucumber, peeled and sliced
instructions: Boil the water for the yakisoba sauce. Mix sugar and ketchup in a 1 qt saucepan over medium heat. Do not allow the sugar to change color, or it will burn. Add the chilies, vinegar, and mirin to the sugar mixture. Cook and stir until the red chilies have popped and are slightly darkened in color. Mix cornstarch, and stir into the sauce, bring to a boil to thicken. Simmer until sauce is very thick. Add cream of celery soup, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and mix in the chopped cucumber while still hot.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,red cabbage,texas toast bread,heavy whipping cream,cream celery soup,anchovy fillet
title: Italian Shrimp Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 can cream of celery soup | 1/2 lb red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 6 slices texas toast thick bread | 1 can anchovy fillets, drained well, drained, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Heat soup, cabbage and cream in a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until hot but not boiling.

Random Ingredients: miso,pepper sauce,baking powder,wonton wrapper,pork loin chop
title: Won Ton Wraps
ingredients: 12 wonton wrappers | 1/3 cup finely cut boneless pork loin chop | 1/3 cup prepared miso | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Place the wonton wrappers on a work surface. Using a pastry brush, paint each wrapper with oil. Place 1/6 of the pork chops in the middle of each wrapper. Dip the wonton wrapper in the miso and press firmly, leaving about 1/2 inch space all around. Fold the triangle over and crimp the edge. Repeat with remaining wonton wrappers. Place the wontons on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Brush the tops of the tortillas with more oil. Bake in a 375 degree f oven for 12 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp. Drain on paper towels and keep warm. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,white mushroom,horseradish,safflower oil,tomato green chilies,herb
title: Red Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 large white mushrooms, roughly chopped ( flats ) | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained ( flats ) | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 tablespoon safflower oil | 1 tablespoon chopped mixed herbs ( parsley, dill, coriander, etc., any combination of these ) | 1 teaspoon red food coloring
instructions: Place all ingredients except the optional ingredients, in a small frying pan and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes until they are just soft and sauce is thick and creamy. You don't have to add any water or oil.

title: Taco Bell Mexican Vanilla
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco sauce
instructions: Take the taco seasoning and mix with the taco sauce. Pour into a microwave safe bowl. Microwave for a few seconds, or until the taco sauce has melted. Serve with whatever you like.

title: Lori's Baked Orzo Salad
ingredients: 8 cups mixed salad greens ( romaine, bibbere, or your prettiest mixed greens. ) | 1 cup sweet green bell pepper, diced | 12 cherry tomatoes ( quartered ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely chopped leeks ( white part only, sliced or minced ) | 2 ounces orzo pasta, cooked according to directions | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. Line a 15x10x1 baking pan with aluminum foil. Toss the orzo with 2 tablespoons of the fish sauce and chopped dill. Place 1/2 cup salad greens in each of 12 salad bowls. Arrange the bell peppers, scallions, and tomatoes on top of the mixed greens. Pour 1 tablespoon in each bowl.

title: Italian Peppers on Toast for Two
ingredients: 2 peppers, sliced thinly ( jarred recommended ) | pepperoni, sliced thinly ( use sliced pepperoni pepperoni in the can )
instructions: Toast the pepperoni slices in a toaster oven for two minutes. Slice into thin rounds. Layer pepperoni and pepperoni in a small bowl.

title: Italian Ribs for a Crowd
ingredients: 4 lbs country-style boneless ribs | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: In a large slow cooker, place ribs. Sprinkle herbs over top. Sprinkle with remaining seasonings. Cover. Cook on low 8 - 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,sea salt,kidney bean,sage leaf,cayenne,tahini sauce,shiitake mushroom
title: Mushroom Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaf ( chopped or sliced ) | 1 cup creme fraiche or 1 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon tahini sauce ( sesame-seed paste mixed with a splash of olive oil ) | 1 cup shiitake mushroom, thinly sliced ( i've used dried mushrooms so i've found them in the ethnic aisle at the store ) | sea salt ( to taste, my apologies, oh, to be honest. go ahead, shitake mushrooms. they look pretty in a pinch, but if they're salted, soak them in a little bit of ice water ) | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed, saving a little of the juice ( can use black beans ) | 1 pinch cayenne ( to taste )
instructions: In a small bowl, with the sage, mix together the creme fraiche and tahini. Add mushrooms and the chopped sage/leaves and mix thoroughly, mixing. Heat refried beans in a skillet and sprinkle a little sea salt on the tops. I like this with a sprinkle of fresh cayenne.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,double cream,spring onion,purpose flour,yellow squash,chicken bouillon,red wine
title: Mashed Yellow Squash & Sweet Potato in Hot Wine Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg yellow squash, grated ( about 3 medium ) | 500 g sweet potatoes, grated ( about 3 medium ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 25 ml red wine | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon of chopped spring onion
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut squash and sweet potatoes into similar sizes and shape slightly smaller ones. Put flour, wine, vinegar, bouillon and onion in a large bowl and mix thoroughly. Add the squash and sweet potato to the flour, gently mix it around the bowl. Add water to just make a coating the mixture, you will not need to add water all the way, but it helps to coat everything evenly. Spray a large frying pan with oil spray and pour in the contents of the bowl of the mix, distributing the mixture evenly from the outside in circular motion. Cook in the hot oven for 30 - 40 minutes or until you smell the first aroma coming and feel slightly undercooked. Serve with a crusty bread if desired.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,beef brisket,cheddar cheese,bay leaf,thyme sprig,english pea
title: Cottage Pot Pub Style Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 sprig thyme sprig | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup frozen english pea ( thawed ) | 1 cup grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f in crockpot on top of high, combine the beef brisket and spices. Pour over cheese and stir. Cover and cook for 8 hours. Remove meat from crockpot, slice and serve on buns with gravy, vegetables or pickled vegetables.

title: Cashew Nuts & Fennel Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package cashew nuts ( ground finely ) | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried fennel ( crushed leaves ) | 1 teaspoon dried celery ( finely diced ) | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves ( chopped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix cashew nuts, greek seasoning, fennel and celery in a bowl. Add sour cream and mix well with hands. Pour mixture into a 1 quart baking dish sprayed with olive oil cooking spray. Sprinkle chopped parsley over the top. Bake for 30 minutes or until hot and well coated.

title: Tahini (For Passover)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons tahini, plus a little extra | chilies, to taste ( or to taste )
instructions: To make the chili paste combine the tahini and chili ingredients together and blend thoroughly with a fork or blender or food processor in a small thin stream, until smooth or creamy.

title: Chef John's Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 pound gruyere cheese, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning
instructions: Season the shredded gruyere cheese with taco seasoning, coating liberally on all sides. Let rest for 10 minutes before grilling and grilling. Heat an outdoor grill for medium high heat. When hot, lightly oil grate. Cook cheese slices on grill until melted, 2 to 4 minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,kosher salt,pam cooking spray,italian tomato,fine sea salt,oyster,red pepper flake
title: Easy Boiled Pork Chops and Onions
ingredients: 2 -8 pork chops | 3 tablespoons kosher salt or 3 tablespoons coarse sea salt | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1 can italian-style crushed tomatoes | pam cooking spray | 1/2 cup extra finely crushed oysters, shell and liquor will work as well | 1 teaspoon kosher salt or 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Slice pork chops into thick 1 inch pieces and sprinkle both sides with salt and the red pepper flakes. Place pork chops on a non stick or oiled baking pan in a single layer. Cover pan tightly with foil and bake in a 425°f oven approximately 15 minutes or until tender. Mix the crushed tomatoes with 1 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp each of crushed red pepper in a cup measuring cup. Stir mixture well, adding more crushed tomatoes as needed for consistency. Remove bread and vegetables from oven and pour 1/4 cup of liquid into tomatoes and stir to combine. Pour mixture evenly into a serving dish and top with the remaining crushed tomatoes and red pepper flakes. Wear pam in your hand to mix it into the liquid. Sprinkle top of pork chops with salt, remove foil and serve with pan juices.

title: Traditional Sausage & Sauce Recipe
ingredients: 4 lbs bulk pork sausage | 1 tablespoon mixed spice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Poke the sausages with a knife several times and brown all over. Serve over cooked rice, if desired.

title: Fax Seed Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower | 1 tablespoon coriander seeds ( coarsely ground flakes )
instructions: Snap off the floret about 1 wide by 4 long. Boil 1 1/2 cups of water. While the water is heating, dry fry the flax seeds, shaking the pan often, until dark in color and very fragrant about 10 minutes. Drain off the water and set aside to cool completely. Chop cauliflower into bite size pieces and place in a bowl. Add the coriander and the ground flax seeds and mix lightly. Add more water if required. Serve hot.

title: Tex Mex Cowboy Bowl
ingredients: 1 pound beef chuck, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1/2 cup pico de gallo | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 package frozen mixed turnips, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 cup fresh blueberries, divided | 1 package rice noodles, cooked
instructions: Place beef, pico de gallo, and cumin in a large bowl.

title: Crumble Corn
ingredients: 3 cups corn niblets | 4 teaspoons cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c or 350°f. Combine corn flour & cumin & mix until the lumps are gone. Grease a baking tray generously & line it with baking paper. Using a ladle, spoon the corn mixture into the tray & bake for 50 minutes. Serve with plain bread.

title: Vegan Noodle and Coconut Noodles (Sinangag)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coconut oil ( coconut cooking oil ) | 8 ounces soba noodles, cleaned and trimmed
instructions: In a skillet or wok, heat the coconut oil. Add the soba noodles and saute to desired doneness, about 2 minutes per side. Remove from skillet or wok. Pour coconut oil into the noodles, coating the noodles well.

title: Mexican Green Pesto
ingredients: 10 green chili ( canned mexican green peppers ) | 1 -2 tablespoon pine nuts
instructions: Cut the chilies in half lengthwise and remove the hard seeds of each half. Use a vegetable peeler to remove the white bit from the green chili and discard the seeds. Place the chilies in a bowl of a food processor and blend them for 10 to 20 seconds. Add the pine nuts, and process in the processor until they are finely chopped and well combined. Store in a sterilized jar in the refrigerator. Variation, when using canned green peppers for hot sauce, replace 1 tsp of green chili powder with 1 - 2 teaspoons of canned green bell pepper powder.

title: Rosemary Paste
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh rosemary sprig | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Place wine and rosemary sprigs in a small saucepan. Bring water to simmer in a double boiler over high heat. Reduce heat to low. Add sherry. Stir and simmer 5 minutes or until the wine is reduced by half. Remove rosemary from sauce and transfer to a small bowl. Press rosemary paste through a fine sieve into a bowl. Serve warm or cold.

title: Chow Down Cream of a Cold Lentil Soup
ingredients: 6 ounces cooked brown lentils ( or 1 lb fresh ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 10 -15 cashews | 1 teaspoon of chipotle powder
instructions: Fry cashews in olive oil, on medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring constantly. Turn down heat, add cream soup and chiles and simmer for 5 mintues, stirring frequently. Add cooked lentils and stir. Serve immediately, garnishing with some of the crispy cashews.

Random Ingredients: parsley,limeade concentrate,corn kernel,black bean,half,tortilla chip,beef brisket,tomato green chile pepper
title: Mexican Beef Brisket in Clay Pot
ingredients: 4 pounds beef brisket | 1 jar corn kernels, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans limeade concentrate, undiluted | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 package tortilla chips | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Place brisket in a 3 quart clay pot. Add corn, tomatoes, beans, limeade concentrate and half and half. Combine with hands to combine. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours. Remove brisket from clay pot. Discard marinade. Place seasoned brisket on a hot skillet. Cook, uncovered, until browned on all sides and cooked as desired. Reserving any cooking water, drain meat and serve on a platter with tortilla chips and chopped fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,garlic powder,spice,scotch bonnet pepper,french bread,yellow cornmeal,beet
title: Hot Pepper Soup
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 2 cups spiced whipping cream | 1/2 cup french bread, torn into small pieces | 2 cans large beets, chopped | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 5 pinches scotch bonnet peppers ( optional )
instructions: In a medium pot, melt cornmeal in cream. Add remaining ingredients and cook covered on medium for 45 minutes. Serve with sour cream and fresh fruit for dipping.

title: Brazilian Sprouts
ingredients: 3 cups fresh bean sprouts | vegetable broth, to cover | natural bran, to cover ( optional )
instructions: Place sprouts in a bowl. Sprinkle with bran. Pour enough hot broth over the sprouts to cover and soak for 15 minutes, adding more broth as needed to cover.

title: Crunchy Maple Peanut Dessert
ingredients: 250 g plain breadcrumbs | 80 g sugar | 250 g roasted peanuts, chopped | 250 g ladyfingers | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | maple syrup
instructions: Mix breadcrumbs, sugar and nuts. Dip in the maple syrup. Line a greased cake tin with half of the syrup. Arrange 2 of the ladyfingers on the syrup, covering the entire base. Repeat with the rest of the syrup. Sprinkle over the nut mixture. Place the remaining ladyfingers on top and press lightly down.

title: Cranberry  Scented Cake
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated lime rind | 1/2 teaspoon whole cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic salt | 3 tablespoons sultanas or 3 tablespoons raisins | 80 g caster sugar
instructions: Put the cranberries, rind, cardamom and garlic salt into a food processor and pulse till combined. Add the sugar and pulse again till the mix is smooth. Pour into greased 20cm loaf pan or cake tin. Cut slashes across the top with a sharp knife. Turn off the oven, but leave the cake in there for 8 to 10 hours. Remove from the oven, turn the oven down to 120 - 140 degrees celcius. Slice the cake into three thin pieces and return to the oven for a further 30 minutes. Remove from oven and leave for 10 minutes. Turn over the sultanas and leave until ready to serve.

title: Chicago Style Pork Gyros
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/3 cup warm butter | 3/4 cup warm pork loin | 6 slices dry white or wheat bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Sprinkle the yeast over 1/3 cup warm butter in a small bowl. Let stand 5 minutes, then mix in the yeast. Let stand 5 more minutes. Melt the remaining 2/3 cup of butter in a skillet. Add the pork loin. Cook, turning often until browned on all sides, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Spread the pork evenly with the melted butter. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until the internal temperature is 190 degrees f and the internal temperature has reached 145 degrees f. Insert a thermometer into the center of the loaf.

title: Rosemary French Toast With Oranges, Lemon, and Orange
ingredients: 8 large brown bread, slices crusts removed | water, to submerge bread ( about 2 cups ) | 2 lemons, zest of, chopped | 2 oranges, sliced | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 4 orange wedges, garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Cut 4 squares of foil large enough to hold four bread slices together. Place one of the squares of foil into a 15 x 30 pan, and generously spray with oil. Line each piece of foil with a piece of bread, and submerge it in oil. Place one another on top of the stacks of bread, then wrap the foil completely around each other into a packet shape, and place on top of the 4 squares of foil. Repeat with other pieces of bread and foil, placing the pieces of foil in a large pan large enough to leave room for the bread to bake. Bake until golden brown, about 45 minutes, depending on oven. While the french toast is baking, prepare the orange sauce. In small bowl, combine 1 tbls. Olive oil, the rosemary, and nutmeg. Pour sauce over french toast, and bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven, and top with a wedge of orange. Goes great with potato salad.

title: Simmered Veggie and Tortilla Noodle Wrap (Low Fat Version)
ingredients: 1 package dry spaghetti ( or 4 cups cooked rice ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 bunch bok choy ( or 2 bunches ) | 1/4 cup canned coffee ( coffee tastes best ) | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herbs, to your taste ( i used mrs. dash mix of herb blend ) | 3/4 cup fresh mushrooms ( sliced, i used 3-8 small ) | 16 fat free egg-free corn tortillas
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions. In a pan, heat canola oil on medium. Add bok choy and heat for about two minutes. Add italian herbs, coffee, and mushrooms to pan. Cook for one minute. Set aside to cool to room temperature. Place tortillas evenly in a large skillet to roll. Serve in a tortilla bowl and top with mixture. Fold up and place on a plate to serve.

title: Salmon Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon ( boned and skinned ) | 1/2 cup mirin ( or sweet rice wine )
instructions: Combine the fish and marinade in a skillet. Cook on medium heat until the fish is cooked through and the liquid is reduced and reduced. Let cool for a few minutes serve over cooked steamed greens as an hors d'oeuvre.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,pork loin chop,corn tortilla chip,tomato juice,coconut rum
title: Smoky Pork Chops
ingredients: 8 medium boneless pork loin chops, 1 inch thick | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 4 1/2 tablespoons aged balsamic vinegar | 2 1/2 teaspoons coconut rum | 2 ounces corn tortilla chips
instructions: In a bowl, combine tomato juice, vinegar, rum and chips. Whisk until well combined and then pour over chops. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or up to 1 day. Grill over medium hot coals for 10 minutes per side or till meat reaches desired doneness. Cut into thin slices.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,king prawn,sourdough bread,sherry wine,meat,currant,lasagna noodle,chocolate syrup
title: Prawn and Bowtie Lasagne
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna noodle | 1/4 lb ground meat | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons other white wine | 4 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1/4 cup currants or 1/4 cup fresh cranberries | 16 toothpicks dried meat, soaked in hot water for 10 minutes | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup | cooked lasagna noodles, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Arrange bread slices, flat, on baking sheets.

Random Ingredients: vodka,cornstarch,celery salt,rye bread,jumbo shrimp,mustard seed,peppercorn,mint leaf
title: Baked Shrimp in Polish vodka
ingredients: 24 jumbo shrimp, shelled | 12 slices rye bread, cut 1/4 inch thick | 12 -15 sprigs mint leaves | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons celery salt or 2 tablespoons coarse salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons peppercorns
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. To prepare shrimp, place shrimp in a ziplock bad. Add 1 tbsp vodka, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 2 tbsp celery salt, and 1/2 tsp peppercorns. Mix till coated with marinade. Place on rack in a shallow baking pan. Bake 15 - 20 min or until tender. Remove from oven and shake shrimp pieces around in marinade for 5 - 10 min each side just to keep from turning brown.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,mandarin orange,kaffir lime leaf,shiitake mushroom,grill seasoning
title: Grilled Japanese Leaf Rolls
ingredients: 1 package kaffir lime leaves | 12 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 2 tablespoons grill seasoning or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 12 thin slices grilled sandwich-style sesame-fried shallots | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill weed or 1/2 cup cilantro
instructions: Prepare grill seasoning according to package directions. Wrap each kaffir lime leaf around a shiitake mushroom and sprinkle with grill seasoning. Grill approximately 3 minutes, on each side, or until golden brown and tender. Remove mushrooms from grill, and roll up. Wrap each sausage with a sesame fried shallot and a few dill weed leaves. Enjoy.

title: Peach-Chocolate Bites
ingredients: 8 ounces ice-cold peaches | 1 tablespoon icing sugar
instructions: Place ice cold peaches in a freezer bag, and freeze for 20 minutes. Remove peach from freezer bag. With a paring knife, scrape the frozen peaches into a bowl, and cut a slit lengthwise down the center of each peach. Carefully insert small sharp tip of knife into cut hole at the bottom of each peach to remove pit. Return peach halves to freezer for 20 minutes to soften. Remove peach pits with scooped out peaches. Stir icing sugar, and drizzle over each peach. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Easy Raspberry Pork Roll Ups
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs boneless pork shoulder, fat trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 3/4 cup fresh raspberry vinegar or 3/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/3 cup parsley vinegar or 1/3 cup chives, chopped | 24 sheets lasagna noodles, cooked
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Spray 9x13 pan lightly with non stick cooking spray. In large bowl, combine pork cubes and 2 3/4 cups of the raspberry vinegar or wine vinegar. Mix well. Spoon 1 teaspoon of pork mixture down center of each noodle, fold over ends. Place in prepared pan and place in oven. Bake 30 - 40 minute or until pork is tender, stirring every 5 minutes during the last 20 minute of baking. Sauce will thicken and may be slightly thickened. Serve with remaining 1 1/2 cups raspberry vinegar or other wine vinegar mixture.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,dark sesame oil,cream chicken soup,chinese five spice powder,cracker crumb,canola oil,heavy whipping cream
title: Creamy Sesame Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 package frozen sour cream, thawed | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons chinese five-spice powder | 1 1/2 cups finely crushed cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium size baking dish. In a large bowl combine sour cream, soup, grand marnier, sesame oil, and five spice powder. Combine well. Add thawed chicken and 1/2 of cracker crumbs to the sour cream and soup mixture. Blend well. Spread mixture evenly over the baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cracker crumbs. Cover dish with foil. Bake at 375 degrees f for 35 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,leek,chocolate,chicken bouillon cube,o'brien potato,potato starch,bok choy,semolina
title: Chicken Chocolate Potato Pancakes
ingredients: 1 medium potato, diced | 1 small potato, diced | 1/8 green capsicum, finely chopped | 1 leaf bok choy, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon leeks or 1 tablespoon green onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon o'brien frozen potato starch | 1 tablespoon chocolate, grated | chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon potato starch | 1 teaspoon leek or 1 teaspoon leeks, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon chocolate, grated
instructions: Gently fry the potato, potato and capsicum until the potato is soft. Add the chopped ngely chopped onion and continue to fry until the vegetables are all softened. Dissolve the bouillon cube in 1tb water and add it to the saucepan slowly, and continue to stir,.. When the chicken and potato mixture is cooked through, remove from the heat and allow to cool. Transfer to a bowl. Mix in the grated chocolate. Add the blended potato mix and mix well. Allow to chill until possible use for use later in sauces or other dishes. Serve with green salad.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,jalapeno chile,chunk chicken,anaheim chilies,baby carrot,jalapeno pepper
title: Chunky Chicken Mole
ingredients: 1 can sliced anaheim chilies, drained | 2 canned jalapeno chiles, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs thawed baby carrots | 1 1/2 lbs whole roasted whole poblano chiles, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 lbs frozen whole unpeeled fresh jalapeno peppers, thawed | 1 can chunk chicken, drained
instructions: In a 3 1/2 or 4 quart slow cooker, combine anaheim chiles, jalapeno peppers, carrots, and chiles. Arrange remaining ingredients in a single layer. Pour contents of can over contents. Cover and cook on low heat setting about 6 hours and 30 minutes, or until chicken is tender.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke flavoring,orange blossom water,pork loin chop,lemon grass,couscous,egg substitute,black mushroom,pork tenderloin
title: Pork Souvlaki Kebabs With Citrus Pork
ingredients: 3 -4 lemons grass | 3 -4 tablespoons finely chopped fresh lemon grass | 1 small dried orange blossoms or 1 small orange marmalade ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup egg substitute | 3 1/2 boneless pork loin chops or 3 1/2 pork tenderloin, cut into cubes | 2 tablespoons dried black mushrooms, soaked until soft, then cut into small pieces | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 1/2 cups couscous | pork sausage or other meatballs, cooked, sliced into pieces
instructions: Wash lemongrass well and cut into one inch size pieces, or you can add the citrus parts to a food processor. Dice 3 or 4 lemongrass sticks and add to a bowl with the dried orange blossoms and lemon grass. Mix well, then add egg substitute. Add the pork pieces and continue to mix. Add mushrooms and liquid smoke. Cover and refrigerate for about 1 hour. To serve, heat a large skillet over medium high heat, then add meatballs or meatballs and brown on all sides. Transfer meatballs and/or meat to a platter and serve over rice.

title: Green Beans Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 1 package frozen green beans | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cook the frozen green beans in boiling water for about 3 minutes, then remove and drain. Break the nori sheets in half lenghtwise and cut into 4 equal pieces. Cut each of the four pieces lengthwise into thirds, then into 1 inch pieces. Lay the nori sheets out flat and shiny. Place 2 frozen green beans in each sheet. Top with 2 pieces of nori. Roll up each piece, and continue rolling, until the fillings are used up. Cut each roll into 5 to 6 strips. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Lamb or Beef with Apricot Sauce
ingredients: 250 g boneless lamb or 250 g beef, cut into thin strips | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, chopped | 1 tablespoon sweet chili oil | 1/2 tablespoon sweet soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon paprika | 1/8 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/3 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 cup milk
instructions: Heat the oil and saute the beef until browned. Add the ginger and chili oil and cook until beef is cooked. Add soy sweet chili sauce, paprika and mixed spice. When the meat is tender, add apricot preserves and milk. Mix well and cook another 5 minutes on a higher heat until preserves melted.

title: Spicy Sesame Seeds!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of roasted sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon of hot sauce, like tabasco ( or tabasco )
instructions: Spray a bowl with oil and set aside. Combine the above ingredients in a small bowl. Use within 3 days of making.

title: Spinach and Lime Skewers
ingredients: 24 bamboo skewers | 1 1/2 cups baby spinach leaves | 12 slices french bread, halved | 1/4 cup lime juice | 8 slices mixed fruit
instructions: Soak the skewers in water for 8 minutes per side. Preheat grill to high. Grill the skewers on the prepared grid using the prescribed grill distance. Brine, 1 1/2 inches from heat. Cover and cook 1 1/4 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,green chile pepper,tamari,palm sugar,vanilla pudding mix,manicotti,cream coconut,orange peel
title: Sweet and Sour Manicotti
