ingredients: 1 package dry matcha dried mini sweet potato-stuffed manicotti | 1/2 cup cream of coconut | 5 green chile peppers, cored and diced | 3/4 cup diced palm sugar | 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix | 1/4 cup tamari | 1/4 cup grated fresh orange peel | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the matcha dry sweet potato paste, coating the entire package of stuffed manicotti. Return to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until the manicotti are tender, about 30 minutes. Drain and allow to cool for a minute or two before zapping across the dish. Once cool, slice open each manicotti tube almost all the way down the center to make a cup with the open end facing you and scoop out the stuffing with a spoon. Stuff the opening with the reserved sweet potato paste. Place a drained manicotti cup onto a clean flat surface, and spread about 1/2 teaspoonful cream of coconut into the center of the manicotti. Top the cream of coconut with some diced green chile peppers, diced palm sugar, and diced orange peel.

title: Bread Machine Mediterranean Seasoned Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 18 bell peppers | 1 yellow pepper | 1/2 bell pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1/2 teaspoon dried yeast
instructions: Wash the peppers, remove stems and seeds and place peppers in a 3 x 8 deep baking dish. Scoop out the pepper seeds with a teaspoon. Combine all ingredients. Sprinkle with more salt and pepper if needed. Place in your bread machine on the rapid baking setting. When all ingredients are ready, transfer to a 2 - 3 lb loaf pan and let rise until doubled, about 35 - 40 minutes. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 - 50 minutes, until the top is light brown. Serve warm.

title: Roasted Red-Chile Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup slivered almonds | 1/2 red chile pepper - stems, seeds, and veins removed | 1 1/2 lbs boneless chuck roast | 1 fresh red chile pepper, seeded and halved
instructions: Sprinkle almonds with the chile pepper and toss. Spread the mixture on the roast, and place in a covered roasting pan. Cover, and roast in a preheated 475f oven for 5 hours, or until the roast is tender. Place the roast on a cutting board, and slice into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange slices on a platter. Place 2 or 3 whole red chile peppers in a small bowl, and toss the peppers with the sliced beef.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,clove,beef rib,rum extract,cumin,stewing beef,bow tie pasta,flour tortilla
title: Guinness Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef | 1 1/2 cups bows tie pasta, broken into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/4 lbs beef rib eye steaks | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 tablespoon rum extract | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 cup grand marnier ( liqueur )
instructions: Cut beef into very thin slices. Soak both pieces in rum extract.

Random Ingredients: shallot,oil,coconut oil,white balsamic vinegar,almond,red wine vinegar,tamarind juice
title: Tamarind and Shallot Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamarind juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 -2 teaspoon white balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons coconut oil | 1/4 lb shallot | oil ( for frying ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Combine the tamarind juices, red wine vinegar, vinegar and coconut oil, and whisk until well blended. Set aside. Peel shallot, then cut into 1/4 inch slices, set aside. Using a frying pan or flat bladed knife, fry the shallots, about 4 minutes in all, turning until golden brown. While the shallots are frying, add 1/2 cup water to saucepan, boil 1/4 cup water and add to shallots with almonds.

title: Rhubarb Salad With Sesame Oil
ingredients: 125 g rhubarb, rinsed of juice and coarsely chopped | 125 g caster sugar or 125 g turbinado sugar | 1 head boston lettuce, washed, dried and shredded | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Place rhubarb and caster sugar in a pan and cook over a low heat for about 2 minutes. Bring to the boil, then remove from the heat and allow to cool for 20 minutes. Add the lettuce and cook over a low heat until heated through, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, pour the sesame oil into a large bowl. Using a wooden spoon, mix the cooled sugar and rhubarb into the dressing. Serve warm.

title: Yogurt and Cardamom Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons marinara sauce, homemade or 2 tablespoons commercial marinara sauce, homemade
instructions: Slightly toast the cardamom seeds in a small skillet, shaking the pan occasionally, or a few seconds before popping the seeds into the yogurt. Cool the seeds to form a little poky powder, and set aside. In a large nonstick pan, heat the marinara sauce over medium high heat. When it begins to simmer, stir in the cardamom and yogurt and simmer about 5 minutes. The cardamom flavor of the yogurt will deepen as it cools. Add the marinara and simmer another 5 minutes or so, stirring a few times, until the mixture is creamy smooth. The longer it cooks, the stronger the flavor of the yogurt will become.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,black pepper,buttermilk,self rising flour,marjoram,bread,chocolate milk,vanilla pudding
title: Creamy Chocolate Herb Cake
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 1/4 cup plain dried bread ( white or whole or whole wheat ) | 2 tablespoons chocolate milk ( optional ) | 2 packages instant vanilla pudding | 1/4 teaspoon marjoram ( fresh herb ) ( optional ) | 3/4 teaspoon basil leaves ( fresh herb, not dried ) ( optional ) | fresh ground black pepper | 1 cup buttermilk ( not skim )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease and flour a 9 by 13 inch pan. Sift together dry ingredients in a large bowl, then whisk in milk slowly until well blended. Fold in dried herbs. Pour into prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes or until tester inserted in centre comes out clean. Cool cake in pan for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool completely. Whip buttermilk until very thick. Spread half over cake, then sprinkle evenly with marjoram if using. Chill until serving time. Note, this can be made several days in advance, then reheated in a microwave for 15 minutes.

title: Noodle Chicken
ingredients: 500 g egg noodles ( fresh ) | 375 g chicken thighs | 2 cm piece gingerroot, diced | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 3 teaspoons mirin
instructions: Put chicken, ginger, and spices into a large bowl, and pour in 3 tsp of mirin. Marinate a few hours, refrigerate then cook the noodles until fully cooked, drain and serve over noodles.

title: Butternut Squash and Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 cup butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cubed | 1 cup queso fresco, crumbled | 5 cups chicken stock or 5 cups broth
instructions: Combine the cubed squash, crumbled queso fresco and soup. Bring to a boil over medium heat for a few minutes, remove from heat and let sit until most of liquid has evaporated, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green olive,italian sausage,broth,puff pastry,sirloin steak,vegetable oil cooking spray,okra
title: Beef and Italian Sausage Pies
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk sweet italian sausage | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 lb frozen okra, thawed, rinsed | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 cup sliced green olives | 1 can fat-free low-sodium broth, undiluted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Remove casings from sausage, place on paper towels to drain, & pat dry. Coat a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Place okra in a microwave safe bowl & cook with cover on high 4 minutes, or until tender crisp, stirring once or twice. Stir in cooked sausage and set aside. Place puff pastry into a large resealable plastic bag. Add okra mixture, olives, & a 1/4 cup broth. Shake to combine. Place another pastry bag on top.

title: Thai Barley and Barley Instant Shake
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 8 ounces frozen pearl barley | 1/2 cup skim-milk plain yogurt | 7 ounces chicken broth | 1/2 cup water | crushed ice
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together barley, yogurt, and chicken broth. Pour blended ingredients into a microwavable container, and bring to simmer in the microwave. Stir occasionally while boiling to thaw. When ready to serve, stir in crushed ice, and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,rice wine,parmesan cheese,horseradish,lemon juice,dijon mustard
title: Roasted Italian Herbs and Rice Wine Barbecue-Bake
ingredients: 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 2 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons finely grated lemons, juice of | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herbs, crushed
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in shallow baking dish, drizzle with some of the remaining oil.

title: Baked Beef Mussels
ingredients: 1 can beef broth ( regular beef broth can be used ) | 4 mussels, cleaned and debearded ( use your favorite recipe ) | 1 package liverwurst, sliced ( you can use any style that's up to you. i tried it. ) | crushed ice
instructions: Layer all ingredients in a shallow baking dish, starting and ending with the cheese. Cover and bake at 350f for 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and slightly browned on top. Serve with bread pieces for dipping.

title: Baked Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 pound littleneck clams in shell, scrubbed | 2 slices orange, zested | 1 loaf frozen bread dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a kettle of water to boil. Cook clams in boiling water just until tender, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Anko Manis (Sweet Chocolate Balls)
ingredients: 100 g dark chocolate, melted | 500 g sultanas, finely chopped
instructions: Put melted chocolate in a bowl and add the sultanas. Roll into small small balls, or you can roll them up like an oat. Allow to set a few minutes then eat.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,sugar,feta cheese,shallot,celery root,baby spinach
title: Wash Greek Salad
ingredients: 1 bag fresh baby spinach, cleaned | 1 bag fresh baby arugula or 4 cups baby arugula | 1 large shallots or 1 medium sweet onion, sliced thin | 1 stalk celery root, thinly sliced | 1/2 package herbes de provence | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 8 ounces feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Wash, steam, and dry spinach according to package directions. Remove to a bowl and cover with foil to keep cool. To spinach add to spinach and all remaining ingredients. Sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese before serving.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,baking potato,chili pepper flake,chili oil,rice wine vinegar,enchilada sauce,thyme sprig,baby red potato
title: Spicy Red Potato Hummus
ingredients: 3 -4 red potatoes, unpeeled | 1 dash dried chili pepper flakes | 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons chili oil | 2 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 bag baby red potatoes | 1 can enchilada sauce, warmed | 1/4 cup chopped mint leaf
instructions: Slice potatoes lengthwise and place in a lightly oiled baking dish. Sprinkle with chili flakes and bake at 400° f for about an hour. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Then peel potatoes and place in a bowl. Dress with some of the rice wine vinegar, chili oil, thyme and stir. Add the potatoes and toss lightly until well coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour or longer, stirring occasionally. Spread out the enchilada sauce. Spoon potatoes in a 9x13 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Spread out potatoes on top of the sauce. Add warm enchilada sauce on top and sprinkle with mint. Serve immediately. Serve more chili sauce on the side.

title: Peppered Beef for Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 lbs ground chuck | 2 cans sliced peaches
instructions: Brown chuck, adding sliced peaches to crockpot. Top with chopped onions, sprinkly with salt and pepper. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours or on high 5 - 6 hours. Great served on italian rolls.

title: Simple Sausage Noodles
ingredients: 10 ounces rice noodles | 2/3 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch pieces if possible | oyster sauce
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Cover noodles with cold water.

title: Cheese-Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 beefsteak tomatoes | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh gingerroot | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/4 cup monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon minced fresh parsley | 2 teaspoons honey | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, minced | 1/2 cup blueberries
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut a 1/2 inch deep slit down the side of each tomato. Stuff each with 1 tsp of ginger and 1 tsp of the butter. Place tomatoes open side up in a non stick skillet with a drizzle of butter. Broil until nicely browned, 4 - 6 minutes. Remove from skillet and drain on paper towels. Stir the cheese, parsley, honey and 1 tsp of fresh minced parsley into the cheese mixture. Remove the tomatoes from the oven and spread on the cheese mixture on top. Return the topside on the tomatoes. Broil and garnish with the remaining minced parsley.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,oil,cayenne,bacon,white flour,triple sec,fajita seasoning mix,tamari
title: Fajita Triangles(ATK)
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, chopped fine ( use lean bacon, not fatty ) | 1 1/4 cups white flour | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 2 teaspoons fajita seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 2 teaspoons tamari | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 can alfajita seasoning mix | 1/4 cup tamari
instructions: Sauté 1/4 cup of the bacon in a large skillet until crisp. Remove and drain on paper towels. In the same skillet, fry 2 slices of the bacon until crisp again, remove and drain on paper towels. Set aside. In a bowl, stir flour with triple sec, fajita seasoning mix, cayenne and tamari. Stir into the skillet with the bacon and saute until thickened. Turn off heat. Add in the rest of the ingredients and stir until combined. Roll into balls with the palms of your hands dipped in egg white. Place the balls onto a non stick cookie sheet. Bake in a preheated oven 375 degrees for 5 or 6 minutes until lightly browned. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: moisture part mozzarella cheese,gouda cheese,sake,ice cream,spanish onion,tomato,red pepper,asafoetida powder
title: Tomato and Cheese Asafetida
ingredients: 1 small spanish onion ( julienned ) | 1 red pepper ( julienned ) | 1 tomatoes ( julienned ) | 1 teaspoon roasted asafoetida powder ( also called masala powder ) | 2 ounces mozzarella cheese ( grated ) | 1 ounce gouda cheese ( grated ) | 2 ounces smoked gouda cheese ( grated ) | 1/3 cup ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Place asafoetida in microwave. Microwave on high for 1 minute and stir. Stir every minute for about 10 minutes to prevent browning. Let cool and then stir in vegetables. When complete, add 1 cup grated mozzarella to the veggies and mix. Top with 1/2 tsp gouda cheese mixed into it. Cook in microwave for 20 - 30 secues or until cheese is melted.

title: Pommes Lyonnaise - Red Potato Salad
ingredients: 6 large red potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 cup orange peel, cut into thin strips | pepper
instructions: If using medium sized red potatoes trim off the skin, peel and cut in 1 1/2 to 1 inch chunks. Heat up some cooking oil in a big skillet or dutch oven. Add the potatoes and brown, adding peel by tablespoonfuls until they are cooked, then season with pepper at last. Serve as a side dish with french bread, pita chips and/or as a topping on lettuce.

title: Asparagus Dumplings
ingredients: 500 g fresh asparagus, sliced and steamed until tender | 1 cup self raising flour | 1 cup flour | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 -2 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add asparagus. Cook for 8 mins or till tender, stirring occasionally. Drain well. Return to boiling pot and keep warm. Place flour & cinnamon in a large bowl. Whisk in a 1/2 cup of warm water to blend. Pour flour mixture over asparagus, stirring so as not to mash and make a well in the centre. Add salt & sugar and gently mix well. Drop tablespoons of the mixture into the boiling water and cook for 7 - 8 mins or till they rise to the surface, floating. Remove when risen & drain well & serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: margarine,red kidney bean,curry paste,escarole,cardamom,chinese wine,rotel tomato
title: Curried Escarole and Beans - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs escarole | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry paste | 2 cans rotel tomatoes | 2 teaspoons chinese wine or 2 teaspoons other cooking wine | 1 can red kidney beans | 2 cardamom
instructions: Rinse escarole and drain well. In a large skillet cook enchalale in melted butter over medium low heat until wilted.. Transfer escarole to slow cooker. Add rotel, wine and red kidney beans to skillet, cover and cook on high for 3 - 4 hours or low for all day. Serve hot.

title: Hot Kiwi Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper seasoning | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and finely diced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl of a blender or food processor. Blend until well blended. Cover over high heat and allow to sit for 1 hour before serving. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Gruyere Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs grated gruyere cheese | 1 1/2 cups oyster sauce | 1 cup finely minced white onion
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Mixture should be soft, but not too wet.

title: Canadian Hash #1239 (Pinch of Canadian Bacon)
ingredients: 300 g stewing beef, cubed | 2 slices sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 200 g canadian bacon, rind removed
instructions: In a saucepan, over high heat, add canadian bacon. Saute for 3 minutes until bacon is crisp. Add stew meat, raise temperature to high and cook for 3 minutes. Add sun dried tomatoes. Stir in, cook for 3 more minutes, stirring the hash, until heated through.

title: Nigella Lawson Rigatoni With Sage & Almonds
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 bunch fresh sage leaf, torn | 3 tablespoons chopped almonds, toasted | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1/4 cup coriander leaves, to serve
instructions: Remove the hard centre pith around the root end of the sage leaves. Reserve the tough outer leaves. Boil the pasta and drain. Put the shredded sage and bicarb into a dry frying pan and toast with the almonds over a low heat for 5 minutes or until dark brown in colour. Remove, and stir through the coriander leaves. Serve the pasta and sage mixture on the same platter with the roasted almonds scattered over the top.

title: Sriracha Bread Snack
ingredients: 2 cups meal bread | 4 gherkins | 2 tablespoons sriracha chili-garlic sauce | 1 - 1 1/4 cup biscuit, crushed
instructions: Heat oven to 425ºf. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and set aside to dry the bread. Peel and cut up your gherkins into small pieces. Mix the sriracha and biscuit crumbs together and set aside. With your hands, mix the crumb mix together with the dry bread crumbs and set aside. Line the baking sheet with aluminum foil and put the bread mixture on the pan. Bake breads until dry, about 10 minutes if they start to brown at the edges. Serve immediately or put a piece of foil over them and eat to snack, or make into a sandwich of your favorite snack.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,toast,vegetable,jasmine rice,black pepper,chipotle chile,red potato,yukon gold potato
title: Chocolate & Tomato Lunch
ingredients: 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder, plus extra | cocoa powder, to dust | fresh ground black pepper, to taste | 2 large red potatoes, cut in half | 3 yukon gold potatoes, cut in half crossways | 2 medium firm ripe tomatoes, sliced | 4 ounces unsalted roasted vegetables, chopped | 6 slices toast, toasted | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile, finely seeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c and spray a 2 - 3 cm springform cake or ovenproof dish with baking cooking spray. Place the sweet potatoes and yukon gold potatoes in a large pan over a low heat, cover and bring to the boil. Simmer gently for 12 - 15 minutes or until soft.. Place the tomatoes over the potatoes and continue cooking until the tomatoes are well cooked – remove from heat. Remove the skins from the tomatoes and put in the blender with a third of the roasted vegetables. Add the chipotle and process until smooth. Add 1 teaspoon cocoa and season well with salt & freshly ground black pepper. Toast the toast and spread on both sides of the cake. Place cake on a large baking tray and spray with cooking spray. Spread the tomato and vegetable mixture evenly on toast. Put on top the stack of baked sweet potato and tomato salad. Sprinkle with extra cocoa and black pepper. Cook for 25 to 30 minutes until topping is bubbling and golden.

title: Grandma's Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, unsliced ( i use sourdough ) | 1 1/2 cups dry mix ( jiffy ) | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Using hands, cut bread into 8 equal pieces. I divide the crust into 8 portions. On a flat surface, spread dry mix on bread, then sprinkle on baking powder. Shape into a loaf. You may broil at medium heat, broil for a few minutes until golden brown.

title: Rice wine
ingredients: 3 cups dry rice, washed | 1 cup rice wine
instructions: Toast dry rice till dark golden, stirring constantly. Add wine. Turn onto a cloth. Put in bowl. Cool to warm. Break into fingers.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,lemon pepper,white vinegar,horseradish,onion,cardamom pod,barbeque sauce
title: Grilled Lemons
ingredients: 12 kaffir lime leaves, torn | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper, or to taste | 1 dash worcestershire sauce, or to taste | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 4 slices onion | 2 cardamom pods | 1 1/3 cups barbeque sauce
instructions: Wash lime leaves with a damp cloth and tear off the stem and white or purple parts with scissors. Remove only the white and light green part of the lime leaves, leaving just white stalks attached. Sprinkle lime leaves with lemon pepper and worcestershire sauce. Prepare grill for indirect heat, about medium hot. Place kaffir lime leaves in a pan on the heat and cook, turning carefully and continuously, until softened and darkened on both sides, about 5 minutes. Transfer lime leaves and any remaining liquid to a bowl. Place horseradish in a separate bowl, and slice onion in half lengthwise and crosswise. Sprinkle onion slices and cardamom pods lightly with lemon pepper. Remove lime leaves from the grill. Place kaffir lime leaves and cocktail sauce in the bowl with the lemon strips. Stir gently. When the flames die out, spoon 1 1/4 cup cocktail sauce into the center of a lime leaf, and sprinkle with a portion of the horseradish. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Pork and Beef Dip
ingredients: 3 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1 carton sour cream | 10 taco flavored lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup garlic paste, mixed with | 1 tablespoon light cream
instructions: Place in a crockpot the pork, taco seasoning and sour cream. Cover and cook on high for 4 - 6 hours or until the pork is almost tender. Remove pork mixture, discard the fat and shred the meat. Place in a serving bowl with the lettuce, garlic and cream blended with light cream.

Random Ingredients: egg white,hamburger,brown lentil,broccoli rabe,kosher salt,herb,red cabbage,mayonnaise
title: Faux Bolognaise Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 egg white | 1/2 cup low-fat mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon dried herbs ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried breadcrumbs or 1 teaspoon dried breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 of a large red cabbage | 1/2 of a large broccoli rabe | 1/2 cup brown lentils or 1/2 cup red kidney beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients well, except cabbage, bean pinto beans and salt. Form mixture into 8 burgers. Pierce whole cabbage with a fork. Place 1/2 cup lentils over a large plate to catch the drippings that the lentils provide. Cover the plate with tin foil and put it over a burner on medium heat. When bubbling vigorously, put the lid back on, turn down heat and bring to a boil, stirring periodically. Reduce heat to medium, add cabbage and turn the heat back up to medium, or cover tightly. Cook for another 30 minutes. Remove tin foil and the lid and reduce the heat of the lentils and cabbage until they are tender. If necessary, cover loosely with foil or leave the dish off the burner until ready to serve, about another 15 - 20 minutes. Season the hamburgers on both sides with salt. Then cut them into 6 slices across the grain. Place the hamburgers in a flat dish, cover it with the cheese and serve.

title: Chewy Applesauce
ingredients: 4 apples - peeled, cored and grated | 3 ears fresh corn, kernels removed and chopped | 1/2 cup white sugar | 3 tablespoons butter, cut into small pieces
instructions: Place processed apples, corn kernels, sugar, butter, and hot dogs in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 5 minutes, stirring after 5 minutes. Pour into a bowl with a lid or slotted spoon to catch any juices that have accumulated on the bowl.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,string,lemon,cottage cheese,strawberry liqueur,corn,swiss chard,icing sugar
title: Swiss Chard, Green and Baby Corn With Baked Pizza
ingredients: 500 g shredded swiss chard ( or spinach, if using a zaar ) | 1 bunch fresh corn ( cut into 2 cm chunks ) | 1 lemon | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 4 tablespoons light-colored grape liquor or 4 tablespoons cream sour cream | 4 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1/4 cup cottage cheese ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons strawberry liqueur or 1 1/2 tablespoons other blueberry liqueur
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees c, 190 degrees f, gas mark 4 and grease 4 ramekins or individual oven trays. Place the swiss chard, corn and lime juice evenly in the ramekin and put it in the oven. After 20 minutes, remove the ramekin from the oven and cut the wedge off the corncob and discard. Place the wedge of shredded swiss chard in the centre of each ramekin and decorate with some corncob, a tiny bit of lemon juice and some extra lemon juice. Bake for 10 minutes, then turn over the corn and sprinkle more icing sugar over it. Return to the oven and bake until swiss chard and corn are tender – 20 to 25 minutes more. Serve sprinkled with some strawberry liqueur, drizzled with more of any of the above.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,pumpkin puree,fennel leaf,baking potato,spinach leaf,salt black pepper,pinto bean
title: Mexican Green Papery Bean and Fresh Spinach Stew
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato, scrubbed and trimmed | 1 lb fresh spinach leaves, torn into bite size pieces | 1 1/2 cups canned pinto beans, rinsed, drained, and rinsed | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 pinch salt and black pepper | 1 cup reduced-fat mexican cheese blend | 1 tablespoon fresh fennel leaves, chopped
instructions: If using fresh spinach, trim, wash and pat dry. Place a steamer or large dutch oven over boiling water. Add potato and cook about 5 minutes or until just tender, stirring gently. While the potato cooks, place spinach in a colander over a bowl. Press out excess moisture and set aside to drain steam.

title: Sweet and Sour Sweet Noodle
ingredients: 12 ounces canned crushed pineapple, drained | 1 bottle sweet chili sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Serve chilled.

title: Potatoes With Chile -- Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 6 russet potatoes, scrubbed | 2 poblano chiles
instructions: Place potatoes in a large saucepan of hot water. Add water to cover. Bring water to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low. Cook, covered, 30 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer potatoes to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,butter,beef broth,lime wedge,meat tenderizer,coffee,heavy cream,chocolate syrup
title: Caribbean Pepper Jack and Mint Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups beef broth | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup | 6 teaspoons meat tenderizer | 10 chocolate-covered coffee beans ( optional ) | 5 teaspoons finely shredded lime zest | freshly whipped heavy cream | chopped candied orange zest
instructions: Combine broths, sweetener, and meat tenderizer in heatproof bowl. Stir until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,romaine lettuce,vidalia onion,part mozzarella cheese
title: Faux Cilantro Stuffed Onions
ingredients: 6 medium vidalia onions | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | shredded romaine lettuce, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Peel the outer 1/2 of the onions and cut down the centers. Slice the centers into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. Place the olive oil in a nonstick baking pan, and heat over medium high heat. Add the onions, and cook, stirring often, until lightly browned and the onions start to caramelize, about 10 minutes. Stir in the mozzarella and return to the oven. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the onions turn golden brown. Remove from oven, and garnish with lettuce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon,palm sugar,hungarian paprika,flat leaf parsley,onion powder
title: Hungarian Dried Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon beef bouillon | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, minced
instructions: Place beef strips in a glass dish. Combine paprika, onion powder and bouillon.

Random Ingredients: corkscrew macaroni,red onion,french bread,beef tenderloin steak
title: French Herb Crusted Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced red onions | 2 teaspoons finely shredded french bread | 1 beef tenderloin steak | 12 ounces uncooked corkscrew macaroni
instructions: Sprinkle beef with onion and bread crumbs. Arrange on a baking pan.

title: Fajitas (Arroz Blanco)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef short ribs | 1 lb poblano chile | 5 cups hot fat ( for frying ) | 1 quart half-and-half
instructions: Cut short ribs into bite size portions. Wash poblano's and remove stem end. Place ribs into pan over high heat with enough fat to cover. Fry until lightly browned. Add chiles to pan and fry for 4 or 5 minutes. Remove ribs and chiles and place them into saucepan. Place the remaining fat in a fryer and heat to 375 degrees. Cut ribs into thin strips. Add to saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally until done. Remove all fat and stir in the half and half. Heat through, then serve.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,confectioner sugar,hot red pepper flake,date,cherry tomato,red curry paste,red potato
title: Red Potato Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds red potatoes, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 tablespoons red curry paste, more or less as desired | 1 1/2 cups diced red potatoes | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 -2 hot red pepper flakes
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag and set aside, combine red potatoes, curry paste and red potatoes and shake to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or more. Meanwhile combine cherry tomatoes, vinegar and red curry paste in a medium bowl. In a small bowl, combine sugar, red pepper flakes and hot red pepper flakes. Remove potato mixture from refrigerator and place in a medium bowl, stirring until sugar has dissolved. Gently stir in tomatoes. Serve with sweet chutney or sour cream.

title: Baked Linguini
ingredients: 1 lb linguine pasta | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 4 teaspoons dark rum
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package. Drain pasta and rinse with cold water. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, blend vinegar and rum. Toss with warm pasta and spread evenly. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoons rum.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,tater tot,pepper,orange juice
title: Olive Garden® Tater Tot Toss
ingredients: 1/3 cup orange juice | 4 lbs frozen tater tots | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon pepper
instructions: In a large bowl combine orange juice, frozen tater tots and olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: tarragon leaf,habanero pepper,flat leaf parsley,sherry wine
title: Mole Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb ground habanero pepper | 2 tablespoons tarragon leaves, chopped fine | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped fine | 2 tablespoons sweet sherry wine
instructions: Heat broiler. Combine habanero peppers, tarragon, parsley, and sherry, and mix well. If you find the sauce has too thick, add more sherry. Serve warm.

title: Beef Ribs Au Jus
ingredients: 3 pounds beef short ribs, cut into chunks | 3 pounds beef chuck, cut into chunks | 1 lb muenster cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. In a large roasting pan, arrange the short ribs. Place chuck in the roasting pan, and stud the chunks of beef with shavings of muenster cheese. Bake, basting with pan juices every 20 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the meat is tender, about 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Yeai Mow (Yeai Maow)
ingredients: 8 yams ( or substitute butternut, or substitute sweet potatoes ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( i use my mortar and pestle to grind this )
instructions: Cut the yam in half lengthwise and crosswise. Cut it lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Place half the slices cut side down in a shallow baking dish in a single layer. Mix together the cornstarch and cardamom and paint tops of the yams. Let sit at room temperature for 1/2 hour, then bring to a boil. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Plethora of Spicy Tuna
ingredients: 5 ounces canned chunk light tuna | 1 1/2 cups milk | 1/3 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped ( chopped or chopped ) | 1/8 teaspoon clove | 1 can diced green chilies | 1/3 cup fresh raspberry ( optional )
instructions: Drain tuna. Stir it until it begins to separate. Add remaining ingredients including drained tuna & spices. Mix well & enjoy.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,xanthan gum,cumin seed,mustard,baby spinach,italian parsley,bok choy,cayenne
title: Gail's Spinach with Choy and Mustard
ingredients: 2 quarts packed baby spinach | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 2 teaspoons mustard | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seeds | 1 bunch fresh italian parsley | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian spinach | 1 cup chopped bok choy
instructions: Heat a large pot of water over medium heat. When it boils, add the baby spinach. Cook the leaves about three minutes. Immediately transfer the spinach into a colander, rinse it under cool water, and squeeze some of the excess liquid out with your hands. Repeat on the remaining leaves. Place the spinach in a medium dish with a lid. To make the mustard, combine cayenne, xanthan gum, mustard and cumin in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,rice vinegar,chocolate liqueur,cashew nut,parsley leaf,wide rice noodle,black olive,cayenne pepper
title: Indian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package wide rice noodles | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 3/4 cup light cashew nuts | 2 tablespoons light chocolate liqueur | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar ( not instant or regular ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Rinse the rice noodles under warm water, rinse in cold water and drain. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl to make the dressing. Cover and chill for at least one hour. Toss before serving.

Random Ingredients: shallot,tennessee whiskey,green pepper,self raising flour,heavy whipping cream,beer
title: Nanny's Guinness Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour, sifted | 1 cup half and half light beer ( british stout or your favourite dark beer ) | 1/3 cup green pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon shallot, chopped | 6 fluid ounces guinness stout or 6 fluid ounces light beer | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place flour, beer, green pepper and shallot in a medium saucepan. Heat gently, stirring until well blended. Serve hot with cream and guinness stout.

title: Green Chili & Mexican Stainer Mash
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes | 1/3 lb mexican chocolate | 3 cans chopped green chilies | 4 poblano peppers ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Cut cleaned potatoes in half. Place in a large bowl & cover with water by two inches. Let them sit in the sink for 1 hour. Rinse potatoes with cold water. Put in the fridge to speed up the cooking. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the potatoes & stir to separate them. Cook until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Add the chilies & bring water to a boil. Drain the potatoes. Put in a large serving bowl. Chop poblanos in half & add to bowl. Dice chilies & add to bowl. Add salt to taste & mix well.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,cake flour,coconut rum,pomegranate seed,green olive,pork shoulder,beef shank,basmati rice
title: Spanish Pork and Beef Shanks (Cioppino Al Cartoccio)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, sliced into 1/2 '' cubes | 2 beef shank, trimmed of all fat, and cut into 2 '' pieces | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | crushed pomegranate seeds, to taste | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds, to taste | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 2 tablespoons coconut rum | 1/4 cup pomegranate juice or 1/4 cup pomegranate concentrate
instructions: In a 5 or 6 quart slow cooker, pour 1/2 cup water over the pork, then sprinkle the shanks with pomegranate seeds, pomegranate juice, and a little flour. Cover tightly, and cook on low for 12 to 15 hours, or high for 3 to 4 hours, or. Do not remove the meat before serving as the liquid will separate. Turn the slow cooker to high and pour in the remaining 1/2 cup water, coconut rum, and pomegranate juice. Cover, and cook on high for 15 minutes to heat through. Serve with pilau, mexican rice, and sliced tomatoes.

title: Biscotti
ingredients: 1 box graham crackers | 1 jar barley ( white pearl barley is our favorite ) or ( 16 ounce ) jar barley bread ( white pearl barley is our favorite )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Lightly flour a large baking sheet or jelly roll pan. Spread the barley on the untoasted pan until it has an even thickness. Cut a large slit down the center of each to allow it to run through the cutting board. The idea is to flatten the barley out evenly. Add as many bread pieces as possible, being careful not to over crowd the pan. They should also be about a half inch thick. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until slightly crisp on the outside. Remove from oven and allow to cool for a few minutes, then break into small pieces and place in a medium bowl. Spoon the cooled barley over the toasted bread pieces and serve.

title: Cabbage Blueberry Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs celeriac, peeled | 10 cups fresh blueberries or 10 cups frozen blueberries | 4 cups diced cabbage ( about 1 small head ) | 3 cups torn celtic bread or 3 cups breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons peppercorns | 2 teaspoons oregano
instructions: In slow cooker, add celeriac, blueberries, cabbage, bread crumbs, peppercorns and oregano. Close lid securely and cook on low setting for 8 hours.

title: German Style Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 8 medium potatoes, scrubbed | 3 teaspoons ground savory | 3 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f on cookie sheet. Wash and quarter potatoes. Place in a large pot and cover with lightly salted cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and transfer potatoes to a large bowl. Use a potato masher to mash potatoes in the hot water until completely smooth, about 10 minutes. Mix in the savory and marjoram.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,juniper berry,cashew,carrot,cremini mushroom,shrimp,pecan half,white wine vinegar
title: Prawns With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 500 g uncooked shrimp, peeled, deveined and finely shredded | 150 g cremini mushrooms, cut into 1 cm slices or 150 g baby bella mushrooms, cut into 1 cm slices ( 220 grams ) | 150 g carrots, shredded | 1 tablespoon dried juniper berries | 150 ml dry white wine vinegar | 150 g cashews, roasted, coarsely chopped | pecan halves or walnut halves, to garnish
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan on a medium high. Stir fry shrimp over medium for about 30 seconds. Stir in the mushrooms, carrots, juniper berries, vinegar and cashew nuts. Cook for about 7 minutes over high heat so the nuts don't burn. Transfer shrimp and vegetable mixture to a serving dish. Season with salt and pepper. Serve.

Random Ingredients: nacho chip,sharp cheddar cheese,rice wine vinegar,chicken breast
title: Chicken Wrapped in Nacho Chips
ingredients: 1 boneless skinless chicken breast | 1 1/2 cups nacho chip thawed southwestern-style frozen peppers and onions | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly coat a 10x15 inch ovenproof dish with cooking spray. Trim chicken of fat, place in dish and drizzle with 1 1/2 cups seasoning seasoned nacho chip chiles and 1 1/2 cups seasoned nacho chip.

title: Tempura Fish Taco Shell  (Sinangag)
ingredients: 6 tilapia fillets ( or equivalent size of fish ) | 375 ml buttermilk ( or equivalent amount of sweetened soy milk ) | 2 cups ice water ( or equivalent amount of cream ) | 2 -4 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Fill a large pot with water. Make sure to add about 2 - 3 tablespoons of oil to reach the bottom of the pan. Boil water. Add tuna to water. Cook until fish flakes with fork. When fish is cooked, add buttermilk to water in the pot. When all fish has been added, drain off water from the pot. Place a scoop of ice in the ice water until it melts slowly. Pour in drained tuna tuna and sauce. Put a scoop of sweetened soy milk and chili oil in the bowl of an electric mixer. Mix on medium speed until everything is well combined. Pour mixture into a 9x13 pan. Place in freezer until solid, about 1 hour. Slide plastic off of fish to serve, remove the plastic and serve.

title: Sizzling Sizzlin'
ingredients: 1/2 lb cake ( any flavor, like round or sliced or sliced as thin as you wish, the sizzlin's taste best ) | 1 medium onion ( or both ) or 1 medium turnip ( or both ) | 2 anaheim chilies ( or both ) | soy sesame oil | dried fried onions or 2 jalapenos
instructions: Cut the cake on both sides into thin slices. Cut a slit along the inside of the chilies and remove seeds. The chilies should look a few shades of black. Slice thinly into thin pieces. Cut onion as thinly as you can and place in a bowl with the sliced chilies. Dip your toast in the sesame oil. Layer the toast with sizzlin's as follows. On the top slice of toast add a few tablespoons of the onion sizzlin's. Put a few pieces of avocado vertically down the middle on top of the sizzlin's. Dip the avocado slices, then roll and place, sizzlin', and serve.

title: Low Fat Eggplant and Prosciutto Wraps (Baked in Foil)
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants ( eggplants should be very sweet, skin on ) | 4 tablespoons fat ( or more ) | 4 tablespoons fat ( or more ) | 2 celery ribs ( with leaves ) | 10 slices prosciutto or 10 slices deli ham
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Slice the eggplants lengthwise into halves or quarters if they are large. Place the eggplants cut side down on a medium baking sheet and bake until tender, 40 - 50 minutes. If the eggplant is still soft, turn over and bake until the other side browns. Remove from oven and drain off all but 2 tbsp of fat or so, but reserve. Add 4 tbsp of fat and 2 tbsp of fat to a skillet, sauté the celery while you heat the remaining oil. Remove from heat. When cool enough to handle, take the cooked eggplant from the baking sheets, pat dry with paper towels, tear each eggplant piece into 2 pieces and coat each piece with seasoned sugar. Arrange the slices to one side, sprinkle with a little more seasoned sugar, and wrap with a slice or two of prosciutto, or two slices of ham, and a piece of celery. Wrap up the stacked wraps in foil and warm until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,beef brisket,italian seasoning,hard egg,green lentil
title: Lentils With Honey
ingredients: 4 lbs lean fat-trimmed beef brisket, with spice packet | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 cup green lentil | 6 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 6 tablespoons clear honey
instructions: Place meat in 3 to 4 quart electric slow cooker. Sprinkle with italian seasoning. Top with green lentils. Cover. Cook on high 6 to 7 hours or low 5 to 6 hours or until meat is tender and lentils are tender. Remove meat, reserving liquid. Shred meat. Return juices. To cooker.

title: Bourbon Stew (Burgundy Eye Roast)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef eye round | 1 bouillon cube ( knorr ) | 1/2 cup honey
instructions: Place meat, bouillon cube, and honey in the crock pot. Cook on low for 12 hours. Pull out meat and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing. You can also use a slotted spoon or tongs for slicing, but i have never tried this method since my eye of round doesn’t go black when cooked on the top.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,bell pepper,pasta,lettuce leaf,mango,fruit,lea perrins worcestershire sauce
title: Tropical Mango Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup lea perrins worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons red curry paste or 2 teaspoons chile paste | 1 medium mango, diced | 1 small bell pepper, seeded and diced | 4 large lettuce leaves | 1 cup dry pasta, such as rotelle, cooked al dente | 4 large soft light fruit ( raisins, currants )
instructions: In a bowl, combine lea perrins, red curry paste, mango, bell pepper, and lettuce. Sprinkle with drained pasta and raisins. Toss to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Poultry Seasoning for Chicken
ingredients: 1/3 cup yellow sweet pepper, or more to taste | 3 tablespoons poultry seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the sweet pepper and poultry seasoning. Brush onto both sides of chicken. Grill over medium hot coals, or medium low distance for 20 minutes per side. An instant read thermometer inserted onto the side can be used to check if the juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: lime,corn kernel,vegetable shortening,icing sugar,dark chocolate,liquid smoke,cannellini bean,deli roast beef
title: Rich Beef Burritos (Fried Cannellini Bean Fritters)
ingredients: 8 ounces dark chocolate | 8 ounces sweet white chocolate | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/2 tablespoon liquid smoke ( not seasoned ) | 8 ounces small cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 fresh lime | 4 ounces deli roast beef | vegetable shortening ( for deep frying )
instructions: Melt 4 ounces dark chocolate, 8 ounces white chocolate, 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening and icing sugar until smooth in a bowl. Spread mixture evenly onto eight 15 square sheets of plastic wrap. Chop the beans into smaller lengths and place in a large bowl of ice water to prevent them from curling. Drain the beans, but do not drain them. Grate the flesh then set aside. Cut the roll of plastic in half and using the flat end of a rolling pin, roll the tortilla into a thick sausage shape using 2 to 3 tablespoons of softened shortening and 1/4 cup of beans. Repeat with other half of roll until all filling is used. Place the tortillas on a plate and cut a slit along one edge to allow room for spreading the filling. Drain two slices of lime on a plate and set aside. Fill each tortilla with a tablespoonful of beans, pressing the beans into the filling and rolling the tortilla as tightly as possible. Arrange the burritos on a baking sheet and refrigerate, covered with plastic wrap, for 15 to 20 minutes. Heat an electric frying pan over medium heat and remove the plastic wrap. Fry the fritters in batches of 3 to 5 minutes per side, depending on the thickness of the fritters. Remove with a slotted spoon, remove any excess oil and drain on a paper towel lined sheet tray. Serve with caramelised sugar and caramelised lime slices.

title: Olive Oil Furniture Polish
ingredients: 12 -16 dried black mushrooms ( stems removed and discarded ) | 1 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place about 6 teaspoons of oil into individual 12 inch pieces of aluminum foil that have been rubbed with olive oil. Carefully lay a few at a time in the foil, alternating with different mushrooms to fill in the spaces between the paper. Sprinkle the mushrooms generously with 1/4 cup olive oil. Repeat for each layer. Wrap each aluminum foil tightly with a double thickness of double folds, pushing the edges toward the center to seal. Place the foil packages on a baking sheet or wire rack. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Using a vegetable peeler, make a series of diagonal slits down the length of each package, making the slit on one corner. Bake until the crust is pale brown and crisp, about 15 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Transfer the packages to a rack to cool completely. Transfer the cooled packages to a clean surface. Slide a knife along the seam of each packet and make several small punctures in the folded top to allow steam to escape.

Random Ingredients: jarlsberg cheese,yeast,chicken tender,dark chocolate,pistachio,red chili pepper
title: Pistachio Parcels(Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 kg chicken tenders, cut into 2 cm cubes | 2 cups low-fat roasted pistachios | 2/3 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped | 400 g dark chocolate ( i used 70 % cocoa ) or 85 g vegan chocolate chips, divided use | 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 1 small red chili pepper, seeded cut into 1/3 cm strips
instructions: Place the chicken tenders into the bread machine on the dry ingredients plus the extra 1 teaspoon of the cocoa, 1 teaspoon of the mint and half the pistachios. Stir until well combined and then set to dough mode.

title: Cream Puffs (Swiss Almond Puffs)
ingredients: 2 cups almonds, whole, unpeeled | 1 1/4 cups oil | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 3 3/4 cups heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Butter and flour 4 - 4 ounce ramekin dishes and set aside. Finely grind almonds in food processor. In a large bowl, mix oil, capers and almonds until well blended. Add cream and stir well. Gradually add cream, stirring well. Spoon mixture into ramekins, filling almost full. Place ramekins in a roasting pan and sprinkle with coarse sea salt and a few pinches of sea salt. Bake 20 minutes, or until puffed and browned.

title: Overnight Ziti
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds dry ziti pasta | 1 jar taco sauce | 3 eggs
instructions: Pour a few tablespoons of taco sauce into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place ziti in a pot, and fill with enough water to cover the noodles. Set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a baking dish into the oven to warm the noodles. Crack eggs into a bowl, and mix with a fork. Set aside. When the oven is hot to the touch, pour the tomato sauce, taco sauce, and ziti into the baking dish. Pour in enough water to cover the noodles. Cover, and bake 1 hour in the preheated oven, or until the noodles are tender and the sauce is bubbly. Top with more taco sauce, if needed, before removing from the oven.

Random Ingredients: caper,red chile,bay leaf,creme de cacao,rigatoni pasta
title: Crostini Robusto
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 200 ml creme de cacao | 200 g anchovies packed in oil, drained | 1 red chile, seeded, finely chopped | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet instructions. Drain. Meanwhile, heat the creme de cacao in a small saucepan over low heat until almost smoking. Add anchovies and bay leaves. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add pasta and sauce and toss to coat. Season with salt and pepper. Serve.

title: Spiced Spice Rub for Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup mixed spice rub | 1 tablespoon ground red cherry pepper | 3 tablespoons poultry seasoning
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Rub all over chickens. Place chicken in plastic freezer bag or covered dish and chill for 8 hours. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Remove chicken from freezer and cook until juices run clear.

title: Curried Baby Bok Choy  (Wok Seaweed) or Bok Pea Snack
ingredients: 20 baby bok choy | 1 tablespoon thai curry paste or 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 inch gingerroot
instructions: Wash the baby bok choy and cut off any dark green leaves. Break off the leaves leaving about 1 cm of green leaves. Slice the stems from the leaves, and finely chop the leaves. Peel the ginger root and mince fine. Combine the ginger, mince paste and curry paste in a mortar and pestle or a spice mill and mix until well combined. Add the frozen leaves and mix well for a few seconds to coat them. Stuff the mixture into the bok choy, making sure to pack tightly or snap off any leaks. Place on foil over medium heat until the vegetables soften slightly, stirring occasionally. Remove the foil, turn over and cook for another 5 - 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Spaghetti Spice Mix
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chili powder | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 hot chili pepper | 1 lb uncooked spaghetti, broken in half
instructions: In a small bowl, combine chilli powder, corriander powder, chili powder, and sliced chilli pepper. Add spaghetti and rub it into the spaghetti. Add water until it is completely covered. Let it come to boil once in a while and put on the lid, turn heat to low, and let it cook for 10 minutes. This will keep for a week or so in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,chicken meat,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Simple Chicken Cheddar Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 lb chicken meat ( i use already cooked ) | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In small bowl beat soup and cheese together. In large pot combine both cans of soup with chicken meat. Cook until heated through. Serve with a dollop on soup.

title: Nigella's Magical Mystery Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup peanut butter or 1/4 cup peanut oil | 2 packages refrigerated rotini pasta | 25 ounces ground pork or 25 ounces ground sausage | 25 ounces lobster ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1/4 lb bacon
instructions: Boil your pasta and drain. Mix with remaining ingredients except your bacon. Cook on medium heat until heated through. Chop your bacon into little pieces. Once pasta is cooked, add the bacon, stirring to combine. Once pasta is cooked, add the bacon to a pot with about a tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil, and heat in skillet. Sprinkle with cocoa, serve, and enjoy your nieces is simple and delicious.

title: Golden Scented French Ratatouille
ingredients: 1 lb yellow squash | 3 anchovies | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons cognac | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 pinch adobo sauce
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a jelly roll pan and line with parchment paper. Slice the ends off the squash & scrape out the strings from inside. Cut squash in half length wise and scrape out the seeds. Cut the squash in half again length wise and scrape out the seeds. Place both pieces into bowl with remaining ingredients including cornstarch. Combine thoroughly and sprinkle on parchment lined pan. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper. Bake 10 minutes then rotate down heat and bake for 30 minutes or until browned.

title: Tasty Canned Black Beans
ingredients: 1 bag black beans | 1 large carrot, peeled and chopped
instructions: Place the black beans in a large pot with the carrot, and fill with enough water to cover the beans. Cover the pot, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to low and simmer until the beans are extremely soft, about 8 hours. This method is easiest if you turn the pot over several times during this time. Add your favorite seasoning, or allow some liquid to drain of the carrots. Check your beans occasionally, adding more seasoning to taste.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,shrimp paste,corn oil,salsa,poblano chile pepper,mint leaf
title: Shrimp Cholle
ingredients: 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried poblano chile pepper | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds | 1 pound peeled and deveined medium shrimp paste | 1/2 cup salsa | handful chopped fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the poblano pepper, cardamom and shrimp paste, and cook for a minute or two, stirring frequently. Pour in the salsa.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,oregano leaf,hot chili pepper,kaffir lime leaf,corn oil
title: Fried Peppers from Indo Base
ingredients: 6 large peppers or 6 large hot chili peppers, depending on your taste | 8 ounces peperoni, sliced | 3 -4 pieces kaffir lime leaves, torn ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 2 cups corn oil
instructions: Heat oil to smoking point and fry peppers until darkly and blistered.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,lasagna noodle,jalapeno pepper,plum tomato,rom tomato,mexican oregano,yellow pepper
title: Mexican Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles ( regular or half pound ) | 5 roma tomatoes ( small ) | 2 roma tomatoes ( small ) | 1 medium yellow pepper, sliced from all colors ( optional ) | 1 large jalapeno pepper ( seeded and chopped ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon fresh dried mexican oregano | 1 package refrigerated ramen noodles | 1 -2 tablespoon mexican oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Cook lasagna noodles, per package directions. While noodles are cooking, in a saucepan over medium heat, fry tomato until starting to soften, remove from heat and set aside in a bowl. Add tomatoes, bell peppers, and jalapeno to wok and cook, stirring for one minute. Add mexican oregano, season according to taste and stir. Add noodles and half the tomato tomatoe mixture to the wok and combine. Spoon mixture into a 13x9 pan or a 9x9 baking dish and spread over top of noodles, and top with remainder of tomato tomatoe mixture. Sprinkle with remaining oregano. Cover loosely with foil and bake at 325f degrees for 45 minutes, then uncover and bake for 15 to 30 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: ice water,shallot,chunky salsa,macaroni,cucumber,garam masala,romaine lettuce,chili paste
title: Spicy Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces macaroni, uncooked | 3 cups romaine lettuce, chopped | 2 medium cucumbers, cut in 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup mayonnaise or 1/2 cup miracle whip | 3/4 cup chunky salsa | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 3 teaspoons finely chopped shallots | ice water
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions.

title: Poblano Chile Pesto
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 8 leaves red cabbage or 6 leaves green cabbage, outer leaves discarded, outer leaves discarded and leaves stem removed
instructions: Remove stem portion of cabbage and discard. Rinse with cool water and pat dry with paper towels.

title: Chilie Paste (For Dipping foods)
ingredients: 10 -12 dried chilies, pods ( i often use jalapeno peppers ) | 1/4 cup green olives | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: In a dry saucepan, mix the dry chili pods, green olives and chili oil. Heat through and serve in a dipping bowl.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 2 medium baking potatoes, peeled and cut lengthwise into 3 or 4 pieces | 2 lbs chuck or 2 lbs skirt steaks | 1/2 cup thick & chunky salsa ( taco bell thick & chunky salsa ) | oil ( optional )
instructions: Place potatoes in a single layer on the bottom of the slow cooker. Place steak on top of potatoes in a single layer. Brush steak with oil. Bake at 325 for 45 minutes or until meat is done to your liking. If any meat seeps out, tent loosely with tin foil and let sit for a few minutes off the heat. Slice the meat thinly across the grain. Serve with salsa and enjoy.

title: Fresh Tomato Sauce by Giada De Laurentiis
ingredients: 8 italian tomatoes ( homegrown if you have them and canning jars, see note. ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees f. Wash the tomatoes and chop them into 1/4 inch or smaller chunks. Put the tomatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with foil. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring once or twice until the tomatoes are dark brown in color. When the tomatoes are cool enough to touch but still pliable, transfer to a food processor. If the tomatoes feel a little dry, add a little water as needed. Pulse 2 to 3 times, until the tomatoes become coarsely chopped. It is worth the effort to pulse in 1 or 2 times. Pack into clean pint jars, packing in just enough tomato juice so that the tomato skins remain intact. If you prefer a smoother sauce, stir in a little water. It can be stored and used within a couple of weeks but improves with age.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,radish,jalapeno pepper,garam masala powder,rye bread,apple juice,xanthan gum,lettuce leaf
title: Smooth and Creamy Apple & Raita (Quick and Easy)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon zesty irish cream, such as crema ayran | 1 teaspoon apple juice | 1/4 teaspoon xanthan gum | 4 large lettuce leaves | 4 whole rye breads, warmed | 1 jalapeno pepper, stem removed and thinly sliced | 1 small thin sliced apple
instructions: Mix together in a small bowl the garam masala, zesty irish cream, apple juice, and xanthan gum. Arrange lettuce leaves on 6 serving plates. Place one warmed slice of the rye bread on the lettuce, top with half of the apple mixture, and half of the raita mixture. Garnish with peppers and jalapeno slices. Repeat layers.

title: Chinese Radishes
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 4 cups thinly sliced chinese noodles | 1 pound radishes, trimmed
instructions: Bring boiling water to a boil in a large pot. Add noodles, and cook until tender, about 6 minutes. Drain. Drizzle molasses over noodles.

title: Finnish Beef Stew (Sazon)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 leeks or 1/2 red onion | 1 package dry yeast | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Place beef, onion and leek in saucepan, cover with water and boil slowly over medium heat until meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Drain fat from meat and skim off any remaining moisture. Cool meat to warm, skim fat. Strain broth, discarding onion and leek. Cool meat to room temperature, about 1 hour. Transfer meat with remaining broth to bowl and let cool. Add sesame seeds and blend well. Serve into shallow bowls with crackers.

title: Mongolian Meatball Turkey Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs lean ground turkey | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons nam pla ( fish sauce ) | 1 can mexicorn, drained and rinsed | 1 can rotel tomatoes with roasted chiles | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped unsweetened chocolate
instructions: In medium saucepan over medium high heat, combine the turkey, celery, shiitake mushrooms, and nam pla. Cook, stirring to break up turkey, until turkey is no longer pink. Spread the turkey mixture in a large shallow baking dish, leaving excess drippings in the pan. Sprinkle the turkey mixture with salt. Bake, uncovered in 400f oven for 15 minutes. Sprinkle the rotel tomatoes over the turkey, cover loosely with foil, and bake for an additional 15 minutes. Remove from oven and stir well. Sprinkle with chocolate and serve.

title: Cherry Balls
ingredients: 4 cups multicolored candied candy sprinkles | 1 jar candied cherries
instructions: Pour 1 cup of candy sprinkles into a bowl and add 1 - 2 cup cherries to the top. Dip your hands in the sugar and work in the cherries. Roll each cherries in the sprinkles, coating and sealing the cherries in the coating, working the sugar in as you go along. Store in your refrigerator, and serve cold.

title: Nawabi Kebab Masala
ingredients: 2 cups ghee | 2 -3 tablespoons curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Heat the ghee in a frying pan until it begins to smoke. Add the cayenne powder, curry powder and salt. Fry the aromatics and aromatics for 2 - 3 minutes on low heat. Stir, add water if the mixture looks too thick. You may add a little milk to loosen the gravy. Store in a covered tin or a covered glass jar.

Random Ingredients: ice water,italian seasoning,gruyere cheese,taco seasoning,cauliflower,kiwi,confectioner sugar
title: Confilled Kiwi Squares (Passover)
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 jar diced kiwis | 1 package taco seasoning | 2/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 4 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 cups cold water | 2 1/2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 1/2 cups grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place cauliflower in a large pot with enough water to cover.

title: Rustic Italian Bread Chips
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon white flour | 1 teaspoon oregano | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley ( chopped )
instructions: Mix flour, oregano and parsley.

Random Ingredients: cheese,apple,splenda sugar substitute,ice water,chicken stock powder,syrup,lasagna noodle,green cardamom
title: Easy Apple Chicken Lasagne
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles, broken into thirds | 2 large apples | 2 cups chicken stock powder | 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute or 1/4 cup sugar | 12 ounces cheese, shredded ( cheddar, gruyere or your favourite ) | 2 cups frozen petit pois ( from the fridge section ) or 2 cups kevin irish style sausages, coarsely chopped ( can't remember the name, but it's up to you ) | 1/4 cup ice water | splash maple syrup or syrup, for brushing chicken and vegetables
instructions: If using uncooked lasagne noodles, make sure they need to be completely dry enough to handle. Pour a small amount of water into a large bowl, add the broken noodles and leave to soak for about 5 minutes to soften them. Pulse the peeled apples in a food processor with 2 chicken bouillon cubes, 1/4 cup of sugar, and 1/2 cup of your chicken stock until you have a puree. Add this to the soup and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Add as much of the cheese as you like and stir well. Remove from heat and stir in the sausages. Pour the mixture into an ovenproof casserole dish, spread remaining cheese over the top and bake at 350f degrees for 25 - 60 minutes. You may substitute other cheeses, or even whatever your favourite is in there for cheddar or cornedefontons. When done, scatter remaining cheese over the top and bake for 3 more minutes, until bubbly. To serve, lift out of the oven, pour on the creamy apple soup and garnish with a few drops of maple syrup or syrup or syrup.

Random Ingredients: ice,lime juice zest,beef broth,port wine,chili oil,yeast,wild rice,dark soy sauce
title: Wild Rice and Lime Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry yeast | 2 cups wild rice | 1 cup port wine or 1 cup other high-quality dry white wine | 5 cups beef broth, divided | 1 lime, juice and zest of | dark soy sauce | chili oil ( optional )
instructions: In a medium pot, warm the port, 1/2 cup broth and the yeast. The mixture should almost be boiling. Add the wild rice and leave some of the residual moisture. Set aside. In a measuring cup, pour 1 cup of the remaining broth and add the juice of one lime. Add the lime zest and remaining cup of broth into the bowl with the rice. Bring to a boil, stir and set aside. In another large pot, heat 3 cups of broth and add the remaining lime juice and remaining 1 cup broth. Stir well. Bring to a boil. Mix in the soy and adjust seasonings to taste. Pour the hot soup into the awaiting broth and add more broth if soup is too thick. Place in a warm oven and bake at 400 degrees 20 minutes or until heated through.

title: Crazy Pink Apples
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons commercial pesto | 1 pinch cajun seasoning ( optional ) | 1 acorn squash, halved and seeded | 1 yellow squash, halved and seeded | 2 tart apples, cored and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup cashews, toasted
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and pesto together in a shallow dish. Sprinkle with cajun seasoning and top with acorn squash, yellow squash, apples and cashews. Serve immediately.

title: Thai Ginger Ginger Paste for Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh gingerroot ( or about 2 1/2-inch pieces, and lightly smashed using the side of a knife ) | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro
instructions: Combine everything in a food processor, whirl until smooth and creamy about 20 - 20 seconds.

title: Quick Fix Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups stir fry vegetables, such as corn and peas | 1 bottle salsa | 2 -3 cardamom pods | 1 envelope chili flakes | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Heat vegetable in microwave for 1 minute on high.. Add salsa, stir fry veggies and spices in separate bowl. Microwave 2 minutes on high, then remove from microwave. Add noodles, stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,onion flake,vinegar,tomato soup,rom tomato,polenta,enchilada sauce,habanero pepper
title: Johnny Jalapeno's Easy Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 jar enchilada sauce | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 6 ounces polenta | tabasco sauce, to taste ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups diced onions | 3 roma tomatoes, diced
instructions: Mix together, and let sit at least 1hour before serving. Freeze for future use. If needed, can be stored in the freezer.

title: Wasabi Sauce for Seafood  (Pebre)
ingredients: 1 2 jalapenos or 2 chile slices, minced | 2 tablespoons pickapeppa sauce ( sweet pickapeppa sauce ) | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 2 teaspoons wasabi paste
instructions: Pulse the chiles and chiles using a mortar and pestle with 1 teaspoon wasabi paste in a small bowl. Mix until ischoé and adobo. Add the remaining 2 teaspoons of wasabi paste, stirring until ischoé dissolves. Serve with seafood. Serve with your favourite pasta. You can also use the sauce in cooked crabmeat which is usually very salty.

Random Ingredients: currant,chili seasoning mix,taco seasoning mix,frying chicken,cooking oil
title: Quick Spanish Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 frying chicken | 1/2 cup dried currants, soaked and drained | 1/2 cup chili seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: Rinse the chicken under cold water and pat dry. Cut off any excess skin, fat, or pockets that remain. In a bowl or resealable plastic bag, combine all ingredients. Marinate chicken in the refrigerator to marinate for 1 hour. Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking dish large enough to hold the chicken with a baking paper circle.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,pistachio,coffee,rice wine,hot red pepper,kirsch,curry leaf,creamy peanut butter
title: Quick Satay With Pistachio Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-fat creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon kirsch | 1/4 cup instant coffee | 2 teaspoons rice wine ( or sweet rice vinegar ) | 1/4 cup hot red pepper, finely chopped ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios, lightly toasted | 1 tablespoon hot cajun curry leaf | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh sweet basil or 2 tablespoons dill leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Blend on high 1 minute or until smooth.

title: Thyme Dried Basil Shrimp
ingredients: 10 large uncooked jumbo shrimp | 1 cup single cream or 1 cup light cream | 1 cup loosely packed fresh basil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Pulse the shrimp in a food processor or blender until chopped into 1/4 inches or smaller pieces. Set aside. Combine the cream and basil in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high until warm to the touch, about 1 minute. Stir the shrimp mixture into the cream and basil. Cover and cook on high for 20 seconds. Stir once then place in a baking dish in a single layer. Pour hot cream mixture over the shrimp, sprinkle top of shrimp with a few fresh basil leaves. Bake for approximately 5 minutes or until the cream topping starts to brown as the shrimp turns slightly opaque.

title: Appleseed Salad With Vanilla Vodka
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh bean sprout, well rinsed | 2 green onions, diced | 1 1/2 ounces vanilla vodka | 2 teaspoons green candied apple | 2 teaspoons green candied apple | 2 teaspoons black rum
instructions: In medium bowl, toss together bean sprouts and remaining ingredients. Serve immediately.

title: Coconut Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops, cut 1/4 to 1/2 to 1 inch thick ( about 1-inch wide, if you want extra chops it will help to hold the shape of the chops ) | 1/4 cup coconut milk | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract ( or more to taste ) | ice ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir 1/4 cup coconut milk with vanilla until well blended. Add pork chops and turn to coat. Let chops marinate. When meat is done marinating, drain off any excess marinade. If necessary, coat the chops with 1/4 cup more of coconut milk in a 10 or 12 inch skillet. Pour in remaining coconut milk and simmer over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes, or just until a little browned.. Remove pork chops and serve. Tip, you can make small slits in the pork chops for flavor. If you press a whole slab of chops, the slits will seal in the flavor. If you press a whole slab of chops it will be less likely to split and cause soggy or unpleasant to eat in your mouth.

Random Ingredients: beefsteak tomato,celery salt,tomato paste,apple juice,yeast,kaffir lime leaf
title: Tomato Free Style Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beefsteak tomatoes ( fresh or canned ) | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 3/4 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 large kaffir lime leaves ( optional )
instructions: Drain juice from tomatoes into a bowl. Sprinkle yeast over tomatoes, let stand 5 - 10 minutes. Combine yeast, apple juice, tomato paste and lime leaves. When yeast mixture is dissolved, combine with tomatoes, mix and serve on a bun with a nice crust. Makes about a 3 dollar loaf or 2 pizza crust.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,cilantro leaf,peach,kombu,cod,green chili pepper,crescent dinner
title: Green Hot Snack Casserole or Kombu
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls or ( 11 ounce ) cans small crescent dinner rolls | 1 jar chopped green chili peppers, drained ( no substitution ) | 1 can sliced peaches, drained with juice | 1 can refrigerated kombu rolls or ( 12 ounce ) can refrigerated soy biscuit dough | 1 lb fresh cod, in 1/4 dice or 1 lb sea bass or 1 lb other snack, cut into 2 inch chunks ( 2 cups ) | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves ( optional )
instructions: Unroll s/pans of cans of dough on counter and place on work surface. Roll 1 ball of dough into a 12 x6 rectangle and use a 2 inch round cutter to cut out 2 equal x 1 inch strips. Repeat with remaining dough and 1 ring. Place bell peppers, olives, cilantro, fish, seafood if using, on bottom half of dough strip. Cover with 1/2 of the seafood. Top with 1/2 of the bell pepper and then 1/2 of the kombu or soy biscuit dough. Roll remaining dough into a 13 x9 rectangle and place on top with remaining seafood. Roll edges of dough tightly in top of seafood. Repeat process making 3 more rolls and ending with all the seafood. Place the pan on lower rack in oven, preheat to 350 degrees f and bake for 30 - 40 minutes or until light brown, crust is golden brown and dish is bubbly. Let cool 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetable mix,anise seed,beer,pork loin chop,pearl barley
title: German Pork Chops and Barley (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin chop, bone-in ( approximately 2 1/2 oz. ) | 1/2 cup pearl barley, rinsed ( about 5 cups ) | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed | 1/3 cup beer | 2 tablespoons mixed vegetables ( such as celery, mustard, mushrooms, green onions ) or 2 tablespoons peas ( such as celery, mustard, mushrooms, green onions )
instructions: Place chop bone sides up in slow cooker. Sprinkle both sides of chop with salt and pepper. Layer barley and peppercorns on top of chop. Pour beer over the chicken and vegetables and add aniseed seeds. Cover.

title: Hot Chili Dogs
ingredients: 2 lbs finely chopped ham | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Mix together all ingredients, and grill.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,marmite,confectioner sugar,cashew,cremini mushroom,button mushroom,italian salad dressing
title: Italian Mushrooms in a Mushroom Cakes
ingredients: 2 pounds assorted cremini mushrooms | 8 ounces dry italian-style salad dressing | 3 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1/3 cup dried chopped cashews | 1/2 cup parmite ( optional ) | kosher salt to taste | 2 tablespoons marmite, or more if desired ( optional )
instructions: Poke holes through the top of each cremini mushroom with a fork or skewers. Wrap a small piece of plastic wrap around each mushroom, and secure with toothpicks. Mix the italian style salad dressing, sour cream, fennel powder, nuts and parmesan pesto until well combined. Place mushrooms in a large resealable plastic bag, and pour the salad dressing over, seal, and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Transfer the mushrooms to a baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until the tops of the mushrooms are lightly browned and the tops are dark golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes. Turn off the oven, and cool the portobello mushrooms completely to warm room temperature. Remove the toothpicks, and slice the mushrooms thinly, about 1/4 inch thick. Serve warm, or refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: coconut rum,cornflour,shiitake mushroom,sushi rice,onion soup mix,romano cheese,vanilla extract,cherry
title: Oriental Rice Balls
ingredients: 400 g sushi rice ( i recommend minado's brand, but you can use japanese or italian ) | 4 dried shiitake mushrooms ( sliced thinly ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon instant onion soup mix | 300 ml light coconut rum ( or 2 1/2 tbls. rum flavoured rum ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons shredded romano cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon grated romano cheese | dumplings ( see note )
instructions: Rinse rice around in a strainer until water runs clear. Soak rice in water for 20 minutes and then drain. Place remaining ingredients in rice cooker and mix well. Do not add too much water or steam will be lost. Close lid and allow to cook for a couple of hours. Note, i cook my rice balls with two pressure cooker models on high for about 15 mins, checking every 5 minutes or so so and adjusting if required,. When rice balls reach desired softness, remove from heat and set aside, covered. Roll into balls then place on a plate covered with paper towels. Enjoy. Note, this is also quite good with a little freshly ground black pepper. Note 1, i like mushrooms with some nice chunks of garlic and a little of red pesto, but it can also be used as a flavouring for the rice balls.

title: Quick Yeasty Breadsticks
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh yeast | 2 cups angel food cakes, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 package egg noodles | 1 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over 1 1/2 cups warm water in 5 qt bowl. Stir until dissolved. Let stand until yeast softens and begins to foam, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, put water, noodles, and anise seeds into ovenproof pan. Heat to between 235 degrees and 240 degrees, until hot. Drop batter by 3 tablespoons onto pans with a spoon. Let stand 5 minutes. Carefully remove dough with a slotted spoon and carefully peel off dough, saving the oil. Let breadsticks warm, 3 - 5 minutes. Using metal cutters, cut 1 rope of plastic wrap across the top and the other 1/2 inch of plastic wrap down the sides of the breadsticks. Cut dough in 5 - 3 pieces, set aside, and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove dough from the plastic wrap, cut the strands in half lengthwise and cut 1 inch strands along the length of the pieces. Let breadsticks cool completely before serving. Store dough at room temperature. They can be refrigerated and reheated.

title: Baked Italian Sweet Sausage With Peaches
