ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage | 1 peach, firm | 2 teaspoons thyme | 1/3 lb chorizo sausage
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f with a paring knife, poke several criss cross cut marks across the top of the sausage. Push the sausage to the side in a criss cross pattern. Place the sausage, smooth side up, on a rack in a baking pan. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until cooked through. Remove from the oven. Spread the peaches on the underside of the baking pan, then drizzle with the thyme. Place in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until soft and sticky. Remove from the oven and, using the tip of a sharp knife, slice the sausage on the diagonal. Bake for a final touch. Serve with hot italian sausage.

title: Tunisian Turnip Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs turnips ( sweet, green, or red or any combination ) | 1 tablespoon margarine | 24 pitted prunes, finely chopped | 3 -4 red thai chile, sliced 1/8-inch thick | 1 1/2 cups short-grain coriandercrew macaroni
instructions: Clean turnips, remove root end but do not peel. Scrub. Place in a large pot of water with turnips, and add enough cold water to cover by 2 inches. Set aside. Drain and then drain and rinse turnips. Place in a large bowl, and toss with margarine. Then add prunes, chili slices, and coriander. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove cover and stir well. Return to refrigerator for 2 days, taste and add more pepper if desired.

title: German Egg Salad II
ingredients: 1/4 lb lard | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 8 hard-cooked eggs, sliced | 2 tablespoons white pepper | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 12 hot dogs
instructions: Heat the lard until hot, then add vinegar and white pepper.

title: Spicy Spanish Rice With Broth
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper, small dice | 2 anaheim chilies, small dice | 2 -3 green chilies, small dice | 1/4 cup of finely diced onion | 4 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mirin ( rice wine ) | 2 cups of prepared couscous
instructions: In a small cooking pot add the poblano, anaheim chilies, green chilies and onion. Saute until fragrant. Add the spices and let cook on medium heat for about 5 minutes. Add rice and stir. In a separate small cooking pot pour boiling water to 2/3 the depth of the rice and the rice. Bring to boil and then on high again bring to boil. Turn down to medium or low, close lid and cook for about 15 minutes or until all of the liquid is absorbed. Remove rice from heat and cover with damp tea towel or a lid. Allow to stand, leave to stand for about 1/2 hour. Fluff with fork, fluff again add the sesame seeds and serve.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,olive oil,cider vinegar,chicken broth,pine nut
title: Pine Nut and Prawns in Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb fresh prawns or 1 lb prawn prawns ( raw, shelled and deveined ) | 1/4 cup peanut butter ( smooth or creamy ) | 1/2 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon ground roasted pine nuts, for topping ( see note )
instructions: Preparation, cook prawns in boiling salted water for 3 to 5 minutes or until just cooked then drain and set aside. Using a mortar and pestle or a mortar & pestle, crush peanut butter finely or you can use food processor or blender. Bring broth and vinegar to a boil and pour over peanut mixture stirring to combine well. Return pan to heat and stir in prawns. Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes or until prawns are just cooked add pine nuts and transfer to heated serving dish. Note, if using a pestle, heat olive oil in a small skillet and saute pine nuts until aromatic and beginning to turn golden. If using a blender, puree prawn mixture until smooth but not overprocessed.

title: Herbed Balsamic Chicken Broth
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg chicken stock | 1 1/2 kg fresh herbs, including rosemary, parsley and dill
instructions: Bring stock to boil and add herbs. Simmer until reduced and syrupy. You can either strain mixture thru a sieve or leave through a sieve to save any liquid, or use in other recipes. Discard solids. If using as a coffen, it can be covered by plastic wrap and taken out. This broth could last up to 4 days in the fridge.

title: Brown Rice Rice With Oats
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked white rice | 1 cup brown rice | 1 can cut-up canned or homemade whole oats ( about 2/3 cup servings per serving )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Stir rice through the oats in a large bowl. In 9x9″ baking dish, arrange rice and oat mixture in baking dish, evenly. Sprinkle top with 1 cup of the brown rice. Bake, uncovered, for 55 - 60 minutes, until top is lightly browned and rice is tender. Serve warm.

title: Nuts and Bolillos Chips
ingredients: 1 cup ice | 2 1/2 cups nutritional yeast | 12 large nuts ( your choice )
instructions: Soak the nuts in a pot filled up with water for at least 10 minutes. Drain. Place in a large bowl. Dissolve the salt in the water. Dip the nuts in the water until evenly coated on all sides. Heat the non stick skillet on medium high and heat it. Place the bagels in the pan and cook till golden brown. You can flip this if desired. Remove and place in a cool place for about 3 minutes so the chips don't burn. Store in a covered container until serving.

title: Garlic Mustard Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup minced garlic | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill pickle | 1/4 cup minced celery leaves | 1 tablespoon minced fresh dill pickle | 1 1/2 tablespoons salt-free dijon's no-cook low-sodium worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon granulated garlic | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1/2 teaspoon dried allspice | 1/3 teaspoon cracked pepper
instructions: Process or process all ingredients in batches in a blender until they are finely minced. Place all of the ingredients except for the hot mustard between paper towels and thoroughly mix the mustard. Spread the mustard out on a wire rack and let set at room temperature for 30 minutes or until spreadable. Store airtight.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,pumpkin puree,ranch dressing mix
title: Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 1/4 cup ranch dressing mix | 5 -6 small dried red chili peppers
instructions: Bake or steam sweet potatoes according to package instructions. Combine pumpkin puree, ranch mix, & sliced red peppers in a medium sized bowl. Allow mixture to cool. Once cooled completely, spoon pumpkin mixture over baked sweet potatoes & mix gently. If necessary, cover & refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,consomme,picante sauce,cauliflower,beef sirloin steak,head cabbage,kidney bean,tortilla
title: Santa Fe Stew
ingredients: 1 can condensed consomme ( campbell's ) | 1 large head of cabbage, sliced | 1 lb boneless beef sirloin steak, sliced | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 jar picante sauce ( i prefer the smoky picante, but you could use any other kind you like ) | 1 medium green pepper, chopped | 3/4 lb cauliflower, small florets, chopped | 1 cup broken tortillas ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients under low heat.

title: The Perfect Kaffir Lime Liqueur for Vegetables!
ingredients: 5 -7 fresh kaffir lime leaves, torn into pieces | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar
instructions: Toss the lime leaves into a large glass pie dish or bowl. Make sure your glass is clean. Add the cream of tartar until mixture is fluffy and begins to form peaks. Pour the kaffir lime mixture over the lime leaves in the pie dish, distributing it evenly. Refrigerate until needed. Before serving, allow it to stand at room temperature for a few hours before serving. Use this as a garnish over cooked, steamed or fried egg sandwiches, and serve immediately. Alternatively, you can use a mortar and pestle for a fresh herb flavor. I used a little garlic powder and a touch of dried herbs, but you may wish to use all of this spice once or twice as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,dark sesame oil,lettuce leaf,puff pastry
title: Spicy Indian Pizza Rolls
ingredients: 2 frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 leaves lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Cut each puff pastry sheet lengthwise into four 5 inch squares. On each square, spread the sesame oil evenly. Sprinkle with garam masala. Top with lettuce leaves. Place the squares on a baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the pies are golden brown.

title: Quick and Easy Sour Cream Gourmet Chili
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can diced green chiles | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | buttermilk or sour cream | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Serve over hot cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,salmon fillet,feta cheese,garlic salt,currant,lemon extract,dark molasses
title: Crispy Salmon Feta
ingredients: 2 skinless salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon dried currants | 4 tablespoons dark molasses | 6 curly leaf lettuce leaves | 6 slices feta cheese | 1 tablespoon crushed dried currants | 4 garlic cloves
instructions: Place salmon in ovenproof dish. Combine marinade ingredients and pour over salmon. Cover and marinate in refrigerator, turning twice an hour, brushing once or twice with marinade. Bake in a 400°f oven for 10 minutes, basting once with marinade. Uncover and bake for 15 minutes longer. Remove salmon from oven and top each with 1/4 teaspoon of feta cheese. Return to oven for 5 - 10 minutes until feta is hot and bubbly. To serve, spread a tablespoon crushed dried cranberries on a dinner plate, place three slices of salmon on each plate and top with 3 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese. Drizzle each with a tablespoon of warm sauce.

title: Roasted Sage Almonds and Grand Marnier
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs mixed fresh sage | 1 cup toasted almond, whole almonds or 1 cup sliced blanched almond | 2 tablespoons grand marnier, orange liqueur, orange liqueur, or 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 teaspoon anise seed, or 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment paper or lightly oiled cooking spray. Wash the sage thoroughly to remove the sand. Cut the leaves and stems off of each bunch and set their stalks in a roasting pan. Rinse and pat dry the sage. Place a handful of chopped sage on a medium baking sheet with the flat of a knife. Place the baking sheet in the preheated broiler and place the rack about 4 inches from the heat. Broil the sage, stirring a few times, until the top of the stems are dark brown and the leaves darkly tipped, 6 to 8 minutes depending on the thickness of the leaves. Let cool completely, then remove the leaves from the pan. Place the almonds, a splash of sugar or salt and the grand marnier in a bowl. Toss to blend well until the almonds are coated with the granmarnier. Toast the anise seed in the oven or toast a coffee bean, depending on the pan you will be using, in a preheated 325 oven or 325 oven. When the almond toast is a little firm to the touch, it is done. Watch carefully because the slivered almonds might burn very quickly, so watch that this doesn't happen to your almonds before your guests arrive. Set the pan in a larger oven and reduce the heat to 300 degrees f. Continue cooking the mint in the oven, stirring occasionally and making sure it doesn't burn, until the nuts and mint are tender and a golden amber color, another 1 1/2 to 2 hours, shaking the pan after every 15 minutes. Watch carefully as the mints will readily spit and spit from the mill. Test the mint for doneness by taking a small sharp paring knife, removing one leaf from the cob and sliding it out onto a plate. If it starts to lose it's shape, it's too done. If you feel like it, you can quickly peel off some of the mint. Transfer the minted almonds to a small bowl. Place the other leaf on top. Gently pat the mint leaves dry and stir in the mint. Let the mint mint mixture stand to absorb all of the mint flavored oils, about 10 minutes. Stir in the grand marnier, to taste, and the anise seed. Spoon all of the mint mixture onto a serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,mini chocolate chip,salad oil,vegetable stock,grand marnier
title: Cousin June's Simple Lasagna
ingredients: 250 g lasagna noodles, prepared according to the pack instructions | 600 ml vegetable stock | 50 g mini chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon salad oil ( or olive oil ) | 1 teaspoon grand marnier
instructions: Boil the stock in a large pan and remove from the heat. Drain the lasagne noodles. Pour the stock through a strainer and set aside. Melt the chocolate and set aside until it is reduced to a thick paste. Mix the veg oil and grand marnier into the melted chocolate, whisking regularly. Pour half the chocolate into an 11 x 8 baking dish. Layer the lasagne noodles in this order and pour over the remaining chocolate sauce. Top with the rest of the noodles and pour over the remaining sauce. Bake in a preheated hot oven for 20 - 25 minutes, until golden, crisp and warmed through.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,vanilla essence,chicken tender,monterey jack cheese,sun tomato oil,cornstarch,spaghetti squash
title: Spaghetti Squash and Beef Brisket With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs pork brisket ( boston butt ) | 3 lbs spaghetti squash ( about 3 squash ) | 1 lb beef brisket ( brisket cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/2 cup spaghetti squash, rinsed ( about 4 squash ) | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Trim fat from brisket. Cut brisket crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Make sure slices are 1 inch thick. Place strips on rack in shallow roasting pan in oven. Turn oven to 450°f. Arrange 4 to 6 pieces of brisket in single layer on rack. Roast brisket for 25 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Transfer brisket to cutting board.

title: Crock Pot  Swiss Chard
ingredients: 5 lbs swiss chard | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 3 tablespoons corn | 4 -6 serrano chilies | 4 lbs beef shanks
instructions: Trim off and discard tough ends of chard.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,raisin,beef broth,ha avocado,dark raisin,chili sauce,rye bread,wine vinegar
title: Chili Chicken With Raisins and Chocolate
ingredients: 4 large skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup raisins | 2/3 cup dark raisin | 1/4 cup chinese rice wine vinegar ( to taste ) | 1 cup beef broth | 3 tablespoons chili sauce ( to taste ) | 2 medium hass avocados, peeled and sliced | 1 loaf rye bread, toasted and cut into 4 slices
instructions: Place oven rack in middle position and preheat oven to 400º f. Place chicken between two sheets of parchment paper and pound with meat mallet until 1/4 inch thick. Transfer chicken to a large rimmed baking sheet with a meat pounder or heavy cleaver. Whisk raisins and next 4 ingredients in small bowl to blend. Spread raisins in a 3rd layer on baking sheet. Bake in lower third of oven until dry and beginning to crisp, about 20 minutes. Return chicken to baking sheet and roast until thermometer registers 180 degrees, about 10 minutes more. Transfer chicken to cutting board and let stand until cool, about 10 minutes. Remove top sheet of parchment and transfer to cutting board with a wide spatula. Slice crosswise into 1/2 wide strips, then across grain into strips. Arrange chicken on platter, then drizzle with chile sauce and arrange avocado slices around chicken. Serve at room temperature.

title: Yam Balls (New Zealand)
ingredients: 5 yams | 200 g icing sugar | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 4 tablespoons icing sugar
instructions: Scrub yams clean and cut them into half lengthways. Put them into a saucepan of boiling water. Stir and cook for 20 minutes. Turn off the heat. Peel. Discard the skin. Cut yam into slices and put a layer of yam in your freezer. Keep turning them as necessary until all yam is used and remove them from the freezer. Spread the 2 tbsp of icing sugar on top of each yam slice. Dip the yam slices into the icing sugar and place on a tray. Place in shallow oven with the rest of the ice cold. Bake for 30 minutes in a preheated oven at 190 degrees. When removed from the oven, cut each yam slice into 4 even sized slices. Mix and store in an airtight glass tray. These freeze well.

title: Cajun Grilled Salsa
ingredients: 9 tablespoons apple juice | 1/2 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon tequila | 1 celery rib, diced
instructions: Heat grill. In small bowl, stir together apple juice, fajita seasoning mix, tequila and celery.

title: Preserved Lemons and Chick Peas
ingredients: 2 lbs baby lemons ( or 6 small ) | 8 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup palm sugar or 1/4 cup light brown sugar, packed, packed | 1/3 cup preserved lemons, rinsed of, rinsed well, seeded, and cut into eighths
instructions: Using the tip of a paring knife, remove the peel from the lemons, then slice into thin rounds.

title: Vegetarian Blackberry Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 2 teaspoons grapeseed oil ( or any oil you prefer ) | 1 1/4 cups bean sprouts | 400 g can sweet cornmeal | 1 1/4 cups caster sugar | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil ( or olive oil ) | 12 blackberries ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup caster sugar
instructions: Pour the quinoa in a saucepan and cook over a medium heat for 5 minutes, or until slightly translucent. Pour in a sieve and drain the quinoa and return it to the pan, stirring to ensure all the liquid is absorbed, and then add the oil. Stir in the chopped bean sprouts and cornmeal and gently mix to combine. Add the caster sugar, grape seed oil and blackberries and mix well. Taste and add more sugar if needed, and add more blackberries if you like.

title: Nasi Lemak (Grilled Cheese)
ingredients: 1 jar cheese, any flavour, sliced in thin slices | 1 coriander root, chopped ( a small bunch or a piece of root )
instructions: Spread sliced cheese on one side of a piece of non stick foil. Place coriander and root over cheese and fold closed, using edges of foil as handles to seal. Cut several holes through the foil with scissors or scissors, so that the cheese can breath. Brush outside of foil with melted butter, or a touch of olive oil. Bake 15 - 20 minutes at gas mark remove foil and bake a cup of milk for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring after 5 mins, or until cheese is golden.

title: Dutch Oven Baked Cutlets
ingredients: 1/2 kg veal | 4 cups oatmeal, medium grain | 4 cups of flour | 4 chicken parts | 1/2 cup crisco cooking oil
instructions: Preheat oven 350°f. Boil the veal in water and place in a dutch oven. Cook in the preheated oven for about 1hour with lid off. Remove from the oven. Leave for about an hour. Cut into pieces and place in a dutch oven. Mix oatmeal with flour and mix all together. Then place in casserole dish. Heat oven 200c. Place on lid and bake for about 45min. Take the lid off and place in a 350f oven for 30 mins.

title: Pea Pods With Tuna
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen peas | 1 can tuna in olive oil | 4 tablespoons kahlua ( or other strong coffee liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 1/2 tablespoon dried mace
instructions: In a medium size pot, cover peas with water and bring to a boil. Cook for 10 minutes or until beans are just tender. Drain beans and return to pot and add tunas, kahukah, parsley flakes, and mace. Mix well, and simmer over low heat for 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Cabbage and Peppers
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, chopped | 2 poblano peppers | 1 can refried beans
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, combine the cabbage, poblano peppers and refried beans. Toss to coat thoroughly with beans. Cover, and cook until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Apricot Appetizer Tray-Scrub Variation #1
ingredients: 2 cups apricots, cut into 1 by 1/4 inch thick wedges | 1 1/2 lbs red potatoes, in 1 inch cubes | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 cup red wine
instructions: Place apricots, potatoes, vinegar and red wine in a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Place mixture on a large platter, cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight to develop the flavors. When ready to serve, remove from refrigerator and brush potatoes with some of the vinegar. Adjust salt and red wine. Garnish with cherries or a little more vinegar.

title: Hazelnut Chili ( Chili Powder)
ingredients: 9 ounces condensed tomato soup ( or 3 1/2 soup cans of the other ingredients ) | 4 -6 tablespoons italian cheese, grated, divided use | 1 -2 fresh jalapeno chile, chopped, seeded, if desired ( leave seeds if using in your chili recipe ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted, or other nuts
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a blender. Blend until combined, stopping to scrape down the sides occasionally. If you prefer a smoother chili, add more cheese. Spread in an oiled 8 x 8 pan and sprinkle with toasted hazelnuts.

Random Ingredients: red chile,spring onion,coconut,celery salt,asafoetida powder,cornflour,coriander powder
title: Cornflour Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon red chile ( crushed ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1 tablespoon chopped celery salt | 1 tablespoon desiccated coconut, flake optional garnish | 1 -2 spring onion
instructions: Add cornflour to a bowl. Dissolve it into a fine paste with rest of the ingredients. Pour it over fish in bowl and mix, coating the fish well. Let it marinate for 10 - 15 minutes. Before serving use as your dipping sauce.

title: Rice Noodle Stuffed With Pork
ingredients: 3 slices of fresh pork loin, any thickness | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup brandy | 2 packages of dry rice noodles
instructions: Remove the pork meat from the bones and discard the bones from the loin. Rinse to bring out all of the grease. Slice the meat into thick strips and set aside, leaving enough fat from the pork to drain. Combine the soup, brandy and pork slices to make a gravy. Pour sauce over the noodles for a thicker sauce, then stir in the noodles and cover the pan. Keep the pan over medium heat to melt the noodles. Don't let the noodles brown, just keep the heat a constant. When the noodles are fully cooked, serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,avocado,jam,pernod,wine vinegar,caramel topping,yellow food coloring,chocolate baking square
title: Bacon Roll With Avocado
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs bacon | 1 loaf breadcrumbs | 1/2 lb yellow food coloring | 1/2 lb pernod or 1/2 lb orange flavor dark chocolate | 1/2 lb red sweet potato or 1/2 lb white sweet potato | 1/2 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1 lb ripe avocado ( ripe, peeled and sliced into rounds ) | 1/2 teaspoon pernod ( if desired ) or 1/2 teaspoon olive oil ( if desired )
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Reserve all but 2 tablespoons of bacon fat. Remove bacon from skillet and drain on paper towels. Remove bacon grease from skillet and discard. Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine bread crumbs and food coloring in bowl, set aside. Slice avocado into rounds, peel and dice. Set aside. Cut bacon into thin slices, set aside. Remove crusts from bread crumbs, set aside. Heat chocolate over medium heat in small saucepan. Keep chocolate warm, stirring constantly with wire whisk. When chocolate is melted, remove from heat and stir to break into fine pieces. Gradually stir in browned drained bacon. Fold in avocado, scraping into chocolate mixture. Transfer to a small baking dish or cookie sheet and set aside. Bake 1¼ hours or until top is dry. Remove from oven, cover and cool for 30 minutes. Turn onto serving platter or cutting board, cut into 1 pieces and garnish top with avocado slices and caramel sauce.

title: Baked Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 lb fresh blueberries or 1 lb frozen blueberries | 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup jasmine rice, washed | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat ovent to 400 degrees. Mix all ingredients together. Place in a covered dish and bake for 40 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Green Beans and Corn With Green Beans
ingredients: 3/4 lb green beans, trimmed | 1 jalapeno chile pepper, slit lengthwise | 1/4 cup corn, drained
instructions: Place beans and corn in 4 quart saucepan, cover with water to 1 3/4 inches above beans. Bring to boil, cover, and simmer until beans are just tender, 10 - 15 minutes. Drain. Arrange hot chile pepper over beans and corn and toss.

title: Spicy Anchovies With Chilli
ingredients: 2 cups plain flour | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 2 anchovy fillets, roughly chopped | 4 pita bread, triangles ( to serve, use your favourite bread ) | oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Place all ingredients, except the pita triangles, into a large bowl and mix well. Cut dough in half and roll out each 1/4 inch thick. Using a 2½ inch round cutter or a 5 cm round cutter, slice into rounds. Using a knife or a pizza cutter, cut out 12 rounds. Place 3 round or 12 cm pita triangles on a plate and cover with damp tea towel. Repeat until all spiced surfaces are used. Heat oil in a deep heavy based saucepan over a medium high heat. Deep fry 6 at the time for 2 minutes or until golden brown. Drain on kitchen paper. Serve warm, topped with a few tablespoons of chilli sauce.

title: Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 4 apples, peeled and finely diced | 2 ounces dry curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup chopped shallots or 1/4 cup green onion | 1/4 cup guava nectar | 1 package kielbasa ( or other sausage )
instructions: Combine apples, cottage cheese, shallots, and guava nectar in serving bowl and stir to mix. Cook kielbasa in large frying pan over medium high heat 2 to 3 minutes on each side, until no longer pink. Add s&p.

title: Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 3 green chile enchilada sauce | 1 bunch fresh beetroot, rinsed and peeled | 2 ounces pepperoni sausage, sliced | 1 can diced tomatoes with jalapeno peppers and garlic, undrained | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Place chickpeas, green chile enchilada sauce, and beetroot on a plate. Bake in a medium oven, about 30 minutes, until the beetroot begins to soften. Pour the tomatoes into the food processor, and pulse until coarsely chopped. Stir into the chickpea mixture. Remove to a bowl, then refrigerate until cold, at least 30 minutes or overnight. Break each beetskin into 3 pieces at the stem part and remove the leaves so that the shells remain intact. Remove the beetroots from the shells and slice them into 1/4 inch slices. Dice the pepperoni and divide among 4 serving plates. Divide the cooked beets and pepperoni among the pieces of the plates. Add chopped pepperoni to each plate and top with sliced tomatoes and sherry. Serve warm.

title: Wild Rice and Vegetables With Rum
ingredients: 1/4 cup wild rice | 2 small summer squash, ends trimmed, cut into 3/4-inch slices | 1/4 cup dark rum, warmed | 1/4 teaspoon nigella seeds
instructions: Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Add the wild rice and stir. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Remove the lid the rice. Sprinkle the squash with the rum and nigella seeds. Return to the oven and bake until tender, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,hot oil,canola oil,sunflower seed
title: Tunisian Sunflower Seeds
ingredients: 1 cup hot oil | 1 cup sunflower seeds ( or more or less to taste ) | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | canola oil or sunflower oil
instructions: Boil water, add sunflower seeds and let soak for about 15 minutes. Drain the oil. Put sunflower seeds in a bowl. Add three spice, mix together and add 1/2 cup hot water. Stir well and then put in refrigerator to marinate. When ready to serve, add more oil until well coated. Serve on it's own, with or without yoghurt and/or yoghurt.

title: Anaheim Peppers Oat With Chocolate
ingredients: 1 cup quick oats or 1 cup quick quick oats | 1/2 cup oat bran | 2 white chocolate, cut in small pieces | 1 large anaheim chili, split lengthwise, seeds removed, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven at 150 degrees celsius. Combine the oats and bran in a small dish and stir well to combine. Spread the mixture out evenly on a baking tray and bake, stirring the mixture regularly with a fork, for about 10 minutes, or until the mixture just begins to brown a little bit at the edges. Move the oat bran and oat bran onto a baking tray and spread evenly over the oat and oat bran, leaving a 3/4 inch border on all sides. Smooth half the chilies over the chocolate until well coated and sprinkle with half of the white chocolate. Return to the oven for further 10 minutes or until the chocolate melts. Serve immediately.

title: Soya Potatoes With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb russet potato | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | cilantro
instructions: Peel russet potatoes then cut into bite sized pieces. Parboil potatoes in slightly salted water for 10 minutes remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towel. Pour oil into a shallow pan and place over medium heat. When hot, add potatoes and sesame oil. Scoop potatoes into bowl and toss to coat evenly but not too wet, with oil. Serve potato mixture on a big platter and sprinkle cilantro on top.

title: Turkey and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 lb turkey ( skin on ) | 2 liters fresh hot vegetable stock ( or vegetable stock if you decide to use the soup base as stated above )
instructions: If you are using duck or chicken stock then you need to bone it and wash. If you would like to use vegetarian broth then it is fine now. If you can buy the turkey then it will cook evenly. If you would like to use vegetarian stock then it will be a much more acceptable if you use veg stock otherwise it will be the same if you use chicken stock otherwise it will have more intense flavour of the meat with no nitrate of the veg stock. If you wish then you may wish to use chicken broth to create the soup base instead of the vegetable stock which have been combined with a little stock. This is the point where you decide if you want to add any other flavor. Once you know whether the soup is as mild as desired you can add any other ingredients into the soup base. If you don't want to add turkey either, you can keep the neck and the meat separate, or you can add a little bacon or sausage to the soup base and serve it.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,salsa,green chile pepper,salmon fillet,pimento,cooking spray,orange juice
title: Salmon with Creamy Pimento and Green Chile Strips
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 skinless, boneless salmon fillets | 1 jar salsa | 2 cups quick-cooking rolled oats | 1 jar diced green chile peppers | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 jar diced pimentos, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking oil spray. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Place salmon in the boiling water and cook until easily flaked with a fork, about 5 minutes. Drain. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir salmon in the hot oil until the fish flakes easily with a fork, about 5 minutes. Transfer salmon to a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour salsa over top. Sprinkle pimentos over the salmon and pour orange juice over the top. Bake in the preheated oven until the salmon is easily flaked with a fork, about 15 minutes.

title: Crock Pot Juicy Juicy Beef Tenderloin (Beef Tenderloin) With Chicken
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef tenderloin ( trimmed weight. remove tendon that came from slicing the tenderloin. ) | 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Trim fat from meat and cut into serving sized pieces. Place in cooker with the tenderloin. Add more if desired. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Remove meat from slow cooker.

title: Wild Rice & Beef Wraps - Vegetarian
ingredients: 4 large shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 2 cups chopped deli roast beef | 20 -30 large lettuce leaves, lettuce- rinsed of dried
instructions: Put 2/3 cup of mushroom, beef and lettuce on each lettuce leaf, roll or line them tightly and secure with toothpicks. Heat a large skillet over medium to medium high heat. When hot but not smoking, add rolls.

Random Ingredients: popcorn,beef bouillon cube,arborio rice,chili powder,gruyere cheese,french bread italian,chick pea,vodka
title: Chili-Cheese Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant minced fresh garlic ( about 1 teaspoon ) | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 4 ounces shredded gruyere cheese | 1 can chick-peas, drained | 1 cup frozen corn, thawed and drained | 1/4 cup vodka
instructions: Place the minced garlic, chili powder, and bouillon in a large dutch oven over medium heat, and bring to a simmer, stirring frequently. Continue to stir the rice around the lid for about five minutes, then add the cheese 1/4 cup at a time. As it melts, stir in the chickpeas and corn, stirring briskly until all of the cheese is incorporated and the mixture is smooth. Turn the heat to low, pour in the vodka, and simmer to blend the flavors for 2 minutes, stirring continuously. To serve, cut the loaf of french bread in half lengthwise. Scoop out the inside of the loaf, leaving 1/4 inch thick shell and leaving the bread hollowed out. Fill the shells with the steaks, and wrap each in aluminum foil. Place the filled bread on flat baking sheets and drizzle with olive oil. Preheat broiler. Broil, uncovered, about 2 minutes, until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,romano cheese,pinto bean jalapeno pepper,goat cheese,green onion,bibb lettuce
title: Frijoles de Pinto (Fried Stuffed Green Onions)
ingredients: 4 -5 large green onions ( the larger the cut lengthwise ) | 3 tablespoons yellow cornmeal, to use in tortillas | 2 tablespoons goat cheese | 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese, grated, for sprinkling | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce grated romano cheese ( not grated ) | 10 -12 leaves bibb lettuce or 10 -12 leaves other soft flat lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Wash and chop the green onions and place in a bowl. Add cornmeal and stir until well mixed. Place a spoonful of this mixture into the center of each green onion and roll up like a jelly roll. Place seam side down on a baking sheet and bake for 25 - 30 minutes, until the filling is hot and the onions are lightly browned. Remove from oven, drizzle with some goat cheese and sprinkle with parmesan cheese and romano cheese.

title: Pepitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons pure epitas ( or sub. red pepper flakes, dried ) | 6 cans enchilada sauce ( you can double this )
instructions: Mix the vinegar and epices in a large bowl using your fingers until well combined. Add the enchilada sauce and mix thoroughly to combine then chill if using for at least 2 hours. Serve on chips or by itself. Can also be put into a crockpot and cook on high for just a few hours then turn down to low and cook for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: green olive,red onion,cumin powder,red wine vinegar,kalamata olive,caper,chickpea flour,wine
title: Tahinah (Sooz Friendly Chickpea Pasta Salad)
ingredients: 1 can chickpea flour ( near east brand ) | 1 tablespoon kalamata olive ( pitted ) | 1/2 cup red onion ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup green olives ( pitted and chopped ) ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons capers ( drained ) | 1/4 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon wine ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: In a large mixing bowl mix all ingredients together. Toss to blend ingredients adding more red wine vinegar as needed if you like. Serve over your favourite pasta.

title: Fried Apricots and Rice
ingredients: 4 cups hot cooked arborio rice | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 4 apricots or 4 small gala apples, pared, halved lengthwise ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet, heat 1 tablespoon sesame oil. Add apricots and cook 3 minutes or until tender. Serve with rice.

title: Lime, Orange and Chocolate Tuna Fajitas
ingredients: 1/3 cup orange rind, chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 12 ounces tuna, cut into 1/4 inch wide slabs | 1 lime, cut into 4 wedges | 2 cups flour tortillas, warmed | 12 ounces baking chocolate, diced | guacamole ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine orange peel, lime juice and tuna in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 4 hours or overnight. Preheat grill to high. Place half of the shrimp in the center of a tortilla. Top with half of the orange zest. Divide the zest over the shrimp. Roll up and place on the heated grill. Gently press into an open shell. Repeat with remaining shrimp. Spray the outside of the shells with nonstick spray. Place the rolled tortilla on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes. Remove from the grill. Add half of the chocolate to the skillet. Place in an uncovered large nonstick skillet and melt over medium heat. Carefully remove the pan from the heat. Spoon half of the chocolate into the inside of the filled tortilla and place all 4 taquitos, seam sides down, down on top of the chocolate. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Spoon a little guacamole and arrange on a serving platter. Sprinkle with remaining chocolate.

title: Sultana Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 cup sultana | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 can condensed tomato soup
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a blender and process until thick, adding water if mixture seems too thick.

title: Green Pepper Spread
ingredients: 2 lbs green pepper, julienned | 6 ounces green olives, drained, finely chopped | 12 ounces sour cream or 12 ounces cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Place all ingredients into glass jar or jar & cover with extra air. Set aside at room temperature for at least a few days. After the time is out, keep in refridgerator with tight fitting lid. The salad can be served up to 3 days in advance. Keeps for up to one year, keeping it in the fridge for up to 1 year.

title: Heirloom Tomato Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 2 assorted heirloom tomatoes ( see note ) | 1 celery rib | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 -6 canned chiles, minced ( see note )
instructions: Roughly chop tomatoes and place in microwave safe dish with celery and cardamom seeds. Cook on high 4 - 5 minutes. Turn off and let cool. Chop chilies.

title: Crock Pot Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head of cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1 bag red wine, bottle
instructions: In a 12 inch skillet with a tight fitting lid, place cabbage slaw, wine bag and crushed red wine. Stir as the liquid from the bag drips into the contents. Cover, and cook on low heat setting for 6 hours or until slaw is dark and soft. Uncover, and cook for additional 1 hour or until mixture is thick and creamy.

title: Cabbage Slaw, for BBQ, Sandwiches and Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage ( about 5 cups ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons apple liqueur | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro leaves
instructions: Trim the cabbage of tough leaves and discard or discard the core ends. Cut the core from the cabbages. Place all in a large, dry frying pan with enough water to cover and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the cabbage is very tender. Remove the cabbage from the water and set aside to cool slightly. Using a slotted spoon, carefully remove the cores and coarse shreds, then set aside. Remove the core from the cabbage, discard, and cut the finely shredded cabbage into bite sized pieces. In a large stainless steel bowl, combine the golden syrup, sherry and cilantro. Stir to mix. Place the cooled cabbage over a bowl of warm water, and refrigerate to chill in a bowl for about an hour. This will help to develop the flavors. Drain and add to the dressing just before serving. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,soymilk,baby shrimp,sushi rice,italian salad dressing,fettuccine pasta
title: Shrimp Fettuccine Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine pasta, cooked and kept hot | 1 pound baby shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup soy milk, and | 1/2 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 -2 cup sushi rice, cooked and chilled
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cooked fettuccine, shrimp, soy milk, soy milk vinegar, and sushi rice. Toss mixture lightly to blend. Chill for three to four hours before using.

title: Baked Tomato and Hot Italian Sausage Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage or 1 lb italian sausages | 1 jar of your favorite hot italian sausage ( not sweet or hot ) | 1 can plum tomatoes | 1 lb swiss cheese, grated
instructions: In a non stick skillet, heat up the sausage and brown. While these two steps are just cooking, slice the tomatoes into wedges. Drain all of the meat and stir it in with the sausage. Place a slice of swiss cheese in the bottom of a 13x9 greased pan. Spoon the tomato topping over the swiss cheese and spread it on top. Repeat this process until the ingredients are used up. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 20 - 30 minutes or until bubbly. Remove from oven and slice while still hot.

title: Red Beans
ingredients: 200 g red beans or 200 g white beans | 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Clean the beans until all the water is released. Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the beans till brown. Remove from the heat. Add water and salt to taste. Serve.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,sesame,red pepper powder,sirloin steak,adobo seasoning,parsley flake
title: Cuban Grilled Steak
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak, 3/4 inch thick, 2 lbs each | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, undrained | 2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 2 tablespoons adobo seasoning, con pimiento | 1 tablespoon red pepper powder | 1/2 teaspoon sesame, if desired
instructions: Drain the sirloin steak of excess liquid reserving about 1/4 cup. Pat the steak dry. Cut the steak crosswise into 1 pieces. Place the slices on a greased rack in a broiler pan, leaving about 1/4 inch of space at one side of the pan. Broil 6 - 8 inches from heat for 11/2 15 minutes, turning over once, or until done to your liking. Remove steak from pan and let stand to rest on a wire rack for 5 minutes, then slice crosswise into thin slices. Place artichoke hearts with marinade, parsley, adobo, red pepper and sesame in a 3 3/4 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to low, cover tightly and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, until heated through and lightly basted. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,gold tequila,pineapple chunk,beer,ham,ice cube,paprika
title: Pineapple & Ham Kabobs
ingredients: 1/2 cup beer ( i use an oregon pale ale ) | 1/2 cup golden tequila | 1/2 cup ginger-garlic paste ( i use pinch dusted ginger ) | 1 can pineapple chunks ( i use fresh cut the juice ) | 1/4 cup paprika | 1 -2 cup honey | 1 -2 -2 cup cooked ham, cubed
instructions: In a sauce pan combine the beer, tequila, garlic paste, pineapple, paprika & honey. Bring to just a simmer & allow to simmer, stirring frequently. Remove from heat & set aside. Thread the ham on skewers & alternate with pineapple chunks. Pour the beer mixture over the kabobs, marinate, turning occasionally for 5 hours. Preheat grill to high & discard marinade. Remove kabobs from the grill & grill, turning occasionally for 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shrimp paste,vegetable oil cooking spray,steak,cabbage,soy sauce,butter bean,garlic clove,green chili
title: Indonesian Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, sliced | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can butter beans, drained and rinsed | 1 medium head cabbage | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 green chili, chopped | 5 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 teaspoon shrimp paste
instructions: Soak a large pot of water for 8 - 10 minutes. Heat a wok over medium high heat and put in oil then a little bit of the sliced steak. As the meat gets crispy it will start to form a little bit of a crust around the edge. Then it will begin to brown, then place it on a plate. Drain the water from the mushrooms and add about two tablespoons of the mushroom water. Let it heat a few minutes. Then, add the soy sauce and 1/4 cup of water. Now, set aside the remaining steak and slice into thin strips. Take out the wok with oil and put it back over medium heat. Add garlic and chilies and cook for a moment. Then, add the shredded cabbage. Cook, stirring, until it becomes soft. Add the reserved steak, and cook another couple of minutes. Add the mushrooms and soy sauce to the meat and cook until hot. Stir fry for about two minutes. Add shrimp paste and cook for few minutes on medium heat until the shrimp have started to cook. Add the leftover mushroom and soy sauce mixture and cook until heated through. Serve with rice.

title: Rice and Black Beans
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup fresh orange peel, cut into 1 inch squares | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 package arborio rice | 9 ounces tomato juice | 4 cups chicken stock | 1 3/4 cups freshly cooked white rice | 2 packages double crust pie crusts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat the chicken stock to a boil in a large saucepan.

Random Ingredients: capsicum,fish sauce,peach,white onion,salt pepper,rum,grain white rice,chili oil
title: Vietnamese Beef With Peach and Rice
ingredients: 1/2 kg sirloin steak | 1/2 cup rice | 1 large white onion | 1 can sliced peaches | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed chili oil | 1 ounce rum | 4 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon salt and pepper
instructions: Season steak with salt and pepper. Cook beef in a frying pan, stirring occasionally, until browned. Reduce heat, add rice and stir until coated evenly with the fat. Heat remaining oil in pan and fry sliced onion until soft. Stir in rum and fish sauce. Add beef and cook on high heat until almost cooked. Serve beef with rice.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,meat,grain rice,chili oil,fine sea salt,fast rising active yeast
title: Chili Stuffed Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sodium-free chili oil ( i like peanut butter chili oil ) | 1 1/8 cups short-grain rice | 1 1/8 cups shredded low-fat romaine lettuce | 1 ounce fast-rising active dry yeast | unsalted sea salt | 2 -3 teaspoons finely minced canned pickled jalapeno peppers or 1 -2 teaspoon dried jalapeno seeds
instructions: Place the chili oil in a small saucepan and set over medium heat. Add the rice, cover, and cook about 5 minutes, or until slightly translucent and hot, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat. Let stand for 5 minutes, or until cool enough to handle. Combine or transfer the rice with the lettuce, yeast and salt in a large bowl. With dough hooks knead the dough until it becomes smooth and elastic, and pulls away from the sides of the bowl. Form the dough into a ball, place on a cutting board, and with floured hands, make dimples spaced about 1/2 inch apart, about 2 to 3 inches apart. Place the dimples on a piece of wax paper or plastic wrap and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Set aside in a warm room. Let it stand until the rice has absorbed all of the water, about 20 minutes. Remove the plastic wrap, transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface, and divide it into four equal pieces. Working with one piece at a time, form each piece into a large ball. Transfer the balls to a lightly floured surface and knead them on each side for about 8 minutes or until it begins to firm. Wrap each ball in a clean kitchen towel and set aside in the refrigerator. Repeat with the remaining pieces of dough. Divide each ball of dough into 4 portions, flatten each to an 8 to 10 inch disk. Place each disk on a baking sheet sprinkled with sea salt. Place the tomatoes close together on the baking sheet. Set the baking sheet in a warm place to hold the dough for as long as possible, about 30 minutes. Alternatively, place the tomatoes directly on the rack in the oven, and bake them until the tomatoes have browned slightly from the skin and are soft, about 40 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool for about 20 minutes or until the rolls can be picked and spread easily. Place one tomato disk on each warm toasted bread roll, and top with the remaining tomato. Dot the rolls with pickled jalapeños, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cheese,basmati rice,rye bread,heavy whipping cream,flounder fillet,grain white rice,marinara sauce,mirin
title: Fried Whole Fish With Rice, Crisp, and Basil

instructions: Preheat oven to 200f degrees. Arrange fish on a rack of a broiler pan, about 4 inches from the heat, so the fillets are 3/8 to 1 inch thick. Toss bread with 5 tablespoons mirin, and let stand for 10 minutes. Rinse rice with hot water until it runs clear, then drain and discard water. Spread on a large plate and toast in oven until pale golden brown, about 3 minutes. Turn fish and toast on baking sheet in oven at 200f degrees for 5 - 7 minutes. Spread rice on a large platter and top with steaming fish and rice mixture, then top with a small amount of mozzarella cheese. Serve hot. Soups,. To make roux, heat 1/2 cup fat in a saucepan. Stir in roux and serve immediately.

title: Chicken Strip Melt - Weight Watchers
ingredients: 3 cups sliced peeled cucumbers | 2 cups thinly sliced peeled cantaloupe | 1/2 cup shredded reduced fat cheddar cheese | 4 cups fat-free chicken strips | 4 roma tomatoes, cut into 1/4 inch wide strips | 10 slices deli-style hot-butter flavored bread | 3/4 teaspoon mrs. dash table salt ( original flavor ) | 6 teaspoons nonfat dry bread crumbs ( see quick bread crumbs )
instructions: Cut four 1/2 inch wide by 3 long sticks from bread.

title: Pasta With Yogurt, Celery and Almonds
ingredients: 350 g farfalle pasta or 375 g bow tie pasta | 500 ml yoghurt | 1 teaspoon celery salt or 1 teaspoon salt | blanched almond, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cook the bowtie as per package instructions. Mix the yoghurt with the celery salt in a pot on medium heat. Add the blanched almonds, if using, and stir just until heated through. Add the pasta to the yoghurt mixture and stir through until pasta is coated with the yogurt. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Penne With Pepperoni, Beans, and Pork
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 lb ground chicken meat | 6 ounces sliced pepperoni | 1/2 small brown onion, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion salt | 12 ounces penne, cooked | 1 can refried beans
instructions: In a 2 quart baking dish, heat oil over medium high heat. Add meat and pepperoni, and cook, stirring, until meat is no longer pink, 5 to 6 minutes. Drain grease. Stir in onion salt, pasta, and refried beans. Cover, and bake in a 350 degree f oven until heated through, about 30 minutes.

title: Hot Saag
ingredients: 1 lb fresh or frozen peas or 1 lb frozen peas | 1 andouille sausage | 1 package frozen broccoli florets, thawed | 1 can diced green chilies | 4 tablespoons chili | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 -2 teaspoon hing
instructions: In a 6 quart slow cooker, saute sausage and peas until sausage is heated through. Place the broccoli in the slow cooker and the chilies in it. Mix together the molasses, hing and chili powder in a small bowl. Sprinkle this over the vegetables. Top with the sausage and peas. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours. Stir the saag mixture once, cover and cook on low for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Cheesy Baked Cheese
ingredients: 1 kg sharp cheddar cheese | bouquet garni or other bouquet garni
instructions: Pre heat oven to 220c/gas mark 8, 200c if using a fan. Cut cheese into small circles and place on a well oiled baking tin. Dust with bouquet garni. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes until well browned.

title: Beer Filled Flatbread
ingredients: 2 cups cornmeal, stone ground | 8 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 6 tablespoons chives, finely chopped | 32 ounces beer ( such as guinness ) or 32 ounces chicken stock ( such as guinness )
instructions: Put cornmeal on oven tray and bake at 180°c/350°f/gas mark 3 for 15 to 20 minutes, till brown and fragrant. Turn down oven temp to 300°c/350°f/gas mk heat the ghee in a large, deep pan till it becomes slightly thick but not brown then add the chives and chives. When the chives become fragrant, remove it from the heat and allow to cool slightly. Stir the cornmeal into 1 cup of cold beer and pour into this slowly, stirring all the time, till you have about 3 cups of wet batter. Stir in remaining 3/4 cup beer or stock. Keep the heat between you and your cooking element. Pour the batter into the preheated oven and bake for 45 to 60 minutes or till puffed up and dry on top. Allow a few minutes between each turn on the tray to let the batter brown. Allow to cool completely and serve.

title: Sticky Orange Sweet Rice
ingredients: 2 cups glutinous rice ( arborio ) | 1/4 - 3/4 cup red liqueur ( i use pisco or cointreau )
instructions: Prepare glutinous rice according to package directions. When rice is done, fluff with fork and re season with orange liqueur if desired.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,yellow onion,apple,no boil lasagna noodle,beef eye
title: Beef Roulades
ingredients: 2 lbs beef eye round | 1 large yellow onion | 1 bunch fresh rosemary leaf | 1 jar no-boil lasagna noodles | 4 apples ( your preference )
instructions: Grill the beef in the oven. Chop the onion and rosemary fine. Slice the meat thinly against the grain. Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package directions. Dip half the noodles in warm water, drain, rinse with the 1 tablespoon of cooking water. Arrange a layer of noodles in the bottom of a 9x13 inch pan. Next, scatter about half the beef, onions and rosemary. Repeat the layers. The final layer should be with no no more than 1 tomato layer, and about half of the apple slices and then the other half of the noodles that have been dipped in water. Top with aluminum foil. Make a tent over the top of the pan using 2 layers of paper towels. Put in the oven. Bake until the meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours at let stand 10 minutes then slice and serve..

title: Guacamole Creamy French Faux-Marie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili oil | 1 package ladyfingers | 1 1/2 cups guacamole | 1 cup blueberries
instructions: Make the french faux/marinara sauce, in a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the sugar, apple juice and chili oil. Heat, stirring constantly, until mixture begins to bubble. Transfer to a bowl and add the ladyfingers. Pour the sauce over the ladyfingers.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,coconut milk,yellow pepper,red onion,ketjap manis
title: Filipino Yellow Pepper Coconut Sauce
ingredients: 3 large yellow peppers ( i use green, but use what you like. i use green ) | 8 ounces bamboo shoots, trimmed ( fresh ) | 2 cups full-fat coconut milk | 1 teaspoon ketjap manis ( sweet soy sauce ) | 1 red onion, cut into thin strips
instructions: Place the peppers, bamboo shoots and red onion in a blender or food processor. Blend them with a few passes of water until very well mixed. Pour in the coconut milk and ketjap manis. Stir to blend the sauce well. Let it sit overnight. The next day, taste sauce and adjust seasoning, adding salt, pepper, or hot sauce to your taste.

Random Ingredients: goat meat,triple sec,plain yogurt,marinara sauce,apple butter,salad oil,egg white
title: Goat Meatballs with Sweet Onion Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon salad oil, or as needed | 1 1/2 pounds goat meat, shredded | 4 tablespoons triple sec | 1 tablespoon marinara sauce | 2 tablespoons apple butter
instructions: Whisk yogurt, egg white, and salad oil in a bowl until smooth and creamy. Mix goat meat, triple sec, and marinara sauce in a large bowl. Mix apple butter in a skillet over medium high heat until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,bay leaf,fish fillet,mango powder,chili sauce,seasoning,no salt tomato
title: Creamy Hot and Sweet Fish
ingredients: 1 lb fish fillets | 1/2 teaspoon mango powder | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning, any | 2 large no-salt canned tomatoes, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 whole bay leaf | 250 g cream cheese, softened | 1 teaspoon sweet chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon maggi seasoning, any
instructions: Rinse the fish fillets and pat dry. Blend all marinade ingredients and pour onto fish. Let stand, uncovered in the refrigerator overnight. Grill and turn once, basting occasionally with the marinade until cooked.

title: German Caper Molasses or Caraway-Sherry
ingredients: 6 teaspoons caraway seeds | 8 teaspoons sweet sherry
instructions: Toast caraway seeds in a small skillet over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Pour sherry into a small bowl. Cool. In a small bowl, combine caraway seeds and caraway liquid. Cook molasses over medium heat until caraway seed liquid is reduced to about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Lemon Berry Gratin
ingredients: 3 large onions ( about 8 ounces total weight ) | 1 large carrot, peeled and very thinly sliced | 1 lb fresh blueberries or 1 lb frozen blueberry | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 zest of, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Slice the onions very thinly. Cut the carrot slices into 1/4 inch thick slivers. Place the carrots in a large bowl and add the onions, the blueberries, lemon juice and zest. Mix with your hands or a pastry blender until the ingredients are well distributed. Transfer the vegetables to an 8 by 8 inch baking dish. Place the dish in the oven and roast until the carmelized, about 45 minutes. This will depend on the size of onions, carrots and berries, and whether you like to do this in 1-pound batches, or whether you like your gratin to be brown and have a crusty texture that doesn't break apart or clump when it's baked. This is delicious served warm and at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: duck,red wine,egg yolk,baby corn,spinach leaf,chocolate,orange peel
title: Duck and Spinach Cannelloni
ingredients: 12 ounces duck, boneless and skinless trimmed and chopped | 12 ounces spinach leaves, stems removed and washed | 2 ounces roasted baby corn, sliced | 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh orange peel, grated | 2 egg yolks, beaten lightly | 1/4 cup dry red wine
instructions: Combine the duck and remaining ingredients in a large bowl and season. Cook in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until the duck is cooked through and the spinach is wilted, 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Sorrel in Foil
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh key lime juice, about 2 limes, zest of | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 4 -6 leaves lettuce | 2 slices oranges or 2 slices lemons, each of | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Heat the ovento. Mix the key lime juice zest into the fenoor and add the dried fenugreek. Wash and dry the lettuce. Put the lettuce in the ovento and spoon the citrus/spice mixture over the lettuce. Squeeze on the orange or lemon slices.

title: Pan Fried Pork Tenderloin With Chillies
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 2 red chilies, seeded and sliced | 2 tablespoons cornflour, extra | 2 dried red chilies, seeded and finely sliced ( may omit if chillies are not available )
instructions: Dry fry the whole, using an oiled frying pan or grill to reduce the liquid slightly. Remove to a plate. Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Remove the tenderloin from the frying pan and set aside to rest for about 20 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove all the excess fat on the surface, using a teaspoon or pair of paper towels to remove the excess fat. Meanwhile combine the chilli paste ingredients in a cup and mix well. Sprinkle over the meat and set aside for 5 minutes. Using 2 forks, pull it from the pan as you go. Use your foreman grill to gently grip the meat, then lift it off the paper towel. Slice into strips, or shred into strips across the grain of the meat and serve with the chilli sauce or your favourite dipping sauce.

title: Cinco Loco
ingredients: 1 pound boneless pork shoulder | 1 pound biscuit ( buttermilk ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin | 1 teaspoon dried mustard | 1 can chicken broth | 1 1/2 pounds rigatoni pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a small baking dish. Cube pork into 1/2 inch cubes. Place biscuit dough in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with cumin, mustard, and chicken broth. Place the cubes in the baking dish. Cover the dish with a lid or aluminum foil. Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from heat. Cook rigatoni according to package directions. Drain. Serve stew over noodles.

title: Healthier Roasted Eggplant
ingredients: 1 eggplant | cooking oatmeal ( optional )
instructions: Bake eggplant in a pan, on the burner.

title: Pigs & Chicken - Vermicelli Pilaf
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts | 100 g vermicelli, finely chopped | 350 g pineapple rings, finely chopped | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 lemon peel, finely grated | 300 ml pumpkin puree | 1 lemon, juice of | 100 g mixed vegetables, coarsely chopped
instructions: Fry vermicelli in a little olive oil for 2 - 3 minutes and then drain on absorbent paper. Put chicken and chilli into a bowl with vermicelli, pineapple and all other ingredients except the pumpkin puree juice and lemon zest. Cover with cling film and set aside in a warm place for 30 minutes to marinate. Bring water to a boil, add vegetable and stir gently for 5 minutes. Reduce heat, add pumpkin and heat through but do not boil. Serve with rice.

title: Riesling
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 cups riesling wine
instructions: Fill a large bowl with ice and water. Stir in riesling until evenly coated. Set aside. Spray a rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray. Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil. Gently stir riesling into the boiling water. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until riesling is thick and transparent, about 20 minutes. Stir occasionally and allow to cool for 10 minutes. Transfer riesling to a plastic bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let riesling drain in the ice water for 15 minutes before stirring again. Transfer riesling to a resealable plastic bag. Seal and discard plastic inside riesling jar. Store riesling in a cool, dry place until needed.

title: Creamed Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, broken up | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon minced parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Place the cauliflower into a shallow buttered baking dish. Sprinkle the icing sugar and parsley over the cauliflower. Bake in the preheated oven 45 minutes 30 minutes, until crisp and browned.

title: Tuna and Potato Stir-Fry
ingredients: 6 medium yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed and cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 can diced tuna, drained | 1 tablespoon agar-agar | 1/4 cup chopped scallion
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook potatoes until tender and lightly golden brown, about 12 minutes. Meanwhile, drain tuna and crumble. Toss potato mixture with tuna and agar agar. Top with scallions.

title: Ceboladitas de Jitomate (Chile Pork)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into chunks | 4 habanero peppers, seeded and finely chopped | 3 -4 fresh green chili, seeded and finely chopped | 1 1/4 cups dijon mustard | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill ( optional )
instructions: Put pork pieces in a very large pot and cover with cold water, enough to cover. Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer very gently for about 2 hours until pork is tender. Pour off all of the liquid and reserve it when meat is cool enough to handle. When pork is cool enough to handle, remove skin and discard. Skim the fat from the meat. If you wish, you might stir in some reserved liquid. Remove and discard stems from the habanero chilies. Strain the habanero chilies. Remove seeds and membrane from the chilies if your want to use them. Cut the chilies into strips with a knife, like french fries. In a small bowl, mix hot pork with the chili. Place 1 tablespoon of the mustard in a small bowl, then slowly pour the remaining mustard over the chili mixture, spreading it evenly. Stir well to blend. Add 1 tablespoon of the dill in if using. Cover and refrigerate if possible for 2 hours to marinate. The chillies act as a condiment and have a smoke point so use sparingly.

Random Ingredients: allspice,celery,beef bouillon cube,ginger powder,za'atar spice mix,saffron,sausage,apricot jam
title: Roasted Sausages (Kebabs) My Way
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh sausage ( kebabs ) | 8 ounces apricot jam | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 2 teaspoons saffron ( parma ham can also be used ) | 1 teaspoon za'atar spice mix ( parma ham can also be used )
instructions: Preheat oven to mix all ingredients until well blended. Place sausage on a tray lined with parchment paper. Cover with foil and place in oven for approx 60 minutes. Cut a slit in the middle to allow steam. These should come out cleanly. The longer it stays open your smoke will be much more intense. Enjoy.

title: Grapefruit Squares - Hazelnut and Serrano Pepper Spread
ingredients: 4 cups grapeseed nuts | 4 serrano peppers, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Using a food processor or blender, process the grapeseed nuts and serrano peppers until they begin to form a fine paste. Gradually blend in the grated mixture to attain the smooth texture. You should have a smooth, pastelike consistency. Refrigerate until ready to use. Keep, refrigerated, in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jam,black mustard seed,beef steak,baking potato,white bread,mexican cheese,bay seasoning,flour tortilla
title: Beef Roll-Up (Bistec De Riz)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 1 lb beef flank steak | 3 tablespoons flour | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1 bag raspberries ( i like blue & strawberry ) | 1 lb baking potato ( i like yukon gold ) | 12 flour tortillas, 6 inch | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese
instructions: Spread the mustard seeds all over the beef steak. Sprinkle the flour on all sides of the meat. Add the packet old bay seasoning and refrigerate for half an hour.. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add potatoes and boil until tender. Drain. Slice potatoes and stir in the raspberries. Remove 1/4 of the beef and reserve the rest. Cut the reserved beef into strips. Cut the meat into strips and shred the meat with two forks. To assemble, place in a bowl and top with a few strips of raspberries and some shredded cheese. Roll up the tortillas. Place each tortilla on the plate. Place the rolled up beef on each tortilla, seam side down. Spray a skillet with vegetable oil and bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit until the tortillas are crisp and golden. Top with shredded cheese if desired and garnish with black pepper.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,sriracha sauce,currant,mace,ginger garlic paste,chicken leg
title: Grilled Chicken Tandoori
ingredients: 4 chicken legs | 100 g seedless red currants | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 tablespoons of mace | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek mild sriracha sauce | 4 -5 cm fresh english cucumbers
instructions: Pour enough cold water into a pan to be able to submerge the chicken. Cut a few small cuts in each leg. Place the chicken legs in the pan & prick them with a fork all over on all sides, then set aside. Grind the mace and sambal oelek together with the garlic & ginger. Mix all ingredients together with salt, pepper & half of the currants. Add chicken & toss until the legs are coated w/the marinade. Cover & marinate in the fridge for several hours or overnight. Grill over medium heat, basting ochely w/extra marinade. It's ready when the chicken is cooked & the juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,chicken bouillon,egg yolk,blueberry,creole mustard,greek yogurt,cream tartar,cream chicken soup
title: Blueberry Swiss Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 8 ounces sour cream ( low fat ok ) | 1/4 cup crumbled swiss cheese | 2 large egg yolks | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon creole prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 cup blueberries, washed ( frozen ok )
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine soup, sour cream, swiss cheese, egg yolks, yogurt, mustard, bouillon and cream of tartar until well blended.

title: Vegan Chinese Pepper Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 yellow bell pepper ( sliced thin ) | 1/2 cup vegan margarine | 1/2 cup of your favorite pizza sauce | 1/2 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns | 1/2 cup of grated cheese | 1/4 cup of sliced olive ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Brush pan with margarine. Add all the sauce ingredients to pan and stir to combine. Cook sauce approximately 20 - 25 minutes. Top with all the veggies. Sprinkle the top with cheese. Cook for 5 - 7 minutes, flipping halfway through.

title: Cheese Jelly
ingredients: 1 packet unflavored gelatin | 1 1/2 cups parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Place the gelatin in a heatproof bowl. Heat the water on the stovetop to 120c or so, swirling the bowl constantly. Heat the oven to 200c, 230 degrees or 140 degrees if using the oven. Whip the gelatine at the same time, then stir the water through until it is completely dissolved, then stir into the gelatin mixture. Pour into a heat resistant jelly mold and place in a pan of hot water, creating a dome shape or similar in the mould. Do not cover the surface of the jelly with boiling water or it will harden. The jelly can then also be turned into a white jelly mold following the directions of the gelatine package. Place the mold upside down on a cookie sheet and place a pan on the cookie sheet so that the jelly can spread as evenly as it can. Remove the gelatine dome from the water and set it on the cookie sheet to cool. When the jelly starts to harden, remove the mold onto a serving plate and spread the remaining cheese over the edge of the jelly. Cut into wedges and serve. Variation, make 1 packet of the same sized gelatine and add 3 packet of grated parmesan and 3 packet of grated romano.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,sesame seed,lamb,pretzel,onion flake,mushroom,vegetable oil cooking spray,nutritional yeast
title: Mushroom Beef Skewers (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 18)
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw cashews, toasted and cooled or 1/2 cup toasted unsalted peanuts, divided | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast ( gluten-free if desired ) | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/3 cup dehydrated mixed mushrooms | 1/3 cup raw cucumber, peeled, seeded, and cut into fine matchstick size slices | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 2 teaspoons cooking spray | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 1/2 lbs lean lamb, cut into about 1 inch cubes | 8 small pretzels, halved or 16 whole wheat bread rounds
instructions: Place cashews and 1/4 cup nutritional yeast in a food processor. Process until mixture and nuts are finely ground. Stir in sesame seeds, miso paste, mushrooms, cucumber, oil and onion flakes. Transfer to a large bowl. Add meat and toss to coat. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for up to 4 hours. Place pretzels on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper and place in freezer 30 minutes to soften. Drain meat and reserve. Preheat oven to 350°f brush pretzels with remaining 1/4 cup nutritional yeast. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven 15 minutes, or until golden in colour. Serve on a large platter with pretzel wedges.

title: Struffoli Cookies
ingredients: 1 lb unsalted butter | 3/4 lb ground round or 3/4 lb prosciutto | 1 pimiento, minced | 1 cup grated gruyere | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. In a large bowl, beat butter. Add ground meat and knead into a ball. Press or roll meat into 1/2 inch jelly roll pan, jelly roll style. Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes. Remove foil and spread with butter. In small bowl, stir pimiento, gruyere and spice until thoroughly blended. When meat is cooled, spread with this mixture 1/3 cup filling. Cut in half and then lengthwise into 1/4 inch wide strips. Arrange on top of the filling. Cover all with remaining cheese. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until crust is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,rotini pasta,cardamom powder,liquid smoke,button mushroom,yellow pepper,mace,beef tenderloin
title: Sicilian Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into large chunks | 8 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 1 medium yellow pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 teaspoons ground mace | 1 tablespoon cardamom powder | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 jar roasted red mushrooms, sliced | 1 package rotini pasta, uncooked
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Add beef, sliced mushrooms, yellow pepper and salt and pepper to the water in a large pot. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes, then add spice mixture and cook for an additional 5 minutes. Add the jar of roasted sweet red mushrooms and mix all together. Cover the pot and cook for an additional 15 - 20 minutes until the beef is tender. Serve with bread slices and salad.

Random Ingredients: rum,cider vinegar,ice water,egg white,chili flake,tomato puree,chicken bouillon cube
title: Pork Sauce (Mark Bittman)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 3 egg whites | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/4 cup ice water | 1/4 cup tomato puree ( canned is fine ) | 1 tablespoon rum, if desired ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk the vinegar, egg whites and chili flakes, set aside. In a small sauce pan, melt the tomato puree with the rum. In a medium sauce pot, bring about 1/8 cup of the water to a simmer, add the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, turn down the heat and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes, or until thickened. Let cool and transfer to a jar.

title: Mexican Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 bunch fresh italian parsley | 1/2 bunch fresh cilantro | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and minced | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped | 1/2 cup sherry wine
instructions: Chop remaining parsley and cilantro. Place in food processor with poblanos and nuts. Pulse until blended. Pour in sherry and process for 20 seconds.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,tomato soup,lemon grass,tabasco sauce,dashi,fish sauce,chili paste
title: Hot and Sour Gai Padang (Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dashi | 1 tablespoon fresh chili pepper, finely sliced ( red, green or black ) | 1 tablespoon lemon grass, finely sliced | 1 package instant dashi | 1 tablespoon lemon grass, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons chili paste, asian style | 1/2 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 small tomatoes | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: To make the sauce, in a small saucepan, add the 5 tablespoons dashi, chili, lemon grass and the 2 tablespoons of the juice from the lemon grass. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Combine the 3 tablespoons dashi, lemon grass, chili paste, fish sauce, and the 2 tomatoes in a blender and process for 10 seconds, or until smooth. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Pour the sauce into a cup and serve with the dipping hot fish.

title: Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can texas red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup nuts ( i use pistachios )
instructions: Pour red enchilada sauce in to a medium sauce pan. Bring to a boil, and cook until thick. Spread on browned ground beef, onions, and/or veggies that are in chunks. If you find that you are too thin for your tastes, leave on low. Top with more nuts. Continue to cook until heated through. Let cool for several minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,mix,jalapeno pepper,white flour,lime zest,five spice powder
title: Chickpea Pizza
ingredients: 400 g chickpea flour | 400 g white flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons jalapeno pepper | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 2 limes, zest of | 1 1/2 tablespoons of chinese seven spice powder
instructions: Whisk the wet ingredients together. Add chickpea flour slowly and mix. Add more flour if it becomes too difficult. The consistency of the batter will be a little fluid. Pour onto stone and bake at 200 degrees centigrade on middle shelf of oven for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lager beer,chocolate biscuit,deli roast beef,chili,green olive,iceberg lettuce,chicken breast half,sun tomato oil
title: Spicy Beef and Bacon Biscuit
ingredients: 2 soft crisp chocolate biscuits, baked | 2 ripe tomatoes, chopped | 1 1/2 cups sliced green olives | 1/2 lb cooked deli roast beef, chopped | 8 ounces fresh crisp chipped chili, cut in strips | 6 tablespoons catalana lager beer ( or use stout beer ) | 2 chicken breast halves, thin sliced | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained
instructions: Preheat oven according to package directions.

title: Black Bean Milkshake With Amaretto and Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup black beans, drained | 1 scoop vanilla ice cream | 1 tablespoon amaretto
instructions: Stir the beans and ice cream together in a blender until smooth.

title: Chinese Sweet Spareribs
ingredients: 3 lbs pork spareribs | garlic salt, to taste | 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Pour enough water into stockpot to cover spareribs. Soak overnight. Drain spareribs and place in stockpot. Cover and simmer over medium low heat for 2 hours. Remove spareribs from stockpot. Add remaining ingredients and heat through.

title: Chai Chaat
ingredients: 3 cups semolina | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Boil the semolina until it is soft and slightly thick, about 15 minutes. Add all the spices and cook on medium flame till they look slightly roasted and well mixed. Remove from flame with a spatula and serve over plain plain yoghurt and honey. Note, to make this a simple, easy recipe that tastes like yogurt, i like to mix it to a paste with a little salt and turmeric powder and set aside for about half an hour.

Random Ingredients: ice water,spice,avocado,peach,vegetable oil,golden raisin,cream celery soup,artichoke heart
title: Cornichoke Guacamole
ingredients: 1 can condensed golden raisins, drained | 1 can sliced sliced ripe peaches, drained ( reserve juice ) | 1/3 cup frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and chopped | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed spice | 3 cups vegetable oil | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Combine raisins, peaches, artichokes, soup, oil, and spices in a blender or food processor.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,white bread flour,celery rib,tea,guava,cucumber
title: Guava Soup
ingredients: 200 300 g white bread flour or 300 g bread flour | 400 g cream of chicken soup or 400 g cream of mushroom soup | 200 g guavas, sliced ( canned ) | 1/4 cup of diced celery rib | 2 tablespoons of diced cucumbers or 2 tablespoons other fruits | 1 -2 tablespoon tea, to dilute ( optional )
instructions: Put all the ingredients in the pot. Stir well, and place over medium fire. When the soup mixture comes to boil, turn off heat. Let soup cool. Put into freezer containers to solidify. At last, take soup out of the freezer and blend in a blender or food processor until desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: chili bean,rum,mirin,italian sausage,pimiento,italian bread,corn tortilla strip
title: Sausage and Sweet Potato Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage ( casings removed ) | 1 can chili with beans ( drained ) | 1 can italian bread ( i like my loaf of french loaf ) | 7 ounces pimientos | 16 -20 slices italian bread ( toasted ) | 1/2 cup rum | 1 -3 tablespoon mirin ( optional ) or 1 -3 tablespoon sweet pickle juice ( optional )
