instructions: Heat up your grill. Grill them until cooked through, turning once or twice. While the sausage is cooking slice the bread into thin squares. Place bread squares evenly in the center of a large plate that is lightly dusted with cornstarch. Pour the rum and mirin over the bread, making sure each piece has been covered. Add your sweet potato slices, pimentos and sausage. Serve with your choice of dippers, such as shredded lettuce.

title: Easy Irish Cabbage and Vegetable Hash
ingredients: 6 cups shredded cabbage, about 2 pounds | 1 medium turnip, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 large red onion, peeled, halved, and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2/3 cup sliced purslane ( optional ) | 1 -2 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: Fill a 2 quart pot with water. Bring to a boil. Add cabbage, turnip, and onion.

title: Beef and Stout
ingredients: 1 large red onion | 12 ounces beer | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | fresh marjoram or thyme | 2 packages porcini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Peel and quarter the onion. Combine all ingredients, except masala and tamarind in a large bowl and mix with a spoon until all ingredients are coated. Cut mushrooms into small pieces and toss with masala until evenly coated. Heat non stick pan over medium high heat until a drop of water sprinkled on bottom of pan sizzles. Quickly add the beef mixture and saute until it starts to brown, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,garlic paste,chicken bouillon cube,enchilada sauce,olive oil,rye bread,mozzarella cheese
title: Cranberry Crostini
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil | 4 tablespoons garlic paste | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes | 14 1/2 ounces enchilada sauce | 11 ounces of sweetened dried cranberries | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, grated ( or more depending on your preference ) | 8 ounces uncooked rye bread, sliced and left whole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a saucepan, heat olive oil over low. Add garlic paste. Add bouillon cubes and cook for 1 minute. Add beans and stir. Add enchilada sauce and cranberries to the sauce. Pour into an oven proof casserole dish and top with cheese. Cover with bread slices. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Chutney Snack
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chutney | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 8 nori | 8 maraschino cherries
instructions: Dissolve baking soda in chutney. Cut nori in 6 squares. Dip square in chutney. Place 2 cherries on each square and snack with a fork.

title: Crispy Five-Spice Martini (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 6)
ingredients: 200 g white vermouth | 2 tablespoons five-spice powder
instructions: Pour the vermouth into a cocktail shaker and pour 100ml boiling water inches. Shake vigorously to combine and then strain and serve. N. B., i know this sounds like it's a bit gross but you know how i feel about yourself.

title: Chinese Spiced Spiced French Fries
ingredients: 20 -24 slices pickled gingerroot | 1/3 cup sherry or 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In a frypan, mix well the ingredients except the fried french fries. Heat to boiling. Fry french fries until crisp on most side, remove and drain well. Serve hot.

title: Veal Chilies Con Pecoritos
ingredients: 6 ounces veal, ground | 2 ounces red chilies | 2 ounces pecans, chopped | 2 ounces dark rum | 1 ounce medium salsa
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Marinate for 1 - 2 hours in fridge. Serve with corn chips.

title: Tofu and Cheese Delight
ingredients: 200 g reduced-fat extra firm tofu ( abura age ) | 250 g halloumi cheese ( or other soft cheese of choice ) | 1/4 cup frozen green pea | 25 g ground meats | 1/4 cup pecan pieces, lightly toasted ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon mixed spice ( optional )
instructions: Place tofu block in microwave and microwave for 1 minute or so, until warm. Cut cheese into 8 even chunks and place in a microwave safe ramekin. Add 1/4 cup water and mix. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Tofu should be soft and starting to curl up in the microwave oven. Sprinkle with nuts, if using. When tofu is cool, remove the block from the microwave and scoop out the tofu and cheese mix. Break the block into smaller pieces and place on a plate and spoon meat over top of it. Add the mixed spice to taste if using, and sprinkle with pecans if using. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,beef tenderloin,rye bread,white mushroom
title: Beef Tenderloin With Mushrooms and Rye Bread
ingredients: 12 ounces beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup prepared mustard horseradish or 1/4 cup prepared horseradish-flavored horseradish | 10 ounces mushrooms, sliced | 12 small white mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed | 3 beef bouillon cubes
instructions: Preheat broiler. Brush steaks with a little water while broiling. Lightly grease a large oven proof skillet or griddle. Slice steaks crosswise into thin slices against grain. Combine mustard and horseradish in small bowl. Soak mushrooms in 1/4 cup prepared horseradish mixture at room temperature for 10 minutes. Arrange mushrooms over steak. Reserve remainder of horseradish mixture in a small saucepan. Stir bouillon cubes into remaining horseradish mixture. Remove mushroom slices. Spoon over mushrooms in skillet. Broil, turning once, until steaks are medium rare. Serve with remaining horseradish mixture.

title: Glutinous Rice Dumplings
ingredients: 2 cups glutinous rice, uncooked | 1 package dry yeast | 24 square wonton wrappers | 1 cup grand marnier
instructions: Soak rice over night or in the refrigerator. Pour some water, so that it bubbles. Remove from pot and bring to a boil.

title: Chinese Chive and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 medium potato, diced | 2 tablespoons chives, snipped | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 1/4 tablespoons hot tap water
instructions: Cook the diced potato. Stir in the chives and vinegar. Cool the potato gently. Just before serving, add in the hot water in a steady stream. The vinegar will thicken and turn dark green. If the water is cloudy you may add some at a time. I think this salad tastes better after chilling for 3 hours.

title: Kashmiri Style Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup yogurt ( sour ) | 2 tablespoons sour cream | coriander seeds ( roughly chopped )
instructions: Mix ingredients together, garnish with paprika if desired.

title: French Pea Crostini With Croutons
ingredients: 2 cups yellow peas, cooked ( or frozen ) | 3 -4 baguettes, cut crosswise into 8 slices | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: If you froze the peas in baguettes, they have to be thawed in the fridge. Sprinkle the peas with a little salt and leave to thaw completely. Preheat grill to medium high. Slice baguette and place on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with cornstarch and coat slices lightly with cornstarch. Grill on each side for 2 minutes.

title: Kofta (South African Kebab)
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 2 tablespoons masa harina ( corn flour ) | 2 tablespoons grated raw cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped shallots | 1 tablespoon fresh orange zest, finely grated | 1/4 teaspoon saffron ( optional ) | sliced avocados, for garnish
instructions: Combine the ground lamb and coconut oil. Shape the meat mixture into golf ball size meatballs and flatten slightly, if desired. Combine the masa harina, cheese, shallots, orange zest, saffron, and salt and pepper to taste. Place the meatballs on a platter, cover, and refrigerate until chilled, about 45 minutes. Preheat the oven to 500°f place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, until the meatballs are golden brown. Remove, and transfer to a platter. Garnish with sliced avocados.

title: Apple-Avocado Tofu Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, drained | 1 teaspoon dried herbs | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and diced | 1 zucchini, grated | 1 tablespoon roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the tofu on the prepared baking sheet, and drizzle with about half the apple juice. Sprinkle with herbs and mix thoroughly. Bake tofu, uncovered, for about 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until nicely browned. Meanwhile, place avocado, zucchini, and nuts in a bowl. Spoon some of the tofu mixture into the avocado mixture, then roll up the tofu. Serve with a side of sweet pepper, jalepeños, and sour sauce.

title: German Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 head bibb lettuce | 1 can sauerkraut | 1 cup catsup | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock ( or 1 1/2 cups canned chicken juice from cooked potatoes )
instructions: Clean and cut the bibbe head into a medium size bowl. Place each head into a separate large bowl. Rinse and slice the head into thin strips. Place the bibbe strips on the bottom of a large salad bowl or similar to the head lettuce. Place the sauerkraut in the bowl. Sprinkle the catsup on top of the sauerkraut. Add the stock or juice from the potatoes. Mix everything together with a fork or a slotted spoon. Serve immediately. Enjoy.

title: Mangoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Sift brown sugar, flour, and grand marnier together. Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, stirring and brushing every 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: butter,tahini,pecan half,heavy whipping cream,cilantro stem,orange,green chile pepper
title: Frozen Texas Pecan Cream Dessert
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pecan halves, toasted | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup butter | 1 bunch fresh cilantro stems | 2 green chile peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon orange rind | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice, or more
instructions: Place pecans into a food processor, and process until finely ground. Stir in whipping cream, butter, cilantro, chilies, orange rind, and tahini. Spoon into serving dishes, and top with more pecan halves. Cover, and freeze overnight. Remove from the freezer 15 to 20 minutes before serving to develop flavor.

title: Mika's Sausage and Bacon Triangles
ingredients: 8 -12 large sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 15 -16 ounces condensed cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons nori ( asian seaweed, finely chopped ) | 8 ounces cooked sausage, sliced ( use your favourite sausage ) | 4 medium bananas, cut in 1/2-inch slices on the diagonal ( or use a milder one ) | 4 cans nori ( or a combination of all four, or use your favourite sauce ) | ice
instructions: Thaw the phyllo pastry, and place it on the counter to dry out. If you make it fresh while it dry, the phyllo will be a bit sticky but not as dense as baking or baking powder. Place about 13x9 inch pan on the counter with one inch borders going a bit thicker for the two long sides. If you cut in half horizontally, i found that cutting them cross wise would make the dish more manageable, but this is not necessary. If using phyllo, remove the dough about half an inch before you cut it into strips about 1/4 inch wide to match the length of your pan. Using a sharp knife, cut strips about an inch wide and 2 inches long across the strips leaving about 1 inch around the two long sides. Repeat cutting more strips to the four corners. Add 2 tbsp of cream of chicken soup in the center of each strip. On your counter, spread a thin layer of nori. If the sour cream mixture is being used, spread a small thin layer of the sour cream mixture on the nori closest to you. Add about 6 or 7 strips on top of the sour cream mixture, one for each triangle, to cover the bottom of your pan. Layer 3 strips of sausage on top of the top layer, then add more sausage on top of the noodles, and then add another 3 strips, so that they cover the rest of the filling. If any more strips, spread more soup, and add another 12 strips to create three more layers, placing 3 strips on top of the first two strips. Next, add 4 more strips, so that they cover the noodles and the rest of the filling, but the last strips are up to the length of the pan. Take a spoon, put a piece of plastic wrap onto the top of the pan and carefully invert the pan onto it so that the bottom layer is on top. After all the strips are inches from the top layer, remove the plastic wrap and put the pan back on the counter or another flat counter or board. Cut 3 slits on the plastic wrap. Carefully, remove the pan or the plastic wrap, then pour out the pastry into a flat tray or a rectangular serving dish. Sprinkle the top with more nori and or another thick layer of sour cream, and a couple of dallops of cheese and pepper flakes. Cut the pastry into slices. Place the samali's in the pan and flip the two edges of the pastry over. Remove the samali from the pan and top with a little extra sour cream or other toppings, if desired. If there is any left in the pan, gently peel off the plastic wrap as it came out of the samali's. Cut into slices. The bottom layer should be dry, but not watery. Cut into 4 squares, then cut each square into quarters, making 4 triangles. Store the samali's in the fridge to mellow the sour cream flavor, for about one week.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,turmeric,green curry paste,rice wine vinegar,romano cheese,yoghurt
title: Curried Yoghurt
ingredients: 400 ml yoghurt | 1 teaspoon green curry paste | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 3 teaspoons grated romano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Put yoghurt in a glass, ceramic or ceramic bowl. Add curry paste and stir to mix through. Pour vinegar, rice wine vinegar, turmeric and grated cheese over yoghurt. Cover and chill, covered, for at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,chicken bouillon cube,scallop,italian breadcrumb,tomato,fine bulgur,sugar
title: Gugelhosha
ingredients: 2 cups fine bulgur | 1 medium spanish onion, finely diced | 3 3 - 4 cups chicken bouillon cubes, as directed in the seasoning, but you can also use beef broth | 1 cup crushed tomatoes | 1 can whole peeled tomatoes | 1 dash sugar | 1/2 cup fine bulgur, fine or 1/2 cup bulgur, for top ( fine ) | 2 -3 teaspoons italian breadcrumbs, for top
instructions: Put the bulgur in a large bowl. Add the diced onion and cook on low until translucent. Place the broth and tomatoes in a saucepan, and add water to cover the base. If the can of whole tomatoes comes in, add them now. Bring the broth to a boil, then turn off the heat. Add the chopped olives and the sugar. Drain the liquid from the tomato can through a sieve to remove the seeds. If you don't have access to the can of whole tomatoes, add them now. Pour the broth mixture into the hot rinsed/marinated bulgur and stir well so all of the bulgur is coated with the mixture. Add the crumbs to the bulgur, stir until the crumbs look toasted. Sprinkle over the sugared tomato mixture and serve warm. You can also put the grated mozzarella on top the filling instead.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,sharp cheddar cheese,seasoning salt,poppy seed,bread machine yeast
title: Strawberry Bread
ingredients: 2 lbs whole fresh strawberries | 2 teaspoons fresh yeast, divided | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 8 cups bread machine yeast, 1-1/2 cups, 1lb | 10 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Place the strawberries, 1 teaspoon of yeast, and 2 cups of the bread flour into the pan of a blender. Process on high for 1 minute or until the liquid is completely smooth. Transfer to a 9 x 5 loaf pan. Add the remaining yeast, 1 teaspoon of yeast, and the remaining 3 cups of flour, and process on high for 2 to 3 minutes or until the dough is smooth. It may be easier to roll out the dough, in a food mill, if the dough is too sticky to roll out. Transfer the dough to a large bowl, cover with a cloth, and set aside to rise for 15 to 30 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the oven to 450 degrees. Dissolve the remaining 1 teaspoon of yeast in approximately 1/4 cup of hot water. Let rest for 5 minutes, then mix with the poppy seeds. Cut the dough into 24 equal parts. Shape each piece into a loaf around the poppy seed. Place the loaves on an oiled baking sheet and brush tops with the beaten egg. Let the loaves rise in a warm room of about 80 degrees for 45 minutes. Bake for one hour until golden brown on top.

title: Red Beans a La Brasa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cans red beans, drained | 1 teaspoon ground amaretto ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash the beans with the back of a spoon until the mixture is smooth and slightly thickened. Stir in amaretto.

title: Sweet and Sour Posole
ingredients: 1 can hominy, drained | 5 cans picante sauce | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: In a large bowl, blend hominy, picante sauce, honey, dill, and cardamom together. Refrigerate over night or 2 days before serving.

title: Spice Paste (For Grilling)
ingredients: 1 cup peppercorn, coarsely ground | 1 tablespoon garam masala ( can be made as per your own tastes )
instructions: Gently stir all the ingredients together. This should result in coarsely ground mixed spices that you may use as a rub or as a thick paste. Allow 2 - 3 tablespoons of paste for each pound of grilling meat.

title: Sausage & Cauliflower Pies
ingredients: 150 g beef chipped sausages | 75 g cauliflower, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon wheat pastry flour ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c, spray a 12 hole patty pan or patty pan with cooking spray. Mix together sausage & cauliflower in a small bowl, then season generously with salt & pepper & mix well. Divide between patty pans & bake for 40 - 45 minutes until golden brown & cooked through. Serve hot with your favourite vegetables or fresh vegetable accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,hot water,fish sauce,sun tomato oil,sultana,bell pepper,meatball
title: Flambéed Meatballs With Peppers and Sun-dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb mixed meatballs, cut into 24 slices | 1 1/4 cups sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, chopped | 2 tablespoons sultanas ( golden raisins ) | 1 1/2 cups gruyere cheese, grated | 4 cups hot water | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 -3 bell peppers, sliced ( sweet or red )
instructions: In a shallow baking dish, divide meatballs and sundried tomatoes between 8 plates or on 6 plates, top with cheese. Add the warm water, fish sauce, and peppers in a slow steady stream through the dish. Let stand, uncovered, at room temperature for 10 to 15 minutes to allow flavours to meld. Serve accompanied by steamed couscous.

title: Fresh Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup italian stewed tomatoes, drained | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup canned plum tomato, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried crushed red chili, broken into small pieces
instructions: Pour the tomatoes in a colander, remove as much excess juice as possible, and discard the tomato skins. Combine the tomato pulp with the bread crumbs, tomato pieces, chili, and salt and pepper. Let stand over a bowl while preparing the tomatoes. Serve warm.

title: Aussie Beer Manicotti
ingredients: 1 lb fresh manicotti | 12 ounces plain flour | 1 pint watermelon, peeled, seeded, cubed | 12 ounces manicotti | 12 ounces st. lager beer | 3 -4 cups water
instructions: Put one quart of water in a saucepan and cover with the beer. Bring slowly to the boil, then turn heat to low and simmer for at least an hour. Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix flour with plenty of salt in a bowl. Put one third of the dough onto a lightly floured board and, using a knife, cut it into 10 pieces. Roll the pieces in the salt then the flour. Put the rest of the dough onto a lightly floured board and fold it over and gently twist until it is combined. With a fork or your hands, put the pasta into a large littor roasting tin or an oblong baking tin and press the dough to flatten it. Arrange the manicotti around the base of the tin and fill the rest of the way with boiling water. Add 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups of water to the jug of water in the pot and pour over the pasta. Cover tightly, place in preheated oven and bake for 45 minutes. When the pasta is cooked, drain and put them in a large bowl along with the remaining water. Stir well, then spoon into bowls. Serve with a little parmesean if liked.

title: Rosemary & Raisins (Tear Rosemary)
ingredients: 20 g rosemary leaves, tightly packed | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence
instructions: Remove stems from rosemary leaves. Wash leaves thoroughly and place leaves on a piece of greaseproof paper towel. Wipe away the paper and place leaves in a microwaveable bowl with 1 teaspoons of water. Lightly steam on high power, covered in a microwave safe dish for 2 minutes remove from microwave and place under a cold, dry cloth. Cover and leave for 1½ hrs or overnight. Check after 2 hours and add a little water if water evaporates. Allow to cool completely. You can freeze this for up to 2 weeks. Using a small spoon or small sharp knife, carefully scrape away the leaves of the rosemary. You can chop the leaves in a food processor or with a mortar and pestle, adding more rosemary as you go. Replace paper towel and lightly roll up the leaves, starting on the flat sides. Sprinkle with the vanilla essence. Store in an airtight tin for upto 2 weeks or longer.

title: Mexican Rice Vermicelli
ingredients: 1 package uncooked rice vermicelli | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 teaspoons orange zest
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water combine vermicelli, picante sauce and orange zest. Cook until tender but still firm. Remove from heat, drain. Serve warm.

title: Normandy Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 1/2 cup light cream | 1/2 cup sweet vermouth | 1/4 cup light sour cream | 2 teaspoons fresh coriander, minced | 2 teaspoons simple syrup | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place pork tenderloin in a heavy freezer bag.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,stone mustard,cilantro stem,cornstarch,sesame seed,wheat flour
title: Tex Mex Sesame Corn Chips
ingredients: 3/4 cup stone ground mustard | 1 1/4 cups warm taco sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | cilantro stem ( optional )
instructions: Whisk mustard, 3/4 cup taco sauce, sesame seeds, and corn starch in medium bowl to blend. Add flour gradually, mixing between each addition, until dough is smooth and pulls away from the sides of the bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Preheat griddle or large, nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Form dough into 1/2 inch thick disc. Press disc evenly with back of small fork. Cook disc in hot skillet until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Turn disc onto lightly floured surface. Dredge with flour. Garnish with cilantro sprigs, if desired.

title: Chinese Vanilla Frosting
ingredients: 2 cups cold vanilla flavored ice cream, about | 1 -2 inch piece fresh ginger root, peeled and julienned
instructions: Scrape ingredients into a small blender, and process till smooth.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,flour tortilla,molasses,egg white,mini chocolate chip
title: Easy Mexican Breakfast
ingredients: 4 large eggs | 4 mini chocolate chips ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 4 small flour tortillas | 3 tablespoons melted mini chocolate chips
instructions: Mix everything together and let sit over night in fridge. Warm your tortillas for a couple of minutes in a 350°f oven, or in microwave on low for about 45 seconds each side, then set aside. Mix everything together except the 1 tbsp melted mini-chips. Once everything is mixed and ready use the leftover ingredients and place in tortilla bowl. Spray a nonstick skillet with non stick spray. Add egg mixture, roll up and put in the pan with the rolled tortillas. Cook on low for about 10 minutes for me. Serve with chopped cilantro, salsa, anything you want. Garnish with a spoon of melted mini chips on the side, if desired.

Random Ingredients: shallot,lasagna noodle,potato reg,white wine,barbecue sauce,button mushroom,mace
title: Potatoes & Mushroom Lasagne
ingredients: 1 lb potato ( peeled ) | 1 -2 cup mushroom ( sliced ) | 1 shallot ( minced ) | 1 can bush's barbecue sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 cup white wine | 1 lb lasagna noodle
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut the potatoes into 6 1/2 pieces and cook in a large pot of boiling water for 10 minutes or until tender. Remove the potatoes and place in a colander to drain and cool. Slice the mushrooms and shallots and sauté in a skillet in a little butter until softened. Add mushrooms and sauté for an additional 3 to 5 minutes. Add the bbq& mace, then mix in the wine. Bring to a boil and simmer, uncovered, for 3 to 5 minutes or until the mixture is tender. Drain the potatoes, return to the pan and add the sauce. Cook for an additional 15 minutes or until the mixture is heated through.

title: Poblano Pepper-Mustard Puff Pastry Triangles
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry sheets | 2 small poblano peppers | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Slice one poblano pepper lengthwise into half moons. Place 1 tablespoon of mustard seeds in the center of each square of pastry, then top with a poblano pepper, the opposite half of the pepper and a little salt. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 375°f for 20 minutes.

title: Pao Asado(A French Bread Salad)
ingredients: 1 head bok choy, shredded | 3 bunches greens | 1 cup gruyere cheese, grated ( more or less to taste ) | 2 leeks, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Put greens in a bowl with half the grated cheese and half the sliced leeks. Sprinkle with salt, black pepper, garlic powder. Pour the remaining cheese over the top and sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Serve with toasted french baguette as a side salad or with any meat or game dish.

title: Noodles from Korean Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 lb bean sprouts | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Place the bean sprouts in a bowl with the chile and stir to combine seasonings and let it rest for 10 min covered. After 10 min remove sprouts and strain the liquid from the bean sprouts. Set the bean sprouts aside. Put the noodles in a dutch oven and fill it about 1/2 full with boiling water. Cover and cook for about 8 to 10 minutes or until the noodles are flexible and tender.

Random Ingredients: brandy,self rising flour,cocoa,wheat spaghetti,caster sugar,cardamom,pork rib
title: Pork Spaghetti in Chocolate Brandy
ingredients: 200 g small whole wheat spaghetti | 250 ml sugar | 6 cardamoms, capsules | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 2 kg pork ribs | 1 bunch fresh speckled brandy
instructions: Cook spaghetti for 8 minutes in a large pan, or until spaghetti is al dente. Meanwhile, put the sugar, cardamom, cocoa, and 3 litres water together in a large, heavy based saucepan. Bring to the boil over high heat and add the pork. Turn down the heat, cover and cook for 35 - 40 minutes, and then remove the pork from the pot and set aside. Drain spaghetti and return it to the pan, stir and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and cook for 5 minutes, or until the sauce thickens. Return the pork to the spaghetti and mix thoroughly. Discard the cardamom pods and spoon the spaghetti into bowls, leaving about 2cm/1/2cm/2in of the noodle showing at the top of the spaghetti. Pour the brandy over the spaghetti and serve.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,bow tie pasta,yellow bell pepper
title: Penne Pasta with Veggies
ingredients: 1 package bow tie pasta | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, chopped | 10 ounces penne pasta, cooked
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Add bell pepper, cooked drained and drained penne to skillet. Cover and cook 2 minutes until pasta is tender and peppers look coated with sauce.

title: Moroccan Baked Eggplant
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs eggplants | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarsely ground cumin | 5 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 large yellow sweet potato, peeled and cut lengthwise into 5 slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Slice eggplants lengthwise into 1 thick slices and sprinkle liberally with a mixture of the salt and cumin. Place slices on a sheet pan and sprinkle generously with a little more salt and cook until soft then spread out on paper towels to drain. Place slices on parchment or foil lined baking sheet and bake in 375 f oven about 25 minutes or until browned, puffed and slightly crisp. Spread apricot jam on top of slabs. Top with sweet potato slices and continue baking until hot and bubbling, about 5 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: bread,miracle whip,bell pepper,buttermilk,salmon fillet,pumpkin pie spice,tomato paste,lasagna noodle
title: Tasty Salmon Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package uncooked lasagna noodles | 4 fresh salmon fillets or 4 frozen salmon fillets | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice | 1 -2 tablespoon dry bread | butter-flavored grill packets ( or similar flavor enhancer ) | 1 medium tomatoes, seeded and diced | 1 can tomato paste | 1 small bell pepper, roasted, sliced and cut into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a wide saucepan over medium heat, whisk buttermilk and pumpkin pie spice until well blended.

title: Acee (Spicy Sausages)
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage link, sliced thin ( i use 1/2 of the links ) | 20 -25 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Put sausage slices in a casserole dish that you can cover with oil. Sprinkle the spice mixture over all. Bake at 375 degrees for about 30 minutes, or until crisp and browned.

title: Greek Christmas
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped citron peel | 1 cup finely chopped parsley | 8 cups crushed ice
instructions: Combine the citrus peel, parsley, and 4 cups of crushed ice in a large plastic or paper bag. Seal tightly and shake to blend. Strain into a small pitcher and top with the remaining crushed ice. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,cardamom pod,peppercorn,oregano sprig,golden raisin,tortilla,saffron strand
title: Ara-Saffron Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 4 tablespoons saffron strands | 2 -3 tablespoons saffron threads, divided | 1 1/8 cups packed golden raisins, divided | 1 1/4 cups crushed peppercorns, divided | 5 -7 cardamom pods | 3 -4 fresh oregano sprigs
instructions: Trim any excess fat. Cube meat into pieces 1 inch wide and 1/2 inch thick. Mix remaining ingredients and half of saffron in a bowl to marinate meat. Put beef in crockpot on top of saffron, add marinade, cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Add raisins and peppercorns. Cook covered on high for 1 hour more. Check at 3 hours. Serve with buttered toast.

title: Pasta Chips With Pecorino Romano and Peanuts
ingredients: 4 -8 cups peanut oil | 1 cup coarsely grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Heat oil in a deep fryer to 360º f. Place the pecorino romano in a medium bowl. Dip your chips, 3 at a time, into the peanut oil. Deep fry them until they turn a golden brown color, 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer to a dry dish and let stand until cool. Store at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,head garlic,red potato,lemon juice,olive,irish whiskey
title: Spiced Irish Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 2 small red potatoes, halved, quartered | 1 head garlic, cloves peeled | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 tablespoons irish whiskey | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 2 tablespoons olive, chopped
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Coat the potato halves with cooking spray. Place on the prepared grill, close lid and cook until slightly charred, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer the potatoes to a cutting board and cut into 1 inch thick slices. Place onto a wire rack and let cool. Place the garlic cloves in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of water and let sit for 15 minutes, then drain. Pat dry with a paper towel. Place the drained cloves into a small saucepan, cover with olive oil, bring to a boil, and cook for 1 minute. Remove 1 cup of the liquid and set aside. Remove all but 1 tablespoon of the liquid. Place potatoes onto a clean work surface and cut each potato slice in half with a knife or kitchen shears into quarters. Spray the potatoes with vegetable oil cooking spray and arrange on top of the garlic cloves. Serve with the reserved liquid. Whiskey and lemon juice can be served separately, but serve at once.

title: Roasted Mozzarella and Fennel Spread
ingredients: 1 lb fresh buffalo mozzarella | 8 teaspoons fresh mixed herbs | 4 medium size fennel seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Cut the mozzarella in half, horizontally and make 4 1/2 inch thick slices. Place in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle the mozzarella slices evenly and rub with mixed herbs. Insert 1 teaspoon of fennel seed in each mozzarella slice, right to edge. Turn fennel slices over, cut side facing up, and continue to coat with remaining fennel seeds. Sprinkle cheese with remaining fennel seeds. Bake for 15 - 25 minutes, or until cheese is golden, shaking the pan occasionally for even cooking. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,brown rice,red bell pepper,pork loin,dark soy sauce
title: Asian Pork and Vegetables with Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless pork loin, cut into strips | 2 cups uncooked instant brown rice | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 red bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 5 fresh red chile peppers, thinly sliced
instructions: Place pork strips in a large skillet. Add soy sauce, and cook over moderate heat, stirring frequently, until chicken is cooked, about three minutes. Add red bell pepper and chiles. Cook over moderate heat until peppers are crisp tender, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hungarian Beef With Veggies
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1 head broccoli, cut into small pieces | 3 medium zucchini | 1/2 teaspoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Place beef in crockpot and top with vegetables. Sprinkle paprika on top. Cover and cook on high for one hour. Turn to low and cook for 8 hours or until meat falls of bone. Remove beef to cutting board and skim fat. Shred or slice meat and serve with vegetable stew.

title: Olive Salad - Antipasto Style
ingredients: 6 slices kalamata olives | 1/4 cup mixed salad green
instructions: Arrange salad greens on a serving platter. Top with olives. Serve.

title: Macaroni With a Hazelnut and Black Olive Flavor
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni | 10 ounces macaroni | 2 cans sliced black olives | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Cook macaroni to JUST firm in the middle. Drain. While pasta is cooking, rinse olives and slice into rings. Add olives and garlic salt to a large pan with some butter on top. When the pan is hot pour macaroni in and then mix with olive oil and a large handful of crushed walnuts. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sazon goya seasoning,yogurt,cumin seed,cherry tomato,grape tomato,sake
title: Yogurt and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 32 ounces yogurt ( can be low-fat ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 3 -4 cherry tomatoes | 12 grape tomatoes | 1/3 ounce goya sazon goya seasoning | 1 teaspoon sake or 1 teaspoon dry sherry
instructions: Combine yogurt with cumin seeds. In a medium serving bowl, line a sheet tray with parchment paper and place whole tomatoes in a single layer on the baking sheet. Pour the yogurt mixture over the tomatoes, coating each layer. Cover and refrigerate for two to twelve hours. Remove from fridge 20 minutes before serving. Just before serving, slice the tomatoes into 8 slices using a very sharp knife. Arrange tomatoes around the ice.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,tarragon leaf,bamboo shoot,vegetable stock,coconut milk,hazelnut,red chili powder
title: Red Pepper & Hazelnut Soup
ingredients: 3 quarts vegetable stock | 1/2 cup sweet red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon red chile powder | 2 tablespoons tarragon leaves | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 can coconut milk | 1 teaspoon hazelnuts, toasted & chopped
instructions: Pour the stock into large pot & bring it to rolling boil. Add the pepper flakes, chili powder, tarragon leaves, bamboo shoots & coconut milk. Bring to a boil & continue stirring until stock boils again & then lower heat & simmer for about 20 mins. Remove from heat & chill for 10 mins. Garnish with toasted hazelnuts.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,red chili,garlic paste,egg substitute,saffron thread,shallot,leafy green
title: Tunisian Style Parsnips
ingredients: 500 g parsnips ( peeled and shredded ) | 1 red chili, chopped | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 3 shallots | 3 sprigs leafy greens | 3 saffron threads | 2 eggs
instructions: Place the parsnips in a colander and wash well. Place in a salad bowl. Cook the chilli, garlic and shallots in a frying pan and fry until aromatic. Mix everything together. Add saffron and stir to combine. Pour over the parsnips and toss. Beat the eggs. Pour over the salad just before serving.

title: Vermont Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 red chili pepper, cut into pieces | 5 ounces vanilla beans, scraped | 6 ounces apple cider
instructions: Simmer beans in water 15 minutes or until barely tender, but not mushy. Drain. Strain through cheesecloth.

title: Sweet Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 jar pinto beans, drained | 1 cup burgundy wine | 2 packages almond paste | 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( for spicier taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Place the refried beans in a 9x13 oven safe baking dish. Mix together the beans, wine, almond paste, cornstarch and cayenne in a bowl. Spread a layer of the bean mixture over the beans, then spread another layer of the bean mixture before placing the next layer of bean mixture on top. Bake uncovered for 1 hour, uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes or until the top is golden brown and bubbly.

title: Kraft Taco Seasoning for Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 ounce kraft parmesan-romano all-garlic herb and garlic seasoning mix ( kraft brand is no longer in the mix ) | 1 bag kraft mexican style shredded four cheese, with the seasoning mix
instructions: Prepare your favorite taco salad using the directions on the packet. When ready, mix in the grated cheese. Use 2 1/2 tablespoons of cheese for each taco salad, according to how many servings you want the taco filling. Enjoy.

title: Tzatziki Potato Salad
ingredients: butter flavor crisco cooking spray | 1 package frozen tzatziki | 1 red potatoes | 1 can mango chutney | 1/2 cup shredded fat-free whipped topping | fresh mango chutney
instructions: Spray a 9x13 inch pan with cooking spray. Peel red potato and cut into thin strips. Arrange on the bottom of the prepared pan. Combine tzatziki, chutney and sliced potatoes. Spread over potatoes. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator and sprinkle with additional fat free whipped topping if desired.

Random Ingredients: celery leaf,wheat tortilla,bonito flake,cornflour,carrot,curry powder,fontina cheese
title: Easy Carrot and Garlic Wraps
ingredients: 8 whole wheat tortillas | 300 g grated fontina cheese | 400 g grated carrots | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon grated fresh flat-leaf carrot | 2/3 teaspoon dried chicken powder or 2/3 teaspoon dried bonito flakes | 1 small bunch celery leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven 200f or 200°c. Line a baking tray with greased paper and place a tortilla on it. Top with grated fontina cheese, grated carrot, grated fresh carrot, coriander seeds, curry. Fold wrap in half and then in the centre to enclose filling. Press wraps with the back of a spatula to ensure that none of the filling spills out. Repeat with remaining tortilla, filling and wraps.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,mirin,mozzarella cheese,curry powder,enchilada sauce,poblano chile,steak
title: Steak with Chili Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks | 2 cups enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1/2 cup mirin ( japanese cooking wine ) | 1/4 cup pure vanilla bean | shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Marinate flank steak with curry, mirin, vanilla bean, a few drops of oil, chile puree and shredded cheese at least 30 minute let marinade sit for 30 minutes slice flank steak, against grain in the desired shape you want the beef as thin as possible.

Random Ingredients: soba noodle,rum,rice wine,swiss cheese,spice,bacon,ranch dip mix
title: Swiss Noodle Salad With Rum and Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 8 slices bacon | 1 package soba noodles | 1/2 cup dry rice wine | 1 can ranch dip mix | 1/4 cup light rum ( optional ) | 1/2 cup reduced-fat swiss cheese | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon spice ( optional )
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Reserve in a cup. Cook spagetti in boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain. Combine all ingredients in bowl except the spagetti. Toss lightly. Cover and chill overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Greek Flouon Fritters (Nouc Mamoul)
ingredients: 1 cup flour | 10 tablespoons orange zest, in strips
instructions: Dust with flour. Place zest onto a flat surface. Add sugar. Form into small balls. Roll between palms of hands into strips about 3 inches long. Cook over medium flame, until tan color. When cool, store in airtight container.

title: Stir Fry Beef on Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, thinnest strip, fat trimmed and all visible membrane removed | 4 tablespoons oatmeal | 1 can beef broth | 1 -2 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Trim and cut the beef into bite sized strips. Mix ingredients and microwave on high 5 minutes. Add more beef broth if the beef is not moist enough. Serve over white rice.

title: Apple Butter
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple juice ( or fruit juice ) | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar, sifted
instructions: Combine apple juice or fruit juice and sugar in small saucepan. Heat until sugar dissolves. Cook over medium high heat, stirring constantly. When mixture is hot, cool for 1 hour, then beat until smooth. Spoon icing to cover the tops of the cookies. Chill cookies in refrigerator. Sift confectioners sugar and fold over the cookies before serving.

title: Cider Vinegar Lamb
ingredients: 500 g lamb, cut into pieces | 1 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 cup chopped dried thai chile, left over from stinging leaves | 2 tablespoons milo
instructions: In a large saucepan stir fry lamb pieces in apple cider vinegar until lightly browned and cooked. Bring to boil. Add chilies and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in milo and simmer on low heat 30 minutes or until meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,black olive,pea,kalamata olive,pork chop,soy sauce
title: Pork Chops with Bean Salad
ingredients: 8 pork chops | 8 ounces peas, fresh shelled | 6 ounces kalamata olives, pitted and split in half | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup black olives ( to garnish )
instructions: Toast the pea halves, they should be a nice golden brown color and the skins shouldn't be tough. Trim excess fat. Brush the chops with oil and grill over a high heat or until cooked as desired. When done, remove from the pan and let cool. Chop the beans into bite sized pieces. Wash the beans and separate the skins from the pea pods. Combine all the ingredients together and chill. Serve the chops on top of the bean salad, spooning remaining chopped olives over.

title: Grilled Olive-And-Bamboo Sandwich
ingredients: 1 ciabatta | 1 lb ripe green olive | 1/2 lb thin-sliced fresh ciabatta | assorted basting sauce ( sandwich spread )
instructions: Cut the ciabatta lengthwise in half, creating two 6 squares. Spread each half with approximately 1/8 of your favorite sandwich spread. Lay the cut side of the ciabatta halves onto the sandwich spread, then top with the olives, ciabatta cheese, green olives and roll up. Serve warm sandwich.

title: Chilomile-Zest
ingredients: 6 jalapeno peppers, stemmed | 1 strip orange peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f line a baking sheet with foil. Place peppers in a small baking pan. Remove skin, seeds, and veins. Place peppers in a bowl. Add orange peel and toss until lightly coated. Arrange on the baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,hot pepper,taco seasoning mix,garlic powder,half cream,saffron strand,curry powder,cranberry
title: Hot Cranberry Saffron Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint whipping cream or 1 pint half-and-half cream | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 pint fresh cranberries | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon hot pepper ( or a little cayenne pepper ) | 4 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon saffron strand
instructions: Combine all ingredients except saffron in a heavy saucepan. Mix well. Gradually stir in saffron in large saucepan. Simmer for about 20 minutes. Use to baste or drizzle on top of your favorite pasta.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,romaine lettuce,marinara sauce,pecorino romano cheese,dill pickle,bartlett pear,curry paste,vanilla bean
title: Spiced Shredded Romaine and Pear Salad
ingredients: 2 -4 cups romaine lettuce | 1 cup bartlett pear, shredded | 1/4 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 5 pickles, in 1/4 inch slices ( depending on size ) | 1 large jalapeno chile, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup canned tomato based marinara sauce | 2 tablespoons lowfat curry paste | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla beans | 1 teaspoon grated fresh dill pickle, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place lettuce in serving bowl. Remove and discard outer leaves of rind, then tear into 1 in chunks. Add the remaining salad ingredients. If using the pickles, add now. Let chill at least 10 minutes. Just before serving, sprinkle with dill pickle slices to garnish.

title: Black Bean Dip Mix
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup 2 % low-fat milk powder | 2 teaspoons white pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except for black beans and bread crumbs. Place bread crumbs in a bowl. Stir in 2 tsp of white pepper. Add milk powder, stirring gently but thoroughly. Add drained black beans. Mix in 1 tsp of white pepper. Serve.

title: Vietnamese-Style Coffee Sandwich for Two
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red onions, finely minced ( or 1/4-1/3/4 cup minced fresh onions ) | 6 tablespoons strong hot coffee
instructions: Finely chopped fresh onions in a small bowl. Combine all coffee ingredients into a mug or small bowl and stir with a fork or spoon until liquid is absorbed. Pour coffee into mug or bowl.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,xanthan gum,silver tequila,broth,maraschino cherry,red snapper fillet
title: Red Snapper Vera Cruz
ingredients: 3 lbs red snapper fillets, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, minced | 1/2 cup craisins maraschino cherries, dried | 3 cups low sodium broth, warmed slightly | 1/4 cup silver tequila or 1/4 cup triple sec | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: In a bowl, toss the snapper with 1/2 cup cilantro and 1 tablespoon minced cherries and set aside to marinate 30 minutes or longer. In a large bowl, mix the warm broth, tequila, remaining 1 tablespoon minced cherries and xanthan gum and 1/4 cup water.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,molasses,beef bouillon,frying chicken,extra virgin olive oil,yellow onion,broccoli floret
title: Sierra Leone's Favorite Basic Beef Broth(Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs frying chickens | 3 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 2 cans tomato soup | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon | 1/2 - 1 cup broccoli floret, cut up
instructions: Rinse chicken thoroughly. Place chicken in crock pot and coat with olive oil. Place onion in crock pot and brown for about a half an hour, or until onion is golden. In a small bowl, mix the molasses and olive oil together. Add molasses mixture and bouillon to crock pot, stirring well. Add broccoli florets and simmer on high for 1 hour and then switch to low and cook for another 2 or 3 hours. Remove chicken, and shred chicken meat with two forks. Return sauce to crock pot and reheat.

title: Spiced Beet Salad
ingredients: 8 beet, tops only, rinsed, cleaned, boiled and chopped | 2/3 cup bottled italian salad dressing mix | 1 cup double cream | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh gingerroot, grated
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for 3 - 5 hours. Serve or refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: coconut,coriander leaf,chili sauce,black peppercorn,farfalle pasta,beef sirloin steak,chicken broth,plum tomato
title: Beef and Bow Ties With Thai Flavours
ingredients: 500 g beef sirloin steaks or 500 g sirloin steaks | 1 2/3 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 1/3 cups thick chili sauce ( thai kitchen brand is gluten free and reduced ) | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander leaves | 3/4 cup coconut or 3/4 cup peppercorns ( fresh ) | 3 -4 tablespoons plum tomatoes, diced small | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1 cup broken farfalle pasta ( can also use bowties )
instructions: Cut the steaks crosswise into 5mm rounds. Toss the beef in a shallow dish, ensuring all sides are coated. Place the chicken broth in a wok or microwave oven and heat on high for 1 minute. Stir in the sweet chilli sauce and corriander leaves. Add the coconut, peppercorns to the wok and set aside to cool. Preheat the oven to 190°c. Boil the pasta, or in the usual manner, according to the packet instruction. Drain and add to a pan with the sweet chilli sauce mixture. Season with salt and pepper. Stir until the pasta is heated through. Serve with the warm pasta and a bowl of thai fragours. Variation, you can add fresh coriander and chilli paste to the sauce.

title: Chocolate Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 package tortillas, about 4 large | 2 tablespoons dried minced onions | 1 cup of grated aged cocoa | 1 -2 tablespoon of your favourite chinese chinese chinese chinese cheese blend
instructions: Put grated cheese in a bowl, put in the microwave and heat until melted about 2 minutes. Set aside. Mix the dried minced onions well together and pour onto tortilla. Roll the tortillas and place seam side down in a baking dish. Sprinkle with cocoa. Bake 350 degrees approx. 20 to 30 minutes or until crisp. Note, if you do not have chinese chinese cheese mix 2 tbsp of the cayenne pepper with the oregano and basil. If you wish, sprinkle with a little of the chinese chili powder and add it along with the basil to your cheese mix.

title: A Simple Puda
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast or 3 lbs chuck roast | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk ( add more if needed ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1 cup asiago cheese ( or other hard mild cheese ) | 1 large bell pepper, sliced
instructions: Place the meat in a large saucepan and cover with cold water by 2 inches. Bring to a boil, skimming the scum off the top as the surface of the water rises. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: silken tofu,chicken breast halve,flat leaf parsley,cooking tapioca,beef liver
title: Chicken and Liver in Tofu
ingredients: 9 ounces ground beef liver ( preferably organic or other cuts of liver ) | 1 1/2 ounces beef liver ( see note ) | 4 ounces firm silken tofu | 5 fluid ounces cooking tapioca | 5 fluid ounces chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Note, if not using silken tofu, skip this step. If using fresh tofu, skip this step. Wash and pat dry the liver. Add the liver and work it in with the liver until it is nicely and thoroughly coated in the liver. Drain and rinse the tapioca in a sieve and put in the pan with the liver and tamarind and mix well. Heat over low/medium, stirring occasionally, until most of the water is absorbed, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat and leave, covered, to cool. Note, if not using tapioca, stir in 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley. Note, if not using silken tofu, put in water for 20 minutes, then add the following step 2 ingredients and leave, covered, to firm up for about an hour.

Random Ingredients: apricot half,stewing beef,sherry,lemon pepper,garlic salt,angostura bitter,cocoa,cooking onion
title: Hungarian Tateczona Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 can of dried apricot halves | 1 lb stewing beef, cubed | cooking onion | 2 tablespoons ground chocolate or 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon sweet sherry | 1 tablespoon angostura bitters | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Cook stew meat in 1 cup boiling water until tender. When cool enough to handle, chop into 1/4 inch pieces. In medium saucepan, melt the choc and sugar. Saute the onion in melted sugar mixture. Add remaining ingredients except the beef. Stir thoroughly. Bring to a boil. Add beef. Simmer, uncovered.

title: Tarragon Turkey
ingredients: 1 lb turkey | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon vinegar | 1 dash onion powder, to taste | 1 small zucchini, cut in half lengthwise
instructions: Sprinkle turkey with onion powder, cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Grill over medium coals or under the broiler, about 5 - 7 minutes per side. When done, remove from grill and cut into 1 1/2 inch slices. Serve with a nice crusty bread and salad. Note, i serve this with a tossed salad for a complete meal.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,honey,tomato puree,red wine,soy sauce,sesame seed
title: Wild Mushroom Sesame Dressing
ingredients: 3 ounces fresh white mushrooms, very finely chopped | 2 tablespoons brown sugar or 2 tablespoons honey | 2 teaspoons tomato puree | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1 cup red wine
instructions: Place all the dressing ingredients in a medium bowl and mix to combine.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,manchego cheese,self raising flour,bouillon cube,steak,lettuce leaf,mace,maple syrup
title: Steak Fritters (Pound Steaks)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb sandwich steaks | 1 1/2 ounces manchego cheese | 1 bouillon cube ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 4 lettuce leaves, to serve | 1/4 cup self-raising flour ( optional )
instructions: Trim off excess fat from steak. Cut steak into cubes or thin strips, approximately 3in long depending on the size. Place onto a lightly greased flat pan, sprinkle with some marcorino. Top with remaining cheese, bouillon cubes and maple syrup. Sprinkle with some grand marnier and mace. Place into the pre heated grill and cook until desired doneness, turning once halfway through cooking. Serve with lettuce and drizzle with remaining grand marnier.

title: Grilled Salmon for Two
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 1 teaspoon turmeric, ground
instructions: Wash salmon until all excess water runs off the fillet. Lightly oil grill and place salmon on it on it. Sprinkle with turmeric. Heat until fish is cooked throughout and flakes easily with a fork, 8 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,turmeric,garlic clove,plum tomato,semolina flour,seasoning salt,confectioner ' sugar,whipping cream
title: Garlic Tomato Semolina Pudding
ingredients: 6 fluid ounces whipping cream | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, sifted | 2 teaspoons pimientos, chopped | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon seasonings salt | 1 tablespoon semolina flour or 1 tablespoon cornmeal | 4 large ripe plum tomatoes, peeled ( seeded, if desired, and cut crosswise into � - � - 1 � inch pieces ) | 1 garlic clove, thinly sliced
instructions: In a mixing bowl, whisk the cream, sugar, pimiento, turmeric, and salt, and set aside. Dredge the tomatoes in the semolina mix, pressing out any excess. Set them side by side on a cookie sheet. Using a blender or food processor, puree the tomato mixture, 1/2 cup of the cream mixture, and the garlic with 2 tablespoons water into a smooth paste. The sauce will be thick. Arrange the tomato parmesan mixture in the top third of a 9 inch deep, round baking dish. Arrange about 1/4 cup of the parmesan mixture along the edges of the tomato mixture in a circular pattern, separating the pieces from one another by about 1 inch. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator overnight. Bring contents of the saucepan to a boil, and immediately reduce heat to a bare simmer. Simmer until almost all of the tomato liquid has evaporated, about 3 hours. Transfer mixture to a food processor, and process until smooth. Transfer sauce to a bowl and let stand for 5 minutes. Pour sauce through a fine sieve into a bowl, and discard the solids. Let stand, covered, for 2 hours. Preheat oven to invert a baking sheet over the top of the baking dish. Set aside 2 tablespoons of cream mixture and drizzle the remaining cream mixture over the surface of the parmesan mixture. Using a pastry bag fitted with a shallow tip, pipe about ½ cup of the pudding batter in a circle about ½ inch thick on the baking sheet. Bake until the top has turned light brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Corn Fettuccine Meatballs
ingredients: 1 medium white bread, crusts removed | 1 can sweet corn | 2 tablespoons dry mustard powder | 1 packet dry fettuccine | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 lb ground meat
instructions: Slice the crust off the bread and crumble the bread into a medium bowl. Add the corn, mustard powder and fettuccine. Mix thoroughly. Add garlic salt and mix thoroughly. Form large meatballs approximately 2 1/2 inches in diameter and about 10 inches long. Put about 2 inches in diameter on a lightly oiled grill pan. Close grill lid, and grill meatballs for 15 minutes. They should be browned, and cooked through. These meatballs should also be cooked in the oven.

title: Cheesy Smoked Tempeh
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain flour | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1 package tempeh | 1/3 cup of grated cheese ( i use cabot or provolone cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven and lightly oil your baking tray. Mix flour, sage, cumin, and instant coffee in a bowl. Cut tempeh into four or six chunks. Pat mixture into the tray, about 1/2 inch thick. Sprinkle the cheese over the top. Bake for about 30 mins or until the base is cooked, and golden. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken,cream chicken soup,salt black pepper,ginger garlic paste,plain yogurt,beef
title: Baked Keema
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup minced fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup cooked chicken, cut into cubes | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 pound ground beef
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare a baking dish by spraying with cooking spray. Mix yogurt, ginger garlic paste, cream of chicken soup, and ground chicken together in a bowl. Mix salt and pepper into the yogurt mixture until thoroughly combined.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,potato,pastry crust pie,part ricotta cheese,fennel seed,cherry
title: Quick Pie
ingredients: 1 prepared pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie | 1 box frozen mixed sweet potatoes, thawed and drained | 1 container part-skim ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 cup canned sliced cherries, drained
instructions: Place the pastry in a 10 inch ovenproof skillet.

title: Ww Core Mexican Yellow Pepper Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs yellow peppers, diced medium | 1 1/2 quarts pork or 1 1/2 quarts chicken stock | 1 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: In a dutch oven, add a cup of the liquid from the diced yellow peppers to the top to bring out those health benefits. Simmer until the peppers are slightly tender and cooked through. Remove the pepper mixture and reserve. Cut the pepper pieces into large chunks. Reserving the liquid and meat in the pot add pepper chunks and 1 - 2 tbls of the reserved liquid back into the pot. Add 1 - 2 tsp vanilla and cook until the liquid comes to a boil. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Sausage and Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chicken | 12 ounces italian sausage | 1 can evaporated skim milk | 3/4 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon garlic salt
instructions: Fry sausage and place in greased 1 1/2 to 2 gallon baking dish. Brown well, drain and return to pan. Combine remaining ingredients then pour over sausage.

title: Chilled Vinegar Lime Soup
ingredients: 5 liters vegetable stock ( or chicken stock ) | 1 pinch of hokkien gold syrup | 1 tablespoon lime juice or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 2 tablespoons lime juice ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saucepan. Cover and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes. Ladle into bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,creole seasoning,rye flour,white button mushroom,linguine,tuna oil
title: Tuna Fried Primavera
ingredients: 1 package frozen linguine | 1 can tuna packed in oil, undrained | 1 can white button mushrooms, drained | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1/2 cup torn fresh basil leaves, packed | 3 tablespoons rye flour
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain. While pasta is cooking, cook tuna, mushrooms, and creole seasoning in a large skillet in boiling water until heated through. Drain. Stir lemon juice into tuna mixture. Add linguine. Sprinkle with basil. Place in a serving bowl or platter. Sprinkle with rye butter. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Jalapeno Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cans garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon jalapeno jelly | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 2 scallions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the beans with the jelly, chutney, scallions and liquid smoke. Cover, and chill in the refrigerator to blend the flavors, at least 15 minutes.

title: Lebanese Pork and Rice With Fennel Seeds (Puha Emar from Ma’�s Cookbook)
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons fennel seed | 1 tablespoon paprika, smoked | 1/2 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained
instructions: Season pork with salt and pepper and brown in large pan over medium high heat with fennel seeds and paprika. Add quinoa and stir well, cover and cook on low heat for 1/2 to 1 hour. Turn heat off. If pork is tender, cool and bone the meat. If meat is still pink, remove the bones and fat and discard. If the pork is not tender, add more quinoa. If liquid is not enough to moisten and is still moist enough to moisten, remove from heat. Serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: red wine,red curry paste,cream cheese,green cabbage,chili pepper flake,snow pea,hard egg
title: Thai Red Curry Noodles With Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 cups green cabbage, finely shredded | 1 bunch green cabbage, finely shredded | 1/2 cup red curry paste ( for thai red curry ) | 1/2 cup red wine ( for thai red curry ) | 3 -4 tablespoons cream cheese or 3 tablespoons coconut cream | 1 sweet chili pepper flakes or 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 hard-boiled egg, minced
instructions: Combine green cabbage, red curry paste, red wine, cream cheese, chili or red pepper flakes and minced egg. Chill 1 hour or longer before serving.

Random Ingredients: turnip,golden syrup,ginger paste,tahini,lemon zest,pepper flake,splenda brown sugar
title: Tohini and Egg Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup tahini | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 3/4 cup splenda brown sugar blend, blend or 3/4 cup packed brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ginger paste | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 dash hot pepper flakes
instructions: Combine ingredients in blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Serve on greens or with veggies.

title: Basquad Chicken Mole - Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon molasses | 12 ounces pork chops | 4 ounces pork sausage | 2 ounces shredded gouda cheese | 2 ounces chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander | 3 -4 leaves basil or 3 -4 leaves chard | 2 -4 rice, wraps
instructions: Soak a rice towel in hot water for 5 minutes. Dry roast the pork in a heavy skillet in a little oil, turning frequently, until just cooked through, about 10 minutes total. Remove the pork and sausage from the pan and reserve. Stir the molasses into the skillet. When the molasses gets very hot, add the pork back into the skillet. Pour in the chocolate chips. Cook over low heat until heated and melted. Stirring occasionally, add the coriander and add the cheese. Remove from the skillet and spread some chips onto the bottom half of a wrap or other platter or the platter. Spread about 1/4 of the filling over the rice. Spread the remaining chips over the filling and roll up. Chill in the fridge for an hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: white rice,crabmeat,oyster,tomato sauce,barbecue sauce,wheat flour,white tequila
title: Crazy Hot Crab and Rice
ingredients: 1 pound fresh crabmeat | 1 cup white rice | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 can white tequila | 1 bottle barbecue sauce | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 can oysters, drained
instructions: Rinse crabmeat, pat dry with paper toweling, and cut into chunks or chunks. Place into a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then stir in the rice and tomato sauce. Reduce heat, and simmer for 25 minutes. Drain the liquid from the pot into a bowl. Pour the liquid into a saucepan, then add tequila, barbecue sauce, and oysters. Bring to a boil, and reduce heat to low. Cover, and simmer over medium low heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and let sit for 10 minutes. Stir, and serve.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,green leaf lettuce,tofu,tamarind paste
title: Tamarind-Coated Tofu With Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1/4 lb firm tofu ( jumbo or rectangular ) | 16 ounces sharp cheddar cheese or 16 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into bite-size squares | 3 cups packed green leaf lettuce, torn in bite-size pieces
instructions: Drain liquid from tuna in a strainer and set aside. Remove gizzards from tofu. Coarsely chop. Reserve liquid. Place tofu in a shallow dish and pour 1 - 2 inches of tamarind liquid over it. Cover and let sit 30 - 60 minutes. Drain juice from tuna and set aside. Drain tofu. Cut into 1 inch pieces lengthwise and set aside. Cut the cheese into quarters and arrange on serving platter, placing 1 slice of tofu on each. Sprinkle wih cheese pieces then toss lettuce around tofu.

title: Laksha - Spicy peanut butter bread
ingredients: 1 lb plain peanut butter ( not reduced fat ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 cup white vinegar | 4 -5 whole cloves | 1 medium purple onion, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch wedges | 1 small radish, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Cut a slit into the top side of the peanut butter a few times, trying to cut as close to the pocket of the bread so that the peanut butter lays flat against the surface of the peanut butter. This will leave you with peanut butter lumps for later. Measure the flour into a wide shallow bowl. Measure the peanut butter drippings into a small saucepan, scraping the bottom of the bowl. Add the flour to the peanut butter drippings, mix well and cook over moderate heat, whisking all the while, for 1 minute. Do not brown the peanut butter. The peanut butter will keep, covered and heated for quite a while, so be sure all is heated through but do not burn it. Remove from the heat and add the onion. Pour the hot peanut butter into the bowl with the flour and stir until the peanut butter is smooth and creamy and the mixture is mixed well. Cover and refrigerate the peanut butter for 30 minutes to overnight. Strain out any remaining solids and store in an airtight container. You can reheat and serve the peanuts at the same time as stated above, but should not keep at least a couple of weeks.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,beef rump roast,graham cracker crumb,cooking spray,tarragon leaf,chicken broth,sea salt
title: Easy Crock Pot French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 beef rump roast, trimmed of fat | cooking spray | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 carton low sodium chicken broth, undiluted | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon leaf | 2 egg yolks ( i use 'lite'from trader joe'brand ) | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place roast in crock pot. Sprinkle liberally with sea salt. Pour broth over roast and cook on low for 6 to 9 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours. About 30 minutes before end of cooking, combine egg yolks, tarragon, and 1/4 cup of the soup in a saucepan. Gradually stir in remaining soup. Turn crock pot to high and stir egg mixture constantly until soup begins to thicken, about 5 minutes. Pour egg mixture over meat in crock and stir well. Sprinkle crumbs on top and cook on high for 30 minutes or until crumbs are lightly browned.

title: Chipotle Buttermilk Cheese
ingredients: 1 quart buttermilk | 1 cup picante sauce, bottled or fresh salsa | 2 chipotle chiles | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon black pepper | 3/4 teaspoon minced dried chipotle chiles
instructions: Prepare grill. Cut buttermilk into tablespoons. Rinse with cold water and then place into a bowl and add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well. Place meat and cheese onto a cutting board and using a sharp knife, slice until cheese is completely shredded. Spread mixture onto breaded grill rack. Close grill lid and grill until bubbly around edges and cheese is browned, about 15 - 18 minutes.

title: Easy Pear Dip
ingredients: 1 pear, peeled and finely diced | 2 ounces fresh red chilies ( or 1-2 seeded, jalapenos- or 3-4 ounces canned chipotles ) | 1 container cool whip
instructions: Using a small sharp knife, cut the ends off your pears, and peel. Remove some of the soft peels with your hands, if any. If using fresh pears, dice them roughly and add them to the container, along with the chilies and the rest of the ingredients. Mix all together. Cover and chill. Serve with warm toast or crackers.

title: Baked Spiced Chocolate Fondue
ingredients: 500 g dark chocolate, chopped | 250 g graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 600 g mixed dried fruit | 200 g rigatoni pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Grease an 8x4 inch loaf mould and line with baking paper. Place chocolate in a heavy medium sized saucepan, add 100ml water and stir over low heat until melted and smooth. Remove from heat, stir in graham cracker crumbs, cocoa, fruit and remaining water. Pour into mould and bake 15 - 20 minutes. Cool in pan for 20 minutes. Turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: beef mince,celery rib,chocolate,maple syrup,italian tomato,simple syrup
title: Quick and Easy Beef Mince
ingredients: 500 g lean beef mince | 2 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 2 tablespoons italian tomato puree | 2 teaspoons dried celery rib, soaked for 5 minutes | 80 g good quality fresh grated breadcrumbs ( use your favourite stale bread ) | 80 g good quality bittersweet chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Brown mince in a large frying pan. Drain off any fat then stir in the syrup, tomato puree, celery, and grated pecorino cheese. Cover with a lid while bringing to the boil, then simmer for about 10 minutes or so. Stir in the breadcrumbs a little at a time, and cook for a further two minutes, until lightly browned and the mixture is smooth and moist. Spoon into warmed serving bowls and scatter with the chocolate. Serve immediately.

title: Vermicelli (Creamy Chipotle)
ingredients: 1 package vermicelli ( or 3 pkgs. each ) | 1 cup grated banana | 1 can of chopped green chiles
instructions: Soak the vermicelli in water until softened, about 1 minute. Drain well. In a large non stick skillet, mix the vermicelli and banana with half the chilies and the remaining chilies. Cook over low heat, stirring regularly until the vegies are light brown and heated through. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,sea salt,pineapple juice,vanilla ice cream,taco sauce,lime wedge,shallot
title: Best Ever Beer Can Shake
ingredients: 1/3 cup dark beer | 1/3 cup taco sauce ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons mild taco sauce | 1 tablespoon finely minced fresh lime wedge | 1 1/4 teaspoons sea salt | 1/2 cup fresh pineapple juice | 1 shallot, finely minced | vanilla ice cream, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Pour beer, taco sauce, lime wedge, fish sauce, sea salt and pineapple juice into a gallon size zip top plastic bag. Add minced shallot.

Random Ingredients: baby back rib rack,semolina flour,squash,olive oil cooking spray
title: Sima (Ribollita) Pasta With Variations
ingredients: 2 baby back rib racks | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon semolina flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Coat one rack of ribs liberally with olive oil. Spray the second rack with olive oil. Slice off the second rack of ribs. Place the second rack of ribs in a roasting pan or casserole dish. Repeat with the third rack of ribs. Cover with foil and roast until very tender, about 30 hours. Remove ribs from oven and discard foil. Remove the ribs from the oven and place on a cutting board. Using your fingers, poke holes all over the rind and top with 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Continue to rub remaining oil around the outside of the rind. Cut ribs into 1 by 2 inch long chunks.

Random Ingredients: arrack liqueur,poultry seasoning,cider vinegar,ginger root,italian bread crumb,dashi stock,lasagna noodle,shrimp
title: Shrimp and Linguica
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chicken-marinated shrimp, drained and chopped | 3 tablespoons arborack liqueur ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons garlic-infused cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoned bread crumbs | 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning, or to taste | 1 cup dashi stock | 9 sheets lasagna noodles | 1 tablespoon grated ginger root
instructions: Combine chicken, shrimp, arzack liquor, cider vinegar, bread crumbs, ginger, and poultry seasoning in a bowl.

title: Pea & Pecan Ring
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Separate dough into 4 pieces. Separate dough into each piece. On a lightly floured surface, roll each piece into 12 thin ropes. Cut a slit into center of each dough strip. Place 2 or 3 pea pieces on each piece of bread dough. Wrap dough around them in the pea pieces, and pinch ends to seal. Repeat with remaining dough and pea pieces. Place the rings on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in a preheated oven for 15 minutes, then uncover, and bake for 15 additional minutes, or until golden.

title: Fiery Rum Beans
ingredients: 1 can white beans | 1/2 cup dark rum | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Drain white beans and rinse with cold water. Put all ingredients into large covered frying pan. Heat and stir until well mixed and dark enough to take on black or red edges.

title: Italian Sausages Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 16 ounces italian sausage | 3 cups bread cubes, approximately | 5 teaspoons sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease a baking sheet with a non stick cooking spray. Cut sausage into 3/4 inch slices and then dice into 4 inch pieces. Combine bread crumbs and sage in a large bowl. Add sausage and toss to coat evenly. Form bread crumbs into balls about 2 inches in diameter. Arrange on baking sheet, spacing evenly, and bake for 14 minutes, until golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Toffee Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup to-diced prepared topping | 1 tablespoon sweet sherry wine | 2 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: In a small bowl, combine topping and sherry. Place topping mixture and margarine in small freezer ziplock bag.

title: Scallops With Chocolate Glaze
ingredients: 12 large scallops, rinsed and dried | 1/4 cup low-fat chocolate syrup | 1/4 cup chopped shallot | 1 1/2 teaspoons agave, powder | 1 1/4 cups whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon shaved glaze or 1 tablespoon other light flavored glaze
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Place scallops in a bowl of cold water. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high. Sprinkle scallops with a little of the soy sauce mixture. Place scallops in skillet and sprinkle with soy sauce. Simmer, covered, for 3 minutes. Transfer scallops to a platter and cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until chilled, about 20 minutes. Brush tops with glaze and sprinkle with remaining soy sauce. Serve with remaining sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,olive oil,tomato paste,kernel corn,jumbo shrimp,nutmeg,maraschino cherry,coconut
title: Jamaican Shrimp in a Creamy Coconut Milk Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 3 tablespoons milk ricotta cheese, creamy | 1 3/4 teaspoons grated nutmeg | 5 -6 ounces fresh whole kernel corn, drained | 6 tablespoons tomato paste, canned in juice | 4 cups cooked jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 cups chopped maraschino cherries, canned | 1/4 cup flaked coconut | olive oil
instructions: In medium nonstick skillet, heat broth over medium high heat. Add ricotta and nuts. Stir until melted, about a minute. Drain corn. Return corn mixture to pot. Add tomatoes, paste and shrimp. Stir and heat through until shrimp are opaque. Taste for salt, and season with nutmeg. Serve spooned alongside fish. Garnish with cherries and coconut.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,chickpea flour,rosemary,bean,orange flower water
title: Chana Punjabi (Spicy Indian Flat Bread)
ingredients: 2 cups chickpea flour | 6 green cardamom pods ( i like the ones in the international section of my grocery store ) | 4 tablespoons rosemary ( dried ) | 2 tablespoons orange flower water | 1 can baked beans
instructions: Combine the flour, cardamom, rosemary, and orange flower water in a large mixing bowl and blend using a pastry blender or a stick blender or your hands until smooth. Add the baked beans and blend until just mixed. Knead for 2 minutes. Divide the dough into 16 portions and shape into rounds about 1/2 inch thick. Heat a large cast iron pan or griddle over medium heat. Place the patties on the skillet and cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, or until cooked through and lightly browned. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,saltine cracker,sherry,grain rice,phyllo pastry,salad green,bay leaf,corn syrup
title: Sweet Sour Rice Pie
ingredients: 2 cups short grain rice | 1 cup salad green | 2/3 cup dry sherry | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 package frozen miniature phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup sherry | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 bay leaf | saltine crackers ( optional )
instructions: Place rice, salad greens and 1/2 cup sherry in a saucepan. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cook, covered, about 35 minutes, or until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed. Place filo pastry in a 15x6x2x2 inch baking dish and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 2 days or freeze up to 3 months. When ready to bake, heat oven to 350 degrees f. Unwrap phyllo dough.

title: Homemade Pretzels
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups superfine sugar | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3 cups unbleached all-purpose flour
instructions: Place 1 1/4 cup sugar, 2 1/2 teaspoons yeast, and 3 cups of the flour into a stand mixer. Mix on low until ingredients are well blended, about 1 minute. Scrape down bowl and allow to rest, 10 to 15 minutes. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface. Knead for about 10 minutes, or until smooth and shiny. Place in a lightly oiled 8 inch square baking pan or a large, clean, dry loaf pan. Cover and let rise 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Remove from the loaf pan. Drain any excess liquid from the loaf pan. Place in a large bowl and allow the dough to rise 20 minutes. Place the dough over the loaf pan. Cover, then allow to rise until just puffy, about 1 hour. Transfer the loaf to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Allow to rise 1 hour. Turn over and allow to rise 1 hour more until puffy and even. Allow to cool completely. When cool, dust the top of the dough with powdered sugar. Store in a airtight container.
