Random Ingredients: cornflour,rum,horseradish,taco seasoning mix,brown onion,white vinegar,cornmeal mix
title: Horseradish and Onion Cornbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornmeal mix | 1/4 cup brown onion, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant horseradish | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1/4 teaspoon white vinegar | 1/2 cup light cornflour | 1/4 cup rum
instructions: Combine the cornmeal mix, brown onion, horseradish, taco seasoning mix and vinegar. Spread on a greased oven tray. Mix corn flour and rum. Pour on top of the cornmeal mixture. Sprinkle with the extra topping. Bake 30 - 45 minutes at 180 degrees.

Random Ingredients: molasses,feta,mustard seed,rigatoni pasta,chicken,nigella seed,beef stock,vegetable stock
title: Rigatoni With Beef and Greek Vegetables
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1/2 ounce nigella seeds | 7 ounces lean ground beef ( or other lean ground beef ) | 2 1/2 ounces vegetable stock | 7 ounces beef stock ( or more if you prefer ) | 12 ounces yoghurt or 12 ounces greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Bring large pan of water to boil. Meanwhile, rinse rigatoni under cold water and drain. Heat a little olive oil in a heavy skillet, add nigella seeds and cook over a low heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant. Add meat and cook through. Add vegetable stock, beef stock mixture and yoghurt. Place in a bowl and chill for minimum of 3 hours or overnight. When ready to serve, remove casings from casings and add nuts and spices as required. Serve with your favourite salad.

title: Baked Pasta With Red Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg shell pasta, medium size, dried, medium-small | 2 red chili, medium size, dried roasted, medium size | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 3/4 cup ciabatta, crust, roughly torn into very little pieces | 1 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Cook the pasta for about 8 minutes, depending on the type of dried pasta you are using. Pre heat oven to 160°c grease 2 oven trays with olive oil. Place all the roasted onions in a saucepan with 2 tablespoons of oil. Cook at low heat, stirring regularly, for about 20 minutes. Add the remaining 1/4 cup oil to the onions. Remove from heat. Sprinkle the cinnamon over the pan. Place the pasta, 1/4 cup of water and the roasted chillies in a large mixing bowl. Stir well.. Pour the wine vinegar mixture over the pasta. Mix well. Spoon the pasta mix over the rest of the bowl. Sprinkle the torn bread slices over the top. Tear off a piece of tin foil, place over the pasta mix and secure with string by folding over the edges. Arrange the sealed foil parcel on a baking tray large enough to hold the baking tray. Pour the pasta mix over the tin foil and bake in oven for around 40 minutes or until golden brown, stirring regularly. The pasta will continue to cook during this cooking period when you pull out the foil parcel. Allow to stand for about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Scotch Sausage for Dogs
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs italian sausage, cut in 2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 3 1/4 cups white flour
instructions: Place sausage pieces in a medium size skillet or crockpot. Pour in buttermilk and top with the flour. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high 4 to 5 hours. Remove sausage and cook on grill 3 to 5 minutes on each side. Do not overcook. Sausages should be well browned and cooked through. Remove any fat or undesirable pieces and serve with the cooked sausage.

title: Cowboy Bark
ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed pistachios | 30 -35 slices thick bacon | 3 cups good quality enchilada sauce ( i found i'm not partial to el pollo depending on how intense we like it ) | 1/3 cup tequila | 1/3 cup fresh minced garlic | 1/3 cup roasted red pepper flakes or 1/3 cup dried red pepper | 1 tablespoon aniseed, powder
instructions: Put first 7 ingredients together, and in a blender mix everything. Pour mixture over crushed nuts. Chill at least an hour. I like to serve this on toast with shredded carrots, and then top with cheese and pico de gallo..

title: Fried String Beans and Wasabi
ingredients: 1 package string bean, broken up | 1 cup corn oil | 4 tablespoons wasabi paste | 1 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Wash and trim beans. Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a pan. Add the beans and stir fry over high heat for 2 minutes. Add the wasabi paste and stir fry for 10 minutes, until bean is tender. Combine the flour and remaining oil in a separate bowl and gradually add to the frying pan, stirring constantly. Cook for two or three minutes until thickened, adding more oil if necessary. Add the beans and stir fry for 5 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Almond Oil - Oil for Almonds
ingredients: 2 cups oil ( for deep frying ) | 5 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Pour 2 1/2 cups of oil into a glass jar. The oil should reach 1 1/2 inches deep inside a saucepan. The jar should fit nicely inside a small bowl with just the heat released from the drops of oil inches when oil is warm, add 5 tablespoons of chili oil and mix well. Keep the 2 cups of oil on the side. To test if the oil is to your desired temperature, dip your finger in the oil, taking care not to break the air bubbles. It should come out with a light, even coating of oil. If you have too much oil, the oil is likely to get very hot. It may take as little as 20 to 30 seconds per cup of oil.

title: Spinach Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder, center cut | 1 package frozen chopped spinach ( thawed, squeezed dry ) | paprika | ketchup
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Put pork chop in bottom of 13 x 9 baking pan and sprinkle both sides with paprika. Pour chopped spinach over pork. Top with ketchup. Sprinkle with paprika & bake until meat is tender & meat is hot and falling off of bone.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,polenta,asiago cheese,baking potato,apricot jam,bell pepper,red currant
title: Roasted Currant and Asiago Polenta Rounds
ingredients: 1 cup polenta, such as bob's red mill | 2 large baking potatoes, peeled | 1 small red currant, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons red currant jam | 3 tablespoons asiago cheese, grated ( about 2 oz ) | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 1 bell pepper, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Oil two 12 x 8 inch baking dishes or mini loaf pans. Combine polenta, potatoes, red currant and asiago cheese and divide between the prepared baking dishes or loaf pans. Drizzle with marsala wine. Bake until tops spring back when lightly pressed, about 35 minutes. Turn dish over and bake until top is golden brown and crisp, about 25 minutes longer. Cool for 5 minutes. Using a serrated knife, cut polenta slices into quarters.

Random Ingredients: meat,red pepper flake,wine vinegar,coriander leaf,kielbasa sausage
title: Hot Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 500 g kielbasa sausage, cut into 2 cm cubes | 500 g frozen meat, defrosted | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander leaves | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Place all ingredients in a covered bowl. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: leek,asafoetida powder,buttermilk,lemon peel,yellow onion,orange blossom water,spanish paprika
title: Roasted Lemon-Asafetida
ingredients: 1 cup spanish sweet smoked paprika | 1/2 cup orange blossom water | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 3 large leeks, white and pale green part only, thinly sliced | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f brush a 9x13 inch baking dish with 1 tablespoon of oil. In a small bowl, mix paprika and orange blossom water. Place leeks, onion, and 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida in a large bowl. Drizzle the spanish paprika mixture over leeks and onion mixture and toss. Spread in baking dish. Bake, stirring occasionally, 30 minutes, or until leeks are tender.

title: Pickled Turnips With Sausages
ingredients: 3 large medium turnips or 3 large yams | 1/4 cup pickled mixed herbs | 6 -8 sprigs parsley sprigs | scotch treacle or molasses | hot pepper sauce, to taste | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce mirin ( optional ) | herbs ( optional )
instructions: Trim peel and wash turnips. Cut into slices. Arrange on a greased tray and sprinkle with herbs. Pour over treacle/molasses just to cover and drizzle with remaining treacle or molasses, if desired. You can sprinkle with hot pepper sauce, if desired. If desired, herb may be sprinkled on top. Refrigerate for up to 2 weeks until ready to serve.

title: Citrus Salsa
ingredients: 1/4 cup sliced olive | 3 tablespoons sliced ripe olives | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 lime | 1 teaspoon sugar or 1 teaspoon honey
instructions: Cut a slit on one side of a lime, discard. Place olive and olives in a blender of blender, pulse briefly. Add sugar to lime juice, add to blender. Pulse until smooth. Transfer salsa to container, pour over a bag of ice, refrigerate. This salsa will keep 2 days.

Random Ingredients: lima bean,island dressing,vegetable oil cooking spray,brie cheese,red cabbage,turmeric,parsley leaf
title: Brie and Lima Beans Saute
ingredients: 1 head edifl lima beans ( about 4 oz. ) or 1 head red cabbage ( about 4 oz., can use any variety fresh fava beans ) | 6 1/2 ounces brie cheese, 1/4-inch thick slices, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1/2 medium red cabbage, shredded | island dressing
instructions: Place lima beans in a medium bowl. Slice cabbage into thin slices. Rinse beans. In 12 in skillet, add 1/2 teaspoon oil and 2/3 cup water to the pan.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,fish sauce,poppy seed,coriander powder,almond milk,lard
title: Malaysian Poppy Seed Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups almond milk ( i use 2 % milk ) | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/2 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 tablespoon ground coriander powder | 1 hot chili pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Put the almond milk and sugar in a saucepan then add the fish sauce, poppy seeds, ground coriander and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes then remove the pepper. Pour into a bowl and allow to cool then beat with an electric mixer for 1 minute. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: irish whiskey,creme de cassis,bean sprout,broth,tomato puree,chick pea,cumin seed,vanilla extract
title: Guilt Free Irish Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 3 tablespoons irish whiskey ( such as jameson, baileys or cam ) | 1 can chick-peas, drained ( garbanzo beans ) | 6 cups broth | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons creme de cassis | 1 can crushed tomatoes in puree | 1 bag fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Place cumin seeds and whiskey in a small skillet over medium heat.

title: Batali
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 1 cup basmati rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place potatoes in an oven safe baking dish. Roast potatoes in the preheated oven until tender, about 45 minutes. Transfer potatoes to a resealable bag.

Random Ingredients: radish,mustard seed,mascarpone cheese,galangal,paprika,pistachio nut,ricotta cheese,white potato
title: Yummy Mini Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb fresh white potato | 2 tablespoons pickled ginger, shaved into very small pieces peeled | 3 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 1 tablespoon dried oregano flakes or 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed canned galangal | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/3 cup roasted crushed pistachios ( about 1/4 cup )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place potatoes in a steamer basket over boiling water. Remove from heat when tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer potatoes to a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to steam until cold. Peel potatoes, if desired. Set aside. Place ginger in a medium bowl. Add mascarpone, ricotta cheese, oregano, cardamom, mustard seeds and paprika. Stir until blended. Add potatoes to bowl. Sprinkle roasted pistachios on top of potatoes. Transfer dough to a well greased 11” x 7” baking sheet. Bake in oven until tops are golden, about 25 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes before releasing dough.

Random Ingredients: green chili,apple juice orange,vinegar,tomato paste,hazelnut,torn salad green,artichoke heart
title: Mexican Style Artichokes
ingredients: 1 package torn salad greens | 1/2 green chili, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 2 jarred artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 teaspoon hot pickled green chili ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/4 cup apple juice ( or apple cider vinegar ) | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted, finely chopped
instructions: Toss greens with chili, artichokes, and tomato paste. Pour into shallow bowl. Cover, and refrigerate until serving time. To serve, sprinkle with nuts.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,table salt,confectioner ' sugar,tomato soup,provolone cheese,butter cooking spray,mustard oil,farfalle pasta
title: Pantry-Style Beef Fonduta With Cherry Tomatoes and Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mustard oil | 1/2 cup table salt | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 package dry farfalle pasta, preferably barilla picnic steel or other tubular pasta | 3 tablespoons unsalted butter, 1 stick, or 2 tablespoons unsalted margarine | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs medium-large cherry tomatoes, halved ( or grape tomatoes ) | 3/4 cup grated provolone cheese, 2 1/4-inch slices | 1/3 cup tomato soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with baking parchment. Place 1 tbsp mustard oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Pour in 1/4 cup of the confectioners sugar and whisk to combine. Add the farfalle pasta and toss to coat, 2 minutes, or until pasta has just absorbed all the sugar. Add the butter, 1 stick unsalted butter, and enough water to cover pasta, stirring until the butter is melted and the farfalle are just tender crisp, about 3 minutes. Arrange the pasta in a large glass or ceramic baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar on top and then spread the tomatoes and provolone over top. Pour the tomato soup over the cheese and let macerate, at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally, at least every couple of hours. Towards the end of the 2 hours, spread the remaining 1 tbsp mustard oil on a cutting board and turn the dish to coat the entire dish. Heat the grated cheese until it is hot, and then remove from the burner and stir with a fork. When the dish is hot again, ladle 1/4 cup of the cheese sauce over the top and return to the oven. Bake until the fonduta is bubbling hot, about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Spoon the pasta fonduta onto a carving board, and keep warm. Spoon the remaining cheese sauce over top and sprinkle on the chopped walnuts or almonds.

title: Spanish Green Onion & Tomato Jam-Dip for Seafood
ingredients: 200 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained ( oil reserved from sundried tomatoes ) | 1 bunch green onion, trimmed and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Thread green onion onto skewers, alternating the following, sun dried tomatoes of the sun dried tomato oil, spring onion, hot pepper jelly or hot sauce. Grill or broil for approx 5 mins on each side or until bubbling and lightly browned.

title: Potatoes & Romaine
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 kg potato, scrubbed
instructions: Wash romaine lettuce. Wash potatoes very well and dry well. Cut potatoes into 5cm squares and boil until soft. Set aside. Cut romaine leaves into 6 wedges.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,pineapple juice,crawfish tail,apricot half,dark sesame oil,tomato sauce,plain flour
title: Thai Sweet and Sour Spiced Seafood
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil, divided | 1 lb peeled crawfish tails, cut into 2cm pieces | 8 ounces plain flour, seasoned with salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons paprika dark sesame oil
instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon sesame oil in a large frying pan and fry the crawfish pieces in batches for 3 minutes each time, then remove and set aside. Heat remaining sesame oil in the same frypan, and fry the flour, stirring, for 1 minute, then stir in the sugar, pineapple juice, tomato sauce, and paprika. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute, then return the crawfish to the pan, and heat through. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Spicy Mexican Seasoning
ingredients: 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 -2 red chilies or 1 -2 green chilies
instructions: Put all ingredients into a gallon sized resealable plastic bag and shake. Then put all ingredients into saucepan over medium heat and bring to a boil. Stir contents occasionally. Once it boils, simmer for at least a 20 minutes. Check for sweetness and dryness. Also, it can be used on other items like roasted red peppers, salsa, cheese.

title: Pesto Topped White Chocolate
ingredients: 2 ounces white chocolate | 1 sprig pesto sauce
instructions: Melt the white chocolate in the microwave on full power.

title: Randy's Italian Crackers
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons crushed anise seeds
instructions: Mix all the above ingredients together. Roll out and cut into squares. Put on cookie sheet and flatten to about 1/8 inch. Let cool.

title: Quick Chickpea Chapati
ingredients: 1 can chickpea flour | 1/4 cup bread, torn ( bread works best ) | 5 -6 small chilies, crushed ( depending on taste ) | 1/2 cup cheese, grated ( or any other favourite kind you like )
instructions: Dump chickpea flour in a large bowl and mix in bread. Add chili, mix well. Stir in cheese. If mixture is too sticky, add 1 tbs milk. Heat a spoonful of mixture on a lightly oiled pan. Flip when bubbles appear and bubbles are popping on the surface, cook a few seconds longer. Serve warm.

title: Pork Soft-Shell
ingredients: 1/4 pound pork shoulder loin, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: In a nonstick skillet or deep fryer, melt the 2 tablespoons of cornstarch over medium heat. Place the pork in the cornstarch, and brown on all sides. Add a few more tablespoons of cornstarch to loosen browned bits, if desired.

title: Chipotle-Smoked Spanish Prawn Wraps
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked chipotle cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 large eggs | 1/2 cup prawns, cooked | 12 egg roll wraps | 1 medium yellow pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Combine the pepper and the mustard in a bowl. Add the prawns. Stir until combined. Shape the mixture into 4 inch long rolls. Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate until needed. In a skillet, heat the prawn mixture over medium heat. Add the rolls and cook for 1 minute on each side or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,red chili pepper,saffron thread,corn,buttermilk,balsamic vinegar,golden syrup
title: Sweet Corn With Chiles
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs corn, fresh or frozen | 15 dried red chili peppers, soaked in hot water for 10 minutes | 2 cups buttermilk | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1/3 cup packed golden syrup | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 12 saffron threads
instructions: Cut the corn kernels off the cobs by carefully removing the fibers in the cob and cutting away any white kernels. Place in a large bowl with a good pinch of salt. If the corn has no white remaining, just add green and black kernels. Cover with cold water and set aside until it is tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, and save the water. The water should be cloudy. Transfer the corn kernels to a steamer, add the hot water, cover, and steam them for about 1 hour. Cool the corn, remove the seeds, and cut them into 1 inch cubes. Return the cubed corn to the skillet, add the peppers, buttermilk and vinegar, plus the golden syrup and balsamic vinegar. Over medium low heat, stir often, until the mixture is hot enough that it has a thick but still liquid consistency. When the corn is done steaming, remove and discard the corn chunks. Transfer them to a serving dish. Pour hot sauce over them, and sprinkle with saffron. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: baking mix,black walnut,sharp cheddar cheese,gouda cheese,orange blossom water,pepper,chicken bouillon granule
title: Cheese and Walnut Crumble
ingredients: 2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese ( about 8 ounces ) | 2 cups grated gouda cheese ( about 8 ounces ) | 1/2 cup dried black walnuts | 1 tablespoon orange blossom water | 4 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon baking mix | ground pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a bowl, stir the cheeses with the orange blossom water, bouillon, baking mix and pepper. Place the crumble mixture into a ungreased 9 inch square baking pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly. Serve sprinkled with more fresh parsley if desired.

title: Tropical Mushroom, Stout & Pine Nut Soup
ingredients: 1/2 bunch fresh cremini mushrooms, large | 4 bunches bok choy, trimmed | 3 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 3 tablespoons dark beer, such as stout | 2 1/2 tablespoons sage
instructions: Preheat grill or skillet over medium high heat. Remove stems from mushrooms, cut stems into 3 1/2 inch lengths, and discard caps. Cut remaining 3 bunches of bok choy into 4 inch lengths and set aside. Using 2 or 3 t of mushrooms as the base of the salad leaves, line the inside of a 10 inch square of reynolds wrapable aluminum foil with one length of reynolds wrapable foil that will fit snugly. Using a serrated knife, remove and discard ends from each mushroom. Sprinkle each mushroom with 2 t toasted pine nuts, 2 t toasted pine nuts and more salt and pepper to taste. Starting at the stem end, roll each mushroom, beginning on stem end, and tie with kitchen twine at 2 1/2 inch intervals to make a neat roll. Place the mushrooms, wrapped sides up, on top of the 4 bunches of bok choy. Place foil on a second pan to catch drips. Grill mushrooms, with sides, or steam for 30 - 45 minutes, or until tender, basting often with juices. Remove foil. Working from center out, spoon mixture into a bowl and season with 2 teaspoons of the sage. Garnish with remaining toasted pine nuts and serve.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,chick pea,lemon pepper,jaggery,udon noodle,macadamia nut,semolina flour
title: Macadamia Nuts and Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas | 2 1/2 ounces semolina flour | 1 ounce macadamia nuts, finely chopped | 5 ounces jaggery, grated | 1 1/2 ounces salted macadamia nuts | 2 lemon pepper, finely chopped | tortilla chips ( optional )
instructions: Pour the water over the chickpeas to cover, and leave for at least 7 hours. Drain, rinse and dry. Place the flour, macadamia nuts and some salt in the food processor and pulse until thoroughly mixed. Add the sugar and process again until the mixture resembles a dough. Add the chickpeas and lemon pepper and process again for 10 seconds to give a smooth dough. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead briefly, adding more water if necessary. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. The dough will have grown into quite thick fingers. Form the dough into a circle and either use a rolling pin or floured 2 1/2 inch round cutter to cut out circles from the dough, place on a lightly floured baking tray and sprinkle with some macadamia nuts. Bake at 180°c for 15 to 20 minutes, or until well risen and pale golden brown. Leave to cool on a wire rack. Serve with the optional chips.

title: German Standard Sliders
ingredients: 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon vodka | 1 red capsicum
instructions: Place all the ingredients into an airtight container. Make sure the top lid is sealed well. Turn onto to a hot, greased griddle. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes until the sliders are browned, but not burned.

Random Ingredients: white wine,gruyere,dark soy sauce,italian tomato sauce,beef gravy,almond extract,cauliflower
title: Italian Almond Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweet white wine | 1/2 cup italian-style tomato sauce ( i use contadina brand ) | 2 teaspoons beef gravy | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 1/2 lbs cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 - 1 1/2 cup gruyere or 1 -1 1/2 cup grated swiss cheese
instructions: In a small saucepan, bring the white wine to a boil over high heat. Add the tomato sauce, gravy and almond extract. Stir and turn down the heat to low. Simmer uncovered until most of the liquid evaporates, about 20 minutes. While you cook the cauliflower florets, heat the olive oil over medium heat in a large deep skillet. Add the cauliflower and cook, stirring to coat with the oil, about 5 minutes. Add the gruyere to the hot skillet. Cook, stirring until the gruyere is slightly browned, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. To serve, arrange the cauliflower in individual serving bowls. Then drizzle the sauce over them.

title: Spiced Sauerkraut With Sweet Potatoes and Smoked Beef Liver
ingredients: 1 pint double cream ( or cream heavy cream ) | 2 lbs potatoes, peeled and cut into bite sized pieces | 2 lbs smoked veal, in 1 inch pieces ( or pork liver ) | 1/2 pint dried apricot, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Prepare the sauerkraut and place in a saucepan with stock, butter and spices. Bring to the boil, lower heat and simmer uncovered 10 to 15 minutes, or until potatoes are soft, stir in remaining ingredients. Return to simmer and cook, covered, stirring regularly, until heated through. Check the salt and adjust, if necessary, to taste. Serve in warm bowls and a good bread.

title: Pasta-Stuffed Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package frozen brussels sprouts | 1 package lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup chopped green olives | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, blanch the brussels sprouts for 5 minutes, until bright green and slightly crisp tender. Drain, cool, and chop coarsely. In a saucepan of boiling water, cook the lasagna noodles 8 minutes, until al dente.

title: Chickpeas for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained, rinsed with cold water and drained again | 1 ounce mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 1 dried hot red chili pepper
instructions: Heat the mirin until almost smoking, then add the dried chile. Turn up the heat to medium heat. Add the chickpeas with the water, simmer uncovered for about 10 minutes or until slightly tender and a dark green color, around 12 minutes. Serve hot or cold, with dipping sauces such as shoyu and soy sauce.

title: Saffron Rice Krispies Squares
ingredients: 8 -10 cups rice krispies | 1/2 cup saffron | 1 jar marinara sauce | 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped
instructions: In a medium size bowl, mix rice krispies, saffron and chives. Press mixture into a 9x13 inch pan with a spatula. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Navratan Yakh (Caravanese Spicy Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb small shell pasta, or as desired | 2 tablespoons ghee, or more as needed, divided | 1 can stewed tomatoes, with juices, undrained
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add pasta, and cook until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain, and set aside until cool. Melt 2 tablespoons of ghee in a skillet over medium heat. Pour in stewed tomatoes, and bring to a boil. Cook and stir until tomatoes are heated through, about 5 minutes. Stir in the cooked pasta, and coat with the sauce. Return skillet to heat, and bring to a boil. Simmer until pasta has cooked through, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,baby spinach,cashew,pasta sauce,sea salt,scallion,porcini mushroom,head garlic
title: Delicious Garlic Mushroom and Spinach Spaghetti
ingredients: 12 ounces pasta sauce | 1 teaspoon dried porcini mushrooms | 3 medium whole heads of garlic, peeled | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 dash sea salt or 1 dash other salt | 1 package baby spinach, cleaned and chopped | 1/4 cup roasted cashews | 5 scallions, chopped ( optional )
instructions: To make the spaghetti sauce, pour the pasta sauce into a large saucepan along with the mushrooms and bring to a boil. When the sauce comes to a bubble, add in the garlic. Turn down the heat and add the taco seasoning and stir. Turn the heat back up to medium high and simmer about 1 - 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cover and let sit about 2 minutes. Meanwhile, rinse the spinach thoroughly. Drain well. Stir in the cashews, green onions, and mushrooms. Serve hot. Note for those out of the can of be creative, use a combination of pasta sauces and seasoning and add to the spinach before serving. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,mustard seed,queso fresco,black bean,black eyed pea,shortcut bacon,white rice
title: Arroz Blanco (Black Beans and Rice Burritos)
ingredients: 1/2 lb shortcut bacon, chopped | 1 cup uncooked white rice | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 package cheese-stuffed tortillas, cut into 1-inch strips | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 cup queso fresco, shredded
instructions: In large skillet, fry bacon until lightly brown. Stir in rice and beans and bring to boil. Reduce heat.

title: Spanish Lamb in Quinoa Toss
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil ( spanish for authenticity ) | 2 -4 lamb chops, bone-in ( any boneless cut will do but lamb meat can be used if your lamb is fairly lean ) | 1 can chopped tomatoes and green chilies | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( or more to taste ) | 1 cup uncooked quinoa ( i prefer to use a medium grain )
instructions: In a 9x13 inch pyrex or nonstick pan, put the oil on the sides. If you are not using lamb chops cut into slices and lightly brown in oil. While lamb is browning put the quinoa and 1 1/4 cups water in a small sauce pan, bring to a boil and reduce heat if there's not enough. I use a lid, just loosely cover the pot and let simmer until quinoa is done. While the lamb is browning take the tomato and chilies, cayenne, and some flour and mix together. Put the tomato mixture and the lamb in a bowl and mix well. When the lamb is done drain and put it on top of the rice mix. Let sit for 5 - 10 minutes and mix again. The liquid will thicken up just a little bit, making sure it doesn't burn. When the lamb is done it will be slightly firm for your taste and the rice will have absorbed the flavorful broth. Turn on oven to 400° and top with the remaining chile mixture in the pan, pressing gently so everything just comes around the outside of the pan.. Bake uncovered about 30 - 40 minutes or until the top of the quinoa is nicely browned and the liquid is absorbed. It may take more for your pan. Serve.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,canola oil,bell pepper,chuck roast,white potato,vegetable oil cooking spray,triple sec
title: Baked Beef & Rice Noodles With Potatoes
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 2 teaspoons canola oil | 6 ounces tri-colored bell peppers, any color, cut into strips | 1 -2 tablespoon canola oil or 1 -2 tablespoon cooking spray | 1 chuck roast, trimmed of excess fat and cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks | 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 lbs small white potatoes ( i use a small 2-pound bag of the instant pot variety ) or 1 1/2-2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks | 6 ounces uncooked rice noodles ( i use lundberg's rice noodles ) or 6 ounces vermicelli | 1/4 - 1/2 cup triple sec ( may use regular or regular ) or 1 1/4-1/2 cups regular sugar ( may use regular or regular ) | 5 -7 teaspoons vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat 1 - 2 tbsp oil in a large non stick skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir bell peppers until softened and beginning to brown, about 6 - 8 minutes. Transfer peppers to a plate. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil to skillet. Add beef and cook, stirring until the browned bits on the bottom of the skillet are beginning to brown. Remove from heat and set aside until step on list 3, combine vegetables in a large mixing bowl. Place the cooked rice noodles in another large bowl and cover with warm water. When the rice noodles are softened, drain and divide among 6 - 6 bowls. Add 1 1/2 tbsp oil to skillet, and return beef mixture to skillet. Return skillet to the stove and cook, stirring, until beef mixture is well browned on top of vegetables, about 7 - 8 minutes. Add triple sec and remaining 5 cups warm water. Stir to mix well and cover dish with foil. Bake covered for about 45 minutes, or until noodles are cooked. Turn heat off and let sit for an additional 10 minutes, until rice noodles are completely cooked. Serve with a tossed salad, if desired.

Random Ingredients: yellow food coloring,celery heart,manchego cheese,cabbage,cannellini bean,gingerroot
title: White and Yellow Gourd and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 bunch cabbage, sliced thin | 1 stalk celery heart, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, coarsely shredded | 1 yellow food coloring ( `` my special " ) | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 2 packages manchego cheese, grated
instructions: To make your soup, combine all the ingredients in a food processor or blender except for the cheeses. Process until smooth and creamy, stopping occasionally to scrape down the sides of the work bowl to avoid lumps. Add the cheese and process for one minute longer. Serve at once. Note, it can be eaten plain, like you would may have done before.

title: Cheese Rosti #7 #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb finely grated gorgonzola
instructions: Saute ground veal and gorgonzola in a skillet until golden brown. Cook simply potatoes as directed on package. Drain and combine the ingredients with the cooked potatoes. Place in a large baking pan sprayed with the non stick cooking spray. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,green bean,chili,cannellini bean,french onion soup,sun tomato oil,trout fillet
title: Trout With Chili Beans and Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 can french onion soup | 1 package dried red snapper fillets, halved | 1 can cannellini beans, drained ( or any bean you like ) | 12 small dried chili, seeds included | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 12 small sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped ( not oil packed ) | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray a large roasting pan with cooking spray, and arrange snapper over the top. In a bowl combine soup, beans, chili seeds, and water chestnuts. Spread over the fish. Cover and bake in preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 45 minutes. Remove fish from oven, spoon sauce over, and return to the oven until any remaining sauce has been absorbed, about 8 minutes longer.

title: Sweet Home Beef
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef roast | 3 tablespoons filling | 3 tablespoons chili flakes ( i use chili flake ) | 1 recipe pie crust ( from # 3 recipes pie crust )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place roast in large roasting pan. Sprinkle chili flakes over top. Cover and let marinade for 48 hours basting every 15 to 24 hours. Remove roast from pan, strain meat broth. Use 2 - 3 cups of broth if necessary, but do not skim fat. Stir in 2 tbsp of flour if meat seems dry. Roll out dough 1/8 in thickness, 1/8 in top of bottom. Cut into 1/4 wide strips, 1 3/4 on long side. Roll up lengthwise jelly roll style, twist ends. Cut out a 2 inch spiral, 1 - 2 inch in diameter. Repeat with other strips. Put on cookie sheet, top with sauce. If desired, bake for 2 hours at 450 degrees or until golden. Let stand in the juices in the roasting pan for at least 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

title: Guinness Butter
ingredients: 1 lb unsweetened cocoa powder | 4 ounces guinness stout
instructions: Mix all ingredient. It will look crumbly.

title: Mom's Mexican Cheeseburger
ingredients: 8 ounces hamburger | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 8 ounces mexican cheese ( shredded ) | butter
instructions: Brown hamburger. Then put on a panini grill. Brown until the cheese is melted put on a plate and put in a microwaveable dish and microwave cheese. Microwave until melted put on top. Put under the grill. Cook on high about 3 minutes serve with anything.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,bread crumb,vegetable oil,thai red curry paste,gingerroot,cilantro,cranberry
title: Cucumber-Raisin Burgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 cup fresh bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 cup fresh cranberries | 1/2 cup diced ripe cucumber | 1 tablespoon minced fresh gingerroot | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Mix the vegetable oil, bread crumbs, red curry paste, cranberries, cucumber, ginger, and cilantro together in a bowl, and then form into 8 patties. Cook patties on the preheated grill until no longer pink in the center, and the burgers are cooked to your desired degree of doneness, about 5 minutes per side. Serve on a pita with minted cilantro.

Random Ingredients: irish whiskey,beef stew meat,wild rice,spanish onion,black olive,lettuce
title: Big Thunder Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 12 ounces wild rice | 1 medium spanish onion, sliced thin | 1 package frozen chopped deli-stuffed olives | 1 bottle irish whiskey ( such as bushmill irish whiskey ) | lettuce
instructions: Add beef to crockpot, then stir in remaining ingredients. Cook on low 3 hours or high 4 hours. Cut into 6 slices for a sandwich and serve on a lettuce lined buns alongside.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,sage,cardamom,bay seasoning,french bread,chorizo sausage
title: Baked Spicy Sausage Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup chorizo sausage, casing removed and crumbled | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1 loaf french bread | 1/2 cup bottled chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Mix the chorizo, old bay seasoning, chili pepper flakes, cardamom, sage, and chili flakes together in a bowl, stirring to combine.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,chipotle chile adobo,parmesan cheese,hungarian paprika,dill pickle,vanilla extract,hard egg
title: Homemade Chipotle Eggs
ingredients: 3 cups hard boiled eggs | 1/3 cup kiwi fruit ( peeled ) | 1/3 cup sweet hungarian paprika | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese ( freshly grated ) | 4 tablespoons dried dill pickles ( finely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile in adobo ( finely minced ( fresh, not a paste )
instructions: Pound kiwifruit until coarsely chopped. Drain and chop. Mince paprika, dill pickles, cheese and chile. Stir in egg, paprika mixture and chile powder and process in large metal bowl until well blended. Cool. Refrigerate in tightly covered container in refrigerator up to 2 weeks. Stores well for 2 days.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,cardamom seed,romano cheese,black caviar,vinegar,quinoa,marsala wine,cooking oil
title: Spiced Aromatic Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 1/2 - 2/3 cup vinaigrette ( i used maria wine, made with 1/3 cup water and 1/3 cup sugar ) | 1/2 cup wine ( optional ) | 1/2 - 1 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 2 -3 tablespoons romano cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano or 1/2-1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vinegar ( i used lemon juice, white balsamic vinegar and lemon juice ) or 1/2-3/4 cup white balsamic vinegar | 2 -3 cardamom seeds, crushed | 1 teaspoon black caviar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven on convection or high setting. Place a large bowl of quinoa in the oven. It should take 7 minutes. After 5 minutes, check if the quinoa is done, if it is, transfer it to a colander and allow to cool. While the quinoa is cooling, bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the quinoa. Put the quinoa in a bowl, cover it with fresh water and let sit 5 minutes. Drain the quinoa, place it in a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking. Squeeze out the water as much as possible from the quinoa and put into the fridge until the quinoa is cold. In a bowl, make the vinaigrette by combining all the dressing ingredients. Stir the mixture vigorously, it should be smooth but not watery. Place the quinoa in a serving bowl and pour the vinaigrette over it. Add the optional caviar if using now. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,jalapeno pepper cheese,pea,green bean,sultana,cider vinegar,cumin powder,creamy peanut butter
title: Pea, Peanut and Sultana Salad
ingredients: 2 cups green beans, trimmed | 1/2 cup sultana, soaked in boiling water for 3 minutes | 1/2 cup peas ( shelled ) | 1/2 cup red bell pepper | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 jalapeno pepper cheese ( i used trader joe's brand ) | 1 dash cumin powder
instructions: Mix everything together well and serve cold.

Random Ingredients: lemon wedge,thyme leaf,pineapple juice,cinnamon sugar,egg yolk,anise seed
title: Baharat Aka Pineapple-Garlic Mayonnaise
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 1 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon sugar | fresh lemon wedge, to garnish | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice
instructions: Beat the yolks with the anise seed and the thyme leaves until thick and fluffy. Slowly add the sugar and beat until the mixture is light and fluffy. Fold in the lemon. Place the mayonnaise in a serving bowl and garnish with a wedge of lemon.

title: Jalapeno, Orange Blossom Water, and Roasted Garlic
ingredients: 1 lb fresh jalapeno | 8 ounces orange blossom water ( or 1 cup orange blossom water plus 1 tbsp of orange blossom water ) | salt ( to taste )
instructions: Remove and discard papery outer and light green veins from the jalapenos. Split each pepper lengthwise in half and remove the stems and seeds. Heat half of the oil in the oven to 325f. Snap off the tip of the jalapenos and slit the peppers open lengthwise. Remove the seeds and membrane and cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Put them in a baking dish and coat with 1 tbsp of the orange blossom water. Add a pinch of salt. Pour the orange blossom water over the peppers, leaving 1/2 3/4c of water. Roast in the oven, turning over and basting with the remaining oil mixture, until the peppers are tender and the blossom water has a syrupy color and is absorbed, about 1 hour.. Cool to room temperature, then strain and put on an airtight container. Discard the remaining liquid.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,chili pepper,rice wine vinegar,linguine,corn oil,shrimp,pineapple juice
title: Stir Fried Shrimp With Pineapple
ingredients: 2 lbs medium shrimp, shelled and cut into 2 inch pieces | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup clam juice | 3 fresh chili peppers ( jalapenos ) | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup corn oil | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of corn oil in wok or large frypan. Stir fry shrimp until just colored. Remove shrimp to a plate. In a measuring cup, combine 2 tablespoons of rice wine vinegar, clam juice, chiles, clam juice and pineapple juice. Cook until hot and bubbly. Serve over the shrimp. Serve with warm linguine.

title: Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 500 g ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 190'c. Cook lasagna sheets one at a time in boiling water. Drain, and cover with cold water. Cook for 10 - 15 mins, until tender. Remove from stove, drain and cool on kitchen paper. Spray inside of each noodle with oil and bake until crisp. Spread a spoonful of ricotta mix in the top of each one. Roll up and eat. This is good hot. Can be made a couple of days in advance.

Random Ingredients: vodka,italian plum tomato,cranberry sauce,dark sesame oil
title: Tomato-Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans italian plum tomatoes, undrained | 1 cup vodka | 1/4 cup cranberry sauce | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: In a medium size mixing bowl, combine tomatoes and vodka. Let stand for 12 to 18 hours. Strain mixture through a fine mesh sieve and discard solids. Return tomato mixture to saucepan. Stir in cranberry sauce and sesame oil. Simmer, covered over medium low heat for 30 minutes.

title: Chef John's Mexican Pizza (With Bread Mix)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive | 3 cups breadcrumbs | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 3/4 cup warm water | 20 olives with pimento stuffed peppers | 1/4 cup chopped jalapeno pepper, or to taste | 2 1/2 teaspoons yeast
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon olive in a skillet over medium heat.

title: Cape Jack Cocktail
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces sherry wine vinegar | 3 ounces dark rum
instructions: Mix all together very well. Pour into an ice filled 6 oz glass.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,baking powder,gelatin,pecan half,bonnet chile pepper,lemon extract,mushroom cap
title: Pecan Chiles Marinated St Capon
ingredients: 8 skinless, stem-on king prawns, peeled | 10 large capon mushroom caps | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | 2 teaspoons chopped pecan halves, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place capon prawns in the water.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,potato,mustard seed,chestnut,self rising flour,filling,chili pepper flake,rice flour
title: Chestnut Fritters - Japanese Style
ingredients: 1 pound shelled chestnuts, well drained and roughly chopped | 3/4 cup mashed rice flour | 3/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/3 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons minced fresh chili pepper flakes | 3/4 teaspoon dry mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons chopped dried sweet chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup mashed potato | filling : | 1 cup soymilk | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice flour
instructions: Place chestnuts in a large bowl, and mash them. Stir in rice flour, self baking flour, soy milk, chili flakes, ground mustard seeds, sweet chili flakes and sweet chili flakes. Mix well with your hands. Heat about 1/4 inch vegetable oil in a large skillet over low heat. When oil shimmers, drop 1/4 cup chestnut mixture at a time into the hot oil. Fry, stirring, until chestnuts soften and test toothpick comes out clean, about 30 seconds per side. Using a slotted spoon, remove chestnuts to a paper towel lined plate. Spoon warm chestnut mixture around chestnuts and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,italian bread,marinara sauce,rice flour,tomato paste,cocoa powder,pork bean,brown mustard
title: Cheaters Beefy Italian Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread ( cut into 6 slices ) | 1 teaspoon rice flour ( or cornstarch ) | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon brown mustard ( or more ) | 1/4 cup virgin olive oil ( or other ) | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder ( or to taste ) | 1/1 cup marinara sauce ( i use prego baskin marinara ) | pork beans ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven, 350°f. Combine bread and rice flour or cornstarch in a shallow pan. Mix tomato paste, mustard, and cocoa until well incorporated. Dip the cut up meat in the dry ingredients, then brown the meat in a skillet on a medium low heat. Bake at 350°f for 50 - 55 minutes to a minimum internal of 70°f. If using beans, add 1 tablespoon of tomato sauce to marinara sauce when meat is nearly done. Top with marinara sauce and serve. Great with pasta.

title: Raspberry-Tomatillo Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun | 1 cup unsweetened light beer | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tomatoatillo | 1/4 teaspoon fresh lemon, zest of | 1/8 teaspoon of finely minced fresh yellow pepper | 1 cup seedless raspberry ( canned or fresh )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a small dish and mix very well to combine. Add more beer if too wet. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 to 6 hours. Heat a grill pan or broiler to medium high. Cook the burgers for about 3 minutes per side, then place on a large piece of foil to keep them warm. Serve with warm, buttered bread.

title: Amuse Bouche (German Pigs With Sauerkraut)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sauerkraut | 3 tablespoons finely chopped shallots ( or 4 teaspoons chopped white onion ) | 1 slice pepperoni
instructions: Brown sauerkraut, shallots and pepperoni in butter. Pour over cooked sauerkraut.

title: Easy Chinese Green Beans & Dried Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry quinoa | 6 fluid ounces dark soy sauce | 1 lb frozen green beans, thawed | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: In a large shallow pan, rinse quinoa under cold running water until water runs clear. Place quinoa in heat proof bowl. Add soy sauce, cover with plastic wrap, and bring to boil over medium high heat. Lower heat to medium and boil, covered, for about 8 minutes. Add beans, and cook uncovered, stirring halfway through, until thawed but still crisp about 3 - 4 minutes. Remove dish from heat and stir well. Cover tightly and let stand undisturbed for 12 - 15 minutes. To serve, uncover and spoon on some cooked beans.

title: Ginger Macadamia Nuts and Peppers
ingredients: 6 tablespoons gingerroot, minced ( one-inch piece ) | 3 tablespoons watercress, minced, with 1 tsp. oil from can | 1 ripe mandarin orange, skinned and very thinly sliced | 3 green olives, pitted and sliced ( such as nicoise ) | 3 pimento-stuffed green olives, pitted and chopped | 1 box pepper-packed chopped macadamia nuts | 6 tablespoons frangelico
instructions: Stir the gingerroot and watercress in a small bowl. Halve the mandarin oranges in half lengthwise and cut away both the stem and the seed into 1/2 inch pieces. Halve the green olives and cut each lengthwise into 1/2 inch pieces. Cut the pepper pack pepper pack into 1/2 inch pieces. Preheat the oven to 400°f in a bowl, combine the orange peel and all the remaining ingredients, except the nuts and frangelico, and lightly toss to mix. Line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper, or place on a baking sheet that has been lined with parchment paper. Spread the nut mixture evenly onto the parchment paper, or spread evenly on the paper. Spread the reserved nut mixture evenly evenly, being careful not to lay nuts on the top. Sprinkle the frangelico on top, or just dust with more frangelico if desired. Bake until brown and crisp, about 12 - 18 minutes.

title: Spanish Potatoes (Tapas) with Spicy Sausage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons potato starch | 2 tablespoons chorizo sausage ( spanish sausage ) | 1 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 egg, hard-boiled, peeled and cut into wedges | 7 -9 3 -5 slices cooked spanish chorizo sausage ( such as castelvetrano )
instructions: In a small bowl combine the potato starch and 1 tablespoon water. Stir until the mixture is no longer cloudy. Add the chorizo and coat. Add the egg, pinch of salt and pepper and stir until mixed. Preheat your oven to 350°f. Toss together the potatoes, sausage and egg, and place in a roasting pan. Bake the potato mixture for about 1 1/2 hours or until the liquid has evaporated. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bacon dripping,tarragon,lime wedge,green cardamom pod,chicken meat,plum tomato,celery rib
title: Chicken Chata Masala
ingredients: 300 g chicken meat, cubed | 3 slices bacon drippings ( vegetable oil would be nice ) | 2 -3 green cardamom pods | 2 celery ribs, cut into 1cm slices | 4 plum tomatoes, diced | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon, chopped | lime wedge | 2 teaspoons mixed tarragon ( garnish )
instructions: Heat the bacon drippings in a heavy based pan or pan over a medium heat. Toss the chicken pieces in the bacon grease to coat the cubes. Tip the pieces to brown on all sides then set aside. Reduce the heat under the pan. Add the cardamom pods and celery and fry for 5 mins, stirring to release flavours. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes. Return the chicken to the pan and stir. Add the tarragon and pour in enough water to come up 1cm above the chicken. Cover pan and simmer gently for 20 - 25 mins until the chicken is tender and sauce is thickened. Remove the pan from the heat. Season with salt and pepper. Serve in warmed bowls garnished with the extra tarragon. Variation, cook the chicken as stated in the introduction, adding the diced bacon, chopped green onions and a small pinch of freshly crushed chillies before cooking to seal in any flavourings.

title: Nif's Infused Brown Rice
ingredients: 4 cups brown rice, or as needed | 1 medium red onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions. When rice is about halfway, stir onion and fennel seed into the cooked rice. This may be served hot or cold.

title: Cranberry and Onion Nachos
ingredients: tortilla chips | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries or 1/2 cup frozen cranberries | 1/2 cup red onions or 1/2 cup green onion, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh coriander powder | crushed ice ( optional )
instructions: Boil 2 glasses of crushed ice or water. When the chips are soft, place in a blender along with cranberries and onions. Blend on highest setting for 30 seconds. Add crushed ice if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Pimientos on the Trees
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon black sesame seed | 1 jar sliced pimiento
instructions: Empty the cream of chicken soup into a saucepan with the black sesame seeds. Bring to a boil, then simmer over low heat until flavors blend, about 15 minutes. Transfer to plates. Garnish with pimentos.

title: Feta Cheese Spread  (Kalamaria)
ingredients: 2 lbs feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Mix together the feta cheese and vinegar and then refrigerate until ready to use. Makes a nice garnish to a bruschetta for grilled sandwiches.

title: Squash Smoothie
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 1 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 2 tablespoons ice water | 4 slices orange zest
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,dark soy sauce,heavy cream,okra,bacon dripping,bulk italian sausage
title: Baked Okra in Creamy Bavarian Sauce
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped okra ( thawed ) | 1 lb sweet bulk italian sausage ( hot or mild and links to taste ) | 1/4 cup bacon drippings | 1 can cream of asparagus soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup heavy cream or 1/2 cup light cream | dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a large casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle the okra in the bottom of the casserole dish. Cut the sausage into 4 equal portions and place in a large nonstick skillet. Cook over medium high heat until browned, about 5 minutes or until sausage is no longer pink, breaking up into larger pieces as it cooks. Drain sausage on paper towels. Transfer the sausage and cooked okra to the casserole. Stir in the soup, cream and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, stir in the okra. Transfer to the oven and bake until okra is tender, approximately 30 minutes. If sauce is too thick while baking, stir in a little water. Serve over cooked noodles or serve as is with hot buttered noodles and additional sauce.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,soya sauce,beef stew meat,cooking spray,stout beer,chipotle pepper
title: Chipotle Stampede
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 pound beef stew meat, cubed | 1 can chipotle peppers, seeded and diced | 1/4 cup ketchup, or more to taste | 1/4 cup soya sauce, or more to taste | 1/3 cup beer
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a baking dish with cooking spray. Place beef in the bottom of the baking dish and sprinkle with diced chipotle peppers and soya sauce. Pour beer around beef. Cover dish tightly with aluminum foil, and bake in the preheated oven 1 1/2 hours.

title: Bananas and Chicken in Banana Sauce
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | 2 1/2 pounds bananas - peeled, halved lengthwise | freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking dish. Arrange the chicken breasts in the prepared baking dish. Slice the bananas lengthwise into thin rounds. Spread the banana slices over the chicken. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear.

title: Italian Chicken and Beef
ingredients: 2 chicken leg quarters, split | 1 can marinara sauce | 1 pound ground beef chuck
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange half of the chicken leg quarters in the bottom of a casserole dish. Spread half of the marinara sauce across the chicken. Place ground beef across the top. Repeat layers with remaining chicken legs, sauce, and beef. Cover dish with aluminum foil, and bake in the preheated oven until the meat is no longer pink inside, about 1 hour. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees f. Allow to rest 10 minutes before serving.

title: Grilled Whole-Soy Spinach, Lemongrass & Couscous
ingredients: 400 g fresh spinach leaves | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 teaspoon mild vinegar | 2 spring onions, finely chopped | 225 g couscous | 5 tablespoons hoagie rolls
instructions: Place a few handfuls of spinach leaves in a pan and dry them as you do so. Heat a barbecue and grill the spinach until it wilts and it is just starting to brown. Drain this and set it aside. Mash the tamarind paste with 2 teaspoons water and the fish sauce. Set aside. Place the spring onions and couscous in a microwave safe bowl, cover with a microwave safe dish and cook in the microwave for 3 minutes using 600w. Once cooked, fluff with a fork. Stir the tamarind paste through the couscous and serve with your chosen accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,green chili pepper,red chili pepper,french haricot vert
title: Haricot Verts With Chillies and Prawns
ingredients: 500 g french haricots vert | 1 small green chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1/2 small red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed
instructions: Boil the english pea pod and blanch for a couple of minutes, then drain and set aside. Place the sprout heads in a large bowl with a good seasoning of salt, freshly ground black pepper, chili and coriander seeds. Add the pea pods. Toss well to mix and then transfer to a preheated oven at 200°c/400°f/gas add the chopped chillies and toss once more. The prawns cook very quickly and should only take 1 - 2 minutes if they are larger than an inch.

title: Yummy Pomegranate Molasses Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 big mangoes, chopped and peeled | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 -2 tablespoon pomegranate molasses
instructions: Wash mangoes. Sieve to make a finely chopped paste. Add pomegranate molasses and mix well. Serve as a side dish with hot puris or chapati.

title: Covered Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 pork loin | 1/4 cup vanilla extract | 1/4 cup poultry seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In the bottom of a 9 x 13 baking pan, pour 1/4 cup of vanillin into the pan. Sprinkle poultry seasoning over the loin. Cut a slit lengthwise down the center of the loin, lengthwise. Using a small knife, make a pocket in each slit. Pour 1/4 cup of vanilla over the loin and place a heavy object on top. Bake for 45 - 60 minutes, or until internal pork temperature reaches 160 degrees in the thickest part of the loin. Serve with custard.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,vegetable oil cooking spray,watercress,sherry,cream mushroom garlic soup
title: Watercress and Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup watercress or 1/2 cup salad green | 1 can cream of mushroom with garlic soup, undiluted | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Coarsely chop the watercress or mix together with the mushrooms. Add sherry, mustard seeds and reheat if necessary. Add cheese and mix well until melted.

title: Ruffles in Irish Whiskey
ingredients: 12 fresh tarragon, leaves | 3 tablespoons irish whiskey | 4 slices fresh gingernaps | 12 fresh raspberry tops or 12 jelly roll skins | 2 cups water chestnuts, in their shells
instructions: Remove the leaves and stems from the tarragon stalks. Cut the stems from the tarragon and add to a large saucepan with enough water to cover the leaves. Bring to a boil, but keep at a hard boil while you prepare the remaining fruit. Add whiskey and ginger in their shells. Boil for two minutes. Place 1 ramekin on a serving plate. Place a portion of the jam underneath the ramekin, place a small piece of water chestnut in the center and sprinkle with 1 or 2 teaspoons of remaining tarragon leaves. Continue to dip the ramekin in the rum, then place the ramekin onto the plate. Repeat for all 12 ramekin halves. Repeat the process with each ramekin. Pour the spiced rum into 4 champagne flutes, or 4 wine glasses.

title: Nestle's "Chile-Tomato Sauce"
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with juice, heated | 2 medium sized canned red chilies
instructions: Use the back of a spoon to mix all the ingredients. That's a basic sauce for any nacho con queso.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon,ice cube,rotel tomato,jumbo pasta shell,sherry,serrano chilies,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Candy Oranges With Spicy Mexican Shells
ingredients: 10 jumbo pasta shells ( or regular, for this recipe ) | 8 ounces rotel tomatoes | 3/4 cup dry sherry ( can use chicken broth or water ) | 3 tablespoons vegetable bouillon | 2 serrano chilies ( can use 2 green and 2 red chilies ) | 3 ounces grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | ice cube ( for dipping )
instructions: Bring medium size pot of water to boil and season with salt. Once boiling for the pasta, add the shells and cook them until they are just slightly undercooked, but just firm enough to handle and pliable this is best done just right through. Drain the water and then set aside to cool. Meanwhile heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat and add the rotel and chiles. Cook until chiles begin to release their aroma, but do not burn them. Add the tomato mixture, and cook until bubbly. Add the pabeso to the sauce, stirring well. Add the drained pasta to the skillet and stir frequently until all the pasta is coated in the sauce and the pasta is evenly coated with the sauce. Add the salt, to taste, and stir very well. Serve immediately. Optional and delicious notes, for a more substantial dish, you can add a larger amount of jalapenos and/or green peppers.

title: Walnut Oat and Spice Rounds
ingredients: 3 cups quick oats | 1 cup walnuts ( optional ) | 1 package vanilla wafer cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to in a med. Bowl, combine oats, walnuts, and baking. Drop by rounded tablespoons on a lightly sprayed baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for about 10 minutes, or until golden. Let cool on baking sheet. Spread oat mixture out and roll cookies in to coat.

Random Ingredients: xanthan gum,feta cheese,vegetable oil,sultana,brown lentil,back bacon
title: Gluten Free Sultana Cottage Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 200 g reduced-fat feta cheese ( crumbled ) | 2 tablespoons sultanas ( chopped raisins ) | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( or sunflower oil ) | 1 tablespoon gluten free oil
instructions: Bring lentils to boil. Turn down heat and simmer for 10 - 15 mins, until dry. Mash or coarsely chop the lentils, add all the other ingredients and mix well. Simmer for a further 15 mins until smooth and thickened. Serve warm, warm or cold with bread, or as suggested in introduction note.

title: Leprechaun's Eggplant for Two (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 small eggplants ( unpeeled ) | 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 jar salsa | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon peppermint extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Trim eggplants, if necessary. Place eggplants on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt. Bake or roast until tender, about 50 minutes. Remove eggplants from oven. Set aside. In food processor bowl, stir french onion soup, salsa, peppermint extract and eggplant. Process until creamy, stopping to scrape down sides. Return eggplant to baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes longer or until hot.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,red chile pepper,shallot,wonton wrapper,green capsicum,olive oil cooking spray,red potato
title: Peppered Red Capsicum and Pepperoni Pot Pies
ingredients: 12 wonton wrappers | 1 red potato, thinly sliced | 1 red capsicum, thinly sliced | 1 green capsicum, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 shallots, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground red chile pepper, or to taste
instructions: Place a wonton wrapper on a work surface. Place a potato, capsicum, and green capsicum slice alongside the wrappers. Brush each wrapper with olive oil. Sprinkle with a little more red chile pepper. Fold the wrapper in half, enclosing the filling and pressing the edges together. Wrap each pie in plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 hours. Heat a nonstick pan, such as a cast iron griddle, on medium heat. Cook the pies over medium heat until browned, about 3 minutes, turning to brown evenly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,corn tortilla,graham cracker crumb,pork shoulder
title: Chez Jose on the Rocks
ingredients: 2 lbs ground pork shoulder | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 can refrigerated graham cracker crumbs | 12 corn tortillas or 12 oil-cured corn tortillas
instructions: Remove the rind from the pork and crumble meat into a medium mixing bowl. Sprinkle the meat with as much garam masala as needed. Squeeze the bowl as necessary to get a level consistency. Mix together the graham cracker crumbs and the one can of the cracker crumbs until well mixed. Gently mix the meat with the cracker mixture, coating each tortilla with the mixture. Heat the oil or other cooking utensil on your stove over medium high heat. Working in batches, fry the tortillas a few at a time until lightly browned. Place on paper towels to drain. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: pesto,clove garlic,mccormick seasoning,lemon juice zest,parsley,garlic powder,red onion
title: Pesto Dressing for Fish, Fish, or Chicken
ingredients: 1/8 cup pesto ( can be made up to 3 days in advance ) | 1 teaspoon minced peeled garlic | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 3 tablespoons minced canned red onions | 1 tablespoon minced fresh parsley | 1 -2 pinch mccormick seasoning ( i like mccormick's grill mixture and spices ) | 1 pinch ground cloves of garlic | 2 pinches mccormick's mccormick's grill mixture, 1 | 1 pinch lemon juice, 1 ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl stir together pesto, garlic, lemon zest, onion, parsley, 1 - 2 pinches of mccormick grill seasoning and clove of garlic. Pour dressing over fish or chicken. Mix gently. Cover and refrigerate 3 - 4 hours for flavors to develop.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,tomato soup,pasta,white wine,red onion,baking soda
title: Easy Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces spiral pasta | 1 red onion, chopped | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup white wine | 2 tablespoons whole grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil and add pasta. Cook until pasta is al dente. Drain, reserve 1/2 cup pasta liquid and set aside. Sauté onion in saucepan until soft. Turn heat to low and add tomatoes soup, white wine and mustard, stir until it starts to blend. Add baking soda and 1/2 cup pasta liquid. Stir and turn heat back up to medium high and bring to a bubble. Add drained pasta along with the reserved 1/2 cup pasta liquid and stir to mix. Turn heat to low and allow pasta to heat through about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rose water,red food coloring,italian seasoning,orange peel,cream tartar,peppermint extract
title: Italian Creams - Low Fat
ingredients: 1 cup reduced-fat sour cream or 1 cup low-fat yogurt, plain | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 drop red food coloring | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground peppermint extract or 1/4 teaspoon rose water | 1 teaspoon orange peel
instructions: Combine sour cream and cream of tartar in a large mixing bowl. Add powdered italian seasoning and peppermint extract or rose water, and stir until well blended. Add orange and stir gently. Chill for 15 - 30 minutes. To serve, serve with desired garnishes.

title: German Poached Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb carrot, peeled | 1/2 white onion, sliced thinly | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup walnut halves, toasted
instructions: Place carrots and white onion in a sauce pan with barely enough water to cover. Bring to boil, cover, reduce heat to low and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours until carrots and onions are tender. Remove lid and continue cooking 10 minutes or until carrots are tender, stirring frequently. Add mustard and walnuts and toss until thoroughly coated.

title: Baked Parsnips With Hot Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons low-fat creme fraiche or 3 tablespoons sour cream | 1/2 lb parsnip, peeled and chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | fresh ground pepper | paprika, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. Combine the cream and milk in a pan and bring to a simmer over medium head. Add the parsnip and hot pepper sauce, stir to mix. Transfer to an ovenproof dish, sprinkle over paprika and cook in the oven for 30mins.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,orange juice,mini chocolate chip,phyllo pastry,radish,part ricotta cheese,tabasco sauce
title: Microwave Strata
ingredients: 4 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup edam mini chocolate chip | 1/4 cup chopped radish | 1 tablespoon grated gouda cheese or 1 tablespoon cheddar cheese | 3 drops tabasco sauce ( or a bit of your favorite hot sauce ) | 1/3 cup orange juice
instructions: Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray. Preparing a gas or charcoal fire, place phyllo sheets in the bottom of your grill. Coat with olive oil for cooking on top of the sheets or wrap in a damp cloth and place on plate covered with foil which works best for steam. Once you need to place your gas grill, a grill lighter will be helpful since you don't want your lasagna to burn on the bottom. When the grill is hot, place the sheets on a rack in the microwave and cook with the power on medium for 20 - 25 minutes, stopping the microwaving on the sheet every 5 minutes and rearranging them. Check if the strata is done by inserting a metal spatula between the strata and the side of the strata, if it is done, it should have the desired texture. It will vary according to your chosen wattage/heat level and power, i like mine crispy and chewy best while my waffle is still hot. Using a fork, scrape the strata out from the microwave or directly onto the plate, but do this while it is still hot so that everything is evenly distributed. Topping, mix ricotta with chipotle pepper, radish, cheese, tabasco and orange juice. Spread cheese mixture evenly on top with a wet spatula or your fingers. You don't need to use anything fancy. Once the strata is all hot, remove from microwave and cool on counter for 30 - 40 minutes. Unmolding, slice into 3 - 4 pieces. You should have about 24 pieces. Enjoy.

title: Penne
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta | 2 ounces aged cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 -3 tablespoons sourdough bread
instructions: Cook pasta and drain. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine sourdough bread and cheese, stirring with a fork. Pour over pasta. Bake in the oven until cheese is bubbly, about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Broiled Chinese Chicken
ingredients: 4 bone-in chicken breast halves | 1 bunch fresh chives
instructions: Preheat broiler to 500 degrees f. Season chicken with pepper and salt. Place about 2 tablespoons of each in the middle of the chicken breasts. Wrap each breast tightly with a chive stalk. Place them on a broiler pan skin side down. Broil 6 to 8 minutes until just cooked through.

title: Barbecued BBQ Pork
ingredients: 4 lbs country-style pork | 4 -6 cups seasoned rice vinegar
instructions: Clean the pork fillet thoroughly, trimming off any visible fat. Sprinkle the pork with a coating of the vinegar. Wrap the pork in foil. Place on the grill over high heat and cook, turning as necessary, until the pork just begins to show brown spots. Cover the heat and cook until the pork is just cooked through, about 2 hours. Slice on the diagonal. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,corn chip,vanilla bean,escarole,white flour,broccoli,mitsuba,sherry wine
title: Escarole With FAGE Total Baguette-Style Spread
ingredients: 16 ounces escarole, washed and coarsely grated, washed and spun dry | 16 ounces broccoli, washed and coarsely chopped | 1/2 small-size mitsuba ( black caviar ) | 16 ounces white flour, unbleached, unbleached all-purpose | 2/3 cup pine nuts ( not toasted and finely ground ) | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine ( not cooking sherry ) | 1/2 cup sesame seeds and 1 teaspoon cornstarch ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1vanilla beans ( optional ) or lemon ( optional ) or orange ( optional )
instructions: Put everything out into a salad bowl. Stagger on to the next step, when mixing together your hands or a pasta machine, mix everything until thoroughly well mixed. Put the mixture into an even dish, cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. When ready, transfer the mixture to a pretty serving bowl, garnish with the grated almonds and serve.

Random Ingredients: ha avocadoes,blueberry,beef chuck roast,sugar,dark brown sugar
title: Carne Guisada
ingredients: 8 ounces dried blueberries | 1 beef chuck roast, rinsed ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 large ripe hass avocadoes, pitted, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Place the berries in a bowl and cover with cold water by 2 inches. Let stand 30 minutes. Drain the berries and place them, cut side up, on a greased rimmed baking sheet, cover with foil and roast at 300 degrees until the berries have soaked overnight. Remove the roast from the oven and discard the foil. Cover and set aside and let sit at room temperature until the meat is very tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Drain the meat from the berry juice and coarsely chop. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Stem and seed the avocados. Place in a bowl and mash lightly with a fork. Stir in the sugar, sugar and salt and pepper. Place equal portions of the mashed avocado in the center of each piece of meat. Place the pan in the oven and roast until heated through, about 30 minutes.

title: Green Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, washed | 400 g chopped tomatoes and green chilies
instructions: Place the rice and tomatoes in a pan and cover with water. Bring to the boil then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,kernel corn,celery root,tarragon,onion powder
title: Grammy's Corn
ingredients: 3 ears fresh sweet corn | 1 onion, diced | 1 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 2 teaspoons celery root, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the ear of corn on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave for 10 to 15 minutes on high, or until tender. Rinse corn under cold water. When cool, cut kernels from cob. Place corn kernels, onion, cracker crumbs, tarragon and celery root in a medium bowl. Spoon or scoop half the topping mixture onto each cob and fold in half to evenly distribute filling.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,tabasco sauce,pot roast,chocolate coffee bean,catsup
title: Bean Balls - Mexican Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 can chocolate-covered coffee beans | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 dash tabasco sauce | pot roast, to cover
instructions: Place roast in a skillet and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 90 minutes. Remove roast from liquid and cut into small pieces. Drain and discard water. Combine beans, coffee and catsup in a large bowl and stir until well blended. Remove roast from bowl and add tabasco sauce. Shape into 1 inch balls. Place on a foil covered rimmed baking sheet and chill for 2 hours.

title: Mexican-Spiced Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 medium cucumbers | fresh salsa, to taste ( or any salsa you would choose ) | cayenne, to taste
instructions: Peel cucumbers, removing seeds and membrane and trim outer leaves. Cut into 4 or 5 wedges lengthwise. Cut wedges crosswise into thin strips. Place cucumbers in a strainer and rinse under running water a few times until water runs clear and drain. Remove and dry. Place cucumbers in a large bowl. Add salsa and cayenne.

title: Baked Veal and Vegetable Fingers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 lb ground veal | 1 lb ground veal ( optional ) | 1 cup prepared gravy or 1 cup prepared roasted red peppers | 2 large bell peppers, assorted colors, chopped ( red and green ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add both veal and meat, stirring to separate meat. Cook until well browned, stirring frequently.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,mayonnaise,tangerine juice,phyllo pastry,orange juice zest,kosher salt,mix,red chili powder
title: Sicilian Yogurt Cheese Phyllo Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, low-fat is fine | 1/2 cup tangerine juice | 1/2 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon red chili powder | 1/2 medium orange, juice and zest of | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon hot red chili powder | kosher salt | 4 sheets frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed, patted dry | 2 packages frozen reduced-fat mix, thawed
instructions: Make the filling/sauce, whisk together all of the ingredients except for the phyllo and refrigerate until needed. Meanwhile, spray 11x7 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Layer half of the phyllo sheets in the dish, brushing each sheet with melted butter from a jar just before phyllo is done. Spread half of the filling mixture evenly over phyllo. Top with half of remaining phyllo and remaining filling. Top with remaining phyllo sheets, brushing each one generously with butter. Sprinkle with remaining fat from jar. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Cover phyllo rolls with the dish towel, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until very brown. Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,zucchini,confectioner ' sugar,jalapeno pepper,red bell pepper
title: Confetti Zucchini Soup
ingredients: 2 zucchini ( about 1 1/2 lb small zucchini ) | 1 red bell pepper | 1 jalapeno pepper or 3 small serrano peppers | 1 quart vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise and remove seeds. Slice red and green peppers and place zucchini and peppers in a bowl.

title: Pork BBQ Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and brush onto pork.

title: Easy Spareribs
ingredients: 6 baking potatoes, cleaned of any excess moisture | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 1 packet mccormick taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place all the ingredients into a large bowl. Make sure the potato skins are clean. Lay the potatoes on a lightly greased baking sheet and bake for 40 to 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Make sure nothing sticks to them and it will keep from burning.

title: Spiced Semolina Cakes
ingredients: 600 ml semolina | 1/2 teaspoon custard powder | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped tarragon leaves | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped chilli oil
instructions: Heat the oven to 230°c/450°f/gas mark mix the custard powder with the tarragon leaves. Combine with semolina in a bowl and mix well. Pat into small oval patties. Spray oiled frying pan with non stick cooking spray and place on oven shelf. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,cottage cheese,habanero pepper,baking soda,ha avocadoes,red pepper,coffee liqueur
title: Pumpkin Avacado Jelly
