ingredients: 3 habanero peppers | 1 large baking soda | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 container low fat cottage cheese | 1/3 cup sweetened coffee flavored liqueur | 3 hass avocadoes | 1 tablespoon red pepper, finely crushed
instructions: Place peppers, baking soda, pumpkin, cottage cheese and liqueur in a blender and process until smooth. Cut avocados in half lengthwise, removing the skin with a teaspoon. Cut flesh into chunks. Place chunks of avocado into a large bowl and mash with a fork and fork. Stir in red pepper. Pour jelly on top and serve.

title: Roasted Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 - 5 cups sliced mushrooms | 6 medium yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a baking dish with cooking spray. Place the potatoes in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring water to a boil. Cook for about 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Drain and transfer potatoes to the prepared baking dish. Top with sliced mushrooms and dot with butter. Cover and bake for approximately 30 minutes or until the potatoes are lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,breadcrumb,chicken bouillon,white bread,cooking spray,walnut oil,red apple
title: Crispy Apple Crumble
ingredients: 2 lbs red apples, unpeeled, very thinly sliced ( i like macon, empire or rome ) | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 cube chicken bouillon ( or other flavourless bouillon ) | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | finely dry breadcrumb ( i use bread crumbs ) | cooking spray | 3 tablespoons finely chopped walnut oil | 2 tablespoons finely chopped walnut oil | cooking spray
instructions: Make crumbs by combining the walnut oil, walnut oil and bread crumbs and mixing well until you see the mixture become fine and gooey set aside. You want to evenly distribute the crumb mix into the apples, sprinkle with salt and pepper, drizzle 1tb worcestershire sauce over the top and toss gently. Preheat oven to place a large baking sheet in oven and scatter a few sprinkles of finely chopped walnut oil over the top to keep it wet and place in preheated oven. Allow to cook in oven for about 25 minutes till slightly crispy and very lightly coloured. Spray a large, shallow dish with cooking spray, and transfer the crumble mixture into it. Sprinkle with more finely chopped walnut oil and spread evenly. Serve immediately. This dish freezes well.

title: Calypso Bread
ingredients: 1 medium spanish onion, diced | 1/4 cup diced celery | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped pitted dates | 1 tablespoon light flavored bread flour | 2 tablespoons vodka ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Lightly oil or butter a 9x5x3 loaf pan. In a medium bowl, combine all the filling ingredients. Pour into the prepared pan. Bake at 300 degrees f for 90 minutes. Remove from oven, and allow to cool for 15 minutes before slicing and serving to allow complete storage.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,red bell pepper,peanut butter,four cheese mexican,yogurt
title: Mexican Peanut Butter Mousse
ingredients: 4 ounces four-cheese mexican blend cheese | 4 ounces low-fat yogurt | 1 tablespoon apple juice | 1/2 red bell pepper | 1 tablespoon peanut butter
instructions: Cut cheese into chunks, put in a bowl with yoghurt and juice. Stir fry for 3 minutes. Take sauce off the heat. Sieve and toss into cheese mixture, add bell pepper and peanut butter. Pour into serving dish. Leave for 25 - 30 minutes, serves hot or cold.

title: Quick "under the Broccoli" Phyllo-Panna Cotta
ingredients: 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon emeril lagasse's oriental spicy emeril & garlic seasoning | 1 package ladyfingers | 1 can spaghetti, broken in half | 1 head broccoli, chopped ( about 1 1/4 cups ) | 1 jar taco seasoning or ( 8 ounce ) jar hot sauce | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1 envelope shredded unsweetened candy sprinkles ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender and process until smooth, stopping occasionally to scrape down sides of the bowl. Line a baking sheet with parchment. Spread panna cotta in a single layer on baking sheet. Let sit 15 minutes or until phyllo has patted up a little bit. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and spread out to about 1/4 inch thickness. Spread spaghetti on phyllo and cut phyllo triangles in half. Place in your freezer until ready to use. When the phyllo phyllo triangles are up to 2 inches in diameter, transfer them on a paper towel lined cookie sheet. Slice off the top and bottom layers of phyllo, covering the pieces entirely. Set aside. Place spaghetti sheets on the same sheet, cut side down. Cut the phyllo lengthwise into about 6 pieces, then cut those pieces into thirds. Make sure that each piece has one piece cut side down. You will need 3 pieces to cut in each phyllo section, and for the bottom layer, 4 pieces. This will keep your phyllo sheets from drying out. Using a sharp knife, score the bottom of the phyllo sheets lengthwise to help produce slices that are not compressed, and can be cut in half again, producing slices that are approximately 1/2 inch thick. To prevent this kind of thing from happening, use a pastry brush to brush the phyllo rounds with a little oil, and place on a baking sheet. Set aside. Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets. If using candy sprinkles, spread one at a time onto each phyllo sheet, leaving a 1/4 inch border on the outermost side. Arrange broccoli, leaving a little of the stem on the top of each phyllo sheet, then place 4 sheets upright in a baking dish. Top each phyllo with a scoop of the sauce, then place 5 sheets upright on top of each other so they're completely covered. Cover dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least overnight, up to 4 hours or in the refrigerator up to 6 hours. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Use a baking stone, a glass or ceramic dish large enough to hold the phyllo in a single layer, or 2 large, rimmed cookie sheets. Arrange the phyllo sheets flat across the phyllo in a single layer, using your fingers, if necessary. Add 1 or 2 tablespoons of water to bottom of dish if necessary to cover the dough. Cover phyllo whole with waxed paper or parchment. Place the phyllo covered baking dish on a baking sheet with aluminum foil touching the rim. Bake 30 to 35 minutes, until phyllo has puffed up and turned a deep brown.

Random Ingredients: bread machine yeast,chili pepper flake,sherry wine,rice wine,spanish onion,white onion
title: Spanish Onion Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs white onions, peeled | 6 tablespoons bread machine yeast | 1 cup white onion, diced | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar | 1/4 teaspoon dry chili pepper flakes | 4 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 tablespoons rice wine
instructions: Place the ingredients in the bread machine in the order specified by the manufacturer. Select white bread mode.

title: Hot Apple Tofu With Asparagus
ingredients: 14 ounces tofu | 32 slices tart apples ( about 8-1/2 inches thick ) | 7 ounces asparagus, sliced ( about 4 5/8 inches long ) | 8 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 dash ground cloves
instructions: Heat skillet to 400°f and generously coat with nonstick cooking spray. Place tofu on work surface.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,onion powder,vanilla bean,salad dressing,canola oil,canning salt
title: Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups salad dressing | 1 vanilla bean | 1 teaspoon canning salt | 20 pineapple chunks, drained and crushed | 2 teaspoons canning salt | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 quart canola oil
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the salad dressing, vanilla, canning salt, pineapple chunks, onion powder, and canola until well blended.

title: Roasted Tripe Wrapped in Tarragon Leaves
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs tripe | tarragon | grated lettuce ( optional ) | hazelnuts ( optional ) | plain flour
instructions: Take the tripe out of the fridge, remove any fat, and cut into 3 pieces. Roll each piece into a roll. Place them on a baking tray and spread a good amount of the tarragon on each piece. Spread a good amount of the grated lettuce on. Sprinkle lightly with the hazelnuts. Dust the tops with flour. Spray a little oil on the tripe and grill them in the oven, turning as necessary, for 20 - 25 minutes, or until cooked through, turning as it crisps. Serve with a salad.

Random Ingredients: date,green enchilada sauce,olive oil cooking spray,gruyere cheese,red pepper,clove,half,egg
title: Chilean Cheese, Chiles & Dates
ingredients: 10 ounces shredded gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup diced red pepper | 1/2 cup diced green enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 6 dates, pitted, halved, then cut crosswise in 1/2 inch slices | 8 whole cloves | 4 large eggs | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Preheat broiler with rack in middle. Arrange cheese, peppers, enchilada sauce and half and half in 13 x 9 baking dish. Sprinkle with cloves. Whisk eggs with water in large bowl. Pour over cheese mixture. Sprinkle with salt. Cover and chill until ready to bake. Spray broiler grates with cooking oil before beginning bake. Remove from oven. Carefully transfer cheese mixture to broiler for 7 minutes or until golden brown and set around edges. Serve sprinkled with reserved cheese. Yield, 16 servings.

title: Quick and Easy Spanakopita Skillet
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice, uncooked | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 package fresh spinach leaves, washed and dry | 3 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning, divided
instructions: In bowl, combine rice and 1 teaspoon paprika. Drain, rinse under cold water and place on a plate sprayed with cooking spray. Toss with other tablespoon of greek seasoning. In a skillet, add oil and lightly steam spinach leaves. When cooked, remove from skillet and add to rice mixture. Heat through. Serve, garnished with remaining greek seasonings.

title: Spiced Coffee
ingredients: 2 cups brewed coffee | 1 cup vegetable broth or 1 cup coffee can
instructions: Pour coffee into blender. Add 1 cup of the brewed coffee and blend until frothy. Pour into mug and serve.

Random Ingredients: apple juice apricot,artichoke heart,curry powder,snow pea
title: Curried Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 package frozen, cut snow peas | 1 can artichoke hearts | 1 container apple juice ( apricots or apricots will do ) | 2 tablespoons curry powder, or to taste
instructions: Thaw frozen peas, and thaw at room temperature until peas are defrosted. Place snow peas, artichoke hearts, apple juice, and curry powder in an electric blender.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,red hot pepper,taco seasoning mix,seasoning salt,chipotle pepper,raspberry,bean sprout,kosher salt
title: Spicy Raspberries Bean Sprouts & Chipotle Dip
ingredients: 1/3 package taco seasoning mix ( spicy not dry ) | 1/3 cup fresh raspberry | 1 -2 canned chipotle pepper | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh hot pepper, crushed | 2 -3 -4 fresh curry leaves | 1 can fat-free refried beans with mixed sprouts ( or more ) | 1 pinch seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a small bowl, mix the taco seasoning, raspberries, and chipotle peppers. Spread the mixture on a lightly oiled large cookie sheet and sprinkle with the cayenne pepper flakes or the desired amount of pepper. Broil until crisp and lightly browned, about 2 minutes, depending on the temperature of your broiler. Remove from oven and let cool completely. Spread the refried bean sprouts/sauce on a serving plate. Spread the bean sprouts/spicy raspberry mixture on top of the bean sprouts/spicy raspberry mixture. Sprinkle with desired amount of seasoning salt and fresh hot pepper. Serve with corn chips or as a salad accompaniment to a vegetable vegetable snack. Enjoy with crispy grilled or grilled chicken pieces or chicken breasts.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,sage leaf,kaffir lime leaf,mayonnaise,tomato green chilies,havarti cheese,italian bread
title: Green Chile Toast
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons minced fresh sage leaves | 1 tablespoon grated havarti cheese | 3 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies | 4 kaffir lime leaves, cut into strips | 4 slices italian bread, toasted and buttered
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread and lime leaves in a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Spread about ¼ cup of the chile mayonnaise on each piece of bread. Top with the bread. Serve immediately.

title: Braised Chicken Wings (Jidan Er Dun)
ingredients: 2 whole chicken wings | 2 fluid ounces peanut oil | 1 1/2 inches ginger, peeled and chopped | 14 fluid ounces canned black beans | 6 fluid ounces prepared hot mustard
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Wash chicken and pierce with a whole bone or skewer. Insert the ginger into the center of the breasts. Rinse and dry the chicken wings. Cut off the wing tips and set aside. Put the oil into a shallow pan and set over medium heat. When oil is hot, put chicken in. Put a lid on pan and place in the oven. Baste meat frequently with the hot oil. Once the chicken and the fat are about half done, put back in the oven and cook until the wings are tender. Meanwhile, peel and slice the beans into thin half rings or triangles. Drain chicken wings and serve. Garnish with spicy mustard.

Random Ingredients: kingfish,cocoa powder,basic french tart dough pate brisee,gin,sherry,bacon,olive,coriander
title: Pate Brisee Stuffed Faux Brioches
ingredients: 1 basic french tart dough or 1 puff pastry dough, thawed | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder ( see note, below ) | 1 cup finely chopped coriander ( including coriander stalk ) | 2 tablespoons sherry | 1 1/2 lbs kingfish, raw ( about 50g ) or 2 lbs salmon, skin-on, boned, cut into 3/4 inch dice ( about 50g ) | 3 slices bacon, chopped | 1 1/2 cups pinot grigio, freshly grated such as parmigiano-reggiano or 1 1/2 cups pecorino romano cheese or 1 1/2 cups pecorino romano cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons olive, preferably extra virgin
instructions: Note, if using puff pastry dough on a floured surface, using the paddle attachment of your hands, roll out the dough onto a floured surface, adding the cocoa powder a few tablespoons at a time. Using a rolling pin, gently press and roll the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch. Using a 2 1/2 inch round cookie cutter or drinking glass, cut out 12 circles. Using a 3 inch round cookie cutter, cut out 12 squares again. Set aside for use later. Preheat the oven to 200c. Put the coriander, sherry, and 1 tablespoon of olive into a small pot. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally until the liquid has evaporated, about 8 minutes. Let mixture cool about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and transfer to a small bowl. Add the fish, bacon, pinot grigio or mozzarella and cheese and mix together. Divide fish filling among the pastry circles. Brush the edges of the pastry with a little olive oil and fold pastry over to enclose as much of the fish as you can. Place on a baking tray and bake for 30 - 40 minutes or until they are golden and crusty. Let cool a few minutes and serve warm with a fresh tomato concordado or vinaigrette. Note, you can use the basic french tart dough or puff pastry dough or your own homemade dough. If using puff pastry dough, place the dough rounds on a floured baking sheet. Bake at 200c / 400f / gas mark 2 / 375f / 15' for 5 - 8 minutes, until they reach a browned crust. Using a 1 1/2inch round cookie cutter or drinking glass, cut out 12 rounds, each into 12 squares total. Place the triangles on a baking tray. Brush each triangle with olive oil and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until very lightly golden. Variation, alternatively, you can use pastry dough in place of the basic french tart dough or puff pastry dough and bake the triangles for 15 minutes / 20 minutes / 30 minutes, until they reach an instant read thermometer of 180c / 360f / gas mark 5 /. If using puff pastry dough, place the pieces onto a baking tray and bake at 200c / 400f / gas mark 3 / 35 - 40 minutes, until very light and golden. When the pastry is cool, remove from the oven, and arrange on 4 serving plates. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: currant,self rising flour,fettuccine pasta,kaffir lime leaf,caster sugar,curry paste
title: Currant, Lime and Fettuccine Gratinees
ingredients: 1/4 lb currants or 1/4 lb golden raisin | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 lb fettuccine pasta | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon curry paste | 1 kaffir lime leaf, finely shredded | 8 tablespoons thick curry paste ( heaped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f place currants in a small saucepan and just cover with water. Bring to the boil and cook quickly, uncovered, for about 1 minute or until just tender. Pour off the water and reserve. Place the flour and sugar in a medium bowl and, using a wooden spoon, mix in the kaffir lime leaf. Slowly add 1/3 c of the water and with a wooden spoon, stir the flour mixture into the wet ingredients, until just moist. Drain the currants well and place in a bowl. Return the saucepan of currants to the stove and increase the heat until it starts to bubble. Add a little more water and continue cooking the mixture, stirring now and then, until it has been reduced by about one third. Remove from the heat and set aside. Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions. Drain the pasta and return it to the saucepan. Add the curry paste and mix through. Return to the heat, then serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Pepper Spread
ingredients: 10 banana peppers | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 basil sprig, leaves picked
instructions: Peel peppers, remove stems, cut in half lengthwise and remove seeds. Rinse. Cut into thin matchstick strips. Place in a bowl with 1/8 cup water. Mix in cocoa. Cover and refrigerate until thick. Store in a tightly covered container.

title: Easy Chickpea and Tomato Pie
ingredients: ghee or other margarine, for pan frying | 2 medium firm ripe tomatoes, peeled, seeded and diced | 4 tablespoons tomato ketchup, or more to taste | 2 cans garbanzo beans, drained | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
instructions: In a large skillet, heat ghee over medium heat. Add tomatoes and 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup. Cook, stirring frequently, until tomatoes soften, about 10 minutes. Stir in beans and cook another 10 minutes. Reduce heat to low, add remaining tomato ketchup, then blend in flour. Spread mixture into an ungreased 9 inch pie dish. Bake at 325 degrees f for 10 minutes, or until cheese has melted and edges are golden brown. Serve with sliced white or brown basmati rice.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,pineapple chunk,brown rice,white flour,mix
title: Super Easy Sweet Rice Ball
ingredients: 2 cups instant brown rice ( rice flour ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 cups sweet roll mix | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained, reserve juice | 1/4 cup white flour
instructions: Cook rice and drain. Blend soup and reserved pineapple juice with rice. Add sugar to taste and then flour. Place rice mixture into a glass baking dish and roll around mixture, coating all the rice. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake 30 - 45 minutes at 350 degrees until hot, covering after 10 minutes with foil. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,arborio rice,anchovy fillet,baking soda,zucchini,vanilla extract
title: Baked Zucchini With Anchovies
ingredients: 8 cups yellow squash, chopped | 3 zucchini, coarsely chopped | 2 cups arborio rice | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 2 anchovy fillets, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Place all of the ingredients in a large baking dish except the zucchini. Mix well. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Remove from the oven. Allow to cool and then cut diagonally into 1/4 inch slices. Place cut side down on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, cover the zucchini slices with aluminium foil and bake until tender approximately 15 minutes.

title: Anise Spice
ingredients: 500 g chicken stock cubes | 1 tablespoon ground anise seed
instructions: Use a fork or pestle to crush the anise seed until you see puffs of anise.

title: Cheesy Mexican Crumbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mexican blend cheese, shredded ( or similar cheese ) | 3 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup caster sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Cream cheese with caster sugar until light and creamy, gradually adding dry ingredients. Spread onto greaseproof paper lined cookie tray. Press out evenly with floured hands until 1cm thick. Bake for 40 minutes, until golden brown. Allow to cool on wire rack. Cut into squares.

title: Baked Egg Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles | 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Prepare noodles according to package directions. Drain well in a colander. Mix eggs and 1/2 the cheddar cheese together. In a bowl, mix noodles and egg mixture together. Spread with the remaining cheddar cheese. Bake for 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: au jus mix,chinkiang vinegar,red lentil,penne,green cardamom
title: Spicy Red Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 medium red lentil | 8 ounces penne, cooked according to manufacturer instructions ( or couscous ) | 1 package au jus mix | 1 tablespoon chinkiang vinegar | 1 green cardamom
instructions: Drain the red lentils well in a colander. Mix the cooked lentils with the chinkiang vinegar. Mix all ingredients well with clean hands. Chill, serve and enjoy it's wonderful.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,spinach leaf,daikon radish,ricotta cheese,vodka,taco seasoning,tortilla
title: Yummy Mexican Lamb Wraps #5FIX
ingredients: 12 -14 tortillas | 12 ounces ricotta cheese ( approx., a half cup of the kind is good ) | 1 1/2 lbs cooked lamb shoulder ( approx ) | 12 ounces daikon radishes | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1/4 cup vodka
instructions: Dice the lamb, or use leftover cooked lamb, or use leftover cooked potatoes if there are little kids, or if you really like lamb, don't worry about it, they'll just be fine. I also cook a large roll of tortillas which are basically 5 thin ones. When you're about to fry them, make the pizza sauce while making the filling. Combine the ricotta, half of the taco seasoning, spinach, radishes and vodka. Mix thoroughly. Once you have the sauce in the fridge, put one tortilla into a glass container, it will look sort of like a big tortilla, but you'll actually have them all on a plate. Add the filling to the tortilla, spread evenly, and roll the tortilla, starting at the thin edge, and adding the rest of the filling you'll be using for later later. Wrap each rolled wrap in aluminium foil. Place on a hot griddle or a baking sheet on the broil setting. You don't have to use a heavy pan, but for the first side, you don't need to heat the griddle. You'll just use the foil to cover the rest of the wraps. Cook until the outside of the roll is slightly browned, and it can be eaten when the bottom is a bit crispy. Serve with warm tortillas and lots of salad, if desired.

title: Super Easy Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the dry soup mix, red peppers and onion soup mix. Cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes to blend flavors, or until hot. Cool to room temperature and store in refrigerator.

title: Crock Pot Pizzas
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/8 cup sultana | 2 teaspoons lemon zest | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Place pizza base into crock pot on low. Pour all other ingredients into a bowl and mix together. Spoon pizza mixture onto prepared pizza base, sprinkle with oregano. Cook for 30 - 40 minutes. Allow pizza to cool for 10 - 15 mins before cutting into squares and eating.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,crimini mushroom,pimiento,tomato wedge,egg yolk,pesto sauce,pineapple juice
title: Italian Pepper Steak and Pesto
ingredients: 1 large egg yolk | 1/2 cup chopped pimiento | 3/4 cup chopped pineapple with juice | 3/4 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 cup sun-cried tomatoes with oil, chopped | 1/4 cup diced fresh red chili pepper | 2 cups crimini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: In a bowl, beat egg yolk with pimiento, pineapple and pesto until blended. Stir in sun dried tomatoes and chili peppers. Stir in mushrooms. Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Brush with egg mixture. Place over medium high heat and cook about 3 minutes or until cooked through, brushing with egg mixture as it cooks. Slice when cooked.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,chicken tender,limeade concentrate,pasta,chili pepper
title: Chicken Tikka Pasta
ingredients: 1 boneless chicken tenders | 1/2 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 chili pepper, minced | 3 cups hot cooked pasta
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Combine limeade concentrate, yogurt, and chile pepper in a large bowl. Add chicken tenders and toss to coat. Grill about 10 minutes until chicken is no longer pink outside and juices run clear,. Remove from grill, cover, and let rest about 10 minutes. Spoon chicken mixture, over hot cooked pasta, and serve with salsa.

title: Tostones
ingredients: 1 red cabbage, finely shredded or 2 bags red cabbage | salad oil
instructions: Wash the cabbage thoroughly in cold water. Remove excess moisture. You should have about 4 cups shredded or shredded cabbage as compared to the packaged cabbage. Put the cabbage in a dry frying pan with 1 tbs. Salad oil. Cook over medium heat until the leaves become very crisp or, toss with a little salad oil and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,tortilla,almond butter,hot italian sausage,wine vinegar,sea salt,ghee,fenugreek leaf
title: Baked Sausages With Fennel and Almonds
ingredients: 6 tablespoons unsalted almond butter ( almond flavored ) | 1/4 cup paprika ghee ( vegan butter ) | 1 1/2 lbs hot italian sausage, cut into 1-inch thick slices | 1 tablespoon toasted ground almonds ( i omit this entirely, it does make a difference to the flavor ) | 1/4 cup blanched whole almond, slivered ( can be found at asian specialty stores ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 2 teaspoons coarse sea salt, about | 1/2 cup fresh fenugreek leaves, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a 1 1/2 quart baking dish with parchment paper. Butter a 9x13 metal baking dish, with 3 1/2 tablespoons butter, then spread the almond butter in a thin layer across the bottom. Arrange the sausage slices in a single layer in the dish. Sprinkle each with some paprika and a pinch of almonds. Drizzle with more butter, dot with 2 teaspoons butter, and top with the remaining onion slices, sprinkling each layer with almonds. Set baking dish in a small roasting pan. Add the vinegar, almond extract, and coarse sea salt to the pan and stir to mix well. Just before the oven is just about ready add the fenugreek leaves, which should just be steaming hot, just a few minutes. Pour evenly over the sausage slices. Sprinkle the fenugreek on top of the bacon, then cover dish, and bake for 35 minutes, or until fenugreek is tender, basting every 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Roasted Asparagus Sage and Broccoli
ingredients: 3 pounds fresh asparagus, trimmed | 24 fresh sage leaves | 1 cup soymilk | 4 bags frozen broccoli stems
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or aluminum foil. Mix the asparagus, sage, and soy milk together in a bowl. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Remove from heat and drop asparagus mixture by the handful, 2 to 3 at a time, onto the boiling water. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the asparagus is cooked to desired tenderness, about 6 minutes. Remove the asparagus to a bowl with a slotted spoon, and arrange them on the prepared pan. Roast in the preheated oven until the vegetables are tender, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,basil,fish sauce,cold water,beef steak,vegetable oil cooking spray,brown rice,sesame seed
title: Korean Beef With Rice
ingredients: 1 lb beef flank steak | 1 tablespoon sugar | 3 tablespoons water | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil ( i use cooking spray ) | 4 tablespoons sesame seeds | hot cooked brown rice
instructions: Cut flank steak diagonally crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,herb,hot red chili pepper,rump roast
title: Crock Pot Italian Country Style Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 lbs top rump roast | herbs | white sugar | 2 large hot red chili peppers
instructions: Place beef in crock pot and sprinkle with herbs. Add a little white sugar to taste. Stir. Cook on high for 8 - 10 hours. Remove any fat and gristle from chili and slice across the grain. Serve on buns.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,cognac,chicken,lime wedge,grain bread,chunky salsa,bicarbonate soda,clove
title: Pollo En Branche (Chicken & Honey Croquettes)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken or 2 lbs chicken pieces ( chicken breasts ) | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 lime wedge, rind of | 2 cloves | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 12 ounces chunky salsa ( you 'll need 12 oz, a little goes a long way ) | 3 fluid ounces cognac ( you 'll need another splash ) | finely-chopped flat-grain bread, to serve
instructions: Trim the excess fat from the chicken, and cut the meat into chunks. Cut the cloves into quarters if desired. Mix the bicarb soda with the lime rind, lime juice, honey, and salsa. Pour into a bowl, stir in the chicken, and set aside. Heat the broiler to high. Dip the bread in the hot cooking oil, coating them in the batter. Place the tray under the broiler, and cook the strips until golden. Serve at once with the dipping bread. If you prefer, serve them straight from the pan.

title: Nigella Lawson Preserved Lemons
ingredients: 25 green olives | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons mirin ( sweet japanese cooking wine ) | 4 green cardamoms ( black ) | 4 tablespoons tortillas ( or a combination of the two ) or 4 tablespoons other coarse whole-meal sesame seeds, lightly toasted, to garnish
instructions: Rinse olives well, remove white pith, cut off tops, and cut away green center. Cut each olive in half vertically, then cut halves into 1/4 wide slivers. Add salt, mirin, cardamom and cook onions in olive oil until soft and translucent. Add olives and cook another 3 minutes to warm them. Transfer fried onions to serving dish, garnish with toasted sesame seeds and serve immediately or cool and store covered in the refrigerator.

title: Banana Pork
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless pork shoulder, fat trimmed, cut into 1 1/2 in cubes | 3/4 cup chunky salsa or 3/4 cup picante sauce, warmed | 1/4 cup chopped lemongrass or 1/4 cup green onion | 3/4 cup chopped banana | 2 tablespoons fresh capers, minced ( optional ) | 15 ounces sweet peas, drained, rinsed | 1/3 cup sultana | 2 -3 medium loaves day old bread
instructions: Place beef, salsa and lemongrass in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. Top with remaining items except bread, placing a cover on the cooker. Cover and cook on low until meat is tender, 8 to 10 hours. Turn cooker to high, add bread and stir well to pick up any chunks of bread. Serve with boiled or steamed rice or hot spiced potatoes.

title: Crock Pot Mexican Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs egg noodles | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Prep and cook all noodles as directed on package. Cut french stick into 3 or 4 sections. Put in crock pot. Put taco seasoning in a ziploc bag and squeeze out excess air. Remove noodles from bag. When noodles are done add all noodles to crock pot. Dump the dry taco seasoning over top. Cook on low setting for 3 hours. Serve in bowl with sour cream and shredded cheese.

title: Blue Cheese and Garlic Paste
ingredients: 300 g natural blue cheese ( gorgonzola ) | 1 -2 teaspoon peanut oil or 1 -2 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic paste
instructions: Slice the cheese into little balls about 1 inch square each or so. They're easier to cook in the oven. Crush the garlic into small pieces by whizzing it in a coffee grinder or mortar and pestle. Heat a pan over high heat and add the oil. When the oil is hot but not smoking, add the garlic and fry until golden, about 30 seconds. Stir in the garlic paste and cook for 30 seconds. Add the gorgonzola, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Once again stir with the wooden spoon continuously without breaking the cheese, but using a wooden spoon will help keep the cheese from sticking to the bottom. Allow the gorgonzola to soften and get a little bit richer, before serving with crackers.

title: Nacho Yogurt
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups yogurt | 1 fresh pickling cucumber, about 4 cucumbers | 1/2 cup mild salsa ( i use ranchero salsa fresca ) | 1/4 cup sweet vermouth
instructions: Chop 1/2 cup cucumber. Place in a strainer with 1/2 cup water and let stand 10 minutes until water starts to run clear. Squeeze out and discard water. Place cucumber in a small bowl and add 1/2 cup water. Let stand 30 minutes to 1 hour. Drain and discard water. Stirring briskly, stir together 1/2 cup water and 1/2 cup yogurt in large bowl. Toss with drained cucumber. Cover bowl and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Stir in other 1/2 cup yogurt with a fork until smooth. Transfer to decorative, sterilized jars, leaving 1/4 inch headspace. Top with lids and screw on rings. Put in a hot water bath for 15 minutes. Remove from hot water and let cool completely. Repeat process with remaining yogurt. To serve, place a dollop on warm chilled hot tortilla. Top with salsa fresca and 1/4 cup yogurt.

title: Nacho Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup milk | 1/4 cup greek seasoning | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 1/2 cups chopped, sweet mango | 1/3 cup crumbled manchego cheese | 1 pinch dried dill | 1 taco shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Whisk milk, greek seasoning, and salt together in a large glass baking dish. Place mango, cheese, and dill in the mixture, stirring until completely melted. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, about 10 minutes.

title: Wild Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons honey | 1/4 cup water chestnut, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground savory | 1/8 teaspoon chili pepper | 2 portobello mushroom caps, halved
instructions: Combine honey, water chestnuts, savory and chill pepper in small bowl. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Cooks' note, can use frozen mushrooms, although portobello mushrooms are more difficult to detect when cooked. Cooks' note, for extra flavor, you can add chopped fresh, fresh mushrooms, such as mushrooms de arbol, and sliced green onion.

title: Sour Scallops
ingredients: 2 cans cleaned scallops, well drained | 3 tablespoons peanut butter or 3 tablespoons coconut margarine | 2 1/4 cups sour cream ( you can use low fat ) | 1 cup brewed tea or 1 cup water
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the scallops with the peanut butter or coconut margarine. Cover tightly and chill well. Just before serving, stir the sour cream into the chilled sour cream to smooth out, then mix with the coffee powder. Serve over the scallops.

title: Shrimp Enchilada
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, cooked | 1/2 lb cornmeal | 1/4 lb fettuccine pasta ( or linguine ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red chili | 1/4 - 1/2 cup bourbon
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Prepare pasta per package instructions. Saute shrimp, corn meal and garlic salt until shrimp are just pink. Drain. Combine shrimp mixture, Bourbon, chilies and 1/4 cup water in large bowl. Mix well. Spoon into shallow oven proof dish. Bake for 40 minutes. Serve with more bourbon for dipping.

title: Spicy Chicken Quiche (Or Pies)
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie shell | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground gingerroot | 1/2 cup chorizo sausage or 1/2 cup other spicy sausage, browned and crumbled | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 package frozen cooked chicken tenders, thawed, drained and chopped | 1 cup frozen french rolls, thawed and crumbed dry on a paper towel | 1 -2 tablespoon semolina ( optional ) | 1 3/4 teaspoons grated fresh gingerroot or 1 3/4 teaspoons ground gingerroot | 2 teaspoons dried sage leaves | salt and freshly ground pepper, to taste
instructions: Set oven to 400 f. Press pie shell on a pan. Sprinkle with half the ground ginger, all the sausage together, and the remaining ground ginger. Sprinkle with the sage/toothpick/sugar mixture evenly, and press down for a few times on the bottom and the edges. Add the chicken and roll up. Using fingers, lightly push the crust to push it into the shape. Trim and discard the crust. Trim and crimp the edges so as to just cover the pie shell. Slide a few plastic spoons or sharp knives along the edge of the the pie and trim off any crust or extra crust. Brush the top crust with a little water if necessary to prevent pastry from burning. Put the pie in the oven and turn the temperature up to 400 degrees. Bake, uncovered, for approximately 40 minutes. Allow to cool slightly, remove all foil, and bake, uncovered, for another 15 - 20 minutes until the crust is nicely browned. Let cool, remove from the oven and set aside to cool somewhat. Serve warm.

title: Cheese Bites
ingredients: 9 ounces american cheese | 3 ounces bacon drippings
instructions: Cut cheese into 8 chunks, about one third inch wide. Set aside. Roll each chunk with a rolling pin or waxed paper, the thickness of your knife. You need to have enough space between each chunk. Spread bacon dripping into a deep, heavy frying pan. Fry on high heat until it simmers, about 5 minutes. Turn cheese chunks into bacon drippings and fry 5 - 10 minutes more, until golden. Drain on paper towels and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,red potato,cream,ladyfinger,head cabbage,bamboo shoot,sauerkraut,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Polish-Russian Potatoes and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 4 cups cooked red potatoes, diced | 1 head cabbage, quartered cored and sliced 1/2 inch thick | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1/2 head cabbage, shredded | 1 package babyfingers | 1 can lily pickled bamboo shoots | vegetable oil | 2 packages sauerkraut, drained | sour cream or mayonnaise
instructions: In a large bowl toss potatoes with 1/2 cup of the diced cabbage. Let cool, then fold into remaining ingredients. Place the bag of babyfingers in a steamer basket over boiling water. Let sit about 5 minutes until they float to the surface. Drain and cool completely before dipping in a bowl of sour cream and filling.

Random Ingredients: pecan half,white meat chicken,cardamom pod,rice noodle,mirin
title: Spiral Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles | 1 white meat chicken or 3 -4 ounces diced cooked chicken | 3 cups pecan halves or 2 cups pecan halves | 1 cup mirin | 3 cardamom pods
instructions: Wash the rice noodles well. In a large bowl mix together the chicken, pecans, mirin. Mix the rice noodles into the dressing and toss well to coat thoroughly. This salad can last up to 2 weeks if stored covered tightly in the refrigerator. It can also be kept refrigerated indefinitely.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,sherry wine,turmeric powder,edamame,stew beef chunk,hamburger
title: Beef-And-Arib Beef With Edamame
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta, fresh or 8 ounces other small-sized pasta | 1/3 cup sherry wine | 1 lb stew beef chunk, cut bite size | 1 lb frozen shelled edamame, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/3 lb hamburger
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In 3 quart dutch oven, cook beef with 1/3 cup sherry until the beef is no longer pink and drain off fat. Return the beef and onion to dutch oven with the frozen edamame and cook over medium high heat for 12 - 15 minutes stirring often until beef is browned.

title: Taco Mousse
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, cut crosswise into 1 inch pieces | 4 shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and thinly sliced | 3 dashes italian seasoning ( or any other seasoning ) | 1 ounce unflavored gelatin | 1 package taco seasoning, packets ( or 2 envelopes if homemade )
instructions: Place the bacon pieces in a small skillet and cook over medium high heat until the bacon is browned, about 10 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the bacon and set aside. Remove any loose bits in the pan and set aside. Increase the heat to high and lightly brown the mushrooms, about 5 minutes. Spoon the mushrooms into a bowl or set aside, pressing down on the mushrooms with your fingers so the liquid evaporates. Dissolve the gelatin in the hot water. Stir the gelatin mixture into the mushrooms and heat until hot, 1 - 2 minutes. Scoop up 2 tbsp of the hot gelatin and set aside. When the gelatin has absorbed all the gelatin water, stir in 1/2 cup of reserved gelatin water and 1 tablespoons of the bacon mixture. Stir in the taco seasoning mix and set aside. When all of the gelatin is dissolved, pour half of the mixture into a medium bowl or serving dish and gently fold the tofu/bacon mixture into the gelatin, leaving the remaining mixture in the bowl. Cover with another layer of the softened gelatin. Serve.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,swiss chard,grain bread,chicken stock,raisin,self raising flour,chili sauce,chili powder
title: Low Fat Baked Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage, shredded | 3 cups shredded swiss chard | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup skim-milk reduced-fat chicken broth | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 4 slices whole grain bread, crusts removed | 2 teaspoons flour
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 2 cup capacity microwave safe casserole and cook on high for 5 minutes stirring twice or until the cabbage is tender. Add the bread and bake in a 200 degree c oven for 30 minutes. Serve with cream and yoghurt.

title: Viennese Veal (Or Veal With Chips)
ingredients: 4 lbs veal, cut into thin slices ( or other suitable meat ) | 1 can vegetable broth, plus a little broth, but do not use more than a little as needed | mini semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: First of all, allow any fat or impurities to set in the skillet. Pour in the broth and heat. Taste and add more broth if necessary. Add the thin, unpeeled veal strips and brown well. While the strips are cooking, melt the chocolate in a pan over low heat for five minutes or more over very low heat. Remove the seared veal strips, and put on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle the tops with the chocolate bits. Place under a broiler until the chocolate is golden brown, watching carefully. Serve at once, or let cool. Note, if you are making this with venison, use only the meat or veal that has been partially blanched over high heat until no blood seeps out. Serves 4 or 6.

title: Spinach and Broccoli Pakora
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpea flour | 4 medium heads cauliflower, cut into florets | 3 large broccoli florets, cut into florets | 1 - 2 cup prepared salsa
instructions: In a medium bowl or food processor, combine chickpea flour and vegetables. Heat a frying pan over med high heat. Dredge vegetables into the pan, flipping to coat on all sides. Carefully place the pakoras into the hot pan and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until golden brown, turning once. Serve with salsa or sour cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,sharp cheddar cheese,pork chop,chicken breast
title: Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 -8 boneless pork chops | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon chicken breast, dried ( more or less, depending on what you like ) | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: If the pork chops are not very long, cut them in half. If any of the chops are very large, cut them in half. Place chops in a shallow baking dish. Combine and sprinkle both sides of each chop with the onion powder, chicken and about ¼ of the cheese. Bake at 350°f for 15 - 20 minutes, or until chops are cooked through.

title: Smoked Salmon and Cabbage Rolls(Denmark)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs smoked salmon fillets | 1 lb rib-dusted beef or 1 lb pork fillet | 1 1/2 lbs green cabbage | 1/2 cup pistachios or 1/2 cup blanched almond, coarsely chopped to garnish
instructions: Place the smoked salmon, beef or pork, cabbage and nuts in a large pot, bring to a boil, then simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and cool for at least 10 minutes. Cut each roll into four pieces. Cut each piece into four pieces and roll each piece around a smoked salmon piece. Arrange the rolls, seam side down in a large frying pan just big enough to hold them in one layer, add some oil into the pan, and heat until hot. Pour the contents of the frying pan into a casserole or serving platter, pour the contents of the frying pan through a strainer into a saucepan or serve as is in the ingredients list, allowing the flavours to blend together.

title: Italian Fried Beans
ingredients: 2 cans baked beans | 1 envelope dry italian-style salad dressing mix | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Place beans in a large saucepan.

title: Ketchup Cream from a Bottle
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 fresh thyme sprig
instructions: In a small bowl, mix cream with ketchup until desired texture, then set aside. Gather thyme sprigs, and place in a bowl. Pour cream mixture into a pot over low heat, and heat until it begins to thicken, about 5 minutes. Remove thyme sprigs with a slotted spoon, and sprinkle with ketchup. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: winter melon,bourbon,grand marnier,barbecue sauce,plum tomato,grain white rice,olive oil
title: Wild melon Steak (Plum or Mango) Salad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1 lb wild melon, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 4 plum tomatoes, halved and sliced | 1/2 cup bourbon-flavored barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 cup uncooked short-grain white rice ( preferably sushi-grade ) | 1/2 cup bourbon
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees f. Brush the wild melons with 1 teaspoons of the oil and arrange in a large, shallow roasting pan. Sprinkle them with salt. Roast in middle of the oven for 20 minutes, or until firm and lightly browned. Remove from the oven. Place the tomatoes in a baking dish and drizzle with the remaining oil. Combine the barbecue sauce, grand marnier, rice, and bourbon. Top the tomatoes with the hot melons and continue to roast in the oven, covered, for 20 minutes, or until tender and the sauce is slightly reduced. Remove and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,chicken breast,meat,lemon peel,asparagus,chinese cabbage,dark chocolate,yellow cornmeal
title: Stacked Chicken With Asparagus (Mongolian Recipes)
ingredients: 6 ounces dark chocolate, melted | 1 1/2 lbs asparagus, cut into 1/2 inch lengths | 1 1/2 lbs sweet chicken breasts, cut into 8 pieces | 1 cup thinly sliced spanish onion | 6 cups shredded iceberg lettuce or 6 cups cabbage | 1/2 lb frozen precooked peeled asparagus, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons finely chopped preserved lemons or 2 tablespoons lemon peel, finely grated | 12 1/2 ounces chicken-chili prepared meat ( from asian grocery stores ) | 2 cups coarse yellow cornmeal
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Butter a 9x9 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine 1 cup of melted chocolate, the asparagus, chicken, onion and 5 cups of cabbage. Line the bottom of the prepared baking dish with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes. Remove dish from oven. Toss with 1/4 cup melted chocolate. Spread mixture evenly in dish. Top with remaining 1/3 cup melted chocolate. Bake until chocolate firms in center, 10 - 15 minutes. Meanwhile, peel asparagus and thaw in a colander for 10 minutes, then cut into 2 1/2 inch pieces. In a bowl, stir 3 cups of shredded lettuce with remaining 1/2 cup of shredded cabbage. Cut chicken, asparagus, and preserved lemon into 9 pieces each. Arrange on lettuce mixture, then top with meat and sauce.

title: Beef Skewers (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 sirloin steaks | 1/3 cup rice wine or 1/3 cup dry sherry | 1/2 lemon, zest of | 1 tablespoon dried pea | hamburger, cubed
instructions: Cut beef steak crosswise into 1/4 inch wide pieces. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over beef in crock pot. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours, or until meat is thoroughly cooked and falling apart. Serving suggestion, serve with crusty bread. Note, you can also serve this with lettuce, tomatoes, carrots, onion, peas. Note, you can marinate ingredients in a large ziploc bag, resealable bag, or put in a plastic zipper bag and freeze for up to 6 months. As a rule of thumb, this recipe makes about 4 lbs. Servings, 2 beef chunks for 5 skewers and 8 beef chunks as per recipe.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,vital wheat gluten,cranberry juice cocktail,sesame oil
title: Sesame-Lavender Sesame-Dip
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberry juice cocktail, reserved | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 tablespoon vital wheat gluten, or more to taste
instructions: Place the cranberry juice in a bowl, and stir in the sesame oil. Set aside. Stir to combine. Scoop 1 teaspoon of the cranberry miso concentrate into a small bowl. Stir in the pine nuts. Sprinkle in the remaining miso or ginger and stir a little bit more. Cover and refrigerate until serving..

title: Frozen White Onions
ingredients: 6 small white pearl onions | 2 cups ice | 1/3 cup dry sherry
instructions: Freeze the onions. Remove the peel from the onions and cut into 1/2 inch rounds. Using a food processor, or hand held slicer, process on high for about 1 minute. Stir in the ice and sherry and process until smooth.

title: Bread Rolls
ingredients: 1 shortcrust pastry | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon horseradish | 1/4 cup pine nuts or 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 4 small cabbage, shredded | 4 -5 hot dog rolls | 1 teaspoon melted margarine or 3 tablespoons melted butter
instructions: Roll out pastry between two sheets of greaseproof paper. Cut 4 squares from a double thickness of foil. Place on a floured board and pinch the edges to seal. Place the rolls on the pastry. Combine celery seed, horseradish and nuts.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,pink grapefruit,worcestershire sauce,self raising flour,marsala wine
title: Pink Grapefruit Salad
ingredients: 1 small pink grapefruit ( about 600g ) | 1 cup self raising flour | 1 -2 tablespoon marsala wine or 1 -2 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 dash ginger juice
instructions: Cut the grapefruit in half and remove the membrane. Slice the grapefruit into thin wedges to serve with the salad along with some mint flavoured ice cubes. Combine the flour, marsala, worcestershire sauce and ginger juice in a bowl and mix well. Add the grapefruit wedges and toss to combine. Place in the fridge to chill for 30 minutes. The grapefruit is ready to serve when soft and the flour has dissolved. Serve the salad warm either with icecream or cream and/or cream.

title: Yorkshire Beet & Scallion Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces swiss brown or 8 ounces beet greens | 2 scallions, trimmed and sliced | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | pepper, as desired
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,red wine,pineapple juice,arugula,serrano chilies,anise seed,garlic salt,greek yogurt
title: Pineapple Pesto With Arugula
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon peanut oil ( or other veggie oil ) | 15 ounces pineapple juice ( fresh is best ) | 1/4 cup red wine | 3 -4 serrano chilies, seeded & chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh garlic salt ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 cup arugula, firmly packed | 1 cup greek yogurt or 1 cup other low fat greek yogurt
instructions: Pesto, combine all ingredients and mix well. Cover & chill at least 4 hours, up to over night.. Serve on a bed of arugula & top with additional yogurt.

title: Riesling Avocado Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup riesling wine | 3 tablespoons olive oil or 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated ginger | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed | 12 lettuce leaves, such as boston bibb or 12 romaine lettuce, such as bibb, lightly dressed | 1 large avocado
instructions: In a small frying pan combine the wine, oil, mace, rosemary, ginger and dill weed and boil the mixture over moderate heat until reduced to about 1/ coat the back of a metal spoon. Remove the pan from the heat and set aside. Wash, dry and cut the lettuce into 1/4 inch wide wedges. Place the lettuce in a large serving bowl. Cut the avocado into cubes and toss with half of the hot vinaigrette. Spoon the avocado cubes atop the lettuce wedges and drizzle on the remaining vinaigrette.

Random Ingredients: szechuan peppercorn,green olive,pepper,active yeast,pesto sauce,vanilla flavor pudding pie filling mix
title: Pesto & Pile
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns ( or to taste ) | 1 can crushed green olives | 1 package frozen pounder-style pizza dough or ( 8 ounce ) package vegetarian-flavor instant vanilla flavor pudding and pie filling mix | 2 -3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix yeast, peppercorns, olives and pizza mix in a large bowl. When yeast foam begins to appear on surface add pizza mix. Using your hands mix in pesto, pepper and remaining ingredients until thoroughly blended. Transfer dough to greased 13 x 9 pan and cover with foil. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes or until dough is golden on top. Allow to cool at least 20 minutes before cutting. Allow dough to refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,head garlic,onion,lemon juice zest
title: Delicious Low Carmelized Cheddar Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces extra thick cheddar cheese, shredded ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 3 tablespoons minced fresh onions | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest, plus 2 teaspoons | fresh garlic, minced ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together cheese, onion, lemon zest, and garlic. Add more lemon zest, if desired.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,nutritional yeast,pea,butterscotch chip,lemon peel,cumin,white onion
title: The Best Vegan Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 white onion | 1 bag frozen peas | 1 box butterscotch chips | 1/2 cup rinsed and drained pea liquid ( a little over 1/2 of a bag, i just've tried it ) | 4 tablespoons nutritional yeast ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons of extra virgin white wine ( i have never tried this, but if you're going to ) ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a food processor or blender, add onion and pulse until a fine onion is grated, then add frozen peas, pea liquid, nutritional yeast, 1 tbs butter, white wine and cumin. Mix all ingredients well. Place in a medium sized casserole dish and bake at 350°f for 35 - 45 minutes, till bubbly. Add more butter, 1/2 tsp butter, nutmeg, any optional ingredients such as chives or cilantro as desired. Serve warm.

title: Pasta and Romaine
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta, cooked al dente | 3 heads romaine lettuce
instructions: Saute celery, romaine and pepper flakes until lightly caramelized. Turn off heat and add cooked penne. Top with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

title: Strawberry and Rosemary Jam
ingredients: 1 package frozen strawberries, thawed and well drained | 1 jar dried rosemary, stems removed or 1/4 bunch fresh rosemary
instructions: Place the thawed strawberries in a saucepan over low heat. Stir in the rosemary. Increase the heat to medium and cook, stirring often, until the mixture boils and thickens slightly, about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and let cool for 5 minutes. Stir in the cooled jam until well coated. Cover and store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,salt cod fish,wheat flour,beef consomme,coconut oil
title: Beef Tenderloin in Coconut-Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, fat cut off | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 can beef consomme | 1 can shredded coconut oil | salt and cod fish, cut into 2-inch cubes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°. Rinse the meat under cold water, and pat dry with paper towels. In a roasting pan, arrange the meat in a single layer with a tight fitting lid. Combine the flour and consommé mix in the can of beef consomme. Add the meat to the pan and turn over to coat with the flour and consommé mix. Pour the consommé mix over the meat and return the lid. Bake the meat for 2 hours. After removing the lid, stir every 10 minutes, and check the broth thickness. If it is necessary, add a little more water. If the mixture is too thick, add a little more water. Cover and continue cooking until meat thermometer reaches 160°. Add salt and cod fish during the last 15 minutes of cooking.

title: Indian Bread Salad With Cauliflower #2
ingredients: 4 cups french bread, cut into thick slices | 1 small cauliflower | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 2 -3 tablespoons sliced radishes
instructions: Place one piece of bread on the back of a clean cutting board and place in the oven for 5 minutes at 150°f place cauliflower on the baking sheet. Slice the head into thin half moons and place on top of cauliflower. Sprinkle coconut over cauliflower. Drizzle with olive oil and scatter radishes over cauliflower. Continue baking for 5 more minutes with the oven closed. Remove from the oven and allow to cool to room temperature. Slice before serving, if storing for up to two weeks.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,maraschino cherry,ice water,picante sauce,walnut oil,organic baby spinach,lobster meat,lettuce leaf
title: Burritos for Two!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 cup organic baby spinach | 1 cup cooked lobsters, sliced | shredded lettuce | 1 cup fresh picante sauce ( jarred ) | 1 cup ice water | 1/4 cup frozen picante sauce ( jarred ) | garlic-infused maraschino cherries | ice, for dipping ( optional )
instructions: To make the burritos, in a large skillet, heat the walnut oil over medium high heat. Saute the spinach on the oil until heated all the way through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat, and set aside to cool for a moment. Add the lobsters to the spinach, and toss to coat with the walnut oil. Heat for about 1 minute, and then add the cheese. To serve, place the greens on a plate and lay the lobster on top. Top with a sprinkling of picante and chopped lettuce. You can make the burritos in one or two smaller, smaller containers, or place them with a serving dish as your burrito maker. To make the burritos, place the ice water and picante sauce in a saucepan with a lid or invert on the plate and cook for 2 minutes to warm through. Transfer the ice water to the plate and add 2 ice cubes and a handful of mint. Remove from the heat, place one burrito on top of a plate, and drizzle each with 1 tablespoon maraschino and two tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil.

title: Guinness Sizzlin
ingredients: 2 cups guiness guinness stout | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 3 (.25 ounce ) packages dry yeast | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 3 tablespoons finely chopped green coriander | 1 teaspoon dry seaweeds | 1 package crispy rice noodles, broken into 6 sections
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl of an electric mixer, place guinness, olive oil, yeast, cumin, green coriander and seaweed. Cover and allow to stand for 15 minutes, or until thick and bubbly. Meanwhile, add rice noodles to a large pot of boiling water, and cook until just beginning to soften. Drain. Remove from heat. Scoop out the hot mixture into bowl, and add the hot noodles to the bowl. Toss to mix, and allow to cool to room temperature. Transfer chilled mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, about 3 hours. Cut into 4 equal pieces for a total of 6 to 8 pieces.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,celery rib,chicken thigh,basmati rice,cilantro,white sugar
title: Portobello Chicken with Basmati Rice
ingredients: 1 jar diced mushrooms | 12 slices chicken thighs | 1 large portabella mushroom, coarsely chopped | 3 celery ribs, chopped | 2 cups basmati rice | 1/4 cup white sugar | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Combine mushroom and chicken in a large mixing bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 15 to 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place rice in a bowl, season with sugar and cilantro, if using.

title: Belgian Endive & Cheese Rounds
ingredients: 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese, very finely shredded | 2 heads belgian endive, very finely shredded | 2 -4 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Set the oven to 325 degrees. Generously butter a round baking dish or rimmed baking sheet. On a large cutting board, arrange half of the shredded cheese. With a wide spatula, tear the leaves of endive in half and, using the back of a spoon, scoop out most of the inner leaves of the greens with a teaspoon. Repeat this technique with the remaining cheese, sprinkling them over the bottom of the pan, discarding the last tablespoon of shredded cheese. Working over the edge of the pan with your hands, sprinkle the sesame seeds evenly over the top of the cheese. Using your hands or a sharp knife, break the cheese with the edge of a spatula, making sure to break it as finely as possible. Continue until all of the cheese has been broken into large chunks. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. With a sharp, wet knife, cut the cheese into 6 or 8 large squares. Place the squares in the prepared baking dish and bake, uncovered, at 325 degrees for 25 min to 30 minute.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,gruyere cheese,carb flour tortilla,citron,tart apple,spaghetti
title: French Apple Chimichanga Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package fat-free instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 tart apple ( peeled, cored & sliced ) | 1 package fat free cheese-flavored spaghetti | 1 package fat-free temprano fat free cheese ( shredded ) | 2 bags fat free quark low-carb flour tortillas | 1 3/4 cups shredded gruyere cheese, divided ( or 1 1/2 c fontina, 2 tbsp )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees, spray 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Mix pudding mix and cheese thoroughly. In separate bowl, mix spaghetti & apples & divide evenly between two tortillas. Spray a 13x9 baking dish w/nonstick cooking spray or drizzle with any nonstick cooking spray. Dot 1/3 of the puddings over the tortillas & place in dish & sprinkle w/cheese, reserving remaining puddings. Sprinkle ¾ tsp of cheese over the puddings, then top with remaining tortillas, then remaining puddings & cheese. Bake for 25 minutes or until cheese is melted & heated through. Let rest for 5 minutes & cut into 8 slices.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,thyme sprig,onion soup mix,rye flour,black bean,honey,white breadcrumb,pancetta
title: Fried Black Beans II
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup pancetta, finely diced | 1 medium onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon honey ( extra virgin ) | 4 tablespoons rye flour | 1/4 cup dry white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Heat oil in large pan, add pancetta and onion, cook until pancetta is tender and onion is golden. Add thyme and toast. Add drained black beans and corn oil. Add more oil if mixture is too dry, but not soupy. Stir till hot. Lower heat and simmer for an hour or until thickened. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,kernel corn,cream mushroom soup,green chili,mint,tart apple
title: Apple Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 6 medium bell peppers, tops and seeds removed | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 10 ounces sour cream ( about 1 cup ) | 2 teaspoons of chopped of fresh mint | 1 cup whole kernel corn | 1 can chopped green chili ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven at 350°f. Slice tops off of peppers with a very sharp knife or a serrated knife. Place peppers upright in a 9x13 baking pan. In bowl of an electric mixer, blend soup, sour cream, mint, corn, green chilies and salt. Pour mixture over peppers. Bake covered for about 45 minutes until peppers are tender. Uncover, bake 5 minutes longer until peppers are warmed through. Serve warm.

title: Gadogeres (Senegalese) - Stuffed Baby Octopus
ingredients: 8 baby octopus | 2 stalks green onions, chopped thinly | 3/4 cup grated banana | 2 cups cornmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove heads, eyes and main fins from octopus. Cut tentacles from body. Rinse with cold water. Slit stalks off with a sharp knife. Stuff in cleaned octopus. Reserve tentacles for stew. Add green onion and banana. Mix cornmeal and a glass or metal bowl with a small amount of water, until mixture becomes creamy and homogeneous. Add the reserved octopus tentacles. Toss gently to coat. Place in a shallow dish or large baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: japanese eggplant,chili oil,self raising flour,cream celery soup,mustard seed,garam masala
title: Betha's Thai Style Fried Eggplant (Aubergine) Rollups
ingredients: 1 japanese eggplants, sliced into long strips or 1 large eggplant | 1 cup self raising flour | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 packages cream of celery soup | 1/2 tablespoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons chili oil
instructions: Put the oil in a frying pan. First start mixing the flour in with 2 teaspoons of the mustard seeds and then add the garlic. Cook the mixture until it becomes a pale batter. Now put the eggplant in the pan. Pour the prepared mustard mixture into the pan and let it spread evenly. Let it get to room temperature/medium temperature. Now place the eggplant slices face down on a greased pan. Bake for 10 minutes or until they are crisp on the outside and the interior is brown. Turn the slices over, put the pan back on the element and cook for about 10 more minutes or until they are crisp on both sides.

title: Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 8 cups hot broth | 2 slices rye bread | 2 tablespoons egg substitute | 2 cups cooked baby shrimp
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine egg substitute with the broth. Add shrimp and bread and heat for 5 min. Serve.

Random Ingredients: hot paprika,wasabi paste,golden raisin,ginger garlic paste
title: Wasabi Powder Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup wasabi paste | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste ( optional )
instructions: In small bowl, stir together wasabi paste, sweet paprika, garlic paste and ground ginger garlic paste until well blended. Store in airtight jars.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,maraschino cherry,chinese five spice powder,active yeast,star anise,cornmeal
title: Spicy Five-Spice Bread
ingredients: 3 cups cornmeal | 1 package active dry yeast | 2 cups chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes | 2/3 cup star anise | 1 cup maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Scald the cornmeal in a large saucepan of boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain and cool to room temperature. Combine in a large bowl 1 cup cold water, or enough to soften flour, yeast, 5 spice powder, red pepper flakes and star anise in a mixing bowl. Stir to combine. Gradually stir in remaining cup cold water. The dough will be shaggy and sticky. Turn out onto a floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes. Place in a large ball. Cover with a cotton or linen towel, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour. Punch it down, knead it briefly, then divide into 24 pieces. Form each piece into a ball. Place on a well oiled baking sheet, cover with a cotton towel, and let rise in a warm spot for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Sprinkle the tops with maraschino cherries. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until golden. Cool on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,lemon lime beverage,bamboo shoot,rice flour,italian parsley
title: Mock Hoisin Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 package beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks | 1 teaspoon rice flour | 1 bottle frozen cut bamboo shoots, thawed | 1 jar lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage | 3 tablespoons chopped italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, mix chuck, rice flour, bamboo shoots, lemon lime flavored carbonated beverage, and parsley. Bake meat for 30 minutes, or until done.

title: Tater Tot Tikka
ingredients: 350 g tater tots | 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander leaves
instructions: Place the tots in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover and set aside for 10 minutes. Drain. Place the hot pepper sauce, ginger and coriander leaves in a bowl. Add the tater tots. Place under the grill. Cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until the tots are browned, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: green onion,chili pepper flake,yoghurt,cinnamon,ruby port,heavy whipping cream,red chilies
title: Thai Red Chile Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups yoghurt | 6 red chilies | 5 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 bunch green onion | 4 cups ruby port, chilled ( i prefer ruby ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Drain the juice out of the chilies and discard seeds, stems, and pods. Mix all of the above with yoghurt in a small bowl and transfer to a food processor. Blend until smooth. Transfer to a heat and stir in the green onion and port. Add the spices and chillis. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes and taste. Cooks note, i have had to use 1/4 cup sweet red wine, or 1/2 cup white wine. The flavor is not as pronounced as the wine, so you might want to add red pepper to taste.

title: Cuban Carne Adovada
ingredients: 2 lbs carnavata meat, or small cubes ( with or without cubed meat ) | 1 ounce kosher salt | 1 medium celery root, peeled & quartered ( about 1 1/2 lbs ) | 1 jar picante sauce ( not sweetened salsa ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Using your hands, rub the papery root with salt then rub the salt onto the meat. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, drain the meat, wipe the papery root, and cut into cubes.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,cocoa,vegetable,pumpkin seed,rack lamb,green food coloring,bourbon
title: Bourbon Lamb Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck or 1 lb ground lamb | 2 1/2 cups plain flour | 1/4 cup cocoa | 6 ounces mixed vegetables ( such as baby broccoli cuts, pumpkin seeds, peas and courgettes ) | green food coloring | 1/2 cup bourbon | 1 1/2 lbs racks of lamb
instructions: For the base, place a rack in the freezer for about 15 minutes to harden the surface of the meat. Remove the tray from the freezer and place the meat, the flour, cocoa, mixed vegetables, food colouring and bourbon into a food processor and whiz to a medium paste. Press evenly onto the chilled rack.. Cover the base of a tray with aluminium foil leaving approximately 1cm thick all around. Line the tray with foil and bake in a moderate oven for 1 hour. Unwrap the lamb onto a serving plate, cut into chunks and serve the meat chunks alongside the base base of the horseradish cream. For the horseradish cream, place the horseradish cream and the bourbon in a pan and heat through. Remove from the heat and whip the cream until the amount of honey is required. Place in a large bowl and set aside to cool completely. For assembly, bring the tray inside to the table over a bbq / charcoals / gas burner. Place the lamb pieces in a tray and then cover each piece with the horseradish cream. Place under the grill until cooked through and golden. Serve with horseradish cream.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,cilantro stem,kosher salt,turmeric powder,mango powder,salt
title: Mango Chutney - You'll Make Sassy Chutney
ingredients: 3 small fennel bulbs, about 1 1/2 pounds or 12 medium fennel leaves | kosher salt, to taste | 1/8 teaspoon dried mango powder ( i don't use, but it's really a powder that's worth it ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric powder ( i keep a small, small package of mango chutney in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks, so just keep in mind ) | 1/4 cilantro stem, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Trim and section the fennel bulbs carefully so they don't split open. Slice them into 2 1/2 inch pieces and place them into a colander, sprinkle with a generous pinch of salt and toss to coat. Add the remaining ingredients. Dump the chutney into a large, deep, nonreactive bowl and press firmly, trying not to squeeze out any air.

title: French Lovers Beef and Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 can baked beans | 6 cups beef stock or 6 cups broth | 10 1/2 ounces frozen french-style loaves italian bread or 7/8 ounce italian bread | 1 container sour cream | 1/3 cup chopped cilantro | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large skillet. Add garlic and cook for 2 or 3 minutes. Add soup can and simmer for 15 minutes or until soup is thick and soup is hot. Cut french loaf into serving wedges. Serve soup on a plate, topped with beef mixture, sour cream, cilantro, cayenne and chopped cilantro.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,pepper sauce,egg white,coriander seed,pimento pepper,queso fresco
title: Alfredo Style Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 1 cup corn tortillas | 3 teaspoons coriander seeds | 2 teaspoons pimento peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 cup grated queso fresco | 8 large eggs | 3/4 cup hot pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Mix coriander seeds with pimenton and set aside. Place 2 teaspoons vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat, and cook 1 tortilla, stirring constantly, until golden brown. Remove from pan and drain on paper towels. Spread coriander in the pan, and place it over medium low heat. Cook for about 1 minute. Remove from heat. In a medium bowl, beat eggs until well blended. Stir in hot pepper sauce and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Fold in half of the tortilla mixture, then stir in half of the feta and pepper sauce. Continue to fold and stir until all remaining ingredients are combined. Scramble eggs in a large, non stick skillet or wok for 1 to 2 minutes until they begin to set. Stir in remaining tortilla mixture, and continue to cook for about 2 minutes to heat through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,orange zest,okra,cherry,basmati rice,head cabbage,vegetable protein
title: Quick Vegetable Kugel
ingredients: 1 packet okra | 1 head cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup frozen mixed vegetables protein | 1/2 cup frozen mixed cherries, thawed ( optional ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 teaspoon orange zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut okra in half lengthwise. Set aside. Place the cabbage in a large casserole dish. Toss in okra and rice. Sprinkle on mixed vegetables and citrus concentrantly with zest and lemon extract. Bake at 400 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring halfway through. Sprinkle with additional zest and lemon extract.

title: Curried Leaf Thyme
ingredients: 1 teaspoon curry | 1 cup firmly packed fresh leaf thyme | 1 1/4 cups oil | 1 cup lemon juice
instructions: Mix curry with thyme and set aside. Combine oil and lemon juice until frothy. Pour over leaves and stir to coat evenly. Let stand 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,oil,lime wedge,lemon zest,asparagus spear,espresso coffee
title: Green Asparagus
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 3 lbs fresh asparagus spears, trimmed | 2 teaspoons instant espresso coffee | 1 lime wedge | 1 strip lemon zest | salt pork or other lean beef | salt
instructions: Heat an ovenproof skillet over high heat for one minute. Add oil.

title: Easy Tortillas
ingredients: 1 large tortilla | 1 ounce frozen pepperoni, chopped | 3 drops chili-garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Place a tortilla on a plate. Heat chili garlic sauce or other oriental condiment. When tortilla is softened, spread over a thin layer of the tortilla. Top tortilla with pepperoni, then top with remaining tortilla. Spread cornstarch over top of tortilla and serve. You can also spread extra sauce over top, to taste.

title: Chinese Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage, cored and shredded | 1 head chinese cabbage - cored, shredded and sliced | 1/2 pound bacon | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 pint blackberries, or to taste
instructions: Place the napa cabbage, chinese cabbage, and chinese cabbage into a large salad bowl. Cook and stir bacon in a skillet over medium heat until fat is rendered and bacon is heated through and bacon is crisp, about 10 minutes. Drain and crumble bacon, reserving fat in the skillet. Pour half and half into the skillet.

title: Curried Dates
ingredients: 2 cups dates, pitted and sliced | 1 teaspoon prepared curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large microwave safe bowl on high power for 1 minute, or until sugar has melted, stirring well. Microwave on high for 1 more minute. Stir, and leave to stand for five minutes before serving.

title: Hot Beef Gravy II
ingredients: 1 package roast beef gravy | 3/4 cup hot water | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Mix 1st eight ingredients together, pour over gravy, and simmer 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve over brown rice, and enjoy.

title: Beef on Spinach With Cheddar
ingredients: 1/4 ounce active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups warm 100 % cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons fat-free swanson beef fat | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced spinach
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Set aside in a large bowl and allow to set 10 minutes or until foamy. Stir in cheese, fat free swanson, and spinach. Beat by hand until smooth, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a greased 2 1/2 x 1 inch loaf pan, and let rise about 1 hour. Bake at 375°f until golden brown and bubbly, about 55 minutes.

title: Canned Salsa Mexicana
ingredients: 2 cups dry white wine vinegar | 1 3/4 cups chopped dried mulato or 2/3 cups dried pasilla chiles | 20 pints plum ( i used red floral plums ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mace, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: For the jar, combine all ingredients in a large pot or saucepan over medium heat and boil, uncovered, for 1 minute. Strain through a fine mesh sieve. Chill completely before using.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,pesto sauce,risotto rice,meat,marinara pasta sauce,hot sauce,sesame seed
title: Rice Balls and Meat - Arrabiata
ingredients: 1 lb chopped meat | 8 ounces risotto rice | 3 ounces pesto sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds | red hot sauce | 1 3/4 cups marinara pasta sauce | cooked rice, to taste
instructions: Brown meat with pesto salt and pepper, drain if needed. Add rice and mix lightly. Add hot sauce add meat and mix lightly. Cover with hot pan and leave to simmer until rice reaches your desired amount. Meanwhile, cook meat on med high in saucepan until meat is cooked through. Taste rice and add balance of pesto, salt, pepper or other favorite seasonings you wish to add. When meat is cooked, drain most of the excess grease. Roll risotto mixture in rice and eat with hot rice.

title: Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden raisin, soaked in water for 30 minutes, drained | 3 shallots, peeled and halved | 10 chili peppers, stemmed and seeded | 3 ounces prosciutto | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded | 2 teaspoons grand marnier, for basting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Combine raisins, shallots and chile peppers in a baking dish. Bake the sandwiches for 15 - 20 minutes, until heated through and fragrant. Remove from heat and top with prosciutto.

Random Ingredients: ouzo,fennel seed,bay seasoning,coriander seed,cream tartar,jasmine rice,chicken leg,anise seed
title: Ouzo-Flavored Chicken With Rice and Coriander (Jiaozi Bari)
