ingredients: 6 chicken legs | 2 tablespoons anise seed | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon crushed bay seasoning | 1 teaspoon ouzo | 2 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a small frying pan, toast the aniseed, coriander and fennel seeds on medium low heat for 10 minutes, or until aromatic. In a small saucepan, heat a small amount of oil over medium high heat, and fry the aniseed mixture, stirring continuously, for 45 seconds, or until aromatic. Set aside and cool. Coat chicken with orange zest, then with anise mixture. Place in a 9x3 inch square baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, or until chicken is cooked. Remove from oven, cool and refrigerate covered for two hours or overnight. When ready to serve, heat ouzo and cream of tartar in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil.

title: Polenta Bread
ingredients: 8 ounces self rising flour | 1 white onion, finely chopped | 1 lb medium uncooked polenta pasta
instructions: Mix the flour and onion in a bowl. Cut the polenta in to 2 inch cubes. Place the polenta cubes in a large pot of rapidly boiling, salted water. Simmer until the polenta is soft.

title: Cocoa Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 3 cups snow peas | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/3 cup white vinegar
instructions: Cook snow peas with half the cocoa powder and half the vinegar until they are tender. Drain and cool. Toss with remaining cocoa and vinegar.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,chili flake,vinegar,mace,cream chicken soup,bean,garlic clove,couscous
title: Apple Bean Couscous
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chili flakes | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 12 ounces cream of chicken soup, low fat | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 2 teaspoons tbsps olive oil or 2 teaspoons salad oil | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 4 cups cooked beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Combine first six ingredients. Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a non stick frystick frypan. Stir fry garlic, for 1 minute or until golden. Stir in curry mixture, reheat gently, stirring often. Pour curry mixture over beans and sprinkle with cinnamon. Cool.

title: Apricot Kebabs
ingredients: 12 ounces canned apricots, drained | 4 bamboo skewers, soaked 20 minutes in water | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Soak apricots over low heat about 20 minutes to soften. Cut apricots in half and remove seeds. Arrange on skewers alternating with apricot halves and balsamic vinegar. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,purpose white flour,blueberry,romaine lettuce,green olive,french,bean sprout,sea bass fillet
title: Chunky Low Fat Whitefish, Two Ways Casserole
ingredients: 6 large cooked white fish fillets, cut into serving pieces | 1 1/2 cups mixed all-purpose white flour | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup drained black-eyed peas ( canned or canned ) | 1/4 cup drained green olives ( pitted ) | 1/2 cup drained crumbly french's | 1 1/2 cups drained romaine lettuce | 12 cups mixed greens and bean sprouts
instructions: In a large shallow baking dish or roasting pan, arrange the fish pieces, coating the fish evenly. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and 1 cup black eyed peas. Add the remaining 1 cup black eyed peas, olives, and 1/2 cup green lettuce and toss to distribute evenly. Spread the mixture on top of the fish and sprinkle with the crumbly french's. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator for several hours. Remove the fish from the refrigerator in the morning and bake uncovered for 20 minutes at 450 degrees f.

title: Mushroom Sun Dried Tomato Onions
ingredients: 2 large sweet onions, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, thinly sliced ( not oil packed ) | 2 teaspoons meyer's miracle whip light | 1 teaspoon onion flakes
instructions: Saute onions in sun dried tomato oil. When dark brown, transfer onions to platter. While onions are sizzling, add the rest of the ingredients and stir until blended. Spoon over the onions.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,pesto sauce,mustard powder,rice wine,granny smith apple,rosemary
title: Pesto Apple N' Glazed Granny Smith Apples
ingredients: 1/2 cup pesto sauce, prepared | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 pinch rosemary, crushed | 2 granny smith apples | 1 teaspoon cornflour, mixed with a little cold water
instructions: Peel apples and slice on the diagonal. Arrange apples in a tray and drizzle with dressing. Sprinkle over mustard, rosemary and pepper. Roast in a moderate oven for about 45 minutes, stirring every 20 minutes. Sprinkle with cornflour mixture. Roast 10 minutes more.

title: Asian Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili paste | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 2 fresh basil leaves, or more to taste
instructions: Mix chili paste, sour cream, and basil together in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: white bread,broccoli,salt black pepper,pork sausage,basil pesto
title: Pesto Stuffing
ingredients: 1 can broccoli, drained and chopped into small pieces | 1 package dry white bread | 1 lb pork sausage | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | salt and black pepper
instructions: Cut the white bread into chunks. Remove the crusts from the bread and put in a food processor. Add pork sausage. Process for 1 minute and add pesto. Process for 2 minutes. Add salt and pepper and process for 1 more minute. Add parsley or basil.

Random Ingredients: epazote,nori,graham cracker crumb,red kidney bean,black mustard seed,yellow onion
title: Ranchese Beans
ingredients: 1 pound dried red kidney beans | 1/2 pound fresh graham cracker crumbs | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon grated nori | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped epazote | 1 teaspoon black mustard seed
instructions: Combine the beans and 3 quarts water in a large pot, and stir in the graham cracker crumbs, yellow onion, nori, epazote, and mustard seed. Bring to a boil, then turn the heat low, cover, and simmer until tender and the flavors have blended, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,black mustard seed,chicken part,sea salt,guacamole
title: Guacamole and Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef sirloin, trimmed of most fat and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup raw converted gound house spices ( see note ) or 1/2 cup regular ground grain mustard ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons sea salt ( or kosher salt ) | 2 tablespoons black mustard seeds, lightly crushed, lightly toasted | 1 bottle guacamole, in a can
instructions: Thread beef onto skewers, 1 slice each piece of beef and 2 mustard seeds on each skewer. Grill meat skewers and kebabs over hot coals, covered, 3 to 4 minutes per side, or until desired doneness. Let stand 3 minutes, then cut into thin slices. Serve immediately with guacamole and/or salsa on the side for dipping.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,thyme sprig,green cabbage,pear,french bread,oat
title: Breadcrumb Pear Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mixed peaches ( see note above ) | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | fresh thyme sprig, plus | thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 cups finely shredded green cabbage | 1 loaf french bread, thinly sliced and cut into 1 x 1/2-inch sticks
instructions: Peel the peets and chop coarsely. Thoroughly combine with soy sauce and thyme. Toss with cabbage and bread.

title: Tropical Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli floret | 2 bags frozen mixed salad spinach | 1 package frozen chopped broccoli florets | 2 cups chopped bacon | 1/2 cup chopped candied ginger | 1 cup prepared whipped topping ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add broccoli florets and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until crisp tender but still firm. Drain. Remove and plunge into ice water to stop the cooking process. Drain. In a large bowl, mix together the salad ingredients except the whipped topping. Pour the dressing over the salad and mix well. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Frijoles Borracho (Frijoles Borracho)
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 8 ounces sour cream with celery soup | 8 ounces shell pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix together the soup and refried beans. Add salt and pepper to taste and stir in the pasta. Serve with tortilla chips or fresh cilantro, if desired.

title: French Country Mussels
ingredients: 4 1/4 lbs mussels, large | 2 1/4 cups corn oil, divided | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Scrub and discard the beards from the mussels. Bring 3 cups water to a boil in a large pot. Add the muscles, cover tightly, and steam the shells for 20 minutes. Stir in 1 cup oil, then add the yeast and remaining oil. Cover and cook for 5 minutes, or until the mussels are open. Transfer the mussels to a lightly oiled colander with a slotted spoon or strainer placed over a bowl. Discard any unopened mussels. Place the pan of mussels in the preheated oven and bake, uncovered, until the shells have begun to open, about 15 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pepper,maraschino cherry,curry leaf,extra virgin olive oil
title: Tropical Curry Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 cups extra virgin olive oil | 4 curry leaves | 1/4 cup cracked pepper | 1/2 cup chopped maraschino cherry
instructions: Place olive oil, curry leaves and cracked pepper in 2 pint jar. Close lid and shake vigorously until well combined. Add maraschino cherries and stir vigorously with back of spoon until mixed inches.

title: Japanese Vegetables With Barley
ingredients: 1 cup barley or 1 cup bulgur | 1 japanese eggplant | 1 medium carrot | 1 cup canned pineapple tidbits ( drained ) or 1 cup canned pineapple tidbits ( drained ) | 1 lb okra
instructions: Place all ingredients in the bottom of a pan or in a casserole type oven dish. Bake, covered, at 350f degrees for 1 hour. Stir to check vegetables for doneness.

title: Mushroom Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 cup rice ( about 3 cups worth ) | 2 cups diced white mushrooms ( about 3 cups worth ) | 1/2 teaspoon bacon grease | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry
instructions: If using a rice cooker, soak rice in enough warm water to cover in a bowl for about 20 min, or until tender. Drain well. Meanwhile, steam or microwave mushrooms on a covered, ungreased skillet with tight lid. When tender, remove lid and continue cooking, stirring now and then, until water has evaporated and mushrooms are well cooked. Remove skillet from heat and stir in bacon grease or olive oil. Add rice, then stir in mushrooms and cherries. Let rest 15 minutes or until water has mostly absorbed, and rice has absorbed all the water. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,worcestershire sauce,shell pasta,self rising flour,nutmeg,dijon mustard,fenugreek seed
title: Cabbage and Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups dry shell pasta ( short or medium ) | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon ground fenugreek seeds | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 -2 cup thinly sliced cabbage | 1/4 cup small shell pasta ( small )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water for 5 minutes. Place cooked pasta in large bowl and mash with potato masher. Add remaining ingredients plus 1 tbsp cooking oil. Mix well. Add cabbage, coating well with dressing. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white bread,watercress,vegetable bouillon granule,orange zest,celery seed,cake flour,heavy cream,pasta
title: Fruit-Filled Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb dry pasta ( any shape will do ) | vegetable bouillon granules | 2 cups boiling water | 12 ounces fresh bread | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon heavy cream | 1 bunch fresh basil ( to taste ) or 1 bunch of fresh mint ( to taste )
instructions: Wash, then cook the pasta until al dente. Drain and place back in the cooking sauce along with the bouillon granules and boiling water. While this is cooking, dice the bread. Pour the pasta cooking water into a bowl. Mix together the bread flour, celery seeds, orange zest, and cream. Set aside. Add these to the pasta sauce. Drain and add the fresh basil or mint. Serve hot.

title: Chicken With Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: 5 chicken pieces | 1 package frozen strawberries
instructions: Place chicken in a 9x13 baking pan. Combine remaining ingredients in a blender. Mix well and pour the liquid over the chicken. Cover and bake at 350°f for 45 minutes. Serve with your favorite vegetables.

title: Beef and Beans Wrap
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 tablespoon oil | 4 cups cooked bok choy, chopped | 3 poblano chiles, minced | 1 cup roasted pinto beans ( or pinto beans of your choice ) | 1/2 cup prepared corned beef and beans ( or pinto beans of your choice )
instructions: Grill the beef tenderloin for about 10 - 15 minutes until done, rare. Let it rest about 10 minutes. Slice it rare and set aside. Wipe out the grill and preheat your grates. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the bokchoy and poblano chile. Saute for about 2 minutes and then stir in the beef, beans and corned beef. Taste to adjust seasonings, if necessary. Serve hot and let guests add more salt as needed.

title: Pork Chops Filled W-Caramelized Watermelon & Sweet Brown Onion!
ingredients: 1 pork chop, fat trimmed | 1 large green pepper, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1 small brown onion, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1/4 cup watermelon, diced as small as possable | 2 tablespoons brown onions, minced | 1/4 cup watermelon, diced as small as possable | 1/4 cup sweet brown onion | 3 1/2 tablespoons watermelon, diced as small as possable
instructions: To make caramelized watermelon place 1/4 cup of watermelon juice and 1/4 cup sugar in a small heavy saucepan. Heat on low until sugar melts. Raise heat and boil until watermelon melts. Remove from heat and blend in 1/4 cup of watermelon juice. Place pork chops in a large frying pan and sear both sides on both sides until browned. Remove from frying pan and place on greased rack in a bowl. Boil remaining 1/4 cup water in a large pot, then pour over pork chops. Toss to coat. Heat caramelized watermelon and sweet brown onions in a microwave for 3 minutes. Dissolve remaining 1/4 cup in 1/4 cup of water and pour over pork chops. Toss until well coated. Pour caramelized watermelon mixture on top of pork chops and bake in oven at 350f for 35 - 40 minutes, stirring from time to time. Remove pork chops and slice thin.

title: Grpa's Sweet Spiced French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Cut a loaf in half and rub together the rub and grpa's bread. Wrap with plastic wrap and place into the oven. Do not turn off the oven yet. Let sit for 7 - 10 minutes until the bread has risen slightly and has become golden brown. Remove from the oven and serve.

title: Methi Onion Gravy or Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 large onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1/2 tablespoon oregano leaves ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs (, i use sage, rosemary, chives )
instructions: Sauteé chopped onions in ghee until soft. Add oregano and herbs to onions and stir in. Simmer, over low heat, until mixture is hot and thickened slightly.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,banana,bread,bicarbonate soda,tomato green chilies,filet beef
title: Maggie's Beef Burger
ingredients: 500 g filet of beef | 16 ounces diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 3 slices bread | 1 banana, sliced
instructions: Cut a slit in the side of your burger, so that you can pull off any excess fat. I use a little knife as a handle. I use a 4 cm wide by 1 cm long piece of meat, but whatever is available is fine too. Cut the burger in half, and make sure it is quite flat. Slice the burger into thin fingers/truffles. This is a very tasty burger, the taste should have neither been there before. Add the burger into a large bowl on top of a little grated cheese and mix. Put the slice of bread on your work plate, and spread the burger on the toasted slice. Then, place a slice of tomato, followed by the green chillies, then a slice of burger. Put all of your burger into that too, and top off with another slice of tomato. Put the burger back into the bowl somewhere, so it can rest a little before you eat. You can also press a slice of banana onto the burger, to make it stick. If you prefer, you can dip the burger into the vinegar before it is served to prevent it sticking to anything.

title: Mediterranean Steak Wrap
ingredients: 1 lb steak, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb firm tofu | 1/2 lb cooked cod | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt
instructions: Lay spinach leaves on baking sheets. Place fish, tofu and cod on each spinach leaf. Roll up and cover with plastic wrap. Chill for 1 hour. Turn over. Cut each wrap into 8 pieces. Enjoy serves.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,gruyere cheese,chili flake,spaghetti,fish sauce,red leaf lettuce,oatmeal
title: Oatcakes With Gruyère Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 600 g lamb shanks | 1/2 cup oatmeal, fine grind ( or fine grind plain toasted oatmeal ) | 2 teaspoons chili flakes, red | 8 -10 large red leaf lettuce | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 100 g gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees celsius. Cut slits into the lamb shanks and insert 1/4 tsp chilli flakes into each. Mix the rolled oats with half a cup boiling water and leave to soak for 30 minutes or till soft. Place the lamb shanks into an oven proof dish. Spread the oatm using the back of a spoon, over the lamb shanks. Scatter all over with half a cup boiling water. Roast in oven for 30 minutes, turning from time to time and basting with the pan juices every 10 minutes or so, for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven when cooked to your liking. To serve, drain all but a few tablespoons of the fat from the pan and reduce heat to low. Place red leaf lettuces on top of the lamb shank and sprinkle with fish sauce. Return shank to oven and roast till golden brown on top and base of lettuce is crisp and the lettuce is crisp tender crisp. Serve with rice and remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,vanilla bean,cornmeal,egg yolk,chuck roast
title: Savory Beef on Toast
ingredients: 1 chuck roast, cooked | 20 eggs | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1 dash pure vanilla bean | 4 dashes cornmeal
instructions: Combine eggs, spices, and flavorings. Dip beef in egg mixture and lightly coat both sides. Heat skillet on medium high heat, add meat & cover with tinfoil. Place in preheated 375 degree oven for 30 minutes, flip and cook another 30 minutes. Serve with rice or bread.

Random Ingredients: cashew,apple cider vinegar,red wine,brown mustard,baking soda
title: Toffee Muffins Also Served for Dried Pig Wings
ingredients: 2 cups crushed cashews | 1 1/2 cups apple cider vinegar | 3 cups red wine | 2 1/2 cups brown mustard | 1/4 cup baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix cashews, vinegar, red wine, and mustard. Make sure cashews are mixed well with mustard. Place half of the mixture in muffin cups. Top with remaining sausage mixture. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown. Allow to cool for 5 minutes before removing toothpicks enjoy.

Random Ingredients: italian,salad oil,worcestershire sauce,self rising flour,tart apple,cocoa powder,cooking oil,lemon essence
title: Apple Salad
ingredients: 3 medium tart apples | 1/3 cup self rising flour | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons lemon essence | 1/3 cup salad oil
instructions: Cut each apple in half lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Set aside. Combine flour, oil, cocoa powder, salt and worcestershire sauce in a small bowl and mix. Dry apples on paper towel and cut each slice into 1/8 inch strips. Dip apple in flour mixture and arrange on lined serving tray. Make a well in flour mixture and pour in salad oil. Mix well. Put aside. Prepare lemon essence by combining one teaspoon of lemon essence with four drops of water.

title: Crock Pot Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups onions, peeled and chopped | 2 cups mushrooms | 1 can anchovies | 1 can corn kernels ( reserve 2 tablespoons corn juice ) | 1 can mushroom pieces ( reserve 2 tablespoons ) | 3 packages meatballs, cooked and cubed
instructions: Brown onion, mushrooms and anchovies in a skillet. Add all ingredients and mix together. Spray crock pot with cooking spray and pour contents into crock pot. Cook on low for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Mushroom Mushrooms Stuffed With White Zinfandel
ingredients: 4 large ripe mixed vegetables | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/2 cup sliced dry roasted peanuts, divided | 1 tablespoon shredded white zinfandel wine | 1 tablespoon shortening, or as needed
instructions: Strip ends of all vegetables, except mushrooms. Set aside. Place two tablespoons each of chopped nuts and zinfandel into a bowl, mix well, and set aside. Heat shortening in a skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir half of the mushrooms until the stems are soft. Remove stuffing, transfer to a large mixing bowl, and mix with the nut mixture set aside. Spoon stuffing into the center of each green squash mushroom, and roll up the ends, jelly roll fashion. Crimp the mushroom caps, secure with a toothpick, and stuff with stuffing. Place mushrooms onto a baking sheet, and bake under the preheated broiler about 15 minutes, or until tender. Garnish with paprika to serve.

title: Sweet and Savory Rice Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable broth | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato | 4 tablespoons rice vermicelli, broken | 1/3 cup mango salsa | dried herbs ( optional )
instructions: Bring vegetable broth to a boil. Stir in sun dried tomatoes. Add rice vermicelli noodles and salsa. Cover. Reduce heat to simmer. Cover and simmer for 12 minutes, or until rice noodles are tender. Remove from heat, stir in fresh herbs, if desired, and serve.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,cream chicken soup,parsnip,peanut oil vegetable,pesto sauce
title: Pesto Parsnip Pasties
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip | 6 ounces plain flour | 2 cans cream of chicken soup ( or cream of mushroom soup, can also use cream of mushroom ) | 250 ml peanut oil or 250 ml vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Peel parsnips and cut into 3/4 in pieces. Cook in salt water until tender. Drain parsnips and return to pan with soup. Mix in parsley. Preheat oven to 180oc, remove from heat and stir through flour, oil, pesto sauce. Using your hands mix the dough into a ball. Roll out to about 6 in rectangle on a floured surface. Cut into 5 squares. Place 1 tsp of the pesto mix onto each square and roll up each square making sure to be able to pick up the corners. Place pasties on greased cookie sheet and brush with a little milk. Bake for about 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Broccoli, Chinese Vegetable and Crab Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets | 1/2 cup broccoli floret | 1 can small bamboo shoots, with juice | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Soak the broccoli over night with plenty of salt in a large bowl in a cold, dark sided non reactive saucepan of boiling water, or in the freezer. Add a generous dash of salt and set aside for 5 to 10 minutes. Drain off the excess water and set aside to cool. Rinse the rice cooker, then place the broccoli and water in it. Heat until the water begins to boil, then turn the heat to very low. Cover and set aside, stirring occasionally while you prepare the crab, until later. Place the drained vegetables in the rice cooker with the reserved soaking liquid, soya sauce, and cumin, and cook until the crab is cooked through, and liquid is absorbed and the vegetables are tender. Transfer the crab into a large pan and toss with the broccoli and any juices left in the bowl. Enjoy.

title: Amazing Simple Baked Rice
ingredients: 1 lb cooked rice | 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 package mild sazon seasoning | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients, stir well and cover. Set aside in refrigerator for 4 - 6 hours. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 - 60 minutes.

title: Aromatic Black Olive Rice Wine Oil and Olive Oil
ingredients: 4 tablespoons oil ( black and spring ) | 3 tablespoons rice wine or 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/2 cup pitted black olives
instructions: Place the olive oil in a glass cup, or other bowl that will hold enough oil to cover all the ingredients. Add the rice wine and stir to combine. Add the olive halves and stir to coat. Add a few drops of water if mixture begins to dry. Serve in a shallow dish. Note, if mixture seems dry, add a touch of water. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chocolate sprinkle,celery,walnut,beef tenderloin steak,buttermilk,coconut,spring onion,baby spinach
title: Creamy Spinach and Beef Wrap
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef tenderloin steak, trimmed | 1 tablespoon coconut | 2 tablespoons walnuts, finely chopped | 2 baby spinach, trimmed | 1/2 cup baby greens | 2 spring onions, thinly sliced diagonally | 1/4 cup celery, finely chopped | 1/4 cup unsweetened buttermilk | chocolate sprinkles
instructions: Place beef in a wide non metallic dish.

title: Tuna Chicken With Herbs, Seashells or T.H.E.
ingredients: 4 -6 small fresh herb, such as marjoram or 1/4 cup fresh thyme leaves | 1 can canned tuna in water | 4 tablespoons herbs
instructions: Soak the herbs for several hours or overnight in the refrigerator to wilt. In a bowl, combine tuna, herbs and 2 tbsp. Of the oil from the can of tuna. You can also add extra water if you require it to make a sandwich. Fry on medium heat for a few minutes until warmed through. Note, the tuna may still be warm. Serve on crackers, pasta or other hearty salad.

title: Mexican Lasagna #RSC
ingredients: 2 lbs lasagna sheets, ready to cook | 1 bottle of your favorite chili pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons carne asada seasoning | 1 bottle hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing
instructions: Combine sauce ingredients in a sauce pan bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat and stir in pasta. Place in a baking dish pour sauce mixture over top. Bake in 375 degree oven for 40 - 45 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Chinese Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry mustard, preferably coleman's or equivalent | 1/4 cup rice wine
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together mustards and rice wine. Store in a covered container.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,pizza sauce,russet potato,corn oil,fish stock
title: Crispy Greek Potatoes and Spinach
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes, scrubbed | 12 -15 fresh spinach leaves ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon corn oil | pizza sauce | 1/3 cup fish stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Wash potatoes and dry thoroughly. Cut potato chunks into 1 inch squares. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes to water and cook until tender but still firm, about 20 minutes. Drain. Remove potatoes and cool under running cold water. Cut in thick wedges. Lay in a single layer on paper towels. Rinse the spinach in boiling salted water for 1 to 2 minutes. Drain well. Heat corn oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add potatoes and cook 10 minutes, or until well colored and golden. Mix spinach and cooked spinach in a large bowl. Pour tomato sauce over hot potatoes and toss to coat evenly. Top with 1 tablespoon fish or parmesan cheese.

title: Smoked Salmon Pastries
ingredients: 2 tablespoons poblano chiles, finely chopped | 1/2 cup light smoked salmon fillet, finely chopped | 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed according to package directions | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom pod | 3 cups cooked pasta ( linguine, macaroni or fettuccine )
instructions: Heat a grill pan to medium high or set a sheet pan on the burner. Line it with parchment paper or silicone baking mat.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,paprika,pear,parsnip,mexican cheese,grapeseed oil,chicken breast half
title: Easy Chicken and Parsnips
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves - cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1/2 onion soup mix | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 pound parsnips, peeled and sliced | 1/2 pound small sweet onions or red onions, chopped | 2 slices fresh pear, cored and sliced | 1 cup shredded mexican cheese blend
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a bowl, combine the oil, onion soup mix, paprika, parsnips, onions and pear. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until chicken and vegetables are cooked. Top off the baking dish with cheese, if desired.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,lamb chop,lobster tail,black pepper,tomato soup,pizza sauce,italian meatball,saffron thread
title: Italian Lamb Cakes
ingredients: 8 lamb chops | 8 imitation lobster tails | 1 tablespoon saffron threads | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 3/4 cup prepared pizza sauce | 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 2 cups shredded lettuce | 2 cups shredded italian meatballs
instructions: Place lamb chops in a large resealable plastic bag, mix in saffron, black pepper, pizza sauce and tomato soup and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking sheet, and place the lamb mince onto the prepared baking sheet, using 1/2 cup of meat for each chop. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until cooked through. To serve, place lettuce, meatballs, and sliced hot italian tomatoes onto a serving platter. Ladle the meatball mixture onto the top of the salads.

Random Ingredients: red apple,blueberry,ajwain,golden raisin,ginger garlic paste,cilantro leaf
title: Blueberry Salsa
ingredients: 12 fresh blueberries | 2 small red apples ( optional ) | 1 cup golden raisin | 1 medium red apple, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon ajwain
instructions: Preheat to 350ºf. Cut off crown of the blueberries, remove berries and set aside. Peel, core and chop apples and raisins. Dice apple and raisins. Roughly chop cilantro leaves. Mix all ingredients. Strain and serve.

title: Chicken Livers and Rigatoni Pasta
ingredients: 4 cups cold cooked rigatoni pasta | 1 cup cubed chicken liver | 1/4 - 1/3 cup diced lime zest | ice
instructions: Cook the pasta in large pot of boiling water until al dente. While pasta cooks, dice the chicken livers. Add the chicken livers and the lime zest to a large bowl. Toss with hot drained pasta to mix and coat. Arrange at the table and enjoy.

title: Irish Baked Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1/3 cup ketchup, plus | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 1/2 cups vegetarian stock | 1 lb sirloin, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 1/4 cups pearl barley, uncooked | 3/4 cup golden raisin | 12 rolls
instructions: For sauce, stir ketchup with stock in saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: allspice,ginger root,jicama,flat leaf parsley,green cabbage,cider vinegar
title: Jicama Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 pound jicama, peeled and shredded | 1 head green cabbage, cored and shredded | 4 sprigs fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the cider vinegar, allspice, ginger root and cabbage. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Place the salad dressing in a large salad bowl and mix in the jicama and parsley. Toss well and serve cool.

title: Asparagus Risotto
ingredients: 6 1/2 cups chicken bouillon | 1 cup arborio rice | 2 pounds asparagus, trimmed | 1 pinch ground allspice
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in asparagus.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,vegetable stock,golden syrup,chili,chicken breast fillet
title: Apple and Mustard Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable stock, warm | 1/2 teaspoon chili, finely chopped | 85 g boneless skinless chicken breast fillets, sliced | 1/2 cup light golden syrup | 1 tart apple, quartered and thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard or 2 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: Heat stock in a small pan and stir in chilli, chicken and tomatoes. Simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes until chicken is tender and sauce thickens slightly. Place chicken in a warm dish. Boil sauce, stirring, until it is reduced and syrupy, 5 minutes. Stir in mustard and serve.

Random Ingredients: white flour,creamy peanut butter,plum tomato,chocolate syrup
title: Tropical White Pizza
ingredients: 12 medium plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter ( use regular or light for a less crunchy taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chocolate syrup ( or use more or less to taste ) | 2 1/2 cups white flour
instructions: Pour a scant 1/3 cup hot water into mixing bowl and cut tomatoes in half, cut pulp away from seeds. Cut halves in half crosswise. Place half of pulp in center of cookie sheet. Mix remaining filling ingredients and spread onto each slice of tomato leaving 1/3 of space around the edge. Sprinkle tops of tomatoes with chocolate syrup. Bake at 400ºf 5 - 10 minutes. Remove from sheets and cool on rack before cutting into small squares or wedges.

title: Garlicky Artichoke #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained | 1 cup crushed red grapes | 1 cup broth | 2 packages refrigerated # 5fix refrigerated classic lowfat baked potatoes, thawed according to package directions
instructions: Drain liquid from artichokes into a blender. Open bag of simply potatoes and drain liquid from bag of hearts. In a large, deep skillet, add artichokes, diced potatoes and enough broth to bring just to a simmer. Cook covered over medium heat 7 - 10 minutes or until potatoes are soft and Artichokes are tender. Stir the simply potatoes and artichoke hearts into potato mixture.

title: Danish Christmas Cookie(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour ( white or dark ) | 1/3 cup cognac or 1/3 cup rum ( or you can use brandy if you have it ) | 1 tablespoon marjoram or 1 tablespoon oregano | 1/2 teaspoon ground marjoram | 1 can sweet bamboo shoots, drained ( about 3/4 full, drained ) | 1 jar marshmallows
instructions: Sift together flour and marjoram or oregano. Add cognac and marjoram or oregano. Add bamboo shoots and mix well. On a greased baking sheet, spread out your chocolate. When dough is slightly firm, press dough onto pan. Allow it to cool to the touch. Cut dough into 2 squares, or you can shape into balls. Place dough squares on a greased baking sheet and flatten slightly. If preferred, you may use cookie cutters to flatten, then bake at 350 degrees f for 15 - 20 minutes, until just beginning to color. Remove cookies from oven, and set aside. Place marshmallows on a buttered cookie sheet, and melt at 150 degrees f for 5 - 10 minutes until they turn a golden brown color. Watch carefully because marshmallows burn easily. Spread melted marshmallows on top of each cookie, taking care not to make them soggy. Set cookies aside and enjoy,.

title: Fresh Spinach Pies
ingredients: 6 cups fresh baby spinach leaves, rinsed and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 3 cups fresh baby spinach leaves | 1 cup fresh bread crumbs | 1 cup fresh spinach
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the spinach, bread crumbs, baking soda, and baby spinach leaves. Form into 6 patties. Place patties onto baking sheets, and lightly with 1 cup of the bread crumbs, respectively, on the baking sheets. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until browned and cooked through. Cut each patty into 1 pieces, serve.

Random Ingredients: pecan half,white wine vinegar,spaghetti,allspice,puff pastry,silken tofu,mozzarella cheese
title: Pasties With Tofu and Mozzarella Cheese
ingredients: 4 lbs prepared puff pastry | 1/2 lb silken tofu | 3 sheets frozen puff pastry | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 1/2 cups pecan halves or 1 1/2 cups walnut halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Prepare puff pastry according to package directions. Place tofu on cookie sheet. Place 5 cups in lower third of oven. Using sharp knife, poke a deep x across the tofu. Sprinkle the tofu with allspice. Cut 6 slits across the middle of each pastry sheet. Top with tofu, overlapping the slits. Wrap 3 sheets of pastry around tofu, tucking in the ends. With scissors, cut pastry into 6 strips. Repeat with remaining 3 strips. Place on cookie sheet. Brush tops of pastry with wine vinegar. Sprinkle with mozzarella, nuts. Cut a slit in one side of each pastry strip. Then slice the left edge of pastry in half.

title: Baked Pasta
ingredients: 1 kg uncooked pasta | 1 -2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 1/2 cups malt vinegar
instructions: Boil water and drop pasta in. Bake for 1/2 hr drain and serve topped with your favourite sauce and salad dressing.

title: Beef & Rice Casserole
ingredients: 3 cups prepared quick brown rice | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/4-inch strips | 1 large apple, peeled, cored, and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 package dried linguine | 1/2 cup old fashioned oats ( not instant ) | 1/2 cup whole meal, dry-roasted wheat
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees. Spread the brown rice on a lightly oiled cookie sheet, making sure all surfaces of rice are covered. Bake until crisp, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, brown the beef in a large skillet, breaking up any clumps as it cooks. Remove, and set aside. Add the apple slices to the skillet, and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, for a few minutes, then transfer to a baking dish. Add the linguine and brown the pasta for about 5 minutes, or until al dente. Stir in the oats, and mix well. Remove from the oven, and stir in the beef and apple mixture. Return to the oven, and cook just until heated through, about 5 more minutes. Stir in the dry roast wheat, and transfer to bowls.

title: Focaccia Bread with Filled Celery and Dill
ingredients: 2 loaves focaccia bread | 2 stalks celery, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the loaf of focaccia on the prepared baking sheet. Slice the top off of the loaf with kitchen shears, being careful not to cut all the way through the top crust. This will give you room to work with the bread later. Slice 3/4 inch from the top of the loaf leaving the top inch mostly flat. Place the loaf into a small baking pan with a lid. Cover the loaf with its lid. If you have large disposable baking pans, place them on a baking sheet, then line them with the aluminum foil so they overlap the loaf. Broil the loaf 5 minutes, turning halfway through, until the tops turn a pale, golden color. Carefully remove the bread from the oven and set aside with the lip of the loaf facing up. Slice 1/2 inch from the top of the loaf. Place 1 celery slice into a small bowl with 1 teaspoon dill weed.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,bell pepper,lemon zest,sauce,green chile
title: Texas-Style Grilled Steak
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin steaks | 1/4 cup chopped green chile | 3 tablespoons sweet hawaiian hot sauce, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1/4 cup bottled sweet and sour sauce, or to taste
instructions: Place steak in a large resealable plastic bag. Drizzle with 1/4 cup hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,white mushroom,sushi rice,chipotle chile,epazote,chicken,italian sausage
title: Mushroom Chicken & Sausage Rice
ingredients: 16 ounces white mushrooms, chopped | 1 ounce yellow peas, frozen | 12 ounces chicken, chopped | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles | 1/2 teaspoon epazote | 1 cup cooked sushi rice | 1 lb italian sausage, cut in 2-inch pieces ( sausage will be too tough with skin )
instructions: In a small stock pot on high heat, add the mushrooms and peas and cook until heated through. In a separate skillet on high heat, add half of the chipotle, epazote, a couple of tablespoons of water, and the chicken. Cook until the chicken is cooked and brown. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. Add the rest of the chipotle, epazote, and water on the other side of the pan. Turn the heat up and add the sausage. Cook on the stove on medium low until all of the liquid has cooked off and the sausage is cooked throughout. Add the chicken back to the pan. Cook on medium low for 15 minutes to heat through the chicken thoroughly. This way you have a good, juicy chicken with a lot of sauce left over. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,bread flour,red wine,pasta,habanero pepper,mango powder,yeast,chive
title: Bread Machine Chilli Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup bread flour, see note | 3/4 cup red wine | 1 teaspoon yeast | 1/2 teaspoon mango powder | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon chives | 1/2 teaspoon habanero pepper | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1 1/2 cups pasta
instructions: Toast bread flour in a frying pan on medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes. Combine all the bread ingredients into pan. Pour in wine, and toast for 3 more minutes stirring to ensure liquid gets mixed through. This takes about 5 minutes. At end of the 3 minutes, remove from heat, transfer to bowl, cover and cool to lukewarm. When dough is cold. Form into 6 smaller circular loaves. Pour enough oil into frying pan to come half way up the side of the bread loaves. Heat oil to approximately 350f, or until it takes on a crispy brown crust. Turn once, or twice, for about 20 - 30 seconds per side. Remove from pan. Sprinkle generously with salt, or leave it for about 15 to 30 seconds while heating up the oil, and keep an eye on it for a little while, to ensure its not quite to burn, to ensure its not overcooked. While waiting for dough to cool, place the pasta in boiling water to cook. When almost al dente, drain and place into a bowl of cold water to keep warm. Place dough inside until all the noodles are fully cooked. Roll the pasta into circles with floured hands about 4 inches long. Using a pasta roller, cut into 12 - 12 discs. Place a tablespoon of pasta in the centre of each circle and pinch the edge with a fork, to seal. Set aside on a tray covered with a damp towel, just long enough to keep moist. Fill each with warm pasta and pinch the edges to keep moist, keeping the noodles from sticking together. To serve, place a few chives at a time in the centre of the dish. Place the cooked chilli pasta around the chilli pasta, taking care to keep filling open. Serve immediately.

title: Smoky Cauliflower Lamb and Cauliflower Mash
ingredients: 500 g cauliflower florets, trimmed | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 300 g leg of lamb, cubed | 2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Place cauliflower in a microwave safe bowl and drizzle with olive oil. Cook in microwave for 5 minutes, or until cauliflower is slightly tender. Add lamb, stirring to coat. Cook for a further 5 minutes, or until lamb is cooked. Transfer to a serving dish. Cover with foil and set aside for 20 minutes to cool slightly. When cauliflower has cooled slightly, stir in molasses. Serve with the mashed cauliflower.

title: Jerk Meatballs in Syrup
ingredients: 1 can jamaican jerk spice | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 32 meatballs
instructions: Mix jamaican jerk spice, golden syrup and meatballs together in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours, or overnight. Serve on toasted buns.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,egg noodle,coffee,artichoke heart,white rice,onion flake,savoy cabbage
title: Chinese Veggie Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 large head savoy cabbage, chopped | 4 cans hot brewed coffee | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 2 packages egg noodles, broken | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained | 3 tablespoons dried chopped cilantro leaves | cooked white rice, to serve
instructions: Using a sharp knife, slice off and discard the ends of the cabbage. Using only the leaves, remove the core of the cabbage. Cut across once or twice. Place the cabbage in a large stockpot. Add the coffee, onion, and noodle pieces. Cover and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes, until noodles are softened. Transfer mixture to a food processor, then process until smooth. Reheat the soup. To serve, ladle soup into bowls, then spoon noodle soup into the bowls. Sprinkle cilantro on top.

title: The Manoeuvre for Your Party
ingredients: 6 ounces manchego cheese | 6 ounces beer
instructions: Cut the block of manchego in small thin slices. Cut the cheese in half with a knife. Remove most of the white part of the cheese, cutting it into two halves. Put the garlic in a medium size bowl and pour the beer slowly into this until it is almost covered. Mix cheese. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,liquid honey,red wine,kaffir lime leaf
title: Sweet Red and White Vietnamese Lemons
ingredients: 24 kaffir lime leaves, white parts only | 1 1/2 tablespoons liquid honey | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 1/2 ounces sweet red wine, white part only
instructions: Trim off the white parts of the kaffir lime leaves with a thin slice or two of rind. Using a very sharp knife, cut about 1 - 2 slits vertically down each side of the kaffir lime, taking care not to cut into the white veins. If planning to use in this recipe, place a piece of white paper on a cutting board and cut a slit along the stem to make a cone shape and insert the zest in half a lime. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the lime leaves to a saucepan or deep skillet and add the honey and fish sauce. Place the pan over medium heat.

title: Homemade Seven-Spice Powder
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chinese five spice powder | 2 cups caraway seeds | 1 tablespoon crushed dried marjoram
instructions: Use a mortar and pestle to pound 5 spice powder into one cup of the ground powder. Do not use a coffee grinder. Store powder in a airtight container. Variation. Instead of caraway, grind caraway seeds in a spice grinder or spice mill. Variation. Stir 1/4 cup honey and 3/4 cup water into the powder when mixing with a fork, and continue grinding once ground. Variation. Dissolve 1/4 cup of the remaining four spice powder in a tablespoon of hot water before mixing with honey. Variation. Mix the five spice powder into the remaining 1/4 cup honey.

Random Ingredients: fajita seasoning mix,chocolate chip,white pearl onion,apple,water chestnut,anchovy
title: The Fajita's Easy Fajita Onions
ingredients: 6 large white pearl onions | 2 tablespoons fajita seasoning mix | 1 cup water chestnuts | 1/4 cup chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon anchovy, finely chopped | 1 apple, cored and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place all the onions in a large roasting pan with the fajita seasoning mix. Add water chestnuts, chocolate chips, anchovies, and apple. Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven, stirring occasionally, until onions are very tender and golden.

title: Simple Beef and Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 lb stewing beef | 1 can green beans | 1 can pimientos, sliced in half
instructions: Cube meat and brown with onion and green beans in large pot. Add pimientos. Bring to boil then pour over water. Cover and simmer about 1 1/2 hours stirring occasionally until meat is tender and onions are slightly browned.

title: Zucchini & Pasta
ingredients: 1 zucchini | 150 g pasta
instructions: Put the zucchini on to boil in enough water to cover, remove once cooked. Drain well, put in a bowl covered with cheesecloth, leave at room temperature until cold, drain off excess water, put in a microwave safe bowl, cover and cook on high heat setting for 10 minutes, stirring occassionally, stir in the pasta, heat through and serve on warm bread or crackers,.

title: Chipotle Filling for Cajun Tartlets, Rice Bowls(Vegan)
ingredients: 1 quart refrigerated ranch dressing | 7 chipotle chiles, canned in adobo | 1 vanilla bean, seed and juice extracted ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons prepared chipotle-flavored filling, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/chipotle-adobo-with-the-chili-sweetener-205185 '' > chipotle with the sweetener < /a >
instructions: Place the thawed ranch dressing, chiles and vanilla bean in a blender or magic bullet until smooth. If using the chipotle in adobo, scrape the seeds and juice into the blender jar with the sweetener. Blend until smooth, usually takes about 3 minutes. While blending, line a sheet pan with foil. Place the filling on the foil. Gently remove the edge of the foil with the tip of a knife. Using your fingers, spread the cooled dressing mixture into the bottom of the pastry lined pan. Cover the filling entirely with the pastry, leaving a 1/4 inch at the edges. Cover with the top pastry sheet. Cut several slits across the top of the tart, so that steam can escape. Refrigerate at least 3 hours and up to 8 hours or overnight. Heat oven to 350°f.

Random Ingredients: chili bean,wasabi powder,wheat pita bread,pork bean,red wine vinegar,black tea,gingerroot
title: Wasabi Bean Pizzas
ingredients: 2 cups canned pork and beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon pickled gingerroot, minced | 2 tablespoons black tea, infused black tea concentrate | 2 tablespoons wasabi powder | 1 whole wheat pita bread, cut into 1-inch rounds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine the pork, beans, vinegar, ginger root, black tea concentrate, and wasabi powder. Mix well and transfer the mixture to a baking sheet. Insert a round of pita rounds into the prepared pizzas. Bake until the bread is toasted and puffed, about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Kielbasa Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/4 lb kielbasa sausage | 1/4 lb american cheese | 1/4 cup banana | 1 tablespoon dressing | 1/2 teaspoon basil and oregano | 1/2 teaspoon powdered oregano or 1/2 teaspoon fresh oregano | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 3 sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix all the above. Brush kielbasa with marinade and spread on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Cut into 1x1 inch slices and serve on tortillas with your favorite toppings.

title: Tropical Kaffir Lime Soda (Tropical Kaffir)
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/4 cup buttermilk or 1/4 cup milk, room temperature | 3 kaffir lime leaves, torn into pieces
instructions: Lightly spray a nonstick muffin tin or spray with cooking spray. In a small bowl, mix buttermilk or milk and kaffir lime leaves until well blended. Spoon mixture onto prepared muffin pan evenly. Bake at 375°f for about 10 minutes, just until heated through. Cool slightly before removing from pan. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

title: Artichoke and Marinated Vegetables
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs frozen artichokes or 2 1/2 lbs fresh artichokes | 3 tablespoons fresh italian parsley or 3 tablespoons parsley, snipped | 1 tablespoon fresh dill, snipped
instructions: Rinse and drain the artichokes. Tear off the tips of the stalks with a sharp knife. Tops off the bottoms, if any. Cut off the tips of the artichokes and place in a bowl. Cover with water and marinate for at least 25 minutes. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Remove artichokes from water and place in the boiling water. Add parsley and dill, cook for 2 minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Reserve the water. Cook vegetables in the reserved water. Drain and discard marinade. Serve the vegetables separately and serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: green olive,cream mushroom soup,vanilla pod,splenda granular,lemon,spanish onion,green lentil
title: Spanish Lentil Dressing
ingredients: 1 can green lentils, rinsed ( about 2 1/4 cups ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/3 cup spanish onion, chopped | 1/4 cup green olives, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla pod, divided | 1 tablespoon splenda granular, sugar substitute ( optional ) | 1/4 lemon, juice of
instructions: Stir together all the ingredients and mix together until well incorporated and smooth. Chill covered up to 2 hours before serving.

title: Homemade Steamed Whole Onions
ingredients: 4 large onions, peeled and cut into thick slices | 1 1/4 cups beef stock | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Place the onions into a saucepan the broth of choice. Bring the broth to a boil over high heat, skim off any froth that rises to the top, and continue boiling slowly. Add the sherry, cover, and steam for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. If the onion falls apart, uncover, and continue cooking slowly for 15 minutes, or until it has become a tender, caramelized onion consistency.

title: Stuffed Green Chilies (Mexican Style Chili Con Carne)
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice | 8 -10 green chilies ( green and/or red ) | 1 can pineapple, cut into chunks | 1 jar marshmallows ( or regular size ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons rose water | 3 tablespoons dried apricots, snipped ( optional )
instructions: Heat the rice according to package directions. Slice off tops of chilies and remove seeds. Place the rice and chilies in casserole dish with pineapple chunks. Pour remaining sauce ingredients over the top. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes. Fluff with fork.

title: Pomegranate Chicken (Abkhazia)
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, whole | 1/2 cup pomegranate seedless grapes ( called dolmades ) | 2 1/2 ounces bacon drippings or 2 1/2 ounces clarified butter
instructions: Grill or roast or fry the chicken breast. Remove from heat and cut into small slices. Heat the grape seeds in a small saucepan and saute briefly. Add the pomegranate seeds to a small bowl and add just enough water to cover them. Cover the bowl with a towel and set aside. In a non stick skillet, melt the bacon drippings or clarified butter. Add the chicken and cook over high heat for 5 minutes, turning once. Drain the skillet and add the grapes and water to simmering. Return the contents of the skillet to the stovetop and cover the skillet. Allow to cook over medium heat for another 15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked tender. Serve immediately.

title: Chermoula on French Bread (Grilled)
ingredients: 4 lbs lettuce, such as oak leaf, oak-cured, leaves removed ( or lettuce of your choice ) | 1/2 cup saffron threads or 1/2 cup other threads packed in warm water | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, halved
instructions: In one large bowl, toss the lettuce with the saffron, allspice, and lukewarm water. Place lettuce on a flat surface, and sprinkle on the cherries. Wrap tightly in heavy duty foil. Refrigerate at least 1 - 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: sauce,confectioner ' sugar,black tea,salt,italian parsley,chicken breast tender,yeast
title: Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups hot black tea | 2 tablespoons instant minced fresh italian parsley | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 3/4 teaspoon salt | 1 lb chicken breast tenders | 1 tablespoon hot sauce, such as tabasco | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 4 tablespoons hot black tea
instructions: For the tea, heat 2 cups hot black tea in a small bowl to a boil. Stir in 2 tablespoons dried parsley. Let cool to lukewarm.

title: Potato Apple & Cheese Tray for Scones
ingredients: 5 small baking potatoes | 150 g grated cheese | 3 tablespoons finely grated fresh tart apple rind | 3 teaspoons ground allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Place potatoes on oven tray and bake until tender, around 35 - 45 minutes. When cool enough to handle, peel potatoes of skins and cut in large dice. Set aside. Meanwhile, combine cheese with the allspice. Spread potato mixture over the base of a large baking tray lined with baking paper. Top with the apple and cheese mixture. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden and bubbly. Serve with custard or cream to sweeten.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,plain flour,spaghetti,cucumber,cayenne pepper,cheese,hoisin sauce,lettuce
title: Chinese Spaghetti Bites
ingredients: 150 g spaghetti, cooked | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons mild hoisin sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons plain flour | 1/2 cup shredded tasty cheese or 1/2 cup swiss cheese | 1/2 cup low-fat lettuce, shredded | 2 sprigs of your choice of seasonal salad leaves
instructions: In a medium bowl put the spaghetti, salt and water to boil and cook according to package directions and drain. Meanwhile combine the ingredients for the gravy base in a small bowl. Add the shredded cheese to the spaghetti and combine thoroughly. Pour the spaghetti into a lightly oiled baking tray, spread evenly. Place in a preheated oven and bake at c for 20 - 25 minutes or until the top is golden brown. Remove from the oven with a spatula and place on a plate to cool. To serve place a slice of the cooled spaghetti on the plate, top with the cheesy gravy base and extra shredded lettuce. Garnish with the fresh spring onion if desired.

title: Kidney Beans and Cheese With Lazy
ingredients: 1 cup cooked kidney beans, cooked ( can use black and pink beans drained ) | 3/4 cup grated pecorino cheese ( or parmesan cheese ) | 16 -20 ladyfingers
instructions: Combine the drained kidney beans and cheese in a deep skillet or skillet. Simmer for 15 minutes. Split open the ladyfingers and fill them with the bean mixture. Re cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until warmed through.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,cream corn,pistachio nut,white peppercorn
title: Indian Corn with Pistachios and Whipped Cream
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn, drained | 2 teaspoons white peppercorns, cracked | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons dried sweetened shelled pistachio nuts
instructions: Mix cream style corn, peppercorns, vinegar and pistachios in a mixing bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Crawfish Dip With Cream Cheese
ingredients: 20 -30 frozen cooked fresh crawfish tails, thawed | 20 -30 cream cheese, softened
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place thawed crawfish tails in a small square baking dish with a rim about ½ inch in from the sides. In a small bowl, mix together cream cheese and the softened butter. Spread mixture carefully around the shell of the casserole. Bake about 20 minutes, or until dip starts to crisp up and crawfish is tender.

title: French Drier Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons dry tarragon | 1/4 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Wash the tarragon very well and thoroughly. Put to one side. Blanch the tarragon pieces in boiling salted water, draining them well. Put them through a sieve and discard their skins. You should have 6 tablespoons of tarragon. Blend in the cold water, sesame oil and the tarragon. Cool. Serve with cold water.

title: Green Mango Crumbles
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oil | 20 slices green mango | 20 -200 rhodes puff pastry ( thawed if frozen ) | 50 -200 small croutons ( or other filling of your choice )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425 degrees f. Cut each sheet of pastry into 4 equal pieces. Using a rolling pin, roll each piece into a circle about 6 1/2 inches in diameter. Cut into each circle into two or three fingers. Set aside. On a clean surface, place the mangoes, rhodes and some balls of stuffing or stuffing. Place the croutons on one side of each circle of dough, then the mangoes. Fold the pastry around the stuffing, the croutons shouldn't be touching, and any stuffing left on the outside should be encased in the center. The stuffing should be lying on its side toward your right now. Pinch the bottom and sides of the dough to make them meet in the middle. Turn the dough over when the dough is half way up the baking sheet. Place the pastry on top of the stuffing, being careful to leave a gap of steam underneath that's good. Repeat with the rest of the dough, making sure to leave plenty of steam and extra stuffing on top. Place on a cookie sheet, seam side down, and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until the pastry is a nice golden color.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,barbeque sauce,glutinous rice,rose wine,taco seasoning,salad oil,mint,black bean
title: Taco Stuffed Beans
ingredients: 1 1/4 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup salad oil | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup barleyque sauce | 1 tablespoon dried rose wine | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the black beans, kidney beans, salad oil, barbecue sauce, barbeque sauce, rose wine, taco seasoning, and mint in a bowl.

title: Pan-Fried Scallops and Apricots
ingredients: 24 scallops | 3 apricots, peeled and sliced
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan. Wash and dry the scallops, and sprinkle with salt while they are still hot. Remove all but 3 scallops and reserve. Add 3 scallops to the pan. Fry for 2 minutes, then turn over, and fry the other side. Remove from pan and drain. Repeat with remaining scallops. Add apricots to the pan, and fry for a minute or two. Serve.

title: Macaroni and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 3/4 liters boiling chicken stock powder | 300 g macaroni | 300 g courgettes, sliced diagonally | 200 g bamboo shoots, sliced | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Bring stock to the boil. Add macaroni to boiling stock, stir well, reduce heat, simmer for 10 minutes until cooked. Drain pasta. Add remaining ingredients and bring to the boil, simmer, uncovered, for 5 - 7 minutes until vegetables are tender and sauce is thickened.

title: Guacamole from the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 bunch the tips of the asparagus | 1 can tomato puree | 1/4 cup raw guacamole | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Cut off any woody stems of the asparagus, then cut the asparagus into 2 inch pieces and put them in the crock of a slow cooker. In a medium bowl, combine tomato puree, guacamole, soy sauce, garlic powder and dark soy sauce. Stir to blend and pour over the asparagus. Cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Breaded Steak With Melon (Beef or Pork) and Pistachio Balls
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless lean middle cut beef | 3 tablespoons water or 3 tablespoons beef broth | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 1/3 cup breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 2 teaspoons ground mace or 2 teaspoons cayenne | 1/2 cup chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Cut steak into 1/2 inch thick slices. Place in a bowl of cold water. Sprinkle with salt. Add 1/3 cup flour. Toss to coat. Turn in remaining flour. Dredge in bread crumbs. Combine broth, vinegar, anchovy paste and mace together in a measuring cup. Pour over meat and turn so that liquid is at a full boil. Cover, remove from heat, and let stand 15 minutes. Drain meat and pat dry with paper towels. Drain well. Spread on a tray coated with cooking spray. Cover with plastic wrap or plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Remove meat from marinade and let stand, uncovered, at room temperature at least 30 minutes, turning occasionally, until thickened slightly.

title: Mango Coffee Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons dried cherries, chopped | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or as desired
instructions: Place yogurt, cherry chunks, instant coffee, bouillon, hot sauce, and cinnamon in a blender or food processor.

title: Chicken and Celery
ingredients: 8 chicken quarters | 2 stalks celery, coarsely chopped | 2 hard-boiled eggs, diced | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped flat-leaf parsley | 1 dried chile
instructions: Remove skin and bones from the chickens. Place chicken in a dish, and cover with water. Cover, and marinate until tender, about 30 minutes, then drain. Reserve the chicken stock. Boil the celery leaves in the reserved chicken stock for 5 minutes, or until soft. Drain liquid, and discard. Stir the eggs, celery, salt, and pepper into the pot, then cover, and simmer 20 minutes, until chicken is tender and egg is cooked, 10 minutes longer. Remove from heat, and sprinkle fresh parsley on top.

Random Ingredients: vanilla soymilk,sherry wine,sherry,garlic clove,beef chuck,orange juice concentrate
title: Caribbean-Style Carne Asada
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups orange juice concentrate, frozen concentrate in can juice section | 1 cup vanilla soymilk | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 2 tablespoons orange juice from concentrate | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: In 4 qt crock, mix together orange juice concentrate, soy milk, garlic, and oj. Stir well. Add meat. Cover and cook on lo heat for 3 hours or on hi heat for 90 minutes or until meat is very tender. Remove meat and let cool. Skim fat. In medium size skillet, heat sherry, stirring often, about 2 minutes or until it is very dark. Stir meat and pour sherry mixture over meat. Let cool. You can substitute other flavors of marjarom, cumin, cilantro, paprika, hot paprika, nutmeg, ginger, paprika, habanero pepper, serrano pepper, and more garlic. Experiment,. If you make a homemade soymilk soup, follow recipe as below. For a richer, more flavorful beverage, use orange juice concentrate, soy milk and sherry.

title: A Healthier Burgers With Pesto
ingredients: leftover grilled hamburger | 1/2 diced cucumber | 1/4 diced yellow bell pepper | 2 tablespoons chopped mild yellow bell peppers | 2 tablespoons toasted sliced olives | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup tortilla chips, for dipping
instructions: Divide hamburger among 4 dinner plates. Spread 1 tablespoon pesto on burgers and then top with remaining burger ingredients. Serve immediately with toasted tortillas.

title: Bread Chocolate Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 lb whole milk chocolate ( or 85 % cream of chocolate ) | rye bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Put chocolate in a bowl.

title: Low Fat Greek Steak With Broccoli
ingredients: 1/4 cup reduced fat feta cheese | 2 -4 lbs sirloin | 1 cup savoy cabbage or 1 cup bok choy, sliced | 1 bag broccoli florets
instructions: Slice sirloin thinly across the grain.

title: Famous Minty Pasta Filler
ingredients: 10 ounces uncooked pasta ( i like rotelle ) | 2 cups milk chocolate, broken | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint | 14 ounces rotel tomatoes, drained and sliced hot ( we prefer hot )
instructions: Cook pasta in rapidly boiling water according to package directions. Drain. Place in a 2 quart casserole dish. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes. Uncover for the last 10 minutes of baking.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,gingerroot,half,vegetable stock,pork chop,chicken stock,italian salad dressing mix,dijon mustard
title: Crock Pot Pork Chops With Sweet Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 4 thick pork chops | 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot, fresh grated | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 package dried italian salad dressing mix | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup feta cheese
instructions: Cut the chops into 1/4 inch or 1/4 inch wide strips with the grain about 1/4 inch high. Sprinkle the pork cubes with ginger, mustard and french dressing mix. Place in crock pot with stock, chicken broth and half and half. Cover and cook on low for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or on high for 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Stir and add the cheese. Cover and turn crock pot to high for 30 more minutes.

title: Crispy Capsicum Chips (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg sirloin steaks | 1/4 cup low-fat sweet italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon tarragon, chopped | 1 teaspoon tarragon, chopped | 1/2 red capsicum
instructions: Brush steak with dressing, season with pepper and salt and freshly ground black pepper and grill for 4 - 5 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking. Mix together herbs and slice capsicum thinly and place on the chips.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,cinnamon,pumpkin seed pepitas,chili pepper flake,sesame oil,orange
title: Gadogeres
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 pinch cinnamon | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1 orange, rind of, grated ( optional ) | 5 tablespoons pumpkin seeds ( pepitas )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a screw top jar, add some olive oil and shake until combined. Serve in a flat dish. Gadogeres can also be served as a snack with rice or in a wrap as a veggie dish. Toast pepitas over low heat. Spread a few seeds at a time onto a plate. Place a little gadogere on top. Garnish with more seeds. May be served with yogurt.

title: Pesto and Prosciutto Penne
ingredients: 2 pints of drained whole wheat penne | 1 lb manchego cheese, cut into thin sticks | 4 slices prosciutto | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil with 2 tablespoons of gelatin. Coat the pasta with the hot water, and then return it to the pot. Dissolve the gelatin in the 1/2 cup of cold water. When the water comes to a boil again, and then add the gelatin. When the water again comes to a boil, add the pasta and remove from heat. Leave at a simmer.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,asparagus,tomato puree,chickpea flour,red chili,poblano chile
title: Fried Asparagus With Chile and Tomato
ingredients: 8 asparagus, trimmed | 1/2 cup chopped canned poblano chile | 1 tablespoon chickpea flour | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon thinly sliced red chili
instructions: Boil asparagus 3 - 5 minutes or until just tender. Drain well. Place poblano peppers in a colander and place under cold running water. Using a slotted spoon, scrape off the black peppercorns and discard. Rinse the peppers under cold running water and remove any seeds and pith. Cut into bite size pieces and set aside. Heat 1 1/2 tspn of veg oil in a large frying pan over a moderately high heat. In small bowl, combine the tomato puree with the cream of tartar and set aside. Dip each asparagus spear into the tomato puree, then in the asparagus's sauteed seeds, coating well. When the pan is very hot, add the asparagus in batches. Cook until golden brown on both sides, turning over the asparagus once. Cooks note, if the asparagus is browned too fast, raise the heat slightly. Remove from the pan and keep warm on a low heat. Sprinkle with a little extra salt and serve immediately.

title: Rigatoni Pasta with Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, scrubbed | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 package instant dry rigatoni pasta | 1 can stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes, or to taste | 1 package refrigerated fettuccine
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,sauerkraut,anchovy paste,thai red chili pepper jalapeno
title: Astra Kapusta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sauerkraut | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon anchovy paste, to taste | 1 -2 thai red chili peppers ( or jalapeno ) or 1 -2 jalapeno, sliced
instructions: Slice off a 1 1/2 inch deep piece of fat from the sauerkraut. Place it in a pot on the stove, cover and cook until tender. Shred the cheese into pieces or strips, using all or some of the cheese. Drain and set aside. Heat the oil on medium heat and fry the bread. Add about a teaspoon of anchovy paste to keep from turning dark. Add chili peppers or jalapenos. Mix well. Take the bread and place on a platter. Top with the cheese mixture. This is usually eaten with the bread.

title: Aussie Style Spiced Red Beef Ribs
ingredients: 100 g green beans, tops trimmed, trimmed, halved if large | 50 g tamarind paste | 50 g good quality lamb shank ( from chuck ) | 100 g walnut halves, roughly chopped | horseradish, to serve
instructions: Combine the tamarind paste and half a cup boiling water in a shallow glass dish and put in the fridge for at least 3 hours or overnight. Strain out any seeds or fibre that might be released and then discard the pulp. Slice the beef into thin long strips by making long strips about 5cm larger in diameter and 3 4cm long. In a non stick frying pan, heat up the ground walnut nuts and toss over low heat for a minute or two. Stir in the beef and keep stirring so not to break up pieces of food. When the beef has turned a nice dark golden colour, remove it from the heat. Place into a large bowl with just enought water to cover it. Taste and add more tamarind water if the flavours seem to need it. Cover and leave to macerate for about 15 minutes or longer if you need to. When ready to serve, transfer the meat and nuts to a warmed serving dish and scatter over the remaining nuts. Serve with horseradish on the side.

title: Fresh Apple Beans (From the Canadian Book) and  for Clear-Puff Cooking
ingredients: 1 lb dried black-eyed peas ( soaked overnight ) | 1 tart apple, pared and diced - about 2 cups | 1 dash ground mace
instructions: Place the soaked peas and apples in a soup pot and cover with water by 2 inches or just over. The peas will probably be crowded.

title: London Broil Italian Style
ingredients: 1 lb london broil beef, sliced thin | 5 romano cheese slices ( or grated ) | 3 -4 tablespoons ground coriander ( this is very strong, don't add it to the grated romano or any other cheese ) | 1/2 lb pepperoni, sliced thin
instructions: Cut the beef in thin strips and arrange on top of the cheese on a plate. Sprinkle 1/4 cheese on the beef and place under very hot broiler for 10 - 12 minutes until cheese is brown. Remove from heat and top with the pepperoni slices. Note, if you serve this without the cheese, you can use 1/2 package pepperoni.

Random Ingredients: french bread,thai basil,salmon steak,pecorino romano cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,turmeric,banana,broth
title: Salmon and Cranberry Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth | 2 skinless salmon steaks, thinly cut | 4 slices cheddar cheese | 4 slices sharp cheddar cheese | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 4 slices french bread, toasted | 1 tablespoon crushed pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup sliced banana, to serve
instructions: Place chicken broth in a small saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,ginger juice,golden brown sugar,turmeric,cooking spray,tilapia fillet
title: Cermon Ginger Tails
ingredients: 1/4 cup crystallized ginger juice | 2 tablespoons crystallized cilantro | 1 lb tilapia fillet, cut into 1/2 inch thick chunks | 2 tablespoons golden brown sugar | 1 tablespoon ground turmeric | cooking spray
instructions: Combine ginger juice and 1/4 cup of the crystallized cilantro in a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat until ginger is fragrant, about 30 seconds. Remove ginger mixture from heat. Dredge fish in brown sugar and turmeric until fish is well coated with spice mixture. Stir remaining 2 tablespoons crystallized cilantro into saucepan and bring to a boil. Turn heat down to a simmer and cook until fish turns opaque, about 4 minutes. Pour remaining 2/3 cup crystallized cilantro into skillet. Remove fish from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Spoon ginger sauce over fish and serve.

title: Raspberry Steak With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/3 cup unsalted porcini mushrooms, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry ( about 10 pieces ) | 2 lbs boneless sirloin
instructions: Heat a grill pan to medium high. In a small bowl, combine sauce, mushrooms, and chili sauce. Place meat, 1/4 cup sauce mixture, and half the raspberry rinds on a board. Divide meat mixture among 4 plates. Serve with remaining sauce mixture.

title: Truffled Fish #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 lb skinless trout ( in the shell ) | 1 ounce dark chocolate | 1/2 cup whipping cream, whipped
instructions: Mix potatoes with onions and truffle. Put in casserole dish. Cover with cheese. Melt chocolate in microwave. In a small bowl whip cream with cream on high. Spread over cheese. Chill in fridge for at least two hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,palm sugar,sea salt,marsala wine
title: Nouc Mam (Portuguese Dry Red Pepper)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes, crushed | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet red wine or 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained of excess oil, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons palm sugar or 1 1/2 tablespoons packed brown sugar
instructions: Mix crushed pepper flakes, wine vinegar, sun dried tomatoes, and sugar in a small bowl. Store unused portion for later use or refrigerate portion for use. Shake all ingredients vigorously to combine. Store unused portion in refrigerator. This will keep, refrigerated, for up to 3 weeks.

title: Homemade Flank Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup sambhar powder or 1/2 cup other spice powder | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 3 -4 lbs flank steaks
instructions: Mix all ingredients and rub well on both sides of the flank steak. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Grill, basting and turning frequently with 1/2 cup water, on the grill until meat reaches desired doneness.

title: Frank Sinatra's Favorite Picnic Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans ( drained ) | 1/4 lb bacon ( fried ) or 1/4 lb pancetta ( fried ) | 1/3 cup fat-free lardons ( or 1/3 cup ham or 1/3 cup turkey bacon ) | 1/2 cup bertolli sherry ( dry, but not hot ) or 1/2 cup dry white wine ( dry, not hot ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar ( packed ) or 1 tablespoon firmly packed light brown sugar ( packed )
instructions: Rinse beans. Drain well. Place the beans in a colander and rinse with cold water to remove the salt. Press and discard excess moisture from the beans. Drain well. Cook bacon or pancetta until it just begins to brown. Pour out as much fat as possible. Set bacon aside and reserve the cooking fat. Turn down heat on skillet to medium. Add lardons and cook until browned about 1 minute. Then add the beans and sherry, lemon juice and brown sugar or sugar. Stir to coat the beans with the hot fat. Turn down heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove lid, turn heat up to medium high. Cook for 2 minutes until most of the water from the beans and sherry has evaporated, then remove from heat. Allow to stand for 5 minutes and cut into 2 or 3 pieces to serve.

title: Spaghetti with Pork and Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground pork | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup golden raisins | 1 pound small shell pasta
instructions: Cook pork in a large skillet over medium high heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Stir green pepper into the skillet, and cook for 5 minutes. Mix in golden raisins and cooked pork. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Pheasant
ingredients: 12 large pheasants | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( or substitute ) | 4 lemon zest, finely grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 pinch salt or 1 pinch salt | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest, finely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c or 400f. Wash pheasant then prick each one all over with a sharp knife. Pound the pheasant gently with a meat pounder. Combine the asafetida and lemon zests. Brush each pheasant inside and out and sprinkle with spice mix, and brush the outside with remaining mix. Place on a rack in an oven proof dish or roasting tin. Pour boiling water into the roasting tin, into a 2 inch depth. Bake the pheasant for 50 mins or until cooked, basting occasionally.

title: Eggplant-Enchilada Pasta Sauce
