ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 2 fresh anchovies | 1/4 cup bourbon or 1/4 cup white wine | 1 cup red enchilada sauce | fresh cilantro, coarsely chopped
instructions: Wash eggplant. If eggplant is exceptionally ripe, halve it lengthwise or cut it in half crosswise on an angle to obtain four 4 inch long strips, with a quarter inch-length strip at the sides of the dish. Cut off ends and peel eggplant lengthwise, and slice crosswise on the horizontal to yield four 4 inch long strips. Cut anchovies in half and place them in a blender along with the bourbon. Blend, stopping and scraping down sides of bowl as needed until mixture is smooth. Heat half enchilada sauce in a large pot over medium heat. Add eggplant and anchovies, reduce heat to medium low, and cook until coated by the sauce. Remove eggplant mixture from pot and place onto a plate or in a shallow dish. Add remaining sauce to pot.

title: Hot Dogs from New Zealand
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 1 ounce white mushroom, sliced | 5 ounces gluten | 2 ounces cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Place the chicken wings in a pan with enough cold water to cover and bring to the boil, adding the mushrooms and cook until very tender. Drain and set aside. Mix the chilli, gosza, coriander powder and cocoa, adding some warm water to make a slurty paste. Rub the mix under cold water before using. Place on your favourite hot dog and enjoy.

title: Chicken and Shrimp With Black Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb cooked chicken, cut into bite-size pieces | 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup romano cheese, grated | 1/2 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined and butterflied
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Mix chicken, beans, romano and shrimp together and set aside. Place the beans in to a 8 by 8 baking pan and bake for approximately 30 - 45 minutes, or until cheese is slightly brown and slightly brown.

title: The Best "Chinese" Fried Beans.
ingredients: 1 package fresh peas, shelled | 1 can soybeans ( can use other beans ) | 1 teaspoon ground cloves or 1/2 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Add to pan and fry with low heat. These are nice with a dash of bahrat or your favourite nut/nutmeg.

title: Stir-Fried Oyster Cabbage (Stir-Fried in Oyster Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon saffron threads | 1 package frozen thinly sliced green cabbage or 1 package regular cabbage | 1 head green cabbage, cored and shredded | 3 -4 tablespoons oyster sauce, to taste
instructions: Soak saffron in water to release as much flavor as possible. Drain, and set aside. Rinse green cabbage in a colander until water runs clear.

title: Chunky-Salsa Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs roast beef | 2 tablespoons walnut oil ( i like to use the walnut oil ) | 3 jars chunky salsa | 1 large head cabbage ( about 1 large head ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Put roast in a non reactive pot and cover with water. Turn heat to high and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 1 hour. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Shred meat and keep warm. Turn heat back up to medium and pour juice through a strainer and stir in reserved liquid. Bring back to a boil. Reduce heat to lowest setting and simmer until thickened, about 20 minutes. While meat is simmering, mix the salsa with the walnuts. Serve meat, topped with salsa and chopped cabbage.

title: Aromatic Bistarks
ingredients: 2 lbs hot italian sausage | 6 tablespoons ghee, melted | 1 tablespoon bisto
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large, heavy frypan. Brown the sausages well, about 10 minutes and drain, keeping them cold. Add the bisto to the pan drippings and mix well, cooking over moderate heat until glistening and bubbling. Add the sausages to the pan and cook over moderate heat for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: herb,chipotle pepper,tenderloin,orange peel,haddock,farfalle pasta,taco seasoning mix
title: Fisherman's Pasta
ingredients: 1 pound uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 pound tenderloins | 2 large zucchini chopped | 3 teaspoons chopped fresh herbs | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 can chipotle peppers, minced
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook noodles in boiling water until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes.

title: Bahama Mama Fried Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 1/2 cups cooked black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 bell peppers | salt and pepper | 1/4 teaspoon sage ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon savory ( optional )
instructions: Set oven to 375 degrees. Spread out the peas evenly in a baking pan. Mix together the golden syrup, beans, peppers, salt and pepper to taste. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and place on a serving plate.

title: Roasted Eggplant
ingredients: 1 eggplant, sliced | 1 cup oatmeal
instructions: Preheat a grill pan over a fairly high heat. Put the eggplant slices on the grill to char them. This will create a bitter taste to the eggplants. I prefer an oven that tastes best without the bitter taste of the eggplant. Brush the eggplant with the oatmeal and toast under the grill. Alternatively, use a skillet with a lid, spray with pam, and put the eggplant over medium heat. You want to cook this until just slightly charred on the top, then move or move the slices around and turn as necessary until the desired doneness is achieved. Allow to rest.

title: Acapulco Mocha Espresso
ingredients: 2 cups freshly brewed espresso ( or up to 1 cup ) | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 2 tablespoons chocolate, grated ( with a kick ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried mint, loosely packed | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, loosely packed
instructions: Pour brewed espresso into a chilled, dry 8oz mug or heat resistant cup. Add instant coffee, chocolate, mint and marjoram.

Random Ingredients: white bread,soda cracker crumb,italian seasoning oregano,golden syrup
title: Italian Snack Bread
ingredients: 1 package of plain soda cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning or 1 tablespoon oregano | 1 loaf of crusty white bread
instructions: Topping. Combine crushed cracker crumbs and syrup in a small saucepan. Stir over medium flame for 1 minute. Remove from flame. Pour over bread. Sprinkle with grated cheese if desired.

title: Aussie Chili Cones (Tropical Cones, Dip)
ingredients: 250 g paneer, in one piece | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate, chopped | 2 teaspoons white corn, drained
instructions: Cut the paneer into one inch cubes. Heat pan with the chilli powder on med heat, add paneer pieces and coat well. Stir fry for 5 mintes, turn. Turn off the burner. In a small bowl mix remaining ingredients together, pour this mixture on top. Cover pan and allow it to sit until ready to serve.

title: Nuts and Bolillos
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Place turmeric and garlic powder in a clean cloth or a tea strainer. Use wet hands to push the turmeric mixture into the pores of the cloth/strainer. Place a generous 1/4 cup of the turmeric mixture onto the turmeric and gently push it into the pores of the cloth/strainer. Cover with another 1/4 cup turmeric mixture. Wrap the cloth/strainer with a tea cloth or rubber grips, close the ends securely and tie the entire cloth/saran wrap with kitchen string. Allow to rest at room temperature for 20 minutes. Using a sharp knife, remove the cloth/saran wrap and use to gently cut off any hard fiber or dark material on your kitchen wall. Keep in freezer until required. To use.

title: Strawberries and Sunflower Seeds(21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 14 )
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 cup strawberry, cut in half | 120 g reduced-fat thawed frozen strawberries | 1/2 cup reduced-fat thawed frozen whipped topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Spread sunflower seeds evenly, and then scatter over chicken broth. Combine the strawberry halves and frozen strawberries in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 1 minute.

title: Cousin June's Chewy Rice Pudding
ingredients: 10 eggs ( or 4 normal size eggs ) | 1/2 cup milk or 1/2 cup half-and-half ( use half and half milk to get the amount in the ingredients, if possible, if the eggs don't really curdle ) ( optional ) | 1 cup par-boiled rice | 1 cup gorgonzola, grated ( may add a little more ) | fruit, sliced or fresh fruit ( to taste ) | 2 dates, chopped ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f and lightly butter a 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 quart ovenproof casserole dish. In a bowl, mix together 2 eggs, eggs and half and half or milk. Place half of the rice in baking dish and place half the grated cheese in the center and scatter half of the chopped fruit on top. Repeat layers with the rest of the rice, the grated cheese and any optional garnishes. Bake covered for 30 minutes or until set. Let sit for 10 minutes and serve while hot.

title: Cheese Tortellini With Coriander Sauce
ingredients: 32 ounces cheese tortellini | 1/4 cup coriander, chopped | 4 tablespoons barbecue sauce, your favourite
instructions: Cook tortellini for about 10 mins or until done. Drain and toss through coriander sauce. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,english cucumber,basil,egg noodle,vegetable oil,breadcrumb,cannellini bean,yogurt
title: Cannellini Beans (From the Book Easy and Simple Soup)
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 2/3 cups chicken stock | 4 -6 large eggs noodles ( cooked ) | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 2 cups english cucumbers, diced | 1/2 cup basil, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2/3 cup plain yogurt ( to taste )
instructions: Place the cannelloni beans, stock and noodles in a 2qt saucepan and bring to a boil. Simmer 5 - 6 minute, or until the noodles cook. Strain and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper or more of your own flavorings. Mix the cooked egg noodles into the hot soup. Tear basil and fry lightly or chill for 1 hour serve hot, or reheat in the microwave.

title: Choc Chip Nippers (From Yummo)
ingredients: 1/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 3/4 inch fresh rosemary sprig ( optional, and if you have it ) | 24 sheets nori
instructions: Line a standard size jelly roll pan with nori. Break a sheet of nori crosswise into eight pieces and put each piece on a rolling pin with the rounded sides touching the side of the pan. Roll each piece into a log about 18 inches long, about 3 by 4 inches wide. Use a sharp knife to cut crosswise into six equal wedges. Make sure the cookies are at least 1 inch apart with the ends overlapping slightly. Set aside. Melt the chocolate chips in a double boiler. Stir over moderately low heat until the chocolate is melted and no lumps form, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and add the rosemary. Place the nippers on paper towels to drain off any excess melted chocolate. Chill for 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350°. Cut each log crosswise into 3 pieces. Remove the nippers from the plastic. Cut each piece into 6 wedges and arrange on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake until the jiabons are lightly crisp and beginning to brown on top, 8 to 10 minutes. Allow to cool.

title: Kale Ribs
ingredients: 12 -14 lbs pork ribs, split | 2 cans kale | 1/2 cup sugar substitute
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Place ribs, cut side down bone side down heat in a deep skillet until smoking. Reduce heat to low and cook about 8 hours, turning once and rearranging and flipping ribs. When ribs are crispy the meat will fall off the bones. Transfer ribs to a bowl and remove and discard all but 1 or 2 tablespoons of drippings or fat. Heat a little oil in the skillet and brown half of the ribs over medium heat. Drain the ribs and place in a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish and add the fat and cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until it melts and is lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Reserve 1 cup of fat in skillet. Add the kale and stir to distribute leaves.

title: Pasta With Broccoli and Coconut
ingredients: 500 g broccoli, cut into florets | 400 ml coconut milk | 400 g farfalle pasta
instructions: Cook broccoli in boiling water over medium heat for 5 minutes. Drain. Heat coconut milk in a large frying pan over low heat. Add noodles and fry over medium heat for 3 minutes. Cover and cook for 12 minutes or until noodles are cooked through, stirring regularly.

Random Ingredients: ham,baby spinach,vanilla essence,chicken breast,salt black pepper,golden raisin
title: Spinach, Raisin and Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon golden raisin | 4 slices reduced-fat ham | 2 chicken breasts | 1 cup baby spinach | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 150 g mixed dried fruit, such as raisins, dates, apple, cranberry, apple butter, apricots or 200 g sliced cooked vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c fan forced /350°f/3 and lightly grease a medium ovenproof, glass or baking dish. Place raisins in a small bowl and cover with boiling water. Stand for 5 minutes. Drain and toss with cooked chopped spinach, to serve. Place chicken on a roasting tray/ovenproof dish. Top with raisins, then scatter evenly with dried fruit. Top with remaining chicken. Sprinkle with vanilla and remaining raisins. Place dish on oven shelf or shelf 6, and bake for 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear. Place in oven and cook for 5 to 10 minutes longer for boneless, skinless chicken breasts. Taste and adjust seasoning. To serve, slice chicken and serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,swede,ranch dressing mix,ancho chile powder,dijon mustard,chive
title: Roasted White Corn on the Cob With Ranch Dip
ingredients: 12 corn on the cob | 1 1/2 tablespoons ranch dressing mix | 4 ounces cream cheese, softened | 4 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Preheat a grill or griddle pan to medium high. Brush corn with olive oil. Grill the corn until heated through and charred on all sides, about 4 - 5 minutes per side. In a bowl, combine the ranch dressing mix, cream cheese, chives, mustard and chile powder. Add the roasted corn and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: hickory smoke salt,flat leaf parsley,french bread dough,blueberry,baby spinach,american cheese,thyme sprig,red wine vinegar
title: Roasted Blueberry-Spinach Bread With White American Cheese and Herbs
ingredients: 8 slices bread ( i use the round size french bread ) | 3 bunches baby spinach | 1 medium bunch fresh flat leaf parsley, leaves picked, large stems removed, chopped | 8 slices american cheese | 4 tablespoons country-style cheese,, shredded | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon thyme sprig, dry | 1/4 teaspoon hickory smoke salt or 1/4 teaspoon other smoke flavored salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Divide the spinach among the 4 large bread slices on four plates. Sprinkle the top with the remaining bread. Distribute the baby spinach among the bread slices on top of the spinach. Top with the cheese, top with the bread slices and season with the white american cheese and thyme leaves. Combine the vinegar, vinegar salt, and smoke salt in a small bowl. Drizzle over the salad. Let sit for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,red bell pepper,cucumber,swiss chard,nonfat milk
title: Swiss Chard With Cucumber Cheese
ingredients: 1 can fat-free evaporated milk | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream ( i use fat free ) or 1/2 cup fat free sour cream ( i use fat free ) | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 medium cucumber ( about 4 ounces ) | 1 small red bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs swiss chard
instructions: Saute cucumber, onion and swiss chard in a nonstick skillet over low heat until vegetables are limp, about 7 minutes. Drain. Add the shredded cheese, mix well and heat through, about 2 minutes.

title: Pasta with Bacon and Tomato
ingredients: 1 pre-baked thin pizza crust | 6 tablespoons tomato puree | 3 slices bacon, chopped into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 7 ounces tomato slices, cut into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the pizza crust on a baking sheet and brush with about 3 tablespoons of tomato puree. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown and crusty, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and turn the crust over. Place the bacon and parmigiano reggiano cheese over the top and return to the oven until cheese is melted, about 3 more minutes. Pour the remaining 1/2 cup of tomato paste into a skillet and cook over medium high heat for 3 minutes, stirring continuously. Fold in the tomato strips and remove from the heat as soon as they are heated.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,red chile pepper,hot italian sausage,peanut oil vegetable,cooking oat,ginger garlic paste,yeast
title: Peanut and Garlic Pizza II
ingredients: 3 cups quick-cooking oats | 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 6 tablespoons cooking oats | 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon red chile pepper | 1/2 teaspoon fleischmann's powdered yeast
instructions: In a bowl, combine quickcooking oats, sausages, peanuts or vegetable oil and blend well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Place 2 cups of mixture in refrigerator until firm, at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place pizza dough on lightly oiled pizza pan or lightly flour pizza pan. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 - 25 minutes or until crust is golden brown. If not using crust, make a thin layer with a piece of foil. Allow to sit at least 8 minutes before eating.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,salmon,hot pepper,salmon fillet,canola oil,lemon lime beverage
title: Smoke and Rosemary Salmon #2
ingredients: 2 cups 100 % fat free lemon-lime beverage, chilled | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 lemon, juice of | 8 ounces salmon fillets ( fresh or frozen ) | 4 fresh hot peppers | 3 sprigs rosemary leaves
instructions: Whisk together the lemon lime beverage, canola oil, lemon juice, and hot peppers in a bowl. Spray a baking pan with non stick cooking spray and pour the marinade into the pan. Add the salmon and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Place the salmon on the baking sheet and broil for 4 - 5 minutes on each side. Sprinkle rosemary leaves on top and place under broiler for 1 minute or until golden brown and flakey. Serve hot salmon with spoons.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,sun tomato oil,taco seasoning mix
title: Smothered Gouda (Or Spanish Burritos)
ingredients: 1 pound smoked gouda cheese ( cut into thin strips about 3/4 inch wide by 2-inches long ) | 1 box taco seasoning mix | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Toss the gouda with taco seasoning and arrange it on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until it is lightly toasted and crisped. Spread about 2 tablespoons sun dried tomatoes on each tortilla, then spread about 1 tablespoon sun dried tomatoes all around. Place the smoked gouda, then sprinkle about 1 teaspoon sun dried tomatoes all around the edge.

title: Homestyle Mango Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs sirloin, cut into 1 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1 1/2 tablespoons brown mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon, plus | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine all ingredients and marinate beef at least 30 minutes or up to 4 hours or overnight. Place beef on an ungreased rack in a glass baking dish with the marinade in the center of the rack. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 140 degrees f. Baste with marinade once or twice during cooking.

title: Calde Verde
ingredients: 4 ounces boneless catfish | 4 medium shrimp ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/2 cup shelled peas | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon fish sauce soy sauce, to taste | shredded coconut ( to garnish )
instructions: Shell, devein, and pound catfish into thin strips. Arrange catfish on paper towels. Place the frozen shrimp on top of catfish and roll up loosely to submerge. Set aside. To make shrimp tamarind paste, combine the lemon juice, fish sauce, soy sauce, and mint in a bowl. Refrigerate until needed. When ready to serve, drain tamarind paste. Garnish with coconut.

title: Greek Feta Apples
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs red apples, peeled and sliced 1/4-inch thick | 10 tablespoons feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup freshly grated romano cheese | chocolate syrup or preserves, warmed
instructions: Arrange the apples over the base of a greased 13 x9 baking dish. Sprinkle the crumbled feta over. Sprinkle the romano over top, covering the apples. Drizzle with warmed syrup or preserves.

title: Rice and Mussel Soup With Mussels
ingredients: 1 bunch mussels, preferably cultivated | 1 -2 cup brown rice, washed and drained | roasted roasted red peppers or sambal oelek ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring a large stockpot of water to a boil over high heat. Drop in the mussels. They will sink slightly and be just barely open. Discard any that are open. When they are ready, remove with slotted spoon when cooked through. Wipe out the pot from the heat and return the mussels to the pot. Add the rice and hot broth to the pot. Place a sambal oelek atop each serving if desired.

title: Roasted Asparagus on the Barbecue
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, ends trimmed | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped nuts ( your choice )
instructions: Bring all ingredients to a boil in a small skillet, simmer, uncovered, until asparagus tenderens, about 5 minutes. Remove asparagus from heat.

title: Chinese Golden Syrup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweetened soy sauce | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 3 tablespoons of your best thick light soy sauce
instructions: Pour the sauces into a small sauce pan and turn on medium heat. Heat for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring constantly. Let cool, then add in your favourite sweetener, stir and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,coriander leaf,broth,sharp cheddar cheese,haddock fillet,walnut
title: Fish in Creamy Coriander Sauce
ingredients: 350 g haddock fillets, skin and bone removed | 1 1/2 cups boiling stock or 1 1/2 cups fish stock | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup fresh coriander leaves | 50 g coarsely chopped sharp cheddar cheese | 35 g toasted walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degree c.

title: Pomegranate and Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pomegranate syrup | 2 small cucumbers, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Mix pomegranate syrup and cucumbers in bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,puff pastry,ginger garlic paste,ginger juice,macadamia nut,white wine vinegar,beef stock veal,lemongrass
title: Burgers with Melted Cheese (Phat Met Yaum Ko)
ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed ( ready rolled ) | 2 ounces beef stock or 2 ounces veal stock | 2 teaspoons ginger juice | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons ginger juice or 2 teaspoons lemon, juice of | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped ginger-garlic paste | 1 piece ginger, cut into thin strips | 12 ounces boiled fully cooked hamburgers | 2 ounces cretalkean macadamia nuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Prepare pastry for the burgers. Stir together stock, ginger juice and lemon grass. Mix vinegar, ginger garlic paste and ginger in a bowl. Add beef, stirring gently to coat. Make 3 - 4 diagonal slashes on one side of the pastry sheet. Spoon equal amounts of filling onto the slashes and cover with another pastry sheet. Cut a slit in top of each burger. Brush edges with a little water. Roll each steak around the filling, starting from a long side. Cut off each twist and keep the pastry covered with kitchen wrap. Wrap the pastry around the burger and secure with a piece of kitchen string. Cook on a hot griddle, grill over medium high heat for 10 - 15 minutes or until cooked through and crusty and golden. Serve with a salad, boiled veal or rice. Enjoy.

title: Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup good ground mushroom | 1 teaspoon italian spices, crushed
instructions: Heat over medium heat in small saucepan until hot. Add all ingredients. Bring to boil, reduce heat. Simmer over low heat for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and pour into a blender, let cool down for a few minutes.

Random Ingredients: kale,wild rice,red pepper flake,black olive,white kidney bean,corn syrup
title: Mock Brown Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried wild rice | 1 cup white kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup chopped kale | 1/4 cup chopped black olives | 1/4 cup light corn syrup with garlic and olive oil | crushed red pepper flakes, to taste
instructions: Combine the wild rice, kidney beans, kale, olives, and light corn syrup in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer 30 minutes, until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Season with red pepper flakes to taste before serving.

title: Spinach With Honey-Crispy Chips
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs baby spinach leaves, stems removed | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 4 cups corn chips ( white ) | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Preheated oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil, leaving a slight depression on the middle with the foil exposed to avoid heat from steam. Bring a kettle of water to boil. Add about 1/2 tbsp of the dry oregano, the mace and 1 1/2 tsp salt. Meanwhile, snip off the ends of the spinach leaves by scraping them off with your fingers. Trim the leaves from their stems and cut them into 3 lengths by slicing them about 1/4 inch thick. Put the spinach in to a saucer or a bowl of cold water, and set aside. Pour boiling water into the jar of oregano, then add any other seasoning mixture you have in the fridge. The salt is necessary, as it encourages moisture released by the water into the dry oregano. Put the honey in a large skillet and heat over medium.

title: Corn and Lamb Salad
ingredients: 600 g stewing lamb, cubed | 300 g corn kernels | 1 head leafy green lettuce leaf
instructions: Add lamb to crockpot pan with corn and cook over low for 5 - 6 hours. Just add the lettuce and continue cooking. If desired, serve with couscous and other grain saffron rice.

title: Pea Podsal
ingredients: 600 -900 g shelled deveined uncooked shrimp | 450 g fresh- shelled prawns with shell | 500 -700 g frozen shelled peas and carrots ( carrots with capsicum )
instructions: Shell and devein prawns. Make sure all shells are defrosted. Wash peas and prawns. Break up capsicum. Put pepperoncini in a pan with oil. Brown both the shrimps and peas. Put a little of the peas and vegetables into each of the plates in one layer. Sprinkle the vegetables gently with the rest of the pea and pepperoncino mixture. Serve.

title: Art's Fabulous Caponata
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds caponata, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 can sliced plantains, drained | 2 teaspoons ground dried oregano | 1 jar applesauce
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Place caponata cubes into the skillet, and coat with a little olive oil. Place sauteed caponata in the skillet, and cook until the cubes are slightly crispy, and evenly brown. Pour in the cream of chicken soup, and Marsala wine. Sprinkle the plantains over the top of the sauce, and season with oregano and freshly ground pepper. Continue to stir together while the sauce simmers. Serve over cooked spaghetti, and top with a little applesauce.

Random Ingredients: citron,bacon,swiss cheese,cannellini bean,pecorino romano cheese,eggplant,tart shell
title: French Eggplant and Bacon Cannellini Bean Tarts
ingredients: 1 small can cannellini beans, drained | 1 small eggplant, thinly sliced | 12 large frozen tart shells, cooked and drained | 16 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup chopped candied citron, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a baking dish, layer the cannellini beans, eggplant and crumbled bacon and top with shredded swiss cheese. Bake until heated through, about 10 minutes.

title: Grilled Ginger Open Faced Melts on English Muffin Melts
ingredients: 12 slices thick-cut bacon | 8 slices smoked gouda cheese | 4 english muffins, split | 12 leaves fresh ginger ( use 3-4 ) or 12 slices galangal, finely chopped ( use 3-4 ) | 1 bunch fresh greens ( include some scallions and green leaves ) | 12 small red chilies, chopped ( leave the seeds in, but not as much as the peppers ) | toast, for serving
instructions: Heat a grill pan. Fry the bacon til crispy, remove with slotted spoon and drain on absorbent paper. Remove the bacon rind from the cooked bacon and slice into thin, long strips. Reserve bacon fat in the pan. Brush the english muffin halves with the bacon fat, split side down. Grill the english muffin halves a few minutes. Place on a plate, sprinkle with cheese, grill 3 to 4 minutes until it starts to soften. Divide the ginger slices between the muffin halves. Top with a slice of english buttered cheese and top with the bacon, green olives and red chilies. Serve immediately.

title: Nabe's Butter Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dry roasted pistachios | 1/2 cup margarine, plus a little for the pan | 1 can chicken broth | 1/4 cup mirin ( japanese rice vinegar ) | 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: In a medium sized pot over medium heat, toast the pistachios and the margarine until golden brown and fragrant about 2 minutes. Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Strain the soup through a fine mesh strainer, and return it to the pot. Stir in the mirin and crushed red pepper flakes, if using. Simmer for two to three minutes or just before serving, strain. The soup should be rather thick, but possibly very thin. Serve warm.

title: Baby Lima Beans
ingredients: 300 g baby lima beans ( small ones ) or 300 g baby lima beans ( tiny ones ) | 6 -8 dried red chilies | 150 ml warm milk | 1 bay leaf | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Wash the beans under running water and soak overnight. Next day, preheat the oven to 180c/350f/gas wash and remove the stems/stalks from the dried chillies. If using dried chillies, tie them in muslin with a piece of toothpicks to keep them intact. Drain the beans and set aside. Heat a small amount of oil in a wide ovenproof pot. Add chopped chillies and fry them over medium heat, stirring continuously, for 1 minute. Add the soaked beans and fry for a further minute. Place the lid on the pan and place in the oven for about 1 1/2 hours or until the beans are soft. Check with a fork and if tender, remove the lid. Add a little water and mix to loosen the beans and continue cooking for a further 25 minutes. When the pot has cooled a little, mix in the milk, turmeric and bay leaf and cook for a further 30 minutes. Transfer the soup into a separate pot and serve warm or cold on the side.

title: Lemon Calabrese
ingredients: 350 g penne | 50 g walnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons citron, chopped | 3 -4 lemons, juice of | 5 -6 tablespoons five-spice powder | 4 -6 small squid
instructions: Cook the penne as per the directions on the package. Meanwhile, mix the spices and nut together and mix well. Cut the rings from the squid. Cut a slit into the thick end of the squid, this will help it curl up the flavours. Cook in hot water for 3 minutes. Drain well and leave the calamabees to drain. Return the calamabeel to the boiling water. Mix well and add a tablespoon of lemon juice, to taste. Serve it on top of the cooked penne.

title: Fire-Roasted Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning, or to taste | 3 tablespoons diced fire-roasted tomatoes | 2 pounds filet of beef | 1 can enchilada-style corn, drained
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the roasting pan with tomatoes and beef in the pre heated oven and roast for 20 minutes, or until the meat is browned. Mix together the adobo seasoning and the tomato mixture. Cut the meat into strips. Place beef strips in a glass baking dish. Layer with sauce and chopped corn over beef strips. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until beef is fully cooked.

title: Pearls (Italian Beef Stew)
ingredients: 2 lbs round steaks, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup tapioca flour | 1 cup sun-dried tomato, oil packed, drained, rinsed | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: In a large plastic bag, combine the meat, tapioca flour, the sun dried tomatoes and vinegar. Close tightly and shake bag a few times to distribute the oil evenly. Place it into a large, shallow pan. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least one hour, turning meat occasionally. Preheat the broiler, and set a broiler rack 6 inches from the heat. Place the meat onto the hot rack and broil for 3 to 4 minutes per side, or until cooked through. The internal temperature will be 125 degrees f. Transfer to a platter. Serve with plenty of napkins on the side.

title: Calabaza and Pistachio Salad With Orange-Pistachio Vinaigrette
ingredients: 4 calabaza squash | 2 tablespoons orange-flavored liqueur | 2 tablespoons pistachios, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon pepperoni, finely chopped
instructions: With skin off and cut squash into 2x2 inch slices. Toss squash with orange flavored liqueur, cover and chill at least 1 hour or up to 2 hours. Prepare pistachios, slice 2 pods off the top of each calabaza, and then thinly slice across the middle lengthwise. Set aside when finished cutting. In a skillet, gently cook the pepperoni until it just begins to crisp. When the pepperoni has crisped, cut it into very thin slices. Drain the pepperoni onto paper towels, and then slice them into thin strips. Add chopped pepperoni and pistachios to chilled marinated squash. In a small bowl, whisk the orange flavored liqueur with a fork, add another tablespoon of orange flavored liqueur to taste, and then whisk in another tablespoon of orange flavored liqueur. Toss salad together with chilled orange flavored liqueur and pine chips before serving.

title: Chipotle Shredded Beef on French Bread for 2
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs well trimmed boneless beef chuck, cut into 5 to 6 thin slices | 1/2 cup chopped chipotle chile in adobo | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Line a large rimmed baking sheet with non stick foil. Place beef and chiles in a large bowl and toss with the adobe chile. Spread evenly onto the bread slices. Cut the french bread diagonally on the foil and place on the baking sheet. Place a heavy nonstick skillet over high heat and warm the foil on both sides, about 2 to 3 minutes. Remove the foil and bake the beef in the hot skillet until browned on both sides, about 10 to 12 minutes. Serve.

title: Italian Asparagus and Pinto Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans ( undrained ) | 1 1/2 cups asparagus | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1/2 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/2 cup pecorino cheese, grated
instructions: Place beans, asparagus, and bamboo in a bowl. Sprinkle with anise seeds and sprinkle with the pecorino cheese.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,dark rum,apple cider,kaffir lime leaf,feta cheese
title: Spiced Yellow Squash With Feta and Rum Applesauce
ingredients: 12 ounces yellow squash, halved and sliced, fresh if possible | 2 tablespoons good quality dark rum | 6 kaffir lime leaves ( i use 6 or 8-10 large limes ) | 2 -3 tablespoons aged feta cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon apple cider
instructions: Place the squash, rum, kaffir lime leaves, and crumbled feta in a serving bowl and toss. Serve immediately. Enjoy.

title: Fenugreek and Onion Samosas
ingredients: 5 large yellow onions | 10 ounces seitan | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: Cut the ends off the onions. Cut each into 3 - 4 pieces. Place them in a saucepan and cover with enough water to reach 2 - 3 inches above the top. Cover and bring to a boil. Set aside to steam for 15 - 20 minutes. Once the water has reduced to 5/8 of its volume, skim the foam and discard. Place onions in a colander and rinse in hot water to stop the cooking. Drain. Dice the onions. Squeeze out any remaining juice and put them in a bowl. Press together with as much water as you can from the drained onions. Place the onions and seitan in a separate saucepan. Pour water to cover and bring to a rolling boil over medium heat. Stir and skim any foam that rises to the surface as it boils. Lower the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until onions are very soft and golden brown, about 30 minutes. When the water is almost gone, check the onion mixture for doneness. It should be translucent. If the soup begins to stick, stir in a few tablespoons of water. If it begins to stick, stir in a few tablespoons of water. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. Stir in the fenugreek seeds. Refrigerate up to 1 week, then serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,enchilada sauce,poblano chile,sugar,zucchini,egg noodle
title: Zucchini and Yolks in Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini | 1 jar enchilada sauce ( mild ) | 4 poblano chiles, roasted | 4 eggs noodles, cooked | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( fresh ) | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Slice zucchinis & set aside. Roast poblanos under a grill. Remove skin and seeds. Slice chilies and set aside. Heat a frypan and heat enchilada sauce until a drop of water sizzles. Do not let the water boil. Place chilies and zucchini in a large bowl. Mash with a fork or potato masher until the squishy chunks form. You should have a little corn starch remaining in the mixture. Add the eggs noodles. Add the lemon juice and sugar. Toss the ingredients together carefully until all are incorporated and the sauce is smooth. You may add more salt to taste if necessary. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour. Enjoy.

title: Mandarin Orange Rice Wine Infusion
ingredients: 3/4 cup rice wine | 1 teaspoon sage | 2 cans mandarin oranges
instructions: Drain the orange and place them in a blender. Add the rice wine and sage, blend until almost smooth. Press a lid on the mixture. Refrigerate 2 - 3 days. Serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,pickling onion,chive,turkey meat,monterey jack pepper cheese,sirloin,chicken stock,egg
title: Stuffed Meatball Sandwich
ingredients: 32 meatballs ( i like to use ground sirloin ) or 32 ground turkey ( i like to use ground sirloin ) | 8 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup pickling onions or 1/4 cup red onion, minced | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 24 slices sirloin
instructions: Combine the meatball ingredients. Shape mixture into 12 meatballs. Gently flatten into 3/4 inch thick oval patties. Sprinkle the tops with chives. Bake the patties as directed on the package with the cheese.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,cheddar cheese,malt vinegar,dill,rye bread
title: Smolay Dip
ingredients: 3 slices rye bread, cut in half | 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( or more if you want ) | 2 teaspoons malt vinegar | 1/4 cup low-fat cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 teaspoon fresh dill, chopped ( no stems )
instructions: Spread a spoonful of curry paste on each two slices of bread. Place the second piece of bread on top of the paste and spread it with vinegar and cheese in a thin layer. Sprinkle with dill. Place under a hot grill for 1 min or until lightly browned.

title: Easy Boiled Beef on Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1 rump roast | 1 can white mushrooms, sliced | 10 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 12 fresh basil leaves | 1 cup shredded coconut | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 4 leaves fresh basil, torn
instructions: Place roast in crockpot and add mushrooms and egg slices. Cover with plastic wrap and cook on low for 7 - 8 hours.

title: Hard & Crispy Chicken Livers
ingredients: 4 chicken livers | 4 tablespoons herbs, finely chopped | 4 hard & crunchy mustard | 4 eggs, lightly beaten
instructions: Put all ingredients in a medium frying pan and fry on a moderate heat until the chicken livers are cooked, turning them over as they cook. Serve hot.

title: Ginger Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup ginger ( peeled, grated finely ) | 1 can sweet chili paste | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1 pint ice cream
instructions: Combine ginger, chili paste and marjoram in a small pot. Bring to the boil and simmer 5 minutes or until ginger is softened. Sliced ice cream is fine, too. Pour hot mixture into a plastic container and chill until firm.

title: Beet and Chickpea Fritters With Tarragon Gravy
ingredients: 2 medium beets, washed, peeled and finely diced | 2 cups chickpeas, washed, drained and finely cubed | 3/4 cup sweet red peppers, finely diced | 1/2 cup green pepper, finely diced | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed | 1/4 cup port wine | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Combine diced beets, chickpeas and diced sweet peppers and gently toss. Place the coriander seeds and port and toss into the mix. Place the prepared salad spuds into a shallow baking dish and pour over the wine. Sprinkle with dried tarragon. Bake in a preheated oven, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until the beets are tender and the chickpeas are cooked. The cooking time will vary depending on the size of the beet mixture. Remove the beet spuds from the oven and place in a large serving bowl. Taste and season with salt and black pepper if required. Serve in wedges with a sprinkling of fresh parsley.

title: American Bacon Soup
ingredients: 5 slices bacon | 1/2 cup vegetables ( v8 juice, broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, broccoli, or other vegetables )
instructions: Place the bacon on a large microwaveable plate.

title: Lentils With Beet
ingredients: 500 g green lentils | 1 beet | cornflour, to coat
instructions: Wash and pick over the lentils and wash them thoroughly. Cut them into fourths and place them in a pan with enough cold water to cover. Bring to the boil, cover and cook until tender. Drain. Cook the beet in boiling water for 10 - 12 minutes, or until tender and then put into a blender. Blend until the beet has been thoroughly pureed and then transfer it to your serving dish. Heat a little oil in a pan and fry the leek in it, over a moderate heat, until coloured and soft. Add cornflour and stir well. Add lentils and heat gently for 2 - 3 minutes and serve at once. Serve with boiled eggs or potato.

Random Ingredients: ro tel tomato,baking powder,raspberry,mango chutney,wheat spaghetti,sesame seed,green chili pepper
title: Sesame Stuffed Green Chili Peppers(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 green chili peppers | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry | 1 fresh mango chutney ( major greys ) | 3 tablespoons whole wheat spaghetti ( organic, baked ) | 1/2 cup rd seeds from chutney | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup baking powder with 1 tbsp sugar ( splenda )
instructions: Cut top off green chili, and remove the seeds and membrane. Brush each green chile with olive or cooking spray before grilling. Cut the membrane at the stem from the green chile and open up each side gently to collect the juice. Sauce. Place rinds of your choice in a bowl, and squeeze as much juice out of the membrane as possible, creating a pulp. Squeeze the pulp into a medium bowl, and add mango chutney, spaghetti, and rind. Add sugar. Mix. Place stuffed chiles on baking sheet and bake at 400 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes or until chiles are crispy and glazed.

title: Venison Salad
ingredients: 1 lb venison steak | 1 1/4 cups basmati rice, rinsed well with cold water | 2 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs ( to taste ) | 3 heads romaine lettuce
instructions: Score the venison flank on both sides with a small sharp knife or razor blade. Arrange steak on a plate, and lightly sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Wrap rice around steak. Sprinkle with herbs. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or over night. Turn meat over at least once during this time. When ready to cook, line a large baking dish with romaine.

title: Famous Chicken Okra Kebabs (Okra Free)
ingredients: 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 pounds frozen okra, thawed and drained | 1 large chopped onion | 2 cups apple cider | 1 1/2 tablespoons coarse grains of paradise
instructions: Preheat grill for medium hot heat. Place chicken cubes in a bowl, and stir in okra, onion, apple cider, and coarse grains of paradise.

Random Ingredients: crepe,garlic crouton,kalamata olive,sun tomato oil,cumin powder,green onion,chicken stock cube
title: Garlic Swiss Roll-Up
ingredients: 4 pieces crepes | 1/2 cup garlic-flavored croutons | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, cut up | 6 -8 green onions, chopped | 1 chicken stock cube | 1/2 cup kalamata olives | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Wash olives in cold water. Dry them in a clean cloth or paper towel. Drain all excess water from olives and combine with remaining ingredients. Roll crepe up and place on a plate. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Take crepe mixture and roll it into a 16 x12 rolled up jelly roll. Cut roll in half and serve.

title: Simple Microwave Potatoes
ingredients: 6 -8 medium red potatoes | 2 packets brown sugar, with sugar added | 1 tablespoon turmeric
instructions: Microwave your wok on high for 2 mins, stir so it doesn't stick or burst. Add sugar, tumeric & turmeric to the wok & stir fry for a minute or two. The sugar will start to become golden. Turn the stove down to 200c, leave the lid slightly ajar, leave it there for a couple hours. Turn the potatoes once after 1hr of cooking, leave to rest for 10 minutes, then break the potatoes into chunks & sprinkle on the sugar. Eat with a grainy bread, or with your favourite indian meal.

Random Ingredients: english toffee,oil,basil,cream chicken soup,rump steak,garlic butter,brown mustard,cardamom seed
title: Grilled Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 2 medium rump steaks, trimmed of excess fat | 3 tablespoons garlic butter | 2 tablespoons prepared brown mustard | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/2 cup toasted lightly chopped toffee pieces
instructions: Prepare grill. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle steaks with salt. Sear on both sides until the meat is well browned, about 3 minutes per side. Remove from the skillet. Mix garlic butter and mustard into the same skillet. Spread cream soup in the skillet and mix in the cardamom seeds and chopped basil. Return the steak to the skillet and push the toffee into the mixture. Cook until the meat is well browned, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Place sliced meat on a serving plate and top with sauce.

Random Ingredients: salsa,chuck steak,sesame seed oil,yellow bell pepper,beef bouillon cube,orange juice concentrate,cinnamon raisin bread,mayonnaise
title: Salsa Beef Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless chuck steak, trimmed of fat | 1/4 cup canola sesame seed oil | 1 beef bouillon cube | 3/4 cup orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon raisin bread | shredded lettuce ( optional ) | 1 cup salsa | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise
instructions: Coat a 9x13 glass baking dish with cooking spray. Cut steak into 6 equal pieces. Toss with sesame seed oil and beef bouillon cube to coat. Arrange in a single layer in prepared baking dish. Combine orange juice concentrate and cinnamon raisin bread in a small bowl and add to the beef. Cover tightly and marinate for 1 hour in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Remove steak from marinade. Spray a 12 inch non stick skillet with cooking spray and set over medium high heat. Add steak to the skillet in a single layer. Flip when second side of steak is seared and the desired doneness, 5 to 6 minutes total. Transfer steak to a cutting board and let cool slightly. Cut steak into 1/4 slices. Slice remaining 1/4 slices to serve. Spoon lettuce leaves on the side.

title: Spinach and Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 3 packages frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 1/4 ounces vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 kaffir lime leaf ( optional )
instructions: Unroll frozen spinach and squeeze out excess water with fingers. Coat a 2 quart saucepan with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat until lightly browned. Stir in remaining ingredients. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes. Turn off heat. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Fettuccini and Cabbage
ingredients: 2 medium idaho potatoes | 1 head cabbage, cut into bite-sized pieces | 1 pound dry fettuccine | 1 pinch ground nutmeg | 1 tablespoon minced fresh mint ( optional )
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large pot with enough water to cover by 4 inches. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender, about 20 minutes. When the potatoes are done, peel them, and remove the skins. Cut the potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Place them in a large pot with the cabbage and about 1 cup of water. Bring to a boil, and cook until the cabbage is hot, 4 to 5 minutes. While the potatoes are cooking, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta, and cook for about 8 minutes or until the pasta is al dente. Drain the cooked fettuccini, and place in a bowl. Mix in the potatoes, and sprinkle with nutmeg and freshly chopped mint. Serve. This also makes a meal that is great served the next day.

title: Elegant Veal Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 lbs veal bones, picked and left to 2 days in water | 1 tablespoon fresh savory, minced | 2 cups vegetable broth | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1/2 cup orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted
instructions: Heat oil in large heavy saucepan over medium high heat. Add bones and savory. Reduce heat to low. Cover. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until bones are dark mahogany, about 2 hours. Pour broth over bones and skrut and simmer gently, skrutting as needed, about 20 minutes. Strain through large mesh mesh strainer into bowl. Skim foam from top. Return broth to boil. Cover. Simmer gently until meat falls from bone, 2 to 3 hours. Skim foam when returning meat to soup. Discard solids. Skim froth when returning meat to soup. Stir in vinegar and orange juice concentrate. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,port wine,lime juice zest,harissa,flat leaf italian parsley,coconut
title: Grilled Phadites
ingredients: 1 cup freshly grated dry imported coconut | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed lime juice, plus zest | 1 tablespoon harissa ( see note ( tunisian bouquet garni ) | 2 ounces prosciutto, cut into 1-inch dice | 4 teaspoons port wine, or more if needed
instructions: Preheat barbecue or grill pan over medium heat until ready to smoke. Mix coconut, parsley, zest, harissa and 1/4 cup water in a large bowl with a wooden spoon. Season with salt and pepper. Add prosciutto, and toss to coat. Spread coconut mixture onto a grill rack or directly over the coals. Leave 1 1/2 inch of coals on the grill rack. Grill until crispy and lightly golden, turning once, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a platter, drizzle with remaining 1 t. Soy sauce, and sprinkle with lime zest and remaining 1/4 cup water.

Random Ingredients: herb,vegetable broth,curry powder,white pepper,breast half,cottage cheese,creole seasoning,mexican rice
title: Mexican Chicken Soup from Scratch
ingredients: 1 can mexican-style rice | 1 can condensed vegetable broth or ( 10 3/4 ounce ) can v8 vegetable broth, undiluted | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1 teaspoon imitation crab or 1 teaspoon herms, spice | 1 small bag cottage cheese | fresh herb ( oregano, thyme, etc. or whatever you like to use for soup ) | 1 pinch of crushed white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Drain all excess liquid from mexican rice.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,pesto sauce,self raising flour,tart apple,green bell pepper
title: Dutch Apple Bread
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces self-raising flour | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup mixed dried tart apples | 3/4 cup green bell pepper, seeded and diced | 3/4 cup pesto sauce | pesto sauce, to serve
instructions: In bowl combine flour and yeast, stir in apple. Place in 2 greased loaf tins, bake in moderately hot oven for 45 - 50 minutes or until cooked, cool on rack. Serve with pesto.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,jalapeno pepper,ziploc,soymilk,chili,lasagna noodle,cream tartar,cocoa powder
title: Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas ( mini ) | 6 sheets lasagna noodles, sliced crosswise about 12-inch thick | 2 -3 jalapeno peppers | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon light sour cream | 2/3 cup soymilk | 1 teaspoon chili, or more to taste | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Place 3 tortillas on one of the pieces of foil, top with one another and a third of the sliced jalapenos. Fold the sides in half once, then fold the folded ends over the contents and finally remove the foil. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and ingredients. Spread the sesame seeds and cottage cheese in the tortillas on the foil lined pan. Bake for 13 – 15 minutes or until the cheese begins to brown. In a small bowl, stir together the light sour cream with your soy and milk. Blend well and let cool to room temperature. Spread the soy sour cream mixture all over the bottom of the pan. Lay the lasagna in layers, starting and ending with the sauce. Sprinkle with the sesame seeds and chopped green onion if you like. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until hot.

title: Turmeric Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 teaspoon turmeric | 0.5 can creamed coconut milk | 0.5 can coconut milk | 4 grated lemon peel
instructions: Combine turmeric in a small bowl and crush in a pestle. Add the two can of creamed coconut milk and simmer for five minutes. Drain the can of coconut milk and add to the cream of coconut mix. Strain through fine sieve into a bowl. Add lemon peel. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,meat,amaretto,chicken stock powder,sirloin,brown sugar,farfalle pasta
title: Amaretto Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1/3 cup amaretto | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock powder | 1/4 cup light brown sugar | 2 teaspoons chicken stock powder | 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin | 1 cup uncooked farfalle pasta | 3/4 cup italian dressing
instructions: In large pot, combine next 10 ingredients and simmer 1 hour or until beef is cooked through. Meanwhile, cook sirloin in remaining 3/4 cup of dressing over med heat for 3 - 5 minutes or until no longer pink. Add meat mixture and cooked pasta to sauce and cook over med heat 3 - 5 minutes or until pasta is al dente.

Random Ingredients: chambord raspberry liquor,sesame oil,tomato paste,grain rice,chili sauce,black peppercorn,seasoning
title: Chambord Ripe Rice Balls
ingredients: 4 cups cooked long-grain rice | 3/4 cup chambord raspberry liquor | 5 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 3/4 teaspoons maggi seasoning ( with salt, i like my chambord but any will do. this stuff is spicy ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon crushed black peppercorns | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Place mixture in a freezer safe container with lid. If using a blender add 1 2tbs water to blender to blend to a consistency of puree. Shape into about a dozen size balls. Place on baking sheets lined with parchment paper and place in a 400 oven for 20 - 25 minutes. These can be stored in freezer, but are more likely when served straight away as a snack. For a more adult feel free to eat these while still hot.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,spice,grain rice,cream celery soup,pineapple juice,lasagna noodle
title: Yogurt Rice
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 2 cups yogurt | 6 cups cooked long grain rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons advieh mixed spice
instructions: Prepare noodles as directed on package. In 2 qt. Saucepan, combine soup and juice. Bring to boiling over medium to high heat. Stir in rice and advieh. Spoon a portion of noodle mixture into 4 qt. Casserole.

title: Chilled Ginger and Ginger Chutney
ingredients: 50 g fresh gingerroot, peeled and finely grated ( i've used frozen ) | 50 g ghee, melted
instructions: Grind ginger to a fine powder on a fine, clean surface. Stir in ghee and cook over medium heat for 30 seconds. Spread onto a clean surface and allow to cool. Store in an airtight tin for upto 1 month.

title: Mock Beef Pizzas
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans | 4 ounces club soda | poppy seed ( optional ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups pasta ( spaghetti, fettuccini, ravioli ) | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke ( i use no-salt-added )
instructions: Rinse and drain beans. Mix everything together. Place on baking sheet and preheat oven according to instructions on the bag. Bake 20 minutes in 400 degree oven.

title: Roast Beef and Mushroom Parcel With Pesto and Coconut Cream
ingredients: 3 -4 small white mushrooms | 1 -3 tablespoon low-fat pesto ( homemade or bought ) | 400 g leftover good quality roast beef, diced | 1 -2 tablespoon low-fat coconut cream | steak pieces, for stuffing ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 180 deg celsius. Slice open mushrooms and remove the thick green top from the stems, discard. Dice caps. Slice the stems. Dice or dice as required. Spread the pesto in a medium size ovenproof dish. Layer roast beef and mushrooms on this side of pesto. Spread coconut cream over the top evenly. Cover with aluminium foil and bake in oven for 30 - 45 minutes or until the meat is cooked. Uncover, sprinkle over shredded fresh pecorino romano or pecorino romano cheese. Serve with a nice crisp green salad and plenty of warm crusty bread to dip in the dressing. Note, if you do not intend to serve these at room temperature as the coconut cream would be more flavourful to spread as the roast is served, it is better to let them marinate for at least 15 to 30 minutes before serving or they will become very stale. The sauce can be reheated in the microwave. Note, if you do not like to serve these at an angle as suggested in description, you can do this over the direct heat instead of directly on top of the oven.

Random Ingredients: malt drink powder,caster sugar,lamb,kumara,german chocolate cake mix
title: Warm Lamb & Kumara Muffins
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, lean | 400 g kumara, cut into chunks | 300 g german chocolate cake mix | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1 teaspoon malt drink powder
instructions: Cut lamb into 1 inch pieces & place in casserole dish. Add kumara chunks & cover with water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 1 hour. After 1 hour increase heat to high & cook for 1 1/2 hours or until lamb is tender. Stir every so often so it does not stick to base of pan. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 200c. Dissolve chocolate cake mix & sugar in 1/3 cup warm water. Mix & pour into a 20x20cm baking tin, lined with baking paper. Add malt drink & set aside for 3 hours, to allow flavours to develop.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Orange Peel and Date Pieces
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 fresh date, pitted and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 teaspoon dark musaman fish sauce | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Butter an ovenproof skillet or roasting pan, and arrange the beef and date in two layers. Sprinkle with sugar, fish sauce and orange peel. Set pan on a rack over medium heat, and cook beef until a thermometer inserted through the middle registers 130 degrees f. Transfer pan to oven, and cook until the meat thermometer registers 150 degrees f, or until thermometer reads 135 degrees f. Transfer to a cutting board, and slice into pieces to serve.

title: Hararat Ices
ingredients: 1 kg celery ( cut into 3 cm pieces ) | 4 fresh red chili peppers | 4 tablespoons corn oil | 4 tablespoons amaretto ( almond liqueur ) | 1/2 cup coriander leaves
instructions: Heat oil in a large wok. When medium hot add the diced celery and chili peppers. Saute until celery is just beginning to soften at the edges. Add amaretto and mix well. Add coriander and stir. Remove from heat. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine ( if you prefer a more intense sauce ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine ( if you prefer a more intense sauce ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh chipotle chiles | 1/4 cup prepared pasta sauce, of your choice or 1/4 cup homemade pasta sauce of your choice
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate for at least an hour to allow flavors to blend, or until serving. Taste and season if necessary.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,red potato,shrimp,pearl barley,white peppercorn,pot roast
title: Grilled Shrimp Barley and Pot Roasted Corned Hash (Haddie Etoufee)
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs small red potatoes, cut into 1 inch pieces | 3 1/2 lbs very small frozen shrimp | 1 1/2 lbs small frozen white peppercorns | 1 1/2 lbs tiny frozen pearl barley ( quick cooking barley is excellent ) | 2 1/4 - 3 1/2 inches thick ring-style smoked cornish game roast | warm maple syrup ( recipe calls for maple syrup but i found the flavor is subtle )
instructions: Place chicken, shrimps and peas in large dutch oven fitted with a tight fitting lid. Cut the rings on the back of the cornish meat and place inside the pot. Sprinkle on 1 1/2 cups water. Cover tightly and place on high heat, place a plate on top of the pot and bring to a boil, lower the heat to low and simmer for 40 - 45 minutes, checking occasionally to make sure there are no liquid left or adding more salt. The longer you simmer, the more flavorful the potatoes taste. Stir the barley after 40 - 45 minutes and remove the pot from the heat, return pot to the stove top, return to the burner, and remove the foil. Place the brisket in your grill over a medium hot, covered coals, without a heavy lid and let sit for about 10 minutes. Take the brisket out and spread out on a tray lined with foil. Turn out on a chopping board and cut into 1 inch squares. Return the brisket to the tray and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt. Set aside to cool, then store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 month. Grill time does not include overnight cooling. The smoked cornish is cooked the next day and should be warmed up before serving. Serve as is or with maple syrup.

title: Olive Garden Beef Strogonoff
ingredients: 8 ounces rump steak, cut 1/8-inch diagonal slices | 8 ounces ham, cut 1/8-inch diagonal slices
instructions: Arrange meat on foil sprayed cookie sheet. On 1/4 of meat, distribute ingredients. Broil 3 - 4 minutes, turn and broil 30 seconds, then broil 10 minutes for rare, longer if desired.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,chicken meat,tortilla,spring onion,chunky peanut butter,green chilies,strawberry
title: Chunky Peanut Butter Chicken Rollups
ingredients: 3 spring onions | 1 egg | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 can diced green chilies | 2 cups cooked chicken meat, chopped | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 6 tortillas ( burrito size )
instructions: Cut the end from the spring onions and separate them carefully with a scissors. Trim the root end. Slice the stalk on a bias. In a small bowl combine, egg, and creamy peanut butter. Mix well. Add the rest of the ingredients. Take half of the spring onions and pull them apart, leaving about 1/3 of the tops of the onions. Spread a little of the peanut butter mixture on each spring onion to form a roll. Place the spring onions, one at a time, in a microwave safe dish. Microwave for 10 minutes at 600 watts and stir. Turn the heat off and let stand until cool enough to handle. Cut each roll in half lengthwise, and roll. Serve at room temperature. Note, the peanut butter is very soft so use a knife to scrape every tiny bit of peanut butter off of the peel. You may also use a pastry brush to drizzle the peanut butter mixture onto the outside of the spring onions. This will help them stick to each other.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,mace,tomato sauce,green bell pepper,tomato juice,beef chuck,black coffee
title: Lankton Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, trimmed of fat | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup black coffee | 1 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1 tablespoon fresh kaffir lime leaves or 1 dash dried lime leaves | 1/4 cup chopped tomato with juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace ( optional )
instructions: Tear meat into 1 inch pieces. Mix tomato sauce, coffee, bell pepper, lime leaves, and other spices. Heat beef in dutch oven or slow cooker. Top with liquid. Cover and cook on low setting 8 hours or until tender, stirring once. Sprinkle with chopped tomatoes before serving.

Random Ingredients: nicoise olive,nigella seed,white wine vinegar,swiss chard
title: Mexican Chard Salad With Nicoise Olives
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced nicoise olives | 3 stems swiss chard | 1/4 cup of good quality white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons nigella seeds
instructions: Boil the chard in salted water until wilted. Chop and reserve the chard stems. Chop the chard on bias into 1/4 inch slices. Mix the olives, chard, wine vinegar and dill in a large bowl. Toss well. Transfer to a decorative serving dish and let sit 2 hours to develop the flavors and mellow flavors. The salad can be served warm or chilled.

title: Chocolate Pancakes (Lorie Hall's German)
ingredients: 8 tablespoons buttermilk | 8 tablespoons evaporated milk | 1/1 teaspoon vanilla bean, scraped | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon corn oil ( may need up to 2 teaspoons ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( may need up to 3 teaspoons )
instructions: Whisk the ingredients together in a bowl and set aside. Heat the 2 tablespoons of oil in a cast iron skillet or heavy skillet over medium heat. When the oil is hot, add 2 t of the batter to the pan and tilt the pan until the pancake is about 1/2 inch thick. Place a spoonful of the pancake onto the pancake and spread it out in the skillet. Cook for another 3 minutes, or until it is golden, but is still pale. Remove. Repeat until all the batter and the batter is used, reheating the oil as necessary, until all the pancakes have been cooked and cooled.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,sultana,milk powder,green curry paste,vegetable broth,vanilla pudding mix,coriander,jumbo shrimp
title: Green Coconut Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon green curry paste | 1 1/4 cups sultanas | 1 can condensed vegetable broth | 1 package vanilla pudding mix | 1 teaspoon instant malay milk powder | 1/2 cup milk powder | 2 lbs jumbo shrimp, peeled & deveined | 1/2 cup coriander, coarsely chopped
instructions: In large saucepan, combine vegetables & curry paste & simmer for 3 minutes. Add coconut & pudding mixes & stir well. Stir in milk & sweetener to taste. Pour into soup bowls & refrigerate for at least a few hours before serving.

title: Crunchy Teriyaki Rollups
ingredients: 1 cup shredded red cabbage | 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce | 8 slices firm bread ( i use pumpernickel ) | filling
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Mix shredded cabbage and teriyaki sauce. Trim crusts from bread to form 18x12 rectangles. Place 1 slice of bread on each rectangle. Fold in sides and bottom to form a triangle. Fold into thirds and continue folding. Place each triangle on a cookie sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven. Serve with remaining teriyaki sauce to dip. Enjoy.

title: Taco Chips
ingredients: 4 green cardamom pods | 4 tablespoons catsup | 12 packets taco sauce
instructions: Place a cardamon pod in a cup of hot water. Crush the cardamon pods with your fingers until fine. Mix the ground cardamon in a bowl with the catsup and add two packets of taco sauce, mixing well.

title: Manicotti
ingredients: 10 manicotti | 2 cans sliced peaches, drained | 2 cups bread flour, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add manicotti, and cook for 13 to 13 minutes, or until cooked through. Drain, and remove shells. Place shells in a mixing bowl, and stir in 3 cups of peaches and 1/2 cup bread flour until well incorporated. Pour mixture into the hot shells, and place in the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until filling is hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: lamb cutlet,head garlic,white pepper,nonfat beef broth,red chili,carrot,yellow pea
title: Ethiopian Stewed Lamb Cutlets
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lamb cutlet | 1 large head garlic | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 can reduced fat beef broth | 1/2 cup nonfat canned reduced sodium beef broth | 1 medium carrot, chopped | 1/2 medium birdseye chili or 1/2 medium jalapeno, chopped
instructions: Trim fat from lamb and cut into cubes. Chop garlic finely and rub inside of meat with pepper. Combine beef and garlic in a large pot. Add broth and simmer covered about 50 minutes. Skim fat from pot. Add green pepper and chile. Cook uncovered 45 minutes or until meat is fork tender.

title: German Sausage Beer (Beer Bread)
ingredients: 8 ounces smoked pork, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons wheat germ | 1/3 cup flat leaf parsley, thinly sliced ( italian or curly type ) | 32 ounces lager beer | 1 1/4 cups buttermilk | brandy ( optional ) | brandy ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400. Place the sausage ingredients in a 2 quart casserole. Cover and bake, stirring regularly, for 20 to 30 minutes, or until meat cubes are done. Remove from oven. Add the buttermilk.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate,granny smith apple,rump roast,bread crumb,red lentil
title: Red Lentil and Apple Loaf (Greece)
ingredients: 1 pound rump roast, diced | 4 granny smith apples - peeled, cored and diced | 1 1/2 cups red lentils | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | pomona pomegranate, seeds
instructions: Combine the rump, apples, and lentils in a large bowl. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Add the bread crumbs and pomegranate seeds. Mix well and form into an inch thick loaf. Spray a large loaf pan with cooking spray, and place the loaf pan on a rack. Bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes more. Remove the loaf. Let cool and slice.

title: The Perfect Herb & Spice Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried mixed herbs ( any combination of dried herbs such as parsley, oregano, rosemary, and tarragon ) | 8 tablespoons dried herbs ( such as rosemary, thyme, parsley, sage, and chives ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a small bowl combine all of the 3 ingredients and mix well. Store in a dry container for up to 1 week or freeze for up to 6 months. To use, spread on your favourite biscuit or sandwich spread.

title: Peach Soup
ingredients: 6 firm ripe peaches, peeled and coarsely chopped | 4 cups vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger juice
instructions: Place peaches in a blender or food processor.

title: Sweet Raisin Cookies
ingredients: 1 box chocolate cake mix | 1 cup golden raisins | 1 cup amaretto
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a cookie sheet. Prepare cake mix according to package directions, then set aside. Dissolve the amaretto in the amaretto in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,chuck roast,italian parsley,double cream,parsnip,potato,iceberg lettuce
title: Beef and Potato Goulash #5FIX
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast, trimmed of fat and cut into 1 1/2 in. cubes | 1 can diced italian tomatoes, in natural juice | 1 cup double cream, well chilled ( i use fat free ) | 2 large parsnips, peeled and diced | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, snipped | cooked potato, quartered ( optional ) | iceberg lettuce, sliced for garnish
instructions: Place the chuck roast, tomatoes, and cream in a 9 x13 glass baking dish or roasting pan. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Grain off Radishes or Turnips
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped green peppers or 2 cups very finely chopped red bell peppers | 1 cup finely chopped radish | 1/2 cup molasses
instructions: Combine all ingredient and stir well. Cover and store in refrigerator for up to two weeks.

title: French Style Bean Dip (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 3 celery ribs, very finely julienned | 1 can pinto beans ( including liquid ) | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl, mix well, cover with plastic wrap and chill for several hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,flat leaf parsley,rom tomato,corn,egg,gouda cheese,shiitake mushroom,green cardamom pod
title: Gouda and Vegetable Frittata
ingredients: 6 ounces shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 3 green cardamom pods, split | 12 medium roma tomatoes | 4 ounces cauliflower florets | 4 tablespoons corn or 4 tablespoons gouda cheese, grated | 2 -3 tablespoons eggs, lightly beaten | crusty potato and green chinese flat leaf parsley salad ( optional )
instructions: In a large frying pan, add the mushrooms and parsley. Cook over a medium high heat for 2 minutes. Stir in the cardamom pods and tomatoes. Lower the heat and cook for 7 minutes. Add the cauliflower and cover the pan. Simmer for 8 minutes, until the cauliflower is cooked. Turn off the flame. Sprinkle in the grated cheese. Mix the eggs and a pinch of salt. Dip half of each ramekin in the egg mixture. Heat a griddle pan or a broiler. Spray the griddle pan or broiler with nonstick cooking spray. Cook two ramekins on the griddle. Keep the griddle covered, so any extra water from the egg mixture may run off. When the bottom ramekin is set, turn the frittata over, and slide it back into the grill for 30 to 40 seconds and the top ramekin is set with some of the egg mixture covering it in a spiral shape. Spread on some more egg mixture. Sprinkle with a little more cheese followed by more cheese. Repeat two or three times until all the egg mixture and cheese has been added. Top with the remaining ramekin and scatter with the flat leaves or chinese flat leaf parsley.

title: Chinese Melon Balls - Cantaloupe Filling
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cantaloupe | 1 tablespoon dark chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice
instructions: Wash melon, remove pulp and seeds by running your fingers and gently pulling them apart. If the melon still has flesh on it, peel off skin and remove all excess moisture. With damp hands, scoop out the inner seeds using your thumb and use them to replace the pulp in your melon balls. Place melon balls in a dry baking tin and toss with the dark chinese five spice powder and orange juice. The easiest way to do this is to roll in a handful and roll it up like a cigar. Place in the refrigerator for about one hour to an hour. This is the easiest way to do this. Enjoy.

title: Coriander and Pecan Sago
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons coriander, chopped | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped
instructions: Place flour in a bowl. Add coriander and mix together. Add pecans and mix together again. Divide floured pastry into 6 equal portions. Roll each portion into a ball, then flatten each ball to a round. Repeat with remaining pastry and filling. Place on lightly greased baking tray. Brush tops with water. Bake in a hot oven for 15 - 20 mins or until golden. Makes 8 equal sized cakes.

title: Chinese Five Spice Bread
ingredients: 1 package fresh yeast | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 3 cups bread flour
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 10 cups of hot water. After 1 minute, add 5 spice powder, then rest of the flour. Mix well, then let rest 15 to 20 minutes. Form into 1 - 1 pound loaf. Cover with plastic wrap. Let rise until doubled. Slice, then place on greased baking sheet. Let rise again until double. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Bake 10 to 15 minutes. Then turn oven up to 425 degrees f, bake 30 to 35 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before slicing.

title: Chile Con Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 can chiles, pureed | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 -2 tablespoon seasoning ( your favorite, i use old el paso ) | 3 rosemary or 1 -2 sprigs fresh thyme, for garnish ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Heat up a saucepan and add the chiles, cumin, and seasoning. Simmer for 5 - 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Place the fresh rosemary/thyme sprigs or thyme in small dish, top with some of the cheese and place in microwave for 20 - 25 seconds or until cheese is melted. Serve on breaded, italian bread slices. Garnish with some chopped red onion.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,raspberry,baking powder,chocolate,habanero pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Raspberry-chocolate Roasted Raspberry Cheese Filling
ingredients: 2 lbs firm-ripe semisweet chocolate ( we buy a 16 ounce package at the grocery store that consists of about 6 oz. ) | 13 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup sour cream ( we like low fat, low fat and fat free ) | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 large habanero pepper, roasted ( in a jar packed in oil ) | 2 cups fresh raspberries
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish line with parchment paper. Break the chocolate into pieces and set aside. In a large bowl, whisk the soup, sour cream, baking powder, and hot peppers. Mix in the chocolate, sour cream mixture, and the raspberries. Using a pastry brush, smooth and lightly flour the entire surface of the prepared baking dish. Pour into the prepared pan and bake 20 to 22 minutes or until the top is just starting to crisp up.

title: Easy Cheesecake Squares
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Press wonton wrappers into the bottom of an 8x8 inch pan. Mix graham cracker crumbs and melted butter, and spread crumb mixture evenly over the wonton wrappers. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Cool completely and cut into squares.

title: Pasta with Peas, Peppers, and Hot Sauce
ingredients: 3 quarts drained canned chick-peas | 1 cup chopped pepperoncini peppers | 4 dried chipotle chiles | 2 1/2 tablespoons diced fresh ginger root | 3/4 cup pasta
instructions: Combine the chickpeas and next 3 ingredients in a blender or food processor. Pulse, pulsing often, until chunky. Transfer the mixture to a stock pot and bring to a boil over medium heat. Add the pasta and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cooking onion,bacon,beef steak,beef shank,egg,tomato sauce,white onion
title: Beef Pies
ingredients: 5 slices bacon | 1/2 cup of chopped tomato with basil | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1/4 cup chopped white onion | 1/3 cup minced cooked beef shank | 1 egg, well beaten | 1 beef flank steak, sliced
instructions: Fry bacon and set aside. Fry onions and shallions until dark brown in bacon fat. Stir fry beef and add to onions and shallions. Add tomato sauce and cook 2 minute add egg. Cook 2 minute. Put mixture in 4 ramekins. Top with bacon and bake at 350f for 45 minute.

title: Salsa Dip
ingredients: 2 cups chunky salsa | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 raisins | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles, chopped
instructions: Mix salsa, bell pepper, raisins and chilies together in a bowl.

title: Scallops with Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 12 large sea scallops | 4 slices fresh canadian bacon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Remove the thick strips of bacon from the Canadian bacon. Place the bacon on the top of a baking sheet. Place the scallops on top of the bacon.
