Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, then turn over, and bake for 25 minutes. The scallops should be opaque throughout and lightly browned. Serve straight from the oven, with crusty bread on the side.

Random Ingredients: jam,table salt,lettuce leaf,elbow macaroni,kosher salt,lime juice zest
title: Macaroni With Jelly & Salt
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon table salt, plus more for soaking the salad greens | 5 cups elbow macaroni, cooked & rinsed ( such as macaroni, dreamfields'or other small shells ) | 2 -3 teaspoons lime juice, zest of, fresh | 10 -12 large lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup grated smoked kerry irish farmhouse cheese or 1/2 cup emmenthaler cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f line the large rimmed sheet pan with oiled foil. Add the macaroni and a little salt on the plastic covered tray. Using your fingers, press firmly and evenly the salt, making sure the salt is completely submerged in the cheese. Place the tray on kitchen towels to dry the pasta and help it dry. Squeeze out the excess moisture if the pasta begins to stick to the pan. Add the lime zest to the drained pasta and toss it together using your hands to distribute throughout the pasta with the zest, then season to taste with salt. Spread the pasta into the prepared pan, then top with the lettuce leaves and smoked kerry irish farmhouse cheese. Bake until the cheese is toasted, about 20 to 25 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes in the pan before slicing and serving.

Random Ingredients: almond,parmesan cheese,sun tomato,tomatillo,turmeric,virgin olive oil,romano cheese,caster sugar
title: Tomatillo, Turmeric, Sun-Dried Tomato Dessert
ingredients: 16 romaano cheese or 16 any good quality cheeses | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato ( soaked in a little sun-dried tomatoes for 30 minutes and drained. ) | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 6 medium tomatoes, sliced | 8 medium tomatillos, halved lengthways, stalks removed | freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: In a small pot boil the tomatillos for approx 40 mins, until they are softened.

title: Grilled Lime Zest and Lime Sparklers
ingredients: 2 large limes, zest of, about 1 lb. ( red or orange ) | 2 cups sherry wine
instructions: Trim zest from fruit of limes by trimming away rind and removing peel. Cut lime slices lengthwise into 1/8 inch wide ribbons. Coat wok or large skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Add zest and saute about 1 minute. Pour sherry over zest. Bring to a boil, lower heat.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,dill sprig,snow pea,raisin,farfalle pasta,sausage,sun tomato oil
title: Sausage and Noodle Pasta With Raisins
ingredients: 3 ounces boneless turkey sausage, sliced into 1 inch pieces | 1 package farfalle pasta | 1/4 cup sun dried tomato packed in oil, cut into strips | 1/3 cup raisins | 1/4 cup dry rice wine or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 fresh dill sprigs | 10 -12 fresh snow peas
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Meanwhile, cook sausage by removing casing from sausage. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add sausage, saute until heated through, about 4 - 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water. Add to skillet with sausage, raisins, oil and sun dried tomatoes. Remove pan from heat, sprinkle with raisins and dill and toss. Serve warm.

title: Cheater's Panko Semolina Balls (Passover)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 1 tablespoon ground gingerroot | 3 tablespoons tequila | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1 jar semolina, soaked in water
instructions: Mix the panko, parsley, herbes de provence, ground ginger and tequila in a bowl. Form into 8 balls using 1 1/4 cup per ball. Roll the balls in the soaked and drained semolina.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,jumbo shrimp,scotch bonnet pepper,key lime juice
title: Tiny Red Curry Shrimp
ingredients: 16 jumbo shrimp, raw and shelled | 1 scotch bonnet peppers ( or any other hot pepper you like, remove the seeds ) | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 3 -4 key limes, juice of ( fresh if possible )
instructions: Put shrimp in pan with a small knob of scotch bonnet or chilli or chilli. Pour juice of the lime in and bring to boil. Turn down to simmer and put in fridge to marinate for at least an hour. After marinating, pre heat oven. Put flour and key lime in a deep dish and mix the lime juice in with the flour. Turn up temp a bit and mix well. Put in oven. If oven is not getting hot enough you can place shrimp in pan with a knob of scotch bonnet or chilli or chilli powder if you like. Bake for about 15 minutes or according to preference. Let cool slightly. Place in fridge to firm. Will last at least a week or so in refrigerator.

title: Indian Sambol Dogs
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon dry red chili powder | 4 teaspoons coarse sea salt ( to taste )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in small bowl until evenly incorporated. Spread into bag and refrigerate at least for 1 to 2 hours for best flavor.

title: Nate's Ultimate Maggie Beer's Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb mushroom, halved | 6 tablespoons lime peel, grated | 6 tablespoons coconut, shredded | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon mixed spice, for the kick
instructions: Soak mushrooms for an hour or two. Squeeze the mushrooms with your hands all over and dry completely in a kitchen towel. Drain all excess water from the mushroom. Put mushrooms in a bowl and add remaining ingredients except for cream of tartar and spice. Stir to mix, then chill for at least an hour before serving.

title: Czech Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 cup sugar syrup | 1 cup irish beer ( use a light beer ) | 1 teaspoon marjoram, freshly dried | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, freshly ground | 1/4 teaspoon accent seasoning | 4 thick slices bread, crusts removed
instructions: In a saucepan, heat sugar syrup and beer until sugar is dissolved, about 5 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients, except bread, in a shallow dish. Dip bread slices into mixture.

title: Garbanzos in Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb dried garbanzo beans | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup mushroom soup | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: In a dutch oven, mix all ingredients. Cover. Cover. Simmer for 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Haters Grill
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated buttermilk biscuits ( 8 biscuit size ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh ginger | 1 pizza crusts | 1/4 cup buttermilk
instructions: Mix biscuits with ground ginger in small bowl and divide dough in half. Roll each half onto lightly floured board. Using lightly floured fingers roll each half into a circle 3 inches in diameter, about 1 1/4 inches thick. Place a circle on your counter and stretch the dough around the circle to 9 inches in diameter with your hands. Repeat with remaining circles until the dough has finished rolling.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,dashi stock,brown rice,sharp cheddar cheese,yogurt,taro root,dill sprig
title: Steamed Taro Root & Cheese Stix - Japanese Style Mashed Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups uncooked brown rice ( or white pearl barley ) | 8 cups dashi stock | 1 ounce taro root, skin ( or you can substitute any firm bitter root ) | 10 fresh thyme sprigs, leaves only | 3 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | sour cream ( to garnish ) ( optional ) or plain yogurt ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Steam your rice until it is cooked but still wet. Rinse the rice under cold water and drain it well in a strainer. Return to the steamer and bring the stock to the boil. Mash the rice using a potato masher or a wooden spoon. Add the taro root and about 5 of the thyme leaves to the rice and return to the boil. Cover and allow to simmer for about 15 minutes. When done, remove the pan from the heat and let sit for about five minutes to steam the rest of the broth. Meanwhile, remove the taro root in the stem. Slice off the root but save the root for another use. Slice into rounds about 1/2 thick and place in a bowl. Add the cheese and a dollop of sour cream.

title: Fish Simmered in Biscuits
ingredients: 16 ounces salmon fillets | 8 ounces biscuits, bob's red mill mill mill | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup or 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup
instructions: Coat a cookie sheet with non stick spray. Place the biscuits in a plastic bag with high sides. Flip the tray around after 5 minutes. Remove the bag from the oven. Dip the fish fillets in the light corn syrup. Remove the fish from the baking sheet. Place the fillets on the baking sheet, cover with plastic wrap, then plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 20 minutes, or up to 24 hours, turning once. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray the baking sheet with oil. Place fish fillets on the baking sheet, and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Remove the fish from the oven and drain off any excess oil. Spray fish with a light corn syrup. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,saffron,filet beef,white peppercorn,saffron thread,celery rib,margarine,head lettuce
title: Persian Garlic Dill Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups saffron threads ( turkish ) | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter, melted | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 tablespoon celery rib, chopped | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns | 8 slices lean filet of beef | 8 small head lettuce | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Tie saffron threads with kitchen string at 2 inch intervals. Using a spice grinder, coarsely grind saffron into a fine powder. In a large heavy skillet, melt margarine, add saffron and cook over high heat for 5 minutes.

title: Australian Pepper Bread
ingredients: 12 slices rye bread | 12 tablespoons golden syrup ( to taste ) | pepper
instructions: Heat the broiler. Remove the bread slices from the bread tin, place on a baking tray. Brush the bread with the golden syrup and then place on top of the sliced peppers. Place under the hot broiler for about 5 minutes until the tops become golden brown.

title: Creamy Parsnips and Onions
ingredients: 600 g parsnips, peeled & cut into 2cm slices | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 300 ml single cream
instructions: Put the parboiled onions in a pan and pour boiling water over the onion. Simmer until softened, about 10 minutes.

title: Ancho Chile Blanco
ingredients: 2 cans whole green chilies, drained | 1/4 cup ancho chile powder | 2 tablespoons cognac, or more as needed
instructions: Stir green chilies, ancho chile powder, and cognac together in a bowl.

title: Jalapenos (Cooked Molasses)
ingredients: 1 cup molasses | 6 dried jalapenos, chopped, or more to taste
instructions: To make molasses, mix 1 cup molasses, 6 jalapenos, and 1 1/2 cups water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. When molasses is warm, remove from heat and let stand 15 minutes. Strain, skim, or strain through cheese cloth or cheesecloth. Place in refrigerator until cool, about 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,kosher salt black pepper,heavy whipping cream,topping,monterey jack cheese
title: Spicy Cream Sauce in Pastry
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream ( can sub regular or low fat ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt and black pepper, divided | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar
instructions: In blender or food processor, combine sour cream, whipping cream, salt and pepper. Cover and blend until ingredients are well blended, about 30 seconds. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside. On ungreased rimmed baking sheet, spread 1/2 cup of cheese spread evenly. Arrange 1/2 cup of the cream sauce evenly over cheese. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake at 425 until top is golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes. Let stand 2 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,black olive,self raising flour,safflower oil,pesto sauce,breadcrumb,apricot preserve,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Cheese and Olive Frizzled Mini Muffins
ingredients: 7 ounces small shell pasta ( mini muffins ) | 1 tablespoon safflower oil | 1/2 cup self-raising flour | 2 1/4 ounces breadcrumbs | 6 ounces prawns ( shrimp or other meat ) | 3 1/4 ounces sliced black olives | 3 1/4 ounces apricot preserves | 2 1/4 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shaved
instructions: Use a large oven proof serving plate. Place the muffins on top of the plate. Heat the oil in a frying pan and stir in the flour a little at a time until combined and lump free. Mix the breadcrumbs with half the prawns and olives. Sprinkle over the walnuts and breadcrumb mix and stir to combine. Carefully add the tomato and preserves. Grate a little over the top to give the frizzled frizzled frizzled frizzled frizzled frizzled tomatoes some texture, but not over filling them. Bake at 200°c for 12 - 15 minutes until the frizzled frizzled frizzled frizzled tomatoes are golden golden in colour and the frizzled frizzled tomatoes are tender. Serve hot.

title: Crunchy Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 2 sheets phyllo pastry ( thawed & patted dry ) | 3/4 cup crouton ( about 1.5 oz ) | 1 small chicken breast ( cooked & shredded ) or 1 small cooked thigh ( cooked & shredded ) | 1 stalk celery leaves ( finely chopped ) | 1/4 teaspoon arrowroot
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f. Spray a non stick frying pan w/ pam cooking spray & set over a medium heat.

title: Homemade Oriental Seasoning
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons dry mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons dry minced onion | 2 teaspoons lime
instructions: Combine dry onion soup mix, dry mustard seeds, minced onion, and lime juice in a covered container and store at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,liquid honey,white wine vinegar,celeriac,asafoetida powder,beef,chow mein noodle,sake
title: Shank and Dried Beef Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons good quality italian parsley, chopped | 4 tablespoons chow mein noodles ( dry ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 400 g lean beef or 400 g pork, finely diced | 1/2 teaspoon dried celeriac, finely diced ( celery root, or celery root if using )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, except the beef/pork. Add the beef/pork and mix well. Cover with cling wrap and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: water,chili oil,ice water,pearl barley,irish cream,tomato sauce
title: Shake and Tell Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1/4 - 1/2 cup warm water | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/4 cup ice water | 2 -3 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Place pearl barley in bowl and cover with warm water. Let stand 15 - 20 minutes. Place tomato sauce, and 1/4 cup water in medium pot. Slowly add chili oil to help thicken soup as necessary. Drain barley and add to soup. Toss together well until mixed and lightly coated. Slowly add ice water. Stir. Let stand 5 minutes. Ladle into soup bowls. Garnish with irish cream.

title: Beet Soup
ingredients: 1 lb beet, small | 1/4 lb cellophane noodle | 1 egg yolk | 1/4 cup flour | beet, slices | pickled mustard seeds
instructions: Wash and slice beets very thin. Place in large saucepan and add water. Boil for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Melt yolk in bowl. Gradually add to beet broth, stirring constantly. Boil for 15 minutes and ladle soup into soup plates. Place beet slices on top and sprinkle with pickled mustard seeds.

title: Spicy Corn
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can whole red chilies, drained, seeded
instructions: Preheat over to 400 degrees f. Stir corn, chilies, and salt together in a large bowl. Transfer bowl of sauce to a microwave safe bowl, discarding the corn skins. Cover bowl with a lid. Microwave on high power for 1 to 2 minutes. If too hot, corn may stick to lid of bowl. Let stand for a few minutes, then fluff with a fork.

Random Ingredients: saltine cracker,cherry,italian seasoning,coconut milk,ice,baby bok choy,barbeque sauce,honey
title: Baby Bok Choy 'n' Spicy Crab Stacks
ingredients: 1 cup cubed peeled baby bok choy | 1/4 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1 teaspoon honey | 1/4 cup barbeque sauce | 1 tablespoon italian-style seasoning | 1 cup crackers | coarse saltines ( optional ) | ice ( optional )
instructions: Toss baby bok choy, coconut milk, honey, barbeque sauce, and italian style seasoning together in a large bowl with some salt and optional salt. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for up to 3 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Discard seasoning packet from the chilled bowl. Brush the crackers with coconut milk and sprinkle with coarse salt, if desired. Place 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons of the prepared crab mixture on each cracker and serve immediately, passing cold soda water as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,dill weed,double cream,cannellini bean,broth,basil,golden syrup
title: Pan Bagna with Dried Beans
ingredients: 350 g dried cannellini beans | 1 cup cranberry mixed beans or 1 cup mixed dried beans | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups canned low-sodium broth | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill weed | 1/4 cup apricot preserves
instructions: Soak the beans in the hot water, covered, overnight. Drain and put them in a large nonreactive saucepan, add the cranberry mixes and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer slowly, uncovered, for about an hour. Add the chicken stock or broth, golden syrup, basil, dill and preserves to the beans and simmer until the beans are slightly tender, about 15 minutes more. Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and serve hot.

title: Coriander-Scented Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh coriander powder | 1 teaspoon finely chopped onion | 1 tablespoon grated palm sugar | 1/2 cup finely chopped cremini mushroom | 1 teaspoon finely chopped parsley | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: In a bowl mix the chopped coriander, grated palm sugar, chopped cremini mushrooms and chopped parsley. If desired, use a microplane grater to grind it into a very fine powder. Once you have mixed all the ingredients well in the bowl, store in a glass container for upto ½ months.

Random Ingredients: black bean,taco sauce,baking powder,worcestershire sauce,bean sprout
title: Way Worth Making Refried Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 cup bean sprouts | 1 cup taco sauce | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 cup taco sauce, for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Wash beans and snap the ends off. Place the sprouts on a baking sheet and spread out in a single layer. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, shaking the sheet halfway through baking. When almost done, stir in the taco sauce and spread out over the top of the sprouts. Bake 10 to 15 more minutes, or until heated through. Allow sprouts to cool for about 5 minutes, then cut into squares and serve.

title: Thai-Rice Chicken Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup finely shredded chicken | 1 cup finely shredded bok choy | 1 cup finely chopped basil | 1/4 cup finely chopped nutmeg, divided | 2 whole wheat tortillas | 2 tablespoons shredded cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl, mix chicken, bok choy, basil and 3/4 of the nutmeg. Sprinkle with remaining nutmeg. Lay tortillas on a work surface. Evenly distribute chicken mixture and cheese along tortillas. Roll up tortilla, jellyroll fashion so the filling runs over all. Wrap burritos in foil and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: black cumin seed,chunky salsa,lemon,veal,thyme sprig,beef tenderloin,baby carrot
title: Carve-Stuffed Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprig | 2 teaspoons black cumin seeds | 3 -4 lbs beef tenderloin | 3 cups baby carrots | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 lb thin cut bacon, cooked and crumbled
instructions: Mix the salsa, thyme, cumin, and black pepper in a bowl. Place the tenderloin in a flat dish, and pour salsa mixture over it. Let stand 30 minutes, turning once. Preheat oven to 400°f. Place the brined carrots in a shallow baking dish. Cover with foil. Bake 35 - 40 minutes, until meat thermometer registers 125°f. Drain off liquid. Remove the meat from the foil, and set on a serving platter. Cover tightly with foil and keep warm. Remove from oven. Place the lemon juice in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, and boil for 2 - 3 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes. Stir in the bacon, let stand for 5 minutes then pour over the meat. Serve with salsa.

title: Spinach & Bean Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces dried apricots ( sliced ) | 3 ounces bamboo shoots | 2 tablespoons potato starch | 1 chicken stock cube | 6 ounces fresh spinach
instructions: Blanch the mushrooms in boiling water for 20 minutes, drain and reserve juices. Blanch the bamboo shoots in boiling water for 30 seconds, drain and set aside. Put the reserved juices into a pan and add the potato starch and saute over medium heat, stirring, for 3 minutes. Add the stock cube and apricots. Heat for 2 minutes and simmer for 5 minutes. Add the drained mushrooms, spinach and bamboo shoots to the soup. Season if necessary and serve.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,crisco,mussel,butter bean,basil,black sesame seed,basmati rice,mint
title: Jorge's Rice and Beans
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 5 large mussels | 2 tablespoons butterbeans, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 2 tablespoons chopped jalapeno peppers | 2 tablespoons minced fresh mint | 1 tablespoon cracked black sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon crisco ( for frying )
instructions: In a large pot, bring 1 inch of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add the rice and cook until just tender, stirring once, about 3 minutes. Scrub the mussels, but do not remove the beards. Remove the beards from the shells and coarsely chop the meat. In a heavy 3 - 4 quart pan, melt the butter over high heat. Add the mussels, basil, jalapenos and mint. Saute until they open just on the top edge and discard those that do not open. Add the cooked rice and stir for 1 minute or until most of the liquid has been absorbed. Spoon the mussels and vegetables into a serving bowl, leaving a little bit of the broth. Mash the rest of the broth with the sesame seeds and crisco. Pour the gravy over the dish and serve.

title: Cousin Pete's " Born Again" Tomato and Cornstarch
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs canned whole canned stewed tomatoes | 1 1/2 lbs cornstarch
instructions: In crock pot, mix tomatoes with 3 cups water and cornstarch. Cook on high 1 - 2 hours. Note, after 1 hour cook on high again for an additional 30 minutes. Serve over couscous or rice. Also you can drizzle the tomato mixture over the top.

title: Japanese Style Sushi Rice Noodles
ingredients: 3 boxes yellow cake mix | 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 tablespoon unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 package rice noodles
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare yellow cake mix according to package directions. Lightly grease a 13x9 inch baking dish. Mix cake mix and flour in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Blend at low speed until well blended. Stir in rice noodles until well coated with batter. Transfer dough to prepared baking dish. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until golden brown. Cool for about 5 minutes, cut into squares and serve at room temperature.

title: Chickpeas and Crushed Corn Chips
ingredients: 12 corn flakes | 1 can chickpeas ( garbanzo beans ), drained and rinsed ( about 1 cup total ) | 4 shallots, thinly sliced ( about 2 cups ) | hot sauce | chickpea ( garbanzo beans ), to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place about 1 cup hot tap water on a rimmed baking sheet. Place corn flakes on top and press lightly so they stick to the sheet. Bake corn flakes in the preheated oven until lightly browned on all sides, 10 to 15 minutes. While corn flakes bake, arrange 1/2 cup chickpeas in a single layer in a 2 quart baking dish. Top chickpeas with 1/2 cup chickpeas and sprinkle with shallots.

title: Sue's Smothered Swiss Steak and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 pound beef eye round, trimmed and cut into 1-inch squares | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1 can mushrooms, drained and sliced
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a large rimmed baking dish with cooking spray. Place the beef in the dish, and cover with sauerkraut and tomatoes with their juices. Top with mushrooms, and season with salt and pepper if desired. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until the center of the beef is no longer pink, and the sauce is bubbling hot.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,fine bread crumb,lemon juice zest,raisin,rosemary,oregano leaf,apple
title: Apple and Onion Gratin
ingredients: 1 large apple, cored and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 cups fine dry bread crumbs | lemon juice and zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 deg f/180 deg celsius. Grease a large baking dish. In a large bowl, combine apple, raisins, oregano, rosemary, coriander powder and bread crumbs. With a fork, toss to coat evenly with crumbs. Press apple mixture firmly into the baking dish. Place in oven, bake in oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with lemon rind. Allow to cool and set before serving.

Random Ingredients: butter,garlic powder,deli roast beef,jumbo shrimp,yellow squash,cannellini bean,shell pasta,plum tomato
title: Shrimp and White Bean Skillet
ingredients: 1 pound uncooked shell pasta | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 pound jumbo shrimp - peeled and deveined | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 can plum tomatoes | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 cup minced yellow squash | 1/4 pound cooked deli roast beef, diced
instructions: Prepare pasta by cooking in a large skillet or dutch oven until al dente. Drain and set aside. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook shrimp until pink, and remove from heat, and set aside. While pasta is cooking, place canned cannellini beans in a pot and cover with hot water. Boil bean mixture 3 minutes and remove from heat. When pasta and shrimp are cooked, drain and set aside. Saute squash in the remaining butter, then add the shrimp, cannellini beans and tomatoes with garlic powder and heat. Mix well, and cook about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and mix in the cooked pasta and roast beef. Stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: black bean,yellow pepper,chicken bouillon cube,wheat flour,curry paste,orange,blackberry
title: Baked Black Beans With Peach and Orange Blossom Peppers
ingredients: 1 can black beans and peas ( undrained ) | 1 cup dried blackberries | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 orange, sliced into thin wedges | 1 tablespoon mild-tasting curry paste | 1/2 cup yellow pepper, cut into squares
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Open black beans and peas, leaving a little bit of the juice in the can. Place black beans and peas in a shallow dish. Stir remaining ingredients and spread evenly over beans. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Korean Zucchini Appetizers
ingredients: 1 cup zucchini, shredded | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh ginger
instructions: Combine the zucchini, chili sauce and ginger in a bowl. Place in the refrigerator until it is firm. Form the zucchini mixture into balls about the size of an egg and thread on to a skewer. Barbecue the zucchini until lightly browned and crisp, about 6 to 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white pearl onion,nonfat milk,bean sprout,peanut,english cucumber,pistachio,meat
title: Korean Inspired Vegetarian Pancake (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 -3 white pearl onions ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 1/2 english cucumber ( or more, thinly sliced ) | 1/2 cup frozen mixed bean sprouts | 1/2/2 cup dried unsalted pistachio | 4 ounces minced meat | 1/4 - 1/2 cup nonfat milk ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons chopped unsalted dry roasted peanuts ( for topping ) ( optional )
instructions: Place about a cup of water over high heat in a skillet or griddle. When it comes to a boil, scoop a cup of the water and add the onions, cucumber, bean sprouts and pistachios. Boil for 3 - 5 minutes, or until the onions are translucent. Add the meat, and add enough milk to cover the meat. When it's just about right, stir and remove the pan from the heat. When the pancake is cooked, transfer it on a plate to make a nice platter and top with the leftover nuts.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,tuna water,cayenne,turmeric powder,cake flour,sea salt,lemon zest
title: Chilled Tuna Toscano (Smoked Tuna Fritters)
ingredients: 2 lbs solid italian plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 ounce fresh lemon zest | 1 cup sea salt | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon tuna in water
instructions: In a bowl, mash the tomatoes with a potato masher until they are all crushed apart. Sift flour, salt, cayenne, turmeric powder, and lemon zest using a mortar and pestle. Stir into tomatoes. Add tuna and water and work into a smooth paste. Wrap into a sheet of aluminium foil and refrigerate for an hour or two. Remove from refrigerator and divide mixture among small balls the size of the tuna fritters. Roll balls in flour and set the fritters in the foil while you do so. Allow to sit for 10 minutes, then turn over and put another piece of foil on the fritters so they don't burn when they are done. Store in an airtight container.

title: Blueberry Sausage and Peas
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 lb fresh pink pea or 1 lb frozen sweet pea | boiling water
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degree f. Place sausage on a cooking sheet and cook 3 - 5 minutes per side, or until thoroughly cooked.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,beef tenderloin,red curry paste,red chili pepper flake,almond extract,maraschino cherry
title: Spicy Beef Medallions
ingredients: 7 -12 ounces beef tenderloin | 1 jar maraschino cherries | 1 jar roasted red peppers | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Trim beef tenderloines of visible, fat. Place beef in a freezer bag. In a bowl, toss the red peppers with curry paste and almond extract. Place the meat in the refrigerator. Remove beef from the refrigerator about 15 minutes before cooking. Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place beef in a baking dish. Bake meat for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until internal temperature reaches 135 degrees, brushing with a mixture of remaining curry paste and almond extract 1 to 2 minutes. Slice into strips, serve with cherry sauce, or drizzle with pan drippings.

title: Gorgonzola and Kidney Beans
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans | 1/3 lb gorgonzola
instructions: Drain most but not all the liquid. Put in a pot and add enough water to cover the beans and bring to boil. Lower heat and let sit for 10 minutes. Taste and adjust beans and bring to boil again. Lower heat and let beans simmer over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until desired thickness. Add the gorgonzola and stir to combine and serve. Note, this freezes well in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,poppy seed,chicken broth,leg lamb,spring onion,beef bouillon cube,lemon extract
title: Lamb Leg Roast
ingredients: 2 lbs leg of lamb | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 bunch spring onion | 2 ounces canadian bacon, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Cut slits in lamb and insert lamb. Season with lemon extract. Place lamb on rack in roasting pan. Bake lamb at 375 degrees for 1 hour. Turn lamb over. Roast for an hour longer or until internal temp reaches 140 degrees. Cool and slice. Slice and serve with onion and bacon. A salad will be coming to a boil for my family.

title: Tiki's Italian Breaded Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried beans | 2 1/2 lbs of small frozen peas, defrosted | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/4 cup grenadine
instructions: Boil two quarts of water and add the beans and frozen peas. Boil for approximately 20 minutes. Drain peas. Combine bread crumbs and teriyaki sauce in a shallow dish, place frozen peas in and stir. Drain beans and peas, and place in a large pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 5 - 10 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Serve with salad.

title: Mellow Romaine Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, rinsed, dried and chopped | 12 teaspoons white wine ( sauvignon blanco is good )
instructions: In small bowl, combine romaine lettuce and white wine, toss gently. Top with gruyere cheese to taste.

title: Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 2 pints fresh raspberries, sliced from the can | 3 cups frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 can of low fat chicken broth ( or your favorite variety )
instructions: Place raspberries in a large saucepan. Top with broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Let cool slightly or refrigerate overnight to let flavors meld. Serve with your favorite fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,coconut,fenugreek,red chilies,pecan,yogurt,brown onion,heavy whipping cream
title: Panch Phoron
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried red chilies ( roughly 2 - 3 ) | 1/4 cup toasted chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek | 1 medium brown onion, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons ground turmeric powder | 1/4 cup dried coconut, shredded | 1/2 cup yogurt | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Grind first 4 ingredients to a coarse paste, then process to a fine powder. Transfer to a small bowl or baking pan and add onion. Season with turmeric and blend well. Cover and chill until ready to use. Heat oven to 400°f butter baking dish or line with parchment paper. Stir coconut into yogourt, then stir in cream. Pour yogurt mixture into baking dish or mould. Cool to room temperature, then chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,chocolate chip,italian seasoning,grand marnier,blue cheese
title: Double Chip Buffalo Wing Dip
ingredients: 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate chips | 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo | 2/3 cup grand marnier | italian seasoning, mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. In an 8 pan, coat the bottom and sides of an 8x8 baking dish with a small amount of peanut butter. Add all of the remaining ingredients. The mixture will not float, so don’t worry, stir it up and pour it in on top, or else, it won’t spread evenly.

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 package taco seasoning mix | 1 cup prepared broth
instructions: In a medium baking dish, mix together the taco seasoning mix and broth. Sprinkle on top of the taco seasoning mix. Pour over the pizza sauce in your baking dish. Cook at 375 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes, or until the sauce bubbles and the toppings are slightly browned.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,plain flour,capsicum,hazelnut liqueur,walnut half,rice wine vinegar,salsa verde,green olive
title: Roast Capsicum and Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb dried rice vermicelli | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 green olives, halved | 4 ounces barbecued capers, chopped | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons hot salsa verde | 1 tablespoon toasted chopped hazelnuts | 8 ounces egg noodles, cooked
instructions: Place rice in a bowl. Heat oven to 400°f. Combine flour, olives, capers, vinegar and salsa verde in a microwave safe bowl. Place capsicum in bowl and cover with cling film. Microwave on high for 1 minute or until warm and tender. Drain capsicum, reserving dressing. Place noodles in a large bowl. Add reserved dressing and toss. Serve with hot capsicum and nuts.

title: Lamb, Pork & Orzo Bake With Melon Balls
ingredients: 1 kg pork tenderloin ( lean ) | 150 g ground lean pork or 150 g lamb | 75 g raw peanuts, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground bitter melon ( melon ball ) | 1/2 cup oatmeal | 3 tablespoons ground peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c or 160c if in a heavy fry pan. Trim excess fat. Place pork, 1 tbls water and the malcher on a piece of foil big enough to enclose meat. Fold over top and seal all edges. Place on oven tray, bake for 20 minutes. Fry the chopped peanuts until golden brown. Remove. Remove all from oven. Pound meat till you have a coarse mixture about the size of the nora. Take the meat out of the oven and pat dry. Spread the nora, meat on the meat. Mix the meat with your hands so that they are covered with nora. Return to the oven, turn oven down to 150c or 150c and bake for 1 hour. Remove from oven. Remove all bones and set aside. Let meat cool in the mixture. Serve with a sprinkling of ground nut and a small pile of chopped roasted peanuts. Note, the type of meat used is a perogative so if you use lamb, lamb mince should be ground in your hands, and a little of the ground peanuts mixed with the ground mince can be removed from the mixture.

title: Strawberry-Vermont Egg Noodle French Bread
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 4 cups egg noodles, cooked, drained | 2 cups fresh strawberries preserves | 1/3 cup marsala wine or 1/3 cup other dry white wine | 2 cups shredded lettuce
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add eggs except for 1 cup.

Random Ingredients: basil,hard egg,beef shank,butter,green chili,beef chuck,asiago cheese,japanese mayonnaise
title: Beef-And-Cheese Ramen (Ramen Asaki)
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, cut 1-inch thick | 1/2 lb boneless beef shank ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons butter | 6 hard-boiled eggs, cut in half | 1 1/2 ounces dried asiago cheese | 3 tablespoons japanese mayonnaise | 1/2 lb dried basil, crumbled | 1 canned green chili, julienned
instructions: Place beef and shank in large shallow pan. Bake or broil until well done, turning so as not to burn the meat, about 1 1/2 hours. Cool. When the meat is cool, break into small pieces.

title: Hard Boiled Eggs on Rice
ingredients: 2 -3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1 lemon, zest of | cooked rice ( to serve )
instructions: Peel the eggs, if they are already done. Quarter the egg yolks and reserve from the shell. Cut the egg white into eighths and place the yolks in a small bowl. Finely grate the zest of the lemon, also very finely in a small bowl. Cut the reserved egg shell into thin pieces. Add this to the egg whites. Cut the reserved egg white into wedges. Add egg egg whites to potato water in a pot with a lid, bring to a boil. Boil for 1 - 2 minutes so that the egg whites will turn soft but not dry. Place the lemon rind into the pot and add lemon rind and eggs to the pot. Add boiling water until the water reaches 2 3/4 of the way up the egg whites. Turn heat up to medium and cook for 30 minutes or until the yolks are thick and creamy. You may need to stop the pot after 15 minutes or so of cooking. Remove the pot from the heat and allow to infuse. Remove the pot from the heat and transfer the egg mixture into a bowl and serve. Note, you may enjoy this simple potato rice dish without potatoes, but it does taste great using potato starch or cornstarch mixture instead of rice.

title: Garlic Parsnips
ingredients: 12 parsnips | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup good quality parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Peel and cook the parsnips until tender. While they cook, combine the other ingredients and mix well with your hands. Take them out of the oven and transfer them to the oven. When the parsnips are done cooking, bake, drain, and serve.

title: Oriental Veggies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yellow squash, about 3 | vegetable oil | 1/4 teaspoon toasted sesame oil
instructions: Cut squash in half lengthwise and scrape out coarse fibers.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,milk,pico de gallo,escarole,white vinegar,picante sauce,red pepper
title: Pico de Gallo With Escarole and Onions
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pico de gallo | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons milk | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1 tablespoon cornstarch ( corn starch if you have it ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro or 1/4 cup parsley
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Let sit 30 minutes, stir occassionaly for it will thicken. Serve at room temperature as an appetizer. Serve with corn chips.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,vegetable oil cooking spray,rice wine,caster sugar,beef brisket,peach
title: Peppered Beef and Peach Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | vegetable oil cooking spray, for brushing | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket or 1 1/2 lbs cross-cut rolled beef brisket | 3/4 cup chopped peach | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine or 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon caster sugar
instructions: Prick the shortcut across the grain of the beef brisket. Place the meat in a bowl and pour over the cold water. Allow to stand for 10 minutes. Heat the oil or spray oil in a frying pan until very hot, then fry the meat in batches for 3 - 4 minutes per batch until golden brown all over. Meanwhile drain the meat. Preheat the oven to 450f degrees. Return the meat and juice to the pan. Add the chopped peaches. Cover with foil and put into the middle of the oven. Put the pan into the oven. When the meat is cooked, remove the meat and place on a warm dish. Return the pan pan to the oven and continue to cook the meat. When the meat is done, remove from the pan and place on a warm platter. Pour off all but ½ cup of the pan juices and pour into a saucepan. Heat until the mixture turns dark brown. Remove from the heat and stir in the rice wine or sherry vinegar and sugar. Pour sauce over meat and serve immediately.

title: Chinese Red Plum Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 4 -6 tablespoons plum sauce or 4 -6 tablespoons green chili sauce | 1 can niblets ( any kind of canned plums )
instructions: Heat oil in a bowl over medium heat. Add the plums and toss to coat well with oil. Raise heat to medium high and saute for several minutes without stirring. Stir plum sauce into pan. Cook for 2 - 3 minutes until mixture darkens slightly. Remove from heat. You may serve this on rice. You may also like to serve it as an appetizer with noodles or as an accompaniment to a main dish.

title: Rosemary Glaze
ingredients: 6 leaves fresh fennel | 2/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, sifted | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Cut tips off fennel leaves.

title: White Beans, Cashews and Great Northern Beans
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans ( drained ) or 2 cans navy beans ( drained ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom or 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 tablespoon cashews, roasted or 1 tablespoon peanuts, chopped
instructions: Dissolve the cardamon or nutmeg and nuts in the beans then add to a deep frying pan. Cook over medium heat, stirring often.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,yellow squash,cranberry,eggplant,green pepper,duck
title: Texas Eggplant
ingredients: 1 duck, cut into pieces | 3 eggs, beaten | 1 large yellow squash, halved, seeded, sliced into 1/4 inch thick rounds | 2 large green peppers, cut into 1/4 inch thick rounds | 4 large tomatoes with chile peppers, sliced in half | 1 cup dry cranberries
instructions: Arrange duck pieces in a 13x9 inch glass baking dish. Coat with the beaten egg. Place the squash, green pepper, tomatoes, and cranberries in separate plastic bags. Place the bag between two pieces of plastic wrap and pound down with a rolling pin or other heavy object to compress all the contents. Place dish on a rack in a roasting pan. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the remaining duck pieces in a single layer on top of the vegetables in the dish. Cover with foil. Bake in the preheated oven 35 to 40 minutes, brushing and basting frequently with the duck fat from the duck fat and egg. Top with the remaining vegetables and bake 5 to 10 minutes, or until the duck is no longer pink in the center. Turn duck over and serve.

title: Sweet Chilli Ham Salad
ingredients: 400 g cooked ham ( cut into thin strips ) | 2 tablespoons scallions ( thinly sliced ) | 1 red chili pepper ( finely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon lemongrass ( finely chopped ) | 300 ml cream of tartar | 200 ml dry white wine | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts, and stir to combine. Toss with nuts just before serving.

Random Ingredients: salsa,tofu,cayenne,yellow cake mix,bean sprout,spring onion,saffron strand
title: Tofu and Bean Sprouts With Saffron
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 can baked beans with sprouts | 1 teaspoon saffron strand | 10 ounces fresh tofu, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup finely chopped spring onion | 2 tablespoons salsa | cayenne, to taste
instructions: Bake yellow cake mix according to package directions and set aside, uncovered. In a mixing bowl, combine the bean sprouts with saffron strands, baked beans and tofu. Stir well. Add spring onions and salsa. Add cayenne to taste.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,lime juice,flour tortilla,log goat cheese,nonfat yogurt,bean sprout,purpose flour
title: Lime and Basil Party Appetizers
ingredients: 1 cup refried beans seasoned with jalapeno seasoning ( see note ) | 12 flour tortillas or 12 corn tortillas | 1/2 cup nonfat yogurt, stirred | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon white sugar | 1 cup sliced leaves from log of goat cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice
instructions: Note, for crispier chips, sprinkle with paprika and lightly toast or broil in oven until lightly browned. For crispy appetizers, spread cooked beans with 1/8 cup yogurt or an equivalent of your desired consistency. Place a dollop of crumbled goat cheese along the cream cheese line on each bean layer. Add a layer of crisp chips, followed by dollop of more yogurt. Sprinkle with white sugar. Top each with a whole fresh lime and serve warm. Note, for crispier chips, sprinkle with paprika and lightly toast or broil in oven until lightly browned.

title: Steamed Asparagus
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh asparagus | 1 cup chunky salsa | 3/4 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Trim tips off tough ends of asparagus. Cut tips off tips. Cut asparagus diagonally in 1 1/2 to 2 inch pieces. Place asparagus in medium saucepan with salsa. Cover and bring to a boil. Lower heat to medium and cook gently for 8 to 24 minutes until asparagus is bright green and tender. Meanwhile, mix yoghurt and fenugreek in a small bowl. Pour yogurt mixture into pan.

Random Ingredients: orange,caper,thai fish sauce,harissa,vanilla essence,green apple,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pork loin roast
title: Pork With Pineapple (Costiera) Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon harissa | 250 g pork loin roast | 200 -400 g green apples ( peeled, cored, quartered ) | 1 teaspoon honey or 1 teaspoon agave nectar | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 4 slices orange rind ( optional ) or 4 slices lemon rind ( optional ) | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180ºc or 170ºc if your oven is very hot, place all ingredients in a large ceramic bowl/crockpot with lid and toss to combine. Cover and keep warm. Place saute pan on stove on medium high. When it's very hot, add the pork and brown well on all sides. Place meat into warm dish / crockpot and turn to warm temperature. Cover and keep warm in the oven. When your oven has reached 180ºc or 175ºc, remove the lid of the dish / crockpot and allow to warm to simmer for 45 minutes. Check every 15 or 20 minutes and stir if the pork will be drying up too much and it should be. Replace and continue to cook till tender. When ready to serve, turn oven to 180ºc or 175ºc if your oven has a convection oven. Drain all the liquid from the dish / crockpot, removing all visible fat. Add the capers and continue to cook on stove top on low setting. Add the pineapple pieces and stir through until they begin to soften. Serve in an individual wine goblet, with freshly grated parmigiano.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,feta cheese,sun tomato oil,pumpkin seed,chicken breast half
title: Pumpkin Seed Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup finely chopped pumpkin seeds | 3/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Spray 2 qt casserole with cooking spray. Heat tomato oil in skillet over med heat. Sprinkle half of the bean mixture over chicken and stir to coat chicken. Pour remaining bean mixture over chicken and tomato mixture, sprinkle with pumpkin seeds. Cover and bake 35 - 40 minutes, until chicken is no longer pink and beans heated through. Sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,confectioner sugar,cumin seed,white rum,chili oil,extra virgin olive oil,italian sausage link
title: Italian Sausage Rollup Sandwiches
ingredients: 6 ounces mild italian sausage links | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons white rum | 6 lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Grill the sausages until cooked through, but not browned, 5 to 7 minutes per side. Cool completely, cut them into 1/4 inch slices, and set aside. Heat the chili oil over medium heat in a dry skillet. Cook and stir the cumin seeds in the hot oil until fragrant, about 1 minute. Pour in olive oil and rum, and cook until reduced by half, about 3 minutes. Spread about 1 teaspoon of the flavored oil onto each lettuce leaf, top with 1 slice of the sausage, and roll up. Arrange the rolls in a single layer in a baking dish. Heat 1 tablespoon of the reserved chili oil in a saucepan over medium heat, and cook the rolls until heated through, crisp and lightly browned, about 2 minutes per side. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.

title: Scallop & Saffron (Pastry) With Italian Seasonings
ingredients: pastry, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/pastry-mama-rice-473951 '' > pastry mama rice < /a > | 16 saffron strands | 200 ml red wine | 1 teaspoon sea scallops | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Place saffron strands in a small cup with boiling water and simmer until soft, about 3 minutes. Drain and set aside for a few minutes while preparing scallops. Drain saffron liquid and set aside. Bring the wine to a boil in a sauce pan, then reduce heat to med low and simmer until reduced by half. Add scallops and simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the saffron. Preheat oven to 400°f. Roll out half of pastry on a lightly floured surface to a 12 circle. Using a sharp knife or a 3 inch round cookie cutter, cut out circles. In a small bowl, mix the italian seasoning, white sauce and reserved saffron liquid. Brush half the pastry rounds with the white sauce and layer with half the scallops. Brush remaining pastry rounds with sauce and sprinkle with remaining scallops. Press together pastry with a back fork. Slash the top of the pastries with a sharp, serrated knife and make deep cuts in the pastry using a sharp knife or the dull side of a knife. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes or until golden and puffed.

title: Quickie Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 tablespoons garlic pepper seasoning
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Add the oil. Stir in the garlic pepper seasoning. Pour the hot mixture into the skillet.

title: Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 slices smoked sausage ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons corn, drained, rinsed | 1/2 ounce caster sugar or 1/2 ounce superfine sugar | 8 ounces button mushrooms, cleaned and finely chopped | 4 ounces double cream | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 pint strawberry
instructions: Place the smoked sausage in an ovenproof dish. Cook over hot coals/broiler until well browned, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, place the corn, caster sugar or superfine sugar and mushrooms in a small saucepan, cover and set over the simmering water for 5 minutes. Stir well and remove from the heat. Remove the sausage from the pan. Stuff each mushroom with the sausage and return to the pan. Pour the cream over and simmer for a few minutes. The mushrooms should stand a distinct shape, but not be too dry. Sprinkle the flour over and cook stirring for another minute or two. Divide between serving bowls and leave to cool slightly before topping with strawberries.

Random Ingredients: apple pie filling,molasses,egg yolk,lettuce leaf,linguine,red bean
title: Red Bean Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 3 cups lettuce leaves, chopped | 1 can red beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can apple pie filling, drained | 1 egg yolk, unbeaten | 1 tablespoon molasses | 8 ounces linguine, cooked
instructions: Add all to a salad bowl and mix well. May add additional filling to taste. This will reheat very well.

Random Ingredients: double cream,pork butt,self rising flour,saffron,veal,pork liver
title: Mielhaxe
ingredients: 2 lbs pork fat | 2 lbs beef fat | 1 lb veal ( scallopini ) | 1 lb pork liver | 1 lb double cream | 1 pinch saffron, crushed
instructions: Cut liver into slices about ½ thick and set aside. Slice pork butt into approximately 1 inch squares and set aside. Cut meat into approximately 1 inch squares and set aside. Boil until fat is rendered and the gravy thickened. Serve with spaetzle.

Random Ingredients: ice,flat leaf italian parsley,hot water,french bread,cake flour,frangelico,worcestershire sauce,red lentil
title: Dolores' French Bread
ingredients: 1 cup red lentil, rinsed and picked over ( approx 750g ) | 3 cups hot water | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 3 tablespoons cake flour | 2 tablespoons ice | crusty french bread, to serve | fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, to serve
instructions: Put the lentils into a large mixing bowl and add the hot water, sugar, worcestershire sauce and brandy. Use your finger and rub the lentils into the flour to mix well. To serve, place a slice of crusty bread on a plate and top with lentils. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with a side of fresh french bread.

title: Baked Salmon With Chilli and Peppercorns
ingredients: 4 salmon, in 8 serving pieces, skin left on | 6 dried red chili peppers, deseeded and thinly-sliced | 40 -50 white peppercorns
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees centigrade / 375 degrees fahrenheit / gas mark 3 and grease a baking sheet with oil. Cut the remaning salmon fillets into 8 equal size pieces, removing all bones and skin. Cut a lengthwise slit along the side of each piece that is not completely open. Stuff each piece of salmon with the chillies and peel off the skin from each piece. Arrange the salmon in a single layer in the prepared baking tray and sprinkle the peppercorns over the salmon. Pour enough boiling water into a roasting tin to come halfway up the sides of the salmon. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Turn the pieces over, re heat for a further 15 minutes, basting occasionally and turning the pieces of fish over in the pan until the fish is cooked. Serve straight from the roasting tin with white rice.

Random Ingredients: roast,chicken meat,spanish onion,corn tortilla chip,turmeric,ancho chile pepper,crescent dinner,tamarind pulp
title: Roast and Steamed Tamarind Tacos
ingredients: 1 pound ground turkey | 1 spanish onion, sliced and separated into rings | 1 can canned chipotle-flavored stewed tomatoes with chiles, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped ancho chile pepper, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 jar tamarind pulp, drained | 1 jar sliced roast, drained
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Spread turkey and onion into the bottom of a large dutch oven over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,tequila,cooking spray,alfredo sauce,curry powder,coconut oil
title: Curry Nachos
ingredients: 0.5 package tortilla chips | cooking spray | 0.5 package alfredo sauce | 0.5 package tequila | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 0.5 container trader joe's creamy tubetti-flavored alfredo sauce | 1/2 teaspoon coconut oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Coat a baking sheet lightly with cooking spray. Lay tortilla chips across each sheet. Lightly spray each with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: sage,mustard,nam pla,paper,wide egg noodle,laurel leaf,maraschino cherry
title: Nailorean Ramen
ingredients: 3/4 lb wide egg noodles | 4 sheets of fresh seaweed paper, each with a pinch of salt and ends touching around the edge of the pan | 1 tablespoon nam pla ( fish spreadable fish sauce ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped maraschino cherries | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 tablespoon dried nam pla
instructions: Preparation, trim the ends and ends of each noodle and fill with about 3/4 tblsp. Water. Submerge into ice cubes. Soak 20 minutes in ice over night and drain again.. Cut noodles into 5 x 1/4 inch pieces. Put noodles in a serving dish. Add a little bit of the nam pla and some salt. Mix. Put a layer of nori on a large cutting board. Spread 1/3 of the noodles on the nori. Sprinkle 1/4 tblsp. Of the nori mixture on. Spread 1/3 of the cherries on top of this. Spread 1/3 of the rice on the nori mixture. Sprinkle 1/4 tblsp. Of the cherries on top of this. Spread 1/4tblsp. Of the rice on the nori mix. Spread 1/4tblsp. Of the nori mixture on. Sprinkle 1/4tblsp. Of the cherries on. Place 1/4tblsp. Of the nori mixture on. title: Wild Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 -16 wild mushrooms | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Wash the mushrooms and slice into 3 sections. Place in a mixing bowl and coat evenly with the cardamom, pepper and almond extract. Cover the bowl with cling film, and refrigerate 4 - 6 hours, or overnight. Remove from fridge 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: french bread,turmeric powder,ginger garlic paste,veal,pimiento,white pepper,white onion
title: Veal Stuffed French Breads
ingredients: 6 slices french bread, 2 inch slices | 1/4 cup mixed spice, such as ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup smoked veal, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup white onion, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup dried pimiento, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh ground white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon fajita seasoning or 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric powder

Close the sandwiches, and allow to rest at room temperature for 15 minutes. Wrap individually in plastic wrap and store overnight or for up to 2 weeks before using. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Drain the sandwiches tightly from each cloth, and grill until the bread is browned and crispy, 4 to 6 minutes per side.

title: Spicy Creme
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chutney | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Place chutney in a small bowl and stir in lemon pepper. Serve on top of any meal and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,sage leaf,thyme sprig,green enchilada sauce,peanut

instructions: Set aside 1/2 cup of the chile enchilada sauce for later use.

title: Lethal With Asparagus

instructions: Combine the asparagus spears, lentils, rum, chile pepper in a large pot. Bring to a boil.

instructions: Place the potatoes and syrup in a large saucepan, cover and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Preheat the oven to 375°f sift the flour into a bowl and add 100ml boiling water, stir with a fork until the dough comes together. Remove from the heat. Pinch off walnut sized pieces of dough and roll between your palms to a 1/2 inch thickness.

title: Bashian Arharagi (Rice Balls)
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1 inch piece black cardamom pod | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon jeera powder ( optional )
instructions: Soak the rice and cardamom pods in warm water for at least 10 minutes, or until soft. Drain rice thoroughly, then cut into small pieces that are about 2 inches long. Water. Mix well. Add 1 tbsps. Oil. Mix. If using jeera powder, the jeera is the recommended substitute.

title: Chile Con Queso Dip With Crisp French Fries With Beer!

title: Rigatoni With Capsicum, Capsicum and Tamari

instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on packet/bag. Meanwhile, heat soy sauce and tamari sauce in a small saucepan over medium high heat. Stir until warm. Drain pasta and toss with soy sauce and capsicum. Serve immediately with freshly chopped parmesan cheese.

title: Celestial Lasagne - the Mythic Mousse
ingredients: 750 ml double cream | 500 g goats cheese, grated | 1 packet crumbled dried porridge oats ( i used oatcakes, crumblers, or as i am told. i cooked mine in the oven )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180 degrees. Prepare cheese/oat mixture. Combine cream and cheese and bring to a boil and remove frok of foam. Stir in the dry porridge oats. Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,dark sesame oil,red chili pepper
title: Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs seedless red chili peppers | 1 cup dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 lbs fresh vanilla beans
instructions: Char the chilies over a gas flame, turning once. Put the seeds into a clean coffee filter. Toast them well in the oven, about 350'f, or until they are dark brown, about 10 minutes. Keep them under a closed lid. Heat the oils and beans in a large heavy pan with 1½ - 2 pints of water, and cook over a low fire, stirring constantly, for 40 minutes, or until they are soft but not completely soft. When you add the beans, they must be very hot before they can cause the mixture to boil. Do not open the lid to check for burning or splattering. After 20 minutes, remove from heat, uncover, and place in a clean coffee filter until cooled completely.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,golden raisin,lime juice zest,swiss cheese,espresso
title: Mexican Cheese Balls With Spiced Espresso

instructions: Mix cottage cheese, raisins, and lime juice together. Stir in swiss cheese, then espresso. Add more if necessary to make a mixture that is stiff enough to roll into a ball. Chill before serving.

title: Green Chili Pepper Strips

instructions: Sprinkle a baking sheet with cooking spray or line with parchment paper towels. In a medium bowl, mix the green chili peppers, white pepper and bacon fat. Mix well until the peppers are thoroughly blended. Transfer the mixture to a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2 inch round tip. Squeeze and discard excess air from the bag.

title: Easy and Delicious Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 30 ounces enchilada sauce
instructions: Bake the salmon fillets according to package directions but only about 3 minutes total. Heat up enchilada sauce in a medium size sauce pan. Place salmon in a 9x13 baking dish, brush with enchilada sauce. Spoon some of the sauce over the top. Repeat with one layer of salmon until all are finished. Pour remaining enchilada sauce over the top. Bake in preheated over at 400°f for about 20 minutes.

title: Cajun Style Sweet Potatoes

instructions: Heat water on stove. Place potatoes in a large bowl, bring water to a boil. Cook covered with a slightly rounded lid until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain potatoes in a colander. Set aside to cool slightly. Run under cold water to cool further. When you're almost ready to make the filling, place the white potaab in the microwave and on high, microwave potatoes for about 10 minutes, or until potatoes are softened. Take your time with the microwave. The microwave method doesn't take very long, just a minute on high, and microwave for about 10 to 15 minutes or until a knife can be inserted. Test potato for doneness. It should be tender. Dice your cooled potatoes and place them in a large bowl. Season with your favorite topping and spices. Add your reserved potatoes and mix thoroughly. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Grilled Veal Sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce, to taste | 2 tablespoons apple, finely chopped | 12 ounces veal, sliced, cooked and thinly sliced ( or pork, beef, or chicken ) | 4 -6 large marshmallows, finely chopped | 12 ounces fat free greek yogurt | 10 ounces low fat fat greek yogurt or 10 ounces low fat greek yogurt | 2 containers fat-free whipped topping, thawed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat medium sized grill pan. Toss veal with soy sauce and apple. Grill on medium for 5 minutes. Turn over and grill until done. Let cool.. Whip yogurt with a fork. Layer cooked meats, half the marshmallows, half yogurt, half whipped yogurt, and half whipped topping. Place in freezer proof container and freeze until ready to serve.

title: The Best Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 4 teaspoons tabasco sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Add the oregano and tabasco to a small bowl, combine thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients to the bowl and stir to combine well.

title: Homemade Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 5 large free range eggs | 1 cup egg substitute
instructions: In a large bowl, use a fork or rubber scraper to get rid of all of the yellow or lemon pieces. Add the eggs to the bowl. Add sugar to desired sweetness of egg. Mix until egg is creamy and frothy. If you have eggs that don't beat, you can add a tablespoon or two of milk at a time until the soup is creamy and frothy. Scoop up the top of the egg mixture. Return soup to stove. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to simmer. Simmer for five minutes stirring often. Serve with butter and enjoy.

title: Homemade Adobo on the End of a Dollar
ingredients: 1 head lettuce leaf, washed | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic paste
instructions: Place lettuce leaves on a cutting board and cut a 1/2 inch slice off each side of the lettuce. Place a lettuce leaf on a cutting board and spread 1 teaspoon garlic paste over the top of the lettuce leaf.

title: Tofu & Veggies With Tofu Pasta
ingredients: 250 g tofu, cut into cubes | 1/2 kg button mushroom | 1 carrot | 1 stalk celery | 8 sheets toasted thin pasta, shapes | 1/2 cup gouda cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Boil the mushrooms until soft. Take out the mushrooms and save the liquid. Bring water to a boil in a pot. Chop the tofu into cubes. Remove the carrot, celery and tofu from the water. Dice the tofu, mushrooms and carrot. Combine the tofu, tofu and the mushrooms with the mushrooms and carrot. Stir in the rice and oregano, making sure everything is evenly distributed. Cover and simmer over low heat for 10–12 minutes.

title: Shakshuka (Japanese Noodles and Meat Sauce With Diced Beef)
ingredients: 1 package cellophane noodles, broken into pieces | 1 lb fresh lean ground beef chuck | 1 cup hot tap water | 4 ounces fresh shelled pistachio | 1 1/2 tablespoons pistachios, shelled, chopped
instructions: Rinse the cellophane noodles and let them drain thoroughly. Place them in a large skillet and cook over high heat, stirring often, until the noodles are cooked but not mushy, about 3 minutes. Drain the noodles, then set the noodles aside. Meanwhile, grind the beef and 1/2 cup of the hot tap water with a mortar and pestle. In a blender or food processor, process the noodle mixture until it is smooth and creamy. Add half the beef mixture to the noodle sauce and mix thoroughly. Return the remaining beef mixture to the skillet, and add the pistachios and pistachios. Keep stirring until the noodles are hot. Add the remaining ingredients and cook over medium heat, tossing frequently, until hot and well mixed.

title: Fiery Thai Salad
ingredients: 4 -8 large lettuce, washed, dried, and torn into smaller pieces | 1 small fresh kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Chop the lime leaves into very fine long strips using a vegetable peeler. In a large salad bowl, mix the lime strips with the thinly sliced kaffir lime leaves. Cut the lettuce into bite sized pieces.

title: Oven Baked Steak and Chips
ingredients: 1 pound beef short ribs | 14 ounces tilapia fillets, or as needed to cover
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the short ribs in a baking dish. Place the tilapia fillets in the baking dish. Pour seasoning into the baking dish. Place the baking dish under the preheated broiler and broil until fish is easily flaked with a fork, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Mexican Green Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli, trimmed, and cut small chunks ( swiss-aduya or regular, about 3 cups ) | 3 tablespoons shortening | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cook broccoli for 1 - 2 minutes, then remove and run under cold water.

title: St. Patrick's Day Lepritho Delight
ingredients: 2 ounces maraschino cherries, pitted, divided | 4 tablespoons pine nuts, divided | 2 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f. Place 1 ounce of cherries on a pastry towel. Pierce a 2 inch opening of the rind with a sharp knife, about 1/2 inch deep. Squeeze out all the juice, creating a layer 1 3/4 inches thick. Place cherries and 2 tablespoons of pine nuts on a sheet tray. Bake in the 300f oven for 3 - 4 minutes. Pour 1 1/2 cups of irish cream over cherries. Continue cooking for 5 - 10 minutes, until cherries are hot. Remove from oven.

title: Mushroom and Tofu Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups whole wheat flour | 2 packages firm tofu, cubes shredded | 2 cups cremini mushrooms | 1 lb tagliatelle pasta noodles, cooked
instructions: Cook pasta to your liking and drain. Mix together flour and tofu to make a thin paste. Drain pasta and mushrooms. Place flour paste in a large fry pan and fry mushrooms, adding a little olive oil. After cheese is melted add to mushrooms. When pasta is to your liking turn out onto a plate. Serve in a bowl with cheese sauce on top of each serving.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,baking potato,japanese cucumber,coconut oil,cannellini bean,egg yolk,vanilla yogurt,bicarbonate soda
title: Kurdish Potato and Apricot Dumplings (Togarashi)

instructions: Use a mandolin to shred the potato, cucumber and drain the vegetables. Slice the egg yolks and mash them with a fork. If the mixture is very grainy, leave it a while. Drop by rounded tablespoons into boiling water. When they float, they are finished, but only take a few minutes. Drain on absorbent paper, drain and serve with vanilla yoghurt, sweetened whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

title: Swiss Almond Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | 2 tablespoons cream | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: In a blender, combine alfredo sauce, cream, almond extract and blend until mixed.

title: Shabnam Burgers

instructions: First fry the pears. Place the meat in a container. Then add the oil and pears. Mix. Take off the fire and let it cool down. Now take a big flat pan. Spread the mixture evenly in your pan. Now pears are cut. Spread the pears with the ouzo.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,chicken stock powder,kaffir lime leaf
title: Basic Thai Kaffir Lime Juice (Or Chicken)
ingredients: 4 cups chicken stock powder | 8 -10 kaffir lime leaves | white vinegar
instructions: Bring the chicken stock to a boil with the kaffir lime leaves. Let simmer until desired consistency is reached. Remove lime leaves from the juice and stir in white vinegar. Strain back into the saucepan with the juice and bring to a boil. Bring again to a boil then turn off heat and let sauce stand for 5 minutes, or until water becomes clearer.. Pour into a tall glass with your choice of side.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,green bell pepper,ra el hanout spice mix,salmon,vegetable broth,walnut,tea,pinto bean
title: Smoked Salmon and Walnut Stew

instructions: Soak the pinto beans overnight. Drain well and set aside. In a small bowl, add the salt, broth and yeast and stir well to dissolve the yeast. Let stand 5 minutes. Mix in the smoked salmon and peppers and let sit 20 minutes for flavors to combine. Place in a greased 1 quart or larger casserole dish, or a roasting pan. Preheat the oven at 375 degrees fahrenheit. Note, these stews can be made in a dutch oven or other heavy bottom pot and baked in a slow cooker. Cook time does not include soaking the pinto beans.

title: French Dip Sandwiches with Homemade Beef Ribs
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated fully-cooked beef rib slices | 1 cup sliced provolone cheese | 1/3 pound coarse salt pork, sliced | 16 ladyfingers, split, or more if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Drain beef slices of excess juice from can into a small bowl, reserving juice, and pat meat lightly with paper towels to remove excess grease. Place beef, provolone cheese, salt pork slices, and bread triangles in a baking dish, piling each sandwich onto a piece of parchment paper if desired. Sprinkle top of rolls with additional salt pork. Cut into 8 portions. Arrange sandwiches on a tray lined with parchment paper.

title: Fondue for Two (Crock Pot or Not)

instructions: In a crock pot, add the stew meat, potatoes and cheese. Add the horseradish.

title: Guacamole Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 lbs pork back ribs | 1 medium yellow pepper | 6 -8 sprigs fresh thyme | 1 sprig fresh basil | 1 sprig fresh thyme | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | oil | sliced sweet pickle ( toasted, if desired ) ( optional ) ( optional ) | guacamole, if desired ( optional )
instructions: In a large plastic bag, combine pork ribs, peppers, herbs except garlic and a little water and squish it around a bit. Pour the garlic on top and marinate up to 4 hours. Prepare bbq for medium heat and brush grill with oil. Grill the ribs on both sides on a medium hot griller plate or a piece of parchment. If desired, you may broil the ribs and vegetables on the barbecue to brown the garlic slightly. You can also broil them until they are brown. To serve, put a short piece of toast in a hot, clean skillet, add the ribs and top with cheese. If you wish, add guacamole for a special treat. Great with salsa, or as a dip for fresh veggies.

title: Shrimp With Rice and Basil
ingredients: 14 ounces baby shrimp | 1/4 cup light muscovado sugar or 1/4 cup light brown sugar | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1 tablespoon cornflour or 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 pinch five-spice powder | salt & freshly ground black pepper | fresh basil, and basil, to garnish | shredded coconut, to garnish
instructions: Peel, devein and rinse the shrimp under cold running water. Place in a mixing bowl with the sugar, corn syrup, soy and five spice powder. Toss to mix well. Sprinkle with a little salt and pepper if needed. Place a griddle or heavy skillet over medium high heat for a couple of minutes to sear the shrimp, and cook until the shrimp turn translucent and have begun to curl around the edges. Remove from the skewers and keep warm. Turn up the grill to maximum temperature and coat the shrimp lightly. Grill them until medium or well coloured. Repeat with remaining shrimp, brushing and turning until fully cooked. Serve warm garnished with fresh basil and coconut, along with sambal oelek.

title: Lebanese Style Lentil Pancakes (Yogurt Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked brown lentils | 2 tablespoons yoghurt | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh rosemary ( or dried ) | 2 maraschino cherries or 2 cherries, cut into thin strips
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and mix throughly. Spoon the mixture into a large, non stick frying pan. Pour about 1/4 cup of batter into the pan.

title: Baked Strawberries With Peanuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped roasted peanuts ( not salted ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon, minced ( or minced fresh tarragon ) | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 1 dash dried red pepper | 1/2 cup seedless raisin | 4 medium fresh strawberries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. In a bowl, combine the nuts, orange juice and herbs, mixing thoroughly. Arrange berries around the edge of a greased 8 x8 or similar baking dish. Pour pea sections on top of the berries. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until berries are just starting to turn lightly brown. Sprinkle with dried red pepper flakes and serve immediately.

title: Tamarind and Chilies Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup tamarind paste | 2 cups sugar | 4 dried chilies, soaked in hot water, and chopped | 1 tablespoon yeast
instructions: Combine the tamarind, sugar, cilantro, chilies, and yeast in a large bowl. Mix well, and leave to stand for one hour. Add more water and water if necessary, to keep mixture at the right consistency. Pour into a large well oiled container, cover, and set in a warm place for two to three hours, or until dough begins to rise. Turn dough out onto a well floured surface. Cut into four pieces as desired, and roll each half into a cylinder about 1 1/2 inches wide and 5 inches in diameter. Wrap in plastic bags, and refrigerate for up to eight days before baking.

title: Bacon and Mozzarella Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup pizza sauce, warmed or 12 ounces shredded cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons maple bacon fat, cooked and chopped | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a small amount of warm water. Stir in 1 cup pizza sauce. Stir in bacon, 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese and the yeast mixture. Turn onto greased pizza pan. Cover loosely with plastic wrap. Let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 40 minutes. Bake at 400 degree for 10 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.

title: Lavender Rice With Turnips and Sheep Sheep
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried lavender | 4 celery ribs, diced | 4 serrano peppers, sliced thin | 3 cups beef broth | 2 cups turnips, sliced crosswise into 1/2 inch slivers | 3/4 cup long grain rice
instructions: Combine dried lavender and celery in a small bowl, add chiles, cover and steep 30 minutes. In a large saucepan, combine broth and turnip slivers, simmer 20 minutes, then remove and set aside. Remove rub from turnip. Cover turnip and leaves with more broth, bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 7 minutes drain turnip. Rinse with cold water and let dry for 15 minutes. Serve on platter. Note, if you are using whole leaves, remove stems and wash well. Rinse and let dry for the next 2 to 3 days, then put into clean clean, clear jars. If using a whole chickens, add more broth and leave submerged for 30 minutes.

title: Pasta With Bacon & Tomato Aioli
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, cut into 4 pieces each | 1 large apple, chopped ( optional ) | 12 ounces penne pasta ( or pasta of your choice ) | 1 jar enchilada sauce ( or more ) | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning ( i used dried seasoning ) | 1 cup tomatillo, drained and chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cook bacon in large nonstick skillet over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon to paper towels and drain on paper towels. Add chopped apple to skillet in that bacon grease. Cook over medium heat until apple is opaque.

title: Burger Beef
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 50 g red curry paste ( or less ) | 2 tablespoons mustard | 1 tablespoon ground mixed spice
instructions: Mix all the above ingredients together in a large freezer bag. Place in a freezer bag and put in the fridge overnight. Next day, remove from freezer, remove from freezer and place in freezing bag. Freeze solid. Slice. Put meat back in the freezer bag.
