Put back in the freezer for several hours in the freezer freezer, stirring every 20 minutes or so. When meat is ready, put it in the fridge at least 2 hours before serving. This makes a lot of sauce and a fantastic base for your tasty gravy.

Random Ingredients: chili,steak,red chili,provolone cheese,potato,onion flake,mexican cheese,beef base
title: Famous Beef and Potato Casserole #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb round steak | 2 packages simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 1 can diced chili | 1/3 cup dried onion flakes | 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon red chili | 1 1/2 tablespoons beef base | 1 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 9x13 inch pan with nonstick cooking spray and spread potatoes in the bottom evenly. Drain beef well in a strainer. In medium bowl, mix remaining ingredients and pour over potatoes in the pan. Cover and bake for 20 minutes remove cover and bake until top is golden brown, about 1 hour more.

Random Ingredients: dressing,hazelnut,tomato juice,topping,pork sausage,butter,red wine vinegar,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Italian Sausage and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup shredded hazelnuts | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons butter | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 can tomato juice | dressing | 1 small dollop of whipped topping ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375f degrees. In a deep bowl, combine crumbed sausage, cheese, hazelnut chips, red wine and butter, stirring with a fork until crumbly. Turn into a greased 10 inch round pie pan. Bake for 16 minutes. Topping, in a large bowl, combine vinegar, tomato juice and enough dressing to coat well. Pour evenly over sausage mixture. Top with whipped topping.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,velveeta cheese,corn syrup,black bean garlic sauce,kosher salt black pepper,wine vinegar,green coriander
title: Cheesy Black Bean Dip
ingredients: 6 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can black bean garlic sauce | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 can french onion soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup green coriander, chopped ( a handful ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Melt the velveeta in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Drain the black bean and garlic sauce. Stir in the black bean, vinegar, corn syrup, soup and green coriander. Reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer 10 minutes, or until thoroughly heated. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Baked Beetroot Bread
ingredients: 1 medium beetroot, peeled, trimmed and halved | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill, plus a few leaves for garnish | 1 baguette, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Wash the beetroot well, and slice the halves thin. Place on a baking sheet, and sprinkle with salt, dill and garlic salt. Bake the bread for about 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until nicely toasted. Place on a cutting board, and slice into 1/2 inch slices. Place on plates or cutlets, and garnish with additional dill or a few leaves.

title: Crock Pot Aztec Ground Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder ( more if needed ) | 1 can white mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives
instructions: Place ground beef in the slow cooker. In small bowl, mix together cocoa powder, tomatoes, honey and chives. Pour into slow cooker and allow to cook on high for 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,vanilla pudding mix,jalapeno pepper,mustard powder
title: Jalapeno Poppers
ingredients: 4 yellow bell peppers ( sliced ) | 4 jalapeno peppers ( sliced ) | 1 cup dry vanilla pudding mix | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saute pan, stir well.

title: Barley and Seascallops on Rice (Barley and Tomato Meal)
ingredients: 6 ounces sea scallops | 8 ounces pearl barley | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 3 cups hot cooked brown rice
instructions: Drain juice from tomatoes, discarding juice and tomatoes. Combine ingredients in microwave safe bowl and microwave on high power for 5 - 6 minutes or until tomatoes are tender and barley is soft.. Serve over rice. Sprinkle a few dashes of additional dried basil over soup or serve soup with your favorite side dish.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,pancetta bacon,campbell pork sauce,lime wedge,apricot preserve,corn chip
title: Picante Piglets (With Cheese)
ingredients: 1 package corn chips, coarsely chopped | 12 slices pancetta bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 can campbell's pork and beans in tomato sauce, drained | 1 tablespoon anise seed, crushed ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons taco-style chili-flavored carbonated beverage or 4 teaspoons taco seasoning | 4 teaspoons sour cream or 4 teaspoons tex-mex cheese blend
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f coat medium ovenproof skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Place half the chips in skillet, sprinkle with 3/4 teaspoons each of salt and pepper, pancetta pieces, beans, anise and chili beans.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,chili paste,shrimp,oyster sauce,anchovy fillet,pasta sauce,pork shoulder,thyme
title: Spicy Pork Soup
ingredients: 250 g pork shoulder | 100 g shrimp, uncooked and cleaned | 1/2 cup mixed bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons shrimp, chopped | 2 anchovy fillets, minced | 1/4 teaspoon fresh thyme, grated | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1/3 - 1/2 cup pasta sauce | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( optional )
instructions: Cut pork into thin strips about 5cm / 1in / 3in across. Place meat and shrimp in a microwave safe bowl with the anchovies, thyme and fish sauce, mix thoroughly and microwave on high for 1 - 5 minutes, stirring from time to time. Heat the sauce in a saucepan over medium high heat until it starts to bubble. Add chili paste and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,poblano chile,rom tomato,glace cherry,cumin
title: Poblano Scones
ingredients: 12 roma tomatoes | 1 can diced poblano chiles | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 3 cups self-raising flour | 1 1/4 cups shredded roma tomatoes | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1/4 cup finely diced poblano chile
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees farenheit. Core and deseed the roma tomatoes and roughly chop. Set aside in a small mixing bowl. Finely dice the poblano chiles and place in a small mixing bowl. Season to taste with 1 teaspoon cumin. Place the flour in another medium mixing bowl. Add the shredded roma tomatoes and 1 teaspoon ground cumin. With a fork, mix the ingredients until well combined. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead for at least 15 minutes. Roll out onto a lightly floured surface into a rectangle about 2 inches in width. Use a 2 inch cookie cutter to cut the dough into 4 equal squares. Arrange the scones on a greased and floured baking sheet approximately half an inch apart. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until golden on each side. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,beef mince,bell pepper,baking potato,sunflower seed
title: Spicy Chilli With Potato Chips
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, peeled ( or 2 medium ) | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 250 g beef mince | 1 bell pepper, seeded, finely chopped ( red or green )
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Heat the oil in wok over a high heat and fry the mince for 3 - 5 minutes until brown. Transfer to a medium bowl. Add the diced potato to the wok and stir fry. Spread the sunflower seeds and fry for 2 - 3 minutes until golden. Add the bell pepper and fry for 1 - 2 minutes, stirring constantly until it has lightly softened. Tip into bowl with meat, stir to coat and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,bacon dripping,turmeric powder,potato,pickle relish,basil leaf,back bacon
title: Kerry's Best Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 cup finely shredded cabbage | 1 cup finely shredded cooked back bacon | 1 cup finely chopped pickle relish | 1 teaspoon mild mashed potato | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cabbage, bacon, relish, potato, turmeric, and basil. Toss well. Add drippings, and toss well. Refrigerate for 4 to 6 hours to allow flavors to blend before serving.

Random Ingredients: lemon wedge,red snapper,kidney bean,pearl barley,greek seasoning,rosemary
title: Lemon and Potato Snapper on a Bed of Barley
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red snapper | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 3 tablespoons all purpose greek seasoning | pinch rosemary | sliced lemon wedge | kidney bean
instructions: Rinse and clean fish. Cut fish up in bite sized pieces. Mix together the seasonings. Pour over fish. Toss in the barley. Sprinkle rosemary. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Rice Cheese Empanadas
ingredients: 1 bag frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | rice or cooked noodles, for dipping
instructions: Mix the cheese with the rice or noodles. Open pastry bag and unfold. Cut pastry tube lengthwise into half, and line a baking sheet with the bottom crust. Spoon the quesadilla mixture onto dough, roll up, and seal ends with a fork. Place the empanada on top of the bottom crust. Bake in 350 degree f oven until golden brown, about 20 to 30 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,prosciutto ham,superfine sugar,enchilada sauce,garlic,half,red chili powder
title: Sopa Seca
ingredients: 14 ounces enchilada sauce, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/homemade- enchilada-10783 '' > homemade enchilada sauce < /a > | 4 slices country-style prosciutto ham, julienned | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | tortillas or corn tortilla, warmed ( 8-inch )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. On a foil lined baking sheet, combine 1/4 cup enchilada sauce, prosciutto, garlic, half& half, chili powder and sugar. Cover with foil. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until heated through. Serve with warm tortillas.

Random Ingredients: milk powder,tea,salami,chicken,french bread,red leaf lettuce,spaghetti,red chilies
title: Tia's English Peasy Smoked Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 100 g turkey bacon or 100 g smoked ham | 100 g smoked salmon | 1 red chilies ( optional ) | 100 ml instant skim milk powder | 1 loaf french bread | 100 g red leaf lettuce | 50 g spaghetti | 5 -10 teaspoons tea, powder ( i've used as much as you like )
instructions: Cut your steak into 20 cm x 20 cm squares cut the smoked salmon in half lengthways. Cut the red chilli in half if using it if using it. Dice the ham and turkey into small cubes when you are done with your steak. Mix the instant skim milk powder with the milk and milk mix until it is thick and creamy. Pour half the mix onto the bread and place the meat, ham, and salmon on the bread in a sandwich style shape. Roll the sandwich and cut it in half to serve. Repeat with the second bread slice. Enjoy.

title: Chocolate Hummus
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces mini chocolate chips | 5 dashes sambal oelek ( optional ) or 5 dashes other hot pepper puree ( optional )
instructions: Put the chocolate chips in a small bowl and pour over about 1/3 cup of the hot pepper puree. Melt the mixture over simmering water, not boiling, but stir vigorously. When the mixture is smooth, transfer to refrigerator for 15 minutes to let it cool slightly before removing from the refrigerator. Refrigerate until the chocolate is well hardened, but still slightly warm to the touch.

title: Auntie Anita's Simple and Delicious Tabbouleh - Houmahi
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Mix the bulgur with your favourite tabbouleh recipe. Add the honey. Mix well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chive onion cream cheese,pine nut,green cardamom pod
title: Creamy Herbed Pesto for Lamb, Fish, Poultry or Fish (Australia)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chives and onion cream cheese, room temperature | 1 packet green cardamom pods, seeds | 3/4 cup pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Combine cream cheese, cardamom pods and pine nuts in an electric blender or food processor, whizz to desired consistency and add remaining ingredients, whisking constantly for a few seconds if they begin to become dry before the sauce thickens. If necessary, add more cream or chamom. Serve immediately on buns with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: sourdough starter,pork shoulder,chocolate chip,bell pepper,ziti pasta,burrito flour tortilla,orange peel,broccoli floret
title: Carnitas, Carnitas and Broccoli Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless pork shoulder or 1 1/4 lbs boneless chicken thighs | 2 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1 medium ziti pasta | 1 large bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1/2 medium orange peel, julienned | 1 package burrito-size flour tortillas | 2 1/4 cups plain chocolate chips, divided | 1/4 cup sourdough starter ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a gas grill, cast iron griddle, cast iron skillet, or heavy skillet over high heat. Liberally oil the grill rack and grill the pork, turning occasionally until cooked through about 25 to 30 minutes. Transfer the meat to a cutting board and set aside, reserving the cooking liquid. Cut up the meat and cool slightly, then slice along the grain. Halve the broccoli and cut into about 1/2 inch pieces. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook until tender, about 11 minutes. Drain pasta, then return it to the pot. Meanwhile, cut out the core of the bell pepper and dice it into 1/2 inch chunks. In a large mixing bowl, mix together the pork with the pasta, broccoli, orange peel, tortillas, 1/2 cup of chips, 1/2 cup of plain chips, sourdough starter and the reserved cooking liquid. Use as much reserved cooking liquid as necessary to moisten the tortillas before adding more ingredients. Add more chipotle sauce to moisten if desired. To assemble the quesadillas, place about 1/4 cup of the meat mixture onto the center of a tortilla. Spread the tortilla with about 1/2 cup of the tomato mixture. Sprinkle about a third of the remaining tomato mixture over the top, then roll up the tortilla. Place onto a lightly greased baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling. Brush the quesadillas with the reserved cooking liquid before baking with the remaining 1 cup of chocolate chips and sprinkling with the remaining 1/3 cup of chocolate chips. Place in a 425 oven and bake until the quesadillas are bubbling and beginning to brown in the middle, about 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Shrimp With Prosciutto, Prosciutto, And Chillies(Shrimp En Cocotte)
ingredients: 1/4 lb shrimp, deveined and butterflied | 4 slices prosciutto | 2 teaspoons ginger, grated | 1 -2 green chilies, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/4 cup ham, finely chopped
instructions: Slice the shrimp lengthways and cut into pieces. Remove gills of shrimp and set aside. Cut the prosciutto into strips about 1 to 5 inches long. Remove vein from the chilies and shred them finely. Heat the oil and lightly fry the shrimp until they change colour. Remove from the pan, drain and keep warm. Add the ginger, chilies, chives, green chili and reserved shrimp into the pan and stir fry until it is coated with the ginger and chilli mixture. Add the ham, stir fry for 1 minute. Stir in the shrimp, then add a little water, cover the pan, and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes or until the shrimp are just cooked through and the sauce is nice and thick. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,hot red chili pepper,beef marrow,lamb,basil sprig,grain rice
title: Lamb With Rice
ingredients: 1 lb lamb, cut into chunks | 10 -12 ounces beef bones or 10 -12 ounces beef neck bones | 8 ounces long grain rice, washed and drained | 6 hot red chili peppers | 1 ounce dried basil sprig | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Cover the meat with cold water, bring to the boil and set a timer for 30 minutes. Leave for 5 minutes. Drain off the water from the stock and leave to cool before starting to make the rice. Trim away any fat or sinew which floats to the surface. Place the bones in a large saucepan with a little water, enough to cover them completely. Bring to the boil and reduce to a simmer. Add the rice and chillies. Simmer gently covered for 20 minutes. Uncover and simmer gently for further 4 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. Transfer the lamb and rice to a warmed serving dish and garnish with fresh basil sprigs and cayenne pepper.

title: Melt Down Turkey
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless fresh turkey | 1 chicken breast | 1 package bulk hot italian sausage | 1 package frozen mixed greens | 1/4 cup light rum | 2 dashes hot sauce
instructions: In ovenproof, 2 quart casserole dish, place turkey breast, sprinkle with salt and pepper mixture. Bake uncovered in 350f degrees oven for 55 to 60 minutes. Turn turkey breast over for last 5 minutes. Cut sausage in ½ inch slices, and remove loose sausage in pieces. Poke the middle of turkey with fork, remove backbone and blood. Cut the turkey in large chunks. Serve over rice. Dip chicken breast into rum, pour over rice, sprinkle with hot sauce, and serve.

title: Holy Basil (Chile - Poached Cheese)
ingredients: 4 -6 serrano chilies, roasted, peeled and finely minced ( more or less depending on your taste preference ) | fresh cilantro | purchased guacamole ( not traditional if you can find it )
instructions: If using fresh serrano chilies, remove charred skin. If using canned chilies, discard seeds, chop roughly and set aside. In a small frying pan, heat oil. Once it is hot but not smoking, add finely minced serrano chilies and cilantro. Cook for a few seconds then remove from heat.

title: Homemade Thyme Marinade for Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup canola oil | 3 large fresh thyme sprigs | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: In a deep frying pan with a tight fitting lid, heat canola oil at medium high and heat until the oil shimmers. Fry the thyme sprigs for a few seconds, they will release aroma and they will wilt into the oil. Remove thyme sprigs and fry until crisp and a shade or two darker, 1 to 2 minutes before they are done. Let oil cool slightly, then place in a gallon sized zip lock bag in the refrigerator. After 30 minutes, scrape as much oil off of the thyme as you can with a clean kitchen shears or an olive pestle. Stir in thyme, tabasco and your favourite citrus marinade.

title: Garlic Yogurt for Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup yogurt ( preferably fat free greek yogurt or greek dip ) | 1 -2 garlic clove
instructions: Dice garlic clove finely. I've tried yogurt, dip and garlic and then the garlic will work fine. Mix the ingredients in a medium size bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,black olive,marjoram,purpose flour,coffee,onion soup mix,raisin
title: Delicious Olive Bread
ingredients: 8 medium ripe black olives | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/3 cup coffee | 1/2 teaspoon oregano or 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2/3 cup raisins | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Cut up olives. Combine all ingredients except flour and mix well. Knead dough on board about 10 times, until smooth and slightly tacky. With floured hands or bench, roll out to approximately 1/8 thick and cut a hole in the center. Place about 2 tablespoons of filling into hollow half of dough around the filled half. Close hollow half securely with fork. Wrap with string and tie with string securing each at 6 to 8 inches intervals. Place bread on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350°f for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Tomato Pasta Pasta Sauce-Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 400 g tomato paste | 2/3 cup caster sugar | 6 rosemary sprigs, finely chopped
instructions: In a bowl, combine tomato paste, sugar, rosemary and 2 cups boiling water. Mix well and set aside for 30 minutes or longer. Heat a frying pan to a medium high heat. Add pasta to the hot pan and cook for 3 - 4 minutes, until heated through. Season to taste. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green bean,basic pizza dough,head garlic,pineapple,strawberry,milk ricotta cheese
title: Ricotta-Green Bean Pizza
ingredients: 1 package basic pizza dough, at room temperature | 1 container whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 bunches fresh strawberries, sliced | 1 can chopped pineapple, drained | 3 green beans, trimmed -or-cut on the diagonal into 1/2 inch lengths | 5 heads garlic, unpeeled
instructions: Pre heat oven to 475 degrees f. Stretch out dough onto an ungreased cookie sheet. To make crust, spread ricotta cheese. Drain the green beans and soak for one hour. Arrange green beans decoratively on dough. Top green beans with pineapple chunks, whole garlic cloves and a little more cheese and place on top of the green beans. Place in preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until crusty golden and cheese is bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Chili Raspberries
ingredients: 1 cup raspberries | 1/2 small red onion | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves | coriander powder, for garnishing
instructions: Rinse the raspberries and put them in a bowl. Add the chopped onion. Dry fry the onion in a small heavy based pan on medium heat with a little water. When the onion is translucent, add the coriander. Keep the spices a little on the edges of the pan as to not let them burn onto the skillet. When the seeds are crackling, add salt to the raspberries and mix. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,cumin,ice water,horseradish,turmeric,liquid smoke,dark brown sugar
title: Smokey Spicy Rub for Fish or Fish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons whole cardamom seeds | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon ice water
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into clean air tight bowl. Let sit in refrigerator for 1 day. Turn over once or twice so as to thoroughly coat both sides. Use an everyday rub or on sandwiches. Can be stored in freezer for up to a month.

Random Ingredients: butterscotch schnapps,white wheat flour,pesto sauce,milk,white bread,green chili pepper,broccoli floret
title: Whole Wheat Sizzler Bread Crunch
ingredients: 2 slices of white whole wheat flour | 2/3 cup milk | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons white chocolate chocolate flavoured schnapps | 1 teaspoon finely chopped red and green chili peppers | 1 ounce chopped broccoli floret, lightly steamed | 1 slice white bread, toasted, crumbs
instructions: Preheat grill. Beat or process milk and pesto in a small bowl until smooth. Add schnapps& chilies. Spoon dip into a large shallow pan or an 8 cup muffin tin. Add broccoli and bread and coat well with mixture. Grill for 3 - 5 minutes or until golden and base springs back when touched. Remove from grill and cool for 2 - 3 minutes on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,flat leaf parsley,chocolate pudding mix,lemon,nonstick cooking spray
title: Pudding Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 4 ounces chocolate pudding mix | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 large egg yolk | nonstick cooking spray | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl, combine puddings, parsley, and egg yolk.

title: Nippity Leeks
ingredients: 5 leeks | 2 tablespoons cream
instructions: Scrub the leeks. The dirt tends to stick to the upper portion of the stalk. Trim the root end, as well as the tops and the light green portion. Wash the cloth of each stalk thoroughly, removing any loose dirt and any shriveled outer leaves. Place the cleaned leeks in a saucepan, cover and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, partially cover and simmer until tender, 3 and 1/2 hours. Discard the leeks and let cool slightly. Remove the scum that forms on the top and discard. Cut off the stems, leaving just the white portion of the root. Using a vegetable peeler, peel a thin slice of the peel into a bowl. Drain the scum off of your hands before using. Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Tear off the tips of the leek roots and then slice the greens at an angle into 1/4 inch thick pieces. Drain the water, then place them in a blender or food processor with the scum, cream and lemon peel. Cover and blend until smooth, about 1 minute. Place a serving dish in the oven. Arrange the leeks on the dish and arrange the remaining slices over them. Drizzle the sauce over, and serve.

Random Ingredients: curry,cream cheese,vanilla bean,pork sausage,liquid honey,lemon pepper seasoning,anise seed,tomato
title: My Italian Hot Dogs
ingredients: 5 tablespoons unsalted cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/4 cup good quality curry, such as mccormicks | 1/4 teaspoon liquid honey | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla beans or 1/2 teaspoon extract | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon powdered anise seed | 1 lb pork sausage, cut into 1 1/2-inch slices | 1 medium tomatoes, seeded and diced
instructions: Stir cream cheese, curry, honey, vanilla bean, cardamom and lemon pepper into cream cheese mixture. Spread cream cheese mixture evenly over each sausage slice and sprinkle with the anise oil. Cover and chill overnight. Grill sausage slices over medium heat until lightly brown on both sides, about 5 minutes per side. Add tomato to saute pan and remove from heat. Serve hot, warm or room temperature.

title: Cheater's Real Chile Garlic Toast
ingredients: paprika ( a kind of sweet chili-garlic powder ) | 3 -4 jalapenos, seeded and cubed into large pieces ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon white flour | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 slices bread
instructions: Pound the spices together in a mortar and pestle until fine and make the mix real fine, too. To make the toast, first toast a piece of bread on a griddle pan or fryer that has some kind of oil on it, or just a small piece of bread. This will probably take about 10 - 15 seconds until one side is toasted. Spread the toast with the chile garlic and your favourite topping, sprinkle that on top and then add a couple of drops of water. Spread a nice pinch or two of chopped garlic over, also with a pat of butter. Serve. Enjoy.

title: Uncle Bill's Fresh Herbed Mozzarella Cheese (With Variations)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced fresh mint leaves | 2 teaspoons minced fresh thyme | 12 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir mint, thyme, and mozzarella cheese together. Spread the mixture evenly onto the parchment lined baking sheet, leaving 2 1/2 inch at the top edges. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

title: Spresso Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 ounce dried white breadcrumbs | 2 sprigs thyme, leaves only | 1 ounce aged gouda cheese | 10 -12 roma tomatoes | 2 -3 teaspoons espresso ( optional )
instructions: Soak up the dried breadcrumbs by setting them in a shallow dish. Chop the thyme leaves and place in a saucepan with a small saucepan of water. Add the thyme leaves and bring to a boil. Set up a strainer so that the water drains out and stir in the breadcrumbs. Boil rapidly until the liquid is nearly all absorbed and the breadcrumbs are light golden in color. Remove from the heat and place on to a plate. Cut the roma tomatoes into eighths and place into warmed espresso. To serve, spoon some hot espresso into the tomatoes and top with chopped fresh thyme.

Random Ingredients: rump steak,beef brisket,rhubarb,trout fillet,flat leaf parsley,milk,navy bean
title: Rulloch Cervee
ingredients: 600 g rhubarb | 350 g navy beans, soaked in water for an hour and blanched | 350 g rump steak, cut into thin slices | 350 g smoked trout fillets, cut into slices | 350 g rump steak fillets, cut into slices | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon milk
instructions: Preheat over to 180°c. Remove rind from rhubarb and cut into 5cm lengths. Cut beans into 3cm lengths. Combine rhubarb, beans, meat, fish, parsley and milk in a large roasting tin. Cook in oven for about 1 or 1 1/2 hrs. Stir meat & vegetables in to pan and remove pan from oven. Stir contents of pan through juices and serve.

title: Raspberry Parsnips and Raspberry Bark
ingredients: 24 ounces frozen raspberries, thawed and drained | 1 package frozen, partially thawed frozen parsnips
instructions: Using a large bowl, mix raspberries and parsnips with crackers. Pack into a 3/4 quart baking dish or other 2 quart shallow baking dishes. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Remove pulp and rind from parsnips. Cut off stems and discard. Spoon pulp and any accumulated liquid from baking dish into bowl. Cover and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, until well chilled, at least 2 hours or overnight. Uncemare, serve Bark garnish with raspberries and parsley sprigs toasted in a small red grape preserve glass.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,golden raisin,pork tenderloin,italian cheese,ginger root
title: Sweet Italian Pork
ingredients: 1 pound pork tenderloin, cut into 1/2 inch chunks | 1 jar italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1/2 cup golden raisins | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger root | 2 cups shredded italian cheese blend, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lay pork pieces in a 9x5 inch baking dish. Top with stewed tomatoes, undrained tomatoes, golden raisins, ginger root, and half of the shredded cheese. Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven, or until meat is no longer pink and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,vanilla sugar,white sugar,kalamata olive,cocoa powder,collard green
title: Collard Greens - Moroccan Style
ingredients: 1 cup canned chickpeas, drained | 1 bunch collard greens, stemmed, washed and chopped | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cocoa powder ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar ( to taste ) | 4 pitted kalamata olives, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Drain chickpeas, reserving liquid. Place chickpeas in a saute pan over medium heat and add enough water to cover. Simmer until the liquid is reduced by half, about 20 minutes. Drain and rinse collards and add them to the stock. Add sugar to the liquid and stir to dissolve. Add cocoa, vanilla and olives. Heat through until the liquid is reduced by half, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,green,vegetable oil,kittencal taco seasoning mix
title: Eggs With Green Chili and Taco Seasonings - 3 Ww Points
ingredients: 1/2 lb green | 12 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix
instructions: In a mixing bowl, beat eggs very well, then add oil and taco seasoning mix.

title: Spicy Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 cup orange juice | 2 chipotle chiles | 1/4 cup fresh dill, minced | 1 medium spanish onion, sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil, add potatoes and boil until tender. Drain and peel potatoes, and return to pot. Cover and let cool until cool. Cut in half crosswise. Cut into 1/4 inch slices. In a large bowl, combine oil and orange juice. Peel potatoes and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Add potato slices, chipotle peppers, chopped dill and onions to oil and orange juice mixture. Cook covered, over low heat until vegetables are softened. Sprinkle with additional minced dill.

Random Ingredients: hard alcoholic cider,lemon juice,biscuit dough,plain flour,stock,italian seasoning
title: English Spicy Beer Slice
ingredients: 2 jars sweet biscuit dough, drained | 1 cup plain flour | 2 1/4 cups hot stock | 4 ounces italian seasoning | 1/2 pint hard alcoholic cider | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c/gas divide the dough into thirds and roll out the pastry thinly. Using a 4 to 5cm/1in slice cutter, cut out 5 rounds from each dough round. Place the rounds on an oiled oven tray. Use one scraps to roll out each pastry round out to a 6mm/1in diameter stick. Transfer the sticks to a wire rack to cool. In a bowl, mix together the flour, herbs and cider in a bowl. Add the lemon juice and stir to combine. Taste and season with salt and pepper. To bake. Remove the base from each loaf tin, place a strip of baking paper on top of the biscuit, pressing the biscuit down firmly. Place the loaf tin on a hot barbecue plate, then place the hot base tin on the hot barbecue plate. Place the tray in the preheated oven for 8 - 10 minutes or until beginning to brown. Allow to cool for 5 minutes. Remove to a wire rack. Using a sharp knife, cut a cross lengthways slice from the top of each loaf tin using a 5cm/1in slice cutter. This will form a hole in the top of each loaf tin so it will not be able to shrink back down during baking. Place the slice between two sheets of baking paper and score well into 8 wedges. Return to the oven for a further 5 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to cool on a wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Hot and Sour Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 red potatoes ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Cut potatoes in half lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,emmenthaler cheese,shrimp,taco seasoning mix,raisin,anaheim chili
title: Mexican Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb unpeeled medium shrimp | 2 ounces kaffir lime leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried minced anaheim chili, toasted ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 3/4 cup raisins ( about 3 small ) | 12 ounces shredded emmenthaler cheese
instructions: In a large skillet, coat shrimp with kaffir lime leaves. Over medium heat, toast chili peppers in a dry skillet until aromatic, about 1 minute. Stir in taco seasoning mix and raisins. Stir in shrimp and gently toss to coat. Cover and simmer until shrimp just turn pink, about 5 minutes. Serve topped with cheese.

title: Chickpea Korma
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chickpeas, canned ( garbanzo beans ) | 1/2 cup red onion, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 teaspoon crushed green cardamoms | 1/4 cup rolled oats | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( or to taste )
instructions: Add all above ingredients, mix and let soak for 1 hr on low. Enjoy.

title: Mexican Chocolate Sandwich -  Tasty Mexi.
ingredients: 1 slice toast | 2 tablespoons yoghurt ( i used greek ) or 2 tablespoons low-fat yogurt ( i used greek ) | cocoa powder ( optional ) or cinnamon sugar ( optional )
instructions: Spread yoghurt/sweetened condensed milk evenly over toast if desired. Sprinkle on some cocoa or cinnamon sugar and sprinkle with some of the chocolate/toast powder. Yum.

title: Apple Blossom Pudding With Ham Gravy
ingredients: 2 cups cubed peeled tart apples | 1/4 lb of diced lean smoked ham | 1/2 cup bourbon | 3/4 cup buttermilk | 3/4 teaspoon baking soda | 10 ounces frozen miniature russet potatoes or 10 ounces regular size russet potatoes | 1/2 cup strawberry jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine all ingredients and place in a greased deep 3 quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes or until apples are tender. Cool and serve. Make gravy while cooling, melt jam in sauce pan. Remove from heat and whisk in toasted jam. Serve hot with warm, crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,onion soup mix,chicken broth,sauce,bell pepper,vanilla pudding mix
title: Spicy Red Chilies With Instant Pot Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant onion soup mix | 1 package vanilla pudding mix, i use lipton brand | 4 cups chicken broth, i use low sodium | 1 cup red onion, sliced, i use white | 1/4 cup sweet bell pepper, chopped | 1 -2 hot red chilies, chopped
instructions: Toast the onion soup mix into a small casserole dish that is just large enough to hold the ingredients, or with 2 tbsp water. Bring to boil in a medium sized saucepan then slowly whisk in broth. Simmer on medium heat for 5 minutes. Add red onion, sweet pepper and hot chilies. Cook for 20 minutes on medium low. You may add a bit more broth if it looks dry. After 20 minutes, give sauce an stir and taste, or chill for up to 8 hours. Serve hot or warm.

title: Cajun Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Combine the seasonings and grind to a fine powder. Store in an airtight glass jar.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,sage leaf,yellow cornmeal,kidney bean,neufchatel cheese,chili pepper flake,chilies
title: Spicy Bean Croquettes
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 3/4 cups neufchatel cheese | 1/2 cup chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 cups canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed well | 2 teaspoons orange zest ( optional ) | 2 dried chilies | 6 sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a bowl, mix cornmeal, cheese, chili flakes, beans, orange peel, and chili peppers. Using your hands, roll mixture into 2 1/2 inch balls. Roll balls in cornmeal mixture and place on parchment lined cookie sheets. Using toothpicks or scissors, snip sage into 2 inch long slivers, and poke a few slits in the top of the croquettes to prevent sticking. Bake in preheated oven about 8 to 10 minutes, or until light brown.

title: Lamb Shanks and Lentils with Tangy Yogurt Sauce W-Leks
ingredients: 1 cup chinese cabbage, diagonally sliced | 3 large lamb shanks, frenched with bone | 3 2/3 cups lentils | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 3 tablespoons tangy dijon chicken flavored sauce | 2/3 cup heavy cream or 2/3 cup yogurt, greek is the best flavor, i substitute reduced fat | sweet and sour sauce, of choice
instructions: Preheat oven to 475ºf. Spray a 8 x 4 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Spread lentils on the bottom of the baking dish and set aside. Rinse lamb shanks and put aside,. Place lamb shanks on top of dill sprigs in roasting dish and then sprinkle chili powder on the lamb shank. Pour dressing over all and let stand at room temperature for an hour. Place a roasting rack on top of the rack and position the dish in an oven with the rack so that it comes up the side of the dish. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes. Remove lamb shanks from the dish and serve in bowls. You can substitute any meat or vegetable combination of meat or vegetable combination for lamb meat if you prefer.

title: Spanish Lamb Wraps
ingredients: 1 tablespoon island dressing | 1 tablespoon small bacon fat or 1 tablespoon chippy bacon bits | 2 lbs lamb shoulder | 2 poblano chiles ( fresh if frozen, thaw after roasting ) | 1/2 cup low-fat chunky salsa | 6 tablespoons capers | 4 hoagie rolls ( or more, depending on how much filling you like )
instructions: Heat up dressing in a skillet and sautee garlic, onion and chile until translucent. Add lamb, saute and cook 3 - 5 minutes on each side. Set lamb aside. Rinse peppers and slice in half down middle, and remove seeds and membrane. Cut each half into 10 equal pieces. Set a piece of lamb in the middle of each bun. Cover with chunky salsa and roll the stuffed bun. Set the rolled up rolled up lamb in an extra serving dish and drizzle generously with any leftover dressing. Serve at once.

title: Chinese-Style Chicken Rice Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked jasmine rice | 1/2 cup cooked chicken, chopped | 1/2 cup red capsicum, sliced | 1/4 cup iceberg lettuce, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and allow to sit for five minutes. Form into four wraps. Serve with a crisp lettuce leaf.

title: Japanese Wasabi Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup cashew nuts | 1 teaspoon wasabi or 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 3 tablespoons cognac
instructions: Preheat the broiler and spread the nuts well on a baking sheet. Broil, turning nuts 3 or 4 times until the nuts are fragrant and lightly toasted through and they start to crisp a bit, 15 - 20 minutes. Stir to cool and grind nuts into fine textured powder using an electric coffee grinder or food processor. Add wasabi and mix. Store in a cool, dry place for up to 4 weeks.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,gingerroot,physalis fruit,icing sugar,lemon pepper seasoning,water,beet
title: Ginger and Beet Relish
ingredients: 4 stalks parsalis fruit, such as english beet, peeled, cored and sliced 1 inch | 1 kg beet ( about 3 cups ) | 1 small head of cabbage | 4 liters water | 1 -2 lemon pepper seasoning ( if available ) | 1 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot | icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Place beetroot and beet slices in a large bowl and cover with water. Bring to a boil over a high heat, then reduce to medium, cover and simmer for 1 hour. After 1 hour, add cabbage and beetroot/beet mixture and cook for 1 hour longer until liquid has been reduced to approximately 1/4 cup, stirring regularly. Remove from heat and stir in lemon pepper seasoning and gingerroot. Serve with brown bread and butter.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,watermelon,caper,bell pepper,queso fresco,guinness stout
title: Cafe Rio Red Bell Pepper Gazpacho With Corn & Black Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups guinness, divided | 1/8 cup red curry paste ( or 2 tsp. garlic powder and 1/2 tsp. salt ) | 2 cups watermelon | 1/2 cup bell pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup capers | 2 ounces queso fresco, crumbled ( optional )
instructions: Place 1/4 cup guinness into blender with 1/4 cup of water. Blend on high for 2 minutes until smooth. Pour into large pitcher. Remove any seeds and stems from the bell pepper and dice into 1/2 inch pieces. Put into pitcher. Place 1/4 cup guinness into blender with 1/4 cup of water, remaining 1/4 cup guinness, and chopped red pepper. Blend on high for 6 seconds. Add remaining guinness and blend on high for 10 seconds. Add capers and queso fresco. Blend on high for 1 minute until incorporated. Refrigerate until serving. If desired, garnish with cilantro.

title: Frijoles Negros
ingredients: 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup lentils | 3 tablespoons vegetable broth | 3 tablespoons rum extract ( optional ) | 1 can kidney beans, drained
instructions: Cover raisins and lentils with hot water.

title: Pierogies
ingredients: plain yogurt | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons cider
instructions: Combine your favourite dry ingredients. Mix together and serve over plain or chilled yoghurt or yoghurt crème fraiche.

title: Rice Bread with White Vinegar and Pickles
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked white rice | 6 kaiser rolls | 1/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place rice into a large skillet or dutch oven, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the rice is evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Cover, and set aside to steam until the rice has cooked for 50 minutes. Cut kaiser rolls in half lengthwise. Place on a baking sheet, and toast in the oven, until evenly browned. Flip the rolls over, sprinkle the tops with white vinegar, and continue cooking until the bottoms of the rolls are browned, about 10 minutes, more. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 145 degrees f. Remove from oven, let cool for 5 minutes, and slice into quarters.

title: Wild Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 2 cups light zinfandel, chilled ( white wine ) | 1 cup shredded light zinfandel, chilled ( white wine ) | 1/3 cup portabella mushroom, sliced thin ( wild mushroom ) | 1/4 cup shredded light yellow portabella mushroom, chilled | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup mild chunky salsa | shredded lettuce, such as parisian cole
instructions: Note, prep time does not include chilling time. Lightly toss zinfandel and portobello mushroom slices in a bowl with the oregano. Toss mushroom mixture in the zinfandel and salsa. Cover, refrigerate 20 minutes. Before serving, mix well, refrigerate uncovered. Serve at room temperature but not chilled, preferably in a chilled bowl.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,pimento olive,button mushroom,shiitake mushroom,mustard seed
title: Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 button mushrooms | 1 medium onion, diced | 8 slices shiitake mushrooms | 1 pimento stuffed olive | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Saute mushrooms in a little oil. Add the mushrooms and onion and saute until mushrooms are soft. Add mustard seeds and let cook until the color of the onions changes to a redish color. Serve.

title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 jar rotel tomatoes | 1 cup chopped broccoli floret | 1 cup quick oatmeal | 10 chicken wings | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to broil. Place chicken wings in a baking pan and rub with olive oil. Spray with cooking spray. Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes. Turn over and bake 5 minutes longer. In a small bowl, combine tomatoes, onion, broccoli and oatmeal. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add 1/2 to 1 cup of the tomato mixture to the chicken mixture, toss. Place the skillet over high heat until hot. Add chicken to skillet and cook 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,pear,pine nut,creme fraiche,italian parsley,shell pasta,green pepper
title: Tartiflette (Sweet Cheese Pasta Salad)
ingredients: 400 g shell pasta | 125 g creme fraiche or 125 g thick sour cream | 100 g green peppers, chopped ( capsicum ) | 100 g pears, chopped ( a small can of pear halves ) | 100 g pecorino cheese, grated ( a small block of aged provolone cheese ) | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, chopped ( or 2 teaspoons dried parsley ) | 1 package frozen phyllo dough
instructions: Cook pasta in large saucepan of boiling salted water for 1 minute.

title: Apple Cordon Bleu
ingredients: 12 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons minced pimiento | 1 tart apple, peeled, cored and sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Place chicken in a baking dish. Combine soy sauce and pimento. Pour sauce over chicken. Top with apple slices. Bake, 30 - 40 minutes.

title: Stuffed Dates
ingredients: 12 dates | 1/3 cup romano cheese, grated fine | 1 can water chestnuts | water ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f brush each date with romano cheese. Remove pits. Stuff each date with cheese and water chestnuts by inserting a funnel under the stem and spooning stuffing in each date. Place on baking tray and bake for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,lemon zest,chorizo sausage,kitchen bouquet,pepperoni,salsa,tomato
title: Chef John's Famous Chili Dogs
ingredients: 1 pound kitchen bouquet, or more to taste | 1/2 cup salsa | 1 pound fresh chorizo sausage | 2 cans whole peeled tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1 lemon, zest of | salt and black pepper to taste | 1 package pepperoni
instructions: In a dutch oven or large pot, cook the chorizo in the salsa until it has released most of its fat, and has turned dark brown color. Remove from the heat. Transfer to a blender, or food processor, and add the tomatoes, lemon zest, salt, and pepper. Cover, and puree until smooth. Return mixture to the dutch oven or pot, and reheat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,dark corn syrup,table salt,ginger garlic paste,onion
title: Sweet and Spicy Gingerbread
ingredients: 1 loaf crusty italian bread ( such as sourdough round or sweet bread ) | 1/2 cup dark corn syrup | 1 medium sweet onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | table salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Cut off top half of loaf and gently squeeze out excess juices, forming a loaf about 1 1/2 x 1 1/2 inches. Starting at the top of the loaf, cut loaf into 1 inch cubes. In a medium saucepan, combine corn syrup, onion, ginger garlic paste and salt. Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring often. Add bread, reduce heat to low and cook for 10 minutes. Pour warm syrup mixture evenly into bread and bake for at least 30 minutes or until bread is crusty and crispy. Remove bread from oven and let cool for about 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Quick Guacamole and Avocado Appetizer
ingredients: 1 1/2 medium avocados, peeled, seeded and mashed | 1/2 teaspoon green pepper, finely diced
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the avocado and pepper. Enjoy.

title: Soda Noodles (Oriental Style)
ingredients: 4 ounces rice noodles ( oriental style ) | 0.333 can soda water | 1 slice fresh ginger-garlic paste | topping, of your choice, as desired
instructions: In a medium size pan put the soda water in to a small sauce pan. Mix well before adding to your serving bowl. Once the soda water is about halfway at a rolling boil, add the noodles to the pan and stir to coat the noodles and prevent sticking. When both the noodles and the soda water are at a rolling boil, drain the noodles well and rinse them well under warm water. Then toss noodles and soda water in to the serving bowl. Place topping in to a shallow dish and serve.

Random Ingredients: mustard green,cheddar cheese,italian seasoning,saffron,topping,simple syrup,lemon wedge,wheat flour
title: Easy Cheesy Saffron Wedges
ingredients: 1 packet saffron ( not compound bouquet ) | 12 -15 fresh saffron rounds ( at least 1-inch diameter ) | 1/2 cup low-fat cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mustard greens | lemon wedge | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | topping, of your choice ( optional ) | plain whole wheat flour, for dusting
instructions: If using dry threads, place them in a bag and add boiling water. Give them a quick stir, seal and let sit for 30 min then drain water. Crumble into small pieces. Coating, mix all the ingredients together in a small bowl. Sprinkle topping mixture over the toms before refrigerating for a few hours for flavours to develop. Dry the whole wheat flour in a pan, or in a small dry frying pan, and bring to a simmer. Continue frying for about 5 min until the flour is translucent, then lower heat and simmer uncovered until thick.

Random Ingredients: white rice,balsamic vinegar,jalapeno juice,red cayenne pepper
title: Crazy Rice (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 can jalapeno juice | 1 cup cooked white rice | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine vinegar, jalapeno juice, rice, and red pepper in crock pot. Cover and cook on high setting 8 hours.

title: Mongolian Oysters
ingredients: 24 oysters, shucked | gorgonzola ( can use goat cheese ) | ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Preheat grill or broiler. Lightly coat a shallow pan with canola oil spray. Place oysters in pan and scatter top side with gorgonzola. Broil until cheese has melted and oysters are sizzling, 5 to 7 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Beurre Asparagus and Marinated Mushrooms in Pecorino-Romano Blend
ingredients: 6 cremini mushrooms | 4 pieces asparagus | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 10 ounces crumbled pecorino romano cheese | 12 spears pecorino-romano cheese
instructions: Slice mushrooms into 1/2 slices. Trim tips from tips of asparagus, set aside. Heat heavy skillet over medium high heat until very hot. Place pecorino cheese in center of skillet and tilt skillet to distribute cheese evenly. Turn skillet to low. Heat golden syrup, stir until blended, then pour into skillet. Cook over medium heat until hot and bubbly, about 2 or 3 minutes. Place asparagus on a plate with a lid and cover to keep warm. Sprinkle mushrooms with pecorino cheese and toss together. Place 1 tablespoon cheese in center of each of 6 serving plates and place a slice of asparagus over the cheese. Place one third asparagus in center of each plate.

title: Wasabi-Cured Beef Steak
ingredients: 1/4 cup wasabi powder ( kewpie's japanese dipping sauce ) | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 1/2 cup beef chuck, trimmed and cubed
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together wasabi, vinegar and beef. Cover bowl and refrigerate the meat for about 5 hours before using, flipping at least once during that time. Thread the beef onto skewers and reserve any remaining marinade.

Random Ingredients: celery leaf,chicken wing,golden syrup,onion powder,date,red onion,apple juice
title: Harry's Glazed Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 chicken wings ( i use 6 wings and 9 wings or equivalent ) | 1 small onion, sliced very thinly | 8 ounces golden syrup | 8 ounces apple juice | 1 teaspoon celery leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon dried dates, chopped
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 300 degrees. Place an oven safe dish in the oven. Place the chicken wings in a single layer on the dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the pieces of chicken. Bake in the pre heated oven for about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,cavatappi pasta,vanilla ice cream,rice,sun tomato oil,cauliflower
title: Guinness and Cauliflower Rice Bake
ingredients: 500 g guinness stout, light | 1 1/2 liters vanilla ice cream ( vanilla flavour best ) | 2 cans cauliflower, drained, florets cut into florets | 100 -250 g uncooked capelli pasta or 100 -250 g cavatappi pasta | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 125 g raw rice, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c, grease a 1 litre ovenproof dish with 1 tbsp oil. Warm the guinness stout in a medium pot, add the cauliflower and cook over a medium heat until almost cooked through, stirring often. Remove from the heat, stir in the capelli and sun dried tomatoes and season. Spread the rice in the dish, pour the guinness/cauliflower mixture into the dish and bake at 180c for 30 - 45 mins until the cauliflower is cooked and the rice is golden. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Cheese and Sausages Skewers
ingredients: 4 sausages ( johnsonville recommended ) | 1/3 cup chili oil | 1 lb american cheese, grated | 8 -10 shiitake mushrooms, stems removed ( optional )
instructions: Wipe sausages with paper towels. Cut off ends of sausages. Slice sausage on a diagonal.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,chinese five spice powder,honey mustard
title: Chinese 5-Spice Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons asian five spice powder | 3 tablespoons honey mustard | 2 heads romaine lettuce
instructions: Mix 4 tablespoons of the five spice powder and 3 tablespoons of honey mustard together in a mixing bowl. Stir well until mixture is well incorporated. Rinse and dry the lettuce leaves then drain very well and cut into quarters. Toss lettuce with remaining 5 spice blend and stir well until lettuce is well coated. Serve and enjoy.

title: Easy Thai Style Wings
ingredients: 8 chicken legs ( thighs ) | 8 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Place chicken legs in shallow dish or bowl. Turn to coat. Marinate chicken in soy sauce overnight. Turn until no longer pink and drain. Bake at 325°f for 45 minutes. Turn and bake till golden. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,meat,maple syrup,vermouth,egg white,asafoetida powder,monterey jack cheese
title: Sopa De Queso - Mexican Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground meat | 2 egg whites ( room temp if desired ) | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon minced jalapeno pepper | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth or 2 tablespoons dry white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degress f. Mix meat, egg whites, maple syrup, asafoetida, jalapeno, and cheese in a bowl with a wooden spoon. Mix well. Add the vermouth or wine, and mix again, making sure it is no lumps. Form into an oval loaf shape approx 8 x 5 or larger. If using a loaf pan, place loaf in pan. Bake until heated through. Serve with warm bread and enjoy.

title: Lorilyn's Famous Chicken and Potatoes
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 4 large red potatoes | 2 tablespoons shortening | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 cans salmon, drained, flaked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Lay the chicken breasts out on a cutting board and slice about 1/2 inch thick slices. Place slices in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cut potatoes in half, then cut halves in half again. Place in dish just to cover the chicken and potatoes. In a small bowl, melt the shortening in a saucepan. Stir in hot sauce. Pour over the chicken and potatoes. Bake in the preheated oven for 2 hours, or until chicken is easily shredted.

Random Ingredients: cream,cooking oil,sunflower oil vegetable,taco seasoning mix,red curry paste,cheese,campbell cream celery soup,potato pierogies
title: Tasty Potato Pierogies  #RSC
ingredients: cooking oil | 3 tablespoons sunflower oil or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 can campbell cream of celery soup | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil or 2 tablespoons other light oil | 1 can campbell cream of potato pierogies | 2 tablespoons instant minced potato pierogies | 1 jar cooking oil, for sauteing | 1 1/4 cups shredded cheese ( such as colby jack or white cheddar )
instructions: If you use a regular deep fryer, heat it to 375 degrees. In a deep, heavy bottomed skillet, heat the 1 tbls. Of oil until a deep fry thermometer reaches 350 degrees.. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix the 1 1/4 cups shredded cheese with the taco seasoning, the 1 can campbell cream of potato soup, 2 tbls. Of oil, 2 tbls. Of minced potato pierogies, and 2 1/4 cups of cooking oil. Mix well. Dip the pierogies into the oil so they are coated, then fry them in batches. When the pierogies are crispy and have lost their raw look and texture, transfer them onto a paper towel lined plate to drain. Place back in the oil and fry the pierogies until they are golden in color, adding the last splash of oil if they become too dry. Sprinkle over the remaining cheese and serve.

title: Smoked Salmon and Cheddar Baked Cheese
ingredients: 2 salmon steaks | 4 ounces smoked cheddar cheese or 4 ounces colby cheese | 2 fluid ounces apple juice | 20 sage leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Slice each salmon steak into 2 - 3 slices. Sprinkle the cheese and apple juice evenly over the salmon, then place the slices onto a shallow baking dish for 15 minutes. Remove and bake for 5 minutes or until the cheese has melted. Remove the sage and serve straight away.

title: Cancun-Style Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 red cabbage, outer leaves removed | 1/4 cup grated orange peel | 1/8 cup sherry wine | sour cream | bananas, slices ( or berries to garnish )
instructions: Shred the cabbage into tiny shreds. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the cabbage shreds, orange peel and sherry. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring often until the cabbage are wilted, 1 - 2 minutes. Garnish your dish with a few warm bananas or berries.

Random Ingredients: star anise,chicken breast,radish,white wine vinegar,grain rice,oil,chocolate chip,salmon
title: Smoked Salmon Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skinless chicken breasts | 1 star anise ( whole ) | 4 ounces white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup rice | 1/2 cup oil | 1/2 cup miniature chocolate chip | radish, sliced | radish, halves
instructions: Wash chicken breast with cold water, rinse under cold water and pat dry. Cut into 4 pieces and set aside. In a small skillet, toast anise. Pour the smoke out of the grill and set aside. Combine the vinegar and rice in a blender.

title: Sweet and Sour Turkey Breast Wrapped in Spicy Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs turkey, boneless | 2 1/2 tablespoons agar-agar powder | 1 cup of greek date, stoned & chopped | 2 1/2 cups of garnished greek yogurt or 2 1/2 cups sour cream | 10 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 1/2 tablespoons white flour | 2 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh cilantro
instructions: Cut the turkey into strips about the length of the body. Mix all the marinade ingredients together in a baking dish or marinator. Take the turkey strips and marinade for about an hour or more. Preheat the oven to 220 c then remove the turkey from the marinade. Add the turkey into the baking dish and coat with the spiced yogurt sauce. Put the tray in the oven and cook for 30 minutes or until the juices run clear. Put the turkey slices on a plate and cover with aluminium foil. Keep it warm inside the dish while you work, to help it stay moist and moist. Serve with fresh bread and salad.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,chorizo sausage,peanut butter,oregano,chicken tenderloin,campari
title: Crockpot Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs chicken tenderloins | 1/4 cup peanut butter, creamy consistency | 1 teaspoon chorizo sausage | 1 can campari | 1 can diced green chili peppers | 1 pinch oregano ( optional )
instructions: Remove any string from chicken. Toss with rest of ingredients, except chilies, except chilies, in crockpot. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours, stirring every 20 minutes or so.

title: Baked Savory Cauliflower and Reuben
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 cup flour | 4 cups sauerkraut, undrained | 1/2 cup white miso | 2 -4 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 2 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 lb brown rice, cooked
instructions: Place cauliflower in the bottom of a large baking dish. Topping and ending with the cheese, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all ingredients together and pour over the cauliflower. Bake 1 hour, covering last 10 - 15 minutes to brown the top. Let rest, serving immediately..

title: Fenugreek Powder
ingredients: 1 cup toasted ground fenugreek seeds | 2/3 cup rice wine or 2/3 cup dry sherry
instructions: Combine fenugreek seeds and rice wine in a large, heavy saucepan. Cover with water. Place over high heat. Heat until it begins to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Transfer to a spice mill. Use a mortar and pestle to grind until smooth. Stir into fenugreek powder. Store in a dry airtight container for up to one month.

title: Brazilian Style Steak With Green Chili and Tomatillo Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sweet unsweetened cocoa | 2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks | 1 can chopped green chili-infused tomatoes with liquid, undrained | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 2 tablespoons coarsely ground black dried unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/2 pints natural tomatillos, husks removed
instructions: Heat heavy large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.. Add sweet unsweetened cocoa.

title: Chipotle Fruit Salsa
ingredients: 3 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1 lb mixed fresh fruit, such as mango, grapeseed and figs, stems removed
instructions: Heat a non nonstick wok or nonstick skillet over high heat. When the pan is hot, add the chipotle peppers and saute until dark brown spots appear on the top, 1 to 2 minutes. With a spatula, remove the pan from the heat. Working quickly, cut off the chiles and discard them. Using damp hands, remove the blackened tops. Set the chiles aside. In a bowl, combine the chipotle peppers, fruit and reserved chipotle peppers. Let sit until cool, about 15 minutes. Stir. Store the salsa in clean, dry jars in the refrigerator.

title: Chile Ancho Smokes
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili ( pureed chile ) | 2 small plum ( de-seeded ) tomatoes or 2 small plum ( de-seeded ) tomatoes, finely chopped | 1 small clove ( minced or pressed ) | 1 small head of garlic, minced | 3/4 cup celery, finely chopped | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/3 cup dried ancho chilies
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and mix thoroughly. Store in a tightly covered container in refrigerator for up to 8 weeks.

title: Easy tasty Steaks
ingredients: 6 tablespoons pesto sauce | 6 steaks | 1 bunch fresh coriander | 1 bunch fresh courgette | 1 bunch fresh fruit | 1 cup soft brown sugar
instructions: In a hot, oven proof pan put the pesto. Toss the steak, meat and vegetables all around. Pour over the pesto. Sprinkle over the sugar. Grill until the meat is cooked to your liking, then turn and bake. You can add a little more sugar to balance the flavour of the meat.

title: Cardamom-Pepper Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk, plus additional for greasing dish | 3 cardamom seeds | 1 cup portabella mushroom, stems removed | 8 whole free range eggs | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons ground pecans or 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1 roasting chickens or 2 duck breasts, skin removed
instructions: In a large measuring cup or bowl, combine the buttermilk, cardamom and mushrooms with enough water to form a cup to measure 6 cups.

title: Bacon Star Anise With Star Anise in
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, rind trimmed | 3 star anise
instructions: Place 3 pieces of bacon on a piece of foil and wrap it in the foil to catch any extra air. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350 f for 10 minutes until crisp. Remove from oven and set aside until cooled. Remove the star anise pods with the slices facing the foil. Place in paper bag with 5 star anise pieces and secure with a tooth pick. Open the foil and pack back the bacon and star anise. Serve with plain tea, wine or coffee.

title: Cheesy Scallions
ingredients: 4 scallions, cleaned, chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shredded gouda cheese | 3/4 - 1 cup milk or 3/4-1 cup cream
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f. Mix scallions, cheese and milk/cream together. Spread on a piece of foil sprayed with a non stick cooking spray. Bake at 450°f for 8 - 11 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,chicken breast,tomato sauce,lard,chickpea flour,vegetable broth
title: Wild Rice Soup
ingredients: 1 lb wild rice | 1 cup chickpea flour | 1 tablespoon lard | 1 1/4 cups chicken breasts or 1 1/4 cups other meat | 32 ounces vegetarian tomato sauce | 32 ounces veggie broth
instructions: Wash wild rice. Place rice in boiling water for one hour, drain and rinse with fresh water. Add chickpea flour and lard and stir until dissolved. Pour over wild rice and mix gently. Bring to boil, reduce heat and cover and simmer until rice is tender, about 40 minutes. Using immersion blender, blend soup until smooth. Add tomato sauce gradually, blending constantly. When rice is tender, taste and adjust seasonings with kosher salt. Serve with rice.

title: Sweet Beef, Horseradish and Fennel Toast
ingredients: 2 lbs trimmed lean beef chuck or 2 lbs blade steak, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb thinly sliced rare hamburger | 1/4 cup horseradish | 1/4 cup firmly packed light brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon dried fennel bulb, crushed | 12 slices of firm white bread, crusts removed | 8 slices thickly sliced thickly sliced thickly sliced thickly sliced top round beef ( such as texas toast )
instructions: Toss half the sliced meat with the horseradish, sugar, cayenne pepper, fennel, bread, and any accumulated juices. Grill the meat and top with the remaining sliced meat and horseradish mixture. Grill the meat over hot coals or under the broiler, turning once, until internal temperature is 140 °f, 15 to 16 minutes.

title: Figs With Sultanas and Cardamom
ingredients: 2 lbs dried mission figs, well washed | 3/4 cup sultana ( golden raisins ) | 3 tablespoons candied cherries, diced | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom, freshly ground | lettuce, shredded
instructions: Place figs in a large bowl, add enough hot water to cover. Cover and let stand at room temperature while preparing sultanas. Cook sultanas in a large, well boiling saucepan of boiling water 5 minutes. Drain. Mix sultanas with candied cherries in a bowl. In separate pans soak sultanas in enough hot water to cover, turning frequently and pressing with a spatula, until they plump. Drain well and remove pits. Dissolve sugar in hot water, add sultanas and cardamom and boil uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning. Divide figs among plates. Spoon sultanas over and serve with shredded lettuce.

title: Virgin Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup mango juice ( i prefer major grey mango smoothie ) | 1 cup cranberry juice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a glass preserving jar and shake well to combine. Use a funnel to pour the juice into a jar to cool, just before serving.

title: Cheese and Olive Side Spread
ingredients: 1 cup manchego cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup black olives, sliced ( or chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder ( white is fine too ) | 1 package manchego cheese, chopped
instructions: Combine cheese and black olives. Mix well. Add mustard powder and mix well until cheese is melted. Spread on toast, broil or use as a spread for crackers.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,chipotle chile adobo,cream mushroom soup,ice water,bay seasoning
title: Frozen Parsnip Hash
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs parsnips | 1 package cream of mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 2 -3 cups ice cream ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons old bay seasoning
instructions: Trim parsnips and cut into chunks, but do not peel. Cut into chunks no bigger than parsnips. Steam the parsnips until tender. Drain well. While still hot, mash with cream of mushroom soup and parsley. Mix in chipotle and old bay seasoning. Pour into a 9x13 cake pan sprayed lightly with a pam cooking spray and spread evenly. Freeze overnight or at least 3 hours. Serve over ice cream.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,chicken,chinese cabbage,ginger root,pasta shell,red wine,heavy cream,chicken bouillon cube
title: Pasta With Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground chicken | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh ginger root | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup red wine | 1 cup heavy cream | 3 cups cooked and shredded chinese cabbage | 2 cups thinly sliced chinese cabbage | 1 package cooked pasta shells
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, add chicken, ginger root and bouillon cube. Cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Pour in wine and cook until almost all liquid evaporates, about 1 minute. Stir in cream and 1 cup shredded cabbage. Cook until heated through. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with remaining shredded cabbage and cooked noodles. Serve.

title: Grilled Snow Peas And Nuts
ingredients: 3 ounces snow peas | 2 ounces roasted hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 2 medium tomatoes, roughly chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil | 2 tablespoons mexican blend cheese, finely grated | 1 small sugar cube
instructions: Place snow peas in a small bowl. Place the tomatoes and hazelnuts over the snow pea mixture and season with dried basil.

title: Simple Batch Apple Cider Gravy
ingredients: 2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Heat to a simmer. Serve hot.

title: Simple French Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs french beans, rinsed and trimmed | 1 tablespoon capers
instructions: Cook beans over medium heat with capers for 15 minutes or until tender. Drain and reserve broth through a sieve. Place beans in serving bowl and serve.

title: Crispy Chips
ingredients: 1 lb coarse salt pork, diced | 1 lb baby spinach, cleaned and coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 dozen confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Add salt pork to a large, heavy roasting pan. Add chopped spinach to pan. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar. Spread out the mixture evenly onto the spinach. Bake for 35 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Artichoke Curry
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts | 4 marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 8 pickled whole green chilies, including juice | 8 large curry leaves
instructions: Remove skin from chicken breasts. Remove flesh from bones and dice chicken breasts. Combine chicken and marinade ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Strip curry leaves from stems and mix with chicken. Cover bowl with plastic wrap. Refrigerate and marinade chicken for at least 2 hours. Preheat grill to medium high heat. Place chicken skewers on hot grid and cook approximately 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,vegemite,puff pastry,cottage cheese,white pepper,head cauliflower
title: Easy and Delicious Vegetarian Lasagna
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower | 1 tablespoon vegan ground vegemite | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 sheet puff pastry | 1/3 cup cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place a steamer insert into a large bowl and fill with water to just below the bottom of the bowl. Bring water to a boil and blanch the cauliflower until just tender, about 5 minutes. Drain, then set aside. In a bowl, stir together the vegemite, garlic powder, white pepper, and cottage cheese.

title: English Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 slices firm white bread | fresh strawberries, about 5oz ( about 3 cups ) | sherry ( optional, i like it without ) | allspice ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the broiler, or preheat the flat grill, on high. Place the bread slices on a cutting board or cookie sheet. Using a fork, mash the dried fruit with the allspice. Drizzle on the sherry. Cut each slice of bread into 8 finger shaped slices. Broil until golden brown, 5 - 7 minutes, turning once.

title: Noodles With Udon
ingredients: 1 lb udon noodles ( dry ) | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt ( optional )
instructions: Cook the dry udon noodles according to package directions and drain when done. Drain and rinse again with cold water. Pour noodles into a warm serving bowl and toss with salt if using. Top with a small amount of udon sauce. Serve.

title: Basic Moroccan Bread
ingredients: 3 cups whole almonds ( about 10 ounces ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Heat your oven to 350°f butter two 10 inch sandwich pans or a loaf pan. Toast the almonds in a single layer, shaking the pans or shaking the pan frequently for even coloring, 7 to 10 minutes. Move the toasted almonds to a small bowl and sprinkle with 2 teaspoons yeast. Set aside in a warm place for 10 minutes. Pour off some of the hot almonds and place somewhere warm to raise an oven temperature. Put oven rack in middle of oven. Place pans or loaf pan on rack. Place in preheated oven. Turn oven off.

title: Sausage and Tomato Bake
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet italian sausage | 2 cans stewed tomatoes ( not drained ) | 1 teaspoon salt ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried fennel ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease 9 x 13 baking dish. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Sear the sausage, breaking it up as it cooks. Drain if necessary. Turn heat to low. Pour stewed tomatoes into skillet and pour into baking dish. Add salt and fennel to taste. Bake in oven until onions are deep golden brown, about one hour.

title: Baked Zucchini and Apricot Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs zucchini, cut lengthwise in half and then cross-wise into 1/2 inch rounds | 4 large radishes, cut into 1/2 inch slices ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup dried apricot, soaked in warm water for 20 minutes or 1/2 cup raisins and chopped | 1 bottle dark beer, such as miller lite | 1 small lemons or 1 small lime, juice and zest of or 1 small grapefruit, juice of or 1 small orange, juice and zest of | hot cooked pasta, such as macaroni or rotini
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a baking sheet with foil and set aside. Place the zucchini, radishes, apricots and beer in a large mixing bowl. Stir in lemon, juice and zest, stir well. Spoon the zucchini mixture into a baking pan. Drizzle about 1/2 inch of the zucchini mixture over the zucchini mixture. Bake until the zucchini mixture is tender and the zucchini is slightly browned, about 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and serve at once. Garnish with lemon wedges or sliced oranges or grapefruit slices.

title: Bovril Potatoes from Iceland
ingredients: 3 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 can low sodium beef broth ( low salt preferred ) | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: Place pot over medium low heat until hot, about 5 minute stir in broth and cumin. Cover and increase heat to medium.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,fish sauce,wheat germ,beef stew meat,green bell pepper,mincemeat,tomato paste
title: Quick Beef Burgers With Chilli & Tomato
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-sodium tomato passata ( rice bran ) | 1/4 cup low-fat mincemeat | 1/4 cup wheat germ or 1/4 cup coarsely ground wheat germ | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh tomato juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Shape mixture into four burger patties. Lightly oil grill and grill burgers over hot coals for 15 minutes turning once or twice.

Random Ingredients: salmon,curry powder,green pepper,kalamata olive,yam,pico de gallo,green chili pepper,hot chili pepper
title: Baked Salmon with Pina Colada Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup pico de gallo | 2 medium yams, peeled, cut in wedges | 2 lbs thick salmon, in one-inch cubes | 2 medium chilies, sliced | 2 tablespoons dried pimento-stuffed green chili peppers, minced | 1/2 medium green pepper, finely chopped | 3/4 cup pitted kalamata olive, coarsely chopped | 3 -4 teaspoons mild curry powder | 1/2 cup pico de gallo ( to garnish )
instructions: To make the salad, in medium baking dish, arrange yams in a thin layer.

title: Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: 15 ounces frozen blueberries ( thawed ) | 1/4 cup quick-cooking wine
instructions: Cook and stir thawed blueberries in cooking wine in saucepan over medium high heat until boiling, about 3 minutes drain sauce.

title: Vietnamese Spring Salad
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin matchsticks | 1 cucumber, cut into thin matchsticks | 1 tablespoon angostura bitters
instructions: Place all ingredients into a salad bowl, and toss lightly. Sprinkle with angostura bitters to serve.

Random Ingredients: topping,pistachio,chocolate chip,cauliflower,rigatoni pasta,corn oil,vanilla essence,red chile
title: Chilli and Pistachio Riggies
ingredients: 350 g rigatoni pasta or 350 g other long pasta | 4 red chile | 200 g pistachios | 100 g icing sugar or 100 g icing sugar, for dusting | 500 ml corn oil | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 large red chiles, whole | 1 can sweetened condensed milk or ( 13 g ) can reduced sweetened condensed milk, drained | 200 g grated semisweet chocolate pieces | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Soak the cauliflower florets for about an hour in boiling water, drain and dry well. Cut off the ends of the chillies and then peel out the seeds, taking care to leave the centre open. Chop the chillies finely, then place in a small pan with 5 10ml water, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes until the sauce has reduced and become thick. Stir through the powdered pistachios until coated. Add 2 tbsp of the corn oil and a pinch of salt. Heat the oil in a large frying pan or wok until very hot but not smoking. Fry the pistachios for 1 minute or until they colour. Add the chillies, then stir fry for 5 - 7 minutes until they lose all of their crispness. Add the sweetened condensed milk, stirring well until smooth. Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes until the mixture changes colour, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat and stir in the vanilla essence. Pour the cooked pasta into a wide, well seasoned dish. Spread the cauliflower mixture evenly over the buttered pasta. Top the ‘riggies’ with the pistachios. Dust with a little sesame seeds if you wish. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Chinese Red Wine Watercress
ingredients: 3 cups red wine ( preferably shaoxing ) | 2 cans sliced water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring gently. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for approximately 30 minutes or until mixture becomes thick.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,nigella seed,lime zest,butternut squash,coriander,chicken breast half,english cucumber
title: South African Grilled Chicken Salad With Butternut Squash
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut in half | 1 english cucumber, cut in quarters lengthwise, then into half moons | 1 zucchini, halved lengthwise, then cut into 1 cm nighths | 2 teaspoons nigella seeds, toasted | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1 lime, zest of | 4 tablespoons peanut butter, to taste | coriander, to serve
instructions: Place the chicken and vegetables in a shallow plastic dish, add the nigella and toasted sesame seeds and toss. Add the peanut butter and toss a few times.
