Preheat the grill to medium, line the grill with the grates and line with tin foil. Place the chicken on the hot grate and cook, brushing with the peanut butter once every minute, until cooked and the vegetables are starting to darken, about 4 - 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve with coriander.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,oregano,poppy seed,taco seasoning,hot italian sausage,white sugar,wheat pastry flour,vanilla bean
title: Sausage and Pepper Tarts
ingredients: 2 lbs hot italian sausage | 1/2 white sugar | 1/2 cup green pepper, finely diced | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, seeds scraped | 1/2 cup white sugar mixed with 1 tablespoon of water | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1/2 cup poppy seed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Cut sausage into 2 inch pieces. In a heavy skillet, fry sausage over medium heat for 10 minutes or until browned and crisp. Drain well. Reduce heat, add 1/2 cup sugar and simmer for 5 minutes. Add green pepper, vanilla bean seeds, sugar mixed with water and oregano. Simmer for another 10 minutes. Stir in flour. Line muffin tin with waxed paper. Add a teaspoon of dough or a spoonful of filling into each muffin tin. Cover with waxed paper and freeze until firm, then defrost in oven for 3 to 6 minutes. Remove from freezer and dust tops with a pinch of sugar before removing from tin. These freeze well and do not thaw overnight or in the refrigerator.

title: Roasted Marinade for Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 cup honey | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate in a tightly covered container for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: rack lamb,yogurt,vanilla essence,hot paprika,coconut milk,beef roast,cream mushroom soup
title: Beef Roast Balti
ingredients: 3 lbs fat-trimmed beef roast | 15 ounces coconut milk | 3/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt ( not low fat ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon spicy paprika | 1 teaspoon hot paprika ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place meat in crock pot. Add other spices and stir. Pour over coconut milk. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. After 8 hours, stir. Serve with white rice.

title: Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 lemon, juice of | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, roughly chopped | 1 jalapeno chile, chopped | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: In a medium size bowl, stir together the cream, lemon juice and cilantro with a fork. You may have some liquid left. Place all in a large nonreactive bowl, cover and chill in the refrigerator for several hours or overnight, or until very thick.

title: Kuwaiti Spiced Olives
ingredients: 8 ounces mixed olives | 1/4 cup light muscovado sugar | 6 -8 cloves | 4 green cardamom pods
instructions: Place in a bowl. Cover and leave to marinate in the fridge for 2 hours. Strain. Store in the refrigerator until needed.

title: Chocolate Beef Gravy Sandwich
ingredients: 6 -8 slices dark chocolate | 1 can black beans | 1 can hormel beef gravy | 6 hamburger | buttermilk | 1 teaspoon horseradish
instructions: Melt the chocolate on the top of the double boiler or in a double boiler set over simmering water. Mix the beans together well. Add beef gravy and horseradish. Keep warm. Take out of the heat. Using a ladle, make a small indentation for the hamburger. Fill with some of the warmed chocolate. Serve with buttermilk, and enjoy.

title: Grilled Swiss Chard and Parsnips
ingredients: 1/4 cup onion, cut in wedges | 2 tablespoons finely diced parsley | 1 1/2 cups diced swiss chard | 1/2 1/2 cup small cherry tomatoes ( or halved ) or 1/2 cup grape tomatoes ( or halved ) | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 bay leaf | 3 cups buttermilk
instructions: Place onion in a medium skillet with the parsley. Stirring often, cook until onion is tender, about 4 minutes. Add celery and tomatoes. Cover and cook over moderate heat 5 minutes. Combine mustard and bay leaf. Stir into vegetable mixture. Heat and stir until mixture is warm and lightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Pour mixture into 4 - 6 qt slow cooker. Stir to coat. Increase heat to medium. Cover and cook until bottom layer is browned and slightly crisp, 8 - 10 minutes. Serve immediately or cool to room temperature.

title: Mascarpone
ingredients: 1 cup white flour ( about 3 c. all-purpose ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt ( about 1 clove, about ) | 20 -24 ladyfingers | 1 1/2 cups golden raisins ( for topping )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine flour, 1/2 tsp garlic salt and 1/4 cup raisins or nuts. Coat a 9 x 13 inch dish with cooking spray and dip lady fingers in the batter, coating completely. Arrange coated lady fingers in the dish and sprinkle each with 1 tsp of the garlic salt, if using. Pour remaining raisins on dish and bake at 350 for 40 - 50 minutes, or until browned and bubbly. Turn halfway through cooking.

title: Seared Steak With Spicy Fruit Salad - Kona Kari
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, thinly sliced ( or a sirloin steak of any type ) | 6 ounces bamboo shoots, diced, frozen for 30 minutes is best | 2 slices oranges ( optional ) | 2 slices lemons, thin | 1/4 ounce chinese pickled seedsless tamarind paste, can add another flavor | 1/4 teaspoon achiote ( optional ) | 1/2 cucumber, sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for the beef in a small food processor or blender and process until well blended. Set aside. Slice the sirloin steak thinly against the grain of the beef slice. Slice the beef into thin slices on a diagonal. Marinate the beef slices in the sauce on the counter for one to two hours. Meanwhile, preheat your grill to high. Remove the meat from the marinade and thread it onto the skewers. Brush the meat with the marinade, and cook the meat on both sides until cooked through. Remove the meat from the grill and place on a platter. Add an orange, lemon, and achiote to the hot marinade and mix well so that the flavors spread evenly. Pour fruit and sauce over the beef. Serve with the cucumber tossed with pico de gallo and bread. The dish can be prepared the night before and refrigerated the next day to allow the flavors to mix.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,lemon twist,rye bread,spice,cashew,red chili powder,ciabatta
title: Indian Pork Burger
ingredients: 3 kg pork tenderloin, sliced to 1cm thick & fat free | 3 1/2 cm rye bread ( thick slices ) | 3/4 cup cashews | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 grated lemon twists ( optional ) | red chili powder | crackers or rye bread
instructions: Heat grill and spray with veg. Oil to cook pork. Brush with oil and grill on both sides, browned side and then place on grill and cook till done to your liking. Cool slightly & slice into thick pieces. Spread raw cashew bread with lemon and mixed spice. Spread with the pork mixture and sprinkle with chilli powder and nuts or crackers.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,hamburger,anise seed,baking soda,star anise,fast rising yeast,mackerel,salt water
title: Anise-Baked Mackerel
ingredients: 3 cups coarse salt water | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1/2 cup peanut oil | 6 slices lean hamburger | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seeds ( heaping ) | 2 star anise ( heaping, bruised with flat of knife ) | 2 whole star anise pods | 2 lbs fresh mackerel, live
instructions: In the bowl of a food processor, combine 1 cup of the salt, 2 cups of the oil and the yeast. Blend. Gradually stir in the remaining 1 cup of salt, oil, remaining yeast mixture. Add the 2 or 3 whole star anise pods and 3 whole anise leaves to the dough. Mix well. Spread the remaining 1 cup of oil into 4 - 12 baking sheets. Wrap the mackerel in cheesecloth and rub with salt. Place on cookie sheets and turn the sheets so that the oil and water coats the mackerel completely. Cover the cookie sheets with a towel and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 375°f remove the cheesecloth from the risen dough and place it on a lightly floured surface. Divide the dough into 16 pieces. Pat into 1 1/2 inch thick rounds and place 3 inches apart on the prepared cookie sheets. Flatten each round with a fork or razor blade. Brush each of the rounds with egg wash, sprinkle with 2 teaspoons of salt and 2 teaspoons paprika. Bake 25 - 30 minutes until the edges are lightly browned. Remove from the oven and let cool on wire racks. Serve warm with jam or aioli.

title: Easy Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 3 cans mushrooms, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger ( i use jarred ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander ( i don't use it ) | 1 -2 cup fresh rose petal, chopped in small pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Prepare the noodles according to package directions and drain. Add all ingredients except the rose petals to a medium size 2 1/2 quart baking dish coated with cooking spray. Do not stir. Cover and bake 30 minutes or until heated through and top is browned. Serve with hot, crusty french bread. Variation, i double the recipe and add 4 to 6 large bunches of assorted fresh vegetables for each meal.

title: Mushroom Gnocchi With Goat's Cheese
ingredients: 3/4 cup fresh parsnip, grated | 1 1/4 cups fresh enoki mushrooms | 1/2 lb soft fresh goat's cheese, such as gorgonzola | 3 cups unbleached white flour, divided
instructions: To prepare the gnocchi, heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a skillet over moderately low heat and add the grated parsnip and mushrooms and cook the mushrooms, stirring, until the gnocchi begins to bind the strands, about 4 minutes. Stir in the grated cheese and then turn the gnocchi out onto a towel lined baking sheet and repeat until all of the gnocchi has been cooked and set aside. Place the flour in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Add the gnocchi and, working quickly, toss it around the bowl. Using your fingers, pat the gnocchi in the flour to make smooth dough with the consistency of pizza dough. Place the gnocchi on the baking sheet and bake the gnocchi in the preheated 375°f oven for 15 minutes, stirring now and then and then, until the gnocchi is lightly browned. Cut the gnocchi into 1½ inch pieces. Add salt and pepper to taste and serve at once with fresh garlic.

title: Haddock and Capsicum Stewing
ingredients: 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 ounces mince capsicums | 4 ounces small red capsicums, roasted and chopped
instructions: Place capsicums in a shallow baking dish and lightly salt the capsicum. Roast the mince and roast the mince for about 20 - 30 mins until cooked through and browned. Add the capsicum back onto the mince mix. Cook for another 5 mins until bubbling and the capsicum is tender.

instructions: Put ingredients in a medium sized pot and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Turn to low or raise heat to med. Pressure and cook for 15 - 20 minutes. Fluff up with a fork, and add more shoyu if desired. Serve hot, or allow to cool and store in fridge.

title: White Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 4 cups water | 1 can diced green chiles | seasoning : | crushed ice, as needed
instructions: Combine the beans and water in a large pot. Bring to a boil.

title: Linda's Mum's Easy Breakfast Apples With Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, quartered and slightly softened | 12 hard-boiled eggs | 4 cooking apples, peeled, cored and quartered
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/425f/gas slice the hard boiled eggs and the apples. Place the apples and hard boiled eggs in a baking dish and fill with the hard boiled eggs and apples. Roast under the preheated oven for 10 mins until the eggs are hard and the apples soft, the eggs are cooked and the apples cooked. Leave for 2 mins or so on a baking tray until the hard boiled eggs and apples are set and serve straight away, or serve straight away.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Combine the cheddar and chili in a small ovenproof bowl. Place the fondue on a rack in a roasting pan. instructions: Blend yogurt, confectioners' sugar, rice wine, ground chipotle chiles, thyme, and marjoram together in a bowl. Dip mixture into crisco and continue to mix bread crumbs with your hands until dip is thoroughly coated.

title: Belgian Endive and Bok Choy

instructions: Rinse endive. Trim endive and bok choy leaves, removing tough outer leaves. Scoop some leaves of the leaves at a time from bowl, leaving the last of the leaves on for garnish. Wrap leaves in cheesecloth. Place on towel and weight down with plate on top. Refrigerate 1 hour. Discard viens. Remove and discard cheesecloth.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,dark chocolate,lime,beef brisket,baking potato,white peppercorn
title: Chocolate Lime Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 lbs round top-of-beef brisket | baking potato | 2 tablespoons cracked white peppercorns | 6 ounces sweet dark chocolate, broken into pieces | 8 small limes | 4 medium limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat. Place brisket in a roasting pan. In a bowl, combine peppercorns and 1 tablespoon of dark chocolate, and rub over meat. During the last 15 minutes, lower temperature to 325 degrees f and roast uncovered for a total of 90 minutes to 1 hour longer. Remove from oven. Meanwhile, place limes in a small saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a simmer, and cook until soft. Drain, and let sit until cooled enough to handle. Meanwhile, remove meat from pan. Slice into thick slices. Heat remaining dark chocolate over high heat, but do not allow to boil. Remove from heat, and set aside. When meat has cooled enough that it is warm, discard skin and cut meat into thin slices. Remove potatoes from water, peel, and mash. Add potato and lime slices. Heat through and serve with lime wedges.

title: The Best Tomato Soup or Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans condensed tomato soup, undiluted for tomato sauce | 1 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat, combine all ingredients. Bring to bubbling.

Add all remaining ingredients, except the sesame oil, and cook about 3 more minutes, stirring a few times. Drizzle sesame oil on top. Sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately.

title: Ginger Infused Cream

instructions: Pour the syrup into a medium saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat. Cook 5 minutes or until reduced by about half. Set aside to cool, uncovered for 2 - 3 minutes. instructions: Mix yoghurt, pepper powder, rice vinegar, scallion, and palm oil in bowl. Allow to sit for 15 mins at room temp, but no more than 7 hours.

title: Pork and Broccoli Salad With Raspberries and Hard Boiled Eggs

title: Zesty Browned Cod

instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Arrange fillets in pan, skin side down, in medium bowl. Sprinkle evenly with lemon zest, juice and tomatoes. instructions: In a large pan, add cashews and cook over medium heat, stirring, until lightly browned. Do not burn. Stir in 2 cups of the coconut broth, cardamom, chile powder or cayenne pepper. instructions: Combine the curry paste with the lamb, black pepper and seasoning. Cook in a shallow frying pan over a medium high heat for 5 - 6 minutes per side or until cooked to your liking.

title: Slightly Creamy Strawberry Surprise

instructions: Wash strawberries and remove any hard stem. Wash in cold running water. Cut thickly on the diagonal and wash in cold running water, drain and reserve juice. Allow to cool, then chill in the refrigerator for four hours or overnight, stirring once or twice. Serve garnished with fresh fruit and serve with crisp crisp, plain boiled rice or biscuits.

instructions: Prepare gelatin mix according to package directions using clam juice and gelatin solution. Place tortillas on a plate, top with clam mixture and refrigerate until firm or chilling.

instructions: Place the garlic cloves and chili paste in a jar with a tight lid, and shake to combine. Store in the refrigerator for at least two weeks or longer. When the jar is very hot, squeeze a handful of the garlic cloves, or put them into a blender and blend all the time.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,curry powder,breadcrumb,coriander seed,chili pepper flake,nori
title: Spiced Masala Dipping Onions
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon dried nori
instructions: Lightly toast coriander seed in a small skillet over a low heat. Keep shaking the skillet until it's aromatic. The more you work with the seeds, the spiier the dip will be. Remove the seeds from the skillet and set aside. Pour the oil in the skillet until the pan is just about full. Add the curry and chili flakes. Stir the mixture until the spices are distributed evenly around the pan. Turn up the heat. Add the bread crumbs and stir until the bread crumbs are well mixed into the dip. The crumbs will spread the oil. Add more oil if the dip needs a little more oil in it. Turn the heat back on to medium. Stir the dip constantly with a fork to break it up. The dip will become golden brown and crisp. It's done when it pulls from the sides of the pan and forms a ball that curls underneath. You may also turn off the heat. Use a slotted spoon or tongs to transfer the dip to a serving dish. Sprinkle the dried nori over the dip.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,arborio rice,dark rum
title: Spiced Risotto
ingredients: 500 g arborio rice | 1 packet ras el hanout spice mix | 2 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Place the rice, rum and ras el hanout in a pan. Pour boiling water over rice and leave to stand for 10 minutes. Stir gently and turn off heat. Leave covered for 10 minutes until water is absorbed. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: veal cutlet,safflower oil,creole seasoning,walnut oil,cornstarch,red pepper flake,merlot,sesame paste
title: Szechuan Beef With Merlot Sauce

instructions: Toss together cornstarch, sesame paste, and crushed red pepper. Dredge meat in the cornstarch mixture. Heat vegetable oil on medium heat. Brown meat slowly until browned.

title: Curtido

instructions: Place a skillet over medium heat. Blend the jalapeno peppers, dill, and hot pepper sauce in a blender until completely liquefied. Pour sauce into a small bowl. instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Remove skin from fish. Coat fish with 1 bottle of guinness and 2 tablespoons of caraway seed. instructions: Place all ingredients in a small plastic bag, and shake to combine.

title: Basic Chinese Fried Rice

Place the fried rice on a serving platter and serve warm.

instructions: Place sausage in a large sauce pan or stockpot. Add enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Boil about 10 minutes, or until meat is just cooked through. instructions: In a 2 quart microwave safe casserole or microwavable dish add spinach, rice, and microwave for 3 minutes, until hot and hot.

instructions: Cut a thin slice from the stem end of a watermelon and remove the flesh. Place on a baking sheet and paint with olive oil. Wrap in aluminum foil and refrigerate for one hour. title: Gingered Stuffed Mozzarella Cubes With Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 150 g mozzarella cheese ( fresh mozzarella can also be used, but it should be freshly grated ) | 300 ml double cream | 1/4 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/4 inch fresh ginger ( grated or finely minced ) | 1/4 teaspoon citric acid

Scoop the cheese mixture out onto a plate and allow it to cool a bit before serving. If you have a molder which allows room for storing bread crumbs, use that.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f and spray with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Haitian Pork Stew (A Yummy and Simple Way of Making Meatballs)

instructions: Soak dried bread in hot water for 10 minutes. Cut up bread and set aside. Trim fat from meat and cut into 5 - 6 cubes. Spray skillet with oil and add meat, breaking up if necessary. title: Stroganin With Heirloom Tomatoes and Beer

title: Easiest Tiramisu

instructions: Prepare tea.

instructions: In a large bowl, beat the egg yolks until light and fluffy. Stir in the rice vinegar and sesame seeds.

title: Quinoa Gratinee

title: Htapec & Vinegar

title: Mexican Sourdough

Then transfer the mixture to a clean container and allow to ferment in a cool place for a further 4 hours. It will double in size. Serve on toasted toast.

title: Tangled Lunch Plate!   Veggies W- Turkey - Vegan
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 cup shredded red cabbage | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1 cup finely shredded red cabbage | 1 cup crispy turkey ( we prefer a mix of cooked ham and turkey ) | 10 1/2 ounces chile salsa | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish, drained ( more to taste if desired and can use other flavors, e.g. tabasco ) | sriracha hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Combine all vegetables in a shallow baking dish. In a bowl, combine the chile salsa and basil and mix well. Drizzle over vegetables and toss to coat. Transfer to the oven and bake for 15 minutes, or until crisp tender. Serve with more sriracha, if desired.

title: Torta Di Savoiello Di Savoiello E Cioccolato (Romanes Stuffed Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 medium savoy cabbage | 250 g low-fat cream cheese | 1 envelope dried yeast | 25 g citrus peels
instructions: Wash the cabbage well and cut off the head in 6 - 8 slices. Remove any remaining leaves and cut into a small circle around the base of the cabbage. The easiest way to do this is by pulling the top part of the cabbage off through some of your cupped cabbage. With a sharp knife, open up the sides of the core of the ciliegroise. Stuff it with the drained cabbage leaves. Cream the cream cheese with the dry yeast, mix well and spread lightly over the top. Sprinkle citrus peel over the top. Place in a well oiled bowl and cover and let rise in a warm place for about an hour. Heat your grill plate. When your griddle is hot, place the filled ciliegroise on your griddle and when the first side looks dark on the top, flip the ciliegroise and place it under the grill. When ready to eat, take out of the grill and spread a small amount of the cream cheese over the top.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,italian parsley,godiva dark chocolate bar,hoisin sauce,seasoning salt,celery,cashew,coconut oil
title: Guilt-Free French Onion Cashew Veggies
ingredients: 1 bag zucchini ( peeled, if using fresh zucchini, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices ) | 1/3 cup hoisin sauce ( i use braggs ) | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1/2 cup sweet celery ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup fresh italian parsley ( chopped ) | 1 1/2 cups unsalted cashews | 1 cup godiva dark chocolate bar ( finely chopped ) | 1/4 teaspoon maggi seasoning salt
instructions: Slice zucchini 1/3 of the way through, lengthwise, making sure that all of the ends are attached. Slice into 1/4 inch thick slices. In shallow baking dish, mix together guisin sauce, coconut oil, & celery. Spray nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. Add sauteed zucchini, tossing several times, until lightly browned, 10 - 15 minutes. Pour veggies over cashews and toss thoroughly. Sprinkle with grated chocolate. Serve with salad and garlic bread.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,five spice powder,phyllo pastry,red apple
title: Apple Strudel
ingredients: 6 large red apples | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 tablespoon apricot jam
instructions: Using sharp knife, peel apples, discarding the core. Wash apples well. Cut ends off the apples with knife or scissors. Place apple on a cutting board, cut side down, then cut through dough with knife. Take one sheet of phyllo pastry, and place it on a lightly damp towel. Brush phyllo with apricot jam, and spread with about 1/2 tsp jam on the phyllo. Sprinkle with half the apple mixture with some of the remaining pastry. Roll up the first phyllo sheet over the filling. Cut roll in half, and place the halves at the bottom of a lightly greased 8x8 pan. Brush the ends with a little water, fold in sides, and then roll up each ends. Brush with apricot jam, and sprinkle with more apricot jam. Sprinkle with remaining pastry. Bake in 350ºf oven for 40 - 45 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,almond extract,baby green,dark rum,broccoli floret,corn,tea
title: Irish Tea Smøllium
ingredients: 2 quarts boiling water | 8 ounces diced canadian bacon | 5/8 cup baby greens | 1/4 cup fresh broccoli florets | 12 ounces premium premium teabags, like maggi or 12 ounces other dark rum | 1 teaspoon almond extract | sliced roasted corn, garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place boiling water in large saucepan and add smoked bacon. Cook until crisp, then drain on paper towels. While the bacon is curing, place greens in medium bowl of cold water. Boil for 5 - 10 minutes. Dice bacon. Dice broccoli to desired thickness. When the bacon is done, drain liquid off of the broccoli and add to blender, mixing thoroughly. Stir in the tea and rum and add almond extract. Blend for a minute or so, then pour into serving glass. Top each glass with raw sliced corn and garnish with green.

title: Homemade  Sour  Grilling Marinade for Chicken or Shish Kabobs
ingredients: chili pepper flakes | lime wedge
instructions: Mix equal parts chili pepper flakes with half a lime wedge. Seal for chicken or shrimp. Place skewers in a gallon size freezer bag. Seal bag securely and shake several times to distribute the spices and heat evenly. Preheat grill. Place skewers on the heat grill and cook for 10 - 15 minutes, until the meat turns opaque.

title: Raspberry Linguine
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice stick noodles | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 1/2 cups frozen raspberries | 1 1/2 cups frozen pearl barley | 1/3 cup capers | 2 teaspoons pepper | crouton ( optional )
instructions: Boil water for noodles. Drain, rinse and drain noodles again. Meanwhile, in small bowl, add picante sauce, rice stick noodles and frozen raspberries. Cover and refrigerate for atleast 5 minutes. Stir in barley, capers and pepper. Garnish with parsley.

title: Wasabi Sauce for French Fries
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups non-fat powdered milk | 2 teaspoons wasabi powder
instructions: Place the milk into a small sauce pan over medium high heat. Place the wasabi powder into a bowl, and stir in a tablespoon of water until the wasabi is incorporated. When the milk begins to sizzle, pour the wasabi mixture into the non fat powdered milk. Continue to stir until the wasabi coats the back of a spoon or spatula. Continue to stir the wasabi mixture until it has been completely incorporated into the non fat powdered milk. Refrigerate for 2 hours to allow flavors to blend and settled.

Random Ingredients: beefsteak tomato,green chile,triple sec,pork shoulder,pear,pepperoncini pepper,onion powder
title: Saucy Baked Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder | 1 cup triple sec | 1/2 cup chopped pepperoncini peppers | 8 ounces pears, peeled, cored and chopped | 2 cans diced green chilies | 3 tablespoons dry minced onion powder | 1 1/2 cups beefsteak tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Trim excess fat from pork and cut into 1 1/2 cubes. Pour ¾ cup triple sec into a shallow baking pan. Place pork in, overlapping and turning until all sides are covered. Sprinkle ¾ cup of pepperoncino over pork. Top with 1 cup chopped pears and 1 1/2 cups diced green chilies. Mix remaining triple sec with onion powder and pour over pork. Top with remaining ¾ cup of pears and green chilies. Bake, covered, in preheated oven for at least 8 hours. Add diced tomatoes to pork and bake, covered for 30 minutes. Remove pork and continue baking for 2 hours and 15 minutes.

title: Gravy Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 3 3/4 lbs stewing beef or 3 3/4 lbs mutton | 1 cup bulgur | 1/2 cup oat | 1/4 cup baking powder | 1/4 cup wheat | 1 cup ice
instructions: Brown the meat in a stock pot with the bulgur, oat, baking and wheat. When the meat is cooked, add the ice. Cover and simmer for 1 hour on very low heat.

title: Sauce Italian Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: Boil linguine until all of the water is absorbed. Drain. Return the linguine to the pot and cover with cold water. Let sit for about 30 minutes, or until cool and dry. While the linguine is cooking, combine barbecue sauce and water until smooth. After 30 minutes, drain the linguine and stir through the sauce. Toss with pasta and serve.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,thai red curry paste,grainy mustard,gruyere cheese,cream celery soup,sugar,yellow cake mix
title: Thai Beef and Cheese Bundt Cake
ingredients: 1 large yellow cake mix, prepared according to package directions, such as jiffy | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 3/4 cup sour cream or 3/4 cup creamed celery soup | 2 1/2 teaspoons grainy mustard | 1/4 cup light cream or 1/4 cup light sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 cup coarsely shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: In a medium sized bowl mix together the cake mix, curry paste, sour cream, mustard and cream or just to blend ingredients.. Transfer to a lightly greased and floured bundt cake pan and bake at 350of for 1 hour 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean. Allow to cool before slicing.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,curry,white sugar,ziti pasta,sherry wine,beef bouillon cube,red chile pepper,turmeric
title: Curry Rice
ingredients: 1 pound dry ziti pasta | 1 pound lean ground beef | 1 can corn kernels | 1 large beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons sherry wine, or as needed | 2 red chile peppers, minced | 1 pinch ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon curry, or as needed
instructions: Place ziti in a large pot and cover with lightly salted water.

title: Lamb & Pepperoni Burgers
ingredients: 500 g ground lamb | 1/2 cup bulgar wheat ( jumbilla or arugula ) | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup port wine, fruity | 1/4 cup salad oil | 4 slices pepperoni
instructions: Cook bulgogi according to package directions, but omit the oil & set aside. Mix the burger ingredients together & shape into patties. Cook the burgers over medium heat for 3 minutes on each side until lightly browned. Serve with the peppers & sauce.

title: Easy Penne Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups penne, cooked | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 1/2 - 3/4 cup pizza sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: In a small skillet cook and stir 2 cups cooked penne until al dente. Drain well. Stir in tabasco sauce and hot sauce. Cook and stir until the sauce is smooth and well mixed. Add remaining sauce. Bring to boil, stirring until sauce is heated through. Pour into a serving dish. Top with fresh mozzarella slices and parmesan. Bake according to package directions. Allow to stand 10 minutes before serving. Note, can also be made in a crockpot. Add 1/2 cup cooked carrots to crockpot.

title: Cheese with allspice
ingredients: 7 ounces mexican cheese, finely grated | 4 tablespoons dill weed | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients, stirring constantly and let stand a few hours before serving over crackers, or as a topping for veggies. Makes a great burrito filling for vegetarian or oamc.

title: Quick & Easy Tomato Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick-cooking oil ( like grapeseed oil or peanut oil ) | 2 cups cooked brown rice ( i use basmati brand ) | 1 can chopped tomatoes, with juice
instructions: Heat oil in a 2 to 3 quart saucepan over medium heat. While oil is heating, cut rind from tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,grain mustard,tamari,grain brown rice,bacon,egg,tea,adzuki bean
title: Tamina With Burrata Rolls (Rice Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups milk ricotta cheese | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 1/2 cup short-grain mustard | 1 tablespoon tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 1 egg, beaten | 1/4 cup dashi-sweetened condensed milk ( or other sweet pickle ) or 1/4 cup milk ( or other sweet pickle ) | 1 cup short-grain brown rice ( not instant ) | 3 cups cooked adzuki beans, mashed ( or other sweet pickle ) | 1/2 cup steamed whole grain mustard ( for the toast, if you like )
instructions: Make the burrata, place the ricotta, bacon, half of the sweet pickle, and 1 t of mustard in a mixing bowl. Mix together with your hands until everything is well combined, then make the filling, in a small skillet, heat 1 tbsp of oil over medium heat. Add the cooked adzuki beans and 1/2 tsp of mustard, and cook until heated through about 3 minutes. To serve, spread a piece of the rice in the center of a plate, and ladle about 1/4 of the bean mixture onto the rice. Add the burrata and top with your favorite garnish.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,orange juice,ziti pasta,prosciutto,coconut milk,white wine vinegar,cheddar cheese
title: Baked Ziti
ingredients: 12 ounces dry ziti pasta, cooked and drained | 2 ounces prosciutto or 2 ounces ham, halved and very thinly sliced | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup coconut milk, fat-free preferred | 1/3 cup grated reduced-fat cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Arrange the ziti in a large shallow baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients, except cheddar and pour the mixture over the ziti. Sprinkle with the cheese. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Broccoli and Broccoli Puree
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli floret | fresh ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Wash, stem and de bone the broccoli. Place the broccoli in a saucepan with enough cold water to cover the broccoli. Bring to a boil over high heat, then cover pan and cook until the broccoli is tender but firm, about 18 minutes. Once cooked, drain and discard the stalks and any tough parts. Cut the broccoli into 1/2 inch dice using the back of a knife. Drain the broccoli and combine with the broccoli mixture. Taste and season with black pepper.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,pork tenderloin,white cake mix,tart apple
title: Mexican Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 can white cake mix | 1/2 cup finely crushed tart apple | 2 medium serrano chilies, diced | 2 lbs fresh pork tenderloin
instructions: Prepare the cake mix according to the package directions. Drain the mixture well. Cut the pork into 1 inch cubes. Preheat broiler. Place the pork tenderloins in a shallow baking dish and sprinkle evenly with the crushed tart apple. Broil 2 minutes, turning once. Turn the meat and broil 2 more minutes. Turn the tenderloins, and broil 2 minutes total, or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: beef shank,grand marnier,kombu,chili oil,black pepper,thyme leave
title: Beef shank in Oil and Grand Moze
ingredients: 4 lbs beef shank | 6 -12 tablespoons beef shank oil | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leave | 1 tablespoon kombu seaweed, seaweed | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 -3 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Prepare the beef shank using only the shank oil and not any extra. Wash and pat dry the beef shank well. Heat up the oil in a heavy pan on high heat. Add the beef shank and fry until just beginning to brown. Turn down the heat and add the thyme, ketzanu and grand marnier. Reduce the heat and simmer for 35 to 40 minutes to an internal temp of 150 degrees f. Remove from heat and transfer to a warm platter or bowl. Let rest 15 to 20 minutes to absorb some of the juices. Slice the beef thinly and serve with the pan juices. Any leftover meat juices can be used to cook fresh beef shank or use as a stock for steamed rice.

title: Italian N Beans & Tomatoes
ingredients: 16 ounces navy beans, pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups frozen whipped topping ( or fresh ) | 1/3 cup unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 1 can italian plum tomatoes ( drained and crushed )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beans, whipped topping, cocoa, fenugreek, and tomatoes. Toss and chill. Before serving remove the seeds from the tomatoes. Serve with or to dip with your favourite side dishes such as pita bread.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,plain flour,italian parsley,thyme sprig,triple sec,soy sauce
title: Soy Glaze for Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons lemon thyme sprigs, chopped | 6 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon triple sec ( orange flavored liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | fresh italian parsley, to garnish
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the soy sauce, thyme and flour. Whisk in the triple sec and oil. Sprinkle the chicken with the glaze, coating well. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for several hours or overnight. Preheat over to gas mark 4 temperature, or 190°c 180°c place the chicken on the grill. Cook, turning, about 10 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from heat. Transfer to a serving dish, sprinkle with parsley and serve.

Random Ingredients: veal cutlet,coconut,bacon,halloumi cheese,kidney bean,rice paper,red cabbage,rutabaga
title: Veal Wrapped in Coconut and Bacon
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans | 6 ounces bacon | 3 rutabagas, chopped | 2 ounces veal cutlets, sliced | 2 sheets rice paper | 12 round halloumi cheese | 1/4 cup coconut | 1 red cabbage, shredded
instructions: Brown the bacon and drain off excess fat. Put the kidney beans, rutabagas, veal haloumi, bean puree, bacon, paper shreds, coconut and cabbage in a saucepan and boil rapidly for 10 minutes. Add extra water to cover if necessary. Put the mixture in a roll and roll up. Place in a bowl and cover with cling film. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight, turning over once. Preheat oven to 150°c. When you are ready to use the wrap, put a slice of halloumi cheese on the wrap. Wrap a piece of rellen cheese on the wrap and secure with a toothpick. Arrange the wrap on a non stick baking tray, brush with extra olive oil or cooking oil and bake in oven for 1 hour. Slice and serve. You can also wrap a piece of bacon in with the wrap, cut it into smaller pieces and put it inside the wrap before eating.

Random Ingredients: pineapple tidbit,pimiento,green cabbage,chicken bouillon,chorizo sausage,egg white
title: Mexican Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 2 cans chicken bouillon | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained and juice reserved | 1/4 pound thick chorizo sausage, drained | 1 large egg white | 1/4 pound green cabbage, shredded | 1 jar sliced pimiento, drained
instructions: Place the chicken bouillon, pineapple juice, chorizo, and egg white in the work bowl of a blender. Blend until smooth. Gently fold the cabbage and pimentos into the cheese mixture. Pour into bowls with slotted spoon. Top with reserved pineapple juice and serve.

title: Ethiopian Spice Seasoning
ingredients: 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Place all ingredients in clean spice jar. Close lid securely and shake until the mixture is in fine threads. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,ginger root,dark rum,cod,garlic clove,large shrimp
title: Spicy Rum Cod (Hokkaido Style)
ingredients: 1/2 pound cod | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 package ramen noodles | 2 pounds large shrimp - peeled and deveined
instructions: Break the fish into large chunks. Place the fish chunks in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: white button mushroom,asafoetida powder,chicken leg,rotini pasta
title: Paneer (Autumn Pasta)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 4 whole chicken legs | 1 pound rotini pasta | 1 pound sliced white button mushrooms
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 2 quart baking dish. Mix the asafoetida powder into enough water to dissolve the asafoetida powder. Place the chicken legs into a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat as low as possible, and simmer the chicken until no longer pink and falling off the bones, about 20 minutes. Remove chicken, discard bones, shred the meat, and return it to the pot. Return the asafoetida to the water, stir to coat, and simmer until the water thickens, about 10 minutes. Return chicken to the pot and cook the rotini in the boiling water until tender but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes.

title: Tofu Satay
ingredients: 1 package soft tofu | 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon olive, minced | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried cumin powder | 1/4 cup crunchy peanut butter
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. In a food processor or blender, puree tofu with flour, olive and worcestershire sauce until smooth. Form into 1 inch patties. In a shallow baking dish, toss the cumin powder and peanut butter. Place the tofu patties on the mixture. Bake for 15 minutes, or until thoroughly cooked.

Random Ingredients: head broccoli,tahini,curry leaf,scallion,red chilies,coconut cream,red chili pepper flake,coconut flour
title: Spicy Curry Broccoli Coconut Coconut Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb head fresh broccoli | 1/3 cup tahini | 5 cups unsweetened coconut cream ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup coconut flour, more if needed | 6 small red chili peppers, halved lengthwise, seeded, deribbed, and thinly sliced | 1 small red chili pepper flakes, seeded, deribbed, and thinly sliced | 12 large fresh curry leaves, washed ( or 10 japanese ) | 1 scallion, thinly sliced ( preferably green )
instructions: Cut head of broccoli lengthwise into 2 inch pieces. Remove stalks, leaving 1 inch of thick stalks attached to each piece. Cut stalks diagonally into 3/4 inch pieces. Bring large pot of salted water to boil, add the broccoli and blanch 3 minutes. Drain and spread water over broccoli. Drain, rinse with cold water, and set aside. In a large bowl, combine tahini and 5 cups of coconut cream.

title: Grilled Sweet-Sour Bratwurst Pasta
ingredients: 3 sweet bell peppers | 1 lb linguine | 8 bratwursts, sliced in half diagonally | 1/4 cup seasoned dry bread crumbs | 1 1/4 cups dry bread crumbs | 1 package uncooked pasta
instructions: In food processor, process peppers until smooth. Grill peppers until tender and no charred areas show and grill until meat thermometer reaches 160 degrees, turning occasionally, about 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, boil linguine until al dente. While linguine is cooking, drain and reserve the pasta cooking water. Transfer hot peppers to large bowl. Drain linguine and transfer to bowl with the peppers. Mix linguine and peppers in blender until blended. Add reserved cooking water and bread crumbs. Season with more salt and pepper if desired. Stir in bread crumbs until bread crumbs are evenly distributed. Lightly grease a large grill. Grill bratwurst slices over hot coals 3 to 4 minutes on each side. Cook bratwurst in the heated grill until the outsides are just beginning to char, about 30 seconds longer. Serve bratwurst on warm platter. Top with sauce.

title: Homemade British Bull Eye Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons ground pepper | 100 -200 ml tabasco sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: In a small bowl combine the coriander, mustard, pepper and tabasco and mix well. Place the rub in a zip lock bag, or in a spice/spice container with a lid, close and shake well. Store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

title: Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti | 1 lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook pasta until al dente, then drain. While the pasta is cooking, stir the lemon zest into the water and stir. Heat in the pasta and toss until piping hot.

title: Crunchy Fried Cabbage
ingredients: 4 cloves unpeeled head cabbage | 3/4 cup peanut oil for frying
instructions: Wash cabbage thoroughly. Cut each head into 8 wedges. Place wedges into a flat plastic bag or bowl. Pour 1/4 cup of peanut oil into a skillet to a depth of 2 inches. Heat oil until deep fryer reaches 350 degrees f. Carefully remove the cabbage wedges to paper towels to drain. Dry the crisply opened bag a bit on paper towels, then place into the hot oil. Cook until the outer coating is slightly golden brown, about 5 minutes. Carefully remove the crisply fried cabbage wedges with a slotted spoon. Transfer cooked wedges to a paper towel lined plate, cover to keep warm, and repeat with remaining oil, crisping cabbage wedges and crisping oil until all the cabbage wedges and crisppings have been used. Serve with chutney for dipping.

Random Ingredients: beef rump roast,enchilada sauce,cremini mushroom,mustard,wasabi paste,date,ouzo,vanilla bean
title: Ouzo Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 boneless beef rump roast | 32 cremini mushrooms, diced | 12 pitted dates, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 3 tablespoons ouzo | 1 teaspoon ground dry mustard | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place beef on a rack in a roasting pan and roast in the preheated oven until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f on a meat thermometer, about 30 minutes total. Let meat cool to room temperature. Shred meat and reserve. Mix wasabi into the mayonnaise with ouzo and mustard. Combine beef, mushrooms, dates, and wasabi mixture in a large mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,tomato green chilies,leek,salt pepper,plum tomato,beef rib eye steak,turmeric powder
title: Bengali Beef and Leafy Leek Soup
ingredients: 1/2 kg beef short rib eye steak, cut into 4 pieces, preferably cross-cut | 2 -3 large leeks, washed and sliced ( the white green parts only, the whites of the leeks, the tops of the leeks, about 1-1 1/2 inches length ) | 8 plum tomatoes ( about 200 -250g ) or 8 roma tomatoes ( about 200-250g ) | 4 -5 large beef bones with marrow | salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 4 tablespoons chopped leeks
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pot. Bring to the boil over medium high to heat, reduce heat to low and simmer until the meat starts to fall apart, about 2 1/2 hours. Remove meat from pot and skim any fat from pot. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with chopped green onions and sliced leeks.

Random Ingredients: curry,baby carrot,green creme de menthe,beef stock,anise seed
title: Anise Flavoured Carrots
ingredients: 2 lbs baby carrots | 2 tablespoons beef stock | 1/4 cup curry | 1 tablespoon green creme de menthe | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Bring stock and curry to boil over high heat. Add carrots and cook for about 30 minutes until carrots are tender and liquid is reduced. Drain carrots in a colander and set aside. Reheat stock. Add creme de menthe and aniseed and stir. Add carrots and stir. Simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Pasteli Con Pesto With Avocado and Comyrie
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh oregano or 1 1/2 cups fresh white vinegar | 2 teaspoons ground coriander seed | 2 large ripe avocados | 2 ounces fontina cheese, cut into small cubes | 2 -3 teaspoons wasabi paste
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the oregano, coriander and avocado. Puree to a smooth puree. Add the cheese and wasabi to the mixture. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Place on a small plate and drizzle with a few spoonsfuls of the remaining olive oil. To serve, slice with a knife in rounds from the edge to the tip of the bowl. Serve with salad greens.

Random Ingredients: leek,pepperoni,zucchini,apple pie filling,white bread flour,dill weed
title: Polish Meat and Cheese Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white bread flour | 1 jar apple pie filling | 2 medium zucchini ( cut into 1/2-inch pieces ) | 3 tablespoons chopped leeks | 1/2 cup sliced pepperoni | 1 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Mix together the flour and 3/4 cup pie filling in a bowl. Cut zucchini and potatoes in half, and place in a baking dish. Spread evenly with the pie filling. Sprinkle with the pepperoni, and finally the parsley. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,cinnamon,plain nonfat yogurt,pork loin roast,savory,ancho chile,rice vinegar
title: Authentic Lemongrass Pork Skewers
ingredients: 3 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1 stick fresh lemongrass, peeled | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chiles ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 lbs pork loin roast, bone-in | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar
instructions: Slice off top 2 inches of lemongrass stalk, remove white part of bulb, cut away fuzz from thick stalk and discard remainder, thinly slice lemongrass. Place lemon grass, ancho chiles and savory in a mortar and pound with pestle until fine. Place meat on wooden skewers, rub well with pestle mixture. Mix yogurt, lemon grass, cinnamon and vinegar in a large bowl, add 1 tbls oil and marinate meat at least 2 hours in the refrigerator. Preheat grill to high, and prepare skewers, place meat on oiled rack, cook 5 minutes per side or until desired doneness, basting often with yogurt mixture. Skewer meat with lime peel if desired before served with pickled onions, pickled garlic, raisins and cucumber relish.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,grain white rice,anaheim chilies,coffee,chicken bouillon granule,wild mushroom
title: Coffee Beans & Wild Mushroom
ingredients: 16 ounces wild mushrooms, cleaned & sliced | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 -2 anaheim chilies, sliced and seeded | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1/2 cup long-grain white rice
instructions: In a saucepan, combine all ingredients except rice & chilies. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Turn mixture into a well buttered 11 x 7 inch baking dish and coat with cooking spray. Cover with foil and bake uncovered at 450 for 15 minutes, uncover and bake 20 minutes more or until center of rice is puffed & lightly browned. Serve the cooked chiltorean style beans, then top with rice.

title: Tostones (Med to Sirloin)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oats | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons hidden valley original ranch dressing mix ( i prefer hormel ) | 1 lb sirloin steak
instructions: Combine the oats, turmeric and hidden valley ranch mix. Marinade the meat in the mixture for several hours or overnight. Grill over low heat. Serve on a bed of rice.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,dark rum,broiler fryer chicken,celery rib,egg,water chestnut,sugar,rice vermicelli
title: Crispy Chicken & Rice Soup
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons dark rum or 2 -3 tablespoons other dark rum | 2 lbs broiler-fryer chickens, cut up | 1 lb rice vermicelli, broken into half inch pieces | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, with juice, drained | 3 large eggs, beaten | 3 tablespoons sugar | 3 tablespoons dark rum or 3 tablespoons other dark rum flavoring
instructions: In a 3 - 3 qt crockpot, brown chicken on all sides in 3 tablespoons of dark rum or other rum over med low heat. Turn and brown until well browned on all sides. Remove chicken and set aside. Add water chestnuts, celery and rice vermicelli to crockpot. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours. Pound in a meat pounder with a hammer or other pounding utensil until very crumby and slightly flattened. Return chicken to crockpot and reheat for an additional 5 minutes. Stir in beaten eggs and sugar. Cook for an additional 3 minutes and serve hot.

title: Gorgonzola Soup
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups prepared au jus soup or 1 1/4 cups beef stock | 5 fresh rocks ( each about 5 - 6 oz. ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning, crumbled | 1/2 cup dry sherry, plus 1 tsp. additional sherry ( optional ) | 2 2 tablespoons good quality gorgonzola or 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 8 slices romaine lettuce or 8 slices kale, depending on size ( about 4-8 leaves )
instructions: Bring the soup to a simmer. Meanwhile, rinse the rocks. Place them into a medium pot. Add the broth. Season the broth generously with the crumbled italian seasoning. Simmer the soup gently over low heat, stirring occasionally, for about 2 hours, or until the rocks are tender, stirring occasionally. Remove and discard the meat from the bones. Remove the ribs and cut off the tip of the rocks, and set aside the meat. Cut off the meat, discarding any bones or extra pieces of meat. Place the broth into a blender, add the meat, and puree until smooth. Put the soup in a large pot, sprinkle the sherry over the soup, and bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally. Lower the heat to simmer and simmer, partially covered, for 15 - 20 minutes. Taste and adjust for salt. Serve in soup plates and top with a dollop of cheese.

title: Spinach and White Bean Chili
ingredients: 1 cup white beans, cooked to el dente and cooled ( canned or fresh ) | 1 can enchilada sauce, divided | 10 ounces bag baby spinach | 1 tablespoon honey | 2 tablespoons pistachios, ground | 3/4 cup burgundy wine
instructions: Puree white beans and 3/4 cup enchilada sauce in a blender, working in batches at low speed. Add 3/4 cup enchilada sauce. Stir in spinach 1 tbls. Of the ground pistachios. Heat remaining 1/2 cup enchilada sauce in a 6 to 8 quart heavy bottomed pot over medium heat 1 minute. Add remaining ground pistachios to pot, increase heat to medium and cook stirring until nuts turn pale golden brown. Increase heat to high and add remaining 1/2 cup enchilada sauce. Bring to a boil. Toss in white bean mixture. Reduce heat, stirring often, until sauce thickens and coats back of spoon, about three minutes. Toss in remaining enchilada sauce, remaining ground pistachios and honey. Bring to a bubble, stirring occasionally until thickened about 4 minutes. Toss with rest of cooked white bean mixture. Serve over white beans, passing remaining ground pistachios on the side.

title: Thai Chicken Legs.
ingredients: 2 -3 chicken legs | 1 -2 tablespoon thai red curry paste
instructions: Boil chicken legs with thai red curry paste till they are cooked, but not soft. Take chicken legs and pull up and shred. Place shreds on plate. Top with thai red curry paste.

title: Chicken and Pumpkin Grilled French Bread
ingredients: 1 whole boneless chicken breast half | 1 can pumpkin | 1 loaf french baguette
instructions: Preheat broiler. Spray the inside of a large skillet with cooking spray, and place over medium high heat. Cut the chicken breast into strips about 3/4 of an inch thick. Pour some juice from the pumpkin into skillet. Brown the chicken, and remove from skillet. Place the breasts into the food processor, and process until smooth, about 20 seconds, stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl occasionally. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and pour in the pumpkin. When heated through, pour in some of the chicken juices into the food processor. Cut the baguette into thick slices. Arrange the slices in a baking dish with a bit of the remaining canned pineapple juice over the slices. Brush a bit of the strained juice onto the inside surfaces of the bread slices. Cut the chicken into slices, and place into the baking dish. Cook in the preheated oven until the chicken is no longer pink inside, and the bread is toasted and toasted, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,enchilada sauce,cheddar cheese,sesame seed,picante sauce,cilantro
title: Mangolian Queso Dip (Enviro Kids Copycat)
ingredients: 1 cup reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 1 cup monterey jack cheddar cheese | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 can enchilada sauce, plus | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons palm sugar | 1/2 cup minced cilantro
instructions: Combine 1 cup cheddar, 1 cup monterey jack cheddar, 1 cup picante sauce, enchilada sauce, sesame seeds, and palm sugar. Blend well. Spoon into serving glass. Refrigerate until serving time. Garnish with cilantro. Serve with tortilla chips. Variation, add 1/2 cup cheddar, 1 cup monterey jack cheddar and 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese when adding picante sauce, picante sauce or salsa and/or red pepper flakes.

title: Spinach and Baby Corn
ingredients: 1 can spinach | 28 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed ( not thawed ) | 14 ounces baby corn | 1 chili pepper, minced
instructions: Brown spinach until wilted. Drain water and set aside. Wash corn, drain and cut in half. Remove the corn from the cobs if they are large. Heat a large non stick skillet, and add corn. Sauté corn until it is starting to soften, then add chili pepper and spinach. Heat through until heated through and serve. If desired serve over rice.

title: Moroccan Christmas Lamb
ingredients: 250 g lamb | 100 g shrimp, halved | 400 g orange slices, quartered | 300 g currant jelly | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 orange | 1 chicken breast, grilled
instructions: Score the lamb as you would a cross. Cut into bite sized, 1cm strips. Cut the shrimp lengthways into 1 cm pieces. Cut the orange into segments. Place the orange segments and currant jelly into a pan with a tablespoon of cold water and bring to the boil. Add the lamb and stir to combine. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Add the lamb, orange segments and shrimp to the pan and stir to mix. Preheat the grill to medium. Grill the lamb, turning occasionally, for 2 minutes or until the lamb is cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,cocoa powder,red chili powder,plum tomato,italian breadcrumb,jaggery
title: Sweet Plum Tomato Balls
ingredients: 2 cups fresh plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup jaggery | 1/2 cup unsweetened bread crumbs | 1/2 cup seasoned italian breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian seasoned bread crumbs, crushed
instructions: In a blender or food processor combine the plum tomatoes, 1/2 cup jaggery, 1/2 cup bread crumbs, seasoned italian breadcrumbs, 1/2 cup seasoned italian breadcrumbs, cocoa powder, red chili powder and dry italian seasoning bread crumbs. Blend until mixture is smooth. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Form mixture into 1 balls. Roll in crushed italian seasoned bread crumb, pressing to adhere. Place balls onto a nonstick cookie sheet, covered loosely with parchment paper. Chill for at least 1 hour and up to 1 day before serving.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,grape tomato,chocolate syrup,chicken breast half,sauce
title: Tomato Chocolate Chicken
ingredients: 8 ounces chocoholiches-schnooms | 8 ounces grape tomatoes | 2 tablespoons greek sweet and sour sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 chicken breast halves | sweet and sour sauce, as desired
instructions: Dice the tomatoes into small chunks, and put in a ziploc bag. Drizzle sweet and sour sauce on top. Place in the fridge until the mix is really set. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Put two chicken breasts in a baking dish, and sprinkle with both fennel seeds. Bake in the middle of the oven for 30 - 40 minutes, or until the chicken is mostly cooked through. Take them out, and then sprinkle the top with the sweet and sour sauce to taste.

Random Ingredients: peach,cajun seasoning,mirin,white wine vinegar,italian bread,spaghetti,orange juice
title: Spaghetti With Peaches, Onions, and Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 2 packages spaghetti | 1 1/2 cups dry white wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups orange juice, freshly squeezed | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 cup chopped peeled ripe peach | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/3 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Cook spaghetti for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Beef Broth
ingredients: 1/2 lb of any kind beef stew meat that has been trimmed, sliced and cooked ( such as rump, sirloin, and rib eye ) | 1/3 cup oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons beef broth
instructions: Toss the beef with the oyster sauce in a bowl. Heat the cooking oil over high heat in a saucepan. Add the meat to the oil and cook until the outside is crispy. Add the broth and bring the broth to a boil. Turn down the heat and simmer the beef while stirring periodically for 5 min to an hour.

title: Mexican Queso Fundido
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sofrito sauce | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh basil | 1 1/4 cups chopped fresh mint | 1 cup maraschino cherries, drained and chopped
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, stir the oil and sofrito until warm, about 3 minutes. Add the cheese and stir until melted, about 3 minutes. Stir in the basil and mint. Add the cherries and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes.

title: Chicken Fritters from Scratch
ingredients: 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 1/3 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1 teaspoon corn flakes | 1 boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Combine vinegar and broth in medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: white bread flour,turkey,oyster sauce,goat cheese,hot chili sauce,oil,pistachio
title: Tropical Turkey Pizza
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white bread flour | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/2 cup soft fresh goat cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped pistachios or 1/4 cup almonds, blanched lightly and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh hot chili sauce | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2 1/2 - 3 cups leftover cooked turkey, cut into pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450f, and place a pizza stone on the rack. Set aside. Combine the flour with the oil in a large bowl, then mix in the cheese and nuts, blending well with your fingers. Spread the oil and spread evenly onto the bottom and sides of pizza dough or parchment paper. Sprinkle with the chili sauce and spread out evenly. Arrange the turkey over the crust, sprinkle the pizza with the mozzarella, then drizzle with the soy sauce, and sprinkle the pizza with the remaining toppings. Set the pizza on a parchment paper lined pizza pan, then bake for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove the pizza from the oven, drizzle with more soy and fresh soy sauce, and serve hot.

title: Chinese Style Pineapple Eggplant
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled & cut into 1/2 x 2 1/2 inch strips | 1/4 cup butter lettuce or 1/4 cup baby spinach | 2/3 cup pineapple juice | 3 tablespoons diced canned pineapple chunks
instructions: Spray a grill with pan spray or lightly oil the grate. Place vegetables on grill cook, stirring once, until tender. Top each with lettuce, pineapple juice and cooked eggplant.

Random Ingredients: silken tofu,vegetable,poblano pepper,oregano,monterey jack cheddar cheese,vanilla pudding mix,vanilla bean paste
title: Quick  Vegan Cheeseburger Quiche
ingredients: 2 cans prepared vanilla pudding mix | 1 lb ground veggie burger ( vegetarian, turkey, or chicken ) | 1 poblano pepper, grated | 1 envelope mori nuikake dried oregano ( or regular oregano ) | 2 tablespoons vanilla bean paste | 6 tablespoons shredded low-fat monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | vegetables, of choice ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat in skillet with poblano pepper, oregano and vanilla paste on medium heat, adding desired amount of sugar for moisture, about 5 minute. Drain grease from pan. Pour pudding mix into bowl with meat. Add to skillet on low heat, mashing slightly and mixing until mixture is mostly incorporated through meat mix so it's evenly dispersed throughout the dough. Remove mix from heat and add cheese. Stir until cheese is just melted. Pour into a dish and spread evenly with a spatula on the bottom/middle of the pie.. This helps the bottom crust to stick to the bottom, and prevents it from burning over the edge of the pie filling. Let cool slightly.

title: Italian Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 1/4 cup pecorino-romano cheese
instructions: Place the corned beef brisket in the slow cooker. Sprinkle the corned beef with cheese. Cover and cook on low until the meat is tender. Shred with two forks or 2 forks.

title: Italian Sausage and Pasta
ingredients: 6 -8 links pork belly, cleaned of fat | 1/2 can mixed vegetables, drained with juice from can | 1/8 cup vegetable broth or 1/8 cup mushroom broth, heated ( for sausagemeat ) | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 20 ounces small shell pasta
instructions: Place pork belly, mixed vegetables and broth into large frying pan and bring to boil, then reduce to low and simmer for 1 hour or longer if you can. If you like your sausagemeat a little hard, remove from heat and cook longer to absorb broth. Remove pork and slice it as desired, keeping fat in pan. Serve over hot pasta, and top with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,marjoram,lamb,chicken thigh,lime,cooking apple,taro root
title: Aussie Style Skewered Lamb
ingredients: 1 fresh whole lamb, approximately | 2 fresh pared tamaro root, approximately | cooking apple, approximately | 1/2 bunch fresh marjoram ( approx., see note ) | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 5 -6 chicken thighs, approximately | 1 lime, approximately
instructions: Soak tamaro root in water approximately 30 minutes. Cut a small piece off the center of the tamarold, carefully scoop out the outer leaves leaving each piece of tamarold intact. Soak tamaro root for a least 10 hours or overnight in water to cover. Preheat grill, wood, or stove over medium flame. Thread lamb onto skewers with a little marjoram covering each portion. If using bamboo skewers, soak them in water approximately 30 - 30 minutes. Slice tomatoes in half lengthwise and slice crosswise into thin slices. Set aside. Remove tamarold leaves and discard. Cut enough meat from underside of lamb to make approximately 2 skewers. Thread lamb onto bamboo skewers. Arrange meat on plate and cover with tomato slices overlapping in a little pattern. Dribble a bit of cooking oil over tomatoes and skewers. Squeeze lime juice over skewers, making sure all surfaces of skewers are covered with oil. Wipe grill, wood, or stove clean of any remaining marjoram leaves. Grill on medium heat about 3 - 4 minutes on each side, brushing or spraying with olive oil. Serve lamb with salsa and garnish with a bit of julienned tomatoes and/or salsa verde.

title: Sundried Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced pancetta ( about 1 small ) | 24 ounces buttermilk | 12 1/2 ounces quarts water or 12 1/2 ounces stock with seafood ( i have used chicken broth ) | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/3 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup diced tomato with pimento, chopped
instructions: In a large pot, cook pancetta in buttermilk over medium heat until browned, about 5 minutes. Add the water or stock and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Potato-Topped Red Enchiladas for Two
ingredients: 8 -10 large boiled potatoes | 16 ounces red enchilada sauce | 1 lb romano cheese, grated | 1 cup whipped topping | 1 can sliced pickled jalapeno peppers, drained
instructions: Prepare simply potatoes sour cream. Grate romano cheese and place all ingredients in a bowl. Stir to mix cheese into ingredients. Preheat oven to 400°f place a layer of potato onto bottom of casserole dish. Cover this evenly with one cup of the sour cream mixture. Continue layering potato mixture and sour cream as desired. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 400f for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and the top is lightly browned.

title: Crostini Di Ziti (Herring Pasta)
ingredients: 2 ounces dried ziti pasta | 8 dried apricot jam | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 2 1/2 pounds fresh herring fillets
instructions: Place ziti in a large pot with enough water to cover. Turn heat to high, and bring to a boil. Cover, and cook until ziti is tender. Drain and let cool slightly. Place ziti, apricot jam, and sea salt in a resealable plastic bag. Add herring fillets.

title: Red Curry Veg
ingredients: 3 -5 medium green veg, in 3 inch cubes | 3 -5 serrano peppers | 1/4 cup olive ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons red curry paste ( to taste )
instructions: Place on broiler tray or grill. Turn after 5 minutes to prevent burning. In medium bowl mix with red curry paste. Add enough water to cover. Add one serrano and one olive if using. Cover and cook on medium low heat for about 10 minutes. Eat with pita bread or crisp rice and other veggies. For vegetarians use only the olive.

title: Homemade Adobo
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds fresh, trimmed boneless pork butt, cut into cubes | 2 whole serrano peppers | 1/2 cup honey | 1 large anaheim pepper
instructions: Place the pork into a large baking dish or other vessel. Wrap the serrano peppers around the pork and place on top of the meat. Drizzle the peppers with honey. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil. Refrigerate for 8 hours, turning several times. Preheat the oven broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Remove the pork from the marinade and place it on the prepared baking sheet. Broil until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f, about 30 minutes. Allow the pork to rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Feta Noodles
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 pound feta | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon minced onion salt | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | 2 spring onions, chopped, or more to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg,grain rice,prosciutto,juniper berry,red wine vinegar,black olive,chicken tender,hard egg
title: Spanish Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenderloins or 1 lb chicken thighs | 1 large hard-boiled egg, coarsely chopped | 1 lb hard-boiled egg, coarsely chopped | 4 ounces prosciutto or 4 ounces ham, finely chopped | 2 ounces marinated artichoke hearts, chopped | 8 ounces black olives, chopped | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 5 juniper berries | 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice, cooked
instructions: Mix chicken with hard boiled egg, ham, artichokes and green olives. Pour red wine vinegar over the salad. Season with juniper berries. Serve at room temperature.

title: Smoked Mushroom Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb portobello mushroom caps, washed and stems removed | 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1 teaspoon saffron strand ( or, for the smoke-safe portion ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed ( or, for the smoke-safe portion ) | 1 tablespoon bbq bbq oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil, for rubbing
instructions: Cut off the stems from the mushrooms and discard. Rinse them under cold running water, removing the dirt and sand. Cut the caps in half and slice off the ends and discard. Make sure all of your cut stems are removed and only cut stems aside. In a mortar and pestle, pound the mushrooms to release the sand, or crush them using the back of a knife. If you crush the mushrooms very fine, it will not stick to the mortar. Stir saffron in 1 tbsp olive oil. Dip the mushrooms into the mixture and press the leaves with something flat so they stick together. This will facilitate stuffing and keep them compact but you can work with as little air as possible. Place each cut mushroom on its cut surface, spread it open and close the seal. Make sure the mushrooms are closed using the kebab or oil. If not, press the kebab with the palm of your hand. Place mushrooms in a large ziploc bag and close, squeezing out as much air as possible. Refrigerate until you need to use up all of your strained cut mushrooms. Cut the mushrooms in half or into 1 inch chunks. Heat up the oil in a large frying pan, medium high. Add the bbq or olive oil, lower the heat and then put in the mushrooms. Stir it around so that the mushrooms brown on all sides. Make sure all of the mushrooms release their juices. When the mushrooms are browning remove them with a spatula and put them in a bowl. Put the mushrooms and saffron in a saucepan and add the ground cardamom, saffron and cardamom seeds, 1/4 tsp saffron dissolved in 1/4 tsp water. Saute the mushrooms in the oil until the water comes to a boil. Remove them from oil and set aside. When they are done, drain the liquid from the pan. Add a tbsp of the saved oil into the pan and put over medium heat. When the oil is hot, add the mushrooms and saute, stirring from time to time. Remove them from pan, placing on paper towels. When ready to serve, rub the mushrooms with oil from the pan and serve with the mushroom salad. Note that the recipe above is not for a one size bag of mushrooms, as this quantity of mushrooms can be used within 2 days of making. You may use up to 24 mushroom packages.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,kidney bean,coriander seed,taco seasoning mix,chicken strip,broccoli floret,no salt tomato
title: Spanish Chicken Skillet
ingredients: 3 -4 chicken strips or 3 -4 chicken thighs | 1 can no-salt-added kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 jar prepared pasta sauce ( optional ) or, for serving ( optional ) | 16 ounces frozen chopped broccoli florets, thawed | 1/3 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon coriander seed or 1 teaspoon whole coriander, freshly ground | 1 cup jarred crushed no-salt-added diced tomato ( hunts )
instructions: Place chicken and bean in slow cooker. Stir in tomato, taco seasoning, coriander, and bean mixture. Cover and cook on low setting for 6 to 8 hours or on high setting for 4 to 5 hours. Add broccoli during the last 30 to 60 minutes of cooking.

title: Miso Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup miso | 3/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1 package shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Dilute miso with half & half and microwave on high 3 minutes. Top cheese with miso sauce. You may want to add a small piece of provolone depending on the amount of cheese you used.

title: Turnips in Spiced Pisco
ingredients: 6 large turnips, peeled ( yellow-your favourite ones, about 3-inch long ) | 3 1/2 fluid ounces pisco ( i use pisco de ajo )
instructions: Boil the turnips in lightly salted water until very tender but still firm, about 15 minutes. Peel the turnips and cut them into 1/2 inch cubes. Place them into a bowl. Add the pisco. Place in the fridge until ready to serve but no later than about 1 hour.

title: Mango Chutney Popcorn
ingredients: 2 cups mango chutney | 3 eggs | 1 -4 teaspoon hot oil
instructions: Make mincemeat filling by combining chopped mango and chutney. Place all ingredients in a medium sized non stick pan and cook very slowly until thickened. Makes about 3 cups of mincemeat.

title: Garden Tabbouleh #5FIX
ingredients: 5 packages spring onions | 3 cups bulgur wheat | 3 cups cherry tomatoes
instructions: Dice the spring onions. You can cut them up yourself, or leave them whole if you don't have them in your pantry at all.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,brown rice,brown mustard seed,chocolate,french onion,romano cheese
title: Firday Special
ingredients: 1 cup bomba french onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup brown rice | 1/3 cup brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons chopped candied orange peel | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese | 3 tablespoons semisweet chocolate
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the french onions. Add the rice, and 1/4 cup water. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low heat, cover, and simmer until water is absorbed and the rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside to steam for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place 2 tbsp of sunflower oil into the bottom of an oiled 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1/2 inch jelly roll pan. Spread the brown mustard and sunflower seeds in a 10x13 inch jelly roll pan. Sprinkle the orange peel and the orange peel over the mustard. Cut the chocolate into 8 squares with a sharp knife or kitchen scissors. Use a paper towel to blot off any excess oil. Spread the chocolate over the top of the mustard. Douse the pan with boiling water. Spread the rice over the chocolate, and sprinkle on the remaining 1/4 cup sunflower seeds. Refrigerate until set, about 10 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Haitian Countryside Pork Ribs
ingredients: 4 countryside pork ribs | 1 -2 tablespoon chuck, finely cut, shoulder can be quite fatty | 2 -3 beef broth ( depending on how soupy-fat you want the meat ) | 1 cup spinach ( you can chop the kale, or use a blend of kale, spinach-cannellini, and or whatever you have in hand ) | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, defrosted for 30 minutes
instructions: Make sure the pork and beef are on sale, or have the butcher at your local butcher. Season both sides with salt and pepper and allow to sweat in a pan with a drizzle of extra virgin fat and some extra meat juices. While the meat and stock are cooking, slice the ribs into 1/4 slices. While the meat is cooking, make the filling. Boil the stock/soup in a pan big enough to accomodate the ribs. As soon as the bones have pulled out of their bones, remove the bones and set the stock/soup aside for a few minutes to cool while you prepare the meat/meat. Cut the pork and beef slabs in half, removing all the membrane attached to the underside of the ribs. Scoop out and discard any meat scraps. To finish, pat any excess fat from the meat and saute just a quick pat of butter and a drizzle of extra virgin oil in a large frying pan. Add the ribs and toss together. Continue frying over medium heat until the meat loses it's pink color from the pink inside. When the meat has done browning, add the beef broth/soup. Cover and simmer very slowly with a lid on. You can either set the pan over very low heat and simmer, or simmer on the stovetop for about 2 hours, making sure to stir a few times and let the meat simmer at the right texture. If using the stovetop, turn the heat down, add the spinach, mix well, and cook for about 2 minutes, or until it has just turned a nice glaze. Remove the lid off, raise the heat to medium high, and place the pastry sheets in the bottom. I like to use a cookie sheet so that the pastry doesn't get too hot or so hot that i can do this while i am waiting for the beef to simmer. I use my 9x13 baking dish, so i end up with about 3/4 of the sheets. When i put the meat mixture in my baking dish, i make a big tent of foil, and a few smaller ones as a lid around the meat mixture, and they help make it cleaner. Open the foil and spread the filling evenly over the meat. If you use smaller, thinner pieces of dough, just roll them to form a large rectangle around the meat and filling, with the dough about 8 inches across and about 10 inches wide. Cut up the ends of the dough, creating a lid. Wrap tightly in the foil. You are now partially covered with the foil, and can put the lid back on. I usually just put in a couple of smaller pieces of dough, if that will seal in a good deal of moisture, you can use your hand instead to squeeze out any air bubbles from the filling. Preheat your oven to 350°f or 350°f if you are using a convection oven, this process will create nice steamy top crust for the final product. Bake for about 45 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the filling has melted and begun to bubble. Once done, you are done baking. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef tongue,mint sprig,fish sauce,vanilla extract,baking soda
title: Tong Bao
ingredients: 3 beef tongues, separated, washed | 1 piece vanilla extract | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 fresh mint sprigs
instructions: Separate the tongues. Place all of the ingredients in a small pot, bring to a boil over medium heat then reduce to a simmer and cook for about an hour. Turn off the heat and set the tongues aside in a separate container for about half an hour. The tongue can be frozen and used in another recipe for longer or longer. Try your fresh mint for a better flavor and texture. Note, for a different tangy flavor, try 1 tbs of fish sauce and 1/2 tsp of baking soda.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,grain rice,chipotle chile adobo,soba noodle,egg yolk,shallot
title: Soy-Soba With Soba Noodles
