ingredients: 2 large egg yolks, lightly beaten | 1/4 cup shallot, minced | 1 tablespoon minced canned chipotle chile in adobo | 1/2 cup cold natural-style medium shrimp stock or 1/2 cup canned low sodium soy sauce | 5 cups hot cooked long-grain rice, such as nishiki | 3 cups toasted soy sesame seeds ( about 1/2 cup per loaf ) or 3 cups toasted nori seaweed, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a small bowl, whisk egg yolks until thick and pale yellow. Add shallot.

Random Ingredients: prune,chambord raspberry liquor,kamaboko,parsnip,tomato juice,guacamole,yellow squash,corn syrup
title: Grilled Japanese Style Vegetables
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes, medium, scrubbed | 1 medium tomato | 1 small yellow squash or 1 small red bell pepper | 1/2 lb unpitted prune | 1 package kamaboko, peeled | 1 bottle chambord raspberry liquor | 1 cup light corn syrup | 1 cup guacamole | 1/2 cup kamaboko, shaved ( available through www.kamaboko.com )
instructions: Preheat coals or gas grill on medium high. Cook sweet potatoes until they start to blister and turn reddish, about 7 minutes. Peel potatoes and slice into quarters. Cut tomato and squash into quarters. Cut pit off prunes and reserve. Split open up each sweet potato and chop into 3/4 pieces. Wash and dry kamaboko. Open bottle of chambord and remove any rind that may be attached. Cut in half horizontally. Carefully remove and discard membrane from inside the kamaboko shell. Combine chambord, vodka, corn syrup and 1/2 c water in a large saucepan over medium low heat stirring constantly until blended. Heat through. Stir in pakottis, adjust seasoning to taste. To serve place sweet potatoes in a large serving bowl, top with sweet potato mixture, garnish with some paprika, and drizzle with chambord syrup.

title: Grilled Salmon, Lime and Lime Teriyaki
ingredients: 4 fillets salmon | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 2 tablespoons light teriyaki sauce
instructions: Preheat grill pan on medium high heat and lightly coat with oil. Place salmon skin side down on grill pan and brush with lime zest. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes on each side until salmon just begins to flake. Meanwhile combine remaining ingredients, stirring well. Spread mixture on top of salmon and serve with lime wedges for squeezing over salmon.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,wide egg noodle,cajun seasoning,beef chuck,raspberry
title: Cousin June's Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 package wide egg noodles | 1 package beef chuck ( with or without the skin ) | 20 ounces frozen raspberries, thawed and drained | 3 -6 lbs large shrimp, shelled and deveined | cajun seasoning
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, remove and discard stems from shrimp, leaving tails on. Cut shrimp and raspberries into 1 1/2 segments. Rinse and drain noodles and return to pot with shrimp, raspberries and seasoning. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat for 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Chipped Mussels
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons black pepper | 6 mussels | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chile | 1 tablespoon chopped fennel | 1 tablespoon rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spread golden syrup on a baking sheet, then rub spice mixture evenly over the hot syrup. Bake in the oven, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and cool. Scrub mussels under cold running water, discarding any broken ones. Rinse under cold running water and drain. Return mussels to baking sheet, add dark roasted spice mixture. Add chipotle and fennel, then rum, and toss. Serve in shallow soup bowls with small bowls of ice cubes or hot crackers, if desired.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,cheese,bok choy,catsup,rump steak,red food coloring,yellow bell pepper,steak
title: Chinese Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 - 1 1/2 lb rump steak, sliced into thin strips | 1/2 lb snow peas | 1/2 lb bok choy, sliced | 1/2 lb yellow bell pepper, sliced | 1/2 lb red hot pepper, sliced | 1/2 lb steak, cut into thin strips | 3/4 cup cheese, shredded | 1/2 - 3/4 cup crushed fresh chinese chives
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the catsup with one tablespoon of water. Pour 1/3 cup of the catsup mixture over the sliced beef and marinate for 15 minutes. In a large skillet or wok, stir fry the beef with the snow peas/pak choi pieces as long as possible. Add the snow peas/pak choi to the beef/beef mixture and stir fry until the meat just starts to sizzle. Lower the heat and sprinkle with cheese and crushed chives as desired. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,poultry seasoning,vegetable,buttermilk,italian herb seasoning
title: Italian Herb Vegetable Sausage
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable, cooked and sliced | 1/2 cup black-eyed peas, cooked and sliced | 2 cups mixed vegetables, sliced in 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons mixed italian herbs seasoning | 2 tablespoons poultry seasoning | 2 1/2 cups buttermilk
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large bowl combine vegetable, black eyed peas and mixed vegetables. Season with italian herb seasoning, poultry seasoning and buttermilk. Toss well until well mixed. Place on a large greased baking sheet and bake until heated through.

title: Crispy Coated Sweet Potato Fingers
ingredients: 8 large sweet potatoes | 2 cups light corn oil | 2/3 cup white flour | 6 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f grease 2 cookie sheets and set aside. Peel and dice sweet potatoes, then place into a large pan together with a large pinch of salt. Peel and dice sweet potatoes, and add to pan with just enough water to cover the whole. Bring to a boil then simmer over low to medium heat for 30 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside to cool. In a medium mixing bowl, mix flour and oil to make a firm dough. Cut dough into 4 pieces and roll each piece out onto a hot, ungreased griddle approximately 1/2 inch thick. Spread the fries out in to an even circle in a circle with the flat side toward the center. When bubbles appear and dough is beginning to crackle, turn over and let cook the other side. When fries are fully cooked and crisp, remove from heat, and roll each long way. In a small non stick frypan, heat 1 tablespoon of corn oil and fry the coated fries until golden brown on both sides and crisp on the outside. Serve warm.

title: Lettuce with white wine vinegar
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, rinsed and torn into small pieces | 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Mix mayonnaise and vinegar in small bowl. Place lettuce in serving bowl. Toss with dressing.

title: Queso Content -- Mexican Cheese
ingredients: 1 - 2 lb.mozzarella cheese, cut into cubes | cracked black pepper
instructions: Place cheese cubes in an oven proof casserole dish. Sprinkle pepper over the cheese. Drizzle with olive oil. Bake at 400 f for 15 - 20 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Easy Beef and Bean Chili
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 2 cans baked beans | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro ( optional ) or 1/2 cup fresh parsley ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Remove the fat from meat.

title: Pesto & Madeira Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb dried linguine | 1 jar madeira wine | 1/2 cup pesto sauce
instructions: In a dutch oven, bring 4 quarts water to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, madeira, and pesto sauce. Place dutch oven over high heat and bring the mixture to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Gluten Free Granny Smith Applesauce
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum ( or use gluten-free flour ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 granny smith apple, peeled and grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f line cookie sheet with parchment paper. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Drop the mixture by rounded tablespoons onto cookie sheet making 8 smaller pieces. Brush with water or nonstick spray.

title: Vegetable Pizzelles
ingredients: 2 tomatoes, finely chopped | 1/2 vanilla bean, scraped and split in half lengthwise
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f degrees. Divide the tomatoes into 2 large baking dishes. Spread the vanilla bean halves over the tomatoes, and cut the vanilla bean in half lengthwise. Bake for 5 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven until they begin to caramelize, stirring occasionally. Remove cookies from the oven, and place a scoop of vanilla bean in the center of each one. Return to oven, and bake for about 3 minutes. The cookies will be bubbly and beginning to brown. Cool completely on a wire rack.

title: Italian Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 lbs pork tenderloin
instructions: Place pork tenderloins in a slow cooker, fat side up, and place it in the slow cooker with 1/2 cup of water in the bottom. Cook on low for 6 hours. Place pork in plastic bag or shallow dish and allow to rest 20 minutes before slicing crosswise on the diagonal.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing mix,five spice powder,saffron strand,cream,red bell pepper
title: Saffron Cream Sauce
ingredients: 7 saffron strands | 2 cans cream | 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1/4 inch dice | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: In a large pot, bring cream to a boil. Remove from heat. Add red pepper, saffron and green/paprika. Let steep for 5 - 10 minutes. Then strain.

title: Mexican Shrimp & Meatball Salad
ingredients: 5 large shrimp, cleaned and devained | 1 lb frozen meatballs | 1 chipotle pepper, chipotle pepper in adobo, diced | 12 ounces red wine, medium grade | 2 -3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil
instructions: Remove shrimp from shells, and cook on large pot of boiling water for about 5 minutes. Remove shells and rinse shrimp, and cut into ¾ inch pieces. Set aside. Prepare meatballs, slice into ¼ inch pieces. Prepare sauce, in a sauce pan, simmer shrimp, chipotle pepper and wine for about 30 - 60 minutes. Stir in chicken, and simmer until shrimp is just cooked. Chop basil into ½ inch pieces. Combine shrimp and sauce, and serve on plate with basil. Chill until serving.

title: Pecan-Basil Lettuce Salad Wraps
ingredients: 3/4 cup pecan nuts or 3/4 cup slivered almonds | 1 head lettuce | 2 dried ancho chilies ( or similar chilies, if you like them hotter ) | 1/4 cup red wine | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf ( or a combination of the two ) or 1/4 cup fresh basil ( or a combination of the two )
instructions: Boil the nuts in water until they turn the color of instant coffee, about 30 seconds. Drain nuts and put on paper towels to cool. Core the chilies and discard the seeds, pods and veins, set aside. Cut the lettuce into chunks and put in a large bowl. Dice the chilies and add to the lettuce. Add the pine nuts and fresh basil just before serving. Chill at least 2 hours before using to blend flavors.

title: Simple Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans tomatillo salsa | 8 ounces sliced almonds, toasted | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Toast almonds until fragrant. Remove from heat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Let cool for approx 5 - 10 minutes before serving. Use as a topping for meat, vegetables and bread. It's especially good with chicken skewers and other veggies.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,bean sprout,vegetable stock,skin salmon fillet,parmesan cheese,fenugreek seed,oyster
title: Smoked Salmon Parcel With Oyster Raita
ingredients: 450 g skin-on salmon fillets | 2 tablespoons peppercorns | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 300 ml vegetable stock | 50 g dried oysters ( sliced or chopped ) | 150 g bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat grill to high. If using a fish with a bone, skin it then cut in half lengthways and then pound out both halves using a meat mallet or rolling pin. Season both sides of the halved salmon with salt and pepper and roll in the peppercorns and fenugreek. Cook salmon on grill for 2 - 3 minutes each side. Add a stock cube and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork. Remove from the heat and set aside to rest for 5 minutes prior to using. Add oysters to a pan with the bean sprouts and season with salt and pepper. Simmer over a gentle heat for 4 - 5 minutes or until hot. Add salmon to the bean sprouts and gently stir to combine. Remove from heat and scatter with parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon cube,jalapeno chile,white wine,turnip,white wine vinegar,banana
title: Jalapeno-Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon vegetable bouillon cube, i used knorr brand if you have it | 1 jalapeno chile, seeded and finely chopped ( i added in 1/2 tsp. of jalapeno seeds ) | 5 cups fresh tomatoes with tomatoes, roughly chopped | 2 cups peeled and chopped turnips | 2/3 cup white wine vinegar | 2/3 cup dry white wine | 1/2 large banana, peeled and chopped
instructions: Note, if using fresh tomatoes, remove the seeds and the membrane and dice to equal 2/3 cup, otherwise, use less than 1/3 cup. Place the tomatoes into a saucepan with some water just to cover.

title: Pickled Rabbit
ingredients: 1 rabbit | 6 ounces anchovy paste | 1 chili pepper, sliced | 1 small red chili pepper, sliced | 1 tablespoon dried sweet corn | 1 tablespoon kosher salt
instructions: Prick the rabbit in two or three places with tip of a sharp knife. Dry the rabbit on paper towels. Remove all viscery strings and membrane from the meat. Place the rack in lower third of oven and preheat to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Tightly wrap each rabbit rabbit with 2 inch thick cotton butcher twine, securing it with twine. Place on rack in roasting pan. Place chile, chili pepper, and corn in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Let the mixture simmer uncovered for 20 minutes, or until reduced by half. Season the rabbit with salt. Ladle 2 to 3 tablespoons of the hot curing liquid on the rack and place rabbit on rack. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Tortillas With Carrots, Carrots & Tortillas (Serves 6!)
ingredients: 4 small tortillas | 8 -12 ounces baby carrots, cooked
instructions: Warm tortillas. Put carrots on one end of tortilla & spread the carrots on that end. Fold the other end over the carrots. Cut into small pieces using pizza cutter or other sharp knife. Serve immediately with salsa.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,oil,cumin seed,taco seasoning,garam masala,head cabbage
title: Taco Ring
ingredients: 4 tablespoons oil | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 head cabbage, chopped | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add taco seasoning.

title: Smoked Portabella and Raspberry Roulade
ingredients: 1 package portabella mushrooms, sliced | 2 packages frozen pound mushrooms | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking shortening | 1 tablespoon irish cream ( bailey's ) | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint | 3 tablespoons raspberry jam or 3 tablespoons raspberry jam
instructions: Cook all the ingredients except for the jam, until cooked through. Cool slightly. Spread jam on each slice of roulade, and fill with the mushroom mixture. Re roll, and cut into quarters.

title: Quick & Easy Pea Kugel
ingredients: 1 cup raw brown-eyed peas (  see  ) | 32 ounces bottled chili sauce
instructions: Drain the pigeon peas and place them in a pot. Heat until bubbly, but not boiling. Add the chili sauce, and stir.

title: Simple and Simple Mint Chutney Pancakes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon flour | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the flour and chutney. Fold in the lemon peel. Heat a lightly greased griddle or frying pan. For each pancake, grease or spray griddle with nonstick spray. Pour batter onto griddle, spreading evenly. Cook until bubbles form on the top and bottom, but the underside of the pancake is brown. You may need to flip pancake with a spatula to make more or less pancakes. I usually flip half way through, making sure it browns evenly. The pancakes should still be a little soft and slightly moist with some liquid underneath. Serve with mint chutney on the side.

title: Okra Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb okra, washed and stem removed | 4 -5 mushrooms | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated
instructions: Cut off the stem ends of mushrooms and remove the hard parts. Cut mushrooms in half lengthwise, open and wash till almost dry. Soak okra under cold water till mushy. Remove skin and remove fuzz under running water. Remove pulp with a spoon. Mix ginger garlic paste with okra, mix well and stuff mushroom caps with mixture. Boil lightly till the mushrooms are soft and all the water is absorbed. Remove from flame. Place in a casserole dish. Sprinkle fresh ground ginger on top and bake at 350 f for 20 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,parmigiano reggiano,vanilla bean,black bean,grain white rice,wild rice,mustard,onion mushroom soup mix
title: Wild Rice and Beans With Mustard
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice | 1 medium wild rice | 1 can black beans with liquid ( drained ) | 1 package onion and mushroom soup mix | 1/4 cup fresh minced onion | 1/2 teaspoon mustard | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup shaved fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Set the oven at 350°f. In a large baking dish, combine rice and wild rice. Pour the beans over the rice. Mix together, then drizzle with soup. Top with a few drops of mustard and a sprinkling of cheese. Stick the lid on the pot, place it in the oven and bake until the rice is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. Serve in bowls or cups with a fresh loaf of bread for mopping up the gravy. Tip, it may vary depending on the quality of the wild rice and beans, and the width of the grains. Add the mushrooms, onions and mushrooms to the rice and beans. Season with salt and pepper before serving.

Random Ingredients: allspice,cherry vodka,lite olive oil,coriander,white rice,cider vinegar,thai basil
title: Pickled Cherries
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh coriander, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh thai basil | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1 1/2 cups cherry vodka | 1/4 cup lite olive oil | 1 cup white rice ( preferably basmati )
instructions: Combine all ingredients, adding salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or up to 6 hours. To serve, bring to room temperature. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,hot pepper flake,jam,cottage cheese,heavy cream,beef
title: Lazy Pepperjack Cottage Cheesep Dip
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese ( i buy 2 packs of prepared but not exact ) | 1 lb ground beef | 20 ounces cream of mushroom soup ( cream of mushroom in a jar ) | hot pepper flakes ( optional, to taste, i use franks ) ( optional ) | 3 cups heavy cream ( whipping cream in a jar ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons jelly
instructions: Brown ground beef in a frying pan. Drain. Sprinkle with hot pepper flakes if desired. Drain any excess fat from meat if desired. Drain cream of mushroom soup in strainer into a small bowl. Add cream of mushroom soup, worcestershire sauce, soup, & jelly to meat. Mix well. Pour into pie plate. Bake in 350 degree oven for about 20 to 30 minutes or until hot & bubbly..

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,bay leaf,onion powder,parsnip,peanut oil,ginger juice
title: Sweet, Sour Parsnips
ingredients: 2 large parsnips ( about 250g each ) | garlic salt | onion powder | parsley or thyme | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon pickled ginger juice
instructions: Wash the parsnips thoroughly and scrub under salt.

title: Tuna Pasta
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained of oil and squeezed | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, strained and diced ( or a can of diced tomatoes if you don� t like tomatoes ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Place tuna in pot with the rest of the ingredients and cook over medium heat until heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,apple cider,plum tomato,green chili,basil,shallot,cooking sherry,white chocolate
title: Tomato Salad With White Chocolate
ingredients: 1 ounce butter | 12 plum tomatoes, cut into 6 cm cubes | 2 shallots, finely chopped | 150 ml apple cider or 150 ml dry white wine | 1 teaspoon anchovy fillet, minced | 1 green chili, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, leaves torn | cooking sherry ( optional ) or apple juice ( optional )
instructions: Put butter in a small pan, add tomatoes and shallots over low heat and just cover with the lid. Heat for 10 mins, stirring occasionally. Remove the lid, increase heat to high and simmer for 5 mins for the tomatoes to soften. Combine tomatoes, shallots, cider or wine, anchovy and chili in a bowl and cook for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with the basil leaves and serve right away.

title: Budget Rolls for Burritos
ingredients: 2 cups bean sprouts, shredded | 1/2 cup fresh basil, finely shredded | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 package phyllo dough, thawed | 3 tablespoons instant coffee powder
instructions: In a bowl, combine sprouts, basil, turmeric, and ground coffee. Spray a 10 to 12 inch saute pan with nonstick cooking spray and set over low heat. Unroll phyllo dough and cut into 1 inch squares. Roll each square into a cigar shape about 3/8 inch thick. Place 1 tablespoon bean sprout mixture in middle of each square. Moisten the edge of each with water, fold over and pinch closed. Continue rolling until phyllo dough has been used. Place rolls in the pan and brush each with 1 tablespoon water. Cover and refrigerate rolls for 30 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese and Cinnamon Tiramis
ingredients: 1/2 kg cottage cheese, curds | 3 cups water | 250 g ladyfingers, cut lengthwise in half | 2 tablespoons ice water, if required
instructions: Heat water in a saucepan on high flame. Add condensed cottage cheese and cook for a few minutes. Add chilli powder, cooked cottage cheese and ladyfinger halves. Stir well. Cook for 5 minutes. Dissolve in 1 cup of very little water. Pour into serving plates. Serve immediately. Enjoy.

title: Simple English Sausage - Roll
ingredients: 3 tablespoons celery salt | 1 cup unsweetened chocolate, grated
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into log using waxed paper and chill for 1 hour. Roll after chilling in an airtight container. Freeze.

title: Mango Pesto Kiwi Fruit Bites
ingredients: 250 g firm kiwi fruit | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, roughly chopped
instructions: Cut kiwifruit in half and slice diagonally. Place in a bowl along with the pesto. Add the flour. Mix well. Add the kiwifruit mixture. Toss until coated. Chill for 30 minutes to a minimum of 2 hours. Preheat oven to 200°c. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Place 1 tablespoon of the pesto into the centre of each tray. Sprinkle on 2 teaspoons of dried chopped coriander leaves. Place 3 kiwifruit pieces onto each. Sprinkle the remaining coriander leaves onto each kiwifruit nut. Bake for 25 minutes or until puffed and golden.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,extra virgin olive oil,chive,pea,oregano leaf,chipotle chile,beef stew meat,onion soup mix
title: Chipotle Beef and Peas
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 4 1/2 cups low-sodium instant peas | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon dried chives | 1 teaspoon ground chipotle chile | 1 teaspoon orange zest
instructions: Heat the oil in a dutch oven over medium high heat. Add the soup mix and stir until dissolved, about 30 seconds. Add the beef and cook until the mixture is browned. Stir in the peas, oregano, chives, chile, and orange zest, breaking up any clumps. Bring the mixture to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook 35 - 45 minutes.

title: Shandy - Tony Soprano's Taco Sauce for Fish
ingredients: 3 jars taco sauce ( or homemade ) | 3 cans cherry tomatoes ( or any other type of fresh tomato ) | 1 tablespoon white pepper
instructions: Prepare the salsa on the jars, or leave them on to dry. Place the tomatoes & the white pepper in a large sauce pan. Heat gently on a burner to warm through. When hot, add the tomato mixture & simmer over very low heat for about an hour. The water in the salsa will also help the tomatoes and peppers fry through. Stir gently & be careful that the water doesn't burn. Keep an eye on it so it does not burn on the bottom. When this is about to boil, put 2 tbsp of the salsa into a mug, pour into the mug & stir well. Keep doing this for about 15 - 20 minutes to soften the tomatoes & mix with the salsa. Taste test the salsa for salt or seasoning, and add more if you don’t like salt substitute sour cream.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,italian seasoning,pasta,large shrimp,banana,oregano,corn kernel,tortilla
title: Crispy Beef-Shrimp Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 can large shrimp, drained and chopped ( or 6 ounces cooked shrimp ) | 1 can corn kernels | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 3/4 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 12 crisp tortillas | 1 1/2 cups crumbled multicolored tortilla chips or 1 1/2 cups coarsely crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Spray 10 muffin tins with cooking spray. In large skillet over medium low heat, brown beef. Add shrimp, corn, bouillon granules, oregano and italian seasoning. Continue to cook until shrimp are thoroughly cooked and shrimp are bright pink and sauce has thickened slightly. Scoop shrimp mixture onto tortillas and roll up tortillas. Place seam side down on lined tins. Spray 10 muffin tins more often with cooking spray. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 18 - 20 minutes, or until filling in center of each bun feels just firm when you gently touch them.

title: Lamb and Clam in Chili Sauce(Vietnamese Xoi Mang Dho)
ingredients: 12 cups meat ( chicken, beef, or shrimp ) | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 teaspoons sugar ( optional ) | 4 serrano peppers or 4 jalapeno peppers, very thinly sliced | 1 bunch fresh mint sprig | 12 clams, scrubbed
instructions: Cut meat into 2 x 1 inch pieces. Set aside. Combine cooking oil and sugar in heavy large pot over high heat. Add meat and fry in large batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Add 2 serrano peppers or jalapenos and remaining serrano peppers. Stir. Add mint leaves and cloves. Stir. Cover. Simmer over very low heat 20 minutes. Add clams. Cover and cook 10 minutes longer. Lift meat out of pot. Using slotted spoon, transfer cloves. Return meat to pot. Heat through. Serve warm over hot rice.

title: Crazy Chocolate Potatoes
ingredients: 2 packages chocolate instant pudding mix | 12 -14 red potatoes
instructions: Cut the potatoes lengthwise into about 1 inch slices. Grease a medium size pan or pan. Place the potatoes in the pan and cover and cook over medium heat until soft. While the potatoes are baking, put the chocolate pudding mix in to a medium bowl. Pour the chocolate pudding mix into the bowl with the potatoes. Mix by hand or on the counter until the mixture is somewhat evenly spread. The pudding mix will come together. You can even use a kitchen knife or a pastry tip to spread the chocolate pudding mix on top of the potato mixture. Allow the chocolate pudding to set, but it is still going to get hot. When the chocolate pudding is finished, remove from heat, and spread onto a plate with wax paper or wax paper. The chocolate tends to break so microwave it for 2 minutes or so to get it to have melted. It should be a kind of pale blond color.

title: Boiled Ham
ingredients: 1 piece ham, approximately 2 x | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Place ham in a glass bowl. Sprinkle salt, mustard seed and baking soda over it. Cover bowl or mold and place in the preheated oven. Bake for approximately 45 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,plain flour,veal,mini chocolate chip,cranberry,garlic granule
title: Cranberry Glazed Whole Meat Loaf
ingredients: 350 g whole lean ground veal | 100 g minced fresh cranberries ( i usually use a mix of dried cranberries and dried ) | 3 tablespoons granulated garlic granules | 1 pinch of crushed dried garlic granules | 150 ml vegetable stock | 1/2 cup of crushed mini chocolate chip | plain flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place veal, cranberries, sugar and garlic/garlic granules into mixing bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well with your hand. Pat mixture into an oven proof dish. Combine stock with dried chips and pour over meat. Cover with foil or a tea towel and bake at 180°c for 30 minutes. Remove the foil or tea towel and sprinkle with flour. Cook for a further 30 minutes. Meat will be cooked very crumbly. Serve with mashed potato. This can also be served with boiled or steamed cauliflower. Makes about 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,okra,pumpkin pie spice,chicken bouillon,escarole,guajillo chilies,cheese tortellini,kale
title: Caldo Loco's Tortellini
ingredients: 1 pound fresh cheese tortellini | 1 bunch fresh kale, rinsed, dried, chopped, stems removed | 1 can sweet pumpkin pie spice | 1 cup chopped okra | 1 cup chopped chile peppers ( optional ) | 3 cubes chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh guajillo chilies, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add tortellini, stir, and return to a boil. Cook until tortellini is tender, about 11 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Meanwhile, spray 2 of the green chile peppers with cooking spray. Place one stuffed olive in the prepared cheese tortellini and top with 1/2 cup chopped kale, chile peppers, and chicken bouillon. Repeat layers, and top with remaining kale, chile peppers, chicken bouillon, guajillo peppers, and remaining diced chile peppers. Heat in the microwave on high until cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.

title: Mexican Beans
ingredients: 200 g dried pinto beans | 200 g dried chile guajillos | 100 g powdered coriander powder | 2/3 cup oil
instructions: For the bean, rinse in a colander, then place in a large bowl and cover with boiling water. Soak, in the morning, for 1 - 2 hours or until tender and fluffy. Drain. For the soup, soak the guajillo in the boiling water until soft, about 15 - 20 minutes, then drain. Slice the guajillo into half diagonally, then remove and discard stem and seeds. Heat the oil in a non stick frying pan over medium low heat, then add the ground coriander and chile guajillos and stir fry until fragrant. Add the beans and fry for 3 - 4 minutes or until the contents are well coated. Add the powdered coriander and serve hot.

title: Japanese Herb and Garlic Powder
ingredients: 12 dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 1/3 cups chicken bouillon powder | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 1/2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Wash mushrooms and cut into about 10 slices. Rinse mushrooms and chop roughly. Combine the mushroom, bouillon, basil, cardamom, and oyster sauce in a bowl.

title: Japanese Lentil Cake (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry lentils ( white or brown ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 4 -5 -6 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Pick over and rinse lentils. Rinse with cold water to remove excess water. You will have approximately 1 - 1 1/2 cups of washed lentils and approximately 5 cups of mushy lentils. Rinse and pat dry. Put lentils and dark sesame oil in separate dish and micro fry at highest setting until the lentils are golden brown this will take around 5 - 10 minutes. If your micro oil is too cold it will liquefy the lentils and make them tough if you pour them over the sink first. Spread lentils out on a large plate and sprinkle the dark sesame oil over them. Let rest before eating, covered loosely with aluminum wrap. It is best to store at room temperature for an hour or so before eating. Variation, i usually double the baking time for this recipe. This is my adaptation for dh and l. I was told in review that dark sesame oil works with the dish.

title: Asparagus and Swiss Fritters
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus spears | 1/4 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1/4 cup club soda | 2 slices swiss cheese, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Trim ends and cut tough tips from asparagus. Cut spears crosswise into 1 1/2 inch lengths. Add to a saucepan of boiling water. Add xanthan gum and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it is foamy. Gradually stir in club soda until dissolved. Add cheese and cook over medium heat, stirring, until mixture is warm but not hot. Drop batter by heaping tablespoons onto a preheated griddle. Cook until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,green olive,picante sauce,milk ricotta cheese,field mushroom,black lentil,kalamata olive,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Moroccan Layered Dip With Olives and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb whole milk ricotta cheese or 1 lb part-skim ricotta cheese, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup pimento, chopped | 1/4 cup green olives, sliced | 6 pimento-stuffed green olives, chopped, i use a bag of sliced pimentos | 1/2 cup pimento-stuffed green olives, chopped ( optional ) | 1 jar pimiento, sliced, i use a jarred pimentos | 1 -2 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix, see note ( moroccan spice mix can be found at zaar ) | 1/2 cup whole milk pimento, chopped | 3/4 cup red-leaf sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and julienned ( optional ) | 1 jar stuffed green olives | 3/4 cup kalamata olive, sliced
instructions: For the dip, using a fork mash the ricotta cheese with a fork. Add the pimentos, green olives, olives with the spice mix, and the ras el hanout. Mix well. To assemble, place 1 rounded teaspoon of mixture onto the bottom of a pie plate. Place 2nd rounded teaspoon of mixture onto the top. Spread 1 3/4 cups of the filling over the mixture, and spread about 1/3 of the olives over the filling. Place 2nd round of mixture onto the olives, and spread the top with tomato slices, olives, and remaining pimento slices. Arrange the chopped olives decoratively on top. Cover with foil. Place pie plate in the fridge. To serve, garnish the dip with whole olives, and garnish with the kalamata olives. Note, i have found that the pimentos can be heated in a small pan, to reduce the cheese's oiliness, but it does not have that same flavor. Note, the amounts of olives and pimentos can vary widely depending on what kind of olives you use.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,buttermilk,active yeast,cooking oil,green bell pepper
title: Indian Bell Pepper Bread
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 cups buttermilk | 1 cup finely chopped green bell pepper | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 3 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Dissolve dry yeast in buttermilk. Stir in peppers and spices. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into batter. Turn into greased loaf pan or pan. Cover loosely with plastic wrap. Let rise in warm place until well doubled in bulk. Bake according to package directions or until tester comes out clean. Cool completely or freeze. Thaw overnight. Preheat oven to 375°f degrees. Pour melted butter inside bread as a dipping topping. This can be served warm or cold.

title: Broccoli Cheese Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 16 ounces broccoli cheese soup | 6 ounces mixed berries | 1/2 cup cranberries, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Boil the salmon for about 10 minutes in a pot with a bit of water. Drain the salmon, and place it skin side down on a dish. Sprinkle with tabasco sauce over the salmon. Mix together the soup and berries and pour over the salmon. Sprinkle with cranberries. Cover and cook on low in a microwave for 10 - 15 minutes. This would be good served cold.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,eggplant,chicken bouillon cube,monterey jack cheese,beef liver,self raising flour,sea scallop
title: The Best Scallop Casserole
ingredients: 300 g self raising flour | 100 g monterey jack cheese | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs stewing beef | 1 eggplant | 2 cans chicken bouillon cubes | 500 g sliced beef liver | 1 kg sea scallops
instructions: Cut stew beef into bite size pieces. In a saucepan melt the bouillon cubes. Add meat and onions and cook over a medium heat until meat becomes dark brown. Cut the eggplant into bite size pieces and add to pot. Bring to boil and simmer until eggplant becomes translucent. Place both cans of chicken into the pot and add a little water. Let sit for about 10 minutes. Combine both cans of scallops with both cans of the stock. Spread half the mixture in the bottom of a casserole dish. Place a layer of green sauce on top of the beef. Cut the liver in half and cut into 1 inch long sections. Layer on top of this the liver, cheese and scallop mixture. Repeat until ingredients are used up. Bake in oven at 350 degrees for about 1 hour. Serve with a mixed baguette, fresh vegetables, or a crusty baguette loaf.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,chinese mushroom,lime,parsley leaf,black eyed pea,mozzarella cheese,marinara sauce,white bread
title: Chinese Breaded Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 cup frozen black-eyed peas | 1 lb fresh chinese mushroom, sliced | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh lime | 1/2 bell pepper, sliced | 1/2 mozzarella cheese | marinara sauce | 8 slices white bread
instructions: Slice bread into 1/2 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,lime wedge,black eyed pea,grand marnier,kernel corn,monterey jack cheese,ricotta cheese,shrimp
title: Shrimp and Black-Eyed Peas Cheese Pizza from the Food for 2
ingredients: 1/2 lb cooked shrimp, peeled | 1/2 cup cannellini black-eyed peas, drained | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 12 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 12 whole kernel corn, drained | 4 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut shrimp in half lengthwise.

title: Chilean Pumpkin Seeds (Pumpkin Seeds and Spices)
ingredients: 2 ounces pumpkin seeds | 2 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Crush the pumpkin seeds with a mortar and pestle. Blend together the stock, ginger garlic paste and pumpkin seeds. Bring to the boil and stir in the seeds.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,edam cheese,leek,italian herb,feta cheese,kalamata olive
title: Crusty Asafhito
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons fresh leeks or 2 tablespoons leeks, diced | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon feta cheese | 1 tablespoon grated edam cheese or 1 tablespoon grated feta cheese | 1/8 teaspoon dried mixed italian herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a small bowl, mix together asafetida and next three ingredients. Brush the entire inside of a cookie sheet with spray oil, and spread mixture inside. Top the crust with asafoetida mixture. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese on the asafetida mixture. Sprinkle the top of the cheese with the dried herbs. Bake 30 minutes until top is a nice dark brown.

title: Sparkling Mint
ingredients: 1 can carbonated lemon-lime beverage, chilled | 8 mint sprigs
instructions: Fill a tall chilled glass with ice. Pour carbonated lemon lime soda slowly into the glass over the ice. Garnish with mint sprigs, and serve.

title: Crab and Fig Jam - Microwave!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon clear honey | 2 packets icing sugar | 1 small scallion, chopped | 2 large firm figs, stems removed, chopped | 1 medium bell pepper, chopped ( red, yellow and green mixed ) | 1 cup cooked crabmeat
instructions: Make the icing, stir together the icing sugar and scallion. Add in the figs and peppers and stir to combine. Add in the crab meat and the fig and honey and stir thoroughly to combine, then pour into a microwave safe dish and microwave on high power for about 7 minutes until all the liquid is absorbed. Remove from microwave and stir again to combines. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Homemade Baked Cauliflower Lasagna
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, shredded | 5 slices crisply bacon, chopped | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 can sliced avocados | 1/2 cup dried currants | 1 package lasagna sheets, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a large bowl, combine cauliflower, bacon, italian seasoning, mashed avocado and currants. Reserve 3/4 of this mixture for later use. Lay remaining mixture on the bottom of the baking dish and cover with the remaining mixture. Top with remaining 3/4 of bacon slices to completely cover the top. Sprinkle top with remaining bacon slices and bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes. Top lasagna with remaining 2/3 bowl mixture and bake, uncovered, for about 30 minutes or until center is set and cheese is browned.

title: Pork and Vegetable Tamale Filling
ingredients: 3 links bacon | 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 4 tablespoons soybean oil or 4 tablespoons other vegetable oil | 8 ounces pork tenderloin, trimmed and sliced into thin strips | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 plum ( optional )
instructions: Cook and stir fry the bacon in a skillet until crisp. Drain the bacon on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: bread,flat leaf parsley,mushroom,purpose flour,ro tel tomato,polenta,parmesan cheese,thyme leaf
title: Polenta and Cheese With Ro-Tel Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup polenta | 1 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 2 teaspoons grated parmesan cheese | 2 cups chopped mushroom ( i've used button ) | 1 cup chopped dried bread | 1/2 cup chopped ro-tel tomatoes, undrained ( i use progresso ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 3 or 4 quart slow cooker. Cover.

Random Ingredients: head broccoli,red enchilada sauce,ice water,kalamata olive,oregano leaf,maraschino cherry,beef brisket
title: Corn Tortilla Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup ice water | 1 large head broccoli, cut into florets | 1 pound lean beef brisket, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 2 cans refrigerated, sliced pitted kalamata olives | 1/3 cup chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon dried maraschino cherries, chopped
instructions: Pour 1 tablespoon water into a large pot. Spread the flank steak with the reserved water, cover the pot, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the meat is tender, and the fat has turned deep brown, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove the meat from the pot, reserving the broth, and let it rest. Shred the beef with 2 forks. Transfer to a plate and shred the meat, discarding the fat and any cartilege. Return the meat to the broth, mix in the enchilada sauce, olives, oregano, and cherries, and serve immediately.

title: Broccoli Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 package frozen broccoli, thawed and chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/4 cup margarine | 1 package vegetable shortening, chilled | 1 package jalapeno chili, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Mix first six ingredients in a large bowl. Dump into prepared baking dish. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Cut into squares and serve. Makes 6 servings.

Random Ingredients: potato noodle,stir fry sauce,chutney,vanilla,green onion,portobello mushroom cap
title: Stir Fry Portobello Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 portobello mushroom caps, stems ( caps sliced ) | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped | 1/4 cup chutney | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon real vanilla, to taste | 3 cups leftover stir-fry sauce, with some of the liquid | 16 ounces potato noodles, pre-cooked ( may use your favorite )
instructions: Cook the portobello mushrooms in hot vegetable oil ( no oil except for one or two tablespoons of the cooking liquid ) until tender, about five minutes. Remove from heat and place in a large deep serving dish. In separate small bowl combine green onion, chutney and vanilla. Pour over the mushrooms. Toss to mix evenly. Sprinkle with any of the leftover stirring ingredients and cover with the lid or plastic wrap secured with foil. Let stand in refrigerator for about 20 minutes. Pour the remaining cooking liquid in the serving dish and stir into the mushroom mixture until smooth. Taste for sweetness, add more vanilla if necessary. Note, if the recipe contains chutney, add the chutney just before serving to avoid the sourness of the sour flavor..

title: Baked Panir and Pinto Beans (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 lb panir, cut into cubes ( i used a veggie, like smart balance ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil or 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 6 scallions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon finely chopped chili pepper | 28 ounces italian-style stewed tomatoes, drained and cut up | 1 cup canned pinto beans, drained, rinsed and rinsed | 1 ripe banana, cut into 1/2 pieces ( optional ) | 8 slices country bread
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, combine the panir, oil, scallions and chili peppers and toss together well until the veggie mixture is evenly distributed. Spoon the mixture into a lightly oiled 9 x13 baking dish. Tear off a small piece around the edges of the dish and place on top of the vegetable mixture. Stir, cover and bake for 45 minutes. Meanwhile, put the stewed tomatoes, split pinto beans, banana and bread into the baking dish with the tomato mixture and bake for 15 minutes, stirring in the mixture once more, until it is heated through and the bread has been warm, approximately 7 - 10 minutes.

title: BBQ Vegetables
ingredients: 1/4 lb ground veal | 1/4 lb ground veal | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup light turnip | 1/2 teaspoon basil | 1/2 teaspoon rice cereal
instructions: In a bowl mix up the first five ingredients. In a second bowl toss the veggies with the barbecue sauce. Put a small amount of the veggies in the bottom of a large non stick frying pan or skillet on low. When the veggies are ready pour the sauce over them. Cover the pan, or turn on the burner to medium low or medium low. Simmer until the meat is browned and no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: sole fillet,vanilla extract,cracker meal,vegetarian ham,red chili powder
title: Spicy Norwegian Fish Fingers
ingredients: 4 sole fillets | 1/4 cup cracker meal ( plain fine crackers ) | 12 ounces vegetarian ham, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 pinch red chili powder ( not table salt )
instructions: Put the crackers in a food processor/grinder, add ham and pulse till completely finely chopped. Transfer to a shallow dish and add puree and a pinch of chili powder. Spread mixtur in a single layer on the top. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Put a large cast iron frying pan on high to medium heat. Dredge fish in the cracker meal and fry till the bread is golden on eithier side. Serve with tomato sauce and your favourite dipping sauce.

title: Slow Cooker Irish Dried Beef
ingredients: 1 lb of fresh ground beef | 1 small onion, finely diced | 1 can diced tomatoes | 1 beef bouillon cube, such as mccormick irish whiskey, dissolved in | 1 1/2 cups irish cream
instructions: Place ground beef, onion, tomatoes and bouillon cube in crockpot. Cover, and cook on low for 6 - 7 hours, or on high for 3 - 4 hours.

title: Peach & Coriander Italian Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 3 tablespoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup quinoa, rinsed | 1 1/2 cups iceberg lettuce leaves, large, shredded | 3/4 cup peach, ripe pitted and sliced | 4 tablespoons pickled jalapeno peppers, sliced thin | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 2 italian style breadcrumbs | 1 rnd iceberg lettuce leaf, large, shredded
instructions: For cheese, combine bread crumbs and quinoa in a large bowl. Add lettuce and peach slices and toss. To make sandwich, place the horseradish in a small bowl and put in a skillet over medium heat and cook until bubbly. Using a slotted spoon, remove cheese from the horseradish. Spread cheese evenly on the breadcrumb layer. Top with the remaining breadcrumbs. Grill sandwiches until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: turkey breast,red pepper,milk,italian breadcrumb,almond flavoring,sun tomato oil,sumac,lettuce leaf
title: Turkish-Stuffed Turkey Breasts With Toasted Almond Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup milk | 2 teaspoons ground roasted red pepper | 1 teaspoon almond flavoring | 1/2 teaspoon turkish ground dried breadcrumbs or 1/2 teaspoon ground turkish regular breadcrumbs | 4 turkey breast | 1 tablespoon italian seasoned breadcrumbs or 1 tablespoon regular breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, minced | 4 lettuce leaves | 1 teaspoon sumac ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the milk with 1 teaspoon of ground roasted red pepper and almond flavoring. Stir over medium heat and cook, stirring, until thickened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the turkish dried breadcrumbs. Set aside. Sprinkle turkey with remaining 2 teaspoons ground roasted red pepper and almond flavoring. Pound turkey lightly to 1/2 inch thickness. Spread aboutone third of the toasted bread crumb mixture on each of 4 plates. Spoon about 1 tablespoon of turkey mixture onto bread crumbs, then roll turkey up tightly.

title: Swiss Cheese and Pine Nut Balls
ingredients: 1 cup gruyere cheese, shredded fresh | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 tablespoon green island or 1 tablespoon dill, chopped | 2 tablespoons dill, finely chopped
instructions: Using a food processor or blender, put the gruyere and pine nuts and combine. Add the chopped dill and pulse till the mixture becomes a fine dough. If not using dough immediately, add water 1 teaspoon at a time until it's the right consistency. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before forming balls. This makes a nice ball it keeps well if refrigerated for a couple of days. When using dill for garnish, mix well before storing in an airtight container with a lid.

title: Habanero Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 4 medium habanero peppers | 1 1/2 cups ketchup | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 2 1/2 cups bread flour | 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons chili oil ( not olive oil )
instructions: Heat a medium saucepan with approximately 2 tbs. Oil over medium heat. Peel and cut habanero into 6 or 8 pieces.

title: Potato-Chickpea Salad (Tunisia)
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs potatoes | 2 cans chickpeas, drained | 1 -2 cup pecans, toasted, chopped | 1/3 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender enough to pierce with fork, about 15 minutes for firm. Cool potatoes completely, cut into 2 inch cubes. In 8 - 10 x 8 serving dishes, layer potatoes, chickpeas and pecans. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,clam juice,meat,red bell pepper,corn flake crumb,seasoning salt
title: Baked Clamato
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs frozen chopped clams in juice, thawed | 1 cup corn flakes or 1 cup crushed corn flakes | 3 tablespoons finely chopped red bell pepper | 1/4 cup minced cooked meat | 4 -6 tablespoons clam juice | 6 tablespoons shredded fresh lettuce | 2 teaspoons lawry's seasoning salt
instructions: Place chopped clams into a greased shallow 3 qt casserole.

title: Rosemary & Scallion Jam
ingredients: 450 g caster sugar | 450 g scallions, finely chopped | 1 cup finely chopped rosemary | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/2 cup golden brown sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Place half the sugar and half the scallions in a large saucepan over over medium heat. Cook without stirring, constantly stirring until the sugar has melted and the scallions are soft. Add the rosemary and cook, stirring, for 1 minute, or until softened. Dissolve the remaining 1/2 cup sugar in 1/2 cup of boiling water. Bring to the boil and boil for 2 minutes. Pour over the scallions and scallions and stir well. Reduce the temperature to 70c/450f/gas mark 3. Leave until cold. Meanwhile, place the remaining sugar in a saucepan over easy heat and stir continuously until melted. Do not boil. Pour slowly, stirring continuously, into the hot sugar. Stir over moderate heat until the mixture is well combined. Poke the mixture, in 2 or 3 inch diameter, with a skewer or small, sharp knife so as to allow room for jam spreading out. Place jam back into the saucepan and put on a moderately low heat for 2 - 2 1/2 hours, stirring every 30 minutes. Transfer to a baking paper lined 20cm/2in/4in/20cm ovenproof dish. Mark a cross into the top of the jam, then pour over boiling water. Cover and bake for 45 minutes. Remove the pan from the oven and leave in the oven for a further 30 minutes, or until the jam has turned a rich golden colour and shrinks away from the sides of the pan. Remove the paper and turn out onto a wire rack. Remove the paper and paper. Cover with clean kitchen paper and store in a cool, dry place at room temperature. This jam should last up to 2 years.

title: Crazy Noodles With Avocado
ingredients: 5 slices avocados | 4 ounces fine egg noodles
instructions: Dice avocados and toss with noodles. Great cold or room temperature.

title: Spicy Stuffed Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 gallon plain nonfat yogurt | 3/4 cup finely grated unsweetened chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves, crushed | 3 tablespoons capers, drained | assorted fresh basil leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. In a medium size bowl, mix together the yogurt, chocolate and basil. Using your hands, rub the softened butter into the yogurt until the mixture is fully incorporated and the ingredients are mixed well. Stir in the capers and transfer the mixture to a large piping bag. Use a large knife to cut the chip into chunks. Place the chips onto the prepared cookie sheet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the cookies are light brown and crisp around the edges. Let the cookies cool for 15 minutes before removing to cool completely.

title: Queso a La Mexicana
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional ) | 4 ounces mexican-style cheese, shredded ( optional ) | pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray baking sheets with cooking spray. Place a small pat or small amount of fennel seed in a small bowl and sprinkle generously with pepper. Mix well and sprinkle evenly with cheese if desired. Add more fennel seeds if desired. Bake at 400 degrees for about 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.

title: Strawberry and Molasses Spiced Mussels
ingredients: 12 large frozen mussels, cleaned | 1/2 lb extra lean ground beef | 8 tablespoons strawberry jam | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 pinch nutmeg | salt and pepper
instructions: Place the mussels in a large saucepan with just enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil, cover and bring back to the boil. Lower the heat and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes or until they are just opened. Rinse the mussels with cold water.

title: Lily Kwong's Sweet Pearl Barley and Mint Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup palm sugar or 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1 cup pearl barley, rinsed well under cold water and drained | 1/2 cup currants
instructions: Put the sugar and vinegar in a lrg skillet and bring to a boil over med heat, stirring constantly. Boil until it starts to caramelise a little, watch constantly. Remove from the heat, add 1 1/2 cblsp vinegar, then stir in the barley & currants. Set aside to cool.

Random Ingredients: sugar,pepperoni,pistachio,pizza dough,strawberry,beef roast,no salt tomato paste,ginger powder
title: Italian Twisted Sicilian Beef Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless beef roast | 1 can no-added-salt tomato paste | 1 tablespoon ginger powder | 1 1/2 cups shredded sweet pepperoni | 1/2 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped | 1 box frozen strawberries, cleaned and quartered | 6 tablespoons sugar | pizza dough
instructions: Combine tomatoes paste, ginger powder, and pepperoni in a slow cooker. Cover, and cook on low 5 minutes. Add 1/2 cup pistachios, 1/2 cup strawberries, sugar, and 1 tablespoon gelatin. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours until a fork inserted in the thickest part of the roast comes out clean. Remove from slow cooker, allow to cool, remove meat and cut against grain into thin slices. Add 1 - 2 tablespoons gelatin to juices, and mix well. Add meat back into juices, or remove to slow cooker with juice. Note, this might be served with pasta or vegetables and parmesan cheese. Enjoy.

title: Napa Dave's Oriental Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice wine | 1/4 cup dried chile pepper ( such as ancho ) | 1 1/2 cups dried cranberry sauce, divided
instructions: Place rice wine and chiles in a small saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until chiles are tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, cover and chill in refrigerator for 15 to 30 minutes. Strain chiles and stir in half of the cranberry sauce until well blended.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,chutney,balsamic vinegar,garlic paste,red green cherry,pecorino romano cheese
title: Mini Philly Cheesy Cherry Chutney Doves
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped red green cherries | 1/3 cup coarsely grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup chutney ( major greys )
instructions: Drain cherries on paper towels. Mash roughly and set aside to dry slightly. Transfer drained cherries to a bowl and mash well with a fork. Stir in the garlic paste, balsamic vinegar, 1 tablespoon diced fresh cherries and 1/3 cup pecorino romano. Mix well. Stir in the pecorino romano. Mix in the chutney and any remaining pecorino. Spoon into small microwavable paper muffin cups. Cover with foil or plastic wrap. Microwave on high power level just until mixture boils, about 30 seconds. If desired steam longer if desired. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,yellow bell pepper,yukon gold potato,red chile pepper,leek,rigatoni pasta,honey,extra virgin olive oil
title: Stir-Fried Yukon Gold Sweet Potatoes and Peppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 red chile pepper, cut into rings | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, cut into strips | 2 leeks, white parts only, thinly sliced ( white and light green parts only ) | 2 pounds yukon gold potatoes, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup rice flour, or as needed | 1 pound rigatoni pasta
instructions: Whisk together the honey and extra virgin olive in a large bowl. Stir in the red chile. Add the yellow bell pepper and leeks and stir to coat. Place the potato slices in a large bowl, add the rice flour, and toss to coat. Place the yukon gold potatoes in a large skillet over high heat and pour in enough water to cover potatoes by at least 2 inches. Bring to a boil, and cook until cooked through but not mushy, about 3 to 5 minutes. Drain, and place the potatoes in a large serving bowl. Pour the sauce over the potatoes and mix until the sauce coats all the potatoes.

title: Pasta with Sweet Tomatoes and Chili
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 3 cups tomato juice | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon green cardamoms, crushed
instructions: In a large pot, bring 3 cups of water to a boil with a splash of salt. Add the farfalle and cook until al dente, 6 to 8 minutes. Drain pasta, return to pot. Add tomato juice, chili paste and cardamom and stir to combine. Bring to a boil, breaking up any clumps. Reduce heat to low and simmer, partially covered, for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,parmesan cheese,espresso powder,chicken breast,shrimp,corn tortilla chip,red pepper jelly
title: Mexican-Style Chicken with Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bone-in chicken breasts, trimmed and cut in 2 by 1/2-inch strips | 10 large shrimp | 2 tablespoons instant espresso powder | 1 beef bouillon cube | 3 cups hot cooked corn tortilla chips, divided | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese, divided | 1/4 cup red pepper jelly
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Center chicken strips and 1 shrimp piece on each of two 12 by 14 inch ovenproof serving dish, if using fresh shrimp use shells from a cocktail can or use small shrimp. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon espresso powder over chicken. Combine 1 bouillon cube and remaining 1 1/4 cup chips. Spread 2 cups hot pepper jelly over chicken. Top with 1/2 cup prepared cheese and 1/2 teaspoon espresso powder mixture. Repeat layers ending with cheese and espresso powder mixture. Sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon espresso powder. Cover tightly with foil. Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and shrimp are opaque and opaque, basting with remaining jelly after 5 minutes of baking. Serve over cooked hot tortillas with remaining 1/4 cup cheese on top.

title: Tijuana Poo (Tantional Microwave Recipe)
ingredients: 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/3 cup sweet paprika | 1/3 cup sweet marsala
instructions: Combine teriyaki sauce and paprika. Microwave on high power about 1 minute. Pour over popcorn or rice. Add more spiced teriyaki sauce if desired. Microwave 5 minutes more, depending on microwave thickness of microwave. Enjoy.

title: Baby Portabella Shrooms
ingredients: 4 baby portabella mushrooms | 24 ounces tequila
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and discard stems and caps, reserving them for another use or discard. Place mushrooms in a medium bowl with ice cubes. Shake off excess moisture. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Slice stems from mushrooms and set aside. In a small pitcher, combine the reserved mushrooms with the tequila. Add mushrooms and stir until well mixed. Place mushroom mixture in a medium glass casserole dish. Arrange mushroom caps in their shells over the top, cover with plastic wrap or plastic wrap, and refrigerate until very cold, about 30 minutes. To serve, garnish mushrooms with reserved stems and grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,vodka,chicken broth,garlic red chile paste
title: Easy Garlic Soup
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic, minced | 2 tablespoons vodka | 4 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1 tablespoon garlic and red chile paste, or to taste
instructions: Place garlic, vodka, and chicken broth into a blender. Puree until the garlic is finely chopped. Season to taste with garlic and red chile paste.

Random Ingredients: rice vermicelli,vanilla essence,chilies,swiss cheese,shell pasta,garlic paste,cinnamon
title: Baked Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 large soft fresh mushrooms | 8 slices swiss cheese | 2 cups rice vermicelli | 1/4 cup minced garlic paste | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 cup dried small shell pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Rinse mushrooms and dry lightly. Cut off the top of each mushroom being careful not to tear it. Wrap the inside of each mushroom in a slice of swiss cheese. Secure each mushroom with kitchen string or tooth pick. Place the mushrooms on a greased cookie sheet and bake for an hour. Take the sheet out of the oven, take the mushrooms out and top with the cheese. Add the spaghetti and dried shell pasta and mix together,. Continue to bake for 5 - 10 more minutes until the cheese has melted. Remove from oven and pour the sauce over the stuffed mushrooms.

title: Nut Surprise
ingredients: 1 ounce kahlua | 1 ounce wheat germ ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients in a small shaker. Shake shake. Store in covered container in refrigerator.

title: Cheese With Vermicelli and Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 package vermicelli | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon citric acid | 1 package velveeta cheese, cut into cubes
instructions: Cook vermicelli according to package directions. Drain, but leave a little olive oil in the pan. Add oyster and citric acid. Dice velveeta into 1 inch cubes and stir into the sauce. Once butter has melted and coated the vermicelli and sauce, turn heat to medium low or medium low and put the lid on while stirring until cheese has melted. You may take the lid off at this point and it will harden a little bit. Add 1/2 cup water to thin it out a bit if desired.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,cottage cheese,extra virgin olive oil,vegemite,egg substitute,natural yoghurt
title: Mushrooms Stuffed With Egg Beater Yogurt
ingredients: 200 g button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons natural yoghurt | 300 g small curd cottage cheese | 4 eggs | extra virgin olive oil | vegemite
instructions: If you have to buy button mushrooms, trim them as much as possible so they have more room for the yolks. Wash the mushrooms with a little water and cut off the tops. Make sure the mushrooms have been cleaned of any gritty dirt with the gills. Clean the mushrooms again if they have any. Warm up extra virgin olive oil and a little evoo in a frying pan on a low setting until the olive oil is hot enough, about 180°c. Chop up the mushroom pieces roughly and place in a bowl. Add the curd cottage cheese and mix it in with the yogurt, just enough to mix through this. Add the beaten eggs, one at a time, into the mushroom mix until all the egg is absorbed. Place each button mushroom on a sheet of aluminium foil. Mix through the rest of the ingredients with your fingers, or hand held mixer, until everything is well combined, then spoon onto each stuffed mushroom. Close the foil and set aside for 20 minutes. Once the 20 minutes have passed, preheat the grill and put all the parcels under until just cooked, but not browned, so they will not be soggy. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,chili sauce,grain mustard,cream cheese,macaroni,bacon dripping,arborio rice,fish
title: Lorilyn's Easy Microwave Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked macaroni | 1/4 cup bacon drippings | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 6 ounces cream cheese, cut into 1/2 inch pieces each | 2 teaspoons coarse grain mustard | 3 cups cooked arborio rice or 3 cups carnation rice | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon, dissolved in 1/2 cup boiling water
instructions: In a 2 1/2 quart microwavable casserole dish, melt the bacon drippings. Add the chili sauce, and heat for 1 minute until warm. Stir in the soup, cream cheese and rice. Stir until heated through. Add the dissolved bouillon, stir until the mixture is warm to the touch and thoroughly combined. Pour into the cooked macaroni and stir to coat. Transfer to a serving dish, and refrigerate until well chilled.

title: Cabbage and Corn with Cider Gravy (Aka Gluten Free)
ingredients: 4 cups finely shredded red cabbage ( about a large head ) | 1 cup dried currant | 1 cup fresh baby corn | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian parsley or 2 teaspoons dried parsley | crushed ice
instructions: Cook cabbage and currants in boiling water for five to ten minutes or until tender. Transfer to a serving dish and top with corn, mustard seeds, and parsley. Tasty on a green vegetable is always a must at the table.

title: Teriyaki Balls
ingredients: 250 g digestive biscuits | 125 g barley flour | 125 g light teriyaki sauce | barley flour | bamboo skewer ( optional )
instructions: Mix 1 gram barley flour and 5mm light teriyaki sauce in a bowl with 75g bread flour and knead well. Divide biscuit mix into 16 portions and shape into balls. Roll into balls. Refrigerate for 15 minutes. Heat oil in a bamboo skewre fry the balls till golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper. Serve with teriyaki sauce or ginger yogurt.

title: Easy Jalapeno Pepper Sour Cream Cheese Phyllo Packets
ingredients: 1 container sour cream ( or more as desired, i use low fat ) | 1 package phyllo dough, thawed | 1 -2 tablespoon all-purpose flour ( or half white sugar and half brown rice flour ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning ( i used paul massha's italian seasoning ) | 2 tablespoons pickled jalapeno peppers, finely chopped ( i like hot pepper!! )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Set phyllo sheets in a large bowl of hot water. Whisk sour cream and flour in a small bowl and set aside. Mix seasoning and chopped jalapenos in a small bowl. Place about 1 tablespoon of the sour cream mixture in the bottom of each phyllo sheet, leaving about 1/4 inch in between sides of sheets. Fold each phyllo sheet in thirds and place on baking sheets. Bake at 350f degrees about 15 to 20 minutes, until the phyllo is puffed up and crisp. Allow phyllo to cool and then transfer rolls to a serving plate. Enjoy.

title: Shrimp and Bow Ties
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, or as needed | 3 cups shrimp, peeled and deveined | 3 stalks celery leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons pickled ginger root, minced | 2 teaspoons dried shrimp, crushed | 2 large button mushrooms | 1 pinch cayenne sauce, or to taste ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried spinach, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the farfalle, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, and place a plate on the side to keep the pasta warm while you cook the shrimp. Combine the shrimp, celery leaves, ginger root, shrimp, and mushrooms in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Sprinkle with cayenne sauce, if desired, just prior to serving.

title: Beef and Bean Bake
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate syrup | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted and crushed | 14 ounces red beans, drained | 14 ounces frozen peas, thawed | 14 ounces sweet kernel corn | 14 ounces fruit, cut into 1/3s
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f fry ground beef and chocolate syrup stirring frequently until no longer pink, add beans. Stir through s&p.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate “Mushrooms' (Mustard Powder)
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 tablespoon black mustard seeds
instructions: Wear rubber gloves while handling the madras mushrooms. Heat oil in skillet on medium heat, when hot add mustard seeds and stir till they crackle a little bit. Pour the hot oil along with the madras mushrooms, it should look like a deep syrup. Lower heat to medium low. When all liquid has burned off the bottom of the skillet, turn heat back to medium for a few seconds. The mustard powder should be darker in color. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,anise seed,garam masala,greek yogurt,cumin seed,kalamata olive,broth,bourbon whiskey
title: Greek Yogurt With Aniseed Olives, Beer and Cherries
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil ( or ghee ) | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 cup low fat greek yogurt | 1/2 cup bourbon whiskey | 3/4 cup kalamata olive ( pitted ) | 1 - 1 1/4 cup chicken stock or 1 -1 1/4 cup low sodium broth | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f or 160°c. In a large shallow baking dish, combine grapeseed oil and season lightly with a pinch of salt. Sprinkle 1 tsps of the cumin seeds onto the oil and add the rest and the remaining spices. Stir to coat well with seasonings. Cut top layer off yogurt and reserve. Add vinegar to yogurt and stir to combine. Turn into a deep serving bowl. Chill to soften. Toss well, cover and refrigerate until served. Serve yogurt on the side. If desired, drizzle additional rum or coconut rum over top.

title: Quick & Easy Kaffir Lime Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons crisco | 1 kaffir lime leaf, crushed
instructions: Heat crisco in saucepan until warm and stir in lime leaves. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,bamboo shoot,pecan,white onion,pickling salt
title: Pecan Nests with Bamboo Shoots
ingredients: 2 cups pecan pieces | 4 cups coarse sea salt | 3/4 cup pickling salt | 1/2 cup coarse sea salt | 5 small white onions ( about 2 pounds total ) | 1/2 cup coarse sea salt | 2 cups diced pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line two 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pans with parchment paper. Spread pecan pieces flat on a baking sheet. Sprinkle 2 cups coarse sea salt over pecan pieces. Using a vegetable peeler, scrape 1/4 cup coarse salt into a bowl. Stir remaining coarse sea salt into salt and set aside. Peel and core white onions. Cut into rings 1 inch by 2 inches wide and then cut rings in half. Place pecan mixture into a large food processor or blender. Add onions, pecans, 2 cups fine sea salt and pecan pieces to food processor and process until coarsely chopped. Pour into a large bowl, cover and chill. Transfer mixture to a cutting board to cool completely. Cover and chill 24 hours, then chop coarsely. Arrange pecan mixture into prepared pans and store at room temperature for up to 3 days. Make pecan topping, combine pecan mixture and 1 cup coarse sea salt in a 10 inch skillet. Cook over moderate heat, stirring constantly until pecan mixture is dry, about 5 minutes. Add white onions and cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Transfer pecan mixture into a bowl and stir in 2 cups coarse sea salt. Spread pecan mixture over 2 large sheet pans, placing remaining 1 cup coarse sea salt on top of pecan mixture to avoid browning. Bake, covered, until pecan mixture is bubbling and tops of pecan shells and crackers are light golden, about 1 1/2 hours. Cool completely and store at room temperature. Keeps in refrigerator at least 12 hours.

Random Ingredients: cream,half,arborio rice,pork shoulder,angel flake coconut,grand marnier,herbes de provence,corn
title: Cocoa Cocoa Bianco
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh arborio rice | 1 cup sour cream | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon dried herbes de provence | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh herbes de provence | 2 cups shredded pork shoulder, or more to taste | 1 can sliced arborio rice | 2 cans coco lopez or other creamable oil for frying, divided | 1 cup frozen corn, thawed
instructions: Place rice into a large bowl. Pour sour cream over the rice and stir to combine. Spread half and half cream into the center of a square of aluminum foil.

title: Oriental Corn Chips
ingredients: 2 cups corn oil for frying | 1 cup cornstarch | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine corn oil, cornstarch and cold water and stir vigorously for a minute or two. Heat a deep 10 inch frying pan, or a deep fryer to 375 degrees f and drop the corn chips into the hot oil. Immediately turn over and drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with coarse salt and serve.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,beef roast,baby spinach,mustard powder,cake yeast,porcini mushroom
title: Savory Beef on the Run
ingredients: 1 cup cake yeast, lukewarm | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 lb baby spinach | 2 packages mixed mushrooms | 1/4 cup prepared mustard seeds | 1 1/2 lbs prepared lean beef roast ( i prefer chuck roast, but any beef will do )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 3 tablespoons hot water, then combine with remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Dredge meat with remaining flour. Heat a large dutch oven over medium high heat. Brown meat on all sides. Transfer to a warm platter. Pour off fat from pan. Reduce heat to medium, then add sauteed mushrooms. Cover and cook about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Pour mushrooms over meat in the dutch oven. Cover and braise about 45 minutes or until tender. Let stand before slicing.

title: Taco Pasta Sauce (Soup)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 5 drops taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 can soup, undiluted
instructions: Pour picante sauce and taco seasoning mix into small sauce pan and heat over low heat until warmed. While hot stir soup in to heat. Pour over warm pasta and enjoy.

title: Fried Green Peppers
ingredients: 1 large green pepper | 8 fresh sage leaves | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup sofrito sauce | 2 cups milk ( not skim )
instructions: Slice pepper 1/3 to 1/2 thick and cut slices 1/3 thick and set aside. Add enough sofrito in 2 cups milk to make one cup. Heat large skillet until hot, place pepper on it then add remaining sauce and sprinkle tops with panko. Let reduce for 2 minutes. Put meat and sofrito in paper bag then add rest of milk. Poke holes through bag with fork. Fry quickly, place in serving dish and pour remaining sauce over top.

Random Ingredients: green chili,almond paste,asparagus spear,soy sauce,green bean,honey,red cabbage
title: Chinese-Style Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1/2 green beans, washed, trimmed, and cut in 2 -3 inch lengths ( about 14 cups ) | 1 tablespoon almond paste or 1 tablespoon plum paste | 1 stalk asparagus spear, sliced on the diagonal into 1/2 -3/4-inch lengths, about 2 cups | 1 small red cabbage, quartered, cored and cut into 2 or 3 inch pieces | 1 chopped green chili | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2 teaspoons honey
instructions: Boil water in large, deep pot to boiling. Add green beans and cook until tender crisp, about 3 to 8 minutes. Drain off the water and transfer beans into a large bowl. Toss the beans with the almond paste until coated. Place the asparagus spears, cabbage, and chili in the bowl with the green beans and almond paste and mix thoroughly. Whisk together the soy sauce and honey in a small bowl. Pour over the salad and toss well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,brown sugar,carrot,french bread,vinegar,cannellini bean,saffron,pepperoncini pepper
title: Easy Chorizo & Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans or ( 16 ounce ) can other white beans | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon saffron or 1 -2 tablespoon turmeric | 1 loaf french bread | 1 jar marinated roasted pickled carrots or ( 16 ounce ) jar julienne carrots | 1 jar saffron-infused red pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Drain cans of canellini beans. Combine beans, remaining ingredients in a food processor, pulsing until well mixed. Spread on bread and decorate with pickled carrots.

title: Grilled Corn and Ham Salad
ingredients: salt and pepper | onion powder | 1 lemon, juice of | 3 ears corn kernels, cooked | 1 cup corn kernel, boiled | 1 -2 slice of cooked hamburger ( optional ) | salad greens, as desired
instructions: Prepare corn and ham. Mix together in a bowl. Heat a grill pan with a little olive oil. Dip hamburgers in it, or your preference of meat. Grill for about 5 to 10 min or until done. Put salad onto salad.

title: The Best Pinto Beans
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can pineapple juice
instructions: Combine pinto beans and pineapple juice in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until beans are softened and cooked through, about 30 minutes. Chill beans in refrigerator 1 hour. To serve, place a dollop of plain yogurt onto each pinto bean. Sprinkle with red onion slices.

title: Brazilian Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Stir in cream and simmer until caramelized, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,orange juice lime,za'atar spice mix,parmigiano reggiano cheese,brown onion,metal ring
title: Shish Taquitos
ingredients: 1 box za'atar spice mix | 1 brown onion, diced | 8 wooden rings, crushed | 2 cups shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 6 ounces ) | 1 can salsa | 1/2 cup orange juice with lime juice ( or substitute with 1/2 cup lime juice and 1 can lime juice )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°. Spray 15 x10 baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Stir za'atar, brown onion, and crushed wooden ring together in a large bowl to blend. Stir together cheese, salsa, and orange juice in another large bowl. Place about 1 tablespoon of cheese mixture into a patted patty. Gently press mixture into the cheese to form 12 patty, about 2 inches larger than the baking sheet. Arrange on the baking sheet. Top each tortilla with about 1/2 cup salsa mixture, spreading evenly.
