Arrange patties on top of the salsa mixture and top with remaining salsa mixture. Bake until patties are hot and lightly browned, 15 to 18 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese.. Cool 5 minutes on baking sheet. Cut each taquitos crosswise into six wedges. Serve warm or at room temperature. Store airtight in refrigerator, up to 3 days.

title: Creamed Rosemary
ingredients: 3 cups beef broth or 3 cups chicken broth | 32 ounces whipping cream | rosemary leaves
instructions: Boil broth and cream.

Random Ingredients: bacon dripping,pinto bean,pecorino romano cheese,parsnip,hard egg,flat leaf parsley,chili
title: Pasta with Parsnips & Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dry pinto bean | 1 parsnip ( small ) | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1 teaspoon chili | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup dry grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Cook the beans in a large pan of boiling salted water until tender, about 1 hour. Remove from heat and drain. While beans are cooking, remove the parsnip from the skin and cut into 1/4 inch slices and set aside. Peel and chop the eggs into short ribbons. Melt some bacon drippings in a skillet over medium heat, then stir in the eggs, parsley and chili. Cook until set and translucent. In a large pot, combine the beans with some of the bean cooking water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until it thickens slightly. Stir in the parsley, pecorino and season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Remove from heat, stir in the parsnips and eggs. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: carrot,salt black pepper,olive oil cooking spray,vanilla essence,nutmeg,orzo pasta,kiwi,hot paprika
title: Vanilla Orzotto
ingredients: 200 g orzo pasta or 200 g other short grain rice | 300 ml hot paprika ( hungarian pepper ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 small carrot ( grated ) | 2 kiwi ( very thinly sliced lengthways ) | grated nutmeg, to sprinkle | 1 pinch of grated salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 dash vanilla essence
instructions: Rinse the orzo under cold water till it is no longer a little wet take the pasta/rice in a pan and add a little olive oil. Stir in the paprika and cook on gentle to keep from sticking. It should only take about 45 seconds to a minute, mix frequently. Add the carrot, kiwis, nutmeg, salt and pepper. Continue to cook for 8 minutes more. Remove from heat. When all the liquid has boiled off add the rice and stir till coated with the mixture. Cover and allow to sit for 20 minutes. Uncover and add vanilla essence. Stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: asadero cheese,penne pasta,natural peanut butter,italian salad dressing,radish,peanut butter
title: Nummy S'mores Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta, cooked al dente | 1/4 cup natural-style peanut butter | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing | 8 ounces asadero cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup peanuts, chopped very fine | 4 slices radishes, shredded ( optional )
instructions: Put pasta in a large bowl. While waiting for the pasta to be cooked, place a small pan of water on the stove and warm the peanut butter in it, stirring to mix well. Add italian dressing and keep warm stirring. Add asadero cheese and peanuts and mix thoroughly. Add pasta and cheese mixture and toss well. Garnish as your favorite italian vegetables.

title: Choco's Pinto Beans and Shredded Cheese Mashed
ingredients: 1 cup dried pinto beans | 1/2 cup shredded carrots | 1/2 cup finely chopped green chiles, such as hot pepper | 1/2 cup water ( more as needed ) | 1/4 cup vinegar or 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 ounce crumbled cheemo perogies | 2 tablespoons minced fresh chives or 2 teaspoons dried chives
instructions: Combine the pinto beans, carrot, green chilies and water in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes or until the beans are very tender, stirring occasionally. Drain and mash the beans with a potato masher or a fork. Add the chives and vinegar, mix well, and let cool to room temperature. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle the cheese over the top. Serve immediately. Variation, serve with warm tortillas or crudites.

title: Irish Stew With Beer
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef | 1 cup dark beer | 1 cup tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: Place beef in casserole. Add other ingredients and stir to combine. Bake at 350°f for about 1 hour or until meat is tender. Serve over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Irish Pork Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 5 lbs pork, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1 lb raisins | 6 ounces irish whiskey | 3/4 cup beer | 2 tablespoons garam masala or 2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 packages frozen whipped topping, thawed | dried apricots, for garnish
instructions: In a small skillet, combine caraway seeds with 3/4 cup cold water. Cook over low heat, stirring frequently, until seeds become aromatic, about 10 minutes, and cool. Rinse and pat dry meat. In 4 - 5 qt slow cooker, layer all ingredients and pork, repeat layers. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours or high 3 - 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,brown bread,cocoa powder,taco seasoning mix,tangerine,chilies,anchovy paste
title: Tangerine Tacos
ingredients: 3 tangerines | 3 large firm sweet red peppers | 6 -8 medium sweet dried chilies | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/2 cup packed brown sugar or 1/2 cup splenda brown sugar blend | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Peel the tangerines and cut the ends off the red peppers. Cut the caps into 1/2 to 3/4 inch wide strips. Cut the red peppers into 1/2 inch wide strips. In a bowl toss the bell peppers with the anchovies, sugar, hot sauce or taco seasoning and cocoa powder then transfer to a parchment lined 15x10x2 inch baking pan. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour to up to 8 hours. Remove the bell peppers from the marinade and discard the remaining marinade. Grill over direct medium heat for 8 to 12 minutes or until the peppers turn brown, turning twice. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red pepper sauce,sesame seed,granny smith apple,spaghetti squash,almond,orange blossom water,celery,ear corn cob
title: Corn Ceasar
ingredients: 18 ears corn on the cob, husked | 1 package spaghetti squash | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water | 1 teaspoon dried sweet red pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1/2 cup toasted slivered almonds | 1/4 cup chopped celery | 1/2 cup finely grated granny smith apples ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place the corn on a rimmed baking sheet. Roast in preheated oven for 5 to 7 minutes or until tender. Remove from oven. Split the kernels from the cob with a sharp knife. Cut each cob in half crosswise and scrape out and discard the seeds and strings. Place the kernels, squash, orange blossom water, sweet red pepper sauce, sesame seeds, almonds, celery and apples in a deep roasting pan. Sprinkle with the optional apple. Sprinkle with additional sesame seeds if desired. Bake in preheated oven until heated through, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,sherry wine,thyme sprig,coriander leaf,kaffir lime leaf,burdock root,pork chop
title: Pork Chops With Lime and Raisins
ingredients: 4 thick bone-in pork chops, 1 1/2 cm thick, about 1.5 lbs | 1 ounce fresh coriander leaves | 4 -6 fresh small kaffir lime leaves | 4 ounces fresh bread, stale | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 2 fresh lime leaves | 3 ounces burdock root, cleaned and cut lengthwise into 3 slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f in a large shallow roasting pan on the hob, toast the coriander, lime leaves and thyme sprigs for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Remove from the heat and allow to cool. Cut the bread into thin slices. Dip each pork chop into the sherry and arrange on a chopping board or other flat ovenproof dish. Top each chop with some of the lime and coriander soaking. Wrap each chop diagonally in 2 slices of bread and tie with string and place into the heated oven. Cook 30 minutes to 1 hour, until they are cooked through. Alternatively, you can cook in the oven for 4 - 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,rice,sea salt black pepper,sausage,chicken broth
title: Sausage Cheese Rice
ingredients: 3 cups uncle ben's ready rice ( i prefer white ) | 1 teaspoon smoked sage | 1/2 cup cooked ground sausage, leftovers from sausage can be used, too ( or a bit of bacon and half a small can of ham ) | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt and black pepper, to taste | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth
instructions: Boil and drain the rice, just until there are no visible visible moisture, but do not add any other spices. Set aside. Mix together with meat, bread crumbs and salt and pepper. Place the broth in a sauce pan and bring to a slow boil. Pour the rice into a serving bowl. Using a spoon or slotted spoon, spoon some of the broth into individual serving bowls until each portion is 3/4 of a cup. Or, if preferred, you can mix the leftover broth with 1/4 c. Of dry bread crumbs and spread it on the top before serving.

title: Chinese Oysters and Chilli
ingredients: 1 dozen oyster | 1 tablespoon soybean paste ( or other flavour enhancer ) | 1 tablespoon basil chiffonade
instructions: Place the oysters in a large pan with just enough water to cover them. Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Discard the shells, and cool down slightly in the fridge, then discard. Pull out the oysters, and roughly chop them up. Place them in a large serving dish, pour over the remaining sauce and scatter over the basil. Serve.

title: Pesto-Canned Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/2 cup rolled oats | 1 plum tomato, sliced | pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat the grill. Brush the chops on both sides with the oil. Grill chops over high heat for 2 minutes on each side. Remove from the grill and cover with foil for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green,ginger root,maple extract,egg yolk,apricot preserve,crescent dinner
title: Ginger-Apricot Squares
ingredients: 1 package crescent dinner rolls | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons chopped apricots preserves | 1/2 cup chopped candied scallions, divided | 2 teaspoons ground ginger root | 2 tablespoons maple flavored preserves
instructions: Unroll each crescent roll dough into a long strip. Separate each piece into eight triangles. Mix egg yolk, 2 tablespoons apricot preserves, scallions, ginger root, and maple preserves together in a bowl. Fold dough into apricot/ginger mixture. Arrange triangles in a single layer on a baking tray. Brush triangles with egg yolk mixture, and sprinkle with remaining apricot/ginger mixture. Bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven until golden, about 20 minutes.

title: Polish Dill Soda
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon-lime flavored soda ( such as sprite ) | 8 fresh dill sprigs
instructions: Combine lemon lime soda and dill sprigs in a glass.

title: Cauliflower Rice Cake (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 kg cauliflower, trimmed | 100 g chocolate | 250 g short-grain rice | 1 liter cake flour | 1 can canned bamboo shoots, drained | 1 liter tahini | 2 tablespoons vanilla | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Place cauliflower, chocolate, rice, bamboo shoots and tahini in a large bowl and mix to mix well. Pour into a greased and lined 9cm × 12cm cake tin. Bake in a 180 degree celsius oven for 30 minutes or until the cauliflower is tender and the rice cake is firm. Remove from the oven and allow to cool. Meanwhile, heat the remaining sauce, then bring to the boil without allowing it to boil. In a separate bowl, sieve the flour into a clean bowl. Add the sugar and mix it through until a coarse paste forms about 3 minutes or so. Remove from heat. Pour the warm sauce into the cooked cauliflower and mix through. The mixture should form a paste. Pour into a clean, greased and lined 9cm × 12cm cake tin. Bake in a 180 degree celsius oven for 30 minutes or until top is golden. Turn out of heat and cool for 5 - 10 minutes. Turn onto a plate and leave to cool completely. Remove plastic wrap and cut into thin slices.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,lamb shank,french breadcrumb,leek,rye bread,seasoning salt,durkee onion
title: Rye's Hot Dogs
ingredients: 2 lamb shanks | 2 lamb shanks | 3 leeks | seasoning salt | 4 slices rye bread | 4 slices french bread | butter or margarine
instructions: Cut away the rind from each lamb, the top just below the rib bone, and the outside from the shanks. Wash well, trim the ends of the shanks and shred the lamb shanks into large strips. Slice the leeks. If using the rye bread, cut the slices into thick rounds about 1cm thick. If using the french bread, dip one slice through each slice of bread. The rye bread should be round enough to cover the lamb without bulting it. If the bread is not round enough, cut it into four squares to cover the lamb. Add about 1 tablespoon of butter, about a tablespoon at a time, to each piece of bread and brown them in a frying pan. Add a little seasoning salt to each piece of bread. Lay out butter or margarine and butter on a clean dish towel. Place the four lamb shanks on the bread, the pieces of bread should be around 1/4 thick. Top with slices of the rye and then spread on the swiss/swiss swiss and swiss swiss cheese. Add a layer of the chopped leeks. Repeat this process with 4 more shanks. The amount of butter and butter to fry shanks depends on the size of the shanks used to fry, which are about 1/4 wide. You can also add a couple drops of browned onion or dill or parsley for flavor.

title: Steamed Scallops With Peanuts
ingredients: 12 scallops | 1 cup dry-roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons mustard | hot pepper sauce | 1 orange, thinly sliced
instructions: Steam scallops over high heat uncovered for about 5 minutes and set aside. Meanwhile, combine peanuts with 1/4 cup mustard and hot pepper sauce in shallow pan. Heat over moderate heat until hot. Lightly toast peanuts by placing on towel and pressing with flat of small knife just until light brown. Spread peanuts on paper towels and spread with remaining dressing. Cut scallops into three. Scatter each with 2 tablespoons peanuts and serve.

title: Italian Almond Macaroon
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon almond extract or 3/4 teaspoon almond extract powder | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Dissolve the almond and italian seasoning in water and mix with a fork. Store in a cool, dry place. Keeps for up to 2 weeks.

title: Beef, Spinach & Cashew Meat Loaf
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 lb ground sirloin round | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 3 tablespoons minced onions | 1 can cashews, coarsely chopped | 1 can baby spinach, in brine, drained | 1 can bamboo shoots, halved | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Preheat oven to spray a 9x9 inch pan with cooking spray. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add beef.

Random Ingredients: ginger,espresso powder,icing sugar,basil leaf,baking soda,white wine vinegar,salsa,bay leaf
title: Mexican Gingerbread Balls With Salsa & Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 3 cups sweet unsalted almonds or 3 cups chopped toasted almonds | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground ginger, fresh | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1/4 cup sifted icing sugar | 2 -4 bay leaves ( more or less, to taste ) | 24 fresh basil leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° fahrenheit. Line baking sheets with parchment or siliconated, or with parchment paper. In bowl of a food processor, process almonds and baking soda until ground fine. Add vinegar and continue to process until almonds are ground fine and mixture forms a ball. Add in ginger, coffee, sifted icing sugar, bay leaves and 1/2 cup water until dough forms. If dough seems dry add more water, but dough should not be sticky. Form into 2 logs and wrap in saran wrap or wax paper. Freeze overnight. To serve, remove log and slice into 1 1/2 inch thick rounds. Arrange on serving plate and top with salsa. Garnish with a bit of sliced basil.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,rigatoni pasta,radish,chicken bouillon cube,cardamom powder,barley,heavy whipping cream
title: Rigatoni With Shredded Chicken and Browned Barley
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta | 2 3/4 - 3 3/4 cups chicken broth or 2 3/4-3 cups water | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom powder ( to taste ) | 1 medium radish, cleaned and sliced thinly ( or 1/4-1/3 cup sliced ) | 1 tablespoon barley ( or 1/2 cup white rice ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Brown the chicken meat in a large skillet with a dash of olive oil, adding boullion, cardamom and barley to the cooked meat mixture. Sautee the mixture over high heat until it begins to darken. Add cream and cook for a minute. Pour cooked pasta mixture into a large bowl with some of the pan liquid and add the red pepper. Mix thoroughly. Enjoy i sometimes add chopped cilantro and basil or lemon.

title: Tasty Prawns
ingredients: 4 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: Sift the flour and curry powder into a bowl. Add the prawns and knead well to coat well. Heat a large frying pan. Spray with cooking spray and add half the prawns, half at a time, on top of the flour. Cook each side for approximately 15 seconds each, until they turn light brown. Serve with your favourite curry.

title: Trappers on the Run
ingredients: 2 ounces treacle | 1 ounce triple sec | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Mix the treacle with the vanilla and stir well until well blended. Pour the mixture into clean pint canning jars and cover with rings with greaseproof paper. Store in the fridge at least 4 weeks before using.

Random Ingredients: cheese tortellini,pickle relish,water chestnut,baby shrimp,white vinegar,garlic powder,dark brown sugar
title: Tortellini Salad with Shrimp and Shrimp
ingredients: 16 ounces cheese tortellini | 2 cups water chestnuts ( drained ) | 1/3 cup low-fat pickle relish | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garlic powder | baby shrimp
instructions: Cook tortellini until al dente.

Random Ingredients: pear,apple,rigatoni pasta,chili seasoning mix,scotch bonnet pepper
title: Hot Scotch Chiles and Apple Rigatoni
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 ounce chili seasoning mix | 1/8 cup diced carrot | 1/8 cup minced apple | 1/8 cup minced scotch bonnet pepper
instructions: Boil water for pasta. While water is coming to boil boil add chili seasoning. Dice apple and scotch bonnet pepper. Drain pasta and put back into the pot. Pour hot chili over pasta and toss all together until everything is coated well. Enjoy.

title: Noodle Salad With Olives
ingredients: 1/3 cup soymilk | 1/3 cup brown rice noodles | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1/4 teaspoon ground black olives | crushed red pepper to taste
instructions: Mix soy milk, and rice noodles in a bowl, and refrigerate overnight to soften slightly. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Blend the soymilk mixture with the raisins, olives and red pepper.

title: Lobster Butter
ingredients: 1 pound fresh lobster, cleaned and chopped | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 6 squares confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Combine lobster, mustard powder, and mace in a bowl.

title: Easy Jasmine Rice Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups cooked jasmine rice | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 2 tablespoons shortening
instructions: In a large baking dish, mix together rice, vanilla and shortening. Pour melted shortening over rice mixture. Bake at 300 degrees f for 1 hour or until bubbly and golden.

Random Ingredients: plantain,onion soup mix,molasses,date,five spice powder,cilantro leaf,ancho chile powder
title: Baked Plantains
ingredients: 4 ripe plantains | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 medium onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup date, soaked in water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Peel and slice bananas from stem to ends. Place banana slices on baking sheet.

title: Cabbage Vanilla Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shredded cabbage | 1 gallon french vanilla ice cream
instructions: Stir 1 cup shredded cabbage into one gallon plastic bag. Squeeze out excess air. Set aside remaining liquid. Place bag in refrigerator until cold. About an hour. When ready to serve, microwave ice cream according to size of bag and pour on a few tablespoons of prepared ice cream.

title: Dried Banana on the Barbie
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil and 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 4 -8 medium dried mashed banana
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a gallon sized zipper type plastic bag. Add dried mashed banana pieces, squish around a little to coat the bananas. Shake out excess air. Wrap in aluminum foil and refrigerate for 2 to 3 days or longer if you can. Use as a sandwich spread with pita chips, on your favorite crackers, or on sandwiches, etc.

title: Mexican Green Sauce
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes | nutmeg
instructions: Pour can of rotel tomatoes into a food processor and pour in the can of rotel tomatoes. Add the nutmeg. Strain and reserve 1/4c of liquid which may later be added to the liquid. Serve with shredded cheddar or monterey jack cheese. Note, the sauce also makes a wonderful ranch dip for meat balls or crumbly hamburger buns.

title: BBQ & Sliced Tofu with Charred Broth - 5 Points
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley, soaked in water for at least 1 hour | 1 box refrigerated white bread | 1 package frifita seasoning mix | 2 cans diced dates | 1/3 cup vinegar, about 1/2 cup | 2 2 cups hot cooked linguine or 2 cups cooked macaroni | 1/3 cup finely chopped fresh pistachio or 1/3 cup pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Prepare al dente per package directions. Drain, and set aside. Cut day old bread in half lengthwise. Sliced in half. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with bread pieces. Pour drained barley over bread. Bake, uncovered at 325°f for about 30 minutes, or until crusty. Meanwhile prepare Charred Broth. In a saucepan, combine dates and vinegar. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: sandwich bun,oyster sauce,maraschino cherry,dill sprig,wheat pastry flour,grain white rice,spring onion
title: Sticky Rice Pudding
ingredients: 250 g whole wheat pastry flour | 100 g chopped spring onions ( white part only ) | dill sprigs ( for garnish ) | 200 g cooked long-grain white rice ( cold ) | 1 cup cooked maraschino cherry ( drained well ) | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 4 thick sandwich buns, toasted
instructions: Mix the flour and spring onion in a bowl. Add the rice, cherries, 2 tablespoons oyster sauce and seasoning to the flour and stir until the mixture is combined. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 8 - 10 minutes, or until smooth and elastic. Shape the dough into a ball, place on a baking tray lined with foil and chill for 20 minutes. Preheat your oven to 180°c. Dust a board with a little flour and roll the dough out thinly. Place onto a lightly floured board and cut into 2 2cm rounds. Place half a handful of the rice in the centre of each round and spread evenly with the rice and filling. Fold the sides and continue overlapping and pinching together until the pastry parcel is tightly rolled. Place on a lightly greased tray, cover and bake for 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and let it stand for 5 minutes. Serve the pudding warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,palm sugar,shrimp,pork rib,puff pastry,sea salt black pepper
title: Grilled Pork Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 4 portuguese pork ribs, rinsed | sea salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 bananas pepper, roughly chopped | 3 cups palm sugar | 1 pound fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat. Lay the ribs out on a work surface. Season with salt and black pepper, and lightly brown the ribs on both sides. Remove from the grill, brush off and set aside. Turn the heat under the grill down to medium to low. Cover the skillet, and cook until the ribs are dark and richly brown on all sides, about 30 minutes. Remove the ribs from the skillet, set aside. Increase heat under the grill, and allow them to cook for an additional 15 minutes, turning when necessary. Allow them to rest for 10 minutes before cutting into smaller pieces. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the bananas with palm sugar, and set aside. Remove the thick stems from the shrimp, and chop them into large pieces. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Lay the puff pastry sheets out onto the baking sheet, and cut into four triangles. Lay half of the shrimp pieces along the length of each triangle. Put about 1/4 cup of the bananas and a portion of raw shrimp on the center near the center of each shrimp triangle. Spread the mixture evenly over the shrimp, then fold the triangle to enclose the filling, and season with sea salt and black pepper. Wrap the pastry around the filling, and pinch the edges well to seal into a seal. Brush the crust with water. Cook in the preheated oven until the pastry is browned and crispy on top, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Easy Fettuccine Filled With Feta and Green Chilies (Pasta Fadito)
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans ( reserve the liquid ) | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 1 cup feta cheese with herbs ( i use greek thyme and basil flavored feta cheese with basil and it works great ) | 1/4 cup dry cannellini beans or 1/4 cup other small white beans | 1/4 cup vodka | fresh ground pepper | 8 ounces fettuccine ( or other small shaped pasta )
instructions: Combine the beans, cheese and liquid in blender. Blend until smooth. Add pepper and vodka and mix. Cook fettuccine according to package directions. Drain fettuccine and reserve the liquid. Add the fettuccine to the sauce in the blender or use the back of a spoon to mix it up a bit. Place back on the stove and cook until pasta is done. Drain.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,peach,scotch bonnet pepper,coconut extract,cumin,italian salad dressing,flour tortilla,rice vinegar
title: Peach & Pepper Wrap
ingredients: 1 peach, large | 1 scotch bonnet pepper or 1 habanero pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh thyme sprig, chopped | 6 8-inch flour tortillas or 8-inch corn tortillas, cut into 6 even pieces | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/2 teaspoon cumin
instructions: In a small bowl, mash peaches to a paste using a mortar and pestle, or a fork. Combine with thyme and chill 2 hours. Spoon peach mixture onto 6 tortillas. Roll up tortillas and place on a large, flat baking dish. Pour salad dressing over tortillas and toss to combine. Arrange rolls in a single layer on top of dressing. Sprinkle with coconut and cumin and toss to coat salad evenly.

title: Poppyseed and Pear Popovers
ingredients: 1 jar marshmallows | 1 cup crushed peas | 15 large strawberries or 15 large pears | 3 ounces semi-sweet mini peaches, chopped or 3 ounces pears, chopped | 1 ounce sunflower seed meal or 1 ounce corn syrup | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | pam cooking spray
instructions: Mix the marshmallows, crushed pecans and sunflower seed meal/corn syrup together to make the topping. Stir in chopped apple and nuts. Set aside. Spray pam in mini muffin trays with pam. Bake at 200c for 10 minutes. Cool and store in an airtight container at room temperature. This will keep for 6 to 7 days.

title: Bok Choy
ingredients: 4 bunches bok choy | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place bok choy in a steamer over boiling water, and cover. Cook until just tender, about 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer the bok choy to a bowl, and mash with a fork. Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. When it shimmers, fold in mashed bok choy. Sprinkle with lime juice, and continue cooking 15 minutes, turning occasionally.

title: Baby Eggplants (Original Teriyaki Style)
ingredients: 1/2 honey coated baby eggplants ( or other egg sized ) | 1/4 teaspoon instant coffee ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 4 -6 ice cubes
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or blender, grind/crush/smooth the baby eggplants to your preferred consistency. Stir in the coffee/worcestershire sauce and a few ice cubes. Transfer into a container with a tight fitting lid. Serve with your favorite teriyaki sauce, teriyaki rice, or hoagies.

Random Ingredients: pasta,farfalle pasta,chili flake,caper juice,yellow pepper,prosciutto,confectioner ' sugar,lemon juice zest
title: Pasta With Prosciutto, Capers, and Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 3 ounces prosciutto, thinly sliced ( i used turkey bacon ) | 1/2 small yellow pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons capers in juice | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 pinch chili flakes | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1 cup dry pasta, your choice
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water according to package directions and drain. Meanwhile, place prosciutto in a bowl drizzle with oil and toss to coat. Add peppers and toss to coat. Add capers, lemon zest and juice, chili flakes, and confectioner's sugar, toss. Serve with pasta.

title: Easy Chutney Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 green pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup sweet chutney, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons low fat lettuce, finely shredded
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve over salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,self raising flour,honey,cremini mushroom,garam masala powder
title: Honey Crepes
ingredients: 300 g cremini mushrooms, chopped | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 -2 teaspoon honey | 1 cup self-raising flour | 2 -3 cups quick oatmeal
instructions: Mix all ingredients well before adding the oatmeal, and then spoon mixture into a non stick pan. Cook on med low heat, about 20 minutes.

title: Leg of Lamb at Home
ingredients: 1 bag part-skim ricotta cheese | 12 -16 ounces leg of lamb, bone in ( or shoulder if you prefer )
instructions: The night before making the leg of lamb it should come preheated to 450f degrees. Slice the lamb into bite sized pieces, about 3/4 thick, then sprinkle each piece with salt, and place in a roasting pan lined with parchment or aluminum foil. If you prefer a more tender version of the leg, mix 3 tablespoons of cornstarch with 4 ounces of cold water and then add these to the pan. Cover and bake about 45 minute per pound at 450f degrees, or until internal temperature reaches 160f degrees. While oven is heating, mix 4 ounces ricotta with about 1/4 cup water. Drain fat from roasting pan and set aside.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,brown basmati rice,graham cracker crumb
title: Easy Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown basmati rice | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 7 cups graham cracker crumbs, or as needed
instructions: Place rice in a large bowl, and cover with water.

title: Cabbage Soup With Miso
ingredients: 1/4 lb cabbage, washed and shredded | 1/4 lb fresh ginger, peeled, washed, peeled, and chopped | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 6 tablespoons miso ( yellow or green ) | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon crushed dried galangal or 1 teaspoon dried turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: In a saucepan, cover the cabbage with water and cook it until tender. Drain and set aside. Heat the sesame oil in a pan and add the ginger and chillies. Let them sizzle lightly, then add the cabbage mixture. Mix the miso and water. Pour into the pan and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.. Serve hot with miso powder.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,milk,boursin cheese,white bread,tamarind pulp,za'atar spice mix,semolina,halibut fillet
title: Bourin Halibut
ingredients: 1 whole halibut fillets, with skin, bones attached | 1/2 cup milk | 2 slices firm white bread, crusts removed | 3 tablespoons boursin cheese | 2 teaspoons tamarind pulp | 3/4 cup semolina | 3/4 teaspoon za'atar spice mix | 6 whole chipotle chiles, stems removed
instructions: Place bread in the center of a double thickness of heavy duty aluminum foil. Spread the bread onto the bread, then top with the fillet, skin side down. Scoop out the bread from the center of the foil. Spoon milk and cheese onto the halibut, then wrap the meat around the cheese. Wrap the goat pit with the open edges of the foil, secure the edges lightly with a toothpick if desired, and set aside. Combine tamarind pulp and semolina in a blender until well blended, about 30 seconds. Add za'atar and chipotle chiles, blending until the mixture is smooth. Brush each fish fillet with a damp cloth, and place in the center of the prepared baking sheet. Cover with clean, dampened paper towels, and refrigerate overnight, turning the fillet over once to coat with the remaining marinade. Preheat grill for high heat. Cook halibut fillet on grill until fish flakes easily with a fork and is no longer translucent, about 2 minutes per side for rare.

title: Yukon Gold Potatoes
ingredients: 8 medium yukon gold potatoes | 2 cups beef gravy | 3 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Place the potato on a greased baking sheet. Combine the beef gravy and grand marnier in a saucepan. Heat to boiling. Pour over the potatoes and bake at 400 for 20 - 25 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,bean sprout,oregano,mung bean sprout,hot pepper,iceberg lettuce,pistachio,romaine lettuce heart
title: Vegetable Mix
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1 head romaine lettuce hearts, chopped | 1 head cauliflower, chopped | 1 can bean sprouts, drained and rinsed | 2 cups chopped cooked prawns | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh oregano | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios | 4 cups crushed iceberg lettuce hearts, for garnish ( optional ) | 2 fresh hot peppers or 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Place the lettuce, romaine hearts, cauliflower, bean sprouts, prawns, oregano, pistachios, or crushed iceberg lettuce hearts, if using, into a large bowl or appropriate glass trays. Toss with enough dressing to coat. Cover, and refrigerate overnight, so flavors can develop. When ready to serve, remove from refrigerator and top with additional salad greens.

title: Bread Salad With Passionfruit Syrup Dressing
ingredients: 6 slices sourdough bread, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 6 slices small aged cheese | 2 1/2 cups honeydews melon, cut into 1 in pieces | 1 cup passion fruit juice
instructions: Put the bread on a flat baking tray and spread the cheese on each piece, leaving a 1/2 inch margin border around the edge. Put the honeydews on top of the cheese. Cut the passionfruit into 2 segments and put into a jug. Put 1 1/2 cups of passionfruit juice into a small bowl. When the honeydews have softened, beat the juice into it. Pour the passionfruit juice mixture through a strainer into the pan and mix well. Bring to the boil and immediately pour over the bread/cheese salad.

title: Nuked Feta With Wakame Seaweed
ingredients: 8 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 1 ounce wakame seaweed ( or wakame ) | 1 tablespoon cumin seed, toasted | 1/4 red onion, diced | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Place all ingredients into a bowl and toss well. Spray a large skillet or wok with nonstick spray and heat over medium heat. Spread cumin seeds on the surface and toast in the hot oil about 1 minute. Turn heat to low and add the onion and garlic salt. Saute for about 2 minutes but do not burn them. Drain feta and wakame in a colander. Place on plate. Add a drizzle of the melted cumin seeds to the onions, and serve.

title: Ancho Bean Muffins (Ranch-Cookies)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups canned white beans, rinsed and drained ( about 4 ounces ) | 1/4 cup yogurt | 1 tablespoon dried minced mint | 1 2/3 teaspoons ancho chile powder or 1 2/3 teaspoons dried ancho chile flakes, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace ( i prefer fresh nutmeg )
instructions: Drain the beans well.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,tarragon,marsala wine,white flour,honey,parmigiano reggiano cheese,creme fraiche
title: Marsala Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup marsala wine | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon cube | 1 -2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 3 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons white flour, or to taste | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 package fresh-ground parmigiano-reggiano cheese, divided | 1/4 cup honey | 1/2 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon
instructions: Combine 1 cup marsala wine, 1, bouillon cube, 3 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons flour, 1 teaspoon dried tarragon, 1 package parmigiano reggiano cheese, and 1/4 cup honey in a saucepan and simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened. Add more flour if mixture is too thick and smooth, 1 teaspoon tarragon, additional 1/4 cup marsala wine, or as needed.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,garlic powder,red potato,chili oil,pine nut
title: Grilled Sweet Potato and Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 tart apples, peeled, cored and cut into bite size wedges | 8 -10 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted lightly | garlic powder | chili oil, for drizzling
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium high heat. Toss the sweet potatoes, apples, pinenuts, and garlic powder evenly in the salad dressing. Transfer to the grill and grill until the sweet potatoes are golden brown and the apples are tender, 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Beef With Blueberry Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter beans, drained | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup dried blueberries | 1/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Drain the butter beans. Coat beef with cornstarch. Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Add butter beans, cardamom and beef.

title: Garlic & Asiago Spread
ingredients: 1 cup asiago cheese | 1 tablespoon sweet bell pepper ( dried, seeded & chopped ) | 2 tablespoons dried apricots, chopped
instructions: Mince or mash the asiago.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,mexican cheese,mexican four cheese,bok choy,bacon,onion powder
title: Chop of Champions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds | 1 clove ground dried mulato four cheese ( mexican ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped onion powder | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh yellow onion | 1 tablespoon finely chopped drained bacon | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese ( i recommend cheddar, monterey jack, and cheddar combos ) | 1 lb shredded bok choy
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Spread the pumpkin seeds over a baking sheet, and toast in the oven until lightly browned on top, about five minutes, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a small bowl and cover with plastic wrap. In a small bowl, combine the cheese, onion powder and onion. Stir in the cooked pumpkin seeds and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Set aside. Sprinkle the top of each chop with 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper and place on the prepared baking sheet. Broil until the cheese is melted and bubbly, about three minutes. Remove from the oven and spread the top with remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt and the minced onion. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cheese mixture, followed by the black onion and bacon. Return to the broiler, about two to three minutes. Top with 3 or 4 pieces of bok choy.

title: Bunuelos Crab
ingredients: 4 tablespoons anise-flavored water ( optional ) | 1 pound crabmeat, cut into pieces | 1 jar mild chunky salsa
instructions: Stir the anise water and a small amount of each ingredient in a medium saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer slowly, stirring frequently, until most of the liquid has evaporated, about 5 minutes. Spoon the crab into a bowl using a spoon or spatula, and turn to coat with the anise flavored water.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,cumin seed,cremini mushroom,golden brown sugar,cheddar cheese,red chili pepper,egg white,golden raisin
title: Empress & Apple Stack
ingredients: 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, stems removed ( about 4 cups ) | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored, and cubed | 1 tablespoon cumin seed, toasted | 5 tablespoons golden brown sugar ( packed ) | 5 egg whites | 1/4 - 1/2 cup packed golden brown sugar | 1 large red chili pepper, seeded, chopped | 1/4 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: In large bowl, toss mushrooms with apple. In small bowl, whisk egg whites with 3 tablespoons sugar until stiff. Add remaining 3 tablespoons sugar, chili, and cumin seeds. Fold egg whites into apple mixture with rubber spatula until just combined. Spoon mixture onto warm baking sheet. Sprinkle top of stack with cheese. Bake in 300°f oven for 25 to thirty minutes, or until golden brown and set. Let stand 5 minutes. Slice diagonally and serve. Note, apple toast can be purchased at most grocery stores.

title: Tijuana Poo (Vegan Spanish Cabbage & Meat)
ingredients: 3 cups veggie protein | 3 cups chunky salsa | 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 cup sauerkraut, drained | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f and grease a 9x13 inch baking pan or 2 quarts. Mix all of the ingredients and divide among the 9x13 inch greased pans. Bake for about 25 minutes or until golden brown on top. Serve hot.

title: Mango Chutney Crusted Filet of Beef
ingredients: 1 lb center-cut beef tenderloin, thinly sliced | 1 lb cremini mushroom, thickly sliced | 3/4 cup mango chutney | 1/3 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Preheat the broiler.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,hamburger,dark chicken meat,marjoram,cooking sherry,celery rib,fast rising active yeast
title: Chicken and Napa cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cooked shredded napa cabbage (, coleslaw mix works well ) | 3 medium celery ribs, sliced thin on a bias | 3/4 cup dark chicken meat ( can use more ) | 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking sherry, divided in half ( can use more or less ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram, divided in half ( can use fresh ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, divided in half | 1 package fast-rising active dry yeast | 2 cups cooked hamburger, pulled into large chunks | 4 cups prebaked, lightly toasted nappa cabbage ( see above recipe for other roll ) or 4 cups napa cabbage, shredded
instructions: Place the cabbage and celery in a large bowl. Place the chicken on top. In a small bowl, stir together 1/4 c of the sherry, 2 t. Of the reserved sherry and the marjoram. Brush the outside of rolls with the marinade and place them on a baking sheet. Pour the remaining sherry and sherry to the bowl. Stir to combine. Cover and let rise in a draft free place for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until the liquid has almost completely absorbed. To prepare rolls, preheat oven to 350°f. Place rolls on a foil lined baking pan. Bake until tops are lightly browned, about 15 minutes, and bake until heated through and the rolls feel heated through, about 10 minutes more. To assemble rolls, spread about 1/4 cup of the sherry vinegar on the top of the chicken. Cover with about 1/2 cup or so of the cabbage napa cabbage. Add 1/4 cup more sherry vinegar and a little bit of the sherry. Layer 3 or 4 of the rolls atop the napa cabbage and remaining ingredients in a row across the meat and the rolls. Cover rolls with the remaining sherry vinegar. Bake in a preheated oven for about 10 minutes, or until the cabbages are golden.

title: Greek Yogurt, Oregano & Seasonings
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons low-sodium soy seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: In a small bowl stir together the yogurt, oregano, soy seasoning and vanilla bean. Cover loosely and refrigerate for up to 2 hours serve over ice.

title: Korean Sushi
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 sheet nori, seaweed sheets
instructions: Soak the nori in a bowl of cold water, for 10 minutes. Rinse and dry the nori. Form the beef into 10 patties about 6 x 2 inches. Using a sharp knife, cut the meat into slices approximately 1/4 inch thick and 3 inches long. Spread the nori out on a baking sheet and bake at 400 degrees f for 8 minutes. Cut the meat diagonally into 6 slices on the diagonal, about 1 1/2 inch long total. Serve hot with korean sweet pepper sauce or sriracha sauce.

title: Quinoa Beans & Greens
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 - 1 1/2 cup canned kidney beans
instructions: Pour the dried quinoa into a large bowl. Add 1 1/2 cups of warm water and bring to a boil. Cover and turn the heat down to low. Simmer gently for 10 - 15 minutes or till most of the water is absorbed and beans are softened. If the quinoa has dried out, use a slotted spoon and transfer to a bowl. If there isn't any beans left, just drain them and measure out ¾ cup. When quinoa is soft, transfer it back to the pot for the beans and greens to steam over high heat. If you are serving this as a side dish for the burritos, just use a fork and fork, and when the beans are soft, add them to the quinoa. Serve warm as a salad or as part of a mexican style mexican style dish.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,chocolate coffee bean,worcestershire sauce,red kidney bean,self rising flour,elbow macaroni,vidalia onion
title: Homemade Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni, raw | 1 lb self rising flour | 1 1/2 lbs mozzarella cheese ( sliced very thin ) | 1/4 lb vidalia onion ( sliced very thin ) | 10 ounces chocolate-covered coffee beans ( soaked overnight and cooled ) | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 can red kidney beans
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions using the beans and worcestershire sauce to season the noodles. Set aside. Mix the flour and salt together then add the cheese slices and mix until mixture is evenly mixed. Set aside. Grease a 10x15 inch baking dish with oil. When ready to cook, preheat oven to 350f/180c. Mix together in bowl the flour mixture using about 3/4 cup of the mozzarella cheese and 1/4 of diced vidalia onions. When noodles are ready, remove noodles, reserve some for top. Spread half of bean mixture in the prepared baking dish. Add half of noodles on top of bean mixture. Place the rest of the ingredients in a large bowl and mix together with a fork or your hands. Pour the mixture evenly on top of the noodles. Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 of the sliced cheese on top of the cheese. Bake for 45 minutes or until bubbly and top is golden brown. Allow the dish to sit for 10 minutes before cutting and serving.

title: Papa Dave's Classic French Dip
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger, cooked thoroughly ( or use 1 1/2 lb ) | 1 bag neufchatel cheese
instructions: Put cheese in the bottom of a crockpot. Dump in hamburg followed by the neufchatel cheese, followed by the rest of the ingredients. Note, to be authentic, i use 1 cup of hot italian sausage. Do not use pork or turkey products. You can put the cheese, meat, cheese, and spices into a crockpot as well. Turn on low, or warm the pot gently on the stove. Do not add any additional ingredients. Never turn on warm to avoid a burn.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,mint leaf,marinara sauce,courgette,peanut,taco seasoning
title: Chunky, Quick and Easy Courgette Rabe
ingredients: 500 g courgettes or 500 g zucchini | peanuts, ground | 2 tablespoons sweet greek-spiced taco seasoning | 3 tablespoons fresh mint leaves | 250 g graham cracker crumbs | 1 pint purchased marinara sauce
instructions: Cut the ends off the courgettes and cut off the thick stalk. Cut the courgettes into slices about 1/2 inch thick and then cut out the thick centre with a sharp knife. Now use a grater to grate your courgettes into a large bowl. Sprinkle over the chopped peanuts, your taco seasoning, and plenty of mint. Add the graham cracker crumbs and mix everything together. Place the mixture in your food processor to form roughly 15mm thick rabe. Turn onto a floured board and knead the rabe for about 15 – 20 minutes, depending on your fave geometry. It should feel a little bit tacky. Continue kneading for about 10 – 20 minutes, until the rabe is the right consistency. Cut the rabe into 1/2 inch thick slices. Place in an oven dish, brush with a little olive oil and bake in a 200f oven until firm. Leave to cool on a wire rack. Keep in the fridge until ready to use.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breast With Shrimp and Chocolate
ingredients: 800 g shrimp, cleaned | 50 g crisco | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 35 g graham crackers | 1 cup chicken breast, boiled and diced
instructions: Pour 1/3 cup water and pinch salt into a baking tray and place into oven. When it comes to temperature, put the shrimp into a large pan of water and bring to boil. When the shrimp is cooked, remove from water. Cut open and remove white vein with a knife which helps retain the shrimp's shell. Rinse shrimp in a bowl with cold water. Dry shrimp and set aside. Chop crisco in large bowl. Stir cornflour into crisco until smooth with a whisk. Remove the shrimp from the bag with a slotted spoon as you are going to use it. Place 1 tablespoon of crisco mixture in the center of each shrimp in a long straight line. Wrap each shrimped shrimp around the shrimp and secure with toothpicks. If any of the shrimp is still attached, put the toothpicks on it. Spray the inside of the tray with cooking spray and sprinkle the shrimp with the crumbs, pressing them in evenly. Place the shrimp onto a large baking tray. Spray the tray with cooking spray. Cook in the oven for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,anchovy paste,cardamom,red chile,romaine lettuce
title: Cannel Lettuce on Sweet Chilli (Tamarind) Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red chilies, stems removed | 5 ounces rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup peeled anchovy paste | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom, powdered | 3 heads romaine lettuce
instructions: In a heavy bottomed skillet, add the chillies over moderate heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until tender, about 2 minutes. Remove chillies with slotted spoon and transfer to paper towel lined plate. Drain chillies and discard stems and seeds. Cut chiles crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices and coarsely chop. In a medium bowl, combine chillies, rice wine vinegar, anchovy paste, cardamom, 1 tablespoon of the chilli oil and 1 tablespoon water.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,self raising flour,greek oregano,ice water,hot italian sausage,lime
title: Italian Sausage Loaf
ingredients: 1 kg leg of lamb, boned and butterflied | 375 g of hot italian sausage ( sliced and smoked ) | 310 g self raising flour | 375 ml lime juice | 2 tablespoons greek oregano | ice water
instructions: Mix all ingredients well except for the bread mix. Dip the bread in the mix until it is covered with the bread and then place in a non stick pan. Bake in a moderate oven for 1 hour 20 minutes until golden brown. Serve with lots of napkins so it doesn't burn.

title: Easy and Delicious Roast Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 tablespoon diced pimento pepper ( optional ) | 1 can pineapple juice | 4 pounds corned beef brisket, trimmed | 1 jar diced red potatoes, drained ( optional )
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Place the pimento pepper in a skillet over medium heat, and cook until fragrant, about a minute. Remove from heat, and set aside. Heat the pineapple juice in the skillet until just warm, and pour over the brisket. Arrange the corned beef on top of the pineapple juice, and pour enough water into the bottom of a roasting dish to reach halfway up the side. Cover the dish with a lid, and place in the preheated oven. Bake in the preheated oven until the brisket is easily pierced with a fork, about 2 hours. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 135 degrees f. About 20 minutes before the beef is done, stir in the sliced potatoes. Continue cooking until the potatoes have softened and turned slightly brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Shoarma
ingredients: 1/2 lb shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 teaspoon dry masala | 12 wonton wrappers | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves or 8 tsp dried mint leaves | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Combine cheese and half and half.

title: Eggs Benedict
ingredients: 12 ounces hot italian sausage links | 6 slices baguette ( or country bread ) | 3 -4 tablespoons sultanas
instructions: Heat sausages and sultanas to just boiling in water to cover. Lower temperature, cover, and simmer for 40 minutes, until soft and well flavoured. Cut baguettes into thick slices and toast in the oven for a few minutes on both sides. Place toast on serving plate and place hot sausages over them. Top with warm sultanas, if using them.

title: Dee's Oven-Bake Mccormick Dust Mix
ingredients: 1 envelope mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning mix | 1 package icing sugar | 1 box icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to sift seasoning mix into a large bowl, then add the icing sugar. Add sifted icing sugar, reserving a few extra for dusting. Mix well, then add your meal mix and spread evenly onto a greased pie plate. Sprinkle reserved icing sugar on top. Bake 15 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Turkish Style Fried Onions(Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 8 ounces lean green onions, very thinly sliced | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( optional ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 5 tablespoons sun-dried cured ground fire oil ( not olive oil )
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet. Add the onions and stir fry over medium heat, flipping frequently with tongs, until cooked through and golden brown on both sides, about 20 minutes. Reduce the heat to low and toss the onion until heated through.

title: Teriyaki Steak
ingredients: 4 4 lbs sirloin or 4 lbs flank steaks | cooking spray | 2 cans bechamel hot sauce ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons simple syrup | 2 tablespoons chiles
instructions: Heat grill. Coat a large frypan with cooking spray and place over high heat. Spray grate with cooking spray and sear meat on all sides. Lower heat to medium, cover and cook for 20 to 30 minutes until beef is medium rare. Remove meat from frypan, cover loosely and set aside. Discard any juices in frypan. For sauce, stir béchamel sauce and simple syrup together. Bring to a boil and immediately pour over meat, allowing any meat juices to separate. Return to medium heat and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Balsamic Vinegar Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice or 1 teaspoon dried crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In small bowl, whisk vinegar with allspice and crushed red pepper. Add to salad and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving. Bring to room temperature and serve over salads, vegetables, chicken, pork or fried seafood.

title: Bread Crumbs (Bread Mix)
ingredients: 2 cups breadcrumbs ( dry weight ) | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar ( packed ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, crushed ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon oregano ( optional )
instructions: You will need a 9x9 inch loaf pan. To prepare the crumbs, in a medium bowl, dissolve the sugar in the marjoram. Spread the breadcrumbs evenly in the bottom of the pan. Sprinkle the granulated sugar evenly over the breadcrumbs. Sprinkle the breadcrumbs with the dried marjoram or oregano, if using, if using. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 325°. Bake for 1 hour, uncover and bake until a toothpick inserted in the bread crumbs comes out clean. Allow the bread crumbs to cool and firm. Store crumbs in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: topping,barbeque sauce,baby spinach,spring onion,pimento pepper,grand marnier,cream cheese,chipotle powder
title: Spinach-Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 2 tablespoons prepared pimento pepper, sliced | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 3 tablespoons prepared tapioca pearls in pimento hot sauce | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 3/4 teaspoon chipotle powder | 1 bag baby spinach | 3 spring onions, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the cream cheese, 2 tablespoons of the grand marnier, pimento peppers, grand marnier, tapioca pearls, grand marnier, chipotle powder, spinach, and spring onions. Spread the mixture onto a lightly greased 9x7 inch baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the dip is set.

Random Ingredients: tomato,golden syrup,shrimp,celery rib,white bread wheat,gruyere,plain flour
title: Gruyere Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 5 large ripe tomatoes or 5 large cherry tomatoes | 3 -4 tablespoons plain flour | 4 teaspoons golden syrup | 125 g gruyere, grated | 120 g sliced white bread, crusts removed, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 500 g tiny cooked shrimp, peeled | 2 celery ribs, halved, leaves kept separate, washed, and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c if using cherry tomatoes, remove stem and deseed and cut about 1/3rd through base of each tomato.

title: Basic Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tops sirloin or 1 1/2 lbs stew meat | 1 tablespoon seasoning, blend
instructions: In a large stew pot or dutch oven heat 1/2 t. Of water or enough to cover meat. When the water comes up to a boil add the meat and seasoning blend and stir to combine. Cover and simmer 45 minutes stirring occasionally, over low heat. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Griddled Chilli Lamb
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut ( salted ) | 1 red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, crushed | 5 lbs beef shoulder
instructions: Combine peanuts, chili and anchovy paste in a food processor and process to a coarse paste. Spread mixture onto a work surface. Make diagonal slashes on the lamb. Roll lamb in the peanut mixture. Preheat oven to 375°f. Pour oil into a shallow roasting tin. Line the meat with aluminum foil. Carefully place meat on foil. Bake 30 minutes until cooked. Meanwhile, remove meat from foil. Bake for a further 30 minutes. Serve with rice. Variation, roast sesame seeds and ginger make a fine substitute for the chilli paste. To serve, roast chilli and red chilli separately on an ungreased baking tray in a 350°f oven, for 10 to 15 minutes or till the skin is charred. Drain the flesh, reserving the oil. Cool and cut into small pieces. Bring the oil into a saucepan. Add the chilli and chilli and cook over low heat for 2 minutes, stirring continuously. Remove from heat and stir in the reserved oil. Cool. Spread the oil and chilli mixture into a greased shallow roasting tin. Place meat on top. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Spinach in Thyme
ingredients: fresh spinach, to cover | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Wash the spinach well and remove any tough stems, or coarse stalks, from the spinach leaves. Place all the ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer gently over a low heat for 4 minutes, or until the spinach is wilted. If the heat is too high simmer gently for a further 2 - 3 minutes to wilt the spinach.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing,parmigiano reggiano cheese,italian tomato,flour,panko breadcrumb
title: Italian Tomato Balls
ingredients: 1 can italian tomatoes or ( 28 ounce ) can large italian tomatoes, drained, reserving juice | 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup ranch dressing | 1/4 cup flour ( for dusting )
instructions: Place tomatoes in large bowl, add reserved juice and mash with a fork until blended. Add bread crumbs, cheese, ranch dressing, flour and salt and pepper to taste and mix well. Dampen hands and form mixture into 1 inch balls. Place balls on lightly greased tray, spacing evenly for approximately 1 inch depth. Cover and refrigerate while preparing other ingredients. Preheat oven to 350°f when ready to bake, remove balls from tray on baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes, shaking pan about halfway through. Serve warm with tomato sauce or a side of your choice.

title: Filipino Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs filet of beef, trimmed and cut into 3 x 1/2 inch strips | 1 teaspoon nam pla | 2 tablespoons nam pla | 1 1/4 cups half-and-half | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 cup frozen white corn or 1 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed | 1 package kielbasa, thinly sliced
instructions: Using 1 teaspoon of nam pla, toss meat strips in nam pla. Let stand 10 minutes. Combine cream and 1 teaspoon of nam pla in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes. Off heat, stir in half and half. Mix in beef, return to heat. Cook over medium heat until thickened and slightly reduced, about 6 to 8 minutes. Stir in corn. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of confectioners' sugar and serve.

title: Green Apple Curry Powder Mix
ingredients: 6 green apples, such as dutch oven, chopped | 4 teaspoons powdered curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed cardamom | 1 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a glass jar with a lid. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Quick and Easy Crock Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef chuck roast | 16 ounces of any flavor beef gravy | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place roast in crock pot. Mix gravy with cream and pour over the roast. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours. Serve over noodles with garlic bread and salad.

title: Amaretto Bread and Butter Spread
ingredients: 24 slices crusty bread, toasted | 1 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt, or more as needed | 1 cup amaretto or other almond-flavored liqueur
instructions: Spread toast with amaretto cream, or as needed.

title: Cheddar Roesti
ingredients: 500 g extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon dried lavender | 2 teaspoons dried minced lavender | salt ( optional, i'm not a big fan of salt ) | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1/4 cup broth
instructions: Cut the cheddar into 1/2' cubes and mix well with the lemon and lavender. Season to taste. Heat oil in a frying pan over med heat. Add cheese and stir to coat and let brown. Slowly add broth while continuously stirring. Keep warm while preparing other ingredients so cheddar doesn't burn.

Random Ingredients: yellow food coloring,tomato paste,lettuce,horseradish,dark chocolate,monterey jack cheese,honey
title: Hot Cheese, Tomato & Hazelnut Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, washed and well drained | 200 g ripe dark chocolate, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 tablespoons yellow food coloring | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c lightly spray a baking tray with oil. Line the base of the tray with a piece of baking paper. Place the lettuce in a large tea towel. Place the tray of lettuce leaves on your work surface or tea towel. In a microwaveable bowl, combine the dark chocolate, tomato paste, cheeses, horseradish and food colouring. Microwave for 2 minutes until smooth, pour over the leaf wraps, and place the tray in the oven. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, then remove the tray from the oven. Allow to stand for 5 - 10 minutes before serving. Serve topped with extra horseradish. Dressing and variations depending on your taste, place honey in a bowl & set aside, or leave out the colouring.

Random Ingredients: clove,tarragon,lemon peel,milk chocolate candy bar,oat bran,cheese
title: Gran's Muesli
ingredients: 1/3 cup oat bran | 1/3 cup wheat bran | 1/4 cup cline | 4 cloves | 12 -15 ounces cheese cubes ( i use a combo of sharp cheddar & goat cheese in australia ) | 2 ounces milk chocolate candies | 1 lemon peel, pith and all, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Combine cheeses and spices in food processor or blender or stand mixer. Blend 1 minute. Fold in enough milk to make a thin batter. Pour into a bowl or bowl/bowl. Add extra milk if necessary to make thin batter. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Just before serving, garnish with strips of lemon peel, if using. This can be served either hot or cold. Use a slotted spoon to dip cheese into the batter..

title: Tunisian Sea Bass With Pistachios
ingredients: 1/2 cup fat-free greek yogurt | 1/2 tablespoon mustard oil | sea bass | 2 teaspoons pistachios, roughly chopped
instructions: Combine 3 teaspoons of pistachios with 2 tablespoons of mustard oil in medium bowl and dip sea bass into yogurt, cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours, tossing occasionally. Remove sea bass from marinade and grill over medium heat 2 to 4 minutes per side. Serve fillets over a bed of pistachios.

title: Homemade Parsley Salt
ingredients: 1 cup flat leaf parsley, very finely chopped | 1 tablespoon coarse sea salt ( maldon makes a coarse salt )
instructions: Wash and dry parsley generously. Transfer parsley coarsely to a bowl. Sprinkle sea salt over top, cover with a clean wet cloth, and let stand for several hours, or until the salt is creamy and completely absorbed into the parsley.

title: Cheater's Antipasto
ingredients: 8 ounces finely sliced pepperoni | 1/2 ounce grand marnier
instructions: Place the pepperoni slices into a double boiler over low heat. Place the pan over a heat and warm the juice until very hot but not boiling. Remove from heat, pour the warm juice into a sterilized pint jar and pack the jar with the pepperoni and grand marnier. Seal and place in a cool dark place. The juice should reach a temperature of 375 degrees f, and serve.

title: Garlic Taffy Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers | 3/4 cup fajita seasoning, blend | 1 green pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, minced | 1/8 teaspoon saffron threads ( optional ) | 1/2 cup gnocchi
instructions: Drain the ladyfingers. Sprinkle 3/4 of the fajita seasoning blend over the ladyfingers. Mix in peppers, ginger, saffron and saffron. Let the ladyfingers sit in the refrigerator for around 30 minutes. While waiting for the ladyfingers to sit start making your gnocchi.

Random Ingredients: baby rocket,salt black pepper,ranch dressing mix,mexican rice,aleppo pepper,breadcrumb,oat,red cabbage
title: Mexican Red Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oat ( quick and easy ) | 2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs, plain breadcrumbs | 2 cups shredded red cabbage ( or a combination of shredded cabbage and shredded cabbage ) | 3 cups leftover cooked mexican style rice ( mexican rice such as chorizo can also be used ) | 1/2 tablespoon mexican-style dry taco seasoning ( for a kick ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 ounces hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 1/3 cup shredded mexican style aleppo pepper
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the oat, bread crumbs, red cabbage, rice, taco seasoning, salt and pepper. Form about 15 small rolls and place on a foil lined baking sheet, brush the tops with any leftover oat mixture and sprinkle with the shredded cheese if using. Bake in a 375f oven until heated through and the cheese has melted. Let cool 5 minutes and serve with cocktail rye or guacamole.

title: Steak in Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 pound flank steak | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp, or as needed
instructions: Slice thinly against the grain of the steak. Place the steak in a glass dish, and pour the tamarind pulp over the beef. Cover, and refrigerate for at least one hour before serving to marinate. Heat the grill to high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Grill the steak, cut side down, on the preheated grates until the deepest part of the meat is dark brown, about 5 minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: bulgur wheat,puff pastry,mango chutney,italian parsley,juniper berry
title: Easy Crunchy Polenta
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bulgur wheat | 1 teaspoon finely chopped italian parsley | 1 teaspoon finely chopped juniper berries | 2 teaspoons mango chutney | 2 cups of prepared polenta or 2 cups whole wheat pastry dough | 1 tablespoon finely chopped italian parsley | 1 teaspoon finely chopped juniper berries
instructions: In a medium saucepan put bulgur, 1 teaspoon of parsley powder and 1 teaspoon of juniper berries. Boil while stirring, until bulgur is tender and the mixture is translucent. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, make dough. To make the dough, put dough ingredients in your food processor and pulse a few times. Pour onto a lightly floured surface. Roll out until it is about 1/8 inch thick. Cut into desired size circles using a cookie cutter or 3 round cutter. Put your favourite filling on the pastry. Top with other pastry, and close pastry to enclose filling. Preheat oven to 400°f bake on a parchment lined cookie sheet for 20 minutes or until top is puffed and golden on top. If necessary, cool on a wire rack.

title: Italian Pork Loin
ingredients: 2 loin | italian seasoning
instructions: Score the fat from the loin. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoons salt and 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning. Heat oven to 325 degrees f. Place loins skin side down in a roasting pan and roast in the preheated oven until fat is browned, about 1 1/2 hours. Let stand 10 minutes. Slice into thin slices. Serve with sauteed mushrooms and roasted veggies.

title: Grilled Skewers for a Mid-Eastern Fusion of Lamb and Seitan!
ingredients: 1 lb lamb shank or 1 lb leg of lamb, trimmed of all visible fat | 2/3 ounce thickly sliced seitan | 2/3 ounce horseradish | 1 cinnamon stick, broken into two ( or a whole bulb )
instructions: If using lamb shank cut into 2 inch cubes of equal size. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and place on a plate. If using leg of lamb cut into 1 inch cubes. Soak a bowl of water to a depth of 2 inches in a microwaveable bowl for at least 30 second intervals, using a meat mallet to pound the pieces a bit as you go. If using leg of lamb, use your hands to pound out as much as possible. Trim shank pieces of fat, reserving any leftover fat. Brush a grill rack with oil and place all pieces of meat on. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Grill over medium hot coals until tender and nicely blackened, about 8 to 10 minutes. Turn meat over and brush with oil. Grill the seitan until it is crispy and cooked through, about 5 to 10 minutes, depending on the thickness of the slices of lamb you are using, and the crust is crispy. Cut pieces into 3 or 4 equal size pieces. Cut the seitan into pieces about 1/2 inch wide. Divide seitan among skewers and serve immediately.

title: Couscous With Green Stuffing
ingredients: 800 g chicken breasts | 1 cup chopped broccoli | 1 eggplant, diced | 1 cup hazelnuts, sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh thai basil, coarsely chopped | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon sweet chicken cooking bean paste or 1 tablespoon thai sweet chili sauce
instructions: Place chicken or turkey with skin on in a large frying pan. Cook over a medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes per side or until no longer pink and juices run clear. Remove from heat and tent with foil. Cut into strips. Cut eggplant into sticks measuring approx 1cm thick and 3cm wide, halve eggplant lengthways. Place in a large bowl with chopped broccoli and nuts. Toss to combine. Place in a dish, spray with cooking oil and stir through basil and sweet chili sauce. Spoon mixture onto each serving plate, cover and store for an hour to firm. Tip, the preparation and cooking time does not include marinading the chicken or turkey.

title: Oregano Sweet Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 3 cups sugar snap peas ( julienned in half lengthwise and then cut into thirds ) | 1/4 cup shelled pistachios ( pistachios are not traditional ) | 1 1 teaspoon ground unbleached flax seed | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Cut fris crosswise into 1/3 inch thick slices and then crosswise in a cross on a cookie sheet. Remove bread crusts from cookie sheet and brush with 1 teaspoon oil. Sprinkle cheese and pistachios over loaf. Sprinkle bread with oregano. Place in a cool oven or toaster oven on broiler setting. Reduce heat to 350°f and broil for 15 minutes or till golden brown. Watch bread carefully. Be careful not to burn.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,soya sauce,spanish peanut,salsa,red chili pepper,coriander leaf
title: Spicy Soya Spiced Peanuts
ingredients: 4 cups spanish peanuts, roasted | 1 1/2 cups salsa | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1 fresh red chili pepper, seeded | 2 teaspoons ground coriander leaves or 2 teaspoons cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Wash the peanuts and remove the skin. Put them in a food processor and process until they become smooth. Pour them in a large bowl and mix with salsa, soya sauce, chili pepper and coriander. Spread the mixture onto a tray. Keep aside for at least 2 hours. Roast the peanuts in oven under the grill until they become brown.

title: Whole Wheat and Fresh Whipped Cream Cheese Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon juice, zest of | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice, from 2 medium lemons | 8 slices whole wheat bread, toasted | 1 2/3 cups whipping cream ( or double cream )
instructions: For the topping, add all of the topping ingredients to a 1 quart glass measure. Whisk lightly to combine. Pour 1/3 cup cream into a small saucepan. Bring just to a boil, stirring constantly, then pour over the toasted bread. Set aside.

Random Ingredients: ice water,chicken stock vegetable,mango,hot red chili pepper,ladyfinger
title: Quick Mango Sauce With Cinnamon
ingredients: 1/2 cup lime juice or 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 5 hot red chili peppers, finely chopped | 15 -20 ladyfingers, cut in half ( savoiardi, about 2oz each ) or 3 small sweet potatoes | 5 cups ice water
instructions: In a bowl add all the ingredients into a saucepan and stir. Cook over medium heat until mixture is hot and sticky and reduced to 1 cup or as needed. Remove from heat. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Corn Chips #2
ingredients: 1 cup corn chips, crushed | 1/3 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Combine mayo and crushed corn chips in a bowl and sprinkle with mayo.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,white corn,beef brisket,orzo pasta,cider vinegar
title: Corned Beef & Orzo Pasta (Crock Pot or Not)
ingredients: 1 lb orzo pasta, cooked and drained ( orzo ) | 1 corned beef brisket, trimmed of excess fat | 1 package white corn, cut in half | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 unbaked 9 inch pie shell, baked and cooled
instructions: Set oven to 425º f. Spray a 10 1/2 x 7 1/2 inch shallow glass bowl with cooking spray. Place the orzo in a large bowl and toss with 2 tablespoons water. Arrange the corned beef in a 5 - 6 cup, meaty side bag along with the corn on the beef. Close and toss to coat. Pour the vinegar into the bag with the vegetables. Close bag and shake vigorously to mix. Transfer the beef, corn, 1/2 cup water, and orzo to the prepared baking dish. Cover and refrigerate for at least 5 hours or overnight. Bake the orzo covered with foil 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove the foil and top with remaining pasta. Bake 25 minutes longer or until pasta is tender.

title: Lamb Burgundy With Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 4 lbs lamb, boned trimmed of fat | 1 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 1/2 lbs sweet potatoes, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced on the horizontal | 3 cups broccoli, cut into florets | 1 sprig rosemary | 1/2 cup sweet chinese wine or 1/2 cup dry white wine
instructions: Position rack in center of the oven and preheat to 400°f. Remove lamb from its packaging, leaving excess fat in the bag. Place lamb and 1/2 tsp of the 5 spice powder on a work surface. Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp of the five spice powder and roll into a 1 inch log. Place the rolls on a rack in a shallow roasting pan and roast, turning occasionally, until well browned, about 30 - 45 minutes. Set aside on platter and cover with foil to keep warm. For the sweet potato, in a large covered roasting pan, place sweet potatoes and broccoli. Add the remaining 5 spice powder, the wine, and 2 cups water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then cover and braise until sweet potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally, about 25 minutes total. Slice lamb across the grain. Serve lamb and sweet potato with sauce on the side.

title: Mushroom and French Canadian Pate
ingredients: 12 ounces mushrooms, sliced | 6 ounces beef gravy | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/2 lemon, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Put mushrooms and gravy into a bowl. Mix well. Put two strips of lemon on top of each mushroom. Serve with hot toast.

title: Mint Refresher
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Combine the beans and mint. Use to stuff bread.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,tortilla,salt black pepper,beet,sea scallop,chipotle powder
title: Sea Scallops With Chipotle, Tapenade, Parsley & Beetroot Tostadas
ingredients: 1/2 lb small sea scallop | sea scallops, quartered ( or baby beets if they are less than 1/2 inch in diameter ) | 1/2 lb beetroot, trimmed, halved and peeled ( i use turnips, but any sweet green will do ) | 5 tablespoons chipotle powder ( from jarred chipotle ) | sea scallops ( or steaks, use extra scallops for taste, or just leave them whole ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | warm chopped fresh parsley flakes ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. In a medium saucepan, place the scallops over medium heat. Add a little water if scallops begin to darken. Scallops will just about make popping sounds when they are done. Cook for 4 minutes on each side, until just opaque throughout. Meanwhile, place the beetroot in a pot with just enough water to cover it. Bring to a boil. Cook over medium heat until tender. Drain, and let cool. Remove the stems and any coarse outer leaves. Squeeze out the water from the beetroot, if necessary, and coarsely chop. Add to the scallops. Wash and peel the scallops, and set aside. Add the chipotle and parsley to the scallops. Cut the scallops in half lengthwise. Remove the seeds, and slice the halves into 2 inch squares. Toss the scallops with any remaining chipotle, parsley, beetroot, and salt and pepper to taste. Place on a tray and place in the oven during the tostada process. As soon as the toast is to your liking, place 1 tablespoon of tapenade into the center of each slice. Sprinkle with the reserved beetroot and parsley flakes. Serve hot.. The tapenade can be frozen if you do not have any on hand..

title: Scotch Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 1 can reduced-sodium beef broth | 12 ounces shell pasta
instructions: Cook and drain linguine as per package directions. Stir fry linguine until it starts to brown. Pour beef and broth into skillet. Stir well, bring to a boil, and cook for 2 minutes. Combine pasta and sauce.

Random Ingredients: half,cake flour,chicken stock cube,pimento,yellow pepper,turnip,chicken breast half
title: Chop up Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 can condensed yellow sweet peppers | 1 chicken stock cube | 2 tablespoons sliced pimentos | 1 tablespoon cream or 1 tablespoon half-and-half | 1/2 cup cake flour
instructions: Slice chicken breasts into chunks. Combine with peppers, stock cube and pimentos, stirring till dissolved. Pour cream or half and half on top. Mix cake flour and a little water till dough forms. Roll out thinly in a pan brush lightly with a mix. Roll and place on a greased baking tray in a circle over the top of the cream. Bake 10 mins at 180 degrees celcius.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,cilantro leaf,peanut oil,romano cheese,black eyed pea,cinnamon
title: Nif's Peas and Ramen
