ingredients: 14 ounces black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained ( preferably shoepeg ) | 1/4 cup unsalted peanuts oil | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 4 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese | 1/2 cup lightly packed fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: In medium saucepan, bring 2 inches of water to boil. Add peas. Cook uncovered over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until almost tender, about 3 minutes. Stir with a fork to separate peas. Drain peas and return to pan. Season to taste with salt. Heat 1/4 cup of peanuts in oil in a small skillet over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Transfer with a slotted spoon to paper towel lined plate. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of oil from skillet. Add cinnamon, 1 tablespoon of cheese, and cilantro. Cook until sizzling, about 1 minute more. Remove from heat. Divide between two bowls. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon of cheese and serve.

title: Mozzarella Wrapped in Szechuan Peppercorns
ingredients: 16 large ladyfingers | 1 cup shredded muir glen ( you can use a combination of the two ) or 1 cup emmenthaler cheese ( you can use a combination of the two ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon ground szechuan peppercorns
instructions: Lay ladyfingers flat in a single layer on a lightly greased baking sheet. Mix the cheese, turmeric and sichuan peppercorns and spread evenly over the bread. Bake at 375°f for 15 minutes. Cut into 8 wedges. Serve immediately.

title: Tomato Beef Curry for Idlis
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( or 1/8-1/4 teaspoon fenugreek powder ) | 1 1/2 cups peeled chopped tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup stone's original graham cracker crumbs ( about 1 cup ) | graham cracker crumbs, for dipping
instructions: In large skillet, brown beef over medium heat until no longer pink.

title: Easy & Mild Teriyaki Burgers
ingredients: 2 medium courgettes, sliced | 2 slices pepperoni | 3 tablespoons kefalotyri or 3 tablespoons garam masala | 1 tablespoon liquid sweetener, such as splenda | 1/3 cup tasty & herb blends
instructions: Heat non stick frypan over high heat. Add sliced courgettes, pepperoni & liquid sweetener & stir. Cover & cook until lightly cooked, about 3 minutes & serve hot with roti & bread.

title: Pumpkin and Hard-Boiled Eggs: Boeregene Berber
ingredients: 1/2 kg pumpkin | 1 large hard-boiled egg, peeled, boiled and sliced | 1 grapefruit, seeds removed
instructions: Rinse the pumpkin with cold water and remove the top or bottom shell. Trim off the peel from the outer leaves of the inside. Cut the flesh into chunks and remove the centre core with a sharp knife. Set aside. Cut the hard boiled egg into 1 cm dice and cut each into quarters. Place a small piece of egg into each cavity opening and nestle the pumpkin pieces on top. Press the egg pieces firmly together to seal in the pumpkin flesh. Place the bowl in a baking dish to catch any spills. Bake the pumpkin on a medium heat and sprinkle with the reserved seeds. Bake for approximately 1 hour or until the pumpkin is tender and the egg is cooked. Serve warm. Alternatively, allow the pumpkin to cool, remove the skin and cut into chunks and arrange on a platter.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,plum tomato,white pepper,beef rib,ginger ale,spaghetti,gingerroot,cheddar cheese
title: Ginger Pub Cheddar and Beef Short Rib Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb short ribs, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 lb cheddar cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups chopped peeled unpeeled plum tomatoes | 4 tablespoons ginger ale, in water 1-2-inch cube or 2 2 teaspoons grated fresh gingerroot | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 5 ounces uncooked lasagna noodles | 12 ounces thin tomato passata ( not `` tomato dipping sauce '' ) | hot cooked noodles ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Layer ribs, cheese, tomatoes, ginger ale, pepper and ginger into baking dish. Cover loosely and bake until ribs are tender, about 1 hour and 30 minutes, basting twice with liquid in pan. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Cover and keep warm. Remove bay leaf. Serve topped with tomato dipping sauce.

title: Spicy Amaretto Bacon
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled, about 6 slices total | 1 tablespoon amaretto liqueur | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat a skillet to medium high heat. Add the bacon, and fry until crispy, 5 to 7 minutes. Add the amaretto, red pepper flakes, and bacon crumbles. Serve immediately.

title: Rhubarb Fool
ingredients: 3 shallots, finely chopped | 2 lbs rhubarb, sliced | 3/4 cup whipping cream or 3/4 cup heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place the shallots and rhubarb in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes. Drain and reserve cooking liquid. Drain rhubarb and reserve the cooking liquid and juice. Cut rhubarb into small pieces. Place in large bowl. Add reserved cooking liquid and whipped cream. Add worcestershire sauce and stir to blend, adding reserved fruit juice and reserved fat from rhubarb. Blend until smooth. Serve over ice and crackers or pretzels dipped in whipped cream.

title: Currants
ingredients: 1/3 cup fresh cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup dried currant, soaked in 1/3 cup hot water for 10 minutes, then drained | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil or 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, combine the cilantro and currants and add the oil. Raise the heat to high, and cook, stirring frequently, for 3 to 4 minutes, or until the currants are wilted and tender. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,wonton wrapper,monterey jack cheese,catsup,paprika,nonfat milk,red capsicum,bell pepper
title: Aussie Cheese Pinwheels
ingredients: 1 packet wonton wrappers | 12 -16 medium prawns | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons nonfat milk | 200 g monterey jack cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1 tablespoon red capsicums, chopped | 1 bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Place prawns in a pan coated with non fat cooking spray, over a high heat, using a rolling pin. Cook prawns until browned then remove from pan. Drain and place prawns in a bowl with the cheese, tomato sauce, paprika and capsicum. Tuck the wonton wrapper closed and place the pinhons in a muffin tin lined with paper cases. Bake in oven at 220°c for 6 minutes or until golden and crispy.

title: Rajas Verde
ingredients: 12 medium italian tomatoes, ripe | 6 medium sage leaves, fresh, leaves only | 10 juniper berries | 2 tablespoons sage leaves, very finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups tequila | 1 teaspoon finely chopped epazote leaves
instructions: Wash the tomatoes and the sage leaves. Preheat oven to 250°, gas line roasting pan, or other ovenproof pan with a baking sheet, and lay tomatoes and sage leaves inside. Mix oregano with sage on top. Add the tequila with salt and pepper to taste. Place the pan in the oven and warm, then set timer for 45 minutes. Turn tomatoes and sage, re cover, and place in a 300·for about 30 minutes. It should be well puffed and lightly browned but not black. Remove from oven and take out the baking paper. Remove tomatoes and sage. Allow tomatoes to cool, then cut into thin slices. Enjoy this rich rajas verde.

title: Thyme, Cabbage and Horseradish Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 bunch fresh thyme leaves | 4 cups green cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1/4 cup grated horseradish | 6 egg yolks
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the thyme leaves, cabbage, fish sauce, horseradish and egg yolks.

title: Indian Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower, cut into florets | 2 white onions, chopped | 2 1/2 cups shredded green cardamom pods
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook cauliflower for 8 to 10 minutes or until bright green and tender.

title: Fruit Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 jar chopped dried apricot preserves | 1 jar pork-flavored sausage ( use pork loin or turkey sausage or another brand ; it doesn't really matter ) | 1 package prosciutto | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1 jar pineapple preserves | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons fine salt
instructions: Remove giblets from sausage. Place in plastic bags or a large ziplock bag. Remove sausage from bag. If using turkey, remove casing and tear meat into chunks, if you are using other meat, chop or dice the meat. If using pork, remove casing from sausage and tear into chunks, if you are using other meat, cut into chunks. In a 9 x 13 baking pan, layer the first 7 ingredients, and bake in a 350 oven until hot, about 25 minutes. Serve with your choice of fresh fruit. My note, i made these with turkey because it was so easy and really had no fat. My family loved them. Next time i will make these again for a couple of kids.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,strawberry,green cabbage,penne,picante sauce,spinach,italian bread
title: Linguine With Spinach and Strawberries
ingredients: 6 cups cut up green cabbage | 1 lb spinach, coarsely chopped | 12 slices italian bread | 6 ounces fresh strawberries | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 12 ounces picante sauce, chilled | 16 ounces penne ( rotelle )
instructions: In a large pot cook spinach according to package directions, drain and cool. Meanwhile, slice bread into 1/2 inch wide slices and place in a baking dish. Drain cabbage and spinach, then lightly squeeze out excess moisture. Reserve any remaining liquid and chop leaves. Preheat broiler. Place 4 slices of bread on work surface with 1/4 cup each tomato and lettuce for garnish. Top with half of cabbage and 1/4 cup of spinach and 1/4 cup of spinach. Top with 2 slices of bread, tomato, lettuce, remaining leaves and sprinkle with cheese. Repeat with remaining 2 slices of bread and spinach. Broil until browned, about 3 minutes. Cut into 4 pieces.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,dark brown sugar,jalapeno pepper,amaretto liqueur,celery rib,almond,english mustard
title: Amaretto Dipping Sauce for Seafood
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon prepared english mustard | 1 teaspoon dry red food coloring | 2 cups ground blanched almond | 4 celery ribs, chopped | 2 medium jalapeno peppers, seeded and cut in 1/8-1/4 slices
instructions: Place all ingredients except shrimp in small heavy saucepan cook over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves. Increase heat to medium high.

title: Slow Cooker Beef Stew for Slow Cooker
ingredients: 2 pounds cubed beef stew meat | 1 pound cubed pork | 1/3 cup light brown sugar
instructions: Spread meat into the bottom of a slow cooker, and sprinkle brown sugar over the meat. Cover, and set to low.

title: Mexican Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower florets | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: In saucepan bring medium size saucepan of water to a boil, add cauliflower. Reduce heat to lightly boil and cook for 6 to 8 minutes or until tender but still firm. Drain well. Rinse with cold water, drain again and place in large bowl of ice water to stop cooking. Drain well. Place remaining ingredients in serving bowl, mix well. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine,red chili pepper flake,basil,fennel seed,italian sausage link,mustard seed,pinto bean,lemon juice zest
title: Easy Italian Fettuccine and Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage link | 1 large lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon fennel seed ( can add up to 1/2 teaspoon more if necessary ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds ( can add up to 1/2 teaspoon more if needed ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 28 ounces pinto beans ( can use red kidney beans if you prefer ) | 1/2 cup fresh basil ( can use 2 sprigs of or 1/2 basil, plus more for garnish ) or 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley ( can use 2 sprigs or 1/2 basil, plus more for garnish ) | 16 ounces of uncooked fettuccine ( can use 2 spinach leaves )
instructions: Heat a grill pan until very hot. Lightly oil the pan. For the sauce, cut the sausage into 1/2/3 inch slices.

title: Sausage
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon garlic, powder | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour over your favorite sausage roll.

title: French Vinegar and Sage Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 sage leaves, very finely chopped
instructions: Warm the stock and vinegar together in a small saucepan over low heat, but do not boil. Stir in the sage leaves. The sauce will thicken as it cools and keep for up to one week in refrigerator.

title: Tuna Cantonese
ingredients: 1/4 lb tuna steak | 2 tablespoons mustard ( spicy or sweet ) | 1 napa cabbage | 2 ounces canned pineapple chunk
instructions: Thaw tuna, cut into very thin slices. Grill or fry tuna over medium heat, turning once. Let cool slightly. Meanwhile steam or fry cabbage. Add mustard and pineapple chunks, cooking for 5 minutes longer, stirring once. Arrange tuna over rice, making sure it is evenly distributed. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sake,red chili pepper,onion salt,salt pepper,italian breadcrumb,white chocolate chip,graham cracker crumb,iceberg lettuce
title: Chili  Nachos (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped onion | 1/4 cup finely chopped red chili pepper | 1/2 cup dry italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup finely chopped iceberg lettuce | 1/4 cup white chocolate chips or 1/4 cup semisweet chocolate chips | 1/2 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon salt | 3/4 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix together all ingredients well. Place in a greased 13x9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with onion salt. Bake for about 20 minutes or until edges are light brown. Let cool and cut.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,coconut oil,chocolate,heavy cream,yukon gold potato,red chile,kosher salt,vanilla
title: Yukon Gold Chiles and Coconut Milk Recipe
ingredients: 2 medium yukon gold potatoes ( about 3 pounds ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 4 teaspoons pure vanilla | 10 dried red chilies, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup light coconut oil ( unsalted ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 chicken bouillon | 4 teaspoons unsweetened chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into 1/8 inch dice. Transfer to a food processor and pulse until finely chopped but not completely liquefied, about 10 pulses. Transfer to a bowl, season with kosher salt and stir in vanilla and chiles, mixing until well combined. In a medium skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat until very hot. Add the cream and bouillon, stirring to dissolve the bouillon. Bring to a boil over medium heat, scraping the bottom of the pot with a wooden spoon. Pour the hot cream mixture into the hot coconut oil along with the potatoes. Cover and cook until the potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Transfer to a blender or food processor and puree until smooth. Return to the skillet and stir in chocolate, if using. Season to taste with salt.

title: Quick Caribbean Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1/4 cup raisins | 3 tablespoons dried cranberry sauce | 1/8 teaspoon celery salt | 2 cans baked beans
instructions: In a large bowl, mix peanut oil, water chestnuts, raisins, cranberry sauce, celery salt, and baked beans. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Roasted Pepper and Goat Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon goat cheese | 1 teaspoon ground marjoram | 1/2 cup hulled yellow sweet pepper
instructions: Place sour cream, goat cheese, marjoram and yellow sweet pepper into the bowl of a food processor. Blend until ingredients are creamy. Use immediately or refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,chilies,red wine,poppy seed,tomato,anise seed,sea salt,superfine sugar
title: Hot Tomato Paste (Poppy Seed Sauce)
ingredients: 3 cups dry red wine ( italian or french colony preferred ) or 3 cups dry white wine ( italian or french colony preferred ) | 1 1/4 cups poppy seeds | 3 tablespoons finely snipped chilies ( or cayenne pepper flakes, or a mixture ) or 3 tablespoons cumin ( or cayenne pepper flakes ) | 4 1/2 tablespoons finely snipped anise seeds | 2 teaspoons finely grated cardamom pods | 1 1/2 1 1/2 teaspoons coarse sea salt or 2 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar or 1 1/2 cups packed light brown sugar
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the sugar in a large saucepan over medium low heat. Cook, stirring constantly, 1 to 2 minutes, or until the mixture is very fragrant. Bring the mixture to a boil and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture reduces to almost a thick paste consistency. Remove from the heat and let set, about 30 minutes, stirring frequently. Add the sugar and stir until dissolved. Transfer to a covered container or storage container with a tight seal and store at room temperature until ready to use. Can be stored in a tightly covered container until ready to use if desired, up to 1 month. Makes about 1 1/2 cups total. Note, the amount of sugar will vary depending on the sweetness of the green chilies.

title: Orange Rice With Beef
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb steak | 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1 orange, juice of
instructions: Prepare your rice according to package directions. While rice cooks, slice the beef into thin slivers. Place beef in a skillet of your choice, preferably non stick. Over medium heat with the butter, add the slices and brown on all sides. Drain the beef. Pour the orange juice over the beef and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Dolmades (Chicken in Pesto Sauce)
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 1 cup chicken breast meat, diced | 1 cup fresh cherry, halved | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine chicken stock, chicken breast meat, and cherries.

title: Mom's Sushi Roll
ingredients: 3 scallions, chopped finely | 2 large spanish onions, chopped finely | 7 cups cabbage, finely diced | 4 cups rice, cooked | 2 packages dashi stock | pam cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray pam in a large non stick skillet and heat over medium heat. Add chopped scallions and sauté. Add chopped onions and cabbage and stir fry until cabbage just begins to soften. Add dashi stock and stir until fully blended. Line a 9 by 13 inch baking dish with greaseproof paper towels. Tear apart the rice into small pieces and lightly coat with pam. Pour the sushi mix into the dish. Wrap the sushi around the sushi roll and poke holes into the top. Spray a baking sheet with pam and pour in the rice. The bottom of the rice will absorb all the grease and won`t be runny, so do not over stuff the rice in the pan as it should be wet and soggy. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes, until liquid has been absorbed. Enjoy.

title: Mexican Fiesta Blend
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup flour | 1 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Mix Italian on low med heat on a cookie sheet. Add the ingredients and mix. Spread onto your favorite tacos. Or, use as a dip with refried beans. It is also good with tortilla chips.

title: Stuffed Okra
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra | 1 package shredded parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Wrap the okra in aluminum foil, and place in a skillet over medium heat. Pour in enough water to cover.

title: Naan Bread
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons ghee | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Pour a little yogurt into a small baking dish. Cover with a layer of foil. Sprinkle each layer with about 1 tablespoon of ghee and fold one corner of the dish over to make a rim. Repeat until yogurt is gone from the dish. Bake bread in the preheated oven until top is dry and golden brown, 20 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,sage leaf,onion soup mix,ginger ale,cornflour,fenugreek seed,portabella mushroom
title: Foamy Egg Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 package egg noodles, cooked and cooled | 1/2 cup onion soup mix | 1/2 cup ginger ale | 1 package fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1/8 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds ( optional )
instructions: Combine cornflour and dried spices. Set aside. Combine all remaining liquid ingredients in saucepan. Heat just until warm, but do not boil. Pour liquid mixture into lightly greased 8 x8 baking dish. Cover and bake at c for 30 minutes. Remove foil, top with noodles and bake 30 minutes longer, or until noodles are tender. Allow to stand for 10 minutes, then top with a drizzle of cream, if desired.

title: Cranberries With Pecorino, Romano and Craisins (Ricardo Larrivée)
ingredients: 4 cups fresh cranberries, rinsed, picked over | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, diced
instructions: Combine the pecorino and romano in a bowl.

title: Rosemary Country Rib Eye With a Grape Tomatoes and Raspberry
ingredients: 1 1 rib-eye | 1/2 - 2 tablespoons rosemary or 1/2-2 tablespoons thyme mixed with | 2 tablespoons marmalade | 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved | 1/2 pint raspberries ( optional ) or 1/2 pint cherry tomatoes, halved ( optional )
instructions: Place rosemary, marmalade and grape tomatoes on a rack in the broiler pan, sprinkle with rosemary. Set in broiler for 3 hours at 140 degrees.

title: Persian Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and turmeric, making sure to mix thoroughly. Enjoy your delicious mayo.

title: Roasted Rack of Lamb and Horseradish (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 3 lbs rack of lamb | 1/2 cup horseradish
instructions: Cut racks of lamb crosswise in half. Place the halves skin side up on foil lined 5 x 3 or high racks in the crock pot. Rub horseradish on top of meat. Sprinkle top with more of the horseradish. Place crock pot on high and cook on low for one hour. Turn meat over. Cover crock pot with lid. Turn to high for two hours. After two hours, rotate meat so that all sides are well browned. The last 30 minutes, remove meat, discard foil. Serve with crusty bread and vegetables. My notes, i cut slabs about 1 1/2 1/2 & did not use any of the horseradish, i used the 3/4 cup of horseradish. I thought it was pretty sweet as well, but it came out clean.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,cardamom pod,green bean,breadcrumb,farfalle pasta,red bean overnight
title: Lebanese Bean Patties
ingredients: 250 g farfalle pasta | 250 g canned red beans, drained overnight | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese ( grated ) | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 4 pods cardamom pods | 2 liters boiling water
instructions: Cook farfalle pasta according to packet instructions. Drain and cool under cold water. Rinse beans in lukewarm water. Drain well and place in saucepan with a few tablespoons of cold water. Bring to the boil over a medium high heat. Lower heat to just above simmering and simmer, covered, for 25 minutes or until soft. Drain excess water, then return to the pan and stir in cooked beans. Add the grated cheese, breadcrumbs, black pepper and ground cardamom. Stir to combine and add just enough boiling water bit by bit to thin the mixture. Serve at once with fresh breadcrumbs for coating.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,pork tenderloin,sirloin,dark soy sauce,vodka,dark beer,cake flour
title: Pork Cutlets - Veal
ingredients: 3/4 cup cake flour | 2/3 cup light soy sauce | 1/2 cup dark beer ( preferably pacific lager ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 24 ounces pork tenderloins, cut into 3/4-inch slices | 1 teaspoon marjoram or 1 teaspoon oregano, crushed | 3/4 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 cup vodka
instructions: Mix the flour, 2/3°c soy sauce, beer, dark, 1 tbsps. Vodka and marjoram in a bowl large enough to accommodate pork cutlets. Add pork and marinade.

title: Green Tea (For the Tea)
ingredients: 4 green onions, coarsely chopped ( including tops ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup water ( to cook the green onions in )
instructions: Put green onions, water, and green tea leaves in an ear, or in a large, heavy skillet with tight fitting lid and bring to boil over high heat until the water is reduced by one half. The green tea leaves will be ready when the tea leaves are just beginning to soften. Remove from heat. Allow 1 - 2 minutes for the tea to cool.

Random Ingredients: cream cottage cheese,white wine vinegar,philadelphia cream cheese,tequila,oat,basmati rice
title: Basmati Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked basmati rice | 2 packages philadelphia cream cheese | 1 cup cream-style cottage cheese | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons tequila | 1/4 cup rolled oats
instructions: Place rice in food processor container and process until rice is fine crumbs. Cut cream cheese into chunks and add gradually to rice. Add cottage cheese, vinegar, tequila and oats and combine. Refrigerate several hours to let flavors blend.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,yellow pepper,tomato paste,cumin seed,prosciutto,tart apple,cornflour
title: Fried Apples With Sesame Soy Glaze
ingredients: 2 medium ripe tart apples | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed ( lightly crushed in a mortar & pestle ) | 2 tablespoons mustard oil | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 teaspoons cornflour or 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 thinly sliced prosciutto or 1 thinly sliced ham | 1/4 thinly sliced yellow pepper
instructions: Peel the apples, then slice them in half horizontally into thin slices 1 1/2 inches thick. Place the apples on a sheet of parchment paper, using the tip of your fingernail if you use it, to prevent them from bending up while frying. Place the slices in a single layer on top of each other on a flat tray. Combine 1 tsp sesame oil and the cumin and place in a small bowl. Place mustard oil in a small frying pan and place over a medium heat. When the mustard oil is hot, add the sesame seeds. When the seeds begin to sizzle, add the sesame oil/cumin mixture. When sesame mixture starts to sizzle, add the apples. Turn over if necessary to coat the apples with oil or spices. Remove the apple slices when golden brown all over. The sesame glaze, in a small bowl combine the remaining ingredients. Place the apple slices on a serving platter. Spoon the glaze over them and serve warm with your favourite salad.

Random Ingredients: rum extract,italian salad dressing mix,malt vinegar,rice paper
title: Microwave Beer Free Italian Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 ounce italian salad dressing mix | 1 cup malt vinegar | 1 teaspoon rum extract ( or you could sub brandy if you want ) | 1 package rice paper sheets
instructions: Prepare the beer free italian beef rolls, the paper towels, and 1 tsp of rum extract. Mix together dry salad dressing mix, vinegar, and rum extract. Place beef rolls on the rice paper sheets, and coat each roll with the remaining marinade. Place in a baking dish seam side down. The beer free rolls will be tasty and tender. Note, they should be cooked just right through and moist yet not falling apart. Allow to cool slightly and enjoy.

title: California Guacamole
ingredients: 3 ripe avocados | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts, finely chopped
instructions: Peel avocados and remove pit with a sharp knife. Cut in half. Cut each avocado in half again lengthwise and remove pit. Cut each half into thin slices. Mix mayonnaise, vinegar and water chestnuts. Place avocado slices into a large shallow bowl. Add the mayonnaise mixture and toss to coat evenly. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cold water,beer,marinara sauce,strawberry jam,parmigiano reggiano cheese,shiitake mushroom,dill weed
title: Saucy Mushroom-Honey-Mustard Blini
ingredients: 1 tablespoon paprika, preferably sweet | 2 tablespoons cold water | 8 large shiitake mushrooms, stemmed | 1/4 cup marinara sauce, bottled or prepared ( or homemade ) | 2 tablespoons strawberry jam ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 2 tablespoons romano cheese, coarsely grated | 1 tablespoon whole wheat bagoong mixed dill weed ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon bagoong mixed dill weed ( optional )
instructions: Blend paprika, water and mushrooms in blender, stopping blender several times to scrape down the sides of the bowl. With metal blade running, add marinara and tomato sauce, stopping blender frequently to scrape down side of blender. Add wine and blend, stopping blender several times and scraping through the lid, about 10 seconds. Stir in preserves. Spoon into small serving dish and brush top surface with reserved paprika. Cover with foil and chill several hours, preferably overnight. Transfer to plates and garnish with dill weed.

title: Grilled Feta with Chili-Cilantro Croutons
ingredients: 1 bunch cilantro, roughly chopped | 12 ounces feta, crumbled
instructions: Wash your hands, remove the stalks of cilantro stalks. Roughly chop each stalk and place it in a mortar or mini chopper. Add 1/4 1/3 of the feta to the cilantro. If you want the mixture crumbly, sprinkle on 1/4 1/3 of the feta powder and work it through a large spoon a little more or with your hands. Mix again until you get a nice, gooey consistency. If you have a fancy food processor, pulse 4 times to get a mixture that's the right texture. Divide your croutons among your bowls and fill as desired. If your family pack this like you would a pie, place the rest of the feta in a plastic bag and seal it tightly. Put the bowls on the work surface and set out a dish that is wide enough to accommodate your croutons. Roll and stretch the croutons as you go until they are all crinkleed. You can put a piece of foil in the dish to hold the croutons, to keep them from moving when they are done rolling. Put the dish of croutons on the grill and cook about 4 minutes per side, or until the croutons are crumbly, but a little crisped. Transfer the croutons to a plate lined with paper towels to drain off excess liquid. They may take about 15 minutes for them to get to room temperature before eating, but if you want a thinner, go ahead and let them go straight into the fridge. Cut into quarters when they are ready.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,avocado,cornflour,tomato soup,dijon mustard,green olive brine
title: Guinness guacamole
ingredients: 2 avocados, skin and stone removed, peeled and mashed | 4 tablespoons guinness stout | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 cup guacamole, made with the juice of half a lime | 1 tablespoon green olives in brine, finely chopped
instructions: Combine avocado, guacamon mustard, cornflour and a little water. Mix until blended. Add rest of guacamole, mix everything well. Serve at once with crusty bread.

title: Pesto Pesto
ingredients: 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large ziploc plastic food storage bag. Attach lid, and store at room temperature for up to 1 week, stirring every so often to ensure even heating. To serve, allow to rest for 15 - 20 minutes, then slice into rounds or croutons.

title: Tequila Meatballs (Simmered)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons white sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons yellow tepid tequila | 1 lb ground round | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 tablespoons sugar | pam cooking spray or oil
instructions: In a small dry frypan over medium high heat, toast sesame seeds for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and place in bowl of food processor. Pulse in tequila and process until finely ground. Turn off machine and add half the remaining ingredients, reserving remaining spices. Using your hands, work together the reserved spice mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight, stirring occasionally. Preheat oven to 350°f degrees. On a lightly floured surface, roll 3/4 of the meatball mixture evenly into a 3 inch round. Place on oiled cookie sheets and pat with hands so they are completely coated. Spray with pam cooking spray and top with remaining meatballs. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,worcestershire sauce,poblano chile,kalamata olive,pickle relish,pearl barley,garam masala,iceberg lettuce
title: Poblano Barley Salad (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 32 ounces pearl barley ( i used brown & brown rice ) | 32 ounces frozen poblano chiles, drained | 1/4 cup good quality pickle relish | 1 pinch garam masala | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | iceberg lettuce | shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce and iceberg in pressure cooker. Cover tightly and lock lid. Over high heat, develop steam to desired level of pressure. Release pressure as soon as you think it's achieved. This should be about 2 minutes later. Remove lid and bring up to high pressure. Reduce heat and cook 15 - 20 minutes. Remove lid and allow to cool to room temperature. Stir or stir occasionally until all ingredients are mixed thoroughly and hot and desired texture is achieved. Remove and refrigerate 1 - 2 hours or until chilled. Prior to serving, break apart cooled barley grains so they can be easily separated from each other. Stir, serve immediately, or refrigerate in an airtight container and serve cold. Note, if barley is still hot and still liquid, cook to re warm if any liquid is collected. It will take on a slightly sour flavor like chili dip. This may need an additional hour or two to complete. You may also use leftovers. Just keep in mind, if you have any leftovers the rice will keep indefinitely in the fridge, but the flavour will not be different.

title: Dynamite for Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon anise seed | 4 chicken breasts, cut in half
instructions: Crush anise in a mortar. Rub evenly onto chicken. In a saucepan over medium low heat, heat anise seed.

title: Chef John's Easy Calzone
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, uncooked | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne powder | 1/4 cup pizza dough, or as needed | 1 pinch cayenne powder for garnish
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 11 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Pine Nut Mousse
ingredients: 120 g pine nuts | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Put pine nuts and grand marnier in a food processor and process till they turn into a smooth paste. Add the contents of the food processor to the pine nut paste, blend well, and refrigerate till serving time.

Random Ingredients: white sesame seed,apple juice,chicken broth,dark chocolate chip,snow pea
title: A Simple Microwave Power-On-The-Hold
ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate chips | 2 cups chicken broth | 200 g white sesame seeds | 200 g snow peas | 400 g white sesame seeds
instructions: Coat the outside of a 2 litre microwave safe dish with non stick cooking spray. Place the chocolate and sesame seeds in a bowl and set them aside. Microwave the chicken broth and microwave on high power setting for 5 minutes. Do not remove the lid during the last minute or else the chocolate will crackle. Place the microwave safe dish with the chocolate mixture into the microwave and cook on high for 3 minutes or the microwave has stopped and the chocolate and sesame mixture will be hot. Remove and stir from the microwave. Place the snow peas on the microwave with sesame seeds, stir and cover with the microwave lid. Cook in the microwave for 25 minutes remove, stir, replace the microwave lid and cook for a further 2 minutes or finish the cooking in the microwave and serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: white potato,brown lentil,onion powder,sumac,carnation milk,vegetable broth,yogurt
title: Lebanese Potato Lentil Soup
ingredients: 3 cups dry white potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 cup dried brown lentils | 7 1/2 cups vegetable broth, such as swanson | 1 tablespoon light brown lentils ( i prefer yellow yellow ) | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder ( i'm not a big feresh seasonning blend ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried sumac, or more to taste | 1 container low-fat sour cream or ( 8 ounce ) container low-fat sour cream, for topping ( neera )
instructions: Heat potatoes in broth in a 4 quart pot over low heat, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender but still firm, about 20 minutes. Add lentils and next 6 ingredients. Increase heat to medium low and cook until soup thickens slightly, about 10 minutes. Serve topped with sour cream.

title: Cottage Cheese Burgers
ingredients: 200 g cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon green | 1/2 teaspoon dried summer savory | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon ground sirloin
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl and mix well. Chill for at least 20 minutes before using. Shape into 4 burgers. Serve on toasted baggies with salads.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,bread machine acting active yeast,raspberry
title: Peanut and Raspberry Sandwich Apparatizers
ingredients: 1 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/8 teaspoon bread machine quick-acting active dry yeast | 1/4 cup seedless raspberry jam or 1/4 cup seedless raspberry jam | 3 cups assorted fresh fruit
instructions: Stir together peanut butter, yeast, and jam. Press dough into well greased jelly roll pan or baking sheet. Spread warm dough evenly. Cover and let rise until doubled in size, about 1 hour. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Cool slightly. Cut into 24 slices, and set aside to cool completely. Spread with preserves.

title: Burgundy Beef for the BBQ
ingredients: 500 g minced beef | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 2 tablespoons gravy or 2 tablespoons beef stock | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 4 tablespoons vanilla essence
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a bowl and beat thoroughly, making sure the mixture is well combined so that all the meat is coated in the liquid. Cover the meat with cling film and leave to marinate in the fridge for at least one hour. Pour excess marinade into a pan, add the meat and gently stir to bring the meat and sauce together, cook for 10 - 15 minutes, turning the meat over after 5 minutes, if necessary. Serve with boiled potatoes or grilled fish.

title: Philly Cheese Candy
ingredients: 1 package rice paper sheets | 1 can fish | 1/2 cup corn syrup, or to taste | 1 vanilla bean | 1/2 cup shredded smoked gouda cheese
instructions: Fill a saucepan with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rice paper, and return to a boil. Cook the rice paper pieces for about 5 minutes, until the rice is softened, but not yet limp. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Coat one side of each sheet with the corn syrup. Flip the sheets in the heated water, and allow the sheets to sit until cool. Fill a microwave safe bowl with water, and place 3 sheets of cheese in the water. Cover, and cook on high for 1 minute. Carefully remove the cheese sheets with a spatula, and set aside until cooled to room temperature. Place one fried cheese sheet in front of you on each plate, and place 2 teaspoons of rice on top.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,onion soup mix,cheddar cheese,marsala wine,black bean sauce,sirloin tip roast,malt vinegar,ginger paste
title: Beef Tips with Mushrooms and Onion Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped onion ( or to taste ) | 1 can shiitake mushrooms ( or use dried and reconstituted canned mushrooms ) | 1 tablespoon ginger paste or 1 tablespoon ginger powder ( optional ) | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 2 tablespoons dried onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon dried shiitake mushroom, soaked ( available at asian specialty food stores ) | 1 can black bean sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and marinate 8 hours or overnight. Remove beef from marinade, reserve marinade and grill or brown beef, drain. Add 1/4 cup mushroom liquid to marinade and simmer 30 minutes, remove beef. Stir in bean sauce and simmer 2 minutes, add cheese and vinegar.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,thyme leaf,filling,mustard seed,cheddar cheese,mushroom soup,napa cabbage
title: Spicy Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 4 lbs beef roast, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup prepared mushroom soup, warmed | 1 package napa cabbage, sliced | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | 2 packages shredded cheddar cheese | filling, recipe to complete
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Fig Preserve
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh figs, cut 1/2-inch-thick | 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar | 3 large oranges | 1 large bay leaf
instructions: Place figs, sugar and orange peel in mortar. Pound to a paste. Add bay leaf and add enough cold water to dissolve sugar. Allow figs to stand for 5 minutes. Force paste through sieve and reserve. Pour figs juice and orange peel into preserving mason jars and close jars. Chill for 3 days before using, up to 1 month before using.

title: Mustard Seeds Oven Spice Mixture
ingredients: 1/4 cup mustard seeds | 1 cup light cornflour | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds
instructions: Mix together all the dry ingredients. Pour into baking sheet with a star shaped lid and mix gently with spoon. Place in preheated oven for 20 mins or 180 degrees celcius.

title: Spicy Noodle Salad
ingredients: 13 ounces cooked egg noodles | 3 cups watermelon, cubed and cubed | 2 teaspoons moroccan mixed spice | 5 tablespoons red curry paste ( or to your taste ) | 2 tablespoons smoked paprika ( or to your taste )
instructions: In a big bowl, add all ingredients except paprika & paprika. Stir to mix and set aside for at least an hour for flavors to blend. Season to taste & serve.

title: Honey Glazed Seared Scallops
ingredients: 2 lbs scallops | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 dash turbinado sugar ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons creamed horseradish ( optional ) | 400 g cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Lay scallops on a plate and drizzle honey over it. Sprinkle turbinado sugar and horseradish if using.

Random Ingredients: mango powder,tomato puree,bean sprout,polenta,fine breadcrumb,fettuccine pasta,pineapple chunk
title: Tropical Fettuccini With Mangoes (Cokuka Kai Ramen)
ingredients: 1 package fettuccine pasta | 1 cup mushroom mix, canned | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 3 tablespoons mango powder | 1/4 tomato puree | 1/2 cup pomodor prepared instant hot bean sprouts
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add instant ramen noodles, and stir in with a fork. While the noodles simmer, in a large bowl combine all the ingredients except pomodor. Mix well, and set aside. Drain the cooked noodles through a fine mesh strainer, and stir in the mango powder. Pour mixture into the prepared rice bowl, stir well, and put the bowl in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Stir before serving.

title: Beef Rolls with Peaches and Pearl Onions
ingredients: 750 g filet mignon steaks or 750 g prime rib steaks | 750 g russet potatoes, scrubbed | 500 g peach wedges | 2 tablespoons lard, heated
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Tear off 6 6cm lengths of foil, each about 5cm thick. Place on a shallow tray. Place the steaks between sheets of waxed paper and pound with a meat pounder to a thickness of about 5cm. Cut each steak into 8 equal pieces. Cut a slit down each side of each steak. Reserve the marinade for basting. Place onto a baking sheet and bake for 35 minutes. To serve, place potato wedges and 1 potato wedge on each steak.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,beef stew meat,hard egg,brussels sprout,active yeast
title: Brussels Sprouts & Beef
ingredients: 4 - 5 cups cooked brussels sprouts | 3 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 2 packages active dry yeast | 12 garlic cloves, thinly sliced | hard-boiled egg, garnish ( to garnish )
instructions: Drain brussels sprouts well and spread to about 1/2 inch of the depth of your pan. Place about 4 cups of the beef and 3 cups of the beans in a single layer on top of the brussels sprouts. Sprinkle the yeast over. Add about 3/4 cup of water and sprinkle them with some of the garlic cloves. Cover tightly and leave in a warm place. Heat 3 cups of water and the remaining water to about 130 f in a dutch oven, or a large electric slow cooker. Cook until sprouts are fork tender, about 15 minutes, or until the brussels sprouts are tender. While sprouts are cooking, remove the meat cubes from their containers and place in a large bowl. When you are ready to serve, drain the brussels sprouts, and toss with some of the garlic slices and the remaining onion slices. Spread evenly over the top of the meat mixture. Sprinkle with enough of the remaining garlic cloves to completely cover the other layers. Spread the remaining garlic, onion and garlic slices over all. Dot the brussels sprouts with the hard boiled eggs on top. Dot with the remaining hard boiled eggs. Serve immediately.

title: Cumin Stuffed Pears (Peppers) With Swiss Chard and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1 ripe pear, halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons rawspicebar's aged cumin ( or 2 tsp. smoked paprika ) | 2 teaspoons tarragon ( or 1 tsp. dried thyme ) | 1/4 teaspoon savory | 12 -16 ounces fresh goat cheese or 12 -16 ounces farmer's cheese ( 4 1/2 oz. crumbled ) | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 ounce roasted peanuts or 1 ounce cashews
instructions: Peel pears and cut off pith. Cut 2 of the pear halves lengthwise into 1/4 inch half moons, removing core and membrane.. Preheat broiler and position rack in center of oven. Broil pears, skin side down, on rimmed baking sheet. Remove pears, but don't remove skins or the stem. Cover and leave pears upright. Repeat with remaining pears. Blend goat cheese, cocoa, pepper oil, and herbs in a large bowl. Stuff pears with mixture. Sprinkle each pears with peanuts and bake until pears are bubbly and cheese is beginning to melt, about 25 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,apricot,cottage cheese,anchovy,tabasco sauce,orange peel,thai red curry paste
title: Arancini & Coconut Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1 anchovy, small can | 1 teaspoon fresh orange peel, finely slivered | 1 -2 tablespoon dried apricot, chopped coarsely | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | tabasco sauce
instructions: Boil 1 cup of the arborio with 1/2 cup of water. Add anchovy, orange peel and apricot. Simmer until rice is cooked. Keep warm, covered. Keep hot. Heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in a pan for a few seconds. Serve warm with a sprinkling of tobasco, a dash of green onions, or sliced cucumbers on top.

Random Ingredients: hash brown potato,portobello mushroom,xanthan gum,chicken breast

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine the spice mix and mix well. Brush the chicken breasts with this mix, place them in a baking pan and bake for 15 minutes or until done to your liking. Brush the chicken breast with more of the spice mix and place back in the oven to bake for another 5 minutes or until brown, serve.

title: Mexican White Pizza With Broccoli
ingredients: 2 lbs broccoli ( steamed for about 7 10 minutes ) | 1/2 cup fresh thyme leaves ( or 1 1/2 tsp. dried ) | 3/4 cup green chili pepper ( diced ) | 2 teaspoons salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons yeast | 1 1/2 lbs cod ( cut into 3 pieces )
instructions: Set oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper or parchment paper. Place broccoli, thyme, green chilies, salt, seasoned salt in large bowl and toss gently. Rinse and dry the yeast in a large bowl. Add the yeast mixture to the broccoli in the bowl and toss to coat evenly. Let sit at room temperature 1 hour. Remove the broccoli and thyme stems from the bowl. Place the cod on the baking sheet and bake for 10 - 12 minutes. Reduce heat to 425°f, and bake for 15 more minutes till flaky and brown.

Random Ingredients: pecan,italian seasoning,white peppercorn,white onion,lime wedge,kernel corn

ingredients: 3 cups white corn, fresh picked from cob ( see note ) | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped ( see note ) | 1/4 cup white onion, minced | 1/4 cup italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons black peppercorns, whole pitted | 6 lime wedges
instructions: In a blender, combine corn, prunes, onion, and italian seasoning. Puree until smooth, about 1 minute. Stir in black pepper. Divide relish among four serving glasses. Garnish with fresh orange slices. This relish may also be prepared to this stage and saved for later use..

Random Ingredients: wood chip,white vinegar,hot salsa,hot red chili pepper,pear,italian seasoning
title: Peppers Tapas
ingredients: 12 wood chips | 1 cup hot salsa | 1 lb pear, peeled and finely diced | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons hot red chili peppers, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place wood chips on baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and drain off any liquid or oil from the wood chips. Mix the salsa, pear, vinegar and seasonings in a small bowl. Stir in pepper to taste. Spoon mixture evenly over the soaked chips and bake 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken part,coconut milk,jalapeno pepper,golden caster sugar,yellow mustard seed,tea,dijon mustard,white onion

ingredients: 2 tablespoons yellow mustard seeds | 4 tablespoons coconut milk | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/4 cup golden caster sugar | 1 white onion, finely diced | 2 lbs chicken parts, skin on | 1/2 jalapeno pepper, deseeded and finely diced | 1/2 cup brewed tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f put mustard seeds in a small frying pan and cook in a single layer for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Place coconut milk, dijon mustard, sugar, onion, chicken and pepper into a large ovenproof dish or roasting tin. Cover and bake for 45 minutes. Remove chicken from the oven and stir to combine. Return the chicken pieces to the oven for 25 minutes or until cooked & golden brown. Serve with boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: glutinous rice,beef,stir fry vegetable,poblano chile,tamari,coriander powder
title: Tasty Beef and Vegetables

instructions: Set a steamer rack in a large baking pan filled with water over medium high heat and bring to a boil. In a large bowl, toss beef with tamari and coriander and add to the bowl.

instructions: In large skillet over medium heat, sauté ground chuck until no longer pink.
