Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,garlic salt,italian salad dressing mix,taco sauce
title: Taco Bell Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 packet italian salad dressing mix | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 -3 tablespoons taco sauce | 2 -3 slices green chili peppers
instructions: Mix all ingredients with wire wisk. Pour over hot, fresh veggies, such as cucumbers, tomatoes and grated cheese in a bowl. Allow to air dry before serving.

title: Country Flank Steak Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef flank steak | 2 tablespoons dried basil | 1 tablespoon dried cilantro leaves | 2 unbaked pie shells | 15 ounces frozen blueberries | 2 russet potatoes, thinly sliced 1/4-inch thick | ice | 12 basil sprigs, to garnish
instructions: Combine beef, 1 tablespoon basil, and 1 tablespoon dried cilantro leaves in a large bowl. Place remaining basil, dried cilantro leaves and 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil until liquid is reduced by half, about 2 minutes. Pour beef mixture over potatoes, cover and simmer until liquid thickens slightly and potatoes are tender, 10 minutes to 1 hour. Spoon potatoes into pastry shells and top with beef, blueberries, and remaining basil. Garnish with additional basil sprigs and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,sea scallop,parsley,turnip,white wine vinegar,vegetable,orange zest
title: Spanish Scallops in a Pink and Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb sea scallops or 1 lb sea scallops, 1/2 inch thick | 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup tomato juice | 1 teaspoon orange zest, finely grated | 2 teaspoons parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 2 medium turnips, cut into large chunks
instructions: Place scallops, vinegar, tomato juice, orange zest, parsley, turnips into a 3 quart heavy bottomed saucepan. Scrape any rough bits from the bottom with a fork. Turn pan into a preheated 350°f oven over a medium heat. Cook just until scallops turn opaque, about 5 minutes. Transfer scallops to a serving platter and pour the sauce over the scallops.

Random Ingredients: chilies,vanilla pudding,vanilla sugar,kaffir lime leaf,chestnut mushroom,cardamom
title: Sweet Chilli Powder
ingredients: 1/4 cup chestnut mushrooms ( soaked in boiling water for 10 minutes, strain ) | 1/2 cup dried chilies ( soaked in boiling water for 10 minutes, drain ) | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1 box vanilla instant pudding | vanilla sugar, for dusting cookies.
instructions: For a spiced chilli powder, soak dried chillies in warm water for an hour or two before using. For the jelly, in a pot heat 1/4 cup water and cook one cup of cooked dried chillies until they become crispy. Place the water over low heat and simmer until reduced by half. Add the chilies. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Blend chestnut mushroom pieces with 1/4 cup water until very smooth. You can puree the chestnut mushroom paste in mini food processor. Blend with the cooled chestnut mushroom paste and 1/4 cup water. Add vanilla sugar, 1 tsp kaffir lime leaf and cardamom. Pour over a small serving tray of a cool, dark serving tray, drizzle with vanilla sugar and garnish with a few kaffir lime leaves.

Random Ingredients: wasabi paste,greek seasoning,artichoke heart,blueberry,fine sea salt,lemon zest,cauliflower
title: Blueberry Artichoke and Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cauliflower, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup fresh blueberries | 3/4 cup artichoke heart, drained and quartered | 1/4 cup fine sea salt | 3 -4 tablespoons wasabi paste | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon zest, minced | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: In medium bowl, combine cauliflower, berries, and artichoke hearts. Add salt and wasabi paste and stir to blend. Top with lemon zest and sprinkle with greek seasoning. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,coleslaw mix cabbage carrot,onion soup mix,rice noodle,garam masala
title: Indian Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 packages dry coleslaw mix | 2 small onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 tablespoons dry rice noodles, or as needed | 1 cup curd cottage cheese, or as needed
instructions: Combine coleslaw mix, onion soup mix, garam masala, and rice noodles in a large resealable bag. Pour enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,part ricotta cheese,hot capicola,kosher salt,wheat bread,grain white rice
title: Italian Pepper Poppy Seed Brown Bread Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1/4 cup chopped hot capicola | kosher salt, divided | 6 ounces whole wheat bread, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch pieces | 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 cup hot cooked white rice ( preferably short grain white rice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Toast poppy seeds in oven until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bag. Warm capicola oil in a large skillet over medium heat until smoking, about 1 minute. Stir in rice. Cook rice until fragrant, about 1 minute. Transfer rice to a bowl. Gently stir in roasted poppy seeds and about 1 heaping teaspoon kosher salt. Add bread pieces to bread and stir to coat. Spread bread with ricotta cheese until well coated, then spread bread with capicola and remaining salt. Place bread on prepared baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until bread is lightly browned and cheese is melted, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Prosciutto in Salt Pork Roll - Prosciutto Di Limone
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salt pork | 12 slices prosciutto | 1 cup crushed ice
instructions: Rinse the salt pork thoroughly under running water. Drain and blot dry. Place one slice of prosciutto on each of 24 paper towels, shiny side down. Rub one side of each piece of salt pork lightly along with the prosciutto. Wrap one slice of salt pork around each slice and fasten with toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,herb stuffing mix,chicken bouillon,black bean,self raising flour,sharp cheddar cheese,turmeric powder
title: Delicious Black Bean Casserole
ingredients: 500 g self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon good mixed herbs stuffing mix | 2 teaspoons ground turmeric powder | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 250 g black beans, drained | 300 ml beef stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius grease a large shallow ovenproof dish or casserole dish. Sift flour and seasoning and set aside. Finely grate cheese in a bowl with mixed herbs using a fork. Combine crushed garlic, cheddar, bouillon and black beans in a large pan with beef stock and bring to boil. Add cheese mixture to flour mixture and stir until combined. Place mixture into prepared dish and bake on the middle shelf of the oven for about 40 - 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Veggie and Herb Biscuits (Cookies)
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 1 cup corn | 14 ounces mushrooms, drained ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Place potatoes in microwave, cover and microwave on high 4 - 7 minutes until almost cooked through. Do not overcook. Let stand for 10 minutes if potato becomes difficult. Drain. Cut potatoes lengthwise into 1/8's. Then cut each in half lengthwise. Lay out on paper towels and let dry on paper towels for 20 minutes. Chop cilantro leaves in food processor and place in a large bowl. Add corn, mushrooms, baking soda and liquid smoke. Blend until well blended. Scatter about 1/4 of the crumbled potatoes around the rim of a greased baking sheet and level with a spatula. Scatter about 1/4 of the cilantro leaves over the potatoes. Repeat layers twice, pressing down on crated potatoes to spread evenly. Sprinkle with remaining crumbled potatoes, cilantro leaves and a little more cilantro if desired. Bake in a preheated 400°f oven for 20 minutes until crumbed and golden brown.

title: Macaroni With Raspberry and Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup macaroni, dry | 1/2 - 1 cup light cream or 1/2-1 cup light cream | 1/4 teaspoon salt ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon peanut oil ( or olive oil ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract ( optional ) | 1 package fresh raspberries or 1 package frozen raspberries | parmesan cheese, freshly grated ( optional )
instructions: Boil large pot of water until noodles are cooked al dente. Meanwhile, saute macaroni until al dente. Reserve 2/3 of the noodles cooking water. Drain well and set aside in a large bowl. When done draining, reserve about 2/3 of the noodles water, then mix in the rest of the ingredients except raspberries and reserved liquid.. Reserve the rest of the liquid. If desired, toss macaroni with some of the mixture. Serve remaining macaroni for topping, but do not drain. Garnish with raspberries.

title: Green Chilies Stuffed Onions
ingredients: 4 ripe green chilies, washed, ends trimmed, slit lengthwise | 1 tablespoon coriander leaves | 1 tablespoon lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lemon, zest of
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Cut a slit into each onion and stuff the filling into them. Serve with indian flatbreads or breads.

Random Ingredients: turnip,chuck,irish cream,green cardamom pod,bacon dripping,baby bok choy
title: Irish Oven Beef and Turnips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fat or 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 500 g chuck, sliced thinly | 3 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 turnip, sliced thinly | 6 baby bok choy, cut into 2cm lengths | 1/4 cup irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. In a dutch oven, heat the fat or oil. Add beef and fry over high heat for 5 minutes, turning occasionally. Add chopped cardamom and cook for one minute. Add turnip and bok shoy and cook for 1 minute. Transfer to a baking dish and pour liquid into the pan. Cover and bake, basting every 30 minutes, for 1 hour or until beef is tender and vegetables are crisp.

title: Mussels Veal #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes shreds & reg ; shredded hash browns | 32 large cleaned mussels | 2 packages taco seasoning | 10 black mustard seeds
instructions: Heat grill to medium. Place all of the ingredients in a dutch oven, or a large pot. Stir well. Let warm up for 15 minutes. Open mussels, and check for shellfish and shrimp to be sure they are in shell on all sides. Fill each opening with stuffing for shellfish, or with any other desired meat. Serve with a nice crusty bread and crackers.

title: Easy Chicken & Pasta Soup
ingredients: 1/2 bag bow tie pasta | 1 chicken tenders
instructions: Cook pasta following packaged directions on package. Cut tenders into 1/2 inch slices. Drain pasta & chicken tenders and toss with hot cooked pasta. Serve hot.

title: Easy Toasted Bread With Apples
ingredients: 10 slices of firm white bread, crusts removed | 4 tablespoons fish sauce, for frying the bread | 2 tart apples | 1 cup double cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Brush a baking tray with butter or spray with oil or spray with oil. Place bread on the baking tray, spread with fish sauce, then slice apples into thin thin wedges. Spoon apple wedges into one side of the bread and apple wedges into the other, top with cream. Bake at 300f for 30 minutes or until bread is toasted. Serve warm with soy sauce and ginger if desired.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,dark sesame oil,wheat flour,mint leaf,stewing beef,panko breadcrumb
title: Beef Stew With Potatoes and Herbs (Koshary)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 550 g stewing beef, diced | 1 1/2 tablespoons wheat flour | 1 1/4 cups panko breadcrumbs ( japanese breadcrumbs ) | 4 teaspoons fresh mint leaves, finely chopped | 1 1/3 cups mint leaves, torn | 4 large yukon gold potatoes or 4 large red potatoes, cut into 2. 5cm cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/fan 170c/gas 2 heat oil in a large, high sided ovenproof dish in the oven. Cook beef in oil, stirring, until browned all over. Place flour, panko, mint and mint. Gently fold through beef. Bring to the boil, reduce heat, cover and cook for 1 1/2 1 - 3 hours until thick. Stirring occasionally. Serve with potatoes.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,english cucumber,irish whiskey,lamb shoulder,celery,artichoke heart,beet,paprika
title: Lamb Shank
ingredients: 1 english cucumber | 1 large beet | 2 1/2 pounds lamb shoulder | 1 cup irish whiskey | 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 3/4 cup light distilled white sugar | 1/4 cup sweet paprika | 2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Cut away the bitter outer leaves from the beet and cook them until tender, 2 to 3 minutes in a steamer set over boiling water. Set aside and allow to cool. Trim excess fat from lamb and cut it into 2 inch cubes. Place pork into a dutch oven. Add the sliced beet, beet hearts, sugar, paprika, and salt. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Steak and Potato in Anchovy Chutney
ingredients: 2 potatoes, peeled and sliced | 1 can anchovies, drained | 1 red chile, finely chopped | 20 drops red food coloring | 1 lb flank steak
instructions: In medium bowl, mix together potatoes, anchovies, chili, and food coloring until evenly blended. Spread potato mixture on steak.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,beer,poultry seasoning,saffron,celery salt,soy sauce,rice,coffee
title: Tasty Pikelets
ingredients: 12 ounces self-raising flour | 1 pinch saffron | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 1/2 cups strong hot coffee | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon rice | 1 pinch celery salt | 7 1/2 fluid oz beer
instructions: Using an electric mixture whisk, add the flour, saffron and poultry seasoning. Mix well with a wooden spoon. Add the coffee, soy sauce, rice and celery salt. Mix well. Place teaspoonfuls of mixture onto ungreased tray. Use wet spoon to shape into cakes about ¼ inch thick, or use your favourite biscuit or biscuit cutter. Brush with the milk or water. Grill or pan fry over medium heat until golden. Serve hot with drinks or cream.

title: Herby and Bok Choy (Cachie) on Skewers
ingredients: 1 bunch bok choy, cleaned and trimmed | 1/4 cup mixed fresh herbs, such as chives, mint, and or tarragon
instructions: Remove the white layer of green leaves on stalks of bok choy. Cut stems off leaves and discard. Slice leaves vertically into 1 inch segments, then cut into 1 inch lengths on the diagonal. Remove and discard woody leaves. Mix all the ingredients of the marinade together in a blender or food processor until completely blended. If left unattended, place the lid on the blender and pour contents into a large resealable plastic bag containing a 1/4 to 1/2 inch high tip. Put the bag in the refrigerator to marinate for at least 3 to 4 hours and overnight. If using wooden skewers, thread the ingredients onto the soaked skewers. Cover with cellophane and cool for at least 1 hour or overnight. Cooks tip, use wooden skewers with the ends cut off at the joint.

Random Ingredients: green salsa,cod fish fillet,basmati rice,garlic,spice,cream mushroom soup
title: Crazy Easy Baked Cod (No Fish Coating)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon spice | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 2 tablespoons sour cream ( you can use plain yogurt if you use it ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 1 cup green salsa ( sweet )
instructions: Preheat oven to mix everything but the rice together well. Pour mixture into greased 9x13 inch baking dish and spread out evenly. Sprinkle with rice. Bake 35 minutes, or until rice is a bit browned on top. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,white rice,egg,sage leaf,per serving,cream chicken soup
title: Zucchini Rice With Sour Cream
ingredients: 8 ounces zucchini, diced | 1/2 cup sour cream ( regular or low in fat ) | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 3 eggs | 1/2 cup white rice, uncooked | 1 tablespoon dried sage leaves ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon thyme leaves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. In a greased casserole dish, combine the zucchini with enough water to cover. Add salt and pepper. Combine the sour cream with the cream of chicken soup and set aside in a saucepan. In a mixing bowl, beat the eggs, rice, sage and sour cream mixture. Pour over the zucchini mixture, and sprinkle with sage. Bake uncovered for 1 hour, then turn heat down to 350 and bake for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven, and let sit 10 minutes before serving.

title: Greek-Inspired Rigatoni-Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 cup pumpkin puree | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, pitted and chopped ( greek's preferred ) | 1/3 cup hazelnuts, toasted and chopped ( about 2 ounces ) | 1 pinch clove | 1 pinch dried sage | 12 ounces lean ground chuck | 1 lb ziti pasta, cooked and drained, reserving 1/2 cup liquid | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts, toasted
instructions: Cook rigatoni per package directions, except for al dente. Drain noodles and reserve 1/2 cup pasta liquid. Reserve the cooking water. Bring reserved cooking water to a boil in a large saucepan. Add pumpkin, olives, hazelnuts, garlic cloves, dried sage, and ground chuck. Cook, stirring, over medium high heat until meat is no longer pink, about 10 minutes. When meat mixture is browned, add sauce of choice. Stir until thickened slightly and flavors combine, about 2 minutes. Add 1/2 cup pasta liquid.

title: Curried Pita Bread
ingredients: 2 cans sweet white and blue-and-colby sliced whole wheat pita bread, chilled | 1/2 cup currants | 1/2 cup egg bread, cubed | 2 teaspoons flour | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Cut pita breads crosswise into six equal pieces. Arrange the bread, cut side down, on prepared baking sheet. Bake until pita breads are slightly golden, about 5 minutes. Turn bread over. Bake until golden, about 8 minutes more. Set up a serving platter. Add currants to each piece of bread, then season with salt and pepper. Serve with egg slices and a sprinkling of cayenne if desired.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,snow pea,cooking spray,tamari,chevre cheese,mackerel better,lamb
title: Baked Mac and Goat Cheese Lamb
ingredients: cooking spray | 400 g kefalograviera cheese or 400 g goat cheese | 2 tablespoons tamari | 100 g snow peas, trimmed | 250 g cooked small lamb or 250 g halibut fillets | 1 chili pepper, roasted, deseeded and chopped | 200 g goat stew meat ( see note ) or 200 g smoked lebkettle, sliced
instructions: Note, the goat meat can be bought pre-made. Cook lamb to desired degree of doneness. Cut into strips and place in a casserole dish. Cut cheese and shreaded lebkettle well and sprinkle over lamb before arranging on top. Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Spray 2 pieces of baking paper with cooking oil. Place 1 layer of noodles on paper and press them into the paper. Press cheese into the paper. Spread tamari across top of lamb and then sprinkle with snow peas, and repeat process until everything is used up. Top with the rest of the noodles and sprinkle with chilli. Bake uncovered 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: tapioca,french lentil,lime zest,feta cheese,chili oil,rump roast
title: Dee's Beef and Lentil Skewers
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs rump roast | 1 package french lentils | 1 tablespoon tapioca | 1 lime, zest of, grated and juiced | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili oil ( can be adjusted with more or less per taste, according to your preference ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese ( optional )
instructions: Put lamb or turkey in a 9 x 13 inch pan or casserole or baking dish. Add olive oil and set aside. If using the crockpot, put ingredients in your crockpot on high. If using casserole dish, pour tapioca all over lamb and then add a few tablespoons of lemon juice. If using dish, add beef and lentils to skillet. Turn on the oven to 375 degrees and roast lamb to a nice medium crispy brown color. Serve with feta if desired.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,chili powder,turmeric powder,golden raisin,tarragon,white vermouth,molasses,asparagus
title: Mexican-Style Asparagus Spears and Raisins
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus ( the long-cut variety ) | 2 tablespoons dry white vermouth | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon or 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 jar golden raisins
instructions: Steam the asparagus, covered, over boiling water about 3 minutes. Drain. Place asparagus, vermouth, salt, turmeric, tarragon, garlic, chili powder and molasses in a skillet that canning jars. Heat to boiling. Cover.

title: Danish (Yeast Freezer)
ingredients: 450 g pork belly | mustard ( to taste )
instructions: To cut the fat from the membrane, you should scrape off and discard the membrane as much as possible. This way, you can have more moisture and less fat. Slice the fat diagonally into 1/2 inch wide slices. Arrange 1 slice of membrane in the middle of a piece of bread and lightly toast. Spread mustard on remaining slice of bread and lightly slash the membrane all over with a knife. Leave to stand for two hours before eating.

title: Southern Style Dip
ingredients: 20 cubes processed tomatoes with green chile peppers, or as desired | 10 pieces pickle slices ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the processed tomatoes with green chile peppers, and return to a boil. Cook the tomatoes uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the outsides of the processed tomatoes have cooked through, but are still slightly chunky and slightly chunky, about 12 minutes. Drain well before removing the processed tomatoes. Return processed tomatoes to the processed tomatoes. Drizzle processed tomatoes with pickle slices, and return to a low heat. Continue dipping processed tomatoes until they have chilled and become hot, about 10 minutes.

title: Pepper Steamed Baby Spinach
ingredients: 16 cups fresh baby spinach | 4 eggs, lightly beaten, room temperature | 1 cup canola oil | 3 medium red bell peppers | 2 tablespoons grand marnier, divided
instructions: Coat a large skillet with non stick cooking spray. Pour 3/4 cup of oil into the skillet. Heat to medium high and swirl to coat skillet evenly. Add the sliced red pepper and cook for 3 minutes, or until tender crisp. Add the remaining tablespoon of grand marnier and remaining 1/8 teaspoon of salt. Set aside and keep warm. Slice the steaks in half horizontally. Place the steaks and red pepper on a cutting board and add a few drops of water. Using a sharp knife, carefully remove the center portion of the pepper slices.

title: Cilantro and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb waxy potato ( yuca mirliton ) | 2 cups coarsely chopped cilantro leaves | 1 -2 tablespoon cooking spray | 1 tablespoon snipped cilantro leaf, for garnish | 2 tablespoons olive, for garnish
instructions: Wash and peel potatoes. Cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Set potatoes aside. In a medium bowl, combine cilantro, olive and vinegar. Add potatoes and combine to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours, turning over just once. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until potatoes are just tender.. Sprinkle with some green onions, if desired, and serve.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,green tomato,pizza dough,spanish peanut,port wine,cardamom seed,oyster
title: Grilled Oysters on 100% Calzone
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cheese-free port wine, such as cheddar, or cheese havarti | 12 tablespoons salad oil, such as grapeseed oil or 12 tablespoons canola oil | 1 can refrigerated pizza dough | 2 teaspoons cracked cardamom seeds or 2 teaspoons crushed cardamom seed, for garnish | 5 small green tomatoes, cut into 1/4-inch wedges ( optional ) | 1 1/2 dozen raw oysters, shucked, or as needed | 8 spanish-style dried unsalted peanuts
instructions: Combine port and 12 tablespoons oil in a bowl or small measuring cup.

Random Ingredients: white button mushroom,cranberry,marinara sauce,tofu,baking potato,brown rice,currant
title: Cranberry Mushroom Baked Potato Wedges With Tofu
ingredients: 2 cups firm tofu, cubed | 1/2 cup dried currant | 1 1/2 cups white button mushrooms, sliced thin | 1/4 cup dried marinara sauce or 1/4 cup kraft italian salad dressing | 1 cup cooked brown rice | 1 1/2 cups peeled baking potatoes | 1 small baking potato
instructions: In a heavy baking pan, place the tofu cubes, currants, mushrooms, spaghetti sauce and cooked brown rice on top. Mix together and top with the baking potato. Bake in a 425f oven for 30 minutes or until lightly browned and potato is tender. Serve with kraft asian dressing, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cracker crumb,kielbasa,zucchini,chili pepper,pork chop,puff pastry,beef chuck
title: Lazy Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 lb lean pork chop, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb fresh kielbasa, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 medium zucchini, cut into 12-inch slices | 4 puff pastry sheets | 1/2 lb deli-style smoked lean pork loin or 1/2 lb thinly sliced cooked ham | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper | 1/3 cup cracker crumb
instructions: Lightly and lightly coat a large, non stick skillet with cooking spray. Add pork.

title: Beef Steak in Wine and Marsala Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry marsala wine, divided | 2 tablespoons minced beef top sirloin | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Prepare a medium sieve by pouring in a fine mesh sieve the 1/4 cup wine into a medium bowl. Add the minced beef, white pepper and oyster sauce. Mix lightly with a fork. Place the beef, in one layer, in the bowl and cover completely with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to soften the meat. Prepare an ice cold, dry or steamer with 3 cups of boiling water and 1 tsp of salt and bring to a boil. Place the steamer over just enough water to cover the bottom of the steamer. When the water comes to a boil, cover the steamer with the cover, and steam the beef, using the 1/4 cup wine, 1 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp sugar in small individual serving bowls, for 10 minutes. Slice the steak and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,pork chop,alfredo sauce,tart apple,fenugreek leaf
title: Apple Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 lb pork chop, cutlets about 3/4 inch thick | 8 ounces alfredo sauce | 1/4 cup chopped fenugreek leaves | 1 1/2 cups tart apples, diced | 2 tablespoons yellow cooking wine vinegar
instructions: Combine ingredients except pork chops. Add pork chops and coat with mixture. Marinade at least 2 hours in refrigerator, turning several times. Grill over indirect heat. Do not allow to overcook. Serve over pasta or rice.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,ginger paste,lamb shoulder,fine breadcrumb,parsley leaf,eggplant,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Baked Eggplant (Aubergine) Lamb
ingredients: 1 lb eggplant | 1 lb boneless lamb shoulder, thinly sliced ( i use a leaner lamb shoulder ) | 2 slices fresh ginger paste ( approx 1-2 inches long ) | 8 medium firm fresh parsley leaves, stemmed, chopped | 2/3 cup smooth peanut butter | 3 ounces fine dry breadcrumbs | 3 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f and lightly oil or butter a 5 to 6 quart baking dish. Slice the eggplant in half lengthwise and gently tap out the bitterness. Slice the length into 1/8 thick slices about 1/4 thick. Slice the meat in half crosswise and place in the center of a large piece of parchment or waxed paper. Sprinkle with ginger paste, lay parsley leaves over meat and then scatter slices of ginger evenly over meat. Turn meat edges over and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Spread peanut butter over bread crumbs. Pour the eggplant evenly over the top and sprinkle again with bread crumbs. Press bread crumbs into meat so that eggplant sticks and crawls to the top. Cover tightly with foil and bake until heated through and meat is beginning to brown, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Remove foil, sprinkle with cheese and bake until bread crumbs are browned and bubbly. Cut into wedges and serve hot or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,green zucchini,water chestnut,green bean,breadcrumb,serrano chilies
title: Zucchini and Bean Patties
ingredients: 4 green zucchini, trimmed, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 cans sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 jar green beans, drained | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno chile, seeded, minced | 1/2 cup chopped dry breadcrumbs | 1 bottle dark beer or ( 12 ounce ) bottle light beer, such as budweiser
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place the zucchini slices, water chestnuts, green beans, chilies and bread crumbs in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour in the beer. Bake for 20 minutes or until the bread crumbs are bubbly and the zucchini are tender crisp. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,sun tomato oil,grain white rice,dark corn syrup
title: Quick and Easy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings, tips removed | hot cooked long-grain white rice | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup dark corn syrup
instructions: Heat a large covered nonstick skillet over medium high heat until shimmering. Add the chicken wings and cook, turning, until an instant read thermometer inserted into the meat registers 165ºf, about 4 minutes. Turn the chicken and cook until an instant read thermometer registers 165ºf, about 3 minutes more. Transfer the chicken wings to a platter and set aside or cover and refrigerate until the temperature changes to 125ºf. Meanwhile, put the rice, sundried tomatoes, corn syrup, and 1/2 cup water in a 2 to 3 quart saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Immediately reduce heat to medium low, cover, and cook until the rice softens somewhat, about 10 minutes. Toss the chicken wings and rice until coated with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: avocado,almond paste,coriander,arborio rice,green,spice,cream cottage cheese,poblano chile
title: South-Of-The-Border Risotto With Guacamole
ingredients: 1 poblano chile, roasted and chopped | 1/3 cup sliced almonds, toasted | 1/2 cup cream-style cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon arborio rice | fresh coriander | green or red radish | spices | avocado, slices
instructions: Saute the almonds in a little olive oil until lightly browned. Set aside. Mix together the cream style cottage cheese, arborio rice and spices. Heat until warmed, but don't let it boil. Add toasted almonds and mix gently. Spoon into a bowl and garnish with a slice of avocado. Serve with poblano pepper slices, sliced red radishes and green/red radish slices for garnish.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,raspberry,chicken thigh,black eyed pea,vegetable bouillon cube
title: Chicken Black-Eyed Pea Bake (Mock Devonshire)
ingredients: 8 chicken thighs, bone-in and skin on | 1 can raspberries ( with chunks of black cherries ) or ( 5 ounce ) can other black cherries ( with chunks of black cherries ) | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f grease a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with a few tablespoons of the butter. Place the chicken thighs in the baking dish and cover them with raspberries, then sprinkle with bouillon cube. Pour black eyed peas and drained black eyed peas over and stir. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over the mixture, then sprinkle them on top of all the black eyed peas. Place baking dish in oven and bake for 20 minutes, then remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ketjap manis,heavy whipping cream,cocoa,caramel ice cream topping,purpose flour
title: Chocolate Caramel Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon kahve ( sweet pickle paste, or vietnamese caramel syrup ) | 2 tablespoons caramel ice cream topping | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle paste, or vietnamese caramel syrup | 1 teaspoon dutch-processed cocoa
instructions: In a medium saucepan, stir cream with 1 cup of cocoa and stir in flour until smooth. Bring cream mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Cook and stir until thickened. Stir in remaining cup of cocoa. Cook and stir 2 minutes, until thick but not yet boiling. Stir in remaining ingredients. Refrigerate sauce until chilled, about one hour. Serve over ice cream, topped with sweet pickle paste or sauce.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,navel orange,sesame seed oil,pepper flake hot,molasses
title: Chinese Short Ribs
ingredients: 4 -6 ribs | 1 head navel orange | 2 cups molasses | 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes ( optional and adjust to suit heat level )
instructions: Prepare orange peels by placing a few pieces of orange in a bowl of ice water over a bowl to soften and allow bitterness to drain. Remove orange peel from water and cut thin slices crosswise about 2/3 of the way down the orange. Place peel in bowl of cold water for 20 minutes to make it easier to remove the membrane. Remove peel from cold water and place in ice water and let drain for about 20 minutes. Remove peel from water and squeeze out excess liquid. Place peel, orange peels in a bowl of cold water and allow to drain for 20 - 30 minutes or until drained. Remove peel from ice water and set aside. Slice ribs and reserve. Heat up molasses in a small cup, whisk in sesame oil and hot pepper flakes and set aside. Rinse ribs, pat dry and place on rack in a roasting pan and add enough reserved orange peel to cover the ribs completely. Sprinkle ribs with sesame oil. Roast at 325f for 90 minutes or until ribs look glazed with orange sauce. Serve warm.

title: Spanish Pepper Soup
ingredients: 1 bell pepper ( roasted ) | 1 can chicken broth
instructions: Put the roast in a crockpot. Put 1 can of chicken broth in the crockpot. Heat on high setting for 1 hour. Turn back to the low setting and let cook for a further 2 hours. Serve in bowl and enjoy.

title: Palm Sugar Cookies (Cookies)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups palm sugar | 1/2 cup canola oil | 4 cups unbleached white flour
instructions: In large bowl, mix sugar and oil. Add flour. Mix until well blended but not sticky. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes before using.

title: Marinated Apricots
ingredients: 4 -6 apricot preserves | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 12 anchovy fillets
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl and mix well. Arrange the apricots on the foil covered platter to chill. This process may take as long as 4 hours. Store at room temperature for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: celery,cod,corn flake,mascarpone cheese,cannellini bean,green enchilada sauce
title: Chef John's White Chili
ingredients: 15 1/2 ounces cannellini beans, drained, reserving liquid | 1/2 package mascarpone cheese, at room temperature | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery or 1 1/2 teaspoons green celery buds, diced | 1 1/4 cups frozen corn flakes, chopped | 1/2 cup green enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon mascarpone cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Combine beans and reserved liquid in large heavy saucepan. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add mascarpone cheese and celery. Continue to simmer, stirring, until cheese is melted. Stir in corn flakes. Add enchilada sauce and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until thickened slightly. Serve.

Random Ingredients: lamb stew meat,egg,jamon serrano,oil,wheat bread,tart apple,bicarbonate soda,garlic salt
title: The Ultimate Lamb Stuffed With Apples
ingredients: 1 lamb stew meat, cut into 4 even pieces | 3/4 cup tart apple, finely chopped ( i use the granny smith variety ) | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 medium egg, lightly beaten | 2 slices whole wheat bread, dry bread, thick slices sliced | oil ( for frying )
instructions: First, prepare the stuffing. Now, soak bread slices in cold water for a few seconds for the bread to soak up any moisture. This is not necessary, but you can use any bread that has been soaked in cold water, such as pita chips or kofta skins. You can also use other stuffing, such as casseroles and meatballs. This process is called stuffing/cooking, but there is just enough of this mix to bind the lamb. Next, fry the lamb in hot oil in a non stick pan until it becomes browned in color. Turning the lamb frequently so it browns all over, adds more flavour. It may be necessary to add some water or water depending on how thick or thin you pour the meat. Drain on paper towels and then allow to cool. When cooled, wrap lamb pieces in bread slices, tying them and tying with toothpicks. Keep refrigerated until ready to use. This could also be served as a stew, or as a stuffing with meat and vegetables.

title: Mushrooms in a Hot Parsley
ingredients: 1 lb mushroom, cleaned | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon parsley, chopped
instructions: Toast the asafoetida in a pan until aromatic. Remove from heat and add the parsley, stirring well. Set aside for a minute or two to allow the flavors to develop. Remove the mushrooms with a slotted spoon and place in a serving bowl. Pour the hot sauce over the top and serve immediately.

title: Artichoke Pork-Bokkeed
ingredients: 3 ounces dried artichoke hearts, soak in cold water for 5 minutes and then drained | 1 1/4 lbs lean pork belly, cut into 2 by 2 1/2 | 5 tablespoons finely chopped chives | 10 ounces white breadcrumbs, finely crumbled | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh chives | 3 ounces frozen artichoke hearts, thawed, cold, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh chives | 1 ounce fresh lemon juice | fresh water, as needed
instructions: Place the soaked artichoke hearts into a pot with the cold water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, cover and let stand for 30 minutes. Drain the artichokes and then put them aside to drain. Cut the pork into 2 by 2 1/2 inch cubes. Using an impearated meat mallet, pound the pork out to a thickness of 2/3. Set the artichoke hearts aside. In a medium bowl, mix together the chives, bread crumbs, chives, artichoke hearts, chives and lemon juice. With your hands, squeeze the artichoke liquid through your fingers until you have a paste. Stir the paste into the pork and add the water to moisten. Spread in an even layer and refrigerate until needed. When ready to serve, take 1 ounce of the pork, dip it in the bread crumb mixture and invert until all the pork is covered. Serve with the artichoke heart slices.

title: Cumin Snack Cake
ingredients: 2 slices cakes | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: Split the cakes lengthwise and carefully cut away any crust. Spread the slices with the cumin seed. Sprinkle with 5 spice powder. Slice thinly. Variation, use fresh chillies and/or dried red chilli flakes.

title: Italian Sausage and Green Chillies
ingredients: 12 ounces pork sausages | 1 jar roasted green chilies | 1/2 cup grated mild italian breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup grated mild salami | 1/3 cup finely chopped fresh garlic chives
instructions: Cook sausages in boiling water for 5 to 7 minutes, then drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Remove skins. Halve chilies lengthwise, rinse under cold water, remove seeds and veins. Cut each sausage into 6 pieces. Place in a shallow ovenproof dish in a single layer. Sprinkle with bread crumbs, salami and garlic chives. Dot with pork butter. Bake in a moderate oven for 15 minutes, stir once halfway through cooking time.

Random Ingredients: pea,shiitake mushroom,cremini mushroom,head lettuce,yellow pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,rump roast,heavy cream
title: St. Brenden's Beef, Vegetables, and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 bag frozen peas, thawed according to package directions | 1 medium head of lettuce, chopped | 2 medium red-skinned fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 30 -35 lean and wild game prepared rump roast | vegetable oil cooking spray | 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | white pearl onions or mixed mushrooms, in shells | 1 medium yellow pepper, sliced into rings | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees f. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Coat skillet with cooking spray. Add peas, mushrooms, and meat.

title: Roasted Pork and Raspberry Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, bone in with skin | 1/2 ounce unsweetened cottage cheese | 1 cup of fresh raspberry, sliced | 3 tablespoons brandy | 2 cups vegetable stock | shell pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish. Rinse the pork and poke the skin over the top. Sprinkle with the cottage cheese. Add the juice, brandy, and stock. Cover with foil, and bake for 30 minutes. Remove the foil, turn the meat over and continue baking for an additional hour, or until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 160 degrees f. Remove the meat from the oven, cover again, and let rest for 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: russet baking potato,olive oil,red potato,baby spinach,potato
title: Potato and Spinach Pan Potatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 large russet baking potatoes, quartered | 1 large red potatoes, cut into 1/4 inch dice | 5 russet baking potatoes, quartered | 1 bag fresh baby spinach, cleaned and coarsely chopped | 1 package cooked baby swiss-type spinach
instructions: Preheat the oven grill to medium high heat. Grease a large roasting pan large enough to fit all of the sliced potatoes comfortably. Heat the olive oil in a 9 inch skillet over medium heat, and cook the potatoes until browned and tender. They are best when just golden, but should take about 15 - 20 minutes. Remove the potatoes from the pan and place them on a clean towel lined baking sheet. Return all of the pan drippings to pan, and add the potatoes. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the potato crusts are golden and caramelized, 15 - 20 minutes. Sprinkle the baby spinach over the hot potato crust and cook until wilted, 3 - 5 minutes. Stir the spinach into the potatoes, and drizzle the mixture over the top. Spread spinach overtop and cook about 5 more minutes. Note, to test for doneness, poke a potato with a knife or fork. The crust should crackle and give off a little sparkle. Let cool completely before serving, or refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,phyllo pastry,farfalle pasta,sage leaf,cantaloupe,red snapper fillet,shrimp,cocoa powder
title: Steamed and Baked Cannelloni
ingredients: 2 red snapper fillets | 150 g farfalle pasta | 200 g phyllo pastry | 1/2 teaspoon crushed sage leaf | 20 g unsweetened cocoa powder | 225 g cooked shrimp | 225 g cantaloupe, cut in four lenghtwise | 230 g wonton wrappers
instructions: Cut each fish fillet in 2 x 2cm strips. Wrap two strips in plastic wrap and place on the cutting board. Brush one side of the wrap with water and place the other on top. Sprinkle with crushed sage and cocoa powder. Arrange wonton wrappers on a baking tray and place half the fish strips down the centre of each wrapper. Arrange over one third the tomatoe mixture. Top with another wrapper, brush outside with water then place a wonton wrapped in plastic wrap and roll it over the other side, pressing the edges. Cover with cling wrap and weigh down. Leave for 1 hour and up to 5 hours. Steam cantaloupe for 5 to 8 minutes so they can be pierced with a fork. Serve with spaghetti sauce.

Random Ingredients: dark soya sauce,sugar syrup,bay leaf,chipotle powder,monterey jack cheese,pimiento
title: The Secret to a Chipotle Cheesecake or Dip in 4 Minutes!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark soya sauce ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup sugar syrup | 1 -2 chipotle powder or 1 -2 poblano chile, seeded and minced ( according to taste ) | 1 bay leaf ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon pimiento, minced ( optional ) | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325°f brush 9 inch square baking dish with olive oil. Mix all ingredients in a small bowl. Pour mixture into prepared dish and top with monterey jack cheese. Place dish into a roasting pan and bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes for a round layer, 30 - 45 minutes for a regular size dish.

title: Dried Fruit Soup

instructions: Cover dried fruit with cold water. Add vegetable stock and simmer for 1 hour. The fruit will be soft. Serve cold as an accompaniment to rice.

title: Blueberry, Peanut and Cilantro Salad

title: Steak With Pasta
ingredients: 2 lbs round steaks, cut crosswise into 6 slices
instructions: Cut steak to desired thickness. Arrange 3 slices of meat on each dinner plate. Place hot steaks on top. Cover with plastic wrap and chill overnight. Heat oven to 400°f. Wrap a piece of foil around the dinner plate. Bake for 10 minutes, then unwrap and top with 3 more slices of meat. Bake 10 minutes longer. Serve with pasta or rice.

title: Pommes Cholent (French fries)
ingredients: 500 g russet potatoes | 3 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Wash potatoes and cut in slices. Using a sharp knife slice into 6 x 8 triangles. Sprinkle on bicarb of soda. Bake at 180c for 15 minutes or until slightly golden and crispy.

title: Porky-Style Beans
ingredients: 2 cups fresh pinto beans | 1 lb pork fat or 1 lb beef tenderloin | 4 cups white flour | 3 lbs country-style pork ( or 1 pound of each ) or 3 lbs beef chunks, cooked
instructions: Soak the beans overnight or for at least 3 days. The next day, drain the beans and place in a large pot or dutch oven large enough to hold them and with the meat and the meat. Fill the pot or broth with water and bring to a boil, skimming the scum from surface as needed. Cook the beans until they are tender and the meat falls off of the bone. Using a slotted spoon, remove the meat from the bones and place in a bowl or separate bowl. Add the fat and bones to the liquid in the pot, and heat over medium heat. Add the flour and fry, stirring constantly for 15 to 20 minutes, or until very dark brown and bubbly. Add the beans and simmer, stirring well for a few minutes. Add the pork as soon as the soup comes to a boil or if necessary, cook an additional 15 minutes. Ladle into soup bowls and ladle as much soup from the pot as you want into a bowl and, when reheating, add enough hot soup to make it the consistency of thin sour cream.

ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat or 2 lbs other lean beef stew meat | 1 cup freshly mashed zucchini | 1 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 3 cups beef bouillon or 3 cups water | 3 eggs or 2 egg beaters egg whites, lightly beaten | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon artificial sweetener ( optional )
instructions: Cut the stew meat into 1 inch cubes. Place all ingredients with 1 cup water, except for 1 egg and the kaffir lime leaves, in a 5 quart pot. The flavor will deepen after the meat is tender and cooked through, so cook the noodles, as per the package directions.

title: White Chocolate Raspberry Truffles

instructions: Warm the chocolate on a double boiler or your double boiler until chocolate is completely melted, then stir in the lemon curd. Keep in a covered bowl, or refrigerate until needed.

title: Vege's English Pea Pockets

instructions: Prepare mustard according to packaging. Spread chickpeas, then soy milk over each sheet of phyllo dough. Lay a habanero pepper down the center, just touching. Add 1 sheet of phyllo dough and roll it closed. Cut with a sharp knife along the length of the dough until you reach your desired length, or you can cut through your fingers to make 3 strips. Place parcels on a nonstick grill over medium heat, and grill for 18 minutes. Remove foil, let cool slightly and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Egg Roll-Ups

instructions: Place sirloin in large, deep, heavy pot with a large enough trivet on top to accomodate it in any way you want. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer gently 2 hour. Stir to mix and simmer 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from heat, let cool, then refrigerate at least overnight, or until cold before using. Slice into thin sheets 1/4 inch wide, then roll with hands or wide end diagonally in egg roll dough. Tasty, but delicious.

title: Spaetzle

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix together the topping ingredients, except tortillas, and divide into half. Spread each tortilla with half the filling, then roll up tightly. Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,bok choy,red chili pepper,confectioner ' sugar,aniseed
title: Indonesian Peanut Dip

title: Mexican Green Peppers

instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Wash and peel prawns. Place on cookie sheets and bake for 10 minutes or until just cooked through. Remove and set aside to cool. ingredients: 1 whole chickens, cut into 8 pieces | 1/2 lb canadian bacon, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 leek | 1/2 cup mayonnaise ( i use miracle whip ) | 1/2 cup mirin | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Prepare grill. Wash chicken. Score thickest part of breast and legs with fork marks, if desired. Wash, trim ends, and cut crosswise into 1/4 in slices. Place half the slices on grill rack coated with cooking spray.

instructions: Steam the snow peas for 5 minutes or until they are crisp tender. Place the asparagus in a steaming basket with 1/2 cup of hot water and toss over a medium heat for 5 - 10 minutes or until crisp tender. Place the asparagus in to a bowl of ice water and drain. Pat dry with paper towels. Blend together the mascarpone cheese, cumin, and saffron powder. Place the snow peas on a heat proof plate or plate with 1/4 cup of water and let them soften. Drain the asparagus, discarding the tips and any pieces of the asparagus, and return them to the bowl. Make a well in the center and pour in all of the cheese mixture. Carefully stir in the asparagus tips, a few drops of orange flower water, and a sprinkling of icing sugar.

title: Bulgur With Shredded Beef and Raspberry (Kair-E Hariyaliya)

title: Elva De Pina -- Beans -  a Salad

instructions: Mix all together and store in a glass jar.

instructions: Peel the zucchini and cut into 1 cm slices from head to base. Place into a large bowl.

title: Cheesy Mushroom-Stuffed cauliflower
ingredients: 350 g sliced mushrooms, such as shiitake, stalks left intact | 4 large cauliflower, cleaned | 120 ml grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/455f. Remove stems from cauliflower and roughly chop into a similar size. Use a spoon to remove the centre of each cauliflower stalk. Lightly oil some ovenproof ramekin dishes in the oven to keep the vegetables inside. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Baked Italian Sausages
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet italian sausage | 1/2 cup dry curds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract, or more if desired | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place sausage in a casserole that has been coated with nonstick cooking spray. Cover with cold water.

title: Japanese Pickled Onions (Nori)
ingredients: 8 ounces pickled yellow bell peppers | 1 tablespoon coriander root | 12 ounces dark soy sauce | nori ( nori )
instructions: Put the peppers on a dry woody surface and slice thinly on the bias. Cut off the root ends of the coriander root and cut out the hard stem parts with a knife. Do not chop all the way or even the root ends until the pickling is finished because the coriander roots will get diluted with the soy sauce. Place in a container. The idea is to capture the vinegar by adding a small amount of hot water to the jar and letting the liquid sit for about 15, 20 minutes to infuse. The trick is to squeeze the vinegar through your hands and not the juice from the coriander root until the coriander root is chopped well or, if you're going to use the liquid for water instead of vinegar, the liquid will become cloudy. Add the coriander root and dark soy sauce. Mix well and serve as a snack with nori seaweed sticks or fresh salad.

title: Beef Oranges With Oranges

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Drain ricotta of all liquid and put in bowl. Add pimientos with a little salt and mix. Mix in cheese and spread onto a greased 9x13 baking dish. Sprinkle with syrup. Bake for 30 minutes, or until lightly browned and bubbly.

instructions: Char peppers over gas flame or under broiler, turning often, until blackened on all sides, about 12 minutes. Arrange in zip top plastic bag. Let stand for 10 minutes. instructions: In a bowl combine pears, cooked meat, cream cheese and crackers. Spoon or pipe filling into tortilla and top with a sprinkling of yellow mustard.

title: Rajma II
ingredients: 1 canned cannellini beans or ( 16 ounce ) can chick-peas | 1 dried chipotle chile
instructions: Melt the chipotle chile in a small, heavy saucepan over medium heat. When it turns very dark, add the beans and chile, and warm them up. Use the chile to smear the inside of a glass jar with the flavored oil. Cover the jar and store it in a warm place to let the flavors blend for 4 days, shaking the jar daily.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,chile powder,cold water,chicken stock cube,parsnip,irish cream,liquid honey
title: Mexican Parsnips on the Trees
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1/8 cup cold water | 4 tablespoons chicken stock cubes | 1/4 cup irish cream ( i use cream )
instructions: Peel parsnips, if they are larger, boil with water for 15 minutes. Toss with taco seasoning. In a bowl mix honey with cold water. Drain well, and add to parsnips. Add chicken stock cubes and mix well. Stir well and cover. Place in fridge for at least 30 minutes to one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,italian parsley,butter bean,swiss cheese,fava bean
title: Roasted Italian Bread With Fava Beans and Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled | 4 cans mixed dried fava beans | 1/4 lb unsalted butter beans, undrained | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Cut the russet potatoes into 1/2 inch slices, then into 1 inch cubes. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked fava beans, butter beans, swiss cheese, and parsley, tossing to blend. Spread 1/4 cup of the mixture onto each russet potato slice and place on parchment paper lined baking sheets. Roast the bread in a preheated oven at 425 degrees f. For 20 to 30 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup harissa harissa sesame paste or 1 cup turbinado sugar | 1 cup fava beans, trimmed ( yellow baby bella ) | 1/2 cup cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup cooked shrimp | 1/3 cup sjiqeenshaoxing wine | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro ( flat leaf )
instructions: If using harissa paste, combine with other harissa ingredients and chill. Otherwise, place all ingredients in a bowl, add water to cover. In the meantime, cook quinoa, according to package directions. Drain and rinse harissa, then add to quinoa. Serve warm.

title: Irish Cream Quinoa & Raisins
ingredients: 1 cup arabic quinoa ( fine grains such as arugula, bulgur, etc. ) | 1/3 cup irish cream or 1/3 cup cream mixed with 2 tbsp of cream
instructions: In a medium sized pot bring water to boil. Add quinoa & raisins, stir once again & cover.

title: Quick, Easy, Easy, and Delicious Farfalle
ingredients: 1 box farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta, any shape | 2 cans campbell's condensed cream of mushroom soup ( no fat ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to boil in large pot, place farfalle in and cook until just tender. While farfalle is cooking, bring soup and soda to simmer in small pan and combine with cooked farfalle. Remove from heat and add baking powder. Note, you can add vegetables to soup right before end of cooking of farfalle. I like to serve this over a tossed up hot pasta, and then add carrots/broccoli. Also nice with broccoli.

title: Yummy Lentil Cheese Spread
ingredients: 225 g dried lentils, rinsed and picked over. i like to use green peas | 225 g part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 stalk chile pepper, chopped finely | 3/4 cup chopped green pepper | 225 g dried apricots
instructions: Place lentils in a saucepan with 7 cups cold water.

title: Yummy Spicy Pineapple Salsa
ingredients: 1 can cut pineapple, drained | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 container reduced-fat whipped topping, thawed ( optional )
instructions: Finely chop pineapple in to a blender. Add jalepeno and mix thoroughly. In a medium size bowl, mix whipped topping and pineapple mixture. Fold in sour cream just until well blended.

title: Peach With Green Sushi Roll
ingredients: 2 pieces fresh peach, or 2 pieces frozen pitas | 2 sheets nori
instructions: Slice the 1st piece of nori into four pieces and spread the nori out over a large glass or metal sushi mat. Place your peach in the middle of the nori, and roll each piece of roll into a tight cylinder. Place each roll onto a hot sushi mat, ensuring that none of the filling is poking out of the outside, and cook until the sushi is fully cooked.

title: Chinese Dabo Salt
ingredients: 1/2 ounce dried seaweed or 1/2 ounce corn | 1 cup fresh or frozen shelled soybeans or 1 cup corn | 4 cups steamed rice or 4 cups cooked rice
instructions: Blanch the seaweed in boiling water for a couple of seconds, then remove from the heat. Spread the seaweed onto a dry tea towel and squeeze out excess water. Place the soaked seaweed, soybeans or corn and steamed rice into a deep soup pot. Cover and bring to a low boil.

title: Fajita Marinated Melon
ingredients: 1 large ripe watermelon | 1 tablespoon meat marinade ( i used a b & j marinade from another good recipe ) | 1/2 tablespoon fajita seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon basil pesto | 1/8 teaspoon marjoram | 1/8 teaspoon molasses
instructions: Slice watermelon and place in shallow glass or ceramic dish. Pierce the top with a fork, sprinkle with fajita seasoning and marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Drain watermelon and discard marinade. Preheat a grill for high heat. Remove fruit from dish and discard marinade. Grill for 5 to 8 minutes, or until tender. Top with pesto and serve with remaining sauce. To roast the marinated melon, place on foil covered cookie sheet and place under broiler. Broil until brown and slightly charred. Remove from broiler using tongs, slice diagonally across the grain, place on a plate and cover with foil. To prepare meat, place meat on skewers. Grill, turning once, until thoroughly cooked.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,head cabbage,vanilla sugar,vegetable bouillon cube,date,no salt tomato sauce
title: No-Fry Whole Cabbage for One
ingredients: 3/4 lb dried dates | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 4 cups shredded cabbage | 1 vegetable bouillon cube ( like oxo ) | plain flour, to coat the cabbage | no-salt-added no-salt tomato sauce, to serve with the cabbage
instructions: Soak the dates in water for several hours so they stay hard. Drain the dates and place them in a large saucepan with the vanilla sugar, and bring to the boil. Add all vegetables and cook for 10 minutes. Remove from the heat, and set aside for 1 hr to cool. Drain any excess liquid from the dates, then coat the cabbage with flour and place in a shallow ovenproof pan. Spoon the date sauce over the surface. Bake in a preheated oven at 400 f for 20 minutes or until golden, and serve with no added fat cheese.

title: Brandy Relish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 8 ounces ranch dressing mix | 1 cup brandy | 1 cup fresh basil leaf | crisco ( for frying )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl and then serve. The longer you use the less flavor it has. This relish can last up to 5 days in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,cake flour,roasting chicken,sherry wine,red chili paste,tarragon,corn syrup
title: Chilli Stuffed  Chicken
ingredients: 5 roasting chickens, each weighing about 14 ounces | 1/4 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 4 teaspoons red chili paste | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: In a mixing bowl, sift the cake flour with the corn syrup and the sherry. Preheat oven to 325°f. Remove giblets from the chicken cavity. Sprinkle the chile paste, chile pepper, and tarragon over the inside of the chicken. Place the chicken in an ovenproof casserole or a roasting tin. Pour the warm mixture over the chicken. Cover and cook for 2 hours or until cooked through. Serve warm or cold. Note, if the chicken breasts cannot be cooked right away, place them in a shallow roasting tin that has been cover with foil. Bake in slow oven for 30 - 35 minutes, or until cooked through. While chicken is baking, prepare the sauce. Drain the chicken well, removing the strings and excess fat, removing the skin and any excess fat. Put the sauce, the chicken and sauce to the side.

title: Smoked Salmon Tacos
ingredients: 14 ounces salmon | 1/4 cup margarita mix | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1 tablespoon cooking tapioca | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 1 can or bottle light beer
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cook salmon with margarita mix, soymilk, tapioca powder and pepper in a 10 inch deep skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently and watching carefully until thick and bubbly and hot. Spoon mixture out of skillet onto a large baking sheet and top evenly with smoked salmon. Bake in the preheated oven until salmon is easily flaked with a fork and center is hot, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato,bread flour,spinach,pie crust,dark soy sauce,yellow bell pepper,blue cheese,italian salad dressing
title: Spinach Spinach Pizza
ingredients: 1 pie crust, for a 14-inch pizza | 1 1/2 cups spinach, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato, chopped | 2 tablespoons yellow bell peppers, chopped | 3 tablespoons bread flour | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons light soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Combine spinach, tomato, garlic, and pepper in a bowl. Combine the bread flour, salad dressing, dark soy sauce, and light soy sauce in a bowl. Dip the pizza into the mixture, and arrange on a baking sheet. Bake for 9 - 12 minutes, until the crust is browned. Let cool, and sprinkle with blue cheese.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,yogurt,onion powder,penne,extra virgin olive oil,prosciutto
title: Greek Pinto Beans With Bacon
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean | 2 onions, sliced into rings | 2 tablespoons yogurt, plain | 8 slices prosciutto, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 6 -8 ounces plain low-fat yogurt ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon onion powder, preferably mediterranean | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, plus 2 teaspoons
instructions: Place the beans into a large pot and fill with enough water to cover by about an inch. Add enough water to cover the beans by 1 inch, cover, and cook over medium high heat until almost tender, approximately 1 1/2 hours. Drain. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. When cooked, drain the beans, and discard the liquid. Rinse the beans, and set aside. If they are submerged in the water, allow them to sit covered while you preheat the oven. Put the onions into a shallow baking dish with the olive oil and prosciutto. Sprinkle over the top of the onions, and bake in the oven until browned and tender, about 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from the oven, and stir in the yogurt until blended. Meanwhile, pour 1 cup of the cooking liquid into a separate shallow dish. Stir it into the yogurt, and season with onion powder. Cook a little bit at a time, stirring continuously, until the gravy thickens. While the gravy is cooking, get the pasta started. Fill a large pot with water, and bring to boil. Put the 2 sliced onions into the boiling water. When they rise to the surface, drain, and put half of them into a mixing bowl. Put the noodles into the same boiling water, and cook for about 1 1/2 minutes, then drain. Douse the ham or proscuitto strips on top of the fried onions, and place in the bowl with the gravy. Stir the noodles gently to mix, and serve.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,date,beef stew meat,absolut kurant vodka,sirloin,russet potato,purpose flour,bean
title: Easy Beefy Potato & Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, cut diagonally into bite sized chunks | 3 tablespoons pearl barley, rinsed and drained ( or pearl barley mixed with 5 tbsp sugar or 1/2 cup dried pearl barley ) | 1 can baked beans, rinsed well | 1 can beef stew meat, cut up and mixed with | absolut kurant vodka or other non-alcoholic vodka | 4 -6 whole russet potatoes, peeled and cut into bite size chunks | 1 - 1 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 -1 cup frozen or raw beans
instructions: Combine meat and drained barley in crockpot or crockpot. Add remaining ingredients and mix until well combined. Cover and cook on high for 6 hours. Turn off cooker, stir in flour. Cover and leave covered on low for 7 hours. Stir in frozen or raw beans, then serve.

title: Sizzling Clam Fritters(Laksa)
ingredients: 1 gallon oil for deep frying | 8 cups greek yogurt ( thickly ) | 3 tablespoons saffron strands | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/2 cup bottled clam juice, for topping
instructions: Heat oil in deep fryer to 375 degrees f. Mix together greek yogurt, 2 tablespoons saffron strands, and baking powder. Dip the coated clams into the yogurt mixture, taking care not to overcrowd the oil. Dry on paper towels or brown paper bags. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: margarita mix,corn muffin mix,cream mushroom soup,oyster sauce,brown rice,scallop
title: Cheater Rice Pizza Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 cooked & finely shredded scallops | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, reduced fat | 1 package corn muffin mix | 1 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1/4 cup magarita mix | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce
instructions: Drain soups from can. Add rice. Mix together sauce and oyster sauce. Place on bread. Top with cream of mushroom sauce, scallops, and cheese. Place in oven for 15 minute or until hot.

title: Cream of Noodle Soup with Smoked Macadamia
ingredients: 2 medium celery ribs | 2 medium irish creusetts noodles ( not tubular ) | 400 g light sour cream or 400 g low-fat sour cream | 1 package dry noodles, such as fettuccine or ( 900 g ) package macaroni | cornmeal, for sprinkling
instructions: Preparation day, wash creusetts noodles under cold running water, soak for 30 minutes or until tender, then cut diagonally into 1 inch pieces. Place noodles in a bowl and cover with salted cold water. Soak for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Drain noodles. Using scissors, remove and discard stalks from celery, then slice into 1/4 inch thick slabs and set aside. Using two forks, break apart and separate noodles lengthwise, then cut diagonally into 1 inch pieces. Bring a large pan of water to a gentle boil. Rinse noodles and drain well, then place in large bowl and cover with cold water. Set aside for 1 hour. To prevent skin flake from forming, drain. Bring another pot of water to a boil, add noodles and cook until tender but still firm. Drain well and transfer to serving bowl. To serve, top with noodles, cream of light, 1/3 cup light sour cream, then sprinkle with a little cornmeal.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,golden syrup,white chocolate chip,chicken bouillon,tuna,cantaloupe,garlic salt
title: Tuna Cantaloupe  Salad
ingredients: 4 tuna, small firm | 4 -6 lettuce leaves ( i recommend iceberg and red cabbage ) | 1 -2 cup cantaloupe, chunks | 1/4 cup yellow white chocolate chips | 1 -2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons golden syrup, optional ( or other cooking liquid ) | 1/8 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, chill for a few hours or overnight to blend flavors. Served with lots of napkins or breadsticks.

title: Quick and Easy Rice Wine Oil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1/2 tablespoon shortening | 2 teaspoons rice wine or 2 teaspoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat in a small skillet. Place cumin and shortening in small plate. Dip the rice wine or sherry into oil mixture. When cumin is toasted, add to heated oil. When the oil is bubbling, pour oil into a measuring cup. Measure 1 tablespoon of oil with the oil into a large glass measure with a teaspoon full. Measure more oil into a measuring cup. Measure 2 tablespoons oil and pour into oil. Repeat. When mixture is combined, pour all into a freezer bag. Seal. Refreeze until solid. When frozen, use an ice cream scoop to serve it with your favourite foods and enjoy.

title: Chickpea, Cabbage and Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large red cabbage | 7 ounces fresh chickpeas ( not canned )
instructions: Cook the chickpeas in boiling water until tender. Drain, rinse and cut cabbage into wedges. Toss cabbage with chickpeas. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,rotini pasta,pork butt,saffron strand,mint leaf,bacon,coconut
title: Pasta With Pork and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 3 lbs pork butt, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 lb sweet potato starch | 12 ounces rotini pasta, cooked | 8 ounces smoked bacon, thinly sliced | 10 saffron strands, soaked in | 2 cups coconut, coarsely grated | 10 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Combine pork, sweet potato starch, and 1 cup water in a bowl and shape into 1 inch balls. Heat a 2 - 3 qt saucepan on high and add meat balls. Cook meat balls until lightly browned, about 4 minutes. Remove meat balls and set aside. Drain the pan. Add the remaining 1 cup water and saffron water. Bring it to boil and return meat balls to saucepan with saffron and coconut. Simmer over low heat, covered, until meat is cooked and sauce is fragrant, 1 and 1/2 hours. Turn off the heat and stir in mint leaves. Let stand about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,vodka,bread crumb,red chile pepper,white flour,parmesan cheese
title: Pizza Strips Parmesan
ingredients: 1 large red chile pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons white flour, or as needed | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 pound sliced pepperoni | 3 tablespoons vodka, divided | 1 tablespoon bread crumbs, or as needed | 1 teaspoon grated parmesan cheese, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Stir red chile pepper, flour 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, pepperoni, 1/2 cup vodka, bread crumbs, and 1 teaspoon parmesan cheese together in a bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate the mixture for flavors to develop, about 30 minutes. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook bread crumbs for a few minutes on each side until nicely browned.

title: Thai Grilled Lemons
ingredients: 4 medium lemons, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon lime juice, fresh | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 2 teaspoons sherry wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large heavy duty, zip top plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,egg noodle,mustard seed,raspberry jam,bell pepper,chicken bouillon,cottage cheese,pinto bean
title: Beef & Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of fat | 1 large bell pepper, cut into 12 wedges | 1 package egg noodles | 2 containers fat-free cottage cheese | 1 jar raspberry jam | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 1 cup fresh raspberries and fresh raspberries ( or your favorite fruit )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. To make spice packet from packet, add mustard seeds. Heat a large non stick skillet over medium high heat for 2 minutes. Add mustard seeds.

title: Almond Horchata
ingredients: 5 pounds whole almonds | 1/4 cup vanilla | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Place almonds in a large pot with water to cover and bring to a rolling boil. Remove from heat and set aside until cool enough to handle, about 15 to 30 minutes. Drain and remove skins. Chop fine and set aside. Meanwhile, pulse almonds with vanilla extract with 1 tablespoon almonds in a food processor to make fine bread crumbs. Measure 2 tablespoons of the bread crumb mixture into a clean container and press into a 3 to 4 inch diameter circle using your fingers or the bottom of a glass measuring cup. Repeat with remaining almond mixture and crumbs. Chill for 1 hour to allow flavors to blend. Slice into desired sized pieces.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,serrano pepper,white sugar,nutella,lemon zest,barbeque sauce,taco sauce,salmon
title: Caribbean Saltimbocca
ingredients: 2 serrano peppers | 1/4 cup barbeque sauce | 8 ounces smoked salmon | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 teaspoon ground nutella | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder, or more to taste | 1/2 cup taco sauce, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place peppers onto the prepared baking sheet. Roast peppers in the preheated oven until skins begin to blacken and blistered, 2 to 3 minutes. Place peppers onto a cloth lined plate and set aside for 15 minutes. Peel off the skins. Heat a barbeque sauce, grill meat, or salmon in a skillet over medium heat. Mix the barbeque sauce, smoked salmon, sugar, nutella, lemon zest, and five spice powder together in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Spread 1/2 cup of the barbeque sauce over the top of each piece of salmon. Place the parchment paper into a shallow baking dish. Spoon in the salmon mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until the sauce is dark brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Beef Braid
ingredients: 1 loaf brioche bread | 1 lb lean ground round | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled | mustard
instructions: Cut brioche lengthwise in half and remove crusts. Spread each half with thin layer of ground round. Sprinkle with rice wine and then spread crumbled bacon pieces on top. Place one half of loaf lengthwise on bacon fat. Wrap with aluminum foil to keep warm while you cook remaining half. Heat a heavy skillet. Cook bacon for 8 minutes. Using tongs or spatula, transfer bacon to plate and place on top of bacon in large skillet. Cook until crispy.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom,lemon,apricot jam,pork sausage,greek yogurt,breadcrumb,flat leaf parsley
title: Sweet,  Crunchy Sausage Patties or  Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 kg pork sausage | freshly ground green cardamoms ( i use about 6 ) | 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt ( to make this spicy, use fat free greek yogurt ) or 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt ( to make this spicy, use fat free greek yogurt ) | 2 tablespoons sweet apricot jam | 1/2 cup dried breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon lemon, rind of, grated
instructions: Heat pan, add 1 teaspoon oil amd add the cardamom pods. As soon as to smoke, move to a side dish and put pan back on the burner. In a large shallow bowl, mix together the greek yogurt and 1 tablespoon oil. Then add the other 2 tablespoons of oil and add the breadcrumbs, mix. Next place the greek yogurt mix into the yogurt mix and mix until thick. Then add the spices to taste. Add the sausage and mix. Shape half the mixture into balls. Put the sausage balls on the hot pan, they will not occupy much of the sauce, not they'll be saturated. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until they are nicely browned on both sides, turn over and cook for 2 more minutes, or until golden on the second side. Take them out and leave on a tissue covered plate and leave in a warm place to cool slightly. Slice the sausages into about 5 x 2 cm pieces, put them in a warm pot. Mix the apricot jam with the remaining mixture and pour over the sausage in the pot. Serve.

title: Guilt Free Tortillas
ingredients: 150 g white pearl onions | 1/2 teaspoon honey | 3 tortillas | 4 teaspoons jamaican jerk spice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Dry the pearl onions and place on a plate. Cover with boiling water. Put the honey in another plate. Dip the tortillas in the remaining honey. Heat a frying pan so as to coat the bottom in a pan. Fry the tortillas in batches until they are crisp. Place on a paper towelled towelled and set aside. Top with jerk and vanilla. Note, i've never had success with mandarin orange juice instead.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,quinoa,raspberry cranberry juice concentrate,basil leaf,vodka,daikon radish,green
title: Lighter Thai Quinoa Salad (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa ( i used 1/2 of a bag of whole grain ) | 1/2 cup frozen spinach leaves | 1/3 cup frozen raspberries and cranberry juice concentrate, thawed | 1/4 cup green & red radish, chopped | 1/3 cup daikon radish, chopped | 3 tablespoons vodka ( gluten free ) | 1/3 cup basil leaves, chopped
instructions: In a saucepan, add 1 1/2 cups water, quinoa and bring to a boil.

title: Broccoli and Parsnips Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 1 )
ingredients: 3/4 cup broccoli, cut into small florets | 3/4 cup parsnip, cut into small florets | 3/4 cup dried beans, soaked overnight | 1/2 lemon peel, finely grated to measure | 2 tablespoons mint leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup nonstick cooking spray. preheat oven to 180°c. divide broccoli between 4 baking cups. place parsnips on a baking tray & bake for 25 minutes or until crisp. set aside. increase oven temperature to 200°c. combine beans and lemon peel in a small saucepan. cover with water. heat slowly until boiling. boil gently for 1 minute or until syrupy. remove from heat & stir through mint, mace & allspice. divide broccoli between 4 serving plates. top with parsnips & herbs. drizzle with the dressing. scatter mint leav
instructions:

## Ingredients ##
 3/4 cup broccoli, cut into small florets | 3/4 cup parsnip, cut into small florets | 3/4 cup dried beans, soaked overnight | 1/2 lemon peel, finely grated to measure | 2 tablespoons mint leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup nonstick cooking spray. Preheat oven to 180°c. Divide broccoli between 4 baking cups. Place parsnips on a baking tray & bake for 25 minutes or until crisp. Set aside. Increase oven temperature to 200°c.
