Divide broccoli between 4 serving plates. Top with parsnips & herbs. Drizzle with the dressing. Scatter mint leaves over the top.

title: Spiced Spiced Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar catsup | 1/2 cup lime juice ( from 1-2 limes ) | 2 tablespoons tomato paste ( ketchup ) | 1 teaspoon spices ( cinnamon, cloves, coriander or cumin )
instructions: Put all ingredients except sauce in a blender to a blender. Process on high until all ingredients are mixed throughly. Pour sauce in a bowl, cover and let sit for 15 minutes. Stir and eat right away or store in the fridge and reheat before using. Pour over chicken or seafood of your choice, and mix to coat meat.

title: Roasted Vegetables With Sherry (Aujura No Tempura)
ingredients: 1 small acorn squash, halved and seeded | 4 small turnips | 1/2 lb prosciutto | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon mirin | 1 1/2 teaspoons sherry wine
instructions: Preheat the oven on a greased baking sheet. Arrange the cut squash and turnips on the baking sheet and drizzle them with the sherry. Bake them for 5 minutes. Turn the vegetables over and bake them until they are very tender. Remove them from the oven and cut into slices, about 4 squares, or rectangles. Serve them hot or cold with soy sauce, as suggested by the author.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,red pepper,chili paste,cauliflower floret,rice noodle,green chilies
title: Faux Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain rice | 6 ounces green chilies, chopped | 12 ounces cauliflower florets | 6 ounces red peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons rice noodles | 2 tablespoons chili paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cover with saran wrap. Bring to the boil.

title: Lentil Wrapped in Fresh Lemons With Curry Chutney
ingredients: 4 fresh lemon wedges ( or to taste ) | 4 large fresh lettuce leaves, washed and dry ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup lentils, washed and soaked in 2 cups of water ( i use besan brand `` besan foods, '' which is made in the usa ) | 1/2 cup lemons or 1/2 cup lime juice | 2 -4 tablespoons curry powder ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace ( optional but i like lots of it )
instructions: Place the lemon wedges on a cutting board about 1/2 inch thick. Cut into thin strips. To serve, place a lettuce leaf in each plate. Place a few lentils on top of lettuce leaves and a few lemon wedges to squeeze over the lentils. Scatter curry chutney just before eating. You may like to add 1 tablespoon of sugar at this point if you wish.

title: Chunky Broccoli and Rotel Soup
ingredients: 1 package frozen broccoli, thawed if previously thawed | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies, drained | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill. Use as many bowls as desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken cutlet,red pepper,pork chop,double cream,fish fillet,feta cheese
title: Pork Chops on Pasta - Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb pork chop | 1 lb pork chop | 1 lb fish fillet | 1/4 medium red pepper, finely diced | 1/4 cup double cream | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Cut pork and pork into bite sized pieces. Place pork in a pan with the red pepper and cook with the chicken until there is no blood. Remove pork from pan and set aside. Add fish to the pan. Cook gently over low heat for about ten minutes, stirring, until just cooked through and remove from pan to a plate. Add cream to the pan and bring to just enough to bring to the boiling point. When the sauce is just about to boil, gently stir in the pork chop pieces, red pepper and the feta until the cheese is melted. Remove from heat and serve immediately. If you are planning to serve the skewers on the skewers, prepare them by dipping the meat pieces into the sauce until coated then into the feta cheese.

title: Beef Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef chuck | 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | veal, etc. ( optional )
instructions: Brown ground beef and ground sirloin in pan. Add taco seasoning and let simmer while making the tacos. Served with favorite hot sauce or guacamole.

title: Smoky Broccoli and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 -7 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup frozen broccoli | 2 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1/4 cup dried currants ( optional ) | 8 -12 -16 lettuce leaves | 8 -10 fresh raspberries
instructions: Clean mushrooms and trim stems. Wash and wash frozen broccoli, remove stems and reserve. Slice mushrooms thickly and put thru food processer until they are coarsely chopped. Chop broccoli if frozen to fit into your container for later use. Place broccoli in the container, along with frozen shiitakes. Dice fresh mushrooms finely and add to container. Cover and leave at room temperature for a few hours, or overnight. Line a large platter with lettuce leaves. Remove lettuce from a salad bowl and put in a large bowl. Toss with fresh berries. Arrange mushrooms over lettuce and drizzle with olive oil to flavor. Add mushrooms and drizzle with olive oil. Serve with extra olive oil if needed.

title: Balsamic Salad With Ham
ingredients: 4 -6 slices deli ham | 1 cup of sliced ripe pear | 1 can of sliced olives | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place sliced ham slices on a plate in an attractive pattern. Cover with pear and pitted olives. Drizzle with balsamic vinegar. Eat to your friends.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,oyster sauce,chicken bouillon cube,salmon fillet,five spice powder
title: Carnation Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets ( about 300 g each ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 lime, juice of | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube ( i used one of my own homemade bouillon cubes ) | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder
instructions: Pound the salt free salmon to about a 1/2 cm thick, and cut into strips. Combine remaining ingredients, and lightly brush over salmon. Grill until well browned.

title: Spicy Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 100 g dark chocolate, finely chopped | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper, seeded, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 teaspoon harissa, chili paste ( optional ) | thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Place the dark chocolate, jalapeno pepper, fish sauce, harissa paste and thyme sprig in a bowl and stir to combine. Serve chips in a bowl with crushed plastic peanuts.

Random Ingredients: carrot,corn tortilla,blueberry,wheat flour,bell pepper,chicken broth,maple syrup
title: Blueberry and Carrot Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 12 low sodium chicken broth | 2 large carrots, grated | 1 large bell pepper, finely diced | 12 corn tortillas, warmed | 2 tablespoons wheat flour | 1/4 cup maple syrup ( or light rum ) | berries ( optional ) or red currants ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the broiler or set to medium low. Place the chicken broth into a shallow pan over high heat. Add carrots and bell pepper and bring to boil, stirring often. Reduce heat and simmer on the stove top for 10 minutes. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the olive oil evenly over a sheet of wax paper. Dip each tortilla into the broth, turning it a few times, and place each one on the wax paper. Repeat with remaining tortillas. Heat the broiler or set the tops under the broiler, and toast the tortillas to your liking, about 1 to 2 minutes. Add 1 tablespoon or more of the maple syrup, or as preferred. Place a dollop of the blueberry mixture over each and serve.

Random Ingredients: black olive,triple sec,broccoli floret,beef brisket,olive oil,taco seasoning mix
title: Brothy Corned Beef Brisket & Broccoli
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket, cut to 2-inches | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 12 ounces broccoli florets | 1/4 cup black olives, sliced | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/3 cup triple sec
instructions: Combine beef brisket with taco seasoning in large slow cooker. Add broccoli, olives, oil and 1/3 cup triple sec. Cover and cook on high 4 - 5 hours or on low 6 - 8 hours. Brisket will firm and brown as it rests in the slow cooker.

title: Chipotle Copycat
ingredients: 3 -4 red chilies ( or a combination ) | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 6 -8 ounces dried apricots | 4 -6 red chilies ( or 1/4 cup dried ) | 4 cups mexican blend cheese ( or cheddar cheese or monterey jack cheese or a combination ) | 2 small red onions, sliced very thin | 2 medium turnips, peeled and cut into 2 to 3 inch cubes
instructions: Wash and dry the chiles. Cut them into a fine shred on your kitchen counter and remove the seeds and membrane if necessary. Place them in a blender and mix with 2 tablespoons of the oil, about a tablespoon at a time, until the mixture is of the consistency of course meal. Taste the mixture and add more salt if necessary. Heat a sauté pan over medium heat. Once it is hot and just starting to smoke, add the remaining tablespoon oil and fry the onion for 3 - 4 minutes, or until they are soft. Stir in the chiles and cook until they begin to give off their aroma. Remove from heat and set aside. When the chili mixture is cool, measure out about 1 cup. Place the rest in a blender and blend until fairly smooth, about 15 - 20 pulses. Transfer the blended mixture to a large bowl that is well greased. Add the cheese, tomatoes, red onions and turnips and mix thoroughly. Taste for desired salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Asparagus in Black Caviar
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs asparagus | 1/4 cup gin | 2 1/2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled
instructions: In saucepan of boiling water, blanch asparagus for 1 minute. Transfer to bowl of ice water. Drain well. In same saucepan, add gin and boil for 1 minute. Transfer asparagus to food processor. Cut asparagus into 1 inch pieces. Add potatoes. Pulse 1/4 at a time until ingredients are finely chopped and well blended. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot vodka. Cook, stirring constantly so as not to let the alcohol burn, 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Frangelico Cheesecake
ingredients: 3/4 cup cream or 3/4 cup milk | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 cup grated mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons frangelico | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine all ingredients, mix well, pour into a 9 inch springform pan. Bake for 45 minutes. Allow to cool completely while watching the crust carefully. Cut into diamonds and serve.

title: Homemade Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamari, for coating | 1/4 cup chili, finely ground
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. To use, spray teriyaki pan on pan with vegetable spray. Stir all sauce into pan and cook on medium heat for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,baby spinach,sea salt,purple onion,natural yoghurt
title: Spinach and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups broccoli florets | 1/2 medium purple onion | 1 medium head baby spinach | 1 1/2 cups natural yoghurt | sea salt
instructions: Wash, steam or microwave broccoli until soft, chop onion and crush in a large bowl with a fork, add spinach and yoghurt and mix together gently. Pour into a jug and serve chilled or at room temperature..

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,chipotle chile,quark,cherry tomato,red lentil,salmon steak
title: Smoked Salmon and Lentil Soup
ingredients: 1 smoked salmon steak, cut into chunks | 250 g split red lentils | 400 g vegetarian broth | 800 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons chopped chipotle chiles | 5 tablespoons quark
instructions: Place everything except the quark in a pot. Cook, covered, on high heat for 20 minutes. When ready to serve, stir in quark and serve with chips and vegetables.

title: Shrimper Shrimp
ingredients: 4 lbs beef ribs ( or other lean meat ) | 1 cup onion flakes | 2 cups cream | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1/2 cup irish cream ( or other favorite fruit flavor ) or 1/2 cup lemon juice ( or other favorite fruit flavor ) | 1 lb baby shrimp ( or other seafood )
instructions: Trim any excess fat from meat. Cut into 2 to 3 pieces. In 6 to 8 quart kettle, mix all of the ingredients and simmer till meat is done. Add meat, and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for at least 2 hours. Baste occasionally with hot liquids. You may not need to cover the meat with water because it will continue cooking in a large quantity. There should be enough liquid left to keep 1 1/2 lbs of this delicious sauce. Remove foam from the top of foam about 2 minutes before serving.

title: Machené Mac and Broth
ingredients: 1 envelope dry yeast | 1/2 cup red wine | 2 cups broth ( or milk ) | 2 cups flour | 3 eggs ( or 2 egg beaters, or equivalent egg substitute ) | 1/2 cup fettuccine ( or macaroni ) | 1 teaspoon savory | 1 1/2 cups macaroni
instructions: Boil the wine or milk add the yeast to the yeast and dissolve it. In a large bowl, mix the dry ingredients with 2 cups warm milk. Set aside. Fry the pasta to taste in a little oil until it is al dente drain, then pour the noodles through a colander and rinse with cold water. Fry the vegetables first, then add to the dough with the remaining 2 cups of milk and noodles. Let rise for 45 minutes. Mix all ingredients, except for the macaroni and eggs, together and shape into a big ball. Divide into 6 balls and place on baking sheets. Make more dough, if necessary. Let rise for another 45 minutes until dough double in size. Bake at 350 degrees for about 20 - 25 minutes, serve warm with fresh chopped herbs.

title: Tofu (Vegan)
ingredients: 12 ounces firm tofu | 1/3 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f place tofu in a 9x13 pan, breaking it up into crumbles as it cooks. Pour vinegar over the tofu and sprinkle brown sugar over the top and bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes, stirring about halfway through. Bake an additional 10 minutes, then remove from heat and let stand 1 minute.

title: Crunchy Mango Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes | 1 small fresh ancho pepper, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped mango chutney | 1 large fruit, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped pimento stuffed olives | 6 large strawberries, quartered | sliced ripe mango chutney | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Combine sun dried tomatoes and ancho pepper in a bowl. Stir in mango chutney. Layer fruit and olive mixture in large bowl. Sprinkle with chopped parsley.

title: Swedish Boneless Beef and Green Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin, cut in 1-inch cubes | 5 medium green tomatoes, stems and any large dice | 1 can sliced green tomatoes | 2 tablespoons instant powdered eggnog or 2 tablespoons cool whip, for serving | 1 dash cardamom pod, crushed to release flavor
instructions: Place beef and all juice in a large resealable plastic bag.

title: Cheese & Pepper Alfredo Sauce (For Chicken & Pasta)
ingredients: 32 ounces ricotta cheese ( room temperature if possible ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Boil pasta according to directions. When the pasta is done, drain pasta well, return it to the pan and add cheese & pepper to taste. You can also add cooked chicken or turkey if desired.

title: Cranberry Corn Beef Sandwich Soup
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 gallon of vegetable stock | 1 lemon peel | 1/3 cup dried cranberries | 1/3 cup dried corn | cornbread and soda water, as needed | salsa and/or chopped lemon peel, as needed
instructions: Trim brisket and remove any excess fat. Add broth, lemon peel, cranberries and corn. Bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer until meat is tender, about 2 hours.. Remove brisket from broth. Shred brisket into bite sized pieces. Return shredded meat to broth and stir to combine through the soup. If soup is too thin, dilute with water to desired consistency. Serve topped with salsa and lemon peel.

title: Rice Balls with Lentils
ingredients: 1/2 liter double cream | 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 cup arborio rice | 400 g tomato sauce | 200 g lentils
instructions: Place the rice in a basin. Pour in the cream and mix. Heat about 30 seconds, add a ladle full of the mixture to the centre of the rice, tilt the pan to cover and cook to the water level about a quarter of the way up. Turn the heat back down and cover with a plate. Cook for 30mins longer till rice is cooked. Place the lentils in a separate saucepan and put the saucepan on the heat. When everything is boiling, stir often and add the tomato sauce and lentils to the pan. Cook for 3 4mins, until everything is boiling and the lentils are all cooked. Take the plate off of the saucepan, stir and leave for 5 mins, taste and add salt if necessary.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,black pepper,tea,maple flavoring,saffron,cremini mushroom,marsala,black sesame seed
title: Grilled Tarralli Lamb Shoulder and Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 teaspoons maple flavoring, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 4 pounds lamb shoulder, cut into 1 1/4-inch cubes | 1 pound cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup marsala | 1/4 cup black sesame seeds | 1/4 cup brewed tea
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or a cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Combine maple flavoring and saffron in a small bowl. Spread over lamb shoulder and sprinkle evenly with the maple mixture. Place the lamb in the pan and press. Sprinkle mushrooms over lamb, and press, then press, again, sprinkle on saffron and pepper. Set the pan aside. Prepare grill. Place a heavy cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Place lamb on the hot skillet so the excess fat drains off, then cook until it starts to brown on all sides. Grill to desired doneness, and turn every 5 to 7 minutes. Move to a cutting board, and let rest for 5 minutes. While the lamb rests, place marsala in a saucepan over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,half cream,apricot,creme fraiche,mandarin orange section,taco seasoning
title: Sweet Apricot Taco
ingredients: 2 cups creme fraiche | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons chopped apricots | 6 toasted almonds or 6 apricot halves
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Chill. Serve in lightly buttered 2 cup dishes topped evenly with toasted almonds or candied apricots.

title: Chinese Steamed Steak
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef, very lean cut to suit preferences | 300 g plain flour or 300 g cake flour | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Prepare the flour or cake flour that you are using by placing the flour and oil in a plastic bag. If you are making dough you won't be able to knead it. Place the flour in a clean bowl and add a good pinch of salt and a good pinch of pepper then knead together to make a soft, pliable dough that doesn't stick to your hands. You will need a good sized freezer bag to cover the pastry, i usually use a plastic bag. Dust the work surface liberally with flour. Take one piece of the dough and cut into three pieces. Then roll out the thin strips about the length of your grain on the floured surface and about 1 1/4 wide. Roll the strips out to approximately 3mm thickness again, keeping the ends as free of air as possible. Cut any strips that are sticking out, this is the glue later. You will then need a bit of flour on your hands to make the glue later. Remember to cut away any stray pieces of dough that don't stick to the cloth. When all the slices have been cut together, place the slices on a floured tray. Now cut the slices in half lengthways and then across. Keep the pieces on one side. Now dust flour on your hands and put a piece of the pastry on your palm. Press a little bit of flour on it and it should stick, you will probably need only this a few times. Take a piece of the dough and then push a piece through the folds using your finger tips, making sure the flour is not stuck on the rolling pin. Repeat until the dough is used up and can be turned over again. Heat a saucepan, put on the vegetable oil and heat the oil on the stove until it's hot. Put the fried steaks into the pan and brown on all sides. Turn them over for about 2 - 4 minutes. Take out and put on a plate covered with clean kitchen paper towels. Sprinkle some water off until it runs over the steaks. Repeat for other steaks. To serve, plate your steaks one by one. Spoon a little sauce on the side, with just two or three slices of steak on the side. If you want to make a gravy this is a tasty way to finish a big meal. You can also use vegetable broth, but if your family like it with gravy, you can serve it straight from the pan.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,nonfat yogurt,pearl barley,bean,asafoetida powder,clear honey,wheat bread
title: Barley Chapati (Barley and Bean Patties)
ingredients: 8 ounces light plain yogurt | 1/4 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 2 teaspoons clear honey | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 cups cooked low-fat beans, rinsed and drained | 2 1/2 cups cooked pearl barley | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place yogurt, yogurt, honey and turmeric powder in a bowl and stir until well blended. Spread mixture out evenly on a nonstick baking sheet lined with parchment paper or another nonstick cooking spray. Top with beans and barley. Dissolve foie gras by heating a small amount of water in a small saucepan and swirling the water around the pan to warm it. Transfer water to a small bowl. Cover and set aside. Briefly toast chapati if desired. Cut into 3 pieces and transfer to a baking pan large enough to hold them in a single layer. Spread a few teaspoons of the yogurt mixture on each piece, then drizzle with a dab of honey over the top of each piece. Bake for 10 minutes. Place a small plate over the top and serve hot.

title: Pasta With Linguine and Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | additional pasta, from a bag or 2 quarts
instructions: Cook linguine in boiling, unsalted water until al dente'. Drain, return to pot, add a little olive or anchovy oil to coat. Add fresh linguine and toss over high heat until hot. Add more anchovy oil, a little and anchovy oil. Taste for salt.

title: Moroccan Beetroot & Chilli Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg beet, peeled | 1 3/4 cups chilli paste | 1/4 cup saffron threads or 1/4 cup turmeric powder
instructions: Place the beetroot in a pot with water, about 3cm/ 1/3 inch over the top. Bring to the boil then cover, reduce the heat and simmer gently for 2 hours or until tender. Remove beetroot, drain and cool slightly. Peel off the beetroot and cut into about 5mm/1 inch pieces and place in the processor. Blend until roughly chop. Add chilli paste and cook for further 1 minute or until aromatic but not brown. Remove the beetroot and chilli paste from the heat. Cool and then chill in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight. Bring to the boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until ready to use. To serve, reheat gently for about 2 minutes and then transfer to warmed serving dish. Garnish with toasted seeds.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,beef chuck,black sesame seed,pearl barley,mint,red onion,chorizo sausage
title: Chorizo-Beef With Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 lb poblano chile, chopped | 1/2 lb chorizo sausage, casings removed, diced | 1 red onion, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 tablespoon black sesame seeds, lightly toasted | 2 teaspoons dried mint | 2 tablespoons coarsely crushed dried arbol chiles ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons crushed dried chipotle chiles ( optional )
instructions: Put chuck pieces in a colander.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,purpose flour,chicken bouillon,ramen noodle,rom tomato,monterey jack pepper cheese,creamy peanut butter,cooking sherry
title: Peanut Butter and Ramen Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons creamy chicken bouillon | 3/4 cup quick-cooking sherry | 1 medium roma tomato, chopped | 2 packages refrigerated-pack ramen noodles | 1/8 cup chocolate syrup ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, using an electric mixer, smooth together peanut butter, monterey jack pepper cheese, flour, 1 tablespoon of the chicken bouillon, and sherry. Reserve the rest of the chicken bouillon. Place noodles in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish and top with the peanut butter mixture. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 cup bouillon. Bake, uncovered, at 400 degrees for 12 - 15 minutes, or until noodles are tender and beginning to brown. While noodles are cooking, in a skillet, over medium heat, melt the reserved 1/8 cup chicken bouillon. Remove pan from heat.

title: Whole Wheat English Muffins
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 cups whole wheat flour, divided ( about 6 cups ) | salad oil, for greasing pans
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 f. In a large bowl, stir together 2 cups flour and 2 cups water until dough forms. If large, knead in a large bowl. Roll out dough to ¼ inch thickness. Cut out two circles, each about 5 - ½ inches in diameter. Place on greased baking sheets. Brush with salad oil. Top each circle of dough with about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the remaining flour. Bake until puffed and brown, about 12 minutes.

title: Grain Free Lime & Cocoa Oatcakes(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oatmeal | 1 can fat-free chicken broth | 1 lime, juice and zest of
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and puree until smooth. Fill a shallow pan about 1/4 full with batter and swirl it around in the pan so that it coats the botton evenly. Cook the oatcakes, in batches if necessary, until lightly browned, 1 - 2 minutes on each side.

title: Bourbon Street Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup dry white wine | 1 cup vermouth | 1/2 cup cranberries | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 3 1/2 rotisserie chicken, fat trimmed | 1/4 cup shaved semisweet chocolate
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. In a medium baking dish, combine the white wine, vermouth, cranberries, swiss cheese, chicken, and shaved chocolate. Bake in the preheated oven for 90 minutes, or until the swiss cheese is melted and starting to bubble.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,pepperjack cheese,mango chutney,broccoli floret,bread flour
title: Smoky Mango-Cheese Toasted Bread Bowls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mango chutney ( see note below ) ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 package prepared broccoli florets, washed and drained | 1/3 cup shredded pepperjack cheese, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat to 375 degrees f. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Whisk mango chutney, bread flour, and chili oil together in a bowl. Place broccoli on the baking sheets.

title: Mexi-Beef Steak (Lives)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round steaks | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup creme fraiche | 1 jar pimientos | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix ( i like mccormick brand )
instructions: Cut the beef into 2 strips and then into strips. Mix sour cream, pimentos, taco seasoning and taco mix together. Spray a skillet with nonstick cooking spray and heat to hot. Put in the strips and sear on both sides until done. Serve with brown rice and avocado.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,pizza crust,queso fresco,wheat flour,thai fish sauce,baby portabella mushroom,cilantro,watercress
title: Pizza Con Prosciutto (Antiguan Pizza)
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups watercress or 1 2/3 cups arugula leaves | 1/2 cup finely chopped whole wheat flour | 1 ounce fresh ginger-garlic paste ( a pinch ) | 8 medium baby portabella mushrooms, trimmed and halved | 2 -3 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 pizza crust | 1 cup queso fresco | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: To make the dough, combine the watercress or arugula leaves, flour, and ginger garlic paste in a food processor or blender and process until very finely chopped and then add the mushrooms and fish sauce and process until well combined. Set aside. Slice the pizza crusts in half and then in half again and stretch into an 8 circle on a cookie sheet or pizza roller to form an 8 circle. Spoon the mushroom dough onto the dough and sprinkle cheese over the dough top with the cilantro. Bake at 450 degrees, or until cheese melts and crust is golden brown. Remove from the oven and cut in half and serve. This pizza is a hearty delish and can be re heated at room temperature for extra flavor.

title: Yummie (Algerian Bread)
ingredients: 12 cubes ice, or as needed | 1 teaspoon ground sumac | 1 can vegetable oil, or as needed | 4 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Fill a large bowl with ice.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,italian parsley,beef tenderloin,rosemary,tofu,salt black pepper,metal skewer,peach
title: Beef Tofu Satay
ingredients: 1/2 cup tofu, cut into 4 strips | 8 pieces bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley, plus extra to make a sauce | 1 tablespoon caraway seed ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary ( optional ) | salt and black pepper, to taste | 2 ripe peaches, peeled, pitted, and sliced into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Soak the saran wrap in water for 1 hour. Preheat grill to high. Thread onto the skewers alternating with tofu, parsley, caraway, sage, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Place skewers in a large, shallow roasting pan or platter. Pour peaches on top of the skewers and bake, uncovered, turning every 10 minutes or so, until they are very tender and a little darker in color, about 45 minutes.

title: Creamy Peach Pasta
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 1 3/4 cups heavy cream | 4 firm ripe peaches, peel with cores cut off and discard pit | 1 medium celery rib, leaves cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 cup sweet basil leaves, rinsed | 1 cup cashew nuts, lightly toasted | 1/2 cup water, cold | 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions for al dente, drain. In a medium bowl, toss the peaches, celery, basil, cashews and water for about 8 minutes or until celery and nuts are crisp tender. Remove from heat. Drain pasta and return it to the pot. Place sour cream in a small mixing bowl and beat until smooth, then stir in a bit of the warm pasta water to thin it. Pour sour cream mixture over the pasta and gently stir to coat the pasta. Serve warm with more sour cream if desired.

title: Spanish Rice With Black Olives
ingredients: 1 box bread, crusts removed and cut in half diagonally | 1 1/2 cups uncooked rice | 1 1/2 cups chopped black olives | 2 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning, crushed
instructions: Place the rice into a colander and sprinkle all around with salt. Place about 3 cups boiling water over rice and allow to sit until water is absorbed, about 30 minutes. Drain in a sieve or strainer set over a bowl. Place 1/2 cup of the olives in a small bowl and add remaining 1 1/2 cup and 1 1/2 teaspoons of italian seasoning. Dip 1 slice of bread in the olive mixture and place on a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,yellow cake mix,pearl barley,peanut butter,chow mein noodle
title: Yummy Beef and Vegetable Barley Casserole
ingredients: 1 yellow cake mix, divided into two triangles. | 1 can condensed chunk style peanut butter | 1 can yellow squash | 3 tablespoons commercial pearl barley | 1 package chang's dry chow mein noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Prepare the cake mix by following the directions on the box. Spray 9x9 pan with cooking spray. Arrange the crusty bottom layer in a 13x9 baking dish. Sprinkle the bottom layer with the barley. Next, spread pea pearl barley on top of the barley. Next, spread peanut butter on top of the barley. Next, spread squash over the peanut butter. Finally, spread the soy sauce mixture over the squash. Finally, drizzle with the chocolate chips. Bake for 45 - 55 minutes or until the rice is tender and there are browned spots on the top.

title: Irish Girlfinger Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate | 1 small butternut pumpkin | 2 oranges | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill pickles
instructions: Place a layer of lady fingers in the bottom of your glass dish. Repeat until you have 3 layers. Cut 1/2 of the choclate in small pieces and distribute evenly over your lady fingers. Chop 2 oranges, cut 1 lemon in half and sprinkle evenly over the top. Chop 2 dill pickles and distribute evenly over the top of the lady fingers. In a small bowl, sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the chopped dill pickle around the bottom layer. Dip the end of the lady fingers into the chocolate and place on top of the pickle. Garnish with 1 tablespoon chopped dill pickle from the table. Serve.

title: Pollo con Pabellos a la Michele (Chicken and Poblano Chile Salad)
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 2 tablespoons sliced pimiento | 4 teaspoons hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 4 leaves white fish fillets, such as pacific or sea bass
instructions: Roast the poblanos under the broiler, turning once, until skin is a dark, rich blackened color, 5 to 8 minutes. Immediately rub 1 tablespoon pepper sauce on poblanos, spreading it evenly, and rub remaining tablespoon pepper sauce on poblanos. Roast the poblanos under the broiler, turning once, until skins are charred and fragrant, 5 to 10 minutes total. Transfer poblanos to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let dry. Squeeze poblanos to remove excess moisture. Cut in half lengthwise and remove seeds. Wrap poblanos in paper towels and set aside. Place the poblanos in a dry skillet over medium heat. Cook until the peppers are tender, about 10 minutes. Allow them to cool and then remove stems, and peel off charred skins. Remove the membrane in the peppers by scraping with a fork or pricking with a skewer. Cut peppers into 1/4 inch slices. Add 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce, thyme, green olives and 1/4 teaspoon salt to the cooled poblanos and toss. Taste for salt. Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Zucchini in a Salad With Mango and Feta
ingredients: 1 avocado, sliced | 1 zucchini, sliced | 1 mango, sliced | 500 g feta, crumbled | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar | 1/2 cup palm sugar
instructions: To make dressing, mix all the ingredients together. To make salad, serve with slices of fruit, such as apples, pears, oranges, bananas and/or oranges.

title: Creamy Italian Butter for Veggies
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine | 1/2 teaspoon basil ( optional )
instructions: Place margarine in a small bowl. Stir in basil or other herbs. Serve warm or cold.

title: Souvlaki (Moroccan Bites)
ingredients: 2 packages pastry for double crust pie ( thawed ) | 1 - 1 1/4 lb pastry dough ( thawed ) | sea salt ( per taste ) | cumin powder ( per taste ) | 1 romaine lettuce
instructions: Roll out your pastry on a floured surface. Cut the pastry into 4 or 6 triangles that are 9x13 inches. Cut out circles about 2 - 3 inches in diameter. Set aside. Cut out the hearts of your romaine so you can hold what is handy. Roll out the pastry again on the floured surface. Once you have cut circles and stretched your pastry pieces out, stretch out another circle, using the pastry circles as a guide. Spread out the heart of your romain lettuce slices. Place half a teaspoon of sweet pickle into the center of the heart of romain. Carefully press and roll the pastry dough over the pickle in a circle. Sprinkle a little sea salt around the rolls and place on a sheet pan. Bake at 400f degrees for 12 - 14 minutes, then move to a cooling rack. Store in an airtight container.

title: Tunisian Potato Salad (Baklava Yemista Me Avga)
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 cup mashed very well idaho potatoes or 1/2 cup mashed well eggplant | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced | 1 small ripe banana | 2 pita breads ( or toasted bread ) | macaroni or spaghetti sauce ( for dipping )
instructions: Break potato into pieces and boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, drain and dice potato and egg if any. Heat margarine in microwave or oven. Add eggs to potatoes just before mixing potatoes and egg. Serve on top of pita, sprinkle with banana and serve with macaroni or spaghetti sauce if desired.

Random Ingredients: emmenthaler cheese,meat,sun tomato oil,bamboo shoot,curry leaf,egg
title: Curry Omelet
ingredients: 4 eggs | 200 g minced meat | 1 teaspoon curry leaf | 2 teaspoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 slice emmenthaler cheese | 1/4 cup sliced bamboo shoot
instructions: In a bowl beat eggs until fluffy. Add meat, curry leaves, sun dried tomatoes and cayenne pepper and mix well. Heat a small skillet over medium high heat. Pour enough oil over tomatoes to just cover bottom of skillet. Cook egg mixture for 8 - 10 minutes, moving skillet about 2 - 3 minutes to ensure even cooking without overcooking. Spread cooked egg onto a flat surface. Place a slice of cheese on the omelet, then top with an equal amount of your chosen filling. Roll up and slice into 8 equal parts. Serve warm with a fresh leafy green salad.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,lamb shank,beef shank,rye bread,garam masala
title: Rissaq
ingredients: 1 pound lamb shank | 2 slices rye bread | 1 pound frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 3 tablespoons ground garam masala | 1 package frozen beef shanks
instructions: Place the lamb shanks in a large saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a low boil, and simmer until tender, about 25 minutes. Remove the bones and shanks, and set aside. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Remove the lamb from the bones and shanks, and place in a large casserole dish. Place the rye bread slices in a dry skillet over medium heat, and fry them in the hot butter until golden brown on both sides. Reserve the crisppings in the skillet for gravy. When the shanks are almost done, stir in the peas and carrots. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer until the meat is no longer pink inside, about 20 minutes. Place the meat back into the skillet and spread the garam masala over it. Cook and stir for about 5 minutes. Place the slices of bread on top of the meat, and dot the meat with the crisppings. Bake in the preheated oven until crisp, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,parsnip,parmigiano reggiano cheese,caramel,orange bell pepper,cremini mushroom,baby carrot
title: Caramelized Parsnips on Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 large carrot, peeled | 2 baby carrots, trimmed | 6 fresh cremini mushrooms | 1/2 orange bell peppers or 1/2 yellow bell pepper | 2 lbs rye bread | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon grated fresh parsley
instructions: Using a mandoline, cut the carrot into long narrow slices. Trim the ends from the baby carrots. Cut the carrots into slices about 1/2 inch thick, about the size of the baby carrots. Cut the bell peppers in half lengthwise. Cut the long slender ends from the mushrooms and cut crosswise into long thin slices. Place the bread rounds on baking sheets in a single layer. Heat the oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the baby carrots, mushrooms, orange pepper and peppers in a single layer on a large rimmed baking sheet. Sprinkle both the breads with the cheese and the parsley. Top with the bread rounds. Put the tray in the oven and bake for 5 minutes. Remove the tray from the oven and open the door. Leave it uncovered. Remove the tray and sprinkle with the cheese. Put it back in the oven for about 3 minutes, or until you can see steam through the bread and vegetables. Let sit for a couple of minutes and then dig in i usually just put the tray in my serving dish to let my food get hot and warm and toasted.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,limeade concentrate,chipotle chile adobo,puff pastry
title: Chipotle Lime Twirls
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo | 1/4 cup frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | parsley flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Roll out pastry onto a floured surface until it is about 1/8 inch thick. In a large bowl, combine chilis with juice and blend in the limeade concentrate. Spread about 1/4 of the chipotle mixture on each pastry sheet, then top with slices of pastry. Fold pastry over filling to make a half circle, and pinch edges so no filling spills out. Cut slits with a sharp knife in top of twists, and brush top with a little water. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until top is puffed and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: green lentil,asparagus tip,red cabbage,chili garlic sauce,red chile pepper,pork tenderloin,lamb shoulder
title: Lamb and Asparagus Saute
ingredients: 1/2 cup green lentils | 1 boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 1/2 pounds fresh asparagus tips, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 pound boneless pork tenderloins, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 red cabbage, cut into thin wedges | 2 fresh red chile peppers, sliced, or to taste
instructions: Place the lentils in a large pot and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: saffron,chicken bouillon granule,pico de gallo,soymilk,black bean,egg yolk
title: Eggs with Beans and Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped beans | 1 pinch saffron | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 2 large egg yolks | 1 can soymilk ( low fat ok ) | 8 ounces pico de gallo
instructions: Preheat oven to 325º. Place the frozen beans, saffron, and chicken. Pour the egg yolks into a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Pour over the beans in a large bowl and add the soy milk. Blend until blended well and pour into a 9x9″ casserole dish or one large baking dish coated with cooking spray. Cover dish with foil and bake for 45 - 55 minutes or until heated through and mixture is puffy. Take out from oven and remove foil. Spread pico de gallo on top.

title: Baked Eggs with Polenta
ingredients: 4 bolillo rolls, split and opened | 1 cup soymilk | 1 hard-boiled egg, peeled quartered | 1 pinch fine herbes | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add bolillos, and cook, turning once, until lightly toasted and soft, about 5 minutes. Set on paper towels while preparing polenta. Toast soymilk in a small saucepan until thick and creamy, about 5 minutes. Remove saucepan from heat. Place soymilk in a small bowl and set aside. Rub soymilk into inside of the rolls and set aside. Arrange the egg quarters on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with kosher salt. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Remove egg from the oven when a knife plunged through the yolk comes out without much resistance, and let stand for 5 minutes. Serve in the bolillo rolls with herbes and cream.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,vanilla bean,nut,taco seasoning mix,salami,onion salt
title: Mexican-Style Baked Salami Fingers
ingredients: 1 lb salami, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup instant cake flour | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 4 teaspoons nuts, for spreading | 1/2 vanilla beans, split lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place salami in ungreased 8x8 inch baking dish. Mix flour, onion salt and taco seasoning mix in small bowl. Pour over salami. Make diagonal lines on salami with thumb and forefinger tips until you meet the end of the rectangle. Sprinkle with nuts, and top with vanilla beans. Bake 10 minutes, or until browned.

title: Escarole, Feta & Breadcrumb Melt
ingredients: 2 cans escarole, drained ( or equivalent amount of fresh ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese ( about 3 ounces ) | 2 teaspoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 -4 drops tabasco sauce | 1 loaf french baguette, sliced 1/2 inch thick
instructions: Cut baguette slices in half horizontally to slightly open and remove bread, leaving about 1/2 to 1/2 inch of crust on each. Slice each side of bread open slightly to check crust for doneness. In a bowl mix escarole, cheese, bread crumbs & tabasco. Spread evenly on toasted bread and bake in a 425° oven for about 12 to 15 minutes or till cheese is melted & bubbly, stirring once to keep warm.

Random Ingredients: lobster,rigatoni pasta,chili powder,green cardamom pod,extra beef,green chili pepper,pesto sauce
title: Pasta With Seafood and Green Chile Pepper
ingredients: 400 g rigatoni pasta ( i use wholemeal spirals ) | 150 300 g extra lean ground beef or 150 g ground lamb | 1 green cardamom pod | 4 -8 fresh green chili peppers ( depending on taste ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon ground chili powder ( i add more to taste ) | 20 g purchased pesto sauce ( i use herbed pesto ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 green chili pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions. In a large pan, fry ground beef or lamb until no longer pink. Add the green chilies to the meat. Drain off excess fat. Add the chili powder, stir, then add pesto and heat through for 2 minutes. Add cooked rigatoni and stir well with meat mixture. Serve with slices parmesan cheese and fresh green chili slices.

title: Mussels in Lemon and Garlic
ingredients: 2 lbs mussels, scrubbed | 3 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, grated | 1 bay leaf | chopped spinach
instructions: Scrub mussels well and debeard them under cold running water, removing as much mussel fat as possible.. Heat oil, lemon rind and bay leaf slowly in a large frying pan or wok. Add cooked mussels and continue to stir and cook, shaking pan constantly for about 3 minutes. Do not overcook. Serve with chopped spinach.

title: Kale Chips
ingredients: 4 cups kale, coarsley chopped stems and all | 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, microwave kale for 1 to 2 minutes, or until tender.

title: Salmon with Cashew and Pesto Shells #RSC
ingredients: 1 cup fresh basil pesto | 1 1/2 tablespoons gin | 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 cup roasted salted cashews | 1 cup dry red wine | 1/2 lb fresh salmon, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 package shell pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. In a small bowl combine the basil pesto, gin, lettuce, cashews nuts, and red wine. Drain pasta and salmon and add to cheese sauce. Toss well and coat with the cheese sauce.

title: Mushroom Patties (Kofta)
ingredients: 1 package frozen breaded mushrooms ( approximately 2 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds, divided | 1 head napa cabbage, shredded | 1 teaspoon seasoned salt | 1 cup dry breadcrumbs | sweet breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f. Place the fresh whole mushrooms, 1/2 teaspoon of fenugreek seeds and 1 cup of shredded napa cabbage in mixing bowl. Sprinkle with seasoned salt, then stir in remaining stuffing. Place the mixture in a baking dish, sprinkle with bread crumbs and top with sweet breadcrumbs. Cover with foil and bake until cheese is melted and the mixture is heated through, about 40 minutes.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin, 4 to 6 inches thick ( trimmed of all fat ) | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings ( or 2 tbsp. oil ) | parsnip
instructions: In a large skillet, cook bacon over high heat until the fat is rendered. Remove the bacon and set aside. Pat tenderloins dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat the bacon drippings in the skillet over medium heat until very hot. Sear the tenderloins on all sides until they are browned, about 10 - 15 minutes. Remove tenderloins from skillet and set aside until cool enough to handle, about 15 minutes.

title: Peruvian Hot Red Pepper Sauce(Mint)
ingredients: 3 habanero peppers, seeded | 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh mint | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Place peppers, mint, vinegar, and chiles in a food processor, and process until smooth, about 20 seconds.

title: Scallops Florentine(France)
ingredients: 1/2 lb spinach, steamed | 3 tablespoons vermouth | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 lb sea scallops | 1/3 cup sliced blanched almond
instructions: Combine vinegar and 1/4 cup water in small saucepan, bring to boil over medium high heat. Cover, simmer about 3 minutes. Drain well. Thoroughly rinse spinach, return to saucepan. Add vermouth, stir until dissolved. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally til just barely bubbly. Heat remaining 1 1/2 tablespoon oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over high heat until just smoking. Add scallops, cook about 2 minutes or until just beginning to turn opaque, about 2 minutes. Add spinach and almond, cook 1 minute or until scallops are just opaque, stirring constantly. Serve immediately.

title: Lime and Brussels Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout | 1/2 cup natural soymilk | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 large lime, zested and juiced
instructions: Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to the boil. Add the brussels sprouts and cook, uncovered, for 3 - 4 minutes, or until just tender. Transfer the sprouts to a large serving bowl and mix in the soy milk. Add the sugar and zest of the lime. Cover and refrigerate until needed. Taste for seasoning and serve.

title: Onion-Chanterelle Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 lb chanterelle mushroom, sliced | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Sprinkle chanterelles with salt and keep aside. Saute onion in 1t water until brown, then remove from the pan. Saute mushrooms and sun dried tomatoes in remaining water. Pour mushrooms into a blender and blend. Return mushroom mixture back to the pan. Garnish with fresh chives to taste.

Random Ingredients: lime,cumin powder,beef bouillon cube,marinara sauce,chicken broth,walnut,lemon,sherry
title: Zesty Beef Satay Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/4 cup dried shredded lemon, rind or 1/4 cup lime rind | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint or 1/4 cup fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped walnuts
instructions: Cut the meat into bite size pieces and place in crock pot with all other ingredients except walnuts. Set crock pot on high and cook for 4 hours. If you would like a chunkier dish, omit all ingredient except for the walnuts and serve this in a jar with tight fitting lid for dipping. Note, the lemon and lime rind should be the rind of lemon. This is not an approved ingredient and is not a part of the recipe.

title: Rum and Pepper Marinated Broccoli
ingredients: 1/3 cup currants, soaked for 5 minutes and drained | 1/3 cup dark rum | 3 tablespoons cumin | 2 bags fresh broccoli florets
instructions: Place all ingredients except broccoli in a blender add 1/2 cup water and process at high speed until smooth. Pour mixture over broccoli in a shallow baking dish sprinkle evenly with remaining crumb mixture. Sprinkle reserved crumb mixture over top. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 2 hours or as long as overnight stirring occasionally, drain, if desired.

title: Mixed Chowder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons semolina | 2 tablespoons instant hominy | 6 ounces hominy, drained | 1 teaspoon curry | 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 2 ounces cheddar cheese | 2 ounces white chocolate | 1 tablespoon crumbled roquefort cheese
instructions: Place the semolina in the coffee filter or a coffee filter and filter it from any air bubbles.

Random Ingredients: custard powder,taco seasoning mix,tuna steak,italian parsley,cherry,superfine sugar,maple syrup,yellow cornmeal
title: Sweet and Savory Tuna
ingredients: 5 tuna steaks, cut into bite-size pieces | 1/8 cup light cornmeal | 1/8 cup spelt flour | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons prepared custard powder | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 -2 cherry, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a heavy baking pan with baking spray. Arrange half of the tuna in pan and sprinkle with half of the cornmeal. Sprinkle over tuna and bake for 20 to 30 minutes, until tajine is bubbly and the tuna is cooked through. Serve on warm plates with a drizzling of creamy maple syrup.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,puff pastry,raisin,white wine,creme fraiche,celery,fennel seed
title: Faggots Parisienne
ingredients: 4 sheets puff pastry | 1 tablespoon white wine | 3 tablespoons creme fraiche | 3 ounces raisins | 1 ounce celery, very finely diced | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 3 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f roll the pastry sheets on a lightly floured surface. Using 1 sheet of pastry, cut out circles of approx 10 cm in diameter and then use to line the base and sides of an ovenproof dish with the puff pastry rounds. Brush the pastry with water and sprinkle them with white wine followed by a glug of crème fraîche, then scatter over the diced celery and raisins. Place in the oven and bake for 15 minutes. Mix the fennel seeds in with the flour and then scatter it over the top of the pastry. Return to the oven for a further 15 minutes for a well and crusty top.

title: Spaetzle
ingredients: 3/4 cup potato starch | olive oil, as needed
instructions: Combine potato starch and enough water to make pastry dough. Cut in squares using a knife. Heat oil in pan over medium high heat. Drop potato starch mixture by tbsp by tbsp into hot oil. When crisp, drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,ice water,anise seed,tomato paste,pimiento
title: Italian Flavor  (Salsa Di Anise)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 3 tablespoons ice water | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 ounce pimiento ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon whole anise seed ( optional )
instructions: Blend all ingredients together until it comes to a light consistency. Serve in a glass bowl.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,mirin,thai fish sauce,clear honey,chili flake,filling,pork
title: Easy Filling Idlis
ingredients: 1 green cardamom pod | 2 teaspoons clear honey | 1 tablespoon sweeten anchovy-flavored fish sauce or 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon mirin | 0.5 packet thai style seal-tight egg roll filling | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes | fat, for deep frying
instructions: Fill a bowl with ice cold water. Place cardamom and honey in a small heavy based pan over low heat, and cover. Stir frequently until honey dissolves. About 2 minutes. Remove and discard cardamom pod. Strain through cheesecloth over ice cold water. Add anchovy paste. Stir until combined. Stir in mirin and seal sealing packet. Keep refrigerated for at least 1 hour, for better flavor. Drain through a fine sieve. Fill an ice cream maker with dough, then press 1/4 of the filling into center. Close and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions. Makes 24 idli fingers. Enjoy updated note, i often remove the inner membrane from the egg roll while still attached to the center of the dough, just before filling. I usually fill it with very dry instant coffee granules in small batches, or use a small scooped ice cream scoop or scoop of filling, a handful of hot water, and/or gingerroot or any spices that have been ground into fine powder. I use only the cardamom, so when i make these, i usually use about 2 teaspoons of ground cardamom and 1 teaspoon cardamom pod. I also freeze some dough on the side for later use, like a za'atar, or a small squirt from a can of spicy jalapenos, or an almond and walnut filling. I use only the cardamom and honey mixture. To make a small batch of filling for a sandwich, i use a teaspoon of chili flakes. Cut the top of the egg roll into 5 even half moons, then flatten each half between your thumb and finger. Brush with water and bake until lightly browned. I usually leave the edges plain, as it will crisp up in a few seconds. I do this a few times since making these. After warming the cookies up, put them on a cookie sheet, and brush them with more water. I place them in a 300 degree oven to keep warm until all of the egg rolls are baked. These cookies freeze very well and don't stick together and go back once you're out of ingredients.

title: Aluminum Packets
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, any color, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | aluminum foil | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees f. Place aluminum foil on foil. Place 1 pepper into the cavity of each packet. Spray each packet evenly with cooking oil. Bake the packets in the preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the peppers are tender and the foil is slightly puffy.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,sage leaf,lima bean,mushroom cap,dark brown sugar,zucchini
title: Italian Plum Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 lb mushroom caps ( about 2 heads ) | 1 lb zucchini, cubed | 4 slices white breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon ground sage leaf | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 can white navy beans
instructions: Prepare the plump fresh mushrooms and trim off any discolored outer woody stems. Slice lengthwise and clean mushrooms. Cut zucchini into thin slices. Remove the woody stems from the mushrooms. Add all to a crockpot with the breadcrumbs and sage and stir to mix. Cover and cook on high for 3 - 4 hours. Uncover for the last 45 minutes of cooking to brown them. When done, remove from heat to place in a serving dish and keep warm on low in a covered pot or in a 300 watt oven. Note, you can save and stuff up to 5 plum beans.

title: Picante Zucchini (Aka Low Fat Zucchini Beans)
ingredients: 1/4 lb dried apricot preserves | 1/2 cup chunky salsa, divided into 2-4 equal portions | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1 medium zucchini
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the zucchini in a pan and bring to boil over high heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat and cover for 10 minutes. Meanwhile cut the zucchini into 1/3- to 1/2 inch slices, removing the outer skin if necessary. Scoop out the zucchini flesh by draining it from the center of the zucchini chunks and leaving a little whole to fill the bowl. Toss the zucchini slices in the remaining salsa. Serve immediately.

title: Beer and Berries
ingredients: 12 ounces beer | 1 1/2 teaspoons butter | 2 bunches fresh berries ( such as strawberries, raspberries or blackberries ) | 1 tablespoon olive, puree or 1 tablespoon milk
instructions: The beer should be light. Stir in the butter and pour into a heat proof cup. Let sit at room temperature for at least 6 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,halibut fillet,green pepper,herb,self raising flour
title: Fish Baked in Seasoned Vegetables
ingredients: 4 halibut fillets | 2 cups self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs, dried | 2 tablespoons mixed italian seasoning | 1 green pepper, deseeded and deseeded chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Grease a shallow baking dish. Beat the flour with the seasonings and seasoning. Dip the fish fillets in flour, shaking off excess. Line the bottom of the dish with fish and spoon vegetables evenly on top. Bake in oven for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Gruyere-Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 ripe tomatoes, halved lengthwise and placed on a baking sheet | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 ounces gouda cheese, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit | 4 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the tomato halves cut side down on a baking sheet. In a medium bowl, toss together cheeses, dried fruit and thyme.

title: Spicy Cauliflower With Hot Chile & Green Chilney
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower | 2 2 large jalapeno peppers or 2 large mild green chili | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped green chili | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground grainy mustard | 2 tablespoons low-fat mustard
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°f. Cut the head of cauliflower lengthwise into 5 or 6 even sections, depending on the size. Scrub the core or florets away from the head. Cut off the tops if you wish. Cut a large core section from the cauliflower under running water. Cut the cauliflower down the center. Then core the leaves, if you wish. Place the core section and leaves in a glass baking dish, or a crock of your choice. Slice the chiles lengthwise, remove the seeds, and thinly slice. Add the seeds, chilies and mustard to the water in your microwave or the microwave. Place the coated cauliflower in the microwave and microwave the cauliflower on high for 20 minutes. When the cauliflower is cooked, remove from the microwave & stir in about half the chopped green chilies. Add the remaining chopped green chilies and mix. Serve immediately.

title: Greek Pea Dip
ingredients: 2 cans peas | 1 cup italian dressing | 3/4 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1 tablespoon fish stock
instructions: In large bowl, mix together all the ingredients and stir until smooth and creamy.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,fennel bulb,salmon,heavy cream,black bean,parsnip,tomato juice,pecan
title: Smoked Salmon and Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentil | 1/2 cup black beans | 1/4 lb smoked salmon, drained | 1/3 cup chopped pecans | 1/3 cup fresh parsnip, chopped fine | 2 teaspoons fennel bulbs, packed, chopped fine | 1 cup sun-dried tomato juice | 1/2 cup heavy cream, whipped until stiff peaks form
instructions: Drain and rinse your can of black beans. Rinse and drain your red lentils.. Place all ingredients on a baking sheet, and bake at 350°f about 25 minutes. Turning your can of black beans, when they are slightly browned, remove and turn off the oven. Remove your can of black beans from oven, place in a colander, sprinkle the top with salt, then let sit until black beans become like your favorite texture, then remove from the colander. Repeat with your second can of black beans, place in a pot with enough water to cover and bring to a boil, simmer until soft. It is important to not overcook them. You will have mushy black beans. Drain and cool. Scoop out the flesh, leaving shells on, in a medium sized bowl. Chop the flesh into small bits, using a fork on your cutting board and a large spoon. Add chopped parsnip, fennel and sun dried tomatoes, fold in the can of black beans. Let stand for several hours or overnight. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Creamy Broccoli and Celery Salad
ingredients: 6 broccoli florets | 1 cup celery, chopped | 1/2 cup torn broccoli floret | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves
instructions: Steam broccoli and celery leaves 5 minutes or till just tender crisp. Cool. Combine with remaining salad ingredients. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,wheat flour,yellow pepper,red pepper,italian bread crumb,lemon peel,phyllo dough
title: Roasted Italian Peppers
ingredients: 1 jar roasted red peppers | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup dry italian-style seasoned bread crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel | 1 dash ground red pepper | 3 packages frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Drain and discard peppers, and cut up finely. Mix juice, flour, bread crumbs, lemon peel, red pepper, and italian seasoning in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Lay each phyllo sheet on a lightly floured board. Dot with 1/2 cup butter, and lightly roll each sheet in flour on all sides. Spread peppers evenly on phyllo. Bake in the preheated oven until phyllo is crisp, 35 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,thyme,rice wine,cashew,vegetable bouillon cube,chili bean
title: Caribbean Chili
ingredients: 1/2 vegetable bouillon cube | 1/2 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon chili bean, ground | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon cashews | 1/8 - 1/4 cup rice wine
instructions: In saucepan place all ingredients and simmer until the beans are tender.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,red leaf lettuce,mango,arborio rice,parsley leaf,pimiento,extra virgin olive oil,lettuce
title: Mango and Rice Salad With Garlic & Green Onions
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup peeled cooked mango | 2 cups thinly sliced red leaf lettuce | 1 jar diced pimientos | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 head red leaf lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces | 8 large lettuce leaves | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Combine rice and mango in a large bowl. Toss with lettuce, pimentos, parsley, and lettuce. Drizzle with olive oil. Serve.

Random Ingredients: salmon,worcestershire sauce,cumin seed,black mustard seed,icing sugar,wheat flour
title: Spiced Salmon and Mustard Seed Fritters
ingredients: 600 g salmon, cleaned and chopped into 2. 5 cm dice | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons icing sugar | 3 1/2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 200 g whole wheat flour
instructions: In a pestle, dry fry the cumin seeds, mustard seeds, icing sugar and worcestershire, stirring with a metal spoon to combine, for 2 minutes until well mixed, then cool lightly. Add the flour to the prepared mix. Stir well until it forms a firm dough. Divide the mixture into 5 balls, then flatten the portions slightly. Roll each ball between your palms so they form round patties of roughly 2 inches across. Cover and refrigerate for one hour or until firm. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees. Place the salmon patties on an oiled or lined baking tray. Bake for 20 minutes, then turn and bake for a further 10 minutes, or until cooked. Remove from the oven and leave to cool on a wire rack. Serve the patties with jam.

title: Shredded Lamb With Okra and Caper
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb shoulder, trimmed of fat and cut into 2-inch lengths | 1 cup yoghurt | 2 ounces cotija cheese, crumbled ( or feta cheese ) | 1/4 cup milk | 2 tablespoons capers, rinsed and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, chopped | 7 ounces okra, trimmed and cut into 24 pieces | 4 tablespoons butter
instructions: Place the meat in a large pan or dutch oven, and cover with water. Bring to the boil, and then partially cover and simmer slowly for 1½ hours or until the meat is very tender. Remove from heat, cover and strain the liquid, then reserve stock. When the meat is very tender, remove from the pan and keep warm while you prepare the yogurt sauce and mint sauce. Combine yoghurt, cheese, milk and capers in a small bowl. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. In a large sauté pan, melt butter over medium heat and add okra, and cook, stirring occasionally for 10 minutes, and sprinkle with salt. Add yoghurt sauce and stir until heated through. Dice meat and stir into the sauce. Ladle the meat onto serving plates or a heated platter, sprinkle with the remaining olives and serve with salads.

title: Peach and Citrus Fish
ingredients: 1 lb firm-tender white fish fillet | 1 1/2 cups peach brandy | 10 sprigs fresh cilantro | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place fish on a cookie sheet. Broil 6 inches from heat for about 8 minutes or until fish turn opaque and flakes easily with a fork. Remove fish from oven and stir in brandy. Broil 5 minutes until slightly reduced. Scrape brandy mixture over fillet, garnish with cilantro sprigs and top with oyster sauce.

Random Ingredients: red potato,purpose white flour,worcestershire sauce,oil vegetable,cocoa powder,mix,flat leaf parsley
title: Lazy Chocolate Cakes
ingredients: 6 red potatoes, about 1 1/2 lbs ( depending on size and thickness ) | 1 cup all-purpose white flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder, preferably dutch process | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce ( optional but highly recommended ) | salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon oil, preferably vegetable, plus more as needed | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut out the central centre of each potato, using a spoon to scoop out the centre portion. When it shimmers, sprinkle each round with the flour/cocoa mixture and place in one layer. Place the tin on the top rack of the oven and bake until well browned in color and the cake tester inserted in the centre comes out dry, about 20 minutes. Place cooked cakes on a plate, spread with the reserved flour paste and garnish with the fresh parsley. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: catfish fillet,purpose flour,skirt steak,ice,ha avocado,tomato sauce,parsley leaf,demerara sugar
title: Chunky Mexican Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup ice, or as needed | 1 pound lean strip steaks, pounded thin | 1 cup tomato sauce, or to taste | 2 hass avocados, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons tomato paste with capers | 1 1/2 tablespoons demerara sugar | fresh parsley leaves for garnish
instructions: Mix flour and ice in a shallow bowl. Press steaks into flour, shaking off excess. Heat tomato sauce in a skillet over medium high heat until bubbly. Mix avocados, tomato paste, and demerara sugar into hot sauce. Slowly stir hot sauce into skillet until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat to low.

title: Cholay
ingredients: 3 lbs parsnips, peeled & cut into chunks | 1 can enchilada sauce, heated | 1 bottle barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup blackstrap molasses | 1 orange, sliced into thin slivers
instructions: Cook parsnips in boiling water until tender and done. Drain and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes or until syrupy and no longer cloudy. If using whole parsnips, peel, cut into chunks and place in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,saffron strand,french bread,vegetable broth
title: Cheddar and Saffron French Bread Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup saffron strand | 3/4 cup vegetable broth or 3/4 cup chicken stock | 3/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 4 slices crusty french bread, toasted about 2 x 1/4-inch
instructions: Sprinkle saffron on a piece of aluminum foil, let stand about 20 minutes or until warm, turning occasionally. Soften the saffron in the stock. Place 1 slice of bread in each soup bowl and cover evenly with some of the cheese. Serve with salt and pepper if desired.

title: Guilt Free Beef Stock
ingredients: 2 quarts homemade beef stock | 2 tablespoons hot sauce, to taste
instructions: In a pressure cooker, combine the hot sauce and beef stock. Secure lid securely, bring to high pressure over medium heat. Reduce heat to low. Cook 5 minutes after pressure begins to build inside the vent,. Remove from heat.

title: Mexican Bacon-Wrapped Fajitas
ingredients: 4 slices bacon strips | 1/2 cup coconut extract | 1/3 cup molasses | 2 -3 teaspoons mexican oregano | salt and pepper | 1 -2 cup dried apricot, halved | 1 lb assorted fresh cranberries, washed and halved
instructions: Place bacon strips in a large heavy skillet and cook over medium heat until crispy, turning once. Drain all but about 1 teaspoon bacon fat from skillet, leaving 2 tablespoons bacon fat in skillet. Pour in molasses and molasses. Sprinkle with oregano, salt and pepper. Stir briefly. Add fruit and bring to a boil, cook over medium heat 5 - 10 minutes, or until syrupy. Serve hot with chips, corn chips or fajitas.

title: Prawns Shrimps
ingredients: 24 large prawns | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/ 450°f. Rinse prawns and bring back to the boil. Place the flour and cayenne in a shallow dish. Place the prawns in one shallow dish and coat evenly with flour. Press the prawns into the flour using your fingers and then shake off any excess flour. Bake for 25 - 15 minutes until the prawns are just cooked through and the flour has lightly browned.

title: Oysters on the Half Shell
ingredients: 1 pint cherry, blanched in | 1 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Drain the cherries and place in a bowl. Add oyster sauce and stir well to coat the cherries. Chill until serving.

title: Italian Sausage With Avocado Puree and Honey
ingredients: 4 links mild italian sausage | 1 cup golden syrup | 1 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 3 avocados, halved
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f cook sausage on a greased baking sheet till browned evenly. Remove sausage & place with marinade in a blender & puree to desired consistency. Cut avocados in half & remove stone from skin. Cut halves in half again & remove pit using a small spoon. Cut two slits in the top of each avocado half & top each with avocado. Pour sauce into a glass baking dish & arrange sausage. Top with avocado puree. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake, covered, for 30 minutes, or until golden & bubbly.

title: Kolokithaya Ki Rangoon (Fruit Treat)
ingredients: 150 g marshmallows | 150 g sultanas | 3 tablespoons cashews | 4 -5 epazote leaves, crushed | icing sugar, to sprinkle
instructions: Soak marshmallows and sultanas in a cup of water for 10 - 15 minutes until swollen. Drain. Add cashews and epazote leaves. Mix together well. Refrigerate for 12 - 15 minutes until required. Serve, sprinkled with icing sugar.

title: Japanese Lebkuchen (Oats With Cheese)
ingredients: 3/4 cup soymilk | 1/2 cup miracle whip | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 2 teaspoons grated fresh lemon rind | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/8 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 cup cooking oats | 1/4 cup grated kefalotiri cheese or 1/4 cup grated kefalotiri
instructions: Make kefalotiri cheese. Combine all ingredients and stir until well combined. Store in a covered container in refrigerator.

title: Spice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup white rice flour, fine grind | 1/2 chili pepper, ground ( or more, to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Place all ingredients into a bowl and mix well until well blended. Using hands, roll out half the dough into a thin sausage shape, about 3/4 inch in diameter, turning to coat evenly. Cut into fingers or wedges. Place in an uncooked wok, cover, and steam over low heat for 5 minutes. Remove cover and stir. Continue cooking over high heat for 10 minutes or until liquid thickens, shaking wok occasionally for even cooking. Turn off heat and allow to sit for 1 hour. Store in airtight container, refrigerate, and use within 3 days. Makes 10 - 15 smaller, less spicy cookies. Note, you may substitute any ground meat for the chile. The turmeric has been added as well, along with the other spices, and you may or may not be able to find turmeric in the spice mixture. Chili oil can be substituted wherever you have ground meat.

title: Sukatchewan Spicy Peanut Linguine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 3/4 cup dry-roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped, divided | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 lb linguine
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling salted water according to package directions. While linguine cooks, stir together tomato paste, 2/3 cup of peanuts and celery seed in a small bowl. Add tomato paste mixture to pasta and stir well. Cook to al dente, about 5 minutes. Drain linguine and add to pasta. Toss to coat with sauce.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,cantaloupe,pecorino romano cheese,thyme,beef tenderloin,dark brown sugar,dark chocolate,half cream

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f heat a large nonstick frypan over medium low heat, and coat with cooking spray. Add onion and cook until golden brown, about 20 minutes. Stir in the tomato soup, beef, thyme or oregano, pecorino and sugar. Bring to a boil. Cover and transfer to oven to keep warm. Bake until meat thermometer reaches 130 150°f for medium rare, about 75 minutes per pound for medium, 25 minutes for medium well. Transfer beef to a cutting board and let rest for 10 minutes. Remove meat slices from sauce and cut into thin slices. Place on a serving platter. Top with pepper sauce. Calabrian pepper sauce, place chocolate in a heavy medium saucepan over medium heat. Heat, stirring often with a heat proof rubber spatula, until melted and smooth. To serve, pour melted chocolate over beef. To serve, add the melted beef and a few pepper sauce spoonfuls of pepper sauce to each slice of beef and serve.

title: Pesto Cabbage With Peas--(Diabetic Diet)

instructions: Cook peas according to package’s directions. Drain and rinse cabbage and celery.

instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended. Seal in a sealed container.

title: Hot Buttermilk Bacon Rolls

instructions: Pre heat oven to 150c/300°f. Butter & line two baking trays with baking paper. instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut peppers into strips about 1/3 inch wide and 1/3 inch wide, 2 inches long. Add peppers and cook, stirring, until they are just beginning to caramelize, about 2 minutes. Stir in food coloring until just blended. Lay phyllo pastry in skillet. Cover with one layer of phyllo, brushing each with some of the reserved pepper oil. Bake at 425 degrees f for about 15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and bubbling. Set aside on a plate and cool slightly. Once cooled, arrange peppers on a serving platter.

instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place apples and salsa in a baking dish and toss with the lemon rind, juice and zest. Stir in ricotta, pears, bell pepper and molasses. Pour into a 9x8 inch square baking dish and broil, uncovered, until cheese bubbles and browns, about 12 minutes. Serve.

title: Christmas Bites

instructions: Place all the dry ingredients into a bowl and stir. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray and set aside. Shape the mix into 24 small round balls about 3cm in diameter. Flatten each ball slightly with a rolling pin onto the prepared tray and brush the tops with plenty of oil. Bake for 15 - 15 minutes in a preheated 180c oven until golden brown. Serve hot, with salad or crackers.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,fennel bulb,caper,cranberry sauce,red chili powder,yellow onion,poblano chile,onion powder
title: Pueblo Style Hot Sauce

instructions: Heat up your grill to medium/medium hot. Place poblano, fennel, & onion in a large bowl and pour seasoning over the vegetables. Mix it all together really well. Take the skillet out of the heat and stir in the cranberry. When the cranberry and cranberry sauce is bubbling, stir in the red chili powder and onion powder then take out the lid and add it to the bell peppers. Stir to coat the bell peppers with the spices, then transfer back into the warm skillet and stir on low heat until hot and bubbly. I serve this with corn or beans.

title: Raspberry and Cilantro Rice Krispies Treats

instructions: Heat the barbecue grill for medium high heat.

instructions: Combine rice flour and 1/2 cup water in a large shallow pan. Using your fingers, push flours into a thick, flatish paste. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium heat. Spray the capsicum with oil and sauté for 3 to 5 minutes or until capsicum crisp.
