title: Potato Rice Crepes and Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs | 1 package refrigerated crepes | 3/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup salsa | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier or 1 1/2 tablespoons other dry liqueur | red potatoes, cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 1/2 cups cooked boneless, skinless chicken breasts or 1 1/2 cups cooked turkey, slices | 4 sandwich buns, split lengthwise
instructions: Prepare 2 plates, 8 in each, 13 in each. Place 1 crepe in each plate. Combine bread crumbs, 1/2 cup bread crumbs, 1/3 cup salsa, grand marnier and salt and pepper to taste. Spoon 1/4 cup picante in center of each. Top with 1/8 of potatoes, 1/4 of chicken slices and 1/8 of each remaining picante. Fold in sides of crepes. Set aside. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cuban Grill Lemony Baked Ham
ingredients: 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce, plus | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1/3 cup orange peel ( chopped in small pieces ) | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 1 1/2 cups diced ham | 3 tablespoons shredded dried citron | 1/4 cup tequila
instructions: Preheat oven to 300ºf. Brush a 1 quart ovenproof baking dish with 1 tablespoons teriyaki sauce. Dice orange peel into small bite size pieces and put around ham. Put 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce and remaining 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce over ham. Mix orange peel pieces with lime juice in small bowl. Spread in single layer in baking dish. Bake 35 - 40 minutes, or until ham is done. In a small bowl combine remaining 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce and shredded basil and stir well. Drizzle mixture over ham before serving.

title: Tabbouleh
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked bulgur | 3/4 cup quick-cooking oil | 1 3/4 cups chicken stock or 1 3/4 cups broth | 1/2 cup flaked coconut flakes
instructions: Place ingredients in medium saucepan, cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,feta cheese,vinegar,white wine,salt black pepper,fish stock,cauliflower floret
title: Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 1 lb cauliflower floret | 1/4 lb lean sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 3/4 cup dry white wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt-free vinegar | 3 1/2 cups fish stock | feta cheese or feta cheese, to dust
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into long strips and cook them together with 1/4 cup of the vinegar in a 3 1/2 quart saucepan with a pinch of salt for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the fish stock, cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes. Drain the cauliflower and mix it with the soup. Season to taste with salt and pepper. When ready to serve, dust the top with feta cheese or mix with crumbled rye bread crumbs.

title: Wasabi English White Vinegar(wasabi Marlin)
ingredients: 1 ounce wasabi ( japanese wasabi paste ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar ( cider vinegar are more readily available in the asian food area )
instructions: Scoop out the inside portion of isabi or leave the shells off if desired. Add the wasabi to the vinegar. Pour the vinegar over the wasabi and let it stand to soften. Pour as is or refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,caraway seed,enchilada sauce,toothpick,cannellini bean,dark sesame oil,chili flake,lemongrass
title: Tortellini Beans With Lemongrass
ingredients: 16 toothpicks ( soaked at least 30 minutes before using ) | 2 cans cannellini beans, reserve liquid | 1 stalk lemongrass, crushed | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons chili flakes | 3 teaspoons caraway seeds, crushed | 3 bay leaves | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Mix bean liquid in a bowl with the lemon grass, sesame oil, chili flakes, caraway seeds, and bay leaves. Add 1 can of enchilada sauce and 1 can of cannellini beans. Toss to coat. Place bean mixture in a large pot. Toss with remaining can of enchilada sauce. Cover and simmer on low heat for about 45 minutes or until heated through. Serve on toasted tortillini shells or crostini of your choice.

title: English 75
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Put the cream into a small heatproof bowl. Put the vinegar in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir to dissolve into the cream and bring to the boil. As soon as it boils, remove from the heat. Cover and leave to rest for at least three hours. Remove the bowl from the heat and whisk for 1 minute to cool it slightly. This will prevent it from separating. Whisk again and add the vinegar. Whisk again again for 5 minutes to loosen the creamy thickened cream. When you are ready to serve, take the cream out of the bowl and pour some of the hot cream into a small serving bowl, stirring to loosen and dilute the cream. Add to the bowl with the creamy cream and stir gently until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Note, this can also be served with roast chicken pieces to use as a spread for grilled salmon, oysters, or as an accompaniment to savoy cabbage.

title: Devilled Crab
ingredients: 18 ounces crab, peeled, cleaned and dried | 1 dash hot sauce
instructions: Put crab, sauce and any other desired stuffing under the bread. Close lid securely and turn to brown.

title: Garlic Steak Salad With Savory Sauteed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon gluten, for vegans like me | 3 teaspoons gluten ( gluten free optional ) | 1 tablespoon stir-fry sauce ( gluten free 1 1/2 tbsp ) | 5 ounces mushrooms, sliced ( or baby bellas ) | 2 cups cooked torn fresh escarole | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 1 fresh sage leaf, cut into thin strips
instructions: Preheat a grill. In a small bowl, stir together 1 tb of the gluten and the stir fry sauce. Brush olive oil on the grill or broiler grate. Add the mushrooms and toss until heated through, about 3 minute add the greens, toss and set aside. Brush the remaining tablespoon of the gluten on the steak and cook until just cooked to desired doneness with twizz, 2 - 3 minute remove the steak from the grill or broiler and allow to rest for 5 minute slice diagonally on the bias and drizzle with the sauteed soy sauce, tossing to coat. Serve.

title: Basil Pappardelle
ingredients: 1 box orzo pasta | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,broth,pinto bean,green cardamom pod,mango,lima bean,jalapeno
title: Pinto Bean and Mango Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon finely chopped jalapeno | 2/3 cup pinto beans | 1/3 cup lima beans | 1/3 cup coconut milk | 1 small mango, peeled and diced ( about 3/4 cup ) | 4 medium green cardamom pods, cracked | 3 cups chicken broth | 2 cans unsweetened coconut milk
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until beans are tender and liquid has evaporated, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Place coconut milk in a blender and blend until smooth. Bring broth to a boil. Add coconut milk, remaining ingredients and cooked beans.

title: Brothy Thyme Chive Chive Oil
ingredients: 1 cup raisins | 4 -5 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock or 1 1/2 cups broth | 2 -5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place the raisins and thyme in a heat proof bowl and pour boiling water over them. Let soak for about 10 minutes, then drain completely. Dry the chives and herbs on paper towels. Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan. Add the chives and thyme and toss over medium heat until the herbs are just tender. Don't over cook the herbs or they can dry the chives and sprigs up the oil. Pour the stock over the chives and herbs and serve immediately.

title: Sliced Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops, 1 1/2 inch thick ( can use a combination ) | 2 chayotes ( the small green beans ) | 14 ounces canned chopped clams, undrained | 1 apple, peeled and chopped | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Place the pork chops in a 9x13 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes until the pork is browned and cooked and an instant read thermometer reads 170°. Remove pork from oven. Drain pork chops from dish and set aside, reserving fat in pan. Chop chayote and clams. Coarsely chop the apples and place in a large bowl with the reserved pork fat. Toss with the diced apples, chayote, and clams. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes until chops are heated through and the apple coating is fragrant and slightly crisp. Sprinkle with almonds just before serving.

title: Pasta With Heirloom Tomatoes
ingredients: 16 all large heirloom tomatoes | 1 lb gemelli pasta, cooked
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

instructions: In a large pot combine beef, chili paste, broth, ketchap manis, and tomatoes. Bring to a boil.

title: Dukkah (Dukkah)

instructions: Add all ingredients to a pot. Cook, stirring from time to time, over medium low temperature, for 30 minutes, or until the mixture is thick and smooth. Allow to stand about 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Thighs with Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups shredded bread | 12 large skinless chicken thighs | 1 package button mushrooms, sliced | 1 grated lemon, zest and juice of | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 24 wonton skins ( any will work )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix all ingredients. Place 2 tablespoons of mixture on each chicken thigh and wrap each with one wrapper. Secure with toothpick if desired. Add to a greased baking pan. Bake on middle rack until cooked through, approximately 20 minutes. Serve warm w/plastic or paper towels.

title: Linguine With Canadian Bacon and Guacamole
ingredients: 1/2 hass avocado, peeled and pitted | 1/2 cup canadian bacon, slivered | 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( or more to taste ) | 1 lb linguine
instructions: Mash avocado with fork. Cook linguine according to package directions. While pasta is cooking, mix together canadian bacon slivers and hot sauce in a small bowl. Toss with pasta. Serve right away.

title: Simple, Easy, Herbed Chicken

instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix eggs and thyme together in a bowl. Add chicken pieces, coat well with egg mixture. Place on baking sheet, cut sides down. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Turn over, bake for 15 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,scallop,beef,hot water,vinegar,soy sauce,beef broth,shrimp paste
title: Seafood in Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb shrimp paste, cut into chunks | 1/2 lb scallops ( or shrimp ) | 2 bottles beef broth | 1 bottle soy sauce | 1/2 head garlic, peeled and cut large cloves | 1/2 cup vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons sugar or 2 -3 tablespoons brown sugar | hot water ( as needed )
instructions: If this recipe was originally made for shrimp, substitute shrimp, scallops, or shrimp. Bring beef broth to a boil in a saucepan. Serve with rice.

title: Simple French Onion Dip
ingredients: 18 -24 ounces liquid smoke | 24 -36 lbs celery, washed and dried
instructions: On a cutting board place the dry celery and slice the celery very thinly. You can also do this by using a knife or sharp kitchen scissors. Place in the jar and add liquid smoke. Close jar well. Keep in refrigerator for 4 - 5 months. Enjoy to keep for longer storage, keep in closed container in fridge.

title: Limoncello and Peaches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs firm ripe peaches | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, minced | 1/2 cup limoncello
instructions: Cut peaches in half, remove pits, and remove fruit from shells. In a 1 cup glass measuring cup, stir together parsley and limoncello. Spoon 1 tablespoon limoncello mixture into each peach half, place two peach halves on top of the mixture and press down with fingers to flatten slightly and to form a slightly rounded mound slightly larger than a golf ball. Serve at once.

title: New England Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 can crushed clams with juice | 2 cups bottled clam juice | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan over medium heat, combine the clam juice, clam juice, and baking powder. Heat to boiling.

title: Broccoli Toast
ingredients: 2 slices bread ( crusty ) | 2 teaspoons chopped broccoli | 1 teaspoon crushed ice or 1 teaspoon unsweetened pineapple flavoring ( optional )
instructions: Place bread slices in a shallow dish. Top with chopped broccoli and crushed ice. Sprinkle top with desired amount of other toppings.

title: Lemon Sauce for Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 cup lemon juice
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan, whisk cornstarch, lemon juice and remaining 1/4 cup water until combined and bubbly. Cook over medium high heat, stirring until thickened.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,romaine lettuce,nutmeg,bird eye chile,coffee,yeast cake,garlic salt
title: Grilled Chiles and Coffee on a Bed of Romaine
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups coffee, room temperature ( or your favorite coffee ) | 1 1/4 lbs yeast cakes ( like sure stick yeast ) | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs fresh birds eye chiles, stemmed, rinsed, and slit lengthwise ( or jalapeno chiles, deveined, or green bell pepper ) | 2 - 4 cups shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the coffee and yeast cakes. Let stand for 10 minutes. Mix the rest of the ingredients in a large bowl, then add the yeast mixture and mix well. Cover and let rise in a warm place until it has doubled in size about 45 minutes to 2 hours total.. Preheat the grill to medium. Spread the chiles on skewers and brush with cooking oil. Place on the grill, close the lid, and cook 6 minutes, basting with the chile mixture. Turn over and cook 6 more or 8 minutes until soft and lightly charred on all sides. Serve directly from the pan as an accompaniment to grilled meat, or store for later use.

instructions: Arrange the grapes on four dinner plates. Sprinkle salad dressing mix over grapes and nuts, stir and set aside. Process orange halves through food processor with 1/3 cup of the cornflour and 1/2 cup of the brandy. Divide the dressing evenly among the four serving plates and then sprinkle the grapes and nuts over. Cut a slit from one side of each grapefruit on the top of the grapefruit as if you were going to cut through the fruit. Sprinkle top with remaining teaspoon of cornflour.

title: Egg Salad II

instructions: Mix milk, vegetables, and chile together in a saucepan.

instructions: In a skillet, mix together Bourbon, vodka, garlic and pepper. Boil cauliflower till fork tender. Drain, and mix in with the sauce. Serve chilled.

title: Caesar (Kluisbec) Chicken Toast
ingredients: 1 slice white bread or 1 slice pita bread | 2 large egg yolks | 2 tablespoons chicken stock or 2 tablespoons vegetable stock ( 2 teaspoons ) | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1/2 cup red wine, about 2 tablespoons | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce plain yogurt ( or sour cream ) | 1/4 lb beef stew meat, trimmed of fat and cut into 1-inch cubes | 8 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Place bread, egg yolks, stock, anchovy paste and wine in a small saucepan and cook over moderately low heat, stirring, until sauce is thickened and the anchovy paste and oyster sauce have melted into the mixture, about 10 minutes. Arrange the beef in a shallow pan and pour about 1/4 cup of sauce over them and cook over low heat or grill them over moderate heat, stirring often, until the beef is just cooked then transfer the beef to a warm serving platter or individual dishes. Broil, covered, for 2 minutes, just until the cheese melts, then immediately broil for 3 minutes.

title: Chipotle Dip

instructions: Heat saucepan on the stove. Add paste and chipotles. Stir until combined. Turn off heat. Store tightly covered until ready to use.

instructions: Cut tofu crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Drain well and transfer tofu slices to a bowl.

title: Corni and Poblano Bean Burritos

instructions: In a slow cooker, combine cauliflower, kidney beans, poblano pepper, adobo seasoning, cinnamon, and honey. Pour the spaghetti sauce on top, and stir to combine. title: Chicken and Broccoli in Sour Cream (Sopa Con Nar-Tieta)
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts, with bone | 1 cup sour cream | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 tablespoon sour cream | pear, slices ( optional ) | broccoli floret ( optional ) | orange sweet bell pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cut 3 to 4 chicken breasts. Rinse under cold running water and pat dry. Cut 3 slits in each side of each breast. Combine sour cream, turmeric, dijon, mustard, sour cream and pepper.

instructions: Brown pork loins for 5 minutes, remove loins. Combine remaining ingredients and stir in lightly pork chops. Simmer about 20 minutes, remove pork chops from pan and place into an oblong baking dish or roasting pan. Cook at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Bourbon Chicken Lollipops
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons bourbon | 1/8 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1/4 cup plain oatmeal | 2 1/2 tablespoons brewed espresso coffee | 1/2 cup fat-free plain fat-free greek yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Slice each chicken breast into 1/4 inch thick strips, and place them in a lightly oiled bowl. instructions: Rinse rice.

title: Wainachsbury Dark Chocolate
ingredients: 500 g dark chocolate | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Wrap 200g of the dark chocolate in foil and tie with string. Stand in a cool, draught free spot for 12 hours or overnight. Line a 30 x 20cm slice tin, with baking paper, letting the excess drip off. Place 3 tbsp of the dark chocolate in to the bottom of the tin. Microwave the melted dark chocolate on 100% power, stir until melted, stir in the vinegar and pour into the tin. Tap the tin lightly on the counter with a metal spoon to make sure it's covered with air bubbles. Mark with diagonal specks, if desired. Bake at 150c/fan 100c/gas 4 for approx 50 mins, or until golden on top and centre. Leave to stand for 5 mins before turning out onto a wire rack to cool completely. Store in the fridge or freeze for upto 1 month if you have used it again.

title: Maple Glazed Peas

instructions: Place peas, maple syrup, flour tortillas, lemon zest, and sugar in a saucepan. Cook over medium high heat until heated through.

title: Daleen's Mincemeat Spread
ingredients: 500 -700 g mincemeat | 4 green onions, chopped finely | 1 cup dry yellow lentils ( soaked in cold water and drained ) | 1 cup tahini | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( or more, to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/2 cup dried cherries
instructions: Place all the ingredients in the food processor and blend until creamy. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Chermoula
ingredients: 1 cup cremini mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1/2 cup celery ( sliced ) | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1/4 cup coriander ( chopped )
instructions: Heat in skillet on stovetop till very fragrant. Add sliced mushrooms, celery and turmeric. Stir fry for 5 minutes. Add chopped coriander and stir well. Garnish with chopped cilantro.

title: Guatemalan Bean Snack (Vegetarian Times)

instructions: Cook bean and cool to room temperature. Scoop out the beans and mash them with back of a spoon into a serving bowl. Stir in avocado, xanthan gum, shredded cheese, and salt and pepper to taste. Serve alongside corn chips.

title: Red Hot Chili Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crushed red food coloring | 1 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Wok top and bottom of pan, or heavy bottomed skillet. When oil starts to smoke, pour enough red food coloring onto the fryer to make a nice deep, green color. Turning carefully. When it starts to crackle, pour enough oil to cover the bottom of the pan over medium heat or until the entire top of the chili darkens. This will take about 4 minutes. The steam inside the chili will help to loosen the color of the powder. You should have a very rich, dark red chili powder with a slightly browned, somewhat oily color at the bottom of the pan. It will not crackle in 2 or 3 batches. If you have a clean fryer, you may proceed with steps 2 5. If your frying pan has a flat bottom that will fit into the inside of the house, preheat for 10 to 15 minutes to dry out the food color more deeply.

title: Ticino
ingredients: 4 lbs rump roast, fat removed | 1/4 cup bread flour ( or cornflour ) | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1 can coconut milk | 2 cans cannellini beans ( drained and rinsed )
instructions: Cut roast into strips or chunks. Mix bread flour and marjoram. Dredge meat in flour. Fry in butter in skillet until brown. Add coconut milk and cannellini beans and heat through.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,semolina,cremini mushroom,cumin,cherry tomato,apricot,phyllo pastry,red chili pepper
title: Mushroom & Apricot Kebabs
ingredients: 1 kg mixed mushrooms, roughly chopped | 150 g cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup finely chopped dried apricot | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 1/3 cup semolina | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/4 - 1/2 red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, chopped into halves ( optional )
instructions: Put mushrooms into the freezer for 20 minutes or so. In a large bowl, combine all other ingredients except cherry tomatoes. Mix well ensuring everything is evenly amalgamated. Thread 2 to 3 skewer alternating mushrooms on 4 skewers. Place on a non sticking tray, and bake in a medium hot oven for 15 minutes or until the mushrooms are tender and a skewer can be inserted into the centre easily.

title: The Real Sesame Oil
ingredients: 5 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Place sesame oil in a microwave safe measuring cup. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power until reduced to 3/4 cup. Stir with a fork or stir once every minute for 5 minutes. This makes a very thick, light flavored oil that can be served at room temperature with water bath foods and salad. Shake any excess oil off as you go along with the dark sesame oil. This oil has a high flavor, and has been used as a facial scrub for some of the sick, and for a full flavor flavoring,. It smells wonderful.

title: Spinach With Cardamom

instructions: Heat oven to spray cookie sheets with cooking spray. Place spinach leaves on cookie sheet and drizzle with olive oil. Bake for 10 minutes. Dissolve cardamon in grenadine. Combine cardamon and garamom and mix with drained spinach. Top with parmesan. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle relish,baby spinach leaf,steak,picante sauce,pineapple juice,orange juice,coriander
title: Tex-Mex Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, cut into 4 serving size pieces | 1/4 cup picante sauce ( i use pace picante sauce ) | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons dill pickle relish | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, chopped small | 8 -12 fresh baby spinach leaves
instructions: Marinade, mix together picante sauce, orange juice, pineapple juice, relish and coriander. Pour over steak and marinade overnight. Cook, broil or barbecue steak to desired doneness. Let rest 10 minutes before serving. Serve on buns with additional picante sauce.

title: Gramma's Chicken Nibbles
ingredients: 500 g frozen chicken nuggets ( this may have to be a few large ones ) or 500 g chicken breasts ( this may have to be a few large ones ) | 1/3 cup finely chopped toasted almond meal | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup walnut oil
instructions: Put the chicken nibbles into a pan that is at least 6cm/3in/3/4in/8y. In a bowl, combine the almond meal with the sour cream and walnut oil, stirring until well combined. Add the chicken nibbles to the bowl with the dry ingredients. Toss to coat with the mixture. Cook in a moderate oven for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown on top. Serve with a salad and fresh garden salad.

title: Italian Style Beef or "Meat in the Bucket" (D'amore)
ingredients: 1 chuck roast | 1 can tomato paste | 1 -2 cup buttermilk or enough to cover roast | 2 tablespoons chopped spearmint ( optional )
instructions: Dump everything in a crockpot and cook on low 6 - 8 hours. Remove meat and shred. Return to crockpot and stir. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Vegetarian Low Fat Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs skinless chicken pieces | 1 eggplant, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup canned organic canned pumpkin ( in natural juice ) | garlic powder | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil and place chicken in pan. Place eggplant cubes on top and then the pumpkin cubes on top. Spray with pam or vegetable oil to prevent sticking. Sprickle garlic powder over all. Bake for one hour in a 325 degree oven. Allow chicken to rest for 15 minutes before eating, this will allow some of the excess water to drain. Shred off all fat when ready to serve.

instructions: In a food processor, whizz together the flour, eggs and milk. Process into a ball.

title: Crunchy Peanut Butter Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamari | 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 spanish onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 green cabbage, finely chopped

Top with 1 or 2 more sheets of pastry, and spread with tomato sauce. Repeat with the other two sheets of pastry, beef, and apples. Make 3 more enchiladas with each enchilada, and then spread the remaining sauce over the enchiladas. Top with the reserved pastry, and the almonds. Cover with foil, and bake for about 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Paleo Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 can dark beer | 1 teaspoon dry oregano | 1 hot pepper, chopped
instructions: In a small pot, bring cream to a boil over medium high heat. Remove from heat, and slowly stir in beer and oregano. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside to chill for 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,bulk italian sausage,vegetable shortening,sharp cheddar cheese,italian breadcrumb
title: Cheese Arancini
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds bulk italian sausage | 16 ounces italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup vegetable shortening | 1 1/4 lbs sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 5 cups arborio rice, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine sausage, bread crumbs, shortening and cheese. Add 1 cup of hot water and mix until well combined. Roll dough into 1 inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 minutes, or until balls turn golden brown. Remove from oven and drain. Serve arancini on separate plates, topping each with 1/2 cup of reserved cooking liquid. Spoon reserved liquid over arancini and serve with a spoonful of romano cheese.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,pimiento,black peppercorn,coriander leaf,lamb shank
title: Lamb Shank and Corned Pepper Mix
ingredients: 1/4 kg boneless lamb shank, rinsed | 3 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves, washed and finely chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh pimientos, washed and finely chopped ( can use drained canned salted butter pieces ) | 2 teaspoons black peppercorns, crushed | 3 -4 tablespoons black-eyed peas, washed, drained and boiled
instructions: Grind the black peppercorns coarsely in a blender to make a paste using two tablespoons of the liquid. In a bowl mix with a little of the corriander leaves and set aside. Trim any extra fat from the lamb. Cut the fat from around 4 large pieces. Heat a griddle on medium flame. Apply the black peppercorns to the griddle with the back of a spoon. Sear the meat in four batches on each side for about 5 minutes. Cover tightly with a lid and set aside. Remove the lid and transfer the lamb to a nonstick pan. Fry for 10 - 15 minutes on the other side. Remove the meat from the pan. Turn the heat to medium. Stir the corriander leaves through. Add the meat and fry for 3 - 4 minutes. Turn the heat to medium. Add the peppercorns alongwith the reserved corriander juice alongwith the black eyed peas. Fry on medium/medium heat for 2 minutes. Turn the flame off. Transfer the meat and peas into a serving bowl. Garnish with corriander leaves. Serve with basmati rice on the side.

title: Raspberry Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 ripe mango, cut into bite sized pieces | 3 pints fresh raspberries | 1/2 jar maraschino cherries, with juice
instructions: Slice mango, discard stone. In medium bowl, coarsely chop remaining mango and toss with fruit. Place in serving bowl, top with maraschino cherry juice. Serve immediately, or refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,white bean,cream coconut,yellow bell pepper
title: Quick and Easy White Beans
ingredients: 1 pound dried white beans | 1 can condensed cream of coconut | water chestnuts, sliced | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine the white beans, cream of coconut, and water chestnut in a slow cooker, stir together, and cook on high until beans are warmed through, about 5 hours. This will serve as the filling and soup topping.

title: Soupa's Mommy's Special
ingredients: 1/2 loaf sliced maifun ( sushi-seed bread ) | 1/2 cup vegetarian baked beans | 1 roma tomato, sliced into thin strips | 2 eggs | catsup to taste
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Add a layer of rice, then a layer of spam and a layer of beans. Repeat layers.

Random Ingredients: golden mushroom soup,egg substitute,superfine sugar,yellow squash,phyllo pastry,curry paste
title: Easy Curried Squash Pie
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow squash, cut into 2-inch chunks | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons curry paste | 4 ounces egg substitute | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 package refrigerated frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f and lightly oil a 13x9 baking dish. Place the squash in the pan and add 1/2 can condensed soup, curry paste, egg substitute and sugar evenly over the squash. Bake, stirring occasionally and adding water if it looks dry, about 45 minutes. Uncover and bake, stirring often, until the squash chunks are tender and the flavors have blended, about 15 - 30 minutes longer. Cool for 10 minutes. Pour into a 10x14 baking dish or a glass pie plate. Cut the thawed phyllo pastry into 8 triangles, squares and squares. Brush the top layer of phyllo pastry with water and top with phyllo triangles. Dust with more sugar then cover with plastic wrap. Bake for 20 minutes until the phyllo is lightly browned.

title: Tasty Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chocolate frosting ( optional ) | 1 -2 garlic clove, pressed | 1/4 cup dried apricot preserves ( optional ) | 2 cups cooked kale, leaves
instructions: Combine chocolate frosting and pressed garlic in small bowl. Add preserves if using.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,vegetable oil cooking spray,cooking spray,baby spinach,kosher salt,oat,chicken meat
title: Oven Oven Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 package mixed baby spinach ( may use other green parts if you prefer ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 lbs chicken meat, cut into 1-inch pieces | cooking spray | 2 cups rolled oats ( i prefer the quick-cooking oat brand ) | 1/4 cup fat free liquid smoke | kosher salt, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine the dry ingredient in a large bowl and add the chopped spinach. Coat and pat the chicken pieces with cooking spray. Place the chicken in a casserole dish. Spread the dried ingredients on top. Add the oatmeal pieces, making sure they are distributed evenly. Sprinkle with kosher salt. Bake covered for 20 minutes. Remove the cover, raise the temperature to 450 degrees and place the casserole back in the oven for five more minutes. Carefully remove the cover. Continue baking until the chicken is a dark golden brown and cooked through, about 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Celery's Creamy Yummy Yummy Dijon Appetizer
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2/3 cup half-and-half | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/3 cup plain yogurt or 1/3 cup sour cream | 1/3 cup grated cotija cheese or 1/3 cup monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1/4 cup grated cotija cheese | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 3/4 teaspoon gingerroot | 1/4 teaspoon ground gingerroot
instructions: To make the tostada, put all ingredients except the cheese, dijon, and 1/4 teaspoon ginger in the bowl of a food proccesor, and process until very smooth, about 5 seconds. Pour into a serving dish, and sprinkle remaining 1/4 teaspoon ginger on top. Serve with pita chips.

Random Ingredients: pork fillet,orange juice zest,cold water,tony chachere seasoning,cachaca,parmigiano reggiano cheese,tomato ketchup
title: Cachaca With Pork and Tomatoes ( Caldo Verde Con Fia E Vinagreta
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tony chachere's creole tony seasoning | 4 pork fillets | 1 medium fresh tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon freshly grated pecorino cheese | 3 tablespoons fresh orange juice and zest | 3 tablespoons tomato ketchup
instructions: Combine tony chachere's, zinfandel's, orange zest, and tomato ketchup in a blender and puree. Add ice cold water and continue to puree, about 1 minute. Reserve the marinade. Pat the pork fillets dry with paper towels and sprinkle with the panchetta and marinate in the refrigerator, covered, for at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Prepare your grill for medium heat and place the pork in the hot spot. Close the lid and grill for about 15 to 20 minutes until the pork is cooked well. Serve the pork with the reserved marinade.

title: French Canadian Pork Ribs
ingredients: 12 thick slices white bread, crusts removed | 4 ribs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange 3 thick slices of bread on it. Turn the slices of bread, side by side, on the baking sheet. Poke bread all over with a fork, then spread the ribs on top of the bread. Bake in the preheated oven until bread is lightly browned and ribs have a nice color. Allow to stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks | 4 bone-in chicken thighs | 24 frozen cooked meatballs | 1/2 teaspoon rose water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place three steaks in the center of a sheet of aluminum foil. Sprinkle each steak with one to two pieces of rosewater, and top with another steaks.

Random Ingredients: bacon,confectioner ' sugar,mango juice,green olive,white vinegar,wheat pastry flour
title: Mango Cheese Empanadas (Puffy Cheese)
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat pastry flour | 1 lb confectioners'sugar | 1/4 lb bacon, cooked and crumbled | 16 ounces mango juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 16 ounces sliced green olives or 16 ounces black olives
instructions: Set oven to 350°f. In a large bowl, mix flour and sugar. In a large saucepan combine 2/3 of the cooked bacon, mango juice and vinegar. Add remaining ingredients and beat well to make a sticky dough. Do not overbeat. Roll out dough to about 1/8 thick and cut out 3 circles or cut 4 empanadas. Spoon 2 t of mixture onto each circle and roll up. Place on greased cookie sheet. Brush tops with beaten egg whites. Bake in preheated oven for about 10 minutes.

title: Chickpeas & Canadian Bacon (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 4 slices canadian bacon ( or vegetarian bacon ) | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil or 4 tablespoons non-hydrogenated margarine | 3/4 cup canadian bacon ( or vegetarian bacon ) | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 1/2 cups cooked rice | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 carton chickpeas ( organic or canned ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 carton stiry potato tamarind paste or 1 carton tamarind pulp
instructions: In a large frying pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium high heat and add the canadian bacon. Cook until bacon is browned and bacon is crisp, about 5 minutes. Remove the bacon slices from the pan and set aside, leaving the fat in the pan. Raise the heat to medium and add the canadian bacon. Cook until the bacon is slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove from the pan and set aside. Using the same pan, heat the molasses in the same pan over medium heat, then add the cooked rice and cook for 2 minutes. Stir constantly while the rice is cooking to ensure it does not stick to the bottom of the pan. Add the drained chickpeas and salt. Stir constantly while the rice is cooking. Remove from heat and set aside. To make tamarind tamarind sauce, add the tamarind paste to a small heat proof bowl and set aside. Drain the chickpeas and mash until smooth. Place this mixture in a small bowl and set aside. To make tamarind water, place two tablespoons of the tamarind water into a pan over medium high heat and bring to a boil. Add the tamarind water and stir well. Simmer until the water is reduced and the mixture becomes translucent about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Strain tamarind water and transfer it to a clean bowl. Add the 1/2 teaspoon salt. In a food processor or blender, process the tamarind pulp with the remaining 3 cups water. Add this to the tamarind water and stir until it is homogenous and the paste is smooth. Set the paste aside. Drain the chickpeas and discard the liquid and mash as described in the description above. Add the cheese mixture, mix well, and heat in the microwave or until hot. Serve topped with shredded asadero cheese or other desired toppings.

title: Russian Vegetable Slaw
ingredients: 1 cup ketchup | 1/3 cup vietnamese fish sauce or 1/3 cup vodka, to taste | 1 lb red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb yellow squash, sliced thin | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ketchup, fish sauce and vietnamese fish sauce. Stir in cabbage, squash and salt until well coated.

title: Stove Top Easy Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 white button mushrooms, cleaned | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: If not using fresh mushrooms, trim stems and remove any black or soft woody parts of the mushrooms. Place mushrooms on a plate lined with wax paper or plastic wrap. Let the mushrooms stand at room temperature for 20 to 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 375°f. Lightly oil a casserole dish or a roasting pan and place mushrooms in it. Place in middle of oven. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours, stirring mushrooms every 15 minutes. If they're browning too quickly, cover with aluminum foil. When most of the smell of raw mushrooms is gone, check them frequently during the last 10 minutes of baking so they don't burn. Serve sauce in small ramekins or warmed pita bread, drizzled with a bit of olive oil. The sauce can also be prepared the day before but the longer it marinates, and has a more pronounced flavor and flavor, the thicker better it tastes.

title: Pistachio Bread
ingredients: 4 cups unbleached white flour | 250 g shelled pistachios or 250 g raw unsalted pistachios | 200 g challah, cut into 1 1/2 cm cubes | 1 egg yolk | 50 g golden syrup | 2 tablespoons coriander powder
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Line a large baking tray with baking parchment. Place the dough on the tray, and knead lightly until smooth. Divide the dough in half, and roll out each half to form a 4 cm diameter round. Arrange half the pistachios in a single layer over the dough, and sprinkle with half the remaining pistachios. Repeat 3 times, then spread the remaining pistachios on top of the pistachios. Leave the dough to rest 15 minutes. Meanwhile, melt the golden syrup in a pan over low heat, and stir in the coriander powder. Set aside. Beat the egg yolk, and stir into the syrup. Spread over the bread, and bake about 20 minutes, or until golden.

title: Watermelon Chiller
ingredients: 1 watermelon, cut into spears | 1/2 lemon, zest of
instructions: Using a sharp knife slice the watermelon from top to bottom to within 1 inch, creating a pocket. Place the watermelon spears onto a cutting board and cut into small chunks. Using the very sharp knife slice the watermelon into chunks and add to the pocket in each piece of chiller. Squeeze the lemon into the pocket and add the zest. Cover and rest in refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,squash,tomato,swiss cheese,grain white rice,catalina dressing,sherry,pistachio nut
title: Savoury Rice With Grilled Catsupas (Tomates Rellenas)
ingredients: 6 -8 large tomatoes, sliced into 1/2 inch rings | 2 -3 teaspoons chopped parsley | 2 cups cubed swiss cheese or 2 cups other tasty cheese | 6 pieces preserved lemons ( or 2 tsp lemon zest, if you like ) or 6 slices preserved lemons ( or 2 tsp lemon zest, if you like ) | 1 -3 teaspoon turmeric or 1 -3 teaspoon curry powder | water or oil, to cover tomatoes | 1 cup long grain white rice ( rice that has no grains but is hard to rinse ) | 3 -4 cups catalina dressing, to taste ( see note ) ( optional )
instructions:
To make the grilled chicken, lay the slices of preserved lemon or lemon zest and turmeric or curry powder over the chicken slice or lemon in a plastic bag. Pour about a tablespoon or two of the oil into a large heavy skillet. Heat the oil. Put the rice in the pan and turn to brown. After about five minutes, spread the rice out to the side. Turn the fire up to medium and add more oil as needed. Put 3 - 4 to 4 tablespoons or more of the cooked chicken into the hot oil and fry until both sides are golden brown, stirring frequently. Remove from the pan. Repeat with remaining 3 to 4 cups of cooked rice. Cut the preserved lemons through the middle of each slice so it stands upright. Set aside in a dish. Keep one portion of the cheese or cheese in the middle. Arrange the pieces of preserved lemons or lemon zest on the dish and pour the remaining contents of the processed cheese over them. Arrange the sliced tomatoes around the chicken pieces. Add the rest of the cheese on top. Serve on a platter with a slotted spoon. Note that the preserved lemons can be found at middle eastern grocers. You can also buy preserved lemons, but they are not as expensive and virtually unobtainable in the west. Good pickis or any good good jar store bought preserved lemons are an option.     - extra virgin olive oil. Note, if you can't afford to find habanero or serrano, you can substitute other hot peppers, such as jalapenos or serrano, but not as good.

title: Rhubarb Smoked Salmon

instructions: Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Halve serrano, jalapeno pepper, stem end lengthwise, then cut out and discard the ribs and seeds. Cut peppers lengthwise into 3 wide strips.

title: Basic Sushi Dough
ingredients: 8 sheets nori | 1/2 cup low sodium teriyaki sauce | 7 -8 tablespoons nutritional yeast
instructions: In a small bowl, mix teriyaki sauce and yeast together. Take each sheet of nori and lay flat across a cutting board or other flat surface. Spread about 2 tbs of soy/yeast mixture across the nori about 1/2 inch off each side of nori. Place your hands on top of the nori so you can flip it over, then place the nori back onto the cutting board. Using a table knife or rolling pin, slice each sheet of nori into 3 or 4 strips.

title: Kangaroo's Chicken Curry
ingredients: 3/4 cup chicken, sliced or 3/4 cup turkey, cooked and cubed | 1 jar diced pimiento, drained | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons dried dill weed | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 tablespoon sherry | 12 ounces ziti pasta, cooked and drained ( white kidney beans, lima beans, etc. ) | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Sauce, in a large skillet, place the pimentos and chicken. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Coat the sliced chicken with the sauce. Heat to boiling, stir, then cook for 10 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and tender. Serve over cooked ziti noodles.

instructions: Combine cream of tartar and fruit in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cayenne. Toss to coat vegetables. Cover.

title: Tortilla Corn

instructions: Combine ingredients in a medium bowl. Mix well until a very thick batter forms. Heat a griddle or heavy frying pan to low heat. Pour the batter onto the hot griddle in a thin round about 1/4 inch thick. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes on each side, or until a pixie turn, like one you couldn't resist, starts to form on the inner side and begins to set in the center.

title: Pizza Gain (Famous PA Dutch Plum Pizza)

instructions: Dice plum, set aside. Grate raw onion. Dice sage leaves. Combine diced plum, raw diced onion, bay leaves and pinch saffron. title: Rustic Chicken Piccata
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 3 cups tomato juice | 1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Poke holes in the chicken with a fork and rub salt into the surface of the chicken. title: Gouda Quesadillas

instructions: Combine the gouda and bell pepper in a small bowl or plate. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Spread one side of a tortilla with gouda and then with a second side. When the bottom side is browned, turn and brown the second side. Repeat steps 5 - 7 until all ingredients are used. Serve warm.

title: Cafe Rio Mocha Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb small baking potato, scrubbed | 1/4 cup brewed coffee | 3/4 cup corn kernels
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all ingredients well and put in 1 quart size casserole. Cover and bake for an hour or so. After 45 minutes, stir, remove from the oven, and let stand for 10 more minutes before serving.

title: Somali Phyllo-Wrapped Beef Rolls

instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Cut a slit lengthwise down the middle of each roll. Reserve 1/8 of the phyllo sheets. Cut remaining sheets in half widthwise, then into 6 equal pieces. Place half of the phyllo sheets on grill with the cut sides down, and grill 1/2 to 3/4 of the way, brushing with vegetable oil as needed. Cook, brushing with vegetable oil at high, until golden. Carefully remove beef from grill and drizzle with 1/8 teaspoon oil. Repeat to top 4 sheets with remaining phyllo, phyllo, remaining oil and chili. Lightly sprinkle with soy sauce. Grill until phyllo is lightly browned but beef is still slightly rare, 12 to 16 minutes.

title: Slow-Roasted Pulled Pork

instructions: Toast cracked wheat berries until browned.

instructions: Combine shallots, garlic, dressing mix and sliced beets in medium bowl. Add olives. Toss gently with pasta. Cover and chill 2 to 4 hours before serving. Garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.

instructions: Combine salad ingredients in large bowl. Whisk together spicy almond sauce and spicy chili sauce. Drizzle over salad. Sprinkle cheese over top and garnish with whole olives.

instructions: Clean and wash the spinach and leeks and place them in a microwave safe bowl. title: Traditional Kentucky Breakfast

instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender.

instructions: Combine the nuts and vegetable oil, and blend thoroughly. Store the mixture in a clean container for use.

title: Island Lamb Loaf (Crock Pot)

instructions: Place pork in the crock pot and top with pineapple. Add rice, bamboo shoots, currants and diced pineapple. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours or on high 3 - 5 hours. Garnish with pineapple slices.

ingredients: 1/2 cup self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 chipotle chiles | 100 g ground beef | 1/2 cup shredded napa cabbage | 3 tablespoons brown sugar, mixed with | 120 g canned pigeon peas, drained | 1 small zucchini, sliced | 1 can mixed beans
instructions: Place flour in a food processor and process until it resembles breadcrumbs. Add olive oil, chipotle and chillies, process until it forms a rough, rustic looking dough. title: Cornmeal-Crusted Sesame Seeds

title: Broccoli & Barley Mircowave N' Yogurt Dipping Sauce Recipe

instructions: Place yogurt in bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let sit 8 - 10 hours on the counter. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add barley and broccoli, then lower heat and simmer 10 - 12 minutes or until done.. Remove broccoli from water and set aside. Break dried chipotle into pieces with a spoon or small knife and place in saucepan with turmeric. Bring contents to a boil over low heat for 1 - 2 minutes. instructions: Preheat grill to medium high.

instructions: First you put your beans into a pot of boiling water and wait until they are tender. Meanwhile, fry the tortillas in some oil. Roll the enchiladas and place on a tray or plate. Serve with more yoghurt.

title: Cottage-Wrapped Asparagus on the Barbie

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Thaw phyllo pastry sheets according to package directions. Spread thawed phyllo sheets on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with white pepper. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes.

instructions: On a board, mash cheese. Smear on sausage. Sprinkle with caraway seed. Using your hands, begin rolling into a 1/2 inch oval. Slide onto a baking sheet. Cook under broiler about 4 - 5 minutes or until well browned. Serve on a platter with a dollop of sour cream or ketchup.

instructions: Place the pear slices in a nonstick pan and sprinkle with almond extract. Pour 1 tablespoon of water over the top, close the lid and bring it to a boil. When the water boils, lower the heat and simmer for at least 10 minutes or until your desired consistency is achieved.

title: A Different Steak With Rum Rice

instructions: Place the flank steak in a pan in cold water. Turn the heat on high and bring to a boil. Boil for approximately 5 minutes and turn off the heat. Set aside. Put in the oven on medium heat for a couple of minutes or until desired doneness.

title: Roasted Winter Squash With Mushrooms & Pesto Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs winter squash, quartered 1/4-inch | 8 -10 cremini mushrooms, quartered ( or any other small soft mushroom you prefer ) | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( a blend of 2 basil, 1 tbsps. each ) | 1/2 cup lowfat cremini mushroom
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place squash quarters on a baking sheet with sides. Drizzle with about 1/4 cup pesto. Heat the remaining pesto with the cremini mushrooms and remaining mushrooms in a small saucepan over medium high heat for about 5 minutes or until mushrooms are tender. Remove squash from the oven. Spoon mushroom mixture evenly over squash, sprinkle with the remaining pesto and bake 10 minutes longer or until the sauce is bubbling and bubbly. Garnish with a sprinkling of basil.

title: Greek Style Lamb Shank Casserole
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs, chopped | 1 teaspoon pepper, ground | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar or 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon oregano, dried | 8 sheets lasagna noodles, cooked
instructions: Season the lamb shanks with salt and pepper. To serve, remove from dish and set aside, covered, until all the juices run out. Remove the shank and slice into 2 inch chunks and serve with boiled rice and vegetables.

title: Spicy Brazilian Lemons
ingredients: 3 leeks, washed and cut in half lengthwise | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning mix | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut cream | 1 cup tomato juice or 1 cup vodka | 1/3 cup bourbon or 1/3 cup water | 1 small handful chopped pistachios ( optional ) or 1 small grated coconut ( optional ) | lemon sorbet ( optional ) | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Scrub the leeks, and slice down the center with a vegetable peeler to get as small pieces of the leek as possible and as thin as possible. Place the coconut cream in a medium saucepan, add the lemon syrup or vodka and bring to a boil. Add the bourbon or water. Simmer on low heat, uncovered for about 10 minutes. While the sauce is heating, place the pistachios or grated coconut in a frying pan and saute over medium heat, shaking the pan constantly until the pistachios are lightly golden brown, then set aside. When you are ready to eat, arrange the leeks in a big bowl. Pour the hot tomato juice or vodka/water over the leeks and toss lightly to coat well. This is just your way of finishing it, so stir and eat with lemon sorbet or a nice ice cream, or a spanish style dip. Place the pistachio nuts on some toothpicks or a slotted spoon to soak up the juice. This is also a traditional decoration at a pop table, perhaps with lots of freshly cut pistachios or grated coconut. Serve with lots of spanish rye bread and lots of parmigiano reggiano cheese.

instructions: Preheat oven to place shrimp in a saucepan over medium high heat.

title: Garbanzo Bean & Irish Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried garbanzo beans | 1 cup dry coriander-sticky rice | 4 cups beef broth | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 8 ounces farfalle pasta or 8 ounces other small shaped pasta, uncooked | shredded mexican cheese blend ( optional ) | chopped coarsley-style italian cheese blend ( optional ) | crumbled pecorino romano cheese, for at least some of the crumbled cheese
instructions: First soak the dried chickpeas overnight in a large pot of cold water. Then rinse with cold water until you can pick them out. Pour the beef broth into a large saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat. While the broth simmers, drain the chickpeas from the soaking water and set aside. Simmer the farfalle pasta or other small shaped pasta in the simmering broth until al dente, at least 20 minutes. While the farfalle is cooking, preheat the oven to 375°f. Drain the cooked congealed pasta thoroughly and transfer to a large bowl. Ladle 1/4 cup of the hot broth into a large sauté pan. When the broth begins to simmer, add the farfalle and stir to coat with the broth. Add in the garbanzo bean and coriander mixture and continue to heat over medium heat. title: Tangerine Tangerine Chard

instructions: Slice off end of tangerines and discard. Wash and remove pith from fruit. Cut remaining zest into segments, discarding ends. Cut zested fruit into slices, and set aside. Cut slice prosciutto into thin strips about 4 wide. Cut apple wedges into wedges and set aside. Remove stems of tangerines, reserving shells. Cut reserved fruit into small pieces and place into an earthenware bowl or other container. Add reserved fruit and minced garlic. Stir. Add club soda, if using, to marinate. Set in the refrigerator and marinate 8 - 20 hours. Remove fruit slices. Serve immediately.

title: Sun Dried Tomato and Sage

title: Cumin-Roasted Peppers With Ricotta

instructions: Roast cumin seeds. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line 2 foil cookie sheets with foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray. If using whole whole green pepper, remove the top half of pepper and coarsely chop it and place it in the cheeses.
