ingredients: 2 ciabatta bread | 1 1/4 cups soymilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut ciabatta bread in half horizontally and use a pizza cutter to cut into 12 bread size slices approximately 2 by 2/3. This recipe makes 12 bread slices total. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper and spread the soymilk down the center of each slice of bread. Place 3 slices of bread on prepared cookie sheet and bake for 15 - 18 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven and continue baking with the remaining 2 slices of bread until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: veal,soy sauce,yellow onion,apricot preserve,corn oil,margarita mix,beef tenderloin,caster sugar
title: Sweet Beef Strips
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/4 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 yellow onion, sliced | 1 tablespoon margarita mix | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/3 cup apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons margarita mix
instructions: Cut each round steak in half lengthwise, then diagonally into fourths. Heat oil in nonstick frying pan over medium high heat and add beef strips, without crowding. Cook 3 minutes on each side or until brown, brushing once with half marinade. Remove beef from pan. Add onion, sugar and half marinade. Cook, stirring, 2 minutes or until onion is tender. Spoon over beef. Sprinkle with remaining marinade. Bake in oven on grill rack 5 - 6 minutes or until cooked and sauce thickens.

title: Ziti With Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 2 boxes ziti pasta ( uncooked ) | 1 jar of your favorite spaghetti sauce ( i like prego, but any brand will do ) | 2 jars cashew nuts | 1/4 cup amaretto | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seeds
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water so pasta doesn't get too soft. While pasta is cooking combine the cashews, amaretto, and mustard seeds. When pasta is done, drain and add to cashew nut mixture and mix. This is a really spicy pasta so you may want to do it to your own tastes.

title: Cumin Honey Glazed Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket, fat trimmed | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1/4 cup packed light brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cut the brisket crosswise into 6 to 8 thick slices. Spread slices evenly to within 1/4 inch of the bottom of a deep roasting pan. Cut the trimmed fat cap from the corned beef and arrange over the slices.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,penne,rotel tomato,bay leaf,dark sesame oil,veal,cold water,bird chile
title: Mexican Veal and Cabbage Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 3 bay leaves | 1 can rotel tomatoes | cold water | 1 green cabbage, coarsley washed and torn into large hunks | 1 bird chile
instructions: Saute ground veal, sesame oil, and bay leaf in a large pot til no longer pink, breaking the meat apart as it cooks. Drain off excess fat. Pour tomatoes from can over the veal and add enough cold water to cover the meat. Simmer until meat is no longer pink inside. Add cabbage, cover pot and simmer an additional hour. Serve over pasta of choice.

title: Kale and Lentils
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried red lentils | 1 cup prepared red-leaf lettuce hearts
instructions: Combine the lentils and lettuce over medium heat. Cook and stir until heated through. Spread onto plates.

title: Asparagus With Grated Cheese
ingredients: 500 g asparagus | 1 pie shell, made for a'sage pie with a pastry brush | 1 pint stock, made with a little stock
instructions: Peel the asparagus and cut into 1 1/2 2cm pieces. Bring a large pan of water to the boil, and boil the asparagus for 5 minutes. Drain the asparagus, then tip into a large heatproof bowl. Pour the water into the pan and heat gently, until the water starts bubbling. Remove from the heat and add about 100g of grated cheese. Mash the asparagus with a fork or a potato masher, and tip into the pan. Pour on the stock and gently mix together until evenly distributed and evenly distributed. Spoon the mixture into the pie shell. Smooth over the top and season with salt and pepper to taste. Chill for 30 minutes, or until the pie is firm.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,pasta,cocoa,ginger root,red onion,pineapple juice,tomato ketchup,green cardamom pod
title: Chocolate Beef Curry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1/4 cup beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon powdered ginger root, crushed | 1 teaspoon crushed green cardamom pod | 1 can diced tomatoes with ketchup | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1/4 cup diced red onion | 1 1/2 cups dry cooked pasta
instructions: Whisk the pineapple juice, bouillon, ginger root, crushed green cardamom, diced tomatoes, and cocoa in a saucepan over low heat until the tomato sauce thickens, 4 to 5 minutes. Stir in the ketchup and onion.

title: California Crawfish Salad
ingredients: 3 cans bean sprouts, drained | 1 1/2 packages peeled crawfish tails | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 3 lemons, sliced into wedges
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the bean sprouts, crawfish tails, red bell pepper, and lemon slices. Cover, and refrigerate 1 hour. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,nutmeg,gingerroot,sirloin,dark soy sauce,pineapple juice,caraway seed,wheat breadcrumb
title: Grilled Beef Kebab With Pineapple Glaze
ingredients: 1/3 cup picante sauce, your choice | 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated or 1/2-1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, grated | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 teaspoon nutmeg, grated or 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 lbs top sirloin, thinly sliced ( top sirloin, rib eye, and top round ) | 3/4 cup whole wheat breadcrumbs | 1/8 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl to make a marinade. Marinate beef for at least 1 hour. Remove beef from marinade and reserve marinade. Coat a heavy duty nonstick griddle or electric grill with cooking spray. Add beef and cook over high heat, turn frequently until meat is nicely browned and cooked through but not tough and dry, about 5 - 8 minutes per side. Let cool slightly and cut beef skewers into 1/2 inch wide strips. Spoon reserved marinade onto a large platter, top with bread crumbs, then garnish with pineaple juice. Serve with your choice of side dishes.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,grain bread,egg yolk,black pepper,red pepper flake,beef rib
title: Smörnoffse (Swiss Meatballs)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef short ribs | 6 large egg yolks | 1/4 lb canadian bacon, coarsely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon fine ground black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 loaf unsliced loaf whole grain bread
instructions: Wash the short ribs under running water for 5 minutes so as to remove loose fat. Place the short ribs into a large pot of cold water and bring to the boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer the meat for 1 - 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Drain. Remove meat and set aside. When meat is cool enough to handle cut into 1 inch pieces and discard the bones. Cut the meat into 1 inch squares and set aside. In a large bowl, break the bread into pieces and add to meat, mixing until thoroughly blended. Add the black pepper, crushed red pepper flakes and egg yolks, mixing gently. Add in the canadian bacon. Mix until evenly distributed. Line two baking sheets with waxed paper. Place an equal amount of meat mixture on each piece and lightly knead lightly to form a small patty about 1 inch thick. Place each patty on the waxed paper on the baking sheets. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes, until the patties are a beautiful golden color and cooked through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,sun tomato oil,jalapeno,vegetable,red chilies,pasta,honey
title: Pasta With Roasted Vegetables, Shredded Vegetables, and Sweet Chili
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, i use penne | 3 fresh red chilies, minced ( or sub 1/2 tsp. crushed red pepper flakes ) | 1 cup fresh mixed vegetables ( ie, red bell pepper, banana pepper, onions, sweet potatoes or red bell peppers ) | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil ( not oil packed ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 -3 ounces roasted sweet potatoes ( optional ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup red bell pepper, chopped finely ( optional ) | 1 jalapeno ( optional )
instructions: Heat 1 t of the oil in a large skillet over moderate heat and cook the chiles with the sun dried tomatoes, stirring, until fragrant. Stir in the vegetables. Bring to boil and reduce heat. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Season with salt if desired and let cool. Preheat oven to 400 f. Mix the sweet potatoes with the remaining 1 t oil, adding the honey. Season the pasta with salt. Spread 2 t of the sweet potatoes in a buttered shallow baking dish. Roast for 10 mins or until lightly browned. Heat the remaining 1 t oil in the skillet, then add the sweet potatoes. Cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are crisp tender. Top with the jalapenos, if using.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,chicken wing,picante sauce,tart apple,milk,portabella mushroom cap,rice
title: Spanish Chicken With Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 chicken wings | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 2 teaspoons milk | 8 portabella mushroom caps | 1 tart apple | 2 cups picante sauce | 2 cups minute rice
instructions: Wash chicken pieces thoroughly and place in bowl with milk and white pepper. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for about 1 hour. Remove chicken pieces from marinade and pat dry with paper towel. Grill chicken. Cut the chicken into thin slices. When chicken is done, place in a large, deep skillet and turn the heat to high. Add sliced mushrooms to skillet. Cook until mushrooms are a light brown color. Remove mushrooms from heat and slice into rings. When mushrooms are cool, peel the apple slice from the core. Cut each into thin wedges. To serve, place a mushroom ring in a shallow bowl, place chicken pieces, apple, picante sauce, rice, and sauce in another shallow bowl. Garnish with apple wedges.

title: Pistachio Crusted Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 pound ground sirloin | 1 pound flank steak | 1 can roasted pistachio nuts | 1/4 cup chopped green cabbage | 3/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. In a bowl, mix the ground sirloin and flank steak, pistachios, green cabbage, and almond extract. Shape the mixture into 4 or 5 patties. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. If you want to fry the meat, you can grease the bottom of a large skillet with cooking oil before cooking.

title: Tandoori Style Stir Fry Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite sized pieces | 12 ounces raw sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons red asafoetida powder | 1 cup low-sodium ketchup | 1 cup dry white wine
instructions: Heat a wok or fry pan to high. Add ketchup and stir fry until it's nice and hot. Add asafoetida and stir fry until color turns slightly darker. Add chicken and saute until it's cooked thoroughly. Add wine and cook off liquid. Reduce heat, add the red asafoetida and mix well.

title: Spicy Linguini
ingredients: 1 lb linguine ( we prefer spaghetti ) | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon chili peppers, minced | 1 teaspoon advieh mixed spice
instructions: Cook linguini according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat oil on medium heat. When oil is hot, toss with chili powder. Saute until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in linguini and pour sauce over pasta.

Random Ingredients: mung bean,catsup,egg beater substitute,chicken bouillon cube
title: Chinese Style Mung Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh mung beans | 1 large chicken bouillon cube | 1 egg substitute | 3 tablespoons catsup ( optional )
instructions: Soak mung beans overnight. Place in pot and add all other ingredients. Simmer till beans are tender. Drain and serve.

Random Ingredients: english mustard,adobo seasoning,pepperoncini pepper,lard,dark chocolate,bouquet garni,graham cracker crumb
title: Rich Chive & Bacon (Stuffed Peppers & Chive)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red bliss wax savoy chives or 1 1/2 lbs green giant chives | 4 -6 tablespoons lard, with a bit of fat cut in half if necessary | 1/4 lb chopped roasted sweet pepperoncini pepper | 3 ounces semisweet dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon packed fresh adobo seasoning | 3 lbs freshly made grye cracker crumbs | 1 bouquet garni ( optional or your taste, i usually use a dash ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Slice off tops of chives with scissors. Working on a flat surface, using the dull side of a knife, trim the stalks off of the chives and cut off the tops about 1/3 inch thick.

Random Ingredients: chili bean,cheese ravioli,artichoke heart,quinoa,spanish olive,black pepper
title: Peruvian Tortellini With Artichokes and Olives
ingredients: 1 package gluten-free ravioli | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 can refried beans | 2 jars spanish olives | 2 teaspoons ground black pepper | 1/2 cup quinoa
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ravioli and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a medium baking dish.

title: Scandinavian Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup almonds | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1 tablespoon ground roasted almonds, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place almonds in a bowl of a food processor.

title: Polidora -- Dutch Pepper Bread Recipe
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups bread flour | 3/4 cup cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon honey or 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 3/4 cup milk | 4 plum tomatoes, sliced thinly, seeded ( optional ) | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, sliced thinly, seeded ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix the flour and cocoa, and stir in honey. Gradually add the milk. Stir in the tomatoes & sweet pepper. Turn onto floured surface and knead to form a firm dough. Put dough into an ungreased 9x5x3 inch loaf pan. Bake at 400 degrees f for 20 minutes, or until done. Serve warm or refrigerate for up to 3 days.

title: Cheese Crackers (Using Nut Roll or Bread Mix)
ingredients: cooking spray or 1 1/4 cups non stick margarine | 1/2 - 1 1/4 cup of coarsely grated cheese, depending on your taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Using a large mixing bowl, cut up your block of cheese. The amount of flour needed will vary slightly depending on the type of cheese you use or how much cheese you use. Add the melted butter with cheese. Using your hands mix everything together until it has a nice consistency. Use more or less cheese if you think it needs it. Grease a large cookie sheet with cooking spray, or line it with parchment paper.. Spoon about 1/2 tbsp of the cheese mixture on the baking sheet. Using a clean table knife cut up each square of cheese into small squares. This will ensure it will not stick. Spread out each square of cheese on top of the melted butter mixture in a thin layer. Use your finger to pinch the outer perimeter of each square of cheese together. Make a slit in both the upper and lower corners on one side of each square of cheese and fill with the filling.. If you wish to bake the cookie in the oven for 3 to 4 minutes, use a spoon to get out all of the filling leaving empty spaces behind. Do not let the dough get too hard, it will stick. If you bake it on a cookie sheet, bake in an oven with a lid on for 5 to 10 minutes, or until it is nice and browned. If you bake it on the cookie sheet, bake on top of a cookie sheet and bake for another 10 to 12 minutes. It should take a total of 8 to 10 minutes. Slide the cookie on a cooling rack and leave it on the cookie sheet until you are done cooking the rest of the meal.. Enjoy.

title: Kale and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 can reduced fat cheddar cheese soup | 2 tablespoons soymilk
instructions: Add all your ingredients into a saucepan and heat on medium. Once heated through, turn off the heat, and serve it warm with crackers and vegetables on the side.

title: Turmeric Yoghurt Pudding
ingredients: 4 cups natural yoghurt | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 cup marsala wine, chilled ( or any type of dessert wine )
instructions: Mix the turmeric and cornflour until it is smooth. Gradually add yoghurt, stirring well after each addition. Turn into a large oven proof dish and cover with the marsala. Place it on your base of the oven and bake at 170c for about 40 minutes or till the pudding starts to rise. Serve warm with bread or cold roast vegetables.

title: Moroccan Style Party Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 cup grapeseed oil or 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Mix the anise seed and grapeseed oil in a coffee mug until well blended.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,cornstarch,sage,midori melon liqueur,bacon,peanut butter,pineapple juice
title: Midori Melt
ingredients: 2 slices bacon, sliced | 2 1/2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 1/4 tablespoons midori melon liqueur | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons cheddar cheese | 1/8 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp, but not burnt. Remove from pan.

title: Pimiento and Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 -6 cups white mushrooms, thinly sliced ( about 4 pounds ) | 2 cans sliced pimientos, drained | 4 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Cover, let rise at room temperature until it doubles in bulk, about 1 hour. Drain excess water and lightly dry the mushrooms, leaving as much of the liquid. Add to the mixture. Let rise again until doubled, about 45 minutes. Bake in a preheated oven at 450° for 10 minutes.

title: Spiced Gyros
ingredients: 1 fresh ripe italian plum tomato, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup taco sauce, any brand | 12 slices rye bread, toasted | 10 -15 thin sliced lamb or 10 -15 pork chops
instructions: Dice the tomato and remove seeds. Scoop out about 1 - ½ tablespoons of pulp from the tomato. Set pulp aside. In a small bowl, mix the pulp with taco sauce. Toast and spread toasted rye or wheat pitas. Lay one round on a plate. Top with the tomato pulp, then top with meat/tomato/taco/tomato mixture. Garnish with a dollop of sour cream or salsa if desired. Variation, place slices of onion on top of meat, adding salsa at the end. Top with sliced avocados and cheese. Serves 6.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,cumin,garlic clove,sticky rice,spring onion,head cauliflower,anchovy paste
title: Cauliflower Rice & Anchovy Rice
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, cut into florets and florets separated | 1/2 cup spring onion, chopped | 3 medium roma tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 teaspoon cumin | 7/8 cupsticky rice
instructions: Steam the cauliflower florets for 10 minutes, drain and put into cold water. Squeeze out the excess water. Place the chopped rice in a separate pot, cover with water and bring to a boil. Cook for 10 minutes, remove from heat and leave in the cold water for 20 minutes. Add spring onion, tomatoes, anchovy paste and garlic to the rice and stir. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Cashew and Ricotta Stuffed Sweet Buns
ingredients: 1 container ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup cashews, chopped fine | 1 teaspoon garlic salt, more if needed
instructions: Mix well with a fork. Shape the mixture into 16 large sized sweet buns that have been greased on the baking sheet. If using the large size buns, bake at 350f for about 25 - 30 minutes. If using smaller baking sheet, use less time.

title: Sauteed Mushrooms
ingredients: 150 g crimini shiitake mushrooms | 2 tablespoons hot sauce ( kikkoman asian hot sauce ) | 2 tablespoons oil | fresh thyme sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Separate the stem of each mushroom. Devein mushrooms and slice them thinly. Heat your oil in a medium skillet. Then add the mushrooms and stir over medium heat for 4 minutes. Add hot sauce and thyme. Mix well and continue to stir over medium heat for a further 2 minutes. Serve hot garnished with fresh thyme sprigs.

Random Ingredients: green bean,beef chuck roast,orange,green chilies,parsley,goat cheese
title: Mexican Green Chili
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 jar of chopped mild green chilies | 13 ounces of chopped green beans | 1 cup crumbled goat cheese | 1 cup of chopped fresh parsley | 1 orange, sliced
instructions: In a 5 to 6 qt crock pot, combine the roast, chilies, beans, cheese, parsley and orange slices. Cover and cook on high for 6 hours or low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Swiss Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 large white onions | 100 g plain flour | 15 g nonfat dry milk
instructions: Place the eggs in a pan with the milk. Add the flour and stir to make a smooth paste. Bring to heat and leave to cook on low heat for about three minutes. Put the mixture into a separate bowl and leave for a few minutes. Beat again. Heat a griddle. Served hot plain.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,chili pepper,cilantro,baby spinach leaf,vanilla sugar,italian bread,blueberry,pimiento
title: Spinach and Blueberry Salad
ingredients: 1 pint fresh baby spinach leaves, washed well | 1/4 cup bottled diced pimiento | 1 jar chopped fresh italian bread, slices cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 jar whole baby arugula leaves, packed | 1 jar chopped cilantro | 2 cups cold natural yogurt | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 5 hot fresh chili peppers, stemmed, seeded and minced
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the spinach, pimentos, and bread. Divide the spinach mixture onto four salad plates or other attractive serving dishes. In a small bowl, combine the arugula and cilantro. In another small bowl, mix together the yogurt, vanilla sugar, chili peppers and hot pepper. Fold into the yogurt mixture with a fork. Chill until serving.

title: Sausage, Cheese Tortellini  Rollups
ingredients: 1 box cheese tortellini | 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 4 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Fill a large sauce pan 2/3 full with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Add the tortellini and cook according to package directions. Meanwhile, brown the italian sausage in a large, non stick saute pan, stirring occasionally over medium heat until well crumbled and no longer pink inside. Remove the sausage to a plate and place in the slow cooker. Drain the fat from the sausage. Add brandy, raise the heat to high, and bring to a boil. Add the tortellini and stir. Reduce the heat to medium low and cover. Cook until all the water is absorbed, about 20 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: maple flavoring,poblano pepper,asafoetida powder,extra virgin olive oil,red raspberry jam,chili bean paste
title: Raspberry Chilli Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons maple flavoring | 1 teaspoon chili bean paste | 2 teaspoons pure maple flavoring | 2 teaspoons crushed red raspberry jam | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon hing
instructions: Roast poblano pepper on the open flame of a grill, turning often, until skin blisters slightly, 10 to 15 minutes, or until blackened. When cool enough to handle, trim and discard loose black skin. Cool slightly, peel off blackened skin, and seed. Halve poblano pepper lengthwise, remove stems, and cut into 1/2 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: banana,kielbasa,island dressing,balsamic vinegar,tuna steak,dill weed,italian dressing
title: Spicy Tuna Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 bananas | 1 lb italian style tuna steak | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons thousand island dressing | 1/2 teaspoon basil and dill weed | 1 teaspoon italian dressing | 4 kielbasa, sandwich sized rounds
instructions: Peel and slice the bananas. Mix balsamic vinegar with thousand island dressing and italian dressing, stir until well blended. Cut tuna in half lengthwise. Place cut side up on counter and spoon some dressing onto each half of a banana slice and top with a piece of tuna. Top with sliced italian sausage.

Random Ingredients: grape leaf,great northern bean,steak,mushroom soup,celery salt
title: Easy Beef and Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs round steaks, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 can great northern beans, undrained | 1 can mushroom soup | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt or 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 loaf fresh grape leaves ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot or dutch oven over medium high heat. Cover and cook for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: stew meat,tabasco sauce,button mushroom,cumin,chicken drumstick,creole seasoning
title: Easy Crock Pot Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 12 button mushrooms | 24 chicken drumsticks | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin
instructions: Toss together the stew meat, creole seasoning, tabasco®, mushrooms, and cumin in a non disposable plastic bowl. Add all ingredients from step place the chicken on top and toss. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Use your crock pot with fresh vegetables for an evening lunch.

title: Limas(Rice and Beans)
ingredients: 1 can lima beans | 1 liter light flavored dry sherry wine | 1 can cranberry juice | 1 -2 tablespoon irish whiskey
instructions: Empty cans of lima beans into pot and add remaining ingredients. Bring to a low boil. Do not boil again and allow to reduce to a syrup consistency. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer for one hour. When you remove from heat remove and discard any remaining beans or the other flavors.

Random Ingredients: turnip,pinto bean,onion soup mix,cremini mushroom,sun tomato oil
title: Savory Vegetable and Sun-Dried Tomato Soup
ingredients: 8 cups pinto beans | 2 cups turnips or 2 cups zucchini, diced | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 4 ounces sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained ( not oil packed ) | 1 ounce onion soup mix
instructions: In large pot cover beans with water and bring to boil. Add 1 tsp salt. Boil for 7 minutes. Pour into food processor and blend until smooth. Return to pot and add other ingredients. Place over medium heat until thoroughly heated then serve.

title: Tasty Beef and Baked Pasta
ingredients: 250 g pasta, your choice | 2 -3 slices lean hamburger | 1 -2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 -2 small banana pepper, sliced ( or your favourite pepper ) | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet. Meanwhile, fry the burger or turkey, remove and set aside, drain the fat of the burger/turkeys, if any, and place in the casserole. To the fat add the beef, pepper, coriander and sugar, stir well, cook just a minute or two until bubbly. Add the cooked pasta, stir, stir again. Place in oven, 400f for 45min or until hot, crisp and brown.

title: BBQ Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs of lean ground beef | 1/8 cup of chopped yellow pepper | 1/4 cup of chopped fresh bamboo shoot
instructions: Add meat to crock pot. Add peppers and bamboo shots. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or high 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,sirloin,almond filling,vegetable broccoli,jumbo shrimp,egg yolk,rice,italian cheese
title: Jumbo Shrimp Stuffed Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, cut into 3/4-inch thick strips | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables, broccoli and cauliflower mixed salad mix ( thawed if frozen ) | 1 jumbo shrimp ( raw, thawed if frozen ) | 9 ounces prosciutto ( thinly sliced ) | 1 egg yolk | 1/4 cup shredded italian cheese blend ( kraft ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped blanched almond ( toasted, see below ) ( optional ) | cooked rice
instructions: Heat large large nonstick skillet over medium high. Add sirloin and cook 4 minutes or until browned. Add the vegetables and shrimp, stirring frequently. Cover and cook 5 minutes or till vegetables are crisp tender and shrimp are opaque. Remove from heat. Combine prosciutto, egg yolk, cheese and nuts in large bowl. Add vegetables, stirring to combine. Fill pasta shells with mixture and top with toasted almond. Garnish with additional crumbled nuts if desired.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,oatmeal,hard egg,thyme,tortilla,summer squash,yellow bell pepper,shortcrust pastry
title: Indian Pepper and Almond Quiche
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon fat free oats or 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1 can mixed sweet potatoes, drained, finely diced | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, finely diced | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped fine | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 packet reduced fat ready-to-use pastry dough | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats ( see notes above ) | 1 small winter squash ( optional ) or 3 ounces spring squash, diced ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 350 deg f/180c. Line a 10 ovenproof pie dish with the pastry and spray with cooking spray. Set aside. In a medium bowl, combine the curry paste and flour. Make a well in the centre and add the sweet potato, bell pepper, egg, and thyme. Stir gently until well combined. Spoon into the partially lined pie dish. Place on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Bake for 50 minutes, or until the pie starts to colour in the middle and the crust is beginning to brown at the edges. Remove from the oven and set aside for 5 minutes. Invert onto a plate and turn out onto a serving plate. Serve warm with yoghurt, if desired.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,tomato soup,maple syrup,guacamole,baking soda,mustard powder,sriracha sauce
title: Fiery Tex Mex-Inspired Banana Pepper Muffins
ingredients: 1 large banana pepper ( or other hot pepper ) | 13 1/2 ounces condensed tomato soup | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon guacamole | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | sriracha hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cut top off of pepper but leave stem intact. Cut open and remove seeds and membrane and fibers. Cut into strips with scissors.

Random Ingredients: meat,italian breadcrumb,dark chocolate,rhubarb,italian sausage,red chile,sea salt
title: Gorgonzola With Rhubarb
ingredients: 1 lb rhubarb, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 lb thin ground meat, ground lean | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons dark chocolate | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 3 -5 crushed dried red chiles
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Divide into 24 equal portions, shape into 1 inch balls, roll in bread crumbs and skewer with toothpicks. Broil at 300 degrees 4 to 5 inches from heat for about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: plum sauce,chicken leg,onion salt,okra,peppercorn,green bell pepper
title: Chicken, Okra and green bell pepper  Salad
ingredients: 2 large chicken legs ( or 2 chicken thighs ) | 8 okra, ends trimmed, cut in half | 1/2 green bell pepper, cut in strips | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed peppercorn | 1 can plum sauce or ( 10 ounce ) can plum salad dressing | onion salt ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken legs, or thighs, in a large ziploc bag. Add okra, pepper and peppercorns. Shake bag to coat okra with dressing and then add to chicken. Refrigerate and marinate overnight or the longer marinating time, the more flavor the chicken will absorb. Grill or broil chicken until cooked and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: greek feta cheese,almond meal,leg lamb,head garlic,apple cider vinegar,fine semolina,chili sauce
title: Yum Yum Honey Lamb Leg
ingredients: 1/4 cup unbleached all purpose greek feta cheese | 1 tablespoon ground almond meal | 3 pounds leg of lamb, cut into 1 1/4-inch cubes | 1 head garlic, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup good quality sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup good apple cider vinegar | 1/4 cup fine semolina
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Mix together the feta cheese and almond meal in a bowl. Add half of the lamb cubes and mix to coat. Place on the prepared baking sheet and refrigerate 4 hours. Repeat dipping lamb cubes into flour tortillas, shaking off excess, and arranging on the rack of a broiler pan. Roast lamb on the preheated oven until darkly browned, about 25 minutes per pound per pound. An instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a lamb leg should read at least 145 degrees f. Remove leg from the oven and set aside for 15 minutes. Pour off any fat and transfer the lamb to a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate up to 1 day, stirring occasionally. Bring the garlic and chile sauce to a simmer in a saucepan over medium low heat, then cook for 5 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together vinegar and semolina in a microwave safe bowl until well combined. Warm a small skillet over medium high heat until hot. Brush some of the melted butter into the flour tortillas and then sprinkle with semolina mixture. Quickly add the lamb and sprinkle with any remaining feta mixture. Cook over medium high heat until the meat is cooked through, about 3 minutes per side.

title: Spiceful Cashews (Panch Phoron)
ingredients: 1/2 cup salted cashews | 1 teaspoon green chilies | 1/2 cup mild cashews
instructions: Place everything except the cashews in a blender and blend to a fine paste. Pour mixture through a sieve and blend further to smooth. Use as directed in recipes.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,tomato puree,orange food coloring,rice flour
title: Tomato-Greek Yogurt Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt or 1 cup paneer ( to taste ) | 1 cup plain rice flour | 1 teaspoon orange food coloring ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon tomato puree, from a can of tomato puree
instructions: If using non greek yogurt, omit this step. In a small bowl, mix greek yogurt and orange food coloring. Let stand about 10 - 15 minutes. Mix rice flour and greek yogurt, if using, together until you get a nice dough consistency. If using plain rice flour, add enough yogurt/artificial sweetener to achieve desired consistency. If using a jar of tomato purée, add enough color to achieve desired color. Heat up a frying pan on medium high. If using the medium high grill option, preheat for about 4 - 5 minutes.

title: Apple Pork and Pancetta Rollatini
ingredients: 1/2 lb pancetta, diced | 6 ounces pork loin, cut in 1-inch lengthwise slices | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1 apple, cored, finely shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a dry skillet, over medium high heat, cook pancetta until crispy. Remove pancetta from skillet and drain on paper towels, then drizzle pork with bacon drippings. Place pork slices between two sheets of waxed paper and tightly roll them. Secure with a toothpick or two. Place the rollatini on a sheet pan and bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 20 minutes. Transfer rolled bread rolls to a platter and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,pam cooking spray,daikon radish,garlic granule
title: Korean Pickled Daikon Radishes
ingredients: 6 -8 daikon radishes | 1/2 cup malt vinegar, approximately ( the kind you will eat ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules | pam cooking spray ( for the grill )
instructions: Peel the daikon and slice off a very thin slice about a tablespoon or so. Slice the radish into 2 - 4 rounds and set aside. In a plastic baggie combine the vinegar, garlic and paprika and mix until garlic granules dissolve. Add the sliced radish and mix to coat. Let sit for 20 minutes, then rinse the bagged daikon and drain. Place the daikon radish slices onto the grill and cook until golden brown.

title: Dynamite Pie (Sweet Pie)
ingredients: 1/2 can tomato juice | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry | 1 package frozen chopped tomato slices, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, pour the tomato juice and graham cracker crumbs into the tomato juice. Mix well. Roll each sheet of phyllo pastry into a 12 inch circle. Place 2 sheets of dough in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the second sheet on top. Repeat layering of phyllo sheets and tomato juice until all the sheets are used, then spread the mixture in the dish. Top with tomato slices. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

title: Basic French Fried Celery
ingredients: 4 -5 celery ribs | 4 teaspoons french mustard
instructions: Slice vegetables about 1/4 inch thick. Lay out 2 slices of french bread for each slice. Spread the mustard all over the slices of bread. Place a celery slice on the mustard, then place 2 slices of bread on top. Heat a non stick pan or skillet for 4 - 5 minutes on high, then turn off the heat and set the celery for at least an hour. I usually leave it for a few minutes at this point.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,cream mushroom soup,lobster,marjoram,chocolate baking square,okra,egg,rice noodle
title: Lobster and Okra Casserole for 2
ingredients: 1 package fresh okra, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 2 packages frozen cut okra, thawed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 package chunky semi-sweet chocolate baking squares | 1 can tomato sauce | 3 eggs | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 3 cups cooked rice noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange frozen okra on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake okra in preheated oven until tender, about 25 minutes. Remove okra from oven and sprinkle with one package of okra. Place remaining package okra on baking sheet. Bake okra in preheated oven until lightly golden, about 5 minutes. Remove okra from baking sheet and set aside. Spray an 11x15 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Stir spaghetti, cream of mushroom soup, and chocolate squares together in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,italian tomato,lemon juice zest,green pepper,tomato,palm sugar
title: Nigerian Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 medium firm ripe tomatoes ( about 10 ounces total weight ) | 1/2 small lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1 large tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1/4 small green pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon palm sugar | 1/2 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cut tops off tomato, scoop out the pulp, and place them on a sheet of waxed paper. Sprinkle the pulp with the grated lemon zest and sprinkle the pulp with 1/2 teaspoon of palm sugar and crush the pulp slightly with the back of a knife. Fill the tomatoes with the sugar and the pulp. Roll out the crumbs, and coat the tomatoes well while they are being stuffed. Refrigerate for several hours or up to 3 days before serving.

Random Ingredients: linguica sausage,corn flake,red wine vinegar,orange zest,parsnip,parsley
title: Stuffed Parsnips
ingredients: 1 bunch parsnip, cooked and chopped | 250 g linguica sausage | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup red wine zest | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley
instructions: Slice the top off of the parsnips and scoop out the pulp. Discard the stems. Preheat oven to 200 degrees celcius. Mix the following, parsley, red vinegars, oranges and zest together. Take a 1/2 teaspoon and spread over the parsnips. Put the parsnips into a large, shallow oven proof dish. Spoon in the dressing. Scatter over the parsley. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Spanish Spaghetti (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 can spaghetti sauce | 2 teaspoons sweet chipotle chiles, crushed ( or more depending on your heat tolerance ) | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 jar salsa ( your favorite or mild ) | 1 package precooked spaghetti, thawed according to package directions ( roni's )
instructions: Put all ingredients except spaghetti in crock pot. Turn on low and cook for 6 hours. Add spaghetti and stir. Cover and cook for an additional 30 minutes. Serve with your favorite garnishes.

title: Quick Tomato Hoagies
ingredients: 3 hoagie rolls | 1 can del monte stewed tomatoes and basil pasta sauce ( or any tomato flavor pasta sauce ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 - 1/3 cup beer
instructions: Split roll halves in half.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,garlic salt,dijon mustard,red potato,green cabbage,grand marnier,courgette
title: Roasted Potato and Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 large red potato, halved | 4 small green cabbage, shredded | 2 small courgettes or 2 small zucchini | garlic salt | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place potato in a large bowl, season with salt and toss to combine. Place vegetables on the bottom rack of the oven and bake for about 40 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Remove from oven, pour off most of the liquid and reserve the vegetables. Cook cabbage, courgettes and zucchini in boiling water for 5 minutes or until just tender. Drain and cool slightly. Dressing, stir cream, mustard and grand marnier into reserved vegetables. Add reserved vegetables and toss gently. Serve warm or cold.

title: Spice Lasagne (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 small head cabbage | 1/2 cup mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook the noodles until tender, rinse, then drain. Bring a pot of salted water to boil, add cabbage and season with spices. Wash and tear the cabbage into pieces removing the thick stem part of the cabbage. Cook the cabbage pieces until they are clear. Drain off the water, place the noodles in a 13x9 baking dish, then spread the cabbage and spice mixture over the noodles. Bake for approximately 45 - 60 minutes at 350 degrees, or until the cabbage is tender.

title: Cauliflower and Hamburger Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/2 cup dried mashed cooked onion | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 2 cans tomato gravy or ( 16 ounce ) cans tomato sauce | 1 package frozen cauliflower | 6 tablespoons garlic powder ( optional ) or 6 tablespoons garlic paste ( optional )
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and drain if necessary. Return to heat, add onion and continue cooking until onion is a medium brown. Remove from stove. Spread mashed potatoes in the bottom of a 2 quart casserole dish, and spread a layer of cooked hamburger mixture. Spread the rest of the ingredients over hamburger. Pour tomato gravy over top. Cook in oven at 350 degrees until cauliflower is tender, about 60 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,turmeric powder,ancho chili pepper,red grapefruit,chicken bouillon cube,green bell pepper
title: Gujarati's Sweet and Spicy Ancho Chile Gizzards (Chicken)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon turmeric powder ( a tsp is usually too strong ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ancho chili peppers ( a small jalapeno or serrano pepper ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika ( a small chile is good ) | 5 -10 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes ( i use chicken bouillon cubes for this ) | 1 small green bell pepper ( small, seeded, minced ) | 1/2 cup red seedless grapeseed grapeseed oil, or ( 1/2 liter ) vegetable oil | 1 green bell pepper, very thinly sliced
instructions: Place all ingredients into a blender and blend on high until smooth, approximately 1 minute. Pour into a small bowl or container that's wide enough for cooking ancho chilies, green pepper slices, and onion. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours. If it seems like too much water, you can add a bit more at a time.

Random Ingredients: fish,mix,arrowroot,garam masala,sharp cheddar cheese,celery rib,red potato,shiitake mushroom
title: Fish & Potato Pie
ingredients: 1 packet mix ( i use fish flavor ) | 1 lb whitefish, cooked and sliced thinly | 1 bunch baby red potatoes, thinly sliced | 12 large shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 32 ounces fish, prepared | fresh garlic, peeled | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons arrowroot
instructions: Preheat oven to 500ºf. Coat a 9 pie plate with nonstick cooking spray. Combine all ingredients, except cheese and arrowroot. Stir the arrowroot into 1 cup of the tomato liquid and whisk the flour into the water. Pour into pie plate and cover with foil. Place in preheated oven. Cook for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside for 5 minutes. Remove foil and sprinkle top with remaining cheese. Return pie to oven and bake an additional 10 minutes until cheese has melted and is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,tamari,peanut,tomato sauce mushroom,thyme,tarragon,coconut extract,beef chuck
title: African Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 cups tomato sauce with mushrooms | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons tamari | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 cup finely chopped toasted peanuts | 2 -4 green spring onions, and cut in half
instructions: Put beef, tomato sauce, tamari, tarragon, thyme, and peanuts in crockpot. Stir well. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 8 hours or on high for 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,challah,molasses,rice,enchilada sauce,dijon mustard,brown gravy mix,grand marnier
title: Tex Mex Sweet and Spicy Toast
ingredients: 1 challah, cut on the bias | 1 cup instant rice | 3 -5 chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 package brown gravy mix | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/2 cup enchilada sauce
instructions: Spread 1 tbsp of mustard on bread and set aside. Spread the remaining mustard on the bread and set aside. Spread the rice in your blender and add the chipotle and all remaining ingredients except the enchilada. Blend to a paste. Spread the paste in a greased 9x13 and then pour over the rice. Let sit to absorb some of the juices. Heat on the broiler until the bread is golden and the cheese has browned.

title: Pine Nut Sushi
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup pine nuts | 2 sheets nori | 2 cans coconut milk | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, cut in halves
instructions: Prepare 1/2 lb ground beef. If using pine nuts, drain excess liquid. In a small saucepan, bring a few cups of water to a boil and add pine nuts. Heat coconut milk to near boiling point. Turn off heat and add sesame seeds when nuts are cool. Drain pine nuts. Mix nuts with ground beef. Cut nori into strips about 5 x5 x 1 1/2 inches. Cut into 1 1/2 inch wide strips about 3 inches long. Spray a sushi mat with cooking spray and spread seaweed pieces evenly on mat. Add about 1/4 cup more beef mixture on top of seaweed pieces. Make two 1 inch long strips of soaked nori, about 3 inches long. Sprinkle top of nori with cherry tomatoes. Place a teaspoon of nori strips in the center of two slices of beef. Fold nori over the top of the beef and cherry tomatoes to form a partially enclpped log. Press with your hand to flatten log. Seal the roll. Repeat with remaining nori and beef balls.

Random Ingredients: mung bean,pot barley,salt pepper,fish ball,vegetarian bean,enchilada sauce
title: Easy Mexican Vegetarian Beans & Barley
ingredients: 1 cup mung beans, soaked overnight ( dried black or red beans ) | 2 cans vegetarian refried beans | 1 cup mashed potatoes barley | 3 tablespoons dry fish balls | salt & pepper | 2 -3 tablespoons enchilada sauce
instructions: Rinse the beans under running water. Place in a crockpot with all other ingredients except enchilada sauce. Set to low setting and allow 4 to 5 hours cooking time. When ready to serve, remove the lid and toss the beans in the center with a spoon to break and mix.

title: Homemade Smoked Paprika Pickles
ingredients: 7 cups flat leaf parsley | 1 1/2 cups hot paprika | 4 tablespoons salt | 3 tablespoons ground mixed spice
instructions: Place the parsley and hot paprikas in a mortar and pound them into a rough paste about 8 slices. Heat 2 quarts of water over high heat to a depth of 2 inches in a 5 pint jar. Remove the jar of parsley from the heat, slip the paprika paste into the hot brine and allow it to drip into the pot to drip down the sides. The pickling liquid must boil, without boiling vigorously or it will steam the jar. Once the brined jar is at a full boil, shake the jar vigorously to clean the residue of paprika and salt. Add the mixed spice and stir well. Allow the pickling liquid to mature, shaking the jar occasionally, 1 to 3 weeks before using. Tightly seal with lids, wipe the jar back and forth with a clean cloth and store in a dark, cool place, shaking often, for up to 2 weeks.

title: Mashed Potatoes Au Gratin
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes | 2 fresh red chiles, seeds removed | 3/4 cup saffron | salt and black pepper
instructions: In a large pot of salted water, cover the potatoes and bring to a boil. Cook until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain and mash until smooth. Stir in the chiles, saffron and salt and pepper. Serve. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pasta With Olives
ingredients: 2 cups bow tie pasta ( i prefer whole wheat ) | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted, sliced, pitted | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Toss well with remaining ingredients.

title: Spinach Flavored Cola
ingredients: 500 g frozen chopped spinach ( thawed and drained ) | 300 g cola-flavored carbonated beverage | 4 packets maggi ( chicken-spice flavoured or your favourite seasoning )
instructions: Put frozen spinach in a bowl with 1/2 tablespoon of maggi powder. Mix well and set aside. Pour cola over thawed spinach and stir. Cover with plastic wrap on top and refrigerate for 1 hour. When ready to serve, stir the spinach mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,corn flake,black coffee,beef steak,serrano chile pepper,potato,dijon mustard,pasta
title: Cafe Rio Steak and Potato With Black Beans and Spinach
ingredients: 6 slices beef steak ( lean, 1 inch thick ) | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup strong black coffee, divided ( i use starbucks� 99 % fat free ) | 4 1/4 cups leftover mashed potatoes | 1 -2 hot serrano chile pepper, seeded and chopped | 12 fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup leftover cooked couscous or 1 cup dry couscous
instructions: Cut up steak as directed. Prepare beef by seasoning it with dijon mustard and refilling it with the black beans. Drain and rinse potatoes and put into a medium mixing bowl. Place in the same bowl as beans and mash with a potato masher so that the beans are crumbly and homogenous. Add black pepper and 1 1/4 cup coffee. Mix well. Place spinach in a separate bowl and microwave for 1 minute, or until warm to the touch. Add chopped chile to bowl and mix well. Coat steak with potato mixture. Cover with plastic wrap so it wont stick to the steaks. Cook in a hot skillet that has been sprayed with cooking spray. When steak is no longer pink on the outside, place in a preheated oven at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 10 minutes. Remove lid and cook another 5 minutes. Remove steak from oven. Add rest of the coffee to skillet, mix well. Cover and simmer on the stovetop for about 5 minutes or until heated through. Pour the hot beef over potatoes and spoon black bean mixture on top. Scatter spinach on the top. Cook for about 1 to 2 minutes more, or until crisp and hot. Spoon out onto plate and let sit for about 1 minute. Serve hot with couscous, enjoy.

title: Arugula, Strawberry and Coconut Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb small shell pasta ( angel hair ) | boiling water and salt, to taste | 12 ounces fresh baby arugula | 12 ounces frozen strawberries, thawed and lightly drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh rosemary, leaves or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary, crushed | 1/2 cup orange liqueur | chopped fresh lime wedge | freshly shredded coconut
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water, according to package directions. Drain, then rinse under cold water. Combine arugula, strawberries and rosemary in a large bowl. Dressing, in a screw top jar, combine orange liqueur, lime juice and enough water to make a dressing. Pour into dressing and toss well to combine. Pour dressing over salad and toss. Sprinkle with coconut before serving. Note, prep time does not reflect chilling time.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,hamburger,curry powder,baby shrimp,hot water,parsley leaf
title: Baby Shrimp in Mild Curry
ingredients: 1/2 lb hamburger | 1 1/2 cups hot water ( or less ) | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 3/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 lb baby shrimp, cooked | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: In a large, deep skillet melt one teaspoon of the butter. Add the shrimp and parsley and stir fry quickly, until just pink. Add the crumbled burger and fry for 20 seconds, while stirring until the shrimp are heated through. Add the hot water, a little at a time until moistened. Stir in the curry and cheese and cook 1 minute. Stir in the shrimp and serve while hot. Nb., you can also stir in 1/2 tablespoon of butter and a little more water as needed for thickening with a sauce.

title: Gulash - Swedish Meat Faggots
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fatty beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 cup sour cream ( or more )
instructions: Cover the meat with water and soak overnight or for about 8 hours in the fridge. After bringing the meat to room temperature or warmer, cut into 1/2 by 3 pieces and add the caraway seeds. Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least for at least 8 hours. The longer it is stored, the stronger the flavor. The meat should be as dry and somewhat dry, so that when it is cooked it will absorb some of the water. Add the sour cream or more sour cream, and continue to cook meat the usual way, and not over cook. If it is too dry, add a little water to keep it moist. Note, depending on the size of your meat, or if you prefer, you may have to make a small quantity of sour cream at a time.

title: Cuban Ham Salad
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 lb ham, cut into small pieces | 1 jar grape juice ( i prefer vh )
instructions: Rinse ham and place in mixing bowl, cover with grape juice. Cover with cling wrap and refrigerate for about 2 hours at room temperature. Cut chilled ham into 2 to 3 pieces. Serve chilled with slices of french bread cut into desired size. Variation, instead of ham, use left over ham slices.

title: Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1/2 lb salami, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, crushed
instructions: Mix all ingredients together gently. Spread on toasted pita bread with crackers or sliced rye bread. Serve on toast points or as a main course with french fried vegetables.

title: Fried Bread Crisp With Oil
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | cooking oil
instructions: Slice the loaf into 1/4 inch slices. In the skillet you are going to be frying the bread with oil, heat on medium until all the oil is absorbed. While this is going on, cut a piece of bread about 1 inch thick and lay it out in the pan you are going to use. Cut into 1/4 inch slices. Place in the pan with the oil, cooking until bread is browned and crisp on both sides. Serve while hot.

title: Agua De Molcajete (Mace Powder)
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 1/4 cups rice vinegar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and allow to cool before using. Store in an airtight container.

title: Grilled Moroccan Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon salt | 4 chicken breast fillets | 1/4 cup guinness stout | 2 teaspoons lemongrass, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dry dates, pitted and finely chopped | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Mix together the cumin powder, salt and 1/2 teaspoon of the dried chiles in a shallow bowl. Coat the chicken fillets with the cumin mix. Grill the fillets over hot coals or medium grilling element for about 4 minutes on each side, until lightly charred. Turn when chicken is tender. Combine all ingredients. Cut the chicken into slices about 3/4 inch thick and serve with the warm chile mixture and the cooked marinade. Note, the recipe should have suggested cooking the chicken through 1 hour or longer, but i prefer to grill mine for about 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,white cheese,cocoa powder,marsala,mustard,broth,pork baby back rib
title: Marsala and White Cheese Stuffed Pork Ribs
ingredients: 4 baby back ribs | 1/4 cup dry marsala | 1 cup white cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 cup chicken stock or 1/4 cup canned broth | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 - 1 cup shredded blue cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut ribs into 2 inch segments. Reserve neck and giblets. Sprinkle ribs with marsala. Using fork, mix cheese with cocoa and mustard.

title: Pizza Dough
ingredients: 16 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup cubed processed cheese, cut in 1/4-inch cubes
instructions: Combine the flour and cubed cheese. Knead dough to form a soft, smooth, round shape.. Turn onto lightly floured surface and roll or stretch to about 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into 3 inch pieces and place on baking sheets sprinkled with cornmeal. Lightly brown pizza crusts on each side. Serve hot. Enjoy.

title: Broccoli and Queso Blanco Salad
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret, trimmed | 1 leek, washed, white part and light green part only, washed and thinly sliced ( about 1/2 cup ) | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 4 ounces queso blanco, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 2 ounces coleslaw mix, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Steam the broccoli and leek, covered, in a steam basket or large saucepan of boiling salted water until the broccoli is bright green and tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Do not overcook. Transfer the broccoli and leek to a large bowl. Add the golden syrup, queso blanco, and coleslaw. Taste and add more syrup or sugar if desired. Garnish with the ghee. Serve.

title: Spicy Rum (El Hombro)
ingredients: 4 2/3 cups rum or 4 2/3 cups rum flavoring | 1 lb semisweet chocolate-covered chocolate-covered chocolate-covered vanilla bean | 2 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: Place 3 cups hot water with all ingredients into a small container. Cover, and let stand until all the ice crystals have dissolved. To store, run the cooled chocolate covered vanilla bean under cool water to soften, then shake out excess water. Place in a glass container, and chill for 1 hour or longer, depending on how chilled you like your chocolate. Store in a dark, cool place.

title: Grpa Dhabrika (Spiced Celery)
ingredients: 1 stalk celery, with leaves | 4 whole green cardamom pods, cracked in long, thin strips | black pepper, to taste
instructions: Clean the celery.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,cumin powder,turbinado sugar,bamboo shoot,wine,salt black pepper,apricot half
title: Dolmades (Belgian Marinated Fruit Salad)
ingredients: 1 cup champagne wine | 1/4 cup dried apricot halves or 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup turbinado sugar ( for the apricot half, but you can use brown sugar if preferred ) | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon ground cumin powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper ( to taste ) | 4 celery ribs, washed, trimmed chopped ( leaves and stalks ) | 6 bamboo shoots, chopped
instructions: Mix all the dressing ingredients together in a bowl and chill for an hour or so. Toss the celery with the cooled dressing, taste and adjust seasonings as needed. Refrigerate, covered, for at least 6 hours or until serving.

Random Ingredients: spice,coconut,heavy cream,italian sausage,chinese cabbage,maple syrup,navel orange
title: Nama Mama's Fantastically Decadent Orange Colada!
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 cup sweetened shredded sweetened coconut ( a medium to large one ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup diced navel orange ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon mixed spice ( can use spice bagels ) | 1/2 a small head napa cabbage, shredded ( i like golden wonder ) | 1/4 cup maple syrup ( optional, if using a sweetened pineapple you might want to throw it away )
instructions: Crumble the sausage. Brown and drain the sausage and save. Brown the coconut and combine with the sausage mixture. Add the cream, orange. Toss the shredded cabbage and mix well. Pour into a casserole dish or shallow casserole dish. Sprinkle some spices on top, and cover with the maple syrup. Chill well. Bake it at 375 degrees in a preheated oven for 45 minutes.

title: The Best Cilantro Crusted Lamb
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb shoulder, cut into 2 to 3 pieces | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Put the lamb in a large bowl and put the cilantro in.

title: Tahini Cookies
ingredients: 2/3 cup tahini ( sesame seeds ) | 2 tablespoons baking chocolate
instructions: In a bowl blend baking chocolate, tahini, and baking chocolate until creamy. Using 1 teaspoon of mixture for each cookie, roll into balls and set individually on an ungreased cookie sheet. Let cool for 5 minutes and then break apart into pieces. Store in an air tight container.

Random Ingredients: stock,corn syrup,red chili pepper,red chili pepper flake
title: Red Hot Chilli Oil
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili pepper oil ( red hot chilli oil ) | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup stock | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Heat up the chili oil on a low heat. Once hot, add the chilli, corn syrup and stock and mix together. Continue heating on to medium until all ingredients have dissolved and have reached the right temperature. Let come to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for one hour or until thick and syrupy. Remove from heat and leave to cool slightly. Store in a clean jar with a tight lid.

title: Baked Crab & Avocado Salad
ingredients: 1 lb crab meat | 1 can sweetened condensed cottage cheese | 1 jar salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1 -2 tablespoon orange flower water ( optional ) | 1 can sliced black olives ( drained ) | 1 can grape tomatoes ( whole or quartered )
instructions: Cook crab meat until flakey. Drain. Mix crab meat with cottage cheese. Add remaining ingredients except grapes and tomatoes. Pour into baking dish and cut grapes and tomatoes into wedges with an orange slice on top. Bake at 350°f about 40 minutes depending on your oven.

title: Red Lentils(Kara Korma)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups red lentils | 1 yellow pepper, diced | 2 can tomato paste | 1/4 cup chili powder or 1/4 cup dried savory | 1 1/4 cups coffee, any flavor | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour
instructions: Boil the red lentils in water until cooked but still firm. In a pan, place the chopped pepper and tomato paste, chili powder or savory and coffee. Over medium heat, whisk the flour into the flour until the soup thickens. Pour the soup into a bowl and serve.

title: Mexican Lentil and Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 cup dried lentils | 1 lb ground chicken ( can sub ground turkey ) | 1 white onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Prepare the lentils and ground chicken.. Chop the onion. Drain the lentils and store them in an airtight container for up to five days. Prepare the white onion. Brown the ground chicken. Drain the chicken and put it back in the pan. Mix the ground white onion, and the cooked lentils together in a large bowl. Place these in the bottom of a 9x13 pan. Pour over the contents of the bowl of the ground chicken and mix well. Sprinkle with vanilla. Cover with foil. Bake in preheated 180c oven 45 - 50 minutes or until the lentils are just soft and bubbly in the middle. Serve.

title: Olive Oil & Seasoned Butter With Italian Herbs
ingredients: 1 teaspoon butter | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, combine butter and italian seasoning. Using a fork or pastry brush, mix the butter and italian seasoning into the butter. Allow the butter to completely melt then stir until it is completely smooth. Note that the butter will get more and more sticky as it cools.

title: Caramelized Spanish Onions (Venezuelan Inspired Onions)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs spanish onions ( vidalias ) | 3 tablespoons rock sugar
instructions: The best way to caramelize your onions is to melt it in a hot, dry skillet and keep it in a dry skillet over medium low heat. The more frequently you can brown it so that it gives little browning, the more caramelized you will be able to achieve. Try to caramelize the onions with tongs when you want to serve them. Make sure to remove any burned outer skin after caramelizing. When you come to boil your water, place your onions to the boil and boil the onions for a full minute. When the onions are almost fully cooked, turn them out of the water into a colander and set over a bowl to cool to room temperature. Once cool, place them in the refrigerator to set as desired. To caramelize, heat 1/2 inch of oil in a frying pan until it is super hot, add the onions. Stir frequently until they release their liquid and begin to darken in color. This takes about 10 minutes. Watch them carefully as this will cause some of the caramelizing action that will eventually turn this caramelized mixture into brown sugar. Watch the pan closely as they start to darken and get crispy on the outside. They should take a total of another 5 minutes or so. Once you remove the onions from the pan, add the rock sugar. You can also make caramel by melting your sugar in a very hot pot or in a small pot to make caramel sauce.

title: Indian Rutabaga Milk
ingredients: 1 large rutabaga | 3 medium curry leaves ( or one 5-8-ounce bunch depending on the size of your plant ) | 1 cup whole milk
instructions: Wash a few pieces of rutabaga, either by cutting off the ends or peeling them. Slice lengthwise into bite size pieces. Place the sliced rutabaga in a blender or food processor with the curry leaves. Blend until smooth, then place in a shallow casserole or pot over medium high heat. Stir milk, if necessary, into the milk. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until it steams. Stir in a little more milk if to thick. Pour over your prepared rutabaga and serve immediately, either in a shallow bowl or as a side dish for breakfast.

title: Granny Greta's Hazelnut Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 box hazelnut-flavored hazelnuts, crushed | 2 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place hazelnuts in a small bowl and cover with cold water. Let sit for 30 minutes, then drain. Place the hazelnuts in a bowl.

title: Garlic Mushrooms
ingredients: 32 ounces white mushrooms | 3 -4 tablespoons garlic-infused olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon garlic-infused olive oil | 1 tablespoon chicken stock
instructions: Heat the garlic olive oil over medium heat. Cook the mushrooms, covered, for 3 - 4 minute add the stock and remove from heat. Cover and let stand 3 minute.

title: Homemade Meat and Wheat

instructions: In a large bowl, soak bulgur wheat overnight. In the morning, drain the wheat and rinse. Stir in the lamb, pork or beef, bacon, molasses or bread crumbs. Refrigerate until the mixture is firm enough to handle. Form into meatballs. Grill on a preheated grill until brown, 5 to 10 minutes per side.

title: Chicken Cappuccino (no Butter)
ingredients: 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cubed | 5 cups nonfat milk | 1 1/2 cups shredded fontina | 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Place chicken, milk, fontina, and cinnamon in a large pot. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring to melt the cheese.

title: Italian Herb-Crumb Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shortening | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme

title: Mexican Fish Cakes With Salsa Verde #5FIX
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground pam cooking spray or 1 teaspoon canola cooking spray | 1 medium baking potato, peeled and diced | 1 large cauliflower floret | 1 box farfalle pasta ( spiral shaped or bowtie shaped ) | 2 cups seafood-seasoned meat stock | 1 can tomato puree | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 cup diced cooked salmon or 1 cup frozen cooked small whole-milk flounder, thawed if frozen | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley or 1/2 cup chopped cilantro
instructions: Dice potato to about 1 1/2 inches in size. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a large skillet with pam cooking spray. instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large skillet over medium heat, saute the beef until browned.

title: Pecan Biscuits

ingredients: 2 lbs brussels sprouts | 1/2 cup cream of tartar | 2 teaspoons rice wine or 2 teaspoons dry sherry | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1/4 cup seedless raspberry jam or 1/4 cup seedless raspberry jam

instructions: Soak the chili beans overnight. Then, drain the beans and place in a pot and cover with water of choice.

instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas divide the shredded cabbage evenly among 4 large baking sheets, making sure all ingredients are covered. instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Combine the cream cheese and garlic with the lemon rind, allspice and oregano in a bowl and mix well. Cut the artichoke hearts in half and fill each artichoke heart with the cream cheese mixture. Place artichoke hearts on a nonstick baking sheet. Sprinkle with additional spices. title: Lindt's Prawn (Shrimp) Cakes

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,greek seasoning,elbow macaroni,crabmeat,grain rice,cumin powder,pork loin chop,onion powder
title: Spanish Pork and Crab Macaroni Dinner
ingredients: 2 -3 pork loin chops or 2 -3 lamb chops | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1 package dry elbow macaroni | 1 bunch coriander seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons greek seasoning | 1 1/2 tablespoons mixed cumin powder | 1/4 cup rinsed and cracked dry coriander powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin powder
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except for the macaroni and pork in a large ziploc bag or baking dish. Add pork, onion and marinade, refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Place lamb on the foil and spray with a light spray of oil. Sprinkle the rice on top and bake for 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside. Top with coriander sprigs and a slice of french fry bread.

title: Quick Beef Lasagna
ingredients: 1 -2 lb lasagna noodle | 4 teaspoons prepared grain mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add a few tablespoons of mustard oil to coat. Add the ribs to the pan and cook until browned and crisp, about 4 minutes. Add the uncooked lasagna noodle to the pan. Add remaining tablespoons of mustard to the pan and spread evenly. Spread the browned beef mixture evenly across the lasagna and bake for 30 - 45 minutes, or until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Rice Noodle Soup
ingredients: 6 ounces rice noodles | 2 cans tomato soup | 1/2 teaspoon orange rind, grated | salt and pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Cook noodles as per directions, drain and return to pot. Add tomato soup, orange rind, salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 5 minutes, then serve.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,parsley leaf,soymilk,tabasco sauce,meat,ranch dressing,baking potato,spaghetti sauce mix
title: Low Fat Spaghetti Squares #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato | 1 lb cooked spaghetti sauce mix | 1 lb shredded cooked meat | 1.25 cup low-fat soy milk | 1 package ranch dressing | 1 1/2 cups shredded granny smith apples ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley leaves | 5 drops tabasco sauce | parsley leaves
instructions: Bake potatoes in a large cookie sheet with a rack. Rinse under cold water. Bake at 400º for 40 minutes. While still hot cut off skins from potatoes. Slice potatoes. Mix spaghetti sauce mix, cheese, and parsley in a bowl. While potatoes are baking, mix together meat, and soy milk. Cook in a lightly oiled skillet with salt and pepper, until done. Combine sausage and spaghetti mixture in a large bowl. Add cooked potatoes. Mix well and spoon on top of meat mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and refrigerate at least 12 hours. Spray a 9x13 pan with non stick cooking spray, and bake for 20 minutes at 400º.

title: Aubergines
ingredients: 3 medium aubergines | 1/2 - 1 cup plum tomato ( preferably plum ) | 1 teaspoon cumin seed
instructions: Wash and dry the aubergines. Peel off some of the skin and cut into 2 - 3 cm lengthes. Cut a lengthwise slit through the middle and scrape out the flesh. Cut the aubergines lengthways into small strips. Scrape out the seeds and set them on kitchen paper until all are done to your liking. Meanwhile, put the tomatoes, cumin and salt into a frying pan and fry them until softened. Take them out, leave them on the paper. Fry the aubergines in a little oil until they are golden brown and crisp, and set them aside and keep warm now. Take the pan off the heat and add the aubergines and any juices. Fill the aubergines with the tomatoes and put them back on the pan. Add the juices from the pan. Turn the pieces over, spoon a little more oil on top if the tomatoes are going to burn, add more oil if necessary and simmer them for 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,yellow squash,dark soy sauce,pinto bean,canola oil
title: Chinese Vegetable Soup (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 lb dried black-eyed peas | 1 lb yellow squash, ends trimmed and cut into thin rounds | 5 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Sort through all of the dry, dark, and yellow pea pods into a large stock pot or dutch oven. Rinse and drain the pea pods and add them to the pot. Add the soy sauce, canola oil, and pinto beans and stir well to mix. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer for 45 to 55 minutes, or until all of the vegetables are tender. Gently stir in more soy sauce to taste just before serving.

Random Ingredients: fruit cocktail,red pepper flake,cauliflower floret,rigatoni pasta,cardamom seed,jicama,self raising flour,flat leaf parsley
title: Baked Rigatoni & Cauliflower Nests
ingredients: 300 g rigatoni pasta | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons jicama | 2 tablespoons dried fruit cocktail ( or marmalade ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes | 1 cup cauliflower floret | 1/4 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Heat a pan and add 1 tablespoon of oil and then toss all the vegetables. Put the rigatoni into a baking dish and then top with the vegetable mixture and crumpled parsley. Sprinkle all with pepper flakes, toss and put in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes until cooked.

title: Sweet Italian and Spinach Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 1 package fresh spinach, washed and trimmed | 2 large red potatoes, cubed | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained | 2/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh spinach | 1/4 cup chopped fresh pineapple tidbits
instructions: Place sausage in a large pot and add enough water to cover. Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,turnip,beef bouillon cube,green onion,avocado,mozzarella cheese,celery rib
title: Spanish Beef Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground beef ( or use other lean, vegetarian, meat-loaf ) | 2 small yellow peppers, diced | 2 celery ribs, sliced | 3 green onions, chopped | 1 can peeled carrots, coarsely grated | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 avocado | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese
instructions: Brown meat on med high heat in two separate frying pans with one tbsp of olive oil and 1/2 tsp of salt. In the last minute of browning, stir in yellow peppers, celery, onions, and beef cubes. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Add 1/2 can of water, cover tightly, and simmer 15 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: broad bean,kidney bean,ketjap manis,creme de cacao
title: Devonshire Broad Beans
ingredients: 500 g kidney beans | 4 tablespoons ketjap manis | 200 g broad beans or 200 g mange-shell beans | 4 tablespoons creme de cacao
instructions: Rinse and boil the beans in 4 cups of water until it is cooked. Chop the mange shell bean into 5 cm pieces and add to the beans with the creme de cacao. Cover the pot and simmer for 30 minutes. Add salt to taste..

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,cocoa,champagne,bay leaf,pork hock,rye flour,five spice powder
title: Pork and Champagne Pasta

instructions: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions. Rinse with cold water, drain and reserve. Remove any excess fat from the pork shoulder and cut into 2 1/2 inch cubes. Bring to the boil, scrapping any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Dissolve the five spice powder in about 1/4 cup water, add to the pan, stirring well. Add the pork and any juices and simmer for about 3 minutes. Add the bay leaf and cocoa powder and remove from the heat. When cooked, divide pasta among four warmed serving bowls and garnish with shellfish.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,lime juice,monterey jack cheese,muenster cheese,anchovy,island dressing,chicken leg,green olive
title: Lime Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime juice | 3/4 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 3/4 cup shredded muenster cheese | 1 can anchovies, drained | 1/2 cup olive, sliced | 1/3 cup green olives, sliced | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 4 ounces thousand island dressing | 4 chicken legs
instructions: For the marinated chicken marinade, combine the first 8 ingredients. Set aside while you pre heat your grill for 5 - 7 minutes, so the oil heats up. title: Hawaiian Ham Hocks

instructions: Place lemon zest and pineapple juice into a large pot over medium low heat, and cook 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and set aside in refrigerator. title: Baked Chicken Cutlets

instructions: Cube the pork. Heat up the oil on the stove. Add the onions for a minute. Add the bouillon cubes. Boil for 5 minutes. Put pork in the soup. Leave for 5 minutes.

title: Mexican Walnut Nachos

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet with cooking spray. Rinse bulgur until the water runs clear. In a medium bowl, toss bulgur with olives, tortilla chips, and nuts.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,virgin olive oil,halibut fillet,tomato puree,frying chicken,basil pesto,puff pastry

instructions: Slice each steak into four equal portions. Place a portion of tomatoes and spinach pesto in a flat dish and set aside. Slice the fillets into four equal portions. instructions: Mix everything together well and refrigerate.

title: Steamed Whole Fish

instructions: Brush fish with some oil, then sprinkle about a teaspoon of the sesame seeds evenly on the surface. Use the oil to cook the sesame, then transfer to a steaming tray. title: Spanish Pepitas on Toast
ingredients: 1 bag frozen turnips | 1 lb semi stuffed spanish chorizo | 1 cup asiago cheese, grated | 1 cup hummus or 1 cup salad dressing
instructions: First, preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Prepare chorizo slices by spraying liberally with olive oil spray and slicing diagonally 1/4 inch thick. Pour the drained turnip mixture into the bowl and sprinkle the cheese over. Then, spread the chorizo mixture onto the side with the turnips. Place onto a non stick cookie sheet and bake in the oven for 6 - 8 minutes. Serve with asparagus and toasted pita chips.

title: Slow-Cooked Veal
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds veal, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 slices thick-cut bacon, chopped | 1/3 cup triple sec | 1/3 cup grated carrots | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 2 tablespoons ground beef rib, or as desired
instructions: Pour half of bourbon into a 3 1/2 quart slow cooker. Place veal in cooker. Place bacon in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook until meat is browned but not crumbly. Drain excess grease. Stir beef, bacon, triple sec, 2 tablespoons triple sec, and carrots into meat. Cover, and cook on low 2 1/2 hours, or until gravy is thick and velveting. Serve with noodles.

title: Simple Beef Teriyaki Sauce (Tv)

instructions: Brown ground beef and veggies together, then drain. Add tamari, sambal oelek, and ground beef back to pot. Stir. Simmer for 1 minute and serve over rice.
