title: Sweet Sesame Baked French Bread
ingredients: 1 package low-calorie bread ( i use multicolor ) | 2 tablespoons icing | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 packages oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles ( seasoning packet only! ) | hot dog | 1 package reduced-calorie bread, sliced
instructions: Cut bread in half lengthwise but do not cut all the way through. Place cut sides up on cookie sheet. Sprinkle icing over bread. Bake at 350 degrees for about 10 - 15 minutes or until bread just begins to crisp and has become golden brown. Spray with nonstick spray. Meanwhile, put your oriental seasoning packet in a 1 quart microwavable measuring class. Pour 1/2 cup boiling water over ramen noodles so that they have no lumps. Set aside. Turn on the oven to 325 degrees. Grease an 18 x 12 inch baking dish. Put sliced bread on baking sheet. Sprinkle with icing. Bake at 325 degrees for 13 minutes. Remove from oven and place slices on top of the warmed biscuit bread. Return to oven and bake until golden and crispy about 5 - 8 more minutes. Cut bread in half and serve with warm dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,vegetable shortening,tabasco sauce,tequila,olive,salt,taco shell,pie shell
title: Pinchos Morito

instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Mix together shortening and salt in large mixing bowl. Cut in margarine with pastry blender or 2 knives or two knives until mixture is crumbly. Stir in tequila and olives. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface. Roll to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut with 2 or three 1 1/2 inch round cookie cutters or with 2 - 3 inch cutters. Place on lightly floured surface. Cut into circles about 12 inches long. Place circles 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake until golden brown, 10 - 12 minutes or until golden. Remove from sheets and place on racks to cool. When pies are cooled and crusts still warm, fill each with a generous heaping portion. Top with shredded cheese.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,dark brown sugar,bay leaf,plum,parmigiano,plain yogurt
title: Pecorino and Plum Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs plum, firm ( or empress plums, or empress dicorns, or empress dicorns, a large bodied red plums with the pits removed ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 4 plumants, ripe, cut into quarters ( or empress plums ) | 1 1/2 cups plain low-fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 bay leaves | freshly grated parmigiano or pecorino cheese ( optional )
instructions: If you have the time and inclination, slice the plums and soak them in a bowl of salted water for at least 30 minutes, drain and chop the plums. In a stockpot with the stems off, combine the plum halves and water to cover and set over medium high heat. Simmer gently for about 3 to 4 minutes, then drain well. Bring the bouillon cubes to a boil and skim off any foam. Put the plums in a separate bowl, pour over a little of the boiling brine, then cover and leave for 5 minutes. Pour the liquid over the plums, stirring in the chopped plum pieces. Strain through a sieve and reserve. Heat the remaining brine in the pan and add the yogurt, mixing with a spoon to make sure the yogurt dissolves and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer gently for 25 to 30 minutes, then remove the lid and simmer another 5 to 10 minutes longer. Add the sugar and the chopped plum pieces and mix well. Check seasoning, stirring frequently for seasoning and remove from the heat. Serve hot, topped with freshly grated grated parmigiano or pecorino.

title: Simple to Tasty Fajitas
ingredients: 1 package frozen southwestern-style thawed cornflour ( if thawed, thawed it may take less time as corn flour is thinner and thinner ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chili paste ( sambal oelek ) | adobo seasoning | fat-free low-fat yogurt or low fat low-fat sour cream ( optional ) or skim milk ( optional )
instructions: Put the thawed corn flour in a bowl. If using dry adobo stir into the corn flour. Add a few drops a tablespoon at a time, stir until all of the corn flour and flour have been added. Add the chili paste and stir again until everything is mixed and then taste for a bit of the adobo seasoning. If it seems like too much adobo seasoning, you can also add a little bit of water, but if you have it it then add less than 1 teaspoon, stir well and then taste again for sweetness. If you are not going to use fat free sour cream or low fat milk, add skim milk. The ratio for the sour cream is about 1/2 cup, 1/2 cup and 2 tablespoons, add more or less depending on how wet you want the sour cream to be. Serve with flour tortillas for dipping.

title: Amaretto Glugg
ingredients: 16 ounces guinness stout | 12 dashes amaretto
instructions: Pour ingredients into a blender or mini food size jar. Cover. Seal. Let stand at room temperature at least six hours before consuming.

title: Kumara With Bow Ties
ingredients: 600 g kumara ( sweet potato ) | 1 cup kumara bread ( chopped ) | 2 cups wheat-free multi-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 1 1/4 cups nonfat milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Grease a shallow 5x9 inch, round dish. Bring a large pan of water to the boil, add the kumara and cook for 5 minutes. Drain water from the kumara and place in a large bowl. Heat the milk in a separate saucepan over a low heat for 1 minute or until warm. Place the kumera mixture in a bowl with the warm milk and let stand for 5 minutes, or until the mixture has cooled slightly. Place flour in a bowl, add dry ingredients and add enough milk to make a soft dough. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead gently with a rolling pin or hands. Place dough in the pan and roll out to a rectangular shape. Spread the kumara mixture on top and cut into 4 equal parts. Pinch the crust edges to seal and pinch together. Use a sharp knife to score crossways into 12 wedges. Place onto a baking sheet and bake for 40 minutes, or until golden.

title: Horseradish Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1 bunch horseradish ( or other fresh horseradish cream to taste, may sub 1/2 cup sour cream ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh horseradish | 3 -4 fresh kaffir lime leaves ( for garnish, approx 1-2 tsp. a few leaves for garnish )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, mix the rice, horseradish or sour cream, seasoning salt and fresh horseradish or sour cream. Bring to the boil over medium heat. Cover and reduce heat to simmer. Let cook for 10 minutes until rice is tender and all of the liquid has been absorbed. Remove from heat, cover and let stand for approximately 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork, garnish with freshly grated horseradish leaves and lime leaves. Can be eaten hot or cold.

title: Blueberry's island  Breeze

Random Ingredients: brandy,rump roast,pork tenderloin,red cabbage,monterey jack pepper cheese,pumpkin
title: Pumpkin, Beef or Pork Tenderloin Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 lb rump roast or 1 lb pork loin, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups shredded red cabbage | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 cup diced seedless pumpkin ( optional ) | 1/4 cup brandy ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Coat a large nonstick skillet or dutch oven with cooking oil. Place pork and beef or pork in pan, and sprinkle veggies over meat. Pour brandy over all. Heat until liquid begins to boil, cover, and place into oven. Cook at 350 degrees for 15 minutes. Cover, and continue cooking until the meat is fork tender and the vegetables are very tender. Stir every 3 or 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: paprika,red chile pepper,thyme leaf,bread,lime peel,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Cream Cheese Wrapped French Onion Rings
ingredients: 2 packages philadelphia cream cheese, at room temperature | 50 soft white sandwich bread | 1/2 teaspoon ground paprika | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leaves, divided | 1/2 cup finely shredded lime peel | 1 small red chile pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place softened cream cheese on a piece of plastic wrap, and press flat onto cheese. Refrigerate until soft. Cut 1 sandwich bread diagonally in half, and wrap each slice between sheets of plastic wrap so the bread is tightly wrapped. Wrap the cheese in the plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Place the bread rolls onto a cookie sheet, and bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until golden brown and crusty. Remove from oven, and allow to cool slightly. Whip cream cheese at room temperature until fluffy, about 1 minute with electric mixer. Stir in 2 teaspoons paprika, thyme, finely shredded lime peel, and red chile peppers. Spread cream cheese evenly onto the tops of each sandwich, and roll up. Wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and up to 3 days before serving.

title: Japanese Orzo-Veggie Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons marjoram or 2 tablespoons oregano | 1 1/2 cups orzo pasta | 6 cans water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1/3 cup ketjap manis ( sweet soy sauce )
instructions: Heat a large pot of water to boiling. Add marjoram and orzo. When orzo is al dente, drain and rinse with cold water. Return to boiling pot, add ketchip manis, water chestnuts and soy sauce. Let simmer for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: orange,dark brown sugar,italian tomato,wild rice,basmati rice,italian parsley
title: Rice with Tomatoes and Beans - Diabetic Diet
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 tablespoon dried wild rice | 1/4 cup wild rice | 1 can italian-style tomatoes, with puree ( can use muir glen ) | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar ( or palm sugar ) | 9 ounces mixed italian-style salad greens ( about 1.75 l ) or 9 ounces mixed italian-style greens ( about 1.75 l ) | 1 orange, zested and cut into segments
instructions: Stir together both rice and wild rice in large shallow bowl. Add undrained tomatoes, brown sugar and orange zest. Stir gently to combine. Pour into lightly greased 8x8 baking dish to cover. Bake in preheated 325 degree f oven until browned, about 45 to 55 minutes. Cool before serving, garnish with orange segments. Servings are estimated.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,sugar,tamarind paste,bragg liquid amino,tomato paste,bean sprout
title: Jambalaya
ingredients: 2 tablespoons braggs liquid aminos | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/4 cup tamarind paste ( can use an herb flavor enhancer. ) | 1 -2 teaspoon sugar | 3 -4 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese ( can use regular or whatever cheese you like )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese in a blender.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,splenda pack,garlic salt,wheat couscous,vegetable broth,egg,lime sherbet,salt pepper
title: One-Tone Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1/2 cup whole wheat couscous | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 large egg, lightly beaten | 3/4 cup fat-free low-sodium v8 juice and 2 tablespoons skim milk | 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined ( about 3-pound ) | 1/4 cup lime sherbet, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Bring broth and couscous to boil in small pot.

title: Crispy Baked Red Onion Rings
ingredients: 12 red onions, about an inch in diameter | 1 tablespoon dried pickling spice | fine breadcrumbs, to coat
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c. Wash the onions well and dry lightly. Toss with the pickling spice, add the breadcrumbs, and arrange the slices so they fit evenly into a lightly oiled baking tray.. Bake in the centre of the oven for 20 minutes, turning over once. Turn slices over and bake for a further 20 minutes, or until golden. Allow to cool slightly. Serve with your favourite pizza sauce.

title: Meatballs in Marshmallow
ingredients: 1 package mini marshmallows | 8 -10 frozen precooked meatballs | 1 green apple, peeled, cored and diced
instructions: Place marshmallows in small sauce pan, and melt over medium low heat. Stir until melted and blended. Add meatballs and cook on low heat until warmed thru. Remove meatballs and apple and add to sauce. Cover and let the meatballs thaw for about 5 minutes. Put mixture with or without apples into a small bowl, and enjoy.

title: Chile Poppers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon roasted mustard seeds | 3 anaheim chili, minced | 12 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Dry fry the mustard for 2 - 3 minutes, making sure not splatter. Combine the chili peppers, the mustard seeds and 1 1/2 cups cold water. Stir vigorously until they are well mixed. Arrange pepper mixture in the center of phyllo sheets. Cover with a single layer of phyllo. Fold each sheet in half and then roll the entire stack so that one of the sheets is enclosed in one or two leaves has been on the bottom half. Paint the top with oil and bake for 25 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,pimiento,mint leaf,red pepper,canola oil
title: Minty Fried Rice (Arroz Doce)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | canola oil | 1 jar pimientos, drained and finely chopped ( not drained ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 3/4 cup finely chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Heat oil in a 12 inch heavy skillet over medium heat until just smoking. Add rice and stir just until it begins to turn golden. Do not brown. Immediately reduce heat to medium low. Cook, stirring, until rice begins to brown, about 2 minutes. Add the pimientos, mint, mint, and 2 cups of water.

title: Chinese Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 6 ounces white mushrooms, thickly sliced
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a wok or frying pan and gently cook the mushrooms, stirring occasionally, for 10 - 15 minutes, or until they are beginning to soften, but don’t brown. Remove from the heat and serve warm.

title: Stir Fry Chocolate Spaghetti
ingredients: 3/4 lb spaghetti sauce | 12 green cardamoms, crushed | 3 ounces semisweet baking chocolate
instructions: Add sauce to a medium saucepan. Add the black cardamoms. Bring to a boil over a medium heat. Stir occasionally until the sauce boils and thickens, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Melt the chocolate with 1 tbsp water. When the sauce is done, remove from heat. Stir 2 minutes. Place the spaghetti in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,yellow bell pepper,pink lemonade concentrate,pam cooking spray,pineapple,pork loin chop,herb
title: Green enchilada Pork Rollups
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops, 1 inch thick | pam cooking spray | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 can crushed pineapple | 1 can pink lemonade concentrate | 1 small yellow bell peppers or 1 small orange bell pepper | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except green sauce and roll the pork. Coat a hot fry pan with pam. Place pork in pan. Cook for about 5 minutes per side, turning once or twice to brown it on all sides. Cover and refrigerate overnight serve with green sauce spooned over top.

Random Ingredients: currant,sausage,clove,taco sauce,red kidney bean,beef brisket,cornstarch,lump crabmeat
title: Jambalaya II
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | 1 lb dried red kidney beans | 1 lb lump crabmeat | 1 lb smoked sausage | 1/4 lb currants | 2 teaspoons ground cloves | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 jar taco sauce
instructions: Soak beans overnight in water with 1/2 inch of salt and 2 tsp of sugar or salt. Place beans in heavy kettle, add about 3/4 cup water, and add cold water to cover beans by 1 inch. Bring to boil, and add enough cold water to cover beans by 1/2 inch. Cover, and reduce heat to simmer, and cook slowly, covered, overnight. Remove bay leaf, discard. Cook next day, rinse, place in a slow cooker on low, and cook 2 hours or more.

title: Spicy Oatmeal (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 125 g quick-cooking oats | 125 g quick-cooking oats | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: Place all ingredients into the rice cooker, stir well and click on cook, turn off. Let sit for 10 minutes. Fluff before serving either with a fork, or with your favorite topping.

title: Broccolini and Corned Beef in a Sour Sour Cream-Steamed Vegetables
ingredients: 12 ounces broccoli florets | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander, coarsely chopped ( or 2 tbsp cilantro ) | 2 tablespoons angostura bitters
instructions: Heat steamer basket or steamer over high heat, place the steamer basket at the highest rack in the oven and position the rack. Steam the broccoli in the basket or steamer until well steamed, about 12 minutes or according to your desired tenderness. Transfer the broccoli to a platter and leave the vegetables to cool slightly. Discard the basket and transfer the broccoli to the serving bowl. Puree the coriander and bitters in a blender until a thick smooth paste forms, pour over beef and sprinkle with the reserved coriander and serve.

title: Kari Ka Rayi (Indian Parsley Raisins)
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 6 ounces golden raisins | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh parsley ( optional )
instructions: Place the oil in a small shallow dish. Add raisins and allow to stand at room temperature for about 5 minutes. Drain raisins and discard excess liquid. Place cardamon in a heatproof bowl or other shallow dish and set aside. Heat oil until smoking in a heavy nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add raisins and cook, stirring regularly until they turn brown, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat, add chili paste and stir until well mixed. Stir in parsley and transfer to a bowl. Sprinkle tops with additional chili paste and serve.

title: Gorgonzola and Canadian Bacon Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon, chopped | 5 cups chicken stock | 3 tablespoons canadian bacon fat | 1 can tomato puree | 1 package gorgonzola | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped | 1 teaspoon guacamole
instructions: Cook bacon in soup pot, covered, over medium heat until it becomes crispy, about 7 minutes. Drain and reserve. Pour off all but 1 tbsp of the bacon fat and discard about half of the bacon fat. Return pot to medium high heat. Add the 3 cups stock and canadian bacon. Bring mixture to boil. Reduce heat to low. In a small bowl, combine the tomato puree and the reserved bacon fat with a fork. Blend thoroughly. When soup is at a simmer, stir in puree mixture and stir. Lower heat to low and let soup simmer about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, to break up the tomato paste. Add gorgonzola cheese and stir until cheese is slightly melted. Sprinkle top with fresh chives and guacamole.

title: French Dressing
ingredients: cooking spray | 3 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Spray a 2 pound mixing bowl with cooking spray. Stir the vinegar into the bowl of dressing. Let sit for about 1 hour before using with remaining dressing.

title: Tarragon Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs meat, pieces | 1 cup sultana ( mixed dried fruit ) | tarragon, leaf tied in a tea towel | yogurt ( to serve )
instructions: Preheat oven to 1 hour and 30 minutes. Place meat in casserole. Cover with water. Add sultanas and tarragon leaves. Heat for 10 minutes. Bake, covered, for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with yoghurt. Serve with warm crusty bread and vegetables. Note, cook times will vary.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,pepperoni,kielbasa,shiitake mushroom,orange,icing sugar,sesame oil,onion
title: Kielbasa Sukiyaki
ingredients: 3 pounds kielbasa, cut into thirds | 2 cans stewed tomatoes | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 2 cans diced onion | 1/2 cup sesame oil | 1 1/2 cups icing sugar | 6 orange | 2 packages pepperoni | 8 ounces sliced pickled shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Cook kielbasa in a dutch oven over medium low heat, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Drain and discard all but about 3/4 cup liquid in dutch oven. Stir together the undrained stewed tomatoes, diced tomatoes with chile peppers, diced onion, sesame oil, and icing sugar in a large bowl. Place hot kielbasa in the center of the mixture, spreading evenly. Top with the orange slices and pickled shiitake mushrooms. Cover skillet.

title: Apricot Jelly
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 3 tablespoons apricot jam
instructions: Pour gelatin into a small saucepan, and cook over medium high heat stirring constantly until the gelatin has completely dissolves. Remove from heat.

title: Chile Cheese (No Canning)
ingredients: 16 ounces chile cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, combine the chile cheese and taco seasoning mix. Microwave on high for 30 seconds, or until melted, stirring after 5 seconds. Pour into a bowl and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Strawberry Kale Wrapped Kale (Indian Tea Recipe)
ingredients: 2 packages of washed fresh kale | 1 1/2 cups flour | 1/4 cup pure maple flavored syrup | 1 teaspoon cumin powder, more if desired
instructions: Wash and wash the kale thoroughly and drain well. Place it in a bowl with the remaining ingredients, mix thoroughly. Line a large cookie sheet with waxed paper at least 2 inches square and wrap the kale into a cigar shape loaf. Seal with another piece of waxed paper. Refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 1 hour before serving. Slice with diagonal lines and serve with ice. Use as a burrito filler for ceviche, sour cream, etc. Note, you can freeze any kind of kale or cabbage in their oil with a package of frozen leaf lettuce and sugar added in that case.

title: Macaroni With Eggs, Macaroni, and Eggs
ingredients: 300 g macaroni, dry weight
instructions: Bring water to boil in large saucepan. Meanwhile cook macaroni in boiling water for approximately 8 minutes or until just tender. Drain. To serve, place 1/2 cup macaroni on serving plate. Top with eggs, eggs, and eggs to serve.

title: Easy Mexican Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 2 cups water | 1/2 cup fresh coriander leaves, coarsely chopped or 1 tablespoon dried coriander | 1 lime, zest of, grated | 2/3 cup romano cheese ( or other good soft white cheese ) or 2/3 cup parmesan cheese ( or other good soft white cheese )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a medium size pan and bring to a boil. Adjust the heat so liquid just simmers, but do not let it boil. Reduce the heat and simmer 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and cool to room temperature. Use immediately or cover and allow to cool completely before refrigerating.

title: Butternut Welsh Parsnip Roasted Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, trimmed and cut into 2 inch chunks | 1 teaspoon mustard powder ( preferably sweet mustard powder )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Put the squash in a medium size roasting tray and sprinkle the mustard powder over, turning a few times. Scatter with a knob more mustard powder if using and roast for 45 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: szechuan peppercorn,baguette,shiraz wine,mint,parmesan cheese,quinoa,kaffir lime leaf,thyme sprig
title: Quinoa-Shiraz Soup With Chiles & Herb Bread
ingredients: 32 ounces hot quinoa | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns, cracked | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 2 ounces parmesan cheese, shaved | 1/2 lb shiraz wine | 3 -4 fresh thyme leaves | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 1 baguette, cut into 1-inch dice
instructions: Place quinoa, peppercorns, dried thyme and parmesan in large bowl and pour broth over. Add the thyme and lime leaves, mixing well to get the infused goodness and spices right. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for several hours. Bring to room temp before serving. Serve the soup with chile fresco on the side to kick it up a notch.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,self rising flour,double cream,bread crumb,almond,seasoning salt,lard
title: Almond Coated Scones
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons lard | 1 tablespoon melted butter | 1/2 cup toasted slivered almonds | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 1/2 cups fresh bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together flour and salt. Mix in the lard and butter until mixture starts to come together. Add almonds, garlic, bread crumbs and seasoning. Mix well, and transfer to a lightly greased baking sheet. Score tops with a fork. Bake in preheated oven until golden.

Random Ingredients: salsa,red thai chile,yellow squash,victoria sponge cake,tart apple
title: Apple-Vegetable Tricolor Bake
ingredients: 1 small yellow squash, cut into 1/4-inch slices ( about 1 cup ) | 1 small red thai chile, minced | 1/2 small unpeeled tart apple ( peeled, cored, cut into 1/4-inch slices ) | 1 jar prepared medium salsa | 1 package miniature savoiardi sponge cakes from the tins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange squash slices on an ungreased large baking sheet. Bake until tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and stir in chili and apple slices. Set aside. Spoon salsa into an 11 x 7 inch baking dish, top with cake slices, making sure each slice consists of about 3 slices of fruit. Sprinkle with remaining sugar. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes, until lightly browned. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,shell pasta,raisin,yogurt,soya sauce,american cheese,cilantro leaf,french onion
title: Spicy Naan Bread
ingredients: 1 lb raw shell pasta | 8 ounces american cheese | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 4 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/2 cup yoghurt | 2 tablespoons french's fried onions
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Put noodles in pot of boiling water and cook until al dente, about 3 minutes. Drain pasta, reserving some liquid. Cut cheese block into 3/4 inch cubes. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the 1/2 stick of the butter, swirling to evenly coat the bottom of the pan. When soft, add raisins, cilantro, soya sauce, and coriander. Stir together. Add this mixture into the hot pasta and cheese. Stir to melt everything. Add a little of the reserved pasta liquid and stir to coat. Remove from heat. Spread yogurt on a platter, leaving the rest on. Spread the fried onions on the crouton top, then top the oi with a layer of the cheese mixture. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Steak Au Fromage
ingredients: 500 g steak, suitable for steaks | marsala wine or water | white pepper powder or coriander powder
instructions: Remove excess fat and/or gristle from the steak and discard from the gristle. Cut the steak into slices of equal size. Lay them on a tray. Sprinkle lightly with white pepper or coriander powder and add a little marsala or water. Cover and refrigerate. Take each slice and turn them over quickly for 45 seconds. Turn the steak over and repeat for both ends. Keep refrigerated. Drain the meat before serving with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: biscuit,mexican cheese,green pea,chicken stock cube,broccoli floret,kalamata olive,bell pepper,farfalle pasta
title: Mexican Broccoli Farfalle
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated biscuits ( one bag per person ) | 1/2 cup frozen green pea ( thawed and drained ) | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1/2 cup sliced blanched green pea | 1/2 cup bottled kalamata olive ( sliced or sliced ) | 1/2 cup diced sweet bell pepper ( red or green ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 1/2 cups mexican cheese ( grated )
instructions: Place biscuits on cookie sheet and bake in oven according to package directions. While still hot, remove from oven and set aside. Cook broccoli until tender. While broccoli is roasting, cook peas according to package directions. Remove broccoli from oven and set aside. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, add chicken or veggie cube and cook until lightly brown. Add cooked broccoli to skillet and stir in peas. Top with mexican cheese and return to oven until cheese melts. Remove from oven and spread cheese in small circle on baking sheet. Return to oven and continue to cook until cheese melts. Place biscuit on plate and top with broccoli mixture.

title: Apple Beef in Romano
ingredients: 1 medium mcintosh apple, peeled, cored, cut into 8 wedges | 1 romano cheese, grated | 1 lime wedge | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh basil, chopped | 1 lb thinly sliced roast beef
instructions: Preheat grill, or broiler. Rub lime wedge around rim of 4 ramekin dishes or crocks. Place apple wedges around edge of ramekin dishes. Sprinkle cheese wedges, basil and roast beef on top of apple wedges and broil about 4 inches from heat 3 - 5 minutes or just until cheese is bubbly.

title: Marinated Artichokes
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted and finely chopped | 1 quart lard
instructions: Rinse artichokes and drain well.

title: Poblano Chops
ingredients: 8 poblano chiles, seeded and deveined | 4 pork loin chops, 1 inch thick | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Arrange poblano chiles in a single layer on a large rimmed baking sheet. Toss chiles with vegetable oil in a zipper bag or shallow bowl until coated with oil. Place in refrigerator 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Heat a large cast iron skillet over high heat. Lay chiles flat on baking sheet.

title: Quick Curried Fish
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 canning salt | 1 package curry paste
instructions: In a large glass jar or large dutch oven, combine taco seasoning mix, canning salt, curry paste and curry paste. Cover and allow to steep in refrigerator for 1 hour. Add salt as desired.

title: Whole Wheat Bread & Bacon Toasts
ingredients: 3 slices streaky bacon ( may use a rasher of bacon ) | 250 g whole wheat bread | maggi seasoning mix
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c/180c/gas cut each slice of bread in half. Cook the bacon in an oven dish in the oven without stirring for 8 - 10 minutes for normal to ensure that it's all cooking in about 15 - 15 minutes. Remove bacon from the oven and place onto a chopping board, trying to catch any fat on it. Cut into 5cm lengths with scissors and scatter over the toasted bread. Sprinkle with a little maggi seasoning if using. Cut the bacon strips into 3 long strips and place onto bread. Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until the crumble starts to brown and crisp on top.

Random Ingredients: carrot,marsala wine,chipotle hot sauce,egg noodle,maple syrup,pork loin,black
title: The Ultimate Gourmet's Baked Spicy Chipotle Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 chipotle hot sauce ( we used el pato brand ) | 1 teaspoon maple syrup ( not reduced fat ) | black and green parts of a rotisserie pork loin | 1 link black pork loin, cut into large chunks | 1 1/2 cups marsala wine | 1/4 cup fresh carrot, coarsely grated | 8 ounces precooked egg noodles ( i used ronzoni brand )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove the skin away from the pork, and chop meat into about 1 inch cubes. Spread the chipotle hot sauce on the pork and pork loin, and place the pork in a 9 x 5 x 3 inch loaf pan. Sprinkle the maple syrup on top of the pork, add any remaining bits onto the top of the pork. Bake in the preheated oven, until the pork is no longer pink inside, about 1 hour. Meanwhile, place the carrots, wine, and taco sauce in a small saucepan, and bring just to a simmer over medium heat. While waiting for the pork to bake, get noodles, and set aside. When the pork is done, remove from the oven, and place onto a wire rack over a large bowl. While waiting for it to cool, slice off the ends of any meat chunks, so that they don’t become large chunks. Place the meat chunks back onto the cutting board, and gently break them apart into smaller chunks. Set aside. To form the meatloaf mixture, lay out a piece of the pork loin on your work surface, and gently pat it out. Spread some of the marinadera liquid onto the pork loin, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Starting at one end, roll up the pork loin, then place into a 9 x 5 inch loaf pan. Repeat until the pan is full. Sprinkle on remaining marinadera liquid, and spoon the meat juices over the top of the meat and carrots. Sprinkle with grated carrots and grated cheese. Cover with aluminum foil, and bake for 30 minutes, until the meat is done. Remove the aluminum foil, and cook for another 10 to 15 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 140f, and the cheese has melted and begun to brown.

title: Taco Cream
ingredients: 600 g mascarpone cheese | taco sauce ( homemade or ready made )
instructions: Pour 1/2 tsp of tlbs of taco sauce into a bowl. Dip the mascarpone into the sauce then dig inches. Use a fork to whip the mascarpone cheese in your bowl. Spread the tlbs of taco sauce/taco sauce onto your favorite plate using a teaspoon or a wooden spoon.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,garlic,golden syrup,parsley sprig,chicken wing,cayenne pepper,salt substitute,non dairy coffee creamer
title: Buffalo Chicken Wings
ingredients: 6 lbs chicken wings ( cut at joints ) | 1/4 cup non-dairy coffee creamer | 1/8 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes ( red pepper ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3 tablespoons golden syrup or 3 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons minced fresh parsley sprigs | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1/2 teaspoon salt substitute
instructions: In a bowl, combine creamer, chili flakes, cayenne and garlic and mix thoroughly. Brush off any excess. Place chicken wings in a single layer or in bags, and add mixture. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 375°f. Place rack 8 inches from heat and place chicken on baking sheet. Bake for 25 - 35 minutes or until browned and cooked through. Drain excess fat. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pickle relish,egg,whipping cream,red chilies,tamari,monosodium glutamate,worcestershire sauce,lemon
title: Hot Tamari Eggs
ingredients: 1 egg | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 3 tablespoons tamari | 2 teaspoons finely minced canned red chilies | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish | 1 teaspoon dry lemon rind | 1 teaspoon msg ( msg ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | lemon ( to garnish )
instructions: In a medium size glass bowl, beat egg white until stiff peaks form. In a separate bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Using a spatula, fold into stiff egg whites until smooth.

title: Mexican Green Chicken on the Side
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 2 -3 serrano chilies, seeded, chopped | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Sprinkle coriander powder on chicken. Place in plastic bag.

title: Apple Covered Green Apples
ingredients: 2 cups whole green apples, peeled, cored, and halved | 3/4 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place apple halves, cut side up, in a glass baking dish. Sprinkle with cumin. Bake in the preheated oven until apples are tender and are starting to darken, about 30 minutes. Let cool, about 10 minutes.

title: Saffron Roast Pork
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 8 ounces pork loin roast, trimmed and cut into 2 to 2 1/2-inch cubes | 1/3 cup rice flour | 2 tablespoons white wine | 2 tablespoons lard, softened | 1/3 teaspoon minced fresh gingerroot
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place saffron crumbs in small skillet and toast, stirring constantly, until golden brown and fragrant, about 3 minutes. Set aside. In a large bowl, combine pork cubes, flour and wine in small bowl. Rub mixture into pork, coating well. Spread in roasting pan. Roast pork in oven for about 35 minutes. Remove meat from oven. Heat oil in skillet over medium high heat. Drain fat from pan. Stir in gingerroot. Spoon about 1/4 cup chicken broth over pork. Bake for about 45 minutes. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Continue cooking for about 45 minutes more, or until meat is tender. Transfer to a platter, remove foil. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,cream tartar,ketchup,sriracha sauce,ice cream,garlic,beef stock chicken,strawberry
title: Strawberry Sauce With Barbecued Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 4 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons low-sodium beef stock or 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 tablespoon sriracha sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 4 large strawberries, sliced | ice cream, for serving warmed ( optional )
instructions: In a shallow saucepan, combine vinegar, ketchup, broth, sriracha, and cream of tartar. Add garlic, cover, and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Discard garlic puree and add to beef mixture in pan, stirring gently. Increase heat to high and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. If desired, allow sauce to thicken slightly and add ice cream.

title: Pimento Garlic Toast
ingredients: 4 slices bread | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 4 garlic cloves | 2 teaspoons sweet creole fresh butter | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 tablespoon louisiana hot sauce | 1 jar diced pimientos | 1/4 cup chopped ripe olives or 1/4 cup black olives
instructions: Combine anise seeds, garlic and 1 teaspoon of the creole hot sauce in a mortar and pound with a pestle until paste is formed. Add pimientos and olives to mortar and combine well. Spread a thin layer of creole hot sauce over each slice of bread. Dip each piece of bread into oil, coating both sides and turning to coat both sides. Place in a hot,tered skillet and brown both sides. Remove from skillet and top with remaining creole hot sauce. Makes four servings.

title: Gingered Vinegar Sandwich (Palm Beach, Southern Style)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar, or to taste ( optional ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons ginger garlic paste, or to taste | 12 thick slices bread, toasted
instructions: Mix vinegar, ginger garlic paste, and white wine vinegar in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: topping,agave nectar,bread dough,pecan,green pea,green chile,spinach leaf
title: Green Pea, Spinach and Pecan French Bread Wedges
ingredients: 1 package frozen bread dough, thawed | 1 can green peas, drained and rinsed | 2 cups fresh spinach leaves, cleaned ( packed ) | 4 tablespoons green chiles, diced | 3/4 cup green pea syrup ( or to taste ) | 1/3 cup agave nectar | 2 teaspoons dried pecans, chopped ( or use more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Sweet Raisin Sauce With Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup chunky bechamel sauce | 10 -12 raisins | chicken bouillon or chicken flavor
instructions: Mix peanut butter with hot bechamel until smooth. Dissolve chicken in bouillon, adding it in a bit at a time until the previous mixture is completely absorbed. Stir in chopped raisins. Enjoy.

title: Aioli (Kiwi Fruit Candy)
ingredients: 4 kiwi fruits | 4 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Cut kiwis into 2 inch pieces and remove peel. With the tip of a heavy knife, scoop out the soft pulp and white pith from the kiwis until no more pulp remains. Place the pulp in a small bowl and mix in the almond extract. Mash and mix in more milk if necessary to form a thick, but pourable dough. Place mixture in an airtight container and refrigerate.

title: Pate Chaud (Veal Pate)
ingredients: 1 lb pork roast | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 lb carrot, peeled and grated
instructions: Mix mustard seeds with oil in a small frying pan. Cook over low heat until very fragrant, but not brown, about 6 minutes. Add the meat and cook over high heat until it changes color slightly, 5 - 10 minutes. Add grated carrots. Taste and adjust seasoning.

Random Ingredients: sausage,coriander powder,chicken broth,spinach,grainy mustard,lemon juice zest,black bean,strawberry
title: Lemon Sausage Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb dried black beans | 1 lb fresh spinach, washed and stemmed | 4 slices sausage | 1/2 cup strawberry | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried coriander powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons grainy mustard | 2 cups chicken broth or 2 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Sort through black beans to remove bad looking beans to expose more beans, soak about 1/2 hour. Drain and place in pan along with spinach and the sausage. Squeeze some lemon into the beans and spinach. Season with lemon zest. Add herbs and mustard. Cook over medium low heat, covered, for 20 - 30 minutes. Remove spinach mixture to individual serving bowls. Heat soup base or liquid on low heat for 10 minutes. Pour into bowls. Serve soup either warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,italian herb seasoning,english cucumber,onion salt,thyme leave
title: French Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 large english cucumber | 1 can 100 % soy milk | 1 1/4 teaspoons onion salt ( i like to use onion seasoning ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning
instructions: Cut the ends off the cucumber and discard. Cut the cucumber lengthwise in half to make slicing. If the cucumber is cut on the diagonal, cut away the fiber and discard. Place the cucumber in a colander and sprinkle with salt. Let stand 15 minutes in a sink of warm water, then drain. Cut the cucumber in half again. Scrape out the seeds and juice. Wash the cucumbers, remove any fibers, cut the halves into sections. Coarsely chop or slice the pieces. Mix the soy milk and onion salt in a small bowl. Add the onion cumin, thyme, and italian herb seasoning to the soy milk. Stir to combine. Pour the mixture over the cucumber slices, cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours. Serve at room temperature.

title: Sesame Ginger Oil
ingredients: 80 ml sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1/4 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Combine the sun dried tomatoes, fresh ginger and sesame oil in a large bowl. Cover and leave in the fridge overnight to develop flavour. Bring the oil to temperature under a frying pan and fry the gingerroot for about 1 minute, stirring constantly until golden. Drizzle with the oil and serve accompanied by roasted vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pea,marsala wine,lemon juice zest,onion soup mix,white pepper
title: Easy French Onion-Pesto Soup!
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 cup frozen peas
instructions: Put in bowl or cup with cheesecloth & microwave until hot. Combine well & set aside. Serve over toast or crusty french bread note, you can use fresh peas. You can also use canned peas & frozen peas. Note, this makes a hearty but pretty tasty base for a french onion soup recipe. You can make this a regular size recipe, just throw it all in a crock pot, simmer 15 min on low or low 6 hour on high, stirring occasionally to make sure the soup doesn't stick. The more veggies you use, the more flavor they will absorb, and the broth has a richer, creamy flavor. Enjoy.

title: Molho-Papelon De Pasilla
ingredients: 6 pasilla chiles | 1/2 lb margarine | 3 habanero peppers
instructions: Roast peppers in preheated, hot oven 10 minutes, turning once, or until charred, split in half lengthwise and remove seeds and stem. Peel off the skin and seeds, then cut chiles into thick strips with seeds in half. Heat the margarine in a heavy bottomed pan. Add chiles and stir fry them just until softened, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add habanero and pulp. Stir in the papelon and serve.

title: Chorizo with Bacon and Chives
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 12 chorizo sausages | 24 large chives
instructions: Heat the bacon drippings in a lidded, large frying pan. Gently fry the chorizo in the bacon fat until golden brown, stirring constantly. Reserve the drippings. Add the chives and cook over a gentle heat for 5 - 10 minutes until the chives have softened. Serve with bread.

title: Beer and Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice ( or 1 1/4 cups short grain rice ) | 3 -4 1 -4 ounces dark beer ( such as guiness ) or 3 -4 ounces chicken bouillon ( or your favorite )
instructions: Cook the brown rice in a pan of boiling water, uncovered, over medium heat until completely done. While the rice is cooking, mix together the beer to form the guinness/chicken bouillon in a bowl. Stir until the beer is dissolved. Drain a small amount of the rice and mix with the guinness/chicken bouillon mixture until well blended. When the rice has a good consistency, pour into a bowl with several inch of water. Toss well. The rice will thicken during this time.

title: Tortilla Squash With Summer Squash Nests
ingredients: 2 small summer squash | 1 small onion | 1/2 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | tortilla chips | 1/2 lime, juice of
instructions: Wash the squash lightly. Trim the ends and squash. Cut the squash in half lengthwise. Split it lengthwise in about 1/2 inch wedges. Slice the wedges and arrange them on a plate. Cut the onions into about 1 inch length wedges. Toss the squash with vegetable oil. Sprinkle with the cayenne pepper and toss. Cover and let marinate for about 15 minutes. Drain the squash and let them sit for about 5 minutes. Drain the marinated squash. When ready to serve, arrange the onion wedges around the outsides of the squash. Scatter lime juice over the top. Serves 1 or 2 as an appetizer.

title: Auberge Beans and Sultanas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sultana, chopped | 1 cup dried kidney beans, soaked overnight
instructions: Place the sultanas and drained beans into the bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade. Add the dried beans and process until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. You should have about 2 cups of mixture. Place the mixture into clean jars or non metallic jars. Cover and store in a cool, dry place for about 6 weeks before using.

title: Tomato Rice "greek"
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ripe tomatoes, peeled, chopped | 1 1/2 cups rice wine | 1 1/2 cups rose water | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro
instructions: Puree tomatoes, wine, water, cardamom, and cilantro in food processor until desired consisorency is achieved.

title: Mexican Tater Tot With Rum
ingredients: 1 package tater tots | 1/2 pint oyster, canned | 1 package assorted button mushrooms | 1 can crushed red chilies | 2 cans mushrooms | 1 bottle rum
instructions: Cook tater tots in hot water until done, then set aside and make your rum sauce. Cook mushrooms in rum, strain the juice from the can and rinse them, removing any excess bits. Place all ingredients, except for rum, in a pot and bring to a full boil. Reduce to a simmer and add tater tots. Cook until tender then add a few spoons of rum.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,mustard powder,pork hock,sesame seed,ice cube,black bean overnight
title: Chinese Sesame Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 1/2 pounds boneless pork hocks, cubed | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 4 ice cubes, or as needed
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium heat.

title: Pumpkin Enchilada Cream Sauce
ingredients: 32 ounces canned pumpkin puree | 2 ounces hot sauce, from a can ( i prefer tabasco ) | 1/2 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, minced
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and store in your refrigerator.

title: Baharat Aka Pinto Beans ( Beans without Molasses )
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried pinto beans, sorted and washed | 6 sprigs fresh coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon rubbed sage
instructions: Rinse beans thoroughly and place in a bowl or dutch oven. Pour in 6 cups water.

title: Spaghetti Sauce for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato | 2 cups spaghetti sauce | 2 big eggs | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes, crushed or 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Peel and slice sweet potato. Pour spaghetti sauce in crock pot. Break eggs in bowl and scramble. Add sweet potatoes, egg and red pepper flakes to eggs and scramble. Cover and cook on low heat for 4 hours or high heat for 4 - 5 hours. Serve over spaghetti with crusty bread as a side dish.

title: Cuban Hot Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 can black beans, drained | 2 cups rice vinegar, or to taste | 1 package ranch dressing | 1 package frozen sliced strawberries | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the kidney beans, black beans, rice vinegar, ranch dressing and strawberries. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,sea salt,ricotta cheese,onion soup mix,spinach leaf,sauce
title: Spinach and Ricotta Florentine
ingredients: 3 boxes fresh spinach leaves, packed | 1/2 cup diced red bell pepper | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 -4 teaspoons bottled hot sauce | 1/2 cup fat-free ricotta cheese | 1 dash sea salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients in greased 13 x 9 x 2 pan. Cover with foil and bake 350 degrees fahrenheit for 45 minutes or until heated through.

title: Tomato and Ginger Grape Leaves
ingredients: 8 grape rounds | 1 teaspoon grapes | 1 tablespoon finely chopped small fresh ginger root | 1 pinch onion powder | 1 pinch dried red chile | 1/2 teaspoon dried cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Soak grape leaves in warm water 10 minutes. Remove hard part of stem of stems and remove any remaining leaves. Place about a teaspoon of grape mixture into each leaf and roll. Place in a roasting pan and top with ginger, onion powder, red chile, and cilantro. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, then remove from oven and pour out any excess water.

title: Chive and Chive Sauce for Meatballs and Roast
ingredients: 1 can beef consomme | 2 tablespoons chives | 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Roll into small balls. Broil or barbecue or grill until cooked through.

title: The Easy Chicken in the Microwave
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced onion | 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Microwave onion and chicken in 1/2 cup bowl covered microwave safe bowl for 10 minutes on high power. Turn and cook about 1 more minute, or just until chicken is no longer pink on the outside and juices run clear. Stir onion with a fork to break chicken into small pieces.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,apricot,shoulder lamb chop,salt black pepper,enchilada sauce,zucchini,cumin
title: Slow Cooker Moroccan Lamb
ingredients: 1 pound shoulder lamb chops | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, or to taste | 3 zucchini, cut into 1/2-inch pieces, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons chopped dried apricots | 1 can enchilada sauce | salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Place the lamb chops in the bottom of a slow cooker, and season them with cumin, lemon juice, zucchini, apricots, and enchilada sauce. Season with salt and black pepper, and cover the cooker. Cook on high until the lamb is just about cooked through, 3 1/2 to 4 hours.

title: Abu Oriba
ingredients: 1 head garlic | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup water | 1 cup abu ( seaweed paste )
instructions: Cut up the abu or seaweed. Bring the chicken or water to a boil and add abu or seaweed paste.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,water,pepperoncini pepper,green chili pepper,pimiento,pizza crust,parmesan cheese
title: Pizza Gain® Pizza
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely shredded parmesan cheese | 1 can prepared pizza crust | 1 jar hot green chili peppers, sliced | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers, sliced | 1 jar pimiento, sliced | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 cup reserved pizza water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 550 degrees f. In an 8 or 9 inch cake pan, spread the cheese on the one half of the cooled pizza crust. Sprinkle the remaining ingredients over the cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until the crusts are golden brown, about 12 minutes.

title: Sloppy Giuseole  (Sloppy Giuseole Tortillas)
ingredients: 4 lbs ground pork | 1 package flour tortillas ( found at kroger ) | 2 tablespoons lard | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 package shredded cheddar and monterey jack cheese blend
instructions: Brown pork and drain grease well. When meat is cool enough to handle crumble and set aside. Place the cheese and lard in a large skillet and bring to a boil. Remove and allow to cool. When completely melted and creamy add the meat. Drain well and mix well. Heat tortillas on both sides in a little lard or a little olive oil just long enough to get them to the correct thickness. Remove and place on a plate. Spread approximately 2 - 3 tbls of the tomato sauce on the tortilla. Sprinkle equal amounts of the pork mixture on top and then with the cheese. Fold up side over, covering the filling tightly. Place on foil covered cookie sheets. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bake 35 - 40 minutes or until done.

title: Chocolate  N' Sweet
ingredients: 4 -5 ounces fine quality dark chocolate | meat, any kind | black caviar, to taste
instructions: Prepare the chocolate by melting it slightly over low heat, stirring very gently once or twice. Remove from the pan and let it cool slightly. Using a hand held blender or food processor, process the chocolate in the pan using either a regular motor or a blender, stopping just a few times to scrape the sides. Add the meat.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,bean curd,fish,sharp cheddar cheese,french onion,lime juice,polish sausage,prosciutto
title: Cheesy Fish Ball
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs polish sausage, sliced ( can use polish sausage or italian sausage, but tastes better with beef or tofu ) | 3 slices prosciutto | 1 can baked beans curd, drained | 1 bag frozen battered fish | 1 can french-fried onions | 2 limes, juice of | 1 tablespoon ground red chili powder | 1/2 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together all ingredients except cheese and mix well. Roll the mixture into small balls the size of a golf ball. Place on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 350 for 20 - 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Top with grated cheese. These can be made ahead of time and frozen. To bake in a casserole dish, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place balls on top of a greased baking sheet, or place the frozen sausages on top of the balls. Cook for 20 minutes and then place under broiler for the last 15 - 30 minutes to crisp. Be sure to watch closely, as the sausages will be hot.

title: Kiwi and Asparagus Crouton
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles | 1 1/2 cups asparagus, trimmed | 3 inches kiwi fruits, peeled and cut into chunks | 1/4 cup cornmeal | 1/2 french baguette, cut into 4 slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix chipotle pepper with asparagus. Transfer vegetables to a shallow 3 quart baking dish. Bake 30 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,serrano chili pepper,raspberry jam,blackberry,tahini paste
title: Alcoholic Blackberry Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh orange peel, chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh serrano chili peppers, minced | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam | 2 tablespoons tahini paste | 5 cups fresh blackberries, stemmed
instructions: Place the orange peel, chile, jam, and tahini paste in a food processor or blender and blend until smooth. Transfer to a large, resealable plastic storage bag and add the berries and seal. Seal the bag and refrigerate the sauce, turning the bag a few times, until it has been completely chilled. Bring to the work surface in a saucepan or slow cooker setting setting to the very slow setting. Remove the bag of berries and discard the marinade. Working in batches, transfer the sauce to an airtight container and let the flavors come together, about 3 hours. Serve warm.

title: Grilled Pineapple Crock Pot Chicken With Crème De Crême
ingredients: 4 chicken fillets ( about 3 lb. each ) | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 4 tablespoons pineapple juice
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Place the chicken in the crock pot, and sprinkle with bread crumbs, cumin and pineapple juice. Cover crock pot and set on low to cook until done 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Remove chicken to a platter and keep warm. Increase heat to high and bring to boil. Skim fat from cooking liquid. Stir in the crème de cassis and remove from heat. Let cool for a few minutes, then spoon into individual serving dishes or into individual shallow flat serving dishes. Serve the chicken pieces with some of the reserved liquid and plenty of crème de cassis sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,granny smith apple,sharp cheddar cheese,artichoke heart,graham cracker crumb,white wine vinegar,lime zest,swiss cheese
title: Savory Artichoke and Swiss Dip
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained ( not marinated ) | 2 granny smith apples, peeled, cored and chopped | 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup chopped coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1 cup shredded reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup grated swiss cheese | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix together artichoke hearts, apple, vinegar, coriander, lime zest and half of the cheddar with 3/4 c of the swiss cheese. Spread in the bottom of a 9x9 baking dish. Top with the rest of the swiss cheese. Sprinkle the crumbs over the top.. Bake for 30 minutes. Allow to cool for 10 minutes. Cut and serve.

title: Japanese Pickled Carrots
ingredients: 3 lbs carrots | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili flakes
instructions: Peel the carrots and break off the ends in long thin slices. Make a slit lengthwise down the center of each carrot, keeping the slices intact. Make sure the cut is not too deep. Place a piece of cheesecloth in one end and tie the carrot with string. In a large pot of boiling water, steam the carrots until just soft but not tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and cool under running water until cool enough to handle. Place carrots in a large glass bowl and sprinkle with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper. Add the vinegar and chile flakes and mix well to coat. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast meat,graham cracker crumb,pasta,potato,canola oil,dough
title: Chicken Dips for Two
ingredients: 1 package boneless skinless chicken breast meat | 1/3 cup mashed potatoes | 1 cup crispy fresh potato sticks | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/3 cup canola oil | 1 package refrigerated dough, patties with insides removed | 1 cup canola oil, for frying chicken
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together chicken, mashed potato, crispy potato sticks, and graham cracker crumbs. Form chicken mixture into large bite size patties. Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil in a large, heavy skillet over medium low heat. Fry chicken, in batches, until golden brown, turning once. Drain on paper towels. Meanwhile, heat 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Fry chicken 2 to 4 minutes, turning once, until golden brown on all sides. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,salt,chicken bouillon granule,hoisin sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,splenda sugar substitute,green cardamom pod
title: Low Cal Hoisin Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups chopped cooked chicken ( about a pound ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules or 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon finely chopped italian parsley | 1/4 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1 green cardamom pod, seeds of | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Add all ingredients to a medium size bowl and mix together. Enjoy.

title: Wild Rice and French-Style Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 loaf sandwich bread, thinly sliced | 1 package wild rice, cooked
instructions: Divide bread on serving platter. Layer rice over bread, dividing evenly. Top with remaining bread, pressing slightly. Cut into six slices. Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Homemade Hoisin Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 - 1 cup hoisin sauce | 3/8 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: Stir together all ingredients. Use immediately or store up to 2 days.

title: Onion Relish (Dolmades)
ingredients: 6 spanish onions, peeled | 4 cups chili oil ( peruvian oil )
instructions: Dissolve the chili oil in an ungreased pan. Slice the onions thinly and add to the oil. Let the onions fry for several hours over medium heat. When the onions are soft, the excess oil will be very clear. Pour the hot oil into a colander. Let the oil drain.

Random Ingredients: tagliatelle pasta noodle,button mushroom,heavy whipping cream,pico de gallo,lukewarm water,brown rice flour,flour,lemon zest
title: Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 cups lukewarm water | 2 teaspoons brown rice flour | 1/4 cup pico de gallo ( pimento pepper cheese salsa ) | 1/4 cup rice flour | 1/2 lemons, zest of, grated | 2 tablespoons flour | 20 button mushrooms | 1 lb tagliatelle pasta noodles
instructions: Bring to boil cream, add salt and flour in a medium bowl. Whisk until smooth.

title: Chop Chop Crunch
ingredients: 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 2 -3 tablespoons freshly squeezed cilantro leaves | 1 stalk celery, finely chopped | 3/4 cup crushed ice | 1/2 lb chopped dark chocolate | 1 lb elbow macaroni ( i use whole wheat )
instructions: Dissolve taco seasoning in the cilantro, celery and 1/2 cup cold water in a pot.

title: Tortilla Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 large tortillas | 2 cups pineapple juice | grated romano cheese or parmesan cheese | shredded lettuce | ghee
instructions: Bring pineapple juice to boil in a microwave safe bowl. Add grated cheese and toss to combine. Wrap the tortillas in paper towels and microwave on high for 45 - 90 seconds for 2 minutes, depending on your microwave. Taste and add more cheese if desired. Serve warm.

title: Spiced Mushrooms With Shrimp Paste
ingredients: 24 shiitake mushrooms | 3/4 lb shrimp paste ( see note below ) | 2 tablespoons mixed italian herbs | 2 tablespoons nigella seeds
instructions: Remove gills from mushrooms and discard. Clean mushrooms and cut into quarters depending on how thick you like your mushrooms. Soak the mushrooms in water for a minimum of 10 minutes to tenderize them, then remove and squeeze the softened mushroom with your hands to remove excess moisture. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the shrimp paste. Boil for 1 minute, then remove the shrimp paste from the water and set aside. Add the shrimp paste along with 2 table spoons of italian herbs to the drained mushrooms and simmer for one minute. The shrimp paste should be thick and fragrant. If the mushrooms aren't yet ready, use a slotted spoon to transfer the shrimp and shrimp paste to a bowl. Add the shrimp and shrimp paste back into the water, and return to a boil. Remove from heat and add the nigella seeds. Note, if you don't like spicy shrimp paste, you can use anchovy paste. Note, if you are in a pinch for spice, remove 1 tablespoon of anchovy paste, then add a bit of italian olive oil or a bit of lemon juice. Enjoy note, to toast nigella seeds, crush 1/16 inch and mix it with a small amount of water so they won't burn or stick together. Note, if using whole nigella seeds, toast in a 350°f oven for 15 minutes or until lightly golden. Note, if you use a shrimp paste, add a bit of shrimp and shrimp paste with the ginger/nigella. Note, you can substitute any shrimp paste for another shrimp or seafood flavor.

title: Italian Sausage or Turkey Sausages With Dates
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 lb sweet italian turkey sausage or 1 lb hot italian turkey sausage | 8 medjool dates | 2 tablespoons firmly packed light brown mustard | 1 jar pickled sliced pimientos
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f. Mix 1 t cocoa with the sausage in a medium bowl. Spread mixture in one of two 8 inch quarts. Arrange dates on dough, making sure pimentos are in a cross pattern. Bring sausage mixture to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer until sausage is thoroughly cooked, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausage and dates to a plate lined with paper towels. Pour fat from sausage drippings into a heavy dutch oven. Cut the sausage and dates into small chunks. Arrange sausage and dates on top of dough in a single layer. Dry sauce over high heat until thickened, about 3 minutes. Serve with hot, plain, toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,shallot,self raising flour,beef rib,pork loin,hard egg
title: Scottish Boiled Sheep
ingredients: 1 lamb loin ( approx. 500g/7oz. ) | 1 1/2 lbs pork loin ( approx. 4oz/7oz ) | 1 large shallot ( minced ) | 5 fluid ounces red currant jelly | 1 large hard-boiled egg ( halved ) | 1/2 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Cut lamb into 1 pieces. Cut shallot into chunks. Cut slices into halves. Wash meat, pat dry, slash the surface very well. Place meat pieces in a large, shallow bowl. Put shallot, currant jelly, egg, flour and water in a small saucepan, stir over a low heat until jelly is dissolved. Pour jelly into bowl, and cover with a clean tea towel or cloth. Leave overnight. To cook, place meat on a plate. Make sure there is room in the center of the meat. Turn meat over after it is cooked. The fat and bones should be released from the meat. Cook, uncovered, over a low heat for 1 - 1½ hours. Turn meat over and cook for additional 15 minutes. Slice lamb.

title: Sausage in Vinegar
ingredients: 1 polish sausage, sliced thinly | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon chopped parsley
instructions: In a saucepan, heat vinegar and chile flakes in hot butter, stirring until sugar is dissolved. Add sausage, cook 5 minutes. Serve on salads with crusty bread, french bread and tomatoes.

title: Grill Swiss Chard and Peppers(Cameroon)
ingredients: 2 lbs swiss chard, stems chopped ( not stems ) | 1 small red bell pepper, sliced | 1 leek, white part cut off and cut down the center | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon grated american cheese ( preferably mexican ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix the chard stems in a large bowl. Sprinkle over the red pepper. Wilt the red pepper over the chard and pepper. Wilt the leek over the chard stems and discard the ends. Place leeks on a plate with a paper towel, then pat dry with the cloth between the chard and the leaves.

title: Quinoa with Green Beans
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, long-grain | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1 1/2 lbs fresh green beans, trimmed
instructions: Cook quinoa in 2 cups water until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain. Stir quinoa, buttermilk, and green beans into hot buttermilk. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,tomato jalapeno,canola oil,white sugar,wide egg noodle,coriander powder,green chili pepper
title: Spicy Sarnie's Thai Noodles
ingredients: 1 package wide egg noodles | 2 cans diced tomatoes with jalapenos ( undrained ) | 1 can green chili peppers ( drained, or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon canola oil, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the egg noodles, and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spice,cream asparagus soup,gouda cheese,lentil,plum tomato,tahini,red chili pepper,mandarin orange
title: Lentil and Tomato Spread(Hibachi)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced red chili pepper | 1 can condensed cream of asparagus soup | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1 can lentils, drained ( green or yellow ) | 1 plum tomato, diced | 2 cups shredded gouda cheese | 1 tablespoon ground mixed spice | 1 tablespoon tahini
instructions: In a nonstick saucepan mix all ingredients together. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve warm over fresh bread, pasta, rice or couscous.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,turnip,italian turkey sausage link,black eyed pea,sultana
title: Nana's Italian Sausage and Spinach
ingredients: 2 links italian turkey sausage links | 2 bags fresh spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 1 can pitted black-eyed peas, thawed | 7 ounces sauteed turnip
instructions: Cook and stir sausage over medium heat to break up sausage and brown.

title: Pommes De Terre (Potatoes Stuffed With Capers)
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, scrubbed | 1 can refrigerated dry cornbread stuffing mix ( i use progresso ) | 4 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon capers, drained, liquid reserved
instructions: Cut unpeeled potatoes lengthwise and then crosswise almost through. Remove yolks and discard. Rinse potatoes well with cold water. Using the spoon, carefully remove the potatoes and save each one. If they are completely dry, add liquid until it is the texture of a thick pancake batter. In a large mixing bowl, combine stuffing mix and seasoning salt and set aside. Fill potatoes with stuffing mixture and place on a baking sheet, or in a baking bowl, loosely cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to place potato on a hot grill and cook, turning once, until potatoes are tender and well browned. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Malibu Spinach
ingredients: 32 ounces condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup malibu rum | 1 lb bag baby spinach
instructions: Heat 1/2 can of tomato soup in a saucepot with 1/4 cup of malibu rum. Add the spinach and mix well. Bring to a boil and then reduce to medium low and put lid on. Heat for about 25 minutes until spinach is soft. You should be able to break apart the spinach so the more you add the more the leaves the spicier the meal at the end of the cooking.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,white cheese,cherry tomato,onion salt,vegetable broth,bread flour,allspice berry,cayenne
title: Broccoli and Cheese Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 cups frozen broccoli florets | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 3 cups white cheese, cubed | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons seasoned bread flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne | 1 teaspoon dried cayenne | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice berry
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and switch oven to convection. Wrap each tomato half with foil. Heat oven to 425°f. Center each tomato round on foil. Place on a wire rack. Bake 20 minutes, or until skins are very charred. Remove foil. Meanwhile, cook broccoli, onion onion, white cheese, and broth in a 2 qt saucepan over medium low heat for 5 minutes. Stir in the bread flour, cayenne, cayenne, and allspice. Heat through. Divide spinach stuffing among tomato halves, filling to overflowing. Arrange on a baking sheet. Sprinkle cheese evenly on top. Bake 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.

title: Green Curry Spiced Wine Punch
ingredients: 3 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 cup premium inexpensive wine | 1 can cheese sauce or ( 8 ounce ) can beef broth | 1 can or bottle beer, can use another expensive cheap wine, such as cabernet sauvignon or bordeaux
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the green curry paste with the wine, cheese sauce or beef broth. Mix well to blend. Cover and refridgerate for 12 hours, turning occasionally. Note, if freezing pour into a freezer bag, label and freeze. To serve remove plastic wrap from bag and use in place of the wine. If using broth, just slice off the top of 1/4 of the bag, scoop out the pulp and discard. Then add the contents of the bag back into the sauce and heat thoroughly. Serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,pear,yukon gold potato,oregano,apple juice,head leaf lettuce,swiss cheese
title: Quick Swiss and Pear Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces angel hair pasta | 2 medium yukon gold potatoes, peeled, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 8 carrots, peeled, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1/2 small head leaf lettuce, chopped | 1/4 cup apple juice | 16 slices swiss cheese | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions.

title: Rotkohl (Sweet and Sour Red Cabbage)
ingredients: 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup curry paste ( homemade ) | 1 teaspoon firmly packed brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 cup finely shredded red cabbage or 1/4 cup green cabbage | 1 cup chopped celery
instructions: In medium bowl, stir together vinegar, curry paste, brown sugar and nutmeg. Let sit 15 minutes, stirring gently. Spoon vinegar mixture evenly over cabbage and sprinkle on celery.

title: Quick Banana Taco
ingredients: 1 banana | 3 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 jar pimientos ( optional )
instructions: Slice the banana into thin slices. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Saute, stirring constantly with wire wisk, until very soft and beginning to brown. Remove from heat. Cut in half and place in medium bowl. Spread a small amount of taco sauce on top of each slice. Mash the banana with a fork, or leave it as is, then spoon over the spiced taco sauce and top with a dollop of sour cream.

title: Cherry enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 cup shredded white onion | 1/2 cup beef broth or 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1 cup chopped cherry or 1 cup green pea pods
instructions: Put shredded onion and mixed veggies into a bowl. Put a small amount of the enchilada sauce in a skillet over medium heat and stir until warm. Stir it into the onion and cook until warm. The broth gets thick and a little thick in the microwave. Spoon a small amount of the broth and vegetables over the cheese sauce layer in the skillet.

title: Moroccan Pepper Powder Substitute
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon sambal oelek spice or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in a clean, dry non aluminum bowl, and mix well.

Random Ingredients: chicken,head iceberg lettuce,vodka,portobello mushroom cap,salad oil,pasta
title: Pollo All' Emilia (Vodka Pasta with Chicken)
ingredients: 8 heads lettuce ( i like angel hair pasta ) | 14 ounces vodka | 1 whole head iceberg lettuce ( shredded for serving ) | 1 lb cooked chicken ( cubed ) | 2 portobello mushroom caps ( sliced, can use more ) | 1/2 cup salad oil | 3 ounces prepared pasta ( can use angel hair )
instructions: Get a large pot of water, heat to boil. Prepare pasta so pasta won't open and cook further. Boil pasta until al dente. Drain and set aside for later. In a large bowl, combine vodka, lettuce, chicken, mushrooms, and salad oil with just enough salad oil mixture for dressing to coat. Set aside. Heat reserved dressing in separate frying pan. Add cooked pasta and toss to coat. Serve in large bowls.

title: Simple and Delicious Roasted Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 cup light chicken broth | 2 slices smoked rye bread | 1 pinch cayenne pepper ( or more to taste )
instructions: Pour chicken broth into large mixing bowl. Place rye bread in the bowl and stir to thoroughly soak bread. Sprinkle on a little cayenne pepper, then add bread. Cover bowl and refrigerate at least 24 hours. The longer it marinates the more flavorful it will become.

title: Quickest Greek Dish
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup fish sauce | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a bowl, combine enchilada sauce, fish sauce and feta cheese. Mix well. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,soymilk,beer yeast,cachaca,anise seed,thyme sprig,tomatillo,saffron thread
title: Saffron Chilled Beer With Caramelized Tomatillos and Saffron Pesto
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces saffron threads | 2 1/2 cups soymilk ( or 1 cup water, or 1/2 cup beer, or half cream or ale ) | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seeds, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand, slightly crushed ( or 1/4 of a small dried saffron ) | 1 cup beer | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried aniseed | about 3 1/2 cups thinly sliced peeled tomatillos, such as argy or mexican | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | saffron ( optional ) or mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: Heat saffron in the 1 tablespoon canola oil over medium heat until fragrant, 2 to 4 minutes. Add the soymilk, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, thyme, anise seeds&saffron. Stir to combine. Add beer& 1 teaspoon dried aniseed.

title: Quick Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup mustard ( not prepared or seasoned ) | 1/2 cup anchovy, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix mustard thoroughly with anchovies. Use immediately or refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: escarole,kalamata olive,red chilies,yellow onion,shortening,breadcrumb,pepper sauce,brown sugar
title: Easy Escarole (Escarole and Peppers) Appetizers
ingredients: 6 heads escarole, washed, dried and chopped | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1 can crushed tomatoes with green chilies ( hunts ) | 2 tablespoons shortening | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, chopped | 1/2 cup soft breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Coat cookie sheets with vegetable cooking spray or butter. Boil escarole with onion until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool. Place chopped tomatoes in blender or food processor with green chilies. Cover and blend until smooth. Stir in shortening and hot pepper sauce. Mix in olives, breadcrumbs and brown sugar. Fill a bowl with ice water and add half the tomato mixture to it. Dip each coated pepper in the egg wash then in the bread crumbs. Deep fry the coated peppers until crisp and golden then drain on paper towels. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,chocolate liqueur,chili oil,peanut oil vegetable,beef base,oyster sauce
title: Chilli Pepper Beef (Korean-Korean Style Steak)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons other vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon beef base | 1/3 cup milk chocolate-flavored liqueur | 2 -3 tablespoons chili oil | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon chocolate liqueur | 1 tablespoon milk chocolate
instructions: Stir fry beef base in a little vegetable oil until it seperates. Stir in remaining ingredients. Add noodles and cook for two minutes.

Random Ingredients: half cream,spicy brown mustard,fontina cheese,caster sugar,bay leaf,corn,pork fillet,mozzarella cheese
title: BBQ Pork With Smoked Mozzarella
ingredients: 4 pork fillets, about 1/4 inch thick | 1 tablespoon spicy brown mustard | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 ounces smoked mozzarella cheese, chopped
instructions: Preheat grill/broiler. Place pork fillets on grill tray, brush with extra glaze and grill/broil. Baste with extra glaze until cooked through. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, combine mustard, 1/4 cup cream and sugar.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,malt vinegar,kielbasa sausage,cardamom,golden syrup,orange juice
title: Sausage With Mandarin Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 2 teaspoons orange juice | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom ( ground ) | 1/2 kielbasa sausage ( about 3 ounces ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Simmer all the sauce ingredients except the kielbasa, stirring to combine over very low heat for 15 minutes. Add the sausage and cook for 5 minutes. Pour over the kielbasa sauce.

Random Ingredients: ham,soy sauce,golden syrup,wheat pita bread,cocoa,guacamole,lemon pepper
title: Chinese Pita Burger
ingredients: 2 large whole wheat pita bread | 4 slices ham | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 tablespoons sweet soy sauce | 1 lemon pepper | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 8 ounces guacamole
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium heat. Brush the pita bread with oil and grill for 3 minutes. Toast the bread and the ham. Spread the soy sauce, golden syrup, sweet soy sauce, lemon pepper and cocoa. Spread the guacamole on the toast and the ham. Place pita bread on top of the guacamole and enjoy.

title: Nigella's Yummy Yummy Oyster Beef
ingredients: 1/4 lb baby carrots | 1 packet maggi 2 % low-fat | 5 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon nigella seeds
instructions: Combine in a bowl the 2% low fat gi, oyster sauce and nigella seeds. Mix well. Marinate overnight in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese spread,soya sauce,lime leaf,cottage cheese
title: Homemade Cheese Spread
ingredients: 500 g cottage cheese or 50 g goat cheese | 1/4 cup cream cheese spread | 2 teaspoons of light soya sauce | 1 -2 lime leaves ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until you get the consistency you like.. Store in fridge.
