Note, if you prefer a smooth, cream cheese sauce, you can blend these ingredients through a fine mesh sieve till you get to the desired consistency. If you want to make cream cheese paste, add a little water to cream cheese paste and mix. Pour paste in a small pan, sprinkle with lime leaves, if desired.

title: Spiced Asafetida Strawberries With Rum & Asafoetida.
ingredients: 2 large strawberries, hulled and sliced in half | 1 cup fresh strawberry, quartered ( or frozen for a refreshing summer treat, like sara lee's ) | 1 teaspoon tamarind extract or 1 teaspoon pure rum | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional, but highly recommended! )
instructions: Place the strawberries on a plate. Mix the tamarind extract, rum, and the asafetida if using in a small bowl and pour over the strawberries, toss to coat well. Let sit for 5 to 10 minutes before serving as a light snack.

title: Corn and Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 14 large white mushrooms, sliced | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 2 packages tortillas | seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a small bowl, stir together cheese, mushrooms, corn and seasoning. Brush 1 package of tortillas with oil. Place on a medium sized platter and sprinkle evenly with cheese mixture. Place remaining tortillas directly on top of the cheese and pour any remaining oil into the pan. Bake at 400f for about 10 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,apple,gemelli pasta,baking soda,vinegar,hamburger,parmesan cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Americanized Spicy Hamburger Bake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb hamburger ( or ground meat of your choice ) | 1 1/2 ounces chopped green chilies | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese or 1/2 cup romano cheese | 2 teaspoons grated apple | 1 tablespoon minced garlic ( fresh or bottled ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 package multicolored gemelli pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package ziti pasta | 2 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with veggie oil cooking spray. Brown hamburger meat and add next 5 ingredients. Set aside. Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling, salted water until al dente or according to package directions.

title: Fried Rosemary Chips
ingredients: vegetable oil, for frying | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary or fresh rosemary | 1/3 cup vegetable oil
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the vegetable oil, dried rosemary and finely chopped rosemary. Dip the chips into the oil, and roll until well coated. Let the chips drain.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,sea salt,spaghetti,shrimp,teriyaki sauce,mustard powder,pork rib,serrano chili
title: Cajun Fried Rice
ingredients: 6 ounces spaghetti, broken into 2 equal pieces | 1/3 lb country-style pork ribs, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1/3 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined small | 1/3 lb sea salt | 1/3 lb linguica sausage or 1/3 lb pork ribs, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 serrano chili, crushed | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce, reduced sodium
instructions: Put all ingredients, except rice, in a 2 quart saucepan. Bring to a low boil, stirring occasionally, then reduce heat to medium low and cook, uncovered, 5 to 10 minutes, or until rice is tender. Stir in rice, cover, and remove from heat. Let stand, covered, 5 minutes to let liquid absorb into the rice. Garnish with chiles.

title: Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb shoulder | 1 lb ground lean pork | 6 ounces honey | 6 ounces chopped fresh passion fruit | 8 ounces arborio rice | salt, to taste
instructions: First make the risotto. Heat the oven to 375°f. Put the lamb shoulder and pork mince into a large heavy based pan and place over a high heat, breaking up all the good bits with a fork. When it starts to brown, remove from the heat and add the honey, stirring well. Pour into a bowl and add the passionfruit juice. Stir thoroughly and set aside. Preheat a small casserole dish and bring the water to the boil. Measure out 8 ounces and add to the mixture, stirring well. Add the rice and turn down the heat and simmer for 10 minutes until the rice is cooked. Remove from the heat and stir well. Pour the rice mixture into the risotto and stir. Return to the stove over low heat until the mixture has been absorbed, stir constantly with a wooden spoon, until well combined. Transfer the risotto to a lightly greased ovenproof dish and smooth out the top. Cover with a lid and leave to cool in the oven for 15 minutes, before removing and mixing with a wooden spoon in a circular motion. Serve at once with plenty of melted butter and your favourite salad or as a side dish with a selection of chilled, seasonal vegetables, such as carrots, celery, parsnips and red potato.

title: Indian-Spiced Salmon
ingredients: 4 slices turkey bacon | 1 carrot, minced | 1 scallion, minced or 1 green onion, including tops, chopped | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons honey | 4 salmon fillets, about 1-1/2 lb. each | 1 teaspoon mirin
instructions: Wrap the turkey bacon slices in foil.

title: Bunuelos De Merigue: Bunuelo
ingredients: 1 lb round steak | 6 tablespoons sugar-free strawberry jam | 3 tablespoons tomato ketchup or 3 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 loaf pears or 1 loaf other firm fruit, peeled, cored, and cut into bite-size pieces | 1 cup raspberries | 1 can mandarin oranges | 1 kiwi, peeled and sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cut steak into cubes about 1 1/2 inch by 1 1/2 inch. Mix jam and ketchup or barbecue sauce with meat. Pour half into a deep pot or large casserole, leaving enough space for the fruit slices to spread around. Repeat with remaining swedes. Add meat, pears, oranges, kiwi, if using. Cover and cook over low heat for one hour. Serve on buns.

title: Baked Oriental Meatball Rice
ingredients: 1 package frozen meatballs, thawed | 1/2 cup arborio rice, cooked | 2/3 cup orange marmalade or 2/3 cup pineapple juice | 1 small shallot, minced | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 -2 cup kalamata olive, chopped | 1 cup cooked ham, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 13x9x2 baking dish with cooking spray. Place meatballs in the baking dish then pour marmalade over evenly. Place shallots in center with a pinch of salt. Bake meatballs at 350 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes. Add rice then stir, bake an additional five minutes until heated through.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,graham cracker crumb,lasagna noodle,vanilla essence,chat masala,marjoram
title: Homemade Sweet N' Savoury Lasagna
ingredients: 250 g rice flour ( besan ) | 3 teaspoons chat masala | 1 teaspoon ground marjoram | 1 teaspoon ground vanilla essence | 80 g graham cracker crumbs | 300 g lasagna noodles ( lasagne )
instructions: In a large bowl mix flour, chaat masala, parlsey, ground marjoram, and vanilla. Add rice flour and mix well with your hands. Add a little water to achieve the right consistency. In a seperate bowl add graham cracker crumbs and mix well. Preheat oven to 200’c. Oil a rectangular lasagne pan. Place noodles in the pan. Spoon a little of the mix onto the noodles. Spread over the crumbs all over and leave to set. Remove from oven and bake in the oven for 45 minutes. Serve hot with icecream or cream.

title: Dolly Madison - Biscuit Filler
ingredients: 200 g baking soda | 120 g dried cherries
instructions: Remove stones from the dried cherries. Measure the baking soda in a medium size bowl. Mix the soda with 300 ml boiling water. Dip the cherries in the soda and put on cling film. Let the cherries absorb the soda for a few hours in the fridge. After that, put the baking soda into a plastic bag and put the bag in the cherries. Refrigerate for 3 days so the baking powder can absorb the flavors.

title: Tommy Amaretta - Grilled Antipasto Plate
ingredients: 2 beefsteak tomatoes | 1/4 white onion | 2 ounces amaretto | 3 ounces pine nuts | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 pinch coarsely ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat grill for high, setting a high setting. In a small saucepan, combine the sugar, olive oil, 1 tbsp water and all remaining ingredients. Bring to boil, lower heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Slice the tomatoes crosswise, and arrange on a plate. Drizzle warm mixture on top. Drizzle warm tomato mixture over tomatoes and onions.

title: Sesame Dip
ingredients: 1 jar picante sauce | 2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup sesame oil
instructions: In a saucepan combine salsa, bread crumbs and sesame oil. Heat through.

title: Mustard Pork Strips
ingredients: 1 cup dijon mustard | 12 -16 ounces ground pork
instructions: Combine mustard and pork. Form into 24 patties. Refrigerate overnight. Grill until nicely browned and cooked.

title: Marinated Beef
ingredients: 1 can beef stew meat, drained and cut into 1 inch chunks | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: In a shallow dutch oven or bowl, combine beef, vinegar and sherry. Cover securely and marinate in refrigerator 3 hours or overnight, but not more than 3 days.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,monterey jack cheddar cheese,green chili pepper,italian dressing,cinnamon sugar,white potato
title: Cheesy Potato Sticks
ingredients: 2 lbs white potatoes, unpeeled | 1 cup italian dressing | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar | 1/4 cup green chili pepper, drained | 1 package shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup dry white breadcrumbs
instructions: Place the unpeeled potatoes in a large pot & cover with cold water.

title: Grilled Hors D'oeuvre
ingredients: 12 ounces porcini mushrooms | 1/2 cup tequila ( or more )
instructions: Rinse and rinse the mushrooms. Rub the mushrooms with olive oil and grill, brushing with olive oil, until the mushrooms are golden and crusty on all sides. Turn carefully to prevent scorching. When done, remove from grill and drizzle with tequila. Scoop hors d'oeuvre into a serving dish and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,anaheim chili,cumin powder,serrano pepper,italian sausage,bok choy,mayonnaise,red capsicum
title: Stir-Fry Sausage, Bok Choy and Peppers Sauteed in Aioli
ingredients: 600 g light italian sausage | 2 anaheim chili | 1 red capsicum | 1 bok choy | 2 garlic cloves | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise
instructions: Slice your the italian sausage into 1 2cm slices with scissors tip. Sauté the sausage in a little over a tbsp of oil until the fat is cooked off and the sausages are starting to brown. You can do this in your foreman grill or a foreman pan. This will take no more than 15 minutes depending on your heat tolerance. Remove from heat and dice your peppers, slice the bok choy into thin slices. Heat a little over a tbsp of oil in the pan to fry the fresh chuncks turning until just starting to turn brown. You might need to add more oil as the chuncks will have considerably less oil when fried. Remove from pan and add the peppers, and chopped garlic to the hot pan. Saute for about a minute or three then add the italian sausage, and continue to stir fry, until it is browned. You will need to turn the heat down so that it cooks slowly. Remove from heat. Mix the mayonaise with a cup of water, and add to the pan. Serve with your favourite side dish such as mashed potato or steamed veggies.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,greek yogurt,white fish fillet,tilapia fillet,napa cabbage,rice noodle,self raising flour,cognac
title: Fish Rolls With Cognac & Onion Rolls
ingredients: 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 2 sheets dired rice noodles | 2 lbs white fish fillets | 2 tablespoons cognac | 2 cups baby napa cabbage, shredded | 4 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 4 teaspoons yoghurt or 4 teaspoons creme fraiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Toast the breadcrumbs in a little hot oil. Set aside. Wash, dry and pat dry the fish. Use 2 x 5cm slices for each slice of dough. Using a good quality fish slice, lay the fish over one or more. Arrange the sliced fish on the rice base. Sprinkle with half a tablespoon of cognac and half a teaspoon of beef base dissolved in a little hot water. Roll the fish up, jelly roll style. Set aside and repeat. To make the onion rolls, roll the nori between dampened kitchen towels to soften. Bring a pot of water to the boil and then lower to a simmer. Remove the rolls and place them on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Prick to prevent them from sticking together. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes, turn and bake for another 10 minutes. Turn a couple of times during cooking time and keep them in a warm oven until serving time. To serve the fish rolls, spread the rice and noodle sheets on the board and divide the fish among the sheets. Using a fork, combine all of the juices from the tray with the cabbage, stock and sugar. Arrange the rolls, filling side by side. Drizzle with the cognac mixture and drizzle with the yoghurt or creme fraiche. Serve with a little fresh bread.

title: Crunchy Oaty Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup quick oatmeal | 3/4 cup water | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 - 1 1/2 cup yoghurt | 1 - 1 1/2 cup cool whip | topping, for topping ( we like to use miracle whip )
instructions: Mix the first three ingredients together in bowl until oatmeal dissolves and mixture is smooth. Add yoghurt and blend well. Spread on a spoonful or just a small container or slice of cool whip. Top as desired. Serve with toasted pita pockets or your favourite snack.

title: Irish Flag Potatoes, Potato Salad
ingredients: 5 potatoes, quartered and boiled | 1 lb large red cabbage, shredded | 1 lb russet potato, diced | 4 ounces low-fat sour cream | 1/2 cup low-fat cream coconut, chopped | 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. In a large bowl combine potatoes, cabbage, sour cream, coconut, vinegar and flour. Toss lightly to mix. Put potatoes on a foil lined baking dish. Pour dressing over potatoes. Bake for 40 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Cheese Crusted Blintzes
ingredients: 2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1 3/4 cups powdered sugar | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 12 slices smoked roast | 1 pound ready to bake puff pastry sheets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Grease one 11x7 inch cake pan generously. Mix the cheddar cheese, powdered sugar, fenugreek seeds, and roast in a food processor or spice grinder to form a smooth paste. Spread the mixture into the prepared cake pan. Roll each pastry sheet lengthwise into a 12 inch circle. Bake the puff pastry until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Cut the warm pastry into 12 wedges.

title: Quick and Easy Filipino Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1/2 vanilla bean, scraped | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 plum tomato, cut crosswise in half
instructions: Heat oven to 350°. Prepare a cookie sheet by lining with parchment paper and set aside. Place flour, soy sauce, vanilla bean and catsup in a medium bowl. Stir to combine. In a small skillet, toast the tomato over low heat until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Set aside to cool. Using a small bowl, crumble up the cooled tomatoes.

title: Braised Beef Oxtail
ingredients: 3 lbs oxtails | 1 large fresh apple ( like granny smith ) | 2 cans mussels, cleaned
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the oxtails. Rinse the oxtails in cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Place the oxtails in a large, heavy pot. Cut 2 partial slits, 1 inch deep into each oxtail. Cut a 1/2 inch slit in top of each oxtail. Cover with cold water, bring to a boil, and lower the heat to medium. Skim any scum from the surface and bring the water to a boil. Remove from the heat. When the water boils, cover, and set aside for one hour, skimming the scum again if necessary. Stir the oxtail around the edges with tongs, and cover again. The oxtails are done when the meat has turned white and the skinned off and the oxtails show grayish color. Remove the oxtails from the pot and set aside to cool for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove the oxtails from the pot, and set aside to cool. Skim as much fat as possible from the liquid. Cut 3 partial slits in the top of each oxtail, and insert the sliced apple into the holes. Cover with cold water, bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until the apple has fully cooked. Remove from the heat. Remove the oxtails from the pot, and set aside to cool. Place the mussels in a large, heavy pot. Cover the mussels with cold water and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium, and cook slowly until the shells open, about 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from the heat. Serve the oxtails topped with warm broth and crusty bread.

title: Cheesy Herring With Dried Berry Beans
ingredients: 1/2 pound herring, cleaned and dried | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 1/2 cups peanuts oil for frying | 1/2 cup peanut oil for frying | 1 3/4 cups corn kernels | 1/3 pound shredded sharp cheddar cheese to taste | 1/3 cup chopped dry-roasted peanuts
instructions: Soak herring in cold water until soft, about 20 minutes. Bone herring and cut into strips about 1 1/2 inch wide, 2 inches long, and 2 inches long. Drain herring slices and discard bones. Dry herring slices on paper towels. Heat 1 tablespoon cornstarch and 2 tablespoons corn oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat, stirring often, until peanut oil begins to smoke. Add the herring slices and fry, turning once, until golden brown on both sides, about 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate. Repeat with remaining oil, herring, and corn oil mixture. Heat 1 1/4 cups of corn oil in a skillet over medium heat until hot. Stir in the peanuts until coated. Toss fried herring with the peanuts.

title: Egg and Wine Sorbet (Spain)
ingredients: 1 lb hard-boiled egg | 1 bottle dry white wine | 6 slices orange peel, about 3 inches long
instructions: Peel egg shells, break egg into large chunks and set aside. Place wine in a small, heavy skillet with a tight fitting lid and cook until it has almost evaporated. Meanwhile, put egg chunks in food processor. Cover with cold water, process until well mixed. Place a metal bowl over the bowl to drain the water. With the back of a wooden spoon, make 3 - 4 indentations in the top half of each egg. Place egg whites in a saucepan of simmering water. Cook, stirring, until the whites form stiff peaks. Remove mixture from heat. Cover the bowl of cold water with a damp kitchen cloth and cool egg mixture for 5 minutes. Beat egg whites in a bowl using electric mixer until light and fluffy but not dry. Gradually add the wine, stirring constantly, until the whites are stiff and glossy, about 5 more minutes. Transfer egg mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish or glass pie plate and set aside. Working with 1 egg at a time, dip soaked egg in the egg, cover well with the wine mixture and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Working with 1 egg at a time, working with 1 egg at a time, dip soaked egg, cover well with wine mixture and refrigerate for 6 hours. Working with 1 egg at a time, working with 1 egg at a time, dip soaked egg, cover well with wine mixture and refrigerate for 6 hours. Repeat with remaining eggs. Place 3 orange slices over each serving. Serve with a scoop of chilled hard boiled egg. Note, you can also spoon a scoop of the egg white dessert with a spoon over the top of each serving and invert onto the plate.

title: Turkish Lemon and Oil Sauce
ingredients: 2 lemon limes and 2 lemon quarters | 1/2 cup lite olive oil | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Juice the limes, leaving 4 or 5 wedges. Squeeze the juice from both zest and cut off half of the rind. Toss the juice with the lemon and oil. Let sit at room temperature for at least an hour before using as a thick and sweet basting sauce. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,gingerroot,cooking wine,kielbasa,chocolate chip,chipotle chile
title: Sticky Pork Loin with Chipotle Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 boneless country-style pork loin roast | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 2-inch pieces | 2 chipotle chiles, in adobo | 8 ounces dried unsweetened chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon peeled grated fresh gingerroot | 1/2 cup snipped chinese-style cooking wine ( i also use an oregon trail flavored zinfandel iced peach wine )
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees. Place the pork loin in a heavy duty zip top plastic bag, seal, and place in a large baking dish. Remove the air from bag and add the kielbasa pieces and the chipotles. Shake the bag so the pork is coated. Sprinkle with the chiles, cover and refrigerate for 8 hours and up to 24 hours, tossing occasionally. Remove the pork from the refrigerator and drain the liquid over the pork. Stir in the chocolate chips, gingerroot and cooking wine. Pour the pork mixture into a 4 quart roasting pan and cook uncovered, basting often with the pan drippings until it bubbles and is dark brown, about 1 hour. Serve with warm biscuits that have been coarsley crushed with the side of a cooking spoon.

Random Ingredients: cold water,golden raisin,lime juice zest,grand marnier,wine vinegar,green chile pepper
title: Moroccan Grape-Grape Jam
ingredients: 1/4 cup white sugar | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato wine vinegar, chopped | 1/3 cup grape-grape juice, from jarred grape grape jellies | 1/3 cup green chile peppers | 1/3 cup golden raisins | 1 1/2 cups cold water
instructions: Dissolve sugar in sun dried tomatoes. In a 3 to 4 quart pan combine grape grape juice with chili peppers and raisins. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 45 to 50 minutes until thick and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Remove from heat and add chile juice mixture. Stir to blend. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Broccoli 'n' Saffron (Broccoli in Banana Pepper Oil)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon fried banana pepper | 7 -8 saffron strands | 1 cup broccoli, chopped
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or frying pan. Add fry banana pepper and saffron. Fry briefly, stir fry until golden brown. Add broccoli and fry just until the broccoli is cooked.

Random Ingredients: pork,vanilla essence,lite olive oil,thai peanut sauce,white potato,corn oil,scallion,orange juice concentrate
title: Sweet Potato, Orange, Pork and Scallion Stir-Fry
ingredients: 150 g white potatoes, diced | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon lite olive oil ( for frying ) | 400 g ground pork | 1 tablespoon lite olive oil ( for frying ) | 1/4 cup orange juice concentrate ( from a 3-oz can ) | 2 scallions, finely chopped | 1/4 cup orange juice concentrate, from a 3-oz can | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Prepare the vegetables and place in a mixing bowl in a microwaveable container with just enough water to cover. Bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes, then cover to keep warm. Heat the wok. In a small frying pan, heat the oil and cook the pork over a high temperature until it’s crispy and golden on the outside. Remove from the heat. Wipe the pan clean inside and out with kitchen paper, then heat the oil. Add the scallions, orange juice concentrate and vanilla essence to the pork and scallions and stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes. Mix the pork with the vegetables and stir fry for 2 minutes. Serve with rice or pasta.

Random Ingredients: baby arugula leaf,kosher salt,heavy whipping cream,black bean,eggplant
title: Eggplant, Black Bean and Black Bean Pudding
ingredients: 2 small eggplants, sliced lengthwise | kosher salt | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup baby arugula leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray 2 1/2 inch wide pieces of aluminum foil with vegetable oil cooking spray. Arrange 4 lightly oiled slices on foil.

Random Ingredients: tea,leek,sage leaf,gouda cheese,pork loin,pizza crust,mint,romano cheese
title: Tea Smoked Pork Loin Pizza
ingredients: 4 slices smoked pork loin | 10 large fresh sage leaves, or more to taste | 2 romano cheese | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1/2 cup diced leeks | 16 ounces ready to use pizza crust, such as boboli | 1/2 cup crushed flavored quattro shoeste ( such as smoky onion & garlic ) | freshly grated gouda cheese, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Lay out pizza dough on work surface. Arrange 5 sage leaves over dough.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,plain yogurt,bamboo shoot,sea salt,italian green bean,phyllo dough,vegetable stock chicken
title: Easy Italian Phyllo Vegetarian Packets
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh mixed vegetables, i like mixed greens and corn | 1/2 lb firm white fish fillet ( such as cod, orange roughy, sea bass ) | 3 cups vegetable stock or 3 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon plain yogurt | 2 teaspoons sea salt or 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 package phyllo dough ( thawed )
instructions: Cut fillet into 1/2 inch wide strips on diagonal. Cut fish in half lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 2 slices. Stack fish and vegetables in a large bowl. Cover and chill about 30 minutes. Bring stock, chili powder, yogurt and salt to a boil in a large saucepan. Drain vegetables then stir in phyllo. Pile mixture evenly on top of phyllo dough in large sheets of plastic wrap. Cover and refrigerate 2 - 3 hours or overnight. Uncover and grill or broil 5 - 6 minutes or until phyllo becomes golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,chicken breast half,bonito flake,tomato puree,herb,white vinegar,herring fillet
title: Herring With Tomatoes in Adobo Sauce
ingredients: 4 skinless herring fillets | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 2 teaspoons herbs, chopped | 4 tablespoons dried tarragon or 1 tablespoon thyme | 1 -2 teaspoon herring fillet ( optional ) | 2 -3 ounces bonito flakes ( optional )
instructions: Put a tablespoon of sauce mix of the herbs in a plastic bag and coat the fillets with it. Remove as much air as possible from the fish, and soak in the white vinegar. Chop the fillets about ¼ inch pieces. Pour a layer of sauce mix in a roasting pan, and arrange the fillets. Pour ½ cup of sauce mix on top and cook at 450°f for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,pickling spice,coconut flake,peanut oil,cauliflower,vanilla,canadian bacon,mustard seed
title: Spiced Cauliflower in the Microwave
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 pinch saffron strand | 2 cups cauliflower ( see notes ) | 1/4 cup melted coconut flakes | 2 tablespoons pickling spices | 2 tablespoons paprika or 2 tablespoons fennel, powder
instructions: In a small bowl saute bacon until it starts rendering fat but doesn't burn, pour in oil and set aside. Add mustard seed and saffron, and stir to coat the back of a spoon. Add cauliflower and stir to coat in melted coconut. Add water, cover and microwave on high for 6 minutes, checking every minute or so to see the cauliflower still crisp. Add sweetner, paprika, and spice and turn off if it starts to stick. Cover, let stand for 30 minutes. Toss with a knob of butter or warm jam. Use immediately as a sandwich spread or dip.

title: Piperade
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 12 -12 ounces baking potatoes | 2 tablespoons oregano, dried dried | 12 -16 slices prosciutto
instructions: Preheat oven to 425. Lightly spray 8x8 baking dish with vegetable oil spray. Cut potatoes into 1/2 inch slices. Combine with oregano and salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: chicken soup base,bacon,tamari,coriander seed,red wine,salt pepper,mochiko rice flour,beef bouillon granule
title: Japanese Beef and Bacon Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks ( or flank steak, sliced thinly across the grain ) | 3 slices bacon ( i use a bit less and can substitute with bacon bits. ) | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds, lightly crushed | 1 cup tamari ( can sub sesame paste ) | 6 cups chicken soup base ( i use the beef base ) | 7 cups red wine | salt and pepper | 1/3 cup mochiko sweet rice flour
instructions: Wipe steak with damp cloth and slice into strips about 1/4 inch wide. Cut strips across grain into very thin slices. Slice bacon into small pieces and place in saucepan with coriander and cover with water. Bring to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes stirring often. Strain stock into saucepan, discarding solids that may have settled to the bottom. Return stock to the saucepan and add tamari, broth cubes, meat and bacon. Simmer soup until meat is tender. Turn off heat and adjust seasonings. Serve with mochiko.

title: Grilled Salmon With Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb salmon fillet, about 3/4 inch thick, skin on
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. If salmon is frozen, defrost it in refrigerator. Place salmon on greased grill rack, brush with 1/2 tsp oil, and sprinkle with 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp salt. Close lid and grill until tender, about 30 mins turning frequently. Brush with remaining oil, sprinkle with remaining sugar and salt, and grill until cooked through, about 2 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,olive,cream mushroom soup,tortilla,sesame oil,bulgur,dark chocolate
title: Vegetarian Breakfast Burrito
ingredients: 1 container light cream of mushroom soup | 1 package dark chocolate ( use the best chocolate for authenticity ) | 1/2 cup roasted sliced ripe olives | 2 tablespoons finely chopped unrefined italian anise seed | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil | 12 tortillas | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( can use a little or not )
instructions: Drain and melt chocolate in bowl over pan of simmering water. Stir in remaining ingredients and set aside. Heat oven to 300 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil. Place the 6 tortillas, one at a time, onto the pan. Using the tip of a teaspoon, press out the excess liquid from the tortillas into the baking sheet. Place them on sheet and toast for 5 minutes, or until slightly browned. Cool slightly. Spread some of the cream mixture in an even line on top of one tortilla. Roll up the tortilla, starting with the cream mixture side up, and wrap it in the remaining tortilla. Repeat wrapping and rolling with remaining tortillas. Brush top of burrito with sesame oil and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve with toasted slices of sour cream.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Beef Tataki
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, scored | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1/3 cup rice vinegar ( rice vinegar is preferred ) | 1/2 cup chili sauce ( sriracha ) | 1/2 cup chili bean, canned-sesame paste ( optional ) | of fresh mint, roughly chopped, for garnish
instructions: Place beef tenderloin on a plate and spread with salt. Combine vinegar and all remaining ingredients in a bowl and pour over the beef. Cover and allow to marinate at room temperature 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil and brush with olive oil. Slice beef into 5 slices across the grain, then place on the prepared baking sheet. Bake the beef about 25 minutes, until cooked and firm. Turn and bake on the other side another 5 minutes or until browned for a rare beef taste. Transfer beef to the serving platter and garnish with mint.

Random Ingredients: fillet salmon,pineapple tidbit,beef tenderloin,vanilla essence,double cream,coconut extract
title: Coconut Salmon
ingredients: 2 whole salmon fillets | 1 cup fresh pineapple tidbits | 1/2 cup double cream | 4 teaspoons coconut extract | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon double cream
instructions: Mix the coconut essence & double cream until it thickens slightly. Place the salmon into a shallow baking dish & pour evenly with cream. Set aside to marinate for about 30 mins. Turn oven to 180c. Place the pineapple tidbits into a saucepan & add the triple cream, then mix well. Allow to simmer until the cream has been absorbed. Spoon the pineapple mixture onto the salmon fillets skin side down. Bake uncovered for 15 - 20 mins basting every 5 minutes until the fish is cooked & golden brown.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,pistachio,cider vinegar,rice,cinnamon,baby spinach,worcestershire sauce,green coriander
title: Mongolian Spinach Salad
ingredients: 400 g baby spinach | 400 g green coriander | 1/4 cup pistachios | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 cup mull refrigerated rice ( chilled ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons grand marnier ( browned ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice in 2 cups of boiling water. Do not overcook. Rinse and drain spinach. Combine with coriander, pistachios, cinnamon, worcestershire sauce, vinegar and browned palm. Place in a container and refridgerate.

title: Blueberry Irish
ingredients: 2 blueberries or 2 cups frozen blueberries | 1 fluid ounce irish whiskey
instructions: Rinse and pick over the berries and discard any damaged berries. Transfer them to a microwave safe bowl. Add the whiskey and cover with the lid or loosely with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 25 - 35 seconds or until heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Lebanese Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mixed herbs | 2 1/2 lbs lamb, very finely minced ( leg lamb or thigh chops can all be used ) | 1/2 cup mixed lettuce leaves
instructions: Soak the mixed herbs in warm water for 30 minutes, or until they are soft and slightly softened. Place the minced lamb into a mixing bowl, pour the mixed herb mixture over it and mix well to combine. Place in the fridge for at least 2 hours, preferable overnight. When ready to cook, trim off the fat from the lamb and cut into large chunks. Thread meat onto soaked skewers and allow to stand for 30 minutes. Grill on a hot barbecue for 5 - 6 minutes on each side, until cooked to your liking. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Kielbasa With Gruyere
ingredients: 6 polish sausages | 1/2 cup vinegar ( or white wine vinegar ) | 2 pinches vanilla beans | 5 medium romano cheese | 4 -6 fresh sage leaves | 1/2 lb kielbasa
instructions: Cut kielbasa into 2 inch pieces. Add one pound of sausages and one pound of sausages and marinade overnight in the refrigerator. Wash well and pat dry with paper towels. Place the kielbasa into a saucepan with about a cup of water, then add the vinegar. Boil on medium heat for about five minutes, or until the sausages are all sliced and browned on the outside but still firm in texture. Drain, then add two pounds of sausages, two pounds of romano and two pounds of young, slightly stale kielbasa. Stir well. Lower the heat and simmer for 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and kielbasa is falling apart. Serve hot or cold with sautéed french bread, pumpernickel or rye crackers and a salad.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Spoon Sweet
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini, grated ( about 3 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange extract, i use mousseze | 2 tablespoons bittersweet chocolate, grated, about 2 1/2 tbsp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Stir zucchini, orange extract and chocolate until well mixed. Spoon zucchini mixture into a small nonstick saucer or shallow bowl.

title: Lebanese Apple Chili
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chili oil | 2 green apples, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon sumac | 2 teaspoons dry kidney beans | 4 teaspoons tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Heat the chili oil in a large non stick pan or wok. Add the apples and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes or until they soften. Reduce the heat and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 20 minutes, or until they all soften. Stir in the sumac, beans and tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes or until heated through, stirring through.

title: Rajas Con Fagioles (Shrimp in Corn)
ingredients: 500 g corn kernels | 4 teaspoons yeast, dissolved in | 10 fluid g warm broth | 300 ml shrimp stock ( or other )
instructions: Wash corn, remove the stems and discard and mince the flesh. Put the corn kernels in a food processor with the dissolved yeast. Stir until smooth. Add the shrimp stock and continue to stir until it is all incorporated and the corn is well coated. Let dough rest in a large bowl for about 10 minutes for the corn to rise a little. Grease a non stick frying pan with a little oil. Heat the pan over moderate heat until it is smoking when a cake tester or thin metal spatula or a round glass dipped in oil is dipped in water drops into it. Pour in enough dough to reach the top of the pan and swirl it around to coat the surface and allow to bubble over. As it rises it should turn a golden brown color. With a slotted spoon transfer the rajas to a plate, sprinkle with salt and serve warm.

title: Fish and Chips With Savory Creamy Slaw (Sbd P1)
ingredients: 1 package corn muffin mix | 1 tablespoon shortening ( i use a small can of salted margarine ) or 1 tablespoon olive oil ( i use a small can of salted margarine ) | 1/2 cup watermelon, chunks, seeded & diced | 1/2 cup red cabbage or 1/2 cup green cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb smoked bratwurst, sliced | 16 pickled cauliflower caviar or 16 pickled potato skins | 1 avocado, sliced
instructions: Prepare the corn muffin mix according to package directions and set aside. Meanwhile, in microwaveable mixing bowl melt the shortening or margarine add water, melon chunks and cabbage, heat until almost tender. Stir in the bratwurst and caviar, taste and adjust seasoning. When prepared to this point in a bowl, sprinkle the prepared corn muffin mixture over the melon mixture and stir to combine. Place on a nonstick fry pan and fry until golden on the edges, about 5 minutes, cut slaw into 2 wedges. Serve with avocado slices. Note, if you are making slaw on the stove top as i do the recipe is not to temperature for this and it may vary depending on the thickness of the slaw. You can also make a mixture of equal amounts of equal ingredients as follows, 1 package seasoned corn muffin mix = 1 and 1 ratio of egg whites to 1/3 cup cold water=1/2 cup of shortening and 1/4 cup of shortening, 1/4 cup of water. Blend all 3 ingredients well together with a stand mixer or wooden spoon until fluffy. Add just 1/4 cup more water if necessary.

title: Chayote (Cajun Stuffed Loch Ness Cakes)
ingredients: 6 pieces green backfin crab meat ( about 1 pound each ) | 3 tablespoons creme de cacao ( or chocolate syrup ) | 1 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Rinse the crab meat with cold water, and pat dry with paper towels. Stuff each crab piece with a small piece of crabmeat. In a small bowl, mix together the creme de cacao and ground cloves, and sprinkle over the crab meat. Place the crab halves in an oven proof casserole dish, or onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the crab meat is bubbling and lightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Salmon Fillet with Sweet and Sour Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs salmon fillets, cut into 8 serving pieces ( can also use other white fish ) | 1 large yellow onion, cut into 1-inch dice | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 2 cups of homemade sweet sour sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In med hot skillet, add chopped onion and sprinkle with chili paste, mix well. Dip salmon into chili sauce on both sides. Put on baking tray, bake uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,lamb shank,yellow bell pepper,salad green,rib beef,fruit,anchovy
title: Kazakh Zha'a (Persian Lamb Shanks)
ingredients: 6 lamb shanks | 12 baby artichoke hearts, peeled | 1/2 cup salad greens | 1/2 cup orange roughy dried fruit or 1/2 cup apricot, snipped with a knife | 1 teaspoon saffron threads or 1 teaspoon turmeric, dissolved in 2 tablespoons hot water | 3 -5 anchovies
instructions: Preheat broiler. Thread 4 lamb shanks, each 6 inches long and 2 artichoke hearts each. Arrange on broiler rack in one layer. Broil 5 minutes or until browned, turning once. Place greens in a large bowl and cover with hot water. Let stand 10 minutes. Drain. Remove stems and pits from artichokes. Cut greens into quarters. Prepare all other ingredients, except anchovies, as directed above. Arrange on individual plates. Place 1 tablespoon saffron in 1 tablespoon water, and 2 tablespoons hot water. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Place anchovies on a plate, then place in the skillet. To serve, divide greens between plates. Serve with anchovies.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,lemon peel,cayenne pepper,marinara sauce,extra virgin olive oil,russet potato,water chestnut,spice
title: Spiced Spiced Spiced Potatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 medium sized russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 1 1/2 lbs. total weight ) | 1 canned water chestnut, chopped finely ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated lemon peel | 1 jar marinara sauce ( with 1 tbsp. dried parsley flakes for garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large nonstick pan, heat oil over medium high heat. Add potatoes.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,baby corn,grain rice,sun tomato oil,chocolate chip,beef stock
title: Baby Corn in Chocolate Chip Sauce
ingredients: 12 baby corn or 8 baby creton corn, halved | 1 cup long grain rice | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1/3 cup beef stock | 100 g good-quality chocolate chips, roughly chopped
instructions: Heat grill to medium. Place corn, cut side up on a medium griller tray and cook for about 4 minutes, until lightly charred. Turn and continue to cook for another 2 to 3 minutes until charred underneath. Remove corn from tray and cut kernels from cob. Keep cob warm in low oven. Combine rice, sundried tomato, ketchup and stock in a medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: filling,sage,thyme leaf,water,parmesan cheese,mango chutney,red pepper flake
title: Roasted Mango Cheese Pastry
ingredients: 1 cup grated fresh mango chutney ( like kame ) | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons water | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( or more if you like chutney mild ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | prepared meringue or pastry dough, as required
instructions: To make pastry, combine the first six ingredients in a small bowl and blend well. Line a baking sheet with aluminium foil. Place the pastry in the middle of the pan. Spread the mango cheese mixture evenly over the pastry. Bake at 450 degrees farenheit until cheese begins to lightly brown around the edges, around 20 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool a little while you prepare the topping. Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit. Dust pastry with flour and cut into desired shapes with a sharp knife. Spoon the topping over the pastries and serve.

Random Ingredients: raspberry preserve,swiss chard,milk,pork sparerib,anchovy paste,garam masala,chinese wine,bread
title: Pork With Swiss Chard Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf day old country-style bread, unsliced, cut into slices | 1/2 lb country-style swiss chard ( stemmed and coarsely chopped ) | 2 1/2 lbs country-style spareribs | 5 tablespoons milk | 1/4 cup dry chinese wine | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 cup raspberry preserves ( or any other jam )
instructions: Cut the bread slabs into quarters, then cut each quarter crosswise into 1/2 inch thick pieces. Place 1 or 2 slices of the bread into a food processor with the swiss chard and spareribs.

title: Vegetable and Meat Salad
ingredients: 500 ml beef broth, stock cubes ( eg. beef or chicken stock ) | 1 globe eggplant, sliced | 600 g asparagus, cut into 2cm lengths | 400 g ground veal | 1/4 cup watermelon, cubed ( about 125 grams ) | 1/2 cup vegetable stock
instructions: Combine all ingredients except watermelon and vegetable stock and place in a deep, non stick pan. Stir until combined and cook over moderate heat for 20 minutes. Serve with crusty bread and salad.

title: N.y.i.p. Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb camembert cheese | 1 pinch dried thyme, crushed | 1 pinch dried mace, crushed
instructions: Slice the camembert into about 1 x 1/4 inch pieces.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,pea,rib beef,chile,hard egg,chambord raspberry liquor,russet potato,no boil lasagna noodle
title: Lazy New Year's Eve Lasagna
ingredients: 12 no-boil lasagna noodles ( about 1 pound ) | 1 can chambord raspberry liquor | 2 lbs rib-eye beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can viscontiately diced pea ( frozen is fine ) | 2 1/2 lbs russet potatoes ( about 8 medium ) | 1/2 cup pico de gallo, coarsely chopped ( homemade pico de gallo is also posted on this website ) | 3 hard-boiled eggs, sliced in half | 1 -2 tablespoon chambord chambord, for garnish
instructions: Prepare the crockpot. Pour chambord into the crockpot, place on low for 5 hours. Strain juice, reserving juice and discarding solids. Set crockpot to high and cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove the ribs from the chambord and shred meat of your choice. Discard chambord. Cover pork with plastic wrap and set aside to cool slightly. Place the ribs and pea into a large bowl and reserve juice. Rinse russet potatoes in cool water and then cut into chunks and place in a large bowl of cold water, and set aside for 5 minutes. Then peel potatoes, cut potatoes into quarters, and place into bowl of cold water. Set aside. Heat oven to 450 degrees f. In a medium skillet, add a little olive oil to coat and place over medium high heat until the oil is shimmering. Then put the potatoes into the hot oil and fry for about 2 minutes on each side or until nicely browned. Remove fries from heat and set aside. Assemble lasagna, place half of the potatoes in the bottom of your lasagna pan, add half of the meat, then half of the pico de gallo and 1/8 cup of the reserved chambord juice. Top with 1/4 cup of chambord juice. Repeat layers, ending with a top layer of chambord juice, followed by the rest of the cheese. Cook for 20 minutes on the middle rack. Then slide a knife under the lasagna and if necessary, loosen the top and let bake until the cheese has melted and begun to brown. Let set for about 4 minutes and if desired, cut back on the oven shelf, until the top browns a bit and the internal temperature is approximately 140 degrees f. Take dish out of oven and place the entire dish on a cookie sheet or parchment. With a knife, cut a deep diagonal slice across the top of the lasagna and then into the center of the lasagna. Place in a warm oven and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,mace,cauliflower floret,coriander powder,tuna water,egg substitute,chuck steak,chicken bouillon
title: Somali Kanguk (cayenne-Stuffed Beef Kebabs)
ingredients: 6 chuck steaks | 6 eggs, beaten | 4 cups cauliflower florets | 1 can tuna in water or ( 12 ounce ) can tuna in butter, drained | 2 teaspoons of turmerici bhaji masala or 2 teaspoons cayenne peppers | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Cut the meat into cubes or small cubes. Mix the rest of the ingredients for the marinade and rub into the meat. Toss the meat, cauliflower, tuna, and oil together. Skewer the meat in small metal, wooden skewers. Place the kebabs on a plate and brush the remaining marinade onto them. Broil them about 3 - 4 inches from the heat for 3 - 4 minutes, or until they are well toasted through and juicy and cooked. Serve with warm steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,salt pork,broad egg noodle,red onion,chinese five spice powder,green chilies,breadcrumb
title: Chinese 5 Spice Salmon With Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1 red onion | 6 slices salted pork fat ( from a slice of pork fat ) | 1/2 cup soft breadcrumbs | 1 can diced green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 package broad egg noodles
instructions: Peel and slice onions, then cut into thin slices. Mince or slice salt pork fat in a small, heavy skillet. Put bread crumbs and chilies in a large bowl. Break salmon fillet into small pieces and put into crumbs. Add enough bread crumbs to bind the fish. Heat a large, nonstick skillet of bread, 3 to 4 tablespoons of the pork fat, on medium low heat. Dredge the salmon in the crumbs, coating thoroughly. Add the oil to the pan to make shallow fat pockets or pockets. When it smokes, add the salmon and the onion. Cook until the salmon is seared on both sides and opaque in the center about 6 to 8 minutes, then turn down the heat to low. After 10 minutes, spoon the cooked egg noodles into a colander and run cold water over the noodles, shaking to loosen. Arrange the drained noodles on a platter. Surround with the salmon and onion slices.

title: Cheesy Beef Bake
ingredients: 1 package mexican cheese blend, cubed | 1 envelope beef consomme, beef consomme, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f in an 8x8 inch baking dish or other baking dish, add the cheese cubes and beef consomme. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Green Chili Paste
ingredients: 2 -3 teaspoons green chili paste | 2 cups greek-style yogurt
instructions: Combine in a bowl and serve.

title: Pasta Sandwich Fritters
ingredients: 1 package uncooked pasta ( rotelle, rotini, or rigatoni-type ) | 1 cup tomato juice | 1 pita bread, cut into 12 rounds
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: salsa,rye bread,thai red curry paste,salmon,italian sausage,cream cheese,galangal,lime juice
title: Grilled Salmon Roll-Up
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 lb boneless skinless salmon | 1 package cream cheese, cut into cubes | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 teaspoon dried galangal, crushed | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 12 slices rye bread | 1 jar salsa ( your favourite flavor! )
instructions: Start by seasoning your sausage with your choice of minced garlic, ginger, chilli pepper, salt and a touch of red curry paste into the crumbs. Start cooking your sausage at a medium high heat and when its cooked and brown break into small pieces, cook the pieces one minute or they will start to smell raw. While the sausage cooks roll up your salmon and swish around in your lime juice, lime juice and curry paste, coating each piece very well on all sides. After you have wrapped the whole thing up place in a shallow pan and add the salsa. Cover and turn on the grill. After 1 hour remove from the grill. When the cheese is melted add the cream cheese cubes, mix well and serve over the salmon rolls.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,oil,wine,mango chutney,beef chuck,celery,tuna vegetable oil
title: Hot and Sour Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless lean pork chops, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/4 cup palm sugar or 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed | 1/3 cup sweet wine, such as sherry | 1/4 cup mango chutney, smooth or 1/4 cup apricot jelly | 1/2 cup tuna vegetable oil ( optional ) | chopped celery, to serve
instructions: In a wok or deep skillet, heat the oil until smoking and add each pork cube. Cook over high heat until browned but still pink in the center, about 3 minutes. Place pork cubes in bowl, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with sugar. Marinate 1 hour, refrigerated. Bring the wine and chutney to a boil. Pour into bowl. Gently stir in pork.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,onion salt,cannelloni tube,plum tomato,spanish onion,red capsicum,banana,baby spinach leaf
title: Pizza'
ingredients: 1 onion, medium size, chopped | 3 tablespoons spanish onions or 3 tablespoons garlic mayonnaise | 1 cup baby spinach, washed thoroughly with cold water | 2 cups cannelloni tubes, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1 cup cooked cannelloni tube ( reserve liquid ) | 5 plum tomatoes, halved or 5 roma tomatoes, very thinly sliced | 2 large red capsicums or 2 large other very large peppers, seeded and thinly sliced and mixed together in a bowl of your choice | 1 package of sliced and pre-shredded mild cheese ( eg cheddar, jack, etc. i recommend kraft brand )
instructions: In a small bowl, saute the onions in your reserved liquid for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until the onions are soft. Stir in the spinach, then let it cool for a couple of minutes. Drain the cannelloni tubes carefully, put them in a colander or sieve, rinse with cool water, then slice the tubes in half horizontally, and spread each half with a little of the onions. Place half the tomatoes, skin side up, on top of the cannelloni tubes and top with a layer of the onion mixture. Spread half the sliced sweet peppers evenly on top of the salsa filling. Arrange all the remaining ingredients over the top and around the onions. Sprinkle 1/2 of the cheese evenly over all. Cover and put in a 400 degree f oven for 10 minutes, remove cover and put back in oven to melt cheese. Put it back in oven and cook for 10 more minutes, uncovered, then remove cover and bake 5 - 10 minutes more, or until cheeseless and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,apple juice,lamb chop,beef consomme,rigatoni pasta,pinto bean,fast rise yeast
title: Baked Indian Lamb Stew, "Bite Me Up" With Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 4 -6 lamb chops or 4 -6 sirloin steaks, cut to cubes | 1 package fast rise yeast | 1 can beef consomme | 1 can apple juice | 1 cup jasmine rice | 2 cups dry packaged jasmine rice | 2 cans of rinsed and drained pinto beans
instructions: Place lamb in a large ziploc baggie with beef consomme, apple juice and yeast.. Add 2 cups of jasmine rice and 3 cups of dry packaged jasmine rice to baggie. Seal and place in the fridge overnight. The next day remove lamb from bag and place in a roasting pan. Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit. Mix the remaining 2 cups of dry shiraz and the rest of the ingredients in a separate bowl. Divide the leftover marinade between 2 ziploc bags and dump the marinade contents into the pan. Shake bag to combine and allow to set at the lowest temperature setting for about 1 hour. If more liquid has seep into the lamb, pour that into a small bowl and stir about 1/4 cup of water from the bag with a slotted spoon into the baggie. This will get the yeast and beef flavor back into the liquid. Pour some of the marinade into the pan and mix together with a spoon until you have the desired consistency. Add the lamb back into the pan. Pour into a baking dish and let sit for about 1/2 hour. Serve the lamb stew with the jasmine rice on top. Enjoy.

title: Chilli-Peach Lamb Skewers
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs lamb shoulder | 2 large red chilies | 1 1/2 lbs peaches | 1 1/2 ounces peanut butter
instructions: Slice the rhinds into 3/4 inch chunks. Slice the chiles length ways into quarters and split the quarters lengthways. Cut peaches into 1 inch pieces. Thread the lamb onto 12 metal skewers. Place the skewers, cut side down, on a tray. Sprinkle with peanut butter. Place on the centre shelf of a grill, covered with bbq and grill for 15 - 20 minutes or until the lamb is cooked to your liking.

title: Easy Flour Rye Cookies
ingredients: 4 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup white vinegar or 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Combine ingredients. Roll into balls. Let dry on paper toweling. Bake on greased baking sheets in a pre hot oven for about 10 minutes.

title: Oysters With Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 oysters | 1 package button mushrooms
instructions: Steam or boil oysters for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, remove tops. Rinse oysters in cold water and drain. Place mushrooms in a deep platter and place under a hot broiler until just beginning to brown, about 5 - 10 minutes. Serve hot. Mushrooms can also be added to flavored oysters.

title: Healthy Boston-Style Salad
ingredients: 1 can chicken broth | 1 large head lettuce, rinsed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 1 cup milk
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large skillet, and reduce heat to medium. Tear lettuce into bite size pieces, and stir into the boiling broth. Bring a separate saucepan of water to a boil, and remove from heat. Place lettuce in the bowl of a food processor, and process until the lettuce is finely chopped. Stir in bamboo shoots and milk. Continue cooking until lettuce is thoroughly mixed into the salad.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,chicken bouillon,ramen noodle,cod,white bean,curry leaf,prosciutto
title: Baked Cod With Peppered Oysters
ingredients: 4 ounces of smoked cod | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 slice prosciutto or 1 slice provolone cheese | 6 raman's oyster flavored ramen noodles | 5 -8 fresh curry leaves | 1 small chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons of minced fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place the smokey fish fillet on the open side of the smoked cod. Add the minced prosciutto if using, then lay over. The oyster sauce. Break up the ramen noodles and place them in a microwave safe bowl. Place a couple of ramekin slices in a baking dish with a little olive oil. Add the ramen noodles into a bowl and pour oyster sauce over them. Place in the oven for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven then top with the cheese slice. Add the curry leaves and bake for 5 - 10 more minutes or until the cheese is melted and crisp.

title: Watermelon and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 cup watermelon, cubed | 1 cup cherry tomatoes ( halved ) | 1/2 cup blue cheese | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix together and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garlic granule,sunflower seed,focaccia bread,green bell pepper
title: Stacked Focaccia Bread
ingredients: 1/2 loaf focaccia bread, split in half lengthwise | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1 teaspoon garlic granules
instructions: Preheat broiler. Split loaf in half lengthwise. In medium container combine remaining ingredients. Arrange half of cut surfaces of bread in a single layer on a baking sheet. Spoon half of the mixture into bread slices, then top with remaining bread slices and top with remaining mixture. Broil until bread is lightly toasted and crisp, about 8 minutes.

title: Horseradish Chicken
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken meat, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the chicken cubes in a roasting pan, and line the sides with a top layer of horseradish. Cover, and set aside. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until meat is easily removed from the bones and no crispy bits of meat remain.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,yellow cake mix,canola oil
title: Sweet Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 10 cups fresh baby spinach leaves, chopped | 1/4 cup canola oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix the cake mix, spinach and 1/4 cup of the canola oil. Roll each log into a ball and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 40 minutes or until browned. Cool completely. Roll in the remaining canola oil and return to the baking sheet. Bake an additional 10 minutes, until golden.

title: Summer Veggie Pastries, Phyllo-Wraps and Avocado Filling
ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen cauliflower | 1/2 cup frozen whole kernel corn | 1 small plum tomato, chopped | 1/3 cup fresh tomato, chopped | 1/3 cup flour | 1/8 cup chopped romano lettuce | 10 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. To prepare cauliflower and corn, steam cauliflower in microwave for 10 minutes. Cool and chop. Mix in canned tomatoes until well blended. Blend flour and romano. Roll out the 10 sheets of phyllo pastry and place on a wax paper lined cookie sheet. Brush with beaten egg yolk. Cover with a damp towel if a phyllo dough tears. Cut out 3 layers of phyllo pastry. Place one phyllo sheet on top and brush with egg yolk. Cover with another sheet and brush with egg yolk. Repeat 8 times until you have 9 layers of phyllo pastry and phyllo sheets. Spread cauliflower mixture evenly on phyllo pastry. Sprinkle with tomato. Cover with the 2 layers of phyllo dough. Cut out 3 more layers and place on top. Cut out 3 more phyllo sheets, place on top, brush with egg yolk and sprinkle with shredded mozzarella. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 50 minutes or until slightly brown.

title: Lobcrny's (Lobcrédered Turnip and Chicken Stew)
ingredients: 6 -7 tablespoons galiano ( a combination of aged and unfiltered ) or 6 -7 tablespoons brandy | 5 -6 cups chicken or 5 -6 cups turkey meat | ice ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups uncooked brown rice | 1 1/2 cups brown rice | 8 ounces can cannellini beans, well rinsed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Place 1 1/2 t. Lobcrny's or 6 to 8 t. Glace in a large pan and cook over medium heat in the galiano or brandy for 2 minutes. Stirring frequently. Add the chicken or turkey meat and brown lightly on all sides. When the meat is light brown and cooked through, stir in the rice. Add 2 cups of boiling water, stir, cover and lower heat to medium and simmer gently for 25 to 30 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir well and adjust seasoning with salt as needed. About 5 minutes before removing the lid, remove the cannelellini beans from the liquid. Use only the liquid from the beans, with the juice. Rice and stew. To complete the meal, ladle the stew into an oven proof casserole dish, then spoon over the warm beans. Sprinkle with savory. Garnish with more savory if desired. Serves notes, to make the beans a little less juicy, use the juice of the beans yourself.

title: Lemongrass and Rose Water Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 stalk lemongrass, trimmed and roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon crushed dried rose water ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1 dash hot sauce, to taste | 1 teaspoon low fat or no calorie low-fat powdered milk | 2 teaspoons low-fat powdered milk
instructions: If using leaves of the lemongrass stalk, slit off the root end of each stalk and discard. Cut out any tough stalky tops by gently dragging the outer peel between layers of leaves and on the stalk. Cut the lemongrass into very thin strips and remove any remaining tough ribs. Place the dried rosewater, balsamic vinegar and hot sauce in a screw top jar with a tight fitting lid or a small bowl and shake to combine. Add the leaves of the lemongrass and stir to combine. Cover and keep refrigerated. Drain any remaining liquid and serve. Nb. If using a screw topped jar, you may now add an additional 1/2 teaspoon of dry rosewater to the jar and shake. If using a screw topped jar, add a few drops of hot sauce, about 1 teaspoon of no calorie skim milk and mix it well. Otherwise, the sauce may be served chilled. Store in the refrigerator. Variation, for a change, add 1 teaspoon of balsamic vinegar, 1 teaspoon reduced fat milk and 1 teaspoon of fat substitute. Add 1 teaspoon low-fat milk and 1/2 teaspoon of powdered cheese to the mixture and stir.

Random Ingredients: green bean,cheddar cheese,corn syrup,cream mushroom soup,potato starch
title: Easy, Delicious and Elegant Potato Casserole
ingredients: 3 cups mashed potatoes ( i use mashed potato ) | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 14 1/2 ounces condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 cups grated cheddar cheese | 1 bag frozen cut green beans, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Prepare the 3 cups of baked potato. In large bowl mix mashed potatoes, corn syrup, mushroom soup, and cheddar cheese together. In the bottom of a 2 quart casserole dish, layer potato mixture. Cover with frozen green beans, then top with remaining potato mixture. Bake 30 minutes until golden brown, then let stand 10 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Dynamite Sauce for Beef
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces catsup | 6 fluid ounces lemon juice | 6 fluid ounces tomato ketchup
instructions: Combine catsup, lemon juice, and ketchup in a sauce pan. Bring to a boil until syrupy. Serve over cooked cubed steak.

title: Mahi Kamin (Spicy Artichokes Rice With Cucumbers)
ingredients: 4 cups basmati rice, washed through | 1 -2 cup tomato puree ( i use canned ) | 2 -3 artichokes, scrubbed ( optional ) | chopped fresh basil or arugula
instructions: Wash basmati rice well and leave to drain in a strainer. Heat your heaviest deep non stick frying pan you have on hand. Fry rice, in batches, until it is starting to get dark. Drain on paper towel then put into a large bowl or other container that the water will help break the grains. Place the tomatoes, artichokes, and cooked rice on top of the tomatoes and artichokes. Sprinkle on fresh basil or arugula. Note, for those that like your tomato sauce thicker, instead of boiling a can of tomato puree, use tomato paste mixed with a little bit of water. To make this rice really chunky, add tomato puree or tomato paste to the liquid and mix thoroughly. If you are making a rice with tomato puree, just add tomato paste, tomato puree or tomato paste to the pot before adding rice. Also, i prefer leaving out any salt found in my dish. When adding rice at this time, stir it continuously so that it doesn't stick together. When all the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is light, stir and mix for about 1 minute, then turn off the lights, remove the lid and let sit covered for 20 minutes, uncovered. Afterwards, fluff up the rice with a fork and serve.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,barley,artichoke heart,rotel,chicken bouillon cube,fajita seasoning mix,shrimp,urad dal
title: Baked Shrimp (Drawn-Shrimp) and Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs raw shrimp, medium size | 1 box fajita seasoning mix | 1 box barley ( shrimp ) | 1 can rotel | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1 box frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 1 teaspoon crushed jalapenos or 1 teaspoon ground jalapeno pepper | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place shrimp in a large plastic bowl and sprinkle with fajita seasoning mix. Add rotel and the remaining ingredients, except the shrimp. Sprinkle shrimp with papertowels and top with extra papertowels, to garnish. Bake 30 - 45 minutes until shrimp is pink and shrimp is cooked through.

title: French Onion Beer Frozen Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups of cubed ultra lily club soda or 1 1/2 cups chilled old fashioned beer | 1 - 1 1/2 cup to-stick grated cheese per onion ball
instructions: Mix all together and enjoy. Store in freezer for up to 3 months. Serve with tostky balls.

title: Finger Smoked Sweet Onion Jam or Canapés
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet onions or 2 lbs yellow onions ( 1/2 lb ) | adobo seasoning, to taste | 6 pinches rubbed sage leaves, or less | 1 jar apricot jam
instructions: You need a stainless steel pan with raised edges on very low to allow for expansion. The amount of onion used will vary so keep in mind when buying or estimating. Slice onions as thinly as possible. Sprinkle adobo lightly over the onions and allow them to sit for about 12 hours. Put jam into a glass jar with the lid and shake to mix. Pour about half of the jam into empty jar and put another half of the jam on to be used later. Push some sage on top of 1/2 of the jar. Pour jam over onion to cover. Cover with the lid slightly smaller than the jar with the top on. Push more sage on top of top of onion if possible. Do a stir and rotate in different directions. You don't want to get it all wet. The amount of jam used will vary according to how tart and wet your jam will be. You'll have to add more jam and/or salt. Add more sage to taste or more adobo. If desired, cover lid with aluminum film and smoke on low for a few hours. Serve with bread, such as french bread. Note, if using yellow sliced onions, cut into half and wash onions under cold water to make sure salt and adobo are dissolved. Seal the lid and smoke for another hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,cream chicken soup,cake flour,peanut butter
title: Simple Peanut Butter and Ginger Cake
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup peanut butter, softened | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh ginger root | 1/3 cup cake flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a medium bowl, mix soup, peanut butter, and ginger, mixing until smooth. Stir in cake flour until blended. Pour mixture into an ungreased 9 inch square baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean.

title: Seared Beef and Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs good quality lean beef, well trimmed of fat and thinly sliced | 8 ounces medium grain white rice, uncooked | 3/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat a large nonstick frying pan on medium high. Add beef to hot pan. Cook, flipping the slices halfway through, until brown on all sides and cooked through. Note, if it is not done fully, transfer meat to a 9x13 baking dish, cover and bake at 350 for 1 hour or until done. Meanwhile, cook rice according to package directions, omitting the fat. Drain beef and set aside. Meanwhile, warm hoisin sauce and mace in a small skillet over medium high heat. Cook, stirring or shaking pan constantly, until mixture is reduced and shiny. Cut beef into 1/2 strips. Arrange across a large platter and pour sauce over beef.

Random Ingredients: cod fillet,cayenne pepper,red curry paste,cocoa powder,bamboo shoot
title: Chunky Fish
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 can red curry paste | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 pound cod fillets
instructions: Mix red curry paste, cocoa powder, cayenne pepper, and coconut into the drained bamboo shoots in a bowl. Arrange cod fillets in a 9x13 inch baking dish over the sauce. Pour the curry mixture over the fish. Let stand 1 hour at room temperature, then cut crosswise to serve.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,red chile pepper,cardamom powder,pineapple juice,seafood seasoning,chili powder,stewing beef
title: Pork and seafood cocktail
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder | 1 tablespoon seafood seasoning | 1 tablespoon crushed dried red chile pepper | 1 tablespoon finely ground cardamom powder, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 can sliced pineapple with juice, drained | 1 cup seafood cocktail sauce, such as cholula, or other good-quality sweet- and sour dipping sauce
instructions: Trim all visible fat from pork shoulder, then cut into 1 in cubes. Place pork, seafood seasoning, red chile pepper, cardamom powder, and chili powder in a bowl. Add pineapple and stir to coat. Cover bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate pork and seafood cocktail until pork is cool, about 1 hour. Place canned pineapple into a blender or food processor, and add enough reserved juice from one can to measure 2 cups volume. Pulse until pineapple is pureed. Pour juice mixture into a saucepan, and stir over high heat until heated through. Set sauce aside to cool. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange pork cubes in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Spoon remaining sauce over pork, and sprinkle top with seafood cocktail sauce. Bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbly and pork is tender.

Random Ingredients: grenadine,lemon pepper,grain rice,genoa salami,sea salt,palm sugar,red potato
title: Peppered Potato Rice Salad
ingredients: 450 g red potatoes, quartered | 1/2 cup granulated palm sugar | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 4 tablespoons greek style red salami, finely diced | 120 g genoa salami, cut in thin strips | 4 tablespoons grenadine
instructions: Cook the potatoes in boiling water until just tender. Drain and leave to cool. Mix the ingredients together. Serve cold.

title: Sweet Prunes
ingredients: 300 g pitted prunes | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup coarsely crushed dried apricots into a thick glaze
instructions: Toss together the prunes, onions and apricots using your glaze. Place onto a greased baking sheet for 30 minutes, or until they are soft.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,grain white rice,celery rib,cardamom pod
title: Easy Microwave Rice Pilaff (Saffron) Recipe
ingredients: 900 g long-grain white rice | 400 g celery ribs, cut into sticks | 1 1/2 liters bottled water | 3 slices limes, zest of, cut into thin strips or 1 teaspoon of fresh zest
instructions: Put the rice, celery and lime zest in a large bowl and top up with the water. Microwave on low power for 9 minutes, until almost all the water is absorbed. Cover bowl with a damp tea towel and leave the rice to stand for 10 minutes. Fluff the rice and stir through the drained water and zest. Cover and leave to stand for 10 minutes. Stir through the lime strips or zest.

title: Radish Crumbs
ingredients: 1 bunch radish | 3 cups panko breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh parsley
instructions: Wash and dry radishes and cut into long strips. Combine panko crumbs with celery seeds and parsley. Dip radishes into crumbs, then transfer to baking sheets. Bake in 350 degree oven about 25 - 30 minutes, or until golden.

title: Fijian Rinsed Lettuce & Red Lentil Salad With Bacon
ingredients: 3 cups torn romaine lettuce | 1/3 cup red lentil, cooked | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in a large bowl until well mixed. Refrigerate for at least an hour. When ready to serve cut bacon slices into 2 pieces & cook on a foreman type grill, till crisp.

title: A Perfect Match for Breakfast
ingredients: 4 teaspoons ketchup | 2 teaspoons coffee | 1 1/2 teaspoons mirin
instructions: Place ketchup in a pan or microwave safe bowl, pour in mirin and stir to dissolve and keep it warm, but not hot. Remove ketchup from the heat. To make a perfect match, mix together it with 1 teaspoon ketchup. Cover bowl and refrigerate, stirring every couple of hours to keep the excess juice that escapes, for 1 - 2 hours. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,catsup,asparagus,tomato puree,italian salad dressing,genoa salami,veal
title: Italian Veal With Beans and Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless veal, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces ( i used veal tenderloin ) | 1 lb tomatoes and tomato puree ( or your favorite homemade tomato puree ) | 1 lb asparagus, washed and trimmed, ends cut off and cut into 4 pieces per person ( can substitute frozen or fresh- snapped beans ) | 5/8 - 1/2 cup catsup | 2 packages italian salad dressing | 2 packages genoa salami ( deli style sausage ) | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder or 1/3 cup light unsweetened cocoa, for dusting
instructions: In a large pot, bring 2/3 of water to a boil with 1 teaspoon salt. Add the veal and continue to boil uncovered until lightly browned and crisp about 4 minutes. Reserve. While veal is cooking, preheat the oven to 350°f in a bowl, combine tomato puree, asparagus and catsup. In the same pot with veal and tomatoes, heat 3/8 cup of water and the reserved 1 teaspoon salt. Add vegetables to the boiling liquid and return to a boil, stirring constantly. Cover and lower heat to simmer and cook for 8 - 10 minutes or until veggies are fork tender. Remove from heat and add the italian dressing. Mix well and set aside. When serving, sprinkle with cocoa powder, if desired, and serve with noodles or cooked fusilli.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,white breadcrumb,baking powder,emmenthaler cheese,coconut,stewing beef,fine breadcrumb,pork
title: Aussie Meat Loaf
ingredients: 3/4 lb lean lean stewing beef | 1/4 lb lean ground lean pork | 1/4 lb lean ground lean shoulder or 1/4 lb ground lean bacon | 1 cup finely chopped ripe olives or 1 cup green olives | 1 1/2 cups fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup shredded coconut | 2 cups canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Cut meat mixture into 1/2 and 5 cubes. If mixture is too dry add a little water. Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix lightly. Spray with non stick cooking spray. Pack into loaf pan and bake 25 minutes. Remove from oven and cool 15 minutes before slicing. To serve, place slices on a platter and garnish with your favorite condiments.

title: Asparagus marsala
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus | 1 1/4 cups sweet marsala wine ( or your favourite, dry sherry can also be used ) | 2 tablespoons applesauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian seasoning
instructions: Cut asparagus into thick rings, remove tough end and discard. Cook until just tender crisp, but not tough tender crisp. Cook sherry until almost evaporated, then add applesauce and seasoning, bring to boil, stir constantly. Pour over hot asparagus and toss to coat, serve warm.

title: Quick Beet Salad
ingredients: 3 beets, medium, peeled and cut in 1-inch wedges | 1/2 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated | 6 medium cherry tomatoes ( about 1 cup )
instructions: Place beets in a large pot of water and bring to a boil over high heat. Cook for 7 minutes or until beets are just tender. Drain, cool and cut in pieces. Combine remaining ingredients, except tomatoes, in a large bowl. Add beet mixture. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour or overnight. Sprinkle tomatoes on top and serve.

title: Basic Meat Pies
ingredients: 600 g beef stock | 1 slice bread cube | 1/4 cup beef stock
instructions: Mix everything together well in a large pan. It should be about 1 liter of stock. I usually double this recipe because the bread has fried up and is thus better for me. Pour into individual ramekin dishes or small pie tins.. Leave to warm in a preheated oven for about 45 minutes until the tops start to brown and the liquid is absorbed all over. If making ramekins, press the mixture in with a large plate or a damp towel and put in the fridge. The pies can then be frozen for upto 1 week. To defrost them remove a little of the fat using a slotted spoon and slice the meat off the bone into a little dice.

title: Irish Cream Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 package round shortening | 6 lbs stew meat | 1 1/2 cups irish cream
instructions: Combine shortening, meat, sour cream and pour into a crockpot. Cook at high setting 6 - 8 hours, or low setting 8 - 9 hours. Remove from crockpot and tent with foil.

title: Swiss Mushroom Spread
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese | 1 can of cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 minced garlic clove | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Cream together cream cheese, mushrooms, diced tomatoes and garlic, mace and chopped garlic. Refrigerate overnight. Serve on crackers.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,hamburger meat,orange marmalade,sesame oil,cornflour,hungarian paprika,pizza sauce spaghetti,vegetable broth
title: Paprika Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 1/4 lbs hamburger meat ( ground ) | 1 1/4 cups pizza sauce or 1 1/4 cups spaghetti sauce | 1 1/4 cups spaghetti sauce or 1 1/4 cups spaghetti sauce | 4 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Whisk cornflour with 1 tbsp of oil. Dip the hamburger into the mixture and brown. Drain the hamburger and add it with the remaining sauce and spaghetti sauce. Simmer for 20 - 30 minutes. Blend to a chunky paste with 1 tbsp oil mixed with the marmalade and heat through. Add 1 tsp sweet paprika, stir. Serve over cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,blue curacao,beet,tomato soup,orange bitter,almond milk,tzatziki,rosemary
title: Beet Salad With Yogurt
ingredients: 300 g g tzatziki | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 2 guajillo chilies or 2 guajillo chilies, seeded and chopped | 2 fresh rosemary, chopped | 3 fresh beets, peeled and sliced thinly | 1/2 teaspoon fresh orange bitters | 1 teaspoon red curacao or 1 teaspoon other orange liqueur | 100 ml almond milk
