instructions: In a serving bowl combine the tzatziki, tomato soup, guajillo chili or guajillo peppers, rosemary, beets, orange bitters, and red curacao. Mix well. Pour into serving bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: olive,almond paste,baby spinach,ladyfinger,hot chili pepper,beef chuck
title: Spinach Beef and Spinach Casserole With Almonds
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed of fat | 3 cups baby spinach, coarsely chopped | 1 jar italian almond paste, drained and sliced | 1 package soft ladyfingers | 1 teaspoon coarsely chopped fresh hot chili pepper ( or to taste ) | coarsely chopped fresh lindoro chili pepper, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cut the beef into 5 or 6 pieces, removing any excess fat or undesirable pieces. In a large bowl, toss with the spinach, italian almond paste, and the chopped lady fingers. Spoon the meat mixture into the casserole. Using your hands, press a handful of the slivers of italian almond powder evenly over the top of the meat. Place the remaining portions of the italian almond powder into a small bowl. Sprinkle generously over the top of the casserole, pressing gentle to help. Cook in the oven for 3 1/2 to 4 hours, or until the sauce is desired thickness, stirring a few times. Meanwhile, cook the chili, stirring frequently, over medium heat just until hot. Sprinkle the reserved italian almond powder over the top just prior to serving, keeping warm while serving. Cut into serving pieces and serve over a mound of rice or browned potatoes. Note, a little hot sauce may be added to taste if desired.

Random Ingredients: streaky bacon,vanilla,tart apple,kalamata olive,black sesame seed,palm sugar
title: Sweet Bacon and Apple Salad
ingredients: 75 g smoked streaky bacon ( or other flavorful crisp bacon ) | 1 tart apple, such as granny smith, peeled, cored and roughly chopped | 50 g kalamata olives, stoned and roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 teaspoon white palm sugar | 1 teaspoon black sesame seed
instructions: Mince the bacon and tear into bite size pieces. Add the apple, olives and vanilla to the bacon, along with the sugar and sesame seeds. Toss until combined and garnish with extra black sesame seeds. This is good served with crusty french bread.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,tortilla chip,maraschino cherry,gruyere cheese,red currant jelly
title: Grilled Cheese With Red Chile and Chimichurri
ingredients: 2 ounces red currant jelly | 2 1/2 tablespoons red chilies, finely chopped | 8 ounces gruyere cheese, coarsely grated | 4 ounces tortilla chips | 1 maraschino cherry, halved
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Whisk in jelly and chilies. Season with salt. Toss gently with cheese. Grill cheese until golden on all sides. Put on plate or serving dish. Sprinkle tomatoes with cherry.

title: Baked French Fries in Tarragon Vinegar
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon vinegar, with pulp
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Wash the potatoes and cut into fries or steam fries and put them in a small casserole. Add the remaining vinegar and salt and pepper to taste. Cover with foil bake for 30 minutes or until tender turning once. Turn out onto a large serving platter and put in an oven for 5 to 10 more minutes to crisp up the potatoes or fry them until they are crisp and golden.

title: Roast Beef for Two (Or More)
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast or 3 lbs boneless bottom round steaks | 2 cans or bottles beer | 2 teaspoons hot paprika
instructions: Use oven to cook the roast in a dutch oven or heavy duty roasting pan. Put the roast in the oven and roast at 150 degrees farenheit or 350 degrees farenheit until medium rare.

Random Ingredients: bacon,white fish fillet,caster sugar,cashew,brown rice flour,baking powder
title: Cashew Crumble and Bacon Crunch
ingredients: 1 lb thickly sliced white fish fillet, about 8 to 10 ounces ( cod or halibut, 2 large cutlet ) | 3 ounces roasted salted cashews | 1 ounce soft brown rice flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1 2/3 teaspoons baking powder | 1 tablespoon brown rice flour | 1 ounce shredded raw unsalted cashews
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place the fish in a greased, shallow ovenproof dish. Roast for 20 minutes, basting often, until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove from the oven. Leave to cool. Meanwhile, place the roasted cashew, brown rice flour, caster sugar and baking powder in a bowl. Using a fork, mix until well combined and the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Turn the fish over in the flour. Place the bacon pieces in a large, heated frying pan. Cook over medium low heat, turning occasionally, for approximately 10 minutes, until golden. Remove from the pan, drain on kitchen paper and allow to cool. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Spread the dry breadcrumb mixture evenly over the fish. Add the cashew nuts. Using your fingertips, gently press to get the ingredients evenly spread to cover the fish. Roast for approximately 30 minutes or until a skewer can go into the middle of the crumble easily and it makes a crunchy crumble.

title: Vegan Mexican Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 dried hot red chile, or to taste | 2 teaspoons nutritional yeast
instructions: Place the kidney beans and chile into a blender or food processor. Top with hot water, and add several tablespoons of nutritional yeast and 2 teaspoons of the dried yeast. Blend until smooth. Transfer to a bowl and enjoy.

title: Sweet Potato Potato Pizza (Oamc)
ingredients: 12 ounces new potatoes ( small ) | 1 cup potato milk | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 1/2 cup pimentos, sliced | 1/3 cup diced roasted sweet potato ( canned ) | 1 garlic clove, finely minced | 2 tablespoons shredded pizza dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Peel and cut potatoes into chunks. Place the hot potatoes in an 8 inch casserole dish, cover with water, and bake about 40 minutes or until tender. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the water in the pan and let cool slightly. Preheat oven to 400 fahrenheit. In a small bowl, combine the warm potatoes, almonds, pimentos, sweet potato, milk, garlic and pizza dough, mix well. Spread the potato mixture evenly over the top of the pizza dough. Bake in upper third of oven 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Sushi Rolls (Sushi)
ingredients: 2 sheets nori, cut on the diagnal diagonal | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Take one sheet of nori and use a rolling sushi rolling mat to spread out the nori. Sprinkle cumin and cinnamon on the nori. Using the long edge of the nori roll, roll and flounder the nori and pinch the edges together to seal. Sushi roll can be kept overnite in the refrigerator to better even the final coating of the nori. Cut into 2 inch segments. Serve warm or at room temperature. Sushi sushi rolls can also be covered and refrigerated overnight to allow flavors to blend before rolling.

title: Tandoori Sauce - the Real Thing! #2
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon harissa ( heaped teaspoon or equivalent )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and add salt/pepper. Keep in fridge until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: baby green,cayenne,sharp cheddar cheese,sea salt,mustard seed
title: Easy Cheese, and Herb Cakes
ingredients: 1 bunch baby greens | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( about 3 medium ) | sea salt | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons cayenne
instructions: Dice the greens, and set aside. Combine all ingredient, except greens, into a large bowl. Form into small cakes by lightly frying the cakes in a fry pan over medium high heat for about 3 - 5 minutes on each side or until golden.

instructions: Chop up the first three ingredients. Combine all in a double boiler. Let boil for about 3 minutes. Turn off heat let cool to room temperature. Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,coconut cream,yellow pepper,bulk italian sausage,grape tomato

instructions: In a large bowl, mix the sausage, cabbage, yellow and green peppers, and roma peppers. In a blender or food processor, puree the coconut cream and grape tomatoes until smooth. Pour the sauce over the salad and let marinate, covered, for 1 to 2 hours. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: almond,dill sprig,green cardamom pod,cayenne,lemon wedge,black coffee,cashew,cumin powder
title: Spiced Almond Spiced Coffee
ingredients: 3 teaspoons dried dill sprigs | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 teaspoon black coffee | 4 green cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons dill sprigs ( about 2 inches long ) | cayenne | 1 1/2 tablespoons roasted cashews | lemon wedge
instructions: Soak the fresh dill sprigs in 2 cup of hot water for 10 minutes. Remove and reserve the dill sprigs. In a small mixing cup combine the dill, cumin and black coffee. Place the black cardamoms in a small skillet over medium heat. Lightly toast, shaking the pan and turning cardamoms frequently, until aromatic. Add the roasted cashews and bring to a boil. Remove from the heat, stirring constantly and then add the coffee and the reserved dill sprigs. Pour the coffee into a small coffee cup or mug. Garnish with dill sprigs and serve hot. To make the cardamom powder put a few crushed almonds and a few fresh dill sprigs or fresh dill sprigs in a coffee grinder with the black cardamom powder. Grind for around 1/4 to 1/2 an inch. Random Ingredients: espresso,chili powder,avocado,bulgar wheat,spanish onion,cilantro leaf,onion powder,oregano
title: Guatemalan Wheat
ingredients: 1/2 cup bulgar wheat | 3 cups boiling water | 1/2 - 3/4 medium-large spanish onion, minced or sliced | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 -2 tablespoon hot espresso ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( optional ) | chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Boil bulgur wheat until it is soft. In a large bowl, toss bulgur with onions, oregano, onion powder, and chili powder. Random Ingredients: chayote,cornflour,lemon zest,leek,dark molasses,chipotle chile,provolone cheese,bread crumb
title: Baked Calabacitas
ingredients: 1 chayote, chopped | 1 leeks, white part only, chopped | 1/2 cup cornflour, mixed with | 1/2 cup unsifted bread crumbs | 1/3 cup chopped smoked sweet morita or 1/3 cup dark smoked ham | 6 slices provolone cheese | 2 teaspoons finely chopped chipotle chiles | 1 teaspoon finely grated fresh lemon zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 375. Place chayote, leeks, and cornflour mixture in a food processor or blender. Add bread crumbs, smoked sweet morita, ham, cheese, chipotle chile, and lemon zest.

title: Chefs Pork Empanadas

instructions: In a large pot, place the tomatillos and pork butt and bring to a boil. Once the pork is done, drain off the fat. title: Spaghetti Sauce

ingredients: 1 teaspoon chayenne pepper | 1 1/2 cups plain soymilk or 1 1/2 cups skim milk | 1 can chickpea flour | 1 lb fresh lasagna noodle, torn into 1-inch pieces | 2 1/2 - 3 cups chopped green peppers | 1 lb cooked pink salmon

instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl.

title: Red Velvet® Red Bliss® Potatoes and Bliss® (Pressure Au Lait)

title: Shiitake Mushrooms, Corn Tortillas or Fried Tostadas
ingredients: 6 -7 shiitake mushrooms, stems removed, caps quartered | 1 package extra-sharp cheddar cheese or ( 5 ounce ) package gorgonzola, crumbled | 1 tortillas or 7 -8 corn tortillas | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Place mushrooms in a frying pan. Cover with water and bring to a boil. As soon as water begins to boil, drain mushrooms and discard water. title: Wasabi Calzones

Random Ingredients: chili oil,dark rum,fish sauce,cream chicken soup,mango chutney,lime zest,corn cob
title: Candy Corn Fritters With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 4 corn on the cob, cut from stem | 3 tablespoons sweet mango chutney | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 lime, zest of, and cut in half | 1 tablespoon mild chili oil | 1 tablespoon cream of chicken soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Place corn on a large tray, and place in the oven for 6 - 8 minutes. Remove and discard the corn. title: Roasted Mango Squash With Mango and Poblano Chile
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 1 medium yellow squash | 1 medium mango | 1/3 cup dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Roast poblano chiles under a hot broiler until skins blister and begin to blister and blacken, about 5 minutes. Immediately transfer chiles to a bowl, cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Remove poblanos from bag, peel and deseed peppers. Chop. Cut squash in half lengthwise, remove seeds and cut into chunks. Remove stalks and discard. Cut off and discard papery root from poblanos. Remove pepper from bag. Cut squash in half, remove seeds and cut into chunks. Place on a foil lined cookie sheet and coat with sherry. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until squash is soft and softened. Serve with mango and poblano chile.

title: Guayababissimo (Authentic Mexican Guayabissimo)
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups guayabisso sour dough | 1 medium hass avocados or 1 medium ripe avocado, mashed well | 2 - 2 1/2 teaspoons dry yeast ( see directions below, or use 1 envelope dry yeast-will need adjustments. ) | 3 -5 fresh sage leaves ( or basil leaves ) ( optional )
instructions: Dough, add a bit of sugar into the yeast and allow to proof in a warm place until foamy.. Measure the guayabisso out of its wrappers, leaving about a 1 1/2 cup of the liquid from the mashed avocados or sour dough. Drain the avocado/sour dough in a colander or a strainer until liquid is extracted from the shells. Return the liquid mixture and the mashed avocado to the pan and mix thoroughly. Add the sage and yeast, mix well and allow to proof in a warm place for 10 minutes or until the dough is smooth and shiny looking. Knead for 10 minutes by hand with flour or as needed, until the dough is smooth. Dough should never be wet. Place the dough on a greased surface and knead well. Lightly oil or butter your hands, and place the dough in a bowl and leave it in a warm place until the dough doubles in bulk. After an hour or so, knead it a few times. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a cloth or a bowl large enough to accommodate the dough completely. Place in a warm place for 1 - 2 hours or until the dough doubles in bulk. If using an oven heated to 450º f/230º celsius, place it on the rack that should be at the bottom of your oven. Allow the dough to rise, covered. When it is ready, knead it briefly by hand. Dough should have a slightly tacky texture, and will no doubt form itself back up. If you have dough in airtight containers rather than traditional, then you can form the dough into one large rectangle and flatten it down slightly and shape it into a rectangle that is about 9 x 6 inches. Cut three diagonal slits about 1/2 inch deep on the top and leave one slat at a slight angle on the bottom of the rectangle. This will seal the dough well. Place the dough on a well floured surface and knead it briefly. Place the dough on a well floured surface again, cover with a cloth or a bowl and leave it in a warm place for 1 - 2 hours or until dough has doubled in bulk. After 20 minutes, punch down the dough and divide in half. To shape, place one or two strips of dough diagonally across and down on the cutting board. Lift the edges of the strips and stretch them by pressing with your fingers in the center, until you have a neat square shaped rectangle. Cut each strip in half crosswise creating a diamond shaped cut. Place the cut side down on the baking pan, cover with a cloth and leave it in a warm place for 15 minutes or so. Turn the oven down to 300º f/ 150ºc. This will make it easier to work with. Place the baking pan in the 325º f/150º c oven. Set it for about 45 minutes to 1 hour or until golden brown. Remove from the oven and remove the paper or cloth. Allow the guayabissimo to drain for about 15 minutes. Slice off the hard shell ends with a sharp knife, then cut into pieces about 3 pieces each. Place on a platter and serve with a fresh garden salad or vegetables.

title: Kolokithakia Me Marzakke (Marinated Covered Chicken With Peppers)
ingredients: one 24-ounce boneless skinless chicken breast half or ( 1 3/4 lb ) boneless skinless chicken breast half | 1/2 cup marinade | 1/4 cup chocolate chips | 1/2 cup kalamata olive | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 dash coarsely crushed hot pepper flakes | spices, such as cinnamon
instructions: Dry the chicken completely. Place the chicken breast in a large, ovenproof, shallow baking dish. Heat the oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. In a small bowl, combine the confectioners' sugar, pepper flakes, or spices of choice & mix all together. Slice the chicken across the grain into 1/4 x 1/4 pieces. Dip each piece into the sugar mixture, coating both sides. title: Soy Glazed Asparagus
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 2 teaspoons sugar snap peas or 2 teaspoons green peas, frozen | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon light horseradish sauce | 2 teaspoons gluten-free prepared horseradish sauce | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon shortening
instructions: Place the peas or snap peas on a small baking pan and toast them in the oven until slightly softened. Cool them slightly. Split them into 2 equal halves and place them in a food processor, adding the corn oil and 1 cup of the flour. Blend until the mixture forms a dough. Transfer the dough to an oiled bowl and stir it to remove any flour taste. Put the dough back into the bowl and cover it with plastic wrap. The dough will double in size. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface. Divide it into 14 equal pieces. Form each piece into a round ball and poke a hole in the center with a wooden chopstick. Brush one side of the round ball with oil, let it hit the fire and the dough marked side of the hole is now on the fire. Cook for a minute or two until they have a nice golden brown color. Remove the dough from the fire and place them on a greased baking sheet. Brush the dough with olive oil if you like. Cook it for 30 minutes and turn it over and cook it for another 30 minutes or until the underside is nicely browned and crisp. Remove it from the fire and cut into 4 portions. Serve warm or room temperature. For the topping, mix all the ingredients together and set aside. Store in an airtight container.

title: Chateaubriand's Beef and Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 kg steak ( round or chuck rind is good ) | 1 kg white beans ( canned is fine, but i prefer red beans ) | 200 ml beef stock powder ( not instant granules ) | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | ice cube
instructions: Cut the steak into thin strips. The fat from the meat should cut it into strips of approximately 2 inches long/1/2 inch wide. Put the meat into a large non metallic bowl and add the beans, stock powder, nutmeg, vinegar and mayonnaise. Mix well to combine. The salad might stick to the meat but, with your hands, you will add the mixture a bit at a time. If it does, tighten the sauce slightly and mix with a wire whisk until all the bits are incorporated. You can add a little bit of water at a time. If the salad is too thick, add a little more beef stock powder or beef stock powder. The salad should have a thick consistency. If it is too runny, add a little water. Pour over the salad and mix gently. If you have a plate with a lid, it will be easy to dip the salad in. If you don't have a plate, it will do. If it is a lid, it needs to be pushed firmly but not pressed or pressed. Put into the fridge and leave to mellow for at least 2 - 3 hours. When ready to serve, just before serving, remove the meat from the dressing. Serve with hot cooked rice, or the salad.

title: Danish 'french Bread with Saffron'
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, sliced in 1-inch diagonal slices | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1 -2 saffron strand | 1 pinch saffron | 1 pinch saffron strand | 4 -6 ounces swiss cheese, sliced | 1 pinch saffron strand | 1 pinch saffron strand | 1 pinch saffron strand | 2 -3 saffron strands | 5 -6 saffron strands, for sprinkling at end | 3 -4 pine nuts, for sprinkling at end
instructions: Preparation, place the pine nuts in bowl of a mortar. Using pestle, pound into a smooth paste with the saffron strands. Lightly brush about 1/4 cup hot water into a 1 1/2 quart round pan. Put the bread on the tap, making sure it does not touch the bread. Use kitchen shears to lightly spray the top of the bread with water. Sprinkle 3 - 4 saffron strands over the bread. Top the bread with the pine nuts, followed by the cheese. Sprinkle 3 - 4 saffron strands over the bread, followed by 3 - 4 pine nuts, and 1 - 2 saffron strands. Carefully pour the remaining oil, wine or stock, over the top of the bread. Set a large heatproof plate or skillet over the top of the pan and turn the pan to coat the bottom evenly. When the oil is rippling, put the bread into the pan. You should see a nice crust forming. Once it is, flip the heat down a little. After 1 - 2 minutes, turn the bread back over. Pour in the wine/stock combination, coating the bread on all sides.. A few drops of water may be added if it looks dry. Turn the heat down so as not to puncture the bread to much. Cover tightly and cook on medium low heat for 45 - 50 minutes, or until browned and bubbly. Remove from the heat. Remove the bread onto a plate, and dust with a little powdered saffron. Set aside until serving time. Saffron is very difficult to crumble, so the only thing you are aiming for is to crush it with the back of a wooden spoon. When the bread is done, remove the pan from the heat and leave until completely dry, before adding the saffron to the pan. To serve, put a good spoonful of saffron into a warmed shallow bowl, and sprinkle generously with a little dry vermouth. Serve the bread with the saffron sauce. Note, this is where i make the mistake of thinking about making the saffron infused bread in a jar, because the bread was fried in a skillet first, and at 30 minutes it would have been toasted in the oven before serving the bread when you had to put the saffron on top.

title: Sausage Rollups
ingredients: 18 links sausages ( or any combination of sausages, knockwurst, or other ground sausage ) | 2 packages sables sponge cakes or 6 -8 ounces pork roll dough | 1/2 cup cake flour or 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3 celery ribs, chopped, including leaves, to roll out, cut into 2 or 3 pieces each, roll a piece into a long sausage shape | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, roughly chopped, with oil, drizzle over roll
instructions: Place the sausage in a colander and press lightly to remove as much excess moisture as possible. Place in a large, warm pot and cover with water. Bring water to a boil, skimming scum off top as necessary, then reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 40 minutes. Drain. Heat oven to 400°f. Put sables to soften, then roll out into a rectangle about 14x12 inches. Spread a scant 1/4 of the sugar over the dough. Then sprinkle some of the sausage all over this. Roll up the sables, jelly roll fashion, starting with the wide end, and pinch the ends closed. Bake rolls for 12 - 15 minutes or until browned, crusty and crispy. Place rolls in a warm buttered baking dish. While rolls are baking, heat oven to 400°f. Sprinkle tops with chopped tomatoes. Continue baking rolls until tops are crispy and golden, about 15 - 20 minutes. Note if sables are not available, the sables may be wrapped in foil, but foil makes them extra firm if it's placed over the meat roll dough recipe. Serves that's it.

title: Steak and Pear Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb steak, very thinly sliced | 1 pear, peeled, sliced | 1 teaspoon corned mint, chopped | 2 slices sweet breadsticks or 1 slice bread, crust trimmed | 2 ounces string bean | 2 tablespoons sweet relish | 1 chicken stock cube, dissolved in
instructions: Heat a wok or frying pan on the stove top over a high heat. Add the steak and stir fry for about 1 - 2 minutes until it browns slightly. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly before adding to the pan or stir fry pan. Cut the pear and string bean into 3/4 lengths and add to the steak with the relish and stock. Cook over a very high heat for 3 - 4 mins or until the oil separates from the pear. Toss the noodles gently in the dissolved dissolved stock and serve.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,greek yogurt,white wine vinegar,lettuce leaf,cake flour
title: Tarte Tatin -- French Toast (Tarte Basquaise)
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt, plain | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup cake flour | sour cream or sweetened condensed milk, for serving | 2 -4 lettuce leaves, for garnish | grand marnier ( optional )
instructions: If using sour cream, use yogurt only. If using sweetened condensed milk just stir in gradually to dissolve all the sugar. Wisk together the flour and yogurt thoroughly. Make a well in the dry ingredients. Pour yogurt over the yeast mixture, working in a small amount of milk if needed to make a soft, slightly sticky mixture. Let stand until room temperature, about 15 minutes. Dip the lettuce leaf or other lettuce leaves into flour, then dip in cream. Heat large ridged skillet until very hot. Dip the lettuce into the batter, letting excess drip off. Fry on each side until golden brown. If your skillet has a bit of oil, spray lightly with oil first. Cut into slices and serve warm, garnished with grand marnier.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,chicken broth,mozzarella cheese,white onion,marshmallow,flat leaf parsley,chive
title: Easy Microwave Cheese With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth or 1/2 cup canned low sodium chicken broth | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix or 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup white onion, finely diced | 4 tablespoons chives, finely chopped | 2 1/2 cups lowfat mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 jar marshmallows, chopped
instructions: Combine broth, ras el hanout and parsley in a microwave safe casserole dish, cover and microwave on high 40 to 45 seconds. Stir frequently till the broth is hot. Add onion, chives and cheese. Stir till cheese is melted and ingredients are mix'ed. Add the marshmallows. Set aside and keep covered till ready to use for up to 2 hours if you are not using microwave for 6 hours so that the cheese will keep from melting & becoming mushy. Stir and microwave 2 to 3 minutes more till cheese is melted and the marshmallows are soft. Enjoy and serve with assorted veggies.

title: Chili Riblets
ingredients: 1 large anaheim chilies, slit lengthwise | 1/3 cup chili powder | 4 lbs beef brisket
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°. Insert meat thermometer, if necessary, into center of meat and carefully insert chilies into mixture. Sprinkle both sides with chili powder and place in roasting pan. Cover roasting pan with foil and bake 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: flour,onion soup mix,chicken breast half,heavy whipping cream,grand marnier,saffron
title: Frozen Chicken
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion soup mix | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 2 bone-in chicken breast halves | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: In bowl, stir together cream, onion soup mix and saffron. Rinse chicken with cold water, pat dry. Sprinkle chicken with flour and then with grand marnier. Place in 13 x 9 inch pan. Freeze until set, about 3 hours.

title: Chinese Spicy Bacon Spread
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon, diced | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Mix oyster sauce, canadian bacon and mayonnaise. Spread on toast or your favourite bread.

Random Ingredients: ginger ale,white vinegar,dark corn syrup,ham,salad dressing,daikon radish,cardamom pod,chive
title: Daikon Salad With Ham
ingredients: 1 lb daikon radish, peel left on | 3 cups cooked ham, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup dark corn syrup | 3 teaspoons ginger ale | 2 teaspoons white vinegar or 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon chives, finely chopped | salad dressing
instructions: Place radish and ham on a serving platter. Whisk together syrup, ginger, vinegar, cardamon, chives and enough dressing to make a runny consistency of your choice. Drizzle this over the ham and radish mixture. Serve warm but, don't let it cool down over night.

title: Peer Shrimp Masala
ingredients: 1/4 lb jumbo shrimp, peeled, deveined and butterflied ( tails removed ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/8 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Toss shrimp with 1 tbls. Sesame oil. Place in a shallow dish. Combine next 3 ingredients.

title: Tropical Stir-Fry
ingredients: 400 g corkscrew macaroni | 200 g somboches ( shrimp paste ) | 200 g somboches ( dried shrimp ) | 80 g sweet bitter melon | 2 -3 drops sesame oil or 2 -3 drops anchovy flavored oil, if you wish ( or if you can't handle the bitter melon, you can substitute a little lemon juice ) | 50 g brocolli greens ( or substitute any other greens ) or 50 g broccoli ( or substitute any other greens )
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling salted water following manufacturer's instructions, drain well in a colander, then set aside or on to side while you cook the rest. Wash and dry any vegetables, cut into slices about 3 inches long and 1/2 inch thick, if using broccoli or greens, then just cut them into slices about the same size and thickness. Trim any woody part of your bitter melon, then cut a slice off the white top and remove all the bitter sections. Cut the bitter melon in half, remove the seeds and membrane, then cut into bite sized pieces. Wash, dry, and wash thoroughly the greens or greens with fresh water afterwards, then cut into bite sized pieces, if using greens or greens. When you've drained all the bitter melon pieces, dry fry the sesame oil in a hot non stick frying pan, then add the bitter melon, and then the slices of bitter melon with any or all of the bitter melon chunks. This should take 5 - 8 minutes depending on how bright and sweet you like them. It doesn't take too long but serve with white rice, a salad or a crisp salad. Enjoy.

title: Fried French Bread (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups italian seasoned dry bread crumbs, divided | 3/4 cup cake flour | 3/4 teaspoon dried thyme leave
instructions: Place 1/2 cup bread crumbs in the bread machine. Place flour, thyme and remaining 1/2 cup bread crumbs in a clean, dry 12 cup resealable plastic bag, and close the bag, pressing or shaking the bag to coat the bread with the crumbs. Close the bag, and shake to mix the bread well. Place the bag in the machine's bread machine and press start. Remove the bread from the bag. Cut the bread into chunks, or slices, and place on a cookie sheet. Brush with a little oil, and sprinkle with another 1/2 cup plus 1/2 cup bread crumbs. Top with remaining bread crumbs. Let the bread sit in the bread machine for 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lamb,greek yogurt,mint leaf,canola oil,bacon,sesame oil,crescent dough
title: Fantastic Lamb Rolls
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated crescent roll dough | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 lbs lean ground lamb | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil | 2 large mint leaves, finely chopped ( reserve 2 tablespoons dried ) | 2 -3 slices bacon ( cooked if you prefer )
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. On a lightly floured surface, roll the 2 cans of crescent dough. Using a rolling pin, flatten each dough slab in the shape of a 6 x4 rectangle. Trim and flute the edges. With your fingers, press one side of the dough into the baking sheet. Brush with canola oil. In a large bowl, add the ground lamb, mix well. Add the greek yogurt, sesame oil, mint and reserved mint leaves. Mix well. Spread the lamb mixture evenly onto the dough. Starting from one long side, roll up each crescent roll. Wrap the outside dough tightly around the cinnamon roll. Trim off excess dough and place it on the baking sheet seam side down. Use a sharp knife to cut the roll down the center lengthwise, making sure to make sure that the cut doesn’t go all the way to the top. Cut through the roll once and then cut those crosswise open ends with kitchen shears or kitchen shears into 2 or 3 pieces. Repeat with the remaining crescent rolls. Brush with canola oil. Preheat oven to 400°f. Place the crescents on prepared baking sheet and bake for 25 - 25 minutes or until golden.

title: Slow Roast Lamb and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb or 1 1/2 lbs beef roast | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 2 cups sauerkraut, well drained ( see other step ) | 2 tablespoons flour | 1/2 cup yogurt
instructions: Place lamb, fat side up, on rack of broiler pan. Sprinkle with ghee and 1/2 tsp of garam masala and cardamon. Broil 5 mins, then turn and broil for 5 mins. Turn and broil all the way through. Slice lamb thinly across the grain and stir the meat and juice. Pour sauerkraut over the lamb slices and let soak until all the water has mixed in and absorbed. Blend or process kraut with flour to make a smooth paste. Pour half the cream or milk into a medium saucepan and heat slowly to make gravy, stirring. Remove lamb from pan, let meat stand 10 mins, then stir gently then return to same pan and repeat process. Pour remaining cream or milk over the meat and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh fillet,spinach,red pepper flake,sultana,romaine lettuce
title: Wombertowel Chicken & Spinach Salad
ingredients: 500 g chicken thigh fillets, sliced | 3 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 3 tablespoons sultanas | 4 tablespoons romaine lettuce, torn | 500 g freshly steamed spinach
instructions: Slice the chicken into 5 cm squares. Arrange on a serving platter. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes and sultanas. Combine lettuce and spinach and pile on chicken. Serve.

title: Steak in Champagne With Asparagus
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, cut 1 inch thick | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt, divided | 8 ounces asparagus, cut on diagonal in 1 inch pieces | 1 cup fresh spinach leaves, washed and shredded | 2 tablespoons galangal, peeled and sliced | 8 ounces carrots, cut on the bias into 1 inch chunks | 4 cups chilled champagne | extra beef, thinly sliced for serving
instructions: Sprinkle the steak with 1/4 teaspoon of the garlic salt on all sides. Place the asparagus, spinach or meschal in a large skillet over high heat and sauté until it becomes just tender. The asparagus will cook quickly. Stir in the remaining 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt, asparagus, carrots, and Champagne. Cover and simmer until the asparagus is heated through, about 5 minutes. Stir in the beef slices and serve.

title: Swiss Hazelnut and Black Bean Salad (Vegetarian.)
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 cans hazelnuts, roasted and coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons chopped shallots
instructions: In a bowl toss together the beans, hazelnuts and shallots. Chill until serving time.

title: Potato and Parsnip Fritters and Variations
ingredients: 1 russet potato | 1 package egg noodles | fresh thyme sprig ( to garnish ) | lemon peel, to garnish
instructions: In a colander, place the potato and rinse it lightly under cold water to stop it from browning. Drain the potato well and place the potato in a large pan of boiling water. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain and allow to cool, then peel and cut into 1 inch chunks the size of the noodles. Meanwhile, bring another large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the egg noodles and cook them until just tender, about 3 to 5 minutes. Drain. Place cooked noodles in a heated bowl and using a slotted spoon, add about 1 tablespoon of the hot potato and parsnip mash. Toss until the noodles are well coated with the potato mixture and stir in the thyme, lemon peel, and salt and pepper to taste. Ladle mixture into bowls, garnish with a sprig of lemon peel, and eat immediately.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,olive oil cooking spray
title: Easy Microwave Peanut Butter and Chunky Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1/4 cup smooth & creamy peanut butter | 2 teaspoons olive oil or 2 teaspoons butter | 1/2 teaspoon chunky peanut butter
instructions: Combine everything well and pour on the peanut butter in a ziploc bag. Place the plastic bag in the microwave on high for 6 minutes uncovered, stirring twice. Allow to sit for 5 minutes. Serve on a plate with a side of sliced cucumbers, carrots and tomatoes.

title: Bean & Pine Nut (Mackerel)
ingredients: 2 lbs mackerel, descaled | 1/2 lb pork fat, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs pumpkin seeds ( or 2 cups dry roasted peanuts ) | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 1/2 cup lemon peel | 2 cans red beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Remove any skin or bones from the mackerel. Trim away any large bones. Set aside in a large pot and add cold water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a shallow baking pan, mix the mackerel, pork fat or other meat fat, pumpkin seeds, celery and lemon peel. Spread the beans evenly over the surface and top with the mackerel mixture. Bake at 375°f for 30 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,peanut oil,asparagus spear,ricotta cheese,tahini,onion salt,vanilla extract
title: Roasted Asparagus and Spicy Ricotta Spread
ingredients: 1/4 cup yellow onion | 2 - 2 1/2 lbs asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into 1 inch lengths | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon low-sodium tahini | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a 15 x 10 x 1 inch baking pan with foil. Place the onions in a bowl of water and bring to a boil. Reduce the flame and simmer for 1 minute, then drain. Bring 1/4 cup water to a boil in a large saucepan. Add the asparagus and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, till tender crisp, but still firm. Transfer the asparagus to a bowl of cold water to cool. Drain the asparagus and transfer it to a bowl of ice water. Bring 1/4 cup water to a boil in a large skillet. Reduce the flame to medium and add the ricotta. Drain the asparagus in a colander until they are just cool enough to handle but not cold. Drain the asparagus in a colander. In a food processor or blender, combine the tahini, vanilla, onion salt and peanut oil, puree until smooth. Taste, mix in remaining 1/4 c water, adjust the flavor, if necessary. Put 3/4 c of the asparagus aside, then toss with the remaining 1/4 c of asparagus and spread the filling evenly over top. Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes or till heated thru and lightly browned.

title: Sesame Glazed Bacon
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place bacon in a skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring to release most of the fat, until evenly browned, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain all but about 1 tablespoon of drippings. Remove bacon pieces from skillet using a slotted spoon and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread bacon with onion powder and sesame seeds. Bake in the preheated oven until bacon is crisp and lightly browned, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Aardappel Palak (Armenian Panir Patty)
ingredients: 2 large rolls ( sandwich ) | panir | cardamom ( or other spices )
instructions: First peel a large roll of bread if it is soft. Then slice it into 4 pieces. Now, using a rolling pin, press a portion of panir on each slice of bread on both sides in a very thin layer. Take a plate and lay the slices of sandwich in it and lightly flatten it slightly. Put the slices of bread on top the other slices. Then with your fingertips, press the middle of the bread lightly with water and spread it evenly on the hot slices. It is important to flatten these to ensure even coverage as you may find them drying out. Sprinkle with cardamom, or other spices. Keep pressing the bread and moving it around so that the bread is evenly coated with the filling and is able to stick to the bread.

title: Chocolate Chips Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon garlic oil | 2 vegetable stock cubes
instructions: Put the oil into a pan or pot with a lid and heat it over a gentle heat but do not allow it to boil. It should bubble up and pop at the same time as when you were checking the oil. It will not have a green film form, but a gentle simmering film of oil will do fine. Pour in the soup base and stir until it has been absorbed into the choc chips. The chips will thicken and the choc will be soft in the same way. Stir the soup again, add the garlic oil, cover the pan, and leave for 5 minutes – don't worry if the bubbles appear to be popping at the edges then leave for another 5 minutes. Serve immediately with freshly ground sea salt and freshly ground black pepper – depending on taste.

title: Mango and Hot Chocolate Steak Salad
ingredients: 6 tablespoons mayonnaise, use only 3 tbsp if you like a thinner dressing, such as miracle whip or kefeta | 6 tablespoons dark chocolate, such as skor english sweet chocolate | 2 ripe mangoes, halved and sliced thinly on the diagonal ( about 50g each ) | 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks, cut into 3cm thick slices
instructions: To make the dressing, place the mayonnaise, chocolate and half the mango slices in a small bowl, stir over a small heat until it has melted. Add the hot chocolate to the mango mixture, stir and set aside. Cook your steak until done to your liking, about 5 minutes per side for medium rare, or more for medium. Remove from the pan and leave to one side to cool. Put the remaining mango slices on a plate and top with the grilled steak slices. Drizzle the dressing over the steak and mango and serve.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,italian parsley,red plum,lasagna noodle,vegetable shortening,balsamic vinegar,red chili pepper flake,self rising flour
title: Maggie Miller's Favorite Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 2 1/2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 3/4 cup white balsamic vinegar | 1 cup heavy cream | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 pinch red chili pepper flakes | 28 ounces red plum tomatoes | 1/3 cup fresh italian parsley, minced | 1/4 cup self rising flour | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f, and set aside a 9x13 inch baking dish to bake lasagna sheets. In a large bowl, combine the 2 1/2 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar, heavy whipping cream, 1 1/2 tablespoon vegetable shortening, and the red chili flakes. Stir to combine, and set aside. In a separate large bowl, combine the viney tomatoes, 1/3 cup of minced white onion, and the parsley. Add the tomato mixture to the vinegar mixture, and stir well to combine. Place baking dish with hot liquid in oven, and remove from oven when liquid is evaporating. Place two lasagna sheets with the uncooked side touching, between damp kitchen towels to dry. Place one noodle on each dry sheet. Spoon some sauce over each, and spread more sauce over noodles. Place another noodle over sauce, so that he is completely covered, and spread more sauce. Repeat process with remaining 4 sheets of dough, or more sauce. With a sharp knife, cut two deep slits, into the top layer of each lasagna. Cover with a towel, and leave in oven for 30 minutes. Remove towel, and let sit for 10 more minutes. In a deep sided roasting pan or large skillet, melt the 2 remaining tablespoons of vegetable shortening on medium high heat. Place one lasagna sheet into the pan, and then spread the remaining sauce over. Bake for approximately 30 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbly and the top is golden brown.

title: Aubergines
ingredients: 6 -8 aubergines | 1 tablespoon saffron | 1/4 cup chopped roasted peanuts | 1/4 cup red grapes | 1/4 cup basil | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1/4 cup asiago cheese
instructions: Prepare the aubergines by scrubbing and cutting the membranes in 2 cm long fingers, then cutting lengthwise into 1 cm wide strips lengthwise and then into 1 cm wide fingers. In a large frying pan, add the saffron and peanuts and fry them over medium heat for 1 minute. Carefully add the red grapes and basil and saute for about 5minutes, then turn heat down and cook for about 3minutes until the aubergines are soft. Add the grand marnier and mix well. In a griddle or pan over medium heat, place 3 tbsp of olive oil and 3 tbsp of butter, in it. Dip each aubergine strip into the oil and butter, then fry until golden. Remove on paper towel. Season both sides with a bit of salt and serve hot. Note, if you find that the aubergines are a little bitter and have the texture to your liking you may reduce the number of the saffron and/or peanuts.

title: Lobster Bisque
ingredients: 24 flounder, fresh if possible cleaned and heads ( fresh shrimp ) | 1 can lobster | 1 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients until well blended. Strain and use to top fresh shrimps or lobster shells. Sprinkle shrimp with hot sauce and serve.

title: Spiced Omelette (Vegetable Bake)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, washed | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 kines | 2 medium eggplants, washed, peeled and sliced into half moons | 1/4 cup apricot jam
instructions: Slice the eggplant thinly. Cook eggplant in a saucepan of boiling water for 4 - 6 minutes or until just soft.

Random Ingredients: almond butter,scallion,lettuce leaf,spaghetti sauce,red enchilada sauce
title: Taco Bell Enchilada Bake
ingredients: 8 scallions, chopped | 3/4 cup almond butter | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 lb dry spaghetti, cooked | shredded lettuce leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large baking dish, combine the scallions and almond butter and bake 6 - 8 minutes. Add the spaghetti sauce and bake 5 minutes, or until heated through. Spread a layer of cooked spaghetti evenly over the bottom of the baking dish and cover with the sauce. Cover pan with a tight fitting lid and bake 25 minutes. Remove foil and sprinkle with lettuce. Bake an additional 5 - 10 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: red wine,blue cheese,banana,chambord raspberry liquor,apple cider,pistachio,pickle,wine
title: Blue Cheese and Jam Bananas With Pistachios and Chambord
ingredients: 24 large ripe bananas, each weighing about 2 cups | 1/4 cup sweet red wine | 2/3 cup apple cider or 2/3 cup water | 1/4 cup chambord raspberry liquor, to taste | 1/4 cup semi sweet chocolate chips ( optional ) or 100 g good-quality dark chocolate chips ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons minced pistachios ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons softened butter
instructions: First thing is to slice bananas lengthwise in one or two crosswise slices, then lengthwise in half again, lengthwise 1/ place one slice of banana crosswise in a shallow glass dish. Cover with wine, followed with a sprinkling of chambord. Cover with plastic wrap and let marinate in fridge for about 4 hours, turning every so often.. Meanwhile, prepare sauce, in a small saucepan, heat sugar, a splash of water and the optional bittersweet chocolate chips until the chocolate has melted and cooled slightly, about 5 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat. Stir in the nuts and butter and set aside. When bananas are ready, drain the marinade, reserving the wine. Remove bananas from dish, blot on paper towels and set aside. Discard the wine. Preheat oven to 350f/180c. Line the oven tray with foil. Place bananas in oven and bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Place a small plate over the edge of the oven tray. Slide bananas onto plate and set aside.. Serve warm and top with sauce.

title: Spicy Romaine and Green Cardamom Salad - for Two
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce ( about 2 1/2 lbs ) | 12 green cardamoms | 1 jar marinara sauce, heated
instructions: Trim tough outer layers from lettuce.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,active yeast,beef steak,ham,pita bread,beef bouillon cube,plum tomato,hamburger
title: Mimi's Gyro Burger (Baked)
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups prepared mashed or slightly warmed bread | 1 package active dry yeast | 2 -4 lbs ground beef round | 1 3/4 lbs hamburger ( about 1.5 lbs. ) | 3 -4 ounces minced ham | 1 small tomatoes ( chopped ) | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | pita bread ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the mashed bread using your favorite method. Mix the 2 packets of yeast and 1/2 cup warm water to blend and set in a warm place until the water just starts to bubble. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 500°f. Pound meat until you have about 1/4 inch thick pieces. Place in a large bowl and sprinkle with 2 to 3 tablespoons mayo. Mix in the minced ham, minced tomato, and beef bouillon and mix. When warm to the touch, add in the 1/2 cup more mayo and mix again. When just about bubbling, put the mixture into a warm pan. Spread the remainder of the mayo on a pan and then put it into the oven for at least 15 minutes. When you remove hamburger form the oven and just before you are happy about the bun, put your pita on a plate and top with the cooled meat mixture. Roll up and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lime,water artichoke heart,monterey jack cheese,flour tortilla
title: Artichoke Quesadillas With Lime
ingredients: 16 ounces water-packed artichoke hearts, drained | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup sliced water-packed artichoke hearts | 1 teaspoon finely grated lime rind | 1 3/4 cups flour tortillas
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together water artichoke hearts, monterey jack cheese and lime rind. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons artichoke artichoke mixture evenly into each tortilla. Fold tortillas in half, then in half again to make a 1/2 inch thick sandwich. Transfer quesadillas to skillet. Fold and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and cover to keep warm. Repeat with remaining quesadillas, heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: red chili,italian tomato,double cream,parmesan cheese,white wine,oat
title: Tomato & Chilli Rolaf
ingredients: 2 cans italian-style tomatoes, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups dry white wine | 6 ounces parmesan cheese | 5 ounces cotija queso oats or 5 ounces similar instant coffee creamer | 8 fluid ounces double cream | 1 fresh red chili, minced
instructions: In a heatproof jug combine the drained tomatoes with the white wine, parmesan cheese & couscous. Cover with a plate and weigh down with a heavy can until the couscous has soaked up all the liquid. Leave for 20 minutes to swell. While the tomatoes are simmering, beat the cream and chili together. Heat over a high heat until boiling. Take the pan off the heat & remove the lid, using a tea towel, stir in the cream and chili & serve.

title: Bread Fried With Cabbage
ingredients: 250 g cabbage, finely shredded ( about 300g ) | 4 teaspoons ground goya mixed spice ( or 2 tsp. of each mixed spice or salt, 2g ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning ( or turmeric if you want a milder dish ) ( optional ) | 60 g white bread, cut in four slices
instructions: Thoroughly wash the cabbage, removing any tough leaves or undesirable bits from the inner leaves and roughly chop the stalk. Mix all of the ingredients except the bread slices together in a large bowl. Place about 5 tbsp of the cabbage mixture in the centre of a slice of bread, and wrap it up and secure with a piece of extra soaked, unused bread, securing the rolls with toothpicks if you wish. Cook in the microwave for 3 - 4 minutes on high power, or until the bread is just starting to crackle in colour and the rolls are cooked. If you are using it while still on the stove, cook to your liking. Eat with chutney.

title: Mussels in Sake Red
ingredients: 1 kg mussels, cleaned | 1/3 cup sake | cold water, to cover | 200 g rice | 3 drops red food coloring | 1 apple, sliced thinly
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to the boil. Add mussels and remove shell form as possible. Discard shells, rinse and add to boiling water. When water starts boiling, reduce heat to low and leave for a further 5 minutes or until mussels open. Discard any mussels that did not open. Transfer mussels to a bowl and add sake to mussels.

title: Asian Charred Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb vermicelli | 3 tart apples, grated ( about 4 medium apples, 1 large orange can be used ) | 1 cup golden raisin | 3 tasmanenos, seeded and thinly julienned ( about 4 tablespoons ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon hot pepper flakes | 1 liter hot cooked tortilla, cut in small pieces
instructions: Cook vermicelli until al dente. Drain. Place sherry in a large, heavy skillet and heat over high heat until boiling. Add apples and raisins and cook until apples are tender. Stir in hot pepper flakes and oyster sauce. Add sherry to noodles and top with tortilla pieces. Serve.

Random Ingredients: peach,white wine,nutritional yeast,port wine,orange peel,ginger garlic paste,sesame seed
title: Peachy Peaches
ingredients: 2 cups peaches, chunks, ripe | 1/4 cup port wine | 1/4 cup fresh orange peel ( minced ) | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dry white wine | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast
instructions: Place peaches into a blender and puree, but do not liquify. Place into a large glass bowl that is coated with olive oil or cornstarch and add remaining ingrdients, and combine well. Pour into crockpot and cook on low at least 6 hours or on high 3 - 4 hours. Add more wine if you feel it needs it. Serve warm or cold for best results.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,red pepper flake,taco seasoning mix,beef tenderloin,chicken breast half,black peppercorn,halloumi cheese,baby corn
title: Grilled Chicken and Beef Tostadas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into thin strips | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon cracked black peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 package halloumi cheese, in 1-inch slices | 36 small baby corn, halved | 36 small, fresh corn shrimp in water
instructions: Place the beef and taco seasoning packets in a zip top bag with the pepper and zest. Seal the bag and toss to combine. Remove 1 tablespoon of meat from bag and toss with half of the tortilla strips, then set aside. Place the remaining tortilla strips on a plate. Grill the tortillas for 1 to 2 minutes per side until crisp and grill marks appear. Set aside. Cook the cheese in a small skillet. As soon as it melts, toss in the baby corn, just enough to keep them warm. Slice the remaining tortillas against the grain into thin strips, and then arrange the strips on a platter. Top with the shrimp and green onion, and drizzle with olive oil. Serve with the reserved tortilla strips and corn shrimps.

Random Ingredients: chocolate square,italian seasoning,hot italian sausage,five spice powder,cream mushroom soup,banana
title: Stromboli Canapés
ingredients: 4 hot italian sausage, cut into 1-inch slices | 20 banana slices | 12 slices five-spice powder | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup chopped chocolate square | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spray with cooking spray. Place sausage slices in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Stir in banana slices until just barely warmed through, 2 to 3 minutes. Add five spice powder and soup.

Random Ingredients: deli roast beef,garam masala,penne pasta,pork shoulder roast,corn tortilla chip,pasta,kidney bean,dark chocolate
title: Spicy Indian Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder roast | 1 lb ground round | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 lb penne pasta | 2 cups broken corn tortilla chips | 6 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 1 lb deli roast beef, sliced into thin strips
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and add pork shoulder, ground round, and garam masala. Brown lightly and add drained kidney beans. Cover and cook about half way. Cook penne for 10 minutes or until al dente. Meanwhile, cook meat in a large skillet over medium heat until no longer pink. Drain and set aside. Pour meat over drained pasta and mix with about 2 tb of the bean mixture. Cook 3 - 4 min or until pasta is al dente. Fill taco shells with meat and top with a dollop of dark chocolate. Garnish with sliced deli roast beef. This can be made at the party too, as is for appetizers.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,kidney bean,italian salad dressing,sea salt black pepper,wild mushroom,black bean,caster sugar
title: Mushroom & Bean Starter
ingredients: 8 ounces wild mushrooms | 2 cans kidney beans, drained ( or equivalent dried ) | 1 can black beans, drained | 2/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt & black pepper | italian salad dressing ( see note )
instructions: Place mushrooms and beans in a microwave safe bowl. Heat them until hot. Remove cover and cook on high for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir to combine. Remove from heat, stir through caster sugar, pinch of salt & black pepper, and divide among serving glasses. Serve with warm Italian salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,peanut oil vegetable,raisin,pork,vanilla yogurt
title: Somali Peanut Paste (Haitian Pork Balls) (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground lean pork | 12 ounces vanilla yogurt | 1 jar hoisin sauce ( kikkoman ) | 4 -5 scotch bonnet peppers ( depending on your taste ) or 4 -5 chili peppers | 2 -3 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 -3 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with non stick foil and set aside. Place your ground pork in a mixing bowl until it has a uniform thick consistency. Stir in the yogurt and sauces. Use all your hands to mix well making sure the meat is well incorporated into the meat. Add in your scotch bonnet peppers for less heat if you are not using them already. Using a spoon make small indentations on the top of meat. Fill each indentation with meat, then form meat back into a ball shape. Place on prepared baking sheet and cook in pre heated oven for 20 minutes. Serve hot with brown rice, or as your dipper for stir fry. This is really delicious topped with sliced scallions and cilantro for a little bit of flavor.

title: Pear & Ghee Pumpkin Kebabs
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon pumpkin puree, canned with 1 t of liquid | 40 g ghee | 100 g pear halves
instructions: In a large bowl, beat together the eggs, mustard, pumpkin and the liquid. Heat the ghee in a wok. Drop the chopped pear halves into the egg and mustard mixture and stir gently. Cover and stand for about 10 mins until the egg and mustard are set. Gently loosen the pear halves from the skewers using a metal or bamboo skewer and grill or broil for about 3 mins, then remove and stand. Cut the kebabs with a sharp knife into cubes or slices and serve with yoghurt.

title: Welsh Ale Filling for Scones
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup cold catsup | 1 tablespoon single cream | 1 tablespoon stout beer
instructions: Mix together the flour, sugar, brown sugar and cream. Add the stout and mix well. Add the beer in small measures and stir to combine. Pour the mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a 1/4 inch star tip. Roll the maitre of a rolling pin to about the size of your scone doughnut. Score into 5 or 6 wedges, place onto a hot griddle and cook on both sides.

title: French Onion Wrap
ingredients: 2 tortillas | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence ( dried basil ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 teaspoon minced onion | 1 teaspoon minced onion
instructions: Cut tortillas into small pieces. Spray grill with butter flavored cooking spray. Place tortillas on hot grill, close lid and grill for 3 minutes on each side. Remove from griller and spread with herbes de provence and half and half. Remove from grill. Sprinkle minced onion on top and enjoy.

title: Pumpkin Vegetable and Peanut Butter Omelet
ingredients: 2 large eggsplants, sliced and cut lengthways into half | 1 large beet, grated or 4 small beetroots, finely grated | 1 large aubergine, sliced diagonally into half rings | 250 g pumpkin puree | 200 g peanut butter | 3 tablespoons molasses | 2 teaspoons key limes or 2 teaspoons lime juice | 2 thai chiles | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried currants or 1 1/2 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 200° c, or 200°c if fan forced. Place eggplant and beetroot halves in a baking dish, pour over boiling water and toss to cook until the eggplant is just tender. Drain and set to one side. Cut eggplant and beetroot into pieces about the same size. Place in a mortar and pound to a roughly even paste. In a large bowl, whisk together milk, peanut butter, molasses and key limes. Add the eggplant and beetroot and stir until coated in the marinade. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until thick. Stir in currants and serve with sambal oelek.

title: Hot-Pea Casserole
ingredients: 6 hot italian sausages, sliced | 1 can peas | 6 ounces beer | 4 tablespoons milk mayonnaise or 4 tablespoons miracle whip | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 cup peach slices, halved
instructions: Pour the beer in to a shallow ovenproof dish. Cut the sausages into 1 3/4 in long pieces and add them. Cover and cook over a moderate heat for 10 minutes or until the outsides turn an even brown. Drain any remaining juices. Increase the heat to a high and add the peas and cook, stirring, for about 2 - 3 minutes longer, or until the peas are just tender. Spread the peas on a plate, if using, and season with a little sugar, then scatter the sliced sausages on top. Pour the beer mixture over the sausages and peas and sprinkle over the milk or other salad dressing. Sprinkle the top with the peach slices, just before serving.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,jalapeno chile pepper,anise seed,beef bouillon granule,turnip,vidalia onion,splenda sugar substitute
title: Easy Crock Pot Pickled Turnips With Carrots (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 6 -12 baby carrots | 1 turnip, diced into 1-inch pieces | 1 vidalia onion, in 1/4-inch dice | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon jalapeno chile pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon beef bouillon granules
instructions: If using a crock pot, put the carrots into the bottom and add the onions and turnip, stirring in about 1/2 to 1 cup of water from time to time. If using a crock pot, put the onions and turnip into the bottom and add the anise seed, splenda, chilies, beef bouillon, sugar, and salt to taste. Cover the bottom of the crock pot and set the cooker on low for 8 hours. After 8 hours put the mixture in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Allow the flavor to continue to blend into the stew. Check if vegetables are slightly tender and serve.

title: Danish Onion Kneff
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 1 package active dry yeast
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the hot beef broth and yeast. Let stand until frothy, about 5 minutes. Then stir in the yeast mixture and return to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring, until very thick and creamy, 10 to 15 minutes, depending on the size of the onion. You may also turn down the heat and add about 1/3 of broth to the pan.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,green pepper,skirt steak,parmesan cheese,red pepper,cabbage
title: Cheesy Skirt Steak Wedges
ingredients: 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 tablespoon green pepper ( sliced or chopped ) | 1 packet of kriss's red pepper ( spicy seasoning, see recipe description ) | 1 boneless skirt steak ( or other steak ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Grill on high for 4 minutes per side or until medium well done. Slice steak into slices 3/4 inch thick. Coat grill rack with a light coating of cooking spray. Sprinkle steak with 1/4 teaspoon of kosher salt and 1/4 teaspoons of freshly ground pepper. In medium bowl toss the cabbage, green pepper, red pepper and 2 tablespoons of the kriss's red pepper seasoning with 2 tablespoons of the parmesan cheese. Put the meat on the grill rack and grill for 5 minutes on each side, brushing with this leftover seasoning while grilling. Serve with leftover parmesan cheese.

title: Yummy Smoked Salmon and Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 4 salmon, cleaned | 4 tablespoons unsweetened chocolate ( we use lindt ) | 1 packet onion soup mix | 200 g dried chinese mushrooms | icing sugar, sifted ( optional )
instructions: Place the salmon fillets in an ovenproof dish and sprinkle with the chocolate. Cover the fish with foil and bake at 200c for 20 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork, then top with the mushrooms and heat through. Sprinkle with icing sugar if desired.

title: Lime Syrup
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped salted peanuts | 1 can sweetened condensed milk with live cream or 1 can evaporated milk | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Heat a small skillet over medium heat. Cook salted peanuts in the hot skillet until fragrant, about 1 to 2 minutes. Let cool. Place the peanuts in a blender jar and add sweetened condensed milk and cream. Blend until smooth. Pour the syrup into a 2 quart glass baking dish. Tightly cover the baking dish and refrigerate the mixture, at least 2 hours and up to 1 day. Just before serving, remove the dish from the refrigerator. Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl and discard the solids. Chill overnight in the refrigerator. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: adobo sauce,chickpea,grain mustard,tomato juice,oatmeal,pork butt shoulder,tabasco sauce,white pepper
title: Cuban Pork Loaf
ingredients: 2 lbs pork butt or 2 lbs pork shoulder | 1 cup dry oatmeal, unsifted | 1/4 cup low salt tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup chives, minced | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon minced tomato juice
instructions: Place pork and oatmeal in food processor and roll to coarse crumbs. In a bowl, combine remaining ingredients and stir well. Place pork mixture in a greased loaf pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour 20 minutes, adding more water if necessary. Reduce temperature to 300° and bake an additional 30 minutes, or until done. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow potatoes, peeled, halved lengthwise, thinly sliced ( about 6 cups ) | 2/3 cup hoisin sauce ( divided ) | 1/4 cup chicken stock ( divided ) | 1/4 cup lemonade ( divided ) | 1/2 cup italian parsley, chopped very finely | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup half-and-half, heated
instructions: Bring large pot of salted water to boil. Add potatoes and cook until just tender, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes. Drain and cool. Transfer potatoes to large bowl. Using 2 teaspoons of the hoisin sauce for each serving, stir until blended. Stir in 1/2 cup of stock, lemonade and remaining 1/2 cup of broth.

Random Ingredients: black greek olive,green onion,hazelnut,grain white rice
title: Yummy Hazelnut Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain white rice | 1/4 cup sliced green onion | 6 black greek olives, sliced | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted and chopped
instructions: Rinse the rice in several changes of water.

title: Easy Salmon Slice
ingredients: 125 g shortcrust pastry | 200 g salmon | 1 kg brown rice | 3 tablespoons hot chili sauce | 150 g raspberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Roll out your shortcrust pastry into a 5 cm x 6 cm rectangle. Chill for 20 minutes then line a slice tin with the pastry. Cut the salmon into 5cm x 1 cm chunks. Mix the rice, chilli sauce and chilli sauce into the rice. Fold the salmon evenly over the rice and pour onto the pastry. Cut the raspberries into the centre then scatter with more berries on top. Bake in a moderately slow oven for 30 minutes. Serve with a salad and crackers.

title: Tofu-Taki Pasta Salad
ingredients: 400 g abura age abura age plus 12 biscuits | 200 g abura age tofu | 1 liter hot v8 vegetable stock | 120 g cannellini beans | 150 g dried pasta | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 liter dashi stock
instructions: Boil all of the entsines' according to directions on the packet. Drain the abura age. Cut the abura age into quarters. Put the abura age, tofu, soup broth and the dashi into the pan and heat over a low flame until the ingredients are well combined. Mix in the beans and pasta.

title: Ancho Mushrooms with Coconut Milk and Saffron
ingredients: 2 dried ancho chile powder in water | 12 button mushrooms | 1/2 tablespoon coconut milk | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Place the ancho mushrooms on a square of parchment paper. Pour enough coconut milk into the pan until it is half depth or less. The mushrooms shouldn't be touching. Sprinkle with saffron and leave for 5 - 10 minutes. Rinse with more aveiri and dry with towel. Grill under a hot grill until the coconut milk has reduced, then add the mushrooms and heat through.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,harissa,nori,red chili paste,pineapple juice,kosher salt
title: Spicy Sushi Roll (Kushi Al-Kofte)
ingredients: 3 sheets nori | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1 fresh red chili paste | 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon harissa | kosher salt
instructions: Heat the olive oil and then add chili paste. When the chili paste has sizzled, add the poppy seeds and after a minute add the pineapple juice. Add a pinch of salt and continue to mix. Lay the nori flat on your work surface. Roll the nori with the wet ingredients and use the sushi roller to press them into place on the nori. Enjoy.

title: Baby Green  Cakes (Vegan)
ingredients: 6 -12 ounces spring green tea leaves, washed and drained | 1 ounce self raising flour | 1 ounce celery, chopped | 1 ounce cornmeal | 2 leaves herbal tea | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs, chopped
instructions: Stir together all ingredients. Place 2 - 3 heaped tsp onto each spring roll.

title: Edamame - Sandwich Bread - Bobota
ingredients: 2 packages frozen edamame, thawed | 1 large center-cut pork chop | 2 teaspoons dry yeast | 1 cup semolina
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. In a medium bowl mix together all ingredients except bread and oil. Place bread in a greased 9x5x3 inch loaf pan. Pour bread mixture onto bread pans. Cover and let rest 20 minutes. Bake in preheated oven for 35 - 40 minutes, or until loaves sound hollow when rapped on the bottoms.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,heavy whipping cream,beef rib,liquid smoke,rose water
title: Easy Slowburner Smoky Prime Rib Bones
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons dark beer, such as modelo | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon light beer, such as a.1. original | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 cloves roasted beef ribs | 1 teaspoon dried rose water
instructions: Pour the dark beer into a large slow cooker and set aside. Whisk the cream, 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil, liquid smoke, and remaining teaspoon black pepper in a large bowl. Pour the heavy cream mixture into the slow cooker, cover, and cook on low for 10 hours. Do not stir this juice over the meat. After 10 hours, remove the meat from the slow cooker and place on a serving plate. Increase the slow cooker juice level to high. Bring the gravy to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 30 minutes. To serve, slice meat and mix with gravy. Garnish with rose water.

Random Ingredients: corn,orzo pasta,bailey irish cream,white fish fillet,jalapeno seasoning salt,coconut,turmeric,baby carrot
title: Fish in Coconut Cream over Orzo (Orzo) & Black Caviar
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orzo pasta or 2 tablespoons orzo pasta | 1 lb white fish fillet ( such as cod or sea bass ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 -3 jalapeno seasoning salt ( to taste ) | 2 -3 cups baby carrots ( cut diagonally into 1/2 ``-inch pieces ) | 1/2 cup frozen corn | 1 cup coconut ( optional to serve ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup baileys irish cream ( optional to serve )
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions. Meanwhile, rinse fish with cold water and dry with paper towels. Place fish in large, deep skillet. Sprinkle with turmeric. Season to taste with jalapeño seasoning salt. Add baby carrots, baby corn, and coconut if using. Cover and cook over medium high heat for approximately 5 minutes. Stir, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 5 more minutes. Serve with freshly made orzo.

title: Homemade Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 250 g raisins | 300 g italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon savory, plus extra ( or half ) | 1 teaspoon white vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/400f. Grease a 20cmx15cm baking tin and dust with flour. Place a spoonful of raisins in the base of the tin and sprinkle with a little savory or a pinch of black pepper. Cover with breadcrumbs and a generous pinch of savory. Dot with a little extra savory for presentation. Bake the breadcrumb mixture for 30 minutes, or until it has darkened and become firm and puffed. Cut into squares and serve hot or cold. Variation, substitute lemon breadcrumbs. Note the flavour of savory = a little less savory, a bit more savory and a drier taste. You can also use bread crumbs which have been ground or fine.

title: Cheritorita
ingredients: lettuce leaf | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Toast pine nuts in an iron skillet over medium heat. Watch carefully. As soon as they begin to turn golden, remove carefully with a slotted spoon. When they start to crackle, remove from the skillet. Wash the leaves and pat dry with paper towels. Spread leaves on a large platter. Place lettuce in center of platter and top with pine nuts. Serve.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,bulgur wheat,rice noodle,vegetable stock,onion flake,artificial sweetener,sugar,lettuce leaf
title: Oriental Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti ( i like to boil it first and drain it so it can be cut in thirds ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups glutinous rice noodles | 1 cup bulgar wheat | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1/4 cup onion flakes | 3 tablespoons artificial sweetener | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 teaspoon rice noodles ( optional ) | lettuce leaf
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling water until cooked and set aside. Cook rice noodles as per directions on package. Once cooked set aside. Drain and rinse rice noodles and set aside. Saute the rice noodles and onion. Once everything is mixed and cooked remove from heat and mix in bulgur wheat. While doing so break apart the jar of noodles and reserve. Dice the jar of onions and toss it all together.

title: Cashew Dessert
ingredients: 2/3 cup finely chopped cashews | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 2 teaspoons fine sea salt | 1 3/4 cups heavy cream, whipped
instructions: Gently melt the cashew nuts in a small pot over a low heat. Stir every so often so they don't burn then set aside to cool to room temperature. Beat the vanilla sugar and salt with a fork until you have a smooth custard consistency. Beat in the cream slowly, mixing constantly. You should be able to hold a little of the mixture with your finger tips. Pour the mixture into a glass dish or shallow serving dish which has been lightly coated with a light coating of nonstick spray. Refrigerate uncovered for at least 2 hours. Serve in individual glasses garnished with chopped nuts, if using.

title: Spiced anise Coffee
ingredients: 3/4 ounce anise seed | 3 egg yolks | 6 teaspoons ground coffee or 6 teaspoons espresso
instructions: Heat the anise seeds in a small, dry frying pan over low heat until the scent rises. Remove the pan from the heat and add the egg yolks. Whisk constantly until thick and pale. Pour the coffee into a tea cup or heat proof bowl.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing mix,polish sausage,dark beer,vegetable oil,cumin,milk chocolate,beef brisket
title: Tijuana Kitchen Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb whole beef brisket, trimmed | 1 can low-sodium black cola-flavored carbonated beverage-flavored carbonated beverage ( like sprite ) | 9 ounces polish sausage, sliced | vegetable oil | 1 cup skim milk chocolate | 1 envelope hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: Prepare a hot fire for direct high heat and lightly oil the grate. Cut brisket into 2 wide strips and place in a large sealable plastic bag. Pour cola beverage over brisket and seal bag. Refrigerate for 4 hours. The next day, drain brisket and place in a large heavy pot.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,ginger,half cream,baking potato,white cheddar cheese,goat cheese,black pepper,tomato
title: Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 2 cups half-and-half cream | 3 medium baking potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 3/4 cup diced fresh tomato | 12 ounces shredded white cheddar cheese | 3/4 cup cubed gruyere cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 4 ounces goat cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a 2 quart casserole dish. In a medium bowl combine half and half, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, gruyere cheese, pepper, and ginger. Layer half of the potatoes in the prepared casserole dish, and then half the goat cheese evenly over the potatoes. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used. Bake in the preheated oven 40 minutes, or until bubbly and golden brown.

title: Swiss Beet Bites
ingredients: 1/2 large beet, cut in half | 1 tablespoon flax seed | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup canned bean sprouts, drained and rinsed | 1 ham, deli reduced fat and sliced into thin pieces | 1 ice cube
instructions: Cook the beet in boiling water about 5 to 7 minutes or until just barely tender. Remove from heat and drain. Peel and discard beet from water, but leave 2 to 4 inch chunks in the beet. Place the bread crumbs in a medium bowl, and stir in the refried beans. Coat the bottom of a small saucepan with the chopped beet and a few slices of ham, and coat with the egg wash. Place over low heat.

title: Cheese Custard Pudding
ingredients: 3 cups cottage cheese | 10 tablespoons cake flour | 1 1/3 cups caster sugar | 1 tablespoon water | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Heat oven to 200c or390f or 180c. To make the custard base, combine the flour, sugar and water in a saucepan and cook over a medium heat, stirring constantly. When mixture starts to bubble, reduce heat, add vanilla essence and allow to bubble for another minute or until thickened. Pour the custard mixture into a round casserole dish and top with the cheese, smoothing it slightly. Place in oven and bake for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,chicken wing,horseradish,farfalle pasta,shiitake mushroom,cremini mushroom,hummus
title: Chicken and Shiitake Pasta Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 3 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup orange juice | 12 ounces grilled chicken wings, chopped | 10 ounces prepared horseradish | 12 ounces cooked farfalle pasta | 1 bottle prepared horseradish sauce
instructions: Marinate wings and mushrooms in orange juice and horseradish for at least 30 minutes. Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,dill,cocoa powder,chicken breast,coconut cream,seasoning mix,gin,chicken thigh
title: Championship Crock Pot Chocolate Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry gin | 1 teaspoon dill | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/3 cup coconut cream | 1/3 cup coconut cream | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoon cocoa powder
instructions: Stir the 1st measure of ingredients in a 1 1/2 quart slow cooker. Add chicken thighs and turn to coat. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or high for 4 to 5 hours.
