Random Ingredients: grain rice,pizza sauce,raisin,phyllo dough,red potato,green pea,pork roast
title: Easy Crock Pot Pulled Pork and Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork roast | 1/3 cup raisins | 1 jar pizza sauce, low sodium | 0.5 package frozen green peas, thawed | 1 cup sliced red potatoes | 8 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 1 cup short or medium grain rice ( not instant )
instructions: Place pork in bottom of crock pot. Sprinkle with raisins. Pour pizza sauce over pork and peas. Add potatoes, stir to combine. Cover and turn on low until pork is falling off the bone, about 6 hours or 4 to 5 hours. Uncover cook on high for 20 - 45 minutes or until pork is tender and potatoes are tender. Remove pork to cutting board, shred, and set aside. While pork is cooking, prepare rice as directed on package. When pork is finished cooking add rice and peas, stir to combine. Place pork on a cutting board and slice across grain using a sharp, very large, 5 inch slice. Place a piece of cooked rice onto each dinner plate and serve with meat.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,barley,baby spinach leaf,vegetable oil cooking spray,black eyed pea
title: Black-Eyed Peas and Spinach in Walnut Sauce
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups chopped fresh baby spinach leaves | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 2 -4 ounces barley blend or 2 -4 ounces brown rice
instructions: Spray large nonstick skillet with vegetable oil and set over medium high heat. When hot, add spinach and cook until browned, stirring frequently, approximately 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in black eyed peas and fennel seeds and cook until heated through. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Easy Vietnamese Fried Chicken
ingredients: 3 free range chicken piece, skin on, jointed | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 pinch nutmeg, freshly grated ( optional )
instructions: Thoroughly combine all ingredients until well combined. Spread mixture on chicken pieces and leave aside for 20 minutes. Heat oil. Dip chicken pieces in hot oil just long enough to colour them. Drain on paper towel and serve warm.

title: Kalakih (Swedish Christmas Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 medium head green cabbage, cored, cut into chunks | 8 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, blanch the cabbage in batches for 20 seconds. Drain and transfer to a bowl. Stir in cardamom. Let cool for 15 minutes. Place in refrigerator until cold before serving.

title: Swiss Chard With soymilk
ingredients: 2 bunches swiss chard, stemmed and washed, stems trimmed and leaves separated, leaves cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Drop chard pieces in just enough water to cover or a few tablespoons of milk for 1 - 2 minutes to wilt. Drain well and place in a strainer set over a bowl. Let drain 30 minutes. Transfer the chard to another bowl, cover with clean towels and let drain in the swiss chard's water until all of the liquid has drained, about an hour. Rinse chard under cold water. Pat dry. Put the swiss chard with stem pieces on a serving platter. Pour enough soymilk into the skillet to just cover the chard. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer over low medium heat until tender but not mushy, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat, discard stems and leaves and stir in 2 tbsp of the soymilk. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,currant,cod,banana,egg noodle,carrot,extra virgin olive oil
title: Caribbean Cod (Mackerel) Salad
ingredients: 1/4 liter extra virgin olive oil | 2 guajillo chilies, deseeded and slit | 4 large ripe bananas, halved | 4 large carrots, cut into matchsticks | 450 g cod, sliced ( fresh or canned, drained, if canned ) | 1/2 cup currants | 200 g egg noodles, cooked
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Drizzle the oil over the sliced chilies, place them in a frying pan with just enough light heat to cover the surface, and fry for three minutes until hot and lightly coloured. Remove from the heat and shake off any excess oil. Set aside and leave to cool. Combine the bananas and carrots in a large bowl. Toss the cod with the currants in a bowl, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper, and add to the banana mixture. Chop the eggs coarsely, and stir into the salad just before serving.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,coconut,baking potato,tart apple,picante sauce,mushroom,green chili pepper
title: Picante Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb baking potatoes, peeled and cut in 1/2 in slices | 6 flour tortillas, warmed | 12 ounces mushrooms, sliced | 1 can green chili peppers, chopped and drained | 1/2 cup shredded mexican melting cheese | 1 small tart apple, peeled and chopped | picante sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange potatoes slices over the bottom of an ungreased 13 x 9 inch baking dish and top with the mushrooms, chilies, cheese, apple and sauce. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes. Top with cheese slices and serve with hot tortillas.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,pimiento,cream mushroom soup,chili powder
title: Creamy Mexican Chili Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 jar diced pimientos ( or 1 cup pimento stuffed olive with capers ) | 1 dash hot chili pepper flakes | 1 dash chili powder ( more to taste )
instructions: Pour condensed soup into a bowl. Stir in pimientos. Sprinkle on chili powder. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,balsamic vinegar,water,russet potato,white button mushroom,chocolate chip,ham,pineapple juice
title: Sweet Potato & Ham Terrine
ingredients: 180 g sweet potatoes, cut in chunks | 180 g ham, halved diagonally | 2 cups rice flour, mix of rice starch and glutinous rice flour ( mix of glutinous rice and glutinous rice mix ) | 50 g rice flour, mix and glutinous rice flour ( mix and glutinous rice mix ) | 200 g white button mushrooms, cleaned | 200 g pineapple in juice | 20 g balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup cold water | 1/4 cup unsweetened chocolate chips ( for garnishing )
instructions: Pre heat oven 180 degrees c / 350°f line a 20cm lamington tin with parchment paper to make a lining. Place sweet potatoes and ham in a large bowl and add the rice stir until combined. In a food processor or medium mixing bowl place flours and mix slowly add water gradually. If mixture just starts to lose it's been a bit runny add more water. Pour mixture into prepared tin and bake for 45 50mins. Take from oven and leave to stand for 5 10mins, then gently lift from tin and place onto serving plate while preparing the terrine. Serve either warm or cold with sweet potato and ham, you have to be absolutely sure the sweet potato doesn't get dry as this could easily take some drying time and it could take about 20 minutes or two for the sweet potato to become soft and stretchy. You don't want to make it too dry, you might have to use a lot of water. Melt the chocolate chips in a small saucepan over a low heat and stir to smooth it out but it's up to you. When completely smooth, pour over sweet potato and ham mixture and toss gently to coat.

title: Orange Rice Drink
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 2 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Rinse the rice under running water and place in a fine mesh strainer or colander fitted with a fine mesh sieve over a large bowl and set aside until the water runs clear. Transfer the rice to a food processor fitted with the steel blade and chop until fine, about 10 seconds. Add the almond extract, orange juice and almond extract and process until well blended about 30 pulses or until the rice is just tender but not mushy and the orange juice is emulsified.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,pineapple chunk,cornflour,self rising cornmeal,cremini mushroom
title: Aussie Stacks
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising cornmeal | 2/3 cup self-rising cornflour | 2/3 cup cremini mushrooms, finely sliced and chopped | 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained well
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Grease a shallow baking dish. Combine the cornmeal, corn flour, mushrooms, cheese and pineapple in a large bowl.

title: Semolina and Eggplant Rolls
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs eggplants, sliced lengthwise in to 1/8 inch slices | 1 teaspoon salt | 6 ounces fine dry breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 cup semolina or 1 cup fine cornmeal
instructions: In a colander add the salt and water to a depth of 2 inches and bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat and cover. After 15 minutes, remove cover from heat and let sit. After 10 minutes, uncover the skillet and return to heat. Spread the slices in 1/3 of the crumbs coating both sides and set aside. Heat oven to 375°f. In a shallow ovenproof dish, toss together the eggplant and the remaining crumbs. Place in the oven for 15 minutes, flipping once and sprinkling with the rest of the crumbs. Set aside to cool. Put the semolina in a bowl of cold water and stir in enough water to form a loose dough. Shape dough into 6 oval pancakes about 1/2 inch thick. Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to a simmer. Drop the eggplant rolls into the boiling water, one by one, cook for 3 minutes, or until golden through, drain and sprinkle with the remaining crumbs. Serve warm.

title: Broccoli
ingredients: 1/4 cup cooking oil | 12 ounces broccoli florets | 1 loaf french bread | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon dried chives | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse the broccoli and reserve the water. Slice the french bread lengthwise into 6 pieces. Arrange 3 pieces in a baking pan. Cut the broccoli in half and set aside. In each piece of bread toast the mustard seeds and mace until the mustard seeds pop. Then add the dried thyme and set aside. Put the remaining oil in a deep skillet with a drop of cooking oil. When the oil is hot add the broccoli cut side down. Cook over medium heat until the broccoli is very tender, about 25 minutes. Turning the pieces over so they cook evenly will prevent burning. Place the french toast into the oven until slightly crisp. Spoon on the broccoli. Sprinkle the cayenne pepper mixture over the top before serving.

title: Yogurt Rice
ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice | 1/2 cup yogurt
instructions: Wash and drain the rice. Make a bowl of yogurt and combine the rice and yogurt with rice and yogurt. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to blend.

title: Chicken and Strawberry Puree
ingredients: 2 chicken legs | 2 -3 pints of fresh strawberries
instructions: Pre heat over to 175c, then put on the shelf in the sun for 1 hour. Open the container and place the chicken on it. Wash the strawberries and leave it in the sun for 20 minutes. Discard the stems. Shred the chicken and mix with the strawberries. Serve when cool.

Random Ingredients: coriander,dark chocolate,no boil lasagna noodle,vital wheat gluten,shallot,pudding
title: Healthy No-Bake Lasagne
ingredients: 250 g good quality dark chocolate, chopped | 1 shallot, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 150 g good quality plain yogurt-coated pudding, canned | 200 g no-boil lasagna noodles, cooked | 1 teaspoon vital wheat gluten ( optional )
instructions: Place dark chocolate, shallots, coriander and 1 tablespoon of water into a small pan, let stand for 10 - 15 minutes. Take the chocolate mixture from the heat and add the yogurt to it. Bring to the boil, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon. Then whisk to dissolve the cocoa until smooth. When chocolate is melted, spoon it onto the noodles and mix with your hands for a few seconds. Cover and set aside to cool a few minutes.

title: Crawfish and Chocolate Sundae
ingredients: 500 g medium raw crawfish tail, tails on | cooking spray | 3 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted | 400 g corn kernels | 125 g sugar | 4 tablespoons maggi seasoning | 50 g chopped semisweet chocolate
instructions: Place 1/2t of the cob on the bottom of your double boiler and add boiling water. Cover and cook for 5minutes, stirring constantly, until the water boils out of the cob. Remove from heat and add the crawfish tails, cover and let stand for 10minutes. Drain the crawfish tails and discard the heads and shells. Heat the cooking spray in a pan until hot, add chocolate and allow it to melt. Add corn and sugar and stir until the sugar has dissolved. Once the sugar has dissolved, stir in the maggi seasoning, the crawfish tails and the chocolate sauce and heat through. Serve warm or cold. Serve warm.

title: Parsnip Chips (Hiyashi No Amaguzo)
ingredients: 4 parsnips, peeled and cut on the diagonal into thin | 2 -3 bamboo shoots, sliced ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mirin ( for dipping ) ( optional )
instructions: Boil 2 - 3 cups of water, add the parsnips and simmer for about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Place the bamboo shots in a small saucepan with a little water, just enough to cover. Bring to the boil and immediately remove from the heat. You can leave the saucepan with the sprouts sticking to the bottom, but it should not take more than a minute or two, otherwise the sprouts will cook right away. When the sprouts are cool but not completely soft, mash them with the back of a spoon. Stir in mirin. Dip the noodles in the broth and serve.

title: Easy Boiled Italian Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 -6 large wild mushroom, depending on size | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 -2 hard-boiled egg, depending on size | 3 tablespoons triple sec
instructions: Drain tomatoes, save 1/2 cup liquid and chop remaining 1/2 cup. Set aside. Peel egg, slice into 1/2 inch rounds. Set aside. Place mushrooms and tomatoes in a large bowl. Add 1 teaspoons triple sec, 1 teaspoon sherry and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Mix lightly with a fork. Dip the egg in the reserved tomato/mushroom liquid and arrange on top in rings. If necessary, place additional tomato/mushroom/watercress in bowl, place under broiler and broil until egg is golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 baguette | 1 package guacamole | 2 1/2 lbs beef stew meat ( you can use a mix of beef and pork )
instructions: Slice the loaf in half horizontally. On the bottom half, split guacamole into two halves. In one half place beef stew meat. Cover beef with top half of guacamole. Roll up bread and fasten with two toothpicks. Freeze for one hour or until firm.

title: Kielbasa and Sausage on Toast
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa or 1 lb bacon | 1/2 lb butouille sausage | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1 package frozen cherries | crusty bread ( optional )
instructions: Remove kielbasa from packaging and freeze. Slice into 1/4 inch wide strips. Place frozen kielbasa into large frying pan and brown the sausage, then drain off the grease. Place in a medium sized baking dish, and top evenly with the oregano and cherries. I put them into a bowl with plastic wrap over the top. At this point, you can put into a freezer bag and place into the freezer until ready to assemble the dinner rolls. To proceed, defrost the kielbasa and allow to thaw for 10 minutes then slice into 1/4 inch wide strips. Drain excess grease out of the frying pan and set aside. Heat oil in the frying pan and fry until heated through. Serve over toast with the cherry tomato olive salad. I always add cheese to this recipe because i love the cheese.

title: Strawberry Toast Sandwich
ingredients: 4 teaspoons mixed spice | 9 slices bread | 1 cup strawberry, hulled | 4 teaspoons swiss cheese, shredded | 1/4 teaspoon mace, ground
instructions: Spray a grill with cooking spray and place over medium high heat. In a small bowl mix together spice mix, then spread spice mix on bread slices. Spoon 1/4 cup of strawberry and cheese on toasted slice of bread. Sprinkle with the ground mace and serve.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,oat,lamb,black peppercorn,corn,beef brisket,black bean,pod cardamom
title: Fresno Oats (Oats With Meat and Vegetables
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket | 1 1 cup quick oats, uncooked | 6 black peppercorns | 3/4 lb lamb fat or 3/4 lb goat meat | 5 tablespoons corn, frozen or olive oil | 10 -12 cardamom pods | 10 maraschino cherries, halved | 3/4 lb black beans or 3/4 lb garbanzo beans, drained but retain the juice ( 1 pint )
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees f. Place brisket in ovenproof pot with enough water to cover. Add 1 tablespoon each of oats and peppercorns and bring to boil. Reduce heat to simmer and maintain at about 300 degrees f. Simmer, partially covered, for 2 hours. Remove and let meat stand covered in liquid for 45 minutes. Heat olive oil in a skillet and saute the meat over moderate heat until lightly browned and tender, about 45 minutes. While meat is standing, boil the beans until tender and drain. Serve in roasting pan with meat. Sprinkle meat with remaining ingredients and serve along with beans.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,chile,cooking spray,monterey jack cheese,grand marnier,poblano chile,fruit,garlic clove
title: Chiles and Noodles With Grand Marnier
ingredients: 1 medium poblano chile, roasted seeded removed | 3/4 lb egg noodles, cooked | cooking spray | 1 garlic clove, roasted | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese or 1/2 cup goat cheese | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup other citrus marinade | 1 tablespoon chopped dried fruit ( optional ) | 1 minced seeded seeded chile ( optional )
instructions: Using a sharp paring knife, cut the chilie in half lengthwise. Remove seeds and excess white pith. Grill chilie as above except broil about 10 minutes. Heat oven to spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine cooked noodles, minced garlic and mascarpone. Stuff noodles with mixture. Bake at 350 for 8 to 10 minutes or until hot and hot and crumbly around the edges.

title: Cucumber and Apricot Salad
ingredients: 1 cucumber, peeled and sliced | 225 g apricots, stoned and halved | 200 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 75 g mixed dried fruit | 50 g white sugar | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Combine the cucumber, apricots, sun dried tomatoes and mixed dried fruit in a serving bowl. Add sugar and cream, pour over the cucumber and fruit mixture and stir until well combined.

title: Parsley Toast
ingredients: 8 slices white bread | 1/4 cup parsley, finely chopped | 1 dash allspice, ground | 1 lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Preheat your broiler. Place four slices of bread on your broiler tray and spread with parsley. Place second bread slice onto top. Spray top bread with non stick cooking spray and return to oven until bottom bread slice is lightly browned. Cut sandwich in half diagonally, remove bread from tray and serve with wedges of lime.

title: Grilled Beef Tenderloin Steak
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks | 1/4 cup lemon juice
instructions: Prepare grill for medium heat. Rub tenderloin with lemon juice.

title: Tomato Sauce For Shrimp
ingredients: 1 can tomato juice | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Pour tomato juice into blender or food processor. Place bay leaf in blender. Add tomatoes as desired. Blend to desired consistency. Serve over white rice.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,rigatoni pasta,egg yolk,baby spinach,pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,chinese five spice powder
title: Chicken and Spinach Rigatoni
ingredients: 3 cups rigatoni pasta, cooked | 2 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 2 1/2 teaspoons cooking oil, divided | 1 lb baby spinach, washed | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup button mushroom, sliced | 4 large egg yolks | pepper
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 teaspoon vegetable oil over medium high heat. Add spinach or arugula to the skillet and stir to coat well with oil. Saute until just wilted, about 2 minutes, stirring every minute to avoid burning. Remove from heat. In a large bowl, mix cooked rigatoni with 3/4 teaspoon cooking oil, remaining 3/4 teaspoon cooking oil, spinach, five spice powder, mushrooms and egg yolk. Mix well. Sprinkle pepper on top. Heat remaining 1 teaspoon vegetable oil in another skillet over medium high heat. Add rigatoni mixture to skillet and fry, stirring, just until heated through, about 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,orange juice concentrate,brioche bread,vegetable oil cooking spray,fruit,thyme sprig,soba noodle
title: Herbed Sour Soup With Soba Noodles.
ingredients: 1 bag dried soba noodles | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 bay leaf | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 2 tablespoons frozen orange juice concentrate | 1/2 cup sliced mixed fruit | 6 warm brioche bread, cut in 1. 5-inch cubes, toasted
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain. Heat oil in heavy large nonstick skillet on medium high heat. Add bay leaf, thyme, and orange juice concentrate. Stir fry for 1 minute. Add noodles, stirring over medium heat. Heat 3 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Divide noodles among 6 serving plates. Top with fruit. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,triple sec,red chili pepper flake,beet,caper
title: Beetroot Remedy
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh beet, unpeeled | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 1/2 tablespoons triple sec | 5 1/2 tablespoons white sugar ( or more to taste ) | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Rinse off the beetroot, removing any beet leaves. Slice about 1/8 thick or less, depending on the size. Use a vegetable slicer, or the method from your beets for slicing. Place beets in a saucepan or steamer basket and add cold water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium, and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and cool until easily handled. Cut into 1 inch squares. Place the capers in a small bowl with 1 1/2 tablespoons of triple sec, and 1 teaspoon of red chilly flakes. Mix well. Set aside. Peel and thinly slice the beets, using a mandolin or the blade of a meat mallet. Place in a colander, rinse under cold water and shake out as much moisture as possible. Place onto plastic wrap or paper towels to drain. Set aside. To prepare the remedy, mix 1/4 cup of sugar with 3 tablespoons water in a small bowl or pan until the sugar dissolves. Set aside. Remove stems, eyes, and gristle from the beetroot and remove woody outer leaves. Cut into 1 inch lengths and toss with capers in a bowl. To serve, spoon the beetroot onto a plate, and add about 1 teaspoon of sugar and about 1 teaspoon of red chilis if using.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,phyllo pastry,dijon mustard,neufchatel cheese
title: Thai Brik
ingredients: 1 box phyllo pastry ( thawed, frozen ) | 2 ounces neufchatel cheese | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 5 -6 kaffir lime leaves, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Unroll the phyllo pastry and cut off the corner where the phyllo overlaps. Spread a thin layer of the filling over the pastry to within 1/2 of the edges, leaving 1/2 inch of pastry on the edge and overlapping the filling from the sides. Fold the excess dough over to make a rimmed rectangle, remembering to fold all the way around the filling. Crimp the edge of the phyllo pastry with a fork. Place it seam side down on a baking sheet, spray it with cooking spray. Bake for 25 minutes, until the phyllo puffs up and the filling becomes crisp on the top. Remove from the oven and scatter the kaffir lime leaf over it. Let sit for a few minutes before serving.

title: St. Valentines Indian Mix
ingredients: 2 cups cornmeal | 1 tablespoon crushed cumin seed | 1 tablespoon crushed gingerroot | 1 tablespoon rose water | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Grind together the cornmeal, cumin seeds, gingerroot, and rose water. Spread the mixture on a baking sheet. Let stand for 50 minutes or overnight. Spread cornstarch mixture on a dry, ungreased griddle. Spread the cornstarch mixture on the griddle. Cook over moderate heat, turning and stirring, until cornstarch is a light golden brown. Transfer to a plate, and sprinkle with red chilies and paprika.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,vanilla ice cream,great northern bean,russet potato
title: Chinese White Bean Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes | 8 ounces whole great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup chinese five spice powder | vanilla ice cream ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot with boiling water, cook the peeled potatoes until they are tender, about 10 minutes, depending on size. When done, drain thoroughly and cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Place the potatoes, beans, and 2 cups water in a blender or food processor and puree until smooth. Heat oven to 400 degrees f and lightly oil a 2 quart casserole dish and line the bottom with parchment paper. Place potatoes in prepared dish. In a small bowl, stir the five spice powder with a tablespoon of cold water until the powder is dissolved. Sprinkle spice mixture inside the dish with the potatoes. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until bubbly and hot. Turn off the oven, uncover and keep the dish warm in the oven for several hours until it is very hot and getting soggy. Serve with vanilla ice cream, if desired.

title: Tropical Okra Appetizer
ingredients: 3 ounces frozen okra, thawed | 1 large eggplant, cut into 1 in cubes | 2 plum tomatoes, cut into 1& 1/2 in slices | 1/3 cup triple sec liqueur | 1/4 cup grand marnier | sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place frozen okra in a 9x13 baking pan coated with cooking spray and bake until heated through about 5 minutes.

title: English Flapjacks
ingredients: 4 ounces quick-cooking rolled oats | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons dried mint | mace ( fresh or powdered )
instructions: Put the flour in a bowl. Put the oatmeal in a bowl and put 2 tablespoons of the oil into the flour.

title: Foolproof Baked Corn
ingredients: 36 corn husks | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 tablespoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place dry corn husks on a baking sheet. Sprinkle thyme, garlic salt onto dry corn. Place the tray in the center of the oven. Roast in preheated oven about 35 minutes, turning occasionally, until soft and dry.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,cauliflower,olive oil,asiago cheese,ancho chile powder
title: Italian Veggies (Low-Fat)
ingredients: 500 g cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 cup tomato sauce ( or equivalent tomato puree ) | 1 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup light olive oil | 1/4 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Cook cauliflower in lightly salted water in a large pot of rapidly boiling salted water for 4 - 5 mins or until tender crisp. Transfer to colander.

title: Beef Tenderloin Steak With Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin steaks, 5 to 6 ounces each | 2 medium yellow squash, trimmed to 2-inch-thick slices
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the steaks on a broiler rack in a baking pan. Coat with cooking spray. Broil the steaks 4 to 6 inches from the heat, turning once, until just cooked through, 13 to 16 minutes total for medium rare, 12 to 15 minutes for medium well. Transfer the steaks to a cutting board and let rest for 10 minutes to allow the juices to redistribute. Slice the steaks and serve.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,leg lamb,pork sausage,sushi rice,ziti pasta,fritos corn chip,black eyed pea
title: Korean Mini Sausage and Pizzaties
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground pork sausage | 1/2 pound ground sirloin-style lamb | 3 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, diced | 1 bag sushi rice | 24 fritos corn chips | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 1 package korean breakfast rolls, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the sausages and ground sirloin with no pockets of pink in a large skillet over medium high heat and cook until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Stir the tomatoes into the sausage mixture and cook about 10 minutes more. Place the rice in a 2 quart baking dish and cover with plastic wrap. Cook rice in the preheated oven until cooked through, about 20 minutes. Arrange two fritos corn chips on a work surface, break open to expose the insides of the fritos, and pack the rice into a wide, shallow bowl. Place the sausage mixture into an eggwash package, and carefully slip an opening lengthwise, about 1/2 inch wide and 2 inches wide. Roll up the tortos with your hands until well coated. Seal the opening with a little water. Repeat with the remaining fritos and sausage mixture. Spoon rice into the bottom of a round glass baking dish. Spoon the sausage and tomatoes over the rice evenly. Top with fritos, black eyed peas and roll ends up. Seal the top of the baking dish with an egg wash package. Bake in the preheated oven until the fritos form golden brown crust, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: honey,lime juice,breakfast sausage,olive oil cooking spray,turmeric,celery rib
title: Honey Sausages with Celery Ribs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 tablespoon olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 large celery rib, trimmed, cut into thin slices | 8 ounces breakfast sausage, hot, sliced in 1/4 inch pieces
instructions: Prepare grill, if using. Combine honey, lime or lemon juice, olive oil, turmeric and celery in a large resealable plastic bag. Add sausages and shake to coat. Transfer sausages to grill rack and lightly spray with cooking oil. Grill sausages, turning occasionally, until cooked through, about 5 minutes.

title: Savory Baked Sticky Ham Gravy and Gravy Gravy
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs raw ham hocks | 2 tablespoons chopped savory
instructions: In an ovenproof pot, place the ham hocks. Sprinkle the savory over the ham hocks. Pour the stock into the pot and cover with cold water. Put in the oven and cook for 3 - 4 hours, stirring every 30 mins to make sure the stock doesn't dry out. The stock should be very thick and syrupy. The gravy should not be watery but just soicky that you can taste the liquid and you will see how it thickens.. When the thickened gravy is ready to be served, remove the ham hocks from the pot and place on a serving dish. Keep warm. You can make these in the microwave using the leftover ham hocks that have been boiled in water, or boil them with the gravy in a microwave. The ham can be frozen and reheated in an oven heated to 300°f until heated through.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,string bean,flour tortilla,cilantro,coffee,sirloin,anaheim chilies,basil pesto
title: Beef With Beans
ingredients: 1 jar prepared basil pesto | 2 tablespoons coffee | 1 -2 lb sirloin, beef ( optional ) | 8 -10 flour tortillas or 8 -10 corn tortillas | 1 cup green beans, frozen | 2 anaheim chilies, thinly sliced | shredded fresh cilantro
instructions: Put pesto on plate. Slice beef into thin slices. Heat tortillas in microwave until soft and pliable. Combine pesto, coffee and 2 tblsps. Of the meat mixture in bowl, and mix well. Warm meat on skillet, add beef and sprinkle with pepper. Heat another skillet, add meat to skillet and stir fry 1 minute. Divide among tortillas, top with green beans, bean and cheese.

title: Grilled Potatoes and Horseradish Tomatillos
ingredients: 1 potato, halved lengthwise | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh horseradish sauce | 1 can tomatillos, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high. Place the potato halves cut side down on a foil lined baking sheet. Drizzle with horseradish sauce. Cook for 5 minutes. Turn the potatoes over and continue to grill until the tops are golden brown and the potatoes are tender, about 5 minutes. Brush the tomatillos with oil and grill for 2 to 3 minutes, or until browned lightly. Top with the horseradish tomato mixture. Garnish with fresh parsley.

title: Kanabi (Minty Fermented Daikon Beans)
ingredients: 2 cups dark red kidney beans ( soaked overnight, see note ) | 3/4 lb daikon radish ( soaked in 1/2 cup water for 15 minutes, then shredded )
instructions: Place soaked daikon in a large soup kettle with the 1 1/2 cups water and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Lower heat and simmer slowly, partially covered, for 1 hour or until the daikon is very soft.

title: Moroccan-Spiced Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon steaks | 3/4 cup golden raisin
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f | 1 tablespoon golden raisins or 1 tablespoon dried thyme 

 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Rinse salmon well under cold water, rubbing in the juices, and drain. Coat in oil or glaze, and place on a foil lined baking sheet. Put in the middle of the oven, and bake until tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Quinoa and Cheese Balls
ingredients: 3 cups cooked quinoa | 2 tablespoons teh shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 2 teaspoons dry quinoa | 2 ounces medium salsa | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/4 teaspoon sumac | 1 ounce shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine quinoa, 1/2 cup of the mozzarella and the quinoa and mix well. Form the mixture into approximately thirty balls and place on an ungreased rimmed baking sheet. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Meanwhile, in medium bowl combine salsa, 1/2 cup of the part skim mozzarella and the sumac. Sprinkle over the quinoa balls in baking dish. Bake additional 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Top with the remaining 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese and bake additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted and quinoa is heated through.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,red pepper,salt,deli turkey,carrot,canola oil,hot pepper
title: Quick Chicken and Turkey Dogs (Canning)
ingredients: 2 lbs thin sliced deli turkey | 1/2 lb thick sliced carrot | 1/8 cup canola oil | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon salt | 8 -10 drops tabasco sauce | 1 dash ground red pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Trim deli turkey of all fat and slice into approximately 1/2 inch rounds. If you don't have any slicers use a knife. Cut carrots into roughly 1/4 inch rounds. Place carrots in mixing bowl with turkey. Sprinkle salt with tabasco and ground red pepper. Toss well to combine. In a jar with a lid put in 1/2 cup canola oil and 3/4 teaspoon of salt. Set aside. Mix all the veggies in the bowl and place each piece of turkey on the veggies surrounding it. Cover tightly and shake well to help prevent mixture from sticking to the veggies in the jar. After the bottle is made, refrigerate the turkey and veggies for 3 days. Remove turkey and veggies from brine, unwrapping, and rinse the turkey/veggies.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,hash brown potato,baby spinach leaf,dill
title: Potato Chapati With Shiitake and Garlic
ingredients: 1 package fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 package frozen hash brown potatoes | 1 bunch fresh baby spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon dried dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,white vinegar,tomatillo,cooking spray,artichoke heart,crescent,rice wine vinegar
title: Pizza Artichoke Hearts With Tomatillo Dill Sauce
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained, quartered | cooking spray | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 1/4 cups shredded mexican smoked tomatillos or 1 1/4 cups drained fresh tomatillos | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rosemary | 1 package crescent rolls
instructions: Spray a 9 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Unroll 1/2 the crescent dough and separate into 6 rectangles. Place a piece of dough between 2 pieces of plastic wrap. Firmly press 1 inch of the dough down to form a 13 inch circle on the pan. Repeat with another 1/2 tablespoon of dough and remaining dough. Arrange artichokes in a layer on each dough round. To make the dressing, in a small bowl, stir together the rice wine vinegar, tomatillos, white vinegar and rosemary. Spoon the tomatillo and vinegar dressing over artichokes and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 of the crescent dough. Cover skillet with a lid or plastic wrap and set over medium heat. Cook, turning the dough after 30 seconds, for 9 to 12 minutes or until edges rise slightly. In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Sprinkle the remaining 1/2 of crescent dough over the top of the skillet. Cook for 5 minutes or until dough is golden. Transfer each piece of dough to a cutting board. With a sharp, hot knife, cut into 8 or 10 slices. Serve with the tomatillo mustard sauce.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,sunflower oil,red chile,yellow mustard,cayenne pepper
title: Chocolate Mustard Hummus
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons roasted red chile, seeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped red chile | 1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, mash half the mustard into a paste with a mortar and pestle. Stir in the sunflower oil, red chilies, desiccated chile pepper and cayenne pepper.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,monterey jack cheese,red pepper,egg yolk,salt black pepper,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Red Pepper-Cheese Samosas
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 large egg yolk | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 3/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup finely sliced roasted red pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with butter or vegetable oil. Mix the flour, salt, pepper, and egg yolk together in a medium bowl. Stir in the monterey jack, cheddar, red peppers, and the seasoning mixture. Spoon the batter into the prepared baking dish. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes or until the samosas are puffed and golden.

Random Ingredients: banana,tomato basil garlic oregano,vegetable oil cooking spray,emmenthaler cheese,zucchini,cannellini bean,head cauliflower,corn
title: Corn and Bean Fiesta Salad
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 medium zucchini, thinly sliced | 1 small head cauliflower, chopped into small florets | 2 large ripe tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 can cannellini beans or ( 15 ounce ) can other white beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package frozen corn, thawed and well drained | 1/4 cup minced banana ( optional ) | 1/4 cup minced fresh basil and oregano, to taste ( optional ) | 1/3 cup lightly packed grated emmenthaler cheese ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 425ºf. Coat an 18x12 inch baking dish with cooking spray.

title: My Pineapple and Sour Cream Soup
ingredients: 15 ounces condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon pineapple juice
instructions: Heat the cream of chicken soup in a pot. When heated through, add pineapple juice. Stir to mix all together. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,celery leaf,salmon fillet,gingersnap cooky,active yeast,crabmeat,avocado
title: Ginger and Avocado Rice
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain white rice, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups crabmeat | 1 cup chopped celery leaves | 1/4 cup chopped fresh gingerroot (, peeled ) | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 5 1/2 ounces canned salmon fillets, drained | 2 ripe avocados, halved lengthwise and sliced
instructions: Combine the rice, crabmeat, celery, gingerroot, and yeast in a large mixing bowl and mix until combined. Split the salmon into four equal pieces. Cut each piece into four 1/4 inch thick strips. Pour the fish onto the rice mixture and mix to combine. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray and line the pan with the salmon. Cover with plastic wrap and store in the refrigerator to rise slightly. Preheat the oven to 375°f. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove the baking dish from the oven, loosen the salmon strips, and arrange on top of the rice mixture. Return to the oven and bake for 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Raspberry and Cranberry Swiss Spread
ingredients: 6 cups fresh raspberries | 2 cups cranberries ( or frozen ) | 16 ounces swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: In a large bowl, combine raspberries and cranberries. Cover and place in refrigerator for several hours, or overnight. Remove from refrigerator 1 hour prior to serving, then sprinkle with a few shakes of each cheese on top. Serve warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,salt pepper,cornstarch,tomatillo,dark soy sauce,date,swiss cheese,ice water
title: Sweet Fire Antipasto Salad
ingredients: 1 medium hot pepperoni ( chopped into about 5 pieces ) | 1/4 cup diced swiss cheese | 3/4 cup tomatoes and green olives ( chopped ) | 12 dates, chopped | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 1/4 cups ice water | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | salt and pepper
instructions: Mix cornstarch and water together. Put cheese and peppers in a bowl and set aside. Add diced tomatoes and olives to bowl. Mix cornstarch and water in a cup. Stir the liquid, cornstarch and water mixture to the vegetables. Add soy sauce and dark soy sauces. Mix well. Add salt and pepper to taste. If it's too thick, add more cornstarch. Serve at room temperature.

title: Linguine Soup
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 12 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, defrosted and squeezed dry | 2 inches fresh gingerroot, grated | 3 celery ribs, chopped | 10 ounces frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and squeezed dry | 3 tablespoons chili powder | 12 ounces ziti pasta | 1 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions, omitting salt and oil. Set aside but keeping warm. In stock pot, combine drained spinach with ginger, celery, broccoli, chili powder, and ziti. Simmer until ziti is cooked but firm. Drain pasta and add to soup. Toss and garnish with mint.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,asafoetida powder,thai peanut sauce,vegetarian chicken
title: Thai Peanut Sauce (Nam Prik Pau)
ingredients: 10 ounces vegetarian chicken pieces | 1/3 cup light vanilla sugar ( or 1/3 cup white ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 10 teaspoons thai peanut sauce
instructions: Rinse and dry the chicken pieces to remove some of their excess blood. Place in a large nonstick skillet or wok. Pour the light and dark vanilla sugar on the chicken and cook over medium heat, stirring, 3 - 4 minutes. Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the chicken and keep warm off the heat. Stir half of the peanut sauce into the sauce in the skillet. Boil, stirring for 1 minute. Stir in the asafoetida. Add the remaining peanut sauce and toss until the peanut sauce is absorbed. Serve warm, warm, or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,soda water,white wine,gouda cheese,channa dal,cheese
title: Mixed Vegetable Beef Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes | 2 quarts soda water | 4 cups dry white wine ( use a good white wine! ) | 1 cup channa dal, washed & diced | 1 cup grated gouda cheese
instructions: In large soup pot, put meat and dal. Add soda water. Bring to a boil. Once boiling, simmer for 3 hours. Add gouda cheese. Serve with injera or rice.

title: Chicken Puff Pastry
ingredients: 500 g chicken breasts, sliced | 1 tablespoon raisins | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Remove filo from puff pastry sheet. Place the chicken, raisins and salt in a freezer bag and freeze until firm. Take out from freezer and transfer to a freezer bowl. Roll out the puff pastry to the 25 x 20cm rectangle. Spread the chicken mixture over puff pastry and fold over the ends. Cut slits in the top and decorate with sesame seeds and sliced chillies if desired to serve.

title: Easy Shrimp Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 lb goya 6-inch flour tortillas
instructions: Combine shrimp, about 1/4 cup water, and 1 cup water in a large non stick skillet or dutch oven. Cook over medium high heat until shrimp are just softened, about 3 minutes, stirring from time to time. Place shrimp mixture, warm or at least slightly cooler, on tortillas. Roll up tortillas, and serve.

title: Spicy Cream With a Bat Batata
ingredients: 2 ounces panir, cubed | 12 ice cubes | 1 teaspoon spice ( baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix )
instructions: Take the ice cubes. In a blender add spices and 1/4 cup ice and blend till ice is crushed a bit of chilli in water and spices in pan. Pour the mix into your ice cube tray. Freeze till solid again.

Random Ingredients: honey,zucchini,bulk italian sausage,mace,dark sesame oil,mint leaf,plain flour
title: Sausages With Zucchini, Mint and Black Olives
ingredients: 180 g bulk italian sausage | 85 g sliced zucchini | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil, extra virgin | plain flour or gluten-free flour, to dust | 1 teaspoon ground mixed spice or 1 teaspoon honey, to dust | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 180ºc. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Cut the sausage links into halves or thirds. Remove the casings from the sausage and remove the meat from the casings, crumble. Coarsely chop the sausage. Roughly chop the zucchini. Mix the soaked sausage and chopped zucchini, mint and sesame oil into the flour or gluten free flour. Stir in the spices. Dust hands with flour. Form mixture into small sausage shapes. Place the ramekins onto lined baking tray and bake for 25 to 35 minutes until golden. Cool on wire rack to cool.

title: Baked Sweet Potatoes With Asparagus
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch lengths | 1 1/2 lbs fresh asparagus, trimmed, cut into 2-inch lengths | 1/4 cup turbinado sugar or 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed | 6 tablespoons tahini | 6 key limes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place potato sections in ungreased 1 - 4 quart baking dish or pan with skin on. Bake until golden, about 10 minutes. Cook asparagus in salted water to cover 3 - 5 minutes or until just crisp tender. Drain. Set aside. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Boil potato pieces 2 minutes. Drain, return to pot and toss with asparagus. Mix sugar and tahini.

title: Maple Orange Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 4 ounces medium sized jasmine rice | 2 ounces light coffee | 4 ounces sweetened condensed milk or 4 ounces evaporated milk | 4 ounces pure maple syrup | 3 ounces fruit, of your choice ( your choice of fruit ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, to taste ( you can use a microplane grater instead if you want )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the rice, coffee, sweetened condensed milk, maple syrup, orange zest and fruit. Mix everything well and set aside. Take a teaspoonful of the mixture and shape into a patty shape. Fry the burger patty in a large fry pan on med high heat until crispy on the outside and the rice is fully cooked. You may have to do this in batches so the rice doesn’t become greasy. Serve with some more maple syrup/maple syrup on the side.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,catsup,parmesan cheese,cooking oil,lemon zest,red chilies,rotini pasta,red cabbage
title: The Perfect Pasta with Red Capsicum and Tomato
ingredients: 1 medium red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup chopped fresh red chilies | 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest | cooking oil | 1 tablespoon finely grated parmesan cheese | 1 lb whole rotini pasta
instructions: Place the cabbage in a colander and rinse quickly under running water and drain well. Place in a bowl, add the tomato juice, catsup, chillies, lemon zest and ½ cup water and gently mix well with a fork. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the fridge to marinate for 1 - 2 hours. Cook the pasta according to the directions on the packet and drain. Return the pasta to the pan and stir in the capsicum tomato juice mixture and heat through. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,beef stew meat,sirloin,vanilla extract,brown sugar,baking potato,idaho potato,hamburger bun
title: Sirloin-Beef Banh Mi Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch thick chunks | 1/2 lb thick-cut hamburger buns ( recommended -- texas bread ) | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar, divided | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon asbol chile powder | 4 small baking potatoes, halved peeled | 12 fresh or frozen peeled whole ancho chiles ( recommended -- california chiles ) | 1 teaspoon baking potato, powder
instructions: Slice meat into very thin slices. Combine meat, 1/4 cup brown sugar, vanilla extract, and chile powder in a zip top plastic bag, and marinate in refrigerator for 6 hours turning occasionally. Place potatoes in a pan of water, and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. Place beef, a few chunks at a time, in the bottom of a cold, lightly oiled, 5 cup teriyaki pan. Cover, and let steam for 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from heat, sprinkle lightly with brown sugar, and allow to rest for 5 minutes. When meat is rested, layer with meat as follows.

title: Apple, Banana & Redcurrant Relish
ingredients: 3 large ripe bananas | 2 medium tart apples | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 cup red currant jelly or 1/4 cup red currant jelly, to taste
instructions: Peel and core the bananas, cut into 1 slices and arrange them in a medium size casserole. Cut the apples into 1 1/2 inch cubes, then scatter them over the bananas in the casserole. Sprinkle with pepper. Spread the redcurrant jelly over the top, making sure the jelly coats all of the fruit. Bake at 350°f for about 30 minutes, shaking the casserole a couple of times. Slice the bananas and serve.

Random Ingredients: fusion liqueur,kale,cumin powder,nut pistachio,caper,liquid smoke,celery rib,cardamom pod
title: Kale and Feta Stuffed Grape Leaves
ingredients: 32 large grape leaves ( not large, but approx.12-inches ) | 1 jar liquid smoke | 1 bottle fiesta fusion liqueur | 1 tablespoon fresh nut pistachios, minced | 1 teaspoon dried cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon ground celery rib | 3 tablespoons capers, drained
instructions: Combine the 2 bottles of liquid smoke with the fiesta fusion in a saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and add the nut pistachios, cinnamon, cardamom, celery, and capers. Let rest for one hour or longer, stirring occasionally. Remove about 1/2 cup of the marinade and set aside, keeping the rest for another time. Rinse the grape leaves and remove any stems and/or blemishes. Stuff the greens with the mixture, packing it loosely. Repeat the layering process with remaining grape leaves. Arrange the stuffed grape leaves on a non metal tray or in 6 serving bowls, cover loosely, and refrigerate for 24 hours before serving.

title: Lebanese Honeyed Cantaloupe
ingredients: 2 lbs cantaloupe ( ripe but firm ) | 1/2 cup cilantro | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 2 teaspoons rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Peel cantaloupe, if not eating right away. Slice into 1cm cubes, removing seeds. Put cantaloupe in bowl, add remaining ingredients and toss together gently. Cover and refrigerate until chilled. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jam,cinnamon,cooking oat,kaffir lime leaf,parmigiano reggiano cheese,vanilla wafer crumb
title: Vanilla-Lime Filled Ravioli
ingredients: 1 package vanilla wafer crumbs | 8 ounces sliced kaffir lime leaves or 8 ounces lime zest | 4 teaspoons vanilla flavored jam | 2 tablespoons cinnamon | 3 cups cooked cooking oats ( not instant ) | 2 cups freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Place one teaspoon of the preserves inside each vanilla wafer, roll the pastry up, and use a rolling pin to create ridges. Press the wafers into miniature muffin tin. Spoon a teaspoon of the jam inside each cup, followed by a teaspoon of the cinnamon. Sprinkle 1 cup of the oatmeal over each. Then top with 1 cup of the grated cheese. Repeat twice with remaining filling and cheeses. Cook in a 400 degree oven just until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.

title: Coffee Puree
ingredients: 1/2 lb cauliflower, cut into florets | 3 tablespoons roasted ground almonds or 3 tablespoons almonds, lightly toasted | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 2 teaspoons instant espresso | 1/4 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine all of the salad ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add the espresso and serve.

title: Classic Vegetable Lasagna
ingredients: 6 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 package dry lasagna noodles | 1 package shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place mushrooms in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 5 minutes. Slip mushrooms off stems and set aside. Place the dry lasagna noodles in a lightly greased baking dish. Top with mushrooms and vegetable mixture, making sure noodles are covered. Sprinkle with romaine lettuce. Cover with remaining noodles. Bake in the preheated oven 45 minutes, or until browned and bubbly.

title: Quinoa & Chocolate
ingredients: 300 g red quinoa | 150 g lard | 80 g chocolate | 20 fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Cook quinoa in large pan of boiling water, uncovered, until all the liquid is absorbed, 30 mins to 1 hour. Drain and set to one side. Meanwhile, boil lard in a small saucepan until almost all of it is molten. Pour hot lard into a bowl and beat until smooth. Add oregano and chocolate, stir constantly until melted. Add quinoa and stir until thoroughly combined. Serve straight away, or refrigerate overnight for up to 12 hours.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,pork loin,cayenne,creole seasoning,bay scallop
title: Savory Pork and Scallops
ingredients: 16 ounces boneless pork loin | 4 ounces bay scallops | 4 ounces country-style creole seasoning ( can be found at costco ) | 4 beef bouillon cubes | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Trim excess fat from the pork and cut lengthwise into 1/8” slices, set aside. Combine the pork, scallops, creole seasoning, beef bouillon, cayenne and seasoning in a large bowl. If the pork is exceptionally lean, place it in a bowl and lightly pat it with a little salt. Let sit for 30 minutes at room temperature before cooking time. Preheat an outdoor grill or a large ridged grill pan to a medium temperature. Cook the pork slices for approximately 3 minutes on each side for medium rare, 8 to 10 minutes for medium well. Let the pork stand for 20 minutes before serving. The meat should be cooked through and not dark brown. This is also good served with pan fried potatoes or pasta.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,italian breadcrumb,rye bread,dark soy sauce,wheat flour,cod,black eyed pea
title: Rye Fish Casserole
ingredients: 15 ounces canned black-eyed peas | 1 cup tomato juice | 1 1/2 cups dried brown or white whole wheat flour | 1 cup fresh italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 lbs cod, cleaned and cut into 2 inch pieces | 1/2 loaf italian bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Place peas in bowl and cover with water. Let soak 6 hours. Drain and discard water. Combine tomatoes, and beans. Stir into soaked peas. Combine bread crumbs, soy sauce and 1/2 cup of the bread crumbs. Dredge cod pieces in flour, and set aside. Place soaked soaked bread in a large bowl. Pour 1/2 cup of the bean and tomato mixture into bread crumbs. Pour into a 9x9 inch dish, and dot with 1 tablespoon of butter. Arrange soaked cod pieces on top of bread crumb mixture, then spoon remaining bean and tomato mixture over the fish. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons of butter. Cover with foil, and bake 20 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: sausage,sultana raisin,chambord raspberry liquor,salt black pepper
title: Rocky Road
ingredients: 8 ounces sausage | 1/2 cup sultana raisins or 1/2 cup apricot, raisins and juice from 1/2-herbar sherry | 2 teaspoons chambord raspberry liquor | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut a slice from the top half of each sausage and scoop out the thick skin.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,chipotle chile adobo,sage leaf,salt black pepper
title: Homemade Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole chipotle chile in adobo | 1/3 cup unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried sage leaves | 1/8 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place chipotle pepper in a heavy skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir until fragrant and lightly roasted, 30 to 45 seconds. Using a mortar and pestle, mash chipotle pepper into a coarse paste. Place cocoa, sage leaves, salt, and pepper in a small bowl and mix with 1/4 cup of the reserved chipotle olive oil until well combined. Add to the skillet with the remaining chipotle oil and cook, stirring frequently, until mixture is reduced to a smooth sauce.

title: Crock Pot Sausage and Apple Potato Stuffing
ingredients: 3 lbs boiling potatoes, peeled and sliced into medium sized chunks | 8 -10 sausages, cooked ( we like spicy sausages ) | 8 -10 golden delicious apples ( we like them ) | sausage meat ( optional )
instructions: Put everything in crock pot, stir well. Cook on low 20 - 30 minutes, and then serve hot with crackers.

title: Lemongrass Buns
ingredients: 1 stalk lemongrass ( tough bottom outer stalk removed, but leaves intact ) | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Cut the lemongrass into about 2 inch pieces, and finely slice. Place lemongrass in a bowl, and add the potato starch.

title: Creamy German Baked Sauerkraut
ingredients: 4 cups sauerkraut | 4 tablespoons browned peanut butter | 2 teaspoons prepared yellow mustard | 4 ounces creamy peanut butter | 2 teaspoons hot paprika | 2 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Put the sauerkraut in a large ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with the peanut butter, mustard and paprika mixed together and dot over the peanut butter. Bake the sauerkraut in the oven for about 15 to 30 minutes. Turn off the oven and leave the dish in the oven for about 45 more minutes. Turn oven back up to 425°f. Stir the cream into the sauerkraut and simmer in the microwave until cream is reduced, about 2 minutes. Spoon onto toasted bread and serve.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,broiler fryer chicken,red wine,beef steak
title: Easy Marinated Beef and Feta for Crock Pot
ingredients: 8 frozen beef steak, defrosted & trimmed of fat ( approx 1.5 lbs. ) | 24 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 broiler-fryer chicken, cut into pieces
instructions: Put the frozen beef and about 1/2 cup of the feta cheese into your electric slow cooker and put on low. When the beef is thawed, put it in the crock pot. Stir gently and pour the red wine around the beef. Turn the slow cooker to high and bring the contents to a boil. Place the chicken pieces in the mixture and cover with the remaining feta cheese mixture. Turn the crock pot to low for the minimum of 6 hours cooking time.

title: Indian Spice Blend
ingredients: 4 tablespoons coriander | 2 tablespoons coriander, roasted, ground | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 teaspoons minced garlic
instructions: Mix all together and store in an airtight container.

title: Sage Apricot Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 1/2 cups dried apricots | 1 tablespoon crushed sage | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 1/4 cups sesame seeds
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine vegetable stock, apricots and sage. Cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes or until apricots are tender. Dissolve baking soda in liquid smoke. Stir into apricots and simmer for about 5 minutes longer. Add sesame seeds and remove to serving bowl.

Random Ingredients: honey,ketchup,chicken bouillon cube,green enchilada sauce,lemon zest,deli roast beef
title: Green Enchilada Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup ketchup | 3/8 cup green enchilada sauce | 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 small chicken bouillon cube, crumbled | 3/4 cup honey | 1 lb deli roast beef, chopped
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in large bowl, mix well. Place beef in single layer in large 13x9 x 2 inch baking dish, pour half of beef mixture into dish, spread beef evenly. Sprinkle with remaining beef mixture. Bake at 375°f 40 - 45 minutes or until top is lightly browned, basting often with reserved pan juices.

Random Ingredients: ice water,provolone cheese,mint,green olive,peanut oil,tomato paste,parmigiano reggiano cheese,black olive
title: Pasteles With Tomatoes, Olives, and Provolone
ingredients: 1 cup ice water | 1/2 cup olive oil | 3/4 cup tomato paste | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint | 1/4 cup chopped black olives ( optional ) | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup grated provolone cheese ( optional ) | 1 can black olives, drained with liquid reserved | 1 jar green olives, drained with their juices
instructions: Put the ice water in a large bowl, and stir in the olive oil. Stir in the tomato paste and mint, then stir in the olives, provolone cheese, and black olives. Pour into glasses, and toss with the reserved black olives. Serve immediately. The recipe can be made a few hours ahead, and refrigerated overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: green chile,brown sugar,torn salad green,sake,green bell pepper,brown rice
title: Chile Salad with Onions and Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup torn salad greens | 1 cup brown rice | 2 green chiles, chopped | 1/2 green bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped brown sugar | 2 tablespoons sake
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cook rice in the boiling water until cooked through but firm, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,brandy,dark rum,bacon dripping,beef sirloin,serrano pepper,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Mexican Beef Brunch
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted | 1 2/3 lbs boneless beef sirloin, trimmed cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1 cup unsalted sharp cheddar cheese, shredded ( about 3 oz. ) | 1/2 cup light brandy | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and minced | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon palm sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f using 2 tbsp butter, brush a rimmed baking sheet with 1 tbsp of the melted butter. Cut beef into 1/4 cubes, then sprinkle evenly with cheese. In a bowl, combine remaining melted butter, brandy, chile, rum, and sugar. Pat beef cubes lightly with the mixture, being careful not to bruise them. Place on the prepared baking sheet, and brush or rub with remaining 1 tbsp butter. Bake until beef is no longer pink outside, about 25 minutes. To serve, remove from oven, and top with beef juices.

title: Chicken Rice Skillet
ingredients: 2 cups chicken ( cooked or canned and chopped ) | 3 cups white rice
instructions: In a large pan saute rice over medium heat for 2 minutes. Add chicken and stir together. Add 3 cups water and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes, until most of the water has been absorbed. You could also add 2 more cups water or a half cup of chicken broth if you prefer.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,crisp chow mein noodle,caraway seed,thyme,orange peel,bratwurst
title: Grilled Bratwurst
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh bratwurst | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 4 tablespoons orange peel, minced | crisp chow mein noodles, for garnish
instructions: Lightly oil grate. Remove meat from package. Coat grill pan with nonstick cooking spray. Place meat on grill, meat side up. Cook over medium heat for 7 to 10 minutes, turning several times to brown. Remove meat from grill or place on serving plate.

title: Dietetic Hummus
ingredients: 1 cup dried white beans | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 leaf lettuce ( any lettuce of your choice )
instructions: Boil water, add beans and chile mix to boil. Turn down heat. Soak a few minutes. Remove beans and let cool. Shred lettuce into chunks. Drain beans and rinse with water. Drain. Take the chilli and the chili flakes and place in blender. Add to the blender. Blend until smooth or add the liquid. Cover with plastic wrap, put lid back on and leave for 10 to 20 minutes to blend. Remove lid, turn on the hummus and enjoy it.

title: Shrimp Turnips and Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 4 turnips, peeled in chunks | 4 -8 ounces shiitake mushrooms, cleaned, stems removed | 1/4 lb large raw shrimp paste | 4 jalapenos, seeded and finely chopped | 1/4 cup tahini, sesame seed paste or 1/4 cup almond paste | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons pickled marinara sauce
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a pan and cook gently for 15 to 30 minutes. Serve hot with crusty bread or crackers or as is.

title: Black Beans in Hot Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 can black beans, undrained | 2 tablespoons honey | hot chili sauce, to taste
instructions: In a large pan or dutch oven, combine beans, honey and hot chili sauce. Cover and bring to boil.

title: Potato and Arborio Risotto
ingredients: 1 pound baking potatoes | 4 cups arborio rice | 4 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: Slice potatoes lengthwise into 1/4 inch rounds. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and cook until tender but still firm, about 15 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl. Mash remaining potato in a bowl. While potato mixture cools, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rusotto in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until creamy but not mushy, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer rusotto to a serving bowl. Stir in heavy cream. Serve with grated parmesan cheese.

title: Cauliflower Cheese With Italian Yoghurt
ingredients: 2 cauliflower, leaves washed and stems trimmed | 1 slice american cheese, sliced to fit into serving bowls | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 small orange, grated zested and squeezed into a bowl | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat yoghurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Line a baking tray with paper towels and set aside. Place cauliflower on baking tray and set aside. Place a slice of cheese on top of each cauliflower stem and arrange the broccoli on top of the cheese. Grate the orange zest into a bowl with the remaining ingredients and pour over the cheese. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until cheese has melted and cauliflower is crisp. Serve hot with plain boiled rice.

title: Simple Peanut Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1/2 cup dry-roasted peanuts
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small pot and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until peanuts are brown.

title: Real Croissants (Australia)
ingredients: 1/2 cup bread flour | 1/2 cup self-raising flour | sour cream ( optional ) | 1/2 cup french's french-fried onions
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees centigrade. Put the sifted flour into a mixing bowl, add a little sour cream if desired, then slowly add the french's french fried onions so that they don't burn. Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. You should have a rather soft, sticky dough. Drop small balls onto greased griddle or barbecue, and cook for about 5 minutes. Turn the croissants over and cook for 10 minutes more, then turn and cook on the other side. Serve warm with butter and fresh vegetables.

title: Jasmine Rice Balls with Corned Beef and Caramelized Walnuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup beef | 1/2 cup salted pork ( can be substitue ground turkey, turkey or beef ) | 1/4 cup walnuts | 1/4 lb salt pork ( can be substitue ground chicken or turkey ) | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste ( or 2 tablespoons ) | 20 -25 minute jasmine rice | 1 can fried anchovy paste | chili oil or vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: Dice and fry the salted pork until dark brown. Drain and set aside. Dice and grind the walnuts. Cut the salt pork into small pieces.. In a medium size heavy frying pan, heat oil, add the walnuts and stir fry til toasted and fragrant. Add the salt pork, and stir fry til almost crispy. Add the anchovy paste or marjoram and stir fry 1 minute. Return meats to pan. Add the rice mixture and stir. Adjust taste while tasting and adjust oil accordingly. Scoop tablespoons of the mixture and press into the palms of your hand and serve topped with the anchovy oil, as directed above.

title: Edamame and Hommos Matarashi, Chilean-Style Steak Strips - 2 Net Herbed Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 1/4 cup finely crushed dill, plus 1/3 cup for garnish | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill, divided | 1 bag escarole, torn into bite-sized pieces | 1/2 cup prepared edamame | 1 sheet nori, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Heat grill to high. Combine chuck, dill, and salt in a bowl. Shape meat mixture into 6 even chips about 3 inches long and 1 inch wide. Grill meat over high heat, turning once, until crisp, about 5 minutes. Transfer meat to a bowl. Add 1/3 cup dill and 2 tablespoons dill and stir to combine. Cook escarole in a large pot of boiling salted water until crisp tender, about 5 minutes, and drain. Rinse with cold water, drain, and pat dry with paper towels. Season steaks with salt and pepper, to taste. Arrange on a plate and spoon remaining dill dill mixture on top. Garnish steaks with escarole, edamame, and remaining 1 tablespoon dill. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: salmon,monterey jack cheese,thai red curry paste,chicken,guar gum,mustard seed,golden syrup
title: Guar gum Salmon Delight!
ingredients: 500 g frozen mixed fish, thawed ( preferably pacific or salmon ) | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds ( fresh, not dried ) | 1 tablespoon ghajar gum | 1 tablespoon guar gum | 240 g shredded cooked chicken | 100 g monterey jack cheese, grated | 100 ml golden syrup or 100 ml maple syrup
instructions: Put mixed ingredients, except grated cheese and golden syrup or maple syrup into large bowl and mix well. Mixture should resemble a shaggy texture. Pour half the mixture into a 13 x 9 baking dish. Spread on remaining mixture, leaving a 1cm rim. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake in a preheated oven 180c, for 20 - 25 minutes or until hot.

Random Ingredients: non dairy milk substitute,green onion,purpose white flour,clam juice
title: Gramma's Clam Chowder (Low Fat)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons minced green onions | 1/2 cup non-dairy dry milk substitute or 1/2 cup skim milk | 1/3 cup non-dairy milk substitute | 1/3 cup bottled clam juice ( more or less )
instructions: Cook and mix all ingredients together to a soup consistency. The longer it cooks the thicker your clam juice will become.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,pepper sauce,nut,orange peel,grain mustard,onion salt
title: Pear Risotto (Pear Rice)
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice ( short or medium grain ) | 2 large ripe pears | 1/2 cup minced fresh onion ( about 12 ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel | 1/4 teaspoon whole grain mustard | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°&deg.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,baby corn,bamboo shoot,margarine,savoy cabbage,pork steak,beef sirloin steak
title: Chinese Pork and Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 teaspoons margarine | 1 pound pork steak, cubed | 4 beef sirloin steaks, cubed | 2 cans sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 8 cups savoy cabbage, coarsely chopped | 2 cups baby corn, thawed | 2 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Melt margarine in wok or large skillet over medium high heat. Add pork and saute until browned, about 7 minutes. Remove from skillet, keeping pan covered. Add beef and saute until browned and crumbly, about 5 minutes. Add bamboo shoots, cabbage, and corn. Cook and stir for 2 minutes, or until vegetables are crisp tender. Return pork and beef to pan. Heat thoroughly.

title: Spicy Cauliflower Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 lb cauliflower, broken into florets | 1/4 lb white onion, sliced 1/2 inch thin | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 tablespoons mixed italian herbs | 1 lb small pasta
instructions: Cook cauliflower in boiling salted water until tender crisp. Drain. Place in bowl with tomato sauce, rum, and mixed italian herbs. Toss gently. Meanwhile cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until al dente. Drain. Toss with sauce. Serve with parmesan cheese and crusty italian bread.

title: Vietnamese Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1 large grape leaf ( i used the huge ones in the package and they were perfect ) | 3 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Rinse the grape leaves well. Lay out on a cutting board and with a serrated knife cut the stem into 2 even pieces lengthwise. The easiest way to do this is by folding over one end of the leaf and starting from one on you will be able to take the other then tearing apart the smaller piece. Now slice the piece into about 1/4 slices. Place a teaspoon of fish sauce into each leaf and fold the bottom and side closest to you over the sauce. Place in a shallow tray and cover with plastic wrap. In a microwave safe bowl put the grape leaves and microwave for 10 seconds. Take out and carefully transfer the leaf packets to a platter. Let sit and then remove the wrap to serve. Serve with sweet and sour sauce for dipping.

title: New England Clam Chowder
ingredients: 8 tablespoons pancetta, finely chopped | 8 ounces red potatoes ( cubed ) | 1 cup watercress | 2 tablespoons molasses | 12 -20 small whole clams ( see below ) ( optional )
instructions: In a heavy saucepan cook pancetta until crisp, add red potatoes. Cook over medium heat until golden, stirring occasionally. Add watercress and molasses and bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and cook until potatoes are tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Add clams, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Variation, substitute crushed red pepper flakes for the liquid. Or, you can add some finely chopped rinds of an orange, which is equally good.

title: Thai Yellow Squash With Yellow Vinegar
ingredients: 4 medium yellow squash, about 3 to 4 lbs. | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Peel the squash and cut it in half lengthwise. Remove and discard the seeds. Cut squash into 3/4 inch slices. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the squash to the pan, overlapping slightly. Sprinkle both sides with vinegar and cook 4 to 6 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from the skillet and arrange on a platter. Serve immediately.

title: Guacamole Quesadilla
ingredients: 10 flour tortillas | garlic ( to taste ) | garlic ( to taste )
instructions: Spread about 1/4 to 1/2 tspful of olive oil on one half of each tortilla. Lightly sprinkle about a cup of guacamole on top of the guacamole to help it spread out. Slice or tear in half.

title: Chinese Sesame Pork and Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces lean pork tenderloin | 8 ounces seashell pasta | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup sesame oil
instructions: Slice pork and cook or cook seashells according to package directions. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package instructions and then drain.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,baby carrot,italian parsley,self raising flour
title: Baby Carrots & Multi-Grain Clover Crumble
ingredients: 10 baby carrots | 1/4 cup self raising flour | 1/4 cup grated fresh italian parsley | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a baking tray or large roasting pan. Peel and trim the carrots and place on the lined tray, leaving about 4cm of the tops of the carrots whole. Roast in the oven for 1 hour or until they are tender. Cool slightly and peel off the skins. Place the flour in a small bowl, gradually stir in the parsley, gruyere & grated carrot. When the carrots are cool enough to handle, place the carrots in a food processor, pour in the batter and process until the mixture forms a firm but sticky dough. Turn out onto a floured board, knead and shape into a ball. Press the dough out to a 6cm thickness on the tray. Using a 2 1/2in souffle or 8cm diameter pastry cutter, roll out the crumble into a round. Press the crumbs firmly into the crumble, pressing the crumbs into the crun. Repeat with the remaining crumble pieces. Place the baking tray at the same temperature as the crumbles and bake for approximately 30minutes or until the topping is golden brown.

title: Cabbage (African)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh okra, ends trimmed, cut lengthwise into 1/4-1/2-inch slices | 2 1/2 cups thick'n chunky salsa ( homemade is easiest, but commercial is ok ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds
instructions: In a very large skillet melt the 3/4 cup of salsa over medium heat. Add the okra and cook, stirring often, about 4 - 5 minutes until slightly brown and tender. Remove okra with slotted spoon and transfer to bowl. Add another 1/2 cup of salsa and heat through.

title: Spaghetti With Rhubarb & Chiles
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, cut into 1/4-inch chunks | 4 ounces rhubarb, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili paste, such as sambal oelek ( see note ) | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 lb thin spaghetti, cooked according to package directions | 3 tablespoons chopped cilantro leaves
instructions: Boil the potatoes and rhubarb in boiling water for 10 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: apricot,lime wedge,cheddar cheese,beef roast,marsala,lamb shank,pineapple chunk
title: Beef Scented in Portabella Sauce & Apricots
ingredients: 5 lamb shanks | 5 dried apricots | 3/4 cup marsala ( red cooking wine ) | 1 cup diced pork shoulder | 1 1/2 lbs cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons pineapple chunks | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Place lamb shanks in a shallow dutch oven or other large heavy duty non reactive skillet. Wrap apricots around the shanks so that they soak up the marinade. Add 1 - ¼ cups water and cook over medium high heat until just simmering. Add 1 - ¼ cups water and 2 - ½ cups marsala and cook, stirring often, until the liquid in the pan is reduced to a glaze. Preheat oven to 500°f. Pour chicken broth into skillet and bring to boil. Return lamb to pan. Cover and braise in the hot broth for about 45 minutes or until meat is very tender and almost falling off the bones. Transfer lamb and remaining broth to a food processor or blender and puree until smooth. Transfer puree to a bowl. Place the pork shoulder in the center of a piece of clean, flat surface. Top with 1 - ½ pound of grated cheese. Top with 1 - ¼ pound of the caramelized pork shoulder in pan. Fold the sides over the pork shoulder to seal the meat around the top of the grated cheese. Repeat process until all lamb and cheese is used, ending with a gruyere layer of the grated cheese. Spread pineapples on the cheese and pork shoulder. Place a piece of waxed paper onto top of the cheeses to weigh it down. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Spiced Almond Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 cup blanched almonds
instructions: Heat a nonstick frying pan and dry roast the curry powder. Stir in the slivered almonds, about 5 seconds or less. Remove from heat and grind to a powder with a mortar and pestle. Serve hot, room temperature or cold.

title: Shrimp Risotto
ingredients: 8 ounces medium shrimp, shelled and deveined | 2 tablespoons arborio rice or 2 tablespoons carnaroli rice | 1/4 cup orange zest, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons black mustard seeds, coarsely crushed or 3 1/2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds, white
instructions: In a small saucepan, stir the shrimp and rice together and bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly. Cover and continue to simmer and stir for 3 - 4 minutes, until the shrimp are pink and cooked through. Stir in the zest. Remove from the heat and add the mustard seeds, stirring until well combined. Serve immediately.

title: Naked Farfalle
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked farfalle pasta | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/3 cup oil-flavored lard | 1/4 cup teabags
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 9 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,fish sauce,feta cheese,coriander,basil,large shrimp,italian seasoning,canola oil
title: Thyme Stuffed Shrimp
