ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled | 1/8 cup coriander, chopped fresh | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 garlic fresh thyme sprig, tied with kitchen string | 1 tablespoon canola oil or 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 2 teaspoons fish sauce
instructions: Toss shrimp with coriander, basil, italian seasoning, garlic and thyme in a bowl. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add shrimp to skillet in single layer. Cook, turning once until just pink on outside and just cooked through, about 6 minutes. Sprinkle with feta and fish sauce. Serve warm.

title: Broccoli Cheese Parcel(Vegan)
ingredients: 1 cup broccoli ( about 1.75 ) | 2/3 cup fat free greek yogurt | 8 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Wash & steam broccoli until tender. Cook as per directions on the package. Place phyllo pastry sheets sheet on a flat surface sprayed with pam cooking spray. Top the sheets with 1/4 of the broccoli on the phyllo sheet. Place another sheet on top the first. Top with the remaining 1/4 of the broccoli. Poke the phyllo with a fork & bake for 10 - 15 minutes in a 350 degree oven. These will be served hot or cold. Serve with greek yogurt & enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,carrot juice,white vinegar,burgundy wine,onion,herbes de provence,fennel seed
title: Mint Carrots
ingredients: 2 lbs small carrots ( about 24 ) | 1 small onion | 4 mint leaves | 2 -3 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1/2 cup burgundy wine | 1/3 cup white vinegar | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Peel carrots and cut into 1 inch chunks. Place in a 4 - 6 quart boiling water dutch oven over medium heat and slowly bring to a boil. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the cooking water, and transfer carrots to a plate. Discard remaining cooking water. Cool for 15 minutes. Peel onion and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces. In a large deep skillet, combine 2 - 4 teaspoons herbes de provence, burgundy wine, vinegar, fennel seed, and remaining 2 teaspoons herbes de provence. Cook over high heat, stirring often, until alcohol cooks off. Add carrots and onion.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,garam masala,vegetable,cream mushroom soup,red chilies,mascarpone cheese
title: Mascarpone Beef Curry
ingredients: 1 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into chunks | 1 can mixed vegetables, cut up | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 red chilies, finely chopped or 1 green chili, finely chopped
instructions: In one bowl, mix the mascarpone cheese with the garam masala. In separate bowl, stir fry meat in one tbsp of vegetable oil until browned. Add half of this onion and half of the can of soup to the meat. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in remaining soup and chilies and simmer another 5 minutes. Serve over basmati rice.

title: Chocolate Lemon Rice
ingredients: 5 1/2 cups cooked rice | 7 1/2 ounces shaved provolone cheese | 7 1/2 ounces lemonade ( lemon flavored ) | fennel, slices to garnish | 1 semi-sweet chocolate
instructions: Combine rice, cheese and lemonade. Stir gently until well blended. Garnish with fennel and chocolate, stir gently. Serve cold. Tip, you can even decorate the rice with sliced lemons. Note, you can also add crushed or flaked cookies when serving the rice. For instance, for a crispier, more moist rice, add a couple of tablespoons of melted chocolate.

title: Quick Seafood Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked macaroni | 1/2 lb butterflied cod | 1 large white onion, chopped | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 cup salsa fresca | 1/4 cup chopped hazelnuts | 1/4 cup thinly sliced watercress
instructions: Cut cod into pieces or cut other larger piece of fish. Cook cod until opaque in center. Drain. Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add onions and cook until tender. Add half and half and bring to boil, stirring. Add salsa fresca and heat through. Drain cod and place in a larger bowl. Drizzle with seafood sauce and toss with warm sauce until coated and heated through. Garnish with hazelnuts and watercress.

title: Potato Artichoke and Parsnips
ingredients: 5 parsnips, peeled and sliced | 10 ounces cooked bacon drippings | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts | 10 ounces canned button mushrooms
instructions: Preheat bacon drippings in a large skillet or dutch oven. Stir in mushrooms and parsnips.

title: Roast Beef, Sweetcorn and Pickled Beets
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons grated lime zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons oil | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup canned sweetcorn | 1/2 lb thinly sliced lean roast beef | 2 medium firm fresh sweetcorn, scrubbed, cut into 1/4 inch slices | guacamole, garnish
instructions: Mix the 1/2 cup plain yogurt, lime zest, oil, chicken bouillon and sweetcorn in medium bowl.

title: Beef Steak with Broccoli Skaw
ingredients: 2 beef steaks | 2 tablespoons butter | 0.75 packet broccoli slaw mix | 1/2 cup picante sauce
instructions: Brown steak. Remove from pan. Melt butter in pan. Add brocolli and broccoli slaw.

title: Kidney Beans and Cheese
ingredients: 2 cans red kidney beans, drained | 2 lbs velveeta cheese, cubed | 3 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together. Spoon into hot frypan.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,macadamia nut,vegetable stock,wheat penne,water,dill,yellow bell pepper,coconut milk
title: Bean Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat penne | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 1/2 cups white macadamia nuts | 1 1/2 cups yellow bell peppers, chopped | 1 can coconut milk | 3 1/2 cups water | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: In a large pot over high heat, combine the macadamia nuts and the vegetable stock and bring to a boil. Place the penne in the pot and cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the bell peppers and cook 1 minute longer. Add the coconut milk, water, dill, cayenne powder, and the ground nuts. Add the pasta and cook over high heat to desired tenderness. Remove from the heat and let cool slightly before serving.

title: Shrimp With Green Curry Paste
ingredients: 1 lb medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon green curry paste | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs
instructions: Combine the shrimp, cornstarch, curry paste and thyme in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour, or until shrimp have turned pink. Place shrimp onto a lightly oiled rimmed baking sheet. Bake at 425 degrees for 10 minutes, or until shrimp are just cooked through. Serve over rice.

title: Hot Chili Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra-jalapeno, very finely minced | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients very well together.

title: Oystershell Red Wine Oyster Flavoured Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bibb lettuce | 1 cup of fresh mint | 1 cup bibb lettuce | 2 tablespoons rosemary | 1/2 cup white drinking white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Wash and dry the lettuce. Chop the leaves separately and put into a large bowl. In a small bowl, mix together the remaining ingredients. With a pastry blender or two knives, cut up the ingredients at an angle to create a thick dressing. Pour dressing over the lettuce and toss to coat. Refrigerate for at least one hour to allow flavors to develop.

title: Horseradish Cream for Filling
ingredients: 1 pint matzo meal | 1 cup dry wine | 1 cup prepared horseradish
instructions: Combine matzo meal, wine and horseradish in a heavy saucepan. Heat, stirring until boiling. Reduce heat, simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in nut paste, let cool to room temperature, covered. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,lavender,scotch bonnet pepper,anise seed,italian flat leaf parsley,corn oil,jalapeno pepper,garam masala
title: Spicy Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil ( or veg oil ) | 1/2 teaspoon aise seed, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon lavender, crushed | 1 can brussels sprouts, rinsed and quartered | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon ground aniseed seed | scotch bonnet pepper, sliced ( or habanero pepper ) | 1 teaspoon minced italian flat leaf parsley ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil over medium heat in a large saucepan and add salt and pepper to taste. Add the crushed aniseed seeds and saute, stirring continuously about 5 minutes, until aromatic and just starting to color. Transfer the spiced oil to a small bowl. Add the sprouts and toss to coat well, then season with the spices and chill for another 5 minutes. Sprinkle with the scotch bonnet peppers and fresh parsley, if using, and serve.

title: Chef John's Gnocchi
ingredients: 5 pounds ricotta cheese | 4 cups shredded potato | 4 cups shredded swiss fried potatoes
instructions: Blend ricotta cheese, and 2 cups shredded potato in a blender until smooth. Pour the potato mixture into a large pot, and stir in the swiss' fried potatoes. Cook over medium heat about 30 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and gnocchi float to the top. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Grilled Shiitake Mushrooms and Chipotle Pepper Chips
ingredients: 1 lb fresh shiitake mushroom, stems removed, caps sliced | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Grill the mushrooms on the grill or on a baking sheet until the skin is evenly burned and the flesh is slightly browned and blistered. Remove the mushrooms from the grill and set aside to cool slightly. Wrap each mushroom in plastic wrap and refrigerate until fully softened, at least 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small skillet, toast the cumin and chipotle peppers over medium heat, stirring frequently, for several minutes or until fragrant and slightly darker in color. Remove from heat and cool. Peel the caps and slice them thickly on a mandoline or grater. Reserve the juices in the skillet. Preheat the grill to high. Arrange the mushrooms on a grill rack on the skillet, close the cover and grill until very charred and softened, about 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the mushrooms to a plate. Remove the chipotle pepper from the grill and transfer to a small bowl. Dice the chipotle pepper and stir it into the mushrooms and serve immediately.

title: Easy Vietnamese Fish Cakes
ingredients: 500 g fresh firm fish such as halibut ( or cod ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 spring onion, chopped ( scallions )
instructions: Rinse/pat fish dry with paper towel. Cut into cubes. Combine all ingredients with hands. Form small patties, about 1 5cm in diameter. Bake at about 180c for approx 15 mins or until cooked through. Serve with thai jasmine or thai asian dipping sauce.

title: Lazy String Beans (Green Beans With Glaze)
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh green beans | glaze
instructions: Cook the green beans as directed on the package usually about 6 minutes, and keep the pan over a low heat until the beans are just tender. Drain and rinse them, then toss with a few tablespoons of glaze. Taste to see if you want to use your special glaze. If not, sprinkle with a few fresh dill seeds before serving.

Random Ingredients: white onion,white wine,black bean,petite pea,green olive,sumac,tortilla chip,shrimp
title: Black Bean, Shrimp and White Onion Soup
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen petite pea | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 8 ounces shrimp ( large cooked peeled shrimp ) | 2 cans white wine | 1 white onion ( halved lengthwise, halved, thickly sliced ) | 1/4 cup green olives ( pitted, coarsely chopped ) | corn tortilla chips, to serve ( optional ) or avocado, slices to serve ( optional )
instructions: Cook frozen petit fours according to package instructions. Drain and rinse beans.

title: Easy Mexican Beer Can Chicken
ingredients: 1 can beer | 1 ounce chunky salsa | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock ( i use a little of each )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f pour the beer into a 12x9 inch pan. Add the salsa and white pepper.

title: Homemade Taco Seasoning Mix (Or Mix Substitute)
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili seasoning mix ( to taste ) | 1 envelope dried chili seasoning mix, i prefer pampered chef brand
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Mix all ingredients together until you have the right texture to store in an appropiately sized airtight container, then coat a cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray. Spray top each cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray and pour mixture over cookie sheets. Do not mix until coated, or dough will stick to cookie sheets. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes. Let cool slightly and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,asian chili sauce,cooking spray,sauce,seasoning,raspberry jam,parsley sprig
title: Raspberry and Barley Chili Barley Spread
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 1/4 cups pearl barley | 1/2 cup asian chili sauce ( sriracha as needed ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons raspberry jam, softened | 1 teaspoon dried parsley sprig ( or 1 teaspoon dried parsley ) | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning | sauce ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375f degrees. Spray large baking sheet with cooking spray. Place barley in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,cannellini bean,lemon juice,tomato soup,cannellini,romano cheese,ancho chile
title: Tomato White Chili
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed ( white kidney beans such as cannellini beans ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon oregano or 1 teaspoon other dried chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( optional ) | grated romano cheese or parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours or on high 4 to 5 hours. Serve with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,molasses,coriander powder,white pepper,italian seasoning,golden syrup
title: Asian BBQ Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon molasses ( you may use a combination of both if you want ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce, i prefer thai | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon golden syrup
instructions: Prepare a grill and place your fillets on it. I recommend medium high heat or your choice of heat. In a small bowl mix the coconut milk, molasses & fish sauce together then set aside. In a small dish, mix together the spices. Add the spices to the coconut milk with the molasses/maple mixture and mix well. Remove your fillets from the grill and place on high heated grill. Grill approximately 3 - 4 minutes per side, or until fish flakes with fork. Add more seasonings if desired. To serve, place fish on a serving plate and cover with your choice of toppings. Serve with pan fried rice.

Random Ingredients: golden brown sugar,picante sauce,sage,onion soup mix,california chile pod,cottage cheese,lamb
title: Picante Chili
ingredients: 2 pounds ground lamb | 1 pound california chile pods, seeded and diced | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 8 ounces cottage cheese | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Brown the lamb in the hot skillet, breaking it into crumbles as it cooks. Drain all excess grease. Stir in the chile pods and onion soup mix. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer about 30 minutes. Remove and discard the chile pods, onion soup mix, picante sauce, cottage cheese, brown sugar and sage. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes, or until the chili has thickened. Serve over enchiladas.

title: Quick and Easy No-Melt Pepperoni Eggnog
ingredients: 1 jar refrigerated egg yolks ( about 7 ) | 3 ounces sliced pepperoni, sliced | 12 ounces cold no-melt pepperoni, sliced | 2/3 cup ice water
instructions: Separate yolks from refrigerator. Place egg yolks in container with cold water. Cut slices of pepperoni in half lengthwise, then cut into 1/4 inch strips. Mix pepperoni pieces, egg yolks and pepperoni strips in bowl. Stir well to blend. Cover container and refrigerate until slightly chilled, at least one hour. Add ice water during last 5 minutes of freezing.

Random Ingredients: cashew,chili paste,coriander powder,beef liver,self rising flour,aubergine
title: Mughlai Kebab
ingredients: 500 g beef liver | 1 large aubergine | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander powder | 3 tablespoons finely chopped cashews | 3 tablespoons chili paste | 1/4 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Cut the liver into cubes with a knife or cleaver. Peel the aubergine, then cut into small slices with a vegetable peeler. Halve, core, then cut into small cubes, then coat in the chopped coriander, cashews, chilli paste and flour. Dip the liver cubes into the batter and fry the cubes in the oil. Put them in a serving dish and serve topped with fresh coriander flakes.

title: Sauce Golden Syrup for Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 8 ounces hot sauce | 2 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Make and pour sauerkraut into a mixing bowl and stir it thoroughly before opening the bottle. Pour hot sauce over it and stir thoroughly. Place chicken kebabs on a rack so that it is completely coated with sauce, cover, and refrigerate overnight. Allow the flavors to develop and come together before barbecuing.

Random Ingredients: baby corn,rice wine vinegar,chili sauce,romaine lettuce,gingerroot,yellow bell pepper,hellmann mayonnaise
title: Rice Wine Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup hellmann's mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 tablespoon garlic rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon grated gingerroot ( or 1 tsp. freshly grated ginger ) | 4 romaine lettuce, cut in 1-inch pieces | 3 cups baby corn, halved ( or 1 can corn, drained ) | 2 yellow bell peppers, cut in 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the mayonnaise, chili sauce, garlic and ginger until smooth and creamy, about 2 - 3 minutes. Mix in the romaine and baby corn. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve or place in the refrigerator and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Romaine with Whole Wheat Crackers
ingredients: 1 whole wheat bagel, bagel preferred | 1 tablespoon dried celery | romaine lettuce
instructions: Split bagel in half lengthwise. Open both halves, then cut each half into 4 pieces. Lay one piece of bagel on counter top. Place celery in bagel, then spread on top of celery. Then top with another piece of bagel to form a triangle. Then press each triangle with fingers on the bagel. This will make it easier to roll. Warm the bagel on the stove top until it becomes light golden brown in color from celery sticks, and crispy. Turn and brown other side while rolling.

title: Italian Croutons
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 cup seasoned croutons
instructions: In a medium saucepan over low heat, melt the shortening. Remove from the heat, and stir in the stock. Mix in the seasoned croutons and mix carefully to coat. Cover and refrigerate while croutons are cool and firm.

Random Ingredients: thyme leave,egg white,jalapeno pepper,tomato puree,mayonnaise,swiss cheese
title: Hot Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 large tomatoes, sliced almost in half lenghtwise ( about 5 ounces each ) | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 2 1/2 teaspoons jalapeno pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leave | 1 -2 teaspoon finely shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Cut out the sides of the tomatoes. Scoop out about 1/2 inch of tomato flesh from between the tomatoes to make 1 1/2 inch shells, then finely mince. Place the minced tomato in a shallow bowl. Combine the mayonnaise, tomato puree, jalapeno, thyme and most of the cheese in a small bowl and blend well. Stuff inside of the tomato shells. Sprinkle each serving with the remaining cheese. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,mexican cheese,sauce,vegetable shortening
title: Quick Pressing Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1 tablespoon hot sauce, or other hot sauce such as tabasco | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder
instructions: Cut cheese and shortening into 2 1/2 inch cubes. Melt cheese and shortening in a heavy saucepan over medium low heat. Cook and stir until melted, about 5 minutes. Stir hot sauce into melted cheese mixture.

title: Polenta - Mexican Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 3 cups very coarse polenta | 3 1/2 tablespoons sugar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped habanero pepper
instructions: In a medium saucepan, stir polenta and sugar together over low heat, until bubbling and thickens a little bit. The more you stir the polenta, the softer the polenta will be. Once it’s thick and bubbling, stir in the habanero.

title: Perfect English Breakfast for One
ingredients: 1 slice whole wheat bread | 2 teaspoons instant tea, or other herbal brewed tea
instructions: Toast the bread in a low oven or fry in the microwave, you could toast it a little before adding anything else. Spread the tea on the toast and sprinkle tea leaves on it. Eat..

title: Quark Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamari | 3 tablespoons golden raisins | 3 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1 tablespoon gluten free goat's milk quark cheese | cucumber sticks or celery
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and toss well. This can be served cold or room temperature.

title: Crab Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon crabmeat, preferably imitation
instructions: Combine vinegar, pepper and crab in a small bowl and mix well.

title: Mascarpone Cheese Pizza
ingredients: 500 g mascarpone cheese | 1 jar pizza sauce ( prepared )
instructions: Combine mascarpone cheese and pizza sauce in a bowl. Pour mixture onto a pizza base that has been refrigerated for at least 8 hours or up to 2 days. Slice & serve immediately.

title: Dried Peas in Sugar
ingredients: 2 packages frozen baby peas, thawed | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/8 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place dried peas, confectioners' sugar, and allspice in a shallow baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 15 minutes.

title: Peanuts, Avocado and Cremini Mushroom Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 orange bell pepper, finely chopped | 250 g cremini mushrooms, finely chopped | 125 g light bread flour | 1 tablespoon bread flour | 100 g peanuts, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190c or 180c if using baking paper, then grease a 25cmx20cm pizza pan with butter and dust with flour. In a large bowl, combine the peppers, mushrooms, bread flour and peanuts. Add the parsley and mix to combine. Pour this mix into the pizza pan and spread it carefully so the crust doesn't stick to the base. Cook for 30 - 40 minutes or until the base is golden brown. Allow to cool for 5 - 10 minutes before cutting and serving, or alternatively serve with tomato and mint sauce. This pizza is also good with lettuce and greens.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,salt,pork mince,bread flour,prosciutto,red pepper sauce,shallot,egg white
title: Balsamic Crusted Pork Loaf
ingredients: 600 g bread flour ( all purpose or all of the gluten-free bread flour ) | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon salt | 400 g pork mince ( lean ) | 2 tablespoons shallots ( finely chopped ) | 2 teaspoons good red hot pepper sauce ( or more to taste ) | 3/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons prosciutto ( finely chopped )
instructions: Note 1, i have deliberately made this recipe with pork mince it needs work as you can always make your own. Preheat oven to 200c, 425f or gas mark lightly grease a baking sheet. Place the flour, egg white, salt and pepper in the bowl of a food processor and process until the mixture comes together. Add the pork mince and shallots and process until almost smooth. Then pour through a fine mesh sieve. Add pepper sauce and vinegar. Process until mixture is the consistency of coarse cream. Pour into a well greased 20 x 30cm loaf tin and smooth out the top. Cut a few slits in the top and using a skewer, score into the top of the loaf. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes until the top is golden brown. Allow the loaf to cool in the tin for 10 - 15 minutes before turning out onto a large platter. Remove the foil and place a slice of bread on top. The slices should hold together without falling apart. Slice into slices when cooled and serve.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,butterscotch pudding mix,chili,bitter melon,mushroom,kaffir lime leaf,asparagus spear,cilantro leaf
title: Gourmet Noodle Dish
ingredients: 1 package asparagus spears | 1 package gochujahtoasted bitter melon | 1 package butterscotch instant pudding mix | 6 tablespoons canola oil | 1 lb mushroom ( baby portobello, shitake, oyster, shiitake, shitake ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili, sriracha | 1/8 cup cilantro leaf, chopped | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Chop bitter melon lengthwise and cut into 5 pieces lengthwise. Set aside. Wash and slice mushrooms. Slice bitter melon crosswise into 5 sections. Wrap in towel and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large skillet. Sautee mushrooms for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. In medium bowl, mix together the remaining ingredients and stir to blend well. Add vegetables and stir to mix well. Divide mixture evenly among serving bowls. Sprinkle bitter melon pieces on top and serve. Salsa,. Chop cilantro and sprinkle over dish before serving. You can also use julienned pickled peppers and/or scallions.

title: Spanish Rice and Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup risotto rice, uncooked ( i prefer basmati rice ) | 1 -2 chili pepper, fresh and thinly sliced | 1 -2 cup grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place rice in a casserole bowl, pour in a little water, stir to loosen, then place in preheated oven. Bake, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon, until rice is tender. Meanwhile, saute chili peppers in a little oil for two minutes. Add rice, chili peppers to taste, and mix thoroughly, cooking for three more minutes. The idea is to coat with the rice while it cooks, not to leave it sticking if the water doesn't fully absorb the rice. Remove from oven, place cheese on top, and return to oven for 5 minutes, or until cheese melts or is golden.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,garam masala,ice water,garam masala powder,tomato juice
title: Easy Pita Pizza
ingredients: 0.5 frozen pizza crust | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/4 cup ice water
instructions: Mix everything together except for the pizza dough and roll up as you would like with your rolling pin. Place on pizza stone and top with your prepared pizza sauce and bake.

title: Pasta With Mustard Seeds and Bok Choy on the Barbie
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta or 500 g other short hollow pasta | 1 - 2 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 150 g bok choy, chopped into 4cm pieces ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons fresh pecans or 2 tablespoons walnut pieces
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to the boil. Meanwhile, place the saffron in a mortar and crush with a pestle until smooth. Add a few tablespoons water to dissolve the saffron.

Random Ingredients: tea,hot red pepper flake,chili bean,spring onion,horseradish,cayenne,baguette,hard egg
title: Chilli Bean and Eggs Sandwiches
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled halved lengthways | 5 spring onions, cut into thin diagonal strips, white and green parts kept separate | 1 -2 tablespoon grated horseradish | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons dried chili beans, crushed | 1 1/2 cups canned whole canned corned chili beans, drained ( or drained canned whole chard ) | 2 tablespoons strong tea | crackers or baguette, to serve | cayenne, to serve
instructions: Place the eggs in a medium sized bowl, sprinkle with salt, and mash with a fork until well combined and well mixed. Place the spring onions, horseradish, hot red pepper flakes, chili beans, and a little cold water in a small frying pan over medium heat. Simmer gently, stirring, for about a minute. Add the eggs and stir vigorously. Cook for 2 minutes, stir the mixture again, and remove from the heat. Cover the bowl with a kitchen towel, and set aside for 30 minutes. Meanwhile in a small bowl combine the corned chard with the tea. Drain the chard, if necessary, and divide among the 6 serving plates. Add a couple of drops of the tea, if necessary. To serve spread some bread or crackers on the toast, then spoon the egg mixture over to make 2 or 3 sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke flavoring,coffee,chili oil,saffron strand,chipotle chile adobo,asafoetida powder
title: Cafe Rio Cafe Instant coffee
ingredients: 1 cup strong coffee | 1/2 cup chili oil ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand, crushed ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons saffron liquid smoke flavoring | 1 dash asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo ( optional )
instructions: Put coffee, chili oil, saffron, and liquid smoke in a blender and purée until smooth. Pour into a mug, add the chipotle chile, and stir.

title: Cansalat  (Curried Beans & Prunes in Foil)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pepitas ( dried prunes ) | 1 can cannellini beans or ( 19 ounce ) can kidney beans, undrained | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry powder | 3/4 teaspoon tarragon | flour, to dust
instructions: Wash the beans and prunes together throughly. Soak prunes until warm. Drain. Boil for 5 minutes until all water disappears. Add curry powder, tarragon and beans. Season with salt to taste. Toss well. Cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes, or until beans are tender.

title: Simple Sherry Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 cup heavy double cream | 2 red onions, finely sliced
instructions: Heat sesame oil in small saucepan over low heat. Add onions. Cook, stirring occasionally for 8 - 10 minutes, until golden. Cool slightly. Whisk in double cream. Pour over salad greens, mix well.

title: Parmigiana's Macaroni With Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1/2 cup gorgonzola | 1 cup dry macaroni | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1/2 orange, juice of | black olives ( optional ) or red pepper slices ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling, salted water until al dente, drain and keep warm. Add gorgonzola to pasta water and mix together, set aside. Pour orange juice, lemon juice and orange juice into the pasta mixture and mix well.

title: Ranchero's Spicy Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 lb cabbage, shredded | 1 can rotel tomatoes, undrained | 1/2 cup superfine sugar
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cabbage, tomatoes and sugar.

title: Lomo Saltado (Cuban Bread)
ingredients: 1 cup fresh parsnip | 1/8 cup dried yeast | 3 -4 lbs boneless pork loin roast
instructions: Soak the parsnips in water for 10 min and drain. Remove the parsnips from the water and then peel and grate them into a blender. Mix the parsnips, yeast, parsley, and the meat together and let proof for 90 minutes in a warm. Place oven on broil high. Turn the temperature to 400 degrees. Pour the pork loin roast in and spread out until the loin is about 1/4 thick. Place the roasting pan on top and let it warm in the oven for 30 - 45 minutes. Slice off the fat, remove any fat around the pan, and then brush with olive oil. Continue to baste with a thick layer of olive oil every 30 - 40 minutes until there is no more liquid remaining.

title: Aussie Sausages & Cabbage from My Delight
ingredients: 8 links sausages | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220c/455f/gas mark wash and drain the sausages. Cut the sausages into chunks about 2 - 4 in long. Heat a large non stick frypan, and cook the sausages on one side until almost cooked. Turn them over. Add some vanilla sugar. Turn down heat and leave for a few minutes to draw out the juices. Place them on a plate and leave to cool. I like to make them with my food processor, but if you don't bother the time, feel free and put some into ramekin dishes and put in the fridge when cooled off. To serve, just pop them back into the pan with plenty of warm milk for a tasty gravy to serve alongside.

title: Pasta with Arugula Mushroom & Tequila
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups arugula, leaves | 1 -2 lb fresh oyster mushrooms or 1 -2 lb fresh cremini mushroom, sliced | 1/2 cup tequila | 2 cups rigatoni pasta ( or your favorite )
instructions: Put a large pot of water on the stove to boil. Put in the mushrooms and just heat them until softened. Drain mushrooms and set aside. Put some of the arugula leaves and one mushrooms into a food processor to get a uniform color or you can mix it with a bunch of fresh or canned mushrooms. Pour a generous amount of tequila into a big pan and get a bit of your arugula or cretanime leaves added to it. Add some arugula/cretanime leaves to it. Add a couple tablespoons of tequila to the pan. Add rigatoni to the pan and gently toss to coat with the tequila. If you've got a tortellini maker, transfer to the maker as per the manufacturer's instructions. Drain rigatoni as per manufacturer's instructions.

title: Pasta With Potato and Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta, small shape ( bowtie shape ) | 8 ounces assorted fresh vegetables, chopped ( any vegetable you like ) | 2 -4 cups mashed potatoes
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water according to package instructions. While the pasta is cooking, combine the mashed potatoes and vegetables. Mix well and add the pasta. When pasta is done, drain and mix well. Garnish with chopped fresh basil and a slice or two of cheese. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,garam masala,caper,double cream,yeast,lemon juice zest
title: Creamy Onion Disson Vinaigrette
ingredients: 500 ml vinaigrette, vinaigrette ( homemade or prepared, see note below ) | 25 ml dried yeast | 5 ml garam masala | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 900 ml veal stock | 1 tablespoon capers
instructions: In a saucepan, dissolve the yeast in the hot vinaigrette. Add the garam masala, lemon juice and zest and simmer for a few minutes. Add the veal, increase the heat and simmer until the meat is very tender. Add the capers and cook 1 min. Stir well to blend. Transfer the meat to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and place in the fridge to cool, about 3 hours.

title: Tiny Spritz N' Dirty Leprechaun
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder ( or to taste ) | 1/3 cup ground roasted chicken | 1 tablespoon chocolate-covered cherries | 1/2 cup butternut squash, peeled and grated | 1 pinch chili flakes, if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f. In a small bowl, stir together espresso powder and ground chicken. Add roasted, cherries and squash and drizzle mixture over mixture. Squash should be moist but not soupy. Transfer to a baking tray. Bake until top is lightly browned around edges. Cool slightly. Spoon on a drizzle of chocolate and garnish with a pinch of chili flakes if desired.

Random Ingredients: white wine,date,parchment paper,white balsamic vinegar,nori,chili pepper flake,red curry paste
title: Spicy Date Roll
ingredients: 2 ounces red curry paste | 5 ounces dates, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 4 tablespoons white wine | 1/4 teaspoon chat chili pepper flakes | 4 sheets nori | 1 white balsamic vinegar, as needed
instructions: Mix red curry paste, dates, white balsamic vinegar, white wine, chat chille and chili flakes together. Soak nori in vinegar for at least an hour before rolling it into balls. Roll each piece in either balsamic sugar or white balsamic vinegar. Arrange dates at the top of each portion of nori and roll up jelly roll style. Place skewers on a tray or cookie sheet. Cover the roll with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least one hour, or overnight. Slice in half and serve.

title: Amaretto Spice Mix
ingredients: 1 cup amaretto or 1 cup almond liqueur | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger powder
instructions: Place all ingredients into a zip top bag. Add 3/4 cup of ice. Refrigerate in a covered container for about 3 to 4 hours. Enjoy.

title: Mango, Goats Cheese and Banana Pepper Lasagna
ingredients: 400 g mascarpone cheese | 100 g crumbled goat cheese | 2 bananas peppers, diced | 1/2 cup dried coconut | 1 teaspoon crushed dried mango | 30 g dry roasted salted rice salt | 60 g parchment paper | 1 pinch finely ground mace
instructions: Place the mascarpone, goat cheese, banana pepper, dried mango, roasted salted rice, mace and freshly ground roasted paprika and freshly ground black pepper in a microwave safe bowl. Lightly grease a lasagne pan and arrange the lasagne sheets in the pan. Place over a medium high heat and heat for a minute or two on each side until the cheeses are melted and bubbling. Remove from the heat and cover the lasagne sheets to keep warm. Sprinkle with remaining paprika. To freeze, bake for 20 - 30 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,italian salad dressing,turnip,pumpkin pie spice,bread flour,spinach,berbere
title: Turnip, Pumpkin and Spinach Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips, peeled, quartered and coarsely grated | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1 cup crumbled fresh spinach | 2 teaspoons italian salad dressing | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1 tablespoon bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried berbere
instructions: Place turnips into a large pot. Add the broth, spinach, dressing, pumpkin pie spice and bread flour. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 50 minutes or until tender. Stir in the berberre.

title: Mango Chutney enchiladas
ingredients: 1 container mango chutney | 1 package dry dry enchilada mix | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Blend mangos with dry enchilada mix in a bowl with a wire whisk until thoroughly combined. Pour sauce into a saucepan and stir in mango chutney, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil over medium heat, reduce heat to low, and simmer until sauce is thickened, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,cayenne pepper,asparagus tip,lea perrins worcestershire sauce,taco seasoning mix
title: Green Beans, Asparagus & Taco Seasoning Mix Recipe
ingredients: 2 boxes asparagus tips, chopped ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 32 ounces cannellini beans, undrained | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon lea & perrins worcestershire sauce
instructions: In a large frying pan over medium low heat,, combine beans, taco seasoning and cayenne pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, stirring often. Add lea & perrins, stir. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,adobo seasoning,nonfat milk powder,baking soda
title: Dairy Free Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning, or more ( to taste )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place in a covered container. Refrigerate for at least one hour.

title: Mexican Corn and Beef Brisket
ingredients: 4 ounces lean ground beef brisket | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can pitted dates, drained | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped red chile | 1/4 cup cornmeal, or as needed
instructions: Cook and stir beef brisket, pinto beans, corn, dates, red chile, and cornmeal in a large skillet over medium heat until well blended, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low.

title: Green Curry Flavoured Oranges!
ingredients: 8 shallots ( or 2-inch sized ones ) | 250 g mixed fruit | 200 ml green curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder ( or 1/2 teaspoon of all curry powder ) | 1 teaspoon cilantro ( or other herbs of your choice, plus extra ) ( optional )
instructions: First, slice off rounds of peel from the oranges before slicing them into small wedges. Next, slice off the tops of the shallots or the littlenes then cut into quarters or into any size pieces resembling a semi uniform sized pear or apple or orange. Take one section of oranges and place a piece of ginger over it to coat with cooking spray before adding any other ingredients. Next, gently fold and gently squeeze the oranges with your hand to remove any air pockets and dry the orange slices on your kitchen paper. Then, add a 1/4 to 1/3 cup of cooking oil to a wok or nonstick pan/skillet and heat up over medium heat. When it starts to smoke, add in, shallots/cloves, curry paste, cardomom powder, or all curry powder and stir to combine. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes or until all the liquid has evaporated and the curry turned into a paste. Stir in the cooked oranges and garnish with herbs if using. Serve hot, enjoy.

title: Basil Kisses
ingredients: 13 ounces ladyfingers | 1/3 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Cut the ladyfingers in half lengthwise. Arrange on a serving plate. In a small bowl combine the green and red bell peppers. Add basil and peanuts and toss well. Spoon onto the ladyfingers. Serve.

title: Salmon With Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillet, skin and bones removed | 1 large onion, cut into 1/8 inch thick slices | jasmine rice, cooked as per directions on package
instructions: Place fish and onions in a deep skillet. Toss with enough water so the fish is coated in the rice. Heat over medium heat until the water boils and comes to a boil. Reduce heat and allow to cook until fish flakes easily. Serve with rice, if desired.

title: Hot and Spicy Ramen - Noodle and Chilli Flavor
ingredients: 3/4 cup of thin sliced ramen noodles | 3 -4 tablespoons chopped chili paste
instructions: Heat the skillet and add the chili paste, stir briefly. Add the ramen strips, stir briefly until coated with the chili paste. Turn down the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stir now and then to heat through.

title: English Pickled Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 english cucumber, cut into matchsticks | 3 tablespoons yellow mustard
instructions: Lay the cucumber in the work bowl of a food processor or colander and run the blade until a fine, thin membrane runs off. Rinse off any excess liquid from the cucumber and squeeze the pulp to remove excess moisture. Set aside to drain until needed. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Stir the yellow mustard into the cucumber pulp. Spread the cucumber mixture on a clean, dry cutting surface. Turn the heat under grill down to medium, cover, and allow to steam for 5 minutes. Serve warm with chips, if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Quick Fajita Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces tomato sauce | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Pour tomato sauce into a small bowl and sprinkle with salt. Mix well. Spray pan with cooking spray and let cook fajita mixture until desired thickness is reached. Use the cooking spray to coat fajita mixture, if necessary. Serve with flour tortilla chips. Enjoy.

title: Creamy French Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 jars sliced olives
instructions: Reserve 1/4 cup of onion and 2/3 cup olives to make a dipping sauce. Place remaining onion in a slow cooker. Stir condensed soup and olives together.

title: Italian Pomegranate Salmon Salad
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/3 cup italian salad dressing | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons smoked salmon
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the chickpeas, salad dressing, sugar, pomegranate seeds, and smoked salmon. Cover, and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,monterey jack cheese,vanilla pudding mix,green cardamom,broccoli floret,red potato,cider vinegar,beer
title: Baja Style Fish Stew
ingredients: 1 box vanilla pudding mix | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 can beer ( i prefer pacific wonder ) | 1 1/2 lbs medium red potatoes, scrubbed, cut in fourths ( about 2 cups ) | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 lb broccoli floret ( about one 3/4 of a 12 ounce package ) | 1/4 cup sliced green cardamom ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Prepare wine. In bowl, combine the pudding mix and vinegar, and let stand 15 minutes until all the liquid is absorbed. Place potatoes and salt in large saucepan. Cook over high heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, about 6 - 8 minutes. Add sugar and bring to simmer, stirring until melted and a thermometer reaches 140°f stir in drained broccoli and continue stirring until potatoes are hot enough to mash, 15 - 20 more minutes to reach desired thickness. Stir in cardamom and cheese just before serving.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,sugar,coriander seed,orange juice concentrate,brown rice flour
title: Brown Rice Powder Mix and Broth
ingredients: 3/4 cup brown rice flour or 3/4 cup whole grain rice flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander seeds or 1 1/2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon sugar | 2 tablespoons orange juice concentrate | 1 jar cilantro stems
instructions: In dry skillet cook coriander seeds or cumin seeds, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted and fragrant. Transfer to spice grinder and process until fine coarsely ground. Mix in flour, sugar, orange juice concentrate, and cilantro. Store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,white onion,mango chutney,pumpkin puree,mint
title: Indian Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup packed mint | 1/2 cup chopped white onion | 3/4 cup mango chutney | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup powdered mango chutney | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh mint
instructions: Puree 1/2 cup chopped mint and 1/4 cup white onion in food processor. Stir 1/4 cup mango chutney, heavy cream, powdered mango chutney, and 2 teaspoons chopped mint into mango mixture until light. Pour into buttered 1 1/2 quart glass dish. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Serve with a dollop of panko bread crumbs for a tasty topping.

title: Chutney Gravy for a Chefs' Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup homemade chutney ( no substitutions ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dry chutney | 1/4 cup beef broth ( i use low sodium and it just happens to turn out just right ) | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt ( my addition ) or 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt ( my addition )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a medium pan. Turn up heat and whisk, making sure the water doesn't boil away. Cook on medium until all ingredients are boiling and starting to mix the mixture on the bottom. The longer the broth is allowed to simmer on the stove, the more flavorful or tangy you'll get. Pour into cups and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,greek olive,white mushroom,apple juice,single cream
title: Warm Greek Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apple juice | 2 tablespoons greek salad dressing ( see the recipe i posted at ) | 400 g small white mushrooms ( or other veg, if available ) | 2 tablespoons single cream | 8 tablespoons lettuce leaves, torn
instructions: Combine apple juice and greek salad dressing. Cook mushrooms in a little ghee with cream and cook for 5 minutes. Pour over vegetables and toss well. Garnish with shredded lettuce leaves.

title: Rice and Rocket Salad (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups rice ( not short grain rice- must be made if using a fan forced cooker ) | 2 bunches fresh rocket | 20 g salted butter or 20 g hard olive oil
instructions: Open rice cooker. Scatter rocket leaves over the inner edge of the cooker, then press'start'. When the crust forms, replace lid and allow to steam for 1 minute. Remove lid and fluff grains with fork. Leave on lid until steam goes off completely and rice has cooled for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Veal Fondue
ingredients: 250 g ground veal | 2 cans tomato soup | 1 cup broth | 3 ounces goat cheese | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( to taste, i like lots! ) | 24 ounces frozen raspberries, drained ( reserve a few to decorate ) | 2 -3 thawed whipped topping, to garnish
instructions: Brown ground veal and drain. Combine in crock pot soups, chicken broth, goat cheese and cayenne pepper. Cover and cook on high 4 - 6 hours or low for 6 - 8 hours, stirring occasionally and adding more broth if it seems thick or more if you like a thinner sauce. Add raspberries during last 20 minutes of cooking. Top with whipped topping. Serve with hot buttered noodles.

title: Pesto-Stuffed Beef Rolls
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 pound extra-lean ground beef | 1 package all-purpose pesto sauce | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 9 inch square baking dish with cooking spray. Place the ground beef in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir until browned, adding more water if needed. Drain any excess grease. Stir in the pesto sauce, half and half, baking soda, and mace. Heat through, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,irish cream
title: Roasted Ra El Hanout Moroccan Spices
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground ras el hanout spice mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground turkish dried irish cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients & grind into a fine paste. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,onion soup mix,apple,red pepper,creamy peanut butter,filet beef
title: Beef Satay #2
ingredients: 1 lb filet of beef | 3/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 1/2 tablespoons red pepper, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons onion soup mix | 1/4 cup apple juice or 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon chopped dried onion ( soup mix )
instructions: Slice beef into thin strips. Place on skewer in a shallow casserole dish. Mix peanut butter and onion soup mix together. Spoon this mixture on top of the beef strips. Sprinkle dried onion on aswell. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Skewer meat should sit in liquid from left over liquid. Preheat oven to 425 degrees place baking pan on lower rack of oven. Place beef and bake covered for 45 minutes. Slice into strips and serve.

title: Chocolate Rice Krispies Treats
ingredients: 6 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 1 cup chicken broth | 6 ounces chicken-flavored rice krispies | 6 1/2 ounces chocolate squares
instructions: Combine 3 ounces chocolate and chicken broth in a small saucepan, cook over low heat until mixture is smooth and heated through. Transfer peanut butter and 1/4 cup warm chocolate into bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Add rice krispies and blend until combined, set aside. Place remaining 1 ounce chocolate into small bowl of stand mixer fitted with paddle attachment. Remove rice krispies from bowl of chocolate, add to bowl of chocolate.

Random Ingredients: thyme,italian breadcrumb,pearl barley,lemon juice zest,sage leaf
title: Barley and Lemon Squares
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, about 2-3 lemons | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped | 1 1/2 - 2 cups dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 12 fresh sage leaves or 4 teaspoons dried sage, minced ( 1 tbsp. dried )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place barley, lemon juice, thyme, and breadcrumbs in a large bowl. Season with 1 teaspoons salt. Roll mixture to the 1/2 inch size disk, using fingers, then press out as much air as possible. Place disks side by side, cut side up, slightly overlapped, in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle lightly with remaining salt. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, until center is firm and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: egg white,tarragon leaf,thyme leaf,black bean sauce,apricot jam
title: Basic Black Bean Sauce
ingredients: 1 can black beans in their liquid | 3 egg whites | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon leaves | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon apricot jam
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Pour the beans from their liquid into a small bowl, and stir in 3 egg whites. Mix in the tarragon, thyme, and apricot jam to make the sauce. Spoon into an ovenproof dish, and place on the rack in the preheated oven. Bake until lightly browned, about 40 minutes.

title: Easy Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 bag packaged ladyfingers | 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1/2 cup pineapple, chopped | 1 green pepper, sliced | 1 package coleslaw mix
instructions: Heat oil in deep fryer to 350 degrees f. Line a large bowl with ladyfingers. Dip each ladyfinger into oil.

title: Chef John's Easy Bacon and Soy Gravy (Gravy for Beef)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 package unflavored gelatin, ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 3 cups beef tenderloin ( sirloin, top or rib eye ), cut into thin slices ( about 3-1/4-inch pieces ) | 1 lb canadian bacon, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Sprinkle the cornmeal and salt on a dinner plate. Dissolve gelatin in 4 cups cold water in a 2 1/2 to 3 qt heavy pot. Add the beef and bring to a boil over moderately high heat, stirring until any lumps form. Then remove the pan from the heat and stir in the gelatin. Pour the batter into the pan and set over moderate heat. Cook, stirring, until the mixture coats the back of a spoon, 3 to 5 minutes, stirring or shaking the pot. Meanwhile, heat a 6 inch depth of water in a small heavy saucepan to boiling and pour 1 tbs. Of the reserved gelatin over it. Place the pan over high heat until the gelatin is dissolved, then remove the saucepan from the heat. Pour the hot gelatin mixture into a sieve into a bowl and toss with the bacon. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Cheese Focaccia with Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose white flour | 12 ounces muenster cheese, finely shredded
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix flour and shredded cheese. Rub in about 2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture into the dry ingredients. Make a well in the center of the mixture and pour the remaining mixture into it. Mix well with your hands to form a rough ball. Divide dough into golf ball size balls. Flatten with a fork on a floured surface. Arrange on a well buttered baking sheet. Flour should not be able to touch the surface of the dough. Place in a warm oven while the oven is preheating for 20 minutes. Remove when the tops are a light golden brown, about 8 to 10 minutes. Use a spatula if needed to remove the focaccia from the oven. If it browns too quickly, reduce the temperature until all excess moisture has been absorbed. Slices of mozzarella can also be placed on top for added flavor.

Random Ingredients: splenda granular,yellow onion,nonfat beef broth,macadamia nut,kernel corn,molasses,chili paste
title: Low Calorie Beef Satay
ingredients: 1 can reduced sodium beef broth | 1/4 cup splenda granular ( sugar blend ) | 1/4 cup molasses | 3 tablespoons hot chili paste | 2 tablespoons chopped yellow onions | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 cup dry-roasted chopped macadamia nuts
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine broth, splenda and molasses.

title: Candied Eggplant (Aubergine) Alla Romana
ingredients: 4 large eggplants | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 cup freshly grated ginger
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Cut the eggplants lengthwise into 3 or 4 slices. Place the slices on an ungreased baking rack. Brush the slices with 2 teaspoons of the sugar and sprinkle with the seeds. Broil until lightly browned, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove the slices and transfer the pan to the oven. Broil until browned on all sides and interior is dry, about 6 minutes. Brush the eggplant slices with 2 teaspoons of the sugar, sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of the fennel seeds and let them sit until cooled, about 15 minutes. Remove the eggplant.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,hot mustard,egg white,raspberry jam,kale,thai basil
title: Kale Wrapped Eggs
ingredients: 1/2 lb kale | 1 teaspoon hot mustard | 6 whole fresh thai basil, leaves finely chopped ( or 1 tsp dried, if using fresh ) | 1 large egg white | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam | 3 tablespoons apple juice or 3 tablespoons cream
instructions: Thai kale is a good choice if you have the option of using kale leaf as a substitute.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,thyme sprig,whipping cream,white onion,habanero pepper
title: Habanero-Orange Whip
ingredients: 1 cup orange juice ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup whipping cream ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup sweet white onion, minced | 1 teaspoon thyme sprig | 8 habanero peppers, stemmed, seeded, minced or 1 teaspoon jalapeno, seeded, finely minced
instructions: If using fresh orange juice, prepare as directed on the package. Stir in the orange juice. If using frozen whip, place in a sealable jar with a tight fitting lid.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,dark chocolate square,sugar,herb cheese spread,vegetable oil,pineapple tidbit
title: Chocolate Hawaiian Pineapple Spread
ingredients: 1 packet herb cheese spread | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 4 ounces dark chocolate squares, melted | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in refrigerator.

title: Avocodo
ingredients: 5 medium hass avocados, halved and pitted | 5 flour tortillas | 1 teaspoon white whole wheat flour
instructions: Place cut avocado into bowl of chilled food processor. Add the flour and blend until combined. Spoon mixture onto tortillas, sprinkle with reserved 1 teaspoon of flour. Fold to form a burrito shape. Serve seam side down in a baking dish with tortillas on the side. Microwave for 15 - 20 seconds, or until warm and crispy.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 4 ounces sliced swiss cheese | 12 hot italian sausage ( i use sausage breakfast )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the chicken thighs in a large roasting pan. Cover with the cheese, and sprinkle with sausage. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and tender. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: honey,pork,yellow bell pepper,graham cracker crust,chilies,bay leaf
title: Chili Crusted Pork Empanadas
ingredients: 200 g chilies | 1 large yellow bell pepper | 200 g pork ( or bacon ) | 1 tablespoon honey ( or molasses if using other sweetener eg agave ) | 250 g graham cracker crust | bay leaf ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c. Slice the green chilies, the yellow bell pepper and the pork into small pieces. Place the meat with half marinade ingredients in a food processor or a blender and process thoroughly. Place the mixture in a shallow oven proofed pan and bake in the oven for 25 - 30 minutes, or until done. Remove from oven and remove from oven and dip the graham cracker crusts into the melted honey and cut out the crumbs. Roll out the dough using 2 5cm rounds. Place 2 level tablespoons of the pork mixture onto the dough and sprinkle with the graham cracker crumbs. Fold the bottom edge over the filling and press with the bottom end of a fork, you want the moist crusts to stick to the edge of the crusts. Place the empanadas on a baking tray and bake in the oven for approximately 20 minutes. If topping needs more colour, add a few drops of brown sugar or caramelised sugar or cocoa powder when baking.

Random Ingredients: celery,cocoa powder,tomato basil,tomato puree,up,lasagna noodle,egg noodle
title: Easy No Boil Lasagna
ingredients: 10 -12 lasagna noodles ( preferably fresh ) | 2 cans diced tomatoes with basil | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 4 tablespoons tomato puree | 12 ounces frozen chopped celery | 1 1/4 cups canned tomato puree | 5 -6 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: In bowl, chop and mash cans of diced tomatoes with a hand mixer. In a 9x13 backing pan, make layers, starting with noodles. Cover with 3rd can of diced tomatoes, 2 tablespoons of cocoa powder, a third cup of water, 1 tbsp of cocoa powder, the veggies. I use this again for a second layer and for the last layer. Pour remaining 3/4 cup of tomatoes and 1 tbsp of cocoa powder over veggies. Bake at 350° until bubbly, about half an hour, covered with foil, in a preheated 350° oven until bubbling and veggies are tender and everything is bubbling and starting to brown. Allow to cool slightly before cutting and serving.

title: Ziti Salad
ingredients: 1 -2 lb ziti pasta ( uncooked ) | 2 cups white cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 cup jarlsberg cheese, chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Cook ziti in salted water until slightly underdone, drain and set aside. Sprinkle both cheeses evenly over ziti and toss with vinegar.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,dark brown sugar,chunky salsa,chilies,red potato,sole fillet,canadian bacon,leek
title: Chunky Mexican Fish
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chopped leek | 2 ounces chunky salsa | 5 ounces red potatoes | 3 1/2 ounces sweet green chilies | 1 1/2 ounces canadian bacon | 4 1/2 ounces red chilies, seeded | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 4 sole fillets, skinned
instructions: Blanch the chunky salsa.

title: Chocolates Stuffed With Sweet Peas and Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped italian parsley | 100 g frozen sweet peas ( or substitute peas or carrots ) | 1 tablespoon chopped italian parsley | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate | cooking spray | 4 teaspoons ground cumin ( or to taste ) | 250 g ground lean pork
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high to high,. Cook peas or carrots in microwave or in microwave oven for 2 minutes, until partially thawed. Place peas in a microwave safe bowl with remaining ingredients. Microwave on high, for 1 and a half minutes, until hot and melted. Combine filling ingredients. Spoon 1 tsp filling onto each sweet pepper. Place on a baking sheet sprayed with cooking oil cooking spray. Bake for 12 minutes, or until hot and bubbling. Serve immediately.

title: Tom's Quick Spinach, Kumara and Tossed Fernils
ingredients: 2 fresh taco seasoning sheets | 500 g kumara, cut into 1 cm slices | 400 g spinach leaves, washed and drained | 2 tablespoons caster sugar or 2 tablespoons sugar substitute
instructions: In a large bowl sprinkle the kumara with a little seaoned salt and set the kumara in a steamer of water for about 5 minutes to steam. Place the spinach, fenils and packet of taco seasoning on two baking trays and arrange over simmering steaming water. Steam in batches for 3 minutes, or until the fernils are cooked and still a little crisp on the edges. While the sausages are still warm, scatter over the sugar and serve straight away with some warm, buttered naan bread.

title: Hummus
ingredients: 1 lb lamb or 1 lb chicken | zucchini ( chopped or grated )
instructions: Place all ingredients in bowl. Mix, store in fridge. Shake in oven on 350 till all ingredients are done.

title: The Best Cheddar and Chive Fondue for Dogs
ingredients: 8 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/8 cup minced chives | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 2 teaspoons grenadine | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine cheese, chives, hot sauce and grenadine. Mix well and serve.

title: Smoked Trout and Beans
ingredients: pastry shells | 1 can smoked trout | 1 can drained cannellini beans | 1 can sauerkraut | 3 -4 slices of cooked back bacon | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1/2 cup cola
instructions: Brown smoked trout in a skillet & drain. Add remaining ingredients except for the cheese & cola. Mix thoroughly, cover & cook over very low heat until ingredients are well mixed & heated thru. Top each pastry shell with smoked trout & cola. Enjoy.

title: Easy Lemongrass Broiled Fish
ingredients: 2 pounds fish sauce | 6 whole cardamom pods | 1 1/2 pounds boneless fish legs with thigh, skin removed and cut into 3-inch pieces | 1 pound chicken leg, skin removed and cut into 3 to 4 pieces
instructions: Prepare the fish sauce by combining the fish sauce, cardamom pods, and chicken legs in a small saucepan over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: lime gelatin,marsala wine,extra virgin olive oil,corn kernel,feta,cake flour,chicken leg,chipotle chile
title: Chicken Legs With Artesian Chipotle Honey Poteca
ingredients: 2 whole chicken legs | 1 cup cake flour, sifted | 1 jar chardonnay wine, sweet | extra virgin olive oil, plus extra | extra virgin olive oil, for brushing on the chicken | 1/2 cup instant chocolate chipotle chile, cut into thin strips | 3 1/2 ounces lime gelatin | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed ( or fresh )
instructions: Dip the chicken legs into flour. Heat half a cup of olive oil in a large saucepan over medium high heat until it shimmers but not smoking. Pat the chicken dry on paper towels. Arrange chicken, skin side down, in the pan. Brown on both sides, then transfer them to a warmed platter and cover with foil to keep warm. Pour remaining 1/4 cup oil into the saucepan and set over medium heat. When the oil shimmers, add 1/2 teaspoon salt.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,salmon,superfine sugar,buttermilk,carrot,sharp cheddar cheese,chili powder,white vinegar
title: Easy Rosemary Salmon Chowder
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces unsalted sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( about 2 cups or 200 g ) | 1 1/4 cups fresh buttermilk or 1 1/4 cups low-fat buttermilk | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary | 1 lb salmon, skinned, flaked, and cartilage removed, bones reserved ( see note below ) | 1 medium carrot, peeled, thinly sliced, and cut into thin julienne strips | fresh rosemary, for garnish ( see note below )
instructions: Place half the cheese cubes in blender. Add buttermilk, vinegar, sugar, chili powder, and rosemary. Cover and blend on high for 2 minutes. In a large saucepan, bring just to boil over medium high heat. Add salmon and carrot. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer until just cooked through, 3 - 5 minutes, 3 - 5 minutes more longer. Ladle soup into bowls. Garnish with fresh rosemary leaves and serve.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,peanut butter,radish,lemon balm leaf,hard egg,lime,raisin
title: Larb Gai
ingredients: 7 ounces rice noodles ( larb gai ) | 2 ounces soft peanut butter | 2 tablespoons raisins | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 -3 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | radish ( optional ) | lemon balm leaf ( optional )
instructions: Soak the noodles for 10 - 12 hours if possible in a large bowl of warm water. Drain well. Rinse with cold water. Drain well. Soak the raisins in cold water. Drain well. Set aside. Dry fry the peanuts if desired, using only a little of the water. Drain well and set aside. Slice eggs lenghtwise into 1/2 lenghts. Arrange on a bed of noodles. Scatter noodles with lettuce, carrots and radishes if desired. Pour melted peanut butter over and serve. Garnish with lemon balm leaves and radishes if using.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,hard cheese,passover wine,fruit,pizza crust,red chilies
title: Pizza Rustica
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 2 tablespoons sweet pizza crust | 500 ml passover wine | 250 g mixed fresh fruit | 1 small red chilies, de-seeded and finely chopped | 125 g hard cheese, grated and divided into halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Pour sauce over pizza crust, arrange fruit and chillies on top, then crumble over 1/4 of the cheese. Sprinkle with remaining cheese on top. Bake for 10 - 15 mins or until crust is crisp and fruit is hot.

Random Ingredients: black olive,active yeast,dark soy sauce,white wine,ginger paste,nonfat cream
title: Black Olive & Ginger Naan Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs all-purpose white bread flour | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon sesame seed paste or 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 3/4 cup pitted and minced black olives, drained | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger paste | 3 -4 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: First, make the starter, place the warm flour in a mixing bowl, and stir in the yeast. In a small bowl, combine the sour cream, sesame seed paste or garam masala, remaining ginger and green onion stems. Add the mixed flour to the starter and stir until well incorporated. Make the dough, place a large skillet over medium high heat. Add enough oil to just coat the bottom of the pan. Place dough into the skillet and turn once to coat. When the dough begins to turn golden brown, remove the dough and place it in a lightly oiled bowl. Cover with a cloth and set aside to rise in a warm place for 1 to 2 hours or until it doubles in size. Preheat the oven to 400°f remove the dough from the bowl and pat it dry. Turn it out onto a lightly oiled and floured baking sheet and slash two sides with a sharp knife. Spread the filling over the loaf, and top with the sliced olives and ginger paste. Cover and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the baking sheet and increase the temperature to 400°f bake for about 22 to 26 minutes more, or until the top is nicely browned and crusty.

title: Pineapple Poblano Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup fresh poblano chile, stemmed, seeded and chopped | 1 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Let sit, allowing salsa to soften slightly, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,dill,green cardamom,white bread flour,herbes de
title: Herbes De Provence
ingredients: 500 g whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence ( see note ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons white bread flour ( see note ) | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamoms, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Divide into 12 portions. Roll each portion into a thin sausage shape on a floured board, then cut into 3 inch long pieces. Heat a non stick frying pan on medium high until it is hot but not smoking. Add 2 or 3 sections of herbes de provence. As soon as they change colour, reduce heat to very low. Add sausage pieces and fry for about 1 minute or until golden brown. Set aside on absorbent paper towel and serve warm. Note, to crush the spices in mortar, add 2 or 3 crushed green cardamom or dried ground red chilies. You can also grind your own spices if you like a hotter herbes de provence. Note, to flour, you will need 1 tsps salt and 3 tbs lemon juice. Note, in a bowl mix 1 1/2tsp of herb de provence with 6 tbsp water. Mix into flour with 3/4tbs of white bread flour and 3 tablespoons lemon juice. Knead dough until smooth. Flour hands and roll out dough to a 5cm thickness. Cut out rounds with cookie cutter or glass. Place the rounds on a floured board and press edges together to seal. For a vegetarian use the vegetable oil cooking spray in the oil and water. Note, if you use white bread flour omit this step except for the white bread flour which should be gluten free.

title: The Best French Onion Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 lb medium onion, chopped | 12 ounces heavy cream
instructions: Combine soup with cream, and combine in casserole dish. Cut onions into 1/4 slices, and add in slices to soup and cream mix. Cover and bake for about 1 hour on 350 degrees, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: kohlrabi,green chilies,chilies,canola oil,purpose flour,kaffir lime leaf,coconut,orange zest
title: Sweet Potato Pancakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs kohlrabi, peeled, halved lengthwise, and cut into 1 inch squares ( about 8 kohlrabi ) | 3 green chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup finely grated coconut ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 2/3 cup canola oil | 2/3 cup shredded coconut | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1/4 cup zest from 1 orange, zest of | 4 kaffir lime leaves | 1/4 cup canned chopped green chilies, chopped | ground dried red chilies ( to taste ) or hot green chilies ( to taste )
instructions: For the pancake, process kohlrabi and chilies in a food processor until finely ground and evenly ground.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,caraway seed,french bread,white breadcrumb,beef steak
title: Corned Beef and Steak on Toasted Pretzel
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caraway seeds, toasted with | 1 tablespoon white breadcrumbs | 2 - 3 lbs beef flank steak, 1-inch thick, trimmed | 3 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 -3 1/2 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs | 2 slices crusty french bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Spread the toasted caraway seeds onto a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 15 minutes. Let cool and set aside. Trim the beef of all visible fat and cut into very thin slices. Toss the beef in the olive oil with the caraway seeds, then set aside. Dredge in 1 - 2 tbsp bread crumbs, shaking off any excess, and coat with the bread crumbs. Heat a little bit of the oil over medium high heat in a large, heavy baking pan. Add the beef and brown quickly on all sides, about 5 minutes. Transfer the beef to a cutting board, tent with foil, and let it rest for 10 minutes. Transfer the pan to the oven and roast the beef in the middle of the oven until it is barely tender, about 20 minutes. Turn the oven off and put the pan in the oven for 2 - 1 1/2 hours, or until the dish in browned very nicely. Let the beef stand at room temperature for 10 - 15 minutes before serving. Serve with a sprinkling of plenty of freshly grated cheese, and a tossed green salad.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,vanilla essence,provolone cheese,sun tomato oil,iceberg lettuce
title: Polly Welby's Italian Salad
ingredients: 4 cups iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/2 cup provolone cheese, cut in small cubes | 4 cups ice cubes | 2 tablespoons vanilla essence
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, add the iceberg lettuce, sun dried tomatoes, provolone cheese cubes, ice cubes and essence. Pour the vanilla essence over the top and mix together well. Serve at your favourite setting.

title: Quick 'n' Spicy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup horseradish | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,chicken meat,cardamom seed,poppy seed,parsnip,poblano chile,swiss cheese
title: Pepis Poppy Seed Roast Chicken Breast
ingredients: 3 large poblano chiles | 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken meat, cut into 4 pieces | 3 tablespoons lemon juice or 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed | 1/4 teaspoon whole cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons potato starch or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 1/2 cups fresh swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Roast poblanos under griller until blackened on all sides. Immediately seal and let stand for 10 minutes. Immediately place in a plastic bag or large bowl and refrigerate. Peel and seed the chiles, and cut into 1 inch chunks. In a roasting pan, place the chicken pieces, skin side down, between 2 pieces of wax paper on top, and roll up tightly. Remove the paper and chicken and place in freezer for 20 minutes. Remove the roasting pan from the freezer, uncover it, and cut out all of the pieces into bite size pieces. In a small bowl, stir together the lemon juice, poppy seeds and cardamom. Cut poblanos open, remove skin, and remove blackened core, seeds and veins. Cut in half crosswise. Arrange chicken breasts in the roasting pan, skin side up. Place the chiles on top. Pour the marinade over them. Add enough water to reach 1 1/2 inches over the chicken. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours, or overnight. Preheat oven to 375°f place cheese in a shallow, nonreactive baking pan. Spoon half of the sauce over each of the chicken breast halves. Place 2 bread slices on top, and cover with the remaining sauce. Bake for 30 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink inside. Broil for 1 minute or so. Serve.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,swiss cheese,white fish fillet,plantain,spaghetti,kielbasa,stilton cheese,cooking spray
title: Grilled Smoked Fish and Stilton Stifado with Plantains and Swiss
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 plantains, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 6 slices smoked kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3 slices swiss cheese, diced into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 pound smoked stilton cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 8 ounces cooked white fish fillets, cut into chunks | 8 ounces spaghetti
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Spray grill grate with cooking spray. Arrange plantains on the grill. Cook plantains until light brown, about 5 minutes per side. Place smoked kielbasa slices in a large bowl. Sprinkle with parmigiano reggiano cheese, swiss cheese, and smoked fish. Place the slices of plantain, then top with stilton and the smoked fish. Grill plantains until fish is easily flaked with a fork, and the slices are toasted on the bottom, 3 to 4 minutes per side.

title: Spice and Currants Mix
ingredients: 4 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 tablespoon currants
instructions: Pour 100ml 1 tbsp into a glass jar and press a piece of orange peel into the centre. Cover with 100ml 1 tbsp currants and half a tsp of mixed spice.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,pita bread,turnip,chuck roast,salt black pepper,baby corn,grain white rice,scallop
title: Grilled Veggie Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck roast, trimmed | 1 teaspoon grated gingerroot | 4 small turnips, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 cups sliced baby corn | 1/2 cup sliced scallops | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1/2 cup sliced pita bread ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Toss beef with ginger and season with salt and pepper. Grill beef on all sides until charred and cooked to your liking, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer meat to a bowl and cover with foil. Keep warm. Add turnips, corn, scallops, and 3 to 5 more tablespoons water to the pan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes. Place all bread onto a baking sheet. Grill, turning once, until lightly toasted on all sides. Cut sandwiches in half, then serve hot with hot beef.

title: Onion-Cove Curry (Aka Arhar Dal
ingredients: 1 large onion, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup turmeric ( not table salt ) | 1/3 teaspoon cardamom pod
instructions: Over medium high heat saute the onion until soft and transparent. Stir in turmeric. Add cardamom pods. Add a bit of water if necessary to keep ingredients moistened. The curry is ready when you can smell it. Simmer 3 minutes. This should smell wonderful. You can add an asian vegetable. Add any meat and other vegetables you want, it's also a good side dish for rice.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,bean,skirt steak,sugar,lime zest,chicken breast half,ginger paste
title: Cambodian Grilled Chicken Kabobs
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger paste | 2 teaspoons lime zest | 1 can coconut milk | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 lb dried unsweetened coconut, soaked in water 20 minutes then drained
instructions: Cut chicken into cubes and discard bones and fat. Place in a large resealable freezer bag. Combine the ginger, lime peel, coconut milk, and sugar. Pour mixture over chicken and toss to coat. Seal. Place in refrigerator for at least one hour and up to 4 hours. Preheat grill to medium heat. Place chicken, skin side down, on the grill. Cook, turning once, until no longer pink in the center, about 6 to 8 minutes. Transfer chicken to a cutting board. When the grill is ready, using a small sharp knife, slice chicken thinly and against grain. Discard ginger mixture, coating both sides. Grill chicken until the juices run clear, turning once, about 5 minutes.

title: Garbanzo Beans - Quick and easy
ingredients: 250 g dried garbanzo beans | 1 -2 cup vanilla pudding or 1 -2 cup other flavourful pudding for microwaveable protein
instructions: Wash & drain chick peas.
