Place in a medium sized microwave safe bowl & add 2 cups of hot water, cover the bowl tightly & microwave on high for 4 - 5 minutes, or until the rice absorbs the water, then remove the bowl and place on the side to allow to dry out for about 10 minutes then turn off the stove & allow to sit, covered with a paper towel for about 20 minutes. Serve hot or cold with sugar or cinnamon or flavouring.

title: Irish Style Pickle Soup #5FIX
ingredients: 20 small new potatoes | 1 cup pickle juice | 1 jar grape, rinsed | 1 jar pickled beets, drained
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and cool. Remove from cooking water. Place the potatoes into cold running water. Dice the potatoes, and add to a large pot. Add the pickle juice and bring to a boil. Stir in the beets, bring to a boil & continue to boil for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and transfer to a food processor, and process until chunky. Store the soup in the refrigerator.

title: Quick Beef Gravy for Pork Roast
ingredients: 4 packets beef gravy | 1 can minced clams with juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,rice vinegar,new mexico chile,fish,garlic,penne,cheese ravioli
title: Ravioli in a New Mexican Sauce!
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs fresh fish, about 1 pound, of skinned, deveined and finely diced ( a firm fleshed fish such as cod, sea bass and/or haddock work best ) | salt and freshly ground black pepper | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 8 cloves crushed garlic | 1 can tomato puree | 1 teaspoon dried new mexico chile ( optional ) | 4 large fresh ravioli, prepared as directed on box ( small-medium size )
instructions: Place fish in a large bowl, add salt and pepper to taste and toss to coat. Toss sauce with fish and refrigerate for 30 minutes to marinate. Drain fish well. Reserve marinade. Bring marinade to a boil, then add garlic and tomatoes and return to a boil. Lower heat and simmer uncovered for 30 - 40 minutes. Stir sauce occasionally. Drain and discard any remaining liquid. Stir in chiles. Heat oven to 400°f toss ravioli with reserved sauce. Sprinkle with more salt and pepper if needed. Place ravioli in a greased 7x7 inch baking dish. Pour marinade mixture over and around ravioli. Bake for 20 minutes, or until browned. Serve hot.

title: Cantaloupe Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 12 ounces pineapple juice | 4 ounces cantaloupe, cut into chunks | 1 chicken, cut into pieces
instructions: Mix curry powder and cumin in a bowl and set aside. In a small pot, combine pineapple juice and lemon juice and put over medium heat. Add cantaloupe, mix. Add curry powder mixture, mix. Add pineapple mix. Put on lid and let sit for 4 minutes. Turn off and open pot. Let cool for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Smoky Parsnips With Egg and Chilli
ingredients: 4 parsnips or 4 bunches baby parsnips, peeled and halved lengthways | 4 large eggs | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 tablespoon lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh fenugreek seeds or 1 1/2 tablespoons dried fenugreek leaves | sweet chili sauce, to serve ( indian ) | yoghurt or plain yogurt
instructions: Toss the pared parsnips in the dressing and leave for 30 minutes, then drain, peel and cut into wedges. Heat a wok, add the oil and swirl to coat. When it is smoking, add the parsnip, tossing over a high heat for 3 - 5 minutes or until golden on one side, then turn over and add the lemon juice if using. Keep tossing for a further 3 - 4 minutes or until softened. Transfer to a serving plate. Scramble the eggs, add the lemon juice and fenugreek and stir fry for about 2 minutes, then mix in the parsnips. Cover and keep warm. Wipe out the wok. Heat it again and add the oil. Heat for 1 minute then add the leek and stirfry for 1 - 2 minutes. Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with extra fenugreek or yogurt.

title: Shahi Tukray
ingredients: 250 g daikon radishes | 2 heads lettuce | 1 tablespoon honey | 4 teaspoons urad dal ( split black gram-free powder. dry )
instructions: Trim the daikon and jalapenos and discard the ends. Rinse them thoroughly with warm water. Soak for 10 minute. Cut the lettuce to 3 cm size pieces and separate the leaves, keeping the greens separate. Place a portion of the daikon, jalapeno and lettuce inside each leaf. Sprinkle the other tablespoon of urad dal along the edges of the leaf. Fold the lettuce in half. Cook in a heavy based pan for 3 minutes or until the edges become crisp. Serve hot on lettuce leaf.

title: Grilled Manchego With Vermicelli & Cranberry Glaze
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 1/3 cup grated manchego cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh sweet onions or 1/4 cup sweet red onion | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh minced gingerroot or 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest or 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 package dry vermicelli, cooked and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons sazon seasoning | grated fresh gingerroot, for garnish | 1/2 cup drained sliced canned cranberries | guacamole
instructions: Make the dressing by combining the buttermilk, all the remaining ingredients and letting it sit over low heat until the flavors combine. Toss with the cooked vermicelli according to package directions. To serve, place a piece of vermicelli on a serving plate and spoon or ladle about 2 tablespoons of the warm liquid in the center. Top with the chopped ingredients. Garnish with extra grated ginger.

title: My Favorite Rice & Fresh Basil from a Rice Cooker|
ingredients: 3 cups basmati rice | salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place a steamer insert into a saucepan and add enough water to come 1/4 1/2 above rice. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. Cover and cook for 18 - 20 minutes or until done. When done fluff rice with fork.

title: Tamari Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh herb ( or 1 teaspoon dried herbs. )
instructions: Whisk tamari and herb together. Serve as an accompaniment to grilled meat.

title: Veal Chops Wrapped in Broccoli
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, trimmed | 1 large veal chop | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place the broccoli, veal and rice vinegar in a separate gallon container. Remove the block of broccoli from the boiling water, drain. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the veal chops into a baking dish. Add about 1/4 cup of the boiling water to the blender jar. Remove lid and stir thoroughly. Pour over meat. Mix well. Bake in the preheated oven for 70 minutes, turning over every 10 minutes to brown. Remove veal from the oven.

Random Ingredients: black vinegar,hot red pepper flake,russet potato
title: Papas Batantes (Portuguese Sweet Potato)
ingredients: 3 1/4 lb russet potatoes, cut in half crosswise ( about 6 medium ) | 1/4 cup black vinegar | 1 small hot red pepper flakes
instructions: Place potatoes into a medium saucepan and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,curry powder,hazelnut,bell pepper,lemon juice,chipotle chile adobo,velveeta cheese
title: Spicy Chipotle Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs velveeta cheese, cut into cubes approximately 2 inch wide | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon whipping cream ( whipping cream ) | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper curry powder | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted ( or chopped ) | 2 bell peppers, very thinly sliced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl and refrigerate for 1/2 hour for flavours to blend. Grill or broil the pepper slices, stirring as needed, until lightly charred, 4 to 5 minutes. Place on a plate, cover with foil and keep warm in a 300°f oven. After the cheese is chilled you may wish to place it over a paper towel lined grill to absorb some of the excess moisture. Place the cheese in a zip lock bag and snip off a corner. Squeeze out as much air as possible from the cheese, seal the bag and continue to use as much air as possible. Heat griddle to medium hot. Remove cheese cubes from bag, leaving as much cheese as possible in the bag. Place on the rack inside one of two shallow baking dishes. Add the peppers to the upper two thirds of the griddle. Serve topped with red pepper flakes. Serve with hot rice and crackers if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,cheddar cheese,watercress,arborio rice,kalamata olive,cocoa powder,roasting chicken,egg
title: Italian Chicken Mole Bowl
ingredients: 8 ounces roasted chicken | 1 ounce roasting chickens | 6 ounces cheddar cheese | 6 ounces arborio rice | 4 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 cups watercress | 3 eggs | 8 kalamata olives ( optional )
instructions: Cook chicken in 3/4 cup pan or pan of boiling water for about 20 minutes. While chicken is cooking, place other 3/4 cups water in small saucepan. Cook chafing ingredients, mix 1 cup of water with the cocoa powder in mixing bowl, then add rest of the water and mix. Set aside. When chicken has cooled about 5 minutes, shred it. Set aside. To prepare sauce, combine 2 eggs, olives, and remaining 3/4 cups water. Slowly pour egg mixture in pot while stirring with chopsticks, until egg mixture starts to firm. Add 1/2 cup of rice. Stir constantly about 4 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add chicken meat mixture and sauce. Strain excess juices from pan and heat through. Serve with cheese or as an entree.

title: Pasta N Pizzas With Beef
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 2 lbs ground beef | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot. Add pasta and cook until tender but firm. Drain. While the pasta is cooking, spray a baking sheet, or large cookie sheet with cooking spray. Pour the ground beef mixture into a large bowl. Use a fork to break up the pasta enought to mix it together. Add the pasta to the ground beef mixture and mix well. Transfer to prepared baking sheet. Top with your favorite toppings.

title: Quick Sun Dried Tomato Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus ( or any cut you use ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, strips | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | basil leaves, chopped ( or torn )
instructions: If using fresh asparagus cut asparagus into 2 inch lengths, set aside. Combine all ingredients except basil in pot& bring to a boil, then simmer on low for about 4 - 5 minute. Remove from heat, stir, and serve hot with fresh basil or torn basil.

title: Truffles
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1/2 tablespoon vanilla | 3 -4 radishes, preferably sweet | 10 small dried hot salted coffee or 10 small other hot peppers, such as jalapeno or 10 small red peppers
instructions: Remove any rind from the bacon. Cut the bacon into 1/4 1/2 x 1/4 inch strips with scissors. Cook the bacon strips as you normally do, in the bacon grease, stirring over medium heat, until the grease is released, about 2 minutes each side. Remove to paper towels. Add the 1/2 teaspoons coffee powder to the grease in the bacon grease. When the bacon is crisp, stir in 2 tablespoons vanilla and add the radishes. Continue cooking until you've added 10 dropletfuls of the hot coffee, or about 1/2 teaspoon vanilla salt. Stir and taste. Stir in 1/2 teaspoons salt at a time. If you want more spice, add tiny drops of ground coffee as desired. When crispy and glazed, remove carefully from the hot coffee. Spread the bacon evenly onto a baking sheet and spread thin, even layer on each radish, about 1/4 inch thick. Use a spoon to make a hole in the radish. Add the hot peppers as an end to the radish layer. Sprinkle with remaining coffee to moisten. The truffles will keep in the fridge for several days.

title: Coconut Candy
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut oil | 2 cups dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a skillet over high heat until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add soy sauce, lemon peel and coconut to pan and stir until well mixed. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature.

title: Cider Vinegar Masala (Ginger Pickle)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 piece fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder
instructions: Cut ginger into 1/2 inch slices and put into a small saucepan. Pour vinegar over ginger in pan and sprinkle with curry powder. Simmer at least 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has reduced and the ginger is slightly softened. When you are ready to eat, add the ginger in small chunks and mix with the vinegar.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,oregano leaf,lettuce leaf,pearl tapioca,floury potato,cardamom,saskatoon berry
title: Saskatoon Baked with Brazilian Pearls
ingredients: 1 large floury potato | 1 tablespoon pearl tapioca | 1 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons saskatoon berries | 1 pinch cardamom | 1 lettuce leaf | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves
instructions: Boil potato in lightly salted water until tender, about 15 minutes. Add tapioca. Drain and mash potato a small amount while stirring. Stir in pineapple juice, berries and cardamom.

title: Tamari Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Combine tamari and gruyere cheese in a small bowl.

title: Tangerines Foster Crepes
ingredients: 1/2 lb tangerine, peeled and segmented | 1/2 lb crepe, such as oaxaca | 1 tablespoon orange peel, minced
instructions: Combine tangerines and crepes in small saucepan. Heat over high heat until warm and lukewarm, about 15 minutes. Remove pan from heat and sprinkle with orange peel.

title: Wild Rice Salad Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup wild rice mix | 1 small green chili, seeded and diced
instructions: Prepare wild rice mix according to package directions. To serve, add green chilies to the mix, stirring to coat. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Baked Rice and Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 500 g ground chicken | 250 g mangoes, diced | 200 g queso fresco or 200 g feta, cut into 1 inch cubes, crumbled | 2 liters water | 1 bunch arborio rice, rinsed | 1 spice, such as cumin ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons mixed olives, sliced ( optional ) | ice water ( as required )
instructions: Make the spice sauce by mixing all the ingredients together. Heat oven to 180 degrees c or mark remove skewers from oven. Make the chicken meatballs – heat a large frying pan over high heat. Add the chicken meat with seasoning and stir frequently until it changes colour. Add the rice to the chicken and pan, stir well and bring liquid to the boil. Pour into a pyrex or glass baking dish or bowl, ensuring that no liquid residue remains. Place the pan on a roasting tray and add plenty of ice and plenty of water. Place your skewer cubes in the water, ensuring they are submerged. Roast for about one hour, stirring from time to time. Serve in large bowls with slices of red onion, arugula, and chopped fresh coriander sprinkled on top. Serve with guacomole, and more yoghurt as desired.

title: Orecchiette-Spring Roll Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb orecchiette | 1 package frozen cut green cabbage ( or cabbage of choice ) | 1 -2 hot pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup honey ( optional ) | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sliced and toasted apricot ( optional ) | 1 large cubanelle pepper, chopped into small pieces ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients together, except orecchiette dumplings. Mix well, then pour into 2 9x13 baking dishes. Bake at 375°f for 30 - 45 minutes, stirring a few times while cooking. Remove, spooning sauce over dumplings, and serve.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,citron peel,rock salt,garlic clove,brownie mix
title: Kettle Kettle - No-Stick No-Cook Kettle Focaccia
ingredients: 1/2 cup rock salt | 4 large garlic cloves, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon freshly grated carrot peel | 3/4 cup packed grated fresh citron peel | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup water in a small nonstick frying pan until just beginning to boil. When water shimmers, add 1 cup salt and cloves, or to taste, and saute briefly until garlic aroma is released. Stir in carrots and citron, stir, and cook, stirring, until mixture begins to color, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and transfer to a bowl to cool. Season with kosher salt and pepper. When cool, place kettle on a cutting board and slice diagonally using a serrated knife or a sharp knife.

title: Sauerkraut With Miso
ingredients: 7 1/4 ounces sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained | 2 -3 teaspoons white miso
instructions: Mix the sauerkraut with the miso. Heat the skillet or your grill. When the sauerkraut starts to crisp, use a fork to separate the strands. If using a skillet, don't crowd the sauerkraut the first time but if using the grill, use the last few minutes of cooking time to get all the pieces of sauerkraut to be heated through.

title: Cauliflower and Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 baby cauliflower stalks | 1 large scallop | 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cup sultanas | 1/4 cup chopped celery, or as desired
instructions: Place cauliflower stalks and scallops in a large pot. Cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for 15 minutes. Rinse the cauliflower, and snap off any tough ends. Place cauliflower in a bowl with 1 cup water to cover. Cover, and let stand 30 minutes. Drain. Place chicken in a large pot, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, and cook about 5 minutes. Remove chicken, and cool. Remove shells and fibers with a slotted spoon, and cut into bite size pieces. Shred chicken into bite size pieces. Bring 2 cups water to a boil. Place cauliflower in a bowl with 1 cup water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain, and place in a salad bowl. Remove cauliflower shells and skin strings with slotted spoon, and chop. Place chicken in the bowl with the cauliflower. Bring 2 cups water to a boil. Place 1 cup sultanas in a bowl of sherry. Drain, and mix into the salad. Allow the salad to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,penne,apricot preserve,anchovy paste,stew meat beef
title: Danish Penne With Anchovy Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb stew meat ( beef, pork may not be used, just beef chunks that have been sauteed ) | 1 jar anchovy paste | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper ( to taste i used fresh cracked pepper ) | 8 ounces dried penne ( or small tubetti. ) | 4 ounces apricot preserves or 4 ounces apricot preserves
instructions: Boil water for pasta and cook according to package directions. Pour pasta into a large bowl and cover with a lid. Add anchovy paste, white pepper, and black pepper and mix well. Drain any excess water. In a very large sauce pan, cover the meat with 1/2 cup of the sauce mix. Add the penne and stir well. Remove the cover from the sauce pan and let simmer about 3 - 5 minutes or until pasta is tender and meat is heated through. Remove from heat. In a small bowl, mix the preserves with a fork and add to cooked pasta or meat. Serve on top of hot cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,urad dal,rosemary,coffee ice cream,nutmeg,catsup,savoy cabbage,spring onion
title: Baked N' Savoy Cabbage
ingredients: 1/3 cup brown rice | 4 spring onions, thinly sliced | 100 g savoy cabbage, shredded | 3 tablespoons coffee ice cream | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 cup fresh edible rosemary, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place rice, spring onions, cabbage, ice cream, catsup, and nutmeg in a baking dish. Sprinkle with rosemary and optional edible rosemary. Bake in a moderate oven for 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Cardamom Potato Cakes
ingredients: 120 g potato starch | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Combine and knead to a smooth dough. Roll into a circle. Cut into 8 slices. Fry in oil until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,red pepper flake
title: Simple  Moroccan Spice Paste or Marinade
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In a jar, add all of the ingredients. Shake well to combine. Let sit in the refrigerator for at least 8 hours before using to allow flavors to blend. This can also be used as a glaze for chicken.

title: Rosemary Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 1 gallon ricotta cheese | 1 fresh rosemary
instructions: Pour the ricotta into a large mixing bowl. Add the fresh rosemary. Mix until the mixture is well incorporated and smooth. Place mixture in a colander, and let marinate for 2 hours. Wipe off excess liquid with a damp cloth. Refrigerate mixture for 3 days. Before using, drain mixture and mix in a food processor until fully incorporated. Return mixture to refrigerator for 2 more days. Enjoy.

title: The Perfect Cauliflower Pot Roasted
ingredients: 900 g cauliflower or 900 g cauliflower | 150 -230 g leeks ( sliced on the diagonal from root to tip ) | 2 tablespoons mixed spice | 1 1/2 tablespoons white chocolate | 2 teaspoons onion salt | 1 -2 tablespoon tea | 600 ml tomato juice ( approximately ( or stock ) | 3 egg yolks
instructions: Remove the core and hard stem from the cauliflower and shred it. Place in a large roasting tray, and add any other ingredients apart from the egg yolks, which have been whisked with about 1/4 cup or more of stock. Put in the oven, or until the cauliflower is completely cooked. Boil up with 2 - 3 pints of boiling water, then leave to simmer for about 30 minutes or until it is completely cooked. Remove from the oven, and strain the cauliflower through a colander, and place the water back on the stove over medium heat. If needed, add more stock or water until the sauce starts boiling. Beat the egg yolks and gradually add about 1 1/2 tablespoons of stock from the kettle. Do not boil add to the pot stirring quickly and continuously over low heat until thickened and creamy. Do not boil over. Strain to remove lumps and add the sauce to it. Stir the egg yolk mixture and quickly fold into the sauce, reheating slightly.

Random Ingredients: green onion,chia seed,greek yogurt,arborio rice,vegetable oil,pepper,red wine vinegar
title: Rice and Chia Onions
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup carnaroli rice, cooked ( 2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/3 cup chia seeds ( golden raisins ) | 4 -5 green onions, thinly sliced or 3/4 cup frozen sliced green onions | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh ground pepper | chia seeds ( optional, to garnish ) or sesame seeds ( optional, to garnish )
instructions: Saute rice in hot oil in a 4 - 8 quart pot. When rice starts to darken, add chia seeds, green onions, vinegar and pepper.

Random Ingredients: matzo meal,chocolate,coconut oil,oil olive,italian parsley,beer,rye bread,mascarpone cheese
title: Brown Bagels (Bread Pigs)
ingredients: 1/2/3 cup beer ( we like red, but other beer will do ) | 2 tablespoons oil ( we use olive ) | 12 soft light rolled matzo meal ( use matzos meal ) | 1/4 cup grated coconut oil | 12 soft light rolled matzos dough balls | 1 carton mascarpone cheese | 1 cup packed italian parsley, finely chopped | 8 ounces unsalted organic shaved semisweet chocolate ( about 2 cups )
instructions: Poke a hole in the center of 3/4 cup of matzo meal with a fork and spread it out with your fingers. Dip the matzos into the beer and allow to soak. Place the matzos on a floured surface. Gently shape them into 12 oblong patties. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook the patties until golden on both sides and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Wipe the skillet out with paper towels. In a medium bowl, mix together the mascarpone cheese and 1/2 cup of parsley. Dip each patty in the cheese mixture and then roll them up. Place them seam side down in a baking dish coated with non stick cooking spray. Coat the bottom of a glass baking dish with tomato sauce. Spoon cheese mixture over bread slices and top with the remaining 3/4 cup of parsley. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. Garnish with remaining grated chocolate.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,vanilla sugar,cumin,extra beef,rotel tomato chilies,korma paste,vanilla
title: Spanish Spiced Meat
ingredients: 1 package extra lean ground beef | 2 cans rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 can old el paso brand mild chili sauce ( mild or medium ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 4 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar ( optional )
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef and set aside. Cut rotel into chunks and combine with remaining ingredients into a large bowl and mix well. Add ground beef and allow to sit in bowl together with other ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Smoothie
ingredients: 1 green plantain, ripe peeled and cubed | 1 red chilies, seeded and chopped | 1 cup tasty cheese | 1/2 cup raisins | 36 small bamboo shoots
instructions: To make the smooshie, place the plantain in a bowl and cover with boiling water and soak for 15 minutes. Drain, then squeeze over the bowl of cold water to prevent further draining. Place 2cm slices of grated carrot, diced chilli, zucchini and cheese in the centre of each grated plantain. Top with raisins, then add 5 or 6 small bamboo shoots. Wrap the plantain around each mound of grated carrot, making it neat and snug, leaving plenty of room at the top and possibly a little bit of the rind showing on top. Dry fry gently in batches over a moderately high heat for about 10 minutes, until golden brown on all sides and cooked through. Serve warm.

title: Chile Green Chile Powder
ingredients: 4 green chili peppers, seeded and quartered | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves
instructions: In a nonstick pan, toast the chilies over medium heat, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Quickly stir the chilies into the remaining ground masala.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,kernel corn,hazelnut,lime,tomato green chilies,black eyed pea,peanut butter,russet potato
title: Black Bean Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest | 2 cans chopped ripe tomatoes and green chilies | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 bag russet potatoes, cooked and diced | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 cup sliced ripe hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spread peanut butter into 9x13 baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon zest. In a medium bowl, mix tomatoes with green chilis, corn, and potatoes. Place half of potato mixture over peanuts and spread evenly. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Sprinkle with hazelnuts and bake about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sambal oelek chili paste,avocado oil,oat flour,anchovy,dill seed
title: Sambal Oats
ingredients: 2 cups old fashioned oats flour | 2 tablespoons sambal oelek chili paste ( sambal oelek or chilli paste ) | 1 tablespoon anchovy ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dill seed ( optional ) | 3/4 cup avocado oil, from anchovies toasted ( not virgin )
instructions: Using a food processor, process together one cup of oats oats, the chili paste, anchovy, dill seeds and oil until well blended. Using a teaspoon, gently break up the oat mixture with a fork while slowly crushing in larger pieces. Form dough into a ball. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate approximately 1 hour or until firm.

title: Gluten Free Fried Rice - Risotto With or Without Variation
ingredients: 4 cups cold cooked rice ( i use jasmine rice ) | 3 tablespoons rawspice-based seasoning ( i use creole mixed spice but any will work ) | 2 tablespoons rawspice-based seasoning ( i use mccormick's ) | 1 tablespoon dried culinary lavender | 1 teaspoon toasted ground nutmeg
instructions: Note, you can try using fresh garlic infused spices in place of creole spice to intensify the flavour of the spices but be careful not to use creole spice. If you use dried, the flavour of the dried lavender will overpower any rice krispies you might use.

title: Curry Powder - South African Recipe
ingredients: 500 g chicken thighs, boned | 1/2 teaspoon safflower oil or 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 400 g sugar | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon cocoa powder
instructions: Cut off the bone centre of the chicken thigh and scrape away any excess fat and cut it into 1 inch cubes. Heat oil in a saucepan or heavy bottom skillet over medium high heat and stir fry chicken cubes around 5 minutes add sugar and coco powder and stir until well mixed together.

title: Dark and Stormy Welsh Rarebit (Tiny Cheesy Cracker Cheese Dip)
ingredients: 1/2 lb cheddar cheese | 1 pinch caraway seed | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Slice the cheddar into about 1/4 slices. Sprinkle the cheddar with the caraway seeds. Whisk the dark soy sauce into the soy sauce and pour into a medium size mixing bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients, stirring to coat cheddar. Serve with chips.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,lemon peel,whipping cream,cherry pie filling,taco seasoning,yogurt,salt black pepper,worcestershire sauce
title: Mexican Apricot Cheese Whiskies
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot jam | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 4 cups shredded, un-shredded cheese blend | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | salt and black pepper | 3 tablespoons butter, melted
instructions: In a saucepan, bring jam and taco seasoning to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and continue beating until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in cheese, yogurt, worcestershire sauce, lemon peel, salt and pepper until well blended. Spread into a 9x13 pan. Bake, uncovered at 375 degrees for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Cool at least 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,mexican cheese,tabasco sauce,stewing beef,gingerroot,white flour,tea,tahini
title: Shish Taquitos (Sloppy Joe)
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, minced | 2 garlic cloves, mashed | 2 tablespoons tea | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2/3 cup mexican blend cheese | 4 dashes tabasco sauce
instructions: Slice beef into thin slices not thicker. Mix flour and ginger together and sauté in a large skillet until meat is browned. Add garlic and simmer 5 minutes. Add teabag, tahini and tabasco, bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer 10 minutes. Cool and add the cheese. Cover and chill for 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,lamb,green onion,angel hair pasta,green pepper,cooking spray
title: Baked Lamb with Shellfish
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta, cooked according to package directions and drained | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 3/4 lb uncooked boneless lamb, cut into 1/2-inch-wide strips | cooking spray | 1 medium green pepper, chopped | 3 tablespoons chopped green onions
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions in boiling water. Drain.

title: Dried Beef Liver Burgers
ingredients: 1/4 lb sliced beef liver | 1/8 cup dried white breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons sambal oelek | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried fruit
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Dip in bread crumbs and roll in additional bread crumbs. Place on ungreased grill and cook 5 - 7 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Mini Marshmallows and Raisins
ingredients: 7 ounces mini marshmallows or 7 ounces sweet potato sweet potato chips | 2 1/4 cups raisins | 1 teaspoon mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon chili paste with garlic | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir to coat. Set aside. Place all raisins in medium bowl, add mixture and toss.

title: Chop Veronique
ingredients: 2 pounds pork tenderloin | 2 oranges, zest of
instructions: Cut the pork into 1 inch slices. Dip the slices in lemon zest and deep fry in hot fat until golden brown, turning once. Remove to a platter and serve.

title: Chutney Crusted Pork Loin - Gluten Free
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper, plus extra | cayenne pepper, for sprinkling | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme | 2 teaspoons fennel, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped | 8 ounces boneless pork loin, trimmed | 2 tablespoons oil ( if you don't have this, a pinch of salt will do ) | 1/2 cup mango chutney, heaped | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped ( you may use 2 teaspoons of dried )
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 325°f. Coarsely grind the fennel, cayenne pepper, thyme, fennel seed, salt and pepper in a spice or coffee grinder, then combine with the chives. Score the loin by making deep parallel cuts about three quarters of the way down the length of the loin to within 1 cm of the bottom. Heat the oil in a non stick frying pan over medium heat. Cook the slices for 3 minutes on each side or until lighty golden brown. Drain the pork, then transfer to a baking tray. Bake in the oven for 25 - 30 minutes or until cooked through. Let stand for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the chutney and thyme in a small saucepan. Bring to the boil, then stir in the chopped fennel and chopped thyme. Gently pour the chutney sauce over chops, sprinkle with cayenne pepper, and then sprinkle with extra pepper. Serve with wedges of french bread or mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,parmesan cheese,lime zest,chickpea,pecorino romano cheese,parmigiano reggiano cheese,parsnip,golden raisin
title: Pasta with Chick-Pea Pesto
ingredients: 3 large parsnips | 1/2 lime, juice of | 12 cloves garlic | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup dried pimento-stuffed olives, chopped | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped parsley | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: Peel, core, and cut each parsnip in half lengthwise. Cut parsnips lengthwise into 4 to 6 wedges. Using a mandoline or knife, slice each wedge lengthwise into very thin slices. Slice garlic in half and set aside. Squeeze the juice of the lime into a small bowl and add in the garlic cloves, oil from the jar, raisins, olives, cheese, parsley, and lime zest. Whisk to combine, then stir in the parmigiano reggiano. Add the parsley mixture and stir well to combine. Serve at room temperature or serve cold on your preference.

title: Beef Hot Water Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck | 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon chili pepper | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 cup dried fruit ( apricots, peaches, bananas )
instructions: Combine the beef in a large pot and add the oil. Let sit for 3 hours if possible. Add all ingredients and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer until meat is tender. Enjoy this with toast, french bread or bread. Add salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: sugar,ranch dressing mix,coriander seed,chicken leg,romano cheese
title: Crock Pot  Chicken Parmesan (With Ranch Sauce)
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken legs or 4 lbs chicken thighs | 1 package ranch dressing mix ( 2 packages ) | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds ( optional ) | 2/3 cup freshly grated romano cheese | 2 tablespoons sugar ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken breast side up in a 9x13 inch baking dish or crock pot.

title: Brasundi
ingredients: 2 pounds beef chuck steak, finely diced | 1/4 cup milk chocolate | 1/4 cup melted butter, or as needed | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( optional )
instructions: Place the chuck steak in a shallow bowl and spread with butter. Add the curry powder and milk chocolate stir well to combine. Pour the mixture onto a plate and refrigerate until cold, about 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,garlic clove,cream mushroom soup,cornflour,jalapeno sauce,prawn,tomato soup
title: Australian Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1 lb prawns, precooked and shelled ( approx 12 ) | 150 g cream of mushroom soup | 150 g shredded italian parsley ( approx 2.5 bunches ) | 150 ml crushed tomatoes in tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons jalapeno sauce | 60 g cornflour | 4 garlic cloves, crushed
instructions: Drain the prawns. Mix all the other ingredients together and leave in fridge if you're ready to serve. Barbecue the prawns in a grill until the prawns turn light pink. Serve with lots of crusty bread. Great with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: white rice,chili pepper flake,quinoa,linguine,mayonnaise,spanish onion,bicarbonate soda,zucchini
title: Chili Mayonnaise
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 50 g lemons, juice of or 50 ml white wine | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 large spanish onion, sliced | 1 medium zucchini, sliced | 100 g quinoa or 100 g brown rice
instructions: Cook linguine as directed. Drain and set aside. In food processor add chilli and 1/2 of the onions and puree. Add dressing and rest of onion, zucchini, quinoa and rest of ingredients, mix well, serve on a bed of pasta and top with reserved dressing.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,romaine lettuce leaf,yeast,chili powder,beef,fish sauce,chicken breast
title: Vietnamese Pizza
ingredients: 2 cups bread dough | 2 tablespoons dried yeast | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 2 1/2 cups warm-tasting chicken breast, shredded and lightly mixed with | fish sauce | corn flakes ( optional ) | romaine lettuce leaf ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven. Grease a large and high sided pizza pan. In large mixing bowl, mix together chicken and flour to make dough. Sprinkle dough with a little bit of the chili powder. Stir in chicken and sprinkle on salt, cover with plastic wrap and set aside to rest.. After half an hour, punch dough out onto clean surface. Spread dough out on pizza pan and spread over chicken mixture. Sprinkle dough with corn flakes, if using and top with any optional toppings. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes, or until crust is crusty and crispy. Remove from oven and let cool for 5 - 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Yogurt-Lime Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups plain fat-free yogurt | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice, or to taste | 1 lime wedge | 2 prepared pizza crusts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Toss the yogurt with orange juice and zest in a bowl, and spoon into the prepared prepared pizza crust. Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is heated through, about 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,white bread,chili oil,apricot,feta cheese,orange
title: Jungle Stuffing (Veggies!)
ingredients: 8 slices white bread, crusts removed | 50 g diced apricots | 50 g chopped feta cheese | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon ground scotch bonnet pepper | 1 teaspoon grated orange rind
instructions: If using bread cut into 3cm cubes, cut into 3cm pieces.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,lettuce,spice,ginger garlic paste,asparagus,mayonnaise,cooking sherry,yellow squash
title: Taste of Summer Salad (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 lb asparagus | 1 cup yellow squash | 1/4 cup rice flour | 1/4 cup cooking sherry | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 1 3/4 cups mayonnaise | lettuce
instructions: Break the woody ends off the asparagus and cut into 1/2 inches pieces. Place the asparagus and squash in a steamer basket over boiling water, bring back to a boil. Cook for 1 or 2 minutes, just until tender crisp. Remove from the water, place in a bowl of ice water, and let stand about 30 minutes or until cool and easily chopped. Drain well, cut in half and arrange on a serving plate or other serving serving dish. Sprinkle the remaining ingredients over the top and serve.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,curry leaf,rice wine,stout beer,self raising flour,grain white rice,rib roast,gouda cheese
title: Gouda Beef Rolls
ingredients: 6 ounces short-grain white rice | 1 1/4 lbs short rib roast | 8 flour tortillas | 2 ounces mild gouda cheese | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon curry leaf ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups guinness stout or 1 1/2 cups other dark beer | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Cook the rice with the lamb for 40 mins, cut the meat into small pieces and then into cubes. Brown the meat in the cast iron skillet, stirring, and cook until well browned and cooked through. Drain off any excess fat. Mix together the flour and curry powder. Tip the rice and lamb into the cast iron skillet, add the flour mixture and stir until all the flour is absorbed. Tip in the guinness, cover and cook for 10 minutes. Serve immediately on top of the rice and with a few warmed flour tortillas, breads, steamed greens or tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,swiss chard,pork sausage,jalapeno pepper
title: Spicy Mexican Stuffed Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, chopped, stems reserved | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese, divided | 1/2 lb pork sausage | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to cook sausage and jalapeno pepper in large nonstick skillet with a lid over medium high heat, stirring occasionally until sausage is well mixed and sausage is no longer pink. Transfer sausage mixture to a bowl.

title: Sour Orange Baby Carrots
ingredients: 3 cups water ( approximately 110 degrees fahrenheit ) | 1 lb baby carrots, washed and sliced thin ( about 12 medium carrots ) | 1/2 large orange, peeled, including the peel, sections and zest from about 1 orange | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg ( i used about 1/4 teaspoon )
instructions: Heat 3 cups water and the orange zest in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat until the water is boiling. Add the carrots and reduce heat to medium and simmer until carrots are lightened, 30 to 45 minutes, stirring often.. When done, transfer the carrots to a bowl and cool them on a rack. Meanwhile, skim about 1 cup of the boiling water from the surface. When the carrots are cool, slip off the peel and discard, and then transfer the carrots to a bowl or serving platter, reserving the liquid in the skillet. Place the orange zest, 4 teaspoons of the freshly grated nutmeg, and 1/4 teaspoon of salt in a fine mesh sieve set over a medium bowl, and press with the back of a spoon against the side of the bowl to extract as much liquid as possible. Stir the zest into the carrots and add 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon of pepper. Taste, adjust seasoning and serve.

title: Raspberry and Turmeric Butter
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon margarine or 1 -2 tablespoon goat fat | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 fresh raspberries or 1 frozen raspberries, rinsed and trimmed | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Melt the margarine in a frying pan. Stir in the turmeric, add the drained diced raspberries and simmer until most of the juice is released. Cool slightly, stir in salt and pepper. Keep warm until ready to use.

title: Grape Leaves
ingredients: 1 jar grape leaves | 1/2 cup prepared mustard ( or 1/4 cup dry mustard powder ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 can rotel or ( 11 ounce ) can hot v8 juice
instructions: Rinse and drain the grape leaves. Lay them out on a work surface, slightly overlapping. Spread the mustard on the inside of the leaves and on the outside of the leaves to create a flat base of mustard that covers the base of the leaves. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients and press the edges. Wet the leaves with water if necessary, then fold over. Press well, and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Creamy Sweet & Sour Pork
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamari | 1 cup fat-free low-sodium chicken broth | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock or 2 tablespoons low sodium chicken broth | 1/4 - 1/3 cup sliced pickled peas | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 cup nonfat plain yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Whisk first 3 ingredients together in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,catsup,lime,chicken breast,hamburger bun,chocolate pudding mix,yogurt,mango
title: Tropical Mango Chicken
ingredients: 600 g chicken breasts ( cut into strips ) | 100 g instant chocolate pudding mix | 1/3 cup catsup | 1/2 cup honey | 1/2 cup lime juice or 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional ) | hamburger bun | mango, slices
instructions: Spray non stick frypan with cooking oil, heat over medium and sprinkle chicken breast with powdered sugar when chicken becomes golden brown place on a plate and keep warm in the oven on low. When chicken is cooked remove from the oven and keep aside. In the same pan put the chocolate pudding mix, catsup, honey, lime or lemon juice, essence and vanilla. Stir over low heat until dissolved and cook on high for 5 minutes remove from heat and add to the chicken mixture and mix well. Serve with hamburger buns.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,parsnip,red wine,dark beer,sauce,yellow cherry tomato,beef sirloin,garlic salt
title: Beef Sirloin With Cherry Tomatoes & Green Chili Peppers
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic salt | 1 lb boneless beef sirloin | 1 cup green chili pepper, diced | 1 cup yellow cherry tomato, halved | 2 tablespoons dried parsnips | 3 tablespoons red wine or 3 tablespoons white wine | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( my preference ) | 2 teaspoons dark beer ( optional )
instructions: Rub garlic salt into beef and sear on all sides in a cast iron skillet. Remove beef and reduce heat to medium. Add chilies, tomato halves, parsnips, wine, hot sauce and beer and cook 3 - 5 minutes. Return beef and stir well. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 3 - 5 hours or until beef is tender. Serve over noodles and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,white onion,mustard,lemon peel,kidney bean,sunflower seed,prosciutto,creole seasoning
title: Ham and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb wide egg noodles | 1 small white onion, chopped | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 lb thin slices prosciutto or 1/4 lb salami, chopped | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 2 tablespoons creole mustard | 3 teaspoons lemon peel, grated
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and cool. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl and stir through, being careful not to break up noodles as much as possible. Add noodles back to bowl. Enjoy,.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,red bell pepper,hot chili sauce,tahini,beer,pepper flake,provolone cheese
title: Cheesy Mexican Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces wide egg noodles, cooked, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1 cup beer | 2 tablespoons spicy hot chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 3 ounces provolone cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup red bell pepper, finely chopped
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine noodles, tahini, beer, chili sauce and pepper flakes. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes or until sauce thickens slightly. Cool. Sprinkle the noodles with cheese, and arrange the bell pepper on top. Serve at once.

title: Beef Filler Cups
ingredients: 8 ounces thinly sliced corned beef | 24 sugar snap peas | 2 tablespoons ground cumin | 2 tablespoons onion powder
instructions: Cut the brisket across the grain into very thin slices and set aside. In a large bowl, toss the sugar snaps with the cumin and onion powder. Place the beef in the sugar snaps and toss to coat. Transfer the beef to the paper lined muffin tins and bake at 350°f for 20 - 30 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Italian Pork Skewers
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 jar apricots, drained and coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut french bread loins in half lengthwise. Slice pork into 1/2 inch wide slices. Thread pork slices onto skewers accordion style. Place skewers in a shallow pan or plate. Cover and marinate overnight, turning occasionally. In a shallow skillet, cook apricots in hot syrup over medium heat just until tender. Drain. Remove from heat and spoon apricots over skewers. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,half,artichoke heart,white bread flour,rice,sherry wine,red pepper,garam masala
title: Bread Machine Pearl Onions (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons white bread flour | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon vinegar | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper ( optional ) | 2 artichoke hearts, thinly sliced, for added flavor ( optional )
instructions: Place all the ingredients into your bread machine in order suggested by the manufacturer. Choose the white bread or flour and vinegar and push start or stir. When the bread machine completes, add the artichokes and allow to heat through. Do not allow to boil.

title: Swiss Beef Tenderloin With Cucumber Relish
ingredients: 2 slices swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons cucumbers, quartered lengthwise and thinly sliced ( i prefer english cucumbers ) | 1/4 teaspoon rubbed sage | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 lb thinly-sliced beef tenderloin
instructions: On a cutting board, sprinkle the cheese with 1/8 tsp salt. Arrange half the cucumber lengthwise around the cheese. Sprinkle with 1/4 tsp rubbed sage, the 1 tbsp curry powder, and the 1/2 tsp salt. Add the beef and cut in 3/4 inch cubes. Arrange the cubes on the cheese and sprinkle with the remaining 1/8 tsp rubbed sage and 1/4 tsp salt. Grill the beef to desired doneness, about 15 minutes on each side for rare, longer for medium, or longer for medium well. Serve with the cucumber relish.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,chunky peanut butter,mustard seed,green chili salsa,saffron,red potato
title: Chunky-Peanut-Saffron Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes | 2 -3 tablespoons good mild green chili salsa | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1/8 teaspoon saffron, dissolved in 1/8 cup hot water | 4 tablespoons good chunky peanut butter | 2 teaspoons malt vinegar or 2 teaspoons cider vinegar
instructions: Cut the peeled potatoes length wise into 1/8 inch slices, then into 1/8 inch rounds or into 1 inch lengths. Place on lighly greased cookie sheet and bake in a 325 degree oven for about 15 to 20 minutes. When done, rinse in a strainer under cold water. Cool potatoes slightly and then cut into pieces with a mandolin or a sharp knife. Toss potatoes with salsa, mustard seeds& saffron. Toss with peanut butter. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,rib eye,kalamata olive,bratwurst,pink grapefruit,serrano pepper,sausage
title: Grilled Beef Sandwich With Fresh Sausage, Grapefruit, and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 boneless rib-eye | 1/4 lb fresh sausages, about 2 to 4 ounces each ( johnsonville is also good ) | 12 leaves good quality kosher pink grapefruit | 6 ounces good-quality dark chocolate, such as lindt | 2 fresh serrano peppers, stemmed, seeded, and minced | 12 kalamata olives, sliced | 2 fresh bratwursts, casing removed, halved lengthwise, with rind, pinning, or 1/2-inch-thick ( claussen is a good brand )
instructions: Grill the beef. Rub the grill rack with a little oil. Turn the meat and place it directly over the heated grate. Grill until the meat registers 125 degrees on an instant reading thermometer, about 1 to 2 minutes per side. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, melt the chocolate with the serrano peppers, chilies, and olives over moderate heat, stirring, until thick and smooth. Drain the beef on a rack set over a piece of parchment paper and place it on a board with a rim.

Random Ingredients: italian flat leaf parsley,large mushroom,turmeric powder,black cardamom pod,cherry tomato,basmati rice
title: Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 4 cups cooked basmati rice ( about 1 small bag ) | 2 medium cherry tomatoes, halved | 8 large fresh large mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian flat leaf parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 2 black cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line rimmed baking sheet with foil. Place rice on baking sheet, spread into 8 evenly spaced half moons. Bake in preheated oven until crispy, about 15 minutes. Transfer to plate and set aside. Increase oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Place cherry tomatoes cut side up on aluminum foil. Bake until tomatoes are softened and pliable, about 8 minutes. Remove foil and tomatoes and set aside. Place mushrooms, parsley, turmeric, and black cardamom in food processor. Process 1 minute or until ground. Divide rice and tomatoes between 2 serving dishes and surround with mushroom mixture.

title: Vanilla Bean Bread
ingredients: 100 g cornmeal | cooking oil | 1 vanilla beans ( split ) or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ( split ) | 1 3/4 cups maraschino cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Mix cornmeal with oil and vanilla extract. Cut vanilla bean into halves and add them into the wet ingredients. Using a spoon, scrape the seeds into a bowl or cup and add the cherries. Using a wet spoon spread the batter evenly on the cornmeal mixture to make a smooth round bread. Place all pieces on a baking tray. Bake for 40 minute.

title: Gravlax Salad (Pittsburgh Style)
ingredients: 15 ounces pierogies | 3 tablespoons guacamole | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 3 tablespoons pierogies | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 2 tablespoons guacamole, for dipping
instructions: Cut pierogies into wedges. Place in bowl. Mix in 1 t. Guacamole. Sprinkle with 1 t. Cumin. Mix and coat pierogies with guacamole.

title: Baked Ricotta Corn Relish
ingredients: 2 packages coleslaw mix | 1 cup dry mustard powder | 1/2 cup tapioca starch | 5 ounces ricotta cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare corn relish according to package directions, omitting any oil. Dissolve mustard in tapioca starch in a small bowl, then stir in cheese. Spread coated relish onto a cookie sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until lightly browned. Cool. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,horseradish,peach schnapps,ladyfinger,spanish onion,baby spinach
title: Peach & Horseradish Tarts
ingredients: 100 g peach schnapps ( or peach schnapps ) | 200 g green curry paste ( huy fong brand ) | 250 g baby spinach | 100 g sweet spanish onions, finely chopped | 100 g ladyfingers | 1 fresh peach, very thinly sliced and toasted
instructions: To make the peach schnapps, combine all ingredients in an earthenware baking dish large enough to hold them. Cover tightly with foil and cook at 180c c for 15 minutes. Set aside to cool slightly. While the vegetables are cooking, toast the schnapps until fragrant. Use a coffee knife to score the sponge base of each tart. Spoon the peach schnapps filling into the softened schnapps. Arrange the sponge around the base of the pastry. Dollop any extra peach slices over the surface of each tart. Serve at room temperature note. This tart will keep for up to 6 days. Horseradish and curry flavour, place all the ingredients in a food processor and blitz until smooth and creamy.

title: Italian Inn Fresh Garlic Paste
ingredients: 6 garlic cloves | 2 1/2 lbs dried italian firm cured pork loin or 2 1/2 lbs pork loin
instructions: Place garlic and 1/2 inch oil in a food processor or blender and process until well mixed. With machine running, drop half of paste into a hot small frying pan over low heat for 10 seconds. Quickly drop the garlic into the remaining paste. Pour 3/4 to 1/2 cup water into the frying pan and cover. Simmer 20 minutes or until pork is very tender. Remove from heat. Cool completely for several hours. When ready to use, drain garlic. Using a long kitchen towel, pat dry the bread with paper towels until it is completely dry. Cut loin into thin slices, arrange them on a serving platter and pour oil and garlic mixture over. Let cool and then place slices on top of the garlic to be used at christmastime.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,red curry paste,fillet salmon,asian fish sauce,sparerib,mascarpone
title: Thai Style Skewered Spareribs With Mascarpone Nests
ingredients: 2 lbs fillets salmon | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 8 cups cooked spareribs | 8 ounces mascarpone | 2 tablespoons asian fish sauce | 1/4 cup salted roasted cashew nuts, toasted
instructions: Cut salmon into 1 inch cubes. Place salmon, curry paste, spareribs, mascarpone cheese, fish sauce and cashew nuts in large bowl. Toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate. To serve, remove salmon from fridge 10 minutes prior to serving to allow flavors to mingle and flavors to mingle. Thread onto skewers.

title: White Beans Salad
ingredients: 2 cans white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon dried lavender flowers | 4 cups mixed fresh fruit, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together 1 can white beans, the lavender flowers and the remaining can of beans. Stir in the chopped fresh fruit. Cover tightly and refrigerate about 1 hour or until the flavors develop.

title: The Best Mustard Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, cut into 1/4-inch thick pieces ( or other tender steak ) | 3 tablespoons mustard powder
instructions: Spread the mustard powder on both side of your meat. Place meat in a shallow, non porous bowl. Pour the mustard on top of the meat. Cover with foil and let sit at room temperature for 48 hours. Bring to room temperature before grilling. Grill over hot coals, or in a smoker on lower level.

title: Beef and Cranberry Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli floret | 1 can hominy, drained | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 package shredded leftover cooked roast beef | 3/4 cup shredded low-fat ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup chopped green onions | 3/4 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook broccoli for about 2 minutes, then remove and let cool. Reserve 1 cup of the broccoli water. Pour the remaining water into a pot of boiling water, and cook broccoli for 10 minutes. Place the turkey into the crock of a slow cooker set to low. In a small bowl, mix the sour cream and cooked broccoli and hominy together. Stir in the sour cream, beef, ricotta cheese, green onions, and roasted broccoli. Pour turkey mixture into the slow cooker, and stir to combine. Cover the cooker, and set on high for 4 hours. Sprinkle with walnuts, and serve.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,half cream,cream,chili pepper flake,sesame oil,brown sugar
title: Mexican Style Queso
ingredients: 2 cups half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | chili pepper flakes | monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Mix the half and half, sour cream, sugar and chili flakes together in a bowl until combined well. Pour into a greased quiche pan that has been sprinkled with grated cheese. Top with grated cheese. Bake in a 400 degree f oven until hot and bubbling, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,date,italian sausage,pasta,salt pepper,peppercorn,vegetable oil,chinese noodle
title: Chinese Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 lbs ground sirloin or 2 lbs mild italian sausage | 1 1/2 quarts rich vegetable stock or 1 1/2 quarts low sodium vegetable broth | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1/2 cup dried chinese noodles ( soaked in hot water for 3-8 minutes and then drained ) or 1/2 cup thin spaghetti noodles ( soaked in hot water for 3-8 minutes and then drained ) | salt and pepper | 3 cups day old cooked chinese noodles ( also called noodle sticks ) | 4 peppercorns
instructions: Toast the peppercorns in a skillet over medium low heat until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind or grind peppercorns to a fine powder. Cut the sausage in thin 1 inch pieces. Heat the oil in a heavy large dutch oven or soup pot over medium low heat. Add the sausage and cook until lightly browned, breaking it into small crumbles, about 10 minutes. Add the stock& 1 cup water or broth, curry powder and chinese noodles and bring to a simmer. Add the peppercorns and simmer for 1 hour. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,tomato green chilies,pistachio,sea salt,ice,corn tortilla chip
title: MEXICAN Flag Dessert
ingredients: 2 lbs tomatoes and green chilies, diced | 1/2 cup sea salt | 1/2 lb dark chocolate or 1/2 lb semisweet chocolate, finely chopped | 1/4 cup shelled pistachios, ground | crushed ice | corn tortilla chips
instructions: Microwave tomatoes and chilies on high power for 15 - 20 seconds or until just heated. Stir to combine. Add salt, chocolate, pistachios and ground nuts. Turn heat down to medium. Microwave on high power for 5 minutes, stirring every 20 seconds until melted and smooth. Pour into large serving bowl. Dip rim of four serving glasses in melted chocolate. Coat with crushed ice. Dip in crushed ice if desired. Serve with crushed ice and crushed tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: salmon,beef bouillon cube,red pepper flake,pepper sauce
title: Easy Beef Broth
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb fresh salmon, skin on, cut into chunks ( or use fish, shrimp or salmon ) | 1/2 cup beef bouillon cube | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon dried hot red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon dash bottled hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in your slow cooker, put on high for 6 - 7 hours. Turn after 6 hours, turn on hard, remove salmon and put back into slow cooker. Serve over your favourite white or brown rice. This will have gravy as the base of the finished broth as well as a nice crusty loaf of bread to soak up all the gravy, if desired.

title: Sweet and Mild Turnips
ingredients: 3/4 cup mango chutney | 2 cups turnips
instructions: Wash and trim turnips. Cut into large chunks and put into a large saucepan with mango chutney and bring to a boil. Add turnips and simmer for 10 minutes until turnips are tender.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,calvados,white rum,chilies,green pepper,walnut oil,golden raisin
title: Walnut Paste (Raw Food)
ingredients: 1 cup fresh coriander seed | 1 cup walnut oil | 1 large green pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon red jalapenos or 1 tablespoon green chilies, chopped | 1/4 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 1/2 cup white rum ( dark rum can also be used in this recipe ) | 2 tablespoons calvados ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons amaretto ( optional )
instructions: Rinse coriander and walnuts.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,hamburger bun,white wine,banana pepper,cocoa powder,green chilies
title: Hot Chocolate - Green Chili Con Carne (Chile Con Carne)
ingredients: 8 ounces mild boneless hamburger buns, lightly toasted ( 2 1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 16 ounces canned whole green chilies, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder ( preferably dutch-process ) | 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 16 ounces bananas peppers, sliced ( about 4 cups )
instructions: Cut burger bread diagonally into 3/4 inch thick slices. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in skillet, add chiles and cook over medium heat until softened, about 2 minutes. Add cocoa powder and stir for a minute or two, then add the wine and chilies. Cut the bananas in half lengthwise and slice open lengthwise. Arrange a slice of banana atop each burger, then drizzle with remaining oil and sprinkle with coconut flakes.

title: Vietnamese Steak for Two
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, sliced thin | 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaf, chopped | 2 slices basil | 2 ounces clam juice or 2 ounces clam juice | 1/3 cup sherry wine ( optional )
instructions: Soak sirloin slices in 2 quarts of cold water for at least 30 minutes. Drain the meat and pat them dry with paper towels. In a large dutch oven or other heavy skillet, combine the lime leaves, basil leaves, and clam juice. Add the sirloin slices and cook over high heat, turning once, until barely done.. Remove from heat and serve hot. Serves.

title: Vanilla Chili Sausage-Crumiri
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, casings removed | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon chili paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large skillet over medium high heat and bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes.

title: Sparkling Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1/4 cup sweet onion, finely minced | 2 tablespoons port wine or 2 tablespoons other dark dry red wine
instructions: Heat jam in small saucepan over medium heat until jam is warmed and begins to caramelize but not burnt. This should take about 10 minutes. Reduce heat.

title: Japanese Orzo and Orzo Salad
ingredients: 1 cup orzo pasta | 1/2 cup dry butyaki-dashi ( may use instant-dashi in a miso soup can )
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water and orzo to a boil. Cook the butyaki dashi orzo at a boil until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and allow to cool. Crumble the orzo into the bowl of a blender. Add the nori and miso soup and process until smooth. Transfer to a large salad bowl, sprinkle with the reserved tablespoon of miso soup and stir to blend.

title: Oven Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | kalamata olives, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Place the jasmine rice on a baking sheet and lightly toast under the broiler. Watch closely, for no darker than 1 minute. Remove the rice to a bowl and pour a small amount of oil to coat the surface of the rice. Turn the rice, letting excess drip off.

title: Simple Teriyaki Beef  Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 lb skirt steak | cooking spray | fresh vegetables ( your choice, i just used a mix of green leafy vegetable ) | soya sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients in a medium size bowl and refrigerate overnight. Skewer meat on the diagonal. Grill or broil as desired, or broil in oven until desired doneness, about 4 - 6 minutes. Variation, if you omit or increase the amount of marinade used, you can make teriyaki sauce with some white balsamic vinegar.

title: Couscous - Middle Eastern
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons ground cardamom seed | 1/4 cup couscous, prepared and heated
instructions: Place the cardamom seeds in a small frying pan, and toast over low heat until they darken to brown, 4 to 6 minutes. Spread the toasted cardamom seeds on a plate, and place them in a small frying pan and toast over low heat until they darken, about 10 minutes. Combine the cardamom flavored seeds with the hot couscous in a small bowl. When the couscous begins to toast, pour about 1 tablespoon of the hot couscous into the bowl with the hot cardamom oil to a depth of 1/3 inch. Using a fork, mix thoroughly, then spoon the couscous into a medium bowl. Spread a little more than half the hot couscous onto an unlined plate until it begins to swell slightly, then gently mound 1/2 the couscous onto the dish, spreading it out as best you can. Allow to cool completely, about 1 hour. Fluff with a fork before serving.

title: Feta Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 flour tortillas
instructions: Spread cheese onto tortilla. Sprinkle feta cheese onto cheese. Wrap and place on large non stick pan. Microwave on high 1 - 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Cut into slices to serve.

Random Ingredients: double cream,cake flour,rice vinegar,white sugar,coleslaw mix
title: Sweet and Sour Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 cups packaged coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 pinch white sugar | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1/4 cup double cream
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together coleslaw mix, rice vinegar and sugar.

Random Ingredients: pre,onion salt,cream mushroom soup,serrano chilies,leg veal,chicken thigh
title: Crock Pot Carnitas Congee
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless legs of veal, cubed | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can chicken thigh, chopped | 1 serrano chilies or 2 jalapeno chilies, seeded and minced | prepared quick | salt
instructions: Place all ingredients except the stew meat in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 8 - 9 hours. Remove bones & skin from meat if desired. Serve with tortillas, beans, rice or spanish rice. Garnish with spanish hot paprika & shredded cheese, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,lettuce leaf,oregano,angel food cake,ra el hanout spice mix,mace,bamboo shoot
title: Grilled Fresh Lamb Salad
ingredients: 1 medium star shaped lettuce leaf, such as boston or bibb | 4 slices lamb or 4 thin sliced lamb, of desired length | 1/2 cup prepared ras el hanout spice mix | 1/2 cup seedless bamboo shoot, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, lightly crushed ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace or 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Place lettuce leaves in shallow dish or platter. Place lamb on top of lettuce leaves and drizzle ras el hanout on top and sides of meat. Sprinkle the salad with mixed spices. Sprinkle olives over. Sprinkle a few cardamom seeds on top of salad. Cover and refrigerate up to 8 hours before serving. Serve hot.

title: Cumin-Spiced Roasted Shallots
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 pinch cream of tartar | salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add cumin and salt, then stir in the cream of tartar and let simmer, stirring constantly, until cream begins to thicken slightly, about 5 minutes. Pour into a paper cone with a metal tip. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,chick pea,cherry tomato,philadelphia cream cheese,dijon mustard,scallion,vegetable stock
title: Roasted Chickpeas on Creamy White Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup vegetable stock | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 7 scallions, chopped | 10 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary leaf | 8 ounces cherries in light syrup, sliced and patted dry
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spread chickpeas into a large baking pan or baking sheet. Drizzle with vegetable stock. Bake 30 minutes. Remove and cool, stirring occasionally. Stir in mustard, scallions and cream cheese until smooth, about 5 minutes. Stir in rosemary and remove from heat. Drizzle with patted dry dressing. Cool to room temperature. Strain chickpeas and discard solids. Spread on tzatziki. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 20 minutes. Serve with a scattering of cherry tomatoes on top.

title: Mexi-Meatballs (Mexi Meatballs)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground meat | 1 can fat-free half-and-half | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package sun-dried tomato packed in oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat oven to brown meat in non stick skillet. Drain off fat. Mix in half & half, taco seasoning mix and tomatoes. Put meat into 9x13 pan.

Random Ingredients: chuck steak,green chili pepper,coconut,nonfat yogurt,black pepper,swiss cheese,garlic granule,plum sauce
title: Swiss Cheese Burgers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garlic granules | 1 1/4 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit, chopped ( plums, apricots, raisins, red snipped grapes ) | 1 canned green chili peppers, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup bottled plum sauce | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | freshly shredded swiss cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, combine garlic granules. Add meat, fruit, chilies, cheese, yogurt, pepper and salt and mix until ingredients are evenly blended. Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes or until meat is thoroughly cooked. Serve as is, or press mixture into rolls.

title: Yummy Slow Cook Beef Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons gingerroot, grated | 1 teaspoon whole chipotle powder | 1 tablespoon molasses | 2 tablespoons pepino jerk spice spices ( available at oriental specialty food store ) | 5 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons jaggery | 3 tablespoons peppercorns | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef flank steak ( cut 2 1/2 in slices )
instructions: Set slow cooker to high. Combine all marinade ingredients in large bowl, then add meat, turning to coat, and let sit for 1 hour covered. Place beef rolls in the slow cooker, placing 2 slits on each side of meat. Add to slow cooker, cover, and cook on low 3 to 4 hours or until meat is tender.

title: Wild Rice With French Onion Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wild rice, uncooked | 1 can condensed french onion soup | 2 ounces uncooked spaghetti sauce
instructions: Prepare rice according to directions on package. Cook spaghetti sauce according to directions on package. Meanwhile, combine all ingredients in crockpot. Cover, cook on low 3 hours.

title: Rice Noodles With Sweet Peas and Sourdough Bread
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 cup sourdough bread, with crusts removed | 4 -5 ounces fresh sugar snap peas | 1/4 cup vinegar | 3/4 cup sugar-free kikkoman vodka
instructions: Place noodles in an 8 x 8 inch pan. Bake in a medium hot oven for 7 to 9 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, drain noodles and reserve the liquid. Coarsely chop noodles, add the water needed to cover the noodles, and cover again. When all ingredients are cooked, divide among 4 serving bowls. To complete the meal, place sourdough bread on plates. Top with sugar snap peas. Drizzle with 1/4 cup reserved noodle liquid, and drizzle with a small amount of sugar free kikkoman vodka if desired. Pass soda bread.

title: Chef Boysen's Steak and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 lbs roast beef, cut into serving size pieces | 4 -6 small cauliflower | 1 bottle of durrant port wine ( use more if you prefer ) | 1 can tuna packed in olive oil, drained and flaked ( not drained ) | 16 ounces frozen mixed vegetables | 2 packages frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Add the vegetables into the pan with the wine and tuna. The vegetables will thaw a bit. Cook in the oven approximately 50 minutes. You may need to take your time if the vegetables are not cooked all the way through.

title: Southern Fried Corn Bread
ingredients: 12 1/2 inches round cornbread, cut into 4 wedges each for frying, warmed | pepper
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Lightly coat the pan with nonstick cooking spray. Working with one piece of cornbread, dip in the hot oil, one piece at a time, flipping once. After a few seconds on each side, remove and discard the cooked bits of cornbread. If the skillet is dry, moisten with the nonstick cooking spray. Lightly coat the fried corn bread with pepper and remove each piece before serving.

Random Ingredients: blackstrap molasses,basmati rice,avocado,juice,sesame oil,chicken stock cube
title: Simple Avocado Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 4 teaspoons blackstrap molasses ( see note below ) | 2 teaspoons lime juice or 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1/4 chicken stock cube | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 ripe avocados or 1/4 fuji pumpkin, cubed
instructions: Place rice and molasses and lime or lemon juice in a small saucepan. Over medium heat, add stock cube and sesame oil. Bring mixture to boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for 25 - 30 minutes or until rice is just tender or fluffable. Add avocado or fuji, and cook 5 minutes or until heated through. Stir rice through. Tip, to save money, feel free to prep your ingredients. Most supermarkets make this rice in advance, and have great rice frozen on the go. It freezes well.

title: Tomato and Porcini Mushroom Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced tomatoes | 1 ounce diced porcini mushroom | 2 teaspoons shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat your grill for medium heat. Mix diced tomatoes with chopped porcini mushrooms and mozzarella cheese. Place the quesadillas in a nonstick skillet, and cook until it is to your desired temperature. To serve, place tomato mixture on top of quesadilla, and drizzle with tomato mixture.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,pecan,dark chocolate,ginger garlic paste,cooking apple,curry powder
title: Fruit Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g cooking apples, peeled, cored and cut into slices | 1 onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup pecans, dryly crushed | 200 g dark chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a ziploc bag. Seal and massage around the bowl for 1 minute to combine. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Prepare a baking tray and place kabobs in the tray. Drizzle with marinade. Place under a preheated grill for 4 - 5 minutes each side or until the apples are tender. Remove from heat and leave to cool for 5 minutes.

title: Coco - Colombian Pecan Candy
ingredients: 1/2 cup soymilk or 1/2 cup milk | 5 ounces semisweet chocolate | 1 egg, well beaten | 1 tablespoon tapioca starch | 1 teaspoon cumin | 0.5 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Put the soymilk or milk in a small saucepan. Set over low heat and leave for about 20 minutes, stirring regularly until the milk has just come to a boil. Meanwhile, melt the chocolate and cream together in a bowl or in your microwave, set aside. Beat in the egg and the tapioca, and sprinkle in the cumin with the frozen phyllo pastry sheets, then set aside. When the milk and chocolate have come to a boil, remove from the heat and stir in the melted chocolate and let cool to room temperature. When set, cut into squares and drizzle with a little more chocolate.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,garam masala,turkey breast tenderloin,red chile,cottage cheese
title: Cheesy Chicken-Turkey Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup shredded reduced-fat mexican cheese blend | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon ground red chile | 1 turkey breast tenderloins, trimmed and cut into 2 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat broiler. Spray large baking sheet with cooking spray. Mix together cottage cheese, mexican blend cheese, garam masala, and red chile in a small bowl. Spread mixture evenly over turkey.

title: Simmered Scalloped Fusilli
ingredients: 12 ounces dry fusilli | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup unbleached all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Oil an 11x7 inch baking dish. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook until tender, stirring occasionally, about 12 minutes. Drain. Transfer to the prepared baking dish. Stir asafoetida into the hot pasta water. Stir in the flour and toss until evenly coated. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Crunchy Rice Salad (Nu Jang Jang)
ingredients: 4 -5 cups fresh baby spinach leaves, loosely packed | 1 - 1 1/2 cup korean sweet rice ( glutinous rice noodles )
instructions: Wash and cut the spinach into 2 inch julienne pieces. Steam over high heat until wilted, about 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in the rice noodles, and let cool. Break apart into bite size pieces when cool.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,lime,black eyed pea,heavy cream,chili powder,breadcrumb,golden raisin,mustard
title: Sesame Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 lb black-eyed peas, washed | 3 tablespoons crushed garlic-flavored dry mustard | 2 tablespoons minced cayenne chili powder | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons finely chopped peeled lime | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil
instructions: Soak peas in 6 - 8 gallons of water for 4 hours in a large bowl of ice water. Drain. Place peas in a large dutch oven. Cover with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until peas are tender. Drain, cool, and chop finely. Prepare mustard sauce. Combine mustard/crumb/raisin/poppy seed crumbs, garlic/chili powder/mustard sauce, and the breadcrumbs in a small bowl. Blend in the raisins and the cream. Add the grated lime and the oil. Add peas to the mustard sauce. Sauté a few minutes, then remove from heat. Serve imediately with rice.

title: German Style Ketchup Pickle Spread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups sweet paprika or 1 1/4 cups jalapeno chilies, chopped fine | 3/4 cup ketchup | 1 cup dill pickle, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill until serving time. Serve with vegetables. The spread can be thinned with ketchup or mustard.
