Random Ingredients: sea salt black pepper,black bean,vegetable shortening,portabella mushroom,self raising flour
title: Baked Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 portabella mushrooms | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 4 tablespoons self-raising flour | sea salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 2 tablespoons dried black beans, soaked in water for 15 to 30 minutes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Cut the mushrooms into thin slices. Melt the shortening in a medium size skillet over a medium heat. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring often, until browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in the flour and continue cooking for 1 minute, mixing well. Remove the mushrooms from the heat and add the black beans and stir to distribute their flour over the mushrooms. Transfer the mushroom mixture to a baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender and the topping is golden.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,jalapeno chile pepper,ladyfinger,dark sesame oil,hazelnut
title: Sesame Hazelnut & Cheddar Trifles
ingredients: 250 g jalapeno chile peppers | 250 g smoked cheddar cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | 250 g ladyfingers | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 125 g chopped hazelnuts
instructions: Heat the grill to medium high. Roast the chilis over closed gas flame, turning often, for 10 minutes or until blackened. Drain, cut into 2 pieces, and cut each piece into 4 wedges. Place the chilis and cheese into a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap and chillies for 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, line a large serving platter with kitchen paper. Drizzle about 2 tbsp of sesame oil over the breadcrumbs and then sprinkle with half the nuts. Place the chilis and cheese in the bowl with half the sesame oil and press down well. Cut the remaining half of sesame oil into four wedges in a food processor, season with salt and process into fine breadcrumbs. Dip 1 slice of bread into the bread crumbs and arrange on the plate in 1/2 overlapping rows. Top with remaining bread crumbs and sesame oil. Finish off with remaining nuts, pressing down lightly. Sprinkle the trifles with remaining sesame oil. Serve.

title: Sparkling Snow Peas With Cream and epazote
ingredients: 300 g snow peas ( or any combination of snow peas and fresh chard, chopped ) | 1 sprig epazote
instructions: Rinse, dry and pack peas and epazote into tall glasses with a sprig placed at the top. Pour cream over the peas and leave to macerate for 2 hours. Top with fresh epazote, if using.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,pita bread,celery rib,broccoli floret,coconut milk
title: Pita Broccoli Salad with Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1/4 cup coconut milk | 2 tablespoons broccoli florets, chopped | 1/8 lb asparagus spear, cut diagonally into 1/8 inch slices | 2 celery ribs, cut diagonally into 1/8 inch thick slices | 4 pita bread, halved and heated
instructions: Stir the coconut milk, broccoli and asparagus in a bowl to blend and set aside. Arrange salad greens on 4 plates and top with the coconut milk mixture. Sprinkle with celery slices and serve with pita bread.

title: Budget Noodle Coffee Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef chuck | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 24 marshmallows, chopped | 1 cup brewed coffee | 1/4 cup club soda | 2 packages dry rice vermicelli, cooked until tender, still slightly crisp | 1 jar chestnut, chopped fine
instructions: Combine ground beef, mustard and marshmallows with 1/2 of the coffee and let set 10 minutes. Cook rice vermicelli in remaining coffee and set aside 4 to 6 cups to drain. Drain chestnuts well. Add to meat mixture. Refrigerate 1 hour or more. Shape into 1 cup meatballs and roll up in remaining chopped mushrooms. Refrigerate any leftovers. These freeze well. Note, i've found that they cook the longer they are wrapped inches.

title: Crock Pot Pineapple Nachos
ingredients: 1 bag fresh pineapple tidbits, undrained | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 bag cod, cooked and sliced
instructions: Put all ingredients except fish into crockpot. Cook on low for 8 hours. Take fish out of crockpot and put fish in serving dishes. Spoon on nachos.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,wild rice,bow tie pasta,almond extract,club soda,oat,allspice
title: Wild Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 package bow tie pasta | 1 cup wild rice, rinse and rinsed | 1 tablespoon slivered almonds or 1 tablespoon whole cashews | 1 1/4 cups club soda | 1 1/4 teaspoons almond extract | 1 pinch allspice | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Add balls to ice water so it is about 1 - 2 inches above balls. After 10 minutes or so, they will float and move slightly around the pot. When balls are floating, transfer to bowls that have been buttered on the bottom. Sprinkle top with sesame seeds. Note, i like to serve these in a large mixing bowl. If you have a kitchenaid mixing bowl, this will make more balls, and your balls have enough space to hold them in shape. I prefer to make this with a food processor and it works for us..

title: Simple Thai Daikon Salad
ingredients: 4 cups thinly sliced daikon radishes | 6 tablespoons gluten, subtitute gluten free bread crumbs | 5 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1/2 cup seedless raspberry or 1/2 cup blackberry
instructions: Divide daikon into 4 individual bowls. Sprinkle 3 tablespoons of gluten free crumbs over each and mix thoroughly. Add 2 tablespoons of red curry paste diluted with a little water and 3/4 cup of fruit syrup. Mix. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup of raspberry and 1 teaspoon of sugar.

title: Polenta Crumbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs polenta | 1 pint heavy whipping cream, heated | 1/2 cup dry white breadcrumbs
instructions: Slice the polenta into 1 inch wide ribbons. Working on a floured surface, roll and stretch the polenta into a 3''/8'' thick slab. Using a serrated knife, cut through the slab 3/4 to 3/8''/3''/1 inch thick. Transfer to a platter and let rest 5 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°f and spray a baking sheet with nonstick spray. Briefly heat the cream in a medium skillet. Stir in the bread crumbs. Carefully add the polenta, a few spoonfuls at a time, into the cream and gently toss to coat. Spread the crumbs on the top and sides of the cake. Dot with the reserved crumbs. Let stand 20 minutes. Bake uncovered for about 45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean. Transfer the cake to a baking rack and let cool for 30 minutes and then serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,cilantro leaf,chicken breast,white sugar,canola oil,beef,sherry wine vinegar,kabocha squash
title: Kabocha Squash Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground beef | 1/4 pound kabocha squash, peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves, plus more for garnish | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Heat a dry skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir 1/4 pound kabocha squash and 1 teaspoon vanilla extract into the beef. Drizzle 1 to 2 tablespoons sherry vinegar over the beef and soy mixture.

title: Vegetable-Soy Sauce for Pies
ingredients: 4 -6 cremini mushrooms | 1 cup soy milk
instructions: Take two spoons onto a flat tray and place one teaspoon of soy milk onto each slice piece of mushrooms. Wash hands very thoroughly. Spray the tray with cooking spray and flip the mushrooms. Spray and flip again so that both sides of the mushrooms are evenly coated with soy milk. Place in the refrigerator to marinate. This will give the soy milk flavor to the mushrooms. Enjoy this recipe.

title: Korean Barbecue Hoagies
ingredients: 8 ounces grilled deli ham ( about 6 slices ) | 8 ounces ketchup | 8 ounces ketchup | 8 ounces guacamole | 1 large vanilla bean
instructions: Mix ketchup, ketchup, vanilla bean, and sugar in a bowl.

title: Foolproof Vegetable Korma
ingredients: 5 tablespoons yoghurt | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 4 tablespoons green peas | 2 tablespoons pistachios, chopped
instructions: Mix yoghurt, onion powder and greenpeas together in a bowl. Add chopped pistachios. Refrigerate until required. Serve.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,asiago cheese,kielbasa,orange extract,rib beef,pinto bean
title: Kielbasa and Beef Crockpot
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin, cut in half or 1 small cube | 4 -6 ounces kielbasa ( i buy one at a time precut, slice on the bias ) | 2 packages dried pinto beans | 2 -3 lbs beef tenderloin, sliced in half crosswise | 1 package asiago cheese | 1 teaspoon orange extract
instructions: Put everything in the slow cooker and stir. Cook on high for 1 hour and on the low for until the beans are hot, about 10 - 15 minutes. Note, i usually use a low fat one dish beef broth soup. Enjoy. Serve with cornbread and/or fresh veggies.

title: Brown Lentils with Onions & Garlic
ingredients: 2 large spanish onions, with a little green fronds | 1 3/4 cups brown lentils | 1/2 cup garlic pepper or 1/2 cup minced garlic | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Pick the onion off the stem and peel off the outer layers of the onion with a knife. Cut away any root ends and coarse layers. Place into a saucepan and cover with lightly salted water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat, cover partially and simmer for 2 hours or until the lentils are tender when pierced with a fork. Drain well. Place in a mixing bowl and set aside to cool. When cool, drain well. Preheat the oven broiler. Slice the unpeeled onion into long, thin slices about 3/4 inch wide and set aside. Rinse the sauteed onion under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Place in a baking dish, then arrange on top of the lentil slices. In a bowl, mix the onions, garlic and vanilla, then pour the mixture over the onions and garlic. Bake at 400°f, basting occasionally with the liquid, until bubbling and browned on the edges about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,cardamom seed,pizza crust,quark,wheat tortilla,pecorino romano cheese
title: Grilled Quark Sandwich W- Whole Wheat Tortillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons quark | 1 tablespoon diced pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon whole wheat tortilla | 4 whole wheat tortillas | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 2 teaspoons prepared pizza crusts
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together quark, pecorino romano cheese, whole wheat tortillas, cardamom seeds, and pizza crust. Heat a gas or charcoal grill. Brush half of the sandwich ingredients with remaining quark mixture. Grill the sandwich until the topping is browned.

title: Ethiopian Style Meat Loaf
ingredients: 5 cups cubed rye bread | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 pounds ground pork | 1 small cardamom pod
instructions: Mix ground pork with ginger garlic paste in a saucepan over medium heat. Mix in the cardamom pod. Cover the skillet and allow to simmer slowly for 1 hour. Remove cardamom pod and skim off all the fat. Remove meat to a bowl and cool to room temperature before proceeding. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Mix the bread crumbs with enough water to moisten the bread. Spread bread crumbs on the parchment paper. Place meat on the bread crumbs and pat into an 8 x 8 inch rectangle. Drizzle bread crumbs with a little of the peanut oil. Spread the meat mixture in an even layer on top of the meat. Cut a few slits in the top of the meat, forming diamond shapes with cuts about 1 inch deep and about 1/2 inch wide. Cook meat in preheated oven, then reduce heat to 300 degrees f. Continue cooking 1 1/2 hours, until internal temperature is 160 degrees f when taken on the center of the meat loaf.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,lima bean,chicken breast half,tortilla chip,lamb chop,pine nut,chili powder,gingerroot
title: Lamb and Lima Soup
ingredients: 6 large boneless lamb chops | 1 jar lima beans, undrained | 3 lbs boneless skinless lamb chops | 1/2 vidalia onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, finely grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili powder | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | tortilla chips
instructions: Place the lamb in a large saucepan, add the lima beans and water to cover, bring to a boil, and cook until meat is barely tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and reserve broth. Cube the meat and return it to the pan. Add the onions, ginger, chili powder, pine nuts, and lamb to the pan. Cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes. Serve in a large soup bowl with chips sprinkled on top.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,colby monterey jack cheese,spaghetti,apple juice
title: Quick and Easy Chicken Faux-colby Cheese Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken wings | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 cup colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 package spaghetti
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rub chicken meat with apple juice. Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Lightly sprinkle both sides with cheese. Bake in preheated oven for 45 to 50 minutes, until meat is no longer pink and juices are bubbly.

title: Beer Steak Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves, chopped | 1 lb round steak, thinly sliced | 12 ounces beer | cooking spray
instructions: Place coriander leaves on the flat side of a piece of foil. Place round steak on top, then spoon or spoon beer across the steak. Wrap up the foil and fold the edges so that the round steak is encased. Cook in the preheated moderately hot oven, gas 4, for 1 1/2 2 hours, or until steak is cooked to taste. Spray meat with cooking oil.

title: Steak Hot Pot (Crock Pot or Oven)
ingredients: 1 lb steak, cut into thin strips | 1 lb stewing beef, cut into thin strips | 4 leeks, sliced | 11 whole cloves | 2 bags frozen whole meal tea bags, cooked according to package instructions | 16 fluid ounces teapsoon beef broth ( or water )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tea, beef broth and steaks into a 5 or 6 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low setting for 10 to 12 hours, or until steak and beef are tender. Remove from crock pot and skim off fat. Add beef broth and reheat to serving temperature. Serve in soup bowls or on top of hot steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: vodka,chunky salsa,broccoli,lemon juice,gruyere cheese,sage leaf,allspice berry
title: Broccoli With Fresh Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb fresh broccoli | 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( your favorite ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 ounces gruyere cheese, grated ( about 1 1/2 ounces ) | 1 fresh sage leaf, finely chopped | 1 allspice berries ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon vodka ( optional )
instructions: Wash, peel and cube broccoli, making sure that the florets are not cut or broken. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add broccoli and cook 3 - 5 minutes, until just tender. Drain quickly and transfer to a bowl. Use as the seasoning for the salsa, if desired, for the sweeter berry flavors. Combine salsa, lemon juice, rind, cheese, sage, and allspice in a glass bowl. Stir and refrigerate until cold, about 1 hour. Just before serving, add vodka and stir to mix, or pour into a champagne flute and serve.

title: Pesto Fried Onions (Souvlakia Yahini)
ingredients: 5 large sweet onions ( yiaami ) | 8 tablespoons pesto sauce ( approx 1 1/2 cups )
instructions: Peel and cut onions into fine slices. Slice onions almost completely through the root ends. Place the onions in a small bowl. Sprinkle with salt, making sure you don't wash them. Pour approximately 9 tablespoons of pesto into a large bowl and add the onions, mixing well to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and leave it to marinate for at least 6 hours. The idea is to keep the onions in a dry cupboard and not drain any oil. When ready to fry, heat approximately 3 tablespoons of oil in a large flat skillet over medium high heat. Sear the onions until just limp about 3 minutes, stirring regularly. Transfer the onions to a heated serving plate and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,sugar,tamari,sage leaf,ginger garlic paste,vegetable protein
title: Gluten Free and Dairy Free Teriyaki Sauce for Meatballs and Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 cups steamed vegetables ( chikomars, daikon radishes, cabbage, etc ) | sugar | 3 tablespoons tamari | 4 tablespoons gluten free instant chicken stock | ginger-garlic paste ( garlic ginger and ginger paste ) | 1 teaspoon gluten free instant mixed sprouts ( optional )
instructions: Dice up vegetables thinly. Stir water and tamari in a cup to soften. Add vegetables & sugar. Stir gently until all is mixed. In a food processor or blender, puree mixture. Add ginger garlic and ginger paste & blend again. Add mixed sprouts & blend until all all ingredients are incorporated. Let meatballs cook in sauce until cooked, stirring/beatging occasionally. Serve on individual plates topped with the sauce. Make sure each portion is topped with some extra veggies if desired.

title: Tortilla Pasta With Chili and Chilli
ingredients: 500 g tagliatelle pasta noodles | 1/2 - 1 chili, deseeded and sliced finely | 1 teaspoon dried chili
instructions: Boil the pasta and drain. Pour sauce over the hot pasta. Toss.

title: Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces elbow macaroni | 10 ounces peanut butter | 1 1/4 cups brewed coffee | 6 ounces bacon bits | 4 ounces dried cranberries
instructions: Set aside. Cook elbow macaroni in rapidly boiling water for 5 mins, drain. When done, run under cold water. Place the peanuts and coffee into a food processor or a blender and process until nuts are finely ground. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add the pasta to the boiling water and cook until just tender, about 6 - 8 mins. Drain and stir pasta into peanut sauce. Dot with bacon bits and cranberries. Serve right away. Enjoy.

title: Salsa and Raspberry Jalapeno Skewers
ingredients: 12 slices rye bread, cut 1/2 inch thick | 2 ounces jalapeno peppers, very thinly sliced ( or 2 slices serrano peppers, very thinly sliced ) | 8 fluid ounces mild chunky salsa | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 lime, cut into eight wedges
instructions: Thread 8 - 12 slices of rye bread on 4 wooden skewers. Thread each skewer with 1 or 2 jalapenos slice along one side of each skewer. Place skewers on a grill rack coated with cooking spray and cook over medium high heat, turning as necessary, until lightly toasted and lightly charred, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a serving dish and drizzle with salsa. Serve warm with lime wedges.

title: Fried Rice With Rice Wine (Ngow Num)
ingredients: 6 cups white rice ( uncooked ) | 4 ounces white rice wine ( not cooking wine )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Cut four ½ inch long slits in the rice. Insert a piece of cheesecloth into the slits to relieve pressure. Place rice in a casserole dish. Pour approximately one third of the rice wine into the casserole dish. Cover tightly and place in the oven. Bake for 1½ hours. Remove cheesecloth, uncover and cool rice in refrigerator for 15 - 20 minutes. Transfer to the serving plate and serve.

title: Creamy Pasta Salad
ingredients: 0.5 package mostaccioli pasta ( angel hair ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons wine vinegar
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on package. After about 7 minutes, drain. Place back in pot and add vinegar. Cover the entire bowl with cold water. Let stand about 3 minutes, then drain. Add pasta and remaining ingredients, to mix.

title: Lek-Liver Filled Clams in Syrup
ingredients: 1 lb chopped mixed frozen clams | 8 ounces mixed chopped leeks | 1 tablespoon baking ammonia | 36 fluid ounces molasses | 4 3/4 lbs ground chicken liver
instructions: Combine all ingredients above and shape into 24 equal 1 inch balls. Wet hands and roll balls in wet hands to soften. Heat grill then place prawns on center rack and cook 5 mins. Turn and cook 3 mins. Turn again. Turn on other side. When prawns turn pink, drain and dry on cloth towel. Serve with syrup.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 portabella mushroom cap, cleaned | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rhubarb | 1 tablespoon cashews, chopped | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon hamburger, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut a stem from each mushroom cap. Place caps on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for about 20 minutes or until tender. Remove from the oven. Place the rhubarb in a small bowl with cashews. Mash the walnut pieces into the chunky chunks with some water or milk. Spoon the mixture onto the caps of each mushroom. Sprinkle parsley over the top.

Random Ingredients: herb,poppy seed,green chili,steak,olive,chicken stock vegetable,fennel seed,icing
title: Chef John's Sizzlin Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs round steaks | herbs, to taste ( such as tarragon, dill, chives, mint ) | salt and freshly ground pepper | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 3 cans artesian mixed vegetables, drained | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock or 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons icing, powder
instructions: Season the steak with salt, pepper and herbs. Dust with poppy seeds and fennel seeds. Place the mixed vegetables in a large, shallow baking dish. Combine together the stock and icing powder. Pour over the steak, turning well to coat in the icing. Cover tightly and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Bake the steak for 50 - 60 minutes, or until the steak is cooked to taste. Allow to stand for 5 - 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,clementine juice,ginger,chicken bouillon,chicken giblet,vegetable broccoli,mushroom
title: Ginger Chicken
ingredients: 20 lbs chicken giblets | 1/2 head fresh ginger, peeled and sliced | 1 3/4 lbs fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 green bell peppers or 1 red bell pepper, sliced | 3 cans vegetable broccoli pieces, drained and rinsed | 2 cans canned clementines in juice, drained ( any citrus-packed juice ) | 1 cup chicken bouillon, diluted with a little water
instructions: Rinse giblets thoroughly with cold water. Drop into boiling water for 1 minute and cool. Remove outer skin and discard. Rinse with cold water and drain. Peel ginger and cut into thin slices. Cut bell pepper and mushrooms into 1 inch pieces and add to chicken. Add vegetable broccoli rinses, chicken bouillon, ginger slices and mushrooms. Bring to boil and simmer one hour or until chicken is tender. Remove from heat and stir in clementines. Serve in heavy soup dishes or with a little bit of cooking liquid poured over the chicken.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,monterey jack pepper cheese,coconut milk,broccoli,orange juice,mango chutney,bell pepper
title: Quinoa Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa, cooked | 1 orange, juice of ( can use orange zest if you prefer ) | 1 cup broccoli, cooked, chopped fine | 1 cup mango chutney | 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons green mango chutney | 1/4 cup roasted bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Heat a nonstick pan, such as skillet or cast iron skillet over medium high heat. When the pan is hot, pour 1/3 cup of the quinoa in, allowing room for the quinoa to spread out as it cooks. Add 1/3 cup water to cover the quinoa. Turn on the burner to low, and let the quinoa sit for a few minutes. Then flip the quinoa into a flat serving dish that has been turned over onto a plate. When you turn the burner off, pour some of the quinoa on top and sprinkle the remaining ingredients on top. The quinoa will begin to firm up and expand as it sits. After a few minutes, the quinoa should begin to smell a little cooked.. If so, take the quinoa out and spread onto a plate with paper towels. Let cool for a few minutes. This really speeds up the quinoa so enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lamb chop,veal,pepper,curd cottage cheese,monterey jack cheese
title: Lamb Chops Au Jus With Veal
ingredients: 4 small lamb chops or 4 small sirloin steaks | 1/2 lb small curd cottage cheese | 2 ounces thinly sliced veal, cooked and cubed ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cover a large nonstick skillet with nonstick spray and set over medium high heat until very hot. Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper. Place sausages on hot skillet and cook 6 to 8 minutes or until desired doneness, turning once. Remove from heat and place on a paper towel lined plate. Cover plates with foil and keep warm in a 250°f oven. Place cheese on one side of the chops, place remaining sausages on the cheese. Sprinkle with pepper and heat until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Sausages
ingredients: 10 ounces chuck roast ( or your favourite combination of beef and pork ) | 1 loaf rye bread | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Cut an x on the side of the sausages. Slice the roast into thin half moons and lay out flat. Dip slices of meat into fat, coat with fat then fry in a non stick pan over a medium heat for about 8 - 10 minutes, turning to brown all sides. As sausages are cooked, heat the double cream until it begins to thicken. Line a baking tray with a piece of greaseproof paper. Spoon sausages onto the paper, reserving a small amount to dip in the cream if desired. Roll each sausage into a warm, rolled swiss roll. Place onto hot baking tray and return to the hot oven, and allow to cook for 15 - 20 minutes, or until thoroughly cooked.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,cornmeal,tomato green chilies,grain white rice
title: Baked Tomatoes and Beef on Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 2 tablespoons dry cornmeal | 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chilies, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup medium-grain white rice
instructions: Prepare rice in a medium saucepan according to package directions. Preheat oven to 375°f. Place brisket and cornmeal in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with tomatoes, chilies and rice. Bake uncovered for 35 to 45 minutes or until meat is thoroughly cooked. Cover for last 10 minutes of baking to prevent excess browning.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,gelatin powder,cherry pie filling,rosemary,arborio rice
title: Mint Rosemary Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 envelope unflavored gelatin powder | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice, well rinsed | 4 -5 mint leaves, chopped fine | 1 can cherry pie filling ( you won't need it ) | 2 sprigs rosemary ( optional )
instructions: Prepare gelatin according to package instructions. In a small container, make the filling while the rice is soaking. Prepare and wash rice for several soakings. In a saucepan, bring just enough water to cover it to simmering. In a small bowl, combine the cherry pie filling and some freshly chopped mint leaves. Pour into the soup and stir well. Gently stir in gelatin. Cook, while stirring occasionally until the gelatin has melted into the water. Remove from heat and stir in rosemary.. Let cool at room temperature, stirring occasionally. Put into a mold or small baking dish lined with wax paper or plastic wrap.

title: Tunisian Corn
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 pint mexican-style corn | mint sprig
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Brush a baking sheet with vegetable oil or sesame oil. Sprinkle the corn with salt. Spread on the baking sheet, about 2/3 of the way up. Bake until corn is dry and lightly browned, about 45 minutes. Serve hot with mint sprig.

title: Grammy Bahama's Orange Peel-And-Ginger
ingredients: 50 g bacon dripping | 2 navel oranges | 5 slices fresh gingerroot ( or 1/2 tbls. dried ginger ) | 1 teaspoon red pepper ( optional ) | greek yogurt ( plain yoghurt will do just fine )
instructions: Peel and cut the orange peel into thin strips the size of about 1 inch. Place one strip onto each hot griddle or large frypan and, keeping the other strip of orange peel under the grill, cook the strips in any ghee until you see the skins start to peel. Place the orange peel onto a clean cloth or kitchen towel and cover with oiled plastic wrap. Let the peel sweat over the residual heat for about 30 minutes. Drain the strips on paper towels and sprinkle with sugar and salt. Re heat the oil in a small pot until very hot but not smoking. Remove the orange peel strip. Add the peel and ginger into the oil and cook for about 30 seconds. Add red peppers. Sprinkle the mixture with red pepper flakes. Serve with yogurt.

Random Ingredients: butter,black currant jam,egg white,pineapple juice,channa dal,nutmeg,onion soup mix,beer
title: Caribbean Baked Fish
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups channa dal | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice, juice reserved | 3/4 cup orange beer, or more if needed | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 large egg white, beaten | 1 tablespoon dried onion soup mix | 1/4 cup black currant jam | 1 tablespoon channa dal | 3/4 cup unsweetened pineapple juice
instructions: Pineapple stuffing, place channa dal into a 2 quart pan.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,pistachio,jalapeno pepper lengthwise,sage leaf,vegetarian worcestershire sauce,raspberry,mushroom,crescent dinner
title: Pistachio and Sage Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 beef top rump roast | 2 tablespoons vegetarian worcestershire sauce | 1 can sliced mushrooms, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage leaves | 1 tablespoon grated jalapeno peppers, or to taste | 1 can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1/2 cup pistachios, toasted | 2 tablespoons diced raspberries ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Season the roast with worcestershire sauce, and wrap tightly with plastic wrap. Marinate for at least 15 minutes in the refrigerator. Place the roast on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until a meat thermometer inserted 2/3 of the way into the meat registers 130 degrees f, about 3 hours. When the roast is done, shred with a fork and set aside. While meat is baking, melt the vegetarian worcestershire sauce in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in mushrooms, sage, and jalapeno peppers. Simmer 1 minute, then remove from heat. Sprinkle meat with the toasted crescent rolls, and top with the mushrooms and cheese mixture. Serve with a fresh fruit salad and raspberries for a terrific garlic free meal.

Random Ingredients: black currant,tabasco sauce,peppermint extract,mustard,tahini,self raising flour,salad oil,pimento olive
title: Tahini Puffs(Dairy Free)
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons mustard | 2 tablespoons pimento stuffed olives, finely chopped or 2 tablespoons dried pimento pimento | 1/2 cup salad oil | 150 ml tahini ( sesame paste ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh peppermint extract | 1 1/4 cups black currants or 1 1/4 cups golden raisins, finely chopped | 2 -3 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c / 220°c fan forced / 200°c / gas. Sift together the flour, mustard, olives and sesame paste in a large bowl, then stir in the tahini, peppermint extract and tabasco. Add 2 tbsp chopped raisins/currants if using. Stir to combine then fold in enough of the remaining flour to make a slightly sloppy dough. Roll half of the dough on a lightly floured surface, then knead to a firm, even ball. Roll out remaining dough to make a large circle. Using a fork, prick each circle all over. Using your thumb or a sharp knife, prick in the top to make holes about 1cm deep. Using a small bladed knife, make slits in the top of the dough with a sharp knife. Bake the tartlets for about 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,brown sugar,self raising flour,chocolate,cayenne pepper,quinoa,taco seasoning
title: Mexican Quinoa Snack Balls
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa or 1 cup brown rice | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese | 1 cup brown sugar | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper or 1 teaspoon green chili pepper | 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped
instructions: Place quinoa in a large bowl, cover and soak for 30 minutes to 1 - 2 hours, or until soft. Drain and rinse quinoa to remove excess water. Melt the cheese, brown sugar and cayenne pepper in a microwave oven until melted. Stir in the quinoa and 3/4 cup of the flour until blended thoroughly and fluffy. Add the hot mixture. Mix well but do not over mix. Add the chocolate and mix again. The mixture will be quite liquidy. Shape into 8 even balls, and then bake at 150 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes, or until done and beginning to brown.

title: Creamy Maple Syrup Sweetened Pineapple Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup margarine | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup maple syrup
instructions: Place margarine in a saucepan over medium heat. Once margarine melts, add pineapple juice, cream of chicken soup, and maple syrup. Stir together, and let sauce simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Sizzler Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock ( chicken broth is okay too ) | 3/4 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Combine mayonnaise, stock, mustard, and pepper in a jar with a tight fitting lid and shake well to blend. Pour into a serving dish, sprinkle with cardamom and serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,granny smith apple,sherry,beef stock,salt pork,semolina flour,white onion
title: Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 tablespoons semolina flour, or as needed | 1 large white onion, chopped | 2 medium granny smith apples - peeled, cored and peeled | 1 pound lean ground beef | 1 pound salt pork, chopped | 1 cup white onion, chopped | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/2 cup beef stock
instructions: Mix cornmeal for papel dry mix all ingredients to form a crumbly dough. Roll dough out on floured surface to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut into 6 inch strips. Sauté ground beef and salt pork with chopped onion until meat is brown and onion is tender. Drain off fat, but reserve 1 tablespoon, or use 1 teaspoon oil for browning. Add sherry and beef broth to meat, and simmer for 15 minutes before seasoning with salt and pepper to taste. Serve over pasta.

title: Spicy Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 - 1 pinch chili pepper flakes
instructions: Melt the cheese over a low heat. Add a couple of pinches of chili flakes and stir. Serve with warm tortilla chips.

title: Squash & Mushroom Pudding
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, chopped | 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix ( i do not use jello ) | 1 jar salsa | 3/4 cup oyster mixed mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except mushrooms, and microwave 2 minutes on high, until hot. Add mushrooms, stir, heat through.

title: Coriander-Tarragon Roast Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup fresh coriander leaves | 1/4 cup light dried tarragon | 1/4 cup dried chili, chopped | 1 3/4 lbs yellow squash, halved ( about 3 1/4 lbs )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f. Rinse the coriander roots well under cold water, and pat dry with paper towels. Spray a large roasting tray, or rack with nonstick cooking spray, or line it with parchment paper. Combine coriander roots, tarragon, and chili. Spread the vegetables all over the tray. Bake 10 to 20 minutes until cooked through and tender. Transfer to a serving dish and serve warm.

title: Slow Cooker Stout Beer Spinach
ingredients: 2 cups chopped fresh spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons brown rice flour | 1/2 cup dark beer | 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Place the spinach leaves and brown rice flour in the slow cooker bottom, followed by the dark beer, molasses and sage. Stir to combine. Cover and cook on low setting 7 to 8 hours, or on high setting 5 to 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: stir fry vegetable,lamb,gouda cheese,cinnamon,yogurt,chicken gumbo soup
title: Lamb and Cheezy Cheese Stir Fry With Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 cups cubed cooked lamb | 1 can low-fat yogurt | 1 cup stir-fry vegetables, such as broccoli, bell peppers and cauliflower | 2 tablespoons chicken gumbo soup | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 cup shredded gouda cheese
instructions: Combine sour cream, yogurt, and the sauce in a 1 quart casserole dish. Add meat and vegetables. Mix together and sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350 f about 45 minutes or until meat juices run clear. Sprinkle with cheese just before serving.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,white sugar,pimento olive,red wine vinegar,onion,pineapple concentrate,pork,golden raisin
title: Cuban Pork Salad
ingredients: 1/8 cup pineapple concentrate, thawed | 1 1/2 cups cubed cooked pork | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, halved | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 2 tablespoons dried onion, minced | 1/2 cup golden raisins
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together thawed pineapple concentrate, pork, olives, vinegar, balsamic, sugar, sugar, and onion. Place raisins in a small bowl, and sprinkle with raisins. Cover, and refrigerate until serving.

title: Spicy Grilled Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 large mushrooms | 3 tablespoons capers | 2 tablespoons black peppercorns ( or more to taste ) | 2 -4 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chilies, crushed or 1 teaspoon dried chipotle ancho chilies, crushed
instructions: Clean mushrooms and remove stems and blemishes from capses. Arrange mushrooms in 1 or 2 shallow pouches on grill rack. Sprinkle with capers and peppercorns. Brush evenly with pizza sauce and sprinkle with chilies. Grill or broil about 2 minutes, or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,chorizo sausage,cottage cheese,lasagna noodle,half cream,dill weed,dog bun,red pepper
title: Hot Dogs and Chorizo Lasagna
ingredients: 1/2 pound chorizo sausage, removed from casings into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 2 cups half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1 jar fried catfish sausage, drained, chopped | 1 jar barilla lasagna noodles | 8 hot dog buns, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna in boiling water, stirring occasionally until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain and cool slightly. Spread 1 cup half and half cream into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with dill, ground red pepper and catfish sausage. Cover with another 9x13 inch baking dish and spread with another 1/2 cup cream and half. Top with remaining half and half cream. Bake in preheated oven until hot and bubbly, 30 to 35 minutes. Cut each hot dog into 4 diagonal pieces. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 10 -12 medium red potatoes | 1 jar baby red potatoes | 1 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.

title: Rice, Carrots and Raisins With Fresh Mint
ingredients: 2 3/4 1 3/4 cups rice or 2 3/4 cups short-grain rice | 1/2 cup mixed baby carrots ( sliced or julienned ) | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves ( lightly packed ) or 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1/4 cup syrup
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 5 quart casserole. Mix well and bake in a 350°f oven for 60 minutes. Stir well. Cover tightly and bake until rice is tender and carrots are crisp tender, 25 to 30 minutes longer. Remove cover and bake about 10 minutes longer or until heated through. Stir through a 1 teaspoon hot water mixture if desired.

title: Champute Sweet Potato Chips
ingredients: 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and cut into chips | 1 1/2 teaspoons monosodium glutamate | 2 teaspoons mescerari | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a small bowl, stir together the monosodium glutamate and a small amount of water. Place the sweet potato chips, and monosodium glutamate in a small dish. Place 1/4 cup of cheese in a cup of hot water.

Random Ingredients: pepper,thai red curry paste,canola oil,chicken thigh
title: Thai Butter Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/3 cup thai red curry paste | 3 tablespoons canola oil or 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Place chicken thighs between 2 pieces of plastic wrap. Pound to an even 1/4 thickness with a meat mallet. Cut into 2 inch segments. Dip in curry paste coating evenly. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add chicken and cook until brown on all sides, about 10 minutes total. Reduce heat to medium and cook, turning once, until done, about 20 minutes more.

title: English Sandwich
ingredients: 1/3 lb beef liver | 2 tablespoons butter | 3 slices american cheese | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon apple juice | 4 -6 pieces apple-flavored toast, toasted
instructions: Heat wok or deep fryer to 350°f or until deep fryer thermometer reaches 160°f trim off fat from liver. Cut into 2 pieces. Add liver to wok or deep fryer.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,green chili,rice wine,chinese five spice powder,coconut milk
title: Coconut Curry
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 green chili, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon rice wine
instructions: Heat a wok until very hot. Add curry powder and stirfry briefly. Add green chilli and stirfry briefly. Add rice wine. Stir, then add coconut milk. Stir fry briefly until heated through. Serve hot over plain boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,sherry wine,asafoetida powder,white pepper,dijon mustard,sirloin,dark brown sugar,vanilla extract
title: Sirloin Dijon Sandwich
ingredients: 1 sirloin, filet of steak | 1 tablespoon salt | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground sesame oil or 1/2 teaspoon canola oil | 1/8 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons dijon-style mustard | 1 anchovy fillet, sliced
instructions: Place all dressing ingredients in a small bowl, stirring with a fork, until blended. Brush meat with dressing and refrigerate until needed. Grill meat over hot coals or medium high heat about 2 minutes on each side or slightly longer depending on thickness. Brush again with dressing and grill until browned, 1 to 2 minutes.

title: English Mustard
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweet-cream | 2 teaspoons english mustard | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Stir the mustard into the cream just before serving. If the cream does not blend together just whisk it into the sauce. A little bit of the cream at a time should give it the right texture, but it should be thick enough to spread. Serve immediately, but the longer it stands, the stronger the flavour improves.

title: Guacamole and Almonds Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons guacamole | 2 tablespoons blanched slivered almonds | 1 spring onion, finely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl combine guacamole and almonds. Gently stir to coat evenly. Sprinkle with spring onion and serve with fruit and crackers or bread.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,ginger garlic paste,steak,seasoning salt
title: Quick & Easy Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs flank steaks | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Cut steak crosswise into very thin slices. Place in a large resealable jar with tight lid. Add ginger garlic paste, salt and rice wine vinegar. Stir until well mixed and pour mixture over the meat. Close lid tightly and give it a few turns to coat evenly. Let sit at room temperature for no longer than 2 hours. Drain excess marinade, then wipe off any excess meat juices. Place beef in dehydrator, cover and let sit in the dehydrator at 115 degrees f for 24 hours. The dehydrator should take approximately 6 hours then the temperature should be 115 degrees f. Uncover and let sit 30 minutes more. Note, i have never had this turned off, but you may be glad that you do enjoy the jerky.

title: Coconut Ice Cream (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 500 ml double cream | 150 g desiccated coconut | 2 tablespoons anise oil ( not extra-virgin ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 2 teaspoons sifted powdered toasted coconut
instructions: Whip cream until stiff peaks form. Fold in the rest of the ingredients till smooth and creamy. Pour mixture into greased and floured 28cm × 20cm baking dish and bake uncovered in 180°c oven for 10 - 15 minutes till firm. Turn out and cut into squares.

title: Artichoke and Raisin Salad
ingredients: 8 artichoke hearts, about 1 1/2 pounds, unpeeled ( about 3 cups ) | 1/2 cup raisins | 6 lime wedges | pepper
instructions: In a large salad bowl, add artichokes and toss. In a small bowl, combine raisins and lime juice. Add oil and lime juice mixture to salad bowl. Sprinkle with pepper. Serve warm note, salad can be made ahead and chilled. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: French Nuts (Cuts)
ingredients: 1 bag dried whole pecans | 1 can grand marnier ( or other good brand )
instructions: If you are using the grand marnier, do not add any ice cubes to it. Place pecans in a baking dish big enough to hold them in 1 layer. Sprinkle with grand marnier. Bake at 325° until pecans are golden brown, about 35 - 40 minutes. Cool and store in tightly covered jar.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,chicken stock,heavy whipping cream,ra el hanout spice mix,sirloin steak,curry powder,berry,orange
title: Grilled Steak With Couscous & Fruit
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 1/4 cup ra el hanout spice mix ( ras el hanout - moroccan spice mix from your spice aisle ) | 1 can chicken stock | 1 bag mixed berries, whole, black and red | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 4 fresh orange slices | 1 bunch fresh berry ( or red grape, berry and black raisin )
instructions: Place the rack 4 inches from the broiler element and preheat to 400°f/190°c. Place the steaks on a broiler pan. Broil 3 - 4 inches from the heat for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove, brush with some of the ras el hanout spice mixture and sprinkle with 1 tb of the ras el hanout. Place in a baking pan on rack and allow to cool to room temperature. Slice the steaks crosswise into 1 thick slices and place each slice between sheets of cling film with the back of a spoon. Broil for 5 - 10 minutes turning once until seared on both sides. Keep warm on the grill while you complete the remaining steps. While steaks are cooking, place the broth and mixed fruit in a large pan and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to medium and add 2 tb of the curry powder, the cream and the rest of the curry powder to the pan. Continue to simmer until the fruit is cooked. Spoon the couscous onto a platter and place 3 - 4 orange slices over the couscous along with the remaining orange slices and berries. Pour hot broth over the fruit, making sure the orange slices are covered. Allow to rest 5 - 15 minutes. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,chicken tender,salsa,mint leaf,irish whiskey,spring onion,prosciutto
title: Irish Beef and Rice Wraps
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs stewing beef, trimmed | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey or 1 tablespoon rum | 6 spring onions | 4 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto | 4 ounces salsa ( choose your heat ) | 14 ounces chicken tenders, each cut crosswise into 4 pieces | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. In a large deep ovenproof skillet, add the beef, whiskey and spring onions and gently fry for 4 - 5 minutes on each side or until browned. Arrange the prosciutto strips on top and, working quickly, toss in the beef, then cover and bake in the oven for 15 minutes. Remove cover and reduce heat to 325f. Remove beef from oven, season and return pan to the stove and heat to boiling. Add salsa to the pan and bring to a boil over high heat. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the beef onto a board and set aside. Add the beef to the pan in a single layer and cook over moderate heat for 5 - 6 minutes or until crisp and browned. Return all the beef to the pan. Spoon the beef and salsa mixture into 4 - 4 cups or bowls and serve with rice and mint leaves as garnish.

title: Crunchy Corn Sushi Roll
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons corn, finely grated | 1 sheet nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Beat the flour, fish sauce and corn until smooth in a medium bowl. Form the mixture into a ball, then lightly knead it until smooth. Roll the dough gently with 1 1/2 cm of the nori to make a 20cm long roll. Cut the roll into 8 equal pieces. Using a very sharp bladed knife, score the nori sheets lengthwise in a horizontal stripe. Line a large sushi rolling mat with baking paper. Roll out the nori sheet evenly with 2 3mm of nori. Spread approximately 1 tablespoon of the batter across the nori to cover it evenly. Bake the roll at 220c for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot, warm or cold.

title: Korean Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 lb steak ( sirloin or brisket or blade steak ) | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup almonds
instructions: Cut steak into very thin slices. Marinate for 15 minutes. Strain juices. Heat oven to 450°f. Combine saffron, oyster sauce and vinegar. Marinate steak for 20 minutes. Brush with marinade and sprinkle with cheddar. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with mozzarella and almonds before serving. Note, mahi mahi can be made at any time and frozen.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,vegetable stock chicken,cider vinegar,chipotle chile,flour
title: Chipotle Pizza (South Beach Diet Friendly)
ingredients: 1 package pre-baked pizza crust ( such as boboli bread ) | 2 cups vegetable stock or 2 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar ( white or brown ) | 2 teaspoons dried chipotle chiles, paste | 2 teaspoons reduced fat flour
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°f. Heat broth or chicken stock until just hot enough to bring to a boil. In separate bowl add vinegar, chipotle paste, and flour and stir till combined. Drain pizza crust when just barely warm and spoon broth/stock mixture into the center of your pizza crust. Place the crust in the oven until golden brown, about 12 - 14 minutes, depending on oven temperature. Let cool for 2 - 3 minutes before slicing.

title: Hazelnut & Lemon Lasagna
ingredients: 3 cups unsalted hazelnuts | 3 cups coarsely torn fresh rosemary | 2 tablespoons chopped peeled fresh gingerroot | 1/4 cup white wine | 2 1/2 teaspoons fresh grated lemons, zest of | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 16 lasagna noodles, uncooked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place the hazelnuts and the rosemary in a bowl of cold water, and cover with plastic wrap.

title: Scottish Pork Loin
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 3 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 3 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 cups broccoli florets | 4 1/2 fluid ounces oat or 4 1/2 fluid ounces mixed sprouts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Cut the pork into 1 inch cubes. Add the cajun seasoning and sugar to the pork and toss to coat. Place the pork in a roasting tin and add the broccoli and sprouts. Roast for 3 hours, stirring often, until cooked through and well browned.

title: Aussie Grilled Fish - No Eggs
ingredients: 4 firm fish, skin off | 4 slices thinly-sliced prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 1 cup pureed tomatoes | 1/2 cup diced mango | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1/4 cup shredded cotija cheese
instructions: Combine tomatoes, mango, cotija cheese, and pecans. Toast until golden brown. Arrange on plate, top with top slice of prosciutto, and drizzle w/ additional salsa for extra crunch. If desired, serve with fish cut into strips.

Random Ingredients: hoagie,basil,black pepper,chicken rice soup,rice noodle,italian parsley,button mushroom
title: Quick Italian Chicken & Rice Soup
ingredients: 6 cups chicken and rice soup ( your favorite brand ) | 2 cans button mushrooms, drained ( not drained ) | 2 teaspoons dried basil | 2 tablespoons rice noodles ( your favorite name ) | 1 tablespoon italian parsley | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | hoagie rolls or other crusty bread
instructions: Cook your rice noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, cook the mushrooms and herbs in a large skillet with the soup.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,button mushroom,cheddar cheese,hot water,red chili powder
title: Baked Mushrooms in Chili Sour Cream Gravy
ingredients: 1/4 cup hot water | 1 red chili powder | 2 -3 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 lb button mushroom ( fresh or thawed ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Heat oven to 300°c add the hot water and bouillon cubes to a large casserole dish, and stir in the sliced button mushrooms. Pour the chili sour cream mixture over the mushrooms, making sure to cover all the mushrooms. Cover with aluminium foil and bake for about 45 minutes. Sprinkle the grated cheese over the top, and bake for a few minutes more.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,lemon juice,snow pea,rice vinegar,fontina cheese,shiraz wine,chinese rice wine,thyme sprig
title: Shiraz Rice Wine Salad
ingredients: 14 ounces shiraz wine | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/2 cup chinese rice wine | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs | 4 ounces fontina cheese, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 package snow peas, trimmed | 1/2 cup mango chutney
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the wine, vinegar, lemon juice and thyme. Set aside. Arrange cheese slices over medium salad and toss to coat. Divide between 4 plates, then sprinkle snowpeas over the top. Divide wine, lemon juice and thyme mixture among plates. Serve.

title: Yogurt Salad Dressing
ingredients: 300 ml balkan plain flour | 350 g low-fat yogurt ( or greek yoghurt ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 125 g chickpeas
instructions: Sift flour with salt into a bowl, combine the yogurt and vinegar in another bowl. Add chickpeas and basil and stir to combine. Place yoghurt mixture into a food processor and whiz down for 10 seconds until well combined. Add yoghurt mixture to dry ingredients and whiz again until well combined. Pour into an airtight container and refrigerate for 8 to 24 hours.

title: Hungarian Beef Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 cup long grain rice or 1 cup medium grain white rice, cooked | 1/2 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 3/4 cup dry italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon dried sweet paprika | 1/4 cup coarsely-chopped unsweetened cocoa ( optional ) or 1/4 cup chili sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place beef, rice, kielbasa, bread crumbs and paprika in a baking dish. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Place remaining ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend to a chunky mixture. Spoon mixture into hot, slightly greased 10x15 inch casserole and bake for 30 minutes or until heated through and top is golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,baking potato,lamb,lebanese cucumber,grilling,marsala wine,currant,chili paste
title: Lamb in Mushroom Wine
ingredients: 1 kg minced lamb | 300 ml marsala wine | 300 g cream of mushroom soup | 1 lebanese cucumber, seeded and diced | 250 g minced potatoes | 50 g currants | 1 tablespoon cooking oil or 1 tablespoon other fat | grilled ( frozen or homemade )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all the ingredients and mix well. Cut lamb into 1 inch cubes or 1 inch strips. Add marinated lamb to sauce, cover and marinate overnight. Heat oil in a frying pan until hot. Cook lamb in batches over very high heat until lightly browned. Remove meat from the marinade. Grill the meat until well browned. Remove from heat and stir in the currants or other topping ingredients. Serve on buns.

Random Ingredients: green pea,pineapple ring,pear,ra el hanout spice mix,asparagus,yukon gold potato
title: Spiced Oven Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb green peas | 1 lb asparagus, cut into 1-inch pieces | 4 medium yukon gold potatoes, diced | 1 medium pear, peeled and diced | 1 package ra el hanout spice mix, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/ra el hanout-spice-mix-54099 '' > ras el hanout < /a > ( or similar seasoning to ra el hanout spice mix ) | 1 can pineapple rings, drained ( reserve juice )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl. Bake, covered, for 35 - 40 minutes.

title: The Real Cadillac
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 cup amaretto or 1/2 cup almond flavored liqueur | 1 teaspoon saffron, soaked in a little water for about 5 minutes, cooled | 2 serrano peppers, roasted, peeled, and sliced into 1/4-inch strips or 2 jalapeno peppers, roasted, peeled, and sliced into 1/4-inch strips
instructions: Combine canola oil, amaretto, and saffron in blender. Puree until smooth. Place peppers into a small bowl and pour oil over. Refrigerate for 4 hours. Store in refrigerator.

title: The Easiest and Best Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 large flour tortillas | 1 can condensed beef broth | 4 ounces good quality bittersweet chocolate chips ( you may use more ) | 1 teaspoon mango powder ( optional )
instructions: Spread about 1/4 cup of the beef broth on the edges of the tortillas over the top and sides of each tortilla, and make sure the tortillas are completely covered. Place in a 350 degree oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until the tortillas are completely dry and the beef broth has completely reduced to about ¾ cup. Place 2 chipotle chocolates in a bowl, and microwave them to melt slightly, being careful not to let them burn. Stir chocolate and chocolate into the chocolates and place a large dollop of melted chocolate in the middle. Serve on a bed of tortillas or serve with your favourite dipping bread as a filling for your family favorite tortillas

title: Tamarari Pineapple
ingredients: 1 pineapple, fresh | 1 tablespoon tamari ( or soy sauce )
instructions: Slice pineapple in half lengthwise, and remove stones. Use a skewer to stab the edges to separate them. Place on lightly oiled pan, and cook over low heat for about 20 minutes. While pineapple is cooking, mix a bit of tamari and soy sauce together, and drizzle over the pineapple, and allow to sit 10 minutes before serving.

title: Snow Peas, Mushrooms, and Snow Peas With Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb snow peas | 1 ounce parmigiano-reggiano cheese, cut into thin sticks | 12 -16 shiitake mushrooms, sliced
instructions: To cook snow peas in boiling water for 2 minutes, peel immediately and plunge into cold water to stop cooking and to prevent further cooking. Slice snow peas diagonally into 1 pieces. Using a steamer or large saucepan, toss the snow peas with one fourth of 1 ounce of the cheese. Place snow peas into the heated steamer or saucepan over medium heat.

title: Basic Mustard
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 4 saffron strands, crumbled | 1 tablespoon mustard oil
instructions: Grind cumin and saffron into powders. Heat oil in pan and add mustard. Add crushed, ground powder and croutons. Stir and heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: german chocolate cake mix,olive oil,orange zest,black eyed pea,grain white rice
title: German Chocolate Black-Eyed Pea Cake
ingredients: 1 package german chocolate cake mix | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon coarsely grated orange zest | 1/2 cup uncooked long-grain white rice, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine cake mix, olive oil, beans, orange zest and rice. Mix until thoroughly combined but do not beat. Spread mixture into greased pan and bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until top is golden brown and center is firm. Let cool slightly and cut into squares for serving.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,pasilla chile,peanut butter,garlic oil,cream tartar,potato reg,yeast
title: Peanut Butter and Garlic Noodles (Faux Food)
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast ( or 2 1/4-oz. packages fast-rising yeast ) | 1 lb fresh sweet potato ( about 12 medium potatoes ) | 1 tablespoon garlic oil, warmed | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon pasilla chile, dried, crushed | 1 tablespoon peanut butter ( preferably smooth, but not chunky ) | cooked rice noodles
instructions: In a medium, heavy nonstick skillet, warm the oil over medium heat. Add the sweet potatoes.

title: Spices of the Sea - Dry Thai Spice Mix
ingredients: 2 teaspoons coriander seeds or 1 teaspoon cumin | 4 tablespoons brandy or 4 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Place the coriander and cumin in a dry frying pan and toast until fragrant. Cool. Using a mortar and pestle, coarsely crush the seeds into the spices. Bring 2 tb vinegar to the boil and add the coriander mixture. Bring back to the boil again and remove from the heat. Cool completely and store in a bottle in the pantry. Note, if using dry aromatic spices such as cardamon, peppercorns, cardamom, fennel and/or cinnamon, this quantity should be stored in a dry place.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,meat,sherry,asparagus,cooking spray,baby spinach,mace,lima bean
title: Savory Asparagus, Spinach & Meat
ingredients: cooking spray | 16 ounces condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/2 cups cubed cooked meat ( optional ) | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 8 ounces frozen lima beans, fresh or frozen chopped spinach | 2 cups chopped asparagus ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 teaspoon ground mace or 1 teaspoon paprika | 4 ounces fresh baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Spray a 13x9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, mix together onion soup, mushroom soup, beef or chicken, sherry & lima beans. Transfer to prepared pan. Cover and bake at 375f for 45 minutes. Add asparagus, mace and spinach.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,quail egg,green curry paste
title: Egg Rice
ingredients: 50 g long grain white rice | 1 cup medium sized dried purple quail eggs | 4 teaspoons green curry paste or 4 teaspoons red curry paste
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions. Beat eggs together lightly and fold in with rice. Heat 1 teaspoon of oil and fry the egg mixture until set, remove from frying pan immediately. Serve immediately with soy sauce and green chillies.

title: Broccoli and Sage
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into florets | 2 sage leaves, chopped or 2 teaspoons dried rubbed sage
instructions: Place the broccoli into a saucepan, cover with water and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer until the broccoli is tender, about 7 minutes. Drain and set aside to steam dry. Stir in the sage. Makes 2 servings.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,philadelphia cream cheese,green pea,red chilies,golden raisin,tamarind paste,scallion,bell pepper
title: Tamarind-Peanut Cheese Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 1 can sweetened condensed cream of tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 can frozen green peas | 1 cup red chilies | 1/2 cup scallion | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in food processor blend cream cheese, tamarind paste, peanut oil, green peas with chilies, scallions and raisins with an immersion blender until mixture is smooth. Serve warm with roasted cauliflower, grated carrot, or roasted jasmine rice.

title: Camembert Pie
ingredients: 1 sheet phyllo pastry | 1 cup camembert cheese, grated
instructions: Thoroughly mix the cheese with the dough until it is completely covered. Cut a hole in the center of the pastry and fill with half of the cheese mixture. Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,pecorino cheese,peanut,fine sea salt,grainy mustard,pistachio
title: Pistachio Peanut Nuts
ingredients: 3/4 cup peanuts, toasted, cooled, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon pecorino cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon grainy mustard | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 2 teaspoons unsalted ground roasted pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix the peanuts, salt, cheese, mustard, cardamom and 1/4 cup water with a fork in a bowl. Stir well. To serve, spread the nut mixture over a platter or in a serving dish. Sprinkle with the toasted peanuts.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,three cheese tortellini,turmeric,clam,apple pie filling,radish,fish,star anise
title: Tortellini in Apple Chili, Spiced Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 lb fish, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( turbot, sombel or sole ) | 1 1/2 lbs small lobsters or 1 1/2 lbs clams, fresh, in shell | 2 star anise | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 4 cups three-cheese tortellini | 1/2 cup apple pie filling | mixed candied tomatoes or radish, sliced thin, garnish ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dried maraschino cherry, cut into thin slivers
instructions: Bring 6 cups water to boil in large pot. Add fish, lobsters or fish shells and star anise. Simmer, covered, 5 minutes. Cook tortellini according to package directions. Drain. Stir in fish mixture, apple pie filling, and cherries. Tarnish with candied tomatoes and radishes, if desired.

Random Ingredients: prawn,worcestershire sauce,rosemary sprig,nonstick cooking spray,lemon zest,green onion,seitan
title: Pan Fried Prawns
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1/3 cup dry sultana ( golden raisins ) or 1/3 cup currant ( golden raisins ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary sprigs | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon grated lemons or 1 tablespoon lime zest, from half of a lemon | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped ( scallions ) | 2 1/2 lbs large raw prawns, peeled patted dry
instructions: Coat skillet with cooking spray. Add sultanas and dried rosemary. Stir to mix. Add lemon, green onion and zest. Heat about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Add prawns. Turn prawns, leaving marinade inside. Heat cooking spray over high heat. Add prawns, in batches if necessary. Cook until prawns just turn pink, about 2 to 3 minutes each side, depending on size. Transfer to platter. Squeeze lemon juice over. Serve immediately. Recipe can be made up to 3 hours in advance. Keep prawns hot in a 200° oven until serving or cook in microwave at high power for 20 seconds or until prawns are just cooked through, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,bean,grape tomato,cherry,accent seasoning,brown rice,gorgonzola,flour tortilla
title: Rice Vegetable Tortilla Bake
ingredients: 1 package burrito-size flour tortilla chips | 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice | 1 can fat-free refried beans | 8 ounces gorgonzola, crumbles | 2 cups frozen cut corn tortillas or 2 cups corn chips | 12 cups grape tomatoes | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning | 2 cups quick-cooking cherries ( optional ) or 2 cups frozen peaches ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Prepare 4 dinner plates. Sprinkle tortilla chips evenly in the bottom of each plate. In a bowl, combine the rice, refried beans, cheese and corn chips.
