Drizzle each plate with 1 teaspoons of the fat free fat free olive oil and bake for 20 minutes until heated through and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,self rising flour,vermouth,spaghetti sauce,sunflower oil,sesame seed
title: Sesame Seed and Sunflower Oil Scrolls
ingredients: 12 ounces self-rising flour | 2 ounces sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 ounces spaghetti sauce | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 ounces vermouth | 1 cup pizza sauce
instructions: In a food processor, whizz the flour, oil, sesame seeds and spaghetti sauce until it resembles a rough paste. Stir in the vermouth. Form the dough into 2 long cylinders and press them on baking tray. Put the sunflower oil in a pan and heat. Poke holes into the dough with a fork. Cook on both sides until nice and golden, then drain on absorbent paper. Serve the cooked scrolls warm with pizza sauce, cheese and/or sliced onions.

title: Low-Fat French Eggplant Jumbo
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 can water chestnuts | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1/2 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 2 tablespoons unflavored gelatin | 2 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf parsley or 2 tablespoons chives ( optional )
instructions: Slice and cube eggplants.

title: Veal and Mango Linguine in Beer With Sauteed Spinach (Sauce Con Verduras Et Aux Mango)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb boneless veal, cut into thin strips | 1 cup fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 cup prepared mango chutney | 2 tablespoons instant soup ( use gluten-free if required, or vegetarian if preferred ) | 4 ounces lager beer | 8 ounces linguine | 1/8 teaspoon fresh ground mace ( mexican preferred )
instructions: Marinate pork and vegetables with soup, chutney and molasses. Cook linguine.

title: Chakalaka - Japanese Asparagus
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato paste ( ketchup ) | 2 tablespoons oil | 3 tablespoons asparagus spears ( japanese asparagus spears ) | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Slice the tips of 3 spears, then separate into 1 inch pieces. Rinse and dry the pieces, cut in half. Heat oil in large frying pan. Add asparagus and fry over heat for 2 minutes over medium heat. Add beaten egg.

Random Ingredients: fajita seasoning mix,beef brisket,fennel seed,garam masala,cumin,turmeric powder
title: Spiced Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Place brisket in a baking pan and sprinkle with seasoning mix mixed with fennel seeds, cumin and garam masala. Marinate beef at least 2 hours or overnight. Place brisket and remaining seasoning mix in a pressure cooker. Cook for 30 minutes. Turn brisket and cook an additional 30 minutes. Remove brisket. Use metal spatula to remove the brisket and cover tightly. Allow to sit at room temperature for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Lebanese Hummus
ingredients: 410 g cooked chickpeas | 100 g jam
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a pestle and mortar and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes while you prepare the hummus before serving.

title: Sauce for Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 cupbutterscotch chips | 2 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Stir chips into melted butter. Serve with garlic bread.

title: Ham Steak With Lima Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried lima beans | 1 package ham steaks | cooking oil
instructions: Place lima beans at the bottom of a dutch oven. Cut ham into thick slices and arrange over them. Brush steaks with oil and sprinkle with salt. Cook until golden brown about 20 minutes.

title: Mashed Rutabagas-French Onion Bread - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 cup dried currant | 1 cup dried rutabaga | 1 medium yellow onion, peeled and sliced | 3 cups french bread or 3 cups other stale bread, slices about 2 inches thick | 2 teaspoons tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: In pressure cooker. Place all ingredients in pressure cooker except bread. Close lid securely and set high pressure on the whistle and cook for 7 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand covered on the stovetop for 10 minutes. Release pressure according to the manufacturer's directions. Cut bread into 1 inch cubes.

Random Ingredients: ranch bean,yogurt,cucumber,lemon juice zest,sun tomato oil
title: Greek Spicy Bean Ceviche
ingredients: 15 ounces dry ranch style beans ( may substitute other types of beans as desired ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice and zest, grated | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped finely | 2/3 cup plain fat-free greek yogurt | 1 cucumber, seedless, peeled, diced
instructions: Rinse dry beans with water.

Random Ingredients: molasses,tomato soup,chili oil,grain white rice,cream mushroom soup,pork shoulder
title: Pork and Rice on the Road
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder | 3 cans tomato soup | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons molasses | 3 teaspoons chili oil | 1 package long grain white rice
instructions: Wash pork and cut into chunks. Combine tomatoes and tomato soup, chili oil, molasses, and rice. Put meat in a large skillet, and cook until it's browned. Drain, put in large casserole dish and pour tomato mixture over meat. Bake covered at 350 for 90 minutes, stirring every 30 minutes to brown.

title: Brussels Baklava
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped | 1 bunch fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 bunch fresh basil, chopped | 1 bunch fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 1/2 cups vodka | 1 bag frozen frozen phyllo pastry | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Filling, combine all ingredients and mix well. Let rest in refrigerator while preparing baklava. Unroll pastry and separate onto parchment paper. Cut baklava into strips. Brush 1 side of each strip of pastry with water, and sprinkle with cornstarch. Lay 1/2 of phyllo strips on phyllo and brush with water. Sprinkle with 1/2 of baklava. Add 1/2 of baklava on phyllo, brush with water, and top with remaining phyllo strips, brushing each side generously with cornstarch. Fold up sides, and roll up. Twist ends, and cut in half diagonally. Repeat with remaining phyllo and phyllo.

Random Ingredients: pearl onion,black cardamom pod,vanilla pod,corn flake,cornmeal,vodka
title: Vegetables in Vodka (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pearl onions, peeled | 14 ounces corn flakes, unbleached ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 6 ounces vodka | 4 ounces vodka | 24 large black cardamom pods, cracked | 2 1/2 cups cornmeal ( for dredging ) | 16 ounces vanilla pods
instructions: Heat broiler to high. Place onions on a baking sheet and broil, turning over once, until deeply browned and fragrant, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and set aside. In a large saucepan of simmering water, cook cornflakes until puffed, about 1 minute. Add 2oz vodka and 1oz vodka, and cook, stirring occasionally, until vodka is nearly gone. Add cardamom pods, and continue to cook, stirring, until flavors are well blended, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, place remaining 12 ounces vodka in a fine strainer and shake vigorously to remove the seeds. Reserve the vodka. Dip the onions in the cornflakes, then dredge in remaining cornflakes. Arrange attractively in the broiler proof casserole, about 3 inches apart, and heat until hot, bubbling, and lightly browned, 10 to 15 minutes. Carefully remove casserole from broiler and drizzle remaining 2oz vodka over the top. Let stand, undisturbed, until the vodka has reduced and turned a deep brown color, 5 to 7 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: salmon,feta cheese,salad oil,cheddar cheese,cream milk,hot pepper
title: Smoked Cheddar-Feta Salmon Dip
ingredients: 1 lb ground salmon | 3 tablespoons salad oil | 1 1/2 cups light sour cream | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese | 1 fresh hot pepper, seeded chopped ( i added a tsp. of dried crushed red pepper flakes ) | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a large skillet, cook salmon until just done, about 6 minutes. Drain and let cool slightly. While salmon is cooking, in a large bowl, mix together oil, sour cream, cheese and chili pepper. Add fish and stir to combine. Remove the salmon from the skillet and stir in the feta.

Random Ingredients: salmon,romaine lettuce,banana,mexican cheese,wild rice,taco seasoning mix
title: Mexican Salmon And Brown Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix, or more to taste | 1 package salmon, diced | 2 cups cooked wild rice | 8 cups romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried, and torn into bite-size pieces | 4 bananas, sliced | 1 cup shredded low-fat mexican cheese blend, if desired
instructions: Mix taco seasoning mix with salmon in a bowl. Mix in cooked wild rice. Chill 2 hours, or until cold. Arrange romaine lettuce on serving plates. Layer sliced bananas around lettuce.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,sponge cake finger,black eyed pea,mascarpone,meat,tomato sauce,vegetable stock
title: Beef  in Cream With Black Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 sponge cake finger, cut in thin strips | 4 ounces mascarpone cheese | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 12 ounces mascarpone | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained, rinsed | 1 can tomato sauce, heated | 1 cup vegetable stock
instructions: To make the black eye peas, heat the tomato sauce, vegetable stock and black eye peas to boiling in a saucepan. Reduce the heat then simmer for 10 minutes. Place the sponge finger on a slice of cheesecloth and cover with the black beans. Place over high heat and quickly pound with a wooden mallet until the slices are very crisp and fit together easily with the cheese cloth. Keep them warm in the oven while you make the beef. Make a beef drizzle with the black eye peas. Place the beef fingers in a saucepan with the olive oil, some black eye peas and mushrooms on the side. Heat on a low heat, keep stirring and do not let them brown. Serve with creamy white or brown mustard, and a dollop of sour cream.

Random Ingredients: lemon,walnut oil,pork shoulder,canola oil,cabbage,baby shrimp,coconut milk
title: Shrimp With Pineapple and Walnuts over Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 tablespoons lemon rind, minced | 1/2 cup walnut oil | 8 ounces lean pork shoulder, cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 4 cups cabbage, shredded | 1 cup light coconut milk | 1 cup uncooked baby shrimp
instructions: In a 12 inch skillet, heat oil and lemon rind until pale golden brown. Add pork and cabbage.

Random Ingredients: yellow cake mix,drambuie,spice,irish whiskey,tortilla chip,hazelnut,pita bread,cheese
title: Easy Irish Spice Breakfast Cake
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix, your favourite | 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 1 tablespoon instant dijon mixed spice | 1 bag of tortilla chips | 6 tablespoons hazelnuts, chopped | 16 ounces cheese ( any kind, i use pepper jacks ) | 8 -10 pita bread | hazelnut pieces
instructions: Heat oven 350 degrees. Prepare cake mix as directed on box with whiskey, spice and chips. Set aside. Spread the hazelnuts on a baking sheet and toast in oven until lightly golden. Spread the nuts on the toast and top with cheeses. Cut in half and serve with chips and/or fresh herbs.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,button mushroom,kernel corn,cola do not,orange juice
title: Mushroom, Corn and Gruyere St. Louis Style Sandwich
ingredients: 4 slices gruyere cheese | 4 slices cola don't, not diet soda ( i used coke ) | 4 -6 button mushrooms, sliced | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 6 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Combine all ingredients in medium bowl. Spoon about 1 t. Of mixture in center of each slice of bread. Sprinkle with cheese. Heat in the microwave oven for 5 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Italian Pecan Wedges
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes | 2 garlic cloves, peeled & crushed | 1/4 cup pecans or 1/4 cup walnuts, toasted, chopped | 1 tablespoon anisette, melted ( optional )
instructions: Turn oven on broil. Place potatoes & garlic cloves in greased 13 x9 baking dish. Sprinkle w/ nuts & anisette if using. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat for 10 to 12 minutes or till golden brown. Serve with more aioli or cheese. Tip, to toast walnuts toast them in a skillet, put them in to a microplane, or in a skillet & watch over them.

title: Quick Coconut Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1/3 cup mushroom caps | 1/3 cup cakes flour | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine coconut milk, mushrooms and flour in shallow casserole dish. Slice french bread into 8 slices, diagonally. Fill each slice with some of the coconut mixture. Bake on a lightly greased baking sheet for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,grain white rice,pear half juice
title: Pear and Pear Sherry
ingredients: 1 can whole pear halves in juice | 1 cup long grain white rice | 1 cup white vinegar
instructions: Wash rice well, drain off excess water and place in a microwave safe bowl with 1/2 cup of water to cover. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 5 minutes. Remove plastic wrap and increase oven setting to 350 degrees f. In a saucepan, combine the cooked rice and remaining 1 cup of water and heat through, about 5 minutes. Pour into a serving bowl and stir in the vinegar. Spoon over the pear mixture and serve.

title: Blueberry Citrus Tart Sent by Angels
ingredients: 1/2 lb blueberries, fresh or frozen | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 2 tablespoons frozen orange peel, thawed | 3 tablespoons egg substitute | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon dried chives | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Thaw blueberries a little, if using fresh. Place the blueberries in a bowl and toss with the capers, orange peel, egg substitute, oregano, chives and vanilla. Cover and chill for 1 hour or until serving.

Random Ingredients: cooking apple,kalamata olive,apple cider vinegar,parsley sprig,garlic powder,tortilla,marjoram
title: Apple Olive Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup kalamata olive, in brine, pitted and cut in half | 3/4 cup kalamata olive, cut in half | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried parsley sprig | 4 small cooking apples, cored and cut into wedges | 2 -3 teaspoons apple cider vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Let stand at room temperature about 45 minutes. Sprinkle with more marjoram and dried parsley. Refrigerate 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kikkoman soy sauce,mozzarella ball,pizza dough,chicken breast,white wine vinegar
title: Chicken Calzones
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pizza dough | 1 cup shredded mozzarella ball | 1 medium grilled chicken breast, sliced thin | 1 cup italian-style shredded italian cheese blend | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Unroll the pizza dough on a lightly floured surface. Roll out the dough to 1/2 inch thickness. Cut into twelve 3 inch squares. Using a 2 1/2 inch biscuit cutter, cut out 12 circles. Repeat with each bread circle. Arrange the circles evenly in an ungreased 10x15 inch baking dish. Arrange the chicken over the bread in an even layer, then cover with the cheese evenly. Pour the wine vinegar over the cheese. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until the cheese is melted. Uncover and bake for 10 to 12 minutes more, until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb pasta ( of your choice ) | 1 small lime, zest of | 1/2 lb provolone cheese | 1/2 lb pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Cook pasta. Add rest of the ingredients at the table. Serve with fresh sliced avocado.

Random Ingredients: harissa,chili paste,golden raisin,green olive,green bell pepper
title: Golden Spiced Feta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb feta or 1 lb greek feta | 1 tablespoon harissa ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( i use 1-2 tsp. hot sauce ) | 1/4 cup green olives, sliced | 1/4 cup golden raisin, chopped
instructions: Chop cheese and place in serving bowl. Mash with harissa paste, chili paste, olives and raisins using fork. Add more hot sauce to taste if desired.

title: Tofu in Grape and Tomato Jam
ingredients: 100 g firm tofu | 500 g grape tomatoes | 1 tablespoon ginger paste
instructions: Cut the tofu into half and remove the ends. Slice the tofu in half again and remove the tofu scraps. Slice the tomatoes 1 inch by 1 cm thick and set aside. Heat some oil and stir fry the ginger paste until fragrant. Add the tofu and tomatoes and fry over medium high heat for about 3 minutes. Stir in 1 cup water and bring to the boil. Cook until the tofu is soft and the sauce thickens a little. Season to taste.

Random Ingredients: extra tofu,spaghetti,green onion,self raising flour,grape,passion fruit pulp
title: Spaghetti and Fruit Loaf
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti | 3 ounces extra firm tofu, mashed | 1/4 pint grape | 2 tablespoons grape juice or 2 tablespoons passion fruit pulp | 6 green onions, trimmed | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in boiling water following the packet instructions. Drain. Combine the tofu and 1/4 pint of the grapefruit juice in a bowl, then stir in the green onion. Grease 2 x 2 loaf tins well with butter. Add the spaghetti to the bowl and toss together. Spoon the cake mixture into the tins. Stir in the remaining grapefruit juice or grape juice. Spoon the remaining grapefruit juice on top. Bake in a moderate oven for about 30 minutes until golden. Remove from the oven and leave for a few minutes, then serve.

title: Gramma's Egyptian Zucchini
ingredients: 2 lbs zucchini | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 50 g grated cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup urad dal ( black gram or indian chana )
instructions: Cut zucchini in half and then into one inch slices. Arrange in a single layer in an ovenproof dish with a lid. Spray the zucchini lightly with oil and season with salt and pepper. Cover with a clean cloth and leave to cook in a hot oven for half an hour, or until they are tender and starting to wilt. Place the grated cheese on top, sprinkle over the dal and leave to set for half an hour or more before serving.

title: Sticky Beef Rolls With Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 4 -5 cups hot beef stock | 1 package wild rice sticks | 4 -6 crispy rice paper sheets
instructions: In a large, heavy frypan or dutch oven, brown beef in the vegetable stock. Place beef strips on a bamboo rolling mat or sheet, leaving space in between strips to allow additional weight for the rolls to roll while being cooked. Place the hot beef in the center of the rice sticks. Bring the rice over and under the beef, laying the whole mixture on top of the beef strips. Press together the ends with a fork to seal. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 1 hour, or until heated through. Remove beef from the heat, unwrap and set aside to cool to room temperature. Unwrap the rice sticks and place about 1 1/2 rounded tablespoons of the cooked beef in the middle of each one. Pull the rice stick to the edge of rice, moisten with water if needed, and close to enclose the beef and meat, placing 2 or 3 or 3 rice sticks on each side of the roll. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and freeze for up to 4 days. To serve, remove from freezer and place on a plate seam side down and spoon beefy sauce over rolls. Serve with extra sauce on top.

title: Korean Fried Rice With Grilled Squash Strips
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lime juice ( about 2 limes ) | 1 large scallions or 1 large lemonside, sliced very thinly
instructions: In a large bowl, mix rice with 1 1/2 cups water. Let sit for 10 - 15 minutes, until water is absorbed. Heat oil in a large nonstick frypan over medium high heat. Stir fry scallions for 30 - 60 seconds. Add rice and lime juice. Continue cooking over medium heat, stirring continuously, until slightly sticky and cooked through. Serve hot to pass at room temperature.

title: Garlic-Cashew Cream Cheese Bread
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup cashews | 3/4 cup reduced-fat cream cheese | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 2 teaspoons basil and marjoram, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Sift dry ingredients. Press cashews into small baking pan, making sure to coat both sides.. Mix together cream cheese, garlic and 1 tsp basil and spread over the cashews on cookie sheet. Bake in oven for 25 minutes. Remove from oven, sprinkle with remaining basil and top each slice with fresh nuts before slicing enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,pizza crust,zucchini,lemon wedge,italian salad dressing mix
title: Zucchini Lemon Herb Pizza
ingredients: 1 package pizza crust | 1 cup prepared italian salad dressing mix | 2 medium zucchini, sliced thin | 1/2 ounce dried sage leaf, torn ( or 1 teaspoon dried rubbed sage ) | 4 lemon wedges
instructions: Preheat pizza stone. Brush both sides of the crust with dressing and sprinkle over the zucchini, sage, and lemon wedges. Place pizza directly on pizza stone and bake 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until crust is golden brown and zucchini is soft.

title: Zesty Mixed Fruit Salsa
ingredients: 3 pints mixed dried fruit, like raspberries, strawberries, banana & blueberries | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingrediants and pour into a glass bowl with lid. Cover and set in refrigerator for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight.

Random Ingredients: thyme,jalapeno pepper,ro tel tomato,avocado,green chili,tomato puree,cayenne
title: Carol's Excellent Guacamole
ingredients: 6 large avocados | 1 can ro-tel tomatoes | 2 green chili, chopped | 1 jalapeno pepper | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme | 1 tablespoon tomato puree ( tomato paste ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Cut and pare avocados. Cut tomatoes in thin slices, then peel and seed chilies. Scoop out pit and remove flesh from chilies. Cut flesh into chunks. Place in medium bowl. Add all other ingredients and stir well. Cover and chill in refrigerator 8 hours or overnight. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,vinegar,lime juice,corn oil,sprite,green apple,ice,ranch dressing mix
title: Apple-Panko Salad Dressing With Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup light corn oil, plus 1/4 cup reserved | 1/4 cup seasoned dry-roasted green apple ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1/4 cup ranch dressing mix, preferably low-sodium | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 3 tablespoons sprite | ice ( for salads and other accompaniments ) | 1 green apple, cored and cut into small wedges, cored
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in food processor or blender. Cover and process until smooth. Stir in salad dressing mix, vinegar and lime juice.

Random Ingredients: date,brown lentil,ziti pasta,lettuce leaf,espresso powder,whipping cream
title: Easy and Delicious Ziti With Dates and Cinnamon (Ziti E Piselli)
ingredients: 5 packages dry ziti pasta | 1/2 cup freshly brewed espresso powder ( strong and hot ) | 1 cup brown lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1/3 cup cold whipping cream | lettuce leaf | fresh dates, cut into small pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

title: Easy and Delicious aubergine (Eggplants) Curry
ingredients: 1 lb eggplants | 1 1/2 cups dark beer or 1 1/2 cups light rum | 1 -2 teaspoon green curry paste | 20 large fresh green olives | 1 -3 ounce saffron
instructions: Using a sharp paring knife slice the eggplants into 1/4 slices and soak in cold water for about 20 minutes. Shake occasionally. In a cast iron skillet, heat the dark beer or light rum. Cook the sliced eggplants over medium heat until they are soft but not mushy. Do not let them burn so watch the flames. Add the curry paste to the pan. After 10 minutes add the olives. Simmer for another 10 minutes. Serve with rice and a side dish.

title: Mexican Broccoli
ingredients: 3 cups broccoli florets | 1 -1 1/2 cup hot chili pepper ( adjust to your taste! ) | 3/4 cup bottled taco sauce | 1/2 - 1 cup sorrel
instructions: In a large pan, mix all ingredients and bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer uncovered until desired consistency is achieved. Pour out onto a plate and garnish with fresh cilantro.

title: Real Easy Cheap Crusty Cornbread
ingredients: 1 lb bread dough, made | 2 cans white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup cornmeal | 1/2 cup galliano | 1 tablespoon honey dijon mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut the bread dough into small triangles. Separate the triangles horizontally making a small row in the middle. You don't need to use cookie cutters. Stretch one side of each bread square outwards over to the middle of the bread dough. Be sure to stretch at least three parts of the bread dough with a rolling pin as any excess moisture will release. It will likely only get wider the pieces, and will create space for the filling during cooking. Lay the dough triangles out in a single layer on a lightly floured cookie sheet. Cut the loaf into pieces about 1 wide. Use a spatula or cookie cutter to gently press the pieces into the bread slices. Bake for about 15 - 20 minutes, or until crispy, turning often to crisp.

title: Lazyfinger Focaccia in Pasta
ingredients: 16 ounces cooked pasta ( fusilli, macaroni, etc ) | 8 ounces half-and-half or 8 ounces skim milk | 2 packages ladyfingers
instructions: Cook pasta until tender, and drain. Add milk and half&half to pasta. While the pasta cooks, lightly spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Line the bottom of dish with the ladyfinger fingers. Pour in the sauce while the cookies are still hot. Spread out on pasta, top with rest of the sauce. Cut in squares.

Random Ingredients: coffee,shoyu,ice cream,almond,green pepper,cider vinegar,dark soy sauce
title: Fiery Cider Shoyu Shredded Wheat Pudding
ingredients: 400 g sweet wheat ( not quick-cooking! ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce or 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 125 ml shaosing irish coffee | 200 ml thickened cream or 200 ml ice cream | 2 tablespoons shaved almonds, toasted | 2 red peppers, deseeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°c line a baking tray with baking paper and set aside. Dice the sweet wheat into 1cm cubes. Place in a large bowl and add the soy sauce, vinegar and coffee. Stir to combine. Pour into a jug and refrigerate for an hour or so, stirring every now and then. Once you're ready to eat, line a large roasting tin with baking paper and scatter over the shaved almonds. Place the red pepper and beef in the roasting tin and stir well. Pour over the sweet wheat and stir it well. Bake for about 40 - 50 minutes until the meat is very tender.

title: Chile & Beet Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beet, beets peeled and sliced | 8 ounces poblano chiles, sliced | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 jar pitted pickled green beans, drained | 3 tablespoons amaretto
instructions: Cook the beets in boiling water for 15 minutes. Drain the beets & blanch them in abundant water for 5 minutes drain again. Rinse the chiles under running water, and remove the seeds. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil, add the green beans and blanched beets. Cook until tender, about 30 minutes. Drain the chiles and beetroots and put in a soup pot. Add bouillon cube and a few dashes of amaretto. Bring to a boil, then simmer 5 to 10 minutes until the flavors have blended. Ladle the soup into hot bowls.

title: Buttermilk-Stir-Fry (With or Without Beef or Lamb)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 2 cups homemade beef broth | 3/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | salt | ground cardamom pod, for garnish, if desired
instructions: In a medium saucepan, stir the ground cardamom and salt. Add the beef broth and bring to a boil over high heat. Gradually whisk in the buttermilk. Return the heat to a simmer. Cook the whisked mixture until it thickens and begins to thicken, 4 to 5 minutes. Add cardamom pods, cook just until aromatic, about 1 minute. Pour into a shallow bowl and set aside. Garnish with a few cardamom pods.

title: Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 1/2 white onion, diced | 1/4 lb snow peas | 1 tablespoon mint sauce
instructions: Mix onion and snow peas in salad bowl. In separate bowl, pour mint sauce on top and toss.

title: Linguine With COOKED Noodles, Spicy Scallions, Chili Seeds, and Mint
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons minced scallions | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( chili-garlic paste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground clove | 12 ounces linguine | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Toast the sesame seeds in a medium skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until golden and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Cool and coarsely chop seeds, transferring to a coffee grinder, along with sesame oil and scallions. Meanwhile, cook linguine in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup cooking water and then drain linguine and rinse with cold water. Reserve 2/3 cup drained pasta water and noodles for next use. Add chili mixture, linguine, 1/2 cup reserved cooking water, and cracker crumbs to the skillet and toss to combine. Add pasta and toss to coat well. Spoon into bowls and garnish with fresh mint leaves and scallion slices.

title: Rosa's Fried Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, cooked and peeled | 1 head romaine lettuce leaf, washed and dried
instructions: Cut peeled potatoes into pieces or 1 small potato cube. Pour oil into a skillet or deep skillet and heat to 370°f. Fry potatoes in batches of 4 - 6 in the oil in 3 batches until tender but slightly crisp on both sides. Transfer to a paper towel to drain. Add romaine to skillet in batches and fry quickly, stirring once for even crispiness.

title: Bean Salad With Pimientos
ingredients: 800 g small red potatoes, scrubbed | 3 green beans, trimmed | 3 pinches cream of tartar | 1 jar of chopped pimientos
instructions: Cook potatoes until just tender, cool, cut into wedges, toss with green beans, sprinkle with cream of tartar.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,heavy cream,baby spinach,arborio rice,red kidney bean,anchovy,asparagus spear,green chili pepper
title: Aarti’s Ultimate Veggie Stuffed Asparagus Risotto
ingredients: 1/4 cup red kidney beans | 2 tablespoons chopped green chili peppers | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 bunch asparagus spear, ends trimmed, and ends chopped into 2-inch lengths | 6 fennel bulbs, ends trimmed, fronds reserved and fronds chopped into 2-inch lengths | 1 cup heavy cream | 2 jars anchovies, drained and chopped | 3 1/2 ounces fresh basil or 3 1/2 ounces fresh chard leaves, chopped
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook the kidney beans until tender, about 15 minutes, then remove from the heat. Drain the beans and set aside, reserving the liquid. In an 8 - ½ x½½ inch ovenproof casserole dish that has been sprayed with pam, layer the beans and julienned green chile peppers, ending with a layer of asparagus. Sprinkle over the reserved bean liquid. Mix together the rice, shucked fennel stalks and reserved fennel fronds, then top with heavy cream, anchovies and reserved fennel fronds. Cover, and bake in a preheated 325 degree oven for 45 minutes, or until the asparagus is tender. Serve sprinkled with the fresh basil or chard leaves.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,canola oil,vanilla bean,orange peel,clove garlic,tamari,salsa
title: Mexican Bean Barley-Orange Chili
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 2 quarts fresh salsa | 2 cans whole clove garlic | 1 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup tamari | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, split | 1/2 cup orange peel, chopped, with peel | 1 pinch ground cloves ( optional )
instructions: In large pot bring water to boil over high heat. Add barley and boil for 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain, rinse with cool water, and drain again. Toss rice with oil and tamari. Add garlic and sauté 30 seconds. Add beans, orange peel, and spices. Cook 5 minutes. Add salt and pepper, if desired. Serve hot.

title: Sunflower Honeyed Granola With Sunflower Seeds and Cinnamon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 200 g seedsless sunflower seeds | 5 tablespoons sugar syrup | 400 g dried mixed fruit | 1 -2 tablespoon sunflower seeds, to sprinkle on top if required
instructions: Heat oven to 150c/fan 160c/gas place oil in a shallow baking dish or dish. Lightly stir fry seeds in hot oil until golden. Remove and drain on paper towels. Stir fry sugar syrup until dissolved. Fold in mixed fruit, dry seeds and sunflower nuts until coated evenly. Scoop granola into shallow dish or serving jug. Sprinkle with extra seeds and cinnamon to serve.

title: Portenta
ingredients: 1 cup sugar | 1/2 cup liqueur, e.g. cognac | 4 green cardamom pods
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly, and pour into a glass jar i use a funnel, or a tall glass. Store in the fridge.

title: Fruity Porcini Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 ounces dried porcini mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon dried fruit peel
instructions: Wipe mushrooms thoroughly with damp cloth. Place in a single layer on several small baking sheets. Stir together the dried fruit peel and hot water and pour into mushrooms, allowing moisture to soak into mushrooms. The water will help to bind the mushrooms and ensure a good consistency. At no point should mushrooms touch, but if a mushroom is bruised or loose handle it should be done right away. Bake in a pre heated oven 200 degrees c/ 400 degrees f., for approx 10 to 15 minutes, until mushrooms are puffed and golden brown and soft enough to remove from the baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,chilies,watercress,grape tomato,green cabbage,lemon zest,golden syrup,milk
title: Grape Tomato & Chilies Tea
ingredients: 600 g seedless grapes tomatoes or 600 g roma tomatoes, quartered | 3 green cabbage, finely shredded | 1 bunch watercress, coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons grapeseed oil or 4 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 dash worcestershire sauce | 1 dash lemon zest | 1 dash chilies, crushed | 2 tablespoons whey, natural low-fat or 2 tablespoons skim milk
instructions: Boil watercress in separete. Wash the tomatoes and snap off the stems, leave just until any watercress is used up. Leave the tomatoes whole in their capsicum. Heat oil in a large frying pan. Add tomatoes, cabbage and watercress. Season with worcestershire sauce, lemon + chillies and lemon zest. Cover and simmer for 5 - 10 mins, until vegetables are tender. Stir in whey and serve.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,wakame,onion powder,celery leaf,lemon peel,rye bread
title: Reuben Kebab
ingredients: 2 cups thinly sliced celery leaves | 2 packages round rye bread | 1/2 cup wakame | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon dried onion powder, or more as needed | 4 tablespoons finely grated lemon peel
instructions: Combine celery leaves, rye bread cubes, wakame, almond extract, onion powder, and lemon peel in a food processor.

title: Tuna Patties
ingredients: 400 g tuna in brine | 1/2 cup almonds, finely chopped | 100 g white flour or 100 g unbleached white flour
instructions: Put the tuna in a colander and pour boiling water over it to taste. Allow to drain. Place the drained tuna into a sieve and squeeze out as much water as possible. Mix the almonds and flour in a bowl, add the tuna and mix. Roll the tuna mixture into 5 balls and then mould them into the floured almonds, coating them completely. Heat your griddle or frying pan over a medium high heat. When hot brush the griddle with oil and cook the patties for 2 minutes on each side or until they are golden brown and crispy.

title: Savory Swiss Roll Appetizer
ingredients: 4 tablespoons prepared aged brie cheese or 4 tablespoons provolone cheese, room temperature | 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa, sifted | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh rosemary sprig | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh sage leaves
instructions: Position oven rack in center of oven and heat to 450°f spread brie evenly over entire surface of roll. Bake until center of roll is lightly puffed and edges are lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Remove roll from oven. Transfer roll to cutting board. Slice roll lengthwise with sharp knife. Spread cocoa evenly over top and sides of roll.

title: Kalamih
ingredients: 4 pieces roasted leg of lamb | 2 pita breads | 2 teaspoons mustard powder
instructions: Mix the mustard and mustard powder together. Put on one piece of the roasted lamb and put on it a piece of the pita bread. Close up and smoke for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,plain flour,italian salad dressing,pepper sauce,caster sugar,garlic
title: Raspberry Bites
ingredients: 2 teaspoons finely minced garlic | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 cup raspberries | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1 tablespoon dried italian salad dressing | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350f/gas lightly grease mini muffin tins. Combine garlic, sugar and raspberries in a bowl. Sift the flour and salad dressing into a shallow dish and mix well. Make a well in the centre, then combine the mixture with the pepper sauce. Spoon some plum mixture into each muffin cup, then sprinkle with extra raspberries and garlic. Bake in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool in the tins on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,nicoise olive,parmesan cheese,pecorino cheese,parsnip,provolone cheese,rotel tomato chilies,broccoli floret
title: Italian Vegetables
ingredients: 3 small parsnips | 2 medium cornucini parsnips | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 lb grated provolone cheese | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 cup chopped and drained nicoise ( black pepper and cilantro )
instructions: Peel and chop parsnips, cornucini and parsnips. Place in a pot with water, and bring to just tender over medium low heat. Cook. Drain vegetables and place in a bowl. While vegetables are cooking, drain rotel. Add enough hot water to juice to get the right consistency for your tastes. Remove water from tomatoes, and stir in drained rotel, cheeses and lemon zest. Heat a large pan over medium heat. Add vegetable mixture, and cook vegetables until heated through. Serve over your favourite pasta or as an entree with warm flour bread.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,brown rice,green bell pepper,oil,pimento pepper,mustard powder
title: Sweet and Sour Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice ( white, basmati, jasmine, brown or white, whichever you prefer ) | 1/4 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup pimento peppers, chopped | confectioners'sugar | mustard powder | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Wash and stir the rice in several changes of water so it doesn't go lumpy. This usually will take about a half an hour or 2 if using a rice cooker that you would not be able to find in the market. Drain off any excess water. Return rice to pan along with the green pepper and pimentos and cover with about 4 cups of cold water. Cover and simmer until all of the water is absorbed by the rice. Stir the rice every 45 seconds until it bubbles slightly to the surface.. Remove the cover and stir once or twice until the rice is creamy and sticky like cottage cheese. Transfer to a serving dish and dust with confectioner's sugar and mustard powder. Serve immediately.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Smoked Provolone (Escalivos Saltsa)
ingredients: 6 slices prosciutto, chopped | 12 sage leaves, chopped | 1/3 cup soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place sage leaves in a small baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 1 minute, then place prosciutto slices on top. Bake for 10 minutes more, or until prosciutto is crisp and golden. Drizzle a small amount of soy sauce over the tops. Slice the prosciutto into 1/4 slices. You can slice them in as many pieces as you like, or transfer to a container with some salt and remaining soy sauce to preserve moisture.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,icing sugar,cocoa powder,cranberry,beef tenderloin steak
title: Lomo Saltado
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1/2 lb beef tenderloin steak | 2 cups icing sugar | 1/2 cup boiling water | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries ( optional )
instructions: Pound meat to about a 1/4 inch thick. Spread cocoa powder on steak. Place onto wax paper, and roll steak in cocoa to coat. Set aside. In a small bowl, beat icing sugar into boiling water. Stir in liquid smoke. Remove beef from bowl, and pour icing over meat. Toss until all the meat has been coated with icing. Place on baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake at 400f for 30 minutes, checking often. Remove when internal temperature reaches 135 degrees. Slice and serve hot.

title: Beer Dip (Delish)
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup | 1 can beer | 1/4 cup fresh thyme leave
instructions: Pour both cans of soup into a medium sized bowl and top with beer. Finely chop thyme leave and mix into the mix. Serve with tortilla chips, fresh veggies like carrots, mushrooms, etc.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,pine nut,colby monterey jack cheese,sultana,shortening,greek yogurt,onion seed
title: Pine Nut and Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 cup sultana | 1/2 small onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup coconut milk | 1/2 cup shortening | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a casserole dish. Spread sultanas on the bottom of the dish. Sprinkle with onion and 1/3 cup coconut milk. Melt shortening in a saucepan over medium heat and stir in greek yogurt and remaining coconut milk. Stir until smooth and creamy. Pour yogurt mixture over sultanas. Sprinkle with cheese. Top with remaining sultanas and pine nuts. Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes.

title: Mung Bean Beer With Beer
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups mung beans | 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 bottles light beer or ( 330 ml ) bottles light amber beer | 2 -4 teaspoons heavy cream
instructions: Place the mung beans in a bowl with cold water. Soak until softened, about 3 hours. Drain. Place the butter in a heavy skillet over medium high heat. When melted, add the mung beans and brown, breaking up the beans with a wooden spoon, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and cool. When cool to the touch, stir in the beer and cream. Cover and allow to mingle for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: honey,tamarind paste,green chili pepper,beef tenderloin steak
title: Beef Satay
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, very thin, cut into cubes | 1 small green chili pepper, seeded and sliced | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1/3 cup honey
instructions: Thread 4 pieces of beef onto skewers alternating them on the skewer and securing each piece with toothpicks. Place in a bowl marinade with tamarind paste and honey. Chill for at least 8 hours.

title: Mock Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1 to 1/2 inch cubes | 2 pints barley | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate squares | 1 container miniature chocolate squares | 3 tablespoons superfine sugar
instructions: Place the stew meat into a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook for 2 hours. Remove the stew meat, and reduce the liquid by half. Drain and set aside. In a separate pot cover the barley with water. Bring to a boil, and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and set aside. In a medium metal bowl, beat together the chocolate squares and sugar until chocolate is smooth. Stir in the beef and mix thoroughly. Cover the pot with a lid, and set over very low heat so that the chocolate does not burn and caramelize. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, then pour into bowls with the cornbar and beef. Cool to room temperature, then cover tightly and refrigerate for 6 to 6 hours before serving.

title: Orange Zested Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 2 pounds beef brisket, well trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Stir orange zest, tahini, vegetable oil, and brisket together in a glass baking dish large enough to hold the meat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour 30 minutes. Bake brisket in the preheated oven until tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove to a serving platter.

title: Ginger Chunk and Scotch Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 piece fresh ginger-garlic paste | 8 slices sandwich buns | 8 slices scotch
instructions: Spread each piece of sandwich buns with ginger garlic paste and place on a plate. Slice each sandwich diagonally to form 4 triangles. Spread scotch on the toasted sandwich buns. Top with scotch. Serve with pickled cantonese peppers.

title: Brandied Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs chuck roast, trimmed of fat | 3 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Put meat in 2 to 3 large bowls. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper, then pour brandy atop the meat and ignite. Place on a hot platter and let the flames burn down. Do not discard the burned smell of the brandy after eating, there will be a lot of alcohol coming through the platter. After a few minutes, the meat should be pink and slightly crusty inside, but not completely browned inside. Remove meat to a crockpot, or a roasting pan, and place on a rack over 2 inches of the heat. Cover with lid or foil. Cook on low 8 to 12 hours, or until meat is tender. Remove from the grill.

title: Homemade Beef Seasoning
ingredients: 3/4 cup ghee | 1/4 cup dark molasses, not black | 1/4 cup catsup ( optional )
instructions: Melt ghee in a small or medium pan on medium heat. Do not let it smoke. When it turns to dark, add molasses and stir until mixed together. You want it to be fairly dark. Add catsup, if desired, and stir until dissolved. Cool, cover and store up to 2 months.

title: Brown Sugar Glaze
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons cheap cheese ( parmesan, mozzarella, swiss or swiss )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a pan on the stove and stir with a whisk. Cook until bubbly and the cheese is melted and it is mixed.

title: Lebanese Parsley Tea
ingredients: 4 bunches parsley, washed, dried and picked | 1/2 tablespoon parsley, finely shredded ( or 1 tsp. dried )
instructions: Place parsley to the side in a bowl, sprinkle over the parsley and toss to coat. Let stand for 10 - 15 minutes. The tea should be chilled before serving.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,baby shrimp,baking soda,roquefort cheese,kaffir lime leaf
title: Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1 lb baby shrimp | 2 ounces roquefort cheese | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 4 kaffir lime leaves or 4 other citrus limes, quartered | 1/4 lb thinly sliced roasted deli shrimp
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp. Slice cheese into 8 pieces. Rinse with cold water and drain. Squeeze lime juice to release excess liquid and place inside shrimp. Arrange cheese on shrimp and pour over remaining mixture. Sprinkle with remaining lime juice and bake @ 350 until shrimp are cooked through, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,red pepper flake,graham cracker crumb,baby bok choy,mascarpone
title: Baby Bok Choy with Chocolate-Sherry Sauce
ingredients: 1 package baby bok choy, trimmed into 2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup mascarpone | 3/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | crushed red pepper flakes to taste
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Place baby bok choy into the boiling water, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Immediately, remove them from the water, and pat dry with paper towels. Cover and place on a large serving platter. Pour sherry over the bok choy, and set aside 3/4 cup of the sauce. Place mascarpone into a small bowl, and stir in 1/4 cup of the reserved mushroom sauce. Place shredded graham cracker crumbs into a small bowl, and stir in a dash of crushed red pepper flakes into the cheese. Set aside a small amount of the cheese mixture while you assemble the rest of the bok choy. Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Spoon a little bit of the reserved mushroom sauce onto the top of the bok choy, then sprinkle the rest of the cheese mixture over the top. Sprinkle crushed red pepper flakes over the top of the bok choy. Bake in the preheated oven for about 40 minutes, or until the cheese has melted into the sauce.

title: Aussie Beef Burgers
ingredients: 600 g best quality roast beef | 3 tablespoons wheat germ
instructions: Slice your roast beef thinly and then into 1cm / 3 mm / 3inch / 1 1/2 cm / 1 1/2 inch / 1 1/2 cm / 1 cm / 1 cm / 1 1/2 cm / 1 cm / 5 cm / 1 cm / and then across by using a round biscuit cut out of the biscuit into circles for keeping. Place in a non stick grilling pan and cover with water. Cook the beef until it is cooked and browned. When the beef is cooked take it out of the oven, put on a plate to cool. When the beef is cool slice it into about 5 mm / 1 inch / 7 cm / 1 1/2 inch / 16 cm / 1 1/2 inch / 1 1/2 cm / 5 mm / slices / repeat until all the beef has been used. Put the wheat germ into a small bowl and make a well. Add a teaspoon of the heated beef liquid to the wheat germ and mix until thoroughly mixed. Place a wok on the stove top on the highest setting or alternatively have a heavy skillet on top. Add enough beef liquid to the wok to make a total of approximately 1 1/2 cm / 5 cm / 5 cm / 10 cm / 5 inch / 5 cm / 5cm / total. If there is too much liquid, stir in a little water. When the liquid is nearly evaporated, place the beef slices on top of the wheat germ and turn the wok on the other heat and let the liquid evaporate out. The meat will start to stick to the bottom of the wok, this is normal. Try stirring a few times until the meat is completely coated in the wheat germ mixture. The meat will not stick to the wok unless it is so close the meat is browned on all sides. If any meat juices form at this point, add a few drops of water to help absorb the liquid. This will only take a few minutes at most. Once the meat is browned it will all be brown and have a tasty, sticky consistency to it. Remove the meat from the wok with a slotted spoon and put on a plate to cool. It should only be eaten as little as possible. The meat can be served hot or cold. Note, if using the bbq technique the first time the recipe was made it took less than 5 minutes, but would be better if you use an electric grill.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,red chile pepper,broth,sugar cookie dough,pineapple
title: Sweet and Sour Broth Pumpkin Treats
ingredients: 1 can broiled pineapple, drained, coarsely chopped | 1 can wild rice, drained | 3 tablespoons sugar cookie dough | 1/2 red chile pepper, finely diced | 1/2 cup broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. In a large bowl, mix the broccoli, wild rice, pineapple, chile pepper, and sugar cookie dough. Pour in enough broth to moisten the rice mixture. Using a spatula, spread evenly onto the baking sheet. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned.

title: Beefsteak  Salsa Verde
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs top sirloin steaks | 6 tablespoons salsa verde | 1 tablespoon dried sage leaves | 1 tablespoon mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the steak. Combine the marinade ingredients in a medium bowl and pour over the steak. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for up to 36 hours. Remove steak from the refrigerator 30 minutes before grilling. Preheat the grill. Remove meat from the marinade and grill over medium hot coals for 10 minutes for medium rare, 15 minutes for medium. Serve the meat on a platter. Garnish with salsa verde.

title:

 rigatoni with oxtail | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 2 tablespoons unsweetened grated coconut | 1 lb oxtail | 1 lb rigatoni pasta

Random Ingredients: almond extract,macadamia nut,molasses,red pepper flake,oat,granola cereal,pea,rosemary
title: Popsicles
ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats | 1/2 cup granola cereal | 1 cup chopped macadamia nuts | 1 tablespoon ground almonds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon molasses | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Grind oats, granola and macadamia nuts together using a spice grinder or a food processor. Stir in spices. Roll popsicle sticks in ground nut mixture and press balls lightly into miniature muffin cups.

Random Ingredients: white onion,pizza crust,cilantro leaf,turmeric powder,coconut cream,eye roast
title: Easy Shrove Beef Pizza
ingredients: 1 crust | 1 can coconut cream ( i use coco coco lopez ) | 1 white onion | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 10 ounces ready-to-use sliced eye of round roast | 6 -10 fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: To make the crust, use a pizza peel large enough to fit a regular size glass pie pan. Coat the pizza peel in a thin layer of olive oil. In a bowl whisk coconut cream, onions, tumeric, and remaining coconut sauce.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,dark soy sauce,soba noodle,almond,tomato paste,yellow onion,self raising flour,spicy pork sausage
title: Chinese Savoury Sausage and Pastry
ingredients: 225 g chinese chinese spicy pork sausage, cut into chunks ( i actually like chouriya in this recipe. ) | 5 tablespoons salad oil | 2 small yellow onions, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 4 teaspoons unsweetened plain sifted self-raising flour | 125 g soba noodles | 25 g ground almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. In a large ovenproof dish, place the sausage and half the salad oil. Stir fry over low heat for 10 minutes or until cooked through. Transfer to a large bowl. Repeat with the remaining sausage and oil. Drain off the fat from the pan with a slotted spoon. Return the pan to the heat. Add the remaining ingredients and stir well to combine. Remove from the heat. Meanwhile, place the soba noodles in a large pan of boiling water. Cover and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Easy and Delicious Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower ( cut into small florets ) | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1/4 cup black olives ( chopped )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 minutes or until al dente.

title: Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 3 tablespoons hot water | 3 packages ladyfingers | 1 can artichoke hearts | 1/4 cup icing sugar
instructions: In a small bowl, mix icing sugar and hot water. Split the ladyfingers in half and spread half of the icing over the bottom of a springform pan, leaving a little of the crust around the edges. Layer with artichoke hearts. Sprinkle with icing sugar, place in oven, and bake until mixture is bubbly and slightly shrreded, about 40 min. Remove from oven and brush with remaining icing, cool, and cut into 1 slices to serve.

title: Salt-Crusted Barbecue Piglets and Scallops on a Skewer
ingredients: 12 ounces cleaned and deveined scallops | 4 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: In a glass or stainless steel bowl, add the salt and scallops and mix together. Place the metal skewers in the plastic and turn to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit for 20 minutes. Spray a barbeque grill with cooking spray and preheat to 400 degrees f. Cook the scallops, turning often until the edges curl and the scallops are no longer opaque in the center of the tail. Drain on a parchment covered paper towel. Transfer to a platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,cider vinegar,sunflower oil,tapioca flour,red wine
title: Artichoke Flatbread
ingredients: 1 cup tapioca flour ( also known as cornmeal ) | 1/3 cup white dry red wine, such as cabernet sauvignon | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 5 tablespoons sunflower oil
instructions: Mix together the tapioca flour, wine, vinegar, and artichokes in a bowl. Make into 1 inch diameter indentations in the mixture, and add a tablespoon of sunflower oil. Place a teaspoonful of the mixture on a cold, lightly floured surface, and press down so that it just covers the top of the bread. If the indentation is not yet created, sprinkle some water over the surface until it is. Shape the mixture into 2 inch balls, and flatten slightly. If the bread is large, shape into circle shaped patties by pressing lightly. Place flatbread on an ungreased baking sheet, and put into a preheated oven. Bake in 400 f oven for 8 minutes, or until lightly toasted. Cool slightly. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chunk,cauliflower,italian seasoning,balsamic vinegar,bok choy,red lentil,marshmallow
title: Red Lentils With Bok Choy and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 lb cauliflower, cut in florets | 3/4 cup red lentil, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup italian seasoning | 3/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 8 cups chopped bok choy | 6 miniature marshmallows | 1 1/2 cups bittersweet chocolate chunks, chopped
instructions: Steam the cauliflower in the microwave until crisp tender, or in a skillet with a little water, until the cauliflower is just tender.

title: German Baked Clam Chowder
ingredients: 24 large clams, scrubbed | 1 1/3 cups buttermilk | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: In a large dutch oven, bring 2 quarts of salted water to a rolling boil. Add the clams to the boiling water and cook until they open, about 5 minutes. Remove the clams, and immediately cover. Remove the shells from the shells. Discard any clams that don't open. In a medium bowl, mix together the buttermilk and lemon zest. Add the clams to the buttermilk mixture, and stir to coat the clams. Cover and refrigerate the chowder for a few hours or overnight. Sprinkle the seafood with chopped parsley, if desired.

Random Ingredients: french bread,horseradish,creme de cacao,red chili paste,garlic,scallion
title: Horseradish Toast
ingredients: 1/4 cup creme de cacao | 3 tablespoons red chili paste ( sriracha ) | 1 head garlic, sliced thin | 1/2 loaf french bread, sliced | 1 scallion, chopped fine | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish
instructions: Combine the creme de cacao, chili paste, garlic, and 1/4 cup of water in a bowl. Soak bread slices in mixture until dry, but not mushy. Heat frying pan on medium high grill. When hot, place bread slices in the mixture and turn until golden on both sides, about 2 - 4 minutes per side. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,cider vinegar,garlic clove,grain rice,cream tartar,bisquick baking mix
title: Creamy Creamy Short-Form Rice
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger ( optional ) | 3/4 cup bisquick baking mix | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 cup long grain rice or 1 cup other aromatic white rice | 2 garlic cloves, finely minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a medium bowl, mix the first five ingredients, and pour over rice in a 9 inch baking dish. Bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, stirring every 15 minutes. While rice is baking, chop garlic, and stir in remaining ingredients. Turn into a serving dish and refrigerate until set.

title: Chile Mayonnaise With Chive Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons chives, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 can diced green chilies | 1 medium banana, sliced
instructions: Process the chives, mustard, wine and sliced chilies in a food processor. Add the banana and blend until mixture becomes a smooth paste. Place in a serving bowl and chill for at least 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,cauliflower,basmati rice,chicken bouillon cube,hot italian sausage,milk chocolate chip
title: Spicy Sausage and Cauliflower One Pot Meal
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage or 1 lb hot italian sausage, cut into 1-inch slices | 1 cup cauliflower, torn into florets ( about 2 cups ) | 1/3 cup chicken stock, low-fat | 3/4 cup milk chocolate chips | 1 chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 cup chicken stock | 0.5 package basmati rice for risotto or 1 1/2 cups long grain rice
instructions: To make sausage, in medium saute pan over medium heat, cook sausage.

title: Artichoke Appetizer
ingredients: 2 pieces turkey breast tenderloins | 2 jars marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 1/2 cup white vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove meat slices from plastic bag and place them on a square of aluminum foil. Combine artichoke hearts and vinegar in a bowl and set aside. Place turkey tenderloins in the same pan over medium heat and cook until done. Drain turkey and return it to the pan. Pour artichoke heart mixture over the turkey and artichoke hearts. Sprinkle with additional vinegar. Cover and bake 25 minutes.

title: Mexican Beans
ingredients: 1 can chili beans, fully drained | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning
instructions: Drain chili beans into medium saucepan. Stir in mustard, creole seasoning, and chili beans with juice. Heat and serve over flour tortillas.

Random Ingredients: raisin,sesame seed,barbecue sauce,puff pastry,oil,garam masala powder
title: BBQ Mushrooms on a Stick
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 -2 teaspoon barbecue sauce | 1 puff pastry sheet | 1/4 cup raisins | oil, for frying
instructions: Toast sesame seeds in a non stick frying pan. When they turn black, remove them from heat. Grind into a fine powder. Stir in garam masala powder. Cut puff pastry into 2 pieces of equal thickness and roll it out on a floured board. Cut it into 6 wedges. Spread each wedge out thinly with your thumb or a rolling pin. Place the mushroom pieces on the greased baking sheet and bbq on high heat for 15 to 20 minutes till brown and crispy. Remove from heat. To serve, place an equal amount of raisins on each portion of mushrooms. Brush with bbq sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,limeade concentrate,honey,fine breadcrumb,orange juice zest,raisin
title: Sweet Crumb Parfait
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange juice, fresh or 1/4 cup limeade concentrate | 1 lime, zest of | 2 1/2 cups fine breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup dark chocolate | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 cup honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly coat a 9 inch round pan with cooking spray or place in a shallow roasting pan.

title: Balsamic-Glazed Rigatoni in Pasta
ingredients: 350 g rigatoni pasta | 2 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Bring the water to the boil in a large pan. Add half the pasta and cook until tender. Drain. Add remaining pasta and balsamic to the pasta.

title: Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 head lettuce | 3 cups tomatoes with juice, peeled and chopped | 3 plantains, cut into small chunks | 1/3 cup coarsely grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( about 10 lemons ) | grated gruyere cheese ( optional )
instructions: Place lettuce in large bowl. Add tomatoes, plantains, and cheese. Toss to mix and allow flavors to blend. Pour over lettuce in bowl and toss to mix, cover and refrigerate for about 1 hour. Just before serving, stir in nuts. Sprinkle with lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: pecan,chicken thigh,ear corn,currant,orange flower water,mustard seed
title: Mustard Seeds and Chicken
ingredients: 1 bunch ear corn | 8 chicken thighs | 1 cup raisins | 3 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons currants | 1 teaspoon orange flower water
instructions: Cook and stir corn and chicken thighs in a large pot with enough water to cover for 2 to 5 hours, until no longer sticky. Strain through a sieve and reserve. Remove the chicken meat from pot, reserving the cooking liquid. Cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, in a medium skillet, stir together mustard seeds, currants, and orange flower water, and cook over medium low heat, stirring constantly, until toasted. Remove from heat and add poppy seeds to mustard mixture about one cup at a time, stirring well after every addition. Pour cooled mustard mixture over chicken, bring to a simmer, and cook 5 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through. Place chicken in oven or oven safe baking dish, cover, and bake 25 minutes at 450 degrees f. Uncover the saucepan, sprinkle top with crumbled bacon, and bake at 450 degrees f until lightly brown.

Random Ingredients: margarine,pecorino romano cheese,sesame oil,jalapeno pepper,oregano,cremini mushroom,lime wedge,alfredo sauce
title: Grilled Mushrooms with Alfredo
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1/2 cup margarine | 4 cups thinly sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 2 cups chopped pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Place sesame oil and margarine in a small pan over medium heat. Add mushrooms, cover and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in jalapeno pepper. Let cool. Remove and discard mushroom stems. In a small bowl, mix alfredo sauce, cheese, oregano and lime. Pour sauce over mushroom mixture. Add remaining ingredients and heat through. Serve over grilled eggplant, tortilla chips, or as a topping on chicken, veal or shrimp eggs, if desired. Note, if serving as a sandwich, make a small opening for the filling and spread cheese on top, using a spoon. Cook until the cheese melts and serve with bread. Variation #1 or #2. Sauteed mushrooms with jalapeno pepper added during the prep process. Variation #2 in a large skillet, over medium high heat, saute mushroom with hot sauce in margarine. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,pine nut,vidalia onion,pineapple juice,kernel corn,garlic,chili flake
title: Sweet Corn in Pineapple
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 vidalia onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 3 tablespoons garlic, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili flakes | 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Puree the corn and onion, add the rest of the ingredients, blending well and then serve.

Random Ingredients: luncheon meat spam,chili paste,milk chocolate chip,cayenne pepper,pork chop
title: Hot Dogs & Spam-Spam Chops (Coxin Free
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork chops | 2 -3 tablespoons ground chili paste ( kochukaru ) | 2 - 2 1/2 cups skim milk chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 6 lbs luncheon meat ( spam, spam, meat, scallops.. )
instructions: Line the bottom and sides of a large pyrex dish with foil. Lay the chops on the foil. Put a couple of tablespoons of chili paste in the bottom of each fry pan. Sprinkle with a pinch of cayenne pepper, followed by a couple of slices of chocolate chips. Then lay the top slice of spam on top of the chocolate. Put another couple of slices of chocolate on top, followed by a bit of chili paste on top of the spam. Repeat until you've used all of the sauces and meat. Add a couple of tablespoons cayenne pepper on top of the spam so it does not break apart, and then turn the heat to medium. Let the pan cook for about 3 minutes until the top slices are nice and dark. You don't really need to cover with foil, but it is a very good way to keep the pan from getting soggy. You can keep it at this temperature until it is almost gone, or for up to another 15 minutes. Take out the foil carefully, and place the top slices of spam on top of the spam. Take about two spoonfuls of the sauce, put over a few drops of cream and enjoy.

title: Black Olive Pastry
ingredients: 2/3 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup finely ground black olives | 1/2 tablespoon dried tarragon or 1 teaspoon dried minced tarragon
instructions: Put flour in a resealable plastic bag. Add pepper, black olives, dried tarragon and mix with your fingers until the olive is coated. Remove the contents to a bowl. Cover and put in the refrigerator for 6 hours or until firm. Roll pastry very thin on a floured board. Cut the pastry into strips about 1/8 inch wide and 2 inches long by 1 inch wide. Cut strips into 6 strips for 2 cups pastry. Put back on pastry strips and pinch the edges closed. Sprinkle a work surface with additional flour, and roll the pastry into a 3 inch long cylinder. Cut 1 inch strips of pastry from one end of each strip. Repeat with the other 1/3 cup filling. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Place 2 pastries on the sheets.

title: Pancake Baklava
ingredients: 3 cups lychees ( weight after trimming, if frozen ) | 8 sheets phyllo pastry ( see variations below for recipe from recipezaar ) | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 pinch fennel seed | 3 tablespoons fenugreek leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 200c and line 3 baking trays with baking paper. Put phyllo sheets on baking tray. Sprinkle with fennel and anise seeds. Whip remaining egg and brush over phyllo. Place 3 sheets on top, brush both with the egg mixture and sprinkle with a little fennel or ground chilli. Bake for 20 mins or until golden brown. Top with remaining sheets of phyllo to seal and cook for a further 5 mins until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: boston lettuce,almond extract,mini chocolate chip,balsamic vinegar,chive,bay scallop,white cake mix
title: Balsamic Baked Scallops
ingredients: 1 cup mini chocolate chip | 1 package dry white cake mix | 1/4 cup finely chopped chives | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon pure almond extract | 1 1/2 lbs medium sea scallops, rinsed | 1/2 cup thinly sliced boston lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Remove biscuit from package and place on a cutting board. Place chocolate chips on top of a double thickness of heavy duty aluminum foil and top with scallops. Pile chile chips on the scallops. Bake scallops until scallops are opaque and centers are no longer opaque, 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with chives. Combine balsamic vinegar and almond extract in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Pour sauce over scallops to serve.

title: Nilagaire's Famous Parsnips and Great Northern Beans
ingredients: 3 pounds parsnips, peeled and cut into chunks | 3 cans great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 jar sliced luncheon meat | 3 tablespoons mole, bean sauce for topping
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place parsnips in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 8 minutes. Arrange the parsnips in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through but not browned, about 40 minutes.

title: Macaroni and Sour Cream - Microwave Version
ingredients: 300 g macaroni | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Microwave 100g macaroni for 4 minutes, mix with rest of the ingredients, stir and continue microwaving for 5 mins on full power or for 10 mins on full power with 600w. Turn off microwave and leave in pan to stand for 15 minutes, serve warm with bread or cream.

title: Confetti Mexicali
ingredients: 1/2 red onion, sliced | 1/2 yellow pepper, sliced ( or more )
instructions: Saute the sliced onion together with the pepper until onion has softened. Pour out any residual fat. Add the mexican cheese blend. Stir until everything has melted.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,ginger paste,balsamic vinegar,green curry paste,garlic,chicken broth,moisture part mozzarella cheese
title: Quick and Easy Green Curry Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons thai green curry paste | 1 -2 tablespoon ginger paste ( to taste or try sriracha ) | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | sliced green mozzarella cheese ( optional ) | 1 package refrigerated crusty crusty mozzarella cheese ( about 2 cups )
instructions: In small saucepan, stir together all ingredients. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat to simmer. Heat to simmering.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,blueberry,arborio rice,bow tie pasta,thyme,plain yogurt,horseradish
title: Blueberry and Horseradish Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 lb bow tie pasta | 3 cups uncooked arborio rice | 4 cups chilled blueberries | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and cool. Add remaining ingredients and toss. Chill until serving.

title: Spiced Prosciutto
ingredients: 8 ounces prosciutto, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted and sliced | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon dried mint or 1 tablespoon fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to slice prosciutto thinly crosswise, about 4 - 6 slices per serving. Lay slices out on a baking sheet. Place a reasonable amount of each of the following, kalamata olive, red pepper flakes, and dried mint or fresh mint in a cheese cloth or plastic bag, and tie tightly. Serve with olive oil for dipping. You want to keep a little of the spice in because the olives can be salty.

Random Ingredients: bacon,scallion,manchego cheese,thai red curry paste,bacon dripping,gorgonzola
title: Pancake With Gorgonzola and Bacon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bacon drippings | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup manchego cheese, grated | 4 scallions, finely chopped, white and green parts separate | 4 slices bacon, cooked until crisp, finely chopped | 8 ounces gorgonzola
instructions: Heat bacon drippings in large frying pan over low heat. Add curry paste and cook, stirring for 2 minutes. Stir in cheese until it melts. Remove from heat and stir in scallions. Place cheese mixture in an ovenproof dish. Add the bacon and top with crumbled bacon. Bake in a 350 deg f oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve with a side of noodles. Variation, instead of manchego cheese use a mild feta cheese.

title: Faux Mexican Pork Roast
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 cubanelle peppers, cut into 1-inch squares | 3/4 lb boneless pork roast | 1 jalapeno, chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons desiccated coconut, flaked
instructions: In a bowl, combine bread crumbs and panko crumbs with a fork, mix well. Pat meat onto a platter. Rinse and dry peppers. Sprinkle with salt and pepper if desired. Place a piece of pork on each pepper, top with a square or two of jalapeno. Roll up the roast loosely and secure with twine by tying with a toothpick. Heat a heavy skillet over medium heat. Reduce heat, and cook 2 minutes per side. Remove from heat. Let stand 15 minutes. Slice. Serve with rice and beans.

title: Homemade Ham Stock
ingredients: 4 lbs ham, lean & coarsely chopped | 1 bottle wine, any type, such as cabernet sauvignon | 2 liters small clear-bodied red cooking wine
instructions: Combine coarsely chopped ham, cooking wine and liquid in bowl, cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least 8 hours.

title: Cajun Sunflower Seed Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups shelled sunflower seeds | 1/4 cup finely chopped red onion | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 tablespoons drained chopped pimiento
instructions: Place sunflower seeds in a small baking dish and sprinkle with onion. Roast at 400 degrees fahrenheit for about 10 minutes or until the seeds turn a light golden brown. Shake the canola oil on the counter and toss the can and hot pepper in the oil. Add pimiento cheese and continue to shake the can and hot pepper in the oil until the cheese is melted. Pour dressing over sunflower seed salad. Chill and serve with bread.

title: Mustard Chicken Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 chicken tenderloins | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450°f. Rinse and pat dry the chicken tenderloins. Place the chicken tenderloins on a baking sheet and coat them with dijon and then lightly sprinkle with salt. Bake in your oven until the meat is well browned and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,monterey jack cheese,irish cream,orange peel,fruit,cilantro,yellow pepper
title: Roasted Pepper Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 medium yellow peppers, seeded and halved | 4 medium red peppers, seeded and halved | 4 ounces grated monterey jack cheese ( can sub any other kind of cheese ) | 1/4 cup sweet pickled fruit ( pickled ) | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, minced | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons orange peel, finely chopped | coarsely grated fresh cilantro
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and heat to 400°f. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with non stick cooking spray. Arrange peppers slices in a single layer on foil lined baking sheet. Bake for 30 to 30 minutes or until roasted and lightly browned and tender. Cool slightly. Remove peppers and cool completely. Cut bell peppers into 4 long strips. Place on baking sheet and bake approximately 5 minutes or until slightly softened. Using a fork, mash peppers with the cheese. Spread all pepper sauce on peppers. Top with pickled fruit, cilantro and crushed red pepper. Wrap in foil and continue with remaining peppers. Place on prepared baking sheet and top each quesadilla with a sprinkling of orange peel and cilantro.

title: Spinach with Pecans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach or 1 lb frozen spinach, washed and well drained | 2 tablespoons chopped onions | 2 tablespoons chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 dash soy sauce | 1 dash ground chili-garlic powder ( optional )
instructions: Steam or microwave spinach, covered for 2 - 3 minutes. Till all the water released by the spinach is gone. Squish spinach over hot cooked pasta or stir fry veggies. Add in chili paste and soy sauce. Enjoy.

title: Sweet and Savory Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chives | 1/2 cup chopped dried cherries | 1/4 cup green curry paste | 1/3 cup sliced mixed fresh fruit such as sliced berries, bananas and apple, chopped, and tossed with cooking spray | 1/4 cup snipped fresh chives | butter, for frying ( optional ) | 1/3 cup cracked wheat
instructions: Combine pasta and chives in a large serving bowl. Combine cherries, curry paste and fruit juices in small bowl. Sprinkle half of the noodles and chives over mixture in bowl and toss. Top with remaining noodles, chives and fruit.

title: Vegetarian Swiss Chard and Swiss Chard Tiramisu
ingredients: 4 bunches swiss chard | 8 ladyfingers | 2 small red capsicums | 4 tablespoons red capsicums, finely chopped
instructions: Roughly chop the swiss chard and stems from stems. Cut stems into 6 even pieces. Separate stalks from leaves, cut leaves in halves and wash leaves, discard stalks from leaves. Wash leaves until water runs clear. Trim off hard center ribs from chard stems. Cut capsicums into long strips. Place 1 tbsp of the chard stems and capsicum into a small bowl of warm water. Put aside to soften for 10 minutes add to the chilled swiss chard, and mix well. Scoop 2 tablespoons of the chard mixture onto the base of 6 - 8 ladyfingers, arrange the leaves around them, leaving a small gap on the sides. Repeat with the remaining leaves and capsicum mixture. Top with remaining chard stems and capsicum mixture. Put in a preheated oven at 180°c/350°f/gas mark 11 for 20 - 25 minutes until crisp and golden. Garnish with chopped fresh green spring onions.

title: Pressed Cuban Sandwich (Art)
ingredients: 4 slices bread, slightly stale | 1/3 cup half-and-half cream, divided | 1 1/2 cups hamburger, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 small anchovy fillet
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Spread the bread with 1/3 cup of the cream.

title: Chinese Steamed Oysters
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 7 tablespoons french dressing
instructions: Combine the oyster sauce and french dressing and mix well. Spoon into your oysters and serve with other favorite steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,self rising flour,sea salt black pepper,flour
title: Chickpeas - Indian Flat Bread
