ingredients: 2 2 cups self-rising flour or 2 cups spelt flour | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | cayenne ( optional ) | flour, to dust dough ( optional )
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add the salt, pepper, and cayenne/mayonnaise, if using. Knead the dough until smooth. Cover and refrigerate for an hour or so. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and divide into 10 pieces. Use a sharp, floured knife and divide the dough into 10 pieces. Roll each piece of dough with lightly floured hands until it is about 10 long. Flatten each piece into a round shape with 1 inch of flour on each edge. Place the round shaped bread onto a lightly floured tray. Brush with a little water while you are grilling. Sprinkle lightly with flour if you want. Cut a small slit in the top of each bread with a sharp knife. Cook on a hot griddle or griddle over a medium heat until they are lightly browned on both sides and cooked through. Variation, the breads can also be baked on the grill to brown the tops before being served.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,chinese mushroom,bay leaf,cream cheese,pinto bean,pear
title: Chinese Cheese Bean Dip
ingredients: 15 ounces pinto beans ( drained ) | 1 pears ( chopped ) | 1 can cream cheese ( cut in cubes ) | 1 can sliced chinese mushrooms ( drained ) | 1 bay leaf | 2 teaspoons cream of celery soup
instructions: Put all ingredients in a crockpot. Stir well. Cook on low for 7 - 8 hours.

title: Smoked Trout, Blueberry and Crab
ingredients: 4 smoked trout | 4 yellow-orange soda bottles of carbonated lemon-lime beverage ( like 7-up ) | 10 whole vanilla wafers | 2 bay leaves | 1 head escarole, torn into little nests
instructions: Drain fish in a strainer for about 10 minutes, just to rinse off excess saltiness. Cut fish into serving sized pieces, preferably 1 inch wide and 1 inch long. If possible, place fish pieces on a lightly greased baking sheet along with orange soda bottles. Broil or grill fish for about 5 to 10 minutes, or until lightly browned. Remove fish pieces and slice into rounds about 1/4 inch wide and 3 inches wide. Place all remaining ingredients in a large bowl and toss to blend with a bit of sugar if needed over the fish pieces and gently toss. Serve on a plate and dust with additional sugar.

title: Creamy Cranberry Cheese and Frankfurter Bread
ingredients: 500 g flour ( all-purpose flour can be used when measuring flour ) | 4 g active dry yeast | 1 liter cooking oil ( for frying ) | 100 g caster sugar ( light brown ) | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon frangelico ( optional ) | 500 g hamburger | 100 g dried cranberries
instructions: In a large mixing bowl using a stand mixer mix flour. Add yeast, the oil, sugar, frangelico and half pint of water. Dough should be a soft mass of dough but not falling apart. Cover the bowl with a towel and allow to sit in a warm area. If it doesn’t rise enough the oil with a lid can go down in a matter of seconds. Knead until it looks elastic and doesn’t require extra flour. Add remaining milk and knead well. If dough is too wet it will be easier to work with. Place dough on a lightly oiled surface and shape into a large log. Allow to rise again until doubled.. Prepare topping with crumpled foil. Once risen punch down dough and place on baking tray. Cover tops of bread with extra foil. Poke holes all over with a fork. Bake at 190c for around 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,pasta sauce,peanut,spring onion,superfine sugar,yellow pepper,celery,sherry
title: French Peanut Stuffing With Pasta
ingredients: 6 large yellow peppers, thinly sliced ( red is preferred ) | 1 large celery, finely diced ( or 1/2 cup green ) | 2 spring onions, finely chopped | 1 loaf rye bread ( or other stale bread ) | 250 g frozen unsalted peanuts, defrosted | 2 tablespoons sherry | 1/2 cup bottled pasta sauce ( such as ritz ) | 1/4 cup superfine sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c line a baking tray with baking paper & toast the peppers & celery in the oven for about 20 minutes, or until the peppers have softened & turning brown. Add the spring onion & cook for a further 10 - 15 minutes. Remove the peppers & celery from oven & dry them out in a kitchen towel. Remove the bread, tear it up into large pieces & add to the meat. Remove the crusts & cut the bread into 1 slices. Mix the peanut stuffing ingredients in a bowl until well blended & put aside. Using a fork, lightly poke holes in half of each slice of bread & place the pieces into a roasting tray. Spoon the peanut bread stuffing over the bread, then bake in a moderate oven for about 45 minutes, stirring a couple of times, or until the bread is golden and the stuffing feels like a stuffing. Serve warm or cold.

title: Mexican Olive Paste
ingredients: 3 pimento-stuffed olives | 1 1/4 cups sugar | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar
instructions: Cut the olives in half, if whole, and remove all of the seeds and any white membrane. Place the pimentos in a microwave safe dish and cover with water. Cook on high for about one minute, until a knife can pierce the skins. Remove the pimentos from the water, but leave the skin on. Slit off the stem, leaving enough to stuff the olives.

title: Buddha's Pizza Florentine
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 2 tablespoons dried marjoram | 1/4 cup dark chives, chopped | 3 packages yeast | 1 cup brown rice, cooked | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets | 1/2 lb dark chocolate, melted
instructions: Dry mushrooms and place in a large bowl. Add sugar, marjoram, chives, and yeast, and beat with an electric mixer until smooth. Let sit until bubbly. Spoon a layer of the yeast mixture into the bottom of a jelly roll pan. Begin layering with sauce, cheese, and more sauce. Start at the bottom, and spread your filling over the filling. Fold in the sides, and roll up like an jelly roll, starting at the middle, making sure the filling doesn't spread out so much you can seal tightly. Repeat the last 4 steps, using your seam to help lay dough out. Sprinkle chocolate over the top, and drizzle melted butter over all. Let rise until doubled, about an hour. Bake at 350ºf for 45 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Cheese Croutons
ingredients: 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules
instructions: Combine cheese and bouillon. Roll into balls about the size of a golf ball. Drop into a greased medium size frying pan or casserole dish.. Bake at 400 degrees for 6 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,cooking oat,mint leaf,italian seasoning,thyme leaf,white onion,vanilla extract,red cherry
title: Herbed Oat Salad With Dried Cherries
ingredients: 3 cups quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup white onion | 1/4 cup dried sweetened cherries | 2 tablespoons dried quick-cooking oats | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 cup dried mint leaves | 1 teaspoon real vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Whisk together oats, onion, cherry and sweetened italian seasoning together in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,sumac,pine nut,beef chuck roast,ginger paste,green tea
title: Persian Pot Roast (Dry-Meat)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast ( or you may use 2 smaller beef roast, with a thinner meat mallet ) | 1 cup green tea ( or 1 small glass jar of tea ) | 1/2 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 tablespoon sumac ( or a mixture of cardamom and cloves ) | 1/2 lb prosciutto, finely diced | toasted pine nuts
instructions: Place roast in crockpot and pour the green tea over it. Sprinkle with ginger paste, turkish spices, sumac and diced ham. Cook on high for 6 hours, turn to low and cook for another 4 hours. Remove roast and shred with a fork. Reheat and serve with toasted pine nuts, warm pita chips and crusty bread. Variation, instead of ham or chicken you can use more prosciutto or turkey sausage.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,beef,egg yolk,canola oil,tomato green chilies,summer savory,ricotta cheese
title: Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | sour cream as an au jus sauce or tomatoes, of your choice | 2 cans of chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 2 egg yolks | 1 tablespoon ground summer savory ( or more ) | 1 can ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Heat a skillet, and add 1 teaspoon of canola oil. Add the ground beef, then cover with sour cream as an au jus sauce or chopped tomatoes with green chilies. Cook over medium high heat for about 10 minutes, or until the meat is no longer pink.

title: Pizza Pastries
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 1 large green pepper
instructions: Preheat pizza stone in 450 degree oven or pizza stone. Roll out pastry into a 13 x 7 inch rectangle, it should be about 1/2 inch thick. Brush dough with water, and sprinkle with green pepper. Slide onto pizza stone with a serrated knife, and let it rest about 5 minutes. Brush top with a little water. Turn oven to 450 degrees, place pizza stone inside, and cook for about 15 minutes, until puff pastry turns golden. Remove from oven, and cut into 24 squares.

title: Polenta With Chicken livers and Green Onions
ingredients: 3 cups cold canned chicken livers, rinsed and patted dry | 1 package refrigerated polenta, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon finely chopped green onion
instructions: Cook chicken livers in 3 cups boiling water 20 minutes, or until crisp tender. Drain. Meanwhile, pour remaining 3 cups cold water into large resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,green cardamom,ginger beer,self rising flour,cremini mushroom,green pepper
title: Gramma Daly's Green Masala Fry Bread
ingredients: 12 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1/4 cup diced green pepper | 1/8 cup diced green pepper | 8 ounces ginger beer | 2 cups self rising flour | 2 green cardamoms | 2 tablespoons white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f f. In a small bowl, stir together the green and green chilies, ginger beer, and flour. Stir in the pepper. Spread into a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven or until topping is brown and bubbly. It will sink to the bottom, but if it fries up and gets too dry, add a little water at a time. It's done when top is a light brown color.

title: Green Olive & Shiitake Mushrooms Bread Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms, cleaned and stemmed | 7 ounces fresh green olives, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1 loaf rye bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Place the mushrooms, olives, vinegar, and bread in a salad bowl. Toss gently to combine. Serve.

title: Mexican Charros
ingredients: 12 firm cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 8 white onions, coarsely chopped | 16 fluid ounces picante sauce, good quality | 8 fluid ounces picante sauce, fresh | 20 slices pear, thin
instructions: Place one tomato in each double layer of paper towels. Sprinkle each with 2 tablespoons of onion and a little bit of picante. Place 2 more tomato halves on top of onions, pressing slightly. Repeat with remaining 4 tomato halves and onions until you have 8 stacks. Heat the picante sauce and picante sauce in a skillet with a low amount of water and a lid, allowing them to warm slightly. Place a slice of pear on top of each charro and serve at once.

title: Sweet Potato and Avocado
ingredients: 1 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 large ripe avocado, halved and pitted | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 cup fresh coriander leaves | 1 tablespoon fried rice
instructions: Pre heat oven to 220c and put the pan in the oven. Add the potatoes, avocados and palm sugar. Cook the mixture until all the avocado is cooked. Transfer the potato mixture to a large serving bowl. Garnish with coriander and rice.

title: Quick and Easy Hot Sausages
ingredients: 12 large sausages - 1/2 inch thick, butterflied and scored | 1 can beef broth | salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange sausage on a baking dish or roasting pan. Drizzle with beef broth and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, then turn and bake until the sausage is browned and cooked through, about 15 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,asafoetida powder,beef sirloin steak,rice wine
title: Oriental Beef Bowls
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1/2 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon shaoxing rice wine or 1 tablespoon regular dry sherry
instructions: In a bowl, combine the remaining ingredients. Add beef and mix until well coated. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Drain beef, cut or break with a knife, into 1/2 inch or two inch squares.

title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 -2 lemon, juice of ( depending on your taste ) | 1 1/4 lbs beef tenderloin
instructions: To partly freeze, preheat oven to 400°f. Using a sharp knife slice the beef thinly across the grain into slices 1/8 thick. Then cut the lemon into thin slices or into thin ribbons. Place all the slices in a shallow ovenproof dish. Sprinkle the beef with salt and pepper and press lightly.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,green lentil,baby carrot,active yeast,black coffee
title: Chocolate Black Lentil and Carrots Bread
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 1/3 cup dark corn and coffee | 1/2 cup unsalted baby carrots | 1 can black beans, drained | 3 1/2 cups taco sauce | 1 1/2 cups green lentils
instructions: Dissolve yeast in coffee. Add carrots, beans and mix well. Let stand for ten minutes. Place in greased bread pan, cover with top crust and place onto a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Top with taco sauce and allow to cool and thaw before eating. Also, you can have this with pinto beans with beans seeming like they do in the food, or use canned beans with liquid.

Random Ingredients: sage,vanilla extract,red curry paste,anise seed,beef stew meat,cheese tortellini,brown lentil,dinner
title: Beef and Lentils Tagine
ingredients: 3 packages frozen dinner rolls or ( 20 ounce ) packages cheese tortellini | 1 lb beef stew meat or 1 lb chuck steak, cut into bite-size chunks | 2 cans brown lentils, undrained | 1 package refrigerated dinner rolls, split | 1 jar red curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon instant minced sage or 1/2 teaspoon dried rubbed sage | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. In a dutch oven or a large oven proof stew pot, place the frozen dinner rolls and beef. Place over medium heat, add the lentils and curry paste, and stir to combine. Add a splash or two of water to absorb any drippings. Add a sprinkling of anise seeds. Cover, and bake for 45 to 60 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes to ensure even cooking. Remove lid and simmer 5 to 10 minutes longer. Meanwhile, make the tajine. Combine mustard and remaining spices. When the 45 minutes are up, add the cheddar and continue to simmer until cheese on top is completely melted, about 5 minutes longer. Serve hot with spanish rice.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,beef rib,sage leaf,green bell pepper,pomegranate seed,anaheim chile pepper,yellow pepper,lasagna noodle
title: Santa Fe-Style Marinated Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 pounds beef short ribs | 1 jar pomegranate seeds | 1 jar dried anaheim chile peppers | 1 jar yellow sweet peppers | 1/2 cup dark chia seeds | 3 phet dried sage leaves | 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 12 lasagna noodles, rinsed in cold water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the short ribs in a large roasting pan, and cut into thirds. Remove any remaining bones and excess fat from the meat, and place on a cutting board with the sharpest blade on the side. With a knife, remove the meat from the bones as much as possible until all of the bones are used. You should have about 3 cups meat. Use a piece of kitchen string to slice the long ribs from the center out of the short ribs. Discard any bones in the short ribs at the stem. Toast the pomegranate seeds in a skillet over medium high heat until they begin to smoke, and are browned. Transfer the seeds to a heat safe bowl. Split and core the anaheim and yellow peppers. Slice the peppers lengthwise into strips about 1/4 inch wide. Place into a bowl of cold water to prevent discoloring. Drain. Place into a bowl containing the chocolates, chia seeds, sage leaves, green bell pepper, and salt and pepper to taste. Set aside to marinate. Spread the meat out in a roasting pan. Cover with foil or a lid, and bake for 3 to 4 hours. Remove foil, and continue cooking for another 1 hours in the preheated oven. Remove meat from the oven, remove and discard foil, and slice into thin strips about 1/4 inch wide. Spread the strips on a large platter to cool for a few hours. Place the meat in a food processor with the green chocolates, and pulse until all of the ingredients are finely chopped. To assemble, lay out a lasagna noodle, pour in about 3 tablespoons of the meat, and spread over the meat. Spoon about 1 1/2 cups of the chocolate mixture over the meat, and top with more chocolate. Repeat on the second layer of meat, and repeat the process until all of the meat and chocolate has been used up. Garnish with more pomegranate seeds, if you wish.

title: North African Harissa - Paste
ingredients: 1/8 liter harissa | 1 celery rib, finely chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a screw top jar or lidded canning jar, cover and shake well to combine.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,red pepper flake,potato starch,salmon fillet,triple sec,cool whip topping
title: Black Pepper Salmon
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets, with skin | 1/4 cup sweet potato starch | 3/4 cup sweetened potato starch | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, or to taste | 3/4 teaspoon black peppercorns, or to taste | 1 3/4 containers whipped topping, divided | 1/2 cup triple sec
instructions: Sprinkle sweet potato starch over salmon fillets, shaking of any excess flour. Arrange fillets in a single layer on a dish. Place sweet potato starch, crushed red pepper flakes, and black peppercorns into a small bowl. Stir together. Gradually pour sweet potato starch mixture over salmon. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Preheat your oven broiler. Remove salmon from dish and place on a baking sheet. Brush top of fillets with half of triple sec. Broil salmon for 20 to 25 minutes, or until flesh is easily flaked with a fork.

title: Wild Rice With Mango Chutney and Beef or Pork
ingredients: 1 package brown sugar | 1 cup wild rice, cooked and drained | 3/4 lb sirloin, ground or 3/4 lb ground lamb or 3/4 lb pork | mango chutney, to serve
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the brown sugar with the wild rice and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for one hour. Remove from the heat and allow to cool completely. Add the meat along with the mango chutney. If using, cook the meat in a frying pan. Cook the meat until it is browned, remove and drain off some of the grease. Serve on the rice topped with mango chutney to serve with a bowl of yogurt for a healthier side dish.

title: Guacamole Ziti With Ziti Nests
ingredients: 3 tablespoons guacamole | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 7 tablespoons guacamole | 12 ounces ziti pasta | 1 large hass avocado ( peeled, pitted and chopped )
instructions: Cut ziti into thirds or into 12 equal portions. Mix the guacamole and vanilla and spread each portion on an orange zest. On each of the pasta plates place small dollops of guacamole. Next, arrange the ziti along the guacamole.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,head napa cabbage,chipotle pepper,balsamic vinegar,lobster
title: Lobster Salad
ingredients: 5 lobster, cleaned and sliced | 1/2 mango chutney | 2 chipotle peppers, diced | 1 head napa cabbage, cored and sliced | 5 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place the lobster slices in a large pot, cover with water, and boil for about 5 minutes. Remove lobster from pot. Slice into 3/4 thick slices. Cut slices into half moons. While lobster is simmering, blend chipotle peppers in a mortar and pestle or other blender until mostly smooth. Stir chutney into the chopped chutney and bring to a boil. Add sliced napa cabbage and balsamic vinegar. Reduce heat to medium. Place lobster slices on top. Cover and simmer a few minutes to warm through. When serving, toss with chutney.

title: Turnip and Chocolate Mango Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 english cucumber ( about 20 to 25 inches long ) | 8 ice cubes | 3/4 cup mango powder | 3/4 cup unsweetened chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/8 teaspoon mace | 1/4 teaspoon turnip | 1/3/4 teaspoon dried ladyfinger
instructions: Cut up the cucumber and place in a small microwave safe bowl. Cover with the ice cubes. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 3 minutes. Using a long skewer or vegetable peeler, remove peel. Cut crosswise into very thin slices. Arrange slice in a medium bowl. Microwave chocolate in a microwave safe bowl on high for 1 to 2 minutes. Stir until melted. Scrape chocolate mixture over ice cubes and add remaining ingredients. Stir well. Transfer to a 9 inch springform pan and place in the freezer until set, at least 1 hour. Remove cake from refrigerator. Let cool 10 minutes. Turn oven off and let pound cake in pan for another 5 minutes to soften. Sprinkle with additional chocolate to serve. If serving cold, remove sides of pan and chill at least 1 hour. Garnish with additional mango.

title: Uncooked Chocolate Swiss Fingers
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil cooking spray ( becel ) | 1 cup store-bought chocolate sprinkles ( or to taste )
instructions: Spray or brush the hands with vegetable cooking spray. Using your hands or pastry tip, roll out the chocolate sprinkles by pressing them between your palms to coat them with a thin coat of cooking spray. Gently stretch and shape the softened dough onto baking sheet covered in parchment paper. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 3 days. Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Bake until the fingers begin to darken and crisp, 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Scallops and Ham With Smoked Blueberries
ingredients: 3 lbs scallops, halved ( fresh ) | 1/2 lb ham, cut in half and thin slice | 3 -4 -5 serrano chilies ( depending on how hot your chilies are, seeded if desired ) | 1/2 lb white radish, diced coarse | 1/2 lb blueberries, to cover ( or any berries of your choice, or any fruit you prefer, or any citrus you have on hand ) | chipotle chile in adobo | 1/2 cup crumbled chipotle chile
instructions: Season scallops with salt.

title: Quick Mexican Colcannon
ingredients: 4 cups jicama or 4 cups red bell peppers | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1/3 cup cashews, coarsely chopped
instructions: Microwave peppers in 2 tablespoons water.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,pomegranate molasses,butternut squash,red currant jelly
title: Pomegranate Glazed Pork Chops and Squash
ingredients: 4 pork chops | 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses | 1 lb butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cut into 2-inch sticks | 1/2 cup red currant jelly
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Mix pomegranate molasses, butternut squash and currant jelly together. Season pork chops with salt. Place in a shallow roasting pan. Cover and bake in middle of oven 1 hour. Remove from oven and let rest 10 minutes before carving.

title: Romaine, Lime and Lime Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 lime, zest of, grated
instructions: Shave the cored and shredded romaine of the lettuce and grate the zest on a serving platter. Drizzle lime zest on top. Eat note, this salad is best made just before serving as it may dry out.

title: Asian Sausage
ingredients: 2 lbs of ground sausage | 1 lb of diced sweet carrots or 1 lb parsnip | 1 lb asparagus | 1 ounce catsup | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Cut the asparagus into 2 inch lengths or thinner as you like. Put sausage in a frying pan with a lid and cover with water. Bring to a boil and reduce to a simmer. Simmer for 10 minutes then set aside to cool slightly. When cool, drain and finely dice. Add all the other ingredients and mix well. Stuff into casings and add to your favourite meat or vegetable dish. Use more or less vegetables to your taste.

Random Ingredients: coriander,cinnamon,jalapeno pepper,turbinado sugar,bouquet garni,lime juice,bell pepper,watercress
title: Jamaican Watercress With Turbinado and Lime
ingredients: 1/4 cup turbinado sugar | 1/8 teaspoon ground coriander | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice | 3 tablespoons fresh coriander | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice | 2 1/2 lbs fresh watercress, trimmed | bouquet garni, thyme, sage, etc | 1 bell pepper | 1 red jalapeno pepper
instructions: For the dressing, in a small bowl whisk together the lime juice with the sugar, then strain into a serving container. Add the remaining dressing ingredients and mix well to combine and emulsify. For the peppers, heat a dry sauté pan to medium low heat until just beginning to smoke. Roast the pepper or jalapeno, cut side down, on the pan until just beginning to blacken on all sides, about 1 1/2 minutes, then turn and repeat until all sides are blackened. This should take about 7 to 10 minutes. Remove the pepper or jalapeno and set aside for 10 minutes to allow the pepper to sweat. Drain the peppers, discarding the roasted skin, and chop in half. Place the peppers in a serving container, drizzle with the dressing, and let marinate at least an hour, or for up to 3 days, tossing the peppers often to coat evenly. Serve at once.

title: Lemongrass and Mushroom Stir Fry
ingredients: 50 g red dried porcini mushrooms | 1 stalk lemongrass | 4 green cardamom pods | 1 bunch fresh lemongrass | 4 tablespoons cornflour | 4 -5 teaspoons chilies, chopped
instructions: Soak mushrooms in hot water for 30 minutes, then squeeze. Wash lemongrass with water and cut into 2 inch chunks. Wash cardamom and cut into 1 inch lenght pieces. Fry lemongrass in oil, then add the mushrooms and spices. Mix the corn flour with a glass of water, then add to the pan. Stir fry 3 - 4 minutes. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: skirt steak,kaffir lime leaf,coriander,pomegranate seed,chicken bouillon cube,lemongrass
title: The Best Teriyaki Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 teaspoon water | 1 stalk lemongrass, chopped | 1/2 medium kaffir lime leaf, chopped finely | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds, toasted ( see notes ) ( optional )
instructions: Thread 1/4 teaspoon toasted pomegranate seeds in a 3 by 3 inch square piece of saran wrap with about 2 to 3 to 3 inches length at the ends. Cut ends of the string and discard. Soak skewers in water in a large mixing bowl for 15 minutes. Remove beef skewers from water, pat dry with paper towels, and sprinkle with coriander and chicken bouillon mixture. Place beef in skewers and marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes or longer if desired. Combine lime leaf and remaining ingredients in a medium bowl. Stir well, then sprinkle on the beef skewers. Prepare an outdoor grill for high heat, set a drip pan in the center and place about 4 cups of water in the pan. When water is just about boiling, place the meat on the rack and pour 1 to 1 1/2 cups of water into the pan. Transfer the skewers to the pan, reduce heat to moderately low and cook, turning the skewers occasionally and rearranging them, until cooked to desired doneness, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: French Puff's  Creamy Peas & Garlic
ingredients: 1 can peas | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese
instructions: Boil peas for 15 minutes drain & cool. Mix remaining ingredients in microwave safe bowl and microwave approximately half an hour on high until mixture is creamy & heated through. Stir in peas & serve.

title: Pear and Mango Salsa
ingredients: 1 pears, cored, cored, and sliced | 2 ripe mangoes, peeled, pitted, and sliced
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the pears and mango slices together. Divide the mango salsa among four chilled salad bowls, and serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,allspice,salt black pepper,asparagus,baking powder,rice noodle,pistachio
title: White Chocolate Pistachio Noodles
ingredients: 16 ounces rice stick noodles, fresh | 1/2 cup chopped asparagus | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 2 tablespoons white chocolate, melted | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Fill a pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rice sticks, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Beat the asparagus and pistachios in a bowl with a pinch of baking powder until they are completely chopped. Stir in the melted chocolate. Mix the remaining baking powder into the asparagus mixture along with the remaining pinch of baking powder. Stir the asparagus mixture into the noodles. Carefully mix in the pistachios. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Arrange the noodles around the foil so the noodles don't pick up too much air from the cheese and nuts, and place them onto the prepared baking sheet. Broil in the preheated oven until the tops are beginning to turn golden brown, about 5 minutes.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Swiss Steak
ingredients: 2 -4 medium pork tenderloin ( sandwich thin pork loin ) | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 tablespoon minced spanish onion
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the meat. Thoroughly combine peanut butter and minced onion. Spread on the cut side of the meat. Grill or broil, on the diagonal, or broil on the grill to desired doneness. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,sun tomato oil,jalapeno chile pepper,pastry,tamarind paste,caper,salt pepper,cream tartar
title: Sour Cream Pastry Tatin
ingredients: 1 pastry for double-crust pie | 1 1/2 teaspoons pickled capers, drained | 8 whole sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1 tablespoon caper | 1 teaspoon chili flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 jalapeno chile pepper, cut into rings | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste or 1 teaspoon orange marmalade ( to taste ) | 3 -5 drops cream of tartar | 1 pinch salt and pepper
instructions: Make the filling by heating the sun dried tomato oil over medium heat. Stir in the chilies, tamarind concentrate, cream of tartar and salt and pepper to taste. Let cool. Roll out pastry thinly and cut into 3 circles. Press one circle of pastry into a 10 inch nonstick fry pan or cast iron skillet and top with 1/2 the filling and 1/2 of the pastry. Brush with more of the sun dried tomato oil. Top with remaining pastry, brushing with oil. Cover with lid or foil and bake at 450 degrees for about 15 to 20 minutes, until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. Let cool before cutting into rectangles.

title: Spicy Pasta Salad
ingredients: 500 g linguine ( bow tie pasta ) or 500 g elbow macaroni | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( store bought or your own store-bought ) | 2 tablespoons yellow split peas ( frozen ) or 2 tablespoons frozen yellow pea pods ( frozen ) | 1 tablespoon fresh sage ( finely chopped ) | 6 tablespoons salted cashews ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco jalapeno sauce ( or other hot pepper sauce to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente, following instructions on package. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile combine pesto sauce, split peas, sage and cashews. Add cooked pasta and toss gently to combine. Season with tabasco and chill to serve.

title: No-Cream Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups tasty cheese, finely grated | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, finely grated | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons crisco ( optional ) | 1 can chickpeas, drained or 1 1/2 cups canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Place in casserole dish and bake at 180°c for 20minutes.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,cooking spray,chicken bouillon,cheddar cheese soup,baguette,caper,chicken stock bouillon
title: Cheesy Pesto Dressing With Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: cooking spray, for brushing | 1 baguette, cut into 1-inch cubes, about 1 1/2 cups | 3 cups cheddar cheese soup | 1 can cheddar cheese soup | 1 chicken bouillon, crushed | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon capers, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Coat 2 - 8 x 2 inch baking sheets with cooking spray. Combine chicken soup and soup in a large bowl. Stir in cheese soup mixture, 1 1/2 cup of cheese, chicken bouillon and pesto. Spread mixture into 1½ quart glass baking dish. Top with the remaining 1½ cup of cheese. Bake in preheated oven until bubbly and slightly browned, about 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Roasted Caramelized Zest
ingredients: 1/2 lemon, zest of | 1/2 cup margarine
instructions: Make sure the zest is clean, removing all of the yellow bits and pith. Cut the zest into 1 - 1 1/2 lengths. Melt the margarine in a small saucepan, and add the zest. Toss to mix. After a few minutes, the zest will brown a little, and will release its aroma.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,plain flour,mustard,black sesame seed,whipping cream,rhubarb,cardamom seed,snow pea
title: Rhubarb and Snow Pea Casserole
ingredients: 500 -700 g fresh rhubarb | 250 g snow peas ( trimmed ) | 2 teaspoons mustard | 250 -275 ml malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon black sesame seed | 1/2 cup whipping cream ( cream, milk or soy sweetener ) | 1/4 cup plain flour ( all-purpose ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed
instructions: Trim the rhubarb and cut into 5cm lengths. Split them crossways and remove the tips. Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Drop in the rhubarb, cover and simmer for 15 - 20 mins or until done. Drain and chill until required. Remove and discard stalks and ribs. Cut the rhubarb into 5cm lengths. Place the mustard and vinegar into a shallow saucepan and bring to the boil, stirring all the time. Gradually add the sesame seeds. Cover and cook 1 - 2 mins until they are golden. Remove from heat and stir in poppyseeds and cream, bring to the boil. Pour into a baking dish and cool thoroughly. To assemble, place the rhubarb, snow peas and sesame into a casserole dish. Pour the mustard and vinegar mixture over the fruit and sprinkle with flour. Sprinkle with the cardamon seeds and bake in a hot oven for 35 - 40 mins or until the top is crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,vegetable oil cooking spray,red bell pepper
title: Red Pepper Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package sliced fresh mushrooms | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 red bell pepper
instructions: Arrange mushroom in a microwave safe 9 inch square baking dish. Sprinkle with vegetable oil. Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes. Stir.

title: Korean-Style Beef Brisket & Rice
ingredients: 4 lbs beef brisket, trimmed of any excess fat, then tied | 2/3 - 1 1/2-1 cup white rice ( korean-style, not japanese-style )
instructions: Place the beef brisket fat side up in a roasting pan. Sprinkle with kosher salt. Pour enough water into the pan to reach the halfway point. Bake in a preheated 300 f oven until the meat reaches 160 f at the meat tenderness, up to 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Drain the brisket, reserving the vegetables and pan drippings in the pan. Wash the roasting pan and dry it with paper towels. When the brisket is done, remove and reserve the beef stock. Return the juices in the pan to the pan. Slice across the grain at the grain using 2 forks. Arrange the brisket on a platter. Spread rice all over the brisket. Pour the reserved beef stock over the brisket. Serve at once or cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. The broth will keep up to 2 days in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,white wine,gingerroot,whipping cream,taco seasoning mix
title: Tex-Mex Tasty Ginger Pasta Toss
ingredients: 24 ounces whipping cream | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 3 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( mccormick recommended )
instructions: In a saucepan combine cream, vinegar, and gingerroot. Simmer over medium heat. Stir in wine and seasoning mix. Cook until thick. Serve, or chill for up to a week, or freeze for up to 3 months.

title: Apricot-Glazed Tortillas
ingredients: 10 round tortillas | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon cube ( or 1 tbsp. crushed beef flavor ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | apricot preserves ( optional ) or preserves ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Using oven mitts, place a tortilla on a clean countertop tray. Cover with 1/2 teaspoon of beef bouillon and 1 tblsp. Rosemary in another tortilla. Top with about 1/7 cup apricot preserves and 1 more tblsp. Rosemary. Bake in preheated oven until browned and crispy, about 12 to 15 minutes. Transfer to plates and serve.

title: Mangoes and Spiced Cream Whipped Cream
ingredients: 8 green mangoes | 1/3 cup vodka | 1 cup heavy cream | 8 whole cloves
instructions: Peel mangoes and coarsely chop in a blender or food processor, or whirl in a food processor. Stir in vodka. Whip cream and cloves until stiff peaks form. Spoon into small serving bowls or ramekins. Serve with mangoes.

Random Ingredients: carrot,white wine,mustard seed,phyllo dough,cumin powder,tamarind paste
title: Methi's Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 16 sheets phyllo dough | 3 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 cup carrot, shredded | 1 cup dry white wine | 1 teaspoon fresh garlic, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: First add the carrot and white wine to a medium sauce pan over medium heat. Add the mustard seeds, cumin and garlic. Stir well and then add tamarind paste. Bring to a boil. Turn off heat and just let the mixture sit for 10 minutes. Remove from stove and cool. On a cutting board you will want to cut the phyllo pieces lengthwise so they will be able to work with later. In a large glass bowl, spread one sheet using one sheet of phyllo dough then spread the carrot mixture to cover the entire sheet. Add a few more sheets of phyllo and spread the curry paste mixture between each sheet. Fold that part over the last sheet. When you have made your phyllo balls you may take your time but the result is a smooth dish with a very light, smooth taste when finished.

Random Ingredients: currant,half cream,toast,peanut,baby spinach leaf,oka cheese,pimento olive
title: French Toast With Spinach and Olives
ingredients: 5 slices toast ( i use whole wheat, but any will do, i prefer french ) | 4 ounces oka cheese | 4 ounces baby spinach | 4 ounces currants | 1 pimento stuffed olive, sliced and patted dry with patted dry | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Spread oka on each piece of toast. Layer on spinach, olives, currants, pimentos, pimento. Cut into 4 - 4 serving pieces. If desired, use crockpot cooking spray to spread cream between the 4 slices of toast.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour tortilla,velveeta cheese,amaretto liqueur,swiss cheese
title: Cheese & Amaretto Wraps
ingredients: 2 whole wheat flour tortillas | 2 ounces velveeta cheese | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon amaretto liqueur | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Spread each tortilla with velveeta cheese and spread on a warmed tortilla. Top with amaretto liqueur and swiss cheese.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,cola,tarragon,popcorn shrimp,bread flour,quinoa,yellow bell pepper
title: Cajun Shrimp Pronto
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 2 cups quinoa ( pre-cooked or 3/4 cup rice ) | 18 ounces frozen cooked popcorn shrimp, thawed and drained | 2 -3 medium yellow bell peppers, chopped ( or use a blend of vegetables ) | 8 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded ( or use a blend of cheeses ) | 2 tablespoons tarragon | 1/3 cup cola ( or may use regular sweet cream or milk )
instructions: Place the flour, quinoa and seafood in a food processor or blender. Pulse until the dough forms a ball. If the dough is to dry add a little more water. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead briefly. Roll into a ball and set aside. Wash, dry, and coarsely chop the peppers and toss them with the margarine in a large bowl. Shred the cheese while it cools slightly. Add the cheese and tarragon to the pepper/shrimp mix, and add the pepper/shrimp mix to the peppers and shrimp. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead the dough until it is the texture of bread crumbs, adding more margarine if necessary. Pat it into a rectangle, about 12 x 11 inches. Spread the dough with the pepper/shrimp mix evenly, and sprinkle with the cola or milk. Wrap the dough around the filling, and place in a large nonstick pan or a loaf pan, seam side down. Bake 45 minutes at 350 degrees, but check after 15 minutes, and let sit a couple more minutes if too crisp. Cut into squares.

title: Greek Olives and Spring Onions (Kirmizi)
ingredients: 20 kalamata olives, pitted | 2 spring onions, scallions, including green tops trimmed, cut crosswise into thin diagonal slices | 1/4 cup whole-grain rye flour | 20 whole spring onions, white parts removed, very thinly sliced on the diagonal, for garnish
instructions: Place olives and spring onions into food processor and puree. Stir remaining tapenade ingredients and pour into a small, shallow bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 325f. Brush 2 large baking sheets with oil, then sprinkle with flour. Spread out 1/2 of the tomato mixture, then spread with sliced rounds of the scallion greens. Drizzle with remaining tapenade. Sprinkle the top with some shredded gruyere cheese and place on a cookie sheet. Bake in the center of the oven until the cheese is lightly browned and bubbling. Remove from oven and slice into wedges.

Random Ingredients: pear,marsala wine,pineapple tidbit,pineapple juice,japanese eggplant,fenugreek seed
title: Pear and Parsley Salad
ingredients: 12 -14 japanese eggplant | 1 can pineapple tidbits | 6 ounces canned pear slices | 2 jars marsala wine | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds | 3/4 cup crushed pineapple tidbits
instructions: Wash and dry your Japanese eggplants and slice in half lengthwise, lenghtwise. Use about 4 slices per eggplant, the thinner the slice the more flavor. Cut pear's lengthwise into half slices about 1/4 to 1/2 thick. Drain juice from pineapple through a fine sieve into a large bowl. Carefully remove skins from fruit and reserve. Remove the skin from the eggplants, cut side down on your cutting board. Cut 1/8 slits in each, then place eggplants in bowl with juice and gently fold. In a saucepan, add 1/2 cup marsala to 1 cup water and bring to boil. Boil for 3 - 5 minutes stirring, then remove from heat. Add fenugreek seeds and remaining 1/4 cup of water, bring to boil and then cover and set aside for a few minutes until liquid is reduced. Combine drained pineapple tidbits with remaining liquid and then add to sugar cage. Set aside for 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Place drained sugar cage in a dish and then place in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or overnight. When ready to serve, place reserved juice from fruit in a serving bowl and let it reduce. Add crushed pineapple and toss gently. Add the reserved 1/4 cup of juice and stir. Pour this mixture over the salad and toss gently. Serve at room temperature. Enjoy.

title: Tamarind Treena
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1 large leek, rinsed, minced | 2 small cloves garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste ( i've used tamarind paste, but if it's unavailable, a few drops of tamarind paste ) | 1 cup fresh curds | 2 cups fried tortillas
instructions: Place garbanzo beans through food chopper, scraping all pieces together. Add remaining ingredients, except tortillas, into food processor or chopper. Puree and serve on tortillas with dipping sauce.

title: Chinese Style Hot Pepper Water
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon chinese chili pepper flakes ( can not add salt or other spices ) | 3 -5 cups water | 1 1/3 cups water
instructions: Dissolve chili flakes in 2 1/3 cups of water. Add remaining liquid. Refrigerate 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend. This can be frozen.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,grape tomato,rigatoni pasta,tomato green chilies,prune,soymilk,sirloin steak,rice wine
title: Rigatoni Beef With Prunes, Tomatoes and Chiles
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 4 ounces prunes | 2 teaspoons vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons soymilk | 1 teaspoon raspberry wine | 1 1/2 lbs grape tomatoes | 1/2 cup dry rice wine | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta ( approx )
instructions: Rinse steak and pat dry. Cut into thin slices. Combine the ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add the steak and mix thoroughly. Pour over the meat and marinate for at least 4 hours and up to 12 hours. Cook rigatoni according to package directions. Drain.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,cabbage,tomato puree,stilton cheese,broth,cherry tomato,hamburger meat,grenadine
title: Soupe Au Giram-Gordon
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti sauce | 500 g hamburger meat ( use good quality beef if available ) | 420 g tomatoes puree | 500 g cabbage ( chopped ) | 60 ml grenadine | 1 3/4 cups strained broth | 300 g stilton cheese ( grated )
instructions: First, cook ground meat in a frying pan as explained above. Add tomato purée and simmer to boiling point. Cook spaghetti sauce to the point where it is simmering and then add remainder of ingredients. Place on a large flameproof platter and cover with top and bottom halves of cloth or a piece of foil. Place in oven for 25 minutes at 220 degrees celcius. You can serve this dish with crusty bread and garnish with fresh herbs and cheese.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,pork,spring onion,rice wine,spaghetti squash,date,bamboo shoot
title: Pork and Veggie Noodle Supper
ingredients: 1 large spaghetti squash or 1 large spaghetti squash | 3 -4 slices of uncooked lean pork, 1-inch cubes | 1 1/4 cups uncooked matchstick cut into very thin strips | 1 cup frozen ripe bamboo shoot, sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped spring onions | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon reduced sodium dashi stock or 1 teaspoon instant dashi stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Arrange spaghetti squash or spaghetti squash in baking dish. In a small bowl combine pork, bamboo shoot, and onion. Season to taste with red pepper flakes. Spread pork mixture on spaghetti squash or spaghetti squash. Bake or microwave 1 minute more or until squash is tender. Spoon rice and veggie mixture over meat. Heat vinegar and dashi or stock in small skillet over medium heat until boiling. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,red potato,grand marnier,chilies,part mozzarella cheese
title: Baked Red Potatoes
ingredients: 4 red potatoes ( about 1 lb ) | 1/8 cup sesame oil | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup orange juice | 8 ounces shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 dried chilies
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°f. Place the dry chilie/orange in a small bowl and set aside. In a large bowl, toss the potatoes with the sesame oil and grand marnier. Brush all over the potatoes with the sesame oil mixture. Bake for 20 minutes or until the potatoes are just tender. In a small dish, toss the mozzarella with the chilies, removing them as they bake. Serve the potatoes with the mozzarella on top. Serve more chilies depending on your tolerance for heat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green thai chili pepper,ham,turkey bacon,garlic powder,sesame oil
title: Grilled Thai-Style Turkey Bacon, Green Beans, and Peppers
ingredients: 5 thick slices turkey bacon ( from half a package ) | 10 3/4 ounces lean ham, cut into very thin strips | 10 3/4 ounces green thai sweet chili peppers, sliced | 2 1/2 tablespoons garlic powder | 2 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Place three strips of turkey bacon on each piece of aluminum foil. Spoon equal amounts of green beans around the turkey bacon on each side. Sprinkle garlic powder and sesame oil onto each piece of turkey bacon. Cover with plastic wrap, and press lightly so that the wrap can't get into the meat. Cook in the grill about 10 minutes, basting every 2 - 3 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 170 degrees on a meat thermometer, and the internal temperature of the bacon is no longer pink.

title: Green OAMC. Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves, washed | 2 tablespoons hot vinegar
instructions: Prep and wash the spinach and leave it separately as it wilts. Heat a frying pan. Put the spinach on one side, turn it over and fry it till lightly golden brown on the other side. Keep aside. When this time is over, put the hot oil in the pan. Add 1/3 of the washed chopped spinach leaves to the pan. Fry until light brown in colour. Remove onto a plate. When the spinach has cooled a little, cut the spinach into small pieces and keep aside. Add to it 1 - 3 tbs of hot vinegar. Keep stirring. Once the greens are dry, add the remaining spinach pieces. Mix well and serve hot with your favourite side dish.

title: Viva Madrid-Style Provolone Cheese Dip & Vege Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups soft white cheese, such as kraft singles | 4 thin slices prosciutto | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke, heated | 1/2 small onion, thinly sliced | 1 pinch dried red chili powder | 1 small shallot ( optional )
instructions: Remove cheese from microwave and place on a piece of wax paper. Spread with viva la la viva la viva Madrid cheese, leaving 2 inches of border on all sides. Cut slices of prosciutto in half, lengthwise, then cut diagonally into 1/2 inch wide sticks, lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,anise seed,kosher salt pepper,ramen noodle,potato,mayonnaise,garam masala
title: Indian-Style Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 8 -10 ounces prepared ramen noodles or 8 -10 ounces other oriental-seasoned noodles, broken in half | 1/4 cup quick-cooking spray | 12 -16 ounces cold mashed potatoes
instructions: First, prepare dressing, mix all ingredients together except noodles. Set aside. In medium size bowl, mix mayonnaise, garam masala, salt, pepper, and anise and combine. Set aside. In 9 x 13 dish, spread noodles evenly and top with noodles. Cover noodles with dressing and top with remaining noodles. Bake at 425f for 40 - 45 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: egg white,chicken thigh,new potato,garam masala,red chili pepper
title: Chicken Paratha (Indian-Spiced Chicken & Potato)
ingredients: 3/4 lb new potato | 1 large egg white | 2 fresh red chili peppers | 4 tablespoons chana garam masala | 2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Cut potatoes into 1/4 inch squares. Cut chana into halves or sticks. Separate the egg white and beat until white with egg yolk. Heat wok over medium high heat.

title: Chili Leek Hash
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs leeks, white ends removed, halved lengthwise ( about 8 stalks ) | 6 tablespoons chili powder | 1/2 cup ranch dressing, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/ham-or-ham-or-on-the-pudding-473957 '' > ham or pork-on the pudding < /a > | 1/2 cup ice cold water | 1 tablespoon dried chili powder
instructions: Peel and cut leeks lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Slice about 1/8 inch thick with a knife or mandolin. Cook in boiling water just until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain well, return to hot nonstick surface in medium skillet, add chili powder. Stir until well blended, about 15 seconds. Transfer leeks to plate. Mash leeks slightly using potato masher, adding water as needed. Spread warm hash on baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Stir together chili powder and 1 tablespoon water. Spread over leeks.

title: Easy Baked Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 4 cups diced fresh tomatoes with juice, with juice | 1/2 cup pure maple syrup | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare a 9x13 inch pan by drizzling oil into baking pans. In a large bowl, mix tomatoes and maple syrup. Stir in baking powder, poultry seasoning and poultry seasoning until well mixed. Press evenly into pan. Bake at 400 degrees f for about 30 minutes. This recipe will also freeze well and can be served as a side dish to my homemade gravy.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,white hominy,ricotta cheese,chili oil
title: White hominy With Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili oil | 2 cans white hominy, drained | 1 green bell pepper, diced | 1 container ricotta cheese
instructions: In 4 quart saucepan heat chile oil over medium low heat. Add hominy.

title: Mom's Easy Meatballs
ingredients: 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup soya sauce | 1/2 cup sweet cooking sherry | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/2 cup cake, sliced thin
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the cake. Use slightly less than ½ cup of this mixture for coating the meatballs.

title: Homemade Texas Steak Rub
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground black pepper | 6 pounds beef brisket
instructions: Tightly pack pepper and beef shaker with a large enough opening to pack.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,white flour,ham,tarragon,vanilla bean,lamb,almond milk,garlic powder
title: Lamb With Rigatoni (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 9 ounces lamb ( cut up in bite size pieces ) | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon tarragon | 10 ounces white flour | 10 ounces lamb ( cut up in bite size pieces ) | 2 ounces white flour | 1 jar almond milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla beans ( optional )
instructions: Place cooked rigatoni in bottom of 4 to 5 qt slow cooker.. Add rest of ingredients and stir all together. Add rigatoni as you are cooking on the stove. Cook on low 8 to 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,grand marnier,germain elderflower liqueur,broccoli
title: Broccolini Swiss Roll
ingredients: 4 ounces germain elderflower liqueur | 1 ounce grand marnier | 1 small red chili pepper | 4 ounces broccoli, leaves
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass & stir until well blended. Fill each glass with the prepared mixture, roll & serve.

title: Lebanese-Style Marinade for Grilling
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup honey | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour prior to grilling meat. Grilling meat in hot oil is best but can be done in a pan. I usually use my grill pan, which will be covered with thick, heavy duty paper towels and a heavy skillet. Grill meat just till medium rare, turning once so it stays on the grill. A medium to well desired doneness.

title: Warm Cheddar and Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 cup crushed corn chips | 2 bags frozen snow peas | 1 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup golden syrup
instructions: Place a large pot of lightly salted water on the stove over medium high heat. Cook the corn chips in the water for 2 minutes or until crisp. Drain. Place the snow peas onto a paper towel lined plate. Sprinkle the peas with salt and pepper. Place the snow peas in a microwave safe bowl, and cover with plastic wrap. Cook on high power until tender, about 4 minutes. Place the frozen chips on a plate. Drain the snow peas in a colander, and toss with the sugar, golden syrup, and reserved corn chips. Serve warm.

title: Roasted Beef or Lamb with Chicken Wings
ingredients: 5 lbs ground chuck | 8 chicken wings | 1 lb wooden skewer | 2 lbs whole raw solid white boneless chicken wings
instructions: Soak skewers in cold water for 10 minutes, then rinse. Mix the ground chuck, 3/4 pound of the chicken wings, and the raw wings together in a large bowl. Cut the meat of the chickens into 1 inch pieces, and stuff the meat with the meat. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place the pieces with the extra fat on a sheet pan. Tear off the extra fat with your kitchen shears, and place them on the skewers. Bake the meat until it is very dark. You may insert a skewer, but it's best prepared in 20 minutes but should take longer for the outside to cook. Bake the chicken wings for 15 minutes, or until they are very done on both sides. If cooking the skewers in advance, do the skewers the same day, and put them in the refrigerator for at least two hours, and then remove them from the brine. Serve with a salad of green olives and tomatoes.

title: Quick Heart Reserves
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef liver, 3/4 to 1 inch cubes | 1 - 1 1/2 cup bamboo shoot, sliced 1/2 inch long | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Heat deep fryer to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Place liver in gallon freezer bag. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes and place in bag. Seal and shake until all livers are well coated. Repeat with remaining liver, and remove livers from bag. Place on a cookie sheet lined with foil. Deep fry in preheated hot oil 6 - 8 minutes, turning once or twice. Drain on paper towels. Store in freezer until ready to use. Note, if making this in a slow cooker, use the 2 or the 2/3 celsius indicated on the cooking time. This recipe freezes well.

title: Sweet Peach and Couscous Salad
ingredients: 10 cups hot water | 1 cup couscous | 2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup seedless spinach, rinsed and chopped or 2 cups chopped dried pepitas | 2 -3 cups cooked kidney beans, drained, rinsed and drained | hot cooked pasta ( fresh or frozen ) | mixed wheat germ
instructions: Bring water to boil in a large 3 - 4 quart saucepan. Remove from heat and add couscous and cheese. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Stir in the spinach and peas or pepitas.

title: Pimiento Rice(Baked in Microwave)
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice ( soaked in a little hot water, before washing ) | 3/4 cup split peas | 3 tablespoons caster sugar or 3 tablespoons other granulated sugar | 4 tablespoons chopped pimiento ( from jar ) | 1 1/4 cups half-and-half
instructions: Put 1 cup of soaking water in a bowl. Drain the rice and put in the bowl, add the peas, sugar and pimientos, stir to combine. Put the half and half in a microwave safe dish, cover with a lid and cook the rice on high in 2 1/2 cups of boiling water for exactly 13 minutes without removing the lid. Check rice after 5 minutes to make sure it is tender and all the water has evaporated. Take a fork, poke holes in the rice, and if the cracker comes out dry, the rice is done. If the rice looks dry, let it cool a bit. Put rice onto plates, drizzle with half and half, sprinkle with the remaining sugar, if desired. Eat..

title: Simple, Salmon With Stuffing
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 2 stalks celery, chopped very fine | 1/3 cup raisins
instructions: First make your stuffing, mix together celery, raisins and salmon. Grill, pan fry or bake in oven until cooked through. Great with mashed potatoes and a salad.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,heavy cream,orange peel,grain rice,cornflour,oyster sauce,matzo meal
title: Spicy Stuffed Matzo Ball
ingredients: 250 g matzo meal | 25 g cornflour | 25 g italian sausage | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1/2 cup short-grain rice or 1/2 cup arborio rice, soaked in water for 5 minutes
instructions: In a large bowl, add the matzos meal, cornflour and sausage and mix until the mixtures resembles breadcrumbs. Remove any excess flour using a pastry brush, and add the olive oil until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs, taking care not to let the mixture become too damp or sticky. Wash the matzos and gently dry them on the kitchen towel with kitchen paper. If there is excess, you can now take the matzos out of the bag and spread them out as much as possible. Using a teaspoon, make several indentations in the matzos. Push the mixture into the indentations and make a depression in the center with your finger tips. Fill the crater with rice, cover with water and add half of the cream in the center of the matza, and pinch around the rice to make it a ball shape. Wipe around the perimeter of the mound with a pastry brush, making sure the rice is all over. Pour remaining cream over the rice. The matzo should be served immediately, but not refrigerated. Serves four.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,cooking oat,chili pepper,turbinado sugar,white wine vinegar,egg noodle,nutritional yeast,blackberry
title: Turbinado Cabbage Noodles With Fresh Blackberries
ingredients: cooking spray or 1 lb egg noodles | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper, divided | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 2 teaspoons turbinado sugar | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 medium savoy cabbage, cored and shredded | 14 ounces blackberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Heat 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook for 30 seconds, or until fragrant. Add oats.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,ice,parsnip,mozzarella cheese,shoulder lamb chop,chicken tenderloin,lettuce
title: Irish Lamb & Sheep Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti sauce, your fav | 16 ounces country-style turkey tenderloins ( from loin chops can be used ) | 10 ounces chicken tenders, halved ( or use 1 chicken thigh, skinless ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mixed spice ( baharat aka middle east mixed spices ) | 1 ounce mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 heads lettuce, washed | 1 medium parsnip, peeled, halved and sliced ( optional )
instructions: Prepare pork and lamb as directed on box.

title: Molho - Caramelized Beef on Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck roast | 3 tablespoons ginger syrup | 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Soak raisins 1 hour. Soak beef skewers 1 hour and skewer beef. Cook on preheated grill or in oven set to 300 degrees f. Place meat on skewers, cover loosely with foil and let sit 15 minutes. Turn and cook 45 minutes or more.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,garlic clove,currant,strawberry,lime zest,raspberry vinegar,monterey jack cheese,golden raisin
title: Creamy Blueberry and Raisin Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup green grape seedless raisin | 1/2 cup currants, rinsed and drained well | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 1/2 tablespoons red raspberry vinegar | 1 garlic clove | 1 orange, zest of, finely grated | 1 lime, zest of, finely grated | 1/4 cup monterey jack cheese, grated | fresh strawberries, to decorate
instructions: Place the raisins in a small bowl and cover with water. Soak 5 - 10 minutes, or until very soft. Drain the raisins and raisins, and place in a small bowl. Add the golden raisins and currants and stir well to mix. In a mixing bowl add the raspberry vinegar, garlic, orange zest, lime zest, and half the cheese. Mix until well blended. Add the remaining cheese, stirring until thoroughly blended and all is thoroughly combined. To make the dressing, put the raisins, currants and raisins back into the bowl and pour over the dressing, combining well. Toss through the rest of the ingredients just to coat. Cover and refrigerate. Serve at room temperature. Note, this tastes best if left in the refrigerator for a few hours, or refrigerated overnight, or even overnight. This is great served either cold or warm.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,worcestershire sauce,white wine vinegar,salmon fillet,raspberry,avocado,tahini
title: Alaska Salmon with Raspberry Guacamole
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 4 tablespoons fresh tahini | 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 avocado - peeled, pitted and diced | 1/2 cup diced small raspberries | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 rind from a goat cheese or 1 romaita beef tenderloin
instructions: To make the guacamole, mix together 1 tablespoon tahini with worcestershire sauce, avocado, raspberries, and vinegar in a small bowl.

title: Easy Almond & Lemonade
ingredients: 500 ml almond meal | 2 liters fresh lemonade
instructions: Put the almond meal in a bowl, stir in the lemonade and mix well. Spoon the mixture into 2 tall glasses & refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Tip, when you remove the glass from the refrigerator, spoon the almond mixture onto a dessert tray or into a small decorative mould to create swirl effect for each new glaze.

Random Ingredients: lamb,sesame oil,maraschino cherry,wonton wrapper,baking chocolate,green chili,apple juice concentrate,beef consomme
title: Lamb and Apple Dumplings (Chungstäck)
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 large green chili, finely chopped | 3 large apples, finely chopped | 24 wonton wrappers | 1 can condensed beef consomme ( i used one 16 ounce packet of wonton soup starter brand ) | 1 1/2 ounces maraschino cherries or 1 1/2 ounces maraschino cherries, juice and peel | 6 ounces sesame oil | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder or 1 tablespoon dried small red chilies
instructions: Cook ground lamb until browned, drain any fat. Add chile, apples and consommé, reduce over medium heat until thick. Add beef and maraschino juice and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Place a teaspoon of stuffing in the center of each wonton wrapper. Top with one tablespoon of meat mixture, brush the edges with a bit of the sesame oil, and roll up. Place in a freezer bag and freeze for at least two hours, or overnight, until firm. To serve, invert frozen dumplings into an ice tray. Sprinkle top with a little chocolate shavings.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,tamarind paste,sourdough starter,creme fraiche,rice vinegar,japanese eggplant,bread,rice wine
title: Eggplant Sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons toasted rice wine or 2 tablespoons rice syrup | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 6 slices crusty bread | 4 tablespoons sourdough starter | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 japanese eggplant, cut widthwise in a thin slice across its length | 1 cup creme fraiche or 1 cup light cream | shredded red cabbage | shredded sesame seeds or chopped chives, garnish if desired
instructions: Toast the bread slices until dry but not browned. Spread a thin layer of the sesame seed on the toast, if desired. Dress the eggplant slices with the fermented rice vinegar and tamarind. Spread the sourdough starter on the toast and top with the eggplant slices.

title: Roasted Sweet Peppers
ingredients: 6 green bell peppers | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Slice tops off peppers. Place in a roasting pan and drizzle with grand marnier. Season with onion powder and sprinkle with green peppers. Roast in a 400 degree oven for 20 minutes or so until the peppers are tender and begin to give off their liquid.

Random Ingredients: msg,rom tomato,baby arugula,curry powder,red chili pepper,cognac
title: Baked Baby Spinach With Burrata
ingredients: 32 ounces baby arugula ( rocket ) | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon msg ( monosodium glutamate ) | 1 1/2 lbs roma tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon cognac ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking pan with parchment paper. Wash the arugula thoroughly with cold water and pat dry to remove grit immediately. Wash the spinach well to remove grit. Tear off stems of any large leaves, roughly. In a medium bowl, combine the arugula, curry powder, msg, tomatoes and cognac. Toss to combine. Transfer to the prepared baking pan. Cover with parchment paper and bake, stirring occasionally, for about 20 minutes or until the spinach has released some moisture slightly and is tender crisp.. Remove the foil and bake until heated throughout and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,cilantro,grain mustard,jalapeno pepper,vinegar,asafoetida powder,banana pepper
title: Banana Pepper, Asafoetida, and Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 7 tablespoons asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 8 large ripe bananas, thinly sliced, about 2 cups | 1 medium jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1/3 cup vinegar | 3/4 cup sliced pickled banana pepper | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, plus more | cilantro | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard
instructions: Whisk together, 1 tablespoons asafoetida and the remaining ingredients until well blended, then pour into a 2 quart glass bowl to coat. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Serve as above.

Random Ingredients: oyster,pork shoulder chop,thai basil leaf,chili paste,mango chutney,barley,brie cheese,asafoetida powder
title: BBQ Pork and BBQ Brie
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oyster, sauce | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 tablespoons chutney | 2 tablespoons asafoetida powder | 12 boneless pork shoulder chops | 4 slices brie cheese | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 2 large pieces dried sweet bell peppers or 2 large red bell peppers | 8 sprigs fresh thai basil leaves
instructions: Make sauce mixture. In a blender or food processor finely blend until smooth. Mix oyster sauce, mango chutney, 1 tablespoon salsa and asafoetida. Place pork chops in marinade and refrigerate for at least one hour or overnight. Remove pork from marinade and grill, turning once, over indirect medium medium fire, until cooked through, about 8 minutes. Spread 1 teaspoon sesame oil over a broiler rack set 3 to 4 inches from heating element for 1 to 2 minutes, or until very hot. Set aside. Brush both sides of pork chops with some of the reserved marinade and set aside. Place 3 slices brie cheese on broiler rack. Serve with steamed sweet onion and bell pepper for dipping, if desired.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,french onion,water chestnut,green cardamom pod,fontina cheese,caraway seed,green onion,thyme sprig
title: French Onion Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup french onions, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup shredded fontina cheese | 5 tablespoons sour cream or 5 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1 canned water chestnut, sliced ( reserve liquid ) | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 cup fresh thyme sprig, leaves only | 1 1/2 cups ice cubes | 6 green onions, sliced into 6-8 pieces | 1 -2 fresh thyme sprig
instructions: In a large saute pan heat the reserved liquid over medium high heat. Stir in the sour cream and reserved mushroom liquid. Add the drained water chestnuts and green cardamom pods and cook for 2 minutes. Off the heat stir in onions, 2 tsp of thyme and 1 cup of ice. Sprinkle with remaining salt and serve. Note, to make toasts, remove the thyme sprigs from the ice cubes, and set aside. When ready to serve, reheat gently over low heat, stirring often. Transfer to large bowl, garnish with remaining thyme, and serve.

title: Crazy Simple Microwave Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white rice, uncooked | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Add all ingredients to the bowl of a 2 cup electric micro wave safe microwave safe bowl. Stir until the salt has dissolved, then cover the microwave safe bowl with a dish wrap and place in the microwave. Microwave at full power for 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,chili pepper,mexican corn,milk ricotta cheese,blue cheese,cauliflower
title: Cauliflower, Mexican Corn and Blue Cheese Tortilla
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into small florets | 1/2 pint whole milk ricotta cheese | 16 ounces crumbled blue cheese | 1/2 pint mexican-style corn | 1/2 pint chili pepper, chopped | 1/4 pint bailey's irish cream, or more to taste
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the cauliflower in the pot, cook until just tender but still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes, drain. Meanwhile, mix the ricotta cheese and the cheese mixture together in a bowl until smooth. Spread about half the cheese mixture in the base of a skillet. Spread about half the cauliflower on top of the cheese. Flake the remaining cauliflower into chunks and scatter evenly over the cauliflower. Sprinkle the chile pepper over the top of the cauliflower. Sprinkle the cream over the top of everything and spread the remaining cheese mixture on top and on the bottom. Heat in the microwave until the tortilla is heated through and the cheese is melted, about 30 seconds at a time.

Random Ingredients: penne,artichoke heart,vanilla ice cream,flour,head cauliflower,french bread
title: Cape Inn  Artichoke and Feta Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 1 lb penne, cook according to package directions | 1 large head cauliflower, cut into flowerettes | 1 package of four cheese-filled fat free frozen cut french bread, thawed | 8 ounces fat free vanilla ice cream, softened | 1 package of fat-free french's blend cheese, whipped to blend
instructions: In one 9x13 inch baking dish layer the artichokes, spinach, cauliflower, bread, and cheese. The final layer should be crusty. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker,dijon mustard,bay leaf,star anise,pork shoulder,ranch bean,yellow hominy
title: Chef John's Pueblo Style Pork and Hominy Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cans yellow hominy, drained and rinsed | 2 cans diced yellow hominy, drained and rinsed | 1 cup ranch-style beans, rinsed | 1 bay leaf | 1 piece star anise | 1 tablespoon stone ground jutera mustard | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon powdered dry mustard | 2 1/2 tablespoons stone ground jutera mustard | 1 teaspoon stone ground jutera mustard | 1/4 cup stone ground julienne-cut yellow hominy | 3 1/2 cups graham crackers, divided
instructions: Place pork in a large saucepan, cover with water, and add 2 cans of yellow and one can of diced tomatoes with juice. Place a lid on the pan, and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer for at least 2 hours. Discard the lid, and simmer 10 minutes more. Stir in 1 cup of ranch style beans and 1 can of diced tomatoes with juice. Place a lid on the pan, and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer for at least 1 hour and up to 2 hours, adding water as needed. The most important thing about the pork and beans, preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Heat 2 tablespoons stone ground mustard in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring to dissolve the grains of brown and grain. Add 1 teaspoon of stone ground jutera with a pinch of salt, and 3 1/2 cups of graham cracker crumbs, stirring to combine well. Transfer the mixture in the skillet into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Evenly spread the 1 cup graham crackers over the layer. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly toasted, about 20 minutes. Remove the toasted crackers from the oven, and set aside to cool to room temperature. The soup can easily be refrigerated in a sealed plastic container after freezing, or processed to desired consistency in a food processor while still warm.

title: Beetroot (From Vegan Magazine)
ingredients: 1 cup raw eggplant, washed, peeled and cut in 1/4-inch dice | 1/3 cup beet, shelled, trimmed and cut into bite size pieces ( or use 2 cups chopped canned beets and 1 cup beetroot ) | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast or 3 tablespoons yeast flakes | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 - 1 cup nuts, finely chopped, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Dice beetroot into 1 1/2 1 inch cubes. Sprinkle with coconut extract, and stir. Add beetroot mixture, and stir well to mix. Gently stir in nuts, if desired. Let sit in fridge, stirring often. This is not a bread spread, but you could use it as filling for sandwiches, salads or soup.

title: Wakame Salad - Vegetarian
ingredients: 1 package wakame seaweed salad | 8 ounces canned tomatoes | 19 ounces black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 ounces pearl onions | 2 -3 tablespoons skim milk | 1 -2 teaspoon dried marjoram ( optional )
instructions: Shake wakame, tomatoes, and black beans thoroughly in a salad bowl. Garnish with onions and marjoram, if desired.

title: Korean Beef With Apples
ingredients: 1 cup thinly sliced flank steak | 1 small tart cooking apple, peeled, cored, and sliced thinly | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt ( kikkoman ) | 3 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Cut flank steak diagonally across grain into 1/4 inch wide strips. Place in a serving dish. Stir apple slices into beef, and stir with yogurt.

title: Ancho Chile Yogurt
ingredients: 1 bunch greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon dry ancho chiles, crushed
instructions: Cut the stems off the ancho chiles. Break them into chunks about 1 inch diameter. Place the chunks in 2 ice cube trays. Top with plastic wrap or moistened hands. Freeze until the yogurt is slushy, at least 2 - 6 hours. Remove from the freezer when thick. Break into 1 1/2 chunks. Spoon the mixture into 4 ice cube trays. Freeze until almost solid, at least 2 - 3 hours, stirring every 20 - 30 minutes. To serve, gently press the tops of the glasses with a metal spatula. Dip the glasses in the chile and pour on extra yogurt.

Random Ingredients: sugar,pork shoulder,tomato puree,fennel,onion soup mix,cumin seed
title: Cinco De Puerco
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 4 lbs lean pork shoulder, sliced 1/2 inch ( about 4 cups ) | 6 tablespoons granulated sugar | 8 tablespoons chili powder or 3 tablespoons dried onion soup mix | 1 ounce dry fennel, crushed | 1 envelope onion soup mix ( see note )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Toast the cumin seeds in small dry skillet. Transfer to a large baking sheet or roasting pan or dish. Lightly coat pork with a light film of oil, and spread onto baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes. Turn meat, and stir in 3 tablespoons of sugar, chili powder, and fennel. Sprinkle with remaining 1d cup of sugar and bake an additional 15 minutes. Cool, then stir into pork mixture. Store in refrigerator up to 5 days. To reheat, cook uncovered in a 350 degree f oven for 30 to 35 minutes, stirring after every 5 minutes. To freeze for up to a week, place on wax paper and freeze in an airtight container. To reheat, place in a 300 degree f oven, uncovered, for 30 to 40 minutes, stirring after every 5 minutes. Cool fully, then store in freezer, uncovered.

title: Kelijnen - Cold French Fries (Skewered Fish)
ingredients: 1 kg fish fillet, cut to preferred serving sizes | 1 cup ketchup
instructions: Place fish on skewers and brush lightly with ketchup. Grill for about ten minutes, brushing occasionally with juice and turning when cooked as desired.

Random Ingredients: jarlsberg cheese,cranberry,self raising flour,cream mushroom soup
title: Crusty Cranberry Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups cranberries | 2 cups self-raising flour | 3/4 lb jarlsberg cheese, grated | 1 can cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f and spray two 9x13 cake pans with cooking spray. Place the cranberries on a baking sheet, then toss them in the pan with the flour. Sprinkle the cheese over the cranberries. Pour the soup over the cheese and crumble in the cranberries. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown on top and bubbly and cooked through. Cut nuts into squares while still warm. Serve warm.

title: Tahini Hummus
ingredients: 2 teaspoons tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the tahini, lemon juice and olive oil, adding a little of the oil if the mixture is a bit too thick. Mix well. Use immediately, or refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: ice water,peanut oil vegetable,part mozzarella cheese,canola oil,chinese wine,spring wrapper
title: Lillian's Spring Rolls With Peanut Sauce
