ingredients: 1 package spring roll wrappers | ice water | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 cup canola oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 4 teaspoons chinese-style wine
instructions: In a small bowl stir together the oil, rice wine, and the chinese style wine until thoroughly combined. Place one wrapper in the freezer until ready to use. Brush the inside and outside of a spring roll wrapper with a light coat of the oil mixture, and use a 2 or 3 damp paper towels dipped in ice water to dab off excess. Cut the wrapper into 1 1/2 inch wide pieces, and place 1 tablespoon of the cheese into the center of the wrapper, then roll up the wrapper around the cheese, pressing together the filling. Repeat for all the spring rolls. Place on a plate covered with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until all spring rolls have been made. Heat 1 tablespoon of the canola oil in a wok or large skillet over medium high heat. Add the spring rolls and shrimp mixture and stir fry for 4 to 5 minutes until shrimp are pink and spring rolls are golden brown, but inside is not crispy. Place the shrimp on a plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of canola oil in the wok or large skillet over medium high heat. Add the spring rolls in batches, and stir fry until golden brown, but inside is not crispy, 4 to 5 minutes per batch. If using bamboo skewers, soak at least 30 minutes in water. Serve warm, with the peanut sauce.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,coconut,grain white rice,summer squash,asparagus,habanero pepper,red bean,quatre epices
title: Guilt Free Corned Beef, Pumpkin & Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs corned beef | 8 ounces quatre-epices | 1 bag asparagus, cut diagonally into 2 inch pieces | 1 bag medium grain white rice, washed | 8 ounces asparagus, tips cut diagonally in 2 inch pieces | 1 small turnip, chopped into 2 inch pieces | 1 small yellow summer squash, cleaned seeded, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 ounces sweetened flaked coconut | 1 small habanero pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place the corned beef in a heavy pot with the juice from 3/4 of the bag of asparagus, and the quatre épices. Cover and bring the liquid to a boil. Decrease heat and simmer, covered, about 15 minutes. While the liquid is simmering, wash and cut the corn beef into 2 inch pieces. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the corn beef pieces, and cook 2 minutes. Drain the water and cool the corned beef. Place in a casserole, cover with water, and add the asparagus tips. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 5 minutes. Add the rice, rice bran mixture and stir into the water. Bring to a boil. Lower the heat to a simmer, and continue to cook, covered, stirring occasionally, until all remaining liquid has been absorbed, about 25 minutes. While the rice cooks, place all the asparagus tips and vegetables in a pot with the reserved liquid. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and cook 5 minutes, or until tender. Rinse the asparagus and vegetables under cold water, and drain. Combine in a bowl with the fried corned beef and serve. Garnish with a drizzle of fresh chopped coriander.

title: Green Onion Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1/3 cup bulgar wheat ( cracked wheat ) | 2 tablespoons chopped green onions | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 2 1/4 teaspoons cognac | lime wedge
instructions: Add bulgur, green onions, herbs and cognac to food processor.

Random Ingredients: lard,plum tomato,gruyere cheese,onion soup mix,dark sesame oil,chili paste,black pepper
title: Tomato and Gruyere Appetizers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground black pepper | 3 tablespoons chili paste with or garlic | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 lbs plum tomatoes, thickly sliced | 1/2 cup minced dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons lard | 3/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Place the pepper, chili paste, oil, tomatoes and onion soup mix in a large bowl, cover and chill for 5 to 10 minutes or until mixture forms a paste. Heat the lard and sauté the cheese for 1 minute until it begins to caramelize. Add the tomato mixture to the cheese and heat until warm. Spoon cheese into a lightly buttered baking dish. Add the chili paste mixture and sprinkle over the gruyere cheese. Place in a preheated 450ºf oven and bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until the top is light golden brown.

Random Ingredients: green olive,virgin olive oil,lemon peel,extra virgin oil,yukon gold potato,pine nut
title: Potato Salad With Falkes, Green Olives, and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 lbs kirby gold potatoes or 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, cooked and peeled | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1 cup green olives or 1 cup black olives, pitted | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated | 4 tablespoons virgin olive oil
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1/2 inch by 1 1/2 inch cubes and place in a pot of boiling water. Cover, and cook for 20 minutes. Drain and allow to cool. When cool, place potatoes into a large serving bowl. Add enough extra virgin olive oil to coat and toss lightly until potatoes are coated with oil. Add enough olive oil to the pan for frying, but not so that it pools in the oil, to coat the potato. Heat a large nonstick fry pan over medium heat. Add the pine nuts, and cook for 1 - 2 minutes, or until lightly browned. Remove to a plate and set aside. Drain the potatoes very well, and toss them into the pan with the olive oil. Add the green olives, lemon peel, and grated olive oil.

title: Ww Wings of Elegant Oyster Mushroom
ingredients: 10 ounces chicken wings, wing tips removed | 4 dried oyster mushrooms | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce
instructions: Put the chicken wings on a baking tray and roast under a moderately high heat until they are lightly charred all over.

title: Spicy Strawberry & Pecan Tostadas
ingredients: 2/3 cup chopped pecans | 10 ounces frozen strawberries, thawed & drained but liquid reserved | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 1 cup finely sliced green chili pepper ( or green or red ) | 2 tablespoons molasses | 8 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Spray a 2 count baking dish with nonstick spray, or line it with parchment paper. In a small bowl, toss the pecans with the remaining 3/4 cup of the chopped pecans. Place them in a single layer on the baking sheet.

title: Crispy Lentil Chips (Aussie Style)
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentil, rinsed and picked over | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce ( storebought or homemade ) | 1/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 fresh ginger
instructions: Using a fork or pestle, mash up the lentils in a bowl, to release some of their health promoting properties. In a cast iron skillet, heat oil to 300°f. In a separate saucepan, combine the lentils and any reserved bits. Stir the lentils frequently over low heat until they are browned. Add the pesto and stir to blend. Spread the cornmeal on a plate. Dip the chip into the cornmeal and then transfer to the skillet. Cook, turning often, for 7 minutes until the chips have browned. Remove the skillet from the heat. Sprinkle the ginger on top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,new york,green pea,basmati rice,sea scallop,cooking oil,beer
title: Steamed Scallops With Beer and Rice
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 can light beer | 1 can swanson low sodium condensed original beer | 1 package frozen green peas, thawed | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice or 1 1/2 cups long grain rice and wild rice blend | 4 ounces new york steak, sliced thin ( deli size ) | sea scallops, halved
instructions: Mix soup, 2 tablespoons oil, undiluted belgium beer, peas with sauce, rice, noodles and steak. Put into 3 to 4 quart steamer and steaming.

title: Lovers Stuffed With Borscht
ingredients: 8 fresh beets, washed and sliced | 8 small fresh tomatoes or 8 small plum tomatoes, cut in half | 8 tablespoons dry mushroom creme | 80 g fresh italian parsley | 80 g fresh marshmallow creme
instructions: Cut off the tops of the beets and carefully scoop out most of the inside flesh. Remove the beet pulp and remove the pulp with a teaspoon. Mash the pulp. Place in a blender with the chopped tomatoes. In a bowl, blend the mushroom creme and parsley using a little water, until mixture is smooth. Use your fingers to mix in the softened mushroom mixture. Taste for salt. To stuff the beets, arrange the beets around the insides of a lightly greased casserole dish. Cover with the mushroom creme mixture. Garnish with a sprinkle of the shredded parsley. Preheat the oven to 180c and bake for about 1 hour or until very tender.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,goat cheese,vodka,chocolate curl,jicama,dark brown sugar,cooking oil
title: Frosted Jicama - Giada De Laurentiis
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon vodka | 2 ripe but firm jicama | 2 tablespoons unsalted goat cheese, diced | 1 ounce chocolate curls | cooking oil, for dusting
instructions: Peel and cut jicama into 1/4 inch thick strips. Toss jicama in a colander and coat with cornstarch. Set aside. Place the vinegar, brown sugar, vodka and goat cheese in a plastic zipper bag.

title: Bea and Spinach Sauteed in Bacon
ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 12 ounces fresh baby spinach | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Cook bacon until crispy, then crumble. Remove from frypan and drain on paper towels, then crumble the bacon. Remove the spinach from the pan and place in a large bowl. Drain the spinach, reserving about 3 tablespoons of the liquid. Stir in spinach liquid and bamboo shoots, then season to taste with salt and pepper. Heat remaining bacon grease in the frypan over medium high heat and cook spinach for 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through.

title: Mock Devonshire (Devonshire Meatballs)
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground meat | 1/2 cup irish cream
instructions: Combine the meat and the cream until well mixed. Form into 1 inch balls. Steam them over hot, slightly salted water until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side.

title: Salsa Chicken on French Bread
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Place chicken breasts in crock pot. Combine salsa, vinegar, and water and pour over chicken. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours. Cut french loaf into 3 or 4 slices to serve.

title: Pears With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 large ripe pears, peeled halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons other light oil | 8 ounces mixed mushrooms, chopped | 10 -12 dried apricots, chopped
instructions: Serve on a platter with the pears on the side.

title: Blueberry Milk Pork Roast With Polenta
ingredients: 1/3 cup frozen blueberries | 1/3 cup canned whole milk | 1 1/2 cups 1 % low fat milk | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup smoked green olive | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Line a large baking pan with aluminum foil. Place the bag of frozen blueberries on a large plate, and cover with plastic wrap. Place bag in oven, and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until soft. Turn the oven off. Pour 1/3 cup milk into 4 cup measuring cup. Dissolve turmeric in hot pepper sauce, pour this into milk bowl, and set aside. Remove the bag of blueberries, and mash. Stir aside, and return bag of fresh blueberries to the bowl. Using a spoon, stir the blueberries into the milk mixture. Continue to stir until the liquid begins to thicken, about 5 minutes, adding more water, if necessary. Spoon the sauce onto prepped baking pan. Roast for 25 - 30 minutes.. Remove from oven, and stir. To serve, cut into slices, and spoon sauce over. For a beautiful garnish, sprinkle paprika or paprika cheese on top, or serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Chinese Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup thick chinese wine | 3 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 piece fresh ginger root peeled and thinly sliced, or more to taste
instructions: Rinse beef tenderloin in a strainer until the water runs clear. Place on a baking tray and pour in wine. Sprinkle thyme over the top of the beef. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 to 12 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake beef on a baking sheet in the preheated oven until the internal temperature reaches 140 degrees f, for rare, about 20 minutes. Move to a cutting board, tent with aluminum foil, and let sit 5 minutes. Slice into desired serving sizes.

Random Ingredients: corn muffin mix,tomato juice,corn oil,lemon peel,vanilla pudding,ranch dressing,saffron,turmeric
title: Delicious Mexican Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 box corn muffin mix | 1 package ranch dressing | corn oil | 1 package vanilla instant pudding | 2 cups tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 lemon peel, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with non stick cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine corn muffin mix with ranch dressing. Mix together thoroughly. Shape into 8 flat corn fritters, or place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into cornfritters comes out clean. To serve, spoon some warm fritters over your favorite corn pudding.

Random Ingredients: tomato basil oregano garlic,beef chuck,starch,button mushroom,cabbage,tomato juice
title: Italian Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck | 3 carrots, cut in 1 inch strips | 8 ounces cabbage, shredded | 2 cans stewed tomatoes with basil oregano and garlic, undrained | 1 can tomato juice, undrained | 2 teaspoons cornstarch
instructions: Brown beef in large skillet on all sides. Remove to crockpot, add all remaining ingredients and stir well. Cover and cook on low 4 -7 hours. Remove chuck roast and vegetables from crockpot, shred beef, serve with french bread, noodles, or rice.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,pickling spice,pea carrot,jalapeno pepper,sun tomato oil,strawberry jam,vanilla extract,almond
title: Pickled Eggs (Pilaquiles)
ingredients: 1 gallon fresh pea carrots | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded if desired | 3 -4 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 6 tablespoons pickling spice | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 2 teaspoons pickling spice | 3/4 cup pickling pickling spice | 6 tablespoons pickling spice | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 1/2 tablespoons almond, minced
instructions: Clean peas, then split in half and wash in a colander over a bowl of ice water until water runs clear.. Remove the peel and stringy membrane from the vegetables on the back of each potato. Place the whole vegetables in a large stainless steel bowl and cover with water. Let stand for 24 hours. Rinse the vegetables under warm water and drain well. Wash the sun dried tomatoes and sun dried tomatoes. Heat 3 tablespoons of the pickling spice with the sun dried tomatoes in oil in a non stick skillet on medium heat until hot, stirring vigorously. Stir in the coriander and 3/4 cup of the pickling spice, then add the remaining 3/4 cup of pickling spice, and bring to a boil, stirring to break up the sun dried tomatoes. Stir in the pea carrots. Mix the pickling spice, coriander seeds, and the remaining 1/4 cup of pickling spice. Stir into the carrots with the peas and cook for 3 minutes over medium heat. Mix in the tomatoes, increase heat to high, and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until the sauce thickens. Do not boil. Cool. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. The jar can be used the recipe is the journal. Note, you can freeze this without the pickling spice and it can be prepared immediately after the peas have sat for up to 3 days in a large freezer bag. You can do this in a canning jar or a large freezer bag. For the storage, you can simply pour the frozen peas into the pickling spice jar, then fill with the remaining 1/4 cup pickling spice and store in the freezer. The flavor can continue to gain over a month. This recipe can also be prepared with chicken or ham as well.

title: Garbanzo Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs country-style pork spareribs | 1 1/2 lbs pork spareribs | 1/4 cup corn ( optional ) | 1 can chick-peas ( optional ) | 1 french bread, loaf
instructions: Place spareribs crosswise in a roasting pan. Place ribs in center of a rack in a large, deep roasting pan which has a wire rack. Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 25 minutes. While ribs are baking, drain pork and spareribs from pan. Place spareribs, cooked meat and corn with liquid in pan and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes or until beans are very tender.

title: Chickpea and Leek Pizza
ingredients: 1 french bread, cut in 6 slices | 5 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1 leek, chopped ( reserve the white stalk ) | 1 can enchilada sauce, warmed | 1 tablespoon tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread bread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle with 1 tbls. Of the chickpea flour. Bake bread until golden and bubbly, about 5 - 7 minutes. Turn slices over. Spread 1 tbls. Of the warmed enchilada sauce on the toast. Repeat the same with the remaining bread. Top with the leeks and remaining enchilada sauce. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle with tarragon.

title: Spicy Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, trimmed | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup water | 1/4 cup sliced green chile, drained | 1/2 teaspoon pepper, or to taste
instructions: Cut steak into four equal chunks. Place the meat in a resealable plastic bag. Add the envelope of dressing mix, water, chiles and pepper. Close bag and marinate in refrigerator, 30 minutes to overnight. Remove meat from marinade and grill under preheated broiler, 7 to 10 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,beef chuck roast,fruit sugar,herb,anchovy paste,leek,taco seasoning
title: Beef Carnitas
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast ( trimmed and tied ) | 6 large garlic cloves ( minced ) or 1 head garlic ( minced ) | 1 cup fresh mushrooms ( finely chopped or shredded ) | 1/2 cup mixed dried herbs, soaked in hot water for at least 1 hour or 2 tablespoons fresh cherries ( and cilantro, finely chopped to cover ) | 1/4 cup fish sauce/seasoning | taco seasoning | 1/4 cup pearl barley ( soaked in warm water for at least 30 minutes, and then drained, but not overcooked )
instructions: Place meat in roasting pan or dutch oven with garlic. In separate bowl, mix dried herbs with water. Sprinkle over meat and add any herbs and spices that you might want to add now. Cover and place in 350°f oven for about an hour, or until beef meat is very tender and falling apart tender. When done, remove meat from pan and place on serving platter. Use a slotted spoon to remove any fat on the meat.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,cumin,black tea leaf,plain flour,grand marnier,angel hair pasta,porcini mushroom,hoisin sauce
title: Italian Christmas Tea Noodle Bowls
ingredients: 3/4 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons instant guacamole | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 3 cups hot strong black tea leaves | 3/4 ounce grand marnier | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 cups prepared angel hair pasta | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander or 3 tablespoons cilantro
instructions: In large non stick frying pan, toast mushrooms over medium heat, tossing, until golden brown and tender, about 5 minutes. Remove pan from heat, drizzle with guacamole and cover. To serve, divide mushrooms among 4 large hot pint glass measuring cups. Remove 1 cup of hot tea leaves from freezer and set aside. Place bowl in roasting pan, fill with 1/2 cup cold hot tea, brew to boiling, and stir in grand marnier and cumin. Let stand 5 minutes then spoon tea among bowls. Garnish with coriander and serve.

title: French Toast With Syrup
ingredients: 1 bag french bread, cut into thin slices | 1 bouillon cube ( i use knorr ) | 1 tablespoon corn syrup ( light or regular ) | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1/3 cup dry red wine
instructions: Mix all ingredients to form crumbs in a small bowl. Set aside. Dip bread into crumbs, coating well. Place in a non stick skillet and cook until browned on each side.

title: Easy and Delicious Open Faced Green Curry Sandwich (Diabetic)
ingredients: 4 slices bread ( diagonally cut or whole wheat ) | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1/4 cup gouda cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat your broiler or grill. For each bread slice, spread a thin layer of curry paste on one side of the bread slices. Place the bread slices under the broiler, but do not flip. Just lightly toast the bread slices. The pieces of cheese should be lightly toasted. Spread a thin layer of cheese on one side of the bread. Place the bread and curry paste in a small serving bowl and top with the remaining slices of cheese. Serve at once with jasmine rice.

title: Fried Idlis (Curried Noodles)
ingredients: 2 cups frozen urad dal, cleaned and drained | oil or ghee ( for deep frying )
instructions: Wash and drain the urad dal, placing it between two sheets of damp paper towels. Heat the ghee or oil and fry the urad dal until it turns golden brown in color. Remove from the ghee with a strainer. Pour oil/ghee all over the urad dal and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,oregano,yogurt,nicoise olive,italian turkey sausage,dark amber maple syrup
title: Grilled Italian Turkey Sausages with Salsa Verde
ingredients: 12 italian turkey sausage or 12 hot italian turkey sausages | 1/4 cup dark amber maple syrup | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt | 1/4 cup nicoise olives or 1/4 cup black olives, chopped | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh oregano | 1 small serrano pepper, chopped
instructions: Heat grill to medium high. Brush sausage lightly with maple syrup. Grill for 6 minutes or until center is firm. Turn and grill for 3 minutes. Transfer to plate. Toss remaining ingredients in bowl and serve with sausage as a sandwich.

title: French Cantaloupe Salad
ingredients: 2 cantaloupe - peeled, seeded and cubed | 1 cup italian dressing
instructions: Arrange the cantaloupe pieces in a salad bowl. Drizzle dressing over salad. Serve.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,semolina flour,milk,salmon fillet,lamb shoulder,canola oil
title: Lamb with porcini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 1/4 pounds lamb shoulder, bones reserved | 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 3 cups milk | 3 ounces semolina flour | 3 ounces porcini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Heat canola oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Brown lamb on all sides, but not fully cooked. Place lamb in a baking dish, and pour the milk over. Let stand 30 minutes. Remove and discard meat from bones. Bake lamb in preheated oven 15 to 20 minutes, turning over bones and basting every 10 minutes. Melt semolina flour in a 2 quart saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon and scraping with a wooden spoon until the mixture has a light brown color, about 5 minutes. Stir in chopped porcini mushrooms. Serve sauce in a gravy boat with basmati rice.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,tabasco sauce,purpose flour,cayenne,potato,broth,tart apple
title: Crunchy Apple and Potato Knead
ingredients: 8 medium potatoes, cut into thin bite size pieces ( about 1lb ) | 2 tart apples, cut into chunks ( such as granny smith, cored, peeled, or 1/4 ) | 1 cup broth, from cooking apple in broth | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot of salted boiling water. Add apples and apples and reduce heat. Cover and cook over medium heat for 15 - 30 minutes, until slightly softened. Drain, transfer to a bowl, and cool to lukewarm. Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Coat a 9x5x3 loaf pan with cooking spray and transfer the cooled mixture to the pan. Toss lightly with flour. Spread the apple mixture evenly over the knead mixture and sprinkle with the fish sauce, cayenne, and both flours. Bake in the centre of the oven for 45 - 50 minutes, until top is golden brown and crunchy. Serve hot.

title: Wild Rice With Apricots and Apricots in a Bag With
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups wild rice, washed | 1 1/2 lbs apricots, pitted and halved
instructions: Rinse wild rice, picking out any debris.

title: Italian Tomato  & Pistachios With Salsa Fresca
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dried porcini mushrooms ( or dried mushrooms ) | 15 1/2 ounces italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1/2 medium onion, chopped | 1/4 cup pistachios, chopped | 3 fresh lime leaves | fresh fruit, diced, for serving
instructions: Soak the dried mushrooms in hot water for 15 minutes, then drain. Rinse mushrooms and place in a medium non stick frying pan or skillet with a little olive oil, adding 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring until they soften and change color to a nice red. Add mushrooms, stewed tomatoes, chopped onion and pistachios. Stir well. Cook over low heat for 15 minutes or until most of the liquid evaporates. Remove from heat and stir in the lime leaves. Transfer to a bowl and serve topped with diced fresh fruits.

title: French Style Sesame Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped mixed nuts ( dried cherries work well too )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a jar. Cover and shake to blend and coat salad. Cover and shake well to blend and coat salad.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,cream,extra virgin olive oil,german chocolate cake mix,sherry wine vinegar
title: German Chocolate Cake Dessert
ingredients: 1 package german chocolate cake mix | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 cup sweet red bell pepper, finely diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease and flour a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, combine the cake mix, oil, vinegar and sour cream. Stir until smooth. Turn the cake mixture into the prepared pan. Sprinkle with bell pepper and bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Monkey Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup caster sugar | 250 g monterey jack pepper cheese ( grated )
instructions: Heat oven to 190c. Line an oven tray with baking paper or grease with margarine. Beat cheese until smooth. Add sugar & beat until thick & creamy. Pour into pan & bake for 12 - 15 mins, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,american cheese,corn oil,cornstarch,baking soda,dark sesame oil,golden raisin
title: Cheese Raisin Raisin Rice Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups golden raisins ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 cup shredded medium-grind american cheese ( about 3 1/2 cups ) | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil ( dark preferably ) | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 1/2 cups medium-grain rice, well rinsed | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon cornstarch ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Grease and flour a 9 inch loaf pan or 2 small loaf pans. In a large bowl, stir together raisins with cheese. In a small bowl, whisk together sesame oil, cornstarch, baking soda and 2 teaspoons of the dark sesame oil. Add to cheese mixture and stir until well combined. Stir in remaining sesame oil to reserved cheese mixture and stir in. Pour into prepared pan and sprinkle top with remaining 1/2 cup of cheese. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until golden brown and hollow sounding when tapped.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,sauce,napa cabbage,taco shell,arborio rice,lemon wedge
title: Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups uncooked rice | 1/3 cup grated orange rind | 2 cups shredded napa cabbage | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon sugar | 10 taco shells, warmed in hot oven | lemon wedge ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Cool well. Combine shredded cabbage and orange rind in large bowl. Spread rice on the inside of taco shells. Spoon cabbage and orange mixture evenly among taco shells. Sprinkle with sugar. Fold taco shells in half. Garnish with lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,pepper,thai fish sauce,colby monterey jack cheese,half cream,yeast,beer,large shrimp
title: Crock Pot Shrimp and Cheese Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups beer | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant dry yeast | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup minced onion | 1/2 cup chopped canned chicken breast | 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 2 cups peeled and deveined large shrimp | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce
instructions: In large non stick skillet, heat beer and sprinkle yeast over the top. Let sit for about 10 minutes, or until foamy. Add half and half, onion and chopped chicken breast. Stir just until the chicken and onion are heated through. Spread ¾ of the cheese on the inside of a 9 inch pizza pan. Lay the shrimp onto the cheese, then sprinkle evenly with the remaining cheese. Pour the liquid from the pan over the shrimp. Bake in a 425 degree f oven for 10 minutes. Top with remaining shrimp and sprinkle with fish sauce. Continue cooking and additional 5 minutes.

title: Harvest Festal Salad (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 bags shredded coleslaw | 1 bag shredded cheese ( cheddar or vermont jack ) | 1 box phyllo pastry sheets | 8 ounces grape or 8 ounces kiwi juice ( fresh juice is best ) | 1/8 cup chopped fresh marjoram or 1/8 cup basil | 1/8 cup chopped fresh tarragon or 1/8 cup basil | 1/8 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place bag of coleslaw, cheese, and grape/kiiwi in a bowl. Drain juice with a fork until well blended and pour over coleslaw. Toss to coat evenly and generously. Unroll pastry on a clean but dry pastry cloth. Sprinkle evenly with herbs and cumin. Cut pastries into 4 equal pieces to fit individual serving plates. Lay each pastry piece directly on top of the coleslaw and grape/kiiwi/cumin mixture in the plates. Garnish with a sprinkle of more herbs and cumin. Serve immediately.

title: Pasta With White Beans and Vodka Recipe #1
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat penne | 32 ounces navy beans, canned and undrained | 2 tablespoons vodka or 2 tablespoons apple juice concentrate | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside. In a large sauce pan or dutch oven combine all ingredients. Bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Wonton Appetizers
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds
instructions: Separate the leaves of the savoy cabbage and place in a bowl full of cold water. Squeeze out all the excess water and cut the larger leaves into strips of about 4 inch long, leaving the stem attached at the top and bottom of the cabbage whole. Place the cumin seeds on the top of the cabbage leaves. Use a slotted spoon or a wodden wooden spoon to pick off any sand that drains out of the leaves. Place the cabbage in a steamer and cook over boiling water for about 20 minutes, until just tender, then drain and blot dry with paper towels. Fill a large bowl with ice water and set aside until cool, about 5 hours. Place the cabbage and cumin seeds in a blender or food processor and blend into a paste. Transfer the paste into a small bowl and whisk in the remaining filling ingredients. Serve at once.

title: Persian Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 cup raw, unblanched sesame seeds | 2 stalks celery, finely chopped | 1/4 cup sesame seeds, blanched
instructions: Grind sesame seeds and celery with hands in a spice mill or grinder. Store in airtight container.

title: Hot German Salad
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa sausage ( we call sausages in our family ) | pepper ( optional ) | 1 cup wine vinegar | 1 lb muenster cheese
instructions: Slice kielbasa into 1/4 inch slices. Season with pepper to taste. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Spray large, deep frying pan with nonstick spray. Heat to 300° and fry kielbasa until heated through, about 2 - 3 minutes or so. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,asafoetida powder,spanish onion,bamboo shoot,sugar,red capsicum
title: Mild Vegetable Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 200 g uncooked medium egg noodles, soaked in water as per instructions on packet | 500 g sliced asian-style vegetables ( vegetables of your choice such as potato, zucchini, beans or broccoli ) | 1 small red capsicum ( optional ) | 1 small spanish onion, sliced into very thin wedges | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Mix all the ingredients on a salad plate except for the noodles. Drizzle over the dressing and sprinkle with the asafoetida. Cut the noodles with the grain or coarsely chopped vegetables of your choice into the desired size chunks that you will be serving them around in the salad.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,mozzarella cheese,tortilla chip,clam juice,porcini mushroom,shiitake mushroom,okra,cannellini bean
title: Beef and Okra Ragu
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast, 1/2-inch thick, trimmed | 1 teaspoon dried porcini mushrooms | 20 shiitake mushrooms, trimmed, stemmed, caps chopped | 3 cans cannellini beans, rinsed, drained | 1 jar dried cannellini beans, rinsed, drained | 2 teaspoons bottled clam juice | 1 package tortilla chips | 8 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Sprinkle roast with salt and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Bring to room temperature about 15 min before cooking. Trim fat from roast and discard any visible fat and skin. Grill over high heat 1 to 2 min per side, until thermometer registers 135f for rare. Meanwhile, place porcini mushrooms and shiitakes in a bowl. Cover with boiling water, about 20 mls. Pour hot water over mushrooms. Let sit 15 min, then drain. Set aside porcini caps and shiitake stems, reserving liquid. Cut tips into 1/2 x 3/4 inch strips. In a saucepan, cover mushrooms with boiling water, add cannellini beans and clam juice and cook 4 minutes or until beans are heated through. In serving platter, spread some bean mixture on tortillas, top with cheese and shredded roast with some reserved beans and shiitake caps. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white bread,zucchini,taco seasoning mix,rice vinegar,cooking oil,squid,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Tacin de Calabaza (Spanish Calabaza)
ingredients: 8 ounces white bread, sliced in half horizontally into 1/4-inch slices | 3 medium sized zucchini, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices | 3 medium sized squid, cleaned, cleaned and cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices or 1 large calamari, cleaned and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 4 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup cooking oil ( for frying )
instructions: Scoop out and discard all the bread from crusts of the bread slices. Remove and discard the hard, flat pulp to make a hollow in the center of the bread. Cut into quarters or four triangles and set aside. Sprinkle zucchini, squid and seafood in each bread slice. In a small bowl, blend taco seasoning with rice vinegar, adding 1/2 teaspoon of salt and the cheese. Pour 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking oil into a large non stick skillet. When hot, add 1 to 2 tablespoons of the taco seasoning mixture and place into a pancake turner. Fry until the seafood is just opaque and the mixture is hot, about 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. When all of the fried pieces are fried, remove from skillet and keep warm. To serve put into a warmed serving dish and sprinkle with the reserved pieces of bread. Pour the rest of the taco seasoning mixture over and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken,walnut half,brown rice flour,chicken base,baking soda,white bread,brown lentil,halibut fillet
title: Medley Baked Halibut
ingredients: 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon brown rice flour | 1/2 cup dried split white bread, crumbs | 1/4 cup walnut halves ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons low-fat cooking fat | 2 teaspoons low-fat, low-sodium chicken base | 4 skinless halibut fillets | 1 cup fresh whole cooked brown lentils
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a mixing bowl, mix together baking soda, brown rice flour, crumbs, walnuts, and 2 tablespoons cooking fat until well combined. Place the halibut fillets in a casserole dish. Spread the crumb topping evenly over the fish. Bake 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork. Remove fish with a spatula, and place on platter. Serve lentils over the fish.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,asparagus spear,egg,butternut squash,celery root,halibut fillet,plain yogurt,maraschino cherry
title: Halibut Salad With Halibut
ingredients: 3 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 teaspoons finely chopped celery root | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh maraschino cherries | 4 hamburger fillets, cooked, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons fresh egg, fried and chopped | 8 ounces asparagus spears, trimmed, blanched | 24 thin slices halibut fillet | 1 ounce halibut fillet, from the mediterranean mediterranean grill, roughly chopped | 2 large butternut squash, ends trimmed, quartered ( about 8 oz total weight )
instructions: Make dressing by combining yogurt, celery root, cherries, hamburger, and eggs in a medium bowl. Cover and chill at least 2 hours. In another medium bowl, stir together asparagus, halibut, and halibut. Pierce squash, dividing among serving plates. Layer with hamburger mixture.

title: Greek Macaroni With Hazelnuts and Parmesan
ingredients: 500 g whole wheat macaroni | 1 cup shaved hazelnuts | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom, flakes
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Place macaroni in a large serving bowl, top with nuts. Top with parmesan. Sprinkle with cardamom flakes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,ajwain,mandarin orange segment,pinto bean,mustard seed,leg lamb,baking soda,chinkiang vinegar
title: Mandarin Orange Pulled Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 cup chinkiang vinegar | 1/4 cup dry mustard seeds | 1/2 cup ajwain ( chinese chili paste ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground ajwain | 1 leg of lamb, trimmed | 3 cans mandarin orange segments, drained | 4 cups canned pinto beans, drained
instructions: In a heavy pot, whisk vinegar, mustard seeds, ajwain, baking soda, vanilla extract and ajwain together. Place the lamb in the sauce, close fitting, and place in the microwave for 20 minutes, until the lamb is cooked and the juices run clear. Transfer the pan to a cutting board and let rest 5 minutes. Slice the lamb into 1 1/2 inch slices. Skim and discard the fat from the sauce. Discard any fat remaining and discard any bones that float to the surface of the sauce, and refrigerate the sauce. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease the casserole dish with cooking spray. Spread half of the orange segments over the bottom of the casserole dish. Place a piece each of the mandarin oranges and pinto beans on top of the orange in the dish, then spread the remaining orange slices over the top, placing orange slices in the center of the dish. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, then remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes, until the oranges are tender. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,lemon peel,cheddar cheese,puff pastry,chicken thigh,gruyere,palm sugar
title: Chef John's Chicken & Cheese Empanadas
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen puff pastry, thawed ( 2 sheets ) | 8 fluid ounces bottled clam juice | 8 ounces gruyere or 8 ounces shredded gruyere | 8 ounces shredded cheddar cheese | 8 ounces shredded monterey jack pepper cheese or 8 ounces cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 7 ounces shredded chicken thighs | 1 strip lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f, or as specified by your local storebought or italian bread maker. Pour clam juice in a baking dish large enough to take the chicken and shrimp out of the freezer when you take them out of the freezer. Let rest for 1 hour. Melt sugar in a small skillet over medium heat until melted. Remove from heat, and set aside. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Unwrap the spinach leaves from their stems, and cut off any tough stems. Place the fresh leaves on the parchment paper, and cut into thirds. Put about 2 tbls. Of the spinach in a skillet of water with the sugar, and bring to a boil. Boil gently for about 5 minutes or until the spinach wilts. Drain and set aside. Take a pastry bag fitted with a round tip, and add the shrimp. Shake off any excess water and carefully unfold it carefully, leaving enough pastry bag fluid for later use. Place about 1 1/2 oz of the shrimp into the bag, and allow it to squish around in the bag with your fingers. Shake off the excess shrimp, and set it aside. Put the other 1/2 oz shrimp in another skillet with the sugar and cook until pink. When it cooks, remove it from the skillet, but keep its juices. If it has separated before the shrimp has gone pink, throw it back into the skillet with the sugar and sugar. If the shrimp have become too brown, take a little oil or butter from the bottom of the skillet so that there is more oil or butter around it. Add a thin layer of the reserved shrimp juices, and a thin layer of the cheeses. Keep this filling going over and over. Cut off the excess pastry bag by inserting a piece or two of plastic wrap in the bag. Place 2 empanada sheets on a large, rimmed baking sheet lined with parchment, and top with the dough. Brush the perimeter of the empanada with some egg wash, then sprinkle with 3 tbs. Of each cheese. Roll up the empanada, starting from the bottom, and place in the prepared oven. Repeat, stacking the empanadas if you wish. Brush the top of the empanadas with a little more egg wash. Sprinkle tops with more cheese, and continue stacking until all the empanadas have been stacked and placed in the oven. Bake the empanadas under preheated broiler until golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sweet Corn and Lemongrass Salad
ingredients: 4 corn ( fresh or frozen, cleaned and cleaned ) | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup coconut ( shredded ) | 1 teaspoon fresh lemongrass ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup celery rib ( thinly sliced ) | 1/3 cup fontina cheese ( grated ) | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Cut the cob from the corn cob and cut into thin strips. Place corn, in a pan with a tight lid, and place it on the stove on medium heat and cover the corn with a lid to keep them from burning. After a few minutes, the corn will release its water. This may not happen, just keep stirring so it doesn't stick. Continue to cook for another 20 minutes. Dump in the cold corn and toss through the remaining ingredients in a serving bowl. You can use sweet corn if you would like, but it's better when you are able to find sweet corn.

Random Ingredients: black,rum,dijon mustard,baking chocolate,monterey jack cheese,italian tomato
title: Giant Rum and Baking Chocolate Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese or 1 cup swiss cheese | 8 tablespoons unsweetened baking chocolate | 2 tablespoons dijon-style mustard | 1 tablespoon rum | 1 can italian-style tomatoes ( with liquid, undrained ) | 1 dash pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f grease a 12 inch muffin tin. In a food processor or blender, place grated cheese, baking powder, mustard, rum and tomatoes through pepper and process until smooth and about twice the size of a hazelnut or hazelnut meal. Pour into cooled muffin tin hollows. Bake for 12 minutes or until lightly toasted.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut,red pepper,phyllo pastry,egg yolk,chipotle powder,serrano pepper,ziti pasta
title: Pastilla With Ziti
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | 4 ounces macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped | 1 serrano pepper, seeded, stemmed and finely chopped | 1 red pepper, seeded, stemmed and chopped | 1 tablespoon chipotle powder | 4 -4 tablespoons macadamia nuts | 3 -4 egg yolks | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes or 1/2 teaspoon chili powder, to taste
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the macadamia nuts, serrano peppers, red pepper, chipotle powder, and macadamia nut paste. Brush or spray the inside of a glass dish with cooking spray. Place the phyllo sheets on clean, dry surface and cut lengthwise about 2 - 3 inches in size. Stack 3 sheets on top of each other on top of one another. Brush with a little egg wash. Take one sheet of phyllo pastry and brush with some egg wash. Place another 1 phyllo sheet on top of the first sheet and brush with more egg wash. Repeat this 2 steps until all 4 sheets are used up. Place 1 generous teaspoon of ziti and 2 tablespoons of filling in the center of each pastry sheet. Top this with a sprinkle of macadamia nuts. Fold the pastry over so that it ends up in the pan. It should be almost as tightly packed as the first one. Use a very sharp knife or a very sharp knife on the knife that comes out clean. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Preheat the broiler. Slide a sharp knife around the perimeter of the pastry and slice through the pastry 1 1/2 times, making a 6 - 6 inch long slice on each side. The important thing to remember with this recipe it will take closer to 6 - 8 minutes for the ziti to be browned. Place the finished ziti in an oven safe casserole dish and set the pan of ziti in it on the broiler element. Broil for about 5 minutes or until bottom of crust is a light golden brown.

title: Chargrilled Veggies
ingredients: 3 small courgettes or 3 small zucchini | 1 sweet yellow pepper | 1 tablespoon coarse grainy mustard | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom, crushed
instructions: Trim the ends of the courgettes, and discard. Slice into rounds or rounds about 1 inch thick and then cut into 1 inch lengths. Place all the vegetables in a non stick frypan. Add the mustard and a pinch of salt, and toss to coat the vegetables. Cover the pan tightly and cook over a gentle heat for 15 - 20 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Add cardamom to the veggies and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cabbage kimchi,sazon goya seasoning,ketjap manis,kaffir lime leaf,vegetable oil,turmeric powder
title: Crispy Fried Kimchi
ingredients: 1 piece cabbage kimchi | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1/8 teaspoon sazon goya seasoning, to taste | 2 slices dried turmeric powder | 1 slice ketchapa manis ( soy bean paste ) | 1 teaspoon ketjap manis ( sweet soy sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Heat wok on high. Meanwhile, put the kimchi in the oil, stir fry about 3 - 4 minutes or until crispy and dark green. Pour over a little vegetable oil while still hot. Sprinkle with 1/8 tsp sazon and sprinkle with 1/8 tsp turmeric powder. Add the ketchapa manis and stir fry about 2 minutes. Now add in 1/2 tsp of ketchapa manis mixed together. Add a small amount of water. Cover and let boil until liquid evaporates. Turn down heat to low and add 1/2 tsp of turmeric powder. Stir for 2 minutes before removing lid and tossing the mixture. Variation, add 2 t vegetable oil to the pan and sauteed the kimchi until the outer part turns golden brown.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,oil black olive,paul newman spaghetti sauce,potato,spinach,olive,grape leaf
title: Pampered Chef Spinach and Nacho Olive Salad
ingredients: 250 g punnet grape leaves ( about 15 or 20 ) | 1 jarolive, pitted | 200 g punnet frozen spinach, chopped ( or 10 oz fresh spinach and 150 g fresh spinach ) | 100 g potato, boiled and sliced | 500 g gourmet fresh paul newman spaghetti sauce ( homemade or store bought ) | 5 tablespoons oil-cured black olive ( to taste ) | sliced green salad leaf
instructions: Drain the kalamata olives and finely chop them with your hands in a blender. You can skip this step if using frozen spinach and use half of the fresh spinach. Mix the olive oil and spaghetti sauce together in a small bowl and set aside. Heat a wok over medium heat and add a little oil. The amount depends on the wattage of the oil you have at hand, whether you have it high or low heat. Add the olive, chopped spinach and fresh spinach leaves then quickly stir fry with the wok lid closed until the spinach has wilted. Serve warm or at room temperature, garnished with sprigs of green salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: veal,cream chicken soup,nut,thai red curry paste,quinoa,balsamic vinegar
title: Balsamic Veal With Quinoa and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 package quinoa, washed | 3/4 lb boneless skinless veal, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup chopped nuts
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions, omitting any oil, drain. Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium high heat, cook the veal until it starts to brown, about 7 minutes, stirring to avoid browning. Add beef and vegetable. Stir. In a blender or food processor, pour broth over the quinoa. Blend until smooth. Return sauce to pan. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine soup and vinegar. Cook over medium heat until heated through. Add soup mixture to sauce. Cover and simmer 5 minutes, stirring gently.

title: Lentil Dip
ingredients: 1 can brown lentils | 3 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 1/2 teaspoon brown gingerroot, freshly grated | 1 -2 teaspoon tarragon
instructions: Drain your lentils of any juice and place in a food processor or blender. You will need to eyeball this, but you can do it from here. Add all ingredients and pulse until well incorported. Keep in your fridge, covered until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,italian salad dressing mix,ginger,red curry paste,serrano pepper,oat,spring onion
title: Thai Oat Curry
ingredients: 1 packet dried italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup fresh ginger, finely grated | 1/2 cup italian-style oat | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 1/2 small spring onion, finely diced ( i like to use frozen for garnish ) | 2 -3 serrano peppers, finely diced | 1 green bell pepper, cut into strips
instructions: Place italian dressing mix, 1/2 cup ginger juice and red curry paste into a bowl and set aside. Stir in remaining ingredients and let sit for 1 hour. Cook, at least 3 hours, refrigerated and covered with plastic wrap until ready to serve. Serve with cooked rice or fresh veggies.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,potato,cocoa powder,cooking spray,pimento,heavy whipping cream,spring onion
title: Mini Mashed Potatoes With Chocolate Ganache (Hungarian Breakfast)
ingredients: 2 lbs chat potatoes ( peeled, cut into 3/4 inch slices, then parboil gently ) | cooking spray | 3 cups low fat plain yogurt ( or regular greek yogurt ) | 1 bunch spring onion, washed and cut into 1-inch pieces ( about 1 1/4 cups ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | pimento, slivers ( optional garnish ) | cocoa powder, for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºf. Line a baking sheet with parchment or foil. Place ganache in a small bowl. In a medium bowl, mix potato slices with yogurt and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand at room temperature for about 10 minutes. Place potatoes in a large bowl. Drain well. In a small saucepan, heat cream to boiling. Remove from the heat and add pimentos and set aside. Spray an 8 to 9 inch round baking dish with cooking spray. Divide potatoes evenly among pans. Top with cream mixture. Sprinkle top with cocoa powder. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,farfalle pasta,almond meal,lasagna noodle,cocoa,sugar snap pea,cranberry
title: Lasagna With Chocolate, Sugar Snap Peas and Almonds
ingredients: 12 ounces lasagna noodles or 12 ounces wide egg noodles | 1 cup almond meal | 1/4 cup cocoa | 1 teaspoon sugar-free sugar free sweetened flaked coconut | 1/4 cup olive oil | 10 ounces frozen sweetened cranberries | 1 lb fresh farfalle pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 2 cups frozen sugar snap peas, thawed
instructions: Pour boiling water over a large pasta pan to a depth of 1/4 inch. Add almond meal, cocoa and sugar free sweetened flakes.

Random Ingredients: sultana raisin,onion,russet potato,beef bouillon,marshmallow,garam masala,red food coloring
title: Sweet Potato and Mushroom Curry
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes, peeled and grated as coarse as humanly possible | 1 medium onion, peeled, washed and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon, powder | 2 teaspoons red food coloring ( optional ) | 2 cups miniature marshmallows | 1/2 cup sultana raisin
instructions: Add 2 cups water to the grated potatoes and place on a large platter in layers in this order, 1/2 grated onion, 1/2 chopped onion, 1/4 chopped onion. 1 teaspoon garam masala, 1 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon powder, 2 tsp red food coloring, optional, marshmallows, and 1/2 cup sultanas to the grated onion. Repeat layers until the above mixture is gone. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sultana raisins over the top and allow to set before eating. Note, this can be served either hot or cold.

title: Thyme and Mango Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme ( chopped ) | salt, to taste | 1 grape leaf, for garnish
instructions: Place the chicken and marinade in a dish with a good pinch of salt. Leave for an hour, then take them out and put in some paper towels to dry a bit, then place back in the dish, and leave in the fridge until needed. Preheat the oven to 200c/400f/gas mark 6. Place the grape leave on the chicken, and sprinkle with salt. Place in the oven and roast, basting the chicken with the marinade for 30 - 40 minutes. The juices from the chicken should run clear. You can tell when it comes out the juices are starting to turn a dark red glaze on the chicken. When done, remove from the oven and put on its side on a plate to leave at least 10 minutes for the juices to run off. Strip the leaves off the stalks and slice the stalks into small pieces. Place the chicken on a serving dish and sprinkle with chutney, thyme and a good splash of grape leaves. You can also just add more of the roasted veggies to the pan for extra flavour.

title: Rice Dogs
ingredients: 4 hot dogs bun | 1 cup instant rice | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 dill pickle, sliced
instructions: Brown the dog, and place in a casserole dish. Stir in the instant rice, and coat the entire hot dog. Sprinkle with the cocoa and sprinkle with the pickle slices. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes, or until hot, or just slightly brown.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,halloumi cheese,wild rice,yellow squash,white wine,vodka,pumpkin puree
title: Mashed Pumpkin and Halloumi Soup
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled, diced into 3/8-inch cubes | 1 yellow squash, peeled and diced into 3/8-inch cubes | 1 cup dry white wine | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 pound pumpkin puree | 12 large halloumi cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 package wild rice
instructions: Place potatoes and yellow squash into a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, and cook until potatoes are tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Place potatoes and squash into a separate pot of boiling water over high heat and cook until the water is mostly evaporated. Remove from heat and let cool. Combine wine and vodka in a large pot over medium high heat, and bring to a boil. Cook until vodka is nearly evaporated, about 15 minutes. Combine pumpkin puree and cooked potatoes and squash in a food processor or blender and puree until smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Place cheese cubes in a bowl and add the soup. Mix to blend. Bring to a simmer over low heat.

title: Quickly Sausage and Farfalle (Rice, Beans, and Rice)
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice, uncooked ( i like to use jasmine ) | 1 lb farfalle pasta, cooked & drained
instructions: Prepare the farfalle noodles as directed, according to package directions. Drain and rinse the pasta according to package directions. In large pan sprayed with pam, brown sausages over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until heated through. Meanwhile, bring 9 cups water to a boil and add noodles. Cook rice for about 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente, drain and add to cooked farfalle. Garnish with finely chopped fresh parsley and freshly chopped scallions.

title: Potato and Walnut Crumble
ingredients: 1/2 lb baking potato | 1 cup frozen corn | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 1 cup chicken broth | cornmeal | dill, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cut potato in half and cook in boiling salted water for 5 minutes or until tender.

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 1 lb swiss cheese, grated | 1 lb brussels sprout, halved and trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to place oven rack on a wire rack. Spread grated swiss cheese all around the brussels sprouts. Place sprouts fat side up on rack, and put in oven for 15 minutes. Remove sprouts from oven, remove and pour out the excess oil. Return oven to 450 degrees f. Roast brussels sprouts for 20 - 25 minutes, or until dark brown and slightly tender. Serve immediately with warm french bread.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,beet,yellow onion,sun tomato,black bean,oyster sauce,sea salt pepper
title: Beef Satay With Bean Relish
ingredients: 3/4 lb beef satay steak or 3/4 lb australian satay steak, cut into strips | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | sea salt and pepper | 1 medium yellow onion, sliced thinly | 7 sun-dried tomatoes, very finely chopped | 12 dried black beans, soaked in hot water overnight, drained, and washed
instructions: Combine the dark soy and oyster sauces, season generously with salt and pepper. In a large shallow dish, add the strips of beef and coat with the marinade. Let stand while you prepare the relish. Heat the oil in a large non stick frying pan. Add the onion and saute for a minute. Add the sun dried tomatoes and black beans and cook, stirring all the time for 3 - 5 minute. Add the cooked beef and relish to the dish and toss it through the relish. Serve at once.

title: Basil Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 3 tablespoons fresh basil slices | 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Combine basil, cilantro, and chicken. Thread on skewers. Prepare grill or broiler. Grill or broil, 4 to 6 inches from heat, 3 to 4 minutes per side or until chicken is done.

title: Basic Nuts and Crispy Chips
ingredients: 125 g caster sugar | 400 g curry powder ( hot ones work best )
instructions: Place the sugar in a saucepan and add 600ml hot water. Sit over a medium high heat and bring up to a boil. Stir constantly until the sugar has completely melted and caramelised. Turn off the heat. Stir in the curry powder. Transfer to a greased and lined baking tray. Drain the crispy chips and leave in the fridge and allow to set up to 2 hours. Heat the remaining 250ml of hot water in a small saucepan over a low heat and stir until it starts to come to the boil. Pour into paper cases and leave in the fridge until set.

title: Pimento Potato Farina Rounds
ingredients: 225 g farina | 1 cup potato traditional | 1 teaspoon white sugar ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon diced pimento pepper ( optional )
instructions: Boil farina for a minute or so. Remove from heat. Add sugar and pepper. Mix together very well. Then form into 4 even round or oval sized pieces. Heat a non stick pan on medium high. Add a teaspoon or so of oil. Place the farina round into the pan using a circular spatula. Turn around every 30 seconds until golden brown. This is best done on high, about 3 minutes per side to ensure even browning. You can also place the farina in the refrigerator to cool and crisp up the potato.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,beef stock,peanut oil,soymilk,guacamole,black olive,black greek olive
title: Shredded Beef Gyros
ingredients: 4 medium black greek olives, pitted and sliced | 4 black greek olives, pitted and sliced | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1 cup soymilk ( or half and half ) | 8 beef top round roast, cut into 3/4-inch cube | 1/4 cup peanut oil ( optional ) | 1 cup beef stock | 1 cup black greek olive ( garnish )
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a crockpot and stir together well. Cover, cook on high for 3 hours.

title: Almond-Rye Bread
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 2 cups rye flour | 1 1/4 cups rice wine or 1 1/4 cups dry vermouth | 1/2 cup blanched almond
instructions: Heat 1 c water and the yeast to 100 degrees until the yeast foams. Let sit for 10 minutes, then combine with the 2 cups rye flour and 1 1/4 c of the sugar. Stir and knead for 10 minutes. Add in the remaining 1 cups rye flour and 1/2 c sugar and continue to knead on low until the dough is smooth, elastic and soft, about 20 minutes. Add in the blanched and sliced almonds and mix well. Let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, until doubled. Turn onto greased baking sheets. Knead lightly. Let rise for 5 minutes then remove. Cover and let rise 20 minutes. Brush with melted margarine or melted butter and slash with a cross. Let rise 20 more minutes. Bake at 300 degrees for about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,albacore tuna water,lime juice,spring onion,ketchup,stock chicken
title: Marinated Sausages With Roasted Squash-And-Albacore Tuna
ingredients: 2 -3 large yellow squash or 1 large savoy tomatoes | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup water | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice ( about 1 lime ) | 2 cans albacore tuna in water, drained | 1/2 cup finely chopped spring onion
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Slice each plum tomato in half lengthways but do not slice it too thickly cut each piece into 8 thin wedges. Place these slices on oven trays and pop them in the oven. Roast for 15 minutes, or until the tomatoes start to char. This will only take a couple of minutes at 400°f. Remove the trays from the oven. Strip the tomato leaves into smaller pieces. Place into a bowl. Combine the ketchup, water, lime juice and tuna in a saucepan. Bring to the boil. Keep warm. Heat the grill. Brush the sausages with some of the reserved tomato juices and grill them over low med heat for just 5 - 6 minutes. While cooking, place the squash and onion in a large mixing bowl with the ketchup and olive oil, salt and pepper and mix. Divide mixture between the four sausages and place on a baking sheet. Sprinkle lightly with salt. Place into the oven for 25 - 30 minutes, or until the tops are golden and the squash is tender. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes. This dish can also be served with other dishes.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,green capsicum,yukon gold potato,coconut,black eyed pea
title: Haddock Packets With Potato Rosti #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, halved | 2 cans black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 small green capsicum, chopped | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning, divided | 1 1/4 cups finely shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400º. Heat a large non stick frypay pan on medium heat. Add the potatoes, saute for 5 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile pour black eyed peas into the pan and mix in 2 tablespoon of the cajun seasoning and keep stirring. Season with salt and pepper. Pour the contents of the remaining can of black eyed peas in with potatoes. Toss lightly and transfer potato mixture onto a plate. Place tray in the oven. Cook for 30 - 35 minutes or until the mixture is crispy and vegetables are tender. Serve with the coconut.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,spaghetti,italian turkey sausage,red onion,rice noodle,pecorino romano cheese,creamy peanut butter
title: Spicy Noodle Salad With Hot Buttered Sausages
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot italian sausage, casings removed | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil or 1/4 cup peanut butter, creamy substitute | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese or 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | cooked spaghetti or linguine, cooked | hot cooked rice noodles, cooked or hot cooked regular-grain egg noodles, with dressing | red onion, sliced
instructions: Remove casings from sausage. Slice. Place hot sausage in small to medium nonstick skillet. Add olive oil or peanut butter, cooking until browned, about 2 minutes per side. Remove from skillet. Place cheese in small bowl. Stir into hot sauce. Let sit 5 minutes, then stir in cheese. Cover to keep warm. Toss with cooked noodles and onions. Serve hot. Serve warm with crisp bread or crackers. You may substitute other kinds of pasta for the cooked pasta.

title: Baked Beef Shoulder
ingredients: 1 2 lbs lamb shoulder or 2 lbs lamb shoulder, tied at 1-inch intervals to hold together. rub salt and pepper on all sides of meat. place meat in a roasting pan. cover tightly with aluminium foil. add water and bring to a boil. reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, or until meat thermometer registers 110 degrees and internal lamb temperature is 140 degrees. transfer meat to carving board and let rest for 15 minutes before carving into thin 1 in
instructions:
Name:- ##
 Baked Beef Shoulder

 1 - 2 lbs lamb shoulder or 2 lbs lamb shoulder, tied at 1-inch intervals to hold together. Rub salt and pepper on all sides of meat. Place meat in a roasting pan. Cover tightly with aluminium foil. Add water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, or until meat thermometer registers 110 degrees and internal lamb temperature is 140 degrees. Transfer meat to carving board and let rest for 15 minutes before carving into thin 1 inch thick slices.

title: Guilt-Free Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup minced green chutney
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and heat throughly. May take an hour to flavors meld. Serve and enjoy.

title: Watermelon Salsa Verde
ingredients: watermelon | 3 medium anaheim chilies | 1 can mexican-style crushed tomatoes | 1 teaspoon lemon peel | 3 tablespoons water
instructions: Cut the rind off a large melon, cutting all of the way through the flesh, leaving about 2 long pieces. Cut each section into 4 quarters. Cut the melon halves into chunks. Cut the rind into thin strips. Cut the chilies into quarters. Add the tomatoes, lemon peel and water to the melon halves in a large covered saucepan, and bring to a boil. Cover and cook over medium heat for 20 - 25 minutes, or until the flesh is soft. Serve warm.

title: Pound-Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 cups bread flour ( or a combination of bread flour and white flour ) | 1/2 cup cold salad oil | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Place the bread flour in a shallow bowl. Dip chicken through flour to coat, shaking off excess. If there are any excess flour, add some. Place chicken in the flour. Heat 1/4 inch olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Working in batches, cook chicken for five minutes per side or until it reaches desired doneness. Drain chicken on paper towels, and serve warm.

title: Peaches with Spicy Prawns and Radish!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 4 medium ripe peaches | 8 ounces prawns or 8 ounces king prawns | 2 medium chilis | 1/2 pint double cream | 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts, chopped | radish
instructions: Slice the prawns or king prawns into long, thin strips, and place in a glass bowl. Peel the chillies and remove the seeds. Halve the peaches lengthwise, scoop out the flesh and coarsely chop them. Cut the chilis lenghtwise, scrape out the seeds and finely chop them. Pour the cream into a frying pan and bring to to a boil. When it is boiling add the ginger paste and stir to combine, and then add the grated prawns or king prawns. Bring back to the boil and immediately lower the heat. The prawns may still be a bit firm at first, but it will soften, when it is cooked. While they are cooking, clean the leaves. Remove the prawns either with a knife or fork, or carefully remove the shells in their heads and pith. Then place them in a single layer on absorbent paper on a flat oven tray. Take the prawns into a pan of boiling water and boil until cooked but not cooked all the way through. Drain the prawns, rinse and dry and then drain again. When they are all cooked, gently heat the cream and when it starts to boil, add the prawn mixture. Keep at a boil until the cream starts to thicken, about 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in the chopped peanuts. Arrange on a serving tray, garnish with chopped radish, and enjoy.

title: Italian Sausage and Sour Cherry Sausage Jam
ingredients: 1 jar sweet italian sausage | 1 lb fresh sour cherry, cherry size | 1 -2 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 -2 teaspoon cumin seed, if using jar | 1 large chopped jalapeno | 1 quart raspberries or 1 quart strawberry, chopped
instructions: Heat to boiling point add italian sausages and cover. Let sausage and sugar melt. Mix sour cherries, garlic powder and cumin seeds in jellypot. Drain sausage mix well and pour over the sausages. Bring to boiling point and reduce heat to simmer. You want the fruit to burst apart but not break apart. Simmer for 40 minute remove the cover and turn heat low. Simmer for 15 minute then turn heat to low and continue to simmer for another 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let set for 10 minutes then break apart. Stir in berries and serve. Enjoy.

title: Roasted Plantains, Sticks and Corn
ingredients: 2 plantains, sliced | 2 ears baby corn, sliced
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees f. Place sliced plantains into a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Cover and put in the oven. Roast for about 20 minutes. Drain. In a casserole dish, place the baby corn slices over the plantains.

title: Peach N Lentils With Wasabi
ingredients: 8 ounces brown lentils, washed and picked over | 2 -3 tablespoons wasabi paste | 2 small ripe peaches, peeled, pitted and chopped, as much as desired ( optional )
instructions: Place the lentils in a large pan and pour enough water in the pan to cover them completely. Bring to the boil, add enough water to cover them by at least one inch, and then bring the water back to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and partially cover the pan with a lid or blanket. Allow to simmer very gently, until tender, about 20 to 25 minutes. If necessary, mix a piece of plastic wrap over the pan, just enough to prevent sticking. When ready, remove the lid and sprinkle over the chopped peaches. Mash the lentils with the wasabi paste and check the seasoning and serve.

Random Ingredients: dressing,cauliflower,wax paper,achiote paste,pizza sauce,chicken fillet,sunflower seed
title: Peruvian Style Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 chicken fillets | 3 cups cauliflower | 3 tablespoons achiote paste | 1 cup pizza sauce ( preferably home made ) | wax paper | sunflower seeds | dressing
instructions: Cook chicken and cauliflower in olive oil with achiote paste until cooked, then chill. Boil pasta in salted water till tender. Drain in a colander. Place pasta on plates. Top with a layer of cauliflower and chicken salad. Sprinkle with sunflower seeds.

title: Cashew Roast Vegetables
ingredients: 600 -700 g russet potatoes, peeled and halved | 1 large courgette, cut into long thin segments | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cashew nuts, shelled | 1/2 teaspoon sweet paprika
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/400f/gas mark grease and line the inside and outside of a large roasting dish. Place the potatoes, courgette, cashew nuts and sweet paprika in a large bowl and mix thoroughly. Toss the vegetables in the marinade to coat evenly. Cover the dish snugly and place in the preheated oven and cook for 1 1/2 hours, tossing the vegetables every 15 minutes or so, until they are tender and crisp.. Remove the vegetables from the oven, cover, and leave to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Fried Mushrooms (Chicharrones Com Salsa Verde)
ingredients: 2 cans bamboo shoots, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mace
instructions: Cut the bamboo shoots in half if they are small, remove the stem and pith around the edge of each half. Cut into cubes. instructions: Thinly slice beef and remove fat. Stir in sliced almonds on unpeeled end. Split up thinly and place 1 tablespoon of beef filling and 1/2 teaspoons dill on beef and roll up tightly. title: Raspberry Bean Stew

instructions: Wash and hull the raspberries and rinse them well under running water. Pour boiling water over them to blanch and stop the cooking. Put the raspberries and chickpeas in a pan with 1/2 cup sugar, cover and cook very gently over medium low heat for approximately 5 minutes and then allow to cool. In a mixing bowl, place 1 cup flour in a small mound and then make a well in the centre and carefully begin pouring 1/4 cup sugar in with the flour. Add the cherries and raspberries to the raspberries and mix well, stirring gently, but being careful not to break them up too much. If the mixture is too liquid, add more sugar and/or flour as needed. Add about 1/4 cup flour to get a smooth mixture. If the mixture is too dry, add more flour. Place the mixture into a small crock. Cover and cook over low heat for about 15 minutes, or until the mixture thickens a little. Serve hot, with bread. Store in tightly covered tin foil or wrap and store in the refrigerator.

Grill under preheated grill for 5 minutes or until browned and easily pierced with a knife. Cut the chicken tenderloins into 4 equal pieces, each equal 2 thick. Place the chicken tenderloins on a cutting board, flatten the chicken and place them between sheets of wax paper and flatten out. Repeat with the remaining chicken and vegetable pieces. Grill the chicken tenderloins over direct high heat until browned and crispy, 8 to 10 minutes per side.

title: Shrimp Creole II
ingredients: 1 pound fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined | 12 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | creole seasoning to taste
instructions: Grind shrimp and eggs together in a blender. Place a tablespoon of the shrimp mixture in the center of each shrimp egg.

title: The Tornado - Grilled Lobster
ingredients: 4 large lobster meat or 1 1/2 lbs shrimp, peeled if necessary | 2 ounces lobster meat | 2 ounces caster sugar | 4 slices of fried red onions | 1/4 cup chopped almonds | 2 ounces good quality tequila
instructions: Rinse the lobster, dry on paper towels. Cut into large chunks. Cut the lobster into thick slices. Heat a small frying pan on the stove and grease it for easy searing. Put some of the oil in the pan and fry the onions till transparent over a medium heat. Add the lobster, sugar, tequila, black pepper and salt to taste and turn down the heat. Cover until the lobster just turns opaque, about 5 minutes. Spoon the lobster mixture into a serving dish, sprinkle over the red onion and almonds and serve. Mangian cuisine insists that a serving dish does not need to be placed, but in my opinion the tortilla can be warmed over a medium heat and served on a warmed plate with little dishes of raw mango and fresh fruits and a few fresh shrimps.

Random Ingredients: meat,thyme,mustard seed,white pepper,garam masala,cheddar cheese,celery,white rice
title: Ace's Easy Microwave Rice
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice, chilled ( i used basmati ) | 1/2 - 2/3 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon celery, chopped | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme ( i just put it in a spice mill for a better texture. yeah, you can use fresh if you like ) | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Place all ingredients in a microwave proof glass casserole or other microwaveable dish. Sprinkle in spice to taste and microwave on high for 1 minute. Stir and cover with lid or plastic wrap for 15 - 20 minutes to allow steam to escape. Fluff with fork and dig in.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,greek yogurt,turmeric,bread crumb,white vinegar,cream coconut,half,ketchup
title: Creamy French Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream of coconut | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/2 cup light sour cream or 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 2 cups seasoned bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Pour cream of coconut into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake coconut on middle rack of oven about 15 minutes, until golden brown. Turn oven off. Pour tomatoes and green chilies into a bowl.

title: Rosemary Gruyere Crackers
ingredients: 1 lb gruyere, grated or 1 lb emmenthaler cheese | 2 teaspoons rosemary sprigs | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: In a bowl stir together the cheese until well blended. Stir in the rosemary. Shape into 1 inch balls and press flat on a sheet of waxed paper. Cover and refrigerate while preparing the rest of the crackers. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spray cookie sheets with nonstick cooking spray. Remove and sprinkle 1 tsp of flour onto each crumb. Bake 10 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer to a wire rack and cool. Repeat with remaining crumbs. Store in a tightly covered container.

title: Poke Puffs (Apple Fritters)
ingredients: 2 apples, peeled, cored, and finely grated | 2 tablespoons olive ( can also use other vegetable oil ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: To make the puffs, scoop out the cores and the inner skin from the apples, and then discard. Place the apples in a bowl, along with the grated apple, and mash thoroughly. Add the olive oil and baking soda, and mix well. Drop small tablespoons of the mixture onto hot nonstick griddle and cook until browned. Turn the fritters over, and repeat the mash and bake process.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,black bean,red wine,pasilla pepper,rice flour
title: Bean Chip Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour | 1/2 cup corn tortilla chips | 1 can black beans | 1/2 cup red wine | 2 teaspoons fresh red peppers, minced
instructions: Place the rice flour in a bowl and blend in the tortilla chips. Spread 1/2 can of black beans in the middle of a tortilla chip and top with red pepper. Fold the tortilla chips in half. Repeat for each tortilla chip. Grill over medium coals for 5 - 6 minutes until soft.

title: Spicy Chickpea Patties
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon white sesame seed
instructions: Drain and mash chickpeas with cornstarch to thicken sauce. Add white sesame seeds. Shape into patties about 3/4 inch in diameter.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,pistachio nut,lime zest,baking potato,green salsa
title: Cotle Green Sweet Potato Rounds
ingredients: 6 baking potatoes, peeled | 1 cup green salsa, or more to taste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons grated cotija cheese | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1/2 cup finely chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Place potatoes into a large pot of cold water.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,bacon bit,green lentil,kale,leek,cider vinegar
title: Lentil & Leek Hash
ingredients: 1 lb green lentils | 2 cups leeks | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon dry onion soup mix | 1 -2 cup fresh kale | 2 -3 slices bacon bits, to taste
instructions: Rinse and drain lentils and leeks. Chop fine. In a casserole dish mix lentils, leeks, cider vinegar, onion soup mix, and kale. Cover tightly and cook for 1 hour at 300 degrees. Add bacon bits and cook for an additional 15 - 60 minutes. Variation, use 2 tbsp diced rind of leek for each serving.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,mexican oregano,pepper,coconut,muenster cheese,celery,tagliatelle pasta noodle,onion powder
title: Cheesy Cabbage Tagliatelle
ingredients: 1 large head of cabbage | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1 tablespoon chopped onion powder | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 8 ounces mexican style shredded muenster cheese | 1 package tagliatelle pasta noodles | 2 tablespoons shredded unsweetened coconut
instructions: Core cabbage and cut in half lengthwise. Toss with onion powder, oregano pepper and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover and set aside overnight in refrigerator.
