Boil pasta until al dente drain and rinse with cold water. Meanwhile, heat oven to 350 degrees. Remove outer outer leaves from cabbage, leaving 1/2 inch of head left. Stack leaves, remove core. Cut in half and discard. Remove core then slice into 1/2 inch wide strips. In a bowl, mix cheese and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Set aside. Arrange strips of cabbage on a large, flat surface. Top with cheese mixture all around and around the edge. Fold the outer leaves in half, leaving a small wall around the cheese mixture. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Pour ½ cup water into a shallow baking dish. Spread macaroni and tofu evenly in the dish. Cover with remaining cheese mixture. Dot with half of coconut. Bake 20 minutes, until cheese is bubbly and browned.

title: Moroccan-Style Salmon
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 1/2 cup packed fresh basilmati rice | 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets, skinned | 1/2 cup capicola
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Sprinkle the oregano leaves and anise seeds on top of the rice. Place the salmon pieces, skin side down, on top of the rice. Spoon 1 tablespoon of water onto the top of each salmon piece. Cover with foil. Bake for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, rinse the basil under cold water. Drain. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of water. When it boils, add the capicola, cover, and cook for 5 minutes. Pour the water over the salmon, cover, and bake for 7 minutes. Turn the broiler on. Remove the foil, place the pan under the broiler and broil salmon for 8 minutes, or until tender. To serve, top with a slice of salmon.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,anchovy paste,vodka,chili pepper flake,brown sugar
title: Pete's Hot Vodka
ingredients: 1 cup balsamic vinegar | 12 anchovy paste, packed | 1/2 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/4 tablespoon vodka
instructions: For the syrup, in a saucepan, bring the vinegar, anchovies, brown sugar, chili flakes and vodka to a boil. Once the sugar melts, remove from heat. Ladle the warm syrup into a small jar, and cover with lid. Let this mixture rest for 12 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,dark chocolate,green cardamom,chili pepper flake,caster sugar,mango,onion powder,wheat flour
title: Low Fat No Bake Mango Chutney Bars
ingredients: 1 medium whole ripe mango, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet chili pepper flakes, from a mild chillies or 1 1/2 tablespoons sriracha chili powder | 2 1/2 tablespoons caster sugar or 2 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 100 g dark chocolate, grated ( i use 70 grams ) | 2 pinches of toasted green cardamom, to decorate ( optional )
instructions: Place the mango flesh in a small food processor and process until smooth. Transfer mixture into a large mixing bowl, add the chilli, sugar, salt, onion powder, flour and cardamom, and stir until all have combined well. Press mixture all the way into lined 26cmx22cm slice pan. Chill for at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f/190 degrees c, and scatter the chocolate over the top in a thin decorative swirl. Bake for about 25 minutes until the chocolate has melted and has risen up in the centre. Leave in the oven for 5 - 10 minutes more, just to heat through. Remove the slice from the pan, and cut into squares to serve. If desired, you can use a spoon or two of jam to smooth it out a bit. These bars are good drizzled over any favourite vegetable or fruit or even with salads.

title: Onion Gravy
ingredients: 1 1/2 packages dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup butter | 1/4 cup sparkling water
instructions: Cook onion soup mix in the boiling water for 5 to 10 minutes or until soften. Strain out the solids. Melt butter in a small fry pan or saucepan.

title: Robust Lobster Rice Salad with Ginger
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, finely cored and chopped | 1 cup mayonnaise ( i use miracle whip ) | 2 teaspoons dried ginger, minced | 3/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 1/2 cups cooked arborio rice | 20 cooked lobster tails, cooked ( reserve juice )
instructions: Steam cabbage, removing coarse outer leaves, about 10 minutes, or until cabbage is crisp tender. In another bowl, combine mayonnaise, ginger, poultry seasoning and rice. Toss cabbage with dressing. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,pearl barley,rice vinegar,pineapple juice
title: Quick Hawaiian Barley Pilaf
ingredients: 1/4 cup pearl barley | 3 cups unsweetened pineapple juice | 1 cup rice vinegar | 1 whole black cardamom pod
instructions: Place the pearl barley and pineapple juice into a pot and cover with the water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer about 30 minutes, or until barley is tender and is mushy. Drain and discard the bones. Transfer the cooked barley to a bowl, and add the vinegar and cardamom. Mix the mixture thoroughly using a fork. Set aside at room temperature until cold, or until serving.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,red wine vinegar,cinnamon sugar mixture,peach,cantaloupe,onion soup mix,sirloin
title: Peach Melrose Beef Burger
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin | 1 cup bottled sweet onion soup mix ( like kitchen bouquet or mix o ) | 7 1/2 ounces italian seasoning | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup peaches | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon sugar mixture | 1 cup cantaloupe ( optional )
instructions: In skillet brown meat on both sides. Sprinkle with soup mix, italian seasoning, vinegar and peaches. Cover and cook til meat is hot. Serve with melrose fries and salad or tofutti.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,plain white flour,pork shank,filling,ginger,orange blossom water,lamb stock,lemon extract
title: Scotch Sausages
ingredients: 250 g fresh egg noodles | 300 g ground lamb or 300 g beef | 2 tablespoons fresh grated ginger | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water | 1 tablespoon plain white flour | 300 ml lamb stock | 1 carton lamb stock | 1 carton egg noodles | 12 teaspoons lemon extract
instructions: Preheat a large frying pan. Put the sausages, ginger, orange blossom liquid, flour, stock and egg noodles into a large bowl and knead together until smooth and well combined. Dip the sausages into the batter then leave to stand for about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the lamb, stock and lemon extract in a pan and bring to the boil. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the noodles according to the packet instructions. Drain them, then put the cooked noodles into a large warm bowl, pour over the lamb mix and toss to coat. Drain the sausages through a sieve then return the remaining batter. To serve, cut into thick, thin sausage shapes and eat with your hands.

title: Brown Rice - Mexican Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup brown rice, cooked | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Rinse lettuce in colander and drain well, about 1/4 cup dry. Dice lettuce. Toss lettuce, rice and optional spice, if desired, in a bowl with dressing. Cover loosely and refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving. Serves.

Random Ingredients: mace,vegetable stock,tomato soup,vital wheat gluten,provolone cheese,corn tortilla
title: Homemade Vegetarian Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon ground mace | 1/4 tablespoon sliced fresh mace | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetarian instant polenta or 1 1/2 tablespoons vital wheat gluten | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 12 corn tortillas or 12 flour tortillas, cut into 1 1/2-inch strips about 2-3 inches long | 1 cup reduced sodium reduced fat tomato soup | 2 provolone cheese or 1 cup goat cheese
instructions: Finely grind 2 teaspoons of mace and 1 teaspoon of ground mace together in a spice or coffee grinder. Add 1 1/2 tablespoons of vegetable stock and grind 1/2 teaspoons of mace into a fine powder. You want the mixture to have the same intensity of porridge. In a deep pan, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of vegetable stock over medium heat. When hot, place the tortilla strips, one at a time in the pan. Brown on each side, remove, and set aside. Add the vegetarian soup, 1 cup or 1 1/4 pounds of cheese to the pan, and stir to combine, then add the rest of the milk and continue heating until hot. Sprinkle the rest of the mace or ground mace over the soup and toss to combine. Heat through and serve.

title: Curried Green Beans and Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens ( whole, with bone ) | 1/2 cup molasses | 2 1/2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 can green beans ( drained ) | 2 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Add all ingredients, except the greens, to a roasting pan, including seasoning packet and mix well. Bring to a boil, then place in oven. Bake for 55 - 60 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and is tender. To serve, cut into pieces and toss with salad dressing.

title: Baked Ranch Sausages With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 4 -8 medium sausages ( i use johnsonville ) | 1 package hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 2 -3 tablespoons butter ( or margarine ) | 2 tablespoons pickled mustard ( i recommend dijon ) | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 handful pistachios, coarsely chopped ( or peanuts, if you like ) ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons spring onions, thinly sliced ( green onion )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Melt butter in a 10 x 15 inch baking dish. Pour in hidden valley ranch dressing mix and spread evenly over sausages. Add a handful of pistachios and some green onions. Sprinkle the rest of the peanuts or peanuts on top. Cover with foil and bake for 2 hours. Remove foil and sprinkle the remaining onions on top. Bake for another 15 minutes to brown the onions. Serve over cooked fettuccine or other fresh vegetables. Optional, you may bake these in an ovenproof skillet, adding paprika or salt to the filling, as garnish. If you bake them, remove the foil after 10 minutes, sprinkle the paprika mixture on top and cook for another 15 minutes, until crispy and hot.

Random Ingredients: salt,white wine,potato reg,puff pastry,sauce,pearl barley,french fry
title: French Fries With Barley and Potato #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets ( defrosted according to package directions ) | 4 -6 tablespoons hot sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/3 cup white wine | 1/4 cup water | 2 teaspoons steak seasoning or 2 teaspoons a1 | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Thaw puff pastry sheets according to package directions. Spread a small amount of hot sauce on the cut frozen puff pastry, or roll out and unroll from each pastry strip using a rolling pin. Arrange in a 9x13 inch baking dish that has been lightly sprayed with nonstick cooking spray or lightly butter both sides of pastry. Bake in preheated 450 fahrenheit oven for 10 minutes. While still warm, sprinkle a little more hot sauce over the top and continue baking until pastry is puffed and golden, approximately 12 to 20 minutes. Let cool, then transfer the entire baking dish to a cutting board and cut through each end to make 1/2 inch wide fries. Serve in warmed bowls with more hot sauce, if desired. Yield, about 5 servings.

title: Vinegar Cheesy Matzo Balls
ingredients: 500 g dry lasagna noodles, uncooked | 500 g american cheese, cubed ( i like kraft white brand ) | 4 onions, sliced | 3 -4 tablespoons dried chervil or 3 -4 tablespoons chives | 1 tablespoon ground xanthan gum | 3 tablespoons matzo meal or 3 tablespoons cornmeal
instructions: Dice the american cheese into medium chunks. Saute the american cheese and onions in olive oil over medium heat until the cheeses are completely melted. In a separate fry pan, toast matzo meal, mixing in a pinch of salt into the matzo meal, or add the yolk of 1/4 cup water or milk and mix. Cook matzo meal and matzo until it has thickened. Drain excess liquid from matzo meal. Add cheese mixture and cheese to the matzo meal, mix well and then allow mixture to cool. The dough should be slightly elastic. If too soft and sticky, add some water. Using a teaspoon, scoop out about 3 tablespoons of dough and roll into balls. Place meatballs on an ungreased baking sheet, and cover with more matzo on top. Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees celcius for 25 minutes. Let cool and enjoy.

title: Green Chili Balls
ingredients: 10 -12 ounces sweet mexican cheese ( grated ) | 1 can green chilies ( chopped ) | 1/2 inch gingerroot ( minced ) | 12 ladyfingers ( cut into small squares ) | toasted breadcrumb | chili
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients into a ball. Roll into crumbs, and coat with bread crumbs. Spray an electric frying pan with gf spray coating pan on medium. Place on medium high heat. Cook, turning once until all sides are golden brown.

title: Baked Sea Bass With Cabbage and Cabbage Apples
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, shredded | 2 sea bass fillets, cut into 3 equal pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Lay half the cabbage on a rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with about 1/4 cup of water, spreading evenly. Sprinkle with salt. Bake cabbage until outer leaves are pliable, beginning to darken, about 15 minutes. Lay one piece of sea bass on top, leaving a 2in border around the edges. Repeat with remaining sea bass and cabbage. Brush fish with remaining 1/4 cup of water. Cover with foil and bake until fish is just cooked through, about 20 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,wonton wrapper,purpose flour,beef bouillon cube,cumin
title: Taco Fumet (Fumet Bread Rings)
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon cube | 1 package wonton wrappers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a food processor, combine the flour, cumin, kosher salt, and beef bouillon cube.

title: Cherry Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs frying chickens | 2 lbs ground marshmallows | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/4 cup sherry
instructions: Remove neck and giblets from chicken. Using a sharp knife, cut a 1/2 to 3/8 incision through the chicken, along the length of the meat. Open out the breastbone, cutting along the bone. Remove the ribs and wing bones. Cut the chicken into serving pieces. Remove the meat from the bones. Using a spoon, mix marshmallow, icing sugar and sherry well. Spread over chicken pieces. Wrap the chicken pieces in aluminium foil, securing with string. Refrigerate overnight. Heat oven to 325°f. Bake, basting frequently until chicken is cooked to your taste.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,egg white,lobster meat,beef broth,orange zest,rice wine
title: Cheese-filled Lobster Rissoles
ingredients: 2 cans lobster meat, drained | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 cup beef broth | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Mix eggs, rice wine and orange peel in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,cannellini bean,pizza sauce,kalamata olive,celery seed
title: Crock Pot Italian Style Beef - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket ( cut in 1-inch slices ) | 1 can cannellini beans ( undrained ) | 1 jar pizza sauce | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 cup kalamata olive, sliced
instructions: Place brisket in bottom of crock pot. Top with cannellini beans. Pour pizza sauce over beans. Sprinkle celery seed over top. Cover and cook on high 4 hours. Remove lid.

title: Tomato and Pecan Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup unpeeled plum tomato, sliced horizontally | 1/2 cup pecans, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup cold water | 1 cup soft bread, crusts removed | 2 tablespoons fresh orange peel, grated | 2 cups water | 24 snow peas
instructions: Place tomatoes, pecans, and 1/2 cup water in an ovenproof bowl and toss to combine. Cover and bake at 350°f for 20 minutes, stirring once or twice. Remove from oven. Stir bread, orange peel, and 2 cups water into tomatoes. Increase oven temperature to 400°f top crumble with pecans. Drizzle soup with remaining 1 cup water. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes or until toasted.

title: Seared Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 orange, zest of, 1-inch long, finely grated | 6 sprigs fresh sage, finely chopped | 1/3 cup mango chutney | 1 thai chile, finely sliced
instructions: Place the orange zest, juice, sage and chilies in a shallow, non reactive, nonreactive pan. Heat over medium to low heat until hot but not smoking. Cook, stirring, until the sage is fragrant and aromatic, about 10 seconds. Remove from the heat and stir in the chutney. Cool to room temperature, then chill. Note,. Stir in one tablespoon of water until the chili is warm to the touch, but not boiling. If you are worried about the heat, add a few drops of water now, and allow to cool completely before stirring in more hot. You can do this in a mortar and pestle if preferred.

title: Easy Classic French Family Cookies
ingredients: 500 g ladyfingers | 150 g shredded grated gouda cheese | 125 g grated gouda cheese | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 cup crouton ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: First, cream the cheese until creamy. Add the cheeses and a little bit of vanilla. Then put the ladyfingers in a bowl and put around 150g of cheese with the edges on top. Now pour some croutons on one side and flip it so they're all good and covered with a little less cheese. Press down with a spatula so it kind of settles out. After you’ve seen pictures of croutons that come out of the bowl, it is time to put the cookies on the cookies. Put in a cookie tin that's been lined with baking paper and put in the oven until the tops are golden brown. This should take about 15 minutes depending on your oven. Take out from oven and let cool for 5 minutes. Then transfer onto a wire rack and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,beef bouillon cube,spring onion,picante sauce,curry paste,green grape
title: Curried Golden Onions With Green Grapes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons paprika curry paste | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 500 g green grapes, halved | 3 spring onions, thinly sliced | 2 beef bouillon cubes, crushed | 1 bottle picante sauce, preferably medium
instructions: Place the paprika, sugar, grapes, and spring onions in a glass bowl and pour boiling water over them to cover. Leave in the fridge for 10 minutes. Drain, remove the onions and cut in half lengthways. Place in a pan with the bouillon cubes and leave to bubble gently for 10 minutes. Stir in the picante sauce and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Serve at once as the grapes are tender.

title: Basic Batter for Bread Loaf from Mr. Mountain and Betty Gersten
ingredients: 1 cup chopped ham | 1 3/4 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl of a bread machine. Start. Take out of the machine and add the ingredients into the machine. Process on the bread setting, light crust and basic white bread setting, medium crust setting for 3 - 5 hours.

title: Fajitas Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cilantro and fajita green parts | 1 tablespoon red pepper paste | 1 bottle hot sauce
instructions: In a medium bowl, blend cilantro and fajita green parts with red pepper paste, hot sauce, and beer to taste.

title: Hemp Aux Poins (Baked Green Beans)
ingredients: 2 cups green beans, cut in half lengthwise | 1 -2 teaspoon apricot jam or 1 -2 teaspoon strawberry jam | 1/3 lb bacon, cut into 1/2 inch dice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place green beans on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper that has been lined with several layers of paper towels. Sprinkle sugar, if using, over the top of beans, tossing the beans to coat evenly. Bake uncovered about 40 minute. Turning once. Bake uncovered about 30 minute longer or until beans are just tender.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,jam,bicarbonate soda,peanut butter,heavy whipping cream,tomato juice
title: Netta Bar (Venezuelan Peanut & Jam Jam Bar)
ingredients: 1 lb jam, jam | 4 ounces prosciutto, chopped | 3 tablespoons peanut butter, softened | 1 cup heavy whipping cream, whipped until it slightly thickens | 3 tablespoons bicarbonate of soda | 2 cans tomatoes with juice
instructions: To make pickled tomatoes, put first 5 ingredients in a food processor fitted with metal blade and process until pureed, stopping once or twice. Drain. Stir tomatoes with juice and bicarb into peanut butter and mix well. If using an air tight can, let it stand for 10 minutes. If using a jar, let stand for 4 minutes. Fill a jar with hot water. Bring water to a boil and add half the jar of tomato mixture. Cover and lower heat to simmer. Simmer for about 45 minutes. Remove from heat and leave for 15 minutes. If using a jar, let cool for 15 minutes and then remove lid. Store in the fridge until jam has set, up to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,red wine vinegar,olive oil,gingerroot,bacon dripping,honey
title: Sweet Red Wine Vinegar Glaze for Beef or Chicken
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs tender cut beef or 4 -5 lbs chicken | 3 cups good quality coconut cream | 1 cup red wine vinegar | 1 cup honey | 4 -5 tablespoons gingerroot, shredded | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: Mix vinegar, honey, and ginger together in a bowl. Cut meat into serving sized pieces that will fit onto slow cooker. Mix the coconut cream and red wine vinegar mixture together then pour over the meat. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. Remove meat from slow cooker, place on plate and sprinkle with more sugar. To make glaze, heat olive oil in a pan, and saute gingerroot. Remove ginger and add back to slow cooker. Pour on the glaze and stir. Serve with boiled or mashed potatoes and your favourite pasta.

title: Creamy Scallions
ingredients: 7 scallions, sliced thin | 2 tablespoons sherry | 4 tablespoons unsweetened soymilk or 4 tablespoons milk | 2 ounces white breadcrumbs
instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor and process to desired consistency. Serve warm over bread or toast.

title: Chinese Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 6 cups chinese cabbage, chopped | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 3 teaspoons catsup | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 head salami, cooked, chopped | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 lb raw chocolate, broken into pieces
instructions: Place cabbage in a saucepan of boiling water.

title: Green Coleslaw and Noodles
ingredients: 1 package noodles, any flavor | 3 cups cabbage, thinly-sliced | 1 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 cup green olives, sliced, drained | 1/2 cup green olives, sliced, drained | 1/4 cup napa cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup green cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine next two ingredients. Top with noodle mixture.

title: Beef Ramen
ingredients: 12 ounces beef-flavor ramen noodles | 4 tablespoons lard or 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | crushed ice ( or other topping of choice ) | cherries, for garnish ( use a cherry or two )
instructions: Add ramen as per directions on seasoning packet. In a large skillet, add the lard or oil and heat until lard is smoking. Add crushed ice to skillet and melt, being careful not to burn. Add crushed ice to skillet. Dunk ramen noodles in melted ice.

title: Olive Oil and Cognac
ingredients: 10 fluid ounces cognac, heated | 2 teaspoons mixed fresh herbs, finely chopped
instructions: Pour in the ingredients, and shake before adding the herbs in small batches in a shaker. Shake, then store in a glass bottle.

title: Fricot Burger
ingredients: 4 beef short rib, cut lengthwise | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon grated peeled fresh ginger | 2 cloves fresh mixed spice, crushed | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 cup sliced ripe plantains | 4 pieces stale crusty bread ( about 1 pound total ) or 4 pieces french bread | 2 tablespoons sweet marsala wine
instructions: Place short ribs in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cheese, ginger, mixed spice, yogurt and plantains into a large bowl. Stir to blend. Form mixture into an 8 inch patty. Grill or broil patties 2 minutes on each side or until desired doneness. Brush tops with a little oil before eating.

title: Nacho Seasoning
ingredients: 1 teaspoon tarragon ( fresh herbs ) | 1 package salt-free seasoning ( mccormick's montreal brand italian herb seasoning )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl for a quick rub on vegetables.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 1/2 cups white wine, divided | 1 jar salsa | 3 tablespoons wine vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, beat cream cheese, 2/3 cup of the wine, salsa, and vinegar until smooth. Chill remaining 1/3 cup of the wine for later use. Add remaining wine, 1/3 cup of the cream cheese, cream cheese, and salsa to the cream cheese mixture.

title: Quick Cuban Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon triple sec or 1 tablespoon other orange-flavored liqueur | 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded to 1/8-inch thickness | 1/3 cup pineapple juice ( reserved from the baked chicken )
instructions: In shallow nonmetal bowl, combine the triple sec, and enough pineapple juice to make 1 cup. Place the chicken in the mixture and turn to coat. Cover the bowl, refrigerate, and marinate the chicken at least 2 hours and up to 8 hours turning often. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place meaty side down in a roasting pan, and place on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in upper third of the oven for 25 to 30 minutes, or until meat thermometer reaches 165 degrees. Remove from the oven, and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Serve immediately while still warm.

title: Garlic Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice wine | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in a jar and chill in the refrigerator.

title: Italian Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 container ricotta cheese | 1 packet dry onion soup mix
instructions: Dissolve dry soup mix in 1/3 cup boiling water. Add to remaining ingredients. Stir to mix well.

title: Chipotle Arroz Con Nogales
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1 teaspoon ground chipotle chiles
instructions: Place the rice in a bowl and pour in enough cold water to cover. Allow to soak overnight. Drain the rice and transfer it to a medium saucepan. Season with chipotle chiles. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, about 20 minutes.

title: Faux Chilled Stuffed Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup mini chocolate chip | 1/2 lb bacon, chopped fine | 2 cups canned lobsters, drained | 1 cup canned apricot, drained | 1 lb boneless rump steak, fat trimmed | 1 lb phyllo pastry sheet, defrosted
instructions: In a saucepan, melt the chocolate over medium heat. When the chocolate melts, stir in the bacon. Slice the steak crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices. Combine the lobsters and apricots. Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Place one sheet of phyllo on a work surface. Lay a second sheet of phyllo on top. Sprinkle with a little of the chocolate. Dip each piece of steak into the chocolate, then fry over medium high heat until golden.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,green chili pepper,chili sauce,salsa,ham steak,vegetable oil cooking spray,lemon,mexican cheese
title: Barbecue Swiss Steak Salad With Lime Juice
ingredients: 4 -6 thin sliced ham steaks | vegetable oil flavored cooking spray | 2 tablespoons spicy chili sauce or 2 tablespoons your favorite hot sauce | 1 cup mexican cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon canned chopped white and light green chile peppers, drained | salsa | lemon wedge
instructions: Place meat in large bowl and coat with cooking spray. Pour hot sauce over steak.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,linguine,pearl onion,pumpkin seed,cream chicken soup,vegetable
title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1 package dried linguine | 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup grated fresh pumpkin seeds | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried sweet onion ( optional )
instructions: In a medium pot of boiling water, cook linguine pasta until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, combine the cream of chicken soup, pumpkin seeds, grated onion, and grand marnier. Add the pasta to the soup mixture and stir to mix. When the pasta is cooked, drain well. Transfer pasta to a large baking dish and sprinkle with the poppy seeds and remaining grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,beetroot,vinegar,thai red curry paste,vegetable oil cooking spray,shrimp,dill weed
title: Red Curry Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lbs medium raw shrimp, shelled & deveined, butterflied | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon cooking spray | 1 teaspoon fresh dill weed or 1/2 teaspoon dried dill | 3/4 cup mixed sprouts ( about 2 cups fresh ) | chopped mixed fresh dill weed ( optional ) or mint leaf ( optional )
instructions: Thai red curry paste note, for a change of pace, add 1 tsp red chilies, 1/8 tsp lime juice, & 2/3 cup chopped mixed sprouts. Blend together red curry paste, rice vinegar, vegetable oil & 1/2 tsp dried dill weed or dried dill weed. Mix the ingredients together & set aside. Place shrimp in shallow nonmetal dish or plate & coat with curry paste mixture. Cover & marinate in refrigerator for about 20 minutes or up to 6 hours. In the meantime, heat nonstick skillet on high heat & spray with cooking spray. Stir fry shrimp just until pink, 2 - 3 minutes. Sprinkle with mixed sprouts & serve over hot rice, garnish with dill or mint leaves & additional Thai chile if desired.

Random Ingredients: stew meat,italian bread crumb,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Italian Stew Meatballs
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds lean stew meat, cut into 1 1/3 inch cubes ( see note ) | 1/4 cup italian seasoned bread crumbs | 3 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place stew meat, bread crumbs and parmigiano reggiano cheese evenly into a large bowl. Mix thoroughly. Roll meat mixture into 1 1/2 inch balls and place them on the prepared baking sheet. Bake meatballs in preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until thoroughly cooked.

Random Ingredients: lemonade,grand marnier,pimiento,hot italian sausage,soymilk,radish,baby spinach,red enchilada sauce
title: Spinach-Sausage Salad Recipe
ingredients: 15 ounces red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 4 ounces hot italian sausage, cubed | 2/3 cup pimiento, diced | 2/3 cup pickled radishes, julienned | 1 package baby spinach | grated radish
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium bowl, mix and refrigerate overnight for best results. Enjoy with grated radishes.

title: Olive and Anise Seed Spread
ingredients: 20 kalamata olives, pits removed | 1 tablespoon dried anise seed | 1 tablespoon dried onion
instructions: Break the olives apart into small pieces. Add the aniseed and onion and grind or crush thoroughly. Sprinkle on bread, cheese or anything else that strikes your fancy.

title: Rinser Doe
ingredients: 3 packages dried sauerkraut | 3/4 cup sherry wine ( do not boil ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1/2 1/2 cup peas or 1/2 cup carrot, diced | 3 tablespoons apricot jam or 3 tablespoons apricot preserves
instructions: Rinse the sauerkraut under water for several minutes until it has soaked up all the water. Combine the first 3 ingredients together in a large pan. Cover and let simmer for 60 minutes on low heat. When the water evaporates and the sauerkraut is tender, remove from heat and stir the sauerkraut, preserves and apricots into the contents. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed. Serve at once.

title: Scotch Sausage and Blueberry Sausage Salad
ingredients: 2 links sweet italian sausage | 20 ounces fresh blueberries | 12 sprigs fresh oregano | 4 leeks, whites and light green parts, chopped | 1 tablespoon rice wine ( or red wine ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Grill sausages until no longer pink and just slightly charred on both sides. Turn off and allow to cool slightly. When cool enough, slice into 1/2 inch slices. While sausages are in the oven, in a small bowl, combine blueberries, oregano, and leeks. Toss gently. Arrange sausage slices into an attractive platter. Sprinkle over the leeks and crème brulee over all. Dribble over the wine for a light balsamic glaze, if desired.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,streaky bacon,coconut cream,lettuce leaf,garlic clove,sherry,herb,mayonnaise
title: Chicken Wrapped Bacon With Lime Mayonnaise & Basil
ingredients: 4 slices streaky bacon, trimmed of fat but left on one side | 1 tablespoon sweet sherry | 8 lettuce leaves, cleaned ( such as bibb lettuce ) | 1/3 cup sweetened mayonnaise | 125 ml coconut cream | 1/4 cup limeade concentrate, frozen concentrate | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 2 limes, quartered
instructions: Pre heat the grill to high, or heat a griddle pan. Add the bacon to a large frypay or frying pan and cook over medium heat until golden all over. Remove to a large plate and put aside. Add the sherry to the pan, then reduce heat slightly and let the alcohol begin to evaporate. To the pan add the lettuce leaves, mayo, coconut cream, limeade concentrate, lemon juice, garlic, and mixed herbs. Mix to combine. Cut the lime wedges into quarters and arrange them decoratively on the tops of the lettuce leaves. Put the bacon wrapped lettuce leaves onto the hot grill or in an ovenproof dish. Cut the lime quarters into quarters and position them on top of the lettuce leaves. Cover with foil and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes, or until the limes become softened. Serve immediately.

title: Parsley Stuffed  Crispy Shrimp
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, minced | 1/2 lb raw shelled deveined jumbo shrimp | 1/2 cup uncooked vermicelli | 1 teaspoon ouzo | 1/2 teaspoon tomoto paste | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon or 1/4 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 1 cup arugula or 1 cup rocket leaves | 3 pomegranates
instructions: Cut the shrimp into 1 1/2 in. Ropes and set aside. Cook vermicelli according to package. Drain and set aside. In a bowl, mix ouzo, tomoto paste, tarragon and salt and pepper to taste. Dredge shrimp in mixture, marinating for 30 minutes or so. Set shrimp aside. In a medium non stick pan, heat 1 tblsp. Of olive oil. Add shrimp and marinade until shrimp are opaque and the shrimp are just beginning to turn pink. Serve hot, over the arugula.

title: Homemade Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 2 cans whole tomatoes with green chilies | 2 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Open the two cans of tomatoes and put them in a blender. Use your hands and blend the tomatoes until they are smooth. Do not over blend. Add the oregano and stir. Pour into a serving dish and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,black olive,serrano chilies,chicken leg,garlic salt,flour tortilla,orange marmalade,oregano leaf
title: Moroccan Chicken and Preserved Lemons
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, and drumsticks, with skin and bones attached | 1 cup orange marmalade, such as keens organics | 2 -3 serrano chilies, stemmed, seeded and finely chopped ( jalapenos ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix | 2 cans black olives, drained and coarsely chopped | 12 flour tortillas, 2 to 3 inches in diameter
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°. Put chicken legs into a 9x13 baking pan with the marmalade, chiles, garlic salt, oregano, and ras el hanout. If you need to, rinse chicken. Toss to evenly coat. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. When done, tent loosely with foil if you need to. When chicken is almost cooked through, remove from oven and tent with foil. Cover the pan with foil, and allow to cool in oven. Put olives into a glass bowl, and pour the olives over them. Return the pan to the oven, and continue baking 20 to 25 minutes, or until olives are toasted. Taste and adjust seasoning with garlic salt, oregano, and salt and pepper if necessary. Remove olives from oven after 20 to 25 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a warm platter and cover with foil. Raise oven temperature to 400°. Place warm platter on top of platter. Put the tortillas in a warm water bath, and set aside. Remove the platter from oven, then fill with approximately 1/4 cup of the olives. Serve tortillas warm, with remaining olives and chicken.

Random Ingredients: tea,puff pastry,broccoli floret,oat,romaine lettuce,venison steak,ketchup,chicken bouillon
title: Venison Roll Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 lb venison steak, cut into strips | 12 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 1/2 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 1/4 lb broccoli floret, stems removed | chopped fresh cilantro ( optional ) | 1/2 cup rolled oats, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place steak in freezer bag.

title: Polish Okra Goulash - Vegetarian Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh okra | 1/2 cup amaretto | 1 hot pepper, chopped | 1 pint grape tomatoes ( or 2 pints grape tomatoes in tomato oil ) | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth or 1 1/2 cups water | shredded pepperoni, etc ( optional )
instructions: Wash and dry okra. If using whole okra, cut off the ends of stem and trim away any tough ends. Rinse well. Peel the okra if necessary. Slice off the ribs and cut off the top half of the stem just below the eyes. Place slices in a crock pot, and sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the amaretto. Add hot pepper. Add okra. Add the remaining ingredients with enough stock or water to cover. Cover and cook on low for 3 hours. Serve over hot cooked rice. Optionally, top with sliced pepperoni.

Random Ingredients: peach,extra virgin olive oil,blue cheese,onion soup mix
title: Peaches and Blue Cheese Skewers With Bleu Dauphinoise and Chive
ingredients: 4 large peaches | 1 ounce blue cheese, crumbled ( preferably a mild, preferably organic, sharp cheese ) | 1 envelope onion soup mix | extra virgin olive oil, for cooking
instructions: Peel and cut the peaches in half, remove the pits and cut off the stem. Cut into halves, scoop out the seeds, and set the flesh aside. Place the peaches and blue chees in a container with a secure lid. In a small bowl mix the onion soup mix with a little salt. Add the olive oil and gently stir with your hands to blend. Spoon the peaches onto a plate or dish with the cheeses. Pour the soup mix over the peaches. Serve at least 30 minutes but up to 8 hours.

title: Curried Beef
ingredients: 1 lb filet of beef | 1 packet ranch dressing mix | 2 tablespoons curry powder
instructions: Brown filets in skillet with curry powder. Add dressing and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve with bread.

title: Jicama & Mushroom Jam-Jam-Jam Jam
ingredients: 2 lbs jicama, peeled and cut into about 5 inch slices
instructions: Peel the jicama and cut into about 5 inch rounds then into the rounds. Heat the jars in a large saucepan. Turn the oven up to 400 degrees f and place the rounds on a baking sheet. Bake for about 8 minutes or until the lids have separated. Immediately remove jam from the oven and place pieces on a jelly towel over the top. Press the towel in the jelly until it starts to wrinkle. It should not be too damp. Place the jars in a large jam plastic bag to keep warm while you place the jars in a large dutch oven or other heavy bottomed pot. Place over medium heat and bring to a boil. After 10 minutes, stir the jars from the top of the bowl. Remove and discard the jam. It should be the consistency of jam and clear to the touch. Cover the jam jar completely and set aside at least 4 days and up to 8 weeks. The jam can also be kept in the refrigerator for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,baby shrimp,black mushroom,cream mushroom soup,golden raisin,phyllo pastry
title: Pita Wedges
ingredients: 1 package frozen, thawed, phyllo pastry sheets | 1 cup cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup fresh baby shrimp, halved | 1/3 cup golden raisins | 1 package torn fresh black mushrooms | 3 packages frozen, thawed, phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. On a lightly floured surface, unroll one sheet of phyllo dough into a 10 x 14 inch rectangle. Spread the phyllo dough with 1/3 the cream of mushroom soup. Layer the shrimp and raisins over the soup mixture.

title: Mussels in Tagliatelle
ingredients: 1/2 small head of cabbage, finely shredded | 9 -10 fresh mussels | 8 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles | 1 1/2 tablespoons walnut oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Place cabbage in microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 7 minutes, or until cabbage softens. Do not overcook. Preheat oven to 450°f. Rinse the mussels in cold water. Discard any unopened mussels. Discard any mussels that have cracked shells. Place shellfish in a shallow baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 5 minutes, or until the shellfish is firm. Using a slotted spoon, remove the mussels into a bowl. Cover the mussels with cold water and microwave on high for 15 - 20 minutes, until open. Remove the mussels from the microwave and use a fork to tear off any mussels that have not opened. Discard the shellfish. Drain the mussels and discard any remaining mussels. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Place noodles in the water and cook according to package directions.. Reserve 1/4 of the water. Drain the noodles, then mix with the walnut oil or butter. Spread the noodle mixture over the mussels and top with the cabbage mixture. Return the dish to the oven and bake for 15 - 18 minutes more, until the cheese is melted.

title: Herbed Meat Loaf (Bifte)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 12 fresh basil leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325ºf. Remove the stems from the basil and discard. Using your fingers or an upright floured board, roll the basil until it is in long strips about 3 inches long and about 3 inches wide. Tear off pieces of the remaining stem and discard. Roll and stretch each piece of meat to a 7 inch square. Place half of the meat in a greased shallow 3 1/2 to 4 quart ovenproof baking dish. Top with half of the basil leaves and spread about 1/2 cup basil over the top. Finish with remaining meat and the remaining basil. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 75 to 90 minutes, or until meat is tender when pierced with a fork. Let stand 10 minutes before removing from the pan. Cut into slices with a sharp knife.

Random Ingredients: couscous,tamarind pulp,corn flake,white mushroom,rosemary,hard egg,english cucumber,pear
title: Eggs and Tamarind Couscous
ingredients: 1 lb white mushroom, thinly sliced | 12 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1 cup couscous | 1 can sweet corn flakes, drained | 2/3 cup tamarind pulp, soaked in 4 tbsp water | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped | 4 pears, peeled, cored and diced | 1 english cucumber, thinly sliced, for garnish
instructions: Place a large skillet over medium heat with 1/2 cup oil. Add mushrooms and saute for about 5 minutes, until mushrooms release their water. Remove from skillet and set aside. Place eggs in the skillet and cover with water. Simmer over medium heat until cooked through and very brown. Remove from heat and remove eggs from the pan. Cover with a towel to soak up any liquid. In a bowl, combine all the ingredients.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,ginger root,kaffir lime leaf,red chilies,roasting chicken
title: Chinese Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 dried red chilies | 1 tablespoon ginger root, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaves | 1 tablespoon bottled dijon-style hot mustard
instructions: Rinse the chicken under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Spread both sides with mustard. Season with chili powder, and place on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Place the dried red chiles on a tea towel, and soak for 30 minutes or longer. When ready to bake, preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove the chicken from the marinade and rub the mixture all over the chicken. Place the chicken in the preheated oven and turn until browned and cooked through, about 20 minutes. Do the same with the ginger root and lime leaves. Allow to stand 10 minutes before serving. Garnish with chopped fresh coriander. Serve with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,lime zest,tamarind paste,white vinegar,pineapple tidbit,white wine,jicama,veal
title: Veal Tamarind Nests in Sweet Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/curry/cous-tamarind-paste-425441 '' > curry tamarind paste < /a > | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/3 cup white vinegar | 1 lime, zest of | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 lb veal, ground round | 1/2 lb cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/4 cups pineapple tidbits
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the chinese pickled napa cabbage in a saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Combine ground round, mushrooms & pineapple. Mix the ground round mixture and the vegetables with tamarind sauce. To assemble, use your hands to form 3/4 pieces of meat approx 3 inches in diameter. Fill each of the tamarind tamarind wrappers with meat and vegetable mixture. Moisten the edge of each wrapper with water and place a 1 to 2 tablespoon of the filling in the center of the wrapper. Seal the edges with toothpicks. Place the tamarind pickled napa cabbage in a basket with a kitchen towel. Serve with rice.

title: Radishes With Parmesan Cheese
ingredients: 24 small radishes, washed, peeled, very thinly sliced, and kept separate, if you want a lot on them | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Combine parmesan cheese and honey in a screw top jar. Shake until smooth. Place drained radish in a large bowl. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese mixture. Toss to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Chilen Pizza Bread
ingredients: 2 cans lentils, drained | 3/4 cup green chili salsa | 1/4 cup white onion, chopped | 1/4 cup capers, drained | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1 teaspoon oregano | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake in a 375 degree oven about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,dashi stock,dark rum,beef broth,beef chuck,allspice berry,crawfish
title: Toshiko Mitsuba
ingredients: 1 cup dashi stock | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 1/4 cup prepared dark rum | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 3/4 pounds beef chuck, cut into narrow strips | 4 whole allspice berries, tied into knots
instructions: In a saucepan over medium low heat, combine the dashi stock, beef broth, dark rum, and cider vinegar.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,mace,tomato green chile pepper,spinach leaf
title: Mexican Green Chile Spinach
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, with liquid | 3 cups fresh spinach leaves, thoroughly cleaned | 1 tablespoon white sugar | ground mace
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, combine the green chile peppers with the tomatoes, and bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until thickened and reduced to about 2 cups, about 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, and boil for an additional 2 minutes, and remove from heat. Cool, and store in the refrigerator in a tightly covered container.

Random Ingredients: tequila,green cabbage,stewing beef,sesame seed,texas toast bread
title: Margaritas Stuffed With Beef
ingredients: 1 -2 lb stewing beef, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 tablespoons tequila | 4 slices texas toast thick bread or 4 slices challah, 1 inch in thickness | 2 teaspoons toasted sesame seeds, for garnish | 4 -8 slices medium green cabbage, for garnish
instructions: Place beef slices into a shallow nonreactive dish, overlapping a little. Sprinkle with tequila and refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes. Preheat the oven on broiler setting. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat and add sesame seeds. When they brown, place beef slices on toast and bake 2 to 3 minutes per side, or until golden brown. Watch carefully and adjust the time accordingly. Place beef slices on plates, spoon some of the yummy margaritas on the meat and serve with green cabbage.

title: Ancho Chile Pesto With Semolina (Pista-Pista)
ingredients: 5 cups semolina | 4 dried ancho chilies ( about 1-2 tablespoons ) | 1/4 cup capers, chopped | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Put semolina in a large bowl and set aside for 15 minutes. Rinse it and break it into small pieces with your fingers. Then add semolina, dried ancho peppers, capers and vinegar. Knead on a floured surface until dough has formed and the ingredients are thoroughly distributed throughout. Cover and refrigerate for about 2 hours. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead well for about 5 minutes. If it seems to dry out, add water a couple of tablespoons at a time. Divide the dough into 2 or 3 portions and shape each one into a ball. Flour the work surface and roll out each portion into a circle about 1/8 of an inch thick. Spread out a thin layer of the sherry and sprinkle evenly with salt. Sprinkle with more salt and freeze for about 15 - 20 minutes. When firm, gently transfer the frozen piaccia to a cutting board and slice into 1 inch rounds. Place on a baking sheet and bake at 300 for 15 minutes, turning over when edges are lightly browned.

title: Sweet Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 white onion, chopped | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/4 cup horseradish | 2 tablespoons dry minced onion | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: In food processor, add the chopped onion, catsup, horseradish and dry minced onion. Cover and process until smooth. Transfer to crockpot or serving dish. Garnish with cayenne pepper if desired.

title: Smoked Corn and Parsnips
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped dry parsnip | 2 teaspoons snipped fresh dill sprigs | 3 ounces unsalted shelled whole almonds | 3 3/4 ounces chopped smoked corn | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons dark rum | 2 teaspoons cornstevia extract | 2 teaspoons oatmeal
instructions: Place the parsnips and dill in a bowl and set aside. Place the almonds in a dry frying pan. Turn the heat to medium high and toast the nuts, shaking the pan occasionally until golden. Remove from the pan. Place the chopped parsnips and dill in the bowl with the nuts and dill and stir to combine. Place the smoked corn in the food processor, food processor or blender and process until well mixed. With the motor running, pour in the pesto. Pour in the rum and cornstevia and process only until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. The mixture should have a chunky texture. Shape the mixture into 2 diameter rounds and place on a serving tray lined with foil. Allow to chill before serving. Garnish with the toasted almond flakes if desired. Serve chilled.

title: Turmeric Apple Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs granny smith apples, cut into 1/3 inch cubes | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, mix together the apples and turmeric and cook, stirring constantly, until the apples are slightly softened and fragrant. Add the sour cream and sugar, stirring well. Transfer mixture to a crockpot and chill, uncovered, to let flavors blend, several hours or overnight. Serve warm.

title: Ciabatta
ingredients: 2 slices irish cream ( the real thing ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: If using irish cream, mix cinnamon in top of your irish cream, then spread the cinnamon on top and side, then cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for an hour or two before serving. When ready to serve, cut into small pieces.

title: Jamaican Pork Chops With Bananas and Cashews
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, 3/4-1/2 -inch thick | 8 ounces unsalted cashews, unsalted | 12 slices serrano peppers, 1 1/2-inch long | 12 teaspoons sour cream | 4 1/2 ounces bananas, cooked, halved lengthwise
instructions: Heat grill. Grill pork chops until cooked through, about 6 minutes per side. Spread cashews over a baking sheet. Bake in 400 degree oven until cashews are golden, about 20 minutes. Spread 2 teaspoons of sour cream over each chop. Top each wit 6 pieces of sliced serrano peppers. To serve, top with remaining sour cream, bananas and cashews. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: pepper,lime juice zest,tea,nori,kaffir lime leaf,salmon,italian seasoning,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke Salmon Lovers  and Spicy Seaweed Tea
ingredients: 5 kaffir lime leaves, lightly crushed | 2 tablespoons lime juice ( zest of 3 or 4 lime ) | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 3/4 lb salmon, cut into 4 equal pieces ( skinless salmon can be used ) ( optional ) | 3/4 cup mixed artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | kaffir lime leaf, to taste | fresh ground pepper, to taste | 4 sheets nori, seaweed sheets
instructions: Make the marinade, in a large serving bowl, stir together the lime leaves, lime juice, italian seasoning and italian seasoning. Add the salmon, artichokes and pepper and gently toss to combine. Arrange the seaweed sheets on a baking sheet, and place under the broiler until lightly toasted, stirring once or twice through. Allow to cool before serving. Serve as is or with your favourite tea. Note, marinating the salmon will make the sushi more digestible and more tender. You can use a sharp knife if you like.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,red pepper flake,red pepper jelly
title: Pepper Jelly Spread
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons red pepper jelly | 2 -3 tablespoons parsley leaves, chopped | 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes or 1 pinch pink pepper flakes
instructions: Blend jelly, parsley and spices in a food processor until smooth.

title: Seared Sole Ceviche
ingredients: 1 sole fillet | 1 tablespoon whole chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 2 tablespoons watermelon, coarsely chopped | 1 can shell crab, drained
instructions: In a 1 quart casserole pan, toss the fish with the chipotles, watermelon and crab. Cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.

title: Nama's Kebabs
ingredients: 100 g lamb stock | 1 stalk lemongrass | 2 -3 tablespoons salsa
instructions: Mix the stock into the salsa. Trim as much of the stalks as possible from the lemongrass using a vegetable peeler. Trim away the hard rind and cut the ends off the lower portion. Slice the lemongrass finely. Take the lamb out of the refrigerator for 20 minutes before using in barbeque. Thread pieces of lamb onto skewers until evenly coated with the mixture. Barbeque over high heat for approximately 5 minutes, turning so the skewers don't burn when brown.

Random Ingredients: red onion,oyster sauce,hoagie,cannellini bean,idaho potato,mace,orange bell pepper,cornbread mix
title: Cannellini and Orange Grilled Cornbread
ingredients: 1 box frozen mixed sweet potatoes, thawed | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup diced red onion | 1/4 cup orange bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon cornbread mix | 10 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise
instructions: Place the frozen sweet potatoes in a large pot of boiling water.

title: Peanut Creme With Dijon Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup heavy cream, divided | 1/4 cup peanut oil ( not extra virgin ) | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/2 cup shredded orange rind | 1 cup canned crabmeat, drained and coarsely broken | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Blend 1/4 cup heavy cream and 1/4 cup peanut oil in a blender until smooth. Blend in 1/4 of the peas along with 1/4 cup orange rind. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Just before serving, mix 3 tablespoons mustard with the crab and refrigerate 1 hour, tossing to blend. Just before serving, stir the remaining 1/4 cup cream, the remaining 1/4 cup heavy cream, and the remaining 1 tablespoon orange rind. Season with salt and pepper. Divide salad on 4 large plates. Spoon dijon over the salad.

title: Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 2 packages phyllo dough, thawed | 1 pound raisins | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups madras curry powder | 1 1/2 cups white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cut phyllo dough into three layers.

title: Cardamom Brandy Peppercorn (Shrik Korma)
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 -3 whole cardamom seeds | 1/3 cup brandy
instructions: Spray the cooking griddle or dry skillet lightly with cooking spray and set it to 325f/160°c. Place the cardamom toasted whole cardamom seeds and whole cardamom pods in the hot oil and toast lightly turning often until they have dark spots all over but are not burnt. Move them to a paper bag and store them in an airtight jar. Make sure they are completely cooled before storing or storing them.

title: Italian Sausages for the BBQ
ingredients: 4 links italian sausage, cut into slices about 6 inches long and 1-inch thick, with the fat removed | cooking spray | 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 tablespoon cardamom seeds
instructions: Preheat and indoor grill to 350 degrees f. Spray a 4 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange the sliced sausage in a single layer in the baking dish. Coat the sliced sausage with cooking spray. Bake in preheated oven until the sausage is hot and the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees f, 10 to 15 minutes. Heat the mixed vegetables and cardamom seeds in a skillet over low heat for 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white bread,peach,sherry wine vinegar,cumin powder,meat,beef brisket
title: Cuban Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 lbs meat | 1 lb lean boneless beef brisket | 6 -8 slices white bread | 1 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 cup peach slices or 1 cup kiwi fruit, sliced
instructions: Brown meat in a skillet with the 1 cup of sherry. Place brisket and sauce in a crockpot with 4 cups water, 1/4 cup sherry vinegar, cumin and cayenne pepper. Cook in crockpot on low 8 hours. To serve, lay bread slices on a warm platter and place the brisket over them. Top with slices of fruit. Spoon on the meat sauce.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,margarine,amaretto,chili paste,lavender,head cauliflower,self raising flour
title: Lavender and Lavender Cauliflower Pudding
ingredients: 250 g self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon cracked dried lavender | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 2 tablespoons margarine, chopped | 2 tablespoons dried amaretto or 2 tablespoons almond essence | 1 teaspoon mild chili paste | 2 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c if using an ovenproof saucepan, pour the oil into the bottom and set over a med high heat. Once the oil is hot, gradually whisk in the flour, mixing very well. Add the lavender and thyme. Turn the mixture into a small cup and stir in the sugar until dissolved. Pour this mixture into the base of a large, greased, ovenproof, ceramic bowl and scatter over the amaretto, chilli paste and 2 tbsp melted margarine. Stir well to combine them well and fill the cauliflower molds or small ramekins/ramekins with the mixture. Bake for 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: The Best Vodka Black Pepper Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup sour cream with dry sherry | 1/4 cup good-quality mayonnaise | 1 jar salsa, medium heat ( medium or hot ) | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 teaspoon pure vodka | freshly cracked black peppercorns, to taste ( optional, see note )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a small bowl and mix well. Store the mixture in a clean, dry jar in a cool, dark place for up to three months.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,plain flour,live lobster,oregano leaf,jicama,sage,basil,double cream
title: Jicama Rice Balls
ingredients: 300 g jicama, peeled and finely diced into fine julienne strips | 25 g plain flour ( all purpose ) | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 tablespoons double cream | 5 live lobsters | cooked basmati rice
instructions: Place jicama in a bowl with flour, oregano, basil and sage. Add cream and toss to combine. Place the lobsters on the rack of an oven tray and bake at 220c/425f/gas mark 6 for 10 - 15 minutes, until soft. Remove lobster meat and place on kitchen paper towel to drain. Increase oven temperature to 190c/375f/gas mark 4 and line 2 baking trays with kitchen paper. When oven is ready, toss jicama with reserved cooking juices, leaving any excess sticky coating in the tray. Bake for 12 minutes until warm. Remove from oven and set aside. Raise oven temperature to 220c/425f/gas mark 4 and spread cooked rice evenly on baking tray. Dip jicama fingers in warm water for 3 - 4 seconds to wet, then place in tray. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,pepperoni,mascarpone cheese,dark sesame oil,red potato
title: Kittencal's Greek-Inspired Pizza Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb red potatoes ( about 3 medium and 1/2 inch diameter ) or 1 lb yukon gold potato ( about 3 medium and 1/2 inch diameter ) | 1/2 lb sliced pepperoni | 1/2 cup fat free greek yogurt, plain | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil ( dark works best ) | 1 ounce mascarpone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the 2 largest unpeeled potatoes on a cookie sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Cut potatoes in half at thickest part, then cut each half into 3 or 4 chunks, as you like. In a large mixing bowl combine all the ingredients, mix well. Spread out the potato mixture on a clean, dry surface. Cook pizza in oven for 20 minutes, or until crust is crisp and crust is golden brown. Let cool slightly, remove from oven. Cut into 3 or 4 pieces. Place on serving platter and drizzle with your favorite glaze.

title: Thiples
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1 tilapia fillet
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place pizza crust on an ungreased cookie sheet. Cut fillet into thin strips. Arrange the strips over the pizza crust. Bake in the preheated oven 12 minutes, until fish is opaque and crust is golden.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,italian dressing,self rising flour,chicken breast half,fennel,sugar cube,chicken broth
title: Apple Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup italian dressing | 4 cups fat free chicken broth | 1/2 cup apple cider or 1/2 cup white wine, divided | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves or 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 3 tablespoons sugar cubes | 1 tablespoon self rising flour | 1 teaspoon fennel
instructions: Place dressing in saucepan and set over medium heat, stirring often, until hot. Add chicken and 1/4 cup of the cider to saucepan. Cook for 6 minutes, turning once, until chicken is cooked through and slightly browned.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,snow pea,coconut milk,cottage cheese,malt vinegar,purpose flour,green capsicum
title: Sweet Stuffed Snow Peas
ingredients: 20 green capsicums | 100 g cottage cheese | 200 ml coconut milk | 20 g all-purpose flour | 200 g roasted sambal oelek ( a mild savoury sauce ) | 100 g chopped green sweet capsicum ( canned ) | 100 ml malt vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c. In a bowl put the cottage cheese, coconut milk and salt, mixing thoroughly. Pile the capsicum, sambal oelek and coconut sauce in the middle of each green pepper. Dip the green pepper halves in the flour, then roll them in the sambal mixture, making sure to coat all sides. Arrange the stuffed green peppers on a baking tray and bake for 40 - 45 minutes, or until they are tender.

title: Italian Sausage Balls II
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk italian sausage | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup italian breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl, mix sour cream, bread crumbs and italian seasoning. Add the sausage, breaking apart as needed. Mix well and shape into about 32 small balls about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Chile With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 kg medium shrimp, unpeeled | 150 g ground almonds | 1 large red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 stalk fresh red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Shell the shrimp and wash under cold water. Heat a dry frying pan over medium high heat and add the ground almonds, stirring and cooking, until they are golden brown, about 5 minutes. Remove the hazelnuts and set aside. Add the chilli to the pan and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Add the shrimp and stir once or twice to coat. Cover the pan and leave for 3 to 4 minutes. Remove the shrimp mixture to a platter and sprinkle over the toasted almonds and chili. Serve as a dip for vegetables.

Random Ingredients: garlic,mushroom,apple cider vinegar,yogurt,taco sauce,swiss cheese,dark chocolate
title: Swiss Cheese and Mushroom Taco Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package shredded swiss cheese | 3 cups shredded fresh mushrooms | 2 1/4 cups light beer or 2 1/4 cups apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 large apple, chopped | 2 tablespoons low-fat plain yogurt or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1/4 cup low-fat taco sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees. Spray cookie sheet or large cake pan with non stick cooking spray. In a bowl combine all ingredients except yogurt and taco sauce. Stir well. Spread in prepared pan. Bake at 325 degrees for 35 minutes, topping with taco sauce and bake 5 more minutes.

title: Green Beans and Peppers With Ginger and Piquillo
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, tips tipped | 1 jar roasted piquillo peppers, packed in natural juice | 1 1/2 inches fresh ginger, peeled, cut into thin julienne strips | 1 jar frozen corn niblets, packed in natural juice
instructions: Remove 1/2 cup of the liquid from the jar of roasted peppers and set aside. Place the remaining contents in a blender and puree to a smooth sauce consistency. Set aside. Bring the remaining liquid to a boil in a large sauce pan. Add the green beans and fresh ginger and cook 3 minutes over moderate heat, stirring frequently. Add the blended green beans and return the sauce to a boil. Lower the heat slightly and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, or until thickened. Stir in the corn mixture and simmer until just heated through.

title: Crock Pot Pasteurized Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 white mushrooms | 1 habanero pepper | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper ( i use kosher )
instructions: Dice the mushrooms into 1 inch pieces with a fork. You can keep them in the freezer for long time if you do not want to get eaten right away. I do not like them mushy. Place a pan on medium high heat. Add the water in which the mushrooms were cooked and the green peppers. Mix and bring to a boil. Once boiling, immediately reduce the heat. Dump the mushrooms in and mix. Let simmer until soft and tender. Add the salt and pepper. Serve over white rice.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,pecorino romano cheese,chicken breast half,white miso
title: Miso Chicken
ingredients: 4 bone-in chicken breast halves | 1/3 cup frozen white miso | 3/4 cup grated pecorino-romano cheese | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the chicken breasts between 2 sheets of plastic wrap on a flat work surface. Flatten with a meat mallet until 1/4 inch thick. Pound each breast to 1/4 inch thickness. Using a sharp knife, cut a pocket in the bone side of each breast. Reserve 3 or 4 pocket pieces, but reserve enough scraps to serve as a garnish for the tops. Place the miso in a medium bowl, stirring with a spoon until it has completely dissolved. Stir in 1/4 cup of the cheese, seasoning salt, and 1/4 cup of the pecorino romano cheese. Fill the reserved pockets with the miso mixture. Arrange the chicken breasts on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup of cheese on top. Bake chicken in the preheated oven until the bottom is lightly browned, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chive,rice bran oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,lamb shoulder,parsley flake
title: Lamb Rillettes
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice bran oil ( aka vegetable oil ) | 1 lb boneless lamb shoulder or 1 lb boneless thigh meat, cut into 1-inch cubes ( 2 1/2 inch squares ) | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley flakes | 4 tablespoons shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon chives
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over moderate heat. Add the meat and turn to brown lightly on all sides.

title: Golden Syrup Condiment
ingredients: 1 teaspoon pure golden syrup | 2 tablespoons lime, pulp of
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a non reactive non reactive saucepan. Simmer for 1 minute to 1 minute and 45 seconds, stirring constantly. Allow to cool a little or heat up for 1 - 2 minutes. If necessary, reheat again in the microwave to make the mixture warm to the touch. Enjoy.

title: Turnip and Mango Dal
ingredients: 4 turnips, peeled and chopped | 1 mango, peeled and cubed | 1 cup red lentil | 1/4 cup whole milk | 1 tablespoon jicama, grated | 25 coriander seeds | 1 cup grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Place the turnips, mango, lentils, milk, grated jicama, and coriander seeds in a slow cooker. Cover, and cook on high for 5 hours, stirring every 15 minutes. Reduce the heat to low, and continue cooking for an additional 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Add cheddar cheese, and increase the heat to medium for about 30 minutes, until the cheese is melted. Serve hot.

title: Pizzelles (Spaghetti and Spice)
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti sauce, of your choice | 1/4 lb nuts, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients evenly and place on cookie sheet to bake at 275°f for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Tamarind and Ham-Hock Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloins | 1/2 lb ham hock | 1 lb cauliflower, broken in small pieces | 6 ounces yoghurt, beaten until smooth | 2 sprigs fresh sage | 1/2 spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp
instructions: Rinse the meat and remove any strings and any fat that may be forming on the meat. Cut the meat into bite sized cubes and set aside. Bring a large saucepan or dutch oven with 5 cups of water to a boil. While the water is heating up, slice the onion and saute in a small pot over low heat. When the onions are translucent, add the ham hock and heat thru. Add the meat and stir to coat with onion/ham mixture. Stir in the cauliflower and return to a boil. Cover and continue to boil for 10 minutes. Take the cover off and reduce the heat to low, then simmer for 30 minutes. Mix in the yoghurt and simmer for 10 more minutes, stirring occasionally. Garnish with the sage, onion and tamarind pulp.

Random Ingredients: galliano,snow pea,kidney bean,basil leaf,chili pepper,cube steak,meatball
title: Beef and Stampkolae
ingredients: 4 cubes steak | 4 ounces frozen meatballs | 1/3 cup chili pepper, crushed | 2 tablespoons galliano, grated | 1/3 cup dry kidney beans | 14 ounces snow peas, trimmed | 1/3 cup fresh basil leaf, chopped
instructions: Combine meatball, chilli and galliano in crockpot. Pour into crockpot. Add beans and peas. Cook on high for 6 - 9 hours or low for 8 - 10 hours. To make tostada, garnish with basil.

Random Ingredients: baby pea,garlic powder,icing sugar,fontina,baby spinach,cranberry,chili powder,pepperoni sausage
title: Pepperoni Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 head baby spinach | 4 ounces fresh bratwursts ( with or without casings ) or 4 slices hot pepperoni sausage, sliced | 1 1/2 cups frozen baby peas, thawed | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder or 1/2 teaspoon all-spice | 1/2 cup crumbled fontina or 1/2 cup provolone cheese | 1/2 cup diced pepperoni sausages
instructions: Place all salad ingredients in a large bowl.

title: French Toasted Swiss Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 12 ounces frozen asparagus, defrosted
instructions: Cut steak into 1/4 strips. Coat a large skillet with cooking oil. Toss with sliced beef. Saute for 4 minutes. Place on baking dish. Combine soup, tomato puree and asparagus, reserving 2/3 of mushroom soup mixture. Pour mixture over meat. Cover tightly and bake at 325° f. For 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,pie shell,shiitake mushroom,cooking spray,mini chocolate chip,sage,basil leaf
title: Herbed Calzones
ingredients: 1 pie shell | 1/2 cup mini semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon snipped fresh basil leaves | 1 dash dried sage | 1 dash dried basil leaves | 2 fresh shiitake mushrooms, chopped | cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Combine the chocolate chips, celery salt, basil, sage, and mushrooms in a small bowl. Roll each puff pastry dough into a 12 inch circle on a lightly floured surface. Trim 1 circle from the top. Spray the inside of the pastry circle with the cooking spray. Place a pastry circle on a non stick baking sheet, pressing in slightly. Repeat with the remaining circles and filling. Bake for 5 minutes or until the filling is heated through and the edges of the pastry are beginning to crisp up. Cut halfway through making the calzones for a great tasting taste. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: almond essence,chicken stock,tangerine peel,red capsicum,pepper,black peppercorn,veal cutlet,horseradish
title: Pheasant's Day Duck
ingredients: 1 chicken stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons tangerine peel, grated zest of | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh horseradish, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh cracked pepper | 2 teaspoons aubergine peppercorns | 1 large red capsicum, diced | 2 1/2 ounces sliced almonds | 3/4 lb veal cutlets, sliced thin
instructions: Bring chicken stock to the boil and add tangerine peel, horseradish and black pepper. Remove from the heat, stir in the aubergine, capsicum and almonds and pour into a flameproof dish. Cover and cook in a moderate to hot oven for 45 - 60 minutes or until tender.

title: Creamy Corn and Chiles
ingredients: 1 poblano chile | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 shallot, diced | 2 ears fresh corn kernels
instructions: Roast the poblano chile on a grill directly over medium heat, turning frequently until skin is blistered and blackened in areas, about 10 minutes. Transfer chile to a bowl, cover with a plate to steam for 20 minutes. Peel, deseed, and chop. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Place cooked chile, cranberries, and shallot in a blender with remaining ingredients.

title: Flounder With Berry Compote (Azerbaijan)
ingredients: 8 ounces flounder fillets | 4 ounces mixed berries | 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup refried beans ( black beans can be used instead )
instructions: Slice the flounder into 1/4 slices. Coat with flour and fry over medium heat, turning once or twice. Remove, drain on paper towels. In saucepan combine the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Place the flounder on heated serving plate. Pour the compote over it or serve it with breads and fresh fruit.

title: Green Smoothie
ingredients: 1 medium onion, roughly chopped | 1 lb seedless watermelon, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 3/4 cups salsa | 1/2 cup pomegranate syrup ( or try nectarines to make the kick, if nectarines are not available ) | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup chopped pomegranate seeds ( or try 2 teaspoons crushed dried pomegranate seeds, or try nectarines ) | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients into the bowl of a blender and pulse to combine. Pour the smoothie into your vitamix container and place into the freezer. After 1 hour, blend the smoothie and re freeze for up to 2 days.. If using dry pomegranate seeds, add them now. If too dry, add 1 teaspoon of pomegranate syrup at a time just before serving.

title: Cashew Vegetables and Kidney Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 medium red capsicums, chopped | 1 medium celery, finely chopped ( leaves only ) | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 200 g chinese vegetables, chopped ( snow pea pods, capsicum, bamboo shoots or small ) | 15 -20 raw cashews | 2 cans pinto beans ( drained ) or ( 30 ounce ) cans other white beans | 8 1/2 cups chinese egg noodles, cooked
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt margarine over a medium heat. Add capsicums and celery and soften for a few minutes. Stir in the kidney and chinese vegetables and stir in the cashews.

title: Hot and Savory Sweet Brownie Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint sweet black soy sauce | 1 cup barley, coarsely ground | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 cup hard-boiled egg, finely chopped | 1 vanilla bean, split, seeds scraped and split
instructions: In a 2 to 3 quart saucepan, bring water to rolling boil over medium high heat. Sprinkle in soy sauce.

title: Jicama Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 pounds beef tenderloin | 2 pounds pork tenderloin | 2 teaspoons cumin | 2 teaspoons garlic, minced | 1 pound jicama, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1 can condensed chicken soup
instructions: Place the beef tenderloin into a large stock pot.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,dark rum,cream mushroom soup,rye bread,gruyere cheese
title: Easy Cheesy French Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon dry dark rum | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 4 slices rye bread, toasted and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine soup, rum, cheese, and bouillon in a skillet. Simmer over medium heat until cheese is melted and blended into the mixture. Spread toasted rye bread with the mushroom mixture. Layer with toasted rye bread slices.

title: Linguine With Eggplants and Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium eggplants or 1 medium lebanese eggplant | 2 whole eggs | 4 tablespoons parmesan cheese ( grated ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 2 tablespoons cranberry sauce ( or other herbs of choice ) | 2 tablespoons fresh basil or 2 tablespoons other fresh herb of choice
instructions: Slice the eggplant at an angle, approximately 1/4 inch thick. Place slices in a baking dish and sprinkle with the remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Bake or grill the eggplant until tender. You may also use the broiler if possible, to give the eggplant a smoky grill taste. Serve with the cranberry sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: wasabi,white onion,mascarpone,korean red pepper paste,poppy seed
title: Wasabi Kisses
ingredients: 1/4 white onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 2 teaspoons korean red pepper paste | 1 tablespoon wasabi | 500 g mascarpone cheese
instructions: Combine onion, poppy seeds, and korean red pepper paste in a bowl. Let sit for approximately 10 minutes. Place kimbap in a mortar and pound to form a paste. Add wasabi and mix thoroughly. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,dijon mustard,onion soup mix,shrimp paste,thyme sprig
title: Shrimp Re
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix | 1 package dry italian-style salad dressing mix | 1/2 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 tablespoon dry onion soup powder | 1 tablespoon shrimp paste | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Prepare package mix according to package directions. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over shrimp paste in a slow cooker. Cook on low setting for 4 hours or on high setting for 2 to 3 hours. Sprinkle with fresh thyme when serving.

title: Capetown Cooler (Raw Raw or Gluten Free)
