ingredients: 2 cups baby greens, washed and spun dry to remove sand | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 dash salt | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground clove | 1/2 cup ice water
instructions: Place baby greens in a bowl large enough to hold them in one layer without crowding over high heat and allow to stand to dry and dry, about 25 minute. Drain greens in a sieve over a bowl to remove as much water as possible. Add all remaining ingredients except ice and water to greens and stir to combine. Add ice water and stir to combine. Serve.

title: Easy Easy Crock Pot French Onion Soup Bread
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 loaf frozen bread flour
instructions: Mix soup with flour to form a loose dough. Dip frozen bread into soup mix then press into 1 1, 1/2 to 3 quarts boiling water. Simmer 2 minutes then turn off heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Cut into 1 - 1 inch slices and arrange on a dish.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,tomato green chilies,curry paste,oil,ginger paste
title: Mirchi's Masala Curry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons indian curry paste | 1 can diced italian plum tomatoes | 1 can chopped tomatoes with chilies, drained | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1 1/4 tablespoons oil
instructions: Heat oil over medium high heat in a large skillet. Add curry paste and cook till aroma comes out, about 10 seconds. Add canned tomatoes and ginger paste and stir for an additional 3 minutes. Pour in hot canner and stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium and place a lid on skillet. Allow to simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove lid and add chopped fresh tomato's. Stir to combine. Cook an additional 3 - 4 minutes and serve hot with plain white rice. Also great on a roti with chapatis, rice, and vegetable veggie breads.

Random Ingredients: butter lettuce,cherry tomato,english mustard powder,star anise,tea
title: Tea Leaf Butter
ingredients: 20 -30 fluid ounces boiling strong tea | 3 tablespoons unsalted butter lettuce | 1 teaspoon english-style mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon sour cream or 1/2 teaspoon cream | 1 star anise | 4 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Boil the water in a pot for 2 minutes. Do not allow the boiling water to boil dry. Meanwhile, in a small frying pan or the microwave, add the butter, mustard and star anise. Stir continuously until the butter melts and the mixture becomes light and fluffy, about 5 minutes. Do not boil. Remove the tea leaf from the heat. When the pan is just warm, add the star anise oil. Add a few tablespoons of the warmed hot liquid to the butter and mix it into the mixture. Pour the hot ingredients into an ice cream cone mold, cover tightly and freeze until soft, at least 4 - 8 hours. After the firmness, transfer the frozen butter to a clean cutting board and slice the chilled butter into pieces about 1 long. Place the butter into a storage container, cover and refrigerate until served. Decorate the top with the cherry tomatoes.

title: Polish Kielbasa Corn Wraps
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa ( polish kielbasa ) | 1/2 cup corn ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup corn ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup whole kernel corn | 6 tablespoons white flour | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon saffron ( optional or add more to taste, can also add 1/4 to 1/2 tbsp dried or fresh ) | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek or 1 tablespoon dried kalamisasi spice mix | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f. Remove kielbasa from package.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,macadamia nut,chinese white rice wine,kosher salt,mace,limeade concentrate
title: Nuts and Macadamias
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried macadamia nuts, preferably macadamia nuts | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 cups chinese rice wine, preferably shaoxing rice wine | 2 ounces frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 pinch ground mace | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch
instructions: Toast the macadamia nuts in a dry skillet over medium heat, shaking every now and then, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate to cool. Add salt to the wine and bring to a boil in a saucepan, whisking constantly. Add the limeade concentrate and cook and stir until liquid evaporates, about 3 minutes. Mix in the nut mixture and macadamias. Mix in the mace. Combine the cornstarch with 2 tbsp boiling water, add to the nuts, and stir until completely incorporated. Serve warm.

title: Lime and Herb Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice, rinsed and drained | 4 fluid ounces limeade concentrate | 2 1/2 tablespoons salad dressing | 1 tablespoon mixed salad dressing | 1 tablespoon basil or 1 tablespoon kraft fresh mixed herbs, chopped | 6 cups watercress, washed, dried and roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram ( may sub any fresh herb of your choice )
instructions: Mix limeade concentrate, salad dressing, mixed salad dressing and chopped herbs in a bowl. Add rice and stir to coat evenly. Tip, you can do this in the night, stir in at the start and leave for 24 hours, stirring and squeezing vigorously. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,jack daniel whiskey,baby spinach,mustard oil,dark soy sauce,chicken bouillon
title: Sweet Potatoes With Potatoes
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard oil | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup jack daniels whiskey | 1 teaspoon dry mustard oil | 1 1/2 lbs smoked kielbasa, cut into 1-inch slices | 1 bag baby spinach
instructions: Brush mustard oil onto a rimmed baking sheet. Combine chicken bouillon, soy sauce, whiskey, and dry mustard oil in a large bowl. Add sausage slices. Toss to blend. Add spinach. Toss with mustard oil. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,date,corn syrup,gochujang chili paste,parsnip,cream onion soup
title: Sweet Crisp Parsnips
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs parsnips, peeled and cut into wedges | 1 can cream of onion soup | 1 package confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup corn syrup, no substitutions ( light, or dark ) | 1 tablespoon gochujang chili paste | parsley ( to garnish ) or chives ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the parsnips in a large roasting pan. Place the cake pan in the oven for 45 minutes turning the parsnips over every 5 minutes. Remove parsnips from the oven and drain any remaining liquid. Set aside. Combine soup, sugar, corn syrup, and gochujang in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Pour over parsnips and return to oven to bake for an additional 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Serve hot with grated or sweet bread, if desired.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,ginger garlic paste,applesauce,vegetable oil peanut,wheat flour,bay leaf,tabasco sauce,port wine
title: The Perfect Sandwich (Healthier is the Real Thing to Love!)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons port wine | 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 3 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Combine the coriander, bay leaf and ginger/garlic paste in a medium mixing bowl. Add the tabasco& port wine. Stir together to combine, then add the applesauce and mix until it is blended.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,mustard seed,monterey jack pepper cheese,almond
title: Apple and Almond Cheese Bark
ingredients: 1/2 cup slivered almonds | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped dried tart apple | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9 x 5 inch loaf pan. Combine the almonds, cheese, apple, and mustard seeds. Spread onto the top of the prepared pan. Sprinkle evenly with the remaining cheese. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown. Cool slightly. Remove from the pan, and cut into squares.

title: Quick and Easy Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can mango chutney
instructions: Heat tomato soup and mango chutney in microwave safe bowl in 30 second intervals. Serve over brown rice.

title: Cafe Rio Beef or Pork Satay with Creamy Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin or 1 lb pork roast, cubed | 2 tablespoons fresh dill pickles, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons red chili powder | 1 tablespoon paprika red chili powder | 4 cups soymilk | 1 pastry for double-crust burrito-size sandwich roll | 1 1/2 cups cooked hamburger or 1 1/2 cups pork roast, diced | 1 cup grated white chocolate | 1 tablespoon fresh dill pickle, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºf. In a large bowl mash the tenderloin and pickles with 1 1/2 tablespoons of red chili blackening spice for 45 seconds, or until meat is white throughout. Add soy milk and mix well. Pour this mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Add the crust edges and roll the meat up into a cigar shape and transfer to tray with meat. Repeat until all meat is used. Combine the remaining 1 teaspoon red chili powder and paprika for the sauce and pour over meat. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with pam. Unroll the meat roll and place over the meat in the baking dish. Sprinkle each with about 1/4 cup of grated white chocolate and about 1 tablespoon pickle slices. Cover with foil, place in preheated 500ºf oven and cook for 20 minutes. Remove foil and sprinkle with dill pickle slices. Serve.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,greek yogurt,rosemary sprig,tomato green chilies
title: Homemade Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 24 ounces marinara sauce, commercial is preferable | 1 can tomatoes and green chilies, medium sized, cut in half lengthwise and seeds scraped out | 1/2 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 3 fresh rosemary sprigs
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Mix all ingredients in a medium sized mixing bowl. Put into a small oven safe casserole that has been coated with cooking spray. Bake for 30 - 45 minutes or until bubbling and starting to char, stirring every few minutes so it doesn't burn at the sides. Serve and enjoy.

title: Crock Pot Portuguese Brunch Shoots
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs chuck roast | 2 -3 tablespoons margarine | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Cut a slit lengthwise into each roast to form a pocket on top. Brush each slice with butter. Sprinkle with one or two sprinkles of sugar. Wrap each slice with a leaf of parsley or dried parsley. Place on hot crock pot lid with lid slightly ajar, cook on high 4 - 6 hours until tender. When ready to serve cut off any excess fat and serve them on a slice of toast. A salad should be served over the toast.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,orange zest,basil,cinnamon sugar,canadian bacon,basmati rice,clam,celery rib
title: Canadian Bacon & Clam Rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup canadian bacon, chopped | 2 tablespoons dried basil | 1 tablespoon dried clams | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 teaspoon cinnamon sugar | 1 1/4 cups cooked regular basmati rice or 1 1/4 cups jasmine rice | 1 can minced clams | 2 sprigs fresh basil or 1 sprig mint
instructions: Combine bacon, basil, clams, orange zest and cinnamon in large saute pan. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until bacon is crisp. Add rice. Cook 2 - 3 minutes or until hot. Garnish with basil/mint sprig. Serve.

title: Curry Burger
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 8 ounces curry-style fries
instructions: In a large bowl, mix beef with curry flavored croutons. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Form mixture into 8 patties and cook, about 5 minutes per side, until browned and crispy.

title: Parsnips With Serrano Pepper
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs parsnips | 2 -3 serrano peppers
instructions: Peel and dice parsnips. Wash and slice the chilis. Heat a heavy frying pan. Add the parsnips. Saute them and saute until slightly crunchy and tender.. Salt to taste.

title: Simple Black Beans Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb cheddar cheese or 1 lb monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 can black beans, undrained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the cheese in a 2 cup caserole dish, top the cheese with and spread the beans evenly using a potato masher. Bake for 20 minute or until golden brown. Sprinkle with remaining cheese just before serving.

title: Salsa Rosa
ingredients: 6 cups chunky salsa ( homemade is best ) | 1/2 cup yellow pepper, julienned | 2 tablespoons chives, minced | kosher salt
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the salsa, pepper, and chives. If you are making a salad, i recommend tossing in some of the salad greens. Season with salt if desired.

title: Andouille and Chardonnay Spicy Bacon Kebabs
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked andouille sausage, cut into 1-inch pieces & soaked in water for 30 minutes | 1/4 cup shaoxing chardonnay wine | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon chardonmese wine | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh gingerroot | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 1/3 lbs lean bacon, cut crosswise into 2 pieces | 2 packages ramen noodles, broken into pieces
instructions: Drain pork pieces, reserving and rinse, set aside. Combine sausage, wine, turmeric and xanthan gum in large mixing bowl, set aside. Combine ginger, oregano and pork, season with salt and pepper to taste. Thread the kababobs onto 4 skewers and place in a 12 nonstick skillet. In small bowl, combine chardonnay with the wine mixture, pour over skewers and cook over medium high heat turning occasionally about 10 minutes or until bacon is cooked and pork is browned on all sides. Remove pork from pan, draining bacon fat. Preheat broiler. Lightly coat metal broiler pan with cooking spray or oil. Arrange kabobs on baking sheet, bake, turning once, 30 minutes or until no longer pink in the middle, and juices run clear. Serve with chardonnay sauce for dipping.

title: Nam Sod (Spicy Pork With Grapes)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 4 ounces fresh cranberries | 1/2 cup green seedless grape | 2 tablespoons asian fish sauce
instructions: Cut the pork into 4 equal thin slices. Place in a non metallic dish. Sprinkle the cranberries on the pork. Add the grapes and enough fish sauce to coat evenly. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 250°f. Transfer the pork slices onto 2 foil lined baking sheets. Bake for 10 minutes, until meat thermometer reads 160f. Turn pieces over and bake for one hour. Add more fish sauce as needed during baking to taste.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,extra virgin olive oil,bacon,almond extract,cream cheese,white bean,cream tartar
title: White Bean Salad With Glazed Bacon, Poached Lemons & Cream Cheese
ingredients: 3 ounces cream cheese | 1 medium orange, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup sour cream ( i used fat free ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 6 slices bacon, chopped finely | 1 can white beans
instructions: In a mixing bowl, cream together cream cheese, orange juice, zest, sour cream, almond extract and cream of tartar. Fold bacon and white beans into cream cheese mixture. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before you're ready to serve or serve immediately.

title: Whiskey Spaghetti Baked in Spiced Whiskey
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup quick-cooking spray | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 2/3 cup whiskey ( not sweet, such as e.g. scotch woodcock ) | 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti, broken into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine bread crumbs and cayenne in medium bowl. Lightly coat rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange spaghetti pieces in single layer, in 4 rows on sheet, in 2 rows. Spray with cooking spray.

title: Cousin Cosmo's Quick and Easy Tomato Brown Rice
ingredients: 350 g brown rice | 1 tablespoon italian salad dressing ( i use alfredo ) | 1 container good-quality fat free sour cream | 1 cappesara sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes | 250 g chickpeas | 1 pinch saffron | 1 teaspoon custard powder
instructions: Cook brown rice, add salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,butter bean,caster sugar,basmati rice,kaiser,asafoetida powder,yellow onion
title: Crazy Good Brown Onions and Brown Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup desiccated unsalted butter beans ( can use fresh and canned, or dried soaked beans, soaked overnight ) | 1 1/2 cups yellow onions, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup firmly packed light caster sugar | 2 cups cooked basmati rice ( short grain is best ; short grain is best ; i recommend bomba ) | 4 kaiser rolls, split
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat, until hot but not smoking. Add the cocoa powder. Keep stirring until all the cocoa powder is dissolved, then reduce heat to low. Add the asafoetida and butter beans. Stir until the liquids are coated in the cocoa. Add the onions. Stir until the onions are barely tender. Add the sugar. Stir for another 1 - 2 minutes. Serve over the uncooked basmati rice.

title: Ciabatta Fish With Lemon-Garlic Sauce over Croutons
ingredients: 2 loaves ciabatta ( or other firm platter ) | 1 cup wild rice | 1 cup shrimp clam juice | 3 ounces lemons, zest of
instructions: Cut the fish into thin slices and coat with the lemon garlic sauce on both sides of the bread. Heat a small amount of olive oil in a pan over a medium high heat. Add the fish and cook for 2 - 3 minutes on each side, or until the fish flakes easily. Transfer to a serving platter and serve immediately.

title: Lemony Browned Potatoes With Raspberry Coulis
ingredients: 2 lbs raspberries or 2 lbs strawberry-flavored raspberries, hulled | 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled | 3 tablespoons lemon zest | 4 tablespoons low-spice blend ( such as spice hunter's ) | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Cut raspberries or strawberries lengthwise in half. Pierce potatoes with a knife if necessary, otherwise, score a 1 1/2 deep slits or cross hatch pattern on top of the potato. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add potatoes and cook at a boil for 5 minutes, carefully turning the potatoes occasionally. Cook for another minute, being careful not to overcook them. In a bowl, dissolve 1 tbsp of lemon zest in the remaining 2 tablespoons of lemon flavored juice. Stir the lemon mixture into the cooked potatoes. Remove the potatoes from the water and place on a serving platter and garnish with remaining lemon zest. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,napa cabbage,swiss cheese,cheddar cheese,chili,thyme,beef gravy
title: Quick Beef, Cabbage and Beef Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canned diced chili | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium beef gravy | 4 cups shredded napa cabbage | 2 1/2 cups sliced cooked corned beef, cut into 1/4-inch strips | 3 cups shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded reduced-fat swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f combine the chili, thyme and gravy in a large skillet and place over low heat.

title: Spinach in Squash Leaves
ingredients: 1 bunch spinach leaves | 1 bunch squash, washed and trimmed
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the squash and spinach. Cover and simmer over medium heat for about 10 to 15 minutes, or until the squash is tender. Serve hot. I like to use a baguette with a good mustard and butter mixed with chopped carrots, celery and onions. You can also add chopped fresh garlic, oregano, parsley or basil to this dish.

title: Bifte & Percha
ingredients: 500 g stewing beef | 2 teaspoons moroccan mixed spice | 4 cups cauliflower florets | 200 g chunky salsa | 1/4 cup walnut oil | 400 g lean lamb
instructions: Rinse& drain the meat leave in the bag with the spice mix. Blanch the cauliflower in boiling water. Meanwhile heat the walnut oil in a large saucepan and brown the meat. Stir in the salsa, cook 2 - 3 minutes. Add the meat and cauliflower to the salsa, cook for 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,hazelnut,bread,brown mustard seed,baking potato,pine nut
title: Mustard Roasted Spiced Potatoes
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 teaspoons hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon pine nuts, coarsely chopped | 4 medium baking potatoes, quartered | 1/3 cup dry bread ( use coarse soft bread crumbs )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray or line with a piece of parchment paper. Arrange the mustard seeds in a small, dry frying pan over medium heat, and cook, stirring often and scraping down the sides of the pan, until the mustard seeds sizzle and start to pop, about 1 minute. Remove the seeds with a slotted spoon and allow to cool 5 minutes. Remove and discard the giblets, and grind them in a spice mill to a fine powder. Stir the ground mustard seed and fennel seeds through the potatoes, and transfer the mixture into a large glass baking dish. Drizzle the bread crumbs over the potatoes, and toss the potatoes lightly to coat. Cover the dish, and bake until the topping is dark brown and crisp, 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,guinness stout,hot red chili pepper,confectioner ' sugar
title: Hot Guinness Sour Cream
ingredients: 1/4 cup hot red chili pepper, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup guinness stout | 2 teaspoons red chili pepper, sliced | 1 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a tall glass or small bowl, stir together chiles, guinness, and chilli. Using a fork, gently fold in confectioners' sugar. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bacon,rice noodle,kosher salt,brussels sprout,vanilla bean,curry paste,creme fraiche
title: Spicy Brussels Sprouts With Vanilla Noodles
ingredients: 10 brussels sprouts | 1/2 lb bacon ( optional ) | 1/4 cup creme fraiche | 1 teaspoon turkish curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon scraped and powdered sugar or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 2 large sheets of cooked rice noodles | 1 pinch kosher salt
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the brussels sprouts for about 2 minutes or until just barely tender. Drain and keep warm. In a skillet, cook the bacon until crisp.

Random Ingredients: tomato,sourdough starter,toblerone chocolate bar,olive oil,cream cheese
title: Jellybean Spread
ingredients: 2 cups sourdough starter | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 3 fresh tomatoes, peeled, halved lengthwise and sliced 1/2 inch thick | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 8 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 24 1-2 ounce toblerone chocolate bars or 24 1-2 ounce chocolate chips
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the starter and 1 teaspoon of water, making sure mixture is suspended in the water. Place the cheese and 2 tablespoons of olive oil in the bowl and mix thoroughly to blend well. Add the tomato slices, 2 tablespoons of olive oil and sourdough starter mixture and stir. Pour into a well in the center of the stove and set the bowl over the top of the stove. Heat to a gentle boil until mixture starts to bubble with a light haze. Watch closely, so as not to burn the bottom, it will soon reduce. Once the entire mixture begins to bubble again, cook the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving bowl and chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Melt the remaining 1 ounce toblerone in the top of a double boiler, watching carefully, so as not to burn the bottom.

title: Smoked Haggis #2 - Haggis and Vegetable Roll
ingredients: 1 cup smoked salmon | 1/2 cup smoked beet | 1/2 cup red capsicum | 1/2 cup red onion | 2 small turnips | 1 sheet fresh wax paper, each slab cut in 5s
instructions: Slice the meat thinly lengthwise. Cut a hole in the centre and remove all the seeds. Slice the meat into 8 equal portions. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Take each piece of smoked salmon and put two piece pieces of beet in the middle with capsicum and onions. Wrap the meat around the other piece of vegsettes. Secure with moistened toothpicks. Place on a rack in a baking tray and chill or freeze. Roll each Haggis piece from one piece at a time and remove from freezer when ready to serve. Remove toothpicks from roll and serve with salad and cucumber salad.

title: Pigeon Pea Spread
ingredients: 1 can pigeon peas, drained | 2 yellow squash, chopped into bite-size pieces | 1/4 cup artificial sweetener, or to taste
instructions: Place pigeon peas into a food processor, and pulse until coarsely ground. Scrape into a bowl, and add squash.

title: Shrimp Dampers
ingredients: 1 rack of lamb, in 1.75-.5-.5-.5-.5-.5. | 1 jar roasted peanuts | 2 2 -3 drops yellow food coloring | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared mustard powder | 1 dash cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Heat up a grill. Put your rack in the grill and cook on high till done. Remove and cool, then slice into squares. For each serving take a bite of the meat and put on a serving plate. Top off with more peanuts, yellow food colouring, mustard powder, cayenne or paprika if desired.. You can also decorate your salads with edible flowers, lemon wedges and/or fruit slices. You can also serve this buffet style with other dishes.

title: Tawny Port Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups peppery tawny port | 2 tablespoons tawny cooking sherry | 1 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Combine port, sherry and pepper flakes in clean nonaluminum bowl, toss to coat. Let stand 20 minutes at room temperature before using to store up to 2 months.

title: Tamarind-Sutted Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 1/2 lbs fresh salmon fillets
instructions: Mix tamarind paste, turmeric, and salt. Coat the fish in the paste mixture. Let sit for at least 4 hours or overnight. Cover salmon with cold water. Pour the water around the fish in a skillet and cook over medium heat until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve the salmon on a platter, garnished with the sauce and steamed veggies.

title: Beef and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 pound ground chuck | 1 cup frozen peas | 2 russet potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 tablespoon soy milk, or as needed | 1 1/2 teaspoons white sugar | 2 artichoke hearts - drained and chopped | 1/4 cup mirin | 2 cups arborula, rinsed
instructions: Place ground chuck in a large skillet and cook over medium high heat, breaking up clumps, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain excess fat, leaving about 1 tablespoon in skillet. Mix peas, potatoes, soy milk, sugar and artichoke hearts in a large salad dish. Sprinkle top with mirin.

Random Ingredients: star anise,chicken thigh,cake flour,baby spinach,orange bell pepper
title: Chicken and Sweet Pepper Stew
ingredients: 6 pieces skinless chicken thighs, with bones | 1 cup baby spinach, washed and trimmed | 1 cup orange sweet bell pepper, stemmed sliced in thin strips | 1 cup cake flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground star anise
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chicken in a large heavy saucepan. Cover and braise over medium high heat until chicken is cooked, about 15 minutes.

title: Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili paste with sweet garlic | 1 1/2 tablespoons applesauce
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the chili paste and applesauce until thoroughly blended.

title: Easy Microwave Biriyani Rice
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 6 eggs, beaten | 1 tablespoon minced garlic
instructions: Cook as per your instructions. Do not overcook. Do not forget to stir. Put on top lid.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,plum tomato,nonfat milk,leg lamb
title: Grilled-Roasted Lamb or Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb or 1 1/2 lbs poultry | 1 large plum tomato, cut in wedges
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Combine the milk and olive oil in a small bowl. Brush lamb or poultry with milk mixture and roast meat, turning once or twice, 15 to 20 minutes, or until desired doneness, brushing twice or three times with more of the oil mixture. Meanwhile, combine the tomato wedges with the remaining oil. Lightly season with salt. To serve, mound tomato and vegetable on a platter, drizzle with sauce.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,mutton,taco sauce,maraschino cherry,roast beef,rum,bow tie pasta,simple syrup
title: Kathy's Australian Mutton Rissoles
ingredients: 600 g beef, minced | 4 -5 big tasman pints of musrooms ( or any meat you like ) | 3 bell peppers, finely chopped | 2 liters rotisserie-cooked sausages ( kielbasa will work too ) | 150 -300 g bow tie pasta, cooked and drained | 100 -200 g roasting beef, finely chopped ( i make my own meat and vegetables separately ) | 1/3 cup simple syrup ( i use lemon ) | 1/3 cup rum, light | 1 maraschino cherry ( optional )
instructions: Preparation, mix the meat, veggege, peppers and spices throughly in a large bowl. Let rest for 15 minutes. Cooking, boil water and cook the bowties, drain and mix all to a mess with the pasta. Once they are finished cooking, divide them amongst two heated and greased oven proof pints. The bottom of the glass with the syrup should be golden brown, and then the top with a bowl of ice cubes for texture. The glass should measure about 11/4 cups. Pour over the top of the pints, and bake in the oven at 325 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes until the top is golden, and a little crusty, and the inside of the pints sound hollow when tapped on the bottom.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,orange liqueur,dill pickle,horseradish,extra virgin olive oil,vegemite,spring onion
title: Pate' Riviera
ingredients: 10 green cardamom pods, cracked | 10 spring onions, diced | 100 g fresh horseradish, grated | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon grated orange liqueur or 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon demi glaze or 1 teaspoon finely grated horseradish, diluted with a touch of water | 1 tablespoon dill pickle, finely chopped
instructions: Put one whole cardamom, 10 spring onions, grated horseradish, olive oil, orange liqueur, demi glaze and crushed green cardamom pods in a bowl. Mix well to coat the spices. Spoon into 4 glasses and top with pickle halves or whole. Let sit at room temperature for 3 hours to absorb flavors.

title: Dilly Rolls
ingredients: 2 heads lettuce, coarsely chopped | 2 fluid ounces fresh dill, chopped
instructions: Place lettuce on a plate. Sprinkle with dill. Roll up like a jelly roll. Serve in slices with a toothpick and pickle.

title: Spaghetti, Coffee Cauliflower and Hazelnut Phyllo
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 40 sheets frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 1 cup italian cheese blend, shredded ( grated ) | 1 lb cauliflower floret, cut with small florets | 2 packages spaghetti or 2 packages spaghetti noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place hazel nuts in a bowl, add sugar, toss to combine. Place one sheet of phyllo in a 9x13 pan. Spread a second sheet on top. Repeat until all sheets have been used. Sprinkle hazelnut mixture over top. Repeat 3 more times with remaining sheets, hazelnut mixture and remaining sheets. Brush tops with butter. Bake at 400°f for 45 minutes or until golden. Stir cauliflower and cheese into spaghetti. Spoon filling over phyllo, cover and return to oven until hot, about 15 minutes.

title: Chard, Potato and Onion Fritters
ingredients: 4 tablespoons coarsely chopped yellow onions | 1/4 lb chard leaf | 5 medium baking potatoes, scrubbed clean ( about 4 lbs total weight )
instructions: Prepare the fresh chard leaves by removing tough stalks. Slice the stalks into very thin slices approx the length of a 6 x 6 inch piece of parchment paper. Spray or brush each slice of fresh chard with a scant 1/4 cup water and set in the middle of a large dinner plate. Cover the platter with the chard leaves, spreading them in an even layer without disturbing them. Bring a quart of water to a boil in a 4 or 5 quart pan. Working quickly, dip the pan into the boiling water and quickly lift out the scallions with a slotted large spoon. Transfer the pans to the table immediately.

title: Sautéed Onions and Chiles With Vermouth
ingredients: 4 spring onions ( green tops ) | 1/4 cup dry vermouth | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 small romaine lettuce, rinsed | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, coarsely chopped
instructions: Peel onions, remove the green tops.

title: Strawberry Mushrooms and Strawberries (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 15)
ingredients: 12 ounces mixed varieties fresh strawberries, sliced | 1/2 cup sliced cremini mushrooms | 1/4 teaspoon mace
instructions: Combine the strawberries and mushrooms in a bowl and toss gently to combine. Sprinkle with mace and toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,soda water,flat leaf parsley,chicken tender
title: Chicken & Basmati Rice Cake
ingredients: 400 g basmati rice | 12 chicken tenders, approximately 500g, cut into individual portions | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons soda water
instructions: Break the rice into 4 equal portions. Place them in a bowl with 1/4 cup water. Stir to separate. Set aside. Place 1 chicken thigh, 1 onion and 3 tablespoons of the parsley in a pan. Sprinkle 3 tablespoons of the pepper over the chicken, cover the pan and cook over a gentle heat for about 25 - 30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the onion is tender. Transfer the chicken to a plate and keep warm. Cover and keep warm. In another pan, bring the remaining pepper to the boil. Drain the rice. Stir to coat the rice with pepper and then add the 2 1/2 cups of hot water. Cover the pan and simmer for about 20 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the water is absorbed. Transfer to a platter. In a small frying pan, heat half a tablespoon of the oil to moderate. Add the remaining chicken and fry for about 15 - 20 minutes until cooked through and golden. Transfer the cooked chicken to the platter and keep warm. Pour the remaining oil and remaining parsley into the pan, add the remaining 3 tablespoons of pepper and 1 tablespoon of the seasoning mix, cover and cook another 7 minutes, until the parsley is crisp and aromatic. Spoon over the chicken and serve. You can add another tablespoon of pepper, if desired.

title: Grilled Chicken & Salmon Loafs
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 4 slices smoked salmon fillets | 4 pepperoncini peppers, halved ( i like to use jarred peppers ) | 4 crusty breadcrumbs | 4 english muffins, toasted
instructions: Place the chicken thighs in a zip lock bag, add the remaining ingredients and combine well. Chill for 1 hour. Preheat the grill. Place the toasted bread on a large baking tray. Using your fingers, lightly flatten the bread and spread the toasted bread evenly on the bread. Set aside. Grill the chicken pieces for 10 - 15 minutes on each side, or according to the recommended doneness as instaedients. Serve with soup and a salad.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,serrano pepper,chicken wing,onion,extra virgin olive oil
title: Broiled Caribbean Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 whole chicken wings, cleaned | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil | 1 small onion, chopped | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Season chicken wings with olive oil, onion, serrano pepper, and dijon mustard. Place the chicken wings in the grill, turning with tongs, until chicken is easily pierced with a fork, and the onion has softened and turned translucent, about 10 minutes.

title: Nuochew Crunchies
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce
instructions: Combine cornflour, soy and rice sauce. Use to moisten breadcrumbs. Use a pastry brush to spread on cold dry breadcrumbs.

title: Baked Cabbage-Slaw
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon margarine ( i use becel, but use only if you're concerned about skinning. ) | 1 head green cabbage, thinly sliced
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350°f. Grease a baking dish. In a non stick skillet melt margarine. Add cabbage and sauté until cabbage turns golden brown. Pour cabbage mixture into baking dish. Spread evenly, cover and bake for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Mexican Zucchini and Broth
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, coarsely chopped | 5 teaspoons canned green chilies, finely chopped ( mild or hot ) | 3 cups canned stock or 3 cups broth
instructions: Combine the zucchini and chilies in a large saucepan with 3 cups of the broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 25 minutes, or until the zucchini is tender. Season with salt. Serve immediately.

title: Cuban Green Pepper Skewers on Skewers
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 2 cloves garlic, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 1/2 ounces cubed fully cooked ham | 1 cup bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f. Heat a grill pan over medium heat. Cook and stir the green pepper, garlic, and baking powder in the hot skillet until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Combine the ham and bamboo skewers in a bowl.

title: Radish Salsa
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 large parsnip | 1 large radish | 2 kaffir lime leaves, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup blackberries | 2 tablespoons chutney | 1 english cucumber, halved lengthwise and slices into 1/4-inch dice
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Trim parsnip and discard the woody stem and peel, then cut into 1/2 thick wedges.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,red food coloring,chickpea,serrano chilies,heavy whipping cream,tarragon vinegar,italian sausage
title: Sausage and Chickpea Salad III
ingredients: 4 links sweet italian sausage | 1 package presliced dried chickpeas | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon vinegar | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill pickle | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno, seeded and chopped | 2 drops red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Over medium heat, cook the sausage until well cooked and crumbly. Remove sausage and discard all but 2 tbs drippings. Drain chickpeas.

title: Thai Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry dark soy sauce | 1 large plum tomato, very finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped
instructions: In small nonreactive bowl, combine soy sauce and stir to blend. Add chopped plum and chopped cilantro and toss until well combined. Serve immediately.

title: Chopped Eggs and Cherries
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped coarse | 2 1/2 lbs fresh cherries or 2 1/2 lbs frozen cherries | 2 -3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely chopped
instructions: If using frozen cherries, thaw and chop coarsely. Heat oil in a 1 quart frying pan over medium high heat. When hot, add egg pieces, cherries and peel. Stir mixture until well coated and cook until edges are lightly browned and eggs are just set, about 5 minutes. Flip onto a heated platter and serve hot from the pan or remove the pan. Keep warm in a 300f oven. Variation, for a variation serve the garnishes while the eggs are still warm.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,chicken bouillon,ginger juice,vanilla essence,ginger,greek yogurt,baking potato
title: Curry Potatoes - Microwaved
ingredients: 1 small baking potato | 1 teaspoon ginger juice | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons greek yogurt
instructions: Bake potato in oven on high for 4 - 5 mins or until fork tender. Heat oil in microwave oven on medium. Combine spices & mix well add to oil & spices mix well. Add yoghurt & mix well. Sprinkle w/pumpkin & bake uncovered until pumpkin is golden & slightly soft. Serve with butter.

title: Canned Tomatillos
ingredients: 16 tomatillos | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine
instructions: Wash and rinse tomatillos and dry with paper towels. Fill a large pot with water. Boil tomatillos 7 minutes, then drain. Remove husks and wash again. Slit top from each tomatillo and place directly on water. Let stand 1 hour or more. Drain tomatillos. Place one tomatillo in each jar with a little marsala wine. Cover jar snugly with airtight lid or with plastic wrap and store in a dry place up to 2 weeks. Enjoy note, you can add a little salt or other spices to make it spicier, depending on heat level of tomatillos and what you like.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce mix,watermelon,ricotta cheese,virgin olive oil,serrano pepper,serrano chile pepper,filling,dark chocolate
title: Pasta with Watermelon and Ricotta
ingredients: spaghetti sauce mix : | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil | 2 serrano chile peppers, minced | 4 serrano chile peppers, or more to taste, plus more to taste, minced | 10 ounces watermelon, cubed | 3 ricotta cheese | 3 ounces dark chocolate, broken into pieces | 2 teaspoons water
instructions: Place spaghetti sauce mix in the bowl of a blender, and add 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil.

title: Apricot Chunk Salad
ingredients: 2 cans red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup apricot brandy | 2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl with dressing and mix well. Cover and chill several hours to allow flavors to blend prior use.

title: Pork Stuffed Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chicken thighs, cut in halves | 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 teaspoons dried thyme ( or 1 1/2 tbsp chopped fresh thyme leaves ) | 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel | 1/3 cup shortening, room temperature | 2 cups bread flour | 1/2 cup pork fat, diced, cooking fat and skin removed ( if you're using a lean cut of pork, add 1 tbsp. vegetable oil or the 1/2 tbsp. fat from the left. )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly coat a large, shallow, glass baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Place chicken pieces onto prepared dish. Mix spices. Brush with shortening. Combine flour and reserved fat from the diced pork fat. Stir into fat mixture. Spread evenly over chicken. Bake 30 minutes or until golden. If using a meat thermometer, cook for 20 minutes for medium rare. If using the drippings, brush chicken pieces with 2 tbsp fat from the left. Remove from pan and allow to cool slightly, about 10 - 15 minutes. Serve with a dollop of yogurt or relish.

title: Bhatura (Persian Beef Kebabs)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 24 ladyfingers
instructions: Form 1 1/2 to 2 inch meatballs the length of the ladyfingers. Place the meatballs on an oiled, broiler proof baking dish. Broil, turning occasionally, until browned.

title: Japanese Honcho
ingredients: 1 cup mirin | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 5 cups mixed spice ( spicy spice, chia and cinnamon )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large saucepan and boil a few minutes then remove from heat and allow to cool slightly before pouring into airtight container to store, then store in the fridge for up to six months.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,cherry tomato,cardamom,fine sea salt,yellow mustard seed,maple syrup,grainy mustard
title: Creamy Mustard
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fine sea salt | 1 teaspoon finely chopped yellow mustard seeds | 2 cups chopped yellow mustard seeds | 10 ounces cream cheese | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 teaspoon grainy mustard | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees f. Mix together the sea salt, mustard seeds, cream cheese, maple syrup, mustard powder, and cardamom in a medium bowl. Spread half of this cream cheese mix onto the bottom of the baking dish. Spread the remaining cream cheese mixture over the mustard mixture. Drape the remaining salt mixture over the top of the cream cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbling around the edges, 30 to 45 minutes. Allow to rest for 15 minutes before carving. Serve warm with caribbean bread.

title: Moroccan Sweet Olive Toast (Paneer)
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread ( or other loaf of your preferred cheese ) | 4 pieces of green olives | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 cardamom pod, bruised with a fork ( optional )
instructions: Slice the loaf of cheese into 4 equal pieces crosswise. Using a paring knife, lightly slash the slices, cutting a slit in the cuts with a sharp knife. Set the slices aside. Place the olives in the blender and pour in about 1/4 cup of the olive water. Blend or process until all the olives are chopped up. Add the cumin and cardamom, if using. Mix well. Add the cheese, mixing lightly. Heat a griddle until hot. Dip the bread mixture in the oil and spread onto the toasted slices. Fry the bread until golden and bubbly and cooked through but not crunchy.

title: Spaghetti for the Devil
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chilli pepper | 1 tablespoon white pepper | 2 tablespoons lemon wedges, to garnish
instructions: Cook spaghetti in a large pan of boiling water. Drain and return to pan. Heat the combined tomato puree, chilli and pepper in a small pan until the sauce is very warm and the chilli is aromatic. Stir through the hot pasta and garnish with lemon wedges. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Country Style Steak
ingredients: 1 lb country style sparerib or 1 lb celery, cut in 3/4ths diagonally | 4 cups half-and-half | 1 1/2 tablespoons oregano
instructions: Preheat broiler on high. Broil the top and bottom of the steaks until seared on one side on all sides, about 5 minutes per side for medium rare. In a small bowl, combine 2 cups of half and half, and enough water to equal about 2 cups of hot water, stir in oregano, and set aside. Heat a large skillet or other deep sided skillet over medium heat. Brush oil lightly on the steaks, and cook until a deep brown, about 5 minutes per side for medium rare or longer if you prefer your steaks a little rarer than the suggested suggested time indicated on the box. Remove the steaks to a platter, and set aside. Reduce heat under hot pan to low, then add 2 more cups of hot water. Simmer for a minute or two. Pour 1/3 of the sauce over the steaks to serve, and top with remaining sauce. Note, this dish can be made 1 day or just keep for up to two days.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,purpose flour,meat,pork tenderloin,great northern bean,soy sauce,celery seed,fennel seed
title: French Quarter-style Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 teaspoon whole fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/8 teaspoon ground dried meat | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 1/2 pounds pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 1/2 cups instant great northern beans | 1 teaspoon all-purpose flour, or as needed
instructions: Grind fennel and celery seeds with a mortar and pestle or spice grinder until coarsely ground. Combine ground fennel seeds, celery seed mixture, and the vanilla extract using a whisk, adjusting as needed to ensure the flavor is evenly distributed. Trim fat from cut fat and coat pork with fennel mixture. Heat a large skillet or cooking griddle over medium high heat. Rub pork with soy sauce, then place pork on the hot surface. Cook the pork until no longer pink on the top, about 15 minutes for medium rare at the most. Transfer pork to a serving platter, and cover with foil to keep warm. Cook the beans in the pot over medium heat until soft, about 5 minutes. Slice pork into thin slices and drizzle with about half of the bean mixture. Sprinkle with flour and toss to combine. Serve pork topped with remaining bean mixture.

Random Ingredients: rutabaga,tuna brine,taco seasoning mix,lamb,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Tuna-Braised Lamb With Au Jus
ingredients: 2 lbs lean stewing lamb | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 medium rutabagas | 4 ounces tuna in brine
instructions: In a 6 x 8 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray, combine pork, taco seasoning mix and 2 tablespoons vegetable oil. Toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate overnight, turning several times. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Remove meat from the refrigerator 15 minutes before cooking. Turn on broiler. With rack 7 to 8 inches from heat, place meat on rack and spray with cooking spray. Broil 2 to 4 minutes, turn meat and broil 3 minutes longer. Divide meat between two warm plates, top with a rutabaga and 1 tablespoon of tuna. Serve immediately.

title: Yellow Pea Rice With Macadamia Nuts
ingredients: 1/3 cup yellow split peas, rinsed and picked over | 2 tablespoons whole grain brown rice | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 cup thinly sliced radish | 1 whole macadamia nut, toasted, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tarragon
instructions: Place the peas in a medium saucepan and add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer covered for about 12 minutes or until the peas are tender. Drain, reserving a cup of the cooking liquid. Let cool. Stir in the rice, turmeric and remaining ingredients. Place a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add the reserved cooking liquid and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat to low. Cook until rice is tender, 25 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,sambhar powder,lemon juice,coconut cream
title: Sambhar Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat ( i prefer 2 lbs of cubed stew meat ) | 2 cups coconut cream | 2 tablespoons sambhar powder ( or other mild curry powder ) | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: In a large saucepan melt 1/2 c. Of coconut cream over medium heat. Add 3 c. Of sambhar powder, stirring to blend thoroughly. Add 1/2 c. More of sambhar powder, stirring constantly to blend thoroughly. Stir in lemon juice. Add beef cubes, stirring to cover all pieces. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for about 2 hours or until beef is tender. Serve over steamed rice.

title: Dutch Oven Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 box frozen sausages | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic hot sauce | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Thaw sausages.

title: Easy "baked" Sandwiches
ingredients: 12 large lettuce leaves | 1 package soy mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place a lettuce leaf in a shallow dish. Smear the soy cheese into the lettuce leaves on top. Put the baking sheet on the ground. Bake for 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted and evenly browned.

title: Sneaky Mushroom Filling
ingredients: 18 -20 medium mushrooms | 1/4 - 1/3 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg ( or 1/4 tsp. ground nutmeg if prefer it )
instructions: Remove stems and the gill from each mushroom. Wipe off gills, slice mushrooms thinly and place in a small bowl. Add nutmeg to each mushroom and lightly grind until mixed.. Pour a small amount about 1/8 teaspoons of mushroom mixture at a time in your hands onto a square of waxed paper paper. Smooth until smooth. Dip other side of the mushrooms, in the mushroom mixture and roll up tightly.

title: Southern Style Sauteed Chicken and Sausage
ingredients: 1 whole boneless, skinless chicken breast half | sausage
instructions: Rinse chicken under cold water. Score the skin in several places with a knife on one side, the other to the same side. Score lines with fingers by cutting through chicken breast with knife, just from the skin of the chicken. Heat a skillet with a tight fitting lid over medium heat. Place sausage links in hot skillet, and cook until chicken breasts are beginning to brown. Turn chicken, and sprinkle sausage with cajun seasoning. Cook until sausage is no longer pink inside.

title: Black Bean and Olive Biscuits
ingredients: 1 cup black beans | 1/2 cup kalamata olives | 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 2 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Rinse the black beans. Place them in a large bowl and pour in enough water to cover them by an inch or two. Soak, covered, 24 hours. Drain and discard the liquid. Rinse black beans and pat dry. Cut the olives in half lengthwise, then cut each half crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Place the black beans in a saucepan and cover with water to a depth of 2 inches. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, covered, until beans are tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain beans. Place flour in a large bowl. Add the black beans and olives. Add hot pepper flakes. Combine and knead with hands until well blended. Turn onto lightly floured surface and knead by hand. Cut dough into 4 equal portions. Roll each portion into a ball. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Bake 20 minutes in preheated oven. Remove and turn oven down to 350 degrees f. Bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes until golden.

title: Sooji
ingredients: 1 cup semolina flour or 1 cup cornmeal | 1 cup rice wine ( if not available, 3 cups of rice wine may be used )
instructions: Combine the semolina and rice wine in a small saucepan over low heat. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. The mixture will thicken as it cools. Once it begins to bubble, remove from heat and gradually stir in the suji. Scoop into a bowl and allow to chill completely before serving. Keeps for 1 to 3 days if stored in an airtight container.

title: Pigs & Ham - British Fried Beans and More - Fried Beans
ingredients: 500 g cooking oil | 500 g ham, finely diced
instructions: Over medium heat in large skillet heat about 10 minutes until bacon is crisp. In the meantime clean and dry beans, add to skillet and cook. While browning ham add the cooked ham and fry. When ham melts, taste and adjust flavors. Pour off excess fat. Serve hot.

title: Beets on the Run
ingredients: 3 medium beets | 1/4 cup light brown sugar | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup instant espresso | 2 black cardamom pods | 1 ounce green speculaio tea leaves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Place the beet on aluminum foil with 2 inch sides facing upwards on a baking pan. Brush beet with a thin layer of glaze, then press lightly in the foil to form a packet. Bake for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes until tender. Cut beet slices into 1/2 inch dice. Serve warm or room temperature with green tea leaves. Keeps up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,monterey jack cheese,red pepper jelly,allspice
title: Uncle Bill's Cheese Spread Dip
ingredients: 1 lb shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 lb red pepper jelly | 1/4 lb onion flakes | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Brown the onion flakes over medium heat in some olive oil. Add cheese and mix well. Serve immediately.

title: Crispy Spinach
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 cup apple juice
instructions: Thaw spinach according to package directions. Add tamari and apple juice, stirring to coat spinach. Cover and let sit at least 1 hour.

title: Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 small cucumber, peeled, halved, seeds removed, and diced into small pieces | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley sprigs | 1 ounce red onion, cut into thin strips
instructions: Drain the cucumber, and gently squeeze out all the juice. Place in a large bowl with the parsley and red onion. Toss until well well mixed. Serve with pumpernickel or rye bread.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,red bell pepper,sake,tart shell,hot water,white radish,cheese tortellini
title: Miso Salad With Cheese Tortellini
ingredients: 14 ounces cheese tortellini, cooked | 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas ( drained ) | 1/2 cup white radish, sliced | 1/2 red bell peppers ( diced ) or 1/2 green bell pepper ( diced ) | 1 can tuna packed in oil, drained | 3 tablespoons sake | 2 tablespoons sake, sauce | 1/4 cup hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. In a medium bowl combine all of the salad ingredients and toss well to combine. Add the tuna and sake sauce and stir well. Add the hot water quickly, allowing the cheese to melt. If it seems too thick, add more hot water. Toss to combine and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: french haricot vert,pecorino romano cheese,salmon,soy sauce,tahini,tomato ketchup
title: Italian Pasta - Lightened
ingredients: 1 bunch french haricots vert | 400 g tinned salmon, skinned and chopped | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon fresh grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon tahini or 1 tablespoon a mixture of the three
instructions: Put the potatoes in a little saucepan with a lid. Add water until just covering them, and boil over a gentle heat until they are tender, about 15 20minutes depending on thickness. Meanwhile, drain cooked potatoes, and cool slightly in a cloth. Using a mandolin, cut the potatoes roughly into 1/3 inch chunks. Put the roughly chopped salmon in a bowl, add the potatoes, soy sauce and tomato ketchup. Add the pecorino and stir through until they're evenly mixed. Taste and adjust seasoning with the soy sauce and/or the tahini. Drain any excess water or stock off the pasta and place in a large bowl, stir through the tuna mixture and serve.

title: Garlicky Garlic Farfalle
ingredients: 500 g fresh farfalle pasta | 60 g fresh garlic
instructions: Heat a few tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan or wok. Meanwhile squeeze out any excess water from the garlic so that it can be mixed with the garlic in it. Dry the farfalle until it is all covered. Pour in enough water to cover and leave to swell for 30 minutes, until the pasta is cooked and tender. Drain the pasta and return it to the pan, adding the garlic and olive oil. Toss well, making sure it is coated in the garlic oil.

title: Chinese-Mushroom and Egg Noodle Kebabs
ingredients: 2 cups instant hot pudding and rice, bowls prepared | 2 large eggs noodles | 1 1/2 cups sliced fresh chinese mushrooms ( about 4 ounces ) | 2/3 cup chopped fresh chinese sweet pepper ( the sweet hot pepper, such as a combination of green and red peppers ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon extract | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Stir soup bowls and prepared instant hot pudding together in medium bowl to blend. Cover and refrigerate 30 min or firmer. Meanwhile, cook noodles according to package directions and rinse under cold water.

title: Nuoc Cham
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 2 large chipotle peppers ( stems removed )
instructions: Heat small dry skillet over medium heat. Add hot pepper and turn heat down to low. Cook pepper about 15 to 30 seconds. Pour in hot spice and stir for about 5 seconds. Transfer pepper using a slotted spoon to a plate and cover loosely with foil while you make the chutney.

title: Pesto Quesadilla (Mexican Quesadillas)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon shredded monterey jack cheese | 3 teaspoons unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder
instructions: Using a 1 1/2 or 2 inch plate, spread pesto onto one side of the tortilla. Place 1/2 tablespoon monterey jack cheese and 1 tablespoon monterey jack cheese into the center of the tortilla, overlapping slightly. Top with 1/2 tablespoon monterey jack cheese and 1 teaspoon cocoa.

title: Irish Country Rosemary Scones
ingredients: 2 ounces self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon pickling salt | 1 1/2 ounces celery ribs, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Lightly flour a baking sheet. In a large bowl, combine flour, rosemary and salt. Gradually stir in the celery. Knead the dough on the floured surface until smooth. Pat into a 12 inch wedge shaped scone, about 1/2 inch thick. Cut circle from half the wedge of dough, creating a total of 3 rounds. Brush top of scone lightly with a little water. Using a slotted spoon, lift scone and transfer to the prepared baking sheet. Score top of scone with a sharp knife into wedges of desired size. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden on top. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,beef tenderloin steak,lemon juice zest,tortilla,brie,broccoli,pork loin
title: Mountain Man (Beef and Pork)
ingredients: 2 italian sausages ( or your favourite pork and pork ) | 2 beef tenderloin steaks, 1 in thick | 1 cup brie, sliced ( or your favourite white brie ) | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, from concentrate or 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 3/4 cup frozen broccoli | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 bag tortillas, heated ( or 4 warmed flour tortillas, such as i have them in the freezer for easter-day )
instructions: Heat a 10 - 12 inch heavy skillet, until very hot. Add sausages or pork and cook over high heat, turning, until well browned on all sides and cooked through. While sausages are cooking, prepare your beef bouquet. Pour off most of the fat from the frying pan and add some olive oil to the pan. When the pan is hot, add bacon slices and sausages and cook for 4 - 5 minutes on each side or until they are medium. Remove from heat and set aside. Meanwhile, drain the brie from its wrapper and slice into 1 1/2” to 1 1/2” pieces. Add to frying pan and simmer for 20 minutes. Add lemon juice, remaining ingredients and simmer 5 minutes longer. Pour mixture back into frying pan and heat through. Serve warm tortillas onto plates and spoon mixture over. Serve hot, garnished with reserved bacon.

title: Herbed Olive Oil
ingredients: 1 lb kalamata olive, pitted | 2 cups loosely packed fresh basil, chopped ( i usually use 2 handfuls )
instructions: Pour olives in a large bowl and add the basil and about 2 1/2 cups of water. Stir gently and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Let stand for 6 hours. Strain the liquid reserving 3/4 cup. I sometimes use this to baste some of the flavored oil on my salads, etc, but if desired i use my hands to crush the olives until they are a coarse paste. Pour olive oil in jar, seal, or freeze until solid. This can be made up to 4 days ahead of time and frozen.

title: Indian Eggplant (Aubergine) and Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 6 large eggplants, peeled and quartered | 1/2 head napa cabbage, shredded | 1/2 head daikon radishes or 1/2 head savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 cup white distilled vinegar | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, cracked
instructions: Place the eggplant in a pot with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute, and remove the potato. Leave in the water with the eggplant and continue to boil for another 1/2 hour. Drain, and place on a plate lined with paper towels to dry. In a large bowl, mix together the eggplant and cabbage. Drizzle in the vinegar, and mix well. Let stand for at least 1 hour before using to marinate.

title: Pita Pizzas
ingredients: 1 pint heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks and creamy | 3 pita breads, cut into large wedges
instructions: Heat your oven on a rack set at 220°c/450°f put your pita wedges on a baking tray and prick them all over with a fork. Bake for a couple of minutes, then remove them. Wipe each pita, and then place in the oven for a few more minutes until the pita are golden. Take out to cool for a few minutes, then serve with desired garnishes.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,chicken portion,white wine vinegar,chili sauce,head iceberg lettuce,yellow squash,advocaat
title: Chicken Nachos With Yellow Squash, Broccoli and Provolone
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken portions | 1 1/2 lbs yellow squash | 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili sauce ( sirachi to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon unflavored accent | 16 ounces broccoli florets, thawed drained | 1/2 cup advocaat ( advocaat or anise flavoring )
instructions: Rinse the lettuce thoroughly with hot water, drain and pat dry. Cut the chicken portions into small bite size pieces and place them in a shallow baking dish. Cut the squash in half and cut it into 1/4 cubes about 1 inch long and 1 inch wide. Cut both the squash and the chicken breasts into thin slices about 1½ inch wide. Set them aside. In a small bowl, combine the vinegar, chili sauce and accent. Pour over the chicken. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator at least 8 hours, or overnight. Add the vegetables 15 minutes before serving. Sprinkle the advocaat or anise flavouring over top. Cook's notes, altho availaat or anise flavoring the recommended advokaat are optional, however it is quite unpleasant to balance the balance of the vinegar and anise. Affects may be altered according to the taste of your choice. Affects can be removed by adding hot water.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,spinach,ice,potato starch,apricot,sugar snap pea,apple,idaho potato
title: Potato & Apple Crispy Apricot Nests
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs idaho potatoes, thinly sliced | 1 ounce potato starch, sifted | 1/2 cup sugar snap pea, ends trimmed | 1 tablespoon granulated garlic and herb seasoning blend ( or equivalent ) | 2 apples, peeled, cored and shredded | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained | 1/2 cup dried apricot, halves | 1 cup ice, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Grease a 9 inch square pan or a similar sized baking dish. In a medium saucepan, cook potatoes in vegetable oil or margarine over medium heat, about 3 - 5 minutes. Stir in the starch and sugar, and stir for 1 minute, then add apples and cook stirring until apples begin to soften. Add spinach, apricots and cooked potatoes. Toss lightly, then add ice. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 45 - 60 minutes.

title: Yummy Spicy Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 6 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges | 2 large shallots, cut into two-inch chunks | 1/2 small red hot serrano chili pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange potato wedges in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. In a small bowl, stir together shallots, chili pepper, and olives. Drizzle vegetables with olive mixture.

Random Ingredients: meat chicken,blue cheese dressing,chicken breast half,miracle whip,pork roast,yellow squash
title: My Hearty Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, pounded thin | 3 pounds skinless, boneless pork roast, cut into pieces | 1/2 cup miracle whip | 3 cups blue cheese dressing | 1 package yellow squash, cut into thick slices | 4 bone-in chicken breast halves, pounded thin
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag or bowl, combine the chicken, pork, miracle whip, dressing and yellow squash. Reserve some of the cheese dressing for topping if desired. Toss to thoroughly combine then refrigerate for at least 2 hours, turning occasionally. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Meanwhile, remove the chicken from the marinade and place on a plate or aluminum foil baking sheet. Bake, basting frequently with the reserved cheese dressing until the chicken is no longer pink inside and the marinade is slightly reduced, about 15 minutes. Place the chicken and pork into a large casserole dish or roasting pan and broil until chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 10 minutes. Slice the chicken and serve.

title: Spicy Mexican Shrimp
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh mussels | 10 baby shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 small new mexico chile, seeded and chopped
instructions: Place mussels into a large pot filled with water and bring to a boil. Add shrimp and cover. When shells open, remove from boiling water and set aside. Heat an iron wok over medium high heat until a drop of water quickly sizzles and rises to the surface. Add mussels and shrimp with any liquid.

title: Beef & Sausage Buns With a Kick!
ingredients: 350 200 g beef broth | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 1/2 tablespoons yeast | 1 1/2 tablespoons braggs liquid aminos or 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried yeast | 400 g bulk sausage | 400 g chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons ground cloves
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine broth, grand marnier, yeast, braggs, garlic, cloves and chilies. Place over high heat and bring to a boil to kill the yeast. Lower heat, add the sausage and simmer for one hour. Add chickpeas, cook for an additional two hours. Serve hot.

title: Herbes De Terre Roast Rack of Lamb
ingredients: 1 rack of lamb | fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Preheat oven 180degc. Rub rosemary over lamb and rub with rosemary. Leave in oven to roast for 1 hour 20 minutes to 1 hour unstuck any excess air from the rack. Remove and allow to rest in a large shallow baking tin for 50 minutes to 1 hour before carving.

title: Kielbasa Lasagna
ingredients: 8 uncooked lasagna noodles | 12 ounces kielbasa, sliced diagonally | 1 cup chopped fresh parsley sprigs | 2 eggs | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 teaspoon dried basil, crushed
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f place lasagna noodles on a foil lined baking sheet with parchment paper. Beat eggs lightly in large bowl. Stir in grated kielbasa and parsley. Spread 1 tablespoon kielbasa mixture over noodles.

title: Beef and Orzo Vegetable Stew With Parsnips
ingredients: 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1 lb steak, cut into chunks | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/3 cup raisins | 1 can vegetable broth or ( 14 ounce ) can water | 2 tablespoons fresh parsnips, diced | 1/2 cup orzo pasta, uncooked
instructions: Heat oil in a dutch oven or deep heavy pot over medium heat. Add beef and cumin and cook, stirring, until beef is browned and crumbly. Stir in raisins and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer about 30 minutes, or until meat is tender. Stir in broth and orzo. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until orzo is tender. Sprinkle parsnips on top and serve.

title: Gado (Gado)
ingredients: 2 packages mung bean sprouts | 1 container apple slices | 1 small onion ring | 10 ounces beets, cut in halves
instructions: Soak the sprouts, the apple slices and the onion rings separately for at least 15 minutes. Steam or grill the beets until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain. Place the sprouts on a platter and garnish with the onion rings. Goes well with fish or vegetable bowls.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,coriander,red capsicum,chicken stock vegetable,chicken stock,snow pea
title: Capsicum and Parsley Pesto Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, leaves chopped finely | 500 g snow peas | 1 small red capsicum, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons basil pesto or 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic & herb spreadable pestle | 8 ounces chicken stock ( vegetable stock should be available to be gluten free ) | 2 tablespoons chicken stock ( vegetable stock should be gluten free )
instructions: Blanch and deseed the snow peas if preferred and coarsely shred them if you prefer. Heat the grill on high. Place the snow peas on a baking tray and bake on a baking sheet for 8 - 10 minutes or until beginning to soften, but still crunchy crisp. Allow to cool. Blend the coriander leaves, capsicum, pesto and stock in a food processor or blender. To serve, top with the snow peas, drizzling with extra pesto if desired.

title: Homemade Wood Polish
ingredients: 12 anchovy paste, anchovies with 100 % brine | herbs or spices, to use
instructions: If using salted anchovies, bring them to room temperature. In a clean jar with a tight fitting lid, pour in the anchovies and 1 1/2 tbsp of brine, and seal. Leave in the fridge overnight, or at least 3 weeks. It is important that you allow a little over 24 hours. Note, i remove the lid about 30 min before using. Remove the anchovies before using it.

title: Pernil-Style Conchiladas
ingredients: 1 pound pork tenderloin | 2 cups chopped broccoli | 1 jar pimento stuffed olives | 1 bottle rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut pork into 2 inch cubes. Place in a baking dish. Add broccoli, olives, and rum to pork. Turn dish to coat with rum. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until tender.

title: Cherie's Easy Tortilla Casserole
ingredients: 1 small baking potato, peeled | 3 cups bean sprouts | 3 teaspoons crumbled chicken bouillon | 10 tortillas
instructions: Place potato, skin on, in a roasting tin. Sprinkle evenly with bouillon. Carefully pour bean sprouts on top of potato. Bake at 220c for 20 minutes. Boil the bean sprouts for 15 minutes, until barely cooked and the skins pull off. Serve alongside tostados.

title: Pasta With Shrimp and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package jumbo shrimp ( or equivalent amount of fresh shrimp ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream ( heavy or half and half works best ) | 4 ounces button mushrooms | 1 finely chopped green chili | 1 lb pasta ( spaghetti, linguine or linguine will work best )
instructions: Bring 6 quarts of water to a boil in a wide pot. Meanwhile, remove the shrimp either from shells or tails and throw off the heads. Rinse the shrimp well and clean off well with cold water. Shake off excess water. Slice the shrimps into bite size pieces and set aside. Boil the cream in a large pot for a few minutes until a light haze rises to the surface. Add the shrimp pieces and mushrooms and cook over low heat for 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat and cool thoroughly. While the shrimp and mushrooms are cooking, cook your pasta according to package directions, according to package directions. Drain. Serve sauce over cooked pasta and toss to coat.

title: Crispy Romaine Leaves
ingredients: 3 cups romaine lettuce | 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 cup loosely packed fresh mint leaves | 3 cups oil for frying, or as needed
instructions: Stir romaine lettuce, olive oil, and mint leaves in a bowl with a fork.

title: Tandoori Recipes (Gingered Butter)
ingredients: 2 cups margarine | 1/2 cup fresh ginger, minced | 4 cups fresh mint leaves
instructions: Beat the margarine in a heavy saucepan over medium heat until light and fluffy. Stir in the minced ginger and mint leaves and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture becomes dark and the mint has turned a rich golden color, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,hamburger,double cream,self rising flour,peanut oil,pineapple juice,cranberry,caribbean jerk marinade
title: Crispy Pork Fried With Pineapple, Cranberries, and Pork
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 4 tablespoons dried cranberries | 3 tablespoons self rising flour | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon caribbean jerk marinade | 3 sprigs fresh dill weed | 1/2 cup double cream | 3 tablespoons double cream | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: In a bowl, combine the hamburger, cranberries, flour, and pineapple juice. Stir to combine ingredients. Place a small skillet over medium high heat. Add oil, or enough to coat a 1 1/2 inch depth. Dip each hamburger in crumbs.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,corn niblets,caraway seed,guacamole,chili oil,baby lima bean,bibb lettuce,green bean
title: Quick Hawaiian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen baby lima beans, thawed and drained | 1 head bibb lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces | 1 pound fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 1/2 cups canned corn niblets | 1 package frozen guacamole | 3 tablespoons chili oil | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 whole green cardamom pod
instructions: Combine red beans through cardamom in small bowl. Toss with lettuce, green beans, corn niblets, guacamole, chili oil and cardamom seeds. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Passover Baked Beans and Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces ground round | 12 ounces shredded chives | 14 ounces mixed beans | 4 1/2 ounces matzo cake meal | 2 -3 cups chicken stock, heated
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Coat a small baking dish with cooking spray. In medium bowl, lightly mix together meat, chives, beans and matzo meal. Put meat mixture into prepared dish and bake for 20 minutes. Bake for 5 minutes more or until hot and golden brown on top. Serve with mustard and green salad.

title: Cabbage Risotto
ingredients: 10 ounces cabbage | 5 cups half-and-half | 6 ounces arborio rice | 3 ounces peanut oil
instructions: Shred finely. Boil the rice. Place in a pan with half and half and peanut oil. Stir. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally. When it starts to bubble, drain. Add cabbage and arborio. Cook over very low heat, stirring frequently until all of the liquid has been absorbed and there are only a couple of small pieces of cabbage sticking out. Serves that's it.

title: Applesauce and Lentil Bites
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg green lentils, washed and drained ( green chard may be used ) | 1 medium onion, peeled and finely chopped | 1 hard-boiled egg, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | 500 ml coke ( coke in a can in the can, not the hot stuff ) | 2 tablespoons red apple chocolate ( chocloate ) | 50 -60 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: If you are using green chard stalks, remove the thick ribs and the ribs and finely chop the stalk. Place the lentils, onion, hard boiled egg, apple and apple sauce in a large saucepan and stir well. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat, partially cover and simmer for 45 minutes, or till the lentils are tender and the liquid has thickened slightly. Remove from heat, stir in the chocloate and chill.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,tomato,tomato sauce,marsala wine,great northern bean,white corn tortilla,butter
title: Whole Wheat Enchiladas With Marnier, White Corn, and Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 2 cups white corn tortillas, torn into 1/4-inch pieces | 2 cans great northern beans, undrained | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes, undrained | 1 cup marsala wine, divided | 1 package plain whole wheat flour
instructions: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Toss in the tortilla pieces one at a time, and cook just until tortillas soften, about 10 seconds per side. Transfer to a sheet of waxed paper.

title: Rooster's Quick Red Beans & Veggies
ingredients: 3 cups red kidney beans | 1 - 1 1/2 lb baby carrots
instructions: Place beans in a large saucepan, cover with water and cook over medium heat until almost all the water in the beans has evaporated. Reduce heat and simmer covered for about 1 hour and 30 minutes or until beans are tender. Stir occasionally to keep beans from sticking. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Transfer the contents of the saucepan to a large serving bowl. Drain the cooked beans, discarding water and vegetables. Set aside and let cool. When beans are cool, stir through the cooled beans into the carrot mixture. Transfer to a shallow baking dish and refrigerate overnight to let spices marinate. The following day, preheat oven to 425°f sprinkle the top and sides of the dish with 1/4 teaspoons salt. Arrange the vegetables in a single layer in an large roasting pan and bake until vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Easy Fennel and Green Pea Pierogies
ingredients: 1 package frozen green peas | 1 package frozen green peas | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons margarita mix | 1/2 cup prepared crusty breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Defrost the frozen green peas well and combine with the fennel seed, margarita mix, and enough bread crumbs to wet the peas. Fill pastry bag with peas mixture and roll the pierogies, seam side down, to seal in the stuffing. Repeat until all of the pierogies are done. Place in a well buttered casserole dish, and bake uncovered for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: egg white,cream chicken soup,vegetable oil,cherry,gouda cheese
title: Cherry Gougeres
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream ( can be reduced-fat if desired ) | 1 1/2 cups gouda cheese, shredded | 1 egg white, slightly beaten | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: In a large bowl combine the sour cream, cheese, and egg white. In a saucepan over medium heat bring soup to a boil. Add sour cream mixture.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,tomato juice,pecan,bacon bit,baking powder,chili sauce,red pepper flake,ginger root
title: Spicy Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced bacon bits | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger root | 3/4 cup chopped pecans | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 drops chili sauce | 1/3 cup tomato juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: In a small, heavy skillet, cook bacon bits over medium heat. Stir in ginger, pecans, chili sauce, cabbage, crushed red pepper, and chili sauce. Cook and stir until cabbage is coated.
