Stir in tomato juice and baking powder. Reduce heat to low and simmer 10 minutes, or until cabbage is heated through.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,zucchini,bake buttermilk flaky biscuit,green chilies,beef sirloin steak
title: Green Chile Beef and Zucchini
ingredients: 2 lbs beef sirloin steaks, thinly sliced | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 1 package refrigerated buttermilk flaky biscuits | 1 cup zucchini, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine sliced steak and bread crumbs.

title: Authentic Ramen Noodle Beef Tamago
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs smoked beef, cut into thin strips | 1 bag corn husks, soaked in water | 1 1/2 lbs andouille sausages, sliced thin | 1 1/2 cups ketchup | 12 ounces ramen noodles | 1/2 cup sake | 2 teaspoons black pepper | 1 tablespoon cilantro
instructions: Rinse, drain and soak the corn husks for about 30 minutes. Place the beef, sausages and half of the ketchup in a large sauce pan and bring to a boil, then simmer for 30 minutes. Place the noodles in a large bowl, add the remaining ketchup, ramen and sake, and toss well to coat. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add noodles, and cook for about 7 minutes or until tender. Drain. Stir in the cilantro, adjust seasoning, and serve.

title: Mashed Potatoes and Cheese With a Kick
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, scrubbed, peeled and diced ( about 6 medium ) | 4 tablespoons granulated sugar | 1 jar diced pimientos | 1 jar chopped raspberries | 5 cups all-purpose white flour | provolone cheese, grated
instructions: In a large pot on high heat bring water to a boil and add potatoes.

title: Homemade Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 bottle taco seasoning | 1/2 cup dijon-style mustard
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Place in hot sterilized jars and process in water bath for 10 minutes to reconstitute.

title: Roasted Veggie Seasoning
ingredients: 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 drop hot red pepper sauce
instructions: Dry roast on baking sheet or cookie sheet in oven at 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until done. Do not over crowed. Cool and place in air tight container. Keeps overnight in the fridge.

title: Spicy Cabbage Salsa
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage, chopped | 1 large head cauliflower, chopped | 1 jar chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning
instructions: Stir fry cauliflower and cabbage leaves, drain. Mix salsa, lime juice and italian seasoning into cabbage mix.

title: The Best Plum Tomato Burgers
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes, cut in half | 1 tablespoon nutmeg, freshly grated | 1/4 - 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup water | 2 -3 tablespoons chutney
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Place tomatoes cut side down on grill grate or in toasted pita bread pan. They should be slightly blackened. Turn tomatoes frequently until both sides are slightly charred about 1½ - 2 minutes a side with chutney. Remove from grill and season with nutmeg. Sprinkle panko on plate. Sprinkle tomato halves with red pepper flakes and press lightly with a spatula into bread crumbs. Spoon tomato halves, straight side facing in, on toasted bread crumbs. Use additional bread crumbs if necessary to make this a thick dish, as tomatoes tend to lose this shape when baking. Place tomatoes on hot grill, close lid, and place toasted pitas on a baking sheet. Grill for 3 - 4 minutes or until slightly toasted and crumbs are lightly browned. Remove and serve with chutney.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,sesame seed,celery rib,bamboo shoot,lime wedge,jicama
title: Mock Devonshire Bamboo Shoots-Sesame Seed Relish
ingredients: 1 lb jicama, peeled and cut into small sticks | 1 lb bamboo shoot, drained, cut in 1-inch strips | 4 celery ribs, chopped in 1/2-inch pieces | 4 -6 ounces white chocolate, chopped coarsely | 1 2/3 cups sesame seeds | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray 12 inch nonstick skillet on medium high heat, add jicama.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger buns | 1 1/2 lbs mexican blend cheese ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup dry parmesan cheese
instructions: Cut buns in half.

title: Chili Cheese & Nuts in Shell
ingredients: 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce | 90 g whole flakey seed cookies | 1/3 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 3 tablespoons chopped sunflower seeds
instructions: Combine enchilada sauce and yogurt over a small heat resistant bowl. Stir fry seeds in oil for about 1 minute. Drain on paper towel. Spread on cheese and sprinkle with seeds. Serve with warm chili beans.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,sharp cheddar cheese,red bell pepper,mustard oil,yellow pepper,cayenne pepper
title: Spicy Yellow Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard oil | 1 medium red bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1 jar roasted red peppers in oil, drained | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Mix cornstarch with mustard oil in bowl. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Bacon and Mustard Powder
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon bacon fat, minced
instructions: Add mustard oil into pan. Add the bacon fat and cook until bacon bits are slightly crispy about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,button mushroom,milk,garnish,guacamole,saffron strand,red pepper flake,maraschino cherry
title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Tamarind Chai (Mirchi Ka Ruhu)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon milk | 1 large saffron strand | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 10 button mushrooms, sliced | 3 -6 saffron strands, ground | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes, to taste | 1 tablespoon fresh maraschino cherry, snipped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons garnish, of your choice ( red onion rings, cilantro, green and purple bell peppers ) ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons guacamole ( storebought or homemade )
instructions: In a medium size pot, bring milk to a simmer over medium heat. Add saffron strands and allow to dissolve completely. Add the tamarind paste and whisk until blended. Strain the milk mixture through cheesecloth and put back into the pot. Simmer over medium low heat for 15 minutes. Add mushrooms and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until thickened. Remove from heat, place in a serving dish, and garnish if desired. Serve immediately and enjoy,.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,celery rib,maraschino cherry,sunflower seed,chicken bouillon cube,cauliflower floret,yellow mustard,parmesan cheese
title: Cauliflower and Toasted Seed Crush
ingredients: 2 cauliflower florets, blanched and chopped into small florets | 3 fresh maraschino cherries ( optional, i use the juice from one ) | 1 container sunflower seeds | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon prepared yellow mustard | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: In a large pan set on medium heat bring the cauliflower, cherries, sunflower seeds, 1 tsp. Drippings from chicken bouillon cube, soya sauce, yellow mustard. Cook until cauliflower and cherry mixture is tender and flavours are fully blended together. Add cheese and toss. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Radishes & Pizza Chips
ingredients: 1 package prepared pizza dough | 1/4 cup corn oil | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1/4 cup radishes, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Roll pizza dough out on a floured surface to a 12 inch round. Remove dough from oiled bowl & poke holes 3 or 4 times using a fork. Brush dough with corn oil & sprinkle heavily with taco seasoning. Layer radishes over pizza then sprinkle generously with taco seasoning mixture. Bake in a 450°f oven for 15 minutes then reduce heat to 400f, bake for 15 additional minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Sausage and Cabbage Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot italian sausage, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup rice noodles ( dried ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 2 tablespoons tarragon-dried cherries | 1 small head cabbage, finely shredded | 2 bags hot salted snap bags or ( 10 ounce ) bags hot rice bags, each 4 inches in diameter
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions using tarragon, tarragon and cherries. Arrange cabbage around top and bottom of salad.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,herb seasoning mix,cream celery soup,chive
title: Low Fat Creamy Chive-Sour Cream Celery Bake
ingredients: 1 can reduced fat cream of celery soup | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fat-free parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | herb seasoning mix, of your choice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine soup and cheeses in a medium bowl, stir well. Combine with chives. Spray a 9 x 13 pan with nonstick spray. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Linguine With Eggs, Tomato, and Fenugreek
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine pasta ( or other short pasta ) | 2 large eggs | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/8 teaspoon fenugreek ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook linguine in boiling water for 8 minutes. Drain and return to hot pan. Add egg and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add basil, oregano, salt, cayenne pepper, fenugreek or other desired topping.

Random Ingredients: courgette,poblano chile,asiago cheese,canola oil,citron,fruit,vegetable bouillon cube,white hominy
title: Creamy Poblano, Asiago, and Hominy Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 poblano chile, seeded and finely diced ( optional ) | 2 vegetable bouillon cubes, dissolved in | 1 cup hot white hominy, rinsed and drained | 3 3 cups diced firm ripe tomatoes or 3 cups roma tomatoes, undrained and chopped, about 1 cup | 1 cup loosely packed chopped mixed fresh fruit, such as cranberries, papaya, cherries, and peaches | 1 cup finely grated asiago cheese
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and add poblano. Cook, stirring frequently, until the poblano is lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add bouillon cubes and mix. Pour in the hot hominy, stirring gently. Stir in tomatoes and their juices and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer over medium heat until flavors have blended, about 15 minutes. Just before serving, stir in the mixed fruit, cheese and poblano. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature, then chill for at least 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: steak,cheddar cheese,cumin,thai fish sauce,russet potato,fruit,pizza sauce
title: Thai Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb steak, cut 1 inch thick | 12 slices cheddar cheese | 2 medium russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 jar pizza sauce | 4 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1 cup fresh fruit, cut up
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Brush grate of grill with vegetable oil. Place steaks on grill. Bake steak for 15 minutes or until medium rare. Slice into 1 inch strips. Place potatoes on paper towel, and drizzle with some of the oil. Toss to coat, and set aside. Remove steak from grill and place on a sprayed cookie sheet. Top with cheese and potato. Bake, layered on 4 slices of the cheese, until melted. To serve, stack 3 slices cheese and 3 slices steak on top of the last piece of cheese. Sprinkle with cumin, garnish with fresh fruit, and serve right away or refrigerate until serving.

title: Mama's Easy Beefy Shells
ingredients: 1 can beef stock ( i know the kind is a measuring 1/4 cup. but i think the real stuff is worth it ) | fresh oregano, lots of it, chopped | 1 package uncooked large pasta shells
instructions: Bring the beef stock to a boil over high heat in a medium sauce pan. Add the chopped oregano and toss to coat. Add 1/2 of the uncooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: cayenne powder,cracker crumb,rye bread,tahini,basmati rice,black pepper,tamarind paste,celery
title: Indian Taufganous Pilaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon cayenne powder | 1 tablespoon cracked black pepper | 1 tablespoon chopped toasted cracker crumb | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1/2 cup basmati rice, soaked 15 minutes and drained | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil or parsley
instructions: Combine tahini, tamarind paste, cayenne powder, black pepper, cracker crumbs, celery, rice, and basil or parsley in a food processor and process to a coarse paste. Serve at room temperature or refrigerate for up to 1 week..

title: Aeblegrod Med Fløde (Veal Medallions With Apples)
ingredients: 2/3 cup fresh fruit ( sliced in strips or small triangles ) | 1/3 cup whipping cream ( heavy ) | pepper | 1/2 lb veal ( sliced thin ) | 1 red capsicum ( sliced in strips or slices ) | 2 tablespoons mixed dried fruit ( craisens )
instructions: Stir all the ingredients in a small pan and cook over low heat for 4 minutes or so. Set the eetables aside. Divide the eetables between four serving plates and top with the medallions. Drizzle the juices from the pan over the medallions and serve immediately.

title: Fish Fingers
ingredients: 1 lb fish, any firm fleshed white fish | 3 medium onions | 6 -8 dried apricots or 6 -8 raisins | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Wash and slice onions into rings lengthwise and set aside. Place apricots in a single layer on parchment paper, sprinkle with asafetida and almond extract and allow to sweat off. Remove parchment paper, and layer the onion rings over them. Place fish on and around the onion layer. Brush fish with egg wash. If you're using raisins, sprinkle with them during last few minutes of cooking. Place the top piece of parchment on a cookie sheet so that the whole thing adheres tightly to parchment. Place the entire cookie sheet inside your oven for 40 to 50 minutes. After 20 minutes, check to see if fish is done and if desired, take the fish out of the oven. Serve with rice and veggies.

Random Ingredients: feta,cornish hen,dijon mustard,sugar,peppercorn,beef chuck,peanut oil,brean sprout
title: Beef With Pepperoncini
ingredients: 1 cornish hen | 1/2 cup fresh corned beef chuck bone | 1/8 cup raw bran sprouts | 1/2 cup fresh flat-leafed pista or 1/2 cup baby peppercorn, pounded | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/4 - 1/2 cup granulated sugar | 1/4 cup peanut oil | fresh ground peppercorn ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the hen inside and out thoroughly in cold water. Trim excess fat and set hen aside. Using poultry shears, cut 6 slits in the hen from top and bottom to within 1/2 of the lower back bone. Insert a peppercorn into each slit. Truss legs of each hen by cutting down between breast meat and wing tips. Combine the corned beef, peppercorn brass and 1/4 cup water in a large skillet. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer over low heat for 1 hour. Transfer meat to a bowl and cool, then remove bones. Reserve liquid in skillet. Cut away skin and discard. Remove meat from bones, then cut into pieces, removing any tough part of the neck. Discard skin.

title: Spicy Condensed Milk
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried soy milk | 1 tablespoon chopped of your choice mixed spice, such as mint, paprika, garlic or cumin | 1 serrano pepper | 1 red capsicum
instructions: Combine everything in a pan or small bowl. Bring to the boil and then remove from heat. Allow to cool a little.

title: Real Easy Hominy and Cauliflower Starter
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter or margarine | 1 can white hominy, rinsed
instructions: Drain most of the water out. Cut off all water and set aside. Melt margarine in a large stock pot over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until creamy. Stir in hominy. Return to a boil and reduce heat to medium low. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. To keep hot, set aside for later use. Serve with hot, not hot, flour tortillas, shredded cheese, or corn to dip or croutons.

title: Mexican Green Apple Pie.
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper | 2 plantains | 1 lb chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1 cup dry roasted salted peanut
instructions: Slice the green bell pepper and plantains vertically into chunks and place in a large, deep skillet. Cook over low medium heat until the bell pepper is completely cool. Add the chopped up green bell pepper and plantains and cook until tender. Combine all of the ingredients and process until smooth. Pour into an ungreased pie plate. If you want as an appetizer filling, you can also stuff it into your favorite pie crust.

title: Sara
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon ground cilantro | 8 slices rye bread or 8 slices egg noodles | 1/3 cup couscous ( optional )
instructions: Mix together lamb, egg white and cilantro. Using hands form lamb mixture into 10 x 12 inch log shapes. Arrange on a platter arrange rice on the end of the log shaped meat in a horizontal strip. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand 25 minutes. Unwrap meat and slice 1/4 inch thick on the bias. Cook over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until meat is lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Remove meat from the pan and place on a platter. Pour off the cooking excess fat from the pan. Put a bowl of water on the heat and add the ramen noodles. Cover and cook for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,fennel seed,mustard powder,monterey jack pepper cheese,gala apple,marshmallow,pasta
title: Aegean Mac 'n Cheese
ingredients: 3 cups dry pastas ( about 3 1/2 cups ) | 2 1/2 lbs granny smith apples, peeled, cored, shredded | 2 ounces graham apples, peeled, shredded | 2 ounces gala apples, peeled, shredded | 2 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 16 large marshmallows
instructions: Cook pasta and keep warm in a saucepan. Combine mac 'n cheese, the apples, cheese mixture and mustard powder in a bowl. Stir in fennel seed. Top with marshmallows, if desired, and sprinkle with additional cheese. Serve with toast soldiers.

title: Stir-Fried Broccoli & Cornmeal
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs fresh broccoli florets | 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal ( cornmeal will also work ) | 1 medium peeled firm-ripe yellow cornshredder ( about 12 oz., can also use store-bought store-bought roasted corn ), coarsely grated ( about 12 oz. )
instructions: Cut steamer insert into a large bowl of cold water or ice water.

title: Blueberry and Rice Pancakes With Fried Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 400 g rice noodles | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 175 g blueberries
instructions: Prep and fry the noodles till done. Cut into small pieces and keep aside. Make the sauce, add all the ingredients in a pan and combine. Cook till buby, then strain and divide immediately into 4 portions. Place in a serving bowl and pour most of the sauce over, allowing the sauce to spread evenly.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,head cauliflower,baby spinach,white bread,coca cola,single cream,cream wheat
title: Creamy Spinach and Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach | 1 head cauliflower | 1 tablespoon cream of wheat | 10 slices white bread | 250 g cottage cheese | 200 ml coca-cola | 100 ml single cream
instructions: Rinse and wash the spinach, then cut the leaves in half. Boil the leaves separately in water with the cream of wheat for one minute. Drain and run under cold water. Drain well and chop finely. Toast the bread. Spread a thin layer of butter on a tray. Spread a layer of spinach, then a layer of cauliflower. Add a layer of cottage cheese, then a sprinkling of bread. Repeat for all the layers. Sprinkle with coca cola. Add a thin layer of cream on top. Garnish with chopped corriander or mint leaves.

title: Famous Fresh Sage
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh sage leaves or 2 bunches frozen sage leaves, thawed | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon, crushed
instructions: Place the sage leaves in a wide, shallow dish. Sprinkle with the tarragon.

title: Creamy Cheese Dressing
ingredients: 16 ounces cream of chicken soup, can or ( 10 ounce ) can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup chopped pimiento-stuffed pepperoncini pepper ( about 1 pepperoni pepper ) | 2 cups fresh bean sprouts, cooked | 1 cup chopped pea pods, cooked | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tarragon, or | 1/4 cup snipped fresh parsley | 2/3 cup grated parmigiano ( parmesan for sprinkling, and if it has dried out, a grated carrot for sprinkling ) | 3 tablespoons toasted oats
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 3 quart container with a tight fitting lid. Stir until well blended. Cover and chill overnight.. Store tightly covered at room temperature. Note, may be served as a salad condiment for a complete meal that holds its shape.

title: Beef Burgundy on a Bun
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun | 1 lb london broil beef, cut into 3/4 inch slices | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 3/4 cup cooked pasta
instructions: In medium skillet, cook beef and worcestershire sauce until meat is browned and cooked, drain off fat. Break up beef with hands. Dip bun in boiling water. Spoon equal amounts of meat and sauce into prepared bun. Top with desired amount of pasta.

title: Cauliflower - Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 4 ounces milk chocolate | 1 cup milk chocolate | 5 ounces cauliflower | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup dry red wine
instructions: Microwave milk chocolate and milk choclate in 1/2 cup glass measure until mixture melts. Mix flour and wine together in medium bowl. Drain cauliflower and break up pieces with large spoon.. Add to chocolate mixture. Microwave on medium high for 2 minutes. Add to chocolate mixture on low for another 2 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Hot Dog
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper | 1 bag prunes | 1 bouquet garni | fat ( for frying )
instructions: Slice poblano pepper into 1/4 thick slices. Place pepper slices in non stick skillet and place on medium heat. The objective here is to cook the pepper for about 5 minutes on each side. When they are almost dark and blistered on both sides, carefully remove from skillet. Once they are cool enough to handle and a bit charred on the edges, peel and crush it and set aside in a bowl. Drain prunes in a strainer. Slice peppers into strips about 1/4 wide and 1/4 thick. Set aside in a large bowl. Slice poblano pepper in small pieces about the size of the prunes. Add to large bowl and toss. Set aside. Mix bouquet garni in pan with a little bit of water. Stir frequently on medium heat. Add pepper strips to pot and stir to mix. Keep stirring until pepper strips are tender and all liquid has been absorbed. Add the prunes and mix well. Serve immediately. Enjoy.

title: Peanut Smoked BBQ Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs flank steaks, trimmed of excess fat | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 cups cherry brandy | 3/4 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon roasted red chili powder
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or grill pan over high heat. Add the steak and brown well. Stir in the cherry brandy, then cook for 10 - 15 minutes, then stir in sour cream and red chile powder and heat through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,butter,vegetable stock,coleslaw mix,red enchilada sauce,bread flour
title: Deliciously Easy Cabbage Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 cups shredded coleslaw mix | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup bread flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, melt butter in a sauce pan over medium heat. Stir in the coleslaw mix, mushroom soup, vegetable stock, and enchilada sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and add bread flour gradually to soup mixture, stirring constantly. Transfer mixture to a bowl, and add shredded cabbage mixture. Fill each enchilada with soup mixture. Place enchiladas in the baking dish, filling almost to the top of the dish. Bake in preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, or until bubbly and slightly browned.

title: Prawn and Pepperoncini
ingredients: 600 g prawns, raw | 2 red chili peppers | 1 cup sweet pepperoncini pepper, sliced | 400 ml coconut milk
instructions: Peel the prawns removing the heads and shells. Reserve heads and shells. Rinse prawns and pat dry with a paper towel. Cut chilli peppers in half, remove seeds and white membrane. Heat a wok over high heat, add 1/4 cup water and 2 teaspoons of the oil. Add prawns and stir fry for 2 minutes, remove and keep warm. Repeat with remaining oil and prawn heads. Add chillies and peppers. Stir fry for 3 minutes. Add milk and bring to the boil on high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Serve prawns on a plate, spooning sauce over.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,chambord raspberry liquor,red curry paste,ranch salad dressing,basil leaf,gingerroot,sage leaf,green bean
title: Ranch Bean Dip With Chambord
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups chopped green beans | 1/2 cup dried kidney beans | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons chambord raspberry liquor | 1 tablespoon chambord raspberry liquor | 1 teaspoon finely chopped gingerroot | 1 teaspoon basil leaves | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh sage leaf | 1/3 cup ranch salad dressing
instructions: Combine beans, greens, kidney beans, curry paste, chambord, liqueur and ginger root in a food processor and process until smooth. Pour into a bowl and chill. Serve with warm Ranch dressing. Note, to make chambord dip, combine all ingredients and blend well.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,vegetable oil,new york,curry powder,konbu,nam pla
title: Konbu Ke Atar With Lamb
ingredients: 2 pounds lamb shoulder, chopped | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1/4 pound new york strip steaks, diced | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil, divided ( optional ) | 1 pound konbu ( kurage ) noodles ( cellophane noodles ) | 2 tablespoons nam pla ( fish sauce )
instructions: Grind lamb with curry powder in a food processor until thick and pasty.

title: Avocado and Date-Stuffed Avocados With Peppercorns
ingredients: 1 ripe avocado, peeled | 2 dates, halved | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 teaspoon lemon, zest of | 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Cut avocado in half lengthwise, remove pit and peel out the pit using a teaspoon. Combine the avocado flesh, dates, bamboo shoots, zest, black pepper and vanilla and mix well. The resulting avocado mixture can be kept in the refrigerator for up to a day. Slice avocados crosswise into 1/4 slices. To serve, arrange slices in serving dishes or glasses and top with desired amount of the peach ranch dressing. Sprinkle with additional peppercorns for presentation.

title: Easy Mexican Burgers
ingredients: 4 hamburger | 1 lb. italian parsley, minced | 12 taco shells, 8 inch size, with patter
instructions: Combine the hamburger and parsley together. Add 4 taco shells, and place on baking sheets/pitcher, or other shallow baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap and press plastic onto the top to make the shells easier to handle. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes, or until heated through. Serve with your favorite toppings.

title: Lemongrass Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup lemongrass, minced | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: Mix the minced lemon grass, mustard seeds, and dijon mustard together in a bowl with a whisk until well blended. To prevent the mixture from getting too dry, stir in any amount of water to make a thinner sauce. Cover, and chill for 2 to 3 hours, shaking the bowl occasionally.

title: Baked Corn Dogs (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dry cornflour | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 3 lime wedges
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Place cornflour in a large mixing bowl, and gradually add a teaspoon or so of cold water. Dry mustard seeds in a small frying pan over a medium heat, shaking and stirring for a few seconds until they begin to pop. Quickly pour the seeds onto a baking tray lined with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 - 15 minutes until crispy and golden brown. Serve immediately with lime wedges.

title: Best Ever Basting Sauce #1 (Sweet & Mild)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon molasses | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar
instructions: Stir together the molasses and vinegar until the sugar dissolves. Use immediately for basting. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: green pea,sandwich bun,celery,green bell pepper,beef roast,pearl barley
title: Stuffed Beef Roast With Vegetables
ingredients: 2 lbs beef roast | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 2 tablespoons dried split peas | 2 tablespoons chopped celery | 2/3 green bell pepper, chopped | 12 sandwich buns, split
instructions: If using beef roast with the bone in place, remove the bone, discard the skin. Place the meat on a rack in a shallow baking pan in a single layer. If using a meat thermometer, carefully remove it from its cup. Set the oven to 325 degrees farenheit. To make sure you don't burn your roos, cover the pan loosely with foil, then place in the oven. Bake for 1 3/4 hours checking for tenderness and fat level. Remove roast from oven, reserving the pan juices. Place the pearl barley in a large pot and boil, covered, until tender, about 45 minutes. Drain and allow the meat to come to room temperature. Meanwhile, drain the beef fat and then mash well with the cooking barley. Add the peas, celery and bell pepper, mixing well. Let the roast rest at room temperature for 15 minutes. If you need to thin, strain the cooking liquid. If you wish to serve the meat on it's own, transfer the beef to a cutting board and pull the fat off the beef and discard. Add enough cooking liquid to the pot to reach the desired consistency. Remove the crusts. Fill the sandwich buns with the roasted beef mixture and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white bread,sunflower oil,beef rib,red bell pepper,cumin powder,prosciutto ham,liquid smoke,cucumber
title: BBQ Short Ribs With Homemade Smoked Ham & Cucumber-Cereal
ingredients: 4 beef short ribs, approx | 5 slices white bread | 12 slices prosciutto ham or 12 slices duck bacon, cut in 2 pieces | 1 cup cucumber, peeled, seeded and cut into quarters | 1 cup red bell pepper, halved and deseeded | 1 cup sunflower oil | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke, to your taste
instructions: Preheat your barbeque or grill to medium high. Place all the ingredients but the last five in a medium size bowl and mix. Cover with cling wrap and refrigerate for at least an hour, or ideally overnight. Take the short ribs out of the fridge on a cutting board and trim away any fat. You should have 3 to 4 skewers. Place half the bread onto the barbeque, top with half the short ribs and top with half the ham. Sprinkle the cumin over the ham and ribs. Top with the rest of the ham and then the cumin. Grill under high for about 8 minutes. Remove from the grill. Turn the ribs over and repeat this process until the ham is cooked through, and meat has begun to bleed and caramelise. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,custard powder,flour tortilla,serrano pepper,salmon fillet,ice water
title: Sauerkraut Salmon Wraps with Spicy Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet, skin removed | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons custard powder | 2 tablespoons water | 4 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and thinly sliced
instructions: Place salmon in a medium sized plastic bag. In a small bowl, blend sauerkraut with custard powder and water. Stir to combine. Reserve 3/4 of the sauerkraut mixture, and pour remaining sauerkraut mixture over salmon. Coat fish with remaining mixture. Wrap tortillas in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes or longer.

title: Mae's Easy Grilled Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 12 corn on the cob, husks and silk removed | 1/2 cup tomato puree ( puree of your choice )
instructions: Brush the corn with olive oil. Place on a rack set on a barbecue grill over medium heat. Place one corn cob on the grill and top with another corn cob and cook until flesh has turned yellow, about 10 minutes. Turn and continue to cook until flesh has grill marks and corn is cooked evenly, about 15 minutes longer. Remove from heat and drain on paper towels. Transfer charred corn husks to a bowl or warmed platter and toss with tomato puree until just covered. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Rice with Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups prepared rice | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 4 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Spray 2 - 8 x 2 1/2 inch deep dish pie plates or baking dishes with nonstick cooking spray. In saucepan, place rice and soup in microwave. Microwave, covered, on high for three minutes, remove lid and stir. Microwave on high for five minutes, remove from microwave. Stir. Microwave cheese to melt. Mix in cheese, making the mixture into four patties. Microwave for another five minutes or to desired doneness. Serve over rice.

title: Custard (Elegant)
ingredients: 200 g double cream | 50 g cinnamon bark, cracked in several pieces
instructions: Divide cream into 6 equal portions and fill each portion with cracker. Place 2 cassava or other mould on the board and place the cinnamon bark in the centre. Roll the cassava or mould with a rolling pin or a roller or metal spoon to make a cylindrical mould. Whip the cream and sprinkle cinnamon bark over cassava or mould.

Random Ingredients: banana,rice vinegar,cornflour,almond,red food coloring,puff pastry,pecorino romano cheese,juniper berry
title: Almond & Banana Rice Paper Rolls
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried juniper berries | 2 teaspoons finely grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 ripe bananas, cut into halves lengthways | 1/2 cup toasted almond | 2 teaspoons red food coloring, or as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the pastry sheets on the baking sheet, cut side down, making space of a 25cm x 30cm rectangle. Brush the pastry with oil and bake for 5 minutes, or until the pastry is just beginning to soften. Remove the pastry from the oven and reduce the oven temperature to 200 degrees centigrade. Place the bacon and smashed almonds into a mini cup or small dish and microwave for 2 minutes until just beginning to brown. Add the food coloring and stir until combined. Place the banana cut side down onto the pastry and spread out to evenly cover the bacon. Top half of the banana with the fried almond and the second slice of banana. Repeat with the second sheet of pastry dough. Cut the pastry between the bananas and carefully unroll them. Place onto the baking sheet and brush with oil and bake for 10 to 15 minutes, or until golden all over and crisp. Allow to cool for 5 minutes before attempting to roll out for a 14cm board and cutting diagonally into 3cm squares. Place onto a serving plate.

title: Smoked Corned Beef and Cilantro - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs corned beef brisket | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 3/4 cups fresh cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place brisket in the bottom of a 3 1/2 to 6 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle with baking soda. Using a slotted spoon, remove any remaining liquid in the slow cooker. Spoon cilantro over corned beef if desired. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or until meat begins to easily pull apart. Remove beef from slow cooker. Shred with 2 forks or your hands. Serve corned beef with sauce in the slow cooker. Garnish with remaining cilantro before serving.

title: Roast Beef With Parsley
ingredients: 1 tablespoon flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs roast beef, trimmed and tied
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix together the parsley and beef. Place in a small foil loaf pan. Press out as much air as possible. Bake for about 1 hour, or until the meat is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Remove from the oven and let rest for a few minutes before slicing.

title: Chinese Cucumbers
ingredients: 4 ounces chinese broccoli ( shredded ) | 1 cup mixed fresh salad ( mixed salad with red onion ) | 1 1/2 cups broth | 2 cups old english cucumbers, peeled, trimmed, halved lengthwise, seeded, and cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch-thick slices ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 2/3 cup old fashioned sweet breadcrumb | dark soy sauce, to taste ( optional and to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake broccoli and salad in a bowl of cold water to cover for 15 minutes or until slightly softened, but still firm. Drain through a sieve and reserve the liquid. Remove broccoli mixture with a slotted spoon to a bowl and set aside for 10 minutes. Stir reserved liquid into broccoli mixture along with vinegar. Heat reserved liquid in a large shallow baking pan and add broths and cucumbers. Cover and bake until cucumbers are tender, about 15 minutes. Stir in breadcrumb and sprinkle with soy sauce. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,mirin,black bean,eggplant,green chili pepper,sugar snap pea,cayenne pepper,cream cheese
title: Japanese-Style Breakfast Salad With Crispy Vegetables
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, room temperature ( or light cream cheese ) | 1/3 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 3 tablespoons sugar snap peas, cooked and shelled | 1/3 cup green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 large eggplant, cut into 3 slices lengthwise | 1 small swiss chard, center ribs removed, leaves torn into bite size pieces | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Combine cream cheese, mirin, sugar snap peas, chilies and eggplant and cut into 3 slices lengthwise. Sprinkle with cayenne and black beans. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: papaya,egg substitute,egg beater substitute,chambord raspberry liquor,celery rib,chili sauce
title: Sate Bread French Toast
ingredients: 1 pepaya ( pawpaw mango, may use papaya or other tropical fruit ) | 1 celery rib | 3 egg whites ( can use 1/3 cup egg beaters egg substitute ) | 1/3 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1 tablespoon bottled minced sweet chili sauce ( like sriracha ) | 3 tablespoons chambord raspberry liquor
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium bowl. Whisk egg whites until foamy and gradually add in egg substitute. Beat until blended. Stir in sweet chili sauce and chambord. Add more sweet chili sauce to preference or if preferred, you may add more chambord. Pour into 13x9 greased and sprayed pan. Bake 325 for 35 - 40 minutes. Cut into eight slices, and serve hot on bread, with salsa on the side.

title: Spicy Poblanos Bread
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles, seeded, deveined | 3/4 cup brandy | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 -3 cups shredded cabbage ( preferably one large head of cabbage ) | 6 ciabatta, slices | 1 1/2 - 2 cups coarsely chopped dates ( or more to taste )
instructions: Preheat grill or broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil. Lightly coat the peppers with the brandy and season with salt and pepper. Grill or broil until blackened and charred. Place the chopped cabbage in a mixing bowl with the ciabatta slices and dates. Toss to coat with the brandy and season with salt and pepper. To serve, divide bread on serving plates.

title: Gruyere Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups coarsely grated gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 pounds chicken wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Mix gruyere cheese and fish sauce together in a bowl.

title: Scallops and Mustard Rice
ingredients: 400 g sea scallops, rinsed and drained | 1 1 cup arborio rice | 1 tablespoon coarse sea salt ( coarse sea salt ) or 1 tablespoon fine sea salt, plus more as needed | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard ( dijon-rye ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill sprigs
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large heavy based pan or wok with a lid.

title: Ahi Yu Bing
ingredients: 3 baby eggplants | 1/2 onion | hoisin sauce | 1/2 liter guinness stout
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Poke all over the eggplants with a fork. Using a melon baller, scoop out the inside of the eggplants leaving 1cm protruding around the walls. Leave the skin of the eggplant attached at the base of the eggplant. Put the scooped out eggplant into an oiled roasting tin. Cook for 20 min at 180 degrees c or till eggplant is soft and soft. Finely slice the onion thinly. Place the chopped onions and hoisin sauce into a pan. Stir, and heat thoroughly on a medium heat till the onions are golden. Remove from heat. Place the scooped out eggplant into a serving bowl, and drizzle with the hoisin sauce, top with the eggplant slices, sprinkle over some fresh coriander if using, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white hominy,cream celery soup,chicken thigh,ale,gingerroot,risotto rice,green cardamom pod,white pepper
title: Chicken and Irish Stew
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 12 fluid ounces ale or 12 fluid ounces water | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 can white hominy, well drained | 8 fluid ounces risotto-style rice | 8 fluid ounces canned diced white hominy, well drained | 1/2 inch fresh gingerroot, peeled fresh | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 green cardamom pod
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit. Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish, fat side up. Bake chicken in preheated oven for 30 minutes and then stir once and then return baking dish to oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown and then remove chicken from dish and set aside. Pour into measuring cup, add beer to the pan juices and bring to simmer. Then add cream of celery soup, undiluted, stir well, then add to pan juices and simmer until thickened, about 10 minutes. Add undrained, cooked white and fresh hominy mixture, rice, diced white and green hominy, white and black pepper, and stir well until heated through. Meanwhile, split the cardamom pods in half and scrape out the seeds and membrane. Seed them and roughly chop them. Place the half of the cardamom pods in a small bowl and crush them. Add a 1/4 cup of the soup liquid to the pan liquid, stir well, then add the contents of the bowl to the pot and stir well. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of white pepper and 1/2 teaspoon of ground ginger and set aside. When chicken is done, remove it from the baking dish and allow to cool slightly. Once cooled, remove chicken thighs.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 2 -3 slices of your favourite ham, your favourite type
instructions: Wash the lettuce so the water is clear and put it in a large bowl mix it with your chosen vegetables. Put a couple of slices of ham on top of the lettuce and wrap it up. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,mortadella,grenadine,nonstick cooking spray,breadcrumb,lemon zest,hamburger
title: Grilled Kaffir Lime Sliders
ingredients: 1 medium kaffir lime leaf, halved | 1 lemon, zest of | 4 hamburger rolls | 1/4 cup dried breadcrumbs | 50 g mortadella, thinly sliced | nonstick cooking spray | grenadine ( optional )
instructions: Brush lime peel and lemon rind onto one side of each biscuit. Place on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Set aside. Combine breadcrumbs, mortadella, pepper and lemon zest in a medium bowl and place in refrigerator for 10 minutes to absorb flavors. Heat grill grates. Spray grates with oil. Place breadcrumb mixture on the biscuit, and roll up. Repeat with remaining breadcrumbs. Cook on grill plate sprayed with oil. Grill each biscuit 2 minutes or until golden brown. To serve cut into quarters and serve with cocktail dippodile.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,yellow pepper,apple,white wine,asparagus,yellow bell pepper,kielbasa,lima bean
title: Asparagus and Apple Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh asparagus | 4 lbs yellow onions, peeled | 3 lbs carrots, peeled | 1 lb yellow bell pepper | 1 lb yellow bell pepper | 1 lb kielbasa | 1 cup white wine | 1 apple, peeled
instructions: Trim asparagus and cut into 2 inch lengths. In a large pot, place asparagus, carrots, onions, and peppers with water to cover, and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer, partly covered, until vegetables are tender, 45 minutes to 1 hour. Dice kielbasa into small cubes and place in a medium bowl. Remove vegetable mixture from heat and stir in wine. Place apple on top of asparagus and apple, making sure it is covered. Cover and allow to rest at room temperature until serving time. This salad can be reheated in the microwave. You can add more wine if needed, depending on how full the amount of apple and sausage is.

title: Lavender Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun | 1/2 teaspoon ground lavender oil
instructions: Cut the hamburger bun in half lengthwise. Spread lavender oil all over the top of the bun. Spread ground burger. Toast under grill until lightly browned and burgers are browned on the insides, 2 - 3 minutes per side.

title: Granny's Squash
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash | 3/4 cup virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 cups dry italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Trim and peel the squash and cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Pour enough olive oil into a medium size saute pan to yield a depth of about 1/4 inch.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,green onion,liquid smoke,oregano leaf,red cayenne pepper,veal,sun tomato,thyme sprig
title: Veal Fondue
ingredients: 1 lb lean veal, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup chopped green onion | 3 tablespoons chopped, fresh oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon red cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground hazelnuts | 2 -3 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1/3 cup chopped pitted hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the hazelnuts. Pour into a saucepan.

title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, washed and drained | 2 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Boil the chicken broth with tomato ketchup till reduced by half. Add the cooked rice and stir. Pour the chicken broth into the rice. Sprinkle with cheese and bake till heated through.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,pumpkin puree,marinara sauce,crawfish,rom tomato,broccoli
title: Chef John's Broccoli Crawfish and Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, trimmed | 1 can pumpkin puree | 2 roma tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( zest of 1 lemon only ) | 1 jar marinara sauce | 8 ounces cooked peeled crawfish, peeled and coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut broccoli into florets. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Cook broccoli in the boiling water until tender crisp, about 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,red plum,cremini mushroom,tortilla,double pie crust,baby green
title: French Grilled Vegetable Pie
ingredients: 2 double pie crust | 1/4 lb cremini mushroom | 1 small red plum | 8 ounces baby greens | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon crushed red plum
instructions: Cook and cut mushrooms in small pieces and chop garlic. Combine other ingredients and pour over the mushrooms. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Quick French Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice ( sushi rice works well for this ) | 6 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1 tablespoon capers
instructions: Add rice and 2 tbsp of the vinegar to a bowl with lots of hot water. Use your bare hands to wet the grains with a little more or less of the vinegar. The salt and vinegar should mix together well. Add capers, stir well, pour into glass bowl and chill. Enjoy.

title: Chile Verde Dry Rub
ingredients: 1 cup cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Put the cilantro in a bowl or spice grinder. Add red pepper flakes when grinding. Store the mixture in an airtight container, up to two months.

title: Cha Xiao Wan Gai -- Chinese Crab Cake (Shanghai)
ingredients: 2 lbs lump crabmeat ( fresh, picked over and remove excess shell and cartilage ) | 8 ounces prosciutto, cut into thin strips | 8 ounces cornichons, finely choped | 4 teaspoons shaoxing wine ( shaoxing ) | 4 teaspoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon garlic, finely minced ( optional )
instructions: Cut crabmeat into 1/8 inch slices. Arrange shrimp, prosciutto pieces and cornichons on a large plate. Combine 2/3 cup shaoxing wine, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, sugar and garlic in a small bowl. Pour half the marinade over shrimp and crab and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes and up to 45 minutes. Bake shrimp and crab in a hot barbecue or steamer, covered, over high heat for about 5 minutes stirring frequently. Turn onto a wire rack to cool. Remove crab cake from the pan. Re coat with reserved marinade and broil briefly until golden. Serve hot or cold.

title: Homemade Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger
instructions: Combine worcestershire sauce, ginger, and garlic powder in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least two hours. Use as a marinade for grilled meat of your choice.

title: Creamy and Creamy Salmon Rice
ingredients: 3 tablespoons shortening | 1 3/4 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 1 pound skinless, boneless salmon, cubed | 1 package ladyfingers, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Melt shortening in a large pot over medium heat.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked white rice | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 2 cups salsa | 2 medium plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped
instructions: Combine rice and chicken broth in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, covered, until liquid has been absorbed and rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 35 to 45 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Stir in salsa and tomatoes.

title: Irish Parsnips and Stout
ingredients: 2 large parsnips, peeled and sliced into half moons | 1 bottle stout beer, or as needed | 12 ounces dry spaghetti, broken
instructions: Place parsnips and stout beer into a large pot with a lid and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cook until parsnips are tender, about 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 cup spanish rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup instant coffee ( optional, i use espresso as it is less unpleasant to me ) | 1 package frozen peas
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer covered, about 35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender.

title: White Gazpacho Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa | 4 sprigs epazote, leaves or 2 teaspoons dried epazote | 100 ml white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup salsa | 1 medium garlic or 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 vanilla beans, split lengthwise or 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a clean jar with 1 1/2 cup water. Cover the jar, tightly and shake well to mix the ingredients. Refrigerate the soup and prepare other recipes.

title: Crispy Bell Peppers (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 11)
ingredients: 1 lb bell pepper, halved lengthways | 1 ounce maize rice ( jasmine or basmati ) | 1 tablespoon caster sugar ( superfine sugar if you have it ) | 1 tablespoon cornmeal | 1 pinch caster sugar ( superfine sugar if you have it ) | 4 6inch flour tortillas | 1 1/3 cups basilmati rice
instructions: Place the bell pepper halves and maize rice in a bowl and combine everything else. Toss the mixture well. Pour the mixture onto a lined oven tray, using as much of the remaining mixture as you can and leaving the remaining mixture as half the quantity. Sprinkle the rest of the mixture over it and bake it for 40 to 50 minutes at 230c. Cook until it's set and brown, about 1 hour. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,caper,pesto sauce,port wine,vegetable stock chicken
title: Pesto Port and Chicken Gravy
ingredients: 12 ounces pesto sauce ( not prepared ) | 4 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons vegetable stock or 4 tablespoons chicken stock | 3 tablespoons capers, rinsed and drained | 2 ounces port wine
instructions: Combine pesto sauce, vinegar, stock and capers in a saucepan and heat until bubbling. Slowly whisk in the port and place over a medium heat. Stir a few times until hot. Serve with boiled new potatoes.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,salsa,raspberry,malt vinegar,red bell pepper,italian sausage
title: Raspberry Sausage Wrapped in Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 package johnsonville italian sausage | 1 jar prepared salsa | 1 can or bottle white wine vinegar | 1 jar pesto sauce | 1/2 jar raspberries | 2 red bell peppers, diced
instructions: Preheat a small skillet over medium high heat and lightly pan fry the sausage until evenly browned. Remove from heat and slice into 1/4 inch thick slices. Toss sausage with salsa, vinegar, pesto and raspberries. Garnish with peppers.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,corn tortilla strip,chickpea,limeade concentrate,coconut milk,dijon mustard
title: Quick and Easy Caribbean Sausage & Pea Tostadas
ingredients: 4 corn tortillas or 4 bread | 1 package sweet italian sausage | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 can light coconut milk | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 2 cans frozen limeade concentrate
instructions: Brown sausage in a nonstick skillet. Drain. Meanwhile, spray a 13x9 pan with non stick cooking spray or coat with oil. Cut each tortilla into 4 triangles then place one piece over sausage. Drain chickpeas well. Add all to skillet. Pour in coconut milk, mustard and juice from one lime. Simmer over medium heat until thickened and bubbly about 5 minutes. Spoon mixture evenly over tortillas and enjoy.

title: Minty Pistachio Pesto (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups unsalted shelled pistachios ( raw or under a knife, and then rinsed ) | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons light vegetable stock or 1 1/2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon mixed dried italian herbs | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf ( optional )
instructions: Using a blender or food processor, process pistachios to form a coarse texture that will hold its shape when cooked. Transfer to a dish, and stir in remaining ingredients. Heat up the oil and pesto in saucepan over medium heat until hot but not smoking, or heat in a small skillet with a tight fitting lid. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,white wine,yellow mustard,white button mushroom,bean sprout,pork shoulder,nutmeg,soup
title: Crock Pot Oriental Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cubed | 3 1/2 cups onions or 3 1/2 cups shallots, sliced | 1 can reduced-sodium cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup light cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup white wine | 1 pinch ground nutmeg, or to taste | 1 bag fresh bean sprouts | 1 cup canned white button mushrooms, drained and sliced
instructions: Place the pork, onion, mushroom soup, cream of mushroom soup, wine and nutmeg in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours or on high for 4 hours, until pork has completely fallen apart and onions are well caramelized. About 15 to 20 minutes before serving, add the bean sprouts and mushrooms.

title: Baked Halibut With Basmati Rice, Basil and Sea Salt
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces halibut fillets, skin removed | 6 ounces basmati rice
instructions: Put the fish in a dish and put it aside. Heat oven to 200°c/400°f/gas put the rice on a baking paper lined tray. Pour about 2 tablespoons of oil into a large pan and gently fry it quickly until golden brown and crisp. Turn the rice out on to a large plate while you are making the fish fry the halibut take the fish out of the oven. Dip it in the rice and put it on top of the rice. Pour over some more oil and cook the fish for a further 3 - 4 minutes. The fish should flake easily with a fork. Take it out onto paper towels and scatter over the sea salt. It can be eaten straight away or chilled in an airtight container for up to 2 days.

title: Ancho Meatball and Beans
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground meat | 2 cans kidney beans, drained | 2 sprigs ancho chile, chopped | 35 dried bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place about 2 cups of the ground meat onto the center of a piece of aluminum foil. Sprinkle the ancho chile over the meat. Add a spoonful or two of bread crumbs, or as desired. Roll the meat into 1 inch meatballs. Arrange the meatballs in a single layer in the baking sheet. Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven. Allow the meatballs to rest for 10 minutes before removing them from the baking sheet.

title: White Chocolate and Sesame Chocolates
ingredients: 500 g white chocolate, chopped | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 3 tablespoons flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1 jalapeno, chopped | 1 tablespoon white sugar
instructions: Place the chocolate, sesame oil, sugar, flour and sage in a bowl. Stir well to combine. Add the jalapeno, sesame oil and sugar. Mix well together until the mixture is well combined. Heat a small nonstick wok until hot. Add the chocolate mixture. Stir continuously over low heat until the chocolate is melted. Spread immediately or leave in the fridge and cut into squares or squares. Leave in the fridge to set before cutting into squares.

title: Wild Cherry Bake with Corn,swiss Cheese and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 bag frozen berries ( i use cranberries, raspberries, apricots, and blackberries ) | 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese ( shredded ) | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1/2 cup sour cream ( i use ff ) or 1/2 cup mayonnaise ( i use ff ) | 1/4 cup apricot jam ( i use ff ) | 2 cups fresh corn ( from frozen corn, not from canned ) | 2 tablespoons butter ( i use evoo ) | 1/4 cup chopped scallion ( i used green onions )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix cheese and taco seasoning in a large mixing bowl. Add sour cream and melted butter.

Random Ingredients: ice water,sun tomato oil,yellow squash,white sugar,alfredo sauce
title: Squash Alfredo
ingredients: 1 cup ice water | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1 cup frozen yellow squash, thawed | 2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Make the sauce by combining sun dried tomatoes, sun dried tomato, white sugar, and ice water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer while making the rest of the sauce. To assemble, bring sauce to a boil for 30 seconds, then remove from heat. Cover and keep over low heat until ready to serve.

title: Pea Hot Pot
ingredients: 1 cup honey | 12 cups water | 5 large fresh red-leaf hot peppers | 3 teaspoons crushed juniper berries | 2 lbs fresh split peas
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the honey, water, hot peppers, juniper berries and peas. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until peas are tender. Serve warm with mustard or horseradish cream.

title: Cauliflower Polenta
ingredients: 1/2 head cauliflower floret | 2 tablespoons cornmeal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f cut the cauliflower into florets. Place florets in a baking dish. Coat the cauliflower with cornmeal. Sprinkle with some more of the cornmeal. Drizzle baking dish with olive oil, or just turn on all sides of the pan. Bake for 40 - 45 minutes, or until the cauliflower is tender and golden.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,vegetable oil,banana leaf,garlic,italian seasoning
title: Italian Pan Fried Bananas
ingredients: 4 bananas leaves | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 3/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 3/4 teaspoon vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat a skillet or wok over medium high heat. Place an inch of water into the pan and spread the banana leaves out into a sheet. Heat the pan until a single layer of banana leaves just begins to rise to the surface, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove the banana leaves from the pan with a slotted spoon, wiping out the excess oil. Place the sliced banana leaves into the hot skillet, overlapping with the edges. Sprinkle the minced garlic over the banana leaves.

title: Fried Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 3 squid, bodies
instructions: Wash lettuce, remove and cut into thin slices or in julienne strips. Wash squid well, remove hard stalk, cut into rings and separate the rings. Cook lettuce with hot oil, salt, and pepper for 5 minutes drain immediately. Place lettuce wrapped squid in lettuce paper towel to dry, drain and dry again before serving.

title: Tomatillo Bread Salad
ingredients: 8 slices thick cut boneless bacon | 1 lb sweet white sandwich bread | 10 -12 ripe cherry tomatoes | 2 -3 tablespoons olive, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 bunch cilantro, chopped | 8 peppercorns | 12 slices rye bread
instructions: Chop the bacon to make 1/2 inch squares. Place on a cookie sheet and cook in a very small frying pan with a tablespoon of olive oil. Cook for about 5 minutes until the fat is rendered and bacon is browned. Cut the sandwich bread in half lengthwise and then cut on the diagonal. Spread each slice of bread with the croutons. Top with sliced cherry tomatoes. Combine all of the dressing ingredients in a bowl and pour over the bread and tomatoes. Serve at once or refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight.

title: Simple Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 whole salmon, cut into 4 equal pieces | 1 can chopped tomatoes
instructions: Place all ingredients except salmon and tomato into a large dutch oven. Mix all ingredients and bring to a low boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered, for about 20 minutes. Uncover and bake for about 1 hour. Add more tomatoes to taste after removing from the heat.

title: Green Beans with Oranges
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken stock or 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon fresh orange rind, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons parsley leaves, chopped | 16 ounces frozen cut green beans or 16 ounces fresh trimmed frozen green beans
instructions: Combine chicken or vegetable stock, oj and parsley in medium saucepan, bring to boil, simmer gently, stirring occasionally until mixture is reduced to 3/4 c, about 3 minutes. Stir in beans, cook until heated thru, about 2 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: egg wrap,blue cheese salad dressing,wheat hamburger bun,cooking sherry,chili oil
title: Quick and Easy  Chili Beef Wrap
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground round | 1 egg roll wrap, split | 1/2 cup chopped red bell peppers or 1/2 cup green bell pepper | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking sherry | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium blue cheese salad dressing ( can substitue miracle whip if you like )
instructions: Prepare a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add beef and cook over medium heat until browned, stirring frequently and breaking up meat. Drain browned beef in a medium bowl and set aside. Wipe out pan and heat until pan is very hot. Wrap a piece of plastic wrap around its ends tightly so it doesn't dry out and wrap around your wrap. Place the wrap in the skillet over medium high heat and let sit until warm, about 2 minutes. Slice roll into 1/2 inch slices and place into the hot pan. Spoon beef onto the rolled wrap. Top with red or green pepper and drizzle with sherry. Place bottom half of roll wrap on a serving dish. Cut remaining roll to make equal squares and cut each square into 4 triangles. Serve with a drizzle of dressing.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,stew meat,cream tartar,sugar snap pea,raspberry jam
title: Sweet Sour Beef With Fresh Raspberries
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sour cream or 1 tablespoon creamed tartar | 1 lb stew meat, cubed | 1 tablespoon sugar snap peas | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam | 1/4 cup finely crushed corn chips
instructions: Combine sour cream and cream tartar, in a shallow dish. Add beef, toss to coat well, and refrigerate for at least 1 to 6 hours. Turn meat occasionally and drain well. Place peas, razzings and sugar in a deep skillet. Cook over high heat, stirring, until fragrant, 2 minutes or so. Cook, stirring, 1 to 2 minutes longer or until meat is heated through and sugar is melted. Add beef and peas and cook about 3 minutes more or until heated through, stirring to coat meat. Serve over rice with rassens or corn chips.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,italian salad dressing mix,chicken broth,achiote powder
title: Curry Powder
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon achiote powder ( available in asian specialty stores or ethnic food section ) | 1 tablespoon good red curry paste ( i prefer kari brand for this, but use your favorite red curry paste amount ) | 1 tablespoon achiote seasoning mix ( available in asian specialty stores ) | 1 1/2 cups canned low sodium chicken broth
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the achiote powder, curry paste, soup base, and broth.

title: Crispy Pecan and Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup dry quinoa | 1 can diced green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Prepare quinoa according to package directions. Add chile peppers, tossing to combine. Allow to cool. Transfer quinoa to an ice cream maker. Cover, and freeze for about 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: cumin,yellow cornmeal,ginger paste,iceberg lettuce,barbecue sauce,coconut milk,coffee granule,green olive
title: Sweet and Spicy Veggie Packets
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup instant coffee granules ( instant instant coffee may be used if you don't like spice ) | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 2 teaspoons minced ginger paste | 1 can coconut milk | 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce or 2 cups torn mixed fresh vegetables | 1/3 cup sliced green olives | 12 leaves barbeque-style lettuce ( about 18 cups total )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. In medium saucepan combine cornmeal, instant coffee, cumin, and ginger. Over medium heat, stir constantly for 2 minutes, stirring constantly and do not burn. Remove from heat. Stir in coconut milk. Pour into 8x8 baking dish. Top with lettuce. Bake covered 30 minutes. Remove and discard top layer of foil. To serve, cut each packet into 12 wedges. Serve with barbeque style lettuce.

title: Pickled Onions
ingredients: 1 whole serrano pepper, halved and seeded | 1 large onion, sliced into strips | 3 tablespoons finely chopped white onions ( scallions ) | 2 teaspoons peppercorns, coarsely crushed
instructions: Place halved chile and finely chopped onion into a small heavy saucepan and cover with water. Add 2 teaspoons of ground coriander seeds and 1 teaspoon of peppercorns. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring and crushing the onion with a wooden spoon. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer briskly for 30 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent scorching. Uncover and continue cooking for 1 minute longer or until the onion is limp and starting to color. Transfer the chile to a sieve lined with fine paper towels to drain, discard solids. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage link,rice flour,chicken breast,brown rice,rye bread,egg white,tomato green chilies
title: Smoky, Sweet-Topped Sausage and Tomato Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 large skinless chicken breasts | 1/4 pound sweet italian sausage links, casings removed | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon tomato and green chilies, chopped | 1 slice rye bread, toasted
instructions: Brown rice in a heavy pot over medium heat for 10 minutes. Stir in rice flour. Add chicken and sausage. Cook until sausage is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink. Remove from heat. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a large spoonful of the rice mixture in the center of each grilled breast. Fold each slice of bread in half and secure with toothpicks. Place breasts in a baking dish in a single layer. Brush tops with egg white.

Random Ingredients: rose water,dark soy sauce,artichoke heart,custard,part ricotta cheese
title: Artichokes and Artichokes in Fragrant Ricotta Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup low-fat custard | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons rose water ( available at asian or asian market ) | 3 small artichoke hearts, boiled and roughly chopped ( about 2-3 tablespoons )
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk ricotta and custard together until smooth. Stir in dark soy sauce and half of the rose water. Pour into a medium serving dish, cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Just before serving, stir in artichokes. Garnish with remaining rose water and remaining rose water.

title: Smoked Cod With Pinot Grigio and Fresh Cilantro
ingredients: 1 whole smoked cod | 1 1/2 cups pinot grigio wine or 1 1/2 cups other medium dry white wine | chopped fresh cilantro stems | 4 -6 cups broth | 1 1/2 lbs dry pasta or 1 1/2 lbs ziti pasta
instructions: Place the whole smoked cod in a shallow, 12 inch skillet, skin side down.

title: Almond Crescent Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups sesame oil for frying | 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 pound blanched blanched almonds
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet to 375 degrees f. Mix flour and sesame oil in a large dish. Dip almonds into the flour mixture, shaking off any excess. Place 2 to 3 tablespoons of dough onto each blanched almond. Fry until golden brown, about 5 minutes.

title: Cranberry and Pistachios
ingredients: 1 cup of fresh cranberries | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 small red pepper, diced | 1/2 cup of salted whole pistachios
instructions: Prepare a medium sized sautee pan, or other pan of choice. Put in the sesame oil in it and sauté the red pepper. Add the pistachios, and cook until they are softened and slightly browned. Add the cranberry mix to the pan. Saute for about 5 more minutes. Serve hot.

title: Artichoke Coffee
ingredients: 2 packages frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup coffee | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Place artichoke hearts in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: coffee,beef chuck,spaghetti noodle,bulk italian sausage,cream celery soup,penne pasta,feta cheese basil tomato
title: Spaghetti and Italian Meatball Casserole
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef chuck | 1 pound bulk italian sausage | 1 package penne pasta | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 2 tablespoons instant coffee, or as needed | 1 package crumbled feta cheese with basil and tomato | 1 tablespoon grated cheddar cheese with dried basil | 1 package spaghetti noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 11x7 inch baking dish. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir beef, italian sausage, and penne in the hot skillet until the meat is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer the meat to a medium bowl and stir the cream of celery soup, coffee bean soup, and crumbled feta cheese into the meat mixture until thoroughly blended. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl. Transfer the meat mixture again to the skillet and mix in the cheddar and basil. Pour half the meat mixture into the prepared baking dish. Spread remaining meat mixture over the meat layer, leaving a 1/2 inch border along the edges around the dish. Sprinkle the top with remaining cheese and basil. Bake meatball casserole in the preheated oven until bubbling and no longer pink inside, about 30 minutes.

title: Sopa De Mariscos (Chorizo, Beef and Orange Salad)
ingredients: 20 -24 medium sirloin or 20 -24 medium other firm-fleshed steak, each cut lengthwise in half | 3 tablespoons minced shallots | 1/4 cup dry good spanish chorizo, chilqueso | 1/4 cup apple cider or 1/4 cup other mild alcoholic cider | fresh orange wedge
instructions: Preheat broiler and heat broiler. Place the meat and the salt and pepper to taste on a rack. Brush with oil and broil, turning once, about 7 minutes, or until desired doneness. While the meat grills, combine the shallots, chorizo and apple cider in a small skillet over medium heat. Bring to a boil, then cook, stirring, 5 minutes, or until mixture is hot and syrupy. Transfer the mixture to a medium heatproof serving bowl and pour over the warm chorizo and shallots. Garnish with orange wedges.

title: A Kicker Spicy Hamburgers (Stolen From Out Of This!)
ingredients: 1 small red chile, seeds removed | 1 hamburger
instructions: Place the chile in the center of a slice of hamburger. Using a rolling pin, roll the hamburger to thoroughly wrap it. Secure with a wooden dowel or some toothpicks so you can secure the edge of the roll with no leaks. In a slow cooker, cook the hamburger for 5 hours on low. At 5 hours, remove toothpicks. Serve with tomato salsa or any kind of condiment, topping it up with ketchup, sour cream and/or green onion.

title: Cauliflower Stuffed Pork Chops
ingredients: 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped cauliflower | 2 pork loin chops, cooked
instructions: Combine crumbs and cauliflower. Dip top of pork chops into crumb mixture. Arrange on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 375 for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Swiss Green Peppercorn Broth
ingredients: 1/2 cup green peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon fresh mace, ground
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, crush the peppercorns with a rolling pin or the back of an inverted spoon. Alternatively, grind them with a mortar and pestle or a spice mill. Stir in the ground mace. Keeps in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 6 months.

title: Cajun Spice Rub for Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 -2 teaspoon whole cloves | 1 teaspoon fenugreek leaves or 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves | 2 teaspoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon plain bread crumbs
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f, 200°f, 190°f, gas mark 1, 190°f, gas mark 5, 190°f. Line a large baking sheet with a double thickness of aluminum foil. Place the fenugreek seeds, cajun seasoning and fenugreek leaves into an electric spice grinder or a large coffee grinder, and grind together. Add the golden syrup and bread crumbs and grind again. Pour the mixture into a resealable plastic bag, and tip the meat onto the dryened mixture to coat. Place the bag on the oiled baking sheet, spacing evenly. The meat should be completely submerged under the marinade. Refrigerate the meat for up to 12 hours. Turn the oven off, open the door, and leave the meat in overnight. Preheat the oven to 350°f and leave oven to sit for at least 12 hours to cool somewhat. Transfer the meat to a cutting board and cut, across the grain, into thin slices. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

title: Easy Easy Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: In a 1 qt. Bowl, stir together soup and liquid smoke.

title: Zucchini and Tofu Fritters
ingredients: 2 -3 zucchini ( medium sized yellow squash ) | 1/3 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon hoagie roll ( i like kraft brand ) | 4 slices firm tofu, crumbled ( or other firm tofu ) | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | sea salt, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large bowl, toss the zucchini with the cheese and hoagie roll and spread evenly onto an 8 inch baking pan. Sprinkle with sesame oil and sea salt. Bake until zucchini is soft and lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Sour Cream Icing for Pasta, Chips, or Crepes
ingredients: 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Pour cream into mixing bowl. Add oregano to cream. Add more or less of mixture to taste. Cover bowl with towel and chill thoroughly 8 hours in fridge. Stir before serving, stirring occassionally.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,grain white rice,vanilla,ziti pasta,cauliflower,heinz ketchup,pork sparerib
title: Pa Dutch Pork and Cauliflower Rice Pudding
ingredients: 400 g whole grain white rice | 400 g sliced lean pork spareribs | 400 g ziti pasta | 1 head cauliflower | 1 cup heinz ketchup | 3 tablespoons heinz ketchup or 3 tablespoons heinz 57flour | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Chop cabbage and cauliflower into small pieces. Preheat oven to 180c. Place chopped and sliced pork and spare ribs in baking dish and fry in 1 tbsp ketchup, in microwave oven, until browned. Put both together. Remove pork from oven and set aside. Boil water for pasta and rice. When it starts boiling, cook pasta on high for a couple of minutes or until tender. Remove and set aside. Boil water for ziti. Add salt to pasta and pork and combine and put aside. Add cauliflower and ziti and stir fry for one minute. Remove from heat and add remaining ketchup, vanilla, and Heinz. Spoon mixture into a greased, high sided baking dish. Chill for one hour before serving and then serve with a green salad.

title: Wild Berry Pot Pies
ingredients: 2 puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 lb mixed wild berries | 1 1/2 cups bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled | 1 bag tiny new potatoes
instructions: Cut puff pastry sheets into half inch rounds. Cover with dry beansprouts. Bake for 15 minutes at 450 degrees f. Meanwhile, combine berries, bacon and potatoes. Heat and boil until mixture boils and thickens. Spoon filling onto the puff pastry rounds, and cover aspargus with tops, pressing the edges so they puff up.

title: Hot Curried Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans hot salsa | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry paste ( indian spicy )
instructions: Drain liquid from the cans of salsa, but do not reserve. Mix in the curry paste. Cover and refrigerate in a covered container. Keeps for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,lemon juice zest,miso,chili pepper,yukon gold potato,green chili pepper,brie cheese,ranch dressing mix
title: Indian Potato Salad With Brie Cheese and Herbs #RSC
ingredients: 6 yukon gold potatoes, red, quartered ( or equivalent ) | 1 tablespoon miso, gluten-free | 1 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1/4 cup lemon juice ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons kraft brie cheese ( i used a store brand with good flavor, such as kraft 100 % fat brie ) | 2 teaspoons dried chipotle chili peppers or 2 teaspoons chopped fresh chili peppers, seeded | 1/4 cup green chili pepper, chopped, from a jar | 1/4 cup oatmeal, toasted ( or other quick-cooking oats. )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine the potatoes, 1 tablespoon miso, the ranch dressing mix, lemon juice, and half the cheese in a large bowl.. Stir until well combined.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,sage leaf,rose water,bear meat,red curry paste,caramel ice cream topping,horseradish
title: Yummy Red Curry for a Rainy Night
ingredients: 2 -4 tablespoons grated aged horseradish | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 bunch sage leaves | 8 -12 drops red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 pints bear meat ( from the deli ) | your favourite caramel ice cream topping | curls rose water ( optional )
instructions: Shake or trim bear, trim and remove any sinew or pith/stew. Slather with horseradish and add a few drops of red curry paste and a pinch of fresh sage. Cover and leave in fridge. Slice the bear and mix the red vinegar, red wine vinegar and sugar in a medium size saucepan. Place over a high heat and bring to the boil. Add a few drops of red wine vinegar, a few drops of red wine vinegar and some crushed sage leaves to the mixture. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes, until thickened. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Serve over your choice of meat. To serve, place a generous amount of whipped cream in a small, shallow dish. Add a couple of drops of red curry paste and a few drops of rum flavoured red juice. This is a very good dish with pumpernickel bread as an accompaniment, a main meal, or as a side dish with plenty of crusty bread on the side. This is the base of our curry, so i usually double it, but it's up to you.
