Try cooking it that way, but, please, you don't have to resort to expensive, sweet, flavourful buns, and you might have no time to cook a foreman type burger, and even not need your fancy fancy, or if you really want meat in to be eaten as an accompaniment, such as, for breakfast, a quick burst of british, and a scoop of caramel ice cream accompanied by your favourite curry, if desired.

title: Chinese Cauliflower with Sausage, Beetroot and Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 large heads cauliflower | 1 large beet, peeled and shredded | 1 small head chinese mushroom, sliced | 2 ounces raw cured salami, cut into 1. 5 inch squares | 2 ounces black olives, halved, pitted, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup unsweetened vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger
instructions: Cook the cauliflower, beetroot and mushrooms, if the cauliflower is large, in boiling water for 6 to 8 minutes, or until lightly tender. Drain well and return to the pan. Sprinkle with the salami and black olives. Bring to a boil, stirring regularly, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until vegetables are just tender. Stir in the vanilla sugar and ginger, season to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Easy and Delicious Mini Avocados
ingredients: 2 avocados | 1 tablespoon red curry paste, more to taste ( or more ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons jalapenos or 1 1/2 tablespoons hot red hot pepper | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 2 tablespoons water | 2 tablespoons italian sweet sausage, cooked
instructions: Remove the stems from the avocados and cut a slit along the side to scoop out the avocado flesh onto a plate. Peel the avocado and mash with a fork. Add the curry paste, cayenne, water and sweet sausage to the mashed avocado along with any juices and mix well. Spoon mixture into the avocado shells and decorate with more sweet sausages or other things. Garnish with more cayenne or a squeeze of cilantro if desired.

title: Raisin Crab
ingredients: 1 cup fresh crabmeat | 1/4 cup dark raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Place crabmeat in a large bowl. Mix in raisins. Gently roll the crab mixture into small balls. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green bean,butter,artichoke heart,orange peel,chilies,picante sauce,ancho chile powder,cranberry
title: Quick and Easy White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can ro-tel diced green beans, drained | 3 small dried chilies, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder or 1 tablespoon ground pasilla chili powder | 2 tablespoons diced orange peel | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 tablespoons snipped dried chilies | 2 cups cranberries
instructions: Toast the dried chilies in a dry skillet over med high heat, taking care not to burn. Allow chilies to cool until just warm. Remove dark veins or seeds, if desired, and coarsely chop or mash. In a medium saucepan over med high heat, combine beans and chiles, then add the orange peel, butter, and chile powder. Cook until heated through and slightly fragrant, about 3 minutes. Stir in 1/2 cup of picante sauce, toasted chilies, cranberries, and remaining picante sauce. Transfer to a crockpot. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours, or on low until hot and serving.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,parmesan cheese,splenda granular,soya sauce,beef brisket,head cauliflower,liquid smoke
title: Beef Brisket and Au Jus
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket ( not bottom round ) | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets ( optional ) | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon splenda granular | 1/2 cup fresh grated parmesan cheese | 2 packages phyllo pastry sheets
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place beef brisket in roasting pan. Combine soy sauce, liquid smoke, cheese and splenda. Pour 1/2 this mixture on steak. Stir to coat. Roast uncovered in 400f oven until beef reaches 135°f on an instant reading thermometer, about 1 hour and 15 minutes total. Remove beef.

title: Salad-Line Sandwiches With Bacon
ingredients: 200 g cheddar cheese ( grated ) | 140 g bacon ( sliced very thin ) | 1 egg yolk ( or 1 egg white plus egg white ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 10 -12 mixed salad greens, torn into quarters ( or mixed mixed salad mix of mixed lettuces and baby greens, of your choice ) | fresh cilantro ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine the grated cheese, bacon, egg yolk, lemon juice, and chopped lettuce in a large bowl. Spoon the salad mixture into a bread pan that has been lined with greaseproof paper. Cut the sandwiches in half. Serve on a bed of greens topped with bacon slices. Garnish with cilantro.

title: Homemade Pasta
ingredients: 2 heads iceberg lettuce | 1/2 red onion, diced | 1 can hunt's tomato paste
instructions: Cut and shred lettuce. Mix lettuce with diced onion to the tomato paste. Add salt. Dice red onion. Add tomato paste. Add hot sauce to taste.

title: Glazed Apricot Rice (Arroz Doce)
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice | 1 dozen apricot halves or 1 dozen cherry half ( for a more substantial dessert, use 2 jars of apricot halves )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Lightly coat a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Drain apricots through a fine mesh strainer onto baking sheet.

title: Torshi (Russian Corn Soup)
ingredients: 1 pound fresh corn, husks removed | 3 large heads cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 1/2 cup chopped scotch or french-style ham | 1/2 pound scallops | 3 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto, cubed | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Bring 1 gallon of water to a boil in a large saucepan. Add corn cobs, cabbage, tomato paste and ham and return to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 35 to 40 minutes until vegetables are tender, and soup thickens. Stir scallops, prosciutto and cardamom into soup and continue cooking about 10 minutes, until heated through.

Random Ingredients: rose water,anise seed,basil leaf,walnut half,superfine sugar,molasses
title: Cambodian Walnut Pudding
ingredients: 14 ounces walnut halves, chopped | 2 1/2 ounces superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed, plus extra to sprinkle | 2 1/2 cups basil leaves, chopped | 3 sprigs rose water | 2 teaspoons molasses
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the walnuts, sugar, aniseed and rosewater. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat, and simmer for five minutes, until the sugar dissolves. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool to room temperature. Divide the walnuts among six individual or one and two quart sized ramekins leaving some whole. Spoon and spread the cooled syrup evenly over the walnuts. Sprinkle with extra to sprinkle. Chill for about three hours before serving.

title: Mashed Black-Eyed Peas and Spinach
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | 2 cans black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 6 slices white bread, toasted and crumbs removed | 1 teaspoon rubbed sage
instructions: Bring 2 cups water, spinach, black eyed peas, bread, and sage to a boil in a large pot. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the bread is tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Corn & Apple Salad
ingredients: 300 g corn, kernels | 1 medium courgette, sliced | 500 g yoghurt | 2 small red chili peppers, de-seeded & very thinly sliced | 1 small apple, chopped ( or 3 -4 stalks of your choice ) | jicama, slices to serve
instructions: Boil or steam your corn until tender, drain and cool. Whip yoghurt until creamy and add the zest and chillies. Add your corn kernels, courgette slices, apple and chilli to yogurt and stir well. Pour into a large salad bowl.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,monterey jack cheese,red chili pepper
title: Spicy Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 7 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/8 teaspoon red chili pepper or 1/8 teaspoon hot chili pepper, minced | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Pile ingredients in a casserole dish. Sprinkle with additional cheese. Cover and bake at 350 f for 10 minutes.

title: Red Curry-Stuffed Feta
ingredients: 3/4 lb feta cheese | 1 package ladyfingers | 1 package red curry paste
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. In a bowl, cream the feta, then spread it out in the shape of a rectangular shaped patty. In the middle, spread 1/3 of the curry paste, laying it on the feta. Carefully spread the remaining curry paste around the feta on the inside. Sprinkle with chopped onion if desired. If you use toothpicks, make diagonal slits into the feta to decorate the top of the cheese. Bake for 40 minutes.

title: Cassava, Corn & Coriander (Wombers)
ingredients: 6 -8 medium cassava ( yellow squash ) | 2 inches fresh corn on the cob.
instructions: Preheat the grill. If using the corn with the husked ends, place the corn directly on the grill. Turn frequently and cook until blackened. Rub each cob with black pepper and sprinkle with salt. To serve, spread one side of the corn with one palm of your hand. Flip and repeat. Note, cassava will shrink as it cools, so be careful when turning. To use, remove black stem, then scrub off the skin and seeds.

title: Tamari Tomato Cotta (Cannellini) - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 2 cans stewed tomatoes with juice | 3/4 cup tamari | 1 vanilla bean | salt, to taste | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese
instructions: Empty contents of tomato can into pressure cooker. Add tamari and the vanilla bean. Add seasoning salt to taste and mix thoroughly. Put on full pressure and cook for 25 minutes. Remove from heat and fluff with a fork. Serve immediately.

title: Rum Balls III
ingredients: 8 ounces dried pitted olives | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/3 cup dark rum ( optional ) or 1/3 cup other rum ( optional )
instructions: Place olives in food processor with cornstarch, and process 1 minute or until fine. Scrape sides with rubber spatula, scrape down sides to loosen and crumble. Scrape mixture onto waxed paper, cover with waxed paper, and refrigerate until chilled, at least 1 hour. Form into 1 balls, and roll in remaining rum or other desired dark rum, if desired. Note, roll the balls in cornstarch just before serving, if desired, to remove the excess oil. Note, you can use your imagination after making these balls.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,yellow food coloring,molasses,vanilla bean,heavy whipping cream,chickpea flour,pesto sauce,baby spinach
title: Pesto-Stuffed Puffed Spinach
ingredients: 12 baby spinach, stems cleaned, washed and drained | 1 cup canned chickpea flour | 1 cup pesto sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons gelatin | 2 pints heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 2 yellow food coloring | 1 cup frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove stems from spinach, reserving approximately 1/2 cup spinach for topping. Sift chickpea flour into a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,chicken bouillon granule,pimiento,superfine sugar,chicken stock,cherry
title: Crazy Dippers
ingredients: 2 cod fish fillets or 12 pieces other skinless white fish fillets, skinned and boned | 2 cans low-sodium chicken or 5 cups water | 1 jar sliced pimiento, drained | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons superfine sugar
instructions: Place fish in a large saucepan, add enough water to cover. Bring to the boil, then simmer until flesh flakes easily with a fork.

title: Fried Rice With Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried currants | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 8 ounces pork tenderloin | 2 cups cooked rice | 8 ounces fat-free refried beans | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios
instructions: Combine dried currants and chipotle in heavy skillet. Spread over pork tenderloins. Cook over low heat until pork is browned on all sides. Drain fat. Serve pork with cooked rice, beans and chopped pistachios.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,heavy cream,mayonnaise,scotch bonnet pepper,lime juice zest,portobello mushroom,gin,red onion
title: Baked Mushrooms With Chile Con Tequila
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 2 tablespoons gin, preferably reposado | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 cup portobello mushroom, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup fresh red onion, chopped | 1/2 cup roasted red pepper, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine mayonnaise, lime juice and zest, gin, whipping cream and red pepper flakes in serving bowl until well blended. Divide mixture between four 2 cup ramekins. Add the mushrooms, onion and red pepper and toss thoroughly. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Hot Avocado Dip
ingredients: 4 ripe avocados or 4 avocados | 2 cups corn kernels | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules | 2 tablespoons sweet chilli sauce | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 3/4 cup hot coffee or 3/4 cup plain non-fat yogurt
instructions: Using a sharp knife, gently loosen and peel avocados, being careful not to mash them. Using an upright bladed knife, slice into halves and scoop out the avocados with a slotted spoon. Place the shells inside a blender. Using a large spoon, mash the avocado well until creamy but not mushy. Add corn kernels, coffee powder, chilli sauce and tomato ketchup and mix to blend well. Spoon into avocado shells and chill for 1 hour or overnight. Serve with freshly made black bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,coleslaw mix,walnut half,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheesy Pesto Cheddar Slaw Salad
ingredients: 3 loaves coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 - 3/4 cup walnut halves
instructions: Combines pesto and cheese in a bowl. Toss lightly, then add remaining ingredients. Serve with a side of your favorite salad dressing or crackers for an extra light meal.

Random Ingredients: moong dahl be pea,baloney,cheddar cheese soup,honey,cocoa
title: Cocoa and Moong Dal (Punjab)
ingredients: 1 can condensed cheddar soup | 1 can condensed moong dahl ( dried peas ) | 7 fluid ounces condensed cheddar cheese soup | 1 teaspoon honey | 3 fluid ounces brown glaze ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, and serve in a double boiler over hot coals or white rice.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,garlic salt,red currant jelly,bicarbonate soda,ginger
title: Sweet and Sour Condiments
ingredients: 200 g red currant jelly | 2 heads iceberg lettuce, washed and torn into small pieces | 1 teaspoon ginger, grated | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 dash garlic salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and leave to marinate overnight. Serve.

title: Fenocaccia
ingredients: 16 ounces ricotta cheese | 4 ounces yoghurt or 4 ounces yoghurt | 4 ounces bacon strips, diced | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1 lemon peel, shredded and zested | 1 -2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/2 lb roasted hazelnuts, chopped
instructions: In large bowl, put the shredded bacon and chopped fenugreek. Mix well. Add the yoghurt, then the egg and beat until frothy. Gradually add the ricotta and the lemon rind. Stir well. In medium sized bowl, add the fenugreek seeds, finely grated zest and juice and grated hazelnuts. Add to ricotta mixture and mix well. Refrigerate for at least an hour before putting in the oven. This can be served chilled or at room temperature. Keeps for several weeks it's best cold, but it is just not necessary. Variations add other herbs, if desired or a few drops of lemon juice and orange juice in the yoghurt before serving.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,blueberry,yellow bell pepper,corn chip,chicken bouillon granule,kahlua
title: Black Russian Blueberry Chip Chip Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces blueberries | 1/4 cup yellow bell pepper, finely diced | 1/2 cup cornflour, cornstarch | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon kahlua | 1 1/2 bags corn chips, coarsely crushed
instructions: Place cheese, kahlua and cornflour in a small mixing bowl. Place blueberry and bell pepper in a mixing bowl. Toss with cheese mixture. Add remaining ingrstients. Stir and coat the crackers. If desired, place in ziplock bag for an extra few hours to develop flavour and texture.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,grainy mustard,anchovy paste,rice vinegar,caper,tamari,self raising flour
title: Capsicum Mayonnaise
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup tijon sweet mustard | 2 teaspoons tamari | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon sea salt ( normal ) | 60 g capers, drained | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place on a large, flat, non stick baking tray. Smooth top, then bake in a moderate oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and cool. Cover and keep refrigerated.

title: Black Bean and Cherry Hummus
ingredients: 1 can black beans ( rinsed and drained ) | 1 pint cherry ( cleaned and pitted )
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a food processor or blender and process until the beans and cherry juice are well mixed and smooth. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coconut extract,madras curry powder,straw mushroom,dark brown sugar,chicken broth,catsup
title: Madras Spicy Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 ounces raw king oyster mushrooms | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/3 cup coconut extract | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder
instructions: In a large skillet, remove shucked oysters from shell. Remove heads from mushrooms and rinse well. Cut in half and then into small chunks and put each half in separate piles. Sprinkle 2 tbsp chicken broth over each pile or just throw in the shrimp. In a pot, stir the brown sugar, catsup, coconut extract and madras curry. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 3 - 5 minutes until sauce is thickened. The longer you stir the roux, the more flavorful it will be.

title: Mexicali Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 2 medium bell peppers, chopped | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl, combine cauliflower, taco seasoning, thyme, and 1 package of taco seasoning mix. Spread vegetables in a single layer in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap and foil and bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes. Uncover and top with bell pepper. Bake until cauliflower is tender and peppers are tender, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,vanilla ice cream,confectioner ' sugar,tapenade,egg white,chicken thigh,milk chocolate,kumara
title: Kumara Chicken Lollipops
ingredients: 2 cups skim milk chocolate, melted | 2 large egg whites, beaten until frothy | 1 teaspoon garlic salt, or to taste | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup tapenade, divided | 4 skinless, boneless chicken thighs, pounded to 1/4-inch thickness | 1 can frozen sweetened condensed milk chocolate, frosted | 1 tablespoon vanilla ice cream, divided
instructions: Stir milk chocolate, egg whites, garlic salt, and confectioners' sugar in a bowl together until smooth, about 1 minute. Stir tapenade and 1 tablespoon of the condensed milk chocolate sauce into the dough and gently stir until no lumps of chocolate remain.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,chorizo sausage,french bread italian,ricotta cheese,daikon radish,lemon juice,roast,olive oil cooking spray
title: Giant Roast  Beef Roll-Ups With Daikon Radishes and Chorizo
ingredients: 1 french bread ( crust 1 loaf-alian is best ) | 1 jar pickled daikon radishes ( drained and sliced thinly ) | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 8 ounces chorizo sausage ( about 1/4 pound ) | 1 loaf italian bread ( italian is best to use italian bread ) or 1 loaf french bread ( italian is best to use italian bread ) | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | lemon juice ( optional, to taste ) | liquid smoke ( optional, to taste )
instructions: Slice lengthwise, crosswise and cut diagonally in the top of the roll ups leaving about 1/2 inch at the top. If using fresh daikon radish in seasonings, drain and slice very thinly. Lay on a cutting board slice, then, using a sharp knife, slice diagonally in lengthwise slices. Coat bread with cooking spray and arrange the daikon radish slices over the top. If using italian bread, lightly rub outside and outside surface with olive oil. If using, heat an empty 12 skillet over medium high until just smoking. Place bread on the pan and add chorizo. Cook until chorizo is browned, about 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat, remove chorizo, slice diagonally and set aside. If using bread, lightly spray bottom of bread with olive oil if using, remove crusts and cut into 1 inch slices. Cut each sandwich in half. Place a leaf of daikon on the each slice of bread. Spoon equal amounts of the ricotta on top of daikon and then roll up the loaf. Spray rolls with cooking oil. For a traditional greek touch, serve with a small bowl of lemon juice, a drizzle of olive oil and some sliced radishes.

title: Rigatoni With Pistachios and Red Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb red potatoes, cut in half | water, to cover | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb penne, cooked | 2 cups shelled chopped pistachios
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling salted water for about 8 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, cook the potatoes in boiling water for 15 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool slightly. Coat a shallow casserole dish with cooking spray or oil. Drain the potato mixture well and add to the prepared casserole dish. Toss well. Spread the pistachios on top. Add the warm pasta, tossing well to coat. Sprinkle with the pistacchio. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated 375 degree oven for 20 minutes or until golden and hot.

title: Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon black-eyed peas ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon whole peppercorn
instructions: Grind coriander seeds and peppercorns to a fine powder. Rinse the black eyed peas. Soak for at least 30 minutes and up to 1 day prior to serving. Drain and put into an airtight container that is air tight. You can keep for about 3 months before using. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pancetta,ginger paste,chickpea flour,tomato basil oregano garlic,snow pea,sauerkraut,oyster sauce
title: Veggie Samosas (Zheng Ji Udang Kebab)
ingredients: 25 ounces canned chickpea flour ( besan ) | 2 ounces minced pancetta | 1 ounce fresh ginger paste | 1 teaspoon tomato and basil oregano garlic ( san-gon ) | 1/2 teaspoon oyster sauce | 16 ounces sauerkraut, drained | 3 ounces snow peas, trimmed
instructions: First, make your sambusas. In a bowl, mix the chickpea flour, minced pancetta, ground oregano and tomato and basil oregano garlic and ginger paste together until evenly mixed. Add an equal amount of the oyster sauce and mix. Add the sauerkraut, shredded snow peas and mix thoroughly. Set aside to rest for 15 minutes in the fridge or until ready to use. Form the dough into small, golf ball sized, half inch diameter balls. Using a rolling pin, roll each ball into a circle around the edge of a hot saucer, about one or two inches in diameter. Cook the shabab in a dry skillet over medium heat for two minutes on each side, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,sesame oil,beef stock,green chilies,pork shoulder roast
title: Pasta with Sesame Shredded Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder roast, cut into 2-inch chunks | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 1/2 cups low-sodium beef stock | 2 1/2 cups canned green chilies, chopped, drained ( about 10 ) | 1 3/4 cups dry ziti pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°. In a heavy oven proof skillet over medium high heat, brown the pork in the olive oil and then set aside. Add the beef stock to the skillet and bring to a boil. Add the chilies and cook until thick and chunky, about 5 minutes, stirring often. Add the ziti to the pasta in a large bowl and toss with the chilies and pork. Transfer to a baking sheet and bake until heated through, about 40 minutes.

title: Chicken on Stick for 1
ingredients: 1 cup chicken thigh, cut into thirds | 1 tablespoon orange zest, finely grated | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, chopped | 1 tablespoon beets, chopped
instructions: Place the chicken parts in a bowl, sprinkle with the orange zest. Heat the griller to low.

title: Crunchy Crispy Tilapia Chips
ingredients: 1 package crispy rice cereal | 2 pounds tilapia fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread rice cereal flat with a clean cloth or paper towel. Place fish fillets on top of cereal. Bake in preheated oven until fish are opaque and crispy, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and cut fillets into chunks.

Random Ingredients: plastic wrap,saffron,chive,granny smith apple,rotini pasta,red bell pepper
title: Italian Saffron Noodles
ingredients: 6 ounces rotini pasta | 5 ounces granny smith apples, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 green pepper, seeded and sliced into strips | 1/2 red bell pepper, seeded and sliced into strips | 1/3 cup chives, chopped ( or scallions )
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente. Meanwhile, sauté the green, red and or black peppers in the saffron and a dash of water until coated. Reserve in a bowl. Drain the pasta through a sieve, or, you can use a box of cold water. Add to skillet. Add the saffron mixture and the remaining vegetables stirring constantly until hot. Pour pasta mixture over hot vegetables. Garnish with a sprinkle of chives.

title: Walnut Rigatoni II
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 2 cups coarsely chopped walnuts | 1 head boston lettuce
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the rigatoni pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and cool. Once cool, transfer to a bowl, and toss with the cooled walnuts. Cover, and cut into thin wedges, or shred with a cheese grater. Serve. Store any leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: reynolds wrap foil,colby cheese,thyme,lettuce,green curry paste,rice wine
title: Quick and Easy Thai Green Curry on a Bed of Crunchy Cabbage Rolls #RSC
ingredients: 4 cups shredded colby cheese, colby shredded | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1 head lettuce ( or other leafy green vegetables ) | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 3/4 cup dry rice wine | 4 sheets reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Wash and trim veggies, if desired. Lay all veggies on a paper towel. Drizzle curry paste evenly over veggies, then add cheese on top. Sprinkle thyme over all. Fold over once around the edges. Heat a pan of water on medium high. Place rolls on pan, in batches and place in medium hot oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Watch them closely so they don't burn, or they might start to make a lot of popping noises. Serve on a bed of crunchy cabbage rolls with thai rice & a salad of your choice.

title: Buckwheat Italian Sausage
ingredients: 4 ounces sweet italian sausage | 3 teaspoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup peach schnapps dried berries or 1/2 cup berry schnapps | 1/8 cup peach chutney ( peach flavored or apricot flavored ) | 2 tablespoons buckwheat flour
instructions: Cut sausages into 1 inch links and brown over medium high heat in a large skillet. When browned, remove from skillet, add brown sugar and pepper. Add italian sausage and cook over medium high heat until the sausages are no longer pink and the juices in the skillet are beginning to seep out. Remove the sausage from the skillet, add the berry schnapps or any fruit jam desired and mix. Return sausage to skillet. Turn heat down for 3 - 5 minutes, remove from heat.

title: Spanish Vegetables with Crudites
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips, grated ( also known as swedes ) | 1 lb coconut flakes | 1 lb black olives, drained and rinsed | 2 teaspoons golden syrup, warmed | bouquet garni
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In a large bowl, combine the grated turnips, coconut, sliced olives and warm syrup. Stir well until blended. Line 2 cookie sheets generously with foil or parchment paper, put the vegies in the center, leaving enough space to place a single layer of vegies on top. Spoon the mixture evenly onto the greased foil. Bake for 45 minutes or until the vegetables are soft. Sprinkle with a little bouquet garni and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,green chilies,parsley flake,five spice powder,vodka,salad green,sausage,red chili pepper
title: Kielbasa Sausage With Vinegar Dressing
ingredients: 1 package smoked sausage | 4 kielbasa | 3 tablespoons red chili peppers or 3 tablespoons green chilies, pureed | 3 tablespoons smoked paprika and 5 spice powder | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley flakes | 2 cans diced green chilies | 1/2 cup salad greens, chopped
instructions: Prepare sausage by crumbling in a heavy skillet or grinder and heating it in a skillet and chopping. It should take about 7 minutes. If sausage cooks slowly, it will need to be watched about 8 minutes because the smokey taste will burn off. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat in the skillet and return to medium high heat. Add chilies, paprika and 5 spice powder and cook, stirring for 2 - 3 minutes until the chilies are fragrant and aromatic. You should smell the sizzling and aromatic goodness. Dump sausage on plate and cover to keep warm. Add chopped parsley to the skillet. Let them sizzle and wilt until they are a rich golden brown, about 5 minutes. Add 3/4 cup of water, scraping up any browned bits from the pan with a wooden spoon or chopstick. Boil for 20 - 30 seconds and drain on paper towels. In a small serving bowl or other container, combine the vinegar and remaining bottle of smoked sausage. Whisk to combine. Cover and chill 1 - 2 hours or overnight. Before serving, stir the mixture together in a small serving bowl and sprinkle on the salad greens. Serve with sauteed potatoes.

title: Nibby Kikkiri
ingredients: 1/4 cup instant coffee | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon panko breadcrumbs | 0.5 can corn niblets | 0.75 can broth
instructions: Dissolve the cumin powder in the instant coffee with a bit of water. Add the panko, corn niblets, and broths slowly. Bring to a boil, then turn down heat to a simmer. Cook until veggies are tender. Serve over ice cream, if desired.

title: Homemade Cinnamon Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix the sugar and ground cinnamon in small bowl. Stir in the powdered sugar until well incorporated. Spread dough onto an ungreased baking sheet and press into a thin layer. Bake in preheated oven 25 minutes. Cool cookies on baking sheet for 10 minutes, then transfer to wire rack to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,orange juice concentrate,bouillon cube,chili pepper flake
title: Korean Orange Chili Paste for Dipping - Microwave
ingredients: 1 package potato starch | 1 bouillon cube | 5 ounces frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
instructions: In a large microwave safe dish, combine potato starch, bouillon, frozen orange juice concentrate and chili pepper flakes. Cover.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,white vinegar,crab,yellow onion,beef steak,yellow cornmeal,lemonade concentrate,brandy
title: Mexican Crab Cake
ingredients: 1 lb crab | 1/2 yellow onion | 3/4 cup light cream or 3/4 cup sour cream | 3/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 green chili peppers, minced | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 can frozen lemonade concentrate, well drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Remove crab shell, cut the meat into small chunks and toss with onions. Pour cream, add cornmeal, brandy, green chilies, and vinegar into a medium bowl. Mix well to combine. Drain crab meat, and pat dry. Toss crab with the cornmeal mixture. Bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes, or until golden brown and well heated. Turn crab cake onto serving platter. Spoon lemonade concentrate over cake and serve immediately.

title: Spanish Steak
ingredients: 1/3 cup taco seasoning | 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1 cup green olives ( you can use other green olives to equal about 4 c. ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | hot cooked pasta
instructions: Thoroughly rinse steak. Slice cross on the grain 1/2 thick. Sprinkle with taco seasoning. Arrange on a platter and drizzle with extra virgin olive oil. Sprinkle the olives on top.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,beef stew meat,cottage cheese,pasta sauce,baby spinach,sirloin steak,cannellini bean,limeade concentrate
title: Cambodian Lime Beef Stew With Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can low fat cottage cheese | 1 bag fresh baby spinach, washed | 7 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 can condensed cream of coconut soup ( campbell's ) | cooked pasta and mixed salad shells ( ritz or other seashells )
instructions: In a large non stick frying pan, brown beef cubes in 3tablespoon oil over medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes, or till browned. Remove any drippings. Mix cottage cheese, baby spinach, red curry paste, and beans in a large bowl. Pour in beef mixture and cream of coconut soup. Mix well. Spoon mixture into casserole dish. Bake at 400 f for 30 - 45 minutes, or till heated through. Serve over hot pasta, top with additional salad shells for color and garnish.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,cracker,daikon radish,white vinegar,plain nonfat yogurt,club soda,colby monterey jack cheese,mayonnaise
title: Caesar Platter
ingredients: 1 pint nonfat plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup reduced-fat mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 cup prepared colby-monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup plum tomato, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 lb daikon radish, peeled and chopped | 2 1/2 ounces crushed crackers | club soda
instructions: In bowl, whisk together first 5 ingredients. Spoon half of yogurt mixture into a 8 inch x 8 inch glass. Arrange tomato and radishes over yogurt. Spoon remaining yogurt mixture over tomatoes and radishes. Top with crackers and squeeze club soda into a small glass. Garnish with more crackers if desired.

title: Minty Beef Patties
ingredients: 1 ounce mixed herbs | 1 ounce of fresh mint ( or coriander leaves ) | 12 large beef top round lamb stew meat, trimmed of fat | 1 can tomatoes and green chilies, drained ( or equivalent ) | golden raisin, to taste | pepper, to taste, approx, depends on size ( we like lots ) | 1 package refrigerated pepperoni, slices
instructions: Mix herbs together. Tear beef into bite size pieces. Place in bowl with herbs and mint. Stir in tomatoes, green chilies, raisins and pepper. Refrigerate until ready to make, although minimum chill at least 15 - 20 hours. Drain beef and place in a lightly oiled or non stick fry pan. Cook over low heat until meat is cooked but not dried out. Remove from heat. Place the meat on a plate and cover with aluminum foil. Allow to cool to room temperature, about 3 - 5 hours. While meat is cooling slice pepperoni slices into slices. Put a slice of pepperoni in a small bowl. Sprinkle with some fresh mint and a little of the chopped mint. Enjoy eating.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,tiger shrimp,romaine lettuce leaf,english mustard powder,part mozzarella cheese
title: Tiger Shrimp on Garlic Mashed Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | 4 tiger shrimp scoops | 1 teaspoon prepared english mustard powder | 4 small romaine lettuce leaves | 4 slices of your favourite sandwich thin
instructions: Combine the mozzarella cheese, scallions and mustard powder in a plastic bag. Add the shirmp shrimp. Place on a plate, close and pound with a mallet til the shrimp just turns pink, 1 - 2 times. Sauté on high heat for 2 minutes, flip and repeat. Remove from heat and allow to cool until easy to handle. Place on one of the lettuce leaves, then top with your favourite sandwich thin. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ginger powder,italian spice,bread,chili paste,lime juice,vodka,coriander leaf
title: Za Jiang Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 2 slices bread, day old, thick | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 1/4 teaspoons ginger powder | 1 teaspoon dried coriander leaves | 1 stick cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon italian advieh ( i used a little more, to taste ) | lime juice, to taste
instructions: First to make the spice paste, take all the ingredients and mix well. The amount of ginger is up to you, depending on your taste. Then cut the bread in half and spread spice paste onto one side of the bread. Add the sliced bread into a pan on a medium heat. The bread only needs to toast once you get to know the depth. Next after 5 minutes or so, mix in the spice paste. Cook, stirring constantly, around 1 minute. Remove the bread from the pan. The paste will still be on the bread. Using a sharp knife, cut bread into fingers, fingers or other items, and serve with lime wedges. Variation, add 1/2 tsp salt to the vodka and mix in the dried red chili flakes, then mix in the ground coriander. Variation, add 1/2 tsp cayenne, cayenne pepper and ginger powder to the vodka. Variation, add 1/4 tsp ground cardamom to the vodka. Variation, add 1 tablespoon of ground turmeric. Variation, add a teaspoon of red chili flakes to the vodka when you add the red chili flakes and add, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper to the vodka. Variation, add 1 1/4 tsp cinnamon to the vodka and mix in the ground coriander when you add the ground turmeric. Variation, toasting the bread and bread while it is still hot will enhance the flavor, but will not make it crispy. Variation 3. Cut the bread in half into 8 square slices or 6 squares. Heat oil in a fry pan. Dip half the toast cubes into the spicy vodka. Fry bread slices a few times. Place on two serving plates and top with the spicy vodka and sprinkle with cayenne pepper and other fresh, chopped spices.

title: Raspberry Pepperoni Noodles (Noodles)
ingredients: 1 package raspberries | 1 package noodles, any variety, prepared and warmed | 1 package pepperoni, sliced thin | 12 ounces sweet pepperoni, sliced thin | 2 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Soak raspberries for 30 minutes or longer, in large pot of boiling salted water. Reserve 1 cup liquid. In a microwave safe bowl combine all remaining ingredients. Microwave on high for 2 minutes, or until hot or warm to the touch.

title: Crunchy Soydairy Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour or 1 cup gluten-free flour ( gluten-free ) | 1/2 cup miso | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons pine nuts ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons pecan pieces ( optional ) | 1/2 cup buttermilk ( plain ) or 1/2 cup non-dairy milk ( plain ) | 2 -4 tablespoons rice ( gluten-free or gluten-free, gluten-free, or non-dairy )
instructions: Preheat the frying pan to medium heat. You could also substitute low fat cooking spray. Using a 2 - 3 tablespoon measuring scoop, scoop out about two tablespoons of the gluten free mixture.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,plain nonfat yogurt,lemon juice zest,chicken stock,seasoning salt,curry powder,beer
title: Curried Yogurt Sauce for Fish or Chicken
ingredients: 4 teaspoons ginger paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons maggi seasoning salt | 2 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice or 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1 beer or ( 125 ml ) beer
instructions: Blend or process the ginger, maggi seasoning salt, curry powder, yogurt, and lemon or lemon juice to a smooth paste. Place the fish or chicken in a greased saucepan and add the beer or beer. Bring to a boil while stirring constantly. Once the mixture boils, reduce the heat and simmer until the sauce is slightly thickened. Remove from the heat. Add the ginger paste, and mix. Serve over your favourite salad.

title: Grilled Bratwurst (Sausages)
ingredients: 2 bratwursts, sliced thick ( about 1 pound each ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh dill weed, chopped or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill weed | 2 teaspoons fresh flat-leaf italian parsley or 2 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley
instructions: Preheat grill to high. In bowl, combine bratwurst and herbs. Brush both sides of bratwurst with 1 1/2 teaspoons of dressing. Lightly oil grill grate. Lace bratwurst on hot grate and place close together on grill. Grill until brats are just cooked through and brats are lightly charred, about 7 - 8 minutes and coating is browned. Brush with remaining dressing. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Omani
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 2/3 cup uncooked rice
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together through & except the couscous, then form patties. Fry at 350 degrees for 20 minutes. Serve on your own or wrap the entire makage up & cook over couscous as required.

Random Ingredients: trout,lemon extract,chicken breast,pistachio nut,tuna steak,yellow bell pepper
title: Tuna Fish Ceviche with Truffles
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into chunks | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 4 1/2 ounces tuna steaks, cut into chunks | 14 ounces smoked trout, drained and sliced | 4 ounces toasted pistachio nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine chicken, bell pepper, and lemon extract in a bowl, and toss to coat. Stir in tuna, and coat evenly in pesto sauce. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, and up to overnight. To serve, spoon contents of the bowl onto a platter, and sprinkle each with shrimp, and toasted pistachios.

Random Ingredients: lobster tail,penne pasta,red curry paste,shrimp,vanilla extract,onion flake,raisin,green apple
title: Curried Shrimp Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package uncooked penne pasta | 1 1/2 pounds medium shrimp - peeled and deveined | 2 large green apples - peeled, cored and chopped | 3 tablespoons raisins | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dried shrimp
instructions: In a large saucepan, cook the pasta in boiling water until al dente, rinse under cold water, and set aside. Meanwhile, in another saucepan, cook the shrimp and apples with a dash of curry paste, vanilla, and onion flakes to taste over medium heat until just tender. Mix the shrimp, and apples with pasta in a large salad bowl. Sprinkle the cooked pasta with the raisins, and sprinkle with peanuts and mint to serve.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,chili,feta,dark brown sugar,aubergine,chili sauce,star anise,sun tomato oil
title: Aubergine and Chilli Curry
ingredients: 2 large aubergines | 1 1/4 cups sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 500 g chili sauce | 1 1/2 cups of kikkoman chili sauce ( sauce of your choice ) | 100 g dark brown sugar ( or palm sugar ) | 2 star anise | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh chili ( optional )
instructions: Chop aubergine into large cubes. Rinse tomatoes with water. Heat 2 tbsp of chilli sauce in a fry pan over medium heat until bubbling. Add aubergine, sun dried tomatoes and chilli sauté for 3 - 5 minutes. Combine all remaining ingredients and add to pan. Heat through. Serve over rice in large bowls with a sprinkling of fresh chilli pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,ginger,basmati rice,flat bread,fusilli,peanut,steel oat,molasses
title: Fusilli in Wheat  Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups steel cut oats | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/2 cup dry-roasted unsalted peanuts | 3/4 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup fusilli, uncooked | 1 cup flat bread, torn into small pieces | 1/2 inch fresh ginger, peeled, sliced thin | gluten free graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place steel cut oats in a large heatproof bowl, pour boiling water over, and let stand 1 hour, then drain and crumble. Place molasses in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Add peanuts, cooking, and stirring constantly over medium heat, until golden, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl, cool to room temperature, and then stir in rice, fusilli, and ginger. Pour oat mixture over cereal mixture and mix well. Coat hands with gluten free graham cracker crumbs. Drop mixture by rounded 1/2 tablespoonfuls onto parchment paper lined baking sheets, and pat into a small, even circle. Leave at least two inches between crumbs. Serve with maple syrup and fruit.

title: Maple Syrup-Steamed Shrimp and Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 18 -20 jumbo shrimp, peeled, tails on | all thyme sprigs
instructions: Cook cabbage in boiling water until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain. Combine maple syrup, 4 cups of water, and the shrimp in a large oven safe wok. Stir over medium heat until shrimp are pink and thoroughly cooked about 3 minutes. Remove shrimp from wok and place on a platter. Pour maple syrup mixture over shrimp and cabbage. Sprinkle with thyme. Serve hot.

title: Coconut Hominy Pie
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth | 1 can hominy, drained and rinsed well | 1 can coconut milk | salt, to taste | 3 tablespoons paprika, paprika can be substituted ( optional ) | 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: In a pot, combine chicken broth, hominy, coconut milk, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 15 minutes to blend flavors, stirring occasionally. Preheat oven to 400°f. Unfold pastry sheets. Cut each stack in half and place one half on a work surface.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,granny smith apple,vegetable broth,vinegar,beef roast
title: Apple Beef Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup vinegar | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 beef roast, cooked, cubed | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cubed | 1/2 cup vegetable broth
instructions: Place beef and apple in slow cooker. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Chicken Picnic Lovers' Super Easy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb chicken ( whole or sliced ) | 1 tablespoon maggi seasoning salt ( may be sub with beef bouillon or use 1 teaspoon salt ) | 3 fresh red chilies, chopped ( i use two large dried chiles ) | 12 ladyfingers | 3 cups of your favourite figs, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c, gas mark line a large baking tray or roasting tin with baking paper, place chicken onto tray, sprinkle with maggi, cover with a tea towel, allow to rest for 20 minutes. After 20 min, remove chicken from paper, and slice into 1/4 slices. Arrange the slices of chicken, chilies, and jammy fingers on the tray, cover with your favourite figs. Drizzle with remaining maggi, cover with another tea towel and leave for 20 min or so while you sleep. Once out of the oven, open up the baking tray, and bake for 10 minutes or so til cooked completely. Serve with some fresh garden salad, and enjoy.

title: Lime and Potato Pulled Pork Sausage Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb sweet potato ( about 6 medium ) | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 2 tablespoons lime zest | 4 hoagie rolls | 1/2 lb thinly sliced pork sausage, cut into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: Preheat medium nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add sweet potatoes.

title: Lamb and Thyme Rack of Lamb
ingredients: 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 4 racks of lamb
instructions: Make sure the butter is spread out evenly between the rack of lamb. Sprinkle the thyme over both racks. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. Remove plastic wrap and rub lamb all over with white wine. Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Bake for 2 1/2hrs turning the rack frequently. To serve, place rack on a serving platter. Remove juices from pan, discard thyme. Spoon off any fat from gravy and serve immediately.

title: Aunty Mata's Seaweed And Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 1 seedless watermelon | 100 g edamame | 1/2 spring onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon crushed vanilla wafers
instructions: Halve watermelon, remove seeds and cut flesh into 1cm cubes. Put into a bowl and coat in combined edamame and onion and sprinkle with some vanilla wafer crumbs. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or until chilled.

title: Peking Dry Rub
ingredients: 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon minced hot pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients in small bowl. Seal in sterilized jar. To use, wipe rims of jars with damp cloth and sprinkle with coarse salt. Use within 7 days.

title: Easy Mushroom Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb cremini mushroom | 1 pint grape tomatoes ( can use any good quality tomatoes ) | 3 tablespoons chili oil | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Chop mushrooms into 1/3 inch pieces. In bowl, mix tomatoes, chili oil and baking powder. Heat oil and mushrooms up for about 15 minutes. Place on baking sheet and pour sauce over them. Bake for 10 minutes and enjoy.

title: Italian Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 box spaghetti sauce | 1 beer | chipotle powder | canned chili pepper flakes, to taste
instructions: Heat spaghetti sauce in a pot, adding chili powder to taste. Keep warm over low heat. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Vanille Kipferl (Vanille Kipferl Dauphinoise)
ingredients: 10 egg yolks | 1/4 cup port wine ( or brandy )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 160°c grease or line a 25cm springform cake tin. Pour egg yolks into a bowl and beat at high speed with electric mixer for 1 minute, taking medium speed. Reduce mixer speed to low and gradually add port and beat for 7 minutes. Pour batter into prepared tin and tap tin on the counter to level any air bubbles. Bake for 1 1/2 1 3/4 hours or until golden brown. Remove tin and turn out onto wire rack. Cool before removing sides of springform tin to wire rack and releasing sides of tin. Cover with a cloth and then sift icing sugar.

title: Foolproof Bitter Melon and Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs bitter melon or 1 1/4 lbs green bitter melon | 2 tablespoons onion powder
instructions: Cut the bitter melon in half, remove the seeds and pith, then core, and cut crossways into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange the bitter melons on a plate or tray along with the onion powder. Dip all the melons into the onion powder, coating them equally. Leave some onion powder to sprinkle on when eating.

title: Kielbasa Wraps
ingredients: 4 large flour tortillas | 3 -4 links kielbasa or 3 -4 links polish sausage | 1 -2 teaspoon dried red chili pepper | 1 cup radish | 1 jar fresh hoagie rolls, warmed
instructions: Cut sausage into 2 or more slices & soak in 1/2 cup hot water. Drain. Wrap in tortillas. Heat in 300 degree oven for 15 - 20 minutes. While the meat is soaking, peel radish and cut into 1 1/2 slices. Wash & drain rolls. Place rolls onto plate or cutting board. Spread with sausage & add sliced radishes. Spread a tbsp or 2 on each roll. Roll up & place seam side down in a 13x9 baking dish. Cover with a lid or foil & bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes. Remove foil & sprinkle with chopped green onions. Serve hot.

title: Korma (Spinach, Lamb and Bean Stew)
ingredients: 500 g small ground lamb, lean | 15 g fresh ginger, peeled and crushed | 20 g fresh coriander | 10 fresh spinach leaves, washed and torn | 10 fresh basil leaves | 2 cans kidney beans
instructions: Soak the dried beans in plenty of water for a few hours. Put the ground lamb in a deep saucepan, put 3 tbsps. Of cold water. Cover tightly and bring to the boil. Lower heat and simmer for 1 hour. Add ginger, corriander, spinach, basil leaves and water. Cover and cook on medium low for 1 hour. Serve with fresh boiled rice or rotis as a side.

title: Vegetable and Spinach OAMC
ingredients: 500 g spinach leaves | zucchini
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach. Quarter the zucchini and cut each lengthways into about 6 even slices. Put a layer of spinach on the base of a large non stick frying pan. Scatter the zucchinis on top of the spinach leaving the zucchini whole. Push the spinach to the sides of the pan, to give it a good oat shape, then cook on gentle gently for 3 - 4 minutes without moving it too much or any of the air bubbles. Switch the pan to holding the pan and allow to cook for another 3 - 6 minutes until the spinach has wilted. Turn out onto a chopping board with plenty of holes to leave some chew on it at the end of cooking. Eat with your favourite soup, such as as chutney, vegies or pickled vegetables such as potatoes.

title: Zucchini Patties
ingredients: 8 ounces ground chuck | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon cardamom | 1 tablespoon ground dill | 12 sheets phyllo pastry | vegetable oil | 2 medium zucchini, chopped ( about 1 cup )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chuck, vinegar, cardamom, dill and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400°f. Unwrap 1 sheet of phyllo, brush with oil and cut the sheet into 4 or 6 sheets. Place 1/4 pound meat mixture on the longest edge of one sheet. Fold in 1/4 inch of both long sides and roll up into a neat log. Repeat with remaining sheets and filling. Transfer roll to a parchment paper lined baking sheet and brush with more oil. Repeat with remaining sheets and filling. Slice the rolls crosswise into 1/2 pieces. Bake until patties are puffed, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, bring 2 cups water to boil in a large pot. Place 3 zucchini on a small, microwave safe plate. Cover and cook until tender, about 3 or 4 minutes. Drain and let cool slightly. Slice zucchini in half crosswise, then into 1/2 pieces. Repeat with remaining zucchini and zucchini. Serve patties on a platter with zucchini on the side.

title: Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 quart yellow tomatoes, halved | 2 pounds asparagus, trimmed and broken into bite-size pieces | 6 ounces sliced turkey pepperoni, shredded | 1/2 cup halved kalamata olives | 1 tablespoon chili paste with garlic
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange half of the tomato halves in an oven proof skillet. Arrange 1/2 of the asparagus over the tomatoes. Drizzle with chili paste, and top with 1/4 of the turkey pepperoni and 1/4 of the olives. Repeat layers until all asparagus and turkey are used. Sprinkle with remaining tomato halves and drizzle with remaining chili paste. Cover the skillet, and place in the preheated oven. Bake at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes, or until the tomatoes are tender.

title: Apple and Tart Apples With Croutons
ingredients: 1/4 lb italian bread, cut into 3-inch cubes | 2 large large tart apples, peeled, cored, and cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Toss the cubed bread with about 2 tablespoons of the apple juice to coat evenly. Arrange the 4 apple wedges in a single layer on one of the 4 plates. Top with 3 tablespoons grated fresh parmesan cheese, and cover the dish with the remaining apple slices. Drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon of grated cheese over each salad. Serve immediately. Variation with rye bread.

title: Peachy Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 500 g salmon, cut into 6 pieces | 1/2 cup peach schnapps | 1/2 cup roasted red chili pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup sumac | 1/2 cup black mushrooms, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl add all the ingredients and mix well. Marinate the salmon for 30 minutes. Thread the salmon onto skewers and grill to your liking. Serve with rice and vegetables, as a side vegetable, or as a side main dish. Variation, add some sliced kiwi for some extra flavour.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,white sugar,hot italian sausage,self raising flour,cocoa,cheese sauce,salt
title: Cheese and Hot Sausages Rolls
ingredients: 375 g hot italian sausage | 375 g self raising flour | 1/3 cup white sugar | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 250 g cheese sauce | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Cut up hot sausage into small pieces. Place the flour in a large bowl, mix in sugar, salt, cocoa and cheese sauce, mix well. Add sausage and mix lightly, using your hands. Place on a tray cut side up. Bake for 25 minutes or until cooked through. Allow to cool slightly before removing from tray.

title: Chinese Water Chestnut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped water chestnuts or 1 cup finely chopped rindless fresh mushrooms | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced serrano peppers or 2 tablespoons minced jalapeno peppers | 1 small fresh sage leaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl. Allow to sit until ready to use. Store unused portion in refrigerator. Use as directed.

title: Homemade Tomato Sauce for Focaccia
ingredients: 2 cups canola oil, or as needed | 1 pound pepperoni, chopped | 1 tablespoon tomato paste, or as needed
instructions: Heat canola oil in a skillet over medium low heat. Cook pepperoni and tomato paste in hot oil until pepperoni is translucent, about 5 minutes. Pour pepperoni sauce into a resealable plastic bag until cool enough to handle.

Random Ingredients: broth,chicken thigh,coconut milk,celery rib,rosemary leaf,tilapia fillet,szechuan peppercorn
title: Beef Kelagueta (Tilapia)
ingredients: 1 fresh tilapia fillet | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns, crushed | 3 cups coconut milk | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary leaves | 10 chicken thighs, skinned and boned | 1 cup broth | 2 celery ribs, sliced
instructions: Combine the peppercorns and 2 cups of the coconut milk in large bowl. Stir to blend. Add the beef, 1 cup coconut milk, and rosemary and stir. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bring to a boil and simmer over medium heat for about 45 minutes or until just tender, stirring frequently.

Random Ingredients: tahini,coriander seed,pistachio nut,soy sauce,cream chicken soup
title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup light soy sauce | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/4 cup toasted pistachio nut, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Blend the chicken soup, tahini, light soy sauce, coriander seeds and pistachios into a smooth mixture. Place in a shallow baking dish. Spray a cookie sheet with cooking oil, or spread with cooking spray. Bake 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian bread crumb,flour tortilla,fusilli,amarula cream liqueur,coriander,mexican oregano,green onion
title: Tiramisu Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups italian seasoned dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped green onion | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1 pinch dried aramula cream liqueur | 6 flour tortillas, warmed | 1 package fusilli
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix white bread crumbs, green onion, coriander, oregano, and aramula cream liqueur together in a bowl. Set aside 3 tablespoons of the cheese mixture in the bowl.

title: Pistachio Pouch
ingredients: 2 large green cardamom pods, smashed | 4 large dried rotel ( i use homemade-roasted or make your own. seeds, ribs, and leaves ) | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios
instructions: Set rack in centre of oven and heat oven to 400 degrees. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Insert cardamom pods into center of roasting pan, spaced 2 inches apart. Bake 1 1/2 minutes. Turn off oven. Cool, 20 minutes. Meanwhile, rub rimmed baking sheet with a thin layer of oil. Pour about half of seeds and ribs onto sheet, sprinkle with pistachios, shaking pan so pistachios soak in oils. Repeat with second half of seeds and ribs until all seeds and ribs have been used. Scatter pistachios over top. Repeat. Cut into quarters with serrated knife. Sprinkle any remaining seeds on top.

Random Ingredients: wheat tortilla,heavy whipping cream,ziti pasta,cheese spread,pistachio,sesame seed,sherry wine
title: Ziti and Nougat Cheese Pasta Tarts
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon sesame seed | 2/3 cup prepared cheese spread | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 6 whole wheat tortillas, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped pistachios | 1/3 cup dry roasted peanuts
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook lasagna noodles until al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain well. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, over medium heat, warm cream and sesame seeds until hot, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Smoked Salmon & Fava Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 cup dried fava beans ( known as lima beans or chickpeas, 3-4 cups ) | 1/2 cup barley | 1/4 cup smoked salmon ( optional ) | 1 cup yukon gold potato ( or regular potato )
instructions: Rinse & sort fresh fava beans, place in soup pot with barley, salmon, & potatoes. Cook on medium heat for 15 minutes. If there is any extra liquid the soup may be served as a soup base. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,snow pea,navel orange,beef chuck,ziti pasta,molasses,beef sirloin steak
title: Skillet Beef Noodle With Orange, Snow Peas, and Calabrian Style
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck steaks, trimmed and very thinly sliced | 1 lb boneless beef suet, cut into 1/2 thick rounds | 1/2 lb davel orange, sliced | 1 cup beef sirloin steak, trimmed and cut into 4 pieces 1 inch long | 3/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1 can beef short ribs and wild oats | 2 1/2 cups snow peas, preferably white | 2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: In large skillet, over medium high heat, brown beef on both sides. Remove beef and set aside. Drain drippings and pan drippings from skillet. Set beef aside. Add orange slices and cook until lightly browned, turning once. Remove orange slices and add to skillet. Add both the sirloin rounds, aniseed, and remaining juices from the skillet. Add steak strips and cook until well browned. Remove steak strips and steak strips from skillet and add to skillet. Cook until orange slices are tender, stirring occasionally. Add remaining ingredients and stir to mix well. Cook until snow peas are bright green.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,button mushroom,lemon extract,cocoa powder,palm sugar,avocado
title: Champagnole Mushrooms- Avocado Dip - Nigella Lawson
ingredients: 8 ounces button mushrooms, cleaned and washed | 12 ounces unsweetened frozen avocados, cut into small chunks | 20 -24 fluid ounces low-fat yogurt ( nonfat or fat free, i use light ) | 2 -3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder, heaped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Serve chilled or slightly cooled.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces cottage cheese | 1/2 cup finely chopped red onion | 1/2 cup finely chopped red onion | 16 ounces fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Mix together the cottage cheese, red onion, and red onion. Chill a few hours or overnight. Gently fold in the sprouts. Cover and chill.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,pecorino romano cheese,skirt steak,mushroom soup,sherry wine,vanilla yogurt,chicken tender,fish fillet halibut
title: Crock Pot Raita
ingredients: 1 lb skinless chicken breast fillet | 1 boneless skinless skirt steak | 1 can 98 % fat free canned mushroom soup | 1 container low-fat vanilla yogurt | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated or 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder ( i use 1 tsp as i have ) | 2 tablespoons sherry wine ( can substitute water )
instructions: Place chicken fillet and steak in slow cooker. In a medium bowl, combine one can of soup, one container of yogurt, one cup of cheese, 1 tsp chili powder and half of the garam masala. Blend well. Pour over top of chicken and steak and stir to combine. Cover and cook on low until chicken is cooked, 4 - 6 hours.

title: Authentic Pork Soup (Vietnamese-Style)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon thinly sliced galangal | 2 cans beef stock | 1 piece fresh pork shoulder, sliced | 5 shallots, thinly sliced
instructions: Wash and remove the bone, fat and skin from the pork shoulder. Slice pork into thin strips and set aside. Bring the beef stock to a boil. Add the galangal, pork strips and shallots. Return to boil, then simmer 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Mushrooms, Chiles & Raisins With Brandy
ingredients: 8 poblano chiles ( hot and dried ) | 10 ounces cremini mushrooms ( sliced ) | 7 1/2 ounces golden raisins | 1/4 cup brandy | 1/4 cup rose water ( to taste )
instructions: Fire up broiler. Brush or spray pan with olive oil. Roast or grill mushrooms. Spread on sheet pan and roast or grill chiles until they turn a darker tone. Place in bowl. Wipe off any burned or cracked chiles. Rinse chiles by running water over. Pat dry and remove seeds and ribs. Blend chiles, mushrooms and raisins in a food processor. Add brandy and rose water. Puree until smooth. Pour over mushroom mixture.

title: Sugar-Free Noodle Porcini
ingredients: 14 1/4 ounces cooked rigatoni pasta, chilled ( whole grain noodles ) | 1 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon instant coffee beans, drained ( optional ) | 1/2 cup golden raisin ( optional )
instructions: In a 2 l microwave safe bowl, mix 1/2 cup water and 1 tbls. Instant coffee beans, if using. Microwave in on hi for 1 to 2 minutes. Stir. Sprinkle with raisins. Microwave until liquid is absorbed, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Almonds With Garlic Salt
ingredients: 2 tablespoons garlic salt, or more to taste | 1/2 cup almonds, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the almonds in a microwave safe dish using a lid, and cook on high until the nuts are bright green and starting to crackle, about 2 minutes. Sprinkle with salt.

title: Lentils With Pineapple Orchard
ingredients: 1 lb lentils | 1 onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon gelatin | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 aubergine, cut into chunks
instructions: Put lentils, onion, and gelatin in a pot and pour over enough water to cover. Simmer for 12 minutes or until cooked. Drain and rinse well. Pour over remaining ingredients, mix well, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,pearl barley,white flour,kahlua,baking soda,edamame,dark soy sauce,clear honey
title: Edamame (Raw Vegan)
ingredients: 150 g pearl barley ( raw ) | 200 g frozen shelled edamame | 200 g frozen strawberries ( hulled ) | 100 g white flour ( all-purpose ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 1/2 teaspoons kahlua | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh edible flowers such as kerry baby blossoms
instructions: Start with preparing the beans – boil the barley until fully cooked. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius. In a food processor container, grind the edamame, strawberries, barley and hulled edamame into a very small paste. Make a well in the dry ingrdients. Add the sweet soy sauce, honey, baking soda and kahlua. Knead together thoroughly until the mixture starts to form a firm dough. Place on a floured surface and knead it until smooth for approximately 3 minutes. Roll out to about ¾ inch in diameter, cut into slices. Place on the parchment paper with the bean mix. Bake in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes until they have a toasty aroma.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,brown sugar,radish,red curry paste,parmesan cheese
title: Radish Burgers, Japanese Style
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste or 2 tablespoons red chili sauce | 1 tablespoon packed light brown sugar | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 4 medium radishes, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium high. Whisk all ingredients together. Lightly oil grill. Grill radishes 2 minutes on each side or until tender crisp. Spread with more curry/pea mixture. Grill for 2 minutes or until heated through. Serve hot.

title: Quick and Easy Irish Barbecue-Farfalle
ingredients: 3 boxes farfalle pasta | 2 yautia, peeled and sliced | 2 large parsnips, peeled and quartered | 1 bottle honey-based barbecue sauce | 1 cup pearl barley | 4 hoagie rolls, split
instructions: Prepare barbeque sauce, bring 2 liters water to boil. Stir in farfalle, lower heat to simmer and add 2 sliced yautia, parsnips and 2 bottles of barbeque sauce to liquid. Cook for 4 - 6 hours or until farfalle is tender. Drain and cool before serving on hoagie rolls.

title: Saffransalat
ingredients: 2 cups cider vinegar | 3/4 teaspoon saffron threads ( saffron-infused saffron ) | 1 loaf rye bread
instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan combine the vinegar, saffron and the bread. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for about 1 1/2 hours, or until the bread is quite tender and the liquid has evaporated.

title: Cedar Door (Steep and Make Your Own Moose)
ingredients: 1 goose, thawed and patted dry
instructions: Preheat oven to 225°f. Place goose in a roasting pan. Sprinkle top with brown sugar. Roast in preheated oven until juices run clear and fat is caramelized, 2 to 3 hours. Remove from oven and let rest, covered with foil, about an hour.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,mango,flour,double cream,oat,tabasco sauce,oyster sauce,corn syrup
title: Red Cabbage Slaw With Mango & Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup corn syrup | 2 tablespoons light olive oil or 2 tablespoons light olive oil | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 2 teaspoons hot cocoa powder or 2 teaspoons red hot pepper sauce | 1/4 large red cabbage ( about 1 lb. ) | 2 teaspoons flour | 1 tablespoon double cream | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce | 3 small mangoes or 3 other green mangoes, peeled and diced
instructions: Cut cabbage in half lengthwise & cut crosswise into bite sized chunks. Rinse and drain. Mix corn syrup, 2 tbsps olive oil & red hot pepper sauce in a medium bowl. Add cabbage, stir to coat with syrups. Cover and microwave on high for 2 minutes, stir to redistribute evenly. Spread mixture onto a large platter or a cutting board & let sit in the warm oven for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the remaining olive oil in a medium sauce pan. Add the flour & stir over medium heat for a minute or so, then gradually add coconut milk and cook, stirring frequently, until sauce thickens slightly. Stir in cream and oyster sauce & simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve mango or other vegetables over the cabbage mixture.

title: Italian Style Oven Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 fresh tomatoes, sliced lengthwise into halves | 2/3 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Arrange tomatoes around edge of oiled large baking pan. Sprinkle evenly with bread crumbs and cut a slit lengthwise through each tomato. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake, uncovered at 325 degrees 20 - 25 minutes until tomatoes are golden brown and tender.

title: Lahmous (Spinach and Banana Salad)
ingredients: 1 bunch kalamata olive, cut in half lengthwise | 1 bag trimmed spinach | 2/3 cup dried porcini mushrooms | 1/3 cup greek yogurt | 1 banana, sliced
instructions: In a bowl, toss with spinach. Cover and refrigerate. Heat a grill pan over medium heat. Grill olives about 5 minutes, turning once, until blackened, turning once. Remove from grill. Wrap in a towel to remove as much moisture as possible. Rub off oil and discard. Rinse kalamata olives under cold running water, then use a brush to coat both sides. Arrange spinach and mushrooms on a serving platter. Arrange olives over the top and serve with yogourt as a topping for the salad.

Random Ingredients: thyme,rice noodle,oregano leaf,date,cardamom powder,cream chicken soup,pine nut
title: Puppa Naramdil
ingredients: 1 package rice stick noodles, dried ( naiessal ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 teaspoon oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder ( korerim pokete - filipino spice blend )
instructions: Add dry noodles to boiling water, bring to a boil and cook until al dente. Drain and set aside. Add condensed cream of chicken into a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Add to pot of noodles and stir well. Add spices and stir to coat. Note, if making this for a party you can make sure to stir in the nuts and/or pine nuts before serving as you can spoil a great meal.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,jalapeno,pistachio nut,american cheese,garlic powder,cremini mushroom,shiitake mushroom
title: Hot 'n' Spicy Party Dip
ingredients: 1 package cremini mushrooms, cleaned, chopped | 1 bag shiitake mushrooms, cleaned, chopped | 1 package processed american cheese, cubed | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup chopped pistachio nuts, toasted | 1/8 cup pickled jalapeno slices, sliced in thin rings
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large crock pot and cook on high for 15 minutes or on low for 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,chili pepper flake,onion soup mix,tortilla chip,sugar
title: Spicy Cashew Nests
ingredients: 5/8 cup tortilla chips | 5 tablespoons finely chopped onions with or 5 tablespoons dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons dried basil and chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup cashew nuts ( optional ) | 3 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a medium bowl, combine the tortilla chips, chili flakes and basil. Add 2 tablespoons of sugar and toss lightly. Set aside 1 tablespoon of cashew nuts for garnish and pour the remaining oil into a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Add the cashew nuts and cook until golden brown on all sides. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel and set aside. Repeat with remaining cashews. Spoon the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil from frying pan and increase heat to medium high. Stir fry onion for 2 minutes or until softened. Stir in the cashew nut mixture, return to a boil. Stir in the remaining sugar and serve hot.

title: Spaghetti Alla Carbone
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons caramel sauce | 3 -4 leaves baby arugula | spaghetti
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to the boil. Meanwhile, combine caramel sauce and arugula in medium bowl. Pour caramel sauce mixture into a large, wide skillet. Add spaghetti to boiling water. Stir frequently, until pasta is cooked through but is still soft. Remove from heat and immediately toss with pasta mixture. Serve, or refrigerate until ready to use. The carrots will keep for 2 days in the refrigerator.

title: Garlic Slicer Danish Pastry
ingredients: 1 can pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 tablespoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Separate each crescent dinner roll into 4 triangles. Divide rolls into 4 triangles. Sprinkle each one with garlic salt and pinch of garlic, then place on a baking sheet or pastry bag with the other end of the crescent dough on the top, pressing down between each triangle. Bake at 400 degrees for about 10 minutes, or until lightly golden brown on top and edges are slightly crispy. Serve hot.

title: Parmesan Chicken Strips
ingredients: 1 package frozen pound cake flour, thawed | 2 tablespoons cake flour, sifted | 2 cups grated parmesan cheese | 1 lb boneless chicken thighs, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper. To make the filling, mix the flour, parmesan cheese and 1/2 lb of the chicken in a bowl. Roll or dredge the remaining chicken in the flour mixture. Arrange the chicken on the baking sheets and bake for 25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked, then remove from the oven.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,cod,kalamata olive,arborio rice,mace,pistachio nut,white bread
title: Cod and Olive Pilaf Ala Doctrina
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod | 2 1/3 cups arborio rice | 3 ounces white bread, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 4 ounces kalamata olives, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 3 tablespoons roasted pistachio nuts, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Remove the skin from the fish and cut the fish into 1/2 inch wide strips.. Place the cod, rice, bread, olives, pistachio nuts, vinegar and mace in a medium saucepan and barely cover with water. Bring to a boil and then lower the heat, cover and simmer until the rice is tender, approximately 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cheese,red pepper powder,plain flour,sun tomato oil
title: Cheese Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cheese, grated | 1 ounce sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained thoroughly and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper powder ( or to taste ) ( optional ) | 4 -5 drops plain flour ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, mix all of the ingredients except for the flour and knead in your fingers with your hands until they are well mixed. Do not overwork the fritters as they will toughen in the final result. Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and roll each one in flour. Heat a frying pan to medium heat and fry the fritters for about 5 minutes on each side until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese soup,beef stock powder,nonfat cream
title: Low Budget Low Calorie, Low Cal French Onion Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces dry cheddar cheese soup ( i use low fat ) | 1 1/2 cups nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon beef stock powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 c. Mix soup, sour cream and beef stock powder. Pour into a 3 3/4 quart baking dish. Cover with foil with a small lip. Bake 90 minutes. Remove foil.

title: Jalapenos and Tequila Batcheros
ingredients: 1 pound sliced kielbasa | 1/4 cup tequila | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, stir the kielbasa with tequila, cilantro, parmesan cheese, and self rising flour to combine. Cover and refrigerate mixture overnight. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place a baking sheet on the center rack of the oven. Place prepared marinated kielbasa on the hot baking sheet. Bake the chiles in the preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes, until puffed and golden brown. Cool slightly before removing from the baking sheet.

title: Homemade Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 cup fresh lemon-peppercorn and mortar-made black mustard seeds ( found at specialty food stores ) | 2 cups mayonnaise, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Stir the black mustard seed into the mayonnaise to form the base. Spread the base onto a pizza peel or other large flat surface. If desired, make the bread a little thicker with an offset spatula. Let stand for 15 minutes at room temperature, then spread the mayonnaise onto the pizza peel. Place the bread on the pizza peel, and spread the remaining mustard oil onto the top. The mayonnaise can be eaten either from the papas or in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Filipino Fish Rolls
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1 jar kielbasa-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lay each fillet on a cutting board. Using two knife or a sharp knife, pierce a pocket in the thickest portion of each fillet and fill with stewed tomatoes. Cut the cat in half lengthwise and remove the backbone and discard. Rinse the fillets under cold water. Slice lengthways into 1 1/2 inch wide slices. Spread each fillet on a clean, lightly floured surface. Roll each piece of fish loosely around each tomato and secure with toothpicks. Arrange them in a shallow 2 quart baking dish with the legs slightly open. Cover, and bake until fish is easily flaked with a fork, about 30 minutes.

title: Crock Pot Easy Delicious Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 can corn oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons black olives, chopped
instructions: Drain water from cans of soup can. Add olive oil to soup can to cover. Pour soup can over black olives and add chopped olives. Stir. Cover and cook 7 - 9 hours until chicken pulls apart easily.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,lemon juice,espresso,red enchilada sauce,bacon dripping
title: Italian Style Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 2 lbs dry red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup bacon drippings or 1/4 cup melted lard | 3 celery ribs, chopped | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 3 teaspoons instant espresso ( coffee granules )
instructions: Pour about 1/2 cup of the enchilada sauce into a large bowl. Add 4 qts. Of water. Add 2 lbs of the celery and set aside. Add the remaining enchilada sauce and stir to incorporate. Add the melted fat, lemon juice and instant espresso granules. Bring to a rapid simmer and simmer until the liquid is reduced to about half. Add 1/2 of the red enchilada sauce and simmer another 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and strain and set aside.
