When ready to serve, reheat the remaining sauce in a saucepan to warm it through, although it becomes more pronounced with time. Serve as directed over white rice.

title: Shredded Beef-Onion Stew
ingredients: 6 thick slices whole wheat bread | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 1/2 pounds trimmed excess fat beef chuck, cut into thin strips, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seeds | 1 tablespoon peanut oil, or more as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch glass baking dish with a reynolds wrap foil large enough to wrap around the sides. Heat 1 tablespoon of peanut oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in cumin seeds, and allow to sizzle for 30 seconds. Add beef strips.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,beef tenderloin,salt pepper,italian parsley,cauliflower floret,sardine
title: Sardine and Cauliflower Stir Fry
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin, trimmed of all visible fat | 3 cups cauliflower florets | 4 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, minced | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup salt and pepper, to taste | 1 can sardines, drained and meat cut into chunks
instructions: Trim the beef of any visible fat, and slice across the grain into thin slices. Place the beef in a large nonstick skillet, and pour in enough water to cover over high heat to come half way up the meat. Bring the water to a boil, place a lid on, and set the skillet aside. Place the cauliflower in the sink, and drain the cauliflower. Discard the coarsely chopped stems and any coarse woody bits from the cauliflower. Place the cauliflower and parsley in a pot, pour in the sugar, and melt the sugar over medium heat until the sugar is dissolved. Do not allow the sugar to color to change, or the cauliflower will turn into a dark, bitter syrup. Add the salt and pepper, and cook over medium heat until the mixture is syrupy, about 5 minutes. Drain the sardines, reserving the oil, and place the chunks into the sauce in the skillet. Stir fry the meat and cauliflower until the meat is cooked through and the cauliflower is tender crisp, about 5 minutes. It may not take very long, but check the meat occasionally.

Random Ingredients: lemon lime beverage,white wine,tempeh,onion powder,black bean,mango,caper
title: Baked Tempeh Salad
ingredients: 1 package tempeh, cubed | 1 can black beans, drained | 1 can mango, diced | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/2 cup lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage | 1 dash onion powder | 1 tablespoon capers, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine tempeh, black beans, mango, white wine, lemon lime soda and onion. Pour into a large oven proof dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until bubbly.

title: Roasted Beef
ingredients: one inch piece of beef tenderloin, trimmed | 2 tablespoons grated orange peel | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Tear apart the beef tenderloin with kitchen string or kitchen twine. Lay the beef onto a rack in a pan. Turn the roast so the string picks up and encases it tightly. Roast the beef as outlined by the manufacturer's instructions. Let continue baking until it is well browned and well caramelized, about 1 hour.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 4 large avocados | 2 pinches parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( to garnish ) | 2 pinches green peppers ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | picante sauce, salsa ( optional )
instructions: Wash and remove the pit from each avocado half. Cut in half and remove the seed with a teaspoon. Mash the avocado with a fork, being careful not to break any larger chunks. Sprinkle the cheese and green pepper into each avocado half. Garnish with salsa, if desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,plantain,pizza crust,lentil,pork butt,chicken stock
title: Crock Pot Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 lb of cubed lean pork butt or 1 lb lean pork loin, cut into 2 1/2 inch cubes | 3 lbs of cubed plantains ( i recommend using frozen ) | 10 ounces of ditaline lentils ( i recommend red if available ) | 2 cans chicken stock | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 ready-to-use pizza crust
instructions: Place the pork and lentils into the crock pot. Add stock and brown sugar. Cook on high for 3 to 4 hours. Stir well, then check to see if lentils are tender.

title: Beer and Salmon Rolls With Spinach & Beer
ingredients: 1 can beer | 2 bunches baby spinach | 1 whole salmon, skinned, boned and backstraps
instructions: Pour the beer into a large non stick frypan. Put the baby spinach leaves over the top. Scatter the salmon on top. Bring to the boil, lower the heat, cover and cook for 10 - 15 minutes, turning the salmon halfway through cooking. Carefully remove the salmon when cooked through.

title: Nanny's Veggie Fritters
ingredients: 500 g veges, chopped or 500 g ground beef | 2 cups self-raising flour ( or 2 cups gluten-free plain flour ) | 1 cup raisins ( or 100 g sultanas ) | 1 cup cooked kidney beans ( or 1 can of cannellini beans, drained and rinsed ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup lettuce leaf, shredded | lettuce leaf, as required to serve
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the vegie, onion, flour and raisins. Using your hands, mix and knead the mixture until the mixture is smooth and elastic. Wrap a piece of lettuce leaf in foil and spray it with nonstick cooking spray. Using your wet hands, roll the mixture into small patties approximately the size of your lettuce leaves. Refrigerate for 15 minutes. Cook over a medium heat until browned all over. Serve hot with your favourite dips.

title: Vegetarian Baked Beans
ingredients: 4 cans vegetarian baked beans | 1/2 teaspoon sage leaf, crushed
instructions: Heat oven to 400. Combine beans, sage and sage in a baking dish. Bake for 45 minutes covered with foil, stirring twice after 30 minutes. Remove foil.

Random Ingredients: caper,almond paste,cream mushroom soup,turnip,orange peel,cod,cream,pecan half
title: Creamy Fish and Turnips
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod, cut into 4 pieces | 4 turnips, peeled and diced into chunks and pieces | 1 package almond paste, thawed | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup grated orange peel | 1/4 cup capers, drained | 1/4 cup chopped pecan halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine fish, turnips and almonds paste in a bowl. Mix soup, sour cream, orange peel and capers. Pour over fish mixture.

title: Almonds and White Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs raw almonds | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 lbs dried white beans
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over moderately high heat. Add the almonds and toast for 5 minutes or until golden. Turn the almonds over and raise the heat to moderately high. Cook the almonds until they become dry and the edges are quite darkened, about 3 minutes. Using paper towels, transfer the almonds to a large mixing bowl. Cook the beans in boiling water for 4 minutes. Drain the beans.

title: Fresh Jicama - Jicama
ingredients: 3 lbs jicama ( peeled and cubed about 4 ) | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 3 fresh ripe tomatoes ( chopped and seeded, about 1/4 cup each ) | 1 small kielbasa ( or other spicy sausage )
instructions: Heat the oven to 325°f. Combine all ingredients in a bowl, cover and bake for 90 - 120 minutes, or until jicama is very tender when pierced with a fork. Serve.

Random Ingredients: baby portabella mushroom,peanut oil,onion soup mix
title: Sauced Roasted Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 12 baby portabella mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups peanut oil for frying
instructions: On a platter, mix the dry onion soup mix with enough water to make a smooth paste. Stir in portobellos. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,allspice berry,spice,sherry wine,wine vinegar,beef broth,garlic salt,ice water
title: Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon allspice | 2 tablespoons ice water | 2 teaspoons minced garlic salt | 4 teaspoons whole mixed spice ( bergyree blend, if available ) | 1 lb stew meat, cut into 1/2 `` cubes | 2/3 cup beef broth
instructions: Combine the sherry vinegar, 1 tablespoon vinegar, allspice, and 1 tablespoon ice water in a small bowl. Add the garlic salt and whole mixed spice. Combine well. Add the meat, cover and refrigerate for 1/2 hour to marinate. When ready to cook, deglaze the pot with the 2/3 cup beef broth, adding the remaining 1 tablespoon vinegar as needed.

title: Crunchy, Fresh Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 red ripe tomatoes, seeded, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ginger, minced | 1/2 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 tablespoon chopped peanuts | 1 head lettuce ( or torn mixed lettuce ) | 2 tablespoons low-fat yogurt
instructions: Mix all ingredients except lettuce. Garnish with lettuce.

title: Foolproof Scottish Lace Cookies
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups butter | 1 1/2 cups sifted flour
instructions: With the mixer attatch, cream the butter and add the flour. When the mixture is very light and fluffy, add more flour. Work with fingers and do not knead them, just roll with hands until they are as firm as bread flour. Shape the dough into walnut size balls. Cut a small piece into top of each cookie. Place on a tray, cover with greaseproof paper and leave to set for 45 minutes in a warm oven, 200 degrees celsius. When they are firm and pale coloured, gently move onto a wire rack. Store in an airtight container. Variation, substitute other ingredients such as sifted icing sugar, cinnamon, cocoa, icing sugar, etc.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,sugar snap pea,onion powder,velveeta cheese,taco
title: Quick Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese | 1 lb sugar snap peas | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 3 -4 mint leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let sit at room temperature 30 minutes or longer until set. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: cooking sherry,tomato,chili powder,beef stew meat,wheat bread,worcestershire sauce,golden syrup,jalapeno pepper serrano
title: Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can diced tomatoes, drained | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 -2 tablespoon chile powder | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 fresh jalapeno peppers with serrano, seeded and chopped | 1 loaf crusty wheat bread
instructions: In large bowl, toss stew meat with tomatoes, worcestershire sauce, sherry, golden syrup, chili powder and worcestershire sauce. Let marinate at least 2 hours or overnight. Preheat grill to high heat. Place meat on grate 8 to 10 inches from coals. Place a baking pan on grate. Place 1 jalapeno pepper on grill. Close grill. Simmer 10 minutes. Slice crosswise across the grain into thin strips. Place in a large shallow baking dish. Top with tomato mixture. Close baking pan with other side of baking pan. Close lid of grill. Cook 12 minutes. Serve over sliced whole wheat bread.

title: Danish Rhubarb Soup
ingredients: 3 cups chopped rhubarb | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup chopped cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup chopped dried apricots | 8 flour tortillas | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Mix rhubarb, tomatoes, and cheese in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally to avoid scorching, 20 to 30 minutes. Fold 1 tortilla into soup.

title: Aussie Sweet and Sour Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 1/4 cup sweet tomato sauce
instructions: Combine pineapple juice and sweet tomato sauce in a bowl.

title: Peanut-Mustard Beef Shank for Two-Bowl
ingredients: 4 beef shanks | 24 ounces peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Trim excess fat from beef shanks. Sprinkle the inside of a casserole dish with salt and rub with salt. Place the beef shanks on top of the salt and spread out in a single layer. Cover with foil and bake for 2 1/2 hours, until meat is tender. Remove beef shanks to a platter and set aside. Return dish to oven and bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened. Remove the shanks and reheat in the sauce. Spread a bit of peanut onto each of the warmed pita breads and serve with the meat.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,lima bean,french breadstick,greek seasoning,pecorino romano cheese,rice wine
title: Oaxacan Sun Dried Tomato and Lima Cheese Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 loaf french breadstick, cut diagonally into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup lima beans, julienned | 3 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon powdered all purpose greek seasoning | 1/2 cup rice wine or 1/2 cup dry white wine
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Place breadsticks on a baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray and place on the center rack of the grill, grilled side down. Spray breadsticks with cooking spray and cook until browned and crispy, about 15 minutes, turning once. Remove breadsticks from grill and let cool. Meanwhile, combine sun dried tomatoes, lima beans, romano cheese, all purpose greek seasoning and all purpose Greek seasoning in a small bowl. Set aside. Place rice wine or dry white wine in a small pot over medium heat. Cover and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Drain any excess liquid from the sun dried tomatoes, tomato mixture, and grated cheese. Add to the cheese mixture and stir to combine. Serve, drizzling olive oil and sun dried tomatoes over the toasted breadsticks as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,vanilla bean,nigella seed,wheat flour,lime wedge,peanut butter
title: Flourless Chocolate-Lime Chunk Cookies
ingredients: 8 ounces dark chocolate | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1 vanilla bean | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour, sifted | 1 teaspoon nigella seeds | 2 large lime wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Lightly grease a medium sized bowl with nonstick spray and set aside. Place chocolate in a double boiler or a medium saucepan over simmering water. Over low heat, stir until smooth, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat and add the peanut butter and vanilla bean. Whisk until smooth, about 1 minute. Remove vanilla bean and discard. Stir in flour and nigella seeds. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes to an hour before using. Place lime wedges in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment. Using the heel of your hand, roll the dough in the lime to coat evenly, about 10 turns. Remove from bowl and transfer the rounds to parchment lined baking sheets. Repeat with second batch and remaining rounds. Makes about 18 cookies. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

title: Radish and Beef Pizza
ingredients: 2 flour pizza crusts, 12 x 7 inches | 1/4 lb sirloin, sliced thin | 1 cup radish, sliced thin | 1/8 cup lemon juice
instructions: Slice meat as needed. Spread on dough. Combine remaining ingredients. Spread on top of meat and sprinkle with spices. Bake at 400 for 25 - 30 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Kicked Up Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless lean ground beef or 2 1/2 lbs ground lamb | 1 can cherry tomatoes ( with juice ) | ice cube
instructions: Brown ground meat in a medium skillet with salt and pepper to taste. Add cherry tomatoes and juice and heat through. Serve over ice cubes. Great with a salad and a salad mix that just evolved.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,cream tartar,yellow pepper,cheddar cheese,watercress,apple cider vinegar
title: Beef Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 lb boneless beef top round steak, trimmed | 1 yellow sweet pepper, thinly sliced | 1 medium red peppers, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup finely snipped watercress, for garnish
instructions: In small bowl, combine cream of tartar and 1/2 teaspoon salt.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,lemonade concentrate,pomegranate seed,extra beef,grand marnier
title: Protein Slam-Jam
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 16 ounces spaghetti sauce | 1 1/2 ounces lemonade concentrate | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds
instructions: Brown meat with garlic.

title: Marmie's Spicy Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg chicken | 1/2 liter yoghurt or 1/2 liter sour cream | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons chilli oil | 1 -2 tablespoon light rum | 1 -2 slice pepperoni
instructions: Make sure to wash the chicken well in plenty of water so you can clean it off. Rinse and pat dry. Place the chicken in a large, non metallic container with the yoghurt or sour cream, pesto, chilli oil and rum. Till the chicken is coated. Marinate the chicken at least two and up to four hours or up to overnight in the fridge or even overnight in the unlikely case that the chicken is very cold. Bake the chicken in a rotisserie over hot coals, on high for about 20 - 30 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken and how much the fat has cooked into it. Turn the chicken halfway through, basting with any marinade left over during the baking. Remove the chicken in to slices and place on serving plates. Serve straight from the rotisserie. It takes around 20 minutes for the whole batch of chicken to be cooked. If you choose to serve it as a sandwich or dinner plate or main course, cut the chicken in smaller slices and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,green pepper,chile,red pepper flake,cardamom,dark sesame oil
title: Spiced Masala Sauce for Beef or Lamb
ingredients: 1/3 cup finely chopped green pepper | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon minced garlic clove | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon finely chopped fresh chile
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients.

title: Crab Stuffed Calamari #2
ingredients: 24 corn niblets | 4 -5 cups cooked crabmeat | 1 cup walnuts, chopped and toasted | paprika or hot pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the cooked crabmeat in a baking dish. Mix in the walnuts. Sprinkle with paprika or hot pepper sauce. Set in the oven and bake for 5 minutes.

title: Yukon Gold Potato Salad With Mango Dressing
ingredients: 4 medium yukon gold potatoes | 1/2 cup mangoes or 1/2 cup papaya, diced
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut in half. Boil till tender approx 10 minutes or until cooked completely. Drain then put in mixing bowl using a large metal spoon. Add diced mangoes or papaya, the drained potatoes and 1/2 cup water. Mix together. Enjoy.

title: Quinoa Vegetable Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 bunch broccoli, trimmed and cut into 1/4 inch dice ( or use florets mixed with the cut vegetables ) | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup quinoa, rinsed
instructions: Place the oil in a 10x16 inch nonstick skillet. Heat over medium high heat. When the oil shimmers, add the broccoli and cook 3 to 5 minutes or until crisp tender. Remove the skillet from the burner. To test whether it is done, carefully lift one piece, if it fries to your liking, it should be firm. When the broccoli is crisp, remove it to paper towels to drain. When the broccoli is crisp, remove it to paper towels to drain. If the oil is not smoking, add a few drops of tabasco. Add the hot skillet to the pan. Stir in the quinoa and cook until lightly browned over high heat, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in the broccoli and cook until heated through and hot, about 1 to 2 more minutes. Serve warm.

title: Easy Salmon and Potato Rice
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups basmati rice | 1 head garlic, cloves peeled | 1/2 pound salmon fillets | 1/2 cup chopped fresh spinach leaves | 2 ounces diced turnips
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water. Heat a large pot over high heat. Stir in the rice, garlic, and salmon. Scoop the rice with a strainer into the pot. Place the spinach leaves on top of the rice. Sprinkle with salt. Turn heat to medium low and cover. Simmer for about 40 minutes, until the water is absorbed, and rice is tender. Serve the rice in a small bowl alongside the salmon. Garnish with diced turnip.

title: Linguine With Sausages and Zucchini.
ingredients: 1 packet linguine | 1 lb chorizo sausage or 1 lb linguine | 1 jar olive | 1 zucchini, sliced | 1 1/2 cups creme fraiche or 1 1/2 cups sour cream | 1/2 cup abalone sauce, sauce
instructions: Start boiling water for pasta. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to cool pasta. Place in a large bowl in a single layer. Mix in the sausage or linguine and let sit while preparing the remaining ingredients. Cut zucchini into thin slices and toss with olive. Warm creme fraiche or sour cream. Top with a few tablespoons of warm cream and a few drops of abalone sauce if desired. Pour over the pasta and toss to combine. Serve immediately while warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,ketchup,lemon juice,fingerling potato,jalapeno pepper,hamburger,table salt
title: Baked Fingerling Potatoes
ingredients: 2 medium fingerling potatoes, peeled, sliced | 1 tablespoon table salt ( kosher or sea ) | 6 ounces hamburger | 1 1/2 tablespoons ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 dash cream of tartar | 1 jalapeno pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Cook the fingerling potatoes in water till fork tender, about 15 to 20 minutes drain and cool. Transfer potatoes to a 1 1/2 quart baking dish then place the hamburger in a large bowl stir in the chopped jalapeno and season with kosher salt. Stir in the lemon juice and cream of tartar. Spread this mixture over the potato slices and bake, uncovered, in the oven till the cheese is just beginning to melt..

title: Onion Soup Gratinees
ingredients: 2 lbs cooking onions | 12 ounces yogurt, unsweetened | 1 3/4 pints boiling water | 9 ounces pastry flour
instructions: Peel and slice onions thinly. Place onions in boiling water and simmer for 20 minutes until tender. Drain and mash with potato masher. Pour warm soup through sieve and return to pan. Gradually mix in yoghurt making sure that it is well mixed. Cover and store in fridge overnight. The next day add flour to soup and mix well. Bring back to boil.

Random Ingredients: pretzel,green bean,eggplant,sourdough bread,thai fish sauce,cabbage,sesame seed
title: Yakisoba(Sushi Toast) With Pretzel and Green Beans
ingredients: 3 slices sourdough bread | 1 eggplant, sliced | 1 lb green beans, cleaned, trimmed, cut in half lengthwise, and each half cut in half again | 1/2 cup pretzel | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 1/2 cups napa cabbage or 1 1/2 cups komamizoma, coarsely chopped | 6 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to spray 13x9x2 inches baking dish with veggie spray. In a small bowl, combine sesame seeds with chopped cabbages. Toss with bread. Arrange bread slices in a single layer on the cookie sheet. Bake until bread is browned and crisp, about 7 minutes. Cut remaining slices of bread into 6 to 8 triangles. In a small bowl, combine pretzels and sesame seeds. Toss with green beans and pretzels and sesame seeds. Spread on toast. In a small bowl, combine fish sauce and thai sauce. Sprinkle top with pretzels and sesame seeds. Serve hot.

title: Ricotta in a Jar With Chipotle Chilies
ingredients: 1 package part-skim ricotta cheese | 2 canned chipotle chiles, including juice
instructions: In a blender, puree the ricotta and chilies until smooth. Transfer the mixture to a medium bowl and fold in the chipoltes with the chipotles. Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.

title: Spice Mixture
ingredients: 2 large red bell peppers | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Pierce the skin of the peppers with a sharp knife, and remove and discard the cores. Slice the peppers into strips, 2 - 3 inches long by 2 inches wide and 3 - 4 inches long. Place the bell peppers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and season with italian seasoning. Mix the spices and the pepper strips in a small bowl, and brush on the peppers until coated. Bake peppers in preheated oven for 20 - 25 mintues, or until the peppers are tender and the peppers are a little crispy on the outside but more crispy on the inside,. Cool, and store the roasted peppers in their marinade. These are great as appetizers at christmas time, or to snack on the same day.

title: Tahini Fish
ingredients: 12 ounces small fresh oysters | 1/4 cup tahini
instructions: Rinse the oysters under cold running water. Slide a skewer under the shrimp to make a small opening for the tahini. Spread the tahini on the oysters, then set aside. Grill or broil the oysters until the shrimp turn pink and the tahini has lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,ginger,soy sauce,cheddar cheese,black peppercorn,tomato paste,yellow food coloring
title: Chilean Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shredded cheddar cheese ( or you can use mild cheddar ) | 1 can tomato paste | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter, melted | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon yellow food coloring | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 3 -4 black peppercorns
instructions: Note the amounts listed are approximate. I use more than 1/2 cup cheese and may not use all of the cheese. Combine all ingredients in 2 quart casserole. Bake at 350°f for 30 minutes or until cheese has melted. Cool completely. Cover and chill completely in the refrigerator. Makes about a dozen 8 ounce servings. Variation, for a change to this recipe replace the tomato paste with another one of these, 1 tsp of almond extract and 1 cup of very cold water. Or for a change to the soy sauce and/or almond extract, substitute 1 tsp of dark soy sauce and 1 tbsp of tomato paste diluted in 1/2 cup of very cold water. Or for a change to the flavor, substitute 1 tsp of dark soy sauce with 1 tsp of dark rum or 1/4 tsp of bertolli extract. Or just for flavor change go ahead and add 1 teaspoon of dark rum or bertolli extract mixed with 1/4 cup of very cold water. Or for a change to the flavor, substitute 1 tsp of dark soy sauce and 1/4 tsp of dark rum or bertolli extract. Or just for flavor change go ahead and add 1 tsp of dark rum or bertolli extract mixed with 1/4 cup of very cold water. Or for a change to the flavor, replace 1 tsp of dark rum or bertolli extract with 1/4 cup of very cold water, and replace 1 tsp of dark rum or bertolli extract with 1/4 cup of very cold water. Or for a change to the flavor, substitute 1 tsp of dark rum or bertolli extract. Or for a change to the flavor, substitute 1 tsp of dark rum or bertolli extract. Or just for a change to the flavor. Variation, for a change to the flavor, substitute 1 tsp of dark rum or bertolli extract.

title: Roasted Sesame Potatoes
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, peeled | 1 can diced plum tomatoes with juice | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Core potatoes and cut in half. Place potatoes on towel or paper towel and pat dry. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. Drizzle tomatoes with olive oil and sprinkle with sesame oil. Roast potatoes for 45 to 60 minutes, stirring half way through, until tender and slightly browned on the edges.

title: Mildly Whiskey Chai Cheese Balls
ingredients: 2/3 cup low fat cottage cheese ( i use light sour cream ) | 1/2 cup chopped ham ( deli chopped, can sub bacon ( cooked ) | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 2 teaspoons instant tea | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/4 cup rye breadcrumbs or 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: In a bowl, mash cottage cheese, ham, ketchup, tea, lemon peel, and fenugreek seeds with a fork. Add crumbs and toss well. Cover and refrigerate. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,cod fish fillet,wheat bread,beef bouillon cube,spanish rice,pork shoulder,pie shell
title: Portuguese Grilled Skirlie
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast pork shoulder | 10 beef bouillon cubes | 3 3/4 cups sliced spanish rice | 1 red bell pepper | 1 cup canned portuguese-style rice | 1 can pie shells, unbaked | 16 ounces ground pork shoulder | 1 large crusty bread, cut in half
instructions: In a large pot place chicken, bouillon cubes and rice and bring to a boil. Turn heat down and simmer about 45 minutes, or until liquid absorbed and rice is tender, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Place a layer of pork in pie crust and top with 3/4 of the sauteed white rice and 1/2 of the black beans. Repeat layers until ingredients are used up. Heat grill or broiler. Brush grill with oil. Grill for 5 to 10 minutes, or until pork is browned and hot throughout. Remove from grill or broiler. Remove cover and set aside. Let rest about 10 minutes. Place sauteed pork and remaining sauteed white rice on top of the sauteed white rice. Place coals or coals on the grill or grill grate. Turning the grill or grill grates, cook the brined pork with onions until the internal temperature reaches 140 degrees in the thickest part of a deep frying pan, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain excess fat and add the liquid from the sausage and the ground meat. Increase temperature to a high and fry the pork until browned. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Prepare the second pie crust recipe in this way, following the basic recipe with the pork sauteed white rice and beans. Place a layer of sauteed pork and the second pie crust in a preheated oven at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes, or until crust is golden brown. In a separate preheated oven, place the second pie crust in the oven for 5 to 10 minutes. Preheat grill or broiler and grill the pastry crust.

Random Ingredients: anchovy,sesame seed,chicken leg quarter,chili oil,wheat pastry flour,serrano chilies
title: Anchovy Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 4 whole serrano chilies, halved lengthwise | 1 can anchovies, drained and coarsely shredded | 2 chicken leg quarters | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Coat the inside of a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, mix together flour, sesame seeds, chopped chiles, and anchovies with a fork. Roll out the dough into a flat rectangle and cut into four 1 inch strips. Place the chicken pieces in the dish and coat with the sesame oil. Cover with the strips of dough and pinch any excess dough to seal. Place the dish in the oven and bake for at least 2 hours, or until the chicken is cooked through and tender.

title: Baja Style Mahi Mahi
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh poblano peppers | 2 lbs mahi mahi | 1 head cabbage | 1/2 cup chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons freshly grated orange rind | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla extract | 1 cup nuts ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Place peppers in a boiling water for approx 15 minutes and then remove from heat and let sit for 2 hours. Peel outer skin off cabbage, core then shred it into bite sized pieces. Drain and set aside. Rinse and clean mahi mahi, soak in cool water for 30 minutes, then drain and blot dry with paper towels. Remove stems, seeds, and ribs from chilies and boil for 10 minutes then dice into bite sized pieces with some of the “tomato” in the blender. Place in pan and cool. Remove mahi mahi from water and slice into thin strips. Rinse and drain cabbage then, to remove excess water, add cabbage, chilies, and spices. Cover with water and let water reduce for 1 hour. Remove from heat and add nuts if using. Simmer about 20 minutes or until noodles are soft, stirring occasionally. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green apple,epazote,onion powder,star anise,arugula leaf,chocolate shaving,tamarind pulp,palm sugar
title: Mim's Secret Recipe: Tamarind and Anise-Scented Arugula
ingredients: 1 lb green apple, peeled and sliced | 2 star anise, crushed | 2 inches star anise, crushed | 2 -3 lbs arugula leaves, washed and torn ( or any leaves of arugula ) | 3 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 1/2 lb unsweetened chocolate shavings | 1/3 cup palm sugar or 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup epazote, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients except for the mint and chocoate, in a pot over a low heat. Cook until mixture becomes dark, almost crystallized. Add mint and chocoate and mix well. Remove from the stove and cool. Cover and store in the refrigerator.

title: Chilli Scented Chocolate Chips With a Creamy Chocolate Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil ( or vegetable oil, or 1 tablespoon peanut oil ) | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 2 cups low-fat sour cream or 2 cups low fat sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon cocoa powder
instructions: Note, to make dip, combine sour cream, tartar, and turmeric in a bowl and blend thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate. Microwave on medium to high power, for 4 minutes or until mixture bubbles, then stir. Stir in a 1/4 tsp of cocoa if desired. When done, remove from microwave and pour into dip. Let mixture cool to room temperature. Note, to make chocolate chips, microwave until mixture is bubbly throughout, then stir in remaining cocoa mix.

title: Omelet in the Omelette Omelette
ingredients: 8 ounces beef sausages | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme, or to taste | 3 eggs | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme, or to taste
instructions: Toast the sausages in a dry frying pan over a medium heat, turning to brown all over. When browned, crumble into a bowl with the thyme, and set aside. Beat together the eggs with 2 tablespoons of water in a small bowl until well combined. When ready to make the omelet, pour in the thyme, and beat in the sausages. Heat the omelet over medium low heat, turning over the sausage to coat. When the omelet is nearly set, lift the omelet out of the pan, and keep it warm under a buttered broiler. Sprinkle the eggs over the top, and stir gently with a fork. Slide a spatula under the omelet, and overturn the omelet onto a plate. Leave to settle for about 10 minutes before releasing it onto a plate. Cut the omelet into wedges, and drizzle over the thyme.

title: Beef Roast from Leftovers
ingredients: 1 lb beef | 1 lb pork loin
instructions: Put fat on your meat. Place the roast on top of fat and tie tightly. Bake in your oven on the middle rack at 400 degrees f. It can be done in a roasting pan that has been preheated to 500 degrees f until done in 3 hours. Take out of the oven in a shallow pan and shred the meat. Return to pan and heat over low heat stirring constantly until most of juices have evaporated. You can also use turkey or chicken in place of the meat. You may use up how much fat is left in the pan, however it seems to cook more evenly.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,tuna water,celery rib,basmati rice,strawberry,farfalle pasta,pico de gallo
title: Tuna Stuffed With Farfalle and Fresh Strawberries
ingredients: 1 cup farfalle pasta ( bow-tie pasta ) | 1 cup buttermilk | 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1 small celery rib, chopped | 5 ounces canned tuna in water, drained, flaked | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 cup pico de gallo, cut into small wedges
instructions: Cook farfalle in boiling, slated water until al dente, about 3 minutes, breaking up clumps with fingers. Drain and reserve 1/2 cup pasta water. Cook basmati rice in large saucepan of boiling, slated water, 3 to 4 minutes less than package directions, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, melt remaining 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons buttermilk in small nonstick skillet over medium low heat. Add celery.

title: Focaccia Breadsticks(OAMC)
ingredients: 12 pieces italian breadcrumbs ( approximately 2 1/2x13 inch ) | 1 large purple onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large bowl, mix 1 package of italian bread crumbs with the purple onion. Roll each piece in the remaining cup of crumbs on a long, flat surface. Using your hands, shape each piece into a small ball. Poke holes in the top of the balls with a fork, and place on a baking sheet. Bake 15 - 20 minutes with the oven door slightly ajar, until the tops are lightly browned and crunchy. Let stand in the bag a few minutes before removing to cool slightly. Serve at once. Note, for a softer focaccia, bake for 50 - 60 minutes. You can also broil the focaccia. They make a wonderful sandwich on the plate.

Random Ingredients: nam pla,beetroot,raspberry jam,jalapeno chile,linguine,rotel tomato chilies
title: Nam Pla Vietnamese Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 6 fresh jalapeno chiles | 1 lb fresh beetroot | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies ( regular can also be used ) | 1/4 1/4 cup raspberry jam or 1/4 cup raspberry jam | 1/4 cup nam pla
instructions: Cook linguine as directed on package and set aside. Finely dice chilies and place in medium size microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 1 minute to soften. Stir to combine. Cut beetroot into 1 inch chunks and place in microwave safe bowl. Cook on high for 1 minute and stir. Transfer to plate and let sit for about 2 minutes. Add tomato and saute for 3 - 4 minutes more. Set aside. Slice jalapenos on an angle and drain fat. Cook on high for 2 minutes or until slightly soft. Add garlic and beetroot to tomato mixture. Serve tossed with jam and nam pla sauce.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean paste,chinese hot mustard,serrano pepper
title: Chinese Spicy Mustard Powder
ingredients: 2 cups chinese hot mustard ( spicy yellow, spicy black, spicy red, hot yellow or spicy green ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla bean paste | 2 teaspoons serrano peppers, chopped ( or other favorite peppers )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine dry mustard powder and vanilla bean paste. Stir well until smooth. Store in refrigerator.

title: Bircher Muffins (Danish)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 1/2 1/2 cup lemon or 1/2 cup olive oil, for brushing the muffin pan | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon onion seeds ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 2 1/2 - 3 cups swedes ( i use the japanese-style green ones ) | 1/2 cup dried blueberries ( to be fresh or frozen ) or 1/2 cup currants ( to be fresh or frozen )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a little warm water. Mix all the spices except the swedes or berries together in a bowl. Add the yeast mixture and mix until well distributed. Cover, a kitchen towel, an inverted bowl, a large bowl with a towel, and place in a warm, draft free area to warm while you work with it. Add the swedes or berries to the dough. Kneed until smooth. Divide dough into 4 small, lightly floured, pieces and shape each piece into a ball. Place 3 dough balls into each of 4 well buttered baking pans. Cover with warm, slightly floured cloth, and allow to rise until doubled. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bake the muffins until bubbly and lightly browned around the edges, 18 to 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and remove from the pans. Note, if using a baking stone, lightly grease the baking stone, then place all the topping ingredients in the baking aisle of your choice. Set the rack in the middle of your oven, and preheat to 300f. Remove the muffins from the pans and allow them to cool before serving.

title: Italian Coffee Tarts
ingredients: 8 tablespoons hot strong coffee, chilled | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 2 -4 teaspoons kahlua
instructions: In a small bowl, combine coffee, cream of tartar and kahlua. Drop 1 t. Of coffee mixture by tbs. Taking care to not drop too quickly or it will curdle. Use this coffee to fill pastry cases and serve.

title: Canned Italian Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups canned italian tomatoes ( whole or chunked ) | 1/2 cup vodka | 2 envelopes unflavored gelatin | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1/4 cup lard
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a pot and simmer for about 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld. You can also use a food processor to make this mixture. Note, you may use a whisk to thin the sauce. Variation, to prepare the tomato sauce to serve over pasta while still hot, add drained canned tomatoes to the sauce after the tomatoes have been strained. If you like a smoother consistency, add 1 tablespoon of cream to the tomato mixture and use half the bottle of vodka. Variation, for a smoother sauce pour the remaining bottle of vodka into a cupboard with a small hole inserted in the middle and slowly dribble in a small amount of vodka into the cupboard. After a couple of minutes, the vodka will thicken. You can add this mixture to the basic tomato sauce or substitute for the canned tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,no salt ketchup,oat,baby spinach,beef sirloin,chili oil,chipotle chile adobo,lemon
title: Spinach Beef Burger With Chipotle Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin, 4-oz. each, trimmed of all fat | 2/3 cup whole-milk chocolate chipotle chile in adobo, coarsley chopped | 1/4 cup no-salt-added ketchup | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt or 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon no-added-salt ketchup | 1 tablespoon no-salt-added chipotle chile in adobo, coarsley chopped | 1 cup loosely packed baby spinach | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated lemon rind
instructions: Place beef in a shallow dish. Sprinkle chopped chile over meat. Cover and chill for 10 minutes, and turn once or twice. Drain meat if fat runs out before grilling. Make sauce,. Stir yogurt, ketchup, chile oil, and chipotle chile in a small saucepan over medium heat until sauce comes to a boil and is heated through. Remove from heat and stir in spinach. To make burgers,. Preheat a grill or heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add beef and season with pepper. Cook until sirloin is cooked to your liking and a thermometer reads about 160 degrees f for medium rare, or about 85 degrees f for medium rare. Cut burgers diagonally across the grain and place in a burger dish. Top with sauce, drizzle with any remaining sauce, and sprinkle with lemon rind.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,kalamata olive,pea,espresso powder,cauliflower,curry powder
title: Curried Chickpeas and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons espresso powder | 19 ounces cauliflower, small florets cut into florets | 1/3 cup frozen peas | kalamata olive, halved | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley ( garnish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,fruit,milk ricotta cheese,tomato paste,plain yogurt
title: Yummy Ricotta Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons milk ricotta cheese | 1/8 teaspoon baking powder | 2 tablespoons smooth plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons tomato paste, diluted with enough water to make a smooth paste | 1/2 cup dried fruit, such as raisins, marjoram, or cranberries
instructions: Set oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine ricotta cheese with baking powder, yogurt, and tomato paste. Mix until smooth. Stir in dried fruit. Pour into a pie plate or glass dish that has been sprayed with pam. Place pie dish on a baking sheet. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, until bubbly and golden brown.

title: Feta Cheese With Garlic & Garlic Pesto
ingredients: 1 ounce feta cheese ( about 1 1/2 tbs ) | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon minced fresh garlic ( about 1 teaspoon of minced ) | 1/4 cup palm sugar ( or raw sugar and light brown sugar )
instructions: Crush feta cheese with mortar and pestle or food processor until small fine crumbs. Combine feta, 1 1/2 tbsp of the garlic and 3 tbsp of the basil and stir in enough of the basil pesto to bind with a firm paste. Add grated parmesan and remaining minced garlic and the rest of the basil to the feta mixture. Refrigerate 1 - 3 hours until flavors blend. If using a mortar and pestle, blend pesto for 1 minute or until it is well mixed.

Random Ingredients: orange,gelatin,shiitake mushroom,brandy,tomato paste,parmesan cheese,green chili pepper
title: Auberge Hot Tomatoes and Swiss
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh tomatoes and swiss sausages, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups fresh shiitake mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons brandy | 1 teaspoon unflavored gelatin | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 green chili pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Stir tomato paste into warm brandy and add gelatin and chili pepper. Bring to boiling.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,water,curd cottage cheese,fava bean,beef brisket
title: Beef and Refried Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 jar fava beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can corned beef stew meat, drained ( cut into chunks ) | 2 cans beef brisket, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup water | 16 ounces small curd cottage cheese
instructions: Combine drained fava beans and corned beef in slow cooker. Add beef brisket, water, and about half of the contents of the can of corned beef soup base. Cook on high for 10 minutes or low for 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,ricotta cheese,cheddar cheese,red wine,red currant jelly
title: Red Wine and Sun-Dried Tomato Dip
ingredients: 1 cup red currant jelly | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese ( or any other similar mild cheese, you may like ) | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup red wine
instructions: In a bowl, combine the redcurrant jelly with the sun dried tomatoes. Stir in the cheese. Place in ovenproof serving dish. Bake, uncovered, at 160°c for 15 minutes.

title: Chili Watercress & Green Chilies
ingredients: 1 bunch watercress | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Cut watercress in half and remove tough stems. Chop roughly and place in a heat proof bowl. Stir diced tomatoes with chilies and lemon juice in a seperate bowl. Pour over the watercress and stir to mix.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,cucumber,masa harina,cauliflower,popped popcorn,salt pepper,flat leaf parsley,coleslaw mix
title: Sweet Potato, Spring Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 medium sweet potato | 1 medium cauliflower | 1 bunch spring onion | 2 cups coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup flat-leaf parsley, minced | 1 -2 cup frozen peas and cauliflower | salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon masa harina ( or corn starch, if you prefer ) | chopped flat leaf parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Peel sweet potato and cut into 1 inch chunks. Place in saucepan of boiling water and cook for 20 minutes or until just tender. Cool and cut in half. While still warm, cut into 2 inch cubes. Cut cauliflower in florets. Chop spring onion tops. Peel parsley leaves and chop parsley. Add to potatoes. Sauté cabbage and green onion in oil and salt and pepper until just tender. Add vegetables, mix well and coat well. Sprinkle with masa harina or corn starch to thicken.

title: Lamb Shank-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 mushrooms | 12 lamb shanks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Remove the stems from each mushroom and hollow out using a sharp knife or spoon. Make sure that the mushroom stems are all slightly intact. Wrap the mushrooms in foil and place in the oven for about 1 hour or until tender. Remove from the oven. Place a small slice of lamb in each mushroom. Place under the grill of a grill to cook the meat. Serve.

title: Marinated Beet, Thyme & Poppy Seed Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 large beet, beets, washed & cut into pieces | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon vinegar | 1 teaspoon poppy seed, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 4 leaves arugula, washed
instructions: Using a heavy duty clean knife, cut large holes in beetroot with a sharp knife. Keep it aside. Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a bowl. Add the poppy seeds & allow to crackle. Once the mustard seeds begin to crackle, add the beet pieces & mix together nicely. Cover with a lid & leave to marinate for 2 - 3 hours. After 1 hr, mix them well & remove the beetroot pieces from the marinade as you are assembling the salad. Allow it to cool off slightly & set aside to cool completely. Heat the remaining oil & add the thyme & poppy seeds. Add the arugula leaves, toss & remove from heat as soon as you remove them from the stalks. In a serving bowl, serve the beetroot on the side. You can prepare the artfully but be careful that it is not hot.

title: Oriental Spinach II
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach, washed and cleaned | 1 can spinach, drained | 1 cup canned bamboo shoots, drained | 1 can tomato paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place everything except the spinach in a dutch oven and boil until it's tender. Add more water if necessary, the dough will thicken as it cools. Separate the dough into 2 parts and roll it into ropes on greased cookie sheets. Braid the two parts and let them rest for about 10 - 15 minutes in a cool place. Bake at 375 degrees, uncovered, for about 35 - 40 minutes. Turn every ten to fifteen minutes so they get a nice brown color.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,cumin seed,pork loin chop,chili garlic sauce,lamb
title: Spicy Lamb and Pork
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 3 lamb chops | 1 can plum tomatoes with jalapenos | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce | 1 pound lean boneless pork loin chops
instructions: Preheat cooking grate. Rub cumin in a large skillet with your hands. Place lamb over medium heat, and sear on all sides until golden brown, then set aside. Reduce heat, and add tomatoes and chili sauce. Cover and simmer about 30 minutes, or until chops are cooked. Top with pork chops, if desired, and broil until pork is well browned on top.

title: Easy Microwave Carnitas
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, or other thin cut roast, with a bit of fat on it | 1 1/2 soup cans or ( 10 1/2 ounce ) cans fat-free chicken broth
instructions: Place roast in 4 qt crock pot or dutch oven. Add water and chicken bouillon cubes or other liquid to crock pot. Cook on high for about 6 hours. Take off heat, skim fat and serve with tortillas.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce leaf,rosemary leaf,sage leaf,green chili paste,margarine,dijon mustard,gruyere,mace
title: Gruye Sandwich
ingredients: 1 large romaine lettuce leaf | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon mild green chili paste ( such as sambal oelek ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground sage leaves | fresh sage leaf | 1 teaspoon margarine ( or bacon fat ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 3/4 cup gruyere, sliced ( about 2 ounces ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Cut the lettuce leaf crosswise into 1/2 inch wide strips. Place in a single layer on a baking sheet, brush with the mustard, and sprinkle with the chili paste, sage, sage, 1/4 teaspoon each of the fresh chopped sage and the green chili paste, and about 1/2 teaspoon of the fresh chopped sage and the fresh chopped rosemary. Bake the vegetables for about 20 minutes the leaves should be tender but crisp in spots and the chili paste should not brown. Remove from the oven, sprinkle with the gruyere, and allow to cool slightly. Slice the sandwich in half lengthwise, drizzle with the mace, and serve.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,scotch bonnet pepper,heavy whipping cream,red chili powder,amaretto,crabmeat,lemon zest,hearty white bread
title: Hot Spicy Crab Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons fresh lemon zest | 24 ounces crabmeat, picked over | 2 tablespoons scotch bonnet peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 cup crushed roasted hazelnuts ( optional ) | 1/3 cup amaretto | 3 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup scotch bonnet pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup red chili powder
instructions: Puree or process all ingredients until a slurry has formed. Soup can be made up to an hour ahead and refrigerated. Refrigerate over night. Ladle into soup bowls, sprinkle with green food coloring if desired.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,beef tenderloin steak,lettuce leaf,red onion,thyme leaf,vegetarian bean,red bean,orange peel
title: Beef on Lettuce Bites
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetarian refried beans | 1 lb beef tenderloin steak, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced red onions | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves | 6 lettuce leaves | 4 lettuce leaves, washed, dried, and torn | 1/4 cup finely chopped roasted red beans | 1 tablespoon finely chopped orange peel
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together first 3 ingredients. Spread bean mixture on a grill pan or other flat grill and grill over medium high heat, turning once, until just heated through, about 3 minutes per side. Meanwhile, arrange lettuce leaves on a plate and top with lettuce. Top each salad with beef and onion mixture. Sprinkle with thyme. In a small bowl, toss roasted red beans with orange peel, a touch of orange juice and a pinch of salt and pepper to taste.

title: Golden Raisin Balls
ingredients: 1 cup fresh golden raisin | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | parsley
instructions: Boil 1/3 cup of water. Add raisins and ginger garlic paste. Cool down. Make small balls with 1/3 cup of raisins in each ball. Roll in parsley or basil. Store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,green creme de menthe,walnut oil,clove
title: Texas Fudge II
ingredients: 2 cups chopped mixed nuts ( pecans, hazelnuts ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 4 cups sifted confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup green creme de menthe
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Mix mixed nuts, ground cloves, and confectioners' sugar in a bowl until smooth. Stir creme de menthe into the mixture with a knife until smooth.

title: Filling for Pierogi
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: In a small pot over medium heat, stir together the refried beans and cream. Bring to the boil, and simmer stirring occasionally. Drain off any excess cream. Form the mixture into small balls with your fingers, and fill centers with cream if desired. Arrange in a warm shallow serving dish for dipping.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,coriander seed,baby potato,mandarin orange,chicken liver,pecan,cornmeal
title: Crispy Corn Chips With Chicken Livers and Pecans (Gourmet Microwave Recipe)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons cornmeal ( may need more ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely crushed corn chips | 1 package baby potatoes | 4 tablespoons chopped pecans ( i use pecans in a jar or a walnut-can mix ) | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds ( or more if you are nuts nut crazy, i add them in ) | 12 ounces chicken livers, trimmed with most of the fat, thinly sliced ( i use the whole liver, or 1/2 tsp. coriander and 1/2 tsp. dried ) | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained, rinsed, and coarsely chopped ( or just use one 14 oz. can of mandarin oranges, drained )
instructions: Place a 1 kilo ring on a large piece of foil or baking sheet. In a small bowl stir together the cornmeal and crushed corncajores. Dip the potato slices into the cornmeal, coating fully but evenly, and then arrange them on the ring. Scatter 1 tablespoon of the pecans in a shallow bowl and sprinkle with about 1/2 teaspoon coriander and 1 1/4 teaspoon the cornajyri powder. Arrange the sliced livers over the chips, evenly spaced.

title: Cheesy Greek Vegetable Dip
ingredients: 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon onions and herb powder | 1 cup frozen sliced cucumbers, thawed | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 can baked beans
instructions: Stir oil into hot oil in small saucepan. Remove from heat.

title: Bamba  (Okra Sandwich)
ingredients: 1 cup okra, well washed and trimmed of all pieces and thawed if frozen | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin half moons | 2 tablespoons mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | 2 slices baguette, toasted or 2 slices regular toasted sandwich bread
instructions: Place okra in 1 quart glass baking dish. Top with peppers and steak seasoning. Cover with bread slices, being sure that both sides of the bread are flattered out. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly on top.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,red pepper,banana,green olive,american cheese,cauliflower floret,guacamole,italian seasoning
title: American Cheddar Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups packed shredded italian cheese blend | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 2 large ripe bananas, sliced into 1/2-inch pieces ( about 3 cups ) | 1 jar green olives, drained | 1 jar sweet red peppers, drained and sliced into 1/2-inch pieces, about 2 cups | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower florets, blanched and lightly mashed | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | guacamole
instructions: Make the cheese dressing, in a medium saucepan, combine the cheese and cabbage. Cover and cook over moderate heat until the cheese is melted and the cabbage is tender, about 5 minutes. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl and stir in the banana, olives, peppers, cauliflower, italian seasoning, and guacamole. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: water,basil leaf,monterey jack pepper cheese,lamb shoulder,rosemary,coconut oil,spinach,vanilla ice cream
title: Lamb With Wilted Spinach and Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lamb shoulder, trimmed of excess fat | 1/4 cup shredded coconut oil | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 5 tablespoons water | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary, leaves | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach | 24 fresh basil leaves | 3/4 cup scalded scalded water | 16 vanilla ice cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place the lamb in a small baking dish with a rim and a large rim. Drizzle it with oil, then sprinkle the cheese over the meat, then season it with salt and pepper. Bake at 350f for 45 to 60 minutes or until the meat feels springy when gently pressed in the center. Meanwhile, combine the water and rosemary leaves, and set aside. When the meat is finished cooking, remove it from the oven and stir to dislodge any juices. Set it aside for 15 minutes. Stir in the spinach, basil and scalded scalded water until wilted. To serve, place the warm meat on a plate and top with the cheese sauce. Serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or a scoop of vanilla yogurt.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese (Vegetable Bolognese)
ingredients: 8 -10 ounces vegetables | spaghetti ( as desired )
instructions: In a large pot, cook spaghetti according to package directions. Meanwhile, add cooked vegetables to a large bowl in order according to package directions. Add the spaghetti to the vegetables for a sausagemeat.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,pizza dough,pork shoulder,superfine sugar,vegetable protein,red chilies
title: Mama's Savory Carnitas
ingredients: 1 pizza dough | 2 cups superfine sugar | 1 cup vegetable protein ( textured corn protein ) | 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, cubed | 5 red chilies, deveined and cut lengthwise into 3 1/2-inch squares | alfredo sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Roll out the pizza dough and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the sugar, veggie protein, pork, chilis and alfredo sauce. Arrange the dough in a single layer on the baking sheet, pressing down between each layer. Bake until golden brown, about 30 minutes. Cut into pieces.

title: Tuscan Chickpea and Bean Scones
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour, divided | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup dried red lentil, soaked to remove excess salt, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix half the flour with 2/3 cup of the beans. Stir in the lentils. Transfer to a baking sheet, sprinkle with remaining flour and remaining flour, and stir to combine, letting them sit for 5 minutes. Spread on a cookie sheet, sprinkle with salt, and drizzle with remaining 1/4 cup of the beans. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Famous Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup milk ( skim water is ok ) | 2 -3 tablespoons breadcrumbs | assorted bread, cut into 1-inch thick slices
instructions: Whisk milk and bread crumbs in a mixing bowl. Heat nonstick skillet on med high heat. Dip each slice of cheese in the milk/bread cronkure/bread crumbs coating the slices well. Sear cheese slices on both sides until nicely browned. Slip cheese into a warmed warmed dish.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,taco seasoning,baby spinach leaf,grape leaf
title: Mexican Spinach
ingredients: 1 package fresh baby spinach leaves | 1 jar mango chutney | 1 package taco seasoning | chile-stuffed grape leaves
instructions: Cook spinach leaves in boiling water for 3 minutes. Drain. Transfer spinach leaves to serving dish. Dissolve taco seasoning in hot chutney. Spoon over spinach, and sprinkle with grape leaves.

Random Ingredients: champagne,cilantro,almond,lettuce leaf,tahini,espresso,salt black pepper,angel hair pasta
title: Angel Hair Pasta and Three-Spice Coffee Sauce
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups chilled brewed espresso, cooled and refrigerated overnight | 1/3 cup finely grated tahini | 1/4 cup freshly ground strong coffee | 1 tablespoon instant espresso granules or 1 tablespoon instant instant chicken-flavored liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste | 12 large lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup chopped toasted almonds | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Pour 1 cup of brewed espresso into a coffee mug, and add the tahini, coffee, coffee granules, and salt and black pepper, and bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Serve immediately on lettuce leaves, topped with almonds and cilantro.

title: Lemon Peanut Soup  (Lebanese)
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted peanuts, toasted and chopped | 2 lbs beef broth ( home made is best ) | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Place peanuts in blender with 2 cups of the broth. Blend, then place back on stove over low heat. Add remaining broth and season with salt and pepper. Simmer over low heat for about 1 hour or until peanut skins are loosened. When you have removed the peanut skins, let them rest on the counter for 3 - 4 minutes and then break them into small pieces. This will keep them from jumping off each other and blending as you prepare the other ingredients. Serve hot, or chilled. Note, for thicker soup, you can cut smaller bits about one inch in diameter and use a smaller pan. You can use a crockpot, but the taste is better if crockpots are cooked on low for the first 3 - 4 hours or so, adding more broth at the end of cooking time. I have never had it run out of the blender, and always just keep a careful eye on the peanut soup, as you may need to use a crockpot.

title: Zippy Leeks
ingredients: 3 cups thinly-sliced leeks | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/4 cup amaretto | 4 slices rye bread, thick | lettuce | hamburger bun top buns or honey mustard | cayenne pepper | coriander powder
instructions: Slice 2/3 of the leeks into very thin slices. Wrap the leeks in a piece of plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 4 to 6 minutes until soft. Transfer to paper towel lined plate. Cover with a dish towel or foil,. Drain off the excess water. Squeeze out excess moisture, then combine leeks with honey and amaretto in a small microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,marsala wine,button mushroom,lukewarm water,french bread,navy bean,pepper sauce
title: French Beans Bourguignon
ingredients: 1 cup dried navy beans | 5 cups hot water | 1 teaspoon lemon-colored pepper sauce | 2 slices french bread | 1 1/2 ounces smoked provolone cheese or 1 1/2 ounces mujolokia stick peppered mushrooms, sliced | 12 green cardamom pods | 4 tablespoons dry marsala wine
instructions: Place navy beans in a large dutch oven or pot, add 5 cups of hot water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 40 to 50 minutes, until the beans are tender. Stir in a dash of lemon colored pepper sauce, sliced bread, and sliced provolone cheese. Heat through.

title: Yummy Pounded Green Chile Dip
ingredients: 1 can evaporated milk | 2 cans green chilies, diced | 4 ounces greek olives, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 2 ounces white corn ( frozen or canned )
instructions: Heat oven to combine all ingredients. Microwave on medium heat for 10 minute or until cheese is melted and incorporated. Serve with pita chips.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,green chile pepper,yeast,hot pepper,salt,garlic salt
title: Simple Country Style White Chili Style Ribs
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs beef short ribs | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 2 small dried hot peppers, chopped | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 large green chile pepper, chopped
instructions: The day before, arrange ribs on racks. Sprinkle with salt. Sprinkle the yeast over the ribs. Stir in hot peppers, garlic salt and green chile. Allow to ferment overnight or for at least 3 hours. Transfer meat to roasting pan. Bake at 450 degrees fahrenheit, or until just barely done. Serve with your favorite condiments.

title: Brazilian Garlic Oil
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil | 3 cloves garlic oil
instructions: In a blender, place the olive oil and garlic oil. Blend until the mixture has somewhat thickened. Place in a jar, and refrigerate to use 2 weeks.

title: German Salad
ingredients: 5 -6 cups romaine lettuce, washed, dried | 1 lb pecans or 1 lb walnut pieces, chopped | 4 medium size prawns, cooked and shelled | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 cup rice, cooked
instructions: Mix all ingredients. You can also add the nuts right away, then mix in the prawns just before serving.

title: Turnip and Parsley Soup
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups turnips, chopped | 1 cup pearl barley | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 teaspoon dried mint ( optional, or use mint powder from dried mint )
instructions: Boil the carrots and turnips in water until just cooked. Drain and plunge into iced water then salt to stop soup. In a large soup bowl combine the carrots and turnips with the pearl barley and the vanilla and pepper and the mint.

title: Pork Pot Roast
ingredients: 375 ml rose wine | 375 ml sweet chili oil | 125 g roasted cashews | 6 tablespoons jaggery | 25 g roasted peanuts | 5 large cooked pork roast
instructions: Put the pot pot, lid and two inches on the heat at medium heat for 1 hour. Take off the flame, raise it to high heat slightly to allow the smoke to escape. Add cashews, jaggery and peanuts. Allow the pot to dry out for 10 minutes or so. Turn off the heat. Let the pot cool for at least half an hour before opening it. You now have two choices, or you can put all ingredients in the pot and let the roast continue cooking for a total of 30 minutes. Enjoy. This is a very tasty and very tasty dish.

title: Pork-And-Bacon
ingredients: 1 pound pork, cut into 3/4 inch strips | 4 slices bacon bits | 1 small clove garlic, chopped | 1 fresh chile peppers, chopped | 1/4 medium white onion, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons brandy | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chile pepper | lime wedges
instructions: Place bacon in a large skillet. Cook over medium high heat until browned, turning often. Remove bacon from pan and place on paper towels to drain. Rinse bacon strips with cold water and drain. Combine bacon drippings, garlic, chili pepper, onion and brandy in the skillet. Simmer until onions are tender. Pour the contents of the skillet onto the pork and bacon. Add chile pepper to taste. Simmer 5 minutes, until pork is cooked through. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Overnight Microwave Finger-Lickies
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups bread, slices | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamoms
instructions: Cut bread in half lengthwise along long edge. With a sharp knife or scissors, remove and discard crusts. Cut crusts in half, then cut in half again. On wax paper lined tray, shape each half into a finger long and 1/4 inch deep. Repeat on other side of bread. Heat 2 cups of water to boiling in microwave. Add cardamom and green cardamom seeks. Remove from heat. Arrange finger lickies on warm jelly roll pan, cover with damp kitchen towel. Microwave 25 - 30 minutes, or until warm.

title: Asparagus With Almonds
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red wine | 12 cups fresh asparagus, trimmed | 2 lemons, halved | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Combine wine, asparagus and 2 tablespoons lemon juice in a 4 quart heavy saucepan.

title: Blueberry Chipotle Fufé
ingredients: 1 pint blueberries | 4 tablespoons chopped walnuts or 4 tablespoons peanuts, toasted | 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek leaves, crumbled | 1 small chipotle chile, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Put blueberries into crockpot. Sprinkle nuts over berries and add to crockpot. Blend the dried fenugreek leaves and the chile. Add the puree to the remaining berries. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours or on low for up to 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,bean,thai red curry paste,coffee,sauerkraut
title: Quick & Easy Hot Spicy Bean Dip
ingredients: 500 g dried beans | 400 ml strong coffee | 450 g sauerkraut ( fresh is best ) | 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley ( chopped ) | 3 -4 tablespoons thai red curry paste ( or curry powder, i used maggi brand )
instructions: Soak the beans overnight in plenty of cold water to cover. Put the beans, coffee and 1/2 cup of the water into the pan and bring to the boil over a low heat. Cover and simmer over a very low heat for at least two hours until the beans are tender, but are not mushy. Drain the beans and place into a bowl. Mash them slightly until you have a paste. Return the bean mixture back to the pan and reheat gently in a pan, stirring all the time to prevent sticking, until you have a thick creamy consistency. Add the drained beans and mash until well combined. Add the rest of the coffee and the curry paste or curry powder. Stir again, then reduce heat and simmer over a low heat, stirring occasionally until the flavours have amalgamated and the dip is heated to the desired consistency. Serve with breadsticks, vegetables or as a dip for bread sticks or toast points.

title: Baked Cod With Beer and Lemons
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1/2 cup diced leeks | 2 jalapeno peppers ( seeded and minced or more ) | 8 slices smoked ham ( thick slices cut about 3 slices ) | 8 ounces stout beer ( i like trappey jack daniels ) | 4 whole wheat braised fillets cod, halibut ( or other firm fish of your choice ) | 4 slices smoked cod, about 3/4-inch thick ( or other firm fish of your choice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a baking dish that has sides. Put a heaping tablespoon of paprika in the bottom of the dish. Cover with a layer of leeks and peppers and a layer of ham. Repeat layering until dish is full. Pour the beer over top, and sprinkle with a little more paprika. Add 1 tomato per layer, top with the braised fish. Cover tightly and bake, basting occasionally, about 1 hour. Cut into serving pieces and serve with hearty bread and beer.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,parmesan cheese,flour,walnut oil,white bean,pistachio,soy sauce,chili flake
title: White Bean & Multi-Grain White Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped mixed nuts ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1 teaspoon chili flakes ( optional ) | 1/3 cup greek yogurt ( low-fat or low fat ) | 1 teaspoon flour | 1/2 cup low-fat parmesan cheese
instructions: Place the white beans, pistachios, mixed nuts and soy sauce in a food processor, and process until they are finely chopped. Turn off the machine, and add the kombu and greek yoghurt. Add the flour gradually while you are processing, and process 2 - 3 more times as until well mixed. Put the mix in a medium sized bowl and add your cheese. Sprinkle on top of the mixture, and stir lightly. Serve immediately.

title: Ham & Cheese Noodle and Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ham, diced | 1 box penne pasta ( i prefer whole wheat ) | 16 ounces farmer cheese ( you can use ricotta in other container ) | 2 boxes rice noodles
instructions: Brown ham in large skillet. While ham is cooking cook noodles. Add pasta to ham and drain. When done add to bowl when all is cooked to your liking. Add cheese to bowl and mix well. Enjoy.

title: Beet Sesame Dredge (Beetroot Sandwich Fritters)
ingredients: 1/2 lb beet, sliced fine | 8 tablespoons masa harina | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 4 tablespoons flour | 4 tablespoons sweet pesto sauce ( i use thai kitchen brand ) | 1 pint cherry or ( 14 ounce ) pint grape tomatoes, cut in wedges
instructions: Bring boiling water or vegetable broth to boil in a 2 liter skillet for the beets. Blanch for 5 minutes then drain in a colander. In a bowl mix together the beets and harga paste, oil, sesame oil and flour until well blended. Form the beetroot mixture into 16 balls. Dip into the flour, then fry in two batches of the spicy pesto for 5 minutes, turning frequently. Serve while hot with cherry or grape tomatoes.

title: Cocktel (Filipino-Style Fish Stew)
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets ( any kind of fish ) | 250 ml minced liver | 250 ml ground buffalo beef broth | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs
instructions: Dry fish with paper towels. Wash liver in cold water, remove any excess tissue, and slice into thin strips, discarding outer layers and any meat juices. In a small heavy pot, add broth, meat, salt, garlic and herbs, bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the liver.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto Lasagna Rolls II
ingredients: 4 ounces sun-dried tomato pesto | 2 pieces lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lay a piece of dry noodles out on baking sheets. Spread about 2 to 3 tablespoons of sun dried tomato pesto onto the noodles. Divide the sun dried tomato pesto evenly into two portions. Spread one portion with sun dried tomato pesto. Roll up the lasagna lengthwise. Place on the baking sheet. Repeat with the other portions of the sun dried tomato pesto and sun dried tomato pesto. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the rolls are golden brown and the pesto sauce is bubbling.

title: Cherry-Seared Beef Tenderloin With Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 lb beef tenderloin steak, trimmed of large visible fat | 1 can mussels, drained and rinsed | 1 cup cherry or 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 cups uncooked arborio rice or 1 1/2 cups carnarola rice
instructions: Position a rack in the center of the oven.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,chicken thigh,margarine,pine nut,self raising flour,cayenne powder,coconut flake
title: Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 1 kg beef chuck ( lean, trimmed of fat ) or 1 kg beef sirloin ( lean, trimmed of fat ) | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/4 cup margarine | 1 tablespoon coconut flakes | 1 teaspoon cayenne powder | 4 chicken thighs | 1/2 cup pine nuts, roasted ( see note ) ( optional )
instructions: Note, roasted pine nuts can be roasted, in a hot oven until golden but not blackened, or roast them if they are not readily available, and they may be hard to grind. Trim the meat of any large chunks of fat and sinew and pat dry with paper towels. Sift all the flour into a large plate. Make a well in the centre, and add the margarine, coconut flakes and cayenne powder. Cut the meat into 3 to 4 pieces and sprinkle the flour all over the meat with your fingers, then add enough water so that the mixture is not runny. Wrap the meat in a piece of kitchen string or aluminium foil, tie the ends with kitchen string and make a loop in the centre. The amount of string or foil necessary depends on how much of the meat mixture you have and how large you have the meat. Refrigerate the meat for 20 minutes. Turn it over a few times to make sure it is evenly distributed. Place it on the plate and gently press down. Leave for 5 minutes. Flatten with the back of a fork. Sprinkle the nuts over the top. Heat a dry oven, or grill, on high heat. When hot, place the parcels, skin side down in the hot oven, without touching, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the meat is thoroughly cooked and the nuts are toasted. Serve the vegetables with the meat, or with plain boiled rice and a salad or fried rice. Note, you can use an sirloin steak, but it must be trimmed of any fat, cut into 1 to 2 inch thick slices. The meat is usually sliced very thinly and cooked for a meatier taste.

title: Methi's Simple Breadcrumb Mix for Elegant Eats
ingredients: 2 cups channa dal | 1 onion flakes | 1 cup panini bread
instructions: Put all ingredients in a food processor and mix until the mixture forms clumps. Keep in a covered bowl at all times. If all your food processor won't allow you to mix, put the mix in an airtight container and store in the fridge it will give you an essential moist crumb.

title: Sweet Chilli Beef Rolls
ingredients: 500 g beef roast, thinly sliced | 50 g rice flour ( for dredging ) | 4 tablespoons rice flour ( for dusting ) | 1/3 cup water ( for dipping ) | 1/2 cup mango - peeled, diced and tossed with 1 tablespoon of watercress | 1/2 bunch of fresh watercress, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c degrees. Mix beef slices with rice flour. Dredge each slice with rice flour. Place in a non stick ovenproof dish. Repeat with the watercress and mango mixture, stirring until evenly mixed. Cook for approximately 30 minutes. Serve topped with watercress and slice diagonally to serve.

title: Beef Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 2 heads lettuce greens, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: In a shallow glass bowl, combine the mustard powder and pepper. Place the lettuce in an even layer and toss to coat. Sprinkle salt over and around the greens. Serve either hot or at room temperature with fries.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,russet potato,jalapeno pepper,green bean,pork fillet,lime juice
title: Cuban Pork and Green Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 large poblano peppers or 1 large jalapeno pepper | 1 lb green beans, trimmed | 1 lb pork fillet | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 2 medium russet potatoes, cut into about 5 cubes | 1 medium onion, sliced | 1 lime, juice of
instructions: Cut the poblano or jalepeno pepper in half and remove all the seeds and inner white matter inside. Seed and cut the pepper into 1/2 inch chunks, and set aside. In a large soup pot, place the beans and meat that were cut the day before. Cover the meat with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until beans are tender and meat is almost falling off the bone. About 30 minutes. Drain the beans and place in a bowl. Place the blackened meat under running water until the meat is cool enough to handle, drain liquid from the pot. Stir the meat and the beans into the potato and onion. Put into a baking dish or roasting pan. Arrange the sliced onion on top, pressing in the slices of onion. Squeeze the juice of half a lime over the top of the dish and sprinkle the top with the salt, cover the dish and refrigerate overnight. Stir the meat mixture into the potatoes and vegetables and serve with ceviche for a light meal. Note, this can be made in advance and frozen in portions.

title: BBQ Corn Beef With Raspberries
ingredients: 1/2 kg beef brisket | 1 cup corn | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 2 tablespoons fresh horseradish | 100 g red capsicums or 100 g red bell peppers, sliced into thick fingers | 250 g black mushrooms, sliced thinly | 250 g raspberries, cut in half
instructions: Preheat the barbecue. Mix the beef and corn in a glass bowl with the horseradish and black mushrooms. Cook over medium high heat until the beef is cooked through, about 5 minutes. While the beef is cooking, make the raspberries. Stir the raspberries into the raspberries when the beef is ready. Spoon the beef on top of the bbq, and cook for another 2 to 2½ minutes, stirring occasionally. Stick the capsicums. Slice the beef into thick fingers and then use the pickled horseradish for the raspberries.
