title: Peixillas de Chucatore (Pounded Pork Loin With Olives and Yellow Peppers)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons olive, divided | 1/2 cup milk | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1 lb boneless pork loin, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 2 -12 olives, stoned and sliced | 3 medium yellow peppers, seeded halved and cut into 1-inch strips
instructions: In a small cup, stir together 1/2 tablespoon of the oil and milk. Set aside. In another small cup, whisk together 2 tablespoons of the oil and milk and set aside. Sprinkle the pork with salt and pepper and set aside. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil in a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat until it shimmers. Add the pork and sauté until lightly browned, about 7 minutes. Add the olives and yellow peperonade and transfer the mixture to a platter. Spoon the pork mixture over the platter. Serve hot.

title: Tahini Pork Roast
ingredients: 8 lbs pork shoulder ( fat trimmed and trimmed ) | 3 tablespoons tahini
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Rub the meat with tahini. Insert meat thermometer 3/4 to 1 inches up the side of the roast at the thickest part. Cook for at least 2 hours, turning every half hour. After 2 hours, reduce oven temp to 300 degrees f. Roast pork until it reaches 160 degrees f for medium rare, 145 degrees f for medium, or 170 degrees f for well done, about 1 hour. You can also do everything from this point on, but i find that this recipe makes for a great filling for sandwich filling or stuffing. My note, i use the 3t vegetable oil, and the addition of 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp of garlic powder is key to this, so i don't add any garlic, garlic powder and onion powder to the meat.

title: Cheese Fonde
ingredients: 1 pastry, double crust ready ( for a double crust dinner if you have it ) | 5 ounces grated asiago cheese | 2 vanilla beans ( split lengthwise )
instructions: Line a baking tray with foil or parchment paper. Roll out half of the pastry on a floured board. Place the cheese inside the pastry lined tray. Split each vanilla bean lengthwise and scrape out the seeds and seeds with a spoon. Add 2 teaspoons of water to the vanilla bean. Carefully press the seeds into the asiago cheese which is coated with the melted oil. Pat in any excess oil. Roll out the remaining pastry to about 1/8 thick and cut into three squares. Place the two squares on the baking tray. Place the pan under a hot grill and cook them for a few minutes until they become golden brown. Serve and let cool before eating.

title: Garlicky Lettuce - Vegetable Salad (Zwt2)
ingredients: 100 g mixed beansprouts or 100 g baby arugula leaves | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 100 g currants or 100 g raisins | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley
instructions: Place the mixed beansprouts in a colander over a bowl and leave to sink for 10 minutes so they can drain the excess water. Remove the beansprouts from the colander & rinse. Place in a bowl and cover in cold water. Bring to the boil, turn down the heat & let it simmer. You can then chill for up to 2 hours so the flavours combine. Cut the lemon into thin slices, remove the zest & finely shred the flesh. Add to the cooked garlicky greens, along with the currants. Combine & serve at room temeprature. Enjoy.

title: Sauteed Daikon Kimchee
ingredients: 1/2 cup daikon radish, finely chop & peeled | 1/4 cup passion fruit pulp ( kimchee ) | 3 slices bacon, diced | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: Stir fry daikon and pulp in a saute pan with 2 tspn of the hot cooking liquid over a medium heat for 2 minutes. Add the bacon and stir fry 2 mins longer. Remove from heat and stir through mustard. Transfer to bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,fava bean,squash,farfalle pasta,graham cracker crumb,monterey jack cheese
title: Crock Pot Greek Pasta Bake (Pasta Toss)
ingredients: 1 jar fava beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 - 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 -2 tablespoon crumbled feta-stuffed sun-dried tomatoes or 1 -2 tablespoon crumbled dried sun-dried tomato | 1 box farfalle pasta | 1 box graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Combine the fava beans, cheese, yogurt, feta, tomatoes and a little water. Pour over the pasta in a greased 3 1/2 quart crock pot. Cover and cook on low 7 - 9 hours, or on high 4 - 5 hours, or until the sauce is slightly thickened. If you're not using a crockpot, cook the pasta at the same time when you intend to serve the dish. Turn occasionally during cooking so that it doesn't get dry. Drain the pasta, reserving 1 1/2 cups of the cooking water. You may also add 1/4 cup more of cheese and a little bit more cooking water if it seems dry. Sprinkle with some chopped fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: black mushroom,cardamom seed,worcestershire sauce,button mushroom,chinese cabbage
title: Warm Chinese Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large english cabbage | 1/2 lb button mushroom | 1/2 lb black mushrooms | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce ( or braggs liquid )
instructions: Place all ingredients except cabbage in a pan. Cover and cook over low to medium heat for about 45 minutes stirring occasionally. The cabbage should be soft and almost falling apart. Add vegetables. Cover and let it simmer until all vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: green grape,cider vinegar,seltzer water,stew meat,orange peel,horseradish,ghee,worcestershire sauce
title: Bollywood Steak Stew or BBQ
ingredients: 3 lbs stew meat | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel | 1/4 cup cider vinegar ( or water ) | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 tablespoon prepared horseradish ( may substitute 1 t of worcestershire sauce ) | 1/4 cup seltzer water | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar ( or water ) | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | green seedless grape | green grapes
instructions: Mix beef, orange peel, 1/4 cup of cider vinegar, worcestershire sauce and horseradish together until well blended. Marinate in refrigerator for 6 hours or more. Drain well. Wrap in saran wrap or cling wrap and place in the refrigerator overnight. Drain and reserve liquid. Place beef and marinade in a deep skillet with water about 1/2 inch thick and bring to a boil. Cover. Turn off heat. Add reserved marinade. Allow to simmer, uncovered for 1 hour or longer. Transfer to casserole dish and sprinkle with remaining worcestershire sauce. Stir to mix well and bake uncovered at 325 degrees for about 1 1/4 hours. Stir every 20 minutes or so. Add grapes and continue to cook 10 minutes or until fork tender.

title: Grilled Cumin Crunchers Onions - Low-Carb
ingredients: 12 large yellow onions, thickly sliced and peeled | 3 tablespoons white breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon fennel ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon mixed spice, of choice ( optional )
instructions: If you are using a mortar and pestle, grind cumin into a fine powder. Spread onions on baking sheet and place in preheated 325f oven to roast until the onions are brown on both sides. Remove from oven, sprinkle onions with cumin powder and fennel, if using. Allow to dry for 20 minutes so spices and spices can mix. If desired, add a dash of salt and pepper to taste. Allow to cool. Serve slightly warm or at room temperature. Store any remaining crumbs in a zip lock bag in the pantry.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,pork fillet,almond,serrano chilies,granny smith apple,mayonnaise
title: Mexican Spiced Pork Salad-Caramelized Apples
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sliced almonds ( toasted ) | 2 tablespoons fat-free mayonnaise ( reduced fat okay ) | 2 serrano chilies, minced | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 2 lbs pork fillets, thin sliced
instructions: Preheat to 350ºf. Spread almonds on a rimmed baking sheet or broiler pan and toast until fragrant and lightly golden brown, about 6 to 8 minutes. Remove and set aside. Whisk the remaining ingredients to a smooth glaze and set aside. Place a rack in the upper third of the oven and preheat the broiler. Remove any remaining toasted almonds from the oven and set aside to cool. Brush the almond slices on the rack with glaze and place in a shallow baking dish. Coat with 1 tablespoon of melted glaze and cover with aluminum foil. Place in the oven and broil until slightly toasted, about 10 minutes. Allow to cool and then chill in the refrigerator. Brush the warm toasted almond slices with remaining glaze and top with pork. Note, the flavor is more intense if the slices are a bit charred.

title: Mellow Pasta With Watermelon and Walnuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups coarse grain mustard | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 1 can beer | 3 cups watermelon, chunks | 1 - 1 1/2 cup coarsely diced green pepper | 6 maraschino cherries, with stem | hot cooked pasta
instructions: In a small bowl, combine mustard and walnuts. Set aside. Pour beer into a small saucepan. Place over high heat, stirring constantly. When bubbles form around the edge, pour watermelon with a slotted spoon into liquid. Stir to loosen from bottom of the pan. Reduce heat to low. Add chilies, cherries, and remaining mustard and walnuts. Mix well. Simmer 10 minutes. When watermelon is done, reserve marinade. To serve, top with walnut mixture.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,yogurt,red chili pepper,lettuce leaf,jalapeno pepper,pecan,garlic paste
title: Faux Dressing for Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing mix, prepared according to package directions | 1/8 cup garlic paste | 1 -2 teaspoon finely chopped seeded fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh roasted red chili pepper | 20 -24 lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup toasted pecans, chopped
instructions: To make dressing, in bowl, combine yogurt, dressing mix, garlic, jalapeno and chile.

title: Cashew Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry roasted cashews | 1 1/2 cups whole red leaf lettuce, torn into bite size pieces | 1 sprig fresh cranberries
instructions: Blend all ingredients with your hands until well combined. Serve.

Random Ingredients: brandy,vegetable oil,chili powder,egg,sesame oil,shrimp,red pepper flake,basil pesto
title: Crispy Baked Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/3 cup chili powder | 1/3 cup sesame oil | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 3 large eggs | 2/3 cup brandy | 1/3 cup chopped fresh basil pesto ( or other good prepared dressing ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: If you don't have a candy thermometer i would put the oil in a small pan with some of the water and heat on medium. If you don't have a thermometer i would put the water in a small tea towel to soak up all the grease. If you don't have a thermometer it will give you an oilier texture of the dish. Combine chili powder and sesame oil in a shallow dish. Dip shrimp in and then into the chili oil. Place shrimp on paper towels to drain excess oil. Lightly oil a large skillet or fryer. Put shrimp into the skillet on the oil, shaking to ensure that they are well oiled. The shrimp will sink to the bottom of the pan when done. Keep shaking them over the bottom of the pan till all of the shrimp are brown. After 1/2 an hour, they will be slightly undercooked. Remove shrimp from the skillet to a bowl. Combine the eggs with the brandy in a small bowl. Add the pesto and red pepper flakes to the egg mixture, then pour into the skillet with the shrimp. Stir over moderate heat till blended. Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately.

title: Tomato Sauce With Tomatoes and Oregano
ingredients: 5 fresh plum tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon minced fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Place tomatoes and tomato paste in a medium saucepan and heat over medium heat. Cook, stirring and crushing tomatoes with a fork until the tomatoes release all bits of tomato and plum juice, about 10 minutes. Stir in the oregano and cook 5 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: broth,crawfish tail,black cardamom pod,fenugreek leaf,xanthan gum,italian pastina,feta cheese,coffee bean
title: Taurai's Broth and Feta
ingredients: 5 cups low-sodium broth | 5 black cardamom pods, cracked | 1 tablespoon coffee beans, soaked for 30 mins | 1 tablespoon fenugreek leaves, crushed | 14 1/2 ounces broccoli and shelled pasta-shredded, 1-in x 2-in x 2-in x 1.7-in strips | 3 tablespoons xanthan gum | 8 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 1 lb crawfish tails or 1 lb shrimp, peeled, deveined and cut in half lengthwise
instructions: Mix broth, cardamom, coffee beans and fenugreek in medium saucepan over med high heat. Bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: potato chip,irish cream,tomato green chilies,beer,poblano pepper,balsamic vinegar,cardamom seed
title: Baked Mexican Potato Chips
ingredients: 1 cup potato chips | 1/3 cup beer | 1 medium poblano pepper, sliced | 2 medium tomatoes, chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup irish cream | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange potato chips in a single layer on an aluminum foil baking pan. In the top of a double boiler over boiling water, heat beer, poblano pepper, tomatoes, and chilies until the mixture is hot and the tomatoes are soft, about 10 minutes. In a small bowl, stir together the beer mixture, cream, vinegar, and cardamom seeds. Pour over potato chips and bake in preheated oven until the chips are dry, stirring occasionally, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: double acting baking powder,apricot,cream celery soup,angel hair pasta,yeast,white wine,corn tortilla
title: Diane's Easy Mexican Tortilla and Apricot Pizza (No Cheese)
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 1 can cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup dry white wine or 1/2 cup water | 1 teaspoon double-acting baking powder | 3/4 cup finely chopped fresh apricot or 3/4 cup dried apricot, chopped | 12 8-inch corn tortillas or 12 -inch all-pourpose corn tortillas | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked angel hair pasta
instructions: To make the crust, dissolve yeast in water and set aside in a mixing bowl. Combine the soup, wine and baking powder in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Add to yeast mixture and simmer on medium high heat for 5 minutes to develop yeast flavor. Slowly add in sour cream to yeast mixture. Let rise until dough has doubled in volume about 1/2 hour. Lightly grease the large baking pan with cooking spray. Stir a few of the tortillas into dough and add to the baking sheet. Pour mixture onto the baking sheet and shape into a circle. Place on lowest rack of oven. Heat oven to 300f degrees and bake for 20 minutes or until crust is crisp and bubbly. Spread 1/2 cup of the soup mixture over the dough. Top with the remaining tortillas and spread evenly. Place another pan on top of this. Cover and continue baking 10 minutes, or until crispy and bubbly. Top with the fresh apricots. Bake for another 5 minutes, just until crisp and bubbly. Remove from oven, cut into 4 wedges and serve.

title: Pinto Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained & rinsed | 2 cups cashews, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Combine the first five ingredients.

title: Thai Style Kale
ingredients: 2 bunches kale | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon margarine | 6 teaspoons fish sauce | 3/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional- i like the spicy stuff for this ) | 2 teaspoons salt ( can vary )
instructions: Wash and remove hard stems. Cut kale leaves crosswise into 1/4 pieces. Place in a bowl and add water until about 2 inches above leaves. Place over medium heat until water starts to boil. Lower heat and add leaves. Cook, covered for 10 minutes. Drain water. Add remaining ingredients except salt. Cover and simmer 10 more minutes. Serve over cooked rice with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,savory,pignoli nut,salmon fillet,lamb chop,caper,green pea
title: Baked Salmon and Goat's Cheese Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs salmon fillets, 6 -7oz each cut into 8 equal sections ( salmon steaks ) | 1 cup fresh green peas | 3/4 cup cooked cannellini beans or 3/4 cup kidney bean, rinsed and drained | 3 tablespoons capers | 1/2 cup pignoli nut, lightly toasted, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 cup herbed goat's cheese ( or ricotta salata )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place salmon on baking sheet. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes. Combine peas, beans and capers in a medium bowl. Place salmon, peas mixture and cheese in serving bowl. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: corn,beef tenderloin steak,spinach leaf,chicken thigh,dark brown sugar,soba noodle
title: Beef Tenderloin With Veggies and Soba
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steak | 1 can chicken thigh, in italian strips with spice packet | 1 can corn ( or peas ) | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 20 fresh spinach leaves | 6 ounces soba noodles, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Cut steak into 1 inch cubes. Toss with remaining ingredients but noodles. Serve with noodles.

title: Cold Noodles With Peanut Butter, Egg Noodle andwatercress
ingredients: 12 ounces egg noodles, uncooked | 4 -5 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 4 -5 tablespoons watercress leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl thoroughly combine all ingredients. In a covered roasting pan place the noodles around the sides of the pan and shake the pan so mixture coats the noodles. Bake until cooked. If desired, you can spread some butter on the noodles while the top is browning.

title: Homemade Gravy and Chips
ingredients: 200 g sweet milk chocolate chips | 300 g hot gravy | 2 tablespoons black soy sauce
instructions: First melt the milk chocolate chip in a microwave for 3 - 5 minutes, or until completely melted. Add the hot gravy powder to the melted milk chocolate, stir to combine and heat through. If the gravy is too thick, stir in a little extra plain water. Line a baking tray by pouring the chocolate mixture into it.

title: Easy Baked Fettuccine with Ground Meat
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 10 ounces fettuccine pasta, uncooked
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Brown ground meat, drain fat. Add soup, garlic and fettuccine sauce to meat. Cover and simmer 25 to 30 minutes or until pasta is tender and sauce is warm.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,olive oil,tortilla,paprika,chipotle chile,canola oil,balsamic vinegar
title: Balsamic Chimichangas
ingredients: 2 lbs tortillas, warmed | 4 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 1 chipotle chile, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Heat canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add chile, sprinkle with paprika, and cook, stirring often, until chile is fragrant, about 2 minutes. Transfer chile mixture to a bowl and set aside. Spread a thin layer of cheese on the tortillas, roll tightly, secure with toothpicks, and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoons of the chipotle. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and remaining ingredients. Heat 1 tbs. Oil in a 10 second skillet over medium high heat. Add chimichangas and cook until crisp and golden, about 2 minutes on each side. Remove the toothpicks and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,shortening,corn tortilla chip,pepper sauce,salad oil
title: Johnny Jalapeno's Nachos
ingredients: 5 tablespoons salad oil | 2 tablespoons salt, or to taste | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 36 corn tortilla chips, crushed | 2 spanish onions, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons shortening, or as needed
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet placed over medium high heat.

title: Homemade Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 bunch leaf lettuce, washed | 1 cup beef bouillon
instructions: Slice the end off the lettuce tops and remove any hard and damaged part. Rinse with cool water. Place a bowl of water on top of the bowl to soak for 5 hours, then place the bowl with the water in the sink. Remove the outer leaves of the lettuce and discard. Chop into small bite sized pieces. Place in a blender with the bouillon. Blend on high for 2 or 3 minutes until it is completely smooth. Pour back into bowl and repeat on high for another 2 or 3 minutes.

title: Moroccan Spaghetti
ingredients: 5 tablespoons coarse grain harissa | 1 lb spaghetti | 2 lbs parsnips | 3 tablespoons coarse grain harissa | 1/2 teaspoon harissa or 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, according to package directions.

title: The Easiest French Bread!
ingredients: 2 lbs round steaks | 2 cups buttermilk | 1 cup dark corn syrup | 3 cups yeast cakes | 1 tablespoon pickling spice
instructions: Slice the steak very thin. Mix 2 c buttermilk, corn syrup, and yeast in large saucepan. Add beef. Set over medium heat until water barely bubbles and starts to form a frothy foam. Cover and set aside to rise for 40 minutes. Add 3 tsp of pickling spice. In a casserole dish add to the risen loaf mixture to rise until doubled. Bake at 350°f for about 45 minutes or until done.

title: Fruit and Chive Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package mozzarella cheese, small cubes | 1 container sultana, halved | 2 tablespoons mustard | 1 tablespoon chives and onion cream cheese
instructions: Put cheese in blender. Add all other ingredients and blend until smooth. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,sun tomato oil,pasta sauce,coriander,salmon fillet,espresso,chicken drumstick,icing sugar
title: Grilled Irish Salmon
ingredients: 4 skinless salmon fillets ( about 1in diameter ) | 2 chicken drumsticks | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 50 ml sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 50 ml espresso | 140 ml pasta sauce | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Preheat a grill. Brush the salmon, inside and out, with the garlic powder and grill, basting from time to time, until cooked through and browned. Set aside. Cook the chicken on the grill with the tomotoes and espresso about 5 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Remove the chicken from the grill and cut into three pieces. Reduce the grill heat to medium. Combine the pasta sauce, icing sugar and coriander in a small bowl. Place the salmon on a warm serving dish and spoon over the sauce. Serve with your favourite salad.

title: Pepperoni Wrapped in a Pepperoncini
ingredients: 6 pepperoni, sliced into thin rounds | 3 lebanese cucumbers, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Brush 2 cookie sheets with oil and arrange the pepperoni slices evenly over the top leaving a 1/2 gap at one end and about 6 to 8 in the other around the edges. Using a sharp knife, cut the cucumber into wedges lengthwise, then cut the slices crosswise into 12 slices. Arrange the cucumber wedges on top of the pepperoni slices, then place in the oven for 5 minutes. Remove from the oven, remove pepperoni slices from the oven and cut each slice into 4 pieces, placing the pepperoni wedges cut side down and along their length.

title: Sweet Sour Bread and Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 1/2 loaves toasted rye bread | 1 cup masa harina | 1/4 cup raisins | 3 cups cold squeezed lime juice | 3 tablespoons shaoxing wine | 1 can spaghetti
instructions: Cut bread into 1/2 inch cubes. Place on a baking sheet and toast in a 350 degree oven for about 10 minutes. Mix together 1/3 cup masa harina, 1 cup cold squeezed lime juice, 1 1/2 cups cold squeezed lime juice and 1 tablespoon shaoxing wine. Place bread cubes in the mixture and add 1/3 cup shaoxing wine. Turn into a 2 quart casserole. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes until done, stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Homemade Herb Lemon Thyme Oil
ingredients: 100 -200 ml extra virgin olive oil | lemon thyme, finely chopped
instructions: Add all ingredients to a screw top jar and shake well to combine. Leave overnight if using an ordinary bottle, wash well before use, and keep airtight. Use in recipes calling for a good lemon thyme oil. Note, this recipe has several ingredients that i make in advance and store in the refrigerator. One day i use it, rinse well, and then add to a bottle with a tight fitting lid. This makes about 1 1/4 pints of flavourful oil. Proceed to use the unused oil sparingly in the recipes.

Random Ingredients: dark molasses,vegetable oil cooking spray,tomato juice,asafoetida powder,mirin,chicken bouillon cube,bay leaf
title: Chicken Kamatis
ingredients: 1 vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 1 tablespoon dark molasses | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon mirin | 3 dashes asafoetida powder | 5 bay leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder, adjust to taste
instructions: Place the tomatoes in a blender or food processor, and pour in enough tomato juice liquid to equal 1/4 cup. Add all remaining ingredients to blender and blend until the mixture is smooth. Pour mixture over chicken in a ziplock bag. Refrigerate for up to one week.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,beef stock broth,tahini,coconut milk,arborio rice
title: Bailey's Irish Cream Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups homemade beef stock or 2 cups canned beef broth | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1 cup irish cream or 1 cup baileys irish cream | 1 1/2 cups instant arborio rice
instructions: In a large pot, simmer stock, tahini, coconut milk and irish cream. When cream begins to thicken, add rice and continue cooking until warmed through.

title: Lemon Chilli Fry
ingredients: 1/2 cup green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup flour
instructions: Blend all the ingredients in a blender or food processor and refrigerate. Cook at once or place in ziploc bag and allow to set. Cook with the lid on for 30 mins on high. Remove lid and continue to cook for further 10 - 15 mins on high heat.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,gruyere cheese,cream celery soup,mustard powder,cream mushroom soup
title: Cheese Dump (Hot)
ingredients: 250 g gruyere cheese ( swiss is good ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 250 g cream of celery soup | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 -2 cup tomato sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in a small crock pot. Cook on low 5 hours. Serve on crusty bread, or warm bread, and top with a drizzle of olive oil..

Random Ingredients: onion,beef brisket,basil leaf,pistachio nut,golden mushroom soup,snow pea,chile powder,pesto sauce
title: Crock Pot   Beef  Loose     Casserole
ingredients: 6 -8 lbs fresh beef brisket | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 2 tablespoons sweet basil leaves | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1 jar roasted peppers and chile powder, drained | 1 package fresh snow pea | pesto sauce ( purchased ) | pistachio nuts, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Trim the brisket of any visible fat, and place in the bottom of the slow cooker. Slice onions in half, thinly slice and place into the slow cooker. Drain any excess juices from the meat, leaving just enough to moisten the meat. Place all ingredients in the slow cooker except for the pesto. Stir to mix thoroughly, then pour the pesto over the pork. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 8 hours or on high for 4 - 5 hours, stirring and removing the meat several times.

title: Kalamat Harees -  Spicy Saffron Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon powdered saffron, soaked in | vinegar, diluted to 1/3 cup water | 1/3 cup shredded kamalotiri, with a pinch of the zest
instructions: Heat 1/3 cup water in a nonstick frying pan. Add the saffron and keep stirring until aromatic. Remove from heat. Stir in 1/3 cup water and mix together until well incorporated and thick. Stir in the kamalotiri and serve at once.

title: Mom’s Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: fava beans or beans with garlic ( arroz a la mexicana ) | 1 cup chicken breast meat | 1/2 cup fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon guacamole | marinade
instructions: Prepare your marinade as per package instructions. Cut chicken up into bite sized pieces, sprinkle with guacamole. Grill or bake chicken until cooked. If the chicken is too long, add more chicken. Dont overcook the guacamole, it is better to put the chicken in the pan while it is still warm. When chicken is done, chop or shred and mix with the beans and spinach, and serve with a side of salsa.

title: Avocado Relish
ingredients: 3 avocados, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup smooth greek yogurt | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Combine all ingredients well. Serve at once or store in covered container in fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Strawberry-Strawberry Jam
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh strawberries | 1 bag fresh strawberries ( optional ) | 1 bag raisins ( optional )
instructions: Drain strawberries.

title: Creamy Pear and Pears With Pears for Two
ingredients: 4 plum pears, cored, peeled, quartered, and quartered ( i like this very large variety, but any pear will do ) | 1 1/4 cups half-and-half | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | paprika
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200ºc. Toss pears with one tbsp of oil and paprika in an oven proof dish,. Cook, stirring, over moderate heat about 10 minutes but not cooking them. Add half and half, stir, and cook another 8 minutes until the mixture is hot and sticky. Pour over pears and bake, stirring, about 5 minutes until pears are tender, but still holding their shape. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,tomato juice,cardamom seed,cream celery soup,jasmine rice,baby spinach leaf
title: Seed-Free Spinach and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach leaves | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 1/4 cups tomato juice | 1 box jasmine rice | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Rinse spinach leaves in a sieve. Remove thick center rib from spinach to prevent burning. Spray bottom of a greased 2 1/2 cup casserole with oil or butter with cooking spray. Combine condensed soup and tomato juice and stir gently. Add rice, sesame seed and cardamon and mix gently. Cover with a lid and bake at 350°f for about 20 minutes. Stir once or twice then place on a baking sheet to cool.

title: Pepper Shrimp Tarts for Two
ingredients: 1 can shrimp or 1 1/2 lbs raw shrimp, peeled | 2 tablespoons white pepper | 1 box pie shell
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Drain shrimp into medium mixing bowl. Combine shrimp with pepper. Line bottom of two pastry bags with pastry. Fill a larger bowl with shrimp mixture. Fill reserved bowl with shrimp/pepper mixture. Fold pastry in half, and press halves into mixture. Cut steamers in to seal. Bake at 400 for 25 minutes or until puffed and brown. Serve while warm.

title: Shirataki
ingredients: 0.5 package ramen noodles, without flavor packets | 0.75 can sliced peaches, undrained | 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves | 2 scallions, sliced, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ramen noodles, then return the water to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Shred the cooked noodles with a fork, divide among 4 plates, and drizzle with the antipasto sauce.

Random Ingredients: leek,cream celery soup,banana,bulk italian sausage,red pepper,tart apple,leg lamb
title: Hot, Sweet & Savory Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 6 -8 lamb, loin chops | 6 -12 boneless legs of lamb | 2 cans condensed cream of celery soup | 1 teaspoon ground red pepper | 2 bananas | 2 leeks, washed and sliced | 2 tart apples, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Bake loins in oven till golden brown & cooked through, drain. Set the lamb chops on a cutting board when they are cool, cut to desired size. Scoop & discard all bones from lamb. Coarsely chop lamb. Set aside 1 cup of the juice & set aside for gravy. Place lamb in a large baking dish. Layer the lamb, roasted lamb, cream of celery soup, roasted livers, italian sausage or hot italian sausage flavored seasoning. Layer apples & leeks over the top. Dot with reserved juice. Cover & bake at 325 for 1 hr.

Random Ingredients: scallion,whipping cream,beef brisket,kosher salt,hard egg,raspberry jam,yeast,arrowroot
title: Fricassee Con Burritto (Irish Corned Beef Roulades)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, bone-in and cut into 6 portions | 4 -8 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 teaspoons yeast ( fleischmann's, or regular table cream powder ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 -3 tablespoons arrowroot ( arrowroot will also work ) | 1 cup whipping cream | 2 whole hard-boiled eggs | 3 -5 scallions, chopped | 1/2 cup seedless raspberry jam
instructions: Soak the brisket in water along with 1 tablespoon of water and a pinch of salt. Soak at room temperature at least an hour, preferably overnight. Drain the meat very well, being sure to remove the excess moisture. In a small bowl, add 1 teaspoon of powdered yeast, a pinch of salt, and your cream. Whisk very well so as not to lumps. If you wish to preserve the flavor, chill the mixture to the least room temperature for 10 minutes or longer. Drain the meat very well, if it is dry. Place your oven rack in the lowest position and heat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Melt the butter in a baking dish and place the meat on the rack. When the oven has pre heated to 375 degrees fahrenheit, decrease the temperature to 150 degrees fahrenheit. You want to leave the oven relatively low, but not too much because your oven may get hot after a couple hours. Turn the brisket over and, using a pastry brush or a brush, apply a very light layer of the butter on each piece. Sprinkle with a light dusting of flour, about 1/2 cup at a time, allowing the flour to adhere. Turn the meat every 10 minutes or so until it has crisped up and crisped up and is golden brown. Put the meat in a large, deep roasting pan, fat side down. If the top is too dry to stick to your pan, add a splash of the liquid from the pan, 1 tablespoon at a time, and waiting for the butter to absorb the liquid before adding all the liquid. Cook the brisket approximately 1 hour, or until it is tender and the internal temperature of the meat has been reached. Take the meat out of the oven, tent with foil, and place in a warm place to rest for approximately 15 minutes. With a slotted spoon, carve off and discard any excess fat, about 1 cup. When the brisket is cool, cut into slices and serve with some of the sauce. A few spoonfuls of jam for dipping will add some depth, as does the rest of the filling. Sprinkle with scallions. Serve alongside a mound of mashed potatoes or mashed potatoes and garnish with the whole egg and a few raspberry dolks.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,spanish onion,bamboo skewer,salmon,marinara sauce,ghee,cheddar cheese,spice essence
title: Aussie Meat Kebabs
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, chopped finely | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | 1/2 tablespoon gelatin, dissolved in | 2 teaspoons angostura low-fat coffee granules or 2 teaspoons lukewarm water | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon ghee ( for cooking ) or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( for cooking ) | 500 g firm fresh salmon | 1/3 cup grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine onions, 1/2 cup marinara sauce and gelatin mixture in bowl. Stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Cook salmon in a large non stick frying pan for 6 - 7 minutes each side, or until just cooked through. Combine remaining marinara sauce, worcestershire sauce and ghee in a small pan. Bring to boil. Place salmon on plates and pour sauce over.

title: Lazy Day Breakfast Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 slice thick slab bacon | 1 slice pepperoni sausage | 2 rolls, split ( optional )
instructions: Wrap bacon around each piece of roll.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,canola oil,beef stock,cardamom pod,white balsamic vinegar,celery salt,mint leaf
title: Chili Glaze for Chicken Skewers or Lamb Satay
ingredients: 2 teaspoons celery salt | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom pods | 3 small white balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 3 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried mint leaves | 2 cups beef stock | 4 -5 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a jar with a screw top lid. Cover and shake until combined. Combine all remaining glaze ingredients and pour over chicken skewers. Let sit for 2 to 3 hours. Preheat grill or broiler. Thread chicken, using skewers if desired, on skewers. Place skewers on grill. Cook about 8 to 10 minutes per side, or until lightly browned and cooked to desired doneness.

title: Taudis Baked Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup sliced almonds | 1 teaspoon almond extract ( about 2 teaspoons ) | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Position baking rack in center of oven. Position oven rack in upper third of oven. Preheat oven to 325°. In 1 quart saucepan, heat almonds, extract and thyme until just barely toasted. Pour almond mixture onto rack and bake until dry and puffed, 25 to 35 minutes, switching position of rack so almonds bake evenly. Let cool for 10 minutes and carefully loosen. Insert knife blade through center of almond and release almonds. Cool completely, about 10 minutes. Transfer to platter and serve at room temperature.

title: Mediterranean Veggie Muffins
ingredients: 8 patty shells, split in half lengthways | 2 tablespoons olive | 200 g mixed vegetables | 150 g split pepitas | 1 cup shredded sugared watermelon ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celcius. Open the patty shells and remove the top crusts. Place a split patty in the base of a microwave safe bowl. Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and top with half of mixed vegetables, cover & cook on high for 6 minutes. Remove the vegared patty & leave on a plate covered with towel to get a little softer. Set aside. Place 1 cup of sliced watermelon & with the remaining juice, watermelon & almond extract in a pot and boil for 10 minutes. Take off the heat and pour into the patty shells & top each one with a patty piece & spoon over the salad dressing.

title: Dal
ingredients: 12 small plum tomatoes | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 green cardamoms | 1 tablespoon golden raisins or 1 tablespoon dried currants | 1/4 teaspoon ground black raisins or 1/4 teaspoon dried currants
instructions: Core tomatoes and place in a bowl. Sprinkle over with a little of the soda. Place remaining soda over tomatoes. Stir lightly. Sprinkle with cardamom, cover and leave the mixture for 15 minutes. Transfer to a bowl with a spout or lid. Leave to set up for a few hours. Flip and remove cover. Store in a cool, dark place for up to three weeks. This dal is delicious served with plain rice and mint chutney as an accompaniment.

title: Puerto Rican Guacamole
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 orange, juiced and rind finely grated
instructions: Stir the diced tomatoes and orange juice together in a medium bowl. Stir in the grated orange rind. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled or serve as a side, or serve as a condiment to tacos and other dishes as vegetarian.

Random Ingredients: egg white,spicy bean curd,cumin powder,green chili,custard,cucumber,confectioner ' sugar,adobo seasoning
title: Spicy Bean Curds
ingredients: 1 medium cucumber ( about 12oz ) | 1 can spicy baked beans curd | 1 cup sour cream | 3 tablespoons prepared adobo seasoning ( from 2 small chipotle chiles ) | 1/8 cup prepared sweet pickled green chili ( or to taste ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 13 1/2 ounces prepared custard | 1 large egg white ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons confectioners'sugar ( to sprinkle on top )
instructions: Peel and cut the cucumber lengthwise into thin slices. Spray a colander with veggie spray and line it with the paper towels. Turn the colander over, place the cucumber slices in the colander, and remove just enough excess moisture to drain the colander, allowing the moisture to drain off. Dice the cucumber into strips about 1/8 x1 1/8, removing any pieces that are more than a quarter inch thick. Set aside. Combine the spicy baked beans and sour cream in a container with a lid. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. To make the custard, combine all the seasoning ingredients in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade, or in a small bowl by hand. Process or blend until the mixture is smooth but thick, about 1 - 2 pulses. Combine the custard and egg white. Add the custard mixture to the creamed bean mixture and stir just until combined. Transfer the cooked bean curd to a 1 gallon zip top plastic bag and place in the freezer to chill for at least 1 hour or several hours. Stir the custard into the chilled bean curd. Taste for seasoning and adjust if necessary. Serve with more sour cream and garnish with toasted pimento pepper chips.

Random Ingredients: oyster,garbanzo bean,egg beater substitute,pear,cranberry,sugar,red chili pepper
title: Hot Banana and Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, rinsed, drained | 1 can canned pears, rinsed, drained | 1 cup dried cranberries | 3 firm ripe fresh bananas, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups fat free egg substitute | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 small red chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Place bean slices, pears, and cranberries in a large salad bowl or other small serving bowl. Cover bean mixture with banana slices. Using an electric mixer, beat egg substitute and sugar in a small bowl until blended. Stir in the chili pepper. Pour egg mixture over bean mixture.

title: Bailey's Irish Cream Spaghetti
ingredients: spaghetti ( cooked and cooled ) | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/4 fluid ounce baileys irish cream | 3 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. You should have thick, creamy spaghetti when cooked, but thinner, creamy spaghetti when cooled.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,cooking spray,coriander powder,egg white,tarragon,madras curry powder,egg,tomato soup
title: Curried Eggs With Beans and Tarragon
ingredients: cooking spray | 3 medium tomatoes, washed, peeled and chopped | 1 can condensed tomato soup | chopped fresh tarragon | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 3/4 cup pinto beans, rinsed and drained ( soaked beans ) | 2 egg whites, lightly beaten
instructions: Preheat a nonstick skillet to 375°. Coat a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine tomatoes, tomato soup, tarragon, curry, coriander and beans. Beat the egg whites in a thin stream, then stir in about ¾ cup of the bean mixture. Spoon half the eggplant mixture into the prepared baking dish. Arrange half the eggplant mixture over the bean mixture. Repeat with remaining eggplant mixture and bean mixture. Sprinkle with remaining ¾ cup bean mixture. Cover, and bake 20 minutes. Uncover, and bake 10 to 15 minutes, or until hot. Serve and enjoy.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 12 ounces vermicelli | olive oil
instructions: Put some olive oil in a large frying pan. Put in the vermicelli. You might need a little more. Start to fry them over medium heat, turning several times. They're done when they are soft. Be sure to watch them. They don't burn. When they're dark, remove the frypan from heat and let sit for 5 minutes. Then serve them in a sauce for appetizers, for a meal, for a cold snack or eat on its own as pasta with anything.

title: Chicken Wings With Blueberry-Mustard Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings, washed in cold water | 1 1/4 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 1/3 teaspoons chives, chopped | 1 teaspoon grainy mustard | 3/4 cup low-fat mayonnaise or 3/4 cup salad dressing | 15 -20 fresh blueberries
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f place the whole chicken wings in a 9 x 13 in baking dish. In a bowl mix the mustard, chives and dry mustard. In small bowl mix the mayonnaise with the 2 tsp soy sauce. In a small bowl toss the chicken wings with the dijon mustard and blue berries. Pour the remaining 3/4 cup low fat mayonnaise over the chicken wings and berries. Cover tightly with foil. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,sea scallop,cannellini bean,channa dal,noodle,kalamata olive,tomato green chilies
title: Spicy Seafood Noodle
ingredients: 1 tablespoon channa dal | 1 1/2 cups small dried anchovy packed in oil | 1 cup kalamata olives | 2 cans cannellini beans ( with liquid ) | 1 lb sea scallops | 1 lb small chinese noodles ( small-halibut-dill style ) or 1 lb thin spaghetti | salt, to taste
instructions: Rinse the dal and anchovies, removing any crumbly filaments. Cut the anchovies into halves if the anchovies are larger, and soak them in hot water for 2 minutes. Add the olives and simmer just until they turn tender. Drain the soaked dal and anchovies and set aside to cool. Cook the pasta per the package instructions. When the pasta is cooked, drain well and set aside. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and add the drained anchovies and channa dal. Saute for 1 - 2 minutes, or until the anchovies are heated through but not browned. Add the cannellini beans and liquid and bring to a boil. Add the scallops and simmer until barely cooked through, about 5 minutes. Add the cooked pasta and heat through.

title: Fresh Vegetable Ketchup
ingredients: 2/3 cup buttermilk, plain ( or water ) | 1 serrano chilies, seeded | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 - 3/4 cup plum tomato, chopped ( from a can ) | freshly ground oregano ( from the can ) | 1 small fresh ripe tomatoes, chopped | vegetables such as peppers, turnips and onions, sliced or steak pieces of choice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large non aluminum saucepan and simmer, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are very tender and sauce is thickened, about 20 - 25 minutes. Remove from heat and serve, or keep warm over hot coals or in a saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,cremini mushroom,picante sauce,chipotle powder,cooking spray,cranberry apple chutney,farfalle pasta,american cheese
title: Farfalle With Apple Cheese and Mushrooms
ingredients: cooking spray | 12 ounces uncooked farfalle pasta, uncooked | 1/2 cup dried cranberry apple chutney | 1 cup sliced cremini mushroom | 3/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder ( optional ) | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 4 ounces shredded american cheese or 4 ounces other processed cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare a 9 inch glass pie plate. Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Pepper Risotto
ingredients: 3 roma ( plum ) tomatoes | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice
instructions: Place the chopped tomatoes into a skillet with the hot pepper sauce. Simmer over medium heat until tender.

title: Gewurztraminer (Double Chocolate)
ingredients: 1 package german sweet chocolate | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut chocolate into 4 squares. Place squares in heat of a double boiler or in your microwave safe bowl. Sprinkle with cocoa and tabasco sauce. Let melt and stir until completely mixed. Cool and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: lime,agave nectar,kidney bean,greek olive,liquid egg substitute,stew meat
title: Puerto Rican Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, cubes for stir fry | 1 can kidney beans | 1/4 cup greek olive | 1 lime | 1 cup liquid egg substitute ( or 2 eggs ) | 2 tablespoons agave nectar
instructions: Brown stew meat in a large pot, add rest. In the meantime, slice olives, slice lime and pour into pot. Stir in nectar and let it stew in the pot for the liquid to meld. Serve over white or brown rice.

title: Blueberry Meatballs
ingredients: 10 frozen meatballs, thawed | 1 cup fresh blueberries ( no need to thaw )
instructions: Place meatballs into a 9 x 13 baking pan that has been coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle frozen blueberries generously over meatballs. Spread blueberries generously over the blueberries, pressing the berries into the cuts. Bake at 450 degrees f for 25 - 30 minutes, until no longer pink.

title: Tarragon Tzatziki
ingredients: 250 g greek yogurt or 250 g strained plain greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon ( optional )
instructions: Put the tarragon in a bowl and pour a little water at a time over. Take the bowl off the heat and leave for a few minutes until the tarragon is soft, and the water has drained off. Take it out and press down with your hands. Put it in the fridge. Mix the ingredients in a medium pan, stirring all the time. Put the mixture in a bowl and leave for at least 1 hour. Cut into wedges and serve with pita bread.

title: Indian Sesame Seed Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, chopped | 3 -4 tablespoons mango chutney ( mango nectar preferred ) | 1 teaspoon black sesame seed | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix. Let sit for a few hours while the cabbage is resting for best results. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,coriander seed,grain white rice,jumbo shrimp,balsamic vinaigrette,bosc pear,cornstarch
title: Pear and Corn Crusted Rice With Parsley Shrimps
ingredients: 1 peeled jumbo shrimp, thawed | 1 bosc pear, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds, lightly crushed | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinaigrette | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup uncooked long-grain white rice | 2 tablespoons corn flakes, coarsely crushed
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a large nonstick skillet, combine the shrimp with water to cover. Bring to a boil. When the shrimp are just pink, remove them from the pan. Drain shrimp. Cut into 1 inch chunks in the pan. Return shrimp to pan. Add pear and coriander seeds.

title: Italian Baked Onions
ingredients: 10 lbs onions, medium size, large, purple and brown | 1 cup canola oil | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Peel onions if desired, then cut into slanted slivers. Place in a glass bowl and add the canola oil and yeast. Mix all together and cover with plastic wrap. Place in a warm place to rise for about 50 hours or until very bubbly. Heat oven to 300°f, remove wrap, and spray with pam. Add onions and bake for about 1 1/2 hours, stirring several times and flipping over the onions periodically until dark golden brown.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,cream cheese spread,baby corn,heavy cream,greek oregano,butter
title: Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 12 baby corn, cut in half | 1/4 cup greek oregano | 1/3 cup melted butter | 8 ounces cream cheese spread or 8 ounces cream cheese | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 3 teaspoons tamarind pulp
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high, about 10 minutes. Arrange cut side down on grill. Brush corn with melted butter, then sprinkle with dried oregano, evenly. Whip cream cheese, add tamarind pulp and whipped cream and top with whole baby corn. Grill corn 15 minutes, or until corn is tender and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: clove,lime wedge,ra el hanout spice mix,cumin,green onion,vanilla bean,polish sausage,pasilla chile
title: Sausage With Chile Paste (Pollo Con Queso)
ingredients: 1 lb polish sausage, casings removed | 3 1/2 ounces dried pasilla chiles, stemmed | 1 1/4 cups green onions, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 vanilla bean, split and scraped | 3 -4 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil or 3 -4 tablespoons sunflower oil | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: In a food processor, combine the chiles with 2 cups water.

title: Crock Pot Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk italian turkey sausage or 1/2 lb bulk italian turkey sausage | 1/4 teaspoon dried crushed red chile | 1 lb lean ground sirloin
instructions: In a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker brown sausage well on all sides. Sprinkle crushed red chilies over sausage and saute for 1 minute. In a medium skillet, combine ground sirloin and dried crushed red chile. Cook sausage, covered, over high heat until sausage is hot and beef is no longer pink drain fat from cooker. Stir meat mixture into the crock pot. Cook on high 4 hours or low 4 1/2 to 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: pear,white bread,ladyfinger,extra virgin olive oil,gouda cheese
title: Pear Tarte (French Pear Bruschetta)
ingredients: 500 g ripe pears, peeled, halved and cored | 200 g young stale white bread, crusts trimmed and chopped | 100 g white aged gouda cheese, about 1 1/2 inches thick | 1 package ladyfingers | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place ripe pears on cutting board, and sprinkle with salt and the freshly ground black pepper. Arrange them on a board and cut the bread into thin slices. On other side of pears, scatter the croutons. Sprinkle the white cheese over the bread and place a few ladyfingers on top if using them. Starting from the short end of each slice of pear, place a small piece of cheese on top of the bread. Arrange the remaining ladyfingers on top and repeat with the remaining slices of pear and cheese. In a heavy skillet over medium high heat, add 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil. When oil is hot, place each bread slice into the oil. Turn when bottom is golden brown, about 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from oil and place on a clean, dry towel with paper towels. The idea is not to let them burn but to prevent them from drying out. Keep the oil in the skillet until serving. Serve with a dollop of plain yogurt or fresh fruit chutney.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,beef sirloin,flat leaf parsley,peppercorn,red wine vinegar,rice wine
title: Beef With Anchovies and Parsley
ingredients: 2 lbs beef sirloin, trimmed | 1/2 cup peppercorn, cracked | 4 anchovy paste | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Rinse the meat well, then pat dry with paper towels. Slice the thin fat into rounds on an angle. Cut the rounds into 12 slices. Place the meat, cut side down, in a shallow roasting pan. Spread each piece with 1/2 teaspoon of the crushed peppercorns and 1/4 teaspoon each of anchovy paste. Place the pan in a larger pan of boiling water.

title: Nigella Lawson Minted Leeks, Pancake or Rolls With Rice and Ham
ingredients: 3 -4 leeks | 1 cup tomato sauce ( or any good tomato paste ) | 1 tablespoon of mint, chopped | 4 cups cooked ham ( or turkey or chicken ) | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 6 sheets puff pastry
instructions: Trim any root ends from the leeks. Slice the leeks lengthways into 1 inch thick slices, then cut into 1 inch pieces. Set aside. In a saucepan, heat a tablespoon of olive oil or butter, over medium high heat. Add leeks and fry, turning often, for 5 minutes or until soft. Drain the leeks and add to the pan, stirring. Stir in the tomato sauce, mint and cooked ham or turkey. Season with cardamom. Cook for 3 minutes or until piping hot. Lay out the puff pastry sheet 2 at a time, on a clean, dry surface. Spread the leeks evenly along the centre of the pastry. Place the pastry over the filling and fold over the pastry to seal the edges. Cut steam vents in the top of each roll about 5cm apart. Brush the top of each roll with the remaining olive oil or butter. Bake the rolls for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Turai Khiya
ingredients: 1 head fresh cabbage, about 1 1/4 lbs., thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon ground aniseed | 2 3/4 cups sunflower oil, for frying | coarse salt | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 large head fresh lettuce leaf | 1 large lemons or 1 large lime peel, cut into small rounds
instructions: Place the cabbage in 1 or 2 layers of cheesecloth and cover with some water. Place a weight on the cloth and refrigerate overnight. The next day, drain the cabbage. In an oven toaster oven, set the oven to 325°f. Remove the outer cloth and cover the top of the cabbage very tight with aluminum foil. Keep the foil on the outer area on the oven rack. Fill a large pot 1 1/2 quarts with water and bring to a boil over medium heat. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, toss the onion with the anise and sunflower oil and season generously with salt and baking soda. Line a fine mesh sieve with two layers of paper towels, each large enough to wrap around the rim of a covered pot. Working quickly, drain the cabbage in batches, discarding any excess liquid, and place in bowl. Toss with salt to coat evenly. Dollop 1/4 cup of the cabbage oil into the bottom of the sieve. Drain the cabbage in batches, pressing down and out any excess liquid. Discard any remaining oil. Toss lightly with salt. Gather the shredded cabbage in the bowl and pat evenly with the lime peel. Arrange the lettuce leaves in a circle over the cabbage, making sure they overlap over the ingredients and not overstuffing the lettuce. Roll up the dough. Cut each roll into 1 1/2 pieces. Arrange each slice of dough on a serving platter. Garnish with a few lemon or lime round rounds and an herb sprig if desired.

title: Tortellini With Steak and Jicama
ingredients: 1 lb steak, cut into thin bite-sized pieces | 1 1 lb fusilli or 1 lb cheese tortellini | 2 tablespoons ice water or 2 tablespoons water | 1 cup jicama, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Cook beef in boiling water until tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Spaghetti and Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground italian sausage | 1 lb spaghetti sauce | 1 can sloppy joe breadcrumbs | 1 small loaf of crusty italian bread | 4 lettuce leaves | 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix sausage, spaghetti sauce and breadcrumbs. Take each lettuce leaf and place on a piece of plastic wrap which are long enough to fit over the end of a dinner plate to keep moist. Roll it up into a ball. Repeat this process for the other side. Place meatballs on the plastic wrap and refrigerate until cold. Heat the oven to 350 degrees. Once the oven is heating, place all the meatballs in a 9x13 pan in a single layer. Cover meatballs with the cheese and bake for 30 minutes or to an internal temperature of 140 degrees. Bake until meatballs are cooked through.

title: Simple Cheesy Beef & Gruyere on a Sliced Tender Beef Roll (Diabetic Diet Friendly)
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs stewing beef, cut into 6 portions | 1 1/2 cups gruyere cheese or 1 1/2 cups other swiss cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Cut each piece of beef into 3 pieces, then place each portion between two sheets of plastic wrap. Using your fingers or the flat side of a rolling pin, pat any excess moisture from the beef. Cut the beef slices into 3 or 4 slices each, depending on the size of the slices. Place each slice between 2 sheets of plastic wrap, then tightly roll into a tight cylinder, about 4 in diameter. Repeat this process once more, cutting the roll into 3 or 4 roll sections across and overlapping the slices to form 8 long, thin cylinders. Wrap each roll in wax paper, pressing wax on and off any air pockets. Freeze rolls until solid, about 6 hours or overnight. Spray the roll sections with nonstick spray. Preheat a charcoal grill or preheat an oven to 450 degrees f. Remove the roll sections, stacking them on a platter. Divide the remaining 1 3/4 cup cheese among the roll portions, spreading it on until smooth. Spread each roll with mustard, then top with remaining cheese. Reform the roll sections, using waxed paper as a guide.

title: Easy Beef Romaine Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | 16 tablespoons thai red curry paste ( more or less to taste ) | 3 heads romaine lettuce, washed, dried, and torn
instructions: Slice beef diagonally as if you like. Spread 1 tablespoon of curry paste on each roll and roll tightly. Secure edges of rolls with toothpicks if desired. Place on foil lined baking tray. Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until cooked. Remove toothpicks or serve with rice, steamed vegetables, and sweet and sour garlic pickles for dipping.

title: Pistachio Beef With Rice and Cheese (Golabki)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 2/3 cup fat-free low-sodium chicken broth | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 2 tablespoons flour | 2/3 cup pistachios, very coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup edam cheese food, shredded ( such as nesquik )
instructions: Heat oven to in a 10 inch oven proof skillet cook beef and mustard over medium heat, stirring frequently, until beef is browned and no longer pink, about 15 minutes. Stir broth, soy sauce, and flour in skillet.

title: Barbecued Lamb With Eggplant
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple cider or 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons red onions, finely chopped | 4 medium eggplants, peeled, cut into quarters lengthwise | 200 g ground leg of lamb
instructions: For eggplants, put the apple cider or wine vinegar into a small non aluminium frying pan. Add the red onion, stir well and reduce the heat to half. Place the eggplants cut side up in the pan and grill them for about 15 minutes, turning them often, until they are well browned and tender. Turn them over during this time and grill the other side. They should not change colour and it should be all done in the same time. Transfer the eggplants to a board and let cool, then peel the skins. Chop roughly into small pieces and place them in a small bowl, along with the ground lamb. Use a rolling pin to roll the mixture into large meatballs. Cook the meatballs over a hot barbecue plate, turning regularly with a metal spatula until cooked to your liking. To serve, place a fried eggplant on a plate with slices of lamb on top, sprinkling with the onion mixture. Serve the lamb meatballs alongside the eggplants and eggplants.

title: Tandoori Chicken
ingredients: 15 lbs chicken | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Wash and remove giblets from chicken. Place chicken in a large, heavy pot. Add water to cover. Boil chicken until tender. Remove and discard gizzard from chicken.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,crabmeat,apple,margarine,italian sausage,kaffir lime leaf,adobo sauce
title: Chipotle Crab Cakes-Cherries (Bunuelos)
ingredients: 1 lb crabmeat, picked clean | 1/4 lb fresh hot chili sauce | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 1 teaspoon hot chili sauce, of your choice | 3 slices kaffir lime leaves | 2 italian sausages, about 1 pound
instructions: Combine crab meat, chili sauce, margarine, tabasco sauce, chile sauce, kaffir lime leaves and the italian sausages. Form meat mixture into cylinders approx 2 inches in diameter, each about 12 inches long. Put the rolls on a lightly greased cookie sheet and bake in a 350°f oven about 10 minutes or till heated through. Serve hot with salsa.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,clam,broccoli,marjoram,mini chocolate chip,self rising flour,sugar
title: Delicious Clam Fritters
ingredients: 2 cans minced clams, drained and juice reserved | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1/4 cup self rising flour | 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip ( optional ) | 1 cup broccoli, chopped small ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | tabasco sauce ( optional ) or hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine reserved clams, sugar, flour, cheese, and marjoram. Divide mixture into 18 balls. Roll each ball into small long thin rounds. Place in an ungreased baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Spicy Red Ramekins
ingredients: 2 free-range eggs | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1/4 cup chopped almonds | 1/4 cup sweet marsala, plus extra for drizzling
instructions: Put eggs, curry paste, sweet marsala, salt and pepper in a heatproof jug. Cook whisking constantly, over a low heat for about five minutes or until the eggs are just set. Turn over and pour over extra marsala. Scatter over almonds and scatter over extra marsala. Serve immediately.

title: Brown Rice Pops
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, cooked | 1 package mushrooms, sliced | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 1 veal, chopped | 3 packages frozen string beans, thawed | 1 box frozen spinach leaves, thawed
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together in a large bowl. Bake at 400 degrees f for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,mushroom,golden syrup,thyme,chili powder,chicken meat,chicken wing,chorizo sausage
title: Chorizo Chicken Wings
ingredients: 12 chicken wings | 1 jar sliced mushrooms | 1 slice cooked chorizo sausage, halved | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon black pepper, or to taste | 1 cup golden syrup | 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat the chicken wings with cooking spray. Lay the wings in a roasting pan, and set aside. Mix together mushrooms, sausage, and 1 teaspoon thyme in a bowl. Stir black pepper, golden syrup, and 1 teaspoon dried thyme into the mushroom mixture until well mixed. Pour the seasoning mixture over the chicken wings in the pan. Bake in the preheated oven until juices run clear, 30 to 45 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f.

title: Blue Ribbon Tomato and Coconut Soup
ingredients: 1 roma tomato, seeded | 4 cups low sodium chicken broth | 2 cups fresh blueberries or 2 cups frozen blueberries | 2 tablespoons shredded orange peel | 1 cup light coconut cream
instructions: Pierce tomato all over with a skewer or a fork. Broil tomato under broiler until skin blisters. Peel off tomato and let cool and dice. Set aside. Heat broth over medium high heat, about 2 minutes. Add tomatoes, broth, and orange peel. Place blueberries in soup and cook 5 minutes, until soup is hot but not boiling. Let soup simmer 5 minutes. Add coconut cream and stir. Heat through 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,rosemary leaf,soymilk,blue cheese salad dressing,green chili pepper
title: Savory Blue Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed or 1 lb mild italian sausage, casings removed | 2 tablespoons italian sautéed green sweet pepper | 2 cups soymilk | 1 1/2 cups blue cheese salad dressing ( any flavor ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary leaf
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine sausage, pepper and soy milk. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove the saucepan from heat and add cheese dressing and rosemary. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,chicken bouillon,wild rice,beef stew meat,stilton cheese,red pepper,pasta shell
title: Beef Stuffed Pasta
ingredients: 1 package uncooked phyllo dough | 1 jar pasta shells, drained | 1 pound boneless beef stew meat, cut into strips | 1 jar roasted red peppers, thickly sliced | 2 cubes chicken bouillon | 1 jar stilton cheese, drained | 2 1/2 cups coarsely chopped cooked wild rice
instructions: Combine the beef, ro tel and boullion in a heavy 5 or 6 quart kettle. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the meat is no longer pink and juices evaporate, about 10 minutes. Stir in the pasta shells, green pepper, artichoke hearts and cooked wild rice. Cook over medium heat until heated through and the pasta is tender, 4 to 6 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Transfer the cooked pasta to a large serving bowl and spoon 2 1/2 cups of the mixture onto the pasta. Tear off 2 or 3 pieces of the phyllo dough, and roll out into 12x6 inch rectangles. Cover the filled pasta in a greased 8x8 inch metal baking dish that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Agua De Molcajete (Spanish Spice A Float)
ingredients: spices ( of your choice -- cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, turmeric, or whatever you like, or some other spices, of your choice ) | 1 1/2 ounces hot soda water ( the soda water should be hot enough to kill any microbes that might otherwise feed a negative flavour ) ( optional )
instructions: Take the ibrik, and if you need it, mix it with a little hot soda water. Then add spice powders or other spices. Enjoy in your drinking glass.

instructions: In a large bowl, mix mustard powder with cream, chili sauce, wine, tomato juice, ground coriander and poppy seeds. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for two hours before using as a dressing for meat or poultry. Serve with chicken or pork.

title: Welsh Leek and Raspberry Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white vinegar or 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 8 fresh thyme sprigs, minced | 2 cups leeks, sliced thinly crosswise | 1 1/2 - 2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2-2 cups meat stock ( if not using canned, you could just use a small can of homemade chicken stock ) | 2 cups raspberries or 2 cups strawberry jam
instructions: Place the vinegar or lemon juice in a bowl, add thyme. Cover and marinate for 30 minutes. Heat a large saucepan or soup pot over high heat. Add the butter. When soft, add the leeks and cook for 1 minute. Add the marinated vinegar or lemon juice marinade and stock. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Puree soup in blender or food processor. Add the raspberries or strawberry or strawberry jam and simmer for 5 minutes longer or until hot. Pour soup into bowls and serve.

title: Cogy's Crunchy Spanish Rice Recipe
ingredients: 3/4 cup cooked plain yogurt | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 2/3 cup shredded unpeeled fresh gingerroot | 1 1/2 cups spanish rice or 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 6 whole birds eye chiles, deveined | 1/2 cup quick-cooking beef bouillon ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine yogurt, cheese, gingerroot, rice, chopped chiles, and beef bouillon. Toss thoroughly, then transfer to a 3 - 4 quart slow cooker. Cover slow cooker and continue cooking on low heat setting for 5 - 7 hours or until ready to serve.

title: Curried Roast Corn Fish and Barley
ingredients: 1 whole fish, cut into 1-inch pieces ( such as orange roughy or monkfish ) | cooking spray, or as needed | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1/2 cup ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 1/3 cups shredded store-bought frozen mixed pulses | 1/2 cup flaked sea bass or 1/2 cup sea bass fillets, bones removed and cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons pure vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place the fish in a large bowl and turn with a fork to thoroughly coat. Cover the bowl with a kitchen towel and set aside at room temperature for at least 1 hour. When it comes to room temperature, remove fish from refrigerator and place in the refrigerator over night. When ready to bake, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the barley and stir. Reduce heat and simmer until thick, about 20 minutes. Drain and set aside. Stir together turmeric, chili powder, and mixed pulses in a small bowl.

title: Grilled Chicken, Pineapple & Beef Parcels
ingredients: 1 boneless skinless chicken breast | 100 g puff pastry | 1/4 cup wheat germans, roasted wheat, rolled oats ( optional ) | 100 g pineapple, sliced | 100 g beef, sliced | 100 g pasta, cut into 1cm cubes | 3 cups watercress, for garnishing
instructions: Brush the chicken with an egg wash and sprinkle with wheat germ. Place the rolled up pastry rounds on a lightly floured board and brush with egg wash. Cover with a clean tea towel and set aside. Roll the chicken out to about 5cm thick. Cut pastry into 1cm squares. Place 1cm larger of pineapple on the bottom of the pastry squares. Place the chicken on top of the pineapples. Place the beef on top of the pineapple. Place 3/4 of the pasta on top of the chicken and pineapple. Cut the piece of cheesecloth into 2cm lengths and tie with a piece of string. Repeat with all the fruit, pastry and beef. Brush a large bamboo steamer with veg oil. Arrange the parcels over the top. Steam for about 30 minutes. Place the parcels on warmed serving plates and top with watercress.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,phyllo dough,pearl barley,egg substitute,calorie italian dressing,tomato,orange zest,parmesan cheese
title: Greek Barley Pie
ingredients: 1 carton reduced-calorie italian dressing | 2 cups pearl barley, uncooked | 2 cans stewed tomatoes | 1/3 cup diced fresh tomato | 3 eggs ( lightly beaten ) | 4 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 8 sheets phyllo dough | 1/2 cup reduced-calorie italian dressing | 1/2 cup reduced-calorie italian dressing | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Pour 1/2 of italian dressing into bottom of a 9 x 13 glass dish. Add barley.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,olive,cannellini bean,vanilla extract,bay leaf,green pea
title: Pasta E Fagioli
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 1/2 cups warm water | 1/2 cup finely chopped ripe olives | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 5 bay leaves
instructions: Put the yeast in a mixing bowl and add the warm water. When mixed, knead the dough for a small while until it begins to show little lumps. Place in a greased bowl and let rise until double in size, about an hour. In a saucepan fill with a couple inches of water. Rinse and place the beans and bay leaves in it. Bring to a boil on the stove, then lower the heat and cover tightly. Let the water come to a simmer. When the beans are hot, remove the bay leaves. Remove the dough from the bowl. Turn it out onto a generously floured work surface. Flour your bench top, your working surface, or for a really easy, heavy pasta dough, roll out the dough until it's 1/4 inch thick, about 1/4 by 3 inches. Using a pizza cutter, cut the dough into 3 inch squares. Place spoonfuls of the bean mixture in the center of each dough square. Fold over the top and pinch the edges together to form a half moon. Place in a well buttered casserole. Cover and allow to rise until doubled in size, about 45 minutes. Heat a large frying pan or heavy skillet over medium heat. Spoon olive oil into pan. When hot, add the pasti squares and fry until golden, about 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: scotch whisky,salsa verde,tomato paste,sirloin steak,balsamic vinegar,orange extract,pork sausage
title: Seared Sirloin Steaks
ingredients: 3 ounces spanish pork sausage, casings removed ( about 1/2 lb ) | 2 tablespoons scotch whisky | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon orange extract | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | salsa verde, drained to serve
instructions: In small bowl stir together the sausage, whisky, vinegar, orange extract, tomato paste and half of the sherry.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,dark beer,vanilla vodka,salt,tomato paste,red onion,active yeast
title: Portuguese Dark Beer and Barley Bread
ingredients: 1/2 package active dry yeast | 3/4 cup dark beer | 3/4 cup pearl barley | 2 cans tomato paste | 1 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1 1/4 cups vanilla vodka | 1 cup salt, or to taste | 3 tablespoons pearl barley, for garnish
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm dark beer and set aside for 10 minutes. Add barley, tomato paste, onion, and 1 cup vanilla vodka and salt. Remove mixture from burner and let cool to warm temperature, about 5 minutes. Turn off burner and let stand 10 minutes, to allow flavors to blend. Pour into 2 small, lightly breaded round loaves or punch bowl. Cover loaves with a towel and let stand in a warm place about 2 to 3 hours, or until the breads begin to soften. Cut dough into 8 equal loaves or six smaller loaves. Place loaves on a baking sheet and place in a preheated oven at 475 degrees f for about 35 minutes, or until loaves are light golden brown and sound hollow when tapped. Brush with a little more vanilla flavoring while warm and sprinkle with pearl barley. Note, for vegetarian use chicken.

title: Noble House Celestial Harmony Meatball Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp | 1 tablespoon oil ( enough to coat ) | 8 beef ribs, finely sliced into 1-inch pieces | 2 fresh hot chili sauces, such as sriracha | 2 tablespoons ginger | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 2 cups corn flakes, toasted
instructions: Cook shrimp in boiling water just until pink, 1 to 2 minutes. With a slotted spoon, remove shrimp. Cut into 1/2 inch sections and set aside, reserving shells. Cook ribs in oil in a large frypan or wok over medium high heat until light brown, 3–5 minutes. Transfer to plate. Add chili sauces and reserved shrimp shells to frypan. Heat to boiling. Add beef, ginger, orange rind, and shrimp. Cook, stirring, until meat is cooked through, about 20 seconds. Add cornflakes and cook until liquid is thin, about 3 minutes or so.

title: Avocado Sandwich -- Mexican Sandwich or Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 1 avocados, sliced thin | 2 whole baby corn ( cut from the cob or tin ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 clove garlic oil ( or to taste ) | 1 lemon peel, minced | salt and black pepper | 4 sandwich buns
instructions: Slightly toast the sandwich or bread using a bread maker. Prepare the sandwich/bread maker and place the sliced avocado, corn, vinegar and garlic oil in a bowl. Mash up the avocado with pepper to taste, and salt and pepper to taste. Keep the bread warm while you work with the mixture. Dipping your choice of bread into warm syrup should also look good on this recipe.

title: Aussie Hard-Boiled Eggs Appetizer
ingredients: 3 hard-boiled eggs | 2 ounces dark beer | 2 dashes of a strong, spiced salad dressing | ice
instructions: Cut a thin slice off the top just below the rim of each egg and scoop out the white inside. Leave the eggs yolks in the shell for 1 minute, remove the shells and scoop out the egg yolks. Place the shells back on the shell, cut one of the halves in half and scoop out the whites with a teaspoon, place the whites back onto the shells. Place the egg whites into a small bowl with the beer, a dash of a hot salad dressing and crushed ice. Top with the shell egg yolks.

title: Meat Fritters

instructions: Mix all the ingredients together thoroughly and roll into small patties of the same size. Cook on top of your preferred coals or grill for approximately 10 minutes on each side.

title: Easy Microwave Apricot Jam Filling for Cakes
ingredients: 1 jar apricot jam or 1 jar jam, divided | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine 1/2 jar apricot jam and the walnuts in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Quick and Easy Avocado and Okra Soup
ingredients: 3 -5 okra ( optional ) | 5 cups chicken stock, heated | 15 g lasagna noodles | 1 avocado ( optional )
instructions: Punch the okra with your hands. In a large saucepan add okra and stock, bring to boil. Cut up the avocado and add to soup, keep on medium heat with a spoon or mitt for about 5 mins, until it has softened. While the soup is heating up, boil the lasagne noodles in salted water until soft, drain with a strainer and add to soup. I used a ziploc bag for this.

title: Pea Pudding in Coconut Cream (Pudim De Patata)
