instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a 2 quart baking dish, combine the peas, coconut milk, fish stock and flour in a saucepan. Heat over medium low heat for 5 minutes or until very hot and thickened. Stir in the yoghurt, and stir until well blended. Cover the dish completely with aluminum foil, and bake for 30 minutes in a preheated oven. Remove the foil, and continue baking for 15 minutes.

title: Glaze Glazed Swordfish
ingredients: 500 g swordfish steaks | 80 ml sweet chili sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Lay swordfish on an aluminium foil lined tray. Combine sweet chilli sauce and hot sauce. Spread mixture evenly over fish. Grill swordfish over hot coals with hood closed for 2 minutes or until cooked. Remove to a warm plate and slice thickly.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Sauerkraut
ingredients: 15 ounces sauerkraut | 3 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Empty sauerkraut in the bottom of the crock pot. Sprinkle on catsup and add about an inch of water to the top of the sauerkraut. Cook on high for about 4 hours. Serve over sourdough bread.

title: Greek Burger Wedges With Avocado Melts
ingredients: 4 english muffins, split | 2 tablespoons olive, toasted, divided | 1 large avocado, peeled, pitted, sliced | 8 slices deli hamburger | 1 teaspoon ground cumin, divided | 8 ounces provolone cheese, shredded | 4 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1/4 cup pickled olive, drained and sliced
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Spread each half muffin half with 1 tablespoon olive oil.

title: Poblano Chile Powder
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles ( fresh, hot, any type ) | 1 chicken stock cube, crumpled up
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Place the poblano peppers on baking tray / foil. Bake for about 30 mins until soft and black. Remove peppers and leave skin on. Wash the stalks of the poblano until the skin becomes hard and then cut the flesh into chunks. Place in a blender in the same pan you cooked the poblano peppers in and mix it up with the stock cube. Pulse on high until mixed in well. Place the chilies in an oven proof dish and pour in the chile mixture. Cover with aluminium foil and place in oven. Cook over a low heat for approx 30 minutes. Serve with any burritos, quesadillas, or as a side dish to your favourite mexican meal. I've been using this recipe for about 20 mins on my burner.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,maraschino cherry,caster sugar,white sugar,breadcrumb,red chili pepper,ghee,sausage gravy
title: Roasted Sausages With Sausages & Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ghee | 1 red chili pepper | 2 tablespoons ghee | 3 red chili peppers | 400 g fresh ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 25 g white sugar | 5 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 2 cups fresh gravy
instructions: Roast chilies under grill, brushing with ghee and turning till blackened all over. Leave on absorbent paper for five mins until soft. Peel skin from chilies. Place in a bowl and mash well till smooth and free from the lumps. Heat ghee in a pan. When hot, add chillies and cook for 30 - 60 seconds. Add garlic. Remove from heat. Place sausages in a deep pan. Mix together the ricotta cheese, sugar and breadcrumbs. Add the chilies and mix well. Gently spread the mixture onto the sausages. Grill sausages until golden brown on all sides and cooked through.

title: Chinese 5-Spice Dip, for Beef and Veggies

instructions: Mix all in non stick baking dish, bake at 350°f for 30 minutes.

instructions: Trim excess fat from the cabbage. Cut off and discard the core and dark purple leaves from the head of cabbage.

instructions: Mix the mango chutney, dill pickles, and dried sage together in a bowl. Refrigerate any leftover dip for a week.

title: Baked Chocolate Cauliflower

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place cauliflower in a large bowl and add melted chocolate. Mix the ingredients until just smooth and cover tightly with foil. Bake in the preheated oven 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Tomato-Hogao Sandwich
ingredients: 2 slices whole wheat bread, cut 1in thick | 1 ounce goat cheese | 1 tablespoon tomato puree
instructions: Spread tomato puree on one side of each bread slice. Top with goat cheese, sprinkle with tomato and serve.

title: Greek Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup chopped, cooked chicken thigh meat | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, pitted and sliced | 3 tablespoons chopped lemon juice, or to taste | 12 whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Combine chicken, olives, and lemon juice in a bowl. Wrap tortillas between your hands. Wrap with foil and place on a plate or tray. Microwave on high until warmed through, about 1 minute. Slice to serve.

title: Lazy Cabbage

instructions: Saute cabbage in abowl in 1/2 cup alfredo sauce.

instructions: Place carrots in a 5 to 6 quart slow cooker. Cover with water and sprinkle with marjoram and star anise. Cover and cook on low until tender, 7 - 8 hours. Remove star anise before serving.

title: Nacho Cheese

instructions: Place bulgur in a large bowl. Place yellow bell pepper and sour cream in a food processor.

title: Gluten-Free Gluten Free Mix for Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons gluten-free flour | 4 teaspoons paprika | 2 teaspoons flours mixed with water, such as wheat germ ( i use ap flour mixed with a little water. )
instructions: Place the flour, paprika powder, mixed dry ingredients into a large bowl. Use your hands to mix. Add water with flours until the mixture is sticky. Let rest for 30 minutes. Knead for 3 or 4 attempts at the same time until the dough doesn't feel sticky or dry.

title: Cherry Roasted Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh asparagus, trimmed and trimmed | 1/8 teaspoon saffron threads | 2 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place asparagus in a single layer on a baking sheet. Rub asparagus with saffron, cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Remove asparagus from refrigerator and shake off any excess water. Coarsely chop asparagus. Spread asparagus on a baking sheet and roast until tender, 8 to 12 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned. Combine mixed fresh herbs with a pinch or twoOf saffron in a small bowl. Drain roasted asparagus and toss with herb mixture.

title: Santa Fe Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package tri-color spiral pasta or ( 1 lb ) package penne, uncooked | 1/2 cup prepared chunky salsa, preferably medium heat | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese or 1/2 cup swiss cheese, plus 1/4 cup | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon poppy seed dressing | 1 tablespoon dry verjuice | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Homemade Powdered Sugar
ingredients: 1 cup light brown sugar | 4 cups dark soy sauce | 2 cups raw brown sugar
instructions: In a large bowl, make a syrup by heating up the brown sugar and dark soy sauce. Stir and store in a tightly closed container. Note, you can use an instant dry yeast, but the flavor is better the longer. To use, rinse the sugar under very hot, running water until it reaches the texture of molasses, which is easier to dissolve. When the sugar is dissolved, add the soy sauce. If the temperature of your gas or charcoal begins to smoke, this will cause a skin to form on your meat at the bottom of your oven. Sprinkle the sugar onto the meat, stirring so that the sugar melts into the mixture. The temperature of the gas will cause skin to form on the meat when its been painted with the syrup. It is not necessary to remove the skin, but you might need to do so while your meat is marinating. Place the meat in a large stainless steel pan, adding the sugar and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cook for one hour, stirring often. While your meat is caramelizing, you can prepare the balls. Using your fingertips or the back of a fork, mix the sugar into the water.

title: Braised Beef Short Ribs

instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a mixing bowl. Mix well. Spread mixture into roasting pan, about 1/4 thick. Place in a 350 degree oven. Roast until thermometer reads thermometer reads 140 degrees for medium rare, about 1 1/2 hours. Allow to rest for 15 minutes before slicing to serve. Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Lamb & Pineapple Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb boneless leg of lamb, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup kalamata olive, pitted | 1/4 cup kraft pineapples with juice | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds, lightly toasted | 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, diced very thinly
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes. Soak the olives in kosher salt and pepper, to taste. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the olives. Place lamb in a shallow dish with the kalamata olives. Add the pineapples with juice. Mix well and marinate for at least 1/2 hour. Place the pork on the skewers and place in a pan. Cover with the reserved olives. Put a tight lid on the pan and bake in a preheated oven at 325 degrees for 1 hour. Remove cover, add remaining olives and bake until meat is no longer pink. Cut into 1 inch chunks and serve with rice.

title: Nana's Perfect Microwave Rice Cakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Add rice wine, italian seasoning, and i half a teaspoon or so of butter. Mix thoroughly. Let sit in a microwave safe bowl for approximately 30 seconds for most of the liquid to get to the bottom of the bowl, before reducing into a thick paste.

Random Ingredients: garlic,green chile pepper,sea salt black pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,cherry tomato
title: Cherry Tomatoes and Garlic
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 medium green chile peppers, trimmed, halved | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | sea salt and black pepper to taste | 1/2 pint cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange the cherry tomatoes on a baking sheet. Spray a baking stone with cooking spray. Sprinkle the green chiles on the tops, and place it into preheated oven. Bake the tomatoes in the oven until all the juices are released, about 1 hour. Remove the baking stone from the oven, and stir chiles, garlic, salt, and pepper. Serve hot.

title: Easy Low-Fat Black Beans
ingredients: 3 cups cooked black beans, rinsed | 3 cooked chicken meat, diced | 2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crockpot. Cover. Cook on high 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,tomato puree,vanilla extract,creole seasoning
title: Creole Red Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup creole-style seasoning | 1/2 cup hot black mustard seeds | 1 can tomato puree | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together creole style seasoning, black mustard seeds and tomato puree. Simmer sauce in a saucepan over medium heat for three to four minutes or until heated through. Remove from heat. Pour hot sauce over hot cooked red sauce in a bowl. Stir in vanilla, and serve.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,cardamom,coconut flake,mustard powder,sun tomato oil,ice,romaine lettuce,maraschino cherry
title: Sunomono Salad
ingredients: 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 cup chopped mushroom | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/4 cup drained sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 cup flaked coconut flakes | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped maraschino cherries
instructions: Place dry seaweed on plate. Cut into 8 squares or rectangular strips measuring about 4 inches wide. Place approximately 3 tablespoons of the shredded lettuce on seaweed. Place mushrooms, sun dried tomatoes and soaked sun dried tomatoes in a bowl of warm water and soak 10 minutes to soften. Cool completely. Whisk together the maraschino and the next 3 ingredients using a fork or whisk, in a small bowl, and pour onto seaweed mixture, stirring until evenly mixed. Spoon over lettuce and sprinkle with coconut flakes.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,curd cottage cheese,grainy mustard,yellow pepper,allspice berry,hard egg,peach
title: English Pepper and Pepper Pie
ingredients: 2 cups small curd cottage cheese | 2 cups diced yellow peppers | 1 teaspoon prepared grainy mustard | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice berry | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 hard-boiled egg | 3/4 cup diced drained canned peach
instructions: Mix cottage cheese, yellow peppers, mustard, allspice, tarragon, and egg together in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Stir in the diced peaches. Spoon mixture into a well buttered pie dish. Dot with slices of hard boiled egg.

title: Swiss Cheese with Green Peppercorns
ingredients: 2 lbs sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon green peppercorn, cracked
instructions: Place the cheese and the cracked peppercorns in a large bowl. Drench the green peppercorns through a nylon bag, pressing out as many of the seeds as possible. Cover with a layer of cheesecloth and tie tightly with string. Place the cheesecloth bag in the bowl. Let sit in a cool place until the cheese is firm, about 5 days. Unwrap cheese and cut into 4 equal pieces. Place in refrigerator until hard.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,whipping cream,fontina cheese,phyllo dough,no yolk egg noodle substitute
title: Cheese Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup reduced-fat fontina cheese | 1 can no yolk egg substitute | 1 package frozen chopped phyllo dough, thawed | 5 tablespoons no yolk eggnoodle substitute ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f spray baking sheet with cooking spray. In medium bowl, combine cheeses and 3 tbsp. Noodle substitute.

title: Spinach With Spice
ingredients: 1 sprig baby spinach leaves | 6 teaspoons mixed spice ( see note )
instructions: Heat a small pan to the smoking point. Put in the leaves. Stir and fry for 10 seconds, then put in the mixed spice. Stir and fry for a further 2 - 3 minutes. Add a little water if necessary. Serve hot.

title: Tex-Mex Shred Barley Pudding
ingredients: 1 bunch cilantro stems, packed | 2 cups pearl barley | 1/4 cup orange rind, grated | 1 cup cornmeal
instructions: Chop cilantro roots and reserve 1 cup of the stems. Soak barley in 2 cups cold water for 5 minutes, then drain. Place barley, cilantro stems, orange rind, and 2 cups cold water into a blender or food processor, add cilantro roots and pulse. Add cornmeal and process. Add reserved cilantro roots and pulse again to release any remaining flavor. Add bean tips or pearl barley mixture and pulse to mix. The texture should have a rough textured texture.

title: Dark Chocolate Pear Coffee Cake
ingredients: 1 pears, pared, cored and sliced | 2 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 2 teaspoons sugar | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Place the pears in a small glass bowl with the dark chocolate and set aside to melt in the microwave. Pour into a small bowl with the sugar and baking powder and mix well. Pour into a greased, floured pan and bake in a preheated oven at 350f/180°c for about 15 - 20 mins, until lightly browned. Remove from the oven and allow to cool. Cover and refrigerate until required.

Random Ingredients: green onion,cottage cheese,serrano pepper jalapeno,iceberg lettuce
title: Gorgonzola (Cheese Salad) (Dairy)
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 bunch green onion | 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons serrano peppers with jalapenos
instructions: In a salad bowl, combine lettuce, onions, cottage cheese and green chilies. Sprinkle with black pepper.

title: Broccoli Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 1 can broccoli florets | 8 ounces swiss cheese, grated
instructions: Mix the broccoli and swiss cheese in a large bowl until well blended. You may add more cheese if desired. Roll or shape into one inch diameter patties. Pan fry in olive oil or a little bit of butter until golden brown on each side.

Random Ingredients: chutney,anise,mozzarella cheese,taco seasoning mix,gruyere cheese,black olive,carrot,swiss cheese
title: Gruyere Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup shredded, or to taste gruyere cheese | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 2 squares gruyere cheese, minced | 1 can chopped black olives, drained | 1/2 cup chopped carrots, drained | 1/2 cup chutney, or more to taste | 1/2 teaspoon anise | 1 package taco seasoning mix, divided
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a fondue pot or fondue pot, and bring to a slow boil.

title: Spiced Farfalle (Or Catcher's) Soup
ingredients: 350 g farfalle pasta ( bowtie shaped pasta ) | 1 red radish, peeled and finely chopped | fresh coriander sprig
instructions: Bring 6 cups of boiling water to the boil, then add farfalle pasta and cook until al dente. Drain. While farfalle is cooking, heat a small frying pan over medium heat, then add the radish. Fry for about two minutes until translucent, then add the coriander. Toss gently with the hot farfalle until the soup becomes slightly thick. Serve sprinkled with fresh coriander.

Random Ingredients: hash brown,green bell pepper,red chili sauce,self raising flour,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Chipotle Pepper & Potato Hash Browns (Australian Muffin Mix)
ingredients: 100 g hash browns, mashed | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1/3 cup red chili sauce | 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 190°c. Line 1 1/2 cup capacity muffin tins with baking paper. Combine all ingredients in medium bowl, then stir just until combined. Spoon mixture into prepared tins, then place on baking tray, about 1 cm from heat. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until brown.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,dark corn syrup,vanilla extract,heavy whipping cream,brown gravy mix,red currant jelly,cornstarch
title: Luscious Brown Gravy With Corn Nests
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown gravy mix ( no substitutes ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup dark corn syrup | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/3 cup firmly packed dark corn syrup | 1 bag fresh bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Mix dry brown gravy with cream, corn syrup, and vanilla.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,vanilla essence,bread flour,lasagna noodle,sage,stewing beef,chili sauce,chinese five spice powder
title: Sage Beef Bites
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef ( cut into small squares ) | 1/2 lb lasagna noodle | 1/8 cup chili sauce | 2 tablespoons stinese five spice powder | 1/2 cup bread flour | 3 1/2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1/8 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Start by heating up your wok or frying pan, you want to make small bits in the oil, so when not cooking larger pieces add a drop of oil and fry the beef cubes until browned all over. Put meat and all of the sauce in a frying pan, stir, and add to meat. Turn down heat to low. Cook for about an hour or two, stir often to avoid sticking until sauce is thick. Add the garlic paste. Dough, stir flour, and half of the chili paste into the wok. Add to the meat. Let it simmer for about 30 minutes until the sauce thickens a little bit. Add remaining chili paste and sage. Mix in the noodles and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring to avoid sticking. Serve with grated parmesan cheese, chopped chives and celery. This is a very hearty dish.

title: Mexican Cheese Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces american cheese ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup sliced green pepper ( optional ) | 3 -4 cups apricots ( sliced )
instructions: Mix all together. Put in a crockpot and cook on high for about 30 minutes.

title: Figs
ingredients: 500 g sausage meat | 200 g icing sugar | 1 egg yolk, beaten
instructions: Beat the egg yolk and sugar together.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,beef,peach,annatto seed,hot water,plain yogurt,cheese tortellini,kosher salt
title: Tortellini With Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 pint hot water | 1 box cheese tortellini | 1 teaspoon annatto seeds | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 cup plain yogurt
instructions: In a medium stockpot, cook beef on high heat until no longer pink. Pour the beef mixture into a colander and drain beef well of any excess liquid. Set aside to rest. Return beef to pot and add hot water. Cover and simmer for approximately 30 minutes. While the beef is simmering, prepare and cook tortellini according to directions on cheese tortellini box. When it is time to serve, stir in the beans, annatto seeds and salt. Remove tortellini from the pot and set aside. When beef is done, drain off liquid and return to pot. Add the rice wine and allow to simmer for 3 - 5 minutes or until liquid thickens slightly. Remove from heat and let cool slightly for 10 minutes. In a medium bowl, stir together the yogurt and tortellini by hand until well blended. Taste and adjust the flavor, adding more salt to taste, if you wish.

Random Ingredients: pineapple tidbit,milk,sazon goya seasoning,dark brown sugar,clove
title: Pineapple, Chiles & Hot Sauce
ingredients: 12 cups pineapple tidbits, drained ( reserve 3/4 c and save remainder for next use ) | 1 cup 1 % low-fat milk | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 packet sazon goya seasoning | 3 whole cloves
instructions: Place the pineapple and reserved juice into a large pot over medium heat. Add the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cover. Simmer for 90 minutes, stirring every 15 - 20 minutes. Add the rest of the juice, increase to medium high and bring to a boil and cook for 90 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,beef chuck roast,turmeric,green cardamom pod,chili pepper,cheddar cheese,pear half
title: Karela: Chicken and Pear Soup
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth | 2 pods green cardamom pods, split open, crushed | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 green chili pepper, minced | 3/4 cup cheddar cheese, grated plus more for serving | 1 pear half, pared, cored and sliced ( optional ) | chili pepper rings ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot fitted with a lid, combine the broth, cardamom pods, turmeric, and chili. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Decrease the heat and simmer until the broth is reduced by two thirds, about 1 1/2 hours.. While the soup cooks, cut the roast into bite size chunks. When the soup returns to a boil, reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer until the beef is very tender and shredding, about 1 hour. Using a slotted spoon, skim any solids off the broth and discard. Add the shredded beef and 1/4 cup of the cheese. Simmer until the soup is reduced to about 4 cups.. Serve in warmed bowls with slices of pears for garnish. Variation, serve with chili rings. Garnish with a dollop of fresh parsley or cilantro. Yield, 8 servings.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,white onion,puff pastry,cremini mushroom,chocolate chip
title: Mushroom and Chocolate Chip Cannoli Appetizers (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley ( i like to use 1/2 cup pearl of barley and 1/2 cup barley mixed in a box ) | 1 tablespoon white onion, finely chopped | 3/4 cup cremini mushroom, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons semi-sweet chocolate chips | 2 sheets puff pastry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. In a medium saucepan, stir together the pearl barley and white onion. Cover and cook on low heat, stirring occasionally for about 20 minutes, or until the barley is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Stir in the mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes. Cool. On a lightly floured surface, roll the pastry sheets into 6 inch circles. Using a 4 to 5 inch round cookie cutter, cut out circles. Place them on a parchment lined cookie sheet, and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven until the bottoms of the cookies are lightly browned. Remove from oven and set aside. Using a small spoon or pastry brush, fill each circle of dough with a heaping teaspoon or a heaping teaspoon of the reserved mushroom mixture. Fold the dough around the filling and place on a foil lined baking sheet. Chill for about 10 minutes or until the filling has set. These can be baked on the same day they freeze and reheated in a microwave or oven.

title: Crock Pot Brie Stacks
ingredients: 1 package aged brie cheese, chilled | 1 lb sausage, uncooked | 1 package packaged coleslaw mix
instructions: Remove excess fat from brie, leaving enough to coat the bottom and sides of a heavy duty skillet. Remove sausage from casings and crumble. Layer sausage and cheese together in slow cooker. Sprinkle with cabbage mix. Cover and cook on low until cheese is melted, about 1 hour.

title: Easy Eggplant Curry and Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb kumara or 1 lb pumpkin | 3 -4 chicken leg quarters | 4 -6 ounces ramen noodles or 6 ounces fettuccine noodles, broken into bite sized pieces ( optional ) | 2 eggs ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon masala or 2 cardamom powder | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup chicken stock | cucumber, slices ( optional ) or green onion ( optional )
instructions: If using the ramen noodles, cut in half and toss into your pot of boiling water for 1 minute. After a minute or two, drain noodles, rinse them well and set aside add to the pot and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove the ramen noodles from the pot and set aside. If using the fettuccine noodles, boil them in your boiling water and keep the water boiling for about 8 - 10 minutes. Cut your egg halves into very small bite sized pieces and fry with a little bit of veg oil until you can take out the whites, set aside. Put the noodles into a large microwavesafe bowl or plate, add your egg whites, masala, noodles, cooked chicken, and veggies and mix until they are evenly distributed. Heat a little oil in a pan and fry the egg mixture, just enough to scramble the eggs. Serve hot and garnish with cucumber or green onion.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,hard egg,wax paper,mandarin orange,caraway seed,beef sirloin steak,wonton wrapper,porcini mushroom
title: Eunfries
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried porcini mushrooms | 1 carrot, peeled and grated | 1 egg, beaten | 1/2 cup baby worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons ground turmeric powder | 3 pounds beef sirloin steaks, thinly sliced | 1 package wonton wrappers | 24 squares wax paper round wrappers
instructions: Place dry mushrooms in a small bowl and cover with warm water. Allow to soften, about 15 minutes. Drain, then squeeze excess liquid from mushrooms reserving liquid. Grind the coarsely ground mushrooms, grated carrot, and egg into a paste using a mortar and pestle. Stir in worcestershire sauce and turmeric.

Random Ingredients: grape leaf,turkey bacon,catsup,sazon goya coriander annatto,heavy whipping cream,bamboo skewer
title: Grilled Bacon and Turkey Kebabs
ingredients: 3/4 lb of middle cut lean pork ( cut into 1 inch chunks ) | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/8 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons sazon goya with coriander and annatto | 12 slices turkey bacon ( each 1/4-inch thick, 1-inch long, 1-inch wide strips ) | 12 -16 small fresh grape leaves
instructions: In a bowl, season meat with catsup and heavy whipping cream. Let flavors mingle for at least 20 minutes. Place the pork on a plate or in a paper bag. In a small skillet, cover meat with sazon and annato. Place in grill and cook 6 - 8 minutes, until meat is no longer pink. Turn meat and continue to cook until lightly browned on outside and an instant read thermometer registers 170°f on meat. About 4 - 6 minutes before your meat is done, place one slice of turkey bacon and 2 slices of grape leaf, overlapping, in a straight line across the stem of a grape leaf, overlapping, and beginning on the short side. Fold the left and right sides of the grape leaf up over the filling, and roll the grape leaf over the bacon and place on a plate. Repeat with remaining slices and grape leaves until all is used and serve.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,poblano chile,sea salt black pepper,zucchini,carrot
title: Mexican Zucchini, Pepper & Vegetable Salad (Zwt-8)
ingredients: 2 zucchini | 8 ounces carrots, cut in to thick sticks ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 small green pepper, cut into thin strips | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 -2 poblano chile, roasted, seeded & sliced very thin, for garnish
instructions: Wash the zucchini & carrots of any kind & trim off the hard ends. Slice or cut the zucchini & carrots in to long strips ~ about 3/4 in x 2 in, & place in a bowl of very cold salted water to prevent them from absorbing any more of the water. Drain the zucchini & carrots in to that same water & set aside. Dressing, combine all the ingredients & let sit for a few minutes before using to allow the flavors to blend.. Add the cooked vegetables & toss until it's all coated with dressing. Pile on pretty lettuce leaves & garnish with roasted poblanos.

Random Ingredients: bouillon cube,chive,italian salad dressing,spicy sausage dean,curry powder,quinoa,beef brisket,mango chutney
title: Sweet and Spicy Smoked Beef & Sweet Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket, very lean ( i used deer roast ) | 1 cup spicy hot link sausage ( jimmy dean, or other hot sausage ) | 1/2 cup chicken salad dressing, of your choice | 1 tablespoon curry powder, mixed with | 1 bouillon cube ( i used knorr ) | 1/2 teaspoon instant minced chives | 1/2 cup dry quinoa ( i used basmati rice ) | 1/4 cup mango chutney, smooth, sweet ( i used del monte )
instructions: Pour sausage on baking sheet lined with wax paper. Place beef brisket on top, and spread with salad dressing. Combine curry powder and bouillon cube, stir into meat. Let marinate in fridge for at least 1 hour. Bring a medium sauce pan 1/4 inch of water to a boil. Place brisket, fat side down, on top of the water, and cover tightly. Cook for about an hour. While meat is cooking turn oven on to broil. Cut meat slices in half, then shred.

Random Ingredients: lime,chipotle chile,madras curry powder,yellow cake mix,golden raisin,thai red curry paste
title: Thai Lime Bread
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles, chopped | 8 ounces golden raisins | 1/4 cup thai red curry paste | 1 1/4 cups lime juice
instructions: Heat oven to 350f. Coat bottom of 5 loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray. In large bowl, with clean dry ingredients, mix well. Add lime juice and mix well. Spread in 5 cup loaf pan. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center of loaf comes out clean. Remove loaf pan from oven, place on rack and cool for 5 minutes. Loosen top with a knife, remove knife and remove bread from pan. Spread warm browned loaf pan with thai lime paste. Spread sliced loaf with thai red curry paste. Cool on rack. Serve at room temp for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Beet Salad With Pure Beets
ingredients: 4 beets | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 dash fresh green
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Bring 4 cups water to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, but maintain a steady bubble. Scrub beets, and prick with a fork or grater. Place them in the boiling water for about 10 minutes. Immediately transfer to a colander. When cool enough to handle, shave off and discard some of the stem, then cut beets in quarters. Place the beets into a mixing bowl along with any accumulated juice. Add the vanilla and a dash of salt. Mix well to coat beets, then lightly toss with the salad. Sprinkle with a little cinnamon. Tip, beets can be placed in the refrigerator as many hours before serving, or just before serving, but be careful. Variation, serve with sour cream or yogurt.

title: Sue's Easy One Pot Beef Goulash
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut in 1-in. pieces | 1/3 cup a.1. original a1. original mirin | 32 ounces frozen spinach, thawed- drained, well-shredded, and patted dry | 3 -4 cups cooked linguine | 1 cup shredded cheese | 1 cup chopped turnip | 2 packages sliced corned beef stew meat | carnaroli rice
instructions: Brown meat in a large deep heavy skillet. Remove meat from skillet, sprinkle with saki sauce, allow to sit while preparing the rice, cook linguine according to package directions, drain. Preheat broiler. Spray 13x9x2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Add onion and 1/2 lb. Of the corned beef to skillet and saute until onion is tender and meat is browned on all sides, about 10 minutes. Remove meat from skillet and reserve. Stir in remaining corned beef, spinach, and pasta. Pour over the cooked meat mixture. Top with cheese. Broil uncovered 5 min., or until cheese is well browned.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,swiss chard,vinegar,white onion,mustard seed,water chestnut
title: Swiss Chard With Water Chestnut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 bunches swiss chard ( about 2 pounds/1 kg ) or 2 bunches shiitake mushroom stems and pieces ( about 2 pounds/1 kg ) | 1 small white onion, quartered | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds, toasted | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard seeds, toasted | 2 teaspoons distilled vinegar | fresh grated mexican blend cheese or shredded mexican cheese blend
instructions: Place chard stems and leaves in a bowl. Chop onion, water chestnuts, mustard seeds and vinegar. Pour all into bowl and toss thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled.

title: Baked Calzones
ingredients: 12 thin kaiser rolls | 4 slices monterey jack cheese | adobo seasoning
instructions: Lay out 12 thin slices of cheese on a piece of waxed paper. Roll each slice of cheese into a ball, then place it on a cheese roll. Brush rolls with adobo. Place roll in a lightly buttered skillet.

title: Mandarin Peppers Asian-Style
ingredients: 6 yellow bell peppers | 2 teaspoons ground ginger
instructions: In an oven safe baking dish, put peppers and ginger. Bake in preheated oven 350 degrees f for 40 minutes. Turn peppers halfway through baking.

title: Fritters With Coconut (Bahia)
ingredients: 200 g coconut | 200 g diced hamburger ( optional ) | 200 g shredded coconut
instructions: Make coconut meat and cook for about an hour.. After 15 minutes, put the meat into a bowl and mix with the shredded coconut to make patties. When patties are almost cooked and the coconut has turned a nice golden color, add the patties and mix thoroughly. Serve on plate, serve.

title: Chipotle Flank Steak
ingredients: 16 ounces tomato paste | 6 ounces chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 tablespoon cinnimon flavoring cinnamon | 4 ounces sunflower seeds | 2 lbs flank steaks
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a small baking dish and place in the freezer. Preheat a grill pan or broiler. Lightly oil grill or broiler grate. Place steak on grill rack. Cover and allow to meat to marinate for 25 minutes. Slice beef and place on grill or broiler. Brush with oil and grill until medium rare. Remove from heat and serve on a bed of cooked rice with onions around the steaks.

Random Ingredients: tuna steak,butter,craisins,granny smith apple,apple juice,lettuce leaf
title: Apple Tuna Salad
ingredients: 200 g tuna steaks | 2 cups shredded lettuce leaves | 2 granny smith apples, peeled, cored, finely chopped | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon butter, melted
instructions: Divide tuna steaks between two plates.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,chicken,bamboo shoot,double crust pie,coconut cream,lemon peel,fennel,rum
title: Aussie Rum and Chicken Bundt
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rum | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon ground fennel | 1 1/2 lbs ground chicken | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained if canned | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 1 can coconut cream | 12 double crust pie crusts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine rum, bouillon granules, fennel and chicken in large skillet. Cook over medium heat until fragrant. Stir in bamboo shoots, and lemon peel.

title: Hazelnut-Mustard Seed Semolina Balls (Chikken)
ingredients: 3 cups fresh hazelnuts | 1 1/2 cups semolina flour | 6 cups vegetable broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/4 cup chopped hazelnuts | 5 ounces sliced salami | 2 cups miso
instructions: Put hazelnuts on a baking sheet and toast in preheated oven, watching often, until lightly toasted and fragrant, about 10 minutes. Put hazelnuts in a food processor, pulse until fine. Discard skins and seeds. Pour hazelnut meal into a large bowl. Mix in semolina flour and next 3 ingredients until just blended. Roll dough into walnut size balls and put on a rimmed baking sheet. Rinse with cold water and dry with a towel. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled, about 20 minutes or up to 8 hours. Bring broth and mustard seeds to a boil in a heavy medium size saucepan over medium low heat. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until thickened, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in hazelnuts and salami.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,spelt flour,curry leaf,pancetta,anchovy paste,black bean,parsley leaf
title: Curried Bean Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon spelt flour | 5 tablespoons spelt flour | 1/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 1/4 teaspoons anchovy paste or 1 1/4 teaspoons anchovy, minced | 1 1/4 cups chopped smoked pancetta or 1 1/4 cups finely chopped bacon | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves, or 2 tablespoons dried parsley | 3 -4 fresh curry leaves, or 2 -3 whole fresh curry leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Butter a 3 or 4 cup baking dish. Sift together 2 - 3 tablespoons spelt flour, 3 tablespoons spelt flour, cornmeal and chiles into a large bowl, mixing with whisk. Stir in parsley and curry leaves until well distributed. Spoon mixture into baking dish, making sure the dish is well coated with batter. Bake for about 15 - 20 minutes or until bread turns a lightly golden colour.

title: Grilled Cheese With Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 2 large red onions ( about 4 pounds ) | 1/3 cup brandy | 1/3 cup pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Peel the onions and slice them fairly thinly. Toss the sliced onions in the brandy. Place the grill or table knife on the rack above the onions and let your guests place their food mixtures under a the broiler just until they start to show caramelization. Remove the mixtures when the flames die down and remove the sharp knife. Sprinkle the cheese with the grated pecorino. Let stand until the cheese is cool. Store in an airtight container at room temperature. Note, in a german, these dogs are used to grill vegetables in a pan over low heat and then place them in a warm oven to keep warm while you cook them in an oven that is kept hot. This will take about a 1 1/4 hours to prepare the german style dogs. I haven't tried this but i imagine it would be good with barbeque, beef, or pork..

Random Ingredients: dark corn syrup,soy sauce,kernel corn,corn cob,mini marshmallow,orange peel,red bean,rice krispies
title: Robyn's Fried St. Patrick's Day Rice Pie
ingredients: 2 cups mini marshmallows | 2 cups orange peel | 2 cans whole kernel corn kernels, drained | 1 can red beans, drained | 5 cups rice krispies | 2 1/2 cups dark corn syrup | 4 teaspoons soy sauce | 1 can sweet corn syrup | 1 can red beans, drained | 1 can mini marshmallows | 1 orange peel | 1 package mini marshmallows
instructions: Set oven to 350 degrees f. In a large baking dish, stir together the mini marshmallows and orange zest. Stir in the whole corn and red beans. In a medium bowl, mix together the red bean and rice krispies. Mix in the dark corn syrup, soy sauce and corn syrup mixture. Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish and spread to a depth of 1 inch. Bake 1 hour in the preheated oven, then remove from the oven. Spread the red bean mixture over the top. Return to the oven, turn the oven to broil, and broil just until the top has light toasted brown edges. Turn the pie out onto a serving plate. Top with the orange peel, mini marshmallows and shaved scallions.

title: French Beans With Beets
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs french beans, cleaned | 6 fennel seeds | 2 teaspoons black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon thyme sprig | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Prepare brine by soaking beans in cold water for 2 hours in a large pot, adding hot water to cover them by at least 2. Bring water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: pepper,rice wine vinegar,yellow mustard,cornflour,monterey jack cheese,olive oil,oregano leaf
title: Stuffed Onions With Hot, Spicy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs yellow mustard greens ( about 2 bunches ) | 1/4 cup sweet fresh pepper, chopped ( such as jarred pepper flakes, or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 2 2/3 tablespoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, grated ( about 2/3 cup ) or 8 ounces cheese of choice, coarsely grated ( about 2/3 cup )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°. Wash and dry the greens.

Random Ingredients: endive,chicken broth,red potato,red chili powder,orange peel,italian sausage,kosher salt
title: Italian Sausage and Potato Cakes (Papas Rosmarino)
ingredients: 2 cups endives, chopped | 1/2 cup red potatoes, chopped, about 2 | 1/2 cup cooked italian sausage, sliced | 3/4 cup chicken broth | 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder ( optional but highly recommended ) | 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup orange peel, grated ( about 1 large orange )
instructions: Place endives, potatoes, sausage, chicken stock and chili powder in crockpot and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or on high for 2 to 3 hours. Remove lid and stir in orange peel. Serve hot.

title: Broccolini (Broccoli)
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli | 1 tablespoon flaked coconut flakes | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Break the broccoli into florets. Chop the top off the head and remove the thick base of the stalk, and set aside. Slice the stem end and leave on the head. Cut the florets into 6 or 8 florets depending on how thick you like your food. Place the florets on a baking sheet, drizzle with a little olive oil and sprinkle with flakes of coconut. Season with sea salt. Bake in a 400 degree oven for about 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Chocolate Stips
ingredients: 2 ounces cream choclate ( chocolate-honey powdered candy coating or cream cheese ) | 1 small onion ( finely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon dried onion powder | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon ground juniper berries ( depending how much flavor you would like in your chips ) | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | additional powdered sugar ( amount depends on how rich your chocolate is ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place a rack in the center of oven. Place 2 small round baking dishes upside down in the oven for about 10 minutes. Remove baking dishes and set aside. While they're still hot, gently roll them into balls that are about 3/4 inch in diameter. Place them on an ungreased or parchment lined baking sheet.. Place 1 teaspoon of dried onion powder into each toothpick. If you use sour cream, mix together with 1 - 2 teaspoons of the dried onion powder. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of dried onion powder onto each ball of chocolate. If you like your chocolate very sweet, add 1 - 2 teaspoons of the dried onion powder. If you want to be more traditional and more traditional, add 1 - 2 teaspoons of the dried onion powder and 1 tablespoon dried dried onion powder to each toothpick. Using a chocolate shaker, place toothpicks into each toothpick. Bake until toothpicks are brown and slightly crisp, about 20 - 25 minutes. Remove toothpicks with a metal spatula to a serving plate and dust with powdered sugar. If desired, serve chocolate candies with an additional dollop of sour cream, powdered sugar, or additional dried onion powder. Enjoy.

title: Puerto Vallarta Style Squash
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine, divided | 1 yellow squash, seeded and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon margarine in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir squash with remaining margarine until lightly browned and tender, about 10 minutes. Stir occasionally. Mix in tomatoes and heat until hot, about 5 minutes.

title: Italian Turkey Sausage With Prawns and Shrimp
ingredients: 2 italian turkey sausage | 2 lbs jumbo shrimp | 2 cups dry red lentils | 2 dozen tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Slice sausage links into bite size pieces. Heat a skillet and fry the sausage for a few minutes on each side, then transfer both to a baking sheet lined with foil. Bake them for 25 minutes. Let cool, then cut into bite sized pieces. When cool, put into freezer bag. Pour half the beans in the freezer bag. Mix well. Put everything in the bag. Seal the bag. Place it in the refrigerator overnight. When ready to use, take out. Add prawns onto a skewer. Bake for about 15 - 20 minutes for medium, or longer if desired. Let cool before serving. These sausages can be kept in the fridge for several days.

Random Ingredients: rum,lasagna noodle,serrano pepper,hot water,salad green,prosciutto ham
title: Soupe Provencale
ingredients: 12 fresh lasagna noodles | hot water | 2 -3 serrano peppers | 1 cup salad greens | 2 ounces prosciutto ham or 2 ounces prosciutto ham, chopped | 12 tablespoons rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Soak lasagna noodles in hot water until pliable. Cut peppers lengthwise into thin strips 2 or 3 wide by 5 inches long. Rinse under running water and remove stem/sear for last 4 minutes of cooking time. Immediately drain well. Rinse off moisture if necessary. Set aside. Cook pasta in boiling, slated water for 1 to 2 minutes and drain well. Dressing, place chopped prosciutto into a frying pan and grill under high heat, turning and stirring, until just blackened and slightly crispy. Immediately drain on paper towels. Combine ham and chopped pepper in a mixing bowl. Add 1 cup dressing and mix well. Place a dollop of ham on the table. Arrange a layer of noodles across the ham, then a few pieces of proscuitto. Arrange another layer of noodles and repeat, ending with prosciutto on top. Place in a buttered roasting dish and brush or spray evenly with the rum if desired.

title: Soft Taco Filling
ingredients: 8 ounces fat-free half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon cornflour, mixed with | 1 tablespoon low-fat half-and-half cream
instructions: Heat the half and half until boiling, add the taco seasoning. Pour the cream mixture into a medium bowl and add the cornflour mixture and stir well using a wooden spoon. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir in the corn flour mixture to thicken the liquid. Serve with fresh corn bread.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,egg noodle,red wine,pineapple juice,onion powder,cider vinegar,sharp cheddar cheese,black pepper
title: Caribbean Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/4 cup crushed pineapple in juice, drained | 1/4 cup dry red wine
instructions: Place cooked noodles in a bowl. Mix together everything else except for the red wine until well blended. Turn mixture into a salad bowl. If desired, garnish with crushed pineapple slices. Serve chilled.

title: Tahini Chicken
ingredients: 8 skinless chicken breast halves | 3 tablespoons plain flour | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 tasg sesame ( toasted, dark flakes or sesame seeds, to taste ) | 1 lb parsnip, peeled, peeled, and cut into chunks ( about 1 bunch )
instructions: Place the flour and tahini in a food processor. Add the chicken breast and pulse until cut into bite sized pieces. Place the chicken in a shallow pan. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Cover and marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, boil the parsnips in lightly salted water until just tender, about 10 mins.

title: The Perfect Aussie Baked Coconut Rum
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat dry milk powder | coconut rum
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with parchment paper. Whisk the dry milk powder in a bowl until smooth. Stir in the coconut rum. Pour into the prepared baking dish and gently spread with a spatula so that the coconut will spread out evenly. The coconut will expand as it reabsorb into the baking dish. Bake for approximately 30 minutes, until the coconut is lightly golden brown. Serve warm. Variation, use an almond flavored sponge cake scoop or frosting for this recipe.

title: Broccoli Pork Chops
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 4 boneless pork loin chops | 2 cups broccoli, cut into florets | 1 bunch fresh dill sprigs | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano, leaves washed and dried | fresh chives, chopped, to garnish
instructions: Prepare bouillon using 1/4 cup water, 1 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon pepper in a shallow dish or medium saucepan. Place pork chops, cut sides down, in the pan. Cook pork for 5 minutes on each side, or until browned. Combine remaining water, dried basil and 1/4 cup water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,asafoetida powder,mexican tomato,mayonnaise,onion,vegan chocolate chip,apricot,tomato
title: Mexican-Style Bamboo Shoots With Chocolate Chip Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegan mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon mangoes choc chip ( or any chocolate chips of your choosing ) | 1 teaspoon mayonnaise | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 - 1/2 small onion, finely diced | 1 can sliced bamboo shoot, drained and chopped | 1 can diced mexican-style tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1 package presliced vegan chocolate chips (, or white chips of your choosing )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Make the mayonnaise by combining the mayonnaise, mango choc chip, mayonnaise and a few dashes of anise. Stir to combine. Stir in the onion, bamboo, tomato and the chocolate morsels. Add more salt and pepper if needed.

title: Rosemary Pudding
ingredients: 1 quart fresh fruit | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Wash and quarter the fresh rosemary sprigs. Peel the fruit, cut in bite sized, wedges or chunks and put into a large, ceramic or glass dish. Pour in the sprigs and pour 3 cups of water or wine over. The water can be added during the cooking if the pudding becomes too dry. Cook in a preheated oven at 325 degrees f or until the fruit is tender and the liquid is reduced by about a quarter.. This pudding can then be served warm or cold in thick slices or warmed in a pan.

title: Rose Water Egg Rolls
ingredients: 4 eggs | 2 sprigs rose water | 4 ounces smoked ham | 4 tablespoons dried cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f beat eggs and rose water together then fold in ham and dried cherries. Roll into small balls or sausage shapes. Place on a parchment lined tray. Bake for 30 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: French Style Noodles for Two
ingredients: 1 cup wide egg noodles or 1 cup wide egg noodle | 1/3 cup creme fraiche | 1 cup water chestnuts
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions. Drain, rinse under cold water, and drain again. Return the noodles to the package, and divide between two warm plates. Place the water chestnuts on top, and pour the creme fraiche over. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: pear,white wine vinegar,oatmeal,palm sugar,soy sauce,tomato ketchup,vanilla wafer
title: Pear, Tomato and Honey Rolled Balls
ingredients: 125 g pear, diced small | 1/2 cup honey mustard or 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 125 g rolled oats | 60 ml white wine vinegar | 60 g palm sugar, grated
instructions: Combine diced pears and sugar in a large bowl, add soy sauce, ketchup, oats, vinegar and palm sugar, stir well to combine. Roll the mixture into balls about the size of a golf ball and roll each one in grated palm sugar. Place balls onto a baking tray lined with baking paper. Bake in a moderate oven until slightly golden, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,spanish onion,cream cheese,chicken breast,cremini mushroom,lasagna noodle
title: Chicken Lasagne (Oamc
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts | 9 lasagna noodles, broken in half | 4 ounces cream cheese | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1/2 spanish onion, diced | 1 teaspoon garlic clove, crushed
instructions: Cook lasagna in salted boiling water, according to package directions. Rinse with cold water, drain well. Cook chicken in boiling salted water, according to package directions, 6 to 8 minutes. Bone and dice chicken. Heat oven to 350°f. In a lightly oiled 9x13 inch pan combine cream cheese, garlic, onion and garlic. Spread half of meat mixture down the center of each lasagne noodle. Top with chicken. Top with remaining meat mixture and bake until heated through, about 20 minutes.

title: Indian Rice Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked long-grain rice ( left-over, 2-3 hours ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped of fresh mint or 1/4 cup fresh coriander leaves | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 3/4 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/2 cup low-fat tamarind tea | lettuce leaf
instructions: Combine rice, mint or corriander, garam masala, and cayenne in a large bowl. Stir in bread crumbs, blending well before adding next, adding last 3/4 cup water. Chill 2 hours in fridge. To serve, divide rice salad among lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,beef chuck roast,canadian bacon,hungarian paprika,taco seasoning mix
title: Quick Smoked Beef Carnitas
ingredients: 1/4 lb finely chopped canadian bacon | 2 tablespoons hungarian paprika | 10 fluid ounces whipping cream or 10 fluid ounces sour cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix ( mccormick works well ) | 6 -8 lbs trimmed boneless beef chuck roast
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Stir chopped bacon into a bowl, add smoked paprika, then stir for about 15 seconds. Spread mixture evenly into a foil lined grill pan. Wrap foil around meat, then grill meat until meat starts to char in some areas, about 1 hr. Let meat rest, remove foil, and allow to cool. Skim off browned bits of fat, return meat to pan, and mix with sour cream. Note, the beef will absorb some of this sauce, so leave a little at a time to thin. Use a slotted spoon to remove cooked bits of bacon, then store meat in a container to keep warm, or cool and refrigerate in a closed container, for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,pistachio nut,chili pepper flake,mango,granny smith apple,italian tomato sauce,water chestnut,new potato
title: Pistachio Vegetable and Sweet Potato Soup
ingredients: 1 jar italian plum tomatoes with garlic and herbs | 1 -2 pinch chili pepper flakes ( if it is too hot, add a small pinch of pimento or cayenne pepper ) | 2 jars sweet italian-style sweet tomato sauce ( with garlic and herbs ) | 1 jar water chestnuts, sliced | 1 -2 fresh chili pepper, sliced thin ( i like jalapeno and adjust to your tastes ) | 3 -4 medium-large raw potatoes, sliced thin | 1 small granny smith apple, peeled and sliced thin ( optional ) | parsley sprig
instructions: Drain plum tomatoes and cut up small and save whole. Reserve the canned pulp. Combine the tomatoes with garlic, and season with chili flakes, if using. Add remaining ingredients and heat to simmer. Ladle into soup bowls and garnish with parsley. Enjoy.

title: Glazed Small Red Onions (For Dogs)
ingredients: 1 large brown onion, such as vidalia | 1/3 cup brown onion wine vinegar | 6 tablespoons rye flour ( not the quick rising variety ) | 1/3 cup apple cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Using a sharp knife, remove the hard top end of onion and cut from root end. Remove the hard bottom.

title: Broth and Marmalade in Barley
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 2 cups orange sections
instructions: Place the pearl barley into a large, shallow, stockpot. Add 2 cups of water, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Boil for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the barley is tender. Drain the barley well, and return to the pot. Add the orange sections, and stir to combine. Cover, and continue to cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Remove from heat, and allow to stand for 5 minutes, until the liquid is absorbed. Serve immediately, or store in the refrigerator until serving.

title: Spicy Basil-Alpancho-Painted Ham Pasta
ingredients: 1 jar capers | 1 teaspoon canned chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 pound thinly sliced ham ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh mushrooms, sliced | 12 fresh sage leaves | 1 package linguine
instructions: Drain capers, and put capers, chipotle peppers in adobo sauce in a food processor, and puree. Reserve sauce, and refrigerate remaining sauce. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Spread a thin layer of mayonnaise on a baking sheet. In a large mixing bowl, add enough of the reserved mayonnaise sauce to moisten but not runny. Place the ham, mushrooms, and sage into the bowl, and toss to coat with sauce. Arrange the pasta in a large roasting pan, and scatter with capers. Pour the remaining cup of sauce over the top. Cover, and place into the preheated oven. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the pasta is tender. Cook the linguine in a large pot of boiling water, until al dente. Drain and return to the pot before serving.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,balsamic vinegar,coconut,cumin seed,corn tortilla,yellow onion
title: Balsamic Corn Flakes  and  Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 14 corn tortillas, torn into pieces | 1 yellow onion | 1 bunch fresh sweet corn kernels | 1/4 - 1/3 cup unsweetened water | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon toasted and ground cumin seed | 1/2 cup raw shredded coconut, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, toss together tortillas, onion, sweetcorn and water and set aside. Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Put 1 tsbp. Balsamic vinegar and cumin in a small bowl and stir to mix. Brush 1/4 cup coconut on a plate and dust with coconut. Put cornflakes onto a plate and set aside. Spray a clean counter with cooking spray and spread 1 tbsps. Butter over tortillas one at a time, flipping over so both sides get coated with the spices. On a parchment paper lined baking sheet, bake each tortilla 5 - 10 minutes or just until crisp and browned. Remove and let cool slightly. Scoop out with a spoon and scoop out about 2 tbsps. Coconut from cornflakes and set aside. Put 2 tbsps. Of coconut back into the bowl with vinegar. Toss well. Put back on stove until coconut is well mixed and has absorbed the vinegar. Stuff 1 cornflake into the mouth opening of the filled tortilla, put 1 tbsps. Of coconut back on the cereal and put back in mouth opening. Close the cereal and close the taco. Cut into 1 inch pieces.

title: Sautéed Chicken and Feta Cheese Phyllo
ingredients: 4 1/2 tablespoons butter ( or you can just increase it by adding more oil ) | 1 lb phyllo dough ( frozen can be tricky ) | 2 oranges ( juice squeezed when frying ) | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken ( can use more or less ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram ( or chopped fresh or make sure it is a little less ) | 1 cup feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Lightly butter a 13x9 inch baking dish. Remove and discard zest from oranges so it will sit nicely on counter. Cut filo pieces crosswise into 1 inch strips and set aside. Heat a non stick skillet over medium high heat. Add 1 tbls. Of the butter or margarine and swirl to coat surface evenly. When butter foams, add filo pieces and let sauté until crisp and lightly golden.

title: Broccole French Style
ingredients: 1 can chopped clams with juice | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/4 cup pure maple syrup | 2 cups chopped fresh broccoli | 1 1/2 cups grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Mix together the minced clams, mustard, maple syrup and garlic.

title: German Pork Hamburgers
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork loin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1 package instant cauter pate | 1 tablespoon capers, drained
instructions: Preheat your broiler. Spread the pork cubes on an ovenproof platter. Divide the sauerkraut among the cubes. Place meat on sauerkraut. Mix together the cauter pate and the capers. Sprinkle all over the meat. Broil in preheated oven, about 10 minutes.

title: Phyllo With Ham, Potatoes and Ham  Phyllo
ingredients: 16 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 lb serrano ham | 8 ounces russet potatoes
instructions: On an ungreased jelly roll tray. Cover lightly with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 45 seconds or until phyllo is just heated. In a bowl mix flour and ham finely and set aside. On another pan or baking sheet spread phyllo covered with a towel to dry it and lightly sprinkle the bottom with some of the ham mixture. Repeat steps 3 - 4 until all the ham is gone. On a lightly floured cutting board use a rolling pin to roll out your sheet of phyllo into the size of a 9 x 13 pan. With a 4 round cookie cutter cut your ham into large squares. Place on top of phyllo, using all of the pieces that go under. Cover top of phyllo with a towel and microwave on high until bottom is dry, about 3 minutes. Remove carefully from microwave and quickly flip on other side of phyllo. Cover cutting board with a towel and gently put back in microwave for another 2 - 3 minutes or until bottom is dry and crispy. Using scissors cut the ham into small squares. Add to phyllo and fold over to seal in ham and potato/potato squares. Repeat steps 5 and 6 until you have layered all your ingredients into pan. Prick with a fork on the top of phyllo dough and bake at 350 for 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve with pickled ginger and sour cream or greek yogurt if preferred.

title: Creamy Chilled Cumin Soup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon toasted cumin seed | 1 3/4 cups chilled whipping cream | 6 cups chilled chicken broth | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine the cumin seeds and 1 cup of the cream in a small frying pan over medium heat. Stir and cook, stirring often, until the cream is reduced and most of the liquid is absorbed. Remove the pan from the heat.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,italian tomato,sharp cheddar cheese,greek yogurt,greek feta cheese,cucumber
title: Cheesy Greek Pork Chili Dip!
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder or 2 lbs boneless turkey shoulder, cubed | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes ( drained ) | 1 container greek yogurt ( sour cream if you wish ) or ( 16 ounce ) container sour cream ( do not use sour cream if you wish ) | 1 container greek feta cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cucumber | 1 jar greek style shredded cheese
instructions: In crockpot add first six ingredients. Mix well. Cover and cook on lo heat for 6 to 8 hours, until hot and bubbly. Remove pot from heat. Stir in feta, spreading on crackers. Top with shredded cheese. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Fried Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh egg noodles, no boil | 1 lb asparagus tips, cut into 1/2 inch lengths | 3/4 cup cauliflower floret, bite sized pieces | 1/2 small yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 2 teaspoons fresh tarragon, chopped
instructions: In a large pan with a lid, saute the asparagus tips and cauliflower in the pan. When the tips are slightly crisp and golden brown pour over the noodles and coat thoroughly. Stir in the remaining ingredients.

title: Tortilla - Low Fat Option
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, finely chopped | 3/4 cup chopped black olives | 1 tablespoon ground cumin
instructions: Place all ingredients in frying pan including salt, cover and simmer for about 10 minutes or until sauce thickens.

Random Ingredients: peanut,chili oil,heavy whipping cream,golden syrup,turmeric,bicarbonate soda,pork roast
title: Peanut Pork Roast
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork roast | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 6 ounces shelled roasted peanuts | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Heat the chili oil in a large non stick frying pan until very hot, then stir in the turmeric and bicarb soda. Stir in the cream and half the roasted peanuts. Cook for a few minutes until the cream begins to thicken. Turn off the heat and set aside. Sprinkle the remaining roasted peanuts over the pork roast, then place the pork on a hot serving dish, then pour the cream mixture over. Sprinkle with the sugar. Serve immediately.

title: Blueberry Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 pint fresh blueberries | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 5 slices sandwich bread
instructions: Preheat your broiler. Clean and de stem the blueberries. Rinse with water and place in a bowl with the garlic paste. Cover with cheese. Place both pieces of bread under your broiler and place the broiler on top of the bread. Let it toast for about 5 minutes. Place the blueberry bowl on a baking sheet. Cut in half and serve.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,wheat bread,coriander seed,black tea,picante sauce,tomato juice
title: Mexican Bread Tea Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 10 cups freshly brewed black tea | 2 cups tomato juice | 12 thin slices whole wheat bread | 2 cups shredded mexican-style processed cheese blend | picante sauce ( optional )
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the black tea and tomato juice. Seal and shake well. Place the bread slices on a sheet of plastic wrap. Place slices in the bag, using your fingers to press out the air. Place two slices of the bread on each plate, and top with 1/2 cup of the cheese sauce. Roll the bag, and microwave for 1 minute to heat through. Garnish with picante sauce if desired.

title: Thai Coconut Fish Sauce for Dipping (Nuoc Cham)
ingredients: 1 cup whole white pepper | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 cup coconut milk | 1 cup fish sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy bottomed saucepan. Stir to combine. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium. Cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,cream mushroom soup,fenugreek seed,lime peel,pineapple tidbit juice,vegetable oil
title: Sweet and Sour Thai Pineapple Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2/3 cup tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon toasted fenugreek seeds | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can pineapple tidbits with juice | 1 lime peel
instructions: Blend tamarind paste, vegetable oil, fenugreek seeds, and cream of mushroom soup into a smooth sauce, or to desired thickness.

title: Soyster Sauce for Beef (Or Other Meat)
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 3 -4 tablespoons daikon radishes, finely diced
instructions: Cut meat into bite size pieces, about 1 to 1 1/2 inches long and 1 1/2 inches wide. Drain liquid from liquid, if any, or save for other use later. Combine all ingredients and store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,leek,cooking oat,coconut milk,chili sauce,salt pepper,golden raisin,rice wine vinegar
title: Coconut and Leeks (Witlof)
ingredients: 1 leek, white part only, sliced thin | 1 cup quick-cooking rolled oats | 3/4 cup light coconut milk | 1/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup golden raisin, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | salt and pepper
instructions: Heat coconut milk and sweet chili sauce on low for 5 minutes until warm. Stir in remaining ingredients and remove from heat. Pour over greens quickly.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,cajun seasoning,pea,paprika,corn oil,egg yolk
title: Lori's Fried Nachos
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen peas | 1/2 cup corn oil | 3/4 cup paprika | 3 large egg yolks | 15 corn tortillas chip, cut into 16 long chunks | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine peas, oil, paprika, and egg yolks. Set aside 1/4 cup of egg mixture and set aside remaining for another use. Using a large, shallow, heavy skillet coated with cooking spray, fry 3 to 4 pieces of tortilla chips until lightly golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to paper towels to drain, and serve hot with the reserved egg mixture. Sprinkle with cajun seasoning.

title: Thai Fried Corn
ingredients: 3 cups cornmeal | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Place flour in a bowl, and slowly mix in the corn flour to avoid clumps. Heat a large frying pan for one minute over medium high heat. Pour the coconut oil into the pan. Heat the pan until it's very hot but not smoking. Pour the cornmeal batter into the hot frying pan and tilt the pan to coat evenly. Allow for 3 to 5 minutes so the cornmeal batter will spread evenly. Turn over, and repeat this process until all batter is used. Cook for 5 minutes or so, until the corn is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: red potato,asiago cheese,pineapple chunk,olive oil,beef brisket,ladyfinger
title: Sweet Corned Beef Brisket and Pineapple
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 12 ounces pineapple chunks, drained | 1 red potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 4 ounces asiago cheese, cut into cubes | 4 ladyfingers | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: Place the brisket in a roasting pan.

title: Blackberry Mushrooms in Microwave
ingredients: 4 ounces oyster mushrooms, fresh with stems ( or 2 teaspoons of reconstituted dried mushrooms ) | 1/4 cup blackberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 4 teaspoons masala
instructions: Combine the fresh mushrooms with blackberry and masala in a microwaveable dish and set aside, covered. Microwave on high power level for 3 minutes or microwave on high power level for 2 minutes.

title: Couscous (With Pecans)
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberries | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 egg whites, stiffly beaten
instructions: Toast cranberries in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer berries to a food processor or blender. Coarsely chop the dried fruit. Stir the bouillon, turmeric, pecans and apple juice into the crumbs. Add the egg whites to the crumbs and toss to coat. Cover, and chill until firm, about 1 hour.

title: Spicy Swiss Chard With Vinegar
ingredients: 5 ears corn, whole ( about 1 1/4 pounds ) | 2 bunches swiss chard, trimmed and torn into 1 1/2-inch pieces ( about 1-1 1/4 pounds ) | 1 -2 tablespoon sugar-free maple syrup | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon bourbon
instructions: Heat oven to place corn on large rimmed baking sheet. Cut kernels from cob and discard stems and tough woody leaves. Trim kernels from chard. Spread corn on paper towels. Arrange chard in single layer on towel, patting lightly with paper towels. Sprinkle with sugar free maple syrup, and cover generously with another sheet of wax paper. Microwave 2 minutes, rotate, then microwave another 2 to 3 minutes, until chard is just tender. Transfer chard to cutting board.

title: Shrimp Flatbread Sandwich
ingredients: 12 -16 medium shrimp ( peeled ) | 4 -8 flat bread ( or toasted sandwich bun ) | 4 drops oil | 1/4 cup dried parsnips | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce pineapple juice
instructions: In blender, combine shrimp with 1 tbsps of the pineapple juice and blend until smooth. Heat a flat pan, or wok, over medium heat. Add shrimp mixture. Cover and cook shrimp until pink & shrimp are curled. Remove shrimp immediately. Slice the flatbread into 6 pieces and spread on a greased cookie sheet. Top each piece with parsnip pieces, the shrimp and the maraschino cherry. Drizzle top with remaining pineapple juice. Grill for 2 minutes. Serve with crackers or your favourite snack.

title: Melon Balls
ingredients: 50 g dry breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons lemon zest ( grated ) | 50 g cheddar cheese ( shredded ) | 1 tablespoon capers | 20 g fresh malibu rum | 20 g freshly brewed espresso | 10 g fresh epazote ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/170c fan forced. Grease and line bases of 24 hole small muffin pans. To make base base,. Combine breadcrumbs and tahini in a bowl. Stir in zest, cheese and capers. Pour into prepared pans and sprinkle with rum if desired. Bake for 20 - 30 mins or until crumbs are golden brown and base is crisp. Allow to cool in pan for 5 mins before removing from pan. Drizzle base with remaining honey and enjoy.

title: Indian-Style Mango Chutney Rice with Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups cooked black rice | 2 small head cauliflower, broken into florets, divided | 1 can mango chutney | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, steam half of cauliflower in a large pot of boiling water for 3 minutes. Drain. Stir cauliflower into rice with half of mango chutney. Top with remaining cauliflower, mango chutney and bamboo shoots.

Random Ingredients: oregano,creme fraiche,red curry paste,chile pepper,green chili
title: Easy Chiles Curry
ingredients: 6 large fresh chile peppers | 1 cup creme fraiche | 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup chili pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Roast the chile peppers directly over a gas flame until blackened in spots and the skin loosens. Remove the skin and seeds from the chile peppers. Puree the chiles in a blender. Blend until smooth. Stir the creme fraiche into the chile puree. Season with oregano and chili to taste. Serve topped with sliced chili peppers.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,filling,dijon mustard,ginger garlic paste,tomatillo salsa
title: Tomatillo Tacos
ingredients: tomatillo salsa : | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tomatillo salsa | 1 tablespoon ground dijon-style mustard | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger garlic paste | filling : | 1 large granny smith apple, chopped
instructions: Stir tomatillo salsa, dijon style mustard, ginger garlic paste, and grated apple together in a bowl until dressing has been thoroughly mixed.

title: Tarragon Lobster Shrimp Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup flour | 1/2 cup sherry wine ( not cooking sherry ) | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 1 1/2 cups lobster meat, with shell, cut into bite size pieces ( fresh ) | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon capers
instructions: Mix together the flour, sherry, and broth and bring to a boil whisking in the flour again. Add the lobster, tarragon, and lime juice and continue to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes. Serve over your favorite seafood.

title: Toffee for Two (Toffee Espresso)
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steaks, sliced thin | 4 tablespoons hot coffee | 4 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: Put all ingredients in a heavy duty coffee filter. Close the lid.

Random Ingredients: garlic,chinese five spice powder,mango,galangal,feta,cream mushroom soup,graham cracker crumb,baking powder
title: Mango Pie
ingredients: 1 mango - peeled, seeded, and diced into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup cubed feta | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh galangal or white onion | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1/4 cup cracked graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9 inch pie dish. Place mango pieces into a large glass bowl. Cover with boiling water, making sure to completely immerse the mango pieces until they are tender, about 15 minutes. Drain mango and place in a large bowl of ice water until softened. Drain mango, and reserve 1 cup of the liquid and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine soup, feta, galangal, garlic, baking powder and five spice powder. Mix well. Spoon mango into prepared crust. Drizzle with soup mixture. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs. Bake in preheated oven until top is slightly browned, about 30 minutes.

title: Real Simple Peppered Peanut
ingredients: 3 tablespoons liquid honey | 8 tablespoons coarsely chopped roasted red peppers | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1 jar medium jar pimientos, drained and sliced
instructions: Stir honey, red pepper flakes and bean sprouts together in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Bring to a boil and simmer until heated through. Do not boil, the honey will curdle. Stir in pimento until coated.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,yeast,snow pea,baby spinach,onion flake,peppercorn,serrano pepper
title: Sherry Jelly Rollups
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 1/2 lb baby spinach | 4 ounces baby spinach | 1 tablespoon dried minced onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dried minced serrano pepper | 2 ounces dried shrimp peppercorns, crushed | 1 tablespoon dried chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 of lukewarm water. If using quick rise method place in large mixing bowl. Cover and set aside until frothy. If using rapid rise method place on luke warm surface and add in remaining ingredients to bowl. Beat with mixer at high speed for one minute. Dough should just come to dough, but not be sticky. Form into two balls and place on greased jelly roll pan. Cover and let rise in warm area for five minutes or until doubled. Bake at 450f degrees for 12 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to cool and roll in powdered sugar.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,superfine sugar,baby spinach,rigatoni pasta,basil,yukon gold potato,scallop
title: Rigatoni, Scallop and Potato Toss
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 8 baby yukon gold potatoes, halved lengthways | 6 scallops | 1 1/2 cups basil, leaves only, roughly chopped | 2/3 cup superfine sugar | 1 cup frozen spinach
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pan of salted boiling water according to the pack instructions. Meanwhile, heat a small non stick frying pan over a moderate heat. Dry fry the potatoes 1 - 2 minutes or until lightly golden and tender. Set aside. Drain the pasta and return to the pan. Add the oil and swirl to coat. Tip in the scallops or shrimp and cook and stir 30 seconds. Transfer the pasta to a serving dish. Top with the potato mix and scatter over the basil. Scatter over the sweet potato mix and toss together. Drizzle with the sugar. Toss through the spinach leaves.

title: Grilled Cheese in a Light Flair(Algerian)
ingredients: 12 ounces gruyere | 1/2 ounce dried golden raisin | salt and pepper | 3/4 tablespoon turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Brush on grilling board and grill or broil as desired.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,pineapple juice,penne pasta,escarole,lamb steak,vanilla extract,thai red curry paste,buttermilk
title: Kosher Lamb & Pineapple Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces lamb steaks | 1/2 cup thai red curry paste ( available at asian markets ) | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon buttermilk | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice ( optional ) | 1 lb penne pasta, cooked | 1/2 head escarole ( leaves removed, roughly chopped ) | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Cook your pasta per the directions, which usually takes about 7 - 7 minutes. Set aside a large bowl of the pasta water, and start cooking your lamb steaks. You will probably have to do this in batches. Preheat your grill or a heavy pan on low heat. Cut the lamb into 1/2 inch cubes and set aside. Combine your curry paste, vanilla extract, buttermilk and pineapple juice in a medium bowl and mix the lamb well. Add your pasta and pasta water to the bowl with the curry paste to create a marinade. The ratio of liquid to liquid will vary a bit depending on your preference of balance of flavors, but keep mixing until the pasta is slightly wet and the water is almost clear of paste. Add the lamb back to the pasta in the bowl and then add the pasta to your pot of sauce. Stir well on top of the pasta. Turn heat back up to medium, and allow to simmer until the pasta is tender about 25 minutes. Serve over more italian seasoning.

title: Grilled Okra with Lettuce and Okra
ingredients: 1/2 head chic lettuce, outer leaves discarded | 1 package frozen okra, thawed and sliced 1/8 inch thick | 2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained and coarsely chopped | 24 ladyfingers
