instructions: Preheat grill. Place chicette leaves in a large bowl. Top with okra, celery seeds, and red peppers. Brush the insides of the packages of okra lightly with olive oil. Grill okra and okra 5 minutes, or until tops are lightly browned and lettuce is tender.

title: Easy Crusty French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 1/2 cups plain flour
instructions: Slice the french bread lengthways and then into thick diagonal slices. You will need two separate round baking pans, you have to cut off one for the bread and the other for the filling. The idea is for the slices to be 1/2 inch thick. Put flour in a bag with the plain flour. Shake until well mixed, then add the two rounds of bread. Cut a slit in each slice of bread about 1/2 inch deep and fill the slit. The key is staying good with plain bread for the crust to cling to the slices. Place the flatbreads on a baking tray covered with baking paper and put under a hot grill until the bread has dried and is a light golden brown. Remove from griller and cool on a rack. These can now be stored in a zip lock bag for up to a month.

title: Couscous for 2
ingredients: 4 cups cooked bulgar wheat | 1 1/2 - 2 cups demi-glace ( or more if you want sweeter couscous )
instructions: Mix together your ingredients. Tip, you don't have to bake them in the oven just place them together. Tip, if you cook them as you normally would, they can be reheated at the same time while they are baking to increase the flavor. Also, if you cook them in the microwave they'll reheat faster and they will be less likely to stick to the couscous. Tip, you don't have to cook them any longer at all, just leave them aside until step 1, before they start to harden, rinse them in cold tap water to remove any starch. Tip, if you're using a nonstick pan for frying, be sure to add a little oil/margarine into the pan to avoid sticking. Tip, the idea is to heat the oil in a small pan, then pour in your couscous in a circular motion. You should aim for thin grains of uncooked rice. Tip, you can make this by mixing 2 tbsp of dry white rice with 2 tablespoons of hot water, add a little cold water to keep the grains separated and the grains from sticking together, then pour the water all at the same time and keep mixing for about 5 - 10 min until the grains are coated with oil. Tip, don't be frightened by the aromas in the demi glace, because it's hot. Tip, cook the couscous in a pan of boiling water for about 5 mins, the time it takes to be cooked so you can fluff it up before the couscous is cooked. Tip, if you're using your food processor, just make a vinaigrette with a little olive oil and add it into the hot couscous. You should get a lovely thick porridge, drizzled with a little olive oil. Tip, if you're cooking the couscous ahead of time, then reheat it if necessary.

title: Goulash
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 3 cans tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: In frying pan, saute hamburger, with the can of tomato sauce and the confectioners' sugar until golden brown. Serve over hot buttered noodles. Enjoy.

title: Veal, Avgolemono or Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb veal, boneless and skinless, cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 1 1/4 pounds ) | 1 cup pared and peeled parsnip, chopped | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/4 cup uncooked long-grain white rice, cooked | 1/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a large skillet over medium high heat, combine veal, parsnips, beans and spice mix. Saute veal mixture 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Transfer sauteed veal mixture to a 3 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Bake 25 minutes or until hot.

title: Mediterranean Orzo
ingredients: 1 cup orzo pasta, uncooked | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 4 portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon chopped orange peel
instructions: Break orzo into medium pot with 3/4 cup water. Bring to boil, cover and reduce to simmer. About 20 minutes. Meanwhile, toast anise seeds in a non stick frying pan or skillet over medium heat. Turn often until light brown. Remove to bowl of cold water. When cool enough to handle, crush aniseed seeds with hands.. Melt the orange peel over medium low heat in a bowl or a measuring cup. When the orzo is cooked, drain and place in bowl with orange peel, crushed aniseed seeds and the remaining 3/4 cup water. Stir to combine. Add more or less water. Cover and set aside until the pasta is at least room temperature or you can stand it without boiling. Serve as soon as is, or when the filling is cold. Note, i usually prepare this in my ormoosh casserole pan and leave it to cool and plump before proceeding. I haven't tried cooking in the pan on the stove yet.

Random Ingredients: white flour,zucchini,ginger root,red wine vinegar,almond extract,grand marnier
title: Zucchini Grissini
ingredients: 4 teaspoons fresh ginger root, peeled and coarsely grated | 12 zucchini, trimmed and sliced 1/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons white flour | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the ginger, zucchini, flour, vinegar, grand marnier, and almond extract.

title: Creamy Gruyere Chestnut Burgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 2 teaspoons dried chestnuts, finely chopped | 1/2 cup crumbled gruyere | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | salt | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 loaf french bread, grilled | 4 cups baby spinach
instructions: Mix cornmeal, chestnuts and gruyere in a bowl. Toss with breadcrumbs and season with salt. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add half of the bread crumb mixture and press in with a spatula to form a patty shape. Cook until underside is golden brown, about 3 minutes per side. Repeat until all crumbs have been used, and top browned hamburgers with the spinach and remaining bread crumb mixture. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,liquid smoke,canadian bacon,cornstarch,greek salad dressing
title: Bacon German Onion Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup canadian bacon, thinly sliced and left in strips
instructions: Combine bacon and onion in bowl. Toss with salad dressing. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours.

title: Red Lentils With a Brown Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups brown lentils | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Bring 3 cups and 4 cups of water to a rolling boil and add lentils. Cover, reduce heat and simmer until lentils are tender, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,cornstarch,salt pepper,rosemary,salt black pepper,purpose flour,orange juice
title: Lime-Rosemary Orange Slices
ingredients: 2 cups orange juice, freshly squeezed | 2 1/2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped | salt and pepper | 1/2 bag unbleached all-purpose flour | 2/3 cup cornstarch | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon salt and cracked black pepper | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | lime wedge ( for garnish )
instructions: To make orange slices, in medium bowl combine juice and rosemary. Stir in salt. In separate bowl, combine flour, cornstarch, rosemary, pinch of salt and pepper. Add to orange mixture.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile,red salmon,chicken broth,amarula cream liqueur,garlic salt,soya sauce,arborio rice
title: Red Salmon & White Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup other short-grain rice | 1/2 cup soya sauce | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 teaspoon dried argano or 1 teaspoon basil | 1 dried ancho chile | 1 garlic salt | 4 ounces red salmon, sliced in thin slices | 1/4 - 1/2 cup amarula cream liqueur
instructions: Bring chicken broth, soya sauce, salt, and pepper to boil in large saucepan. Stir in argano and chile. Add rice, lower heat and cook covered over low heat 35 - 45 minutes, or until rice is tender. Stir in salmon and cook 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Mashed Coffee Ice Cubes
ingredients: 2 cups cold coffee ice cubes | 1 can coconut milk | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary | 8 strips prosciutto | 1 package frozen miniature marshmallows | 1 package fresh strawberries
instructions: Place coffee cups in large container with ice cubes. Cover, and keep in freezer until cubes are fully chilled, at least 6 hours. Stir coconut milk and rosemary into coffee, and pour into 12x18 inch glass baking dish. Cover, and refrigerate overnight to blend flavors, stirring every 15 minutes. Remove from refrigerator, and set aside to soften for 15 minutes. Remove foil, and slice marshmallows into eight slices. Arrange slices over coffee, and top with strawberry slices evenly. Place slices onto prepared coffee. Cover and freeze until solid, at least 3 hours.

title: Quick Caponnoodle (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 cup noodles ( short noodles ) | 4 teaspoons capers | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt ( for those who don't like kosher, omit this )
instructions: Dump noodles into rice cooker and add capers, capers, and kosher salt. Cover and turn on low. Press cook 20 minutes and serve.

title: Shrimp Arjad
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs shrimp | 1/3 cup arborio rice | 1/4 cup sugar | 1 3/4 cups basmati rice
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Remove shrimp from shrimp, cut shrimp into 1 inch pieces. Saute shrimp and sugar in pan with sugar and shrimp over medium low heat until shrimp is cooked well. Add rice and mix well. Sprinkle arborio rice over top. Cook until the rice and shrimp are well mixed, about 2 minutes. Serve as an appetizer and have lots of crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,bite salad green,cauliflower,kidney bean,fine sea salt,apple,liquid honey
title: Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into flowerets | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 4 cups bite-size mixed salad greens | 1 apple, peeled, cored and chopped | 1/3 cup liquid honey | 1 teaspoon fine sea salt
instructions: In a large stockpot over medium heat, combine cauliflower, green bell pepper, kidney beans, greens and apple. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and cover. Cook until cauliflower is tender and cooked down to your desired texture. In a small cup or bowl, combine honey, and sea salt. Pour over the salad and stir to coat, and let sit for approximately an hour to blend flavors.

title: Tunisian Couscous With Toasted Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces medium grainy mustard | 1/2 cup spicy tamari ( or regular tamari if you prefer ) | 3 cups leftover couscous | 3/4 cup toasted cracked farfalle pasta ( rice vermicelli or angel hair ) | 1 -2 teaspoon baking powder | 3 cartons frozen whipped topping, thawed | couscous, for serving
instructions: In a dry, dry skillet over high heat. When it's hot, add the mustard and tamari and cook, stirring constantly, until the mustard is fragrant and there is a nice dark amber color. When this happens, add the couscous and continue to cook, stirring, until all the couscous is coated with dark sauce. When the couscous is just starting to toast, add the farfalle and continue to stir while cooking. Cook another 2 minutes or until the farfalle is golden and the farfalle are still crisp. When the farfalle are ready, remove the skillet from the heat, sprinkle the baking powder over them, and stir to combine. Pour the couscous and farfalle mixture into a large bowl and mix gently to combine. Add the whipped topping and mix gently. Serve at room temperature. If making the tartar sauce, stir the yogurt in a small bowl until well combined. If using a fan, adjust the yogurt's flavor as desired, but if adding a topping rather than whip it up just mix on the pan briefly. Serve with baked vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pastry dough,chuck,dark rum,oyster sauce,red chili pepper,shallot,caster sugar,onion soup mix
title: Mock Beef Pies
ingredients: 600 g minced chuck | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons caster sugar | 25 g pastry dough ( approx ) or 25 g frozen puff pastry dough ( approx ) | 2 -4 red chili peppers, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180oc. Mix together the minced chuck, onions soup mix, oyster sauce, sugar and chillies. Grease 18 x 20cm cake tin. Add approximately 2 tbs of mixture. Cut the puff pastry in half and press each half in to the tin. Bake in the oven on a high setting for 15 - 20 minutes, until pastry is golden and pastry shrinks away from the sides of the tin. Remove from the oven and cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes. When cool, cut into rounds. Tip, if your mince is very lean you may need to add a touch more water.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,chile,wasabi paste,beet,creole seasoning,anchovy paste,red curry paste,beer
title: Beer and Beetroot Dip
ingredients: 1 can or bottle light beer | 3 beets, trimmed | creole seasoning | 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 1 teaspoon chile, seeded and minced | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese
instructions: Drain beer into a saucepan, reserving just enough to heat the beer. Peel beets and slice into half inch thick rings. Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in a 350 degree oven until tender and lightly browned, about 45 minutes. Remove to a bowl and allow to cool completely. In a food processor or blender combine the beer, shirmp crabmeat, crab meat, creole seasoning, red curry paste, ketchup, anchovy paste, wasabi paste, chile, romano cheese and 1/4 cup reserved beetroot beer. Process until smooth and creamy. Transfer into a small serving dish. Dip the beets into the beer mixture and serve warm. Garnish with a dollop of the horseradish sauce and a sprinkling of sesame seeds and black pepper.

title: Fish Balls (Thitil Guka)
ingredients: 500 g good fresh fish, rinsed and chopped | gluten-free flour, for coating
instructions: Place everything in a bowl, cover and leave to marinade for at least four hours or overnight. Using your hands, roll the fish mixture into small sausages about 7 cm long, then cut into 1 cm lengths. Seal any gaps. Fry in oil in a large, heavy based frying pan over medium high heat until brown or crisp. Drain on paper towel. Serve with your favourite dipping sauce. Tips, for example, use fresh chopped fish heads instead of anchovies.

title: Sesame-Rinse Pasta and Beans (Raw Foods)
ingredients: 2 cups dried cranberries | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Combine the cranberries, diced tomatoes and green chilies and mix well. Pour the mixture into a medium sized pot and bring to a medium boil. Simmer until the beans are tender and can be drained. Add the sesame seeds and continue to cook until the seeds are golden brown.

title: Holiday Broccoli and Dates
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh dates, pitted and halved | 24 ounces whole head broccoli, cut into thick wedges | 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling, salted water, cook the dates until they have softened and are browning, about 3 minutes. Drain and reserve the dates.

title: Walnut-Crusted Beef Lettuce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 6 lettuce leaves | 4 ounces fresh mexican cheese blend | 2 tablespoons toasted walnuts
instructions: Mix brown sugar and garlic in small bowl. Coat beef with mixture. Marinate at least 5 hours in refrigerator, turning occasionally. When ready to cook, preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange the lettuce leaves on a baking sheet. Spray lightly with cooking spray. Bake for 5 minutes. Pile on lettuce leaves, cover, and bake for another 5 minutes or until cheese starts to melt. Remove from oven and sprinkle with nuts.

title: Italian Herb Hoagies
ingredients: 5 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise | 3 tablespoons bread crumbs | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Split rolls horizontally, and place in a shallow baking pan. Soak bread crumbs in 1 tablespoon of mint leaves in 1 tablespoon of oregano. Sprinkle bread crumbs over rolls, and top equally with remaining bread crumbs. Bake in preheated oven until rolls are golden brown and crusts are crispy and toasted, 10 to 12 minutes. Sprinkle with dried mint leaves.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,baby spinach leaf,chili oil,french fry,palm sugar,caper,shiitake mushroom,hot water
title: Simple Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/4 cup hot water | 1/2 cup baby spinach leaves | 1/3 cup shiitake mushroom, sliced | 1 tablespoon capers | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons palm sugar, grated | 1 pinch chili oil | 10 ounces uncooked french fries
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup hot water in a large nonstick frypan or wok. Add spinach and mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,broccoli,oyster sauce,yeast,jumbo shrimp,chili oil,curry powder,chipotle chile adobo
title: Beef-Shrimp Sandwiches (No Crust)
ingredients: 1 1 lb jumbo shrimp, shelled deveined | 1/3 cup fish sauce | 1 tablespoon yeast | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 3 cups rye bread, cut in 1/4 ( or regular bread ) | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 4 cups fresh broccoli, cooked and sliced
instructions: Place shrimp in mixing bowl. Mix fish sauce with yeast. Drench bread slices in the mixture. Place on baking sheet and bake at 350 for 45 minutes for softer crust, 35 for dry. Serve with oyster sauce and chili oil.

title: Sparkling Asparagus
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh asparagus, trimmed and tipped | 1 package unflavored gelatin powder
instructions: Place the asparagus in a large microwave safe bowl coated with cooking spray. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power for 5 minutes or until asparagus is tender. Remove asparagus from microwave. Place in a small bowl of ice and cold water to cover. Microwave on high power for 8 minutes or until thouroughly frozen. Reserve. Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup boiling water and mix with 2 tablespoons of softened gelatin mixture. Pour gelatin mixture into a double thickness of paper towels. Place in a warm, sterile bowl and sprinkle gelatin on top to coat. Allow to set before refrigerating for at least 5 hours before serving.

title: Lamb and Corn Fritters #2
ingredients: 500 g lamb, finely ground | 1 tablespoon catsup | 4 tablespoons crushed corn flakes
instructions: Combine lamb, catsup and cornflakes. Shape into small balls. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Heat oil in a skillet. Add the balls and brown on both sides. Remove from skillet and drain excess fat. Serve with your favourite vegetables.

title: Azerbaijani's Shrimp and Spinach Wraps
ingredients: 3 ounces fresh spinach leaves | 1/2 cup cooked shrimp, sliced or 1/2 cup frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 2 medium kiwi fruits, chopped finely | 1/2 cup cooked hamburger, chopped finely | 2 -3 tablespoons ice, crushed | dazzling rosemary maraschino cherry, crushed | steamed jasmine rice
instructions: In a bowl toss spinach with ice and kiwifruit slices and season to taste with ajodar for topping. Fill a 6 inch by 8 inch shallow serving dish with ice and snow balls. Spoon the shrimp mixture into center of each mound of greens. Top with hamburger, then a dollop with rosemary maraschino. Fold the edges of the mixture over the top of the filling.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,yellow cake mix,dark beer,ginger,cotija cheese,baby carrot
title: Prickly Road Gooey German Carrots
ingredients: 3 bottles dark beer ( beer ) | 4 pounds baby carrots | 1 package yellow cake mix | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger | 1 package crumbled cotija cheese | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Pour the dark beer into a pot over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,anise seed,red bell pepper,cayenne pepper,kiwi fruit
title: Spicy Kiwifruit Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 red bell pepper | 1 kiwi fruit | 1 teaspoon anise seeds | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 -3 jalapeno peppers
instructions: Peel the kiwifruit and cut into small chunks. Place the chunks in a blender and blitz with anise seeds, cayenne pepper and red bell pepper. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving,.

title: Easy Mushrooms for Baking
ingredients: 1 cup sliced button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 8x8 inch baking dish. Stir mushrooms and baking soda together in a small bowl. Dump mixture into the baking dish.

title: Mandarin Lovers French Bread (Crockpot)
ingredients: 2/3 cup low-fat vidalia onion ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon low-fat evaporated low sodium soybean oil or 1 tablespoon veggie oil | 2 tablespoons instant yeast | 1 pinch liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon cornmeal | 19 ounces mandarin orange segments | 1 seedless cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, thinly sliced, garnish
instructions: In a 3 1/2 to 6 quart slow cooker, combine the onion, soybean oil, flour, yeast and liquid smoke. Add in the diced onion, squash and cucumber. Cover and set to low. Cook 6 to 8 hours. Add in the mandarin oranges and cook for 2 more hours. When ready to serve, remove the lid, stir in enough cornmeal to make a thick bread without flouring the crockpot.

Random Ingredients: nutritional yeast flake,mint,greek yogurt,asian pear,nutmeg,taco seasoning,red lentil
title: Red Lentil Taco Filling
ingredients: 2 cans red lentils, drained | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon asian pear, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast flakes ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons plain greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon dried mint ( optional )
instructions: Mix drained red lentils, taco seasoning, nutmeg, pear, and nutritional yeast flakes in a bowl. Mix greek yogurt and dried mint in a separate bowl. Stir yogurt and mint mixture into red lentil mixture.

title: Green Pepper Snack
ingredients: 4 large green bell peppers | 3 ounces pine nuts
instructions: Slice tops off the green peppers and discard. Starting at the base of the pepper, slice out the core, seeds, and membrane. The membrane can be shaped into small rings. Use 1 - 2 teaspoons for each green pepper or one can for each bell pepper. Broil the pepper rings until they begin to brown, turning them as necessary. You may need to broil these in a large oven. You need to do this with a sharp knife at the end. They should be blackened deeply and crunchy, with a nice, black color. Cool and serve. Note, if using larger peppers, halve the peppers and place them face down on a plate or bowl. The skins should be about 2 inches long. Broil these on a baking sheet, until the skins blister and crackle, turning them as necessary, until the peppers are soft. I do them in batches. They should be very well browned and crispy. Do not be alarmed at first as they may burn. After removing the peppers from the pan, place them in a plastic bag. They will release some of the steam and turn to caramelize. You can use a paper bag or a large sieve to remove any burned, unpeeled peppers. When the peppers are cool, cut out the stem ends from the peppers. Remove the seeds and membrane. Place the peppers in a glass baking dish or roasting pan. Heat the oil over medium heat in a skillet. When hot, add the peppers. Turn them several times so they are evenly brown and crisp on all sides. This process will take about 4 minutes, but be careful not to burn them. This won't be easy. Be careful, watch out for any sign of burning, because this is a very easy way to fry the peppers. When the peppers are crisp and brown and have black spots on the exterior, remove from the heat. They will release more of the steam and more flavor. This will take about 5 - 10 minutes and it will be done when the peppers are done. Dice the pepper pieces if desired. Serve warm along with the peppers. Also great on a side of steamed veggies.

title: Pasteis De Coco (Coconut and Almond Chicken)
ingredients: 1 coconut oil ( or any lite oil ) | 1 teaspoon chicken fat ( or vegetable oil, for healthier alternative ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract, to taste
instructions: Combine 1teaspoon of coconut oil to 1 tsp of almond extract in a medium size bowl. Rinse your chicken well. Pour desired amount of marinade over the chicken and enjoy a nice snack.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,tomato,escarole,arborio rice,oregano leaf,stewing beef,blackberry,pork tenderloin
title: Baked Risotto With Sausage and Pork
ingredients: 7 cups hot beef broth | 1 lb lean pork tenderloin, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 large pork tenderloin, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 5 medium tomatoes, peeled and chopped | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 8 cups escarole, washed and well-curbed ( about 13 cups ) | 1/2 cup arborio rice | 1/4 cup sliced blackberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°. Combine beef broth and chopped pork in slow cooker. Mix in tenderloins. Press down to flatten. Add tomatoes, garlic paste, oregano, and 1 1/2 cups escarole. Cover and cook on high setting 3 to 4 hours or low setting 6 to 8 hours or until tender, stirring twice. Serve with remaining escarole sprinkled around the top. Note, if not preparing as quickly as you'd like, the meat can be cooked ahead and chilled. Ladle hot broth into a separate covered container or large baking pan. Drain meat mixture into another container or baking pan. Skim fat from broth. Bake, covered, 30 minutes to 1 hour, or until thickened. If too thick, thin with broth, if too thin, cook uncovered for last 8 to 10 minutes. Stir in blackberries during the last 3 minutes of baking. Serve sprinkled with additional cheese if desired.

title: Homemade Horseradish
ingredients: 100 g milk chocolate | 4 1/2 tablespoons white horseradish
instructions: Put the milk chocolate and horseradish into a microwave safe bowl, heat on high, stirring every 20 seconds, until smooth. Stir through all the remaining ingredients and store in a cool place for upto 2 months.

title: Lebanese Butter
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs unsalted butter | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon curry leaf | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and leave for 2 hours. Take a small handful of this mixture and spread it onto the counter top. Use your fingertips to break the lumps off of it and place it between your palms. Melt butter very slowly at 300 degrees f. Using a knitting needle, gently press the hole in your palm. If the holes do not appear clean, use the tips of fingers to press out any additional air bubbles. If you notice air bubbles, feel free to experiment with the amount of butter you use.

title: Spinach Triangles (Takes a few hours for diet and light snacks )
ingredients: 1/4 lb spinach | 2 leaves puff pastry | 5 whole buns ( or 4 rolls )
instructions: Cut spinach into strips or squares. Heat a dry frying pan. Add spinach, a dash of salt and a few sprinkles of white onion flavoring.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,meat chicken roast beef,cannellini bean,almond paste
title: Glorious Crock Pot Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs meat or 2 lbs stew meat, with bone | 2 cans cannellini beans, with liquid | 3 tablespoons almond paste | 2 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Put everything in the crock pot on high and cook on high for 3 - 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: crouton,no boil lasagna noodle,green bell pepper,radish,jalapeno pepper,bean sprout,phyllo dough,fruit
title: Fresh Vegetable Lasagna
ingredients: 4 cups assorted fresh vegetables ( such as cauliflower, onions and carrots ) | 1 can bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons diced green bell peppers | 2 tablespoons diced pickled jalapeno peppers | 1/4 cup crouton, or to taste | 1 sheet phyllo dough | 1/2 jar pickled fruit, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a 9 inch pie pan on a baking sheet. Arrange the vegetables in a layer in the pie pan, and top with sprouts, bell peppers and jalapeno pepper. In a small bowl, mix together the croutons, fruit and cilantro. Layer 2 more sheets of phyllo dough on top of the vegetables. Brush with some of the crumb mixture. Repeat layers until all the vegetables are in the pan. Cut slits in the top of the lasagna with a sharp knife. Cover with aluminum foil, and bake in the preheated oven until rolls are lightly browned, about 40 minutes.

title: French Quarter Shrimp Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp | 1 lb sirloin | 1 lb ground chuck ( you can also use ground sausage ) | 3/4 lb gouda cheese ( or cheese of your choice ) | 1/2 cup cognac ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon margarine
instructions: Dice the beef into bite sized pieces, and then set aside. Cube the shrimp. Cube and mix the shrimp, beef, and swiss cheese together in a bowl. Chill in the fridge while preparing the other ingredients. Divide the mixture into 8 portions, form each portion into a patty shape by squeezing around the edge of a patty with your fingers. Pan fry the patties in a saute pan, or a little lower heat and grill until golden brown. Add the cognac, allow to cool then serve. Note, you can do both patties to the individual portions, and then you can slice them into thin slices to serve.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,ice water,cream cheese,aubergine,chunky salsa,guacamole,baguette,sandwich bread
title: Mixed Vegetable Sandwiches with Cream Cheese
ingredients: 2 bags spinach leaves, washed and stemmed | 6 cups sandwich bread | 8 ounces low fat cream cheese | 1/2 aubergine, peeled and sliced into thin half moons | 1 cup frozen chunky salsa | 1 cup guacamole | 1/2 cup crushed ice water | 1 baguette
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Toast baguette with cooking oil spray. Spread 1/4 cup of sauce on baguette. Wrap baguette with spinach and then with foil and bake in oven for 8 minute meanwhile heat cream cheese in microwave or on stove top till melted. Layer each serving with half of the chunky salsa, half of the cheese mixture, the aubergine slices, and remaining salsa. Serve with toast.

Random Ingredients: hot noodle,mint leaf,yoghurt,cranberry,puff pastry,sesame seed,kaffir lime leaf,red wine
title: Nohut Naan Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot noodle, preferably tangy ( or other gluten-free dish ) | 1 package puff pastry sheets ( or plain plain or gluten-free flour ) | 1 tablespoon poppy seed ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried coriander leaves ( cilantro ) | 1/2 tablespoon dried mint leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 cup red wine ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons yoghurt ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons sour cream, mixed with milk ( optional )
instructions: Heat a fry pan over high heat, until very hot. Sprinkle the pepitas on the noodles, and turn to coat. As soon as they start to pop, quickly move them to the outer perimeter of the pan, moving them around so they don't splash. This will happen very quickly, especially with a wok or other object, so err on the cautious side of the instructions. As soon as it starts to puff, reduce the heat to low and allow the noodles to cook, turning occasionally, until all the liquid in the pan has evaporated and the noodles have expanded a little, about 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400°f with a knife at a diagonal, cut each sheet of puff pastry into 3 equal sized pieces. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or other non stick baking sheet. On a lightly floured surface, roll each piece of pastry into a circle about 10 inches by 5 inches, about 3/4 inch wide and 3/4 inch thick, and as thin as your finger can safely be from the edge of the pastry. Remove dough circles from sheets and place on prepared baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining dough, placing a few at a time between the two sheets. Spread 1 tablespoon of poppy seeds lightly on the flat side of each circle, along the edge farthest away from you. Sprinkle cilantro leaves, dried mint leaves, dried mint leaves, and red wine around the outside edge of each circle. Place a few drops of sesame oil on top of each circle. Bake in preheated oven, until puffed, golden, and just starting to brown, 15 to 18 minutes, depending on size and thickness of your noodles. When finished, transfer to a tea towel lined with tea towels.

title: Rice Pilaf With Dates and Almonds
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups long grain white rice, preferably long grain | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, lightly toasted and peeled
instructions: Place two cups of water, rice and slivered almonds in a medium saucepan and bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low. Simmer covered, until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, about 20 minutes. Allow to stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Transfer to a serving plate.

title: Spinach and Pineapple Empanadas
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained well | 1 cup thawed chopped pineapple, well drained | 2 egg yolks | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 cup fresh breadcrumb | 2 packages frozen puff pastry, thawed ( use thawed if previously defrosted ) | 1 cup fresh raspberry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Toss spinach, pineapple, egg yolks with garlic, and bread crumbs.

title: Spumoni
ingredients: 7 egg whites | 15 maraschino cherries, dried | bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Place egg whites in a bowl. Sprinkle on a couple of tablespoons of caster sugar and mix well. Add in the cherries. Add the bicarb soda. Mix well with your hands until all ingredients are evenly distributed. Roll out the dough onto a floured surface. Use a sharp knife to cut into rectangular shapes approximately 5 x 8 inches. Bread or cookies may be dipped into soda. Chill for 30 minutes for better texture and grip. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,baby portobello mushroom,vodka,linguine,red wine vinegar
title: Portobello Vodka Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb linguine, in thin, thin, uncooked, pieces ( i used barilla large shells ) | 16 baby portobello mushrooms, cleaned, washed and sliced ( i used baby portobello from the fridge ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar ( to taste ) | 1 jar picante sauce, not fat free ( i used vh ) | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Cook linguine in lightly salted water until al dente. Drain linguine and rinse with cold water. Combine linguine, mushrooms, vinegar, picante sauce, and vodka in a bowl, cover and refrigerate for another half hour. When ready to serve, toss and serve.

Random Ingredients: espresso,pasta,lime wedge,wheat flour,italian bread crumb,breadcrumb,ziti pasta
title: Chilled Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta, cooked and drained | 16 large ziti pasta | 1 jar espresso | 1/4 cup italian-style breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup toasted italian breadcrumb | lime wedge
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Spray a 13x9 pan with cooking spray. Stir well using a rubber spatula until pasta absorbs the marinade. Spread in a single layer and allow to stand until ready to use. Spread 1/4 cup of bread crumbs on a plate. Spread remainder in another plate. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on another plate. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on a plate. Dust the crumbs with bread crumbs. Press crumbs into the top. Chill in the fridge at least 4 hours. Cut into halves and serve with a lime wedge.

title: Lemon Meatball Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup panir | 1/2 cup meat, ground | 2 egg yolks | 12 slices lemon peel, 1-inch x 1/4-inch strips | 5 -10 fresh curry leaves or 3 -5 sprigs | 2 large bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Combine the meat, egg yolks, peel, curry leaves, water or milk in a mixing bowl and beat with an electric mixer. Use an ice cream scoop to roll 1/4 balls into small balls. Set the meatballs on a tray and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight. Cooking time is chilling time.

title: Polish Dumplings (Skuetska)
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 32 whole eggs | 24 egg yolks | 48 -40 stalks fresh dill ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon dried dill ( optional )
instructions: Put a large pot of water in the bottom of the stove to boil. Mix the two egg yolks together and set aside. Separate the whites from the yolks with a spoon, keeping yolks for later, and the whites kept separate separately. Beat whites until stiff. Beat egg whites. Break yolks into a bowl with a pinch of salt. Dip a wonton wrapper in the egg yolk, and gently roll it around it until it is completely covered. Melt 3 tbsp butter in a large skillet. Brown the won ton in the skillet, breaking it as it browns. Do not drain the oil. When it is browned, stir it a few times through the fried won ton. When the mixture is smooth, pour it into the bottom of a casserole dish. Put the dill and the fried won tons in the center of the dish. Put the eggs around the dish, and finish off with the 4 tbsp of melted butter. Bake at 350 degrees on medium heat for about 15 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek,active yeast,black olive,red shallot,thyme,sunflower oil,pork roast
title: Beef and Olive Pies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork roast, trimmed of fat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( may use nz pork or other dark meat ) | 3 red shallots, sliced | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/4 cup dried fenugreek | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 package active dry yeast | 1 can black olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a large, heatproof bowl, combine all of the ingredients apart from the olives and stir to combine. Cover and let stand in a warm place for about 1/2 hour, or until the mixture has formed a slightly doughy mass. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper or spray with waterproof baking spray. Turn out the dough onto a lightly floured surface and divide into 16 equal portions. Roll each portion into a sausage shape and place on the baking sheets. Place in the oven and cook for 15 minutes, or until golden brown all over. Remove from heat and spread the olives on top of each pie. Sprinkle with remaining fenugreek. Serve warm.

title: Bell Peppers Stuffed With Stuffing
ingredients: 2 large yellow bell peppers | 1 cup whole wheat breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Chop peppers and mix together in a bowl. Sprinkle bread crumbs over the top and mix together. Lightly sprinkle cinnamon over the mixture and mix together. Fill the peppers and wrap tightly with toothpicks. Place the stuffed peppers on a preheated grill with high heat. Grill for about 20 minutes turning occasionally.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,thyme sprig,lemon juice,chipotle chile adobo,beef tenderloin
title: Chipotle Grilled Beef Tenderloin(Diabetic Friendly)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped onion ( the kind that's sliced fairly thick ) | 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprigs | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle chile in adobo ( chopped or ground ) | 1 tablespoon dried minced onion soup mix ( i used 1/2 a packet )
instructions: To make the marinade, mix all ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend till smooth. Put tenderloin in large plastic bag. Pour marinade over top. Seal and marinate in fridge 2 hours, or freeze overnight. Preheat grill to high. Remove tenderloin, reserving marinade. Cook meat on grill, turning once, for about 6 minutes or till tenderloin is done. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: tofu,confectioner ' sugar,maple syrup,graham cracker crumb,rice noodle,beef cube,szechuan peppercorn
title: Chinese Takeout Tofu Balls
ingredients: 1/2 pound cooked rice noodles | 1 package firm tofu, drained and cubed | 6 ounces beef cubes, drained | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns, or to taste | 1 cup confectioners'sugar, divided | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 package graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place the rice noodles in a large bowl with enough water to cover. Soak to remove any excess water. Drain again. Cut tofu into 1/4 inch cubes. Add tofu, peppercorns and half of confectioners' sugar to the noodles, toss well. Fill a large bowl with ice water, and place the graham cracker crumbs in another large bowl. Dredge the tofu mixture in the graham cracker crumbs until coated. Place the tofu mixture in the refrigerator to chill, about 40 minutes. Melt the remaining confectioners' sugar in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring until smooth. Remove from heat, and stir in maple syrup. Set aside until serving. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and line all over with parchment paper. Place the tofu balls on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, turning frequently, until lightly browned.

title: Carnival Pork Twirls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry yeast | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 1/2 cups dark rum, warmed
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 50% of warm water. Rub the loins of pork with half of the rum, and add the rest. Allow to proof 10 - 12 hours in a cool place till doubled in size. Boil down the rest of the rum. Spread out each pork cutlets in a clean dish towel, and cover with new wrung out towel. Let double in size. Bake in a preheated 375f oven till they are browned. Serve with a sauce of your choice for dipping.

title: Dilly Swiss Cheese Steak
ingredients: 2 ounces thinly sliced corned beef | 1 slice swiss cheese | 2 teaspoons dried dill weed | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Line a plate with aluminum foil. Spread the corned beef onto the foil. Place onto the hot grill. Place swiss cheese over the corned beef and use the back of a fork to spread the herb and salt.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,basmati rice,noodle,gnocchi,spinach leaf,pie shell,orange blossom honey,rice flour
title: Gnocchi in Pastry
ingredients: 3 large uncooked noodles ( bihon noodles ) | 1 pint fresh spinach leaves | 1 medium pie shell, rolled out | 5 tablespoons rice flour | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup orange blossom honey | confectioners'sugar, for dusting | 1 -2 teaspoon orange blossom honey or 1 -2 teaspoon sambal oelek, for garnish | cooked asian sushi noodles ( optional ) or cooked asian noodles ( optional )
instructions: To make the crust, boil 4 quarts of water. Meanwhile, soak noodles until tender, about 20 minutes, then drain well. Preheat oven to 425°f. Cut a deep slit lengthwise down the center of each noodle, stopping just below root end. Place noodles in the bowl of a food processor and pulse until finely chopped. Add the spinach and pulse to a coarse paste over medium high heat. Remove from heat when spinach wilts, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a mixing bowl and stir in dough paste. To make glaze, using a pastry brush brush lightly brush onto noodles, then drizzle over top. Serve gnocchi sprinkled with confectioners' sugar and orange blossom honey.

title: Rinse and Wash the Peas and Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1 cup cleaned fresh peas or 1 cup frozen peas | 1/3 cup fresh crouton
instructions: Cook the peas in boiling water until partially defrosted and no longer transparent. Drain and let them cool until ready to use. Meanwhile in a wide and narrow sieve, press out the browned peas and rinse them well under cold water. The skins should be loosened. Remove the skin and discard discard. Chop the peas up into manageable bite size pieces. Place the peas in the food processor and pulse a few times to chop or pulse to the texture you want. Add the croutons and pulse just a few times to mix well, but watch out for the croutons they can burn easily. The peas can then be stirred into the croutons and passed through a food mill, or stirred back into the soup. Add more croutons if you like. If you don't like croutons, you can add a few drops of hot mustard to your soup mix to give it a smoother consistency. You can also add a bit of your favorite green chili sauce, or a dash of tabasco sauce to sharpen the flavors.

title: Easy Avocado Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 small avocado | 1 package chicken wings, split in half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake the chicken wings in the preheated oven just until they are crispy and beginning to brown, 20 to 30 minutes. While the chicken wings bake, prepare a bowl of mashed potatoes to serve alongside the chicken wings. Mash the avocado until chunky. Dip the chicken wings into the mashed avocado until they have been thoroughly coated. Arrange the fried chicken wings on a platter and top with the mashed potatoes. A traditional garnish is a sprinkling of chopped cilantro.

Random Ingredients: green onion,white peppercorn,cilantro,kidney bean,red pepper oil,sage leaf
title: Cassic Style Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dry kidney beans | 2 tablespoons red pepper oil | 3 green onions, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon white peppercorns, cracked ( or black pepper if you like ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage leaves or 1/4 teaspoon fresh sage, grated | 1 fresh cilantro, sprigs ( to garnish )
instructions: Rinse and drain beans. Place in heavy saucepan and cover with water.

title: Baby Blueberry Leeks
ingredients: 12 baby leeks | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 cup blueberries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Peel leeks and cut into medium sized chunks. Place in a large baking dish with a lid or rimmed foil. Wash blueberries and place on top of leeks. Pour the chili sauce on top of leeks. Cover and bake for 45 to 50 minutes. Uncover and bake for another 15 minutes to thicken the sauce and allow even coloring.

title: Zucchini Rice With Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice, uncooked | 12 medium zucchini, trimmed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a heavy medium pot. Remove from heat.

title: Kielbasa (Kielbasa with Pear Sauce)
ingredients: 1 package turkey kielbasa ( or other hot or sweet sausage links ) or ( 9 ounce ) package kielbasa, cut into 4 pieces ( or other hot or sweet sausage links ) | 1 jar pimento pepper, chopped ( pimento stuffed peppers, also known as chile de arbol, available at latin markets ) | 1 cup dried pimento pepper, cut into 4 squares | 1 tablespoon cayenne ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups chopped pears
instructions: Slice or dice the kielbasa and saute in a skillet over medium heat until golden brown and crispy. About 12 - 15 minutes. While the sausage is cooking, rinse pimentos in cold water, drain, and dry well. Return sausage to skillet, and add pimento, peppers, cayenne/hot sauce, and pears. Stir well, and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve warm, or refrigerate the kielbasa mixture until it is cold.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,red curry paste,tomato green chilies,chili flake,green chilies,green bell pepper
title: Hot and Hot Sourribs
ingredients: 2 lbs skinless side pork ribs ( such as leg or drumsticks ) | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 cup red curry paste | 1/2 cup chopped green chilies ( i like thai chilies ) | 1 large green bell pepper, cut into 1/2 inch thick | 4 canned diced tomatoes and green chilies
instructions: Place ribs in large pot. Sprinkle with five spice powder. Stirring well. Add curry paste and chilies. Cover. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes. Add peppers and continue cooking for 30 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,butter,water,sun tomato pesto,yellow pepper,monterey jack cheese,fish sauce
title: Pesto Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato pesto | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 packages shredded monterey jack cheese ( about 6 cups ) | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 1 can water | 1 -2 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 -3 small yellow peppers, cut into 1/2-inch strips
instructions: To make the pesto sauce, mix together the sun dried tomato pesto and butter until creamy.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive,alfredo sauce,lemonade,mascarpone cheese,corn oil,gruyere cheese
title: Grilled French-Style Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 1 baguette ( about 1-1/2 inches in diameter ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 3 cups mascarpone cheese, at room temperature | 1 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 jar spanish olives, drained and patted dry | 1 jar lemonade, chilled or 1 -4 cup homemade lemonade, heated | 16 ounces alfredo sauce
instructions: Brush oven rack with corn oil and place it on a baking sheet. Place in the freezer until firm, about 20 minutes. Using a sharp knife, score the crusts of the baguette. Brush each with corn oil and sprinkle with a little salt and pepper. Set aside. Preheat grill to high. Place the cheese and half of the olives in a bowl. Using a rubber spatula, spread the mascarpone cheese across the cheese. Grate in half of the gruyere cheese blend. Add the olive jar with lemonade and remaining olives. Toss with the cheese and remaining gruyere cheese blend. Grill bread with the lid closed until golden crusty around the edges, about 10 to 15 minutes. Remove to the cutting board, cut into quarters and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: hot chili pepper,white cake mix,mint sprig,self raising flour,garlic clove
title: Nanaimo's Mint Bundle
ingredients: 1 box white cake mix | 1 1/2 cups green mint sprigs ( optional ) | 1/4 cup minced hot chili pepper | 1 garlic clove ( minced or crushed ) | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour ( to sprinkle on top )
instructions: Preheat oven at 180c or 350f. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl and add about 1/2 cup of water to make a thin batter. Spoon the batter into muffin pans, sprinkle tops of floured fingers with the rest of the water. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes until a knife inserted into the centre comes out clean. Cool on wire rack. When cool you can then slice into rounds and serve with fresh mint if desired.

title: Scotch Broche
ingredients: 1 kg beef brisket | 3 teaspoons dried yeast | 1 cup warm apricot puree | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 cup frozen grapes
instructions: Pre heat oven to 140c/300f/gas place brisket in a large roasting tin. Rub with 2 teaspoons of dry yeast. Pour the apricot puree on it and pour around the brisket. Sprinkle over the flour. Mix the cream with the rest of the dry yeast and spread on top. Cover with a sheet of baking parchment. Place in the oven and cook for 1 hour, until meat is cooked. Remove from heat and leave to rest in a warm place for an hour. Cut meat if necessary and spoon some juices over it. Return to the oven for a further 20 minutes to crisp, crisp and golden on top. Serve with mashed potatoes or salad leaves.

title: Worth the Work?
ingredients: 2/3 cup kalamata olives, pitted | 1 1/2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Cut a 1/2 inch slice off each end of the olives, just below the top, if they don't have stems, they can be cut with scissors. If using scissors, remove the ends of each piece. Combine the olives, worcestershire sauce, and poultry seasoning in a small bowl.

title: Chilled Vegetarian and Dill Pickle Risotto
ingredients: 250 g arborio rice | 500 ml double cream | 3 cups mixed vegetables, diced ( such as broccoli, cauliflower, zucchini, cauliflower, broccoli sprouts and carrots ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 2 teaspoons pickle relish | 2 teaspoons grated kefalotiri or 2 teaspoons sliced pickle cheese
instructions: Place rice in a bowl, pour boiling hot water over to cover, then leave to stand for 1 hour. Meanwhile, place cream in small pan over medium heat, add vegetables and cayenne and heat gently, stirring often. Stir into rice. Season with salt and pepper, to taste, and then leave until liquid is absorbed. Heat a large frying pan, add veg, spread on paper plate, then grill, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Melt cheese, stir through risotto, then heat through.

title: Moroccan Spice Blend for Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 3 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 green pepper, seeded and thinly sliced
instructions: Roast the fennel seeds for about 3 minutes in 350f oven. Combine the fennel and spices in a mortar and pound with pestle until a fine powder forms. Transfer the spices to a bowl and let sit for about 20 minutes. Add the green pepper slices and toss to coat. Store the mixture in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,pineapple chunk,serrano chilies,marjoram,dark brown sugar,chicken breast half
title: Fiesta Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup dried onion flakes, minced | 2 tablespoons dried minced serrano chilies | 2 teaspoons dried minced marjoram | 1 1/2 cups pineapple chunks, drained ( canned ) | 1 cup heavy brown sugar
instructions: Pound chicken to 1/4 inch thickness. Combine onion powder, chiles, marjoram and pineapple. Sprinkle half of salt and black pepper over chicken, and dredge with onion mixture. Place in baking dish. Combine sugar and remaining salt and pepper. Sprinkle over chicken. Bake at 375 degrees for 45 minute.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,turkey bacon,vanilla bean,orange juice
title: Pico de Gallo
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pico de gallo | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup skim milk | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 6 slices turkey bacon ( thin slices )
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients in a noncorrosive bowl until smooth and well blended. Place the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat. Discard the skin, but do not cook. Place spoonfuls of the mixture in the skillet and cook on all sides until crisp and brown, 3 - 5 minutes per side. Serve at once.

title: Pasteles De Suèdoises Me Mandarinas Negros
ingredients: 4 bunches fresh asparagus | 1 cup chopped asparagus tip ( a mix of green and young asparagus ) | 1 cup mandarin oranges or 1 cup mandarin segments, drained | 8 drops chili | 1/2 - 1 cup caster sugar | 3 drops rosemary, or more if desired
instructions: Trim the ends of the asparagus and cut the asparagus tips into 1/4 thick slices, set aside. Place the asparagus tips in a bowl, cover with warm water. Set aside. In a saucepan over a medium heat, add the orange and mint leaves which are chopped, stir in the chillies and sugar until dissolved. Stir the asparagus tips into the sauce and cook until they are just tender, about 3 minutes. Strain the asparagus tips and serve the mix with the orange and mint.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,pork shoulder,palm sugar,peanut butter,pear,milk chocolate,oil,hot italian sausage
title: Korean Pork Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup evaporated milk chocolate | 2/3 cup peanut butter | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 hot italian sausage, sliced | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 large pear, peeled and cored and thinly sliced
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the pork with the chocolate milk, peanut butter, sugar, and oil. Refrigerate for 2 to 6 hours, tossing a few times. Arrange the lettuce in a large salad bowl. Top with the pork mixture and pear slices.

title: Molho (Stuffed Rye Bread )
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs whole rye bread | 2 slices prosciutto, very thin ( or more if desired ) | 1/4 cup white rum ( such as mounded or tawny ) | 6 small tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Cut a slit in each piece of bread to form a pocket. Place the bread, proscuitto, and rum into a large bowl. Spoon equal amounts of rum mixture onto each bread pocket. Insert a slice of prosciutto onto each bread pocket, then reshape the loaf around the prosciutto and prosciutto. Wrap with cheesecloth, place on a baking sheet or foil, and bake for 15 minutes or until bread is puffed up and crumbly. Remove from oven, top with 2 or 3 slices of prosciutto, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken base,herb stuffing mix,chuck roast,pastry shell,chicken thigh,cider vinegar,white bean
title: Beef, White Bean & Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs chuck roast | 1 3/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 package herb stuffing mix | 1 tablespoon instant chicken base | 1 bottle cider vinegar | 1 can white beans, rinsed | pastry shells, refrigerated if necessary
instructions: Cut chuck roast in half, put meat into crock pot. Place thighs on top of meat. Add stuffing mix with chicken base, chicken, cider vinegar and white beans. Put lid on crockpot. Cook on low for at least 6 hours. When ready to serve, remove from crockpot and cut into squares about 3/4 inch thick. To serve, serve the bitesize squares on a plate with toothpicks.

title: Angel Hair Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta ( short tube shaped spiral is traditional ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup or ( 10 ounce ) can cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until just al dente. Once pasta is cooked drain the pasta and return it from the pot and add the mushroom soup or cream of mushroom soup, and heat. Drain pasta thoroughly and return to pot. Serve warm or cold.

title: Cheesecloth Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs mushrooms stems, sliced | 2 tablespoons cheesecloth, drained | 2 -3 tablespoons grated cheese cheese ( optional )
instructions: Pack the mushroom caps tightly, tightly. Wrap each mushroom cap with cheesecloth. Securely. Refrigerate for up to a month. Place a heavy frypan over high heat. When a cube of bread turns golden brown, quickly dip the mushrooms into the browned bread, drain on paper towels and serve.

title: Prosciutto-Wrapped Pear Pastries
ingredients: 2 ripe pears | 1/8 - 1/4 lb prosciutto di parma | 8 slices olive | 1/4 cup sweet pepper | 1/4 cup rye flour
instructions: Cut pears into thin slices, removing the pit, and then slice slices thinly. If the prosciutto is very thin, you may want to cut it in 2 or 3 pieces. In a bowl, combine the prosciutto, olives and sweet sweet pepper.

title: Mandarin Poppy Seed Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup white flour | 1/2 cup coriander seed | 1 container mandarin oranges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a spice grinder or an electric coffee grinder, grind coriander seeds until fine. In a small bowl mix flour and coriander, using 1/4 cup water. Stir in oranges. Drop mixture by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased cookie sheets, 1 inch apart. Bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cool 2 minutes. Transfer to an airtight container. Keep cookies in an airtight container in a cool dry place until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: nonfat plain yogurt,tomato green chile pepper,hard egg,lentil,phyllo dough,leek,ha avocado,broiler fryer chicken
title: Lentil Tart
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, cut into pieces | 1 cup dry lentils | 1 leek, thinly sliced | 1 green chile pepper, minced | 2 large tomatoes with green chile peppers, chopped | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce, or as desired | 1/4 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced | 10 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 5 tablespoons nonfat plain yogurt
instructions: Place chicken into the pan of a food processor with 2 cups water, lentils, lemon grass, chile pepper, tomatoes, 1/2 cup lettuce, 1/4 cup yogurt, and the hard cooked egg. Pulse about 30 times.

title: Frozen Yellow Sweet bell peppers
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple in juice, drained | 1 can yellow bell peppers, finely chopped
instructions: Place bell peppers, drained pineapple, and chopped yellow onion and canned pineapple juice into a blender. Cover and blend on high 5 minutes, or until a chunky slurry appears.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,sesame oil,yeast,dark chocolate chip,turmeric powder,shrimp
title: Dark South Chilli Shrimp (Chilli Dogs)
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg whole shrimps ( raw ) | 2 -3 tablespoons chili oil | 3 teaspoons ground turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon salt | 3 slices dark chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon dry yeast
instructions: Mix the chili oil, tumeric powder and salt together in a glass bowl and pour over the raw shrimp. Leave in the fridge for about 45 mins to an hour. Invert onto a damp towel and rub down the shrimp. Leave to drain for 10 - 15 mins so it will become sticky. Remove the shrimp from the fridge and pat dry. Take four ramekin's, dip each ramekin in sesame oil and sprinkle with a good handful of dark chocolate chips, spread a good quantity of dark chilli chilli on each ramekin's lid and seal them by squeezing to make space for the heat. Use as per instructions on the tins. When ready to eat, take the shrimp out and place on a paper towel to soak up the sauce. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Nadia's Famous Potato Salad
ingredients: baking potato ( about 1-1/2 inches in diameter ) | 3/4 cup golden syrup | 2 green peppers, thinly sliced | 1 small beet, peeled, very thinly sliced | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Place potatoes in pot, cover with cold water, and bring to boil. When potatoes are tender, drain. While the potatoes are boiling, cut green peppers into thin slices and cut beet into matchstick size peices. When potatoes are done, drain, and peel if desired.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,rice,tomato paste,banana pepper,sauerkraut,russet potato,sauce
title: Simply Delicious Sauerkraut Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds sauerkraut, drained | 6 russet potatoes, peeled and cubed | 3 large bananas pepper, sliced | 1 can tomato paste | 3/4 cup sweet and sour sauce | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | cooked rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the sauerkraut, and cook until the sauerkraut has softened, about 15 minutes. Drain well in a colander, and run the vegetables under cold water until they're cold enough to handle, about five minutes. Drain. Rinse out the pot, and return to the oven. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the potatoes, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Place the banana peppers and tomato paste in a large bowl, and mash until lumpy. Stir in the sweet and sour sauce. Transfer the puree to a large casserole dish, and sprinkle top with the parmigiano reggiano cheese. Set on medium high in the preheated oven, and bake for 30 minutes. Stir once halfway through. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: pear,self raising flour,vanilla sugar,sharp cheddar cheese,pistachio nut,jarlsberg cheese
title: Baked Pear and Cheese Scrolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour, plus extra for dusting | 150 g sharp cheddar cheese | 2/3 cup shelled roasted unsalted pistachio nuts, chopped | 1/2 cup pickled jarlsberg cheese, finely grated | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 2 cups pears, skinned, cored and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Lightly grease a shallow 2lb shallow ovenproof baking dish. Sift flour into a large bowl, gradually whisk in 100ml cold water, and then stir in theheddar. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in the pistachios, jarlsberg cheese and vanilla sugar. Using 2 3mm round scone trays, transfer dough so it fits the recesses of the dish. Brush or spray the dough with oil and bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until golden. Cool on the wire rack. Using a thin sharp knife, slice through the dough to create eight 12 x 20 cm long squares, or 8 x 8 cm square strips. Transfer to a baking sheet covered in baking paper and freeze until firm, about two hours. Place the pears in a small bowl. Sprinkle with remaining 100g of the cheese and toss gently to coat. Spoon the pear mixture into 4 glasses, then top with the toasted bread rounds or squares. Dust tops of scrolls with the reserved cheese. Cut into wedges.

title: Beef Rolls - Vegetarian!
ingredients: 3/4 lb thinly sliced beef top round steak | 3/4 lb assorted frozen vegetables | 1 1/2 2 cups fresh bean sprouts or 1 1/2 cups chopped mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup textured vegetable protein ( or rice flour ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 sheet nori ( dry seaweed, each cut lengthwise into 3 pieces ) | prepared herb ( optional ) | 3/4 cup vegetable stock or 3/4 cup chicken stock
instructions: Slice steak lengthwise into thin strips about 1/2 inch wide. Wash and dry veggies. Place beef and vegetables in shallow glass dish. Sprinkle meat, vegetables and protein with baking soda. Cover and marinate at room temperature 1 - 6 hours or refrigerate up to several days. Preheat oven to 300°f. Remove beef from liquid and place on an oiled baking sheet. Bake, covered, for 30 - 45 minutes until steak is cooked through. Meanwhile, place cellophane on a microwave safe plate, cover with microwave safe cling wrap, and heat on high, 100% power for 1 minute or until soft and transparent. Pour cellophane over and mix to dissolve. Set aside for 5 minutes or until cool completely. Meanwhile, place torn seaweed or plastic wrap on a cutting board and carefully break into very fine grains with your fingers. Place seaweed or plastic wrap on cutting board and use scissors or razor blade to flatten. Spread cellophane across seaweed lightly. Cut strips lengthwise into 3 strips, about 3 3/4 inches long and about 3/4 inch wide. Cut each strip crosswise into very thin strips measuring 1 1/2 inches wide. Place a few strips on a flat surface. Roll each strip into a 4 inch log using rolling pin. Place 2 to 3 pieces of the veg on each roll. Wrap and tie to form a roll. Place in one or more shallow metal pans. Cover with a damp kitchen towel and microwave on high power for 10 - 13 minutes or until heated through and veggies are crisp. Serve with prepared herb and broth.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,mango chutney,marsala wine,penne,cherry tomato,chunky salsa
title: Quick Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 8 ounces penne | 1 can small cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 1 can mango chutney, undrained
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine raisins, marsala wine, and salsa. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to medium low. Simmer 40 minutes. While it simmers, cook pasta. When pasta is done, drain excess water, and place in a large bowl. Add cooked pasta, tomatoes, and chutney. Mix well. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,red wine vinegar,black currant jam,basmati rice
title: Charoses and Rice Salad With Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 1/2 cup seedless red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup black currant jam | 2 whole cardamom pods | 1 1/4 cups basmati rice, steamed, hot, for 15min
instructions: Toast the cardamom pods and discard their husks. Place the rice in a bowl, add the vinegar, rum and the black coffee brew and stir quickly. Pour the liquid over the rice and chill in the fridge 1hour or so, and then serve cold.

title: Mom's Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 6 cups shredded chinese cabbage ( about 12 ounces total ) | 1/2 medium celery, diced ( about 1 cup ) | 2 tablespoons chopped celery leaves | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning ( or to taste i prefer it ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: In a large serving bowl toss together cabbage, celery, and seasonings. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: elbow macaroni,orange peel,brown mustard seed,allspice,burgundy wine,mung bean,vegetable
title: English Mung Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup red burgundy wine | 1/2 cup dried mung beans | 1/2 cup assorted fresh vegetables, chopped | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1/4 cup finely diced peeled orange peel | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 1/2 cups elbow macaroni, cooked | vegetable broth ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Bring wine, beans and vegetables to boil in a medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,puff pastry,butter,green chili pepper,avocado,vanilla bean,hazelnut,rutabaga
title: Indian Avocado and Cream Twister
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 1 lb rutabaga, peeled and seeded ( or other sweet potato ) | 1 yellow green chili pepper, seeded | 1 large ripe avocado, pitted | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 medium avocado, chopped ( or 1/2 cup sweet potato, peeled ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons hazelnuts, toasted | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla beans ( optional )
instructions: Melt butter in a 12″ nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add rutabaga and cook, stirring occasionally, until rutabaga is just tender, about 8 - 10 minutes. Stir in chile, avocado, and poultry seasoning. Cut avocado and hazelnuts in half, then cut crosswise into thin slices. Return to pan. Cook, stirring, until squash is heated through and beginning to crisp, about 3 minutes. Stir in vanilla and serve hot or warm.

title: Mango Beef Rib Stew With Fresh Squash
ingredients: 2 medium winter squash, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 can or bottle san marzano tomatoes, stewed with 1 1/2 cups of water | 1 pound boneless beef ribs, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 large mango, cut into 3/4-inch chunks, cut in quarters
instructions: Prepare a medium high fire or medium high heat outdoor grill for direct cooking. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan, place over medium heat and cook until squash is tender, stirring occasionally, approximately about 1 hour. Cool completely, pour into a freezer bag and freeze until ready to use. To serve, place in a large resealable freezer bag. Seal, label and vent. Reheat and reheat under normal times.

Random Ingredients: green olive,orange sherbet,basil leaf,carrot,caraway seed,crouton,phyllo pastry,ice
title: Chef John's Orange Salad
ingredients: 20 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 1 cup ice, or as needed | 3 carrots, grated | 1 package green olives, sliced | 8 ounces orange sherbet | 1 package shredded carrot | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds, or to taste | 2 tablespoons freshly torn basil leaves, or as desired
instructions: Place phyllo pastry sheets on a work surface, and cut in half horizontally. Stack 8 sheets on top of one another, then cut in half again to cover the entire bottom half of the pastry sheets. Repeat the stack of phyllo sheets with the remaining pastry in a 2 quart casserole dish. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Mix green olives, orange sherbet, chopped carrot, and caraway seeds together in a large bowl. Gently place 1 phyllo sheet in the bottom of your prepared casserole dish. Top with about a third of the olives/sour cream mixture. Continue layering phyllo sheets, olives, and the sour cream mixture until the filling is used up, finishing with about 3 phyllo sheets on top, using 1/2 cup of the filling per sheet. Cut the remaining sheets in half diagonally to make small squares. Remove plastic wrap, sprinkle with basil leaves, and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Creamy Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup short-grain white rice | 1 chicken stock cube | 1/4 cup light soymilk ( to taste )
instructions: Place the rice in a rice cooker, pour in the stock cube, add your soy milk and stir until all the liquid has been absorbed. Turn on the rice cooker, press go and let the liquid cook through until your meal is ready.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,self rising flour,salt black pepper
title: Cape Breton Beef
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 pounds beef chuck roast, trimmed | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine self rising flour and salt together in a large bowl. Pat beef dry with paper towels. Cut slits across the top of the beef, taking care not to cut into too much of the flour. Dredge beef in flour mixture to coat, shaking off any excess. Place beef in a baking dish. Roast beef in preheated oven until very tender, about 90 minutes. Allow to cool, then discard fat and bones. Shred meat using a fork.

title: Homemade Sour Cream Dressing
ingredients: 3/4 cup single cream | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup green pepper, chopped | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Process in a food processor for 15 seconds. Store in a container with a tight fitting lid.

Random Ingredients: chive,sherry,mango syrup,baby spinach,balsamic vinegar,red food coloring,italian seasoning mix
title: Mango Zest
ingredients: 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup mango syrup | 4 teaspoons good italian seasoning mix | 1 package fresh baby spinach | 1 -2 teaspoon red food coloring | 1 teaspoon chopped chives | 1/4 cup sweet sherry
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Refrigerate until ready to use. When ready to serve remove spinach from bag and toss with desired sauce. Enjoy.

title: Polish Sausage Chicken and Polish Sausage Pizza
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken breasts, thawed if frozen | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon granulated sugar | 1 package frozen polish sausage, thawed | prepared pizza crust, for your favorite type of pizzas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f lightly spray a grill pan with non stick cooking spray. Thaw chicken breasts if frozen. Combine horseradish, sugar and sausage in a medium bowl. Spread sausage mixture over both sides of chicken breasts. Place chicken in the pizza pan. Bake for 10 - 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cover to keep warm. Bake for approximately 5 to 10 minutes until chicken is cooked through and crust is golden brown, brushing with leftover horseradish mixture during the last ten minutes of cooking. Serve with remaining horseradish sauce for dipping.

title: Refried Beans - Diabetic Friendly
ingredients: 1 cup canned black beans, drained | 1 1/2 cups skim milk | 2 large fresh basil leaves ( or 1 t dried basil leaves )
instructions: Put the beans in a saucepan and pour enough water to cover the beans by 1/2 inch or so. Boil, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender, around 5 minutes.

title: Easy Taco Ole Topping
ingredients: 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons green olives
instructions: Mix all together. This freezes really well.

title: Chile Colorado
ingredients: 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 4 onions, minced | 1 can chopped birds chiles, undrained | 1/2 cup broth | 4 slices bacon bits
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Stir the flour into the onions, and continue to cook and stir over medium heat until the garlic turns a deep amber color, about 10 minutes. Stir in the chilies and their broth. Cook one minute, stirring constantly. Arrange the bacon bits on top.

title: Korean-Style Short-ribs
ingredients: 2 lbs beef short ribs ( about 2 1/4 to 2 1/2 inches long ) | 1 ounce small peeled snap pea ( about 24 cups ) | 1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce or 1/2 cup fish sauce
instructions: Soak short ribs in cold water 30 minutes. Drain. Cover 2 or 3 layers of heavy duty foil well with heavy coating of cooking spray. Working quickly, place short ribs on foil.

title: Breaded Vegetables
ingredients: 1 zucchini, 1/2-inch dice | 1 okra, 1/2-inch dice | 3 slices pancetta, chopped | pancetta ( one slice for each ) or bacon, diced ( one slice for each ) | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar or 1 tablespoon water | 2 hard-cooked eggs, peeled and quartered
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Combine zucchini, okra, bacon, oil, or bacon fat, pancetta and cider vinegar, season with salt and pepper. Cook about 5 1/2 minutes, stirring occasionally, then transfer to a baking sheet cut side up. Bake until tender and lightly browned, 20 to 25 minutes. Break into bite sized pieces with a spatula.

title: Italian Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 2 cans small beans | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Add stewed tomatoes, beans, broth. Heat through. Enjoy.

title: Sour  Black Olives. (Salad)
ingredients: 12 ounces canned pineapple chunks, drained | 12 ounces canned black olives, drained | 4 teaspoons pickapeppa sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes, toss and serve.

Random Ingredients: potato,garlic paste,ginger paste,grape tomato,taco seasoning,tomato sauce,grain rice
title: Tomato Rice Indian Style
ingredients: 1 large potato, chopped | 1 can crushed tomatoes | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground ginger and ginger paste | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 cup long grain rice
instructions: Saute diced potato in a skillet over medium heat until nicely browned. Put in all other ingredients and mix until well combined. Turn heat to low and cover. Simmer over medium low heat until potatoes are soft and all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Turn temperature off and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: tamari,pecan,celery rib,parmigiano,seasoning salt,new mexico chile powder
title: Tajine De Nuez (Mexican Stuffing)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons new mexico chile powder | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 1/2 - 2 cups coarsely chopped pecans | 3 celery ribs, chopped | 1 1/2 cups finely grated parmigiano, divided
instructions: Combine chile powder, tamari, and seasoned salt in a small bowl. Dry well pecans on paper towels. Combine pecans, celery, and 1/4 cup parmigiano in separate bowl. Stir in 1/4 cup pecan mixture. Stuff vegetables. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup parmigiano over top. Cover with dampened paper towels, and refrigerate, loosely covered, for at least 2 hour. Remove paper towels before serving.

title: Auntie Anita's Nests
ingredients: 8 -10 cups flour | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Combine the flour, cocoa powder, margarine and sugar in a large bowl. Add enough cold water so that the dough is not very sticky. Knead dough on a floured surface until smooth and silky, about 10 minutes. Form into a ball. Roll out thinly between two pieces of wax paper. Cut the dough into strips 3 inches wide and 2 to 4 inches wide. Working quickly, place a strip of pastry at the narrow end and gather up the other side until it is in a spiral 3 inches long and 2 to 3 inches wide. Working quickly, lower the spiral and continue to work the dough with the hands to produce long fingers. Cut strips into strips about the width of your peanut butter, and place about one third of the strips at a time on top of each other. Repeat with the remaining strips of pastry and peanut butter. Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat and add about 2 tablespoons of butter. Cook the nests on both sides until golden, but not burnt. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Repeat the same process until all nests have been cooked. Dust each nclair with powdered sugar before serving.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,heavy cream,baby spinach,lemon,rye bread,kosher salt black pepper,cream chicken soup,baby green
title: Creamy Spinach French Onion Soup #RSC
ingredients: 24 inches flour tortillas | 2 pounds baby spinach, chopped - rinsed, dried and chopped | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can light cream of chicken soup | 6 green onions, chopped | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 10 ounces baby greens | 1 lemon - cut into wedges, for garnish
instructions: Preheat New York oven to 425 degrees f. Place the tortillas into a baking dish. Bake for 5 to 10 minutes, or until evenly dark. Remove from oven, and cut into 20 squares. Set aside. Place half the spinach into food processor, and process until finely chopped, but not grainy. In a bowl, mix the spinach, cream of chicken soup, green onion and seasoning with kosher salt, pepper and a small amount of water to blend. Spread the mixture evenly evenly over 1/2 of the tortillas, then cover with 3 more tortillas, and repeat the layers. Top with remaining 2 tortillas, then cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until warmed through and bubbly, 30 to 40 minutes. Serve garnished with lemon wedges.

title: Arepas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 2 tablespoons flaked coconut
instructions: Heat the oil in a non stick frying pan. Mix together all of the ingredients well, and cook over low heat for 5 - 10 minutes, until golden brown and crisp on the edges. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,chinese duck sauce,sage,chicken wing,chuck,sherry wine,white chocolate baking square
