title: Sticky Chinese Duck
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 lb chicken wings | 8 ounces white chocolate baking squares | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup chinese duck sauce | 1 teaspoon sage | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and lightly mix well. Put mixture in a resealable gallon freezer bag with the corner cut off. Place air tight plastic wrap directly on mixture in bag and marinate in refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours. Bring mixture to room temperature and remove plastic wrap. After 1 to 1 1/2 hours, remove meat mixture from bag and using hands form into 12 meatballs by gently pulling meat back into remaining marinade in bag. Serve with noodles, rice, or pasta.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,ghee,tamari,red kidney bean,coconut,genoa salami,taco sauce
title: Taco Salad With Coconut & Salami
ingredients: 250 g clear honey-flavoured refried beans | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 8 slices genoa salami | 1 tablespoon tamari | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 1 tablespoon tamari | 4 teaspoons olive oil or 4 teaspoons peanut oil | your favourite taco sauce
instructions: To make the dressing combine ingredients and set aside until needed. To make the salad combine everything in a large bowl with the beans & coconut. Stir well before serving. Garnish with the salami slices & serve.

title: Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 tablespoons flour | 1 fresh jalapeno chilies, minced or can jalapeno chilies | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 cups vegetable broth | 1 package ditalini, uncooked | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine flour, chiles, and salt in a medium saucepan. Heat until lightly browned, stirring frequently. Add vegetable broth. Cover and simmer on low heat, stirring occasionally for 20 minutes or until thickened. Add pasta and cheddar cheese. Cook 2 minutes on medium heat, stirring frequently until cheese melts.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,purpose flour,vegetable stock,molasses,peppermint extract,black pepper,anaheim chilies
title: Chile Peppermint Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup beef broth | 1 cup prepared roasted peppers and chilies, drained and chopped | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup molasses | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon peppermint extract | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground black pepper
instructions: In a large bowl, combine broth, pepper and chilies, and vegetable stock. Mix thoroughly.

title: Puerto Rican Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs corned beef brisket | 12 ounces beer | 2 pinches ground ancho pepper | 1 small turnip, peeled and diced and deveined | 12 -16 medium pimento stuffed olives and pimentos ( or any canned pimentons ), coarsely chopped | 1 cup sour cream ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed nut ( optional )
instructions: Place brisket, fat side up, on rack in roasting pan, fat side up. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour. Combine beer, pepper and tomatoes in large skillet and heat to boiling over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low and cook brisket for 1 hour. Place corned beef on rack in roasting pan. Discard accumulated fat and pan juices. Pour beer mixture over brisket. Cover pan tightly and roast in 425°f oven for 1 hour, or until brisket is fork tender. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing and serving.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,sugar substitute,saffron,spinach,icing sugar,lump crabmeat,okra
title: Chilled Beef and Okra Salad With Crab-And-Shrimps
ingredients: 1 lb fresh okra | 1 lb fresh lump crabmeat | 8 ounces frozen spinach | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, trimmed and cut into chunks | icing sugar
instructions: Cut okra crosswise into 1/2 to 1/2 inch slices. Place in a steamer basket and cover with water. Set over a pot of simmering water. Allow to cook about 3 to 5 minutes until the okra is thawed. Drain. Place remaining ingredients in a 1 1/2 to 2 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, on low for 4 to 5 hours, or until okra meat is very tender and sauce is reduced to a thick sauce. Remove from heat and stir in the okra just before serving. If the meat loses its red color, refrigerate overnight and reheat. Serve over steamed pasta, topped generously with icing sugar.

Random Ingredients: mango,pecorino romano cheese,celery rib,caraway seed,wild rice,sauce,bell pepper
title: Caraway Wild Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice | 0.667 can sweet onions ( with 1/3 of can ) | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 2 medium sweet bell peppers ( orange and yellow ) | 1 mango ( or other tropical fruit ) | 1/3 cup hot sauce
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package directions. Cool and drain rice. Add remaining ingredients, except hot sauce and stir to mix well.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper seasoning,porcini mushroom,chunky salsa,cooking oil,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Sandy's Best Ever Herbed Cheese
ingredients: 3 containers chunky salsa ( we prefer pace medium ) | 2 jars bottled chunky salsa ( we've used pace medium ) | 3/4 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper seasoning ( or to taste ) | 4 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: In a large bowl, combine 1/2 cup salsa, 3/4 cup salsa, parsley, lemon pepper seasoning, and 1/2 cup oil.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,french green bean,mexican cheese,golden delicious apple,colby monterey jack cheese,couscous,apple
title: Green Bean and Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 bag frozen french style green beans, thawed | 1 small golden delicious apple, unpeeled, sliced and chopped | 7 ounces baby spinach leaves, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup cubed colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup diced drained canned hot italian-style cheese blend | 1/2 cup dry instant couscous
instructions: Cook green beans according to package directions to pok. Meanwhile, place apple and spinach in a medium nonstick skillet.

title: Mango Mashed Potato Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 can mangoes, drained | 2 tablespoons maple flavored syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons canned instant coffee beans | 2 teaspoons limeade concentrate | 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 whole potato, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: In a blender or food processor combine the mangoes, syrup, and coffee beans. Puree until smooth. Line a serving platter with lettuce leaves, and spoon the banana mango mixture into the center. Top with potato slices.

Random Ingredients: french haricot vert,wine vinegar,grain white rice,orange marmalade
title: Haricots Verts and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice or 1 cup carnaroli rice | 1 can french haricots vert, including the liquid | 1/3 cup orange marmalade | 1/3 cup wine vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot. Bring to boil, cover, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer 25 to 35 minutes, or until a knife can be inserted and rice is tender.

title: Chile Pured Pork (Puerco Com Molcón Salsa Com Molcajete)
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, about 3 1/2 pounds | 1/2 cup kirsch | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 fresh red and green chili peppers, chopped ( or to taste )
instructions: Trim all visible fat from the meat, making sure you remove any thick strings or strings attached to the skin. Make slits all around the meat with a sharp knife. Stuff the kirsch into the slits so that the meat will absorb the kirsch. Place the pork in a pot, and add enough lightly salted water to cover by 1 inch or up to 1 inch above the meat. The water should be at lease about 2 - 3 inches above the level of the skin of the pork. Put the pot over high heat, cover, and bring the water level to a boil. Cook for about an hour, skimming the foam that rises to the surface frequently as it boils down. Remove the cover, and continue cooking for 30 minutes, skimming off any foam that rises to the surface. Remove the pork from the heat, and cool. Meanwhile, heat the kirsch in a small skillet over medium heat for about 15 - 20 minutes, until it is a rich reddish color.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Karaage
ingredients: 2 cans catsup | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 tablespoon chili | 1 flank steak, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 10 slices feta cheese | 1 whole boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Combine catsup, marjoram and chili in a bowl. Add beef, coat well and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Preheat grill. Thread beef strips onto skewers and grill over medium hot coals, turning frequently, until browned, about 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: margarine,kosher salt,nutmeg,monterey jack pepper cheese,dill leaf,yogurt,celery salt
title: Low Fat No-Yeast Creamy Cheese Dip Made With Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 lb monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 cup margarine | 1/4 cup yogurt ( non-fat may be substituted ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons nutmeg | 12 fresh dill leaves ( not dried )
instructions: Cube pepper cheese and dice fine into desired shape. Combine all ingredients in blender and blend well. Place in a small dish and chill slightly before serving.

title: Cauliflower in Whipped Cream
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, separated into florets | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots ( drained ) | 2/3 cup whipping cream
instructions: Cut cauliflower into pieces about 1 inch long and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the cauliflower, bamboo shoots and cauliflower florets. Cook, uncovered, over medium heat until cauliflower is tender and florets are just tender, about 10 minutes. Stir occasionally until cool. Remove the cauliflower from the heat and stir in the whipping cream. Pour into serving bowls and serve.

title: Asparagus With Champagne & Prosciutto or Bacon (21 Day Wonder Diet:daydaydayday 4)
ingredients: 500 g asparagus, tough ends snapped off and cut into 4 lengths | 100 g proscuitto or 100 g bacon, lean, chopped into 2cm pieces | 25 ml worcestershire sauce | 25 ml champagne or 25 ml prosecco, chilled to serve
instructions: Place asparagus in a saucepan with 1cm of water.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,italian tomato,guacamole,green capsicum,ginger paste,margarine,sirloin,purpose flour
title: Thai Tilapia Burger
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine, softened | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger paste | 400 g italian tomatoes, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons guacamole | 3 tablespoons green capsicum, finely chopped | 2 packages frozen cooked tilapia fillets
instructions: In a small bowl, mix margarine, flour, ginger and paste, tomatoes and sirloin. Shape mixture into eight thick hamburgers. Sauté in margarine for 5 mins each side or until crisp. Serve on toasted french rolls, topped with guacamole, capsicum and sliced tilapia. Tip, use your favourite brand of salsa to dip your tilapia into while hot.

title: camembert Cheese
ingredients: 1 ounce camembert cheese or 1 ounce brie cheese | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Finely chop the camembert. Mix all ingredients well and refrigerate for about 4 hours at room temperature, stirring every so often to make sure all of the cheese gets coated with the spices. Scoop the mixture into a greased, preheated saucer. Dust with additional poultry seasoning, if you would like.

title: Mango Burgers With Grilled Ham
ingredients: 1/2 mangoes or 1/2 peach | 1 hamburger bun | tortilla
instructions: Place two burger buns on a grill and heat on each side. Rub mango/peach slices all over the bun and then spread with the grill/hamburger bun. Slice the burgers. Serve with a side of tortillas.

title: Moroccan Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 10 skinless boneless chicken breasts, about 2 lbs. total, cut into 8 pieces | 2 teaspoons ground cilantro leaves | 8 slices purple onions | 3/4 lb cantaloupe, halved diagonally
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f lightly oil a shallow 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 quart casserole dish. Spread chicken pieces evenly in dish. Sprinkle with cilantro leaves and onions.

title: Sinfully Good Korean Pork Balls
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork shoulder, ground | 1/4 lb sirloin, ground | 1/4 lb chocolate | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon jeera powder | 1/2 cup oats, well-topped | 1/2 cup artichoke
instructions: Combine all ingredients, apart for pork, in a large bowl and mix well until you have an even paste. Roll your hands into a ball. Roll balls in the oats until well coated on all sides. Chop artichokes into bite sized pieces and place in a large fry pan with about 5 cups of water. Bring to boil and simmer until onions are limp but not mushy. Place pork balls into boiling water for about 15 minutes, making sure to turn off the boil. When done, drain water. Remove meat from water, reserving cooking water, and chop. Return the meat to the saucepan and add enough oats to cover. Heat briefly, then remove from heat. Add chopped meats and artichokes to the sauce and mix well. Serve with rice, rice wine, or white wine.

title: The Dagwood Freaky Monkey
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot italian sausage ( mild or hot, your preference depending on your love of sausage ) | 1/2 cup cashews | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1 teaspoon garlic ( or 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder ) | 1 teaspoon stevia ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dried fruit ( i use cranberries & strawberries )
instructions: Preparation, the first time i made this i made it, my family made it for the kids it was on a bun and they loved it, so i took it out when they needed it again and i took everything out after dinner and mixed everything else, except the dried fruit. I put everything except the dried fruit in a food processor and buzz on to make sure everything is well mixed. Add the dried fruit if using and buzz on. The nuts should become very mixed together with the sausage mixture. The final product should have some air pockets. To top of the recipe, spread the sausage mixture on the top of your macaroni dough, sprinkling some cinnamon on and sprinkle some grated cheese on all. It is now ready to bake and your in no time. This is not a one dish, but it will serve as it freezes well.

title: Rye Bread With Guacamole & Cranberries
ingredients: 2 tablespoons raw cashews or 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted | 1 loaf rye bread, sliced and chilled | sliced raisins or dried cranberries, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Lightly coat a large cookie sheet with cooking spray. Cut the loaf in half lengthwise, then crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Arrange bread slices in two layers in a single layer on cookie sheet. Bake bread slices in small batches in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Cool in sheets for 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. While bread slices are cooling, combine the cashews with the butter in a small skillet over medium heat. Let the cashews soak up the buttery butter flavor, stirring frequently until the butter is melted and the cashew mixture is combined well. Top each bread slice with about 1 tablespoon cashew mixture. Top with raisins or cranberries.

title: Pasteli
ingredients: 2 cups semolina | 2 ounces chorizo sausage, finely chopped
instructions: Place the semolina in a large, clean, dry pan or bowl and crumble in roughly 3 tablespoons of water. If the water is too cold, the semolina will crack open, like crackers. Turn the heat down on the semolina and stir occasionally with a wooden spoon. Let the semolina continue stirring to avoid burning, until all the water has been absorbed. Pour the water through a sieve and check to make sure the semolina is broken but not dried out. If the water tastes bitter, add a little more water. Remove from the heat and allow to sit for 20 minutes, before topping with chorizo.

title: Spicy Thai Curry Paste Mint Cups
ingredients: 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 12 fresh mint leaves, thinly sliced in to long strips | msg ( optional )
instructions: Combine curry paste, kahlua and mint. Keep in the refrigerator and serve over mint.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,butter,pudding mix,cayenne pepper,black pepper,gingerroot,spinach leaf
title: Spinach-Makki
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach leaves, washed | 1/4 cup fresh gingerroot, minced | 1/4 cup butter | 1/2 cup dry pudding mix ( made without pudding, instant or french ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: Cook the spinach in salted water in large pan or kettle until tender. Drain well. Combine spinach in a blender or food processor with remaining ingredients. Blend on high for just a moment to blend ingredients. Chill until serving time.

title: Spicy Bean Cakes
ingredients: 7 ounces mixed dried fruit ( raisins, cranberries, strawberries, chopped peaches, apples ) | 12 pepperoncini peppers, halved | 1/2 cup shredded reduced-fat mizithra cheese | 1/2 cup vegetarian baked beans
instructions: Soak fruit in water for about 10 minutes. Drain. Combine drained fruit and 1 cup bean water in a large bowl.

title: French Broccoli & Leek Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables ( broccoli, cauliflower, and carrots ) | 2/3 cup finely chopped leeks | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Using paper towel to drain vegetables, trim away any visible green bits. Combine all ingredients in a sprayed 1 1/2 qt casserole dish. Cover with tinfoil and bake 30 minutes. Remove foil.

title: Apple Guacamole
ingredients: 1/2 green chili pepper, chopped into 1 1/2 inch pieces ( about 1/2 teaspoon or less ) | 1 tablespoon apple juice | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/2 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and stir until mixture is well mixed. Serve with your favorite meal.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,sugar snap pea,malt vinegar,topping,kosher salt,white wine vinegar
title: Spiced White Sauce With Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 1 bunch sugar snap pea | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 dash kosher salt | 1 -2 tablespoon extra-virgin sugar-free topping
instructions: Trim blanched snap peas and cut into 3 inch lengths and set aside. In a non reactive bowl mash the sugar snap peas with a fork until well mixed and then transfer to a large bowl. Heat 1/4 cup of the vinegar, white wine vinegar, turmeric and salt until the mixture just starts to bubble. Remove from heat. Pour over snap peas and toss well to coat. Transfer the mixture to a non reactive bowl and refrigerate until ready to use. Spoon hot sauce into a small nonreactive baking dish, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Spoon reserved glaze over peas to serve.

title: Spaghetti All'Amatriciana"
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fresh basil leaf, sliced thin
instructions: Cook pasta with fennel and basil leaves only until pasta is al dente, drain well. Serve or reheat. Note, if using fresh basil leave it whole. Serve the drained spaghetti with a fresh mixed herb salad. Note, you can substitute 1 lb fresh or frozen chopped spinach for the basil to get the fresh, just thaw before using.

title: Peppers and Banana Pepper Fritters
ingredients: 6 medium banana peppers | 1/8 cup potato starch
instructions: Cut the outside of each banana pepper half down the length. Insert the slit to each pepper half with a toothpick. Coat each pepper with potato starch mixed with water. Fry in nonstick pan over medium heat until the skins blacken. The peppers will be tender, crisp and chewy. Place in a paper bag to cool. Chop and place in a plastic freezer bag. Label and freeze. Slice and store in zip lock freezer bags.

title: Chicken Armadillo
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings | 1/2 lb green olives | 1/2 lb pears or 1/2 lb pear, pared and pared | 2 teaspoons golden rum or 2 teaspoons rum | 1 small onion, chopped
instructions: Cut up wings of chicken and brown in 4 batches in olive oil in frying pan. Remove and put into pot. Add remaining ingredients and boil down rapidly on stovetop or in pot to thicken. Remove from stove and pour over chicken in dish. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at reduce heat to 275°f and bake 25 min or until chicken is tender.

Random Ingredients: yellow pear tomato,bamboo shoot,macaroni,flat leaf parsley
title: Macaroni and Macaroon with Carrots and Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 lb macaroni | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 lb yellow pear tomato, chopped | 1/2 lb canned bamboo shoot, chopped
instructions: Cook macaroni in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender. Drain and reserve 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Return 1/2 cup of the liquid to the pot. Stir in the parsley. Drain the macaroni and return it to the pot. Add the remaining liquid, tomatoes, and bamboo shoots. Cook until most of the liquid has evaporated. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Egg Beer
ingredients: 5 cups hard-boiled eggs, chopped small | 1 cup dark beer ( or coke or other dark beer ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the eggs, beer and baking powder together. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, up to overnight.

title: Polish Vodka Slaw
ingredients: 1 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 head cabbage, cored and shredded
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together sugar and vodka. Place cabbage in the bowl, and drizzle with the vodka mixture.

title: Cottage Cheese Patties
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1 pound ground pork
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet using a paper towel. Mix cottage cheese together with pork. Shape into 12 patties, and place on prepared baking sheet. Bake for 25 minutes, or until browned and no longer pink inside.

title: Banana and Lemon Cream Dessert
ingredients: 4 bananas, peeled and sliced ( fresh is best ) | 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( fresh is best ) | 1/2 - 1 cup half and half ( depending on how full you cut the fruit ) | 2 -3 tablespoons wine, depending on how sour your cream will taste
instructions: Place the bananas on a serving dish and add the lemon juice and a splash of wine, if needed. Cover with foil and chill in the refrigerator. Prior to serving, add the remaining wine, if desired, to taste. Serve topped with a bit of jam, if desired.

Random Ingredients: red tomato,wheat flour,thyme,banana,jalapeno pepper,ice water,gherkin,chicken bouillon cube
title: Tropical Banana Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 2 whole jalapeno peppers, deseeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons sweet gherkins | 2 tablespoons dried thyme, chopped | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup ice water | 1/2 cup red ripe tomato, chopped | 1 ripe banana, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the flour, jalapenos, sweet gherkins, thyme, and bouillon in a food processor and pulse for 2 minutes until smooth. Pour in the water, tomatoes, and banana, process until smooth. Spread into a 12 inch pie dish and bake for 20 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned. Remove from oven and cool completely in tin, 10 to 15 minutes before cutting. Serve immediately or chill, cut into slices and serve.

title: Strew Beef and Veggies
ingredients: 600 g stewing beef | 1 tablespoon crisco or 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 1 can vegetarian baked beans | 1 zucchini, chopped | 2 courgettes, chopped
instructions: In a frying pan melt the meat add oil and allow it to brown on all sides. Place in a casserole dish and cover with the vegetables and bake in 150c for 2 hours. Serve with crusty french bread and salad.

title: Pineapple-Sausage Spread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shortening | 2 tablespoons vegetarian sausage crumbles | 1 tablespoon horseradish, drained | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice ( reserve juice )
instructions: Put the shortening into a small bowl, add the vegetarian sausage crumbles, cheese mixture, and horseradish. Mix until well blended. Add the pineapple juice, and blend all together. The mixture will appear small, but it will thicken up somewhat as it sits on the plate. It will continue to thicken as it sits. Refrigerate for a few hours when ready to use.

title: Irish Pork Noodle Soup
ingredients: 4 pounds pork shoulder, cut into chunks | 1 1/2 pounds egg noodles | 5 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Place the pork and egg noodles in a large pot, and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender enough to shred, about 2 hours. Drain, and set aside. Stir in the flour, and heat until thickened. Serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,chili garlic sauce,pita bread,cranberry,lettuce leaf,turnip,enchilada sauce
title: Spicy Nacho Salad
ingredients: 1 large turnip, peeled, cooked and cut into bite sized pieces | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chili garlic sauce ( see description ) | 3 -4 large lettuce leaves | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/8 cup diced turnip | 1/4 cup enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup cranberries or 1/4 cup strawberry
instructions: Combine diced turnips and chilies. Mix together vinegar, chili garlic sauce, and red wine vinegar. Add to turnip mixture. Chill thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,port wine,button mushroom,bean sprout,asparagus,beef stock broth,kalamata olive,basil leaf
title: Beef and Asparagus Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 600 g thinly sliced beef sausages | 1 cup frozen asparagus | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1/2 cup port wine | 1 cup beef stock with broth | 2 tablespoons torn fresh basil leaves | 6 kalamata olives, pitted and sliced
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a large wok until very hot. Stir fry the beef until browned. Add the asparagus and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until they start to soften. Add the beansprouts and cook for 1 minute. Stir in the port and simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in the stock and basil leaves. Mix well until the beef has heated through.

title: Bharawan - Spiced Broccoli and Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs roasting chickens or 4 1/2 lbs chicken legs with thigh | 1 head fresh broccoli floret | 8 fluid ounces roasted blanched almond paste ( or almond butter with honey ) | 6 cloves | 2 tablespoons ground coriander seed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Trim the chicken legs and thighs, and cut off any excess fat. Rinse chicken with cold running water, and pat dry with paper towels. Cut chicken into eight portions. Cut the broccoli floret into 10 or 12 squares. Bring a large pot of water to a boil with a teaspoon of salt and a tablespoon of almond oil. Add in the chicken, and cook for about 10 minutes, or until the chicken turns white. Remove from the heat and transfer to a large bowl. Stir in the remaining chicken ingredients. Cover. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or overnight. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,lemon peel,creme de menthe,island dressing,pineapple juice,caper,head iceberg lettuce
title: Tropical Grilled Scallops with Pineapple-Island Dressing
ingredients: 5 sea scallops, 6-inch thick, thawed | 1 head iceberg lettuce, outer leaves removed and washed | 1 tablespoon creme de menthe ( can use a bit more if desired ) ( optional ) | 3 1/2 ounces thousand island dressing | 6 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon lemon peel | 1 teaspoon capers ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. In a mixing bowl, mix montre de menthe, undrained pineapple juice, 1 teaspoon lemon peel, and capers. Set aside. Place unpeeled scallops on preheated grill and grill 2 to 3 minutes, or just until scallops are opaque throughout. Turn and continue to move the scallops and turn until the desired doneness. Drain on paper towels. In a large bowl, combine the dressing and scallops. Stir in the dressing and toss to coat. Add the additional lemon peel and/or orange juice if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Luscious Sauteed Kale and Gruyere Cheese on Toast
ingredients: 1 bunch kale | 2 cups kefalotyri or 2 cups fat free buttermilk | 2 cups light cream or 2 cups buttermilk | 1 tablespoon buttermilk | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 7 slices gruyere cheese, 1/4-inch thick | 1 tablespoon dried breadcrumbs | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Slice kale crosswise then coarsely chop or shred. Toss kale with 1 1/2 cups buttermilk in skillet until wilted. Cover, simmer 3 - 5 minutes until kale is just tender, stirring occasionally. Stir in cream, buttermilk, nutmeg. Heat in microwave for 1 minute. Melt 1 tablespoon veggie mixture in fry pan.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,cheddar cheese,watercress,vegetarian bean,olive oil,taco seasoning mix
title: Tostadas for a One Pot Meal
ingredients: 3 cups vegetarian refried beans, heated | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 3/4 cup water ( may be a bit more if desired ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped | pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, except for olive oil, and stir until well mixed. Form into 4 patties and place on a baking dish. In a medium non stick pan on medium low heat, cook the patties until browned and done to your liking, about 8 - 10 minutes. Top with desired toppings.

title: Italian Salsa
ingredients: 1 lettuce, head lettuce | 2 cups italian parsley | 1/2 cup fresh grated lemon juice | 1 fresh fruit, cut into wedges
instructions: Drain romaine lettuce, tear or chop into bite size chunks. Place in a large bowl. Add parsley, lemon juice, and fruit and toss. Stir and serve immediately.

title: Spicy Chorizo with Yellow Squash (Ejane Ka Halwa)
ingredients: 1 pound chorizo sausage, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 medium yellow squash, cut into 1 inch pieces | 10 pinches green cardamom pods | 3 tablespoons pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook the chorizo in a frying pan over medium heat until evenly browned, 10 to 15 minutes. Add the yellow squash, pinches of cardamom with green cardamom pods, and cook until the squash is slightly softened, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain the chorizo slices on a paper towel lined plate and crumble in a food processor. Add the chorizo and pistachios and pulse until evenly distributed.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,lemon,beef,chicken wing,oregano leaf,soya sauce,chicken bouillon cube
title: Lamb Shanks With Lemon (Mantequegreng)
ingredients: 800 g chicken wings | 400 g beef, chopped into 1 cm pieces ( or lean beef ) | 1 lemons or 2 limes | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( see note ) | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons lemon juice or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 teaspoon dry oregano leaves ( extra to garnish ) or 1 teaspoon dried oregano flakes ( extra to garnish )
instructions: Dissolve lemon or lime into 1/2 cup warm water. Place chicken wings on grill tray and cook on one side over hot coals. Turn and cook on other side until browned. Place meat, 1/2 cup water, lemon or lime juice, lemon or lime juice, oregano and oregano in a medium saucepan. Add a little extra water if needed to make an upto half cup of liquid. Cover and simmer slowly for around 45 to 50 minutes until meat is tender and liquid thickens slightly. Meanwhile, bring the rest of the liquid to boil in saucepan. Add the beef.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,palm sugar,roquefort cheese,grape tomato,mustard seed,almond extract,pork trotter
title: Troquefort (Cheese Salad)
ingredients: 150 g grapes tomatoes, quartered ( about 2 tomatoes ) | 100 g punnet leftover cooked pork trotter ( from 1-lb carton reduced-calorie canned pork trotter, ) | 3 -4 mint leaves | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons blanched slivered almonds ( toasted, divided ) | 1 teaspoon palm sugar | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup cold water, tomatoes, remaining ingredients except sesame seeds, in large bowl and season generously with salt and pepper. Let stand 10 - 15 minutes in cool, running water. Using long thin metal spatula quickly transfer vegetables to serving bowl and toss gently. Transfer to plate.

title: Beef Rolls
ingredients: 200 g white mushrooms ( i prefer a mixture ) or 200 g oyster mushrooms ( i prefer a mixture ) | 200 g bean sprouts | 1 beef flank steak
instructions: Slice or shred beef across the grain. Make sure beef is well marinated. Place beef in an air tight container and freeze for later on. Slice mushrooms on the diagonal. Soak bean sprouts in cold water for at least an hour, but no longer, it will kill the flavor of the beef. Remove meat from the refrigerator about 30 minutes before cooking, then make sure it is still in the freezer. Heat the oven to 180°c or 160°c if using a fan forced oven. Slice or shred meat into approximately 1cm thick slices, then put them on a tray and bake for a few minutes on each side. Serve with a sauce. It tastes best to marinate the meat for a while before assembling and serving. Great for reheating, if you have leftovers.

title: Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs green peppers or 1 1/2-2 lbs red peppers | salt and extra olive oil | 3/4 lb sliced bacon | 1/4 cup pistachio nut
instructions: Remove stem and seeds from peppers. Cut out the core to about 3/4 inch from the top. Use a spoon to scoop out the center of the pepper, keeping the stem and seeds intact. Chop pepper pulp and set aside. Cook bacon in 10 inch skillet on medium high until lightly browned, about 5 to 10 minutes. Drain fat. Stir in cheese, bacon, pistachios and seasoning. Cook on medium high heat until cheese melts, about 3 to 5 minutes. Mold pepper stuffing into pepper shells, taking care not to break the stuffing. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,chicken breast half,whipping cream,white flour,cream chicken soup,herb,green bell pepper,broccoli floret
title: Chinese Broccoli Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup white flour | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 -3 tablespoons thai sweet soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dried herbs, crushed | 1 medium green bell pepper, sliced | 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 can cream of chicken soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a bowl combine flour and salt and pepper. Dredge chicken in flour mixture then brown chicken in lightly oiled baking dish and place on a cookie sheet. In a bowl combine remaining ingredients except for broccoli and cream of chicken soup. Pour over chicken in baking dish and bake about 20 - 25 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Cauliflower and Mushroom
ingredients: water to cover | 1 package frozen cauliflower, thawed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place cauliflower in a medium baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven in the preheated oven until tender and golden brown, about 20 minutes. Break cauliflower into florets with a fork. Place cauliflower in a bowl. Stir in the cream of mushroom soup. Pour soup over cauliflower and cauliflower.

title: Confetti Penne Nests
ingredients: 1 box penne or ( 16 ounce ) box elbow macaroni | 1 can beets | 1 can blue corn posole ( or to taste ) | 1 cup golden raisin
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and transfer to a bowl. Add in the remaining ingredients and mix well. If pasta seems dry before the end of cooking, add some more cornstarch or water. Serve immediately.

title: Duckling With Black Beans
ingredients: 1 duckling ( i use a 1 1/2 quart jar ) | 1 can black beans, drained
instructions: In a medium sized pot, cover duckling with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to simmer, cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Drain duckling, cut into pieces and set aside. Discard any skin that forms and bones. Set a large deep skillet over medium high heat. Add duckling to skillet and brown pieces quickly. Lower heat. Add black beans and cook about 5 minutes until flavors are blended and beans have heated through. Remove duckling from skillet and reserve the mixture in the skillet. Cover and cook for about 10 minutes, or until duckling is done.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,golden delicious apple,ricotta cheese
title: Apple and Ricotta Parfait
ingredients: 1/3 cup ricotta cheese | 1 golden delicious apple, peeled, halved, cored and cut into small dice | 15 kaffir lime leaves, cut into thin strips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Place the ricotta and apple in a large bowl, pour boiling water over, and stir until the cheese is the consistency of soft but still creamy. Stuff the kaffir lime leaves evenly into each kaffir stick, and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake until the cheese is bubbly, about 5 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Gravlax (Aka Meat Ball Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pecans | 1/2 - 1 cup dry white wine ( such as vernuva ) | 1/4 cup dry white wine ( such as vernuva ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 teaspoons wine or 2 teaspoons water
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let sit for at least an hour, but no more than 24 hours. Serve by itself or with pasta of choice.

Random Ingredients: coconut sugar crystal,mirin,rhubarb,shiitake mushroom,cake flour,cream tartar,horseradish,skewer
title: Rhubarb and Shiitake Mushroom Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup soybean paste ( available near asian markets ) | 1 tablespoon fresh horseradish, grated | 1 teaspoon mirin | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons coconut sugar crystals or 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cake flour ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sifted cake flour | 1 1 -3 lbs rhubarb, cut into 2-inch pieces | 3 shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and halved
instructions: Drain mushrooms and remove stems and cut into 2 inch lengths. In a bowl combine the soybean paste, horseradish, mirin, sour cream, sugar, 1/2 tsp cake flour, and 1/4 cup cake flour. Mix well. Place 1 tbsp mix at a time, into 1/4 of the rhubarb pieces, turning in gently to coat on all sides. Place skewers onto a clean plate, cover with a moist towel, and press in remaining paste mixture gently. Cover and refrigerate until ready to grill. Place hot skewers on a baking sheet, oiled side up. Brush tops with remaining 1/2 tsp of cake flour. Grill, turning, over indirect heat, turning often with tongs, until golden brown and cooked through, 6 to 7 minutes or serve. Serve with a bowl of your choice.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,brandy,wasabi paste,rose petal,campari,double cream,gruyere cheese,dark chocolate
title: Chilli Con Truffle
ingredients: 300 ml double cream | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 300 g gruyere cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 150 ml campari | 50 g dark chocolate, finely cut in four | 1 tablespoon rose petals | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional )
instructions: Set a non stick frying pan to medium high or low heat. Add oil. When the oil is hot, put in the cheese, wasabi, guiness, campari and rose petals. When the cheese starts to melt, pour in the cream and turn the heat off. After two minutes, turn a small knob of cream onto the cheese, remove from the heat. Serve topped with grated gruyere cheese.

title: Potato Greek Style
ingredients: 4 lbs potatoes | 6 yellow onions | 2 bottles grape tomatoes | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons orange zest | 1 container plain low-fat greek yogurt
instructions: Peel potatoes and dice. Chop onions. Cut tomatoes in half and remove seeds and membrane and the white pith. Place potatoes in large pot, cover with cold water and bring to boil. Once boil, partially cover pot, reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and rinse potatoes, return potatoes to pot, add onions, tomatoes, oregano, zest and yogurt. Cook uncovered over low heat until heated through, about 10 minutes. Turn off heat and let stand 10 minutes before eating.

Random Ingredients: banana,rump roast,spicy brown mustard,peanut butter,white wine vinegar,pesto sauce
title: Lorrie's Famous Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon spicy brown mustard | 1 tablespoon smooth peanut butter | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon spicy brown mustard | 1 tablespoon spicy pesto sauce | 6 -8 lbs rump roast, trimmed | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 6 1/2 ounces banana slices
instructions: Mix all dressing together and spoon over steak. Refrigerate at least one hour.. Broil or barbecue or roast until desired doneness. Cut in slices. Serve with creamy horseradish and greens.

title: Chinese Naan Bread Crumbs  (Breads)
ingredients: 1/3 cup yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 4 cups plain breadcrumbs, toasted ( day old if possible )
instructions: Finely mince onion and stir in chili paste to coat lightly, add bread crumbs and mix until well blended. Shape into a medium sized ball. Let sit 20 minutes, then gently flatten 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick with your hands. Spray tops with oil, bake in a preheated 350°f oven for 10 minutes. Cool completely on a wire rack.

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 round steak
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, mix together the soup and steak. Pour into a lightly greased glass casserole dish. Cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes, or until rice is hot and bubbly.

title: Crusty French Toast
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu | 1 lb chicken wings | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Slice french bread into thick slices. Place french bread on cookie sheet sprayed with pam. Spray liberally with pam. Sprinkle with salt. Place in oven for 3 - 5 minutes. Place chicken wings over french bread slices.. Cover with remaining bread slices, and bake another 10 minutes. Turn over and bake for an additional 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,snow pea,okra,cardamom pod,baking soda,stewing beef
title: Brazilian Beef Stew (Pulao)
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into one-inch cubes | 3 cups frozen okra, thawed, cut in half | 1 jar mild picante sauce | 12 whole cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 package frozen cut okra, thawed | 1 cup snow peas
instructions: In a large dutch oven, cook beef until it is golden brown. Remove beef from pan. Add okra, picante sauce, cardamom pods, and baking soda to the stew. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Add okra and snow peas. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender.

title: Arroz Blanco
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 1 package risotto rice | salad dressing
instructions: Cut 1 poblano chile in half lengthwise. Carefully slit each pepper lengthwise, leaving a small piece of the stem attached. Rinse the stem with cool water. Remove the stem and seeds. Cut poblano chile into strips about 1/2 inch wide. Place cooked rice in a bowl and drizzle with salad dressing. Spread a generous 1/4 cup of the rice on the top of the chile strips. Serve at once.

title: Egg Rolls
ingredients: 4 egg roll wraps | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup white vinegar
instructions: Mix the bread crumbs and vinegar in a bowl. Dip the rolls into the crumb mixture and fry in hot oil. Turn over once the egg rolls are golden on all sides. Serve with favorite dipping sauce.

title: Baked Chicken and Mushrooms (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken pieces ( about 3-3 lbs ) | 1 jar red raspberry jam | 10 cremini mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 1 bag frozen meatballs, thawed | 15 cherry rolls, quartered
instructions: Place the chicken pieces into the bottom of a 5 1/2 quart slow cooker. In a medium bowl, mix the jam and the mushrooms. Sprinkle evenly over the chicken. Top with the meatballs. Cover and cook on low for 2 to 4 hours, lifting the cover at about once during cooking if necessary to ensure the meatball mixture does not run during cooking. Remove meatballs and mushrooms and serve. Serves, makes a large batch of 5 servings.

title: Beef Tofu
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained, sliced | 1 lb beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 1/4 cup grated unblanched dried coconut | 1 teaspoon flaked coconut | 1 teaspoon flaked dried oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat broiler. Lightly grease grill. Place tofu on foil lined baking sheet. Broil 2 minutes per side. Rub each slice with flour and sprinkle with oregano, fenugreek seeds, and coconut. Broil 5 minutes more or until tender. Remove from grill and slice into thin slices. Serve with sauce.

title: Rajma (Rice Balls)
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces ricotta cheese | 18 leaves fresh basil
instructions: Soak the rice in boiling water for 10 - 15 minutes. Drain and set aside. Crumble the ricotta cheese into a large bowl. Add the rice, ricotta, and basil leaves, cover, and refrigerate for 8 - 10 hours, or overnight. Form the rice mixture into rice balls, and set aside for up to 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,mace,chocolate,grand marnier,dill,white flour,sesame seed oil
title: Molten Chocolate Cakes (Moltenkuchen)
ingredients: 1 lb sweet potato flour or 1 lb white flour | 2 ounces sesame seeds or 2 ounces sesame oil | 2 ounces potato starch | 2 ounces grand marnier or 2 ounces cointreau liqueur | 1/4 ounce sweet dill | 2 tablespoons chocolate or 2 tablespoons dark chocolate couverture ( optional ) | 1/8 ounce white flour
instructions: Mix all the ingredients well until smooth. Place in a non metallic bowl and chill until set. Pour the mixture onto a well greased baking sheet lined with parchment paper and flatten the surface with the back of the spoon. Use a knife to mark circles of pastry from the dough around the edges of the pan using a sharp paring knife. Prick into small pieces with a fork. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 15 minutes, then remove and allow to set in a tumbler for 10 minutes while they are hot.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,rice paper,cheddar cheese,fava bean,triple sec,parsley sprig,chicken soup base,peanut butter
title: Foolproof Phyllo Wraps Filled With Prosciutto, Peanuts, and Cheddar
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh parsley sprig | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 cup canned fava beans, drained ( reserve the liquid ) | 1 teaspoon instant chicken soup base | 8 sheets frozen rice paper sheets, thawed | 8 slices prosciutto | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line baking sheet with a reynolds wrap aluminum foil. Mash beans with fork in small bowl and combine with soy sauce and lemon juice and let sit till it thickens slightly. Combine peanut butter and 1/4 cup of the reserved bean liquid and let sit for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in fava beans with soup base and set aside. Lay out one piece of the rice paper a little larger than your workspace. Spread some beans/peanut butter mixture on 1/8 of the rice paper and then top a second sheet on top. Roll the phyllo and begin to roll up the phyllo and lay seam side down first on the prepared baking sheet. Repeat till all 2 sheets are used. Bake for about 10 minutes until the bottom is browned and the top crispy and slightly crisped. To serve, cut into 4 triangles and toss with cheese. Serve immediately. The feta beans make a perfect side dish.

title: Easy Delicious White Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, washed and dried | 1 head white cabbage, washed, drained and finely chopped | 1 can alfredo sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, coarsely chop the greens and place them in a large collander. Rinse and dry the cabbage a little. Place the chopped lettuce in the salad bowl of a blender, and pour enough alfredo sauce to drown it, stirring until the lettuce is completely covered. When the water reaches a full boil, toss the salad lightly with a fork, and immediately stir in the chopped cabbage. Top with more alfredo sauce if desired.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,white flour,italian parsley,toast,hot sauce,chicken breast meat,coconut milk,cognac
title: Olive Garden Crock Pot Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup white flour | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons cognac | 1 can coconut milk, or as needed | 1 can chicken breast meat, cooked and diced fine | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine flour, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, cognac, coconut milk, chicken and parsely in the bottom of your crock pot. Stir a few times as to not let it clump. Place the crock on low for 3 - 4 hours or on high for 5 - 7 hours. Serve hot or cold. Top with hot sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: black bean,mace,creme de cacao,spaghetti squash,banana chip,parmesan cheese,milk
title: Baked Spaghetti Squash With Bananas, Black Beans, and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, halved and seeded, tentacles reserved | 1/4 cup reduced-fat parmesan cheese, shredded | 3 bananas, thinly sliced | 1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup evaporated skim milk | 2 teaspoons creme de cacao | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) or 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the squash halves cut side down on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until squash is tender and beginning to brown. Meanwhile, spread the parmesan cheese on the insides of the baking sheet and top with the bananas. Pour in the black beans, evaporated skim milk, creme de cacao, and mace, if desired. Bake for 7 - 10 minutes longer or until heated through, or until lightly browned. Serve the baked spaghetti squash with the peanut dipping sauce. Enjoy.

title: Egg in a Spoon - Microwave
ingredients: 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1 dash turmeric powder
instructions: Mix together with the spoon well.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,chicken wing,kale,creme fraiche,beef broth,asafoetida powder,almond extract,sparkling water
title: Grilled Kale and Kale Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs kale ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup low sodium beef broth | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 12 chicken wings | 1 cup creme fraiche | 1 teaspoon almond extract | kassorted raw vegetables or frozen peas ( as desired )
instructions: Chop kale into bite size pieces. Wash, remove root ends and white membrane from wings, wash, dry thoroughly and trim excess fat. Cut each wing in half crosswise. Set aside. In a small nonreactive bowl, mix broth, vinegar, asafoetida and half the kale. Place chicken breasts in mixture and toss to coat. Let stand 5 minutes to marinade. Preheat grill. Remove all but 3/4 cup marinade from bowl and set aside. Thread skewers accordion style, place on grill rack just below medium hot coals. Cook skewers until golden, turning and brushing with reserved marinade every 5 minutes or so. Remove. For an added touch, top half of kebabs with crème fraîche, shredded carrot or other desired garnish. Serve with warm rice.

title: Grilled Mushrooms for a $25 Grilled Sandwich
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cremini mushrooms, finely sliced | 1 teaspoon kaiser roll | 1 tablespoon mushroom oil, from mushrooms
instructions: Brush the outside of the roll with the mushroom oil, and place it on a grill directly on the coals. Cook over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes on each side.

title: Easy Pilaf, Indian Style
ingredients: 3 cups half-and-half | 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup long grain rice
instructions: Heat cream and half and half in medium saucepan over medium heat. Bring to boil, then immediately lower heat to medium. Add rice to boiling cream, stirring constantly. Stir frequently until hot and absorbed. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Barbecue Sauce - the Best!
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | lemon slice
instructions: Pour alfredo sauce in crock/bag. Garnish with lemon slices.

Random Ingredients: oregano,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cheese spread,ice cube,flat leaf parsley
title: Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cheeses ( like colby or co-jack ) | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon fresh oregano, chopped | 2 ice cubes
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix cheeses, parsley, cheese, oregano and the ice.

title: Roast Beef - Weight Watchers
ingredients: 1 head roast beef, trimmed in 2. 5 cm cubes | 2 teaspoons rosemary | 1/4 cup sunflower seeds | 1/4 cup quinoa ( brown rice works too )
instructions: Wash and dry the beef. In a large bowl toss together the beef, rosemary, sunflower seeds and quinoa. Place the beef in a roasting pan and marinate, covered, for at least 3 hours or overnight in the fridge. Cook for 1 hour and drain off excess fat. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving, on its own or with veg, veg or salad.

title: Pasta With Meat
ingredients: 400 g chopped meat | 50 ml sun-dried tomato | 100 g farfalle pasta, uncooked | 1 pinch baking powder | 100 g rye flour
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Takes 9 minutes or according to package instructions. Meanwhile boil the meat in boiling water and drain. Drain the meat. Toss meat with remaining ingredients. Place in bowl and allow to cool completely. To serve, put on plate, add some shredded cheese and salad and serve.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,pig,nutritional yeast,oregano leaf,prawn,feta,beef stew meat
title: Grilled Shrimp and Shrimp Skewers (Shrimp)
ingredients: 12 prawns, large peeled, tail on, peeled and deveined | 1/3 cup greek style feta | 12 prawns, uncooked ( or raw king prawns ) | 4 tablespoons nutritional yeast, gluten-free | 1 1/2 tablespoons oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon ground nutmeg | 1/3 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Mix prawns, feta cheese, nutritional yeast, oregano, and nutmeg in medium bowl. Pour 3 tablespoons of oil in nonstick cooking pan over medium heat. Add prawn mixture.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,red chilies,red chili pepper,ginger garlic paste,sazon goya con culantro y achiote,chestnut,habanero chile pepper
title: Al Jorim Belizean  (Chestnuts) and Phyllo Pastries
ingredients: 1 jar chestnuts, drained | 2 fresh red chilies, seeded and finely chopped ( i prefer serrano ) | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger-garlic paste ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 habanero chile pepper, seeded and finely chopped ( wear rubber gloves for safety ) | 2 tablespoons sazon goya con culantro y achiote | 2 sheets phyllo dough, thawed, at room temperature | 20 -25 dry red chili peppers ( or red chilies )
instructions: To make the paste, crush the dried chiles in a mortar. Add the ginger, garlic paste and hot peppers and pound until they dissolve. Stir in the sazon and set aside. Brush a 13x9 inch baking dish or baking pan with cooking oil. Cut the phyllo sheets in half crosswise, making them 1 inch thick. Cut a slit into the side of each pasty sheet, going 2/3 of the way down the length of the first strip. Spread about 1 teaspoon of chestnut paste inside each square. Pour 1 inch of water into the dish. Arrange the phyllo sheets on top of the chestnut paste. Then top with a layer of chili paste. Make the phyllo stacks 1 - ½ inch below the bottom of the dish. Cover with plastic wrap and chill at least 4 hours, or overnight, before you freeze it. Just before serving, brush the dish with a thin film of oil. Place the frozen phyllo stack on top of the phyllo stacks. Heat on a solid, even layer in your microwave oven. The phyllo should only take a few seconds, but if it gets cooked and golden on top, it is done. Scoop out and eat warm. It can also be served cold on a piece of flatbread or toasted baguette, and it can also be reheated on the stove top, over very low heat, as needed.

Random Ingredients: chicken tenderloin,cucumber,mint sprig,liquid smoke flavoring,pearl barley,toothpick
title: Simple Smoky Chicken Tater Tot-Tawook
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins | 2 cans pearl barley | 6 toothpicks | 1 cucumber - peeled, seeded, and diced | 1 jar dried mint sprigs | 3 tablespoons liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spray a medium baking dish with cooking spray. Cut each chicken tenderloin into 2 to 4 thin slices. Place the chicken into the prepared baking dish. Drain the barley into a bowl. Remove and discard the toothpicks from each bag. Place the barley in a bowl of water to dilute. Place a plastic bag inside the baking dish, and secure with toothpicks. Place the bags in a microwave and cook on high for 4 minutes. Drain the barley and pour it into a bowl.

title: Chipotle Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed | 1 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce
instructions: Place the rice and chili pepper in a saucepan, and pour about one cup of water into the pan. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, partially cover, and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Grilled Chicken Breasts with Thyme and Bay Leaves
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup chopped fresh thyme leave | 4 bay leaves
instructions: Place chicken, thyme and bay leaves in a large resealable plastic bag. Seal bag and marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Arrange chicken breasts on a grill rack coated with cooking spray on a medium high grill. Grill chicken and top with remaining bay leaves and additional thymemary leaves. Cook, covered, over very low heat for 1 hour or until chicken is cooked through. Serve.

title: Easy and Delicious Dessert Couscous
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant couscous | 2 teaspoons jack daniels whiskey | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 -2 tablespoon white flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl and serve cold. Keeps a month in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,cranberry,nam pla,cider vinegar,bacon bit,onion salt,currant
title: Aussie Narnies: Cranberry & Narnie Relish
ingredients: 6 slices bacon bits, cooked but not crispy cut into 1/2 inch pieces ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh cranberries, chopped | 1 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup dried currants | 3 teaspoons nam pla or 3 teaspoons chili sauce | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 2 teaspoons dried minced onion salt
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients except the onion salt into a medium sized bowl. Add the onion salt and narnie salt. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or until needed.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,lentil,taco seasoning mix,chili sauce,onion salt,tomato green chilies,vanilla essence
title: Low Fat, Low Cal. Chili
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dry lentils | 0.333 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 3 tablespoons onions salt | 1 teaspoon dried chili sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 dash vanilla essence
instructions: Soak lentils in the water for 1 hour. Drain the excess water and cook on stove till tender. Add remaining ingredients, cover and simmer till heated through. Serve with a side of raw vegetables such as runner beans, broccoli, cauliflower, asparagus, asparagus tips, etc.

title: Chicken Liver Nachos
ingredients: 3 ounces cooked chicken livers | 15 ounces farfalle pasta | 1/2 head cabbage, shredded, about 4 cups | crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions, omitting salt. Drain and rinse livers under cold water. Combine ingredients except tortilla chips in bowl. Toss with hot pasta, sprinkle with additional crushed tortilla chips, if desired.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,cream,vanilla ice cream,kaffir lime leaf,tomato puree,asafoetida powder,shell pasta
title: Quick and Easy Kaffir Lime-Asafoetida Pasta
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cream | 1 pinch asafoetida powder or 1 pinch hing ( if unavailable, use 1 tbsp kaffir lime leaf, crushed ) | 1 kaffir lime leaf ( optional, recipe calls for 2-3 tbsp lime juice ) | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract or 6 sunflower oil | 1 lb small shell pasta | 4 ounces asafoetida powder ( to taste ) or 4 teaspoons vegetable oil ( to taste ) | 1 cup tomato puree ( see note ) or 1 cup tomato concentrate ( see note )
instructions: To make a kaffir lime asafoetida sauce, combine all ingredients in medium sized saucepan and heat over high heat until the cream is reduced by 1/8, stirring often and being careful not to allow them to boil. Remove from heat. Note, if desired, may use kaffir lime leaves or ancho powder.

title: Chilli Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 cup wheat germ | 2 cups savory | 1/2 cup sultana | sweet chili sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in a pot with enough water so that it boils. Simmer till it doesn't get too dry and the syrup has thickened and become creamy. Serve immediately or cover with cling film and refrigerate till required.

title: Bacon Wrapped Chestnuts
ingredients: 4 large chestnuts, peeled, halved, and opened at the seam | 1/3 lb bacon, sliced into 1 inch pieces | 1 3/4 ounces dried sweet sausage, crumbled | 2 tablespoons orange zest, fine grated | 1 can extra firm tofu, drained, rinsed and drained | 3 tablespoons gin | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Set bacon slices on paper towels to absorb excess grease. Bake chestnuts, without stirring or turning, in oven until lightly browned, about 15 minutes, remove to a plate and tent with foil. Bring a small saucepan of salted water to a boil. Cook bacon in the boiling water for 3 minutes, drain, and crumble. Return bacon to the bacon pan and add cooked chestnuts, crumbled bacon, sausage, and orange zest. Stir to combine. Heat tofu with gin over medium heat until hot, about 2 minutes. Stir in cheese and bacon mixture. Cook 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,ketchup,canola oil,red chili pepper flake,cooking oil
title: Quick and Easy Chinese-Spiced Fried Poppy Seed
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup chopped red chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Heat the oil in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir in the ketchup, chile flakes, poppy seeds and canola oil, then cover and cook over low heat for 1 minute to heat through. Uncover and stir for one more minute. Serve over hot rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: tomato,cilantro leaf,five spice powder,chile paste,ghee,golden syrup,cheese
title: Gujarati Restaurant Pizza (Pizza)
ingredients: 2/3 cup oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons minced chile paste | 1 1/4 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 1/4 cups shredded cheese ( your favorite ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon finely chopped seeded tomatoes ( aji-piri ) | 2 tablespoons hot ghee ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f in large bowl, stir together first 5 spice and remaining ingredients. Spread among pizza crusts. Bake pizza 15 minutes until edges lightly browned. Cut crosswise into 12 wedges. Serve hot with salsa, salsa verde or salsa, if desired.

title: Homemade Coffee
ingredients: 1 ounce brewed coffee | 2 spring onions, with the white inner bulb finely chopped
instructions: Take your coffee filter and run it through it. Put the beans and onion through the filter as soon as you pour in the coffee and let it set until the coffee is cold. Pour the cup into a bowl that's big enough to accommodate everything and then pour the coffee into it.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,active yeast,red pepper,dark brown sugar,chickpea,snow pea,beef bouillon cube
title: Beef With Chickpeas and Snow Peas
ingredients: 3/4 cup packed dark brown sugar | 3/4 cup chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes or 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh parsley | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/4 cup thinly sliced red hot pepper | 1 cup snow peas, trimmed | 1 can chickpeas, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f mix first 5 ingredients except peas in a small bowl and set aside. Lightly oil an 11 x 7 inch glass baking dish. Add all ingredients except peas. Stir to blend. Drop spoonfuls of the beef mixture onto bottom of pan. Sprinkle with nuts. Repeat procedure five times. Cover tightly and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour. Bake at 375f for 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake an additional 10 minutes or until top is golden brown.

title: Chile Chppers with Cream
ingredients: 1 poblano chile pepper | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat the grill or broiler. Place the poblano chile on a baking sheet and grill, turning with tongs or a slotted spoon, until blackened, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat, peel, and slice into strips. Place the strips, still in the skins, in a plastic bag. Cover and allow to steam in the sun. Heat the cream in a heavy medium skillet over medium low heat for about 5 minutes, or until it is heated through. Transfer the cream to a bowl. When the chilies are cool, peel, and cut in half lengthwise into strips. Pour the cream into the food processor, and add the chile strips. Process until well combined. Refrigerate for 1 minute, or until sauce has thickened slightly.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,egg substitute,zucchini,lemon wedge,picante sauce,prosciutto,steak,nonfat cream
title: Grilled Flank Steak With Zucchini
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, 1 1/2 inches thick ( at least 1-1/2 inches thick ) | 4 large zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut crosswise on diagonal into 1/4 inch slices | 1 cup egg substitute | 1/3 cup nonfat sour cream, plus additional if needed | 2 tablespoons picante sauce, divided | 1/4 cup grated provolone-romano cheese or 1/4 cup fresh pecorino romano cheese | 1 dash fresh thyme leaves or 1 dash fresh oregano leaves | lemon wedge, for garnish
instructions: Trim excess fat from steak. Place steak between 2 sheets of wax paper and pound lightly with flat side of a meat mallet to 1/4 inch thickness. Place the zucchini slices in a small bowl and sprinkle with salt and let stand at least 15 minutes. Meanwhile, mix egg substitute, sour cream, 1/4 cup salsa and the cheese.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,walnut,oyster sauce,fennel seed,lime zest,creole seasoning,wheat pasta
title: Oystershell Bow Tie Pasta Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces whole wheat pasta | 1 tablespoon minced flat-leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon minced fennel seed | 1 teaspoon grated lime zest | 3/4 cup finely chopped walnuts | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta, let cool for 1 minute, and then put in large bowl. Toss with other ingredients except omelettes.

title: Beef Tenderloin Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons slivered almonds, toasted | 2 tablespoons minced garlic chives | 4 slices toast | 4 slices filet of beef ( thin slices ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup trimmed cauliflower ( fresh or frozen ) ( optional ) | 1 cup zucchini ( grated ) | 1 cup cooked brown rice
instructions: Heat grill to medium high heat. Spread almonds on toast. Sprinkle with garlic chives. Top with beef and grill 3 minutes. Turn and let stand 3 - 4 minutes, then slice between pieces of toast. Serve with hot vegetables and favorite hot sauce for dipping.

title: Momma's Hot Potato & Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 bagashed potatoes | 1/4 of vidalia onions ( i use sweet onion ) | 1 can limeade concentrate, not ice cold | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Clean potatoes and cut into slices around the size of your finger. If they are not peeled then place in a colander and rinse them in lots of water until all the water is drained. Place in a large pot of salted water then bring to a boil. Once they come to a boil add potato slices, bay leaf, onions until both are soft and golden brown.

title: Real Indian Bread
ingredients: 4 cups white bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened chocolate syrup ( i use hershey's or carolan's ) | 1/2 cup palm sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º. Place bread cubes in a large bowl and mash to a pulp. Add tahini paste and chocolate syrup and mix well. Pour mixture into a small baking pan. Sprinkle with palm sugar. Bake for 25 - 35 minutes.

title: Dried Cranberry (Cranberry and Coconut) Breadsticks
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated biscuits | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Roll out the biscuits into thin long sticks about 3/4 inch thick. Place the dried cranberries into a shallow baking dish. Cut the sticks in half crosswise. Place the sticks on top of the dried cranberries. Bake for 17 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the breadsticks are lightly browned and crisp. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: carrot,beef mince,chicken broth,cannellini bean,apple juice,mexican seasoning,pecorino cheese
title: Easy Baked Bean and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 1 medium carrot | 8 ounces cannellini beans or 8 ounces white beans | 440 g diced beets ( canned in juice ) | 50 ml apple juice | 2 teaspoons mexican seasoning | 3 tablespoons freshly grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c. Cook mince for 20 minutes. Cut the mince into small pieces and put to one side. Using another pan, put the carrot and beans in a medium heat, then add the mince and apple juice. Heat through to cook everything through. Add the spices. Pour into a ovenproof dish. Cover the top with olive oil, then bake for 40 minutes. Top with freshly grated pecorino cheese. Cook another 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mango and Pimiento Salad
ingredients: 2 mangoes, peeled and cubed | 2 pimento stuffed olives, chopped | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oil | 1/4 cup canned cranberry juice
instructions: Toss mango, pimentos, olives, wine, brown sugar and oil together. Let stand 10 minutes.

title: English Bread Pudding
ingredients: 14 slices raisin bread | 14 ounces pecans
instructions: Butter six ramekin dishes or custard cups. Dip the raisins into the pecan mix until coated. Place in a pan, cover with boiling water.

title: Black-Eyed Peas (Khatta) in Salmon Ceviche
ingredients: 1 pound dried black-eyed peas, picked over | 2 cups salmon, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon thinly sliced fresh ginger root, chopped | 1 tablespoon canned black eyed peas
instructions: Place the black eyed peas in a large saucepan, and cover with just enough water to cover, about 2 inches over the bean layer. Bring to a boil, and boil for 5 minutes, then cover and remove from heat. Let stand for 1 hour, then drain water from the black eyed peas. Place the salmon in a bowl, and pour the black eyed peas over it. Grate the ginger into the bowl, and stir in the black eyed peas, reserving cooking liquid. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to develop flavor, or refrigerate overnight to let flavors develop. Serve the black eyed peas with a side salad of lettuce, salmon, and croutons from your refrigerator.

title: Shrimp and Rice

instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a heavy medium sized saucepan, then add the rice and salt, and return to a boil. Immediately, stir in the oils and adjust seasonging, if necessary add more water, and adjust seasonings. Cover and cook gently just until the shrimp are pink, about 1 minute. Pour shrimp and rice over the rice, then discard the thyme and stir. Add the spinach leaves and cook just until the spinach wilts, about 2 minutes more. Serve immediately, and spoon over steamed or steamed pitta bread for dipping.

title: Creamy Microwaved Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g lean ground mutton | 250 ml double cream | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 6 tablespoons chicken broth
instructions: Combine the meat, cream, garlic and poppy seeds in a bowl. Roll the mixture into balls of meatballs. Cook the meatballs in 1 litre full of water for 5 minutes. Drain the meatballs and set aside. Place the remaining water, and the chicken broth in a saucepan and bring to boil. Add the meatballs and cook about 20 minutes or until the meatballs are cooked through. Remove the lamb from the saucepan.

title: Sweet Asian Rice Noodles Salad
ingredients: 2 cups rice noodles | 20 -25 teaspoons liquid honey | 2 teaspoons liquid honey
instructions: Preparation, wash the rice noodles well. Place 3 cups of water over high heat in a skillet and bring to a boil. After the foam begins to subside, throw in the noodles and cook on medium heat for an additional 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain and rinse the noodles under warm water and then drain and rinse thoroughly. Repeat above steps 7 - 10 more times. Transfer to a medium sized bowl, stir in 2 tsp of honey until honey is absorbed. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 or 3 hours.

title: Easy Cuban Burger With Peppers and Garbanzos
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 -4 tablespoons adobo sauce | 8 ounces garbanzo beans ( canned is fine )
instructions: Brown your hamburger and then add the peppers. Cook a few minutes until they start to pop a little bit in you burger. Mix everything in the skillet and cook until peppers are crisp and all the burger is done.

title: Ladyfingers from the Famous Rao Family
ingredients: 2 pounds soft ladyfingers | 1 cup crisco shortening | 1 1/2 cups firmly packed brown sugar | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Using a pastry brush, spread the crisco shortening onto the prepared baking sheet. Cut the ladyfingers into 1/2 inch long strips about 2 inches wide and 3 1/2 inches long. Stir together the brown sugar, dill, and lemon peel in a bowl. Dip the ladyfinger strips into the sugar to coat, and spread them out evenly onto the crisco shortening. Bake in the preheated oven 35 to 40 minutes, or until crisp and brown, turning occasionally.

title: Frijoles Borracho (Authentic Mexican Beans and Tomatoes)

instructions: Place vegetarian baked beans, goat cheese, kahlua, and garlic granules in a large skillet over low heat.

title: Bell Pepper Swiss Fondue
ingredients: 1 jar roasted red bell peppers, drained | 1 package shredded swiss cheese
instructions: In a 1 1/2 quart electric slow cooker, combine roasted red bell peppers, cheese, and 1 cup water. Cover and cook on high setting 2 1/2 hours, or until the cheese is melted, stirring a few times.

title: Duck Fennel Wrapped in Basil
ingredients: 8 duck, cutlets | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground fennel seed | 3/4 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1 cup queso fresco | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil leaves | 1/4 cup water, or as needed | 1 egg, beaten
instructions: Lay the duck pieces on a cutting board, and lightly sprinkle with the fennel seeds. Gently pound down the fennel until even thickness. Season and spread the seeds onto the duck pieces. Spread out the queso fresco on a platter. Sprinkle the basil leaves on top, and place four pieces of duck on top. Roll up the duck legs around the cheese. In a small bowl, lightly beat the egg with a fork. Brush the egg on the rolled mushrooms. Let sit 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,heavy cream,marsala wine,bonito flake,cumin powder,tamari,asparagus spear,pistachio nut
title: Asparagus With Minted Marsala Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus spear | 3 cups heavy cream | 3 tablespoons tamari | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup roasted pistachio nut, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup sweet marsala wine, of choice | 4 tablespoons hot red curry leaves | 2 tablespoons shaved fresh goat tail ( i use bonito flakes )
instructions: Snap off the woody ends of the asparagus spears & set them aside. Cut off the tips of the asparagus spears with a knife, then cut them in half across the stalks. Slice the asparagus spears into 1/2 inch thick slivers, set aside. In a small bowl, combine the cream& tamari & stir. Add the cumin & mix. Stir in 2 tbs. Of the pistacchio nuts to the cream mixture. Set aside. In a saucepot, bring the remaining 3 cups of cream to boiling over medium heat, stirring often. Stir in the curry leaves, heat through. Immediately place the asparagus in to the cream mixture, then add the remaining pistacchio nuts. Pour in the cream mixture and toss to coat evenly. Transfer the asparagus to a serving platter & garnish with the shaved goat tail and the remaining pistacchio nuts. Serve immediately.

title: Tunisian Beetroot Salad W- Green Peas - Vegan
ingredients: 2 small beetroots, chopped | 1 1/2 cups green peas, cleaned cooked and drained | 1/3 cup raw yellow split green pea, diced | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Line a small baking tray with baking paper. Place the beetroot in the oven and roast for approximately 30 - 45 minutes. Allow to cool, drain completely, then slice finely. Place the peas in a microwavable bowl and combine with the peas. Sprinkle over the cumin and mix thoroughly. Add the beetroot and mix well. Place on the baking tray and cook in the oven for approximately 20 - 30 minutes, or until very slightly softened, stirring occasionally. Add the cilantro just before serving.. Variation, to serve the salad with spinach or cauliflower, toss the beetroot with 1 tablespoon oil or cooking oil and a small amount of lemon juice to thin the dressing.

title: Tropical Crawfish With Pesto and Prunes
ingredients: 15 prunes, pitted and quartered ( about 8 ounces total weight ) | 2 lbs crawfish tails | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( homemade or store-bought ) | 1/4 cup coarse palm sugar | 3 oranges
instructions: Trim the fruit of any large clumps and cut into a large bowl with a large spoon. Reserve any fruit left unpeeled. Place the prunes in a double layer of boiling water for 30 seconds, drain. Pat the prunes dry with paper towels and cut into 1 inch segments. Remove the peel from the oranges, cut each segment into 1/4 inch slices and place them in a large, non metal bowl. Cut the reserved orange peel into thin strips and set them aside. Cut the peel and oranges crosswise into thin matchsticks. Toss well with the pesto and sugar. Squeeze the orange and parve enough juice into the bowl to yield 1 1/2 cups of concentrated pesto. Transfer the fruit and orange segments to the bowl and toss well. Arrange the orange and prune segments in attractive dishes, or place the oranges and prune pieces upright on a serving platter. Arrange the orange and prune mixture over the fruit and serve straight away. Cook's note, this fruit mixture may be made ahead to this point and kept covered and chilled, and reheated about 45 minutes in a skillet.

title: Beef & Green Chili
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 3 small red potatoes, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1 can diced green chilies
instructions: Brown ground beef over medium heat in 4 qt pan or dutch oven. Remove beef and reserve. Drain beef. Add potatoes to pan. Cook potatoes until tender, about 8 minutes or til tender and slightly browned. Add beef back to pan with remaining ingredients. Heat through. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,pork back,gherkin,cilantro leaf,pepper,spanish onion,rotini pasta
title: Crispy Prawns Pasta With Ginger & Peppers in a Light Flair
ingredients: 400 g dry rotini pasta | 1/2 spanish onions ( small to medium in size, medium in size, finely chopped ) or 1/2 a small spanish onion ( small to medium in size, finely chopped ) | 2 -4 tablespoons ginger juice ( about one-third ) | 8 -10 gherkins | pepper | fresh cilantro leaves, for garnishing | spanish onion, for extra decoration ( optional )
instructions: Dry fry the onion in a pan till transparent. In a blender, mix together everything except for the cooked prawns and the rotini with 1/4 cup of water. Blend till you get a medium paste. Then add the paste to the pan, mix well and cook on slow fire for approximately 20 minutes, stirring from time to time, stirring occasionally, so as not to burn the paste.

Random Ingredients: ginger,artichoke heart,head cauliflower,mozzarella cheddar cheese,red wine vinegar,rigatoni pasta,cake flour
title: Artichoke Cauliflower Pizza
