ingredients: 9 ounces cake flour | 8 ounces mozzarella and cheddar cheese, cut in 1/4-inch slices | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1 large head cauliflower, separated into flowerets | 1/2 cup salad dressing or 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Oil a 12 inch pizza pan or a 9x10 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, beat flour with a pinch of salt. Add cheese to flour mixture and beat. In a separate bowl, mix artichoke hearts, ginger, vinegar, and marinade.

title: Spicy  Beans  (Red Beans)
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans or ( 16 ounce ) cans pinto beans, drained | 1 -8 ounce bottled hot red chili pepper, diced, from a can ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let it sit in a crock pot for at least a week. The longer it simmers the hotter it gets and hotter it gets. If you put it into a crock pot, the longer this gets, because if it gets too dry before the beans get cooked, or too soupy just put back in your crock pot and cook it on low for 6 - 8 hours.

title: Bacon Lard-Lime Beer Can
ingredients: 1 gallon chilled beer | 1 bunch good cheese, shredded | 24 slices bacon drippings, fried crispy, then drained on paper towels
instructions: Pour the beer concentrate into a large freezer jar, and add the cheese. Squeeze about 8 slices of the bacon drippings into each jar. Cover the jar, and leave the bottle on the counter overnight. The next day, drain the remaining beer into a large, clean, chilled pot over high heat. Bring to a rolling boil. After a few minutes, take out the can. Place the bacon slice in the can, leaving some drippings in the bottom. Place a slice or two of fried bacon over the bacon. Close the lid and shake to blend the bacon and bacon before removing from the pan. The can can may bubble up just a moment, so watch carefully. Use a large spatula to remove the can, and place on a serving plate, or in toaster oven proof beer can holder, set over a burner on low heat. Allow to heat for about 5 minutes to infuse the juice. The lard can be reheated, after removing from burner, over medium heat to restore the flavor. The can has a subtle flavor, so do not go overboard.

title: Easy Low Fat Herbed Stock
ingredients: 5 quarts low sodium chicken broth | 1 cup dried and chopped citron | 3 tablespoons low sodium beef bouillon, crushed | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary
instructions: Simmer broth and citron in covered pot over a medium heat for 30 minutes, or until liquid is reduced to 3/4 cup and a clear liquid. Transfer to large stainless steel bowl and add rosemary. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove herb bowl, stir liquid through, then refrigerate 1 hour or more until ready to use.

title: Roasted Peppers and Tahini
ingredients: 3 poblano peppers | 1/2 cup tahini | 4 egg whites | crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the broiler rack about 6 inches from the heat. Place the broiler rack on a baking pan. Cut off the tops of the peppers. Slice the peppers in 1/4 inch slices and place on the rack. Broil peppers for 5 minutes on each side, until skin is charred. Remove from oven and peel peppers and discard skins. Place in a bowl and mash in a large bowl with a fork. Stir the tahini into the mashed peppers and combine well. Beat the egg whites in a separate bowl until stiff peaks form. Fold the yolks one at a time into the pepper mixture with a fork. Add to peppers and mix well. Place peppers on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Remove and place on a wire rack to cool. To serve, slice and serve the pepper mixture on top. Sprinkle with crushed ice.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,white chocolate,salt,coconut milk,dill pickle,lemon zest,green
title: Gino's Snow Pea and Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs fresh snow peas, trimmed | 1 1/4 lbs fresh dill pickles, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 8 ounces firm white chocolate | 2 cups canned unsweetened coconut milk | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | salt, and freshly ground pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large saucepan of salted boiling water, blanch the snow peas for 2 minutes, and then plunge them into a bowl of ice water to halt the cooking. When cool, scrape out the peels and discard them before coarsely. In a sauté pan over medium high heat, melt 1 stick of unsalted butter. Add the snow peas, dill pickles, and grated chocolate and stir until chocolate is completely melted. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the snow peas to a large bowl. In a medium saucepan, combine the coconut milk and the remaining 2 ounces of chocolate with the lemon zest. Over moderate heat, bring to a boil. Add the milk mixture into the skillet with the snow peas, stirring often, and season to taste with the salt and pepper. Stir, add more salt and pepper to taste, and serve.

title: Shrimp Balls With Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp, peeled with tails left on ( about 3-4 ) | 2 tablespoons canola mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons lime juice | 2 cups oatmeal ( i use wholemeal ) | 6 tablespoons nonfat milk | 1/4 cup sake ( rice wine or sake-style cooking sake ) | sugar-free mayonnaise or low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Drain shrimp and pat dry with a paper towel. Cut into chunks and set aside. Prepare oatmeal according to package directions to make the rice. Place all ingredients except sugar free mayonnaise in a medium sized bowl and whisk until combined. Add sugar free mayonnaise. To store, place in a bowl and freeze, you can do this in the freezer with the remaining ingredients and then store in the fridge or just eat it right away.. Make sure you mix it before storing in the freezer. Slaw dressing, in a blender or food processor, finely chop the shrimp for about 30 seconds or just until they are minced small. Add in sugar free mayonnaise/powdered soy sauce and pulse again until all ingredients are in the right consistency. Serve with fried rice.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,sesame oil,italian breadcrumb,lasagna noodle,velveeta cheese
title: Roasted Red Pepper Lasagna
ingredients: 3 cups red bell peppers, roasted, peeled and cubed | 1 lb velveeta cheese, cubed | 1 1/2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 12 sheets lasagna noodles, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. Spread roasted and cubed bell pepper evenly across entire bottom of a 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Mix velveeta cubes with bread crumbs. Spread mixture evenly over red pepper. Carefully place uncooked lasagna sheets over cheese and cheese and spread to cover ingredients completely. Bake covered 1 1/2 hours.

title: Midori Sunrise
ingredients: 1 dash midori melon liqueur | 1 dash cooking oil | 2 pieces ham
instructions: Take a plate and put some cooked ham on top. Drizzle midori on top. Then pour the rest of the sauce in. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,browning sauce,sherry vinegar,turmeric powder,ginger root
title: Spicy Indian Sweet Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1/2 pound ginger root, peeled | 1 tablespoon browning sauce | 1 tablespoon sherry vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder, or as desired
instructions: Puncture several holes in the rice all over so it will release water. Place rice into a bowl, and sprinkle with a little water. Cover, and reserve 4 cups of the water. Place the ginger root into a blender, and fill with juice. Blend until ginger is finely diced and extracted from the skin. Reserve remaining juice, in a bowl, and pour it into a saucepan. Heat browning sauce and sherry vinegar in the reserved 2 cups water in the microwave. Pour the sauce into the rice, and cook over low heat for about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, and mix in turmeric.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,beef stock consomme,vegetarian oyster sauce
title: Yorkshire Beer ( Oyster Burgundy)
ingredients: 2 cans vegetarian oyster sauce | 2 cans homemade beef stock or ( 14 ounce ) cans beef consomme | 1 cup dry marsala wine ( can use another favorite favorite, try to use marsala with the scouringch and orange at this point. )
instructions: In a 3 qt. Skillet, combine oyster sauce, beef or consomme, marsala, and wine. Cook at a slow, steady simmer for about 25 minutes, stirring, making sure it doesn't burn. Remove from heat. Transfer to a bowl and cover tightly. Allow to sit for about 5 minutes. Serve warm. I usually serve this with bread rolls, fresh fruit, or rice for dipping.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,pie shell,italian salad dressing mix,lime,marinade
title: Lime and Orange Grilled Pies
ingredients: 1 envelope zesty italian salad dressing mix | 4 tablespoons marinade | 1 1/4 pounds finely shredded orange peel | 12 prepared pie shells | 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the italian salad dressing mix and marinade. Add the orange peel, and stir to coat evenly. Place the pie shells on a baking sheet, and top each with 1 tablespoon of the lime mixture, spreading into a circle on the top. Sprinkle tops with remaining lime, cover, and refrigerate 8 hours, or overnight. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Remove pie weights and sheets from the refrigerator, but leave about 2 tablespoons reserved for garnish. Grill the pies until heated through and browned on the tops and bottom, 5 to 7 minutes per side. Serve hot.

title: Quick and Easy Teriyaki Marinade for Grilling Beef or Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed
instructions: In a medium skillet, cook the sausage over medium heat until cooked through, turning occasionally. Add the hot italian sausage mixture to the skillet. Over medium heat, heat the mixture until bubbling, stirring frequently. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, turning and stirring continuously, until the liquid thickens and the sausage is cooked through, about 10 minutes.

title: Frozen Lime (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 1 1/2 limes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine cream cheese and limes and mix well. Line a baking sheet with foil and lightly grease with a little vegetable oil. Pour mixture in pan and bake for 40 minutes or until bubbly and lightly brown. Remove from oven and cool.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,mexican chocolate,creole seasoning,mayonnaise,red onion,gingerroot,cardamom,chicken bouillon
title: Mexican Chicken or Turkey Crunch
ingredients: 18 ounces mexican chocolate, broken in pieces | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1/4 medium red onion, diced | 4 tablespoons mayonnaise, low fat okay | 1 1/2 teaspoons gingerroot, finely grated | 1 large yellow pepper, diced
instructions: Combine the chocolate, instant chicken bouillon, cardamom and creole seasoning in large bowl. Add red onion. Fold in mayo and ginger. Spoon into greased 11 x 7 or 8 x 8 inch pan. Bake at 375 for about 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Grilled Chicken Breasts With Truffles
ingredients: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves, thawed | 1/4 cup truffles, chopped
instructions: In a shallow dish, combine the flour and vinegar. Coat chicken with flour mixture. Place on the grill and cook 5 to 6 minutes per side, brushing occasionally with the balsamic vinegar mixture. Remove chicken from the grill and sprinkle with truffle.

title: Quick Orzo with Prosciutto and Coffee
ingredients: 8 ounces orzo pasta | 2 cups chicken stock | 2 -3 sprigs fresh basil or 1 ounce dried fresh basil | 1/3 cup chopped shallot | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 ounces fresh prosciutto, sliced thin
instructions: Cook orzo in boiling salted water until al dente drain and rinse under cold water. Meanwhile heat chicken stock, basil and shallots in large saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil. Add orcchiette and parboil. Cover, remove from heat and stir in liquid smoke. Add sliced prosciutto. Serve hot.

title: Poblano Chiles Con Sriracha
ingredients: 5 poblano chiles | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon sriracha sauce
instructions: Place 2 or 3 chiles on a baking sheet & broil 2 mins or just until skins blister. Place chiles in kitchen towel & rub off skins. Chop chiles into small pieces & set aside. In a small bowl, combine yogurt & sriracha.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,coconut cream,basil pesto,vegetable broth,butter,mahi fillet
title: Butter-Filled Mahi Mahi With Coconut-Pesto-Fish
ingredients: 12 ounces mahi mahi fillets | 12 ounces white fish fillets | 3 tablespoons basil pesto | 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 15 3/4 fluid ounces coconut cream | 1 teaspoon butter
instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper and lightly dust each with some of the pesto. Heat the vegetable broth in a pan and gently pour into a saucepan. Add the coconut cream. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Place the mahi mahi fillets on a foil lined tray and cover with aluminium foil. Preheat the grill, setting the burners to high. Grill the fish for 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until golden. Add the sliced fish to the coconut pesto sauce and serve with remaining pesto sauce.

title: Seared Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh beef tenderloin | 1 japanese red chili pepper
instructions: Place the tenderloin in a plastic freezer bag and add 1/2 cup water. Close, and massage the air out of the bag to get air to circulate. You want to get about 2 celsius of liquid in the bag, and it should reach 2 celsius at this point. Remove plastic bag, and add your desired amount of japanese red pepper on it. Add the chile. Seal, and shake the bag to mix. Sear the beef on a hot grill to desired temperature. Turn, and let burn until meat reaches desired color.

title: Easy Chocolate Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry for double dipping | 1 1/4 cups unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place one sheet of phyllo pastry into a 9x13 inch pan. Sprinkle with cocoa. Repeat 4 more times, brushing each sheet with cocoa to make sure the sheets are not sticking together. Once the last sheet is brushed, paint all 4 sheets with cocoa, and cover with remaining sheet. Cut in 3 more circles using a pizza cutter or other heavy knife.. The dough will be very dry but slightly wet. Place triangles on a cookie sheet with a parchment paper under the sheets. The top layer should not be runny because of the cocoa. Place in the oven, and bake for approximately 30 minutes, checking to make sure the top sheet gets brown. Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before slicing. Enjoy.

title: Apple and Pork Meatballs
ingredients: 600 g ground pork | 1 large tart apple, grated | 1 medium spanish onion, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 3 tablespoons cornflour or 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup catsup | 150 g strawberries
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180c. Put everything into a large bowl. Mix well. Add the pork to the bowl and mix throughly but firmly. Form the mixture into approximately 20 small meatballs. Place on an oven tray. Bake 20 - 30 minutes, turning and stirring every so often until brown on all sides. Serve with your favourite salad, rice or toast.

title: Easy Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans | 1 small onion, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Microwave until heated through.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,linguine,lettuce leaf,cabbage,radish,snow pea,fusilli,hot red pepper
title: Pasta With Fusilli, Radish and Snow Peas (Lettuce Cups)
ingredients: 150 g fusilli | 200 g cabbage ( finely shredded or sliced ) | 100 g snow peas ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1/2 red hot red pepper ( finely chopped ) | 50 g radishes ( thinly sliced ) | 2 tablespoons lettuce leaves ( chopped ) | 200 g linguine
instructions: Cook fusilli in boiling salted water for 3 minutes drain and return to pan. Add cabbage and stir over low heat until mixture becomes soft, then stir in peas. Season with coriander powder, red pepper and green pepper. Fold in radishes and cook for a further 4 minutes. Drain pasta. Add pasta, vegetables and herbs and toss to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Pineapple (With Maple Syrup)
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots, sliced diagonally | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon splenda granular
instructions: Heat syrup in a small, heavy skillet over medium high heat just until hot but not smoking, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, cut bamboo shoots crosswise into very thin slices, about 1/4 inch thick. Transfer to a bowl of warm water to cool. Drain off liquid.

title: Tabbouleh With Cauliflower and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 large white potatoes, peeled | 1 -2 head cauliflower, separated into florets | 1 can whole anchovy fillets ( optional ) | 1 lb sun-dried tomato ( packed in oil ) | lemon peel, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place potatoes in a pot with an ample amount of water. Bring to a boil and cook until they are soft. Meanwhile, put in boiling water to cover and simmer until the potatoes are tender. If using an anchovy fillet, slice them thinly lengthwise and add them to the potatoes. When the potatoes are tender, drain and run under cold water to stop the cooking and make them easy to work with. Reserve a little of the oil from the sun dried tomatoes if you are using them. When the potatoes are cool enough a bit, peel the tomatoes off the skins, cut each in half and remove the seeds and ribs from the caps. Add the olive oil to a small bowl. Add lemon peel, crushed anchovy fillets and a couple of teaspoons of oil to the oil, a few drops of the remaining oil should mix well and emulsify. Reserve 1/2 cup of this mixture and set the remainder aside. When the potato is done, drain and run under cool water until the potatoes are able to work with. Transfer them to a bowl and mash the potatoes with the reserved oil. Add the tomatoes, onion, basil and the salt and lemon peel. Add a layer of cabbage in the following fashion, starting with a layer of cauliflower, then finishing with the potatoes and finally finishing with the reserved sun dried tomato mixture mixture. Garnish with more grated lemon peel if desired. Serve at room temp with crusty bread and a bowl of hot chicken broth.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,parsnip,olive oil,andouille sausage,bell pepper,apricot,shiitake mushroom
title: Chicken and Sausage Skewers
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken thighs | 4 spanish andouille sausages | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 cup pepsi-grade stewed tomatoes with pimentos, drained of excess | 1/2 cup chopped parsnip | 1/4 cup chopped andouille sausage | 3/4 cup dried apricot, cut into 1/2 by 1 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Cut chicken thighs lengthwise into equal thickness pieces. Thread chicken onto 14 bamboo skewers. Thread andouille over each piece of chicken, reserving any remaining skewer. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours. Prepare the grill or prepare the broiler. Combine the olive oil and stewed tomatoes in a small bowl. Let stand about 10 minutes. Cut sausages crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices, and remove sausage from casings. Cut sausage into 2 by 1 1/2 inch pieces. Brush the grill rack with oil.

title: Hominy and Star Anise Raita
ingredients: 3/4 cup diced hominy | 1/4 cup frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1 star anise pod | 3 cloves fresh turkish beans or 1 teaspoon dried turmeric | 3 1/2 teaspoons black tea | ice | 4 corn tortillas or 4 flour tortillas, cut into 1 inch slivers
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes, or until thick, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,asian red chilies,red pepper flake,bouillon cube,lime juice,extra virgin olive oil,feta cheese
title: Tangy Mexican Onion Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 fresh asian red chilies, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1 bouillon cube | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro leaves | 1 pinch red pepper flakes
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat.

title: Taco Shreds for Two
ingredients: 20 taco shells | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 10 ounces mascarpone cheese or 10 ounces goat cheese | 2 tablespoons half-and-half, warmed | 1 tablespoon half-and-half or 1 tablespoon milk | 1/2 teaspoon spices, blend | 1/2 mango chutney, chopped
instructions: Mix the vinegar, mascarpone or goat cheese and half and half in a bowl. Whisk in 1/2 tsp of spice blend into the chutney. Spread 2 tbsp of mixture on each taco shell and garnish with mango chutney.

title: Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces large walla walla cheese, grated | 1/2 shallot, finely chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons cottage cheese | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3 tablespoons white tequila
instructions: Finely crumble the cheese and shallot, if using. Combine with the remaining ingredients, except for the margarine and roll up the roll in the margarine. Chill for at least 15 minutes to blend flavours. Cut rolls into halves.

title: Corn Lasagna from Molcajete
ingredients: 32 ounces lasagna sheets ( i use the mini size ) | 12 ears fresh corn, sliced in thirds | 3 -4 yellow squash, sliced ( or a combination of squash and zucchini for a variation ) | 10 cups shredded lettuce | 8 scallions, sliced thin ( some for garnish ) | shredded mexican blend cheese ( optional ) or monterey jack cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f degrees. Arrange corn and squash on large rimmed baking sheet. Spray each cob generously with cooking spray. Bake until tender, about 40 - 50 minutes. Remove from oven and slice crosswise. Place in large bowl. Toss corn and squash with enough remaining ingredients to coat. Spray a 13x9 pan with cooking spray. Top evenly with lasagna sheets, overlapping slightly. Bake until lightly bubbly, about 20 minutes. Sprinkle top with cheese.

title: My Mamma's Mambo Sweet and Sour Clam
ingredients: 2 lbs manila clams | 1/2 cup apple juice, divided | 1 green pepper, sliced | 1 tablespoon ketchup
instructions: Drain the clams and put them in a baking tray with the 1/2 cup of your apple juice. Bake at 300 degrees for around 30 minutes, then turn and bake at 300 degrees for about 10 more minutes. When cooked take out the clams and place in a serving bowl. Slice off the stem in and around the clams, discarding any open sheards. Add the rest of the apple juice to the cooking clams and mix. When the juice comes to a boil, add the green pepper and ketchup. Stir. Cover and cook at 250 degrees for around 15 minutes or until the pepper is soft.

title: The Joy of Sizzling Rice
ingredients: 4 jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup lard | 1 cup sugar syrup | 4 1/4 cups jasmine rice, cooked and chilled | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds ( optional )
instructions: Slice peppers in half lengthwise, remove seeds. Slice livers crosswise. Melt lard in a 10 inch skillet over medium heat. Add rice. Cook, stirring often, until lightly toasted, about 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in mustard seed and livers. Drizzle sugar syrup over rice mixture. Transfer to a serving platter.

title: Persian Grape Spread
ingredients: 2 2/3 lbs grapes or 2 2/3 lbs yellow grapes | 1/2 lb pistachios, blanched
instructions: Wash the grapes, remove any pips, cut the grapes in half, remove the rind and place the grapes in a bowl and cover with water. Refrigerate for 24 hours, drain and cool. Press the grapes by pounding with your hands and then squeezing with your hands to a pulp that has the consistency of cooked peas. Put the grapes in a processor and add enough pistachios so that they stick. Pulse in the pistachios to form a smooth, creamy paste. Add the juice and mix together. Refrigerate for 2 days before serving.

title: Homemade Pecorino Romano
ingredients: 3/4 cup buttermilk | 3/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup cold-pressed frying oil
instructions: Whisk buttermilk and pecorino romano cheese together in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Gradually stir in the cold pressed oil. Continue whisking until the mixture thickens and becomes slightly translucent, about 1 minute. Scoop 1/4 cup mixture into the center of each pie crust. Cover each pastry circle with dampened plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,bean,sake,ketchup,brussels sprout,pork tenderloin,vanilla bean,bucatini pasta
title: Porotos Granados
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 -3 tablespoons sake | 12 ounces bucatini pasta, cooked according to directions on box ( i prefer bowtie pasta ) | 6 ounces brussels sprouts, trimmed and cut into 2-inch lengths | 2 limes, wedged | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/4 cup ketchup | lime wedge
instructions: In a large skillet, over medium high heat, fry the pork until just browned. Add the sake.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,chipotle salsa,butternut squash,tart apple,swiss chard,brandy,fennel seed,cilantro leaf
title: Chermoula With Butternut Squash & Swiss Chard
ingredients: 2 small butternut squash, peeled and seeded | 2 chipotle salsa, chipotle flavored, divided | 12 slices tart apples, thin cored | 3 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 1 bunch swiss chard, leaves and stems sliced, leaves separated | 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | 1 bunch cilantro leaf | 1/4 lb asparagus, trimmed | chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring a large kettle of water to boil over high heat. Add squash and 1 1/2 tablespoons of seasoning and return to boil. Lower heat and cook until squash is tender. Meanwhile, place 1 chard leaf, stems, and leaves in a 9x12 baking dish with 2 tablespoons of seasoning. Cover and cook until softened, about 3 minutes. Stir in 2 tablespoons brandy, remove squash, chard stems, and leaves to serving dish. Spoon squash and chard into a serving bowl. Dress with remaining tablespoon of brandy and scatter with cilantro. Serve with salsa.

title: Garlic-Garlic Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shrimp paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme ( plus one extra tsp. for garnish ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Taste and adjust seasoning. Place in a sealed jar & refrigerate to allow flavors to develop and develop, 1 to 2 weeks.

title: Quick Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 1 bottle hot rotel or ( 32 ounce ) bottle salsa | 1 package monterey jack pepper cheese, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl. Serve with tortilla chips, or any other cracker that you like to dip.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,bacon,red onion,chicken breast,garlic,cream chicken soup,oat
title: Parmigiano-Reggiano Chicken
ingredients: 12 slices bacon | 6 chicken breasts, boneless, skinless | 6 slices red onions | 6 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( or other good cheese ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic | 2 2 tablespoons oats ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons couscous, uncooked
instructions: Place bacon in a large, deep stockpot or skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly browned. Remove bacon, reserving drippings. Set the skillet aside. Reduce heat to medium low and cook chicken, onions, and cheese, stirring frequently, until the chicken is no longer pink in the center. Stir in the soup mixture and garlic.

title: Pumpkin Bread (Abm)
ingredients: 1/4 cup pumpkin seeds | 1/2 cup raw pumpkin seeds | 1/4 cup fresh pineapple chunk | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 egg | 1 1/4 cups warm water | 1 tablespoon yeast
instructions: In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Mix well. Bake in oven at 350f for 40 - 45 minutes. If loaf does not fit in your oven, allow to cool in pan for a few minutes uncovered.

title: Thai Style Chicken Cannelloni
ingredients: 3 chicken drumsticks | 2 chili peppers | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Cut the wings and body of each drumstick into 4 pieces, and remove the wing tips. Cut each drumstick in half lengthwise. Heat a little oil in a frying pan, add the chicken and stir fry. Add all the ingredients and stir for 5 - 6 minutes or until well marinated. Serve with plain rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,extra virgin olive oil,chipotle chile adobo,brown rice,pork cutlet,penne,chili pepper flake
title: Chipotle Spiced Pork With Penne
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 3/4 lb pork cutlet, cut into thin strips | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 1 1/2 cups instant brown rice ( such as mahatma's ) | 1/4 lb dry penne pasta
instructions: In a large pot, heat oil over medium high heat. Add bell pepper, pork strips, chili peppers and minced chipotle and sauté until meat is cooked and veggies are crisp tender. While this is cooking, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook pasta until al dente, drain and set aside in a warm bowl. Add brown rice and cooked noodles to remaining oil in the pot and fry together, tossing a few times, until pasta is crisp tender. Add reserved rice and peppers and fry 2 minutes more.

title: Saffron Roast  (Aka  Meat Roasted  in Soy Sauce (Yalan Hamiatika)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 kg meat ( bone-in or thick lamb ) | salt ( for soaking bones ) | 1/4 cup soy sauce ( i use reduced sodium, reduced sodcan ) | 1 cup grand marnier ( powdered sugar ) or 1 cup icing sugar ( powdered sugar ) | 2 tablespoons minced red onions | 1 tablespoon lemon rind ( finely minced ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the meat in a roasting pan about 1/3 inch deep, but not as thick as the chicken.. Sprinkle with salt and pour over the soy sauce in equal parts, making sure the surface is covered. Roast in oven for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is extremely soft and the liquid has evaporated. Allow the meat to cool slightly and slice the meat into 1/3 inch wide slices, and place on a platter, or plate, with the meat arranged in a spoke pattern. Allow to cool completely. Pour the remaining ingredients into a shallow pan or bowl, and bring slowly to a boil over high heat. Boil for 1 minute. Pour the sauce over the meat, and garnish with the minced onion & lemon rind. Serve immediately.

title: Cachapas a La Veracruzana
ingredients: 5 cups strawberries, hulled and sliced ( about 8 medium ) | 4 cups cilantro roots, peeled, minced or 4 -6 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro | 1 cup raisins | 1/3 cup distilled white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Marinate, covered, at least overnight or for several hours. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: sage,russet potato,mango chutney,poblano chile,cranberry sauce,chickpea,garlic powder
title: Quick Chickpea Fries With Mango Chutney and Roasted Roasted Poblano
ingredients: 6 russet potatoes | 1 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 1 can garbanzo bean puree | 1 tablespoon dried sage | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1 small red roasted poblano chile
instructions: Peel potatoes, dice and steam until tender. Place all ingredients except chiles in a large resealable pan. Heat on medium high stirring often until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes until potatoes are tender. Stir occasionally. Remove from heat then stir in hot salsa. Set aside and cool. Transfer cooled potatoes to a serving bowl. Heat a large cast iron or nonstick skillet over high heat until very hot. Coat pan with cooking spray. Spread chiles in the pan and toast, shaking the pan until the slices are slightly browned and have shrunk. Spread the chiles on a plate.

title: Pasta With Ham and Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 6 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1/3 cup catsup | 4 stalks celery & leaves, minced | 1/2 lb prosciutto ( about 5 ) or 1/2 lb bacon, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch-wide slivers ( about 5 )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until just tender but firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 9 minutes. Drain.

title: Peanut Butter Mint Chilies
ingredients: 1 pound dried red chile peppers, rinsed | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1 bunch fresh mint, coarsely chopped | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add red chilies and cook until tender, about 3 minutes. Drain. Drain liquid into a small bowl. Stir in peanut butter and mint leaves until thoroughly mixed. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and place in refrigerator to chill.

Random Ingredients: ranch salad dressing,saffron strand,chive,baking potato,beef stock,egg yolk,apricot jam
title: Auberge Rommaise
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, peeled cut into wedges | 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 4 ounces apricot jam | 8 saffron strands or 8 saffron strands | 4 large egg yolks | 1 1/2 cups chopped chives | 3 tablespoons ranch salad dressing
instructions: Boil the potatoes until just tender. Drain and leave in cold water to stop the cooking. Dry fry the saffrins in a little oil until lightly brown. Transfer to paper towel lined plate and cover with towel to absorb any moisture while preparing the rommaise. Place the stock in a saucepan with the apricots and saffron. Bring to the boil then add the potato wedges. Let simmer over a low heat, covered, until tender and smooth. Set aside for 5 minutes. Dissolve the egg yolks with a little of the stock from the potato, then beat in the chives. Remove from the heat. Pour into a pan and stir in the warm ranch, mix well and set aside to cool slightly. Put the rommaise in a serving bowl and top with the rommaise and mix lightly. Serve at room temperature with a crisp green salad, french baguettes or baguette slices.

title: Shchi Shri's Mashed Sweet Lulled Green Cabbage With Pearl Onions
ingredients: 4 head green cabbage ( about 6 pounds ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped marjoram | 1/3 cup white flour ( or white salt ) | 1 1/2 cups sour cream | 2 tablespoons heavy cream ( not whipped cream ) | 2 tablespoons tapioca
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the cabbage and blanch 5 - 8 minutes, or until just barely tender, but firm in the center. Dislodge the cabbage to a bowl of ice water while still hot. Drain. Slice the cabbage very thinly. Stir in the marjoram and season to taste with salt and pepper. In a bowl, mix sour cream and heavy cream. Stir in tapioca and cool to room temperature. Stir mixture into cabbage. Mix well. Divide the filling between 2 large serving plates.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,crabmeat,salt pepper,kiwi fruit,half,vanilla essence,consomme,corn syrup
title: Creamy Crabcakes
ingredients: 2 cups kiwi fruits ( kiwifruit, fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 pint reduced-fat half-and-half | 1 can consomme ( or use cream of wheat ) | 250 g crabmeat | 1/3 cup light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons light cream or 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | salt and pepper
instructions: Using a sharp knife, core kiwifruit and slice lengthways into thick strips. Squeeze strips to remove excess liquid. Combine cream, corn syrup, cream and vanilla essence, then mix with crab and kiwifruit. Pour into paper lined 20 x 12 cm jelly moulds, then smooth top. Refrigerate for 45 minutes or overnight, until set. Serve.

title: English Peppers
ingredients: 8 ounces bell peppers, sliced | 1 teaspoon white flour
instructions: In a hot frying pan, add peppers. Sprinkle on the flour. Let fry for 3 minutes on high. Serve as is or use in a recipe calling for a brown sauce.

title: Buffalo Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 bag blueberries | 1/3 cup chili sauce | 2 dashes hot sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Place the blueberries in a pan on medium heat and cover. When they are done to your liking remove them from the pan and sprinkle with hot sauce and vanilla. Mix well and let the flavors meld and heat up through. Use in any bbq you use for basting.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,vinegar,tomato puree,cumin seed,allspice,lemon juice zest,velveeta cheese,golden syrup
title: Velveeta Cheesecake with Cumin
ingredients: 2 lbs velveeta cheese | 1 cup tomato puree, fresh | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 2 tablespoons golden syrup ( maple syrup can also be used ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese in a bowl and blend thoroughly. Crumble in cheese and refrigerate till set.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,bucatini pasta,yellow food coloring
title: Quick and Easy White Rice With Bucatini
ingredients: 12 ounces bucatini pasta, uncooked | 1 yellow food coloring, or as desired | 2 cups long-grain white rice, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups hot water, or as needed
instructions: Fill a large saucepan with lightly salted, boiling water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Boil uncovered, stirring occasionally, until a small amount of the water evaporates, about 2 minutes. Immediately stir in bucatini, and return to a boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender but still slightly firm, about 5 minutes. Drain pasta, and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with food coloring as needed, stirring often, until completely drained and reserved. Stir rice and warm water into bucatini and serve.

title: Gnocchi With Sausage, Clam and Potato
ingredients: 1 lb gnocchi | 1 lb bratwurst or 1 lb breakfast sausage, cut in thin, bite size pieces | 1 -2 garlic clove, minced | 4 medium potatoes, cut into chunks | pepper
instructions: Cook gnocchi according to package directions. While gnocchi is cooking, crumble sausage into large skillet, cook until brown. Stir. Add minced garlic over sausage. Cook until almost no liquidy remains. Add potatoes and water to cover. Bring to a boil. Cover and cook over low heat for about 15 minutes or until vegetables are done. Add sausage mixture to gnocchi.

Random Ingredients: apple,steak,plain flour,black mustard seed,heavy whipping cream,oatmeal,cayenne pepper
title: Smoked Beef and Oatcakes
ingredients: 750 g round steaks, cut into 5cm pieces, cut diagonally into bite size pieces | 1 apple, cored and cut into thin wedges | 2 tablespoons plain flour, plus extra for dusting | 3 tablespoons oatmeal | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place steak, apple and flour in a bowl, and toss to ensure coated in flour. Heat a large non stick frying pan, add oat meal, cayenne pepper, cream and 1 teaspoon mustard seeds and cook for 1 minute. Remove from base of pan and add steak mixture into pan, dust with extra oat meal and fry for 3 - 4 minutes until browned all over and cooked to your liking. Drizzle olive oil over the tops of the steaks, sprinkle with extra spiced oat meal and serve with salads or bread or your own favourite vegetable and bean salad.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,green olive,halibut fillet,paprika,sesame seed,red curry paste,sea salt,tabasco sauce
title: Pacific Halibut Fillets With Mango Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 14 1/2 ounces halibut fillets, cut into 6 serving pieces | 1 cup mango chutney, warmed | 1/2 cup pimento-stuffed green olives | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce, divided | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Heat a broiler.

title: Spanish Green Olive and Cheese Spread
ingredients: 9 ounces soft italian cheese | 1/2 cup unsalted butter, at room temperature | 2 ounces green olives, chopped | 2 teaspoons chopped green chili | 8 ounces grape juice
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,cinnamon,torn salad green,grain rice,rice wine vinegar
title: Moroccan Rice Salad with Cinnamon Dressing
ingredients: 4 cups mixed torn salad greens | 1 tablespoon toasted rice wine vinegar | 3/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup hot cooked short-grain rice, chilled
instructions: Combine rice vinegar and remaining ingredients except dressing in a large bowl. Sprinkle rice over salad mixture and toss.

title: Cannellini Beans With Bacon & Sage
ingredients: 5 ounces dried cannellini beans or 8 ounces dried beans, washed, picked over and soaked overnight ( 3 cups ) | 6 ounces smoked ham, very thinly sliced | 3 ounces suet, very thinly sliced | 5 ounces bacon or 5 ounces streaky bacon, minced | 1/2 cup triple sec ( or a little more ) | 1/3 cup sage, torn
instructions: Place soaked beans in a saucepan with 8 cups water. Cover and bring to the boil. Lower heat and simmer for about 45 minutes or until beans are very tender. Drain and reserve cooking liquid. Return beans to the saucepan and add ham, suet and bacon or streaky bacon. Add cooked beans and simmer for 2 hours or until beans are very tender. Remove meat and stir in double sec. Serve.

title: Hot Tofu With Cucumbers and Tofu
ingredients: 5 dried boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 small cucumber, finely chopped | 2 ounces firm tofu, drained, rinsed, drained and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: In a bowl, combine the sour cream, cucumber and tofu. Spoon onto the chicken and season with salt and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap, pressing down lightly to squeeze the moisture from the tofu. Let stand at room temperature for 2 hours or refrigerate for up to 2 days up to 2 days. Preheat the grill and grill chicken for 4 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Serve with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,sea salt,salt black pepper,parsley leaf,vanilla
title: Homemade English Custard, Traditional for Scones, Atkins, or Bar Mash - Welsh
ingredients: 250 g milk chocolate ( good quality ) | 250 -275 g fresh parsley leaves, washed and very finely chopped ( use a good processor or food processor ) | coarse salt | 1 tablespoon raw sugar ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon caster sugar ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla, pure extract ( optional, see notes in description ) | sea salt | fresh parsley leaves, freshly chopped
instructions: Place milk chocolate and chopped parsley/parsley in a saucepan and stand over low heat. When the chocolate has melted and is smooth, add sugar and vanilla, if using. Stir and boil until reduced by half over a low heat, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Use immediately in your recipe or store in a cool container if the mixture is still a little cold. Note, you can use your food processor to measure out 1 1/2 tablespoons of water, but you must get a fairly fine consistency so it can be spoonable. Add the parsley/parsley to the cooled milk chocolate mixture and stir until combined. Do not over whisk the mixture, it should eventually form into a creamy smooth mixture. You are aiming for a creamy consistency. Transfer mixture to a bowl, stir in the salt/sugar and vanilla if using, then allow to cool completely before marking into 12 scones. Toast lightly under a hot broiler. To finish, sprinkle each scone on some parsley leaves before serving. Alternatively, you can make your scones in the oven, split open and place on a baking paper lined baking tray, cook in a dry oven for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once, until very lightly browned. Serve immediately.

title: Beer & Noodles
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta ( bowtie shaped ) | 1 can beer
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package. Put pasta in large casserole dish with beer& noodles. Cook for approximately 20 minutes or until noodles are coated with creamy, creamy sauce.

title: Japanese Style Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup japanese cake flour | 1 tablespoon cream or 1 tablespoon cream cheese | 1 cup sushi rice ( i use japanese senpuru, it has a sweet flavor ) or 1 cup japanese sweet vermicelli ( i use japanese sweet vermicelli ) | 2 1/2 - 3 tablespoons cashew nuts paste or 2 1/2-3 tablespoons coconut paste ( or to taste )
instructions: Sift cake flour into a mound in a deep plate. Add cream cheese and mix well, then add 2 cups rice in small increments until you have a batter resembling small pancake batter. Divide among the rice bowls and top with nuts paste. Let the rice cool for 10 minutes and top with more nuts paste or coconut paste.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,hot green chili pepper,broccoli floret,oatmeal,whipping cream,rice,leek
title: Chili and Vegetable Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked oatmeal | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 hot green chili peppers | 4 -5 tablespoons sliced leeks | 2 red chili peppers, seeded or 2 jalapeno peppers, seeds and membrane removed, divided | 4 -5 cups small broccoli florets, defrosted and coarsely chopped | hot cooked rice, accompaniment ( optional )
instructions: Bring water to boil in a medium saucepan. Combine oatmeal& whipping cream in a bowl, set aside. Place 2 chillies, 1/4 cup sliced leeks, and 3/4 cup sliced red red chili in boiling water. Cook 3 - 4 minutes or until leeks are tender crisp, drain well. Place 1/2 cup broccoli in a food processor with remaining chillies, sliced leeks, and 1/2 cup chopped red chilli. Pulse 3 - 4 times or until coarsely chopped. Pour 1/2 cup boiling water over mixture in a measuring cup. Cover and cook over low heat until the water is absorbed and the liquid is absorbed, about 25 minutes. Repeat the process, adding more boiling water or cream as needed, stirring occasionally, until the cream is reduced by 1/2. Remove from heat and stir in 1 tb rice or hot cooked spelt cooked in water. Cover and keep warm over very low heat or microwave until ready to serve. Stir in remaining red chillies, if using.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,tomato juice,green pea,mahi fillet,spinach,parmesan cheese,juniper berry,cream cheese frosting
title: Steamed Mahi Mahi With Spinach and Prosciutto (Medianoche)
ingredients: 2 hothouse mahi fillets or 2 other smoked fish fillets ( 3/4 of a pound total, cut into 2 inch pieces and tentacles left on ) | 8 ounces fresh spinach, chopped | 1/3 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 - 1/3 cup cream cheese frosting | 1 cup tomato juice or 1 cup sour cream | 3/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 3 tablespoons chopped green peas | 4 juniper berries | 1 teaspoon dry crushed juniper berries, crushed, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Lay the fish in a steamer basket over a bowl and set in one layer. Pour enough water into a saucepan to come about 2 inches up the fish. Bring to a boil over high heat, cover and steam for 6 to 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily when prodded with a fork. Remove and set aside. Drain spinach, pat dry with a paper towel. Coarsely chop it. Spread spinach on a dinner plate. Sprinkle lightly with cheese. Spread cream cheese frosting on spinach. Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top and stir to coat evenly. Sprinkle tomato juice over cheese and spinach. Sprinkle with crushed juniper and if using sour cream mixed with molasses, toasted juniper berries. Cover and steamed mahi with plastic wrap and rest for about 15 to 20 minutes. Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Line the top of a baking sheet with a double layer of foil. Place mahi on the prepared baking sheet. Spread some sour cream mixture and greens all around fish. Place the remaining fish on top and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove promptly from oven and top with pea pods and/or chopped onion.

title: Easy White Sauce
ingredients: 14 ounces cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 4 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Place the beans in a saucepan. Pour in enough water to cover and bring to the boil. Meanwhile, sift the flour into a large mixing bowl. Make a well in the middle of the flour. Break in all of the bean mixture and mix well to make a smooth paste. Remove from the heat and add a cup of boiling water. Beat until smooth. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface, knead gently and divide into 4. Wrap each of the balls in plastic wrap and chill in the refrigerator for 15 minutes. Divide each of them between 2 clean, lightly oiled, plastic bowls. Working quickly, roll each piece of dough out with your hands to 1 and 1/2cm thick. Cook in batches, until the tops are golden. Transfer to a baking paper lined oven tray. Cool the pasta in the water in the pan for 3 minutes and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,orange zest,coriander leaf,turkey,new mexico chile,habanero,marjoram,sun tomato oil
title: Beef & Huitres With Chilli, Horseradish & Tomato
ingredients: 1 boneless beef top sirloin steaks | 3 small dried new mexico chiles ( i find mine in the ethnic aisle in the supermarket ) | 4 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, halved lengthwise | 2 habanero, seeded, flesh minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, grated zest only | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram, chopped | 1/2 cup coriander leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh turkish dulse or 2 tablespoons dried mexican oregano leaves
instructions: Cut steak diagonally across grain into thin 2 cm wide slices and lay flat in large shallow dish. Heat oven to 180 c or conventional oven. Cut chilies in half lengthwise and remove membrane and seeds. Place in heat resistant bowl and cover with boiling water.

title: Scotch Clam Biscuits
ingredients: 1 pound cubed stew meat | 1 can or bottle clam juice | 1 cup quick-cooking rolled oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place stew meat and clams in a large casserole dish. Stir in oats. Cover, and bake 35 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove cover, and bake an additional 10 minutes, or until meat mixture reaches desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: pie apple,garbanzo bean,passion fruit,salad,green bean,rose water
title: Garden Chickpeas with Rose Water
ingredients: 5 cups mixed baby greens with red lentils and apples | 1/2 cup mixed sweet potato, peeled | 1 tablespoon fresh rose water | 1 tablespoon low-fat prepared salad dressing | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | pie apples, finely chopped, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place the lentils, potatoes, sweet potato, rose water, and salad dressing in a large bowl and toss to combine. Divide the potato salad among 4 serving dishes or plates. Top each with 1/2 cup of beans with remaining salad. Garnish with orange slices and serve with fresh fruit if desired.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,white wine,lemon zest,veal,vanilla syrup,heavy whipping cream,beef broth
title: Veal and Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs veal bones, with sinew removed | 2 cups beef broth | vanilla flavored syrup ( optional ) | lemon zest, to taste | 2 lbs head cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a large stew pot, combine the veal bones, broth, cinnamon and zest and simmer over very low heat for 1 - 2 hours. Add the cabbage and white wine and simmer on low medium heat for about 1/2 hour, or until the cabbage is tender. Remove the meat from the bones, reserving the broth to be used in the soup. Sauté the meat until a nice brown color has formed on top of the meat. Put the meat back into the sauce and stir in the cream. Serve warm and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,mace,floury potato,hard egg,yellow pepper,red currant jelly,pork loin,chicken breast
title: Brunede Kartofler
ingredients: 250 g red currant jelly | 1 small white chicken breast, sliced into 1. 5 cm rounds | 250 g button mushrooms | 4 large floury potatoes, peeled and cut into quarters | 2 -4 hard-boiled eggs | 1 small yellow pepper, sliced into 2. 5 cm rounds | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 12 slices pork loin, cut into 12 slices
instructions: Warm jelly and cook slowly for 15 minutes. Add chicken, mushrooms and potato, cook on low for approximately 45 minutes. Serve with egg.

title: Moroccan Lamb Roll up
ingredients: 1 lb lamb, shaved | 1 shallots or 2 spring onions, chopped | 1 can fat-free refridgerated butter spread or ( 11 ounce ) can fat-free evaporated milk | 1/4 vanilla bean, split, seeds scraped, and cut int 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Put the shaved lamb or shallot, refridgerated butter spread, vanilla bean halves and the shallot slices into a shallow baking dish, spreading evenly. Bake for 25 minutes or until the lamb has cooked and is lightly browned.

title: Amaretto Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice | 1/2 cup amaretto
instructions: Serve warm with a spoon full of amaretto as a facial mask.

Random Ingredients: ham steak,vegetable oil,dark soy sauce,milk,green chili pepper
title: Creamy Chile Salt - Homemade
ingredients: 500 g ham steaks | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 small green chili pepper, seeded | 1 1/2 liters milk
instructions: Cut your ham steak into thin strips, about ½ inch long. In a bowl add the salt and stir until well mixed. Heat a large saucepan, preferably non stick, on high heat until it is hot. Add the vegetables and cook, stirring, until tender. Add the milk in a steady stream, stirring constantly, until the milk is reduced by half. Add the salt and mix well. Reduce heat to low, cover and allow to simmer gently for 5 minutes.. The sauce should be quite thick. This can serve up to an hour, depending on the shape you use. If you like a thicker sauce, cover and reheat before serving.

Random Ingredients: coffee,ladyfinger,chick pea,sriracha chili garlic sauce,raspberry,plain flour,lime peel
title: Quick and Easy Vietnamese Dessert
ingredients: 50 g plain flour ( i use wholemeal ) | 1 cup coffee | 1/2 teaspoon ginger ( grated or grated ) | 2 tablespoons sriracha chili-garlic sauce | 30 -50 ladyfingers, peeled | 4 ripe raspberries | 1/2 cup raspberry ( frozen or fresh )
instructions: Firstly prepare the dumplings. The easiest way to do this is to roll a big bunch of dumpling out onto a lightly floured surface. This will be easier afterwards if you can roll a small handful to create it.. First, make the syrup. Place all the ingredients in a small sauce pan and boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir until the chile fragrant and is smooth. Pour over the dumplings and mix carefully so they don't stick. Let the dumplings cool in the fridge for at least an hour. To serve, cut off plenty of them to make them more manageable. Make sure your lady fingers are peeled and left intact. Put the raspberry raspberries in a heat resistant bowl and spoon the warm syrup onto the raspberries. Top with the rasparfruits and serve immediately.

title: Cousin June's Saffron Raspberries
ingredients: 500 g raspberries | 2 tablespoons saffron strands | 4 cloves garlic granules | 2 tablespoons light soya sauces
instructions: Soak the saffron strand in a little water for approx 10 mins and then rub the strands into raspberries. Place raspberries in an oven proof dish. Mix all remaining ingredients in a pan and then pour mixture over the raspberries. Mix together well and bake 20 mins at 175c, or until the cousin is dry when inserted. Let cool in pan.

Random Ingredients: olive brine,pickling salt,flour tortilla,button mushroom,turmeric,green pea
title: Mushroom and Pea Fajitas
ingredients: 8 flour tortillas | olive brine ( not salty ) | 1 tablespoon pickling salt | 1 small green peas, ends trimmed and cut into 2 inch lengths | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 lb fresh button mushroom, sliced | 5 -6 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Combine brine and salt and let stand 15 minutes. Drain brine mixture through cheesecloth, discarding brine. Add vegetables and oil and toss to coat, cover and refrigerate for up to several days, shaking off excess brine. When ready to use, divide vegetables, if using, among tortillas. Roll up and serve.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,caper,chunky salsa,chicken breast meat,phyllo pastry,parsley sprig,vanilla essence,lettuce
title: Brazilian Chicken Pie (Poulet a La Cerveza)
ingredients: 250 g spaghetti sauce | 350 g skinless chicken breast meat | 150 g phyllo pastry | 1 cup fresh parsley sprig ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup capers | 50 g chunky salsa | 100 g lettuce | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Line a 24cm spring release pan with greaseproof wrap or baking paper. Roll 1 sheet pastry to fit the base and side of the pan and overlap the pastry onto the base of the pan and brush the pastry with a little olive oil. Bake blind for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, heat half the chopped parsley. Finely chop the rest of the parsley/parsley and reserve. When the chicken has cooked add the spaghetti sauce, chicken, capers and chunky salsa and simmer until chicken is cooked and sauce is thick. To assemble the pie, slice through the middle of the pastry sheet without cutting all the way through. Fold in the sides and roll out the rest of the pastry till it is the size of the pan. Arrange it, seam side down on a baking sheet and brush with olive oil. Repeat this process, making 3 more pie until all of the pastry is used up or 3 more pie sheets are used up. Cover with a damp paper towel during the oven to keep pastry from drying out. Meanwhile remove the foil from the pastry and lightly butter the base of the dish. Lay out the phyllo pastry and scatter around to cover the base evenly. Prick it all over with a fork. Brush the pastry with olive oil and bake at 180c for 30 mins or until golden. Remove from oven and allow to cool for 5 mins, then slice into 4 even slices or wedges. Top with the lettuce, parsley sprigs and a few drops of vanilla essence. Serve with a wedge of orange peels or a little thick yoghurt, if desired.

title: Lizzie's Spinach French Toast
ingredients: 4 butter flavoured cakes, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 box frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed but not dried | 1/3 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup rum-flavored rum extract
instructions: Coat a 10x15 inch glass baking dish with nonstick spray. In a large deep fryer or a large heavy skillet, heat the buttermilk just until bubbles start to form around the edges. Add the spinach, rum and essence. Quickly stir.

Random Ingredients: vanilla wafer,red potato,salad oil,sirloin,white bread,jasmine rice
title: Grilled Steak and Potato Sandwiches
ingredients: 8 red potatoes, cut into wedges | 1 1/4 lbs sirloin, cut 1/4 inch thick ( rib eye steaks may be subsituted ) | 1/4 cup salad oil | 1 large loaf crusty white bread | 3 tablespoons salad oil | 4 thin slices red potatoes | 1/2 cup uncooked jasmine rice
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high or preheat the broiler. Place red potatoes in a large bowl. Add beef, turning to coat. Pour 1/4 cup salad oil on top of potatoes. Toss to coat. Divide meat evenly among four dinner sized pieces of bread. Roll up each piece to form a log, and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup salad oil. Grill steak for 10 - 12 minutes or to desired degree of doneness, turning once, or until instant read thermometer reaches 165 degrees. Meanwhile, toss together rice, 1 1/4 cups salad, and butter. Divide rice mixture and meat slices among dinner plates, and top with cooked potatoes. Serve with remaining salad. This recipe was designed to be served as a luncheon dish. Please use a lean steak such as skirt steak or flank steak that has a high percentage of fat, such as skirt steak or flank steak.

title: Champagne Mushroom Cap Muffins
ingredients: 1 package mushroom caps, sliced | 1/4 cup margarine | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorns, cracked | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Heat margarine in a skillet or oven.

title: Chinese Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 lb chinese-style beef jerky, thawed if frozen | 2 packages frozen mixed vegetables ( i usually just buy the frozen veggies ) | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Cut jerky in half lengthwise, then crossways, into 1/2 inch strips. In a nonreactive bowl, toss beef strips with worcestershire sauce. Store coated strips between two waxed paper sheets at least 30 minutes. Drain vegetables. Place in dehydrator, dehydrate on high, rotating strips around the dehydrator so they dry somewhat. After 30 minutes, unwrap strips and place on waxed paper. Using a slotted spoon, spread strips on jerky.

title: Gruene Bohnen
ingredients: 1 medium butternut squash or 1 medium butternut squash, peeled | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup fresh green onion, minced | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 1/2 cups double cream ( whipping cream ) | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 24 slices deli meat, sliced ( deli turkey sausage )
instructions: Cut squash in half lengthwise and remove seeds and white pith around each half. Put cut side of squash down on a cutting board and cut a slit in the skin about 1/2 inch thick. With a vegetable knife scrape the insides out of the squash. Discard outer shell and core. Cut each half into about 8 wedges about 1 inch thick. Cut each wedge crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Mix ricotta, green onion, sherry, cream, nutmeg and 1 teaspoon salt in a medium bowl until well blended. Place 3 slices of meat and the remaining 3 slices of butter in a 9 pie pan. Spread the ricotta mixture evenly in pan. Cover with the remaining 3 slices of meat and cover with the meat. Press gently with a wooden spoon to compress cheese. Cover pan with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Unwrap plastic wrap and bake for 15 minutes. Then remove from oven and place in a serving dish. Serve with a fresh green salad.

Random Ingredients: fish stock,peanut butter,thyme sprig,cauliflower floret,french bread,queso anejo,cherry tomato,gingerroot
title: Cauliflower & Tomato Soup (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 cup reduced-sodium fish stock | 1 cup french bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 2 tablespoons fresh gingerroot, peeled, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig | 1 can cherry tomatoes, drained, liquid reserved | 1 cup cauliflower floret, cut into 1 inch pieces | 3/4 lb queso anejo, sliced
instructions: Combine broth, bread, peanut butter, gingerroot, thyme, tomatoes with 1 tablespoon reserved tomato liquid in a 1 1/2 quart slow cooker. Heat to boiling over high heat, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer soup until bread is tender, about 4 minutes. Ladle soup into bowls.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,serrano chili pepper,hash brown potato,cream cheese,spanish olive,italian breadcrumb
title: Mexican Hash Browns
ingredients: 4 large parsnips, peeled and cut in 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup chopped roasted peeled whole spanish olives | 1 serrano chili pepper, seeded and minced | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 packages cream cheese | 6 lbs frozen southern fried potatoes, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to in large bowl, mix parsnips, olives, chili pepper, sour cream, italian bread crumbs and cream cheese. Arrange in one layer on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 40 minutes. Bake 10 minutes longer depending on oven temperature and type of potatoes used. Cut into wedges to serve.

title: Apricot Rice Krispies Treats
ingredients: 2 cups crispy rice krispies | 1 teaspoon apricot jam | 1 container plain low fat yogurt
instructions: Dip half of rice krispies into yogurt. Place in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Repeat with remaining krispies and yogurt. Bake in a 350 degree f oven until golden brown.

title: Quick and Easy Artichoke and Cucumber Wings
ingredients: 1 cucumber | 2 cooked chicken wings ( optional ) | 4 frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 1 tablespoon cake flour ( or rice flour ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Cut cucumber lengthwise into thirds. Place on paper towels in a large bowl and sprinkle with salt on both sides. Toss to cover. Let sit 10 minutes, then drain any liquid from bowl and discard. Sprinkle cucumber with flour and garlic, shaking off excess. Place dough in a large plastic zipper bag. Slash down the center of the bag a few times to release air pockets. Cut a few slits in top of dough, then place in bowl with cucumber and artichoke hearts. Repeat with remaining dough. Place bag on top of a tray, sealed side up. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees, then remove the bag from the tray. Slit top of bag several times with a sharp knife, cutting several slits all around the edge of bag for steam to escape. Bake bread for 45 minutes, then remove from oven and set aside until cool enough to handle. Turn dough out onto a floured board and divide into 10 pieces for the hearts and 10 pieces for the wings. If using wings, place on separate baking sheets lined with parchment paper and cut each into 6 pieces. Repeat until all wings are used. If using onions, place cut up pieces on a baking sheet and bake in oven for 25 minutes or until tender. If using mushrooms, place in oven until tender. Serve with dipping sauce, such as dipping sauce.

title: Cholula
ingredients: 4 cups pureed green food coloring | 2 cans chipotle chiles | 4 teaspoons dried oregano | 4 teaspoons dried gingerroot | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Puree canned chilies, oregano, gingerroot and chile powder together in a food processor or blender until well blended. Strain into a bowl, and add lime jace, vodka and chili oil. Mix well. Use immediately to decorate mint spoons for use as decorations.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,jam,cumin powder,tomato green chilies,puff pastry,pistachio nut,fennel bulb,active yeast
title: Fennel and Mustard Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, cleaned and cubed | 1 jar tomatoes and green chilies, drained well and chopped fine | 1 teaspoon dried active dry yeast or 2 1/2 tablespoons dry active yeast | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 7 sheets frozen puff pastry or 7 sheets fresh puff pastry, thawed ( 15 x 15 inch pieces ) | freshly ground jam | pistachio nut | 1 teaspoon prepared roasted & grated fresh cheese or 2 teaspoons grated fresh parmesan cheese
instructions: Note, use poudre, chunky tomatoes instead of chillis. Cut fennel bulb into 2 inch long slivers. Combine chopped fennel, tomatoes, yeast and cumin powder in a large bowl. Add fennel, chilies, dough scraper and 1 teaspoon salt. Let stand in warm place overnight. Preheat oven to 325 degrees. On a floured board, roll out pastry to 8 x 8 inch rectangle. Cover with plastic wrap and a kitchen towel and allow to rise until it has almost doubled in size, about 45 minutes, depending on the oven temperature in your oven. On a floured board, roll out pastry to 9 x 12 inch rectangle. On a floured board, roll out pastry again to 9x 12 inch rectangle. Cover remaining half slice of pastry with plastic wrap and a kitchen towel. Fold bottom slice of dough over top slice of pastry, leaving about 1 inch over edge. Seal edges. Slide focaccia onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush top with jam. Grate cheese over top of pastry. Sprinkle top with pistachios. Bake until golden, about 45 minutes, rotating about half way through baking. Allow to stand 5 minutes before cutting, if desired. Cool for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Prosciutto With Onions
ingredients: 1 package prosciutto | 1 can condensed onion soup mix
instructions: Cut prosciutto in half length wise and then crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Place ham slices on a sheet of aluminum aluminum foil or parchment paper and spray with cooking spray. Spread soup mix over ham, making sure to coat each slice completely. Wrap each slice with a piece of prosciutto and seal all the seams with toothpicks. Heat heavy skillet in a preheated oven 350 degrees f for 20 minutes. Turn the ham over and bake for 30 minutes more, or until ham is well browned.

Random Ingredients: thai red chili pepper,asparagus,peanut,beef sirloin,yellow curry paste,pork tenderloin,dark soy sauce
title: Chile Pork With Asparagus
ingredients: 3 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 3/4-inch slices | 1 lb beef sirloin, cut into 1 1/2-inch slices | 0.5 can dark soy sauce, undiluted | 2 tablespoons yellow curry paste | 8 -10 asparagus, cut lengthwise into 2-inch lengths | peanuts, roasted for garnish ( can substitute ) | fresh thai red chili pepper, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a plastic bag, combine all ingredients and mix well. Add meat, a few at a time, turning to coat thoroughly with marinade. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Bring to room temperature. Remove meat from plastic bag, place on broiler pan or cookie sheet, and broil 2 - 3 minutes or until meat is well browned outside but not cooked inside. Remove meat from oven and place on serving platter, sprinkle with roasted peanuts, and spoon hot pepper sauce over.

title: Swiss Melon Soup With Gruyere Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 watermelon, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 ounces cream cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes | 6 cups water | dried thyme sprigs ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a stockpot and simmer over low heat until watermelon is tender, about 15 - 20 minutes. Serve topped with sour cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,vanilla,cilantro leaf,pumpkin flesh,salt,white sugar,bacon grease
title: Southern Fried Cannellini Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds fresh medium-sized clams in shell, cleaned | 6 slices bacon grease, divided | 1/4 cup pumpkin flesh | 1 1/2 cups prepared clam juice | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/3 teaspoon salt
instructions: Fill a large pot with water, and place over high heat. When it comes to a rolling boil, stir in the clams, and return to a boil. Cook the clams for about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Drain, and set aside. Dice bacon, and set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons of bacon grease in a large skillet over medium high heat. Quickly fry the pumpkin until it is golden, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Place the clam juice, vanilla, sugar, and salt into the skillet, and stir until the sugar has dissolved. Place the bacon/pumpkin mixture into the skillet, cover, and simmer over medium heat for 20 minutes. Remove cover and simmer for 10 more minutes, until shrimp are pink and soft.

title: Japanese Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sake | 3 tablespoons curry powder, mild hotness | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato, soaked in a little | sake, hot | 1 iceberg lettuce, shredded, not too big | 1 clove ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan boil the water and then stir in all ingredients except for the cabbage. Put in the cabbage and stir for 2 - 3 minutes, add more hotness if needed. Drain the cabbage well and mix the cabbage and dressing.

title: Cottage Cheese (Beef) Smothered in White Vinegar for 2
ingredients: 1 lb cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon beef eye round, smoked
instructions: Preheat oven to 300'f or 180'c. Place beef in a saucepan. Cover with vinegar and water. Bake for one hour or until beef is tender and cooked through. Slice the beef thinly and serve with a sprinkling of ground black pepper.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,soda water,picante sauce,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Tortilla Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 envelope italian salad dressing | 1/2 cup shredded flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 2/3 cups soda water
instructions: Bring picante sauce, salad dressing, and parsley to a boil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer until sauce has thickened, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in soda water until dissolved, then cover and refrigerate until cold, at least 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,white sandwich bread,maraschino cherry,tamarind pulp
title: Tamarind Toast (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 1 package white sandwich bread, or more to taste, cut into 6 slices ( bread dough recommended ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded fresh maraschino cherries, divided | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp, or more to taste | 1/3 cup fish sauce
instructions: Tear the bread pieces into 1/2 inch pieces, and place on a microwave safe plate with the 1 1/2 cups of maraschino cherries and 3 tablespoons of tamarind pulp. Cover loosely with plastic wrap, and cook in microwave until hot, about 2 minutes. Drizzle fish sauce over the bread, and sprinkle with remaining cherries. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,mace,red chile pepper,sharp cheddar cheese,rice cracker,broth,mango chutney
title: Quick, Easy Indian-Style Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup minced mango chutney | 1 tablespoon minced fresh red chile pepper | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 16 small rice crackers | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 2 3/4 cups leftover broth
instructions: Place the cheese, chutney, red chili and orange zest in a bowl and mix together to combine. Spread 1/4 cup of the chutney mixture over the bottom of a 12 inch saute pan. Place the rice crackers in another bowl and pour the broth over the top of the rice crackers. Bring the broth to a full boil over medium high heat. Cover, reduce heat to low, and let simmer until the water is absorbed and the rice crackers are tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat, let cool for a minute or two, then stir in the remaining 1/4 cup chutney mixture. Season to taste with salt and pepper and sprinkle with the mace. Preheat the grill or broiler to high. Remove the cheeses from the bowl, transfer to a serving dish, and drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of chutney mixture. Return them to the serving bowls and serve immediately.

title: Simple Simple Spaghetti Sauce for a Crock Pot!
ingredients: 1 can cream of tomato soup | 1 can italian stewed tomatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a sauce pan. Simmer for 30 minutes. To freeze, place the sauce in a zipper bag and freeze until you need to make a dinner. You can also prepare this as i have done, but it is much more elegant when you can just stir all the ingredients together. I also freeze it for quick meals. That way, you can do everything and have this over night. I usually watch it simmer for 30 minutes, then serve with grated parmesan cheese on top, chopped green onion and some grated extra virgin olive oil. This makes enough for 2 lbs of sauce for a 3 lb. Of sauce.

title: Fattigmans Bakess (Lamb With Peppers)
ingredients: 1/2 kg leg of lamb | 3 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 yellow pepper | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 300 g roasted sweet peppers
instructions: Boil up 500g of water. Cut and remove the meat pieces. Leave aside. Mix the sugar and salt with the water. Bring to boil. Put in the lamb and stir for 10 minutes. Put the green pepper on the top. Baste with water. Add 1 tsps of saffron oil. Remove from burner. Leave the pan with the meat for 10 minute. Then put on a big oven proof dish. And close the lid. Place in the oven at about 200c for about 45 minutes. Slice the meat. When the time is up, you can put the meat in a pre heated oven as well. Remove and serve with rice and veggies. You can also serve on top of the roasted sweet peppers or serve with pitta bread or rice bread. A nice salad with boiled rice.

title: Super Simple Rice Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, washed | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Heat your rice cooker or microwave for 15 - 20 seconds. Place the contents of the rice cooker/turcketida in your rice cooker/custard bowl. Add enough boiling water to the rice to cover with 2 - 3 cups. Close the cover and turn the heat on. Let it sit on high for 4 - 5 minutes. Uncover rice and fluff with a fork. Mix in almond extract and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,green chilies,garlic salt,extra tofu,creole seasoning
title: Lime Roasted Tofu, Green Chile, Chile Dip, and Chile
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, drained reserving excess water | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice, or to taste | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 2 cans chopped green chilies, drained | creole seasoning, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with paper towels. Beat reserved tofu and lemon juice in a blender until smooth.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,chinese five spice powder,pork roast
title: Chinese Barbecue Pork Roast
ingredients: 8 -10 lbs boneless pork roast | 12 slices fresh chinese five spice powder ( or to taste, i use tone's ) | 8 ounces low fat canned reduced-fat cream of mushroom soup or 8 ounces 98 % fat-free cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Set oven temperature to 400 degrees. Rub roast with five spice powder. Place roast fat side up on rack in roasting pan or glass baking dish. Pour soup on top, then sprinkle top with more five spice powder. Roast, uncovered, for an hour, until internal temperature of the meat reaches 195 degrees. Internal temperature should reach 145 degrees for a medium rare roast.

title: Farfalle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces arborio rice | 4 ounces gorgonzola cheese, cubed | 1 can canned tart apples, drained | 1 tablespoon minced garlic or 1 tablespoon fresh minced garlic | 1 tablespoon minced ginger | 2 packages refrigerated farfalle pasta or ( 9 ounce ) packages rotelle pasta, cooked according to package directions with no salt added | 1 bag frozen strawberries or 1 bag red and green strawberries | 1 jar sliced pared strawberries
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package directions or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,soybean,monterey jack cheese,syrup,vegetable stock chicken,orange twist
title: Rendering Vegetarian Oyster Motoyaki
ingredients: 1/2 lb yellow endive lettuce ( optional ) or 1/2 lb spinach ( optional ) | 1/4 cup soybean roll syrup ( optional ) | 4 slices monterey jack cheese | 1 orange twist | 1/4 cup vegetable stock or 1/4 cup chicken stock | dill pickle ( optional )
instructions: Wash the endive in cold water until it can be removed easily. Slice the endive on the diagnol into thin ribbons approximately ¼ inch wide. Bring the stock to a boil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,hot pepper,beef chuck,queso fresco,pomegranate seed,digestive biscuit,sugar,pineapple juice
title: Cuban Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 12 ounces beef chuck, thinly sliced | 8 ounces queso fresco, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 2 cans condensed condensed digestive biscuits | 1 teaspoon sugar | 3 tablespoons pineapple juice
instructions: Heat corn oil in 6 quart skillet, add beef and cook over medium heat for 2 to 8 minutes or until brown. Add cheese and nuts, cook over medium heat until cheese is melted and the nuts are starting to brown, stirring constantly.. Pour over the noodles and add the condensed biscuits to the skillet, stir and heat. Combine sugar and pineapple juice, add to the pan. Cool for 20 minutes, serve on french toast.

title: Jambalaya Style - Caribbean Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 pound cubed beef stew meat | 2 cans chopped green chile peppers, or more to taste | 2 cups currants | 1 can crabmeat, drained
instructions: Mix the beef stew meat, green chile peppers, currants, and crabmeat together in a large pot. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: flour,kaffir lime leaf,corn tortilla chip,water,nutmeg,watermelon,sea salt
title: Fried Watermelon (Or Spinach) Salsa With Chips
ingredients: 2 cups water | 1/4 cup powdered flaked sea salt | 1 1/4 cups warm water | 2 green kaffir lime leaves, chopped finely | 1 small melon, cut into chunks ( or 1-inch diameter semi-ripe melon ) | 1/3 cup dry-roasted chopped nuts ( try feta ) | 8 ounces plain corn tortilla chips or 8 ounces corn chips, broken into halves
instructions: Combine the water, powdered salt and flour in a mixing bowl. Stir until well blended and set aside. Drain the watermelon on paper towels. Place chunks into a blender, add the kaffir lime leaves, and process to a smooth, semi creamy consistency. Spread 1/8 cup of the salsa on each of four plates.
