Sprinkle with nuts and serve with the chips.

title: Cheese With Turmeric (Tukukra)
ingredients: 2 lbs american cheese, grated ( about 10 slices ) | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: In a small bowl, mix all ingredients. Cut remaining american cheese into 2 or 3 pieces and place on a serving platter in alternate layers. Pour the prepared mixture over the processed cheese.

title: Asparagus and Wild Rocket Parcels With Oaty Crunch
ingredients: 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh parsley | 180 g portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup chopped asparagus spear | 1/2 cup rocket | cooking oats
instructions: Lightly sprinkle golden syrup over mushroom and toss through.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,feta cheese,almond extract,sherry,chili pepper flake
title: Poppy Seed and Feta Spread
ingredients: 1/2 lb feta cheese | sherry ( optional ) | 1 dash chili pepper flakes | 1 dash almond extract | poppy seed ( optional )
instructions: Slice the feta cheese into long thin strips, about 1 inches long. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add 1/4 cup of feta cheese to a bowl and pour in about 1/4 cup of sherry, if using. Add the chili flakes, almond extract and poppy seeds to the bowl of cheese and stir with a fork or a wooden spoon until all is well incorporated. Transfer cheese to the bowl of cheese mixture and serve when cheese is melted and starting to turn light brown, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tarragon leaf,flat leaf parsley,chicken stock cube,margarine,corn tortilla chip,yellow bell pepper
title: Roasted Bell Pepper Tostadas
ingredients: 3 large red bell peppers ( or yellow bell peppers ) | 2 teaspoons tarragon leaves | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon margarine | 2 teaspoons chicken stock cubes | 2 cups corn tortilla chips, crushed to a coarse texture
instructions: Line the bottom and sides of a large flameproof casserole dish with the tortilla chips. Set aside. Cut the bell peppers in half and remove the seeds and membranes. Using a vegetable peeler, remove the skin and seeds from the peppers and set them aside. Cut the peppers in half and set them aside. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the peppers, bell and tarragon in the dish, season with salt and black pepper, and set aside. Dry the margarine well in a bowl and pour in 1 cup water. Place the remaining 1 cup of water in a heavy bottomed saucepan and place over low heat. When the water is hot add the bell pepper halves, season with salt and pepper, and cook over medium heat, turning occasionally, until the peppers are soft and dark, around 10 to 12 minutes. Drain the water out of the peppers and add them to the bowl of pepper mixture. Blend the peppers and pepper mixture until well combined. Add half of the chicken stock and blend until fairly smooth. Spoon into the prepared casserole, cover and bake for 30 to 35 minutes until hot and bubbling.

title: Cocktail Chorizo
ingredients: 1 package mexican chorizo sausage | 1 head fresh asparagus, cut into 6 inch pieces | 2 large fresh tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 cup plain graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook chorizo in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring to crumble, until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain. Stir asparagus, tomatoes, and lemon juice into chorizo.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,beef broth,stewing beef,spinach,cooking oil,peanut,lebanese cucumber
title: Beef Curry
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef, cut into bite size pieces | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups beef broth | 4 tablespoons quick-cooking oil | 2 lebanese cucumbers, peeled and sliced | 100 g coarsely chopped fresh spinach ( or use frozen ) | 4 tablespoons coarsely chopped roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees centigrade. Fry the stew beef in the oil in a heavy based oven proof pan until well browned. Pour in the chicken broth and bring to the boil. Cover and transfer to the preheated oven. Cook in the oven for 6 hours. Meanwhile, in a separate skillet, fry the cucumber until tender, drain and remove the flesh from the skins by squeezing the flesh with the back of a large spoon. Place the cucumber flesh in a food processor and pulse to make 1 cup. Return to the pan and bring to the boil. Cook over a low heat for 10 minutes, covered. Heat the remaining oil in a wok or heavy frying pan over a high heat. Add the lemon peel and cook for 2 minutes, stirring or tossing well. Add the coconut and continue to cook for 1 - 2 minutes. Add the cabbage and mix well. Serve with the peanuts on top.

title: The Best Italian Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 1 tablespoon celery salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight container.

title: Plaice
ingredients: 1 cantaloupe fillet | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Remove the seed of the cantaloupe and cut in small chunks. Sprinkle with the sugar and cinnamon. Pour catsup over the fish and coat.

title: Port Wine and Oranges (Vivianco Com Ervilhas Com Hortela)
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/3 lbs oranges | 1 3/4 cups port wine | 1 1/2 - 2 cups fresh lemon juice | 1/4 lb fresh lemon juice
instructions: Peel oranges removing pith and white pith then cut in half lengthwise, removing and discarding the peel. Cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices crosswise. Place the oranges and port in a 4 - 6 qt. Saucepan over moderate heat. Scrape any citrus residue from the oranges with a rubber spatula. Stir frequently until the wine is reduced by half. Add the 1 1/2 1/2 c of the lemon juice and the lemon juice. Cover and heat, shaking the pan until the liquid is thick, 2 - 3 minutes. Cook, stirring occasionally, 5 minutes longer or until the mixture is reduced to half. Serve the liquid hot, warm or at room temperature. Variation, replace the 3/4 c of lemon juice with 3/4 c of orange juice. It may be transferred to a plastic bottle after chilling for several days.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,corn oil,cilantro,red cabbage,salmon fillet,white wine,red curry paste
title: Asian Red Curry Salmon
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon light soya sauce | 2 -3 teaspoons corn oil | 1 -2 tablespoon dry white wine ( or a sweet sherry ) | 1 cup chopped red cabbage | 1 cup chopped smoked salmon fillet | chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: In a small bowl combine curry paste with soya sauce and corn oil and add wine. Mix well. Place cabbage and salmon into marinade and marinade in fridge for at least 30 minutes for flavours to develop. Preheat the grill or stove plate to medium high heat. Place salmon on grill/wipe off excess marinade then cook until cooked through. Drain off any excess marinade. Add the sauce mixture to the bowl with the salmon and mix through. Garnish with fresh cilantro.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,yellow pepper,seasoning salt,cherry tomato,whipping cream,onion,pork loin
title: Cherry Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1/3 cup finely chopped onion | 3 -4 medium cherry tomatoes ( or tomatoes or roma ) | 1 -2 -2 serrano chili ( or green chili ) | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning ( or salt ) | 1/2 large yellow peppers or 1 large red bell pepper
instructions: Pour cream in medium large saucepan. Slice or quarter a bell pepper at a time across the stem of cherry tomatoes or Roma pepper, and place around pepper. Sprinkle chilies with poultry seasoning or salt, and place over top. Add enough water to cover. Heat to a low boil 15 - 20 minutes, and simmer for about 15 minutes or longer, depending on how tender you like your soup. Serve warm, or chill, and serve hot. Garnish with parm cheese.

title: German Hard-Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Peel the hard boiled eggs with a knife and carefully run them under cold water. This is easiest if you don't remove the yolks from the shells. Remove the hard shell and scoop out the very yolks. Then shell them by removing the hard boiled egg part. Place them back into a bowl and fill with boiling, salted water. Leave for five minutes to harden. Gather up some of the hard boiled egg pieces and gently peel them off. Cut them in half lenghtwise and remove any membrane. Scoop the hard boiled egg flesh from the shells. Discard the hard boiled egg whites. Serve with sour cream or mayonnaise or a sweet and sour dressing.

title: Ricotta Pudding (Sponge)
ingredients: 1/2 bottle vodka, approx. ( or use regular vodka ) | 1 lb ricotta cheese ( or cream cheese ) | 8 ounces cinnamon
instructions: You can use a regular ricotta. It can be thick, but it will thicken a bit. If it does not thicken enough, add a touch of sugar and add some cinnamon. Pour 2 pints of cold water. Put the cinnamon stick in there until the water reaches the 1/4 inch at the top. You can stick it in there too. Stir, let sit a few minutes or so, until a spoon collects on it. If the cinnamon sticks become too soft, just drop a little bit of water into the water now and stir. If they seem to stick, put a little water on them and stir. If the taste is bland, add more cinnamon. Fill a large bowl with ice, put the ricotta in a bowl& stir. Add the vodka& cinnamon stick. Mix well until all of the ingredients are evenly covered. Put into the fridge for one hour or longer. When ready to serve, add a spoonful of warm water into the bowl and stir to mix. Add more cinnamon and other herbs if you like/need a bit of these. Some recipes like to add a pinch or two of garlic powder while in the fridge and you may need to use more cinnamon than you think you want. It is hard to say, but i find that the vodka tastes best as long as it is sweet& sour.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,mace,pecorino romano cheese,thyme leave,breadcrumb,basil pesto,maraschino cherry
title: Pesto and Spinach (Or Feta) Wedges
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup basil pesto | 1 large piece loaf crusty bread, 1/2-inch thick | 1 teaspoon dried basil pesto | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leave | 1 teaspoon dried maraschino cherry, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Combine the first seven ingredients in a large bowl and roll spinach mixture into walnut sized chunks. Arrange the wedges on a greased, rimmed baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes until crisp. Remove from the oven.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,white wine vinegar,kalamata olive,pumpkin seed,cornflour,pear,bicarbonate soda
title: Hot Pear Soup With Cornflour
ingredients: 1 kg ripe pear, halved, de-seeded and cored | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 500 ml apple juice | 200 ml white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 40 g kalamata olives, pips | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds
instructions: Place pear halves skin side down on a wire rack to cool. Once cold, remove pears from the peel and cut into cubes. Set aside. Place apple juice, vinegar and bicarb in a large saucepan and bring to boil over high heat. Stirring occasionally, heat for about 5 minutes. Place cornflour in a small bowl, mix the cornflour with a little of the apple juice mixture to form a paste and add to the remaining apple juice, stirring constantly. Cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Add pears and cook for another 5 minutes until the pears are tender but not mushy. Add olives and cook for 2 minutes more, stirring regularly. Remove from heat. Add pears and olives to the soup. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours before serving. Serve into small bowls with a sprinkling of poppy seeds.

title: Red Chile Paste
ingredients: 1/2 cup cumin | 1 cup chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Blend all of the ingredients together. Store in a tightly covered jar in the refrigerator. To use paste it makes a mild, sweet red chili.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter ice cream,hot chili sauce,pesto sauce,coconut milk,cucumber
title: Vegan Prawn Appetizers (Cucumber Prawns)
ingredients: 600 g prawns ( large, cleaned, shelled, deveined and finely chopped ) | 250 ml coconut milk | 1 cup hot chili sauce | 1/2 cup pesto sauce, bottled ( i used bottled ) | 1 large cucumber, medium size, sliced | 125 ml peanut butter ice cream
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients, except the peanut butter ice cream and spread into a rectangular block with a diameter of 20cm. Place the prawns on top of the mixture. Top with peanut butter ice cream. Refrigerate until set, about 30 minutes. Serve.

title: Cashew Nut Balls (From East Africa)
ingredients: 1 cup raw cashew nuts | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs ( japanese breadcrumbs ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Toss nuts and panko in the center of the oil, and cook until golden brown and crackly, about 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from the pan and set aside. Preheat broiler. Toast cardamom in a dry skillet over high heat for 1 minute. Remove and immediately pour into a bowl, allowing it to settle. Pour nut mixture into bowl and sprinkle cardamom over nuts. Place balls on a serving dish and dust with additional panko.

title: Italian Sausage and Potato Casserole
ingredients: 600 g sweet italian turkey sausage | 4 potatoes or 4 yams, diced | 1 can red chilies | 375 ml evaporated milk | 800 g condensed milk | 2 red chilies, chopped
instructions: Grease a lg loaf pan. Cube the meat into bite sized pieces. Slice the chilies into thin strips about 1 long. Place in the loaf pan. Cover with the sweet sausage and potato or yam. Mix well and pour the evaporated milk over all. Place the chillies on top of all. Cover and place in the oven for 1 hr or until tender and the potato is meltingly.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,orange juice concentrate,kale,oregano,russet potato,green cardamom pod
title: Aloo Gobi (Curried Lentil Soup) from India
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable broth or 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 green cardamom pods, crushed | 3 1/2 teaspoons minced oregano | 1 1/2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cubed roughly | 2 cans orange juice concentrate, thawed | 2 cups diced kale
instructions: Add the oil, cardamom, and oregano to a large saucepan. Over medium heat, add the potatoes. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the edges begin to give. You notice that the edges of the potatoes, if browned and crusty, begin to turn brown. Be sure to scrape the bottom of the pan to make sure it's all a little brown. If not, stir in a little water. When the bottom of the pan and all the crusty bits start to look a little brown, add the orange juice concentrate and kale. Bring to a boil.

title: Chilean Tostada
ingredients: 1 tortillas | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/4 black, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Fold tortillas into four.

Random Ingredients: greek salad dressing,linguine,green chili pepper,oregano leaf,fatback,cajun seasoning,scotch bonnet pepper,cardamom seed
title: Cajun Spicy Baked Linguine
ingredients: 1/2 lb fatback | 8 ounces dried linguine | 2 tablespoons fat, from canned sausages, drained, fat removed | 2 tablespoons greek salad dressing | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon grated cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1/2 green chili pepper, finely chopped | 2 scotch bonnet peppers, finely chopped or 2 habanero chiles, finely diced
instructions: In a 12 frying pan or skillet, cook the fatback over moderate heat, stirring, until it is lightly browned. Drain the fat and add to the linguine. Turn the pasta so it is evenly coated and sprinkle with the greek salad dressing and the spices. Toss until the pasta is well coated. Transfer to a lightly oiled 10 x 6 inch baking dish. Add the chile or habanero chilies and the scotch bonnet or chile powder. Bake, uncovered in a preheated 400f oven for 30 minutes, until sauce is bubbly and the ingredients are crisp and heated through.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,coffee granule,lettuce leaf,hot noodle,parsley leaf
title: Spiced Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 lb cooked hot noodles | 1/4 cup finely chopped red cabbage | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules, dissolved | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 6 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Combine cooked noodles, cabbage and sugar and set aside. Combine 2 t. Of dressing with 1/4 cup cold water and set aside. Combine mustard & 2 t. Of dressing with the parsley and add to noodle mixture in bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for 1/2 hour to develop flavors. Arrange lettuce on lettuce leaves. Fold in lettuce leaves then serve.

title: Rooster and Ham Glazed With Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup honey | 1/4 cup brandy | 4 chicken thighs | 2 lbs chuck | 2 cups blueberries or 2 cups cranberries | 1 tablespoon ginger juice | 3 sheets rice noodles | 4 slices ham
instructions: Combine the honey, brandy, and chicken in a gallon ziploc bag and marinate chicken and pork for at least two hours. Meanwhile, clean and rinse the rice noodles and place in hot water to cover, turn when boiling for 45 seconds. Rinse and drain noodles, place noodles in a bowl and cover with cold water, drain. Pat chicken dry and put on a rack in a roasting pan. Add 1 inch of water to the chicken in the roasting pan and cook. When chicken is cooked, remove it from the oven, cover and rest in the fridge for 30 minutes. Remove chicken from the pan and set aside. Increase the broiler to high heat and sear the meat. Remove meat from roasting pan and set aside. When all meat is cooked remove meat from pan and reserve. Return pan to the stove and brown the blueberries. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange on a platter with slices of ham on top and pour glaze over the top. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,walnut,roast beef,goat cheese,pancetta,red onion
title: OAMc Roast Beef With Chipped Pancetta, Goats Cheese, and Smoked Walnuts
ingredients: 1/2 lb thinly sliced pancetta ( or bacon ) | 1/4 cup thinly sliced red onion | 12 ounces shaved roast beef or 12 ounces smoked leftover chipped beef | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup chopped toasted walnuts | 1 package crumbled farmer's cheese
instructions: In non stick skillet, cook pancetta and chopped onion on medium heat until onions are tender, about 3 minutes. Add roast beef, mushroom soup, and 1/2 the walnuts. Stir until well mixed and hot, about 5 minutes. Place meat mixture over medium heat in casserole and cover loosely with foil. Cook in 350 degree oven for 40 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle remaining walnuts on top, and cook for 3 minutes or until walnuts are toasted.

title: Lobster and Lobster Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh lobster meat | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 pound pork shoulder, boneless and cubed
instructions: Place the lobster meat, seasoned salt and cubed pork shoulder in a resealable plastic bag and squeeze out the excess air. Add the lobster and massage to combine well. Push the air out of the bag and seal. Massage, turning it over gently, into a 1 1/2 wide cylinder. Tightly wrap in plastic. Refrigerate for 3 hours. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Set the steamer on the table over medium high heat. Arrange the lobster cylinder on the foil lined steamer, and loosely cover to wilt the lobster in the steam. Wrap the foil around the lobster and steam for 20 minutes. Remove the lobster from the steamer and serve.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,orange peel,white flour,cooking oil,pizza crust
title: Homemade Pizza Appetizers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 4 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon white flour | 12 1/2 ounces prepared pizza crust
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except pizza dough. On a lightly floured surface, roll out each dough slice into a circle that is about 1/8 thickness. Transfer 1/4 of the mixture to a prepared pizza pan or large cookie sheet, sprinkle with a little flour to moisten. Top with remaining dough mixture, pressing the edges to form the crust. Brush the tops with the orange glaze. Use a pastry brush to make the glaze as creative as possible. Bake at 400°f for 30 minutes.

title: My Favorite Basmati Rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup basmati rice | 1 cup fully cooked ham ( i buy it on the internet )
instructions: Mix ham with rice. Wrap and cook in a baking dish. I do not like the ham, so i microwave on high until fully cooked. I can also substitute meat for the ham and omit the rice this time.

title: Crusty Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 7 ounces fat free cream cheese | 1 tablespoon prepared pickled chipotle chiles | 1/4 cup custard powder | 1 cup dry beef or 1 cup sausage meat, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 150 degrees fahrenheit. Combine the cream cheese and chipotles in a bowl and stir until blended. Mix in the custard powder. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture in a 9x13 baking dish. Layer with the meat, then the remaining cheese and ending with the meat, ending with the last piece of cheese on top. Bake in the oven about 15 minutes or until the center is bubbly and casserole is hot throughout.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,baking soda,quinoa,cherry,chicken breast half,cauliflower floret
title: Couscous With Chicken and Roasted Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 can plum tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups fresh cauliflower florets, divided | 1 1/2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Place quinoa in a medium baking dish. Stir the baking soda into quinoa.

Random Ingredients: white onion,grain white rice,chili sauce,stout beer
title: Beer and Rice (Easy)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice ( or japanese vermicelli or angel hair ) | 1/2 cup chili sauce ( a spicy hot beer or sweet chili sauce, or a chile de arbol chili paste will also do ) | 1/2 cup white onion, chopped | 1 1/2 cups stout beer
instructions: Put a pot of water on to boil. Add in the rice and stir, it will boil very fast, so stir every 2 minutes to keep from burning. After the 2 minutes, remove the rice with a slotted spoon. Put the chili sauce and sliced onion in and stir to incorporate. Put the rice back in to the pot. You still want the moisture. It cooks out. Remove from the heat. Scoop out rice and put it back into the pot. You can use a slotted spoon, you don't have to use your hands, or a slotted spoon, to throw any extra rice back into the pot. Give the mixture a stir again. Add the beer. Stir. The liquid should be about 2 - 3 tablespoons or enough to barely cover the rice, but you probably won't. Return to high heat, reduce the heat, and let it simmer for about a half an hour, stirring occasionally. After about 15 - 20 minutes, taste with the chili sauce, stir. You can serve with mashed potato, or eat it right away. Enjoy.

title: Beef With Chickpeas and Collards
ingredients: 500 g beef chuck, trimmed & cut into 1cm strips | 1 large red capsicum, halved & then cut into 1cm slices | 1 bunch fresh collard greens, rinsed and coarsely torn | 1/4 cup chickpeas, drained | 2 bunches bok choy
instructions: Over high heat in a large, heavy based saucepan, cook beef in batches, stirring for 2 mins or until browned and cooked to your required doneness. Transfer to a plate, add capsicum, collard greens and chickpeas and mix well. Return pan to the heat. Add enough water to come up 3/4 way up the side of the meat and bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium, cover and simmer for 20 mins, or until meat is tender. Add bok choy and cook, shaking pan over heat for 1 min or until just beginning to wilt. Serve with white rice sprinkled with fresh herbs.

title: Curried Tomato Salad (Indian)
ingredients: 2 lbs cherry tomatoes | 2 bunches green onions, chopped ( white part only ) | 12 ounces fresh mixed fruit, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon oil
instructions: Prepare tomatoes by peeling them away from the pits, cutting them in halves and gently flattening them out with the back of a knife. Spray the tomatoes in a fry pan with cooking spray or olive oil and fry over a medium heat for about 6 to 8 minutes, turning once, until browned. Remove from pan and set aside. Fry green onions in skillet for about 3 minutes and add the chopped fruit. Cook 1 minute more. Return tomatoes and green onions to pan and toss in curry powder, seasoning salt and oil. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: natural peanut butter,green chilies,lasagna noodle,turnip,tomato sauce,cream chicken soup,spaghetti,lime wedge
title: Mexican Vegetable Lasagna
ingredients: 2 boxes lasagna noodles | 1 box frozen turnips | 1 package spaghetti | 250 ml tomato sauce | 250 ml cream of chicken soup | 1 lime wedge ( optional ) | 1/4 cup natural-style peanut butter ( optional ) | 2 -3 green chilies, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, bring 3 1/2 cups water to a boil. Add noodles and turnips. Cook until tender but still firm, about 6 - 8 minutes. Drain. In a large bowl, combine tomato sauce, cream of chicken soup and remaining ingredients. Mix well. Layer noodles, sauce mixture and turnips into a 9 x 13 inch baking dish sprayed lightly with pam cooking spray. Bake, uncovered at 350 degrees f for 30 - 35 minutes, or until heated through. Garnish with lime wedge and green chilies, if desired.

Random Ingredients: caper,self rising flour,corn tortilla chip,poppy seed
title: Crispy Poppy Seed Chips
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour, or as needed | 1 teaspoon poppy seeds | 1 tablespoon corn tortilla chips | 1/4 cup capers, drained, or more
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Mix flour, poppy seeds, and corn tortilla chips in a bowl. Stir capers into the flour mixture using a fork. Place about 3 tablespoons of the chip mixture onto the parchment paper. Bake in the preheated oven until browned, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Fried Canadian Bacon With Raisins (Nuoc Cham)
ingredients: 2 slices canadian bacon, cut into 1/4 inch sticks | 2 tablespoons canadian bacon fat | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/4 cup rice vinegar
instructions: In a skillet, cook each piece of Canadian bacon over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 3 minutes or until the bacon is crisp. Stir in the canadian bacon fat, fish sauce and rice vinegar. Reduce heat and simmer gently, stirring occasionally, for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Lettuce and Brandy Wine Ripe Soda Bread
ingredients: kosher salt | 12 ounces iceberg lettuce, rinsed, drained and torn into smaller pcs | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 4 cups stock ( or broth ) or 4 cups broth ( or broth ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened | 2 tablespoons dark rum or 2 tablespoons brandy, warmed
instructions: Slice the lettuce 1/8 thick. In the bowl of a food processor fitted with the steel blade, pulse the lettuce just until mixed. Add the rum and pulse a few more times to break out remaining bits. Stir in stock or broth. Add baking powder and cinnamon, process briefly with electric mixer until completely blended. Divide evenly between 6 serving bowls. Beat butter with rum in small bowl with spoon until smooth. Drizzle over crusty tops.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,half,sauerkraut,green olive,baker ' ammonia,taco seasoning
title: Easy Sauerkraut Filling
ingredients: 1 package store bought sauerkraut | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup taco seasoning | 1 cup saffir lime leaf, shredded | 1 1/2 teaspoons baker'ammonia ( ammoniac ) | 1 cup sliced pimento-stuffed green olives
instructions: Drain sauerkraut and rinse well under running water until water runs clear, if frozen, drain before using, it should be just covered. Combine sauerkraut and half and half, taco seasoning, lime leaves and baker ammonia in a saucepan and heat until liquid thickens and sauerkraut absorbs liquid. Remove from heat. Stir in black olives and let cool. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks or up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: ham hock,orange juice,egg noodle,adobo sauce,cheddar cheese,buttermilk,tea,lobster
title: Lobster Eggs over Noodles (Oamc)
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine or 8 ounces egg noodles, broken in half | 1 ham hock | 2 ounces shrimp, cooked & crumbled | 1/2 cup unsweetened orange juice | 1/4 cup low-fat buttermilk, room temperature | 2 teaspoons adobo sauce, from canned chipotle sauce | 1/4 cup shredded low-fat cheddar cheese | 2 large eggs, poached
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Place the ham hock and shrimp in the pan of a food processor. Pulse until finely minced. Pour the orange juice in the pan and heat briskly until hot but not boiling. Pour in the buttermilk, stir in the adobo sauce and cook until thickened. To serve, transfer the noodles to a bowl and mash with a fork. Spoon 1/2 cup of hot sauce over the noodles and toss thoroughly. Top with the ham hock, shrimp, sauce and cheddar.

title: Beef Shank
ingredients: 300 g lean boneless rump steak, trimmed of fat | 40 g green peas, trimmed | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 10 dried red chilies, torn | 100 g gherkin, sliced | 100 ml kahlua | 3 large dried red chilies, torn | 12 gerskin, diced into rounds
instructions: Place meat in a shallow, non metallic dish. Sprinkle with the cardamom, cardamom and chilies. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to chill for 30 minutes. Place peas, rump steak and all the marinade ingredients into a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Pour into a large nonstick frypan or frypan and add the kahlua and all the chillies. Bring to the boil then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring every so often. Toss the beef with the marinade and cook over a moderate heat for 10 - 15 minutes, or until browned all over and cooked through. Toss through the gernkin pieces and serve.

title: Coconut Mince
ingredients: 500 g raw sausage | 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 200 g lean steak | 6 tablespoons cilantro leaves ( finely chopped )
instructions: Fry the raw sausage in a large pot over a medium heat until browned all over and cooked through, remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the cocoa to the same wok and stir until it has melted. Add both mince and stir gently, coating each side. Add the cilantro and stir until the contents are heated through, remove and serve.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,bitter melon,dark chocolate,lard,pineapple juice,plum tomato,pam cooking spray
title: Chili-Infused Bitter Melon and Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 4 bitter melons ( seeds removed ) | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 5 plum tomatoes ( halved, deseeded and chopped ) | 2 tablespoons kaffir lime leaf ( can use lemon, lime or vinegar ) | 1 tablespoon lard ( or other cooking oil, to taste ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons lard ( or other cooking oil, to taste ) | 240 g dark chocolate | 230 g broccoli florets, drained
instructions: Using a sharp knife, core the bitter melon peel, cut away the skin and slice the bitter melon into bite sized pieces, rinse and dry. Using a small, sharp knife, slice the bitter melon. Place the pineapple, tomatoes, kaffir lime leaves and sugar in a food processor and blend to form the dressing. Toss the drained bitter melon with the remaining dressing. Whip 100g of the chocolate, using a fork or wooden spoon to soften it. Cut the remaining 200g of dark chocolate into small cubes, keeping a cup to dip in and add to the choc chips, set aside for garnish. Heat the wok over a high heat, add the peanut or lard and peanut oil, then the chili in a single layer. Reduce the heat and fry the bitter melon pieces for 2 minutes on each side or until they are a rich golden brown. Place on a plate and set aside. To serve, spoon the chili oil around the pineapple salad and garnish with the dark chocolate chunks. Pour the hot chili oil back into the wok and stir to melt the chocolate.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,wheat cheese tortellini,plantain,white vinegar,avocado,butternut squash
title: Summer Squash and Avocado Tortellini With Butternut Squash
ingredients: 12 whole wheat cheese tortellini | 2 ripe butternut squash, halved, lengthwise, seeded to yield 2 cups | 1 small butternut squash, halved lengthwise, seeded and cut into � inch thick slices | 12 slices orange peel | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 2 tablespoons finely grated peeled avocado
instructions: Cook tortellini in 2 quarts boiling salted water until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain. Return quarts water to boil in large skillet. Add squash, squash and oranges. Cook over high heat until squash is tender, about 5 minutes. Transfer squash to large bowl. Add vinegar and toss for 1 minute. Toss butternut squash with squash mixture. Serve tortellini in large bowl.

title: Shrimp in a Salt Shell
ingredients: 1 kg shrimp | 1 kg shortening ( not tubs! )
instructions: Boil the large shrimp whole for 1 minute. Place shrimp in a bowl and cover with cold water. Let stand for 15 minutes. Drain well and transfer shrimp to a strainer. Sprinkle with salt and allow to drain for 10 minutes. Whip the shortening to a firm but not solid lump. Drain shrimp and pat dry. Roll shrimps on a board and roll with rolling pin to 1cm thickness. Lay in salt lined bowl. Cut into desired shape.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,raspberry jam,mustard powder,chunky salsa,basmati rice,ginger ale,zucchini
title: Mexican Chicken Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup soup | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 medium zucchini ( grated or sliced ) | 2/3 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup seedless raspberry jam
instructions: Cook basmati rice according to package directions. Prepare soup and sour cream. Drain water from rice and stir into soup. Add mustard and zucchini. Stir in salsa.

title: Santa-Salad Beef
ingredients: 4 ounces beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup graham cracker | 3 tablespoons flour | 1 tablespoon diced serrano chilies | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon celery, minced
instructions: Coat beef with cracker crumbs and set aside. Combine chilies, and seasonings in nonstick frypan.

title: Guinness Potato Lips
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled | 2 tablespoons guinness stout | fresh grated horseradish and garnish or chopped chives, as desired
instructions: Using a sharp knife, core the potato and cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Cut the potato into 1/2 to 2 inch wedges each. Put the wedges in a bowl and stir in the guinness. Place the lips in the pot and stir to coat. Cover and heat until the potatoes are tender and the rind is golden brown. Place the potato wedges on a serving dish. Garnish with grated horseradish and chopped chives.

title: White Pepperoni Dip
ingredients: 250 g reduced-fat cream cheese | 2 tablespoons low-fat cream cheese | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1 medium green capsicum, chopped | 1 medium tomatoes, finely chopped | 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | pepperoni, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a jug until well combined. Chill and serve with your favourite dip or with baked zucchini, crusty bread and fresh vegetables.

title: Rice Ring On the Rice (For Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 10 ounces rotini pasta, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice ( can use red if desired ) | 2/3 cup cracker crumbs, divided
instructions: Combine all ingredients in rice cooker.

Random Ingredients: aleppo pepper,sesame seed,cream chicken soup,gingerroot,red potato,parsley
title: Dee's Potato Sticks
ingredients: 12 red potatoes, peeled | 1/2 cup sour cream ( i use cain's ) | 1 teaspoon dried mustard seeds | 1/4 cup finely grated fresh gingerroot | 1 bottle aleppo pepper ( or 1 c. sherry, if you want fresh aleppo pepper ) | 2 -3 teaspoons toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Boil potatoes in large pot of water until tender. Meanwhile, mix together sour cream, mustard seeds, ginger, and aleppo pepper. Drain potatoes.

title: Italian Banana Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 large bananas, peeled and sliced | 1 package coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup amaretto | 4 ounces mascarpone cheese, softened
instructions: Combine bananas and coleslaw mix in a large bowl. In small bowl, combine amaretto and mascarpone cheese. Pour over bananas and coleslaw. Toss gently until coated and mixed well. Serve with toasted bread or crackers.

title: Fassoulia Con Calabaza (Mlima Bean Soup)
ingredients: 1 lb lima beans ( lima beans are best ) | 1/3 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Rinse beans and remove rocks and stems. Cover beans with cold water and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Mix saffron into the beans and then return to a boil, heat, pour into soup plates and serve hot. Variations, add 1/2 tsp crumbled dried parma ham or 1/8 cup diced ham when you add the beans.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,lemon juice zest,vegetable oil,kasseri cheese,greek yogurt,adobo sauce
title: Tortilla De Carioca (Spinach Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups spinach leaves, steamed and chopped | 1 cup greek yogurt | 4 dashes of your favorite chipotle adobo sauce, depending on how hot you want it ( we use lots! ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 lemons, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Mix everything together in a salad bowl and serve at room temperature until flavors blend.

title: Pecan Crackers
ingredients: 1 loaf bread | 1 1/2 cups pecans
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°f slice bread about 1/3 of the way through to make sure each slice comes out completely. Place one bread slice in a cookie sheet. Sprinkle pecans onto the bread. Place in oven for 15 - 20 minutes. Turn over and brush pecans with the melted butter. Let cool for 5+ minutes before removing. Eat these on their own or with a filling of choice.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,red enchilada sauce,cranberry,coriander powder,confectioner ' sugar
title: Easy Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar red enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Heat enchilada sauce in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Remove from heat and stir in sherry and sugar. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Stir in coriander and cranberries and pour into a serving dish. Let cool to room temp before serving.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,dill weed,family kit kat chocolate candy bar
title: Holland Family Kator Mix
ingredients: 8 family kit kat's quick chocolate candies ( one square each ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Line an 8 x 2 inch sheet pan with foil and set aside. Microwave chocolate bars in a 3 cup microwave safe microwavable bowl on high power for 4 minutes. Stir, being careful, for 1 minute. Stir in golden syrup and dill weed.

title: Mace and Herb Tiramisu
ingredients: 1/3 cup vegan margarine ( vegan margarine ) | 1 package active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm organic warm dinner gases free powdered milk or 1/2 cup warm milk, mixed together | 1/2 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1/2 tablespoon dried oregano leaves or 1/2 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 2 -3 tablespoons garlic paste or 1 -2 tablespoon garlic powder | 8 ounces ladyfingers
instructions: Add all of the ingredients in the order listed together in your manufacturer's specifications, and blend to dissolve the butter completely into the mixture. Place the ladyfingers on a greased cookie sheet with parchment paper on the rack. Brush the edges of your sheet with melted vegan margarine. Cover with wet but not foamy parchment paper or lightly spray with a little olive oil. Place in preheated oven at 400°f for 6 minutes or until golden on one side. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Store in an airtight container. This can be made up to 2 days in advance. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,pork sausage,cannellini bean,red bell pepper,peppercorn,wheat bread crumb
title: Pork Sausages and Beans
ingredients: 2 pounds pork sausage | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 red bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon crushed peppercorns | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 3/4 cup quick-cooking wheat bread crumbs
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir sausage in the hot skillet until the color of the sausage has begun to change, about 5 minutes. Stir bean, red bell pepper, peppercorns, and triple sec into the sausage. Pour in more water if needed to cover sausage by 1 inch. Reduce heat to medium low.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,sage,cornbread mix,monterey jack cheese,eggplant,baking soda
title: Mama Corley's Chinese Eggplant Appetizer
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon ground sage | 1/4 package cornbread mix | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Prepare eggplant according to package directions. Drain, and peel. Cut into 1/2 inch slices. Place in a large bowl. Mix in soy sauce, baking soda, sage, and cornbread mix. Transfer to a 9 or 10 inch cast iron skillet. Top with the cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spinach,almond extract,topping,cherry tomato,lime juice,catalina salad dressing,vodka,gruyere
title: Lime Swiss Torta
ingredients: 4 frozen dinner rolls, thawed | 1/4 cup frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed lime juice | 1 tablespoon catalina salad dressing or 1 tablespoon cream salad dressing | 1 dash almond extract | purchased whipped topping ( optional ) | shredded gruyere or shaved mozzarella cheese ( optional )
instructions: To make base, spread roll dough evenly on a cutting board. Cut rolls crosswise into ½ inch slices. Place spinach in a bowl, add yogurt, lime juice, catalina dressing, and almond extract and stir to mix. Divide spinach salad evenly into 4 portions. Arrange half of spinach filling on one half of each rolled slice of bread, and spread lightly with cream. Top with remaining slice of bread, using spinach filling. Roll each sandwich into a tube.

title: Sopa de Alhos - Spanish Onion Cookies
ingredients: 2 lbs spanish onions, peeled, divided and sliced very thinly | 1/2 cup walnut pieces | 2 cups unbleached self raising flour | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Line cookie tin lightly with foil. Place onions in a bowl and sprinkle with walnuts. Combine flour and 1/4 cup of water and add to onions. Stir to combine with a spoon and spread onto the onions on the bottom of the tin. Arrange the cherry tomato halves over the mixture. Cook on the middle shelf of the oven for about 40 minutes, or until golden brown on top. Remove to drain on a paper towel lined plate.

Random Ingredients: vermouth,glace cherry,grand marnier,habanero pepper,superfine sugar,cream milk,onion,vegetable
title: A Symphony of Ham
ingredients: 250 g onions, very thinly sliced | 150 ml vegetable fat or 150 ml beef fat | 225 ml sour cream | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 1/3 cup superfine sugar | 250 g mixed ripe vegetables, chopped ( such as potato ) | 2 -3 habanero peppers, sliced | 1 cup glace cherries
instructions: Heat the fat in a large frying pan. Add the onions and cook gently, stirring constantly, until the onions have softened and begun to brown.. Stir in the sour cream, vermouth and sugar, and boil gently until thickened, about 5 minutes. Add the vegetables, habanero slices, cherries and the juice from the habanero pods. Stir to heat through. Serve at once, hot, or chilled.

Random Ingredients: caribbean jerk seasoning,chicken,penne rigate,spaghetti,orange juice,seasoning,white bean
title: Robust Caribbean Chicken Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 2 cups pasta rigate | 1 chicken, cut into bite size pieces | 1 can canned white beans, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 teaspoon mrs. dash seasoning ( or seasoning of your choice ) | 1 dash caribbean jerk seasoning | 1 dash maggi seasoning ( or seasoning of your choice ) | 1 dash margarine ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. While it is cooking, heat skillet with the rub. In skillet, add 1/3 cup orange juice and the 1/3 cup of jerk seasoning. Stir until mixed well. Add the chicken and cook till done, but not done. When pasta is done, drain well and add to skillet. To serve, spoon the chicken mix onto the pasta. Add the drained white beans, orange juice and 1/3 cup of jerk seasoning. Mix. Serve with a sprinkling of cheese, grated cheese or sour cream.

title: Southwest Burger
ingredients: 1 pound ground burger | 1 can tomato chutney | 1 yellow sweet pepper, sliced
instructions: Form hamburger into 4 patties. Combine the tomato chutney and yellow sweet pepper in a small bowl. Spray skillet with cooking spray and cook patties for 5 minutes on each side or until browned.

title: Berry Rigatoni Bake
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta | 1 pint fresh blueberries, well rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In a large bowl, combine the rigatoni and blueberries and toss to coat. Transfer into oven and bake until lightly brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,rum,hot paprika,thai chile,fennel bulb,chunky salsa
title: Acapulco Poblanos & Salsa #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bunch fennel bulb, cleaned, trimmed of leaves, julienned and reserved | 1/2 poblano chile - seeds and stem removed and roughly chopped | 1 1/2 cups medium hot salsa | 2 teaspoons spiced rum | 1 teaspoon spiced rum | 1/2 teaspoon thai chile, chopped
instructions: Heat the grill to high. In a blender or food processor, combine the fennel, poblano pepper, salsa, rum, rum & chile and process until smooth. Pour into an 8 ounce baking dish and serve alongside the dish.

title: Chorizo With Raw Brown Sugar
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: The chorizo should be slightly undercooked. If it is, remove it shortly before it burns and grind it to a fine powder. Bring a large pot of very lightly salted water to a boil and cook the chorizo over medium heat until it is translucent yet soft, about 7 - 10 minutes. Stir in the chorizo and brown sugar and remove from heat. Serve hot or cold with a spicy mexican salad.

title: Quick Pasta With Spicy Sauce (Pasta Al Patate)
ingredients: 1 lb thin spaghetti ( about 3 ) | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling water till al dente. Drain when firm.

title: Spiced Chilled Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 red roasted pepper, deseeded and finely diced ( i use chile ) | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger paste | 1 tablespoon chicken stock cubes or 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon caraway seed
instructions: Place the red pepper, ginger paste, and chicken stock cubes in a blender with a little water. Blend until smooth and set aside until ready to serve. You can use this immediately, but i find it gives a smoother sauce.

title: Filipino Sinigang
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds pork loin | 1 can coconut water | 3 tablespoons coconut oil, or more as needed | 1 yellow onion, finely chopped, or more to taste | 1 sprig fresh basil, or to taste | 1 teaspoon sesame oil, or to taste
instructions: Place pork loind in a large pan, pour in coconut water, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until pork is very tender, about 1 hour. Stir shredded pork through coconut cream sauce, and cook for 15 more minutes, or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,green enchilada sauce,brown sugar,chicken broth
title: Easy Creamy Green Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans green enchilada sauce | 1 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup packed brown sugar | 4 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Simmer the chicken broth in a saucepan until the chicken is slightly browned, about 10 minutes. Combine the enchilada sauce with the brown sugar, salt and remaining chicken broth in a bowl, and set aside until the flavors combine, about 10 minutes. Serve over your favorite fajita chips or tortilla.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,dark chocolate,vanilla extract,fennel seed,apricot,vegetable stock
title: A Simple English Eccles Cottage Pie!
ingredients: 4 sheets puff pastry | 600 ml vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon fennel seeds | 25 g dark chocolate, chopped | 1 cup dried apricot, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200 degrees celcius. Line a baking sheet with baking parchment. Mix fennel seeds, stock and half of chocolate in a small saucepan. Place over a low heat. Once the stock starts coming to a boil, stir in the apricots and mix well. Pour onto the pastry. Sprinkle with remaining chocolate and cook for 10 minutes, until the chocolate has just melted and the apricots begin to soften. Once the pastry is cooked, remove from the oven and cut a cross in the top of the pie, so that you have two circles of the same diameter. Leave to cool for 1 hour before cutting in wedges to serve.

title: Dairy Free, Dairy Free Semolina Halva
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs semolina | 5 drops cream of tartar or 1 teaspoon cream of wheat
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients together. Start kneading, or you could make it, cover with a cloth, and let it sit for an hour to relax. The dough should be very smooth. Take your dough out of the refrigerator and divide into 12 equal pieces. On a flat surface, take one piece of piece of dough and roll it out thinly on a floured surface. The dough will be very dry. Add a pinch of cream of tare or wheat on one side of the rolled dough, and spread it over the cream of tare. Fold up the half of the rolled dough over that, and roll out into a triangle about 10 inches in diameter. Cut the triangle into 6 pieces and spread the halva as thick as you can wrap it. Repeat this process. Place on greased baking sheets. Make a small slit in the center of each halva with your thumb and, if you have a sharp knife, take a sharp tip and make small pieces of halva. Bake at 325 for 15 - 20 minutes, or until lightly browned. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container.

title: Roast Pepperoncini
ingredients: 1/2 cup hot water | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries, chopped | 3 slices rye bread, toasted | 1 dash italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons pepperoncini peppers, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Stir the hot water and dried cranberries in a small bowl. Let sit 5 minutes to soften, then drain. Trim a slice from each slice of rye bread about 1/2 inch thick, then cut each into 1/2 inch to 2 inch squares. Place the toasted rye slices in a shallow roasting pan. Pour pepperoncini hot water over rye bread, then season with italian seasoning and pepperoncini. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is browned and bubbly, about 15 minutes.

title: Ricotta, Lemon and Ricotta Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 2 containers ricotta cheese | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Preparations for the sauce, combine the ricotta and lemon juice in a small mixing bowl with a wire whisk. Stir vigorously until the mixture is creamy and smooth. Keep refrigerated up to a week before using. In a pasta bowl, stir the sauce before adding vegetables. Drain pasta and toss with sauce.

title: Nam Prik Num
ingredients: 3 lbs ground turkey | 1 lb italian sausage | 1 tablespoon parsley leaves ( leaves only ) | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 teaspoons lemongrass ( fresh ground )
instructions: Grind the italian sausage. Mix all ingredients together. Shape into patties of your preferred size, and saute over hot coals for about 10 minutes turning once.

title: Grilled Pepperoni Subs
ingredients: 1/2 cup wine vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh thyme leave | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 12 slices pepperoni | fresh basil leaf, torn
instructions: Combine vinegar, thyme, garlic, pepperoni and basil. Marinate 1 hour.

title: Italian Bean Sprout Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Plunge the bean sprouts into the boiling water, and cook until tender, about 2 minutes. Drain well. Combine the sprouts, olive oil, and salt in a bowl.

title: Unbelievable Cheesy Baked Leavened Cheese - No Boil
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups extra sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons dried lemon zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix all ingredients together and place in large round or square baking dish. Bake until lightly browned and cheese is melted, 8 to 16 minutes. Variation, for a slightly different twist on the cheeses, sprinkle thinly with cinnamon or nutmeg before baking.

title: Gramma 'n' Turnips
ingredients: 2 large butchers turnips, peeled ( or 2 large gratins of grated turnips ) | 2 spring onions, chopped ( scallions ) | 1 tablespoon cottage cheese ( or your favorite type ) | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Peel and cut turnips into 1/2 inch slices, then into 1/2 inch slices. Sprinkle with a little salt and set aside. Melt half the cottage cheese or cream cheese in a skillet over med high heat, and sprinkle with black pepper. Heat for 5 minute or so. Add turnips and saute until brown. Add scallions and gently toss them until they're completely coated with the cheese mixture. Transfer to a platter and serve at once. Enjoy.

title: Creamed Lentils
ingredients: 250 g soft lentils | 1 tablespoon dried mushroom
instructions: Combine the lentils and mushrooms in a large saucepan. Stir in the mushroom. Bring to the boil and simmer until the lentils are tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Thai Red Curry Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream-style corn | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1 teaspoon thai red curry paste
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together cream style corn, sauerkraut, and red curry paste. Cover, and refrigerate overnight to blend flavors, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,yellow bell pepper,beef steak,celery rib,liquid smoke
title: Carolina Beef Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs beef round steak, cut 3/4 inch thick | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste ) | 1 large yellow bell pepper, cut into 16 squares | 2 celery ribs, cut into 1/4 to 1/2 inch pieces | 4 teaspoons liquid smoke, divided
instructions: Preheat a grill pan over high heat. Season the steak on both sides with cayenne over medium high heat. Add the peppers and stir. Move the pepper slices around the pan until they start to caramelize. Transfer the pepper slices to a dish and set aside. Return the pan to high heat. When the pan starts to smoke, add two tbsps water. The water should almost cover the steak, but you don’t want to dislodge the flavor from the peppers. Place the steaks in the pan and brush with 1/2 the liquid smoke. Turn the heat down to medium, cover and cook for 2 minutes. Turn the steak and repeat cooking for 2 more minutes. Turn the heat off and place the steak on a board. Cover the beef with aluminum foil, place it in the microwave and cook at high for 10 minutes. It should be just firm to the touch. Flip it over and continue cooking for a further 5 - 7 minutes until rare, but don’t overcook it. Remove the steak from the microwave and let it rest for about 5 minutes. Slice into ¼ inch thick pieces and serve over the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,cooking oat,mustard seed,rice wine vinegar
title: The Best Low Calorie, Low Fat Pineapple Rice Dressing
ingredients: 4 cups canned crushed pineapple with juice, in water, drained ( reserve 1/2 cup juice ) | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar, in asian sections | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats ( you can also use ground or whole wheat )
instructions: Place all ingredients except last 2/3 cup juice into a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Pour over rice into a container with a lid and stir well to combine. Can be stored in the refrigerator for 5 days and can be reheated for up to 3 - 4 days.

title: Potato and Beer Soup
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, peeled and peeled | 1 bottle aleppo pepper | 2 cans sprite, undiluted | 1/2 lb citron, halved
instructions: In a large stainless steel or enamel pot on the stovetop, bring the potatoes to a boil, and continue to boil and stir until the potatoes are completely tender. Stir in the beerppo pepper and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and let simmer for approximately 30 minutes. Drain and reserve the cooking liquid, and return the liquid to the pot. Add the sprite, cover and let the soup cook on low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring a few times. Stir in the citron and serve. Enjoy,.

title: Mexican Bacon
ingredients: 3 cups oil, for frying | 1 cup bacon grease | 1 cup chili powder | 6 -8 ice cubes
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok on medium heat. When hot, add the bacon grease. When the oil mixture in the wok starts to smoke, add the chili powder and stir well or stir often until there are browned bits of chili powder on the pan bottom. Keep stirring until the oil starts separating. Pour about 2 - 3 cups of the meat drippings into the wok or deep skillet. Turn the heat to low and pour the bacon drippings into the pan, constantly stirring the drippings. Do not let the liquid drippings stick to the side of the pan. As it dries, remove the wok from the burner. Turn the heat back up to medium high and add the ice cubes one at a time in small balls, and flatten between your palms.. When the cubes are slightly flattened and slightly separated, remove and turn the balls to the other side. Transfer the cooked bacon to a paper towel to drain grease. Note, if your wok is large enough, you may want to cut the bacon slices in half in half after you have tried to stuff the meat, as this could tear some of the membrane from them and make them slimy.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,brown mustard seed,salmon,tamari soy sauce,mayonnaise
title: Thai Salmon Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cans salmon, rinsed | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 6 tablespoons mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons chicken stock or 3 tablespoons vegetable stock
instructions: Drain salmon well with a fine sieve. Place the fish in food processor. Add tamari chili sauce and mustard seeds, and pulse on highest speed until thoroughly mixed. Add mayonnaise and stock, and pulse again until desired consistency. Divide among 6 serving bowls, and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,chinese cabbage,chicken breast,wheat pastry flour,tamarind pulp,cardamom,blue cheese,lemongrass
title: Thai Chicken Parcels (Chicken With Tamarind)
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain wheat pastry flour | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp | 1/2 cup grated chinese cabbage | 3 plum tomatoes, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon finely chopped lemongrass ( fresh if possible ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped cardamom | 2 tablespoons shredded blue cheese | 6 tablespoons chicken breast, cooked
instructions: Preheat griddle or pan, and grease. Mix the flour, tamarind pulp, cabbage, tomatoes and lemon grass in a bowl. Add the grated cheese and cardamom, then stir in the chicken. Roll 3/4 cup of the dough out on the counter, to 1/3 inch thick. Cut out 8 circles using the cutter. Place a tablespoon of the filling along the lower edge of the circle, and pinch the edges securely. Dip the parcels, one at a time, in the flour, then in some of the remaining flour. Place on top of each other on a lightly greased griddle or skillet and fry until golden brown, turning once. Serve hot.

title: Ethiopian Onion Samoins
ingredients: 2 kg red onions | 4 tablespoons liquid smoke ( bahir ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried marjoram | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Clean the onions, and slice them into thin rings about 1 cm thick. Heat a pan with some water and some oil on your high burner and let the water boil. Place the onions in the pan, and toss so they are all coated with oil. When water appears to be boiling, stir a small amount of bahir into the water. Turn the heat down as low as it will go inches cover and let stand for 2 hours. After 2 hours, you can eat them. If you want, you can sprinkle the onion with a little sambar powder, or a little dill.

title: Simple Pizzelle
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups molasses | 5 tablespoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Measure the molasses, and stir. Add the baking powder, and stir. Add a teaspoon of water if necessary to mix. If it does not foam, add more. Pour into hot, grease free pan, and immediately sprinkle with a few flakes of a butter flavoring like pecan nut. The pizzelle will pop out of the pan, and harden as they cool, and will harden on the outside and be more or less pliable.

title: Wakame Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 pound dry pinto beans | 1 pound frozen cut wakame | 1 cup pico de gallo | 3 cups fresh blueberries, or as desired, or as desired | 6 bamboo skewers, soaked
instructions: Place dried beans in a large container and cover with several inches of cool water.

title: Chopsticks and Coffee
ingredients: 4 scallions, finely chopped, green parts only | 1/4 cup finely chopped cocoa | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 3 teaspoons dry sherry
instructions: Stir scallions, cocoa and sherry together. Spoon in a cup, or into a pitcher.

Random Ingredients: portobello mushroom,baby spinach leaf,italian salad dressing mix,prosciutto,chocolate
title: Spinach-Cannellini Mushroom-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 baby portobello mushrooms | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 100 g baby spinach leaves, washed and patted dry | 8 slices prosciutto | 4 tablespoons salted roasted salted roasted sweetened chocolate, chopped ( use a good brand )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c / 400°f. Wash the mushrooms and slice capsicum thinly on the diagnonal. Place in a large bowl. Put the italian dressing mix and spinach leaves into a pestle, add 2 tsp oil and process into a paste. Add to the mushrooms and mix together. Spread onto the mushroom capsicum slices and season as per taste. Wrap each mushroom capicum with an prosciutto slice and secure with a tooth pick. Place on a baking tray lined with baking paper and bake for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and stir to prevent sticking or burning. Serve on a plate with a drizzle of chocolate alongside. Enjoy.

title: Easy "spaghetti" Sandwich #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package rye bread ( i like to use my homestyle miniature flat bread ) | 1 package taco seasoning ( i like the taco seasoning mix mix and lawry's )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Cut crusts off the bread. Cut the bread into 1/2 pieces. Pour taco seasoning into the hollowest side of the bread, then spread taco seasoning mixture over the top. Bake for 8 minutes, then top with a slice of bread. Continue baking for an additional 2 to 3 minutes or until the bread is slightly browned on the edges and cheese is melted.

title: Croutons (France)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 3 tablespoons cooked yellow peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 cup seasoned croutons
instructions: Melt butter in pan over medium heat. Add peppers.

title: Quick Penne Pasta
ingredients: 1 package dry penne pasta | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, with their juice
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,cream chicken soup,stewing beef,half,chunky salsa,brussels sprout,mozzarella cheese,yellow onion
title: Crock Pot Salsa Beef and Loves
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 by 1 inch pieces | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 4 -5 cups of ready to serve shredded mozzarella cheese, divided | 2 cups fresh brussels sprouts, thinly sliced | 1 cup chunky salsa, divided | 1/2 cup of thinly sliced yellow onion | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1/3 cup half-and-half
instructions: Combine cubed beef, soup, and 2 cups cheese in the crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 5 hours. Layer 1/2 cup of brussels sprouts over beef mixture. Layer of sliced yellow onion around sprouts. Cover and cook an additional hour on low or 4 hours on high. Before serving, stir in salsa and the remaining 1 cup of cheese. Stir in sesame seeds. Serve over noodles, rice, or pasta of your choice.

title: Pine Nuts Salad
ingredients: 1 lb granny smith apple | 1 cup yellow sweet pepper | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Peel, core and slice apples. Cut sweet peppers into chunks. Mix all together in a bowl and sprinkle pine nuts over top.

Random Ingredients: rosemary sprig,parsnip,chicken bouillon,rye flour,beef ravioli,spinach leaf,tawny port,pimiento
title: Beef and Veggie Ravioli With Parsnips and Port
ingredients: 1 lb beef ravioli | 1 tablespoon parsnip, grated | 1 teaspoon olive oil or 1 teaspoon butter, divided | 2 cups tawny port | 4 garlic mushrooms, minced | 6 -8 fresh rosemary sprigs | 2 1/2 cups spinach leaves | 1 jar pimientos
instructions: Cook onion in 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet or dutch oven over medium heat until tender, 7 - 10 minutes or so. Stir in mushrooms, rosemary, spinach and pimentos. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until spinach is just tender, about 5 - 10 minutes longer. Add cooked ravioli and cook over low heat stirring constantly until hot.

title: Cappuccino Mix
ingredients: 1 cup non-dairy coffee creamer | 1 celery rib
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and shake well in plastic bag to ensure that the mixture mixes. Let dry and store in airtight container.

title: Pasta With Meat and Sausage
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta | 3 lbs ground venison or 3 lbs lean ground beef | 3 lbs lean ground lean pork belly | 5 lbs smoked pork belly ( or smoked sausage ) | 3 quarts homemade pesto sauce or 3 quarts homemade marinara sauce | 8 medium size raw squash
instructions: In a big stockpot, begin to place the farfalle in 1 cup hot water. Cook, following package directions, until al dente, about 5 minutes, about 10 minutes. Strain the farfalle into a colander and run cold water over the farfalle and away from the lining of the strands when it is cool enough to handle. Set aside. When the farfalle are cooled, put them in a colander, sprinkle with salt and cover. Refrigerate overnight or up to 3 days. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. On a large rimmed baking pan, lay out the farfalle and spread out using a spatula. Repeat the process with each piece of beef and pork. When all the meat has been spread out, layer the meat mixture on the farfalle then top with the sausages. Spread half the pesto over the meats and meat. Top with the remaining farfalle then the remaining pesto. Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake for 45 minutes, until the farfalle are browned and bubbling. Turn the oven off. The farfalle can also be cooked with a small amount of olive oil cooking spray placed on them, for one or two hours, and basting with a pan of pan juices during the baking.

Random Ingredients: meringue powder,soy flour,jiffy corn muffin mix,cantaloupe
title: Melting Moments
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups jiffy corn muffin mix | 3 tablespoons sweetened soy flour | 3/4 cup meringue powder | 3/4 cup cantaloupe
instructions: Combine ingredients in a large bowl. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet. Bake in a 350 oven for 8 to 12 minutes or until tops are golden brown and muffins begin to crisp. Allow to cool. Makes 2 dozen. Keep crisp.

title: Tarragon Noodles
ingredients: 3/4 cup cooked egg noodles | 1 teaspoon whole wheat pita bread ( or other similar textured bread ) | 3 eggs, beaten | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon | 3/4 teaspoon chili flakes | 3/4 cup salted peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Break up the bread into small pieces and toast in a skillet until light brown. This will take about 5 minutes. Remove bread from skillet and set aside. Combine eggs, tumeric, salt and chili flakes in a medium bowl. Add the bread, egg mixture and peanuts. Using 2 fingers, mix until all ingredients are well combined. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,chicken bouillon,spanish onion,red chilies,red potato,purpose flour,artichoke heart,egg yolk
title: Artichokes in Red Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces small red potatoes, cut in half | 1 large spanish onion, diced | 8 ounces snow peas, trimmed and cut diagonally | 1 small red chilies, chopped ( i used hot chile, in olive oil with a dash of salt ) or 1 small serrano chili, chopped ( i used hot chile, in olive oil with a dash of salt ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( i use 3/4 of bisto instead ) | 1/2 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 2 egg yolks | 1 artichoke hearts, roughly chopped ( i used dried hearts, not marinated artichokes )
instructions: Boil the potatoes until fork tender, about 15 minutes. Drain potatoes and set aside to cool enough to handle. While potatoes are cooling, combine the onion, snow peas, onion, and chilies in a medium skillet, and saute on medium low heat until onion is translucent. Add the chicken stock, or bouillon and bring to a simmer. Stir in the potatoes. Simmer for 12 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and sauce is thickened. Stir in the flour and let cook a couple of minutes longer. If the sauce gets too thick, add a bit of water, about 1 tablespoon at a time, until desired thickness is achieved. While cooking, make the artichokes by combining the egg yolks and the remaining bisto in a medium saucepan over low heat. Cook until a light coating of tater tots forms.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,pinto bean,apricot jam,cardamom seed,turmeric,romano cheese
title: African Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 cup canned pinto beans | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 1 tablespoon grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Drain the beans, and spread them out into the bottom of the dish with your hands.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,mint sprig,liquid honey,green bean,mozzarella cheese,gruyere cheese,peanut butter,worcestershire sauce
title: Green Bean Gratin With Gruyere Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb green beans | 1 ounce grated mozzarella cheese | 1 ounce grated gruyere cheese | 3 tablespoons light creamy peanut butter or 3 tablespoons low-fat butter | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | fresh mint sprig, for garnish | 1 - 1 1/2 cup chicken broth ( or vegetable )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Remove ends of green beans and blanch them in boiling water for about 3 minutes.

title: Apple Walnut Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds apples - peeled, cored and chopped | 2 small yellow bell peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon powder | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 3 radishes, sliced
instructions: Place apples and yellow peppers into a large pot and sprinkle with the beef bouillon and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until the apples are tender. In a separate small pot, toast the walnuts, stirring frequently and adding water if it becomes too dry. Spoon walnut mixture into food processor and process until finely ground. Stir into soup with the radishes. Refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,water,red chili pepper,almond,chicken wing,white onion,pork shoulder
title: Indonesian Honeyed Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, cut on the wings | 1 large egg yolk | 2 cups water | 6 pieces boneless pork shoulder, cut into bite-size pieces | 2 tablespoons sliced almonds | 1/2 medium white onion, sliced | 1 small red chili pepper, seeded and sliced lengthwise | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground almonds
instructions: In a medium heavy pot or dutch oven combine the chicken wings and enough water to barely cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer, covered, over medium heat for about 15 minutes. Drain. Transfer the chicken wings to a bowl and combine with the egg yolk, water, and pork bones. Set aside and let stand for about 15 minutes, then drain and set aside. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. In the same pot and along the side, add the sliced onion and sliced chili pepper. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until the onion is tender. Transfer mixture to a bowl. Stir in the ground almonds and set aside. Bake chicken in the oven, covered, for 30 minutes. Stir almond mixture to combine. Turn the chicken over, and bake until the chicken is tender in the middle, about 15 minutes longer. Transfer to a serving platter. Serve as a main course, or with steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,corn cob,flour,garam masala,curly endive lettuce,taco seasoning
title: Tortillas Roll-Ups
ingredients: 24 -30 leaves curly endive lettuce | 8 -10 corn on the cob | 1 package taco seasoning | 4 tablespoons flour | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets | olive oil ( for frying )
instructions: First you'll want to remove some of the lettuce leaves from the cob, or save for another use. Trim the cob leaves, unless absolutely necessary. Cut the leaves into 3 strips. Mix the taco seasoning into the flour and then put in the corn on the cob, stirring to coat. Brush the leaves with oil. Roll each strip of the pastry into a rectangle about 8x12 inches and 1 inch wide. Cut into pieces about 1 inch wide. Cut the squares in half lengthwise and set aside. When all the tortillas have been made, deep fry in hot olive oil until a golden brown colour. If they turn brown too much, add a tablespoon of water mixed with the taco seasoning to make a paste. Drain on absorbent paper. Serve with salsa. Serve with spanish rice or plain yogurt.

title: Bouquet Garni
ingredients: 1 bunch mixed italian herbs | 1 pint herb, chopped or finely chopped ( mixed herbs, parsley, chervil, thyme, and summer savory )
instructions: Combine herb and mix. Chill and serve.

Random Ingredients: wooden skewer,tomato juice,basil,french bread,parsley flake,no salt tomato,beef tongue
title: Oven Baked Greek Style Beef Tongue or Basted Spicy Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 beef tongue ( i prefer beef tongue, because there are so many vegetables to cover the tongue ) | 32 ounces canned tomatoes, chopped ( or stewed tomatoes of your choice canned ) | 2 cans no-salt-added tomato juice | 1/4 cup fresh parsley flakes | 2 tablespoons dried basil | wooden skewer |  french bread ( i like baguette slices, just make sure to toast both before slicing )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place tongue in a large pot with enough water to cover and bring to boil. Simmer for 10 - 15 minutes or until easily pierced with the tip of a sharp knife. If the water level drops right out of the tongue, add more water. Remove from heat and let sit 10 minutes. Use butcher sawing utensil to roughly trim the heads and intestines. Place the tongue in a dutch oven, add the tomatoes, tomato juice and parsley and bring to boil. Simmer for 45 minutes or until meat is tender enough to fall off the bone. Remove and discard tongues and set aside. Remove meat from the broth and cool completely, about 1 hour. Slice lamb up into 1/2 inch slices. Set aside. Slice onions as thinly as possible and reserve. Skewer meat on top of slices of soaked noodles. Add bread lightly to soak up any last remnants of juices from the meat, being careful not to let them brown. Arrange on a well greased and hot baking sheet. Cover with foil and bake for 25 - 30 minutes. Place bowls in oven for a few minutes to warm through and absorb any residual heat. Serve immediately in warmed bowls and with fresh bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,chicken breast meat,salt water,grainy mustard,garlic paste,maple syrup,quinoa
title: Maple Chicken and Quinoa
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 2 chicken breast, cut into chunks | 2 chicken breast meat | 1 clove garlic paste | 4 cups salt water | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon grainy mustard
instructions: Rinse the quinoa well and drain through a fine mesh sieve. Place the quinoa in a saucepan along with 4 cups of water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cover, reduce heat to medium, and simmer for 10 minutes. Turn the heat to low, and simmer for about 45 minutes, or until all of the water is absorbed and water is absorbed. While the quinoa is cooking, put the chicken in a skillet over high heat, and season with 1 clove garlic paste. Cook until golden, about 5 minutes, then transfer to a plate. Mix in the quinoa. Remove the pan from the heat and keep covered over very low heat. Place the maple syrup in a saucepan over medium low heat, and set the heat so it simmers. When the syrup is heated, whisk in the mustard and remaining garlic paste. Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Taste, and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Serve topped with the cooked quinoa.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,cardamom seed,chili seasoning mix,cayenne pepper,hot dog
title: Indian Style Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 package hot dogs, split lengthwise | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1 package chili seasoning mix | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the hot dogs on a baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Bake at 400 degrees f for 12 - 15 minutes, or until crisped. Arrange the fresh spinach and hot dogs on a serving platter. Mix the chili seasoning mix, cardamom seed, cayenne and ground nutmeg in a small bowl. Spread over the hot dogs and serve.

title: Nacho Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1/3 cup garlic salt | 3/4 cup cumin
instructions: Mix well and store in a covered container to prolong seasoning.

title: Onion-Vodka Sauce
ingredients: 5 lbs red onions, peeled and quartered | 2 lbs vodka
instructions: Place onions and vodka in a large, heavy pot and stir to thoroughly mix. Add water to cover and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 hour, skimming as needed.

title: Baked Martini
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 ounce good quality vodka | 8 -10 tablespoons bread ( toasted )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the bread, in a cocktail shaker. Shake for 10 - 15 seconds or until the outside surface of the martini turns a slight golden color.

title: Low Fat Mexican Tempeh
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package tempeh | 2 cups napa cabbage, sliced thinly | 2 cups shredded fat-free queso fresco | 1 cup low-fat tomato juice
instructions: Preheat over to 400 degrees. Spray large non stick skillet with cooking spray.

title: Low-Carb Glazes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons splenda brown sugar blend | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mixture will foam when heated. Use as needed.

title: P.f. Chang (Mexican Brandy Sauce)
ingredients: 1 jar picante sauce | 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Pour 1/4 cup brandy into a 4 or 5 pint glass. Stir in picante sauce. Microwave until hot and bubbly, about 1 minute.

title: Homemade Yoghurt Chips
ingredients: 1 cup natural yoghurt | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder
instructions: Place the yoghurt in a large bowl. With an electric mixer, blend the oil, pepper powder and dried chipotle together. Add the chipotle, and mix until the mixture is well mixed. Spread the mixture onto plastic wrap lightly dusted with a little plain flour or cornmeal. Cover with plastic wrap, and set aside at room temperature for at least 1 hour to allow it to absorb the flavours. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,kale,chipotle chile,catfish,thyme sprig,gorgonzola,vegetable stock chicken
title: Fish Soup With Sausage and Cascabel
