ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chile, in adobo | 1 smoked catfish | 3 tablespoons gorgonzola ( or other fat-free cheese ) | 4 cans vegetable stock or 4 cups chicken stock | 1 bunch kale, rinsed, stemmed, and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest, freshly grated zest of
instructions: Dry basil in a dry skillet set over medium heat. Sprinkle with thyme, chiles, and catfish. Cook until hot and easily flaked with a fork, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Set aside. Melt 2 tbsp gorgonzola in saucepan over low heat. Add stock, and boil until reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Add kale and lemon zest, and boil for 2 to 3 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Creamy Cranberry Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2/3 cup dried apricots, chopped | 1/3 cup white wine | 1 cup dried cranberries ( i used craisins ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 3/4 cup goat cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning
instructions: Rinse and drain the dried apricots. Place the apricots in a small saucepan with the white wine, cranberries, and half & half and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 8 - 10 minutes until thickened slightly. Remove from heat, and stir in goat cheese. Add taco seasoning and adjust seasoning to taste. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Easy Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1/2 lb linguine, preferably with long, flat steel strands, of about 1/4 to 1/2 inch diameter | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 1 package snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil until a few tablespoons of cooking water sprinkled on the pasta turns pale blond, about 2 minutes. Add the linguine and cook for 13 to 14 minutes, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Drain the pasta, reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Transfer to a large bowl. Stir the cooked pasta into the reserved cooking liquid. Stir in the pimientos and snow peas. Add the reserved pasta cooking liquid to the pot, mix well. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cognac,yellow bell pepper,oyster sauce,italian sausage,worcestershire sauce,aniseed,salt black pepper,fine breadcrumb
title: Baked Sausages in Sicilian Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces italian sausages | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon cognac | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon ground aniseed | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Pierce the sausage links all over. In a medium size bowl, mix together worcestershire sauce, cognac, oyster sauce, anise, and fine dry bread crumbs. Dredge links in crumb mixture until well coated. Arrange the links in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour enough sauce over the sausages to cover them completely. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes or until cooked through, turning to cook all sides. Let sit for a few minutes, uncover and serve warm.

title: Chipotle Glazed Salmon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo | 12 -16 ounces salmon | 1/4 cup creme fraiche | fresh dill
instructions: Place chipoltes on a large cutting board or in a coffee grinder and process until ground. You can also do this in a blender.

title: Tortellini Salad With Shredded Beef
ingredients: 4 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 3/4 lb cooked ground beef | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 bag frozen tortellini, cooked according to package directions ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | peanut butter | 1 can baked beans with roasted asparagus | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Combine the beef, corn, and tortellini in a large bowl. In another large bowl, combine the peanut butter, roasted asparagus and baking soda, set aside, until ready to use. Just before serving, toss the beef mixture in with the asparagus and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,quinoa,chili pepper flake,nigella seed,creme fraiche,black pepper
title: Creamy Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( not the quick-cooking kind ) | 1 3/4 cups vegetable stock, divided | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon nigella seeds ( shelled pistils ) | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche or 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Combine quinoa and 1/4 cup of the stock in a medium saucepan. Cook over low medium heat until quinoa is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed, about 10 minutes. Stir in remaining 1/4 cup stock and chili flakes. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Stir in remaining teaspoon spices and creme fraiche, garnish with fennel seeds and chillies to serve.

title: Izakaya Sakura Avocado with Shiroyaki Dressing
ingredients: 24 medium avocados | 1/2 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°f. Cut the avocados in half lengthwise. Place the avocado halves cut side up in an ovenproof dish. Drizzle generously with mirin. Bake for about 30 minutes, or until the avocados turn soft and lightly colored on the exterior. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Chicken Wings
ingredients: 6 chicken wings | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into chunks | 1 can apricot jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange chicken wings in the baking dish in 3 rows, skin side up. Toss yellow bell pepper with apricot jam until coated evenly. Pour jam over chicken wings. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until sauce has reduced and wings are tender.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,tart apple,green cardamom pod,dark chocolate
title: Chocolates in Oil (Kulfi)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dark chocolate | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed with edge of knife blade running | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Place 1/4 teaspoon of dark chocolate in small bowl. Heat 1 teaspoon sesame oil in small heavy nonstick skillet over low heat until chocolate is hot. Pour chocolate into small bowl set in microwave and heat, stirring once or twice, until just beginning to melt, about 1 minute. Stir in 1/4 teaspoon dark chocolate and 1/4 teaspoon dark chocolate liqueur or 1 teaspoon dark rum. Stir until combined, about 1 minute. Divide among serving plates and garnish with remaining white chocolate curls.

title: Zhongnyok (Pepperminted Meat for Two)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses | 1/2 small red chilies, seeded and sliced diagonally | 1/2 - 3/4 cup brewed espresso or 1/2-3/4 cup strong coffee | 1/2 lb sirloin, cut in cubes | 1/2 cup pomegranate-infused liqueur, such as meringue, such as kahlua or 1/2 cup frangelico | 5 medium ripe bananas or 5 medium other firm ripe bananas | 2 small firm tart apples ( peeled, cored, and cut into small wedges ) | 3 -4 sprigs of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, combine 1 tablespoon of the pomegranate molasses, chilies, and espresso. Add meat and toss to coat. Let marinate for 15 minutes. Remove meat and set aside. In a small saucepan, heat remaining pomegranate molasses until hot. Strain liquid, reserving 1 cup, and add reserved liquid to molasses mixture. Simmer, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Set meat aside. In a small saucepan, heat reserved liquid just until it boils. Remove from heat. Transfer fruit to a food processor and chop. Add reserved marinade and pour over meat.

title: Niter Kebab
ingredients: 3 tablespoons paprika | 3 teaspoons fennel seeds, crushed
instructions: Mix all the ingredients well together. Store in a dry, dark, dry glass covered bowl or plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: cream,poblano pepper,equal sugar substitute,green onion,brown sugar
title: Poblano Jalapeno Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium poblano pepper, roasted peeled, coarsely chopped | 4 green onions, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon equal sugar substitute | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: In a food processor, mix everything except sour cream and brown sugar until smooth. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Prior to serving, mix sour cream and brown sugar in a bowl and then add to food processor and process until well blended.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,chili powder,lard,basmati rice,cabbage carrot coleslaw mix,hamburger,italian seasoning
title: Mexican Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 package cabbage and carrot coleslaw mix | 1 - 1 1/2 cup instant long grain rice, uncooked | 1 -2 teaspoon chili powder | 2 teaspoons dried basil and italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon lard, or other vegetable oil | 1 1 cup basmati rice
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain fat. Mix with rice, chili powder, basil and seasoning. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. While that is cooking, heat oil in pan that's been sprayed with cooking spray or a little bit of the lard. Put the rice in the pan along with remaining meat and cabbage. Mix well. Serve as is or with guacomole.

title: Curried Shrimp and Horseradish Shrimp over Bulgur (Bamia Nut Meal)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 lb large shrimp or 1 lb prawns, peeled and deveined | 1 1/2 cups low-fat tomato juice, preferably from canned tomatoes | 1 1/2 tablespoons horseradish, drained | 3 ounces bulgur, finely-chopped ( i prefer bulgur for this ) | 1 1 teaspoon crushed cayenne or 1 teaspoon green chili pepper flakes | 3/4 teaspoon fish sauce
instructions: In a medium nonreactive saucepan, simmer the curry powder in the boiling tomato juice for 5 minutes, or until lightly reduced and fragrant.

title: Butternut Squash Souffle
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs butternut squash, peeled seeded and cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1/8 teaspoon lemon extract | salt and pepper | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate | 2 teaspoons hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Place squash on a baking sheet or piece of foil.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,lemon,yellow bell pepper,chipotle chile adobo,flour tortilla
title: Grilled Pepper and Scotch Bonnet Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 large yellow bell peppers, halved and thinly sliced lengthwise | 2 large scotch bonnet peppers, sliced lengthwise | 4 flour tortillas | 6 slices chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped ( canned without oil, recommended ) | 1 lemon, cut into small wedges
instructions: Prepare grill or preheat broiler. Brush both sides of bell peppers with oil and arrange on rack in broiler pan. Allow peppers to broil 6 - 8 minutes or until browned lightly on both sides. Turn peppers, and cook for 3 - 4 minutes on second side, until charred. Remove from broiler and wrap in aluminum foil. Allow peppers to rest 10 - 15 minutes. Place peppers on a grill rack coated with oil, and grill turning over once, until charred but still slightly blackened at the edges, about 15 to 20 minutes. Turn heat into a food processor, and finely grate peppers over coarse chopping board. Scrape down sides when necessary until mixture is the consistency of heavy cream. Remove peppers from grinder, and chop coarsely. Combine peppers and scotch bonnet peppers in a large skillet over medium high heat. When warm, spoon 1/4 of sauce over each tortilla. Place one chipotle slice on top of each portion of food, and close with toothpicks. Heat over medium heat until hot. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Jalapeno Poached Salmon
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons prepared jalapenos, minced ( from a jar ) | 2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1/2 cup spanish onion, minced | 4 skinless salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix jalapenos minced, poultry seasoning, and onion.

title: Salami Wrapped Kumara Kumara
ingredients: 1 large kumara, halved lengthways | 1 1/2 tablespoons coconut oil | salami | serrano chili, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 120c or 140c fan forced. Slice the kumara lengthways and scoop out the seeds. Scatter the whole or partially cooked komara flesh decoratively on an ovenproof baking tray or baking sheet. Drizzle with the oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Roast for 30 minutes, until almost tender and beginning to caramelise. Meanwhile slice salami, chili and deseeded kumara flesh. To roll the Kumara, lift onto a large plate or onto a serving plate. Drizzle with the sherry, then pile together with the salami, chili, kumara and red onion. Serve.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,cottage cheese,chicken breast,artichoke heart,garlic clove,vegetable stock,chicken bouillon cube,anchovy paste
title: Carnation Chicken
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 cup italian salad dressing mix | 2 chopped garlic cloves | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons low fat cottage cheese | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 - 1/2 cup italian-style salad dressing mix ( to your taste )
instructions: Cube chicken into bite sized pieces. Mix all ingredients and marinate overnight. Place in crock pot for low overnight, then high until chicken is done.

title: Grandma's Gator Crumble
ingredients: 11 ounces graham cracker crumbs | 1 brown onion, finely chopped
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix graham cracker crumbs and brown onion together. Press into a baking dish that has been lined with tin foil or parchment paper. Sprinkle the crumble mixture over the crumble and dot with the melted butter. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Barley & Pearl Onions
ingredients: 16 ounces pearl barley ( about 2 cups of chopped barley ) | 12 ounces peeled white pearl onions | 1/4 cup ground red pepper
instructions: Cook the barley in a medium saucepan until tender, about 25 minutes. While the barley cooks, prepare the onions by halving and slicing them in half crosswise. When the barley is almost done, place the onions and red pepper in a bowl and toss. Drain the barley and pearl barley, reserving the barley and pearl onion cooking liquid. Stir the barley liquid into the vegetables until moistened and serve.

title: Frijoles (Fried Beans)
ingredients: 50 g dried beans, soaked overnight & drained, keeping the soaking water | 5 spring onions, finely chopped
instructions: Place soaked beans on cloth & tie with kitchen string. Heat 1 cupful of hot bean soaking water then drain the water. Heat the rest of the olive oil in a skillet. When the oil is very hot, add beans & fry on low heat for about 10 mins, or until the color changes. Add the spring onions & fry for another 3 mins until they become soft & golden. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,yogurt,grand marnier,sultana,pear,anaheim chili,vanilla essence,broccoli floret
title: Creamy Caribbean Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons pineapple chunks | 4 tablespoons sultanas | 4 tablespoons curds or 4 tablespoons yoghurt | 4 tablespoons grand marnier, or 3 drops other milk liqueur | 4 tablespoons instant mashed oats | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 1 -2 hot anaheim chili, seeds and membrane removed, sliced | 1 small pears or 1 small apple, chopped & roasted or unpeeled | 2 cans broccoli florets
instructions: Topping, mix all ingredients together and pour into a well greased 8 inch cake pan.. Bake at 180 degrees celcius, for 45 minutes, until lightly golden brown. Sprinkle topping on while warm and let cool. Serve or cover and let set. Top with whipped cream, fresh fruit, chilli and a fresh herb if desired.

title: Roasted Cauliflower Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 2 1/2 lbs baby portabella mushrooms | 2 cups wine, vinho verde ( red wine ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Break cauliflower into small pieces and blanch in the boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain. In a roasting pan, layer cauliflower, mushrooms, wine and bouillon, if using, on top. Cover with a sheet of foil and roast in oven, stirring halfway through, for 1 hour, or until cauliflower is soft. Let cool, remove foil and bake for 20 minutes more, or until cauliflower is fork tender.

title: Lettuce Wraps from Ting-Town Style
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup red leaf lettuce | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 bag frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Remove fat from beef. Trim and discard fat. Score board with sharp knife. Cut meat into 2 strips. Combine mustard and tabasco. Spread over meat. Roll meat tightly in mixture, overlapping edges slightly. Arrange on dull side of platter. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 1/2 hours. Meanwhile, cook lettuce according to directions on package. Drain. Cover and chill at least ½ hour. To serve, stir cornstarch into catsup. Heat over medium high heat 5 to 10 seconds or until thickened. Spread 1 tbsp. Of catsup on each roll.

title: Grilled Kielbasa W-Apricot
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked rigatoni pasta | 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa ( sliced very thin ) | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup mango chutney
instructions: Preheat outdoor grill to medium high. Prepare grill for direct heat and lightly oil grate. In a medium saucepan, bring 2/3 cup water to a boil. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and rinse under cold water. Drain well and while still hot, transfer to a large serving bowl. In a 10 inch nonstick skillet, heat preserves. To assemble kielbasa, in 1 quart ovenproof skillet, place half the kielbasa. Top each with half the preserves. Dollop apricot mixture evenly on top of kielbasa. Top with remaining kielbasa, apricot preserves and chutney. Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, or until heated through and kielbasa is heated through. Cover and let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese | 3 1/2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let stand several hours before use. Serve at room temperature or cold.

title: Sarson Kaftai (Spinach Salad)
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained well | 1/2 cup tamarind paste or 1/2 cup crushed arils | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel, for garnish
instructions: Place spinach, tamarind concentrate, lemon peel and lemon juice into a salad bowl. Add water to cover. Cover and chill well.

title: Salmon and Chilies with Flaked Salmon
ingredients: 800 g sirloin | 50 g of minced chilies, from a jar of roasted chilies ( from a 1.5kg jar ) | 3 tablespoons minced chilies from a 3kg jar | 1/4 lb salmon fillet, 1 inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celcius. Cut the salmon into 4 thick slices crossways. Spray an ovenproof dish with a cooking oil spray and arrange 3 slices of salmon on the base, allowing each piece to overlap slightly in the dish and to rise up over the salmon. Pour over 1/4 cup of the chunky salsa evenly over the salmon. Sprinkle 2 tbsp of the minced chilies over this. Cover with the final piece of salmon and place in the oven. Cook for 20 minutes or until salmon is cooked, sprinkle with the rest of the salsa, and serve straight away.

title: Ceci-Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 500 ml whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Place all ingredients in saucepan. Serve with noodles or rice.

title: Italian Almond Paste
ingredients: 1/4 cup almond extract | 2 tablespoons garlic paste
instructions: In a small bowl combine the almond extract, garlic paste, and the almond milk. Mix well. Variation 1, toasted crushed almonds, add 2 - 3 tablespoons blanched or sliced almonds to the almond paste, mix well.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,panko breadcrumb,orange,pineapple ring,jalapeno,lime wedge,pineapple tidbit
title: Jamaican Pork Patties
ingredients: 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup orange puffed fresh pineapple tidbits | 4 tablespoons jalapenos, chopped, seeds removed | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 2 teaspoons lime wedges ( optional ) | plain pita chips ( optional ) or crushed pineapple rings ( optional ) | pineapple rings, to serve with pork chops
instructions: Combine panko and panko in a shallow bowl. Mix in pineapple, jalapeños, vanilla sugar and lemon wedges. Turn out onto a plate and roll up to form large patties. Repeat with remaining patties. Toast pita chips or crush with a rolling pin on a cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Place patties, if using, on baking sheet. Brush tops with a little oil. Broil or grill patties about 3 - 4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through. If using toothpicks if using, cut into 4 long strips. Serve with plain, pita chips. Also good with pineapple wedges.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated pizza dough | 2 cups frozen spinach leaves, thawed, squeezed dry & amp, chopped | 1 cup frozen green pea | 1 jar of diced pimientos, drained | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary | 1/4 cup canned sliced cherry tomatoes ( optional ) | 2 bags fresh spinach leaves, thawed & amp, chopped
instructions: Unroll dough & refrigerate. Remove from refrigerator and sprinkle dough with chopped spinach, green peas, pimentos, horseradish, rosemary & chopped tomatoes if using. On a sprayed tray, lightly spray with olive oil, sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bake 10 - 12 minutes in a preheated 450°f oven or until lightly browned.

title: Artichoke Hummus
ingredients: 1 can artichoke, drained and finely chopped | 16 fluid ounces buttermilk | 1 cup grated almonds | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Soak the artichokes in water to cover for 30 minutes, then drain and chop into cubes. Mix in the buttermilk.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,ham hock,lettuce,lime wedge,milk,celery root,stewing beef
title: Brazilian Beef and Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 32 ounces evaporated milk | 6 ounces diced celery root | 2 lbs fresh lime wedges | 1 tablespoon dehydrated ham hock | garlic salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except salt, in crock pot, cook until meat is tender. Place in freezer container to freeze. The beef should defrost in about 1 hour before serving. Remove from crock pot and put in crockpot. Cook for at least another 2 - 3 hours. Serve in a bowl with a dollop of sour cream as garnish.

title: Baked Shredded Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck | cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place meat in a large roasting pan and sprinkle evenly with cayenne pepper. Cover with foil and place in the oven. Bake 2 hours, turning meat every hour. Turn meat and bake a least 1 1/2 hours more.

title: Amaretto Glaze for Dipping Sauerkrauts
ingredients: 1 cup glaze ( commercial glaze all purpose, recipe follows ) | 2 teaspoons cardamom pods, slightly crushed ( may use 2 tsp powder ) | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup amaretto, warmed
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in a covered container.

title: Pecan Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin chop, cut into thick chops | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1 1/2 cups pecans, ground | 1 package jumbo shrimp, uncooked
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Place pork chops in a medium nonstick saute pan. Cook until browned.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,red cabbage,beef stock,golden raisin,baking chocolate,chili sauce,mexican cheese,crescent dinner
title: Chili Calzones (Cabbage Slumpers)
ingredients: 2 cans crescent dinner rolls | 1 head red cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 cup mexican blend cheese ( shredded ) | 1 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 1 cup beef stock | 4 tablespoons good quality baking chocolate, grated | 24 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Grease a baking sheet. Cut dough into eight 1/4 inch thick strips. Lay dough strips on the greased baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove and set aside. Combine cabbage/cheese, raisins, chili sauce and beef stock in a large bowl. Bring to a boil and cook 3 minutes or until heated. Stir in shredded chocolate. Transfer 2 tbsp. Cheese mixture to a small bowl and use to top casseroles. Return rolls to oven and cook about 8 minutes or until golden. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: spinach,coconut milk,apricot brandy,yellow bell pepper,ketjap manis,sugar substitute,lasagna noodle,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Spinach-Bell Peppers-Chow
ingredients: 4 sheets lasagna noodles, halved lengthwise | 1/2 cup ketjap manis | 3 tablespoons sugar substitute | 1 can light coconut milk, well shaken | 2 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk | 2 tablespoons apricot brandy, cognac or 2 tablespoons brandy, liqueur ( optional ) | 2 cups chopped romaine lettuce leaves | 3 large yellow bell peppers, seeded, cut diagonally into 1/2-2-inch slices, 1/8-inch thick
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit coat rectangular baking dish with cooking spray or line with foil paper. Rinse noodles under cold running water and drain well. Transfer noodles to prepared dish and spread evenly with 1/4 cup ketjap manis. Roast 10 minutes. To make sauce, combine coconut milk, sweetened condensed milk and cognac in a medium saucepan. Heat through. Toss the lettuce with hot noodle mixture and the remaining 1 tablespoon ketjap manis. Serve with remaining sweetened condensed milk and the optional condiment of choice.

Random Ingredients: baby red potato,cumin powder,golden syrup,pear,gelatin,amaretto,honey,brown rice
title: Pears With a Honey Glaze
ingredients: 4 baby red potatoes | 1 pears | 2 teaspoons honey | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon amaretto | 3 tablespoons crystallized aubergine golden syrup | 1 packet plain unflavored gelatin | 2 cups cooked brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius. Cut the pears into 8 wedges and place on a baking tray. Make the glaze by placing the honey, cumin, sesame cream and aubergine golden syrup in a saucepan and heat gently, stirring together. Pour over the pears and bake 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are soft but not mushy. Cool slightly and gently toss with the cooled ginger and potato pieces. To serve, spoon the pears onto a plate and drizzle over the glaze. Eat with brown rice, if you like.

title: Taquito Seasoning - Tex Mex Style
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried oregano leaves | 1/4 cup dehydrated taco seasoning | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Combine all together in a small bowl or ziplock baggie and use as directed on the seasoning packet.

title: Cowboy Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese | 1/2 cup caramel topping, heated
instructions: Rinse black eyed peas.

Random Ingredients: orange lentil,chicken breast tender,hot red chili pepper,chicken thigh
title: Posh Lentil Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely chopped dried orange lentils | 1 teaspoon minced hot red chili pepper | 6 -8 boneless skinless chicken thighs, halved ( about 1lb ) | 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken tenders or 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts
instructions: Rinse and discard any damaged ingredients. Combine the lentils with the chile and 1/4 cup water. Cover and set aside. Place the chicken in a 10 inch skillet that has been coated with cooking spray. Add 1/4 cup water, pressing down on the bottom of the skillet. Bring to a boil over high heat, turn down the heat, and cover tightly. Simmer 20 minutes to an hour, basting periodically with the reserved lentil water. Remove chicken from skillet. Increase heat to high and heat until boiling. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until liquid is reduced by half, about 20 minutes. Serve the lentil chicken in warm bowls over couscous, accompanied by a tossed greens tossed with chutney. Note, i made this in a 2 quart casserole with 3 cups of the cooking liquid and 6 or 8 chicken thighs. It was outstanding.

Random Ingredients: tapioca flour,whipping cream,white wine vinegar,semolina flour,rice vermicelli,lamb chop,rice vinegar,black pepper
title: Malaysian Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons tapioca flour | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 2 lbs lamb chops, trimmed of fat and cut into 2 `` cubes | 2 tablespoons dry-roasted rice vermicelli ( or other long rice vermicelli ) | 3 cups short-grain rice noodles | 1/4 cup chilled whipping cream
instructions: In a 1 quart bowl, combine the tapioca flour, rice vinegar, pepper and all but 1 teaspoon of the liquid. Add chops, rice vermicelli, remaining liquid and cream.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,green pea,thyme,chili pepper flake,serrano pepper
title: Green Pea and Basil Salsa
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh green peas | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped basil leaf | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 2 tablespoons finely chopped serrano peppers
instructions: Rinse peas well under cold water. Put peas in a small bowl and stir in spices and herbs. Serve immediately.

title: Linda's Easy Lunch Burritos
ingredients: 4 large flour tortillas | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce or 1 cup chunky salsa | 1 cup hot sauce, of your choice | 2 tablespoons rum | 1 cup chunky salsa ( i prefer red or white but i like black ) or 1 cup guacamole ( i prefer red or white but i like black )
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 400 degrees. Divide the lettuce into four four bowls. Top with hot sauce, rum and salsa. Place each bowl of filling in one and place in the oven for approximately 15 minutes,. Or until the tortillas are golden.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,salsa,egg wrap,mozzarella cheese,flat leaf parsley
title: Quick and Easy Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup salsa | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 package egg roll wrap | 1 1/2 - 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook salsa and parsley in a small skillet over medium heat until warm, about 1 minute. Spread 1/4 cup salsa and all but 2 t. Of the butter in the bottom of a 12 x 14 inch baking dish. Place 3 egg roll wrappers in dish, overlapping them as necessary. Using a 1/2 cup measuring scoop, press down center of each wrapper with your fingers to make a small cup shape. Sprinkle 1 t. Of the cheese on each wrapper. Arrange 1/2 cups of the salsa mixture along the outside edge of each wrapper. Starting with the wide side, roll up the wrapper, making sure all sides are sealed. With a spatula, carefully transfer the rolled wrappers to the baking sheet. Repeat process with the remaining wrappers and filling. Top with remaining salsa and all of the remaining cheese. Bake until the cheese filling is bubbly and golden brown, about 25 minutes. Let cool at least 5 minutes before removing the rolls from the baking sheet.

title: Crockpot Sweet and Sour Brisket
ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed beef brisket, drained | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped | 2 spring onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Combine the sweetened condensed beef brisket, cashews, onions, barbecue sauce, baking soda, and cayenne pepper in a 5 liter crockpot. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or on high for 4 hours.

title: Chickpea, Lentil and Chilies Raita
ingredients: 1 cup green lentil | 1 red chilies, deseeded and finely chopped ( optional ) | 400 g chickpeas or 400 g split yellow beans, drained and rinsed | spices, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Place lentils and chilies in pan with 125ml boiling water. Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes, until lentils are cooked and tender. Heat remaining oil in frying pan over medium heat. Add beans and fry, stirring, for a few minutes. Stir in cooked lentils and sauces, or mix in vegetables. Serve hot or cold as accompaniment to meat, fish or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,dark soy sauce,chicken bouillon cube,vegetable oil cooking spray,red tomato,sausage,pita bread,cooking oil
title: Red Tomato, Sausage and Pitas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | cooking oil | 1 1/2 lbs sliced chinese-style sausages ( can be substituted with other sausage ) | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 10 firm red ripe tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 8 pita breads, warmed
instructions: Wrap the sausages in plastic wrap and refrigerate them until ready to cook. Heat a grill pan over high heat or place a cast iron griddle on the rack. Coat the sausages with oil and grill them, turning, until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side. While the sausages are grilling, bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add 1 tbsp of the soy sauce and the bouillon cube. Place the tomatoes, cut side up, on a plate. In the drippings from the tomatoes, add the olive oil and cook over high heat, stirring, until fragrant and starting to colour, about 2 minutes. When the tomatoes are beginning to give colour, stir in the diced sausages and continue cooking 2 minutes. Divide the sausage and tomato among warmed pita halves. Spoon the onion mixture into warmed pita halves.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,mustard seed,topping,red chilies,swordfish steak
title: Simple Chilli Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 3 -3 kaffir lime leaves ( or other chilli ) | 1 lb swordfish steak | 4 fresh red chilies ( or 4 medium fresh chili ) | fat-free whipped topping
instructions: Put mustard seeds in a large frying pan. Add 5 - 7 tbsp boiling water and cook for about 8 minutes. Remove from heat and grind mixture with a spice or pestle. Slice fish or slice very thinly and add 1 tbsp sweetened chilli sauce, to the mustard seeds. Pour over the remaining sauce. Mix well. Put in fridge for 2 - 3 days. Drain off any remaining sauce. Serve with a dollop of whipped topping.

title: Vegetable Toast
ingredients: 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables, thawed & drained ( such as carrots, lima beans, chard, spinach, cauliflower, corn or cauliflower combination ) | 2 slices white bread | 1 bay leaf | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil ( optional )
instructions: Heat a skillet or a griddle, and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Toast the bread until golden, about 3 to 4 minutes each side. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a skillet, if using, over medium high heat. Add the veggie mixture, bay leaf and salt, to taste, except for the white bread. Cook until the veggie mixture is hot and heated through, about 5 minutes. Add more oil if it seems dry. Place the cooked bread on a plate to serve.

title: Tasty Chicken Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 skin-on chicken breasts | 500 g shell pasta, cooked, drained ( i used gemelli ) | 3 cups greek yogurt | 1/2 cup miracle whip | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 cup shortening | 1 cup miracle whip | 3 -4 teaspoons mixed spice ( i use baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix )
instructions: Cut chicken breasts into thick strips. Place in a large mixing bowl and sprinkle with 3/4 teaspoons mixed spice mix and 1/2 cup of shortening to coat. Mix and refrigerate until serving. Boil pasta until tender and drain. Rinse with cold water. Drain pasta and return to bowl. Add chicken and toss to coat. Sprinkle with remaining 3/4 teaspoons of mixed spice mix. Serve with salad dressing.

title: Healthy Bran and Scallion Mac And Cheese Pasta Fresca
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon tamari | 10 ounces of your favourite pasta in gluten free packet ( gluten free ) | 8 ounces broccoli-florets in bran cereal | 1 -2 teaspoon sifted fresh scallion
instructions: Cook pasta, rinse with cold water, drain and set aside. Toast sieve and set aside. Heat some olive oil in a frypan till smoking, add scallions, fry till light brown, add to pasta and stir to coat. Add tamari, toss through for 1 - 2 minutes, serve immediately. The longer it sets the better the sauce.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,bow tie pasta,watermelon,soda water,dark rum,monterey jack cheese
title: Bowties & Melon Crush
ingredients: 5 cups bow tie pasta, cooked al dente | 4 ounces uncooked button mushrooms ( capsicums ) | 1 can soda water | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 1/4 cups watermelon, cut into 1 inch cubes | 6 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In an ovenproof dish, combine cooked bowties noodles, mushrooms, soda water, cheese, and watermelon. Stir and bake for 20 to 25 min or till hot. Serve immediately, sprinkled with rum.

title: Italian Chicken and Coffee Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup hot and strong coffee | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons chicken breasts, grilled, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 4 lettuce leaves, for garnish | 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt, for garnish
instructions: Combine hot coffee and chopped rosemary in small bowl.

title: Grilled Meat With Apples
ingredients: 300 ml minced leftover meat | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 3 apples, thinly diced ( mcintosh is best )
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Pour in a well greased grill or bbq pan, and grill for 5 – 7 minutes or until meat begins to brown slightly and the apples are warm through. Serve with rice.

title: Custard Covered Beef Tenderloin With Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 8 beef tenderloin, center cut on a rack, tied securely with kitchen twine | 2 cups reduced-fat custard | 2 large eggs, lightly beaten | 1 cup fat-free half-and-half | 1/2 cup nonfat plain half-and-half | 1/4 cup yukon gold port | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In shallow dish using rubber spatula, combine custard and eggs.

title: Potato Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 2 cups mashed potatoes ( not instant ) | 2 cups potato starch
instructions: Stir potato starch into mashed potato until smooth.

title: Easy Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup prepared enchilada sauce, or more to taste ( divided ) | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 medium onion, chopped ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta, or more as needed ( optional )
instructions: Heat chicken stock in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir in 2 tablespoons enchilada sauce and set over medium low heat. Melt shortening in a small skillet over medium heat.

title: Pineapple & Bacon Damper
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup pineapple juice, your favourite | 1 cup fresh cilantro, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped bacon, chopped into pats | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn, mixed with | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice
instructions: Place the flour, sugar, peppercorns, bacon and half pineapple juice into the bowl of a food processor and pulse several times until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs/chopsticks using a medium pulse. Add the rest of the pineapple juice and continue to pulse until the mixture forms a paste, adding more flour or pineapple juice if necessary. Shape the mixture into small balls, roll in the chopped cilantro and season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Place the onigiri onto a lightly greased tray, cover with baking paper, and set aside in the fridge for 30 min to allow the dumplings to dry out. Preheat the oven to 220c / 400f/ gas mark 7/29 – or 180c if fan forced. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes, checking after 5 mins and swapping the positions as needed, until they have a golden crust. Remove, transfer the dumplings to a serving plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,lettuce leaf,anise seed,head cabbage,banana,chili sauce
title: Thai Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 medium head of cabbage ( about 300g ) | 2 medium bananas | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon anise seed | lettuce leaf
instructions: Wash and dry cabbage. Cut into long thin strips. Peel and slice bananas. Heat saki and fry the cabbage for 3 - 4 minutes until it is just starting to become limp. Remove from fire and mix in the chilli sauce, bicarbonate of soda, and aniseed. Spoon onto lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: urad dal,red bell pepper,ramen noodle,pesto sauce,plum sauce,andouille sausage,seasoning
title: Andouille Sausage and Peppers
ingredients: 1 package dry ramen noodles | 2 teaspoons dry rubbed idli seasoning | 1 package sliced fully cooked andouille sausage | 1 jar purchased refrigerated pesto sauce | 1 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1 jar plum sauce
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,chili sauce,moong dahl be pea,dill pickle,irish cream,tortilla
title: Bailey's Irish Pizza
ingredients: 10 8 inch oven proof tortillas | 1 1/2 cups freshly grated emmenthaler cheese or 1 1/2 cups parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas, thawed | 1/3 cup italian sweet'n choclate'cream | 1/3 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Place 3 tortillas on work surface. Spread chili sauce evenly on tortillas. Sprinkle top with grated cheese. Spread peas evenly. Roll up. Serve with additional chili sauce and grated cheese as desired.

title: Smoked Haddock With Sweet Peanut & Hot Red Cabbage
ingredients: 100 g smoked haddock ( can be sliced into 3 rounds ) | 100 g sweet peas and thawed rolled oats | 4 kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons peanuts ( or roasted pistachios, finely chopped ) | 1/3 small sweet red cabbage, shredded ( or a mixture of any other seasonal vegetable )
instructions: Cook the haddock and peas separately in salted water for 5 minutes drain and keep warm in the oven as you cook the other ingredients. Place the coconut, peas, lime leaves and nuts in a baking dish and top with the cabbage, and place under a hot grill until the cabbage has darkly crisped.

title: Broccoli Raita
ingredients: 10 ounces broccoli, floweretts peeled | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 3 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/8 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Slice the broccoli into thin spears. Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Add the blanched broccoli and cover. Cook 5 minutes or until tender. Drain, cool and transfer to a bowl. In a large bowl, combine the buttermilk, yogurt, orange juice, tarragon and allspice. Stir into the broccoli and fold together gently. Taste and adjust for sweetness and salt. Chill. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,taco seasoning mix,liquid honey,thai chili sauce,orange,kidney bean,anchovy paste,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Chorizo & Bean Chili
ingredients: 1 tablespoon finely chopped orange rind | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon liquid honey | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons low-sodium taco meat seasoning mix, package | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed | 2 teaspoons fresh minced thai sweet chili sauce | 2 teaspoons chipotle-flavored taco seasoning mix, package
instructions: Finely dice 1/4 cup orange peel and set aside. Mix the remaining ingredients except the dried beans, chili sauce and chipotle in a large skillet. Bring to a boil over medium low heat and simmer 5 minutes. Add the drained kidney beans and simmer, uncovered, until flavors meld and the beans are very hot. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. To serve, divide mixture among 6 soup bowls and sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup of orange peel on top of each bowl.

title: Creamy Cauliflower and Quinoa With Irish Cream
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, cored and cut into florets | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup white quinoa | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme or 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | fresh fruit, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the optional ones.

Random Ingredients: green food coloring,american cheese,mozzarella cheese,provolone cheese,pineapple
title: Pineapple and French Canadian Roll up Antipasto Toasts
ingredients: 6 ounces hawaiian cheese | 1/2 cup pineapple, chopped | 1/2 cup green food coloring, approximate | 3 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese | 4 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Mix pineapple with green food coloring. Cut the cheeses in half diagonally. Using a 3'' round cookie cutter, cut the cheese slice into 1 squares. Place 1 rounded tablespoon of the pineapple mixture on one half of the cheese square. Press the cheese down lightly. Place other half on top and press the edges with a fork to seal. Place on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate 30 minutes, or until serving time. Serve in a shallow soup bowl. This can also be done with cream cheese, but i prefer the consistency of whipping cream.

Random Ingredients: chili,pork loin chop,baby spinach leaf,baby spinach,spring onion
title: Lori's Baked Pork Chops
ingredients: 6 pork loin chops, 1 1/2cm thick | 4 spring onions, cut into chunks | 200 g baby spinach leaves | 1/4 cup coriander's chili, spice paste | 20 g baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c/fan 160°c/gas grease a 5cm deep, non stick baking tray with olive oil, lay the chops skin side down in the tray. Bake for about 5 minutes, turn the chops skin side up and continue baking for about 30 - 45 minutes, or until the chops are cooked and browned. Set the trimmings aside. Boil water, add the spinach and cook for 2 - 5 mins, drain, remove and cut into small pieces. Mix the spinach with the chili, mustard and a spoonful of coriander/chili paste. Cut the chops into thin slices and pile between two plates. Add the spinach salad to the pork chops and serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,grain rice,rosemary,kidney bean,rice vinegar,italian plum tomato,heavy cream,frangelico
title: Ravioli Con Arroz Con Crema
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice, short grain | 1 can crushed italian plum tomatoes | 3 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 ounce roasted rice vinegar | 1 bunch rosemary | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 1/3 cup frangelico or 1/3 cup other orange-flavored liqueur | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a large pot, soak rice in cold water for 30 minutes, then transfer to a strainer and let drain overnight. In same pot bring 3 cups of water. Add all ingredients except frangelico and beans and simmer for 30 minutes. Mix well and cook for one minute. Add the frangelico and cook for an additional minute. Stir in the drained and rinsed drained beans and cook for another three minutes. Serve over fresh or slightly cooled cooked pasta of your choice.

title: Jicama and Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 1/4 cup butter | 2 teaspoons ground cloves | 1 medium jicama, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch rounds
instructions: Cut chicken and jicama into 1/2 inch cubes. Thread 4 pieces onto 4 long metal skewers. Cover with plastic wrap.

title: Fried Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 package pre-cooked brown rice | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the cream of celery soup, brown rice, and saffron together in a bowl.

title: Asparagus and Sausage With Italian Sausage
ingredients: 5 asparagus spears, trimmed | 2 large italian sausages | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | 2 -3 cups cooked lamb, cubed
instructions: Trim the root ends and break the asparagus tips into 2 inch pieces with a vegetable peeler. Boil the asparagus for 3 - 5 minutes until crisp tender but not mushy. Remove asparagus to bowl with cold water.

title: Sweetened Condensed Peas
ingredients: 150 g chickpea flour | 1 large green pepper, diced | 4 -6 tablespoons pineapple preserves | fresh rosemary leaves ( optional )
instructions: Peel and dice green pepper into small dice. Add all ingredients into food processor and process until smooth. If mixture is too thick add a little water. Transfer mixture to a sealed container and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until chilled. The longer it refrigerates the better results.

title: Linguine With Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 can minced clams ( in the can ) | 3/4 cup bottled clam juice | 1 teaspoon season-all salt | lemon wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Meanwhile, remove clams from shells, reserving juice. Heat clam juice in a saucepan over medium high heat until reduced by half. Add the reserved clam juice, season with the salt and simmer until sauce thickens. Drain linguine and return to pot. Add clam chowder mixture and heat through. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Sesame Oil-Braised Chicken
ingredients: 1 quart chicken stock | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Heat the chicken stock in a wide soup pot to boiling point. While it is heating, in a small, heavy skillet over high heat, pour the sesame oil. When the oil shimmers, remove the saucepan from the heat and pour in the sesame oil. Place the chicken, skin side down, in the hot oil. Turn the chicken breast side up and cook until the skin is golden brown, about 10 minutes. Turn the chicken over and transfer the pan to a baking sheet lined with wax paper or parchment paper and roast the chicken in a 200 degree f oven until it is golden brown and no longer pink inside, about 20 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: scallion,veal,spanish onion,chili pepper flake,herbes de provence
title: Herbes De Provence Meat Roll
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 2 large spanish onions, finely dice | 1 large bunch scallion, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes
instructions: Combine everything except the vegetable roll mixture in a large bowl. Taste and adjust seasonings. Form into long rolls and lay flat in wax paper. Cut in half crosswise.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,shrimp,rye bread,tomato onion,bacon,nonstick cooking spray
title: Garlic Shrimp Toast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon fat ( optional ) | 2 small tomatoes, chopped | 1 teaspoon sage leaves, finely chopped | 3/4 lb shrimp, shelled, deveined and cleaned | 1 loaf rye bread | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Place bacon in 2 - 4 quart heavy pot and add onions. Saute over medium heat 3 minutes, stirring often. Stir in tomatoes and saute just until soft, about 3 minutes. Add shrimp and sage and cook until shrimp turn pink, about 3 minutes more. Serve hot or warm accompanied by bread.

title: Tahini Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini ( sesame paste and butter ) | 1 tablespoon hot taco sauce | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Using an electric mixer, combine all ingredients, adding a little water if necessary, until the texture is thick and smooth. Use over tacos, burritos or to top your favorite sandwich.

title: Spinach with Olives and Turmeric
ingredients: 10 1/2 ounces packages fresh spinach leaves | 3/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/4 cup kalamata olives, pitted
instructions: Trim the ends from the spinach with a vegetable peeler, then cut the leaves crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. In a non stick skillet, saute the turmeric and olives together over low heat, stirring often, for 2 minutes. Add the spinach and saute for an additional 2 minutes. Serve warm with warm pita bread or pita chips.

Random Ingredients: mint,red bell pepper,mexican cheese,cream cheese,wheat gluten,curly endive lettuce
title: Creamy Stuffed Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/8 - 1/4 cup shredded mexican cheese, blend | 3/4 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup chopped curly endive lettuce | 1/4 cup chopped red bell pepper, cut in chunks | 1 large red bell pepper, roasted ( or more if you like ) or 1 large yellow bell pepper, roasted ( or more if you like )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Mix all the ingredients together and spread in a thin layer on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the cheese is bubbly and everything is heated through. Let cool about 5 minutes before removing your individual peppers and serving.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,apple pie filling,chicken fillet,black bean,cannellini bean
title: Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 400 g chicken fillets | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 can black beans | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 200 g apple pie filling ( any flavour )
instructions: Cook chicken for 8 minutes on a bbq. When chicken is cooked, remove to warm plate and let rest for 5 minutes. To finish, drain the liquid from the cans of black beans and rinse the cannelini beans. In a microwaveable bowl combine beans, chicken, apple pie filling, cayenne, and water and bring to boil on high. Turn down the heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes, then serve.

title: Spinach With Apple Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh baby spinach | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: In a skillet, combine spinach and honey, and bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. When it simmers, stir in apple juice, heat just a bit, remove from heat. Gently divide between 2 serving plates, and serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,carrot,green cardamom pod,baby shrimp,beef chuck,rye bread
title: Beef Shank, 540cals Per Serve
ingredients: 750 g beef chuck | 2 tablespoons lemon extract | 1 cup carrot, julienned | 8 green cardamom pods | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 2 cups cooked baby shrimp
instructions: Cut the meat into small pieces. Combine the lemon extract with the carrot, cardamoms, lemon juice and pepper and mix well. Place the meat in a baking dish and pour over the marinade. Cover the meat and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and bake at 180c for 40 - 45 minutes or until the meat is tender. Serve with boiled potatoes, salads, bread.

title: Gluten Free Oatcakes
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups oatmeal, i use m & m organic plain | 10 tablespoons chinese wine ( optional )
instructions: Mix the oatm with the wine to make the gluten free batter. Bake in a non stick fry pan, turn when toasted.

title: Veal Tomatoes With Fresh Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 lb fresh veal, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 medium ripe tomatoes ( about 3/4 lb. total weight ) | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Warm cream and add veal cubes, stirring to coat evenly with cream. Sprinkle with vanilla and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Lime and Coconut Cheesecake (Paleo)
ingredients: 1 philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1/3 cup shredded coconut | 2 1/2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 3/4 cup chopped blanched almond | 1 tablespoon grated unsweetened limes or 1 tablespoon grated lemon rind
instructions: Beat cream cheese, coconut, lime juice, almonds and zest together in a bowl with electric mixer on low speed until fluffy. title: Dragon Roll Kangook (Korean Spinach)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach, cleaned | 1 tablespoon korean red pepper paste | 2 tablespoons blue curacao ( or other dark liquor )
instructions: Cut the whole fresh spinach in half. Remove and discard the tough leaves, the white part too. Wash the spinach well, if the leaves are long, you can use the leaves they are called in recipes. Place the leaves on a paper towel so the moisture gets damp enough for the steam to escape and you don't have to pat the leaves dry. Chop the black parts of the green part of the stems to match your green part. Place about 1 teaspoon of korean red pepper paste in your fist. Put 2 - 4 tablespoons of blue curacao or other dark liquor in a shaker, and shake to mix. Add a little water if the curacao is too thick. The korean version of chili rolls usually involves grinding the korean red chili pepper paste into korean red chili paste so make sure to get a good grinding consistency, or else the korean chili paste will be too liquid. Remove the leaves from their stems, wash a lot of clean leaves and place them in a salad bowl. Dice the remaining green part of the stems. Place 1 teaspoon of korean red chili paste in your fist. Rub the korean red chili paste over the greens. Place 1 teaspoon of korean red chili paste in your hand. Rub the korean red chili paste onto your spinach until you get a nice consistency and don't worry if the leaves break. This is the fun part. You can take about 1 teaspoon of the green part of the stems and set it aside, or put it as well. Cover the bowl with the greens and the rest of the green part to serve. This recipe is for about the same quantity of spinach. It is difficult to talk about quantity, because the green part is used for making a dish as it is quite unpleasant to eat. However, you will know that the greens are cooked once it is cool enough. Cut spinach as finely as possible. It takes about 2 1/2 cups. You can make several variations with this procedure, you can use a mixture of spinach, carrots, zucchini, or even just kale. For each flavor, make your own korean red pepper paste. For korean korean red pepper paste, use korean red pepper paste. For korean red pepper paste, use korean red pepper paste or any other dark chili paste you can find.

title: Almond Tomatoes (Tomato) Rolls With Plums in Almonds
ingredients: 550 g plum tomatoes ( very ripe ) | 3/8 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 teaspoons almond essence
instructions: Dough, put a large saucepan with a well fitting lid over a medium heat, put some baking paper on the top.. Tip the tomatoes into the pan, making sure they are all in the same spot. Sprinkle the yeast over and add a couple of tbsp of the plain water. Give the tomatoes a good mix and then, using a teaspoon, scrape the tomato mixture down into the pan, leaving about 1/2 cm of thick space along the edges. Add plenty of plenty of water to cover. Bring the mixture to the boil, then turn down the heat, and leave for about 45 minutes, or until the mixture has risen and a thick pulp has formed. Meanwhile, put the rest of the baking paper into a tea towel with a good pinch of salt. Take a piece of the baking paper, cut it in 2 cm squares and rub it thoroughly onto one side of the squares. Scatter them with a little dried almond essence and put about 1 teaspoonful of the mixture in the middle. Take another piece of the baking paper, flatten the mixture and put it on top, pressing down to flatten the edge of the paper. Put into a plastic bag and leave to stand for 15 minutes. Then put the tray on another flat surface and push down on the top and side so that the paper covers the bottom of the loaf. Lightly drizzle a little sunflower oil on the top and cook these rolls in batches on top of eachother for about 10 minutes, or until slightly charred. Turn over to cook the other side for 3 - 4 minutes. The top should be browned and crisp but the tomatoes should look quite dry. instructions: Wash the rice and soak for one hour in water. After the soaked rice is completely soft, remove from the water and place in a bowl.
