instructions: In a saucepan, bring water to a boil. Add quinoa.

title: Radicchio (Italian Tomato and Smoked Hazelnut Oil Combo Meal)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons tomato paste | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon ground roasted peanuts if using hazelnuts | 2 bunches radicchio, leaves trimmed, washed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces
instructions: Combine tomato paste, flour and ground hazelnuts in a medium bowl. Sprinkle radicchio with salt and toss it through the flour. Spray pan with nonstick spray and heat over moderate heat until hot but not smoking. Pour 1/4 cup tomato mixture into the pan and spread to cover half the pan. Cook until it bubbles and begins to brown, turning the tray over midway through cooking. Turn it over, cover, and cook until the radicchio has wilted, about 40 seconds more. Transfer to plate and let cool to room temperature. Repeat with remaining tomato mixture. When the radicchio has rested, spoon any excess radicchio juices into a small bowl and lightly mash with a fork. Return liquid to pan. Add remaining 1/4 cup tomato mixture and heat to boiling, then reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes to blend flavors. Ladle hot tomato and radicchio mixture back into a serving dish and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: asadero cheese,italian parsley,beef bouillon cube,rhubarb,double cream whipping,lasagna noodle,mussel
title: Brontë (Steamed Meat With Rhubarb) Mushroom Ramekins
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna noodle | 14 lbs shucked, fresh mussels, quartered, washed and debearded | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 10 cups double cream or 10 cups whipping cream | 1/2 cup italian parsley, chopped | 2 lbs rindless fresh asadero cheese or 2 lbs grated montasio cheese | fresh italian parsley ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large large pot with water, add salt and bring to a boil. Add lasagna noodles and cook for 3 minutes, drain and run under cold water to stop the cooking process. Set aside in a bowl and set aside. In the same pot, add the shucked mussels, bouillon concentrate and cream and bring to a boil, boil for 3 minutes. Add the chopped parsley and bring to a boil, boil for one additional minute and remove from heat. Set aside. Place 1/2 cup of grated cheese, the asadero slices and parsley in a large mixing bowl and mash with a wooden spoon or fork. Cover it with a clean cloth and set aside. Place 2 1/2 cups of ice water in a large bowl and beat hard to break up lumps. With a dessertspoon or a slotted spoon, scoop out some of the ice water. Dunk the ramekins into the water, one at a time, and bring to a gentle boil to cook. Remove ramekins and discard the water. Place in a colander or strainer and let sit for one hour under cold water to stop the cooking process. To serve, remove the cheese on a platter. Arrange the ramekins around the cheese and place in a warmed soup plates or large deep skillet. Ladle in the soup and top with a few sprigs of fresh italian parsley if desired. Cheese can be garnished with fresh rinds of asadero slices and extra grated cheese. Note, when in this recipe, you might garnish the stuffed ramekin with garlic or grated cheddar cheese.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,grain rice,cilantro leaf,red pepper flake
title: Yummy Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice ( i usually use jasmine or jasmine white, but any rice will do ) | 1 3/4 cups whipping cream | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves ( i sometimes substitute parsley instead ) | 1 -1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Bring rice, cream, and chili flakes to a boil. Cover and let simmer for 20 to 30 minutes or until water is almost absorbed, stirring once or twice. Add cilantro and let sit another five minutes until cilantro is soft. Serve.

title: Lennie's Swedish Creamy Swedish Spiced Roasted Cardamom Roast Chicken
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs whole chickens | 4 -5 cups cream of chicken soup | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350' and lay rack in lower part. Place whole chickens on rack, and sprinkle with cardamom pods. Cover, and place in baking dish roast 30 to 40 minutes, basting occasionally. Turn the oven off and leave the chickens in the oven. Bake in upper and lower thirds of the oven for 15 minutes. Remove the chicken and tent loosely with foil. Poke the thickest part of the thigh with a fork. Pull the legs and thighs of the chicken apart, pull them apart, and place them into a large bowl. Add the cream of chicken soup to the bowl the chicken was cooked in, and mix well. Heat oven to 325' and remove the cover from the bowl. Sprinkle the top with cardamom pods just. Place the chickens back into the bowl. Bake for 40 - 45 minutes, basting occasionally.

title: Italian Almond Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package provolone cheese or 1 package mozzarella cheese | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract ( the kind i use almond milk )
instructions: Spread on your favorite crackers or fresh bread. If your cheese is not very soft yet, just use a fork to break it up into small bits. Sprinkle with almond extract. Enjoy.

title: Grilled French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf white bread, cut 1 inch thick | mint sprig
instructions: Soak 12 wooden skewers in water until ready to use. Line a shallow pan or grill basket with two or three pieces of foil. Preheat grill for medium heat. Brush bread with a thin layer of olive oil and set on a rack. Grill bread until puffed and lightly toasted, about 2 minutes per side. Watch carefully and broil, turning once, until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer bread, topped with a couple of mint sprigs, to a serving plate and serve immediately.

title: Pasta With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup light molasses | 1/2 tablespoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 lb linguine pasta
instructions: Preheat your oven to mix all ingredients except pasta. When i put my water on to boil for the pasta, i use a cast iron pan.

title: Cream Creme Brulee
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup double cream
instructions: Position a rack in the center of the oven and heat to 425 degrees f. Place a 10 inch saucer in the oven to allow the oven to heat properly. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Wisk together the whipping cream and flour in a bowl, then fold 1/4 cup hot cream into the mixture one at a time. Then fold the cream mixture into the flour and cream mixture until the batter is smooth. Spoon half of the batter into six ramekins or custard cups, then place in the oven and heat until the center is set, about 8 to 12 minutes. Remove the ramekins from the oven and allow them to finish cooling on a wire rack. After 10 minutes, cover the ramekins with a clean towel and refrigerate until chilled, about 3 hours. Do not fill the ramekins more than halfway up, as the cream mixture may separate. To serve, remove the ramekins from the oven and spoon 1 to3 tablespoons of cream onto each of the warm ramekins to cover. In a bowl, stir together the remaining cream and the remaining whipped cream. Serves, though the cream cream can be thinned with water or milk, according to the cream mixture's volume. If using vanilla, combine 1 teaspoon of vanilla into the cream before adding the cream.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,swiss chard,raspberry,spinach,green bell pepper,leek,brown rice
title: Spinach and Chard Florentine
ingredients: 2 lbs spinach, washed and chopped | 3 green bell peppers, quartered and seeded | 1 chorizo sausage, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 leek, white part only thinly sliced | 1/2 lb swiss chard, outer layer coarsely chopped ( or other leafy green ) | 1 -3 tablespoon brown rice ( optional ) | fresh raspberries or other fruit, such as sliced apple
instructions: Place the spinach in a large saucepan and add cold water to just cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, cover, and cook 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and squeeze excess moisture. Meanwhile, heat a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat. Add the chorizo and cook until it begins to brown, about 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels and transfer to a bowl. Add the spinach and cooked peppers to the skillet. Stir in the leek and salt to taste. Sprinkle the rice on top and reduce heat to low. Cook, stirring often until the rice is golden and the spinach is piping hot, about 5 minutes longer. Remove from the heat and transfer the spinach mixture to a warm serving bowl. Sprinkle with the raspberries or other fruit and serve warm.

title: Tortilla Triangles With Chili Dipping Sauce (South Beach Diet Version)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chili | 3/4 cup cake, pieces | 1 1 sheet phyllo dough, defrosted | pam cooking spray | jalapeno, slices for filling
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Mix chili with cake pieces and dip pieces one by one, letting each piece soak with the chili juice. Place a sheet of pastry, overlapping it lightly to cover the whole pan. Spray pastry with pam and sprinkle with jalepeno slices, pressing in the slices of jalepeno as you go. Spread one/half cup of chili mixture over the layered tortilla. Fold in half and repeat until all are used, top with remaining puff pastry, chilli and jalepeno slices. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil and bake until pastry is golden.

title: Anise and Raspberry Pizza
ingredients: 1 package frozen raspberries | 2 rashes anise seeds | 1 container frozen cheese | 2 cups frozen topping, thawed | oil | 1/2 - 3/4 cup thawed lemonade
instructions: Prepare the frozen raspberries and place in a food processor. Process until smooth. Put raspberries in a bowl. Add aniseeds, cheese, frozen topping and oil. Mix well. Spread the mixture over the pizza crust. Sprinkle generously with lemonade. Bake in preheated oven at 450 degrees about 10 - 15 minutes or until puffed and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: broad egg noodle,maraschino cherry,chicken breast,turmeric powder,cinnamon,baby corn,red chilies,apple juice
title: Mixed Noodle Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken breasts ( chopped ) | 2 red chilies | 100 g broad egg noodles ( soaked in hot water ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 150 ml apple juice | 250 g baby corn ( sliced ) | 75 g maraschino cherries
instructions: Sprinkle salt on one side of chicken and put on a tray on a stove. Heat the rest of the ingredients except for the cherries. When the chicken starts brown, add the cherry to it. After two minutes, cover and cook on a low heat. After 10 minutes, turn all the chicken and cover them again for 15 minutes. Remove from stove. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,coriander sprig,red wine vinegar,head lettuce,pork,watermelon,red potato,tofu
title: Chinese Pork and Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces firm tofu | 1 1/4 lbs top quality pork, thinly sliced ( or cut in thin strips ) | 2 large red potatoes, cut in thin wedges | 2 cups cooked red potatoes, cubed | 1 red onion, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup coriander sprig | 3/4 cup chili-garlic sauce | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 - 2 cups watermelon or 1 1/2-2 cups melon, diced
instructions: Cut tofu into thin blocks and arrange on a serving platter. Cover with another plate and set aside. Cut potatoes to desired size. Slice onion and toss lightly with coriander. In large bowl, toss pork with 1/2 cup watermelon. Top with potatoes. Add remaining ingredients and toss lightly. Serve in lettuce leafs.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,pistachio nut,oat,purpose flour,squid,salt black pepper,turnip,steak
title: Grilled Stuffed Squids
ingredients: 1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 3 medium turnips, peeled and cut on the diagonal into 1/8 inch-thick wedges ( about 1-1/2 lb. ) | 1 large squid, cleaned and cut into 1/2-inch rings ( about 1 1/2 lb. ) | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 3/4 teaspoon salt ( plus more salt and pepper to taste ) | 3/4 teaspoon olive oil | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pistachio nuts or 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped walnut pieces | salt and black pepper
instructions: For the vegetables, heat the olive oil over medium high heat in a large stainless steel or enamel pot. Add the turnips, squid and cover. Cook, turning the squid occasionally with a fork, until browned, about 6 minutes. Uncover and cook until no blood leaks from the squid or the squid is just tender when pierced with a fork, about 5 minutes. Transfer the turnips, squid and squid to a bowl. For the pistachios walnut meal, combine the flour, salt, pepper in a medium bowl. Add the olive oil in a thin, steady stream, stirring well with a fork, then stir in the nuts. Add 1 t. Of the pistachio meal to the pistachios walnut meal, stirring just until the nuts are moistened. Stuff the squash mixture with the pistachio nut mixture that has been moistened by the olive oil and nuts.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,black eyed pea,topping,green chilies,peppercorn,flat leaf parsley
title: Cassic Chilli and Black-Eyed Pea Scones
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour, sifted | 1/4 cup cracked black-eyed peas, drained | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1/2 cup green chilies, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn, crushed | 1/2 cup low & fat jersey franks or 1/2 cup gravy mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Grease & line a 2l baking pan with baking paper. Place flour, peas, parsley, chillies, peppercorns & jhang in a large bowl. Stir quickly to combine, using a metal spoon to make a loose batter. Spoon mixture into prepared baking pan, smooth the top, sprinkle top of scones with extra finely ground black cracked black pepper.

title: Swiss Sesame Seed Brownies
ingredients: 2 cups unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 cups sultanas
instructions: Melt cocoa powder in hot but not boiling water. Add sultanas and stir until just combined.

title: Zesty and Healthy Seafood Pasta
ingredients: 6 -7 ounces pasta, any flavor your preference | 1/4 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 8 ounces sea scallops | 2 cups cooked quinoa
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook until tender but firm, about 8 minutes. Add the limeade concentrate. When cooked, drain pasta and combine with limeade and salt. Taste for seasoning, add more limeade and lime to taste, and serve over cooked quinoa. This recipe makes 1/2 batch to feed three people.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,portabella mushroom,potato,chinese chive,chicken bouillon granule
title: Spinach, Potato and Chinese Chives Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces portabella mushrooms, sliced | 2 medium potatoes, chopped | 3 tablespoons chinese chives, chopped | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 8 cups fresh spinach leaves ( can use canned spinach if you like )
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine mushrooms, potatoes, chives and chicken boulion and bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: margarine,pistachio,garlic granule,thyme leave,sherry wine vinegar,oregano leaf,tahini
title: Pistachios in Tahini
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups tahini | 1/2 cup unsalted margarine | 2 teaspoons fresh garlic granules or 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 2 teaspoons fresh oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme leave | 2 teaspoons sherry wine vinegar | pistachios or walnuts
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the tahini, margarine, garlic, oregano, thyme and sherry vinegar. Add a pinch each of salt and pepper, if desired. Transfer to glass serving bowl or serving dish and garnish with peanuts or walnuts.

title: Margarita Salad
ingredients: 9 ounces spinach, washed and chopped | 4 bell peppers, chopped | 2 cans yellow corn, drained | 1/2 cup diced canned yellow corn | 2 tablespoons fresh marjoram or 2 teaspoons dried marjoram leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon or 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 cup egg white | 1/4 cup tequila ( optional ) or 1/4 cup brandy ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl& chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,loaf french bread,pinto bean,baguette,salt black pepper
title: Frijoles Charros (Feijoada and Beans)
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds dried farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 9 slices baguette, cut in half lengthwise, lengthwise | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 pinch crushed bread crumbs ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the bow tie pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Agnello
ingredients: 6 1/2 - 7 cups arborio rice | 1/4 cup margarine ( i use butter ) | filling
instructions: Boil salted water. Drain liquid out of arborio. Add margarine and cook. Cut dough into pieces and deep fry in 350f degrees oil for 3 - 6 minutes. Drain and top with your favorite filling. You can also use a favorite cheese sauce.

title: Linguine & Chocolate Linguine
ingredients: 1/2 - 2/3 cup chocolate syrup | pastry for a double-crust 9-inch double crust pie or | 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup | 1/2 - 3/4 cup finely chopped chocolate-covered linguine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Melt chocolate syrup and butter. Prepare pastry, unfold pastry on top of wax paper and cut circles, one third at a time. Place in 10 pie pan that has been coated with cooking spray, line the bottom of pan with pastry, brushing with any melted butter or margarine. Spoon chocolate syrup mixture over pastry and sprinkle with 1/4 chocolate covered linguine, dot with remaining melted butter. Cover with pastry lid. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes. Let cool for about 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,broccoli floret,asiago cheese,green chilies,rice wine vinegar,pinto bean
title: Asiago, Broccoli, and Beans Salad
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/3 cup shredded asiago cheese | 1 1/2 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1/3 cup basil leaves, torn
instructions: In a medium saucepan, stir together beans, chilies, and rice vinegar. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,mango,champagne,angel food cake,cabbage chickpea,confectioner ' sugar,lemon
title: Charcoal Cupcakes or Loews With Mango & Cabbage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 can reduced carbonated beverage, chilled ( sprite ) | 1 cup mango, finely diced | 1/2 cup cooked cabbage ( from 2 cups cooked chickpeas, shredded ) | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons champagne, chilled | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1/2 cup angel food cake, cut into 12 thin slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In small saucepan over medium heat, bring cider vinegar to boil. Remove from heat. Stir in mango. Place sweet potato in small baking dish.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,tilapia fillet,breadcrumb,white wine vinegar,mint leaf,spaghettini,wine,ha avocadoes
title: Tilapia and Prosciutto Wrapped Tilapia in Wine Jelly With Avocado
ingredients: 9 ounces white wine vinegar | 3 ounces hoisin sauce or 3 ounces plum sauce | 1 ounce fresh breadcrumb | 4 tilapia fillets | 1/2 ounce prosciutto, chopped | 2 ounces mint leaves | 3 avocadoes, peeled and sliced thinly | 3 ounces dry white wine
instructions: In a glass bowl, stir the vinegar, hoisin sauce, bread crumbs, prosciutto, mint and avocados together. Arrange the fillets in a baking dish. Spoon the dipping sauce over the fillets and bake at 400f for about 15 - 20 minutes or until the fish flakes easily.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,snow pea,tortilla,spaghetti sauce,red wine,lasagna noodle,turnip,beef broth
title: Slow Cooker Seafood Lasagna
ingredients: 2 cups yellow squash, halved and sliced | 2 cups turnips, quartered and sliced | 1 cup anchovy fillet or 1/4 cup finely chopped anchovy | 1 can spaghetti sauce | 1 1/2 - 2 cups beef broth | 1 cup dry red wine | 3/4 cup uncooked dry lasagna noodle | 0.5 package frozen snow peas ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine squash, turnips, anchovy, spaghetti sauce and half of the beef broth.

title: Ziti With Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces ziti pasta | 2 small eggs noodles ( small ) | ice water | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil
instructions: Start by cooking the ziti according to the directions on the package. Meanwhile, boil three salted water and two tablespoons of oil in a large pot for at least ten minutes. When the noodles are softened, drain them and place on a plate covered in cold water, set aside. In a large bowl, beat the eggs in the ice water. Drain the pasta, and add the eggs and drained ziti and toss gently with a fork. Serve at once.

title: Banana Chutney
ingredients: 2 large bananas, sliced | 1 yellow onion, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/2 cup mango chutney, pureed
instructions: In a non stick frying pan, cook onions until slightly browned. Add banana, cook until almost done. Stir in cinnamon, nutmeg, and chutney.

title: Chickpea Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons chickpea flour ( also known as chickpea flour in asian markets ) | 5 tablespoons vegetable shortening or 5 tablespoons other shortening, chilled | 2 tablespoons canola shortening
instructions: Combine flour, 1 1/2 teaspoons chickpea flour and 2 tablespoons shortening in a bowl. Rub in remaining flour until dough forms. Turn dough onto floured surface. Knead gently just until dough leaves sides of bowl. Pat or roll into a thick circle. Cover with a damp cloth and let rest 5 minutes. Wrap and chill 1 - ½ hours or until dough's firm.. Preheat grill. Place one tortilla on grid and press lightly with hands to form crust. Flake with fork and cook until lightly browned, about 10 seconds.

title: Garlic and Prawn Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 large garlic cloves | 1/3 cup reduced-fat mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 2 packages fresh spinach, rinsed well, spun dry, large stems removed | 3/4 cup plain bread crumbs | 1 kg prawns, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Coat large baking tray with cooking spray. Cut 1/2 inch deep slit down centre of each garlic clove.

title: Spinach and Beetroot
ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats | 12 ounces shredded beetroots or 12 ounces baby beetroot | 2 tablespoons dried adobo seasoning | 6 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Cook oats in a pan at medium heat, stirring regularly until golden.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola,splenda sugar substitute,ice water,head broccoli,onion salt,bread,purpose flour,shrimp paste
title: Garithes Yiouvets
ingredients: 1 small head of broccoli, broken into florets | 1/3 cup chopped dried bread | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 1 pinch onion salt | 1/4 teaspoon shrimp paste | 1/4 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 tablespoon ice water ( about ) | 1/2 teaspoon glutenadine sugar substitute ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons crumbled gorgonzola
instructions: Boil the broccoli in salted water until just tender, stirring occasionally. Drain well. Stir in the bread, flour, onion salt, shrimp paste, splenda sugar blend and ice water. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes. Sprinkle with the gorgonzola and toss lightly to blend. Serve immediately.

title: Berry Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups fresh blueberries | 1/3 cup marinara sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Place blueberries in a saucepan and pour over enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and boil for 2 minutes. Drain, place in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: sourdough bread,margarine,amarula cream liqueur,pork loin,green pea,swiss cheese,chocolate cooky
title: Lazy Manhattan Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 loaves sourdough bread, crust trimmed | 1 tablespoon margarine | 3/4 cup sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 pound boneless pork loin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup frozen green peas | 1/4 cup amarula cream liqueur | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place sourdough loaf on a foil lined cookie sheet. Bake the loaves in the preheated oven until the centers open, 1 to 1 1/4 hours. Set aside to cool completely. Remove slices and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain, approximately 15 minutes. Cut each slice into four squares.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,pork baby back rib,crescent dough
title: Chinese Ribs
ingredients: 1 can crescent roll dough | 2 tablespoons almond extract | 2 pounds pork baby back ribs
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Separate crescent roll dough into 12 equal pieces. Roll each section into an 8 round. Place ribs on dough and spread 1 teaspoon almond extract onto each piece of meat. Moisten the ends of each roll with water. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 45 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Swiss Party Appetizers
ingredients: 24 inches swiss cheese, grated | 24 frozen dumplings wrappers ( approx. 4-inch squares ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: If using fresh swiss cheese and making certain that you use the premade cheese, heat over medium low heat until it begins to bubble and melts. Turn down heat just a little and keep stirring until all the liquid dries up. Add gruyere cheese and stir until cheese begins to melt. Drop a large scoop of dumpling wrappers into the mixture and carefully roll them around the dumplings. Place each one into a small paper thin bowl or large ziploc baggie and allow to dry at least 3 hours. Store in the refrigerator. When serving, pour vodka over the cheese until it tastes great. It would just be a bonus for a week with lots of flavor.

title: Easy Crock Pot Easy Microwave Rice
ingredients: 1 box long grain rice, long-grain, long grain, regular rice cooker okay | 2 cans cream of chicken soup, any flavor
instructions: In bowl, place all ingredients and mix well. Pour into crock pot with lid on low or high. Let cook for 4 hours. Cook on high for 5 hours, turn crock pot off and let stand for 30 minutes to let rice absorb flavors more and dry out.

title: Gramfloury Tuna & Clam Dip
ingredients: 12 slices fresh oyster mushrooms | 12 slices canned tuna, rinsed & drained | 12 slices canned littleneck clams | 1 chopped serrano chili ( seeds removed if desired ) | 2 tablespoons liquid gravy browner
instructions: Combine ingredients well.

title: Zucchini Chips (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 lb zucchini, halved lengthwise | 1/4 cup brandy | 2 tablespoons freshly grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 8 slices french bread
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange the zucchinis on a foil lined baking sheet or broiler pan and broil 3 to 4 minutes, turning once, until slightly charred and starting to brown. Place the zucchini in a small bowl and cover with 1/4 cup brandy. Let stand 10 minutes. While the zucchini cool, whisk together 2 tablespoons cream and the next 3 ingredients. Spread a thin layer of brandy on each slice of bread. Top with zucchini chips and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup grated cheese. Broil bread 3 to 4 inches from the heat until cheese is melted and beginning to bubble, 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,pepper sauce,red pepper,dark rum,rice vinegar
title: Easy Vietnamese Dressing
ingredients: 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 1/2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 can crushed tomatoes, drained | 1 bunch sun-dried tomato, julienned ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender container and process until smooth. Chill several hours or overnight before serving.

title: Tropical Dessert
ingredients: 1 cup celery, diced | 4 ounces unsweetened coconut cream
instructions: Put celery in a small bowl. Stir in coconut cream to cover. Chill before serving.

title: Stuffed Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 large raw cauliflower | 1/2 lb ground chuck | 3 ounces chinese mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 1 ounce madeira wine | 1/4 ounce brandy | 1/2 envelope dry yeast
instructions: Remove the core from the cauliflower and boil the water until it falls off the head. Remove outer leaves and discard. Cut a cone shape in the base of the cauliflower and take out the base of the florets. Steam them until they're as tender as you can get them, remove any remaining heads and place them in the large bowl. When the cauliflower is a little mushy, boil them in the milk water for 2 minutes. Add the beef, mushrooms, madeira, brandy and yeast and mix well. Pour the sauce over the cauliflower and serve.

title: Yakitori (Japanese Dipping Sauce for Beefsteak)
ingredients: 2 cups dried unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1/3 cup mirin
instructions: In a small saucepan, place peanuts, and enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook 3 to 5 minutes, or until crisp, then drain and set aside. Meanwhile, heat the mirin in a small saucepan until it reaches 220 degrees f on a candy thermometer. Stir in peanuts, and cook 1 minute, or until peanuts are golden. Spread over hot beefsteak, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,red onion,walnut,barbeque sauce,thyme,demerara sugar,italian salad dressing mix,basil
title: Barbeque Sauce With Walnuts
ingredients: 8 ounces store-bought demerara sugar salad dressing mix ( or make your own in advance ) | 2 tablespoons barbeque sauce | 1/4 teaspoon thyme or 1/4 teaspoon rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon basil | 1 teaspoon curry leaves | 1/2 cup walnut pieces or 1/2 cup slivered almonds | 1/4 cup chopped red onion | 1/2 cup chopped dried italian salad dressing mix
instructions: Prepare the barbeque sauce according to the package directions and set aside. Combine the first 8 ingredients in a small pan. Simmer 1 - 2 minutes over low heat, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir in nuts, onion and dressing mix, reserving a few walnuts for garnish. Serve in martini glasses or over brown rice.

title: Aussie Beef Skewers With Raw Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks | 3/4 cup miso | 3 tablespoons reduced-fat peanut butter or 3 tablespoons coconut cream lite | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Place the sirloin steaks between 2 sheets of greaseproof paper and pound each one to about 4 in. Thickness. Dry on a cutting board approximately 30 minutes before cooking. Mix all of the remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Mix well until all the ingredients are incorporated. Set aside 2/3 of the sauce. Use a sharp knife to cut the steaks at least 3/4 wide. Thread three 8 oz. Threads of the sirloin each onto a metal skewer, alternating with some of the remaining tender steak. Grill or broil the skewers of steaks until cooked through. Serve with remaining sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,fennel seed,kernel corn,tomato ketchup,white wine,pork sausage,green chili pepper
title: Goul-Au-Feu
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1/2 lb pork loin chop, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb smoked pork sausage, sliced diagonally into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can stewed tomatoes with ketchup | 1 green chili pepper, sliced | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup
instructions: Put a wok over medium heat. Add the fennel seeds, and toast them, stirring often, until they begin to sizzle, about 1 minute. Quickly stir in the pork and sausage slices. Stir fry them until all the pork is cooked. Add the tomatoes with their juices, chile, wine and ketchup.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,cocoa powder,cantaloupe,wheat flour,extra virgin olive oil,vanilla
title: Barefoot Contessa's Cuban Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 5 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 cup cantaloupe ( ripe mango, ripe or sweet )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f mix first four ingredients together. Place tenderloin on aluminum foil lined baking pan and bake 45 - 50 minutes per pound. While cooking, baste tenderloin lightly with oil and sprinkle surface with cinnamon flakes. Enjoy.

title: Dee's Lentil Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups dry lentils ( can use a combination of lentils, romano, lentils, etc. ) | 1 cup mixed dried fruit
instructions: Preheat oven to 325/160f. Put lentils, mixed dried fruit and salt and pepper in the slow cooker. Pour the olive oil or basting spray over the top. Cover and cook for 5 hours on low or 7 to 8 hours on high.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,tamarind soup mix,panko breadcrumb,grain white rice,mayonnaise,broth,ginger garlic paste,lamb
title: Korean Lamb & Rice Ramen
ingredients: 2 lbs lean lamb ( boneless or lamb tenderloin ) | 3 tablespoons tamarind soup mix ( mccormick sweet soy dipping sauce mix ) | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 1/2 cups broth | 2 cups instant long-grain white rice ( nishiki ) | 1 -2 chipotle chile
instructions: Cut the lamb into 1/2 inches cubes. Set aside. Mix tamarind soup mix, ginger garlic paste, mayonnaise, panko with broth. Place the meat cubes into the mixture and marinate in the refrigerator. Bring the broth to a simmer then add the rice and chiles. Simmer for 45 - 50 minutes, until rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,salt black pepper,lobster tail,dough,porcini mushroom,orange
title: French Baked Lobster Tails With Cracked Pepper & Orange
ingredients: 2 lobster tails, shelled | 100 g dried porcini mushrooms ( soaked in warm water ) | 2 large oranges, cut into thin julienne strips | orange zest, strip of zest ( for zing or serving ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice, from the oranges | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
instructions: Heat oven to 200 c/ 400 f/ gas grease 4 large ovenproof dishes, or use two 8 inch diameter ramekin dishes/dutch oven dishes with removable base. Toss lobster tails and mushrooms in salt & pepper and arrange in the dishes & then toss in orange zest, zest strips, orange juice, and the melted butter and season generously. Bake in the centre of the pre heated oven for 45 - 50 minutes, until the lobster tails are just cooked through. Serve lobster tail mixture warm or cold, with freshly ground black pepper.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,white pearl onion,vegetable shortening,plum,garlic,saffron,beef broth,ice water
title: Emposto Tuscany
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 teaspoon garlic | 1 tablespoon butter ( optional, do not use margarine ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening ( optional, but good quality would be ) | 1 tablespoon ice water | 2/3 cup low sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 8 large white pearl onions, peeled | 8 plums, halved, pitted, coarsely chopped ( optional, i don't add these )
instructions: Combine saffron and garlic in a small bowl and place in freezer to infuse, 15 - 20 minutes. Toast saffron mixture over medium high heat until fragrant, 1 - 2 minutes. Stir saffron into butter and shortening until melted, about 10 seconds. Stir in ice water and beef broth and bring to the boil. Stir in mayonnaise. Add drained pearl onions and plums, 2 - 3 to 3 minutes. Pour into bowl and cool well. Store in a tightly-seal plastic container in refrigerator up to 2 weeks up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,poblano pepper,onion soup mix,caster sugar,rice flour
title: Poblano Pepper & Onion Bread
ingredients: 16 poblano peppers | 4 tablespoons rice flour | 4 teaspoons dehydrated onion soup mix | 1 pinch caster sugar | 1 tablespoon italian dressing or 1 tablespoon soy dressing
instructions: Pre heat your oven on the lowest setting. Roast the poblano peppers on the cookie sheet for about 15 - 17 minutes. When the skin has loosened, remove them from the oven and peel off the skins. In a food processor/blender purée the poblano peppers and liquid until smooth. Mix well the poblano pepper purée and rice flour. Add the soup mix, sugar and dressing. Mix well and pour into an oven proof dish. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until the crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: parsley stem,chicken meat,fennel bulb,dark brown sugar,veal,rice vinegar
title: Pate' With Charred Veal from Rieska
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, pounded thin, then cut into small cubes | 5 fennel bulbs, crushed | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken meat, washed and cubed | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley stems
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the veal, fennel, chicken and brown sugar. Mix together the vinegar, brown sugar and parsley, pour over the beef mixture. Mix well.

title: Spicy Chilies on Fiddle Skewers (Prawns and Quark) - Fritters
ingredients: 12 medium quark | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting | 1 -2 fresh red chilies, seeded and finely chopped ( deseeded or a little less to taste )
instructions: Make sure the quark is lukewarm. Place the flour in a mixing bowl with a little salt and chillies. Dredge the shrimp in the seasoned flour. Lightly oil the frying pan, then pour in the quark. Cook the fritters, using a pair of wooden skewers until they turn pink and slightly firm on the outside but moist on the inside. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel to drain. Serve with a dipping sauce of your choice.

title: Broccoli Causa
ingredients: 3 lbs broccoli, chopped into bite-size florets | 2 cans sliced black olives | 1/2 - 1 1/2-1 teaspoon adobo seasoning ( or to taste ) | 2/3 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil, add the broccoli, and blanch until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Add olives and adobo to the cooked broccoli. Toss to combine. Serve on a platter, and top with grated parmesan cheese.

title: Lazy-Day Cheesecake
ingredients: 250 g frozen mixed vegetables | 2 cups cooked dates, chopped and drained | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 celsius or 140°c if using large tin. Line base of ovenproof cake tin with greaseproof paper. Sprinkle crackers over, then place frozen mixed vegetables and dates inches in between sheets of baking paper and bake for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Use electric mixer to beat the mixture for a few minutes to get a smooth but lump free texture. Return to oven and cook for a further 5 - 10 minutes or until mixture starts to thicken. Remove from oven and leave in to a wire rack to cool. This also makes a nice cold crust the next day. To serve, cut into wedges and serve with a dollop of cream or ice cream.

title: Crabmeat Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 box crabmeat, flaked | 1 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 package spaghetti | 1 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Prepare the crabmeat by stirring the crab with a fork in a bowl. Stir in the preserves, peppercorns, and anise. Cook the spaghetti until it is al dente, drain, and toss with the crab mixture.

Random Ingredients: au jus mix,italian parsley,purple onion,milk chocolate,raspberry vinegar,whiskey,cranberry
title: Raspberry and Whiskey Triple Sec Sauce
ingredients: 1 package au jus mix | 2/3 cup raisins soaked in milk chocolate ( like ghirardelli's chocolate chips ) | 1/4 cup whiskey | 1 jar blueberries | 1/3 cup chopped purple onion | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley | 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar
instructions: Combine au jus mix, raisins, whiskey, blueberries, onions, parsley, and vinegar in a large bowl, and refrigerate 1 hour, or until chilled. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Salad for Two
ingredients: 1/3 lb linguine | 4 -5 tablespoons wine vinegar ( a good-quality white ) | 1 tablespoon nam pla ( thai fish sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups chopped romaine lettuce | 1/3 cup chopped fresh chinese parsley
instructions: In a large saucepan bring 1 1/2 quarts of water to a rolling boil. Add linguine and 2 tablespoons of the vinegar. Cook for a few minutes, drain and rinse under cold water. Pat linguine dry with paper towels. In a small bowl whisk remaining dressing ingredients together and set aside. To serve, mound dressing onto lettuce leaves and mound into a glass dish. Arrange chinese parsley overtop of dressing and serve.

title: Ice Cream-Mushrooms With Cremini Mushrooms &icing Sugar
ingredients: 50 g cremini mushrooms, cleaned, stalks removed | 200 g icing sugar | 1/4 - 1/3 cup icing sugar, icing ( or confectioner's sugar )
instructions: Cut a cross on the base of the cremini mushrooms leaving a 1 ‘2 ‘in length on one side. Do this to the other side of the mushrooms. Place the sugar in a shallow dish or bowl. Carefully insert the slices of mushrooms into the sugar. Dip the mushrooms in the icing sugar, ensuring you do this, then set them on wax paper. Put the icing sugar in a plastic bag and gently shake around your rolling pin until the icing is absorbed. Cut the mushrooms in half diagonally, then cut the halves in half again diagonally so that you have 4 rectangles. Place the cut mushrooms onto plates and decorate with the cut side of the mushroom.

title: Baileys Bombs (Irish Eggroll)
ingredients: 1 package phyllo dough, thawed | 1 cup irish cream
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350degrees f. Take a piece of phyllo dough and cut into a ball with a glass or a biscucer. This takes a while to get the hang of it. Using a rolling pin roll the dough out to get an appropriate size that you want to keep the size to be able to roll out. If it goes right, the dough is too dry. If this happens, throw in a drop or two of bailey's worth of bailey's at a time. Rolling your dough out thin will produce a faster and easier rolling. With a cookie cutter take out a 6 x 10 rectangle of phyllo dough. Place 2 tablespoons bailey's worth of dough onto the sheet of phyllo dough. With your thumb, make a small indentation in the middle. Push the bailey's through the center of the phyllo dough. This will make your little bailey's sticky little balls. Place in the oven on cookie sheet while your work is heating up. When the time is up, spread half of your bailey's across the dough. Carefully place another sheet of phyllo down to the top, making 4 layers. When the time is up, spread another 1/3 of your bailey's across the dough. The dough should make 1 dozen little balls. After 4 hours of baking, take the sheet out of the oven and brush the bottom layer of phyllo with a little glaze. Repeat. With a sharp knife, cut the bailey's crosswise into 3 or 4 strips with kitchen shears. Repeat process until all the dough has been used. After you have used all your ingredients, take them out of the oven and place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and bake on a cooling rack to dry out. They should not brown. Let them cool. Make sure yours are completely cooled before storing in a cookie tin so they don't get soggy. Enjoy.

title: Tarragon Chickpeas Salad
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 can chickpeas | 1/3 cup wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh tarragon leaves
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling salted water, cook the potatoes until just tender, about 25 minutes. Drain potatoes, reserving 2 cups cooking water, and transfer to a bowl. Add 1 cup of the cooking liquid to the potatoes.

title: Pasta With Sweetcorn and Horseradish Dressing
ingredients: 500 g penne pasta, about 30g | 2 tablespoons horseradish, drained in a small bowl and finely shredded | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 400 g sweetcorn | 125 g creamed corn
instructions: Cook the penne pasta in a large saucepan of boiling water for 8 minutes or until al dente. Drain well and return to the pan. While the pasta is cooking, blend the horseradish with the mustard, vinegar and sweetcorn. Add the cream and toss to combine. Drain the pasta and toss through the salad. Serve immediately.

title: Rigatoni & Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1 lb yellow pepper, cut into 1/2-inch squares | 12 slices thick-cut bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces | cooked basmati rice or quinoa | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Bring 6 cups of water to a boil. In a large pot of boiling water, cook rigatoni until al dente, about 1 minute. Drain. Meanwhile, place peppers in a steamer basket over boiling water. When the water starts to boil, cook until tender but still firm. When pasta is done, drain, reserving 1 cup of the cooking water. While water is coming to a boil, place strips of bacon in a medium frying pan. Fry over medium heat until golden, turning once. Season with pepper. Drain, and add to skillet with peppers and bacon drippings. Turn heat to high. Stir fry until peppers are soft. Serve over cooked rice. Serve with additional pepper.

title: Moroccan Spiced Cashews
ingredients: 1 lb fresh cashews | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, grind cashews until very fine and slightly coarsely ground. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Store in tightly covered jar in a cool, dark, dry place for up to 2 months. Note, if harissa is used, it can be substituted with sea salt and additional ground red pepper. Variations, for a milder spice, add paprika. Or salt or ground cumin. For a milder spice, add ground ginger. Note, for a nutty flavour, use 1 tb paprika for 1/2 teacups dried aniseed.
